Dameŋ fufuŋkenao Anutuzi sambâŋ â mâreŋ bâfuac‐jofawec.
Ehame mâreŋ e sisifucne â tacne fowec, â ʒâkâŋ ʒora duŋdapâczi foŋkewec, ehame opâ faicko Wofuŋte Mârozi teŋ hâmorâ rac warec ewec.
Eme Anutuzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Tamaeoc!” Mume tamaewec.
Eme Anutuzi tatamac honeme biaŋkeme tatamac â dapâc bâtâc bacjofawec.
Ehuc tatamacte ʒâŋe ʒoaŋ â dapâcte ʒâŋe ŋafe mujactewec. Iŋuc eme hae ŋaferâ fureme ʒoaŋ 1 tarawec.
Tarame Anutuzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Opâ ŋondeŋko aka sanaŋ moc fuaoc, ehuc izi opâ bâtâc bazejec.”
Iŋuc mume opâ ŋondeŋko aka sâko fuarâ izi opâ bârâwiŋneme tâcnerâ faic moc ewec â juwic moc ewec.
Iŋuc fuame Anutuzi aka irec ʒâŋe sawa muwec. Eme hae ŋaferâ fureme ʒoaŋ 2 tarawec.
Tarame Anutuzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Sambâŋ rurumaŋnao opâ mockoa qâzuckepie kereŋnezi fua tâcneoc!” Mume iŋuc fuawec.
Eme Anutuzi kereŋne irec ʒâŋe mâreŋ muwec â opâ ʒâkâŋ sâko irec ʒâŋe hâwec muwec. Eme honeme biaŋkewec.
Eme Anutuzi muwec: “Mâreŋte faio wiac fofone i âkeʒurâ wefuoc! Nânâ monʒaŋ ʒariŋ wiac ukichec sasawa, â jâc wiac hândâŋ ukichec sasawa, iŋucne fuŋne fuŋne wefunʒepieŋ!” Mume iŋuc hâcne fuawec.
Mâreŋzi âke sueme nânâ monʒaŋ ʒariŋ wiac fuŋne fuŋne, ukic‐jeŋichec sasawa wefumbiŋ, â jâc fuŋne fuŋne fârihec â fârimaŋko ukic‐jeŋichec sasawa. Eme Anutuzi honeme biaŋkewec.
Iŋuc eme hae ŋaferâ fureme ʒoaŋ 3 tarawec.
Tarame Anutuzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Sambâŋko ʒoctamac fua raniŋ. Jaŋe hâcne ʒoaŋ â ŋafe bâtâc bacjofanʒepieŋ, ehuc hoemaŋ â sâko ʒoaŋ, gie bapa â jara irec dameŋ mufua‐nârehuc doma ranʒepieŋ!
Ehuc sambâŋte ʒoctamac erâ mâreŋ âke tamaenʒepieŋ!” Mume iŋuc fuawec.
Anutuzi iŋuc ehuc ʒoctamac sâko jajahec bâfuac‐jofawec, kâcɋene moc e ʒoaŋko micne barâ juocte â kâkâcɋene moc e ŋafeo micne barâ juocte. Erâ wâc bâpiŋ mâmâc bâfuac‐jopawec.
Jaŋe mâreŋ âke tamaeniŋte â ŋafe ʒoaŋ soŋaŋ‐jofahuc dapâc â tatamac bâtâc bacjofaniŋte Anutuzi sambâŋko hâcne râec‐jopawec.
Eme Anutuzi honeme biaŋkewec.
Iŋuc eme hae ŋaferâ fureme ʒoaŋ 4 tarawec.
Tarame Anutuzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Opâ jaŋere maŋko opâ qowi fuŋne fuŋnezi fuarâ fusucmapie qiriŋ sâko fuazejec â wipe jaŋe sawao furuc furuc qahuc junʒepieŋ!” Mume fuawec.
Anutuzi hâwec qowi sâko mako mecne â wiac jujune fuŋne fuŋne opâmaŋko qiriŋhec foŋgopieŋ, â wipe fakechec fuŋne fuŋne, iŋuc bâfuac‐joparâ honeme biaŋkewec.
Eme Anutuzi ʒiŋuc muhuc jambuŋ‐jopawec: “Ŋoŋe ukichec erâ sawe mâririackehuc opâ hâwec sâcke‐fârenʒepieŋ â wipe jaŋe mâreŋ faio sawenʒepieŋ!”
Iŋuc mume hae ŋaferâ fureme ʒoaŋ 5 tarawec.
Tarame Anutuzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Mâreŋzi wiac jujune fuŋne fuŋne kiweckerâ rozejec, hae qowi â homa gisic â kâte qowi fuŋne fuŋne!” Mume iŋuc fuawec.
Anutuzi hae qowi fuŋne fuŋne â kâte qowi fuŋne fuŋne erâ homa gisic wiac fuŋne fuŋne iŋuc hâcne bâfuac‐joparâ honeme biaŋkewec.
Eme Anutuzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ajoc! Nâŋâc nâŋâcne hawarire sâcko ŋic bâfuac‐jopanaŋ! Jaŋe hâwec qowi â sawa wipe â hae qowi â kâte qowi sasawa erâ homa gisic wiac mâreŋko babarâ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ ejarenʒepieŋ!”
Eme Anutu e hawari‐ticnere sâcko ŋic bâfuawec hâcne. Ŋic â ŋokac bâfuac‐jofawec.
Erâ jambuŋ‐jofahuc ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ɋârichec ehuc fua sawec erâ mâreŋ ŋefusucmahuc ruckenʒepieŋ. Ehuc hâwec qowi â sawa wipe â mâreŋ qowi gisic wiac sasawa ŋicwofuŋ ejarenʒepieŋ!”
Anutuzi iŋuc murâ ʒiŋuc jasawec: “No monʒaŋ wiac ukic‐ticne tie raekac â jâcfâri nânâne ukic‐ticnehec ʒi râe‐ŋactekopac, izi nânâ‐ŋekic ezejec.
Â mâreŋ qowi â sawa wipe â homa gisic wiac nokafehec bâfuac‐jopakicne, jaŋere nânâ ine sopâc hofâ qinʒiŋ wiac râekopac.” Eme iŋuc fuawec hâcne.
Eme Anutuzi wiac bâfuawec i hone‐fâreme biaŋne jâmbâŋ ewec. Eme hae mocwâc ŋaferâ fureme ʒoaŋ 6 tarawec.
Iŋuc hâcne ehuc sambâŋ â mâreŋ jahe kikefuŋ guru sâkofâc‐jekic jaŋehec bâfuac‐jopa‐fârekicne.
Eme ʒoaŋ 7 ira Anutuzi gie‐ticne batara‐fârehuc gie wiac bawec irec ŋemanaocte hombaŋ ŋewec.
Iŋuc ehuc Anutuzi ʒoaŋ 7 hâcne jambuŋkehuc bâtiriwec, i wiac mocte mâcne, wiac sasawa bâfua tararâ ŋemanaocte hombaŋ ŋewec.
Kecʒi sambâŋ â mâreŋ kikefuŋfâc‐jekic jaŋehec bâfuac‐jopa wefukicne irec binaŋ. Wofuŋ Anutuzi sambâŋ â mâreŋ bâfuac‐jofawec dameŋ ira jâc me monʒaŋ wiac fuŋne fuŋne mâreŋko mi fua rawec,
i Wofuŋ Anuture micte hoezi moc mi hewecte, â gie hesarac ee ŋic mi bâfuac‐jopakicnere iŋuc hâcne fowec.
Dameŋ ira mâreŋ maŋnaonec rombâŋ sâkozi wefu fehuc waha mâreŋ bâgunuckewec.
Eme Wofuŋ Anutu e mâreŋzi ŋic moc basarickehuc sâkenao juju mâro ficneme hume ŋic e nokafe herâ ɋârewec.
Eme Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec Edeŋko jufu gie moc sararâ ŋic bâfuawec e ira râewec.
Eme Wofuŋ Anutuzi mâreŋ ecneme e jâc hone aŋacnehec â fâri nânânehec biaŋne fuŋne fuŋne âke sueme wefuwec, jufu ʒâʒâŋiŋnao ine jujujâc â fuŋne mamana jâc jahe wefupic.
Opâ kâcɋene moc e ine Edeŋ jufu gieonec wefurâ bâbâgunuc gie baku gieonec waha fâuckeme sohocne 4 ewec.
Moc ʒâŋene Pisoŋ, izi Hawila mâreŋ orâŋke‐fârekac. Ira gol fokac.
Mâreŋ irec gol i furi sâko. Ira wâc Bedolac sâfâ â Soham qânâ fokopirec.
Opâ ombâŋne moc ʒâŋene Gihoŋ. Eki Kusu mâreŋ orâŋke‐fârekac.
Â ombâŋne moc ʒâŋene Tigirisi, eki Asiria mâreŋ ʒoaŋ wewefu‐ticnao hurakac. Â ombâŋne moc ʒâŋe‐ticne Eufrata.
Eme Wofuŋ Anutuzi ŋic rorâ Edeŋ jufu gie ira hone soŋaŋ ehuc giene baocte râewec.
Râerâ ŋic ʒiŋuc mupaŋkecnewec: “Jufu gieo jâc fârihec doma raŋgopieŋ i sâcne ro nâc efârecmu.
Fuŋne mamana jâc mocjaha ere fârine moc mi nâjâmbâŋkezemec! Sifu nâcmuo ine hâmo‐jâmbâŋkecmu.”
Eme Wofuŋ Anutuzi muwec: “Ŋic e buc jume mi biaŋkekac. Irec no ere sâc jaha âgo babafic‐ticne moc bâfuazepac!”
Wofuŋ Anutu e hae qowi â kâte qowi sasawa â sawa wipe sasawa mâreŋzi bacjoparâ ŋiczi ʒâŋe‐jeŋic weniŋuc muocmu i hone manac eocte ŋictao amec‐jopa fisiwec. Eme ŋiczi ʒâŋe‐jeŋic mufuahuc muocmu i foocte muwec.
Eme ŋic e hae qoqi â kâte qowi â sawa wipe sasawa jaŋere ʒâŋe mufârewec. E jahacne sâc âgo babafic‐ticne moc ine mi bâfuawec.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutuzi ŋic ecneme guŋsâko qâmâckeme fowec. Eme tambaraŋne moc unuckerâ fofotacne biuczi bâbâzickewec.
Erâ Wofuŋ Anutu e ŋicte tambaraŋ rowec izi ŋokac moc barâ ŋictao jowa rawec.
Jowa rame ŋiczi honerâ muwec: “Keʒi jâmbomac siec‐nane â biuc‐nane! E ŋickonec rokicnere ʒâŋene Ŋokac mucnezo.”
Irec hâcne ŋiczi neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne behec‐jofarâ ŋonâŋ‐ticnerao qohotame jahe maŋ sahac mocjaha erâ junicmu.
Ŋic ŋokac jahe mâmâc jaha biuctac juhuc mi mimiepic.
Wofuŋ Anutu e kâtere wiac jujune gâcne bâfuac‐jopawec jaŋere sâc jâuru‐fârehuc homare gibioczi fejâmbâŋkewec. Eme homa e ŋokac ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnewec: “Jufuo jâc sasawa doma rakac irec fârine mi nânicte Anutuzi muwec me?”
Eme ŋokaczi homa âzâcnewec: “Nâhe jufuo jâcne jâcne doma rakac irec hândâŋne sâcne nanacte mana‐nâctekicne,
â jufu ʒâʒâŋiŋko jâc moc domakac irec hândâŋne ine Anutuzi mi nanacte, erâ wâc mi bâuanacte muwec, iŋuc erâ hâmozipecte.”
Eme homazi ŋokac âzâcnewec: “Aricne, ŋohe mi hâmonicmu.
Anutu e ʒiŋuc manakac: Ŋohe hândâŋ i nâpire ʒâŋe‐ŋekic tâcneme e jahacne iŋucne erâ biaŋne â sâqocne irec fuŋne mana taranicmu.”
Eme ŋokaczi jâc honerâ ʒiŋuc manawec: Jâchândâŋ i nânâne biaŋ â hawarine hone aŋac eene, erâ wâc mamana bâbâfua‐ticnehec muhuc maname biaŋkewec. Iŋuc eku hândâŋ i batararâ nâwec. Nâhuc ŋowene râcneme nâwec wâc.
Nâpire ʒâŋe‐jekic tâcnewec. Tâcneme biuctac jupic i hone tarapic. Irec qoŋgeŋ rehaczi siŋiŋ furâ jomapic.
Eme ʒoaŋ otewehuc hae urueme Wofuŋ Anutu e jufuo hata jume fânâŋ‐ticne manapic. Manarâ ŋic â ŋonâŋ‐ticne jahe Wofuŋ Anuture hâwic‐jofame jufuo jâc ŋondeŋko soŋkepic.
Ehame Wofuŋ Anutuzi ŋic wiracnerâ muwec: “Go wena?”
Eme muwec: “No jufuo hata jutec fânâŋge manarâ, biuctac jukopacte hâwicnume soŋkepac.”
Eki muwec: “Biuctac jukomec i mozi gazajec? Go jâchândâŋ mi nâcmurâ mupaŋke‐garepo i moc nâmec me?”
Ŋiczi muwec: “Ŋokac nohec juocte naremeŋ eki jâchândâŋne nareme napac.”
Eme Wofuŋ Anutuzi ŋokac âzâcnewec: “Go wemocte iŋuc emec?” Ŋokaczi muwec: “Homazi eatucnume napac.”
Eme Wofuŋ Anutuzi homa ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go iŋuc emecte ine hae qowi â kâte qowi jaŋeraonec go mocjaha sâwecgukopac. Go mâreŋko jucmu sâc bugezi foforâ juhuc gâc wândoc nâzemec.
Erâ go â ŋokac ŋoherao kikisâ sanaŋ râekopac, izi ɋâricge â ɋâric‐ticne jaherao wâc fozejec. Eme eki qizecge âtenʒaŋneocmu, goki ine kike kiririŋne kinʒaŋnecmu.”
Ŋokac ine ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Kiwechec juhaŋtec ʒâic bocjaha bâfua‐garepemu, eme gozi kicgukuhame naru motec rocjopazemec. Ŋowegere aŋacguha eki bomboŋ egarezejec.”
Adam ine ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go ŋonâŋgere dâŋ reŋkehuc jâchândâŋ mi nâjâmbâŋkecmurâ mupaŋke‐garepo i nâmec, irec gore ehuc mâreŋ sâweckekopac! Go ʒâic gie sâko tatara tâmiric bahuc nânâge bâfuazemec.
Ehame hofâ qinʒiŋ wiaczi giegao kosa fuaha irecnec monʒaŋ wiac nâhuc juzemec!
Fofoŋac sâkohec nânâge nârahuc juku mâreŋkonec rocgukicnere mocwâc risie mâreŋko jaha huzemec! Gâc wândoczi gâc wândocko jaha risiezemec!”
Eme ŋic e ŋonâŋ‐ticnere ʒâŋe Ewa muwec, e mâreŋko ŋic sasawa fuambeŋ nâŋâcne neŋgoc fuŋfuŋ ewec hâcne.
Eme Wofuŋ Anutu e qowi sahaczi ŋaqi ɋâtârâ ŋic ŋokac hejacteme hume rojupic.
Wofuŋ Anutu e iŋuc erâ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Jei! Ŋic e biac nâŋâcne sâcko biaŋne â sâqocne irec fuŋne mamana ejec! E meticne sicnerâ jujujâcte hândâŋ rorâ nâhuc juju sanaŋ juzacte mi manacnezo.”
Wofuŋ Anutu e iŋuc murâ ŋic soreme Edeŋ jufuonec hurâ rawec, e mâreŋzi bakicnere hu mâreŋ sawanao e jahac gie he sarac eocte.
Wofuŋ Anutuzi ŋic ŋokac iŋuc jâpec‐jofame hurapic. Eme Edeŋ jufu gie ʒoaŋ wewefu‐ticnao bâbâricte ʒocbâruŋ âkendâŋnehuc kerubim jajahec jahe jujujâcte hata âte bâzickenicte soŋaŋ râec‐jofawec.
Eme ŋic e ŋonâŋ‐ticne Ewa ehec jume motec kiweckerâ Kaiŋ rowec. Rorâ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Anutuzi baficnume ŋokâ moc fua‐narekac.”
Eme ʒuhuckerâ ɋaticne Abe rowec. E sokarâ noniŋ â lama jaŋere hone soŋaŋ gie bawec. Kaiŋ e ine hesarac ŋic erâ juwec.
Eme jufeku Kaiŋzi gieonec nânâ wiac rorâ Wofuŋ taha bâzi rikecnewec.
Â Abe e iŋuc jaha lamafâcne mârâc fufua irecnec moc hezurâ wokemaŋne rorâ bâzi rikewec. Eme Wofuŋzi Abe jahacne â bâzi‐ticne hone biaŋkewec.
Kaiŋ â bâzi‐ticne ine hone takirewec. Iŋuc eme Kaiŋ e mâretec aarickeme ʒâŋe maine enduŋkewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Kaiŋ âzâcnewec: “Wemocte aaricgume ʒâŋe maige enduŋkekomec?
Go biaŋne jutec mana‐garepe sâckeocmu. Biaŋne mi jucmuo ine sâqocnezi motâc râpeo soŋkerâ ruc bagareocmu. E gore hâcne ecnekac, go ine aka hecnezemec.”
Eme Kaiŋzi ɋaticne Abe âzâcne muwec: “Nâhâc gieo ranac.” Mume gieo ra jupic, ehuc Kaiŋzi fahare ɋaticne Abe qarâ qâhâmowec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Kaiŋ ʒiŋuc wiocnewec: “Ɋage Abe wena jukac?” Eki muwec: “Mi manakopac, no ɋananere soŋaŋ me?”
Eme Wofuŋzi muwec: “Go wemo wiac emec? Ɋagere soczi mâreŋko wira wâwâsic enareme manakopac.
Irec sâwec faigao fekac, ehuc mâreŋ, micne aŋkehuc ɋagere soc megaonec rorâ nâjec, mâreŋ izi jâpecgukac.
Hesarac gie batec mâreŋzi guec‐ticnere fârine sakare‐garezejec. Eme wise wise juhuc ra ju ware ju ezemec.”
Eme Kaiŋzi Wofuŋ âzâcnewec: “Okacne narekic i bâmâmâckekopac.
Go miŋecgac gie hesarac mâreŋkonec jâpecnukomec, irec ʒâŋesoŋ bagarerâ wise wise juhuc ra ju ware ju epemu, ehame ŋiczi bâfuacnurâ qâhâmocnuniŋmu.”
Eme Wofuŋzi muwec: “Iŋuc misac, moc e Kaiŋ qâhâmome okacne arec 7 irec sâc râcnezo.” Iŋuc murâ Kaiŋ sahacnao maqâreŋ moc râewec, moczi moc bâfuarâ qanʒipiŋte.
Eme Kaiŋ e Wofuŋte maionec rarâ mâreŋ moc ʒâŋene Nodi, Edeŋ ʒoaŋ wewefu‐ticnao, ira juwec.
Eme Kaiŋ e ŋonâŋ‐ticne ehec jume motec kiweckerâ Enoko rowec. Eme Kaiŋ e hae moc barâ ŋokâ‐ticnere wase bahuc ʒâŋene Enoko jaha muwec.
Enokore ŋokâ moc fuawec ʒâŋene Iradi, eme ere bifuŋko Mehujae fuawec, Mehujae ere bifuŋko Metusae fuawec, Metusae ere bifuŋko Lamec fuawec.
Lamec e ine ŋokac jajahec rocjofawec, moc ʒâŋene Ada, moc Zila.
Ada e motec kiweckerâ Jabali rowec, e qoruc bozeo juju fofo eere â bec bulimakao hone soŋaŋ giere fufuŋke ŋic.
Jabali ɋaticnere ʒâŋe ine Jubali. E gita â mimi ŋokac irec fufuŋke ŋic ewec.
Zila e iŋuc jaha motec kiweckerâ ŋokâ moc rowec ʒâŋene Tubali‐Kaiŋ, eki aeŋzi wiac fuŋne fuŋne bapa ŋicguru jaŋere fufuŋke ŋic â micne ewec. Tubali‐Kaiŋ seŋticnere ʒâŋe ine Nama.
Juku Lamec e ŋonâŋ jahec‐ticne hefârec‐jofarâ ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ada â Zila, ŋohe hazec râerâ dâŋnane mananic! Ŋonâŋ jahec‐nane, ŋohe saoreŋ gae‐nane maŋkenic! Jâmbomac jâmbâŋ, wicte okacne ŋic moc qapo, â ʒâpâ nukicnere ine motec mac moc.
Kaiŋ qaocmuzi okacne arec 7 roocmu â Lamec no nuocmuzi ine okacne arec 77 roocmu.”
Adam e ŋonâŋ‐ticnehec mocwâc jume kiwechec erâ motec moc rowec. Eme ʒâŋe‐ticne ʒiŋuc manasuhuc Sete muwec: Kaiŋzi Abe qawecte ere âkehoc Anuturaonec ŋic ukic biaŋ mocwâc fisi‐narekac.
Eme Sete e iŋuc jaha ŋokâ moc fuacneme ʒâŋene Enosi muwec. Eme dameŋ ira hâcne ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋ ʒâŋe‐ticne bâtirihuc nunumucne gie i fuŋkembiŋ.
Kecʒi Adamte ɋâricfâc jaŋere ʒâŋe biri papia: Anutuzi Adam bâfuawec dameŋ ira e jahacne hawarire sâcko hâcne bâfuawec.
Ŋic â ŋokac bâfuac‐jofarâ ʒâŋe‐jekic ŋic â ŋokac iŋuc mujacterâ jambuŋ‐jofawec.
Eme ŋic e jara 130 bazuhame ere bifuŋko ŋokâ moc, e jahacne sâc â hawari iŋucne fuawec, eme ʒâŋe‐ticne Sete muwec.
Adam e Sete fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 800 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Adam e iŋuc jufeku jara 930 bazurâ hâmowec.
Sete e jara 105 bazume ere bifuŋko Enosi fuawec.
Sete e Enosi fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 807 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Sete e iŋuc jufeku jara 912 bazurâ hâmowec.
Enosi e jara 90 bazume ere bifuŋko Kenaŋ fuawec.
Enosi e Kenaŋ fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 815 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Enosi e iŋuc jufeku jara 905 bazurâ hâmowec.
Kenaŋ e jara 70 bazume ere bifuŋko Mahalale fuawec.
Kenaŋ e Mahalale fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 840 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Kenaŋ e iŋuc jufeku jara 910 bazurâ hâmowec.
Mahalale e jara 65 bazume ere bifuŋko Jarede fuawec.
Mahalale e Jarede fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 830 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Mahalale e iŋuc jufeku jara 895 bazurâ hâmowec.
Jarede e jara 162 bazume ere bifuŋko Enoko fuawec.
Jarede e Enoko fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 800 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Jarede e iŋuc jufeku jara 962 bazurâ hâmowec.
Enoko e jara 62 bazume ere bifuŋko Metusela fuawec.
Enoko e Anutuhec ʒuʒuhuc jâmbâŋ jupic. Enokozi ŋokâ‐ticne Metusela fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 300 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Enoko e iŋuc juku jara 365 bazuwec.
E Anutuhec ʒuʒuhuc jufeku sipuac ewec. I Wofuŋ e jahac jowawec hâcne.
Metusela e jara 187 bazume ere bifuŋko Lamec fuawec.
Metusela e Lamec fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 782 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Metusela e iŋuc jufeku jara 969 bazurâ hâmowec.
Lamec e jara 182 bazume ere bifuŋko ŋokâ moc fuawec.
Fuame ʒiŋuc muhuc ʒâŋene Noa muwec: “Anutuzi mâreŋ sâweckewecte ʒâic busâqoc faio gie sâko bahuc juhapene motec eki bâmiriŋ‐nâpozejec!”
Lamec e Noa fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 595 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Lamec e iŋuc jufeku jara 777 bazurâ hâmowec.
Noa e jara 500 bazume ere bifuŋko ŋokâ 3 fuambiŋ, ʒâŋe‐jeŋic Sem, Ham â Jafete.
Ŋiczi mâreŋko sawe mâririackezo ehapie narufâc‐jeŋic wâc bocjaha fuambiŋ,
dameŋ ira nemu jaŋe ŋic jaŋere narufâc hawari biaŋ honec‐jopambiŋ, erâ honebâc‐jopambiŋ sâc ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic bacjopambiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi muwec: “Nore tâpirizi ŋicko mi fofehuc juzejec, ŋic e mâreŋkonec, sahac biuchec, mâreŋko juju‐ticnere jara dameŋ 130 mocwâc mi jâuruzejec.”
Dameŋ ira nemu â mâreŋ ŋokac jaŋe turepie ŋicsâko mako ʒâŋe biŋehec fuarâ jurambiŋ.
Eme ŋic jaŋe mâreŋko mamakâc sâko fuŋne fuŋne ehuc maŋ sâc wiac sâqocne sasawa ʒuʒuhuc maŋke jumbiŋte
Wofuŋzi i honerâ mâreŋŋic bâfuac‐jopawec irec erâ bunezi hâhâtâwewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi muwec: “Ŋic bâfuac‐jopapo jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopape mâreŋko omaenʒepieŋ, qowi â gisic wiac â sawa wipe jaŋe mâmâc, jaŋe bâfuac‐jopapore bunane hâhâtâwekac!”
Noa e ine Anutuzi hone ʒemuraŋ ecnewec.
E tiŋne â mitinezi ŋic ŋondeŋko juwec, ehuc Anutuhec ʒâʒâfic sanaŋ erâ juwec.
Ehame ere bifuŋko ŋokâ 3 fuambiŋ, ʒâŋe‐jeŋic Sem, Ham â Jafete. Noare binaŋ iŋuc.
Â mâreŋŋic gâcne jaŋe ine Anuture maio sâqore‐fârepie sindaŋ hârindaŋzi mâreŋ fusucmawec.
Eme Anutuzi mâreŋ honeme sâqore‐jâmbâŋkewec, mâreŋŋic juju â eebapa‐jeŋic sifuc safucke‐fârerâ fowec.
Eme irec Anutuzi Noa ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No mâreŋŋic jaŋere dameŋ taraocte manapaŋkekopac. Jaŋe sindaŋ hârindaŋ‐jeŋiczi mâreŋ fusucmakacte no bâsirowec‐jopapemu.
Irec go marojâc herâ izi woke moc bazemec. Erâ âke tâcnetec maŋne maŋne fua‐fâreme maŋne â sahacne sâfâzi ʒimickezemec.
Woke sâcticne kecʒiŋuc bazemec: Ʒoricne‐ticne kubi 300, otecne‐ticne kubi 50 â hâŋne‐ticne kubi 30.
Erâ bupune bâbâzickehuc sâcmutâcte sâcko faic motâc piticne moc bazemec â motâc jâmbâŋ‐ticne ine neŋgocnaopec râezemec. Maŋnao feŋgaŋne jahec â moc fuanʒepieŋ.
Manakic, no mâreŋko ŋic juŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârepemurâ rumi sâko bâfuape mâreŋko wiac jujune forakac i omae‐fâreocmu.
Gohec ine ʒâʒâfic fârine ekopac. Goki wokeo ferâ juzemec, go â ŋonâŋge â ŋokâ joŋaofâcge, jaŋe gohec mâmâc wokeo ferâ junʒepeiŋ.
Â wipe qowi jaŋe sipiricke‐fârenʒipiŋte jaŋeraonec jajahec jajahec, ŋicne ŋokacne iŋuc aŋa sâsâc rocjopatec gohec mâmâc wokeo fenʒepieŋ.
Wipe fuŋne fuŋne, qowi fuŋne fuŋne, â homa gisic wiac fuŋne fuŋne jaŋeraonec jajahec jajahec gohec mâmâc wokeo raʒirâ junʒepieŋ.
Â wiac nânâne i me i fokac sâc mâmâc nuse qâzuc efârerâ wokeo rotec feme izi gahacne â wipe qowi jaŋere juju dopeckezejec.”
Eme Noa e Anutuzi muwec sâc micdâŋ‐ticne reŋke‐fârerâ ejâmbâŋkewec. Noa e iŋuc hâcne ewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Noa ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Go â wiacfâcge ŋoŋe wokeo fefârenʒepieŋ, go ŋicguru ʒi jaŋere ŋondeŋko mitihec jukomecte honecgupe biaŋkekac.
Irec go qowi nânâne jaŋeraonec 7, 7, ŋicne â ŋokacne aŋa sâsâc â qowi mi nânâne jaŋeraonec jajahec jajahec rowosâec‐jopac.
Â sawa wipe jaŋeraonec iŋuc jaha 7, 7, ŋicne â ŋokacne rocjopatec gohec wokeo fefârenʒepieŋ, mâreŋte faio wiac jujunere ukicnezi omaezacte.
Eme no ʒoaŋ 7 tarame mupe hoe micsâko mâreŋko hehuc domahame ŋafe ʒoaŋ 40 taraocmu. Iŋuc ehuc wiac jujune bâfuapo i mâmâc sasawa mâreŋkonec bâsirowe‐fârepemu.”
Eme Noazi Wofuŋte micdâŋ i reŋkehuc efârewec.
Noa e jara 600 bazume faicnao rumi sâkozi mâreŋko fisiwec.
Fisizo ehame Noa e jahacne â ŋonâŋ‐ticne erâ ŋokâ joŋaofâcne jaŋe mâmâc wokeo fefârembiŋ.
Ehame qowi nânâne â mi nânâne, erâ wipe â homa gisic wiac i jaŋe
jajahec jajahec sasawa, ŋicne ŋokacne aŋa sâsâc, iŋuczi Noahec wokeo mâmâc fembiŋ, Anutuzi Noa mutâcnecnewec irec sâc jâmbâŋ fembiŋ hâcne.
Eme ʒoaŋ 7 hâcne tarame mâreŋko rumi sâko fisiwec.
Noare jara dameŋ 600 irec mosa 2‐re ʒoaŋ gie bapa 17 ira opâ â hâwec ʒâkâŋ neŋgocne juwicnec soka siwiŋ ewefuhapie sawaonec opâ motâc aŋkeme
hoe micsâko jâmbâŋ hehuc foha ʒoaŋ 40 â ŋafe 40 ewec.
Eme ʒoaŋ ijaha Noa â ŋonâŋ‐ticne erâ ŋokâfâcne Sem, Ham â Jafete â ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic, jaŋe mâmâc wokeo fefârembiŋ.
Erâ hae qowi â kâte qowi fuŋne fuŋne â homa gisic wiac fuŋne fuŋne â wipe fuŋne fuŋne suhuc fakechec jaŋeraonec jajahec jajahec sasawa,
ŋicne ŋokacne aŋa sâsâc jaŋe wâc Noahec fefârehapie mâsi sâko i hâcne fuawec.
Wiac jujune moc mi behekicne, Anutuzi Noa mutâcnecnewec sâc fefârembiŋ. Fefârehapie Wofuŋzi motâc herâ sahacnao ki bawec.
Ehame rumi sâko hâcne fisime opâ jaŋe siwiŋne fehuc woke eferenʒoŋkepie mâreŋkonec fahare fewec.
Eme opâ jaŋe soka siwiŋ ehuc hâhâwicne qaratiepie wokezi opâ faio rac warec ewec.
Eme opâ jaŋe mâreŋ faio mocwâc âke sue feku tiki ʒora doma raŋgopieŋ i mâmâc sasawa qâuruc‐jopa‐fârembiŋ.
Opâzi tiki botâŋ‐jeŋic sirickewec ine kubi 15 irec sâc.
Iŋuc eme mâreŋ faio wiac jujune omaewec, wipe mecne, hae qowi mecne, kâte qowi mecne, â homa gisic wiac mecne, mâreŋko babarâ jueŋgopieŋ, erâ wâc mâreŋŋic mâmâc, jaŋe sipiricke‐fârembiŋ.
Mâreŋko wiac jujune, nokafehec, jaŋe hâmo‐fârembiŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc Anutuzi mâreŋko wiac jujune sasawa, ŋic me qowi me gisic wiac, me wipe, i jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârewec. Noa â ehec woke maŋnao jumbiŋ, jaŋe sawa akic‐jopawec.
Eme opâ sâko jaŋe mâreŋ faio siwiŋne fehapie ʒoaŋ 150 tarawec.
Dameŋ ira Anutuzi Noare manasuhuc qowi wiac ehec wokeo jumbiŋ jaŋere mâmâc manasuwec. Iŋuc ehuc mume mâŋâŋ sâko qame opâ sâko e fâre wahawec.
Eme opâ mârâc juwic ʒâkâŋkonec wefuwec i mecne â faic sawa motâc aŋkeme wahawec i mâmâc Anutuzi aka hejareme ʒicke kereŋ embiŋ.
Eme mâreŋ faio opâ jaŋe fofo‐jeŋickoa risiehuc qâzucke‐fârepie opâ sâko fâre wahawec. Ʒoaŋ 150 irec faicnao hâcne fuŋkehuc fâre wahawec.
Fâre wahakume wokezi mosa 7 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 17 ira Ararata tiki botâŋne mocko hesanaŋkerâ ŋewec.
Juku opâ e fâre wahakume mosa 10 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 1 ira tiki botâŋ‐jeŋic tâtâc fua rawec.
Eme ʒoaŋ 40 tarame Noazi faic motâc pitic, mârâc bakicne i rorâ
kâec kâec moc soreme sawao rac warec ehuc juhame mâreŋko opâ kereŋkewec.
Eme jurâ jurâ Noazi hapâ moc soreme rawec, mâreŋko opâ fâre wahawec me mâcne, irec fuŋne mana‐hâmoocte.
Hapâzi rac warec ehuc, opâzi mâreŋ sâockewecte ŋeŋe basaku mocwâc Noarao risiewec. Eme Noazi meticne sicnerâ hapâ ro wokemaŋko râewec.
Eme mocwâc ʒoaŋ 7 woŋec juku hapâ ijaha soreme rawec.
Eme hapâzi owâcne erao risiehuc mi oliwa rehacne ɋâricne barezejec i! Iŋuc eme Noazi fuŋne ʒiŋuc manawec: Opâ fâre wahame mâreŋ fua rakac.
Eme mocwâc ʒoaŋ 7 woŋec ŋeku hapâ moc soreme rawec. Eki rarâ mocwâc mi risiewec.
Noare jara dameŋ 601 irec mosa wâŋte ʒoaŋ gie bapa 1 ira opâ sâko mâreŋ faio fowec i kereŋke‐fârewec. Eme Noazi wokere bupu bâropierâ honewec: Mâreŋ faio opâ ʒickewec hâcne.
Eme mosa 2 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 27 ira mâreŋzi kereŋkerâ fowec.
Eme Anutuzi Noa ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec:
“Go â ŋonâŋge erâ ŋokâ joŋaofâcge, ŋoŋe wokeonec wahaniŋ!
Erâ qowi mecne, wipe homa gisic wiac mecne, gohec wokeo juŋgopieŋ jaŋe ejaretec waha‐fârerâ fua sawec ehuc mâreŋ sâcke‐fârenʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Noa â ŋonâŋ‐ticne â ŋokâ joŋaofâc‐ticne,
erâ qowi sasawa â wipe â homa gisic sasawa, hawari‐jeŋic sâc wokeonec wahambiŋ.
Waha‐fârepie Noazi Wofuŋte alata moc barâ qowi â wipe nânâne jaŋeraonec moc moc iŋuc rocjopaku Anuture bâzi rikec‐jopawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi bâbâmiriŋte âsu manahuc maŋticnao ʒiŋuc muwec: “No mâreŋko wiac jujuhec i ŋicte ehuc mocwâc mi sâweckezepac. Ŋic jaŋe ɋieonecteaŋ maŋjeŋiczi mamanasu gie repicne baraʒihuc juniŋmu, no ine sifu ŋicte erâ wiac jujuhec mocwâc mi bâsirowepemu.
Mâreŋte dameŋ fofeocmu sâc: Hesarac â qa roro, mâmâteŋ â fâroroc, hoe dameŋ â ʒoaŋ dameŋ, ŋafe â furec iŋuczi iŋuc ʒuʒuhuc fofehuc juzejec!”
Eme Anutuzi Noa â ŋokâfâcne ʒiŋuc muhuc jambuŋ‐jopawec: “Ŋoŋe fua sawec ehuc mâreŋ ŋefusucmanʒepieŋ.
Erâ kâte qowi â sawa wipe jaŋe ŋoŋere hâhâwic bahuc wise wise junʒepieŋ. Homa gisic wiac mâreŋko foforâ juekac â hâwec qowi jaŋe mâmâc ŋoŋere meo râec‐jopa‐fârekopac.
Erâ monʒaŋ wiac ŋarekopac i â wiac jujune qiriŋ‐ticnehec i nânâ‐ŋeŋic efârezejec.
Mocjaha, qowi socnehec ine mi nânʒepieŋ! Erâ ʒiŋuc mananiŋ:
Socŋeŋicte okacne i noni batarapemu. Ŋicjuju irec okacne qowi jaŋerao, me ŋic jaŋerao, me âgo soctofa jaŋerao i nonizia batara‐jâmbâŋkepemu.
Ŋic e mocte hawario mâcne, Anutu nore hawarire sâcko bakicne, irec moc e ŋicsoc hoŋkeocmu, ere soc ŋiczia wâc hoŋkenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ine ukichec ehuc sawe mâririackenʒepieŋ. Eme mâreŋ rauckehuc guriŋne banʒepieŋ!”
Anutuzi iŋuc murâ Noa â ŋokâfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“No ʒi ŋoŋe â ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic sanaŋ ekopac,
erâ wâc wiac jujune sasawa, ŋoŋehec wokeonec wahambieŋ, jaŋehec mâmâc, wipe â kâte qowi â hae qowi sasawa,
ŋoŋehec mâmâc ʒâʒâfic sanaŋ ekopac, irec rumi sâko mocwâc fisirâ mâreŋte wiac jujune â mâreŋ e jahacne mi imac‐ŋopa‐fârezejec!”
Erâ Anutuzi ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “No ʒi ŋoŋe â wiac jujune sasawa ŋoŋehec ʒâʒafic sanaŋ ekopac.
Irec maqâreŋ‐nane huriri keci sawao râekopac, izi ʒâʒâfic‐nâŋecte ma ezejec.
Nore micte hoe karorac qâzuckeha manane i sawao fuame
no ʒâʒâfic sanaŋ irec manasupemu, ehame opâ rumi sâkozi mâreŋte wiac jujune mocwâc mi imackezejec.
Eme no huriri hâcne karoracko domaocmu sâc, ʒâŋitahuc mâreŋko wiac jujune sasawa ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic sanaŋ epo irec manasupemu.”
Anutuzi iŋuc murâ ʒuhuckerâ Noa ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mâreŋko ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic sanaŋ ekopac irec ma ine hâcne!”
Noare ŋokâfâc wokeonec wahambiŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe Sem, Ham â Jafete. Ham e ine Kanaaŋte mamac.
Ŋic jahec â moc keci jaŋe hâcne Noare ŋokâfâc, jaŋeraonec mâreŋŋic gurune gurune fua sawec ewarekicne.
Noa e ine hesarac ŋic juwec, ehuc waiŋ gie wâc fuŋkewec.
Juku waiŋ opâne barâ nâku maŋne bibiriwame qoruc boze‐ticnao waha iŋke aŋke ehuc fowec.
Eme Ham, Kanaaŋte mamac hâcne, e mamac‐ticne Noa ere fuŋne honehuc hahac jahec‐ticne mâreŋko hu dâŋ binaŋ ejactewec.
Eme Sem â Jafete jahe ŋaqi moc rorâ ɋawe‐jekicko râehuc rârâpe bozeo raʒirâ mamac‐jekic biuctac fohame mi honehuc qofackepic.
Eme Noa e waiŋzi qame guŋ sanaŋ foweckonec ɋârerâ motec‐ticnezi wiac kosa ecnewec irec dâŋ manarâ ʒiŋuc muwec:
“Sâweczi Kanaaŋ ere faio fezejec, e hahac jahec‐ticne jahere kiŋaŋ motec wawahane juzejec!”
Iŋuc murâ ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Wofuŋ Anutu‐nanezi Sem jambuŋkezejec ehame Kanaaŋ e ine kiŋaŋ motec‐ticne juzejec!”
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Anutuzi Jafete bafickeme sawe mâririackezejec, ehame ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋe Semte ɋâricfâc jaŋehec ŋeŋe juju enʒepieŋ, â Kanaaŋ e ine kiŋaŋ qaqa‐ticne ezejec.”
Rumi sâkozi omaeweckonecteaŋ Noa e jara 350 ʒuhuckerâ juwec.
Juku jara 950 bazurâ hâmowec.
Noa ŋokâfâcne jaŋere ɋâricfâc jaŋere ʒâŋe biri ʒine hâcne: Sem, Ham â Jafete jaŋe rumi sâkozi omaewec irec faicnao ŋokâ fua‐jarembiŋ.
Jafete ere ŋokâfâc jaŋere ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc: Gomera, Magogo, Madai, Jawaŋ, Tubali, Meseke â Tirase.
Gomera ere ŋokâfâc ine Asakenasi, Rifata â Togama.
Â Jawaŋte ŋokâ jahec ine: Elisa â Tarasisi; jaheraonec Kitim â Dodanim ŋicguru fuambiŋ.
Jaŋeraonec guru gâcne gâcne fua rambiŋ, mâreŋ‐jeŋic sâc â dâŋjeŋic sâc â kikefuŋ guru‐jeŋic sâc, jaŋe Jafetere ɋâricfâc hâcne.
Ham ere ŋokâfâc jaŋere ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc: Kusu, Miziraim, Puti â Kanaaŋ.
Kusure ŋokâfâc ine Seba, Hawila, Sabita, Rama â Sabateka. Â Ramare ŋokâ jahec jahere ʒâŋe ine Seba â Dedaŋ.
Kusure bifuŋko ine Nimorodi fuawec, eki hâcne mâreŋko ŋicwofuŋ fekicne juju i fuŋkewec.
Nimorodi e Wofuŋte maio wosaŋeŋ bapa kâcɋene juwec, irec ŋic jaŋe ere qâqiŋ qahuc ʒiŋuc mujumbieŋ: “Wofuŋte maio wosaŋeŋ bapa kâcɋene, Nimorodi ere sâcko.”
Uucmaŋ‐ticnere fufuŋke hae barawec ine Babe, Ereki, Akada â Kalene, jaŋe sasawa Sina mâreŋko ŋerambiŋ.
Irecnec rarâ Asiria mâreŋko fisirâ hae biri moc ʒiŋuc bâfua rawec: Niniwe, Rehoboti‐Iri, Kala
â Reseŋ, izi Niniwe â Kala ŋondeŋ‐jekicko ŋekac erâ hae sâko jâmbâŋ.
Â Miziraim ere ɋâricfâc guru sâc ʒâŋe‐jeŋic ʒiŋuc: Ludi, Anami, Lehabi, Nafituhi,
Patarusi â Kasiluhi. Jaŋeraonec Filisa â Kafatori jaŋe fua sawec embiŋ.
Â Kanaaŋ ere mârâc motec ine Sidoŋ â ere râpeo ine Heti erâ guru gâcne ʒiŋuc:
Jebusi, Amori, Girigasi,
Hiwi, Areki, Sini
â Arawadi, Semari â Hamati, guru iŋuc fua rambiŋ. Eme faicnao Kanaaŋ ere ɋâricfâc jaŋe râwiŋnehuc qaratierâ jurambiŋ.
Kanaaŋ ŋicguru jaŋere mâreŋ qaŋeŋnezi Sidoŋ haeonec fuŋkerâ hae ʒiŋuc fotâcne rakac: Gerari, Gaza, Sodom, Gomora, Adama, Seboim â Lasa. Ira tarakac.
Hamte ɋâricfâc jaŋe iŋuc, guru‐jeŋic sâc â dâŋjeŋic sâc erâ mâreŋ‐jeŋic sâc biric‐jopa wahakicne.
Jafete hahac‐ticne Sem, Ebere ere ɋâricfâc jaŋere mamac fuŋfuŋ, ere ŋokâfâc wâc fuambiŋ.
Sem ŋokâfâcne jaŋere ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc: Elam, Asihuru, Arapakisa, Ludi â Aram.
Aram ere ŋokâfâc ine Usi â Hulu, Getere â Masi.
Arapakisa ere bifuŋko ine Sela â Sela ere bifuŋko ine Ebere.
Â Ebere ere ŋokâ ine jajahec fuapic, moc ʒâŋe‐ticne Pelege mukicne, ere dameŋko mâreŋŋic fâucke râwiŋ embiŋte. Ɋaticnere ʒâŋe ine Jokataŋ.
Jokataŋ ere bifuŋko fuambiŋ ine ʒiŋuc: Alamoda, Selefe, Hazamawe, Jera,
Hadoram, Uʒali, Dikila,
Obali, Abimae, Seba,
Ofiri, Hawila â Jobabe; ŋic keci jaŋe Jokataŋ ere ŋokâfâc sasawa.
Fic hae biri‐jeŋiczi ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec tiki mâreŋko Mesanec fuŋkerâ ŋeraku Sefara ira tarakac.
Semte ɋâricfâc ine hâcne, guru‐jeŋic sâc â dâŋjeŋic sâc erâ mâreŋ‐jeŋic sâc biric‐jopa wahakicne.
Noa ŋokâfâc‐ticne jaŋere ɋâricfâc iŋuc, kikefuŋ gurune gurune fuambiŋ sâc râec‐jopa wahakicne. Rumi sâko fisiwec irec faicnao jaŋeraonec hâcne mâreŋŋic gurune gurune fua warembiŋ.
Mâreŋŋic sasawa dâŋmarac‐jeŋic mocjaha fowec â wiac ʒâŋene ʒâŋene ijaha sasawa mujumbieŋ.
Eme jaŋe ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec rahuc juku Sina mâreŋko wâneŋ sâko moc bâfuarâ ira fic hae erâ jumbiŋ.
Erâ kecʒiŋuc muc manac embiŋ: “Ajoc, nâŋâc afe qâhâckerâ ʒocko rikepene sanaŋkeoc.” Eme afe sanaŋkekicne izi fic bapa qânâ ejarewec â mâreŋ maŋkonec sâfâ izi simeŋ ejarewec.
Eme mumbiŋ: “Ajoc, nâŋâc hae sâko moc barâ ficʒora moc feŋgaŋne feŋgaŋne râe fekupene botâŋnezi sambâŋ âke uazejec. Eme ʒâŋe biŋehec erâ siŋsaŋ qahuc mâreŋne mâreŋne mi ranʒepeneŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ hae sâko â ficʒora bambiŋ i Wofuŋzi honeocte wahawec.
Erâ muwec: “Jâmbomac, jaŋe ŋicguru mocjaha â dâŋmarac‐jeŋic wâc mocjaha, erâ gie baniŋte mu biric embieŋ i mâc fufuŋkene sawa. Efehuc fârine quŋquŋke tâmiric bâfuaniŋmu.
Ajoc, nâŋâc hurâ dâŋjeŋic bâsifuckepene dâŋte kâuc babac enʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋ e iŋuc muhuc irecnec bârâwiŋ‐jopame mâreŋ sâc rafârembiŋ, ehuc hae qizec sâko bapa i behembiŋ.
Wofuŋzi hae ira hâcne mâreŋŋic dâŋjeŋic bârâc qârâwiŋneme fâuckehuc mâreŋ sâc rafârembiŋte hae irec ʒâŋe Babe mumbiŋ.
Kecʒi Semte ɋâricfâc jaŋere ʒâŋe biri: Sem e jara 100 bazume ere bifuŋko Arapakisa fuawec, ine rumi sâko omaewec irec faicnao jara 2 tarame fuacnewec.
Sem e Arapakisa fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 500 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Arapakisa e jara 35 bazume ere bifuŋko Sela fuawec.
Eme Arapakisa e Sela fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 403 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Sela e jara 30 bazume ere bifuŋko Ebere fuawec.
Eme Sela e Ebere fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 403 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Ebere e jara 34 bazume ere bifuŋko Pelege fuawec.
Eme Ebere e Pelege fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 430 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Pelege e jara 30 bazume ere bifuŋko Reu fuawec.
Eme Pelege e Reu fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 209 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Reu e jara 32 bazume ere bifuŋko Serugu fuawec.
Eme Reu e Serugu fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 207 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Serugu e jara 30 bazume ere bifuŋko Naho fuawec.
Eme Serugu e Naho fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 200 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Naho e jara 29 bazume ere bifuŋko Tera fuawec.
Eme Naho e Tera fuawec dameŋ irecnec jara 119 ʒuhuckerâ juhame ere bifuŋko naru motec gâcne fua fembiŋ.
Tera e jara 70 bazume ere bifuŋko ŋokâ ʒiŋuc fuacnembiŋ: Abram, Naho â Haraŋ.
Kecʒi Tera ere ɋâricfâc jaŋere ʒâŋe: Tera ere bifuŋko Abram, Naho â Haraŋ fuambiŋ. Haraŋ ere bifuŋko ine Loti fuawec.
Haraŋ e ine mamac‐ticne Tera juhame Kaldea mâreŋ qizec‐ticnao Uru hae ira hâmowec.
Eme Abram â Naho jahe ŋokac ropic. Abram e ŋonâŋ‐ticne Sarai rowec, â Naho e Haraŋte otâ Milika i ŋonâŋ‐ticne rowec. Haraŋ e otâ jajahec jucnepic, Milika â Isika.
Sarai e ine ŋokac hufiŋne naru motec tâmiric juwec.
Eme Tera e ŋokâ‐ticne Abram â ŋosa‐ticne Loti, Haraŋte ŋokâ hâcne, â joŋao‐ticne Sarai, Abramte ŋonâŋ, iŋuc rocjopame Kanaaŋ mâreŋko raniŋte Kaldea mâreŋko Uru hae ŋewec i beherâ hata fuŋkembiŋ. Raku hata ombâŋko Haraŋ mâreŋko fisirâ ira ŋembiŋ.
Terâ e jara 205 bazurâ Haraŋ mâreŋko ira hâmowec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Abram âzâcnewec: “Go mâreŋ qizecge â mame sâkofâcge â fic haege behe‐fârerâ noni mâreŋ moc gowatupemu ira ra juzemec.
Eme no jambuŋgupe ɋâricfâcge fua sawec epie gore ʒâŋe biŋezi haŋ bazejec. Eme go jambuŋte qizec ezemec.
Go jambuŋguniŋmu i noni wâc jambuŋ‐jopapemu, â go sâwecguniŋmu i noni iŋuc jaha sâwec‐jopapemu. Â goraonec jambuŋzi ŋeratierâ mâreŋŋic sâcjopa‐fârezejec!”
Eme Abram e Wofuŋte mic reŋkehuc hata fuŋkerâ raha Loti e bâjâpeme mâmâc rapic. Abram e jara 75 bazuhuc Haraŋ mâreŋ behewec.
E ŋonâŋ‐ticne Sarai â hahac‐ticnere ŋokâ Loti erâ kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne â mafa wiac‐ticne rocjopame Kanaaŋ mâreŋkopec raku mâreŋ ira fisimbiŋ.
Fisirâ fotâcne raku Sikem hae bâfuambiŋ, ira qâpuc jaŋere boriŋjâc bâtirikicne domawec.
Dameŋ ira Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋe hae mâreŋ irec rune jumbiŋ. Eme Wofuŋzi Abram fuacnerâ muwec: “Ɋâricfâcge jaŋe mâreŋ ʒi hâcne jarezokopac.” Eme Abram e Wofuŋzi fuacnerâ dâŋ âzâcnewecte ira alata moc bawec.
Eme mocwâc tiki mâreŋkopec feraku Bete hae ʒoaŋ wewefunao fisirâ ira qoruc boze‐jeŋic fârembiŋ. Bete hae ʒoaŋ huhunaopec ŋewec â Ai hae ine ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec ŋewec. Eme Abram e ira Wofuŋ alata moc bacnehuc numu wâwâsic ecnewec.
Erâ mocwâc faharerâ Negebe mâreŋkopec rawec.
Eme mâreŋ ira roroc fuame Abramzi Aigita mâreŋko jaba juocte ira rawec, roroc ŋemâc bâmâcne fowec irec.
Eme Aigita mâreŋ bâqiŋkezo ehuc ŋonâŋ‐ticne Sarai ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, go ŋokac sahac hawarige biaŋne i kâuc mi bakopac.
Aigita ŋic jaŋe honecguhuc ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: O, e ŋonâŋ‐ticne hâcne. Iŋuc murâ no nuniŋmu â go ine akicguniŋmu.
Irec go ʒiŋuc muzemec: No seŋticne. Iŋuc mutecne no gore erâ akicnupie sâcne jupemu.”
Eme Abram e Aigita mâreŋko ra fisime Aigita ŋic jaŋe ŋokac e sahac hawari‐ticne biaŋne jume honembiŋ.
Eme Farao fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe ŋokac honerâ ra Faraore maio mumbiaŋkembiŋ. Erâ ŋokac e rorâ Faraore ficko jowa fembiŋ.
Eme Farao e Saraire erâ Abram jauŋ biaŋne bacnehuc lama, bulimakao, doŋgi, kiŋaŋ motec â kiŋaŋ naru erâ kamele bocjaha tahackewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Farao â wiacfâcne jaŋe Abram ŋonâŋ‐ticne Saraire erâ ʒâic guru fekicne bâfua‐jarewec.
Iŋuc fuame Faraozi Abram hefârerâ ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnewec: “Keci wemo mâsi mo enaremeŋ?
E ŋonâŋ‐nane, go iŋuc wemocte mi nazameŋ? E seŋnane, iŋuc wemocte mutec nore ŋonâŋ erâ juocte ficnaneo râepo? Ajoc, ʒi ŋonâŋge mocwâc jowarâ wisec!”
Eme Faraozi momori ejareme Abram ŋonâŋ‐ticne â mafa wiac‐ticne qâzuc‐joparâ mâreŋ‐ticnaonec jowac‐jopa rambiŋ.
Abram e jahacne â ŋonâŋ‐ticne â mafa wiac‐ticne erâ Loti mâmâc Aigita mâreŋkonec risierâ Negebe mâreŋko ra fisimbiŋ.
Abram e lama bulimakao erâ gol â siliwa ŋemâcne focnewec.
Eme Abram e Negebe mâreŋkonec Bete haeopec juju fofo raku mârâc jaha Bete â Ai hae ŋondeŋ‐jekicko qoruc boze‐ticne fâreme fowec ira fisiwec.
Erâ mârâc jaha alata bawec ira hâcne Wofuŋte ʒâŋe riwaseckewec.
Loti e Abramhec juhuc iŋuc jaha lama bulimakao bacjopa juwec â qoruc boze wâc ŋecnewec.
Eme mâmâc jaha junicte mâreŋzi mi sâcjofawec. Qowifâc‐jekic bocjaha jumbiŋte mâreŋ mocjahao ŋec juc eenere sâc mi ewec.
Irec Abram â Loti qowi soŋaŋfâc‐jekic jaŋe mâreŋte iiriac embiŋ. Dameŋ ira Kanaaŋ ŋic â Periʒi ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ irec rune jumbiŋ.
Eme Abram e Loti ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Nâhâcne ŋondeŋko me soŋaŋfâc‐nâhec jaŋere ŋondeŋko rârâsi fome mi sâckeocmu, nâhâc mame ŋokâ.
Ʒâŋe maigao mâreŋ sâko forakac i mi honekic me? Irec râwiŋnenac. Go qanaopec razo mukicko noni fâreopec rapemu, me fâreopec razo mukicko noni qanaopec rapemu.”
Eme Loti e ʒâŋe fime rame honewec: Jordaŋ mâreŋ i opâzi bâgunucke‐fârekicne, Wofuŋte jufu gie iŋucne, erâ Aigita mâreŋ iŋucne, domarâ raku Ʒoari fisikac hâcne. Wofuŋzi Sodom â Gomora hae mi bâsirowec‐jofawec dameŋ ira Jordaŋ mâreŋzi iŋuc hâcne fowec.
Eme Loti e Jordaŋ wâneŋ sâko hone wosâerâ ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec rawec. Iŋuc ehuc rârâwiŋ epic.
Eme Abram e Kanaaŋ mâreŋko ŋec juc ewec, â Loti e ine Jordaŋ mâreŋko hae ŋerambiŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko ju fofo raku Sodom hae mendâŋko fisirâ qoruc boze‐ticne fâreme fowec.
Sodom hae rune jaŋe ine Wofuŋte maio ŋic hehesicne juhuc sindaŋ fuŋne fuŋne ejumbieŋ.
Loti e Abram beherâ rame Wofuŋzi Abram ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go mâreŋ domakomecko qâhâŋnerâ ʒâŋe fitec mâreŋ faicpec â juwicpec erâ ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec â huhunaopec raoc.
Mâreŋ honekic sasawa i go â ɋâricfâcge fofo sanaŋ foŋareocte biŋe qaŋarekopac.
Â ɋâricfâcge basawec‐jopape sawe mâririackepie ʒare‐jeŋic mâreŋko rufe fokac irec sâc eocmu. Eme rufe wowosene mi ekac, wowosene ezacko ine ɋâricfâcge wowosec‐jopane jaha ezac.
Go faharec, erâ mâreŋ hâŋne â otecne fotâcnerâ rac, mâreŋ i go tahacgukopac hâcne.”
Eme Abram e ju fofo raku Heboroŋ haeo Mamere ere boriŋ gie fowecko qoruc boze‐ticne fâreme fowec. Erâ ira ŋec juc ehuc Wofuŋte alata moc bawec.
Sina ŋicwofuŋ Amarafe, â Elasa ŋicwofuŋ Arioko, â Elam ŋicwofuŋ Kedo‐Laome erâ Goim ŋicwofuŋ Tidali
jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ 5 kecʒiŋuc jaŋehec qaqac embiŋ: Sodom ŋicwofuŋ Bera, â Gomora ŋicwofuŋ Birisa â Adama ŋicwofuŋ Sinaba â Zeboim ŋicwofuŋ Semebe erâ Bela ŋicwofuŋ. (Bela i Ʒoari irec ʒâŋe moc.)
Ŋicwofuŋ i sasawa jaŋe Sidim wâneŋko (Sidim i Hâwec Hâmocne irec ʒâŋe moc) ʒâʒâfic erâ tumaŋnembiŋ.
Jaŋe jara 12 Kedo‐Laome kiŋaŋ qacnehuc jumbiŋ, jara namba 13‐ko ine e râpeckembiŋ.
Eme jara namba 14‐ko Kedo‐Laome â ŋicwofuŋ ehec jumbiŋ jaŋe ware Asitero‐Karanaim haeo Refaim ŋic jopambiŋ, izi ware Ham haeo Ʒuŋim ŋic jopambiŋ, izi ware Kiriatim wâneŋko Emimŋic jopambiŋ,
izi ware Seiri tikio Horite ŋic jopa jâpec ejare raku Eleparaŋ haeo, mâreŋ burocnere qaŋeŋnao fisimbiŋ.
Erâ irecnec raku Eŋmisipa haeo (i Kadesi hae irec ʒâŋe moc) fisirâ ŋic mâreŋ ira jurambiŋ jaŋe joparâ Amori ŋic Hazazoŋ‐Tama haeo mâmâc jopambiŋ.
Eme Sodom ŋicwofuŋ, Gomora ŋicwofuŋ, Adama ŋicwofuŋ, Zeboim ŋicwofuŋ, â Bela ŋicwofuŋ i jaŋe Sidim wâneŋko ʒika qaniŋte rambiŋ.
Ra fisirâ ŋifec domahapie ŋifec Elam ŋicwofuŋ Kedo‐Laome, â Goim ŋicwofuŋ Tidali, â Sina ŋicwofuŋ Amarafe, erâ Elasa ŋicwofuŋ Arioko i jaŋe domambiŋ. Ŋifec 4 domambiŋ, ŋifec 5.
Sidim wâneŋko ira mâreŋ sâfâ irec nombâŋ i mâreŋ sâckerâ forawec. Eme râsi jaŋe Sodom â Gomora ŋicwofuŋ jahe jofa jâpec ejactepie wisepire ŋicfâc‐jekic gâcne nombâŋko humbiŋ â tiwâne jumbiŋ jaŋe tiki mâreŋko wiserâ rambiŋ.
Irec râsi jaŋe Sodom â Gomora haeonec mafa mecne nânâ mecne rofârerâ barâ rambiŋ.
Ehuc Abram hahac‐ticnere ŋokâ Loti Sodom haeo ŋec juc ewec, e jahacne â mafa‐ticne iŋuc jaha rorâ amecke rambiŋ.
Eme ʒikare nâfocne ŋic moczi fisi Hebiraio ŋic Abram biŋe âzâcnewec. Abram e dameŋ ira Amori ŋic Mamere ere boriŋ gieo ŋec juc ewec, â Mamere qomâ jahec‐ticne Esikola â Anera jahe wâc Abramhec ʒâʒâfic erâ jumbiŋ.
Abram e ine motecoc‐ticne niŋgiŋko barâ rakicne biŋe i manarâ izia ŋicfâc‐ticne ʒikare fuŋne mamana, ʒare‐jeŋic 318, e jahacne ficko fuakicne sasawa rocjopame râsi bâjâpec‐jopa raku Daŋ haeopec fisimbiŋ.
Eme Abramzi ŋicfâcne bâfâuc‐jopame gurune gurune ehapie ŋafeo râsi ututuŋ fisi‐jarerâ jopa jâpec ejare raku Hoba haeo Damasko faic‐ticnao fisimbiŋ.
Fisirâ mafa jowac rofârehuc motecoc‐ticne Loti â mafa wiac‐ticne, erâ ŋokac â ŋic ŋokac gâcne wâc mâmâc bârisiec‐jopa‐fârewec.
Abram e Kedo‐Laome â ŋicwofuŋ âgofâcne jopa jâpec ejareku risehame Sodom ŋicwofuŋ e fahare Sawe Wâneŋ, ʒâŋene moc Ŋicwofuŋ Wâneŋ ira hâcne bâfuaocte rawec.
Ehame Salem ŋicwofuŋ Melikisede, Anutu Femicne ere taha bapa juweczi Abram poroŋ â waiŋ bacne rawec.
Erâ jambuŋkehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Anutu Femicne e Abram jambuŋkezejec, Anutu sambâŋ mâreŋ bâbâfua eki hâcne.
Erâ Anutu Femicne mucne bacnezo, eki hâcne râsifâcge megao râec‐jopajec.” Eme Abram e wiac sasawa teŋkonec wâŋ irec sâc râcnewec.
Ehame Sodom ŋicwofuŋ e Abram ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋic ŋokac bârisiec‐jopa‐narec, mafa ine fogareoc.”
Mume Abramzi Sodom ŋicwofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋ Anutu Femicne hâcne, sambâŋ â mâreŋ irec bâbâfua, erao musanaŋkekopac.
No qoruc ɋâɋâtâ muc me kikehuhu bâmbândeŋ me wiac piticne i me i goraonec mi ropemu; go ʒiŋuc muzicte: Noni Abram mafa qâmiecnepo.
Mâc motec jaŋe suanʒeŋ nâmbieŋ izi fozejec, erâ ŋic nohec jumbeneŋ, Anera, Esikola â Mamere jaŋe ine sâcjeŋic ronʒepieŋ.”
Eme irec faicnao Wofuŋzi Abram maŋko fuac ecnerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Abram, go mi hâwicguoc, maroge no hâcne, â furige i fekicne jâmbâŋ fuaocmu.”
Abramzi ine muwec: “Wofuŋ Anutu, go wemo wiac moc narecmurâ mukic? No ɋâric tâmiric mâc hahata juekopac, eme Elieʒe Damasko haeonec eki merâfâc‐nane rauckerâ bajuocmu.”
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Manakic, go ɋâric moc mi tahacnumeŋ, irec juku kiŋaŋ qaqa‐nanezi merâfâc‐nane rauckeocmu hâcne.”
Iŋuc mume Wofuŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fuacnewec: “Eki merâfâcge mi rauckezejec, aricne, gore bifuŋko fuaocmuzi merâfâge rauckeocmu.”
Eme mâreŋko jowa hurâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go qâhâŋnerâ sambâŋko ʒâŋe fitec feme bâpiŋ honec‐jopac, i sâcne wosec‐jopacmu me?” Erâ âzâcnewec: “Ɋâricfâcge jaŋe irec sâc hâcne fua ranʒoŋgopieŋ.”
Mume Abramzi Wofuŋ manasiŋkeme irec erâ maname kiŋticne tarawec.
Erâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋ jukopac, noni hâcne mâreŋ ʒi garepemurâ Uru haeonec, Kaldea mâreŋkonec jowacgu warepo.”
Abram ine dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Wofuŋ Anutu, no mâreŋ ʒi rauckepemu i weniŋuc erâ sâcne mana ʒakiepemu?”
Iŋuc mume âzâcnewec: “Go ra bulimakao ŋokacne moc jara‐ticne 3 ekicne â noniŋ ŋokacne â lama ŋicne moc jara‐jekic 3 jaha ekicne, erâ hapâ â buni motecne, iŋuc rocjoparâ bare‐narec.”
Mume ro bafisic‐joparâ hefâuckehuc dâkâne moc ŋifec â dâkâne moc ŋifec iŋuc biricke rawec, wipe sawa ine mi hefâuckewec.
Eme gafu hâro jaŋe fisirâ âsu gârec nâcjopaniŋte wahapie Abramzi jâpec‐jopawec.
Eme ʒoaŋ huzo eha Abram e guŋ qâŋɋâŋ foha hâhâwic â duŋdapâczi foŋkewec.
Ehame Wofuŋzi Abram ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go ʒiŋuc mana sanaŋkec: Ɋâricfâcge jaŋe mâreŋ moc, biŋe mi qajarekicne, ira jaba juniŋmu; ehuc mâreŋ rune jaŋe bomac‐jopapie kiŋaŋ qajarehuc juhapie jara 400 taraocmu.
Â kiŋaŋ qajareniŋmu ŋicguru i jaŋe ine noni okacne bazu‐jarepemu, eme ɋâricfâcge jaŋe mafa mâririhec waha raniŋmu.
Go gahacne ine apa ŋosafâcge jaŋere jujumana mâreŋko raʒicmu, go juju juutuckehuc ŋicqizec erâ hâmotec ducguniŋmu.
Jaŋe ine Amori ŋic jaŋere kiŋte sâc micnao biac mi qakacte jufekupie gaŋne 4 eme risie wareniŋmu.”
Eme ʒoaŋ hume dapâc efâreha hosâc râqâc â waha ʒocbâruŋhec fuarâ qowi dâkâne ŋondeŋko fotâcne rawec.
Ʒoaŋ ira Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc muhuc Abramhec ʒâʒâfic ewec: “Aigita mâreŋte opâonec fuŋkerâ raku Eufrata opâ sâkoo tarakac, mâreŋ i hâcne ɋâricfâcge jaŋe jarepemurâ mupaŋkekopac.
Keniŋic, Keniʒi ŋic â Kadomi ŋic,
Hitiŋic, Periʒi ŋic â Refaim ŋic,
Amori ŋic, Kanaaŋ ŋic â Jebusi ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ hâcne.”
Abram ŋonâŋ‐ticne Sarai e hufiŋne juhuc naru motec moc mi rowec. Ehame Aigita mâreŋkonec kiŋaŋ naru‐ticne moc juwec, ʒâŋene Haga.
Eme Saraizi Abram ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, Anutuzi kogoc fufua irec mâsi sakare‐narewecte go kiŋaŋ naru‐nanehec juhaŋtec eraonec motec moc sâcne fua‐nareocmu mecne.” Mume Abramzi Saraire dâŋ reŋkewec.
Irec Abram e Kanaaŋ mâreŋko jara 10 jutarawec dameŋ ira Sarai, Abramte ŋonâŋ, e Aigita mâreŋkonec kiŋaŋ naru‐ticne Haga rorâ ŋowe‐ticne Abram râcneme ŋonâŋ‐ticne ewec.
Eme Haga e jume motec kiweckewec. Erâ, kiwechec ekopac, iŋuc manahuc ŋokac bomboŋ‐ticnere maname wawahane ewec.
Iŋuc eme Saraizi Abram ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mimi fua‐narekac i gorao qacnezejec. Noni kiŋaŋ naru‐nane garehuc amecgao râepo, eme eki, kiwechec ekopac, iŋuc muhuc mana wahacnukac. Ŋondeŋ‐nâhecko dâŋ fuarâ fokac i Wofuŋ e jahac mutarazejec.”
Mume Abramzi Sarai dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wiac kiŋaŋ naru e gore meo jukac, e iŋuc me iŋuc ecnezo murâ ecnec.” Eme Saraizi Haga qa bâtiŋ ecneme wiserâ rawec.
Rame Wofuŋte aŋelozi mâreŋ burocnao Suru hatamecko opâ ʒâŋe fokac ira bâfuawec,
bâfuarâ ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnewec: “Haga, Saraire kiŋaŋ naru, go wenirec warekic erâ wena rakomec?” Eki muwec: “No ŋokac bomboŋ‐nane Sarai wisecnekopac.”
Eme Wofuŋte aŋelozi‐âzâcnewec: “Go risierâ ŋokac bomboŋge rumecnehuc juzemec.”
Erâ Wofuŋte aŋelozi ʒuhuckerâ âzâcnewec: “No ɋâricfâcge basawec‐jopape mâretec sawe mâririackepie ʒare‐jeŋiczi wowosenere sâc jâuruocmu.”
Erâ Wofuŋte aŋelozi ʒiŋuc wâc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, go kiwechec jukomecte juku motec moc rocmu, ere ʒâŋe Isimae muzemec, Wofuŋ e ki mamakucge manajec irec.
Eki doŋgi momori wânʒâŋ iŋucne erâ juocmu, ehuc ŋic sasawa râsi ejareha jaŋe wâc râsi jaha ecne‐fâreniŋmu, eme ɋafâcne jaŋere maio ŋec juc ehuc qâhuc‐jopaocmu.”
Eme dâŋ âzâcnewec Wofuŋ ere ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc muwec: “Go fufua tâcne Anutu.” I ʒiŋucte muwec hâcne: No fua tâcne‐narewec eme no e hâcne ʒâŋitapo.
Irec opâ ʒâŋene ʒiŋuc mueŋgpieŋ: “Juju runezi honecnuekac ere opâ ʒâŋe”, opâ ʒâŋe i Kadesi â Berede ŋondeŋ‐jekicko fokac.
Juku Hagazi Abramte motec moc rowec, eme Abram e Hagazi motec rowec ere ʒâŋe Isimae muwec.
Abram e jara 86 bazuhame Isimae fuawec.
Abram e jara‐ticne 99 bazume Wofuŋzi fuacnerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No Anutu tâpiri rune, go nore maio bahacmâc juzemec.
Ehame noni gohec ʒâʒâfic ehuc basawecgupe sawe mâririackezemec.”
Mume Abramzi ʒâŋe maine mâreŋko hetutuckerâ fowec. Eme Anutuzi ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec:
“Manakic, no gohec ʒâʒâfic‐nane ekopac i ʒiŋucte: Go ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere mamac erâ juzemec,
irec go ʒâŋege Abram mocwâc mi mumu Abraham, ʒâŋege iŋuc muzo, no ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere mamac âkendâŋgukopac hâcne.
Ɋâricfâcge sawe‐jâmbâŋkeniŋte mupaŋkepe ŋic gurune gurune enʒepieŋ, erâ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe goraonec jaha fua ranʒoŋgopieŋ.
Eme no go â ɋâricfâcge ŋoŋere Anutu jupemurâ ʒâʒâfic‐nane basanaŋkepe go â apa ŋiric ŋurucfâcge mimiŋzi ɋâric ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko tatara tâmiric forahuc juocmu sanaŋ.
Ehame mâreŋ jaba jukomec, Kanaaŋ mâreŋ sâko hâcne, i go â ɋâricfâcge ŋoŋe ro rauc epie fosanaŋke‐ŋareocte ŋarepemu, ehuc Anutu‐ŋeŋic erâ jupemu.”
Erâ Anutuzi Abraham ʒiŋuc wâc âzâcnewec: “Goki ine ʒâʒâfic‐nane paŋnea soŋaŋkehuc bajuzemec, go â ɋâricfâcge mimiŋzi ɋâric mâmâc.
Go â ɋâricfâcge ŋoŋe ʒâʒâfic‐nane fokac i aimuŋ soŋaŋkeniŋte mukopac ine ʒiŋucte: Ŋoŋerao ŋic juŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc sasawa sahac tofa‐jeŋicko ma bajarezo.
Ma bapa ine sahac tofa‐ŋeŋic hetâcnehuc ma bazo, eme izi ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko ʒâʒâfic fuawec fokac irec ma eocmu.
Ŋoŋerao gaŋne gaŋne motec fua feniŋmu jaŋe fuarâ fohapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 8 eme sahac‐jeŋicko ma bafârezo, ŋaŋacne ficko fuakicne erâ wâc ŋic furune moctaonec moneŋzi furine bakicne â gore soc biuckonec mi fuawec jukac e mâmâc.
Ine hâcne, ficgao fuakicne â moneŋzi furi bakicne jahe mâmâc sahac‐jekicko ma bazo. Ʒâʒâfic‐nanezi iŋuc hâcne sahac‐ŋeŋicko forâ forahuc juzejec.
Ŋic moc e ʒâʒâfic‐nane qâsuahuc sahac‐ticnao ma mi bapa mâc juocmu, e gurufâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec bârâriepie juju‐ticne omaezejec.”
Erâ Anutuzi ʒuhuckerâ Abraham dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋonâŋge Sarai ere ʒâŋe Sarai mocwâc mi muhuc Sara muzemec.
No e jambuŋkerâ eraonec ŋokâ moc tahacgupemu. No Sara hâcne jambuŋkepe eraonec ŋic gurune gurune fuarâ junʒepieŋ, erâ eraonec jaha ŋicwofuŋ fua ranʒepieŋ.”
Mume Abrahamzi ʒâŋe maine mâreŋko hetutuckerâ gâwiehuc ʒiŋuc manasuwec: “Ŋic moc e jara 100 bazume ŋokâ moc sâcne fuacneocmu, erâ Sara e jara‐ticne 90 bazuweczi kogoc moc sâcne roocmu?”
Abraham e iŋuc ehuc Anutu ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go mana‐naretec Isimaezi gore maio jufezac me!”
Anutuzi ine muwec: “Misac, ŋonâŋge Sara eki ŋokâ moc roocmu, ere ʒâŋe Isaka muzemec. Eme noni ehec ʒâʒâfic sanaŋ epe ʒâʒâfic izi ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋehec fofehuc juzejec.
Â Isimaere wâc biac mana‐garekopac. Manakic, no e jambuŋkehuc ecnepe ɋâricfâcne fuarâ sawe mâririackenʒepieŋ. Ere bifuŋko ŋic fekicne 12 fuaniŋmu, erâ manacnepe ŋicguru sâko erâ juocmu.
Ʒâʒâfic‐nane ine Isakarao basanaŋkepemu e hâcne Sarazi jara faicnao dameŋ ʒiŋucnea roocmu.”
Anutuzi Abrahamhec dâŋticne iŋuc mutararâ eraonec fahare fewec.
Ehame Abraham e ŋokâ‐ticne Isimae â kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne ficticnao fuakicne mecne â moneŋzi furi bacjopakicne mecne, ine hâcne ficticnao ŋic jumbiŋ sasawa, i jaŋe rocjoparâ Anutuzi mutâcnewec irec sâcko ʒoaŋ ijaha sahac tofa‐jeŋicko ma bajare‐fârewec.
Abraham e jara‐ticne 99 eha e jahacne sahac tofao ma bawec,
â ŋokâ‐ticne Isimae e ine jara‐ticne 13 eha sahacnao ma bawec.
Ine hâcne Abraham â ŋokâ‐ticne Isimae ʒoaŋ ijaha sahac‐jekicko ma bakicne.
Ehuc kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne sasawa, ficticnao fuambiŋ me ŋic moctaonec moneŋzi furi bacjopakicne, jaŋe dameŋ ijaha sahac‐jeŋicko ma bafârekicne.
Eme Abraham e guŋpitic eme qoruc boze‐ticnere motâcko ŋehame Wofuŋzi Mamere boriŋ gieo fuacnewec.
Eme qâhâŋnerâ ʒâŋe fime feme mi ŋic jahec â moc ututuŋ jaha mainao domapie honec‐jopazejec i! Honec‐joparâ izia boze motâckonec faharerâ gasacke ra bâfuac‐jopahuc mâreŋko fodaperâ
ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋicbomboŋ‐nane, go nore manatec biaŋkekacko kiŋaŋŋicge no mi nowaruzemec.
Mupe opâ bawarepie kike‐ŋeŋic ʒurerâ jâc mumucko waha ŋemananiŋ.
Ehame no nahac ine ra poroŋ mac moc roŋarepe nâqiŋnerâ razo murâ ranʒepieŋ. Kiŋaŋ qaqa‐ŋeŋic norao mac fisiŋgopieŋte weniŋuc qâoma ezo!” Mume mumbiŋ: “Sâcne, mukomec iŋuc ec.”
Eme Abraham e biac qoruc bozeo ferâ Sara âzâcnewec: “Ajoc, go poroŋ uucne fifia râqâc jahec â moc fiarâ bâsifuckerâ poroŋ rikec.”
Abraham e iŋuc murâ gasacke rarâ bulimakao motecne urucne biaŋne moc bâwosâehuc kiŋaŋ motec râcneme eki picpac jaha hezu rikec ewec.
Eme susu opâne â wokemaŋne erâ bulimakao motecne rike bâmoc ekicne i mâmâc ro baware jarewec; eme jaŋe nâhuc ŋehapie e jahacne jâc mumucko domawec.
Eme jaŋe wiocnembiŋ: “Ŋonâŋge Sara e wena?” Eme muwec: “E bozeo ŋekac.”
Eme moc eki muwec: “No jara faicnao dameŋ ʒiŋucnea mocwâc gorao warepemu, eme Sara e kogoc baŋeocmu.” Sarazi ine motâc râpenao soŋkerâ hazec râehuc domawec.
Abraham â Sara jahe ine biac jara‐jekic bocjaha bazurâ ŋic ŋokac qizec epic, irec Sara e kogoc rorore sâc mocwâc mi ewec.
Irec Sara e maŋzi ʒiŋuc muhuc gâwiewec: “No sahac‐nane muzuckekicne â bomboŋ‐nane wâc ŋicqizec ekicnezi mocwâc hâpo mumuduc enacmu me?”
Eme Wofuŋzi Abraham ʒiŋuc wiocnerâ âzâcnewec: “Sara e wemocte ʒiŋuc muhuc gâwiekac: ‘No ŋokac qizec ekicnezi jâmbomac motec sâcne kiweckerâ ropemu?’
Wofuŋzi wiac irec me irec moc bâipieocmu me? No jara faicnao dameŋ ʒiŋucnea mocwâc gorao risie warepemu eme Sara e ŋokâhec juocmu.”
Eme Sara e hâwickeme mickehuc muwec: “No mi gâwiepac.” Eki ine muwec: “Aricne, go gâwiemec.”
Eme ŋic jaŋe irecnec faharerâ Sodom haeopec raniŋte rambiŋ. Eme Abraham e hatao râec‐jopaocte jaŋehec mâmâc rambiŋ.
Rahuc Wofuŋ e maŋticnezi ʒiŋuc manawec:
“Abraham e ŋicguru sâko â sasanaŋhec eocte â eraonec jambuŋzi mâreŋne mâreŋne ŋic jaŋerao fotâcnehuc sâcjopaocte mupaŋkekicne. Irec no wiac ezo mukopac i Abraham wemocko hesoŋkecnepemu?
No e kecʒiŋuc muhuc rowosâepo hâcne: E ɋâricfâcne â kikefuŋfâcne jaŋe Wofuŋ nore hata jowatuhuc tiŋne â mitine juniŋte jaza qâmoc ejarezejec. Iŋuc eme no Wofuŋzi Abraham wiac biŋe qacnepo irec fârine sâcne bâfuacnepemu.”
Erâ Wofuŋzi muwec: “Sodom â Gomora haeonec ŋic jaŋere sâqocne i ŋemâcne jâmbâŋ fokacte jaŋere erâ mu owa sâko fuakac.
Irec no hurâ honepe, jaŋe jâmbomac mu owa norao wefume manapo irec sâcko wiac efârembiŋ me weniŋuc, irec fuŋne mana‐jâmbâŋkezo mukopac.”
Eme ŋic jajahec jahe irecnec faharerâ Sodom haeopec rahapire Wofuŋzi ine Abrahamhec ʒuhuckerâ domawec.
Eme Abraham e Wofuŋte maŋfuŋko ra domahuc muwec: “Go jâmbomac ŋic biaŋne â sâqocne mâmâc bâsirowec‐jopazo mukomec me?
Hae irec maŋnao ŋic tiŋne 50 juŋgopieŋko, irec go jaŋe mâmâc bâsirowec‐jopacmu me jaŋere erâ hae sifu mi akickenʒaŋ me? Iŋuc mac mi ezemec!
Go ŋic tiŋne â sâqocne mâmâc bâsirowec‐jopatecne tiŋne â sâqocne jahe sâc mocjaha ezipicte iŋuc mi ezemec. Go mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec mumutara sâko jukomeczi giege fâretiŋ jaha bazemec.”
Eme Wofuŋzi muwec: “No Sodom haeo ŋic tiŋne 50 bâfuac‐jopapemuo ine jaŋere erâ gâcne sâko wâc hone akic ejarepemu.”
Eme Abrahamzi âzâcnerâ muwec: “No gâc wândoc â ʒafe iŋucnezi sifu ropaŋ erâ Wofuŋ‐nane go dâŋ gazakopac.
Ŋic tiŋne 50 muhape jaŋeraonec 5 basac‐jopacmu mecne, eme go jâmbomac 5 jaŋere erâ hae sâko bâsirowecmu me?” Mume muwec: “No ira 45 bâfuac‐joparâ hae i ima mi bapemu.”
Eme Abrahamzi ine mocwâc ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Me ŋic 40 sawa bâfuac‐jopa wiac moc ecmu?” Eki muwec: “No 40 jaŋere erâ mi epemu.”
Eme Abrahamzi muwec: “No dâŋ ʒuhuckerâ mupe Wofuŋ‐nane go sifu mana‐naretec mi sâqoreoc: Ŋic 30 sawa bâfuac‐jopacmu mecne.” Eki muwec: “No 30 bâfuac‐joparâ mi epemu.”
Eme Abrahamzi muwec: “No Wofuŋ‐nane gohec muc manac ezore ropaŋ epac, ŋic 20 sawa ira bâfuac‐jopacmu mecne.” Wofuŋzi muwec: “No 20 jaŋere erâ hae i mi bâsirowepemu.”
Eme Abrahamzi muwec: “O Wofuŋ‐nane, no arec mocjaha sawa mac ʒuhuckerâ mupe sifu mi mana sâqore‐narezemec: Ŋic 10 sawa bâfuac‐jopa wiac moc etec!” Eki muwec: “No 10 jaŋere erâ hae i ima mi bapemu.”
Wofuŋ e Abrahamhec dâŋ iŋuc mutararâ rawec. Eme Abrahamzi hae‐ticnao risiewec.
Hae owâeme aŋelo jajahec jahe Sodom haeo fisipic. Eme Loti e Sodom haesac motâcko ŋehuc honec‐jofarâ izia fahare ra bâfuac‐jofarâ maŋfuŋ‐jekicko fodapehuc muwec:
“Ŋicbomboŋ jahec‐nane, ŋohe miŋecgac ŋafeo kiŋaŋ qaqa‐ŋekic nore ficko ferâ kike‐ŋekic ʒurerâ ŋec foc enic. Tomâcko furicte ine sâcne faharerâ hata ʒuhuckerâ razepirec.” Jahe mupic: “Aricne, nâhe ŋafe ʒi hae ʒoŋao fonacmu.”
Eki ine mâretec hota‐jacteme sifu ficticnao fepic. Eme hezu hewâneŋ ejactehuc poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric rike‐jacteme nâpic.
Jahe ine guŋ mi fohapire hae irecnec ŋic, Sodom ŋic hâcne, ŋic â motec mâmâc sasawa jaŋe ware fic orâŋkerâ
Loti wiracnehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ŋafe ʒira gorao ŋic fisipirec jahe wena? Jowac‐jofa wahatecne bâsâqorec‐jofanaŋ.”
Eme Loti e jaŋerao hurâ motâc râpenao ki bawec.
Erâ muwec: “Âgofâc‐nane, wiac sâqocne iŋucne moc mi eniŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, nore otâ jajahec jukopirec, jahe ŋichec moc mi jupic. No jahe jowac‐jofa wahape wiac iŋuc me iŋuc ejactezo murâ ejacteniŋ. Mocjaha, ŋic ʒi jahe ine wiac moc mi ejactenʒepieŋ, jahe nore ficko wefupirec i!”
Jaŋe ine mumbiŋ: “Go wisec!” Erâ âzâcnembiŋ: “Go wiwickonec warekicnezi ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko jaba juhuc mutiŋ‐nâpozo mukic me? Nâŋe jahe wiac ejactezo mumbeneŋ irec sâc sirickehuc go egarenaŋmu.” Jaŋe iŋuc murâ Loti ro fârec ecnehuc motâc qanʒaŋnezo fuŋkembiŋ.
Eme ŋic jahe mejekic sicnerâ Loti ficko fârepire feme motâc ki bapic.
Eme ŋic kâcɋene â piticne fic orâŋkembiŋ jaŋe ine tiŋtuŋ bacjopapire motâc basambiŋ.
Eme ŋic jahe Loti ʒiŋuc âzâcnepic: “Âgofâcge ʒira moc juŋgopieŋ me? Kimofâcge me ŋokâ otâfâcge me wiacfâcge gâcne, jaŋe ejaretec hae ʒi beherâ wisenʒepieŋ.
Nâhe hae ʒi ima bazo ekoperec. Hae ʒirec ŋic jaŋere erâ mu owa sâko Wofuŋtao fuawec, irec Wofuŋzi hae ʒi ima banacte sorec‐nâfome wareperec.”
Eme Loti e ra otâ jahec‐ticne jahere ŋicbiŋe ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ajoc, fahare wiserâ ranic! Wofuŋzi hae ʒi ima bazo ekac.” Jahe ine manapire ʒoraŋ ekac tinac ewec.
Eme furic râeme aŋelo jahe Loti fâro ecnehuc mupic: “Ŋic ʒi jaŋere sâqocnere erâ mâmâc hâmozicte fahare ŋonâŋge â otâ jahecge ʒi rocjopatec wiserâ raniŋ!”
Eme e bititiehuc domame aŋelo jahe Wofuŋzi akickeocte muwecte e â ŋonâŋ‐ticne â otâ jahec‐ticne mejeŋicko rocjoparâ haeonec jowac‐jopa hurâ hae mendâŋnao râec‐jopahuc
moczi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ajoc, go mâmâc sipirickezicte wiserâ razemec! Erâ forisie mi fizemec â Jordaŋ wâneŋko ŋec domac wâc mi ezemec! Sipirickezicte tikio wiserâ fezemec!”
Eme Lotizi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋicbomboŋ‐nane, iŋuc mâcne.
Go kiŋaŋ qaqage no aki anonoc enarehuc akicnumec. Noni ine tikio sâcne mi wiserâ fepemu, ira wiac hâhâwicne moc fua‐nareme hâmozipohec.
Manakic, hae piticne mac kecocni i bembeŋko ŋekac, irec mana‐naretec ira ra juzepac. No ira sâcne jupemu.”
Eki ʒiŋuc muwec: “No i wâc mana‐garehuc hae mukomec i ima mi bapemu.
Mâc go ira mi fisihaŋtec no wiac moc ezo murâ eipiezipore gasackehuc wiserâ ira rac!” Irec hae irec ʒâŋe Zoari mukicne.
Eme ʒoaŋ wefuhame Lotizi Zoari haeo ra fisiwec.
Eme Wofuŋzi mume Sodom â Gomora haeo ʒoc hoe kâmbâc iŋucne sambâŋkonec waharâ
wâneŋ ira hae ŋerawec â ŋic sasawa â mâreŋko wiac doma rawec i ʒâseŋ‐jopa‐fârewec.
Loti ŋonâŋ‐ticne e ine forisie firâ izia hâwec qânâ ewec.
Eme hae fureme Abraham e Wofuŋte maŋfuŋko domawec hae mâreŋ ira rarâ
Sodom â Gomora hae ŋepicko wâneŋ mâreŋ irapec ʒâŋe firâ hosâc sâko jâmbâŋ ŋezurâ feme honewec.
Ine hâcne, Anutu e Jordaŋ wâneŋko hae ŋerawec i ima bawec dameŋ ira Abrahamte manasuhuc Loti sisipirickonec jowa rarâ hae juwec i ima bawec.
Loti e ine Zoari haeo juocte hâwickeme otâ jahec‐ticne jahehec hae i beherâ tikio ferâ hawec mocko jumbiŋ.
Eme mârâc otâ‐ticnezi qoticne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mamac‐nâhec e ŋicqizec, eme mâreŋ ʒirec ŋic moczi moc warerâ mâreŋŋic jaŋe eeŋgopieŋ irec sâcko mi enâcteocmu.
Ajoc, nâhâc mamac‐nâhec ecnepere waiŋ opâ nârâ maŋne sifuckeme ehec fonac, eraonec ɋâric fua‐nâcteocte.”
Eme ŋafe ira mamac‐jekic waiŋ opâ gumepire maŋne sifuckeme foha mârâc otâzi ferâ mamac‐ticnehec fowec. Erâ waha fowec â fahare rawec i mamac‐ticnezi mi manawec.
Ʒoaŋ faicnao mârâc otâzi qoticne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, no jacne ŋafeo mamac‐nanehec fopac, nâhâc miŋecgac ŋafeo iŋuc jaha waiŋ opâ gumepere maŋne sifuckeme goki ferâ ehec fozemec, nâhâc mamac‐nâhec eraonec ɋâric fua‐nâcteocte.”
Eme jahe ŋafe ira mamac‐jekic iŋuc jaha waiŋ opâ gumepire maŋne sifuckeme ʒâhec otâzi ferâ ehec fowec. Erâ waha fowec â fahare rawec i mamacnezi moc mi manawec.
Loti otâ jahec‐ticne jahe iŋuc ehuc mamac‐jekictaonec kiwec bâfuapic.
Eme mârâc otâzi motec moc rowec, ere ʒâŋe Moabi muwec. Eki Moabi ŋic jaŋere apa ewec.
Eme ʒâhec otâzi iŋuc jaha motec moc rowec, ere ʒâŋe Ben‐Ami muwec. Eki ine Amoŋŋic jaŋere apa ewec.
Eme Abraham e Mamere ere boriŋ gieonec faharerâ Negebe mâreŋko Kadesi â Suru ŋondeŋ‐jekicko Gerari hae ŋewec, ira ra jaba juwec. Ehuc ŋonâŋ‐ticne Sarare seŋnane muwec.
Eme Gerari ŋicwofuŋ Abimelec eki kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne soreme ra Sara rowec.
Anutuzi ine Abimelec ŋafeo guŋko fuacnerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go ŋokac romec irec hâmocte biŋe ekomec. E ŋic mocte ŋonâŋ jukac irec.”
Abimelec eki ine ehec moc mi juwecte ʒiŋuc muwec: “Wofuŋ, go ŋicguru tiŋne nâŋe sipiric‐nâpozo mukomec me?
Abraham e ʒiŋuc nazajec: E seŋnane. Â ŋokaczi wâc mujec: Eki seŋnane. Irec no wiac epac, i maŋɋaɋaoko epac, â menane i wâc bahacmâc.”
Eme Anutuzi guŋko ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go wiac i maŋɋaɋacko emec, i no wâc manakopac, erâ noni hâcne e bâuazicte aka hegarehuc sabecguhape nore maio mi sâqoremec.
Irec go ʒiŋuczia ŋic e ŋonâŋ‐ticne bârisiecnezemec, e porofete jukac, irec go jucmurâ eki gore erâ nunumu gie bazejec. Goki e mi bârisiecnecmuo ine go â wiacfâcge ŋoŋe jâmbomac hâmo‐fâreniŋmu.”
Eme Abimelec e furicte jâmbâŋ faharerâ kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne hetumaŋ‐joparâ dâŋ i sasawa jaza‐fâreme mâretec hâwic‐jopawec.
Eme Abimeleczi Abraham hefârerâ ʒiŋuc wiocnewec: “Go wemo wiac enaremeŋ? No wemo wiac sâqocne moc egarepacte go no â ŋicfâc‐nane sahacko râec enâremeŋ? Go norao wiac mi eene emeŋ.”
Ehuc ʒuhuckerâ Abraham ʒiŋuc wiocnewec: “Go weniŋuc manasuhuc wiac iŋucne emeŋ?”
Eme Abrahamzi muwec: “No ʒiŋuc manasuhuc wiac i epo: Mâreŋ ʒirec ŋic jaŋe Anutu araŋ mi bacneeŋgopieŋ, irec jaŋe no ŋonâŋ‐nanere erâ qâhâmocnuniŋmu.
Erâ e wâc jâmbomac seŋnane jukac. E mamac‐nanere otâ hâcne, neŋgoc‐nanere otâ aricne, erâ e ŋonâŋ‐nane ewec.
Eme Anutuzi munareme mamac‐nanere fic beherâ mâreŋ furunao warepo dameŋ ira noni ʒiŋuc âzâcnepo: ‘Hae ira me ira fisirâ no sâsecnuhuc ʒiŋuc muzemec: E seŋnane.’”
Eme Abimeleczi lama bulimakao â kiŋaŋŋic ŋokac rocjoparâ Abrahamte biŋe râec‐jopawec, ehuc ŋonâŋ‐ticne Sara mâmâc bârisiecnewec.
Erâ Abraham ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, mâreŋ‐nane ʒi maigao forakac, go ira me ira ŋec juc ezo murâ ezemec.”
Erâ wâc Sara ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, wiacfâcge jaŋe mana wahacgunʒipiŋte â jaŋere maio mimi gaŋgaŋhec juzicte no seŋge siliwa dâkâne wâŋ tauseŋ râcnekopac.”
Anutu e Abraham ŋonâŋ‐ticne Sarare erâ Abimelec ere ficko ŋokac jumbiŋ jaŋe mâmâc sasawa ejareme hufiŋ efârembiŋ.
Irec Abraham e Anutu numucneme Anutuzi Abimelec â ŋonâŋ‐ticne erâ kiŋaŋ ŋokacfâcne jaŋe mocwâc ɋâric bâfuac‐jopaniŋte bâpiaŋ‐jopawec.
Eme Wofuŋ e Sara iqickerâ mupaŋkecnewec irec sâc jauŋkehuc bafickewec.
Eme Abraham e ŋicqizec eha Anutuzi dameŋ bacnewec i maickeme Sara e motec moc kiweckerâ rowec.
Eme Abraham e ŋokâ fuacnewec, ere ʒâŋe Isaka muwec.
Erâ Abraham e ŋokâ‐ticne Isaka fuarâ fohame ʒoaŋ gie bapa 8 tarame Anutuzi mucnewec irec sâcko hezuwec.
Abraham e ine jara‐ticne 100 eha ŋokâ‐ticne Isaka fuawec.
Eme Sarazi muwec: “Anutuzi hata banarewec i honepe gâgâwine ekac, irec binaŋ ʒi mananiŋmu jaŋe gâwie‐nareniŋmu wâc.”
Erâ muwec: “Mozi mo Abraham ʒiŋuc âzâcnezac: Sarazi kogoc moc sâcne moŋ gumeocmu? Eme Abraham e ŋicqizec eha no sifu ŋokâ moc ropo.”
Eme motec e sokarâ moŋ natarame Abrahamzi tiwâ bâzi sâko moc rike bâmoc eme nâmbiŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ mocko Aigita ŋokac Hagare ŋokâ e Isakahec mamasiri erâ gâwiepire Sarazi hone manac ejactewec.
Irec Abraham ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go kiŋaŋ ŋokac keci ŋokâ‐ticnehec tuŋjofazemec. Kiŋaŋ ŋokac keci ere ŋokâzi nore ŋokâ Isaka ehec merâfâc wiac‐nâhec mâmâc mi rauckezepirec.”
Abraham e ine ŋokâ‐ticne Isimae ere busâqoc manarâ Sarare dâŋ maname mi sâckewec.
Anutuzi ine Abraham ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go motec â kiŋaŋ ŋokacge jahere busâqoc mi manac. Sarazi dâŋ gazakac i reŋkezemec. Isakare ɋâricfâc jaŋe sawa gore ʒâŋe biŋe rauckeniŋmu.
Eme kiŋaŋ ŋokacte ŋokâ e gore ɋâric ekacte iŋuc jaha ecnepe ɋâricfâcne jaŋe ŋicguru sâko eniŋmu.”
Eme Abraham e furicte faharerâ poroŋ â ʒopo opâhec Haga râcnerâ motec âsi‐ticnao herâ sorec‐jofame rapic. Rarâ Bere‐Seba haeopec mâreŋ burocnao qâsoriehuc jupic.
Eme ʒopoo opâ ʒickeme Hagazi motec jâcdutu moc ira domawec irec mumucko râewec.
Erâ tepe moc qâtâcnepene raekac irec sâc rarâ taicko ŋewec. Ʒiŋuc muhuc ewec: “No motec hâmorâ foha wemocko honepemu.” Iŋuc murâ motec fowec ocniŋucnao ŋehame moteczi ki kâcɋene kiowec.
Eme Anutuzi motecte ki owa manawec; ehame Anuture aŋelozi sambâŋkonec Haga wiracnerâ muwec: “Haga, go weniŋuc egarekac? Mi hâwicguoc. Anutu e motecte ki owa manakac.
Irec fahare motec menao sanaŋne bazemec; noni ecnepe ɋâricfâcne jaŋe ŋicguru sâko eniŋmu.”
Eme Anutuzi ʒâŋene bâtâcneme ʒâŋe firâ opâ ʒâŋe moc honerâ ra ʒopoo opâ fiarâ ware motec gumewec.
Eme Anutuzi motec hone soŋaŋ ecnehame sokawec. Erâ mâreŋ burocnao wosaŋeŋ gie bapa kâcɋene juwec.
Mâreŋ burocne ʒâŋene Paraŋ ira hâcne juwec; eme neŋgocnezi Aigita mâreŋkonec ŋokac moc rorâ râcnewec.
Dameŋ ira Abimelec â momori soŋaŋ‐ticne Fikoli jahe Abraham ʒiŋuc âzâcnepic: “Anutu e gohec juhame wiac ebac ehuc jukomec.
Irec go no â ɋâricfâc‐nane erâ jaŋere ɋâricfâc burec eatuc moc mi enârecmurâ mupaŋke‐narezemec. Noni âgo egare warehuc jupo iŋuc jaha goki no â mâreŋ jaba jukomec irec ŋic nâŋe âgo enârezemec.”
Abrahamzi muwec: “No mupaŋke‐garekopac.”
Abimelec kiŋaŋŋicfâcne jaŋe ine Abraham opâ nombâŋ moc oma jâoc rombiŋ, irec Abrahamzi mu tutuc ecnewec.
Eme Abimeleczi muwec: “Ŋic weni jaŋe iŋuc egarembiŋ i no mi manakopac; goki irec dâŋ moc mi nazameŋ â no nahac wâc mi mana huŋgaŋkepo.”
Eme Abrahamzi lama bulimakao rocjoparâ Abimelectao râec‐jopame jahe ʒâʒâfic moc epic.
Eme Abraham e lama ŋokacne 7 bâtâcko râec‐jopame
Abimeliczi honerâ muwec: “Go wemocte lama ŋokacne 7 bâtâcko râec‐jopamec?”
Eki muwec: “Noni opâ nombâŋ ʒi ropo i goki ŋic jaŋere maio musanaŋkecmurâ lama ŋokacne 7 ʒi qikiŋne‐garepe rocjopazemec.”
Jahe ira mumupaŋ sanaŋ mupaŋkepicte hae irec ʒâŋe Bere‐Seba mukicne.
Jahe Bere‐Seba haeo ʒâʒâfic epic, ehuc Abimelec â momori soŋaŋ‐ticne Fikoli jahe Filisa mâreŋko risiepic.
Abraham eki ine Bere‐Seba haeo boriŋjâc moc sararâ Wofuŋ Anutu juju runere ʒâŋe riwaseckewec.
Erâ Filisa jaŋere mâreŋko dameŋ ʒora jaba juwec.
Wiac i tara‐fâreha Anutuzi Abraham esâickehuc muwec: “Abraham!” Eki muwec: “No ʒi.”
Eme muwec: “Go ŋokâge mocjaha Isaka, maŋzi jauŋkeekic, e hâcne Moria mâreŋko jowa rarâ tiki moc gowatupemu ira bâzi rike‐narezemec.”
Eme Abraham e furicte jâmbâŋ doŋgi‐ticne sate hecnerâ kiŋaŋ motec jahec‐ticne â ŋokâ‐ticne Isaka rocjopawec. Erâ bâzi ririkere ʒoc hesuckerâ jareme fahare Anutuzi hae mâreŋ mutâcnecnewec irapec rambiŋ.
Rakupie ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha Abrahamzi qâhâŋnerâ fime rame mâreŋ hâcne taicko honewec.
Erâ kiŋaŋ motec jahec‐ticne jasawec: “Ŋohe doŋgi ʒira barâ ŋenic, ehame ŋokâhec kecocna rarâ taha nunumu wiac erâ ŋoherao risie warenac.”
Eme Abraham e bâzi ririkere ʒoc rorâ ŋokâ‐ticne Isaka fainao râewec. E jahac ine ʒoc ʒakicne â sâqe bawec. Eme mâmâc jojowac rapic.
Eme Isakazi mamac‐ticne Abraham âzâcnewec: “Mamac!” Eme muwec: “Ŋokâ‐nane, no ʒi.” Eki muwec: “Ʒoc ʒakicne â ɋâricne i bajukoperec, â bâzi rikenacmu irec lama ine weni?”
Abraham muwec: “Ŋokâ‐mae, Anutu e jahac bâzire lama moc bâfuaocmu.” Eme mâmâc jojowac rapic.
Raku Anutuzi mâreŋ mutâcnewecko fisirâ Abrahamzi ira alata moc bawec, erâ ʒocfiki barâ ŋokâ‐ticne Isaka bândeŋnerâ alatao ʒocfiki faio râewec.
Erâ mene sicnerâ ŋokâ‐ticne qaocte sâqe rowec.
Ehame ine Wofuŋte aŋelozi sambâŋkonec wiracnehuc muwec: “Abraham, Abraham!” Eme muwec: “No ʒi.”
Eki muwec: “Go motec keci mi bâuac, â wiac moc mi ecnec, go miŋecgac ŋokâge mocjaha e no mi sakare‐naretec mana jaŋgeŋgukopac, go Anutu araŋ bacnekomec.”
Eme Abraham fotikie firâ honewec, râpenao lama ŋicne moc ʒuŋenezi jâc uupicko heme hume domawec. Irec Abraham e rarâ lama ŋicne rorâ ŋokâ‐ticnere okacne taha bâzi rikewec.
Eme Abraham e mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc muwec: “Wofuŋzi bâfuakac”, irec dameŋ ʒiŋuczia wâc mueŋgopieŋ, “Wofuŋzi tikionec bâfuawec.”
Eme Wofuŋte aŋelo e sambâŋkonec harierâ Abraham wiracnehuc muwec:
“Wofuŋzi mukac, no nahacne ʒâŋeo mupaŋkekopac, go wiac kecʒi emec, ehuc gahacne ŋokâ mocjaha mi sakare‐naremec,
irec noni fehuc jambuŋgupemu, erâ ɋâricfâcge basawec‐jopakupe sambâŋko bâpiŋ ŋeraŋgopieŋ â hâwecmecko moŋgeŋ forakac irec sâc enʒepieŋ. Erâ ɋâricfâcge jaŋe râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere fic hae rauckenʒepieŋ.
Â ɋâricfâcge jaŋeraonec jambuŋzi mâreŋ sâc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋerao fotâcnezejec, ine goki dâŋnane reŋkemec irec furine iŋuc fuazejec.”
Eme Abraham e kiŋaŋ motec jahecne jaherao risieme jaŋe faharerâ Bere‐Seba haeo rambiŋ, eme ira ŋec juc ewec.
Wiac i tara‐fâreha Abrahamtao biŋedâŋ ʒiŋuc fuawec: Milika â ɋage Naho jahere ŋokâfâc fuambiŋ wâc:
Bâbâni ŋokâ Uzi â ɋaticne Buʒi erâ Kemuele, e ine Aramte mamac.
Erâ Kesede â Hazo â Pilidasi â Jidilafe erâ Betuele.
Betuele ere bifuŋko ine Rebeka fuawec. Ŋokâ 8 i jaŋe Abraham ɋaticne Naho ere ŋonâŋ Milikazi rocjopawec.
Eme ŋonâŋoc‐ticne, ʒâŋene Reuma, eki motec rocjopawec ine ʒiŋuc: Teha, Gaham â Tahasi erâ naru moc ʒâŋene Maka.
Sara e jufeku jara dameŋ‐ticne 127 bazuwec.
Eme Sara e Kanaaŋ mâreŋko, Kiriati‐Araba hae, Heboroŋ hâcne, ira hâmowec.
Eme Abraham e Sarare ki mamakuc eocte bozeo raʒiwec. Ki mamakuc eku qâŋɋâŋ foweckonec faharerâ Hitiŋic jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“No ŋoŋerao jaba â mafa sawa juekopac, irec ŋoŋe mâreŋ mac moc ʒâŋeruŋte biŋe qikiŋne‐narepie qâŋɋâŋ‐nane mai‐naneonec bârârierâ duckezepac.”
Hitiŋic jaŋe ine Abraham ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ:
“Ŋicbomboŋ, gazapene manac: Go ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko Anuture ŋic fekicne iŋucne jukomec, irec qâŋɋâŋge nâŋere ʒâŋeruŋ basarickekicne mocko duckec. Nâŋeraonec moczi qâŋɋâŋge duckecmurâ ʒâŋeruŋ‐ticne moc mi sakare‐gareocmu.”
Eme Abraham e faharerâ mâreŋ rune, Hitiŋic hâcne, jaŋe dape‐jarehuc
ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe qâŋɋâŋ‐nane mai‐naneonec bârârierâ ʒira duckepere mana‐nareŋgopieŋko mupe mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe Zoharire ŋokâ Eferoŋ,
e mâreŋ ʒirec tofanao Makepela hawec fokac irec rune jukacte nore âkehoc ecnepie hawec i nore eocte mana‐narezejec. Eme ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko hawec izi nore ʒâŋeruŋ gie eocte furine muocmu sâc râcnezepac.”
Eferoŋ e Hitiŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋewec. Erâ Hitiŋic sasawa ere haeo tumaŋnerâ ŋembiŋ jaŋere maio Abraham ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Ŋicbomboŋ, iŋuc misac, mupe manac: Gie i mâc qikiŋne‐garekopac erâ gieo hawec fokac i mâmâc tahacgukopac, âgofâc‐nane mâmâc manahapie qikiŋne‐garekopac hâcne, irec qâŋɋâŋge duckec.”
Eme Abraham e mâreŋ rune jaŋe dape‐jarehuc Eferoŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcneme mana‐fârembiŋ:
“I sâcne, erâ sifu mac moc mana‐narenʒaŋ! No mâreŋte furine garepe rozemec, eme qâŋɋâŋ‐nane ira duckezepac.”
Iŋuc mume Eferoŋzi Abraham âzâcnewec:
“Ŋicbomboŋ, go mupe manac: Mâreŋ tofane mac moc irec furine siliwa moneŋ 100 ekac, erâ dâŋ wemocte boc munacmu. Go sifu qâŋɋâŋge duckec.”
Abraham e ine furinere maname sâckeme Hitiŋic jaŋere maio ŋemâc bâbâfuao râerâ râcnewec. I eebapa‐jeŋicte sâcko iŋuc ehuc siliwa moneŋ 100 râcnewec hâcne.
Abrahamzi iŋuc ehame Eferoŋte gie, Mamere ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec Makepela wâneŋko fowec, erâ hawec â jâc wiac doma rawec i mâmâc
Hitiŋic haeru â ŋicmanac fisimbiŋ jaŋere maio ere biŋe ewec.
Eme Abraham e ŋonâŋ‐ticne Sara Makepela gieo hawec fowec ira hâcne duckewec. Makepela ine Mamere hae, Heboroŋ hâcne, ocniŋucnao Kanaaŋ mâreŋko fowec.
Iŋuc eme Hitiŋic jaŋe gie mecne, hawec mecne, i mâmâc Abraham ʒâŋeruŋ giere qikiŋnecnepie ere ewec.
Abraham e dameŋ ʒora jufeku ŋicqizec ewec. Ehame Wofuŋ e Abraham wiac sasawa jambuŋkecnewec.
Iŋuc eme Abrahamzi kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne micne, fic hae â wiac sasawa qizeckerâ irec soŋaŋ juwec, e hâcne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go mege gâjoŋ‐naneo râehuc
Wofuŋ, sambâŋ â mâreŋ jahere Anutu, ere maio ʒiŋucte mupaŋkezemec: Go Kanaaŋ ŋic ŋondeŋko jukopac jaŋere naru moc rorâ ŋokâ‐nane mi râcnezemec.
Aricne, go ŋokâ‐nanere ŋonâŋ moc bâfuacmurâ nore fufua mâreŋko mame sâkofâc‐nane juŋgopieŋ jaŋerao razemec.”
Mume kiŋaŋŋiczi âzâcnerâ muwec: “Ŋokac e no bâjâpecnurâ mâreŋ ʒira wareocte mi afeckeme weniŋuc epemu. No ŋokâge mâreŋ beherâ waremeŋ ira mocwâc jowarâ risiepemu me mâcne?”
Iŋuc mume Abrahamzi muwec: “Aricne jâmbâŋ, go ŋokâ‐nane ira moc mi bârisie‐jâmbâŋkezemec.
Wofuŋ, sambâŋte Anutu hâcne, mamac‐nanere fickonec â mame sâkofâc‐nane jaŋere mâreŋkonec jowacnu warewec eki dâŋ mupaŋkehuc ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Ɋâricfâcge jaŋe mâreŋ ʒi hâcne jarepemu.’ Wofuŋ eki hâcne ŋokâ‐nanere ŋonâŋ moc mâreŋ irecnec bâfuacmurâ aŋelo‐ticne ecneme bânie‐gareocmu.
Eme ŋokac e bâjâpecguocte mi afeckeocmuo ine mumupaŋgezi fârimâc eme irec manabâc mi ezemec. Ehuc ŋokâ‐nane ine sifu mâreŋ ira moc mi jowa razemec.”
Iŋuc mume kiŋaŋŋiczi meticne Abraham gâjoŋnao râerâ dâŋ i mupaŋkecnewec.
Erâ kiŋaŋŋic e bomboŋ‐ticnere kamelefâc jaŋeraonec 10 rocjopawec, erâ bomboŋ‐ticnere boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ wiac fuŋne fuŋne i mâmâc ameckerâ rawec. Rahuc juku Mesopotamia mâreŋko, Naho ere haeo hâcne fisiwec.
Hae mendâŋko ine opâ ʒâkâŋ fowec. Eme hae owâ ririŋte ŋokac jaŋe ira hâcne opâ fianiŋte haeonec waha jumbieŋ. Eme kiŋaŋŋic e dameŋ ira kamele ejareme waha fombiŋ.
Eme muwec: “O Wofuŋ, bomboŋ‐nane Abraham ere Anutu, go miŋecgac baficnuhuc bomboŋ‐nane Abraham bubiaŋ qacnezemec.
Manakic, no ʒira opâ ʒâŋeo domahape hae rune jaŋere narufâc opâ fianiŋte wahaniŋmu.
Eme naru moc wahame, ‘Opâ kiruŋge naretec opâ nâpe,’ iŋuc âzâcnepe manarâ muocmu: ‘Nâc, eha kamelefâcge opâ jarepe nânʒepieŋ wâc,’ naru e hâcne kiŋaŋŋicge Isaka ere biŋe bâwosâemeŋ, no iŋuc manarâ ʒiŋuc mana tarapemu: Go ŋicbomboŋ‐nane bubiaŋ qacnekomec.”
Dâŋ i mi mutarahame izia Rebeka opâ kiruŋ‐ticne hâporâ warewec. Rebeka e Milika ŋokâ‐ticne Betuele ere otâ fuarâ juwec, Milika e ine Abraham ɋaticne Nahore ŋonâŋ.
Naru e ine sahac hawari biaŋ‐ticnehec, erâ naru ʒeŋoŋ juhuc ŋic mocte biŋe biac mi ewec. E opâ ʒâŋenao hurâ opâ fiarâ wefuwec.
Wefuhame kiŋaŋŋic e erao gasacke ra muwec: “Mana‐naretec kiruŋgaonec opâ piticne nâpe.”
Eme eki muwec: “Bomboŋ‐nane, nâc,” murâ izia opâ kiruŋ‐ticne rorâ sicnecneme nâwec.
Eme nâ gapec eme ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No kamelefâcge jaŋe iŋuc jaha opâ fia‐jarepe nâ gapec enʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ picpac jaha opâ otoo hoŋkeme hume mocwâc fiaocte opâo huwec. Iŋuc ehuc kamelefâc‐ticne sasawa opâ fia‐jare‐fârewec.
Ŋic eki ine dâŋ mi mumu mâc wareckehuc domawec, ehuc kecʒiŋuc manasuwec: Wofuŋ e gie‐nane jambuŋkeocmu me mâcne, i mana tarazepac.
Eme kamele jaŋe opâ nâ gapec epie tarame ŋic e maŋŋuruc moc golzi bakicne, â maŋguc jajahec, furi‐jekic fekicne i râcnewec.
Erâ muwec: “Go more otâ, i nazac. Erâ mamacgere ficko sâcne fonaŋmu?”
Eki muwec: “No Betuelere otâ, Betuele e ine Milika â Naho jahere ŋokâ.”
Iŋuc murâ ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Kamele jaŋere jawa wiac â nânâ bocjaha fonârekac â guŋfic‐nâŋec fokac wâc.”
Eme ŋic e daperâ Wofuŋ numucnehuc muwec:
“Bomboŋ‐nane Abraham ere Anutu, Wofuŋ hâcne, e maŋuruchec juhuc mumupaŋ‐ticnere fârine bomboŋ‐nane mi sakarecnewecte muteŋ bâteŋ ecnezo. Wofuŋ e fâretiŋ jaha jowacnume bomboŋ‐nanere soctofa jaŋere ficko ware fisipac.”
Naru e ine gasacke rarâ neŋgoc‐ticnere ficko fe fisirâ wiac sasawa irec dâŋ binaŋ ewec.
Eme Rebekare seŋ moc juwec, ʒâŋene Labaŋ, eki ŋic opâo domawec erao gasacke rawec.
I ʒiŋucte: E qoticnerao maŋŋuruc mecne â menao megâŋ ŋewec i honewec, erâ wâc ŋiczi dâŋ binaŋ ewec i qoticnere mickonec manawec. Iŋuc hone manac erâ izia rawec hâcne. Ŋic e ine kamelefâcne jaŋehec opâoa domawec.
Eme muwec: “Wofuŋzi jambuŋguwec go wefuc me! Wemocte hae râpeo domakic? No fic biac emasaŋkepac, â kamele jaŋere ŋeŋe fofo irec sawane wâc fokac.”
Eme ŋic e ficko ferâ kamele jaŋere sate wiac hetarawec. Ehame kamele jaŋere jawa wiac â nânâ râembiŋ. Erâ ŋic ehec jumbiŋ jaŋere kike ʒuʒure opâ i mâmâc râembiŋ.
Eme irec faicnao nânâ râcnembiŋ. Eki ine muwec: “No dâŋ bajukopac i mupe mi manahapie nânâ jâpec mi nâpemu.” Eme Labaŋ muwec: “Murâ muc.”
Eme ʒiŋuc muwec: “No Abrahamte kiŋaŋŋic.
Wofuŋzi bomboŋ‐nane jambuŋkeme ŋic fekicne ewec jukac. Ehame qowi fuŋne fuŋne â bulimakao, siliwa â gol, kiŋaŋŋic â kiŋaŋ ŋokac, kamele â doŋgi wiac râcne tahac ewec.
Â bomboŋ‐nanere ŋonâŋ e ŋokac qizec erâ sifu bomboŋ‐nanere ŋokâ moc rowec. Eme Abraham e wiac‐ticne sasawa ere meo râe‐fârewec.
Erâ no mumupaŋ dâŋticne kecʒiŋuc i reŋkezo mupaŋkepemurâ nazawec: ‘Go Kanaaŋ ŋic, mâreŋ‐jeŋicko jukopac, narufâc‐jeŋic jaŋeraonec ŋokâ‐nanere ŋonâŋ moc mi rozemec.
Go mamac‐nanere haeo â mame sâkofâc‐nane jaŋerao ŋokâ‐nanere ŋonâŋ moc bâfuazemec.’
Iŋuc mume no bomboŋ‐nane ʒiŋuc âzâcnepo: ‘Ŋokac e mi mecne afeckerâ bâjâpecnuocmu.’
Eki ine ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘No Wofuŋte maio juwefuhuc juekopac, eki hâcne aŋelo‐ticne soreme gohec juhuc baficgume mame sâkofâc‐nane jaŋerao â mamac‐nane ere fickonec ŋokâ‐nanere ŋonâŋ moc sâcne bâfuacmu.
Go iŋuc etec mumupaŋ dâŋ i fârinehec eme taraocmu. Me mame sâkofâc‐nane jaŋerao fisitec ŋokac sakare‐garepie mumupaŋgezi fârimâc eme irec manabâc mi ezemec.’
“Eme no miŋecgac opâ ʒâŋeo fisirâ ʒiŋuc mupac: ‘Wofuŋ, bomboŋ‐nane Abraham ere Anutu, go gie bapemurâ warekopac irec baficnutec fârine fuaocte gazakopac mac,
no ʒira opâ ʒâŋeo domakopac, eme naru moc opâ fiaocte wahame, “Kiruŋkonec opâ piticne naretec nâpe,” no iŋuc âzâcnepe dâŋ
ʒiŋuc bâtikierâ nazaocmu: “Nâc, eha kamelefâcge iŋuc jaha fia‐jarepe nânʒepieŋ.” Iŋuc mume ere mupemu: Wofuŋzi bomboŋ‐nanere ŋokac biŋe bâwosâewec hâcne.’
No maŋnanezi iŋuc muhuc mutarahape Rebekazi opâ kiruŋ hâpo fârâ opâ ʒâŋeo hurâ opâ fiajec. Eme no ʒiŋuc âzâcnepac: ‘Opâ narec nâpe.’
Mupe izia opâ kiruŋ rorâ mujec: ‘Nâc, ehame kamelefâcge fia‐jarepe nânʒepieŋ wâc.’ Iŋuc mume napac â eki kamele gumec‐jopajec wâc.
Tarame wiocnehuc mupac: ‘Go more naru?’ Eki mujec: ‘No Betuele ere otâ, e ine Naho â Milika jahere ŋokâ.’ Iŋuc nazame maŋŋuruc sâkenao râepac â megâŋ ine meombâŋ‐ticnao hecnepe fejec,
erâ daperâ Wofuŋ, bomboŋ‐nane Abraham ere Anutu hâcne, e numucnehuc muteŋkepac. Eki hâcne bomboŋ‐nane ɋaticnere otâ Abraham ŋokâ‐ticnere ŋonâŋ ropemurâ hata biaŋnao jowacnuwec.
Eme ʒi nazaniŋ: Ŋoŋe bomboŋ‐nane maŋuruc ecnehuc bubiaŋ qacnezo muŋgopieŋ me weniŋuc? Arictac eme nazanʒepieŋ wâc, eme no hata‐nane fâreopec me qanaopec sâcne rapemu.”
Iŋuc mume Labaŋ â Betuele jahe ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnepic: “Wiac keci Wofuŋtaonec i, irec nâhe dâŋ iŋuc me iŋuc, biaŋne me sâqocne sâcne mi munacmu.
Rebeka e gore maio domakac hâcne, irec bomboŋgere ŋonâŋ eocte Wofuŋzi dâŋ muwec irec sâcko ehuc jowa razemec, eme Wofuŋzi muwec sâc sanaŋkezejec.”
Eme kiŋaŋŋic e dâŋjeŋic mupie manarâ Wofuŋ dapecnehuc ʒâŋe maine mâreŋko hetutuckewec.
Erâ faharerâ mafa wiac siliwa â golzi bakicne erâ ŋaqi wiac rorâ Rebeka râcnewec â boreŋ wiac furi sâko gâcne neŋgoc hahac jahec‐ticne wâc jactewec.
Iŋuc erâ kiŋaŋŋic Eliesa â ŋic ehec fisimbiŋ jaŋe mâmâc nânâ opâ nârâ ŋafeme waha fombiŋ. Hae fureme faharepie muwec: “Râecnupie bomboŋ‐nanerao rape.”
Rebeka neŋgoc hahacne jahe ine mupic: “Naru e woka moc me ʒoaŋ 10 nâŋehec juku razejec.”
Eki ine muwec: “Wofuŋ e hata juju‐nanere guriŋne bame biaŋkewec irec mi niŋgiŋnunʒepieŋ, bomboŋ‐nanerao rapemurâ râecnuniŋ.”
Mume mupic: “Nâhe naru hefârerâ e jahacne wiocnenac.”
Murâ Rebeka wiocnerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnepic: “Go ŋic ʒi ehec razo mukomec?” Eki muwec: “No razo mukopac.”
Iŋuc mume jaŋe seŋjeŋic Rebeka â jauŋ ŋokac‐ticne â Abrahamte kiŋaŋŋic â ŋicfâc‐ticne râec‐joparâ
Rebeka mu jambuŋ ecnehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “O seŋnâŋec, go ŋic tauseŋne tauseŋne jaŋere neŋgoc ezemec erâ ɋâricfâcge jaŋe râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere fic hae rauckenʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mupie Rebeka â kiŋaŋ narufâcne jaŋe faharerâ kamele faio ferâ ŋehuc ŋic bâjâpepie rambiŋ. Kiŋaŋŋic eki ine Rebeka soŋaŋkehuc rawec.
Isaka eki ine opâ moc ʒâŋene “Juju runezi honecnuekac ere opâ ʒâŋe” ira raweckonec warewec. E Negebe mâreŋko ŋec juc ewec.
Eme ʒoaŋ moc ira hae owâ ririŋte Isakazi gieo rawec. Ra juhuc ʒâŋe fime rame kamele warepie honec‐jopawec.
Eme Rebeka e iŋuc jaha ʒâŋe fime rame Isaka honerâ kameleonec waharâ
kiŋaŋŋic ʒiŋuc wiocnewec: “Ŋic kecocna gieonec warekac e mo?” Kiŋaŋŋiczi âzâcnewec: “E bomboŋ‐nane hâcne.” Iŋuc mume qârufac rorâ ʒâŋe mai‐ticne sâockewec.
Kiŋaŋŋic eki ine wiac ewec bawec irec dâŋ binaŋ Isaka ecne‐fârewec.
Tarame Isakazi Rebeka neŋgoc‐ticne Sara ere qoruc bozeo jowa ferâ ŋonâŋ‐ticne rorâ âgo ecnewec. Ehuc e jahacne maŋ bâmiriŋkerâ neŋgoc‐ticnere busâqoc i behewec.
Abraham e juku mocwâc ŋokac moc bawec, ʒâŋene Ketura.
Eme eki ŋokâ ʒiŋuc rocjopawec: Ʒimiraŋ, Jokisaŋ, Medaŋ, Midiaŋ, Isibake â Sua.
Jokisaŋ ere bifuŋko ine Seba â Dedaŋ jahe fuapic, eme Dedaŋ ere ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc fuambiŋ: Asurim, Letusim â Leumim.
Midiaŋ ŋokâfâcne ine ʒiŋuc: Efa, Efere, Hanoki, Abida â Elda, ŋic i jaŋe sasawa Ketura ere ɋâricfâc hâcne.
Abraham eki ine moneŋ mafa wiac‐ticne Isaka râcne‐fârewec.
Ŋonâŋocfâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋokâfâc ine mâc taha wiac gâcne jarerâ Isakahec mi junʒepieŋ muhuc ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec mâreŋ fokac ira sorec‐jopame rafârembiŋ.
Abraham e jufeku jara‐ticne 175 bazuwec.
E jujâmbâŋkeku ŋicqizec erâ hâmowec. Ehuc mimiŋnefâc‐ticne hâmombiŋ jaŋerao ʒuhuckewec.
Eme ŋokâ jahec‐ticne Isaka â Isimae jahe Makepela hawecko duckepic. Hawec i Hitiŋic Zoari ŋokâ‐ticne Eferoŋte gieo fowec. Gie i hâcne Mamere ocniŋucnao fowec.
Gie i Abrahamzi Hitiŋic jaŋeraonec furine bawec. Ira hâcne Abraham â ŋonâŋ‐ticne Sara ducjofakicne.
Eme Abrahamzi hâmome Anutu e ŋokâ‐ticne Isaka jambuŋkewec. Isaka eki ine opâ moc ʒâŋene “Juju runezi honecnuekac ere opâ ʒâŋe”, ira ŋec juc ewec.
Abraham ŋokâ‐ticne ʒâŋene Isimae, Sara kiŋaŋ naru‐ticne Aigita ŋokac Hagazi rowec eraonec ŋic fuambiŋ jaŋere binaŋ ʒine hâcne:
Isimae ŋokâfâcne jaŋere ʒâŋe ʒi, fua rambiŋ sâc râekicne hâcne: Mârâc ŋokâ‐ticne Nebajoti izi Kedara, Adibele â Mibesam,
erâ Misima, Duma â Masa,
Hadadi â Tema, Jeturu, Nafisi erâ Kedema.
Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne Isimaere ŋokâfâc, ʒâŋe‐jeŋic i hae‐jeŋic â qoruc boze‐jeŋic ŋerakac sâc mukicne. Jaŋe guru‐jeŋicte sâc ŋicwofuŋ 12 jumbiŋ.
Â Isimae dameŋ‐ticnere fuŋne ine ʒiŋuc: E jufeku jara 137 bazurâ hâmohuc mame sâkofâc‐ticne jaŋerao ʒuhuckewec.
Jaŋe Hawila â Suru, Aigita mâreŋ ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec mâreŋ ŋondeŋ moc ira jumbiŋ. Soctofafâc‐ticne jaŋere mâreŋ heririŋko juwec hâcne.
Ʒi Abrahamte ŋokâ Isakare binaŋ.
Isaka e jara‐ticne 40 bazurâ Rebeka ŋonâŋ‐ticne rowec. E ine Mesopotamia mâreŋkonec Aramea ŋic Betuele ere otâ Labaŋte seŋ.
Eme Isaka e ŋonâŋ‐ticnezi hufiŋ juwecte ere erâ Wofuŋ numucnewec. Eme Wofuŋ e manacneme Rebekazi motec kiweckewec.
Ehame kogoc jajahec jahe neŋgocte bumaŋko hehec epire ʒiŋuc muwec: “Iŋuc fuame wemocko jupemu?” Erâ ra Wofuŋ mu wioc ecnewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Bumaŋgao ŋicguru jajahec fokopirec, ŋicguru jajahec goraonec fuarâ râwiŋnenicmu hâcne. Ŋicguru moczi mocte femicne erâ juocmu, bâbânizi ʒâhec ere kiŋaŋ qaocmu.”
Eme motec roro dameŋ‐ticne maickeme bunaonec mi funʒuŋ fâri fuazepirec i!
Bâbâni fuawec ere sahac i bâbâroŋ â ŋaqi kanʒaŋnehec iŋucne, irec ʒâŋe‐ticne Esau mukicne.
Izi ɋaticne fuawec, e meticnezi Esau kike kiririŋnao bahuc fuawecte ʒâŋene Jakobo mumbiŋ. Isaka e jara‐ticne 60 eha ŋokâ jahec‐ticne fuapic.
Eme motec jahe juku sokarâ Esauzi wosaŋeŋ gie bahuc irec fuŋne manawec, ehuc kâteo kosa jujujec, Jakobo eki ine ŋic pectâcnezi haeo juhuc gie bawec.
Isaka e kâte qowire boc aŋackewecte maŋticne Esaure kâcɋene domawec, Rebeka e ine Jakobore maname joroc biaŋ‐ticne ewec.
Eme Jakobo e juku nânâ wiac rikewec. Ehame Esauzi kâteonec fisirâ nânâre betaŋkehuc
Jakobo ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wiac bâbâroŋ keci moc biac naretec nâpe, no nânâre hâmo sâqorekopac i!” Irec hâcne ʒâŋe‐ticne Edom mukicne.
Jakobozi ine muwec: “Mârâc fufuare wiac biŋege qikiŋne‐narec.”
Mume Esauzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Manakic, no hâmopemu irec bucne, irec mârâc fufuare wiac biŋe qanarekicne izi wemocko moc baficnuocmu.”
Jakobozi muwec: “Qanaŋ mupaŋke‐narec.” Eme mupaŋkecnehuc mârâc fufuare wiac biŋe‐ticne Jakobo qikiŋnecnewec.
Eme Jakobozi Esau poroŋ â basac bâbâroŋ rikekicne râcnewec. Eki ine nânâ opâ nârâ faharerâ rawec. Esau e iŋuc ehuc mârâc fufua‐ticnere wiac biŋe qaisockewec.
Juku mâreŋ ira roroc mocwâc fuawec. Mârâc Abrahamzi juhame moc fuawec, ʒi ine moc. Irec Isaka e Filisa ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ ʒâŋene Abimelec, Gerari haeo juwec, erao rawec.
Ehame Wofuŋzi fuacnerâ muwec: “Go Aigita mâreŋko mi rahuc mâreŋ moc noni gaza gowatuc epemu ira ra juzemec.
Mâreŋ ira jaba juhaŋtec no gohec juhuc jambuŋgupemu. Mâreŋ i sasawa go â ɋâricfâcge ŋarepemu hâcne, ehuc mamacge Abraham mumupaŋ dâŋ âzâcnepo i fârio qazejec.
