Ɋâricfâcge jaŋe mana‐jarepe fua sawec epie ʒare‐jeŋic sambâŋko bâpiŋ ŋeraŋgopieŋ irec sâc ezejec, â ɋâricfâcge jaŋere jambuŋzi mâreŋ sâc ŋicne ŋicne sâcjopa‐fârezejec.
I Abrahamzi dâŋnane â mumutâc‐nane â sâcmutâc‐nane â dâŋsanaŋ‐nane â wiac sasawa mana rereŋ efârewecte iŋuc epemu.”
Iŋuc mume Isaka e Gerari haeo juwec hâcne.
Eme mâreŋ irec rune jaŋe ŋonâŋ‐ticnere mu indiŋ ecnepie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “E seŋnane.” “E ŋonâŋ‐nane” iŋuc muocte hâwickewec. Maŋnezi ʒiŋuc manasuwec: Fuŋne mufuape mâreŋ rune jaŋe Rebekare erâ qâhâmocnunʒipiŋkohec, e sahac hawari‐ticne biaŋne irec.
Eme ira juhuc dameŋ mocko ŋonâŋ‐ticne Rebeka hâpo mumuduc ecnewec. Ehame ŋicwofuŋ Abimelec e qâqâtâc kataŋko honec‐jofawec.
Honerâ Isaka hefâreme fisime âzâcnewec: “E ŋonâŋge i! Fuŋne weniŋucte ‘E seŋnane’ mumec?” Isakazi muwec: “Jâmbomac, no ere erâ nupie hâmozipore hâwicnume mupo.”
Eme Abimeleczi muwec: “Go wiac hâhâwicne enâremeŋ, irec ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋeraonec moczi ŋonâŋge bâsâqoreme muzac, nâŋe gore erâ kiŋ hotâckenʒapeŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ ŋicfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Moc e ŋic ʒi me ŋonâŋ‐ticne wiac iŋuc me iŋuc ecneocmu e hâmoocmu.”
Eme Isaka e mâreŋ ira gie he sarac ewec, ehame Wofuŋzi jambuŋkeme jara ira mâriri sâko fuacnewec.
Eme ŋic e mazuc mâririhec eha mafa sâko mako fuacnewec.
E hâcne lama bulimakao guru sâko â kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne bocjaha bacjopa juwec. Irec Filisa ŋic jaŋe honerâ iiŋ guuŋ ecnembiŋ.
Opâ nombâŋ sasawa mamac‐ticnere kiŋaŋŋic jaŋe Abrahamzi juhame rombiŋ, i hâcne Filisa ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ fiapie hume hemase‐fârembiŋ.
Eme Abimeleczi Isaka ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go nâŋe siric‐nâpomeŋte behec‐nâporâ mocko ra juzemec.”
Eme Isaka e hae mâreŋ i beherâ Gerari wâneŋko hae boze barâ ŋec juc ewec.
Erâ opâ nombâŋ mamac‐ticne Abraham juhame rombiŋ â Filisa ŋic jaŋe hemasembiŋ i hâcne Isakazi mocwâc roniŋte muwec. Erâ opâ nombâŋ irec ʒâŋe mamacnezi muwec ijaha muwec.
Eme Isaka kiŋaŋŋicfâcne jaŋe mâreŋ ro gufuc ehuc opâ nombâŋ moc ira opâ ʒâŋene bâfuambiŋ.
Gerari lama bulimakao soŋaŋ jaŋe ine Isaka soŋaŋfâcne jaŋehec dâŋ mumuc ehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Opâ i nâŋere.” Iŋuc epie opâ ʒâŋene “Dâŋ mumuc” iŋuc muwec, jaŋe opâ irec erâ hehefaric embiŋte.
Eme irec faicnao opâ nombâŋ moc ropie iŋuc jaha dâŋ mumuc embiŋ. Eme irec opâ irec ʒâŋe “Hehefaric” muwec.
Iŋuc epie mâreŋ i beherâ opâ nombâŋ moc rowec, opâ irec erâ ine dâŋ mi fuawec, irec ʒâŋe i kecʒiŋuc muhuc “Sawa sâko” muwec: Wofuŋ e mâreŋ ʒira sawe mâririackenaŋte mâreŋ kâcɋene nârewec.
Eme irecnec Bere‐Seba haeo rafewec.
Eme Wofuŋ e ŋafeo fuacnerâ muwec: “No mamacge Abraham ere Anutu, go mi hâwicguoc, no gohec jukopac hâcne. No jambuŋgupemu erâ ɋâricfâcge jaŋe kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Abraham ere erâ basawec‐jopapemu.”
Eme Isaka e ira alata moc barâ Wofuŋ numucnewec. Erâ wâc qoruc boze‐ticne fârerâ ŋec juc ewec, ehame kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe ira opâ nombâŋ moc rombiŋ.
Eme dameŋ mocko Abimelec e âgo‐ticne Ahuʒata â momori micne‐ticne Fikoli jahehec Gerarinec ware fisimbiŋ.
Eme Isakazi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe wemocte norao wareŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe râsi enarehuc jâpecnupie warepo i!”
Jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Nâŋe Wofuŋzi gohec jukac i hone‐jâmbâŋkerâ ʒiŋuc manambeŋ: Nâŋâc ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko mumupaŋ moc mupene foha gohec ʒâʒâfic moc enʒepeneŋ.
Nâŋe go wiac sâqocne moc mi egarehuc ehâmo‐garerâ wama faio râecgupene waremeŋ, iŋuc jaha goki wiac sâqocne moc mi enârezemec. Go Wofuŋzi jambuŋguwec hâcne.”
Eme Isakazi tiwâ bâzi ejareme nânâ opâ nâmbiŋ.
Eme hae fureme mumupaŋ dâŋ muhuc ʒâʒâfic embiŋ. Iŋuc ehuc Isakazi râec‐jopame wama faio rambiŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ ijaha Isaka kiŋaŋŋicfâcne jaŋe warerâ opâ nombâŋ rombiŋ irec dâŋ binaŋ ehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Nâŋe opâ bâfuambeneŋ.”
Mupie opâ irec ʒâŋe Siba muwec. Irec dameŋ ʒiŋuczia hae irec ʒâŋe Bere‐Seba mueŋgopieŋ jaha.
Esau e jara 40 bazurâ Hitiŋic Beri ere otâ ʒâŋene Juditi ŋonâŋ‐ticne rowec, erâ Hitiŋic Eloŋ ere otâ Basemata mâmâc rowec.
Ŋokac i jahe ine Isaka â Rebeka busâqoc boc bâfua‐jactepic.
Eme Isaka e jufeku ŋicqizec erâ ʒâŋe‐ticne mâteŋkeme wiac sâcne mi honehuc mârâc ŋokâ‐ticne wiracnerâ âzâcnewec: “Ŋokâ‐mae!” Eki muwec: “No ʒi.”
Mume muwec: “Manakic, no biac ŋicqizec ekopac, ehuc hâmoc dameŋ‐nane mi manakopac.
Irec go wosaŋeŋte wiacge, tepege neŋgocne motecne rorâ kâteo ra qowi moc qanarezemec,
erâ aŋac‐nanere sâcko rikerâ bare‐narezemec. Eme hâmoczi mi rocnuha qowi nârâ jambuŋguzepac.”
Isaka e ŋokâ‐ticne Esauhec dâŋ muc manac ehapire Rebekazi hazec râerâ manawec. Eme Esau e qowi qaocte kâteo rawec.
Ehame Rebekazi ŋokâ‐ticne Jakobo ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, no mamacgezi hahacge Esau ʒiŋuc âzâcneme manapac:
‘Go qowi moc baware‐narerâ nânâ aŋacne rike‐naretec hâmoczi mi rocnuha Wofuŋte maio jambuŋguzepac.’
Irec ŋokâ‐mae, ʒi dâŋ gaza mutâc epe mana rereŋ ezemec.
Go ʒiŋuczia rarâ noniŋ motecne ŋicne jajahec baware‐narec, eme noni mamacge aŋac‐ticnere sâcko rike bâmoc ezepac.
Eme goki mamacgerao bafetec nârâ hâmoczi mi maickeha jambuŋguzejec.”
Jakobo e ine neŋgoc‐ticne Rebeka ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, hahac‐nane Esau e sahac ʒâwânehec, no ine sahac fâfâsâc.
Eme mamac‐nanezi bâuacnuocmu mecne, iŋuc eme no ere maio eeatuc ŋic tinac domahuc jambuŋ mâcne, sâwec hotâckepemu hâcne.”
Eme neŋgoc‐ticnezi âzâcnewec: “Ŋokâ‐mae, sâwecgezi nore faio fezejec. Go ine sifu dâŋnane reŋkehuc ra noniŋ motecne baware‐narec.”
Eme eki ra rorâ baware neŋgoc‐ticne râcneme neŋgoc‐ticnezi nânâ moc mamac‐ticnere aŋac irec sâcko rike bâmoc ewec.
Erâ Rebekazi mârâc ŋokâ‐ticne Esau ere ŋaqi wiac biaŋne ficko fowec i rorâ ŋokâ‐ticne Jakobo hecneme huwec.
Erâ noniŋ motecne jahere sahaczi meticne â upe‐ticne foŋkerâ
noniŋ aŋacne â poroŋ rike bâmoc ewec i ŋokâ‐ticne Jakobo menao râewec.
Eme eki mamac‐ticnerao barerâ muwec: “Mamac‐nane!” Eki muwec: “Motec‐mae, no ʒi, go ine mo?”
Eme Jakobozi mamac‐ticne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No mârâc ŋokâge Esau, no dâŋ nazamec i efârepac, go faharerâ ŋehuc qowi‐nane nârâ jambuŋnuzemec.”
Mume Isakazi ŋokâ‐ticne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋokâ‐nane, go weniŋuc erâ qowi biac jâmbâŋ bâfuamec?” Eme eki dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Wofuŋ, gore Anutu, eki nowatume biac bâfuapac.”
Iŋuc mume Isakazi Jakobo âzâcnewec: “Ŋokâ‐nane, waretec bâuacgupe, eme go ŋokâ‐nane Esau me mâcne, irec fuŋne taniŋkeoc.”
Eme Jakobo e mamac‐ticne Isaka erao rame eki bâuarâ muwec: “Dâŋge manape Jakobore dâŋ ekac, â megere ine manape Esaure me ekac.”
Eme meticne Esaure me iŋucne ʒâwânehecte mi ʒâŋitahuc jambuŋkewec.
Erâ muwec: “Go jâmbomac ŋokâ‐nane Esau me?” Eki muwec: “Ine hâcne.”
Eme muwec: “Nânâ barec, eme ŋokâ‐nanere qowi rikekicne i nârâ jambuŋguzepac.” Eme râcneme nâwec. Ehame waiŋ opâ mâmâc râcneme nâwec.
Erâ mamac‐ticne Isakazi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋokâ‐nane, maŋfuŋ‐naneo ware muducnuc.”
Eme maŋfuŋ‐ticnao rarâ muduckewec. Ehame ŋaqi‐ticnere âsu manarâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc jambuŋkewec: “Manakic, ŋokâ‐nanere âsu i kâte âsu iŋucne Wofuŋzi jambuŋkewec kâte i hâcne.
Anutu e sambâŋte titikuc â mâreŋte wokemaŋ erâ jacgoŋ â waiŋ mazuc mâririhec tahacguzejec.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe kiŋaŋ qagarenʒepieŋ â ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe gorao dapenʒepieŋ! Go hahac ɋafâcge ŋicbomboŋ ejarezemec eme neŋgocgere ɋâricfâc jaŋe gorao dapenʒepieŋ! Go sâwecguniŋmu jaŋe sâwec‐jopazo, â go jambuŋguniŋmu jaŋe jambuŋ‐jopazo!”
Eme Isaka e Jakobo jambuŋkeme tarame Jakobozi mamac‐ticne beherâ rahame Esauzi kâteonec risie warewec.
Erâ e iŋuc jaha qowi rikerâ mamac‐ticnerao baferâ âzâcnewec: “Mamac‐nane, go faharerâ ŋokâge nore qowi nârâ jambuŋnuzemec.”
Eme mamac‐ticne Isakazi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Hâc, go mo?” Eki muwec: “No mârâc ŋokâge Esau.”
Eme Isaka e fâfâre sâqorehuc muwec: “Eme go mi warehaŋtecne qowi qarâ bawefu‐nareme nârâ jambuŋkepac e mo? Jambuŋzi erao fohuc juocmu sanaŋ.”
Eme Esau e mamac‐ticnere dâŋ i manarâ kio ŋâŋâtâc ehuc mamacne âzâcnewec: “O mamac‐nane, no sifu jambuŋnuzemec wâc.”
Isakazi ine muwec: “Ɋagezi sioc ehuc jambuŋge gowac rojec.”
Eme muwec: “Sowine ʒâŋe‐ticne Jakobo mukicne, e sioc enareha biac arec jajahec ekac, e qanaŋ mârâc fufuare wiac biŋe‐nane nowac rowec â ʒi jambuŋ‐nane nowac rokac wâc.” Erâ ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Nore biŋe jambuŋ moc mi sakaremec me?”
Eme Isaka e Esau ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, e gore ŋicbomboŋ juocte âkendâŋnepac â qomâfâc‐ticne jaŋe ere kiŋaŋ qaqa juniŋte mupac erâ jacgoŋ â waiŋ i ere biŋe jaha qapac. Irec, ŋokâ‐mae, go wemo wiac mo egarepemu?”
Eme Esauzi mamac‐ticne âzâcnewec: “Mamac‐nane, jambuŋge mocjaha mac sawa fogarejec me? O mamac‐nane, no sifu jambuŋnuzemec wâc!” Eme Isaka e dâŋemâc ŋeha Esauzi ki owa kâcɋene ewec.
Iŋuc eme mamac‐ticne Isakazi dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc bâtikiecnewec: “Manakic, go mâreŋ guec mi fokacko â sambâŋte titikuc mi wahaekacko fic hae ezemec.
Go ʒikagezi nânâ bâfua‐garezejec, eme ɋage kiŋaŋ qacnezemec. Ehame ʒiŋuc fuaocmu: Go sanaŋkerâ ʒoɋac ecmuo ine tagi‐ticne upegaonec hetaracmu.”
Esau eki ine mamac‐ticnezi Jakobo jambuŋkewec jambuŋ irec erâ Jakobo aaric manacnewec. Ehuc maŋnezi ʒiŋuc manasuwec: Mamac‐nanere ki mamakuc ee dameŋne bembeŋkekac, irec faicnao ɋanane Jakobo qâhâmozepac.
Eme Rebeka e mârâc ŋokâ‐ticnere dâŋ i âzâcnepie manarâ ʒâhec ŋokâ‐ticne hefârerâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, hahacge Esau e okacne bazu‐garehuc qâhâmocguzo mukac.
Irec, ŋokâ‐nane, ʒiŋuc mupe manac: Go fahare hahac‐nane Labaŋ, Haraŋ haeo jukac, erao wiserâ razemec.
Erâ erao dameŋ ʒoricne juhaŋtec hahacgere aariczi mâteŋkezejec.
Mâteŋkeme go wiac ecnemec irec nikeckeha no gorao dâŋ râepe fâme manarâ risie warezemec. Ŋohe wemocte ʒoaŋ ijaha mâmâc omae‐narenicmu?”
Rebeka e iŋuc murâ Isaka ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No Hiti ŋokac jahere takicnuekac. Ehame Jakobo e iŋuc jaha Hitiŋic jaŋere naru, mâreŋ ʒirec rune hâcne, jahe iŋucne moc roocmuo no wenac epemu?”
Iŋuc mume Isakazi Jakobo hefârerâ jambuŋkehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Kanaaŋ mâreŋkonec naru jaŋeraonec ŋonâŋ moc mi rozemec.
Irec faharerâ Mesopotamia mâreŋko neŋgocgere mamac Betuele erao razemec. Ira neŋgocgere hahac Labaŋte otâfâc jaŋeraonec ŋonâŋ moc rozemec.
Anutu babafâre e jambuŋguhuc baficgume fua sawec erâ ŋic gurune gurune ezemec.
Eme eki go â ɋâricfâcge ŋoŋe mâmâc Abrahamte jambuŋ tahac‐ŋopaocmu, ehame Anutuzi Abraham mâreŋ râcnewec jaba jukomec hâcne i sâcne rauckecmu.”
Isakazi Jakobo iŋuc âzâcne sorec eme eki Mesopotamia mâreŋko Labaŋtao raocte rawec. Labaŋ e Aramea ŋic, Betuele ere ŋokâ â Jakobo â Esau neŋgoc‐jekic Rebekare hahac.
Isakazi Jakobo jambuŋkerâ ŋokac moc bâfuaocte Mesopotamia mâreŋko sorewec. Erâ jambuŋkehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Kanaaŋ ŋokac jaŋeraonec ŋonâŋ moc mi rozemec.”
Eme Jakobo e neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne jahere dâŋ reŋkerâ Mesopotamia mâreŋko rawec.
Esauzi ine wiac i, â mamac‐ticne Isakazi Kanaaŋ ŋokac jaŋere maname mi sâckewec, i mâmâc hone manac ehuc
Abrahamte ŋokâ Isimae erao rarâ otâ‐ticne Mahalati Nebajotire seŋ hâcne, ŋokac rorâ mârâc ŋonâŋ jahec‐ticne jaherao ʒuhuckewec.
Jakobo e Bere‐Seba hae beherâ Haraŋ haeo raocte rawec. Raku hae mâreŋ mocko fisihame ʒoaŋ ŋetarawec.
Eme mâreŋ ira qânâ ŋerawec irec moc ro roŋgâŋ herâ guŋ fowec.
Guŋko ine riri moc honewec, fuŋne mâreŋko domawec â botâŋnezi fe sambâŋ âke uawec, ehame Anuture aŋelofâc jaŋe mi ririo fefec wawahac enʒepieŋ i!
Ehame Wofuŋ e ututuŋ fuarâ riri botâŋnao domahuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No Wofuŋ, mamac ŋosa jahecge Abraham â Isaka jahere Anutu, mâreŋ fokic i go â ɋâricfâcge ŋarezokopac.
Â ɋâricfâcge jaŋe fua sawec eku mâreŋko rufe fokac irec sâc enʒepieŋ. Eme go mâreŋ ŋifec â ŋifec faic â juwic ira soka ŋeratiec ezemec. Erâ wâc go â ɋaricfâcge ŋoŋere erâ mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋe jambuŋ hotâckenʒepieŋ.
Manakic, no gohec jupemu, ehuc mâreŋ jucmu sâc sabecgupemu, erâ jowacgupe mâreŋ ʒira risie warecmu. No mi behecguhuc gohec jaha jukuhape wiac mupaŋke‐garekopac i fârio qafâreocmu.”
Eme Jakobo e guŋkonec ɋârerâ muwec, “Wofuŋzi mâreŋ kecʒira jujâmbâŋkekac, no mâc fokac muhape.”
Erâ sahacne gâgâmârâme kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Mâreŋ ʒi qeŋ bipinehec i! Jâmbomac, ʒi Anuture ŋeŋe hae â sambâŋte motâc hâcne.”
Hae fureme Jakobozi furic araraŋte fahare qânâ roŋgâŋ he fowec i bafahare ma âkendâŋnerâ wokemaŋ ruacnewec.
Ehuc hae mâreŋ ʒâŋene Bete muwec. Juwicnao ine hae irec ʒâŋe Lusi mujumbieŋ.
Eme Jakobo e dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupaŋkewec: “Anutu go nohec jucmu, ehuc hata ʒi rahuc juhape hone soŋoŋ enarecmu, ehuc hobu‐nanere nânâ â sahac‐nanere foŋ bâfua‐narecmu,
iŋuc enarekutec sahac furu mamac‐nanere ficko risiepemuo ine Wofuŋ go nore Anutu erâ juzemec.
Eme qânâ ʒi ma âkendâŋnekopac izi gore fic ezejec; â wiac narehuc jucmu sasawa i bâfâuckehuc teŋkonec wâŋ irec sâc bârisie‐garehuc jupemu.”
Eme Jakobo e ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec ŋic jumbiŋ jaŋere mâreŋko ju fofo rawec.
Raku ʒâŋe fime rame gieo opâ nombâŋ moc honewec. Ira lama guru jahec â moczi fombiŋ. Hae rune ŋic jaŋe opâ nombâŋ irecnec hâcne qowifâc‐jeŋic opâ gumec‐jopa jumbieŋ. Opâ nombâŋ micnao ine qânâ sâko ŋewec.
Irec opâ ira lama bulimakao jaŋe qanaŋ tumaŋne‐fârepie ie soŋaŋ jaŋe opâ nombâŋ micnaonec qânâ i qârândiŋkerâ qowi gurune gurune gumec‐joparâ qânâ i mocwâc ŋeŋe‐ticnao hepie ŋejujec.
Eme Jakobozi soŋaŋ wio‐jarewec: “Âgofâc, ŋoŋe wenirec?” Jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Nâŋe Haraŋnec.”
Eme wio‐jarerâ muwec: “Ŋoŋe Nahore ŋokâ Labaŋ e moc manaŋgopieŋ me?” Jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Ea, manaŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme wio‐jarehuc muwec: “E sâcne jukac me?” Jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Sâcne jukac, erâ otâ‐ticne Rahe e kecocna lama bulimakao jowac‐jopa warekac hâcne.”
Eki muwec: “Hâc, ʒoaŋ ɋaɋacko lama bulimakao haeo râec‐jopaniŋte dameŋ biac mi maickekac i. Irec motecne sawa opâ gumec‐joparâ mâc râec‐jopapie nânâ nâhuc juniŋ.”
Jaŋe mumbiŋ: “I qowi gurune gurune mi ware‐fârehapie sâcne mi enaŋmu. Ware‐fârepie ine nombâŋ micnao qânâ ŋekac i qârândiŋkerâ qowi motecne opâ gumec‐jopaeŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme Jakobo jaŋehec dâŋ muc manac eha ehame izia Rahezi mamac‐ticnere lama bulimakao bacjopa ware fisiwec, e irec soŋaŋ juwec hâcne.
Eme Jakobo e wawa‐ticne Labaŋ ere otâ Rahe â wawa‐ticnere qowi mâmâc honec‐joparâ ra opâ nombâŋkonec qânâ qârândiŋkerâ wawa‐ticne Labaŋ ere lamafâc opâ gumec‐jopawec.
Tarame Rahe muduckehuc fuŋkerâ kisâko kiowec.
Erâ e Rahe mamac‐ticnere soctofa â Rebekare ŋokâ juwec irec dâŋ âzâcnewec. Eme eki beherâ ra mamac‐ticne biŋe âzâcnewec.
Eme Labaŋ e seŋticnere ŋokâ, Jakobo ere biŋe manarâ gasacke ra bâfuarâ hâpo mumuduc ecnehuc ficticnao jowa fewec. Eme eki binaŋ‐ticne Labaŋ ninic jaha bacnewec.
Eme Labaŋzi âzâcnewec: “Go nore biuc â soc jâmbâŋ.” Eme Jakobo e mosa wâŋ ehec juwec.
Eme Labaŋzi Jakobo âzâcnewec: “Go soctofa‐nane jukomeczi wemocko okacmâc kiŋaŋ qanarecmu. Furine wemo rozo mukomec i nazac.”
Labaŋte otâ jajahec jupic, mârâc otâ ʒâŋene Lea â ʒâhec otâ ʒâŋene Rahe.
Lea e ʒâŋe hândâŋ‐ticne gogowac râmockekicne, Rahe e ine ʒâŋe mai‐ticne â sahac hawari biaŋne.
Eme Jakobore maŋzi Rahere domawecte muwec: “No ʒâhec otâge Rahe ere erâ jara 7 kiŋaŋ qagarezepac.”
Eme Labaŋzi muwec: “E ŋic furune moc mi râcnehuc go garepe sâcke‐jâmbâŋkeocmu, irec nohec juzemec!”
Eme Jakobo e Rahere erâ jara 7 kiŋaŋ qahuc juwec, ehuc ere mâretec ecnewecte jarare maname ʒoaŋ afecne tinac ewec.
Eme juku dameŋ i tarame Jakobozi Labaŋ âzâcnewec: “Dameŋ‐nane tarakacte ŋonâŋ‐nane narec, eme no ehec juzepac.”
Eme Labaŋ e haeru hefârec‐joparâ tiwâ ʒepec ejarewec.
Erâ hae qâhâpoha otâ‐ticne Lea rorâ Jakoborao jowa fewec. Eme ehec fowec.
Eme Labaŋ e kiŋaŋ naru‐ticne Silipa e otâ‐ticne Lea kiŋaŋ qacneocte râcnewec.
Hae fureme ine Jakobozi honeme mi Lea ezejec i! Eme Labaŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go wemo mâsi enaremec? No Rahere erâ kiŋaŋ qagarepo i! Go wemocte eatucnumec?”
Eme Labaŋzi muwec: “Hae mâreŋ ʒira mârâc naruzi mâc juha ʒâhec naru ŋicko rârâe i mi eeŋgopeneŋ.
Irec keci ehec jutec woka moc tarame moc e wâc garepene ere erâ iŋuc jaha jara 7 ʒuhuckerâ kiŋaŋ qanarezemec.”
Eme Jakobo e iŋuc hâcne ehuc Leahec jume woka moc tarawec. Eme Labaŋ e otâ‐ticne Rahe râcneme ŋonâŋ‐ticne ewec wâc.
Erâ kiŋaŋ naru‐ticne Biliha e otâ‐ticne Rahere kiŋaŋ qaocte râcnewec.
Eme Jakobo e Rahe ehec fowec wâc. Eme maŋticne Rahere kâcɋene domaha Leare afecne ecnewec. Ehame jara 7 ʒuhuckerâ Labaŋte kiŋaŋ qahuc juwec.
Eme Wofuŋ e, Lea maŋzi mi jauŋkekicne, iŋuc honerâ kiwechec eocte manacneha Rahezi hufiŋne juwec.
Eme Lea e motec kiweckerâ rowec, ere ʒâŋe kecʒiŋuc muhuc Rubeŋ muwec: “Wofuŋ e busâqoc‐nane hone manac ehuc baficnuwec, miŋecne ŋowe‐nanezi jâmbomac maŋzi jauŋnuocmu.”
Eme faicnao motec mocwâc kiweckerâ rowec. Erâ muwec: “Âgo mi enarekicne no Wofuŋzi mana‐narerâ kecʒi ʒuhuckerâ narewec.” Iŋuc murâ ʒâŋene Simeoŋ muwec.
Faicnao motec mocwâc kiweckerâ rowec. Erâ muwec: “No ŋokâ jahec â moc rocjopapo irec ŋowe‐nanezi norao qohotaocmu.” Iŋuc murâ ʒâŋene Lewi muwec.
Faicnao motec mocwâc kiweckerâ rowec. Erâ muwec: “Ʒi ine Wofuŋ muteŋkezepac,” iŋuc murâ ʒâŋene Juda muwec. Faicnao ine ʒuhuckerâ motec mocwâc mi rowec.
Rahe e ine hufiŋne juhuc Jakobore naru motec moc mi rocjopawec, e jahacne fuŋne iŋuc honerâ hahac‐ticne Lea iiŋ guuŋ ecnehuc Jakobo ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go naru motec bâfuac‐jopa‐narezemec, mi etecne hâmopemu.”
Eme Jakobo e Rahere erâ bune wefume ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wiac, Anutuzi naru motec sakare‐gareha no wemocko e âkehockerâ moc bâfua‐garepemu.”
Eme eki muwec: “Ʒi kiŋaŋ naru‐nane Biliha bajuhaŋtec ŋokâ moc rome nore biŋe ezejec.”
Iŋuc murâ kiŋaŋ naru‐ticne Biliha ŋokac‐ticne eocte râcneme Jakobozi ehec juwec.
Eme Bilihazi motec kiweckerâ Jakobore ŋokâ moc rowec.
Rahezi ine muwec: “Anutu e mana‐nareme sâckeha dâŋnane manarâ motec moc tahacnuwec,” iŋuc murâ ʒâŋe‐ticne Daŋ muwec.
Eme Rahe kiŋaŋ naru‐ticne e faicnao mocwâc motec kiweckerâ Jakobore ŋokâ moc rome jajahec epic.
Eme Rahezi muwec: “Hahac‐nanehec juju gie baku sanaŋkepo,” iŋuc murâ motecte ʒâŋe Naftali muwec.
Eme Lea e motec roro dameŋ‐nane tarawec iŋuc manarâ kiŋaŋ naru‐ticne Silipa rorâ Jakobore ŋokac eocte râcnewec.
Eme Silipa, Leare kiŋaŋ naru hâcne, e Jakobore ŋokâ moc rowec.
Rome Leazi muwec: “Bubiaŋ!” iŋuc murâ ʒâŋene Gade muwec.
Eme Silipa, Leare kiŋaŋ naru hâcne, e Jakobore ŋokâ moc rome jajahec epic.
Eme Leazi muwec: “No ʒeri‐nanehec! Ŋokac jaŋe nore manapie ʒerine eocmu.” Iŋuc murâ ʒâŋene Ase muwec.
Eme waizeŋ qa roro dameŋ ira Rubeŋzi ʒoaŋ mocko hata rarâ gieo ŋokac seroŋ wiac moc bâfuawec. Erâ bare neŋgoc‐ticne Lea râcnewec. Eme Rahezi Lea ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋokâgezi seroŋ wiac bawarejec i gâcne no narec.”
Eki ine muwec: “Ŋowe‐nane nowac rozo ekomec i manatec afeckeha ŋokâ‐nanere seroŋ wiac i mâmâc rozo mukic me?” Rahezi ine muwec: “Sâcne, ŋokâgere seroŋ wiac irec okacne ŋowe‐nâhec ŋafe ʒi gohec sâcne foocmu.”
Eme Jakobo e owâ ririŋte gieonec ware fisime Leazi ra bâfuarâ muwec: “Go norao wefuzemec, no ŋokâ‐nanere seroŋzi furi bacgupac.” Iŋuc mume ŋafe ira ehec fowec hâcne.
Eme Anutu e Lea manacneme motec kiweckerâ juku Jakobore ŋokâ moc rome 5 embiŋ.
Eme Leazi muwec: “No kiŋaŋ naru‐nane ŋowe‐nane râcnepore Anutuzi ŋokâ moc narewec.” Iŋuc murâ ʒâŋe‐ticne Isasa muwec.
Eme irec faicnao Leazi mocwâc motec kiweckerâ juku Jakobore ŋokâ moc rome 6 embiŋ.
Eme Leazi muwec: “Anutu e taha biaŋne tahacnume ŋowe‐nanere ŋokâ 6 rocjopapo, irec ʒi nohec paŋʒâic juocmu.” Iŋuc murâ ʒâŋene Sebuloŋ muwec.
Faicnao otâ moc rowec ere ʒâŋe Dina muwec.
Iŋuc fua‐fâreme Anutuzi Rahere manasurâ nunumu‐ticne dopeckehuc naru motecfâc‐ticne fuaniŋte manacnewec.
Eme motec kiweckerâ ŋokâ rorâ muwec: “Anutuzi mimi‐nane nowac rowec.”
Iŋuc murâ ʒâŋe‐ticne ʒiŋuc muhuc Josefe muwec: “Wofuŋ e ŋokâ moc ʒuhucke‐narezo murâ ʒuhucke‐narezejec.”
Eme Rahe e Josefe rome Jakobozi Labaŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No hae mâreŋ‐naneo rapemurâ râecnuzemec.
Ŋonâŋ jahec‐nane â naru motecfâc‐nane jaŋere kiŋaŋ qagarehuc jupo irec jaŋe qikiŋ‐jopa‐naretec jowac‐jopa razepac. Erâ kiŋaŋ weniŋuc jaha qagarehuc jupo i go gahac manakic.”
Eme Labaŋzi âzâcnerâ muwec: “Wiac mocjahare sawa mupe mana‐narenʒaŋ. No ɋâsâi qahuc ʒiŋuc mana tarapo: Wofuŋ e gore erâ ehâmo‐narewec.”
Eme ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Giegere furine mutec garezepac.”
Jakobozi ine muwec: “No kiŋaŋ weniŋuc qagarepo â lama bulimakaofâcge soŋaŋ‐jopahape jaŋe weniŋuc embiŋ i go gahac manakomec.
No mi warehape afecne sawa jugarembiŋ, ʒi ine fua sawec erâ guru sâko embiŋ juŋgopieŋ, eme Wofuŋ e gie‐nane bahape go ehâmo‐garewec. Dameŋ ʒi ine no nahac wiacfâc‐nane jaŋere erâ gie bahuc dope wiac bâfua‐jarezepac.”
Eme Labaŋzi wiocnewec: “Wemo wiac garepemurâ mukic?” Jakobozi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go wiac moc mi narezemec. No dâŋ maŋkekopac i mupe manatec sâckeocmuo ine lama bulimakaofâcge mocwâc soŋaŋ‐jopahuc juzepac.
Ʒiŋuc: No miŋecgac qowifâcge gurune gurune honec‐jopahuc qâqâreŋ â tiŋpâc tiŋpâc jaŋe bâwosâec‐joparâ bârâriec‐jopapemu, lama motecne gâgâpâc â noniŋ kuiqâreŋ â tiŋpâc tiŋpâc jaŋe hâcne. Eme qowi iŋucne jaŋe hâcne gie furi‐nane enʒepieŋ.
Eme wiac ekopac i sâckekac me mâcne, irec fuŋne ʒâhec taniŋkezejec. Go juku furi‐nane honezo warerâ, noniŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko kuiqâreŋ â tiŋpâc tiŋpâc tâmiric â lama motecne jaŋere ŋondeŋko gâgâpâc sawa mâcne, gâcne mâmâc juniŋmu, iŋuc bâfuac‐joparâ muzemec: I jaŋe fiuc rocjopakicne.”
Eme Labaŋzi muwec: “Sâcne, mukomec iŋuc fooc.”
Iŋuc murâ ra ʒoaŋ ijaha lama ŋicne qâqâreŋ â tiŋpâc tiŋpâc â noniŋ tiŋpâc tiŋpâc â kuiqâreŋ â qaŋqaŋ ocŋondeŋ sasawa hâcne, erâ lama motecne gâgâpâc rocjoparâ ŋokâfâcne jaŋere meo râec‐jopa‐fârewec.
Erâ Jakobo beherâ ʒoaŋ jahec â moc hata raku mâreŋ wiwicko fisiwec. Ehame Jakobozi Labaŋte lamafâc gâcne soŋaŋ‐jopahuc juwec.
Erâ Jakobo e fâric â jâc wiac gâcne irec huti ɋâricne hetâcnerâ sahacne ocŋondeŋ ritume maŋne qaŋqaŋ fua tâcneme qâqâreŋ ewec.
Iŋuc erâ huti ritukicne i lama jaŋe opâ nâniŋte ware fisipie jaŋere maio opâ otoo râeme hujujec.
I lama jaŋe opâ nâniŋte fisirâ ŋicnezi ŋokacne hucjopa jumbieŋte iŋuc ewec. Eme qowi jaŋe hutire maŋfuŋko iŋuc erâ juku motecfâc‐jeŋic qâqâreŋ â tiŋpâc tiŋpâc â kuiqâreŋ rocjopambiŋ.
Eme Jakobo e lama motecne bâwosâec‐joparâ ejareme Labaŋte qowi gurune gurune qâqâreŋ â gâgâpâc jaŋeraopec ʒâŋe fihuc domambiŋ. E iŋuc ehuc e jahacne guru moc buc bâfuarâ Labaŋte guruo mi ʒuhuc‐jopawec.
Eme qowi sanaŋne jaŋe huhuc epie sâc Jakobozi ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋicko huti otoo râeme hujujec. I huti wiac honehuc huhuc eniŋte iŋuc ewec.
Qowi rorokacne jaŋe Labaŋte biŋe ehapie tâpirihec jaŋe Jakobore embiŋ.
Ŋic e iŋuc hâcne ehuc mafa sâkohec eha qowi â kiŋaŋ qaqa â kamele â doŋgi bocjaha fuacnembiŋ.
Eme Labaŋ ŋokâfâcne jaŋe dâŋ mumbiŋ i Jakobore hazecko huwec. Dâŋ kecʒiŋuc: “Jakobo e mamac‐nâŋecte wiac sasawa hurewec, mamac‐nâŋecte biŋe fowec wiac gâcne sâko i ro qâzuc eku mafa sâko hurewec hâcne.”
Eme Jakobo e Labaŋte ʒâŋe mai sorondoŋ eme honerâ ʒiŋuc manawec: E mârâc âgo enarehuc juwec irec sâc mocwâc mi enarekac.
Eme Wofuŋzi Jakobo âzâcne muwec: “Mimiŋnefâcge â mame sâkofâcge jaŋere mâreŋko risiezemec, eme no gohec jupemu.”
Eme Jakobo e qowi jaŋehec gieo juhuc dâŋ râeme rame Rahe â Lea jahe erao fisipire
ʒiŋuc jasawec: “No ʒiŋuc honekopac: Mamac‐ŋekic e mârâc âgo enarehuc juwec sâc ijaha mocwâc mi enarekac, mamac‐nanere Anutuzi ine nohec jukac.
Ŋohe manakopirec, no tâpiri‐nanere sâc mamac‐ŋekic kiŋaŋ qacnehuc jupo.
Mamac‐ŋekiczi ine eatucnuhuc gie furi‐nane bafec bawahac eme arec 10 ewec, ehuc wiac‐nane nowac rohuc bâʒâicnuzacte Anutuzi hekecnewec.
‘Qowi tiŋpâc tiŋpâc jaŋe gore gie furi enʒepieŋ,’ iŋuc mume qowi sasawa jaŋe motecfâc‐jeŋic tiŋpâc tiŋpâc rocjopa‐fârembiŋ, me ‘Qâqâreŋ jaŋe gore gie furi enʒepieŋ,’ iŋuc mume qowi sasawa jaŋe motecfâc‐jeŋic qâqâreŋ rocjopa‐fârembiŋ.
Iŋuc fuame Anutuzi mamac‐ŋekic qowi iŋucne jâoc rohuc no nare‐fârewec.
Qowi ŋicne jaŋe ŋokacne hucjopambiŋ dameŋ ira guŋ manahuc ʒâŋe firâ ʒiŋuc honepo: Lama â noniŋ ŋicnezi ŋokacne hucjopambiŋ jaŋere sahac i qâqâreŋ, kuiqâreŋ â tiŋpâc tiŋpâc sasawa.
Eme Anuture aŋelozi ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Jakobo!’ Eme no âzâcnepo: ‘No ʒi.’
Eme muwec: ‘Go ʒâŋege qâhâŋnerâ honec: Lama noniŋ ŋicnezi ŋokacne hucjopaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe qâqâreŋ, kuiqâreŋ â tiŋpâc tiŋpâc sasawa! No Labaŋzi wiac egarewec i hone manac efârepo.
No Bete hae irec Anutu, go ira hâcne qânâ moc wokemaŋ ruacnehuc dâŋ moc mupaŋke‐naremeŋ. Ajoc, go ʒiŋuczia faharec, erâ mâreŋ ʒi beherâ fufua hae mâreŋgao risie razemec.’”
Eme Rahe â Lea jahe Jakobo dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnepic: “Nâhe mamac‐nâhecte merâfâc wiac biŋe qanâctekicne moc fokac me?
Me ere maio jaba tinac mi juekoperec? E qikiŋ‐nâforâ furi‐nâhec rohuc sipirickewec i.
Irec Anutuzi mamac‐nâhec mafa jâoc rowec sasawa i nâŋâc â ɋâricfâc‐nâŋec nâŋâcne biŋe ekac. Irec Anutuzi mutâcne‐garewec sâc ezemec.”
Eme Jakobo e faharerâ ŋonâŋ jahec‐ticne â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe kamele faio râec‐jopawec.
Erâ lama bulimakaofâcne â mafa wiac Mesopotamia mâreŋko juhuc hurewec i rocjopa‐fârerâ Kanaaŋ mâreŋko mamac‐ticne Isaka erao risieocte rawec.
Labaŋzi ine lamafâcne jaŋere kanʒaŋ bâtâcnezo rawec. Ehame Rahezi mamac‐ticnere nemuɋâŋ fiuc rowec.
Jakobzi ine wiseocte Aramea ŋic Labaŋ hesoŋkecnehuc eatuckewec.
Ehuc faharerâ wiac ere biŋe ewec sasawa i ame susuckerâ wisewec. Wiserâ ra Eufrata opâ fotâcnerâ Gileade tiki mâreŋkopec rawec.
Eme ʒoaŋ jahec â moc tarame Labaŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: Jakobo e wisewec. Iŋuc âzâcnepie manarâ
soctofafâc‐ticne rocjopame ʒoaŋ 7 jâpe raku Gileade tikio bâfuambiŋ.
Anutuzi ine Aramea ŋic Labaŋ ŋafeo guŋko fuacnerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Jakobo dâŋ i me i moc mucnezicte rucge bazemec.”
Jakobozi tikio qoruc boze wiac‐ticne bahame Labaŋzi bâfuawec. Eme soctofafâc‐ticne jaŋehec Gileade tikio jaha mâmâc fombiŋ.
Ehuc Labaŋzi Jakobo ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go wemo mâsi enaremeŋ? Erâ eatucnuhuc otâ jahec‐nane kâpâcwâru ŋic iŋucne jowac‐jofa waremeŋ.
Go wemocte eatucnuhuc kamierâ wisemeŋ? Mufua‐naretec muzac noni gae woŋgâŋ ehuc râecguzapo.
Go ine otâ jahec‐nane muduc‐jofapemurâ mi manasu‐naremeŋ. Go mutuc emeŋ hâcne.
Eme ʒi wiac i me i kosa eŋarezo murâ tâpiri mi basazapo. Mamacgere Anutuzi ine ŋafeo qatara‐narehuc ʒiŋuc mujec: ‘Go Jakobo dâŋ i me i moc mucnezicte rucge bazemec.’
Go mame sâkofâcge jaŋere boc egareha wisemeŋ i sâcne, mocjaha, nemuɋâŋ‐nane wemocte fiuc romeŋ?”
Eme Jakobozi Labaŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “No otâ jahecge nowac rocjofazicte hâwicnuwec.
Irec moctao me moctao nemuɋâŋge bâfuacmu e mi juzejec. Wiac bajukopac i soctofafâc‐nâhec jaŋere maio hone‐fârezemec. Ehuc bâfuarâ rozemec.” Jakobo e ine Rahezi nemuɋâŋ fiuc rowec i mi manawec.
Eme Labaŋ e Jakobo â Lea â kiŋaŋ narufâcne jaŋere qoruc bozeo fewec, erâ nemuɋâŋ‐ticne moc mi bâfuawec. Erâ Leare bozeonec waharâ Rahere bozeo fewec.
Ehame Rahezi ine nemuɋâŋ biac rorâ kamele jaŋere mafa bapa he ŋierâ fainao ŋewec. Eme Labaŋzi bozeo babasa gie bame arictac ewec.
Rahezi ine mamac‐ticne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Bomboŋ‐nane, go aaric mi manazemec, no gore maio sâcne mi faharepemu, ŋokac huc ejareekac i hâcne enarekac.” Eki ine wiac sasawa hone‐fârehuc nemuɋâŋ mi bâfuawec.
Eme Jakobozi aarickeme Labaŋ dâŋ mucnehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No wemo wiac sâqocne me bahac bâfuapore nu jâpec enarekomec?
Ʒi wiac‐nane sasawa basa hewiric efâremec, irec gahacne wiac moc bâfuamecko soctofafâc‐nâhec jaŋere maio râetecne jaŋe honerâ nâhâcne dâŋ mutaranʒepieŋ.
No gohec juhape jara 20 tarawec, ehame lama â noniŋfâcge jaŋe motec rocjopapie hâmo sipiric moc mi embiŋ, â gore lama guruonec ŋicne qa nâc moc mi ejarepo.
Me qowi momori jaŋe lamafâcge kisuc qâsuc‐jopapie mi bafisi‐garehuc no nahac okacne râepo, go ʒoaŋko me ŋafeo nâcjopapie okacne garepemurâ munaremeŋ hâcne.
No ʒoaŋko fârorocte dockehuc jupo â ŋafeo mâmâteŋte erâ guŋqâri jupo.
No jara 20 sâko ficgao kiŋaŋ qagarehuc jupo, jara 14 otâ jahecge jahere erâ epo â jara 6 qowifâcge jaŋere erâ epo, goki ine gie furi‐nane bafec bawahac etecne arec 10 ewec.
Mamac‐nanere Anutu, Abrahamte Anutu hâcne, â Isakazi araŋ bacnehuc juwec, e mi jume muzac go metariŋ jâmbâŋ râecnutec warezapo. Anutuzi ine busâqoc â ʒâic gie‐nane hone manac erâ ŋafeo dâŋnane mutarajec.”
Eme Labaŋzi Jakobo dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Otâ jahe mecne, naru motec mecne, lama bulimakao mecne â wiac hone‐fârekomec ʒi jaŋe nore biŋe sasawa. Mâc otâ jahec‐nane â naru motec rocjopambiŋ jaŋe ine miŋecgac wemo wiac moc ehâmo‐jarepe sâckeocmu?
Ajoc, ʒâʒâfic moc enac, ehuc qânâma moc âkendâŋnepere izi ŋondeŋ‐nâhecko mumutaniŋ erâ ŋezejec.”
Iŋuc mume Jakobozi qânâ moc rorâ ma âkendâŋnewec.
Eme Labaŋzi soctofafâc‐ticne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe qânâ gâcne nuseniŋ.” Eme jaŋe qânâ nuse guruc epie heririŋnao ŋehuc tiwâ bâzi nâmbiŋ.
Ehuc Labaŋ eki qânâ guru irec ʒâŋe Jega Sahaduta muhame Jakobozi ʒâŋene Galede muwec.
Eme Labaŋzi muwec: “Miŋecgac qânâ guru ʒizi nâhâcne mumutaniŋ ezejec, irec ʒâŋene Galede mukicne,
â qânâma jâmbâŋ ine ʒiŋuc muhuc ʒâŋene Mizipa muwec: Wofuŋ e rârâwiŋ juhapere soŋaŋ‐nâhec juzejec.
Go otâ jahec‐nane hone takirec‐jofacmu me mi manahape ŋokac gâcne ʒuhuckerâ rocjopacmuo ine ʒiŋuc manasuzemec: Anutu e honec‐nâpoekac.”
Erâ Labaŋzi Jakobo ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, qânâ guru â qânâma ŋondeŋ‐nâhecko âkendâŋnepac
izi hâcne mumutaniŋ‐nâhec ŋeha no râsi egarehuc jâururâ gorao mi fâzepac, erâ goki wâc râsi enarehuc iŋuc jaha jâururâ norao mi warezemec.
Abraham â Naho jahere Anutuzi hâcne mumutara‐nâhec ezejec.” Eme Jakobo e mamac‐ticne Isakazi Anutu araŋ bacnehuc juwec erao mupaŋkewec.
Erâ tikio taha bâzi moc bâmockerâ soctofafâc‐ticne nânâre hefârec‐jopawec. Eme tiwâ bâzi nârâ tikio fombiŋ.
Izi hae fureme Labaŋ e otâ ŋosafâc‐ticne muduc‐joparâ jambuŋ‐jopawec. Iŋuc erâ behec‐jopahuc hae‐ticnao risie rawec.
Eme Jakobo e iŋuc jaha hata‐ticnao rawec. Rahame Anuture aŋelofâc jaŋe hatao bâfuambiŋ.
Eme Jakobozi honec‐joparâ muwec: “I Anutu momorifâc‐ticne jaŋere toma i!” Irec hae mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe Mahanaim muwec.
Erâ Jakobore hahac Esau e Seiri mâreŋko Edom hae mâreŋko hâcne juwec. Eme Jakobozi kiŋaŋŋic erao sorec‐jopame bânierâ rambiŋ.
Ehame ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe bomboŋ‐nane Esau ʒiŋuc âzâcnenʒepieŋ: Kiŋaŋŋicge Jakobo e ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘No mâreŋ ʒoricko Labaŋhec juwarehuc jupo.
No lama, bulimakao, doŋgi â kiŋaŋŋic ŋokac rauc‐jopapo. Eme bomboŋ‐nane go âgo enarecmurâ biŋedâŋ i hâcne râepe fakac.’”
Eme kiŋaŋŋic jaŋe Jakoborao risierâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Nâŋe hahacge Esau bâfuambeŋ, e biac bâfuacguocte ŋicfâc‐ticne 400 jaŋehec warehuc jukac.”
Eme Jakobo e hâwicke sâqoreme maŋticne gâckewec. Irec ŋicfâc‐ticne mecne, lama bulimakao â kamelefâc‐ticne mecne bâfâuc‐jopame guru jajahec embiŋ.
I ʒiŋuc muhuc ewec: “Esau e guru moc jopaocmuo ine guru moc jaŋe sâcne wiserâ raniŋmu.”
Erâ Jakobozi ʒiŋuc muhuc numuwec: “O Wofuŋ, mamac ŋosa jahec‐nane Abraham â Isaka jahere Anutu, goki hâcne ʒiŋuc nazameŋ: ‘Go mâreŋ qizecgao â soctofafâcge jaŋerao risietec ehâmo‐garepemu.’
Go kiŋaŋŋicge waha qaqane no buuruc â bubiaŋ sâc mo iŋucne qanaremeŋ. No gunu‐nane sawa bajuhuc Jordaŋ opâ ʒi fotâcnerâ rapo, ʒi ine sawe mâririackerâ warehuc guru jajahec ekopac.
Irec go ŋezicnurâ hahac‐nanere meonec bataracnuzemec, e ware no mecne, naru motecfâc‐nane mecne, â neŋgocfâc‐jeŋic mâmâc qâhâmoc‐nâpozacte hâwicnukac.
Go gahac ʒiŋuc hâcne mumeŋ: ‘No bubiaŋ qagarehuc ɋâricfâcge basawec‐jopape hâwecko moŋgeŋ fokac irec sâc enʒepieŋ, i guru sâkore wowosene tâmiric ekac.’”
Eme Jakobo e ŋafeo ira guŋ fowec. Hae fureme ine wiac hurewec irecnec gâcne hahac‐ticne Esau bubiaŋ qacneocte ʒiŋuc bâwosâewec:
Noniŋ ŋokacne 200 â ŋicne 20, erâ lama ŋokacne 200 â ŋicne 20,
kamele susu bapazi motecnehec 30 a bulimakao ŋokacne 40 â ŋicne 10, erâ doŋgi ŋokacne 20 â ŋicne 10.
Wiac i hâcne gurune gurune buc buc kiŋaŋŋicfâcne jaŋe jarehuc muwec: “Ŋoŋe bânie‐narepie qowi gurune gurune jaŋere ŋondeŋko sawane fozejec.”
Â micne bawec e ine ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Hahac‐nane Esauzi bâfuacgurâ, ‘Go more kiŋaŋŋic â wena razo ekomec â wiac keci bânie‐garekac i more,’
iŋuc wio‐gareme ʒiŋuc muzemec: ‘I kiŋaŋŋicge Jakobozi bomboŋ‐nane Esau go tahacguocte râeme warekac, erâ manakic, e jahacne ʒâhec bâjâpec‐nâporâ warekac.’”
Erâ soŋaŋ namba 2 â namba 3 erâ qowi guru gâcne soŋaŋ‐jopahuc rambiŋ jaŋe sasawa dâŋ ijaha jaza‐fârehuc muwec: “Ŋoŋe Esau bâfuarâ iŋuc hâcne âzâcnenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ munʒepieŋ: ‘Manakic, kiŋaŋŋicge Jakobo e ʒâhec warehuc jukac.’” Jakobo e kecʒiŋuc manasuhuc wiac i efârewec: “Bubiaŋ wiac râepe rame Esauzi honerâ bune mâteŋkeha raku bâfuape âgo enarezejec.”
Iŋuc manasuhuc bubiaŋte wiac râeme bâniewec, e jahacne ine ŋafe ira tomao jaha fowec.
Eme Jakobo e hae mi fure taniŋkeha ŋafeoa faharerâ ŋonâŋ jahec‐ticne â kiŋaŋ ŋokac jahec‐ticne â ŋokâfâcne 11 jaŋe rocjopame Jaboko opâ rendacnao fotâcnembiŋ.
E wiacfâcne jaŋe rocjopame fotâcne‐fârepie mafa wiac‐ticne sasawa i mâmâc râeme raʒi‐fârewec.
Jakobo e jahacne ine opâ ʒiŋucnao risierâ ŋewec. Ehame ŋic moc fuame ehec juju gie bahapire furic râewec.
Eme ŋic eki Jakobore tâpiri bawahaocte eipierâ gâjoŋnao qawec. Eme Jakobo e ŋic ehec juju gie bahapire hoqaŋeŋ‐ticne ŋetarawec.
Eme ŋic e ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Furic biac râekacte behecnuzemec.” Jakobozi ine dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Mâc mi behecgupemu, jambuŋnutec behecgupemu.”
Eme ŋiczi wiocnewec: “Go ʒâŋege mo?” Mume muwec: “Jakobo.”
Eme muwec: “Gore ʒâŋe Jakobo mocwâc mi muhuc Israe muzo. Go Anutuhec â ŋichec mâmâc juju gie barâ sanaŋkemec hâcne.”
Eme Jakobozi wiocnerâ muwec: “Go muc, gore ʒâŋe ine mo?” Eki ine muwec: “Go wemocte ʒâŋe‐nanere wiokomec?” Iŋuc murâ ijaha jambuŋkewec.
Eme Jakobo e hae mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe Peniele muwec, i ʒiŋuc muhuc: “No Anutu ʒâŋe mai jâmbâŋ‐ticne honerâ sifu mac mi hâmopac.”
Eme Peniele mâreŋ beherâ rahame ʒoaŋ wefuwec, e hoqaŋeŋ‐ticne ŋetarawecte âte ŋetarac rawec.
Eme ŋic e Jakobo gâjoŋnao qawecte Israe ŋic jaŋe qowi gâjoŋnere rua mi nânâ qikiŋnembiŋzi qikiŋnehuc jueŋgopieŋ jaha.
Eme Jakobo e ʒâŋe fime rame mi Esau â ŋicfâcne 400 warepie honec‐jopazejec i. Iŋuc honec‐joparâ naru motec bâtâc bacjoparâ Lea â Rahe erâ kiŋaŋ ŋokac jajahec jaŋerao râec‐jopawec.
Erâ kiŋaŋ ŋokac jahe naru motecfâc‐jekic jaŋehec micne râec‐jopawec, izi Lea â naru motecfâcne, erâ Rahe â Josefe jahe ine ʒâhec jâmbâŋ.
E jahacne ine bânie‐jarehuc mâreŋko dape qâhâŋ eha arec 7 eme hahac‐ticnerao fisiwec.
Esauzi ine gasacke ra fisirâ hâpo mumuduc ecneme kikioc epic.
Ehuc ʒâŋe fime rame ŋokac naru motec honec‐joparâ muwec: “Keci weni jaŋe gohec juŋgopieŋ?” Eki muwec: “Anutuzi buuruc‐ticnere erâ kiŋaŋŋicge no naru motec tahacnuwec jaŋe hâcne.”
Eme kiŋaŋ ŋokac jahe â motecfâc‐jekic jaŋe ware dapembiŋ.
Eme Lea â naru motecfâcne jaŋe iŋuc jaha ware dapembiŋ, eme ʒâhec Rahe â Josefe jahe wâc ware dapepic.
Eme Esauzi Jakobo wiocnewec: “Ŋic â qowi guru hatao fâpie bâfuac‐jopapac izi wemo ezo mukomec?” Eki dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Bomboŋ‐nane goki akicnucmurâ râec‐jopapac.”
Esauzi ine muwec: “Ɋanane, no nahacne wiac bocjaha fonarekac, irec wiac fogarekac i fogareoc.”
Mume Jakobozi muwec: “Aricne, go nore manatec sâckekacko taha i sifu mac rozemec. Go âgo enarehuc akicnutec honecgupe ʒâŋe maige Anuture ʒâŋe mai tinac ejec.
Irec taha baware‐garepac i rozemec mac, Anutuzi buuruc‐ticnere erâ râe tahac enarewecte sesic qeqeri fonarekac hâcne.” Iŋuc muhuc fotariecneme sifu rowec.
Erâ Esauzi muwec: “Ʒi faharerâ bânie‐garepe ranac.”
Eki ine muwec: “Bomboŋ‐nane go manakic, naru motec jaŋe gegecne sasawa â lama bulimakao motecne jaŋe susu nâhuc juŋgopieŋ, irec ʒoaŋ mocjahao sawa hatare fâro ejarepe biac betaŋkerâ hâmo‐fârenʒipiŋkohec.
Irec bomboŋ‐nane, go kiŋaŋŋicge no bânie‐narec. No ine qowi â naru motec tâpiri‐jeŋicte sâcko qataŋ‐joparâ fâku Seiri haeo gorao fisizepac.”
Eme Esauzi muwec: “Iŋuc mukicte ine ŋicfâc‐nane nohec juŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec gâcnezi baficguniŋte gorao râec‐jopape.” Eki ine muwec: “Iŋuc wemocte? No bomboŋ‐nane go akicnucmurâ mocjaha mukopac.”
Eme Esau e ʒoaŋ ijaha risie raku Seiri haeo fisiwec.
Jakobo e ine Sukoti haeo rarâ ficticne moc bawec, ehuc qowifâcne jaŋere boze wiac bawec wâc. Irec hae mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe Sukoti muwec.
Jakobo e Mesopotamia mâreŋkonec sahac furu risie wareku Sikem haeo fisirâ hae mendâŋko ŋec juc ewec.
Ehuc boze‐ticne bawec mâreŋ i Sikemte mamac, ʒâŋene Hamoro ere ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec moneŋ kâcɋene 100‐zi furine bawec.
Erâ ira alata moc barâ ʒâŋene ʒiŋuc muwec: “Anutu e Israere Anutu”.
Leazi Jakobore otâ moc rowec ʒâŋene Dina, e hâcne dameŋ mocko mâreŋ rune naru âgofâc‐ticne jaŋe honec‐jopaocte rawec.
Ehame mâreŋ irec ŋicbomboŋ Hiwiŋic Hamoro ere ŋokâ Sikemzi naru e honewec. Erâ rorâ ehec fohuc bâsâqorewec.
Ehuc maŋticnezi erea domaha âgo ecnehuc mu bâmiriŋ biaŋne ecnewec.
Erâ mamac‐ticne Hamoro ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go naru keci nore ŋonâŋ eocte dâŋgie bazemec.”
Jakobozi ine otâ‐ticne bâsâqorekicne irec biŋene manawec, ehuc ine ŋokâfâcne jaŋe qowi soŋaŋ jumbiŋte jaŋere woŋec juhuc dâŋ i mâc râeme fowec.
Ehame Sikem mamac‐ticne Hamoro e Jakobohec dâŋ municte erao rawec.
Eme Jakobo ŋokâfâcne jaŋe gieonec risierâ Sikemzi seŋjeŋic bâsâqorehuc Israe guruo mimi sâko bâfuawec biŋe i manarâ bujeŋic wefume aaric‐jopawec. E wiac mi eene jâmbâŋ ewec hâcne.
Hamoro e ine ʒiŋuc muhuc jazawec: “Ŋokâ‐nane Sikem e maŋticne ere sanaŋne domakacte sifu ŋonâŋ‐ticne eocte râcneniŋ me!
Eme nâŋehec sâsâme efârenaŋ, ŋoŋe narufâc‐ŋeŋic nârehuc nâŋere narufâc rocjopaniŋ.
Ehuc nâŋerao juhapie mâreŋ ʒizi ŋoŋere biŋe ezejec wâc, irec ʒira juhuc gie barâ ŋesanaŋkeniŋ.”
Eme Sikem e Dina mamac‐ticne â seŋfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe sifu mac mana‐nareniŋ! Eme wiac muniŋmu sâc i ŋarepemu.
Ŋoŋe ŋokac furi bafehuc bec boreŋ wiac bocjahare mupie sifu muniŋmu sâc râepemu, mâc naru e ŋonâŋ‐nane eocte nare‐jâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Sikem e seŋjeŋic Dina bâsâqorewecte Jakobo ŋokâfâcne jaŋe sioc ehuc Sikem â mamac‐ticne Hamoro dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jactehuc jasambiŋ:
“Nâŋe ŋic moc sahacnao ma mi bakicne iŋucne seŋnâŋec sâcne mi râcnenaŋmu, wiac iŋucne i nâŋerao miminehec eekac.
Irec ʒiŋuc epie mana‐ŋactenaŋmu: Ŋoŋe nâŋe iŋucne ehuc ŋic sasawa sahac‐ŋeŋicko ma banʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc epie narufâc‐nâŋec ŋarenaŋmu â nâŋe wâc narufâc‐ŋeŋic sâcne rocjopanaŋmu, erâ ŋoŋerao ʒuhuckepene ŋicguru mocjaha efârenʒepeneŋ.
Â dâŋ ŋazaŋgopneŋ i qatarahuc sahac‐ŋeŋicko ma mi baniŋmuo ine naru‐nâŋec rorâ hae mâreŋ ʒi beherâ ranaŋmu.”
Hamoro â ŋokâ‐ticne jahe dâŋjeŋicte manapire sâckewec.
Eme Sikem e iŋuc eocte manabâc mi ewec, e Jakobo otâ‐ticne honebâckewec hâcne â wiacfâcne jaŋe ere manapie fefene ewec.
Eme Hamoro â ŋokâ‐ticne Sikem jahe hae‐jekicko risierâ tutumaŋ ficko ferâ hae rune ʒiŋuc jazapic:
“Ŋic keci jaŋe wamane, irec mâreŋ‐nâŋecko juhuc gie wiac‐jeŋic baniŋte mana‐jarenʒepeneŋ. Mâreŋ rârec rârec kâcɋene fokacte sâcne sâcjopaocmu. Ehame nâŋâc narufâc‐jeŋic ŋokac rocjopanʒepeneŋ, ehuc nâŋâcne narufâc jaŋe jarenʒepeneŋ wâc.
Mâc jaŋe wiac ʒiŋucte sawa mana‐nârerâ ʒira juhuc nâŋâcnehec sisifuc eniŋte muŋgopieŋ: Jaŋe sahac‐jeŋicko ma bakicne iŋuc jaha ŋic sasawa nâŋâc sahac‐nâŋecko ma banʒepeneŋ.
Iŋuc epene lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic â mafa wiac‐jeŋic sasawa i nâŋâcne biŋe jaha eocmu. Irec mana‐jarepene nâŋâcnao ŋec juc enʒepieŋ.”
Eme hae rune sasawa jaŋe Hamoro â ŋokâ‐ticne Sikem jahere dâŋte manapie sâckeme sahac‐jeŋicko ma bambiŋ.
Eme ŋic jaŋe ʒâic manahuc fohapie ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha Jakobo ŋokâ jahec‐ticne Simeoŋ â Lewi, Dinare seŋ jahec hâcne, jahe ʒika‐jekic rorâ haeo ferâ ŋic jopa‐fârepic.
Ehuc Hamoro â ŋokâ‐ticne Sikem jahe mâmâc jofarâ Sikemte fickonec Dina fâre waharâ jowa rapic.
Eme Jakobo ŋokâfâc‐ticne gâcne jaŋe ŋic qâhamoc‐jopakicne jaŋere mafa â hae irec mafa wiac fiuc rombiŋ, i seŋjeŋic bâsâqorembiŋte iŋuc embiŋ.
Erâ lama bulimakao â doŋgifâc‐jeŋic, haeo jumbiŋ mecne gieo jumbiŋ mecne i mâmâc rocjopa‐fârembiŋ.
Ehuc mafa wiac‐jeŋic â ŋokac naru motecfâc‐jeŋic i mâmâc jowac‐jopa rambiŋ. Ficko wiac fowec sâc i fiuc rofârerâ barambiŋ hâcne.
Iŋuc epie Jakobozi Simeoŋ â Lewi ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ŋohe mâreŋ rune Kanaaŋ â Periʒi ŋic jaŋere maio ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane bâsâqorehuc fai‐naneo wiac hâhâwicne râepire fejec. No ŋicfâc‐nane afecne sawa juŋgopieŋ, eme jaŋe râsi roroc ehuc ware nâpopie no â wiacfâc‐nane sipiricke‐fârenaŋmu.”
Eme jahe mupic: “Hâc, e seŋnâŋec boe sau ŋokac iŋucne wiac ecneme sâckewec me?”
Eme Anutuzi Jakobo ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ajoc, go ʒawierâ Bete haeo ferâ ira ŋec juc ezemec. Ehuc hahacge Esaure hâwicgume wisehaŋtec Anutuzi fua‐garewec, e hâcne ira alata moc bacnezemec.”
Iŋuc mume Jakobozi wiacfâcne â ŋic ehec jumbiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jaza‐fârewec: “Ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko nemuɋâŋ forakac i behepie raha sahac‐ŋeŋic emasaŋkehuc ŋaqi wiac‐ŋeŋic ɋaɋacne hepie huzejec.
Eme faharerâ Bete haeo fenʒepeneŋ, no fific guguriŋ faio juhape mana‐narehuc hatao ŋezicnuwec, Anutu e hâcne ira alata moc bacnezepac.”
Iŋuc jazame nemuɋâŋ bajumbiŋ i mecne â hazec warawa wiac‐jeŋic i mâmâc Jakobo râcnepie, Sikem hae qaŋeŋnao boriŋjâc domawec irec fuŋnao duckewec.
Eme faharerâ rambiŋ. Ehame hae rârec rârec ŋerawec irec rune jaŋe ine Anuture hâwic‐jopame Jakobo â ŋokâfâcne wemocko jopa jâpec ejarenʒapiŋ.
Eme Jakobo â ŋicfâcne ehec jumbiŋ jaŋe Kanaaŋ mâreŋko Lusi haeo, Bete hâcne, ira fisi‐fârembiŋ.
Ehuc Jakobo e ira alata moc barâ ʒâŋene El‐Bete muwec. E hahac‐ticnere hâwickeme wiserâ raha Anutuzi ira hâcne fuacnewecte iŋuc ewec.
Eme Rebeka jauŋ ŋokac‐ticne ʒâŋene Debora, e ira hâmome Bete hae juwicnao boriŋjâc fuŋnao duckembiŋ. Boriŋjâc ʒâŋene “Ki mamakuc boriŋ” muwec.
Eme Jakobo e Mesopotamia mâreŋkonec warerâ juhame Anutuzi mocwâc fuacnerâ jambuŋkewec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go ʒâŋege Jakobo, ʒi ine Jakobo mocwâc mi muhuc Israe muzo.” Iŋuc murâ Israe muwec.
Erâ Anutuzi ʒuhuckerâ âzâcnewec: “No Anutu tâpiri rune, go fua sawec ehuc sawe mâririackezemec, ehame goraonec ŋicguru mocjaha sawa mâcne, ŋic gurune gurune fua ranʒepieŋ, erâ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe gore bifuŋkonec fuanʒepieŋ wâc.
Eme Abraham â Isaka mâreŋ jactepo i go garehuc ɋâricfâcge jaŋe mâmâc jarezepac.”
Eme Anutu e Jakobohec dâŋ muc manac epic irecnec fahare fewec.
Ehame Jakobo e Anutuzi dâŋ âzâcnewec mâreŋ ira qânâma moc âkendâŋnewec, erâ fainao taha bâzi râerâ wokemaŋ ruacnewec.
Ehuc Anutuzi dâŋ âzâcnewec mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe Bete muwec.
Eme jaŋe Bete beherâ rahuc juku Efarata hae bâqiŋkehuc Rahezi ʒâic sâko manahuc motec rowec.
Motec roocte ŋemâckeme gozi bapa‐ticnezi ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Go mi hâwicguoc, ŋokâ jaha rocmu.”
Eme motec rorâ hâmozo ehuc ʒâŋene Ben‐oni muwec, Mamacnezi ine ʒâŋene Benjamiŋ muwec.
Eme Rahezi hâmome Efarata hatao, Betelehem hatao hâcne, duckembiŋ.
Eme Jakobo e ʒâŋeruŋ‐ticnao qânâma moc âkendâŋnewec. Qânâ izi Rahe ʒâŋeruŋ‐ticnere ma ŋeweczi ŋekac.
Eme Israe e hata mocwâc ʒuhuckerâ raku Migida‐Ede ficʒora ocniŋucnao fisirâ qoruc boze‐ticne fârewec.
Erâ mâreŋ ira ŋec juc ehame Rubeŋzi mamac‐ticnere ŋonâŋoc Biliharao rame ehec fopic. Eme Israezi biŋe manarâ aarickewec.
Jakobo ŋokâfâcne 12 jumbiŋ. Leare ŋokâfâc ʒiŋuc: Rubeŋ, e Jakobo mârâc ŋokâ‐ticne, erâ Simeoŋ, Lewi, Juda, Isasa â Sebuloŋ.
Rahe ere ŋokâ jahec ʒiŋuc: Josefe â Benjamiŋ.
Biliha, Rahe kiŋaŋ naru‐ticnere ŋokâ ʒiŋuc: Daŋ â Naftali.
Silipa, Leare kiŋaŋ naru ere ŋokâ ine Gade â Ase. Jakobo ŋokâfâcne iŋuc hâcne Mesopotamia mâreŋko fuambiŋ.
Eme Jakobo e mamac‐ticne Isaka Mamere haeo Kiriati‐Araba, Heboroŋ hâcne, juwecko ra fisiwec. Hae mâreŋ ira hâcne Abraham â Isaka jahe jupic.
Isaka e jara‐ticne 180 bazuwec.
E jujâmbâŋkeku ŋicqizec erâ hâmohuc mimiŋnefâc‐ticne jaŋerao ʒuhuckewec. Eme ŋokâ jahec‐ticne Esau â Jakobo jahe duckepic.
Ʒi Esau, Edom hâcne, ere ɋâricfâc jaŋere ʒâŋe biri.
Esau e Kanaaŋ naru jaŋeraonec ŋonâŋ jahec â moc rocjopawec, moc Ada, Hitiŋic Eloŋ ere otâ, â moc Hiwiŋic Zibeoŋ ŋokâ‐ticne Ana ere otâ, ʒâŋene Oholibama,
erâ moc ine Isimaere otâ, ʒâŋene Basemata, Nebajotire seŋ.
Eme Adazi Elifaʒi rowec, Basematazi Reguele rowec
â Oholibama eki ine Jeusi, Jalam â Kora rocjopawec. Esaure ŋokâfâc iŋuc hâcne Kanaaŋ mâreŋko fuambiŋ.
Eme Esau e ŋonâŋfâcne mecne, naru motecfâcne mecne â ŋic ŋokac gâcne ficticnao jumbiŋ jaŋe mecne, erâ mafa wiac â lama bulimakao sasawa â wâcwiac‐ticne Kanaaŋ mâreŋko juhuc hure‐fârewec i rocjopa‐fârerâ ɋaticne Jakobo beherâ Seiri mâreŋko rawec.
Mafa wiac‐jekic bocjahare mâmâc jaha ŋec juc enicte manapire quŋkewec, erâ bulimakaofâc‐jekic guru sâkore mâreŋ jaba jupic izi mi sâcjopawec.
Esau, Edom hâcne, e iŋuc ehuc Seiri tiki mâreŋko ŋec juc ewec.
Ʒi ine Edomŋic Seiri tiki mâreŋko jurambiŋ jaŋere apa Esau ere ɋâricfâc.
Esau ŋokâfâcne jaŋere ʒâŋe biri ʒine hâcne: Elifaʒi e Esaure ŋonâŋ Ada ere ŋokâ, Reguele e Esaure ŋonâŋ Basemata ere ŋokâ.
Elifaʒire ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Temaŋ, Omare, Ʒefo, Gatam â Kenaʒi.
Eme Elifaʒi, Esaure ŋokâ hâcne, ere ŋonâŋoc Timina eki Amaleke rowec. Esau ŋonâŋ‐ticne Ada ere ɋâricfâc ine hâcne.
Reguele ere ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Nahati, Sera, Sama â Misa. I jaŋe hâcne Esaure ŋonâŋ Basematare ɋâricfâc.
Eme Zibeoŋte ŋokâ Ana ere otâ Oholibama e Esaure ŋonâŋ juweczi ŋokâ‐fâcne ʒiŋuc rocjopawec: Jeusi, Jalam â Kora.
Ʒi ine Esau ŋokâfâcne jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ. Esau mârâc ŋokâ‐ticne Elifaʒi ere ŋokâfâc hâcne: Temaŋnec ŋicwofuŋ, Omarenec ŋicwofuŋ, Ʒefonec ŋicwofuŋ, Kenaʒinec ŋicwofuŋ,
Koranec ŋicwofuŋ, Gatamnec ŋicwofuŋ erâ Amalekenec ŋicwofuŋ. Elifaʒiraonec ŋic izi hâcne Edom mâreŋko ŋicwofuŋ jumbiŋ. Erâ ŋic izia Ada ere ɋâricfâc.
Ʒi ine Esaure ŋokâ Reguele ere ŋokâfâc: Nahati ŋicwofuŋ, Sera ŋicwofuŋ, Sama ŋicwofuŋ, Misa ŋicwofuŋ. Reguele eraonec ŋic izi hâcne Edom mâreŋko ŋicwofuŋ jumbiŋ, erâ ŋic izia wâc Basemata ere ɋâricfâc.
Ʒi Esaure ŋonâŋ Oholibama ere ŋokâfâc: Jeusi ŋicwofuŋ, Jalam ŋicwofuŋ, Kora ŋicwofuŋ. Ŋic izi hâcne Esaure ŋonâŋ Oholibama, Anare otâ, eraonec fuarâ ŋicwofuŋ jumbiŋ.
Ŋic izi Esau, Edom hâcne, ere ŋokâfâc erâ jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ.
Ʒi ine Horiŋic, ʒâŋene Seiri ere ŋokâfâc â mâreŋ irec rune jâmbâŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe: Lotaŋ, Sobali, Zibeoŋ, Ana,
Disoŋ, Eʒere â Disaŋ. Ŋic izi hâcne Horiŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ â Seiri ere ŋokâfâc Edom mâreŋko jumbiŋ.
Lotaŋ ŋokâ jahec‐ticne Hori â Hemaŋ, Lotaŋ seŋticne ine Timina.
Sobali ere ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Aliwaŋ, Manahati, Ebali, Sefo â Onam.
Zibeoŋte ŋokâ jahec ine kecʒiŋuc: Aja â Ana. Ana ere fuŋne ine ʒiŋuc: E mamac‐ticne Zibeoŋ ere doŋgi soŋaŋ‐jopahuc mâreŋ tuhuo opâ ʒâŋe fârone moc bâfuawec.
Anare naru motec ine ʒiŋuc: Disoŋ â otâ‐ticne ʒâŋene Oholibama.
Disoŋte ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Hemidaŋ, Esibaŋ, Itiraŋ â Keraŋ.
Eʒere ere ŋokâfâc jumbiŋ ine kecʒiŋuc: Bilihaŋ, Sawaŋ â Akaŋ.
Disaŋ ŋokâ jahec‐ticne ʒiŋuc jupic: Uzi â Araŋ.
Horiŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne jumbiŋ: Lotaŋnec ŋicwofuŋ, Sobalinec ŋicwofuŋ, Zibeoŋnec ŋicwofuŋ, Ananec ŋicwofuŋ.
Disaŋnec ŋicwofuŋ. Ŋic izi hâcne Horiŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ mâreŋ ruckembiŋ sâc Seiri mâreŋko jumbiŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ moc mi fuarâ juha Edom mâreŋko ŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ gie bahuc jumbiŋ:
Beoro ere ŋokâ ʒâŋene Bela e Edomko ŋicwofuŋ juwec, hae qizec‐ticne ʒâŋene Diŋhaba.
Bela hâmome Sera, Bozera haeonec, ere ŋokâ Jobabezi tucticne qawec.
Jobabezi hâmome Husam, Temaŋ mâreŋkonec eki tucticne qawec.
Husamzi hâmome Hadadi, Bedadi ŋokâ‐ticne, eki tucticne qawec. Eki ine Midiaŋ ŋic Moabi mâreŋko jopawec. Hadadi hae qizec‐ticne ine Awiti.
Hadadizi hâmome Samala, Masarekaonec, eki tucticne qawec.
Samalazi hâmome Saulu, Rehoboti hae Eufrata opâo ŋewec, e irec runezi tucticne qawec.
Sauluzi hâmome Baali‐Hanaŋ, Akaboro ere ŋokâzi tucticne qawec.
Baali‐Hanaŋ, Akaboro ere ŋokâzi hâmome Hadarizi tucticne qawec. E hae qizec‐ticne ʒâŋene Pahu â ŋonâŋ‐ticne ʒâŋene Mehetabe. Mehetabe e ine Matirede ere otâ â Meʒahabare ŋosa.
Esaure ɋâricfâc ŋicwofuŋ jumbiŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe biri ine fufua â hae â ʒâŋe‐jeŋicte sâcko kecʒiŋuc fokac: Timina irec ŋicwofuŋ, Aliwanec ŋicwofuŋ, Jeteti irec ŋicwofuŋ,
Oholibamanec ŋicwofuŋ, Elanec ŋicwofuŋ, Pinoŋ irec ŋicwofuŋ,
Kenaʒi irec ŋicwofuŋ, Temaŋnec ŋicwofuŋ, Mibezare irec ŋicwofuŋ,
Magadeilenec ŋicwofuŋ erâ Iramnec ŋicwofuŋ. Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne mâreŋ rauckembiŋko jurambiŋ sâc Edom ŋicwofuŋ erâ jumbiŋ. Edomŋic jaŋere apa Esau, ere ɋâricfâc hâcne.
Jakobo e Kanaaŋ mâreŋko mamac‐ticnezi jaba juwec ira hâcne ŋec juc ewec.
Jakobo wiacfâcne jaŋere binaŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac: Josefe e jara‐ticne 17 bazume hahacfâcne jaŋehec mâmâc lama soŋaŋ jumbiŋ. E motec ɋâri juwecte mamac‐ticnere ŋokac jahec Biliha â Silipa jahere ŋokâfâc jaŋehec juwec hâcne. Eme jaŋe bahac i me i moc bâfuapie Josefezi irec dâŋ mamac‐ticne âzâcne jujec.
Israezi ine Josefe maŋjauŋ ecnewec i ŋokâfâcne gâcne ejarewec irec sâc sirickewec. E Israezi biac ŋicqizec erâ juha fuawecte iŋuc ecnewec. Ehuc mume ŋaqi menehec moc bacnembiŋ.
Eme hahacfâcne jaŋe, mamac‐jeŋiczi ŋokâfâcne gâcne jauŋ afecne ejarehuc Josefe ine bafehuc ecnewec, iŋuc honerâ Josefe qaisockehuc ehec dâŋ urucne muc manac mi embiŋ.
Juku Josefezi guŋ moc manarâ hahacfâcne binaŋ bajarehuc
ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe mananiŋ, no guŋ moc ʒiŋuc manapo:
Nâŋâc gieo padi dâtâckembeŋ. Ehame nore dâtâczi acmâc fahare domawec, â ŋoŋere dâtâczi ine nore orâŋkerâ hasickehuc domambiŋ.”
Iŋuc mume hahacfâcne jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Hâc, go nâŋere ŋicwofuŋ ehuc soŋaŋ‐nâpocmurâ mukic me?” Iŋuc murâ guŋticnere â dâŋticnere boc qaisockembiŋ.
Eme irec faicnao guŋ moc manawec i ŋuc jaha hahacfâcne binaŋ bajarehuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Mananiŋ, no guŋ moc ʒiŋuc manapac: Mosa ʒoaŋ â bâpiŋ 11 jaŋe dape‐narembiŋ.”
Binaŋ i mamac hahacfâcne mâmâc bajarewec. Eme mamacnezi dâŋ mucnehuc âzâcnewec: “Go guŋ keci manamec i weniŋuc? Neŋgoc mamac â hahacfâcge nâŋe fisirâ maŋfuŋgao fodapenaŋte mukomec me?”
Eme hahacfâcne jaŋe iiŋ guuŋ ecnehapie mamacnezi ine dâŋ i maŋkerâ juwec.
Eme hahacfâcne jaŋe mamac‐jeŋicte lamafâc soŋaŋ‐jopaniŋte Sikem hae mâreŋko ra juhapie
Israezi Josefe ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go manakic, hahacfâcge jaŋe Sikem mâreŋko lama soŋaŋ juŋgopieŋ. Irec warec, eme no jaŋerao sorecgupe razemec.” Mume muwec: “No ʒawierâ jukopac.”
Eme eki âzâcnewec: “Go rarâ hahacfâcge honec‐jopazemec, jaŋe ɋiɋicne â biaŋne juŋgopieŋ me weniŋuc, erâ lama guru jaŋe iŋuc jaha sâcne mac juŋgopieŋ me mâcne, erâ ware dâŋ binaŋ enarezemec.” Iŋuc muhuc Heboroŋ wâneŋkonec soreme raku Sikemko fisiwec.
Erâ hata qâsoriehuc rac warec eha ŋic moczi bâfuarâ wiocnewec: “Go wemo wiac basakic?”
Eki muwec: “No hahacfâc‐nane basac‐jopakopac. Jaŋe wena juhuc lama soŋaŋ‐jopaŋgopieŋ i nazac mac.”
Ŋic eki muwec: “Jaŋe ʒirecnec mocko rambiŋ. Ehuc ʒiŋuc mupie manapo hâcne: ‘Ajoc, nâŋâc Dotaŋko ranaŋ.’”
Eme Josefe e hahacfâcne basac‐jopa raku Dotaŋko bâfuac‐jopawec. Eme taicko juhame honerâ qaniŋte mumockehuc
ʒiŋuc muc manac embiŋ: “Honeniŋ, guŋŋic warekac kecocna!
Ajoc, wareme qanaŋ, erâ opâ nombâŋko behepene hurâ foha ʒiŋuc munʒepeneŋ: Qowi mimicnezi ware kisuckewec. Ehame guŋticnere fuŋne taniŋkezejec.”
Eme Rubeŋzi dâŋ i manarâ mejeŋickonec bataraocte manasuhuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Aricne, mi qazo.”
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ jazawec: “Socticne mi hoŋkeniŋ! Mâreŋ tuhuo nombâŋ moc fokac ira behepie huoc, juju‐ticne ine akickenʒepieŋ.” E mejeŋickonec batararâ mamac‐ticnerao bârisieocte manasuhuc iŋuc muwec.
Eme Josefe e hahacfâcne jaŋerao fisime ŋaqi rojuwec, ŋaqi menehec hâcne, i heunuckecnembiŋ.
Erâ rorâ nombâŋko behepie huwec, nombâŋ ine opâ tâmiric tacne fowec.
Jaŋe iŋuc erâ nânâ nâniŋte waha ŋembiŋ. Ehuc ʒâŋe fipie rame Isimae âbârâ ŋic Gileade haeonec warepie honec‐jopambiŋ. Jaŋe kamelefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe gumi â wokemaŋ â jâc sâŋiŋ wiac âsickepie Aigita mâreŋko raniŋte warembiŋ.
Eme Judazi ɋafâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Nâŋâc ɋanâŋec qâhâmorâ hesoŋkepene wemo wiac fârine moc fua‐nâreocmu?
Irec Isimae ŋic jarepene jaŋe furi nârenʒepieŋ, e jahacne ine akickenʒepeneŋ, e ɋanâŋec â nâŋâcne soc biuc jaha.” Iŋuc mume ɋafâcne jaŋe manapie sâckewec.
Eme Midiaŋ âbârâ ŋic jaŋe ware fisipie Josefe nombâŋkonec fârepie wefume Ismae ŋic jarepie furine siliwa moneŋ 20 jarembiŋ. Ehuc Aigita mâreŋko barambiŋ.
Eme Rubeŋ e ʒâhec nombâŋko risie rarâ Josefe basawec. Erâ busâqoc manahuc ŋaqi‐ticne bâsuckerâ
ɋafâcne jaŋerao risierâ muwec: “No motec e basakopac i! Irec weniŋuc epe.”
Eme jaŋe noniŋ ŋicne moc qarâ Josefere ŋaqi noniŋ socko âke uruckembiŋ.
Iŋuc erâ ŋaqi menehec i mamac‐jeŋictao ʒiŋuc muhuc râepie rawec: “Wiac bâfuambeŋ i honec! I ŋokâge Josefere ŋaqi me mâcne?”
Eme eki ʒâŋitarâ muwec: “I ŋokâ‐nanere ŋaqi hâcne. Qowi mimicne moczi kisuckerâ nâwec, jâmbomac Josefe e kisuc qâsuckekicne.”
Erâ Jakobo e ŋaqi‐ticne bâsuckehuc mateŋ qonaŋkerâ ŋokâ‐ticnere ki mamakuc ehuc juwec.
Eme naru motecfâcne jaŋe sasawa faharerâ mu bâmiriŋ ecnezo mupie mana‐bipiehuc muwec: “Aricne, no ki busâqoc ehuc juku hâmorâ ŋokâ‐nanerao hâmoc haeo huzepac!” Mamacnezi iŋuc hâcne murâ kiohuc juwec.
Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋe ine Josefe Aigita mâreŋko ŋic moc ʒâŋene Potifa râcnepie furine bawec. Potifa e Faraore momori fuŋfuŋfâc jaŋere micne juwec.
Eme dameŋ ira Juda e ɋafâcne jaŋe behec‐jopa ra Adulam hae mâreŋko ŋic moc ʒâŋene Hira erao juwec.
Erâ ira juhuc Kanaaŋ ŋic moc, ʒâŋene Sua, ere otâ honerâ ŋokac rorâ ehec juwec.
Eme ŋokac e motec kiweckerâ rorâ ʒâŋene Ero muwec.
Juku motec mocwâc kiweckerâ rowec, ere ʒâŋe Onaŋ muwec.
Izi motec moc kiweckerâ rowec, ere ʒâŋe Sela muwec, motec e ine Keʒibi haeo juhuc rowec.
Eme Juda e juku mârâc ŋokâ‐ticne Ero ŋokac moc râcnewec, ʒâŋene Tama.
Wofuŋzi ine mârâc motec ere maname mi sâckewecte mume hâmowec.
Iŋuc fuame Judazi Onaŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go qozigerao razemec, erâ qozi jaŋere ɋâric bâbâfuare dâŋ mukicne, i hâcne reŋkehuc hahacgere biŋe ɋâric bâfuazemec.”
Onaŋzi ine ʒiŋuc manawec: No ɋâric bâfuape nore biŋe mi eniŋmu. Iŋuc muhuc hahac‐ticnere ɋâric moc mi bâfuaocte manasuhuc ŋokactao rawec sâc wie gorewac‐ticne mâc mâreŋko hoŋkeme wahawec.
Iŋuc eme Wofuŋzi mana sâqorerâ mume e wâc hâmowec.
Eme Judazi joŋao‐ticne Tama ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go mamacgere ficko ra hozec jaha juhaŋtec ŋokâ‐nane Selazi sokazejec.” I ʒiŋuc manahuc muwec: Sela e hahac jahec‐ticne hâmopic iŋuc jaha hâmozackohec. Eme Tama e ra mamac‐ticnere ficko juhuc juwec.
Ehame juku ʒâhec Suare otâ, Juda ŋonâŋ‐ticne hâcne, e hâmowec. Eme ki mamakuc dameŋ tarame Judazi âgo‐ticne Hira, Adulam haeonec ehec Timina mâreŋko, lamafâc‐ticne jaŋere kanʒaŋ bâtâcnembiŋko rapic.
Ehame Tama dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Manakic, joŋaoge e lamafâcne jaŋere kanʒaŋ bâtâcneocte Timina hae mâreŋko fekac.”
Iŋuc manarâ rurufa‐ticne hetararâ qâruruzi ʒâŋe maine foŋkewec. Erâ ra Timina hatao hae moc ŋewec, ʒâŋene Enaim, hae irec mendâŋko waha ŋewec. I Selazi soka tarame ere ŋonâŋ juocte mi râcnembiŋte iŋuc ewec.
Eme Judazi fisi honerâ ere maname boe sau ŋokac tinac ewec, e ʒâŋe maine foŋkewec irec.
Eme hata kizurâ erao ra muwec: “No gohec fopemurâ mana‐narec.” E joŋao‐ticnezi ŋewec i mi manahuc dâŋ i muwec hâcne. Eki muwec: “Nohec focmurâ mana‐garepe wemo wiac mo narecmu?”
Mume muwec: “No noniŋ motecne moc râe‐garepe wareocmu.” Mume muwec: “Irec kifac wiac moc naretec bajuhape ware fisizejec.”
Eki muwec: “Wemo kifac mo garepemurâ mukic?” Ŋokaczi muwec: “Meo fefege maqâreŋhec â mucge â gunuge meo badomakic i narec.” Eme wiac muwec sâc râcnerâ ehec fowec.
Eme kiwechec ewec. Izi faharerâ ra qâruru hetararâ rurufa‐ticne mocwâc heme huwec.
Eme Judazi âgo‐ticne, Adulam haeonec, e ŋokactaonec kifac wiac rorâ bârisiecneocte noniŋ motecne râcnehuc soreme rawec. Eki ine ra ŋokac basawec.
Ehuc ŋic mu wioc ejarehuc muwec: “Boe sau ŋokac Enaim hatao ŋewec e wena?” Jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Boe sau ŋokac moczi ʒira moc mi wareme honembeŋ.”
Eme mocwâc Judarao risie âzâcnewec: “No ŋokac e mi bâfuapo, ehame hae irec rune jaŋe ʒiŋuc nazambiŋ: Boe sau ŋokac moczi moc ʒira ware mi juwec.”
Eme Judazi muwec: “Dâŋnâŋec fuazacte wiac i sifu focneoc. No noniŋ motecne râepe rawec, eme goki mi bâfuameŋ.”
Eme mosa jahec â moc tarame Juda biŋedâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Joŋaoge sasec gie baku ʒi kiwechec jukac.” Eme Judazi muwec: “E jowa warepie ʒocte biŋe ezejec.”
Eme jowapie rahuc joŋao‐ticnerao dâŋ ʒiŋuc râeme rawec: “Wiac ʒirec rune jukac eki bacnume kiwechec epo. Irec go honec, meo fefe maqâreŋhec â muc â gunu wiac i more?”
Eme Juda e wiac i hone dendeŋnehuc ʒâŋitarâ muwec: “E dâŋ jâmbomac mukac, wiac i nore sasawa. No wemocte mutuc erâ ŋokâ‐nane Sela erao mi râepo.” Iŋuc murâ ŋokac ehec mocwâc mi juwec.
Eme motec roocte dameŋne maickeme mi funʒuŋ fâri rocjofazejec i!
Motec rozo ehame qanaŋ mocte mezi wahawec. Wahame gozi bapa ŋokaczi biac rorâ muc bâbâroŋ bândeŋnewec. I ʒiŋuc muhuc ewec: Eki hâcne bâbâni fuawec.
Kogoc eki ine meticne mocwâc fâreme fehame ɋanezi fuawec. Eme gozi bapa ŋokaczi muwec: “Hâc, go hawec sâko mo iŋucne bâfuarâ fuamec?” Iŋuc mume ʒâŋe‐ticne Pereze mumbiŋ.
Eme ʒâhec hahac‐ticne menao muc bâbâroŋ bândeŋnekicne eki fuawec. Ere ʒâŋe ine Sera mumbiŋ.
Eme Josefe Aigita mâreŋko ba fisipie Aigita ŋic moc ʒâŋene Potifa e Faraore momori fuŋfuŋfâc jaŋere micne juweczi Isimae ŋic jaŋeraonec furine bawec.
Wofuŋzi ine Josefehec juwecte eki wiac ebac ewec i biaŋke‐fâreme bomboŋ‐ticnere ficko juocte manacnekicne.
Eme Josefe e gie bawec sâc i Wofuŋzi ehec juhuc bafickeme bame biaŋke‐fârewec.
Bomboŋ‐ticnezi iŋuc honerâ Josefere maname sâckeme e jahacne kiŋaŋ qaqa jâmbâŋ bawec, ehuc ficticnere â wiac focnewec sâc irec soŋaŋ âkendâŋnewec.
Eme Potifa e Josefe ficticnere â moneŋ mafa wiac‐ticnere soŋaŋ râewec, dameŋ ira Wofuŋzi Josefere erâ Aigita ŋic ficticne jambuŋkewec, ehame wiac focnewec sâc, ficko mecne, gieo mecne i Wofuŋte jambuŋzi sâcke‐fârerâ fowec.
Eme irec hâcne wiac focnewec sâc i Josefere meo râehuc wiac irec me irec mana mezac mi ewec, mâc nânâ nâhuc juwec irec mocjaha manasuwec. Josefe e sahac hawari biaŋ.
Eme irec hâcne Potifa ŋonâŋ‐ticnezi Josefe honebâckehuc juku dameŋ mocko ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go nohec fozemec.”
Eki ine qatararâ bomboŋ‐ticnere ŋonâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, bomboŋ‐nanezi nore manabâc mi ehuc wiac focnekac sâc i nore meo râe‐fârewec.
Ehuc fic ʒira e jahacne sâc jaha jupemurâ râecnuwec. E wiac sasawa qikiŋne‐narehuc go mocjaha ŋonâŋ‐ticne jukicte sakare‐narewec. Ehame no wemocko hehesic iŋucne sâko moc bâfuahuc Anutu bunao bapemu.”
Eme ŋokac e ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne Josefe jâiŋkehuc jume sifu sanaŋkerâ ehec juc foc eocte takickeme dâŋticne qikeŋnewec.
Eme ʒoaŋ mocko kiŋaŋ qaqa gâcne jaŋe mocko juhapie Josefezi gie‐ticne baocte ficko fewec.
Eme ŋokac e Josefere ŋaqi rorâ basanaŋkehuc muwec: “Go ware nohec fonac.” Eki ine ŋaqi‐ticne hetarame ere meo foha wiserâ hae ʒoŋao wahawec.
Eme ŋaqi‐ticne hetararâ hae ʒoŋao huwec, ŋokaczi iŋuc honerâ
kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne wira‐jarerâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Keci honeniŋ! Potifa e Hebiraio ŋic moczi kosa enâreocte baware‐nârewec i! E nohec foocte wefume owa ruruckepac.
Eme owa ruruckepe manarâ ŋaqi‐ticne norao hetararâ hae ʒoŋao hujec.”
Eme ŋaqi‐ticne râeme foha Josefe bomboŋ‐ticnezi risiewec.
Eme binaŋ ijaha bacnehuc muwec: “Hebiraio kiŋaŋŋic jowa waremeŋ, e wiac kosa enareocte wefujec i!
Eme no owa ruruckerâ wirape ŋaqi‐ticne norao ʒi hetararâ mâc wiserâ hae ʒoŋao hujec.”
Eme bomboŋ‐ticne e, ŋonâŋnezi “Kiŋaŋ qaqage e iŋuc enarejec” muhuc dâŋ binaŋ ecneme manarâ mâretec aarickewec.
Eme Potifa e Josefe rorâ kâpâcwâru ficko, ŋicwofuŋte kâpâcwâru ŋic ŋembiŋkoa râewec, eme ira fohuc juwec.
Ehame Wofuŋzi Josefehec juhuc kâpâcwâru fic soŋaŋ ecneme eki Josefere maname biaŋkewec.
Irec kâpâcwâru fic soŋaŋ e Josefezi kâpâcwâru ŋic sasawa soŋaŋ‐jopaocte erao râec‐jopa‐fârewec. Eme jaŋe wiac ebac embiŋ i Josefere micte efârembiŋ.
Eme kâpâcwâru fic soŋaŋ e Josefezi giedâŋ i me i muwec ira ʒuhuckerâ dâŋ moc mi muwec, i Wofuŋzi Josefehec juhuc bafickeme wiac ebac eme biaŋke‐fârewecte iŋuc ewec.
Eme wiac keci fuawec irec faicnao ŋicwofuŋte waiŋ soŋaŋ micne â poroŋ ririke micne jahe gie‐jekic bâsifuckepic.
Eme Farao e kiŋaŋŋic jahec‐ticne, waiŋ soŋaŋ micne â poroŋ ririke micne hâcne, jahere aarickewec.
Irec mume momori micne ere ficko, kâpâcwâru ficko hâcne, râec‐jofambiŋ. Josefezi ine fic ijaha fowec.
Eme momori micne e Josefezi kiŋaŋ qajacteocte mucnewec. Ehame jahe dameŋ ŋondeŋ bembeŋne kâpâcwâru ficko ʒuhuckerâ fopic.
Ehuc dameŋ mocko ŋafe ijaha guŋ manapic. Moc e guŋticne moc manawec â moc e guŋticne moc manawec, guŋ manapic i ine fuŋnehec. Aigita ŋicwofuŋte waiŋ soŋaŋ micne â poroŋ ririke micne kâpâcwâru ficko fopic, jahe hâcne iŋuc epic.
Eme hae fureme Josefezi jahere ficmaŋko ferâ busâqoc hawari ŋehapire honec‐jofawec.
Honec‐jofarâ indiŋ‐jofahuc muwec: “Ŋohe miŋecgac wemocte busâqoc hawari ŋekopirec?”
Mume jahe âzâcnepic: “Nâhe guŋ manaperec, erâ ŋic moczi irec fuŋne nâsâocte basakoperec.” Eme Josefezi muwec: “Guŋte fuŋne mumu i Anuture wiac, erâ sifu binaŋ banarenic.”
Eme waiŋ soŋoŋ micnezi guŋ manawec irec binaŋ bahuc muwec: “No ʒiŋuc manapac: Maŋfuŋ‐naneo waiŋ qizecne fuame honepac.
Eme gitecne jahec â moc heha hehame ârine qajec, erâ izia wâc fârine fuarâ qeuejec.
Noni ine Faraore râqâc menanezi badomahuc hândâŋne rorâ bâpisickepe râqâcko hume Farao menao râepe rowec.”
Eme Josefezi âzâcnewec: “Irec fuŋne ʒiŋuc: Gitecne jahec â moc izi ʒoaŋ jahec â moc irec sâc ekac.
Ʒoaŋ jahec â moc tarame Faraozi bârisiecgurâ mocwâc giegao râecguocmu, eme go mârâc waiŋ soŋaŋ micne juhuc Farao râqâc râcnehuc jumeŋ iŋuc jaha mocwâc ehuc jucmu.
Iŋuc erâ bubiaŋ faio juhuc ine nore mac manasuhuc fuŋne‐nane Farao âzâcnezemec, iŋuc ehuc baficnutec fic ʒi behezepac.
Manakic, no Kanaaŋ mâreŋkonec fiuc rocnukicne â ʒira iŋuc jaha wiac sâqocne moc mi ehape oma jâmbâŋ kâpâcwâru ficko râecnumbiŋ.”
Eme poroŋ ririke micne e, Josefezi guŋte fuŋne biaŋne mutaniŋkejec, iŋuc honerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No guŋ manapac wâc, kecʒiŋuc: No amae jahec â moc poroŋhec qizecko huhuckepac.
Ehame amae faine ŋejec ira Faraore biŋne nânâ poroŋ aŋacne fuŋne fuŋne foha wipe jaŋe ware irecnec nâmbiŋ.”
Eme Josefezi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Irec fuŋne kecʒiŋuc: Amae jahec â moc izi ʒoaŋ jahec â moc irec sâc jaha.
Ʒoaŋ jahec â moc tarame Faraozi mume jâcko bituacguniŋmu, eme wipe jaŋe biucge nâfâreniŋmu.”
Eme ʒoaŋ jahec â moc tarame Farao fufua hombaŋ‐ticne maickeme kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne jaŋere tiwâ bâzi ewec. Ehuc kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne jaŋere ŋondeŋko waiŋ soŋaŋ micne â poroŋ ririke micne jahere dâŋ mutarawec.
Ehuc waiŋ soŋaŋ micne e râqâc‐ticne mocwâc râcneocte mucnewec, mârâc gie‐ticnao râewec hâcne.
Poroŋ ririke micne e ine Josefezi jasawec irec sâcko bituambiŋ.
Waiŋ soŋaŋ micne eki ine Josefere mocwâc mi manasuwec, mâc nâme nikec erâ juwec.
Juku jara jajahec tarame Faraozi guŋ moc kecʒiŋuc manawec: E Nilu opâ mecnao domaha
bulimakao 7 biaŋne biuc sâko jaŋe Nilu opâonec wefurâ kecɋaŋ nâhuc domambiŋ.
Ehame bulimakao 7 jaha ʒuhuckerâ wefumbiŋ, jaŋe ine sâqocne â siec sawa, erâ bâbâni wefumbiŋ jaŋerao rambiŋ.
Erâ bulimakao sâqocne â siec sawazi mi biaŋne biuc sâkohec jaŋe ɋâcjopanʒepieŋ i! Eme Farao e guŋkonec ɋârewec.
Erâ mocwâc qâmâckeme fohuc guŋ mocwâc ʒiŋuc manawec: Padi wefurâ domawec, kikene mocsâkoa â fârine ine 7, biaŋne â kâcɋene.
Ʒâhec ine padi kikene moc wefuwec, fârine 7 jaha erâ piticne â jowareczi qakume ɋaŋakicne.
Eme fârine piticne jaŋe fârine biaŋne â kâcɋene ɋâcjopambiŋ. Eme Faraozi ɋârerâ ʒiŋuc mana tarawec: No guŋ fârine manapac.
Hae fureme ine Faraozi manabâc ewec. Irec qaŋgec bapa â fuŋne mamana ŋic Aigita mâreŋko jumbiŋ jaŋe sasawa hetumaŋ‐jopaocte dâŋ râeme rawec. Fisipie guŋ manawec i binaŋ bajarewec. Eme jaŋeraonec moczi wemocko Farao guŋticnere fuŋne mana tarahuc âzâcnezac.
Eme waiŋ soŋaŋ micnezi Farao ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No miŋecgac bahac‐nane manasukopac.
Farao go kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋere aaric manahuc poroŋ ririke micne â no nâhe kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐nâfomeŋ
dameŋ ira ŋafe mocko guŋ manapec. Erâ guŋ manapec i fuŋnehec.
Eme dameŋ ira Hebiraio ŋicmotec moczi momori soŋaŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa juhuc nâhehec fowec. Eki hâcne guŋ manapec i âzâcnepere fuŋne nâsâwec, ehuc guŋ manapec sâc fuŋne buc buc mutaniŋke‐nâctewec.
Eme fuŋne mutâcnewec irec sâcko jâmbâŋ fârine fuawec, no mocwâc gie‐naneo râecnukicne â poroŋ ririke micne e ine bituambiŋ.”
Eme Faraozi Josefe wareocte mume izia kâpâcwâru fickonec jowa warembiŋ. Erâ qizec‐ticne bâtâcnepie ŋaqi ɋâricne heme hume Faraore maio fuawec.
Fuame Faraozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No guŋ manapac, eme irec fuŋne ŋic moczi moc mi mana tararâ nazakac. Gore ine ʒiŋuc mupie manapac: Go guŋ manarâ gazapie fuŋne mutaniŋkeekic.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Josefezi Farao dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “No maŋnanere wemocko epemu, Anutuzi ine Farao go bubiaŋ dâŋ gazazo murâ gazaocmu.”
Eme Faraozi Josefe ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No Nilu opâ mecnao domapac.
Ehame opâonec bulimakao 7 biaŋne â biuc sâko wefurâ kecɋaŋ nâhuc domambieŋ.
Eme ʒâhec bulimakao 7 jaha, sâqocne â siec sawa iŋuc jaha wefumbieŋ. No bulimakao sâqocne iŋucne Aigita mâreŋko moc mi honec‐jopahuc jupo.
Eme bulimakao sâqocne jaŋe bâbâni bulimakao 7 biaŋne â biuc sâko nâcjopambieŋ.
Nâcjopa‐fârepie sifu bujeŋic mi sokajec. Qanaŋ sâqocne â siec sawa domambieŋ sâc ijaha ʒâhec domambieŋ. No guŋ iŋuc manarâ ɋârepac.
Erâ guŋ mocwâc manapac ine kecʒiŋuc: Padi wefurâ domajec, kikene mocsâkoa â fârine ine 7 biaŋne â kâcɋene.
Eme ʒâhec padi kikene moc wefujec fârine 7 jaha, erâ jowareczi qakume ɋaŋakicne.
Eme fârine aputaczi fârine biaŋne ɋâcke‐fârejec. Eme irec mamana ŋic jazape fuŋne nazaniŋte eipieŋgopieŋ.”
Eme Josefezi Farao ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Farao, go guŋ jajahec manamec irec fuŋne mocjaha sawa fokac. Anutuzi mâsi moc baocte gazakac hâcne.
Bulimakao biaŋne 7 izi jara 7 irec sâc ekac, erâ padi fârine biaŋne 7 izi jara 7 irec sâc jaha, irec guŋ jajaheczi mocjaha ekac.
Bulimakao sâqocne 7 ʒâhec wefumbieŋ jaŋe jara 7 irec sâc jaha, erâ padi fârine aputac jowareczi qakicne izi roroc jara 7 irec sâc.
No irec hâcne manasuhuc Farao go ʒiŋuc gazapac: Anutu e mâsi baocte mukac i go mufua‐garezo ekac.
Manakic, ʒi Aigita mâreŋko jara 7 mâriri sâko fuarâ foocmu.
Eme mâriri dameŋ tarame roroc sâko fuarâ fokuhame jara 7 jaha taraocmu. Dameŋ irec maŋnao mâririre nikec‐jopame nânâre hâmo sipiric efâreniŋmu.
Mâririre kâuc baniŋmu i roroc qaŋqaŋ fuarâ fofeocmu irec.
Farao go guŋ ijaha arec jajahec manamec irec fuŋne ine ʒiŋuc: Anutu e wiac i biac jâmbâŋ fuaocte mupaŋkewec fokac.
Irec Farao go ŋic moc mamana â maŋɋârâŋhec bâwosâerâ Aigita mâreŋ sâko soŋaŋkeocte mucnezemec.
Erâ go hae sâc kia râec‐jopa ratec jaŋe jara 7 mâriri maŋnao wiac fuaocmu sâc irec 5‐konec wâŋ rorâ râepie mâc fozejec.
Jaŋe dameŋ irec maŋnao padi â jacgoŋ fuaocmu sâc ro qâzuc erâ gore micte râepie fozejec, jaŋe padi â jacgoŋ wiac hae sâkoo râepie rame soŋaŋkepie fozejec.
Iŋuc epie jacgoŋ â padi izi roroc jara 7 irec biŋe fozejec. Eme Aigita mâreŋko roroc fuarâ foha ŋiczi nânâre hâmo sipiric mi enʒepieŋ.”
Eme Farao â ŋicfâcne jaŋe dâŋ irec manapie biaŋkewec.
Ehame Faraozi kiŋaŋŋicfâcne ʒiŋuc muhuc wio‐jarewec: “Nâŋâc ŋic kecʒi Anuture Mârohec jukac iŋucne moc sâcne bâfuanaŋmu me?”
Erâ Josefe ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Anutuzi dâŋ i sasawa mufua‐garewecte ŋic mamana â maŋɋârâŋhec go iŋucne moc mi jukac.
Irec go hâcne ficnanere soŋaŋ râecguzo mukopac, eme ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe gore dâŋ reŋke‐fârenʒepieŋ. Mocjaha, ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋezi sawa nore biŋe ŋezejec.”
Erâ Faraozi Josefe ʒuhuckerâ âzâcnewec: “Manakic, no ʒi hâcne Aigita mâreŋ sâko irec soŋaŋ râecgukopac.”
Farao e iŋuc murâ meo fefe‐ticne, ŋicwofuŋ mahec, i heunuckerâ Josefere meo hecneme fewec, erâ ŋaqi biaŋne moc hecneme huwec â qoqonaŋ golzi bakicne qonaŋkecnewec.
Erâ mume namba 2 keretac‐ticnao ferâ rahame ŋiczi bâniecnerâ ʒiŋuc wirahuc mumbiŋ: “Dieŋzi hecneniŋ!” Iŋuc ecnehuc Aigita mâreŋ sâko irec soŋaŋ âkendâŋnewec hâcne.
Erâ Faraozi Josefe ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No hâcne Farao, erâ sifu goki mi manahaŋtecne Aigita mâreŋ sâkoo ŋic jaŋe maŋjeŋicte iŋuc me iŋuc moc mi enʒepieŋ.”
Eme Farao e Josefe ʒâŋe‐ticne Zafena‐Panea muwec, erâ Oŋ haeonec taha bapa moc, ʒâŋene Potifera, ere otâ Asinati râcneme ŋonâŋ‐ticne ewec. Iŋuc fuaha Josefe e Aigita mâreŋ irec soŋaŋ juwec.
Josefe e jara‐ticne 30 bazurâ Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Farao ere maio fuarâ domawec. Erâ Farao beherâ keretacko Aigita mâreŋ sâko fotâcne‐fârewec.
Jara 7 irec maŋnao mâreŋ ira mâriri sâko jâmbâŋ fuawec.
Eme Josefe e jara 7 irec maŋnao padi â jacgoŋ guru fufusuc fuawec i ro qâzuc erâ hae sâkoo râeme rafârewec. Hae sâko sâc râreckehuc gie forawec irecnec padi â jacgoŋ rorâ haeo râe qâzuc ewec hâcne.
Josefe e iŋuc ehuc padi â jacgoŋ i hâwecko moŋgeŋ fokac irec sâc fofo dunduŋ fome râe qâzuc ekume wowosere sâc jâurume mâc kosa rome fewec.
Eme roroc mi fuahame Josefe ŋokâ jajahec fuacnepic, Oŋ haeonec taha bapa Potiferare otâ Asinatizi rocjofawec.
Eme Josefe e mârâc ŋokâ‐ticnere ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc Manase muwec: “Anutuzi baficnume ʒâic busâqoc‐nanere â mamac‐nanere ficte nikecnuwec.”
Ʒâhec ŋokâre ʒâŋe ine ʒiŋuc muhuc Eferaim muwec: “Anutuzi mâreŋ ʒira fific guguriŋ faio juhape manasu‐narerâ ɋâric bâfua‐narekac.”
Eme Aigita mâreŋko jara 7 mâriri sâko fowec i tarame jara 7 jaha roroc dameŋ fuŋkerâ fuawec.
Josefezi muwec irec sâc fuawec hâcne. Ehame mâreŋ sâc roroc fuarâ foha Aigita mâreŋ sâkoo nânâ mi basambiŋ.
Eme Aigita mâreŋko roroc fuame ŋic jaŋe nânâre hâmohuc Farao kiocnembiŋ. Eme Faraozi Aigita ŋic ʒiŋuc jaza‐fârewec: “Ŋoŋe Joseferao raniŋ, eme eki mume sâc enʒepieŋ.”
Roroczi ine mâreŋ sâcke‐fârerâ fowec. Iŋuc fuame Josefezi Aigita ŋic nânâ rowaŋ irec motâc rojareme nânâ furine bambiŋ. Ehame roroczi Aigita mâreŋko ɋârâŋkewec.
Eme mâreŋ sâc irec ŋic jaŋe nânâ furine baniŋte Aigita mâreŋko fisimbiŋ, i mâreŋ sâc roroc ɋârâŋkerâ fowec irec.
Eme Jakobo e, Aigita mâreŋko nânâ sâcne furine bazo, iŋuc manarâ ŋokâfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe wemocte mana qâoma ehuc juŋgopieŋ?
Aigita mâreŋko nânâ wiac sâcne furine bazo, no iŋuc mupie manakopac i! Irec ŋoŋe ira ra furine barâ bawareniŋ, nâŋâc nânâre hâmo sipiric enʒipeŋte.”
Eme Josefe hahacfâcne 10 jaŋe nânâ furine baniŋte Aigita mâreŋko rambiŋ.
Josefere ɋa, Benjamiŋ hâcne, e ine mamacnezi hahacfâcne jaŋehec mi raocte ʒiŋuc manasuhuc sakarewec: E raku hatao ʒâpâ faio fezackohec.
Eme Kanaaŋ ŋic gâcne rambiŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko Israe ŋokâfâcne jaŋe mâmâc nânâ furine baniŋte raku fisimbiŋ. Kanaaŋ mâreŋko iŋuc jaha roroc sâko fowec hâcne.
Josefe e Aigita mâreŋte ŋicbomboŋ juhuc mâreŋ sâc irec ŋic sasawa nânâ jareme furine bambiŋ. Ehame hahacfâcne jaŋe erao fisirâ fodapecnembiŋ.
Eme Josefe e hahacfâcne honec‐joparâ ʒâŋitac‐jopawec, ehuc fuŋne‐ticne hesoŋke‐jarerâ dâŋ fâfâcnehec ehuc ʒiŋuc wio‐jarewec: “Ŋoŋe wenirec wareŋgopieŋ?” Jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Kanaaŋ mâreŋkonec, nânâ furine banaŋte wareŋgopeneŋ.”
Josefe e hahacfâcne ʒâŋitac‐jopahame jaŋe ine e mi ʒâŋitambiŋ.
Eme Josefe e mârâc jaha jaŋere guŋ manawec irec manasuwec. Ehuc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe doc bapa ŋic, ŋoŋe mâreŋ‐nâŋec moc wena soŋaŋ tâmiric kosa fokacko hone tâcnezo wareŋgopieŋ.”
Jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Bomboŋ, iŋuc mâcne! Kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge nâŋe nânâ furine banaŋte warembeneŋ.
Nâŋe ŋic mocjahare ŋokâfâc sasawa, nâŋe ŋic sioc tâmiric, kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge nâŋe doc bapa ŋic aricne.”
Eki ine jazawec: “Aricne, ŋoŋe mâreŋ ʒi moc wena soŋaŋ tâmiric kosa fokacko hone tâcneniŋte warembieŋ hâcne.”
Mume jaŋe ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge nâŋe 12‐zi jumbeŋ. Nâŋe hahac ɋa, ŋic mocjahare ŋokâfâc, Kanaaŋ mâreŋkonec. Ɋaʒâc‐nâŋec mamac‐nâŋehec jukac â ɋanâŋec moc ine mârâc jaha sifuckewec.”
Eme Josefezi jazawec: “No mupac i, ŋoŋe doc bapa ŋic.
Irec dâŋŋeŋicte fuŋne taniŋkezejec. No Faraore ʒâŋeo mupaŋkekopac: Ɋaʒâc‐ŋeŋic mi ware fisiocmuo ine ŋoŋe mâreŋ ʒirecnec mocwâc mi risie raniŋmu.
Irec ŋoŋeraonec moc râepie rarâ ɋaʒâc‐ŋeŋic jowa warezejec, â gâcne ŋoŋe ine kâpâcwâru ficko ŋeniŋmu. No dâŋŋeŋicte fuŋne bataniŋkezepac, eme dâŋ muŋgopieŋ i honepe burec eme doc bapa ŋic mucŋopapemu, i Faraore maio mupaŋkekopac.”
Iŋuc murâ kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐jopa‐fâreme ʒoaŋ jahec â moc ira fombiŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha Josefezi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No Anutu araŋ bacneekopac. Irec no akic‐ŋopapemurâ muŋgopieŋko kecʒiŋuc enʒepieŋ:
Ŋoŋe ŋic eeatuc tâmiric juŋgopieŋko ŋoŋeraonec mocsâkoa ʒira kâpâcwâru ficko râepie ŋeha gâcne ŋoŋe ine wiacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe nânâre hâmo sipiric enʒipiŋte padi jacgoŋ barâ ranʒepieŋ.
Erâ ɋaʒâc‐ŋeŋic norao jowa warepie, dâŋ jâmbomac muŋgopieŋ, iŋuc manarâ akic‐ŋopape juniŋmu.” Eme jaŋe mume sâc embiŋ.
Ehuc jaŋaczia nazaŋ gazaŋ erâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Jambomac, wiac ʒi ɋanâŋec behembeŋ irec okacne fisi‐nârekac hâcne. E nokafe tataeŋ ehuc mu wâwâsic enâreme dâŋticne mana‐bipierâ behembeŋ. Eme irec hâcne wiac hâhâwicne ʒi fai‐nâŋecko fekac.”
Eme Rubeŋzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No ŋazapo i! Ŋoŋe motec mac e wiac sâqocne mi ecnenʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe ine dâŋnane mana takirembiŋ irec ʒi fuŋne honeŋgopieŋ: Socticnere kiŋte okacne fisi‐nârekac.”
Jaŋe ine Josefezi dâŋnâŋec manakac i mi manambiŋ, e jaŋehec dâŋ dâŋ eocte dâŋ bâbâtikie ŋic ecneme dâŋ mu bâtikic ehuc juwec hâcne.
Erâ Josefe e behec‐joparâ ra kiowec. Izi ʒâhec jaŋerao risierâ jaŋehec dâŋ dâŋ ewec. Ehuc mume ŋondeŋ‐jeŋickonec Simeoŋ rorâ mai‐jeŋickoa bândeŋnembiŋ.
Erâ mume târu‐jeŋicko padi â jacgoŋ ŋiepie hurâ fusucmame moneŋ‐jeŋic ru sâc târu‐jeŋicko ŋiembiŋ. Erâ hatare nâsiŋ jareniŋte mâmâc jazawec. Eme iŋuc ejarembiŋ.
Eme jaŋe nânâ wiac‐jeŋic doŋgifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere faio herâ rambiŋ.
Raku tomafic mocko fisirâ jaŋeraonec moczi doŋgi‐ticne nânâ gumeocte târu‐ticne firuerâ honewec: Moneŋ‐ticne nânâ fainao ŋiekicne fowec.
Iŋuc honerâ hahac ɋafâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Moneŋ‐nane bârisie‐narekicne, ʒi târu‐nane micnao fokac hâcne.” Eme jaŋe manarâ maŋjeŋic gâckeme fâfârerâ hohonec ehuc mumbiŋ: “Anutuzi weniŋuc enârekac?”
Eme jaŋe Kanaaŋ mâreŋko, mamac‐jeŋic Jakoborao fisirâ wiac fua‐jarewec irec dâŋ binaŋ ninic sininic ecnehuc mumbiŋ:
“Mâreŋ rambeŋ irec ŋicbomboŋ e dâŋ hâhâwicne enârehuc, ‘ŋoŋe docbapa’ iŋuc muhuc kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐nâpowec.
Iŋuc enâreme ʒiŋuc âzâcnembeŋ: ‘Nâŋe ŋic wamane, nâŋe docbapa aricne.
Nâŋe hahac ɋa 12 mamac‐nâŋecte ŋokâfâc, mocjahazi mârâc jaha sifuckewec â ɋaʒâc‐nâŋec e ine Kanaaŋ mâreŋko mamac‐nâŋechec jukac.’
Iŋuc mupene mâreŋ irec ŋicbomboŋ e ʒiŋuc nâzâwec: ‘Ŋoŋe ŋic wamane me mâcne, irec fuŋne ʒiŋuc ehuc bataniŋkepie honezepac: Ŋoŋeraonec mocsâkoazi ʒira juha gâcne ŋoŋe wiacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe nânâre hâmo sipiric enʒipiŋte padi wiac rorâ baraniŋ.
Juku ine ɋaʒâc‐ŋeŋic jowa warenʒepieŋ, eme ŋoŋe docbapa mâcne, ŋic wamane jueŋgopieŋ, irec fuŋne hone tarazepac. Iŋuc epie hahac‐ŋeŋic bârisie‐ŋarepe ŋoŋe mâreŋ ʒira rambaŋ juhuc rac warec ezo murâ enʒepieŋ.’”
Eme jaŋe ru sâc târu‐jeŋickonec padi hoŋkehapie mi moneŋ kânoŋ‐jeŋic moneŋhec wahame bâfuanʒepieŋ i! Eme motec jaŋe mecne, mamac‐jeŋic mecne, moneŋ kânoŋ moneŋhec honerâ hâwic‐jopawec.
Eme mamac‐jeŋic Jakobozi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ŋokâfâc‐nane nowac rofâreniŋmu, Josefezi sifuckewec, Simeoŋzi mocwâc mi junarekac, ehame Benjamiŋ e wâc iŋuc jaha jowa razo muŋgopieŋ. Busâqoc wiac i sasawa fai‐naneo fekac.”
Iŋuc mume Rubeŋzi âzâcnewec: “No Benjamiŋ mocwâc mi bârisie‐garepemuo ine okacne ŋokâ jahec‐nane sâcne qâhâmoc‐jofazemec. Irec sifu e nore meo râec, eme no sâcne bârisie‐garepemu.”
Eki ine muwec: “Ŋokâ‐nane e ŋoŋehec mi rajâmbâŋkeocmu, hahac‐ticnezi hamowecte e buc mac junarekac. Ŋoŋe hata raniŋmu ira wiac hâhâwicne moc fuacneme no jaŋɋâŋheczi busâqocko hâmope kiŋnane ŋoŋere faio feocmu.”
Roroc neŋgocne jâmbâŋ Kanaaŋ mâreŋ sâcke‐fârerâ fohuc juwec.
Eme Aigita mâreŋkonec nânâ bawarembiŋ i nâpie omaeme mamac‐jeŋiczi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe nânâ‐nâŋec gâcne furine baniŋte mocwâc ranʒepieŋ.”
Mume Judazi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋic e dâŋ mupaŋkehuc ʒiŋuc nâzâwec: ‘Ŋoŋe ɋaŋeŋic tâmiric nore maio mocwâc mi fuanʒepieŋ.’
Irec go ɋanâŋec e nâŋehec mâmâc ranaŋte mana‐nârecmuo ine sâcne ra nânâ furine bagarenaŋmu.
E sakare‐nârecmuo ine ŋic e ʒiŋuc muwecte mi ranaŋmu: ‘Ŋoŋe ɋaŋeŋic tâmiric nore maio mocwâc mi fua‐jâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ.’”
Eme Israezi muwec: “Ŋoŋe wemocte bunaneo bahuc, ɋaŋeŋicte biŋe ŋic e âzâcnembiŋ?”
Mume mumbiŋ: “Ŋic e nâŋe nâŋâcne â wiacfâc‐nâŋec ŋoŋere mu indiŋ enârehuc muwec: ‘Mamac‐ŋeŋic jukac me? Erâ ɋaŋeŋic moc jukac me weniŋuc?’ Iŋuc eme juŋgopeneŋ sâc irec dâŋ âzâcne‐fârembeŋ. Eme eki, ‘Ɋaŋeŋic jowa warenʒepieŋ,’ iŋuc muocmu, i wemocko mananʒapeŋ.”
Eme Judazi mamac‐ticne Israe âzâcnewec: “Motec e norao râetec ʒawierâ fahare ranʒepeneŋ. Eme nâŋe mecne, go mecne, naru motecfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mecne, nâŋâc hâmo sipiric mi enʒepeneŋ.
No ere riŋ rohape risie‐gareocte mupaŋkekopac, me bârisie‐garerâ maŋfuŋgao mi râepemuo ine irec kiŋ i fai‐naneo feme âsickerâ juhape juju dameŋ‐nane tarazejec.
Nâŋe irec maŋjahec boc mi enʒapeŋ muzac ine huc wefuc epene biac arec jajahec ezac.”
Eme mamac‐jeŋic Israe e ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Iŋuc eene fokacko ine ʒiŋuc enʒepieŋ: Mâreŋ ʒira wiac fuaekac irecnec gâcne biaŋne kecʒiŋuc bâwosâerâ târu‐ŋeŋicko ŋierâ ŋic erao bara tahackenʒepieŋ: Wokemaŋ biaŋ, gumi, baŋac, jâcsâŋiŋ, kaŋa â fâric.
Erâ moneŋ ɋâricne â mârâc târu‐ŋeŋicko nânâ fainao ŋiekicne i mâmâc baranʒepieŋ, i bâbâsifuc moc fuawec mecne.
Erâ wâc ɋaŋeŋic jowahuc ŋic erao mocwâc ranʒepieŋ.
Anutu bapafâre eki ine ŋic ere maio roroŋ sasabec eŋarehuc hahac‐ŋeŋic mecne, Benjamiŋ mecne bârisie‐ŋarehuc sorec‐ŋopame risie warenʒepieŋ. No ine naru motecheczi naru motec tâmiric tinac juekopac hâcne.”
Eme ŋic jaŋe taha mecne, moneŋ ɋâricne â raŋɋane mecne rorâ Benjamiŋ jowapie Aigita mâreŋko rahuc juku Josefere maio fuambiŋ.
Eme Josefezi Benjamiŋ jaŋehec jume honerâ ficsoŋaŋ‐ticne âzâcnerâ muwec: “Go ŋic jaŋe ficko jowac‐jopa fec, erâ qowi hezurâ tiwâ bâzi râe bâmoc etec jaŋe ʒoaŋte nânâ nohec mâmâc nânʒepeneŋ.”
Eme ŋic e Josefezi muwec sâc efârewec, erâ ŋic jowac‐jopame ficko fembiŋ.
Jaŋe ine Josefere ficko râec‐jopakicnere hâwic‐jopame mumbiŋ: “Bâbâni warepene târu‐nâŋecko moneŋ mocwâc bârisierâ ŋie‐nârekicne moneŋ irec erâ ʒira râec‐nâpoŋgopieŋ: nâŋâc ʒira ŋehapene wefu niŋgiŋ‐nâpohuc kiŋaŋ qaqa bacnâponiŋmu â doŋgifâc‐nâŋec nâwoc roniŋmu.”
Irec Josefere ficsoŋoŋ juwec ŋic erao rarâ ficmotâcko domaha
ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “O bomboŋ‐nâŋec. Nâŋe mârâc nânâ furine banaŋte warembeŋ.
Eme ra juku fic fombeŋ ira fisirâ târu‐nâŋec firuerâ mi târu sâc moneŋ nânâ faio fome bâfuanʒepeneŋ i! Eme moneŋ i hâcne mocwâc bawarembeneŋ.
Â nânâ furine banaŋte moneŋ ɋâricne mâmâc bafisimbeneŋ wâc. Moneŋ‐nâŋec mozi târu‐nâŋecko ŋiewec i mi manaŋgopeneŋ.”
Eki ine muwec: “I sâcne, mi hâwic‐ŋopaoc, ŋoŋere â mamac‐ŋeŋicte Anutu eki hâcne târu‐ŋeŋicko wiac furi sâko ŋarewec, moneŋ‐ŋeŋiczi norao sâcne fisiwec.” Iŋuc murâ Simeoŋ jaŋerao jowa wahawec.
Erâ Josefere ficko jowac‐jopa ferâ kike‐jeŋic ʒureniŋte opâ fia‐jarewec, erâ doŋgifâc‐jeŋic nânâ gumec‐jopawec.
Eme jaŋe Josefezi nânâre wareocte woŋec juhuc, ere taha wiac bafisimbiŋ i râe biric embiŋ; jaŋe ficmaŋne ira nânâ nâniŋte mukicne irec biŋe biac manambiŋ hâcne.
Eme Josefe e wareme taha wiac bajumbiŋ i bafe râcnerâ ere maŋfuŋko fodapembiŋ.
Eki ine mu indiŋ ejarehuc muwec: “Mamac raŋɋa‐ŋeŋicte nazambiŋ e weniŋuc jukac? Sâcne jukac me?”
Jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Kiŋaŋŋicge, mamac‐nâŋec hâcne, e sâcne mac jukac.” Iŋuc murâ dieŋzi hecnehuc fodapembiŋ.
Eme eki qâhâŋnerâ ɋaticne Benjamiŋ honerâ muwec: “Ɋaʒâc‐ŋeŋicte dâŋ nazambiŋ ʒine hâcne me?” Erâ muwec: “Motec‐mae, Anutuzi ehâmo‐garezejec.”
Josefe e iŋuc murâ biac e jahacne ficmaŋko raʒiwec, ɋaticne honerâ bu heheric ecneha kiozo ewec irec. Erâ ira kiowec.
Erâ ʒâŋe mai‐ticne ʒurerâ mocwâc waha sanaŋkerâ muwec: “Nânâ râeniŋ!”
Eme e nânâ buc râcnehuc jaŋe iŋuc jaha buc jarembiŋ, erâ Aigita ŋic ehec mâmâc nânâ nâhuc ŋembiŋ jaŋe iŋuc jaha buc jarembiŋ. Aigita ŋic jaŋe Hebiraio ŋic jaŋehec nânâ mi nâniŋte aka fowec hâcne, Aigita ŋic jaŋe irec manapie mamakâcne ewec.
Eme Josefe e ŋifec ŋeha jaŋe ŋifec mârâc motec erao fuŋkerâ biric‐jopa rakupie ʒâhec motec erao tarawec, fua rambiŋ irec sâcko biric‐jopapie ŋerambiŋ hâcne. Eme jaŋe irec hohonec erâ wareckembiŋ.
Josefezi ine mume e jahacne teboonec nânâ rorâ jarembiŋ. Ehuc gâcne jaŋere wâŋ wâŋ râehuc Benjamiŋte 5, 5, iŋuc râembiŋ. Eme jaŋe ehec nânâ â waiŋ opâ nâhuc bubiaŋ manambiŋ.
Eme Josefezi ficsoŋaŋ‐ticne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go ŋic tâpiri‐jeŋicte sâc manahuc padi târu‐jeŋicko fiatec huoc, erâ moneŋ‐jeŋic i ru sâc târu‐jeŋicko padi fainao ŋie‐jarezemec.
Râqâc‐nane, siliwazi bakicne, i ine ʒâhec motec ere târu micnao padire moneŋhec mâmâc ŋiezemec.” Eme Josefezi muwec sâc efârewec.
Hae fureme ŋic doŋgifâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec râec‐jopapie rambiŋ.
Eme hae beherâ rapie mi ʒoraha Josefezi ficsoŋaŋ‐ticne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ajoc, go ŋic jâpec‐jopa rac, erâ bâfuac‐joparâ ʒiŋuc jazac: ‘Ŋoŋe wiac biaŋne eŋarekicnezi okacne wemocte sâqocne bazu‐narehuc râqâc‐nane siliwazi bakicne i fiuc rombieŋ?
Bomboŋ‐nanezi râqâc ira hâcne opâ nâekac, erâ i bajuhuc findaŋdâŋ muekac. Ŋoŋe iŋuc epie sâqorejec.’”
Eme e ra bâfuac‐joparâ dâŋ i hâcne jazawec.
Jaŋe ine dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ: “Bomboŋ‐nâŋeczi wemocte dâŋ iŋucne nâzâkac? Nâŋe wiac iŋucne moc mi eeŋgopeneŋ.
Nâŋe mârâc jaha târu‐nâŋec micnao moneŋ bâfuambeŋ i Kanaaŋ mâreŋkonec barâ risie warembeŋ, irec wemocko bomboŋgere fickonec siliwa me gol fiuc ronʒapeŋ?
Kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge e me e erao bâfuacmu e hâmocte biŋe ezejec, ehame gâcne nâŋe bomboŋ‐nâŋec gore kiŋaŋŋicfâc enʒepeneŋ.”
Eki muwec: “Muŋgopieŋ iŋuc hâcne fuaoc, moc erao bâfuanaŋmu e hâcne kiŋaŋŋic‐nane ezejec, gâcne ŋoŋe ine mâc ra junʒepieŋ.”
Eme jaŋe biac târu‐jeŋic rorâ mâreŋko hepie ŋeha firue‐fârembiŋ.
Eki ine mârâc motec erao fuŋkerâ târu sâc basa raku ʒâhec motec erao basa tarawec, râqâc ine Benjamiŋte târuo bâfuawec.
Iŋuc fuame jaŋe ŋaqi‐jeŋic bâsuckerâ târu wiac‐jeŋic doŋgi faio râepie feme haeo risie fembiŋ.
Eme Josefe e ficko jaha juhame Juda â hahac ɋafâcne jaŋe fisirâ maŋfuŋnao fodapembiŋ.
Eme Josefezi jazawec: “Ŋoŋe wemo mâsi mo embieŋ? Ŋic moc no iŋucnezi findaŋdâŋ muhuc fuŋne‐ŋeŋic bataniŋkeocmu, i ŋoŋe kâuc bambieŋ me?”
