Eme Judazi muwec: “Nâŋe bomboŋ‐nâŋec go wemo dâŋ moc gazanaŋmu, me Anutuzi kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋere kiŋ bataniŋkewecko ine wemo dâŋ moc mupene sâckeocmu? Manakic, ʒi bomboŋ‐nâŋec gore kiŋaŋŋic eŋgopeneŋ hâcne, nâŋe mecne â târu‐ticnao râqâc bâfuakicne ŋic e mâmâc.”
Eki ine muwec: “Iŋuc misac! Târu‐ticnao râqâc bâfuakicne e sawa kiŋaŋŋic‐nane juzejec, gâcne ŋoŋe ine wamao mamac‐ŋeŋictao sâcne ranʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Judazi mai ferâ muwec: “O bomboŋ‐nane, kiŋaŋŋicge no gore maio dâŋ micafec jaha mupe manarâ buge mi wefuzejec, go Faraore sâc jukic i!
Bomboŋ‐nâŋec go kiŋaŋŋicfâcge ʒiŋuc muhuc wio‐nâremeŋ: ‘Ŋoŋe mamac‐ŋeŋic me ɋaŋeŋic moc jukac me?’
Eme nâŋe bomboŋ‐nâŋec go ʒiŋuc gazambeŋ: ‘Nâŋe mamac‐nâŋec jukac, erâ ŋicqizec erâ juha ɋaʒâc‐nâŋec moc fuawec. E hahac fuŋfuŋ‐ticne hâmowec. Neŋgoc‐jekiczi motec jajahec sawa rocjofawecte e mocsâkoa hâcne jukac, eme irec mamacnezi ere boc ecneekac.’
Goki ine kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋe ʒiŋuc nâzâmeŋ: ‘Ŋoŋe jowapie wareme honezepac.’
Nâŋe ine bomboŋ‐nâŋec go ʒiŋuc gazambeŋ: ‘Motec e mamac‐ticne sâcne mi beheocmu, beheme muzac mamac‐ticnezi hâmozac.’
Eme go ʒiŋuc nâzâmeŋ: ‘Ɋaʒâc‐ŋeŋic e mi wareocmuo ine nore maio mocwâc mi fua‐jâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ.’
Eme nâŋe kiŋaŋŋicge, mamac‐nâŋec hâcne, erao risierâ gore dâŋ hâcne mufuacnembeŋ.
Eme juku mamac‐nâŋeczi ʒiŋuc nâzâwec: ‘Ŋoŋe nânâ‐nâŋec furine baniŋte mocwâc ranʒepieŋ.’
Iŋuc mume ʒiŋuc âzâcnembeŋ: ‘Nâŋe mâc mi ranaŋmu. Ɋaʒâc‐nâŋec e nâŋehec mâmâc ranaŋte mana‐nâretec sâcne ranaŋmu. E tâmiric ine ŋic ere maio sâcne mocwâc mi fuanaŋmu.’
Iŋuc mupene mamac‐nâŋeczi ʒiŋuc nâzâwec: ‘Ŋonâŋ‐nanezi ŋokâ jajahec sawa rocjofawec i ŋoŋe manaŋgopieŋ.
Eme moc e behecnurâ sifuckeme ʒiŋuc mupo: E qowi mimicnezi kisuc qâsuckewec irec e mocwâc mi honehuc jupozi jukopac.
Eme ʒi jukac e wâc nowac ropie wiac moc fuacneme no jaŋɋâŋheczi busâqocko hâmope kiŋnane ŋoŋere faio feocmu.’
Irec no motec e tâmiric kiŋaŋŋicge, mamac‐nâŋec hâcne, erao risiepemuo ine maŋticnezi motecte boc domaekacte
motec hâcne basarâ izia hâmoocmu.
Kiŋaŋŋicge no, motec ere riŋ ropemurâ mamac‐nanerao ʒiŋuc mupaŋkepo: ‘No mi bârisie‐garepemuo ine gore maio kiŋhec jaha juhape hâmoc dameŋ‐nane maickezejec.’
Irec ʒi kiŋaŋŋicge no motecte âkehoc bomboŋ‐nane gore kiŋaŋ qahuc jupemurâ mana‐naretec moteczi hahacfâcne jaŋehec risiezejec.
No motec e tâmiric wemocko mamac‐nanerao risie rapemu. No mamac‐nane wiac iŋucne fuacneme honezore hâwicnu sâqorekac.”
Eme Josefe e orâŋkerâ domambiŋ ŋic i jaŋere maio bu heheric ecneme ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋic ejarepie hufâreniŋ.” Iŋuc mume hufârepie Josefezi hahacfâcne fuŋne‐ticne mutaniŋke‐jarewec.
Eme ki kâcɋene kiowecte Aigita ŋic jaŋe manambiŋ, â Faraore ficko jumbiŋ jaŋe wâc mâmâc mana‐fârembiŋ.
Eme Josefezi hahacfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No Josefe, mamac‐nane jukac me?” Hahacfâcne jaŋe ine fâfâre sâqorehuc mâc bipic tatara domambiŋ.
Ehame Josefezi hahacfâcne jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ware mai domaniŋ!” Eme jaŋe rarâ mai domahapie ʒiŋuc muwec: “No ɋaŋeŋic Josefe, Aigita ŋic jaŋerao râecnuhuc furi rombiŋ, no hâcne ʒi.
Eme ʒi mi hâwic‐ŋopaoc â busâqoc boc mi mananiŋ, furi‐nane rohuc Aigita ŋic jaŋerao râecnumbiŋ i no juju‐ŋeŋic dopeckepemurâ Anutuzi sorecnume bânie‐ŋarerâ warepo hâcne.
Ʒi roroc foha biac jara jajahec tarakac, erâ he sarac â qa roro mi ee mâc jufekuhapene ʒuhuckerâ jara 5 taraocmu.
Garikiŋfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mâreŋko mi omaeniŋte â ŋoŋeraonec bocjahazi mi hâhâmo jufehuc juniŋte Anutuzi sorecnume bânie‐ŋarerâ warepo hâcne.
Irec ŋoŋe mâcne, Anutuzi sorecnume warepo, eki hâcne Farao mamac ecnehuc ficticnere soŋaŋ â Aigita mâreŋ sâko irec ŋicbomboŋ jupemurâ râecnuwec.
Irec ʒi bâruŋ jaha mamac‐nanerao risierâ âzâcnenʒepieŋ: ‘Ŋokâge Josefe e gore dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukac: Anutuzi Aigita mâreŋ sasawa irec ŋicbomboŋ râecnuwec, irec go ŋeŋe râqâc mi ehuc biac norao warezemec.
Erâ Goseŋ mâreŋ bembeŋko fokac ira ŋec juc ezemec, go mecne, ŋokâ ŋosafâcge mecne, lama bulimakaofâcge mecne, erâ wiac fogarekac sasawa i mâmâc.
Go ira juhaŋtec hone jauŋ egarepemu, i roroczi ʒuhuckerâ jara 5 foha go â wiacfâcge erâ wiac jugarekac sasawa ŋoŋe tac qararacne erâ junʒipiŋte iŋuc ezemec.’
No nahac ŋoŋehec dâŋ dâŋ ekopac i ŋoŋe ʒâŋe fâri‐ŋeŋiczi honeŋgopieŋ erâ ɋanane Benjamiŋzi wâc honekac.
Eme Aigita mâreŋko gie fekicne munarekicne bahuc jukopac i mecne, â wiac gâcne hone manac embiŋ irec binaŋ mâmâc mamac‐nane bacne‐fârenʒepieŋ, ehuc biac jaha jowa warenʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ ɋaticne Benjamiŋhec hâhâpoc ehuc kikioc epic.
Eme hahacfâcne sasawa hâpo mickukuc ejarehuc kiowec. Iŋuc ejareme hahacfâcne jaŋe ehec dâŋ dâŋ embiŋ.
Eme Faraore ficko dâŋ biŋe ʒiŋuc ra fisiwec: “Josefe hahacfâcne jaŋe warembieŋ.” Eme Farao â kiŋaŋŋicfâcne jaŋe biŋe i manarâ bujeŋic biaŋkewec.
Eme Faraozi Josefe âzâcnewec: “Hahacfâcge ʒiŋuc jazac: ‘Ŋoŋe becâsicfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere faio nânâ mafa râepie feme Kanaaŋ mâreŋko risierâ
mamac‐ŋeŋic â ŋonâŋ naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic norao jowac‐jopa warenʒepieŋ. Eme Aigita mâreŋko mâriri sâko fokac i hâcne ŋarepe mâreŋ ʒirec nânâ qowi nâ bac enʒepieŋ.’
Go ine ʒiŋuc jazacmurâ gazakopac: ‘Ŋoŋe ŋonâŋ motecfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere erâ Aigita mâreŋkonec keretac bararâ mamac‐ŋeŋic jowa warenʒepieŋ.
Erâ wâc wiac‐ŋeŋic gâcnere mana mezac mi enʒepieŋ, Aigita mâreŋ sâkoo wiac fâri biaŋ jâmbâŋ fuaekac izi ŋoŋere biŋe ezejec.’”
Eme Israe ŋokâfâcne jaŋe iŋuc hâcne embiŋ. Ehame Josefe e Faraore micte keretac â hatare nâsiŋ jarewec.
Erâ ru sâc hombaŋ ŋaqi mocjaha mocjaha jarehuc Benjamiŋ ine hombaŋ ŋaqi 5 â siliwa moneŋ 300 râcnewec.
Ehuc mamac‐ticnere ine doŋgi 10, fainao Aigita mâreŋte wiac fâri biaŋ râekicne jaŋe mecne â doŋgi ŋokacne 10 padi â poroŋ â hatare nâsiŋhec jaŋe mâmâc râec‐jopame rambiŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc hahacfâcne râec‐jopahuc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe hatao rahuc mumu hehec mi enʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc ejareme jaŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec fahare raku Kanaaŋ mâreŋko mamac‐jeŋic Jakoborao fisimbiŋ.
Fisirâ dâŋ binaŋ ʒiŋuc ecnembiŋ: “Josefe e jukac, ehuc Aigita mâreŋ sasawa irec ŋicbomboŋ jukac hâcne.” E ine dâŋjeŋicte maname fârine mi eha maŋticne gâckewec.
Ehame jaŋe Josefezi dâŋ jazawec sâc âzâcne‐fârembiŋ. Eme Josefezi mamac‐ticne roocte keretac râewec i ware fisime mamac‐jeŋic Jakobozi honerâ maŋne fie ruruckewec.
Eme muwec: “Sâcne, ŋokâ‐nane Josefe jukac, no mi honehuc hâmozipore biac ra honezepac.”
Eme Israe e wiac‐ticne sasawa ame susuckerâ ra Bere‐Seba haeo fisirâ mamac‐ticne Isakare Anutu bâzi rikecnewec.
Eme Anutuzi guŋko Israe ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Jakobo, Jakobo!” Eki ine muwec: “No ʒi.”
Eme muwec: “No mamacgere Anutu. Go Aigita mâreŋko racmurâ mi hâwicguoc, no ira basawecgupe ŋicguru sâko ezemec.
No gohec mâmâc Aigita mâreŋko ra jupemu, erâ juku irecnec mocwâc bârisiecgupemu, Josefezi ine ʒâŋege bâhâpozejec.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Jakobo e Bere‐Seba haeonec fahareme ŋokâfâcne jaŋe mamac‐jeŋic mecne, naru motecfâc‐jeŋic mecne, ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic mecne mâmâc keretac faio râec‐jopapie fembiŋ. Faraozi Jakobo roocte keretac râeme warewec, ira hâcne.
Erâ qowifâc‐jeŋic â mafa wiac‐jeŋic Kanaaŋ mâreŋko hurembiŋ i mâmâc rocjoparâ raku Aigita mâreŋko fisimbiŋ. Jakobo â ɋâricfâc‐ticne sasawa
ŋokâ otâfâcne â ŋosafâcne hâcne Aigita mâreŋko bacjopa rawec.
Ʒi ine Israe ɋâricfâcne Aigita mâreŋko fisimbiŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe biri, Jakobo â ŋokâfâcne hâcne: Mârâc ŋokâ‐ticne Rubeŋ.
Rubeŋ ŋokâfâcne ine ʒiŋuc: Hanoki, Palu, Hezoroŋ â Karami.
Simeoŋ ere ŋokâfâc ʒiŋuc: Jemuele, Jamiŋ, Ohada, Jakiŋ erâ Kanaaŋ ŋokac ere ŋokâ Saulu.
Lewire ŋokâfâc ʒiŋuc: Geresoŋ, Kohati â Merari.
Juda ere ŋokâfâc ʒiŋuc: Ero, Onaŋ, Sela, Pereze â Sera. Ero â Onaŋ jahe ine biac Kanaaŋ mâreŋko hâmopic. Eme Pereze ere ŋokâ jajahec ʒiŋuc jupic: Hezoroŋ â Hamulu.
Isasa ere ŋokâfâc ʒiŋuc: Tola, Puwa, Jasubu â Simoroŋ.
Sebuloŋ ere ŋokâfâc: Serede, Eloŋ, â Jalele.
Leazi Mesopotamia mâreŋko Jakobore ŋokâ rocjopawec ine hâcne, erâ otâ‐ticne Sine mâmâc; qâhâckepene naru motec 33 eŋgopieŋ.
Erâ Gadere ŋokâfâc: Ʒifioŋ, Kagi, Suni, Eziboŋ, Eri, Arodi â Areli.
Ase ere ŋokâfâc ʒiŋuc: Imina, Isiwa, Isiwi, Beria â seŋjeŋic Sera. Erâ Beria ŋokâ jahec‐ticne Hebere â Malikiele.
Labaŋzi otâ‐ticne Lea Silipa râcnewec, e Jakobore ŋokâfâc 16 rocjopawec hâcne.
Jakobo ŋonâŋ‐ticne Rahe ere ŋokâ ine Josefe â Benjamiŋ.
Josefe e ine Aigita mâreŋko ŋokâ jajahec fuacnepic, ʒâŋe‐jekic Manase â Eferaim. Ine Oŋ haeonec taha bapa Potifera ere otâ Asinatizi rocjafawec.
Benjamiŋte ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Bela, Bekere, Asibele, Gera, Naemaŋ, Eki, Rosi, Mupim, Hupim â Arada.
Rahe e Jakobore ŋokâfâc 14 i jaŋe hâcne rocjopawec.
Daŋ ere ŋokâ Husim mocjaha.
Naftali ere ŋokâfâc ʒiŋuc: Jazele, Guni, Jezera â Silem.
Labaŋzi otâ‐ticne Rahe Biliha râcnewec eki Jakobore ŋokâfâc rocjopawec jaŋere ʒare 7 hâcne.
Ŋic ŋokac sasawa, Jakobore bifuŋko fuambiŋ erâ Aigita mâreŋko ra fisimbiŋ, jaŋere ʒare qâhâckepene 66 ekac. Jakobo ŋokâfâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋonâŋfâc ine jaŋerao mi ʒuhuc‐jopakicne.
Josefere ŋokâ, Aigita mâreŋko fuacnepic ine jajahec sawa. Jakobore wiacfâc Aigita mâreŋko fisi‐fârembiŋ jaŋere ʒare 70 hâcne.
Jakobo e Juda soreme Joseferao bânierâ rawec, i biŋe âzâcneme Goseŋ mâreŋko raocte iŋuc ewec.
Josefezi mume keretac baʒawiecnepie mamac‐ticne Israe bâfuaocte Goseŋ mâreŋko rawec. Ra bâfuarâ hâpohuc boc kiowec.
Eme Israezi Josefe âzâcnewec: “Go juhaŋtec jaha ʒâŋe maige honekopacte ʒi sâcne afeckerâ hâmopemu.”
Eme Josefezi hahacfâcne â mamac‐ticnere wiacfâc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No ra Farao dâŋ binaŋ ecnehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnepemu: ‘Hahacfâc‐nane â mamac‐nanere wiacfâc jaŋe Kanaaŋ mâreŋko jumbiŋzi norao ware fisimbiŋ.
Erâ jaŋe lama soŋaŋ juhuc bulimakao gie baeŋgopieŋ wâc, irec lama â bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic â wiac‐jeŋic sasawa amec‐jopa warembiŋ.’
Eme Faraozi hefârec‐ŋoparâ, ‘Ŋoŋe wemo gie bahuc jueŋgopieŋ,’
iŋuc wio‐ŋareme ʒiŋuc âzâcnenʒepieŋ: ‘Kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge nâŋe mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe iŋucne ɋie‐nâŋeckonecteaŋ qowi gie bapa jumbeŋzi jueŋgopeneŋ.’ Ŋoŋe iŋuc âzâcnepie Goseŋ mâreŋko juniŋte mana‐ŋareocmu; i Aigita ŋic jaŋe lama bulimakao soŋaŋ jaŋere manapie mamakâcne eekac irec.”
Josefe e iŋuc murâ ra Farao biŋedâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Mamac hahacfâc‐nane â bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic erâ wiac sasawa‐jeŋic jaŋe Kanaaŋ mâreŋkonec warembiŋ Goseŋ mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ.”
Erâ hahacfâcne jaŋeraonec 5 rocjoparâ Faraore maio râec‐jopame domambiŋ.
Eme Faraozi Josefe hahacfâcne ʒiŋuc wio‐jarewec: “Ŋoŋe wemo gie bahuc jueŋgopieŋ?” Iŋuc wio‐jareme ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋe mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe iŋucne lama soŋaŋ jueŋgopeneŋ.”
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ Farao ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Nâŋe mâreŋ ʒira jaba junaŋte warembeŋ. Kanaaŋ mâreŋko roroc qaŋqaŋ fuarâ fokacte kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋere lamazi nânâ basambiŋ. Eme irec hâcne kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋe Goseŋ mâreŋko juzo muŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme Faraozi Josefe âzâcnewec: “Mamac hahacfâcge jaŋe gorao sâcne warembiŋ.
Aigita mâreŋ i gore meo râekicne, irec mamac hahacfâcge mâreŋ dâkâne biaŋnao râec‐jopazemec, jaŋe Goseŋ mâreŋ hâcne mujaretec sâcne juniŋmu. Ehame go jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec ŋic ʒoɋachec moc manac‐jopakicko no nahacne qowi guru irec soŋaŋ juniŋte râec‐jopazemec.”
Eme irec faicnao Josefezi mamac‐ticne Farao jâutuocte erao jowa fewec; eme Jakobozi Farao jambuŋkewec.
Eme Faraozi Jakobo wiocnewec: “Go jarage wezimuc?”
Jakobozi Farao dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Mâreŋko jaba juju‐nanere dameŋ jara 130 tarawec, i dameŋ bembeŋne mac erâ sifu ʒâic busâqoc‐ticnehec. Erâ mamac ŋosafâc‐nane jaŋe mâreŋko jaba juju‐jeŋicte dameŋ ʒoricne, no irec sâc mi bâfuakopac.”
Jakobo e iŋuc murâ Farao jambuŋkerâ rawec.
Josefezi ine mamac hahacfâcne fic hae bâfua‐jarehuc Aigita mâreŋte dâkâne moc jaŋe jaŋacne biŋe eocte qikiŋne‐jarewec. Mâreŋ i mâreŋ biaŋne jâmbâŋ, Faraozi muwec sâc, Ramesesi mâreŋ hâcne.
Erâ Josefe e mamac hahacfâcne â mamac‐ticnere wiacfâc sasawa naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sâcko nânâ wiac râe‐jarewec.
Eme mâreŋ sâc nânâ poroŋ basambiŋ, roroc qaŋqaŋ jaha fome Aigita mâreŋ â Kanaaŋ mâreŋ irec rune jaŋe nânâre hâmo sipiric embiŋ hâcne.
Josefezi ine Aigita â Kanaaŋ mâreŋkonec nânâ furire moneŋ warewec i sasawa ro qâzuc ewec. Erâ moneŋ i Faraore ficko bafewec.
Eme juku Aigita mareŋko mecne, Kanaaŋ mâreŋko mecne moneŋ omaeme ŋic jaŋe Joseferao fisirâ mumbiŋ: “Go nânâ bâfua‐nârec! Nâŋe wemocte gore maio hâmo sipiric ehapene hone qâoma enâreekic? Moneŋ‐nâŋec omaewec hâcne.”
Josefezi muwec: “Moneŋ omaekacko qowi wiac‐ŋeŋic bacjopa wareniŋ, eme noni irec okacne nânâ ŋarepemu.”
Iŋuc mume jaŋe qowifâc‐jeŋic bacjopa warepie becâsic â lama bulimakao erâ doŋgi irec okacne nânâ jarewec. Jara ira hâcne iŋuc epie qowifâc‐jeŋic sasawa izi nânâ kitâcne‐jareme gumec‐jopawec.
Eme jara i tarame jara moc ira mocwâc ware fisirâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Bomboŋ‐nâŋec, nâŋe gore maio fuŋne‐nâŋec wemocko hesoŋkenaŋmu: Moneŋzi omaewec erâ qowi gurufâc‐nâŋec jaŋe biac gore biŋe embiŋ, irec sahac‐nâŋec â gie hesarac mâreŋ‐nâŋec sawa bomboŋ‐nâŋec gore biŋe eocte fokac.
Nâŋe nâŋâcne mecne, â mâreŋ‐nâŋec mecne wemocte gore maio sipirickenaŋmu? Irec nâŋe nâŋâcne â hesarac mâreŋ‐nâŋec nânâre furine bacnâpotecne Faraore kiŋaŋ qanʒepeneŋ. Nâŋe hâmo sipiric epene mâreŋ tuhu fuazacte nânâ ukicne nâretec gie he sarac enʒepeneŋ.”
Iŋuc mupie Josefezi Aigita mâreŋko hesarac mâreŋ sasawa furi bame Faraore biŋe ewec. Roroc qaŋqaŋ foha nânâre boc hâmombiŋte Aigita ŋic jaŋe ʒeŋgoma hesarac mâreŋ‐jeŋic furire qikiŋne‐fârembiŋ, eme mâreŋ i Faraore biŋe efârewec.
Ehame Josefezi Aigita mâreŋ ŋifec â ŋifec, faic â juwic ŋic jurambiŋ jaŋe sasawa Faraore kiŋaŋ qaqa bacjopa‐fârewec.
Taha bapa jaŋere mâreŋ mocjaha ine furi mi bawec; jaŋe Faraonec gie furi rombiŋ; irec Faraozi gie furi jarewec izi nânâ kitâcne‐jarewecte mâreŋ‐jeŋic furire mi qikiŋnembiŋ.
Eme Josefezi ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No miŋecgac ŋoŋe â mâreŋ wiac‐ŋeŋic furine bacŋopape Faraore biŋe eŋgopieŋ, irec nânâ ukic ʒi rorâ gie he sarac eniŋ.
Eme juku fârine fuame ine 5‐konec wâŋ i Faraore biŋe eha, 4 ŋaŋacne biŋe ezejec, i gie mocwâc he sarac epie fârine fuame ŋaŋacne â wiacfâc‐ŋeŋic erâ naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic ŋoŋe nâniŋte iŋuc enʒepieŋ.”
Jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Go juju‐nâŋec ŋezickekomec, irec juranaŋmu sâc bomboŋ‐nâŋec go honec‐nâpotec biaŋkeme ine afeckerâ Farao kiŋaŋ qacnenaŋmu.”
Josefe e iŋuc hâcne ehuc Aigita mâreŋ‐jeŋicko sâcmutâc ʒiŋuc râeme foweczi fokac: Nânâ wiac 5‐konec wâŋ i Faraore biŋe râezo. Taha bapa jaŋere mâreŋ sawa Faraore biŋe mi ewec.
Iŋuc fuame Israe ŋic jaŋe Aigita mâreŋko, Goseŋ mâreŋko hâcne, ŋec juc embiŋ, ehuc mâreŋ i rauckerâ fua sawec ehuc sawe mâririackembiŋ.
Eme Jakobo e Aigita mâreŋko jara 17 ʒuhuckerâ jufeku jara‐ticne 147 bazuwec.
Eme hâmoc dameŋ‐ticne qândâŋkeme ŋokâ‐ticne Josefe hefârerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go bubiaŋ wiac moc enarecmurâ ʒiŋuc ezemec: Mege gâjoŋ‐naneo râerâ jauŋnuhuc mupaŋke‐narec: Go Aigita mâreŋko mi ducnuzemec.
No mamac ŋosafâc‐nane jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ hâmope Aigita mâreŋkonec bacnu rarâ jaŋere ʒâŋeruŋko ducnuzemec.” Eki muwec: “Mukomec irec sâcko epemu.”
Eme muwec: “Mupaŋke‐narec!” Eme mupaŋkecnewec. Eme Israe e fofo‐ticnere roŋgâŋkopec dapewec.
Juku Josefe biŋedâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Manakic, mamacge huc bakac.” Eme ŋokâ jahec‐ticne Manase â Eferaim rocjofame rambiŋ.
Eme Jakobo âzâcnembiŋ: “Manakic, ŋokâge Josefe ware fisijec.” Eme Jakobo e sanaŋkehuc fofo‐ticnao fahare ŋewec.
Erâ Josefe ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Anutu bapafâre e Lusi haeo fua‐narerâ jambuŋnuhuc
ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Manakic, no basawecgupe sawe mâririackezemec, erâ go ŋicguru sâko ehaŋtec ɋâricfâcge jaŋe mâreŋ ʒi jarepe jaŋere biŋe esanaŋkezejec.’
Irec no Aigita mâreŋko mi warehape ŋokâ jahecge Aigita mâreŋko fuapic jahe nore biŋe ezepirec. Eferaim â Manase jahe, Rubeŋ â Simeoŋ junarekopirec jahere sâc jaha junarezepirec.
Eme ʒâhec naru motec gâcne fua‐garembiŋ jaŋe ine gore biŋe junʒepieŋ, jaŋe mâreŋ biŋe qajarekicne ira juhapie jaŋe jaŋacne ʒâŋe mâcne, hahac jahec‐jeŋic jahere ʒâŋe sawa fuazejec.
No ine Mesopotamia mâreŋkonec wareku Efarata hae bâqiŋkehape Rahezi Kanaaŋ mâreŋko hâmome, Efarata hatao, Betelehem hâcne, ira duckepo.”
Eme Israe e Josefe ŋokâ jahec‐ticne honec‐jofarâ wiowec: “Keci weni jahe?”
Eme Josefezi mamac‐ticne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋokâ jahec‐nane, mâreŋ ʒira juhape Anutuzi narec‐jofawec, jahe hâcne.” Eki muwec: “Ejactetec warenic, eme jambuŋ‐jofape.”
Israe e biac ŋicqizec ewecte ʒâŋe‐ticne mâteŋkewec, irec wiac sâcne mi ʒâŋitawec. Eme ejacteme maŋfuŋnao ra domahapire hâpo mumuduc ejactewec.
Erâ Josefe ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No ʒâŋe maige mocwâc honepemu i mi manasupo, eme ʒi Anutuzi mana‐nareme ɋâric jahecge honec‐jofakopac wâc.”
Eme Josefezi qicticnaonec rocjofarâ mâreŋko fodapewec.
Erâ Josefe e mefâre‐ticnezi Eferaim rorâ Israere meqanaopec râewec, erâ meqana‐ticnezi Manase rorâ Israere mefâreopec râewec.
Eme Israezi meticne nowac gowac ehuc mefâre‐ticne sicnerâ ʒâhec motec Eferaimte qizecko râewec â meqana‐ticne Manasere qizecko râewec.
Erâ jambuŋ‐jofahuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Mamac ŋosa jahec‐nane Abraham â Isaka jahe Anuture maio jupic, Anutu eki hâcne jambuŋ‐jofazejec, Anutu, nore soŋaŋ juweczi jukac, eki jambuŋ‐jofazejec.
Ʒârâ hâriŋ fuŋne fuŋne irecnec bataracnuwec, aŋelo eki motec jahec ʒi jambuŋ‐jofame nore ʒâŋezi jaherao fohuc juzejec. Erâ mamac ŋosa jahec‐nane, Abraham â Isaka jahere ʒâŋe mâmâc. Eme motec jahe mâreŋko sawe mâririackezepirec.”
Eme Josefe e, mamacnezi mefâre‐ticne Eferaimte qizecko râewec, i honeme mi sâckeme mamac‐ticnere me Eferaimte qizeckonec Manasere qizecko râeocte rowec.
Ehuc muwec: “Mamac, iŋuc mâcne! Ʒizi mârâc motec, irec mefârege ere qizecko râec.”
Mamacnezi ine qatararâ muwec: “Ŋokâ‐nane, no manakopac, no mana‐jâmbâŋkekopac. Manase e iŋuc jaha ŋic fekicne juocmu â ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋe ŋicguru sâko eniŋmu, mâc ɋanezi sirickeocmu â ere ɋâricfâc jaŋe ŋic gurune gurune erâ juniŋmu.”
Iŋuc murâ ʒoaŋ ijaha jambuŋ‐jofahuc muwec: “Ŋohere ʒâŋeo ɋetickehuc Israe ŋic jaŋe jambuŋdâŋ muniŋte ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Anutu e Eferaim â Manase ehâmo‐jactewec irec sâc jaha egarezejec.’” E iŋuc muhuc Eferaim e Manasere fekicne râewec hâcne.
Israe e iŋuc erâ Josefe ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, no ʒi hâmozo ekopac, Anutuzi ine ŋoŋehec juhuc juku jowac‐ŋopame apafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere mâreŋko mocwâc risieniŋmu.
Eme no tiki moc, Amori ŋic tepe ʒikazi jopa jâpec ejarehuc jowac ropo i hahacfâcge jaŋe mâcne, go hâcne qikiŋne‐garekopac.”
Eme Jakobo e ŋokâfâcne hefârec‐joparâ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋoŋe tumaŋneniŋ, eme jufeniŋmu dameŋ irec maŋnao wemo wiac fua‐ŋarezokac irec dâŋ ŋazazepac.
Ŋokâfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe tumaŋne‐fâreniŋ, ehuc mamac‐ŋeŋic Israe norao hazec râeniŋ!
“Rubeŋ, go mârâc ŋokâ‐nane, tâpiri â sasanaŋ‐nanere fârine bâbâni go hâcne, go tâpiri â ʒai ʒonʒoŋge fekicne.
Go opâzi roma baekac iŋuc emeŋ irec fekicne sâko mi juzemec. Go mamacge nore fofoo femeŋ ehuc fofo i dameŋ ira gâc hecnemeŋ.
“Simeoŋ â Lewi ŋohe hahac ɋa, ʒika‐ŋekiczi bâbâʒâic gie baekac.
Maŋnanezi ŋohere tutumaŋ geŋkezejec, mâro‐nanezi ŋohere guruo mi ʒuhuckezejec. Ŋohe aaricte ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopapic â maŋhazec gâc jaha bulimakao bâpuriŋ‐jopapic.
Maŋʒoc‐ŋekiczi momori wânʒâŋ ekacte sâweckezo, â aaric‐ŋekic hâhâwicne i mâmâc. No Jakobore mâreŋko bâfâuc‐ŋofapemu â Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko bârâwiŋ‐ŋofapemu.
“Juda, go hahac ɋafâcge jaŋe mu ʒeri egareniŋmu. Megezi râsifâcge jaŋere upeo foocmu, mamacgere ŋokâfâc jaŋe gorao dapeniŋmu.
Juda go laioŋ motec iŋucne o ŋokâ‐nane, go soroŋ qaqa juhuc sokameŋ hâcne. Go laioŋ ŋicne iŋucne waha fomanaekic, erâ laioŋ ŋokacne iŋucnea, mozi moc sâcne surucguocmu?
Ŋicwofuŋ gunu i Juda goraonec mi râriezejec, â micne gunu i kikegezi qafitackerâ ŋezemec. Ehame tâpiri rugezi fisime mâreŋ sâc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe micne reŋke‐fâreniŋmu.
Go doŋgige neŋgocne waiŋjâc fuŋnao niŋgiŋkehuc doŋgi motecne tieŋnao niŋgiŋkeekic. Go qorucge waiŋ opâo ʒureekic â ŋaqige waiŋ hândâŋnere opâo heuruckeekic.
Ʒâŋe hândâŋge waiŋte erâ bâruŋkeekac â micsiecge susure erâ qaŋqaŋ eekac.
“Sebuloŋ go hâwec heririŋko ŋec juc eekic, go woke jaŋere siluŋ ehaŋ magezi raku Sidoŋ hae mâreŋko tarakac.
“Isasa go doŋgi sasanaŋhec, lama bulimakao sapa ŋoŋondeŋko foekic.
Ŋeŋemana toma i aŋacne â mâreŋ fomeŋ i biaŋne, go iŋuc honerâ tagi hâpocmurâ ɋawege sicnehuc jâiŋko gie irec kiŋaŋ qaqa emeŋ.
“Daŋ go Israe guru gâcne eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc jaha ehuc ŋic gurufâcge jaŋere dâŋ mutaraekic.
Daŋ go sopâc homa â kâteo qotâ juekac iŋucne erâ becâsic kike kiririŋko kitec fainao ŋeekac e rârâpe rândiŋke qazejec.
O Wofuŋ, no bâbâpiaŋgere woŋec juekopac.
“Gade go râsifâcge jaŋe gu jâpec boc egareeŋgopieŋ, goki ine kikeo kikeo ejarehuc jopa jâpec ejareekic jaha.
“Ase go nânâ qowi fofo dunduŋ fogareekac irec nânâ wiac aŋac baŋacne kâdoc bacmu.
“Naftali go qowi rambaŋ jueŋgopieŋ iŋucne, goki hâcne gae biaŋne hefuaekic.
“Josefe go jâc dutu ɋâri fâri raraunehec iŋucne, jâc dutu ɋâri fâri rarauneheczi opâ mecko domaha tieŋ taeŋnezi sac qambaraŋkehuc ŋeratieekac.
Tepeŋic jaŋe râsi fisirâ surucguhuc tepe qâtâcnepie
go gahacne tepezi sifu qiriŋ tâmiric domawec â megezi wâc mi tarawec; i Jakobo nore Tâpiri runezi baficguwecte â Israere soŋaŋ â haroŋaŋ ere ʒâŋeo roweckemeŋ irec.
Mamacge nore Anutu e basanaŋguweczi baficguzejec, Anutu bapafâre e sabecguweczi jambuŋguzejec. E sambâŋkonec mâririzi jambuŋguzejec. E mâreŋmaŋko opâre rowaŋ fokac izi jambuŋguzejec, erâ kogoc fufua â moŋ i mâmâc jambuŋke‐garezejec.
Mamacge nore jambuŋ i tiki ŋeŋene irec sâc sirickehuc tiki sanaŋ irec guec i mâmâc sirickekac. Jambuŋ i sasawa Josefe gore faio ferâ fozejec, hahacfâcge jaŋere guruonec rowosâecgukicne gore faio hâcne.
“Benjamiŋ go qâto momori wânʒâŋ, go furicte soroŋ qahuc nâekic â ŋafeo ine nânâ qowi tucne fokac i bâtâc baekic.”
Ŋic i sasawa jaŋe Israe ŋicguru 12 ine hâcne, erâ mamac‐jeŋiczi jambuŋ‐jopahuc dâŋ jazawec ine hâcne; ru sâc jambuŋdâŋ jazahuc buc buc jambuŋ‐jopawec hâcne.
Iŋuc erâ dâŋ mu qâmoc ejarehuc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No mimiŋnefâc‐nane jaŋerao rape ŋoŋe mamac ŋosafâc‐nane jaŋe foŋgopieŋko ducnunʒepieŋ, ine Kanaaŋ mâreŋko Mamere ʒoaŋ wewefunao mâreŋ dâkâne Makepela ira Hitiŋic ʒâŋene Eferoŋ ere gieo hawec fokac ira ducnunʒepieŋ. Gie i hâcne Abrahamzi Hitiŋic Eferoŋ eraonec ʒâŋeruŋte biŋe furine bawec.
<range>
Ira Abraham â ŋonâŋ‐ticne Sara ducjofambiŋ, â Isaka â ŋonâŋ‐ticne Rebeka ducjofambiŋ, erâ noni wâc Lea ira duckepo.
Gie â hawec i Hitiŋic jaŋeraonec furine bakicne.”
Eme Jakobo e ŋokâfâcne dâŋ iŋuc jaza mutâc ejare‐fârerâ kike jahec‐ticne fofoo fâreme feme hâmorâ mimiŋnefâc‐ticne jaŋe qâtec‐jopawec hâcne.
Eme Josefezi mamac‐ticne hâporâ kiohuc muduckewec.
Erâ kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne â dotafâcne jaŋe mamac‐ticnere sahac babasanaŋ wokemaŋ ruacneniŋte mujarewec; eme jaŋe Israe wokemaŋ ruacnembiŋ.
Gie i bahuc juhapie ŋafe ʒoaŋ 40 tarawec, dameŋ ʒora iŋuc hâcne gie i bajumbieŋ. Eme Aigita ŋic jaŋe ere ki mamakuc ehapie ʒoaŋ 70 tarawec.
Eme ki mamakuc dameŋ tarame Josefezi Farao wiacfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe bubiaŋ moc qanarezo murâ ine nore âkehoc Farao ʒiŋuc âzâcneniŋ:
Mamac‐nane e ʒiŋuc mupaŋkecnepemurâ muwec: No hâmope Kanaaŋ mâreŋko qânâ hawec‐nane moc gufupo, ira ducnuzemec. No irec hâcne rarâ mamac‐nane duckerâ mocwâc risiezo mukopac.”
Eme Faraozi muwec: “Murâ iŋuc ec, erâ mumupaŋ dâŋ mumeŋ irec sâcko mamacge duckezemec.”
Eme Josefe e mamac‐ticne duckeocte rawec, ehame Farao kiŋaŋŋicfâcne â ficticnere micnefâc â Aigita mâreŋkonec ŋic fekicne jaŋe mecne,
erâ Josefe â Israe wiacfâc‐jekic mecne, jaŋe sasawa ehec mâmâc rafârembiŋ. Naru motec piic piic â qowi â bulimakao wiac jaŋe sawa ine Goseŋ mâreŋko behec‐jopapie jumbiŋ.
Keretac â becâsicko rarâ ŋic ine mâmâc rapie biri ʒora jâmbâŋ ewec.
Eme jaŋe raku Goreŋ Atadi Jordaŋ opâ ocniŋucnao fokac, ira fisirâ soŋgâŋ bahuc ki kâcɋene kiombiŋ. Ehame Josefezi mamac‐ticnere erâ ki mamakuc eha ʒoaŋ 7 tarawec.
Iŋuc epie mâreŋ rune, Kanaaŋ ŋic hâcne, jaŋe hone manac erâ mumbiŋ: “Aigita ŋic jaŋere ki mamakuc ine hâcne.” Eme irec hae mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe AbeMiziraim mueŋgopieŋ; mâreŋ i Jordaŋ opâ ocniŋucnao fokac.
Eme Jakobo ŋokâfâcne jaŋe wiac muwec sâc ecnembiŋ.
Jaŋe Kanaaŋ mâreŋko bararâ ine Mamere ʒoaŋ wewefunao Makepela mâreŋko hawec fowec, Abrahamzi Hitiŋic Eferoŋ eraonec furine bawec, ira duckembiŋ.
Eme Josefe e mamac‐ticne duckeme tarame e jahacne mecne â hahacfâcne mecne â gâcne sasawa ehec mamac‐ticne duckeniŋte mâmâc rambiŋzi Aigita mâreŋko risie‐fârembiŋ.
Josefe hahacfâcne jaŋe mamac‐jeŋic hâmome honerâ mumbiŋ: “Josefe e wiac sâqocne ecnembeŋ sasawa irec juku qaisoc‐nâpohuc okacne wiac moc nâreme!”
Iŋuc muhuc erao dâŋ kecʒiŋuc râepie rawec: “Mamacgezi hâmozo ehuc mutâcne‐nârerâ muwec:
‘Josefe âzâcnenʒepieŋ, hahacfâcge nâŋe wiac hehesicne egarembeŋ kiŋ bahac‐nâŋec i sifu behezemec.’ Irec numu‐gareŋgopeneŋ hâcne, mamacgere Anutu ere kiŋaŋ qaqafâc juŋgopeneŋte kiŋnâŋec behezemec.” Josefezi dâŋ i manarâ kiowec.
Ehame hahacfâcne jaŋe jaŋac wâc rarâ Josefere maio fodaperâ mumbiŋ: “Kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge nâŋe ʒi.”
Iŋuc epie Josefezi jazawec: “Mi hâwic‐ŋopaoc, no Anuture dodomao mi domakopac.
Ŋoŋe jâmbomac norao wiac sâqoreocte muhuc embiŋ, Anutuzi ine herisieme bibiaŋko rawec. Ŋic bocjaha juju‐jeŋicte hata wiŋkeocte iŋuc manaha fuawec i miŋecgac tâtâc honeŋgopeneŋ.
Irec mi hâwic‐ŋopaoc. No ŋaŋacne â ɋiefâc‐ŋeŋic hone maiŋ eŋarehuc jupemu.” Iŋuc mu baafec ejarehuc bâmiriŋ‐jopawec.
Eme Josefe e jahacne â mamac‐ticnere kikefuŋ Aigita mâreŋko jumbiŋ. Josefe ine jufeku jara 110 bazuwec.
Ehuc Eferaimtaonec apa ŋosafâcne fuapie honec‐jopawec. Erâ wâc Manasere ŋokâ Makiri ɋiefâcne qicjopawec.
Eme Josefezi hahacfâcne jaŋere ɋâricfâc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No ʒi hâmozo ekopac. Anutu e ine iqic‐ŋopazokac. Ehuc mâreŋ ʒirecnec rocŋoparâ jowac‐ŋopa ra mâreŋ Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo mupaŋke‐jarewec ira râec‐ŋopazokac.”
Eme Josefe e Israe ŋokâfâcne jaŋe Anuture maio dâŋ mupaŋkecneniŋte ejarewec. Ʒiŋuc muwec: “Anutuzi iqic‐ŋopazokac dameŋ ira siec‐nane barâ ranʒepieŋ.”
Eme Josefe e jara 110 bazurâ hâmowec. Hâmome sahac babasanaŋ wokemaŋ ruacnerâ Aigita mâreŋko qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne katapa mocko râepie fowec.
Israere ŋokâfâc jaŋe ru sâc ŋokac naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec â mamac‐jeŋic Jakobo ehec mâmâc Aigita mâreŋko ra fisimbiŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe biri ʒiŋe hâcne:
Rubeŋ, Simeoŋ, Lewi â Juda.
Isasa, Sebuloŋ â Benjamiŋ.
Daŋ â Naftali, Gade â Ase.
Jakobore ɋâricfâc sasawa jaŋere qâqâhâc ʒare 70; Josefe eki ine biac juwicnao Aigita mâreŋko ra juwec.
Eme Josefe hahacfâcne â wiacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe juku hâmo‐fârembiŋ.
Ehame ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ine fua soka erâ sawe mâririackepie ʒare‐jeŋic fejâmbâŋkeme sanaŋkerâ mâreŋ fusucma sâqorembiŋ.
Ehame Aigita ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ ɋâricne moc fuawec e Josefe kâuc bawec.
Eki hâcne ŋicfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Manaŋgopieŋ, Israe ŋic jaŋe siric‐nâpopie ʒare â tâpiri‐jeŋic boc fekac.
Ajoc, nâŋâc bomac‐jopanʒepeneŋ, jaŋe boc sawe mâririackepie juku ʒika wiac moc fua‐nâreme râsifâc‐nâŋec qâtec‐joparâ nâpohuc mâreŋ nâwoc ronʒipiŋkohec.”
Iŋuc mume kia âkendâŋ‐jopapie jaŋe soŋaŋ‐jopahuc gie hâhâwicne jarembiŋ, ehuc Faraore nânâ rowaŋ hae jajahec, Pitoŋ â Ramasesi bacjofaniŋte mujarembiŋ.
Jaŋe ine bomac‐jopa‐bipiehapie sifu fehuc sawe mâririackembiŋ, eme Aigita ŋic jaŋe Israe ŋic jaŋere hâwic‐jopawec.
Irec Aigita ŋic jaŋe Israe ŋic kâpâcwâru gie ŋemâcne mujarembiŋ,
ehuc fific bacjoparâ gie ŋemâcne jarepie ʒâic manahuc afezi fic bapa qânâ bambiŋ, â nânâ gie he rikec â he sarac eniŋte ʒoɋac ejarembiŋ wâc.
Eme Aigita ŋicwofuŋ e Hebiraio gozi bapa ŋokac jajahec, Sifera â Pua, jahe ʒiŋuc muhuc jasawec:
“Ŋohe Hebiraio ŋokac gozi bajarehapire ɋâric fuapie honec‐jopa‐hâmozepirec, motec fuaocmuo bâhâmozepirec, naru fuaocmuo ine akickezepirec.”
Gozi bapa ŋokac jahe ine Anutu araŋ bacnehuc Aigita ŋicwofuŋzi dâŋ jasawec i mana rereŋ mi ee motec akic‐jopapic wâc.
Iŋuc epire Aigita ŋicwofuŋ e gozi bapa ŋokac hefârec‐jofarâ mu wioc ʒiŋuc ejactewec: “Ŋohe wemocte iŋuc ehuc motec jaŋe akic‐jopapic?”
Eme gozi bapa ŋokac jahe Farao dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnepic: “Hebiraio ŋokac jaŋe Aigita ŋokac iŋucne aricne, jaŋe ŋokac sanaŋne, irec gozi bapa ŋokac nâŋe mi fisihapene motec biac rocjopaeŋgopieŋ.”
Anutuzi ine gozi bapa ŋokac ŋezic‐jopawec irec ŋic jaŋe fua sawec erâ soka sanaŋ embiŋ.
Eme gozi bapa ŋokac jaŋe Anutu araŋ bacnehuc gie bambiŋte ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic tahac‐jopawec wâc.
Iŋuc fuame Faraozi ŋicfâcne ʒiŋuc muhuc jazawec: “Hebiraio ŋic jaŋere motecfâc fuaniŋmu sâc Nilu opâo behec‐jopapie hufârenʒepieŋ, naru jaŋe ine akic‐jopanʒepieŋ.”
Eme Lewi guruonec ŋic moczi ra Lewi guruonec jaha ŋokac moc rowec.
Eme ŋokac e juku motec kiweckerâ rowec. Erâ motec e sahac hawari‐ticne biaŋne, iŋuc honerâ soŋkeme foha mosa jahec â moc tarawec.
Eme ʒuhuckerâ ficko soŋkeocte maname quŋkeme sasac moc soroqeczi fukicne i rorâ kikisune sâfâzi bâbâzicke‐fârerâ motec ira râeme hume Nilu opâ mecnao ʒamac ʒamac maŋko heme ŋewec.
Eme seŋticnezi ine wiac i me i moc fuacneme honezepac muhuc taicko soŋaŋ domawec.
Ehame Farao otâ‐ticne e opâ ruaocte ra fisiwec, eme kiŋaŋ narufâcne jaŋe opâ mecnao rac warec ehuc juhapie naru e sasac i bâfuarâ kiŋaŋ naru‐ticne moczi roocte soreme huwec.
Eme bawefume tapane rorâ mi motec moc kiohuc foha honezejec i! Ehuc bune sâqoreme muwec: “Hebiraio ŋic jaŋere ɋâric moc ʒine hâcne.”
Eme seŋticnezi Faraore otâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No ra Hebiraio ŋokac moc âzâcnepe ware motec moŋ gume‐garezac me?”
Eme Faraore otâzi âzâcnewec: “Ra iŋuc ec.” Eme naru e ra motec neŋgoc‐ticne jowa warewec.
Ware fisime Faraore otâzi âzâcnewec: “Go motec kecʒi bararâ moŋ gume‐narezemec, eme no irec furine garepemu.” Eme ŋokac e motec bararâ moŋ gumehuc juwec.
Eme motec e sokame Farao otâ‐ticne bara râcneme motec‐ticne erâ juwec. Ehame ʒâŋe‐ticne kecʒiŋuc muhuc Mose muwec: “No opâonec fârepe wefuwec hâcne.”
Eme Mose e juku soka tararâ dameŋ mocko Israe ŋic âgofâcne jaŋerao rarâ kâpâcwâru gie bahuc juhapie honec‐jopawec. Ehuc Aigita ŋic moczi Hebiraio ŋic âgofâcne jaŋeraonec moc qame honewec.
Erâ ŋifec â ŋifec ŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe fime arictac eme Aigita ŋic qâhâmorâ moŋgeŋzi hefackewec.
Hae fureme mocwâc rarâ Hebiraio ŋic jajahec perec eec ehapire ŋic âgo‐ticne maŋgâŋ qawec e ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go wemocte âgoge qakomec?”
Mume eki dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Nâŋere ŋic fekicne me mumutara ŋic i mozi râecguwec? Go Aigita ŋic qâhâmomec iŋuc jaha no qâhâmocnuzo mukomec me?” Iŋuc mume Mosezi hâwickeme ʒiŋuc manasuwec hâcne: “Wiac epac i biac mana‐fâreŋgopieŋ i.”
Eme Faraozi biŋe manarâ Mose qaocte qâqâreŋne qawec. Mose eki ine Faraoraonec wiserâ Midiaŋ mâreŋko ra juwec. E ira fisirâ opâ nombâŋ mocte heririŋko waha ŋewec.
Eme Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋere taha bapa ere otâfâc 7 jumbiŋ. Eme jaŋe ware mamac‐jeŋicte lama bulimakao opâ gumec‐jopaniŋte opâ fiarâ otoo hoŋkepie huwec.
Ehame qowi soŋaŋ jaŋe fisirâ jâpec‐jopambiŋ. Iŋuc epie Mosezi faharerâ naru bafic‐jopahuc qowifâc‐jeŋic opâ gumec‐jopawec.
Eme jaŋe mamac‐jeŋic, ʒâŋene Reguele, Jetoro hâcne, erao fisipie ʒiŋuc wio‐jarewec: “Ŋoŋe miŋecgac weniŋuc erâ biac jâmbâŋ wareŋgopieŋ?”
Jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Aigita ŋic moczi soŋaŋ jaŋe jâpec‐nâpopie bafic‐nâpojec, ehuc opâ fia‐nârerâ qowifâc‐nâŋec gumec‐jopajec wâc.”
Eme otâfâcne wio‐jarehuc muwec: “Ŋic e wena? Ŋoŋe wemocte behepie ŋejec? Wiracnepie ware nânâ nâzejec.”
Eme Mose e ŋic ehec juocte maname sâckewec, ehame ŋic e otâ‐ticne Ʒibora Mose râcnewec.
Eme juku motec kiweckerâ rowec. Rome Mose e ʒiŋuc muhuc ʒâŋene Geresom muwec: “No mâreŋ furunao jaba jukopac.”
Eme juku Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Faraozi hâmowec. Israe ŋic jaŋe ine kâpâcwâru giezi bâmâc‐jopame mu huacbuc â kio wâwâsic embiŋ. Eme kâpâcwâruo juhuc kio wâwâsic epie Anuturao fe fisiwec.
Eme Anutu e mu huacbuc‐jeŋic manarâ Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ewec irec manasuwec.
Erâ Anutu e Israe ŋic jaŋe hone ʒemuraŋ ejarehuc batarac‐jopaocte manasuwec.
Mose e kimo‐ticne Jetoro, Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋere taha bapa, ere lamafâc soŋaŋ‐jopahuc juwec. Eme lamafâcne mâreŋ burocne ocniŋucnao jowac‐jopa raku Anuture tike Horebe ira fisiwec.
Eme Wofuŋte aŋelozi ʒocbârun hawari fuacnewec, ʒoc i jâc dutu maŋkonec bâruŋkehuc domawec. Eme fime rame honewec, jâc dutu i bâruŋkehuc sifu mi ʒâtâcnewec.
Eme Mose e manasuwec: “No ipec rarâ wiac ʒâŋe furu fuakac i honepe, jâc dutu i wemocte mi ʒâtâcnekac?”
Iŋuc murâ wiac i hone taraocte ipec rame Wofuŋ Anutuzi honerâ jâc dutu maŋkonec wiracne muwec: “Mose, Mose!” Eme muwec: “No ʒi.”
Eme eki muwec: “Bembeŋko mi warec, kikehuhuge hetarac, mâreŋ domakic i furu.”
Erâ muwec: “No apafâcge Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo jaŋere Anutu.” Eme Mose e Anutu honezacte hâwickeme ʒâŋe maine bâsoŋkewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi muwec: “Ŋicfâc‐nane Aigita mâreŋko fific guguriŋ ejarepie honekopac; â jopa tuŋtuŋ ejarepie kio owa eŋgopieŋ i manakopac, ʒâic manaŋgopieŋ i kâuc mi bakopac.
Erâ ʒi Aigita ŋic jaŋere meonec batarac‐jopapemurâ wahakopac hâcne. Erâ mâreŋ irecnec jowac‐jopa rarâ mâreŋ biaŋne â qaratiekicne sâko moc ira râec‐jopapemu. Mâreŋ ira susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeekac, Kanaaŋ ŋic, Hitiŋic, Amori ŋic, Periʒi ŋic Hiwiŋic â Jebusi ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ.
Eme manakic, ʒi ine Israe ŋicguru jaŋere ki owa bâfuacnujec, â Aigita ŋic jaŋe bomac‐jopaŋgopieŋ i honekopac.
Irec fahare rac, no Faraorao sorecgukopac, go Israe ŋicfâc‐nane Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa razemec.”
Mosezi Anutu âzâcnewec: “No iŋucnezi wemocko Faraorao rarâ Israe ŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa rapemu?”
Eme muwec: “No gohec jupemu. Noni sorecgukopac irec ma ine kecʒiŋuc fuame honezemec: Israe ŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopatecne tiki kecʒira Anutu no kiŋaŋ qanareniŋmu.”
Eme Mosezi Anutu âzâcnewec: “No Israe ŋic jaŋerao ra fisirâ ʒiŋuc jazapemu, ‘Mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋere Anutuzi ŋoŋerao sorecnukac,’ eme jaŋe, ‘Anutu ʒâŋene mo?’ iŋuc muhuc wio‐narepie weniŋuc jazapemu?”
Eme Anutuzi Mose âzâcnewec: “NO JUKOPACZI JUKOPAC.” Erâ muwec: “Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec, ‘NO JUKOPAC eki ŋoŋerao sorecnukac.’”
Erâ Mose ʒuhuckerâ âzâcnewec: “Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec, ‘Wofuŋ, mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo jaŋere Anutu, eki ŋoŋerao sorecnukac.’ Izi ʒâŋe‐nane fofo sanaŋ ekac, mimiŋzi ɋâric ʒâŋe‐nane iŋuc hâcne muhuc junʒepieŋ.
Go rarâ Israe ŋic micnefâc‐jeŋic hetumaŋ‐joparâ jazazemec, ‘Wofuŋ, mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo jaŋere Anutu, eki fua‐narerâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “No ŋoŋe honec‐ŋopakopac erâ Aigita ŋic jaŋe wiac eŋareŋgopieŋ i wâc mâmâc hone manac ekopac.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc mupaŋkekopac, ‘No Aigita mâreŋte fific guguriŋkonec batarac‐ŋoparâ jowac‐ŋopa raku Kanaaŋ ŋic, Hitiŋic, Amori ŋic, Periʒi ŋic Hiwiŋic â Jebusi ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko râec‐ŋopapemu. Mâreŋ ira susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeekac.’” ’
Eme jaŋe dâŋge manapie fârine eha go Israe ŋic micne jaŋehec Aigita ŋicwofuŋ erao rarâ âzâcnenʒepieŋ, ‘Wofuŋ, Hebiraio ŋic nâŋere Anutu e fua‐nârewec, irec mana‐nâretec nâŋe ʒoaŋ jahec â moc ra juku mâreŋ tuhuo Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec taha bâzi rikecnenʒepeneŋ.’
No ine ʒiŋuc manakopac wâc, Aigita ŋicwofuŋ e mesanaŋ izi me izi ʒoɋac mi ecneha raniŋte mi mana‐ŋareocmu.
Irec no menane sicnerâ jaŋere ŋondeŋko fuŋne qaqa mâsi bâfuahuc Aigita mâreŋ ima bapemu. Eme irec faicnao sâcne râec‐ŋopame raniŋmu.
Eme no Aigita ŋic ejarepe ŋoŋe âgo eŋareniŋmu, eme ŋoŋe behec‐joparâ raniŋmu i metariŋ jâmbâŋ mi raniŋmu.
Irec ŋokac sasawa jaŋe Aigita ŋokac âgofâc‐jeŋic erâ ficjeŋicko mâmâc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe eri wiac, siliwa â golzi bakicne irec mecne, â ŋaqi wiac irec mâmâc numu‐jarepie jarenʒepieŋ. Eme wiac i naru motecfâc‐jeŋic hejarepie huzejec; ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc Aigita ŋic wâc wiac‐jeŋic jowac ronʒepieŋ hâcne.”
Eme Mose e dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnerâ muwec: “Manakic, jaŋe dâŋnane mi mana ʒakiehuc muniŋmu, ‘Wofuŋ e go mi fua‐garewec.’ Iŋuc mupie wenac epemu?”
Mume Wofuŋzi âzâcnewec: “Megao wemo wiac bakomec?” Eme eki muwec: “Gunu moc.”
Eme muwec: “Mâreŋko behec.” Eme mâreŋko beheme gunuzi homa eme Mose e wisewec.
Wiseme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mege sicnerâ ʒinao roc.” Eme meticne sicnerâ rome mocwâc gunu ewec.
Eme muwec: “Iŋuc etec jaŋe ʒiŋuc mana taraniŋmu, Wofuŋ, apafâc‐nâŋec Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo jaŋere Anutu eki fuacnewec.”
Erâ Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mege ŋaqimaŋko esoriec.” Eme e meticne ŋaqimaŋko esoriewec, eme mocwâc unuckeme mene mi wakoc sasawa ehuc qaŋqaŋ jâmbâŋ ezejec i!
Eme Anutuzi muwec: “Mege mocwâc ŋaqimaŋko esoriec.” Eme meticne mocwâc ŋaqimaŋko esoriewec, eme mocwâc unuckeme fâsâerâ sahac‐ticne gâcnere sâc ewec.
Eme Anutuzi muwec: “Jaŋe dâŋge mi mana ʒakieniŋmuo â mâsi bâbâni bacmu irec wâc manapie fârine mi eocmuo ine mâsi arec jajahec irec manapie fârine eocmu mecne.
Me mâsi i â i hone‐bipiehuc manapie fârine mi eha dâŋge qataraniŋmuo ine Nilu opâonec opâ afecne fiarâ mâreŋ kereŋnao hoŋkezemec, eme opâ fiacmu izi mâreŋ kereŋnao soc eocmu.”
Mosezi ine Wofuŋ âzâcnewec: “No ŋic micafec aricne, no mârâc ŋic micafec moc mi jupo, erâ ʒi kiŋaŋŋicge no dâŋ nazakomecko ŋic micafec wâc mi jukopac, aricne, no marac‐nane piticne â nameŋ‐nane ŋemâcne.”
Eme Wofuŋzi âzâcnewec: “Ŋicte mic mozi bâfuawec? Me mozi ŋic ecneme nâŋguŋ me qepoŋ me ʒâŋe fifi me tiŋtuŋ eekac? Wofuŋ noni hâcne.
Irec go rac, eme no nahac micge baafeckehuc dâŋ qazu‐garepemu i hâcne muzemec.”
Eki ine muwec: “O Wofuŋ, go ŋic e me e sorezo murâ soretec raoc.”
Iŋuc mume Wofuŋ e Mosere erâ bune ʒâʒâficne qame muwec: “Hahacge Aroŋ, Lewiŋic hâcne, e mi jukac me? E dâŋ micafec muekac i no manakopac, erâ e bâfuacguocte biac warehuc jukac, erâ ware honecgurâ ine bune biaŋkeocmu.
Eme go dâŋ âzâcnehuc micnao râezemec. Noni ine gore â ere mic i mâmâc baafeckehuc wiac enicmu i qazu‐ŋactepemu.
Eki gore âkehoc ŋic dâŋ jazazejec, eme e gore mic eha goki ere Anutu tinac ezemec.
Eme go gunu keci megao badomahuc izi hâcne mâsi bazemec.”
Eme Mose e kimo‐ticne Jetoro erao risie rarâ âzâcnewec: “No qomâfâc‐nane Aigita mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ jaŋe sâcne mac juŋgopieŋ me weniŋuc i honec‐jopazore jaŋerao risiezo mukopac.” Eme Jetorozi Mose âzâcnewec: “Go wamao rac.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Midiaŋ mâreŋko Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ajoc, go Aigita mâreŋko risie rac, ŋic guzo mumbiŋ jaŋe hâmo‐fârembiŋ hâcne.”
Eme Mose e ŋonâŋ motecfâcne rocjoparâ doŋgi faio râec‐joparâ Aigita mâreŋko risie rawec; ehuc Anuture gunu meo bawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec: “Go Aigita mâreŋko risie rarâ mâsi wiac gaza gowatuc ehuc irec tâpiri qikiŋne‐garepo i sasawa manasurâ Faraore maio bafârezemec. Noni ine ŋic mi râec‐jopame raniŋte maŋsanaŋ bâfuacnepemu.
Goki ine Farao âzâcnezemec, ‘Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Israe e mârâc ŋokâ‐nane hâcne.
Eme “Ŋokâ‐nane râetec ra kiŋaŋ qanarezejec,” iŋuc gazape mi ehuc qataracmuo ine no gahacne mârâc ŋokâ qâhâmopemu.’”
Eme hata raku mocko fohapie Wofuŋzi Mose qâhâmoocmurâ fuacnewec.
Iŋuc eme Ʒiborazi buse dâkâne micnehec rorâ ŋokâ‐ticnere sahac tofa hetâcnerâ izi Mosere sahac tofa heuahuc muwec: “Go socte erâ nore biŋe ekomec.”
Iŋuc mume Wofuŋzi Mose akickewec. Dameŋ ira sahacko ma bapare ʒiŋuc mujumbieŋ hâcne: “Socte erâ nore biŋe.”
Wofuŋzi Aroŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Mose bâfuacmurâ mâreŋ tuhuo razemec.” Eme eki raku Anuture tiki fuŋnao bâfuarâ muduckewec.
Eme Mose e Anutuzi dâŋ âzâcnewec â mâsi baocte mucnewec irec binaŋ Aroŋ bacne‐fârewec.
Eme Mose â Aroŋ jahe ra Israe ŋic micne sasawa hetumaŋ‐jopapic.
Ehuc Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ âzâcnewec sâc i Aroŋzi jaza‐fârewec, erâ mâsi wiac i ŋic mai‐jeŋicko bawec.
Eme ŋic jaŋe mana ʒakiembiŋ, erâ Wofuŋ e Israe ŋic nâŋere busâqoc manahuc fific guguriŋ‐nâŋec hone manac ewec, jaŋe iŋuc manarâ fodapehuc numucnembiŋ.
Eme Mose â Aroŋ jahe juku Faraorao rarâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnepic: “Wofuŋ, Israe ŋic jaŋere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Go ŋicfâc‐nane râec‐jopatec mâreŋ tuhuo rarâ nore hombaŋ moc ŋenʒepieŋ.’”
Iŋuc mupire Faraozi muwec: “Mo Wofuŋ mo, irec no dâŋticne mana rereŋ erâ Israe ŋic ŋoŋe râec‐ŋopape raniŋmu? No Wofuŋ e kâuc bakopac, erâ Israe ŋic ŋoŋe mi râec‐ŋopape raniŋmu.”
Iŋuc mume mupic: “Hebiraio ŋic nâŋere Anutu e nâŋe fua‐nârewec, irec huc hâmoczi me ʒikazi sipiric‐nâpozacte mana‐nâretec ʒoaŋ jahec â moc raku mâreŋ tuhuo Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec taha bâzi rikecnenʒepeneŋ.”
Aigita ŋicwofuŋzi ine jasawec: “Mose â Aroŋ, ŋohe wemocte ŋic jaŋe gie‐jeŋic beheniŋte mukopirec? Ŋohe kâpâcwâru gie‐ŋekic ra banic me!”
Farao e iŋuc murâ ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Manakopirec, jaŋe mâreŋ rune nâŋe biac siric‐nâpoŋgopieŋko wemocte gie‐jeŋic hetararâ hombaŋ ŋeniŋte mukopirec?”
Erâ Farao e ʒoaŋ ijaha gie soŋaŋfâc‐jeŋic â micnefâc‐jeŋic dâŋ ʒiŋuc mutâcne‐jarewec:
“Ŋoŋe ŋic sopâc uucne jarepie afehec bâsifuckehuc fic bapa qânâ baeŋgopieŋ i mocwâc mi jarenʒepieŋ, jaŋe jaŋac rarâ ro nusec enʒepieŋ.
Erâ juwicnao qânâ rikeniŋte mujarekicne ʒare i moc mi bawahahuc ijaha bâfuanʒepieŋ. I jaŋe ojoŋ juhuc ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋte: ‘Nâŋe ra Anutu‐nâŋec bâzi rikecnenʒepeneŋ.’
Irec fai‐jeŋicko gie bâmâckehuc ŋemâcne jâmbâŋ râepie ferâ kihâmoc‐jopame burecdâŋte hazec mi râenʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume ŋic jaŋere gie soŋaŋ â micne jaŋe ra ŋic jazambiŋ: “Farao e muac‐nâpohuc ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Sopâc mocwâc mi jarezo.
Irec ŋoŋe ŋaŋac, ira me ira fokacko ra bâfuarâ ronʒepieŋ, ehame gie‐ŋeŋicte sâc ine moc mi wahazejec.’”
Eme ŋic jaŋe sopâc ro nusec eniŋte Aigita mâreŋ sâkoo râwiŋ qâwiŋne‐fârembiŋ.
Gie soŋaŋ jaŋe ine fafine ejarehuc mumbiŋ: “Sopâc uucne râe‐ŋarekicne dameŋ ira ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne gie bambiŋ sâc ijaha wâc bâfuanʒepieŋ.”
Ehame Faraore soŋaŋfâc Israe gie soŋaŋ râec‐jopambiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc wio‐jarehuc jopambiŋ: “Ŋoŋe wemocte juwicnao qânâ gie muŋarepene bambiŋ sâc ijaha jacne â miŋecgac mi bâfuambieŋ?”
Eme Israe gie soŋaŋ jaŋe Faraorao rarâ mu huacbuc ehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge nâŋe iŋuc wemocte enârekomec?
Sopâc uucne mocwâc mi nârehuc sifu ʒiŋuc munâreŋgopieŋ: ‘Qânâ rikenʒepieŋ!’ Iŋuc muhuc kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge nâŋe nâpoŋgopieŋ wâc. Go ŋicfâcge nâŋe iŋuc enârehuc kiŋsâko hurekomec i!”
Eme eki muwec: “Ŋoŋe ŋic ojoŋne, ojoŋ juŋgopieŋ hâcne. Irec muŋgopieŋ, ‘Nâŋe ra Wofuŋ bâzi rikecnenʒepeneŋ.’
Ʒi ra gie‐ŋeŋic baniŋ, mâc sopâc uucne ine mi ŋarezo, erâ sifu qânâ ʒare muŋarekicne i jâmbâŋ bâfuarâ râepie warezejec.”
Eme Israe gie soŋaŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazakicnere manapie boc ŋemâckewec: “Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne qânâ bâfuaniŋte mukicne sâc i moc mi wahazejec.”
Eme Faraoraonec waharâ Mose â Aroŋ jahe woŋec domahapire bâfuac‐jofarâ
dâŋ ʒiŋuc jasambiŋ: “Wofuŋzi fua‐ŋacterâ okacne bazu‐ŋacteoc. Farao â ŋicfâcne jaŋe ŋohere erâ hâcne mana‐nârepie boc sâqorekac, ŋohe qâhâmoc‐nâponiŋte ʒika mejeŋicko râekopirec hâcne.”
Iŋuc mupie Mosezi Wofuŋ mu wâwâsic ecnehuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “O Wofuŋ, go wemocte ŋicguru ʒi wiac hâhâwicne iŋucne ejaremeŋ, wemocte sorecnutec warepo?
No Faraorao rarâ gore micte dâŋ âzâcnepo dameŋ ira hâcne fuŋkerâ ŋicguru ʒi mâsi repicne ejarehuc juweczi jukac jaha, eme goki ine gurufâcge moc mi batarac‐jopameŋ.”
Wofuŋzi ine Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No miŋecne Farao wiac ecnepe honezemec, mesanaŋ‐nanezi ecnepe râec‐ŋopame raniŋmu, mesanaŋ‐nanezi ecnepe mâreŋ‐ticnaonec jâpec‐ŋopaocmu hâcne.”
Erâ Anutuzi ʒuhuckerâ Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac.
No Anutu tâpiri runezi Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo fua‐jarepo, mâc Wofuŋ ʒâŋe‐nane mutaniŋkerâ fuŋne‐nane mumufua‐jare ine mi epo.
No Kanaaŋ mâreŋ jarepemurâ jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo wâc, mâreŋ jaba jumbiŋ i hâcne.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, Aigita ŋic jaŋe kâpâcwâru gie mujareeŋgopieŋ Israe ŋic i jaŋere ki owa manapo wâc, ehuc ʒâʒâfic‐nanere manasupo.
Irec Israe ŋicguru jazac, ‘No hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac, erâ no Aigita mâreŋte ʒâic gieonec â kiŋaŋ qaqa bacŋopakicnaonec batarac‐ŋoparâ bawefuc‐ŋopahuc mesanaŋ‐nanezi okac babazu gie bahuc firuec‐ŋopapemu.
Erâ no ŋicfâc‐nane bacŋoparâ Anutu‐ŋeŋic juhape ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ: Anutu‐ŋeŋic, Wofuŋ no hâcne Aigita mâreŋte kâpâcwâru â ʒâic gieonec batarac‐ŋopakopac.
No menane bafaharehuc Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo mâreŋ jarezo mupaŋke‐jarepo ira hâcne jowac‐ŋopape raʒiniŋmu; eme qikiŋne‐ŋarepe ŋoŋere biŋe eocmu. No hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac.’”
Mose e Israe ŋic jaŋe iŋuc hâcne jazawec. Jaŋe ine kâpâcwâru giere hâbi fafara ejareha dâŋticne mi manambiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Faraorao ferâ âzâcnetec Israe ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ‐ticne beherâ raniŋte mana‐jarezejec.”
Eme Mosezi Wofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, Israe ŋic jaŋe dâŋnane qatarambiŋko Faraozi wemocko moc manaocmu, erâ no micnane ŋemâcne i.”
Wofuŋ eki ine Mose â Aroŋ jahe Israe ŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa ranicte mukicne dâŋ i Israe ŋic mecne, â Farao mecne mâmâc jazanicte mujactewec.
Israe ficne ficne micnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe ʒine hâcne: Israe mârâc ŋokâ‐ticne Rubeŋ ere ŋokâfâc: Hanoki, Palu, Hezoroŋ â Karami. Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne Rubeŋte ɋâricfâc.
Simeoŋte ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Jemue, Jamiŋ, Ohada, Jakiŋ, Zohari â Sauli. Sauli e ine Kanaaŋ ŋokac ere ŋokâ. Ŋic i jaŋe Simeoŋte ɋâricfâc.
Ʒi Lewi ŋokâfâcne fuambiŋ sâc jaŋere ʒâŋe: Geresoŋ, Kohati â Merari. Lewi e jara 137 bazurâ hâmowec.
Geresoŋte ŋokâ jajahec ine ʒiŋuc: Libini â Simei, guru‐jekicte micne hâcne.
Kohati ere ŋokâfâc: Amaram, Izara, Heboroŋ â Uʒiele. Kohati e ine jara 133 bazuwec.
Merari ere ŋokâ jajahec ʒiŋuc: Mali â Musi. Ŋic i jaŋe Lewire ɋâricfâc gaŋne gaŋne fua wefumbiŋ.
Eme Amaram e neŋgoc pitic‐ticne Jokebede ŋokac‐ticne bawec, eme eki hâcne Mose â Aroŋ rocjofawec. Amaram e ine jara 137 bazurâ hâmowec.
Izara ere ŋokâfâc ʒiŋuc: Kora, Nefege â Sikiri.
Uʒiele ere ŋokâfâc ʒiŋuc: Misae, Eliʒafaŋ â Sitiri.
Aroŋ eki ine Aminadare otâ, Nasoŋ ere seŋ, ʒâŋene Eliseba e ŋokac‐ticne bawec. Eme eki Nadaba, Abihu, Eleaʒa â Itama rocjopawec.
Kora ere ŋokâfâc ine Asiri, Elikana â Abiasa iŋuc fuambiŋ. Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne Korare ɋâricfâc.
Aroŋte ŋokâ Eleaʒa e Putie otâfâcne jaŋeraonec moc ŋokac‐ticne bawec, eme eki Pinehasi rowec. Ŋic i jaŋe Lewire ɋâricfâc gaŋne gaŋne juwefumbiŋ jaŋere micnefâc.
Mose â Aroŋ jahe hâcne Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ŋohe Israe ŋic guru‐jeŋic sâc biric‐jopahuc Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopapire wahanʒepieŋ.”
Erâ Mose â Aroŋ jahezia Israe ŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopanicte Faraorao dâŋgie bapic.
Eme Wofuŋ e Aigita mâreŋko Mosehec dâŋ muc manac ehuc
ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac, irec no dâŋ sasawa gazakopac i Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Farao âzâcne‐fârezemec.”
Mosezi ine Wofuŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, no micnane ŋemâcne, irec Farao e dâŋnane wemocko moc manaocmu?”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec: “Manakic, no Faraore maio Anutu tinac âkendâŋguhape Aroŋzi porofetege juzejec.
Erâ dâŋ sasawa mutâcne‐garekopac i hahacge mufuacnetec eki Farao âzâcneme Israe ŋic râec‐jopame mâreŋ‐ticne beherâ ranʒepieŋ.
Â no nahac ine Farao maŋticne bâzickehuc Aigita mâreŋko wiac ʒâŋe furu â fuŋne qaqa mâsi bocjaha bapemu.
Eme Farao e ine sifu dâŋŋekic mi manaocmu. Irec no Aigita ŋic bomac‐jopahuc okacne ŋemâcne jarehuc Israe ŋic guru sâko Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐ŋopa rapemu.
Eme no tâpiri‐nanere fuŋne Aigita ŋic jaŋerao bataniŋkehuc ŋondeŋ‐jeŋickonec Israe ŋic jowac‐ŋopapemu dameŋ ira, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac, irec fuŋne mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Eme Mose â Aroŋ jahe Wofuŋzi dâŋ jasa mutâc ewec irec sâcko wiac epic hâcne.
Jahe Faraorao rarâ dâŋgie bapic dameŋ ira Mose e jara‐ticne 80, â Aroŋ eki ine 83 iŋuc bazupic.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose â Aroŋ ʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Farao e, ‘Dâŋŋekic dopeckehuc mâsi moc banic,’ iŋuc ŋasame Aroŋ âzâcnezemec, ‘Gunuge rorâ Faraore maio mâreŋko behetec homa ezejec!’”
Eme Mose â Aroŋ jahe Faraorao ferâ Wofuŋzi muwec sâc epic. Aroŋ e gunu‐ticne Farao â kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne jaŋere maio beheme homa ewec.
Eme Farao e mamana ŋic â qaŋgec bapa hefârec‐jopawec. Eme Aigita qaŋgec bapa jaŋe iŋuc jaha mâsi soŋne bapie ijaha fuawec.
Jaŋe ru sâc gunu‐jeŋic behepie homa efârembiŋ hâcne. Aroŋte gunuzi ine jaŋere gunu ɋâcjopa‐fârewec.
Faraore maŋzi ine râŋgeŋkeme mi mana‐jactewec, Wofuŋzi muwec iŋuc hâcne fuawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Farao e maŋsanaŋ erâ ŋic jaŋe raniŋte qatara‐jarekac.
Irec go tomâcko furicte Faraozi opâo raocte rahame gunuzi homa ewec i hâcne meo barâ Nilu opâ moŋgeŋnao bâfuacmurâ razemec.
Erâ âzâcnezemec, ‘Wofuŋ, Hebiraio ŋic nâŋere Anutu hâcne, e ʒiŋuc gazapemurâ gorao sorecnuwec: “Ŋicfâc‐nane mâreŋ tuhuo kiŋaŋ qanareniŋte râec‐jopatec ranʒepieŋ. Go ine dâŋ i moc mi reŋkehuc juekic.”
Irec Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, no gunu menaneo bakopac izi Nilu opâ qape soc eocmu.
Ehame Nilu opâo qowi hâmo‐fârepie Nilu opâ âsu fime Aigita ŋic jaŋe opâ nâzore mamakâc‐jopaocmu. Iŋuc fuame, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac, irec fuŋne mana tarazemec.” ’”
Erâ Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Aroŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnec, ‘Go gunuge rorâ Aigita mâreŋte opâ sasawa, opâ sâko mecne, opâwâc mecne, opâ ʒâkâŋ mecne, â opâ nombâŋ mecne irapec mege sicnetec opâzi soc efârezejec, ehuc Aigita mâreŋ sâko sâcke‐fârehuc opâ râqâc jâczi me qânâzi bakicne ira mâmâc fozejec.’”
Mose â Aroŋ jahe Wofuŋzi dâŋ mutâcne‐jactewec irec sâcko wiac epic. Ehuc Aroŋ e Farao â ŋicfâcne jaŋere maio gunu‐ticne bâfeŋnerâ Nilu opâ qame soc efârewec hâcne.
Eme Nilu opâo qowi jumbiŋ jaŋe hâmo‐fârepie opâ âsu fime Aigita ŋic jaŋe wemocko moc sâcne nanʒapiŋ. Ehame soczi Aigita mâreŋ sâckerâ fowec.
Aigita qaŋgec bapa jaŋe ine mâsi soŋne bahuc ijaha embiŋ. Irec Farao e maŋsanaŋ erâ Wofuŋzi qanaŋ muwec irec sâcko ehuc mi mana‐jactewec.
Ehuc râpec‐jofarâ ficticnao rawec, erâ wiac fuawec irec maname fârine mi ewec.
Aigita ŋic sasawa jaŋe ine opâ nâniŋte Nilu opâ heririŋnao opâ nombâŋ rombiŋ. Nilu opâonec nâniŋte mamakâc‐jopawec irec.
Wofuŋ e Nilu opâ qame wiac i fuarâ foha ʒoaŋ 7 tarawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Faraorao rarâ âzâcnec, ‘Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Go ŋicfâc‐nane râec‐jopatec ra kiŋaŋ qanarenʒepieŋ.
Me raniŋte qatara‐jarecmuo ine mupe qaqec fuarâ hae mâreŋge ŋefacke‐fâreniŋmu.
Erâ Nilu opâ fusucma sâqorehuc wefurâ ficgao ferâ guŋficko mecne fofogao mecne sâcke‐fârerâ raku kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge â ŋicfâcge jaŋere fic sasawa fusucma‐fâreniŋmu wâc. Erâ ʒafeo â oto gomba wiacko qaqec sasawa ŋeniŋmu.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, gahacne sahacko mecne, ŋicfâcge jaŋere sahacko mecne, kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge sasawa jaŋere sahacko mâmâc ferâ bohotaniŋmu.” ’”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Aroŋ âzâcnec, ‘Go gunuge bahuc mege bâfeŋnerâ opâ sâko â opâ hata â opâ ʒâkâŋ irapec sicnerâ mutec qaqec wefurâ Aigita mâreŋ ŋefacke‐fârenʒepieŋ.’”
Eme Aroŋzi meticne Aigita mâreŋte opâopec sicneme qaqaeczi wefurâ Aigita mâreŋ ŋefacke‐fârembiŋ.
Qaŋgec bapa jaŋe ine mâsi soŋne iŋuc jaha bapie qaqeczi Aigita mâreŋ sâcke‐fârembiŋ.
Iŋuc fuame Faraozi Mose â Aroŋ hefârec‐jofarâ ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ŋohe Anutu‐ŋekic numucnepire qaqec wiac no â ŋicfâc‐nane nâŋeraonec bârârieme no ŋoŋe râec‐ŋopape ra Anutu‐ŋeŋic bâzi rikecnenʒepieŋ.”
Mosezi Farao dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “No wezimucko go â kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge â ŋicfâcge ŋoŋere erâ numupe qaqec i gorao mecne â fic ŋerakac sâc ira mecne arictac ehapie Nilu opâo sawa foniŋmu, irec ʒâfo i go gahac banarec.”
Eki muwec: “Tomâcko.” Eme Mosezi muwec: “Mukomec iŋuc fuazejec. Fuame ine ʒiŋuc mana tarazemec: Wofuŋ, Anutu‐nâŋec e iŋucne moczi moc mi jukac.
Qaqec jaŋe gorao mecne, ficge ŋerakac ira mecne, kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge â ŋicfâcge jaŋerao mecne mâmâc arictac efârenʒepieŋ, mâc Nilu opâo sawa ine junʒepieŋ.”
Eme Mose â Aroŋ jahe Faraoraonec waharâ Mosezi Farao mupaŋkecnewec irec sâcko qaqec rârieniŋte Wofuŋ numucnewec.
Eme Wofuŋ e Mosezi numucnewec sâc manacnerâ mume qaqec ficko mecne, hae ʒoŋao mecne, gieo mecne hâmo‐fârembiŋ.
Eme ofaŋne guruc epie âsunezi hae mâreŋ sâcke‐fârewec.
Qaqec arictac eme honerâ Farao sahac‐ticne firieme mocwâc maŋsanaŋ erâ mi mana‐jactewec. Wofuŋzi qanaŋ muwec iŋuc hâcne ewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Aroŋ âzâcnetec gunu‐ticne bâfeŋnerâ mâreŋko rufe fokac i qazejec, eme Aigita mâreŋ sâkoo rufezi neŋgec efârezejec.”
Eme jahe iŋuc hâcne epic. Aroŋ e meticnezi gunu bawec i bâfeŋnerâ mâreŋko rufe fowec i qâiŋneme neŋgec qâŋhec fuarâ ŋic â qowi mâmâc nâcjopawec. Mâreŋko rufe fowec i sasawa neŋgec efârerâ Aigita mâreŋ sâcke‐fârewec hâcne.
Eme qaŋgec bapa jaŋe neŋgec jaha fuaocte qaŋgec bahuc bâipiembiŋ. Iŋuc epie neŋgeczi ŋic â qowi nâcjopawec hâcne.
Eme qaŋgec bapa jaŋe Farao âzâcnembiŋ: “Ʒi Anuture tâpiri jâmbâŋ.” Farao e ine maŋsanaŋ erâ mi mana‐jarewec. Wofuŋzi qanaŋ muwec iŋuc hâcne fuawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go tomâc furicte Faraozi opâo raocte rahame fuacnerâ âzâcnezemec, ‘Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Go ŋicfâc‐nane râec‐jopatec ra kiŋaŋ qanarenʒepieŋ.
Manakic, ŋicfâc‐nane mi râec‐jopacmuo mâkâc mimiŋ ejarepe go mecne, kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge mecne, ŋicfâcge mecne ŋoŋerao mâmâc fuaniŋmu. Ehuc Aigita ŋic ŋoŋere fic wiac mâkâczia fusucmaniŋmu â fic ŋerakac hae mâreŋ i mâmâc sâocke‐fâreniŋmu.
No ʒoaŋ ira ŋicfâc‐nane Goseŋ mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ jaŋerao ine mâkâc wiac moc mi fuaniŋte mupe, no hâcne mâreŋ ʒirec Wofuŋ jukopac i mana tarazemec.
Erâ nore ŋicfâc â gore ŋicfâc jaŋere ŋondeŋko aka moc âkendâŋnepemu. Ma i tomâcko hâcne fuazejec.” ’”
Eme Wofuŋ e iŋuc hâcne ewec. Irec mâkâc mimiŋzi Faraore fic, ŋicfâcne jaŋere fic â Aigita mâreŋ sasawa fusucma‐fârerâ mâreŋ sipiricke‐fârembiŋ.
Eme Faraozi Mose â Aroŋ jahe hefârec‐jofarâ jasawec: “Ajoc, ŋoŋe Anutu‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ ʒi jaha bâzi rikecneniŋ.”
Mosezi ine muwec: “Iŋuc misac, nâŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec bâzi rikecnepene Aigita ŋic jaŋe honepie mamakâcne eekac. Eme Aigita ŋic jaŋe bâzi‐nâŋecte manapie mamakâc eekac i mana‐bipiehuc sifu jaŋere maio rikehapene qânâzi mi hecnâponiŋmu me?
Nâŋe Wofuŋzi nâzâ mutâc ewec sâc mâreŋ tuhuo rakupene ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec bâzi rikecnepene sâckeocmu.”
Eme Faraozi muwec: “Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic bâzi rikecnezore mâreŋ tuhuo raniŋte sâcne mana‐ŋarepemu, mocjaha, ʒoricko boc mi ranʒepieŋ. Erâ wâc nore erâ numunʒepieŋ.”
Mosezi muwec: “No ʒi behecgu hurâ Wofuŋ numucnepe tomâcko mâkâc mimiŋ i gorao mecne, kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge â ŋicfâcge jaŋerao mâmâc omaezejec. Mocjaha, go eatuc‐nâpohuc ŋicguru jaŋe Wofuŋ bâzi rikecnezo raniŋte mupie mocwâc mi sakarec‐jopazemec.”
Mose e iŋuc muhuc Farao beherâ Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnewec.
Eme Wofuŋ e Mosere dâŋ manarâ mume mâkâc wiaczi Faraorao â kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne â ŋicfâcne jaŋerao omae‐jâmbâŋkerâ moc mi fohuŋgaŋkewec.
Faraozi ine dameŋ ira iŋuc jaha maŋne bâzickeme ŋic mi râec‐jopawec.
Iŋuc fuame Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Faraorao ferâ âzâcnec, ‘Hebiraio ŋic nâŋere Anutu, Wofuŋ hâcne, e dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe kiŋaŋ qanareniŋte râec‐jopatec ranʒepieŋ.
Manakic, dâŋnane qatararâ sakarec‐jopahuc râec‐jopatecne mi raniŋmuo
ine Wofuŋ nore tâpiri mesanaŋzi qowifâcge gieo juraŋgopieŋ, becâsic mecne, doŋgi mecne, kamele mecne, lama bulimakao mecne jopame qowi hâmoc fua‐fâreocmu.
Ehame Wofuŋ noni Israe ŋic jaŋere qowi wiac â Aigita ŋic jaŋere qowi wiac i bâtâc bacjopape Israe ŋic jaŋere qowi moc mi sipirickeocmu.” ’”
Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc muhuc dameŋ bawec wâc: “No tomâcko mâreŋ ʒira iŋuc hâcne epemu.”
Eme hae fureme Wofuŋzi iŋuc hâcne ewec. Ehame Aigita ŋic jaŋere qowi wiac hâmo‐fârehapie Israe ŋic jaŋere qowi wiac ine moc mi hâmombiŋ.
Eme Faraozi fuŋne mana‐hâmoocte kiŋaŋ râeme rame mi ʒiŋuc taniŋkezejec i: Israe ŋic jaŋere qowi moc mi hâmombiŋ. Ehame Farao e ine sifu maŋsanaŋ ehuc ŋic mi râec‐jopawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose â Aroŋ ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ŋohe meŋekiczi ʒocmâsic me fufusuc rozepirec eme Mosezi Faraore maio sawao wickezejec.
Eme ʒocmâsiczi iiŋnehuc rufe erâ Aigita mâreŋ sâcke‐fâreme ŋic sahacko mecne, qowi sahacko mecne wicʒâhâc fuarâ fâuckezejec. Aigita mâreŋ sâkoo wiac iŋuc hâcne fuazejec.”
Eme jahe ʒocmâsic rorâ Faraore maio fuarâ domahuc Mosezi sawao wickeme feme ŋic sahacko â qowi sahacko wicʒâhâc fuarâ fâuckewec.
Eme Aigita ŋic wicʒâhâc fua‐jare‐fârewec iŋuc jaha qaŋgec bapa jaŋerao fuame jaŋe Mosere maio fuarâ domaniŋte quŋkembiŋ.
Wofuŋzi ine Faraore maŋ bârâŋgeŋkeme mi mana‐jactewec, Wofuŋzi qanaŋ Mose âzâcnewec sâc fuawec hâcne.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Tomâcko uupictea faharerâ Faraorao rarâ âzâcnezemec, ‘Hebiraio ŋic nâŋere Anutu, Wofuŋ hâcne, eki dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋicfâc‐nane kiŋaŋ qanareniŋte râec‐jopatec ranʒepieŋ.
No dameŋ ʒi hâcne go â wiacfâcge â ŋic gurufâcge wiac hâhâwicne jâmbâŋ eŋarepe ʒiŋuc mana tarazemec: ‘Mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ ira Anutu iŋucne moc mi jujâmbâŋkekac.’
No biac juwicnao menane sicnerâ go â ŋic gurufâcge iroŋzi qâmiziec‐ŋopazo murâ sâcne ezapo, eme go arictac enʒaŋ.
No ine tâpiri‐nanere fuŋne gowatupemurâ â ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane mâreŋ sâc muromackepie haŋ baocmurâ akicgupo.
Goki ine gahacne manatec feha ŋicfâc‐nane râec‐jopatec raniŋte mupe qatarakomecte
no tomâcko dameŋ ʒiŋucne hoe sanaŋ hâhâwicne, Aigita mâreŋ fuŋnaonecteaŋ fuarâ fowefuwecko moc mi hejujec, iŋucne moc mupe heocmu.
Irec kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopatec rarâ bulimakao â qowifâcge sasawa gieo juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe qâzuc‐jopapie ficko fefârenʒepieŋ; ŋic mecne, qowi mecne ficko mi fehuc gieoa juniŋmu jaŋe ʒeŋgoma hoezi hecjopame hâmo‐fâreniŋmu hâcne.” ’”
Eme Faraore ŋicfâc tucne jaŋe Wofuŋ dâŋticnere hâwic‐jopame kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic â qowifâc‐jeŋic ejarepie ficko fefârembiŋ.
Â mi hâwic‐jopawec jaŋe ine kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic â qowifâc‐jeŋic gieoa behec‐jopapie jumbiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mege sambâŋkopec sicnetec Aigita mâreŋ sâkoo hoe sanaŋ hehuc ŋic mecne, qowi mecne jâckâte mecne â nânâ monʒaŋ mecne Aigita mâreŋko forakac sasawa hecjopazejec.”
Eme Mose e gunu‐ticne sambâŋkopec bâfeŋneme Wofuŋte micte ɋuŋ parandaŋ â hoe sanaŋ â ʒocbâruŋ sambâŋkonec mâreŋko wahawec. Ehame Wofuŋzia mume Aigita mâreŋko hoe sanaŋ hewec.
Hoe sanaŋ â bâbâric hâhâwicne jâmbâŋ ʒuʒuhuc jaha wahahuc fowec, wiac iŋucne Aigita mâreŋ sâkoo ŋic fuarâ juwefumbiŋko moc mi fuarâ fowec.
Eme hoe sanaŋ izi Aigita mâreŋ sâkoo ŋic mecne, qowi mecne, gieo jurambiŋ jaŋe hehâmoc‐jopa‐fârewec erâ nânâ monʒaŋ â jâc wiac gieo doma rawec i wâc iŋuc jaha henʒaŋ qanʒaŋne‐fârewec.
Mâc Goseŋ mâreŋko, Israe ŋic jumbiŋ ira sawa hoe sanaŋ mi hewec.
Iŋuc fuame Faraozi kiŋaŋ soreme ra Mose â Aroŋ hefârec‐jofame rapire dâŋ ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ʒi kiŋnane hone manac ekopac, Wofuŋ e tiŋne jâmbâŋ, no â ŋicfâc‐nane nâŋe ine hehesicne.
Irec ŋohe nore erâ Wofuŋ numucnenic, ɋuŋ parandaŋ â hoe sanaŋ izi siric‐nâpokac hâcne. No râec‐ŋopape ranʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe ʒira ʒuhuckerâ mi junʒepieŋ.”
Mosezi ine dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “No hae beherâ menane sicnepe Wofuŋtao feme ɋuŋ parandaŋ â hoe sanaŋ tâcneme ʒiŋuc mana tarazemec: Mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ i Wofuŋte biŋe.
No ine go â ŋicfâcge ŋoŋere fuŋne manakopac, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anuture sifu mi hâwic‐ŋopakac.”
Bundajâc â padi imacke‐fârekicne, padi i biac fârinehec domawecte â bundajâc i ârine qawecte.
Waizeŋ â wiac iŋucne tinac ine ʒâhec sawa ârickerâ fârine râeekacte hoe sanaŋzi mi imackewec.
Eme Mose e Farao beherâ haeonec hurâ meticne Wofuŋtao sicneme ɋuŋ parandaŋ â hoe sanaŋ omaepire mâreŋko hoe mocwâc mi hewec.
Eme Farao e ɋuŋ parandaŋ â hoe sanaŋ omaeme honerâ izia e jahacne mecne â ŋicfâcne mecne sâqocne‐jeŋic basanaŋkepie maŋjeŋic ʒicke sanaŋkewec.
Eme Farao e maŋsanaŋ erâ Israe ŋic mi râec‐jopawec. Wofuŋzi qanaŋ Mose âzâcnewec iŋuc hâcne fuawec.
Iŋuc fuame Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Faraorao fezemec. No nahac hâcne fuŋne qaqa mâsi‐nane ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko bapemurâ e â ŋicfâcne jaŋe ejarepe maŋjeŋic sanaŋkewec.
Eme no Aigita ŋic maŋ bâsifuc ejarehuc fuŋne qaqa mâsi bakopac irec binaŋ naru motecfâcge â ŋosafâcge bajaretec, no Wofuŋ jukopac, irec fuŋne ʒâŋitanʒepieŋ.”
Eme Mose â Aroŋ jahe Faraorao ferâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnepic: “Wofuŋ, Hebiraio ŋic nâŋere Anutu, e ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Go nore maio rumehuc juju i wemocte boc qikiŋnekomec? Go ŋicfâc‐nane nore kiŋaŋ qaniŋte râec‐jopatec raniŋ.
Manakic, go ŋicfâc‐nane raniŋte mi mana‐jarecmuo ine tomâcko mupe hâpiczi fuarâ hae mâreŋge sâcke‐fâreniŋmu.
Erâ mâreŋ sâockerâ, hoe sanaŋzi wiac gâcne akickewec i hâcne nâ miziehuc gie‐jeŋicko jâc wiac doma rakac i mâmâc nâ imac epie garaŋ garaŋne domazejec.
Erâ go gahacne fic mecne, kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge jaŋere fic mecne â Aigita ŋic sasawa jaŋere fic mecne i mâmâc fusucma‐fârenʒepieŋ. Wiac iŋucne i mamac ŋosafâcge jaŋe mâreŋko fua wefumbiŋkonecteaŋ moc mi honehuc jumbiŋ.’” Iŋuc muhuc fotikierâ Farao beherâ rawec.
Eme Faraore kiŋaŋ qaqa jaŋe e ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ŋic sipiric‐nâpoocte doc sipuac enâreku mo dameŋko moc behec‐nâpoocmu? Go ŋic jaŋe râec‐jopatec ra Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋic kiŋaŋ qacnenʒepieŋ. Aigita mâreŋ biac ima bakicne i go mi manakic me?”
Iŋuc mupie mume Mose â Aroŋ jahe Faraorao risiepire ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ŋoŋe raniŋ, erâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic kiŋaŋ qacneniŋ. Mâc mozia raniŋmu?”
Mosezi muwec: “Nâŋe kâcɋene piticne, ŋokac naru motecfâc‐nâŋec, bulimakao â qowifâc‐nâŋec i mâmâc jowac‐jopa ranaŋmu. Nâŋe Wofuŋ‐nâŋecte hombaŋ ŋenaŋte munârekicne hâcne.”
Eki ine jasawec: “No ŋoŋe â ŋokac motecfâc‐ŋeŋic râec‐ŋopape ra wiac moc eniŋmuo ine Wofuŋzi ŋoŋehec juzo murâ juzejec. Ŋoŋe wiac hehesicne eniŋte maŋkerâ juŋgopieŋ i tâtâc fokac i!
Mâcne, ŋiczi sawa ra Wofuŋte kiŋaŋ qanʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe iŋuc hâcne eniŋte muŋgopieŋ.” Iŋuc murâ mume Faraore maionec jâpec‐jofapie rapic.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go mege Aigita mâreŋkopec sicnetec hâpic jaŋe ware Aigita mâreŋ ŋefacke‐fârerâ wiac rehacnehec, hoe sanaŋzi akickewec fokac i nâpie omae‐fârezejec.”
Eme Mose e gunu‐ticne Aigita mâreŋkopec bâfeŋnewec. Eme Wofuŋzi mume ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec mâŋâŋ sâkozi ware ŋafe ʒoaŋ qahuc fowec. Eme hae fureme mâŋâŋ izi hâcne hâpic ficne suec‐jopame warembiŋ.
Erâ hâpic guru hâhâwicne jâmbâŋzi Aigita mâreŋ sâko sâckerâ ŋefacke‐fârembiŋ. Hâpic guru iŋucne sâko dameŋ juwicnao moc mi fisi jumbieŋ erâ wâc juku mocwâc mi fisinʒoŋgopieŋ.
Eme mâreŋ sasawa ŋefacke‐fârepie dapâc ewec. Ehame hoe sanaŋzi mâreŋko wiac rehacnehec â jâchândâŋ akickewec i nâmiziembiŋ. Irec Aigita mâreŋ sâkoo jâc mecne, wiac gâcne gieo doma rawec i mecne rehacnehec mocwâc mi domawec.
Iŋuc fuame Farao e Mose â Aroŋ bâruŋ jaha hefârec‐jofarâ jasawec: “No Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic sindaŋ ecnehuc ŋoŋe mâmâc eŋarepo.
Irec ʒi sâqocne‐nane mocwâc bâtâmire‐narenicmurâ numu‐ŋactepe ŋohe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋekic wira wâwâsic ecnepire sisipiric keci mume arictac ezejec.”
Eme Mose e Farao beherâ Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec mâŋâŋ i herisieme ʒoaŋ huhunaonec mâŋâŋ sanaŋ warewec. Mâŋâŋ izi ine hâpic ficne suec‐jopame Hâwec Bâbâroŋko hufârepie Aigita mâreŋko hâpiczi omaewec.
Wofuŋzi ine Farao ecneme maŋsanaŋ erâ Israe ŋic mi râec‐jopawec.
Iŋuc fuame Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go mege sambâŋkopec sicnetec Aigita mâreŋ sâkoo dapâc qisiric jâmbâŋ fuazejec.”
Eme Mose e meticne sambâŋkopec sicneme Aigita mâreŋ sâkoo dapâc qisiric fuarâ ʒoaŋ jahec â moc foha
ŋiczi hohonec eniŋte eipiembiŋ, ehuc fic hae‐jeŋic moc mi bebehe mâc fohapie ʒoaŋ jahec â moc tarawec. Israe ŋic jaŋere fic hae ine tatamac jaha foha jumbiŋ.
Iŋuc fuame Faraozi Mose hefârerâ muwec: “Ŋoŋe Anutu ra kiŋaŋ qacneniŋ, mâc qowi â bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic ine hae mâreŋ ʒira behec‐jopapie junʒepieŋ. Ŋokac naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ine ŋoŋehec sâcne raniŋmu.”
Mosezi ine muwec: “Aricne, go bâzi ririkere â qowi bâzire wâcwiac nâretecne Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec bâzi rikecnenʒepeneŋ.
Qowi â bulimakao wiac‐nâŋec i mâmâc ame susuc‐jopahuc huŋgaŋne mac moc mi behepene juzejec. Nâŋe irecnec hâcne gâcne bâwosâerâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec bâzi rikecnehuc kiŋaŋ qacnenaŋmu. Nâŋe bâzi weniŋucne Wofuŋ rikecnenaŋmu i biac mi manaŋgopeneŋ, raku ocna fisirâ ine mananaŋmu.”
Wofuŋzi ine Faraore maŋ bârâŋgeŋkeme râec‐jopaocte mi ecnewec.
Eme Faraozi Mose âzâcnewec: “Go behecnurâ rac, erâ mocwâc maicnuzicte tukige rozemec. Go mocwâc maicnutec izia qâhâmocgupemu.”
Mosizi muwec: “Mukomec iŋuc, no ʒâŋe maige mocwâc mi honepemu.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wiac hâhâwicne sâko mocjaha fokac i mupe Faraorao â Aigita mâreŋko fuazejec. Fuame râec‐ŋopame ʒirecnec sâcne raniŋmu, erâ mâteŋne mi sorec‐ŋopaocmu, fâro bahuc hae nânâ jâpec‐ŋopame raniŋmu hâcne.
Irec go ʒiŋuczia ŋic ŋokac jazatec jaŋe ru sâc diguracfâc‐jeŋic eri wiac siliwa â golzi bakicne irec numu‐jarepie jarenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋ e Aigita ŋic bufahac qajareme mana‐jarembiŋ. Eme Israe ŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biŋe i Wofuŋte erâ Aigita ŋic jaŋerao boc haŋ bawec. Erâ i sawa mâcne, Mosere ʒâŋe biŋe i iŋuc jaha Aigita mâreŋko boc fewec, Farao ŋicfâcne jaŋere maio mecne erâ ŋic ŋokac sâko jaŋere maio mâmâc.
Eme Mosezi muwec: “Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘No ŋafe ʒâŋiŋko waharâ Aigita mâreŋ fotâcne rahape
Aigita mâreŋko mârâc motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ʒeŋgoma hâmo‐fârenʒepieŋ. Farao mârâc ŋokâ‐ticne, juku tucticne qaocte mukicne, erao fuŋkerâ raku kiŋaŋ naru padi masiŋko banʒaŋnehuc ŋekac ere mârâc ŋokâ erao taraocmu. Erâ i sawa mâcne, lama bulimakao ŋicne mârâc fufua jaŋe iŋuc jaha hâmo‐fâreniŋmu.
Ehame kio owa sâkozi Aigita mâreŋ sâko sâcke‐fâreocmu. Kio owa sâko iŋucne juwicnao moc mi fuarâ fowec erâ wâc juku mocwâc mi fuaocmu.
Ehame Israe ŋic jaŋerao qâto moczi, ŋic me qowi moc mi qâŋke‐jarezejec. I kecʒiŋuc mana taraniŋte: Wofuŋ e Aigita ŋic â Israe ŋic bâtâc bacjopakac.
Iŋuc fuame kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge ʒi jaŋe sasawa norao fuarâ fodape‐narehuc ʒiŋuc muniŋmu, “Go â ŋicfâcge bâjâpecguŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe sasawa rafârenʒepieŋ.” Iŋuc nazapie rapemu.’” Mose e iŋuc murâ bune ʒâʒâficne qame Farao beherâ rawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No Aigita mâreŋko mâsi bocjaha barâ ba ezo mupe Faraozi mi mana‐ŋareocmu.”
Mose â Aroŋ jahe Faraore maio mâsi i sasawa bafârepic, eme Wofuŋ e sifu Farao ecneme maŋsanaŋ erâ Israe ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ‐ticne beherâ raniŋte mi mana‐jarewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Aigita mâreŋko Mose â Aroŋ ʒiŋuc mupaŋke‐jactewec:
“Ŋoŋe mosa kecʒirec manapie fufuŋke mosa ezejec. Jara sâc mosa ʒizi gâcne sasawa bânie‐jarezejec.
Erâ Israe kikefuŋ mâmâc sâko sâcmutâc ʒiŋuc ejarenic: Mosa kecʒirec gie bapa namba 10 ira ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe ŋokac naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere lama motec wâŋ wâŋ ronʒepieŋ, moc e garikiŋfâc‐ticne jaŋere lama wâŋ, moc e wâŋ, iŋuczi iŋuc.
Â fic mocko ŋic ŋokac naru motec afecne juniŋmu, lama motecne mi nânâ‐fârene, ine fic jajahec, didigurac ŋekopireczi lama motec mocjahare turezepirec. Ŋic ŋokac naru motec hobu‐jeŋicte sâc manahuc fic wezimuc lama mocte biŋe musanaŋkezo.
Erâ lama motec ŋicne sahac furu, jara‐jeŋic wâŋ, iŋucne sawa rocjopazo, lama motec me noniŋ motec.
Baʒawiec‐joparâ bacjopa juhapie mosare gie bapa namba 14 ehame hae owâeme Israe kikefuŋ guru mâmâc sâko lama motec serec jaha hezuc‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Erâ socjeŋic gâcne rorâ izi, fic maŋnao ŋehuc nâniŋmu, fic irec motâcte wâtuŋ ŋifec â ŋifec erâ jâc otecne faic rikenʒepieŋ.
A biucne ŋafe ijaha ʒegoc ʒame nânʒepieŋ. Poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric erâ wâc rehac hâtâne ihec nânʒepieŋ.
Qowi i ɋâricne me opâ sicko ʒakicne mâcne, ʒegoc sasawa rikerâ nânʒepieŋ, ine qizecne â me kikene â fâri ombâŋne furu foha ʒame nâzo.
Â tiwâne ine moc mi ŋeha hae furezejec; moc ŋeha hae fureocmuo ine ʒocko râepie ʒâtâmirezejec.
Erâ kecʒiŋuc ehuc nânʒepieŋ: Umbika‐ŋeŋic jomarâ, kikehuhu‐ŋeŋic hepie huha, gunu‐ŋeŋic baŋehuc fârohec nânʒepieŋ. Fuŋne ʒiŋucte: Wofuŋzi akic‐ŋopahuc ŋowaruocmu.
No ŋafe ijaha Aigita mâreŋ fotâcnehuc mârâc fufuafâc‐jeŋic, ŋic mecne qowi mecne, jopa‐fârepemu, â Aigita nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao okac babazu gie bapemu, Wofuŋ noni hâcne.
Soczi fic juŋgopieŋko maŋeŋic ezejec, soc i honerâ ŋowarupemu, eme Aigita mâreŋko ima sâko bâfuahape ŋoŋerao wiac hâhâwicne moc mi fuahuc sipiric‐ŋopazejec.
“Eme ʒoaŋ izi hombaŋ‐ŋeŋic ezejec, i jara sâc ŋehuctecne Wofuŋzi wiac ewec irec manasuhuc junʒepieŋ; mimiŋzi ɋâric mâsi i basanaŋkerâ bajupie hata sanaŋ foŋarezejec.
Ŋoŋe poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric nâhuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec. Gie bapa namba wâŋ ira goreŋ ficŋeŋickonec bârârienʒepieŋ. Eme moc e poroŋ goreŋhec nâocmu e Israe guruonec tuŋkepie huzejec. Dâŋ izi gie bapa wâŋkonec sâcmutâc‐ŋeŋic foraku 7‐ko tarazejec.
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa wâŋ ira tutumaŋ tirine moc enʒepieŋ, erâ ʒoaŋ namba 7 ira tutumaŋ iŋucnea mocwâc fuazejec. Gie bapa jajahec mukicne ira gie moc mi banʒepieŋ, mâc ŋiczi nânâ nâniŋmu sâc i sawa rike bâmoc enʒepieŋ.
Erâ goreŋ sowa jujure sâcmutâc i mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ. No ʒoaŋ ira hâcne ŋic ŋokac naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec batarac‐ŋopapo. Irec ŋoŋe mimiŋzi ɋâric gie bapa irec manasurâ mâsi i basanaŋkerâ bajupie hata sanaŋ foŋarezejec.
Fufuŋke mosa irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 14 owâcne fuŋkerâ goreŋ sowa jufeku ʒoaŋ namba 21 owâcnea behenʒepieŋ.
Ficŋeŋicko goreŋ moc mi ŋeha ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec, irec jaba me mâreŋ rune moc e poroŋ goreŋhec nâocmu, e tuŋkepie Israe kikefuŋ râpenao huzejec.
Wiac goreŋnehec moc mi nânâ ficŋeŋic sâc goreŋ sowa jufârenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Mose e Israe ŋic micnefâc‐jeŋic hetumaŋ‐jopa‐fârerâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ra garikiŋfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere sâc manahuc lama bâwosâec‐joparâ aakic lama qa hezuc enʒepieŋ.
Erâ soroqec rehacne rorâ soc otoo fokac ira âke uruckerâ izi motâcte wâtuŋ ŋifec â ŋifec â otecne faic rikenʒepieŋ. Erâ ŋoŋeraonec moczi moc hae mi fureha fickonec mi wahazejec.
Wofuŋ e Aigita ŋic jopaocte mâreŋ fotâcne raocmu hâcne. Ehuc jâc otecne faic â motâcte wâtuŋ jajahec ira soc honerâ motâc jâuruhuc ima bapa aŋelo aka hecneme ŋopaocte ficŋeŋicko mi feocmu.
Ŋaŋacne â ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic ŋoŋe mâsi i basanaŋkerâ bajupie hata sanaŋ foŋarezejec.
Eme Wofuŋzi mâreŋ biŋe qaŋarewec i ŋareme raʒirâ hata i hâcne âtehuc junʒepieŋ.
Eme naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe, ‘I fuŋne weniŋucte eeŋgopieŋ?’ iŋuc wio‐ŋarepie
ʒiŋuc jazanʒepieŋ: ‘I Wofuŋte aakic tiwâ bâzi. Eki hâcne Aigita ŋic jopahuc Israe ŋic Aigita mâreŋko jumbiŋ, jaŋere fic jowaruhuc akic‐jopawec.’” Iŋuc mume ŋic ŋokac jaŋe manarâ fodapehuc numumbiŋ.
Erâ Israe ŋicguru jaŋe ra iŋuc embiŋ; Wofuŋzi Mose â Aroŋ mujactewec irec sâcko embiŋ hâcne.
Eme ŋafe ʒâŋiŋko Wofuŋzi Aigita mâreŋko mârâc fufua sasawa jopa‐fârewec. Faraore mârâc ŋokâ, juku tucticne qaocte mukicne, erao hâcne fuŋkerâ jopa raku kâpâcwâru ŋic jaŋere mârâc ŋokâfâc jaŋerao jopa tarawec, erâ qowi sasawa jaŋerao sâc ijaha ewec.
Iŋuc eme Farao â kiŋaŋŋicfâcne erâ Aigita ŋic sasawa jaŋe ŋafeo faharerâ kio owa sâko epie Aigita mâreŋ sâcke‐fârewec. I fic sasawa ira qâŋɋâŋ fua‐fârewecte iŋuc fuawec.
Eme Faraozi ŋafeoa Mose â Aroŋ hefârec‐jofarâ muwec: “Ajoc, ŋohe mecne Israe ŋicguru mecne, ŋoŋe fahare ŋicfâc‐nane behec‐joparâ raniŋ; ehuc mumbiŋ irec sâcko ra Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacneniŋ.
Erâ lama bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic mâmâc amec‐jopa raniŋ; eme nunumu‐ŋeŋicte fârine i norao fotâcnezejec wâc!”
Eme Aigita ŋic jaŋe Israe ŋicguru ʒiŋuc muhuctecne mâreŋ‐jeŋic beheniŋte fâro boc ejarembiŋ: “Nâŋe hâmocte biŋe efâreŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme Israe ŋicguru jaŋe poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric mi ʒakicne, ɋâricne foha otohec rorâ ŋaqi‐jeŋiczi foŋkerâ ɋawe‐jeŋicko herâ rambiŋ.
Erâ Mosezi moc mutâcne‐jarewec i wâc iŋuc jaha embiŋ: Eri wiac siliwa â golzi bakicne â ŋaqi wiac irec Aigita ŋic numu‐jarembiŋ hâcne.
Eme Wofuŋzi Aigita ŋic ejareme jaŋe Israe ŋicguru âgo ejarehuc mana urue‐jarerâ wiac numu‐jarembiŋ sâc jare‐fârembiŋ. Iŋuc ehuc Aigita ŋic jaŋere wiac jowac rombiŋ hâcne.
Eme Israe ŋicguru jaŋe Ramasesi hae beherâ Sukoti haeo rambiŋ. Kikezi rambiŋ ŋic i jaŋere ʒare 600 tauseŋ qâririŋ, ŋokac naru motec ine mi wosec‐jopakicne.
Erâ ŋic jaba bocjahazi jaŋehec mâmâc rambiŋ, erâ lama bulimakao guru sâko jaha.
Eme Aigita mâreŋkonec poroŋ ɋâricne barambiŋ i goreŋ tâmiric rike nâc embiŋ. Jaŋe Aigita mâreŋ beheniŋte fâro ejarehuc bâsuec‐jopambiŋte dameŋ basahuc poroŋ goreŋhec mi bâsifuckembiŋ hâcne. Ehuc hatare nâsiŋ gâcne wâc mi barambiŋ.
Israe ŋicguru jaŋe Aigita mâreŋko juwefukuhapie jara 430 tarawec.
Eme jara 430 tarawec ʒoaŋ ira jâmbâŋ Wofuŋte ŋicfâc guru sâko jaŋe Aigita mâreŋ beherâ rambiŋ hâcne.
Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa rawec, ŋafe i guŋɋâri juju ŋafe hâcne. Eme Israe ŋicguru jaŋe mimiŋzi ɋâric ŋafe i hâcne Wofuŋte erâ guŋɋâri jaha jumbiŋzi jueŋgopieŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose â Aroŋ ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Aakic hombaŋte hata sanaŋ ʒiŋuc fozejec: Jabazi aakic lama moc mi nâjâmbâŋkezejec.
Kiŋaŋ qaqa moneŋzi furi bacjopakicne jaŋe ine sahac‐jeŋicko ma bajarepie sâcne nâniŋmu.
Kiŋaŋ qaqa omane me mâc qâtec‐ŋoparâ juocmu, iŋucnezi ine aakic lama moc mi nâzejec.
Aakic lama i fic mocjahao turerâ nânʒepieŋ, ehuc fickonec tiwâne mac moc mi bawahanʒepieŋ, â aakic lamare siec wiac moc mi qazunʒepieŋ.
Dâŋ i Israe kikefuŋ mâmâc sâkozi reŋke‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Ŋic jabane moczi ŋoŋehec juhuc aakic lama nâzo mume ine e jahacne sahacko mecne, ŋic â motecfâc‐ticne jaŋere sahacko mecne ma bapie sâcne nâocmu, eme e ŋoŋe iŋucne mâreŋ rune jaha erâ juzejec. Sahacnao ma mi bakicnezi ine mi nâzejec.
Mâreŋ rune â ŋic jabane ŋoŋehec jueŋgopieŋ ŋoŋere sâcmutâc mocjaha fozejec.”
Eme Israe ŋicguru jaŋe ʒeŋgoma iŋuc embiŋ, Wofuŋzi Mose â Aroŋ mutâcne‐jactewec irec sâcko embiŋ hâcne.
Eme Wofuŋ e Israe ŋic gurune gurune ʒoaŋ ira hâcne Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopame wahambiŋ.
Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Mârâc fufua ʒeŋgoma nore biŋe qahuc bâwosâec‐jopapie junʒepieŋ. Israe ŋondeŋko ŋic me qowi neŋgoc bumaŋkonec bâbâni fuaocmu izi hâcne nore biŋe ezejec.”
Eme Mosezi kecʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ ʒi Aigita kâpâcwâru fickonec wahambiŋ irec manasuhuc junʒepieŋ, Wofuŋ e mesanaŋ‐ticnezi irecnec jowac‐ŋopame wahambiŋ hâcne. Irec ŋoŋe poroŋ goreŋhec moc mi nânʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe miŋecgac, fufuŋke mosa April hâcne ira waha raŋgopieŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ e mâreŋ moc, susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeekac, erâ ŋoŋe ŋareocte mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic mupaŋke‐jarewec, Kanaaŋ ŋic, Hitiŋic, Amori ŋic, Hiwiŋic â Jebusi ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ hâcne, ira râec‐ŋopame mosa ʒi hâcne mâsi ʒiŋuc basanaŋkepie hata sanaŋ foŋarezejec.
Ŋoŋe goreŋ sowa juhapie gie bapa 7 tarazejec, eme ʒoaŋ namba 7 ira Wofuŋte hombaŋ fuazejec.
Poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric i nâhuc juhapie gie bapa 7 tarazejec. Wiac goreŋhec ŋoŋerao moc mi bâfuazo, â hae mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko, goreŋ wiac moc mi bajunʒepieŋ.
Ehame gie bapa ira ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic ʒiŋuc jazanʒepieŋ: ‘I Wofuŋzi Aigita mâreŋkonec wahahapene ehâmo‐nârewecte iŋuc fuakac.’
Eme eebapa irec nikec‐ŋopazacte meŋeŋicko â ʒâŋe mai‐ŋeŋicko ma bapie muzac sâckezac, erâ iŋuc mâcne, Wofuŋte sâcmutâc dâŋzi micŋeŋicko fozejec. Wofuŋ e mesanaŋ‐ticnezi Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐ŋopame wahambiŋ irec.
Hata sanaŋ i hâcne jara sâc dameŋ‐ticnao âte rahuc junʒepieŋ.
“Eme Wofuŋ e ŋoŋe â apa ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic mupaŋke‐ŋarewec irec sâcko Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko râec‐ŋopahuc mâreŋ ŋareme
ŋoŋe neŋgoc bumaŋkonec mârâc fufua sasawa Wofuŋte biŋe qanʒepieŋ; bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere mârâc fufua ŋicne sasawa i Wofuŋte biŋe jaha.
Doŋgi jaŋere mârâc fufua sasawa irec okacne ine lama motecne râezo murâ ine upene qâpirickenʒepieŋ. Ŋic jaŋere mârâc fufua sasawa irec okacne lama motecne râenʒepieŋ.
Eme juku ʒâhec ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic ʒiŋuc wio‐ŋareŋimu: ‘Wiac i fuŋne weniŋucte eeŋgopieŋ?’ Eme ʒiŋuc jazanʒepieŋ: ‘Wofuŋ e mesanaŋ‐ticnezi Aigita kâpâcwâru fickonec batarac‐nâporâ jowac‐nâpome wahambeŋ.
Farao e râec‐nâpoocte maŋsanaŋ erâ qikiŋnewecte Wofuŋzi Aigita mâreŋko mârâc fufua sasawa, ŋicte mecne qowire mecne qâhâmoc‐jopa‐fârewec. Eme irec hâcne neŋgoc bumaŋkonec mârâc fufua sasawa i Wofuŋte bâzi rikeeŋgopeneŋ. Mârâc ŋokâfâc‐nâŋec jaŋere kiwiric ine roeŋgopeneŋ.’
Wofuŋ e mesanaŋ‐ticnezi Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐nâpome wahambeŋte mâsi izi ma iŋucne erâ megao â ʒâŋe maigao fozejec.”
Eme Farao e ŋic ŋokac râec‐jopame Anutuzi ʒiŋuc muhuctecne hata bembeŋne Filisa mâreŋkopec fowec, ira mi jowac‐jopawec: “Hatao ʒika wiac moc fua‐jareme maŋjeŋic risieme Aigita mâreŋko risienʒipiŋkohec.”
Anutu e iŋuc murâ ine ŋic ŋokac bârisiec‐jopame mâreŋ tuhuo Hâwec Bâbâroŋkopec rambiŋ. Israe ŋicguru jaŋe momori ŋiczi birio raeŋgopieŋ irec sâcko Aigita mâreŋkonec waha rambiŋ hâcne.
Eme Mose e Josefere siec mâmâc barâ rawec, i Josefezi Israe ŋicguru jaŋe ʒiŋuc mupaŋkecneniŋte ejarewec irec: “Anutuzi iqic‐ŋopazokac dameŋ ira siec‐nane barâ ranʒepieŋ.”
Eme jaŋe Sukoti haeonec fahare raku Etamko tuhu mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao hâcne ira toma âterâ fombiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ e jowac‐jopaocte ʒoaŋko karorac ɋâfoŋne maŋnao bâjuŋ‐jopahuc juwec â ŋafeo ine ʒocbâruŋ maŋnao juhuc tamae‐jarewec. Jaŋe ʒoaŋko â ŋafeo hata honehuc raniŋte iŋuc ejarewec.
Eme ʒoaŋko karorac â ŋafeo ʒoc izi mi bebehec‐jopa ŋic bânie‐jarehuc jaha juwec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋicguru jaŋe risierâ Migidoli ficsanaŋ â hâwec irec ŋondeŋko Pi‐Hahiroti hae maickehuc toma âterâ fonʒepieŋ.
Farao eki Israe ŋicguru jaŋere ʒiŋuc muocmu hâcne: ‘Mâreŋ burocnezi râreŋ bârâreŋ fokacte jaŋe kosa qac qâsoric ehuc juŋgopieŋ.’
Eme no Faraore maŋ bâzickepe kikeo kikeo eŋarezejec, ehame no Farao â momori gurufâc‐ticne jaŋerao tâpiri‐nanere fuŋne bataniŋkezepac. No hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac, jaŋe i mana taranʒepieŋ.” Eme jaŋe iŋuc embiŋ.
Ŋic ŋokac wiserâ rambiŋ, Aigita ŋicwofuŋ biŋe iŋuc âzâcnepie manarâ e jahacne mecne, ŋicfâcne jaŋe mecne fâfârerâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Nâŋâc wemocte mutuc erâ Israe ŋic jaŋe kiŋaŋ qanârembiŋkonec râec‐jopapene rambiŋ?”
Iŋuc murâ ʒika keretac‐ticne mume wareme momorifâcne rocjopawec.
Keretac bâwosâec‐jopakicne 600 erâ keretac gâcne gâcne Aigita mâreŋko bajumbiŋ sâc i mâmâc rofârewec wâc. Keretac fainao ine ru sâc momori ŋic bâwosâec‐jopakicne râec‐jopame ŋembiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋicguru jaŋe momori hawari birio rahapie Wofuŋzi Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Farao maŋne bâzickeme bâjâpec‐jopa rawec.
Aigita ŋic, Farao becâsicfâcne â keretac wiac â becâsicko rara ŋic â momori, iŋuczi bâjâpec‐jopa raku Baali‐Zefoŋ ʒiŋucnao, Pi‐Hahiroti haeo waha ŋehapie bâfuac‐jopambiŋ.
Eme Faraozi bâqiŋ‐jopahame Israe ŋicguru jaŋe ʒâŋe fipie rame honec‐joparâ mi ʒiŋuc mananʒepieŋ i: Aigita ŋic jaŋe nâpo jâpec enârezo wareŋgopieŋ. Iŋuc manarâ mâretec hâwic‐jopawec. Eme Israe ŋicguru jaŋe Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnembiŋ.
Ehuc Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Aigita mâreŋko ʒâŋeruŋ gie mi fokac me, irec ʒira mâreŋ burocnao hâmonaŋte hota‐nâretecne wareŋgopeneŋ? Go weniŋuc enârehuc Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐nâpo waremeŋ?
Nâŋe ocna Aigita mâreŋko ʒiŋuc mi gazambeŋ me, ‘Go behec‐nâpotec nâŋe sifu Aigita ŋic kiŋaŋ qajarenʒepeneŋ?’ Nâŋe Aigita ŋic jaŋere kiŋaŋ qahuc junʒapeŋ muzac afecke‐nârezac, ʒi ine mâreŋ burocnao hâmo sipiric enaŋmu ekac.”
Eme Mosezi ŋic ŋokac jazawec: “Ŋoŋe mi hâwic‐ŋopaoc, qiŋ herâ domaniŋ. Erâ Wofuŋzi miŋecgac bafic‐ŋopaocmu i honenʒepieŋ. Aigita ŋic miŋecgac honec‐jopaŋgopieŋ jaŋe mocwâc mi honec‐jopa‐jâmbâŋkeniŋmu hâcne.
Ŋoŋe mâc domahapie Wofuŋ e ŋoŋere âkehoc ʒika qaocmu.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go wemocte wira wâwâsic enarekic? Go Israe ŋic jaŋe jazatecne fahare ranʒepieŋ.
Go ine gunuge bâfeŋnerâ mege hâweckopec sicnetec hâweczi tâcneme Israe ŋicguru jaŋe mâreŋ kereŋnao fotâcne ranʒepieŋ.
Eme noni Aigita ŋic jaŋere maŋ bâzickepe jaŋe bâjâpec‐ŋopahapie Wofuŋ qâreŋ‐nane Farao â momorifâc‐ticne, keretac‐ticne erâ becâsicko rara ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋerao bataniŋkezepac.
Eme no Farao â keretac‐ticne erâ momori â becâsicko rara ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋerao Wofuŋ qâreŋ‐nane bataniŋkepe Aigita jaŋe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac, i mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋte aŋelo Israe ŋic bânie‐jareweczi rârierâ râpefuŋ‐jeŋicko domawec. Ehame karorac ɋâfoŋnezi iŋuc jaha mai‐jeŋickonec rârierâ râpefuŋ‐jeŋicko domawec.
Ehuc Aigita ŋic â Israe ŋic ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko aka iŋucne erâ domawec. Ehuc ŋifecne dapâc ewec, â ŋifecne tamaewec, irec ŋic jaŋe ŋafeo hohonec me bâbâfuac mi ehapie hae furewec.
Ehame Mose e hâwec faio meticne sicnewec. Wofuŋ eki ine mume ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec mâŋâŋ sâkozi ŋafe ʒora qahuc hâwec qâkereŋkewec.
Eme opâzi ŋifec â ŋifec sanaŋkerâ sac iŋucne domaha Israe ŋic jaŋe duŋmâreŋ kereŋnao fotâcnembiŋ.
Ehame Aigita ŋic jaŋe fâro erâ bâjâpec‐jopahuc iŋuc jaha fotâcnezo murâ Faraore becâsic sasawa mecne, keretac mecne erâ becâsicko rara ŋic mâmâc hâwec ʒâʒâŋiŋko ra fisimbiŋ.
Eme hae fufurecte ruc bapa dameŋko Wofuŋzi ʒocbâruŋ â karorac maŋnao juhuc Aigita ŋic jaŋeraopec ʒâŋe fime rame honec‐joparâ maŋmutuc bacjopawec.
Ehuc mume keretac‐jeŋicte ʒafeŋgâŋne ŋetarame ʒuhuckerâ raniŋte eipiembiŋ. Iŋuc fuame Aigita ŋic jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Israe ŋic behec‐joparâ wiserâ ranaŋ me! Wofuŋ e jahac bafic‐jopakac i! I Aigita ŋic nâŋâc nâpoocte iŋuc ekac.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go mege mocwâc hâwec faio sicnetec hâweczi risierâ Aigita ŋic, keretac â becâsicko rara ŋic hâcne qâuruc‐jopazejec.”
Eme Mose e meticne hâwec faio mocwâc sicnewec. Eme hae fureme Aigita ŋic jaŋe hâwec risie wareweckopec wisezo ehapie hâweczi fofo‐ticnao risiehuc qofac‐jopawec. Iŋuc fuame Wofuŋzi Aigita ŋic hâwec ʒâʒâŋiŋko bâsirowec‐jopawec hâcne.
Eme hâweczi risierâ keretac mecne, becâsicko rara ŋic mecne, Faraore momori sasawa hâcne Israe ŋic bâjâpec‐joparâ hâwecko humbiŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma qâuruc‐jopa‐fâreme hâmo miziembiŋ.
Israe ŋicguru jaŋe ine hâweczi ŋifec â ŋifec sanaŋkerâ sac iŋucne domaha hâwec ʒâʒâŋiŋko mâreŋ kereŋnao rahuc fotâcnembiŋ.
Iŋuc fuame Wofuŋzi ʒoaŋ ira Israe ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Aigita ŋic jaŋere meonec batarac‐jopawec, ehame Aigita ŋic qâŋɋâŋ‐jeŋic hâwec sirizi qârâriec‐jopame moŋgeŋko fe fohapie Israe ŋic jaŋe honec‐jopambiŋ.
Erâ Wofuŋzi tâpiri sâko‐ticnere fuŋne Aigita ŋic jaŋerao bataniŋkewec i Israe ŋic jaŋe mâmâc hone tarambiŋ. Ehuc Wofuŋ araŋ bacnehuc manasiŋkembiŋ â kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Mose e wâc manasiŋkembiŋ.
Dameŋ ira Mose â Israe ŋicguru jaŋe Wofuŋ muteŋkehuc gae kecʒiŋuc hembiŋ: “No Wofuŋ gae hecnepe, e tâpiri ɋuŋɋasaŋ‐ticne bataniŋkewec hâcne; e becâsic â ŋic hâwecko tuŋjopame humbiŋ.
Sasanaŋ â mumuteŋ‐nane i Wofuŋ e hâcne, ŋeŋezic‐nane i ekizia juwec; e hâcne Anutu‐nane, no muteŋ bâteŋ ecnezepac, e apa ŋosa â mamacfâc‐nane jaŋere Anutu, no e muafeckezepac.
Wofuŋ e ʒika qaqa ŋicsaric ʒâŋe‐ticne Wofuŋ hâcne.
“Faraore keretac â momorifâc i hâwecko tuŋjopawec, â momori micne bâwosâec‐jopakicne jaŋe Hâwec Bâbâroŋko bâutuc‐jopakicne.
Rumizi bârârâŋ‐jopawec; qânâ iŋucne ʒâkâŋ fâhâŋnao hujâmbâŋkembiŋ.
