O Wofuŋ, mefârege i tâpiri ɋuŋɋasaŋhec, gore mefârezi râsi qanʒaŋ‐jopaekac, o Wofuŋ.
Tâpiri ɋuŋɋasaŋge fekicne, irec râsi jaŋe guriŋ‐jopaekic; erâ kimbeŋgere ʒocbâruŋ râetec izi ra sopâc iŋucne ʒahuc ʒâseŋ‐jopaekac.
Sâke rombâŋge wefume opâzi ferâ sanaŋkewec, â hâweczi sac iŋucne hâŋ domawec, sirizi hâwec ʒâʒâŋiŋko sanaŋkerâ fowec.
Râsizi muwec: ‘No jopa jâpec ejarehuc jowarupe, no mateŋ bâtâc bape andac‐nane omaezejec. No ʒika‐nane bâfeŋnepe menanezi jopa miziezejec.’
Go mutec mâŋâŋ qame hâweczi qâuruc‐jopawec, jaŋe aeŋ iŋucne opâ sâkoo hufârembiŋ.
“O Wofuŋ, nemu ŋondeŋko go iŋucne mozi moc jukac? Mozi moc go iŋucne ɋuŋɋasaŋ‐ticnehec â tirine erâ mâsi bapa â ʒika qaqare ʒâŋe rara sâkohec jukac?
Go mefârege sicnemeŋ, eme mâreŋzi ɋâcjopawec.
“Go aki anonoc fogareha ŋic batarac‐jopameŋ, go tâpirigezi jowa qataŋ ejarehuc tiri haegao râec‐jopameŋ.
Ŋic jaŋe manarâ fâfârembiŋ, Filisa mâreŋ rune jaŋe ɋarac ɋarac qambiŋ.
Dameŋ ira Edom ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe bipic tatara ejarewec, â Moabi fekicnefâc‐jeŋic hâwic‐jopawec. Kanaaŋ mâreŋ rune ʒeŋgoma maŋjeŋic gâckewec.
Hâhâwic â bipic tatara ejarewec; megere tâpiri sâko irec erâ qânâ iŋucne qiriŋmâc embiŋ. O Wofuŋ, gurufâcge jaŋe fotâcnembiŋ, go gahac batarac‐jopameŋ ŋicguru i jaŋe hâcne fotâcnembiŋ.
Goki jowac‐jopatec raʒimbiŋ erâ gokizia gahacne tiki mâreŋko sara mama ejaremeŋ, go gahac fic hae erâ ŋec juc eekic ira hâcne, o Wofuŋ, gahacne mezi tirific bameŋ, ira hâcne, o Wofuŋ.
Wofuŋ e guriŋ bapa gie‐ticne bahuc juekaczi baraʒihuc juocmu sanaŋ.”
Farao becâsic â keretac â momorifâc‐ticne jaŋe hâwec fotâcnezo ehapie Wofuŋzi hâwec ecneme fai‐jeŋicko fehuc qâurucjopawec hâcne. Israe ŋic jaŋe ine mâreŋ kereŋnao hâwec fotâcnembiŋ.
Eme porofete ŋokac Miriam, Aroŋte qo hâcne, eki woŋgâŋ rome ŋokac sasawa e qâterâ woŋgâŋ jaha ropie gae wombiŋ.
Eme Miriamzi gae ʒiŋuc hejarewec: “Wofuŋ gae hecnenaŋ, e tâpiri ɋuŋɋasaŋ‐ticne bataniŋkewec hâcne; e becâsic â momori hâwecko tuŋjopame hufârembiŋ.”
Eme Mose e Israe ŋic jaŋe ejareme Hâwec Bâbâroŋ behembiŋ. Eme jaŋe Suru mâreŋ burocnao rahuc juhapie ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha opâ moc mi bâfuambiŋ.
Raku Mara mâreŋko fisirâ opâ bâfuambiŋ. Erâ i opâ hâtânere wemocko moc nanʒapiŋ. Opâ hâtânere mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe Mara mukicne.
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Mose mu heŋɋâŋ ecnehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Nâŋe opâ wenirec nanaŋmu?”
Eme Mose e Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecneme Wofuŋzi jâc moc jâutuwec i rorâ opâo beheme hume opâzi nocne ewec. Eme Wofuŋ e ira hâcne dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋ gâcne jarehuc esâic‐jopawec.
Ehuc muwec: “Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte mic reŋkehuc ere maio wiac eene biaŋ i ehuc dâŋsanaŋ â sâcmutâc‐ticne reŋkeniŋmuo ine Aigita mâreŋko huc ʒâic wiac bâfuapo i ŋoŋere faio râepe mi feocmu, no Wofuŋ ŋoŋere bâbâpiaŋ hâcne.”
Eme jaŋe raku Elim hae mâreŋko fisimbiŋ. Ira ine opâ ʒâŋe 12 fowec â hâmu jâcne 70 doma rawec. Eme jaŋe opâ fowecko toma âterâ waha fombiŋ.
Juku Elim beherâ rambiŋ. Raku Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma mâreŋ burocne moc, ʒâŋene Sini ira fisimbiŋ. Sini mâreŋ i ine Elim â Sinai ŋondeŋ‐jekicko fokac. Jaŋe Aigita mâreŋ beherâ ra juku mosa namba tu irec gie bapa 15 ira hâcne fisimbiŋ.
Eme Israe kikefuŋ mâmâc sâko jaŋe mâreŋ burocnao Mose â Aroŋ mu kâroŋ ejactembiŋ.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc muhuc jasambiŋ: “Nâŋe Aigita mâreŋko qowi â poroŋ mâretec fonâreme nâ gapec ehuc jumbeŋ dameŋ ira Wofuŋte mezi nâpome hâmonʒapeŋ me! Ŋohe ine kikefuŋ ʒi nâŋe hâmo‐fârenaŋte mâreŋ burocnao jowac‐nâpopire warembeŋ hâcne.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec: “Noni mupe poroŋ sambâŋkonec hoe iŋucne ŋoŋerao wahaocmu, eme ŋic jaŋe ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne ra ʒoaŋte sâc ro nusec enʒepieŋ. Iŋuc ehapie nore micsâcko juŋgopieŋ me mâcne, irec fuŋne honezepac.
Eme ʒoaŋ namba 6 ira ro nusec eniŋmu i rike bâmoc epie ʒoaŋ sâc roeŋgopieŋ irec sâc sirickehuc ʒoaŋ jajahecte sâc ezejec.”
Iŋuc mume Mose â Aroŋ jahe Israe ŋicguru ʒeŋgoma ʒiŋuc jazapic: “Wofuŋzi Aigita mâreŋkonec batarac‐ŋopame wahambiŋ irec fuŋne i hae owâeme hone taranʒepieŋ.
Erâ hae fureme, Wofuŋ mu kâroŋ ecnepie manawec i sifu mana urue‐ŋareme Wofuŋ ʒai ʒonʒoŋ‐ticnere fuŋne honenʒepieŋ wâc. Nâhe mac ʒi ine wemo wiacte maŋgâŋ dâŋ munâcteŋgopieŋ?”
Eme Mosezi muwec: “Wofuŋ e mu kâroŋ ecnepie manawecte hae owâeme qowi ŋareocmu â furicte poroŋ ŋareme nâ gapec eniŋmu. Nâhe iŋucnezi wemo enacmu? Ŋoŋe nâhe mâcne, Wofuŋ mu kâroŋ ecneŋgopieŋ hâcne.”
Erâ Mosezi Aroŋ âzâcnewec: “Go Israe kikefuŋ mâmâc sâko kecʒiŋuc jazac, ‘Ŋoŋe Wofuŋte maio ware fuaniŋ, e mukâroŋ‐ŋeŋic manawec hâcne.’”
Eme Aroŋ e Israe kikefuŋ mâmâc sâko dâŋ jazahame jaŋe mâreŋ burocnaopec ʒâŋe fipie rame mi Wofuŋ tatamac‐ticne karorac maŋko fuame honenʒepieŋ i!
Iŋuc fuame Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnerâ muwec:
“No Israe ŋicguru jaŋere kâroŋ qaqa manapac, irec go jazac, ‘Owâ ririŋko qowi nâniŋmu â furicte poroŋ nâ gapec eniŋmu, iŋuc ehuc no Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.’”
Eme hae owâeme koneŋ qâŋhec fisirâ tomao herâ fusucmambiŋ, eme hae fureme titikuczi toma râreckehuc fowec.
Erâ titikuc kereŋkeme mâreŋko hândâŋ piic piic padi tinac ŋerawec.
Eme Israe ŋicguru jaŋe honerâ jaŋackoaŋ ʒiŋuc mu wioc embiŋ: “Ʒi wemo wiac mo?” Jaŋe wiac irec fuŋne kâuc bambiŋ hâcne. Iŋuc epie Mosezi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “I nânâ hâcne, Wofuŋzi nâniŋte ŋarejec.
Wofuŋzi irec dâŋ ʒiŋuc mutâcne‐ŋarewec: ‘Ŋoŋe ru sâc nânâ i sâcŋeŋic ro nusec enʒepieŋ. Boze‐ŋeŋicko ŋic ŋokac naru motec ŋec foc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere ʒare manahuc ru sâc amae wâŋ wâŋ iŋuc ronʒepieŋ.’”
Eme Israe ŋicguru jaŋe iŋuc hâcne embiŋ, gâcnezi afecne, gâcnezi bocjaha iŋuc rofârembiŋ.
Eme sâcticne honeniŋte amaeo râepie hume ʒiŋuc fuawec: Bocjaha nuseweczi mâririhec mi ewec â afecne nuseweczi nânâ wâc mi basawec, jaŋe sasawa hobu‐jeŋicte sâc ro nusec embiŋ hâcne.
Eme Mosezi jazawec: “Ŋic moczi tomâc furictere biŋe moc mi râeme fozejec.”
Jaŋe ine Mosere dâŋ mana rereŋ mi embiŋ. Ehuc gâcnezi tiwâne ʒoaŋ mocte biŋe râepie foha umbeŋ fuame âsu fiwec, eme Mosezi aaric mana‐jarewec.
Jaŋe furic sâc hobu‐jeŋicte sâc ro nusec ejumbieŋ, ʒoaŋ wefurâ sanaŋkeme ine opâ efâre jujec.
Ʒoaŋ namba 6 ira ine ʒoaŋ gâcnao rombiŋ irec sâc ʒuhuckerâ ru sâc amae jajahec ro nusec embiŋ. Iŋuc epie soŋaŋ sasawa jaŋe Moserao rarâ âzâcnembiŋ.
Âzâcnepie muwec: “Wofuŋ e irec hâcne ʒiŋuc muwec: ‘Tomâcko sabata hombaŋ, Wofuŋte tiri sabata hâcne. Ŋoŋe ʒegoc rikezo murâ ʒegoc rikeniŋ me kuʒio rikezo murâ rikeniŋ, iŋuc epie tiwâne ŋeme tomâckore biŋe râepie fozejec.’”
Eme jaŋe Mosezi jazawec irec sâcko ehuc furictere biŋe râepie forâ âsu mi fiwec erâ umbeŋ wiac ira wâc mi fuawec.
Eme Mosezi muwec: “Miŋecgac nânʒepieŋ, miŋecgac Wofuŋte sabata hombaŋ hâcne. Ŋoŋe miŋecgac gieo moc mi bâfuaniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 sâcne ro nusec eniŋmu, ʒoaŋ namba 7, sabata hâcne, ira ine moc mi fuarâ foocmu.”
Gâcne jaŋe ine mana‐bipiehuc ʒoaŋ namba 7 ira sifu ro nusec eniŋte rarâ basambiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋoŋe dâŋnane â sâcmutâc‐nane qatarahuc juwarembiŋ i wezimucko moc mana rereŋ eniŋmu?
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ no hâcne sabata bâfua‐ŋarepo, irec ʒoaŋ namba 6 ira ʒoaŋ jajahecte sâc nânâ râe‐ŋarekopac. Irec ʒoaŋ namba 7 ira ŋic sasawa ŋoŋe boze‐ŋeŋicko ŋefârehapie ŋic moczi boze‐ticne beherâ gieo moc mi razejec.”
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe iŋuc ehuc ʒoaŋ namba 7 ira sabata hombaŋ ŋembiŋ.
Eme Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe nânâ irec ʒâŋe “mana” mumbiŋ. I padi qaŋqaŋ iŋucne, erâ nâpie baŋac aŋac iŋucne ewec.
Eme Mosezi muwec: “Wofuŋzi mumupaŋ dâŋ muwec i kecʒiŋuc: ‘Ŋoŋe nânâ i amae mocte sâc ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere erâ râepie fozejec. Eme jaŋe, no Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐ŋopa waharâ mâreŋ burocnao nânâ weniŋuc gumec‐ŋopapo i honenʒepieŋ.’”
Eme Mosezi Aroŋ âzâcnewec: “Go rowaŋ kiruŋ moc rorâ ira amae mocjahare sâc ‘mana’ hoŋketec hume ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere erâ Wofuŋte maio râepie domazejec.”
Eme Aroŋ e Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec irec sâcko ehuc sâcmutâc dâŋte katapa maŋfuŋnao râeme domawec.
Israe ŋicguru jaŋe ine “mana” nâhuc juhapie jara 40 tarame mâreŋ moc ŋic jumbiŋko ira fisimbiŋ. Ine hâcne, “mana” nâhuc juku Kanaaŋ mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao fisimbiŋ.
Amae 10 râepie oto kâcɋene mocjahare sâc ewec.
Israe kikefuŋ mâmâc sâko jaŋe Wofuŋte micte Sini mâreŋ burocne beherâ juju fofo raku Refidimko fisirâ toma âterâ boze bafârembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic ŋokac jaŋe opâ basambiŋ.
Irec Mose dâŋ mucnehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Opâ nâretec nanaŋ me!” Eme Mosezi jazawec: “Ŋoŋe wemocte no dâŋ munareŋgopieŋ? Wemocte Wofuŋ esâickeŋgopieŋ?”
Ŋic jaŋe ine opâre hâmorâ Mose mu kâroŋ ecnehuc mumbiŋ: “Go wemocte nâŋe nâŋâcne mecne, naru motecfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mecne â lama bulimakaofâc‐nâŋec nâŋe mâmâc ʒira opâre hâmo sipiric efârenaŋte Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐nâpo waremeŋ?”
Iŋuc mupie Mosezi Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnehuc muwec: “No ŋicguru ʒi weniŋuc ejarepemu? Jaŋe qânâzi hehâmocnuzo eŋgopieŋ ine.”
Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec: “Go Israe soŋaŋ micne gâcne rocjopatec ŋicguru bânie‐jareniŋ, ehuc gunuge Nilu opâ qameŋ i hâcne barâ razemec.
Manakic, no ocna, Horebe tiki fuŋnao haroŋaŋ faio maigao domazepac. Eme go haroŋaŋ qatec opâ wahame ŋic ŋokac jaŋe sâcne nâniŋmu.” Eme Mose e Israe soŋaŋ micne jaŋere ʒâŋe faio iŋuc hâcne ewec.
Erâ hae mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe “Masa” (eesâic) â “Meriba” (dâŋ mumu) muwec, ine Israe ŋic jaŋe mu kâroŋ ehuc Wofuŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc esâickembiŋ irec: “Wofuŋ e ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko jukac me mâcne?”
Refidim mâreŋko juhapie Amaleke ŋic jaŋe warepie Israe ŋic jaŋehec qaqac embiŋ.
Eme Mosezi Josua âzâcnewec: “Go ŋic rowosâec‐jopatec ra Amaleke ŋic jopanʒepieŋ. No tomâcko tiki botâŋnao ferâ Anuture gunu badomapemu.”
Josua e Mosezi âzâcnewec irec sâcko ehuc momori jaŋehec Amaleke ŋic jopaniŋte rambiŋ. Ehame Mose â Aroŋ erâ Huru jaŋe ine tiki botâŋnao ferâ domambiŋ.
Eme Mose mejahec‐ticne bâfeŋneme sâc Israe ŋic jaŋe sanaŋkembiŋ, mene wahame sâc ine Amaleke ŋic jaŋe sanaŋkembiŋ.
Eme Mose e mene baŋaŋkeme qânâ moc rorâ domawecko hecnepire waha ŋewec. Ehame Aroŋ â Huru jahe mejahec‐ticne dopec‐jofahuc domapic, moc ŋifec â moc ŋifec; iŋuc ehapire mejahec‐ticne sanaŋkerâ domaha ʒoaŋ huwec.
Iŋuc epie Josua e Amaleke ŋicwofuŋ â momorifâcne ʒika tinacbiric jopawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go wiac irec manasuhuc juniŋte papiao qâreŋkerâ Josua âzâcne qâmoc ezemec, no sambâŋ rurumaŋnao Amaleke ŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biŋe hetâ qâtâtiepe omae‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.”
Mose eki ine alata moc barâ ʒâŋene “Wofuŋzi filak‐nane ekac” iŋuc muwec.
Erâ muwec: “Wofuŋte filak i meŋeŋicko râepie fooc! Wofuŋzi hâcne Amaleke ŋic jaŋehec mimiŋzi ɋâric ʒika gie bahuc juocmu.”
Midiaŋ mâreŋkonec taha bapa ŋic moc ʒâŋene Jetoro, Mose kimo‐ticne hâcne, e Anutuzi Mose â Israe ŋic ehâmo‐jarewec, erâ Wofuŋ e Israe ŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa wahawec irec biŋe mana‐fârewec.
Irec Mose kimo‐ticne Jetoro e Mosezi juwicnao ŋonâŋ‐ticne Ʒibora â ŋokâ jahec‐ticne râec‐jopame risiembiŋ jaŋe Moserao jowac‐jopa raocte hefârec‐jopawec.
Motec mocte ʒâŋe i ʒiŋuc muhuc Geresom mukicne: “No mâreŋ furunao jaba jukopac.”
Mocte ʒâŋe ine ʒiŋuc muhuc Elieʒe mukicne: “Mamac‐nanere Anutuzi bafic‐nane juhuc Faraore ʒikaonec bataracnuwec.”
Eme Jetoro, Mose kimo‐ticne hâcne, e Mose ŋonâŋ‐ticne â ŋokâ jahecne jowac‐jopa raku mâreŋ burocnao Anuture tikio Mosezi ŋec juc ewecko fisiwec hâcne.
Ehuc Moserao dâŋ ʒiŋuc râeme rawec: “Go manac, kimoge Jetoro no â ŋonâŋ ŋokâfâcge nâŋe gorao fâzo eŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme Mose e kimo‐ticne hatao bâfuaocte rawec. Raku bâfuarâ maŋfuŋnao fodaperâ muduckewec. Eme jahe juju‐jekicte muc manac eraku qoruc bozemaŋko fepic.
Eme Mose e Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic jaŋere erâ Farao â Aigita ŋic jaŋerao wiac ewec bawec irec dâŋ binaŋ kimo‐ticne ninic ecne‐fârewec. Erâ hatao juhapie ʒârâ ʒâpâ wiac fua‐jareme Wofuŋzi hone kitaŋ ejarewec irec bianŋ i mâmâc bacnewec.
Iŋuc eme Jetoro e Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic ehâmo‐jarewec â Aigita mâreŋkonec batarac‐jopawec irec binaŋ sasawa manarâ bubiaŋ manahuc ʒeri bari ewec.
Erâ Jetorozi muwec: “Aigita ŋic â Farao jaŋere meonec batarac‐ŋopawec â ŋicguru ʒi Aigita kâpâcwâru‐jeŋickonec firuec‐jopawec, Wofuŋ e hâcne muteŋ bâteŋ ecnezo.
No ʒi manakopac: Wofuŋ e nemu fuŋne fuŋne siric‐jopa‐fârerâ femicne sâko jukac. E Aigita ŋic jaŋe ŋicguru ʒi bomboŋ ejarehapie mejeŋickonec batarac‐jopawec hâcne.”
Eme Mose kimo‐ticne Jetoro e Anutu qowi bâzi â taha bâzi rikecnewec. Ehame Aroŋ â Israe ŋic micnefâc‐jeŋic sasawa jaŋe Anuture maio Mose kimo‐ticnehec tiwâ ʒepec nâniŋte bozeo raʒimbiŋ.
Hae fureme Mose e ŋic jaŋerao mumutiŋ gie baocte waha ŋeha ŋic jaŋe Mosere maio furicte fuŋkerâ domahuc juhapie hae owâewec.
Eme Mose kimo‐ticne e Mosezi ŋic jaŋerao gie sasawa bahuc juwec i hone‐fârerâ muwec: “Go ŋic jaŋerao keci wemo gie bakomec? Erâ go wemocte gie i buc bahuc ŋehaŋtecne ŋic jaŋe gore maio fuŋkerâ ware domahuc juhapie hae ŋafekac?”
Eme Mosezi kimo‐ticne âzâcnewec: “Ŋic jaŋe Anutu mu wioc ecnezo norao wareŋgopieŋte bakopac.
Jaŋe dâŋjeŋic moc fuame norao wareeŋgopieŋ, eme noni dâŋjeŋic mutarahuc Anuture dâŋsanaŋ â mumupaŋ dâŋ mutâcne‐jareekopac.”
Iŋuc mume kimo‐ticnezi âzâcnewec: “Go wiac keci etecne mi sâckekac.
Ŋoŋe iŋuc epie gore tâpiri mecne â ŋic gohec juŋgopieŋ jaŋere tâpiri mecne i biac wahaocmu. Gie keci i ŋemâcne, irec go buc bapare sâc mi ekac.
Irec no dâŋ moc gazape manahuc juhaŋte Anutuzi gohec juzejec. Go ŋic jaŋere erâ Anuture maio fuazemec, ehuc dâŋ wiac‐jeŋic muzemec.
Erâ dâŋsanaŋ â mumupaŋ dâŋ mutâcne‐jarehuc hata raniŋte â wiac ebac eniŋte mukicne i wâc jaza jowatuc ezemec.
Iŋuc ehuc ine jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec ŋic asa faio gie bapane â Wofuŋ araŋ babacne, siocmâc â mu bâmiriŋ dâŋ qiqikiŋ, iŋucne bâwosâec‐joparâ micne râec‐jopazemec. Eme gâcne jaŋe ŋic tauseŋ, gâcne jaŋe 100, gâcne jaŋe 50, gâcne jaŋe 10 jaŋere micne junʒepieŋ.
Ehuc dameŋ sâc dâŋjeŋic mutiŋne‐jarehuc mutara‐jarenʒepieŋ. Dâŋ ŋemâcne sasawa gorao râenʒepieŋ, aafecne ine jaŋe jaŋac mutiŋne‐jarehuc mufâsâenʒepieŋ. Iŋuc epie gore giezi afeckeha jaŋe tagi ŋifec dehuc go baficgunʒepieŋ.
Go iŋuc ecmuo ine Anutuzi giedâŋ mugarewec i sâcne bahuc jucmu â ŋic ŋokac ʒi jaŋe ʒeŋgoma maŋjeŋic taraha bumâteŋko fic boze‐jeŋicko risieniŋmu.”
Mose e kimo‐ticnezi dâŋ âzâcnewec sâc mana rereŋ efârewec.
Ehuc Israe ŋic gurune gurune jaŋeraonec ŋic ropaŋ‐jeŋichec rowosâec‐joparâ ŋic ŋokac jaŋere micne râec‐jopawec, gâcne ŋic tauseŋ jaŋere micne, gâcne ŋic 100, gâcne ŋic 50, gâcne ŋic 10 jaŋere micne râec‐jopawec hâcne.
Ehuc ŋic ŋokac jaŋere dâŋ dameŋ sâc mutiŋne‐jarehuc dâŋ ŋemâcne erao râeniŋte â aafecne ine jaŋe jaŋac mutaraniŋte mujarewec.
Mose e iŋuc erâ kimo‐ticne mâzockeme mâreŋ‐ticnao risie rawec.
Israe ŋicguru jaŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec waha rahuc juhapie mosa jahec â moc eha ʒoaŋ ijaha jâmbâŋ Sinai mâreŋ burocnao fisimbiŋ.
Jaŋe Refidim hae mâreŋ beherâ raku Sinai mâreŋ burocnao fisirâ ira ŋec juc embiŋ. Ehuc Sinai tiki mendâŋko toma âterâ fombiŋ.
Mosezi ine Anuturao fewec. Ehame Wofuŋzi tikionec wirahuc âzâcnewec: “Go Jakobore ɋâricfâc, Israe ŋicguru hâcne ʒiŋuc muhuc jazazemec:
No Aigita ŋic jaŋe wiac ejarepo â ŋoŋe tucwipere fakec faio tinac bacŋopa warepo i ŋoŋe hone‐fârembiŋ.
Eme ʒi dâŋnane mana rereŋ ehuc ʒâʒâfic‐nane bajuniŋmuo ine ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋicfâc‐nane bacŋopapemu, mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ i nore biŋe ekac hâcne.
Ŋoŋe taha bapazi uucmaŋ‐nane rauckerâ ŋicguru tirine moc erâ junarenʒepieŋ. Go dâŋ i hâcne Israe ŋic jazazemec.”
Eme Mose e waharâ ŋicguru jaŋere micne bapa hetumaŋ‐joparâ Wofuŋzi dâŋ âzâcnewec i furu jaha jaza‐fârewec.
Eme ŋic jaŋe ʒeŋgoma ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Wofuŋzi dâŋ muwec i reŋke‐fârenaŋte muŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec: “No karorac maŋko gorao fâzo ekopac, eme no gohec dâŋ muc manac ehapere ŋicguru jaŋe manarâ dâŋge mana ʒakiehuc junʒepieŋ sanaŋ.” Iŋuc mume Mose e ŋic ŋokac jaŋere dâŋ i Wofuŋ âzâcnewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec: “Go ŋicguru jaŋerao hurâ jazatec jaŋe miŋecgac â tomâcko maŋsowa juhuc ŋaqi wiac‐jeŋic ʒurenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ʒawierâ juhapie ʒoaŋ namba 3 maickezejec. Eme ʒoaŋ ira hâcne Wofuŋzi ŋic ʒeŋgoma jaŋere ʒâŋe faio Sinai tikio wahaocmu.
Goki ine aka hajarehuc ʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘Ŋoŋe tikio fenʒipiŋte me tiki qaŋeŋne sawa moc ba bâuac enʒipiŋte rucŋeŋic banʒepieŋ. Moc e tiki ba bâuac eocmu e hâmo‐jâmbâŋkezejec.
Ŋic moczi moc mi bâuazejec, bâuame qânâzi hehâmozo me tepezi muru‐hâmozo, ŋic me qowi e moc mi jujâmbâŋkezejec.’ Qeŋ ʒoricne dâŋeme manarâ ine tiki fuŋko warenʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Mosezi tikionec ŋic jaŋerao waharâ ʒawieniŋte jazawec, eme jaŋe ŋaqi‐jeŋic ʒurembiŋ.
Eme ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe sowa juhapie ʒoaŋ namba 3 maickezejec. Ehame ŋokac ba bâuac moc mi ejarenʒepieŋ.”
Eme ʒoaŋ namba 3 hae fureme ɋuŋ parandaŋ hehuc fowec â karorac ɋâfoŋne moc waha tiki botâŋne foŋkewec erâ qeŋ sokawec dâŋeme ŋic tomao jumbiŋ jaŋe ɋarac ɋarac qambiŋ.
Iŋuc fuame Mosezi ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Anutuhec bâbâfuac eniŋte tomaonec jowac‐jopame tikifuŋko birickerâ domambiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ e ʒocmaŋko tikio wahawecte tikizi hosâc qame hosâc‐ticnezi hosâc qeŋqeŋko feekac iŋucne fewec, erâ tiki i mâretec ɋiɋiteckehuc ŋewec.
Ehame qeŋzi soka makawec dâŋeme Mose e dâŋ mume Anutuzi okacne ɋuŋmaŋko bâtikiecnewec.
Erâ Wofuŋ e Sinai tikio wahawec, tiki botâŋnao hâcne. Ehuc Mosezi tiki botâŋnao feocte wiracneme fewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec: “Go hurâ ŋicguru uŋ jazac, jaŋe Wofuŋ no honecnuniŋte aka huckerâ wefuhuc bocjahazi hâmo sipiric enʒipiŋte.
Erâ taha bapa Wofuŋ maickeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe iŋuc jaha maŋsowa juhuc ʒawienʒepieŋ, mi epie Wofuŋ noni sipiric‐jopazipore.”
Eme Mosezi Wofuŋ âzâcnewec: “Ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Sinai tikio sâcne mi wefuniŋmu, i go gahac uŋsawaŋ enârehuc ʒiŋuc mumeŋte: ‘Tiki râreckehuc sac barâ furu muzemec.’”
Eme Wofuŋzi âzâcnewec: “Go huc, eme Aroŋ jowatec mâmâc wefuzepirec, taha bapa â ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ine Wofuŋ norao wefuniŋte aka mi huckenʒepieŋ; epie Wofuŋ noni sipiric‐jopazipohec.”
Iŋuc mume Mosezi ŋicguru jaŋerao waharâ jazawec.
Eme Anutu e dâŋ kecʒiŋuc sasawa mufuahuc muwec:
“Noni Wofuŋ gore Anutu, no hâcne Aigita mâreŋ, kâpâcwâru fic hâcne, irecnec bataracgupo.
“Go nore maio nemu burec wiac moc mi bajuzemec.
“Go ɋâŋ qâqâtâc moc barâ mi bajuzemec, sambâŋko mecne mâreŋko mecne opâo mecne, mâreŋmaŋko mecne wiac forakac irec qâqâtâc moc mi bazemec.
Go wiac i araŋ bacnehuc kiŋaŋ moc mi qacnezemec; no Wofuŋ gore Anutu hâcne, no ʒoɋac‐nanehec. No qaisocnueŋgopieŋ jaŋe kiŋjeŋicte okacne naru motec ŋosafâc‐jeŋic bazu‐jare raekopac.
Â ŋic tauseŋ gurune gurune maŋzi ʒâficnuhuc dâŋnane reŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine ehâmo‐jarehuc juekopac.
“Wofuŋge Anutu ere ʒâŋe mi sipirickezemec, ʒâŋe‐ticne sipirickeocmu ŋic e Wofuŋzi mi akickeocmu.
“Sonda e tiri foocte manasuzemec.
Go ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 giege baku bafârezemec.
Ʒoaŋ namba 7 izi ine Wofuŋge Anutu ere hombaŋ ekac, irec ʒoaŋ ira gie moc mi bazemec, go mecne, ŋokâge mecne, otâge mecne, kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge ŋic me ŋokac jaŋe mecne, bulimakaofâcge mecne erâ ŋic furunezi ficgao jukac e mecne.
Wofuŋ e gie bapa 6 gie bahuc sambâŋ â mâreŋ â hâwec erâ maŋnao wiac forakac sasawa i bâfua‐fârewec hâcne, ʒoaŋ namba 7 ira ine ŋemanawec. Irec Wofuŋ e sabata jambuŋkehuc furu muwec.
“Go neŋgoc mamac jahecge sâsec‐jofazemec, Anutuzi mâreŋ râecguocmu ira dameŋ ʒora juhâc qâhâmocmurâ iŋuc hâcne ezemec.
“Go ʒika mi qazemec.
“Ŋowe ŋonâŋ ŋohe bebehec mi ezepirec.
“Go fiuc mi rozemec.
“Go ŋic âgoge micko âkec mi ecnezemec.
“Go ŋic jaŋere huhure wiac irec andac mi ezemec. Go ŋic âgofâcge jaŋere ŋokac me kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic ŋic me ŋokac me bec bulimakao me doŋgifâc‐jeŋic me wiac‐jeŋic i me i fojareekac irec andac mi ezemec.”
Ŋic ŋokac jaŋe sasawa ɋuŋ parandaŋ â bâbâric â qeŋfânâŋ â tikizi hosâc qawec, wiac i sasawa hone manac erâ hâwic‐jopame ɋarac ɋarac qambiŋ, ehuc taicko domambiŋ.
Erâ Mose âzâcnembiŋ: “Goki dâŋ nâzâtec mananʒepeneŋ. Anutuzi ine dâŋ moc mi nâzâzejec, nâzâme hâmonʒipeŋ.”
Iŋuc mupie Mosezi ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Mi hâwic‐ŋopaoc, Anutu e ŋoŋerao fisijec i fuŋne‐ŋeŋic bataniŋkeocte, erâ ere hâhâwiczi mai foŋareha sâqocne mi baniŋte.”
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe taicko domahapie Mose e Anutuzi karorac ɋâfoŋne maŋnao ŋewec karorac i ra bâqiŋkewec.
Ehame Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnerâ muwec: “Go Israe ŋicguru kecʒiŋuc jazac: ‘No sambâŋkonec dâŋ mupe hufâjec i ŋoŋe ŋaŋac hone manac embieŋ.
Irec nemu moc norao ʒuhuckehuc qâqâtâc‐ticne siliwazi me golzi bapa i mi enʒepieŋ.
Mâreŋzi alata banarenʒepieŋ, erâ fainao qowi bâzi â wama bazi lama bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic rike‐narenʒepieŋ. Noni mupe hae mâreŋ moc ira me ira araŋ banareniŋmuo ine maic‐ŋopahuc jambuŋ‐ŋopapemu.
Irec go qânâzi alata moc banarezo murâ ine qânâ fasaekicnezi mi bazemec, go aeŋ wiaczi qânâ he fasaec etecne omane eocmu hâcne.
Go ririo fehuc alata‐nane mi maickezemec, iŋuc etecne alata maŋfuŋnao mimige jaŋgeŋkezacte.’
“Sâcmutâc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mutâcne‐jarezemec:
Go Hebiraio kiŋaŋ qaqa ŋic moc furine bacmu ine kiŋaŋ qagarehuc juhame jara 6 tarazejec, jara namba 7 ira ine mâc râetec ra rambaŋ juzejec.
E bucticne warewecko buc jaha râetec ra juzejec, me ŋonâŋ‐ticnehec warepicko ŋonâŋnehec mâmâc râec‐jofatec ra juzepirec.
Me bomboŋ‐ticnezi ŋokac moc râcneme naru motec rocjopaocmuo ine ŋokac mecne naru motec mecne jaŋe mâmâc bomboŋte biŋe ehapie ŋic e bucticne ra juzejec.
Me kiŋaŋŋiczi ʒiŋuc muocmu, ‘Maŋnanezi bomboŋ‐nane mecne, ŋonâŋ naru motecfâc‐nane mecne jaŋerao domakacte no bucnane rambaŋ mi jupemu,’
iŋuc mume bomboŋ‐ticnezi Anuture maio râeme domazejec. Eme motâcko me motâc wâtuŋko râeme domaha bomboŋ‐ticnezi hazecne bâmârâŋkezejec; iŋuc eme kiŋaŋ qaqa‐ticne jusanaŋkezejec.
“Ŋic moc e otâ‐ticnezi kiŋaŋ qaqa juocte manasuhuc furire erâ qikiŋneocmu ine juku bomboŋ‐ticnezi kiŋaŋ qaqa ŋic jaŋere sâcko râeme mi razejec.
Me bomboŋ‐ticnezi e jahacne biŋe qarâ juku ere takickeocmuo ine ŋic moctao furire jaha râezejec. E ŋic furune jaŋerao furire râeocte mi manacnekicne, e eatuckewec irec.
Me ŋokâ‐ticnere biŋe qaocmuo ine e jahacne otâfâc ejareekac sâc ijaha ecnezejec.
Ŋokac moc ʒuhuckerâ roocmuo ine bâbâni rokicne e nânâ me ŋaqi qoruc me sahac‐ticne mi sakarecnezejec.
Wiac jahec â moc i mi ecneocmuo ine ŋokaczi tofa mi bazucnehuc mâc beherâ rambaŋ juzejec.
“Ŋic moczi moc ŋic âgo‐ticne moc qâhâmome e jahacne wâc qâhâmozo
Me hâmocne mâcne, ʒâpâ qaocte qame Anutuzi manaha hâmoocmuo ine ʒika qaqa ŋic e mâreŋ moc mutâcnepe ira sâcne wiserâ ra juzejec.
Me ŋic moczi âgo‐ticne somâckerâ ututuŋ qâhâmoocmu e alata‐nane maicke‐bipieha sifu bârârietec hâmozejec.
“Ŋic moczi neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne jofaocmu e wâc qâhâmozo.
“Ŋic moczi âgo‐ticne fiuc rorâ furi roocte ŋic gâcne qikiŋne‐jareocmu me e jahacne kiŋaŋ qaqa juocte fiuc roocmu ŋic iŋucne hâmocko râezo.
“Moc e neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne sâwec‐jofaocmu e wâc hâmocko râezo.
“Ŋic jaŋe dâŋ mumuc ehuc moczi ŋic âgo‐ticne qânâzi me mehuhuŋzi heme mi hâhâmo mâc puriŋ erâ
juku mocwâc biaŋkerâ gunuo sâcne juocmuo ine ʒika qawec ŋic e okac tâmiric juzejec. Mâc âgo‐ticnere gie dameŋ sipirickekicnere furine râcnezejec, ehuc dotazi erao gie baocte wâc furine mâmâc râezejec.
“Ŋic moc e kiŋaŋ qaqa‐ticne ŋic me ŋokac qaha qaha hâmoocmuo ine bâbâtiŋko râezo.
Me kiŋaŋ qaqazi ʒoaŋ 2 me 3 ʒuhuckerâ juocmu ine ŋic e bâbâtiŋko mi râezo, e jahacne moneŋzi kiŋaŋ qaqa furine bawec irec.
“Ŋic jaŋe ʒika kosa qahuc ŋokac kiwechec moc qa hetuŋ ecnepie kogoc hâmocne rome faicnao huc ʒâic mi fuacneocmuo ine ŋokac qa hetuŋ ecnewec ŋic eki okacne moneŋ râcneme tarazejec. Ine ŋokac ŋowenezi kogoc hâmocnere furi muocmu sâc râezejec, erâ i mumutara ŋic jaŋe mutâcnehapie râezejec.
Me huc ʒâic me hâmoc fuacneocmuo ine okacne ŋic e wâc hâmozejec,
ʒâŋere okacne ʒâŋe jaha, micsiecte okacne micsiec jaha, mere okacne me jaha, kikere okacne kike jaha,
ʒocte okacne ʒoc jaha, wicte okacne wic jaha, ʒâpâre okacne ʒâpâ jaha râezemec.
“Ŋic moczi kiŋaŋ qaqa‐ticne ŋic me ŋokac ʒâŋenao qahuc ʒâŋe‐ticne sipirickeocmuo ine ʒâŋe‐ticnere erâ mâc râeme ra rambaŋ juzejec.
Me kiŋaŋ qaqa‐ticne ŋic me ŋokac ere micsiec moc hemârâŋkeme wahaocmuo ine micsiec‐ticnere erâ mâc râeme rambaŋ juzejec.
“Bulimakao moczi ŋic me ŋokac moc ʒuŋenezi heme hâmome bulimakao e qânâzi hehâmorâ biuc‐ticne mi nânʒepieŋ, bulimakao rune ine okacnere mi mucnezo.
Me bulimakao e ʒuŋenezi ŋic hecjopaku biac maŋne eha rune uŋdâŋ âzâcnepie mana‐bipiehuc mi soŋaŋkeha ŋic me ŋokac moc hehâmome ine bulimakao qânâzi hehâmorâ rune mâmâc qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Me moneŋzi juju‐ticne kitâcneocte mucnepie ine jaŋe juju‐ticnere okacne moneŋ ʒare muniŋmu sâc râezejec.
Me ŋic mocte naru me motec moc hehâmoocmuo ine sâc ijaha ecnezo.
Kiŋaŋ qaqa ŋic me ŋokac moc hehâmoocmuo ine bulimakao runezi kiŋaŋ qaqare bomboŋ siliwa moneŋ 30 râcnezejec, bulimakao ine qânâzi hehâmozo.
“Ŋic moczi nombâŋ beheme aaŋ foocmu me nombâŋ rorâ mi qofackeme bulimakao me doŋgi moczi huocmuo
ine nombâŋ runezi okacne râezejec, ine qowi rune moneŋ hâcne râcnezejec, â qowi hâmocne izi nombâŋ rune e jahacne biŋe ezejec.
“Ŋic mocte bulimakaozi ŋic mocte bulimakao heme hâmoocmuo ine bulimakao ɋâricne juocmu e râepie moneŋ kitâcneme moneŋ i sâckoa bâtâc bazepirec, â bulimakao hâmocne i hezurâ iŋuc jaha bârâwiŋnezepirec.
Me bulimakao e râŋgeŋne, runezi fuŋne‐ticne iŋuc biac juwicnao manarâ sifu mana‐bipiehuc sapao mi râewecko ine bulimakao hâmocnere okacne bulimakao jaha râezejec, â hâmocnezi e jahacne biŋe ezejec.
“Ŋic moczi bulimakao me lama moc fiuc rorâ qa nâc eocmu me furire râeocmu ine bulimakaore okacne bulimakao 5 â lamare okacne lama 4 iŋuc râezejec.
Fiuc roro e fiuc rohuc juhame jaha runezi bâfuarâ qâhâmoocmuo ine ʒika qahuc kiŋ bâfuawec mi mucnezo.
Me fiuc roro biac mi qâhâmohuc ŋafe moc huckehuc qâhâmoocmuo ine ʒika qahuc kiŋ bâfuawec muzo. Fiuc rorozi okacne râe‐jâmbâŋkezejec, mi focnekacko ine wiac fiuc rowec irec okacne e jahacne ŋic gâcne qikiŋne‐jarehuc furi ronʒepieŋ.
Qowi fiuc rokicne, bulimakao me lama me doŋgi i ɋâricne jaha juha bâfuaniŋmuo ine bârisiehuc e jahacnaonec moc ʒuhuckezejec.
“Me ŋic moczi qowifâcne seacko me waiŋ gieo nânâ nâniŋte râec‐jopame rambaŋ juku âgo‐ticnere gieo raʒirâ nânâ wiac sipirickeniŋmu irec okacne ine e jahacne gieonec â waiŋkonec wiac biaŋne jâmbâŋ râezejec.
“Me ŋic moczi gieo ʒoc râeme ʒa fofotâc raku nâŋ gagate rohuc padi qa râec ekicne me gieo doma rakac me gieo wiac gâcne gâcne ʒafâreocmuo ine ʒoc râeme ʒawec eki okacne bazu‐fârezejec.
“Me ŋic moc e moneŋ me mafa wiac gâcne i ŋic âgo‐ticnezi soŋaŋkecneocte râcneme râeme foha ere fickonec fiuc ropie ʒâhec fiuc roro bâfuaniŋmuo ecnepie bârisiehuc e jahacnaonec irec sâc jaha ʒuhuckerâ râezejec.
Fiuc roro mi bâfuaniŋmuo ine fic runezi âgo‐ticnere wiac fiuc rowec me mâcne irec fuŋne taniŋkeocte Anuture maio fuarâ fuŋne‐ticne muzejec.
“Me ŋic moczi ŋic âgo‐ticne qorickehuc bulimakaore me doŋgire me lamare me ŋaqi qoructe me wiac irec me irec, ‘Ine hâcne nore,’ iŋuc muhuc hehefaric epire mâmâc jaha Anuture maio râec‐jofazo. Eme Anutu e ere me ere fuŋne bataniŋkeocmu ŋic e hâcne âgo‐ticne okacne bafehuc râcnezejec.
“Me ŋic moc e âgo‐ticne doŋgi me bulimakao me lama me qowi moc soŋaŋkecneocte râcneocmu, eme qowi izi hâmoocmu me puriŋ eocmu me ŋic moczi mi honehuc mocko ro bawiseniŋmuo ine
ŋic jajahec jahe Anuture maio mumupaŋ dâŋ muzepirec. Eme ŋic e âgo‐ticnere wiac fiuc roocte meticne sicnewec me mâcne irec fuŋne taniŋkezejec. Eme qowi runezi mumupaŋte maname fârine eha okacnere mi muzejec.
Fiuc rowecko ine fiuc rorozi rune okacne bazucnezejec.
Me qowi mimicnezi kisuckembiŋko ine qâŋɋâŋne ro bafisime fuŋne taniŋkezejec, eme qowi kisuckekicnere okacne râeocte mi muzo.
“Me ŋic moczi âgo‐ticnere qowi moc gie sawa bacneocte bajuha kikene bazuocmuo me runezi mi honeha hâmoocmuo ine okacne furu jaha bazucnezejec.
Me runezi honeha hâmoocmuo ine okacne râeocte mi muzo. Qanaŋ qowire gie furi râewecko ine gie furizi okacne ezejec.
“Me ŋic moczi naru ŋokac moc ŋicbiŋe tâmiric juha eatuckehuc bâsâqoreocmuo ine ŋokac furi furu jaha râerâ ŋonâŋ‐ticne bazejec.
Mamac‐ticnezi mi râcnehuc sakare‐jâmbâŋkeocmu ine ŋokac ʒeŋoŋte furi fehuc roeŋgopieŋ irec sâcko jâmbâŋ râcnezejec.
“Ŋokac hafec bapa e manacnetec mi juzejec.
“Ŋic moczi qowihec sâqocne baocmu e hâmo‐jâmbâŋkezejec.
“Ŋic moczi Anutu sawa mâcne, nemu gâcne wâc bâzi rike‐jareocmu e bâsirowezo.
“Ŋoŋe ŋic jaba moc wiac sâctiri mi ecnenʒepieŋ â gie bapare faficne wâc boc mi ecnezo, ŋaŋac wâc Aigita mâreŋko jaba jumbiŋ irec.
Ŋoŋe hozec bekâ jaŋe mi bomac‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Bomac‐jopapie wira wâwâsic enarepie manarâ mana‐jare‐jâmbâŋkepemu,
ehuc kimbeŋ‐nanere ʒocbâruŋzi ʒâseŋ‐ŋopapemu â ʒika‐nanezi qâhâmoc‐ŋopape ŋonâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic hozec erâ juniŋmu, â naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic mamac tâmiric erâ juniŋmu.
“Go ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋeraonec moczi hapetac erâ gohec juekac e moneŋ moc râcnecmuo i juku okacne bafehuc gareocte mi muzemec, â moneŋ nâfocne ʒuhucke‐gareocte wâc mi muzemec.
Me go moneŋte okacne âgogere ŋaqi rocmuo ine ʒoaŋzi mi huha mocwâc bârisiecnezemec.
Wiac izi mocjaha rurufa‐ticne hâcne, izi hâcne sahac‐ticnere foŋ, i tâmiric ine wemo wiac rufarâ guŋ foocmu? E no wira wâwâsic enareocmuo manacnepemu, no buuruc‐nanehec hâcne.
“Go Anutu mi musoriŋkezemec, erâ wâc ŋicfâcge jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ mi sâweckezemec.
“Nânâ mâririge â waiŋ mâririge irecnec gâcne tahare biŋe mi sakarehuc afeckerâ râezemec. Mârâc ŋokâge ine nore biŋe qazemec.
Bulimakao â lamafâcge jaŋere mârâc fufua iŋuc jaha ezemec, i neŋgocnehec juha ʒoaŋ 7 tarazejec, ʒoaŋ namba 8 ira ine no narezemec.
“Ŋoŋe ŋic tirine junarenʒepieŋ, ehuc gieo qowi kisuckekicne irec biucne i mi nânâ qâto behe‐jarenʒepieŋ.
“Go micko âkec mi ezemec. Go ŋic sâqoc qaqocne hehesic‐ticnere mi bafickehuc eebapa‐ticnere fuŋne mutaniŋkezemec.
Go ŋic guru sâko jaŋe sâqocne bazo mupie mi qâtec‐jopazemec, erâ dâŋficko ŋic guru sâko jaŋere hata hehesicne âtehuc dâŋ tiŋne mi muhasickezemec.
Me ŋic fekicne mocte dâŋ fuame fuŋne‐ticne mi hesoŋkezemec.
“Kisâgere bulimakao me doŋgi qâsorierâ juha bâfuacmuo ine runerao bârisie‐jâmbâŋkezemec.
Qaisocguekac ere doŋgi e mafa‐ticnezi kidapeme foha hone qâoma mi ehuc fahareocte bafickezemec.
“Go ŋic waha qaqanezi dâŋgie bahuc juhame dâŋticne mi muhasickezemec.
Go ŋic qorickehuc dâŋko rârâe i mi ezemec, erâ ŋic kiŋ bahac tâmiric hâmoocte mi mutaracnezemec, no ŋic kiŋ bahachec mi akickepemu irec.
Go micmuacte furi mi rozemec, micmuacte furizi dâŋ mumu ŋic ʒâŋe sâoc ejareekac â kiŋ tâmiric jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere dâŋ muhasickeekac.
“Ŋic jabane moc mi bomackenʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe ŋaŋac Aigita mâreŋko jaba jumbiŋte jaba jujure fuŋne manaeŋgopieŋ hâcne.
“Go giegao nânâ wiac sara mama erâ fârine qa roro ehuc juhaŋte jara 6 tarazejec.
Jara namba 7 ira ine mâc behetec foha hapetac gurufâcge jaŋe ro nâc epie tiwâne fome kâte qowi jaŋe nâfârenʒepieŋ. Waiŋ giegere â oliwa giegere sâc ijaha ezemec.
“Go ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 giege bahuc juzemec, ʒoaŋ namba 7 ira ine ŋemanazemec, i doŋgi bulimakaofâcge jaŋe ŋemananiŋte â kiŋaŋ narugere ŋokâ â ŋic jabane ficgao jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe wâc âke mâteŋ‐jopaocte iŋuc ezemec.
Dâŋ ŋazapo i sasawa aimuŋ bajuhuc junʒepieŋ. Nemu gâcne jaŋere ʒâŋe mu bâuac mi enʒepieŋ, erâ ʒâŋe wiac iŋucne micŋeŋickonec moc mi wahazejec.
“Jara mocte maŋnao nore hombaŋ ŋepie arec jahec â moc ezejec.
Ŋoŋe goreŋ sowa hombaŋ ŋenʒepieŋ, ine noni muŋarepo irec sâcko goreŋ sowa juhapie ʒoaŋ 7 tarazejec, erâ dameŋ bakicne, mosa April ira iŋuc enʒepieŋ; ŋoŋe mosa ira hâcne Aigita mâreŋkonec wahambiŋ. Irec moczi nore maio metariŋ mi fisizejec.
Hombaŋ moc ine nânâ bâbâsu hombaŋ ŋenʒepieŋ, gieo nânâ sara mama embiŋ irec fârine bâbâni rorore hombaŋ hâcne. Erâ qa roro hombaŋ ŋenʒepieŋ wâc. Ira hâcne gie‐ŋeŋicte fârine gieonec ro qâzuc eeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic sasawa ŋoŋe jara mocte maŋnao Wofuŋ Anuture maio arec jahec â moc fuanʒepieŋ.
“Qowi bâzi‐nanere soc i poroŋ goreŋhec mi rikezemec, erâ tiwâ bâzi‐nanere wokemaŋ irec tiwâne foha hae mi furezejec.
“Gieonec nânâ bâbâsu biaŋne jâmbâŋ i Wofuŋ Anutugere ufuŋko bafezemec. Go lama motec neŋgocnere susuhec mi rikezemec.
“Manakic, no aŋelo moc sorepe bânie‐garehuc hatao roroŋ sasapec egarerâ hae mâreŋ bâʒâwe‐garepo ira râecguzejec.
Go ere maio aimuŋ juhuc dâŋticne mana rereŋ ezemec. Go mi râŋgeŋkecnezemec, e ʒâŋe‐nane maŋkerâ bajukacte qaqatara‐ŋeŋic mi bâtâmire‐ŋareocmu.
“Ŋoŋe dâŋticne mana rereŋ ejâmbâŋkehuc no dâŋ mukopac sâc efâreniŋmuo ine no râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe râsi ejarepemu â kisâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe fific guguriŋ ejarepemu.
“Aŋelo‐nanezi bânie‐garehuc Amori ŋic â Hitiŋic â Periʒi ŋic â Kanaaŋ ŋic â Hiwiŋic â Jebusi ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko râecguhame no jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopapemu.
Go jaŋere nemu wiac fodape‐jarerâ araŋ mi bajarezemec, â eebapa‐jeŋicte sâcko wiac moc mi ezemec, aricne, go ɋâŋ qâqâtâc‐jeŋic hetâc qâtâtiehuc qânâ wâtuŋ‐jeŋic i wâc henʒaŋ qanʒaŋne‐fârezemec.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic no kiŋaŋ qanarenʒepieŋ, eme no poroŋ â opâ‐ŋeŋic jambuŋkehuc ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋickonec huc ʒâic‐ŋeŋic bârâriepemu.
Ŋokac moczi moc kogoc hâmocne roro me hufiŋne juju mâsi iŋucne mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko moc mi fuaocmu. Noni hâcne juju‐ŋeŋicte dameŋ mutâcnepe feriŋ wahariŋ mi ezejec.
No wiac bipinehec mupe bânie‐ŋareme ŋic gurune gurune bâfuac‐jopaniŋmu sâc jaŋe maŋ bâsifuc ejarepemu â râsifâc‐ŋeŋic sasawa jaŋe ejarepe râpec‐ŋopaniŋmu.
Erâ no bitu gâpâc mupe fuarâ bânie‐ŋarehuc Hiwiŋic â Kanaaŋ ŋic â Hitiŋic ŋoŋere maionec jâpec‐jopame wisenʒepieŋ.
No jara mocjaha irec maŋnao ŋoŋeraonec jâpec‐jopape mi wiseniŋmu, iŋuc epe mâreŋzi tuhu foha qowi mimicnezi sawe mâririackerâ râsi eŋarenʒipiŋte.
No dameŋ sâc âketâc âketâc jâpec‐jopahuc juhape ŋoŋe sawe mâririackerâ mâreŋ raucke‐fârerâ junʒepieŋ.
Eme no mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicte ma i Hâwec Bâbâroŋkonec fuŋkerâ raku Filisa ŋic jaŋere hâwecko râepe mickezejec, erâ wâc mâreŋ burocnaonec fuŋkerâ raku Eufrata opâo tarazejec, no mâreŋ rune jaŋe ŋoŋere meo râec‐jopape jâpec‐jopapie ŋoŋeraonec wisenʒepieŋ hâcne.
Ŋoŋe jaŋehec me nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic moc mi enʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋoŋere mâreŋko ʒuhuckerâ mi junʒepieŋ, ira juku sâqocnere mu qafeŋ eŋarepie behecnunʒipiŋte; ŋoŋe nemufâc‐jeŋic kiŋaŋ qajareniŋmuo ine izi wiwitic‐ŋeŋic jâmbâŋ eocmu hâcne.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Aroŋ â Nadaba â Abihu erâ Israe micne bapa 70 jaŋehec Wofuŋ norao wefuzemec, erâ taic domahuc fodape‐narenʒepieŋ.
Ehame Mose go bucge no maicnuhaŋ jaŋe bembeŋko mi warenʒepieŋ, â ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ine gohec moc mi wefu‐jâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Mose e jaŋerao fuarâ Wofuŋte dâŋ â mumutâc jaza‐fârewec. Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe musereckehuc mumbiŋ: “Wofuŋzi dâŋ muwec i sasawa efârenaŋmu.”
Eme Mose e Wofuŋte dâŋ sasawa qâreŋke‐fârewec. Erâ furic uupicte faharerâ tiki fuŋnao alata moc bawec, ehuc Israe ŋicguru 12 irec sâc qânâ wâtuŋ 12 jaha âkendâŋnewec.
Iŋuc erâ Israe ŋic socɋâri jaŋe jaza sorec eme qowi bâzi rikembiŋ â bulimakao hezurâ wama bubiaŋ bâzi rikembiŋ wâc.
Eme Mose e soc gâcne rorâ râqâcko hoŋkeme huwec â gâcne ine alata faio tiewec.
Iŋuc erâ ʒâʒâficte papia rorâ ŋic ŋokac wose‐jarewec, eme jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Wofuŋzi dâŋ muwec i sasawa mana rereŋ efârenʒepeneŋ.”
Iŋuc mupie Mosezi soc rorâ ŋic tie‐jarerâ muwec: “Dâŋ mukicne sasawa irec sâcko Wofuŋzi ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic ewec irec soc ʒine hâcne.”
Eme Mose â Aroŋ â Nadaba â Abihu erâ Israe micne bapa 70 jaŋe tikio fembiŋ.
Ferâ Israe ŋic jaŋere Anutu kecʒiŋuc honembiŋ: Kike‐ticnere ââtesiŋ i qânâ furi sâko â sambâŋ hawari iŋucne tatamac jâmbâŋ.
Eme e meticnezi Israe ŋic kâcɋene mi jopawec, aricne, jaŋe Anuture maio domahuc nânâ opâ nâmbiŋ.
Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec: “Go norao tikio wefurâ woŋec juc, eme no ŋic jaŋe jaza qazuc ecmurâ sâcmutâc dâŋ â Sâcmutâc Sanaŋ qorac tapao qâreŋkepo i garezepac.”
Eme Mose e kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Josua ehec ʒawierâ Anuture tikio fepic.
Micne bapa jaŋe ine ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ʒira woŋec ŋehapie risie‐ŋarezeperec. Manaŋgopieŋ, Aroŋ â Huru jahe ŋoŋehec jukopirec, irec moc e dâŋ moc bajukacko jaherao razejec.”
Eme Mose e tikio feme karoraczi tiki foŋkewec.
Ehame Wofuŋte tatamaczi Sinai tiki botâŋnao waha ŋesanaŋkewec. Eme karoraczi tiki foŋkerâ foha ʒoaŋ 6 tarawec, ʒoaŋ 7 ira ine Wofuŋzi karorac maŋkonec Mose wiracnewec.
Wofuŋte tatamac fuawec i Israe ŋicguru jaŋere ʒâŋe faio ʒoc iŋucne tiki botâŋnao fuawec.
Eme Mose e karorac maŋko raʒirâ tikio fewec. Ferâ juhame ŋafe ʒoaŋ 40 tarawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnerâ muwec:
“Go Israe ŋicguru jaŋe taha wiac râe‐nareniŋte jazazemec. Râeniŋte maŋjeŋic afeckeekac ŋic i jaŋeraonec sasawa nore taha ronʒepieŋ.
Jaŋeraonec tahare wiac kecʒiŋuc ronʒepieŋ: Gol, siliwa, aeŋ bâbâroŋ,
qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne, qoruc hahameŋne â noniŋ kanʒaŋne,
lama ŋicnere sahac peŋ bâbâroŋzi rikekicne, noniŋ sahac â jâmiŋjâc,
lambere wokemaŋ, rurua wokemaŋte â hosâc âsu ririkere wiac âsu biaŋhec.
Erâ taha bapare qoqonaŋ ŋaqi â qâticnere qânâ furi sâko bâbâroŋ â qânâ furi sâko gâcne gâcne.
Eme jaŋe furufic moc banarepie no ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ŋec juc ezepac.
No tiri boze â maŋnao wiac ŋeraocmu hawarine gowatupemu irec sâcko jâmbâŋ bafârenʒepieŋ.
“Eme jaŋe jâmiŋjâczi katapa moc banʒepieŋ, ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc kubi jajahec â nâfocne, otecne‐ticnere sâc kubi mocjaha â nâfocne â hâŋne‐ticnere sâc kubi mocjaha â nâfocne jaha.
Eme maŋne â sahacne gol ɋaɋacnezi foŋkezemec, erâ qaŋeŋne moc golzia râreckerâ bazemec.
Erâ reŋ raraʒi 4 golzi barâ katapa kikenao basanaŋkezemec, ine ŋifec jajahec â ŋifec jajahec.
Erâ jâmiŋzi reŋ jajahec fasaerâ golzi foŋkezemec wâc.
Eme katapa reŋkeniŋte reŋ i katapa ŋifecnao reŋ raraʒi basanaŋkekicnao esorietec raʒizejec.
Eme reŋ i moc mi unuckehuc katapahec jaha behepie fozejec.
Erâ sâcmutâc dâŋ garepemu i katapa maŋko râetec hurâ fozejec.
Iŋuc efârerâ golzi tapane moc bazemec, ʒoricne‐ticne kubi jajahec â nâfocne â otecne ine kubi mocjaha â nâfocne.
Erâ go kerubim hawari jajahec golzia bazemec, gol hedapirekicnezi hâcne tapanere qaŋeŋnao bazemec.
Kerubim hawari moc ŋifec â moc ŋifec iŋuc râec‐jofatec jahe tapanehec qâfâsâehuc qaŋeŋne ŋifec â ŋifec ŋezepirec.
Eme kerubim jahe mamaic erâ ŋehuc fakec‐jekic tapa hezickehuc faicpec qaratiepire domazejec, ehame ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic tapaopec enduŋkezepirec.
Go tapane katapa fainao hetec ŋezejec â katapa maŋnao ine sâcmutâc garepemu i râetec hurâ fozejec.
Eme gohec ira bâbâfuac enacmu, erâ kerubim tapa fainao ŋekopirec jahere ŋondeŋko domahuc dâŋ gazapemu sasawa i Israe ŋicguru jaza mutâc ezemec.
“Eme go jâmiŋzi tebo moc bazemec, ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc kubi jajahec â otecne‐ticnere sâc kubi mocjaha â hâŋnere sâc kubi mocjaha â nâfocne.
Erâ gol ɋaɋacnezi foŋkerâ mecqaŋeŋne rârec rârec ine gol ɋâfoŋnezi bazemec.
Erâ tebo rârec rârec qaŋeŋne moc metapere sâc, â irec qaŋeŋne moc golzi ba akic ekicne i mâmâc râezemec.
Erâ irec reŋ raraʒi 4 golzia barâ gurucne 4 kikene fokacko basanaŋkezemec.
Reŋ raraʒi ine qaŋeŋnere heririŋko jâmbâŋ domazejec.
Go reŋ i jâmiŋzi fasaerâ golzi ɋorockezemec, eme reŋ izi hâcne katapa reŋkezo.
Eme go taha wiac rârâere oto â amae â waiŋ bâzire kiruŋ â râqâc kâwinehec bazemec wâc, i gol ɋaɋacnezia ba akic ehuc bazemec.
Erâ go tebo ira poroŋ furu mukicne i dameŋ sâc nore maio râetec fozejec.
“Lambe dodoma i gol ɋaɋacnezia bazemec. Kikene â wâtuŋne i gol hedapirekicnezi bazo, â râqâc‐ticne erinehec â ʒariŋ ɋoŋnehec i gol hâcbuczia bazemec.
Eme wâtuŋkonec sohocne 6 râwiŋnerâ domanʒepieŋ, ŋifec sohocne jahec â moc â ŋifec sohocne jahec â moc jaha.
Erâ wawec kaoŋne ɋoŋnehec iŋucne ʒariŋ ɋoŋne jahec â moc sohocne ŋifec â ŋifec ira bazemec; lambe dodomare wâtuŋkonec sohocne 6 râwiŋnerâ domaŋgopieŋ ira iŋuc hâcne bafârezemec.
Erâ lambe dodomare wâtuŋko ʒariŋ ɋoŋnehec iŋucne 4 râezemec.
Ine ʒiŋuc bahuc râezemec; ʒariŋ ɋoŋnehec sohocne moc biri wâŋ irec juwicnao, moc biri 2 irec juwicnao, moc biri 3 irec juwicnao, iŋuc hâcne ehuc sohocne 6 ŋifec â ŋifec râwiŋnerâ domaŋgopieŋkoa râe razemec.
Sohocne â ʒariŋ ɋoŋnehec i ɋâfâsâerâ fozejec, ehame gol ɋaɋacne hedapirekicnezi bazemec.
Erâ go lambe‐ticne 7 bazemec, eme lambe i fainao hetec ŋehuc wiac mamai fokac i batamae‐fârezejec.
Lambe qoruc bâbâtâc â râqâc‐ticne i gol ɋaɋanezia bazo.
Gol bâwiŋke‐hâmokicne ŋemâc‐ticne 100 izi lambe dodoma â wiac i sasawa bazo hâcne.
Erâ manakic, tikio hawarine gaza gowatuc epemu irec sâcko jâmbâŋ bafârezemec.
“Tiri boze i qoruc sanaŋ 10 izi bazemec, ine qoruc fâfâsâc â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ furi sâko â keŋkeŋne izi bazemec, ehuc qoruc i mutec qâreŋnehec fupie kerubim hawari fuazejec.
Qoruc sanaŋ moc ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc i kubi 28 â otecne‐ticne kubi 4 iŋuc efârezejec. Qoruc sanaŋ 10 i sasawa sâc ijaha bafârezo.
Ŋifec qoruc 5 ʒuʒuhuc ezo â ŋifec qoruc 5 iŋuc jaha ʒuʒuhuc ezo.
Erâ qoruc sanaŋ mocte qaŋeŋnao jâmbâŋ qoruc keŋkeŋnezi ʒâʒâfickere muc barâ râezemec, erâ qoruc sanaŋ mocte qaŋeŋnao jâmbâŋ ijaha ezemec.
Qoruc moc ʒâʒâfickere muc 50 â qoruc moc ʒâʒâfickere muc 50 jaha qoruc qaŋeŋnao basanaŋkezemec, ʒâʒâfickere muc i qoruc ŋifec â ŋifec sâckoa forazejec.
Eme go heheawic‐ticne 50 golzi bazemec, erâ heheawic izi qoruc ʒâficketec tiri boze mocjaha fuazejec.
“Erâ noniŋ kanʒaŋnezi qoruc moc barâ tiri boze fainao râetec forazejec, qoruc iŋucne 11 bazemec.
Qoruc buc buc i ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc kubi 30 â otecnere sâc kubi 4 ezejec, qoruc 11 jaŋere sâc mocjaha fuazejec.
Eme qoruc 5 jaŋe moc buc ʒâfic‐jopazemec, erâ qoruc 6 jaŋe iŋuc jaha moc buc ʒâfic‐jopazemec, erâ qoruc namba 6 i ine qazurâ qoruc boze mamai râetec faio fefec fozejec.
Ʒâʒâfickere muc 50 i qoruc qaŋeŋnao fokac irec mecnao râe razemec â ʒâʒâfickere muc 50 jaha i qoruc ʒuhucke itic ekicne irec qaŋeŋnao râe razemec.
Erâ go heheawic‐ticne 50 aeŋ bâbâroŋzi barâ ʒâʒâfic‐ticnao esoriezemec, iŋuc ehuctecne qoruc ʒâficketec mocjaha ezejec.
Eme qoruc bozere qoruc tofane foocmu, qoruc nâfocne hâcne, i tiri boze râpenao behepie waha domazejec.
Erâ qoruc ʒoricnere tofane i ŋifec kubi mocjaha â ŋifec kubi mocjaha jaha waha domahuc tiri boze sâockezejec.
Wiac i batec tarame qoruc boze bupunere qofac moc noniŋ kanʒaŋne peŋ bâbâroŋzi rikekicne izi barâ râezemec, erâ fainao sâsâoc moc lama ŋicnere sahaczi barâ qârufacnetec fozejec.
“Tarame tiri bozere katapa fasaezemec, ine jâmiŋzi fasaerâ hâŋ âecketec safatariŋ iŋucne domazejec.
Katapa ʒoricnere sâc kubi 10 â otecnere sâc kubi moc â nâfocne.
Katapa sasawa bareŋ‐jeŋic jajahec jajahec iŋuc bazo, i ʒuʒuhuc eniŋte tiri boze katapa‐ticnere iŋuc hâcne efârezo.
Katapa ʒare‐ticne ine ʒiŋuc fuazejec: Sâpe juwic mâreŋkopec ira katapa 20 âeckezo;
erâ rurumaŋnao râqâc siliwazi bakicne 40 hetec ŋezejec, katapa mocte râqâc jajahec, katapa mocte jajahec, iŋuc hetec sâcke‐fârezejec.
Eme sâpe faic mâreŋkopec iŋuc jaha katapa 20 âeckezemec;
ehuc râqâc‐ticne 40 i siliwazia bazo, katapa mocte râqâc jajahec, katapa mocte jajahec jaha.
Sâpe ʒoaŋ huhunaopec, fic râpenao hâcne, ira ine katapa 6 fasaerâ âeckezemec.
Erâ fic râpenere gurucko katapa jajahec âeckezemec.
Eme katapa i juwic rârâwiŋ domahuc feku faic hoŋeŋeŋ micne foocmuo iitic ezepirec. Ŋifec â ŋifec iŋuc hâcne domapire gurucne fuazejec.
Katapa 8 jaŋe hâcne râqâc‐jeŋic siliwazi bakicne iŋuc doma ranʒepieŋ, katapa mocte râqâc jajahec, mocte jajahec, iŋuc ŋerapie râqâc 16 ezejec.
“Erâ go babasanaŋ‐ticne jâmiŋjâczi bazemec.
Babasanaŋ 5 tiri boze neŋgoc ŋifecte biŋe â 5 izi tiri boze neŋgoc ŋifecte biŋe, â babasanaŋ 5 izi ine tiri bozere sâpe râpene, ʒoaŋ huhunaopec fokac irec biŋe.
Babasanaŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋko fokac izi katapa ombâŋnao ŋifeckonec ware raku ŋifecko tarazejec.
Katapa sasawa ine golzi ɋorockezemec, erâ babasanaŋte raraʒi i golzia bazemec, â babasanaŋ i wâc iŋuc jaha golzi ɋorockezemec.
Go iŋuc ehuctecne tiri bozere hawari tikio gowatukicne irec sâcko âkendâŋnezemec.
“Erâ ʒuhuckerâ qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ fâfâsâc izi ââketâc moc bazemec, ehuc mutec qoruc i qâreŋnehec fupie kerubim hawari fuazejec.
Erâ qoruc ââketâc i jâmiŋ wâtuŋ 4 golzi ɋorockekicne â heheawic‐ticne golzia bakicne ira ɋetickezemec, jâmiŋ wâtuŋzi ine râqâc siliwazi bakicne irec faio domazejec.
Erâ qoruc ââketâc i heheawic juwicnao fifitaczi basanaŋketec waha domazejec, ehame qoruc ââketâc râpenao qorac tapa katapa hetec ŋezejec; eme qoruc ââketâczi hâcne furufic â furu dindiŋ irec aka domazejec.
Go mumutaniŋ katapa furu dindiŋko ŋekac irec fainao tapane hetec ŋezejec.
Erâ tebo i ââketâc sahacnao hetec ŋeha lambe wâtuŋne tiri boze juwic mâreŋkopec tebo ŋifecnao domazejec, tebozi ine faic mâreŋkopec hetec ŋezejec.
“Qoruc bozeo raraʒire motâc moc i qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne â bâbâroŋ, qoruc fâfâsâc izi bazemec, qoruc geroŋkeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc hâcne.
Ââketâcte qoruc irec jâmiŋ wâtuŋ 5 fasaerâ golzi ɋorockezemec, â ɋeɋetic‐ticne i golzia bazo erâ wâtuŋte râqâc 5 jaha i aeŋ bâbâroŋzi ba akic ehuc bazemec.
“Go alata jâmiŋjâczi bazemec, ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc 5 kubi otecne‐ticnere sâc 5 kubi jaha, sâckoa fozejec hâcne, erâ hâŋne‐ticnere sâc kubi 3.
Faic gurucne 4 ira ʒuŋene 4 fasaerâ râezemec, eme ʒuŋenezi alatahec qâfâsâezejec. Eme alata aeŋ bâbâroŋzi foŋkezemec.
Wokemaŋ wiac alatao bohotame ʒure bataniŋ ezo â ʒafe‐ticne hezuzo irec kuʒi pake wiac barâ sapac â titie râqâc â sarac â ʒocrâqâc wiac mâmâc bazemec, erâ wiac sasawa i aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bafârezemec.
Erâ go sapa‐ticne moc aeŋ bâbâroŋzia bazemec â sapare gurucne 4 ira aeŋ bâbâroŋzi reŋ raraʒi 4 jaha barâ basanaŋkezemec.
Eme sapa i alatare qaŋeŋne rurumaŋnao âke hotahuc alata ombâŋnao wefu mickezejec.
Erâ alatare reŋ i jâmiŋzia fasaerâ aeŋ bâbâroŋzi ɋorockezemec.
Eme reŋ i reŋ raraʒinao esoriepie raʒizejec, eme reŋ i alata ŋifec â ŋifec fohame reŋke ranʒepieŋ.
Eme go alata hâcbuc mâcne, tikio gaza gowatuc ekicne irec sâcko katapazi maŋnehec bazemec.
“Go tiri boze hae ʒoŋa‐ticne bazemec wâc. Juwic mâreŋkopec ira qoruc fâfâsâc ɋetickepie waha domazejec, ŋifec ʒoric‐ticnere sâc kubi 100.
Wâtuŋ‐ticne 20 â wâtuŋte râqâc 20 jaha aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bazo, erâ heheawic â qârârâc‐ticne i siliwazi bazo.
Faic mâreŋkopec iŋuc jaha qoruc ʒoricne jaha domazejec, ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc kubi 100 jaha; erâ wâtuŋ 20 â râqâc‐ticne 20 jaha aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bazo, qârârâc‐ticne ine siliwazi bazo.
Â otecne‐ticne ʒoaŋ huhunaopec ira ine qoruc moc ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc kubi 50 izi waha domazejec, wâtuŋ‐ticne ine 10, erâ wâtuŋte râqâc 10 jaha wâc râezo.
Hae ʒoŋare otecne ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec izi kubi 50 jaha ezejec.
Motâc ŋifecnere qoruc i kubi 15 â wâtuŋ‐ticne 3 â wâtuŋte râqâc 3 jaha wâc, iŋuc hâcne fuazejec.
Â motâc ŋifecnere qoruc i kubi 15 jaha, erâ wâtuŋ‐ticne 3 â wâtuŋte râqâc 3 jaha wâc ŋezejec.
Sacmotâc sâko irec qoruc kubi 20 irec sâc, erâ qoruc i qoruc fâfâsâc keŋkeŋne, âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ erâ eri qâreŋ‐ticnehec bazo. Wâtuŋ‐ticne 4 â wâtuŋte râqâc 4 jaha râezo.
Wâtuŋ sasawa sac râreckehuc domaniŋmu jaŋe siliwazi ɋoroc‐jopazo, â heheawic‐jeŋic i siliwazia â râqâc‐jeŋic ine aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bazo.
Hae ʒoŋa ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc kubi 100 â otecne‐ticnere sâc kubi 50 â hâŋne‐ticne ine kubi 5, iŋuc fuazejec. Erâ qoruc fâfâsâc barâ ɋetickepie waha domazejec â wâtuŋ râqâc‐jeŋic ine aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bazo.
Tiri bozere wâcwiac sasawa taha giere bajuniŋmu i mecne erâ hae ʒoŋare wâtuŋte fâzâ mecne i iŋuc jaha aeŋ bâbâroŋzia bafârezo.
“Eme go Israe ŋicguru mujaretec tatamacte wokemaŋ ɋaɋacne baware‐garenʒepieŋ, i lambe qazepie sâcne ʒaocte iŋuc enʒepieŋ.
Eme tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo, ââketâc sahacnao hâcne, ira Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe hae ŋafeme fuŋkerâ lambe i Wofuŋte maio soŋaŋkehuc juhapie hae furezejec. Mâsi i Israe ŋicguru mimiŋzi ɋâric basanaŋkerâ bajupie hata sanaŋ‐jeŋic ezejec.
“Eme go hahacge Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe Israe ŋicguru jaŋeraonec rowosâec‐jopatec maŋfuŋgaoa juhuc nore taha bapa erâ junʒepieŋ, Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne Nadaba â Abihu â Eleaʒa erâ ltama jaŋe hâcne.
Eme go hahacge Aroŋ e ʒâŋe biŋehec â eri tatamachec juocte tiri ŋaqi‐ticne moc bazemec.
Eme maŋ mamana tahac‐jopape mamana sarichec juŋgopieŋ ŋic iŋucne jaŋe jazatec Aroŋ giere mufirieniŋte ŋaqi‐ticne ɋâtâpie nore taha bapa juzejec.
Ŋaqi wiac kecʒiŋuc ɋâtânʒepieŋ: Amecte qâ â qoqonaŋ ŋaqi â ŋaqi goŋgoŋhec erâ ŋaqi maŋne qaŋeŋnehec â duticne â umbika moc; wiac i hâcne hahacge Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne ɋâtâ‐jarepie nore taha bapa erâ junʒepieŋ.
“Ŋaqi wiac i baniŋte gol â qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ erâ qoruc fâfâsâc iŋuc ronʒepieŋ.
Qoqonaŋ ŋaqi i golzi â qoruc keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ furi sâko â qoruc fâfâsâc biaŋne fukicne izi banʒepieŋ.
I tofane ŋifec â ŋifec ɋaweo ʒuhucke itic enʒepieŋ.
Erâ bâmbândeŋ‐ticne i wiac izia, gol â qoruc keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ â fâfâsâc izi ba akic enʒepieŋ.
Erâ go qânâ furi sâko jajahec rorâ ira Israe ŋic guru 12 jaŋere ʒâŋe heutuckehuc qâreŋkezemec,
qânâ moc ira ʒâŋe 6 â qânâ moc ira ʒâŋe 6 jaha, ehuc fuambiŋ sâc heutuckehuc qâreŋkezemec.
Golzi wiac bapa ŋic e wiac furi sâkoo ʒâŋe heutuckeekac iŋuc hâcne Israe ŋic guru 12 jaŋere ʒâŋe heutuckehuc qânâ jajahecko qâreŋkezemec, ehuc râqâc kâwinehec golzia barâ maŋnao qânâ i râetec ŋezejec.
Iŋuc erâ qânâ jajahec i ɋawe ŋifec â ŋifec qoqonaŋ ŋaqi tofanezi ʒuʒuhuc‐jekicko Israe ŋic guru 12 jaŋere manasuhuc basanaŋkezemec. Eme Aroŋ e qânâ izi ɋawenao foha Wofuŋte maio jume Wofuŋzi jaŋere manasuhuc juzejec.
Eme go râqâc kâwinehec golzi bazemec.
Erâ kâpâcwâru jajahec gol ɋaɋacnezi bazemec, erâ i muc wiac mizeeŋgopieŋ iŋuc tinac mizerâ muc mizekicne kâpâcwâru i râqâcko basanaŋkezemec.
“Izi amecte qâ, dâŋ mumutarare ma hâcne moc ba akic ezemec; ehuc qoqonaŋ ŋaqi iŋucne gol â qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ â fâfâsâcne izi bazemec.
Ʒoricne â otecne‐ticne sâc mocjaha, 9 inses hâcne eha maine â râpene mâmâc bacjofazemec.
Eme qâ faio qânâ biri 4 birickezemec. Biri namba wâŋ ira qânâ furi sâko ʒiŋuc râezemec: Saradiu i qânâ bâbâroŋ, Topazi i qânâ âmuc âmucne â karapuŋke i qânâ ârâŋ ɋâri.
Biri namba 2 ira ine qânâ furi sâko kecʒiŋuc birickezemec: Emerali i qânâ ârâŋ ɋâɋâri, Safiri i qânâ keŋkeŋne â Daemaŋ i qânâ ɋaɋac taeŋne kiruŋ tinac.
Biri namba 3 ira qânâ ʒiŋuczi fozejec: Jaziŋti i qânâ bâbâroŋ soc tinac, Akata i qânâ buge iŋucne â Ametis i qânâ qondaŋ horiki tinac.
Biri namba 4 ine qânâ ʒiŋuc birickezemec: Berili i qânâ bâbâŋeŋ, Onisi i qânâ bâbâroŋ moc, â Jasipe i qânâ birâ birâ. Erâ qânâ i sasawa jaŋere râqâc golzi bafârezo.
Qânâ 12 hâcne ʒâŋe‐jeŋichec birickezo, â ʒâŋe ine Israe ŋokâfâc‐ticne jaŋere ʒâŋe heutuckehuc qâreŋkepie ŋic guru 12 jaŋere ma fozejec.
Amecte qâ irec masecne ine gol ɋaɋacnezi muc mizekicne tinac bazemec,
erâ hoŋeŋeŋ‐ticne jajahec golzia barâ qâ qaŋeŋne ŋifec â ŋifec ira basanaŋkezemec.
Muc jajahec golzi bakicne i ine qâ qaŋeŋnao hoŋeŋeŋ jajahec basanaŋ‐jofakicnao esoriezemec.
Iŋuc erâ gol tofa jahecne ine baferâ qoqonaŋ ŋaqire qânâ râqâcko basanaŋkezemec, ehame qoqonaŋ ŋaqire faio fozepirec.
Izi hoŋeŋeŋ jajahec golzi barâ qâ maŋnere qaŋeŋne juwicpec ŋifec â ŋifec qoqonaŋ ŋaqiopec ira bohotazemec.
Erâ gol hoŋeŋeŋ jajahec mocwâc ʒuhuckehuc barâ qoqonaŋ ŋaqi ʒuʒuhuc‐jekicko, qâ fokackoa bohotazemec.
Eme qâre hoŋeŋeŋ i qorucmuc keŋkeŋnezi qoqonaŋ ŋaqire hoŋeŋeŋ bohotakicne ira basanaŋkepie qâzi qoqonaŋ ŋaqionec mi ŋetarazejec.
Eme Aroŋ e tiri ufuŋko raʒiocmu sâc Israe ŋokâfâcne jaŋere ʒâŋe qâo fohapie amecnao bajuhuc Wofuŋte maio jaŋere manasuhuc juzejec.
Qâ ira ine dâŋ mumutarare ma jajahec, Urim â Tunim, fuŋne babataniŋ â mumutiŋte ma hâcne, i ŋihec‐jofatec Aroŋ e Wofuŋte maio fuaocmu sâc amec‐ticnao fohuc juzepirec. Aroŋ e iŋuc ehuc Israe ŋicguru jaŋere erâ mumutara ma i Wofuŋte maio amecnao foha juzejec.
“Eme qoqonaŋ ŋaqi irec juwicnao ŋaqi ʒoricne moc qoruc keŋkeŋnezi bazemec.
Ehuc qizeczi raʒiocte faic ʒâʒâŋiŋko hawecnehec bahuc qaŋeŋne mâmâc ɋâtâzo; erâ tâcnezacte momori jaŋere aeŋ ŋaqio hawecne fokac irec sâc bahuc ɋâtâzo.
Eme ŋaqi qaŋeŋne juwicne jâchândâŋ qâqâtâc qoruc keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ izi ba akic ehuc ɋâtâzemec. Erâ ŋondeŋko huhuc rârec rârec golzi goŋgoŋ biricke razemec.
Ine ŋaqi ʒoricne irec qaŋeŋne waha domakacko goŋgoŋ â jâchândâŋ ŋondeŋko huhuc doma raocte iŋuc enʒepieŋ.
Aroŋ e ŋaqi i hâcne rojuhuc tiri gie bazejec, erâ Wofuŋte maio fuaocte tiri ufuŋko raʒic wefuc eocmu sâc goŋgoŋzi dâŋeme mananʒepieŋ, goŋgoŋ tâmiric juhuc hâmozacte.
“Erâ go gol ɋaɋacnezi masapu moc barâ irec faio dâŋ ʒiŋuc heutuckehuc qâreŋkezemec: ‘Wofuŋte erâ bâtirikicne’.
Eme masapu i muc keŋkeŋnezi basanaŋkerâ maikura fainao bândeŋnetec mai fozejec.
Aroŋte maio fozejec hâcne, ehame Israe ŋicguru jaŋe tiri taha wiac i me i bâtirihuc kiŋ bahac bâfuaeŋgopieŋ i Aroŋzi de âsic efârezejec. Ine hâcne Wofuŋzi Israe ŋicguru jaŋere maname biaŋkeocte masapuzi Aroŋte maio fohuc juzejec.
“Eme ŋaqi maŋne ine qoruc hahameŋnezi qâqâreŋ bazemec, erâ du moc qoruc hahameŋnezia â umbika moc erinehec ba akic ezemec.
“Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne jaŋere ŋaqi maŋne â umbika erâ du ʒoricne batec huririnehec â hone aŋac eene ezejec.
Iŋuc erâ hahacge Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne hejaretec hume wokemaŋ rua‐jarezemec, ehuc giere mufiriec‐joparâ jambuŋ‐jopatec taha bapa junarenʒepieŋ.
Eme mimi‐jeŋic sâockeniŋte qoruc fâfâsâczi kike ŋaqi bajarezemec wâc, bifuŋ‐jeŋickonec waha dieŋko qazejec.
Eme Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo raʒiniŋmu sâc me tiri gie baniŋte alata maickeniŋmu sâc kiŋ bâfuarâ hâmonʒipiŋte wiac i hâcne rojunʒepieŋ. Sâcmutâc izi Aroŋ e jahacne â ɋâricfâc‐ticne hata sanaŋ‐jeŋic ezejec.
“Jaŋe taha bapa junareniŋte mufiriec‐jopahuc kecʒiŋuc ezemec: Bulimakao ŋicne motec ɋâric moc erâ lama ŋicne sahac fâsâc jajahec rocjopazemec.
Erâ poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric â poroŋ aŋacne goreŋ tâmiric jaha erâ poroŋ wokemaŋ ruacnekicne erâ poroŋ waizeŋ uucnezi bakicne i mâmâc rozemec.
Rorâ kâdoc mocko râetec hume kâdoc mecne bulimakao ŋicne mecne â lama ŋicne jajahec mecne i mâmâc bafisizemec.
Ehuc Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne ejaretec tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko ware domapie opâ rua‐jarezemec.
Erâ tiri ŋaqi rorâ ŋaqi maŋne â sahacne â qoqonaŋ ŋaqi erâ amecte qâ i Aroŋ hecnetec huzejec â qoqonaŋ umbika jomacnezemec.
Â duticne hecnetec hume du fainao tiri hendiŋ wâc hetec huzejec.
Eme rurua wokemaŋ rorâ qizecnao hesierâ wokemaŋ ruacnezemec.
Izi ŋokâfâcne jowac‐jopa warerâ ŋaqi maŋne hejaretec hume
umbika joma‐jarezemec â dujeŋic basanaŋke‐jarezemec. Iŋuc ejarehaŋtec taha bapa gie i sâcmutâc dâŋ fofo sanaŋ irec sâcko mejeŋicko fezejec. Go iŋuc hâcne ehuctecne Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne giere mufiriec‐jopazemec.
“Eme bulimakao ŋicne tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko jowa warezemec. Eme Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe mejeŋiczi bulimakao qizecne bânduŋkehapie
motâc fuŋnao Wofuŋte maio qazemec.
Qarâ bulimakao soc gâcne rorâ memotecgezi alata ʒuŋene ruacnezemec â soc gâcne ine alata fuŋnao hesiezemec.
Erâ wokemaŋ sasawa hobu wiac foŋkerâ fokac i mecne â bugâpâc mecne erâ râpe hândâŋ jajahec wokemaŋnehec mecne mâmâc rorâ alata faio rikezemec.
Biucne â sahacne â howiac‐ticne i ine sâqocne muhuc toma râpenao riketec ʒafârezejec.
“Tarame lama ŋicne moc rotecne Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe mejeŋiczi qizecne bânduŋkehapie qazemec,
erâ socticne rorâ alata rârec rârec tie razemec.
Erâ lama ŋicne hezurâ hone â kikene ʒurerâ qizecne â dâkâne alata faio rike‐fârezemec,
izi hâcne Wofuŋte qowi bâzi, âsu mumundoŋ fârine, Wofuŋte maio ʒoczi bâzi ririke hâcne.
“Iŋuc erâ lama ŋicne moc i rorâ Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe mejeŋiczi qizecne bânduŋkehapie
goki qâhâmorâ socticne gâcne izi Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne hazec tofa‐jeŋic fâreopec â meneŋgoc fâreopec â kike neŋgoc fâreopec rua‐jarezemec; â soc gâcne ine alata rârec rârec tie razemec.
Erâ ine soc alata faio fokac irecnec gâcne â rurua wokemaŋ i mâmâc rorâ Aroŋ mecne ŋokâfâcne mecne erâ wâc ŋaqi wiac‐jeŋic mâmâc tie‐jarezemec; iŋuc ejaretecne e jahacne â ŋaqi‐ticne erâ ŋokâfâcne â ŋaqi wiac‐jeŋic mâmâc tirine efâreniŋmu.
“Eme wiac ʒiŋuc ro bâmoc ezemec: Lama fârinere wokemaŋ, gecne wokemaŋnehec, hobunere wokemaŋ erâ bugâpâc â râpe hândâŋ jahecne wokemaŋnehec erâ ŋefacne fâreopec (lama ŋicne i mumufiriere lama hâcne).
Erâ nânâ poroŋ moc hâcbuc â poroŋ moc wokemaŋ opânehec bâsifuckerâ bakicne, erâ Wofuŋte maio poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric kâdochec ŋekac irecnec poroŋ moc.
Wiac i sasawa Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne mejeŋicko râetec foha Wofuŋte maio fenʒoŋkenʒepieŋ.
Epie tarame mejeŋickonec rorâ Wofuŋte maio bâzi âsu mumundoŋhec eocte qowi bâzi rikerâ ijaha ʒuhuckerâ alata faio rikezemec wâc. Izi Wofuŋte maio ʒoczi ririke bâzi hâcne.
“Eme Aroŋte mumufirie lama ŋicne irec amecne rorâ Wofuŋte maio fefenʒoŋkere bâzi eocte fenʒoŋketec gore biŋe ezejec.
Eme go Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋere mumufirie lama irec amecne â ŋefacne fenʒoŋkekicne i fefenʒoŋkere taha bâzi muhuc mutirizemec.
Israe ŋicguru jaŋe Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋere furi sanaŋ iŋuc hâcne râehuc junʒepieŋ. Israe ŋicguru jaŋe wama bâzi‐jeŋic rikeeŋgopieŋ irec tofane wiac izi hâcne taha bapa jaŋere biŋe ezejec. Jaŋe iŋuc epie Wofuŋ taha râcneŋgopieŋ eocmu.
“Aroŋte tiri ŋaqi i eki hâmome ŋokâfâcne jaŋere biŋe ezejec. Eme jaŋe rojuhapie wokemaŋ opâ rua‐jarehuc taha giere mufiriec‐jopazo.
Ŋokâfâcne jaŋeraonec moczi moc âkehoc‐ticne erâ taha bapa juhuc tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo raʒirâ taha gie baocmu eki hâcne ŋaqi i rojuhame ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
“Mumufirie lama biucne ine rorâ tiri tomao rikezemec.
Eme Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe lama biucne rikekicne i mecne erâ poroŋ kâdocko fokac i mecne mâmâc tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko nânʒepieŋ.
Jambuŋ‐jopahuc mufiriec‐jopazore wiac kiwiric‐jeŋic rokicne i hâcne nânʒepieŋ, wiac izi tiri fokacte ŋic omane moczi moc mi nâzejec.
Biuc mecne poroŋ mecne jambuŋkekicne i tiwâne foha hae fureocmuo ine tiwâne hâcne ʒocko râetec ʒafârezejec, i tiri fokacte mi nâzo.
“No dâŋ gaza qâmoc egarepo irec sâcko hâcne Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne ejarezemec. Eme jambuŋ â mumufirie gie bahuc juhaŋtec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
Go ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne bulimakao ŋicne rorâ Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋere kiwiric rohuc sâqocne tâtâmire bâzi rikezemec. Erâ alatare kiwiric rohuc sâqocne tâtâmire bâzi rikezemec wâc, erâ jambuŋkezore wokemaŋ ruacnezemec.
Alatare kiwiric roro gie i ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 iŋuc bahuc jambuŋkezemec. Iŋuc etecne alatazi tiri jâmbâŋ ŋeocmu, â moczi moc alata bâuaocmu e tirificte biŋe eocmu.
“Alata faio ine wiac kecʒiŋuc rike râec ezemec: Ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne lama jajahec jara‐jekic wâŋ ekicne.
Ine lama moc furicte â moc owâcne iŋuc rikec‐jofazemec.
Lama bâbâni rikecmu ira poroŋ uucne oto moc irec teŋkonec wâŋ oliwa wokemaŋ tase mocjahahec bâsifuckekicne i erâ taha bapare waiŋ opâ sâc ijaha ʒuhuckezemec.
Erâ lama moc ine owâcne bâzi rikezemec, ehuc poroŋ â waiŋ furicte taha râecmu sâc ijaha jâmbâŋ râetecne ʒoczi ʒâsi siŋkeme Wofuŋte âsu mumundoŋ fuazejec.
Tiwâ bâzi i ʒoaŋ sâc mimiŋzi ɋâric tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko Wofuŋte maio rikehuc junʒepieŋ. Ehame no dâŋ gazapemurâ ira gohec bâbâfuac ehuc juzeperec.
Eme ijaha Israe ŋicguru jaŋehec bâbâfuac ehapene eri tatamac‐nanezi tiri bacjopazejec.
Eme no iŋuc ehuc tutumaŋ qoruc boze mecne, alata mecne jambuŋkehuc Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne mâmâc jambuŋ‐jopapemu, eme jaŋe nore taha bapafâc juhuc kiŋaŋ qanarenʒepieŋ.
Ehame no Israe ŋicguru ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ŋec juc ehuc Anutu‐jeŋic erâ juzepac.
Iŋuc epe jaŋe, no Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋic, noni hâcne ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ŋec juc epemurâ Aigita mâreŋkonec batarac‐jopapo i hone mana tarac enʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋic no hâcne.
“Eme go jâmiŋjâczi hosâc âsu ririkere alata moc bazemec.
Ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc kubi mocjaha â otecne‐ticnere sâc kubi mocjaha jaha, sâc mocjaha hâcne ezejec. Hâŋne‐ticnere sâc ine kubi jajahec bazemec, ʒuŋene ine alatahec qâfâsâezejec.
Erâ alata faine mecne sâpene mecne ʒuŋene mecne i mâmâc gol ɋaɋacnezi ɋorockezemec, erâ mecqaŋeŋne moc golzia barâ rârec rârec qatec fozejec.
Eme reŋ raraʒi jajahec golzia barâ ŋifec â ŋifec mecqaŋeŋne juwicnao basanaŋkezemec, i alata reŋkezore reŋticne ira hâcne esoriepie raʒizejec.
Reŋticne i jâmiŋzia fasaerâ golzi jaha foŋkezemec.
Eme go ââketâc qoruczi qorac tapa katapa sâockehuc waha domaekac, â qorac katapare tapanezi Sâcmutâc Sanaŋ fomackeekac, erâ gohec bâbâfuac enacmu ŋondeŋne ira hâcne alata hetec ŋezejec.
Eme Aroŋ e alata irec fainao hosâc âsu rikezejec, furic sâc lambe wiac bâpiaŋkehuc iŋuc hâcne ezejec.
Erâ wâc owâc sâc lambe wiac qazehuc rikezejec. Izi mimiŋzi ɋâric Wofuŋte maio hosâc âsu ririke fohuc juzejec.
Ŋoŋe alata irec faio hosâc âsu jawane me qowi me taha bâzi mi rikenʒepieŋ, erâ soczi taha ira wâc mi hoŋkenʒepieŋ.
Eme Aroŋ e jara mocte maŋnao arec mocjaha alata ʒuŋene domakacko kiwiric rorore taha gie bazejec, ine sâqocne tâtâmire taha irec soczi jara mocte maŋnao arec mocjaha sâqocne bâbâtâmirere gie i mimiŋzi ɋâric bahuc juzejec. Alata izi Wofuŋte maio wiac furu dindiŋ ekac hâcne.”
Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋicguru wose qâreŋ ejarecmu dameŋ ira ŋic sasawa sahac taha‐jeŋic Wofuŋ qikiŋnecnenʒepieŋ, eme wose qâreŋ ejarehapie ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko huc hâmoc wiac moc mi fuarâ fozejec.
Ehame wose qâreŋ ejarekicne jaŋe sasawa furuficte moneŋte sâc mukicne irec sâc moneŋ seke nâfocne râenʒepieŋ, (seke wâŋ izi gera 20 ekac) i Wofuŋte taha hâcne.
Jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac â wose qâreŋ ejarekicne sasawa jaŋe hâcne taha i râenʒepieŋ.
Moneŋ mafaheczi sâc baferâ rârâe me hapetaczi sâc bawaharâ rârâe i misac, jaŋe sasawa seke nâfocne Wofuŋte taha râepie sahac taha‐jeŋic ezejec.
Go Israe ŋicguru jaŋeraonec sahac taha moneŋ iŋuc rotec izi tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo gie bapa irec biŋe ezejec. Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc ŋaŋac juju‐ŋeŋicte kiwiric roŋgopieŋ tinac eocmu, ehuc wâc Wofuŋzi Israe ŋicguru ŋoŋehec juocte manasucneniŋmu.”
Erâ Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go aeŋ bâbâroŋzi wiac ʒuʒure râqâc kikenehec barâ tutumaŋ qoruc boze â alata ŋondeŋ‐jekicko hetec ŋeha opâ qatec huzejec.
Eme Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe ira hâcne me kike‐jeŋic ʒurenʒepieŋ.
Ine tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo fehuc me Wofuŋ bâzi rikecneniŋte alata maickehuc tiri gie bazo murâ hâmonʒipiŋte iŋuc hâcne enʒepieŋ.
Hâmonʒipiŋte me kike‐jeŋic ʒurenʒepieŋ. Eme Aroŋ â ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋe mimiŋzi ɋâric mâsi i hâcne basanaŋkerâ bajupie eebapa sanaŋ‐jeŋic ezejec.”
Erâ Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go wiac furi sâko â âsunehec kecʒiŋuc rozemec: Moneŋ 500 seke irec sâc wokemaŋ âsu biaŋ, erâ moneŋ 250 seke irec sâc musijâc sahacne, erâ moneŋ 250 seke jaha irec sâc sopâc ââsu,
erâ moneŋ 500 seke irec sâc woworaŋ ââsu jâc irec sâfâ, erâ oliwa wokemaŋ fifia râqâc moc irec sâc; seke ine furuficte moneŋte sâc mukicne irec sâc ezejec.
Go wiac i sasawa, wokemaŋ bapazi weniŋuc eme wokemaŋ fuaekac iŋuc hâcne ehuc bâsifucketec tiri wokemaŋ fuazejec.
Eme wokemaŋ izi tutumaŋ qoruc boze â qorac tapa katapa ruacnezemec.
Erâ tebo â fainao wiac ŋerakac sasawa, erâ lambe dodoma â wiac‐ticne â hosâc âsu ririke alata,
erâ bâzi ririke alata â wâcwiac‐ticne sasawa erâ ʒuʒure râqâc kikenehec i mâmâc ruacne‐fârezemec.
Go iŋuc ehuc bâtiritecne wiac sasawa tirine efârezejec. Eme moczi moc wiac i ba bâuac eocmu e tirificte biŋe ezejec.
Erâ Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne mâmâc wokemaŋ rua‐jarehuc tiri bacjopatec nore taha bapafâc erâ junʒepieŋ.
Israe ŋicguru jaŋe ine ʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘Ŋoŋe mimiŋzi ɋâric wokemaŋ irec manapie nore tiri rurua wokemaŋ ezejec.
Wokemaŋ i ŋic omane moc mi rua‐jarenʒepieŋ, erâ ŋoŋe wokemaŋ iŋucne wâc bâsifuckerâ mi bâfuanʒepieŋ; wokemaŋ i tirine erâ ŋoŋe wâc manapie tirine jaha ezejec.
Moc e wokemaŋ iŋucnea bâsifuckerâ bâfuaocmu me irec nâfocne rorâ ŋic furune moc râcneocmu e ŋic âgofâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec bârâriehuc qâhâmonʒepieŋ.’”
Erâ Wofuŋ e Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go wiac âsu biaŋ sâckoa kecʒiŋuc rozemec: Jâcsâŋiŋ fuŋne fuŋne (waha kufaŋ, usu â qârâpâ) erâ wiac âsu biaŋ ɋaɋacne moc.
Rorâ hosâc âsu ririkere wiac bapazi eekac irec sâc jaha ehuc bâsifuckezemec, erâ hâwec ʒuhucketecne ɋaɋacne â tirine ezejec.
Eme gâcne piic piic banʒaŋnerâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo qorac tapa katapa ŋekacko ira bahefârâ râetec ŋehame ira hâcne fua‐garezepac. Wiac irec manapie tirine jâmbâŋ ezejec.
Eme hosâc âsu ririkere wiac bâsifuckecmu irec sâcko jâmbâŋ ŋaŋacne biŋe moc mi banʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe irec manapie Wofuŋte biŋe bâtirikicne ezejec.
Moc e wiac irec âsu mana aŋac eocte e jahacne biŋe bâfuaocmu e ŋic âgofâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec bârâriehuc qâhâmonʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Manakic, no Juda guruonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Bezalele, Huru ŋokâ‐ticne Uri ere ŋokâ hâcne e rowosâepo.
Erâ Anutu nore Mâro mecne, maŋfânâŋ mecne, maŋfâri â mamana tara mecne i tahackepe maŋnao fusucmarâ foha metâ bapa ŋic erâ jukac.
Erâ i ʒiŋucte epo: Ŋic e mana gufuc erâ wiac fuŋne fuŋne gol â siliwa â aeŋ bâbâroŋzi ba akic ezejec.
Erâ qânâ wiac furi sâko i râqâc kâwinehecko râezore fasaezejec â jâc wiac wâc fasaerâ meqâreŋ fuŋne fuŋne bazejec.
Erâ manakic, no Daŋte guruonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Ahisamac ere ŋokâ Oholiabe eki Bezalele bafickeocte râcnepo; erâ metâ bapa ŋic sasawa jaŋe wiac mugarepo i ba akic efâreniŋte maŋfânâŋ qikiŋne‐jarepo. Wiac kecʒiŋuc:
Tutumaŋ qoruc boze, qorac katapa â tapane, qoruc bozere wâcwiac;
tebo â wâcwiac‐ticne, lambe dodoma gol ɋaɋacnezi bakicne â wâcwiac‐ticne;
hosâc âsu ririke alata, erâ bâzi ririke alata â wâcwiac‐ticne; ʒuʒure râqâc kikenehec;
taha bapa Aroŋ ere gie ŋaqi hone aŋac eene â tiri ŋaqi‐ticne, erâ ŋokâfâcne jaŋere gie ŋaqi;
rurua wokemaŋ â tirificte hosâc âsu ririkere wiac. Ine hâcne mugarepo irec sâcko jâmbâŋ wiac sasawa ba akic efârenʒepieŋ.”
Erâ Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋicguru jazazemec, ‘Ŋoŋe hombaŋ‐nane ŋefârenʒepieŋ, hombaŋ i ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo irec ma, erâ i mimiŋzi ɋâric forahuc juzejec. No Wofuŋ jukopaczi tiri bacŋopakopac, iŋuc mana‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe hombaŋ‐nanere manapie tirine eha ŋenʒepieŋ. Moc e hombaŋ sipirickeme qâhâmozo, â moc e hombaŋko gie baocmu e wâc iŋuc jaha ŋic âgofâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec bârâriehuc qâhâmozo.
Gie bapa 6 ira gie bazore mukicne, gie bapa namba 7 izi ine Wofuŋte hombaŋ sâko, irec moc e sabata hombaŋko gie baocmu e qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Irec Israe ŋicguru jaŋe mimiŋzi ɋâric hombaŋ ŋepie hata sanaŋ‐jeŋic eha hombaŋ i hâcne ŋehuc junʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ noni hâcne ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 sambâŋ â mâreŋ bâfuac‐jofapo, erâ ʒoaŋ namba 7 ira ine ŋemanahuc âke mâteŋnuwec, irec hombaŋ i Israe ŋicguru ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo irec ma erâ nac ʒora fosanaŋkezejec.’”
Eme Wofuŋ e Mosehec Sinai tikio dâŋ muc manac epire tarame Sâcmutâc Sanaŋte tafe râcnewec. Tafe i qânâzi fasaekicne â Anuture mezi qâreŋkekicne.
Mose e tikio jume ʒorame ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Aroŋtao heâckerâ rarâ âzâcnembiŋ: “Ajoc, nemu moc bâfua‐nâretec bânie‐nârezejec. Mose ŋic keci, Aigita mâreŋkonec bacnâpo warewec, e iŋuc me iŋuc fuacnejec i mi manaŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme Aroŋzi jazawec, “Ŋoŋe ŋokac naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere hazeckonec pâŋi warawa golzi bakicne batararâ norao bafisiniŋ.”
Eme ŋic ŋokac naru motec mâmâc sasawa jaŋe pâŋi warawa hazec‐jeŋicko doma rawec i batararâ Aroŋtao bafisimbiŋ.
Eme Aroŋ e gol jowac rohuc rike dockerâ bulimakao motecne irec hawari bawec. Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “O Israe, Aigita mâreŋkonec bacgu warewec nemuge ʒi hâcne.”
Iŋuc epie Aroŋzi honerâ bulimakaore maŋfuŋko alata moc bawec; erâ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc jazame wirapie hazec sâc huwec: “Tomâcko Wofuŋte hombaŋ ŋezo.”
Hae fureme uupictea qowi bâzi rikembiŋ â wama bubiaŋte taha wiac bafisimbiŋ. Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe waha ŋehuc nânâ opâ nâmbiŋ, erâ faharerâ mamasiri wiac embiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec, “Ajoc, fahare huc! Ŋicfâcge Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa waremeŋ jaŋe sindaŋ eŋgopieŋ;
no hata mutâcne‐jarepo i biac qâsuambieŋ. Jaŋe bulimakao qâqâtâc moc bâfuarâ numucnehuc bâzi rikecneŋgopieŋ, ehuc ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: ‘O Israe, Aigita mâreŋkonec bacgu warewec nemuge ʒi hâcne.’”
Iŋuc murâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No ŋic ŋokac ʒi hone tarac‐jopakopac, jaŋe ŋic ŋokac maŋsanaŋ;
irec behecnuhaŋ kimbeŋ‐nanere ʒoczi bâruŋkerâ ʒâseŋ‐jopazejec; go ine mupe sawe mâririackerâ ŋicguru sâko ezemec.”
Eme Mose e ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐ticne mu bâmunaŋ ecnerâ muwec, “O Wofuŋ, ŋicfâcge Aigita mâreŋkonec mesanaŋgezi tâpiri sâkohec bacjopa waremeŋ, jaŋe wemocte kimbeŋgere ʒoczi ʒâseŋ‐jopaocte bâruŋkekac?
Go iŋuc etec Aigita ŋic jaŋe ʒiŋuc muniŋmu i: ‘Imac‐jopaocte manasuhuc tiki mâreŋko bacjopa rawec, ehuc mâreŋkonec bâsirowec‐jopaocte iŋuc hâcne ewec?’ Irec sifu ŋicfâcge jaŋere buge sâqoreme mana uruetec kimbeŋgere ʒoc qaʒuezejec.
Kiŋaŋŋicfâcge Abraham, Isaka â Israe jaŋe manasuc‐jopac. Erâ gahacne ʒâŋeo iticnehuc mumupaŋ sanaŋ mupaŋke‐jarehuc biŋedâŋ ʒiŋuc jazameŋ i manasuc, ‘Ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic basawec‐jopakupe sambâŋko bâpiŋ ŋeraŋgopieŋ irec sâc fuaniŋmu, â mâreŋ biŋe qaŋarepo ʒi ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jarepe raucke sanaŋkenʒoŋgopieŋ.’”
Eme Wofuŋ e ŋicfâcne sisipiric wiac ejarezo muwec i mana uruehuc maŋne risieme behewec.
Eme Mose e tikionec risierâ wahawec. Eme Sâcmutâc Sanaŋte qorac tapa jajahec meo bacjofawec. Tapa jajahec i ŋifec â ŋifec qâreŋhec sasawa.
Qorac tapa i Anutuzi bâfuawec erâ qâreŋ i ekizia qorac tapao heutuckehuc qâreŋkewec.
Eme wahahuc Josuazi ŋic jaŋere ojowa fânâŋ manarâ Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Tomao ʒikare ojowa fuame manakopac.”
Eme eki muwec: “No saoreŋ fânâŋ me busâqocte kio owa mâcne, gae woŋgâŋte micʒonʒoŋ manakopac.”
Eme wahaku toma bâqiŋkehuc bulimakao qâqâtâc â gae wowo hone manac erâ bune bâruŋkeme qorac tapa tiki fuŋnao beheme qanʒaŋnewec.
Erâ ra bulimakao qâqâtâc bambiŋ i rorâ ʒocko beheme ʒame henʒaŋ qanʒaŋnerâ uucne opâhec bâsifuckerâ Israe ŋicguru jaŋe nâniŋte ʒoɋac ejarewec.
Eme Mosezi Aroŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe weniŋuc egarepie kiŋ iŋucne sâko fai‐jeŋicko râetec fewec?”
Aroŋzi muwec: “O bomboŋ, kimbeŋgezi mi bâruŋkeoc, ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe boc repireeŋgopieŋ i gahac manaekic i!
Jaŋe ʒiŋuc nazambiŋ hâcne: ‘Go nemu bâfuac‐jopatec bânie‐nârepie ranʒepeneŋ; Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐nâpo warewec, Mose hâcne, ŋic e sifucke wiac moc ewec me weniŋuc i mi manaŋgopeneŋ.’
Iŋuc mupie jazapo, ‘Moc e eri wiac golzi bakicne moc bajuekacko hetarazejec.’ Eme narepie ʒocko behepe hume bulimakao qâqâtâc ʒi hâcne fuawec.”
Eme Mose e bâbâsifuc sâko bâfuapie honewec. Aroŋzi docke‐jareme iŋuc epie râsifâc‐jeŋic sowine iŋuc eŋgopieŋ muhuc bubiaŋ manambiŋ, Mose e iŋuc hone manac erâ
teuŋ‐jeŋicte motâcko domahuc wirarâ muwec: “Moc e Wofuŋte ŋic juzo ecnekacko norao warezejec.” Mume Lewire gurufâc jaŋe sasawa erao tumaŋne‐fârembiŋ.
Eme jazawec: “Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e hâcne ʒiŋuc mukac, ‘Ŋoŋe ru sâc ombâŋ‐ŋeŋicko becsahac jomarâ ʒika‐ŋeŋic esorienʒepieŋ. Erâ teuŋ sâckerâ motâc mockoneczi mocko rac warec ehuc hahac ɋafâc‐ŋeŋic mecne, âgo tofafâc‐ŋeŋic mecne, soctofafâc‐ŋeŋic mecne jaŋe mâmâc sasawa qâhâmoc‐jopanʒepieŋ.’”
Eme Lewire gurufâc jaŋe Mosezi mujarewec sâc efârembiŋ. Iŋuc epie ŋic jaŋeraonec ʒoaŋ ira 3 tauseŋzi hâmombiŋ.
Eme Mosezi muwec, “Ŋoŋe miŋecgac ru sâc Wofuŋte biŋe eniŋte mupaŋkehuc ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic me hahac ɋafâc‐ŋeŋic qaisoc‐jopambieŋ i Wofuŋte jambuŋzi ʒoaŋ ʒira fai‐ŋeŋicko feocte iŋuc hâcne embieŋ.”
Hae fureme Mosezi ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe sâqocne ŋemâcne bâfuambiŋ. Irec no ʒi Wofuŋtao fepemu, erâ hece, ŋoŋere erâ Wofuŋ mu wâwâsic ecnehuc kiwiric‐ŋeŋic sâcne ropemu me weniŋuc?”
Mose e iŋuc murâ mocwâc Wofuŋtao ferâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Jâi, ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe sâqocne ŋemâcne bâfuambiŋ, jaŋe golzi nemuɋâŋ bambiŋ hâcne.
Eme ʒi sifu sâqocne‐jeŋic bâtâmire‐jarezemec. Mi ezo murâ ine nore ʒâŋe papiagao qâreŋkemeŋ i hetâmirezemec.”
Wofuŋzi ine Mose âzâcnewec, “Iŋuc mâcne, moc e sâqocne bahuc bunaneo baocmu ere ʒâŋe papia‐naneo hetâmirepemu.
Ʒi ine rac, erâ hae mâreŋ gazapo ira ŋicguru jowac‐jopatec ranʒepieŋ. Manakic, aŋelo‐nanezi bânie‐gareocmu. Ehame dameŋ‐nane maickeme ine kiŋjeŋicte okacne bazu‐jarepemu.”
Eme Aroŋzi bulimakao qâqâtâc bame araŋ bacnembiŋte Wofuŋzi mume wiac mimicne fai‐jeŋicko fewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ajoc, go â ŋicguru Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa waremeŋ ŋoŋe ʒirecnec rahuc juku Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo mâreŋ mupaŋke‐jarehuc biŋe qajarepo ira fisinʒepieŋ. Ʒiŋuc hâcne mupaŋke‐jarepo: ‘Ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jarezokopac.’
Eme no aŋelo moc sorepe bânie‐ŋarezejec, ehame Kanaaŋ ŋic, Amori ŋic, Hitiŋic, Periʒi ŋic, Hiwiŋic â Jebusi ŋic jâpec‐jopazepac.
Go mâreŋ susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeekacko razemec; no ine ŋoŋehec mi rapemu, ŋoŋe ŋic maŋsanaŋ juŋgopieŋte juku hatao bâsirowec‐ŋopazipohec.”
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe dâŋ ŋemâcne i manarâ makuc bambiŋ, ehuc moczi moc eri qoqonaŋ wiac‐ticne moc mi qonaŋkewec.
Wofuŋzi ine Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Israe ŋicguru jazac, ‘Ŋoŋe ŋicguru râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne, irec no dameŋ bembeŋne mac sawa ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko rafehuc bâsirowec‐ŋopazipohec. Irec ʒi eri wiac‐ŋeŋic heunucke hetarac enʒepieŋ, eme no wiac weniŋuc jaha eŋarezo i mana tarazepac.’”
Iŋuc mume Israe ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Horebe tikionec rahuc rahuc izia eri wiac‐jeŋic heunucke hetarac embiŋ.
Eme Mose e ine qoruc boze rorâ teuŋ qaŋeŋnao taicko fâre jujec, ehuc ʒâŋene tutumaŋ qoruc boze mujujec. Eme moc e Wofuŋ mu wioc ecnezo murâ tutumaŋ qoruc boze teuŋ qaŋeŋnao ŋewec ira rajujec.
Eme Mose e qoruc bozeo rame sâc ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma faharerâ ru sâc boze‐jeŋicte motâcko domahuc Mose ʒâŋezi hone jâjâpe jumbieŋ.
Eme Mose e qoruc bozeo raʒime karorac ɋâfoŋnezi waharâ bozere motâc ɋorockerâ domaha Wofuŋzi Mosehec dâŋ muc manac ejujec.
Eme ŋic ŋokac ʒeŋgoma jaŋe boze motâcko karorac ɋâfoŋne domame honerâ ru sâc faharerâ boze‐jeŋicte motâcko fodape jumbieŋ.
Wofuŋ e Mosehec mamaic ehuc dâŋ muc manac ejupirec, ŋic moczi âgo qomâ‐ticnehec dâŋ muc manac eekopirec irec sâc. Eme Mose e ŋic jaŋere teuŋko risieme kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne socɋâri Josua, Nuŋte ŋokâ hâcne, e tutumaŋ qoruc boze i moc mi behe jujec.
Eme Mose e Wofuŋ âzâcnerâ muwec: “Manakic, go ŋicguru ʒi bacjopa rapemurâ munaremeŋ, erâ mo ŋic mo soretec nohec mâmâc ranacmu, i ine mi mutec manaekopac; kecʒiŋuc ine nazameŋ: ‘No ʒâŋege manaekopac â honeriŋguekopac.’
Irec ʒiŋuc numu‐garekopac: No jâmbomac honeriŋnuekicko mamana birige nowatutec fuŋnege mana tarape â honeriŋnuekic i wâc hone tarape. Erâ ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe gore gurufâc juŋgopieŋ i wâc manasuc.”
Eme dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “No nahac bânie‐ŋarehuc jowac‐ŋoparâ hatao râec‐ŋopape me?”
Eme eki muwec, “Go gahac jâmbâŋ mi bânie‐nârezo mukicko ine ʒirecnec mi jowac‐nâpo razemec.
Goki no mecne â ŋicguru ʒi mecne honeriŋ‐nâpoekic i wemocko fuŋne taniŋkeme hone tarazo? Ʒiŋucko hâcne hone tarazo: Go gahac jâmbâŋ bânie‐nâretec no â ŋicfâcge nâŋe ŋicne ŋicne mâreŋko juraŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc mâcne, sâc moc enaŋmu hâcne.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec, “Wiac moc, go mukomec iŋuc jâmbâŋ epemu hâcne. No go honeriŋguekopac â ʒâŋege wâc manaekopac i!”
Mume Mosezi muwec, “Mana‐naretecne eri tatamacge honezepac.”
Mume muwec, “No eri tatamac‐nane gore maio râepe fota rame ʒâŋe‐nane ‘Wofuŋ’ i gore maio musokapemu, erâ no ŋic moc aki anonoc ecnezo murâ ecnepemu; â moc buuruc qacnezo murâ qacnepemu jaha.”
Erâ muwec, “Mocjaha, ʒâŋe mai‐nane sâcne mi honecmu, ŋiczi honecnurâ ɋâricne juju i mi fokac.”
Erâ Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ muwec, “Manakic, ʒi maŋfuŋ‐naneo sawane fokac ira haroŋaŋko domazemec.
Eme no qânâ hawecko râecgurâ menanezi ʒâŋege bâsoŋkehuc eri tatamac‐nanehec gowarupemu.
Iŋuc ehuc menane bârâriepe râpe‐nane sawa honezemec, mâc ʒâŋe mai‐nane hohonene ine mi fokac.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec, “Qorac tapa jajahec qanaŋ fasaec‐jofakicne iŋucne mocwâc fasaec‐jofazemec, eme qorac tapa qanʒaŋ‐jofameŋ jahere faio dâŋ qâreŋkekicne fowec ijaha qâreŋkepemu.
Irec go uupicte ʒawiezemec. Erâ furicte Sinai tikio wefurâ tiki botâŋko nore maio fuazemec.
Erâ moczi moc gohec moc mi wefuzepirec, â moczi moc tikio moc mi juzejec, â lama bulimakao wiac jaŋe tiki fuŋko ware nânâ mi nânʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Mosezi qorac tapa jajahec mârâc fasaec‐jofakicne iŋucnea fasaec‐jofawec. Erâ Mose e furic uupicte Wofuŋzi mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko qorac tapa jajahec bacjofarâ Sinai tikio fewec.
Eme Wofuŋ e karorac maŋko waharâ erao domawec. Eme Mose e Wofuŋte ʒâŋe riwaseckeme
Wofuŋzi ere ʒâŋe maio fotâcnehuc kecʒiŋuc wirawec: “Wofuŋ, Wofuŋ e Anutu buuruc â aki anonoc‐ticnehec, kimbeŋ‐ticne urucne, erâ maŋjauŋ â erâ‐eesanaŋ i ɋârâŋnea focnekac.
E ŋifec kiŋtofa â qaqatara â sâqocne bâtâmirehuc ŋic tauseŋne tauseŋne ehâmo‐jarehuc juekac, â ŋifec ine kiŋhec jaŋere fuŋne mi mana pitiwahuc naru motec ŋosafâc‐jeŋic bazu‐jare raekac.”
Iŋuc mume Mose e picpac jaha mâreŋko fodapewec.
Ehuc muwec, “O Wofuŋ, go nore manatec sâckekacko ine sifu ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko juhuc nâŋehec mâmâc razemec, ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne juŋgopieŋ hâcne. Erâ kiŋ bahac â sâqocne‐nâŋec behehuc biŋefâcge bacnâpozemec.”
Eme Wofuŋzi muwec, “Manakic, no ʒâʒâfic moc bâfuapemu. No ŋicgurufâcge sasawa jaŋere maio mâsi moc bapemu, mâsi iŋucne mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec faio mecne â ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko mecne moc mi fua wefuwec, eme ŋicguru ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko jukomec jaŋe ʒeŋgoma Wofuŋ nore gie bapare fuŋne honenʒepieŋ; no wiac qeŋ bipinehec eŋarepemu hâcne.
“No miŋecgac dâŋ ŋazakopac i mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ. Manaŋgopieŋ, no Amori ŋic, Kanaaŋ ŋic, Hitiŋic, Periʒi ŋic, Hiwiŋic â Jebusi ŋic ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko jâpec‐jopapemu.
Ŋoŋe rucŋeŋic banʒepieŋ, mâreŋ raʒiniŋmu irec rune jaŋehec juhuc ʒâʒâfic moc epie dâŋzi bitiŋ râe‐ŋarenʒipiŋte.
Ŋoŋe alata wiac‐jeŋic heropienʒepieŋ, nemure qânâ wâtuŋ wiac‐jeŋic qanʒaŋnenʒepieŋ â nemuɋâŋ‐jeŋic hezu henʒaŋnenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe nemu gâcne moc mi numu‐jarenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ nore ʒâŋe ‘Ʒoɋachec’; no Anutu ʒoɋac‐nanehec hâcne.
Ŋoŋe mâreŋ irec rune jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic moc mi enʒepieŋ, jaŋe nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao qohotahuc bâzi rike‐jareniŋte hefârec‐ŋopapie nemure tiwâ ʒepec nânʒipiŋte
erâ narufâc‐jeŋic rocjoparâ motecfâc‐ŋeŋic jarepie ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic juhuc nemufâc‐jeŋic araŋ bajarehuc motecfâc‐ŋeŋic eatuc‐jopapie jaŋe wâc nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao qohotanʒipiŋte.
“Ŋoŋe gol rike dockekicnezi nemu qâqâtâc moc mi banʒepieŋ.
“Goreŋ sowa hombaŋ ŋehuc junʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe goreŋ sowa juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec, ine ŋazapo irec sâc mosa dameŋ April‐ko ŋenʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe mosa dameŋ ira hâcne Aigita mâreŋkonec wahambiŋ.
Mârâc fufua sasawa ŋic me qowi i nore biŋe, qowi ŋicne mârâc fufua, bulimakao â lama mârâc fufua hâcne.
Doŋgi mârâc fufua irec okacne lama râenʒepieŋ, me okacne mi râezo murâ ine doŋgi upene qâpirickenʒepieŋ. Motecfâc‐ŋeŋic mârâc fufua jaŋere okacne wâc râenʒepieŋ. Erâ moczi moc nore maio metariŋ mi fisinʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 gie sâcne baniŋmu, ʒoaŋ namba 7 ira ine hombaŋ ŋenʒepieŋ, ine gie hesarac dameŋko me qa roro dameŋko hombaŋ ŋenʒepieŋ wâc.
Erâ woka hombaŋ, bâbâsu hombaŋ hâcne, i mecne â jara tataranao waiŋ qa roro irec hombaŋ mecne i mâmâc ŋenʒepieŋ.
Ŋic ʒeŋgoma jaŋe jara mocte maŋnao arec jahec â moc Wofuŋ Anutu, Israere Anutu hâcne, nore maio fuanʒepieŋ.
No ŋoŋere maio ŋic gurune gurune jâpec‐joparâ hae mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic bâsokapemu, eme jara mocte maŋnao arec jahec â moc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic fua‐nareniŋte rahapie moczi moc mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicte andac mi ezejec.
“Ŋoŋe qowi bâzi‐nanere soc i poroŋ goreŋhec mi rikenʒepieŋ, erâ aakic hombaŋte lama bâzi i tiwâne râepie foha hae mi furezejec.
Nânâ bâbâsu dameŋko wiac fârine biaŋne i Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic nore ficko bafenʒepieŋ. Erâ lama motecne i neŋgocnere susuhec mi rikenʒepieŋ.”
Erâ Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcne muwec, “Go dâŋ i qâreŋkezemec, no dâŋ izi hobeteŋne eha go â Israe ŋic ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic mocwâc ekopac hâcne.”
Eme Mose e ira Wofuŋhec nânâ opâ tâmiric juhame ŋafe ʒoaŋ 40 tarawec. Ehame ʒâʒâficte dâŋ, Sâcmutâc Sanaŋ Teŋ i hâcne qorac tapao qâreŋkewec.
Eme Mose e Sinai tikionec wahahuc Sâcmutâc Sanaŋ Teŋ irec qorac tapa jajahec i meo bacjofa wahawec. Ehuc faic Wofuŋhec dâŋ muc manac epicko ʒâŋe mai‐ticne tatamachec ewec tatamac i foha waha fisiwec, i e jahac mi manawec.
Eme Aroŋ â Israe ŋicguru sasawa jaŋe Mose honembiŋ i ʒâŋe mai‐ticne tamaeme honerâ hâwic‐jopame maŋfuŋ‐ticnao mi rambiŋ.
Eme Mosezi wira‐jareme Aroŋ â kikefuŋte micne bapa jaŋe Moserao rapie jaŋehec dâŋ muc manac embiŋ.
Izi ʒâhec Israe ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋe ware maŋfuŋnao fisipie eki Wofuŋzi Sinai tikio sâcmutâc dâŋ âzâcnewec i bâtikie‐jare‐fârewec.
Dâŋ jaza‐fârerâ ʒâŋe mai‐ticne rurufazi qofackewec.
Erâ dameŋ sâc Wofuŋhec mai ecneme dâŋ dâŋ enicte rurufa bârârierâ mâc domaha Wofuŋzi dâŋ âzâcneku âzâcne‐fârewec. I tarame waharâ dâŋ âzâcne mutâc ekicne sasawa i Israe ŋicguru bâtikie‐jare‐fârewec.
Eme dameŋ ira Mose ʒâŋe mai‐ticne tamaeme Israe ŋicguru jaŋe hone jumbieŋ. Irec Mose e ʒâŋe maine rurufazi mocwâc qofackeme foha Anuturao fefe dameŋ‐ticne maicke jujec.
Eme Mose e Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma hetumaŋ‐joparâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wofuŋ e wiac kecʒiŋuc eniŋte ŋaza mutâc ewec:
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 ira gie banʒepieŋ, â ʒoaŋ namba 7 ira ine Wofuŋte hombaŋ ŋenʒepieŋ. Moc e ʒoaŋ ira gie baocmu e qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe sabata hombaŋko ficŋeŋicko ʒoc moc mi ruqenʒepieŋ.”
Erâ Mose e Israe ŋicguru kikefuŋ qâqâhâc sâko ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wofuŋzi wiac kecʒiŋucte dâŋ ŋaza mutâc ewec:
Wiac foŋarekac irecnec gâcne rorâ Wofuŋte taha râenʒepieŋ; moc e maŋticnezi mutâcnecneme sâc Wofuŋte taha ʒiŋuc bafisizejec: Gol, siliwa, aeŋ bâbâroŋ,
qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne â bâbâroŋ â âmuc âmucne â fâfâsâc, erâ noniŋ kanʒaŋne,
â lama ŋicnere sahac peŋ bâbâroŋzi rikekicne, erâ noniŋ sahacne â jâmiŋjâc,
erâ lambere wokemaŋ â rurua wokemaŋ â hosâc âsu ririke irec wiac âsu biaŋ.
Erâ qoqonaŋ â qâ irec biŋe qânâ furi sâko bâbâroŋ erâ qânâ furi sâko gâcne mâmâc.
“Erâ ŋoŋeraonec metâ bapare fuŋne mamana ŋic jaŋe warerâ, Wofuŋzi wiac muwec i bafârenʒepieŋ, ine ʒiŋuc: Tiri boze,
erâ sâpe â bupu‐ticne, heheawic â katapa â babasanaŋ erâ wâtuŋ râqâc‐ticnehec mâmâc.
Erâ qorac tapa katapa reŋ wiac‐ticnehec, katapa tapane â ââketâc qoruc,
erâ tebo reŋnehec â râqâc wiac‐ticne erâ poroŋ furu mukicne,
erâ lambe dodomane â wâcwiac‐ticne â lambe â lambere wokemaŋ,
erâ hosâc âsu ririkere alata reŋticnehec, erâ rurua wokemaŋ â hosâc ririkere wiac âsu biaŋ erâ tiri boze motâcte ââketâc,
