erâ qowi bâzi ririkere alata irec sac â reŋ erâ gie bapare wiac‐ticne sasawa erâ wiac ʒuʒure râqâc kikenehec,
erâ hae ʒoŋare sâpe irec qoruc â wâtuŋ â wâtuŋte râqâc erâ hae ʒoŋa motâcte qoruc,
erâ tiri boze â hae ʒoŋare fâzâ â mucticne,
erâ tirificko gie bapare ŋaqi ba akic ehuc bakicne, taha bapa Aroŋte tiri ŋaqi hâcne, erâ ŋokâfâcne jaŋere tiri giere ŋaqi mâmâc.”
Dâŋ iŋuc jazame Israe ŋicguru kikefuŋ ʒeŋgoma jaŋe Mosere maionec ratâmirembiŋ.
Erâ maŋjeŋiczi bufahac qajarewec jaŋe risierâ tutumaŋ qoruc boze bapa â maŋnao gie bapa â tiri ŋaqi irec wiac i Wofuŋte taha bafisi‐fârembiŋ.
Ŋic mecne ŋokac mecne maŋjeŋiczi esoc qafeŋ ejarewec jaŋe kubu â sarasa â pâŋi warawa â megâŋ mahec, erâ maŋguc eri wiac gâcne gâcne golzi bakicne i Wofuŋte taha bafisimbiŋ hâcne.
Erâ qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne â bâbâroŋ, fâfâsâc â âmuc âmucne, erâ noniŋ kanʒaŋne â lama sahacne peŋ bâbâroŋzi rikekicne â noniŋ sahacne fojarewec jaŋe sasawa wiac iŋuc bafisimbiŋ hâcne.
Â moc e siliwa me aeŋ bâbâroŋ râeocte manasuweczi wiac i Wofuŋte taha bafisiwec, â moc e jâmiŋzi wiac bapa irec biŋe jâc focneweczi bafisiwec wâc.
Eme ŋokac qoruc bapare fuŋne mamana jaŋe qoruc furâ bafisimbiŋ, qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne â bâbâroŋ â fâfâsâc â âmuc âmucne.
Erâ maŋjeŋiczi bufahac qajarewec ŋokac i jaŋe sasawa noniŋ kanʒaŋnezi qoruc fumbiŋ.
Eme micne jaŋe ine qânâ furi sâko bâbâroŋ â qânâ furi sâko gâcne gâcne bafisimbiŋ, qoqonaŋ ŋaqi â amecte qâ irec biŋe.
Erâ tatamacte wokemaŋ â ruruare wokemaŋ erâ hosâc âsu irec wiac furi sâko, âsu biaŋ â wokemaŋ i mâmâc bafisimbiŋ.
Ine hâcne, Israe ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋe Wofuŋzi gie baniŋte Mose âzâcnewec irec wiac i maŋjeŋiczi baafec‐jopawec sâc buafec jaha Wofuŋte taha bafisimbiŋ.
Eme Mose e Israe ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ e Juda guruonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Bezalele, Hurure ŋokâ Urire ŋosa hâcne e ʒâŋene muhuc rowosâewec.
Ehuc Mâro‐ticne qikiŋnecneme eki maŋ baafec ecneme ŋic meafec â maŋɋârâŋ â metâ bapare fuŋne mamana tarahec ewec.
I wiac bâbâfuare mamanasu gie baocte, ehuc gol â siliwa â aeŋ bâbâroŋzi wiac ba akic ehuc baocte,
erâ qânâ bâjomireocte â jâc fasaeocte â wiac sasawa ba batakire eocte iŋuc ecnewec.
Erâ e Daŋ guruonec ŋic moc, ʒâŋene Oholiabe, Ahisamac ere ŋokâ hâcne, jahe ŋic gâcne wâc qazu‐jarenicte mamana qikiŋne‐jactewec.
Metâ qâreŋ ba eric ehuc bapa ŋic jaŋe qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne â bâbâroŋ â âmuc âmucne â fâfâsâc irec faio eri wiac baeŋgopieŋ, me qoruc bapa me wiac i me i bapa jaŋe gie‐jeŋic baeŋgopieŋ, irec sâcko jâmbâŋ gie‐jekic banicte tâpiri râe‐jactewec hâcne.
“Eme ʒi Bezalele â Oholiabe erâ ŋic meafec gâcne gie iŋucne baniŋte Wofuŋzi maŋɋârâŋ â mamana tahac‐jopame furufic bapare fuŋne manaŋgopieŋ jaŋe sasawa Wofuŋzi mutâcnewec irec sâcko jâmbâŋ bafârenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Mose e Bezalele â Oholiabe erâ ŋic meafec sasawa Wofuŋzi metâ bapare mamana tahac‐jopawec â maŋjeŋiczi gie i ware baniŋte qacfahac ejarewec jaŋe hefârec‐jopawec.
Erâ Mose e Israe ŋic ŋokac jaŋe furufic bapare taha wiac bafisimbiŋ i jare‐fârewec, ehame ŋic ŋokac jaŋe furic sâc buafec jaha taha gâcne ʒuhuckerâ bafisihuc jumbiŋ.
Irec metâ bapa furuficte gie bambiŋ jaŋe sasawa gie‐jeŋic bahuc jumbiŋ i beherâ
Moserao fisirâ mumbiŋ, “Ŋic ŋokac jaŋe wiac bafisiŋgopieŋ i Wofuŋzi gie banaŋte muwec irec sâc sirickekac.”
Iŋuc mupie Mosezi dâŋ ʒiŋuc râeme teuŋ sâcke‐fârewec: “Ŋic me ŋokac moczi furuficte taha wiac ʒuhuckerâ mocwâc mi bafisinʒepieŋ.” Iŋuc muhuc ŋic ŋokac wiac ʒuhuckerâ bafisinʒipiŋte aka hejarewec hâcne,
i wiac bafisikicne izi giere sâc sirickewecte.
Eme gie bambiŋ jaŋeraonec ŋic meafec sasawa jaŋe tiri boze i qoruc furi sâko fâfâsâc â keŋkeŋne â bâbâroŋ â âmuc âmucne 10 izi bambiŋ, ehuc qoruc i qâreŋnehec fupie kerubim hawari fuawec. I Bezalelezi iŋuc bawec.
Qoruc moc i ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc kubi 28 â otecne‐ticnere sâc kubi 4, iŋuc bapie sâcjeŋic mocjaha efârewec.
Eme e qoruc 5 jaŋe moc buc ʒuhuc‐jopawec â 5 jaŋe iŋuc jaha moc buc ʒuhuc‐jopawec.
Erâ e qoruc qaŋeŋnao jâmbâŋ qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋnezi ʒâʒâficke muc barâ râewec â qoruc mocte qaŋeŋnao jâmbâŋ iŋuc jaha ewec.
Qoruc mocte ʒâʒâfickere muc 50 â qoruc mocte qaŋeŋnao ʒâʒâfickere muc 50 jaha basanaŋkewec. Iŋuc eme ʒâʒâfickere muc i qoruc ŋifec â ŋifec sâckoa forawec.
Erâ heheawic 50 golzi barâ izi qoruc heawic‐jofame tiri boze mocjaha fuawec.
Erâ bupure qoruc 11 i noniŋ kanʒaŋnezi bawec.
Qoruc buc buc ʒoricne‐jeŋicte sâc kubi 30 â otecne‐jeŋicte sâc kubi 4, qoruc 11 sâcjeŋic mocjaha hâcne.
E qoruc 5 moc buc ʒâfic‐jopawec â qoruc 6 jaŋe iŋuc jaha moc buc ʒâfic‐jopawec.
Erâ ʒâʒâfickere muc 50 i qoruc tataranere qaŋeŋnao râe rawec erâ ʒâʒâfickere muc 50 jaha i qoruc mocte qaŋeŋnao iŋuc jaha râe rawec.
Erâ qoruc ʒuhucke itic eme mocjaha eocte aeŋ bâbâroŋzi heheawic 50 bawec.
Erâ qoruc boze bupune i lama ŋicnere sahac peŋ bâbâroŋzi rikekicne â noniŋ sahacne izi bawec.
I tarame tiri bozere katapa hâŋ ââeckene jâmiŋzi fasaewec.
Katapa ʒoricnere sâc kubi 10 â otecnere sâc kubi moc â nâfocne sasawa.
Katapa sasawa bareŋ‐jeŋic jajahec jajahec, i ʒuʒuhuc eniŋte tiri bozere katapa iŋuc sasawa bawec.
Tiri bozere katapa ine kecʒiŋuc bafârewec: Sâpene juwic mâreŋkopec irec biŋe 20,
erâ katapa 20 irec juwic tofanao siliwazi râqâc 40 bawec; katapa mocte bareŋne jajahec irec râqâc jajahec â katapa mocte bareŋne jajahec irec râqâc jajahec, iŋuczi iŋuc.
Erâ tiri bozere sâpene faic mâreŋkopec irec katapa 20
â siliwazi râqâc‐ticne 40 jaha, katapa mocte râqâc jajahec â katapa mocte râqâc jajahec jaha.
Tiri boze râpene, ʒoaŋ huhunaopec hâcne, irec katapa 6 fasaewec.
Erâ fic gurucne râpenao irec wâtuŋ jajahec fasaewec.
Eme wâtuŋ i juwic rârâwiŋ domahuc feku faic hoŋeŋeŋ micne fowecko iitic epic; gurucne jajahec irec wâtuŋ jajahec iŋuc hâcne bawec.
Katapa 8 i siliwazi râqâchec hâcne, mocte râqâc jajahec mocte jajahec, iŋuc râe rame 16 ewec.
Eme jâmiŋzi babasanaŋ fasaewec, ine tiri bozere neŋgoc ŋifec 5,
â tiri bozere neŋgoc ŋifec 5, â râpene ʒoaŋ huhunaopec irec biŋe 5 jaha.
Eme babasanaŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋko fowec izi katapa ombâŋnao ŋifeckonec ware raku ŋifecko fisiwec.
Eme katapa sasawa golzi ɋorockewec, erâ babasanaŋte raraʒi, hoŋeŋeŋ hâcne i golzia bawec, â babasanaŋ i wâc iŋuc jaha golzi ɋorockewec.
Qoruc ââketâc ine qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ â fâfâsâc izi bawec, ehuc qâreŋnehec fume kerubiŋ hawari fuawec.
Erâ wâtuŋ‐ticne 4 jâmiŋzi fasaerâ golzi ɋorockewec; wâtuŋ heheawic‐ticne golzia bakicne â râqâc‐ticne ine siliwa rike sueŋkekicnezi bawec.
Qoruc boze motâcte qoruc i qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ â fâfâsâc izi bawec wâc, ehuc geroŋkewec.
Erâ wâtuŋ‐ticne 5 i heheawic‐ticnehec bawec. Wâtuŋ utune â otecne i golzi ɋorockewec â râqâcne ine aeŋ bâbâroŋzi wâc bawec.
Eme Bezalele e qorac tapa katapa jâmiŋzi fasaerâ bawec, ine ʒoric‐ticnere sâc kubi jajahec â nâfocne, otecne‐ticnere sâc kubi moc â nâfocne â hâŋne‐ticnere sâc kubi moc â nâfocne jaha, iŋuc bawec.
Erâ maŋne â sahacne i gol ɋaɋacnezi ɋorockewec, erâ qaŋeŋne moc rârec rârec i golzia bâjomirehuc bawec.
Guruc‐ticne 4 irec reŋ raraʒi 4 jaha golzi bawec, ine ŋifecte biŋe jajahec â ŋifecte biŋe jajahec jaha.
Erâ jâmiŋzi reŋ jajahec fasaerâ golzi foŋkewec wâc.
Eme katapa reŋkeniŋte reŋ i katapa ŋifec â ŋifec reŋ raraʒi basanaŋkekicnao esorieme raʒiwec.
Iŋuc erâ katapa tapane i gol ɋaɋacnezia ba akic ewec; ʒoricnere sâc kubi jajahec â nâfocne â otecnere sâc kubi moc â nâfocne.
Erâ kerubim hawari jajahec gol hedapirekicnezi basaric‐jofawec, ehuc tapa qaŋeŋ jahecnao bâjomirec‐jofame ŋepic.
Kerubim hawari moc i qaŋeŋne ŋifec â kerubim hawari moc i qaŋeŋne ŋifec; kerubim hawari i katapa tapa faio ŋifec â ŋifec bâjomirec‐jofawec hâcne.
Kerubim jahe mamaic erâ ŋehuc fakec‐jekic bâfeŋnepire faicpec qaratierâ domahuc tapane qofackewec, ehame ʒâŋe mai‐jekic tapaopec enduŋkepic.
Eme jâmiŋzi tebo fasaewec wâc, ine ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc kubi jajahec, otecne‐ticnere sâc kubi mocjaha â hâŋne‐ticnere sâc kubi moc â nâfocne.
Erâ gol ɋaɋacnezi ɋorockerâ rârec rârec mecqaŋeŋne golzia bâjomirewec.
Erâ qaŋeŋne moc metapere sâc i golzia ba akic erâ rârec rârec râe‐fârewec.
Izi ine gol sueŋkekicnezi reŋ raraʒi 4 barâ kikene 4 irec nopacnao basanaŋkewec.
Reŋ esoriepie raʒime tebo reŋkeniŋte reŋ raraʒi i qaŋeŋnere heririŋko mickewec.
Eme tebo reŋkeniŋte reŋ i jâmiŋzi fasaerâ golzi foŋkewec.
Wiac teboo ŋeŋe i gol ɋaɋacnezi bawec, kecʒiŋuc: Oto, amae, râqâc â ʒopo eme ira hâcne taha bâzire wiac hume râe jumbieŋ.
Eme lambe dodoma i gol ɋaɋacnezia wâc bawec. Lambe dodomare kikene â wâtuŋne i gol hedapirekicnezi bawec, eme râqâc â ʒariŋ ɋoŋnehec izi dodomahec qâfâsâerâ mocjaha ewec.
Wâtuŋnere ombâŋkonec ine sohocne 6 râwiŋnerâ domambiŋ. Ŋifec sohocne jahec â moc â ŋifec sohocne jahec â moc jaha.
Erâ wawec kaoŋne ɋoŋnehec iŋucne ʒariŋ ɋoŋne jahec â moc sohocne ŋifec â ŋifec domawec; lambe dodomare wâtuŋkonec sohocne 6 râwiŋnerâ domambiŋ ira iŋuc hâcne doma‐fârembiŋ.
Erâ lambe dodomare wâtuŋko wawec kaoŋne ɋoŋnehec iŋucne ʒariŋ ɋoŋne 4 bakicne.
Ine ʒiŋuc domawec: Ʒariŋ ɋoŋnehec moc sohoc fuŋne irec juwicnao, moc sohoc birine namba 2 irec juwicnao, iŋuczi iŋuc doma rawec.
Sohocne â ʒariŋ ɋoŋnehec i qâfâsâerâ mocjaha efârewec, wiac i sasawa gol ɋaɋacne hedapirekicnezi bakicne hâcne.
Erâ e lambe 7 â lambere qoruc bâbâtâc â râqâc‐ticne i gol ɋaɋacnezia bafârewec.
Gol ɋaɋacne ŋemâc‐ticne 100 izi lambe dodoma â wâcwiac‐ticne sasawa basaricke‐fârewec.
Hosâc ririkere alata i jâmiŋzi ʒiŋuc bawec: Ʒoricnere sâc kubi mocjaha â otecnere sâc kubi mocjaha jaha, sâckoa bawec hâcne; hâŋne‐ticnere sâc kubi jajahec â ʒuŋene ine alatahec qâfâsâeme mocjaha ewec.
Eme faine â sâpene rârec rârec â ʒuŋene i gol ɋaɋacnezia ɋorocke‐fârewec â mecqaŋeŋne moc i golzia barâ rârec rârec râe‐fârewec.
Mecqaŋeŋne juwicnao ŋifec â ŋifec ine reŋ raraʒi golzi bakicne râec‐jofawec, i reŋkeniŋte reŋ ira esoriepe raʒiocte.
Reŋ ine jâmiŋzi fasaerâ golzi foŋkewec.
Erâ tiri rurua wokemaŋ â hosâc âsu ririkere wiac ɋaɋacne i âsu biaŋ wiac bapa jaŋere sâcko bawec.
Erâ jâmiŋzi qowi bâzi ririkere alata fasaewec i ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc kubi 5 â otecne‐ticnere sâc kubi 5 jaha, sâcjekic mocjaha hâcne; hâŋne ine kubi 3, iŋuc bawec.
Erâ gurucne 4 irec ʒuŋene 4 jaha fasaeme domawec, erâ alatahec qâfâsâerâ domaha aeŋ bâbâroŋzi ɋorockewec.
Izi alatare wâcwiac sasawa kecʒiŋuc bawec: Kuʒi, sapac, titie râqâc, sarac â ʒocrâqâc; wiac i sasawa aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bafârewec.
Erâ alatare sapa moc i aeŋ bâbâroŋzia bawec, eme sapa izi alatare qaŋeŋne rurumaŋnao âke hotahuc wefu alata ombâŋnao mickewec.
Erâ sapa gurucne 4 ira aeŋ bâbâroŋzi reŋ raraʒi 4 jaha bahuc basanaŋkewec, i reŋ ira esoriepie raʒiocte.
Reŋ ine jâmiŋzi fasaerâ aeŋ bâbâroŋzia ɋorockewec.
Eme alata reŋkeniŋte reŋ i raraʒi‐ticnao esorieme raʒiwec. Alata ine katapazi maŋnehec bawec.
Wiac ʒuʒure râqâc â kikene ine aeŋ bâbâroŋzi basarickewec, ine ŋokac tutumaŋ qoruc boze motâcko kiŋaŋ gie bahuc jumbiŋ jaŋere hawari wiac rorâ izi bawec.
Erâ ie tiri boze hae ʒoŋa‐ticne bawec. Juwic mâreŋkopec ira qoruc sâko fâfâsâc i ɋetickewec, qoruc ʒoricnere sâc kubi 100.
Qoructe wâtuŋ ine 20 â wâtuŋte râqâc aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bakicne i 20 jaha, wâtuŋte heheawic â qârârâc‐ticne ine siliwazi bawec.
Faic mâreŋkopec ira qoruc iŋucnea, sâcticne kubi 100 ɋetickewec, â wâtuŋ‐ticne 20 â wâtuŋte râqâc aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bakicne 20 jaha. Heheawic â qârârâc‐ticne ine siliwazia bawec.
Ʒoaŋ huhunaopec irec qoruc ine sâcticne kubi 50 â wâtuŋ‐ticne 10 â wâtuŋte râqâc 10 jaha, iŋuc râewec, heheawic â râqâc‐ticne i siliwazi bawec.
Ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec mamai hâcne, irec qoruc i kubi 50 jaha.
Motâc ŋifecnere qoruc i kubi 15 â wâtuŋ‐ticne 3 â wâtuŋte râqâc 3 jaha.
Motâc ŋifecnere sâc ijaha ewec. Iŋuc eme qoruc ŋifec â ŋifec sâcticne kubi 15 â wâtuŋ‐ticne 3, 3 â wâtuŋte râqâc 3, 3 iŋuc doma rawec.
Qoruc hae ʒoŋa rârec rârec râe rakicne i qoruc fâfâsâc sasawa.
Wâtuŋte râqâc sasawa aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bakicne, heheawic â qârârâc ine siliwazi bafârekicne. Wâtuŋ botâŋne sasawa siliwazi ɋorockekicne â hae ʒoŋare wâtuŋ qârârâc‐ticne i siliwazia bafârekicne.
Hae ʒoŋa motâcte qoruc i qoruc fâfâsâc â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋzi geroŋkekicne; qoruc ʒoricne‐ticne kubi 20 â otecne‐ticne kubi 5, erâ hae ʒoŋare qoruchec sâc mocjaha ewec.
Wâtuŋ‐ticne 4 â wâtuŋte râqâc aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bakicne 4 jaha, heheawic ine siliwazi bakicne â botâŋne i siliwazi ɋorockekicne â qârârâc‐jeŋic i siliwazia bakicne.
Tiri boze â hae ʒoŋare fâzâ rârec rârec râe rakicne i aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bafârekicne.
Ʒi ine tiri boze, sâcmutâc dâŋte tiri boze hâcne, irec wiac sasawa ʒare â sâcticne Mosezi mutâcne‐jarewec irec sâcko wosembiŋ. Ine Lewire garikiŋfâc jaŋe Aroŋte ŋokâ, taha bapa Itama eki hâcne soŋaŋ‐jopaha wosembiŋ.
Juda guruonec ŋic ʒâŋene Bezalele, Huru ŋokâ‐ticne Uri ere ŋokâ hâcne, eki Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko wiac efârewec.
Ehame Daŋ guruonec ŋic ʒâŋene Oholiabe Ahisamacte ŋokâ hâcne, e aeŋ wiac bapa â ficbapa â qoruc keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ â fâfâsâc irec faio geroŋ bapa juweczi bafickewec.
Tiri boze bapare gol râekicne sasawa irec ŋemâc i 2 tauseŋ 930, erâ i furuficte ŋemâc fowec irec sâc.
Â kikefuŋte ŋic wose qâreŋ ejarekicnezi siliwa râembiŋ irec ŋemâc i 10 tauseŋ 70, erâ i furuficte ŋemâc fowec irec sâc jaha.
Ine kecʒiŋuc ehuc râembiŋ: Ŋic jara‐jeŋic 21 bazukicne jaŋe wose qâreŋ ejarepie ʒare‐jeŋic 603 tauseŋ 550 fuawec; ehame furuficte ŋemâc fowec irec sâc buc buc moneŋ râeniŋte mujarekicne i râembiŋ.
Siliwa ŋemâc 10 tauseŋ izi ine furuficte katapa sasawa â ââketâc irec râqâc wiac rike sueŋkehuc bambiŋ, ŋemâc 100 izi râqâc moc, ŋemâc 100 izi râqâc moc, iŋuczi iŋuc bame râqâc 100 fuawec.
Siliwa nâfocne ŋemâc 70 fowec izi ine heheawic bawec â wâtuŋ ɋorockewec, erâ wâtuŋte qârârâc i siliwa izia bawec wâc.
Aeŋ bâbâroŋ tahare biŋe râekicne irec ŋemâc ine 7 tauseŋ 90.
Izi tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcte wâtuŋ irec râqâc mecne, alata mecne, alata sapa‐ticne mecne, alatare wâcwiac mecne,
hae ʒoŋare wâtuŋte râqâc mecne, hae ʒoŋare motâcte wâtuŋ irec râqâc mecne erâ tiri bozere fâzâ â hae ʒoŋa rârec rârec fâzâ râe rakicne i sasawa bafârewec.
Eme qoruc keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ izi tirificko gie bapare ŋaqi ba akic ehuc ɋâtâmbiŋ, ŋaqi i Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko Aroŋte biŋe bambiŋ hâcne.
Ehuc qoqonaŋ ŋaqi i gol â qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ â fâfâsâc izi bambiŋ.
Erâ gol hejacnerâ bâtâcnepie muc eme izi qoruc keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ â fâfâsâc qâreŋnehec bambiŋ.
Â qoqonaŋ ŋaqire masecne barâ tofanao ʒuhucke itic embiŋ.
Eme ŋaqio basanaŋkezore bâmbândeŋ‐ticne i wiac izia bakicne, gol â qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ â fâfâsâc izi basarickekicne hâcne, ine Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâko bakicne.
Eme qânâ furi sâko ba akic erâ râqâc kâwinao râepie huwec, eme qânâ furi sâko ira Israe ŋicguru 12 jaŋere ʒâŋe heutuckehuc qâreŋkembiŋ.
Eme qânâ jajahec i ɋawe ŋifec â ŋifec qoqonaŋ ŋaqi masecne ʒuʒuhuc‐jekicko basanaŋkembiŋ, erâ i Israe ŋic manasuc‐jopahuc juniŋte iŋuc embiŋ; ine Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko hâcne.
Eme amecte qâ i qoqonaŋ ŋaqi iŋucne gol â qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ â qoruc fâfâsâc izi ba akic ehuc bambiŋ.
Ʒoricne â otecne sâcjekic mocjaha, erâ sâcticne i 9 inses bahuc maine â râpene bâturec‐jofarâ bacjofambiŋ.
Erâ qâ faio qânâ birine 4 birickembiŋ. Biri namba wâŋ ira qânâ furi sâko ʒiŋuc birickepie forawec: Saradiu i qânâ bâbâroŋ, Topazi i qânâ âmuc âmucne,
Karapuŋke i qânâ ârâŋ ɋâri. Biri namba 2 ira ine qânâ furi sâko kecʒiŋuc râembiŋ: Emerali i qânâ ârâŋ ɋâɋâri, Safiri i qânâ keŋkeŋne â Daemaŋ i qânâ ɋaɋac taeŋne kiruŋ tinac.
Biri namba 3 ira qânâ furi sâko ʒiŋuc birickembiŋ: Jaʒiŋti i qânâ bâbâroŋ soc tinac bâbâroŋ, Akata i qânâ buge iŋucne â Ametisi i qânâ qondaŋ horiki tinac.
Biri namba 4 ira ine qânâ ʒiŋuc birickembiŋ: Berili i qânâ bâbâŋeŋ, Onisi i qânâ bâbâroŋ fuŋmoc, erâ Jasipe i qânâ birâ birâ. Erâ qânâ i sasawa râqâc golzi bakicne ira râepie fowec.
Eme qânâ furi sâko 12 jaŋe ʒâŋe‐jeŋichec sasawa, ʒâŋe i ine Israe ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋere sâcko heutuckehuc qâreŋkepie fowec.
Eme amecte qâ ira gol ɋaɋacnezi muc kâpâcwâru hawari mizekicne i basanaŋkembiŋ.
Erâ babasanaŋ jajahec â hoŋeŋeŋ jajahec golzi barâ hoŋeŋeŋ i qâ qaŋeŋ jahecnao basanaŋkembiŋ.
Erâ golzi muc jajahec qâ qaŋeŋnao hoŋeŋeŋ jajahec basanaŋ‐jofakicnao esoriembiŋ.
Erâ muc tofa jahecne i heheawic jajahec ira basanaŋkembiŋ wâc, ehuc qoqonaŋ ŋaqire masecne mamai fowec ira basanaŋkembiŋ.
Izi hoŋeŋeŋ jajahec golzia barâ qâ maŋnere qaŋeŋne ŋifec â ŋifec qoqonaŋ ŋaqi heririŋnao basanaŋkembiŋ.
Erâ gol hoŋeŋeŋ jahec â moc barâ qoqonaŋ ŋaqi ʒuʒuhuc‐ticne juwicpec mamai fowec erâ bâmbândeŋ ba akic ekicne izi basanaŋ‐jofawecko râembiŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc qâ i qoruc muc keŋkeŋnezi qoqonaŋte hoŋeŋeŋko basanaŋkepie qoqonaŋte bâmbândeŋko fosanaŋkewec. I qâzi qoqonaŋ ŋaqionec ŋetarazacte iŋuc embiŋ. Wiac i Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko embiŋ hâcne.
Eme qoqonaŋ ŋaqi irec juwicnao ŋaqi ʒoricne moc qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋnezi fumbiŋ.
Ehuc faic momori jaŋere aeŋ ŋaqi hawecnehec bajumbieŋ iŋuc jaha hawecnehec bambiŋ, erâ tâcnezacte hawecne râreckehuc qaŋeŋne ɋâtâmbiŋ.
Ŋaqi qaŋeŋne juwicne ira ine jâchândâŋ qâqâtâc qoruc keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ izi ba akic ehuc basanaŋkembiŋ.
Erâ goŋgoŋ gol ɋaɋacnezi bambiŋ. Erâ goŋgoŋ mecne jâchândâŋ qâqâtâc mecne i ŋondeŋko huhuc ɋetickepie ŋaqi qaŋeŋnao rârec rârec waha doma rawec.
Goŋgoŋ moc â jâchândâŋ qâqâtâc moc, iŋuczi iŋuc ocŋondeŋ taha giere ŋaqi qaŋeŋnao râe rambiŋ, i Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko embiŋ hâcne.
Erâ Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne jaŋere ŋaqi i qoruc fâfâsâc fukicnezi bambiŋ wâc.
Ehuc maikura â dujeŋic i qoruc fâfâsâczia bambiŋ, â kike ŋaqi‐jeŋic ine qoruc âmuc âmucne fâfâsâczi ɋâtâmbiŋ.
Umbika ine qoruc fâfâsâc â qoruc furi sâko keŋkeŋne â âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ izi ba eric embiŋ; i Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko embiŋ hâcne.
Erâ tiri masapu i gol ɋaɋacnezi barâ irec fainao dâŋ ʒiŋuc heutuckehuc qâreŋkembiŋ: “Wofuŋte erâ bâtirikicne”.
Erâ masapu i muc keŋkeŋnezi bândeŋnerâ maikura fainao basanaŋkembiŋ, i Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko embiŋ hâcne.
Iŋuc epie tiri bozere gie sasawa tarawec. Ehame Israe ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ âzâcne mutâc ewec sâc i mana rereŋ efârehuc iŋuc hâcne embiŋ.
Tarame tiri boze Moserao bafisimbiŋ. Wiac kecʒiŋuc bafisimbiŋ hâcne: Qoruc boze â wâcwiac‐ticne sasawa, heheawic‐ticne, katapa‐ticne, babasanaŋ‐ticne, wâtuŋ‐ticne, râqâc‐ticne,
bupure qoruc lama â noniŋ sahaczi bakicne â peŋzi rikekicne, erâ ââketâc qoruc i mâmâc.
Qorac tapa katapa â reŋticne erâ tapane,
tebo â wâcwiac‐ticne erâ poroŋ furu mukicne;
erâ lambe dodoma gol ɋaɋacnezi bakicne sohocne â râqâc kâwinehec, â wâcwiac‐ticne sasawa erâ tatamacte wokemaŋ.
Alata golzi bakicne i â rurua wokemaŋ erâ wiac âsu biaŋ, erâ qoruc boze motâcte qoruc.
Alata aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bakicne â sapa‐ticne aeŋ bâbâroŋzia bakicne, reŋticne â gie bapare wiac sasawa, wiac ʒuʒure râqâc sâko â kikene mâmâc.
Hae ʒoŋa sâpere qoruc â katapa â râqâc‐ticne â hae ʒoŋa motâcte qoruc, erâ muc â fâzâ wiac‐ticne, erâ tiri boze, tutumaŋ qoruc boze hâcne irec maŋnao gie bapare wâcwiac sasawa.
Tirificko gie bapare ŋaqi ba akic ehuc ɋâtâkicne, taha bapa Aroŋ ere tiri ŋaqi â ŋokâfâcne jaŋere taha giere ŋaqi hâcne.
Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko Israe ŋic ŋokac jaŋe gie iŋuc hâcne bafârembiŋ.
Eme Mose e wiac ebac embiŋ i sasawa hone‐fârerâ ʒiŋuc hâcne mana tarawec: Wofuŋzi muwec irec sâcko jâmbâŋ efârekicne. Iŋuc manarâ jambuŋ‐jopawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Fufuŋke mosare ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba wâŋ ira tiri boze, tutumaŋ qoruc boze hâcne wisetec huzejec.
Ehame qorac tapa katapa i maŋnao hetec ŋeha qoruc ââketâczi sâockezejec.
Erâ tebo iŋuc jaha boze maŋnao hetec ŋeha fainao poroŋ furu mukicne i râe biric ezemec, â lambe dodoma wâc baferâ lambe wiac‐ticne âkendâŋnezemec.
Erâ hosâc âsu ririkere alata golzi bakicne i qorac tapa katapa maŋfuŋnao hetec ŋeha tiri boze motâcte qoruc ââketâc ɋetickezemec.
Qowi bâzi ririkere alata ine tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâc fuŋnao hetec ŋezejec.
Ʒuʒure râqâc sâko ine tutumaŋ qoruc boze â alata ŋondeŋ‐jekicko hetec ŋeha opâ qatec huzejec.
Erâ rârec rârec hae ʒoŋare sac bafârehuc motâc‐ticnere qoruc ɋetickezemec.
Izi rurua wokemaŋ rorâ tiri boze â maŋnao wiac ŋerakac sasawa i ruacnetec tiri ŋezejec.
Qowi bâzi ririkere alata â gie bapare wiac‐ticne sasawa i iŋuc jaha wokemaŋ ruacnehuc bâtirizemec, eme alatazi tiri jâmbâŋ ŋezejec.
Erâ ʒuʒure râqâc â kikene i iŋuc jaha wâc wokemaŋ ruacnehuc bâtirizemec.
Iŋuc erâ Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne ejaretec ware tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko domahapie opâ rua‐jarezemec.
Erâ Aroŋ tiri ŋaqi‐ticne hecnetec hume wokemaŋ ruacnehuc mufirietecne taha bapa‐nane erâ juzejec.
Eme ŋokâfâcne jaŋe wâc mutec ware domahapie ŋaqi ʒora hejaretec huzejec.
Eme mamac‐jeŋic wokemaŋ ruacnecmu iŋuc jaha jaŋe wokemaŋ rua‐jaretec taha bapafâc‐nane erâ junʒepieŋ. Eme wokemaŋ rua‐jarehuc mimiŋzi ɋâric taha bapa gie forahuc juocte mutara‐jarezemec.”
Eme Mose e Wofuŋzi mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko jâmbâŋ wiac efârewec.
Eme jara namba 2 irec fufuŋke mosare ʒoaŋ gie bapa wâŋ ira tiri boze wiseme huwec.
Mose e tiri boze ʒiŋuc ehuc bafaharewec: Râqâc wiac‐ticne heme ŋeha katapa âkendâŋnewec, erâ babasanaŋ‐ticne râerâ wâtuŋ bâfeŋnewec.
Eme tiri boze bupunere qoruc fâreme sâcke‐fârewec, erâ fainao bupu sâsâc‐ticne i Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec irec sâcko qaratiewec.
Izi ine Sâcmutâc Sanaŋ qorac tapa katapa maŋnao râeme huwec, erâ reŋ i fofonao esorieme raʒiwec, eme tapa‐ticne qorac tapa katapa fainao heme ŋewec.
Eme qorac tapa katapa i tiri bozeo baferâ qoruc ââketâc ɋetickeme qorac tapa katapa sâockewec. Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec irec sâcko ewec hâcne.
Erâ tebo i tutumaŋ qoruc boze ira faic mâreŋkopec qoruc ââketâc sahacnao heme ŋewec.
Ŋehame fainao poroŋ furu mukicne i Wofuŋte maio râe biric ewec, i Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ âzâcne mutâc ewec irec sâcko jaha ewec.
Izi lambe dodoma i tiri boze juwic mâreŋkopec ira tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo tebo ŋifecnao heme ŋewec.
Erâ Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcne mutâc ewec irec sâcko lambe wiac‐ticne i wâc Wofuŋte maio âkendâŋnewec.
Eme alata golzi bakicne i tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo ââketâc qoruc heririŋnao heme ŋewec.
Ehame wiac âsu biaŋzi hosâc âsu rikewec, i Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko ewec.
Ehuc tiri bozere motâcko qoruc ɋetickewec.
Qowi bâzi ririkere alata i ine tiri boze motâcnao heme ŋeha fainao qowi bâzi rikewec â taha bawec. Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ âzâcnewec irec sâcko ewec hâcne.
Eme wiac ʒuʒure râqâc i tutumaŋ qoruc boze â alata ŋondeŋ‐jekicko heme ŋeha opâ qame huwec.
Eme Mose mecne â Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne mecne jaŋe ira me kike‐jeŋic ʒure jumbieŋ.
Ine tutumaŋ qoruc boze raʒimbiŋ sâc me alata maickembiŋ sâc iŋuc ejumbieŋ hâcne. I Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcne mutâc ewec irec sâcko embiŋ.
Wiac i tara‐fâreme tiri boze â alata rârec rârec hae ʒoŋa bafârewec. Ehuc hae ʒoŋa motâc irec qoruc ɋetickewec. Mose e iŋuc ehuc gie batarawec hâcne.
Eme karoraczi tutumaŋ qoruc boze qofackewec, ehame Wofuŋte tatamaczi tiri boze fusucmawec.
Eme karoraczi tutumaŋ qoruc boze qofackehuc fowecte â Wofuŋte eri tatamaczi tiri boze fusucmawecte Mose e ira wemocko moc raʒizac.
Eme Israe ŋicguru jaŋe mâreŋ sawao jumbiŋko karoraczi tiri bozeonec fewec sâc hata‐jeŋic ʒuhuckerâ rajumbieŋ.
Karoraczi mi fahareme ine jaŋe mi rara fahareocte mâc woŋec jujumbieŋ.
Ʒoaŋko Wofuŋte karoraczi tiri boze qofackerâ fowec hâcne, â ŋafeo ine Israe ŋicguru ʒeŋgoma jaŋere maio ʒocbâruŋ tinac bâruŋkewec. I mâreŋ sawao juhapie iŋuc hâcne fua jujec.
Wofuŋ e tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo juhuc Mose hefârerâ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ŋokac dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc jazazemec: Ŋoŋeraonec ŋic moczi Wofuŋ taha bacneoctemurâ ine bulimakao moc me lama me noniŋ moc rorâ taha bacnezejec.
“E qowi bâzi moc rikezo murâ ine bulimakao ŋicne biaŋne moc taha bazejec, ehuc Wofuŋzi maname biaŋkeocte tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko taha bazejec.
E meticne taha bâzi qowire qizec faio râeme Wofuŋzi manacneme biaŋkeha kiŋticne tarazejec.
Izi Wofuŋte maio bulimakao i hâcne qâhâmozejec, eme taha bapa, Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne hâcne, jaŋe socticne rorâ alata qoruc bozere motâcfuŋko ŋekac i râreckehuc tienʒepieŋ.
Ehame tahare qowi sahacne âkehockerâ fârine hezuzejec.
Eme taha bapa, Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne jaŋe ʒoc ruqenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc alata faio ʒoc ʒakac ira qowi dâkâne â qizecne erâ wokemaŋne râe‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Hone â kikene ine opâo ʒure‐fârezejec. Eme taha bapa e wiac i mâmâc sasawa alata faio qowi bâzi rike siŋsiŋkeme Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec.
“Me qowi bâzire biŋe lama me noniŋ moc rikezo murâ ine ŋicne biaŋne moc taha bazejec.
Ehuc alata tambaraŋne faicpec ira Wofuŋte maio qâhâmozejec, ehame taha bapa, Aroŋte ŋokâfâc hâcne, jaŋe socticne rorâ alata râreckehuc tienʒepieŋ.
Eme ŋic eki hezume taha bapa jaŋe dâkâne dâkâne â qizecne erâ wokemaŋne alata faio ʒoc ʒakacko ira râe guruc enʒepieŋ.
Hone â kikene ine opâo ʒurezejec. Eme taha bapa eki wiac i sasawa alata faio qowi bâzi rike siŋsiŋkeme Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec.
“Wofuŋ taha bacneocte qowi bâzire biŋe wipe râecnezo murâ ine hapâ â buni râecnezejec.
Eme taha bapa e alatao bararâ upene ʒâkiriŋkerâ alata faio rikezejec. Socticne ine alata ŋifecnao hoŋkeme razejec.
Erâ nârowaŋne â suhucne i alata ŋifecne ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec ʒafe hohoŋke hae fokac ira beheme huzejec.
Â fakecne ine mâc bazu banʒaŋ eme fârinehec fozejec. Ehuc taha bapa e alata faio ʒoc ʒakacko ira qowi bâzi rike siŋsiŋkeme Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec.
“Moc e Wofuŋ taha bacneocte taha bâzi râezo murâ ine poroŋ uucne râecnezejec, ehuc wokemaŋ fainao hoŋkehuc wiac âsu biaŋ ʒuhuckezejec.
Iŋuc erâ Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne taha bapa jaŋerao barazejec. Eme jaŋeraonec moczi wiac irecnec poroŋ uucne â wokemaŋ me fufusuc jaha rorâ wiac âsu biaŋ sasawa ihec alata faio ʒocko rike siŋsiŋkeme Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec.
Taha bâzire nâfocne izi ine Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋere biŋe ezejec, i Wofuŋte taha bâzi rikepie wiac tirine jâmbâŋ ewec irec nâfocne hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe taha bâzi ofeŋ maŋnao rikekicne tahare biŋe râezo murâ ine poroŋ uucne goreŋ tâmiric wokemaŋ opânehec bâsifuckekicne me poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric wokemaŋ opâ ruacnekicne i râenʒepieŋ.
Me taha bâzi ofeŋ fainao rikekicne tahare biŋe râezo murâ ine poroŋ uucne goreŋ tâmiric wokemaŋ opânehec bâsifuckekicne râenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe poroŋ bâfâuckepie piic piic eme wokemaŋ ruacnenʒepieŋ. Iŋuc epie taha bâzi eocmu hâcne.
Me taha bâzi‐ŋeŋic ʒocrâqâcko rikekicne tahare biŋe râezo murâ ine poroŋ uucne jaha wokemaŋ opânehec bâsifuckerâ rikenʒepieŋ.
Erâ taha bâzi wiac izi bakicne i Wofuŋtao baranʒepieŋ, ehuc taha bapa râcnepie alatao râezejec.
Erâ taha bapa e taha bâzi nâfocne rorâ alata faio ʒocko rike siŋsiŋkeme Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec.
Taha bâzire tiwâne ine Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋere biŋe ezejec, i Wofuŋte taha bâzi rikepie tirine jâmbâŋ ewec irec nâfocne hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋte biŋe taha bâzi râezo murâ goreŋ tâmiric banʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe goreŋ me baŋac wiac Wofuŋ taha bacnehuc ʒocko moc mi rikepie ʒazejec.
Wiac iŋucne i Wofuŋte biŋe râezo murâ nânâ nânâsu dameŋko taha râeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc râenʒepieŋ, âsu biaŋ fuaocte ine alata faio mi rikenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe taha bâzi wiac‐ŋeŋic râezo murâ hâwec hefârenʒepieŋ. Anutuhec ʒâʒâfic ekicne irec hâwec i behepie taha bâzi‐ŋeŋic nocne mi ezejec. Aricne taha bâzi wiac‐ŋeŋic sasawa i hâwec hefârehuc râenʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe gie ɋârionec jacgoŋ taha bâzire biŋe Wofuŋ râcnezo murâ ine hazecne moc ʒocko rikekicne me ɋâricne banʒaŋnekicne râenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc wokemaŋ opâne hoŋkepie ruacnezejec. Erâ wiac âsu biaŋhec ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ, iŋuc epie taha bâzi eocmu hâcne.
Eme taha bapazi hândâŋne banʒaŋnekicne â wokemaŋ irec nâfocne, erâ wiac âsu biaŋhec sasawa i rorâ rikeme ʒazejec. Iŋuc eme Wofuŋte taha bâzi rikekicne eocmu.
“Ŋic moc e wama bâzi rikezo manasurâ bulimakao ŋicne me ŋokacne moc roocte ecneme ine biaŋne moc rorâ Wofuŋte maio râezejec.
E meticnezi qowi qizecne bânduŋkerâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko qâhâmozejec, ehame Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne taha bapa jaŋe socticne rorâ alata râreckehuc tienʒepieŋ.
Eme qowi taha bâzire biŋe bâmockekicne irec wokemaŋ qârurune raruŋkerâ Wofuŋ bâzi rikecnezejec.
Ehuc râpe hândâŋ jajahecko wokemaŋzi bohotarâ fokac, erâ bugâpâcko qârurune fokac i mâmâc bârâriec‐jopazejec.
Eme Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne jaŋe wiac i rorâ qowi bâzi ʒocko fokac irec fainao râerâ rikenʒepieŋ. Iŋuc rike siŋsiŋkepie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec.
“Me Wofuŋ wama bâzi rikecnezo manasurâ lama noniŋfâcne jaŋeraonec ŋicne me ŋokacne moc roocte ecneme ine biaŋne moc rozejec.
E lama moc bâzi rikezo murâ Wofuŋte maio rikezejec.
Ehuc meticnezi qowi qizecne bânduŋkerâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko qâhâmozejec; ehame Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne jaŋe socticne rorâ alata râreckehuc tienʒepieŋ.
Eme qowi wama bâzire biŋe bâmockekicne irec wokemaŋ qârurune raruŋkerâ Wofuŋ bâzi rikecnezejec. Ehuc gecne wokemaŋnehec fuŋnao hetâcnekicne â qârurune sasawa,
erâ râpe hândâŋ jajahecko wokemaŋzi bohotarâ fokac erâ bugâpâcko qârurune fokac i mâmâc bârâriec‐jopazejec.
Eme taha bapazi wiac i rorâ alata faio Wofuŋ tiwâ bâzi rikecnezejec.
“Me taha bâzire biŋe noniŋ moc râeocmu ine Wofuŋte maio rikezejec.
Ehuc meticnezi qowi qizecne bânduŋkerâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko qâhâmozejec; ehame Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne jaŋe socticne rorâ alata râreckehuc tienʒepieŋ.
Eme qowi irec qârurune sasawa raruŋkeme taha bâzi‐ticne eha Wofuŋ rikecnezejec.
Ehuc râpe hândâŋ jajahecko wokemaŋzi bohotarâ fokac erâ bugâpâcko qârurune fokac i mâmâc bârâriec‐jopazejec.
Eme taha bapazi wiac i rorâ alata faio Wofuŋ tiwâ bâzi rikecneme âsu biaŋ fuazejec. Wokemaŋ sasawa i Wofuŋte biŋe hâcne.
Ŋoŋe wokemaŋ me soc mi nâjâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ, dâŋsanaŋ i mimiŋzi ɋâric ira me ira jufeniŋmu sâc bajunʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ŋokac dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Wofuŋzi wiac ebac ezore sâcmutâc râewec i ŋic moczi mi mana tarahuc huckeocmuo,
me taha bapa wokemaŋ ruacnekicne e sâqocne bâfuahuc ŋic ŋokac bâbiec‐jopame kiŋhec eniŋmuo ine sâqocne bâfuawec irec erâ bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne biaŋne moc Wofuŋte maio sâqocne tâtâmire taha moc bazejec.
Ehuc bulimakao i tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko Wofuŋte maio bafisizejec, erâ meticnezi qizecne bânduŋkehuc qâhâmozejec.
Erâ taha bapa wokemaŋ ruacnekicne e bulimakao soc gâcne rorâ tutumaŋ qoruc boze maŋko bafezejec.
Ehuc memotec‐ticne socko âke uruckerâ Wofuŋte maio tirificte ââketâc fuŋnao tieme arecne 7 ezejec.
Erâ taha bapa e soc gâcne Wofuŋte maio hosâc âsu ririkere alata, tutumaŋ qoruc bozere maŋko ŋekac irec ʒuŋene ruacnezejec. Soc tiwâne ine tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko qowi bâzi ririkere alata ŋekac irec fuŋnao hoŋkezejec.
Erâ bulimakao sâqocne tâtâmirere biŋe qakicne irec wokemaŋ â qârurune honao bohotarâ fokac i raruŋkezejec.
Ehuc râpe hândâŋ jajahecko wokemaŋzi bohotarâ fokac, erâ bugâpâcko qârurune fokac i mâmâc bârâriezejec,
(wama bâzire biŋe bulimakao taha bahuc wiac ecnekicne sâc ijaha ecnezo). Ehuc taha bapa e wiac i taha bâzi ririkere alata faio rikezejec.
Bulimakao sahacne â biucne â qizecne â kikene erâ hone
i sasawa hae râpenao ʒafe hohoŋke mâreŋ biaŋnao bararâ ʒocko rikenʒepieŋ.
“Me Israe kikefuŋ ʒeŋgoma jaŋe Wofuŋzi wiac ebac ezore sâcmutâc râewec i mi mana tarahuc huckerâ tutumaŋko hesoŋkehuc kiŋhec eniŋmu.
Eme sâqocne bâfuakicne i fua taniŋkeme kikefuŋzi bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne moc rorâ sâqocne tâtâmirere biŋe taha baniŋte tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo bafisinʒepieŋ.
Ehame soŋaŋ micne jaŋe Wofuŋte maio mejeŋiczi bulimakao qizecne bânduŋkerâ qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
I tarame taha bapa wokemaŋ ruacnekicne eki bulimakao soc gâcne rorâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo bafezejec.
Erâ memotec‐ticne socko âke uruckerâ Wofuŋte maio ââketâc fuŋnao tieme arecne 7 ezejec.
Izi soc gâcne rorâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozere maŋko alata Wofuŋte maio ŋekac irec ʒuŋene ruacnezejec; soc tiwâne ine tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko qowi bâzi ririke alata ŋekac irec fuŋnao hoŋkezejec.
Ehuc wokemaŋ‐ticne sasawa alata faio rikezejec.
Sâqocne tâtâmirere biŋe mârâc bulimakao wiac ecnekicne sâc ijaha bulimakao ʒi ecnezejec. Taha bapa e iŋuc ehuc kiwiric‐jeŋic rome sâqocne bâbâtâmire fua‐jarezejec.
Eme bulimakao hae râpenao bahurâ mârâc moc rikewec iŋuc jaha rikezejec. I kikefuŋte sâqocne tâmireocte wiac iŋuc hâcne fuazejec.
“Me ŋic fekicne moc e Wofuŋ Anutu‐ticnezi wiac ebac ezore sâcmutâc râewec i mi mana tarahuc huckerâ kiŋ bâfuaocmuo,
me sâqocne bâfuawec i mutaniŋkecneniŋmuo ine taha baocte noniŋ ŋicne biaŋne moc râezejec.
Ehuc meticnezi noniŋ qizecne bânduŋkerâ taha bâzire qowi qâhâmoeŋgopieŋ ijaha Wofuŋte maio qâhâmozejec. E iŋuc eme sâqocne tâtâmire taha eocmu.
Eme taha bapa e sâqocne tâtâmire taha irec soc gâcne rorâ memotec‐ticnezi qowi bâzi ririkere alata ʒuŋene ruacnezejec; soc tiwâne ine alata irec fuŋnao hoŋkezejec.
Wokemaŋne sasawa ine alata faio wama bâzire wokemaŋ rikewec irec sâc jaha rikezejec. Taha bapa e iŋuc ehuc ŋic sâqocne ere kiwiric rome sâqocne bâbâtâmire fuacneocmu.
“Me ŋic ŋokac omane jaŋeraonec moc e Wofuŋzi wiac ebac ezore sâcmutâc râewec i mi mana tarahuc huckerâ kiŋ bâfuaocmuo,
me sâqocne bâfuawec i mutaniŋkecneniŋmuo ine taha baocte noniŋ ŋokacne biaŋne moc râezejec.
Ehuc meticnezi noniŋ qizecne bânduŋkerâ noniŋ i taha bâzire qowi qaeŋgopieŋ ira okacne qâhâmozejec.
Eme taha bapa e meticnezi soc gâcne rorâ qowi bâzi ririkere alata ʒuŋene ruacnezejec; soc tiwâne ine alata fuŋ nao hoŋkezejec.
Ehuc wama bâzire wokemaŋ bârârieeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha wokemaŋ‐ticne sasawa bârâriezejec. Erâ alata fâio rike siŋsiŋkeme Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec. Taha bapazi iŋuc ehuc ŋic ere kiwiric rome sâqocne bâbâtâmire fuacnezejec.
“Me ŋic ekizia sâqocne tâtâmire taha baocte lama moc râeocmuo ine ŋokacne biaŋne moc râezejec.
Ehuc meticnezi lama qizecne bânduŋkerâ bâzire qowi qâhâmoeŋgopieŋ ijaha sâqocne tâtâmirere qowi qâhâmozejec.
Eme taha bapa e sâqocne tâtâmire irec soc gâcne rorâ memotec‐ticnezi qowi bâzi ririkere alata ʒuŋene ruacnezejec; soc tiwâne ine alata fuŋnao hoŋkezejec.
Wokemaŋ‐ticne sasawa i wama bâzire lama irec wokemaŋ bârârieeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha bârârierâ alatao Wofuŋte taha bâzi gâcne ʒahuc fokac irec fainao râeme ʒazejec. Taha bapa e iŋuc ehuc ŋic sâqocne bâfuawec ere kiwiric rome sâqocne bâbâtâmire fuacnezejec.
“Ŋic moc e ŋic âgo‐ticnezi wiac repicne ebac eme hone manac erâ mi mufuaocmuo ine kiŋ hotâckeocmu.
Me ŋic moczi wiac wâwânâŋne, qowi mimicne me hae qowi jaŋere qâŋɋâŋ me wiac babarâ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere qâŋɋâŋ moc mi mana tarahuc ba bâuac erâ wâwânâŋhec ehuc kiŋ bâfuaocmu hâcne.
Me ŋic moc e ŋic âgofâc‐ticne wiac repicne izi me izi bâpuriŋ‐jopaha qanaŋ mi mana tarahuc he heuac ejareocmu mecne, ʒâhec ine mana tarahuc ʒiŋuc muocmu: No kiŋhec ekopac hâcne.
Me ŋic moczi wiac biaŋne me sâqocne ebac eocte mi mana tarahuc acmâc jaha mupaŋkeocmu mecne, ʒâhec ine fuŋne‐ticne mana tararâ kiŋhec ekopac muocmu.
Ŋic moc e wiac i me i ehuc kiŋ bâfuaocmuo ine sâqocne bâfuawec i mufuazejec.
Ehuc sâqocne bâfuawec irec kiŋ tatarare bâzi Wofuŋtao râezejec. Lama me noniŋ ŋokacne moc sâqocne tâtâmire taha râezejec hâcne. Eme taha bapazi sâqocne‐ticnere erâ kiwiric‐ticne rozejec.
“Me lama moc mi focnekacko ine sâqocne bâfuawec irec kiŋ tatara tahare biŋe hapâ jajahec me buni jajahec Wofuŋtao râec‐jofazejec. Moc i sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ehame moc i qowi bâzire biŋe ezejec.
E wiac i taha baparao râezejec. Eme eki hapâ moc i sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe râezejec, ehuc upene mâc ʒâkiriŋkerâ mi hetâcnezejec.
Erâ soc gâcne rorâ alata tambaraŋnao tiehuc nâfocne ine alata fuŋnao hesiezejec. Iŋuc eme sâqocne tâtâmire taha eocmu hâcne.
I tarame hapâ moc mumutâc dâŋte sâcko qowi bâzire biŋe râezejec. Taha bapa e ŋic sâqocne bâfuawec ere kiwiric rome sâqocne bâbâtâmire fuacnezejec.
“Me ŋic hapâ jajahec me buni jajahec moc mi jucnepie ine sâqocne bâfuawec irec sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe poroŋ uucne amae 10‐konec wâŋ râezejec. Sâqocne tâtâmire taha ekacte wokemaŋ opâne me wiac âsu biaŋhec moc mi ʒuhuckezejec.
E wiac i taha baparao bafisime eki hosâc âsure biŋe me fufusuc jaha rorâ alatao bâzi gâcne Wofuŋte biŋe ʒahuc fokac irec fainao rikezejec i sâqocne tâtâmire taha ekac hâcne.
Taha bapa eki ŋic e wiac i me i ehuc sâqocne bâfuawec ere kiwiric rome sâqocne tâtâmire fuacnezejec. Ehame taha bâzire ekicne sâc ijaha ehapie poroŋ tiwânezi taha bapare biŋe ezejec.”
Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Ŋic moczi mi mana tarahuc wiac moc Wofuŋte biŋe bâtirikicne i sâctiri râeocmu ine kiŋ tatara tahare biŋe lamafâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec ŋicne biaŋne moc Wofuŋtao râezejec. Furi‐ticne ine tiri ficte siliwa moneŋ fokac irec sâcko muzemec, wiac i kiŋ tatarare taha hâcne.
Wiac bâtirikicne sâckoa mi râewec irec okacne bârisiezejec, erâ i sawa mâcne, wiac fiuc rowec irec 5‐konec wâŋ ʒuhuckerâ taha bapa râcnezejec. Eme taha bapa e lama ŋicne kiŋ tatara tahare biŋe râehuc kiwiric jâoc rome sâqocne bâbâtâmire fuacnezejec.
“Wofuŋzi wiac ebac ezore sâcmutâc râewec i ŋic moczi mi mana tarahuc huckerâ sâqocne bâfuaocmuo ine sifu kiŋ hotâckeocmu.
Irec ŋic e goki mutâcnecnecmu irec sâc lamafâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec ŋicne biaŋne moc kiŋ tatara tahare biŋe taha baparao bafisizejec. Eme taha bapa eki, ŋic mi mana tarahuc bahac bâfuawec ere kiwiric jâoc rome sâqocne bâbâtâmire fuacnezejec.
Ŋic e Wofuŋte maio kiŋ bâfuawecte taha izi kiŋ tatara taha ekac hâcne.”
Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Ŋic moc e ŋic âgo‐ticnere wiac hone soŋaŋ eocte râcnekicne i mickecnehuc bajuocmu me wiac moc fiuc roocmu, me ŋic âgo‐ticne bâʒâickehuc wiac jâoc roocmu e Wofuŋ râpeckerâ kiŋ bâfuaocmu.
Me wiac sifuckekicne i bâfuarâ mumupaŋ dâŋ burecne muhuc mickeocmu ine kiŋ jaha bâfuaocmu.
Ine ŋiczi wiac i me i ebac ehuc sâqocne bâfuaeŋgopieŋ i ehuc kiŋ hotâckeocmu jaha. Irec wiac fiuc roocmu me ŋic jopa sipiric ehuc roocmu me wiac hone soŋaŋ eocte râcnepie bâsifuckeocmu me wiac sifuckekicne bâfuaocmu,
me wiac irec me irec mumupaŋ dâŋ burecne muhuc sakareocmu i furu jaha bârisie‐fârezejec. Erâ i sawa mâcne, e wiac i sasawa irec 5‐konec wâŋ ʒuhuckerâ kiŋ tatara taha râeocmu dameŋ ira rune râcne‐fârezejec.
Erâ goki mucmu irec sâc lamafâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec ŋicne biaŋne moc Wofuŋte biŋe qahuc kiŋ tatara tahare biŋe taha baparao bafisizejec.
Eme taha bapa e Wofuŋte maio kiwiric jâoc rome ŋic e wiac i me i ebac ehuc kiŋ bâfuawec irec bâbâtâmire fuacnezejec.”
Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne ʒiŋuc mutâcne‐jarezemec: Qowi bâzi ririkere sâcmutâc kecʒiŋuc fokac: Qowi bâzi i alata faio ʒafeo jaha ʒahuc foha hae furezejec, ehame alatao ʒoc ʒakac i bâruŋkehuc fozejec.
Eme taha bapa e gie ŋaqi â hohose‐ticne heme hume qowi bâzi alatao ʒakume ʒafe fuawec i rorâ alata heririŋnao hesiezejec.
Iŋuc erâ gie ŋaqi wiac‐ticne mocwâc heunuckerâ ŋaqi omane herâ ʒafe wiac hae râpenao ʒafe hohoŋke mâreŋ biaŋne fokac ira barazejec.
Alata faio ʒoc i mi hâhâpo ʒahuc jaha fozejec, ehame taha bapa e furic sâc ʒoc tucne râerâ fainao qowi bâzi qandaŋkehuc ine wama bâzire wokemaŋ rikezejec.
Ehame alata faio ʒoc i mi hâhâpo ʒahuc jaha fozejec.
“Taha bâzi ririkere sâcmutâc kecʒiŋuc fokac: Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne jaŋe Wofuŋte maio alata fuŋko taha bâzi râenʒepieŋ.
Ehame moczi taha bâzire poroŋ uucne wokemaŋnehec me fufusuc moc, â wiac âsu biaŋhec fainao râekicne i sasawa rorâ alata faio rike siŋsiŋkeme Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec.
Tiwâne ine Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe nânʒepieŋ, jaŋe wiac i goreŋ tâmiric tutumaŋ qoruc bozere tiri hae ʒoŋao nânʒepieŋ hâcne.
Tiwâ bâzi i goreŋ tâmiric mâc rikenʒepieŋ. Nore biŋe tiwâ bâzi rikekicne irec dâkâne moc qikiŋne‐jarepo hâcne, i sâqocne tâtâmire â kiŋ tatarare taha irec sâc taha tiri jâmbâŋ ekac.
Aroŋ ɋâricfâcne jaŋe sasawa Wofuŋte tiwâ bâzire dâkâne sâcne nâniŋmu irec sâcmutâc i mimiŋzi ɋâric foŋare rahuc juzejec. Ehame ŋic izi me izi wiac i ba bâuac ejarerâ tirine eocmu.”
Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne jaŋeraonec moc wokemaŋ ruacneniŋmu dameŋ ira Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe taha bâzi kecʒiŋuc râenʒepieŋ: Poroŋ uucne amae 10‐konec wâŋ iŋuc râenʒepieŋ, ehuc gâcne furictere â gâcne ŋafere biŋe râenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe wokemaŋhec bâsifuckerâ ʒocrâqâcko rikenʒepieŋ; eme rike hâmokicne i bazutec dâkâ piic piic eme taha bâzi iŋucne bafisirâ rike siŋsiŋketec Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec.
Ehame Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne jaŋeraonec moc mamac‐ticne âkehockeocte wokemaŋ ruacnekicne e wâc iŋuc jaha taha bâzi Wofuŋte biŋe râehuc juzejec. Ʒi Wofuŋte mumupaŋ fofo sanaŋ. Taha i ine furu jaha rikenʒepieŋ.
Taha bapazi taha bâzi rikeocmu i moc mi nâhuc furu jaha râepie ʒafârezejec.”
Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne kecʒiŋuc jazazemec: Sâqocne tâtâmirere sâcmutâc i kecʒiŋuc: Qowi bâzi qâhâmoeŋgopieŋ hae ijaha sâqocne tâtâmire qowi Wofuŋte maio qâhâmonʒepieŋ, i wiac tirine jâmbâŋ.
Taha bapa sâqocne tâtâmire bâzi rikeocmu eki nâzejec; ine tutumaŋ qoruc bozere tiri hae ʒoŋao nâzejec.
Ŋic omane moczi ba bâuac eocmu e ine okacne fuacneocmu, me socticnezi ŋaqi moc ruacneme ŋaqi i tirific maŋko ʒurenʒepieŋ.
Â qowi biucne ʒaekac hapec i qanʒaŋnenʒepieŋ, me aeŋ kuʒio ʒaocmuo ine kuʒi i ʒure bâkereŋ enʒepieŋ.
Taha bapa ŋic jaŋe sâqocne tâtâmire taha irecnec nâzo murâ sâcne nâniŋmu, taha i wiac tirine jâmbâŋ hâcne.
Mâc sâqocne tâtâmire qowi mocte soc tutumaŋ qoruc bozere maŋko kiwiric rorore manasuhuc tirificko bafembiŋko ine qowi i moc mi nânʒepieŋ, aricne, i ʒocko râepie ʒafârezejec.
“Kiŋ tatara taha bâzi i tirine jâmbâŋ, irec sâcmutâc ine kecʒiŋuc:
Qowi bâzi qâhâmoeŋgopieŋ hae ijaha kiŋ tatara taha bâzi irec qowi qâhâmonʒepieŋ wâc, ehuc socticne taha bâzire alata râreckehuc tienʒepieŋ.
Wokemaŋ‐ticne sasawa, gecticne wokemaŋnehec â qârurune honao bohotakac i mâmâc tahare biŋe qafârenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc râpe hândâŋ jajahecko wokemaŋzi bohotarâ fokac erâ bugâpâcnao qârurune fokac i râpe hândâŋhec mâmâc bârâriezo.
Taha bapa eki hâcne wiac i Wofuŋte biŋe qahuc alata faio rikezejec; wiac i kiŋ tatarare taha hâcne.
Taha bapa ŋic jaŋe irecnec wiac gâcne nâzo murâ sâcne nâniŋmu, wiac i tirine jâmbâŋ ekacte nâzo murâ tirific maŋko nânʒepieŋ.
Kiŋ tatara i sâqocne tâtâmire tahare sâc jaha, irec jahe sâcmutâc‐jekic mocjaha. Wiac i taha bapa kiŋ tatara taha râehuc kiwiric roocmu ere biŋe ezejec.
Me taha bapa moc e ŋic i me i ere qowi bâzi rikeocmu e qowi bâzi rikewec irec sahacne rozejec.
Me taha bâzi ofeŋmaŋko me ʒocrâqâcko me ofeŋ fainao rikekicne i taha bapazi taha râeocmu ere biŋe ezejec.
Â taha bâzi wokemaŋhec bâsifuckekicne me kereŋne i sasawa Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne jaŋere biŋe eme sâckoa bâtâc banʒepieŋ.
“Wama bâzi gâcne gâcne Wofuŋte biŋe qahuc rikeniŋmu irec sâcmutâc i kecʒiŋuc:
Ŋic moc e wama bâzi daŋge tahare biŋe râezo murâ ine nânâ poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric wokemaŋhec bâsifuckekicne â poroŋ wokemaŋ ruacnekicne erâ poroŋ uucne wokemaŋhec bâsifucke‐hâmokicne i mâmâc râezejec.
Wama bâzi‐ticne daŋge tahare biŋe râehuc nânâ poroŋ goreŋnehec mâmâc râezejec.
Erâ e taha râeocmu sâc poroŋ irec dâkâne moc rorâ Wofuŋte biŋe qazejec; izi ʒâhec ine taha bapazi wama bâzire soc tieekac ere biŋe ezejec.
Daŋge tahare biŋe wama bâzi qowi irec biucne rikeniŋmu ʒoaŋ ijaha nâfârenʒepieŋ, tiwâne moc behepie foha hae mi furezejec.
Me ŋic moczi mumupaŋ muwecte erâ taha râeocmu me buafec‐ticnere râeocmuo ine râeocmu ʒoaŋ ijaha nânʒepieŋ, tiwâne foocmuo ine hae fureme nâfârenʒepieŋ.
Me qowi tucne tofane moc foocmuo ine ʒoaŋ namba 3 ira ʒocko râepie ʒafârezejec.
Me wama bâzi qowi irec biucne gâcne ʒoaŋ namba 3 ira moc nâniŋmuo ine Wofuŋzi ŋic taha râewec e jahacne â taha‐ticnere maname mi biaŋkeocmu. Taha iŋucnere manapie wiac mamakâcne ezejec, ehame moc e nâ bac eocmuzi kiŋ nâfuaocmu.
“Qowi biucnezi wiac mamakâcne he heuac eocmu ine mi nânʒepieŋ, i ʒocko râepie ʒazejec. Ŋic ɋaɋacne juŋgopieŋzi qowi gâcne nâzo murâ nânʒepieŋ.
Mâc ŋic moc e wâwânâŋhec juhuc wama bâzi Wofuŋte biŋe mukicne irec qowi nâocmu e mi juzejec.
Me ŋic moczi ŋic me qowi wâwânâŋhec me wiac wâwânâŋne ba bâuac erâ wama bâzi Wofuŋte biŋe mukicne irec qowi nâocmu e wâc mi juzejec.”
Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazac: Ŋoŋe bulimakao me lama me noniŋ irec wokemaŋ moc mi nânʒepieŋ.
Qowi e jahac hâmoekac me qowi mimicne gâcne jaŋe kisuc qâsuckeeŋgopieŋ irec wokemaŋ i wiac irec me irec rozo murâ ronʒepieŋ, nânâ ine moc mi nânʒepieŋ.
Me ŋic moc e Wofuŋte biŋe bâzi rikeniŋmu irec wokemaŋ nâocmu e mi juzejec.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, ŋoŋe ira me ira juhuc qâqâc me qowi soc moc mi nânʒepieŋ.
Moc e soc i nâocmu e mi juzejec.”
Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazac: Moc e wama bâzi‐ticne Wofuŋtao râeocmu e irec tofane Wofuŋte biŋe qazejec.
Ehuc Wofuŋte biŋe alatao rikeeŋgopieŋ i e jahac bafisizejec. Wokemaŋ â qowi amec siecne hâcne bafisizejec, eme amec siecne i Wofuŋte maio fenʒoŋkehuc taha râenʒepieŋ.
Ehame taha bapa e wokemaŋ alatao râeme ʒaha amec siecnezi Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋere biŋe ezejec.
Wama bâzire ŋefacne fâreopec i ine taha bapa râcne tahac enʒepieŋ.
Ŋefacne fâreopec i Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne jaŋeraonec moczi soc tiehuc wokemaŋ rikeocmu ere biŋe ezejec.
No Israe ŋic wama bâzi‐jeŋic irecnec amec siecne â ŋefacne nore biŋe rorâ taha bapa Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jarepo. I Israe ŋic jaŋe honerâ iŋuc erahuc juniŋte epo hâcne.
Wofuŋ bâzi rikecneniŋmu irecnec wiac izi hâcne Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋere biŋe ezejec. Iŋuc fuaocte Wofuŋzi taha bapafâc‐ticne erâ juhuc kiŋaŋ qacneniŋte rowosâec‐jopawec dameŋ ira hâcne mupaŋkekicne.
Israe ŋic jaŋe wiac iŋuc hâcne jare tahac eniŋte Wofuŋzi taha bapa wokemaŋ rua‐jarembiŋ dameŋ ira mupaŋke‐jarewec. Jaŋe mimiŋzi ɋâric iŋuc erahuc junʒepieŋ.”
Qowi bâzi ririke â taha bâzi sâqocne tâtâmire â kiŋ tatara taha â mumufirie taha erâ wama bâzi irec sâcmutâc iŋuc hâcne fokac.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Sinai mâreŋ sawao Wofuŋ bâzi rikecneniŋte mutâcne‐jarewec dameŋ ira hâcne sâcmutâc i sasawa Sinai tikio Mose âzâcne mutâc efârewec.
Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne rocjopazemec, erâ ŋaqi qoruc, wokemaŋ opâ, sâqocne tâtâmire tahare bulimakao, lama ŋicne jajahec erâ poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric kâdohec i mâmâc rofârezemec.
Rofârerâ kikefuŋ ʒeŋgoma tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko hetumaŋ‐jopazemec.”
Eme Mose e Wofuŋzi âzâcne mutâc ewec irec sâc efârewec, ehame kikefuŋ jaŋe tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko tumaŋnembiŋ.
Ehame Mose e kikefuŋ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wofuŋzi wiac kecʒiŋuc enaŋte mutâcne‐nârewec.”
Mose e iŋuc jazarâ Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne ejareme warepie opâ rua‐jarewec.
Rua‐jareme tarame Aroŋ ŋaqi maŋne hecneme hume umbikazi basanaŋkecnewec. Izi ŋaqi sahacne â qoqonaŋ ŋaqi hecneme hume qoqonaŋ ŋaqire masecne mizekicne izi hafecnewec.
Iŋuc erâ qâ amecnao qonaŋkecnerâ amecnao dâŋ mumutarare ma jajahec Urim â Tumim i hâcne râecnewec.
Erâ Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko qizecnao du kakambuc moc hecneme huwec â masapu golzi bakicne, eri hendiŋ tirine hâcne, i ira bohotacneme mamai fowec.
Eme Mose e rurua wokemaŋ opâ rorâ tiri boze â maŋnao wiac fofârewec i ruacnehuc bâtiriwec.
Erâ wokemaŋ gâcne alatao tieme arec 7 ewec. Ehuc alata â giere wiac‐ticne sasawa erâ opâ pake sâko ŋeŋenehec i bâtirieocte wokemaŋ ruacnewec wâc.
Wokemaŋ gâcne ine Aroŋ mufirieocte qizecnao hoŋkehuc ruacnewec.
Mose e iŋuc erâ Wofuŋzi mutâcnecnewec irec sâc ehuc Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne ejareme warepie ŋaqi hejareme hume umbika joma‐jarerâ du hejareme huwec.
I tarame sâqocne tâtâmire tahare bulimakao ŋicne mume bafisipie Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe mejeŋiczi qizecne basanaŋkembiŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc bânduŋkepie Mosezi qâhâmowec. Ehuc socticne rorâ meticnezi alata ʒuŋene râreckehuc ruacnewec, iŋuc ehuc ʒure ɋaɋackewec. Soc gâcne ine alata fuŋnao hoŋkewec. E alatare due baocte iŋuc ehuc bâtiriwec.
Iŋuc erâ Mose e wokemaŋ qârurune â bugâpâcnao qârurune fokac erâ râpe hândâŋ jahecnao wokemaŋzi bohotara fokac i rorâ alatao râeme ʒawec.
Bulimakao fârine â sahacne â biucne erâ hone i ine Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko hae râpenao ʒocko râeme ʒafârewec.
Eme Mosezi mume qowi bâzi ririkere lama ŋicne bafisipie Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe qizecne bânduŋkembiŋ.
Ehame Mose e qâhâmorâ socticne alata râreckehuc tie rawec.
Izi lama ŋicne hezupie tarame Mosezi qizecne â dâkâne dâkâne erâ wokemaŋne râeme ʒawec.
Erâ hobune â kikene opâzi ʒureme tarame wiac i sasawa iŋuc jaha alatao rome ferâ ʒawec. I Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko hâcne qowi bâzi râeme ʒahuc Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuawec.
Eme Mose e lama ŋicne moc, mumufiriere lama hâcne, i mume bafisipie Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe mejeŋiczi qizecne bânduŋkembiŋ.
Ehame Mosezi qâhâmorâ soc gâcne rorâ Aroŋ hazecɋoŋ‐ticne fâreopec â meneŋgoc‐ticne fâreopec erâ kike neŋgoc‐ticne fâreopec jaha ruacnewec.
I tarame Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne jowac‐jopa warepie Mosezi hazecɋoŋ‐jeŋic fâreopec â meneŋgoc‐jeŋic fâreopec â kike neŋgoc‐jeŋic fâreopec jaha i soc rua‐jarewec; soc gâcne ine alata râreckehuc tie rawec.
Iŋuc erâ wiac kecʒiŋuc rofârewec: Wokemaŋ â gecne wokemaŋhec â honao wokemaŋ bohotarâ fowec â bugâpâcnao qârurune fowec â râpe hândâŋ jajahec â ira wokemaŋzi bohotara fowec erâ ŋefacne fâreopec.
Erâ Wofuŋte maio nânâ poroŋ kâdoc ŋewec irecnec poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric moc â poroŋ wokemaŋhec rikekicne moc erâ poroŋ rike dapirekicne i mâmâc rorâ wokemaŋ â ŋefacne fâreopec irec faio râewec.
Ehuc wiac i sasawa Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋere meo râerâ ejareme Wofuŋte maio fenʒoŋkembiŋ.
Eme Mose e mocwâc mejeŋickonec rorâ alata faio qowi bâzihec mâmâc mumufirie taha eha rike siŋsiŋkeme Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuawec.
Ehame Mose e amec siecne rorâ Wofuŋte maio fenʒoŋkewec wâc. Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâc mumufiriere amec siecne i Mosere biŋe ewec hâcne.
Eme Mose e rurua wokemaŋ gâcne â alatao soc fowec irecnec wâc gâcne rorâ Aroŋ jahacne â ŋaqi‐ticne erâ wâc ŋokâfâcne erâ ŋaqi‐jeŋic rua‐jarewec. Iŋuc ehuc Aroŋ e jahacne â ŋokâfâcne mâmâc ŋaqi‐jeŋichec bâtiric‐jopawec.
Erâ Mose e Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko qowi biuc rikerâ poroŋ mumufirie kâdocko fokac ihec mâmâc nânʒepieŋ. No irec hâcne ʒiŋuc mutâcne‐ŋarepo: ‘Aroŋ go â ŋokâfâcge ŋoŋe nânʒepieŋ.’
Erâ qowi â poroŋ irec tiwâne fome ʒocko rikenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tutumaŋ qoruc boze moc mi bebehe ijaha ŋehuc juhapie mumufirie dameŋ‐ŋeŋic tarazejec; nâŋe mufiriec‐ŋopahuc juhapene ʒoaŋ 7 taraocmu hâcne.
Miŋecgac wiac ekicne i kiwiric‐ŋeŋic rozore Wofuŋte micte ekicne.
Ŋoŋe hâmonʒipiŋte Wofuŋzi mutâcnewec irec sâcko wiac ebac ehuc tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko ŋafe ʒoaŋ ŋehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ 7 tarazejec; dâŋ iŋuc hâcne ŋazapemurâ mutâcne‐narekicne.”
Eme Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ mutâcnecnewec i jazame reŋke‐fârembiŋ.
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 8 maickeme Mosezi Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne erâ Israe soŋaŋ micne hetumaŋ‐jopa‐fârewec.
Ehuc Aroŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go bulimakao motecnezi ŋicne biaŋne moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe, erâ lama ŋicne biaŋne moc qowi bâzire biŋe rocjofarâ Wofuŋte maio bâzi rikec‐jofazemec.
Ehuc Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘Ŋoŋe noniŋ ŋicne moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe rorâ bulimakao motecne â lama biaŋne jara‐jekic wâŋ ekicne i qowi bâzire biŋe rocjofanʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋte maio wama bâzi rikeniŋte bulimakao ŋicne moc â lama ŋicne moc rocjofanʒepieŋ, erâ taha bâzi i wokemaŋhec bâsifuckenʒepieŋ; Wofuŋ e miŋecgac maic‐ŋopaocmu hâcne.’”
Eme Mosezi wiac mutâcne‐jarewec irec sâc tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo bafisipie kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋe Wofuŋte maio tumaŋne‐fârembiŋ.
Ehame Mosezi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wofuŋ e huriri qâreŋ‐ticnezi fua‐ŋareocmurâ iŋuc hâcne eniŋte mutâcne‐ŋarewec.”
Mose e iŋuc murâ Aroŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go alata maickehuc sâqocne tâtâmire taha â qowi bâzige rikehuc gahacne â wiacfâcge ŋaŋacne kiwiric rozemec. Izi ine Wofuŋzi mutâcnewec irec sâcko ŋic ŋokac jaŋere taha bahuc kiwiric‐jeŋic wâc rozemec.”
Eme Aroŋ e alata maickehuc e jahacne biŋe sâqocne tâtâmire tahare bulimakao motecne moc qâhâmowec.
Ehame ŋokâfâcne jaŋe soc râcnepie memotec‐ticne ira âke uruckerâ alata ʒuŋene ruacnewec, soc tiwâne ine alata fuŋnao hoŋkewec.
Sâqocne tâtâmire tahare wokemaŋ â râpe hândâŋ erâ bugâpâcte qârurune i ine Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko alatao râeme ʒawec.
Biucne â sahacne ine hae râpeo ʒocko rikewec.
Aroŋ e iŋuc erâ qowi tahare biŋe qâhâmowec; ehame ŋokâfâcne jaŋe soc râcnepie alata râreckehuc tie rawec.
Eme jaŋe qowi bâzi i dâkâne dâkâne erâ qizecne wâc râcnepie alata faio râeme ʒawec.
Ehame hobune â kikene opâzi ʒurerâ qowi bâzihec mâmâc alata faio râeme ʒawec.
Ʒafâreme ŋic ŋokac jaŋere taha ʒiŋuc râewec: E qanaŋ e jahacne biŋe sâqocne tâtâmire taha râewec irec sâc jaha ehuc noniŋ ŋicne rorâ ŋic ŋokac jaŋere biŋe sâqocne tâtâmire taha rikewec.
Erâ mumutâc‐ticne fowec irec sâcko qowi bâzi rikewec wâc.
Erâ taha bâzi mâmâc râewec, ehuc me fufusuc jaha alata faio furictere qowi rikewec ijaha ʒuhuckerâ râeme ʒawec.
Eme Aroŋ e bulimakao â lama ŋicne ŋic ŋokac jaŋere biŋe wama bâzire qâhâmowec, ehame ŋokâfâcne jaŋe soc râcnepie alata râreckehuc tiewec.
Bulimakao â lama jahere wokemaŋ me gecne wokemaŋhec â qârurune honao mecne, râpe hândâŋko mecne, erâ bugâpâcnao mâmâc bohotarâ fokac
i hâcne amec siec‐jekicko ropie feme alatao râeme ʒawec.
Amec siecne â ŋefacne fâreopec i ine Mosezi mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko Wofuŋte maio fenʒoŋkehuc taha râewec.
Aroŋ e iŋuc erâ mejahec‐ticne ŋic ŋokac jaŋeraopec bâfeŋnehuc jambuŋ‐jopawec. Iŋuc erâ sâqocne tâtâmire taha â qowi bâzi erâ wama bâzi rike‐fârerâ wahawec.
Eme Mose â Aroŋ jahe tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo raʒipic. Izi risie wefurâ ŋic ŋokac jambuŋ‐jopapire Wofuŋte huriri qâreŋzi ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋerao fua taniŋkewec.
Ehame Wofuŋtaonec ʒoc bâruŋzi fuarâ qowi bâzi â wokemaŋ alata faio fowec i ʒâseŋkewec. Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe wiac i honerâ ʒeri ehuc fodape‐fârembiŋ.
Aroŋ ŋokâ jahec‐ticne Nadaba â Abihu jahe hosâc âsu ririkere ʒocrâqâc rorâ ʒoc ʒakicne â hosâc âsure wâcwiac râepic. Erâ Wofuŋzi mi mutâcne‐jacteha ere maio ʒoc furune rikepire gâpârewec.
Iŋuc epire Wofuŋte ʒocbâruŋzi fuarâ mai‐ticnao ʒâhâmoc‐jofawec.
Iŋuc fuame Mosezi Aroŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec irec fârine fuakac hâcne: ‘Norao qohotahuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋerao tiri juju‐nanere fuŋne bataniŋkepe ŋic ŋokac jaŋerao huriri qâreŋ‐nane fua taniŋkezejec.’” Iŋuc mume Aroŋ e mâc fâsâerâ domawec.
Eme Mose e Aroŋ wawa‐ticne Uʒiele ŋokâ jahecne Misae â Elizafaŋ jahe wira‐jacterâ ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ŋohe âgo jahec‐ŋekic jahere qâŋɋâŋ tiri bozeonec hae râpeo reŋjofa hunic.”
Iŋuc mume jahe rarâ qâŋɋâŋ jahe ŋaqi‐jekiczi foŋjofarâ Mosezi mutâcne‐jactewec irec sâcko hae râpenao reŋjofa hupic.
Eme Mose e Aroŋ â ŋokâ jahec‐ticne Eleaʒa â Itama jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe hâmonʒipiŋte â Wofuŋzi kikefuŋ aaric mana‐jarezacte qizec susuc‐ŋeŋic behepie mi ʒorazejec â ŋaqi‐ŋeŋic wâc mi bâsuckenʒepieŋ. Qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic Israe kikefuŋ hâcne jaŋe ine Wofuŋzi manaha ʒoc fuarâ ŋic jahe ʒâseŋ‐jofawec irec ki soŋgâŋ ezo murâ enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋzi wokemaŋ rua‐ŋarewecte, me hâmonʒipiŋte tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâc beherâ mi hunʒepieŋ.” Eme Mosere dâŋ reŋkehuc iŋuc embiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ e Aroŋ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec:
“Go mecne, ŋokâfâcge mecne, ŋoŋe hâmonʒipiŋte tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo raʒizo murâ waiŋ me opâ sanaŋ gâcne moc mi nânʒepieŋ; dâŋsanaŋ i mimiŋzi ɋâric bajunʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe wiac tirine â omane erâ wiac ɋaɋacne â wâwânâŋhec i ʒâŋitarâ mana wosâenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc noni Mose dâŋsanaŋ âzâcne mutâc epe mufua‐ŋarewec i Israe ŋic ŋokac qazu‐jare‐fârenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Mose e Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋeraonec jajahec sawa jupic, Eleaʒa â Itama jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe taha bâzi Wofuŋte biŋe rikepie tiwâne foekac i wâc tirine jâmbâŋ ekacte rorâ alata heririŋko goreŋ tâmiric nânʒepieŋ.
I Wofuŋte biŋe rikekicnaonec go â ŋokâfâcge ŋoŋere biŋe qakicnere tiri haeo nânʒepieŋ. No iŋuc hâcne mutâcne‐narekicne.
Amec siecne fenʒoŋkekicne â ŋefacne bâzi rikekicne i go mecne â ŋokâfâcge mecne erâ otâfâcge jaŋehec mâmâc fic hae ɋaɋacne mocko nânʒepieŋ. Wiac i hâcne Israe ŋic ŋokac jaŋere wama bâzionec go â ŋokâfâcge ŋoŋere biŋe qakicne.
Ŋefacne bâzi rikeeŋgopieŋ â amec siecne fenʒoŋkeeŋgopieŋ i Wofuŋte maio fenʒoŋkehuc taha baniŋte wokemaŋ ʒocko rikeeŋgopieŋ ihec mâmâc bafisinʒepieŋ. Eme Wofuŋzi mutâcnewec irec sâcko go â ŋokâfâcge ŋoŋere biŋe erâ fohuc juzejec.”
Mose e iŋuc murâ sâqocne tâtâmire tahare noniŋ irec aijakic jaha mu wioc ewec. Ehuc, biac râepie ʒajec, iŋuc manarâ Aroŋ ŋokâfâcne jaŋeraonec jajahec jupic, Eleaʒa â Itama jahe aaric mana‐jactehuc ʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Ŋohe sâqocne tâtâmire taha i wemocte tiri haeo mi nâpirec? I wiac tirine jâmbâŋ hâcne, erâ Wofuŋte maio kikefuŋ jaŋere kiwiric rohuc kiŋjeŋic âsickenicte ŋacte taha ekicne.
Manakopirec, socticne i tiri boze maŋnao mi bafekicne. No mutâcne‐ŋactepo irec sâcko tiri bozeo nâpire muzac sâckezac.
Iŋuc mume Aroŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: Manakic, jahe miŋecgac Wofuŋte maio sâqocne tâtâmire taha â qowi bâzi‐jekic rikepirec, ehame sifu wiac hâhâwicne keci fua‐narejec. Me miŋecgac sâqocne tâtâmire taha nâpe muzac Wofuŋte maio sâckezac me?”
Eme Mose e dâŋ i manarâ maname fâsâewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose â Aroŋ ʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Ŋohe Israe ŋic ŋokac kecʒiŋuc jazazepirec: Ŋoŋe mâreŋko qowi juraŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec gâcne kecʒiŋuc nâcjopazo murâ nâcjopanʒepieŋ.
Kike râqâc‐jeŋic fâucke‐hâmokicne fuambiŋ â nânâ ŋâc hepie wefume nâeŋgopieŋ i jaŋe sâcne nâcjopaniŋmu.
Kike râqâc‐jeŋic fâuckekicne fuambiŋ me nânâ ŋâc hepie wefume nâeŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec sifu kecʒiŋuc jaŋe mi nâcjopanʒepieŋ: Kamele e nânâ ŋâc heme wefume nâekac, mâc kike râqâc‐ticne mi fâuckekicnere manacnepie wâwânâŋhec ezejec.
Erâ qowi moc ʒâŋene roki beʒe e nânâ ŋâc heme wefume nâekac, mâc kike râqâc‐ticne mi fâuckekicnere manacnepie qowi wâwânâŋhec ezejec.
Me qowi moc ʒâŋene hea, e nânâ‐ticne ŋâc heme wefume nâekac, mâc kike râqâc‐ticne mi fâuckekicnere manacnepie wâwânâŋhec ezejec.
Erâ bec e kike râqâc‐ticne fâuckekicne, mâc nânâ nâhuc ŋâc mi heekacte manacnepie wâwânâŋhec jaha ezejec.
Qowi i jaŋere hâcne manapie wâwânâŋhec eha mi nâcjopanʒepieŋ â qâŋɋâŋ‐jeŋic ba bâuac wâc mi enʒepieŋ.
“Opâo qowi juŋgopieŋ gâcne kecʒiŋuc nâcjopazo murâ nâcjopanʒepieŋ: Hâwecko me opâo qowi dipa â garac‐jeŋichec sasawa juŋgopieŋ jaŋe sâcne nâcjopaniŋmu.
Qowi wiac gâcne gâcne hâwecko me opâo dipa â garac tâmiric gerec gerec bahuc juŋgopieŋ jaŋere ine manapie wiac mamakâcne ezejec.
Eme jaŋe mamakâcne jaha juhapie biuc‐jeŋic mi nânʒepieŋ â qâŋɋâŋ‐jeŋic honepie mamakâcne jaha ezejec.
Opâ qowi dipa â garac tâmiric sasawa honec‐jopapie mamakâcne efârenʒepieŋ.
“Wipe jaŋeraonec ine kecʒiŋuc jaŋere mamakâc‐ŋopame mi nâcjopanʒepieŋ, jaŋe wiac mamakâcne hâcne. Tucwipe, mombaŋ, keŋ,
bicqâreŋ, mebâroŋ â wipe iŋucne gâcne,
kâec kâec â wipe iŋucne gâcne,
qera, ŋafe wipe, kâte kaiŋɋaŋ, piʒu piʒu â wipe iŋucne gâcne,
bioc bioc, gararaweŋ, ɋâreŋ hâmoc,
mebâ, baro gâgâpâc, qeri,
qeʒo, baro qaŋqaŋ, bikuaŋ erâ mindi mindi.
“Gisic wiac fafakec‐jeŋichec â mekike‐jeŋic 4‐zi rac warec eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere manapie wiac mamakâcne jaha ezejec.
Mâc gisic wiac gâcne fakec‐jeŋichec â mekike‐jeŋic 4‐zi rac warec eeŋgopieŋ erâ kike‐jeŋic gâcnezi mâreŋko tara he ehuc raeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine nâcjopazo murâ sâcne nâcjopaniŋmu.
Ʒiŋuc jaŋe sâcne nâcjopaniŋmu hâcne: Hâpic fuŋne fuŋne, ɋâuc bisirec fuŋne fuŋne, ɋirikiŋ fuŋne fuŋne, erâ hefuac fuŋne fuŋne.
Gisic wiac gâcne gâcne fakec‐jeŋichec â mekike‐jeŋic 4 jaŋere ine manapie wiac mamakâcne ezejec.
“Ŋoŋe qowi â gisic iŋucne nâhuc wâwânâŋhec eniŋmu hâcne; eme moc e qâŋɋâŋ‐jeŋic ba bâuac ehuc wâwânâŋhec erâ juha hae ŋafeocmu.
Me moc e qâŋɋâŋ‐jeŋic tofane moc rorâ baraocmu e ŋaqi‐ticne ʒurezejec, e jahacne ine wâwânâŋhec erâ juha hae ŋafeocmu.
Qowi kike râqâc‐jeŋic dâkâpeaŋ fâuckekicne fuambiŋ, me nânâ nâhuc ŋâc mi heeŋgopieŋ jaŋere manapie wâwânâŋhec ezejec. Irec moc e ba bâuac ejarerâ wâwânâŋhec eocmu.
Erâ qowi me kike tape‐jeŋic 4‐zi rac warec eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere wâc manapie wâwânâŋhec ezejec. Ehame moc e qâŋɋâŋ‐jeŋic ba bâuac ejareocmu e wâwânâŋhec erâ juha hae ŋafeocmu.
Me moc e qâŋɋâŋ‐jeŋic rorâ baraocmu e ŋaqi‐ticne ʒurezejec, e jahacne ine wâwânâŋhec erâ juha hae ŋafeocmu. Ŋoŋe qowi iŋucne hâcne honec‐jopapie wâwânâŋhec enʒepieŋ.
“Wiac kecʒiŋuc jaŋe mâreŋko guru sâko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere wâc manapie wâwânâŋhec ezejec: Qâqâto, ʒuc, fârio fuŋne fuŋne,
râoŋ, gugume, rekâ, gurac erâ kambarec.
Qowi piic piic i jaŋere hâcne manapie wâwânâŋhec ezejec, ehame ŋic moczi qâŋɋâŋ‐jeŋic ba bâuac ehuc wâwânâŋhec erâ juha hae ŋafeocmu.
Me qâŋɋâŋ‐jeŋiczi wiac moc jâczi bakicne, me ŋaqi, me qowi sahac, me târu, me giere wiac i me i he heuac ejareme wâwânâŋhec eniŋmu. Irec wiac iŋucne i opâo râepie hurâ foha hae ŋafeme ɋaɋackezejec.
Me qowi iŋucnezi hapecko me kuʒio hume wiac maŋnao fokac izi wâwânâŋhec eme kuʒi qanʒaŋnenʒepieŋ.
Hapec iŋucnao opâ fokac i nânâ faio hesiepie wâwânâŋhec eocmu, me hapec irecnec opâ nâpie wâwânâŋhec jaha eocmu.
Me qâŋɋâŋ‐jeŋic moczi waha qahuc wiac i me i he heuac ecneme wâwânâŋhec eocmu. Irec nânâ ʒaza qânâ nombâŋ me ʒafe he heuac ejacteme hezuc hemasec ejactenʒepieŋ. Jahe wâwânâŋhec epicte honec‐jofapie wâwânâŋhec jaha ezepirec.
Qowi iŋucne moczi opâ ʒâŋeo me opâ nombâŋko hume opâzi sifu ɋaɋacnea foocmu; mâc qowi opâo hukicne i ŋic moczi ba bâuac ehuc wâwânâŋhec eocmu.
Me qowi i jaŋere qâŋɋâŋte dâkâne moczi hândâŋ titiere biŋe râekicne irec fainao ferâ heuame hândâŋ izi sifu ɋaɋacne foocmu.
Mâc hândâŋ i qanaŋ opâ hehapie ʒâhec qâŋɋâŋ iŋucnezi heuame ine manapie wâwânâŋhec ezejec.
“Qowi nâcjopaniŋte mana‐ŋarekicne jaŋeraonec moc hâmome ba bâuac ecneniŋmu ine wâwânâŋhec erâ juhapie hae ŋafezejec.
Me ŋic moc e qowi hâmocne i nâocmu e ŋaqi‐ticne ʒurerâ wâwânâŋhec erâ juha hae ŋafezejec. Me moc e qowi hâmokicne rorâ baraocmu e wâc iŋuc jaha ŋaqi‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâwânâŋhec erâ juhame hae ŋafezejec.
“Gisic wiac piic piic mâreŋko gerec gerec bahuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe wiac mamakâcne eŋgopieŋte mi nâcjopanʒepieŋ.
Qowi wiac foforâ jueŋgopieŋ me mekike‐jeŋiczi babarâ raeŋgopieŋ me mekike‐jeŋic bocjaha, erâ wiac sasawa mâreŋ faio gerec gerec bahuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe wiac mamakâcne eŋgopieŋte mi nâcjopanʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe wiac gerec gerec bahuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ba bâuac ejarehuc mi makârenʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe juju‐ŋeŋic hegâpârenʒipiŋte wiac i ba bâuac ejarehuc wâwânâŋhec mi enʒepieŋ.
No Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic jukopac hâcne, no tiri jukopacte ŋoŋe juju‐ŋeŋic bâtirihuc tiri jaha junʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe mâreŋko wiac gerec gerec bahuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ba bâuac ejarehuc wâwânâŋhec mi enʒepieŋ.
No Wofuŋ‐ŋeŋiczi Anutu‐ŋeŋic jupemurâ Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐ŋopa wefupo, irec no tiri jukopacte ŋoŋe tiri jaha erâ junʒepieŋ.”
Dâŋ ʒizi wipe qowi â wiac jujune sasawa opâo me mâreŋko gerec gerec bahuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâcmutâc.
Ŋoŋe wiac wâwânâŋhec â ɋaɋacne me qowi gâcne nâniŋte me mi nâniŋte muŋarekicne i ʒâŋitarâ mana wosâec‐jopaniŋte dâŋ i hâcne râe‐ŋarekicne.
Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Ŋokac moczi kogoc kiweckerâ motec roocmu irec faicnao wâwânâŋhec juha ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec; mosa dameŋ‐ticnao soc rohuc wâwânâŋhec ewec irec sâc jaha juzejec.
Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 8 maickeme motec e sahac tofa‐ticne hetâcnenʒepieŋ.
Eme ŋokac e tâpiri‐ticne mocwâc fuaocte ʒoaŋ gie bapa 33 ficko ŋehuc juzejec, e wiac tirine ba bâuac mi ehuc â tirificko wâc mi fefe mâc ŋehuc juha ɋaɋacne juju dameŋ‐ticne mocwâc maickezejec.
Me ŋokac e kogoc kiweckerâ naru roocmu irec faicnao wâwânâŋhec juha sonda 2 tarazejec, e mosa dameŋ‐ticnao soc rohuc wâwânâŋhec ewec irec sâc jaha juzejec. Eme irec faicnao ʒoaŋ gie bapa 66 mâc ŋehuc juha ɋaɋacne juju dameŋ‐ticne mocwâc maickezejec.
“Ŋokac e naru me motec roocmu irec faicnao taha bapa tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko juekac erao taha râezejec, ine lama moc jara‐ticne wâŋ ekicne i qowi bâzi tahare biŋe â hapâ me buni moc ine sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe râezejec.
Eme taha bapa e wiac i Wofuŋte maio taha bahuc ŋokacte kiwiric rozejec, ehame ŋokac e soc rohuc wâwânâŋhec juweczi ɋaɋackezejec. Ŋokac naru me motec roocmu ere sâcmutâc dâŋ iŋuc hâcne fokac.
Me lama moc mi jucneŋgopieŋko ine hapâ jajahec me buni jajahec rocjofarâ moc qowi bâzi tahare biŋe â moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe râezejec. Ehame taha bapazi taha bahuc kiwiric rocneme ɋaɋackezejec.”
Wofuŋ e Mose â Aroŋ ʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Ŋic moc e sahac‐ticne siwiŋneocmu me pupucneocmu me waec fuacneocmuzi ʒâhec wicsanaŋ ecneme taha bapa Aroŋ me ŋokâfâcne jaŋeraonec taha bapa moc erao jowa ranʒepieŋ.
Eme taha bapa e ŋic sahac ʒâwâ‐ticne qaŋqaŋ eme me sahac‐ticne biac dockeme honerâ muzejec, i wicsanaŋ hâcne. Taha bapa e ŋic iŋuc hone manac ecnerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: Go wâwânâŋhec.
Mâc sahaczi dockerâ wic mi ehuc mâc qeueocmu, me sahac ʒâwâ‐ticne qaŋqaŋ mi eme taha bapazi ŋic e ficko râeme ŋehuc juha ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 7 ira ine taha bapazi ŋic mocwâc hone manac ecneme wic biac mi fuame ine ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 ʒuhuckerâ ficko ŋeocte muzejec.
Eme dameŋ i tarame hone manac ecneme wiczi fua sokac mi eme taha bapazi ŋic ʒinuc âzâcnezejec: Sahacge ɋaɋacnea fokac, i mâc pupucne rakac; eme ŋic e ŋaqi qoruc‐ticne ʒure‐fârerâ ɋaɋacne jaha juzejec.
Eme ŋic e taha baparao fuaocmu irec faicnao wiczi sokame ine taha bapa mocwâc fuacnezejec.
Eme taha bapazi mocwâc hone manac ecnehuc, wiczi fua sokac ewec, iŋuc honerâ ʒiŋuc muzejec: Ŋic e wicsanaŋ fuacnekacte wâwânâŋhec ekac.
“Ŋic moc wicsanaŋ ecneme taha baparao jowa ranʒepieŋ.
Eme taha bapazi hone manac ecnezejec. Ehame sahac‐ticne tamaehuc siwiŋneme sahac ʒâwâ‐ticne qaŋqaŋ ewec, eme sisiwiŋ fokac ira biuczi hâckerâ ŋeme honerâ ʒiŋuc manazo:
I wicsanaŋ raŋɋane, irec taha bapa e, ŋic go wâwânâŋhec jukomec, iŋuc âzâcnerâ ficko mi râezejec; ŋic e biac wâwânâŋhec ekac hâcne.
Me wicsanaŋzi fua sawec erâ sahac‐ticne sasawa qizecnaonec fuŋkerâ wahaku kikenao tarakac i sâcke‐fâreme
taha bapazi hone manac ecnezejec. Eme wicsanaŋzi sahac‐ticne sâcke‐fârewec, iŋuc honerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: Go ɋaɋackekomec. Wiczi qaŋqaŋ efârewecte ŋic e ɋaɋackekac hâcne.
Me biuczi erao hâckerâ ŋeme ʒiŋuc manazo: Ŋic e wâwânâŋhec.
Eme taha bapa e hone manac ecnerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: Go wâwânâŋhec ekomec. Wicsanaŋ fokacte biuc hâckekicnezi wâwânâŋhec ekac.
Me biuc hâckekicnezi qaŋqaŋ eme ŋic e taha bapa mocwâc fuacnezejec.
Eme taha bapazi hone manac ecnehuc, wic i biac qaŋqaŋ efârewec, iŋuc honerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: Go ɋaɋackekomec hâcne.
“Me ŋic mocte sahacko wicʒâhâc tackekicnao
sisiwiŋ hawarine qaŋqaŋ me gogowac moc fuame taha bapa jâutunʒepieŋ.
Eme taha bapazi hone manac ezejec. Ehame sahac‐ticne biac dockeme sahac ʒâwâ‐ticne qaŋqaŋ eme taha bapazi honerâ ŋic ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: Go wâwânâŋhec ekomec, i wicʒâhâczi juku wicsanaŋ ewec hâcne.
Me sahac ʒâwâzi qaŋqaŋ mi eme â sahac‐ticnezi biac mi dockeha taha bapazi honerâ ficko râeme ŋehuc juha ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
Ehame wiczi mesahac‐ticne gâcne sâcke‐fâreme taha bapazi ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: Go wâwânâŋhec ekomec, wicgezi wicsanaŋ ekac hâcne.
Me wiczi mi sokame ine ʒiŋuc muzo: Wicʒâhâcte râfâ sawa eme taha bapazi fâsâcne jukomec, iŋuc âzâcnezejec.
“Me ŋic mocte sahac ʒoczi ʒame pârâckerâ gowaeme qaŋqaŋ erâ foocmu,
ine taha bapazi hone manac ezejec. Ehame sahac ʒâwâzi qaŋqaŋ eha sahac‐ticne dockeme ʒiŋuc manazo: I wicsanaŋ hâcne, ʒoczi ʒakicnao fuawec. Eme taha bapazi ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: Go wicsanaŋ fua‐garekacte wâwânâŋhec ekomec hâcne.
Me sahac ʒâwâzi qaŋqaŋ mi ewec, me sahaczi biac mi dockehuc mâc bâŋeŋkeme taha bapazi honerâ ficko râeme ŋehuc juha ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 7 ira taha bapazi ŋic e hone manac ecnezejec. Ehuc wic i fua sokac eme honerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: Go wicsanaŋ fua‐garekacte wâwânâŋhec ekomec.
Me wic i mârâc fowec ijaha fohuc mi sosoka mâc gowaeme ʒiŋuc muzo: Ʒocbâruŋzi ʒame siwiŋnewec. Irec taha bapa e ŋic ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: Ʒocte râfâ sawa ekacte ɋaɋackekomec.
“Eme ŋic me ŋokac moc utunao me mecqaŋeŋnao wic moc fuacneme
taha bapazi wic i honezejec. Ehame sahac‐ticne dockeha sahac ʒâwâne bâŋeŋkeme taha bapazi ŋic ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: Utugao me mecqaŋeŋgao wic fua‐garekac i wicsanaŋ ekacte wâwânâŋhec ekomec.
Me sahaczi biac mi dockeha â sahac ʒâwâzi gâgâpâc mocwâc mi ehuc bâŋeŋkeme taha bapazi wicte fuŋne iŋuc honerâ ŋic wichec e ficko râeme ŋehuc juha ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 7 ira taha bapazi i mocwâc honezejec. Eme wiczi soka ŋedâmârec mi ewec, me sahac ʒâwâzi bâbâŋeŋ mi fuame â wiczi mi dockeme
ine ŋic e mecʒâwâ hehuc wicko ine mi hezejec. Ehame taha bapazi ŋic wichec e ficko râeme ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 ʒuhuckerâ ŋezejec.
Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 7 ira taha bapazi wic honezejec. Ehame wiczi soka ŋedâmârec mi eme â sahaczi wâc mi dockeme taha bapazi ŋic ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: Go ɋaɋackekomec. Iŋuc âzâcneme ŋic e qoruc wiac‐ticne ʒure‐fârerâ ɋaɋacne juzejec.
Me irec faicnao wicticnezi mocwâc soka ŋedâmârec eme
taha bapazi honezejec. Ehuc fua sawec ewecko ine sahac ʒâwâ bâbâŋeŋte ʒâŋe mi fihuc mâc ʒiŋuc sawa âzâcnezejec: Go wâwânâŋhec jukomec.
Me wic sâfirune mârâc fowec ijaha foha sahac ʒâwâ gâgâpâc mocwâc fuame honerâ ʒiŋuc muzo: Wiczi somiekacte ŋic e ɋaɋackekac. Eme taha bapazi ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: Go ɋaɋackekomec.
“Me ŋic me ŋokac moc sahac‐ticnao ɋâɋâfoŋ fuame
taha bapazi honezejec. Ehame sahac‐ticnao ɋâɋâfoŋ fuakaczi qaʒueme ʒiŋuc manazo: Wic omanezi sawa fuakacte ŋic e ɋaɋackekac.
“Ŋic moc qizec susuc‐ticne waha‐fâreme utu pârâc eocmuzi sifu ɋaɋacne juocmu.
Me ŋic moc e qizec susuc‐ticne mai‐ticnao me naki‐ticnao domakac izi waha‐fâreme mai pârâc erâ sifu ɋaɋacne juocmu.
Me utu pârâc me mai pârâc‐ticnao sahaczi bâruŋkeme ʒiŋuc muzo: Utu pârâc me mai pârâc‐ticnao wicsanaŋ fuakac hâcne.
Iŋuc fuame taha bapazi honezejec, ehame sisiwiŋ bâbâroŋ fuakac i sahacko wicsanaŋ fuaekac irec sâc eme ʒiŋuc manazo:
Ŋic e wicsanaŋhec ehuc wâwânâŋhec ekac. Irec wicsanaŋzi qizec‐ticnao fuakacte taha bapazi ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: Go wâwânâŋhec ekomec.
“Ŋic moc wicsanaŋ ecneocmu e ŋaqi suckekicne heme hume juzejec, erâ qizec susuc‐ticne beheme ʒorazejec. Ehuc mecʒâwâ‐ticne faicpec bâsoŋkerâ ʒiŋuc muhuc owackezejec: Wâwânâŋhec, wâwânâŋhec.
E wicsanaŋ focneocmu sâc wâwânâŋhec jaha juocmu. Erâ wâwânâŋhec ekacte hae râpenao bucticne juzejec.
“Ŋaqi ʒâwânehec me ʒâwâ tâmiric
â qoruc wiac ʒâwânehec me ʒâwâ tâmiric, erâ qowi sahac me wiac gâcne qowi sahaczi bakicne
i gukuckehuc qondaŋ qarâ gufeme honerâ taha bapa jâutunʒepieŋ.
Eme taha bapazi honerâ ŋaqi qoruc gukuckekicne i ficko râeme foha ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
Ehame ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 7 ira mocwâc honezejec. Eme gukuczi ŋaqi qoruc me qowi sahac me wiac gâcne qowi sahaczi bakicne i sâcke‐fâreme honerâ ʒiŋuc manazejec: I wiac repicnezi wâwânâŋhec.
Iŋuc manarâ ŋaqi qoruc ʒâwânehec me ʒâwâ tâmiric â wiac gâcne qowi sahaczi bakicne i ʒocko rikezejec.
“Me taha bapa e ʒiŋuc mecne honeocmu: Gukuczi ŋaqio me qoruc wiacko me wiac qowi sahaczi bakicnao mi sawewec.
Iŋuc honerâ wiac gukuckekicne i ʒureniŋte mutâcne‐jarezejec, ʒurepie ficko râeme foha ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
Eme wiac gukucnehec ʒurekicne i taha bapazi mocwâc honezejec. Eme gukuczi mi sawewec â hawari‐ticne wâc mi hetikiewec, iŋuc honerâ sifu ʒiŋuc manazejec: I wâwânâŋnehec ekac. Irec gukuczi ŋifec fuame ʒocko rikezemec.
“Me wiac gukucnehec ʒurepie gowaeme taha bapazi honerâ ŋaqi me qowi sahac me qoruc tofane gukuckewec i bâsuckerâ behezejec.
Eme ŋaqio me qoruc wiacko me wiac gâcne qowi sahaczi bakicnao mocwâc saweme go wiac gukuckekicne hâcne ʒocko rikezemec.
Me ŋaqi me qoruc wiac me wiac gâcne qowi sahaczi bakicne i ʒurepie gukuc omaeme harierâ ʒurepie ɋaɋacke‐hâmozejec.”
Ŋoŋe ŋaqi ʒâwânehec me ʒâwâ tâmiric me qoruc wiac, me wiac gâcne qowi sahaczi bakicne i gukuckeme ɋaɋacne me wâwânâŋhec eocmu irec fuŋne mananiŋte sâcmutâc ʒine hâcne râekicne.
Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Ŋic wicsanaŋheczi ɋiɋic qaocmu ʒoaŋ ira sâcmutâc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac irec sâcko ecnezo: Ŋic e taha baparao baranʒepieŋ.
Eme taha bapazi hae râpenao hurâ ŋic e hone manac ecnezejec. Eme ŋic e ɋiɋic qawec,
taha bapazi iŋuc honerâ mume ŋic ere biŋe taha râepie ɋaɋackeocte wiac kecʒiŋuc bafisinʒepieŋ: Wipe ɋâricne biaŋne jajahec â jâmâzâc jâc dâkâne moc, erâ muc bâbâroŋ â wiac âsu biaŋhec.
Erâ taha bapazi jazame wipe moc i kuʒimaŋko opâ ɋâricne ŋekac irec fainao qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Ine wipe ɋâricne â jâmâzâc jâc dâkâne erâ muc bâbâroŋ â wiac âsu biaŋhec i rocjoparâ wipe opâ faio qâhâmokicne irec socko âke uruc‐jopazejec.
Ehuc ŋic wicsanaŋheczi ɋiɋic qaocte bafisimbiŋ e soc ruacneme arec 7 ezejec. Iŋuc erâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: Ɋaɋackekomec hâcne. Iŋuc muhuc wipe ɋâricne sawao beheme ferâ razejec.
Eme ŋic ɋiɋic qaocte mukicne e qoruc wiac‐ticne ʒurerâ qizec‐ticne rozejec, ehuc e jahacne opâ ruarâ ɋaɋackezejec. Eme irec faicnao haeo raʒirâ boze râpeo ŋehuc juha ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 7 ira ine qizec‐ticne mocwâc rohuc mecʒâwâ â ʒâŋe susuc‐ticne â sahac ʒâwâ‐ticne sasawa hefârezejec. Iŋuc erâ ŋaqi qoruc‐ticne mocwâc ʒurehuc e jahacne wâc opâ ruarâ ɋaɋackezejec.
“Erâ ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 8 ira wiac kecʒiŋuc bacjopa fisizejec: Lama ŋicne biaŋne jajahec â lama ŋokacne biaŋne moc jara‐ticne wâŋ ekicne erâ poroŋ uucne oto moc irec 10‐konec 3 wokemaŋhec bâsifuckekicne â wokemaŋ opâ kiruŋ moc.
Eme taha bapa e ŋic wâwânâŋhec eki ɋaɋackeocte taha gie baocmuzi ŋic e jahacne â wiac bafislocmu i tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko Wofuŋte maio râec‐jopazejec.
Ehuc lama ŋicne moc â wokemaŋ opâ kiruŋhec i kiŋ tatara tahare biŋe râehuc Wofuŋte maio fenʒoŋkezejec.
Iŋuc erâ sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe qowi â qowi bâzi tahare biŋe qâhâmoeŋgopieŋ alata mutirikicne ira lama qâhâmozejec; kiŋ tatarare tahazi sâqocne tâtâmire taha iŋucne taha bapare biŋe ekac irec, i wiac tirine jâmbâŋ.
Eme taha bapa e kiŋ tatara tahare soc gâcne rorâ ŋic ɋaɋackeocte mukicne ere hazec fâreopec â meneŋgoc‐ticne fâreopec â kike neŋgoc‐ticne fâreopec i ruacne‐fârezejec.
Taha bapa e iŋuc erâ wokemaŋ opâ kiruŋko ŋekac i gâcne e jahacne metape qanaopec ira hoŋkezejec.
Izi memotec‐ticne fâreopec wokemaŋ ira âke uruckerâ Wofuŋte maio tieme arec 7 ezejec.
Wokemaŋ tiwâne ŋeocmu i ine ŋic ɋaɋackeocte mukicne ere hazec fâreopec â meneŋgoc‐ticne fâreopec erâ kike neŋgoc‐ticne fâreopec kiŋ tatarare soc ruacnekicne irec faio ruacne‐fârezejec.
Wokemaŋ opâ tofane taha bapare meo ŋeocmu i ine ŋic ɋaɋackeocte mukicne ere faio hoŋkezejec. Iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋte maio kiwiric jâoc rozejec.
Taha bapa e ŋic ɋaɋackeocte mukicne ere kiwiric rohuc sâqocne tâtâmire taha hâcne râezejec. Iŋuc ehuc ʒâhec qowi bâzi ririkere qowi qâhâmozejec.
Qâhâmorâ qowi bâzi â taha bâzi i alatao rikezejec. Taha bapa e iŋuc ehuc ŋic kiwiric jâoc rome ɋaɋackezejec.
“Me ŋic e hapetacte wiac iŋucne sâko râeocte quŋkeocmuo ine kiŋ tatara taha fenʒoŋkehuc kiwiric jâoc roniŋte lama ŋicne mocjaha sawa râezejec. Taha bâzire ine poroŋ uucne wokemaŋhec bâsifuckekicne oto moc irec 10‐konec wâŋ erâ wokemaŋ opâ kiruŋ moc bafisizejec.
Ehuc hapâ jajahec me buni jajahec, ine focneocmu sâc râezejec, ehame moc i sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe â moc i qowi bâzi tahare biŋe ezejec.
Ŋic e ɋaɋackerâ wiac i ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 8 ira taha baparao tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko Wofuŋte maio râezejec.
Eme taha bapa e kiŋ tatara tahare lama â wokemaŋ kiruŋ i rorâ taha bahuc Wofuŋte maio fenʒoŋkezejec.
Ehuc kiŋ tatara tahare lama qâhâmorâ socticne gâcne rorâ ŋic ɋaɋackeocte fisiocmu ere hazecɋoŋ fâreopec â meneŋgoc‐ticne fâreopec erâ kike neŋgoc‐ticne fâreopec i ruacne‐fârezejec.
Taha bapa e iŋuc erâ wokemaŋ opâ kiruŋko ŋekac i gâcne e jahacne metape qanaopec ira hoŋkezejec.
Izi memotec‐ticne fâreopec wokemaŋ opâ ira âke uruckerâ Wofuŋte maio tieme arec 7 ezejec.
Wokemaŋ gâcne ine ŋic ɋaɋackeocte mukicne ere hazecɋoŋ fâreopec â meneŋgoc‐ticne fâreopec erâ kike neŋgoc‐ticne fâreopec kiŋ tatara tahare soc ruacnekicne irec faio ruacne‐fârezejec.
Wokemaŋ opâ tofane taha bapare meo ŋeocmu i ine ŋic ɋaɋackeocte mukicne ere faio hoŋkezejec. Iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋte maio kiwiric‐ticne rozejec.
Eme ŋic e hapâ me buni moc jucneŋgopieŋko taha bazejec.
Ine moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe â moc qowi bâzi tahare biŋe eha taha bâzi mâmâc râezejec. Ehame taha bapazi ŋic ɋaɋackewec ere kiwiric rozejec.
Ŋic moc wicsanaŋhec juku biaŋkeweczi taha wiac râezo eipieocmu ere sâcmutâc iŋuc hâcne fokac.”
Wofuŋzi Mose â Aroŋ ʒiŋuc jasawec:
“No Kanaaŋ mâreŋ i ŋoŋere biŋe eocte ŋare tahac epemu. Eme ŋoŋe ira fisirâ juhapie mupe fic hae‐ŋeŋic gukuckeme
fic runezi taha baparao rarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: No honepe fic hae‐nane gukuckekac iŋuc tinac ekac.
Iŋuc âzâcneme taha bapazi ficmaŋko wiac sasawa fokac i ropie waha‐fâreocte jazazejec. Wiac i wâwânâŋhec efârekac muzacte iŋuc enʒepieŋ. Eme ropie waha‐fâreme taha bapazi ficmaŋko fezejec.
Ferâ fic gukuckewec i honezejec; ehame ficsâpe gukuckehuc qondaŋ qarâ gufewec,
taha bapazi iŋuc honerâ fickonec waharâ motâc ki bame ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 fozejec.
Eme taha bapa e ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 7 ira risierâ mocwâc honezejec. Ehame gukuczi fic sâpenao soka ŋedâmârec eme
honerâ jazame qânâ gukuc hawarinehec i bârârierâ hae râpeo jawao tuŋkepie razejec.
Erâ qânâ sâpe fainao rârec rârec simeŋ fokac i fâze emasaŋ eniŋte jazazejec wâc. Eme wiac fâzekicne i hae râpeo jaha jawao hoŋkepie razejec.
Erâ qânâ ɋâricne rorâ ŋeŋetacnao hepie ŋeha simeŋzi ʒimickenʒepieŋ.
“Eme qânâ wiac ropie wahaocmu â sâpe fâze emasaŋ erâ simeŋ ɋâricnezi ʒimickepie fainao mocwâc gukuckeocmuo
ine taha bapazi ra honezejec. Eme gukuczi fic maŋnao soka ŋedâmârec eme ʒiŋuc manazo: Gukuc repicnezi fic maŋne fusucmakacte wâwânâŋhec ekac.
Iŋuc manarâ fic i heropierâ qânâ â paraŋ wiac‐ticne erâ simeŋ ʒimickekicne i hae râpeo jawao behepie razejec.
Me ŋic moc e ficzi motâc hehe foha raʒiwecko ine wâwânâŋhec erâ juha hae ŋafezejec.
Me moc e fic ira foocmuzi ŋaqi‐ticne ʒurezejec, â moc e fic ira nânâ nâocmu e wâc iŋuc jaha ŋaqi‐ticne ʒurezejec.
“Me fic i simeŋ ɋâricnezi bâpiaŋkepie faicnao gukuczi mocwâc mi fuame taha bapazi honerâ ʒiŋuc muzejec: Gukuczi omaeme ficzi ɋaɋacne jaha ŋekac.
Eme fic i wâwânâŋ tâmiric ʒuhuckerâ ŋeocte taha bapazi wipe piticne jajahec â jâmâzâc jâc dâkâne erâ muc bâbâroŋ â wiac âsu biaŋhec rozejec.
Rorâ wipe moc kuʒimaŋko opâ ɋâricne ŋekac irec faicnao qâhâmozejec.
Iŋuc erâ jâmâzâc jâc dâkâne erâ wiac âsu biaŋhec â muc bâbâroŋ i wipe qâhâmokicnere socko mecne â opâ ɋâricnao mecne âke uruckerâ ficmaŋko tieme arec 7 ezejec.
E iŋuc ehuc wipesoc â opâ ɋâricne â wipe ɋâricne â jâmâzâc jâc dâkâne erâ wiac âsu biaŋhec â muc bâbâroŋ izi ficmaŋne ʒure ɋaɋackezejec.
Tarame wipe ɋâricne i hae râpeo sawao beheme ferâ razejec. E iŋuc ehuc ficte due bame fic izi hâcne ɋaɋackezejec.”
Wicsanaŋ fuŋne fuŋne irec sâcmutâc iŋuc hâcne fokac.
Wic sâfiru me ŋaqio me ficko gukuc fuakac,
me sisiwiŋ me ɋâɋâfoŋ me pârâc fuame
wâwânâŋhec me wâwânâŋ tâmiric ekac irec fuŋne taniŋkeocte sâcmutâc iŋuc hâcne fokac.
Wofuŋzi Mose â Aroŋ kecʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Ŋohe Israe ŋic ŋokac kecʒiŋuc jazanic: Ŋic moc sahac tofa‐ticnaonec opâ wahaocmu i wâwânâŋhec eocmu.
Ehame sahac opâ‐ticne wâwânâŋhec irec sâcmutâc kecʒiŋuc fokac: Sahac opâ‐ticne wahahuc foekac me waharâ mocwâc omaewec ŋic e sifu wâwânâŋhec jaha ekac.
Irec ira me ira fome fofozi wâwânâŋhec jaha eocmu, me ira me ira ŋeme ŋeŋezi wâc wâwânâŋhec jaha eocmu.
Me ŋic izi me izi fofo‐ticne ba bâuac eocmu e qoruc wiac‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâc opâ ruazejec, ehuc wâwânâŋhec jaha juha hae ŋafezejec.
Me ŋic izi me izi ŋic sahac opâ‐ticne wahame ŋewec ijaha ŋeocmu e qoruc wiac‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâc opâ ruazejec, ehuc wâwânâŋhec jaha juha hae ŋafezejec.
Me ŋic izi me izi ŋic sahac opâ‐ticne wahaekac e ba bâuac ecneocmuzi qoruc wiac‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâc opâ ruazejec, ehuc wâwânâŋhec jaha juha hae ŋafezejec.
Me ŋic sahac opâ‐ticne wahaekac e ŋic moc tâfeckeme eki qoruc wiac‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâc opâ ruazejec, ehuc wâwânâŋhec jaha juha hae ŋafezejec.
Me ŋic sahac opâ‐ticne wahaekaczi sate faio ŋeme sate i wâwânâŋhec jaha eocmu.
Me ŋic e wiac i me i ŋefackeocmu i ŋic moczi ba bâuac erâ wâwânâŋhec jaha juha hae ŋafezejec; me moc e wiac iŋucne baraocmu e qoruc wiac‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâc opâ ruazejec, ehuc wâwânâŋhec jaha juha hae ŋafezejec.
Me ŋic sahac opâ‐ticne wahaekaczi meticne mi ʒuʒure ŋic moc ba bâuac ecneocmu e qoruc wiac‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâc opâ ruazejec, ehuc wâwânâŋhec jaha juha hae ŋafezejec.
Me ŋic sahac opâ‐ticne wahaekaczi kuʒi moc ba bâuac eme kuʒi i henʒaŋnenʒepieŋ, oto wiac ine opâzi ʒurenʒepieŋ.
“Eme ŋic sahac opâ‐ticne wâwânâŋhec e ɋiɋic qarâ ɋaɋackeocte ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 wose fezejec. Dameŋ i tarame qoruc wiac‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâc opâ fifisinao rarâ ruahuc ɋaɋackezejec.
Erâ ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 8 ira ine hapâ me buni jajahec rocjofarâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko Wofuŋte maio taha bapa râcnezejec.
Eme taha bapazi taha râeme moc i sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe eha moc ine taha bâzire biŋe ezejec. Ehame taha bapa e Wofuŋte maio ŋic wâwânâŋ‐ticnere erâ kiwiric jâoc rozejec.
“Ŋic moc e wie gorewac‐ticne hoŋkeocmu e sahac‐ticne sasawa opâzi ʒure‐fârezejec, ehuc wâwânâŋhec jaha juha hae ŋafezejec.
Ehame wie gorewac‐ticnezi ŋaqi wiac me fofo mâki bânâŋkeme opâo ʒure‐fârenʒepieŋ, eme wâwânâŋhec jaha foha hae ŋafezejec.
Me ŋic moczi ŋokac mochec fohuc wie gorewac‐ticne hoŋkeme jahe mâmâc jaha opâ ruarâ wâwânâŋhec jaha juhapire hae ŋafezejec.
