“Ŋokac moc e mosa dameŋ‐ticnao soc rohuc juocmu e wâwânâŋhec erâ juhame ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec; ehame moczi ba bâuac ecnerâ wâwânâŋhec jaha juha hae ŋafezejec.
Eme ŋokac e wiac irec me irec fainao fome wiac izi wâwânâŋhec jaha eocmu; me wiac i me i irec fainao ŋeme wâwânâŋhec jaha eocmu.
Me moc e fofo‐ticne ba bâuac eocmu e qoruc wiac‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâc opâ ruazejec, ehuc wâwânâŋhec jaha juha hae ŋafezejec.
Me ŋokac e wiac i me i irec fainao ŋeha ŋic moczi ba bâuac erâ ŋaqi wiac‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâc opâ ruazejec, ehuc wâwânâŋhec jaha juha hae ŋafezejec.
Me ŋokaczi ŋec foc ewecko wiac moc fowec i ŋic moczi ba bâuac ehuc wâwânâŋhec erâ juha hae ŋafezejec.
Me ŋic moc e ŋokac iŋucne ehec foha ere wâwânâŋzi erao fotâcneme wâwânâŋhec jaha juha ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec. Ehame ŋic e fofo foraocmu sâc fofo izi wâwânâŋhec efârezejec.
“Me ŋokac moc e mosa dameŋ‐ticne mi maickeha soc roocmu, me mosa dameŋ‐ticne tarame sifu soc ʒuhuckerâ roocmuo ine soc rohuc juocmu dameŋ irec sâc wâwânâŋhec erâ juzejec, mosa dameŋ‐ticnao wâwânâŋhec eekac irec sâc hâcne wâwânâŋhec ezejec.
Soc rohuc fofo fainao foocmu fofo izi mosa dameŋ‐ticne maickeme fofo foekac irec sâc ezejec, me wiac i me i irec fainao ŋeocmu izi wâwânâŋhec ezejec, ine mosa dameŋ‐ticnao ŋeŋe wiac‐ticne wâwânâŋhec eekac irec sâc.
Eme moczi wiac i ba bâuac eocmu e wâwânâŋhec ehuc qoruc wiac‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâc opâ ruarâ sifu wâwânâŋhec jaha juha hae ŋafezejec.
Me socticne kereŋkeme ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 wose fezejec; eme irec faicnao ɋaɋackezejec.
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 8 ira ine hapâ me buni jajahec rocjofarâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko taha bapa râcnezejec.
Eme taha bapazi taha râeme moc i sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe eha moc izi ine taha bâzire biŋe ezejec. Eme taha bapa e Wofuŋte maio ŋokac wâwânâŋ‐ticnere erâ kiwiric jâoc rozejec.
“Israe ŋic jaŋe tirific‐nane ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ŋekac i gâc hecnehuc hâmonʒipiŋte wâwânâŋ‐jeŋicte erâ uŋ sawaŋ ejarezemec.”
Ʒi ŋic moc sahac opâ‐ticne wahaocmu me sahac tofa‐ticnao opâ hoŋkehuc wâwânâŋhec eocmu ere sâcmutâc.
Erâ sâcmutâc i ŋokac moc mosa dameŋ‐ticne maickeme wâwânâŋhec eocmu, me ŋic ŋokac i me i sahac opâ‐jeŋic wahaocmu jaŋere biŋe, me ŋic moczi ŋokac wâwânâŋhec ehec foocmu ere biŋe wâc mâmâc eocmu.
Aroŋ ŋokâ jahec‐ticne jahe Wofuŋte maio fuarâ hâmopic irec faicnao Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go hahacge Aroŋ e hâmozacte âzâcnetec tirificte ââketâc râpenao katapa tapanere maŋfuŋko dameŋ sâc mi warezejec, no ʒira hâcne karorac maŋko fuapemu.
Aroŋ e tirificko wefuocte wiac kecʒiŋuc rorâ wefuzejec: Sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe bulimakao motecnezi ŋicne moc â taha bâzire biŋe lama ŋicne moc, iŋuc rocjofarâ wefuzejec.
Ehuc ŋaqi maŋne â kike ŋaqi heme hume umbikazi basanaŋkerâ du kakambuc mâmâc heme huzejec. Wiac izi gie ŋaqi tirine ekac, i hâcne opâ ruarâ heme huzejec.
Erâ e Israe kikefuŋ jaŋeraonec noniŋ ŋicne jajahec sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe rocjofahuc lama ŋicne moc taha bâzire biŋe rozejec.
“Eme Aroŋ e jahacne â wiacfâc‐ticne jaŋere kiwiric roocte bulimakao i sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe râezejec.
Iŋuc erâ noniŋ jajahec rocjofarâ Wofuŋte maio tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko râec‐jofazejec.
Râec‐jofarâ moc Wofuŋte biŋe â moc Aʒaʒele nemure biŋe eocte ɋâsâi qazejec.
Erâ Wofuŋte biŋe âke fuaocmu i sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe râezejec.
Aʒaʒelere biŋe âke fuaocmu i ine ɋâricne domahame Wofuŋte maio râehuc kiwiric rorâ mâreŋ burocnao Aʒaʒelerao ecneme razejec.
“Aroŋ e bulimakao i e jahacne â wiacfâc‐ticne jaŋere kiwiric roocte sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe râezejec, ehuc e jahacnere wâc manasuhuc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe qâhâmozejec.
Ehuc alata Wofuŋte maio ŋekac irecnec ʒoc kine gomba tâtâcko hezurâ hosâc âsure wiac uucne me jajahec fufusuc i ââketâc maŋnao bafisizejec.
Erâ hâmozacte ʒoc ʒahuc fokac ira râeme hosâc âsure rombâŋzi qorac tapa katapa tapane sâckezejec.
Ehame bulimakao soc gâcne rorâ meticnezi qorac tapa katapa tapane maŋfuŋnao â fainao tieme arec 7 ezejec.
“Eme irec faicnao sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe noniŋ moc ŋic jaŋere erâ qâhâmozejec, ehuc socticne ââketâc râpenao bafisihuc bulimakao soc tiewec irec sâc jaha ehuc qorac tapa katapa tapane fainao â maŋfuŋnao tiezejec.
E iŋuc ehuc Israe ŋic jaŋe wâwânâŋhec â qaqatara erâ sâqocne‐jeŋic sasawazi tirific hegâpârembiŋ i bâtirizejec. Jaŋe wâwânâŋhec juhapie tutumaŋ qoruc bozere manasuhuc iŋuc hâcne ezejec.
Aroŋ e jahacne me wiacfâc‐ticne â Israe ŋic jaŋere kiwiric roocte tirificko ferâ juhame ŋic moczi tutumaŋ qoruc bozemaŋko moc mi juzejec.
Kiwiric rome tarame waharâ Wofuŋte maio alata ŋekac i bâtirizejec, ehuc noniŋ bulimakao soc gâcne rorâ alata ʒuŋene râreckehuc ruacnezejec.
Ehame meticnezi soc gâcne tieme arec 7 eha Israe ŋic jaŋe alata hegâpârembiŋ i ʒure ɋaɋackehuc bâtirizejec.
“Eme tirific â tutumaŋ qoruc boze erâ alata irec bâbâtiri gie bame tarame noniŋ moc i tahare biŋe ɋâricne râezejec.
Ehuc mejahec‐ticne noniŋ qizecnao râehuc Israe ŋic ŋokac jaŋere kiŋ bahac â qaqatara erâ sâqocne mutaniŋkezejec, ehuc noniŋte faio mume feha ŋic moc ʒawierâ jukac e hâcne soreme mâreŋ burocnao jowa razejec.
Eme noniŋ e kiŋ bahac fainao râekicne i de âsic erâ mâreŋ tuhu pectâcko fisime ŋiczi soreme mâreŋ burocnao ra juzejec.
“Eme Aroŋ e tirificko feocte ŋaqi hewec i tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo ferâ hetara ira râeme fozejec.
Ehame fic maŋne moc bâtirikicne ira opâ ruarâ gie ŋaqi‐ticne moc i heme hume waharâ e jahacne â ŋic jaŋere biŋe taha bâzi rikezejec, ehuc e jahacne â ŋic jaŋere kiwiric rozejec.
Ehuc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare wokemaŋ i alatao rikezejec.
Eme noniŋ Aʒaʒele nemurao jowac rawec ŋic e ŋaqi‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâc opâ ruarâ teuŋko raʒizejec.
Erâ socjekic bâbâtiri gie bazore tirificko bafekicne bulimakao â noniŋ i jahere fâri hae râpenao bacjofa hunʒepieŋ, ehuc sahac â biuc erâ hojekic ʒocko behepie ʒâtâmirezejec.
Eme wiac i rikeocmu ŋic e iŋuc jaha ŋaqi‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâc opâ ruarâ teuŋko raʒizejec.
“Eme dâŋsanaŋ kecʒiŋuc foŋarehuc juzejec: Ŋoŋe mosa namba 7 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 10 ira sowa juhuc ŋaŋacne mecne â ŋic jabane ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mecne gie moc mi banʒepieŋ.
Ʒoaŋ ira ɋaɋackeniŋte kiwiric ŋowac rozo, ehame Wofuŋte maio sâqocne tâmiric domanʒepieŋ.
Ʒoaŋ i sabata hombaŋ fekicne, irec erâ sowa junʒepieŋ; dâŋ izi hâcne foŋare rahuc juzejec.
Eme taha bapa mamac‐ticnere âkehoc wokemaŋ ruacnekicne â mufiriekicne e tiri ŋaqi heme hume tiri gie bazejec.
Ehuc furufic â tutumaŋ qoruc boze erâ alata bâtirihuc taha bapa âgofâcne erâ kikefuŋ guru sasawa jaŋere kiwiric rozejec.
Israe ŋic sâqocne‐jeŋicte erâ jara mocte maŋnao arec wâŋ kiwiric‐jeŋic rozo, dâŋ izi hâcne dâŋsanaŋ‐ŋeŋic erâ foŋare rahuc juzejec.” Eme Mose e Wofuŋzi mutâcnecnewec irec sâc ewec.
Eme Wofuŋ e Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne erâ Israe kikefuŋ ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mutâcnewec:
Israe kikefuŋkonec ŋic moc e bulimakao me lama me noniŋ hae maŋnao me hae râpeo qâhâmorâ
Wofuŋte tiri bozeo taha râeocte tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko mi bafisiocmuo ine soc hoŋkewec irec kiŋ i ŋic ere faio feme ŋic âgofâcne jaŋere guruonec bâsirowezo.
Israe ŋic jaŋe taha bâzire qowi gieo qâhâmoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ i Wofuŋte biŋe qahuc tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko taha baparao bafisirâ ira wama bâzire biŋe qâhâmorâ Wofuŋ taha bacnenʒepieŋ.
Ehame taha bapazi irec soc rorâ Wofuŋte alata tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko ŋekac ira tiezejec, ehuc wokemaŋ‐jeŋic ine ʒocko rikeme Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec.
Israe ŋic jaŋe taha bâzire qowi‐jeŋic i nemu sâqocne kiŋaŋ qajareeŋgopieŋ jaŋere biŋe mocwâc mi qâhâmonʒepieŋ. Dâŋ izi ŋic gaŋne gaŋne fuarâ juniŋmu sâc jaŋere dâŋsanaŋ erâ fozejec.
“Erâ ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ jazazemec: Israe kikefuŋ ŋoŋeraonec, me ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic jaba jueŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec moczi qowi bâzi rikehuc
tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko bafisirâ Wofuŋ taha mi bacneocmu ine ŋic e âgofâcne jaŋere guruonec bâsirowezo.
“Israe kikefuŋ ŋoŋeraonec me ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic jaba jueŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec moczi soc nâocmu e ine râsi ecnehuc ŋic âgofâc‐ticne jaŋere guruonec bâsirowepemu.
Jujure tâpiri i socko fokac hâcne; eme no irec hâcne taha bapazi kiwiric‐ŋeŋic rohuc alatao hoŋkeocte mupo. Jujure tâpiri i socko fokacte taha bapazi iŋuc ehuc kiwiric‐ŋeŋic sâcne roocmu.
No irec hâcne Israe ŋic kecʒiŋuc jazapo: Ŋoŋeraonec me ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic jaba jueŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec moczi soc mi nâzejec.
Israe ŋic ŋoŋeraonec me ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic jaba jueŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec moczi wosaŋeŋ gie bahuc qowi nânâne moc roocmu e socticne mâreŋko hoŋkerâ rufezi hemackezejec.
“Wiac jujune sasawa jaŋere tâpiri i socko fokac; eme no irec hâcne Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazapo: Wiac jujune sasawa jaŋere tâpiri i socko fokacte wiac i jaŋere soc moc mi nânʒepieŋ. Moc e sifu nâocmuzi mi juzejec.
Â mâreŋ rune me ŋic jabane moczi qowi e jahac hâmoekac me qowi gâcne jaŋe ki sipiric ecnepie hâmoekac i nâocmuzi ŋaqi‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâc opâ ruarâ wâwânâŋhec jaha juha hae ŋafezejec. Hae ŋafeme ine ɋaɋackezejec.
Me ŋaqi wiac‐ticne mi ʒurehuc opâ mi ruaocmu ine kiŋ hureocmu.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic kecʒiŋuc jazazemec: No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu.
Ŋoŋe Aigita mâreŋko juhuc Aigita ŋic jaŋe wiac ebac epie hone jumbieŋ irec sâc mi enʒepieŋ, â Kanaaŋ mâreŋko jowac‐ŋopape raʒirâ, mâreŋ rune jaŋe wiac ebac eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc wâc mi enʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe jaŋere dâŋsanaŋte sâcko mi junʒepieŋ.
Aricne, ŋoŋe nore mumutâc dâŋ â dâŋsanaŋ mana rereŋ ehuc irec sâcko junʒepieŋ. No hâcne Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu.
Ŋoŋe irec hâcne dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋnane reŋkehuc bâjâpenʒepieŋ, ine hâcne, moc e bâjâpehuc reŋkeocmuzi juju bâfuaocmu. No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.
“Ŋoŋeraonec moc e soctofafâc‐ticne bâsâqorec‐jopaocte mi fua‐jarezejec. No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.
Go neŋgocge bâsâqorehuc mamacge mimi qaqa mi ecnezemec, e hâcne neŋgocge jukacte mimi fainao mi râezemec.
Go neŋgococge bâsâqorehuc mimi qaqa mi ecnezemec.
Go mamacgere me neŋgocgere otâ, seŋge hâcne, soctofage me seŋocge bâsâqorehuc mimi qaqa mi ecnezemec.
Go ŋosage mi bâsâqorezemec, gahacne faio mimi fezacte iŋuc mi ezemec.
Go neŋgococgere otâ, mamacgezi bâfuawec e mi bâsâqorezemec, e seŋge jaha, irec mimi qaqa mi ecnezemec.
Go neŋgoc piticge mi bâsâqorezemec, e mamacgere soctofa hâcne.
Go neŋgoc piticge mi bâsâqorezemec, e neŋgocgere soctofa hâcne.
Mamac jahecge hahac ɋa jahere ŋokac mi bâsâqorec‐jofazemec, jahe neŋgoc jahecge jaha.
Go joŋaoge mi bâsâqorezemec, e hâcne ŋokâgere ŋokac, irec e mimi qaqa mi ecnezemec.
Go qozige mi bâsâqorezemec, hahacge mimi qaqa ecnezicte.
Go ŋokac moc â naru‐ticne mi bâsâqorec‐jofazemec, me joŋao‐ticne me ŋosa‐ticne jahe wâc mi bâsâqorec‐jofazemec, jahe soctofa jahec‐ticne, irec jahehec sâqocne bapa i wiac hâhâtâne.
Go ŋonâŋge juhame qoticne mamare bajuhuc mi bâsâqorezemec.
“Go ŋokac moc mosa dameŋ‐ticne maickeha bâsâqorecmurâ mi fuacnezemec.
Go ŋic âgogere ŋokac bâsâqorehuc wâwânâŋhec mi ezemec.
Go naru motecfâcge Moleke nemure biŋe râec‐jopahuc Anuture ʒâŋe mi sipirickezemec. No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.
Ŋokac jaŋehec foeŋgopieŋ irec sâc ŋic jaŋehec mi fozemec, iŋuc etec wiac mamakâcne eocmu.
Go qowi moc bâsâqorehuc wâwânâŋhec mi ezemec; â ŋokac moczi qowi ŋicnehec sasec gie mi bazejec, iŋuc eme wiac mamakâcne jâmbâŋ eocmu.
“Go wiac mukicne sasawa i ebac ehuc wâwânâŋhec mi ezemec; no ŋoŋere maio qâpuc ŋic gurune gurune jâpec‐jopape wiseŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne wiac iŋucne ebac ehuc wâwânâŋhec embiŋ.
Jaŋe iŋuc epie mâreŋ‐jeŋiczi wâwânâŋhec ewec; eme no kiŋjeŋicte erâ okacne bazu‐jarepe mâreŋ‐jeŋic tuhutac fuawec.
Ŋoŋe ine dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋnane reŋkerâ bâjâpehuc wiac mamakâcne keci moc mi enʒepieŋ, mâreŋ rune ŋoŋe mecne â ŋic jabane ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mecne.
(Ŋic mârâc jaha mâreŋ ʒi rauckerâ jumbiŋ jaŋe hâcne wiac i ebac epie mâreŋ i wâwânâŋhec ewec.)
Ŋoŋe iŋuc epie mâreŋzi mârâc jaha tuhutac fuarâ fowec irec sâc fuaocmu.
Ŋic izi me izi wiac mamakâcne keci moc ebac eocmu e ŋic âgofâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec bâsirowezo.
Irec ŋoŋe mumutâc dâŋnane mana rereŋ ehuc wiac mamakâcne mârâc jaha ejumbieŋ i ebac ehuc wâwânâŋhec mi enʒepieŋ. No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu hâcne.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe kikefuŋ sasawa kecʒiŋuc jazazemec: Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic no tiri jukopacte ŋoŋe tiri jaha junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe sasawa neŋgoc mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic sâsec‐jopanʒepieŋ, erâ sabata hombaŋ‐nanere manapie tirine ezejec. No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu hâcne.
Ŋoŋe nemuɋâŋ jaŋerao mi qohotanʒepieŋ, ehuc ɋâŋ qâqâtâc wâc mi banʒepieŋ. No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe wama bâzi rikezo murâ ine mumutâc dâŋte sâcko rikepie Wofuŋzi mana‐ŋareme biaŋkezejec.
Wama bâzi rikeniŋmu i ʒoaŋ ijaha me hae fureme nânʒepieŋ; â tiwâne foha ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eocmuo ine ʒocko râepie ʒazejec.
Me ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha sifu nâniŋmuo ine wiac mamakâcne eme Wofuŋzi mana‐ŋareme mi biaŋkeocmu.
Moc e wiac i eocmuzi kiŋ hureocmu, e Wofuŋte wiac tirine irec maname wawahane ewecte. Ŋic iŋucne e âgofâcne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec bâsirowezo.
“Ŋoŋe padi wiac qa roro ehuc gie qaŋeŋnao doma rakac i mi rofârenʒepieŋ; â kisecne doma raocmu i wâc mi unucke‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Waiŋ hândâŋne i iŋuc jaha furu mi bâtâcne‐fârenʒepieŋ, â mâreŋko waharâ fokac i wâc mi nusehuc ŋic hapetac â jabane jaŋere biŋe behepie fozejec. No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe fiuc mi ronʒepieŋ â eeatuc ehuc burec eec wâc mi enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe nore ʒâŋeo ɋetickerâ mumupaŋ dâŋ burecne ehuc ʒâŋe‐nane mi bawahanʒepieŋ. No hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac.
“Ŋoŋe ŋic âgofâc‐ŋeŋic bâʒâic‐jopahuc mafa wiac‐jeŋic mi jowac ronʒepieŋ. Kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere gie furi i bajuhapie hae mi furezejec.
Ŋoŋe ŋic nâŋguŋne mi sâwec‐jopanʒepieŋ; â tiŋtiŋ jaŋere hata i aka mi henʒepieŋ, ehuc Anutu‐ŋeŋic ine araŋ bacnenʒepieŋ. No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe ŋic dâŋjeŋic mutarahuc mi musifuckenʒepieŋ, ehuc ŋic waha qaqane araŋ mi bajarenʒepieŋ, â ŋic fekicne jaŋe wâc mi sâsec‐jopanʒepieŋ, aricne, ŋoŋe ŋic âgofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere dâŋ i sâcmutâc dâŋte sâcko mutara‐jarenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic âgofâc‐ŋeŋic micko âkec mi ejarenʒepieŋ â jaŋere dâŋgie bahuc juju‐jeŋic ba ima ezo mi munʒepieŋ. No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic mi qaisoc‐jopanʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe jaŋere erâ kiŋ hurenʒipiŋte juju â eebapa‐jeŋic mutiŋnenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe okac babazu gie bahuc âgofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere kiŋ mi bajunʒepieŋ; ŋoŋe ŋaŋacnere eŋareekac sâc ijaha âgofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere eŋarezejec. No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe dâŋsanaŋ‐nane mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ. Bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe bulimakao fuŋne fuŋne jaŋehec sisifuc erâ mi junʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe wiac ukicne jajahec gie‐ŋeŋicko mi tienʒepieŋ, â ŋaqi wiac‐ŋeŋic i qoruc hawarine jajaheczi bakicne mi rojunʒepieŋ.
“Ŋic moc e kiŋaŋ naru moc ŋic mocte biŋe qakicne e kiwiric‐ticne ropie rambaŋko mi juha bâsâqoreocmu ine dâŋgie fuazejec. Naru e rambaŋko mi juwecte mi qâhâmoc‐jofazo.
Ŋic e kiŋ tatara taha Wofuŋ râcnezejec, ine lama ŋicne moc kiŋ tatara tahare biŋe tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko hâcne râezejec.
Eme taha bapa e Wofuŋte maio lama ŋicne i kiŋ tatara tahare biŋe râehuc kiwiric‐ticne rozejec, eme sâqocne bawec i bâtâmirecnezo.
“Ŋoŋe mâreŋ biŋe qaŋarekicne ira fisirâ jâc fuŋne fuŋne sarapie fârine fuame mi nâhuc juhapie jara jahec â moc tarazejec. Iŋuc juhuc manapie muac‐nâpokicne ezejec.
Eme jara namba 4 ira fârine fuaocmu i Wofuŋ ʒeri mumuteŋ ecnehuc daŋge taha râecnenʒepieŋ.
Jara 5 ira ine nâ bac epie mâriri sâko fua‐ŋarezejec. No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe qowi biuc socnehec mi nânʒepieŋ, ehuc faŋfaŋdâŋ muhuc qaŋgec mi banʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe naki‐ŋeŋic ŋifec â ŋifec susucne mi hezunʒepieŋ, â mecʒâwâ‐ŋeŋic tofane wâc mi bâtâcnenʒepieŋ.
Hâmoc fuame busâqocte sahac‐ŋeŋic mi hetâcnenʒepieŋ, â soqâreŋ wâc mi banʒepieŋ. No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.
“Go otâge bawahahuc sasec giere mi qikiŋnezemec, iŋuc etec sau gie â hehesiczi mâreŋ mi sâckezejec.
Ŋoŋe sabata hombaŋ‐nanere manapie tirine eha furufic‐nane araŋ bacnenʒepieŋ. No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe bawe me faŋfaŋ wiac maic‐joparâ jaŋerao qohotahuc wâwânâŋhec mi enʒepieŋ. No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe ŋic jaŋɋâŋhec jaŋerao faharenʒepieŋ, ehuc ŋicraŋɋa jaŋe sâsec‐jopanʒepieŋ, â Anutu‐ŋeŋic araŋ bacnenʒepieŋ. No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.
“Ŋic jabane moc e ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko juhame mi bâʒâickenʒepieŋ.
Aricne, ere manapie mâreŋ rune tinac eha ŋoŋe ŋaŋacnere eŋareekac sâc ijaha ere eŋarezejec. Ŋoŋe Aigita mâreŋko jaba jaha jumbiŋte iŋuc enʒepieŋ. No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe ŋic dâŋjeŋic mutarahuc mi musifuckenʒepieŋ, â sâcmeta me sigelire bâbâsifuc wâc mi bâfuanʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe sigeli me ŋemâc me oto me fifia râqâc wiac‐ŋeŋic i sâc mocjaha foŋarezejec. No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu, noni hâcne Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐ŋopa wefupo.
Irec ŋoŋe dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋnane mana rereŋ efârenʒepieŋ. No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic kecʒiŋuc jazazemec: Israe ŋic ŋoŋeraonec moc me ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic jabane jueŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec moczi naru motecfâc‐ticne Moleke nemure biŋe qaocmu e hâmozejec, mâreŋ rune jaŋe hâcne qânâzi hehâmonʒepieŋ.
Ŋic e naru motecfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec moc Molekere biŋe qahuc furufic‐nane wâwânâŋ ecnerâ ʒâŋe‐nane bawahawecte râsi ecnehuc ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere guruonec bâsirowepemu.
Ŋic moc e motec me naru‐ticne Molekere biŋe qame ŋic jaŋe hone bipiehuc mi qâhâmoniŋmuo
ine ŋic e mecne â wiacfâc‐ticne jaŋe râsi ejarehuc gurufâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec bâsirowec‐jopapemu, e jahacne â e bâjâpehuc Moleke nemu araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe iŋuc hâcne ejarepemu.
“Ŋic moc e bawe me faŋfaŋ wiac maic‐joparâ jaŋerao qohotaocmu e râsi ecnehuc ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec bâsirowepemu.
Ŋoŋe juju‐ŋeŋic bâtirihuc pectâc junʒepieŋ, no Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic hâcne.
Ŋoŋe dâŋsanaŋ‐nane bajuhuc mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ, Wofuŋ noni hâcne bâtiric‐ŋopakopac.
Irec moc e neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne sâwec‐jofaocmu e hâmozejec, e neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne sâwec‐jofawecte kiŋticnere okacne fisicnezejec.
“Ŋic moc e âgo‐ticnere ŋonâŋhec sau gie banicmuo ine ŋic mecne ŋokac mecne mâmâc qâhâmoc‐jofazo.
Ŋic moc e neŋgococ‐ticne bâsâqorehuc mamac‐ticne mimi qaqa ecneocmu, irec e mecne â neŋgococ‐ticne mâmâc qâhâmoc‐jofazo, jahe okacne fua‐jactezejec.
Me ŋic moc e joŋao‐ticne bâsâqoreocmuo ine jahe mâmâc jaha qâhâmoc‐jofazo, jahe wâwânâŋhec epicte okacne fua‐jactezejec.
Me ŋic moc e ŋokac jaŋehec foeŋgopieŋ irec sâc ŋic mochec foocmu ine jahe wiac mamakâcne epicte qâhâmoc‐jofazo, jahe okacne fisi‐jactezejec.
Me ŋic moc e ŋokac moc â neŋgoc‐ticne rocjofame wiac hehesicne eocmu, irec jaŋe mâmâc ʒoczi ʒacjopame ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko hehesiczi omaezejec.
Me ŋic moczi qowi mochec foocmu ine ŋic mecne qowi mecne mâmâc qâhâmoc‐jofazo.
Me ŋokac moczi qowi i me i moc maickerâ ehec foocmuo ine ŋokac mecne qowi mecne mâmâc qâhâmoc‐jofazo, jahe okacne fua‐jactezejec.
“Ŋic moc e seŋoc‐ticne, mamac‐ticnere otâ me neŋgoc‐ticnere otâ hâcne, ehec mamanac ehuc sasec gie bapire wiac miminehec eocmu, irec jahe gurufâc‐jekic jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec bâsirowec‐jofazo. Ŋic e seŋticne bâsâqorewecte kiŋticnere okacne fuacnezejec.
Me ŋic moc e ŋokac moc mosa huc dameŋ‐ticne maickeha bâsâqoreocmuo ine jahe mâmâc jaha ŋokac soc roro‐ticnere fuŋne bajaŋgeŋkenicmu, irec jahe gurufâc‐jekic jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec bâsirowec‐jofazo.
Go neŋgocgere qo me mamacgere seŋ mi bâsâqorec‐jofazemec. Go iŋuc etec soctofa jahecge bâsâqorec‐jofakic eocmu. Irec kiŋŋeŋicte okacne fua‐ŋareocmu.
Me ŋic moc e woki‐ticne bâsâqoreocmuo ine wawa‐ticne mimi qaqa ecneocmu, irec ŋic e â woki‐ticne jahe sâqocne‐jekicte okacne hufiŋne erâ juku hâmozepirec.
Me ŋic moc e qozi‐ticne bâsâqoreme wiac gâgâpâcne eocmu, ehuc hahac‐ticne mimi qaqa ecneocmu; irec jahe hufiŋne erâ juzepirec.
“Ŋoŋe irec hâcne dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋnane sasawa i bajuhuc mana rereŋ efârenʒepieŋ, ehame mâreŋ qikiŋne‐ŋarepe ŋec juc eniŋmu izi râsi mi eŋarezejec.
Ŋoŋe ŋic gurune gurune mai‐ŋeŋicko jâpe bâsuec ejarekopac jaŋere hata mi âtenʒepieŋ, jaŋe hâcne wiac i sasawa efârepie honec‐joparâ mamakâcnuwec.
Ŋoŋe ine dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc mupaŋke‐ŋarepo: ‘Ŋoŋe jaŋere mâreŋ susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeekac i hâcne ro rauc epie ŋoŋere biŋe ezejec.’ No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu, noni hâcne ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec rowosâec‐ŋopapo.
Ŋoŋe irec hâcne wipe qowi wâwânâŋhec â wâwânâŋ tâmiric hone râwiŋ‐jopanʒepieŋ. No wipe qowi me mâreŋko wiac babarâ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe biac bâtâc bacjopapore nâcjopahuc me ba bâuac ejarehuc wâwânâŋhec mi enʒepieŋ.
No Wofuŋ tirine jukopacte ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha nore maio tiri jaha junʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe nore biŋe erâ juniŋte ŋic gâcne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec rowosâec‐ŋopapo.
“Ŋic me ŋokac moc e bawe me faŋfaŋ wira hefârec ejareocmu e hâmocte biŋe ezejec. Ŋic iŋucne jaŋe hâcne qânâzi hehâmoc‐jopanʒepieŋ. Jaŋe kiŋjeŋicte okacne fisi‐jarezejec.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Aroŋte ŋokâfâc taha bapa juŋgopieŋ jaŋe kecʒiŋuc jazazemec: Taha bapa ŋoŋe ŋic âgofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋeraonec moczi hâmome qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne ba bâuac ehuc wâwânâŋhec mi enʒepieŋ.
Â soctofafâc‐ŋeŋic, neŋgoc mamac me naru motec me hahac ɋafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe hâmopie ine ba bâuac sâcne ejareniŋmu.
Erâ seŋ qofâc‐ŋeŋic ʒeŋoŋne ŋic tâmiriczi maŋfuŋ‐ŋeŋicko juŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâmopie wâc sâcne ba bâuac ejareniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe mamac‐ŋeŋicte soctofafâc jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhuc ŋokac moc ŋichec erao sâqorerâ wâwânâŋhec mi enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe qizec susuc‐ŋeŋic rohuc utu pârâc mi enʒepieŋ, erâ mecʒâwâ‐ŋeŋic tofane mi bâtâcnenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Anuture maio tirine juhuc ʒâŋe‐ticne mi sipirickenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe Wofuŋte taha bâzi, Anuture nânâ hâcne, i rikeeŋgopieŋte tirine erâ junʒepieŋ.
Taha bapa jaŋe sasec ŋokac me ŋokac wâwânâŋhec moc mi rocjopanʒepieŋ, erâ ŋokac ʒuhuc bâtâc ekicne wâc mi rocjopanʒepieŋ; taha bapa jaŋe Anutu nore maio ŋic tirine juŋgopieŋte iŋuc mi enʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe Anutu no taha bâzi rike‐nareeŋgopieŋte jaŋere manatec tirine juŋgopieŋ ezejec; Wofuŋ no bâtiric‐ŋopahuc tiri jukopacte jaŋere manatec tirine jaha juŋgopieŋ ezejec.
Ehame taha bapa mocte otâzi sasec gie barâ juju‐ticne sipirickehuc mamac‐ticnere ʒâŋe biŋe bawahaocmu; irec e ʒocko rikenʒepieŋ.
“Taha bapa micne wokemaŋ ruacnehuc gie ŋaqi tirine rojuocte mufiriekicne e busâqocte erâ qizec susuc‐ticne beheme mi ʒorazejec, â ŋaqi wiac‐ticne mi bâsuckezejec.
Ehuc neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne me ŋic mocte qâŋɋâŋ fokacko raʒirâ wâwânâŋhec mi ezejec.
E Anuture tiri wokemaŋ ruacnekicnere furufickonec mi wahazejec, â Anutu‐ticnere furufic i wâwânâŋ mi ecnezejec. No hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac.
E ŋokac bazo murâ ine ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ rozejec.
E hozec me ʒuhuc bâtâc ekicne me ŋokac wâwânâŋhec me sasec ŋokac, ŋokac iŋucne moc mi rozejec, aricne, e ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ moc rozejec hâcne.
E iŋuc ehuc ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec naru motecfâc‐ticne mi bawahac‐jopazejec. Wofuŋ noni hâcne e bâtirikopac.”
Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Aroŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnezemec: Ɋâricfâcge gaŋne gaŋne jufeniŋmu jaŋeraonec moczi sahac fâsâc mi juocmu e Wofuŋ taha bâzi rikecneocte mi maickezejec.
Ŋic kecʒiŋucne jaŋe hâcne mi maickenʒepieŋ: Tiŋtuŋ me ʒeke puriŋ, me ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic sâqorekicne, me tuturuŋ‐jeŋic tarakicne,
me mekike‐jeŋic herickekicne,
me râpe kumbeŋ‐jeŋichec, me ŋic bembeŋne, me ʒâŋe‐jeŋic hâpokicne, me wic piic piic â korehec, me biŋjeŋic bakicne.
Taha bapa Aroŋ ere ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec moc sahac fâsâc mi juocmu e Wofuŋ taha bâzi rikecneocte mi maickezejec. E sahac fâsâc mi jukacte iŋuc hâcne ezejec.
E taha bâzi bâtirikicne â tiri jâmbâŋ Wofuŋte biŋe qakicne i nâzo murâ sâcne nâocmu,
mâc sahac fâsâc mi juhuc tirific‐nane bawahazacte ine ââketâc me alata mi maickezejec; Wofuŋ noni hâcne bâtirikopac.”
Eme Mose e dâŋ i hâcne Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne erâ Israe ŋic sasawa jaza‐fârewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe tiri ʒâŋe‐nane bawahanʒipiŋte Israe ŋic jaŋe tiri taha nore biŋe qahuc râeeŋgopieŋ i moc mi maickeniŋte jazazemec, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac.
Erâ ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Ɋâricfâcge gaŋne gaŋne jufeniŋmu jaŋeraonec moczi Israe ŋic jaŋe tiri taha wiac Wofuŋte biŋe qahuc râeniŋmu i wâwânâŋhec juhuc maickeocmu e mai‐naneonec bâsirowezo, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac.
Aroŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec moczi wicsanaŋhec me sahac opâ‐ticne wâwânâŋheczi tiri taha moc mi nânâ mâc juhuc ɋaɋackezejec. Ŋic moc e, wiac moczi me ŋic moczi qâŋɋâŋ heuawec i ba bâuac eocmu, me wie gorewac‐ticne hoŋkeocmu
me wiac babarâ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ba bâuac ejareocmu, me ŋic moc wâwânâŋ‐ticne i me i he heuac eocmu e wâwânâŋhec jaha eocmu.
Wiac iŋucne hâcne ba bâuac eocmu ŋic e wâwânâŋhec erâ juha hae ŋafezejec, ehame tiri taha wiac moc mi nânâ qanaŋ opâ ruazejec.
Izi ʒoaŋ hume ɋaɋackezejec. Eme faicnao tiri taha wiac izi nânâ‐ticne ekacte sâcne nâzejec.
Qowi e jahac hâmoekac me qowi gâcnezi ki qâsuc ecneeŋgopieŋ i wâc wâwânâŋhec ekacte mi nâzejec, no Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.
Jaŋe qaqatara bâfuahuc kiŋhec erâ hâmonʒipiŋte mumutâc dâŋnane mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ noni hâcne bâtiric‐jopakopac.
“Ŋic furunezi nânâ bâtirikicne moc mi nâzejec. Me ŋic moczi taha bapa ŋicmanac fisicneocmu, me taha bapare kiŋaŋŋic jabane, jahe wâc nânâ bâtirikicne mi nâzepirec.
Taha bapa kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne moneŋzi furine bakicne e me ficticnao fuambiŋ jaŋe ine sâcne nâniŋmu.
Taha bapa otâ‐ticnezi ŋic furune moc baocmu e wâc iŋuc jaha taha bâtirikicne mi nâzejec.
Mâc otâ‐ticne moczi hozec me ʒuhuc bâtâc erâ naru motec tâmiric juhuc mârâc naru‐ticnao juwec irec sâc mamac‐ticnere ficko risierâ juocmu eki ine mamac‐ticnere nânâ sâcne nâocmu; ŋic furunezi ine mi nâzejec.
Me ŋic moczi fuŋne mi mana tarahuc nânâ bâtirikicne nâocmu e irec okacne râehuc ʒuhuckerâ moneŋ 5‐konec wâŋ bâfuarâ taha bapa râcnezejec.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋte tiri taha râeeŋgopieŋ i taha bapa jaŋe mi bâsifuckenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe iŋuc epie Israe ŋic jaŋe nânâ bâtirikicne i nâhuc kiŋ bahac bâfuanʒipiŋte iŋuc mi enʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ noni hâcne bâtiric‐jopakopac.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne erâ Israe ŋic sasawa ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Israe kikefuŋ me ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic jabane jueŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec moczi mumupaŋ‐ticnere manasuhuc taha râeocmu, me buafec faio taha râehuc Wofuŋ rikecneocmu
e bulimakao me lama me noniŋ ŋicne biaŋne moc râeme Wofuŋzi manacneme biaŋkezejec.
Ŋoŋe qowi repicne mi râenʒepieŋ, qowi iŋucnere Wofuŋzi mana‐ŋareme mi biaŋkeocmu.
Ŋoŋeraonec moczi mumupaŋ‐ticnere manasuhuc me buafec faio Wofuŋ wama bâzi moc rikecnezo murâ ine qowi biaŋne â bahac fâsâc moc rikecnezejec.
Qowi ʒâŋe‐jeŋic hâpokicne me tuturuŋ‐jeŋic tarakicne me wichec me sahac opâ‐jeŋic wahaekac me korehec, iŋucne Wofuŋte taha râehuc alatao mi rikenʒepieŋ.
Bulimakao me lama me kike‐jeŋic herickekicne jaŋe buafec faio taha râezo murâ râenʒepieŋ, mâc mumupaŋ‐jeŋicte manasuhuc qowi iŋucne râepie mi sâckeocmu.
Qowi moc biŋticne bâropiekicne me kijacnekicne me bâpârâckekicne me bakicne i mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko juhuc Wofuŋte taha mi râenʒepieŋ.
Erâ qowi iŋucne ŋic gurune gurune jaŋeraonec rorâ Anutu taha mi bacnenʒepieŋ. E qowi puriŋne iŋucne tahare râepie mana‐ŋareme mi biaŋkeocmu.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Bulimakao me lama me noniŋ motecne moc fuarâ neŋgocnehec juhame ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec. Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa 8 ira fuŋkerâ jufehuc taha rârâere sâc eme alatao rikepie Wofuŋzi maname biaŋkeocmu.
Bulimakao me lama neŋgocne jahe motecnehec ʒoaŋ ijaha mi qâhâmoc‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ daŋge taha moc râcnezo murâ ine Wofuŋzi maname biaŋkeocte manasuhuc râenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe taha i ʒoaŋ ijaha nâfârenʒepieŋ, tiwâne moc râepie foha hae mi furezejec. No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne. “Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc sâcmutâc dâŋnane reŋkenʒepieŋ.
No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.
Ehame tiri ʒâŋe‐nane mi bawahanʒepieŋ, aricne, Israe ŋic ŋoŋe nore manapie tiri jukopac ezejec, noni hâcne bâtiric‐ŋopakopac.
Erâ nonizia Anutu‐ŋeŋic jupemurâ Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐ŋopa wefupo. No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.”
Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Ŋoŋe Wofuŋte hombaŋ kecʒiŋuc mukicnezi tutumaŋ hombaŋ eocte musokanʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 gie banʒepieŋ, ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 izi ine hombaŋ ezejec, ehame tutumaŋ tirine enʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe ira gie moc mi banʒepieŋ, aricne, ʒoaŋ izi ŋeŋe juju eraniŋmu sâc Wofuŋte sabata hombaŋ ezejec.
Wofuŋte hombaŋ, tiri tutumaŋ hâcne kecʒiŋuc fokac i dameŋ mukicne ira musokahuc ŋenʒepieŋ:
Mosa wâŋ irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 14 owâcne Wofuŋte aakic hombaŋ maickeocmu.
Eme mosa irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 15 ira ine Wofuŋte manasuhuc poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric nânâ irec hombaŋ ŋenʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe dameŋ ira fuŋkerâ nânâ poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric nâhuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
Ʒoaŋ ira tiri tutumaŋ moc ehuc gie moc mi banʒepieŋ.
Erâ Wofuŋ alatao bâzi rikecnehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 ira ine mocwâc tiri tutumaŋ ehuc gie moc mi banʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Ŋoŋe mâreŋ ŋarepemu ira fisirâ nânâ nânâsu dameŋ maickeme nânâ gieonec fuŋkerâ rohuc taha baparao râenʒepieŋ.
Eme sabata hombaŋ ŋerâ irec faicnao Wofuŋte maio fenʒoŋkeme Wofuŋzi mana‐ŋareme biaŋkezejec.
Fenʒoŋkeocmu ʒoaŋ ira ŋoŋe lama ŋicne biaŋne moc Wofuŋ bâzi rikecnenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc taha bâzire biŋe wiac kecʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ Wofuŋ rikecnepie âsu biaŋ fuazejec: Poroŋ uucne wokemaŋhec bâsifuckekicne oto mocjahaonec teŋkonec jajahec â waiŋzi taha bâzi ine fifia râqâckonec nâfocne 4 irec sâc ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ŋoŋe nânâ poroŋ me jacgoŋ hâcbuc me sâŋsâŋ bakicne i mi nânâ mâc juhapie ʒoaŋ i hâcne maickezejec, ŋoŋe qanaŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic taha bacnenʒepieŋ. Dâŋ izi hâcne ŋic gaŋne gaŋne fuarâ ŋeŋe juju eniŋmu sâc dâŋsanaŋ‐ŋeŋic erâ forahuc juzejec.
“Ŋoŋe sabata hombaŋ tarame nânâ nânâsu dameŋko taha baparao nânâ wiac râepie fenʒoŋkeocmu, ʒoaŋ gie bapa irecnec fuŋkerâ jufekupie sabata hombaŋ 7 tarazejec.
I tarame ʒoaŋ gie bapa 50 eha gie ɋârionec padizi taha bâzi Wofuŋ râcnenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc oto mocjahaonec teŋkonec jajahec irec sâc poroŋ uucne rorâ goreŋhec bâsifuckerâ poroŋ jajahec rikepie tarame ficŋeŋickonec taha baparao bafisipie eki fenʒoŋkezejec. Poroŋ izi hâcne Wofuŋtao nânâ bâbâsu tinac ekac.
Erâ lama biaŋne 7, jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne, erâ bulimakao motecnezi ŋicne â lama ŋicne jajahec jaŋe poroŋhec tahare biŋe râec‐jopanʒepieŋ. Jaŋe hâcne Wofuŋtao qowi bâzire biŋe enʒepieŋ. Ehame taha bâzi â waiŋzi taha bâzi i ʒuhuckerâ rikepie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec.
Ehame ŋoŋe sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe noniŋ ŋicne moc, me wama bâzire biŋe lama ŋicne jajahec jara‐jekic wâŋ ekicne, iŋucne râec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Eme taha bapa eki nânâ bâbâsu poroŋ â lama mâmâc jaha Wofuŋte maio fenʒoŋkezejec. Jaŋe Wofuŋte maio bâtiric‐jopakicnezi taha bapare biŋe enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ ira hâcne ŋic ʒiŋuc jazanʒepieŋ: Ŋoŋe tiri tutumaŋ ehuc gie moc mi banʒepieŋ. Dâŋ izi hâcne ŋic gaŋne gaŋne fuarâ ŋeŋe juju eniŋmu sâc dâŋsanaŋ‐ŋeŋic erâ forahuc juzejec.
“Ŋoŋe padi wiac qa roro ehuc, gie qaŋeŋnao doma rakac i mi rofârenʒepieŋ â kisecne doma raocmu i wâc mi unucke‐fârenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe wiac i ŋic hapetac â jabane jaŋere biŋe behepie fozejec. No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu hâcne.”
Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Mosa 7 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa wâŋ ira hombaŋ moc ŋenʒepieŋ, erâ sawaŋ qaqac ehuc qeŋ qanʒepieŋ, ehuc tirificko tumaŋnenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe gie bapao gie baeŋgopieŋ irec sâc hombaŋ ira mi banʒepieŋ, ehuc Wofuŋ taha bâzi rikecnenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Mosa 7 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 10 izi kiwiric roro dameŋ ezejec. Ŋoŋe ira hâcne tirificko tumaŋnenʒepieŋ, erâ sowa juhuc Wofuŋ tiwâ bâzi rikecnenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ ira gie moc mi bajâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ, ʒoaŋ i kiwiric roro dameŋ hâcne. Taha bapa jaŋe ʒoaŋ ira hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic ere maio kiwiric‐ŋeŋic ronʒepieŋ.
Eme ŋic moc e ʒoaŋ ira sowa mi juocmu e ŋic âgofâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec bâsirowezo.
Me moc e ʒoaŋ ira gie baocmu e ŋic âgofâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec bâsirowepemu.
Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ ira gie moc mi bajâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ. Dâŋ izi hâcne ŋic gaŋne gaŋne fuarâ ŋeŋe juju eniŋmu sâc dâŋsanaŋ‐ŋeŋic erâ forahuc juzejec.
Hombaŋ izi sabata hombaŋ fârine eha sowa junʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe sabata‐ŋeŋic ʒoaŋ gie bapa 9 ira hae owâeme fuŋkerâ ŋehapie hae furerâ owâeme ŋetaranʒepieŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Mosa 7 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 15 ira fuŋkerâ Wofuŋte rehac boze hombaŋ ŋehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
Ʒoaŋ bâbâni ira tirificko tutumaŋ ehuc gie moc mi banʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne Wofuŋ tiwâ bâzi rikecnehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ 7 tarazejec. Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 8 ira ine tirificko mocwâc tumaŋnehuc Wofuŋ tiwâ bâzi rikecnenʒepieŋ wâc; i hombâŋ fârine jaha, irec gie moc mi bajâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe hombaŋ biri ʒi mucjopakicne ira hâcne Wofuŋ taha bâzi kecʒiŋuc rikecneniŋte mupie tirificko tutumaŋ fuazejec. Qowi bâzi, taha bâzi fuŋne fuŋne erâ waiŋzi taha bâzi; i dameŋ bakicnao rikenʒepieŋ.
Ŋifec ine Wofuŋte sabata hombaŋ ŋenʒepieŋ wâc, ehuc mumupaŋ taha, me buafec taha me taha wiac gâcne i Wofuŋ râcnenʒepieŋ jaha.
“Ŋoŋe gieonec nânâ wiac rofârepie tarame mosa 7 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 15 ira Wofuŋte hombaŋ sâko fuŋkerâ ŋehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ 7 tarazejec. Ʒoaŋ bâbâni izi hombaŋ fârine eha gie moc mi banʒepieŋ, â ʒoaŋ namba 8 izi wâc hombaŋ fârine jaha ezejec.
Ʒoaŋ wâŋ ira jâchândâŋ biaŋne erâ hâmu rehacne â jâc rehac sâkohec irec tieŋne â kakikic jâc irec tieŋne jaha bazurâ fenʒoŋkehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic ere maio ʒeri ehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
Ŋoŋe hombaŋ i Wofuŋte manasuhuc jara sâc ŋehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ 7 tarazejec. Ŋoŋe hombaŋ i mosa 7 ira ŋenʒepieŋ. Dâŋ izi ŋic gaŋne gaŋne fuarâ jufeniŋmu ŋoŋere dâŋsanaŋ erâ forahuc juzejec.
Israe kikefuŋ sasawa ŋoŋe dameŋ ira rehac bozeo ŋehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ 7 tarazejec.
Iŋuc epie Wofuŋ noni hâcne Israe ŋic ŋoŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐ŋopa waharâ rehac bozeo ŋec juc eniŋte muŋarepo, ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe iŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ. No Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic hâcne.”
Eme Mose e Wofuŋ hombaŋ‐ticnere dâŋ i Israe ŋic mutâcne‐jarewec.
Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic jazatec oliwa hândâŋne bâpisickekicne irec wokemaŋ ɋaɋacne lambere biŋe bafisipie ʒahuc ʒuʒuhuc jaha tamaehuc fozejec.
Tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo qorac tapa katapa ŋekac irec ââketâc râpenao ira Aroŋzi ʒure emasaŋ ezejec; eme hae owâeme Wofuŋte maio qazeme ʒahuc ŋeha hae furezejec. Dâŋ izi gaŋne gaŋne dâŋsanaŋ‐ŋeŋic erâ forahuc juzejec.
Lambe kikene golzi bakicne irec faio lambe ŋekac i ʒure emasaŋ eme Wofuŋte maio ʒuʒuhuc jaha ʒahuc ŋezejec.
“Eme go poroŋ uucne rorâ nânâ poroŋ 12 rikezemec, nânâ poroŋ mocjahare sâc ine poroŋ uucne tase moc irec teŋkonec jajahec rocjofazemec.
Ehuc tebo golzi bakicne irec faio biri jajahec râezemec, biri mocko nânâ poroŋ 6 â mocko 6 jaha, iŋuc râe razemec.
Erâ nânâ poroŋ birickerâ wiac âsu biaŋ furi sâkozi ruacnezemec. Eme poroŋ âsu biaŋhec izi Wofuŋte taha bâzi ezejec.
Eme Aroŋ e sabata hombaŋ sâc nânâ poroŋ iŋuc hâcne birickehuc juzejec. Israe ŋic jaŋe iŋuc ehuc juniŋte mutâcne‐jarekicne hâcne.
Nânâ poroŋ i wiac tirine jâmbâŋ, irec Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋere biŋe eha tirificko nânʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ taha bâzi rikecneniŋmu sâc wiac izi hâcne taha bapare biŋe erâ forahuc juzejec.”
Ehame Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋic moc juwec e neŋgoc‐ticne Israe ŋokac â mamac‐ticne ine Aigita ŋic. E juku dameŋ mocko teuŋ‐jeŋicko Israe ŋic moc ehec dâŋ mumuc epic.
Ehuc ŋic e Wofuŋte ʒâŋe musoriŋkehuc sâweckewec. Iŋuc eme Moserao jowa rambiŋ. Neŋgoc‐ticnere ʒâŋe Selomiti, e Daŋ guruonec Dibirire otâ.
Eme Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ okacne mananiŋte woŋec kâpâcwâru bapie ŋewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Ŋic sâwecdâŋ muwec e mutec teuŋkonec jowa wahanʒepieŋ, ehame sâwecdâŋ mume manambiŋ jaŋe mejeŋic qizecnao râehapie kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋe qânâzi hehâmonʒepieŋ.
Erâ Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Moc e Anutu musoriŋkeocmu e kiŋsâko hureocmu.
Moc e Wofuŋte ʒâŋe musoriŋkeocmu e qâhâmonʒepieŋ; kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋe qânâzi hehâmonʒepieŋ. Ŋic jabane mecne mâreŋ rune mecne Wofuŋte ʒâŋe musoriŋkepie qâhâmoc‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Moc e ŋic moc qâhâmome okacne qâhâmonʒepieŋ wâc.
Â moc e qowi moc qâhâmoocmu e okacne râerâ juzejec.
Me ŋic moczi âgo‐ticnere sahac sipirickeocmu e ine âgo‐ticne ecnewec sâc ijaha ecnezo.
Me kikene qazume okacne ere wâc qazuzo, ʒâŋene âke hâpome okacne ere wâc âke hâpozo, me micsiecne hezume okacne ere wâc hezuzo. E âgo‐ticne ba imac ecnewec sâc ijaha ecnezo.
Moc e qowi qâhâmoocmu e okacne râezejec â moc e ŋic moc qâhâmoocmu e wâc qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Ŋic jabane mecne mâreŋ rune mecne jaŋere sâcmutâc dâŋ i mocjaha fozejec. Noni hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic.”
Mose e Israe ŋic dâŋ iŋuc hâcne jazawec, ehame jaŋe sâwecdâŋ muwec ŋic e ecnepie teuŋkonec wahame qânâzi hehâmombiŋ. Iŋuc ehuc Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko embiŋ.
Wofuŋzi Sinai tikio Mose dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Ŋoŋe mâreŋ ŋarepemu ira fisirâ Wofuŋte manasuhuc sabata hombaŋ sâko moc ŋenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe jara 6 gie‐ŋeŋic he sarac ehuc waiŋ‐ŋeŋic bâtâcne emasaŋ enʒepieŋ, ehame fârine fuame ro nusec enʒepieŋ.
Jara namba 7 ira ine Wofuŋte manasuhuc sabata hombaŋ sâko ŋenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe jara ira hesarac gie mi bahuc waiŋ‐ŋeŋic wâc bâtâcne emasaŋ mi enʒepieŋ.
Wiac gâcne ro bâtiric epie waha ŋehuc âkeʒurâ fârine fuame mi ronʒepieŋ, me waiŋ bâtâcne emasaŋ mi ekicnao fârine fuame wâc ro nusec mi enʒepieŋ. Jara ira mâreŋzi mâc jâmbâŋ fozejec.
Mâc wiac nânâne gâcne mâreŋzi sabata hombaŋ dameŋ ira gume hesiwiŋ ecneocmu izi ine ŋaŋacne â kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ŋeŋic furi bacjopakicne â kiŋaŋ ŋic ŋokacfâc‐ŋeŋic gâcne moneŋ gie baeŋgopieŋ, erâ ŋic jabane ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jueŋgopieŋ ŋoŋere nânâ ezejec.
Erâ hae qowi â kâte qowi mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere wâc mâmâc ezejec.
“Eme ŋoŋe sabata jara hombaŋ iŋucne 7 guru 7 irec sâc wosekupie jara 49 ezejec.
Eme jara 50 irec mosa 7 â ʒoaŋ gie bapa 10 ira ine qeŋ lama ʒuŋezi bakicne i qâsokapie fânâŋ‐ticne mâreŋ sâc rafârezejec. Ine kiwiric roro dameŋ ira hâcne qeŋ qapie fânâŋ‐ticnezi mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic sâcke‐fârezejec.
Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc jara 50 i furu munʒepieŋ, ehuc hae mâreŋ sâc irec ŋic ŋokac jaŋe wama faio rambaŋ juniŋte jazanʒepieŋ. Ehuc ŋoŋe fic hae‐ŋeŋic sâc me wiacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋerao risiehuc manapie ʒeri bubiaŋ sâkohec ezejec.
Jara 50 izi hâcne ʒeri bubiaŋ dameŋ‐ŋeŋic ezejec. Ŋoŋe dameŋ ira hesarac gie me wiac bâtirikicnezi fârine fuaekac i qa roro mi enʒepieŋ, me waiŋ bâtâcne emasaŋ mi ekicnao fârine fuame wâc ro nusec mi enʒepieŋ.
Dameŋ i bubiaŋ dameŋ, irec manapie tirine ezejec. Ehame mâreŋzi gume hesiwiŋ ecneocmu izi nânâ‐ŋeŋic ezejec.
“Ŋoŋe ʒeri bubiaŋ dameŋ ira ru sâc hae mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko risie‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic âgofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋehec âbârâ gie bahuc nareŋ gareŋ sâcti qâtiric mi enʒepieŋ.
Ʒeri hombaŋ juwicnao fuŋkerâ jara wezimuc juwefumbiŋ irec sâc manasuhuc ŋic âgofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋeraonec wiac furine banʒepieŋ, erâ jara wezimuc qa roro gie baniŋmu irec manasuhuc moneŋte erâ mâreŋ mutara‐ŋarenʒepieŋ.
Jara ʒoricne fome furine bafenʒepieŋ, me bembeŋne fome furine bawahanʒepieŋ. Jara wezimuc irec maŋnao he sara nâc eniŋmu irec manasuhuc mâreŋ qikiŋne‐ŋarenʒepieŋ hâcne.
Ŋoŋe nareŋ gareŋ sâcti qâtiric mi ehuc Anutu‐ŋeŋic araŋ bacnenʒepieŋ. No hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic jukopac.
“Ŋoŋe irec hâcne dâŋsanaŋ‐nane bajuhuc mumutâc dâŋnane mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ. Iŋuc ehuc mâreŋko wama faio ŋec juc eniŋimu.
Ehame mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko nânâ mâriri sâko fuame nâ gapec ehuc wama faio juniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc muniŋmu mecne: ‘Nâŋe jara namba 7 ira he sarac â qa roro mi ehuc wemo wiac moc nâ bac enaŋmu?’
Ŋoŋe iŋuc mupie ʒiŋuc ŋazapemu: No jara namba 6 ira jambuŋ‐ŋopape mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko jara 3 irec sâc mâriri sâko fuarâ foocmu.
Irec jara 8 ira he sarac ehuc nânâ raŋɋane nânʒepieŋ, ehame jara 9 ira nânâ gie raŋɋanaonec jaha nâhuc juhapie ɋâricnezi fuazejec.
Ŋoŋe mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic i moneŋte erâ mi qikiŋne sanaŋkenʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe nohec juhuc ŋic furune â jabane sawa eŋgopieŋte mâreŋ i nore biŋe ekac hâcne.
Irec ŋoŋe mâreŋ ro rauc embiŋ i mâreŋ runezi mocwâc furine bazo mume mana uruecnenʒepieŋ.
“Âgo qomâge moczi hapetac juhuc mâreŋ‐ticne gâcne moneŋte erâ qikiŋneocmuo fisirâ âgo‐ticnezi mâreŋ qikiŋnewec i moneŋ râeme kitâcneme mocwâc bârisiecnezejec.
Me ŋic ere tuctofa moc mi juhuc mâreŋ bârisiecneocmuo, me e jahac juku moneŋ bâfuarâ mocwâc furine bazo muocmuo
ine ŋic moczi mâreŋ‐ticne furine barâ jara wezimuc bajuwec i manasuhuc moneŋ tofane sawa bârisiecnezejec, ehuc mâreŋ‐ticnao risiezejec.
Me mâreŋ i mocwâc e jahacne biŋe furine baocte moneŋ basarâ beheme ŋic furine bawec eki bajuhame ʒeri bubiaŋ jara hombaŋ sâko maickezejec. Eme hombaŋ dameŋ ira ine mâreŋ bajukac ŋic eki beheme runezi mocwâc fuarâ rauckezejec.
“Ŋic moc e hae sâko qânâsac‐ticnehec ira ficticne moc moneŋte erâ qikiŋneocmu mecne. Erâ jufehuc jara moc mi taraha fic izi mocwâc e jahacne biŋe eocte furine bazo murâ sâcne furine baocmu. E jara ŋondeŋ irec maŋnao iŋuc ezo mume manacnezo.
Me jara ŋondeŋ irec maŋnao runezi mocwâc furine bazo mi ecneme ine ŋic qanaŋ furine bawec e jahacne â ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋere biŋe erâ ŋefehuc juzejec. Ʒeri bubiaŋ jara hombaŋko ine fic i behepie runere biŋe mocwâc mi ezejec.
Hae piticko fic sac tâmiric ŋerakac izi ine giegaŋte sâc jaha ekac, irec runezi mocwâc furine bahuc ŋec juc eniŋmu, â ʒeri bubiaŋ jara hombaŋ sâko ira behepie mocwâc runere biŋe ezejec.
Lewiŋic jaŋe hae sâko‐jeŋicko fic hae‐jeŋic moneŋte erâ qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ i ʒâhec dameŋ ira me ira mocwâc furine bahuc jaŋacne biŋe eocte mupie mana‐jarezo.
Me Lewiŋic moc e hae iŋucnao ficticne moneŋte erâ qikiŋnewec i mocwâc e jahacne biŋe eocte furine mi baocmu ine ʒeri bubiaŋ jara hombaŋko behepie mocwâc runere biŋe ezejec; Lewiŋic jaŋere hae sâkoo fic hae ŋerakac i Lewiŋic Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko juraŋgopieŋ jaŋere biŋe hâcne.
Mâc giegaŋ‐jeŋic hae sâko orâŋkehuc forakac izi ine furi bapare biŋe mi ekac, i Lewiŋic jaŋere biŋe erâ fosanaŋkeocte mukicne.
“Âgo qomâ‐ŋeŋic moczi hapetac juhuc juju‐ticnere dope wiac sâcne mi bâfuaocmuo ine ŋoŋe bafickenʒepieŋ, ehame ŋic furune me jabane iŋucne ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko juzejec.
Ŋoŋe moneŋ‐ŋeŋic tofane erao fokac i bafehuc mi jâoc ronʒepieŋ, aricne, ŋoŋe Anutu‐ŋeŋic araŋ bacnehuc juhapie âgo qomâ‐ŋeŋiczi ŋoŋehec juzejec.
Ŋoŋe moneŋ me nânâ râcneniŋmu irec furi bafehuc bârisie‐ŋareocte ʒoɋac mi ecnenʒepieŋ.
No Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic, noni hâcne Kanaaŋ mâreŋ ŋarehuc Anutu‐ŋeŋic jupemurâ Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐ŋopa wefupo.
“Âgo qomâ‐ŋeŋic moczi hapetac erâ juhuc ŋoŋere kiŋaŋ qaqa erâ juzo mume mi manacnenʒepieŋ.
E ŋoŋehec ŋic jabane jaŋere sâc erâ juhuc moneŋ gie bazejec, e ŋoŋere kiŋaŋ qaqa gie iŋuc bahuc juhame ʒeri bubiaŋ jara hombaŋ sâko maickezejec.
Hombaŋ ira ine naru motecfâc‐ticne jaŋehec behec‐ŋoparâ wiacfâc‐ticne jaŋerao risiezejec, ehuc mamac ŋosafâc‐ticne jaŋere mâreŋ rauckezejec.
Jaŋe nore kiŋaŋŋicfâc, noni hâcne Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa wefupo, jaŋe moneŋte erâ kiŋaŋ qaqa mi bacjopazo.
Ŋoŋe Anutu‐ŋeŋic araŋ bacnehuc ŋic iŋucne ŋicbomboŋ ejarehuc mi bâʒâic‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe kiŋaŋ ŋic ŋokac rocjopazo murâ ine qâpuc ŋic gurune gurune rârec rârec juraŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec furi bacjopanʒepieŋ.
Me ŋic jabane â wiacfâc‐jeŋic ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jueŋgopieŋ me mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko fuambiŋ jaŋeraonec wâc furi bacjopazo murâ furi bacjopapie ŋoŋere biŋe enʒepieŋ.
Erâ juku hâmoc dameŋ‐ŋeŋic maickeme ŋic iŋucne jaŋe ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋerao râec‐jopazo murâ râec‐jopapie jaŋere kiŋaŋ qaqa erâ junʒepieŋ. Israe ŋic qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ine ŋicbomboŋ ejarehuc mi bâʒâic‐jopanʒepieŋ.
“Ŋic furune me jabane moc moneŋ mafa sâkoheczi ŋoŋehec juhame qomâ‐ŋeŋic moczi hapetac erâ ŋic jabane e jahacne me soctofa‐ticne moc ere kiŋaŋ qaqa erâ juocmuo
ine hahac ɋafâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec moczi furi‐ticne râezo murâ râeme rambaŋko juzejec.
Me wawa‐ticne me nafe‐ticne me soctofa‐ticne moczi furine bazo murâ bahuc rambaŋko râeme juzejec. Me e jahac moneŋ mafa sâkohec erâ sahac‐ticnere furi râehuc rambaŋko juzejec.
E jahacne â ŋic furi‐ticne râewec jahe kiŋaŋ gie fuŋkekicne jara irecnec fuŋkerâ wose rakupire ʒeri bubiaŋ hombaŋko tarazejec. Ehame dameŋ ŋondeŋ ira jara wezimuc foocmu, irec sâcko furi râezejec. Kiŋaŋ qaqa gie dameŋ‐ticnere manapire ine moneŋ gie bapa ŋic ere dameŋ iŋucne ezejec.
Jara‐ticne bocjaha foocmuo ine irec sâc manasuhuc furi rowec irecnec sahac‐ticnere furi rorâ râezejec.
Me jara‐ticne afecne sawa fome ʒeri bubiaŋ hombaŋ sâko maickeocmuo ine jara irec manasuhuc moneŋ afecne sawa bârisiecneme tarame rambaŋko juzejec.
E ŋic furine bawec erao jara sâc moneŋ gie bapa ŋic iŋucne juzejec, ehame bomboŋ‐ticnezi bâʒâickeocte mi manacnenʒepieŋ.
Me jaŋe furi‐ticne bahuc rambaŋko mi râeniŋmu ine ʒuhuckerâ juhame ʒeri bubiaŋ jara hombaŋ maickeme bomboŋ‐ticnezi beheme rambaŋko juzejec, e jahacne mecne â naru motecfâcne jaŋe mâmâc iŋuc ejarezejec.
Israe ŋic jaŋe nore kiŋaŋ qaqafâc, noni hâcne Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa wefupo. No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu jukopac hâcne.
“No Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic jukopacte ŋoŋe nemu â ɋâŋ qâqâtâc me qânâ wâtuŋ herâ mi âkendâŋnenʒepieŋ, erâ qânâ kita qâreŋnehec dapecneniŋte mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko wâc mi bajunʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe sabata hombaŋ‐nane ŋehuc furufic‐nane araŋ bacnenʒepieŋ. No hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac.
“Ŋoŋe dâŋnane bajuhuc sâcmutâc dâŋnane mana rereŋ eniŋmuo
ine mupe hoe i dameŋ‐ticnao heŋareocmu, ehame mâreŋzi nânâ wiac gume hesiwiŋ ecneocmu â jâc wiaczi wâc hândâŋ fârihec efâreocmu.
Eme padi jacgoŋ bâmârâŋkehuc juhapie waiŋ roro dameŋ maickezejec, â waiŋ rohuc juhapie hesarac dameŋ maickezejec; iŋuc fuame nânâ wiac‐ŋeŋic nâ gapec ehuc mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko juhâc qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Ehame noni wama bâfua‐ŋarepe ŋoŋe waha fohapie moczi moc hâhâwic mi heŋarezejec. Erâ no qowi mimicne mâreŋ‐ŋeŋickonec bârâriec‐jopahape ʒikazi mi maic‐ŋopazejec.
Eme ŋoŋe râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jopa jâpec ejarepie jaŋe ʒikare micko fenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋeraonec ŋic 5 jaŋe ŋic 100 jâpec‐jopahapie 100 jaŋe teŋ tauseŋ jâpec‐jopanʒepieŋ; ehame râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko ʒikare micko feniŋmu.
Eme no ehâmo‐ŋarehuc sâoc‐ŋopahape sawe mâririackenʒepieŋ, ehame ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo i basanaŋkepemu.
Ŋoŋe nânâ rowaŋ raŋɋanaonec nâhuc junʒepieŋ, ehame nânâ ɋâricnere dameŋ maickeme raŋɋane bârâriepie ɋâricnere ŋeŋe fuazejec.
Eme no ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋeŋe juju epemu, ehame maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi mi suŋgiŋ‐ŋopazejec.
Ehame no ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko rac warec ehuc Anutu‐ŋeŋic juhape ŋoŋe ŋicfâc‐nane erâ junʒepieŋ.
No Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic jukopac, noni hâcne Aigita ŋic jaŋere kiŋaŋ qaqa ʒuhuckerâ junʒipiŋte mâreŋ‐jeŋickonec jowac‐ŋopa wefupo; ŋoŋe rambaŋ juniŋte upe‐ŋeŋicko kioŋte babasanaŋ bazupo.
“Me ŋoŋe dâŋnane manahuc sâcmutâc dâŋ sasawa ʒi mana rereŋ mi eniŋmuo
me dâŋsanaŋ‐nane qâsuahuc mumutâc dâŋnane qaisockerâ mumutâc dâŋ sasawa mana rereŋ mi ehuc ʒâʒâfic‐nane hetâcneniŋmuo
ine wiac ʒiŋuc eŋarepemu: No mupe wiac hâhâwicnezi ututuŋ fua‐ŋareocmu, ehame hucsanaŋ â huc ʒocnehec fua‐ŋareme ʒâŋe ʒoʒora â sahac wawaha eniŋmu. Iŋuc ehuc nânâ wiac he sarac eipiehapie fârine fuame râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe nâ bac eniŋmu.
No râsi eŋarehape râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe jâpec‐ŋopanʒepieŋ, â qaisoc‐ŋopaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bomboŋ eŋarenʒepieŋ, ehame moczi moc ŋopa jâpec mi eŋareha wisenʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc fua‐ŋareme sifu dâŋnane mana rereŋ mi eniŋmuo ine sâqocne‐ŋeŋicte erâ bâtiŋ‐ŋopape arec 7 ezejec.
Ehame no pepec penaroŋ‐ŋeŋic bawahahuc sawa qânikiŋ mupe aeŋ iŋucne erâ sanaŋkerâ fozejec â mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic i aeŋ bâbâroŋ iŋucne erâ fozejec.
Iŋuc fuame ŋoŋe tâpiri‐ŋeŋic mâc qâmienʒepieŋ, erâ mâreŋ‐ŋeŋiczi nânâ wiac gume hesiwiŋ mi ezejec â gieo jâc wiac doma rakac izi hândâŋ fârihec mi ezejec.
“Ŋoŋe dâŋnane qatarahuc micnane mi reŋkeniŋmuo ine mupe wiac hâhâwicne mocwâc fua‐ŋareocmu, sâqocne‐ŋeŋicte erâ mupe wiac hâhâwicne arec 7 fua‐ŋarezejec.
Erâ no qowi mimicne ejarepe ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko fuarâ naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic kisuc qâsuc‐jopahuc bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic wâc sipiric‐jopapie ʒare‐jeŋic wahazejec; iŋuc eŋarepie hae mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fozejec.
“Bâbâtiŋ iŋuc fua‐ŋareme sifu norao risiehuc dâŋnane mi mananiŋmuo
ine noni iŋuc jaha dâŋŋeŋic mi manahuc sâqocne‐ŋeŋicte erâ bâtiŋ‐ŋopape arec 7 eocmu.
Erâ mupe ʒikazi fai‐ŋeŋicko ferâ ʒâʒâfic hetâcnembiŋ irec okacne bazu‐ŋarezejec, ehame ŋoŋe hae sâko‐ŋeŋicko tumaŋnepie mupe huc hâmoc fua‐ŋareme râsi jaŋere meo fenʒepieŋ.
Eme noni nânâ mâriri‐ŋeŋic baafeckepe ŋokac 10 jaŋe kuʒi mocjahao sawa nânâ rikerâ sigelio râehuc kâdoc qaŋarepie nârâ hesâsâc‐ŋopazejec.
“Wiac iŋuc fua‐ŋarehame sifu micnane mi reŋkehuc dâŋnane qataraniŋmuo
ine noni iŋuc jaha dâŋŋeŋic mi mamana fotariehuc sâqocne‐ŋeŋicte erâ bâtiŋ‐ŋopape arec 7 eocmu.
Ehame qowire okacne naru motecfâo‐ŋeŋic nâcjopaniŋmu.
No nemuɋâŋ fic hae‐ŋeŋic â hosâc âsu ririkere alata wiac‐ŋeŋic i hetâtierâ qâŋɋâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic nemuɋâŋ‐ŋeŋic ʒaŋkekicne irec faio behec‐jopape foniŋmu, eme honec‐ŋoparâ mamakâcnuocmu.
Ehame no hae sâkofâc‐ŋeŋic ima bacjopahuc nemufic‐ŋeŋic hetâtierâ wiac âsu biaŋ‐ŋeŋicte takicnuocmu.
Eme hae mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic imackepe râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ira ŋec juc eniŋte fisi honerâ bipic tatara ejareocmu.
No qâpuc gurune gurune jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐ŋopahuc ʒikazi ŋopa jâpec eŋarepe mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic tuhu fuaha hae sâkofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fonʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere mâreŋko juhapie mâreŋ‐ŋeŋiczi niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ foha sabata jara hombaŋ‐ticne maickeocmu, dameŋ ira hâcne mâreŋ‐ŋeŋiczi qoroc herâ fozejec.
Mâreŋ e niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ foocmu iŋuc jaha qoroc herâ forahuc juzejec hâcne. Ŋoŋe mâreŋ ira juhuc sabata jara hombaŋ mi ŋembiŋte iŋuc mi fojujec.
Ʒanʒaŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere mâreŋko juniŋmu jaŋe ejarepe maŋjeŋic gâckeme jâcrehac hâmocne mâŋâŋzi ficneme fânâŋkeme hâwic‐ŋopame wiseniŋmu, ine ŋic moczi ʒikare hâhâwicte wiseekac irec sâc wiseniŋmu hâcne, ehuc moczi moc jopa jâpec mi ejareha sifu waha jopaocmu.
Moczi moc jopa jâpec mi ejareha, ʒikazi jâpec‐nâpokac muhuc wiserâ fâfâc‐jopame waha jopaocmu. Ehame râsifâc‐ŋeŋic sanaŋke‐jareniŋte tâpiri basaniŋmu.
Ehuc râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko sipirickepie mâreŋ‐jeŋiczi ɋâcŋopaocmu.
Ehame ʒanʒaŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe jaŋacne kiŋte me mamac ŋosafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere kiŋte erâ râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere mâreŋko hâmo miziec eniŋmu.
“Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc jaŋe jaŋacne mecne â mamac ŋosafâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mecne ʒâʒâfic hetâcnerâ râsi enarehuc kiŋ bahac bâfuambiŋ i mufuaniŋmu.
Erâ dâŋnane qâsuambiŋte no iŋuc jaha dâŋjeŋic qâsuahuc râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere mâreŋko râec‐jopapo i ʒâŋitaniŋmu wâc. Jaŋe iŋuc epie maŋrâŋgeŋ‐jeŋiczi urueha okacne fua‐jareme manapie sâckeocmuo
ine noni Jakobo â Isaka erâ Abraham jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo irec manasuhuc mâreŋ‐jeŋicte wâc mi nikecnuocmu.
Jaŋe ine mâreŋ‐jeŋic beherâ rapie mâreŋzi ŋic tâmiric foha sabata hombaŋ‐ticne maickezejec. Jaŋe ine mumutâc dâŋnane qâsuahuc dâŋsanaŋ‐nane qatarambiŋte kiŋjeŋicte okacne fisi‐jareocmu.
Eme râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere mâreŋko juhapie no sifu wiac irec erâ qâmâtâc mi ejarepemu, erâ bâsuec‐jopahuc mi sipiric‐jopapemu; erâ jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ekicne i mi hetâcnepemu, no Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋic hâcne.
No jaŋere erâ mamac ŋosafâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo irec manasupemu. No Anutu‐jeŋic jupemurâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic qâpuc gurune gurune jaŋere maio Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa wefupo. No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.”
Wofuŋ e dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc erâ sâcmutâc dâŋ i hâcne Sinai tikio e jahacne â Israe ŋic jaŋere manasuhuc Mose râcnewec.
Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Ŋic moc e Wofuŋte maio mumupaŋ‐ticnere fârine e jahacne me ŋic mocte okacne moneŋ râezo murâ ine irec sâcmutâc kecʒiŋuc forakac irec sâcko râezejec:
Ŋic jara‐ticne 20‐onec 60‐o tarakac jaŋere erâ siliwa moneŋ 50 râezo, ine furufic moneŋte hawari mukicne irec sâc.
Me mumupaŋ izi ŋokac mocte manasuhuc mukicnao ine siliwa moneŋ 30 râezo.
Me ŋic ŋokac jara‐jeŋic 5‐konec 20‐o taraocmuo ine ŋicte okacne siliwa moneŋ 20 â ŋokacte okacne moneŋ 10 râezo.
Me ŋic ŋokac jara dameŋ‐jeŋic mosa wâŋkonec raku jara 5‐ko fisiocmuo ine ŋicte okacne siliwa moneŋ 5 â ŋokacte okacne moneŋ 3 râezo.
Me ŋic ŋokac jara dameŋ‐jeŋic 60 me jara 60 jâururâ feocmuo ine ŋicte okacne siliwa moneŋ 15 â ŋokacte okacne moneŋ 10 râezo.
Me ŋic e hapetac juhuc moneŋ mukicne i râezo eipieocmuo ine taha baparao jowa rapie eki ŋic fuŋne‐ticne mana tarazejec. Ehuc ŋic e moneŋ wezimuc sâcne râeocmu i mana tarahuc irec sâc râeocte mucnezejec.
“Me qowi Wofuŋ taha rikecneeŋgopieŋ qowi iŋucne moc Wofuŋte biŋe qambiŋko ine manapie tirine ezejec.
Ŋic moc e qowi iŋucne mocwâc bârârierâ âkehoc‐ticne moc rârâe i mi ezejec, e qowi biaŋnere okacne sâqocne mi râezejec â qowi sâqocnere okacne biaŋne wâc mi râezejec. Me sifu âkehoc‐ticne râezo mume ine qowi mârâc râekicne â âkehoc‐ticne ʒâhec râekicne jahe mâmâc jaha Wofuŋte biŋe ezepirec.
Me ŋic moczi qowi wâwânâŋhec Wofuŋ mi rikecneeŋgopieŋ iŋucne moc râezo murâ ine qanaŋ taha baparao barazejec.
Eme taha bapa eki, qowi biaŋne me sâqocne irec dâŋ mutarame manapie sâckezejec.
Me ŋic e qowire okacne moneŋ râezo murâ ine furine mukicne irec sâc erâ 5‐konec wâŋ ʒuhuckerâ râezejec.
“Me ŋic moc e ficticne Wofuŋte biŋe qaocmuo ine taha bapazi fic i biaŋne me sâqocne irec fuŋne hone manac ehuc furine muzejec, eme dâŋ muocmu irec manapie sâckezejec.
Me ŋic e ficticne Wofuŋte biŋe qawec i mocwâc e jahacne biŋe eocte manasurâ ine furine mukicne irec sâc erâ 5‐konec wâŋ ʒuhuckerâ râeme e jahacne biŋe ezejec.
“Ŋic moc e mamac ŋosafâc‐ticne jaŋere merâfâc mâreŋ bajukac irec dâkâne moc Wofuŋte biŋe qaocmuo ine mâreŋ ira wiac ukicne pake wezimuc râeniŋmu izi furire sâc mufuazejec, padi ukicne pake wâŋ irec furine siliwa moneŋ 50 ezejec.
Ŋic e mâreŋ‐ticne sabata jara hombaŋko Wofuŋte biŋe qaocmuo ine furine mukicne i furu jaha rozejec.
Me ŋic e mâreŋ‐ticne sabata jara hombaŋ faicnao sawa Wofuŋte biŋe qaocmuo ine irecnec fuŋkerâ wose rakupie sabata jara hombaŋ moc maickeocmu dameŋ ŋondeŋ ira jara wezimuc foocmu irec sâc manahuc furine bawahanʒepieŋ.
Me mâreŋ‐ticne Wofuŋte biŋe qaocmu i mocwâc furine bazo murâ ine mâreŋte furi mukicne irec sâc erâ 5‐konec wâŋ ʒuhuckerâ râeme e jahacne biŋe fozejec.
Me mocwâc furine bazo mi ecneocmuo me moneŋte erâ ŋic moc mutaracneocmuo ine furi bapare sâc mocwâc mi eocmu.
Aricne, mâreŋ i sabata jara hombaŋko behepie Wofuŋte biŋe tirine eha taha bapazi rauckezejec.
Me ŋic moc e merâfâc mâreŋ mâcne, mâreŋ furune moc furine bakicne i Wofuŋte biŋe qaocmuo
ine taha bapazi mâreŋ Wofuŋte biŋe qakicne dameŋ ira fuŋkerâ wose rakume sabata jara hombaŋ maickeha jara wezimuc eocmu irec sâc ʒoaŋ ijaha furine râeme Wofuŋte taha tirine ezejec.
Sabata jara hombaŋko ira ine mâreŋ i mocwâc mârâc rune ere biŋe ezejec, mamac ŋosafâc‐ticne jaŋere meonec rorâ bajuwec erao hâcne risiezejec.
Furine sasawa ine furufic moneŋte hawari fokac irec sâc efârezejec. Gera moneŋ 20 izi siliwa moneŋ wâŋ irec sâc ezejec.
“Qowi mârâc fufua i biac Wofuŋte biŋe ekacte ŋiczi Wofuŋte biŋe mocwâc mi qanʒepieŋ; bulimakao me lama, qowi iŋucne i Wofuŋte biŋe mukicne hâcne.
Me qowi iŋucnezi sahac fâsâc mi fuawecko ine runezi furine mukicne irec sâc erâ 5‐konec wâŋ ʒuhuckerâ râeme e jahacne biŋe ezejec. Me eki furine mi baocmuo ine ŋic moczi furine mukicne irec sâc sawa râeme ere ezejec.
“Ŋic moc e ŋic me qowi me hae mâreŋ wiac sipirickeocte mukicne i Wofuŋte biŋe qame ŋic moczi irecnec furine mi bazejec. Wiac sisipiricte biŋe mukicne sasawa i Wofuŋzi honeme tirine jâmbâŋ ekac.
Ehame ŋic moc sisipiricte biŋe râembiŋko moczi furine moc mi bazejec, e hâmocte biŋe ekac hâcne.
“Mâreŋkonec wiac sasawa, wiac ukicne me jâchândâŋ, irecnec hâcne teŋkonec wâŋ i Wofuŋte biŋe, eki honeme tirine ekac.
Wiac teŋkonec wâŋ râezo mukicne irec okacne ŋic moczi moneŋ râezo murâ ine furine mukicne irec sâc erâ 5‐konec wâŋ ʒuhuckerâ râezejec.
Erâ lama bulimakao â qowi sasawa soŋaŋ‐jeŋic jâuruhuc rahapie gunu‐ticnezi wose qârâwiŋ ejarehuc teŋkonec wâŋ bâtirieocmu i Wofuŋzi honeme tirine eocmu.
Ehame ŋic moczi, qowi i biaŋne me sâqocne, iŋuc mu wioc ehuc okacne mi râezejec. Me sifu râeocmuo ine qowi qanaŋ bâwosâekicne i mecne erâ okacne râekicne i mecne mâmâc jaha râec‐jofame tirine ezepirec, jahe furi bapare sâc mi ekopirec.”
Sâcmutâc dâŋ i hâcne Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic jaŋere biŋe Sinai tikio Mose râcnewec.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec waharâ juhapie jara 2 irec mosa 2 â irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 1 eha Wofuŋzi Sinai mâreŋ burocnao tutumaŋte qoruc bozeo Mose dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Ŋoŋe Israe kikefuŋ sasawa wose qâreŋ ejarenʒepieŋ, ehuc fic sâc â guru sâc mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forakac irec sâcko ŋic sasawa jaŋere ʒâŋe ronʒepieŋ.
Aroŋhec ŋohe Israe ŋic jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, ʒikao rarare sâc eŋgopieŋ jaŋere ʒare rofârezepirec.
Ehame guru sâc irecnec micne bapa ŋoherao ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ.
Ine ŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋe hâcne ŋohehec ranʒepieŋ: Rubeŋ guruonec Sedeure ŋokâ Elizuru,
Simeoŋ guruonec Zurisadaire ŋokâ Selunie,
Juda guruonec Aminadare ŋokâ Nasoŋ,
Isasare guruonec Zuarare ŋokâ Netanele,
Sebuloŋte guruonec Heloŋte ŋokâ Eliaba,
Josefere ŋokâ Eferaim guruonec Amihudure ŋokâ Elisama, â Manase guruonec Pedazure ŋokâ Gamalie,
Benjamiŋte guruonec Gideonire ŋokâ Abidaŋ,
Daŋte guruonec Amisadaire ŋokâ Ahieʒe,
Ase guruonec Okoraŋte ŋokâ Pagiele,
Gadere guruonec Reguelere ŋokâ Elisafa,
Naftali guruonec Enaŋte ŋokâ Ahira.”
Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne kikefuŋkonec rowosâec‐jopakicne, jaŋe mamac ŋosafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec micne â Israe ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere fekicnefâc.
Eme Mose â Aroŋ jahe ŋic ʒâŋe‐jeŋic mukicne jaŋe rocjopapic.
Eme jaŋe mosa 2 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 1 ira kikefuŋ sasawa hetumaŋ‐jopambiŋ. Ehuc fic sâc â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko ŋic sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac jaŋe wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ.
Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko ehuc Sinai mâreŋ burocnao ʒare‐jeŋic rofârewec hâcne.
Israe mârâc motec‐ticne Rubeŋ, ere ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc erâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, erâ ʒikao rarare sâc embiŋ,
jaŋere ʒâŋe muhuc wosec‐jopakupie Rubeŋ guru ʒare‐jeŋic 46 tauseŋ 500 fuawec.
Simeoŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc erâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, erâ ʒikao rarare sâc embiŋ
jaŋere ʒâŋe muhuc wosec‐jopakupie Simeoŋ guru ʒare‐jeŋic 59 tauseŋ 300 fuawec.
Gadere ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc erâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, erâ ʒikao rarare sâc embiŋ
jaŋere ʒâŋe muhuc wosec‐jopakupie Gadere guru ʒare‐jeŋic 45 tauseŋ 650 fuawec.
Judare ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc erâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, erâ ʒikao rarare sâc embiŋ
jaŋere ʒâŋe muhuc wosec‐jopakupie Juda guru ʒare‐jeŋic 74 tauseŋ 600 fuawec.
Isasa ere ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc erâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, erâ ʒikao rarare sâc embiŋ
jaŋere ʒâŋe muhuc wosec‐jopakupie Isasa guru ʒare‐jeŋic 54 tauseŋ 400 fuawec.
Sebuloŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc erâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, erâ ʒikao rarare sâc embiŋ
jaŋere ʒâŋe muhuc wosec‐jopakupie Sebuloŋ guru ʒare‐jeŋic 57 tauseŋ 400 fuawec.
Josefere ɋâricfâc, Eferaimte ŋicguru hâcne, jaŋe fic sâc erâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, erâ ʒikao rarare sâc embiŋ
jaŋere ʒâŋe muhuc wosec‐jopakupie Eferaim guru ʒare‐jeŋic 40 tauseŋ 400 fuawec.
Manasere ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc erâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, erâ ʒikao rarare sâc embiŋ
jaŋere ʒâŋe muhuc wosec‐jopakupie Manase guru ʒare‐jeŋic 32 tauseŋ 200 fuawec.
Benjamiŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc erâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, erâ ʒikao rarare sâc embiŋ
jaŋere ʒâŋe muhuc wosec‐jopakupie Benjamiŋ guru ʒare‐jeŋic 35 tauseŋ 400 fuawec.
Daŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc erâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, erâ ʒikao rarare sâc embiŋ
jaŋere ʒâŋe muhuc wosec‐jopakupie Daŋ guru ʒare‐jeŋic 62 tauseŋ 700 fuawec.
Asere ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc erâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, erâ ʒikao rarare sâc embiŋ
jaŋere ʒâŋe muhuc wosec‐jopakupie Ase guru ʒare‐jeŋic 41 tauseŋ 500 fuawec.
Naftalire ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc erâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, erâ ʒikao rarare sâc embiŋ
jaŋere ʒâŋe muhuc wosec‐jopakupie Naftali guru ʒare‐jeŋic 53 tauseŋ 400 fuawec.
Ŋic guru i jaŋe hâcne wose qâreŋ ejarekicne. Mose â Aroŋ erâ Israe ŋic micne 12 jaŋe wose qâreŋ gie i bambiŋ. Ŋic 12 i jaŋe ine Israe guru sâc â ficjeŋic sâc irec micne erâ jumbiŋ.
Jaŋe mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko Israe ŋic sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, erâ ʒikao rarare sâc embiŋ
jaŋere ʒare qâhâckekupie 603 tauseŋ 550 ewec.
Lewi guru jaŋe ine mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri foipieha wose qâreŋ mi ejarekicne.
Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Ŋoŋe Lewi guru jaŋe mi wosec‐jopanʒepieŋ, â Israe ŋic gâcne jaŋerao ʒuhuc‐joparâ wose qâreŋ wâc mi ejarenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe ine tiri boze â wâcwiac‐ticne sasawa irec soŋaŋ âkendâŋ‐jopanʒepieŋ. Jaŋe tiri boze â wâcwiac‐ticne sasawa reŋkenʒepieŋ, erâ kiŋaŋ‐ticne qahuc râreckerâ ficboze erâ ŋenʒepieŋ.
Izi ʒuhuckerâ raniŋte manasuhuc Lewiŋic jaŋe tiri bozere wiac qâzuckerâ reŋke ranʒepieŋ, me ŋemanahuc tiri boze mocwâc fârenʒepieŋ. Ehame ŋic omane moczi tiri bozere maŋfuŋko fisime qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Israe ŋic gâcne jaŋe ine guru‐jeŋic â maqâreŋ‐jeŋic sâc qoruc boze‐jeŋic fârenʒepieŋ.
Anuture kimbeŋzi Israe kikefuŋ jaŋere faio fezacte Lewiŋic jaŋe tiri boze râreckehuc ŋec foc enʒepieŋ. Lewiŋic jaŋe hâcne tiri boze soŋaŋkehuc irec kiŋaŋ qaqa gie banʒepieŋ.”
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko efârembiŋ hâcne.
Wofuŋzi Mose â Aroŋ kecʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Israe ŋic jaŋe guru sâc jaŋe jaŋacne maqâreŋ â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ma âkendâŋnehuc teuŋ âterâ tutumaŋ qoruc boze maickehuc râreckerâ fonʒepieŋ.
Ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec ira Juda guru jaŋe maqâreŋ‐jeŋic âkendâŋnehuc birine birine teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc enʒepieŋ. Ine Nasoŋ, Aminadare ŋokâ hâcne, eki micne bajareha iŋuc enʒepieŋ.
Momori ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere ʒare 74 tauseŋ 600.
Jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ ine Isasa guru jaŋe teuŋ âtenʒepieŋ. Ehame Netanele, Zuarare ŋokâ hâcne, eki micne‐jeŋic juzejec.
Momorifâc‐ticne jaŋere ʒare ine 54 tauseŋ 400.
Izi ine Sebuloŋ jaŋe Eliaba, Heloŋte ŋokâ hâcne, eki micne‐jeŋic juha teuŋ âtenʒepieŋ.
Ere momorifâc ine 57 tauseŋ 400.
Juda guru birine birine jaŋere qâqâhâc ʒare i 180 tauseŋ 400 ekac. Jaŋe hâcne fuŋkerâ birihec ranʒepieŋ.
“Mâreŋ juwicpec ira ine Rubeŋ guru jaŋe maqâreŋ‐jeŋic âkendâŋnehuc birine birine teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc enʒepieŋ. Ehame Sedeure ŋokâ Elizuru eki micne‐jeŋic juzejec.
Momorifâc‐ticne jaŋere ʒare ine 46 tauseŋ 500.
Jaŋerao ine Simeoŋ guru jaŋe ʒuhuckerâ teuŋ âtenʒepieŋ. Ehame Zurisadaire ŋokâ Selumie eki micne‐jeŋic juzejec.
Ere momorifâc ine 59 tauseŋ 300.
Izi ine Gade guru jaŋe Reguele ŋokâ‐ticne Elisafa eki micne bajareha ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ.
Elisafa ere momorifâc ine 45 tauseŋ 650.
Rubeŋ guru birine birine jaŋere qâqâhâc ʒare i 151 tauseŋ 450 ekac. Jaŋe Juda guru jaŋere râpefuŋko ranʒepieŋ.
“Eme jaŋere râpefuŋko Lewiŋic jaŋe guru gâcne jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋec foc eeŋgopieŋzi faharerâ tutumaŋ qoruc boze reŋkerâ ranʒepieŋ. Jaŋe teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc eeŋgopieŋ irec sâcko ru sâc maqâreŋ‐jeŋic bâjâperâ ranʒepieŋ.
“Ʒoaŋ huhunaopec ira ine Eferaim guru jaŋe Amihudure ŋokâ Elisama eki micne bajareha maqâreŋ‐jeŋic âkendâŋnehuc birine birine teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc enʒepieŋ.
Elisama momorifâc‐ticne jaŋere ʒare ine 40 tauseŋ 500.
Jaŋere ŋifecnao ine Manase guru jaŋe ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ. Ehame Pedazure ŋokâ Gamalie eki micne‐jeŋic juzejec.
Momorifâc‐ticne ine 32 tauseŋ 200.
Izi ine Benjamiŋ guru jaŋe Gideonire ŋokâ Abidaŋ eki micne bajareha ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ.
Abidaŋte momorifâc jaŋere ʒare ine 35 tauseŋ 400.
Eferaim guru birine birine jaŋere qâqâhâc ʒare i 108 tauseŋ 100 ekac. Jaŋe rapie biri jahec â moc ezejec.
“Mâreŋ faicpec ira ine Daŋ guru jaŋe Amisadaire ŋokâ Ahieʒe eki micne bajareha maqâreŋ‐jeŋic âkendâŋnehuc birine birine teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc enʒepieŋ.
Ahieʒe momorifâc‐ticne jaŋere ʒare 62 tauseŋ 700.
Jaŋere ŋifecnao ine Ase guru jaŋe ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ. Ehame Okoraŋte ŋokâ Pagiele eki micne‐jeŋic juzejec.
Momorifâc‐ticne ine 41 tauseŋ 500.
Izi ine Naftali guru jaŋe Ahirare ŋokâ Enaŋ eki micne bajareha ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ.
Enaŋte momorifâc jaŋere ʒare ine 53 tauseŋ 400.
Daŋte guru birine birine jaŋere qâqâhâc ʒare i 157 tauseŋ 600 ekac. Jaŋe hâcne birine birine rakupie tarazejec.”
Israe ŋic guru i jaŋe hâcne mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâcko wosec‐jopakicne. Teuŋ sâc birine birine ŋec foc erambiŋ jaŋere qâqâhâc ʒare i 603 tauseŋ 550.
Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâc Israe ŋic gâcne wose qâreŋ ejarehuc Lewiŋic mi wosec‐jopakicne.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâc jâmbâŋ efârembiŋ. Iŋuc ehuc maqâreŋ‐jeŋic doma rawec sâc teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc ejumbieŋ, erâ fic sâc â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâc bâjâpehuc fahare rajumbieŋ.
Wofuŋzi Sinai tikio Mose dâŋ âzâcnewec dameŋ ira Mose â Aroŋ jahere ɋâricfâc kecʒiŋuc jumbiŋ:
Aroŋ ŋokâfâc‐ticne janere ʒâŋe ine kecʒiŋuc: Mârâc motec ere ʒâŋe Nadaba, ere râpeo ine Abihu â Eleaʒa erâ Itama.
Aroŋte ŋokâfâc, taha bapa gie baniŋte mufiriec‐jopahuc wokemaŋ rua‐jarekicne jaŋere ʒâŋe iŋuc hâcne.
Nadaba â Abihu jahe ine Sinai mâreŋ burocnao Wofuŋte maio taha bâzi wâwânâŋhec rikehuc izia hâmopic. Jahe naru motec tâmiric. Irec Eleaʒa â Itama jahe mamac‐jekic Aroŋ eki hone soŋaŋ ejacteha taha bapa gie bahuc jupic.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Lewiŋic jaŋe ejaretec warepie taha bapa Aroŋ ere maŋfuŋko râec‐jopatec kiŋaŋ qacnehuc junʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo taha bapa â kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋere gie fokac i hâcne bahuc tiri bozere kiŋaŋ gie banʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe tutumaŋ qoruc bozere wâcwiac i hone soŋaŋ ehuc Israe ŋic gie mujarekicne jaŋe âkehoc‐jopahuc tiri bozere kiŋaŋ qanʒepieŋ.
Go Israe ŋic jaŋeraonec Lewiŋic hâcne Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋerao ʒuhuc‐jopatec Aroŋte biŋe efârenʒepieŋ.
Eme go Aroŋ â ŋokâfâc‐ticne jaŋe taha bapa giere âkendâŋ‐jopazemec, ehame ŋic omane moczi taha bapa gieo ʒuhuckezo mume qâhâmonʒepieŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Manakic, no Israe ŋic jaŋeraonec mârâc motec jaŋere âkehoc Lewiŋic rowosâec‐jopapo, jaŋe hâcne nore biŋe erâ junʒepieŋ.
Mârâc motec jaŋe sasawa nore biŋe. No Aigita mâreŋko ŋic â qowi mârâc fufuafâc‐jeŋic qâhâmoc‐jopa‐fârepo, dameŋ ira hâcne Israe ŋic jaŋere mârâc fufua sasawa no nahacne biŋe rowosâec‐jopapo. Jaŋe nore biŋe erâ junʒepieŋ. No Wofuŋ jukopac hâcne.”
Eme Wofuŋ e Sinai mâreŋ burocnao Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Lewire ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forakac irec sâcko wose qâreŋ ejarezemec, ehuc ŋic mosa‐jeŋic wâŋko domarâ fekac jaŋe wosec‐jopazemec.”
Eme Mose e Wofuŋzi mutâcnecnewec irec sâc wose qâreŋ ejarewec.
Lewire ŋokâfâc jaŋere ʒâŋe biri ine kecʒiŋuc: Geresoŋ, Kohati â Merari.
Geresoŋ ŋokâ jahec‐ticne garikiŋfâc‐jekichec jaŋere ʒâŋe ine kecʒiŋuc: Libini â Simei,
Kohati ŋokâfâc‐ticne garikiŋfâc‐jeŋichec jaŋere ʒâŋe ine Amaram, Izara, Heboroŋ erâ Uʒiele.
Merari ŋokâ jahec‐ticne garikiŋfâc‐jekichec jahere ʒâŋe ine Mali â Musi. Lewire ɋâricfâc mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâc iŋuc hâcne jumbiŋ.
Libini â Simei ŋicguru i jaŋe Geresoŋtaonec fua wefumbiŋ, jaŋe Geresoŋte ɋâricfâc hâcne.
Ʒare‐jeŋic ine kecʒiŋuc: Ŋic mosa‐jeŋic wâŋko domarâ fekac jaŋe wosec‐jopakupie ʒare‐jeŋic 7 tauseŋ 500 ewec.
Geresoŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe ʒoaŋ huhunaopec tiri boze râpenao teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Micne‐jeŋic ine Laele ŋokâ‐ticne Elisafa eki juwec.
Geresoŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe wiac kecʒiŋuc soŋaŋkeniŋte mujarekicne: Tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo tiri boze ŋewec i mecne erâ qoruc boze â bupu‐ticne erâ motâc‐ticnere ââketâc,
hae ʒoŋa kâcɋenere ââketâc qoruc erâ hae ʒoŋa piticne alata â tiri boze rârec‐jofahuc forakac irec motâcte ââketâc â mucticne i mecne erâ ba bâpiaŋ eere wiac mâmâc.
Amaram â Izara â Heboroŋ erâ Uʒiele ŋicguru i jaŋe Kohatiraonec fua wefumbiŋ, jaŋe Kohatire ɋâricfâc hâcne.
Ʒare‐jeŋic ine kecʒiŋuc: Ŋic mosa‐jeŋic wâŋkonec domarâ fekac jaŋe wosec‐jopakupie ʒare‐jeŋic 8 tauseŋ 600 ewec. Jaŋe hâcne furuficte kiŋaŋ gie baniŋte mujarekicne.
Kohatire ɋâricfâc i jaŋe mâreŋ juwicpec tiri boze râpenao teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Micne‐jeŋic ine Elisafaŋ eki juwec.
Jaŋe wiac kecʒiŋuc soŋaŋkeniŋte mujarekicne: Qorac tapa katapa, tebo, lambe dodoma, alata â taha bapa jaŋe taha gie bambiŋ irec wâcwiac â furufic irec ââketâc, erâ i ba bâpiaŋ eere wiac.
Ehame Aroŋ ŋokâ‐ticne Eleaʒa eki Lewiŋic jaŋere micne juhuc furuficko gie bambiŋ jaŋe soŋaŋ‐jopawec.
Mali â Musi ŋicguru i jaŋe Merariraonec fua wefumbiŋ, jaŋe Merarire ɋâricfâc hâcne.
Ʒare‐jeŋic ine kecʒiŋuc: Ŋic mosa‐jeŋic wâŋkonec domarâ fekac jaŋe wosec‐jopakupie ʒare‐jeŋic 6 tauseŋ 200 ewec.
Micne‐jeŋic ine Abihaire ŋokâ Zuriele eki juwec. Jaŋe mâreŋ faicpec tiri boze râpenao teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Jaŋe wiac kecʒiŋuc soŋaŋkeniŋte mujarekicne: Tiri bozere paraŋ â babasanaŋ‐ticne, erâ wâtuŋ â râqâc wiac ŋesiŋ‐ticne erâ wâcwiac‐ticne sasawa, erâ i ba bâpiaŋ eere wiac.
Erâ hae ʒoŋare wâtuŋ doma rawec i jaŋere ŋesiŋ â fâzâ erâ mucwiac i mâmâc soŋaŋ‐jopambiŋ.
Eme mâreŋ ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec, tiri boze maŋfuŋnao hâcne, ira Mose â Aroŋ erâ Aroŋ ŋokâfâc‐ticne jaŋe teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ. Jaŋe hâcne Israe ŋic jaŋere erâ furuficko taha gie bahuc jumbiŋ. Ehame ŋic omane moczi maŋfuŋ‐jeŋicko fisime qâhâmombiŋ.
Mose â Aroŋ jahe Wofuŋte micte Lewiŋic fic sâc mosa‐jeŋic wâŋkonec domarâ fekac jaŋe wosec‐jopapie ʒare‐jeŋic 22 tauseŋ ewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Israe ŋic jaŋere mârâc motecfâc mosa‐jeŋic wâŋkonec domarâ fekac jaŋere ʒâŋe muhuc wosec‐jopazemec.
Ehuc Israe mârâc motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere okacne Lewiŋic jaŋe Wofuŋ nore biŋe erâ juniŋte rowosâec‐jopazemec. Erâ Israe ŋic lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic mârâc fufua irec okacne Lewiŋic jaŋere bulimakao mârâc fufua nore biŋe jaha qazemec.”
Eme Mose e Wofuŋzi mutâcnecnewec irec sâc Israe ŋic mârâc motecfâc‐jeŋic wosec‐jopawec.
Eme mârâc motec sasawa ʒâŋe biri‐jeŋic forawec irec sâc mosa‐jeŋic wâŋkonec domarâ fekac jaŋe wosec‐jopakume ʒare‐jeŋic 22 tauseŋ 273 fuawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic mârâc motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere okacne Lewiŋic jaŋe Wofuŋ nore biŋe erâ juniŋte rowosâec‐jopazemec, ehuc Israe ŋic lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic jaŋere okacne Lewiŋic jaŋere lama bulimakao nore biŋe jaha qazemec.
Israe ŋic mârâc motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒarezi Lewiŋic jaŋere ʒare jâurukac, 273 irec sâc jâurukac hâcne. Irec 273 jaŋe sahac taha‐jeŋic moneŋ râenʒepieŋ.
Ehame go moctaonec siliwa moneŋ 5 â moctaonec 5 jaha, iŋuczi iŋuc rofârezemec; ine furuficte moneŋ hawari fokac irec sâc hâcne rozemec. Ehame moneŋ bâbâroŋ 20 izi siliwa moneŋ wâŋ ezejec.
Eme go sahac taha moneŋ râepie Aroŋ â ŋokâfâc‐ticne jaŋe jarezemec.”
Eme Mose e Lewiŋic jaŋere okacne ŋic gâcne wose bâtiric ejarekicne jaŋere sahac taha moneŋ rowec.
Moneŋ ʒare ine kecʒiŋuc rowec: Furuficte moneŋ hawari fowec irec sâc siliwa moneŋ 1 tauseŋ 365 rowec hâcne.
Erâ Mose e Wofuŋzi mutâcnecnewec irec sâc ehuc sahac taha moneŋ i Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jarewec.
Wofuŋ e Mose â Aroŋ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Ŋohe Lewiŋic jaŋere guruonec Kohatire ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forakac irec sâc wose qâreŋ ejarezepirec.
Jara‐jeŋic 30‐o domarâ feku 50‐o tarakac â tutumaŋte qoruc boze maŋko kiŋaŋ gie bapare sâc eŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe hâcne wose qâreŋ ejarezepirec.
Kohatire ɋâricfâc jaŋe tutumaŋte qoruc bozeo tiri gie kecʒiŋuc banʒepieŋ:
Israe ŋic jaŋe ŋec foc embiŋkonec faharerâ razo ehapie Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo ferâ qoruc ââketâc tiri bozeo domakac i batararâ izi qorac tapa katapa qofackenʒepieŋ.
Irec fainao ine noniŋ sahac râerâ qoruc keŋkeŋnezi foŋkenʒepieŋ, ehuc reŋ wiac‐ticne esorienʒepieŋ.
Poroŋ furu mukicne irec teboo ine qoruc keŋkeŋne jaha râehuc fainao tela â hosâc âsure râqâc wiac erâ waiŋzi taha bâzi irec tase wiac hepie ŋerazejec; ehame poroŋ râepie ŋeekac i mâmâc râenʒepieŋ.
Izi ine wiac sasawa qoruc bâbâroŋzi qofacke‐fârerâ fainao noniŋ sahac râepie fohame reŋ wiac esorienʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc erâ qoruc keŋkeŋne moc rorâ lambe dodoma lambe‐ticnehec erâ qoruc bâbâtâc fitac â râqâc erâ wokemaŋ kiruŋ sasawa râekicne i sâocke‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc lambe dodoma â wâcwiac‐ticne sasawa i noniŋ sahaczi foŋke‐fârerâ reŋ faio râenʒepieŋ.
Erâ alata golzi bakicne i iŋuc jaha qoruc keŋkeŋne â noniŋ sahaczi qofackerâ reŋticne esorienʒepieŋ.
Ehuc taha giere râqâc wiac sasawa furufic maŋko bajueŋgopieŋ i wâc qoruc keŋkeŋne â noniŋ sahaczi foŋkerâ reŋ faio râerâ basanaŋkenʒepieŋ.
Izi ine bâzi ririke alata irec ʒafe hezurâ qoruc bâbâroŋzi behepie qomackezejec.
Erâ irec fainao alatare wâcwiac kecʒiŋuc taha giere bajueŋgopieŋ i râenʒepieŋ: Ʒocrâqâc, sarac â sapac erâ râqâc, alatare wâcwiac sasawa i hâcne râe‐fârerâ noniŋ sahaczi qofackerâ reŋ wiac‐ticne esorie‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Eme Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe furufic â irec wâcwiac sasawa qofacke‐fârepie tarame ŋic jaŋe raniŋte ʒawiehuc Kohatire ɋâricfâc jaŋe wiac i reŋkeniŋte afeckenʒepieŋ. Erâ hâmonʒipiŋte ine wiac tirine i ba bâuac moc mi enʒepieŋ. Kohatire ɋâricfâc jaŋe tutumaŋ qoruc bozere wiac i hâcne reŋkeniŋte mujarekicne.
“Eme taha bapa Aroŋ ere ŋokâ Eleaʒa eki wiac kecʒiŋuc soŋaŋkehuc juzejec: Lambe wokemaŋ, hosâc âsu biaŋ irec wiac, taha bâzi râehuc jueŋgopieŋ erâ rurua wokemaŋ. Ehuc tiri boze â irec maŋnao wiac fofârekac erâ furufic â wâcwiac‐ticne sasawa i mâmâc soŋaŋkehuc juzejec.”
Wofuŋzi Mose â Aroŋ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Kohatire ɋâricfâc jaŋe Lewiŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhuc hâmo sipiric mi enʒepieŋ.
Irec jaŋe wiac tirine i maickerâ hâmonʒipiŋte kecʒiŋuc ejarenʒepieŋ: Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe furufic maŋko raʒirâ Kohatire ŋicfâc jaŋe ru sâc giedâŋ mujarenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe jaŋacne ine hâmonʒipiŋte wiac tirine i honeniŋte maŋnao moc mi raʒinʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Geresoŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forakac irec sâc wose qâreŋ ejarezemec.
Jara‐jeŋic 30‐o domarâ feku 50‐o tarakac, â tutumaŋ qoruc boze maŋko kiŋaŋ gie bapare sâc eŋgopieŋ, ŋic i jaŋe hâcne wose qâreŋ ejarezemec.
Eme Geresoŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe wiac kecʒiŋuc reŋkehuc kiŋaŋ gie banʒepieŋ:
Tiri bozere ââketâc qoruc â tutumaŋ qoruc boze bupunehec erâ fainao lama sahac fokac i mecne erâ tutumaŋ qoruc boze motâcte ââketâc qoruc i mâmâc.
Erâ hae ʒoŋa kâcɋenere ââketâc qoruc â hae ʒoŋa piticnezi alata â tiri boze rârec‐jofahuc forakac irec motâcte ââketâc qoruc â muc erâ wâcwiac‐ticne gâcne, jaŋe wiac iŋucne hâcne reŋkenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc wiac irec gie gâcne fokac i wâc mâmâc ebac enʒepieŋ. Ehame wiac reŋkehuc gie baniŋmu sâc i Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe mutâcne‐jarehapie bafârenʒepieŋ. Erâ wiac reŋkeniŋte mujarekicne i ʒâŋene muhuc biricke‐jarepie reŋkenʒepieŋ.
Geresoŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe tutumaŋ qoruc bozere kiŋaŋ gie iŋuc hâcne bahuc juhapie Aroŋte ŋokâ Itamazi hone soŋaŋ ejarezejec.
“Go Merarire ɋâricfâc jaŋe fic sâc â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forakac irec sâc wose qâreŋ ejarezemec wâc.
Ehuc jara‐jeŋic 30‐o domarâ feku 50‐o tarakac â tutumaŋ qoruc boze maŋko kiŋaŋ gie bapare sâc eŋgopieŋ, ŋic i jaŋe hâcne wose qâreŋ ejarezemec.
Jaŋe tutumaŋ qoruc boze irec kiŋaŋ gie bahuc wiac kecʒiŋuc reŋkerâ baranʒepieŋ: Tiri boze irec jâc wiac â babasanaŋ, erâ wâtuŋ â ŋesiŋ‐ticne.
Erâ hae ʒoŋare wâtuŋ doma rakac i jaŋere ŋesiŋ â fâzâ erâ muc â wâcwiac‐jeŋic sasawa. Ehame goki wiac reŋkeniŋmu i ʒâŋene muhuc biricke‐jaretec reŋkenʒepieŋ.
Merarire ɋâricfâc jaŋe taha bapa Aroŋ ere ŋokâ Itamazi hone soŋaŋ ejareha tutumaŋ qoruc bozere kiŋaŋ gie iŋuc hâcne bahuc junʒepieŋ.”
Mose â Aroŋ erâ kikefuŋte micne guru jaŋe Kohatire ɋâricfâc fic sâc â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâc wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ.
Ehuc ŋic jara‐jeŋic 30‐o domarâ feku 50‐o tarakac â tutumaŋ qoruc boze maŋko gie bapare sâc embiŋ jaŋe hâcne wosec‐jopambiŋ.
Fic sâc wosec‐jopakupie ʒare‐jeŋic 2 tauseŋ 750 ewec.
Mose â Aroŋ jahe Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâc Kohatire ɋâricfâc wosec‐jopapire tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo kiŋaŋ gie bambiŋ jaŋere ʒare iŋuc hâcne fuawec.
Geresoŋte ɋâricfâc jara‐jeŋic 30‐o domarâ feku 50‐o tarakac â tutumaŋ qoruc boze maŋko kiŋaŋ gie bapare sâc embiŋ, jaŋe fic sâc mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâc wosec‐jopakicne.
<range>
Fic sâc â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâc wosec‐jopakupie ʒare‐jeŋic 2 tauseŋ 630 ewec.
Mose â Aroŋ jahe Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâc Geresoŋte ɋâricfâc wosec‐jopapire tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo kiŋaŋ gie bambiŋ jaŋere ʒare iŋuc hâcne fuawec.
Merarire ɋâricfâc jara‐jeŋic 30‐o domarâ feku 50‐o tarakac â tutumaŋ qoruc boze maŋko kiŋaŋ gie bapare sâc embiŋ, jaŋe fic sâc â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâc wosec‐jopakicne.
<range>
Fic sâc â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâc wosec‐jopakupie ʒare‐jeŋic 3 tauseŋ 200 ewec.
Mose â Aroŋ jahe Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâc Merarire ɋâricfâc wosec‐jopapic jaŋere ʒare iŋuc hâcne fuawec.
Mose â Aroŋ erâ Israe ŋic jaŋere micne guru jaŋe iŋuc ehuc Lewiŋic fic sâc â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forawec irec sâc ʒâŋe biri‐jeŋic rofârembiŋ.
Ŋic jara‐jeŋic 30‐o domarâ feku 50‐o tarakac â tutumaŋ qoruc boze maŋko kiŋaŋ gie bapa â mafa rereŋkere sâc embiŋ
jaŋere ʒare ropie 8 tauseŋ 580 ewec.
Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ mutâcnecnewec i reŋkehuc ru sâc kiŋaŋ qaqa â mafa bapa gie mujarekicne. Iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâc ejarembiŋ hâcne.
Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic jazatec ŋic wicsanaŋhec me sahac opâ‐jeŋic wahaekac me qâŋɋâŋ ba bâuac ejarehuc wâwânâŋhec eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe teuŋkonec bârâriec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ŋic â ŋokac mâmâc teuŋ râpenao râec‐jopapie teuŋ‐jeŋic mi hegâpâreʒepieŋ, no teuŋ‐jeŋic ira hâcne juekopac.”
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe iŋuc ehuc ŋic wâwânâŋhec jaŋe teuŋ râpenao râec‐jopambiŋ. Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcnewec irec sâc hâcne embiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Ŋic me ŋokac moc e ŋiczi hehesic bâfuaeŋgopieŋ hehesic iŋucne moc bâfuahuc Wofuŋ râpeckerâ kiŋ bâfuaocmu
e hehesic‐ticne i mufuazejec. Ehuc wiac bâsifuckewec irec okacne i furu jaha râehuc furine 5‐konec wâŋ ʒuhuckezejec.
Wiac‐ticne sipirickewec ŋic ere soctofafâc moc mi juŋgopieŋko ine okacne i Wofuŋte biŋe qahuc taha bapa râcnezejec. Okacne i ine kiŋticne taraocte kiŋ tatara taha bâzire lama ŋicne râeocmu ira ʒuhuckerâ râezejec.
Ehame Israe ŋic jaŋe taha wiac me wiac‐jeŋic tirine gâcne taha baparao râeeŋgopieŋ i ere ezejec.
Ine hâcne, ŋic sasawa jaŋe wiac tirine taha bapa râcneeŋgopieŋ i ere biŋe jaha efârezejec.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Ŋokac moczi qâsoriehuc ŋowe‐ticne eatuckeocmu,
me ŋowe‐ticne hesoŋkecnehuc ŋic mochec sasec gie bahuc wâwânâŋhec eocmu. Eme moczi hone manac mi ecnehuc fuŋne‐ticne mi bataniŋkeocmu.
Ehame bahac bâfuawec me mi bâfuawec i ŋowe‐ticnezi mi mana tarahuc sifu manauŋkeocmuo ine taha baparao jowa razejec.
Ehuc ŋokac iŋucnere taha râezo mukicne i mâmâc barazejec. Wiac kecʒiŋuc hâcne: Oto mocjahao poroŋ uucne fokac irecnec teŋkonec wâŋ; erâ taha bâzi i mamanauŋte bâzi ekacte wokemaŋ opâne me wiac âsu biaŋhec mi ʒuhuckezejec. Taha bâzi i fuŋne babataniŋ taha bâzi hâcne.
“Eme taha bapazi ŋokac e Wofuŋte maio barazejec.
Ehuc râqâc afezi bakicne moc rorâ opâ bâtirikicne hoŋkeme hume irec fainao tiri bozere rufe fiame huzejec.
Ehuc taha bapazi ŋokac e Wofuŋte maio râeme domaha rurufa hecneme hume meticnao mamanauŋte fuŋne babataniŋte taha râezejec. Ehuc e jahac ine hâwec opâ hâtâne badomazejec.
Ehuc ŋokaczi mumupaŋ dâŋ muocte kecʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec: ‘Go ŋowegehec juhaŋ ŋic moczi gohec fome wâwânâŋhec mi emeŋko ine sâwec opâ ʒi nâtec iŋuc me iŋuc mi egarezejec.
Me ŋowegehec juhuc qâsorierâ wâwânâŋhec emeŋ me ŋic moczi bâsâqorecguwecko ine’
(taha bapazi iŋuc muhuc ŋokac e sâwecte mumupaŋ dâŋ muocte ecnehuc ʒuhuckerâ muzejec) ‘Wofuŋzi gorao sâwecte fârine bâfuame kogoc dameŋne mi maickeha ombâŋne sawa rotec ŋic ŋokac gâcne jaŋe honecgurâ hâwic‐jopazejec.
Sâwec opâ ʒizi bumaŋgao hurâ wiac iŋuc hâcne bâfua‐garezejec.’ Iŋuc âzâcneme ŋokaczi ʒiŋuc muzejec: ‘Jâmbomac jâmbâŋ, iŋuc hâcne fua‐narezejec.’
“Iŋuc mume taha bapa e sâwecdâŋ i papiao qâreŋkerâ opâ hâtâne izi ʒurezejec.
Ʒurerâ sâwec opâ hâtâne i hâcne ŋokac ecneme nârâ buʒâic fuacnezejec.
Ehame taha bapa e ŋokacte meo mamanauŋte taha bâzi râekicne i jâoc rorâ Wofuŋte maio fenʒoŋkehuc alatao râezejec.
Ehuc taha bâzi hosâc âsure biŋe qakicne irecnec me mocjahare sâc rorâ alatao rikezejec. Erâ ŋokac opâ gumezejec.
Eme opâ gumeme nârâ wâwânâŋhec ehuc ŋowe‐ticne eatuckewecko sâwec opâzi bumaŋ‐ticnao ʒâic serereŋ bâfuacnezejec. Ehame buticne siwiŋneme gâjoŋ‐ticne tackeme ŋic ŋokac gâcne jaŋe honerâ hâwic‐jopazejec.
