Me ŋokac e wâwânâŋhec mi ehuc bahac tâmiric juwecko ine wiac hâhâwicne moc mi fuacneha motec sâcne mocwâc kiweckerâ roocmu.
“Mamanauŋte sâcmutâc dâŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: Ŋokac moczi ŋowe‐ticnehec juhuc qâsorierâ wâwânâŋhec eocmu,
me ŋic moczi mamanauŋ bâfuarâ ŋonâŋ‐ticne manauŋkeocmuo ine ŋic e ŋonâŋ‐ticne Wofuŋte maio râezejec. Ehame taha bapazi sâcmutâc dâŋ fokac irec sâc ŋokac wiac ecnezejec.
Eme ŋic e kiŋ tâmiric juha ŋokaczi kiŋticnere okacne rozejec.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Ŋic me ŋokac moczi Wofuŋte biŋe juocte muocmuzi ine ŋic pectâc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere mumupaŋ dâŋ muzejec.
Ehuc waiŋ opâ me opâ momori gâcne moc mi nâzejec; e opâ ʒaʒacne waiŋzi me opâ momori gâcnezi bakicne i wâc mi nâzejec, ehuc waiŋ hândâŋne bâpisickepene opâne wahaekac i wâc iŋuc jaha mi nâzejec. Erâ waiŋ hândâŋne ɋâricne me raŋɋane kereŋkekicne i qikiŋnezejec wâc.
E pectâc juocmu dameŋ ira wiac i me i waiŋzi bakicne, me waiŋ maŋnao hândâŋne fokac me sahacne i moc mi nâhuŋgaŋkezejec.
“E pectâc juocmu dameŋ ira qizec susuc‐ticne moc mi rozejec; e tirine juha Wofuŋte erâ pectâc juju dameŋ‐ticne tarazejec. Ehuc qizec susuc‐ticne beheme fohuc ʒorazejec.
E Wofuŋte erâ pectâc juocmu dameŋ ira qâŋɋâŋ moc mi maickezejec.
Neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne me hahac seŋ ɋafâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec moczi hâmone jaŋere qâŋɋâŋ ba bâuac ehuc wâwânâŋhec mi ezejec, e Wofuŋte biŋe jukac irec.
E pectâc juocmu sâc Wofuŋtetiriŋic juocmu hâcne.
“Me ŋic ere heririŋko ŋic moczi ututuŋ hâmome qizec‐ticne furu mukicne izi wâwânâŋhec eocmuo ine ʒoaŋ namba 7‐ko mocwâc ɋaɋackeocmu dameŋ ira hâcne qizec‐ticne rozejec.
Ʒoaŋ namba 8 ira ine hapâ me buni jajahec tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko taha baparao bafisizejec.
Eme taha bapazi rocjofarâ moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare râehuc moc ine qowi bâzi tahare biŋe rikezejec: Iŋuc ehuc, ŋic e qâŋɋâŋ bâuahuc kiŋhec ewecte kiwiric‐ticne rozejec. Ehame ʒoaŋ ijaha pectâc juocte mupaŋkehuc qizec‐ticne beheme ʒorazejec.
Ehuc mârâc mumupaŋ dâŋticne mocwâc heɋârehuc Wofuŋte maio pectâc juocte mupaŋkezejec. Erâ lama ŋicne jara‐ticne wâŋ ekicne i kiŋ tatara tahare biŋe râezejec. E wâwânâŋhec ewecte mârâc pectâc juju‐ticnezi fâri tâmiric ewec.
“Ŋic e pectâc juju dameŋ‐ticne tarame ine sâcmutâc fokac irec sâcko kecʒiŋuc ezejec: E tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko ecnepie razejec.
Ehuc wiac kecʒiŋuc Wofuŋ taha bacnezejec: Qowi bâzi ririkere biŋe lama ŋicne biaŋne moc jara‐ticne wâŋ ekicne, â sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe lama ŋokacne biaŋne moc jara‐ticne wâŋ jaha, erâ lama ŋicne sokakicnezi biaŋne moc wama bâzire biŋe, wiac iŋuc râezejec.
Erâ wiac kecʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ râezejec: Poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric kâdoc moc â nânâ poroŋ uucnezi bakicne â wokemaŋ opâhec bâsifuckekicne, poroŋ wokemaŋ ruacnekicne erâ taha bâzi gâcne â waiŋzi taha bâzi,
wiac iŋuc hâcne râe‐fârezejec. Eme taha bapazi wiac i Wofuŋte maio râehuc sâqocne tâtâmire taha â qowi bâzi i mâmâc rikezejec.
Lama ŋicne sokakicne â poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric kâdoc moc i ine wama bâzire biŋe Wofuŋ rikecnezejec. Ehuc taha bâzi gâcne â waiŋzi taha bâzi i mâmâc râezejec.
Eme pectâc juju ŋic e tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko qizec susuc‐ticne furu mukicne i bâtâcnerâ wamare taha bâzi ʒakac ira beheme ʒazejec.
Eme taha bapa e lama ŋicnere ɋawe siecne moc â kâdockonec nânâ poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric moc erâ poroŋ wokemaŋ ruacnekicne i rorâ, pectâc juju ŋic e qizec‐ticne rofâreha ere meo râezejec.
Erâ taha bapa e Wofuŋte maio wiac i fenʒoŋkezejec. Wiac i â amec siecne fenʒoŋkekicne erâ ŋefacne i taha bapare biŋe tirine ekac. Gie i bapie tara‐fâreme pectâc juju ŋic e waiŋ nâzo ecneme nâzejec.
“Pectâc juju ŋiczi mumupaŋ dâŋ muekac ere sâcmutâc iŋuc hâcne fokac. E maŋticnere wiac râeocmu ira ʒuhuckerâ Wofuŋ taha bacneocmu i pectâc juju‐ticnere mumupaŋ dâŋ fokac irec sâc ezejec. Mumupaŋ‐ticnezi fârinehec eocte ine pectâc jujure sâcmutâc fokac irec sâcko wiac efârezejec.”
Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jazac: Ŋoŋe Israe kikefuŋ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc jazahuc jambuŋ‐jopahuc junʒepieŋ:
Wofuŋ e jambuŋgurâ hone maiŋ egarezejec.
Wofuŋ e ʒâŋe mainezi âke tamaecgurâ anonocguzejec.
Wofuŋ e ʒâŋe maine bâfeŋneme sâocguha wama garezejec.
Iŋuc ehuc ʒâŋe‐nane Israe kikefuŋ fai‐jeŋicko râepie no jambuŋ‐ŋopahuc jupemu.”
Mose e tiri boze bafârewec ʒoaŋ ira wokemaŋ ruacnehuc mutiriwec; erâ irec wâcwiac â alata wâcwiac‐ticnehec i mâmâc ruacnehuc mutiriwec.
Eme Israe ŋic fekicne, gurune gurune jaŋere micnefâc wose qâreŋ giere Mose â Aroŋ bafic‐jofambiŋ
jaŋe hâcne taha wiac‐jeŋic kecʒiŋuc bafisirâ Wofuŋte maio râembiŋ: Qoruczi keretac 6 qofac‐jopakicne erâ bulimakao ŋicne 12. Micne jajaheczi keretac wâŋ â jajaheczi keretac wâŋ, iŋuczi iŋuc râe‐fârembiŋ; bulimakao ine ru sâc râec‐jopambiŋ. Ehuc wiac i tiri boze motâcko râec‐jopa‐fârembiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go wiac i sasawa micne jaŋere meonec rocjopatec tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo gie baniŋmu irec biŋe efâreʒepieŋ. Erâ Lewiŋic jaŋe ru sâc gie baniŋmu irec manasuhuc jaŋere meo râec‐jopazemec.”
Eme Mose e keretac â bulimakao rocjoparâ Lewiŋic jarewec.
Ehuc keretac jajahec â bulimakao 4 i Geresoŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe gie baniŋmu irec manasuhuc jaŋere meo râec‐jopawec.
Keretac 4 â bulimakao 8 ine Merarire ɋâricfâc taha bapa Aroŋ ere ŋokâ Itamazi hone soŋaŋ ejareha gie baniŋmu irec manasuhuc jaŋere meo râec‐jopawec.
Kohatire ɋâricfâc jaŋe ine wiac tirine reŋkeniŋte mujarekicnere wiac moc mi jarewec.
Ehame ŋic micne jaŋe alata mutirikicne ʒoaŋ ira alatare taha wiac râembiŋ i alatare maŋfuŋko râembiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Micne bapa jaŋe alata mumutirire taha wiac‐jeŋic ʒoaŋ sâc buc buc râenʒepieŋ, ehuc moc e ʒoaŋ moc â moc e ʒoaŋ moc, iŋuczi iŋuc râe‐fârenʒepieŋ.”
Ʒoaŋ namba 1 ira Judare guruonec Aminada ere ŋokâ Nasoŋ eki taha râewec.
Ehuc wiac kecʒiŋuc râewec: Râqâc siliwazi bakicne moc, sigeli‐ticnere sâc 130, â oto siliwazi bakicne moc, sigeli‐ticnere sâc 70, â sigeli ine furuficte sigeli fowec irec sâc; ehame râqâcko mecne otoo mecne taha bâzire poroŋ uucne wokemaŋ opâhec bâsifuckekicnezi ŋewec.
Erâ râqâc golzi bakicne moc wiac âsu biaŋzi fusucmakicne, râqâc i sigeli‐ticnere sâc 10.
Erâ qowi bâzire biŋe bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne moc â lama ŋicne sokakicne moc erâ lama ŋicne moc jara‐ticne wâŋ ekicne.
Sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ine noniŋ ŋicne moc.
Wama bâzire biŋe ine bulimakao ŋicne jajahec â lama ŋicne sokakicne 5 erâ noniŋ ŋicne 5 jaha erâ lama ŋicne 5 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne. Aminadare ŋokâ Nasoŋ ere tahare wiac iŋuc hâcne.

Erâ qowi bâzire biŋe bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne moc â lama ŋicne sokakicne moc erâ lama ŋicne moc jara‐ticne wâŋ ekicne.
Sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ine noniŋ ŋicne moc.
Wama bâzire biŋe ine bulimakao ŋicne jajahec â lama ŋicne sokakicne 5 erâ noniŋ ŋicne 5 jaha erâ lama ŋicne 5 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne. Gideonire ŋokâ Abidaŋ ere tahare wiac iŋuc hâcne.
Ʒoaŋ namba 10 ira Daŋte gurufâc jaŋere micne Ahieʒe, Amisadaire ŋokâ hâcne, eki taha râewec.
Ehuc wiac kecʒiŋuc jaha râewec: Râqâc siliwazi bakicne moc, sigeli‐ticnere sâc 130, â oto siliwazi bakicne moc, sigeli‐ticnere sâc 70, â sigeli ine furuficte sigeli fowec irec sâc; ehame râqâcko mecne otoo mecne taha bâzire poroŋ uucne wokemaŋ opâhec bâsifuckekicnezi ŋewec.
Erâ râqâc golzi bakicne moc wiac âsu biaŋzi fusucmakicne, râqâc i sigeli‐ticnere sâc 10.
Erâ qowi bâzire biŋe bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne moc â lama ŋicne sokakicne moc erâ lama ŋicne moc jara‐ticne wâŋ ekicne.
Sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ine noniŋ ŋicne moc.
Wama bâzire biŋe ine bulimakao ŋicne jajahec â lama ŋicne sokakicne 5 erâ noniŋ ŋicne 5 jaha erâ lama ŋicne 5 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne. Amisadaire ŋokâ Ahieʒe ere tahare wiac iŋuc hâcne.
Ʒoaŋ namba 11 ira Asere gurufâc jaŋere micne Pagiele, Okoraŋte ŋokâ hâcne, eki taha râewec.
Ehuc wiac kecʒiŋuc jaha râewec: Râqâc siliwazi bakicne moc, sigeli‐ticnere sâc 130, â oto siliwazi bakicne moc, sigeli‐ticnere sâc 70, â sigeli ine furuficte sigeli fowec irec sâc; ehame râqâcko mecne otoo mecne taha bâzire poroŋ uucne wokemaŋ opâhec bâsifuckekicnezi ŋewec.
Erâ râqâc golzi bakicne moc wiac âsu biaŋzi fusucmakicne, râqâc i sigeli‐ticnere sâc 10.
Erâ qowi bâzire biŋe bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne moc â lama ŋicne sokakicne moc erâ lama ŋicne moc jara‐ticne wâŋ ekicne.
Sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ine noniŋ ŋicne moc.
Wama bâzire biŋe ine bulimakao ŋicne jajahec â lama ŋicne sokakicne 5 erâ noniŋ ŋicne 5 jaha erâ lama ŋicne 5 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne. Okoraŋte ŋokâ Pagiele ere tahare wiac iŋuc hâcne.
Ʒoaŋ namba 12 ira Naftalire gurufâc jaŋere micne Ahira, Enaŋte ŋokâ hâcne, eki taha râewec.
Ehuc wiac kecʒiŋuc jaha râewec: Râqâc siliwazi bakicne moc, sigeli‐ticnere sâc 130, â oto siliwazi bakicne moc, sigeli‐ticnere sâc 70, â sigeli ine furuficte sigeli fowec irec sâc; ehame râqâcko mecne otoo mecne taha bâzire poroŋ uucne wokemaŋ opâhec bâsifuckekicnezi ŋewec.
Erâ râqâc golzi bakicne moc wiac âsu biaŋzi fusucmakicne, râqâc i sigeli‐ticnere sâc 10.
Erâ qowi bâzire biŋe bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne moc â lama ŋicne sokakicne moc erâ lama ŋicne moc jara‐ticne wâŋ ekicne.
Sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ine noniŋ ŋicne moc.
Wama bâzire biŋe ine bulimakao ŋicne jajahec â lama ŋicne sokakicne 5 erâ noniŋ ŋicne 5 jaha erâ lama ŋicne 5 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne. Enaŋte ŋokâ Ahira ere tahare wiac iŋuc hâcne.
Israe ŋic micnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe alata mutirikicne dameŋ ira alatare taha wiac kecʒiŋuc râe‐fârembiŋ: Râqâc siliwazi bakicne 12, oto siliwazi bakicne 12, erâ râqâc golzi bakicne 12 jaha.
Râqâc siliwazi bakicne buc buc sigeli‐jeŋicte sâc 130, â oto siliwazi bakicne buc buc sigeli‐jeŋicte sâc 70. Wiac siliwazi bakicne sasawa jaŋere sigeli 2 tauseŋ 400 ewec, ine râepie furuficte sigeli fowec irec sâc bâfuawec.
Râqâc 12 golzi bakicne â wiac âzu biaŋzi fusucmakicne buc buc sigeli‐jeŋicte sâc 10, i ine furuficte sigeli fowec irec sâc râepie bâfuawec. Râqâc wiac golzi bakicne sasawa jaŋere sigeli ine 120.
Qowi bâzire biŋe ine wiac kecʒiŋuc râekicne: Bulimakao ŋicne 12, lama ŋicne sokakicne 12, lama ŋicne jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne 12 jaha erâ irec taha bâzire wiac gâcne. Sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ine noniŋ ŋicne 12 râec‐jopakicne.
Wama bâzire biŋe ine bulimakao ŋicne 24, lama ŋicne sokakicne 60 â noniŋ ŋicne 60 jaha, erâ lama ŋicne jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne 60 jaha râec‐jopakicne. Alata mutirimbiŋ irec faicnao taha wiac‐ticne iŋuc hâcne râe‐fârembiŋ.
Eme Mose e Wofuŋhec dâŋ muc manac enicte tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo raʒirâ ine qorac tapa katapa tapare faionec dâŋ moc fuame manawec. Kerubim jajahec jahere ŋondeŋkonec dâŋ fuame manawec hâcne.
Wiac tara‐fâreme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Aroŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnec: Go lambe jaŋe birio hecjopatec mai jaha ŋehuc tamaenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Aroŋ e Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâc ehuc lambezi mai jaha ŋehuc tamaeniŋte biric‐jopawec.
Lambe dodoma i gol hedapirekicnezi bakicne; fuŋnaonec feku tieŋnao tarakac wiac‐ticne i sasawa gol hedapirekicnezi bafârekicne; Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcne jâutuc ewec irec sâc lambe dodoma bawec hâcne.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec Lewiŋic rowosâec‐joparâ ʒure ɋaɋac‐jopazemec.
Wiac kecʒiŋuc hâcne ejarehuc ʒure ɋaɋac‐jopazemec: Sâqocne tâtâmire opâ rua‐jarehuc ejaretec jaŋe sahac ʒâwâ‐jeŋic resazi hefârerâ ŋaqi wiac‐jeŋic â mesahac‐jeŋic ʒure emasaŋ enʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc erâ bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne moc â taha bâzire biŋe poroŋ uucne wokemaŋ opâhec bâsifuckekicne i ronʒepieŋ. Ehame goki bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe rozemec.
Ehuc Lewiŋic tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko râec‐jopahuc Israe kikefuŋ furu jaha hetumaŋ‐jopazemec.
Iŋuc ejarehuc Wofuŋte maio râec‐jopahaŋtec Israe ŋic jaŋe mejeŋic Lewiŋic jaŋere qizecko râe‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Ehame Aroŋzi Israe ŋic jaŋere taha, Lewiŋic hâcne, Wofuŋte maio râec‐jopame Wofuŋte kiŋaŋ gie bahuc junʒepieŋ.
Eme Lewiŋic jaŋe mejeŋic bulimakao qizecko râepie kiwiricjeŋic rozore bulimakao moc i sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe â moc ine qowi bâzire biŋe Wofuŋ rikecnezemec.
Iŋuc erâ Lewiŋic jaŋe Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋere maio râec‐jopatec Wofuŋte taha fuŋmoc enʒepieŋ.
“Go iŋuc ehuc Lewiŋic Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec rowosâec‐jopatec nore biŋe erâ junʒepieŋ.
Irec faicnao ine ʒure ɋaɋac‐joparâ nore maio râec‐jopatec tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo raʒirâ kiŋaŋ gie‐jeŋic fuŋkenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe hâcne nore biŋe Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec rowosâec‐jopapo. Israe ŋic jaŋere mârâc fufua sasawa irec okacne Lewiŋic hâcne nore biŋe erâ juniŋte rowosâec‐jopapo.
Israe ŋic jaŋere mârâc fufua ŋic me qowi jaŋe nore biŋe sasawa; no Aigita mâreŋko mârâc fufua qâhâmoc‐jopa‐fârepo dameŋ ira hâcne rowosâec‐jopapo.
No Israe ŋic jaŋere mârâc motecfâc jaŋere âkehoc Lewiŋic rowosâec‐jopapo.
Ehuc Israe ŋic jaŋere taha, Lewiŋic hâcne, Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋerao râec‐jopapo. Jaŋe tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo Israe ŋic jaŋere erâ kiŋaŋ gie bahuc kiwiric‐jeŋic roniŋte iŋuc ejarepo. Jaŋe iŋuc epie Israe ŋic jaŋe furufic maickehapie wiac hâhâwicne mi fua‐jarezejec.”
Mose â Aroŋ erâ Israe kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋe Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâc Lewiŋic ejarehuc mutiric‐jopambiŋ.
Eme Lewiŋic jaŋe sâqocne tâtâmire opâ ruahuc ŋaqi‐jeŋic ʒure bâpiaŋ embiŋ. Ehame Aroŋzi Wofuŋte maio râec‐jopahuc ɋaɋackeniŋte kiwiric‐jeŋic rowec.
Eme irec faicnao Lewiŋic jaŋe Aroŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe hone soŋaŋ ejarehapie kiŋaŋ gie‐jeŋic fuŋkerâ baniŋte tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo raʒimbiŋ. Wofuŋzi Lewiŋic jaŋere dâŋ Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâc hâcne ejarembiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Lewiŋic jaŋere dâŋ ʒiŋuc fokac: Ŋic jara‐jeŋic 25‐ko domarâ fekac jaŋe hâcne tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo kiŋaŋ gie banʒepieŋ.
Jara‐jeŋic 50 bazurâ ine kiŋaŋ gie i râerâ mâc junʒepieŋ.
Mâc qomâfâc‐jeŋic tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo gie baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bafic‐jopazo murâ bafic‐jopanʒepieŋ, jaŋe jaŋac gie mocwâc ruckerâ bapa ine mi enʒepieŋ. Go Lewiŋic giedâŋ mujarehuc iŋuc jazazemec.”
Israe ŋic jaŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec waharâ juhapie jara 2 irec mosa 1 maickeme Wofuŋzi Sinai mâreŋ burocnao Mose kecʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec:
“Israe ŋic jaŋe dameŋ mukicnao aakic hombaŋ ŋenʒepieŋ.
Mosa ʒirec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 14 ira hae owâeme dameŋ mukicne ira ŋenʒepieŋ; dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋticne fokac irec sâcko hâcne ŋenʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Mosezi Israe ŋic jaŋe aakic hombaŋ ŋeniŋte jazawec.
Eme jaŋe mosa 1 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 14 ira hae owâeme Sinai mâreŋ burocnao aakic hombaŋ ŋembiŋ. Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ âzâcne mutâc ewec irec sâc efârembiŋ hâcne.
Ehame ŋic gâcne jaŋe ŋicqâŋɋâŋ ba bâuac ehuc wâwânâŋhec embiŋte ʒoaŋ ira aakic hombaŋ ŋeniŋte quŋkembiŋ. Ehuc ʒoaŋ ijaha Mose â Aroŋ jaherao fuarâ
Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Nâŋe qâŋɋâŋ bâuarâ wâwânâŋhec embeŋ. Eme irec erâ wemocte dameŋ bakicne ira Israe ŋic jaŋehec juhuc Wofuŋ taha bacnenaŋte muac‐nâpokicne?”
Iŋuc mupie Mosezi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe behehapie, no Wofuŋzi ŋoŋere dâŋ weniŋuc nazame manarâ ŋazapemu.”
Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazac: Ŋoŋeraonec me ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋeraonec moczi qâŋɋâŋ moc bâuahuc wâwânâŋhec eocmu me mâreŋ ʒoricko ra juocmu e sifu Wofuŋte manasuhuc aakic hombaŋ ŋezejec.
Jaŋe mosa 2 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 14 ira hae owâeme ŋenʒepieŋ, ehuc aakic lama i poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric â monʒaŋ hâtâne ihec nânʒepieŋ.
Ehuc tiwâne moc mi behepie foha hae furezejec, â siecne wâc mi qazunʒepieŋ. Aakic hombaŋte dâŋsanaŋ fokac irec sâc efârehuc ŋenʒepieŋ.
Me ŋic moc e wâwânâŋ tâmiric juhuc hombaŋ mi ŋeocmu me mâreŋ ʒoricko wâc mi raocmuzi sifu aakic hombaŋ mi ŋeocmu e ŋic âgofâcne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec bâsirowezo. E dameŋ mukicnao Wofuŋ taha mi bacnewecte iŋuc hâcne ecnezo, ehame kiŋticnere okacne fisicnezejec.
Me ŋic furune moczi ŋoŋehec juhuc Wofuŋte manasuhuc aakic hombaŋ ŋezo murâ ine aakic hombaŋte dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋ fokac irec sâc ŋezejec. Ŋaŋacne mecne â ŋic furune jaŋe mecne ŋoŋere dâŋsanaŋ mocjaha fozejec.”
Tiri boze bafârembiŋ ʒoaŋ ira karoraczi tiri boze, sâcmutâc dâŋte tiri boze hâcne i qofackewec, eme hae ŋafeme ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne tamaehuc domaha hae furewec.
Eme iŋuc hâcne ʒuhuckerâ fua‐jare jujec, ʒoaŋko karoraczi boze mâc qofacke jujec â ŋafeo ine ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne tamae jujec.
Ehuc karorac e qoruc bozeonec fahare feme sâc Israe ŋic jaŋe hata fuŋkerâ rajumbieŋ, me karoraczi waha boze qofackeme sâc Israe ŋic jaŋe teuŋ âterâ ŋejumbieŋ.
Jaŋe Wofuŋte micte hata rajumbieŋ â Wofuŋte micte jaha teuŋ âterâ ŋejumbieŋ, ehuc karoraczi boze qofacke jujec sâc teuŋko ŋec foc ejumbieŋ.
Ehame karoraczi tiri bozeo waharâ dameŋ ʒora qofackerâ ŋeme Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ reŋkehuc mocwâc mi rajumbieŋ.
Dameŋ gâcnao ine karoraczi tiri bozeo waharâ ʒoaŋ jahec mac sawa qofackerâ ŋeme jaŋe Wofuŋte mic reŋkehuc ijaha ŋejumbieŋ. Erâ Wofuŋte dâŋ jaha reŋkehuc mocwâc ʒuhuckerâ rajumbieŋ.
Dameŋ gâcnao ine karoraczi tiri bozeo waha ŋeha hae fure jujec. Hae fureme mocwâc fahare feme ŋic jaŋe hata‐jeŋic ʒuhuckerâ rajumbieŋ. Me ŋafe ʒoaŋ moc ʒuhuckerâ ŋeku fahareme ŋic jaŋe ʒuhuckerâ rajumbieŋ wâc.
Me karorac e ʒoaŋ gie bapa jajahec, me mosa moc, me mosa moc jâuruhuc dameŋ ʒoʒoricne ŋeme ŋic jaŋe iŋuc jaha ʒuhuckerâ mi rahuc ŋejumbieŋ. Izi ine mocwâc fahare feme ʒuhuckerâ rajumbieŋ.
Ine hâcne, jaŋe Wofuŋte micte teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc ejumbieŋ, erâ wâc Wofuŋte micte jaha hata rajumbieŋ. Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ âzâcne mutâc ewec i reŋkehuc iŋuc efârembiŋ hâcne.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go qeŋ jajahec siliwa hedapirekicnezi bazemec. Eme qeŋ i hâcne qapie dâŋeha kikefuŋ jaŋe manahuc tumaŋnenʒepieŋ me teuŋ beherâ hata ranʒepieŋ.
Me mâmâc jaha qapie dâŋehapire kikefuŋ jaŋe manarâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko gorao fisinʒepieŋ.
Me qeŋ mocjaha sawa qapie dâŋeme ine Israe ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere micnefâc jaŋe sawa gorao tumaŋnenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe qeŋ bâsokahuc qapie ine ŋic ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe fuŋkerâ hatackenʒepieŋ.
Eme qeŋ bâsokahuc qapie arec jajahec eme ine juwic mâreŋkopec ŋec foc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hatackenʒepieŋ.
Kikefuŋ hetumaŋ‐jopaniŋte qeŋ bâsokahuc mâcne, bâpitiwahuc qanʒepieŋ.
Qeŋte dâŋ mukopac izi ŋoŋerao mimiŋzi ɋâric dâŋsanaŋ erâ forahuc juzejec.
Râsifâc‐ŋeŋic fific bacŋopaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe jopaniŋte ʒikao rahuc qeŋ bâsokahuc qapie Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ŋoŋere manasuhuc râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere meonec batarac‐ŋopazejec.
Ʒeri hombaŋ‐ŋeŋicko me hombaŋ muŋarekicnao, me mosa fufuŋkenao ira qowi bâzi me wama bâzi rikehuc qeŋ qanʒepieŋ wâc; qeŋ jahe ŋoŋere erâ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio dâŋepire Anutuzi manasuc‐ŋopazejec. Noni hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic jukopac.”
Jara 2 irec mosa 2‐re ʒoaŋ gie bapa 20 ira karoraczi sâcmutâc dâŋte tiri bozeonec fahare fewec.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe biri‐jeŋic sâc Sinai mâreŋ burocnaonec fahare rahapie karoraczi Paraŋ mâreŋ burocnaonec waha herâ ŋewec.
Jaŋe Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ âzâcne mutâc ewec i bâjâpehuc hata fuŋkerâ rambiŋ hâcne.
Judare gurufâc jaŋe maqâreŋ‐jeŋiczi bânie‐jareha birine birine fuŋkerâ rambiŋ, i Aminadare ŋokâ Nasoŋ eki micne bajareha iŋuc embiŋ.
Isasare gurufâc jaŋere micne i Zuarare ŋokâ Netanelezi juwec.
Â Sebuloŋte gurufâc jaŋere micne ine Heloŋte ŋokâ Eliabazi juwec.
Tiri boze batac qatara‐fârerâ qâzuckepie Geresoŋ â Merari jahere ɋâricfâc jaŋe tiri boze reŋkerâ jujumbieŋ jaŋe hâcne hata fuŋkembiŋ.
Erâ Rubeŋte gurufâc jaŋe maqâreŋ‐jeŋiczi bânie‐jareha birine birine rambiŋ, i Elizuru, Sedeure ŋokâ hâcne, eki micne bajareha iŋuc embiŋ.
Simeoŋte gurufâc jaŋere micne Zurisadaire ŋokâ Selumiezi juwec.
Â Gadere gurufâc jaŋere micne ine Reguelere ŋokâ Elisafazi juwec.
Eme jaŋere râpeo Kohatire ɋâricfâc jaŋe wiac tirine reŋkerâ rambiŋ. Rahapie bânierâ rambiŋ jaŋe tiri boze mocwâc bambiŋ.
Izi ine Eferaimte gurufâc jaŋe maqâreŋ‐jeŋiczi bânie‐jareha birine birine rambiŋ, i Elisama, Amihudure ŋokâ hâcne, eki micne bajareha iŋuc embiŋ.
Manasere gurufâc jaŋere micne Pedazure ŋokâ Gamaliezi juwec.
Â Benjamiŋte gurufâc jaŋere micne ine Gideonire ŋokâ Abidaŋzi juwec.
Eme ʒâhec jâmbâŋ Daŋte gurufâc jaŋe maqâreŋ‐jeŋiczi bânie‐jareha birine birine rakupie tarawec. Jaŋe Ahieʒe, Amisadaire ŋokâ hâcne, eki micne bajareha iŋuc embiŋ.
Asere gurufâc jaŋere micne i Okoraŋte ŋokâ Pagielezi juwec.
Â Naftalire gurufâc jaŋere micne ine Enaŋte ŋokâ Ahirazi juwec.
Israe ŋic guru sâc jaŋe faharerâ birine birine bâbâjâpec iŋuc hâcne rambiŋ.
Eme Mose e kimo‐ticne Reguele, Midiaŋ ŋic hâcne, ere ŋokâ Hobabi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Nâŋe Wofuŋzi ‘mâreŋ i ŋoŋere biŋe qakopac’ iŋuc muhuc mâreŋ nârewec ira razo eŋgopeneŋ. Wofuŋ e Israe ŋic nâŋe ehâmo‐nâreocte mupaŋkewecte go nâŋehec ratecne nâŋe wâc ehâmo‐garenaŋmu.”
Eki ine dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “No ŋoŋehec mi rahuc no nahacne mâreŋko â wiacfâc‐nane jaŋerao risiepemu.”
Iŋuc mume Mosezi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go mi behec‐nâpocmurâ numu‐garekopac. Goki hâcne mâreŋ burocnao ju fofo eere fuŋne manakicte jowac‐nâpozemec.
Go nâŋehec racmuo ine Wofuŋzi nâŋe ehâmo‐nâreocmu sâc ijaha nâŋe go egarenaŋmu.”
Eme jaŋe Wofuŋte tiki beherâ rahuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc tarawec. Ehame Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapazi ʒoaŋ jahec â moc jaha bânie‐jarehuc ŋec foc eniŋte hae mâreŋ hone tâcnewec.
Jaŋe teuŋ‐jeŋic behembiŋ sâc Wofuŋte karoraci ʒoaŋko bânie‐jarehuc juwec.
Eme katapa e hata rawec sâc Mosezi ʒiŋuc muhuc numuwec: “O Wofuŋ, go faharerâ râsifâcge batâtiec‐jopac, ehame qaisocgueŋgopieŋ jaŋe gore maionec wisenʒepieŋ.”
Me katapa e niniŋkerâ ŋewec sâc Mosezi ʒiŋuc muhuc numuwec: “O Wofuŋ, go Israe ŋic tauseŋ gurune gurune jaŋehec juzemec.”
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe nânâ opâre hâmo sipiric ehuc Wofuŋ mu kâroŋ ecnepie manawec. Manarâ aarickeme mume ʒoc fuarâ teuŋ qaŋeŋne ʒahuc wâcwiac‐jeŋic gâcne ʒafârewec.
Iŋuc fuame ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Wofuŋ kio wâwâsic ecnepie Mosezi Wofuŋ numucneme mume ʒoczi hâpowec.
Wofuŋzi mume ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ʒoc fuarâ ʒawecte hae mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe Tabera mumbiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋic repicne gâcne jumbiŋ jaŋe nânâ wiac biaŋnere andac ehapie Israe ŋic jaŋe wâc kiohuc kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Qowi moc fua‐nâreme nanʒapeŋ me!
Nâŋe Aigita mâreŋko opâ qowi me qahac me bomboŋ herimuŋ me raki wiac fuŋne fuŋne furi tâmiric nâjumbeneŋ irec manasuhuc juŋgopeneŋ.
Ʒi ine nânâre hâmohuc tâpiri‐nâŋec omaeme mana sawa honeŋgopeneŋ.”
Mana ine hândâŋ piic piic, padi tinac fuarâ ŋerawec.
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe nuserâ toŋtoŋko âkenʒaŋnerâ kuʒio rikepie dockeme poroŋ bajumbieŋ; erâ nâpie aŋac‐ticne poroŋ uucne wokemaŋ opâhec rikekicne iŋucne tinac ewec.
Mana i ŋafeo teuŋko titikuc wahame mâmâc waha jujec.
Eme ŋic jaŋe guru sâc qoruc boze‐jeŋicko domahuc kiohapie Mosezi manawec. Ehame Wofuŋzi aaricke sâqoreme Mosezi mana gâpârewec.
Ehuc Wofuŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go kiŋaŋ qaqage no weniŋucte wiac ʒâʒâicne iŋucne enaremeŋ? No wemo wiac sâqocne moc egarepo irec ŋic ʒi jaŋere ŋemâc i nore faio râekomec?
Noni neŋgoc‐jeŋic jukopac me? Me noni bâfuac‐joparâ mâreŋko râec‐jopapo irec go ʒiŋuc nazakomec: ‘Go ŋokac moczi kogoc‐ticne hâpo heâroŋ ecneekac irec sâc ŋic ʒi jaŋe ejarehuc mamacfâc‐jeŋic mâreŋ biŋe qajarepo ira jowac‐jopa razemec?’
No qowi wenirec bâfuarâ ŋic gumec‐jopape sâcjopa‐fâreocmu? Jaŋe nore maio kiohuc ʒiŋuc hâcne mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Go qowi moc bâfua‐nâretec nânʒepeneŋ.’
Ŋic ʒi jaŋere ŋemâc i nore sâc sirickekac, no bucnane sâcne mi âsickepemu.
No iŋuc epemurâ manasukicko ine ʒiŋuczia qâhâmocnuzemec, me nore manatec sâckeme ine wiac ŋemâcne ʒi bârârietec omaezejec.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Israe ŋic soŋaŋ micnefâc‐jeŋic weni jaŋe jupie manac‐jopaekic guru i jaŋeraonec ŋic 70 rowosâec‐joparâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko biric‐jopatec gohec mâmâc domanʒepieŋ.
Ehame no hufâpe gohec dâŋ muc manac enacmu, ehuc go maŋɋârâŋhec jukic maŋɋârâŋ iŋucnea jaŋe wâc tahac‐jopape ŋic jaŋere ŋemâc i go buc mâcne, jaŋe gohec mâmâc âsickenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazac: ‘Ŋoŋe tomâckore ʒawiehuc juhapie hae fureme qowi fua‐ŋareme nânʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc kio wâwâsic ecnembiŋ irec: “Nâŋe Aigita mâreŋko sâcne mac jumbeŋ, ʒi ine mozi qowi nâreme nanaŋmu?” Iŋuc mumbiŋte Wofuŋzi qowi ŋareme nânʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe qowi nâniŋmu i ʒoaŋ gie bapa 1 me 2 me 5 me 10 me 20 ira sawa mâcne,
nâhuc juhapie mosa moc tarame qowire takic‐ŋopame mamakâc‐ŋopaocmu. Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jukac e hâcne râpeckerâ ʒiŋuc muhuc kio wâwâsic ecnembiŋte iŋuc fua‐ŋareocmu: “Nâŋe wemocte Aigita mâreŋ beherâ warembeŋ?” ’”
Mosezi ine ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋic nohec hata wareŋgopieŋ jaŋere ʒare i 600 tauseŋ, eme go sifu mukomec: ‘No qowi bâfua‐jarepe nâhuc juhapie mosa moc tarazejec.’
Jaŋere erâ lama bulimakaofâc‐nâŋec qa hezuc epene sâcjopaocmu me? Me hâwec qowi rocjopa‐fârerâ gumec‐jopapene sâcjopaocmu me?”
Mose e iŋuc mume Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Wofuŋ nore tâpirire manatec wawahane ekac me? Dâŋnane burec me jâmbomac irec fârine miŋecgac jaha taniŋkeme honezemec.”
Eme Mose e ŋic ŋokac jaŋerao rarâ Wofuŋte dâŋ jazawec, ehuc soŋaŋ micne jaŋeraonec ŋic 70 rocjoparâ qoruc boze râreckehuc râec‐jopa rawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi karorac maŋko waharâ Mose dâŋ âzâcnewec. Ehuc Mosezi maŋɋârâŋhec juwec irec sâc jaha ŋic 70 jaŋe maŋɋârâŋ tahac‐jopame findaŋdâŋ mumbiŋ. Mâc ʒâhec ine findaŋdâŋ mocwâc mi mumbiŋ.
Ŋic jajahec ʒâŋe‐jekic Elida â Meda, jahe ŋic gâcne rowosâec‐jopakicne jaŋere guruonec jaha, erâ sifu teuŋko ʒuhuckerâ ŋehuc maŋɋârâŋhec erâ findaŋdâŋ mupic.
Eme ŋicmotec moczi manarâ gasacke rarâ Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Elida â Meda jahe teuŋkoa ŋehuc findaŋdâŋ mukopirec.”
Iŋuc mume Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua, e fuŋnaonecteaŋ Mosere mefâro juweczi ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “O bomboŋ‐nane Mose, go qatara‐jactec.”
Mosezi ine dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go wemocte nore mana mezac erâ ʒoɋac ekomec? Manakic, Wofuŋte ŋic sasawa jaŋe porofete erâ juhapie Wofuŋzi maŋɋârâŋ tahac‐jopame muzac biaŋkezac.”
Mose e iŋuc mutararâ e jahacne â Israe soŋaŋ micne jaŋe teuŋko risiembiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi mume hâweckonec mâŋâŋ ʒocnehec qahuc koneŋ wipe qâŋhec ficne suec‐jopame wefurâ teuŋko ŋifec â ŋifec herâ ŋerambiŋ. Eme ŋiczi ʒoaŋ mocjahao hata raniŋmu irec sâc teuŋ râreckehuc herâ ŋerambiŋ hâcne. Ehuc mâreŋ sâockerâ gurune gurune qâŋhec ŋembiŋ.
Eme ŋic jaŋe faharerâ ŋafe ʒoaŋ ro nusec ejarehuc juhapie hae fureme ʒuhuckerâ rohuc juhapie hae ŋafewec. Aafecne rombiŋ jaŋe sifu pake 10 bâfusembiŋ. Ehuc kereŋkeocte teuŋ rârec rârec qandaŋkembiŋ.
Eme qowi nâhuc nâhuc juhapie Wofuŋte kimbeŋzi bâruŋkeme wiac hâhâwicne fua‐jareme hâmo sipiric embiŋ.
Eme hae mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe Kibero‐Hatawa mukicne irec fuŋne kecʒiŋuc: Ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ira qowire andac epie okacne fisi‐jareme hâmo duduc embiŋ.
Erâ Kibero‐Hatawa mâreŋ beherâ raku Hazeroti hae mâreŋko fisirâ ira ŋec foc embiŋ.
Mose e Kusi ŋokac moc rome ŋonâŋ‐ticne ewecte Miriam â Aroŋ jahe mana sâqorecnepic.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc mupic: “Wofuŋ e jâmbomac dâŋticne Mosere micko sawa me gâcne nâŋere micko mâmâc râewec me?” Iŋuc muhapire Wofuŋzi manawec.
Mose e mâreŋte faio ŋic jumbiŋ jaŋe jowaruhuc maŋhuhuŋ jâmbâŋ juwec.
Eme jahe dâŋ mupic i Wofuŋzi manarâ izia Mose â Aroŋ â Miriam ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋic ŋokac jahec â moc ŋoŋe tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo wefuniŋ.” Iŋuc mume jaŋe fembiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ e karorac maŋko waharâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko domahuc Aroŋ â Miriam wira‐jacteme mamai rapic.
Eme e ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ŋohe dâŋnane mananic: Ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko porofete moc juocmu ine Wofuŋ no maŋɋârâŋ‐ticne bâtâcnehuc fuŋne‐nane âzâcne jâutuc epemu, ehuc guŋqâhâŋ ecnerâ dâŋnane âzâcnepemu.
Kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Mose e wiac iŋucne moc mi ecneekopac, e kikefuŋfâc‐nane sasawa soŋaŋ‐jopaocte mucnekicne.
No e guŋko mâcne, tâtâc mai fuacnehuc dâŋ âzâcnepe Wofuŋ qâreŋ‐nane honeekac. Ehame ŋohe wemocte mi hâwic‐ŋofaha kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Mose mana sâqorecnekopirec?”
Eme Wofuŋ e kimbeŋ‐ticne bâruŋke‐jacteha behec‐jofarâ rawec.
Ehame karoraczi qoruc boze beherâ feme Miriam e mi wicsanaŋ fuacneme qaŋ kisieckerâ domazejec i! Eme Aroŋzi Miriamtao forisierâ honeme wicsanaŋhec domawec.
Iŋuc honerâ Mose ʒiŋuc muhuc wâsickewec: “O bomboŋ‐nane, nâhe mutuc erâ bahac bâfuaperec irec okacne mi mac nâctezemec.
Go manatec kogoc moc neŋgoc bumaŋkonec ombâŋtâc fuaekac irec sâc mi ezejec.”
Iŋuc mume Mosezi Wofuŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc wiracnewec: “O Anutu, go bâpiaŋkecmurâ numu‐garekopac.”
Wofuŋzi ine dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Mamac‐ticnezi ʒâŋe mainao tâfeckeme muzac ine mimiehuc juhame ʒoaŋ 7 tarazac. Irec teuŋ râpenao râepie hurâ juhame ʒoaŋ 7 tarazejec, tarame ine mocwâc ecnepie wefuzejec.”
Iŋuc mume jaŋe Miriam teuŋ râpenao râepie hurâ juhame ʒoaŋ 7 tarawec hâcne. Ehame ŋic ŋokac jaŋe hata ʒuhuckerâ mi rambiŋ.
Miriamzi teuŋko risie wefuwec irec faicnao ine Hazeroti hae mâreŋ beherâ raku Paraŋ mâreŋ burocnao fisirâ ŋec juc embiŋ.
Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Israe ŋic Kanaaŋ mâreŋ jarepemu i hone tâcneniŋte ŋic 12 sorec‐jopazemec. Mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere guruonec ŋic micne wâŋ wâŋ bâwosâec‐joparâ sorec‐jopate ranʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Mose e Wofuŋzi mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko Israe ŋic micne rowosâec‐joparâ Paraŋ mâreŋ burocnao sorec‐jopame rambiŋ.
Ʒâŋe‐jeŋic ine kecʒiŋuc: Rubeŋte guruonec Ʒakurure ŋokâ Samua.
Simeoŋte guruonec Horire ŋokâ Safati.
Judare guruonec Jefunere ŋokâ Kalebe.
Isasare guruonec Josefere ŋokâ Igali.
Eferaimte guruonec Nuŋte ŋokâ Hosea.
Benjamiŋte guruonec Rafure ŋokâ Palati.
Sebuloŋte guruonec Sodire ŋokâ Gadiele.
Josefere guruonec (Manase guru hâcne) Susire ŋokâ Gadi.
Daŋte guruonec Gemaliere ŋokâ Amiele.
Asere guruonec Mikaere ŋokâ Seturu.
Naftalire guruonec Wofisire ŋokâ Nabi.
Gadere guruonec Makire ŋokâ Geuele.
Mosezi ŋic mâreŋ hone tâcneniŋte sorec‐jopawec jaŋere ʒâŋe ine hâcne. Ehuc Mose e Hoseare ŋokâ Nuŋ ere ʒâŋe Josua muwec.
Eme Mose e ŋic i jaŋe Kanaaŋ mâreŋ hone tâcneniŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc jazahuc sorec‐jopawec: “Ŋoŋe Negebe mâreŋ râpenao tiki mâreŋ fokac ira feranʒepieŋ.
Ehuc mâreŋ irec fuŋne hone tâcnehuc ŋic ira juŋgopieŋ jaŋe sanaŋne me dodocne, bocjaha me afecne i mâmâc hone manac efârenʒepieŋ.
Erâ mâreŋ juŋgopieŋ i biaŋne me sâqocne, â hae‐jeŋic i jaba sawa me basanaŋ‐jopahuc bakicne,
erâ mâreŋ i guec sâkohec me mâreŋ kereŋne, erâ jâckâte‐ticne fokac me mâcne, i wâc mâmâc hone‐fârenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe hâbi hârohec eniŋ, ehuc mâreŋ irec fâri wiac gâcne bawarenʒepieŋ.” Rambiŋ i waiŋ fâri fufua dameŋko hâcne.
Eme jaŋe ferâ, Ziŋ mâreŋ burocnaonec raku Rehoboo, Hamati hae mendâŋko ira forakac mâreŋ i hone tâcnembiŋ.
Ehame Anakare ɋâricfâc Ahimaŋ, Sesai â Talamai jaŋe hâcne ira jumbiŋ. (Heboroŋ hae bambiŋ irec faicnao jara 7 tarame Aigita mâreŋko Zoaŋ hae bakicne.)
Eme jaŋe Esikola wâneŋko fisirâ waiŋ qaŋeŋne moc makenehec bâtâcnerâ ŋic jajaheczi reŋkepire risie warembiŋ. Ehuc wâc nemuja â jâchândâŋ gâcne i mâmâc bawarembiŋ.
Eme ŋic jaŋe waiŋ qaŋeŋne makenehec ira bâtâcnembiŋte hae mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe Esikola wâneŋ mumbiŋ.
Eme mâreŋ hone tâcneniŋte rambiŋ jaŋe juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 40 tarame risie warembiŋ.
Ehuc Mose â Aroŋ erâ Israe kikefuŋ sasawa Paraŋ mâreŋ burocnao Kadesi haeo jumbiŋ jaŋerao risie warembiŋ. Erâ dâŋ binaŋ ejarehuc mâreŋ hone tâcnembiŋ irec jâchândâŋ wiac jowatumbiŋ.
Ehuc Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Sorec‐nâpomeŋ nâŋe mâreŋ ira sâcne ra fisimbeŋ. Mâreŋ i susu â baŋaczi fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkehuc foekac irec hândâŋ fâri‐ticne ʒi hâcne.
Ŋic ira juŋgopieŋ jaŋe ŋic sanaŋne, â hae‐jeŋic i kâcɋene erâ basanaŋkehuc bakicne. Ira Anakare ɋâricfâc jupie honec‐jopambeŋ wâc.
Amaleke ŋic jaŋe Negebe mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ, â Hitiŋic â Jebusi ŋic erâ Amoŋŋic jaŋe tiki mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ; Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋe ine hâwecmecko â Jordaŋ opâ heririŋnao ŋec juc eraŋgopieŋ.”
Kalebezi ine Mosere maio ŋic ŋokac mu bâmiriŋ ejarehuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Nâŋâc ʒiŋuczia ferâ mâreŋ i ro rauc enʒepeneŋ, nâŋâc sâcne sanaŋkerâ ro rauc enaŋmu.”
Iŋuc mume ŋic ehec rambiŋ jaŋe ine kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋic keci jaŋere tâpirizi nâŋâcne tâpiri sirickerâ fokac, irec nâŋâc sâcne mi sanaŋke‐jarenaŋmu.”
Jaŋe iŋuc murâ mâreŋ hone tâcnembiŋ irec dâŋ binaŋ bipic tataranehec ʒuhuckerâ ejarepie Israe ŋic jaŋe manarâ hâbi‐jeŋic goroŋkewec. Ehame ʒiŋuc hâcne jazambiŋ: “Mâreŋ hone tâcnenaŋte fotâcnembeŋ izi hâcne ŋecjucfâc‐ticne ɋâcjopa‐fâreekac, erâ ŋic honec‐jopambeŋ jaŋe ŋic ʒoricne â sanaŋne sasawa.
Erâ ŋic soka makakicne, Anakare ɋâricfâc hâcne, jaŋe wâc honec‐jopambeŋ. Honec‐jopahuc nâŋe nâŋâcne manapene ɋirikiŋ jaŋere sâc juŋgopeneŋ tinac ewec, ehame jaŋe wâc honec‐nâpopie irec sâc jaha embeŋ.”
Eme Israe kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋe kio owa sâko ehuc juhapie hae furewec.
Iŋuc ehuc Mose â Aroŋ mu kâroŋ ejactehuc ʒiŋuc jasambiŋ: “Nâŋe Aigita mâreŋko juhuc hâmonʒapeŋ me! Me mâreŋ burocnao ʒira moc hâmonʒapeŋ me!
Wofuŋ e wemocte ʒikare nânâ enaŋte mâreŋ ʒira jowac‐nâpome wareŋgopeneŋ? Â ŋokac naru motecfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe wâc râsifâc‐nâŋec jaŋere meo feniŋmu, irec Aigita mâreŋko risiepene muzac sâckezac.”
Iŋuc murâ jaŋaczia ʒiŋuc muhuc nazaŋ gazaŋ embiŋ: “Nâŋâc micne moc âkendâŋnepene eki jowac‐nâpome Aigita mâreŋko risienʒepeneŋ.”
Iŋuc mupie Mose â Aroŋ jahe Israe kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋere maio mâreŋko hetutuckerâ fopic.
Ehame Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua â Jefunere ŋokâ Kalebe, mâreŋ hone tâcneniŋte mâmâc rapic jahe ŋaqi‐jekic bâsuckepic.
Ehuc Israe kikefuŋ mâmâc sâko ʒiŋuc jazapic: “Mâreŋ hone tâcnezo rambeŋ i mâreŋ biaŋne jâmbâŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ e nâŋâcne maname sâckeme mâreŋ ira jowac‐nâpo rarâ nâre tahac eocmu; mâreŋ i susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkehuc foekac.
Mocjaha, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ mu kâroŋ mi ecnenʒepieŋ, ehuc mâreŋ rune jaŋere wâc mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec, nâŋâc jopa jâpec sâcne ejarenaŋmu. Ŋeŋezic‐jeŋic rârieha Wofuŋzi nâŋâc bafic‐nâpoocmu, irec jaŋere mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec.”
Iŋuc jazapire kikefuŋ ʒeŋgoma jaŋe qânâzi hehâmoc‐jofazo mumbiŋ. Iŋuc muhapie Wofuŋte tatamaczi tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo ira fuarâ Israe kikefuŋ batamaec‐jopawec.
Ehame Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋic ʒi jaŋe qaisocnuhuc jueŋgopieŋ i mo dameŋko beheniŋmu? Me ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko mâsi wiac fuŋne fuŋne baekopac i honehuc mo dameŋko moc manasiŋnuniŋmu?
No mupe huc hâmoczi rocjopame omaenʒepieŋ, ehame go basawecgupe ɋaricfâcge jaŋe ŋic ʒi jaŋere sâc sirickehuc guru sâko erâ junʒepieŋ.”
Mosezi ine Wofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go ŋicguru ʒi Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa waremeŋ i Aigita ŋic jaŋe mana‐fârembiŋ.
Erâ mâreŋ ʒirec rune jaŋe wâc ʒiŋuc manambiŋ: Wofuŋ, go ŋicguru ʒi jaŋere ŋondeŋko jutec ʒâŋe fâri‐jeŋiczi honecgueŋgopieŋ, ehame ʒoaŋko karorac maŋko domahuc bânie‐jareekic â ŋafeo ine ʒocbâruŋ maŋko juhuc jowac‐jopaekic.
Eme ʒi ŋicguru keci bâsirowec‐jopacmuo ine ŋic gurune gurune gore biŋe manambiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc muniŋmu:
‘Wofuŋ e ŋicguru keci jaŋe mâreŋ jareocte mupaŋkewec ira bacjopa raocte eipierâ mâreŋ burocnao qâhâmoc‐jopawec.’
Iŋuc fuazacte ʒiŋuc numu‐garekopac: Go ʒiŋuc hâcne mupaŋkemeŋ irec sâcko Wofuŋ tâpirige bataniŋkezemec:
‘No kimbeŋ‐nane uneŋne â buuruc‐nane ɋârâŋne, no hehesic â qaqatara‐jeŋic behekopac, kiŋ hureeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine okacne bazu‐jare rahuc juhape naru motec ŋosafâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao tarazokac.’
Irec buurucge ɋârâŋne fokac â Aigita mâreŋkonec fuŋkerâ kiŋjeŋic behe waremeŋ irec sâcko kiŋjeŋic mocwâc behecmurâ numu‐garekopac.”
Eme Wofuŋzi muwec: “No nunumuge manarâ kiŋjeŋic behekopac.
Erâ no jujâmbâŋkekopac, â Wofuŋ nore huriri qâreŋzi mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ sâcke‐fârerâ foocmu irec ʒiŋuc mupaŋkekopac:
Huriri qâreŋ‐nane hone‐bipiembiŋ â Aigita mâreŋko me mâreŋ burocnao mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bapo i hone‐bipiehuc jumbiŋ jaŋe mamacfâc‐jeŋic mâreŋ jarepemurâ mupaŋkepo i moc mi honenʒepieŋ. Jaŋe esâicnupie arec 10 ewec, ehuc dâŋnanere hazec wâc mi râembiŋ. Erâ qaisocnuhuc jumbiŋ jaŋe wâc mi honenʒepieŋ.
<range>
Kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Kalebe e ine maŋticne norao râehuc dâŋnane reŋkewecte mâreŋ hone tâcnewec ira manacnepe ra fisime ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋe mâreŋ i ro rauc enʒepieŋ.
Ʒi ine Amaleke ŋic â Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋe wâneŋko juŋgopieŋte ŋoŋe tomâcko risierâ mâreŋ burocne Hâwec Bâbâroŋkopec fokac irapec ranʒepieŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋ e Mose â Aroŋ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Kikefuŋ râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne ʒi jaŋe mu kâroŋ enareeŋgopieŋ i mo dameŋko moc beheniŋmu? Israe ŋic jaŋe mu kâroŋ enarepie boc manaekopac.
Irec ʒiŋuc jazanic: Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: ‘No jujâmbâŋkekopac, irec ŋoŋe dâŋ muwarepie manaekopac irec sâcko wiac eŋarepemu.
Irec qâŋɋâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mâreŋ burocnao ʒira hâcne foraniŋmu. Wose qâreŋ ejarekicne â jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac erâ mu kâroŋ enarembiŋ ŋoŋe hâcne
mâreŋ juniŋte biŋe qaŋarepo ira moc mi raʒi‐jâmbâŋkeniŋmu. Mocjaha, Jefunere ŋokâ Kalebe â Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua jahe sawa raʒinicmu.
Erâ naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere manabâc ehuc râsi jaŋere meo feniŋmu mumbiŋ jaŋe wâc raʒiniŋmu. Ehuc ŋoŋe mâreŋ surembiŋ i hâcne ro rauc ehuc juhâc qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ine mâreŋ burocnao hâmo‐fârenʒepieŋ:
Ehame naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mâreŋ burocnao lama bulimakao soŋaŋ juhuc qaqatara‐ŋeŋicte okacne âsickehuc juhapie kâcɋene ŋoŋe ira hâmo‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋafe ʒoaŋ 40 mâreŋ hone tâcnehuc jumbiŋ iŋuc jaha jara 40 kiŋŋeŋic âsickehuc ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ: Wofuŋzi behec‐nâpokac.’
Wofuŋ no, kikefuŋ râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne ʒi râsi enarehuc juŋgopieŋ jaŋe wiac iŋuc hâcne ejarepemurâ mupaŋkekopac; jaŋe mâreŋ burocnao hâmo miziec efârenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Mosezi ŋic mâreŋ hone tâcneniŋte sorec‐jopame rambiŋ jaŋe risierâ kikefuŋ sasawa mâreŋ irec binaŋ bipic tataranehec bajarepie jaŋe manarâ Mose mu kâroŋ ecnembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie binaŋ bipic tataranehec bambiŋ jaŋe Wofuŋte maio ututuŋ hâmo‐fârembiŋ.
Ehame mâreŋ hone tâcneniŋte rambiŋ jaŋeraonec Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua â Jefunere ŋokâ Kalebe jahe sawa jupic.
Eme Mose e Wofuŋte uŋdâŋ i Israe kikefuŋ sasawa jaza‐fâreme jaŋe manarâ ki busâqoc kâcɋene embiŋ.
Erâ jaŋe furic uupicte faharerâ kecʒiŋuc muhuc tiki mâreŋko fembiŋ: “Manakic, nâŋe kiŋ i jâmbomac bâfuambeŋ, erâ ʒi sifu Wofuŋzi mâreŋ biŋe qanârewec ira razo eŋgopeŋeŋ.”
Mosezi ine dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarewec: “Ŋoŋe wemocte Wofuŋte dâŋ ʒuhuckerâ qatarazo eŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe iŋuc epie mi sâckeocmu.
Wofuŋzi ŋoŋehec mi jukacte râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ŋopanʒipiŋte mi fenʒepieŋ.
Amaleke ŋic â Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋe ira juŋgopieŋte ŋoŋe ʒikare biŋe eniŋmu. Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ bâjâpezore takic‐ŋopawecte Wofuŋzi ŋoŋehec mi juocmu.”
Jaŋe ine Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapa mi rawec â Mosezi wâc teuŋ beherâ mi raha sifu maŋsanaŋ erâ tiki mâreŋko feniŋte mumbiŋ.
Erâ fehapie Amaleke ŋic â Kanaaŋ ŋic tiki mâreŋ ira jumbiŋ jaŋe waharâ jopa bâtâtiec ejarepie raku Horima haeo fisimbiŋ.
Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazac: No mâreŋ ŋarepemu ira fisirâ ŋec juc ehuc Wofuŋ taha bâzi rikecneniŋmu.
I mumupaŋte erâ me buafec faio taha rârâe irec erâ me hombaŋ dameŋ‐ŋeŋicte erâ Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuaocte bulimakao me lama moc qowi bâzire biŋe rikeniŋmu hâcne.
Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc taha bâzire wiac kecʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ: Oto moc irecnec poroŋ uucne teŋkonec wâŋ wokemaŋ opâhec bâsifuckekicne.
Erâ lama taha bâzire biŋe râeniŋmu sâc ine waiŋzi taha bâzi i fifia râqâc irecnec teŋkonec 4 irec sâc mâmâc râenʒepieŋ.
Me lama ŋicne moc râeniŋmuo ine oto moc irec poroŋ uucne teŋkocne 2 wokemaŋ opâhec bâsifuckekicne i mâmâc râenʒepieŋ.
Erâ waiŋzi taha bâzi ine fifia râqâc irecnec teŋkonec 3 râenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc râepie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuaocmu.
Me bulimakao ŋicne moc qowi bâzire biŋe, me mumupaŋ‐ŋeŋiczi fârinehec eocte irec biŋe, me wama bâzire biŋe Wofuŋ rikecnezo murâ,
ine oto moc irecnec poroŋ uucne teŋkonec 3 wokemaŋ opâhec bâsifuckekicne i mâmâc râenʒepieŋ.
Erâ waiŋzi taha bâzi ine waiŋ fifia râqâc irecnec teŋkonec 5 râenʒepieŋ wâc. Wiac i sasawa rike râec epie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuaocmu.
“Ŋoŋe bulimakao me lama ŋicne me lama â noniŋ motecne taha bâzire biŋe rikekuc iŋuc hâcne enʒepieŋ.
Erâ qowi rike râec eniŋmu sâc ijaha wiac gâcne râenʒepieŋ.
Mâreŋ rune ŋoŋe Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuaocte taha bâzi iŋuc hâcne rikenʒepieŋ.
Me ŋic jabane moczi ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko juocmu, me ŋic moczi ŋoŋehec raŋqa juwefuhuc Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuaocte taha bâzi rikezo murâ ine ŋoŋe eeŋgopieŋ ijaha ehuc rikezejec.
Ŋic jabane ŋoŋehec jueŋgopieŋ â mâreŋ rune ŋoŋere dâŋsanaŋ i mocjaha erâ mimiŋzi ɋâric foŋare rahuc juzejec. Ŋoŋe mâmâc Wofuŋte maio sâc mocjaha erâ junʒepieŋ.
Ŋic jabane ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jueŋgopieŋ â mâreŋ rune, ŋoŋere sâcmutâc â mumutâc dâŋ mocjaha foŋarezejec.”
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazac: No mâreŋ jowac‐ŋopa rapemu ira fisirâ
mâreŋ irec mazu mâriri nâ bac ehuc ine Wofuŋ taha bâzi râcnenʒepieŋ wâc.
Nânâ bâbâni nâniŋmu irec poroŋ moc barâ tahare biŋe râenʒepieŋ; gie ɋârionec nânâ wiac gâcne tahare biŋe râeniŋmu irec sâc râenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe mimiŋzi ɋâric iŋuc erâ Wofuŋ taha bacne rahuc junʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋzi Mose sâcmutâc dâŋ râcne‐fârewec i mi mana tarahuc âte sifuckeniŋmuo
ine Wofuŋzi qanaŋ fuŋkerâ sâcmutâc dâŋ Mosere micko râehuc mimiŋzi ɋâric mutâcne‐ŋare warehuc juwec,
i kikefuŋ jaŋe mi mana tarahuc âte sifuckembiŋko ine jaŋe sasawa bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne moc qowi bâzire biŋe rikepie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec, ehame taha bâzire wiac â waiŋzi taha bâzi i mumutâc dâŋte sâcko mâmâc râenʒepieŋ, ehuc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe noniŋ ŋicne moc râenʒepieŋ wâc.
Eme jaŋe mi mana tarahuc bâbâsifuc bâfuambiŋ erâ bâbâsifuc‐jeŋic irec erâ taha bâzi‐jeŋic râehuc Wofuŋ bâzi rikecnembiŋte taha bapazi kikefuŋ sasawa kiwiric‐jeŋic rome sâqocne‐jeŋic tâmirezejec.
Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe mecne erâ ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic jabane jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mecne mâmâc sasawa bâbâsifuc bâfuambiŋte iŋuc hâcne fua‐jarezejec.
“Ŋic moc e mi mana tarahuc bahac moc bâfuaocmu e sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe noniŋ ŋokacne moc jara‐ticne wâŋ ekicne râezejec.
Iŋuc eme taha bapazi Wofuŋte maio kiwiric‐ticne rome sâqocne‐ticne tâmirezejec.
Mi mana tarahuc bahac bâfuaniŋmu, Israe ŋic me ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ŋic jabane jueŋgopieŋ, jaŋere sâcmutâc dâŋ mocjaha fuarâ fozejec.
Israe ŋic me ŋic jabane moczi bahac mana afeckerâ bâfuahuc Wofuŋ bunao baocmu e ine ŋic âgofâcne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec bâsirowezo.
E Wofuŋte dâŋ qâsuahuc sâcmutâc dâŋticne qatarawecte bâsirowe‐jâmbâŋkezo hâcne, e kiŋticnere okacne buc rozejec.”
Israe ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ burocnao juhuc ŋic moc sabata hombaŋko ʒoc rohuc juhame bâfumbiŋ.
Bâfuarâ Mose â Aroŋ erâ kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋerao jowa rambiŋ.
Eme ŋic iŋucne weniŋuc ecnezo irec mumutâc dâŋ moc mi fowecte mâc kâpâcwâru bapie ŋewec.
Ehame Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋic e hâmocte biŋe ezejec, kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋe teuŋ râpenao qânâzi hehâmonʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume kikefuŋ jaŋe teuŋ râpenao jowa hurâ, Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ mutâcnecnewec irec sâc qânâzi hehâmombiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazac: Ŋoŋe mimiŋzi ɋâric ŋaqi‐ŋeŋic qaŋeŋnao eri wiac ʒariŋ hândâŋ hawari tinac biricke ranʒepieŋ. Ehuc hândâŋ ira muc keŋkeŋnezi ɋâtâ ranʒepieŋ.
Erâ hândâŋko muc râekicne i honeniŋmu sâc ine Wofuŋte sâcmutâc dâŋ sasawa i manasuhuc reŋke‐fârenʒepieŋ. Ehuc eeatucko qâsorienʒipiŋte maŋŋeŋicte hata kosa mi âtenʒepieŋ â ʒâŋe kosa mi finʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc sâcmutâc dâŋnane sasawa manasuhuc reŋke‐fârerâ Wofuŋte maio tirine junʒepieŋ.
No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu, noni hâcne Anutu‐ŋeŋic jupemurâ Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐ŋopa warepo. No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Anutu jukopac hâcne.”
Eme Lewire ŋokâ Kohati ere ŋosa Kora, Izarare ŋokâ hâcne, e â Eliabare ŋokâ jahec Dataŋ â Abiram, erâ Peletire ŋokâ Oŋ, Rubeŋte ŋosa hâcne, jaŋe Mose râsi ecnembiŋ.
Ehuc Israe kikefuŋ soŋaŋ micne ʒâŋe biŋehec â bâwosâec‐jopakicne jaŋeraonec ŋic 250 rocjopambiŋ.
Rocjoparâ Mose â Aroŋ râsi ejactehuc ʒiŋuc jasambiŋ: “Ŋohe ŋahacnere boc manapire fekac. Kikefuŋ jaŋe furu jaha tirine erâ juhapie Wofuŋzi ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko jukac. Ŋohe ine wemocte Wofuŋte kikefuŋfâc jaŋere manapire wawahane eekac?”
Iŋuc mupie Mosezi manarâ mâreŋko hetutuckerâ fowec.
Ehuc Kora â ŋicfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Hae furume Wofuŋzi ŋic weni jaŋe ere biŋe erâ tirine juhuc taha gie sâcne baniŋmu irec fuŋne bataniŋkeocmu. Ehuc rowosâeocmu ŋic eki hâcne Wofuŋ maickezejec.
Kora gahacne â ŋicfâcge ŋoŋe tomâcko ʒiŋuc enʒepieŋ:
Ŋoŋe ʒocrâqâc moc rorâ maŋnao ʒoc kine â wiac âsu biaŋ ropie hume Wofuŋte maio râenʒepieŋ. Eme Wofuŋzi ŋic e me e rowosâeocmu eki hâcne tirine ezejec. Lewire ɋâricfâc ŋoŋe ŋaŋacnere manapie boc fekac i!”
Mose e iŋuc murâ Kora ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Lewire ɋâricfâc ŋoŋe mananiŋ:
Ŋoŋe Anutu maickehuc Wofuŋte tiri bozeo ŋic ŋokac jaŋere kiŋaŋ gie baniŋte Israere Anutuzi rowosâec‐ŋopawec irec manapie wawahane ekac me?
Eki hâcne go gahacne mecne â Lewire ɋâricfâc hahac ɋafâcge jaŋe mecne rowosâec‐ŋopawec. Eme irec wemocte manapie wawahane eha taha bapa erâ juniŋte muŋgopieŋ?
Irec go â ŋicfâcge ŋoŋe Wofuŋte maio mu kâroŋ epie mi sâckekac. Aroŋ e mo ŋic mo, irec mu kâroŋ ecneŋgopieŋ?”
Eme Mosezi Eliabare ŋokâ jahec Dataŋ â Abiram jahe erao fisinicte dâŋ râeme dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnepic: “Nâhe mi hefanacmu.
Mâreŋ burocnao hâmo sipiric enaŋte susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeekac mâreŋ irecnec jowac‐nâpo waremeŋ i go manatec afeckeha ŋicbomboŋ enârezo mukic me?
Erâ go mâreŋ susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeekacko râec‐nâpotec mi raʒimbeŋ, ehuc mâreŋ â waiŋ gie wiac nâŋere biŋe eocte wâc nâre tahac mi emeŋ. Go ʒâŋe bâsoŋ enârezo mukic me? Nâhe mi hefanacmu.”
Eme Mose e dâŋ i manarâ aaricke sâqoreme Wofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go taha wiac‐jeŋic hone aŋac mi ezemec. No jaŋeraonec doŋgi wiac moc mi ropo erâ wiac gâgâpâcne wâc mi ejarepo.”
Mose e iŋuc murâ Kora ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go gahacne mecne ŋicfâcge jaŋe mecne ŋoŋe tomâcko Aroŋhec Wofuŋte maio fuanʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ŋoŋe mâmâc sasawa ʒocrâqâc‐ŋeŋic rofârerâ wiac âsu biaŋ râehuc Wofuŋte maio râenʒepieŋ, ʒocrâqâc 250 hâcne râenʒepieŋ. Erâ Aroŋhec ŋohe mâmâc râezepirec.”
Iŋuc mume ŋic sasawa jaŋe ʒocrâqâc‐jeŋic rorâ maŋnao ʒoc kine â wiac âsu biaŋ ropie hume Mose â Aroŋ jahehec tutumaŋte qoruc bozere motâcko tumaŋnerâ domambiŋ.
Domahapie Korazi ŋicfâc‐ticne sasawa ejareme jaŋe tutumaŋte qoruc bozere motâcko Mose â Aroŋ râsi ejactehuc domambiŋ. Ehame Wofuŋte huriri qâreŋzi kikefuŋ sasawa batamaec‐jopa‐fârewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose â Aroŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Ŋohe kikefuŋ keci jaŋe behec‐joparâ bucŋekic domapire mi ʒoraha ututuŋ bâsirowec‐jopazepac.”
Eme jahe mâreŋko hetutuckerâ ʒiŋuc muhuc numupic: “O Anutu, go ŋic sasawa jaŋere Anutu, irec ŋic mocjahazi sâqocne bâfuame kikefuŋ sasawa bâsirowec‐jopatec sâckeocmu me?”
Iŋuc mupire Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go ŋic jazatec jaŋe Kora, Dataŋ â Abiram behec‐joparâ warepie buc domanʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Mosezi faharerâ Dataŋ â Abiram jaherao rahame Israe soŋaŋ micne jaŋe bâjâpembiŋ.
Ehame kikefuŋ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ŋic repicne keci jaŋere boze behehuc wiac‐jeŋic ba bâuac moc mi enʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe jaŋere sâqocnere erâ sirowenʒipiŋte.”
Iŋuc jazame jaŋe Kora, Dataŋ â Abiram jaŋere boze behembiŋ. Eme Dataŋ â Abiram jahe ŋokac naru motecfâc‐jekic jaŋehec boze‐jeŋicte motâcko waha domambiŋ.
Domahapie Mosezi kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Gie sasawa keci i no nahacne maŋte mâcne, Wofuŋzi munareme baekopac irec fuŋne ʒi taniŋkeme honeniŋ.
Ŋic ʒi jaŋe, ŋiczi hâmoc omane hâmo‐fâreeŋgopeneŋ iŋuc sawa hâmopie, me wiac gâcne fua‐nâreekac irec sâc sawa fua‐jareme, ‘Wofuŋzi mi sorecguwec,’ iŋuc munarenʒepieŋ.
Me Wofuŋzi mâsi fuŋmoc bame mâreŋzi aŋkerâ ɋâcjopame wâcwiac‐jeŋichec ɋâricne hâmoc haeo hupie honerâ ʒiŋuc mananʒepieŋ: Ŋicguru keci jaŋe hâcne Wofuŋ behe qaisoc ecnembiŋte wiac iŋuc fua‐jarekac.”
Eme Mose e dâŋ i mutara‐fârehame mâreŋ domambiŋ izi fâuckewec.
Fâuckerâ aŋkehuc Kora â ŋicfâcne garikiŋfâc‐jeŋic â mafa wiac‐jeŋichec ɋâcjopa‐fârewec.
Iŋuc fuame jaŋe wâcwiac‐jeŋichec ɋâricne hâmoc haeo hufârembiŋ. Hufârepie mâreŋ mocwâc kibâzickeme kikefuŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec omaembiŋ hâcne.
Owackehuc hupie Israe ŋic rârec‐jopahuc domambiŋ jaŋe owa‐jeŋic manarâ kecʒiŋuc muhuc wise‐fârembiŋ: “Ʒira domahapene mâreŋzi ɋâcnâpozackohec.”
Eme Wofuŋtaonec ʒoc fuarâ ŋic 250 ʒocrâqâc badomambiŋ jaŋe ʒâseŋ‐jopa‐fârewec.
Iŋuc fuame Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Aroŋ ŋokâ‐ticne taha bapa Eleaʒa âzâcnetec ʒocrâqâc i ʒockonec bârâiehuc ʒoc hetâtiezejec. Ʒocrâqâc i wiac tirine hâcne.
Erâ ŋic sâqocne bâfuarâ hâmombiŋ jaŋere ʒocrâqâc i hamazi hejacnerâ alata râreckehuc ɋorockepie fozejec. Wiac i Wofuŋte maio bajumbiŋte tirine ekac. Wiac izi hâcne Israe ŋic jaŋere uŋsawaŋ ehuc majeŋic ezejec.”
Iŋuc mume taha bapa Eleaʒa e ʒocrâqâc aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bakicne, ŋic ʒoczi ʒâhâmoc‐jopawec jaŋe badomambiŋ, i rofârerâ ŋic jareme hedapirerâ alata ɋorockembiŋ.
Eme ŋic moczi taha bapa mi juocmu me Aroŋte ɋâric wâc mi juocmu e sifu Wofuŋte maio fuarâ wiac âsu biaŋ rikerâ Kora ŋicfâcne wiac fua‐jarewec iŋucnea fuacnezacte wiac izi Israe ŋic jaŋere uŋsawaŋ ehuc majeŋic ewec. Eme Eleaʒa e wiac i sasawa Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ âzâcnewec irec sâc efârewec.
Hae fureme Israe kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋe Mose â Aroŋ mu heŋɋâŋ ejactehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋohe hâcne Wofuŋte ŋicfâc qâhâmoc‐jopapirec i!”
Erâ Mose â Aroŋ râsi ejactehuc tumaŋnerâ tutumaŋ qoruc boze maickehuc ʒiŋuc honembiŋ: Karoraczi waha boze sâockerâ foha Wofuŋte huriri qâreŋ fuawec.
Ehame Mose â Aroŋ jahe tutumaŋ qoruc boze maŋfuŋnao ra domapic.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Ŋohe kikefuŋ keci jaŋe behec‐joparâ bucŋekic domapire mi ʒoraha ututuŋ bâsirowec‐jopazepac.” Iŋuc mume jahe mâreŋko hetutuckerâ fopic.
Ehuc Mosezi Aroŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋtaonec kimbeŋ aaric fuame huc mimicnezi biac rocjopakacte go ʒocrâqâcge barâ maŋnao ʒoc kine rotec hume fainao wiac âsu biaŋ râerâ kikefuŋ jaŋerao ra kiwiric‐jeŋic rozemec.”
Eme Aroŋ e Mosezi dâŋ âzâcnewec irec sâc ehuc kikefuŋ jaŋe tumaŋnembiŋ ira rawec. Ra juhame mi huc mimicnezi ŋic gâcne biac rocjopazejec i! Iŋuc fuame honerâ ʒocrâqâcko wiac âsu biaŋ râerâ ŋic kiwiric‐jeŋic rowec.
Ehuc ŋic hâmockicne â ɋâricne jumbiŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko domahame huc mimicnezi omaewec.
Huc mimicnezi ine ŋic 14 tauseŋ 700 rocjopame hâmombiŋ. Kora ŋicfâcne hâmombiŋ jaŋerao ŋic iŋucnezi ʒuhuckerâ hâmombiŋ hâcne.
Eme huc qaʒuerâ wahame Aroŋzi tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo Moserao risie rawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic jazatec gurune gurune irec micne jaŋe apafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sâc gunu moc moc râekupie 12 ezejec. Ehame gunu sahacnao micne jaŋere ʒâŋe qâreŋkezemec.
Lewire gunuo ine Aroŋte ʒâŋe qâreŋketec fozejec. Ehame guru sâc micne jaŋere biŋe gunu mocjaha sawa fozejec.
Iŋuc erâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo qorac tapa katapa maŋfuŋnao bâbâfuac eekoperecko ira râetec fozejec.
Eme rowosâepemu ŋic ere gunuzi gitec qame Israe ŋic jaŋe honerâ pipic tatara ejareme mu heŋɋâŋ eŋacteeŋgopieŋ i moc behenʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Mose e ŋic jazame micnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe apafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sâc manahuc gunu ru sâc râcnekupie 12 ewec. Gunu 12 jaŋeraonec moc ine Aroŋte biŋe.
Eme Mose e gunu i tiri bozeo Wofuŋte maio râeme fowec.
Eme hae fureme Mosezi tiri bozeo raʒirâ honeme mi Lewire guruonec Aroŋte gunuzi gitec qazejec i! Ehuc âri qarâ hândâŋ fârihec ehuc woze qeuc ewec.
Eme Mosezi gunu sasawa i Wofuŋte tiri bozeonec Israe ŋic ŋokac jaŋerao bawahawec. Bawahame ʒâŋe qâreŋ‐jeŋic sâc honehuc rofârembiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Aroŋte gunu i mocwâc tiri bozeo bârisierâ râezemec. Izi hâcne ŋic râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne jaŋere ma ezejec. Ehuc no mu heŋɋâŋ enareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe jazatec behe‐jâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ. Iŋuc mi eniŋmuo ine hâmo‐jâmbâŋkeniŋmu.”
Eme Mose e Wofuŋzi dâŋ âzâcnewec irec sâc efârewec.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Mose ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Manakic, nâŋe hâmo sipiric ehuc omae‐fârezo eŋgopeneŋ.
Moc e Wofuŋte tiri boze maickeocmu e hâmoocmu. Nâŋe moczi moc mi bafic‐nâpoha omaenaŋmu me?”
Eme Wofuŋzi Aroŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Furufic maŋnao bâbâsifuc moc fuame irec kiŋ i go â ŋokâfâcge erâ kikefuŋfâcge ŋoŋere faio fezejec, me taha gieo bâbâsifuc moc fuame irec kiŋ i iŋuc jaha ŋoŋe âsickenʒepieŋ.
Qomâfâcge, Lewiŋic guru, mamacgere kikefuŋ hâcne, jaŋe mana‐jaretec qâtec‐ŋoparâ, go â ŋokâfâcge ŋoŋe tiri bozeo taha gie bahuc juhapie kiŋaŋ qaŋarenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc tiri bozere kiŋaŋ gie gâcne wâc banʒepieŋ, mâc jaŋe mecne â ŋoŋe mecne mâmâc hâmonʒipiŋte alata â furuficte wâcwiac gâcne mi maickenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe hâcne qâtec‐ŋoparâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozere wiac gâcne bahapie ŋic omane jaŋe moc mi siŋŋopanʒepieŋ.
Ehame ŋoŋe furufic â alatare gie bahuc juhapie kimbeŋ aariczi Israe ŋic jaŋere faio mocwâc mi fezejec.
Erâ manakic, no qomâfâcge, Lewiŋic hâcne, Israe ŋic gâcne jaŋeraonec rowosâec‐jopapo, jaŋe Wofuŋ nore biŋe erâ juhuc tutumaŋ qoruc bozere kiŋaŋ gie baniŋte ŋoŋe tahac‐ŋopapo.
Go â ŋokâfâcge ŋoŋe sawa ine alatao â tiri boze maŋnao taha gie banʒepieŋ, gie izi hâcne ŋoŋere biŋe ekac. Taha bapa gie i ŋoŋe hâcne tahac‐ŋopakopac. Ŋic omane moczi gie i bame qâhâmozo.”
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ Aroŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, Israe ŋic jaŋe taha wiac sasawa bâtirihuc nare tahac eeŋgopieŋ irec tiwâne gâcne i gore biŋe qakopac. Go â ŋokâfâcge ŋoŋe mimiŋzi ɋâric wiac i nâ bac ehuc juniŋte qikiŋne‐ŋarekopac.
Wiac tirine kecʒiŋuc i ʒoczi mi ʒâtâcneha ŋoŋere biŋe ezejec: Nânâ wiaczi taha bâzi me sâqocne tâtâmire taha bâzi, me kiŋ tatara taha bâzi; taha bâzi wiac‐jeŋic sasawa hâcne nore biŋe râeŋgopieŋ i go â ŋokâfâcge ŋoŋe ŋare tahac epe ro rauc ehuc irec manapie tirine jâmbâŋ ezejec.
Ehame ŋoŋe tirificko juhuc nânʒepieŋ, ehuc irec manapie tirine eha ŋiczi sawa nânʒepieŋ.
Erâ wiac kecʒiŋuc izi wâc ŋoŋere biŋe ezejec: Israe ŋic jaŋe taha wiac fenʒoŋkeeŋgopieŋ i go â ŋokâfâcge ŋoŋere biŋe qape mimiŋzi ɋâric nâ bac erahuc junʒepieŋ. Wiacfâcge jaŋeraonec e me e ɋaɋacne juocmuzi nâzo murâ nâzejec.
Ehame wokemaŋ opâne me waiŋ opâne me padi wiac biaŋne jâmbâŋ me nânâ bâbâsu Wofuŋ nore biŋe qaeŋgopieŋ i go qikiŋne‐garekopac.
Erâ mâreŋ‐jeŋicko wiac nânâne sasawa fuŋkerâ woze qeuc eha Wofuŋ norao râeniŋmu i gore biŋe jaha; ehame wiacfâcge jaŋeraonec e me e ɋaɋacne juocmuzi nâzo murâ nâzejec.
Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko wiac i me i Wofuŋte biŋe mupaŋkekicne izi gore biŋe jaha efârezejec.
Ŋic me qowi mârâc fufua sasawa Wofuŋ nore biŋe râeeŋgopieŋ i gore biŋe jaha ezejec; ehame ŋic mârâc fufua me qowi sâqocne mârâc fufua irec okacne ine moneŋ garepie rozemec.
Jaŋe mosa wâŋ bazupie iŋuc ehuc furi‐jeŋic siliwa moneŋ 5 rozemec. Ine furuficte moneŋ hawari fokac irec sâc hâcne rozemec. Gera moneŋ 20 izi ine siliwa moneŋ wâŋ ekac.
Bulimakao me lama me noniŋ mârâc fufua jaŋe tiri bozere biŋe eeŋgopieŋte akic‐jopahuc okacne moneŋ mi rozemec. Go socjeŋic alatao tierâ wokemaŋ‐jeŋic ʒocko rike siŋsiŋketec Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec.
Ehame amec siec‐jeŋic fenʒoŋkekicne â ŋefac‐jeŋic gore biŋe eekac irec sâc jaha biuc‐jeŋiczi gore biŋe ezejec.
Israe ŋic jaŋe taha wiac tirine no nare tahac eeŋgopieŋ i go â ŋokâfâcge ŋoŋe tahac‐ŋopape ŋoŋere biŋe erâ forahuc juzejec. Wiac izi Wofuŋ nore maio ʒâʒâfic fofosanaŋ erâ go â ɋâricfâcge ŋoŋere biŋe fozejec.”
Wofuŋ e iŋuc muhuc ʒuhuckerâ Aroŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Israe ŋic mâreŋ‐jeŋicko merâfâc mâreŋ me jufu sesuc moc mi fua‐garezejec. Go jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhaŋtec noni hâcne merâfâc mâreŋ â jufu sesucge erâ jupemu.
“Israe ŋic jaŋe wiac sasawa irec teŋkonec wâŋ râeŋgopieŋ i Lewiŋic jaŋe tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo kiŋaŋ gie baeŋgopieŋte jaŋere biŋe eocte jarepo.
Israe ŋic jaŋe sâqocne âsickerâ hâmonʒipiŋte jefuhuc tutumaŋ qoruc boze maŋfuŋnao moc mi ranʒepieŋ.
Irec Lewiŋic jaŋe hâcne sâqocne‐jeŋic qâŋkerâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo kiŋaŋ qahuc junʒepieŋ. Sâcmutâc dâŋ izi ŋoŋerao mimiŋzi ɋâric forahuc juzejec. Ehame Lewiŋic jaŋe Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhuc merâfâc mâreŋ moc mi bâfuanʒepieŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋe wiac sasawa teŋkonec wâŋ Wofuŋ no nare tahac eeŋgopieŋ i Lewiŋic jaŋere biŋe eocte qikiŋne‐jarepo hâcne. Irec erâ jaŋere kecʒiŋuc mupo: Jaŋe Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhuc merâfâc mâreŋ moc mi bâfuanʒepieŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Lewiŋic ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ jazac: Ŋoŋe Israe ŋic jaŋe wiac teŋkonec wâŋ râepie ŋoŋere biŋe eocte qikiŋne‐ŋarepo irecnec teŋkonec wâŋ jaha Wofuŋ nore tiri taha eocte râenʒepieŋ.
Eme no taha wiac irec manape ŋaŋacne gieonec me waiŋ rowaŋ‐ŋeŋickonec râeŋgopieŋ ezejec.
Ŋoŋe Israe ŋic jaŋeraonec wiac teŋkonec wâŋ roeŋgopieŋ irecnec gâcne Wofuŋ no nare tahac enʒepieŋ, erâ nore taha i taha bapa Aroŋ râcnepie ere biŋe ezejec.
Wiac ŋareniŋmu sasawa irecnec Wofuŋ nore biŋe mukicne i nare tahac enʒepieŋ, ine wiac biaŋne jâmbâŋ irecnec bâtirihuc nore biŋe qanʒepieŋ.
Irec hâcne kecʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘Ŋoŋe wiac biaŋne jâmbâŋ taha bâzire biŋe râepie ine manape Lewiŋic ŋaŋacne gieonec me waiŋ rowaŋ‐ŋeŋickonec râeŋgopieŋ ezejec.
Ehame ŋoŋe â kikefuŋfâc‐ŋeŋic ŋoŋe ira me ira nâzo murâ nânʒepieŋ, i tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo kiŋaŋ gie baeŋgopieŋ irec suanʒeŋ‐ŋeŋic ekac hâcne.
Ŋoŋe wiac biaŋne jâmbâŋ taha bâzire biŋe râehuc kiŋ moc mi hotâckeniŋmu. Ehuc Israe ŋic jaŋere wiac tirine mi hegâpâreniŋmu, erâ wâc mi hâmoniŋmu.’”
Eme Wofuŋ e Mose â Aroŋ kecʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Wofuŋzi sâcmutâc dâŋte dâŋsanaŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: Ŋohe Israe ŋic jazapire bulimakao biaŋne bâbâroŋzi sahac fâfâsac, erâ upenao kioŋ mi râekicne iŋucne moc noherao bafisinʒepieŋ.
Bafisipie taha bapa Eleaʒa râcnepire eki teuŋ râpenao jowa hume ere maio qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Qâhâmopie taha bapa Eleaʒazi memotec‐ticne socko âke uruckerâ tutumaŋ qoruc boze maŋfuŋnao tieme arec 7 ezejec.
Eme eki honehame bulimakao sahac biuc‐ticne â socticne erâ hoticne i ʒocko râepie ʒazejec.
Ehame taha bapa e jâmâzâc jâc erâ wiac âsu biaŋ â muc bâbâroŋ rorâ bulimakao ʒakac ʒoc ira wâc beheme ʒazejec.
Taha bapa e iŋuc erâ ŋaqi wiac‐ticne ʒurehuc e jahacne wâc opâ ruarâ teuŋko risierâ wâwânâŋhec juhame hae ŋafezejec.
Â ŋic bulimakao ʒocko rikeocmu e wâc iŋuc jaha ŋaqi wiac‐ticne ʒurehuc e jahacne opâ ruarâ wâwânâŋhec jaha juhame hae ŋafezejec.
Ehame ŋic moc wâwânâŋ tâmiric juocmuzi bulimakao ʒafe‐ticne hezurâ teuŋ râpenao hae mâreŋ biaŋnao hoŋkezejec. Eme ʒafe i Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe opâhec bâsifuckepie sâqocne tâtâmire opâ eocte irec biŋe fozejec.
Â bulimakao ʒafe hezuocmu ŋic e iŋuc jaha ŋaqi wiac‐ticne ʒurerâ wâwânâŋhec juhame hae ŋafezejec. Dâŋ izi Israe ŋic â ŋic jabane ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere dâŋsanaŋ erâ forahuc juzejec.
“Ŋic moczi qâŋɋâŋ moc ba bâuac eocmu e wâwânâŋhec juhame ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
E ʒoaŋ gie bapa 3 â 7 ira sâqocne tâtâmire opâ ruarâ ɋaɋackezejec, me ʒoaŋ ira opâ i mi ruaocmu ine mi ɋaɋackeocmu.
Moc e ŋic hâmokicne jaŋere qâŋɋâŋ ba bâuac erâ opâ mi ruaocmu e Wofuŋte tiri boze wâwânâŋ ecneocmu, eme ŋic iŋucne e Israe kikefuŋkonec bâsirowezo. Wemocte? E sâqocne tâtâmire opâ mi ruawecte wâwânâŋhec jaha ʒuhuckerâ jukac hâcne.
“Ŋic moczi qoruc bozeo hâmome ine sâcmutâc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac irec sâc enʒepieŋ. Boze ira juniŋmu me ira fisirâ raʒiniŋmu jaŋe wâwânâŋhec erâ juhapie ʒoaŋ 7 tarazejec.
Ehame boze ira kuʒi hapec wiac tapa tâmiric ŋeocmu i wâc iŋuc jaha wâwânâŋhec eocmu.
Me moc e ŋic ʒikazi qâhâmokicne, me qâŋɋâŋ moc, me ŋicsiec ba bâuac ehuc ʒâŋeruŋko rac warec eocmu e iŋuc jaha wâwânâŋhec juhame ʒoaŋ 7 tarazejec.
Wiac wâwânâŋhec iŋucnere ine sâqocne tâtâmire bâzi rikekicne irec ʒafe fiarâ râqâcko opâ ɋâricnehec bâsifuckenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ŋic moc wâwânâŋ tâmiric e ʒariŋ moc âsunehec irec tieŋne bazurâ opâ ira âke uruckerâ qoruc boze mecne, erâ kuʒi hapec â ŋic sasawa mecne, erâ ŋicsiec bâuambiŋ, me ʒikazi qâhâmoc‐jopakicne, me mâc hâmokicne ba bâuac ejarehuc ʒâŋeruŋko rac warec embiŋ jaŋe tieme rua‐jare‐fârezejec.
Ehuc wâwânâŋ tâmiriczi wâwânâŋhec jaŋe ʒoaŋ gie bapa 3 â 7 ira tieme rua‐jarezejec. Iŋuc hâcne ehuc ʒoaŋ 7 ira ʒure ɋaɋac‐jopazejec. Erâ ŋaqi wiac‐ticne ʒurerâ e jahacne wâc opâ ruarâ juha hae ŋafeme ɋaɋackezejec.
“Ŋic moc wâwânâŋhec juhuc ɋaɋackeocte giene mi baocmu e kikefuŋkonec bâsirowezo. E sâqocne tâtâmire opâ mi ruawecte wâwânâŋhec juhuc Wofuŋte furufic hegâpâreocmu.
Sâcmutâc dâŋ izi ine foŋare rahuc juzejec. Sâqocne tâtâmire opâ tieocmu ŋic e ŋaqi wiac‐ticne ʒurezejec, â sâqocne tâtâmire opâ bâuaocmu ŋic e wâwânâŋhec juha hae ŋafezejec.
Ŋic wâwânâŋheczi wiac i me i ba bâuac eme wâwânâŋhec jaha ezejec, ehame moc e wiac i bâuarâ iŋuc jaha wâwânâŋhec juha hae ŋafezejec.”
Eme Israe kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋe mosa wâŋko Ziŋ mâreŋ burocnao Kadesi haeo fisirâ ira ŋec juc embiŋ; ehame Miriam e ira hâmome duckembiŋ.
Eme kikefuŋ jaŋe mâreŋ irâ opâ basarâ tumaŋnehuc Mose â Aroŋ dâŋ mujactembiŋ.
Erâ Mosere aaric manahuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Qomâfâc‐nâŋe jaŋe Wofuŋte maio hâmombiŋkoa hâmonʒapeŋ me!
Wofuŋte kikefuŋ nâŋe â bulimakaofâc‐nâŋec mâreŋ burocnao ʒira hâmonaŋte wemocte jowac‐nâpo waremeŋ?
Erâ wemocte Aigita mâreŋkonec enâretec mâreŋ sâqocne ʒira warembeŋ? Mâreŋ ʒira padi jacgoŋ me jâmbo me waiŋ me jâcfâri gâcne sâcne mi fuaekac, erâ opâ wâc mi fokac.”
Iŋuc mupie Mose â Aroŋ jahe kikefuŋ behec‐joparâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko rarâ mâreŋko hetutuckerâ fopic. Ehame Wofuŋte huriri qâreŋzi batamaec‐jofame
Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go gunuge rorâ kikefuŋ sasawa hetumaŋ‐joparâ hahacge Aroŋhec ŋohe ʒâŋe fai‐jeŋicko qânâ dâŋ âzâcnepire opâ wahame kikefuŋ jaŋe â bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic opâ gumec‐jopa‐fârezepirec.”
Eme Mose e Wofuŋzi mutâcnecnewec irec sâc eocte gunu‐ticne rowec.
Eme Mose â Aroŋ jahe kikefuŋ sasawa qânâ maŋfuŋko hetumaŋ‐jopa‐fârerâ Mosezi ʒiŋuc muhuc jazawec: “Ŋic râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne ŋoŋe mananiŋ! Nâhe sâcne ŋoŋere opâ qânâ ʒirecnec bâfua‐ŋarenacmu me?”
Mose e iŋuc muhuc meticne bafahararâ gunu‐ticnezi qânâ qame arec jajahec ewec; iŋuc eme opâ sâro sâko jâmbâŋ wahahuc domawec, eme kikefuŋ jaŋacne â bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic mâmâc nâfârembiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose â Aroŋ ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ŋohe wemocte Israe kikefuŋ jaŋere maio ʒâŋe‐nane bâtirihuc mi manasiŋnupirec? Irec erâ ŋohe kikefuŋ jaŋe mâreŋ biŋe qajarepo ira jowac‐joparâ sâcne mi ranicmu.”
Eme opâ irec ʒâŋe Meriba mumbiŋ, ira hâcne Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe Wofuŋ mana sâqorecnehapie eki tiri juju‐ticnere fuŋne jaŋerao bataniŋkewec.
Eme Mose e Kadesi haeo juhuc Edom ŋicwofuŋtao dâŋ ʒiŋuc râeme rawec: “Qomâfâcge Israe ŋic nâŋe ʒiŋuc muŋgopeneŋ: Ʒârâ hâriŋ maŋko juwefumbeŋ i go manaekic.
Mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe Aigita mâreŋko hurâ ira dameŋ ʒora jumbiŋ; ehame Aigita ŋic jaŋe mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mecne â nâŋe mecne boc bomac‐nâpombiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnepene dâŋnâŋec manarâ aŋelo‐ticne moc soreme eki Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐nâpo wefume gore mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao Kadesi haeo warembeŋ juŋgopeneŋ.
Irec mana‐nârehaŋ mâreŋge fotâcnenaŋte muŋgopeneŋ. Nâŋe giegaŋ me waiŋ gie‐ŋeŋic mi fotâcnenaŋmu, erâ opâ nombâŋ forakac irecnec opâ nanaŋte wâc mi manasuŋgopeneŋ; nâŋe fâreopec me qanaopec mâcne, hata sâkooa rahuc juku mâreŋge fotâcnenaŋte muŋgopeneŋ hâcne.”
Edom ŋicwofuŋzi ine ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋoŋe mâreŋ‐nane moc mi fotâcnerâ ranʒepieŋ, sifu raniŋmuo ine râsi eŋarehuc ʒikazi ŋopa jâpec eŋarenaŋmu.”
Iŋuc mume Israe ŋic jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ: “Nâŋe hata sâko sawa bâjâperâ ranaŋmu, ehuc nâŋe nâŋâcne mecne bulimakaofâc‐nâŋec mecne nâŋe opâ wiacge moc nanaŋmuo ine furine râenaŋmu, nâŋe mana‐nârehaŋ mâreŋge mâc fotâcnerâ ranaŋte muŋgopeneŋ.”
Edom ŋicwofuŋ eki ine dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarewec: “Aricne, ŋoŋe mi fotâcnenʒepieŋ.” Ŋicwofuŋ e iŋuc murâ momorifâc‐ticne bocjaha rocjopame haeonec wahambiŋ.
Edom ŋic jaŋe iŋuc ehuc Israe ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ‐jeŋic fotâcnenʒipiŋte aka hejarembiŋ. Iŋuc epie Israe ŋic jaŋe behec‐joparâ hata kizurâ rambiŋ.
Eme Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma Kadesi hae beherâ raku Hora tikio fisimbiŋ.
Eme tiki ira fisipie Wofuŋzi Edom mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao Mose â Aroŋ ʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Aroŋ e ʒira apafâc‐ticne qâtec‐jopahuc hâmozejec. Ŋohe Meriba opâo dâŋ ŋasapo i qatarapicte e Israe ŋic mâreŋ biŋe qajarepo ira mi raʒizejec.
Irec go Aroŋ â ŋokâ‐ticne Hora tikio jowac‐jofa fezemec.
Ferâ Aroŋ gie ŋaqi wiac‐ticne hetararâ ŋokâ‐ticne Eleaʒa hecnetec huzejec. Aroŋ e ira hâcne apafâc‐ticne jaŋe qâtec‐joparâ hâmozejec.”
Eme Mose e Wofuŋzi dâŋ âzâcne mutâc ewec irec sâcko ehuc kikefuŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe faio jowac‐jofame tikio fembiŋ.
Fe fisirâ Mosezi Aroŋte ŋaqi hetararâ ŋokâ‐ticne Eleaʒa hecneme huwec. Ehame Aroŋ e tiki botâŋnao ira hâmowec. Hâmome Mose â Eleaʒa jahe tikionec wahapic.
Aroŋ hâmowec, Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe biŋe iŋuc manarâ Aroŋte ki busâqoc ehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 30 tarawec.
Kanaaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Arada e Negebe mâreŋko juweczi, Israe ŋic jaŋe Atarim haeo warehuc juŋgopieŋ, biŋe iŋuc manarâ fahare jopahuc gâcne kâpâcwâru bacjopawec.
Iŋuc fuame Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋtao dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupaŋkembiŋ: “Go ŋic ʒi jaŋe menâŋecko râec‐jopatec nâŋe fic hae wiac‐jeŋic i hetâc qâtâtienʒepeneŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋ e Israe ŋic dâŋjeŋic manarâ Kanaaŋ ŋic mejeŋicko râec‐jopawec. Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe ŋic mecne â fic hae wiac‐jeŋic mecne i bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârembiŋ. Iŋuc epie hae mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe Horima mumbiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Hora tiki beherâ Edom mâreŋ getâckeniŋte Hâwec Bâbâroŋkopec rambiŋ, rahuc juku aaric‐jopawec.
Irec Wofuŋ â Mose dâŋ mujactehuc kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋohe wemocte mâreŋ burocnao hâmonaŋte Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐nâpo warepic? Ʒira nânâ opâ mi fokac, â nânâ nâeŋgopeneŋ kecirec mamakâc‐nâpoekac.”
Iŋuc mupie Wofuŋzi mume homa bâbâroŋ ŋic ŋondeŋko fisirâ Israe ŋic kicjopapie bocjahazi hâmombiŋ.
Ehame ŋic jaŋe Moserao fisirâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Nâŋe Wofuŋhec ŋohe dâŋ muŋactehuc bahac bâfuambeŋ, irec go Wofuŋ numucnetec mume homa arictac ezejec.” Iŋuc mupie Mosezi jaŋere erâ numuwec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go aeŋ bâbâroŋzi homa qâqâtâc moc barâ jâmâ wâtuŋko qahasickec, eme homazi ŋic kicjopame homa qâqâtâc i hone dendeŋnerâ juniŋmu.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Mose e aeŋ bâbâroŋzi homa qâqâtâc barâ jâmâ wâtuŋko qahasickewec. Eme homazi ŋic kicjopame homa qâqâtâc hone dendeŋnembiŋ jaŋe biaŋkerâ jumbiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe hata ʒuhuckerâ raku Oboti haeo teuŋ âterâ fombiŋ.
Erâ Oboti haeonec raku Ije‐Abarim hae mâreŋko teuŋ âterâ fombiŋ. Hae mâreŋ i Moabi mâreŋ ŋifecnao ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec ira fowec.
Eme irecnec raku Ʒerede wâneŋko teuŋ âterâ fombiŋ.
Erâ irecnec raku Aronoŋ opâ ocniŋucnao fisirâ mâreŋ burocnao teuŋ âterâ fombiŋ. Mâreŋ burocne izi ine raku Amori ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko mickekac. Aronoŋ opâzi ine Moabi â Amori ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko fohuc Moabi mâreŋte ma ekac.
Irec hâcne Wofuŋte ʒika papiao dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukicne: “Wahebe opâ ʒâŋe i Sufa mâreŋko fokac, erâ wâc Aronoŋ opâre wâneŋ.
Â wâneŋ irec tiki ŋifec â ŋifec ŋeraku Ari hae mâreŋko tarakac, ehuc Moabi mâreŋ mao siŋkekac.”
Eme ŋic jaŋe irecnec raku Bere opâ nombâŋko fisimbiŋ. Opâ nombâŋ irec Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go ŋic ŋokac hetumaŋ‐jopatec opâ gumec‐jopapemu.”
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe dameŋ ira gae kecʒiŋuc hembiŋ: “Opâ, go siwiŋnerâ nombâŋkonec wefuhaŋ gae ʒiŋuc hegareniŋ:
Ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe opâ nombâŋ i rombiŋ, ŋic fekicne jaŋe gunu â ɋaruc‐jeŋiczi nombâŋ i qaandaŋkembiŋ.” Eme jaŋe mâreŋ burocne i beherâ raku Matana hae mâreŋko fisimbiŋ.
Erâ irecnec raku Nahalie hae mâreŋko fisimbiŋ; erâ irecnec raku Bamoti hae mâreŋko fisimbiŋ.
Bamotionec fahare raku ine Moabi hae mâreŋko Pisiga tikitoŋko fisimbiŋ. Tikitoŋne i mâreŋ burocnao domahuc tâtâc ŋeme hone jumbieŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Amori ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ erao kiŋaŋŋic ʒiŋuc muhuc sorec‐jopambiŋ:
“Mana‐nârehaŋ mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic fotâcnenaŋte muŋgopeneŋ. Nâŋe hata qâsorierâ giegaŋko me waiŋ gieo mi raʒinaŋmu, erâ opâ nombâŋ‐ŋeŋickonec opâ wâc mi nânâ mâc hata sâkooa rahuc mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic fotâcnenaŋmu.”
Sihoŋ eki ine Israe ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ‐ticne fotâcnezo mupie qatara‐jarewec. Ehuc momorifâc‐ticne hetumaŋ‐jopame Israe ŋic mâreŋ burocnao râsi ejare raku Jahazi haeo fisirâ Israe ŋic jopazo embiŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋe ine sanaŋkerâ jopa jâpec ejarehuc mâreŋ‐jeŋic Aronoŋ opâo fuŋkerâ raku Jaboko opâo â Amoŋŋic jaŋere mâreŋko mickekac i ro rauc efârembiŋ. Jazere haezi ine Amoŋŋic jaŋere mâreŋte masanaŋ ewec.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Amori ŋic jaŋere hae sâko â hae piticfâc‐ticne i ro rauc efârerâ ira ŋeŋe juju embiŋ.
Hesiboŋ i Amori ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ ere hae qizec hâcne. Sihoŋ eki mârâc jaha Moabi ŋicwofuŋ qa jâpec ecnehuc mâreŋ‐ticne ro rakume Aronoŋ opâo tarawec.
Irec hâcne mu âke sisic gae ʒiŋuc hembiŋ: “Ŋoŋe Hesiboŋ haeo fisiniŋ, ehuc Sihoŋte hae heɋârerâ bapie honeniŋ.
Ʒoczi Hesiboŋ hae, Sihoŋte hae qizeckonec hâcne bâruŋkerâ ʒarawec. Ehuc Moabi hae Ari i ʒâseŋkewec, â Aronoŋ opâre jâckâte i mâmâc ʒâtâmirewec.
Jei, Moabi! Kemosi nemure qâjâpecfâc ŋoŋere dameŋ i tarakac hâcne. Moabi ŋokâfâc‐ticne jopa jâpec ejarembiŋ, â otâfâc‐ticne jaŋe kâpâcwâru bacjoparâ Amori ŋicwofuŋ erao bacjopa rambiŋ.
Hesiboŋ haeo fuŋkerâ jopa qâhâmoc ejae raku Diboŋ haeo fisimbiŋ, ehuc ima samaki bapene foha ʒoczi ʒaraku Medeba haeo fisiwec.”
Israe ŋic jaŋe iŋuc ehuc Amori ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko ŋeŋe juju embiŋ.
Ehame Mosezi Jazere hae hone tâcneniŋte ŋic gâcne sorec‐jopame rambiŋ. Eme jaŋe hae i erâ hae piticfâc‐ticne ro rauc ehuc Amori haeo ŋic jumbiŋ jaŋe jâpec‐jopambiŋ.
Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc risierâ Basaŋ haeopec rambiŋ. Ehame Basaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Ogo e â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe Israe ŋic jaŋehec Ederei haeo qaqac eniŋte wahambiŋ.
Wofuŋzi ine Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go jaŋere mi hâwicguoc, no ŋiwofuŋ â ŋicfâc‐ticne erâ mâreŋ‐ticne i gore meo râec‐jopa‐fârepo; irec Amori ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ Hesiboŋ haeo juhame wiac ecnemeŋ sâc ijaha Ogo ecnezemec.”
Iŋuc mume jaŋe Ogo jahacne â ŋokâfâcne erâ ŋicfâc‐ticne sasawa jopaku jopa mizie‐fârepie nâfocne moc mi jumbiŋ; ehame mâreŋ‐jeŋic rauckembiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe irecnec fahare raku Moabi mâreŋ sawao Jordaŋ ocniŋucnao Jeriko haeopec teuŋ âterâ fombiŋ.
Ziporore ŋokâ Balake eki ine Israe ŋic jaŋe Amori ŋic wiac ejarembiŋ i hone manac efârewec.
Ehame Moabi ŋic jaŋe Israe ŋic bocjahare mâretec hâwic‐jopawec. Eme honec‐joparâ bipic tatara ejarewec.
Irec Midiaŋ soŋaŋ micne ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Bulimakao jaŋe qinʒiŋ nâfâreeŋgopieŋ irec sâc ŋicguru keci jaŋe omaec‐nâpo‐fâreniŋmu.” Iŋuc mupie Ziporo ŋokâ‐ticne Balake e dameŋ ira Moabi mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ juweczi
Beoro ŋokâ‐ticne Bileam erao kiŋaŋŋic sorec‐jopame rambiŋ. Bileam e ine Amawi mâreŋko Eufrata opâ heririŋnao Petoro haeo juwec. Eme kiŋaŋŋic jaŋe erao fisirâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcneniŋte sorec‐jopawec: “Manakic, Aigita mâreŋkonec ŋicguru moc jaŋe warerâ mâreŋ‐nane sâcke‐fârerâ maŋfuŋ‐naneo ŋefâreŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe guru sâkore bâipiec‐jopaŋgopeneŋ, irec goki ware nore erâ sâwec‐jopatec rokawepie sâcne mecne jâpec‐jopapene mâreŋ‐nâŋec beheniŋmu. No gore ʒiŋuc hâcne manakopac: Goki ŋic jambuŋ‐jopatec fârinehec eekac, me sâwec‐jopatec i wâc fârinehec jaha eekac.”
Iŋuc mume Moabi â Midiaŋ soŋaŋ micne jaŋe sâwecdâŋ mumure furi bara rambiŋ. Rahuc juku Bileamtao fisirâ Balakere dâŋ i âzâcnembiŋ.
Âzâcnepie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ʒira foniŋ, ehame Wofuŋzi dâŋ i me i nazame ŋazapemu.” Iŋuc mume Moabi ŋic micne jaŋe Bileamhec fombiŋ.
Eme Anutuzi Bileam fuacnerâ ʒiŋuc wiocnewec: “Ŋic weni jaŋe gohec juŋgopieŋ?”
Eme Bileamzi Anutu dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Ziporore ŋokâ Balake, Moabi ŋicwofuŋ hâcne, e norao dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc râeme warejec:
‘Manakic, Aigita mâreŋkonec ŋicguru moc jaŋe warerâ mâreŋ sâcke‐fâreŋgopieŋ. Irec goki ware nore erâ sâwec‐jopatec rokawepie sâcne mecne jopa jâpec ejarepene behec‐nâponiŋmu.’”
Anutuzi ine Bileam kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go jaŋehec mi razemec, erâ ŋicguru keci jaŋe jambuŋ‐jopakicnere mi sâwec‐jopazemec.”
Iŋuc mume Bileam e furicte faharerâ Balake ŋicfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wofuŋzi ŋoŋehec mi rapere qatara‐narejecte ŋoŋe mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko risieniŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Moabi ŋic micne jaŋe fahare Balakerao risie rarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Bileam e nâŋehec wareocte mi ecnekac.”
Eme Balake e harierâ ŋic fekicne bocjaha ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec sorec‐jopame rambiŋ.
Rahuc juku Bileamtao fisirâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ziporore ŋokâ Balake e ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Go norao warezo etec wiac moczi aka moc mi hegarezejec.
No sâsecgu‐jâmbâŋkehuc wiac irec me irec numu‐naretec sâcne epemu, irec go ware nore erâ ŋicguru keci jaŋe sâwec‐jopazemec.’”
Bileam eki ine Balake kiŋaŋŋicfâcne dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc bâtikie‐jarewec: “Balake e ficticnao siliwa â gol fusucmarâ fokac i nare tahac eocmuo ine no sifu wiac piticne me kâcɋenere erâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐nanere dâŋ sâcne mi qatarapemu.
Erâ ŋoŋe sifu ʒira foniŋ, eme no Wofuŋzi dâŋ weniŋuc ʒuhuckerâ nazaocmu i manazepac.”
Eme Anutuzi ŋafeo Bileam fuacnerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋic jaŋe jowacguzo warembieŋko ine faharerâ jaŋehec rac; mâc noni dâŋ gazapemu i sawa ezemec.”
Eme Bileam e hae fureme faharerâ doŋgi‐ticnao sate râerâ Moabi ŋic fekicne jaŋehec rawec.
Rame Anutuzi aarickewec. Ehame Wofuŋte aŋelo aka hecnehuc hata âte bâzickecnewec. Bileam e ine kiŋaŋŋic jahec‐ticne bâjâpehapire doŋgi faio rawec.
Eme doŋgi e Wofuŋte aŋelozi ʒika barâ hatao domaha honewec; honehuc hata kizurâ giegaŋko raʒiwec. Eme doŋgi e mocwâc hatao risieocte Bileamzi qawec.
Eme aŋelozi ra waiŋ gie ŋoŋondeŋko hata gâŋgâŋnao domawec, ŋifec â ŋifec ira ine saczi orâŋke‐fârekicne.
Ehame doŋgi e Wofuŋte aŋelo honerâ sac jâŋâhuc rame saczi Bileam kikene najacnewec. Iŋuc eme Bileamzi doŋgi mocwâc qawec.
Eha Wofuŋte aŋelozi ʒuhuckerâ bânie ra hata gâŋgâŋne fowec ira domawec. Ŋondeŋ ira domahuc qanaopec me fâreopec foc fotikic sâcne mi eene.
Ira hâcne doŋgizi Wofuŋte aŋelo honerâ hata razo eipierâ mâreŋko waha fowec. Bileamzi iŋuc honerâ boc aarickeme ɋaruc‐ticnezi doŋgi mocwâc qawec.
Iŋuc eme Wofuŋzi doŋgi micne baafeckeme Bileam dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No wemo wiac moc egarepe honehuc nutecne arec jahec â moc ekac?”
Iŋuc mume Bileamzi doŋgi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go âke sisic boc enarehuc jukomec. Manakic, no sâqe bajurâ muzac ʒine hâcne âke‐hâmocguzapo.”
Eme doŋgizi Bileam ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No gore doŋgi mocwâc mi ekopac, â nore faio rac warec ehuc jumeŋzi miŋecgac wâc mi jukomec me? No gore mic reŋkehuc wamane moc mi jupo me?” Iŋuc mume Bileamzi muwec: “Misac!”
Iŋuc muhame Wofuŋzi Bileam ʒâŋe‐ticne bâtâcneme Wofuŋte aŋelozi ʒika barâ hatao domaha honehuc fodapecnerâ mâreŋko hetutuckewec.
Iŋuc eme Wofuŋte aŋelozi kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go wemocte doŋgige qatec arec jahec â moc ejec? Manakic, go hata hehesicne rakomecte no aka hegarezore fua‐garepac.
Eme doŋgizi honecnurâ hata kizuhuc rame arec jahec â moc ejec. E hata mi kizume muzac no ʒi e akickehuc go qâhâmocguzapo.”
Iŋuc mume Bileamzi Wofuŋte aŋelo ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go râsi enarehuc hatao domamec i mi hone tarahuc wiac epe sâqorejec. Irec wiac epac i manatec sâqorekacko risiezepac.”
Eme Wofuŋte aŋelozi Bileam dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go ŋic jaŋehec rac, mâc noni dâŋ gaza mutâc epemu i sawa muzemec.” Iŋuc âzâcneme Bileam e Balakere ŋic fekicne jaŋehec rawec.
Eme Balake e Bileamzi warehuc jukac, biŋe iŋuc manarâ Ari‐Moabi haeo bâfuaocte rawec. Hae izi ine mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao jâmbâŋ Aronoŋ opâzi mâreŋ ma ekac ira ŋewec.
Eme Balakezi Bileam bâfuarâ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No hefârecguhuc ŋic sorec‐jopape fâpie wemocte mi waremeŋ? Me manatec sâsecguhuc furine sâcne mi garepemu me?”
Iŋuc mume Bileamzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “No gorao warepac i mi honekic me? Erâ ʒi no nahacne maŋte wiac irec me irec dâŋ moc mupemurâ tâpiri fonarekac me? Aricne, Wofuŋzi mutâcne‐nareme sâc sawa mupemu.”
Iŋuc murâ Balakehec raku Kiriati‐Huzo haeo fisipic.
Eme Balake e ira bâzire biŋe lama bulimakao qa hezuc ejarehuc Bileam â ŋic fekicne ehec jumbiŋ jaŋere wâc râeme rawec.
Eme hae fureme Balakezi Bileam jowame Bamoti‐Baali mâreŋ toŋnao fepic. Ferâ ira domahuc Bileamzi Israe ŋic teuŋ âterâ fombiŋ jaŋe honec‐jopa‐fârewec.
Eme Bileamzi Balake ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go ʒira alata 7 banarezemec, ehuc bulimakao 7 â lama 7 jaha râec‐jopazemec.”
Eme Balake e Bileamzi âzâcnewec sâc ewec. I tarame Balake â Bileam jahe alata ŋerawec ira bulimakao â lama bâzi rikec‐jopapic.
Iŋuc erâ Bileamzi Balake ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go qowi bâzigere maŋfuŋko domahaŋ no ipec rape Wofuŋzi fua‐nareocmu mecne. Eme dâŋ i me i naza nowatuc eme gazapemu.” Iŋuc murâ mâreŋ toŋnao fewec.
Eme Anutuzi Bileam fuacneme eki ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No alata 7 barâ irec fainao bulimakao â lama bâzi rikec‐jopapo.”
Iŋuc mume Wofuŋzi Bileam dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Balakerao risierâ dâŋ gazapemu i âzâcnezemec.”
Eme risierâ honeme Balake e mi Moabi ŋic fekicne jaŋehec bâzi‐ticnere maŋfuŋko jaha domanʒepieŋ i!
Eme Bileam e jambuŋdâŋ fuŋkerâ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Moabi ŋicwofuŋ Balake e Aram mâreŋkonec ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec tiki mâreŋkonec ʒiŋuc muhuc hefârecnume warepo: ‘Go nore erâ ware Jakobore ɋâricfâc sâwec‐jopac, erâ Israe ŋic jaŋe musoriŋ‐jopac!’
Noni ine wemocko Anutuzi mi sâwec‐jopawec, ŋic iŋucne sâwec‐jopapemu, me Anutuzi mi musoriŋ‐jopawec ŋic iŋucne musoriŋ‐jopapemu.
No tiki botâŋko domahuc honec‐jopakopac, â tikitoŋko ferâ hone manac ejarekopac. Honec‐jopape gâmbuŋ juŋgopieŋ ekac, eha ŋicguru gâcne jaŋehec qaja fuserâ mi juŋgopieŋ.
Mozi Jakobore ɋâricfâc wosec‐jopaocmu, me Israe ŋic guru dindiŋ jaŋere ʒare manaocmu? Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe hâmoeŋgopieŋ hâmoc iŋucne hâmozo enarekac, â juju dameŋ‐jeŋic taraekac irec sâc nore juju dameŋ wâc tarazejec.”
Iŋuc mume Balakezi manarâ Bileam ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go wemo mâsi enarekomec? Go râsifâc‐nane sâwec‐jopacmurâ hefârecgupo, goki ine mi sâsâwec‐jopa jambuŋ‐jopakomec i!”
Eki ine dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Wofuŋzi dâŋ naza mutâc ejec i wemocko moc huckezapo.”
Iŋuc mume Balakezi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go waretec mâreŋ toŋne mocko fenac, eme ira domahuc Israe ŋic ʒeŋgoma mâcne, mai juŋgopieŋ jaŋe sawa honec‐jopacmu. Honec‐joparâ sâwec‐jopa‐narezemec.”
Iŋuc murâ jowame ruc bapa ŋic jaŋere toma Pisiga tiki toŋnao fowec ira fepic. Fe fisirâ Balakezi alata 7 barâ bulimakao â lama bâzi rikec‐jopawec.
Ehame Bileamzi Balake ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go qowi bâzigere maŋfuŋko domahaŋ no ocna ra Wofuŋ bâfuazepec.”
Eme Wofuŋzi fuacnerâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Go Balakerao risierâ dâŋ gazapemu i âzâcnezemec.”
Eme risierâ honeme Balake e mi Moabi ŋic fekicne jaŋehec bâzi‐ticnere maŋfuŋko jaha domanʒepieŋ i! Eme Balakezi ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnewec: “Wofuŋzi mo dâŋ moc gazajec?”
Eme Bileam e ʒuhuckerâ jambuŋdâŋ muwec: “Balake, go faharerâ manac, Ziporore ŋokâ, go norao hazec râec.
Anutu e ŋic aricne, irec burec moc mi eekac, e ŋicte ɋâric wâc aricne, irec maŋne mi risieocmu. Eki dâŋ moc mume sâcne mi sanaŋkeocmu me? Me mumupaŋ dâŋ mume fârinehec sâcne mi eocmu me?
Manakic, no jambuŋdâŋ mupemurâ mutara‐narekicne. Eki jambuŋ‐jopawecte no sâcne mi sâwec‐jopapemu.
Jakobore ɋâricfâc jaŋerao wiac hâhâwicne moc mi fome honekopac, erâ Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko ʒârâ ʒâpâ wâc mi fokac. Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋiczi jaŋehec juekac, ehame ŋicwofuŋ iŋucne ofac hecneeŋgopieŋ.
Anutuzi Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopame wefumbiŋ, irec ere manapie tâpiri sâkohec eekac.
Jakobore ɋâricfâc jaŋerao qaŋgec qapene fâri tâmiric eocmu, â Israe ŋic sâwec‐jopapene fârimâc jaha eocmu. Dameŋ ʒiŋuczia hâcne Jakobo â Israe ŋic jaŋere ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Anutuzi jaŋerao mâsi sâko bawec i!’
Opoŋ, jaŋe ŋicsaric! Laioŋ ŋokacne iŋucne fahareeŋgopieŋ, â iaioŋ ŋicne iŋucne tarahuc he raeŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe qowi qarâ mi nâfârehuc ine mi waha foniŋmu, â qowi qakicne irec soc mi nâhuc wâc mi fomananiŋmu.”
Eme Balakezi Bileam ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go sâwec‐jopazore manatec quŋkeme ine jajambuŋ‐jopa i wâc mi ezemec.”
Iŋuc mume Bileamzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “No ʒiŋuc gazapac i! ‘Wofuŋzi dâŋ nazaocmu i sawa mupemu.’”
Bileam e iŋuc mume Balakezi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go waretec hae mâreŋ mocko jowacgu rapemu. Eme Wofuŋzi ira mecne maname sâckeha nore erâ sâwec‐jopazemec.”
Balake e iŋuc murâ Bileam Peoro tikio jowame fepic. Ira hâcne domahuc mâreŋ burocne hone‐fârepic.
Ehuc Bileamzi Balake ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go ʒira alata 7 banarezemec, ehuc bulimakao 7 â lama 7 jaha bâfuac‐jopa‐narezemec.”
Eme Balake e Bileamzi âzâcnewec irec sâc ehuc alata ŋerawec ira bulimakao â lama bâzi rikec‐jopawec.
Eme Bileam e Israe ŋic jambuŋ‐jopaocte Wofuŋzi maname sâckekac, iŋuc mana tarahuc sowi wiac moc hone manac eocte mi rahuc mâc mâreŋ burocnaopec ʒâŋe fime rawec.
Ehuc Israe ŋic gurune gurune teuŋ âterâ fopie honec‐jopawec. Erâ Anuture Mârozi erao waharâ neŋgoc ŋecnehame
jambuŋdâŋ ʒuhuckerâ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Bileam no Beorore ŋokâ, no ʒâŋe‐nane bâtâcnekicne.
No Anuture dâŋ manahuc tâpiri rune ere mu bararuŋ dâŋ hone manac ekopac; no mâreŋko fodapehape maŋʒâŋe‐nane tâcnewec noni hâcne ʒiŋuc mukopac:
O Jakobo, boze wiacge i biaŋne jâmbâŋ! O Israe, ŋeŋe tomage i aŋac ʒizine!
I wâneŋ qaratiekicne fokac iŋucne, â jufu gie opâ heririŋnao fokac irec sac, i ʒineaŋ saŋkarac âsu biaŋ Wofuŋzi sarawec iŋucne, â jâmâzâc jâc opâo domakac irec sâc.
Jambuŋ‐ticnezi ine opâ pake fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeekac irec sâc, â guec mâriri‐ticnezi opâ moc mi basaocmu. Ŋicwofuŋ‐ticne e ŋicwofuŋ Agagere sâc sirickeocmu â uucmaŋ‐ticnezi ferâ foocmu.
Aigita mâreŋkonec jowa wefuwec Anutu eki hâcne kâte bulimakaore ʒuŋe iŋucne tâpiri‐ticne erâ jukac. E ŋic gurune gurune râsifâc‐ticne imac‐jopa‐fârewec, ehuc siec wiac‐jeŋic henʒaŋ qanʒaŋne‐fârerâ tepe motec‐ticnezi muruc‐jopa‐fârewec.
E laioŋ ŋicne iŋucne wahawec fokac, erâ laioŋ ŋokacne irec sâc; mo ŋiczi sâcne suruckeocmu? Moc e go jambuŋguocmu e jambuŋkezo, â moc e go sâwecguocmu e wâc sâweckezo.”
Eme Balake e dâŋ i manarâ bune qâoriŋkeme Bileam me pocpoc qacnerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No râsifâc‐nane sâwec‐jopacte hefârecgupo, goki ine ware jambuŋ‐jopatec mi arec jahec â moc ezejec i!
Irec ʒi mâreŋgao wiserâ rac me! No ʒiŋuc hâcne gazapo: ‘No sâsecguhuc furine garepemu,’ ʒi ine Wofuŋzi mu hezuc egarekacte foocmu.”
Iŋuc mume Bileamzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Kiŋaŋŋicfâcge sorec‐jopatec fâmbiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazapo i:
‘Balake e ficticnao siliwa â gol fusucmarâ fokac i nare tahac eocmuo ine no sifu Wofuŋte dâŋ huckerâ nahacne maŋte wiac biaŋne me sâqocne moc mi epemu. Wofuŋzi dâŋ nazaocmu i sawa mupemu.’
No ʒi ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋerao risiepemu, irec ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe juku ʒâhec ŋicfâcge weniŋuc ejareniŋmu irec dâŋ gazape manac.”
Eme Bileam e jambuŋdâŋ‐ticne ʒuhuckerâ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Bileam no Beorore ŋokâ, no ʒâŋe‐nane bâtâcnekicne.
