No Anuture dâŋ manahuc, Fekicne sâkore mamana biri kâuc mi baekopac. No tâpiri rune ere mu bararuŋ dâŋ hone manac ekopac, no mâreŋko fodapehape maŋʒâŋe‐nane tâcnewec noni hâcne ʒiŋuc mukopac:
Jakoboraonec bâpiŋ moc fuazokac, â Israe kikefuŋkonec ŋicwofuŋ moc fisizokac. E hâcne honezo ekopac, erâ ʒiŋuczia mâcne, e ʒoricko juhame erao ʒâŋe fipe rakac. E fuarâ Moabi ŋic qa imac ejareocmu, â Sefere ɋâricfâc jopa qâtâtiec ejareocmu.
E Edomŋic jaŋere mâreŋ ro rauc eocmu, â Seiri râsifâc‐ticne jaŋe wâc jowac roocmu. Israe ŋic jaŋe ine sanaŋkerâ juniŋmu.
Ŋicwofuŋ e Jakoboraonec fuarâ hae sâkoo soŋkerâ juraniŋmu jaŋe imac‐jopaocmu.”
Bileam e iŋuc murâ Amaleke ŋic honec‐joparâ dâŋticne ʒuhuckerâ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Amaleke ŋiczi, ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere micne erâ jumbiŋ, jaŋe hâcne imac‐jopapie omaenʒoŋgopieŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ Keniŋic honec‐joparâ dâŋticne ʒuhuckerâ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Fic hae‐ŋeŋic sanaŋne ŋerakac, â sareŋ‐ŋeŋic i qânâ faio râe rakicne.
Ehame Kaiŋte qâjâpecfâc ŋoŋe sifu omae‐fâreniŋmu. Manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ mi ʒoraha Asihuru ŋic jaŋe kâpâcwâru bacŋopa raniŋmu.”
Iŋuc murâ dâŋticne ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Jei, Anutuzi wiac i mume fuaha mozi sâcne juocmu?
Kitim mâreŋkonec ine woke wiac fisirâ Asihuru â Ebere ŋic imac‐jopaniŋmu wâc.”
Bileam e iŋuc muhuc faharerâ mâreŋ‐ticnao risiewec; ehame Balake e wâc iŋuc jaha hae‐ticnao risierâ rawec.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Sitim mâreŋko juhuc Moabi ŋic otâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec sasec boe sau gie bambiŋ.
Jaŋe hâcne nemufâc‐jeŋic taha bâzi rike‐jarehuc Israe ŋic hefârec‐jopambiŋ. Eme jaŋe rarâ taha bâzi nâ bac ehuc nemufâc‐jeŋic araŋ bajarembiŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋe iŋuc ehuc Baali‐Peoro nemu erao qohotapie Wofuŋzi jaŋere boc mana gâpârewec.
Ehuc Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go micne bapafâc‐jeŋic rocjoparâ ʒoaŋ ɋaɋacko Wofuŋ nore maio bituac‐jopa‐fâretec aaric‐nane omaezejec.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Mosezi Israe mumutara ŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ru sâc ŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic Baali‐Peoro nemurao qohotambiŋ jaŋe qâhâmoc‐jopanʒepieŋ.”
Eme Israe kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋe tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko kio owa ehuc domahapie Israe ŋic moczi Midiaŋ ŋokac moc Mose â kikefuŋ jaŋere maio e jahacne wiacfâc jaŋerao jowa warewec.
Eme taha bapa Aroŋte ŋokâ Eleaʒa ere ŋokâ Pinehasizi honerâ fahare ŋic ŋokac behec‐joparâ damu moc rowec.
Erâ ŋic ŋokac jahe ficmaŋko fepire mi bâjapec‐jofa ferâ âke hâmoc‐jofazejec i! E iŋuc eme Israe ŋic huc mimicne fua‐jarewec i qaʒue wahawec.
Eme sifu huc mimicnere erâ hâmombiŋ jaŋere ʒare 24 tauseŋ ewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Aroŋte ŋokâ Eleaʒa ere ŋokâ Pinehasi eki nore âkehoc Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko ʒoɋac sâko ehuc jaŋeraonec aaric‐nane bâsuewecte moc mi bâsirowec‐jopapo.
Irec hâcne ʒiŋuc âzâcnezemec: ‘Manakic, no gohec wamare ʒâʒâfic epemu.
Eme go â ɋâricfâcge ŋoŋe ʒâʒâfic irec maŋnao juhuc taha bapa gie barâ barahuc junʒepieŋ. Go Anutuge nore erâ ʒoɋac ehuc Israe ŋic jaŋere kiwiric romeŋte iŋuc fua‐ŋarezejec.’”
Israe ŋic Midiaŋ ŋokac ehec âke hâmoc‐jofakicne ere ʒâŋe Ʒimiri. E Simeoŋte guru irec garikiŋ guru moc jaŋere micne Salu ere ŋokâ.
Midiaŋ ŋokac âke hâmokicne ere ʒâŋe ine Koʒibi. E Midiaŋ ŋicguru irec garikiŋ guru moc jaŋere micne Zuru ere otâ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Midiaŋ ŋic bâʒâic‐jopazemec.
Jaŋe nemuɋâŋ‐jeŋiczi eatuc‐ŋopahuc bâʒâic‐ŋopambiŋ, irec ŋoŋe okacne joparâ ima samaki bacjopanʒepieŋ. Jaŋe hâcne Peoro nemure taha bâzio hefârec‐ŋoparâ otâ seŋjeŋic Koʒibi ŋarehuc eatuc‐ŋopapie sâqorembiŋ. Koʒibi e Midiaŋ ŋicguru irec garikiŋ mocte micne ere otâ. Eme ŋokac e hâcne Peoro nemure erâ huc mimicne fuawec ʒoaŋ ira qâhâmombiŋ.”

Huc mimicnezi qaʒue wahame Wofuŋzi Mose â taha bapa Aroŋte ŋokâ Eleaʒa jahe ʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Ŋohe Israe kikefuŋ sasawa jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac erâ ʒikao rarare sâc eŋgopieŋ jaŋe mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forakac irec sâcko wose qâreŋ ejarezepirec.”
Iŋuc mume Mose â taha bapa Eleaʒa jahe Moabi wâneŋko Jordaŋ opâ heririŋnao Jeriko hae ŋewec ira
ŋic jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fewec jaŋe wose qâreŋ ejarepic. Ine Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko epic hâcne. Israe ŋic kecʒiŋuczi Aigita mâreŋkonec wahambiŋ:
Rubeŋ Israere mârâc motec ere ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec ŋic ʒiŋuczi wahambiŋ hâcne: Hanoki ɋâricfâc‐ticne, Hanoki ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Palu ɋâricfâc‐ticne, Paluŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Hezoroŋ ɋâricfâc‐ticne, Hezoroŋ ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Karami ɋâricfâc‐ticne, Karami ŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Ŋicguru i jaŋe hâcne Rubeŋ kikefuŋ erâ jumbiŋ; ʒare‐jeŋic ine 43 tauseŋ 730.
Palure ŋokâ ine Eliaba.
Eliabare ŋokâfâc ine Nemuele, Dataŋ erâ Abiram. Dataŋ â Abiram jahe hâcne kikefuŋ jaŋere micne bâwosâec‐jofakicnezi Kora kikefuŋko ʒuhuckerâ Mose â Aroŋ râsi ejactehuc Wofuŋ bunao bapic.
Eme mâreŋzi fâuckerâ aŋkekuc Kora â wiacfâcne jaŋehec mâmâc ɋâcjopa‐fâreme ʒoczi ŋic 250 ʒâseŋ‐jopawec. Jahe iŋuc ehuc okacne ropic izi ŋic gâcne jaŋere uŋsawaŋ ewec.
Kora ɋâricfâcne jaŋe ine ʒeŋgoma mi hâmo‐fârembiŋ.
Simeoŋ ŋokâfâcne jaŋere garikiŋfâc kecʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Nemuele ɋâricfâc, Nemuele ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Jamiŋte ɋârifâc, Jamiŋŋic jaŋe hâcne; Jakiŋte ɋâricfâc, Jakiŋŋic jaŋe hâcne;
Ʒerare ɋâricfâc, Ʒeraŋic jaŋe hâcne; Saulire ɋâricfâc, Sauliŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Ŋicguru i jaŋe hâcne Simeoŋte garikiŋ guru sasawa erâ jumbiŋ; ʒare‐jeŋic ine 22 tauseŋ 200.
Gade ŋokâfâcne jaŋere garikiŋfâc kecʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Zefoŋte ɋâricfâc, Zefoŋŋic jaŋe hâcne; Hagire ɋâricfâc, Hagiŋic jaŋe hâcne; Sunire ɋâricfâc, Suniŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Oʒinire ɋâricfâc, Oʒini ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Elire ɋâricfâc, Eliŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Arodore ɋâricfâc, Arodo ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Arelire ɋâricfâc, Areli ŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Ŋicguru i jaŋe hâcne Gadere garikiŋ guru sasawa erâ jumbiŋ; ʒare‐jeŋic ine 40 tauseŋ 500.
Juda ŋokâ jahec‐ticne Ero â Onaŋ jahe Kanaaŋ mâreŋko hâmopic.
Ŋokâfâcne gâcne jaŋere garikiŋfâc ine kecʒiŋuc: Serare ɋâricfâc, Seraŋic jaŋe hâcne; Perezere ɋâricfâc, Pereze ŋic jaŋe hâcne. Zerare ɋâricfâc, Zeraŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Pereze ŋokâfâcne ine ʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Hezoroŋte ɋâricfâc, Hezoroŋ ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Hamulure ɋâricfâc, Hamulu ŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Ŋicguru i jaŋe hâcne Judare garikiŋ guru sasawa; ʒare‐jeŋic ine 76 tauseŋ 500.
Isasa ŋokâfâcne jaŋere garikiŋfâc kecʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Tolare ɋâricfâc, Tolaŋic jaŋe hâcne, Puware ɋâricfâc, Puwaŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Jasubure ɋâricfâc, Jasubu ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Simoroŋte ɋâricfâc, Simoroŋ ŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Ŋicguru i jaŋe hâcne Isasare garikiŋ guru sasawa; ʒare‐jeŋic ine 64 tauseŋ 300.
Sebuloŋte ŋokâfâc jaŋere garikiŋfâc kecʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Seredere ɋâricfâc, Serede ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Eloŋte ɋâricfâc, Eloŋŋic jaŋe hâcne; Jalele ɋâricfâcne, Jalele ŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Ŋicguru i jaŋe hâcne Sebuloŋte garikiŋ guru sasawa; ʒare‐jeŋic ine 60 tauseŋ 500.
Josefe ŋokâ jahec‐ticne Manase â Eferaim.
Manase ŋokâfâcne jaŋere garikiŋfâc ine kecʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Makirire ɋâricfâc, Makiri ŋic jaŋe hâcne, Makiri e ine Gileade ere mamac. Gileadere ɋâricfâc, Gileade ŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Gileade ŋokâfâcne jaŋere garikiŋfâc ine kecʒiŋuc: Jezerare ɋâricfâc, Jezera ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Helekire ɋâricfâc, Heleki ŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Asiriele ɋâricfâcne, Asiriele ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Sekemte ɋâricfâc, Sekemŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Semidare ɋâricfâc, Semida ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Hefere ɋâricfâcne, Hefere ŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Hefere ŋokâ‐ticne Zelofeha e naru sawa jucnembiŋ, ʒâŋe‐jeŋic ine kecʒiŋuc: Mala, Noa, Hogela, Milika erâ Tiriza.
Ŋicguru i jaŋe hâcne Manasere guru sasawa; ʒare‐jeŋic ine 52 tauseŋ 700.
Eferaimte ŋokâfâc jaŋere garikiŋfâc ine kecʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Sutelacte ɋâricfâc, Sutelac ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Bekere ɋâricfâcne, Bekere ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Tahaŋte ɋâricfâc, Tahaŋŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Sutelac ŋokâ‐ticne mocjaha ʒâŋene Eraŋ ere ɋâricfâc, Eraŋŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Ŋicguru i jaŋe Eferaimte ŋokâfâc jaŋere garikiŋ guru sasawa; ʒare‐jeŋic ine 32 tauseŋ 500. Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne Josefe ŋokâfâc‐ticne jaŋere garikiŋfâc.
Benjamiŋte ŋokâfâc jaŋere garikiŋfâc kecʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Belare ɋâricfâc, Belaŋic jaŋe hâcne; Asibelere ɋâricfâc, Asibele ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Ahiramte ɋâricfâc, Ahiram ŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Sefufamte ɋâricfâc, Sefufam ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Hufamte ɋâricfâc, Hufamŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Bela ŋokâ jahec‐ticne ine Arada â Namaŋ. Aradare ɋâricfâc, Arada ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Namaŋte ɋâricfâc, Namaŋŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Ŋicguru i jaŋe hâcne Benjamiŋ ŋokâfâc‐ticne jaŋere garikiŋ guru sasawa; ʒare‐jeŋic ine 45 tauseŋ 600.
Daŋte ŋokâ mocjaha ʒâŋene Suham ere ɋâricfâc i Suhamŋic. Jaŋe hâcne Daŋte garikiŋfâc.
Suhamŋic garikiŋ guru sasawa jaŋere ʒare i 64 tauseŋ 400.
Asere ŋokâfâc jaŋere garikiŋfâc kecʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Iminare ɋâricfâc, Imina ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Isiwire ɋâricfâc, Isiwi ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Beriare ɋâricfâc, Beria ŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Beria ŋokâfâcne jaŋere garikiŋfâc ine kecʒiŋuc: Hebere ɋâricfâcne, Hebere ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Malikiele ɋâricfâcne, Malikiele ŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Ase otâ‐ticnere ʒâŋe ine Sera.
Ŋicguru i jaŋe hâcne Ase ŋokâfâcne jaŋere garikiŋ guru sasawa; ʒare‐jeŋic ine 53 tauseŋ 400.
Naftalire ŋokâfâc jaŋere garikiŋfâc kecʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Jehasire ɋâricfâc, Jehasi ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Gunire ɋâricfâc, Guniŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Jezerare ɋâricfâc, Jezera ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Silemte ɋâricfâc, Silemŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Ŋicguru i jaŋe hâcne Naftalire garikiŋ guru sasawa; ʒare‐jeŋic ine 45 tauseŋ 400.
Israe ŋic wose ɋâreŋ ejarekupie qâqâhâc ʒare‐jeŋic 601 tauseŋ 730 iŋuc fuawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Ŋicguru i jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forakac irec sâcko mâreŋ bâtâc bajarepie ro rauc enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ŋicguru kâcɋene jaŋe mâreŋ kâcɋene jarenʒepieŋ â guru piticne jaŋe mâreŋ piticne jarenʒepieŋ; ine hâcne, ŋic ʒare‐jeŋic fokac irec sâcko mâreŋ bâtâc bajarenʒepieŋ.
Mâreŋ ine ɋâsâi qahuc bâtâc bazo; eme ŋic jaŋe mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere garikiŋ guru ʒâŋe‐jeŋic forakac irec sâcko mâreŋ ro rauc enʒepieŋ.
Ehame ɋâsâi qapie âke fuaocmu sâc mâreŋ i ŋicguru kâcɋene â piticne bâtâc bajarenʒepieŋ.”
Lewiŋic garikiŋfâc‐jeŋic wose qâreŋ ejarekicne jaŋe ine kecʒiŋuc: Geresoŋte ɋâricfâc, Geresoŋ ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Kohatire ɋâricfâc, Kohati ŋic jaŋe hâcne; Merarire ɋâricfâc, Merari ŋic jaŋe hâcne.
Lewire garikiŋfâc ine kecʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Libini garikiŋfâc, Heboroŋ garikiŋfâc, Mali garikiŋfâc, Musi garikiŋfâc, Kohari garikiŋfâc. Kohati eki ine Amaramte mamac.
Amaram ŋonâŋ‐ticnere ʒâŋe ine Jokebede, e hâcne Lewire otâ Aigita mâreŋko fuawec. Ŋokac eki hâcne juku Mose â Aroŋ erâ seŋjekic Miriam rocjopawec.
Aroŋte ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc fuambiŋ: Nadaba, Abihu, Eleaʒa â Itama.
Nadaba â Abihu jahe ine Wofuŋte maio bâzi wâwânâŋhec rikepicte hâmopic.
Eme Lewiŋic mosa‐jeŋic wâŋkonec domarâ fekac jaŋe wosec‐jopakupie ʒare‐jeŋic 23 tauseŋ ewec. Jaŋe Israe ŋic gâcne jaŋere ŋondeŋko mâreŋ moc mi jarekicnere Israe ŋic jaŋehec qâturerâ mi wosec‐jopambiŋ.
Mose â taha bapa Eleaʒa jahe Moabi mâreŋ sawao Jordaŋ opâ heririŋ Jeriko hae ŋewec ira Israe ŋic wose qâreŋ ejarekupire ŋic ʒare‐jeŋic iŋuc hâcne fuawec:
Ehame Mose â taha bapa Aroŋ jahe mârâc jaha Sinai mâreŋ burocnao Israe ŋic wose qâreŋ ejarepic ŋic i jaŋeraonec moczi guru ʒi jaŋere ŋondeŋko moc mi juwec.
Jaŋere hâcne Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Jaŋe mâreŋ burocnao hâmonʒepieŋ.” Jaŋeraonec Jefunere ŋokâ Kalebe â Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua jahe sawa jupic.
Eme Josefere ŋokâ Manase ere ŋokâ Makiri ere ŋokâ Gileade ere ŋokâ Hefere ere ŋokâ Ʒelofeha ere otâfâc jaŋe dâŋ gie baniŋte fisimbiŋ. Jaŋere ʒâŋe ine kecʒiŋuc: Mala, Noa, Hogela, Milika erâ Tiriza.
Jaŋe hâcne tutumaŋ qoruc bozere motâcko Mose â taha bapa Eleaʒa erâ micne bapa â kikefuŋ jaŋere maio fuarâ kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋ:
“Mamac‐nâŋec e mâreŋ burocnao hâmowec, erâ e Kora â ŋicfâc‐ticne Wofuŋ râsi ecnehuc jumbiŋ jaŋere guruo mi juwec, aricne, e ŋokâ tâmiriczi e jahacne kiŋte erâ hâmowec.
Eme e ŋokâ tâmiric juwecte erâ ʒâŋe‐ticne garikiŋfâc‐ticne jaŋerao omaeme sâckeocmu me? Irec mamac‐nâŋecte hahac ɋafâc jaŋere ŋondeŋko mâreŋ moc nârenʒepieŋ wâc.”
Mose e ine dâŋjeŋic i Wofuŋte maio bafisiwec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Ʒelofeha otâfâc‐ticne jaŋe dâŋ muŋgopieŋ i manape sâckekac; irec go mamac‐jeŋicte hahac ɋafâc jaŋere ŋondeŋko mâreŋ moc jaretec ro rauc epie mamac‐jeŋicte mâreŋ izi jaŋere biŋe ezejec.
Ehame Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘Ŋic moc e ŋokâ tâmiric juku hâmome mâreŋ‐ticnezi otâ‐ticnere biŋe ezejec.
Me otâ‐ticne moc mi jume mâreŋ‐ticne i hahac ɋafâcne jarepie jaŋere biŋe ezejec.
Me hahac ɋafâcne moc mi jupie ine mâreŋ‐ticne i mamac piticfâc‐ticne jarepie jaŋere biŋe ezejec.
Me mamac pitifâc‐ticne wâc mi jupie ine mâreŋ‐ticne i tuctofafâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec moc râcnepie ere biŋe ezejec. Dâŋ i Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâc Israe ŋic jaŋere dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc erâ forahuc juzejec.’”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Abarim tikio ferâ, Israe ŋic mâreŋ jare tahac ekopac i honezemec.
Honerâ hahacge Aroŋ e mamacfâc‐ŋekic qâtec‐joparâ bâmowec iŋuc jaha goki qâtec‐joparâ hâmozemec.
Ŋohe hâcne Ziŋ mâreŋ burocnao kikefuŋ jaŋere maio opâ bâfuahuc ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane bâtirinicte mupe qatarapic.” (Meriba â Kadesi opâ i jahe Ziŋ mâreŋ burocnao fokopirec hâcne.)
Eme Mose e Wofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Wofuŋ, go ŋic sasawa jaŋere Anutu juekiczi kikefuŋ jaŋere micne moc rowosâezemec.
Eme eki jowa qataŋ ejarehame ʒikao ranʒepieŋ â ekizia micne bajareha risienʒepieŋ. Ehame Wofuŋ gore kikefuŋ jaŋe lama guru soŋaŋ tâmiric iŋucne mi junʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua e Mâro focnekacte rowosâerâ jambuŋkezemec.
Ehuc ecnetec taha bapa Eleaʒa â kikefuŋ ʒeŋgoma jaŋere maio domaha giere mufiriezemec.
Eme eki gore tuc qarâ tâpirihec eme Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe dâŋticne mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ.
E dameŋ sâc taha bapa Eleaʒa ere maio fuahuc juzejec. Eme Eleaʒazi ere âkehoc domahuc Wofuŋte maio ɋâsâi tirine qazejec. Ehame Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ weniŋuc fuaocmu i manarâ Josua â Israe kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋe hata ranʒepieŋ, erâ wâc risienʒepieŋ.”
Eme Mose e Wofuŋzi dâŋ mutâcnecnewec i renkehuc Josua ecneme eki taha bapa Eleaʒa â kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋere maio ra domawec.
Ehame Mose e Wofuŋzi dâŋ âzâcne mutâc ewec irec sâc ehuc jambuŋkerâ giere mufiriewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc mutâcne‐jarezemec: ‘Nore taha bâzi rikepie âsu biaŋ fuaekac i dameŋ mupaŋkekicnao rike râec enʒepieŋ.’
Erâ ʒiŋuc wâc ʒuhuckerâ jazazemec: Ŋoŋe wiac kecʒiŋuc rorâ Wofuŋte bâzi rikenʒepieŋ: Lama ŋicne biaŋne jajahec jara‐jekic wâŋ ekicne i ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne rikec‐jofahuc junʒepieŋ.
Moc i furicte â moc i owâcne rikenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc taha bâzire wiac kecʒiŋuc wâc ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ: Poroŋ uucne i oto moc irecnec teŋkonec wâŋ rorâ wokemaŋhec bâsifuckenʒepieŋ. Wokemaŋ ine fifia râqâc moc irecnec 4‐onec wâŋ irec sâc ronʒepieŋ.
Taha bâzi iŋucne hâcne ʒoaŋ sâc rikehuc juniŋte Sinai tiki mâreŋko fuŋkerâ rikepie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fua jujec.
Lama mocko ine waiŋ taha bâzi fifia râqâc moc irecnec 4‐onec wâŋ irec sâc ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ, ehuc waiŋ izi Wofuŋte bâzi eocte tirificko hoŋkenʒepieŋ.
Â lama moc ine hae owâeme rikenʒepieŋ, ehuc furicte taha bâzi â waiŋ bâzi rike râec eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha rikepie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec.
“Sabata hombaŋko ira ine lama ŋicne biaŋne jajahec jara‐jekic wâŋ ekicne, erâ poroŋ uucne oto moc irecnec teŋkonec 2 wokemaŋhec bâsifuckekicne, erâ waiŋ taha bâzi i mâmâc râenʒepieŋ.
Sabata hombaŋ sâc wiac iŋuc hâcne ʒoaŋ sâc taha bâzi rikeeŋgopieŋ ira ʒuhuckerâ rike râec enʒepieŋ.
“Mosa fufuŋkenao ira wiac kecʒiŋuc i Wofuŋte bâzi rikenʒepieŋ: Bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne jajahec, lama sokakicne ŋicne moc erâ lama ŋicnezi motecne 7 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne.
Erâ bulimakao rikeniŋmu sâc ira taha bâzire biŋe poroŋ uucne oto moc irecnec teŋkonec 3 wokemaŋhec bâsifuckekicne i mâmâc râezo. Ehuc lama ŋicne ira taha bâzire biŋe wiac kecʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ râezo: Poroŋ uucne oto moc irecnec teŋkonec 2 wokemaŋhec bâsifuckekicne.
Erâ lama sasawa jaŋerao taha bâzire biŋe poroŋ uucne oto moc irecnec teŋkonec wâŋ wokemaŋhec bâsifuckekicne râenʒepieŋ. Wiac i sasawa rikepie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec.
Waiŋ taha bâzi ine kecʒiŋuc râenʒepieŋ: Bulimakao mocte sâc ine fifia râqâc moc irec nâfocne, lama ŋicnere sâc ine fifia râqâc moc irecnec 3‐onec wâŋ â lama motecnere ine fifia râqâc moc irecnec 4‐onec wâŋ. Jara mocte maŋnao mosa sâc taha bâzi wiac iŋuc hâcne râehuc junʒepieŋ.
Ehuc sâqocne tâtâmire bâzire biŋe noniŋ ŋicne moc Wofuŋ rikecnenʒepieŋ, noniŋ i taha bâzi â waiŋ bâzi rike râec eeŋgopieŋ ira hâcne ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ.
“Mosa wâŋ irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 14 ira Wofuŋte aakic hombaŋ ŋenʒepieŋ.
Erâ mosa irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 15 ira ine tiwâ bâzi hombaŋ fuazejec. Ira hâcne fuŋkerâ poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric nâhuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
Ʒoaŋ namba wâŋ ira tiri bozeo tumaŋnehuc gie moc mi banʒepieŋ.
Ehuc Wofuŋ qowi bâzi kecʒiŋuc rikecnenʒepieŋ: Bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne jajahec, erâ lama ŋicne sokakicne moc, erâ lama ŋicnezi motecne 7 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne, erâ qowi râeniŋmu i qowi biaŋne sasawa râe‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc qowi i jaŋerao taha bâzire biŋe poroŋ uucne waiŋhec bâsifuckekicne kecʒiŋuc râenʒepieŋ: Bulimakao moc ira oto moc irecnec teŋkonec 3 ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ. Lama ŋicne moc ira oto moc irecnec teŋkonec 2,
â lama motecne 7 ru sâc jaŋerao ine oto moc irecnec teŋkonec wâŋ ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ.
Erâ kiwiric‐ŋeŋic roniŋte sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe noniŋ ŋicne moc rikenʒepieŋ wâc.
Furic sâc qowi bâzi rikehuc jueŋgopieŋ ira ʒuhuckerâ wiac i hâcne rike râec enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 ira iŋuc hâcne ehuc taha bâzi wiac rikepie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec. Wiac i ʒoaŋ sâc taha bâzi â waiŋ bâzi rike râec eeŋgopieŋ ira hâcne ʒuhuckerâ rikenʒepieŋ.
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 ira ine tiri bozeo tumaŋnehuc gie wiac moc mi banʒepieŋ.
“Mâc nânâ bâbâsu ʒoaŋ ira ŋoŋe padi wiac nâsuniŋmu â woka irec maŋnao Wofuŋ taha bâzi rikecnehuc irec hombaŋ ŋeniŋmu ira tiri bozeo tumaŋnenʒepieŋ. Ehuc gie wiac moc mi banʒepieŋ.
Mâc qowi bâzi kecʒiŋuc rikepie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec: Bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne jajahec, â lama ŋicne sokakicne moc, erâ lama ŋicnezi motecne 7 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne.
Ehuc qowi i jaŋerao taha bâzire poroŋ uucne waiŋhec bâsifuckekicne kecʒiŋuc râenʒepieŋ: Bulimakao buc buc ira oto moc irecnec teŋkonec 3 ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ. Lama ŋicne moc ira oto moc irecnec teŋkonec 2
â lama motecne 7 ru sâc jaŋerao oto moc irecnec teŋkonec wâŋ ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ.
Erâ kiwiric‐ŋeŋic roniŋte ine noniŋ ŋicne moc rikenʒepieŋ wâc.
Ʒoaŋ sâc qowi bâzi â taha bâzi gâcne rike râec eeŋgopieŋ ira wiac i â waiŋ taha bâzi ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ. Erâ qowi râeniŋmu i qowi biaŋne sasawa râe‐fârenʒepieŋ.
“Mosa 7 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa wâŋ ira tiri bozeo tumaŋnehuc gie wiac moc mi banʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ ira hâcne qeŋ qahuc domanʒepieŋ.
Ehuc qowi bâzi wiac kecʒiŋuc rikepie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec: Bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne moc â lama ŋicne sokakicne moc erâ lama ŋicnezi motecne biaŋne 7 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne.
Ehuc qowi i jaŋerao taha bâzire poroŋ uucne wokemaŋhec bâsifuckekicne kecʒiŋuc râenʒepieŋ: Bulimakao ira oto moc irecnec teŋkonec 3 ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ. Lama ŋicne ira oto moc irecnec teŋkonec 2
â lama motecne 7 ru sâc jaŋerao oto moc irecnec teŋkonec wâŋ ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ.
Erâ kiwiric‐ŋeŋic roniŋte sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe noniŋ ŋicne moc rikenʒepieŋ wâc.
Mosare qowi bâzi â taha bâzi‐ticne gâcne, â ʒoaŋ sâc irec qowi bâzi â taha bâzi‐ticne erâ waiŋ taha bâzi rike râec eniŋte mutâcne‐jarekicne ijaha wiac i wâc ʒuhuckerâ rikepie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec.
“Mosa 7 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 10 ira sowa juhuc tiri bozeo tumaŋnenʒepieŋ, ehuc ʒoaŋ ira gie wiac moc mi banʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ira qowi bâzi wiac kecʒiŋuc rikepie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec: Bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne moc â lama ŋicne sokakicne moc erâ lama ŋicnezi motecne 7 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne. Qowi râec‐jopaniŋmu jaŋe biaŋne sasawa râec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ehuc qowi jaŋerao taha bâzire poroŋ uucne wokemaŋhec bâsifuckekicne kecʒiŋuc râenʒepieŋ: Bulimakao ira oto moc irecnec teŋkonec 3 ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ. Lama ŋicne ira oto moc irecnec teŋkonec 2
erâ lama motecne 7 ru sâc jaŋerao oto moc irecnec teŋkonec wâŋ ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ.
Erâ kiwiric rorore sâqocne tâtâmire taha â ʒoaŋ sâc irec qowi bâzi â taha bâzi‐ticne erâ waiŋ taha bâzi rike râec eeŋgopieŋ ijaha noniŋ ŋicne moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ wâc.
“Mosa 7 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 15 ira gie moc mi bahuc tiri bozeo tumaŋnenʒepieŋ, erâ Wofuŋte erâ hombaŋ ŋehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ 7 tarazejec.
Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ ira qowi bâzi wiac kecʒiŋuc rikepie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec: Bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne 13 â lama ŋicne sokakicne 2 erâ lama ŋicnezi motecne 14 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne. Jaŋe biaŋne sasawa râec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ehuc qowi jaŋere taha bâzire poroŋ uucne wokemaŋhec bâsifuckekicne kecʒiŋuc râenʒepieŋ: Bulimakao ru sâc ira oto moc irecnec teŋkonec 3 ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ. Lama ŋicne 2 ru sâc ira oto moc irecnec teŋkonec 2
erâ lama motecne 14 ru sâc ira oto moc irecnec teŋkonec wâŋ ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ʒoaŋ sâc qowi bâzi â taha bâzi‐ticne gâcne erâ waiŋ taha bâzi rike râec eeŋgopieŋ ijaha noniŋ ŋicne moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ wâc.
“Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 2 ira ine bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne 12 â lama ŋicne sokakicne 2 erâ lama ŋicnezi motecne biaŋne 14 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne rike râec enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc bulimakao mecne, lama ŋicne mecne, â lama motecne ʒare‐jeŋic manasuhuc taha bâzire poroŋ uucne â waiŋ taha bâzi mukicne irec sâc ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ʒoaŋ sâc qowi bâzi â taha bâzi‐ticne gâcne erâ waiŋ taha bâzi rike râec eeŋgopieŋ ijaha noniŋ ŋicne moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ wâc.
“Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 3 ira bulimakao 11 â lama ŋicne sokakicne 2 erâ lama ŋicnezi motecne biaŋne 14 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne i rike râec enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc bulimakao mecne, lama ŋicne mecne, â lama motecne ʒare‐jeŋic manasuhuc taha bâzire poroŋ uucne â waiŋ taha bâzi mukicne irec sâc ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ʒoaŋ sâc qowi bâzi â taha bâzi‐ticne gâcne erâ waiŋ taha bâzi rike râec eeŋgopieŋ ijaha noniŋ ŋicne moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ wâc.
“Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 4 ira bulimakao 10 â lama ŋicne sokakicne 2 erâ lama ŋicnezi motecne biaŋne 14 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne rike râec enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc bulimakao mecne, lama ŋicne mecne â lama motecne ʒare‐jeŋic manasuhuc taha bâzire poroŋ uucne â waiŋ taha bâzi mukicne irec sâc ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ʒoaŋ sâc qowi bâzi â taha bâzi‐ticne gâcne erâ waiŋ taha bâzi rike râec eeŋgopieŋ ijaha noniŋ ŋicne moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ wâc.
“Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 5 ira bulimakao 9 â lama ŋicne sokakicne 2 erâ lama ŋicnezi motecne biaŋne 14 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne i rike râec enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc bulimakao mecne, lama ŋicne mecne, erâ lama motecne ʒare‐jeŋic manasuhuc taha bâzire poroŋ uucne â waiŋ taha bâzi mukicne irec sâc ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ʒoaŋ sâc qowi bâzi â taha bâzi‐ticne gâcne erâ waiŋ taha bâzi rike râec eeŋgopieŋ ijaha noniŋ ŋicne moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ wâc.
“Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 ira bulimakao 8 â lama ŋicne sokakicne 2 erâ lama ŋicnezi motecne biaŋne 14 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne i rike râec enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc bulimakao mecne, lama ŋicne mecne â lama motecne ʒare‐jeŋic manasuhuc taha bâzire poroŋ uucne â waiŋ taha bâzi mukicne irec sâc ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ʒoaŋ sâc qowi bâzi â taha bâzi‐ticne gâcne erâ waiŋ taha bâzi rike râec eeŋgopieŋ ijaha noniŋ ŋicne moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ wâc.
“Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 ira bulimakao 7 â lama ŋicne sokakicne 2 erâ lama ŋicnezi motecne biaŋne 14 jara‐jeŋic wâŋ ekicne i rike râec enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc bulimakao mecne, lama ŋicne mecne â lama motecne ʒare‐jeŋic manasuhuc taha bâzire poroŋ uucne â waiŋ taha bâzi mukicne irec sâc ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ʒoaŋ sâc qowi bâzi â taha bâzi‐ticne gâcne erâ waiŋ taha bâzi rike râec eeŋgopieŋ ijaha noniŋ ŋicne moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ wâc.
“Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 8 ira gie i me i moc mi bahuc tiri bozeoa tumaŋnenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ine qowi taha bâzi kecʒiŋuc rikepie Wofuŋte maio âsu biaŋ fuazejec: Bulimakao moc â lama ŋicne sokakicne moc erâ lama ŋicnezi motecne biaŋne 7.
Ehuc bulimakao mecne, lama ŋicne mecne â lama motecne ʒare‐jeŋic manasuhuc taha bâzire poroŋ uucne â waiŋ taha bâzi mukicne irec sâc ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ʒoaŋ sâc qowi bâzi â taha bâzi‐ticne gâcne erâ waiŋ taha bâzi rike râec eeŋgopieŋ ijaha noniŋ ŋicne moc sâqocne tâtâmire tahare biŋe ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ wâc.
“Bâzi wiac iŋuc hâcne hombaŋ‐ŋeŋic mupaŋkekicnao Wofuŋ rikecnenʒepieŋ. Erâ i qowi bâzi mecne, taha bâzi mecne, waiŋ bâzi mecne, erâ wama bâzi mumupaŋ‐ŋeŋicte erâ me buafec faio rike râec eniŋmu ira hâcne ʒuhuckerâ râenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Mose e Wofuŋzi dâŋ mutâcnecnewec i Israe ŋic ŋokac jaza‐fârewec.
Mose e Israe ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere micnefâc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mutâcnewec:
Ŋic moczi Wofuŋte maio dâŋ moc mupaŋkeocmu me wiac irec me irec sowa juocte Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo iticnehuc dâŋ mupaŋkeocmu e mumupaŋ dâŋticne moc mi huckehuc micticnaonec dâŋ wahawec irec sâc fârine bâfua‐fârezejec.
Me naru ŋokac socɋâri moczi mamac‐ticnere ficko juhuc Wofuŋte maio dâŋ moc mupaŋkeocmu, me wiac irec me irec sowa juocte mumupaŋ dâŋ moc muocmu mecne.
Ehame mamac‐ticnezi mumupaŋ dâŋ i manarâ moc mi qataracneocmuo ine naru mumupaŋ dâŋticne i sanaŋkezejec, â sowa jujure dâŋ mufârewec i wâc deŋkezejec.
Me mamac‐ticnezi mumupaŋ dâŋticne manarâ ʒoaŋ ijaha qataracneocmuo ine mumupaŋ dâŋticne mecne â sowa jujure dâŋ muwec i mâmâc fâri tâmiric ezejec. Ehame mamac‐ticnezi qataracnewecte Wofuŋzi wâc kiŋticne beheocmu.
Me mumupaŋ dâŋticne â wiac irec me irec sowa juocte mi mana tarahuc mumupaŋ dâŋ muwec i foha ŋic baocmu mecne.
Eme ŋowe‐ticnezi mumupaŋ dâŋ i manarâ ʒoaŋ ijaha mi qataracneocmuo ine ŋokacte mumupaŋ dâŋ â sowa jujure dâŋ mupaŋkewec i sanaŋkezejec.
Me ŋowe‐ticne e mumupaŋ dâŋ i manarâ ʒoaŋ ijaha qataracneocmuo ine mumupaŋ dâŋticne mecne â sowa jujure dâŋ mi mana tarahuc muwec i mâmâc fâri tâmiric ezejec. Ehame Wofuŋzi wâc kiŋticne beheocmu.
Me ŋokac hozecte me ŋokac ʒuhuc bâtâc ekicne i jahere mumupaŋ dâŋ moc me moc izi ine sanaŋkezejec.
Me ŋokac neŋgocne moczi ŋowe‐ticnere ficko juhuc mumupaŋ dâŋ moc muocmu me wiac irec me irec sowa jujure dâŋ muha
ŋowe‐ticnezi manarâ dâŋ moc mi mucnehuc qataracneocmuo ine mumupaŋ dâŋticne mecne â sowa jujure dâŋ mupaŋkewec i sanaŋke‐fârezejec.
Me ŋowe‐ticne e manarâ ʒoaŋ ijaha mumupaŋ dâŋ i fârimâc ekac muocmuo ine mumupaŋ dâŋ i mecne â sowa jujure dâŋ mupaŋkewec izi mâmâc fâri tâmiric ezejec. Ŋowe‐ticnezi mana suawecte Wofuŋzi wâc kiŋticne beheocmu.
Ŋic moc e ŋonâŋ‐ticnere mumupaŋ dâŋ me sowa jujure dâŋ basanaŋkezo murâ basanaŋkezejec â qâsuazo murâ qâsuazejec.
Me ŋic e ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne irec dâŋ moc mi muhuc ŋonâŋ‐ticnere mumupaŋ dâŋ â sowa jujure dâŋ sasawa mupaŋkewec i basanaŋkeocmu. E mumupaŋ dâŋ i manarâ ʒoaŋ ijaha dâŋ moc mi muwecte basanaŋkekac hâcne.
Mâc mumupaŋ dâŋ manarâ irec faicnao qâsuaocmuo ine ŋonâŋ‐ticnere kiŋ i e jahac âsickeocmu.”
Wofuŋ e ŋowe ŋonâŋ erâ mamac â naru‐ticne socɋâri ehec juekac jaŋere dâŋsanaŋ iŋuc hâcne Mose mutâcnecnewec.
Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic jaŋere erâ Midiaŋ ŋic okacne bazu‐jarehuc mamacfâcge qâtec‐joparâ hâmozemec.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Mosezi ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋickonec ŋic baʒawiec‐jopapie ʒikao ranʒepieŋ, ehuc Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo Midiaŋ ŋic okacne bazu‐jarenʒepieŋ.
Israe ŋic guru sâc irecnec ŋic wâŋ tauseŋ iŋuc rocjopapie ʒikao ranʒepieŋ.”
Eme jaŋe iŋuc ehuc Israe ŋic guru sâc irecnec wâŋ tauseŋ wâŋ tauseŋ rocjopakupie ʒikao rarare biŋe ŋic 12 tauseŋ embiŋ.
Eme Mose e ŋic i jaŋe hâcne ʒikao sorec‐jopame rambiŋ, ehame taha bapa Eleaʒare ŋokâ Pinehasi eki furuficte râqâc wiac â qeŋ rome mâmâc rambiŋ.
Erâ Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâc Midiaŋ ŋic joparâ jopa miziembiŋ.
Ehuc Midiaŋ ŋicwofuŋ 5 kecʒiŋuc jaŋe mâmâc jopambiŋ: Ewi, Rekem, Zuru, Huru â Reba. Erâ Beoro ŋokâ‐ticne Bileam e wâc qâhâmombiŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Midiaŋ ŋokac â naru motecfâc‐jeŋic kâpâcwâru bacjopambiŋ, ehuc lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic â mafa wiac‐jeŋic sasawa mateŋ‐jeŋic eocte rofârembiŋ.
Ehuc fic hae ŋerawec â teuŋ âterâ ŋeŋe juju embiŋ i rikepie ʒafârewec.
Eme mafa mateŋ mecne, ŋic mecne â lama bulimakao i mâmâc rocjopambiŋ.
Rocjoparâ Mose â taha bapa Eleaʒa erâ Israe kikefuŋ Moabi wâneŋko Jordaŋ opâ heririŋnao Jeriko hae ŋewec ira ŋec juc embiŋ jaŋerao bacjopa rambiŋ.
Eme Mose â taha bapa Eleaʒa erâ kikefuŋte micnefâc sasawa jaŋe teuŋ râpenao bâfuac‐jopaniŋte hurâ rambiŋ.
Mose e ine momori ŋic micnefâc‐jeŋic, tauseŋ guru â 100 guru jaŋere micnefâc hâcne ʒikaonec risiembiŋ jaŋere boc aaricke sâqorewec.
Ehame ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ŋokac sasawa akic‐jopambiŋ me?
Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋokac jaŋe hâcne Bileamte dâŋ reŋkehuc Israe ŋic eatuc‐jopapie Peoro nemurao qohotahuc Wofuŋ râpeckembiŋte kikefuŋ ŋondeŋko huc mimicne fuawec.
Irec ŋoŋe motecfâc‐jeŋic â ŋokac ŋichec jukicne sasawa jaŋe qâhâmoc‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ŋokac naru mesawane jaŋe ine akic‐jopapie ŋaŋacne biŋe junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe teuŋ râpenao juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec. Ehame ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ ŋoŋe mecne, me ʒikao hâmokicne ba bâuac ejarembiŋ ŋoŋe mâmâc ʒoaŋ gie bapa 3 â 7 ira ŋaŋacne â kâpâcwâru ŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere sahac ʒure ɋaɋackenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ŋaqi wiac‐ŋeŋic sasawa â wiac qowi sahaczi me noniŋ kanʒaŋnezi bakicne sasawa erâ wiac jâczi bakicne sasawa i ʒurepie ɋaɋacke‐fârezejec.”
Eme taha bapa Eleaʒa e momori ŋic ʒikaonec risiembiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wofuŋzi Mose sâcmutâc dâŋte dâŋsanaŋ âzâcne mutâc ewec i kecʒiŋuc:
Ŋoŋe gol, siliwa, aeŋ bâbâroŋ, aeŋ, wapa, led,
erâ wiac sanaŋne sasawa ʒocko rikepie mi ʒâtâcneekac i hâcne ʒocko râepie ʒame ɋaɋackezejec. Ehame sâqocne tâtâmire opâzi wâc ʒurenʒepieŋ; erâ wiac gâcne sasawa ʒocko ririkenere sâc mi eekac i opâzi ʒure‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 ira hâcne ŋaqi wiac‐ŋeŋic ʒurerâ ɋaɋackenʒepieŋ; iŋuc efârerâ teuŋko wefunʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go â taha bapa Eleaʒa erâ garikiŋne garikiŋne irec micnefâc ŋoŋe mafa mateŋ wiac ŋic me qowi i wosec‐jopafârenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc kâdoc qapie guru jajahec eme guru moc i momori ŋic ʒikao rambiŋ jaŋere biŋe eha guru moc ine kikefuŋ jaŋere biŋe ezejec.
Ehame momori ŋic wiac jarekicne irecnec Wofuŋte biŋe kecʒiŋuc râenʒepieŋ: Ŋic me bulimakao me doŋgi me noniŋ â lama 500 gurune gurune juraŋgopieŋ irecnec moc moc rocjopanʒepieŋ.
Rocjoparâ taha bapa Eleaʒa râcnepie eki Wofuŋte biŋe qazejec.
Erâ Israe kikefuŋ mafa mateŋ jarekicne irecnec ine wiac kecʒiŋuc ronʒepieŋ: Ŋic me bulimakao me doŋgi me noniŋ â lama 50 gurune gurune juraŋgopieŋ irecnec moc moc rocjopanʒepieŋ. Rocjoparâ Lewiŋic Wofuŋte tiri boze hone soŋaŋ eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe jarenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Mose â Eleaʒa jahe Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcne mutâc ewec irec sâc efârepic.
Eme momori ŋic jaŋe mafa mateŋ wiac rombiŋ irec nâfocne kecʒiŋuc bafisimbiŋ: Lama 675 tauseŋ,
bulimakao 72 tauseŋ,
doŋgi 61 tauseŋ,
â naru ŋokac mesawane ine 32 tauseŋ.
Eme kâdoc qapie tucne kecʒiŋuc i momori ŋic ʒikao rambiŋ jaŋere biŋe ewec: Lama 337 tauseŋ 500.
Irecnec ine Wofuŋte biŋe 675 bâwosâec‐jopambiŋ.
Bulimakao 36 tauseŋ. Eme irecnec Wofuŋte biŋe qambiŋ ine 72.
Doŋgi 30 tauseŋ 500 jarekicne, eme irecnec 61 Wofuŋte biŋe râec‐jopambiŋ.
Naru ŋokac mesawane 16 tauseŋ, eme jaŋeraonec Wofuŋte biŋe 32 bâwosâec‐jopambiŋ.
Ehame Mose e Wofuŋzi âzâcne mutâc ewec irec sâc ehuc wiac Wofuŋte biŋe qakicne sasawa i taha bapa Eleaʒa râcne‐fârewec.
Mafa mateŋ wiac bafisimbiŋ i Mosezi bâfâuckeme momori ŋic jaŋere guru moc ewec â Israe ŋic ŋokac sâko jaŋere moc ewec.
Kikefuŋ jaŋere biŋezi ine kecʒiŋuc fuawec: Lama 337 tauseŋ 500.
bulimakao 36 tauseŋ,
doŋgi 30 tauseŋ 500,
â naru ŋokac ine 16 tauseŋ.
Eme Mose e Israe ŋic jaŋere biŋe kâdoc qakicne irec ŋic me qowi 50 gurune gurune jurambiŋ irecnec moc moc rocjoparâ Lewiŋic Wofuŋte tiri boze hone soŋaŋ ejumbieŋ jaŋe jarewec. Wofuŋzi mutâcnecnewec irec sâc ewec hâcne.
Eme momori ŋic tauseŋne tauseŋne jaŋere micnefâc, tauseŋ gurune gurune â 100 gurune gurune jaŋere micnefâc hâcne, jaŋe Moserao fuarâ
ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋe momori ŋic wahakicnefâc‐nâŋec wosec‐jopapene furu jaha jufâreŋgopieŋ.
Nâŋe Wofuŋte biŋe tahare wiac i kecʒiŋuc bâfuarâ Wofuŋte maio kiwiric‐nâŋec ronaŋte bafisimbeneŋ: Wiac gâcne golzi bakicne, erâ maŋguc â qoqonaŋ wiac, meo fefe maqâreŋhec, hazec sarasa â kubu wiac.”
Eme Mose â taha bapa Eleaʒa jahe jaŋere meonec eri wiac golzi bakicne i ropic.
Tauseŋ gurune gurune â 100 gurune gurune micnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe Wofuŋ taha bacneniŋte gol bafisimbiŋ irec ŋemâc i 16 tauseŋ 750 ewec.
(Momori ŋic omane jaŋe ine mafa mateŋ wiac jaŋe jaŋacne biŋe sawa rombiŋ.)
Eme Mose â taha bapa Eleaʒa jahe tauseŋ gurune gurune â 100 gurune gurune micnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere meonec gol i rorâ tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo bafepic. I Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic jaŋere manasuhuc juocte iŋuc epic.
Rubeŋ â Gade jahere ɋâricfâc jaŋere bulimakao guru sâko jumbiŋ. Ehame jaŋe Jazere â Gileade mâreŋ honepie bulimakao jaŋe jujunere sâc ewec.
Jaŋe iŋuc honerâ Mose â taha bapa Eleaʒa erâ kikefuŋ jaŋerao fisirâ ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ:
“Ataroti, Diboŋ, Jazere, Nimira, Hesiboŋ, Eleale, Sebem, Nebo â Beoŋ mâreŋ
i bulimakao jaŋe jujunere sâc jâmbâŋ; mâreŋ i hâcne Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic nâŋâcne maio ima bawec. Kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic nâŋe ine bulimakaofâc‐nâŋec bocjaha.”
Jaŋe iŋuc murâ ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋoŋe nâŋere manapie sâckekacko ine mâreŋ muŋgopeneŋ i kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic nâŋe nârepie ro rauc erâ Jordaŋ ocniŋucnao mi ranʒepeneŋ.”
Iŋuc mupie Mosezi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Hâc, ŋoŋe qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic ʒikao buc rahapie ʒira ŋezo muŋgopieŋ me?
Ŋoŋe wemocte Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic mâreŋ jarezo mukac i ocniŋucnao raʒirâ mi roniŋte mu bawahac ejareŋgopieŋ?
Mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mâreŋ hone tâcneniŋte Kadesi‐Baranea haeonec sorec‐jopape mâsi ijaha embiŋ.
Jaŋe Esikola wâneŋko ferâ mâreŋ honehuc, ine Wofuŋzi mâreŋ jareocte muwec ira Israe ŋic jaŋe mi raniŋte mu bawahac ejarembiŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ e ʒoaŋ ira aaricke sâqoreme dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mupaŋkewec:
‘Aigita mâreŋkonec wahambiŋ, jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac, ŋic i jaŋeraonec moczi moc Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo mâreŋ jarepemurâ mupaŋkepo ira moc mi raʒi‐jâmbâŋkezejec; jaŋe norao mi qohota sanaŋkembiŋ irec.
Mâc Keniʒi ŋic Jefune ere ŋokâ Kalebe â Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua jahe sawa norao qohota sanaŋkepicte raʒinicmu.’
Eme Wofuŋ e Israe ŋic jaŋere aaricke sâqoreha ejareme mâreŋ burocnao juhapie jara 40 tarame Wofuŋte maio hehesic bâfuambiŋ ŋic i jaŋe hâmo sipiric efârembiŋ.
Erâ manaŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe ŋicguru sâqoc qaqocnezi mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere âkehoc Wofuŋ maŋbâiŋ ecnepie Israe ŋic jaŋere mocwâc aaricke sâqore‐jâmbâŋkeocte faharembiŋ.
Ŋoŋe e râpeckehuc mi bâjâpeniŋmuo ine Israe ŋic jaŋe ejareme mâreŋ burocnao jaha ʒuhuckerâ juku hâmo sipiric efâreniŋmu hâcne.”
Iŋuc jazame jaŋe maŋfuŋnao rarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Naŋe mâreŋ ʒira lama bulimakaofâc‐nâŋec jaŋere sapa bahuc ŋokac naru motecfâc‐nâŋec jaŋere fic hae sawa banaŋmu.
Ŋic nâŋe nâŋâc ine sându maro rorâ Israe ŋic bânie‐jarehuc, mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋmu ira râec‐jopahapene ŋokac naru motecfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mâreŋ rune jaŋere erâ hae basanaŋkekicnao ŋenʒepieŋ.
Nâŋe hae mâreŋ‐nâŋecko mi risiehapene Israe ŋic jaŋe ru sâc merâfâc mâreŋ‐jeŋic rauckenʒepieŋ.
Nâŋere merâfâc mâreŋ i Jordaŋ opâ ʒiŋucnao ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec fokacte mâreŋ Jordaŋ ocniŋucnao me ʒuhuckerâ forakac i ro rauc mi enaŋmu.”
Jaŋe Mose iŋuc âzâcnepie kecʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe iŋuc ejâmbâŋkehuc Wofuŋte maio ʒikare ʒawieniŋmu
erâ ʒikare ʒawiekicne sasawa ŋoŋe Wofuŋte maio Jordaŋ fotâcnerâ râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jopa jâpec ejarehuc
mâreŋ‐jeŋic jowac roniŋmuo ine risierâ Wofuŋte maio me Israe ŋic jaŋere maio kiŋ tâmiric eniŋmu, ehuc Wofuŋte maio mâreŋ ʒi ro rauc epie ŋoŋere biŋe ezejec.
Iŋuc mi eniŋmuo ine Wofuŋ bunao bahuc sâqocne bâfuapie sâqocnere okacne fua‐ŋare‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.
Irec ʒi naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere fic hae mecne â lamafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere sapa i mâmâc baniŋ, ehuc dâŋ mupaŋkembiŋ irec fârine wâc bâfuaniŋ.”
Eme Rubeŋ â Gade jahere ɋâricfâc jaŋe Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋe dâŋ nâzâ mutâc ekomec irec sâc enaŋmu hâcne.
Ŋokac naru motecfâc‐nâŋec mecne â lama bulimakaofâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mâmâc Gileade mâreŋko hae ŋerakac ira ŋec juc efârenʒepieŋ.
Kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋe ine ʒeŋgoma sându maro rorâ Wofuŋte maio opâ fotâcnerâ ʒikao ranaŋmu. Bomboŋ‐nâŋec goki dâŋ mutâcne‐nârekomec irec sâc enaŋmu hâcne.”
Iŋuc mupie Mosezi jaŋere erâ taha bapa Eleaʒa â Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua erâ Israe ŋic gurune gurune garikiŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere micnefâc mumutâc dâŋ jaza mutâc ewec.
Ehuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Gade â Rubeŋ jahere ɋâricfâc jaŋe ru sâc Wofuŋte maio ʒikare ʒawierâ ŋoŋehec Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ bânie‐ŋarehuc mâreŋ getâckepie ŋoŋere biŋe eha Gileade mâreŋ jarepie ro rauc enʒepieŋ.
Me ŋoŋehec ʒikao rahuc opâ mi fotâcneniŋmuo ine ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko Kanaaŋ mâreŋ gâcne ro rauc enʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Gade â Rubeŋ jahere ɋâricfâc jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ: “Wofuŋzi kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋe dâŋ nâza mutâc ewec irec sâc enʒepeneŋ.
Nâŋe sându maro rorâ Wofuŋte maio opâ fotâcnerâ Kanaaŋ mâreŋko raʒinʒepeneŋ, ehame merâfâc mâreŋ‐nâŋeczi ine Jordaŋ opâ ʒiŋucnao fozejec.”
Eme Mose e Amori ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ â Basaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Ogo jahere uucmaŋ irec maŋnao hae mâreŋ forawec i Gade â Rubeŋ jahere ɋâricfâc erâ Josefere ŋokâ Manase ere ɋâricfâc dâkâne jaŋe jare‐fârewec.
Eme Gadere ɋâricfâc jaŋe hae kecʒiŋuc barambiŋ: Diboŋ, Ataroti, Aroe,
Ataroti‐Sofaŋ, Jazere, Jobeha,
Bete‐Nimira erâ Bete‐Haraŋ. Hae i hae sanaŋne â lamafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sapa hâcne.
Rubeŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe ine hae kecʒiŋuc barambiŋ: Hesiboŋ, Eleale, Kiriataim,
Nebo, Baali‐Meoŋ (hae i jaŋere ʒâŋe moc mukicne) erâ Sibema. Hae barambiŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe iŋuc hâcne mumbiŋ.
Manasere ŋokâ Makiri ere ɋâricfâc jaŋe Gileade mâreŋ ro rauc ehuc Amori ŋic mâreŋ rune jopa jâpec ejarembiŋ.
Ehame Mose e Gileade hae mâreŋ Manasere ŋokâ Makiri ere ɋâricfâc jareme jaŋe ira ŋec juc embiŋ.
Eme Manasere ŋokâ moc ʒâŋene Jairi ere ɋâricfâc jaŋe ine Amori ŋic jaŋere hae boze wiac gâcne ro rauc ehuc ʒâŋe‐jeŋic Jairi ere hae boze iŋuc mumbiŋ.
Erâ Nobare garikiŋfâc jaŋe ine rarâ Kenati hae sâko â hae piticfâc‐ticne ro rauc ehuc ʒâŋene Noba jaha mumbiŋ.
Israe ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe Mose â Aroŋ jahe micne bajarehapire Aigita mâreŋkonec waha rahuc teuŋ‐jeŋic sâc ju fofo rambiŋ irec ʒâŋe biri ʒira fua rakac.
Mose e Wofuŋte micte teuŋ fisimbiŋ sâc irec ʒâŋe biri i qâreŋke‐fârewec. Erâ hata fuŋkerâ rahuc teuŋ sâc fisi rambiŋ irec ʒâŋe biri ʒine hâcne.
Israe ŋic jaŋe mosa namba wâŋ irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 15 ira Ramasesi mâreŋ beherâ rambiŋ. Ine aakic hombaŋ tarame Aigita ŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe faio rambiŋ hâcne.
Aigita ŋic jaŋe mârâc motecfâc‐jeŋic Wofuŋzi qâhâmoc‐jopawec jaŋe ducjopahuc domahapie iŋuc embiŋ. Wofuŋ e iŋuc ejarehuc nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋere fuŋne bataniŋkewec wâc.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Ramasesi beherâ raku Sukoti ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Sukoti beherâ raku ine Etam mâreŋ burocnere qaŋeŋnao fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Etam mâreŋ beherâ risie raku Baali‐Ʒefoŋ ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec Pi‐Hahiroti hae ŋewec ira fisimbiŋ, ehuc Migidoli ficsanaŋ maickerâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Pi‐Hahiroti beherâ Hâwec Bâbâroŋ fotâcnerâ raku Etam mâreŋ burocnao rahuc juhapie ʒoaŋ jahec â moc tarame Mara opâ ʒâkâŋko fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Mara beherâ raku Elim hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ. Elim ira ine opâ ʒâŋe 12 forawec erâ hâmu jâcne 70 doma rawec.
Elim beherâ raku Hâwec Bâbâroŋ qaŋeŋnao teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Hâwec Bâbâroŋ beherâ raku Siŋ mâreŋ burocnao fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Siŋ mâreŋ burocne beherâ Dofaka hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Dofaka beherâ raku Alusi hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Alusi beherâ raku Refidim hae ira fisirâ opâ basambiŋ.
Refidim beherâ raku Sinai mâreŋ burocnao fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Sinai mâreŋ burocne beherâ raku Kibero‐Hatawa hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Kibero‐Hatawa beherâ raku Hazeroti hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Hazeroti beherâ raku Ritama hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Ritama beherâ raku Rimoŋ‐Pereze hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Rimoŋ‐Pereze beherâ raku Libina hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Libina beherâ raku Risa hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Risa beherâ raku Kahelata hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Kahelata beherâ raku Sefeli tiki fuŋnao teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Sefeli tiki beherâ raku Harada hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Harada beherâ raku Make‐Heloti hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Make‐Heloti beherâ raku Tahati hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Tahati beherâ raku Tera hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Tera beherâ raku Mitika hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Mitika beherâ raku Hasimona hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Hasimona beherâ raku Moseroti hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Moseroti beherâ raku Bene‐Jakaŋ opâ nombâŋ ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Bene‐Jakaŋ beherâ raku Horo‐Hagiga hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Horo‐Hagiga beherâ raku Jotibata hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Jotibata beherâ raku Abirona hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Abirona beherâ raku Ezioŋ‐Gebe hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Ezioŋ‐Gebe beherâ raku Ziŋ mâreŋ burocnao, Kadesi mâreŋko hâcne fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Kadesi beherâ raku Hora tikio, Edom mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Eme taha bapa Aroŋ e Wofuŋte micte Hora tikio ferâ ira hâmowec. Ine Israe ŋic jaŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec waharâ juwefukuhapie jara namba 40 irec mosa 5 â irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa wâŋ eha hâmowec.
Aroŋ e jara 123 bazurâ Hora tikio hâmowec hâcne.
Kanaaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Arada e Negebe wâneŋ Kanaaŋ mâreŋko juhuc, Israe ŋic jaŋe wareŋgopieŋ biŋe iŋuc manawec.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Hora tiki beherâ raku Zalimona hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Zalimona beherâ raku Punoŋ hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Punoŋ beherâ raku Oboti hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Oboti beherâ raku Moabi mâreŋ mao Ije‐Abarim hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Ijim beherâ raku Diboŋ‐Gade hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Diboŋ‐Gade beherâ raku Alimoŋ‐Dibilataim hae ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Alimoŋ‐Dibilataim beherâ raku Nebo tiki ʒoan wewefu‐ticnaopec Abarim tiki mâreŋ ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Abarim tiki beherâ raku Moabi wâneŋ Jordaŋ opâ heririŋ Jeriko hae ŋekac ira fisirâ teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Jaŋe Jordaŋ opâ heririŋnao Bete‐Jesimo hae ira fuŋkerâ raku Abe‐Sitim haeo tarakac Moabi wâneŋ ira teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc embiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ e Moabi wâneŋ Jordaŋ opâ heririŋ Jeriko hae ŋekac ira Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazac: Ŋoŋe Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ Kanaaŋ mâreŋko raʒinʒepieŋ.
Ehuc mâreŋ rune jopa jâpec ejarehuc nemuɋâŋ‐jeŋic qânâ me aeŋ rike dockekicnezi bakicne i henʒaŋ qanʒaŋ‐joparâ furu mâreŋ‐jeŋic ima banʒepieŋ.
Erâ no mâreŋ i rauckeniŋte tahac‐ŋopapo, irec ro rauc erâ ira ŋec juc enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ɋâsâi qahuc garikiŋ‐ŋeŋic sâc ro rauc enʒepieŋ. Garikiŋ guru kâcɋene jaŋe mâreŋ kâcɋene jarenʒepieŋ â garikiŋ guru piticne jaŋe mâreŋ piticne jarenʒepieŋ. Ɋâsâi qapie âke fuaocmu sâc rauckenʒepieŋ; mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forakac irec sâc ro rauc enʒepieŋ hâcne.
Me mâreŋ rune jopa jâpec mi ejareniŋmuo ine jaŋe ʒuhuckerâ juhuc, ʒâŋe‐ŋeŋicko siŋuŋzi heâriŋ‐ŋopaekac â ʒârâzi sahac‐ŋeŋic bâpârâckeekac irec sâc eŋarehuc mâreŋ ŋec juc eniŋmu ira fific bacŋopaniŋmu.
Ehame no wiac ejarezo manasupo i ŋoŋe hâcne eŋarepemu.”
Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc muhuc jaza mutâc ezemec: Ŋoŋe dameŋ mi ʒoraha Kanaaŋ mâreŋko raʒiniŋmu. Mâreŋ izi hâcne merâfâc mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic erâ fosanaŋkeocte mukicne. Mâreŋte ma ine kecʒiŋuc forazejec:
Mâreŋ dâkâne juwicpec irec ma i Ziŋ mâreŋ burocnao ira fuŋkerâ Edom mâreŋ qacnerâ razejec, â juwicpec ma izi ine Hâwec Hâmocnere ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec fuŋkerâ hurazejec.
Huraku Akerabim heâŋ juwicpec ira ŋehasickerâ Ziŋ mâreŋ fotâcnerâ raku Kadesi‐Baranea hae juwicnao fisizejec.
Irecnec ine ŋehasickerâ Aigita opâopec raku hâwecko tarazejec.
“Ʒoaŋ huhunaopec ine Mâreŋ Ŋoŋondeŋ Hâwec izi mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicte ma ezejec.
“Faic mâreŋkopec mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicte ma ine kecʒiŋuc fuarâ fozejec: Mâreŋ Ŋoŋondeŋ Hâwec irecnec fuŋkerâ ma qahapie raku Hora tikio fisizejec.
Hora tikionec ine ʒuhuckerâ qarapie Hamati hae upe rozejec.
Ma tofane ine irecnec fuŋkerâ qapie Ʒiforoŋ haeo fisirâ raku Haza‐Enaŋ hae ira tarazejec. Faic mâreŋkopec mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicte ma iŋuc hâcne fuazejec.
“Ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicte ma ine Haza‐Enaŋ haeonec fuŋkerâ qapie raku Sefam haeo fisizejec.
Erâ Sefamkonec huraku Aiŋ opâ ʒâŋere ʒoaŋ wewefunao Ribela hae ŋekac ira fisizejec. Erâ irecnec hurâ raku Kinerete riqicte ʒoaŋ wewefunao tiki ŋerakac ira fisizejec.
Irecnec ine Jordaŋ opâ qacnerâ rahuku Hâwec Hâmocnao tarazejec. Mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicte ma iŋuc hâcne forazejec.”
Eme Mosezi Israe ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc muhuc jaza mutâc ewec: “Mâreŋ ʒi hâcne Wofuŋzi ŋic guru 9 erâ dâkâne moc jaŋe jare tahac eocte mupaŋke‐jarewec. Irec ŋoŋe ɋâsâi qapie merâfâc mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic âke fuaocmu sâc ro rauc enʒepieŋ.
Rubeŋ â Gade guru garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc erâ wâc mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe biri forakac irec sâc merâfâc mâreŋ‐jeŋic ro rauc efârembiŋ. Erâ Manase guru dâkâne jaŋe wâc mâmâc.
Ŋic guru jajahec erâ wâc guru dâkâne moc keci jaŋe hâcne Jordaŋ ʒiŋucnao Jeriko hae ŋekac irec ʒoaŋ wewefunao ira hâcne merâfâc mâreŋ‐jeŋic ro rauc efârembiŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Mâreŋ bâtâc baŋarepie ro rauc eniŋmu ŋic i jaŋere ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc hâcne: Taha bapa Eleaʒa â Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua.
Erâ mâreŋ bâtâc bapie ro rauc eniŋte gurune gurune jaŋeraonec micne moc moc bâwosâec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ʒâŋe‐jeŋic ine kecʒiŋuc: Judare guruonec Jefunere ŋokâ Kalebe.
Simeoŋte guruonec Amihudure ŋokâ Semue.
Benjamiŋte guruonec Kisoloŋte ŋokâ Elidada.
Daŋte guruonec Jogilire ŋokâ Buki.
Josefere ɋâricfâc Manase guruonec Efodire ŋokâ Haniele.
Eferaimte guruonec Sifetaŋte ŋokâ Kemuele.
Sebuloŋte guruonec Paranakare ŋokâ Elisafaŋ.
Isasare guruonec Azaŋte ŋokâ Palatie.
Asere guruonec Selomire ŋokâ Ahihudu.
Naftali guruonec Amihudure ŋokâ Pedahele.
Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne Kanaaŋ mâreŋko Israe ŋic merâfâc mâreŋ‐jeŋic bâtâc bajareniŋte Wofuŋzi mutâcne‐jarewec.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Moabi wâneŋko Jordaŋ opâ heririŋ Jeriko hae ŋekac ira Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic mutâcne‐jaretec hae mâreŋ ro rauc embiŋ irecnec fic hae wiac gâcne Lewiŋic jarepie jaŋe ira ŋec juc enʒepieŋ. Erâ hae râreckehuc mâreŋ fokac i lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sapa eocte jarenʒepieŋ wâc.
Eme ŋic jaŋe hae ira ŋeŋe juju ehuc lama bulimakao â qowifâc‐jeŋic gâcne mâreŋ jareniŋmu ira râec‐jopapie junʒepieŋ.
Haesac râpenao mâreŋ râreckehuc forakac izi wâŋ tauseŋ kubi ezejec. Eme mâreŋ irec tofanao Lewiŋic lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sapa fuazejec.
Ehame hae râpenao ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec sâc bapie 2 tauseŋ kubi ezejec, â juwic mâreŋkopec sâc bapie 2 tauseŋ kubi ezejec, â ʒoaŋ huhunaopec sâc bapie 2 tauseŋ kubi ezejec, erâ faic mâreŋkopec sâc bapie 2 tauseŋ kubi jaha ezejec; fic haezi ine ʒâʒâŋiŋko ŋehame mâreŋ ira hâcne lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sapa fuazejec.
Ŋeŋezic hae 6 ŋerakac i hâcne Lewiŋic jarenʒepieŋ, ehame ʒika qaqa ŋic jaŋe hae ira rarâ soŋkeniŋte mana‐jarenʒepieŋ. Ehuc hae 42 ʒuhuckerâ qikiŋne‐jarenʒepieŋ.
Hae mâreŋ jareniŋmu irec qâqâhâc ʒare 48 ezejec.
Israe ŋic jaŋe fic hae ro rauc embiŋ irecnec hae jareniŋmu ine guru kâcɋenezi hae bocjaha qikiŋne‐jarenʒepieŋ â guru piticnezi hae afecne qikiŋne‐jarenʒepieŋ. Ine hâcne, guru sâc fic hae wiac ro rauc embiŋ irec sâc manahuc Lewiŋic hae mâreŋ wiac qikiŋne‐jarenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Ŋoŋe Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ Kanaaŋ mâreŋko raʒinʒepieŋ.
Raʒirâ ŋeŋezic hae‐ŋeŋic bâwosâec‐jopapie ine ŋic moczi ŋic âgo‐ticne mi mana tarahuc qâhâmoocmuo ira ra soŋkezejec.
Okacne bazucnenʒipiŋte wiserâ hae ira ra soŋkerâ mi hâhâmo ɋâricne juhame kikefuŋ jaŋe fuŋne‐ticne bataniŋkenʒepieŋ.
Hae ine ŋeŋezic hae‐ŋeŋic 6 qikiŋne‐jarenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Jordaŋ opâ ʒiŋucpec hae 3 â Kanaaŋ mâreŋko hae 3 jaha ŋeŋezic hae‐jeŋic eocte qikiŋne‐jarenʒepieŋ.
Hae 6 i jaŋe hâcne Israe ŋic me ŋic furune me ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ŋic jaba jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere ŋeŋezic hae erâ ŋehapie ŋic moczi mi mana tarahuc ŋic âgo‐ticne moc qâhâmorâ ra ira soŋkezejec.
“Me aeŋ ɋaruczi ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ ɋaruc iŋucnezi ŋic âgo‐ticne qame hâmoocmuo ine ŋic e ʒika qaqa mucnerâ qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Me qânâzi ŋic hehâmoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ qânâ iŋucnezi heme hâmo‐jâmbâŋkeocmuo ine ŋic e ʒika qaqa mucnerâ qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Me jâcɋaruczi ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ ɋaruc iŋucnezi qame hâmo‐jâmbâŋkeocmuo ine e ʒika qaqa mucnerâ qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Okac babazu ŋic eki hâcne ʒika qaqa ŋic e bâfuarâ qâhâmozejec.
Me ŋic e ŋic âgo‐ticne qaisockehuc mezi heocmu, me somâ barâ fohuc wiac moc wickerâ hehâmoocmu,
me râsi ecnehuc mezi heme hâmoocmuo ine ŋic e ʒika qaqa mucnehuc qâhâmozo wâc. Okac babazu ŋic eki hâcne ʒika qaqa ŋic e bâfuarâ qâhâmozejec.
“Me râsi ecnehuc mezi mi heocmu, me somâ mi bacnehuc wiac moc kosa wickeme ŋic âgo‐ticne heocmu
me qânâzi ŋic hehâmoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ qânâ iŋucnezi ŋic âgo‐ticne mi honehuc, me qa jâpec ecneocte wâc mi manasuhuc kosa wickeme ra hehâmoocmuo
ine kikefuŋ jaŋe ʒika qaqa ŋic â okac babazu ŋic jahere dâŋ i mumutâc dâŋ mukicne irec sâcko mutara‐jactenʒepieŋ.
Ehame kikefuŋ jaŋe ʒika qaqa ŋic ŋezickehuc okac babazu ŋic ere meonec batararâ ŋeŋezic haeo wiserâ rawec ira râepie juhame taha bapa sâko tiri wokemaŋ ruacnekicne ere hâmoc dameŋ maickezejec.
Me ʒika qaqa ŋic e ŋeŋezic haeo soŋkewec i beherâ râpenao hurâ juhame
okac babazu ŋic eki ware ŋic e bâfuarâ qâhâmome kiŋ tâmiric ezejec.
Ʒika qaqa ŋic e ŋeŋezic hae‐ticnao juhame taha bapa sâko ere hâmoc dameŋ maickezejec. Taha bapa sâko hâmone ine ʒika qaqa ŋic e hae mâreŋ‐ticnao risiezo murâ risiezejec.
“Irec wiac ʒiŋuczi ŋoŋere mumutâc â dâŋsanaŋ erâ ŋic gaŋne gaŋne fuarâ ŋec juc efeniŋmu sâc forahuc juzejec.
Ŋic izi me izi ŋic moc qâhâmoocmuo ine ʒika qaqa ŋic e fuŋne‐ticne mutaniŋkepie okacne bazucnehuc qâhâmozo wâc. Mâc ŋic mocjahazi sawa mutaniŋkeme ŋic e sâcne mi qâhâmozo.
Erâ ʒika qaqa ŋiczi juku hâmome hâmoc‐ticnere furi wâc mi ronʒepieŋ, e ine qâhâmo‐jâmbâŋkezo.
Me ŋoŋe ʒika qaqa ŋic eki ŋeŋezic hae‐ticnao wiserâ ra juweczi taha bapa sâkozi mi hâmoha mâreŋ‐ticnao risierâ juzo mume manacnehuc furi wâc mi ronʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe soc hoŋkehuc mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic mi hegâpârenʒepieŋ, soczi hâcne mâreŋ he gâpâreekac; â soc hoŋkekicne izi mâreŋte kiwiric sâcne wâc mi roocmu, ŋic soc hoŋkewec ere soczi ine sâcne rorone.
Ŋoŋe mecne â no mecne mâreŋ ŋec juc eeŋgopeneŋ i mi hegâpârenʒepieŋ, Wofuŋ noni hâcne Israe ŋic ŋoŋere ŋondeŋko ŋec juc eekopac.”
Manasere ŋosa Gileade, Makirire ŋokâ hâcne, ere ŋokâfâc jaŋere garikiŋfâc gurune gurune, Josefere ɋâricfâc gaŋne gaŋne juwefumbiŋ irec tofane moc hâcne, jaŋere micnefâc jaŋe Mose â Israe ŋic garikiŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere micne bapa jaŋerao fuambiŋ.
Ehuc kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Wofuŋzi bomboŋ‐nâŋec goki ɋâsâi qahuc Israe ŋic merâfâc mâreŋ‐nâŋec nârecmurâ mutâcne‐garewec. Ehuc qomâ‐nâŋec Zelofeha ere merâfâc mâreŋ i otâfâc‐ticne jarecmurâ mutâcne‐garewec wâc.
Mâc jaŋe Israe ŋicguru gâcne jaŋeraonec ŋic rocjopaniŋmuo ine merâfâc mâreŋ‐jeŋic i mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋere merâfâc mâreŋ fonârekac irecnec rorâ guru weni jaŋehec juniŋmu jaŋere merâfâc mâreŋ ira ʒuhuckeniŋmu. Iŋuc ehuc nâŋere merâfâc wiac gâcne nâwoc roniŋmu hâcne.
Iŋuc fuame Israe ŋic nâŋâcne jara hombaŋ sâko maickeme merâfâc mâreŋ‐jeŋic i guru weni jaŋehec juniŋmu jaŋere merâfâc mâreŋko ʒuhuckeocmu hâcne, ehame mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋere merâfâc mâreŋ i pitiwaocmu.”
Iŋuc mupie Mosezi Wofuŋte micte Israe ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc muhuc jazawec: “Josefere ɋâricfâc jaŋere garikiŋ guru jaŋe dâŋ muŋgopieŋ i manape sâckekac.
Wofuŋ e Zelofeha otâfâcne jaŋere dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Jaŋe ŋic i me i rocjopazo ejareme rocjopanʒepieŋ, erâ ine mamac‐jeŋicte soctofa jaŋere guruonec sawa rocjopanʒepieŋ.
Israe ŋic ŋoŋere merâfâc mâreŋ i guru mockonec guru mocko mi fotâcnezejec, aricne, Israe ŋic ŋokac sasawa ŋoŋe ru sâc mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere merâfâc mâreŋ rosanaŋkerâ bajunʒepieŋ.
Â naru ŋokac Israe ŋic guru‐jeŋicko merâfâc mâreŋ‐jeŋichec juŋgopieŋ jaŋe mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere garikiŋfâc irecnec ŋic rocjopapie Israe ŋic ŋokac ŋoŋe ru sâc mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere merâfâc mâreŋ ro rauc erâ bajunʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc epie merâfâc mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic i guru mockonec guru mocko mi fotâcnezejec. Israe ŋic gurune gurune ŋoŋe ru sâc ŋoŋe ŋaŋacne merâfâc mâreŋ basanaŋkerâ bajunʒepieŋ.’”
Eme Zelofeha otâfâcne jaŋe Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâc efârembiŋ.
Zelofeha otâfâc‐ticne Mala, Tiriza, Hogela, Milika â Noa jaŋe mamac‐jeŋicte hahac ɋafâc jaŋere ŋokâfâc rocjopambiŋ.
Jaŋe Josefere ŋokâ Manase ere garikiŋfâc jaŋeraonec ŋic rocjopambiŋ hâcne; irec merâfâc mâreŋ‐jeŋic i mamac‐jeŋicte garikiŋ guruo jaha fowec.
Sâcmutâc â dâŋsanaŋ i hâcne Wofuŋzi Moabi wâneŋko Jordaŋ heririŋ Jeriko hae ŋewec ira Mose âzâcneme Israe ŋic mutâcne‐jare‐fârewec.
Mose e Jordaŋ opâ ocniŋuc mâreŋ burocnao, Araba wâneŋko hâcne, ira Israe ŋic ʒeŋgoma dâŋ jazawec ʒine hâcne. Araba wâneŋ i Sufu mâreŋ ŋifecnao erâ Paraŋ, Tofele, Labaŋ, Hazeroti â Diʒahaba ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko fowec.
Horebe tikionec rahuc juku Seiri tiki mâreŋ fotâcnerâ Kadesi‐Baranea haeo fisihapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 11 tarawec.
Eme jara namba 40 irec mosa 11 ʒoaŋ gie bapa wâŋ ira, Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic jaŋere sâcmutâc dâŋ Mose âzâcnewec i heɋâre‐jarehuc jaza mutâc ewec.
Ine Amori ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ Hesiboŋ haeo juwec â Basaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Ogo Asitaroto â Ederei haeo juwec jahe jofa jâpec ejactewec irec faicnao iŋuc ewec.
Mose e Jordaŋ ocniŋucnao Moabi mâreŋko hâcne sâcmutâc dâŋ i mutâcne‐jarehuc ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec e Horebe tikio kecʒiŋuc nâzâwec: ‘Ŋoŋe tiki ʒira boc jupie dameŋ ʒorakac.
Irec fahare risie raniŋ, rahuc Amori ŋic jaŋere tiki mâreŋko erâ wâc âgo diguracfâc‐jeŋic Araba wâneŋko me tiki mâreŋko me Negebe wâneŋko me hâwec heririŋko juraŋgopieŋ ira fisinʒepieŋ. Ine hâcne, Kanaaŋ â Lebanoŋ mâreŋ foraku Eufrata opâ sâkoo tarakac ira fisi‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no mâreŋ i hâcne ŋarezo ekopac, irec ŋoŋe raʒirâ, mamac ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo erâ ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic mâreŋ jarepemurâ mupaŋke‐jarepo i ro rauc enʒepieŋ.’
“No dameŋ ira dâŋ kecʒiŋuc ŋazapo: ‘No bucnane jowa qataŋ sâcne mi eŋarepemu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi manaha sawe mâririackerâ juwefukupie ʒare‐ŋeŋic sambâŋko bâpiŋ ŋeraŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc ekac.
Wofuŋ, mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere Anutu hâcne, eki basawec‐ŋopame dameŋ ʒiŋuczia juŋgopieŋ irec sâc fejâmbâŋkehuc sirickenʒepieŋ, erâ dâŋ mupaŋke‐ŋarewec irec sâc jambuŋ‐ŋopazejec.
No ŋemâc‐ŋeŋic â tagi‐ŋeŋic erâ fâfâuc‐ŋeŋic i wemocko bucnane sâcne de âsic epemu?
Irec ŋoŋe ŋic maŋɋârâŋ â mamanahec erâ fuŋne mamana saric bâwosâec‐jopapie noni micnefâc‐ŋeŋic âkendâŋ‐jopapemu.’
Iŋuc ŋazape dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐narembiŋ: ‘Wiac ebac enaŋte nâzâkomec i manapene biaŋkekac.’
Iŋuc mupie guru‐ŋeŋic sâc irec micne maŋɋârâŋhec â fuŋne mamana saric rocjoparâ guru‐ŋeŋic sâc hone soŋaŋ eŋareniŋte râec‐jopapo. Gâcne jaŋe tauseŋ gurune gurune, gâcne jaŋe 100 gurune gurune, gâcne jaŋe 50 gurune gurune â gâcne jaŋe 10 gurune gurune ŋoŋere micnefâc erâ juniŋte râec‐jopapo hâcne.
Ehuc dameŋ ijaha mumutara ŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic ʒiŋuc jaza mutâc epo: ‘Ŋoŋe qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere dâŋ manahuc, ŋic moc qomâ‐ticnehec me ŋic jabanehec dâŋjekic foocmu i sifu fâretiŋ jaha mutaranʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ ŋifecpeaŋ sawa mi mutaranʒepieŋ; ŋoŋe ŋic fekicne me waha qaqane jaŋere dâŋ sâkoa mananʒepieŋ, ehuc ŋic jaŋere mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec, dâŋ mutaraniŋmu i Anuture manasuhuc mutaranʒepieŋ. Me dâŋ moc manapie ŋemâckeme norao bawarepie manazepac.’
No dameŋ ira hâcne wiac sasawa ebac eniŋte mutâcne‐ŋarepo.
“Eme nâŋâc Wofuŋzi mutâcne‐nârewec irec sâc ehuc Horebe tiki beherâ mâreŋ burocne kâcɋene â hâhâwicne sâko i honehuc fotâcnerâ Amori ŋic jaŋere tiki mâreŋkopec wareku Kadesi‐Baranea hae mâreŋko fisimbeŋ.
Fisirâ kecʒiŋuc ŋazapo: ‘Nâŋâc Amori ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko fisiŋgopeneŋ; Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi mâreŋ i hâcne nâre tahac ezo mukac.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e mâreŋ i ŋarezo ekac, irec ŋoŋe Wofuŋ, mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere Anutuzi dâŋ ŋazawec irec sâc ehuc ro rauc enʒepieŋ; ehuc mi hâwic‐ŋopaha hâbi gogoroŋ wâc mi enʒepieŋ.’
Iŋuc ŋazape ŋoŋe ʒeŋgoma fua‐narehuc ʒiŋuc nazambiŋ: ‘Nâŋâc ŋic sorec‐jopapene bânie rarâ mâreŋ hone tâcnenʒepieŋ, ehuc hata wena raku hae wenimoira fisinaŋmu i hone manac erâ binaŋ banârenʒepieŋ.’
Iŋuc mupie manape sâckeha guru‐ŋeŋic sâc irecnec ŋic 12 rowosâec‐jopapo.
Eme jaŋe faharerâ raku tiki mâreŋko Esikola wâneŋko fisirâ mâreŋ hone tâcnembiŋ.
Erâ mâreŋ irec jâcfâri wiac gâcne rorâ bafisi‐nârembiŋ, ehuc dâŋ binaŋ ʒiŋuc enârembiŋ: ‘Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi mâreŋ nâre tahac ekac i mâreŋ biaŋne jâmbâŋ.’
“Ŋoŋe ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte mumutâc dâŋ qatarahuc feniŋte mi afeckembiŋ.
Ehuc qoruc boze‐ŋeŋicko ŋehuc mu kâroŋ erâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: ‘Wofuŋ e qaisoc‐nâpohuc Amori ŋic jaŋere meo râec‐nâpome nâpo sipiric eniŋte Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐nâpo wefuwec.
Ʒi ine ira ferâ wemo wiac moc bâfuanaŋmu? Qomâfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupie maŋnâŋec gâckewec: “Ŋic faic juŋgopieŋ jaŋe nâŋâcne sâc sirickehuc ŋic kâcɋene â ʒoricne juŋgopieŋ, â fic hae‐jeŋic i basanaŋkehuc bafekupie sambâŋ heuazo ekac. Erâ ŋic soka makakicne, Anakare ɋâricfâc hâcne jaŋe wâc honec‐jopambeŋ.” ’
Iŋuc mupie kecʒiŋuc ŋazapo: ‘Ŋoŋe bipic tatara eŋareha mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi Aigita mâreŋko ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jopawec irec sâc jaha ehuc bafic‐ŋopaocmu.
Erâ mâreŋ burocnao ʒiŋuc honembiŋ wâc: Ŋic moczi ŋokâ‐ticne âsi qataŋ ecneekac irec sâc jaha Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi âsi qataŋ eŋare warehuc juha hae mâreŋ ʒira fisimbiŋ.’
Ŋoŋe ine sifu Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic mi manasiŋkembiŋ.
Eki hâcne teuŋ âterâ ŋec foc eniŋte bânie‐ŋarehuc hae mâreŋ bâfua‐ŋare jujec. Hata ŋaza ŋowatuc eocte ŋafeo ʒocbâruŋ maŋko â ʒoaŋko karorac maŋko bânie‐ŋare jujec hâcne.
“Ehame Wofuŋ e dâŋŋeŋic manarâ aarickeme ʒiŋuc mupaŋke‐ŋarewec:
‘Ŋicguru repicne ʒi domaŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ jarepemurâ mupaŋke‐jarepo i moc mi hone‐jâmbâŋkeniŋmu.
Jefunere ŋokâ Kalebe eki ine maŋticne hâcbuc jaha Wofuŋ norao râeme foekac, erâ mâreŋ i wâc âtewec; irec e jahacne â ɋâricfâcne jaŋe sawa mana‐jarepe mâreŋ i honenʒoŋgopieŋ.’
Wofuŋ e ŋoŋere eebapa sâqocnere erâ no wâc aaric mana‐narekac, ehuc ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Go wâc iŋuc jaha mâreŋ ira mi raʒicmu.
Erâ wâc Josua, Nuŋte ŋokâ mefâroge juekac e hâcne mu âkeriŋ ecnetec bânie‐jarehuc mâreŋ ira raʒirâ Israe ŋic ejareme mâreŋ i ro rauc enʒepieŋ.
Erâ ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic ʒikare nânâ eniŋte mumbiŋ, â naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic dameŋ ʒiŋuczia biaŋne â sâqocne irec fuŋne moc mi mana taraŋgopieŋ jaŋe ira raʒiniŋmu, jaŋe hâcne mâreŋ i jarepe ro rauc eniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe ine mâreŋ burocnao risierâ raniŋte Hâwec Bâbâroŋkopec ranʒepieŋ.’
“Iŋuc ŋazape dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikie‐narembiŋ: ‘Nâŋe sâqocne bahuc Wofuŋ bunao bambeŋ, irec Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi dâŋ nâzâ mutâc ewec irec sâc jaha ehuc ferâ ʒika qanʒepeneŋ.’ Ŋoŋe sasawa iŋuc muhuc ʒikare wiac rofârerâ tiki mâreŋko feraniŋte manapie afeckewec.
Iŋuc epie Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Go ʒiŋuc jazac: No ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko mi juhape râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ŋopanʒipiŋte ʒika qazo mi fenʒepieŋ.’
No dâŋ iŋuc ŋazape ŋoŋe mi manambiŋ, ehuc Wofuŋte mumutâc dâŋ qatararâ sahac fefe ehuc sifu tiki mâreŋko fembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Amori ŋic tiki mâreŋ ira jumbiŋ jaŋe waharâ, bituc bâiŋnepene jâpec‐nâpoekac irec sâc Seiri tiki mâreŋkonec fuŋkerâ jâpec‐ŋopa raku Horima haeo ŋopambiŋ.
Iŋuc eŋarepie ŋoŋe risierâ Wofuŋ kio wâwâsic ecnepie mi mana‐ŋarewec.
Wiac iŋuc fua‐ŋareme Kadesi haeo dameŋ ʒora jumbiŋ hâcne.
“Eme nâŋâc risierâ, Wofuŋzi nazawec irec sâc ehuc mâreŋ burocnao ranaŋte Hâwec Bâbâroŋkopec rambeŋ, ehuc dameŋ ʒora Seiri tiki mâreŋ râreckehuc jumbeŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc nazawec:
‘Ŋoŋe tiki mâreŋ ʒira dameŋ ʒora râreckehuc jumbiŋ, irec ʒi faic mâreŋkopec raniŋ.
Erâ ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazac: Ŋoŋe qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic, Esaure ɋâricfâc jaŋere mâreŋ fotâcnezo eŋgopieŋ; jaŋe Seiri mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ hâcne, ehuc ŋoŋere hâwic‐jopakac. Irec ŋoŋe rucjari‐ŋeŋic bahuc
jaŋehec qaqac mi enʒepieŋ. No Esau Seiri tiki mâreŋ râcnepe ro rauc ewecte jaŋere mâreŋ dâkâne piicne jâmbâŋ, kike tapezi ââtenere sâc i moc mi ŋare‐jâmbâŋkepemu.
Ŋoŋe jaŋeraonec nânâ opâ moneŋzi furine barâ nânʒepieŋ.
No Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi wiac ebac ehuc jumbiŋ sasawa i jambuŋke‐ŋarepo, ehuc mâreŋ burocne ʒi fotâcnehuc juhapie hone manac eŋareekopac wâc; no Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi jara 40 sâko ŋoŋehec juhape wiac moc mi basambiŋ.’
Wofuŋzi iŋuc nâzâme hata ʒuhuckerâ rambeŋ, ehuc qomâfâc‐nâŋec, Esaure ɋâricfâc Seiri tiki mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ jaŋe behec‐joparâ Araba wâneŋko hata sâko fokac i mecne erâ Elata â Ezioŋ‐Gebe hata i mâmâc jâururâ rambeŋ. “Rahuc hata bâŋorierâ Moabi mâreŋ burocnaopec rambeŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Ŋoŋe Moabi ŋic maŋbâiŋ ejarehuc ʒika mi qanʒepieŋ; no Ari hae Lotire ɋâricfâc jaŋe jarepe ro rauc embiŋ, irec Moabi ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ dâkâne ŋarepe moc mi rauckeniŋmu.’
(Emimŋic jaŋe mârâc jaha ira jumbiŋ, jaŋe ŋic kâcɋene â guru sâko; jaŋe Anaka ŋic jaŋere sâc ŋic ʒoricne jaha.
Anaka ŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe Refaim ŋic mumbiŋ iŋuc jaha wâc jaŋere ʒâŋe mumbiŋ, mâc Moabi ŋic jaŋe ine Emimŋic mujarembiŋ.
Horiŋic jaŋe mârâc jaha Seiri tiki mâreŋko jumbiŋ wâc, ehame Esaure ɋâricfâc jaŋe ine mâreŋ‐jeŋic jowac rorâ ŋic jopa jâpec ejarehuc sipiric‐jopambiŋ. Ehuc rune jaŋere jujutacko ŋec juc embiŋ; ine Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic mâreŋ jareme ro rauc ehuc rune jopa bâtâtiec ejarembiŋ irec sâc embiŋ hâcne.)
‘Irec ŋoŋe ʒi faharerâ raku Ʒerede opâ fotâcneniŋ.’ Wofuŋzi iŋuc nâzâme nâŋâc raku Ʒerede opâ fotâcnembeŋ.
Eme Kadesi‐Baranea hae beherâ rahuc juku Ʒerede opâ fotâcnehapene jara 38 ewec. Erâ rahuc juhapene Wofuŋzi momori ŋic mupaŋke‐jarewec irec sâc fua‐jareme hâmo sipiric efârembiŋ.
Wofuŋ e râsi ejarehuc teuŋkonec bâsirowec‐jopakume omae‐fârembiŋ hâcne.
“Eme momori ŋic jaŋe ŋic ŋokac guru‐jeŋicko omae‐fârepie
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc nazawec:
‘Ŋoŋe miŋecgac jaha Moabi mâreŋte ma Ari haeo fokac i jâurunʒepieŋ.
Jâururâ raku Amoŋŋic jaŋere mâreŋ bâqiŋkerâ maŋbâiŋ ejarehuc ʒika mi qanʒepieŋ; no mâreŋ‐jeŋic Lotire ɋâricfâc jaŋe jarepe ro rauc embiŋte Amoŋŋic jaŋere mâreŋ dâkâne ŋarepe ro rauc moc mi eniŋmu.’
(Mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe i Refaim mâreŋ mueŋgopieŋ wâc, mârâc jaha Refaim ŋic jaŋe ira jumbiŋ irec. Amoŋŋic jaŋe ine Ʒamaʒumim ŋic mujareeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋic kâcɋene erâ guru sâko, Anaka ŋic jaŋere sâc ŋic ʒoricne jaha. Wofuŋzi ine jopa jâpec ejarehame Amoŋŋic jaŋe mâreŋ‐jeŋic ro rauc erâ jujutac‐jeŋicko ŋec juc embiŋ.
Wofuŋ e mârâc jaha Esaure ɋâricfâc, Seiri tiki mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ jaŋere erâ iŋuc jaha ewec. E jaŋere ʒâŋe faio Horiŋic jopa sipiric ejareme jaŋe mâreŋ‐jeŋic jowac rorâ jujutac‐jeŋicko ŋec juc embiŋzi eeŋgopieŋ.
Awimŋic hae piic piicko Gaza hae râreckehuc jurambiŋ jaŋe sâc ijaha wâc ejarekicne, Kafatori ŋic jaŋe hâcne mâreŋ‐jeŋickonec fisirâ jopa sipiric ejarehuc jujutac‐jeŋicko ŋec juc embiŋ.)
‘Ajoc, ŋoŋe faharerâ hata ʒuhuckerâ raku Aronoŋ opâwâc qaniŋ. Manaŋgopieŋ, no Hesiboŋ haeonec Amori ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ e jahacne â mâreŋ‐ticne i ŋoŋere meo râekopac, irec ŋoŋe fuŋkerâ ʒika qahuc mâreŋ‐ticne ro rauc enʒepieŋ.
No miŋecgac hâcne fuŋkerâ, sambâŋ rurumaŋnao ŋic gurune gurune juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe ejarepe ŋoŋere hâwic‐jopaha bipic tatara ejarezejec. Jaŋe ŋoŋere biŋe manarâ ɋarac ɋarac qahuc maŋjeŋic gâckezejec.’
“Eme Kedemoti mâreŋ burocnao juhuc kiŋaŋŋic sorec‐jopape Hesiboŋ ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋtao wamadâŋ kecʒiŋuc barambiŋ:
‘Go mana‐nârehaŋ mâreŋge fotâcnenʒepeneŋ. Nâŋe fâreopec me qanaopec mâcne, hata sâkooa ranaŋte muŋgopeneŋ.
Erâ nânâ opâ râe‐nâretec moneŋzi furine banʒepeneŋ.
Esaure ɋâricfâc Seiri tiki mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ â Moabi ŋic Ari haeo juhuc mana‐nârembiŋ, iŋuc jaha mana‐nârehaŋ mâreŋge kikezi fotâcnerâ raku Jordaŋ opâ qarâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi mâreŋ nâre tahac ekac ira raʒinʒepeneŋ.’
Hesiboŋ ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ eki ine hecke‐nârewec, erâ i Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi menâŋecko râeocte maŋmutuc bahuc maŋrâŋgeŋ bâfuacnewecte iŋuc ewec. Irec fuŋne miŋecgac taniŋkekac hâcne.
Eme Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Manakic, no Sihoŋ â mâreŋ‐ticne i meŋeŋicko râezo ekopac, irec ŋoŋe fuŋkerâ mâreŋ‐ticne ro rauc enʒepieŋ.’
Sihoŋzi ine râsi enârehuc momorifâc‐ticne sasawa jaŋehec waharâ Jahazi haeo ʒika fuŋkembiŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec eki ine menâŋecko râec‐jopame Sihoŋ e jahacne â ŋokâfâc‐ticne sasawa jopa‐fârembeŋ.
Erâ domarâ fic hae wiac‐ticne ro rauc ehuc ŋic ŋokac naru motec qâmiziec‐jopambeŋ.
Bulimakao jaŋe sawa ʒikare mateŋ‐nâŋec rocjopambeŋ, erâ haeo ʒikare merâfâc wiac gâcne fowec i mâmâc rombeŋ.
Aroe hae Aronoŋ wâneŋ qaŋeŋnao ŋekac ira fuŋkerâ raku Gileade mâreŋko tarakac, ŋondeŋ ira hae sacnehec ŋerawec ira wâc mi quŋkembeŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi menâŋecko râe‐fârewec hâcne.
Amoŋŋic jaŋere mâreŋ ine mi bâqiŋkembeŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi dâŋ nâzâ mutâc ewec i reŋkehuc Jaboko opâ qaŋeŋnao me tiki mâreŋko hae ŋerawec ira moc mi rambeŋ.
“Eme irec faicnao forisierâ Basaŋ mâreŋko fembeŋ. Ehame Basaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Ogo e ŋicfâc‐ticne sasawa jaŋehec waharâ râsi enârehuc Ederei hae ira ʒika fuŋkembiŋ.
Wofuŋzi ine kecʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Ŋoŋe ere mi hâwic‐ŋopaoc, noni hâcne e jahacne â ŋicfâc‐ticne erâ mâreŋ‐ticne meŋeŋicko râe‐fârekopac. Irec ŋoŋe Amori ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ e Hesiboŋ haeo juhame wiac ecnembiŋ sâc ijaha Ogo ecnenʒepieŋ.’
Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi iŋuc murâ Basaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Ogo â ŋicfâc‐ticne sasawa menâŋecko râec‐jopame qâmiziec‐jopa‐fârembeŋ.
Erâ hae wiac‐ticne ŋerawec i moc mi behehuc ro rauc efârembeŋ. Nâŋâc hae sâko 60, Arigoba hae mâreŋ, Basaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Ogo ere uucmaŋ hâcne i rofârembeŋ.
Hae i basanaŋkekicne erâ sac ʒoranehec, erâ motâc sâko i babasanaŋ‐ticnehec sasawa. Erâ hae piic piic sac tâmiric i wâc bocjaha rocjopambeŋ.
Ehuc Hesiboŋ ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ ecnembeŋ sâc ijaha ehuc fic hae sasawa hetâc qâtâtie‐fârehuc ŋic ŋokac â naru motec mâmâc qâmiziec‐jopa‐fârembeŋ.
Mâc bulimakao sasawa â haeo ʒikare merâfâc fowec i ʒikare mateŋ‐nâŋec rocjopambeŋ.
Nâŋâc dameŋ ira hâcne Amori ŋicwofuŋ jajahec jahere mâreŋ Jordaŋ opâ ʒiŋucnao Aroroŋ opâo fuŋkerâ raku Herimoŋ tikio tarakac i jofac rombeŋ.
(Sidoŋ ŋic jaŋe Herimoŋ tiki irec ʒâŋe Sirioŋ muhapie Amori ŋic jaŋe Seniri mueŋgopieŋ.)
Wâneŋko fic hae ŋerawec erâ Gileade mâreŋ sasawa â Basaŋ mâreŋ raku Saleka â Ederei haeo tarakac, Basaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Ogo ere uucmaŋte hae mâreŋ sasawa hâcne i rofâ qâfârembeŋ.
(Basaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Ogo e hâcne Refaim ŋic jaŋere soctofa moc buc juwec. Qâŋɋâŋ‐ticnere fofo buse heutuckehuc gufukicne i Amoŋŋic jaŋere hae moc ʒâŋene Raba ira foweczi fokac. Ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc i 9 kubi â otecne‐ticnere sâc i 4 kubi ekac. Sâc i kubi omanere sâc manahuc mukicne.)
“Nâŋâc mâreŋ ro rauc embeŋ dameŋ ira Rubeŋ â Gade jahere gurufâc Aronoŋ wâneŋ tofanao Aroe hae ŋekac irecnec fuŋkerâ mâreŋ forakac i mecne erâ Gileade tiki mâreŋ ŋifecne i mâmâc jarepo.
Gileade mâreŋ ŋifecne â Basaŋ mâreŋ sasawa, ŋicwofuŋ Ogo ere uucmaŋ, Arigoba hae mâreŋ sasawa i hâcne Manase guru dâkâne jaŋe jarepo. (Basaŋ hae mâreŋ sasawa irec ʒâŋe Refaim mâreŋ mueŋgopieŋ.
Manasere ŋokâ Jairi ere ɋâric moc e Arigoba hae mâreŋ, Basaŋ hâcne, i rorâ raku Gesuri â Makati ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao rotarawec, ehuc hae wiac irec ʒâŋe ‘Jairi hae boze’ mume foweczi fokac jaha.)
Makiri e ine Gileade mâreŋ râcnepo.
Rubeŋ â Gade jahere gurufâc jaŋe ine Gileade mâreŋko domarâ raku Aronoŋ wâneŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋko mâreŋ ma fokac i jâururâ raku Jaboko opâo Amoŋŋic jaŋere mâreŋ mao tarakac mâreŋ i hâcne jarepo.
Erâ Araba wâneŋ, Jordaŋ opâzi ma eha Kinerete riqickonec raku Araba hâwec, Hâwec Hâmocne hâcne, ira hurâ Pisiga tiki fuŋnao ʒoaŋ wewefunao forakac wâneŋ i mâmâc jarepo.
“Eme no dameŋ ira dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc ŋaza mutâc epo: ‘Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ʒi hâcne ro rauc eniŋte ŋare tahac ewec, irec momori ŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ʒikare wiac‐jeŋichec Israe ŋic qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic bânie‐jarehuc opâ ʒi fotâcnenʒepieŋ.
Ŋokac naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic â lama bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ine hae mâreŋ qikiŋne‐ŋarepo ʒira ŋefârenʒepieŋ (lama bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe guru sâko i no manakopac).
Eme Wofuŋzi ŋoŋe wama bâfua‐ŋarewec iŋuc jaha qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe bâfua‐jareocmu. Eme Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi Jordaŋ opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ jare tahac ekac i ro rauc efarenʒepieŋ. Iŋuc epie tarame ŋoŋe ru sâc mâreŋ kâdoc qaŋarepo ʒira risienʒepieŋ.’
Erâ dameŋ ira Josua wâc kecʒiŋuc âzâcne mutâc epo: ‘Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ â Ogo wiac ejacteme ʒâŋe fârigezi honemeŋ sâc ijaha ŋicwofuŋ gâcne jaŋe ejareha mâreŋ‐jeŋic ro rauc eniŋmu.
Irec ŋoŋe jaŋere mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec; Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e bafic‐ŋopahuc iŋuc hâcne eocmu.’
“Erâ no dameŋ ira ʒiŋuc muhuc Wofuŋ mu wâwâsic ecnepo:
‘O Wofuŋ Anutu, go kiŋaŋŋicge no ʒai ʒonʒoŋ â tâpirigere fuŋne naza nowatuc emeŋ; sambâŋkonec me mâreŋkonec mo nemuzi goki wiac qeŋ bipinehec ebac emeŋ irec sâc moc ezac?
Irec mana‐narehaŋ Jordaŋ opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ biaŋ fokac, tiki mâreŋ biaŋne â Lebanoŋ tiki hâcne, i honezepac.’
Wofuŋ eki ine ŋoŋere erâ aaric mana‐narehuc dâŋnane qatararâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Sâcne mumec, irec dâŋ mocwâc mi muc.
Go Pisiga tiki botâŋnao ferâ ʒâŋege bâfeŋnerâ fitec rame ʒoaŋ huhunaopec, â faic mâreŋkopec â juwic mâreŋkopec erâ ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec hae mâreŋ fokac i hone‐fârezemec, Jordaŋ opâ ʒi fotâcnerâ ine mi razemec.
Josua ine mu baafec ecnerâ hâbidâŋ âzâcnetec ŋic ŋokac micne bajarehuc opâ fotâcnerâ, mâreŋ honecmu i bâtâc bajareme ro rauc enʒepieŋ.’
Iŋuc nazame nâŋe Bete‐Peoro hae ŋifecnao wâneŋ fokac ira ʒuhuckerâ ŋec juc embeŋ.
“O Israe ŋicbureŋ, no dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋ qazu‐ŋarekopac i mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ, iŋuc ehuc sâcne juniŋmu, ehuc Wofuŋ mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere Anutu e mâreŋ ŋare tahac ekac i ro rauc enʒepieŋ.
No dâŋ ŋaza qâmoc ekopac ira moc ʒuhuckerâ mumu me irecnec moc bârârierâ bebehe ine mi enʒepieŋ, aricne, Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte sâcmutâc dâŋ ŋaza mutâc ekopac i hâcne reŋkenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋzi Baali‐Peoro haeo wiac ewec i ʒâŋe fâri‐ŋeŋiczi hone‐fârembiŋ; Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e Baali‐Peoro nemurao qohotambiŋ jaŋe hâcne ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋickonec bâsirowec‐jopawec.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋictao qohotambiŋ ŋoŋe sasawa ine jumbiŋzi juŋgopieŋ jaha.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu‐nanezi naza mutâc ewec irec sâcko dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋ qazu‐ŋarepo i ŋoŋe mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋmu ira juhuc mana rereŋ eniŋte iŋuc hâcne epo.
Irec ŋoŋe mana rereŋ eniŋ. Iŋuc epie ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe dâŋsanaŋ i mana‐fârerâ ŋoŋere manapie ŋic maŋɋârâŋ â mamanahec eha ʒiŋuc muŋareniŋmu: ‘Opoŋ, ŋicguru keci jaŋe jâmbomac maŋɋârâŋ â mamanahec juŋgopieŋ.’
Me Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec wira wâwâsic ecnepene nâŋâcnehec juekac irec sâc mo ŋicguru ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec jaŋere nemuzi iŋuc ejareekac?
Me miŋecgac sâcmutâc dâŋ mutâcne‐ŋare‐fârekopac dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋticne iŋucne i ŋicguru weni jaŋe moc bajuŋgopieŋ?
“Ŋoŋe wiac fua‐ŋareme ʒâŋe fâri‐ŋeŋiczi honembiŋ i jufeniŋmu sâc nikec‐ŋopazacte juju‐ŋeŋic soŋaŋkehuc aimuŋ junʒepieŋ, ehuc naru motec ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic irec dâŋ binaŋ ejarenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Horebe tikio Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio domahapie Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Go ŋic ŋokac nore maio hetumaŋ‐jopatec dâŋnane jazape mananʒepieŋ, ehuc mâreŋko jufeniŋmu sâc araŋ banarehuc naru motecfâc‐jeŋic qazu‐jarenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ irec moc mi nikec‐ŋopazejec.’
Eme ŋoŋe tiki fuŋnao warerâ domambiŋ. Ehame tikionec ʒocbâruŋ fuarâ feku sambâŋko qataraha duŋdapâc â hâweŋ karoraczi râreckehuc hae mâreŋ sâockerâ fowec.
Iŋuc fuame Wofuŋzi ʒocmaŋko juhuc dâŋ ŋazame manambiŋ, e jahacne ine mi honehuc mâc dâŋticne sawa manambiŋ.
E ʒâʒâfic‐ticnere dâŋ Sâcmutâc Sanaŋ Teŋ hâcne, i mana rereŋ eniŋte ŋazahuc qorac tapa jajahecko qâreŋkewec.
Wofuŋ e dameŋ ira hâcne dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋ qazu‐ŋarepemurâ naza mutâc ewec, i ŋoŋe mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋmu ira juhuc mana rereŋ eniŋte iŋuc ewec.
“Wofuŋ e Horebe tikio ʒocmaŋko juhuc dâŋ ŋazawec dameŋ ira e jahacne mi honembiŋte aimuŋ junʒepieŋ.
Ehuc sâqorenʒipiŋte wiac i me i jaŋere hawari ɋâŋ qâqâtâc moc mi henʒepieŋ; ŋic hawari mecne, ŋokac hawari mecne,
me mâreŋ faio qowi juraŋgopieŋ jaŋere hawari mecne,
me mâreŋko wiac i me i foforâ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere hawari mecne, me opâ qowi opâmaŋko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere hawari mecne i moc mi banʒepieŋ.
Erâ wâc sambâŋko mosa ʒoaŋ â bâpiŋ wiac ŋeraŋgopieŋ jaŋe honec‐jopahuc araŋ bajarenʒipiŋte ira qâhâŋnerâ fipie mi fezejec. Wofuŋ e ŋic gâcne sasawa mâreŋko juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe wiac i araŋ bajareniŋte mutâcne‐jarewec hâcne.
Ŋoŋe miŋecgac Wofuŋte ŋicfâc eŋgopieŋ, iŋuc hâcne fuaocte Wofuŋzi ʒocmaŋkonec, Aigita mâreŋkonec hâcne, batarac‐ŋoparâ jowac‐ŋopa wefuwec.
Erâ wâc ŋoŋere erâ aaric mana‐narehuc no Jordaŋ opâ mi fotâcnepemurâ mupaŋke‐narewec. Erâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ biaŋne ŋare tahac eme merâfâc mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic eocmu ira wâc mi raʒipemurâ hecke‐narewec.
No Jordaŋ opâ mi fotâcnehuc mâreŋ ʒira hâcne hâmozepac, ŋoŋe ine fotâcnerâ mâreŋ biaŋ forakac i ro rauc enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic ewec irec nikec‐ŋopame wiac qatara‐ŋarewec irec hawari ɋâŋ qâqâtâc wiac henʒipiŋte rucgereŋ‐ŋeŋic banʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne erâ ʒoɋac‐ticnehec hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe sawe mâririackerâ naru motec ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋehec mâreŋ ira juku ŋic ŋokac qizec erâ ɋâŋ qâqâtâc i me i hehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio wiac mamakâcne erâ maŋbâiŋ ecneniŋmuo
ine Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋmu ira jupie mi ʒoraha sipiricke‐jâmbâŋkeniŋmu. No miŋecgac sambâŋ â mâreŋ jahe hone manac ehapire dâŋ ʒi hâcne mukopac.
Eme Wofuŋ e ŋopa bâtâtiec eŋareme siŋsaŋ qarâ ŋicguru gâcne jaŋere ŋondeŋko rahuc ʒanʒaŋne erâ juniŋmu.
Ehuc ɋâŋ qâqâtâc jâc me qânâzi he fasaec ehuc ŋicmezi bakicne erâ wiac hone manac mi eene, me nânâ opâ mi nânâne me wiac âsune mi manaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne araŋ bajarehuc kiŋaŋ qajareniŋmu.
Mâc ŋoŋe ira juhuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic maŋ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋiczi wira basac ecnehuc sâcne bâfuaniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe juku ʒârâ hâriŋ faio juhapie wiac i sasawa maic‐ŋopaocmu dameŋ ira Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋictao risiehuc dâŋticne mana rereŋ eniŋmu.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e buuruc‐ticnehec, irec qâmâtâc eŋarehuc mi sipiric‐ŋopaocmu, me mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ehuc dâŋ mupaŋke‐jarewec irec wâc mi nikeckeocmu.
“Ŋoŋe mi fuarâ juhapie Anutuzi mâreŋko ŋic bâfuawec irecnec fuŋkerâ dameŋ fowefuwec irec maŋnao wiac qeŋ bipinehec ŋoŋe fua‐ŋarewec iŋucne moc ŋic gâcne jaŋe wâc fua‐jareme hone manac embiŋ me? Ŋoŋe irec fuŋne mananiŋte mâreŋ qaŋeŋne ŋifeckonec fuŋkerâ raku ŋifecko tarakac ira ŋic juŋgopieŋ jaŋe mu wioc ejarenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Anuture dâŋ ʒocmaŋkonec fuame manarâ jumbiŋ irec sâc ŋic weni jaŋe wâc manarâ jumbiŋ?
Me Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi Aigita mâreŋko ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko mâsi bahuc ŋicfâc‐ticne bacŋopawec irec sâc mo nemuzi ŋicguru moc jaŋe e jahacne biŋe eniŋte mume wiac hâhâwicne kecʒiŋuc fua‐jareme tâpiri â mesanaŋ‐ticnezi ŋic gâcne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec rocjopawec: Fific guguriŋ, wiac ʒâŋe furu fuŋne fuŋne erâ ʒika â wiac hâhâwicne sâko gâcne gâcne?
Wofuŋ e mocjahazi Anutu, e iŋucne moc mi jukac, irec fuŋne i ŋoŋe hâcne ŋaza ŋowatuc ekicne.
E fuŋne‐ticne ŋaza ŋowatuc eocte dâŋticne sambâŋkonec wahame hone manac embiŋ, â mâreŋko ine ʒocbâruŋ sâko‐ticne honembiŋ, ehuc ʒocmaŋkonec dâŋticne fuame manambiŋ wâc.
E maŋticne mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋerao foha ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic ŋoŋe rowosâec‐ŋoparâ e jahacne tâpirio Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐ŋopa wefuwec.
Ehuc ŋicguru gâcne jaŋe ŋoŋere sâc sirickehuc tâpiri sâkohec jumbiŋ jaŋe ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko jopa jâpec ejarehuc mâreŋ‐jeŋic ro rauc eniŋte ŋare tahac ewec. Eme miŋecgac irec fârine fuakac hâcne.
Irec ŋoŋe miŋecgac dâŋ ʒiŋuc mana maŋ enʒepieŋ: Moczi mâcne, Wofuŋ eki hâcne sambâŋko â mâreŋko Anutu jukac.
Irec dâŋsanaŋ â sâcmutâc‐ticne miŋecgac ŋaza mutâc ekopac i mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ. Iŋuc ehuc ŋaŋacne mecne â ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mecne juhâc qâhâmonʒepieŋ, ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ fosanaŋke‐ŋareocte ŋare tahac ekac ira dameŋ ʒora junʒepieŋ.”
Eme Mose e Jordaŋ opâ ocniŋucnao hae jahec â moc jaŋe ŋeŋezic hae erâ ŋeniŋte rowosâec‐jopawec.
I ʒika qaqa ŋic moczi juwicnao ŋic âgo‐ticne râsi mi ecnehuc â qâhâmoocte wâc mi manasuhuc juku sifu qâhâmoocmuo ine hae ira wiserâ ra juocte iŋuc ewec.
Hae kecʒiŋuc jaŋe hâcne rowosâec‐jopawec: Bezere hae mâreŋ burocnere wâneŋko ŋewec i Rubeŋ guru jaŋere biŋe; Ramoti hae Gileade mâreŋko ŋewec i Gade guru jaŋere biŋe, â Golaŋ hae Basaŋ mâreŋko ŋewec i Manase guru jaŋere biŋe.
Mosezi Israe kikefuŋ sâcmutâc dâŋ mutâcne‐jarewec ʒine hâcne.
Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec wahapie Mosezi dâŋsanaŋ erâ mumutaniŋ â mumutâc dâŋ ʒi jaza‐fârewec.
Ine Jordaŋ opâ ocniŋucnao, Bete‐Peoro hae ŋifecnao Amori ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ Hesiboŋ haeo juwec, ere mâreŋko wâneŋ fokac ira hâcne jazawec. Mose â Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec waharâ ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ e hâcne bawahambiŋ.
Bawaharâ e jahacne â Basaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Ogo jahere mâreŋ ro rauc embiŋ. Jahe Amori ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋzi Jordaŋ opâ ocniŋucnao ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec jupic hâcne.
Aronoŋ wâneŋ qaŋeŋnao Aroe hae ŋekac irecnec fuŋkerâ raku Sirioŋ tikio (Herimoŋ tiki hâcne) tarakac mâreŋ i hâcne ro rauc embiŋ.
Ehuc Araba wâneŋ Jordaŋ ocniŋucnao foraku Hâwec Hâmocnao, Pisiga tiki fuŋnao tarakac i mâmâc ro rauc embiŋ.
Eme Mose e Israe kikefuŋ ʒeŋgoma hetumaŋ‐joparâ kecʒiŋuc jazawec: “O Israe ŋicbureŋ, no miŋecgac dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋ mai‐ŋeŋicko ŋazakopac i aimuŋ mana maŋ ehuc reŋkenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec e Horebe tikio nâŋâcnehec ʒâʒâfic ewec.
Ʒâʒâfic i mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋehec mâcne, ʒiŋuczia juŋgopeneŋ nâŋâcnehec ewec hâcne.
Wofuŋ e ʒocmaŋko juhuc ŋoŋe manahapie dâŋ ŋazawec.
Ehame ŋoŋe dameŋ ira ʒocte hâwic‐ŋopame tikio mi fembiŋ, irec noni ŋic â Wofuŋ ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko domahuc dâŋticne mutâcne‐ŋarepo. E dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec:
“‘Noni Wofuŋ gore Anutu, noni hâcne Aigita mâreŋ, kâpâcwaru fic hâcne, irecnec bataracgupo.
“‘Go nore maio nemu burec wiac moc mi bajuzemec.
“‘Go ɋâŋ qâqâtâc moc barâ mi bajuzemec, sambâŋko mecne, mâreŋko mecne, opâo mecne, mâreŋmaŋko mecne, wiac forakac irec qâqâtâc moc mi bazemec.
Go wiac i araŋ bacnehuc kiŋaŋ moc mi qacnezemec; no Wofuŋ gore Anutu hâcne, no ʒoɋac‐nanehec. No qaisocnueŋgopieŋ jaŋe kiŋjeŋicte okacne naru motec ŋosafâc‐jeŋic bazu‐jare raekopac.
Â ŋic tauseŋ gurune gurune maŋzi ʒâficnuhuc dâŋnane reŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine ehâmo‐jarehuc juekopac.
“‘Wofuŋge Anutu ere ʒâŋe mi sipirickezemec, ʒâŋe‐ticne sipirickeocmu ŋic e Wofuŋzi mi akickeocmu.
“‘Go sabata hombaŋ i Wofuŋ Anutugezi mutâcne‐garewec irec sâc tiri foocte manasuzemec.
Go ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 giege baku bafârezemec.
Ʒoaŋ 7 i ine Wofuŋge Anutu ere hombaŋ ekac, irec ʒoaŋ ira gie moc mi bazemec; go mecne, ŋokâge mecne, otâge mecne, kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge ŋic me ŋokac jaŋe mecne, bulimakao â doŋgifâcge jaŋe mecne erâ ŋic furunezi ficgao juekac e mecne, ŋoŋe hâcne ʒoaŋ ira gie moc mi banʒepieŋ. Iŋuc ehuc kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge jaŋe gohec mâmâc ŋemananʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Aigita mâreŋko kiŋaŋ qaqa juhapie Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e tâpiri â mesanaŋ‐ticnezi irecnec jowac‐ŋopa wahawec irec manasuhuc junʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e irec hâcne sabata hombaŋ ŋeniŋte ŋaza mutâc ewec.
“‘Go Wofuŋ Anutugezi mutâcne‐garewec irec sâc neŋgoc mamac jahecge sâsec‐jofazemec; iŋuc ehuc Anutu no mâreŋ râecgupemu ira dameŋ ʒora juhâc qâhâmocmu.
“‘Go ʒika mi qazemec.
“‘Ŋowe ŋonâŋ ŋohe bebehec mi ezepirec.
“‘Go fiuc mi rozemec.
“‘Go ŋic âgoge micko âkec mi ecnezemec.
“‘Go ŋic âgofâcge jaŋere ŋokac, me fic hae‐jeŋic, me giegaŋ wiac‐jeŋic, me kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic ŋic me ŋokac, me bulimakao â doŋgifâc‐jeŋic, me wiac‐jeŋic i me i irec andac mi ezemec.’
“Wofuŋ e tikio ʒocmaŋko â karorac maŋko erâ duŋdapâc maŋko juhuc dâŋ hahaŋne bahuc sâcmutâc dâŋ i hâcne kikefuŋ ŋoŋe ŋaza‐fârewec. Ŋaza‐fârerâ dâŋ ʒuhuckerâ moc mi muwec. Ehuc dâŋ i qorac tapa jajahecko qâreŋkerâ narewec.
Ŋoŋe ine ʒocbâruŋzi tiki sâockeha duŋdapâc maŋkonec dâŋ fuame manahapie gurune gurune irec soŋaŋ micnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe nore maŋfuŋko fisimbiŋ.
Fisirâ kecʒiŋuc nazambiŋ: ‘Manakic, Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec e tâpiri â huriri qâreŋ‐ticnere fuŋne nâzâ nâwotuc eha dâŋticne ʒocmaŋkonec fuame manambeneŋ. Ŋic jaŋe Anutuhec muc manac ehuc sifu mi hâmoeŋgopieŋ, nâŋâc miŋecgac iŋuc hâcne honembeneŋ.
Eme ʒi wemocte hâmozo eŋgopeneŋ? Ʒocbâruŋ sâko kecizi ʒâseŋ‐nâpozo ekac hâcne, irec Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec ere dâŋfâŋâŋ mocwâc mananaŋmuo ine hâmonaŋmu.
Mo mâreŋŋiczi Anutu jujunere dâŋfâŋâŋ ʒocmaŋkonec fuame manambeneŋ irec sâc manarâ mi hâmoocmu?
Irec go bembeŋko rarâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋecte dâŋ manazemec, erâ dâŋ gazaocmu sâc i risie nâzâtec mana rereŋ enʒepeneŋ.’
“Eme Wofuŋ e dâŋ nazambiŋ i manarâ kecʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Ŋic ŋokac jaŋe dâŋ gazapie manapac, erâ dâŋ mumbieŋ sasawa i manape sâcke‐fârekac.
Jaŋe maŋjeŋic norao domaha araŋ banarehuc sâcmutâc dâŋnane sasawa mana rereŋ ehuc jaŋacne â ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe dameŋ ʒora juhâc qâhâmoniŋte enarekac hâcne.
Irec go ra ʒiŋuc jazac: “Ŋoŋe qoruc boze‐ŋeŋicko risieniŋ.”
Go gahac ine ʒira nore maŋfuŋko domazemec, eme no sâcmutâc dâŋ â dâŋsanaŋ erâ mumutâc dâŋ sasawa qazu‐jarecmu i gazapemu. Eme jaŋe mâreŋ jarepe ro rauc eniŋmu ira juhuc mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ.’
Irec ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ŋaza mutâc ewec irec sâc ebac eniŋte aimuŋ junʒepieŋ, ehuc hata qâsorierâ fâreopec me qanaopec moc mi ranʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hata mutâcne‐ŋarewec ira rahuc juku mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋmu ira dameŋ ʒora juhâc qâhâmoniŋmu.
