“Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi sâcmutâc dâŋ â dâŋsanaŋ erâ mumutâc dâŋ naza mutâc ewec i qazu‐ŋarepe ŋoŋe mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋte raŋgopieŋ ira juhuc mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ŋoŋe â naru motec ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic araŋ bacnehuc sâcmutâc dâŋ â dâŋsanaŋ‐ticne ŋaza mutâc ekopac i juniŋmu sâc mana maŋ enʒepieŋ, iŋuc ehuc dameŋ ʒora jufeniŋmu hâcne.
Irec Israe kikefuŋ ŋoŋe dâŋ i manarâ aimuŋ soŋaŋkehuc mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mupaŋke‐ŋarewec irec sâc susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkehuc foekac mâreŋ ira juhâc qâhâmohuc sawe mâririackeniŋmu.
“O Israe kikefuŋ, ŋoŋe mananiŋ: Wofuŋ e mocjahazi Anutu‐nâŋec jukac.
Irec ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic â qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋic â ʒoɋac‐ŋeŋic Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic furu jaha qikiŋnecnepie fozejec.
Ehame miŋecgac ŋaza mutâc ekopac dâŋ i hâcne maŋkenʒepieŋ.
Erâ naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic aijakic jaha qazu‐jarehuc ficko ŋec foc eniŋmu me hata juniŋmu me fo faharec eniŋmu sâc irec dâŋ muc manac enʒepieŋ.
Erâ irec manasuhuc juniŋte qâreŋkerâ meŋeŋicko â mai‐ŋeŋicko bândeŋnepie fozejec.
Ehuc ficwâtuŋ â sacmotâc‐ŋeŋicko mâmâc qâreŋkepie fozejec wâc.
“Eme Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo mâreŋ ŋareocte mupaŋke‐jarewec ira jowac‐ŋopa rarâ, hae kâcɋene ŋoŋe tâmiricko basarickekicne ŋerakac i ŋare tahac eocmu.
Ehuc wiac biaŋnezi ŋoŋe tâmiricko fic hefusucmakicne erâ opâ nombâŋ ŋoŋe tâmiricko rokicne, â waiŋ gie â oliwa jâc ŋoŋe tâmiricko jaha sarakicne i wâc ŋare tahac eocmu. Irec ŋoŋe nâ gapec ehuc
Wofuŋ Aigita mâreŋ, kâpâcwâru fic hâcne, irecnec batarac‐ŋoparâ jowac‐ŋopa wahawec ere moc nikec‐ŋopazacte rucgereŋ‐ŋeŋic banʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic araŋ bacnehuc kiŋaŋ qacnenʒepieŋ, ehuc ere ʒâŋeo ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ dâŋŋeŋic munʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic gurune gurune rârec‐ŋopahuc juraŋgopieŋ jaŋere nemufâc jaŋerao mi qohotanʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko juekac e ʒoɋac‐ticnehec, irec e maŋbâiŋ ecnepie mâreŋkonec bâsirowec‐ŋopazacte iŋuc moc mi enʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic Masa opâo (Meriba opâ hâcne) ira eatuckembiŋ iŋuc jaha mocwâc mi eatuckenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic sâcmutâc â mumutaniŋ dâŋ â dâŋsanaŋ‐ticne ŋaza mutâc ewec i aijakic jaha mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc Wofuŋzi maname sâckeekac wiac i hâcne ehuc junʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc juhâc qâhâmoniŋmu erâ Wofuŋzi mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ biaŋ jare tahac eocte mupaŋke‐jarewec i sâcne ro rauc eniŋmu.
Ehuc Wofuŋzi mupaŋke‐ŋarewec irec sâc râsifâc‐ŋeŋic wâc jopa jâpec ejareniŋmu.
“Juku ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ʒiŋuc mecne wio‐ŋareniŋmu: ‘Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi mumutaniŋ â mumutâc dâŋ erâ dâŋsanaŋ ŋaza mutâc ewec irec fuŋne weniŋuc fokac?’
Iŋuc wio‐ŋarepie dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazanʒepieŋ: ‘Nâŋe Aigita mâreŋko Faraore kiŋaŋ qaqa jumbeŋ; Wofuŋ eki ine mesanaŋ‐ticnezi Aigita mâreŋkonec batarac‐nâpowec.
Ehuc mume ʒâŋe fai‐nâŋecko wiac ʒâŋe furu â mâsi hâhâwicne â bipic tataranehec Aigita mâreŋko erâ Farao â kikefuŋfâcne jaŋerao fuawec.
Erâ mamacfâc‐nâŋec mâreŋ jareocte mupaŋke‐jarewec ira hâcne râec‐nâpohuc mâreŋ i nâre tahac eocte Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐nâpo wahawec.
Ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec araŋ bacnepene, miŋecgac juhâmoŋgopeneŋ irec sâc hone maiŋ enâreha dâŋsanaŋ i sasawa mana rereŋ efârehuc juhâc qâhâmonaŋte nâzâ mutâc ewec.
Eme Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec e sâcmutâc keci nâzâ mutâc ewec i ere maio aijakic jaha mana rereŋ efârepene irec erâ mana‐nâreme kiŋnâŋec taraocmu.’
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae mâreŋ biŋe qaŋarewec i ro rauc eniŋte jowac‐ŋopa fisihuc ŋicguru bocjaha, Hitiŋic, Girigasi ŋic, Amori ŋic, Kanaaŋ ŋic, Periʒi ŋic, Hiwiŋic â Jebusi ŋic, ŋicguru 7 ŋoŋere sâc sirickehuc tâpiri sâkohec juŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne ŋoŋere erâ jopa jâpec ejareocmu.
Eme Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi meŋeŋicko râec‐jopame bawahac‐jopahuc jopa qâmiziec ejarenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ehuc moc mi akic‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Erâ jaŋehec roroc babac mi enʒepieŋ, ehuc narufâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere motecfâc mi jarenʒepieŋ â jaŋere narufâc jaŋe motecfâc‐ŋeŋic mi rocjopanʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe motecfâc‐ŋeŋic ejarepie no behecnurâ nemu gâcne kiŋaŋ qajareniŋmu. Iŋuc epie Wofuŋ no kimbeŋ qaŋarehuc acmâc jaha sipiric‐ŋopa‐jâmbâŋkepemu.
Ŋoŋe ine kecʒiŋuc ejarenʒepieŋ: Alata wiac‐jeŋic hetâc qâtâtienʒepieŋ, ɋâŋwâtuŋ wiac‐jeŋic henʒaŋ qanʒaŋnenʒepieŋ. Aserim nemu wâtuŋ‐ticne hetâc qâtâcnenʒepieŋ, erâ ɋâŋ qâqâtâc wiac‐jeŋic i ʒocko behepie ʒazejec.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte biŋe erâ juniŋte rowosâec‐ŋopakicne. Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e mâreŋte faio ŋic gurune gurune juraŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec ŋoŋe hâcne ere biŋe juniŋte rowosâec‐ŋopawec.
Ŋoŋe ŋic gâcne siric‐jopahuc bocjaha jumbiŋte mi rowosâec‐ŋopakicne, aricne, ŋoŋe ŋic afecne sawa jumbiŋ.
Wofuŋ e maŋjauŋ eŋareekac â mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic dâŋ mupaŋke‐jarewec, irec erâ mesanaŋ‐ticnezi kâpâcwâru, Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Faraore meonec hâcne batarac‐ŋoparâ jowac‐ŋopa wahawec.
Irec ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc mananʒepieŋ: Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec eki mocjaha Anutu fârine. Eki hâcne maŋjeŋic erao râehuc sâcmutâc dâŋticne mana rereŋ eeŋgopieŋ jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ehuc aki anonoc ejare rahuc juocmu sanaŋ.
Â e qaisockehuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine sipiric‐jopahuc okacne bazu‐jareocmu. Ine hâcne, e qaisockeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe okacne bazu‐jareocte ŋeŋe ʒeʒepec mi eocmu.
Irec ŋoŋe sâcmutâc dâŋ â dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋ miŋecgac ŋaza mutâc ekopac i aijakic jaha mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe mumutâc dâŋ keci mananiŋmuo ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic eki ʒâʒâfic â aki anonoc irec dâŋ mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mupaŋke‐jarewec i iŋuc jaha soŋaŋkehuc juocmu.
E maŋjauŋ eŋareocmu â jambuŋ‐ŋopaocmu erâ basawec‐ŋopaocmu, ehuc ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic â mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko wiac nânâne fua‐fâreocmu, padi jacgoŋ‐ŋeŋic mecne, waiŋ‐ŋeŋic mecne, oliwa wokemaŋ‐ŋeŋic mecne erâ lama bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic motecne juŋareŋgopieŋ i mâmâc mâreŋ ŋareocte mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mupaŋke‐jarewec ira juhapie jambuŋ‐jopaocmu.
Ŋoŋe ŋicguru gâcne jaŋere sâc jâuruhuc jambuŋ‐ŋopame ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic aputacne me ŋokac â bulimakao hufiŋne moc mi junʒepieŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋ e huc wiac sasawa bârârie‐ŋareme Aigita ŋic jaŋere hucukic repicne hone manac embiŋ i ŋoŋe moc mi fua‐ŋarezejec, aricne, ŋic qaisoc‐ŋopaeŋgopieŋ jaŋere faio ine mume feocmu.
Ehame ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ŋic meŋeŋicko râec‐jopaocmu jaŋe honec‐joparâ busâqoc moc mi mana‐jarehuc jopa sipiric ejare‐fârenʒepieŋ. Erâ nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋe wâc kiŋaŋ mi qajarenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe kiŋaŋ qajarehuc sahac‐ŋeŋic seroŋ baniŋmu hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋiczi ʒiŋuc mecne muniŋmu: ‘Ŋicguru keci jaŋe nâŋere sâc sirickehuc tâpiri sâkohec eŋgopieŋ, irec weniŋuc erâ mâreŋ‐jeŋic ro rauc enaŋmu?’
Ŋoŋe iŋuc muhuc mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec, aricne, Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi Farao â Aigita ŋic ʒeŋgoma wiac hâhâwicne ejarewec irec manasunʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe honehapie tâpiri‐ticnere fuŋne bataniŋkehuc wiac ʒâŋe furu â mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bâfuarâ tâpiri mesanaŋ‐ticnezi Aigita mâreŋkonec rocŋoparâ bacŋopa wahawec, sâc ijaha râsifâc‐ŋeŋic keci jaŋe sipiric‐jopaocmu.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e iŋuc ehuc wâc bitu gâpâc fuŋmoc ejareme ki bâʒâic ejarekupie ʒanʒaŋne juniŋmu me ŋoŋere hâwic‐jopame soŋkeniŋmu jaŋe omaeniŋmu.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic, Anutu kâcɋene â ʒoɋac‐ticnehec e ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jukacte jaŋere mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e ŋic gurune gurune keci jaŋe uneŋ uneŋ jopa qâhâmoc ejareocmu. Eme qowi mimicne jaŋe nâcjopahuc boc fua sawec erâ ŋoŋe mâmâc nâcŋopanʒipiŋte ŋic keci jaŋe acmâc jaha mi bâsirowec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic eki ine meŋeŋicko râec‐jopahuc maŋ bâsifuc ejarekume sipirickeniŋmu hâcne.
E ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe wâc meŋeŋicko râec‐jopame ŋoŋe mâreŋko ʒâŋe biŋe‐jeŋic bawahapie omaezejec. Ŋic moczi moc sanaŋkerâ mi domaha bâsirowec‐jopa‐fâreniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe nemu ɋâŋ qâqâtâc wiac‐jeŋic sasawa ʒocko behepie ʒafârezejec. Ɋâŋ qâqâtâc siliwa â golzi ɋorockekicne i rohuc sahac‐ŋeŋic seroŋ banʒipiŋte me ŋaŋacne biŋe eocte irec andac mi enʒepieŋ. Wiac izi hâcne Wofuŋte maio mamakâcne ekac.
Erâ ŋoŋe wiac mamakâcne i ficŋeŋicko moc mi bafenʒepieŋ. Iŋuc ehuc sâwec hotâckenʒipiŋte wiac sâwec bâbâfuanehec i qikiŋne behec efârenʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe ʒuhuckerâ juhuc sawe mâririackeniŋte â Wofuŋzi mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ jare tahac eocte mupaŋke‐jarewec i ro rauc eniŋte miŋecgac sâcmutâc dâŋ sasawa ŋaza mutâc ekopac i aijakic jaha mana rereŋ efârenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ burocnao jara 40 jowa qataŋ eŋare warehuc juwec hata irec wâc manasunʒepieŋ. E maŋŋeŋicko dâŋ weniŋucne fowec erâ sâcmutâc dâŋ mana rereŋ embiŋ me mâcne irec fuŋne manaocte esâic‐ŋopahuc bawahac‐ŋopawec hâcne.
E bawahac‐ŋopame nânâre hâmo sipiric epie ŋaŋacne â mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mana kâuc bambiŋ i hâcne gumec‐ŋopawec. I ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc mana taraniŋte iŋuc eŋarewec: Ŋiczi nânâre sawa mi juhâmoocmu, Wofuŋte mickonec dâŋ wahame sâc manahuc juhâmoocmu.
Jara 40 sâko juwefuhapie ŋaqi wiac‐ŋeŋic tâcne ʒaŋ mi ewec â kike‐ŋeŋiczi soka siwiŋ wâc mi ewec.
Irec ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ: Ŋic moczi ŋokâ‐ticne qa bâtiŋ ecneekac irec sâc jaha Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ŋoŋe qa bâtiŋ eŋareekac.
Ŋoŋe iŋuc mana tararâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic araŋ bacnehuc ere kike hata bâjâperâ sâcmutâc dâŋticne mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e mâreŋ biaŋne moc tiki â wâneŋ‐ticnao opâ ʒâŋe â riqic wiac forakac ira râec‐ŋopaocmu.
Mâreŋ ira hâcne padi jacgoŋ fuaekac, erâ jâmbo â waiŋ, nemuja â oliwa jâc fuarâ doma rahapie ombâŋ‐jeŋicko baŋac wâc mâmâc âteekac.
Ŋoŋe mâreŋ ira nânâ bocjaha nâ gapec ehuc wiac moc mi basaniŋmu. Mâreŋ irec qânâmaŋko aeŋ fokac â tikimaŋkonec aeŋ bâbâroŋ wise gufuc erâ roniŋmu.
Irec ŋoŋe ira juhuc nânâ nâ gapec erâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ biaŋne ŋare tahac ewec e muteŋ bâteŋ ecnenʒepieŋ.
“No miŋecgac sâcmutâc â mumutâc dâŋ erâ dâŋsanaŋ ŋaza mutâc ekopac i mana rereŋ mi ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte nikec‐ŋopazacte rucgereŋ‐ŋeŋic bahuc junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe nânâ nâ gapec ehuc fic wiac biaŋne basarickerâ ira ŋec foc eniŋmu
me lama bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic â siliwa â gol wiac‐ŋeŋic erâ wâcwiac‐ŋeŋic gâcne sasawa sawe mâririackeme
maŋfefe ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic kâpâcwâru fic, Aigita mâreŋkonec hâcne batarac‐ŋopawec ere nikec‐ŋopazacte rucgereŋ‐ŋeŋic banʒepieŋ.
Eki hâcne mâreŋ burocne kâcɋene â hâhâwicne sâko homa momori â omeqaqa fusucmakicne ira jowa qataŋ eŋarewec, erâ ekizia mâreŋ kereŋnao mume qânâ sanaŋ jomirekicnaonec opâ wahawec.
Erâ wâc mâreŋ burocnao mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mana kâuc bambiŋ i hâcne gumec‐ŋopawec. Erâ i bawahac‐ŋopahuc esâic‐ŋoparâ ʒâhec mocwâc ehâmo‐ŋareocte iŋuc eŋarewec.
Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc munʒipiŋte rucgereŋ‐ŋeŋic banʒepieŋ: ‘Menâŋec â tâpiri‐nâŋecte fârine mâriri sâko ʒi bâfuaŋgopeneŋ hâcne.’
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte manasuhuc junʒepieŋ, eki hâcne mazuc mâriri bâfuaniŋte tâpiri râe‐ŋareekac; e ʒâʒâfic‐ticnere dâŋ mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mupaŋke‐jarewec i basanaŋkeocte iŋuc hâcne eŋareekac.
No miŋecgac uŋdâŋ kecʒiŋuc ŋazakopac: Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte nikec‐ŋopame nemu gâcne bâjâpec‐joparâ kiŋaŋ qajarehuc araŋ bajareniŋmuo ine sipiricke‐jâmbâŋkeniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte dâŋ mana rereŋ mi epie Wofuŋzi ŋic gurune gurune ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko bâsirowec‐jopawec irec sâc jaha ŋoŋe bâsirowec‐ŋopaocmu.
“O Israe kikefuŋ, ŋoŋe mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe Kanaaŋ mâreŋko raʒirâ ŋic gurune gurune ŋoŋere sâc sirickehuc kâcɋene â tâpiri sâkohec juŋgopieŋ jaŋere hae kâcɋene basanaŋkekicne erâ bafekupie sambâŋ heuazo ekac i ro rauc eniŋte miŋecgac Jordaŋ opâ fotâcneniŋmu.
Jaŋe ŋic kâcɋene â ʒoricne, Anaka ere ɋâricfâc hâcne; ŋoŋe jaŋere dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupie manaeŋgopieŋ: ‘Mo ŋiczi Anaka ɋâricfâc‐ticne sâcne sanaŋke‐jareocmu?’
Irec ŋoŋe miŋecgac ʒiŋuc mananʒepieŋ: Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne bânie‐ŋarehuc ŋic keci jaŋe bawahac‐joparâ ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko sipiric‐jopaocmu; irec Wofuŋzi mupaŋke‐ŋarewec irec sâc jopa jâpec ejarehuc ɋeŋ jaha omaec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
“Wofuŋzi ŋic keci jaŋe ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko jopa qâtâtiec ejareme maŋŋeŋiczi kecʒiŋuc mi munʒepieŋ: ‘Wofuŋ e tiŋne juju‐nâŋecte erâ mâreŋ ʒi ro rauc enaŋte bacnâpo warewec.’ Aricne, Wofuŋ e ŋic gurune gurune keci jaŋe hehesic‐jeŋicte erâ ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko jopa jâpec ejareocnu.
Ŋoŋe tiŋne â maŋɋaɋac juju‐ŋeŋicte erâ mâcne, ŋic gurune gurune keci jaŋere hehesicte erâ mâreŋ i ro rauc eniŋmu. Wofuŋ e irec hâcne ŋic keci jaŋe ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko jopa jâpec ejareocmu; erâ wâc mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo dâŋ mupaŋke‐jarewec i basanaŋkeocte iŋuc eocmu.
“Irec ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc mananʒepieŋ: Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e mâreŋ biaŋne ʒi tiŋne juju‐ŋeŋicte erâ ŋare tahac mi eocmu; ŋoŋe ŋicguru râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne hâcne.
Ŋoŋe mâreŋ burocnao Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic maŋbâiŋ ecnembiŋ irec manasuhuc mi nikec‐ŋopazejec. Ŋoŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec wahambiŋ dameŋ ira fuŋkerâ Wofuŋte dâŋ qatara warehuc juku hae mâreŋ ʒira fisimbiŋ.
Ŋoŋe Horebe tikio ira Wofuŋ maŋbâiŋ hâhâwicne ecnepie aaric mana‐ŋarehuc sipiric‐ŋopazo muwec.
Eme no Wofuŋzi ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic ewec irec qorac tapa ropemurâ tikio ferâ ŋafe ʒoaŋ 40 juhuc nânâ opâ moc mi nâpo.
Ehame Wofuŋ Anutu e qorac tapa jajahec e jahacne mezi qâreŋkerâ narewec. Ŋoŋe tumaŋnehapie Wofuŋzi tikio ʒocbâruŋ maŋko juhuc dâŋ nazawec i sasawa qorac tapa ira hâcne qâreŋkekicne fowec.
Eme ŋafe ʒoaŋ 40 tarame Wofuŋzi ʒâʒâfic qorac tapa jajahec i narewec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Ajoc, go ŋicfâcge Aigita mâreŋkonec bacjopa waremeŋ jaŋe wiac mamakâcne eŋgopieŋte biac faharerâ huc. Jaŋe hata jaza jowatuc epo i biac râpeckehuc aeŋzi ɋâŋ qâqâtâc moc bambiŋ.’
“Erâ Wofuŋ e ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Manakic, no ŋicguru keci jaŋe râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne jaha juhapie honec‐jopakopac.
Irec behehaŋ bâsirowec‐jopape ʒâŋe biŋe‐jeŋic mâreŋko omaezejec; ehame go basawecgupe jaŋere sâc sirickehuc ŋicguru kâcɋene â tâpiri sâkohec ezemec.’
Iŋuc nazame forisierâ tikionec wahapo; ehuc qorac tapa jajahec bacjofa wahahape tikio ʒoc bâruŋkehuc domawec.
Eme ʒâŋe firâ ʒiŋuc honec‐ŋopapo: Ŋoŋe wiac mamakâcne ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic bunao bahuc bulimakao ɋâŋ qâqâtâc moc bambiŋ; ŋoŋe Wofuŋzi hata ŋaza mutâc ewec i biac beherâ qâsoriembiŋ hâcne.
No iŋuc honerâ qorac tapa jajahec bacjofa wahapo i ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko behepe qanʒaŋnewec.
Eme mârâc epo iŋuc jaha ehuc Wofuŋ fodapecnehuc juhape ŋafe ʒoaŋ 40 tarawec; erâ ŋoŋe sâqocne barâ Wofuŋte maio wiac mamakâcne ehuc bunao bambiŋte erâ nânâ opâ moc mi nâhuc jupo.
Erâ Wofuŋ e aarickeme kimbeŋ qaŋarehuc bâsirowec‐ŋopazo muwec irec hâwicnume wira wâwâsic ecnepo; eme Wofuŋ e dameŋ ira wâc mana‐narewec.
Erâ Wofuŋ e Aroŋte wâc aarickeme bâsirowezo mume ere erâ mâmâc numucnepo.
Eme tikionec waharâ bulimakao ɋâŋ qâqâtâc bambiŋ, wiac repicne i hâcne ʒocko behepe ʒame rorâ henʒaŋ qanʒaŋnepe uucne eme opâ tikionec wahahuc fokac ira tiepe huwec.
“Ŋoŋe Tabera â Masa erâ Kibero‐Hatawa hae mâreŋ ira wâc iŋuc jaha Wofuŋ maŋbâiŋ ecnepie aarickewec.
Eme Wofuŋ e Kadesi‐Baranea haeonec ʒiŋuc muhuc sorec‐ŋopawec: ‘Ŋoŋe ferâ mâreŋ ŋare tahac epo i ro rauc enʒepieŋ’; iŋuc muhuc ŋazame ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte sâcmutâc dâŋ qatararâ e jahacne mi manasiŋkehuc dâŋticne wâc mi reŋkembiŋ.
No fuŋkerâ manac‐ŋopapo dameŋ ira hâcne Wofuŋ fecnehuc jumbiŋzi juŋgopieŋ jaha.
“Wofuŋzi bâsirowec‐ŋopazo muwecte ŋafe ʒoaŋ 40 ere maio fodaperâ fohuc jupo.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc muhuc Wofuŋ wâsickepo: ‘O Wofuŋ Anutu, go ŋicfâcge â ʒâŋetucfâcge tâpiri sâko â mesanaŋgezi Aigita mâreŋkonec batarac‐joparâ jowac‐jopa wahameŋ jaŋe mi bâsirowec‐jopac.
Go kiŋaŋŋicfâcge Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo jaŋere manasuhuc ŋicguru ʒi maŋsanaŋ â hehesic erâ sâqocne‐jeŋichec jaŋe honec‐jopatec boc mi gâpârezejec.
Iŋuc mi etec Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐nâpo wahameŋ irec rune jaŋe ʒiŋuc munʒipiŋte: “Wofuŋ e mâreŋ mupaŋke‐jarewec ira râec‐jopazo eipierâ qaisoc‐jopahuc mâreŋ burocnao jopa qâhâmoc ejareocte jowac‐jopa rawec.”
Jaŋe ŋicfâcge â ʒâŋetucfâcge tâpiri sâko â mesanaŋgezi jowac‐jopa wahameŋ hâcne.’
“Dameŋ ira Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Qorac tapa jajahec mârâc fasaec‐jofakicne iŋucne mocwâc fasaec‐jofarâ tikio norao bawefuzemec, erâ jâczi katapa wâc bazemec.
Eme qorac tapa qanʒaŋnemeŋ irec fainao dâŋqâreŋ fowec ijaha qâreŋkepe katapa maŋko râetec huzejec.’
Iŋuc nazame jâmiŋjâczi katapa bapo, erâ qorac tapa jajahec mârâc fasaec‐jofakicne iŋucne mocwâc fasaec‐jofarâ tikio bacjofarâ fepo.
Eme ŋoŋe tumaŋnehapie Wofuŋzi tikio ʒocbâruŋ maŋko juhuc Sâcmutâc Sanaŋ Teŋ ŋazawec i mârâc qâreŋkekicne irec sâc jaha qorac tapao qâreŋkerâ narewec.
Nareme forisierâ tikionec waharâ qorac tapa i Wofuŋzi mutâcne‐narewec irec sâc ehuc katapa bapo irec maŋnao râepe hurâ fowec fokac jaha.”
Eme Israe ŋicguru jaŋe Beroti‐Bene‐Jakaŋ teuŋkonec faharerâ raku Mosera haeo fisimbiŋ. Eme Aroŋ e ira hâcne hâmome duckembiŋ, ehame ŋokâ‐ticne Eleaʒa e tucticne qarâ taha bapa juwec.
Eme jaŋe irecnec ʒuhuckerâ raku Gudogoda haeo fisirâ fombiŋ. Erâ irecnec raku Jotibata hae mâreŋko fisimbiŋ. Hae mâreŋ ira opâ wiac bocjaha forawec.
Eme Wofuŋ e dameŋ ira Lewiŋic jaŋe ʒâʒâfic katapa‐ticne reŋkerâ ere maio kiŋaŋ gie bahuc ŋic Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo ʒuhuc‐joparâ jambuŋ‐jopaniŋte rowosâec‐jopawec. Eme jaŋe gie i hâcne bambiŋzi bahuc juŋgopieŋ jaha.
Eme irec hâcne Lewiŋic jaŋe qomâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ mâreŋ wiac ro rauc mi eniŋmu. Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi jazawec irec sâc rujeŋic erâ juhuc hone bafic ejareocmu.
Mosezi ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Eme no mârâc epo iŋuc jaha ehuc tikio juhape ŋafe ʒoaŋ 40 tarawec, ehame dameŋ ira Wofuŋ numucnepe mana‐narewec wâc; ehuc sipiric‐ŋopaocte boc mi afeckewec.
Wofuŋ e iŋuc erâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Ajoc, go faharerâ ŋic micne bajaretec hata ʒuhuckerâ raku mamacfâc‐jeŋic mâreŋ mupaŋke‐jarepo ira fisirâ ro rauc enʒepieŋ.’
“O Israe ŋicbureŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e wiac kecʒiŋuc jaha eniŋte ŋaza mutâc ekac: Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu araŋ bacnehuc ere kike hata bâjâpenʒepieŋ, ehuc maŋŋeŋic erao râepie domaha maŋ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋiczi kiŋaŋ qacnenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc Wofuŋte sâcmutâc dâŋ â dâŋsanaŋ miŋecgac ŋaza mutâc ekopac i hâcne mana rereŋ ehuc juhâc qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, sambâŋ â mâreŋ â irec maŋnao wiac fokac sasawa i Wofuŋte biŋe.
Ehame sifu mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic maŋjauŋ ejarehuc ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic ŋoŋe ŋic gurune gurune jaŋeraonec rowosâec‐ŋopame ŋicfâc‐ticne erâ jumbiŋzi juŋgopieŋ jaha.
Irec ŋoŋe maŋrâŋgeŋ‐ŋeŋic beherâ maŋuruc junʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e nemu jaŋere femicne â ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere Wofuŋ, e hâcne Anutu fekicne â tâpiri‐ticnehec â araŋ babacnehec, e ra rowec ware rowec mi focnekac â bâbâmiriŋ moneŋ wâc mi roekac.
E hozec bekâ jaŋe roroŋ sasabec ejarehuc dâŋjeŋicte bafic‐jopaekac, ehuc ŋic jabane maŋjauŋ ejarehuc nânâ opâ â ŋaqi qoruc wiac jare tahac eekac.
Irec ŋoŋe ŋic jabane maŋjauŋ jaha ejarenʒepieŋ; ŋoŋe hâcne Aigita mâreŋko jabane jumbiŋ wâc.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic araŋ bacnenʒepieŋ, ehuc kiŋaŋ qacnehuc erao qohotanʒepieŋ, erâ ere ʒâŋeo ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ dâŋŋeŋic mupaŋkenʒepieŋ.
E hâcne mumuteŋ‐ŋeŋic â Anutu‐ŋeŋic, wiac hâhâwicne â bipic tataranehec ʒâŋe fâri‐ŋeŋiczi honembiŋ i eki hâcne mume fuawec.
Mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ŋic ŋokac 70 sawazi Aigita mâreŋko humbiŋ, ʒi ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi basawec‐ŋopame ŋic guru sâko jâmbâŋ embiŋ juŋgopieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe irec hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic erao maŋŋeŋic râepie foha micdâŋ â dâŋsanaŋ erâ mumutâc â sâcmutâc dâŋticne dameŋ sâc mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e ŋoŋerao bâbâtiŋ gie bahuc fekicne juju â tâpiri â mesanaŋ‐ticnere fuŋne bataniŋkewec i hone mana tarac efârenʒepieŋ. (No naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe wiac i fuame hone manac mi embiŋte jaŋere mi mukopac.)
Wofuŋzi hâcne Aigita mâreŋko Farao â ŋicfâc‐ticne sasawa jaŋerao wiac ʒâŋe furu â mâsi fuŋne fuŋne ebac ewec.
Ehuc Aigita momori ŋic â becâsic keretac wiac‐jeŋichec sipiric‐jopa‐fârewec, erâ jâpec‐ŋopahuc Hâwec Bâbâroŋ fotâcnehapie hâweczi qâuruc‐jopaha Wofuŋzi bâsirowec‐jopawec. Wiac iŋuc fuawec fokac.
Wofuŋ e mâreŋ burocnao ehâmo‐ŋare warehuc juha mâreŋ ʒira fisimbiŋ.
Erâ ekizia mume mâreŋ fâuckerâ aŋkehuc Rubeŋte ŋokâ Eliaba ere ŋokâ jahec Dataŋ â Abiram â wiacfâc‐jekic erâ qoruc boze â wiac jujunefâc‐jekic sasawa ɋâcjopa‐fârewec.
Wofuŋzi wiac sâko ebac ewec i ŋoŋe hâcne ʒâŋe fâri‐ŋeŋiczi honembiŋ.
“Ŋoŋe irec hâcne miŋecgac sâcmutâc dâŋ ŋaza mutâc ekopac i reŋkenʒepieŋ, iŋuc ehuc sanaŋkerâ mâreŋ razo eŋgopieŋ ira raʒirâ ro rauc eniŋmu.
Erâ Wofuŋzi mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic â mamac ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ jareocte mupaŋke‐jarewec ira hâcne dameŋ ʒora juniŋmu. Mâreŋ i susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeekac.
Mâreŋ raʒirâ ro rauc eniŋmu i Aigita mâreŋ beherâ warembiŋ iŋucne aricne; ŋoŋe ira hâcne gie‐ŋeŋic he sarac ehuc monʒaŋ gie iŋucne opâ râe jumbieŋ.
Mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋmu i ine tiki â wâneŋ‐ticnehec, ehame hoezi hehuc bâgunuckeekac.
Mâreŋ i Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e jahac soŋaŋkeekac, ehuc jara moc irec fufuŋkenao fuŋkerâ mâreŋ i hone ʒiziwehuc juhame jara taraekac.
“Ŋoŋe miŋecgac sâcmutâc dâŋ ŋaza mutâc ekopac i mana rereŋ ehuc maŋŋeŋic Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic erao râepie domaha maŋ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋiczi kiŋaŋ qacneniŋmuo
ine eki mume hoe ʒoaŋ jahe mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic sâckoa bacnehapire padi jacgoŋ erâ waiŋ â oliwa wokemaŋ wiac fua biaŋ eme ro nusec eniŋmu.
Erâ Wofuŋzia mume bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere kecɋaŋ wiac fua biaŋ eocmu. Wiac i sasawa fua‐ŋareme ŋoŋe wâc nâ gapec eniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic eatuckehuc Anutu râpeckerâ nemu gâcne kiŋaŋ qajarehuc araŋ bajarenʒipiŋte rucgereŋ‐ŋeŋic bahuc junʒepieŋ. Iŋuc mi eniŋmuo
ine Wofuŋzi aaric mana‐ŋarehuc hoe motâc hecneme mâreŋko nânâ mi fuame Wofuŋzi mâreŋ biaŋ ŋare tahac ewec ira biac hâmo miziec efâreniŋmu.
“Ŋoŋe irec hâcne sâcmutâc dâŋnane ʒi maŋkehuc mana sakac enʒepieŋ, ehuc qâreŋkerâ meŋeŋicko â mai‐ŋeŋicko bândeŋnepie fozejec.
Erâ naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic qazu‐jarehuc ficko ŋec juc eniŋmu me hata raniŋmu me fo faharec eniŋmu sâc irec dâŋ muc manac enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ficwâtuŋko â sacmotâc‐ŋeŋicko mâmâc qâreŋkepie fozejec wâc.
Iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋzi mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ jareocte mupaŋke‐jarewec ira ŋaŋacne â naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic ŋoŋe sambâŋ â mâreŋ fonicmu sâc dameŋ ʒora jufehuc junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkeniŋte ŋaza mutâc ekopac i aijakic jaha mana rereŋ ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic maŋzi ʒâfickerâ kike hata‐ticne bâjâpehuc erao qohotaniŋmuo
ine Wofuŋ e ŋic gurune gurune keci jaŋe jâpec‐jopame ŋoŋere sâc sirickehuc ŋic tâpiri sâkohec juŋgopieŋ jaŋere mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋmu.
Eme kike‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ âteniŋmu sâc i ŋoŋere biŋe ezejec; mâreŋ burocnaonec fuŋkerâ raku Lebanoŋ tikio tarakac erâ ŋifec Eufrata opâonec fuŋkerâ ware raku Mâreŋ Ŋoŋondeŋ Hâwecko tarakac mâreŋ izi hâcne ŋoŋere biŋe.
Ŋic moczi sanaŋkerâ ŋopa jâpec sâcne mi eŋareocmu. Ehame Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mupaŋke‐ŋarewec irec sâc ehuc mâreŋ âtehapie ŋic hâhâwic bâfua‐jareocmu.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, no miŋecgac jambuŋ â sâwec biŋe qaŋarekopac.
Eme ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte sâcmutâc dâŋ miŋecgac ŋaza mutâc ekopac i mana rereŋ epie jambuŋzi ŋoŋere faio feocmu.
Me Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte sâcmutâc dâŋ mana rereŋ mi ehuc miŋecgac hata ŋaza ŋowatuc ekopac i râpeckerâ nemu wiac mi mamana‐ŋeŋic jaŋerao qohotaniŋmuo ine sâwec hotâckeniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi jowac‐ŋopame mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋmu ira fisirâ Geriʒim tikio jambuŋdâŋ munʒepieŋ â Ebali tikio ine sâwecdâŋ munʒepieŋ.
Tiki i jahe Jordaŋ opâ ocniŋucnao Giligali hae mendâŋko â More haeo boriŋjâc domaŋgopieŋko erâ Kanaaŋ ŋic Araba wâneŋko juŋgopieŋ jaŋere mâreŋko hata ʒoaŋ huhunaopec fokac irec heririŋnao ŋekopirec.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ ŋare tahac eocmu i ro rauc eniŋte Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnezo eŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Irec ŋoŋe ira juhuc dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋ miŋecgac ŋaza mutâc ekopac i aijakic jaha mana rereŋ efârenʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋ ʒine hâcne i Wofuŋ mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere Anutuzi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eme ro rauc eniŋmu ira jufeniŋmu sâc aijakic jaha mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere mâreŋ ro rauc ehuc, nemufâc‐jeŋic tikio me mâreŋ facnao me jâc dodomanere fuŋnao kiŋaŋ qajare jumbieŋ hae mâreŋ i ima bafârenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc alata wiac‐jeŋic heroc qâropienʒepieŋ, â ɋâŋwâtuŋ wiac‐jeŋic henʒaŋ qanʒaŋnenʒepieŋ, â Aserim ɋâŋ qâqâtâc i ʒocko behepie ʒazejec, erâ nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋere hawari wiac i hetâc qâtâcnepie ʒâŋe biŋe‐jeŋiczi hae mâreŋ ira omaezejec.
Ŋoŋe wiac iŋuc bajuhuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic araŋ mi bacnenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi guru‐ŋeŋic sâc mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋmu irecnec moc bâwosâe‐ŋarehuc ʒâŋe‐ticnere ŋeŋe hae bâfuame ira ranʒepieŋ.
Ehuc qowi bâzi me taha bâzi wiac‐ŋeŋic teŋkonec wâŋ me taha wiac gâcne me mumupaŋ taha me buafec taha me lama bulimakao‐ŋeŋic jaŋeraonec mârâc fufua i sasawa ira râe‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ira hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio taha bâzire wiac nâ bac enʒepieŋ, ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi jambuŋ‐ŋopame wiac hure hemârec embiŋte wiacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋehec mu ʒeri enʒepieŋ.
Nâŋâc miŋecgac buc buc maŋnâŋecte wiac ebac eeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc mi enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi juju mana â merâfâc mâreŋ ŋareocte muwec ira biac mi fisimbiŋ.
Erâ ŋoŋe sifu Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋareme ro rauc eniŋmu, erâ râsifâc‐ŋeŋic rârec rârec juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe bawahac‐jopame wamao juhâmoniŋmu.
Ehame Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae mâreŋ moc bâwosâe‐ŋarehuc ʒâŋe‐ticnere ŋeŋe hae bâfuame ŋoŋe wiac ŋaza mutâc ekopac i ira hâcne bara‐fârenʒepieŋ. Wiac kecʒiŋuc: Qowi bâzi, taha bâzi, wiac‐ŋeŋic teŋkonec wâŋ, taha wiac gâcne, â Wofuŋtao mumupaŋ dâŋ mumbiŋ irec taha wiac sasawa.
Ehuc ŋaŋacne mecne, naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic mecne, kiŋaŋ ŋic ŋokacfâc‐ŋeŋic mecne, ŋoŋe mâmâc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio mu ʒeri enʒepieŋ. Erâ Lewiŋic hae mâreŋ tâmiriczi ŋoŋehec juŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc.
Ŋoŋe qowi bâzi‐ŋeŋic i hae mâreŋ maŋŋeŋicte kosa honeniŋmu ira mâcne,
Wofuŋzi guru‐ŋeŋic sâc mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋmu irec dâkâne moc bâwosâe‐ŋareme ira hâcne rikenʒepieŋ, ehuc wiac mutâcne‐ŋarekopac i ira wâc ebac efârenʒepieŋ.
“Ŋifec ine hae‐ŋeŋic sâc ira qowire eŋareme Wofuŋzi ŋare tahac eekac irec sâc qa hezuc ezo murâ enʒepieŋ; ehame kâte noniŋ â kâte bulimakao nâcjopaeŋgopieŋ iŋuc jaha qowi i ŋic wâwânâŋ tâmiric â wâwânâŋheczi kosa nânʒepieŋ.
Socjeŋic ine mi nâhuc opâ omane iŋucne mâreŋko hoŋkepie razejec.
Ŋoŋe hae mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko juhuc wiac kecʒiŋuc ine mi nânʒepieŋ: Padi jacgoŋ me waiŋ me oliwa wokemaŋ wiac‐ŋeŋic irec teŋkonec wâŋ, me lama bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic mârâc fufua, me mumupaŋ taha wiac‐ŋeŋic, me buafec taha wiac‐ŋeŋic, me taha wiac fenʒoŋkehuc râeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe wiac i Wofuŋzi hae mâreŋ bâwosâe‐ŋareocmu ira hâcne ere maio nânʒepieŋ; ŋoŋe ŋaŋacne â naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic mecne, â kiŋaŋ ŋic ŋokacfâc‐ŋeŋic mecne, erâ Lewiŋic ŋoŋehec hae‐ŋeŋicko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc. Ehuc ŋoŋe meŋeŋiczi gie i me i bapie fua biaŋ eŋareme Wofuŋte maio bubiaŋ manahuc ʒeri enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko jufeniŋmu sâc Lewiŋic hone takirec‐jopanʒipiŋte jaŋere mana mezac ehuc junʒepieŋ.
“Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e mupaŋke‐ŋarewec irec sâc mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic bâsokame qowire eŋareme ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Nâŋe qowi nânʒepeneŋ,’ iŋuc murâ qowi aŋac‐ŋopaocmu sâc nânʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnere hae mâreŋ bâwosâeocmu i ʒoricko fome ine Wofuŋzi lama bulimakao ŋare tahac ewec jaŋeraonec ŋaza mutâc epo irec sâc ehuc moc qazo murâ qanʒepieŋ. Ehuc qowire eŋareme sâc hae‐ŋeŋicko nânʒepieŋ.
Kâte noniŋ me kâte bulimakao nâcjopaeŋgopieŋ iŋuc jaha ehuc ŋic wâwânâŋ tâmiric â wâwânâŋheczi kosa nânʒepieŋ.
Mocjaha, socjeŋic ine moc mi nâjâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ, soczi juju ekac, irec soc nâhuc juju mâmâc nânʒipiŋte qowi socnehec mi nânʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe soc mi nânâ mâc opâ omane iŋucne mâreŋko hoŋkepie razejec.
Ŋoŋe ŋaŋacne mecne, â ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mecne, Wofuŋte maio wiac ebac epene sâckeekac, i erâ soc mi nâhuc juhâc qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Mâc taha wiac bâtirihuc râeniŋte mukicne erâ mumupaŋ taha wiac i ine Wofuŋzi hae mâreŋ bâwosâe‐ŋareocmu ira baranʒepieŋ.
Ehuc qowi bâzi wiac‐ŋeŋic soc biucnehec i Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte alatao râenʒepieŋ, ehuc soc i Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte alatao hoŋkerâ qowi biucne nâzo murâ nânʒepieŋ.
Dâŋ ŋaza mutâc ekopac i aijakic jaha mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ, erâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio wiac ebac epene sâckeekac i ehuc ŋoŋe ŋaŋacne mecne â ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mâmâc raŋɋa raŋɋa juhâc qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ŋic gurune gurune ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko bâsirowec‐jopame mâreŋ ro rauc erâ ira ŋec juc eniŋmu.
Ehuc jaŋe sirowe‐fârehapie ŋoŋe dockerâ jaŋere kike hata bâjâpehuc nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒiŋuc mu wioc enʒipiŋte rucŋeŋic banʒepieŋ: ‘Ŋic gurune gurune keci jaŋe weniŋuc erâ nemufâc‐jeŋic araŋ bajarembiŋ. Jaŋe embiŋ sâc ijaha ezo muŋgopeneŋ.’
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic iŋuc moc mi ecnenʒepieŋ. Jaŋe Wofuŋzi maname mamakâcne eekac wiac i hâcne ehuc nemufâc‐jeŋic araŋ bajare jumbieŋ, ehuc jaŋere erâ naru motecfâc‐jeŋic rikec‐jopa jumbieŋ wâc.
“Ŋoŋe wiac sasawa ŋaza mutâc ekopac i aijakic jaha mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ, ehuc dâŋ moc bârârierâ bebehe me moc ʒuhuckerâ mumu i moc mi enʒepieŋ.
“Ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko porofete burecne me guŋ burec mamana ŋic moc fuarâ wiac ʒâŋe furu â mâsi hâhâwicne moc fuaocmu irec dâŋ ŋazaocmu mecne.
Izi juku fârine fuame ʒiŋuc muocmu: ‘Nemu furune bâjâpec‐jopahuc kiŋaŋ qajarenʒepieŋ.’
Iŋuc ŋazame dâŋticne mi mananʒepieŋ. Maŋ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋic Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic erao furu jaha râepie foekac me mâcne, irec fuŋne taniŋkeocte Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi esâic‐ŋopaocmu hâcne.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic bâjâpehuc sâcmutâc â micdâŋ‐ticne mana rereŋ erâ kiŋaŋ qacnehuc erao qohotanʒepieŋ.
Porofete burecne me guŋ burec mamana ŋic e ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi kâpâcwâru, Aigita mâreŋ hâcne, irecnec batarac‐ŋoparâ jowac‐ŋopa wahawec ere dâŋ qataraniŋte qazu‐ŋarewec irec qâhâmonʒepieŋ. Ŋic eki hâcne Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi kike hata‐ticne bâjâperâ raniŋte mutâcne‐ŋarewec i beheniŋte esoc qafeŋ eŋarewec. Ŋoŋe wiac hehesicne ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko fuame bâsuepie razejec.
“Neŋgocgere ŋokâ, hahacge hâcne, me gahacne ŋokâ me otâge me joroc ŋonâŋge me âgo fâri‐jâmbâŋge, ŋic ŋokac i jaŋe eatucguhuc ʒiŋuc gazaniŋmu: ‘Ajoc, nâŋâc nemu gâcne kiŋaŋ qajarenaŋ.’ Go gahacne â mamacfâcge ŋoŋe ine nemu i moc mi manac‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic bembeŋko me ʒoricko me mâreŋ tofane ŋifec â ŋifec rârecguhuc jueŋgopieŋ
jaŋere nemure iŋuc mu qafeŋ egarepie mi mana‐jarezemec â busâqoc mana‐jarehuc mi ŋezic‐jopazemec erâ kiŋjeŋic wâc mi hesoŋkezemec.
Aricne, ŋic i jaŋe qâhâmoc‐jopazo; qanaŋ go gahac fuŋkerâ jopatec ʒâhec ine ŋic ʒeŋgoma jaŋe qâhâmoc‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic i jaŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi kâpâcwâru fic, Aigita mâreŋkonec hâcne, jowac‐ŋopa wahawec ere meonec batarac‐ŋopazo fotarie‐ŋarembiŋte qânâzi hehâmoc‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic sasawa ŋoŋe irec dâŋ manarâ hâwic‐ŋopame wiac hehesicne mocwâc mi enʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae wiac gâcne ŋare tahac eme ira ŋec juc ehapie dâŋ ʒiŋuc mecne ŋazapie mananiŋmu:
Ŋic repic qapicne gâcne ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋickoneczi fuarâ hae rune eatuc‐jopahuc ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: ‘Ajoc, nâŋâc ra nemu gâcne kiŋaŋ qajarenaŋ.’ Ŋoŋe ine nemu i jaŋe moc mi manac‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Irec ŋoŋe dâŋ iŋucne mana taraniŋte aijakic jaha mu wioc enʒepieŋ. Eme ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko wiac mamakâcne iŋucne fuarâ fokac, ŋoŋe iŋuc mana taraniŋmuo ine
hae irec rune qâhâmoc‐jopanʒepieŋ, ehuc bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic â wiac‐jeŋic gâcne sasawa haeo fokac i bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe mafa wiac‐jeŋic sasawa hae ʒoŋao ropie fisime ficjeŋichec rikepie Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte bâzi hâcbuc rikekicne tinac ezejec. Hae i heɋârerâ mi banʒepieŋ, i mâc sesuctac jaha fohuc juzejec sanaŋ.
Wiac ʒocte biŋe mukicne i moc mi ronʒepieŋ; eme Wofuŋ e kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋ qaʒue wahame busâqoc mana‐ŋarerâ buuruc qaŋarehuc mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mupaŋke‐jarewec irec sâc basawec‐ŋopaocmu.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte sâcmutâc dâŋ â micdâŋ‐ticne miŋecgac ŋaza mutâc ekopac i mana rereŋ eniŋmu â ere maio wiac epene sâckeekac i eniŋmuo ine iŋuc hâcne eŋareocmu.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte naru motecfâc, irec hâmoc fuame busâqoc manahuc sahac‐ŋeŋic he qânʒiŋ mi enʒepieŋ, erâ mai‐ŋeŋicko qizec susuc‐ŋeŋic mi bâtâcnenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio ŋic tirine juŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ eki hâcne e jahacnere biŋe erâ juniŋte ŋic gurune gurune mâreŋko juraŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec rowosâec‐ŋopawec.
“Ŋoŋe wiac mamakâcne moc mi nânʒepieŋ.
Qowi kecʒiŋuc jaŋe ine sâcne nâcjopaniŋmu: Bulimakao ŋicne, lama, noniŋ,
kâte bulimakao, kâte noniŋ fuŋne fuŋne erâ tiki lama.
Qowi kike‐jeŋic sosohoc â nânâ ŋâc hepie wefume nâeŋgopieŋ i jaŋe sasawa sâcne nâcjopaniŋmu.
Mâc nânâ ŋâc hepie wefume nâeŋgopieŋ â kike‐jeŋic sosohoc jaŋeraonec qowi kecʒiŋuc jaŋe ine mi nâcjopanʒepieŋ: Kamele â qowi moc ʒâŋene hea â moc ʒâŋene roki beʒe. Jaŋe nânâ ŋâc hepie wefume nâeŋgopieŋ, mâc kike‐jeŋic sosohoc mi efârekicnere mana‐jarepie qowi wâwânâŋhec enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc bec jaŋe kike‐jeŋic sosohoc, erâ ine nânâ nâhuc ŋâc mi heeŋgopieŋte mana‐jarepie wâwânâŋhec jaha enʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe biuc‐jeŋic mi nânʒepieŋ â qâŋɋâŋ‐jeŋic ba bâuac wâc mi enʒepieŋ.
“Opâo qowi juŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec gâcne kecʒiŋuc nâcjopazo murâ nâcjopanʒepieŋ: Dipa â garac‐jeŋichec sasawa sâcne nâcjopaniŋmu.
Ehuc opâ qowi dipa â garac tâmiric juŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine mi nâcjopanʒepieŋ, jaŋe wâwânâŋhec hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe wipe wiac wâwânâŋ tâmiric jaŋe nâcjopazo murâ nâcjopa‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Mâc wiac kecʒiŋuc jaŋe ine mi nâcjopanʒepieŋ: Tucwipe, qeri, keŋ,
mebâroŋ â bicqâreŋ,
kâec kâec,
qera, wioc, kâte kaiŋɋaŋ, piʒu piʒu,
bioc bioc, qâoŋ, opâ baro,
baro gâgâpâc, gafu hâro, gara raweŋ,
qeʒo, baro qaŋqaŋ, bikuaŋ â mindi mindi.
Erâ gisic wiac fakec‐jeŋichec jaŋere manapie wâwânâŋhec eme mi nâcjopanʒepieŋ.
Wiac fakec‐jeŋichec gâcne biaŋne ine nâcjopanʒepieŋ.
“Qowi wiac i me i e jahac hâmo sipiric eocmu i mi nânʒepieŋ. Hae‐ŋeŋicko ŋic jaba juŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine jarezo murâ jarepie nânʒepieŋ, me ŋic furune jaŋe jarezo murâ jarepie furine ŋarenʒepieŋ. “Ŋoŋe lama motecne neŋgocnere susuhec mi rikenʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe jarane jarane gie wiac he sarac epie fârine fuame irecnec teŋkonec wâŋ bârârienʒepieŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e ʒâŋe‐ticnere ŋeŋe hae moc bâfuaocte hae mâreŋ bâwosâeocmu ira ere maio padi jacgoŋ me waiŋ me oliwa wokemaŋ me lama bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic mârâc fufua irec teŋkonec wâŋ nânʒepieŋ; ehuc dameŋ sâc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic araŋ babacne irec fuŋne mana taranʒepieŋ.
Me Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi giegaŋ‐ŋeŋic jambuŋkeme nânâ wiac‐ŋeŋic teŋkonec wâŋ i hata ʒoricnere Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic ʒâŋe‐ticnere ŋeŋe hae bâfuaocte mâreŋ bâwosâeocmu ira baraniŋte eipieniŋmuo
ine moneŋte erâ qikiŋnehuc moneŋ rorâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae mâreŋ bâwosâeocmu ira ranʒepieŋ.
Ra fisirâ aŋac‐ŋeŋiczi muocmu irec sâc moneŋ izi wiac kecʒiŋuc furine banʒepieŋ: Lama bulimakao, me waiŋ me opâ sanaŋ me wiac gâcne gâcne. Ehuc ŋaŋacne â wiacfâc‐ŋeŋic ŋoŋe ira hâcne wiac i Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio nâ bac ehuc ʒeri enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc Lewiŋic jaŋe merâfâc hae mâreŋ tâmiric ŋoŋehec jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere mi nikec‐ŋopazejec.
“Ŋoŋe jara jahec â moc tarame sâc wiac fua‐ŋareocmu irecnec teŋkonec wâŋ hae‐ŋeŋicko bâtumaŋnenʒepieŋ.
Ehame Lewiŋic jaŋe ŋoŋehec merâfâc mâreŋ mi rauckeniŋmu jaŋe mecne erâ ŋic jabane me hozec bekâ hae‐ŋeŋicko mâmâc juraniŋmu jaŋe fisirâ nâ gapec enʒepieŋ. Iŋuc epie Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi gie baniŋmu sâc i jambuŋke‐ŋareocmu.
“Ŋoŋe jara 7 tarame sâc tofa bebehec enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc wiac kecʒiŋuc enʒepieŋ: Ŋic moc e ŋic âgo‐ticne me qomâ‐ticne wiac moc râcneme hotâ bajuocmuo tofa‐ticne bazuocte ʒoɋac mi ecnehuc mâc beheme fozejec, i Wofuŋ araŋ bacnehuc tofa bebehere dâŋ musanaŋkembiŋ irec.
Ŋic furune jaŋerao tofa‐ŋeŋic foocmu i bazu‐ŋareniŋte muzo murâ munʒepieŋ, mâc qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe wiac‐ŋeŋic i me i jarepie bajuniŋmuo ine mâc behepie fozejec.
Erâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi merâfâc mâreŋ ŋareme ro rauc ehuc ira juhapie jambuŋ‐ŋopame ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic hapetac moc mi juniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte dâŋ mana rereŋ ehuc, sâcmutâc dâŋ miŋecgac ŋaza mutâc ekopac i aijakic jaha bajuniŋmuo ine iŋuc hâcne fuaocmu.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e mupaŋke‐ŋarewec irec sâc jambuŋ‐ŋopaocmu, irec ŋoŋe ŋic gurune gurune wiac hotâ jarenʒepieŋ, mâc ŋoŋe ŋaŋac ine jaŋeraonec wiac tofamâc mi ronʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe ŋic gurune gurune rauc‐joparâ kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ŋeŋic bacjopanʒepieŋ, ehame jaŋe ine rauc‐ŋoparâ kiŋaŋ qaqa mi bacŋopanʒepieŋ.
“Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eocmu ira juhuc hae‐ŋeŋicko qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋeraonec moczi hapetac jume honehuc maŋsanaŋ erâ mi hone takirenʒepieŋ.
Aricne, ŋoŋe qomâ‐ŋeŋic afeckerâ bafickehuc, wiac i me i basaocmu sâc râcnepie hotâ baŋare juzejec.
Maŋŋeŋiczi dâŋ sâqocne manasuhuc ʒiŋuc munʒipiŋte rucŋeŋic banʒepieŋ: ‘Jara 7, tofa bebehe jara hâcne maickekac.’ Ŋoŋe iŋuc murâ qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic ʒâŋe ʒârâ honec‐jopahuc wiac moc mi jareniŋmuo ine jaŋe Wofuŋ kio wâwâsic ecnepie ŋoŋerao kiŋnehec eocmu.
Ŋoŋe buafec jaha wiac aameo jarenʒepieŋ; iŋuc epie Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi gie baniŋmu me wiac ebac eniŋmu sâc i jambuŋke‐ŋareocmu.
Ŋic hapetac dameŋ sâc ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko juniŋmu, irec ʒiŋuc mutâcne‐ŋarekopac: Ŋoŋe qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic me ŋic hapetac me qarâ suriŋne mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko juniŋmu jaŋe afeckerâ bafic‐jopahuc junʒepieŋ.
“Qomâge, Hebiraio ŋic me ŋokac moczi moneŋte erâ kiŋaŋ qaqage juocte muocmuo ine kiŋaŋ qagarehuc juhame jara 6 tarazejec. Jara 7 ira ine mocwâc rambaŋ juocte râetec razejec.
Erâ ine rambaŋ juocte râetec metariŋ mi razejec.
Go lama bulimakao me padi jacgoŋ me waiŋ wiacge irecnec ŋeŋemâcne râcnezemec; Wofuŋ Anutugezi jambuŋguwec irec sâc manahuc râcnezemec.
Go Aigita mâreŋko kiŋaŋ qaqa jaha juwefukuhaŋte Wofuŋ Anutugezi irecnec bataracguwec irec manasuzemec. No irec hâcne miŋecgac dâŋ ʒi mutâcne‐garekopac.
Me ŋic e gore maname sâckeha ʒiŋuc mecne muocmu: ‘No maŋnane go â wiacfâcge ŋoŋerao fokacte mi behec‐ŋopapemu.’
Iŋuc gazarâ motâc wâtuŋko roweckeha hazec‐ticne âke mârâŋketecne kiŋaŋ qaqage juraʒihuc juzejec. Kiŋaŋ ŋokacge e sâc ijaha ecnezemec.
Ŋic e rambaŋ juocte râecmurâ manatec boc mi ŋemâckezejec. Wemocte? E kiŋaŋ qaqa giere furi nâfocne sawa rohuc jara 6 kiŋaŋ qagarewec irec. Go iŋuc ehaŋ Wofuŋ Anutugezi wiac ebac ecmu sâc jambuŋke‐gareocmu.
“Lama bulimakaofac‐ŋeŋic mârâc fufua i Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte biŋe qanʒepieŋ; ehame bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic mârâc fufua jaŋe gie mi baŋarenʒepieŋ â lamafâc‐ŋeŋic mârâc fufua jaŋere kanʒaŋ wâc mi bâtâcnenʒepieŋ.
Go â wiacfâcge ŋoŋe Wofuŋzi hae mâreŋ bâwosâe‐ŋareocmu ira jarane jarane Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio nâcjopahuc junʒepieŋ.
Mâc, sahac fâsâc mi juju, kike demba â ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ, me wiac izi me izi bâpuriŋ‐jopakicne jaŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte biŋe taha bâzi mi rikec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe qowi iŋucne i hae‐ŋeŋicko juhuc qa nâc enʒepieŋ; ehame kâte noniŋ â kâte bulimakao nâcjopaeŋgopieŋ iŋuc jaha qowi i ŋic wâwânâŋ tâmiric â wâwânâŋ heczi kosa nânʒepieŋ.
Mocjaha, socjeŋic ine mi nânâ mâc opâ omane iŋucne mâreŋko hoŋkepie razejec.
“Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e mosa April ira ŋafeo Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐ŋopa wahawecte mosa irec manapie feha Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte manasuhuc aakic hombaŋ ŋenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc lama bulimakao gâcne rocjoparâ, Wofuŋzi ʒâŋe‐ticnere ŋeŋe hae bâwosâeocmu ira Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte manasuhuc bâzi rikec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe bâzi irec poroŋ, ʒârâ ʒâpâ bâzi hâcne, i goreŋ tâmiric nâhuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec. Ŋoŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec fâro faio wahahuc poroŋ i hâcne nâmbiŋ. Irec Aigita mâreŋkonec wahambiŋ dameŋ irec manasuhuc junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko goreŋ moc mi bapa mâc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec; erâ hombaŋ fuŋkerâ ŋehuc qowi bâzi rikec‐jopaniŋmu irec tiwâne râepie foha hae mi furezejec.
Ŋoŋe aakic hombaŋte bâzi i Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae ŋare tahac eme ro rauc eniŋmu ira moc mi rikenʒepieŋ.
Aricne, Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ʒâŋe‐ticne foocte hae mâreŋ bâwosâeocmu ira hae owâeme, Aigita mâreŋkonec wahambiŋ dameŋ iŋucnao hâcne aakic hombaŋte bâzi rikenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae mâreŋ bâwosâeocmu ira hâcne rike nâc enʒepieŋ. Erâ hae fureme qoruc boze‐ŋeŋic sâc risie rafârenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric nâhuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 tarazejec, ʒoaŋ 7 ira ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte manasuhuc tutumaŋ sâko ehuc gie moc mi banʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe padi qa roro dameŋ maickeme fârine fuŋkerâ rohuc Sonda wosefekupie 7 ezejec.
Sonda 7 tarame woka moc ira ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte manasuhuc hombaŋ sâko ŋenʒepieŋ, ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi jambuŋ‐ŋopawec irec manasuhuc buafec taha râenʒepieŋ.
Erâ otâ ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic me kiŋaŋ ŋic ŋokacfâc‐ŋeŋic me Lewiŋic hae‐ŋeŋicko juniŋmu me ŋic jabane â hozec bekâ ŋoŋerao juniŋmu jaŋehec Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ʒâŋe‐ticne foocte mâreŋ bâwosâeocmu ira juhuc mu ʒeri enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Aigita mâreŋko kiŋaŋ qaqa jumbiŋ irec manasuhuc dâŋsanaŋ ʒi aijakic jaha mana rereŋ efârenʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe padi jacgoŋ â waiŋ wiac‐ŋeŋic ropie fisi‐fâreme rehac boze hombaŋ ŋehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarazejec.
Erâ ŋoŋe otâ ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic me kiŋaŋ ŋic ŋokacfâc‐ŋeŋic me Lewiŋic me ŋic jabane â hozec bekâ hae‐ŋeŋicko juniŋmu jaŋehec hombaŋ ŋehuc mu ʒeri enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae mâreŋ bâwosâeocmu ira hâcne hombaŋ i ŋehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ 7 tarazejec. Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi gie bapie jambuŋke‐ŋareha fâri rarau fuame qa roro epie tarame hombaŋ ŋehuc ʒeri bubiaŋ sâko enʒepieŋ.
“Ŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic sasawa jaŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae mâreŋ bâwosâeocmu ira jara mocte maŋnao Wofuŋte maio fuapie arec jahec â moc ezejec. Ine aakic hombaŋko, woka hombaŋ ira erâ rehac boze hombaŋko iŋuc enʒepieŋ. Erâ ine Wofuŋte maio metariŋ mi fuanʒepieŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâriri bâfua‐ŋarewec irec sâc manahuc ru sâc taha râenʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae wiac ŋare tahac eocmu ira guru‐ŋeŋic sâc mumutara ŋic â micne fekicne râec‐jopapie jaŋe ŋic ŋokac jaŋerao mumutiŋ gie fâretiŋ jaha banʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ mutiŋnehuc mi muhasickenʒepieŋ, ehuc ŋic dâŋjeŋic sâckoa mutaranʒepieŋ, erâ bâbâmiriŋ moneŋ wâc mi ronʒepieŋ. Bâbâmiriŋ moneŋ ropie maŋŋeŋic sifuckeme ŋic tiŋne jaŋere dâŋ muhasickeniŋmu hâcne.
Ŋoŋe tiŋne jujure sawa henʒiriŋnenʒepieŋ, iŋuc erâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eocmu i ro rauc erâ juhâc qâhâmoniŋmu.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte alata baniŋmu irec ŋifecnao Asera nemu ere ma wiac moc mi râepie domazejec.
Erâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ɋâŋwâtuŋ sureekacte moc mi âkendâŋnenʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic lama me bulimakao puriŋ ekicne me huc wichec‐jeŋic taha bâzi moc mi rikecnenʒepieŋ; Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e wiac iŋucne hâcne honeme mamakâcne eekac.
“Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae mâreŋ ŋare tahac eocmu ira ŋic me ŋokac moc e Wofuŋ Anuture maio wiac hehesicne ehuc ʒâʒâfic‐ticnere dâŋ bâsueocmu,
me nemu wiac gâcne â mosa ʒoaŋ erâ bâpiŋ wiac araŋ bajarehuc kiŋaŋ qajareocmu, wiac qatara‐jarepo i hâcne eocmuo
ine manarâ aijakic jaha mu wioc ecnenʒepieŋ. Eme wiac mamakâcne iŋucne Israe ŋondeŋko jâmbomac ekicne, ŋoŋe iŋuc manarâ
ŋic me ŋokac wiac hehesicne bâfuawec e haesac râpenao bahurâ qânâzi hehâmonʒepieŋ.
Hâmocte biŋe mukicne ŋic ere fuŋne ŋic jajahec me jahec â moc jaŋe mu rituc epie qâhâmonʒepieŋ; ŋic mocjahazi sawa mume ine mi qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Fuŋne‐ticne rituocmu eki fuŋkerâ qazejec, ehame gâcne sâko jaŋe ʒâhec qâhâmonʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc wiac hehesicne ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko fuame bâsuenʒepieŋ.
“Hae‐ŋeŋicko ŋic moczi ŋic âgo‐ticnere soc hoŋkeocmu, me hae mâreŋte hehefaric mu qaqatara sâko fuaocmu, me ŋic moczi ŋic âgo‐ticne qa bâʒâic ecnekume hâmoocmu, me wiac ŋemâcne i me i moc fuarâ siric‐ŋopaocmuo ine dâŋŋeŋic i Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae mâreŋ bâwosâe‐ŋareocmu ira baranʒepieŋ.
Ehuc Lewiŋic taha bapa mecne â mumutara ŋic juocmu jaŋe mâmâc mu wioc ejarepie dâŋŋeŋic i hâcne mufâsâenʒepieŋ.
Eme jaŋe Wofuŋzi hae mâreŋ bâwosâe‐ŋareocmu ira juhuc dâŋ ŋaza mutâc eniŋmu i mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc hata i me i mutâcne‐ŋarepie bâjâpehuc qanaopec me fâreopec qâsorierâ mi ranʒepieŋ.
Eme ŋic moczi maŋfefe ehuc, taha bapa Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio domahuc kiŋaŋ gie baekac erâ mumutara ŋic jahere dâŋ qataraocmu ŋic e qâhâmonʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc wiac hehesicne Israe ŋic ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋickonec bâsuenʒepieŋ.
Ehame ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋe manarâ hâwic‐jopame maŋfefe mocwâc mi enʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae mâreŋ ŋare tahac eocmu ira fisirâ ro rauc erâ juku ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Ŋic gurune gurune rârec‐nâporâ juhuc mâsi eeŋgopieŋ iŋuc jaha ehuc ŋicwofuŋ moc âkendâŋnepene junârezejec.’
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ŋic moc bâwosâe‐ŋareocmu e ŋicwofuŋ âkendâŋnezo murâ âkendâŋnenʒepieŋ. Mâc ŋic furune, qomâ‐ŋeŋic mi juekac e mâcne, qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec ŋic moc ŋicwofuŋ juocte âkendâŋnenʒepieŋ.
Mocjaha, e becâsicfâc‐ticne bocjaha mi rocjopazejec, me becâsicfâc‐ticne guru sâko jucneniŋte ŋic ŋokacfâc‐ticne sorec‐jopame Aigita mâreŋko mi risienʒepieŋ; Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc hâcne ŋazawec: ‘Ŋoŋe mâreŋ ira mocwâc mi risie‐jâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ.’
Erâ maŋticnezi Wofuŋ behezacte ŋokac bocjaha wâc mi rocjopazejec, â siliwa â gol hure hemârec boc mi ezejec.
“Âkendâŋnepie ŋicwofuŋ erâ juhuc, Lewiŋic taha bapa jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋte papia bajuŋgopieŋ ira honehuc e jahacne biŋe moc qâreŋkeme fozejec.
Focnehame ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne wose manac ehuc sâcmutâc dâŋ â dâŋsanaŋ i mana rereŋ erâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ticne araŋ bacnehuc juzejec.
Ehuc maŋfefe erâ qomâfâc‐ticne mi mana wahac‐jopazejec, erâ wâc sâcmutâc dâŋ beherâ qâsoriehuc qanaopec me fâreopec mi razejec. E iŋuc ehuc e jahacne â ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋe Israe ŋondeŋko ŋicwofuŋ gie dameŋ ʒora bahuc junʒepieŋ.
“Lewiŋic taha bapa, Lewiŋic sasawa hâcne, jaŋe Israe ŋic gâcne jaŋehec merâfâc mâreŋ me mâreŋ dâkâne gâcne ro rauc moc mi enʒepieŋ, aricne, jaŋe Wofuŋ bâzi rikecneeŋgopieŋ â taha wiac gâcne râecneeŋgopieŋ i hâcne nâhuc junʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe qomâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhuc merâfâc mâreŋ moc mi rauckenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋzi mupaŋke‐jarewec irec sâc hone bafic ejareocmu.
Ehame kikefuŋ jaŋe lama bulimakao bâzi rikehuc taha bapa wiac kecʒiŋuc jarenʒepieŋ: Qowi ɋawene, mauc jahecne erâ ho neŋgocne.
Ehuc nânâ gie ɋâricnaonec padi jacgoŋ â waiŋ erâ oliwa wokemaŋ wiac i mâmâc râe‐jarenʒepieŋ. Erâ lama motecne jaŋere kanʒaŋ bâtâcnehuc jarenʒepieŋ wâc.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic eki hâcne gurune gurune jueŋgopieŋ ŋoŋeraonec Lewiŋic jaŋe mimiŋzi ɋâric Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo kiŋaŋ gie bahuc juniŋte rowosâec‐jopawec.
“Eme Lewiŋic moc e Israe hae ŋerakac ira juocmuzi faharerâ Wofuŋzi hae mâreŋ bâwosâe‐ŋareocmu ira mecne ra fisiocmu.
Fisirâ Lewiŋic âgofâc‐ticne jaŋe Wofuŋte maio kiŋaŋ gie bahuc jueŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo kiŋaŋ gie bazo murâ bazejec.
Ehame mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere wiaczi moneŋ kitâcne‐jareme fojareha nânâ sâckoa nâ bac enʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eocmu ira fisirâ mâreŋ irec rune jaŋere eebapa mamakâcne i moc mi bâjâpenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ŋoŋeraonec moczi naru motecfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec moc rorâ bâzi mi rikezejec. Erâ wâc ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko findaŋdâŋ mumu ŋic, me sowidâŋ mumu ŋic, me riuc bapa, me hafec bapa,
me qaŋgec bapa fuŋne fuŋne me faŋfaŋdâŋ mumu ŋic moc mi junʒepieŋ.
Ŋic moc e wiac iŋucne ebac eocmu ere Wofuŋzi maname mamakâcne eocmu. Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e ŋic iŋucne jaŋe hâcne ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko jopa jâpec ejareocmu.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio bahac fâsâc junʒepieŋ.
Mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋmu irec rune jaŋe hâcne findaŋdâŋ â sowidâŋ mumu ŋic jaŋere dâŋte hazec râeeŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe ine iŋuc enʒipiŋte Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi aka heŋarewec.
“Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e porofete no iŋucne moc ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋeraonec hâcne âkendâŋneme dâŋticne mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Horebe tikio tutumaŋ sâko ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic wira wâwâsic ecnembiŋ irec sâc hâcne fuaocmu. Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc hâcne mumbiŋ: ‘Nâŋe hâmonʒipeŋte Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋecte dâŋmarac mocwâc mi mananʒepeneŋ â ʒocbâruŋ sâko‐ticne mocwâc mi honenʒepeneŋ.’
Iŋuc mupie Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Jaŋe dâŋ mumbiŋ i fârine.
Irec no qomâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋeraonec porofete go iŋucne moc âkendâŋnehuc dâŋnane micticnao râepemu. Eme dâŋ âzâcne mutâc epemu i ŋic ŋokac jaza‐fârezejec.
Ehame nore ʒâŋeo dâŋ jazame ŋic moczi mana rereŋ mi eocmu e okacne bazucnepemu.
Me porofete moc e maŋfefe ehuc noni dâŋ âzâcne mutâc mi ecnehape e jahacne maŋte nore ʒâŋeo me nemu jaŋere ʒâŋeo ɋetickehuc dâŋ muocmu e hâmozejec.’
Me ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc mu wioc eniŋmu mecne: ‘Dâŋ i Wofuŋzi muwec me mâcne, i weniŋuc erâ fuŋne mananaŋmu?’
Irec ʒiŋuc mananiŋ: Porofete moc e nore ʒâŋeo dâŋ mume fâri tâmiric eme honerâ munʒepieŋ: ‘Dâŋ i Wofuŋzi mi muwec.’ Eme porofete e maŋfefe ehuc dâŋ muwecte ere mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ŋic gurune gurune bâsirowec‐jopahuc mareŋ‐jeŋic ŋare tahac eme ro rauc erâ hae‐jeŋicko ŋec juc eniŋmu.
Ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eme ro rauc eniŋmu ira hae sâko jahec â moc bâwosâec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Erâ hata wiac‐jeŋic barâ, Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eocmu i bâfâuckepie dâkâne jahec â moc ezejec; ehame ʒika qaqa ŋic jaŋe ira wiserâ razo murâ ranʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe iŋuc epie ʒika qaqa ŋic jaŋe hae ira wiserâ rahuc juju‐jeŋic sâcne ŋezickeniŋmu. Ŋic moczi ŋic âgo‐ticne râsi mi ecneocmu me qâhâmoocte mi mecne manasuocmu.
Ehuc âgo‐ticnehec kâteo rarâ jâc qahuc râric qâunuckeme rarâ âgo‐ticne hehâmome ine ŋic e hae kecira wiserâ ra soŋkezo murâ soŋkezejec.
E okac babazu ŋiczi aarickeme jâpe raku hata ʒoricnere dockeme qâhâmozacte iŋuc ezejec. Ŋic iŋucne e juwicnao ŋic âgo‐ticne râsi mi ecnewecte hâmocte biŋe mi ekac.
No irec hâcne ʒiŋuc mutâcne‐ŋarekopac: Ŋoŋe hae jahec â moc bâwosâenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ŋoŋe miŋecgac sâcmutâc ŋaza mutâc ekopac i aijakic jaha mana rereŋ ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic maŋzi ʒâfickerâ kike hata‐ticne bâjâpeniŋmuo ine eki mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mupaŋke‐jarewec irec sâc mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicte ma bâskoahuc mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ jareocte mupaŋkewec i sasawa ŋoŋe ŋareme hae iŋucne jahec â moc ʒuhuckerâ bâwosâenʒepiaŋ.
<range>
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eme ro rauc eniŋmu ira ŋic bahacmâc ere soc hoŋkepie irec kiŋzi fai‐ŋeŋicko fezacte iŋuc hâcne enʒepieŋ.
“Me moczi ŋic âgo‐ticne râsi ecnerâ somâ bacnehuc qarâ qâhâmohuc wiserâ ra ŋeŋezic hae moc ira fisirâ soŋkeocmu mecne.
Iŋuc eme e jahacne hae soŋaŋfâc jaŋe ŋic gâcne sorec‐jopapie ra rorâ okac babazu ŋic ere meo râepie eki qâhâmozejec.
Ŋoŋe ŋic e honerâ ere busâqoc mi mananʒepieŋ, aricne, e qâhâmopie ŋic bahacmâc socticne maŋgâŋ hoŋkekicne irec kiŋ i Israe ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko omaezejec. Ŋoŋe iŋuc erâ juhâc qâhâmoniŋmu.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eme ro rauc eniŋmu ira juhuc mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe diguracfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere mâreŋte ma bambiŋ i mi bârârienʒepieŋ.
“Ŋic moczi wiac hâhâwicne me wiac hehesic i me i bâfuame ŋic mocjahazi fuarâ fuŋne‐ticne mi muzejec, aricne, ŋic jajahec me jahec â moc jaŋe fuŋne‐ticne mutaniŋkepie dâŋticne mutaranʒepieŋ.
Me ŋic sindaŋne moczi fuarâ ŋic âgo‐ticne dâŋgieo râezo mume
ine jahe mâmâc jaha Wofuŋte maio mecne erâ taha bapa â mumutara ŋic dameŋ ira mumutara gie baniŋmu jaŋere maio mâmâc fuazepirec.
Ehame mumutara ŋic jaŋe fuŋne‐jekic mananiŋte aijakic jaha mu wioc ejactenʒepieŋ. Eme mumutaniŋ ŋic burecnezi ŋic âgo‐ticne maŋgâŋ qorickewec, fuŋne iŋuc taniŋkeme
ine âgo‐ticne wiac ecneocte manasuwec i hâcne e ecnenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc wiac hehesicne ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋickonec bâsuepie razejec.
Eme ŋic gâcne sâko jaŋe wiac i hone manac erâ hâwic‐jopame wiac hehesic iŋucne ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko mocwâc mi enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic iŋucne honerâ busâqoc mi manacnenʒepieŋ, aricne, eki ŋopame okacne qanʒepieŋ, me moczi ʒâŋe‐ŋeŋic âke hâpome okacne âke hâpocnenʒepieŋ, me moczi micsiec‐ŋeŋic hezume okacne hezucnenʒepieŋ, me moczi me kike‐ŋeŋic qazume okacne qazucnenʒepieŋ jaha.
“Ŋoŋe râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jopaniŋte ʒikao rahuc becâsic keretac wiac‐jeŋic â momorifâc‐jeŋic ŋoŋere sâc sirickepie honec‐joparâ jaŋere mi hâwic‐gopazejec. Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi Aigita mâreŋkonec batarac‐ŋoparâ jowec‐ŋopa wefuwec, eki hâcne ŋoŋehec juocmu.
Eme ʒikao razo ehapie taha bapazi mai fuarâ momori ŋic mu basanaŋ ejarezejec.
Ehuc kecʒiŋuc jazazejec: ‘O Israe ŋicbureŋ, mupe mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe miŋecgac râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jopaniŋte ʒikao raŋgopieŋ, irec maŋŋeŋic mi gâckezejec erâ jaŋere hâwic‐ŋopame ɋarac ɋarac qahuc mi fâfârenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic eki hâcne ŋoŋehec juhuc râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jopame sanaŋke‐jarenʒepieŋ.’
Iŋuc mume tarame ŋic micne jaŋe momori guru ʒiŋuc muhuc jazanʒepieŋ: ‘Ŋic moc e ficticne ɋâricne barâ nâ ŋemac mi ewecko ʒikao hâmome ŋic moczi ficticne nâ ŋemac ezacte risiezejec.
Me ŋic moczi waiŋ gie‐ticne sararâ fârine fuame mi nâsuwecko ʒikao hâmome ŋic moczi nâsuzacte risiezejec.
Me ŋic moc e ŋokac biŋe‐ticne mi rowecko ʒikao hâmome ŋic moczi rozacte risiezejec.’
Jaŋe momori ŋic iŋuc jazahuc ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc jazanʒepieŋ wâc: ‘Ŋic moc e maŋticne goroŋkeme hâwickeocmu e risiezejec; e maŋ gogoroŋ ecneme âgofâcne jaŋere maŋ iŋuc jaha ezacte iŋuc ezejec.’
Jaŋe momori guru iŋuc jazapie tarame micne bajareniŋte ŋic âkendâŋ‐jopanʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe hae mocko ʒika qaniŋte rarâ bâqiŋ‐jopahuc qanaŋ hae rune jaŋehec wama qaqac eniŋte giene banʒepieŋ.
Eme jaŋe wamadâŋ jaha ŋazahuc hae motâc roŋarepie ferâ ŋic ŋokac bâfuac‐jopaniŋmu sâc ejarepie kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ŋeŋic erâ junʒepieŋ.
Me hae irec rune jaŋe wamadâŋ mi ŋazahuc râsi eŋarepie ine hae i somâckenʒepieŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae i meŋeŋicko râeme ŋic ʒeŋgoma jopa‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Ŋokac naru motec me lama bulimakao me haemaŋko wâcwiac gâcne sasawa, mafa mateŋ wiac hâcne i ropie ŋaŋacne biŋe ezejec. Ehame Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi wiac ŋare tahac eocmu i bubiaŋ faio bajunʒepieŋ.
Mâreŋ ʒira hae ŋeraŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâcne, taicko ŋeraŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne iŋuc ejarenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ŋic gurune gurune ʒi jaŋere hae wiac ŋare tahac eme ro rauc eniŋmu ira wiac jujune moc mi akic‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Aricne, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ŋaza mutâc ewec irec sâc Hitiŋic, Amori ŋic, Kanaaŋ ŋic, Pereʒi ŋic, Hiwiŋic â Jebusi ŋic jaŋe jopa mizienʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe nemufâc‐jeŋic kiŋaŋ qajarehuc wiac mamakâcne embiŋ i ŋoŋe qazu‐ŋarepie ijaha ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic bunao banʒipiŋte bâsirowec‐jopanʒepieŋ hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe ʒika qahuc hae moc ro rauc eniŋte dâmeŋ ʒora somâckehuc jâc wiac‐ticne râriczi mi qafaranʒepieŋ. Aricne, ŋoŋe jâc i jaŋere fârine nâhuc akic‐jopanʒepieŋ. Jâc gieo doma raŋgopieŋ jaŋe ŋic aricne, irec râsi ejarehuc mi somâc‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Jâc wiac gâcne fâri tâmiric doma raŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine qafarac‐jopahuc somâ bapare sacwiac barâ hae râsi eŋareocmu i somâckekupie meŋeŋicko fezejec.
“Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eme ro rauc eniŋmu irec mâreŋ sawane ira me ira ŋic qâhâmokicne moc bâfuarâ, mozi qâhâmojec, iŋuc muhuc kâuc baniŋmuo
ine soŋaŋ â mumutara ŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe warerâ ŋic qâhâmokicne râreckehuc hae ŋerakac irec sawane forakac ira muc fârehuc ma banʒepieŋ.
Eme hae bembeŋko ŋekac irec soŋaŋ micne jaŋe bulimakao ŋokacne gie biac mi bakicne â fainao kioŋ mi râekicne iŋucne moc ronʒepieŋ.
Ehuc bulimakao i wâneŋ mocko opâ rahuc fokac â gie he sarac mi ekicne ira jowa hurâ upe siecne qazunʒepieŋ.
Eme taha bapa, Lewire ɋâricfâc jaŋe hâcne mai fuanʒepieŋ. Jaŋe Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacneniŋte â ere ʒâŋeo ŋic jambuŋ‐jopaniŋte erâ wâc dâŋ me ʒika wiac fuame irec dâŋ mutaraniŋte Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi rowosâec‐jopawec hâcne.
Ehame hae bembeŋko ŋekac irec soŋaŋ micne jaŋe bulimakao upe siecne qazukicne ere faio mejeŋic ʒurenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc musokanʒepieŋ: ‘Nâŋe soc ʒi mi hoŋkembeneŋ, erâ mo ŋiczi soc hoŋkejec i wâc mi honembeneŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ, go Israe ŋicfâcge nâŋere kiwiric romeŋte sâqocne‐nâŋec behec, ehuc ŋic bahacmâc ere socte kiŋ i Israe ŋicfâcge nâŋere faio mi râehuc soc irec kiŋ behe‐nârezemec.’
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋte maio wiac ebac epene sâckeekac i ehuc soc kosa hoŋkekicne irec kiŋ i ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋickonec bâsuepie razejec.
“Ŋoŋe râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jopaniŋte ʒikao rahuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi meŋeŋicko râec‐jopame kâpâcwâru bacjopaniŋmu.
Ehame ŋoŋeraonec moczi kâpâcwâru ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋokac hawari biaŋ moc honerâ ere aŋackeme ŋonâŋ‐ticne eocte rohuc
ficticnao jowa rame qizec susuc â mesârâ‐ticne bâtâcne‐fârezejec.
Erâ ŋaqi‐ticne raŋɋane hetararâ ŋic ere ficko juhuc neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne jahere ki busâqoc ehuc juhame mosa moc hâmozejec. Eme irec faicnao ŋiczi ehec juhame ŋonâŋ‐ticne ezejec.
Eme juku ʒâhec ine ere aŋac mocwâc mi manahuc soreme ira me ira razo murâ razejec, mâc ehec juju fofo ewecte furinere erâ mi sorezejec â kiŋaŋ qaqa wâc mi bazejec.
“Ŋic moc ŋokac jajahec rocjofarâ maŋticnezi moc âgo ecnehuc moc hone takireocmu. Eme jahe juku motec kiweckerâ rocjofanicmu. Ehame ŋokac hone takic ecnekicne ere moteczi bâbâni fuaocmuo
ine mamaczi merâfâc bâtâc bapa dameŋko ira ŋokac âgo ecneekac ere motecte maname feha mafa bocjaha râcnehuc ŋokac hone takic ecneekac ere motec ine afecne sawa mi râcnezejec.
Aricne, hone takic ecneekopac ere motec e mârâc fufua‐nane, iŋuc mana tarahuc wiac focnekac sasawa irecnec ŋemâcne jaha râcnezejec. E mamacte mârâc motec, irec hâcne wiac iŋuc râcnezo.
“Motec râŋgeŋne â qaqatarane moc e neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne jahere dâŋ mi reŋkeme mu bâtiŋ ecnehapire sifu micrereŋ mi bâfuaocmuo
ine neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne jahe hae ʒoŋao soŋaŋ micne ŋeeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao barazepirec.
Ehuc soŋaŋ micne ʒiŋuc jazazepirec: ‘Ŋokâ‐nâhec ʒi e motec râŋgeŋne â qaqatarane, e dâŋnâhec moc mi reŋkeekac; e nâ araŋ ehuc opâ sanaŋ âmbâŋ nâekac.’
Iŋuc muhuc jazapire hae irec ŋic sasawa jaŋe qânâzi hehâmonʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc wiac hehesicne ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋickonec bârârienʒepieŋ. Iŋuc epie Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋe manarâ hâwic‐jopazejec.
“Ŋic moc sâqocne barâ hâmocte biŋe eme jâcko bituaniŋmuo
ine behepie domahame hae mi furezejec; aricne, ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ ijaha batararâ duckenʒepieŋ. Ŋic bituakicne e Anutuzi sâweckewec hâcne. Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eme ro rauc eniŋmu i wâwânâŋ mi ecnenʒepieŋ.
“Go qomâgere lama bulimakao wiac moc qâsoriepie hone qâoma mi ejarehuc qomâgerao bârisiec‐jopazemec.
Me qomâge e bembeŋko mi juhame mi manacnekicko ine lama bulimakao i go gahacne ficko râec‐jopatec ira juhapie qomâgezi basac‐jopahuc juhame erao bârisiec‐jopazemec.
Erâ go qomâgere doŋgi me ŋaqi me wiac i me i moc sifuckeme bâfuarâ ijaha ezemec. Go qomâge bafickecmurâ mi takicguzejec.
Doŋgi me bulimakao‐ticne hatao qarâ fohame honerâ mocwâc fahareocte bafickezemec. Go iŋuc ehuc qomâge bafickecmu hâcne.
“Ŋokac moczi ŋic ŋaqi moc mi rojuzejec, â ŋic moczi ŋokac ŋaqi wiac moc mi heme huzejec. Moc e iŋuc eocmuzi Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio mamakâcne eocmu.
“Go jâc hahaŋko me mâreŋko wipe jawa moc bâfuarâ neŋgocnezi hândâŋne me motecne fomackerâ foha honecmu.
Go iŋuc honerâ neŋgocne behetec rame motecne go gahacne biŋe rozo murâ rozemec. Iŋuc erâ dameŋ ʒora juhâc qâhâmocmu.
“Go fic ɋâricne bahuc bupune sacticnehec bazemec. Ŋic mozi waha qame socticnere kiŋzi go â wiacfâcge ŋoŋere faio fezacte iŋuc hâcne ezemec.
“Go waiŋ giegao ukic hawari jajahec mi râezemec. Waiŋ gieo wiac fuaocmu sasawa waiŋ mecne â ukic tiecmu irec fârine i mâmâc jaha tirificte biŋe ezacte iŋuc mi ezemec.
Go mâreŋ bâbâfâuc giere bulimakao â doŋgi mâmâc jaha mi râec‐jopazemec.
Go ŋaqi qowi kanʒaŋne â qâruruzi ateŋ bakicne mi rojuzemec.
“Bilaŋke rufarâ foekic irec qaŋeŋne 4 ira hândâŋne mize razemec.
“Ŋic moczi ŋokac moc rorâ ehec fohuc qaisockeocmu,
ehuc mimi qaqa ecnerâ qorickehuc ʒiŋuc muocmu: ‘No ŋokac ʒi rorâ ehec fohuc ʒiŋuc hone tarakopac: E ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ mocwâc mi jukac.’
Ŋic e iŋuc mume naru ŋokac ere neŋgoc mamac jahe naru‐jekicte fuŋne bataniŋkenicte fofo qoructicne hae soŋaŋ hae ʒoŋao ŋeeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao barazepirec.
Ehuc naru mamac‐ticnezi soŋaŋ ʒiŋuc jazazejec: ‘No naru‐nane ŋic keci ŋonâŋ‐ticne eocte râcnepo, eki ine qaisockerâ
mimi qaqa ecnehuc ʒiŋuc mukac: Naruge e ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ mocwâc mi jukac, no fuŋne‐ticne iŋuc honekopac.’ Iŋuc muhuc neŋgoc mamac jahe fofo qoruc i haere soŋaŋ jaŋere maio qaratiezepirec.
Iŋuc epire hae irec soŋaŋ jaŋe ŋic e rorâ kâcbiŋzi qanʒepieŋ.
Ehuc siliwa moneŋ 100 râeocte mucnenʒepieŋ. Eme ŋic e Israe naru ʒeŋoŋ ere ʒâŋe biŋe bawahawecte moneŋ i kimo‐ticne râcnezejec, ehuc naru e rome ŋonâŋ‐ticne erâ juha mocwâc mi behe‐jâmbâŋkezejec.
Me naru e juwicnao ŋic gâcne jaŋehec juwec, iŋuc mana taraniŋmuo
ine mamac‐ticnere ficmotâcko râepie domaha hae irec ŋic jaŋe qânâzi hehâmonʒepieŋ. E mamac‐ticnere ficko sasec gie bahuc Israe maŋnao wiac miminehec bâfuawecte iŋuc hâcne ecnenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko wiac hehesicne bârârienʒepieŋ.
“Ŋic moczi ŋic mocte ŋonâŋhec fohapire bâfuac‐jofarâ ŋic ŋokachec fowec e mecne erâ ŋokac mecne mâmâc jaha qâhâmoc‐jofanʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc Israe ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko wiac hehesicne bârârienʒepieŋ.
“Ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ ŋic mocte biŋe qakicne e haeo juha ŋic moczi bâfuarâ ehec foocmuo
ine jahe mâmâc jaha haesac motâc râpenao bacjofa hurâ qânâzi hehâmoc‐jofanʒepieŋ. Naru ŋokac e haeo juipiehuc bafickeniŋte mi owackewec â ŋic e ine âgo‐ticnere ŋokac bâsâqorewec irec. Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko wiac hehesicne bârârienʒepieŋ.
“Me ŋic moczi ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ ŋic mocte biŋe qakicne i hae hatao bâfuame ehec fohapire bâfuac‐jofaniŋmuo ine ŋic e sawa qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Ŋokac erao bâbâsifuc hâmocte biŋe mi fokacte wiac moc mi ecnenʒepieŋ. Mâsi i ŋic moczi ŋic âgo‐ticne qâhâmoocmu irec sâc.
Ŋokac e hae hatao juhame ŋiczi fuacneme gâcne jaŋe bafickeniŋte owacke‐bipiewec hâcne.
“Me ŋic moczi ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ ŋic mocte biŋe mi qakicne iŋucne moc bâfuame ehec fohapire bâfuac‐jofaniŋmuo
ine ŋic ŋokachec fowec e ŋokac mamac‐ticne siliwa moneŋ 50 râcnezejec, ehuc ŋokac bâsâqorewec e ŋonâŋ‐ticne barâ mocwâc mi behe‐jâmbâŋkezejec.
“Ŋic moczi mamac‐ticnere ŋonâŋ mi rozejec, erâ mamac‐ticne mimi qaqac wâc mi ecnezejec.
“Biŋhândâŋ‐jeŋic bakicne â sahac tofa‐jeŋic hetâcnekicne jaŋe Wofuŋte kikefuŋ guruo mi junʒepieŋ.
“Â soc sisifucko fuakicne jaŋe gaŋne gaŋne jufekupie arecne 10 ehame wâc sifu Wofuŋte kikefuŋko mi junʒepieŋ.
“Amoŋŋic me Moabi ŋic jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha Wofuŋte kikefuŋ guruo mi ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ, ehuc ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe gaŋne gaŋne jufekupie arecne 10 ehame wâc sifu mi ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe hâcne ŋoŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec waharâ wefuhapie hatao nânâ opâ wiac moc mi gumec‐ŋopambiŋ, erâ wâc Mesopotamia mâreŋkonec, Petoro haeonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Beoro ere ŋokâ Bileam e sâwec‐ŋopaocte mu qafeŋ ecnehuc furine râcnezo mumbiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ine sifu Bileam mi manacnehuc sâwecdâŋ‐ticne i hetikieme jambuŋdâŋ ewec. Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ŋoŋere boc ecnewecte iŋuc hâcne ewec.
Jaŋe juhâc qâhâmonʒipiŋte jaŋerao eehâmo gie mi bahuc junʒepieŋ.
“Edomŋic jaŋe qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic juŋgopieŋte mi qaisoc‐jopanʒepieŋ â Aigita ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko jaba jumbiŋte wâc mi qaisoc‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Jaŋere ɋâricfâc jaŋe jufekupie arecne 3 ehame Wofuŋte kikefuŋko ʒuhuckezo murâ sâcne ʒuhuckeniŋmu.
“Ŋoŋe râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jopaniŋte ʒikao rarâ teuŋko juhuc wiac sâqocne sasawa dic bacnenʒepieŋ.
“Me ŋoŋeraonec ŋic moc e ŋafeo sahac tofa‐ticnere opâ wahame wâwânâŋhec eocmuo ine teuŋ râpenao hurâ juzejec.
Juku hae owâehame opâ ruarâ ʒoaŋ hume teuŋko risiezo murâ risiezejec.
“Ŋoŋe teuŋ râpenao mâreŋ ŋondeŋne moc ho fâzire biŋe mupie fozejec.
Ehame ʒikare wiac â sua i mâmâc bajunʒepieŋ. Ehuc ho fâzire eŋareme mâreŋ ŋondeŋ ira hurâ suazi mâreŋ qâfierâ ho fâzi enʒepieŋ. Epie tarame hemackenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko juhuc bafic‐ŋoparâ râsifâc‐ŋeŋic meŋeŋicko râec‐jopazo ekacte teuŋ‐ŋeŋic pectâc fozejec. E ŋoŋerao wiac mamakâcne honerâ râpec‐ŋopazacte iŋuc hâcne enʒepieŋ.
“Kiŋaŋ qaqa moc e bomboŋ‐ticne beherâ ŋoŋerao fisime bomboŋ‐ticnerao mi bârisienʒepieŋ.
E hae‐ŋeŋic ira me ira juocte ecneme ŋoŋehec juzejec; ehame qa bâʒâic mi ecnenʒepieŋ.
“Israe ŋic ŋoŋere otâ â ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec moczi moc taha ufuŋko sasec gie moc mi bazejec.
Me moc e mumupaŋ‐ticnere fârine bâfuaocte ŋicte me ŋokacte sasec furi i Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte ufuŋko wâc mi bafezejec; Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e wiac irec â irec mâmâc maname mamakâcne eekac hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe moneŋ me nânâ wiac me wiac gâcne i me i ŋic omane jarehuc furine roeŋgopieŋ, wiac iŋucnea i qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jarepie mâc bajunʒepieŋ. Â ŋic furune jaŋeraonec furine rozo murâ sâcne roniŋmu, qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋeraonec ine mi ronʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe iŋuc eniŋmuo ine mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋmu ira juhuc gie i me i bahapie Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi jambuŋke‐ŋareocmu.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic dâŋ moc mupaŋkecneniŋmuo ine irec fârine bâfuaniŋte qâoma mi enʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e iŋuc hâcne eniŋte muekac, fârine mi bâfuaniŋmu ine kiŋhec eniŋmu.
Me mumupaŋ dâŋ mi muniŋmuo ine kiŋ tâmiric eniŋmu.
Mâc ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋiczi afeckeha Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic dâŋ moc mupaŋkecneniŋmuo ine irec manasurâ fârine wâc bâfuanʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe âgofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere waiŋ gieo rarâ waiŋ hândâŋne nâzo murâ nâ gapec enʒepieŋ, mâc heŋeŋicko ine mi ŋienʒepieŋ. Me âgofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere jacgoŋ gieo rarâ jacgoŋ fârine wackezo murâ wackenʒepieŋ, mâc jâcnehec ine mi qanʒepieŋ.
<range>
“Ŋic moc e ŋokac moc ŋonâŋ‐ticne barâ juku, ŋokac e bahac‐ticnehec, iŋuc manarâ ʒuhuc bâtâcte papia moc qâreŋkerâ râcnehuc soreme ficticne beherâ razejec.
Ra juhame ŋic moczi mecne roocmu.
Eme e juku wâc iŋuc jaha ŋokac ere maname mi sâckeme ʒuhuc bâtâcte papia jaha qâreŋkerâ râcnehuc soreme ficticne beherâ razejec. Me ʒâhec ŋowe‐ticnezi ŋonâŋ‐ticne juocte rowec e hâmome
mârâc ŋowe‐ticnezi soreme rawec e mocwâc mi rozejec. Ŋokac e ro behec ecnepie wâwânâŋhec ewecte iŋuc hâcne ezo. Wiac iŋucne i Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio mamakâcne eekac hâcne. Irec ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋte biŋe qaŋarewec i mi bâsâqorenʒepieŋ.
“Ŋic moczi ŋokac ɋâricne rorâ momori jaŋehec ʒikao mi razejec â gie niŋgiŋ ʒiriŋ‐ticnehec wâc mi râcnenʒepieŋ. Ŋic e ŋokac rowec ehec bubiaŋ faio junicte mâc juhame jara wâŋ tarazejec.
“Ŋic moc e ŋic âgo‐ticne wiac moc râcnehuc okacne nânâ opâ‐ticne mi jâoc rozejec; nânâ opâ jâoc rohuc juju‐ticne sipirickeocmu hâcne.
“Ŋic moc e Israe ŋic âgofâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec ŋic moc fiuc rorâ e jahacne kiŋaŋ qaqa baocmu me moneŋte erâ ŋic moc râcneocmuo ine fiuc roro ŋic e qâhâmonʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc epie hehesiczi ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko omaeocmu.
“Ŋoŋe wicsanaŋ fua‐ŋareme aimuŋ, sosoŋaŋ ehuc junʒepieŋ, ehuc Lewiŋic taha bapa jaŋe dâŋ ŋaza ŋowatuc eniŋmu sâc reŋke‐fârenʒepieŋ. Ehuc dâŋ jaza mutâc epo irec sâc jâmbâŋ wiac efârenʒepieŋ.
Erâ Aigita mâreŋkonec waharâ juhapie Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic eki Miriam wicsanaŋ bâfuacnewec irec manasuhuc junʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe ŋic âgo‐ŋeŋic wiac i me i hotâ bajuocte râcnerâ ŋaŋaczia ficticnao ferâ wiac irec okacne mi ronʒepieŋ.
Aricne, ŋoŋe hae ʒoŋao domahapie ŋic e jahac okacne ŋarezejec.
Me ŋic e hapetac juhuc wiac irec okacne ŋareocmuo
ine ŋoŋe bajuhapie hae mi ŋafeha mocwâc bârisiecnenʒepieŋ, eme e bilaŋke‐ticne rufarâ fohuc ŋoŋere maname biaŋkezejec. Ŋoŋe iŋuc epie Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mana‐ŋareme sâckezejec.
“Ŋoŋe kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ŋeŋic hapetac â qarâ suriŋne, qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic me ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jaba kiŋaŋ qaŋareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe bâʒâic‐jopahuc gie furi‐jeŋic mi sakare‐jarenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe gie baŋareniŋmu ʒoaŋ gie bapa ijaha hae mi ŋafeha gie furi jarenʒepieŋ. Jaŋe hapetac juhuc dope boc basarâ Wofuŋtao kio wâwâsic epie ŋoŋe kiŋhec enʒipiŋte iŋuc hâcne enʒepieŋ.
“Mamac jaŋe naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere hehesicte erâ mi qâhâmoc‐jopazo â naru motec jaŋe mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere hehesicte erâ wâc mi qâhâmoc‐jopazo. Aricne, ŋic sasawa ru sâc jaŋe jaŋacne hehesicte erâ qâhâmoc‐jopazo.
“Ŋoŋe ŋic jabane me bekâ mâsiŋ jaŋere dâŋgie bahuc dâŋjeŋic mi muhasickenʒepieŋ, â hozec moc hone bafic ecnehuc okacne ŋaqi‐ticne mi jâoc ronʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi Aigita mâreŋko kiŋaŋ qaqa jumbiŋkonec batarac‐ŋopawecte iŋuc eniŋte dâŋ ʒi ŋaza mutâc ekopac hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe qa roro dameŋko padi wiac ro bâtiric epie foekac i risierâ mi ronʒepieŋ, i ŋic jabane â hozec bekâ jaŋere biŋe fozejec. Iŋuc epie Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi giegaŋ‐ŋeŋic jambuŋke‐fâreocmu.
Me woraŋ âtepie fârine wahaocmu i sawa ro nusec efârenʒepieŋ. Ʒâhec risierâ ine mocwâc mi âtenʒepieŋ. Gâcne ŋeocmu ine ŋic jabane â hozec bekâ jaŋere biŋe ŋezejec.
Ŋoŋe waiŋ hândâŋne qa roro ehuc gâcne bâtiripie foocmu i ʒâhec risierâ mi ronʒepieŋ, i ŋic jabane â hozec bekâ jaŋere biŋe fozejec.
Ŋoŋe Aigita mâreŋko kiŋaŋ qaqa jumbiŋ irec manasuhuc junʒepieŋ; iŋuc hâcne eniŋte dâŋ ʒi ŋaza mutâc ekopac.
“Ŋic jahec jahere ŋondeŋko fâfâuc fuame dâŋgieo râec‐jofapie mumutara ŋic eki dâŋjekic mutarahuc ŋic bahac tâmiric e râeme raha bahachec e ine okacne rozejec.
Ŋic ʒikare biŋe ekac e mumutara ŋiczi mume mai‐ticnao ecnepie waha foha kâcbiŋzi qapie arec 40 ezejec, i bahac bâfuawec irec sâc hâcne ecnenʒepieŋ.
Qapie 40 eme behenʒepieŋ; ʒuhuckerâ qapie 40 jârume qomâ‐ŋeŋicte faio mimi fezacte.
“Go bulimakaozi gie bagareha micticne qâqâ mi hafezemec.
“Hahac ɋa jajahec junicmu, eme hahaczi ɋâric tâmiric juku hâmome hozec‐ticne ŋic furune moc mi râcnenʒepieŋ. Ŋowe‐ticnere ɋa eki rome ŋonâŋ‐ticne ezejec, ehuc ʒâŋetuc‐ticne moc bâfuazejec.
Eme motec bâbâni fuaocmu e hahac‐ticnere wase bahuc ʒâŋe‐ticne mume Israe ŋondeŋko moc mi omaezejec.
Me ŋic e hahac‐ticnere hozec qikiŋneme ine ŋokac e soŋaŋ micne jaŋerao rarâ ʒiŋuc jazazejec: ‘Ŋowe‐nanere ɋa e hahac‐ticnere ʒâŋezi Israe ŋondeŋko ʒuhuckerâ foocte mi ecnekac, ehuc hahac‐ticnere gie tofa i norao baocte takickekac.’
Iŋuc jazame haere soŋaŋ micne jaŋe ŋic e hefârehuc dâŋ âzâcnenʒepieŋ. Eme ŋic e sifu sanaŋkehuc ʒiŋuc muocmu mecne: ‘No ŋokac e rozore takicnukac.’
Iŋuc mume hahac‐ticnere hozeczi ra soŋaŋ micne jaŋere maio ŋic ere kikehuhu hetararâ ʒâŋe mainao tâfeckezejec, ehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc muzejec: ‘Ŋic moc e hahac‐ticnere kikefuŋ fua soka eocte mi manasuocmu e wiac iŋuc hâcne ecnezo.’
Ehuc e jahacne kikefuŋ irec ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc muzo: Kikehuhu hetaracnekicne ŋic ere kikefuŋ.
“Ŋic jajahec jahe qaqac ehuc juhapire mocte ŋonâŋzi ŋowe‐ticne bafickehuc kisâ‐ticnere meonec bataraocte meticne sicnerâ ŋic e sahac tofa‐ticnao fâreocmuo
ine meticne hetâcnenʒepieŋ; ŋoŋe ŋokac ere busâqoc moc mi mananʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe ŋemâc bâbâfuare sâc wiac teŋtiri mi bajunʒepieŋ
â sâcmeda wiac iŋuc jaha teŋtiri wâc mi bajunʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋemâc bâbâfuare sâc me sâc bapare wiac gâcne i sâc mocjaha baju‐fârenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc epie Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eocmu ira dameŋ ʒora jufeniŋmu.
Wiac teŋtiri bajuhuc eeatuc gie baniŋmu ŋic i jaŋere Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi maname mamakâcne eocmu.
“Ŋoŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec waharâ wefuhapie Amaleke ŋic jaŋe wiac eŋarembiŋ irec manasuhuc junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe hatao rahuc docke betaŋ ehapie jaŋe ŋopa jâpec eŋarembiŋ, ehuc Anuture mi hâwic‐jopaha ŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic gâcne betaŋke sâqorerâ ʒâhec jumbiŋ jaŋe jopambiŋ hâcne.
Ŋoŋe irec hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eme ro rauc erâ ira juhuc râsifâc‐ŋeŋic sasawa qâhuc‐joparâ wama faio juniŋmu dameŋ ira Amaleke ŋic jopa miziepie sambâŋ rurumaŋnao ʒâŋe biŋe‐jeŋic omaezejec. Ŋoŋe irec moc mi nikec‐ŋopazejec.
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ moc ro rauc epie ŋoŋere biŋe eha ira juniŋte ŋare tahac eocmu.
Eme ŋoŋe ira fisirâ juhuc he sarac epie fârine fuame gie ɋâricnaonec nânâ wiac gâcne heo ro ŋiec erâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e ʒâŋe‐ticne foocte hae mâreŋ moc bâwosâeocmu ira baranʒepieŋ.
Ehuc dameŋ ira taha bapa moczi gie bahame erao rarâ ru sâc ʒiŋuc âzâcnenʒepieŋ: ‘No miŋecgac Wofuŋ Anutuge ere maio ʒiŋuc mupaŋkekopac: Wofuŋzi mâreŋ nâre tahac eocte mamacfâc‐nâŋec mupaŋke‐jarewec mâreŋ ira hâcne ware fisipo.’
Iŋuc mupie taha bapazi nânâ wiac ŋowac rorâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte alata maŋfuŋko râezejec.
“Ehame ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio dâŋ kecʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Mamac‐nâŋec e Aramea ŋiczi hahata jujujec. Juku Aigita mâreŋko hurâ ira jaba juwec. E kikefuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋe ŋic afecne mac. Eme ira juhuc ine sawe mâririackerâ ŋic guru sâko embiŋ.
Ehame Aigita ŋic jaŋe bomac‐nâpohuc bâʒâic‐nâporâ fai‐nâŋecko tagi ŋemâcne râepie fewec.
Iŋuc enârepie mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋere Wofuŋ Anutu e wira wâwâsic ecnepene mana‐nârehuc fific guguriŋ â ʒâic busâqoc erâ ʒârâ hâriŋ faio jumbeŋ i hone‐fârewec.
Hone‐fârerâ tâpiri mesanaŋ‐ticnezi mâsi wiac hâhâwicne fuŋne fuŋne bâfuahuc Aigita mâreŋkonec bacnâpo wahawec.
Ehuc hae mâreŋ susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeekac ʒira hâcne râec‐nâpowec.
O Wofuŋ, ʒi ine mâreŋ nâre tahac emeŋ irec fârine bâsuhuc baware‐gareŋgopeneŋ.’ Ŋoŋe iŋuc muhuc nânâ wiac‐ŋeŋic i Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio râepie foha Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic mai ecnenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ŋaŋacne mecne, garikiŋfâc‐ŋeŋic mecne, Lewiŋic mecne â ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic jabane juŋgopieŋ jaŋe mecne mâmâc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ehâmo‐ŋarewec irec ʒeri enʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe jufekupie jara jahec â moc eha gie‐ŋeŋicko wiac fuaekac irec fârine teŋkonec wâŋ i Lewiŋic mecne, ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic jabane jueŋgopieŋ mecne, erâ hozec bekâ jaŋe mâmâc jare‐fârepie hae‐ŋeŋicko juhuc nâ gapec enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Nâŋe nânâ wiac bâtirikicne i ficnâŋeckonec bârârierâ sâcmutâc nâzâ mutâc emeŋ irec sâcko Lewiŋic â ŋic jabane erâ hozec bekâ jaŋe jare‐fârembeŋ. Nâŋe sâcmutâc dâŋge pitic siŋsiŋne moc mi qâsuambeŋ, me irec wâc mi nikec‐nâpowec.
Nâŋe ki busâqoc ehuc wiac teŋkonec wâŋ moc mi nâmbeŋ, me wâwânâŋhec juhuc moc mi bârâriembeŋ, me gâcne hâmokicne jaŋere taha bâzi wâc mi râembeŋ. Nâŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec gore dâŋ mana rereŋ ehuc dâŋ nâzâ mutâc emeŋ irec sâc wiac efârembeŋ.
Irec go tiri haegao sambâŋ hâcne, ira juhuc ʒâŋe fitec wahame Israe ŋicgurufâcge nâŋe jambuŋ‐nâpohuc mâreŋ susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeekac i nârezo mamacfâc‐nâŋec mupaŋke‐jaremeŋ i mâmâc jambuŋkezemec.’
“Ŋoŋe dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋ ʒi mana rereŋ eniŋte Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi miŋecgac mutâcne‐ŋarekac; irec ŋoŋe maŋ â mamanasu‐ŋeŋic i erao furu jaha râepie foha aimuŋ mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe miŋecgac Wofuŋ e Anutu‐nâŋec jukac muhuc ere kike hata bâjâperâ dâŋsanaŋ‐ticne â sâcmutâc â mumutâc dâŋticne bajuhuc dâŋticne reŋkeniŋte musanaŋkembieŋ hâcne.
Ehame Wofuŋzi mupaŋke‐ŋarewec irec sâc e jahacne ŋicfâc erâ juniŋte â sâcmutâc dâŋticne reŋke‐fâreniŋte miŋecgac mupaŋke‐ŋarekac wâc.
Ehuc bafaharec‐ŋopame, ŋic gurune gurune bâfuac‐jopawec jaŋere sâc siricke‐fârehuc ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec erâ juhapie muteŋ‐ŋopahuc sâsecŋopanʒepieŋ. Ehame mupaŋkewec irec sâc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte tiri ŋicguru erâ junʒepieŋ.”
Mose â Israe soŋaŋ micne jaŋe ŋic ŋokac dâŋ kecʒiŋuc jaza mutâc embiŋ: “Ŋoŋe miŋecgac sâcmutâc dâŋ ŋaza mutâc embeneŋ i reŋke‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋare tahac ekac ira raniŋte Jordaŋ opâ fotâcneniŋmu dameŋ ira qânâzi ma âkendâŋnehuc simeŋzi batakirenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc fainao sâcmutâc dâŋ ʒi sasawa qâreŋke‐fârenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eme ro rauc eniŋte raʒihuc iŋuc hâcne enʒepieŋ. Mâreŋ ira susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeekac i hâcne mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere Wofuŋ Anutuzi ŋareocte mupaŋkewec.
Ŋoŋe Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ, dâŋ ŋaza mutâc embeneŋ irec sâcko qânâzi ma i Ebali tikio âkendâŋnenʒepieŋ, ehuc simeŋzi batakirenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ira Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte alata moc aeŋ wiaczi mâcne, qânâzi sawa banʒepieŋ.
Ine hâcne, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte alata i qânâ hâcbuczi banʒepieŋ, ehuc fainao Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte qowi bâzi rikenʒepieŋ.
Erâ wama bâzi wâc rikerâ nâhuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte maio ʒeri enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe sâcmutâc dâŋ ʒi qânâo qâreŋke‐hâmopie fua taniŋkezejec.”
Eme Mose â Lewiŋic taha bapa jaŋe Israe ŋic ʒeŋgoma ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “O Israe ŋicbureŋ, ŋoŋe niniŋkerâ hazec râeniŋ: Ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ ʒira Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte ŋic ŋokac eŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe irec hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte dâŋ mananʒepieŋ, ehuc sâcmutâc â dâŋsanaŋ‐ticne miŋecgac ŋaza mutâc eŋgopeneŋ i reŋkenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Mose e ʒoaŋ ijaha ŋic ŋokac dâŋ ʒiŋuc jaza mutâc ewec:
“Ŋoŋe Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ ŋicguru kecʒiŋuc jaŋe ŋic ŋokac jambuŋ‐jopaniŋte Geriʒim tikio domanʒepieŋ: Simeoŋ, Lewi, Juda, Isasa, Josefe â Benjamiŋ.
Â sâwec‐jopaniŋte ine ŋicguru kecʒiŋuc jaŋe Ebali tikio domanʒepieŋ: Rubeŋ, Gade, Ase, Sebuloŋ, Daŋ â Naftali.
Ehame Lewiŋic jaŋe Israe ŋic ʒeŋgoma hahaŋne bahuc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc jazanʒepieŋ:
“‘Metâ bapa ŋic jaŋe ɋâŋ qâqâtâc wiac bapie Wofuŋzi maname wiac mamakâcne eekac i ŋic moczi moc jâczi me aeŋzi barâ soŋsoŋko heme ŋeocmu ŋic e sâweckenʒepieŋ.’ Iŋuc epie ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Jâmbomac.’
“‘Ŋic moczi neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne ʒaubac ejacteocmu e sâweckenʒepieŋ.’ Iŋuc epie ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Jâmbomac.’
“‘Ŋic moczi âgo‐ticnere mâreŋte ma bârârieocmu e sâweckenʒepieŋ.’ Iŋuc epie ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Jâmbomac.’
“‘Ŋic moczi ŋic ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ moc ecneme hata qâsorieocmu e sâweckenʒepieŋ.’ Iŋuc epie ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Jâmbomac.’
“‘Ŋic moczi ŋic jabane me hozec bekâ jaŋere dâŋ muhasickeocmu e sâweckenʒepieŋ.’ Iŋuc epie ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Jâmbomac.’
“‘Ŋic moczi mamac‐ticnere ŋonâŋhec fohuc mamac‐ticne mimi qaqac ecneocmu e sâweckenʒepieŋ.’ Iŋuc epie ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Jâmbomac.’
“‘Ŋic moczi qowi jaŋehec sasec gie baocmu e sâweckenʒepieŋ.’ Iŋuc epie ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Jâmbomac.’
“‘Ŋic moczi seŋoc‐ticnehec foocmu e sâweckenʒepieŋ.’ Iŋuc epie ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Jâmbomac.’
“‘Ŋic moczi safeŋ‐ticnehec foocmu e sâweckenʒepieŋ.’ Iŋuc epie ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Jâmbomac.’
“‘Ŋic moczi ŋic âgo‐ticne soŋsoŋko qâhâmoocmu e sâweckenʒepieŋ.’ Iŋuc epie ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Jâmbomac.’
“‘Ŋic moczi ŋic moc kiŋ tâmiric qâhâmoocte furine râcnepie roocmu e sâweckenʒepieŋ.’ Iŋuc epie ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Jambomac.’
“‘Ŋic moczi sâcmutâc dâŋ ʒi reŋkehuc mi bajuocmu e sâweckenʒepieŋ.’ Iŋuc epie ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Jâmbomac.’
“Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte dâŋ mana rereŋ ehuc sâcmutâc dâŋticne miŋecgac ŋaza mutâc ekopac i aimuŋ jaha bajuniŋmuo ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi bafaharec‐ŋopame mâreŋ sâc ŋicne ŋicne juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe siric‐jopaniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte dâŋ mana rereŋ eniŋmuo ine jambuŋte fârine kecʒiŋuc bâfuanʒepieŋ:
Hae‐ŋeŋicko juhâc qâhâmonʒepieŋ â gie boze‐ŋeŋicko iŋuc jaha juhâc qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe fua sawec enʒepieŋ â giegaŋ‐ŋeŋicte fârine mazuc mâriri fuazejec erâ lama bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic sasawa jaŋe sawe mâririackenʒepieŋ.
Heŋeŋicko me rowaŋ‐ŋeŋicko dameŋ sâc nânâzi fusucmarâ fozejec.
Fahare raniŋmu me fisi foniŋmu ine Wofuŋzi jambuŋ‐ŋopahuc juzejec.
“Wofuŋ e râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe qâzuckerâ guru mocjaha warehapie ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko bawahac‐jopame siŋsaŋ qarâ gurune gurune ehuc wise‐fâreniŋmu.
Wofuŋ e iŋuc ehuc rowaŋ fic wiac‐ŋeŋic jambuŋkeme mazuc mâriri sâkohec eocmu â gie wiac‐ŋeŋic sasawa jambuŋkeme qarâ biaŋ fua‐fâreocmu. Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eocmu ira juhapie jambuŋ‐ŋopaocmu hâcne.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte sâcmutâc dâŋ mana rereŋ ehuc itiroc‐ticne bâjâpeniŋmuo ine mupaŋke‐ŋarewec irec sâcko tiri ŋicgurufâc‐ticne bacŋopaocmu.
Iŋuc eme Wofuŋte ŋicfâc muŋareeŋgopieŋ i mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋe manarâ ŋoŋere erâ hâwic‐jopazejec.
Ehame Wofuŋzi mâreŋ ŋare tahac eocte mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mupaŋke‐jarewec ira juhapie jambuŋ‐ŋopame ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic mecne, bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic mecne jaŋe sawe mâririackehapie nânâ wiac‐ŋeŋic wâc fua biaŋ ezejec.
Ehame Wofuŋzi mume sambâŋ aŋkeme hoezi dameŋ‐ticnaoa hehuc mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic bâgunuckezejec. Iŋuc eme nânâ mâriri fua‐ŋareme ŋicne ŋicne kime dopec ejarehuc jaŋere wiac tofamâc mi jowac ronʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ e iŋuc ehuc bafaharec‐ŋopame ŋicguru gâcne jaŋere kiŋaŋ qaqa mi junʒepieŋ, ehame juju ʒae‐ŋeŋiczi wawahane mi eha fefene jaha fozejec. Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic ere sâcmutâc dâŋ miŋecgac ŋaza mutâc ekopac i mana rereŋ ehuc aimuŋ jaha bajuniŋmuo
me miŋecgac dâŋ wiac gâcne ŋaza mutâc ekopac i qatarahuc fâreopec me qanaopec qâsorierâ nemu gâcne araŋ moc mi bajareniŋmuo ine iŋuc hâcne eŋareocmu.
“Me ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte dâŋ mana rereŋ mi eniŋmu me sâcmutâc â dâŋsanaŋ‐ticne miŋecgac ŋaza mutâc ekopac i aimuŋ jaha mi bajuniŋmuo ine sâwec ʒiŋuc hotâckeniŋmu:
Hae‐ŋeŋicko juhapie sâwec‐ŋopazo, me gie boze‐ŋeŋicko ŋec juc ehapie sâwec‐ŋopazo wâc.
Heŋeŋic me rowaŋ‐ŋeŋic i sâweckezo jaha.
Ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic mecne, giegaŋ‐ŋeŋicte fârine mecne, lama bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mâmâc sâwec‐jopa‐fârezo.
Ehame sâweczi fai‐ŋeŋicko feha fahare ranʒepieŋ me fisi fonʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe behecnurâ wiac hehesicne embiŋte gie i me i bahuc juhapie Wofuŋ noni mupe ʒika â ʒârâ hâriŋ faio sisi hâhâŋ juju i fua‐ŋareme izia hâmo sipiric enʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ nonizia mupe huc sâqocnezi rocŋopa‐fâreme mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋte raʒizo eŋgopieŋ ira sirowe‐fâreniŋmu.
Erâ Wofuŋ nonizia wâc mupe hucsanaŋ me huc ʒocnehec, me huc ʒupu me sahac ɋâɋâfoŋ fua‐ŋareocmu, me ʒoaŋ sanaŋ qaocmu, me nânâ wiac‐ŋeŋic râec mâʒiac efâreme hâmo sipiric efâreniŋmu hâcne.
Ehame sambâŋko karoraczi aeŋ bâbâroŋ iŋucne eme hoe mocwâc mi heocmu â mâreŋzi aeŋ iŋucne eme wiac nânânezi wâc mi fuaocmu.
Wofuŋ noni mupe mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko hoezi herisieme kâmbâc â rufe iŋucne waharâ sipiric‐ŋopa‐fâreocmu.
“Ŋoŋe râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jopaniŋte qâzuckerâ guru mocjaha rahapie Wofuŋzi râsifâc‐ŋeŋic mana‐jareme bawahac‐ŋopapie siŋsaŋ qarâ gurune gurune ehuc wise‐fâreniŋmu. Ehame mâreŋ sâc ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe honec‐ŋoparâ bipic tatara ejareocmu.
Iŋuc fuame qâŋɋâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic wipe qowi jaŋere nânâ ehapie ŋic moczi moc jopa jâpec sâcne mi ejareocmu.
Eme Wofuŋzi mume Aigita ŋic jaŋere wicsanaŋ mecne, erâ wakoc â sisiwiŋ â kore i mâmâc fua‐ŋareme bâbâpiaŋkenere sâc mi eocmu.
Ehuc Wofuŋzia mume bemiroc â ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ erâ maŋsifuc wâc fua‐ŋareocmu.
Ehame ŋic ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋzi dapâcko âtesac qasac ehuc juekac irec sâc jaha ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ ɋaɋacko âtesac qasac ehuc juniŋmu. Ehuc gie i me i bapie fâri tâmiric eocmu, ehame ŋic jaŋe bâʒâic‐ŋopahuc wiac‐ŋeŋic fiuckepie ŋic moczi moc sâcne mi bafic‐ŋopaocmu.
Dameŋ ira ŋic moc ŋokac biŋe qacnehapie ŋic moczi ŋokac ehec foocmu. Â fic moc barâ maŋnao ŋec juc mi eniŋmu, â waiŋ gie bapie fârine fuame ro nâc wâc mi eniŋmu.
Erâ wâc bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko jopapie biuc‐jeŋic moc mi nâniŋmu, â doŋgifâc‐ŋeŋic ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋickoa fiuc rocjoparâ mocwâc mi bârisiec‐jopaniŋmu. Râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe lamafâc‐ŋeŋic rocjopa‐fârepie moczi moc sâcne mi bafic‐ŋopaocmu.
Ehame otâ ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ŋic gâcne jaŋere meo fepie hone jâjâpec‐jopahuc juku ʒâŋe‐ŋeŋic râŋgeŋkeocmu, ehame ŋaŋaczia sanaŋkeniŋte eipieniŋmu.
