“Nâŋâc Aigita mâreŋko weniŋuc ehuc jumbeŋ i ŋoŋe mana‐fâreŋgopieŋ. Erâ ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere mâreŋ fotâcne warehuc
nemuɋâŋ jâc me qânâ me siliwa me golzi bapie ŋerawec i hone‐fârembiŋ.
Irec miŋecgac ŋoŋeraonec ŋic me ŋokac me garikiŋ moc me ŋicguru i me i moczi Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic râpeckerâ ŋicguru i jaŋere nemuɋâŋ wiac kiŋaŋ qajarenʒipiŋte me ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko wiac sâqocnere gâtâ qafeŋzi fua soka erâ fârine ŋiŋiŋne â hâtâne fuazacte rucgereŋ‐ŋeŋic bahuc junʒepieŋ.
Irec ŋoŋeraonec ŋic moczi ʒâʒâfic kecʒirec mumupaŋ manarâ maŋzi ʒeri ehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc mi muzejec: ‘No maŋsanaŋ‐nanere hata bâjâpehuc sifu juhâc qâhâmopemu.’ Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc sisipiricte biŋe efâreniŋmu hâcne.
Wofuŋ e ŋic iŋucnere sâqocne mi bâtâmirehuc kimbeŋ â ʒoɋac‐ticnezi qa imac ecneha papia kecʒirec maŋnao sâwecdâŋ qâreŋkekicne fokac izi ere biŋe efâreocmu, ehame Wofuŋzi ŋic ere ʒâŋe bâtâmireme mâreŋko omaeocmu.
Eme Wofuŋzi ŋic e Israe gurune gurune ŋoŋere ŋondeŋkonec rorâ ʒâʒâfic kecʒirec mumutâc papiao sâwecdâŋ fokac irec sâcko tuŋkeme hurâ sisipiricte biŋe eocmu.
Eme Wofuŋzi mume mâreŋ ʒi â ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋerao ʒârâ hâriŋ me huc mimicne fuaocmu i ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mecne â ŋic jabane mâreŋ ʒorickonec wareniŋmu jaŋe mâmâc honeniŋmu.
Erâ mâreŋ i kereŋke‐fâreme ŋiczi he sarac sâcne mi eniŋmu â sopâc kecɋaŋzi wâc sâcne mi wefuocmu; iŋuc honehuc juhapie Wofuŋ e aarickeme Sodom â Gomora erâ Adama â Zeboim hae mâreŋ bâsirowec‐jopawec irec sâc fuame honeniŋmu wâc.
Iŋuc honerâ jaŋacne mecne â ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe mecne mâmâc ʒiŋuc mu wioc eniŋmu: ‘Wofuŋ e wemocte mâreŋ ʒira sisipiric iŋucne bâfuawec, â wemocte boc aarickekac?’
Iŋuc mu wioc epie ŋic jaŋe dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jareniŋmu: ‘Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋiczi mamacfâc‐jeŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa wahahuc jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ewec, ʒâʒâfic i râpeckembiŋte iŋuc hâcne fua‐jarekac.
Jaŋe nemu burecne mi manac‐jopambiŋ â Wofuŋzi wâc mi bâfua‐jarewec jaŋe hâcne araŋ bajarehuc dape‐jarembiŋ.
Irec erâ Wofuŋte aariczi bâruŋkeme papia kecʒirec maŋnao sâwecdâŋ qâreŋkekicne fokac irec sâcko mâreŋ ʒi sipirickekicne.
Ehame Wofuŋzi mana gâpâre‐jarehuc aarickeme mâreŋ‐jeŋickonec unuc‐joparâ mâreŋ mocko bacjopa rarâ behec‐jopame jumbiŋzi juŋgopieŋ jaha.’
“Wiac soŋsoŋko fokac i Wofuŋte biŋe, â wiac bararuŋkekicne i nâŋâc â ɋâricfâc‐nâŋec nâŋâcne biŋe, irec sâcmutâc kecʒirec dâŋ fokac i sasawa mana rereŋ ehuc junʒepieŋ.
“Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi bâtâtiec‐ŋopame ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhapie miŋecgac jambuŋ â sâwecdâŋ ŋaza mutâc ekopac izi fai‐ŋeŋicko feme irec manasunʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ŋaŋacne â ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋictao risierâ miŋecgac dâŋ ŋaza mutâc ekopac i maŋ mamanasu‐ŋeŋiczi manatâc qâtâc ehuc reŋke‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc eniŋmuo ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi kâpâcwâruonec batarac‐ŋoparâ busâqoc mana‐ŋarehuc ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐ŋopawec irecnec mocwâc qâzuc‐ŋopaocmu.
E mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao bâtâtiec‐ŋopaocmuo ine sifu irecnec mocwâc rocŋoparâ mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko bârisiec‐ŋopaocmu.
Ehuc mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mâreŋ ro rauc embiŋ ira râec‐ŋopame ro rauc erâ mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere sâc sirickehuc basawec‐ŋopame juhâc qâhâmonʒepieŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e ŋaŋacne â ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic ŋoŋe baafec‐ŋopame maŋŋeŋic erao furu jaha râepie foha juhâmonʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc epie Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi sâwecdâŋ sasawa i râsifâc‐ŋeŋic kisâ eŋarehuc ŋopa jâpec eŋarembiŋ jaŋere faio râeme feocmu.
Ehame ŋoŋe ine Wofuŋ noni miŋecgac sâcmutâc dâŋ ŋaza mutâc ekopac i mocwâc mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi jambuŋ‐ŋopame meqâreŋ wiac‐ŋeŋic mecne, ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mecne, bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mecne erâ giegaŋ wiac‐ŋeŋic sasawa i fua babaraŋ fua raocmu. Wofuŋzi mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic buafec jaha ehâmo‐jarewec irec sâc jaha ŋoŋe ehâmo‐ŋareocmu.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte dâŋ mana rereŋ ehuc sâcmutâc dâŋ â dâŋsanaŋ‐ticne mumutâc papia kecʒirec maŋnao qâreŋkekicne fokac i bajuniŋmu, ehuc maŋ â mamanasu‐ŋeŋic Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋictao furu jaha râepie foocmuo ine iŋuc hâcne eŋareocmu.
“Sâcmutâc dâŋ miŋecgac ŋaza mutâc ekopac i dâŋ ŋemâcne aricne, erâ ʒoricko wâc mi fokac.
Sambâŋko mi fokacte ʒiŋuc mi muzo: ‘Mozi ferâ bawaha‐nâreme mana rereŋ enaŋmu?’
Me hâwec ocniŋucnao wâc mi fokacte ʒiŋuc mi muzo: ‘Mozi hâwec fotâcnerâ baware‐nâreme mana rereŋ enaŋmu?’
Aricne, sâcmutâc dâŋ i maŋfuŋ‐ŋeŋicko jâmbâŋ fokac, ŋoŋe mana rereŋ eniŋte maŋŋeŋicko â micbipic‐ŋeŋicko râekicne fokac hâcne.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, no miŋecgac wiac aŋac baŋacne â juju fârine ŋowatukopac, erâ ŋifec ine eebapa sâqocne â hâmoc irec hata wâc mâmâc ŋaza mutâc ekopac.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic maŋzi ʒâfickehuc hata‐ticne bâjâperâ sâcmutâc â dâŋsanaŋ erâ mumutâc dâŋticne bajuhuc sâcmutâc dâŋticne ŋaza mutâc ekopac i mana rereŋ eniŋmuo ine juhâmohuc sawe mâririackeniŋmu. Ehuc mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋte raʒirâ juhapie Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi jambuŋ‐ŋopaocmu.
Me ŋoŋe Wofuŋ râpeckerâ dâŋticne qatarahuc nemu burecne jaŋerao qohotarâ araŋ bajarehuc kiŋaŋ qajareniŋmuo
ine sipiricke‐jâmbâŋkeniŋmu, no miŋecgac dâŋ iŋuc hâcne ŋazakopac. Ŋoŋe Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋmu ira dameŋ ʒora mi juniŋmu.
No miŋecgac sambâŋ â mâreŋ jahere maio juju â hâmoc erâ jambuŋ â sâwecdâŋ irec hata hone taraniŋte fuŋne ŋaza ŋowatuc ekopac. Irec ŋoŋe ŋaŋacne â ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic mâmâc juhâc qâhâmoniŋte jujure hata âtenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic maŋzi ʒâfickerâ dâŋticne mana rereŋ ehuc erao qohotanʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc epie Wofuŋzi apafâc‐ŋeŋic Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo jaŋe mâreŋ jareocte mupaŋke‐jarewec ira dameŋ ʒora juhâc qâhâmoniŋmu.”
Eme Mose e ʒuhuckerâ Israe ŋic ʒeŋgoma dâŋ jazawec.
Ehuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: “No miŋecgac jara‐nane 120 ekac. Irec no hata jujunere sâc mocwâc mi ekopac. Erâ Wofuŋzi wâc ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Go Jordaŋ opâ mi fotâcnezemec.’
Wofuŋ Anutu e jahac bânie‐ŋarehuc fotâcneocmu, ehuc ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko ŋicne ŋicne keci jaŋe ima bacjopahame mâreŋ‐jeŋic jowac ronʒepieŋ. Ehame Wofuŋzi muwec irec sâcko Josuazi bânie‐ŋareha opâ fotâcnenʒepieŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ e Amori ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ â Ogo erâ mâreŋ‐jeŋic mâmâc ima bacjopahuc wiac ejarewec sâc ijaha‐jaŋe ejareocmu.
Ehuc meŋeŋicko râec‐jopame ŋoŋe sâcmutac dâŋ ŋaza mutâc efârepo irec sâcko ejarenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe hâbihec erâ sanaŋkenʒepieŋ, ehuc jaŋere hâwic‐ŋopame mi gâgâmârânʒepieŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e ŋoŋehec juhuc mi behec‐ŋopaocmu.”
Mose e dâŋ iŋuc jazame tarame Josua hefârerâ Israe ŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe faio ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go hâbihec erâ sanaŋkezemec. Go ŋicguru ʒi jaŋehec Wofuŋzi mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ jareocte mupaŋke‐jarewec ira bânie‐jaretec ranʒepieŋ, erâ mâreŋ i bâtâc bajaretec ro rauc enʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋzi hâcne bânie‐garerâ gohec juhuc mi behecguocmu, irec hâwicgume mana mezac mi ezemec.”
Eme Mose e sâcmutâc dâŋ ʒi qâreŋkerâ Lewiŋic taha bapa Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapa reŋke jumbieŋ jaŋe â Israe soŋaŋ micne sasawa jarewec.
Ehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc jaza mutâc ewec: “Jara 7 tarame sâc tofa bebehere jara dameŋ bakicne i maickeme rehac boze hombaŋko
Israe ŋic ʒeŋgoma jaŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae mâreŋ bâwosâeocmu ira ere maio fisipie ŋoŋe sâcmutâc dâŋ ʒi hâcne tutumaŋ‐jeŋicko wose‐jarenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ŋic ŋokac naru motec â ŋic jabane hae‐ŋeŋicko juniŋmu jaŋe hetumaŋ‐jopahuc dâŋ i jazapie Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic araŋ bacnehuc sâcmutâc dâŋ ʒi aijakic jaha reŋkenʒepieŋ.
Ehame naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic sâcmutâc dâŋ kâuc baniŋmu jaŋe wâc manarâ, mâreŋ rauckeniŋte Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnezo eŋgopieŋ ira juhuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic araŋ bacnehuc junʒepieŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, hâmoc dameŋge maickekac; irec go Josua wiracnetec wareme tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo fepire giedâŋ mucnezepac.” Iŋuc âzâcneme Mose â Josua jahe tutumaŋ qoruc bozeo fepic.
Ehame Wofuŋzi karorac ɋâfoŋne irec maŋnao juhuc qoruc bozeo fua‐jactewec. Karorac ɋâfoŋne izi ine qoruc bozere motâcko sanaŋkerâ domawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, go apa ŋosafâcge jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ hâmozo ekomec. Iŋuc etec ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe mâreŋ mukicne ira raʒirâ ŋic furune jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhuc nemufâc‐jeŋic araŋ bajareniŋmu, ehuc no râpecnurâ jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo i hetâcneniŋmu.
Iŋuc epie kimbeŋ‐nanezi bâruŋkeme behec‐jopahuc râpec‐jopape wiac ʒâʒâicne â sisipiricnehec fai‐jeŋicko feme omae‐fâreniŋmu. Iŋuc fua‐jareme honerâ ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Wiac ʒâʒâicne i Anutu‐nâŋeczi ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko mi jukacte fua‐nârekac hâcne.’
Jaŋe nemu burecne jaŋerao qohotahuc wiac hehesicne fuŋne fuŋne embiŋte no dameŋ ira râpec‐jopapemu.
Go irec hâcne gae ʒi qâreŋkerâ Israe ŋic qazu‐jarezemec, ehuc ejaretec herâ he epie fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋke‐jarezejec.
No kâcɋenefâc‐jeŋic mâreŋ susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeekac i jarepemurâ mupaŋke‐jarepo ira jowac‐jopape ra fisirâ juhuc nânâ mâretec nâ gapec erâ soka puŋpuŋ ehuc nemu burecne jaŋerao qohotahuc kiŋaŋ qajareniŋmu. Ehuc no râpecnurâ ʒâʒâfic‐nane hetâcneniŋmu.
Iŋuc epie wiac ʒâʒâicne â sisipiricneheczi fai‐jeŋicko feme gae ʒizi hâcne fuŋne‐jeŋic bataniŋkezejec. (Gae i ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe herâ he ehuc juniŋmu sanaŋ.) Jaŋe mamanasu‐jeŋic wena râepie foocmu i mâreŋ jarezo mupaŋkepo ira mi ra fisihapie biac mana tarakopac hâcne.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Mosezi gae i ʒoaŋ ijaha qâreŋkerâ Israe ŋic qazu‐jarewec.
Eme Wofuŋ e Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua giedâŋ mucnehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go hâbihec erâ sanaŋkezemec. Goki hâcne Israe ŋic jowac‐jopatec mâreŋ jarezo mupaŋkepo ira ranʒepieŋ. No gohec jupemu.”
Eme Mose e sâcmutâc kecʒirec dâŋ i papiao qâreŋke tarawec.
Qâreŋke tararâ Lewiŋic Wofuŋte katapa reŋke jumbieŋ jaŋe dâŋ kecʒiŋuc jaza mutâc ewec:
“Ŋoŋe sâcmutâc dâŋte papia keczi rorâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte ʒâʒâfic katapa maŋfuŋnao râepie fohuc fuŋne‐ŋeŋic bataniŋkehuc juzejec.
No manakopac, ŋoŋe ŋic qaqatarahec â râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne. Manaŋgopieŋ, no miŋecgac ŋoŋehec jaha juhape Wofuŋ maŋrâŋgeŋ bâfuacneŋgopieŋzi juku hâmohape weniŋuc eniŋmu.
Irec ŋoŋe Israe ŋic gurune gurune â momorifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere micnefâc hetumaŋ‐jopa‐fârehapie no sambâŋ â mâreŋ jahere maio dâŋ ʒi ŋazape mana‐jâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ.
No manapaŋkekopac, no hâmohape ŋoŋe hehesic sâko bâfuarâ hata ŋaza ŋowatuc ewarehuc jupo i râpeckerâ qâsorieniŋmu. Ŋoŋe Wofuŋzi maname sâqoreekac wiac iŋucne hâcne ehuc juju bapa‐ŋeŋiczi maŋbâiŋ ecnepie juku sisipiric fua‐ŋareocmu.”
Mose e dâŋ iŋuc jazarâ Israe ŋic sasawa tutumaŋ‐jeŋicko gaere dâŋ kecʒi hâcne jazaku jaza tarawec:
“Sambâŋne sambâŋne ŋoŋe hazec râepie dâŋ ŋazape, â mâreŋ go micdâŋ‐nane manazemec.
Mu qaqazuc dâŋnane i hoe pisiŋ pisiŋ iŋucne eha micdâŋ‐nanezi maniŋ titikuc wahaekac irec sâc ezejec, hoe sisiczi kecɋaŋ bagunuckeekac â hoe micsâko hehuc nânâ monʒaŋ gume hesiwiŋ ecneekac irec sâc hâcne.
No Wofuŋ ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne mutaniŋkepe ŋoŋe Anutu‐nâŋec muteŋ bâteŋ ecnenʒepieŋ.
“E haroŋaŋ sanaŋ iŋucne, erâ gie‐ticne i fâretiŋ, eebapa‐ticne i tiŋne sasawa. E Anutu mume sasanaŋ â bâbâsifuc tâmiric, e tiŋne â jâmbomac rune hâcne.
Ŋoŋe ŋicguru repicne â hehesicnezi Anutu maŋbâiŋ ecnembiŋte naru motecfâc‐ticne mocwâc mi juŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic mutucne â mamana tâmiric ŋoŋe wemocte iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋ bunao baŋgopieŋ? Eki hâcne mamac bâbâfua‐ŋeŋic, erâ ekizia bâfuac‐ŋoparâ hume keteŋ eŋarewec.
Ŋoŋe mârâc jaha dameŋ fowec irec manasuniŋ me! Erâ ŋic gaŋne gaŋne juwefumbiŋ jaŋere jara dameŋte wâc manasunʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic wio‐jarepie ŋazaniŋmu, â micnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe wâc irec binaŋ baŋareniŋmu.
Femicne sâkozi ŋic gurune gurune mâreŋ biŋe qajarewec, â ŋicne ŋicne bârâwiŋ‐jopawec dameŋ ira Israe ŋic ʒare‐nâŋecte manasuhuc guru‐nâŋec sâc mâreŋ bâtâc banârewec.
Israe ŋic nâŋe Wofuŋte biŋe, â Jakobore ŋicfâc jaŋe ere biŋe jaha.
“E mâreŋ burocnao bâfuac‐nâpowec, mâreŋ kereŋnao â qowi mimicne jaŋere jujuo hâcne. E orâŋ‐nâpohuc hone maiŋ enârewec, ehuc ʒâŋe hândâŋfâc‐nane muhuc soŋaŋ‐nâpowec.
E tucwipezi motecfâcne sareŋko ŋehapie hehetâcnehuc hone soŋaŋ ejareekac, me fakec‐ticne hedâmârehuc rocjoparâ fakec fai‐ticnao râec‐jopaekac irec sâc enârewec.
Ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko nemu furune moczi moc mi juhame Wofuŋ e mocjahazi jowa qataŋ enârehuc juwec.
Eki hâcne enâreme hae mâreŋ fotâcnerâ rambeŋ, ehuc giegaŋkonec nânâ monʒaŋ wiac ro nâc embeŋ; erâ ekizia haroŋaŋ haweckonec baŋac gumeqiŋ‐nâpowec, â qânâ sanaŋkonec wokemaŋ wahame nâmbeŋ.
Ehuc wiac kecʒiŋuc wâc nâjumbeneŋ: Bulimakao susure wokemaŋ, lama jaŋere susu, lama motecnere râpe hândâŋ irec wokemaŋ. Basaŋ mâreŋkonec bulimakao â noniŋ ŋicne, waizeŋ uucne aŋac baŋacne erâ waiŋ opâ momori.
“Jakobore ŋicfâc jaŋe iŋuc ehuc nâ gapec embiŋ, â Jesuruŋ ŋic ŋoŋe wokemaŋ sâkohec erâ ʒaubac embiŋ. Ŋoŋe biuc wokemaŋhec erâ soka puŋpuŋ embiŋ, ehuc Anutu Mamac bâbâfua‐ŋeŋic behembiŋ â bâbâpiaŋ‐ŋeŋicte qânâuŋ hone suŋgiŋ ecnembiŋ.
Ŋoŋe nemu furune jaŋerao qohotahuc Anutu‐ŋeŋic maŋbâiŋ ecnembiŋ, ehuc nemuɋâŋ bajuhuc bunao bambiŋ.
Ŋoŋe nemu jabane mârâc mi manac‐jopambiŋ jaŋe bâzi rike‐jarembiŋ; nemu furune, diguracfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋeraonec rombiŋ; â mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mi sâsec‐jopambiŋ jaŋe hâcne iŋuc ejarembiŋ.
Ŋoŋe Mamac bâbâfua‐ŋeŋic ere mi manasumbiŋ, ehuc Anutu bâfuac‐ŋopawec ere wâc nikec‐ŋopawec.
“Wofuŋ e jahacne naru motecfâc jaŋe iŋuc ehuc bunao bapie honec‐joparâ behec‐jopawec.
Ehuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: ‘No ʒâŋe mai‐nane bâsoŋke‐jarepe wiac weniŋuc fua‐jareocmu i honezepac. Jaŋe ŋicguru qaqaharicnezi naru motecfâc‐nane biaŋne mi juŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe nemu burecne jaŋerao qohotahuc maŋbâiŋ enarembiŋ, â nemuɋâŋ bajuhuc bunaneo bambiŋ. Irec no ŋicguru omane ejarepe maŋbâiŋ ejarenʒepieŋ, â ŋicguru mutucne jaŋe ejarepe bujeŋicko banʒepieŋ.
Kimbeŋ aaric‐nanezi bâruŋkerâ ʒahuku hârâc fâhâŋnao fisikac, ehuc mâreŋ â wiac sasawa ʒâseŋke‐fârehuc tiki fuŋnao sâcke‐fâreekac.
“‘No mupe fai‐jeŋicko sisipiriczi sisipiric feocmu, ehame tepe motec‐nanezi jaŋere faio qâtâcne‐fârepemu.
Jaŋe nânâre hâmo sipiric enʒepieŋ, ehame huc ʒocnehec â huc mimicnezi sipiric‐jopazejec. Erâ mupe qowi mimicne â homa momori bujeŋiczi foforâ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe fuarâ ki sipiric ejarenʒepieŋ wâc.
Hae ʒoŋao ʒikazi ima gie sâko baocmu, â ficmaŋko ine ɋâri hâmoczi rocjopaocmu. Ehame naru motec ʒeŋoŋne jaŋe mecne, erâ naru motec susuonec â ŋic ŋokac qizecne jaŋe mecne mâmâc omae‐fâreniŋmu.
No ʒiŋuc mupaŋkezo murâ mupaŋkezapo: “No bâtâtiec‐jopape ŋic jaŋe mocwâc mi manasuc‐jopanʒepieŋ.”
Erâ ine râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mana sifuckerâ ʒiŋuc munʒipiŋte iŋuc mi epo: “Wofuŋzi mâcne, nâŋe nâŋâcne mesanaŋzi bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârewec.” ’
“Jaŋe ŋicguru mutucne â maŋ mamanasu tâmiric.
Jaŋe mamanahec jurâ muzac wiac ʒi hone mana tarac enʒapiŋ, erâ juku weniŋuc fuaocmu i wâc mana taranʒapiŋ.
Rorowec‐jeŋiczi râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere meo mi râec‐jopame muzac ŋic mocjahazi wemocko ŋic wâŋ tauseŋ jâpec‐jopazac; me Wofuŋzi mi râpec‐jopame muzac ŋic jajaheczi wemocko ŋic teŋ tauseŋ bâtâtiec‐jopazapic.
Jaŋere rorowec e nâŋâcne rorowec iŋucne aricne, i râsifâc‐nâŋec jaŋe jaŋac manaeŋgopieŋ wâc.
Waiŋ qaŋeŋ‐jeŋic i Sodom â Gomora mâreŋkonec, waiŋ hândâŋ‐jeŋic i sâqocne â mi nânâne, â waiŋ hândâŋ makenehec i hâtâ qiŋqiŋne.
Waiŋ opâ‐jeŋic i homa momori jaŋere micopâ iŋucne, erâ wâc qotâre micopâ repicne irec sâc.
“Wiac sasawa i norao râekicne fokac, nore rowaŋficko qofackekicne fokac hâcne.
Ira foha okac babazu â okacne roro dameŋ maickeocmu, jaŋe dameŋ ira hâcne âte sowarierâ waha jopaocmu. Sisipiric dameŋ‐jeŋic i bembeŋkekac, â sisirowe dameŋ‐jeŋic i wâc qândâŋkekac hâcne.
Wofuŋ e ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere dâŋ mutaraocmu, ehuc kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe ine busâqoc mana‐jareocmu. Tâpiri‐jeŋic omaeme kiŋaŋŋic me ŋic rambaŋko jujune mocwâc mi jupie honerâ iŋuc hâcne ejareocmu.
Ehuc ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc mu wioc eŋareocmu: ‘Nemufâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe weni? Â qânâuŋko soŋkezo mumbiŋ i wena?
Tiri bâzi‐ŋeŋicte wokemaŋ me tahare waiŋ opâ‐ŋeŋic nâjumbieŋ nemu i jaŋe weni? Ejarepie fahare bafic‐ŋopahuc ŋezic‐ŋopaniŋ me!
“‘Ŋoŋe ʒi mana taraniŋ: No mocjahazi Wofuŋ jukopac, nore râpeo Anutu moc mi jukac. Noni hâcne ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopaekopac erâ mocwâc bâɋârec‐jopaekopac; no ʒâpâ joparâ mocwâc bâpiaŋ‐jopaekopac, ehame ŋic moczi moc nore meonec sâcne mi batarac‐jopaocmu.
No menane sambâŋkopec sicnehuc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mujomirekopac:
Jukopaczi jukopac no sâqe‐nane ʒâmu taeŋkerâ mumutara gie bahuc râsifâc‐nane okacne bazu‐jarepemu, â qaisocnueŋgopieŋ jaŋe katucne jarepemu.
Qâhâmoc‐jopakicne â kâpâcwâru bacjopakicne jaŋere soc mecne, erâ râsi micne bapafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere soc mâmâc, izi tepe motec‐nane ruacnezejec, â sâqe‐nanezi sahac‐jeŋic nâtâcnezejec.’
“Ŋicne ŋicne ŋoŋe Anutu nore ŋicfâc muteŋ bâteŋ ejareniŋ, noni hâcne kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere socte kiŋ batarapemu, ehuc râsifâc‐nane okacne bazu‐jarehuc no nahacne ŋicfâc jaŋere mâreŋ furu mupe foocmu.”
Eme Mose e ra gae irec dâŋ sasawa ŋic ŋokac jazame mana‐fârembiŋ; e jahacne â Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua jahe iŋuc hâcne epic.
Erâ Mose e dâŋ i sasawa Israe ŋic jaza tararâ
moc kecʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ jazawec: “No miŋecgac dâŋ sasawa ŋazakopac i maŋkerâ bajuhuc naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic mutâcne‐jarepie jaŋe sâcmutâc kecʒirec dâŋ sasawa aijakic jaha mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ irec manapie racne mâcne, juju‐ŋeŋicte dâŋ eha bajuhuc Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ mâreŋ rauckeniŋmu ira dameŋ ʒora jufenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒoaŋ ijaha jâmbâŋ Mose dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Moabi mâreŋko Jeriko hae ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec Abarim tiki ŋerakac irec tiki moc ʒâŋene Nebo ira fezemec. Ferâ Kanaaŋ mâreŋ Israe ŋic jarepe ro rauc eniŋmu i honezemec.
Erâ go tiki ira ferâ qomâfâcge qâtec‐jopahuc hâmozemec; ine hahacge Aroŋ Hora tikio hâmohuc qomâfâc‐ticne qâtec‐jopawec irec sâc.
Ŋohe Ziŋ mâreŋ burocnao Meriba‐Kadesi opâo nore dâŋ qatarahuc Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko araŋ mi banarepicte iŋuc hâcne fua‐ŋactekac.
No Israe ŋic mâreŋ jarepemu i ʒoricko domahuc honezemec, raraʒi ine mi raʒizemec.”
Anuture kiŋaŋŋic Mose e hâmoc dameŋ‐ticne maickeme dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc Israe ŋic jambuŋ‐jopawec:
“Wofuŋ e Sinai tikionec waharâ warewec, e Seiri mâreŋkonec huriri qâreŋ‐ticnehec warerâ ŋicfâc‐ticne nâŋâc fua‐nârewec. Tatamac‐ticne i Paraŋ tiki mâreŋko fua tâcnewec ehame tiriŋic gurune gurune jaŋe mefâre‐ticnaopec rambiŋ.
E jâmbomac ŋicfâc‐ticne maŋjauŋ fârine ejarewec, â biŋefâc‐ticne embiŋ jaŋe ere meo jufârembiŋ. Jaŋe maŋfuŋ‐ticnao juhuc eraonec sâcmutâc dâŋ manambiŋ.
Sâcmutâc dâŋ i Jakobore kikefuŋ nâŋâcne biŋe foocte Mosezi mutâcne‐nârewec.
Ehame Israe ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe mecne â micne bapafâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mâmâc tumaŋne‐fârehapie Wofuŋ Sâkozi ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko fua tâcnerâ juwec.
“Rubeŋ e mi hâhâmo ʒuhuckerâ jufeha ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe sawe mâririackenʒepieŋ.”
Judare dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “O Wofuŋ, go Judare nunumu manahuc ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋerao bârisiezemec. Ehuc ere âkehoc râsifâc‐ticne jaŋerao ʒika qahuc bafickezemec.”
Lewire dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Go Lewi mumutiŋ irec ma râcnezemec, â kiŋaŋŋicge biaŋne e fuŋne babataniŋ irec ma. Go e hâcne Masa hae mâreŋko esâickemeŋ, erâ Meriba opâ ira ine ehec mu qaqatarac epic.
E neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticnere kecʒiŋuc muwec: ‘No jahe mi manac‐jofakopac.’ Erâ e (Wofuŋ gore erâ) hahac ɋafâc‐ticne ʒâŋe ruruŋ‐jopahuc naru motecfâc‐ticne hone qâoma ejarewec. Lewiŋic jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋge mana rereŋ ehuc ʒâʒâficge soŋaŋkembiŋte wiacfâc‐jeŋic iŋuc ejarembiŋ.
Jaŋe mumutâc dâŋge Jakobore ŋicfâc qazu‐jarehuc Israe ŋic sâcmutâc dâŋge jaza jowatuc enʒepieŋ. Erâ gore maio hosâc âsu rikehuc gore alata faio qowi hâcbuc rikenʒepieŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go tâpiri‐ticne jambuŋkehuc eebapa‐ticnere manatec biaŋkezejec; â râsifâc‐ticne jaŋere hosiec qanʒaŋnetec mocwâc mi faharenʒepieŋ.”
Benjamiŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “E Wofuŋte joroc biaŋzi dameŋ sâc juhâc qâhâmozejec, erâ Anutu Fekicnezi ʒoaŋ sâc ŋezickehame tiki mâreŋ‐ticnao biaŋne ŋeŋe juju ezejec.”
Josefere dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Wofuŋzi mâreŋ‐ticne jambuŋkeme sambâŋkonec maniŋ titikuc wahazejec, â mâreŋmaŋkonec opâ ʒâŋe wefuzejec.
Ʒoaŋ dameŋko jâchândâŋ wiac biaŋne fuarâ woze qeuc ezejec, erâ mosa dameŋ biaŋnao nânâ monʒaŋ‐ticne fua biaŋ ezejec.
Tiki mâreŋko wiac fua biaŋ eekac i jambuŋkecnezemec ere tiki ŋeŋe sanaŋ ira wiac fofârekac i mâmâc.
Mâreŋte wiac biaŋne â furi sâko izi wâc mâririhec fuacnezejec, ehame jâc dutu maŋko juekaczi manacneme biaŋkezejec. Wiac i sasawa Josefere faio fefârerâ fozejec, qomâfâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋondeŋko fekicne jukac ere faio hâcne fezejec.
E bulimakao ŋicne mârâc fufua tâpirihec juekac irec sâc eha ʒuŋene bulimakao momori ere ʒuŋe iŋucne ezejec; e ʒuŋe izi ŋic gurune gurune hesuac‐jopame mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao wiserâ ranʒepieŋ. Eferaimte ŋicfâc teŋ tauseŋ gurune gurune jaŋe irec sâc eniŋmu, â Manasere ŋicfâc tauseŋ gurune gurune jaŋe irec sâc jaha eniŋmu.”
Sebuloŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Sebuloŋ, go wokeo rac warec eegere ʒeri ezemec, â Isasa go ine qoruc bozeo ŋeŋe jujure bubiaŋ manazemec.
Jaŋe ŋic gurune gurune tikifuŋko hetumaŋ‐joparâ bâzi fârine rikeniŋmu. Jaŋe hâwecmaŋko wiac fokac i rofâreniŋmu, â moŋgeŋmaŋko wiac furi sâko fokac i wâc ro rauc eniŋmu.”
Gadere dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Gade mâreŋ sâko râcne tahac ekac e mumbiaŋkezo Gade e laioŋ iŋucne ruc bahuc fokac, erâ meombâŋ â qizec‐jeŋic kisuc qâsuckeekac.
E mâreŋ dâkâne biaŋne jâmbâŋ e jahacne biŋe bâwosâewec, e micne bapa mâreŋ jarekicne irec sâc rowec hâcne. Eme ŋic ŋokac micnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe tumaŋnehapie Israe ŋic jaŋerao Wofuŋte sâcmutâc dâŋ â dâŋsanaŋ jaza mutâc ewec.”
Daŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Daŋ e laioŋ motecne iŋucne, e Basaŋ mâreŋkonec tararâ warekac.”
Naftalire dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “O Naftali, go Wofuŋte eehâmo â jambuŋ gorao fufusuc fokacte riqic â mâreŋ juwicpec ro rauc ezemec.”
Asere dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Ase e motec ɋafâc‐ticne gâcne jowaruhuc jambuŋ fekicne rozejec, ehame hahac ɋafâc‐ticne jaŋe manacnepie fefene eha kike‐ticne wokemaŋ ruacnezejec.
Motâc babasanaŋge i aeŋ â aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bapie fozejec, erâ tâpirige fokac i jufecmu sâc fogarehuc juzejec.
“Jesuruŋte Anutu e iŋucne moc mi jukac, e sambâŋne sambâŋne fotâcne rac warec ehuc juekac, ehame tâpiri‐ticnezi karoracko fuaekac.
Anutu juju sanaŋ rune eki huec sanaŋ‐ŋeŋic erâ jukac, erâ ekizia meticnezi sabec‐ŋopaekac. E bânie‐ŋarehuc râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jâpec‐jopahuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: Bâsirowec‐jopaniŋ!
Iŋuc fuame Israe ŋic ŋoŋe wama faio juhapie Jakobore ŋicfâc jaŋe wâc bucjeŋic jumbiŋ. Ine mâreŋ padi jacgoŋ â waiŋ mâririhec ira juhapie sambâŋkonec maniŋ titikuc wahahuc fowec.
O Israe ŋic, ŋoŋe ʒeri eniŋ! Ŋoŋe iŋucne ŋicguru moczi moc mi juŋgopieŋ. Wofuŋzi râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere meonec batarac‐ŋopawec. Eki hâcne maro‐ŋeŋic erâ ŋezic‐ŋopaekac, erâ ekizia tâpiri‐ŋeŋic eha ʒika qahuc sanaŋkeeŋgopieŋ. Râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe micbipiczi sawa bâbâmiriŋ dâŋ ŋazahapie ŋoŋe hae mâreŋ‐jeŋicko fotâcnehuc ro rauc enʒepieŋ.”
Eme Mose e Moabi wâneŋkonec rarâ Jeriko hae ŋifecnao Nebo tiki ŋewec irec botâŋne Pisiga hâcne ira fewec. Feme Wofuŋzi mâreŋ sasawa, Gileade mâreŋkonec fuŋkerâ raku Daŋ mâreŋko tarakac i jâutu‐fârewec.
Ehuc Naftali mâreŋ â Eferaim â Manase jahere mâreŋ erâ Juda mâreŋ sasawa hâwec sâkoo mickekac i mâmâc jâutu‐fârewec.
Erâ Negebe mâreŋ â Jordaŋ wâneŋ erâ hâmu hae Jeriko irec wâneŋ raku Zoari haeo tarakac i mâmâc hone‐fârewec.
Ehame Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No mâreŋ kecʒirec dâŋ i Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo ʒiŋuc muhuc mupaŋke‐jarepo: ‘No ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jarepemu.’ No iŋuc mupore mana‐garehape ʒâŋezi sawa honekomec, mâc ira raraʒi ine mi raʒicmu.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mose e Wofuŋte micdâŋ irec sâcko Moabi mâreŋko hâmowec.
Hâmome Wofuŋzi Moabi mâreŋko Bete‐Peoro ŋifecnao wâneŋ fokac ira duckewec. Ʒâŋeruŋ‐ticne ine ŋic moczi mi honembiŋ erâ dameŋ ʒiŋuczia wâc mi manaeŋgopieŋ.
Mose e jara dameŋ‐ticne 120 bazurâ hâmowec; e ʒâŋe‐ticne mi mâteŋkewec â sahac‐ticne wâc mi bâmuzuckewec.
Ehame Israe ŋic jaŋe Moabi wâneŋko Mosere busâqoc ehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 30 tarawec. Tarame Mosere ki busâqoc ee i tarawec.
Eme Mose e Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua ere faio meticne râehuc jambuŋkewecte Josuazi maŋɋârâŋhec ewec. Irec Israe ŋic jaŋe dâŋticne mana rereŋ ehuc, Wofuŋzi Mose dâŋ mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko wiac efârembiŋ.
Eme dameŋ irecnec fuŋkerâ juwefuhapie Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko porofete moc Mose iŋucne moc mi fuarâ juwec. Wofuŋ â Mose jahe hohone mamanac epic.
Wofuŋzi Mose hâcne soreme Aigita mâreŋko rarâ Farao â kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne erâ hae mâreŋ‐ticnao fuŋne qaqa mâsi â wiac ʒâŋe furu fuŋne fuŋne bawec.
Erâ ekizia Israe ŋic jaŋere maio tâpiri â wiac bipic tataranehec bataniŋkeme honembiŋ.
Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mose e hâmohame Wofuŋzi Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua, Mose babafic‐ticne hâcne, e ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Mose e hâmowec. Irec go â ŋic ŋokac sasawa ŋoŋe faharerâ Jordaŋ ocniŋucnao raʒiniŋ, mâreŋ i hâcne Israe ŋic ŋoŋe ŋarekopac.
Mâreŋ sasawa kike‐ŋeŋiczi âteniŋmu i Mose mupaŋkecnepo irec sâcko ŋarekopac hâcne.
Mâreŋ burocnaonec fuŋkerâ wareku Lebanoŋ mâreŋ ʒira fisirâ raku Eufrata opâ sâkoo mickekac, erâ wâc ʒoaŋ huhunao Hâwec Sâkoopec mâreŋ forakac, Hitiŋic jaŋere mâreŋ sasawa hâcne, i ŋoŋere efâreocmu.
Juju dameŋ fogareocmu sâc ŋic moczi sâcne mi bawahacguocmu. Mosehec jupo irec sâc jaha gohec jupemu. No behecgupe bekâ mâsiŋ moc mi ecmu.
Go sanaŋkerâ hâbige roc. No mimi ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic mupaŋke‐jarehuc mâreŋ biŋe qajarepo i jarepe ro rauc eniŋte bâtâc bajarezemec.
Mocjaha, go sanaŋkerâ hâbihec ezemec. Â Mose kiŋaŋŋic‐nanezi mumupaŋ dâŋ râehuc mutâcne‐garewec irec sâc aimuŋ juhuc wiac ebac ezore manasuzemec, ehuc fâreopec me qanaopec moc mi qâsoriezemec. Iŋuc ehuc gie i me i batec fârine biaŋne fuaocmu.
Papia qizec ʒirec maŋnao sâcmutâc dâŋ fokac i gore micko hati fuahuc fozejec, â ʒoaŋko me ŋafeo irec manatâc qâtâc ezemec. Ehuc wiac sasawa qâreŋkekicne fokac irec sâcko jucmurâ manasuzemec. Go iŋuc ehuc jucmuo ine giege fârinehec eocmu.
Go sanaŋkerâ hâbige rocmurâ mi gazapo me? Irec hâwicgume maŋge mi gâckezejec. Wofuŋge Anutu no jucmu sâc gohec jupemu.”
Eme Josuazi ŋic ŋokac micnefâc‐jeŋic kecʒiŋuc mutâcne‐jarewec:
“Ŋoŋe teuŋ sâc fotâcnehuc ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazaniŋ: ‘Ŋoŋe nânâ‐ŋeŋic rike bâmoc efâreniŋ. Eme ʒoaŋ jahec â moc ehame Jordaŋ opâ ʒi fotâcnerâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ ŋarekac i ro rauc eniŋte raʒinʒepieŋ.’”
Eme Rubeŋ â Gade jahere ɋâricfâc â Manasere ŋicguru dâkâne jaŋe mâmâc Josuazi ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mose e dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc ŋaza qâmoc ewec irec manasunʒepieŋ: ‘Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e ŋoŋe jumananiŋte manahuc mâreŋ ʒi hâcne ŋarekac.’
Mosezi Jordaŋ ʒiŋucnao mâreŋ ŋarewec forakac ira ŋokac naru motec â bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe junʒepieŋ. Juhapie ŋic sanaŋne tâpirichec ŋoŋe ʒikare ʒawierâ opâ fotâcnerâ ŋifecnao qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic bânie‐jarehuc bafic‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc juhapie, Wofuŋzi ŋoŋe juju mana mâreŋ ŋarewec iŋuc jaha ɋomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe jareocmu. Eme jaŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ jareme ro rauc ehapie ŋoŋe wâc risierâ mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko junʒepieŋ, Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mosezi Jordaŋ ʒiŋucpec ʒoaŋ wewefunao mâreŋ ŋarewec ira hâcne.”
Eme jaŋe Josua dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ: “Wiac sasawa mutâcne‐nârekomec i efârenaŋmu. Ehuc ira me ira sorec‐nâpotec ranaŋmu wâc.
Nâŋe Mose micticne reŋkehuc wiac sasawa mume ebac embeŋ irec sâc jaha gore mic reŋkenaŋmu. Mocjaha, Wofuŋ Anutugezi Mosehec juwec irec sâc jaha gohec juzejec.
Moc e wiac i me i ebac eocte mucnetec dâŋge qatarahuc sâcmutâcge râsi ecneocmu e hâmocko râezo. Go ine sasanaŋhec â hâbihec ezemec.”
Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua e kamierâ ruc bapa ŋic jahec‐ticne mâreŋ hone tâcnenicte Sitim haeonec jasa sorec ehuc muwec: “Rarâ mâreŋ hone tâcnenic. Erâ Jeriko hae i hone‐hâmozepirec.” Eme jahe rapic. Raku Jeriko haeo fisirâ sasec ŋokac moc juwec, ʒâŋene Rahaba, ere ficko ferâ fopic.
Ehame Jeriko haere ŋicwofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Manakic, Israe ŋic gâcne mâreŋ hone tâcneniŋte ŋafeo ʒira warembiŋ.”
Eme Jeriko haere ŋicwofuŋzi Rahabarao dâŋ ʒiŋuc râeme rawec: “Ŋic jajahec warerâ ficgao fepirec ŋekopirec jahec râec‐jofatec warenic. Jahe mâreŋ‐nâŋec hone tâcne‐fârenicte warepirec.”
Ŋokac e ine ŋic jahec soŋjofawec. Ehuc muwec: “Ŋic jajahec norao warepirec i jâmbomac. Mâc jahe wenirec warepirec i mi manakopac.
Dapâc eme motâc hezo ehapie ŋic jahe hurâ rapirec. Erâ weniŋucpec rapirec ine mi manakopac. Bâruŋ jaha jâpec‐jofa raniŋ. Ŋoŋe sâcne bâfuac‐jofaniŋmu.”
E jahac ine jowac‐jafarâ fe ficbupuo bunda râe guruc ewec ira biac soŋjofawec.
Ehame ŋic jaŋe roc‐jofaniŋte basac‐jofa raku Jordaŋ opâ rendacnao fisimbiŋ. Basac‐jofaniŋte hurâ rahapie haesac motâc hembiŋ.
Eme ŋic jahe ine waha fozo ehapire ŋokac e jaherao ficbupuo fewec.
Ferâ ŋic jahec jasarâ muwec: “Wofuŋzi mâreŋ ʒi ŋoŋe ŋarewec i no mana‐jâmbâŋkekopac. Eme ŋoŋere hâhâwiczi boc fusucmac‐nâpowec. Ehuc mâreŋ ʒirec ŋecjucfâc‐ticne sasawa nâŋe ŋoŋere maio weaŋkeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋoŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec wefuhapie Wofuŋzi ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko Hâwec Bâbâroŋ mume kereŋkewec â Amori ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ jajahec, Sihoŋ â Ogo erâ gurufâc‐jekic Jordaŋ ocniŋucnao jopa miziembiŋ, i mana‐fârembeŋ.
Nâŋe i manahuc maŋnâŋec betaŋkeme hâbi‐nâŋec ŋeŋgoroŋkewec. Ŋoŋere Wofuŋ Anutu eki sawa faic sambâŋko â mâreŋko ʒira Anutu mocjaha juekac.
Eme ŋohe ʒi Wofuŋte maio mupaŋke‐narenic. Noni bubiaŋ qaŋactekopac iŋuc jaha ŋoŋe mamac‐nanere fic ʒi bubiaŋ qacneniŋmu irec ma jâmbâŋ moc mufua‐narenic.
Ehuc neŋgoc mamac, hahac ɋa, seŋ qo â wiacfâc‐nane sasawa akic‐nâpohuc juju‐nâŋec hâmockonec bataranʒepieŋ.”
Eme ŋic jahe ŋokac âzâcnerâ mupic: “Sâcne, ŋopaniŋmuo nâhere juju wâc omaezejec. Go nâhe mi mufuac‐nâfocmuo Wofuŋzi mâreŋ nâreocmu dameŋ ira sioc tâmiric bubiaŋ qaŋarenaŋmu.”
Eme ŋokac e ficticne haesachec iticnehuc bakicnere ira ŋeŋe juju ewec. Irec ŋic jahe qâqâtâc kataŋko repao râec‐jofame sac râpeo hupic.
Ehuc jasarâ muwec: “Basac‐ŋofaŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe bâfuac‐ŋofanʒipiŋte tiki mâreŋko razepirec. Eme ira ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc soŋkerâ juhapire basac‐ŋofaŋgopieŋ jaŋe risie‐fârepie ine ŋohe hata‐ŋekic ʒuhuckerâ razepirec.”
Eme ŋic jahe ŋokac âzâcnerâ mupic: “Go enâctetec dâŋ ʒi mupaŋkekoperec ine wiac ʒiŋucte bahac fâsâc enacmu:
Nâŋe mâreŋ ʒira ware fisinaŋmu dameŋ ira go repa bâbâroŋ ʒi râec‐nâfotec wahakoperec i qâqâtâc kataŋ ʒira ʒâfickezemec. Ehuc neŋgoc mamac jahecge, hahac ɋafâcge â mamacgere wiacfâc jaŋe sasawa ficgao qâzuc‐jopa‐fârezemec.
Eme moc e gore fickonec waharâ hae ʒoŋao juocmuo ine socticnere kiŋ i e jahacne faio fehame nâhe bahac fâsâc enacmu. Â ficko juhapie moczi moc jopaocmuo irec socte kiŋ i nâhere faio fezejec.
Go nâhere gie ʒi mufuacmuo ine dâŋ ʒi mupaŋkekoperec i wahame bahac fâsâc enacmu.”
Eme ŋokaczi jasarâ muwec: “Dâŋ mukopirec irec sâcko fuazejec.” Iŋuc murâ sorec‐jofame rapic. Ehame qâqâtâc kataŋko repa bâbâroŋ i ʒâfickeme domawec.
Eme jahe rarâ basac‐jofambiŋ ŋic i jaŋe risieniŋte tiki mâreŋko ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc woŋec jupic. Ehame basac‐jofambiŋ jaŋe hatao babasa gie sâko baku mâc risiembiŋ.
Ŋic jahe ine tiki mâreŋkonec mocwâc waharâ Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ Nuŋte ŋokâ Josuarao fisirâ wiac fua‐jactewec irec binaŋ bacne‐fârepic.
Ehuc Josua âzâcnerâ mupic: “Wofuŋ e jâmbomac mâreŋ sasawa i nâŋâcne meo râe‐fârewec. Erâ i sawa mâcne, mâreŋ irec ŋecjucfâc jaŋe ʒeŋgoma nâŋâcne hâwic‐jopame maŋjeŋic gâcke‐fârekac.”
Josua â Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋe uupicte Sitim haeonec faharerâ rambiŋ. Raku Jordaŋko fisirâ fotâcneniŋte teuŋ âterâ fombiŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc tarame micnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe teuŋ sâc fotâcnehuc
ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Lewi guruonec taha bapa jaŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte ʒâʒâfic katapa reŋkeniŋmu i honerâ teuŋ‐ŋeŋickonec faharerâ bâjâpec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ehuc hata weniŋuc jaha raniŋmu i mana taranʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe mârâc hata ʒira rac warec moc mi embiŋ irec. Erâ ŋoŋe â ʒâʒâfic katapa ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko sawane fozejec. Sawane i maile nâfocne irec sâc ezejec. Ŋoŋe irec maŋfuŋko mi ranʒepieŋ.”
Eme Josuazi ŋic ŋokac jazarâ muwec: “Tomâcko Wofuŋzi ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko mâsi qeŋ bipinehec baocmu irec ŋoŋe sowa juhuc maŋ sahac‐ŋeŋic emasaŋke‐fâreniŋ.”
Erâ Josuazi taha bapa jazarâ muwec: “Ʒâʒâfic katapa reŋkerâ ŋic ŋokac bânie‐jareniŋ.” Mume jaŋe katapa reŋkerâ ŋic ŋokac bânie‐jarembiŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋzi Josua âzâcnerâ muwec: “No ʒoaŋ ʒira fuŋkerâ Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋere ʒâŋe faio bafecgupe jaŋe ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ: No Mosehec jupo irec sâc jaha gohec jupemu.
Erâ go ʒâʒâfic katapa reŋkeniŋmu taha bapa i jaŋe ine ʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘Ŋoŋe Jordaŋ opâ mecnao fisirâ ira domanʒepieŋ.’”
Eme Josuazi Israe ŋic ŋokac jazarâ muwec: “Fisi‐fârerâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte dâŋ mananiŋ.”
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Anutu jujune e ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jukac i ʒiŋucko mana taranʒepieŋ: E ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko Kanaaŋ ŋic, Hitiŋic, Hiwiŋic, Periʒi ŋic, Girigasi ŋic, Amori ŋic, â Jebusi ŋic jâmbomac jâpec‐jopaocmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec Wofuŋ ere ʒâʒâfic katapazi bânie‐ŋarehuc Jordaŋ opâ fotâcneocmu.
Irec Israe ŋic guru sâc ŋic moc moc rocjopakupie 12 enʒepieŋ.
Eme mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec Wofuŋ ere katapa reŋkeniŋmu taha bapa i jaŋe kike‐jeŋiczi Jordaŋ opâ âte uapie tâcneocmu. Ehame opâ faicnec wahakac i kanaŋ hekicne tinac domaocmu.”
Eme taha bapa jaŋe ʒâŋâfic katapa reŋkerâ bâniepie ŋic ŋokac jaŋe teuŋ‐jeŋickonec faharerâ bâjâpec‐jopahuc Jordaŋ opâ fotâcneniŋte rambiŋ.
Ehuc katapa reŋkembiŋ taha bapa i jaŋe Jordaŋko fisirâ kike‐jeŋiczi opâ qaŋeŋnao hurâ âtembiŋ. (Qa roro dameŋko Jordaŋ opâzi ine boc siwiŋnehuc qaŋeŋne sâckerâ foekac.)
Ehame opâ faicnec wahaekac izi siwiŋnerâ ferâ raku Zaretaŋ heririŋ Adama hae ŋekac ira mickewec. Â opâ juwicne ine raku mâreŋ burocnere hâwec, Hâwec Hâmocne hâcne, ira huekac i kereŋke‐jâmbâŋkewec. Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Jeriko hae ŋifecnao fotâcnembiŋ.
Fotâcnehapie Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapa reŋkembiŋ taha bapa i jaŋe Jordaŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋko kereŋnao domahapie Israe ŋic guru sâko jaŋe kereŋnea fotâcneku fotâcne‐fârembiŋ.
Eme ŋic guru sâko jaŋe Jordaŋ fotâcne‐fârepie Wofuŋzi Josua ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Ŋic guru sâc jaŋeraonec ŋic moc moc rocjopatec 12 enʒepieŋ.
Erâ jazazemec: ‘Jordaŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋ, taha bapa jaŋe domaŋgopieŋkonec jâmbâŋ qânâ 12 rorâ hâpo ranʒepieŋ. Ehuc hae ŋafeme foniŋmu ira hepie ŋezejec.’”
Eme Josuazi Israe ŋic jaŋeraonec guru sâc ŋic moc moc bâwosâec‐jopame 12 embiŋ jaŋe hefârec‐jopawec.
Ehuc jazarâ muwec: “Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte katapare maŋfuŋko fotâcnehuc Jordaŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋ‐ticnaonec ru sâc qânâ rorâ hâpopie Israe ŋic guru ʒare‐nâŋecte sâc ezejec.
Eme izi ŋoŋerao ma moc ezejec. Ehame juku ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe wio‐ŋarehuc ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Qânâ ʒirec fuŋne weniŋuc fokac?”
Wio‐ŋarepie ʒiŋuc jazanʒepieŋ: ‘Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapare maio Jordaŋ opâzi tâcnewec. Tâcneme fotâcnembiŋ. Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe raŋɋa raŋɋa irec manasuhuc juniŋte qânâ ʒizi majeŋic erâ ŋehuc juzejec.’”
Josua e Wofuŋzi âzâcnewec irec sâcko ŋic ejareme jaŋe Jordaŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋkonec qânâ 12 Israe ŋic guru ʒare‐jeŋicte sâc rombiŋ. Erâ hâpo raku fombiŋkoa hepie ŋewec.
Eme Josuazi qânâ 12 rorâ Jordâŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋko taha bapa jaŋe ʒâʒâfic katapa reŋkerâ ra domambiŋko hewec. Eme qânâ i dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ŋekac jaha.
Taha bapa jaŋe katapa reŋkerâ Jordaŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋ‐ticnao domambiŋ. Ehame Josua e ŋic dâŋ jazaocte Wofuŋzi âzâcnewec irec sâc jazame wiac sasawa efârembiŋ. I Mosezi Josua mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko embiŋ hâcne. Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒocnehec fotâcnembiŋ.
Fotâcne‐fârepie Wofuŋte katapa reŋkembiŋ taha bapa i jaŋe tiŋko ferâ ŋic ŋokac bânie‐jarembiŋ.
Mosezi jazawec irec sâcko Rubeŋ â Gade jahere ɋâricfâc â Manasere ŋicguru dâkâne jaŋe ʒika bâmockerâ Israe ŋic ŋokac bânie‐jarembiŋ.
Eme ʒika qaniŋte ʒawiembiŋ ʒare‐jeŋic 40 tauseŋ i jaŋe ʒika sâko qaniŋte Wofuŋte maio Jeriko wâneŋko rambiŋ.
Ehame ʒoaŋ ira Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋere ʒâŋe faio Wofuŋzi Josua ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne bafaharewec. Eme jaŋe Mosezi jume hone warec ecne jumbieŋ iŋuc jaha Josua honerâ bipic tatara ejareha jujumbieŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Josua kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go taha bapa sâcmutâcte katapa reŋkeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ejaretec Jordaŋkonec wefuniŋ.”
Irec Josuazi taha bapa ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe Jordaŋkonec wefuniŋ.”
Mume taha bapa Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapa reŋkembiŋ jaŋe Jordaŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋkonec ferâ tiŋko âtehapie Jordaŋ opâzi fofo‐ticnao mocwâc risierâ qaŋeŋne sâcke‐fârerâ fofone sâc fowec.
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe fufuŋke mosa‐jeŋic irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 10 ira Jordaŋ fotâcnerâ tiŋko fefârembiŋ. Ehuc Jeriko hae mâreŋ bâqiŋkehuc ʒoaŋ wewefuopec Giligali haeo teuŋ âterâ fombiŋ.
Eme qânâ 12 Jordaŋkonec rombiŋ i Josuazi Giligali haeo ma heme ŋewec.
Ehuc Israe ŋic ŋokac jazarâ muwec: “Juku ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe, ‘Qânâ ʒi fuŋne wemocte ŋekac?’ Mamacfâc‐jeŋic iŋuc wio‐jarepie
ʒiŋuc muhuc jazanʒepieŋ: ‘Israe ŋic jaŋe Jordaŋ opâzi kereŋkeme fotâcnembiŋ irec ma.’
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mume Hâwec Bâbâroŋ kereŋkeme fotâcnembeŋ iŋuc jaha Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mume Jordaŋ opâzi kereŋkeme ŋoŋe fotâcnembiŋ.
Eme mâreŋ sâc ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe, Wofuŋte me i tâpirihec, iŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ. Ehame ŋoŋe raŋɋa raŋɋa Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic araŋ bacnehuc junʒepieŋ.”
Amori ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋfâc Jordaŋ ŋifecnao ʒoaŋ huhunaopec jumbiŋ â Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋfâc hâwec heririŋko jumbiŋ jaŋe sasawa Wofuŋzi Jordaŋ opâ mume kereŋkeme Israe ŋic jaŋe furu jaha fotâcnembiŋ i manarâ maŋjeŋic goroŋkewec. Ehuc Israe ŋic jaŋere hâwic‐jopame hâbi gogoroŋ embiŋ.
Dameŋ ira Wofuŋzi Josua âzâcnerâ muwec: “Sesera qânâzi sâqe barâ Israe ŋic sahac tofa‐jeŋicko mocwâc ma bajarezemec.”
Irec Josua e qânâzi sâqe barâ Gibea‐Aralo, ma bapa tiki hâcne, ira Israe ŋic sahac‐jeŋicko ma bawec.
Josuazi fuŋne ʒiŋucte ma bacjopawec: Ʒikare ŋic sasawa Aigita mâreŋkonec wefumbiŋ jaŋe hahata juhuc mâreŋ sawao hâmo‐fârembiŋ.
Ŋic sasawa Aigita mâreŋkonec wefumbiŋ jaŋe ma bacjopakicne, â hahata juhuc mâreŋ sawao fuambiŋ jaŋe ine mi ejarembiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ sawao jara 40 juhapie Aigita mâreŋkonec ʒikare ŋic wefumbiŋ jaŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ mi mana ʒakiembiŋte omae‐fârembiŋ. Jaŋe Wofuŋzi mâreŋ guec sâkohec nâreocte mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec mupaŋke‐jarewec ira mi raʒiniŋte musanaŋkewec hâcne.
Irec jaŋere ɋâricfâc fuambiŋ jaŋe Josuazi ma bacjopawec. Jaŋe hahata juhuc ma mi bacjopambiŋte iŋuc hâcne ejarewec.
Ŋic sasawa sahac‐jeŋicko ma bapie tara‐fâreme wicjeŋic somieocte teuŋkoa woŋec jumbiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Josua ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No ʒoaŋ ʒira hâcne Aigita mâreŋkonec mimizi fai‐ŋeŋicko fewec foekac i bârâriekopac.” Eme mâreŋ ŋondeŋ irec ʒâŋe Giligali mumbiŋ i dameŋ ʒiŋuczia mueŋgopieŋ jaha.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Giligali haeo, Jeriko wâneŋ‐ticnao hâcne, teuŋ âterâ ŋehapie mosa irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 14 ewec, ehame ŋafe ira aakic hombaŋ ŋembiŋ.
Hombaŋ ŋepie hae fureme mâreŋ ira wiac fuarâ fowec irecnec rorâ poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric â jacgoŋ wiac ʒoc uucko râepie qafafaŋkeme nâmbiŋ.
Mâreŋ irec wiac i fuŋkerâ nahapie manazi wâc arictac ewec. Ehame Israe ŋic jaŋe mana mocwâc mi nâhuc jara ira Kanaaŋ mâreŋte nânâ wiac fowec i nâmbiŋ hâcne.
Eme Josua e Jeriko hae heririŋko juhuc ʒâŋe firâ ŋic moc becsahac‐ticnaonec sâqe unuckerâ badomaha honewec. Honerâ erao rarâ wiocnerâ muwec: “Go nâŋere âgo me râsifâc‐nâŋec jaŋere âgo?”
Eme eki muwec: “Aricne, no Wofuŋte momori guru jaŋere micne juekopaczi warekopac.” Eme Josua e waha ʒâŋe mai‐ticne mâreŋko hetutuckerâ araŋ bacnehuc muwec: “Bomboŋ‐nane, go kiŋaŋŋicge no dâŋ weniŋuc nazazo mukomec?”
Mume Wofuŋte momori guru jaŋere micnezi Josua ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go kikehuhuge hetarac. Mâreŋ domakomec i tiri.” Mume Josua e iŋuc ewec.
Israe ŋic jaŋere erâ Jeriko haere motâc herâ basanaŋkembiŋ. Eha mozi moc raʒic wefuc ezac.
Wofuŋzi ine Josua âzâcnerâ muwec: “Manakic, no Jeriko hae â ŋicwofuŋ‐ticne, erâ momori ŋic tâpirihec jaŋe gore meo râec‐jopa‐fârepo.
Go â momori sasawa ŋoŋe hae sâko i asasai âtehuc arec mocjaha orâŋkenʒepieŋ. Iŋuczi iŋuc ehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 tarazejec.
Eha taha bapa 7 jaŋe lama ŋicne jaŋere ʒuŋezi qeŋ 7 bakicne i barâ ʒâʒâfic katapa bâniecnenʒepieŋ. Â ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 ira ine taha bapa jaŋe qeŋ qahapie ŋoŋe hae sâko i asasai âtehuc orâŋkekuhapie arec 7 ezejec.
Eme jaŋe lama ŋicne jaŋere ʒuŋezi qeŋ bakicne i fâre ʒorahuc qapie manahuc ʒeŋgoma aŋara henʒepieŋ. Ehame hae sâkore sac i rândiŋkerâ qanʒaŋneocmu. Iŋuc fuame quruŋ herâ ʒeŋgoma fenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua e taha bapa hefârec‐joparâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ʒâʒâfic katapa reŋkeniŋ. Erâ taha bapa 7 jaŋe ine lama ŋicne jaŋere ʒuŋezi qeŋ 7 bakicne i rorâ Wofuŋte katapa bâniecnenʒepieŋ.”
Erâ Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Momori ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋte katapa bâniecnehapie asasai âtehuc hae sâko orâŋkenʒepieŋ.”
Eme jaŋe Josuazi mutâcne‐jarewec sâc embiŋ. Ehuc taha bapa 7 jaŋe lama ŋicne jaŋere ʒuŋezi qeŋ 7 bakicne i Wofuŋte maio bajumbiŋ jaŋe bâniehuc qeŋ qambiŋ. Ehame Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapazi bâjâpec‐jopawec.
Eme taha bapa jaŋe qeŋ qahapie momori ŋic jaŋe bânie‐jarembiŋ. Qeŋ qahuc rahapie momori ŋic gâcne jaŋe katapa bâjâpembiŋ.
Ehame Josuazi ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe aŋara moc mi henʒepieŋ me dâŋfânâŋ‐ŋeŋic moc mi fuazejec. Erâ dâŋ qisic qasac moc mi ejâmbâŋkehapie noni aŋara heniŋ mupe dameŋ ira henʒepieŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋte katapa reŋkembiŋ jaŋe ejareme hae sâko i arec mocjaha orâŋkembiŋ. Orâŋkerâ teuŋ‐jeŋicko risierâ fombiŋ.
Eme Josua e uupictea fahareme taha bapa jaŋe iŋuc jaha faharerâ Wofuŋte katapa reŋkembiŋ.
Ehame taha bapa 7 jaŋe lama ŋicne jaŋere ʒuŋezi qeŋ 7 bakicne i barâ qahuc Wofuŋte katapa bâniecnembiŋ. Eme momori ŋic gâcne jaŋe bânie‐jarembiŋ â gâcne jaŋe ine Wofuŋte katapa bâjâpembiŋ.
Eme hae fureme mocwâc asasai âtehuc hae i orâŋkerâ teuŋ‐jeŋicko risiembiŋ. Iŋuczi iŋuc ehuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 tarawec.
Ehame ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 ira hae fure pârâckeha faharerâ embiŋ irec sâc jaha asasai âtehuc hae sâko orâŋkekupie arec 7 ewec. I ʒoaŋ ira sawa orâŋkehapie arecne 7 ewec hâcne.
Eme arec 7‐ticnao taha bapa jaŋe qeŋ qambiŋ i tarame Josuazi ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Aŋara heniŋ, Wofuŋ e hae ʒi nârekac hâcne.
Eme hae irec maŋnao wiac fokac bakac sasawa i Wofuŋte micte furu mukicnere sisipiricte biŋe efârezejec. Mâc, sasec ŋokac Rahaba â ficticnao juŋgopieŋ jaŋe sawa ine junʒepieŋ. E kiŋaŋŋic jahec‐nâŋec soŋjofawec irec.
Â ŋoŋe ine wiac sisipiricte biŋe ekicne i bâec bacnenʒepieŋ, i moc ro bâuac epie ine Israere teuŋ i sisipiricte biŋe eha ŋoŋe ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio fenʒipiŋte.
Eme siliwa â gol sasawa, erâ aeŋ â aeŋ bâbâroŋzi kuʒi bakicne i ine Wofuŋte biŋe bâtiripie ere kânoŋko huzejec.”
Eme qeŋ qahapie gurufâc‐jeŋic jaŋe aŋara hembiŋ. Qeŋfânâŋ mana manahuc izia oŋkaraoŋ kizuhame aŋara sâko hepie haesaczi rândiŋkerâ qanʒaŋnewec. Qanʒaŋneme ŋic jaŋe quruŋ herâ fe râsi jopahuc hae rombiŋ.
Ehuc ŋic ŋokac naru motec, lama bulimakao, â doŋgi, erâ wiacte wiac sasawa i ʒikazi omaec‐jopambiŋ.
Eme ŋic mâreŋ hone tâcnepic jahe Josuazi ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Sasec ŋokac mupaŋkecnepic irec sâcko ficticnao ferâ ŋokac e jahacne â wiacfâc‐ticne jowac‐jopa warenic.”
Eme ruc bapa ŋic jahe ficko ferâ Rahaba e jahacne, neŋgoc mamac jahecne â hahac ɋafâcne, erâ soctofafâc‐ticne sasawa jowac‐jopa waharâ Israe teuŋ râpenao râec‐jopambiŋ.
Ehuc hae mecne â irec maŋnao wiac sasawa fowec i mecne ʒoczi turuŋkepie ʒâseŋkewec. Siliwa â gol erâ aeŋ â aeŋ bâbâroŋzi kuʒi bakicne i sawa ine ropie Wofuŋte kânoŋko huwec.
Eme sasec ŋokac Rahaba e jahacne â wiacfâc‐ticne sasawa jaŋe Josuazi ŋic jajahec Jeriko hae hone tâcnenicte sorec‐jofame rapire soŋjofawecte akic‐jopambiŋ. Eme jaŋe Israe guruo jumbiŋzi juŋgopieŋ.
Dameŋ ira Josuazi ŋic ŋokac ejareme Wofuŋte maio ʒiŋuc mupaŋkembiŋ: “Ŋic moczi faharerâ Jeriko hae ʒi mocwâc heɋârerâ baocmuo ine Wofuŋtaonec okacne ʒiŋuczi ere faio fezejec: Wâtuŋ ŋokacne râeme hume mârâc ŋokâ‐ticnezi hâmozejec. Â batarahuc motâc âkendâŋneme ʒâhec ŋokâ‐ticnezi hâmozejec!”
Eme Wofuŋ e Josuahec juhame ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnezi mâreŋ sasawa sâcke‐fârerâ fowec.
Israe ŋic jaŋe wiac Wofuŋte biŋe qakicne ira bahac bâfuambiŋ. I Juda guruonec Ʒabidi ŋosa‐ticne Akaŋ, Karamire ŋokâ, apa‐ticne Ʒera, e wiac Wofuŋte biŋe qakicne i gâcne ro soŋsoŋ ewec. Ehame Wofuŋ e Israe ŋic jaŋere boc mana gâpârewec.
Bete hae ʒoaŋ wewefunao Betaweŋ heririŋko Ai hae ŋewec ira feniŋte Josuazi Jeriko teuŋ‐jeŋickonec ŋic ʒiŋuc jazahuc sorec‐jopawec: “Ferâ mâreŋ hone tâcneniŋ.” Mume ŋic jaŋe ferâ Ai hae hone tâcnembiŋ.
Ehuc Josuarao risierâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ŋic 2 tauseŋ me 3 tauseŋ jaŋe sawa ferâ Ai hae imackenʒepieŋ, sasawazi mâcne. Go ŋic sasawa maŋgâŋ mi ejaretec fenʒepieŋ. Jaŋe afecne sawa mac juŋgopieŋ.”
Eme ŋic jaŋeraonec 3 tauseŋ heririŋ jaŋe fembiŋ. Fepie Aiŋic jaŋe jopa jâpec ejarepie wisembiŋ.
Ehuc Aiŋic jaŋe haere sacmotâckonec fuŋkerâ jopa jâpec ejare raku Sebarim hae heririŋko fisirâ heâŋko ŋic 36 heririŋ sâqezi âke hâmoc‐jopambiŋ. Iŋuc fuame Israe ŋic jaŋere maŋ ŋeŋgoroŋke‐fârewec.
Ehame Josua â Israe soŋaŋ jaŋe busâqoc manahuc ŋaqi qoruc‐jeŋic bâsuckerâ qizec‐jeŋicko ʒafe ruahuc Wofuŋte katapa maŋfuŋko ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic mâreŋko hetutuckerâ fohapie hae ŋafewec.
Eme Josuazi muwec: “Jei, Wofuŋ Anutu, go wemocte ŋic ŋokac ʒi Amori ŋic jaŋere meo râec‐nâpotec qâmiziec‐nâponiŋte Jordaŋ ocniŋucnaonec jowac‐nâpo wefumeŋ? Jordaŋ ocniŋucnao jupene sâckezac.
O Wofuŋ, Israe ŋic jaŋe râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere erâ wisehapie no wemo mupemu.
Kanaaŋ ŋic â mâreŋ ʒirec ŋicguru sasawa jaŋe biŋe manarâ orâŋ‐nâpohuc ʒâŋe biŋe‐nâŋec bârârâŋneniŋmu. Eme go weniŋuc etec ʒâŋe rara biaŋge i mocwâc fuaocmu?”
Eme Wofuŋzi Josua ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Faharec, go wemocte ʒâŋe maige mâreŋko hetutuckerâ fokomec?
Israe ŋic jaŋe bahac bâfuambiŋ, ehuc jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo i qâsuarâ eeatuc ehuc wiac fiuc roŋgopieŋ â wiac bâtirikicne i jaŋacne wiachec bâturehuc soŋkeŋgopieŋ.
Irec Israe ŋic jaŋe sisirowere biŋe eŋgopieŋte râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere maio moc mi sanaŋkehuc mâc wiseniŋmu. Ŋoŋe wiac bâtirikicne ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko fokac i mi bârâriehuc imackeniŋmuo no ŋoŋehec mocwâc mi jupemu.
Ajoc, ŋic ŋokac jaŋe sowa juhuc ʒawieniŋte ʒiŋuc jazac: ‘Sowa juhuc tomâckore maŋ sahac‐ŋeŋic ba emasaŋ eniŋ. Israere Wofuŋ Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: O Israe ŋic, ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko wiac bâtirikicne fokac i mi bârâriehuc râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere maio sâcne mi sanaŋkeniŋmu!
Irec tomâcko furicte guru‐ŋeŋic sâc hefârec‐ŋopazo hâcne. Eme Wofuŋzi guru moc rowosâeme honehuc garikiŋ sâc hefârec‐jopazo. Eme Wofuŋzi garikiŋ moc rowosâeme honehuc fic sâc hefârec‐jopazo. Ehame Wofuŋzi fic moc rowosâeme honehuc ine ŋic buc buc hefârec‐jopazo.
Eme wiac bâtirikicne moc rowec ŋic e jahacne â wiac sasawa focnekac i ʒocte biŋe efârezejec. E Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic qâsuahuc Israe guruo wiac miminehec bâfuawec irec.’”
Eme Josua e furic uupictea faharerâ Israe guru sâc hefârec‐jopahuc guru moc âke fuaocte giene bame Judare guru âke fuawec.
Ehame Judare guru i garikiŋ sâc hefârec‐jopahuc giene bame Ʒerare biri âke fuawec. Eme Ʒerare biri ŋic buc buc hefârec‐jopahuc giene bame Ʒabidi âke fuawec.
Ehame ere birionec ŋic buc buc jaha hefârec‐jopahuc giene bame Judare guruonec Karamire ŋokâ Akaŋ hâcne âke fuawec, ŋosa‐ticne Ʒabidi, apa‐ticne ine Ʒera.
Eme Josuazi Akaŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Motec‐mae, Israere Wofuŋ Anutu e manacnetec fehame muteŋ bâteŋ ecnehuc wiac emeŋ i mi hesoŋkehuc naza‐fârec.”
Eme Akaŋzi Josua dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Jâmbomac, no wiac ʒiŋuc hâcne ehuc Israere Wofuŋ Anutu e sindaŋ ecnepo:
Wiac forawec Babe mâreŋkonec ŋaqi faine moc hone aŋac‐ticnehec â siliwa ŋemâc‐ticne 200, erâ wâc gol dâkâne moc ŋemâc‐ticne 50 i hone sasec ehuc ropo. Ehuc boze‐naneo nombâŋ rorâ siliwa fâhâŋnao râerâ hemackepo fokac.”
Eme Josuazi ŋic gâcne sorec‐jopame Akaŋte bozeo gasacke rarâ wiac gâcne nombâŋko duckekicne i ro huku siliwa fâhâŋnao fohame bâfuambiŋ.
Eme jaŋe bozeonec rorâ Josua â Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋerao bafisirâ Wofuŋte maio guruckembiŋ.
Eme Josua â Israe ŋic jaŋe Ʒera apa‐ticne Akaŋ, erâ siliwa â ŋaqi faine â gol dâkâne i, erâ wâc otâ ŋokâfâcne â lama bulimakao â doŋgi â qoruc boze‐ticne â wiac sasawa i rorâ Akoro wâneŋko bacjopa rambiŋ.
Ehuc Josuazi muwec: “Go wemocte sindaŋ ehuc sipiric‐nâpomeŋ? Irec miŋecgac Wofuŋzi go gahacnao bârisiehuc sipiricguzejec wâc.” Mume Israe ŋic jaŋe Akaŋ qânâzi hehâmorâ wiacfâcne iŋuc jaha hehâmoc‐jopahuc ʒocko behec‐jopapie ʒâseŋ‐jopawec.
Iŋuc erâ qânâ gurucke fembiŋ i dameŋ ʒi ŋekac jaha. Iŋuc epie Wofuŋ aaric‐ticnere ʒoc i mâteŋkewec. Eme mâreŋ ŋondeŋ irec ʒâŋe Sindaŋ Wâneŋ mumbiŋ â dameŋ ʒiŋuczia mueŋgopieŋ jaha.
Eme Wofuŋzi Josua ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manabâc erâ boc mi hâwicguoc. Go faharerâ momori sasawa rocjopatec Ai haeo feniŋ. Manakic, no Ai haere ŋicwofuŋ, erâ ŋicfâcne â hae mâreŋ‐jeŋic i gore meo râec‐jopa‐fârekopac.
Go Jeriko hae â ŋicwofuŋ‐ticne wiac ejactemeŋ irec sâc jaha Ai hae â ŋicwofuŋ‐ticne jaherao ezemec. Mâc bulimakao â wiac gâcne bâfuaniŋmu i ine ropie ŋaŋacne biŋe ezejec. Irec ferâ hae ocniŋucnao somâ râerâ ruc bahuc junʒepieŋ.”
Eme Josua â momorifâcne jaŋe Ai haeo feniŋte faharembiŋ. Ehuc Josuazi momori ŋic tâpiri wânʒâŋhec 30 tauseŋ rowosâec‐joparâ ŋafeoa sorec‐jopawec.
Ehuc jazarâ muwec: “Manaŋgopieŋ, hae jâururâ taicko mi rahuc ʒawie‐fârerâ hae mendâŋko somâ râerâ ruc bahuc woŋec junʒepieŋ.
Ehame no â ŋic gâcne nâŋe ine hae maickehuc fanaŋmu. Iŋuc ehapene jaŋe mârâc embiŋ iŋuc mocwâc ehuc jâpec‐nâponiŋmuo ine wisenaŋmu.
Eme jâpec‐nâpopie haeonec fârec‐joparâ ranaŋmu. Nâŋe wisepene jaŋe ʒiŋuc hâcne muniŋmu: ‘Jaŋe mârâc embiŋ iŋuc jaha eŋgopieŋ.’
Iŋuc ehapie ŋoŋe quruŋ he ferâ hae ronʒepieŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi hae i meŋeŋicko râeocmu hâcne.
Haeo fefârerâ ine Wofuŋzi mutâcne‐nârewec irec sâcko ʒoczi turuŋkepie ʒazejec. No ŋaza mutâc eŋarekopac hâcne.”
Eme Josuazi sorec‐jopame rambiŋ. Rarâ Ai hae ʒoaŋ huhunao, Bete â Ai hae ŋondeŋ‐jekicko ruc bahuc somâ râerâ fombiŋ. Josua e ine ŋafe ira ŋic gâcne qâtec‐jopame mâmâc fombiŋ.
Eme Josua e furic araraŋte faharerâ ŋic biric‐joparâ e jahacne â Israe ŋic soŋaŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe bânie‐jarepie Ai haeopec rambiŋ.
Ehuc momori sasawa e jahacnehec jumbiŋ jaŋe Ai hae bâqiŋkehuc faicpec teuŋ âterâ fombiŋ, â ŋoŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ine uuruŋ moc fowec.
Josua e ine ŋic 5 tauseŋ heririŋ rocjoparâ ʒoaŋ huhunao Bete â Ai hae ŋoŋondeŋ‐jekicko somâ barâ foniŋte râec‐jopawec.
Momori guru sâko faicpec teuŋ âtekicne ira biric‐jopa‐fârembiŋ. Â jaŋere râpeo guru moc ine ʒoaŋ huhunaopec râec‐jopambiŋ. Josua e jahacne ŋafe ira wâneŋkoa fowec.
Iŋuc epie Ai haere ŋicwofuŋzi honerâ e jahacne â ŋicfâc‐ticne sasawa jaŋe ʒocne fârone ehuc Israe ŋic jaŋehec qaqac eniŋte wâneŋkopec rambiŋ. E hae râpeo somâ râerâ fombiŋ i mi manawec.
Eme Josua â Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋe dockerâ wiseŋgopieŋ hawari ehuc mâreŋ burocnaopec rambiŋ.
Eme ŋic haeo jumbiŋ jaŋe sasawa faharerâ Josua â ŋicfacne jâpec‐jopaniŋte fânoc hejarembiŋ. Eme heâckerâ rahapie hae‐jeŋic mâc fowec.
Ŋic moczi Ai me Bete haeo moc mi juhuŋgaŋkewec. Jaŋe hae behepie mâc foha Israe ŋic jâpec‐jopa rambiŋ hâcne.
Ehame Wofuŋzi Josua âzâcnerâ muwec: “Go damuge badomakomec i haeopec sicnec. No hae i megao râekopac.” Mume Josuazi damu‐ticne haeopec sicnewec.
Meticne fâretiŋnehame izia momori jaŋe somâ barâ fombiŋkonec fahare gasake ferâ haeo raʒimbiŋ. Ehuc picpac jaha hae i ʒoczi turuŋkepie ʒawec.
Eme Ai hae rune jaŋe râpe‐jeŋicko fotikie firâ fic haere hosâc sawao feme honembiŋ. Ehame mâreŋ burocnaopec wisembiŋ jaŋe fotikierâ maic‐jopambiŋ. Iŋuc epie Ai hae rune jaŋe ira me ira wiseniŋte hata basambiŋ.
Eme somâ bapa ŋic jaŋe hae rombiŋ â haere hosâczi sawao fehuc domawec i Josua â Israe ŋic jaŋe honerâ risie Aiŋic imac‐jopambiŋ.
Eme bâbâni hae rombiŋ jaŋe wahambiŋ. Ehuc bune râpene ejarehuc fitac‐jopapie Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko domambiŋ hâcne. Ehame Israe ŋic jaŋe imac‐jopakupie moczi moc mi wise‐jâmbâŋkewec.
Â Ai haere ŋicwofuŋ e ine ɋâricne rorâ Josuarao barambiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Ai hae rune mâreŋ sawao ʒikazi jopaku jopa mizierâ Ai haeo risierâ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne iŋuc jaha ʒikazi ima samaki bacjopambiŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ ira Ai haere ŋic ŋokac sasawa jopambiŋ i ʒare‐jeŋic qâhâckepie 12 tauseŋ ewec.
Josua e ine damu sicnerâ badomawec i mi fâre suruckeha Ai haere ŋecjucfâc ʒeŋgoma jopa miziembiŋ hâcne.
Wofuŋzi Josua mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko Israe ŋic jaŋe bulimakao â hae irec wiac gâcne i sawa jaŋacne biŋe eocte rombiŋ.
Josua e Ai hae ʒoczi turuŋkeme ʒarâ sesucne fuawec i dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ŋekac jaha.
Eme Josua e Ai haere ŋicwofuŋ qarâ jâc mocko ɋetickeme domaha hae owâewec. Ehame ʒoaŋ huzo eha Josuazi ŋic ejareme qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne jâckonec batararâ haesac motâcko sârockepie hume fainao qânâ he fembiŋ i dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ŋekac wâc.
Eme Josuazi Ebali tikio Israe ŋic jaŋere Wofuŋ Anutu ere alata moc bawec.
Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mosezi sâcmutâc dâŋko mu qâreŋ ewec irec sâcko bawec. Dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fowec: “Ŋiczi qânâ qa hefâuc mi ekicne furune rorâ banʒepieŋ,” alata iŋucne barâ Wofuŋte âsu biaŋ â wama bâzi rikembiŋ.
Eme Mosezi sâcmutâc dâŋ qâreŋkewec i Josuazi Israe ŋic ŋokac jaŋere maio qânâ faio hâsine qâreŋkewec.
Eme Israe ŋic sasawa, mafa â hae fâri, jaŋe soŋaŋ â micne â mumutara ŋicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec katapa ŋifec â ŋifec domahuc Lewire guruonec taha bapa Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapa reŋkembiŋ jaŋe maic‐jopambiŋ. Ehuc guru moc jaŋe Geriʒim tikiopec â guru moc jaŋe ine Ebali tikiopec iŋuc domambiŋ. I Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mose mârâcko Israe ŋic ŋokac jambuŋ‐jopaniŋte mutâcne‐jarewec irec sâcko embiŋ.
Eme Josuazi dâŋ sasawa sâcmutâcte papia qizecko qâreŋkekicne irec sâcko jambuŋ â sâwecdâŋ i wose‐fârewec.
Mosezi dâŋ sasawa mutâcnewec i Josuazi Israe ŋic â ŋokac naru motec â mafazi jaŋehec jumbiŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma tumaŋnehapie wose‐jarewec hâcne.
Ŋicwofuŋ sasawa Jordaŋ ŋifecnao tiki mâreŋko â hâwec sâko heririŋ wâneŋ sasawa Lebanoŋ tikiopec rakac ira Hitiŋic, Amori ŋic â Kanaaŋ ŋic, erâ Periʒi ŋic, Hiwiŋic â Jebusi ŋic jurambiŋ jaŋe biŋe i mana‐fârembiŋ.
Ehuc roroc erâ Josua â Israe ŋic jopaniŋte maŋ mocjaha embiŋ.
Erâ Gibeoŋ hae rune jaŋe Josuazi Jeriko â Ai hae jahe wiac ejactewec irec biŋe manambiŋ.
Manarâ eeatuc‐jeŋic birickerâ hata nâsiŋ wiac‐jeŋic bâmockehuc târu â waiŋ ʒopo sucke tâc ekicne i ɋâtâ bâpiaŋ erâ doŋgifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere faio hembiŋ.
Ehuc kikehuhu â ŋaqi qoruc‐jeŋic tâcne ʒaŋ ekicne i hepie huwec. Eme hatare nânâ wiac i kereŋkerâ nusuŋkekicne iŋucne bâmockembiŋ.
Erâ Giligali teuŋko Josua â Israe ŋic jazarâ mumbiŋ: “Nâŋe ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic enaŋte mâreŋ wiwickonec wareŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Hiwiŋic jazarâ mumbiŋ: “Hece, ŋoŋe ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko juŋgopieŋ mecne, irec wemocko ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic moc enaŋmu.”
Eme jaŋe Josua ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Nâŋe gore kiŋaŋŋicfâc.” Ehame Josuazi wio‐jarerâ muwec: “Ŋoŋe wenirec wareŋgopieŋ, ʒâŋe‐ŋeŋic mo?”
Eme jaŋe âzâcnerâ mumbiŋ: “Wofuŋge Anutu ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnere erâ kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋe mâreŋ wiwickonec jâmbâŋ wareŋgopeneŋ. Eki Aigita mâreŋko mâsi bawec irec biŋe manambeŋ wâc.
Erâ wâc Amori ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ jajahec Jordaŋ ocniŋucnao jupic, Hesiboŋ haere ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ â Basaŋ mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ Ogo, Asitaroto haeo juwec, jaherao wiac bâfuawec i manambeŋ jaha.
Eme soŋaŋfâc‐nâŋec â ŋic gâcne sasawa jaŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc nâzâ sorec embiŋ: ‘Hatare wiac bâmockerâ raku bâfuac‐joparâ ʒiŋuc jazanʒepieŋ: Nâŋe ŋoŋere kiŋaŋŋicfâc. Irec qâturerâ ʒâʒâfic‐nâŋec moc enʒepeneŋ.’
Ŋoŋerao warenaŋte hata fuŋkembeŋ dameŋ ira nânâ ʒi ficnâŋeckonec hâroŋne foha rorâ bawarembeŋ. Ehame ʒi ine kereŋkerâ nusuŋkekicne fome honeŋgopieŋ.
Â waiŋ ʒopo‐nâŋec ʒi wâc ɋâricnea foha qapene huwec. Eme ʒi ine tâcne ʒaŋ ekac. Erâ ŋaqi qoruc â kikehuhu‐nâŋec i hata ʒoricne ʒora warehuc juhapene sucke tâc efârewec.”
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe qanaŋ Wofuŋtao fuŋne mananiŋte mu wioc moc mi ehuc ŋic jaŋeraonec hatare nâsiŋ moc rombiŋ.
Ehuc Josuazi jaŋehec wama qaqac erâ juniŋte mana‐jareme ʒâʒâfic embiŋ. Ehame Israe kikefuŋte soŋaŋ jaŋe mujomire‐jarembiŋ wâc.
Ʒâʒâfic erâ jufehapie ʒoaŋ jahec â moc tarame Israe ŋic jaŋe ʒiŋuc manambiŋ: Jaŋe hae mâreŋ ʒirecteaŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe raku hae‐jeŋic ŋerawec ira ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha fisimbiŋ. Hae‐jeŋic ʒiŋuc ŋerawec: Gibeoŋ, Kefira, Beroti â Kiriati‐Jearim.
Erâ Israe ŋic soŋaŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe Israe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ticnere maio mujomire‐jarembiŋte mi jopambiŋ. Ehame kikefuŋ jaŋe soŋaŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere mana gâpârehuc masu mumuniŋ bambiŋ.
Eme soŋaŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe kikefuŋ ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Israe ŋic nâŋâcne Wofuŋ Anutu ere maio mujomirembeŋte moc mi jopanʒepeneŋ.
Juniŋte mujomire‐jarembeŋ irec okacne fai‐nâŋecko fezacte kecʒiŋuc sawa enʒepeneŋ:
Nâŋâc mana‐jarepene junʒepieŋ.” Eme soŋaŋ jaŋe mumbiŋ irec sâcko kikefuŋ jaŋere ʒoc roro â opâ fifia ŋic jumbiŋ.
Eme Josuazi hetumaŋ‐joparâ kecʒiŋuc wio‐jarewec: “Ŋoŋe ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko juipiehuc wemocte ʒiŋuc muhuc eatuc‐nâpombiŋ, ‘Nâŋe mâreŋ wiwickonec jâmbâŋ’?
Irec ŋoŋere faio sâwec fohuc juzejec. Ŋoŋe kiŋaŋ giere hati juhuc dameŋ sâc Anutu‐nanere ficte ʒoc roro â nombâŋkonec opâ fâfâre gie bahuc junʒepieŋ.”
Eme jaŋe dâŋ bâtikiecnehuc mumbiŋ: “Kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋe ʒiŋuc manambeŋ: Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ sasawa ʒi ŋareocte kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Mose âzâcnewec. Ehuc mâreŋ ʒirec ŋic bâsirowec‐nâpo‐fâreocte muwec. Irec ŋoŋere hâwic‐nâpome juju‐nâŋecte mana mezac erâ mâsi keci embeŋ.
Eme ʒi gore meo juŋgopeneŋte wiac manakic sâc enârezemec.”
Eme Josua e Israe ŋic jaŋere meonec batarac‐jopawecte mi jopambiŋ.
Eme Josuazi dameŋ ira hâcne mujareme fuŋkerâ Israe kikefuŋte biŋe â Wofuŋzi alata‐ticne wena fuaocte muwec, irec biŋe wâc ʒoc wiac rohuc nombâŋkonec opâ fifia gie bambiŋzi dameŋ ʒiŋuczia bahuc juŋgopieŋ jaha.
Josuazi Jeriko hae â ŋicwofuŋ‐ticne bâsirowec‐jofawec irec sâc jaha Ai hae â ŋicwofuŋ‐ticne ejactewec. Â Gibeoŋ haeonec jaŋe ine Israe jaŋehec wama qaqac erâ juŋgopieŋ, Jerusalemte ŋicwofuŋ Adonizedec e biŋe iŋuc manarâ mâretec hâwickewec.
Gibeoŋ hae i Ai hae sirickerâ kâcɋene sâko ŋewec, ŋicwofuŋ hae gâcne irec sâc jaha, â hae irec ŋic jaŋe tâpiri wânʒâŋhec jufârembiŋ.
Irec Jerusalemte ŋicwofuŋ Adonizedec e Heboroŋte ŋicwofuŋ Hoham â Jaramutire ŋicwofuŋ Piram â Lakisire ŋicwofuŋ Jafia â Egeloŋte ŋicwofuŋ Debiri jaŋerao dâŋ ʒiŋuc râeme rawec:
“Gibeoŋ haeonec jaŋe Josua â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋehec wama qaqac embiŋte ŋoŋe wefurâ baficnupie imac‐jopanʒepeneŋ.”
Eme Amori ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ 5: Jerusalemte ŋicwofuŋ, Heboroŋte ŋicwofuŋ, Jaramutire ŋicwofuŋ, Lakisire ŋicwofuŋ â Egeloŋte ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe momorifâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec ferâ Gibeoŋ hae ŋifecnao teuŋ âterâ juhuc ʒika gie bambiŋ.
Eme Gibeoŋ ŋic jaŋe Giligali teuŋko Josuarao dâŋ ʒiŋuc râepie rawec: “Kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋe mi mac behec‐nâpohuc bâruŋ jaha wefurâ ŋezic‐nâpohuc bafic‐nâponiŋ. Amori ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ tiki mâreŋko jueŋgopieŋ, jaŋe sasawa roroc erâ râsi fisi‐nâreŋgopieŋ.”
Eme Josua â momori ŋic tâpiri wânʒâŋhec sasawa jaŋe Giligali teuŋkonec ferambiŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋzi Josua âzâcnerâ muwec: “Mi hâwicguoc. No gore meo râec‐jopa‐fârepore moczi moc mi sanaŋkeocmu.”
Eme Josua e Giligali teuŋkonec ŋafe hata juku ututuŋ jaha jaŋerao fisiwec.
Fisi‐jareme Wofuŋzi râsi mutuc bacjopame bipic tatara ejareha Israe ŋic jaŋe Gibeoŋ hae mendâŋko mâretec imac‐jopambiŋ. Ehuc jopa jâpec ejare raku Betehoroŋ heâŋne i fotâcnerâ raku Aʒeka â Makeda haeo fisirâ iŋuc jaha jopambiŋ wâc.
Jaŋe Israe ŋic wise‐jarehuc Betehoroŋ heâŋ‐ticne fotâcnerâ Aʒeka haeopec huhapie Wofuŋzi sambâŋkonec qânâ kâcɋene wicke‐jareme hata ŋondeŋko hâmo sipiric embiŋ. Israe ŋic jaŋe ʒikazi jopambiŋ irec sâc jâuruhuc aisi hândâŋzi hecjopame hâmombiŋ.
Wofuŋzi Amori guru Israe ŋic jaŋere meo râec‐jopawec ʒoaŋ ira Josuazi Israe ŋic ʒâŋe fai‐jeŋicko Wofuŋ numucnehuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ʒoaŋ go Gibeoŋko sanaŋkerâ ŋec â mosa go wâc Ajaloŋ wâneŋ‐ticnao sanaŋkerâ ŋec.”
Mume ʒoaŋ e sanaŋkerâ ŋewec â mosa e iŋuc jaha ewec. Iŋuc fuame Israe ŋic jaŋe râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec ʒika gie batarambiŋ. Binaŋ ʒi Jasa ere papia qizecko qâreŋkekicne fokac. Ʒoaŋzi ʒâʒâŋiŋ jâmbâŋ niniŋkerâ ŋehuc juha ʒoaŋ gie bapa moc tarawec.
Mârâc jaha Wofuŋzi ŋic mocte dâŋ manahuc ʒoaŋ gie bapa iŋucne moc mi bâfuawec â irec faicnao wâc aricne. Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic jaŋere erâ ʒika gie bawecte iŋuc fuawec.
Eme Josua â Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋe Giligali teuŋko risiembiŋ.
Ehame ŋicwofuŋ 5 jaŋe wiserâ ra Makeda hae heririŋ qânâ hawecko soŋkembiŋ.
Eme ŋic gâcnezi Josua ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ŋicwofuŋ 5 jaŋe Makeda qânâ hawecko soŋkerâ juhapie bâfuac‐jopakicne.”
Eme Josuazi muwec: “Qânâ kâcɋene qârândiŋkepie hawec motâcne ŋebâzickeha soŋaŋ râec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Â ŋoŋe ŋaŋacne ira mi juhuc râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jâpec‐jopahuc râpec‐jeŋicko kikeo kikeo ejarenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi meŋeŋicko râec‐jopawecte behec‐jopapie haemaŋ‐jeŋicko mi raʒi‐jâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Josua â Israe ŋic jaŋe ima samaki bacjopakupie moc moc sawazi wiserâ hae sanaŋ‐jeŋic sâc raʒimbiŋ.
Ehame Israe ŋic jaŋe furu jaha Josuarao Makeda teuŋko risiembiŋ. Eme dameŋ ira râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋe pepec i me i moc ejareniŋte hâbi‐jeŋic basambiŋ.
Eme Josuazi muwec: “Hawec motâcko qânâ bârâriehuc ŋicwofuŋ 5 bacjopa wareniŋ.”
Eme jaŋe iŋuc erâ ŋicwofuŋ 5 Josuarao bacjopa fisimbiŋ, ine kecʒiŋuc: Jerusalemte ŋicwofuŋ, Heboroŋte ŋicwofuŋ, Jaramutire ŋicwofuŋ, Lakisire ŋicwofuŋ â Egeloŋte ŋicwofuŋ.
Ŋicwofuŋ i bacjopa fisipie Josuazi Israe ŋic hetumaŋ‐jopa‐fârerâ momori micnefâc‐jeŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ʒira warerâ kike‐ŋeŋiczi ŋicwofuŋ ʒi jaŋere upeo âteniŋ.” Mume jaŋe bembeŋko rarâ kike‐jeŋiczi upe‐jeŋicko âtembiŋ.
Eme Josuazi jazawec: “Manabâc erâ mi hâwic‐ŋopaoc. Sanaŋkerâ hâbi‐ŋeŋic roniŋ. Wofuŋzi râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋerao mâsi iŋuc bafâreocmu hâcne.”
Eme Josuazi qâhâmoc‐joparâ jâc 5 ira ɋetic‐jopame domahapie hae owâewec.
Eme ʒoaŋ otewerâ huzo ehame Josuazi ejareme qâŋɋâŋ jâckonec batarac‐joparâ qânâ hawec soŋkerâ jumbiŋ ijaha sâroc‐jopapie hupie qânâ kâcɋene bocjaha qârândiŋkepie motâcne ŋebâzickewec i dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ŋekac jaha.
Eme ʒoaŋ ira Josuazi Makeda hae rorâ ŋicwofuŋ â kikefuŋfâcne ʒikazi imac‐jopawec. Erâ wiac jujune moc mi akic‐jopahuc sasawa bâsirowec‐jopawec. Â Makedare ŋicwofuŋ e ine Jeriko haere ŋicwofuŋ ecnewec irec sâc jaha ecnewec.
Eme Josua e Makedanec fahareme Israe ŋic jaŋe bâjâpepie Libina haeo ʒika qaniŋte rambiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi hae i iŋuc jaha Israe ŋic jaŋere meo râeme Josuazi hae mecne ŋicwofuŋ mecne erâ wiac jujune moc mi akic‐jopahuc ʒikazi imac‐jopa‐fârewec. Ehuc ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic e Jeriko haere ŋicwofuŋ ecnewec irec sâc jaha ecnewec.
Eme Josua e Libinanec fahareme Israe ŋic jaŋe bâjâpepie Lakisi haeo rarâ teuŋ âterâ juhuc ʒika qambiŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋzi hae i iŋuc jaha Israe ŋic jaŋere meo râeme Josuazi Libinao ewec irec sâc jaha ehuc hae fureme raʒirâ wiac jujune sasawa ʒikazi imac‐jopawec.
Ehame Geʒera ŋicwofuŋ Horam e Lakisi ŋic bafic‐jopaocte wefuwec. Eme Josuazi e â ŋicfâc‐ticne ʒeŋgoma imac‐jopawec.
Eme Josua â Israe ŋic jaŋe Lakisinec Egeloŋ haeo rarâ teuŋ âterâ juhuc ʒika qambiŋ.
Ehuc ʒoaŋ ijaha hae ro rauc erâ Lakisio embiŋ irec sâcko hae ima bahuc wiac jujune sasawa jopa miziembiŋ.
Ehuc Josua â Israe ŋic jaŋe Egeloŋnec Heboroŋko fembiŋ.
Ehuc hae i rorâ ʒika qahuc hae â ŋicwofuŋ â hae piticfâc‐ticne erâ irec maŋnao wiac jujune moc mi akic‐jopahuc ʒikazi imac‐jopambiŋ. I Egeloŋko embiŋ irec sâc jaha ehuc wiac jujune ʒikazi bâsirowec‐jopambiŋ.
Eme Josua e Israe ŋic jaŋehec mocwâc Debiri haeo risierâ ʒika qambiŋ.
Ehuc hae â ŋicwofuŋ‐ticne erâ hae piticfâcne rocjopa‐fârerâ wiac jujune moc mi akic‐jopahuc bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârembiŋ. I Heboroŋ â Libina ira ejarembiŋ irec sâcko ejarembiŋ hâcne.
Josua e iŋuc ehuc mâreŋ sasawa, tiki mâreŋ, Negebe mâreŋ, wâneŋ â heâŋ‐ticne â ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic imac‐jopawec. Ehuc Israere Wofuŋ Anutuzi mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko wiac jujune bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârewec.
Erâ Kadesi‐Baranea haeonec raku Gaza hae, erâ raku Goseŋ mâreŋ fotâcnerâ Gibeoŋ haeo fisikac i sasawa imac‐jopa‐fârewec.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋere Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒika qawecte Josua eki ŋicwofuŋ â mâreŋ‐jeŋic i dameŋ ijaha ro rauc ewec.
Eme Josua â Israe ŋic jaŋe sasawa Giligali teuŋ‐jeŋicko mocwâc risiembiŋ.
Hazoro haere ŋicwofuŋ Jabiŋ e biŋe i manarâ ŋicwofuŋ kecʒiŋuc jaŋerao dâŋ râeme rawec: Madoŋ haere ŋicwofuŋ Jobabe â Simoroŋ haere ŋicwofuŋ â Akisafa haere ŋicwofuŋ, â tiki mâreŋ faicpec â sopâc mâreŋko Kinerote riqic juwicpec â wâneŋko â ʒoaŋ huhunaopec Nafado mâreŋko,
<range>
erâ Kanaaŋ ŋic ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec â huhunaopec tiki mâreŋko jumbiŋ: Amori ŋic, Hitiŋic, Periʒi ŋic â Jebusi ŋic, erâ Hiwiŋic Mizipa mâreŋko Herimoŋ tiki fuŋnao jumbiŋ, ŋicwofuŋ â ŋicguru i sasawa jaŋerao dâŋ râeme rawec hâcne.
Eme jaŋe momori guru dindiŋfâc‐jeŋic hâwecko moŋgeŋ fokac irec sâc, erâ becâsic â keretac wiac‐jeŋic bocjaha amec‐joparâ fisimbiŋ.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ sasawa i jaŋe roroc efârerâ raku Meram opâo tumaŋne‐fârerâ Israe ŋic jaŋehec qaqac eniŋte teuŋ âterâ fombiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Josua ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go jaŋere mi hâwicguoc. Tomâcko dameŋ ʒiŋucne hâcne noni joparâ Israe ŋic ŋoŋere meo râec‐jopa‐fârepemu. Go ine becâsicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere rua hetâcnerâ keretac wiac‐jeŋic ʒoczi turuŋketec ʒazejec.”
Eme Josua e momorifâc‐ticne jaŋehec ututuŋ jaha Merom opâo fisi‐jarewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic jaŋere meo râec‐jopame jopa jâpec ejare raku Sidoŋ‐Raba â Misirefo‐Maim haeo, erâ ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec ine Mizipe wâneŋko fisimbiŋ. Erâ moc mi akic‐jopa huŋgaŋkehuc ima samaki bacjopa‐fârembiŋ.
Eme Josua e Wofuŋzi âzâcnewec irec sâcko becâsicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere rua hetâcne‐fârewec â keretac wiac‐jeŋic ine ʒoczi turuŋkeme ʒafârewec.
Eme Josua e dameŋ ira mocwâc risierâ Hazoro hae rorâ ŋicwofuŋ‐ticne ʒikazi imackewec. Hazoro hae i mâmâc jaha ŋicwofuŋ sasawa jaŋere hae qizec ŋewec.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe wiac jujune moc mi akic‐jopa huŋgaŋkehuc bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârembiŋ, â Hazoro hae ine Josuazi turuŋkeme ʒawec.
Eme hae sasawa â ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ine Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mosezi mutâcnewec irec sâcko Josuazi rocjoparâ ʒikazi imac‐jopahuc bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârewec.
Â hae gâcne tikio ŋerawec i ine Israe ŋic jaŋe ʒoczi moc mi turuŋkepie ʒawec, Hazoro hae sawa Josuazi turuŋkeme ʒawec.
Eme hae irec bulimakao â wiac sasawa Israe ŋic jaŋe jaŋacne biŋe rocjopambiŋ. Â ŋic ine moc mi akic‐jopahuc ʒikazi imac‐jopa‐fârembiŋ.
Wofuŋzi kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Mose âzâcne mutâc ewec irec sâc Mosezi Josua mutâcnecnewec. Eme Josua e irec sâc wiac efârewec. E Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec i moc mi hetiriwec.
Josua e iŋuc ehuc tiki mâreŋ â Negebe mâreŋ erâ Goseŋ mâreŋ â wâneŋ â sopâc mâreŋ, erâ Israere tiki mâreŋ â wâneŋ‐ticne, mâreŋ i sasawa ro rauc efârewec.
I Halaka tikionec Seiri mâreŋkopec feraku Baali‐Gada, Herimoŋ tikifuŋko Lebanoŋ wâneŋko fisikac i ro rauc efârewec hâcne. Ehuc Josuazi ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic rocjoparâ imac‐jopa‐fârewec.
Josua e dameŋ ʒora ŋicwofuŋ i jaŋehec ʒika qahuc juwec.
Hae moczi Israe ŋic jaŋehec wama qaqac i moc mi ewec. Gibeoŋ haere ŋecjucfâc, Hiwiŋic hâcne, jaŋehec sawa embiŋ. Hae mâreŋ gâcne i Israe ŋic jaŋe ʒika qahuc rofârembiŋ.
Wofuŋ e mâsi‐ticne bahuc râsi jaŋere maŋ bârâŋgeŋkeme Israe ŋic jaŋehec ʒika qazore faharembiŋ. I Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko buuruc moc mi qajarehuc omaec‐jopaniŋte iŋuc hâcne fuawec.
Dameŋ ijaha Josua e fisirâ Anaka ŋic, tiki mâreŋkonec, Heboroŋ, Debiri â Anaba haeonec, erâ Juda tiki mâreŋkonec â Israe tiki mâreŋkonec jaŋe mâmâc sasawa bârârâŋ‐jopawec; Josua e hae‐jeŋichec bâsirowec‐jopawec hâcne.
Israe ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko Anaka ŋic moc mi akic‐jopapie jumbiŋ. Hae ʒiŋuc ira afecne maczi jurambiŋ: Gaza, Gati â Asidode.
Wofuŋzi dâŋ sasawa Mose âzâcnewec irec sâcko Josuazi mâreŋ i rofârewec. Ehuc ŋic guru‐jeŋic sâc mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne ro rauc eniŋte Josuazi Israe ŋic jarewec. Eme ʒika fowarewec i tara‐fâreme mâreŋ ira wama fuarâ fowec.
Jordaŋ ŋifec ʒoaŋ wewefunao mâreŋ forakac, Aronoŋ wâneŋkonec feraku Herimoŋ tikio fisikac, erâ mâreŋ burocne ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec rakac i sasawa hâcne Israe ŋic jaŋe ro rauc efârembiŋ. Ehuc ŋicwofuŋ ʒi jahe bawahac‐jofambiŋ:
Amori ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ e Hesiboŋ haeo juhuc Aronoŋ wâneŋ mickekacko Aroe hae ŋekac irecnec fuŋkerâ rafeku wâneŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋ fotâcnerâ raku Jaboko opâ Gileade mâreŋ dâkâne Amoŋŋic jaŋere mao fisikac i soŋaŋke‐fârewec.
Erâ mâreŋ burocne irecnec raku Kinerote riqic ʒoaŋ wewefunao Bete‐Jesimo haeopec rakac â Hâwec Hâmocne irecnec mâreŋ juwicpec raku Pisiga heâŋ fuŋnao mickekac i wâc mâmâc.
Erâ Basaŋte ŋicwofuŋ Ogo e Refaim ŋic ʒanʒaŋne jaŋeraonec mocjaha maczi Asitaroto â Ederei haeo juwec.
Ehuc mâreŋ ʒiŋuc soŋaŋkewec: Herimoŋ tiki â Saleka hae, erâ Basaŋ mâreŋ sasawa raku Gesuri ŋic â Makati ŋic jaŋere mao, erâ Gileade mâreŋ dâkâne irecnec raku Hesiboŋte ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ ere mao fisiwec.
Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mose â Israe ŋic jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ i jahe imac‐jofambiŋ. Eme Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mose eki mâreŋ‐jekic i Israe ŋic jaŋe ro rauc eniŋte Rubeŋ â Gade jahere guru â Manase guru dâkâne bâtâc bajarewec.
Ŋicwofuŋ ʒi â mâreŋ‐jeŋic Jordaŋ ocniŋuc ʒoaŋ huhunaopec Lebanoŋ wâneŋko Baali‐Gada hae ŋewec irecnec waharâ raku Halaka tiki Seiri mâreŋkopec ferâ rakac i Josua â Israe ŋic jaŋe imac‐jopa‐fârembiŋ. Eme mâreŋ‐jeŋic i Josuazi Israe ŋic guru sâc bâtâc bajarewec.
I tiki mâreŋ, wâneŋ, sopâc mâreŋ, tapine, mâreŋ burocne â Negebe mâreŋ, Hitiŋic, Amori ŋic, Kanaaŋ ŋic, Periʒi ŋic, Hiwiŋic â Jebusi ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ hâcne.
Ŋicwofuŋ bawahac‐jopambiŋ jaŋere hae irec ʒâŋe biri ine ʒiŋuc: Jeriko, Ai (i Bete hae heririŋnao ŋewec),
Jerusalem, Heboroŋ,
Jaramuti, Lakisi,
Egeloŋ, Geʒera,
Debiri, Gederi,
Horima, Arada,
Libina, Adulam,
Makeda, Bete,
Tapua, Hefere,
Afeke, Lasaroŋ,
Madoŋ, Hazoro,
Simoroŋ‐Meroŋ, Akisafa,
Tanaki, Megido,
Kedesi, Jokeneam (i Karamele tikio).
Doro (i Nafado mâreŋko), Goim (i Giligali mâreŋko),
erâ wâc Tiriza. Ŋicwofuŋ sasawa ʒare‐jeŋic 31.
Eme Josua e jara bocjaha bazurâ ŋicqizec jâmbâŋ ewec. Irec Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go jara bocjaha bazurâ ŋicqizec jâmbâŋ ekomec. Â mâreŋ ro rauc eene i kâcɋene jaha fokac.
Mâreŋ furu forakac ine ʒiŋuc: Filisa ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ sasawa, erâ Gesuri ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ i mâmâc.
I Aigita mâreŋ ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec Sihora opâonec faicpec rafeku Ekoroŋ hae mâreŋte mao fisikac. I Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ. Filisa ŋic jaŋere fekicnefâc 5 jaŋe hae mâreŋ jurambiŋ ine ʒiŋuc: Gaza, Asidode, Asikaloŋ, Gati â Ekoroŋ. Erâ Awim mâreŋ juwicpec forakac i wâc furu fokac.
Erâ Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ sasawa, erâ wâc Sidoŋ ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ moc ʒâŋene Meare irecnec raku Afeke haeo Amori ŋic jaŋere mao fisikac.
Erâ wâc Gebali ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ â Herimoŋ tikifuŋko Baali‐Gada hae ŋekac irecnec raku ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec Hamati hae mendâŋko fisikac, Lebanoŋ mâreŋ sasawa i furu fofârekac hâcne.
Erâ tiki mâreŋ sasawa Lebanoŋkonec raku Misirefo‐Maim mâreŋko fisikac, erâ wâc Sidoŋŋic jaŋere mâreŋ i mâc fofârekac. Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe ira raʒiniŋte no nahac mâreŋ rune bârâriec‐jopapemu. Go ine mutâcne‐garepo irec sâcko Israe ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ i ro rauc eniŋte kâdoc qajarezemec.
Ʒi ine fuŋkerâ ŋic guru 9 â Manase guru dâkâne jaŋe mâreŋ i ro rauc eniŋte bâtâc bajarec.”
Rubeŋ â Gade guru jaŋe Manase guru dâkâne moc jaŋehec juniŋte Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mosezi Jordaŋ ŋifec ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec mâreŋ jarewec irec ma ʒiŋuc forawec:
Aronoŋ wâneŋko Aroe hae opâmecko ŋekac irecnec fuŋkerâ raku wâneŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋko hae ŋekac i fotâcnerâ fe Medeba wâneŋ sasawa rofârerâ Diboŋ haeo fisiwec.
Erâ Amori ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ, Hesiboŋ haeo juwec, ere hae i mâmâc sasawa rofârerâ Amoŋŋic jaŋere mao fisiwec.
Izi Gileade mâreŋ â Gesuri ŋic â Makati ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ, erâ Herimoŋ tiki â Basaŋ mâreŋ fotâcnerâ raku Saleka haeo fisiwec.
Erâ Basaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Ogo ŋeŋe juju ewec hae jajahec Asitaroto â Ederei, i erâ ere uucmaŋ furu jaha. Refaim ŋic nâfocne jaŋeraonec Ogo mocjaha sawa hetirine juwec. Ŋicwofuŋ ʒi jahe hâcne Mosezi jofa jâpec ejactewec.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Gesuru ŋic â Makati ŋic jopa jâpec mi ejarembiŋ. Irec jaŋe Israe ŋic jaŋere guruo jumbiŋzi juŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Lewire guru sasawa jaŋe ine Mosezi mâreŋ moc mi jarewec. Jaŋe Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcne mutâc ewec irec sâcko Israere Wofuŋ Anutu ere mamanac sawa juhapie taha bâzi ririke gie izi jaŋere juju bâfuaocte mujarewec.
Eme Mose e Rubeŋte guru garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc mâreŋ ʒiŋuc ro rauc eniŋte jarewec:
Aronoŋ wâneŋko Aroe hae opâmecko ŋekac irecnec fuŋkerâ raku wâneŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋko hae ŋekac i fotâcnerâ fe Medeba wâneŋ sasawa i mâmâc rofârewec.
Ehuc ʒuhuckerâ Hesiboŋ hae â hae piticfâcne wâneŋko ŋerambiŋ jaŋe rocjopawec wâc; ine kecʒiŋuc: Diboŋ, Bamo‐Baali, Bete‐Baali‐Meaŋ,
erâ Jahaza, Kedemoti â Mefata.
Erâ Kiriataim â Sibema, erâ wâneŋ tiki‐ticnao Zeresaha.
Erâ Bete‐Peoro â Pisiga tiki irec heâŋ, erâ wâc Bete‐Jesimo.
Wâneŋko hae ŋerawec i, erâ Amori ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ, Hesiboŋ haeo juwec ere uucmaŋ furu jaha i mâreŋte mazi rofârewec hâcne. Eme Mosezi ŋicwofuŋ e â Midiaŋ micne ʒi jaŋe jopa jâpec ejarewec: Ewi, Rekem, Zuru, Huru â Reba. Jaŋe mâreŋ ira Sihoŋte mefâro jumbiŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋe ŋic gâcne jopahuc, Beoro ŋokâ‐ticne, faŋfaŋdâŋ mumu Bileam, e mâmâc qambiŋ.
Eme Jordaŋ rârec rârec mâreŋ gâcne forawec izi Rubeŋ guru jaŋere ma ewec. Mâreŋ ira hae kâcɋene â piticne ŋerawec i Rubeŋte guru jaŋe garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc ro rauc embiŋ.
Eme Mosezi Gadere guru jaŋe iŋuc jaha garikiŋ sâc mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋte jarewec ine ʒiŋuc:
Jazere hae â Gileade mâreŋko hae ŋerawec erâ Amoŋŋic jaŋere mâreŋ dâkâne i mâreŋte mazi fotâcnerâ raku Raba hae ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec Aroe hae ŋekac ira fisiwec.
Erâ Hesiboŋ haeonec raku Rama‐Mizipe â Betonim haeo fisiwec. Izi Mahanaim haeonec Debiri hae mâreŋko fisiwec.
Erâ wâc wâneŋko hae ʒiŋuc rorawec: Bete‐Haram, Bete‐Nimira, Sukati â Zafoŋ. Izi Hesiboŋ haere ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ ere uucmaŋ sasawa, Jordaŋ heririŋko mâreŋ forawec hâcne, i furu jaha rofârerâ feraku Kinerete riqic mecnao fisirâ bâŋorierâ ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec rawec.
I Gadere guru jaŋe hae kâcɋene â piticne garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc ro rauc embiŋ hâcne.
Eme Mosezi Manasere guru dâkâne jaŋe mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋte jarewec wâc. Ehuc garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc bâtâc bajarewec.
Eme jaŋere mazi ine Mahanaim haeonec fuŋkerâ raku Basaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Ogo ere uucmaŋ erâ ŋic moc ʒâŋene Jairi ere hae 60 ira ŋerawec i sasawa rofârewec.
Erâ Gileade mâreŋ dâkâne i fotâcnerâ raku Basaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Ogo ere uucmaŋko hae kâcɋene jajahec ŋepic, Asitaroto â Ederei ira fisiwec. I Manasere ŋokâ Makiri ere guru dâkâne jaŋe garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc bâtâc bajarewec.
Mosezi Jordaŋ ŋifecnao Jeriko hae ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec Moabi wâneŋko juhuc mâreŋ i hâcne ro rauc eniŋte jarewec.
Â Lewire guru jaŋe ine Mosezi mâreŋ moc mi jarewec. Jaŋe Wofuŋ e jahac jazawec irec sâcko Israe ŋic jaŋere Wofuŋ Anutu ere mamanac sawa juniŋte mujarewec.
Taha bapa Eleaʒa â Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua, erâ Israe ŋic guru‐jeŋic sâc irec micne jaŋe Kanaaŋ mâreŋ ʒiŋuc bâtâc bajarepie Israe ŋic jaŋe ro rauc embiŋ:
Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko guru 9 â nâfocne jaŋere mâreŋte qaŋgec qambiŋ.
Mosezi qanaŋ guru jajahec â nâfocne jaŋe Jordaŋ ŋifec mâreŋ jareme ro rauc embiŋ. Â Lewire guru jaŋe ine mâreŋ moc mi jarewec.
Josefere guru ine jajahec: Manase â Eferaim. Lewire guru jaŋe mâreŋ dâkâne mac moc mi jarembiŋ hâcne. Jaŋe hae rauckerâ qaŋeŋnao mâreŋ forawec i lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte sawa rombiŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko ehuc mâreŋ ro rauc embiŋ hâcne.
Eme Judare guru jaŋe Giligali haeo Josuarao rambiŋ. Ehuc Keniʒi ŋic, Jefune ŋokâ‐ticne Kalebe, eki ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋzi Kadesi‐Baranea haeo nâhâcne dâŋ Anuture ŋic Mose âzâcnewec i manakomec.
No jara 40 bazurâ juhape Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mosezi mâreŋ hone tâcnepemurâ Kadesi‐Baraneaonec sorecnuwec. Eme no risierâ hone manac epo sâc binaŋ bacnepo.
Â âgofâc‐nane mâmâc fembeŋ jaŋe ine maŋ wawaha dâŋ mupie ŋic ŋokac jaŋere maŋ ŋeŋgoroŋke‐fârewec. No ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐nanerao qohota sanaŋkepo.
Eme dameŋ ira Mosezi mujomirehuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: ‘Kikegezi mâreŋ âtemeŋ i jâmbâŋ hâcne raŋɋa raŋɋa go â ɋâricfâcge ŋoŋere biŋe fozejec. Go Wofuŋ Anutu‐nanerao qohota sanaŋkemeŋ irec.’
Manakic, Israe ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ sawao juhapie Wofuŋzi dâŋ ʒi Mose âzâcnewec. Eme Wofuŋ e muwec irec sâcko jara 45 irec maŋnao hone maiŋ enareha juwefukopac. Ehame ʒi jara dameŋ‐nane 85 ekac.
No Mosezi sorecnuwec dameŋ ira tâpiri â ʒoɋachec jupo sâc iŋucnea dameŋ ʒiŋuczia jukopac wâc. Ʒikare â rac warec eere tâpiri â ʒoɋac‐nane dameŋ ira fowec iŋucnea ʒiŋuczia fonarekac.
Irec Wofuŋzi tiki mâreŋ kecʒirec muwecte miŋecgac mutara‐narec. Erâ Anaka ŋic jaŋe hae sacsâko‐jeŋichec jumbiŋ irec manameŋ wâc. Wofuŋ e nohec juocmu mecne, ehame Wofuŋzi muwec irec sâcko sâcne jopa jâpec ejarepemu.”
Jefune ŋokâ‐ticne Kalebe e dâŋ iŋuc mufâreme Josuazi jambuŋkewec. Ehuc Heboroŋ hae mâreŋ i ro rauc eocte râcnewec.
Irec erâ Heboroŋ hae i Keniʒi ŋic Jefune ŋokâ‐ticne Kalebe eki ro rauc ewec hâcne. E Israere Wofuŋ Anutu erao qohota sanaŋkewecte iŋuc hâcne ecnekicne.
Mârâc jaha Heboroŋ haere ʒâŋe i Arobare hae mujumbieŋ. Araba e jahacne ine Anaka ŋicguruo ŋic fekicne juwec. Eme ʒika fowarewec i tara‐fâreme mâreŋ ira wama fuarâ fowec.
Eme Judare guru garikiŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sâc mâreŋ rukec qajarepie qaŋeŋne Edom mâreŋko fisiwec. Ehuc Ziŋ mâreŋ burocne juwic jâmbâŋ hurâ rawec.
Eme jaŋere ma i juwic Hâwec Hâmocne tataranao hâwec raʒikicne fokac irecnec fuŋkerâ mâreŋ juwicpec rawec.
Erâ mâreŋ juwicpec jaha raku Akerabim heâŋ fotâcnerâ Ziŋ mâreŋko fisiwec. Ehuc Kadesi‐Baranea juwicpec Hezoroŋ haeopec feraku Adari haeo fisiwec. Ehuc bâŋorierâ Karaka haeo fisiwec.
Erâ raku Azamoŋ haeo fisirâ fotâcnerâ Aigita opâopec raku hâwecko mickewec. Izi hâcne mâreŋ juwicpec irec majeŋic ewec.
Eme ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec irec ma ine Hâwec Hâmocne qacnerâ feraku Jordaŋ micnao fisiwec. Â mâreŋ faicpec irec ma ine Jordaŋ micnao hâwec raʒikicne irecnec ferawec.
Eme ma izi Bete‐Hogela haeo fisirâ fotâcnerâ Bete‐Araba hae faicnao fisiwec. Erâ feraku Rubeŋte ŋokâ Bohaŋ ere qânâ ŋewecko fisiwec.
Erâ Akoro wâneŋkopec feraku Debiri haeo fisirâ faicpec jaha raku bâŋorierâ Giligali haeopec rawec. I Adumin heâŋ‐ticne irec ŋifecnao juwicpec wâneŋ forakac izi ma ewec. Eme ma i ʒuhuckerâ raku Eŋ‐Semesi opâo fisirâ fotâcnerâ raku Enerogele haeo mickewec.
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ feraku Hinom ŋokâ‐ticnere wâneŋ fotâcnerâ Jebusi ŋic jaŋere tikio Jerusalem hae ŋewec irec tapine juwicpec fisiwec. Erâ feraku tiki botâŋnao fisiwec. Tiki izi ine Hinom wâneŋ ʒoaŋ huhunaopec foha faicpec Refaim wâneŋ mickekacko ŋewec.
Eme tiki botâŋnaonec ʒuhuckerâ raku Nefitoa opâ ʒâŋeo fisiwec. Eme irecnec raku Eforoŋ tiki irec hae ŋerawecko fisiwec. Eme irecnec ŋehasickerâ Bala hae, Kiriati‐Jearim hâcne, ira fisiwec.
Eme Bala haeonec ʒoaŋ huhunaopec ŋehasickerâ Seiri tikio fisi fotâcnerâ raku faicpec Jearim tiki, Kesaloŋ hâcne, irec ombâŋnao fisiwec. Ehuc Bete‐Semesi haeo hurâ Timina haeopec rawec.
Erâ mazi faicpec tiki ombâŋnao fotâcnerâ raku bâŋorierâ Ekoroŋ haeo fisiwec. Erâ raku Bala tikio fisi fotâcnerâ Jabinele haeo rawec. Erâ raku hâwecko mickewec.
Eme ʒoaŋ huhunaopec ine Hâwec Sâko qacnerâ ferakac izi majeŋic ewec. Eme i hâcne Juda guru garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc mâreŋ majeŋic ewec.
Wofuŋzi Josua mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko Jefune ŋokâ‐ticne Kalebe Judare guruo mâreŋ dâkâne moc Arabare hae, Heboroŋ hâcne, i râcnewec (Aroba e Anakare mamac).
Eme Kalebezi Anaka ŋokâfâc‐ticne jahec â moc: Sesai, Ahimaŋ â Talamai jaŋe mâreŋ irecnec jopa jâpec ejarewec. Jaŋe Anaka ere ɋâricfâc hâcne.
Eme irecnec ine Debiri haere ŋecjucfâc jopaocte rawec. Debiri haere ʒâŋe ine mârâc Kiriati‐Sefe iŋuc fowec.
Eme Kalebezi muwec: “Moc e Kiriati‐Sefe ŋic imac‐joparâ hae i rome otâ‐nane Akisa ŋonâŋ‐ticne eocte râcnepemu.”
Eme Kalebe ɋaticne Kenaʒi ere ŋokâ Otinie eki hae i rowec. Eme Kalebezi otâ‐ticne Akisa râcnewec.
Eme ŋokac e fisime hesarac mâreŋte mamac‐ticne wiocneocte ŋowenezi ʒoɋac ecnewec. Eme doŋgionec wahame Kalebezi wiocnerâ muwec: “Wemo wiacte egarekac?”
Eme eki âzâcnerâ muwec: “Negebe mâreŋko râecnumeŋ irec wiac moc tahacnuc, ehuc opâ ʒâŋe wâc narec.” Eme Kalebezi opâ ʒâŋe faic â juwic i mâmâc râcnewec.
Judare guru jaŋe garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc hae mâreŋ ro rauc embiŋ ʒi hâcne.
Judare guru jaŋere hae mâreŋ juwicpec Edom mâreŋ mao ŋerawec ine ʒiŋuc: Kabezele, Edere, Jaguru,
Kina, Dimona, Adada,
Kedesi, Hazoro, Itinaŋ,
Ʒifi, Telem, Bealoti,
Hazo‐Hadata, Kerio‐Hezoroŋ, (Hazoro hâcne),
Amam, Sema, Molada,
Haza‐Gada, Hesemoŋ, Bete‐Pelete,
Haza‐Sua, Bere‐Seba, Bizioteja,
Bala, Iim, Ezem,
Elitoladi, Kesili, Horima,
Zikilaga, Madimana, Saŋsana,
Lebaoti, Silihim, Aiŋ â Rimoŋ. Hae kâcɋene 29, erâ kâkâcɋene gâcne mâmâc.
Eme wâneŋko ine Esitaoli, Zora, Asina,
Ʒanoa, Eŋ‐Ganim, Tapua, Enam,
Jaramuti, Adulam, Soko, Aʒeka,
Saraim, Aditaim, Gedera, â Gederotaim. Hae kâcɋene 14, erâ kâkâcɋene gâcne.
