Judare guru jaŋe Jerusalem ŋecjucfâc‐ticne Jebusi ŋic jopa jâpec sâcne mi ejarembiŋ. Irec Jebusi ŋic jaŋe Judaŋic jaŋehec Jerusalemko jumbiŋzi juŋgopieŋ jaha.
Josefere ɋâricfâc jaŋe mâreŋ rukec qajarepie majeŋic ʒiŋuc fuawec: Ma i Jeriko heririŋ Jordaŋ ombâŋnaonec fuŋkerâ raku Jeriko haere opâ ʒoaŋ wewefu‐ticnao fotâcnerâ mâreŋ burocnao rawec. Erâ Jeriko haeonec ferâ tiki mâreŋko Bete hae ŋewec ira fisiwec.
Eme Bete haeonec raku Lusi haeo fisirâ Areki ŋic jaŋere mao Ataroti haeo fisiwec.
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ ʒoaŋ huhunao hurâ raku Jafeleti ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko fisirâ fotâcnerâ Bete‐Horoŋ haeo fisiwec. Erâ irecnec ine Geʒera hae fotâcnerâ raku hâwecko mickewec.
Josefere ɋâricfâc Manase â Eferaim guru jaŋe mâreŋ ro rauc embiŋ ine hâcne.
Eferaim guru garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc jaŋere mâreŋ ine ʒiŋuc: Mâreŋ majeŋic ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec ine Ataroti‐Adari haeonec feraku Bete‐Horoŋ hae faicne ira fisiwec.
Erâ raku hâwecko huwec. Faicpec ine Mikimeta haezi ma ewec. Eme mazi ʒoaŋ wewefunao râreckerâ Tana‐Silo haeopec fotâcnerâ rawec. Ehuc ʒoaŋ wewefunao fotâcnerâ Janoa haeo fisiwec.
Erâ irecnec huraku Ataroti â Nara haeo fisirâ Jeriko haeo iticnewec. Ehuc Jordaŋko mickewec.
Erâ mazi Tapua haeonec ʒoaŋ huhunaopec raku Kana opâo fisi fotâcnerâ raku hâwecko mickewec. Eferaim guru jaŋe garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc mâreŋ i hâcne ro rauc embiŋ.
Ehame Eferaimte guru jaŋere hae pitic â hae sâko gâcne i Manasere guruo ŋeraocte mutara‐jarembin.
Eferaimte guru jaŋe Kanaaŋ ŋic Geʒera haeo jumbiŋ i jopa jâpec mi ejarembiŋ. Irec Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋe Eferaimte guruo jumbiŋzi dameŋ ʒiŋuczia juŋgopieŋ jaha. Erâ ine kiŋaŋ qaqa bacjopambiŋte jaŋere mic sâcko jueŋgopieŋ.
Josefe mârâc fuafua‐ticne Manase ere gurufâc jaŋe mâreŋ rukec qajarembiŋ. Manase mârâc ŋokâ‐ticne Mariki, Gilaedere mamac, e ʒikatac juwecte Gileade â Basaŋ mâreŋ rocjofawec.
Eme Abieʒe, Heleki, Asiriele, Sekem, Hefere â Semida jaŋe Manasere guru nâfocne irec garikiŋfâc jumbiŋzi mâreŋ rombiŋ wâc. Jaŋe hâcne Josefe mârâc ŋokâ‐ticne Manase ere garikiŋfâc.
Hefere ŋokâ‐ticne Zelofeha, Gileade ŋosa‐ticne hâcne, e Makirire apa, â apa qaja qaja‐ticne ine Manase, e ŋokâ moc mi fuacnembiŋ, otâ sawa fuacnembiŋ. Otâfâc‐ticne jaŋere ʒâŋe biri ine ʒiŋuc: Mala, Noa, Hogela, Milika â Tiriza.
Eme jaŋe hâcne taha bapa Eleaʒa â Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua erâ micne jaŋerao fuarâ mumbiŋ: “Wofuŋ e seŋfâc‐nâŋec jaŋehec mâreŋ moc nâreme ro rauc enaŋte Mose mutâcnecnewec.” Eme Josua e Wofuŋzi muwec irec sâcko qomâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec mâmâc mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋte jarewec.
Iŋuc ehame Jordaŋ ŋifecnao mâreŋ jajahec fokopirec: Gileade â Basaŋ, ira ʒuhuckerâ Manasere guru jaŋe mâreŋ dâkâne 10 rauckembiŋ.
I Manasere otâfâc jaŋe ŋokâ‐fâcne jaŋehec mâmâc mâreŋ dâkâne rombiŋte iŋuc fuawec. Eme Gileade mâreŋ i Manasere guru dâkâne gâcne jaŋe jaha jarembiŋ.
Eme Manasere mâreŋzi Ase jaŋere mâreŋkonec raku Sikem hae maickerâ Mikimeta haeo fisiwec. Erâ ma izi juwicpec raku Eŋ‐Tapua hae mâreŋte ŋecjucfâc jaŋerao fisiwec.
Tapua mâreŋ i Manasere. Mâc, Tapua hae i sawa ine Eferaim ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋere ewec. Erâ i Manase guru jaŋere mâreŋ mao ŋewec.
Eme mazi Kana opâo huwec. Opâ irec juwicnao Manasere hae ŋerawec irec ŋondeŋnao Eferaimte hae gâcne ŋerawec wâc. Â Manasere mazi ine opâ irec faicnao fotâcnerâ raku hâwecko fisiwec.
Mâreŋ juwicpec i Eferaimte â faic mâreŋ ine Manasere. Ehame hâweczi majekic ewec. Eme faicpec izi ine Asere mâreŋ mao fisiwec â ʒoaŋ wewefuopec ine Isasare mâreŋ bâfuawec.
Eme Isasa â Ase jaŋere mâreŋko Manasezi Bete‐Seaŋ â hae boze‐ticne gâcne, â Ibeleam â hae boze‐ticne gâcne, erâ Doro haere ŋecjucfâc â hae boze‐ticne gâcne â Eŋdoro haere ŋecjucfâc â hae boze‐ticne gâcne, erâ Tanaki haere ŋecjucfâc â hae boze‐ticne gâcne, â Megido haere ŋecjucfâc â hae boze‐ticne gâcne i sasawa rofârewec. Eme mâreŋ dâkâne moc Nafata i iŋuc jaha ere ewec.
Erâ Manasere ɋâricfâc jaŋe hae i biac ro rauc eniŋte eipiehapie Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ ira ʒuhuckerâ jumbiŋ.
Eme ʒâhec Israe ŋic jaŋe fua sawec ehuc tâpirihec erâ Kanaaŋ ŋic bawahac‐jopahuc jaŋacne mic sâcko juniŋte mujarembiŋ, â jopa jâpec ine mi ejarembiŋ.
Eme Josefere guru jaŋe Josua ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Wemocte mâreŋ dâkâne mocjaha sawa nâremeŋ? Wofuŋzi raŋɋa raŋɋa jambuŋ‐nâpoekacte nâŋe ŋic guru sâko juŋgopeneŋ.”
Mupie Josuazi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ŋic guru sâko juŋgopieŋ â Eferaimte tiki mâreŋzi gâŋgâŋne boc ekac. Irec faic jâckâteo ferâ Periʒi ŋic â Refaim ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko ŋaŋacne mâreŋ qa emasaŋ enʒepieŋ.”
Eme Josefere guru jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Tiki mâreŋ i sâcnâŋec wâc mi eocmu. Erâ wâc Kanaaŋ ŋic wâneŋko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe keretac aeŋzi bakicne bajuŋgopieŋ, i Bete‐Seaŋ â hae boze gâcne, â Jesere wâneŋko juŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne iŋuc eeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme Josuazi Josefere garikiŋ Eferaim â Manase jazarâ muwec: “Ŋoŋe ŋic guru sâko erâ tâpiri sâko foŋarekac. Ŋoŋe mâreŋ dâkâne mocjaha sawa ropie mi taraocmu.
Tiki mâreŋ i ŋoŋere efâreocmu, jâckâte fokac i qa emasaŋ ehuc rauckepie raku qaŋeŋnao tarazejec. Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋe tâpirihec, â keretac‐jeŋic aeŋzi bakicne ŋoŋe ine sifu jopa jâpec ejareniŋmu.”
Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe Silo haeo tumaŋne‐fârembiŋ. Ehuc tutumaŋte qoruc boze ira ŋeocte fârembiŋ. Â mâreŋ ine sakarepie jaŋere biŋe ewec.
Eme Israe ŋic guru 7 jumbiŋ jaŋe mâreŋ biac mi jarembiŋ.
Irec Josuazi Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Apafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere Wofuŋ Anutuzi mâreŋ biŋe qaŋarewec i mo dameŋko ro rauc eniŋmu?
Irec guru sâc irecnec ŋic jahec â moc sasawa bâfuac‐jopapie sorec‐jopape rarâ fec wahac ehuc mâreŋ hone‐fârerâ jaŋac mâreŋte sâc qâreŋkerâ norao bawarenʒepieŋ.
Juda e ine mâreŋ‐ticne juwic rowec ijaha ʒuhuckerâ juzejec â Josefere garikiŋfâc jaŋe iŋuc jaha faicpec mâreŋ‐jeŋickoa ʒuhuckerâ junʒepieŋ. Ehame gâcne jaŋe mâreŋ bâfâuckepie dâkâne 7 ezejec.
Eme jaŋe mâreŋ dâkâne 7 i hone tâcnerâ qâreŋkehuc norao bawarenʒepieŋ. Ehame no ʒira Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋecte maio kâdoc qaŋarepemu.
Mâc, Lewire guru jaŋe ine Wofuŋte taha bapa giezi jaŋere biŋe ekacte ŋoŋerao ʒuhuckerâ mâreŋ dâkâne moc mi roŋgopieŋ. Gade, Rubeŋ â Manase guru dâkâne jaŋe ine Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mosezi ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec Jordaŋ ŋifecnao biac jarewec.”
Eme ŋic jaŋe raniŋte faharembiŋ. Razo ehapie Josuazi mâreŋ sâcticne qâreŋkeniŋte ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Fec wahac ehuc mâreŋ sâcticne qâreŋke‐fârerâ norao mocwâc risienʒepieŋ. Eme no Silo haeo ʒira Wofuŋte maio ŋoŋere erâ kâdoc qaŋarepemu.”
Eme ŋic jaŋe rarâ fec wahac ehuc hae ŋerawec sâc mâreŋ bâfâuckepie dâkâne 7 fuame papiao qâreŋkembiŋ. Ehuc Josuarao Silo teuŋko risiembiŋ.
Eme Josuazi Silo haeo Wofuŋte maio Israe ŋic garikiŋ sâc mâreŋ bâtâc bajarewec.
Eme Benjamiŋ guru garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc mâreŋ rukec qajarepie Judare guru â Josefere guru ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko raʒiwec.
Eme ma faicpec i Jordaŋko fuŋkewec. Erâ Jeriko hae qaŋeŋnao fisirâ tiki mâreŋ fotâcnerâ ʒoaŋ huhunaopec rawec. Raku Betaweŋ mâreŋ burocnao mickewec.
Erâ irecnec juwicpec jaha raku Lusi (i Bete hâcne) hae qaŋeŋnao fisiwec. Erâ hurâ Ataroti‐Adari haeo fisirâ uruŋnao Bete‐Horoŋ hae irec juwicpec tiki ŋekac ira fisiwec.
Erâ mazi irecnec ŋehasickerâ ʒoaŋ huhunaopec raku Bete‐Horoŋ juwicpec tiki ŋekac ira fisirâ raku Kiriati‐Baali, Kiriati‐Jearim hâcne, i Judare guru jaŋere hae moc, ira mickewec. Hae i jahe hâcne ʒoaŋ huhunaopec irec ma ekopirec.
Â mâreŋ juwicpec irec mazi ine Kiriati‐Jearim hae qaŋeŋnao fuŋkewec. Erâ irecnec ʒoaŋ huhunaopec raku Nefitoa opâ ʒâŋenao fisiwec.
Erâ irecnec hurâ Refaim wâneŋ faicnao Hinom ŋokâ‐ticnere wâneŋ fokac irec faicnao tiki ŋekac irec qaŋeŋnao fisiwec. Erâ mâreŋ juwicpec jaha raku Hinomte wâneŋ fotâcnerâ Jebusi tiki juwicpec fisirâ Enerogele haeopec rawec.
Izi bâŋorierâ faicpec raku Eŋ‐Semesi haeo fisi fotâcnerâ Adumim heâŋ‐ticne ŋifecnao Geliloti hae ŋekac ira fisiwec. Erâ fotâcne hurâ Rubeŋ ŋokâ‐ticne Bohaŋ ere qânâ ŋewec ira fisiwec.
Â faicpec ine feraku Bete‐Araba hae qaŋeŋnao fotâcne hurâ mâreŋ burocnao fisiwec.
Ehuc ʒuhuckerâ raku Bete‐Hogela hae faicpec ira fisiwec. Erâ fotâcnerâ raku Jordaŋ micnao jâmbâŋ Hâwec Hâmocne raʒikicne faicpec fokac ira mickewec. Izi ine juwicpec irec ma ewec.
Eme Jordaŋ opâzi ine ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec irec ma ewec. Izi hâcne Benjamiŋte guru, garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc mâreŋ ro rauc embiŋ irec ma.

Eliteke, Gibetoŋ, Balata,
Jehudu, Bene‐Beraka, Gate‐Rimoŋ,
erâ Me‐Jarikoŋ â Rakoŋ. Erâ Jope hae ŋifecnao mâreŋ fowec i mâmâc.
Erâ ine Daŋte guru mâreŋ i jowac ropie jaŋe ferâ Lesem hae i ʒika qarâ rombiŋ. Ehuc wiac sasawa ʒikazi jopa mizierâ hae i rohuc ʒâŋe‐ticne apa ŋiric ŋuruc‐jeŋicte wase bahuc Daŋ mumbiŋ.
Hae kâcɋene â piticne i Daŋte guru garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc mâreŋ ro rauc embiŋ ira ŋerawec.
Mâreŋ bâtâc bapie tara‐fâreme Israe ŋic jaŋe Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua e wâc moc râcnembiŋ.
Ehuc Wofuŋzi mutâcnewec irec sâcko Eferaim tiki mâreŋko Timina‐Sera hae ŋewec i e jahac numu‐jarewecte râcnembiŋ. Eme hae i mocwâc barâ jusanaŋkewec.
Taha bapa Eleaʒa â Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua erâ Israe guru garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc jaŋere micnefâc jaŋe Silo haeo tutumaŋte qoruc boze motâcko Wofuŋte maio mâreŋ rukec qajarekupie tara‐fârewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Josua ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go Israe ŋic jazac: ‘Mose ecnepe ŋeŋezic hae‐ŋeŋic bâfua raniŋte ŋazawec irec sâcko bâwosâec‐jopaniŋ.
Eme ŋic moc e âgo‐ticne moc qâhâmoocte mi manasuhuc juku sifu qâhâmoocmuo ine gâcnezi erao ʒikare okac bazunʒipiŋte wiserâ hae ira soŋkezejec. Hae i jaŋe hâcne ŋoŋere ŋeŋezic hae erâ ŋenʒepieŋ.
Ehame ŋic i me i moczi wiserâ ŋeŋezic hae ira me ira razejec. Rarâ haesac motâcko fisirâ soŋaŋ jaŋerao fuŋne‐ticne muzejec. Eme jaŋe jowarâ haemaŋko raʒirâ fic moc râcnepie jaŋehec juzejec.
Ehame okac babazu ŋic moczi soc jaha hoŋkeocte bâjâperâ fisime hae irec rune jaŋe ŋic âgo‐ticne qâhâmowec e okac babazu ŋic ere meo mi râenʒepieŋ.
E hae ira juhame kikefuŋ jaŋe tutumaŋko fuŋne‐ticne bataniŋkepie me dameŋ ira taha bapa micne juocmu e hâmome ine hae‐ticne beherâ wisewec ira mocwâc risierâ wiacfâc‐ticne jaŋehec juzejec.’”
Irec Israe ŋic jaŋe hae ʒiŋuc bâwosâec‐jopambiŋ: Moc Kedesi, hae i Galilaia ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko Naftali tiki mâreŋko ŋewec. Moc ine Sikem, i Eferaim tiki mâreŋko ŋewec. Â moc ine Kiriati‐Araba, Heboroŋ hâcne, i Juda tiki mâreŋko ŋewec.
Eme Jordaŋ ŋifecnao, Jeriko ʒoaŋ wewefunao, mâreŋ burocnere ʒâʒâŋiŋko Rubeŋte guru jaŋere mâreŋko hâcne, Bezere hae bâwosâembiŋ. Â Gadere guru jaŋere mâreŋ Gileade ira ine Ramoti haezi ŋewec. Erâ Manasere guru jaŋere mâreŋ Basaŋ ira ine Golaŋ haezi ŋewec.
Hae keci i Israe ŋic jaŋacne â ŋic jabanezi ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ŋec juc embiŋ jaŋere wâc mâmâc bâwosâec‐jopambiŋ. Eme moc e ŋic moc qâhâmoocte mi manasuhuc juku sifu moc qawecko ine hae ira wiserâ rawec. Eme ŋic moczi socte okacne soc jaha hoŋkeocte bâjâpewecko ine sifu mi qâhâmowec. Â ŋic hae iŋucnao soŋkewec ere fuŋne ine qanaŋ kikefuŋ jaŋere maio bataniŋke jumbieŋ.
Lewi guru, garikiŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere micne jaŋe taha bapa Eleaʒa â Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua, erâ Israe ŋic guru garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc jaŋere micnefâc jaŋerao fisimbiŋ.
Ehuc Kanaaŋ mâreŋko Silo haeo ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Hae â rârec mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋnehec forakac i nâŋe rauckehuc lama bulimakaofâc‐nâŋec râec‐jopanaŋte Wofuŋzi Mose âzâcne mutâc ewec.”
Irec Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋzi mutâcnewec irec sâcko Lewire guru jaŋe hae â hae rârec sopâc kecɋaŋ mâreŋ forawec i lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte jaŋacne mâreŋkonec dâkâne jarembiŋ.
Eme ɋâsâi qapie Kohatire guru garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc jaŋere ʒâŋe i bâbâni fuawec. Izi Lewire guru jaŋeraonec taha bapa Aroŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe Juda, Simeoŋ â Benjamiŋ guru jaŋeraonec hae 13 jarembiŋ.
Iŋuc erâ Kohati guru nâfocne jaŋere mocwâc qapie ine Eferaim, Daŋ â Manase guru dâkâne garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc jaŋeraonec hae 10 jarembiŋ.
Eme Isasa, Ase â Naftali guru garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc, erâ Manase guru dâkâne Basaŋ mâreŋko jumbiŋ jaŋeraonec hae 13 i Geresoŋte guru jarembiŋ.
Eme Merarire guru garikiŋ sâc jaŋe Rubeŋ, Gade â Sebuloŋ guru jaŋeraonec hae 12 jarembiŋ.
Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecneme mufua‐jarewec irec sâcko Israe ŋic jaŋe ɋâsâi qahuc hae rârec lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte Lewi guru hae â mâreŋ i jarembiŋ hâcne.
Juda â Simeoŋ guru jaŋeraonec hae ʒiŋuc
i Lewire guruonec Kohatire ɋâricfâc Aroŋte guru jarembiŋ. I ɋâsâi qapie jaŋere ʒâŋezi bâbâni fuawec hâcne.
Juda tiki mâreŋko Anaka mamac‐ticne Araba ere hae ŋewec, Heboroŋ hâcne, hae i â râreckerâ mâreŋ forawec i lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte mâmâc jarembiŋ.
Â hae irec hesarac mâreŋ â hae piticne gâcne ine Jefune ŋokâ‐ticne Kalebezi ro rauc eocte râcnembiŋ.
Eme taha bapa Aroŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe ine hae ʒiŋuc i lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte mâreŋhec jarembiŋ: Heboroŋ, i ʒika qaqa ŋic jaŋere ŋeŋezic hae hâcne, erâ Libina,
Jatiri, Esitemoa,
Holoŋ, Debiri,
Aiŋ, Juta â Bete‐Semesi. Hae 9 i Juda â Simeoŋ guru jaŋeraonec rombiŋ hâcne.
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ Benjamiŋ guru jaŋeraonec wâc lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte mâreŋ‐jeŋichec hae jahec â jahec ʒiŋuc rombiŋ: Gibeoŋ, Geba,
Anatoti â Alimoŋ.
Hae 13 i lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte mâreŋhec mâmâc Aroŋte ɋâricfâc taha bapa jumbiŋ jaŋe jarembiŋ.
Lewire guruonec Kohatire dâkâne garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc Eferaimte guruonec hae gâcne jarembiŋ.
Eme hae ʒiŋuc i rârec‐joparâ lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte mâreŋhec mâmâc jarembiŋ: Eferaim tiki mâreŋko ine Sikem, ŋeŋezic hae moc, erâ Geʒerâ,
Kibizaim â Bete‐Horoŋ. Hae kâcɋene jahec â jahec i hâcne.
Eme Daŋte guruonec iŋuc jaha hae â rârec‐jopahuc mâreŋ forawec i lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte mâmâc jarembiŋ. Jaŋere ʒâŋe ine ʒiŋuc: Eliteke, Gibetoŋ,
Ajaloŋ â Gate‐Rimoŋ. Hae kâcɋene jahec â jahec i hâcne.
Eme Manasere guru dâkâne jaŋeraonec ine hae jajahec â hae rârec‐jofahuc mâreŋ forawec i lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte mâmâc jarembiŋ ine ʒiŋuc: Tanaki â Gate‐Rimoŋ.
Kohatire guru dâkâne, garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte mâreŋhec mâmâc ropie hae 10 ewec.
Eme Lewire garikiŋ guru jaŋeraonec moc Geresoŋte guru jaŋe Manasere guru dâkâne jaŋeraonec hae jajahec â rârec‐jofahuc mâreŋ forawec i lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte jarembiŋ ine ʒiŋuc: Golaŋ, i ŋeŋezic hae moc, Basaŋ mâreŋko ŋewec, erâ Besi‐Tara.
Eme Isasare guru jaŋeraonec ine hae jahec â jahec erâ rârec‐jopahuc mâreŋ forawec i lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte mâmâc jarembiŋ ine ʒiŋuc: Kisioŋ, Daberata,
Jaramuti â Eŋ‐Ganim.
Eme Asere guru jaŋeraonec hae jahec â jahec erâ rârec‐jopahuc mâreŋ forawec i lama bulimakao râec‐jopaniŋte mâmâc rombiŋ ine ʒiŋuc: Misali, Abadoŋ,
Helikata â Rehobo.
Eme Naftalire guru jaŋeraonec hae jahec â moc â rârec‐jopahuc mâreŋ forawec i lama bulimakao râec‐jopaniŋte mâmâc rombiŋ ine ʒiŋuc: Kedesi, ŋeŋezic hae moc, i Galilaia mâreŋko ŋewec, erâ Hamo‐Doro â Karetaŋ.
Geresoŋte guru, garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc jaŋe hae 13, â rârec‐jopahuc mâreŋ forawec i lama bulimakao râec‐jopaniŋte jarembiŋ hâcne.
Lewire guru nâfocne Merarire garikiŋ guru jaŋe Sebuloŋte guru jaŋeraonec hae jahec â jahec erâ rârec‐jopahuc mâreŋ sasawa i lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte mâmâc jarembiŋ ine ʒiŋuc: Jokeneam, Kareta,
Dimina â Nahalali.
Â Rubeŋte guru jaŋeraonec ine hae jahec â jahec erâ rârec‐jopahuc mâreŋ forawec i lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte mâmâc jarembiŋ ine ʒiŋuc: Bezere, Jahazi,
Kedemoti â Mefata.
Â Gadere guru jaŋeraonec hae jahec â jahec erâ rârec‐jopahuc mâreŋ forawec i lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte mâmâc jarembiŋ ine ʒiŋuc: Ramoti, ŋeŋezic hae moc, i Gileade mâreŋko ŋewec erâ Mahanaim,
Hesiboŋ â Jazere.
Lewire guru dâkâne Merarire guru hâcne jaŋe garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc hae 12 jarepie tarawec.
Israe ŋic guru gâcnezi mâreŋ ro rauc embiŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko Lewire guru jaŋe lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaniŋte hae â rârec‐jopahuc mâreŋ forawec i rokupie 48 ewec.
Hae jarembiŋ i râreckehuc mâreŋ forawec i mâmâc jare‐fârembiŋ hâcne.
Wofuŋ e Israe ŋic mâreŋ jareocte ŋosafâc‐jeŋic mujomire‐jarewec irec sâcko jare‐fâreme ro rauc ehuc mâckerâ jumbiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi mujomire‐jarewec irec sâcko wama fuarâ fowec. I Wofuŋ e jahac râsifâc‐jeŋic sasawa mejeŋicko râec‐jopa‐fârewecte moczi moc mi sanaŋkewec.
Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic mumupaŋ dâŋ biaŋne jaza rawec i fâri mâc mi ehuc deŋke‐fârewec hâcne.
Josuazi Rubeŋ guru, Gade guru â Manase guru dâkâne hefârec‐joparâ
ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mosezi dâŋ ŋaza mutâc ewec i soŋaŋke‐hâmohuc noni dâŋ ŋaza mutâc epo i wâc reŋke‐fârembiŋ.
Erâ dameŋ ʒora jâmbâŋ qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋehec hehetiric moc mi ehuc mâmâc jaha juwefueŋgopieŋ. Erâ wâc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte mumutâc dâŋ sasawa i aimuŋ soŋaŋke‐fârembiŋ.
Eme dameŋ ʒi ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mupaŋkewec irec sâcko qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic uruc jauŋ tahac‐jopawec. Irec ŋoŋe wâc Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mosezi Jordaŋ ŋifecnao hae mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋte ŋarewec fokac ira risieniŋ.
Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Mosezi sâcmutâc dâŋ sasawa mutâcne‐ŋarehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic maŋjauŋ ecnerâ ere hataoa juniŋte â sâcmutâc dâŋticne soŋaŋkehuc erao qohota sanaŋkerâ maŋ mamanasu‐ŋeŋiczi e kiŋaŋ qacnehuc juniŋte ŋaza mutâc ewec i aijakic jaha soŋaŋkehuc junʒepieŋ.”
Josua e iŋuc jaza‐fârerâ jambuŋ‐jopahuc râec‐jopame hae‐jeŋic sâc risie rambiŋ.
Manasere guru dâkâne moc jaŋe Mosezi Basaŋ mâreŋko mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋte jarewec. Â guru dâkâne moc jaŋe ine Josuazi qomâfâc‐jeŋic gâcne jaŋehec Jordaŋ ŋifec ʒoaŋ huhunaopec mâreŋ i jarewec. Josua e sorec‐jopame razo ehapie jambuŋ‐jopawec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe mafa sâkohec, lama bulimakao bocjaha jâmbâŋ, siliwa, gol, aeŋ bâbâroŋ, â aeŋ, erâ ŋaqi qoruc bocaha rombiŋ i barâ hae‐ŋeŋicko risienʒepieŋ; ehuc râsifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋeraonec rokicne i qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋehec bâtâc banʒepieŋ.”
Eme Rubeŋ â Gade guru erâ Manase guru dâkâne jaŋe Silo hae Kanaaŋ mâreŋko ŋewec irecnec Israe ŋic guru gâcne behec‐joparâ hae‐jeŋic sâc Gileade mâreŋ Wofuŋzi Mose mutâcnecneme jaŋe jaŋac ro rauc embiŋ ira raniŋte rambiŋ.
Eme guru jahec â moc i jaŋe Jordaŋ ŋifecnao Kanaaŋ mâreŋ ŋondeŋ moc ʒâŋene Geliloti ira fisirâ alata sâko moc bambiŋ.
Eme Israe guru gâcne jaŋe biŋe ʒiŋuc mupie manambiŋ: “Manaŋgopieŋ, Rubeŋ â Gade guru erâ Manase guru dâkâne jaŋe Geliloti mâreŋko alata moc bambiŋ. Hae mâreŋ i Jordaŋ heririŋ Kanaaŋ mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao Israe guru sâko nâŋâcne mâreŋkopec fokac hâcne.”
Israe guru sâko jaŋe iŋuc manarâ furu jaha râsi fisi‐jareniŋte Silo haeo tumaŋnembiŋ.
Ehuc Israe ŋic jaŋe Gileade mâreŋko Rubeŋ â Gade guru erâ Manase guru dâkâne jaŋerao taha bapa Eleaʒare ŋokâ Pinehasi,
â micne 10 Israe guru garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc irecnec micne moc moc hâcne, jaŋe ehec mâmâc sorec‐jopambiŋ.
Eme jaŋe Gileade mâreŋko Rubeŋ â Gade guru erâ Manase guru dâkâne jaŋerao fisirâ ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ:
“Wofuŋte kikefuŋ ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Ŋoŋe wemocte Israere Wofuŋ Anutu bunao bahuc bâbâsifuc ʒi bâfuambiŋ? Ŋoŋe alata ʒi bahuc Wofuŋte dâŋ sâcne mi reŋkembiŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc Anutu fecneŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Peoro haeo bahac fuame Wofuŋziŋic ŋokac bâtiŋ‐jopawec i moc mi manasuŋgopieŋ me? Eme dameŋ ʒi bahac izi hâcne kidapec‐nâpoha juŋgopeneŋ. Eme izi sawa mi fozac me?
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ râpecke sanaŋkeniŋte muŋgopieŋ me? Ŋoŋe miŋecgac Wofuŋ dâŋticne mi reŋkeniŋmuo ine tomâcko biac Israe ŋic sasawa mana gâpâre‐nâreocmu.
Ŋoŋe mâreŋ‐ŋeŋickoa jupie Wofuŋ araŋ babacnere sâc mi ekacko ine Wofuŋte mâreŋko e jahacne qoruc boze ŋekacko fânʒepieŋ. Ehuc ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko mâreŋ ro rauc enʒepieŋ. Erâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋecte alatao ʒuhuckerâ alata moc bahuc Wofuŋ â nâŋe qâhuc‐nâpohuc wiac ebac ee ine mi enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Ʒera ŋokâ‐ticne Akaŋ erao mâsi fuawec irec manasunʒepieŋ. E wiac Wofuŋte meo râekicne irec mumutâc fuawec i qatarame Israe kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋerao bâbâtiŋ fuawec. Erâ Akaŋ e kiŋ bahac‐ticnere erâ buc mi hâmowec.’”
Eme Rubeŋ â Gade guru â Manase guru dâkâne, jaŋe Israere guru, garikiŋ sâc jaŋere micne dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarembiŋ:
“Wofuŋ e Anutu Fekicne Mocjaha. Wofuŋ e Anutu Fekicne Mocjaha. Fuŋne wemocte alata bambeŋ i eki manakac â ŋoŋe wâc miŋecgac mananʒepieŋ. Me Wofuŋte dâŋ qatarahuc hata âte sifuckembeŋko ine moc mi akic‐nâponʒepieŋ.
Nâŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ qatarahuc nâŋe nâŋâcne alata barâ ira hosâc âsu bâzi ririke, me jacgoŋ wiaczi taha banaŋte, me wamare taha banaŋte alata i bambeŋko ine Wofuŋ e jahac bâtiŋ‐nâpozejec.
Nâŋe ine ʒiŋucte alata i bambeŋ: Juku nacnere ŋoŋere ɋâricfâc jaŋe nâŋere ɋâricfâc ʒiŋuc moc jazanʒipiŋte: Ŋoŋe Israere Wofuŋ Anutu ehec ʒuʒuhuc‐ŋeŋic moc fokac me?
Wofuŋ e Jordaŋ opâzi nâŋe â Rubeŋ â Gade guru ŋoŋe manâŋec eocte râewec, ŋoŋe Wofuŋhec ʒuʒuhuc‐ŋeŋic moc mi fokac i iŋuc muhuc ŋoŋere ɋâricfâc jaŋe nâŋere ɋâricfâc bâuruŋ‐jopapie Wofuŋ araŋ babacne i nâŋerao omaezacte erâ alata ʒi bambeŋ.
I bâzi ririke me taha râe guruc eere mâcne,
guru jajahec nâŋâcne ma eocte bambeŋ. Erâ ŋic gaŋne gaŋne faicnao fua raniŋmu jaŋere wâc mâmâc ezejec. Wiac izi hâcne ʒiŋuc mutâcne‐jarezejec: Nâŋe Wofuŋ Anutu araŋ bacnehuc qowi bâzi ririke, taha bâzi erâ wama bâzi i bajueŋgopeneŋ wâc. Erâ juku nacnere ŋoŋere ɋâricfâc jaŋe nâŋere ɋâricfâc ʒiŋuc jazanʒipiŋte alata ʒi bakicne: ‘Ŋoŋe Wofuŋhec ʒuʒuhuc‐ŋeŋic moc fokac me?’
Irec nâŋe ʒiŋuc manasumbeŋ: Juku nacnere nâŋere me ɋâricfâc‐nâŋec jaŋerao dâŋ iŋucne moc mupie nâŋe ʒiŋuc jazanʒepeneŋ: Honeniŋ, ŋosafâc‐nâŋec jaŋe alata ʒi bambiŋ i Wofuŋte alata iŋucne. I qowi bâzi me taha bâzi ririkere mâcne, ŋoŋe â nâŋe ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko mumutaniŋ‐nâŋec erâ ŋeocte bambiŋ.
Nâŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ mi qatara‐jâmbâŋkenʒepeneŋ, me alata moc barâ ira qowi bâzi ririke, me jacgoŋ â taha gâcne râe guruc i wâc mi mac enʒepeneŋ. Erâ wâc Wofuŋte qoruc bozere motâcnao alata ŋekac iŋucne moc mi ʒuhuckerâ banʒepeneŋ.”
Eme taha bapa Pinehasi â Israe guru, garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc irec micne sasawa taha bapahec jumbiŋ jaŋe Rubeŋ â Gade guru â Manase guru dâkâne jaŋe dâŋ mumbiŋ i manapie sâckewec.
Eme taha bapa Eleaʒare ŋokâ Pinehasi e Rubeŋ â Gade guru â Manase guru dâkâne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Miŋecgac manaŋgopeneŋ: Wofuŋ e ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko jukac. Wemocte, ŋoŋe wiac i ehuc Wofuŋ bunao mi bambiŋ. Eme ʒi Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋe Wofuŋte bâbâtiŋko fenʒipiŋte bâfiriec‐jopaŋgopieŋ hâcne.”
Eme taha bapa Eleaʒare ŋokâ Pinehasi â micne guru jaŋe Gileade mâreŋko Rubeŋ â Gade guru jaŋeraonec risierâ Kanaaŋ mâreŋko Israe ŋic jaŋerao rambiŋ. Ehuc ŋic ŋokac dâŋ binaŋ ejarembiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe dâŋ binaŋ‐jeŋic manapie sâckewec. Eme Anutu mucne bacnehuc Rubeŋ â Gade guru jaŋe mâreŋ ro rauc erâ jusanaŋkembiŋ i râsi ejarehuc bâsirowec‐jopaniŋte mumbiŋ i behembiŋ.
Eme Rubeŋ â Gade guru jaŋe alatare ʒâŋe Mumutaniŋ mumbiŋ. I ʒiŋucte manasuhuc: “Wiac izi manâŋec ehuc, Anutu e Wofuŋ jâmbâŋ jukac i mutaniŋkezejec.”
Wofuŋ e Israe ŋic râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋeraonec batarac‐joparâ wama bâfua‐jareme juwefukuhapie jaha Josua e ŋicqizec jâmbâŋ ewec.
Ehuc Israe ŋic sasawa erâ soŋaŋ micne, mumutara ŋic â fekicnefâc‐jeŋic hetumaŋ‐jopa‐fârerâ kecʒiŋuc jazawec: “No ŋicqizec jâmbâŋ ekopac.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ŋoŋere erâ ŋic gurune gurune ʒi jaŋerao wiac sasawa ewec i hone‐fârembiŋ. E ŋoŋere erâ ʒika qawec hâcne.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Jordaŋ opâzi qâtâcneme raku ʒoaŋ huhunaopec Hâwec Sâkoo fisikac ira ŋic gurune gurune bawahac‐jopapo. Erâ ŋicguru gâcne juraŋgopieŋ jaŋere mâreŋ i guru‐ŋeŋicte sâcko bâtâc barâ ŋoŋere biŋe râepo wâc.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi bânierâ guriŋ‐jopahuc jopa jâpec ejareocmu. Eme Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e mupaŋke‐ŋarewec irec sâcko mâreŋ‐jeŋic roniŋmu.
Erâ Mosere sâcmutâc papia qizecko wiac sasawa qâreŋkekicne fokac i aimuŋ jaha soŋaŋkehuc efârenʒepieŋ, moc mi ʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ŋic gurune gurune irec ʒanʒaŋnezi ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ʒuhuckerâ juŋgopieŋ jaŋehec sisifuc mi enʒepieŋ. Â nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe mu bâuac, me jaŋere ʒâŋeo mumupaŋ dâŋ mumu me kiŋaŋ qaqajare, me dieŋzi herâ dadape‐jare i wâc moc mi ejâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe juwefuŋgopieŋ iŋucnea Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋictao qohota sanaŋkerâ junʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ e ŋoŋe ʒira juniŋte ŋic gurune gurune tâpiri ɋicwânʒâŋ‐jeŋichec jopa jâpec ejare‐fârewec. Irec juwefuhapie ŋic moczi sanaŋkerâ râsi fifisi‐ŋare i moc mi fuawec erâ wâc mi fuakac.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e mupaŋke‐ŋarewec irec sâcko ŋoŋere erâ ʒika qaekacte ŋoŋeraonec mocjahazi ŋic 1 tauseŋ jaŋe ejareme sâcne wiseniŋmu.
Ʒi ine ŋaŋac juhâmoniŋte Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic maŋzi ʒâficke‐jâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe mocwâc risierâ ŋic gurune gurune hetiric‐jopakicne ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko juraŋgopieŋ, jaŋerao qohotahuc ŋokac nareŋ gareŋ eniŋmuo
ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ʒuhuckerâ ŋic gurune gurune ʒi jopa jâpec moc mi ejare‐jâmbâŋkeocmu. Jaŋe hâcne ŋoŋere bitiŋ eniŋmu, erâ wâc ŋâŋârâc‐ŋeŋic ehuc ŋifec â ŋifec qâʒâic‐ŋopaniŋmu â ʒârâ ehuc ʒâŋe‐ŋeŋicko âkec‐ŋopaniŋmu. Iŋuc fokuhame Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ biaŋ ŋarewec ʒira oma‐fâreniŋmu.
“Ʒi hâmoc dameŋ‐nane qândâŋkekac. Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi dâŋ biaŋne mupaŋke‐ŋarewec i ninic jaha fua‐fârewec i ŋoŋe maŋ mamanasu‐ŋeŋicko buc buc manasuŋgopieŋ. Mumupaŋ sasawa i moc mi wahahuc mupaŋkewec sâc deŋke‐fârewec.
Eme Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi wiac biaŋne ŋoŋerao fuaocte mupaŋkewec sâc fuawec. E behepie ine irec sâc jaha ŋoŋerao wiac hâhâwicne sâko bâfuaocmu. Ehuc mâreŋ biaŋne ʒi ŋarewec irecnec bâsirowec‐ŋopaocmu.
E ʒâʒâfic‐ticne mutâcne‐ŋarewec i hetâcnehuc nemu dape‐jarehuc kiŋaŋ qajareniŋmuo iŋuc hâcne fuaocmu. Eme ŋoŋerao Wofuŋte kimbeŋzi bâruŋkeha mâreŋ biaŋ ŋarewec ʒira boc mi jufehuc biac omaeniŋmu.”
Josua e Israe ŋic guru sâc furu jaha Sikem haeo hetumaŋ‐jopawec. Ehuc soŋaŋ micne, mumutara ŋic â fekicnefâc‐jeŋic hefârec‐jopame Anuture maio fisimbiŋ.
Eme Josuazi ŋic ŋokac sasawa kecʒiŋuc jazawec: “Israere Wofuŋ Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Mârâc sasac jaha jâmbâŋ apa ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao juhuc nemu gâcne araŋ bajare jumbieŋ. I jaŋeraonec moc Tera, Abraham â Naho jahere mamac.
Eme no apa‐ŋeŋic Abraham e Eufrata opâ ŋifecnaonec rorâ jowa warepe Kanaaŋ mâreŋ ate‐fârewec. Ehame ɋâricfâc‐ticne bocjaha basawec‐jopapo, ehuc Isaka râcnepo.
Eme Isakare ŋokâ jahec Jakobo â Esau bâfuac‐jofapo. Erâ Esau e Seiri tiki mâreŋ i ro rauc eocte râcnepo. Jakobo â ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋe ine Aigita mâreŋko humbiŋ.
Ehame no Mose â Aroŋ jaŋerao sorec‐jofahuc Aigita mâreŋko wiac qeŋ bipinehec bâfuarâ jowac‐jopa wefupo.
Erâ apa ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopape wareku Hâwec Bâbâroŋko fisimbiŋ. Ehame Aigita ŋic jaŋe apa ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic bâjâpec‐joparâ ʒika keretac â momori ŋic becâsicfâc‐jeŋichec Hâwec Bâbâroŋko fisimbiŋ wâc.
Eme apa ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe Wofuŋ no kio wâwâsic enarembiŋ. Enarepie jaŋe â Aigita ŋic ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko dapâc qisiric bâfuapo. Ehuc mupe hâweczi Aigita ŋic qâuruc‐jopa‐fârewec. No Aigita mâreŋko wiac bâfuapo i hone‐fârembiŋ. Erâ mâreŋ burocnao dameŋ ʒora jâmbâŋ jumbiŋ.
Erâ no bacŋopa warehuc jukuhape Jordaŋ ŋifecnao Amori ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko fisimbiŋ. Fisipie jaŋe ŋoŋehec ʒika bâfuapie meŋeŋicko râec‐jopape mâreŋ‐jeŋic ro rauc ehapie sâc bâsirowec‐jopapo.
Eme Ziporo ŋokâ‐ticne Balake e Moabi ŋicwofuŋzi faharerâ Israe ŋic ŋoŋehec ʒika qawec. Ehuc Beoro ŋokâ‐ticne Bileamzi sâwec‐ŋopaocte dâŋ râecnewec.
Erâ no sifu Bileam dâŋticnere hazec moc mi râepo. Ehame jambuŋ‐ŋopawec. Eme no Balakere meonec batarac‐ŋopapo hâcne.
Eme ŋoŋe Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ Jeriko haeo raʒimbiŋ. Raʒipie Jeriko ŋic jaŋe ŋoŋehec ʒika bâfuambiŋ. Erâ Amori ŋic, Periʒi ŋic, Kanaaŋ ŋic, Hitiŋic, Girigasi ŋic, Hiwiŋic â Jebusi ŋic jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha embiŋ. Eme no meŋeŋicko râec‐jopa‐fârepo.
Iŋuc ehuc Amori ŋicwofuŋ jajahec hâhâwic sâko hejactepe hâbi‐jekic goroŋkeme wise‐ŋarepic. I ŋoŋere tepe me ʒika wiaczi gie i mi bawec.
No mâreŋ â fic hae ŋarepo i ŋoŋe giene mi bambiŋ. Erâ ira ŋeŋe juju ehuc waiŋ â oliwa nâeŋgopieŋ i ŋoŋe ŋaŋac he sarac wâc mi embiŋ.’
“Eme irec hâcne Wofuŋ araŋ bacnehuc maŋbiaŋko jauŋ fârihec kiŋaŋ qacnenʒepieŋ. Erâ apa ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao â Aigita mâreŋko nemu araŋ bajarerâ dape‐jarehuc jumbiŋ i behe‐fârerâ Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnenʒepieŋ.
Me Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacneniŋte mi eŋarekacko ine miŋecgac jaha mo kiŋaŋ qacnezo muŋgopieŋ e mutaniŋkeniŋ. Apa ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ fokac ira nemu araŋ bajarehuc dape‐jarembiŋ i me mâreŋ‐jeŋicko ŋec juc eŋgopieŋ. Amori ŋic hâcne, jaŋere nemufâc dape‐jareniŋmu. No â wiacfâc‐nane nâŋe ine Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnenaŋmu.”
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ: “Nâŋe Wofuŋ râpeckerâ nemu kiŋaŋ qaqajare i moc mi ejâmbâŋkenaŋmu.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec e jahac apa ŋosafâc‐nâŋec â nâŋe nâŋâcne Aigita mâreŋte niŋgiŋkonec batarac‐nâpowec. Ehuc fuŋne qaqa mâsi ʒâŋe fai‐nâŋecko bawec. Â hata jumbeŋ sâc eki aki anonoc enârehuc jowac‐nâpohame ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere ŋondeŋko fotâcnembeŋ.
Erâ nâŋe mâreŋ ʒira raʒinaŋte Wofuŋ e jahac Amori ŋic gurune gurune ʒira jumbiŋ jaŋe jopa jâpec ejarewec. Irec nâŋe wâc Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnenaŋmu. Eki hâcne nâŋâcne Anutu fârine.”
Eme Josuazi ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wofuŋ e Tiri Anutu, e ʒoɋac‐ticnehec, irec ŋoŋe kiŋaŋ sâcne mi qacneniŋmu. E kiŋ bahac â qaqatara‐ŋeŋic moc mi behe‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.
Ŋoŋe nemu kiŋaŋ qajarehuc Wofuŋ fârine râpeckeniŋmuo ine wiac biaŋne eŋareweczi ŋerisierâ wiac hâhâwicne bâmâckehuc eŋarerâ sipiric‐ŋopaocmu hâcne.”
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Josua âzâcnembiŋ: “Aricne, nâŋe Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnenaŋmu.”
Eme Josuazi ŋic ŋokac jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ŋaŋaczia fuŋne‐ŋeŋic muhuc Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacneniŋte mutaniŋkeŋgopieŋ hâcne.” Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Nâŋe nâŋac fuŋne‐nâŋec muŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme eki muwec: “Irec nemu jabane bajuŋgopieŋ i bârârie‐fârerâ Israere Wofuŋ Anuturao maŋ mamanasu‐ŋeŋic râepie fosanaŋkezejec.”
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Josua âzâcnembiŋ: “Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋecte mic reŋkerâ kiŋaŋ qacnenaŋmu.”
Mupie Josuazi ʒoaŋ ira ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Anutuhec ʒâfic‐jopahuc Sikem haeo sâcmutâc â tiŋne jujure dâŋ mutâcne‐jare‐fârewec.
Ehuc dâŋ sasawa i Anutu sâcmutâc‐ticnere papia qizecko qâreŋkewec. Erâ qânâ sâko moc rorâ boriŋfuŋko Wofuŋte furu mâreŋ fowec ira âkendâŋneme domawec.
Erâ Josuazi ŋic ŋokac jazawec: “Qânâ ʒi honeŋgopieŋ, e Wofuŋzi dâŋ sasawa nâzâwec i mana‐fârekac. Eme ŋoŋe Anutu‐ŋeŋic enʒaŋauc ecnehuc eatuckeniŋmuo ine eki fuŋne‐ŋeŋic sâcne rituocmu.”
Eme Josuazi ŋic sasawa mâreŋ ro rauc embiŋ sâc sorec‐jopame râwiŋne‐fârembiŋ.
Wiac sasawa ewarehuc jumbiŋ irec faicnao Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic Nuŋte ŋokâ Josua e jara 110 bazurâ hâmowec.
Hâmome e jahacne mâreŋ Timina‐Sera Eferaim tiki mâreŋko Gasi tiki ŋekac irec faicnao duckembiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Josuare dameŋko â ere faicnao Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic jaŋerao gie bame sâc hone manac embiŋ soŋaŋ i jaŋere dameŋko wâc Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnehuc jumbiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Josefere siec Aigita mâreŋkonec bawefumbiŋ i Sikem haeo Jakobozi mâreŋ dâkâne moc Sikemte mamac Hamoro ere ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec moneŋ kâcɋene 100‐zi furine bawec ira duckembiŋ. Mâreŋ i hâcne Josefere ɋâricfâc jaŋe ro rauc embiŋ.
Eme Aroŋte ŋokâ Eleaʒa e wâc iŋuc jaha hâmowec. Eme jaŋe ŋokâ‐ticne Pinehasi ere hae Gibea, Eferaim tiki mâreŋko râcnembiŋ, ira duckembiŋ.
Josua hâmome faicnao Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋ wiocnerâ mumbiŋ: “Kanaaŋ ŋic jopazore guru wenimoizi micne banârehuc feocmu?”
Eme Wofuŋzi muwec: “Manaŋgopieŋ, no mâreŋ i Judare meo râepore eki fezejec.”
Eme Juda guru jaŋe qomâfâc‐jeŋic Simeoŋte guru jazarâ mumbiŋ: “Nâŋere mâreŋko mâmâc fehuc Kanaaŋ ŋic jopanʒepeneŋ. Ehame nâŋe wâc iŋuc jaha ŋoŋere mâreŋko mâmâc ranaŋmu.” Eme Simeoŋte guru jaŋe bâjâpec‐jopapie rambiŋ.
Eme Juda guru jaŋe ʒikao rahapie Wofuŋzi Kanaaŋ â Periʒi ŋic mejeŋicko râec‐jopawec. Eme jaŋe ŋic 10 tauseŋ Beʒeki hae mendâŋko jopambiŋ.
Eme Beʒeki haeo Adoni‐Beʒec erao fisirâ ʒika qambiŋ. Ehuc Kanaaŋ â Periʒi ŋic bawahac‐jopambiŋ.
Â Adoni‐Beʒec e ine wisehame jâpe ra rorâ meneŋgoc jahecne â kike neŋgoc jahecne hetâcnembiŋ.
Eme Adoni‐Beʒeczi muwec: “Ŋicwofuŋ 70 meneŋgoc â kike neŋgoc‐jeŋic hetâcnekicnezi nore tebo rurumaŋko nânâ huŋgaŋ nuse nâc ejumbieŋ. No iŋuc epore Anutuzi okacne bazu‐narekac.” Eme jaŋe Jerusalem haeo barapie ira hâmowec.
Eme Judaŋic jaŋe Jerusalem haeo ʒika qambiŋ. Ehuc hae i ʒikazi imackehuc ʒoc turuŋkepie ʒawec.
Eme ʒâhec Judaŋic jaŋe Kanaaŋ ŋic tiki mâreŋko, Negebe mâreŋ â wâneŋko jumbiŋ jaŋe jopaniŋte rambiŋ.
Eme Juda guru jaŋe Heboroŋ haeo Kanaaŋ ŋic jumbiŋ jaŋe jopaniŋte rambiŋ. (Heboroŋte ʒâŋe mârâc Arabare hae mujumbieŋ.) Ehuc micnefâc‐jeŋic Sesai, Ahimaŋ â Talamai iŋuc jopambiŋ.
Eme irecnec ine Debiri haere ŋecjucfâc râsi fisi‐jareniŋte rambiŋ. Debiri haere ʒâŋe ine mârâc jaha Kiriati‐Sefe iŋuc fowec.
Eme Kalebezi muwec: “Moc e Kiriati‐Sefe hae imackerâ rome otâ‐nane Akisa râcnepe ŋonâŋ‐ticne eocmu.”
Mume Kalebe ɋaticne Kenaʒire ŋokâ Otiniezi hae i rowec. Eme Kalebezi otâ‐ticne Akisa râcnewec.
Eme ŋokac e fisime ŋowe‐ticnezi hesarac mâreŋte mamac‐ticne wiocneocte ʒoɋac ecnewec. Eme doŋgionec wahame Kalebezi wiocnerâ muwec: “Wemo wiacte egarekac?”
Wiocneme âzâcnerâ muwec: “Negebe mâreŋko râecnumeŋ irec wiac moc tahacnuc, ehuc opâ ʒâŋe hâcne narec.” Eme Kalebezi opâ ʒâŋe faic â juwic i mâmâc râcnewec.
Eme Mosere kimo Keniŋic ere ɋâricfâc jaŋe Judaŋic jaŋehec hâmu gie hae irecnec Juda mâreŋ burocne Negebe mâreŋko Arada hae heririŋnao fokac ira ferambiŋ. Ehuc jaŋehec jusanaŋkembiŋ.
Eme Judare guru jaŋe qomâfâc‐jeŋic, Simeoŋte guru hâcne, jaŋehec rarâ Kanaaŋ ŋic Zefata haeo jumbiŋ jaŋe joparâ hae i bâsirowe‐fârembiŋ. Ehuc hae irec ʒâŋe Horima mumbiŋ.
Judare guru jaŋe hae mâreŋ ʒiŋuc rombiŋ wâc: Gaza, Asikaloŋ â Ekoroŋ.
Wofuŋ e Juda guru jaŋehec juhame tiki mâreŋ rombiŋ. Â wâneŋko jaŋe ine ʒikare keretac aeŋzi bakicne fojarewecte jopa jâpec sâcne mi ejarembiŋ.
Eme Heboroŋ hae i Mosezi muwec irec sâcko Kalebe râcnembiŋ. Eme eki Anakare ŋokâfâc jahec â moc hae irecnec jopa jâpec ejarewec.
Â Benjamiŋ guru jaŋe ine Jebusi ŋic Jerusalem haeo jumbiŋ i jopa jâpec mi ejarembiŋ. Irec Jebusi ŋic jaŋe Benjamiŋ ŋic jaŋehec jumbiŋzi juŋgopieŋ jaha.
Josefere kikefuŋ jaŋe iŋuc jaha Bete hae râsi fisicneniŋte fembiŋ. Wofuŋzi ine jaŋehec juwec.
Eme Josefere kikefuŋ jaŋe ruc bapa ŋic Bete hae hone tâcneniŋte sorec‐jopambiŋ. (Mârâcko hae irec ʒâŋe Lusi mujumbieŋ.)
Eme ruc bapa ŋic jaŋe ŋic moc haeonec wahame honerâ âzâcne mumbiŋ: “Haemaŋko raraʒire hata nâwotuc. Eme nâŋe akicguhuc wiac biaŋne egarenaŋmu.”
Eme haemaŋko raraʒire hata jowatume raʒirâ hae i ʒikazi imackehuc ŋic e jahacne â garikiŋfâcne ine akic‐jopa‐fârembiŋ.
Eme ŋic e Hitiŋic jaŋere mâreŋko rarâ hae moc bawec. Ehuc hae irec ʒâŋe Lusi muwec. Eme ʒâŋe izi dameŋ ʒiŋuczia fokac jaha.
Manase guru jaŋe hae kecʒiŋuc jaŋere ŋecjucfâc jopa jâpec mi ejarembiŋ: Bete‐Seaŋ â hae piticfâc‐ticne, Tanaki â hae piticfâc‐ticne, Doro â hae piticfâc‐ticne, Ibeleam â hae piticfâc‐ticne erâ Megido â hae piticfâc‐ticne. Irec Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ ira ʒuhuckerâ jumbiŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋe fua sawec ehuc tâpirihec erâ Kanaaŋ ŋic jopa jâpec mi ejarehuc jaŋacne mic sâcko juniŋte mujarembiŋ.
Eme Eferaim guru jaŋe Kanaaŋ ŋic Geʒera haeo jumbiŋ i jopa jâpec mi ejarembiŋ. Irec Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋe Geʒera haeo ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko jumbiŋ wâc.
Sebuloŋ guru jaŋe hae kecʒiŋuc jaŋere ŋecjucfâc jopa jâpec mi ejarembiŋ: Kitoroŋ â Nahalolo. Eme Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋe jaŋere kiŋaŋ qahuc micdâŋ‐jeŋicte sâcko jumbiŋ.
Ase guru jaŋe hae kecʒiŋuc jaŋere ŋecjucfâc jopa jâpec mi ejarembiŋ: Ako, Sidoŋ, Ahalaba, Akaʒibi, Heleba, Afiki â Rehobo.
Ase guru jaŋe Kanaaŋ mâreŋ rune jopa jâpec mi ejarehuc jaŋere ŋondeŋko jumbiŋ.
Naftali guru jaŋe Bete‐Semesi hae â Bete‐Anata hae jahere ŋecjucfâc jopa jâpec mi ejarehuc Kanaaŋ mâreŋ rune jaŋere ŋondeŋko jumbiŋ. Erâ ine sifu Bete‐Semesi â Bete‐Anata haere ŋecjucfâc jaŋe Naftali guru jaŋere rurumaŋko juhuc micdâŋ‐jeŋicte sâcko gie bambiŋ.
Amori ŋic jaŋe ine Daŋ guru kikeo kikeo ejarehuc jâpec‐jopapie tiki mâreŋko ferâ jumbiŋ. Jaŋe wâneŋko wahaniŋte moc mi mana‐jarembiŋ.
Amori ŋic jaŋe Hari‐Heresi, Ajaloŋ â Salabim haeo juniŋte boc ʒoɋac embiŋ. Josefere garikiŋ jaŋe ine boc bâuruŋ‐jopapie jaŋere rurumaŋko juhuc micdâŋ‐jeŋicte sâcko jumbiŋ.
Eme Amori ŋic jaŋere mazi Akerabim heâŋ‐ticnaonec fuŋkerâ raku Sela hae jâururâ ferawec.
Wofuŋte aŋelozi Giligali haeonec Bokim haeo ferâ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “No Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐ŋopa wefurâ mâreŋ ʒi, mimiŋnefac‐ŋeŋic jarepemurâ mupaŋkepo, ira râec‐ŋopapo. Ehuc mupo: ‘No ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo i moc mi hetâcne‐jâmbâŋkepemu.
Â ŋoŋe ine mâreŋ rune ʒi jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic moc mi enʒepieŋ, ehuc alata‐jeŋic hetâtienʒepieŋ.’ Ŋoŋe ine sâcmutâc‐nane mi reŋkembiŋ. I wemo mâsi embiŋ!
Irec miŋecgac ʒiŋuc ŋazakopac: No ŋoŋere erâ mi jâpec‐jopa‐jâmbâŋkepemu. Jaŋe juhuc râsi eŋarenʒepieŋ, â nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ine wiwitic eŋarenʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋte aŋelozi Israe ŋic sasawa dâŋ iŋuc jazame jaŋe uu qarâ kiombiŋ.
Eme jaŋe mâreŋ ŋondeŋ irec ʒâŋe Bokim mumbiŋ. Ehuc ira Wofuŋ taha bacnembiŋ.
Eme Josuazi ŋic ŋokac râec‐jopame Israe ŋic ŋokac jaŋe merâfâc mâreŋ‐jeŋic sâc rarâ raucke rambiŋ.
Eme Josua ere dameŋko jumbiŋ, erâ wâc soŋaŋ gâcne jaŋe juwicnao Wofuŋzi Israe kikefuŋ jaŋere erâ gie sâko bawec i honembiŋzi juhapie ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnembiŋ.
Eme Josua, Nuŋte ŋokâ, Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic e jara 110 bazurâ hâmowec.
Hâmome merâfâc mâreŋ‐ticnao, Timinati‐Heresi haeo, Eferaim tiki mâreŋko, Gasi tiki faicnao ira duckembiŋ.
Duckerâ jufehuc Josua juha jumbiŋ jaŋe iŋuc jaha juju‐jeŋic tarame mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic rambiŋko rafârembiŋ. Rafârepie râpefuŋ‐jeŋicko ŋic ʒaene moc fua sokac embiŋ jaŋe Wofuŋ jahacne erâ Israe kikefuŋ jaŋere erâ gie bawec i kâuc bambiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Wofuŋzi wiac maname sâqoreekac i embiŋ, ehuc Baali nemu kiŋaŋ qajarembiŋ.
Jaŋe Wofuŋ mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere Anutu, Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopawec, e râpeckembiŋ, ehuc nemu gâcne, qâpuc guru rârec rârec jumbiŋ jaŋeraonec, i hâcne bâjâpec‐jopahuc dape‐jarembiŋ. Iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋ maŋne bâiŋnembiŋ.
Jaŋe Wofuŋ râpeckerâ Baali â Asitaroto nemu guru kiŋaŋ qajarembiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋte kimbeŋzi ʒocbâruŋhec Israe ŋic jaŋerao faharewec. Eme fific guguriŋ ejare jumbieŋ jaŋerao râec‐jopame jaŋe ʒuhuckerâ fific guguriŋ ejarembiŋ. Erâ Wofuŋ e râsifâc‐jeŋic rârec‐jopahuc jumbiŋ jaŋere meo râec‐jopame moc mi sanaŋkembiŋ.
Ehuc dameŋ ira me ira rahapie Wofuŋzi bawahac‐jopawec. I e jahac uŋ jazahuc mupaŋke‐jarewec irec sâcko ejarewec. Eme jaŋe ʒâicmaŋko jumbiŋ hâcne.
Iŋuc jupie Wofuŋ e mumutara ŋic âkendâŋ‐jopame jaŋe fific guguriŋ ejarembiŋ jaŋeraonec batarac‐jopambiŋ.
Ehame jaŋe sifu mumutara ŋicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere dâŋte hazec mi râembiŋ. Jaŋe sasec boe sau ŋic iŋucne ehuc nemu jaŋerao rarâ dape‐jarembiŋ. Ehuc mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe Wofuŋte sâcmutâc reŋkehuc hata âtembiŋ irec sâc mi âte rahuc âte sifuckembiŋ hâcne.
Wofuŋ e mumutara ŋic âkendâŋ‐jopawec sâc jaŋehec juwec. Ehuc mumutara ŋic jaŋere dameŋko râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere meonec batarac‐jopawec. Wofuŋ e Israe ŋic fific guguriŋ â imaŋ gomaŋ ejarepie mu wâwâsic‐jeŋic manahuc busâqoc mana‐jarewec.
Eme mumutara ŋic jaŋe hâmopie sâc ine jaŋe risiehuc apa ŋosafâc‐jeŋic siric‐joparâ sâqore‐jâmbâŋkerâ nemu jaŋerao rarâ kiŋaŋ qajarehuc dape‐jarembiŋ. Jaŋe mamanasu â eebapa‐jeŋic repicne i moc mi behembiŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ e kimbeŋ‐ticnere bâruŋzi Israe ŋic jaŋerao fahareme muwec: “Ŋic ʒi jaŋe ʒâʒâfic‐nane apa ŋosafâc‐jeŋic mutâcne‐jarepo i huckehuc micdâŋ‐nane mi reŋkembiŋ.
Irec no Josuazi hâmohuc ŋicguru behec‐jopawec i jopa jâpec mi ejarepemu.
Ehuc Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋte hatao apa ŋosafâc‐jeŋic jumbiŋ irec sâcko aimuŋ jaha juniŋmu me mâcne i mâreŋ rune jaŋehec juhapie esâic‐jopapemu.”
Irec Wofuŋ e ŋicguru i jaŋe acmâc jaha jopa jâpec mi ejarehuc behec‐jopame jumbiŋ. Erâ Josuare meo wâc mi râec‐jopawec.
Israe ŋic gâcne Kanaaŋ mâreŋte erâ ʒika gie mi bambiŋ jaŋe Wofuŋzi esâic‐jopaocte ŋicguru gâcne mana‐jareme jumbiŋ.
I Israe ŋic jaŋeraonec gaŋne moc juwefumbiŋ jaŋe mârâc jaha ʒika qaqare fuŋne mi manambiŋte irec fuŋne jowatuocte ewec.
Ŋicguru ʒâŋe‐jeŋic ine ʒiŋuc: Filisa ŋicbomboŋ 5 erâ Kanaaŋ ŋic sasawa â Sidoŋŋic â Hiwiŋic Lebanoŋ tikio jurambiŋ jaŋe hâcne. Jaŋe Baali‐Herimoŋ tikionec raku Hamati haeo hata raʒikac mâreŋ ŋondeŋ ira jurambiŋ.
Jaŋe Israe ŋic jaŋere eesâic, Wofuŋzi apa ŋosafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sâcmutâc Moserao râewec i reŋkeniŋmu me mâcne, irec fuŋne manaocte mana‐jareme jumbiŋ hâcne.
Irec Israe ŋic jaŋe Kanaaŋ ŋic, Hitiŋic, Amori ŋic, Periʒi ŋic, Hiwiŋic â Jebusi ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko jumbiŋ.
Ehuc qâpuc jaŋere otâfâc i jaŋacne ŋonâŋfâc eniŋte rocjopambiŋ. Â jaŋacne otâfâc ine jaŋere ŋokâfâc jarembiŋ. Iŋuc ehuc jaŋere nemufâc kiŋaŋ qajarembiŋ wâc.
Erâ Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋicte nikec‐jopame Baali â Aseroti kiŋaŋ qajarehuc Wofuŋzi maname sâqoreekac i embiŋ.
Irec Wofuŋte kimbeŋzi Israe ŋic jaŋerao ʒocbâruŋhec faharewec. Eha Mesopotamia ŋicwofuŋ Kusaŋ‐Risataim ere meo râec‐jopawec. Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe jara 8 Kusaŋ‐Risataim kiŋaŋ qacnembiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ kio wâwâsic ecnepie batarac‐jopaocte ŋic moc âkendâŋne‐jarewec. Eme Kalebe ɋaticne Kenaʒire ŋokâ Otinie eki batarac‐jopawec.
Wofuŋte Mârozi neŋgoc ŋecneha Israe ŋic jaŋerao mumutara gie bawec. E ʒika qaocte rahame Wofuŋzi Mesopotamia ŋicwofuŋ Kusaŋ‐Risataim e meticnao râewec. Râeme tâpiri‐ticnezi Kusaŋ‐Risataim siricke‐fârewec.
Eme mâreŋ ira wama fuarâ foha jara 40 tarawec. Ehame Kenaʒi ŋokâ‐ticne Otinie hâmowec.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋte maio wiac hehesicne mocwâc embiŋ. Ehame Wofuŋzi Moabi ŋicwofuŋ Egeloŋ hâbi hecneme hume Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋte maio wiac hehesicne embiŋte râsi fisi‐jarewec.
E Amoŋŋic â Amaleke ŋic rocjopame Israe ŋic râsi fisi‐jarerâ bawahac‐jopambiŋ. Ehuc hâmu gie hae i ro rauc embiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe jara 18 Moabi ŋicwofuŋ Egeloŋte kiŋaŋ qahuc jumbiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋ kio wâwâsic ecnepie ŋic moc ʒâŋene Ehudu, Gerare ŋokâ, Benjamiŋte ɋâric, meticne qaqana, eki batarac‐jopaocte âkendâŋne‐jarewec. Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe erao sahac taha wiac râepie rame Moabi ŋicwofuŋ Egeloŋtao barawec.
Â Ehudu e jahacne sâqe moc bawec, bune râpene mictara â ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc 18 inses. I hâcne fâre‐ticnere ŋaqimaŋko mariewec.
Erâ sahac taha i bararâ Moabi ŋicwofuŋ Egeloŋ râcnewec, Egeloŋ e ŋic biuc wokemaŋ sâkohec juwec.
Eme Ehudu e sahac taha i râcneme tarame ŋic taha reŋke rambiŋ jaŋe râec‐jopame risiembiŋ.
Ehame e jahacne ine Giligali heririŋ qânâ ɋâŋguru ira domarâ mocwâc risierâ muwec: “O ŋicwofuŋ, no biŋedâŋ soŋne moc bajukopac.” Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋ e dâŋfânâŋ nac baocte jazawec. Ehuc rereŋfâc‐ticne jaŋe sorec‐jopame fic râpenao hufârembiŋ.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ e bucticne sawa roro ficticnao ŋehame Ehuduzi maŋfuŋnao rawec. Erâ muwec: “No Anuturaonec dâŋ moc gore biŋe bajukopac.” Eme ŋicwofuŋ e ŋeŋe‐ticnaonec faharewec.
Ehame Ehudu e meqana‐ticnezi fâre‐ticnere gâjoŋkonec sâqe unuckerâ buticnao âeckewec.
Âeckeme sâqe tâpâcne mâmâc bumaŋnao raʒiwec. Eme mi unuckewecte wokemaŋzi bârârâŋneme bumaŋ‐ticnao fowec. Fohame hone wefuwec.
Eme Ehudu e ŋicwofuŋte ficmotâc basanaŋkerâ motâc pitickoa râpenao hurâ rawec.
Rame mi ʒoraha ŋicwofuŋte kiŋaŋŋicfâc jaŋe fisimbiŋ. Ehuc ficmaŋ‐ticnere motâc herâ basanaŋkekicne honerâ ʒiŋuc manasumbiŋ: “E ficpiticko raʒiocte motâc sanaŋne hejec.”
Eme woŋec juipierâ maŋjeŋic gâckewec. Eme ʒuhuckerâ motâc hehe jaha fome honerâ kimotec rorâ motâc batarambiŋ. Ehuc fekicne‐jeŋic e ɋâriŋko hâmocne foha honembiŋ.
Jaŋe woŋec juhapie jaha Ehudu e wiserâ qânâ ɋâŋguru ocniŋucnao Seira haeo rawec.
Ehuc Eferaimte tiki mâreŋko fisirâ qeŋ qawec. Erâ Israe ŋic micne bajareme tiki mâreŋkonec hurâ rambiŋ.
Rahuc Israe ŋic jazarâ muwec: “Ajoc, bâjâpecnuniŋ, Wofuŋ e râsifâc‐ŋeŋic Moabi ŋic hâcne ŋoŋere meo râec‐jopakac.” Iŋuc mume jaŋe bâjâpepie hurâ Jordaŋ opâ rendacnao Moabi ŋic jaŋe fotâcnenʒipiŋte sakare‐fârembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic moczi moc fotâcneocte mi mana‐jarembiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Moabi ŋic sahac ɋiɋic â sanaŋne 10 tauseŋ qâririŋ hâmocne jopambiŋ. Ŋic moczi moc mi wise‐jâmbâŋkewec.
Eme dameŋ ira Israe ŋic jaŋe Moabi ŋic bawahac‐jopapie jaŋere mic sâcko jumbiŋ. Ehame mâreŋ ira wama fuarâ foha jara 80 tarawec.
Irec faicnao Anatare ŋokâ Samegari eki juwec. E Filisa ŋic 600 ɋaru‐ticnezi qâhâmoc‐jopawec. Erâ eki iŋuc jaha Israe ŋic batarac‐jopawec.
Ehudu hâmome Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋte maio wiac mamakâcne mocwâc heɋârembiŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋzi Kanaaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Jabiŋ Hazoro haeo juwec ere meo râec‐jopawec. Â momorifâc‐ticne jaŋere micne Sisera e ine Harose‐Goim haeo juwec.
E ʒikare keretac 900 aeŋzi bakicne focneha jara 20 Israe guru bâʒâic‐jopahuc ro waha âte ejarewecte Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋzi bafic‐jopaocte kio wâwâsic ecnembiŋ.
Ehame dameŋ ira Lapidoti ŋonâŋ‐ticne Debora e porofete ŋokac juhuc Israe ŋic jaŋerao mumutara gie bawec.
E Eferaim tiki mâreŋko Rama â Bete hae ŋondeŋ‐jekicko hâmu moc e jahacne wase bakicne irec fuŋnao ŋejujec. Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe mumutara gie baocte ira fisihuc jumbiŋ.
Eme e Abinoam ŋokâ‐ticne Baraki Naftali mâreŋko Kedesi haeo juwec e dâŋ râecnehuc hefârewec. Eme fisime âzâcnerâ muwec: “Israere Wofuŋ Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Go rarâ Naftali guruonec â Sebuloŋ guruonec ŋicfâcge 10 tauseŋ Taboro tikio hetumaŋ‐jopac.
Eme no Jabiŋte momori guru micne‐jeŋic Sisera e momorifâc‐ticne â ʒikare keretac‐ticnehec fârepe fisiha Kisoŋ opâo bâfuacmu. E noni gore meo râepemu.’”
Mume Barakizi Debora âzâcnerâ muwec: “Goki nohec razo mutec rapemu. Â goki nohec mi racmuo ine no wâc mi rapemu.”
Eme ŋokaczi muwec: “No gohec rajâmbâŋkepemu. Mâc go hata rakomec i go gahacne mumuteŋ fuaocte mi rakomec. Wofuŋ e Sisera ŋokac mocte meo râeocmu.” Iŋuc murâ Debora e faharerâ Barakihec Kedesi haeo rapic.
Eme Barakizi Sebuloŋ â Naftali guru Kedesi haeo raniŋte hefârec‐jopawec. Eme ŋic 10 tauseŋ jaŋe bâjâperâ fembiŋ. Â Debora e wâc ehec mâmâc rafewec.
Eme Keniŋic Hebere e Keniŋic guru gâcne Mose kimo‐ticne Hobabi ere ɋâricfâc behec‐joparâ rawec. Raku Kedesi hae heririŋ Za‐Ananim haeo boriŋfuŋko boze‐ticne bawec.
Eme Abinoam ŋokâ‐ticne Baraki e biac Taboro tikio fejec, Sisera iŋuc âzâcnepie
manarâ ʒikare keretac aeŋzi bakicne 900 erâ ŋicfâc‐ticne jumbiŋ i rocjopame Harose‐Goim haeonec Kisoŋ opâo rambiŋ.
Eme Deborazi Baraki âzâcnerâ muwec: “Ajoc faharec, dameŋ ʒi hâcne Wofuŋzi Sisera megao râekac. Wofuŋ e bânie‐garekac hâcne.” Irec Baraki e Taboro tikionec ŋicfâc‐ticne 10 tauseŋ jaŋe bâjâpepie hurâ rambiŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋzi Sisera â ʒikare keretac â momorifâc‐ticne Barakire meo râec‐jopame ʒikazi jopawec. Eme Sisera e ʒikare keretac‐ticnaonec wiserâ waha kikezi rawec.
Barakizi ʒikare keretâc â Sisera momorifâcne jâpec‐joparâ raku Harose‐Goim haeo fisirâ ʒikazi jopa‐fârewec. Ŋic moc mi akic‐jopambiŋ.
Ehame Sisera e wiserâ raku Keniŋic Hebere ŋonâŋ‐ticne Jaele ere bozeo fisiwec. I ʒiŋucte: Hazoro ŋicwofuŋ Jabiŋ â Keniŋic Hebere gurufâcne ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko wama fowec.
Irec Jaelezi waha rarâ Sisera bâfuahuc âzâcnerâ muwec: “Bomboŋ‐nane, ʒira norao warec, mi hâwicguoc.” Eme Sisera e manarâ ere bozeo raʒiwec. Ehame ŋokac e qoruc ɋâfoŋnezi rufacnewec.
Eme Siserazi ŋokac ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Opâre hâmokopacte piticne mac moc naretec nazapo.” Eme ŋokac e susu ʒopo moc tapane rorâ râcneme nâme mocwâc rufacnewec.
Iŋuc eme ŋic e ŋokac âzâcnerâ muwec: “Motâcko domazemec. Eme ŋic i me i moczi fisirâ wio‐gareocmu: ‘Ʒira ŋic moc juŋgopieŋ me?’ Eme muzemec, aricne.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Hebere ŋonâŋ‐ticne Jaele e bozere fâzâ moc â hama rorâ kamic kamic jaha rarâ fâzâ i nakinao heme fotâcnerâ ŋifec mâreŋko kiwec. Ŋic e betaŋkerâ guŋ qâŋɋâŋne fowecte iŋuc ecneme hâmowec hâcne.
Ehame Baraki e Sisera jâperâ raku fisime Jaelezi waha ra bâfuarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Waretec noni ŋic basakic e gowatupe.” Eme e ŋokacte bozemaŋko raʒiwec. Raʒirâ Sisera e hâmocnezi nakinao bozere fâzâ kisoŋhec fome honewec.
Eme ʒoaŋ ira hâcne Anutuzi Kanaaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Jabiŋ bawahahuc Israe ŋic jaŋere meo râewec.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋere tâpirizi Kanaaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Jabiŋtao boc faharerâ fahare ekume ŋicwofuŋ e bâsirowembiŋ.
Debora â Abinoamte ŋokâ Baraki jahe dameŋ ira gae ʒiŋuc hepic:
“Ŋic jaŋe buafec jaha fuapie Israe soŋaŋ jaŋe micne bajarembiŋ, irec Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ!
“O ŋicwofuŋ â fekicne, ŋoŋe hazec râerâ manahapie woŋgâŋ qahuc Wofuŋ Israere Anutu ʒeri gae hecnepemu.
Wofuŋ, go Seiri â Edom tiki mâreŋkonec warehuc asasai âtehaŋtec mâreŋ ɋiɋiteckeme sambâŋ ropieha karorac jaŋe opâ hoŋkembiŋ.
Eme Sinai ocniŋucnao tiki jaŋe Israere Wofuŋ Anutu ere maio qiriŋ qambiŋ.
“Anata ŋokâ‐ticne Samegari â Jaele jahere dameŋko guruhec rac warec ee i tarame hatapecne ŋic jaŋe hata piticnao sawa rac warec embiŋ.
Israe guruo qâzuckerâ juju i omaehame Debora go Israe guruo neŋgoc tinac fua taniŋkemeŋ.
Jaŋe nemu furune hone wosâc ejarembiŋko ʒikazi haere motâcko fisiwec. Dameŋ ira maro me sându wiac Israe guruo moc honekicne me?
Israe guruonec mumutâc ŋic buafec jaha fuambiŋ jaŋerao maŋnane kâcɋene fokac. Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkezo.
“Becâsic qaŋqaŋko rac warec eeŋgopieŋ â fofo qoruc furi sâkoo ŋeeŋgopieŋ â hatao kikezi jueŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe irec biŋe musaweniŋ.
Opâ fifia tomao gae woŋgâŋ ehuc Wofuŋzi eebapa biaŋ Israe hae sâc bâfuakac irec biŋe murâ mu enʒepieŋ. Eme Wofuŋte ŋicfâc jaŋe haesac motâcko humbiŋ.
“Ajoc, Debora, go faharec! Faharerâ gae moc hec! O Abinoamte ŋokâ Baraki, go faharerâ râsifâcge ʒikao rocjopakicne jaŋe kâpâcwâruo bacjopa rac.
Iŋuc fuame Wofuŋte ŋicfâc fekicne uuc ʒanʒaŋne jaŋe tâpirihec râsi fisi‐jarembiŋ.
Benjamiŋ ŋicfâc ŋoŋere râpeo Eferaim mâreŋkoneczi wahambiŋ. Jaŋe gâtâ‐jeŋic i Amaleke mâreŋko fokac. Makiri guruonec ine mumutâc ŋic jaŋe wahambiŋ. Ehame Sebuloŋ guruonec momori micne jaŋe wahambiŋ.
Isasa guruonec fekicne jaŋe ine Deborahec fisimbiŋ. Eme Isasazi Baraki micne reŋkewec. Ehuc wâneŋko jume ju boc embiŋ. Ehame ŋifec Rubeŋte guruo ine maŋ ŋeŋemâc fuawec.
Go wemocte lama sapa ŋondeŋko dameŋ ʒora lama guru jaŋere qeŋ qapie manacmurâ woŋec jumeŋ? Rubeŋ guru jaŋerao maŋ mâmâcne fuawec.
Gileade e Jordaŋ ŋifecnao jusanaŋkewec. Â Daŋ guru jaŋe wemocte wokeo kiŋaŋ gie bambiŋ? Ase guru jaŋe hâwecmecko juhuc hâwec raʒikicnao ŋesanaŋkembiŋ.
Sebuloŋ guru jaŋe ine juju‐jeŋicte manabâc mi embiŋ â Naftali jaŋe wâc tiki hae mâreŋ‐jeŋicko iŋuc jaha embiŋ.
“Ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe fisirâ ʒika qambiŋ. Wahapie Kanaaŋ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe wâc Tanaki haeo Megido opâ heririŋko ʒika qambiŋ. Erâ sifu râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere mateŋ moc mi rombiŋ.
Sambâŋkonec bâpiŋ jaŋe hata‐jeŋic sâc juhuc Siserahec qaqac embiŋ.
Kisoŋ opâ ɋiɋicnea gasackehuc foekac izi râsi amec‐jopa rawec. O maŋnane, go tâpirihec erâ âtec‐jopac!
“Eme becâsic kike fânâŋ sâko fuakac, becâsic jaŋe wisehuc gasacke sâqoreŋgopieŋ.
“Wofuŋte aŋelo e ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Meroʒi hae rune jaŋe Wofuŋzi Israe momorifâc‐jeŋic bafic‐jopahame mi fisimbiŋte, hae‐jeŋic i sâweckezo.’
“Keniŋic Hebere ere ŋonâŋ Jaele e ŋokac sasawa jaŋere femicne, ŋokac bozeo ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko e hâcne mumbiaŋkezo.
E Siserazi opâre numucneme susu râcnewec. Susu râqârekicne i ŋicbomboŋ râqâcko bafisicnewec.
Erâ meticnezi fâzâ rowec. Ehuc fâre‐ticnezi gieŋic jaŋere hama rorâ Sisera qanʒaŋnewec. E qizec‐ticne qanʒaŋnehuc naki‐ticne âke mârâŋkewec.
Eme kike fuŋnao waha qarâ hâmocne fowec.
“Eme Sisera neŋgoc‐ticne e qâqâtâc kataŋ aaŋ bakicne ira firâ râqârewec. Ehuc muwec: ‘Wemocte ʒika keretac‐ticnezi biac mi warekac? Â wemocte keretac fâfâre becâsic jaŋere kike fânâŋ dameŋ ʒoranehec ekac?’
Eme ŋokac maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe irec fârine âzâcnembiŋ. Ehame e sifu dâŋticne i hâsi fâri jaha muhuc domawec.
‘Jaŋe ʒikare mateŋ i bâfuarâ rohuc bâtâc mi baŋgopieŋ me? Ŋic sâc ŋokac naru mocjaha me jajahec mecne? Siserare ŋaqi jâweczi rikekicne â mateŋ gâcne hawari biaŋ erâ upe‐nanere eri qoqonaŋ jajahec bafisi‐nareocmu mecne.’
“O Wofuŋ, râsifâcge jaŋe iŋuc hâcne sipirickembiŋ. Â âgofâcge jaŋe ine ʒoaŋ tâpirihec wefuekac iŋucne.” Eme mâreŋ ira jara 40 wama fuarâ fowec.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋte maio wiac mamakâcne embiŋ. Iŋuc epie Wofuŋzi Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋere meo râec‐jopame jara 7 jumbiŋ.
Ehame Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋe Israe ŋic fific bacjopambiŋ. Iŋuc ejarepie Israe ŋic jaŋe ŋeŋe juju hawec‐jeŋic tikio gufu rambiŋ, erâ qânâ hawec emasaŋkembiŋ â fic sacsanaŋhec barambiŋ wâc.
Israe ŋic jaŋe he sarac epie sâc Midiaŋ ŋic â Ameleke ŋic, erâ ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec gâcne jaŋe heâckerâ fisi‐jare jumbieŋ.
Jaŋe râsi fisi‐jarerâ teuŋ âterâ fohuc mâreŋ ira wiac he sarac epie fowec i ima bahapie raku Gaza hae heririŋko mâreŋ gâcne forawec ira fisiwec. Iŋuc ehuc Israe ŋic jaŋere nânâ wiac me lama â doŋgi i moc mi akickembiŋ.
Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋe kamele â qoruc boze‐jeŋichec afecne mâcne, waŋgambec qoki iŋucne, wowosene tâmiric fisipie mâreŋ i burockerâ fowec.
Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋe iŋuc ehuc Israe ŋic bâuruŋ‐jopambiŋ. Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋ kio wâwâsic ecnembiŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋere meo juhuc Wofuŋ kio wâwâsic ecnepie
Wofuŋzi porofete moc soreme ra kecʒiŋuc muhuc jazawec: “Israe ere Wofuŋ Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: No Aigita mâreŋte niŋgiŋkonec batarac‐ŋoparâ jowac‐ŋopa wefupo.
Ehuc Aigita ŋic jaŋere meonec mecne â ŋic gâcnezi fific bacŋopambiŋ jaŋere meonec mecne firuec‐ŋopapo. Ehuc jaŋe ŋoŋere erâ jopa jâpec ejarehuc mâreŋ‐jeŋic ŋarepo.
Erâ ʒiŋuc ŋazapo: ‘No ŋoŋere Wofuŋ Anutu; ŋoŋe Amori ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko juhuc nemufâc‐jeŋic moc mi dape‐jarenʒepieŋ.’ Iŋuc ŋazahape ŋoŋe ine sifu dâŋnanere hazec moc mi râembiŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋiczi Ofira haeo fisirâ Abieʒe ŋic Joasi ere boriŋfuŋko waha ŋewec. Joasi ŋokâ‐ticne Gideoŋ e Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋere erâ padi‐ticne soŋkeocte waiŋ qaqa nombâŋko ra qahuc juhame iŋuc fuawec.
Ehame Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋiczi fuacnehuc âzâcnerâ muwec: “Wofuŋ e gohec jukac. Go ʒikaŋic tâpiri sâkohec.”
Mume Gideoŋzi micnao rohuc muwec: “Bomboŋ, Wofuŋ e nâŋâcnehec juhame wemocte wiac sasawa ʒi fua‐nârehuc fokac? Apa ŋosafâc‐nâŋec jaŋe Wofuŋte eehâmo biaŋ irec hewirickehuc dâŋ binaŋ enârehuc ʒiŋuc nâzâmbiŋ: Wofuŋ e Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐nâpowec hâcne. Erâ i fârine weni? Ʒi ine Wofuŋzi behec‐nâpo sanaŋkehuc Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋere meo râec‐nâpowec.”
Mume Wofuŋzi erao ʒâŋe fihuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Tâpirige fokac i, irec rarâ Israe ŋic Midiaŋ jaŋere meonec batarac‐jopazemec. No iŋuc ecmurâ sorecgukopac hâcne.”
Eme Gideoŋzi muwec: “Bomboŋ, no weniŋucko Israe ŋic batarac‐jopapemu. Manakic, Manasere guruo nore guruzi tâpiri tâmiric jâmbâŋ ekac. Erâ wâc no garikiŋ guru‐naneo ŋic wawahane jâmbâŋ jukopac.”
Iŋuc mume Wofuŋzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Irec hâcne no gohec jupemu. Eme go Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋe ŋic mocjaha tinac jopacmu.”
Mume âzâcnewec: “Dâŋ nazakomec irec ehuc mana‐naretec sâckeme ma moc nowatutec fuŋnege manazepac.
Go biac mi rahuc ʒira ŋehaŋtec rarâ wiac piticne mac moc baware‐garezepac.” Eme eki muwec: “No ʒira ŋehape rarâ risiezemec.”
Iŋuc mume Gideoŋ e ficticnao rarâ noniŋ motecne moc qarâ rikewec. Ehuc poroŋ uucne foŋ moc rorâ goreŋ tâmiric rikewec. Eme qowi i kâdoc mocko râerâ sicticne kuʒi mocko qame hume bararâ boriŋfuŋko hecnewec.
Iŋuc eme Anuture kiŋaŋŋiczi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Qowi â poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric i rorâ qânâ ʒirec faio râec, qowi sicticne ine hoŋketec raoc.” Mume Gideoŋ e iŋuc ewec.
Eme Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic e gunu‐ticnere botâŋnezi qowi â poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric i qâuawec. Qâuame izia qânâonec ʒocbâruŋ fuarâ qowi biucne â poroŋ i ʒâseŋkewec. Iŋuc fuame Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic e sipuac ewec.
Sipuac eme Gideoŋ e ʒiŋuc mana tarawec: E Wofuŋte aŋelo. Ehuc muwec: “O jei, Wofuŋ Anutu! No Wofuŋte aŋelo ʒâŋe fâri‐nanezi honepac i.”
Eme Wofuŋzi âzâcnewec: “Wama gorao fozejec. Mi hâwicguoc, go mi hâmocmu.”
Mume Gideoŋzi ira Wofuŋte alata moc bawec. Ehuc irec ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc muwec: Wofuŋ e wama. Eme alata i Abieʒe ŋic jaŋere hae Ofira ira ŋeweczi ŋekac jaha.
Eme ŋafe ira Wofuŋzi âzâcnerâ muwec: “Mamacgere bulimakao ŋicne motec ɋâri moc rozemec. Erâ ʒuhuckerâ moc jara‐ticne 7 i rozemec wâc. Ehuc mamacgere biŋe Baalire alata ŋekac i hetâtiezemec â Asera nemuɋâŋ ŋifecnao domakac i wâc henʒaŋnezemec.
Erâ qânâ tiki ʒirec faio qânâ sâckoa râe guruc ehuc Wofuŋ Anutugere alata moc bazemec. Erâ bulimakao ŋicne jara‐ticne 7 i rorâ Asera nemuɋâŋ henʒaŋnecmu ʒoc izi bâzi rikezemec.”
Mume Gideoŋ e kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec ŋic 10 rocjoparâ Wofuŋzi âzâcnewec irec sâcko ewec. Erâ wiac i ʒoaŋko eocte wiacfâc‐ticne â hae irec ŋic jaŋere boc hâwicke sâqorewecte ŋafeo ewec.
Eme hae fureme ŋic jaŋe faharerâ honembiŋ: Baalire alata â Asera nemuɋâŋ i hetâtiekicne fowec. Erâ bulimakao ŋicne jara‐ticne 7 i alata bakicne irec fainao bâzi ʒawec.
Iŋuc honerâ nazaŋ gazaŋ ehuc mumbiŋ: “Mozi wiac ʒi ejec?” Eme irec muc manac â mu wioc eku jaha ʒiŋuc manambiŋ: “I Joasi ŋokâ‐ticne Gideoŋ eki wiac i ejec.”
Eme ŋic jaŋe Joasi âzâcnerâ mumbiŋ: “Ŋokâge e Baalire alata â Asera nemuɋâŋ hetâtiehuc henʒaŋnejecte jowa waretec qapene hâmozejec.”
Eme Joasizi râsi rocnembiŋ jaŋe jazarâ muwec: “Baalire erâ ʒika qaniŋmu me? Moc e ʒika qaocmuo hae mi fure taniŋkeha e wâc iŋuc jaha hâmozejec. Baali e Anuture sâc jukacko alata‐ticne hetâtiekicnere erâ e jahac ʒika qazejec.”
Eme dameŋ ira fuŋkerâ Gideoŋte ʒâŋe Jeru‐Baali mumbiŋ, i ʒiŋuc muhuctecne: E alata‐ticne hetâtiejecte Baali e jahac okacne fisicnezejec.
Eme Midiaŋ ŋic â Amaleke ŋic, erâ ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec ŋic gâcne qâture‐fârerâ Jordaŋ fotâcnerâ Jesere wâneŋko teuŋ âterâ fombiŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋte Mârozi waha Gideoŋ neŋgoc ŋecnewec. Iŋuc ecneme Gideoŋ e qeŋ qahuc Abieʒe ŋic jaŋe bâjâpeniŋte hefârec‐jopawec.
Ehuc kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopame jaŋe Manasere mâreŋ i sâckerâ rahuc ŋic hefârec‐jopapie jaŋe wâc faharembiŋ. Erâ kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopame Ase, Sebuloŋ â Naftali mâreŋko rambiŋ. Eme jaŋe wâc bâfuac‐jopaniŋte ra fisimbiŋ.
Eme Gideoŋzi Anutu kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Gahac mumeŋ irec sâcko Israe ŋic nore mezi batarac‐jopacmurâ mukicko
ine no lama kanʒaŋ bâtâcnekicne ʒi padi qaqa tomao râekopac. Eme titikuczi lama kanʒaŋko foocmu â rârec rârec mâreŋ kereŋne fome ine gahac mumeŋ irec sâcko ʒiŋuc manapemu: Go jâmbomac nore mezi Israe ŋic batarac‐jopacmu.”
Eme iŋuc hâcne fuawec. Hae fureme Gideoŋ e faharerâ lama kanʒaŋ bâpisickerâ qâʒâkiriŋkeme titikuc opâne i râqâc moc fufusenere sâc ewec.
Iŋuc fuame Gideoŋzi Anutu âzâcnerâ muwec: “Kimbeŋgezi boc mi imacnuzejec. Ʒi sawa mac mupe taraoc. Lama kanʒaŋzi buc kereŋne fozejec â rârec rârec mâreŋ i ine titikuczi hefârezejec.”
Eme ŋafe ira Anutuzi mume iŋuc hâcne fuawec. Lama kanʒaŋ sawa kereŋne fowec â rârec rârec mâreŋ i ine titikuczi hefârewec.
Ehame Jeru‐Baali, Gideoŋ hâcne, e â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe furic uupictea faharerâ Haroda opâ ŋifecnao teuŋ âtembiŋ. Ehame Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋere teuŋzi faicpec More tiki heririŋ wâneŋko fowec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Gideoŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋicfâcge jaŋe guru sâkore noni Midiaŋ ŋic mejeŋicko rârâec‐jopanere sâc mi ekac. Jaŋe sahac‐jeŋic bafehuc ʒiŋuc munʒipiŋkohec: ‘Nâŋe nâŋâc sanaŋkembeŋ.’
Irec ʒiŋuc muhuc muromacketec hazec‐jeŋic sâc hufâreoc: ‘Hâhâwic ehuc ɋarac ɋarac qakaczi Gileade tikionec risierâ hae‐ticnao razejec.’” Eme 22 tauseŋ jaŋe risiehapie 10 tauseŋ jaŋe jumbiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi Gideoŋ mocwâc âzâcne muwec: “Ŋic jaŋe guru sâko jaha eŋgopieŋte jowac‐jopatec opâo hupie ira esâic‐jopazepac. Eme ŋic e me e gohec raocte mupe gohec raocmu, â ŋic e me e gohec mi raocte mupe gohec mi raocmu.”
Irec Gideoŋzi ŋic jowac‐jopame opâo humbiŋ. Eme Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Qâtozi eekac irec sâc daperâ opâ nâniŋmu jaŋe guru moc bacjopazemec. Â dieŋzi herâ opâ nâniŋmu jaŋe wâc sâc ijaha ejarezemec.”
Eme daperâ mezi fiahuc nâmbiŋ jaŋere ʒare 300 ewec. Â gâcne sâko jaŋe ine opâ nâniŋte dieŋzi hembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Wofuŋzi Gideoŋ âzâcnerâ muwec: “Opâ mezi fia nâc embieŋ jaŋehec juhuc batarac‐ŋopapemu, ehuc Midiaŋ ŋic gore meo râec‐jopapemu. Â gâcne sâko jaŋe ine hae‐jeŋic sâc ranʒepieŋ.”
Eme jaŋeraonec kuʒi â qeŋ i rombiŋ. Rohapie Gideoŋzi Israe ŋic gâcne sâko jaŋe hae‐jeŋic sâc sorec‐jopame rahapie ŋic 300 jaŋe ine sakarec‐jopawec. Eme Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋere teuŋzi juwicnao wâneŋko fowec.
Ŋafe ira Wofuŋzi Gideoŋ âzâcnerâ muwec: “Faharerâ teuŋ‐jeŋicko huc. No teuŋ i gore meo râekopac.
Eme teuŋko buc huzore hâwicgukacko ine kiŋaŋŋicge Purahec huzepirec.
Ehuc jaŋe weniŋuc muniŋmu i manazemec. Eme irec faicnao ine tâpirige fuame teuŋ râsi fisicnecmu.” Eme Gideoŋ e kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Purahec râsi fombiŋ teuŋ irec qaŋeŋnao hupic.
Ehame Midiaŋ ŋic, Amaleke ŋic â ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec ŋic gâcne jaŋe wâneŋko waŋgambec qokic iŋucne guru dindiŋ jâmbâŋ fombiŋ. Erâ kamelefâc‐jeŋic hâmbâŋ sâko jâmbâŋ wowosene tâmiric hâwec moŋgeŋ iŋucne fombiŋ wâc.
Eme Gideoŋ e fisirâ manahame ŋic moczi guŋ manawec i momori âgofâcne jazawec. Ehuc muwec: “Manaŋgopieŋ, no guŋ moc manapac ine gai huŋ hândâŋ bakicnezi heherâ waha Midiaŋ teuŋ‐nâŋecko raʒirâ qoruc boze wiac hetâtie rajec.”
Eme momori âgofâcne jaŋe fuŋne bâtikiecnehuc mumbiŋ: “I wiac moc aricne, i Israe ŋic moc ʒâŋene Gideoŋ, Joasi ŋokâ‐ticne ere ʒika. Anutuzi Midiaŋ â momori sasawa ere meo hâcne râec‐nâpojec.”
Eme Gideoŋ e guŋ â irec fuŋne mukicne i manarâ daŋge mumuteŋ ewec. Ehuc Israe ŋic jaŋere teuŋko risierâ muwec: “Fahareniŋ, Wofuŋ e Midiaŋ momori guru meŋeŋicko râec‐jopakac.”
Eme ŋic 300 jaŋe bâfâuc‐jopame guru jahec â moc embiŋ. Ehuc kuʒi tacne irec maŋnao waha râerâ qeŋhec mâmâc mejeŋic sâc râewec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Norao fipie wareoc, erâ epe irec sâc jaha enʒepieŋ. Teuŋ qaŋeŋnao fisirâ epemu irec sâc enʒepieŋ hâcne.
No â gurufâc‐nane nâŋe qeŋ qapene teuŋ ŋifec â ŋifec iŋuc jaha qeŋ qafârerâ ʒiŋuc muhuc owackenʒepieŋ: ‘Wofuŋ â Gideoŋ jahere biŋe.’”
Eme râsi jaŋe ŋafe ʒâʒâŋiŋte soŋaŋ guru moc âkendâŋ‐jopahapie Gideoŋ â ŋic 300 jaŋe teuŋ qaŋeŋnao fisimbiŋ. Erâ qeŋ qahuc kuʒi bajumbiŋ i qanʒaŋnembiŋ.
Erâ me qanazi waha bahuc kuʒi qanʒaŋnembiŋ â fâre‐jeŋiczi ine qeŋ qaniŋte bambiŋ. Ehuc owackerâ mumbiŋ: “Wofuŋ â Gideoŋ jahere ʒika!”
Jaŋe dodoma‐jeŋic sâc teuŋ orâŋke‐fârerâ domahapie râsi jaŋe owackehuc gasackerâ wisembiŋ.
Eme ŋic 300 jaŋe qeŋ qahapie Wofuŋzi râsi jaŋacne ʒika i bâtikieme momorifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere faio fewec. Ehame wiserâ raku Tabata mâreŋkopec Abe‐Mehola mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao Bete‐Sita â Zereda haeo fisimbiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic Naftali mâreŋkonec, Ase mâreŋkonec â Manase mâreŋkonec sasawa jaŋe hefârec‐jopapie Midiaŋ ŋic jopa jâpec ejarembiŋ.
Eme Gideoŋ e ʒiŋuc muhuc kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopame Eferaim tiki mâreŋ sâckerâ rambiŋ: “Midiaŋ ŋic râsi ejarehuc waha opâ forakac i âte bâzickepie raku Bete‐Bara haeo â Jordaŋ opâo mâmâc fisizejec.” Irec Eferaim ŋic hefârec‐jopapie jaŋe opâ sasawa i âte bâzickepie raku Bete‐Bara haeo â Jordaŋ opâo wâc fisiwec.
Eme jaŋe iŋuc ehuc Midiaŋ ŋic fekicne jahec‐jeŋic Orebe â Ʒebe rocjofambiŋ. Ehuc Orebe e Orebere qânâ ira qâhâmombiŋ â Ʒebe e ine Ʒebere waiŋ qaqa tomao ira qâhâmombiŋ. I Midiaŋ ŋic jopa jâpec ejarehuc iŋuc hâcne embiŋ. Ehuc Orebe â Ʒebe jahere qizec i Jordaŋ ŋifecnao Gideoŋtao bafisimbiŋ.
Ehuc Eferaim ŋic jaŋe Gideoŋ âzâcnerâ mumbiŋ: “Go Midiaŋ ŋic jopazo rameŋ dameŋ ira wemocte mi hefârec‐nâpomeŋ? Wemo mâsi enâremeŋ?” Iŋuc muhuc râsi sâko ecnembiŋ.
Epie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe wiac embiŋ i nore sâc jâurukac. Eferaimte waiŋ hândâŋ ro nusec ee izi Abieʒere waiŋ gie mi sirickekac me?
Anutu e Midiaŋ ŋic fekicne jahec‐jeŋic Orebe â Ʒebe meŋeŋicko râec‐jofawec, i ŋoŋe no siricnumbiŋ ekac.” E iŋuc mume jaŋe aaric manacnembiŋ i fâre wahawec.
Eme Gideoŋ â ŋic 300 jaŋe râsi jâpec‐jopa raku Jordaŋko fisirâ fotâcnehuc docke sâqorembiŋ.
Irec Gideoŋ e Sukoti ŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋic bâjâpecnuŋgopieŋ ʒi jaŋe nânâ gumec‐jopanʒepieŋ. Midiaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Ʒeba â Zalimuna jâpec‐jofaŋgopeneŋte dockeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme Sukoti haere ŋic fekicne jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Ʒeba â Zalimuna jahe biac rocjofamec irec nâŋe momorifâcge nânâ jarenaŋmu?”
Eme Gideoŋzi muwec: “Sâcne, Wofuŋzi Ʒeba â Zalimuna nore meo râec‐jofame no mâreŋ burocnaonec fâpâ â qiŋambuzi biuc‐ŋeŋic bâtâc qâtâcnepemu.”
Eme irecnec ine Penuele haeo ferâ ira iŋuc jaha jazawec. Eme Penuele ŋic jaŋe Sukoti ŋic jaŋe âzâcnembiŋ sâc ijaha bâtikiecnembiŋ.
Eme Gideoŋ e Penuele ŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No wamao risiehuc ficʒora ʒi heroc qâropiepemu.”
Eme Ʒeba â Zalimuna jahe ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec momorifâc‐jekic ʒika nâfocne 15 tauseŋ jaŋehec Karakora haeo jumbiŋ. Â momori 120 tauseŋ jaŋe ʒikao omaembiŋ.
Eme Gideoŋ e gurufâc‐ticne jaŋehec Noba â Jogobeha hae i ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec ŋehapire feraku momori jaŋerao fisimbiŋ. Momori guru i jaŋe wisembeneŋ muhuc rucgereŋ tâmiric jumbiŋ.
Ehame Midiaŋ ŋicwofuŋ Ʒeba â Zalimuna jahe wisepic. Wisepire jofa jâpec ejacte raku rocjofambiŋ. Iŋuc fuame momori guru tâpiri‐jeŋic ŋeŋgoroŋkewec.
Eme Joasi ŋokâ‐ticne Gideoŋ e ʒikaonec risierâ Heresi heâŋko wahawec.
Wahahuc Sukotinec ŋicmotec moc bâfuarâ ro basanaŋkewec. Ehuc Sukoti haere ŋic fekicne â micne jaŋere mu indiŋ ecneme ʒâŋe‐jeŋic 77 qâreŋkecnewec.
Ehame Gideoŋ e Sukoti ŋic jaŋerao fisirâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ʒeba â Zalimuna ʒi honec‐jofaniŋ. Ŋoŋe hâcne jahere ʒiŋuc muhuc pepec dâŋ nazambiŋ: ‘Ʒeba â Zalimuna biac rocjofamec me? Irec nâŋe ŋicfâcge dockeŋgopieŋ jaŋe nânâ gumec‐jopanaŋmu?’”
Eme Gideoŋ e hae irec micne rocjoparâ mâreŋ burocnaonec fâpâ â qiŋambu rorâ izi Sukoti ŋic bâtiŋ‐jopawec.
Erâ Penuele haeo ficʒora i heroc qâropierâ hae irec ŋic sâqezi qâhâmoc‐jopawec.
Gideoŋ e iŋuc erâ Ʒeba â Zalimuna jasarâ muwec: “Taboro haeo ŋic weniŋucne qâhâmoc‐jopapic?” Mume jahe bâtikiecnehuc mupic, “Jaŋe go iŋucne sasawa. Jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ mocte ŋokâfâc tinac.”
Mupire eki muwec: “Jaŋe ɋafâc‐nane; neŋgoc‐nanere ŋokâfâc. Ŋohe jaŋe mi qâhâmoc‐jopazapic muzac no wâc mi âke hâmoc‐ŋofazapo, i jâmbomac Wofuŋte maio mukopac.”
Iŋuc murâ mârâc ŋokâ‐ticne Jetera âzâcnerâ muwec: “Ajoc, âke hâmoc‐jofac.” Mume motec e mi soka tarawecte hâwickeme sâqe‐ticne mi unuckewec.
Iŋuc eme Ʒeba â Zalimuna jahe Gideoŋ âzâcnerâ mupic: “Ajoc, go gahac faharerâ nâfoc. Moc e ŋic ehuc tâpiri‐ticnehec eekac.” Iŋuc mupire Gideoŋ e faharerâ Ʒeba â Zalimuna âke hâmoc‐jofawec. Ehuc ʒuŋe wiac kamele‐jekicte upeo fowec i rowec.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Gideoŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Go Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋere meonec batarac‐nâpokicte go â ŋokâge erâ wâc ŋosage ŋoŋe nâŋe soŋaŋ‐nâponʒepieŋ.”
Mupie Gideoŋzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No â ŋokâ‐nane nâhe mi soŋaŋ‐ŋopanacmu. Wofuŋzi soŋaŋ‐ŋopaocmu.”
Erâ muwec: “Wiac mocte numu‐ŋarepe. Ŋoŋe sasawa hazec warawa rombiŋ i nareniŋ.” (Jaŋe Isimaere ɋâricfâc irec hazec warawa‐jeŋic i golzi bakicne bajumbiŋ.)
Iŋuc mume jaŋe âzâcnerâ mumbiŋ: “Nâŋe buafec jaha garenaŋmu.” Eme qoruc rumackerâ ŋic sasawa hazec warawa‐jeŋic rombiŋ i guruckepie fewec.
Eme hazec warawa irec ŋemâc i 1 tauseŋ 700 irec sâc ewec. Erâ wâc ʒuŋe â eri qoqonaŋ gacne, erâ kamele jaŋere upeo fofo qoruc i â Midiaŋ ŋicwofuŋ jahere ŋaqi bâbâroŋzi âmuc âmucne i wâc mâmâc guruckembiŋ.
Eme Gideoŋ e wiac izi taha bapa ŋaqi moc ɋâŋ wiachec barâ e jahacne hae Ofira ira râewec. Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe fisirâ araŋ bacnehuc dapecnembiŋ. Ehame wiac izi Gideoŋ â kikefuŋfâcne jaŋere bitiŋ ewec.
Â Israe ŋic jaŋe sanaŋkerâ Midiaŋ ŋic bawahac‐jopakupie tâpiri‐jeŋic omaewec. Eme mâreŋ ira Gideoŋte dameŋko wama fuarâ foha jara 40 tarawec.
Eme Joasi ŋokâ‐ticne Jeru‐Baali e hae‐ticnao risierâ ira jusanaŋkewec.
Gideoŋ e ŋonâŋfâc‐ticne bocjaha jucnembiŋte ŋokâfâc‐ticne 70 fuambiŋ.
Â ŋokac moc Sikem haeo jucnewec eki ŋokâ moc rocnewec. Eme ere ʒâŋe Abimelec muwec.
Eme Joasi ŋokâ‐ticne Gideoŋ e jara bocjaha jâmbâŋ bazurâ ŋicqizec jâmbâŋ ehuc hâmome Abieʒe guru jaŋere hae Ofira ira mamac‐ticne Joasire qânâ hawec gufukicne fowec ijaha duckembiŋ.
Gideoŋ hâmohame izia Israe ŋic jaŋe mocwâc risierâ Baali nemu jaŋerao qohotahuc Baali‐Beriti wofuŋ‐jeŋic âkendâŋnembiŋ.
Ehuc râsifâc‐jeŋic ŋifec â ŋifec jaŋere meonec batarac‐jopawec Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋic hâcne ere nikec‐jopawec.
Erâ Jeru‐Baali, Gideoŋ hâcne, eki Israe ŋic ehâmo‐jarewec irec okacne garikiŋfâc‐ticne bubiaŋ moc mi qajarembiŋ.
Eme Jeru‐Baali ŋokâ‐ticne Abimelec e Sikem haeo rarâ neŋgoc‐ticnere wiacfâc sasawa ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Ŋoŋe Sikem haere ŋic ŋokac sasawa ʒiŋuc muhuc jazaniŋ: ‘Jeru‐Baali ŋokâfâc‐ticne 70 jaŋe ʒeŋgoma soŋaŋ‐ŋopapie sâckeocmu me mocjahazi soŋaŋ‐ŋopame manapie sâckeocmu?’ Erâ ʒiŋuc i mana‐jâmbâŋkeniŋ: No ŋoŋere siec â biuc jaha.”
Iŋuc mume neŋgoc‐ticnere wiacfâc jaŋe dâŋ i sasawa ere okacne Sikem ŋic jaza‐fârembiŋ. Eme maŋjeŋiczi Abimelectao boc domame ʒiŋuc hâcne mumbiŋ: “E ɋanâŋec.”
Iŋuc murâ Baali‐Beriti ere ufuŋkonec siliwa moneŋ 70 rorâ râcnepie ŋic kosane pepechec bâtâc bajareme bâjâpembiŋ.
Iŋuc erâ mamac‐ticnere hae Ofira ira rarâ Jeru‐Baalire ŋokâfâc hahac ɋafâc‐ticne 70 jaŋe qânâ mocjahao qâhâmoc‐jopawec. Â Jeru‐Baali ʒâhec ŋokâ jâmbâŋ‐ticne Jotam e ine soŋkerâ juwecte hetirimbiŋ.
Eme Sikem haere ŋic ŋokac â Bete‐Milo haere ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Sikem haeo mâreŋ furu mukicne ira tumaŋne‐fârerâ Abimelec ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic âkendâŋnembiŋ.
Eme Jotam mufuacnepie manarâ ra Geriʒim tikitoŋko domahuc ʒiŋuc muhuc wirawec: “Sikem haeonec ŋic ŋoŋe dâŋnane mananiŋ, eme Anutuzi ŋoŋere dâŋ iŋuc jaha manaocmu.
Dameŋ mocko jâc jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic âkendâŋneniŋte tumaŋnembiŋ. Ehuc oliwa jâc ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: ‘Goki ŋicwofuŋ‐nâŋec juc.’
Mupie oliwa jâczi ʒiŋuc jazawec: ‘Wokemaŋ‐nanezi nemu â ŋic aŋac bâfua‐jareekac i hetararâ ra jâc gâcne fosâoc‐jopapemu me?’
Eme jâc sasawa jaŋe jâmbojâc âzâcnerâ mumbiŋ: ‘Ajoc, go faharerâ ŋicwofuŋ enârec.’
Mupie jâmbojâczi jazarâ muwec: ‘No aŋac â fâri‐nane hetararâ ra jâc gâcne fosâoc‐jopapemu me?’
Eme jâc sasawa jaŋe waiŋjâc âzâcnerâ mumbiŋ: ‘Ajoc, go faharerâ ŋicwofuŋ enârec.’
Iŋuc mupie waiŋjâczi ʒiŋuc jazawec: ‘Opâ‐nanezi nemu â ŋic maŋ baafec ejareekac i hetararâ ra jâc gâcne fosâoc‐jopapemu me?’
Iŋuc mume jâc sasawa jaŋe fâpâ âzâcnerâ mumbiŋ: ‘Ajoc, go faharerâ ŋicwofuŋ enârec.’
Mupie fâpâzi jâc sasawa ʒiŋuc jazawec: ‘Maŋurucko ŋicwofuŋ‐ŋeŋic âkendâŋnuŋgopieŋko ine ware nâkumuc‐naneo soŋkeniŋ. Iŋuc mi eniŋmuo ine fâpâonec ʒoc faharerâ Lebanoŋ mâreŋte jâmâzâc jâc ʒâseŋke‐fârezejec.’
“Eme ŋoŋe maŋtaniŋ â maŋbiaŋko Abimelec ŋicwofuŋ âkendâŋnembiŋ, ehuc Jeru‐Baali wiac ewec irec sâcko garikiŋfâc‐ticne ejarembiŋ me?
Mamac‐nane e ŋoŋere erâ ʒika qawec hâcne. Ehuc juju‐ticne qaisockerâ Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋere meonec batarac‐ŋopawec.
Ŋoŋe ine mamac‐nanere garikiŋfâc râsi ejareŋgopieŋ. Ehuc ŋokâfâc‐ticne 70 qânâ mocjahao qâhâmoc‐jopa‐fârembiŋ. Erâ kiŋaŋ naru‐ticnere ŋokâ Abimelelec e soctofa‐ŋeŋic, irec Sikem ŋic ŋokac ŋoŋe ŋicwofuŋ‐ŋeŋic âkendâŋnembiŋ.
Ŋoŋe maŋbiaŋko Jeru‐Baali araŋ bacnehuc garikiŋfâc‐ticne jaŋere manapie sâckeme iŋuc embiŋko ine Abimelecte manapie sâckeme ʒeri enʒepieŋ. Eme eki wâc ŋoŋere ʒeri ezejec.
Iŋuc mi embiŋko ine Abimelectaonec ʒoc fuarâ Sikem â Bete‐Milo haeonec ŋic ŋokac ʒâseŋ‐ŋopazejec. Erâ wâc Sikem â Bete‐Milo haeonec ŋic ŋokac ŋoŋeraonec ʒoc fuarâ Abimelec ʒâseŋkezejec.”
Jotam e iŋuc murâ wiserâ rawec. E hahac‐ticne Abimelecte hâwickeme rarâ Bere haeo soŋkerâ juwec.
Eme Abimelec e jara 3 Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ juwec.
Ehame Anutuzi mâro sâqocne moc Abimelec â Sikem haeonec ŋic ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko râewec. Eme eki bâfâuc‐jopame Sikem haeonec ŋic jaŋe Abimelec wiac hâhâwicne ecnembiŋ.
I Abimeleczi Jeru‐Baali ŋokâfâc‐ticne 70 sindaŋ ehuc jopawec, erâ hahac ɋafâcne jopaocte Sikem hae rune jaŋe dopeckembiŋ irec okacne fai‐jeŋicko feocte iŋuc fuawec.
Eme Sikem haeonec ŋic jaŋe ŋic gâcne Abimelecte ruc baniŋte tikitoŋko râec‐jopambiŋ. Eme jaŋe hata ira ŋic rac warec epie sâc ʒâpâ jopahuc mafa wiac‐jeŋic jowac rombiŋ. Iŋuc epie honec‐joparâ Abimelec âzâcnembiŋ.
Eme Ebede ŋokâ‐ticne Gali e ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋehec Sikem haeo raʒiwec. Iŋuc eme Sikem haeonec ŋic jaŋe ere manapie sâckewec.
Eme gie‐jeŋicko rarâ waiŋ hândâŋne rorâ âte pisickehuc tiwâ ʒepec bâmockembiŋ. Ehuc nemu‐jeŋicte ufuŋko raʒirâ nânâ â waiŋ i nâhuc Abimelec mu sopec ecnembiŋ.
Ehuc Ebede ŋokâ‐ticne Gali eki muwec: “Abimelec e mo â Sikem haeonec nâŋâc mo, irec e kiŋaŋ qacnenaŋmu? Jeru‐Baali ŋokâ‐ticne e â micne‐ticne Ʒebuli jahe Sikem haere micne bapa Hamoro ere ŋicfâc jaŋere kiŋaŋ qapic. Irec wemocte e kiŋaŋ qacnenaŋmu?
Ŋicguru ʒi nore meo junʒapiŋ muzac no Abimelec bârâriezapo. Ehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnezapo: ‘Momorifâcge rocjopatec ɋârâŋkepie fua tâcnec.’”
Hae irec guriŋ bapa Ʒebuli e Ebede ŋokâ‐ticne Gali ere dâŋ i manarâ mâretec aarickewec.
Eme Abimelectao kamierâ ʒiŋuc muhuc kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopawec: “Manakic, Ebede ŋokâ‐ticne Gali â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe Sikem haeo fisirâ ŋic maŋbâiŋ ejarekupie râsi egarezo mueŋgopieŋ.
Irec go â ŋicfâcge ŋoŋe faharerâ ŋafeoa ware gieo woŋec junʒepieŋ.
Eme hae fureme ʒoaŋ wefume izia faharerâ haeo wefunʒepieŋ. Ehame Gali â ŋicfâcne jaŋe ŋoŋehec ʒika qazo hufâpie hata fua‐ŋareocmu sâc jopanʒepieŋ.”
Eme Abimelec â ŋicfâcne jaŋe faharerâ ŋafeoa rarâ Sikem hae râsi fisicneniŋte guru jahec â jahec woŋec fombiŋ.
Fohapie Ebede ŋokâ‐ticne Gali e haeonec hurâ haesac motâcko domawec. Ehame Abimelec â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe somâ fombiŋkonec faharembiŋ.
Eme Galizi ŋic honec‐joparâ Ʒebuli ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Tikitoŋkonec ŋic wahaŋgopieŋ i honekic!” Mume Ʒebulizi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go tiki jaŋere mumuc honetec ŋic tinac eŋgopieŋ.”
Eme Galizi mocwâc muwec: “Honec, mâreŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋkonec ŋic wahaŋgopieŋ. Eme guru moc i furu mâreŋkonec warekac.”
Eme Ʒebulizi âzâcnerâ muwec: “Penaroŋ emeŋ irec fârine weni? Go ʒiŋuc mumeŋ: ‘Abimelec e mo, irec nâŋâc e kiŋaŋ qacnenaŋmu?’ Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne goki qaisoc‐jopameŋ. Hurâ jaŋehec ʒika qac.”
Iŋuc mume Gali e Sikem haeonec ŋic bânie‐jareme Abimelechec ʒika qambiŋ.
Eme Abimeleczi Gali jâpeme wisewec. Eme ŋic bocjaha ʒâpâ joparâ feraku haesac motâcko fisimbiŋ.
Iŋuc erâ Abimelec e Aruma haeo ra juwec. Eme Ʒebulizi Gali â ŋicfâc‐ticne jâpec‐jopame Sikem haeo mocwâc mi jumbiŋ.
Hae fureme ŋic jaŋe hurâ gieo rambiŋ. Rahapie ŋic gâcnezi Abimelec âzâcnembiŋ.
Eme e ŋic rocjoparâ bâtâc bacjopame guru jahec â moc epie gieo soŋkerâ woŋec fombiŋ. Fohuc honec‐jopahapie ŋic jaŋe haeonec wahapie faharerâ jopa qâhâmoc ejarembiŋ.
Ehame guru moc Abimelec e jahacnehec jumbiŋ jaŋe gasackerâ ra haesac motâcko domambiŋ. Eme guru jajahec jaŋe faharerâ gieo jumbiŋ i sasawa qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ ira Abimelec e hae i râsi sanaŋ rocnewec. Ehuc hae i rorâ irec maŋnao ŋic ŋokac jumbiŋ i jopa miziewec. Erâ hae i heroc qâropiekume sesuctac fuawec.
Eme Sikem haeo ficsanaŋ kâcɋene moc ŋewec irec ŋic ŋokac jaŋe biŋe i manarâ Eli‐Beriti nemure ufuŋ sanaŋko raʒimbiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Abimelec e ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: Sikem ficsanaŋte ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ufuŋ sanaŋko guru mocjaha qâzuckeŋgopieŋ.
Eme Abimelec â ŋicfâcne jaŋe Zalimoŋ tikio fembiŋ. Ehuc Abimeleczi râric moc rorâ ʒoc qâtâcneme feme dâtâckerâ hâpowec. Ehuc ŋicfâc‐ticne jazarâ muwec: “Wiac epe honeŋgopieŋ irec sâc bâruŋ jaha eniŋ.”
Eme ŋic sasawa jaŋe Abimelec bâjâpehuc ʒoc qâtâcnerâ ufuŋ sanaŋko guruckembiŋ. Ehuc ufuŋ i ŋic ŋokac maŋnao ŋehapie bupuonec ʒoczi turuŋkepie ʒawec. Iŋuc fuame Sikem ficsanaŋte ŋic ŋokac i tauseŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma hâmombiŋ wâc.
Eme Abimelec e Tebezi haeo rarâ somâckehuc hae i rowec.
Erâ hae ira ficsanaŋ moc ŋewec. Eme ira ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋe wiserâ raʒihuc motâc basanaŋkembiŋ. Erâ bupunao fembiŋ.
Eme Abimelec e ficsanaŋko fisirâ roocte ʒoɋac ehuc motâcko fisirâ ʒoczi rikezo ewec.
Ehame ŋokac moczi faicnec poroŋ fofonʒaŋ qânâ moc rorâ sârockeme waharâ Abimelec utu‐ticne henʒaŋnewec.
Eme e maruku babaju‐ticne ŋicmotec e ʒocnehec wiracnehuc muwec: “Ʒikage unuckerâ qâhâmocnuc. Ŋic jaŋe ʒiŋuc munʒipiŋkohec: ‘Ŋokac moczi qâhâmowec.’” Mume ŋicmotec‐ticnezi âke hâmowec.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Abimelec hâmome honerâ hae‐jeŋic sâc rafârembiŋ.
Abimelec e hahac ɋafâc‐ticne 70 jopahuc mamac‐ticnere guruo kiŋsâko bâfuawec irec okacne Anutuzi iŋucko hâcne bazucnewec.
Erâ Anutu e Sikem ŋic jaŋere bâbâsifuc i bâtikieme jaŋacnao risie‐fârewec. Ehame Jeru‐Baali ŋokâ‐ticne Jotam ere sâweczi jaŋerao fâri fideteŋnehec ewec.
Abimelecte faicnao Dodo ŋosa‐ticne Tola, Puare ŋokâ hâcne, e Israe ŋic ŋezic‐jopaocte fua tâcnewec. Ŋic e Isasa guruonec. E Eferaim tiki mâreŋko Samiri haeo juwec.
Ehuc jara 23 Israe ŋic jaŋerao mumutara gie bahuc juwec. Juku hâmome Samiri haeo duckembiŋ.
Eme ere faicnao Gileade ŋic Jairizi fua tâcnerâ jara 22 Israe ŋic jaŋerao mumutara gie bawec.
Eme ere ŋokâfâc 30 jumbiŋ, jaŋe doŋgifâc‐jeŋic 30 jaha jaŋere faio rac warec ehuc jumbiŋ. Erâ wâc hae‐jeŋic i 30 jaha Gileade mâreŋko ŋerawec irec ʒâŋe Jairire hae mumbiŋ i ʒiŋuczia fokac jaha.
Eme Jairi e hâmome Kamoŋ haeo duckembiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Anuture maio wiac mamakâcne mocwâc embiŋ. Ehuc Siria â Sidoŋ erâ Moabi â Amoŋ â Filisa jaŋere nemu Baali â Asitaroto kiŋaŋ qajarembiŋ. Iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ mi qacnehuc râpeckembiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ e kimbeŋ‐ticne fahareme Filisa ŋic â Amoŋŋic jaŋere meo râec‐jopawec.
Iŋuc eme jaŋe jara ira Israe ŋic fific guguriŋ ejarehuc bâuruŋ‐jopambiŋ. Ehuc Israe ŋic Jordaŋ ocniŋucnao Amori ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ, Gileade hâcne ira jumbiŋ, i jaŋe jara 18 fific bacjopambiŋ.
Eme Amoŋŋic jaŋe Judare guru â Benjamiŋte guru â Eferaimte guru Jordaŋ ʒiŋucnao jumbiŋ i jaŋe jopaniŋte Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ raʒimbiŋ. Iŋuc ejarepie Israe ŋic jaŋe fific guguriŋ faio jujâmbâŋkembiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc Wofuŋ kio wâwâsic ecnembiŋ: “Nâŋe Baali kiŋaŋ qajarehuc Anutu‐nâŋec go râpecgurâ sâqocne bahuc bugao bambeŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic jazarâ muwec: “No Aigita ŋic, Amori ŋic, Amoŋŋic â Filisa ŋic jaŋeraonec mi batarac‐ŋopapo me?
Erâ wâc Sidoŋŋic, Amaleke ŋic â Maoŋŋic jaŋe fific bacŋopambiŋ. Eme no kio wâwâsic enarepie jaŋere meonec batarac‐ŋopapo.
Ehame ŋoŋe sifu no râpecnurâ nemu kiŋaŋ qajarembiŋ. Irec no mocwâc mi batarac‐ŋopapemu.
Ŋoŋe rarâ nemu hone wosâc ejarembiŋ jaŋerao kio wâwâsic eniŋ. Eme jaŋe fific guguriŋ dameŋ‐ŋeŋicko batarac‐ŋopanʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Nâŋe sâqocne bambeŋte go gahac manakic sâc enârec. Mocjaha, ʒiŋuc numu‐gareŋgopeneŋ: Dameŋ ʒi batarac‐nâpoc.”
Iŋuc murâ nemu jabane i behec‐jopa‐fârerâ Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnembiŋ. Iŋuc epie Wofuŋ e Israe ŋic jaŋerao ʒârâ hâriŋ fowec irec busâqoc mana‐jarewec.
Iŋuc fuame Amoŋŋic jaŋe roroc efârerâ Gileade mâreŋko teuŋ âtembiŋ. Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha tumaŋne‐fârerâ Mizipa wâneŋko teuŋ âtembiŋ.
Ehuc Israe ŋic, Gileade mâreŋte micne bapa jaŋe jaŋaczia wiwioc erâ mumbiŋ: “Mo ŋiczi Amoŋŋic jaŋehec ʒika fuŋkeocmu? Eme ŋic eki hâcne Gileade mâreŋte ŋecjucfâc nâŋâcne micne juzejec.”
Gileade ŋic Jefita e momori wânʒâŋ juwec. Jefita neŋgoc‐ticne e sasec ŋokac moc â mamac‐ticne ine Gileade.
Eme Gileade ŋonâŋ‐ticne e ŋokâfâc‐ticne gâcne rocjopawec wâc. Eme ŋonâŋ jâmbâŋ‐ticnere ŋokâfâc jaŋe sokahuc Jefita bâsuembiŋ. Ehuc âzâcnerâ mumbiŋ: “Go ŋokac mocte ŋokâ, irec mamac‐nâŋecte mafa wiac i goki ro rauc moc mi ezemec.”
Iŋuc mupie Jefita e wiserâ ra Tobe mâreŋko juwec. Ehame ŋic kosane jaŋe erao tumaŋnerâ juhuc ra ŋic gâcne râsi ejarehuc jumbiŋ.
Eme dameŋ mocko Amoŋŋic jaŋe Israe ŋic jaŋehec ʒika qambiŋ.
Ʒika fuŋkerâ qahapie Gileade guru jaŋere soŋaŋfâc jaŋe Jefita jowaniŋte Tobe mâreŋko rambiŋ.
Ra fisirâ Jefita ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Fârâ micne banâretec Amoŋŋic jopanʒepeneŋ.”
Mupie Jefitazi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe nore takic‐ŋopame mamac‐nanere fickonec jâpecnumbiŋ. Ʒi ine sipirickezo ehuc wemocte norao wareŋgopieŋ?”
Mume Gileade guru jaŋere soŋaŋfâc jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Irec hâcne nâŋehec rarâ Amoŋŋic jaŋehec ʒika qahuc Gileade mâreŋte ŋecjucfâc nâŋere micne jucmurâ jowacguzo wareŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme Jefitazi Gileade guru jaŋere soŋaŋfâc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe Amoŋŋic jaŋehec ʒika qapemurâ mocwâc bârisiecnupie Wofuŋzi nore meo râec‐jopaocmuo ine micne‐ŋeŋic jupemu.”
Iŋuc mume Gileade guru jaŋere soŋaŋfâc jaŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Wofuŋzi dâŋnâŋec soŋaŋkeha go mukomec iŋuc ejâmbâŋkenaŋmu.”
Iŋuc mupie Jefita e Gileade guru jaŋere soŋaŋfâc jaŋehec rambiŋ. Rapie ŋic jaŋe micne bapa‐jeŋic âkendâŋnembiŋ. Eme Jefita e Mizipa wâneŋko dâŋticne sasawa Wofuŋte maio râe‐fârewec.
Iŋuc erâ Jefita e Amoŋŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋtao kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopahuc muwec: “Go nore weniŋuc muhuc mâreŋ‐naneo ʒika qazore warekomec?”
Mume Amoŋŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ e Jefita kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere dâŋ bâtikie‐jarehuc muwec: “Israe ŋic jaŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec wefuhuc Aronoŋ opâonec raku Jaboko opâo fisirâ raku Jordaŋ opâo fisikac mâreŋ i nowac rombiŋ. Irec miŋecgac ine wamaoa bârisie‐narezo.”
Eme Jefita e Amoŋŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋtao kiŋaŋ mocwâc sorec‐jopawec.
Ehuc âzâcnerâ muwec: “Jefita e kecʒiŋuc mukac: Israe ŋic jaŋe Moabi mâreŋ me Amoŋŋic jaŋere mâreŋ i mi jowac rombiŋ.
Jaŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec wefumbiŋ dameŋ ira mâreŋ burocnao rahuc Hâwec Bâbâroŋko fisirâ Kadesi haeo fisimbiŋ.
Fisirâ Edom ŋicwofuŋtao kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopahuc kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: ‘Nâŋe gore mâreŋko fotâcnezo muŋgopeneŋ, irec sifu mac mana‐nârec.’ Edom ŋicwofuŋ e ine mi mana‐jarewec. Ehame Moabi ŋicwofuŋtao iŋuc jaha dâŋ râepie rawec. Eme e wâc iŋuc jaha mi mana‐jarewec. Iŋuc eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Kadesi haeoa jumbiŋ.
Juku mâreŋ burocne fotâcnerâ Edom â Moabi mâreŋ bârârec‐jofahuc Moabi ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec fisimbiŋ. Ehuc Aronoŋ opâ ŋifecnao teuŋ âtembiŋ. Aronoŋ opâzi Moabi mâreŋte ma ewecte jaŋe Moabi mâreŋko mi raʒimbiŋ.
Erâ Israe ŋic jaŋe Amori ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ, Hesiboŋ ŋicwofuŋ hâcne, erao kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopambiŋ. Ehuc âzâcnerâ mumbiŋ: ‘Nâŋe mâreŋgao fotâcnerâ mâreŋ‐nâŋecko fisinaŋte mana‐nârecmurâ muŋgopeneŋ.’
Eme Sihoŋ e Israe ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ‐ticnao fotâcnezore mupie maŋjahec ejarewec. Irec Sihoŋ e ŋicfâcticne hetumaŋ‐joparâ Jahazi haeo teuŋ âterâ fohuc Israe ŋic jaŋehec qaqac embiŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋ Anutuzi Sihoŋ â ŋicfâc‐ticne Israe ŋic jaŋere meo râec‐jopame sanaŋke‐jarembiŋ. Sanaŋkerâ Amori ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ sasawa i ro rauc embiŋ.
Ehuc Amori ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ Aronoŋ opâonec raku Jaboko opâo fisikac, erâ mâreŋ burocnaonec raku Jordaŋ opâo fisikac i ro rauc efârembiŋ.
Ehuc Jefitazi Sihoŋ âzâcnewec: Israere Wofuŋ Anutuzi ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere erâ Amori ŋic mâreŋ jowac rowec i goki mocwâc rozo mukic me?
Go nemuge Kemosizi wiac tahacguwec i sawa mi rauckenʒaŋ? Eme nâŋe wiac sasawa rauckenaŋte Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi nâre tahac ewec i nâŋere biŋe eocmu.
Go Ziporo ŋokâ‐ticne Balake, Moabi jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ, e sirickekomec me? E Isare ŋic jaŋe râsi ejarehuc ʒika moc qawec me?
