Iŋuc mume Dawidizi Itai ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wiac eme bâniec.” Iŋuc âzâcneme Gatiŋic Itai e ŋicfâcne â ŋokac naru motecfâc‐jeŋic mâmâc jumbiŋ jaŋe rocjopame bâniembiŋ.
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe rahuc kiopie hae mâreŋ i sâcke‐fârerâ heumaŋkehuc fowec. Ehame ŋic ŋokac jaŋe fotâcnerâ mâreŋ burocnaopec rahapie ŋicwofuŋ e ʒâhec Kidoroŋ opâ fotâcnewec.
Ehame taha bapa Abiata â Zadoko jahe wâc iŋuc jaha Lewi guru gâcne jaŋehec Anuture ʒâʒâfic katapa reŋkerâ fisimbiŋ. Erâ Anuture katapa i hepie ŋeme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe haeonec hurâ rafârembiŋ.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi Zadoko âzâcnerâ muwec, “Anuture katapa i mocwâc haeo bârisieniŋ. Wofuŋ e nore maname sâckekacko mocwâc bârisiecnume katapa ʒi â ŋeŋe juju‐ticne honezepac.
Me nore ʒiŋuc muocmu: ‘No gore manape mi sâckekac,’ iŋuc mume ʒiŋuc âzâcnepemu: No ʒi hâcne, irec manakomec sâc enarezemec.”
Erâ ŋicwofuŋzi taha bapa Zadoko ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ âzâcnewec: “Go â Abiata ŋohe ŋokâ jahec‐ŋekic Ahimazi â Jonataŋ rocjofapire wamao haeo risieniŋ.
Erâ mi nikecguoc, no mâreŋ burocnao opâ moŋgeŋko ira ŋoŋeraonec dâŋ iŋuc me iŋuc fisime manapemurâ woŋec jupemu.”
Iŋuc mume Zadoko â Abiata jahe Anuture katapa reŋkerâ Jerusalem haeo risierâ ira jupic.
Ehame Dawidi e qizec‐ticne foŋkerâ kikehuhu tâmiric Oliwa tikio kio kio ferawec, eme ehec rambiŋ ŋic ŋokac i jaŋe iŋuc jaha qizec‐jeŋic foŋkerâ kio kio ferambiŋ.
Ehame gâcne jaŋe Dawidi ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ahitofe e Abisalomhec kamierâ râsi roroc eŋgopieŋ jaŋere guruo jukac.” Iŋuc âzâcnepie Dawidizi ʒiŋuc muhuc numuwec: “O Wofuŋ, go Ahitofere mumutâc i bâtikietec mutucne ezejec.”
Eme Dawidi e feraku tiki botâŋnao, Anutu numucne jumbieŋ toma ira fisihame Areki ŋic Husai e ŋaqi qoruc‐ticne bâsuckekicnezi qizec‐ticnao rufe ruarâ fisi bâfuawec.
Eme Dawidizi âzâcnewec, “Go nohec ratec norao ŋemâckeocmu.
Irec go haeo risierâ Abisalom ʒiŋuc âzâcnec: ‘O ŋicwofuŋ, no juwicnao mamacgere kiŋaŋ qaqa jupo irec sâc miŋecgac gore kiŋaŋ qaqa juzepac.’ Go iŋuc ehuc ine Ahitofere mumutâc i sâcne bawahacmu.
Taha bapa Zadoko â Abiata jahe ijaha junicmu. Eme go ŋicwofuŋte ficko juhuc dâŋ i me i manacmu sâc taha bapa Zadoko â Abiata jahe jasazemec.
Erâ jahere ŋokâ jahec, Zadokore ŋokâ Ahimazi â Abiatare ŋokâ Jonataŋ, jahe ijaha wâc junicmu. Eme go dâŋ i me i manacmu sâc jaŋe hâcne jazatec nazanʒepieŋ.”
Eme Abisalom e Jerusalem haeo fisiwec dameŋ ijaha Dawidire âgo Husaizi haeo risiewec.
Eme Dawidi e tiki botâŋko fisirâ piticne rahame Mefibose kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Zibazi doŋgi jajahec rocjofarâ fisi bâfuawec. Doŋgi jahere faio ine wiac kecʒiŋuc râekicne fowec: Poroŋ 200 â waiŋ hândâŋ kereŋne 100 â ʒoaŋ dameŋte jâchândâŋ 100 jaha erâ waiŋ ʒopo moc.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi Ziba wiocnerâ muwec, “Go wemocte wiac ʒi bawarekomec?” Wiocneme Zibazi muwec, “Doŋgi jajahec ʒi ŋicwofuŋ gore wiacfâc jaŋe fai‐jekicko ŋerâ raniŋte bacjofa warekopac, erâ ʒoaŋ dameŋte jâchândâŋ â poroŋ ʒi ine ŋic motec jaŋe nâniŋte â waiŋ ʒopo ʒi ine mâreŋ burocnao juhuc opâre hâmorâ nâniŋte bawarekopac.”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋzi wiocnewec, “Eme bomboŋgere ŋokâ e wena?” Wiocneme Zibazi muwec, “E ʒiŋuc muhuc Jerusalem haeoa ŋekac: ‘Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe miŋecgac mamac‐nanere uucmaŋ mocwâc bârisie‐nareniŋmu hâcne.’”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋzi Ziba ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, Mefibosere wiac sasawa i gore ekac.” Iŋuc mume Zibazi muwec, “Ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, no dape‐garekopacte mana‐naretec sâckehuc juzejec.”
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Dawidi e Bahurim haeo fisihame Saulore garikiŋfâc jaŋeraonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Simei eki fisi bâfuawec. E Gerare ŋokâ. E ware warehuc ʒuʒuhuc jaha mu surec ejarewec.
Erâ qânâ rorâ ŋicwofuŋ Dawidi â kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne jaŋe wicke‐jarewec. Ehame ŋic ŋokac â ŋic qac momori jaŋe orâŋ bârâŋ ecnembiŋ.
Eme Simei e mu surec ecnehuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋic sâqocne, soc hohoŋke ŋic, go wisec, wise tâmirec.
Saulo kikefuŋfâcne jaŋere ŋeŋetacko ŋicwofuŋ erâ jukicte jaŋere socte kiŋ i Wofuŋzi gorao batarakac. Ehuc uucmaŋ i gowac rorâ ŋokâge Abisalom râcnekac. Honekic, soc hohoŋke ŋic go, go gahacne hehesic izia ŋerisie‐garekac.”
Iŋuc eme Zeruja ŋokâ‐ticne Abisaizi ŋicwofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Qâto korehec keci e wemocte ŋicwofuŋ‐nane go iŋuc jâmbâŋ mu surec egarekac? No rarâ upene qâtâcnepemu.”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋzi muwec, “Wiac izi Zeruja ŋokâfâcne ŋoŋere biŋe mi ekac. E sâwec dâŋ mukac i Wofuŋzi ‘Dawidi sâweckec’ iŋuc âzâcneme ekacko mozi ʒiŋuc wiocneocmu: ‘Go wemocte iŋuc ekomec?’”
Iŋuc murâ Dawidi e Abisai â kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne sasawa ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Manaŋgopieŋ, no nahacne ŋokâ jâmbâŋzi nuocte ehame mozi Benjamiŋ ŋic keci ere maname sâqoreocmu. Ŋoŋe behehapie mu surec enareoc. E Wofuŋzi iŋuc eocte mucneme ekac hâcne.
Wofuŋ e busâqoc‐nane honerâ mu surec enareŋgopieŋ irec okacne wiac biaŋne bâtikie‐nareocmu mecne.”
Dawidi e iŋuc jazahuc ŋicfâcne jaŋehec hatao rahapie Simei e ŋifecnao tapio rahuc mu surec ecnerâ qânâ wicke‐jarehuc rufe tie‐jarewec.
Iŋuc ejareme ŋicwofuŋ â ŋicfâcne jaŋe docke sâqorehuc raku Jordaŋ opâo fisirâ opâ nâ ruac embiŋ.
Eme Abisalom e Ahitofe â Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋehec Jerusalem haeo fisimbiŋ.
Eme Dawidi âgo‐ticne Areki ŋic Husai e Abisalomtao fisirâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋicwofuŋ, go juraʒihuc juzemec! Ŋicwofuŋ go juraʒihuc juzemec!”
Iŋuc mume Abisalomzi Husai ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Hâc, go iŋuc ehuc âgoge araŋ bacneekic me? Go wemocte âgogehec mi rameŋ?”
E iŋuc âzâcneme Husaizi muwec, “Mâcne, Wofuŋ â ŋic ʒi, erâ Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋe go hâcne bâwosâecgumbiŋ irec gorao qohotarâ gohec juhuc jupemu sanaŋ.
No ŋic i me i mâcne, Dawidi ŋokâ‐ticne go sawa kiŋaŋ qagarepemu. No mamacge kiŋaŋ qacnehuc jupo irec sâc jaha gore kiŋaŋ qahuc jupemu hâcne.”
Eme Abisalomzi Ahitofe âzâcnerâ muwec, “Weniŋuc jaha enaŋmu i goki muc.”
Iŋuc mume Ahitofezi Abisalom ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go mamacgezi ŋokac mamare rocjopawec erâ fic soŋaŋkeniŋte behec‐joparâ rawec i jaŋerao rarâ jaŋehec foc. Iŋuc etec Israe ŋic jaŋe go gahac mamacge wiac repicne ecnekic i mana‐fârenʒepieŋ. Ehame go gahacnehec juŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋere tâpiri faharezejec.”
Iŋuc mume Abisalomte qoruc boze moc ficbupuo fârembiŋ. Eme Abisalomzi Israe ŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe faio mamac‐ticnezi ŋokac mamare rocjopawec i jaŋehec fowec.
Dameŋ ira ŋic jaŋe Ahitofe mumutâc dâŋticnere manapie Anuture mumutâc dâŋ irec sâc jaha ewec; eme irec hâcne Dawidi â Abisalom jahe wâc mumutâc dâŋticne sâsepire fewec.
Eme Ahitofezi Abisalom ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mana‐naretec no ŋic 12 tauseŋ bâwosâec‐joparâ miŋecgac ŋafeoa Dawidi jâperâ razepac.
E tâpiri‐ticne omaeme betaŋkerâ ŋeha ututuŋ jaha fisicnerâ maŋ bâsifuc ecnezepac. Iŋuc epe ehec juŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe wiseniŋmu. Jaŋe wisehapie no ŋicwofuŋ sawa qapemu.
Iŋuc ehuc ŋokac biŋe moc bârisiepie ŋowe‐ticnerao fisieekac iŋuc tinac ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋe gorao mocwâc bârisiec‐jopapemu. Go ŋic mocjaha sawa qâhâmocmurâ maŋkehuc jukic hâcne. Irec gâcne sâko jaŋe sahac furu junʒepieŋ.”
Eme dâŋ i Abisalom â Israe soŋaŋ jaŋe manapie sâckewec.
Eme Abisalomzi muwec, “Areki ŋic Husai e hefârepene eki weniŋuc muocmu i wâc mananʒepeneŋ.”
Eme Husai hefârepie Abisalomtao fisime Ahitofezi dâŋ sasawa muwec i âzâcne‐fârerâ ʒiŋuc wiocnewec: “Nâŋâc Ahitofezi dâŋ mukac irec sâcne enaŋmu me? Me mi sâckeme ine goki dâŋ moc manasukicko muc.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Husai e Abisalom dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Ahitofezi miŋecgac dâŋ mujec i dâŋ biaŋne aricne.”
Iŋuc murâ ʒuhuckerâ muwec, “Mamacge â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe tai tâpiri sâkohec i manakic. Qowi moc ʒâŋene bea e kâteo juhame motec jâoc ropie momori wânʒâŋ eekac iŋucnezi juŋgopieŋ. Erâ wâc mamacge e ʒika qaqa saric. E ŋafe ʒi ŋic ŋokac guru sâko jaŋehec mi foocmu ekac.
E ʒoaŋ ʒi nombâŋko me mâreŋ ŋondeŋ mocko soŋkerâ jukac. Eme ŋicfâcge jaŋeraonec gâcne jopapie ŋic jaŋe biŋe manarâ ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Abisalomte qâjâpecfâc jaŋerao sisipiric hâhâwicne fuawec.’
Iŋuc mupie ŋic momori wânʒâŋ jâmbâŋ, maŋjeŋic laioŋte maŋ iŋucne jaŋe biŋe manarâ hâwic‐jopa sâqoreocmu. Israe ŋic jaŋe ʒeŋgoma mamacgere manapie ŋic tâpiri sâkohec eekac â ehec juŋgopieŋ jaŋere manapie ŋic momori wânʒâŋ juŋgopieŋ eekac wâc.
Irec no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Israe ŋic sasawa Daŋ mâreŋkonec raku Bere‐Seba haeo mickekac mâreŋ ŋondeŋ ira juŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒare‐jeŋic hâwecmecko moŋgeŋ fokac iŋucnezi gorao tumaŋne‐fârenʒepieŋ. Eme go gahac bânietec ʒikao ranʒepeneŋ.
Ehuc, maniŋ titikuczi fânâŋ tâmiric waha mâreŋko heekac iŋuc tinac mâreŋ ŋondeŋ jukacko fisi fuacnenʒepeneŋ. Iŋuc epene e jahacne mecne â ŋicfâcne mecne jaŋeraonec moczi moc mi juocmu.
Me wiserâ hae mocko raʒiocmuo ine Israe ŋic jaŋe ʒeŋgoma hae ira repa bafisipie nâŋâc hae i repazi orâŋkehuc fârepene tâtierâ wâcko hufârezejec.”
Iŋuc mume Abisalom â Israe ŋic jaŋe manarâ mumbiŋ: “Areki ŋic Husai ere maŋfânâŋzi Ahitofere maŋfânâŋ sirickekac.” Ahitofere maŋfânâŋ biaŋne i Wofuŋzi bâtikierâ Abisalom wiac hâhâwicne bâfuacneocte hatane bawec hâcne.
Erâ Husaizi taha bapa Zadoko â Abiata jahe ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ahitofe e Abisalom â Israe soŋaŋ dâŋ iŋuc â iŋuc mutâcne‐jarejec. Â noni ine iŋuc mutâcne‐jarepac.
Irec ŋohe biac jâmbâŋ Dawidirao kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopapire rarâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcneniŋ: ‘Ŋicwofuŋ go gahacne â ŋicfâcge ŋoŋerao wiac hâhâwicne fuazacte, ŋoŋe miŋecgac ŋafeo mâreŋ burocnere opâ moŋgeŋko mi fohuc Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ ŋifec raʒiniŋ.’”
Eme Jonataŋ â Ahimazi jahe Enerogele haeo jupic. Jahe Jerusalem haeo raʒipire honec‐jofanʒipiŋte kiŋaŋ naru moczi dâŋ manawec sâc binaŋ bajactehuc juwec. Eme jahe ra ŋicwofuŋ Dawidi âzâcne jupirec.
Iŋuc ehuc juhapire ŋicmotec moczi bâfuac‐jofarâ ra Abisalom mufuacnewec. Eme irec jahe bâruŋ jaha wiserâ raku Bahurim haeo ŋic mocte ficko fisirâ hae ʒoŋa‐ticnao opâ nombâŋ ŋewec ira hurâ soŋkepic.
Ehame fic rune ere ŋonâŋzi opâ nombâŋ tapane rorâ ɋorockewec, ehuc fainao hândâŋ wiac gâcne râe bâkereŋ ewec. E ŋic jahec iŋuc ejactewec i mozi moc mana tarazac.
Ehame Abisalomte kiŋaŋ qaqafâc jaŋe ficko fisirâ ŋokac wiocnehuc mumbiŋ, “Ahimazi â Jonataŋ jahe wena?” Wiocnepie ŋokaczi micke‐jarehuc muwec, “Jahe opâ ocniŋucnao raʒipirec.” Iŋuc jazame jaŋe basac‐jofa‐bipieku beherâ Jerusalem haeo risiembiŋ.
Jaŋe rahapie ŋic jahe opâ nombâŋkonec wefurâ ra ŋicwofuŋ Dawidi dâŋ binaŋ ecnepic. Ehuc ʒiŋuc mupic: “Ŋoŋe picpac jaha faharerâ opâ ocniŋucnao raʒiniŋ. Ahitofe e râsi fisi‐ŋareocte dâŋ iŋuc â iŋuc mutâc bâtâc ejec.”
Iŋuc âzâcnepire Dawidi â ŋicfâcne jaŋe faharerâ Jordaŋ opâ fotâcne‐fârembiŋ. Irec hae fureha ŋic moczi moc Jordaŋ opâ ŋifecnao mocwâc mi juwec.
Â Ahitofe e ine mumutâc‐ticne fârimâc ewec i honerâ doŋgi‐ticne sate hecnerâ fe ŋehuc hae mâreŋ‐ticnao rawec. Erâ ficticnao wiac sasawa qâzucke‐fârerâ izia bituawec. Bituame mamac‐ticnere ʒâŋeruŋ gufukicnao duckembiŋ.
Eme Dawidi e Mahanaim haeo fisiwec. Ehame Abisalom e Israe ŋic jaŋehec Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnembiŋ.
Ehuc Joabere okacne momori jaŋere micne Amasa âkendâŋnewec. Amasa e Isimae ŋic moc ʒâŋene Itara ere ŋokâ. Itara e ine Nahasi ere otâ Abigali, Joabere neŋgoc Zeruja ere qo rowec.
Eme Abisalom â Israe ŋic jaŋe Gileade mâreŋko teuŋ âterâ fombiŋ.
Ehame Dawidi e Mahanaim haeo fisihame Raba haeonec Amoŋŋic moc ʒâŋene Nahasi ere ŋokâ Sobi â Lodeba haeonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Amiele ere ŋokâ Makiri, erâ Rogelim haeonec Gileade ŋic moc ʒâŋene Bariʒilai
jaŋe Dawidi â ŋicfâcne jaŋere wiac ʒiŋuc bâmockerâ bafisi jarembiŋ: Fofo, râqâc, hapec kuʒi, padi bâbâroŋ â ɋaɋacne, poroŋ uucne, jâchândâŋ ʒegoc ʒakicne, jacgoŋ â basac,
erâ baŋac â bulimakao susu wokemaŋ â lama bulimakao. I ʒiŋuc muhuctecne iŋuc embiŋ: “Ŋic ŋokac jaŋe mâreŋ sawao juhuc nânâ opâre hâmo betaŋ eŋgopieŋ.”
Eme Dawidi e jahacnehec jumbiŋ ŋic i jaŋe biric‐joparâ momori guru i tauseŋ jaŋere micne â 100 jaŋere micne iŋuc âkendâŋ‐jopawec.
Iŋuc erâ momori guru bâfâuckeme guru jahec â moc ewec: Guru moc i Joabezi micne bajareocte mucnewec â moc i Joabe ɋaticne Zerujare ŋokâ Abisairao râec‐jopawec erâ guru moc i ine Gatiŋic Itai erao râec‐jopawec. Iŋuc ejare‐fârerâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No nahacne wâc mâmâc ranaŋmu.”
E iŋuc mume ŋic jaŋe heckecnehuc mumbiŋ, “Go nâŋehec mi razemec. Juku nâŋe wise wiac moc epene jaŋe nâŋere boc mi manasuniŋmu. Me nâŋeraonec nâfocnezi hâmopie irec wâc boc mi muniŋmu. Goki ine ŋic 10 tauseŋ nâŋere sâc ehuc boc siric‐nâpokic. Irec go haeoa juhuc bafic‐nâpotec sâckezac.”
Iŋuc mupie ŋicwofuŋ e dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarewec: “Ŋoŋe manapie sâckekac irec sâcko epemu.” Iŋuc jazame momori gurune gurune 100 â 1 tauseŋ jaŋe asasai âtehuc hurâ rahapie ŋicwofuŋ e haesac motâc ŋifecnao domawec.
Ehuc Joabe â Abisai â Itai ʒiŋuc jaza qâmoc ewec: “Motec wârâŋ‐nane Abisalom e nore erâ wiac aijakic jaha ecnenʒepieŋ.” Ŋicwofuŋzi micne jaŋe Abisalomte dâŋ jaza qâmoc ewec i ŋic jaŋe mana‐fârembiŋ.
Ehuc momori guru jaŋe Israe ŋic jaŋehec qaqac eniŋte hurâ rambiŋ. Erâ Eferaim mâreŋte jâckâteo ira ʒika qambiŋ.
Ehuc Dawidire ŋicfâc jaŋe Israe ŋic bawahac‐jopambiŋ. Erâ ʒoaŋ ira ŋic afecne mâcne, 20 tauseŋ hâmocne jopambiŋ.
Erâ ʒikazi mâreŋ i sâcke‐fârewec. Eme ʒoaŋ ira ŋiczi jâckâteo sifuckembiŋ i ʒikazi jopambiŋ irec sâc sirickewec.
Eme Abisalom e Dawidire ŋicfâc bâfuac‐jopawec. Erâ doŋgi‐ticnere faio rahame doŋgizi boriŋjâc sâko moc irec tieŋne guruhec ira rurumaŋkehame jâc tieŋnezi qizec gerenao rorâ basanaŋkeme sawao kuraeŋ qahuc domaha doŋgizi fofotâc jaha rawec.
Ehame Dawidi ŋicfâcne jaŋeraonec moczi wiac fuawec i hone manac erâ ra Joabe ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, no Abisalom e boriŋjâcko qaŋatierâ waha domame honepac.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Joabezi wiocnerâ muwec: “Go mâc honemec me? Go wemocte dameŋ ijaha qatec mâreŋko mi rucnejec. Go iŋuc etec muzac no bubiaŋ manahuc siliwa dâkâne 10 â umbika moc iŋuc garezapo.”
Iŋuc mume ŋic e dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go siliwa dâkâne i tauseŋ menaneo râezo mutec no ŋicwofuŋte ŋokâ e sifu mi qazapo. Nâŋe mana‐fârehapene ŋicwofuŋzi go â Abisai â Itai ʒiŋuc hâcne ŋaza qâmoc ewec: ‘Motec wârâŋ‐nane Abisalom e nore erâ akickenʒepieŋ.’
Eme no kosa ehuc juju‐ticne sipirickezapo ine ŋicwofuŋtao soŋsoŋ mi fozac â go ine dic banarenʒaŋ hâcne.”
Iŋuc mume Joabezi muwec, “No gohec dameŋ mi sipirickepemu.” Iŋuc murâ Abisalom e jâczi rowecko ijaha ɋâricne domahame oc fasaekicne jahec â moc bajuwec izi bunao âeckewec.
Âeckeme Joabe e jahacne maro babaju ŋicmotec 10 jaŋe Abisalom orâŋkerâ qahuc qâhâmombiŋ.
Iŋuc erâ Joabezi qeŋ qahuc ʒika bâniniŋkeniŋte mume momori jaŋe Israe ŋic jopa jâpec ejarembiŋ i beherâ risiembiŋ.
Ehuc Abisalomte qâŋɋâŋ rorâ kâteo nombâŋ sâko moc fowec ira behepie hume fainao qânâ ropie huku wefu ferâ ŋewec. Ehame Israe ŋic jaŋe wiserâ hae‐jeŋic sâc rafârembiŋ.
Abisalom e ɋâricne juhuc ʒiŋuc muhuc ŋicwofuŋte wâneŋko ma moc âkendâŋnewec: “Ʒâŋetuc‐nane bajuocte ŋokâ‐nane moc mi jukac.” Iŋuc murâ ma i e jahacne wase bawec, irec dameŋ ʒiŋuczia Abisalomte ma mueŋgopieŋ.
Eme Zadoko ŋokâ‐ticne Ahimazizi muwec, “Wofuŋzi ŋicwofuŋ e râsifâc‐ticne jaŋere tâpirionec batarakac biŋedâŋ i noni barâ gasackepe.”
E iŋuc mume Joabezi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Miŋecgac ʒoaŋ ʒizi biŋedâŋ barâ rara ʒoaŋ aricne. Go tomâc fureme wiac mocko ine barazemec, miŋecgac ine ŋicwofuŋte ŋokâzi hâmojecte misac.”
Joabezi iŋuc murâ Kusiŋic ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go rarâ wiac hone manac ekic i ŋicwofuŋ âzâcnec.” Iŋuc âzâcneme Kusiŋic e Joabere maŋfuŋko fodaperâ fahare gasackewec.
Iŋuc eme Zadoko ŋokâ‐ticne Ahimazi e Joabe mocwâc âzâcnerâ muwec: “Go sifu mana‐naretec no Kusiŋic e bâjâpehuc gasackezapo.” Iŋuc mume Joabezi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Motec‐nane, go maŋgâŋ wemocte gasackecmu? Go biŋedâŋ baracmu irec okacne wiac moc mi rocmu.”
Iŋuc mume Ahimazizi muwec, “No sifu gasackepemu.” Iŋuc mume Joabezi âzâcnerâ muwec, “Wiac eme gasackerâ rac.” Iŋuc âzâcneme Ahimazi e wâneŋkopec hata jaha gasackerâ rahuc Kusiŋic jâuruwec.
Dawidi e haesac motâc jajahec jahere ŋoŋondeŋko ŋewec. Ŋehame ruc bapa ŋic e haesacte sâpeo ferâ motâc bupu faio domahuc fime rame ŋic moc buc gasackeme honewec.
Honerâ ŋicwofuŋ wiracnehuc âzâcnewec. Âzâcneme ŋicwofuŋzi muwec, “Buc warekacko ine ʒiŋuc manazo: E biŋedâŋ bawarekac.” Iŋuc mume ŋic e bembeŋko ware fua tâcnewec.
Eme ruc bapa ŋic e firâ ŋic moc gasackeme jaha honewec. Honerâ sacmotâc soŋaŋ wiracnehuc muwe: “No ŋic moc buc jaha gasackeme honekopac.” Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋzi muwec, “E wâc biŋedâŋ jaha bawarekac.”
Eme ruc bapa ŋiczi muwec, “No bâbâni warekac ŋic ere gagasac i honepe Zadoko ŋokâ‐ticne Ahimazire gagasac tinac ekac.” Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋzi muwec: “E ŋic biaŋne, irec biŋe biaŋ bawarekac.”
Iŋuc mume Ahimazi e fisirâ ŋicwofuŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋicfâcge sâcne jufâreŋgopeneŋ.” Iŋuc murâ ŋicwofuŋte maŋfuŋko fodaperâ ʒâŋe maine mâreŋko hetutuckehuc ʒuhuckerâ muwec, “Wofuŋ Anutuge e muteŋ bâteŋ ecnezo. Eki hâcne ŋicwofuŋ‐nane go râsi egarembiŋ jaŋe ejareme kisâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere meo fefârembieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋzi wiocnerâ muwec, “Motec wârâŋ‐nane Abisalom e sâcne jukac me?” Wiocneme dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Joabezi kiŋaŋŋicge no sorecnuhame ŋic jaŋe ʒocnehec gasacke rac warec epie honepac, erâ wemo wiacte iŋuc embieŋ i mi manakopac.”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋzi muwec, “Kecira rârierâ domac.” Iŋuc âzâcneme rârierâ niniŋkerâ domawec.
Ehame Kusiŋiczi fisirâ muwec, “Ŋicwofuŋ‐nane biŋedâŋ biaŋne bafisikopac. Wofuŋ e ʒoaŋ ʒira go râsi egarehuc faharembiŋ jaŋere tâpirionec bataracgukac.”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋzi wiocnerâ muwec, “Motec wârâŋ‐nane Abisalom e sâcne jukac me?” Iŋuc wiocneme Kusiŋiczi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnehuc muwec: “Ŋicwofuŋ‐nane kisâfâcge sasawa, go sipiricguniŋte fahareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe motecgerao wiac fuajec iŋuc sasawa fua‐jareme muzac sâckezac.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme ŋicwofuŋ e bu ʒaʒamaŋne fâuckezo eme haesac motâc faicnao fic ŋewec irec maŋne ira ferâ kiowec. Erâ kio kio rahuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “O ŋokâ‐nane Abisalom, ŋokâ‐nane, ŋokâ‐nane Abisalom! Noni gore okacne hâmope muzac sâckezac. O Abisalom ŋokâ‐nane, ŋokâ‐nane!”
Iŋuc eme Joabe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Manakic, ŋicwofuŋ e Abisalomte erâ ki busâqoc ehuc jukac.”
Iŋuc muhapie ʒoaŋ ira kisâfâc‐jeŋic bawahac‐jopambiŋ irec ʒeri bubiaŋzi herisieme momori jaŋerao ki busâqoc fuawec. Momori jaŋe ʒiŋuc hâcne manambiŋ: “Ŋicwofuŋ e ŋokâ‐ticnere erâ ki busâqoc faio jukac.”
Iŋuc manarâ momori jaŋe bawahac‐jopapie ʒikaonec wisehuc mimierâ soŋke soŋke jueŋgopieŋ iŋuc tinac kamierâ haemaŋko raʒimbiŋ.
Ehame ŋicwofuŋ e ʒâŋe mai‐ticne foŋkerâ owa ruruckerâ ʒiŋuc muhuc kio wâwâsic ewec: “O ŋokâ‐nane Abisalom, o Abisalom ŋokâ‐nane, ŋokâ‐nane!”
Iŋuc eme Joabe e ŋicwofuŋte ficko fisirâ muwec, “Go ʒoaŋ ʒira iŋuc ehuc go gahacne juju â otâ ŋokâfâcge jaŋere juju erâ ŋonâŋfâcge â ŋokac mamare rocjopameŋ jaŋere juju ŋezickembiŋ kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge i jaŋe mimi faio râec‐jopakomec.
Go iŋuc ehuc qaisocgueŋgopieŋ jaŋere egareha gore ejareekac jaŋe ine qaisoc‐jopakomec. Go wiac ekomec izi ʒiŋuc mutaniŋkekac: Mumutâc â rereŋfâcge jaŋe wiac omane. No miŋecgac ʒiŋuc hâcne hone tarakopac: Nâŋe miŋecgac hâmo‐fârehapene, Abisalomzi ɋâricne juzacko ine gorao sâckezac.
Irec go ʒiŋuczia faharerâ ra kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge urucko dâŋ moc jazac. No Wofuŋte maio ʒiŋuc gaza‐jâmbâŋkepe: Go mi racmuo ine ŋic moczi moc ŋafe ʒira gohec moc mi ŋejâmbâŋkeocmu. Jaŋe iŋuc eniŋmuo ine mârâc motec ɋâri juhaŋtec wiac repicne gâcne fua‐garewec irec sâc sirickehuc repipicne jâmbâŋ fua‐gareocmu.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme ŋicwofuŋ e faharerâ ra haesac motâcko waha ŋewec. E ira ŋehame momori jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ e haesac motâcko ŋekac iŋuc jazapie manarâ erao fisi‐fârembiŋ. Israe ŋic jaŋe wiserâ hae‐jeŋic sâc rafârembiŋ.
Erâ guru sâc ʒiŋuc muhuc muc manac embiŋ: “Ŋicwofuŋ e kisâfâc‐nâŋec gâcne jaŋere meonec batarac‐nâpohuc Filisa ŋic jaŋere meonec batarac‐nâpowec jaha. Eme ʒi ine Abisalomte hâwickeme mâreŋ ʒirecnec wisewec.
Â nâŋâc Abisalom wokemaŋ ruacnehuc qaŋeŋ‐nâpoocte âkendâŋnembeŋ e biac ʒikao hâmowec. Irec nâŋâc ŋicwofuŋ e mocwâc bârisienaŋte dâŋ piticne mu bâuac wemocte mi eŋgopeneŋ.”
Ehame ŋicwofuŋ Dawidi e dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc râeme taha bapa Zadoko â Abiata jaherao rawec: “Ŋohe Juda soŋaŋ ʒiŋuc jazanic: ‘Israe ŋic jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ no fic hae‐naneo risiepemurâ norao dâŋ râepie fisijec, ehame ŋoŋe wemocte irec dâŋ iŋuc me iŋuc moc mi muhuc râpene eŋgopieŋ?
Ŋoŋe soctofafâc‐nane, erâ nore soc biuc jaha. Ŋoŋe wemocte ŋicwofuŋ no bârisiecnuniŋte dâŋne mi muhuc râpene eŋgopieŋ?’
Erâ Amasa ʒiŋuc âzâcnenic: ‘Go nore soc biuc jâmbâŋ. Anutuzi baficnume goki hâcne Joabere okacne momorifâc‐nane jaŋere micne juzemec.’”
Eme ŋicwofuŋte dâŋzi fisime Judaŋic jaŋere maŋzi boc fie ruruckewec. Iŋuc eme dâŋ râecnehuc ŋicfâcne rocjopame risieniŋte fotariecnembiŋ.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ e faharerâ raku Jordaŋ opâo fisiwec. Ehame Judaŋic jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ bâfuarâ Jordaŋ opâo bafickeniŋte Giligali haeo fisimbiŋ.
Ehame Bahurim haeonec Benjamiŋ ŋic moc, Gera ere ŋokâ Simei hâcne, e Judaŋic jaŋehec waharâ ŋicwofuŋ Dawidi bâfuaocte ʒocne fârone ewec.
Erâ Benjamiŋ guruonec ŋic 1 tauseŋ jaŋe ehec mâmâc wahambiŋ. Ehame Saulore garikiŋfâc jaŋere kiŋaŋŋic Ziba e ŋokâfâcne 15 â kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne 20 jaŋehec Jordaŋ opâo bâbâni fisimbiŋ.
Erâ ŋicwofuŋzi manacneme sâckeocte wiacfâcne Jordaŋ opâo bafic‐jopahuc fotâcne rac warec ehuc domawec. Ehame Gera ŋokâ‐ticne e ŋicwofuŋzi opâ fotâcnezo ehame maŋfuŋnao fodapewec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Bomboŋ‐nane, go kiŋtofa‐nane mi bajuzemec erâ ŋicwofuŋ‐nane go Jerusalem hae beherâ waremeŋ dameŋ ira kiŋaŋ qaqage noni mâsi repicne egarepo irec mocwâc mi manasuzemec. Ŋicwofuŋ, go irec moc mi manasu‐jâmbâŋkezemec.
Kiŋaŋ qaqage no mâsi repicne egarepo i mana‐jâmbâŋkekopac hâcne. Erâ no Josefere kikefuŋfâc jaŋeraoneczi fuŋkerâ fisi ŋicwofuŋ‐nane go fua‐garekopac.”
Iŋuc mume Zeruja ŋokâ‐ticne Abisaizi dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Simei e Wofuŋzi wokemaŋ ruacnewec ŋicwofuŋ e mu surec ecnewecte hâmocko râezo.”
Iŋuc mume Dawidizi muwec, “Wiac izi Zeruja ŋokâfâcne ŋoŋere dâŋ mi ekac. Irec wemocte râsi enarezo muŋgopieŋ? Ʒoaŋ ʒira Israe maŋnao ŋic moc hâmocko sâcne râenaŋmu me? No dameŋ ʒi Israe jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ jukopac hâcne.”
Iŋuc murâ ŋicwofuŋzi Simei ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go mi hâmocmu.” Iŋuc muhuc mupaŋkecnewec.
Ehame Saulore ŋosa Mefibosezi ŋicwofuŋ bâfuaocte wahawec. E ŋicwofuŋzi hae beheweckonecteaŋ kikehuhu tâmiric, mecʒâwâ mi hehe â ŋaqi qoruc‐ticne ʒure bâpiaŋ tâmiric jukuhame ŋicwofuŋ e sahac furu risiewec.
Risieme Mefibose e ŋicwofuŋ bâfuaocte Jerusalem haeonec ware fisime ŋicwofuŋzi wiocnerâ muwec, “Mefibose, go wemocte nohec mi rameŋ?”
Wiocneme ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “O ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, no kiŋaŋ qaqa‐nanezi eatucnuwec. Kiŋaŋ qaqage no ʒiŋuc âzâcnepo: ‘Go doŋgi moc sate hecnetec no ira ferâ ŋicwofuŋhec rape.’ Kiŋaŋ qaqage no puriŋne hâcne.
Eme eki hâcne ŋicwofuŋ‐nane gore kiŋaŋ qaqa no eatucnuwec. Ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, go ine Anuture aŋelo iŋucne. Irec manatec sâckekac sâc ezemec.
Mamac‐nanere garikiŋfâc nâŋe sasawa bomboŋ‐nane gore meo hâmo‐fârenʒapeŋ hâcne. Ehame go sifu ficgao hefârecnuhuc nâ jauŋ enaremeŋ. Eme no wemo wiac moc epe sâckewecte ŋicwofuŋ go kio wâwâsic egarepemu.”
E iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go wemocte dâŋ boc wosecmu. No maŋnanezi biac ʒiŋuc mutarapo: Go â Ziba ŋohe mâreŋ i bâtâc bazepirec.”
Iŋuc mume Mefibosezi ŋicwofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, go hae mâreŋgao sahac furu risiekicte eki sawa rofâreoc.”
Eme Gileade ŋic moc ʒâŋene Bariʒilai e Rogelim haeonec wahawec. Erâ Jordaŋ opâo ŋicwofuŋ bafickeocte ehec raku Jordaŋ opâo fisiwec.
Bariʒilai e ŋicqizec jâmbâŋ, jara‐ticne 80 bazuwec. E mafa sâkohec juwecte ŋicwofuŋzi Mahanaim haeo juwec dameŋ ira nânâ bafisirâ guruckecnewec.
Irec ŋicwofuŋzi Bariʒilai âzâcnerâ muwec: “Waretec nohec mâmâc ranac. Eme go ŋicqizec jâmbâŋ irec noni Jerusalem haeo fic moc bâfua‐garezepac.”
Iŋuc mume Bariʒilaizi dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc ŋicwofuŋ âzâcnewec: “No ŋicwofuŋ gohec Jerusalem haeo wemocte fepemu, no jara‐nane ʒoricne mi fokac.
No dameŋ ʒi jara 80 bazukopac. No wiac biaŋne â sâqocne i sâcne mi hone mana tarac ejactepemu. Erâ kiŋaŋ qaqage no nânâ opâ nâhuc aŋac‐ticne sâcne mi manaekopac. Erâ wâc ŋic ŋokac jaŋe mâmâc jaha gae hepie sâcne mi mana râwiŋ‐jopaekopac. Eme kiŋaŋ qaqage no weniŋuc ŋicwofuŋ‐nane gorao ʒuhuckerâ ŋemâc bâŋɋârâŋke‐garepemu?
Kiŋaŋ qaqage no gohec Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ piticne rarâ râecgupemu. Irec ŋicwofuŋ go wemocte okacne fehuc bâtikie‐narecmu?
No sifu risierâ hae‐naneoa juhuc hâmope neŋgoc mamac jahec‐nane jahere ʒâŋeruŋ fokacko ijaha ducnunʒepieŋ. Â nore okacne ine kiŋaŋ qaqage Kimihamzi ŋicwofuŋ‐nane gohec mâmâc Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ razepirec. Ehuc manatec sâckekac sâc ecnezemec.”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Kimiham e Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ nohec mâmâc ranacmu hâcne. Eme e iŋuc me iŋuc ecnepemurâ manakic sâc ecnepemu. Â go wâc iŋuc jaha wiac irec me irec mucmu sâc egarepemu.”
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe bânierâ Jordaŋ opâ fotâcne‐fârehapie ŋicwofuŋ e jahac ʒâhec fotâcnewec. Erâ Bariʒilai muduckerâ mu jambuŋ ecneme hae‐ticnao risiewec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ e fotâcnerâ Giligali haeo rame Kimiham e mâmâc rawec. Ehame Judaŋic sasawa â Israe ŋic dâkâne jaŋe fisirâ hatao ŋicwofuŋ bâfuarâ kime dopec ecnembiŋ.
Ehame Israe ŋic jaŋe guruhec ŋicwofuŋtao fisirâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Qomâfâc‐nâŋec Judaŋic jaŋe wemocte maŋjeŋicte gorao ʒuhuckehuc go gahacne â wiacfâcge, erâ ŋicfâcge ŋoŋe opâo bafic‐ŋopambieŋ?”
Iŋuc mupie Judaŋic jaŋe Israe ŋic dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarembiŋ: “Ŋicwofuŋ e nâŋere soctofa irec iŋuc embeneŋ. Eme ŋoŋe wemocte irec aaric‐ŋopakac? Nâŋe ŋicwofuŋtaonec nânâ opâ me taha wiac moc mi rombeneŋ.”
Iŋuc mupie Israe ŋic jaŋe Judaŋic dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarembiŋ: “Nâŋe ŋoŋe siric‐ŋoparâ guru sâko eŋgopeneŋte ŋicwofuŋ e qanaŋ nâŋere biŋe ekac erâ wâc nâŋe ŋoŋere bâbâniefâc. Ŋoŋe wemocte mana wahac‐nâpoŋgopieŋ? Nâŋe hâcne fuŋkerâ ŋicwofuŋ bârisienaŋte dâŋne embeŋ.” Iŋuc mupie Judaŋic jaŋe Israe ŋic âtec‐jopahuc dâŋ ʒocnehec embiŋ.
Eme hae mâreŋ ijaha ŋic repic qapicne moc juwec, ʒâŋene Seba. E Benjamiŋ ŋic moc ʒâŋene Bikiri ere ŋokâ. Eki qeŋ qahuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Nâŋâc Dawidihec wiac moc wirec mi fonârekac. Isai ŋokâ‐ticne eraonec wiac moc mi rauckerâ juŋgopeneŋ. O Israe ŋic, fic hae‐ŋeŋic sâc rafâreniŋ!”
Iŋuc mume Israe ŋic jaŋe Dawidi râpeckerâ Bikiri ŋokâ‐ticne Sebarao qohota‐fârembiŋ. Eme Judaŋic jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋictao qohota sanaŋkerâ bâjâpepie Jordaŋkonec Jerusalem haeo rambiŋ.
Eme Dawidi e Jerusalem haeo ficticnao risiewec. Ehuc juwicnao ŋokac mamare 10 rocjoparâ juku ficticne soŋaŋkeniŋte Jerusalem haeo behec‐joparâ rawec, ŋokac i jaŋe hâcne fic mocko soŋaŋ‐jopapie juniŋte râec‐jopawec. Ehuc wiac gâcne bâmockerâ râe‐jarewec, e jahac ine jaŋehec moc mi fowec. Eme ŋokac i jaŋe hozec hawari tinac fic ira soŋaŋ‐jopapie ŋehuc juhapie hâmoc dameŋ‐jeŋic maickewec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi Amasa dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go rarâ Judaŋic ejaretec ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc irec maŋnao norao fisiniŋ, erâ go gahacne wâc fisizemec.”
Iŋuc mume Amasa e Judaŋic hefârec‐jopaocte rawec. Ra juhame dameŋ bacnekicne i qâtiriwec.
Eme irec Dawidizi Abisai âzâcnerâ muwec, “Bikiri ŋokâ‐ticne Seba e Abisalomte sâc jâuruhuc wiac hâhâwicne enâreocmu. E hae sacsanaŋ‐ticnehec ira raʒirâ ŋehuc ʒâŋe hândâŋ‐nâŋec ripozacte go bomboŋgere kiŋaŋ qaqafâc rocjopatec jâperâ raniŋ.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Abisai e bânieme Joabe â ŋicfâcne erâ Kereti ŋic â Peleti ŋic tâpirihec sasawa jaŋe rambiŋ. Jaŋe Bikiri ŋokâ‐ticne Seba jâperâ raniŋte Jerusalem haeonec faharembiŋ.
Erâ Gibeoŋ haeo qânâ sâko moc ŋewec ira fisihapie Amasazi ware bâfuac‐jopawec. Eme Joabe e momori jaŋere ŋaqi heme hume juwec. Erâ fainao becsahac moc ʒika‐ticne kânoŋ‐ticnao domaha ombâŋnao jomawec. Erâ Amasa bâqiŋkeocte rahuc unuckerâ
ʒiŋuc muhuc Amasa wiocnewec: “Qomâ‐nane, go sâcne jukomec me?” Iŋuc murâ muduckeocte mecʒâwânao rowec.
Amasa e ine Joabezi menao ʒika bawec i mi honewec. Eme Joabe e wiac izi arec mocjaha sawa âeckeme honezi mâreŋko rucneme hâmowec. Eme Joabe â ɋaticne Abisai jahe ʒuhuckerâ Bikiri ŋokâ‐ticne Seba jâpepic.
Ehame Joabere ŋicfâc jaŋeraonec ŋic moczi Amasa fowecko domahuc muwec, “Moc e Dawidire biŋe jukacko ine Joabe bâjâpeoc.”
Eme Amasare qâŋɋâŋzi hata ʒâʒâŋiŋko soc ruahuc fohame ŋic jaŋe fisirâ Amasa honehuc sâc niniŋkerâ domambiŋ. Eme ŋic e iŋuc epie honec‐joparâ Amasa qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne hataonec rorâ kâteo sârockeme hume ŋaqi moczi qofackewec.
Eme Amasa hataonec bârârieme ŋic jaŋe ʒuhuckerâ Joabe bâjâpehuc Bikiri ŋokâ‐ticne Seba jâpembiŋ.
Eme Seba e Israe gurune gurune jaŋerao fotâcne‐fârerâ Abe‐Bete‐Maka haeo fisiwec. Fisime Bikirire tucne tofane jaŋe tumaŋne‐fârerâ erao qohotambiŋ.
Ehame Joabehec jumbiŋ ŋic i jaŋe Abe‐Bete‐Maka haeo fisirâ somâckehuc hae i heropieniŋte mâreŋ qapie feme ira domahuc fuŋkerâ tuŋzi sâpe âeckembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie ŋokac maŋɋârâŋhec moczi haeonec wirahuc muwec: “Hazec râeniŋ, hazec râeniŋ. Ŋoŋe Joabe ecnepie ʒira mai wareme dâŋ âzâcnepe.”
Iŋuc mume Joabe e ŋokaczi domaweckopec ra domame wiocnerâ muwec, “Go hâcne Joabe me?” Wiocneme muwec: “No hâcne ʒi.” Iŋuc mume ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Kiŋaŋ naruge no dâŋ muzo ekopacte hazec râe‐jâmbâŋkezemec.” Iŋuc mume Joabezi muwec, “No hazec râekopac.”
Iŋuc mume ŋokaczi ʒuhuckerâ muwec, “Mârâc qâqiŋdâŋ moc ʒiŋuc mujumbieŋ: ‘Ŋoŋe dâŋ okacne manazore Abe haeo raniŋ,’ iŋuc mupie dâŋ i me i fua jujec i tara jujec.
No Israe guruo wamane â urucne juekopac. Goki ine Israe guruo hae ʒizi neŋgoc moc ekac i bâsirowecmurâ juju gie bakomec. Go Wofuŋte biŋe hae ʒi bâsirowecmu me?”
Iŋuc mume Joabezi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “No hae ʒi bâsirowepemurâ moc mi manasukopac, aricne.
Ŋoŋe Eferaim tiki mâreŋkonec ŋic moc Bikiri ŋokâ‐ticne ʒâŋene Seba e ŋicwofuŋ Dawidi râsi ecnehuc qazo ewecte e sawa nârepie nâŋe hae ʒi sâcne beherâ ranaŋmu.” Iŋuc mume ŋokaczi Joabe dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Manakic, qizec‐ticne haesac râpeo behepene hufâocmu.”
Iŋuc murâ ra maŋɋârâŋ‐ticnere sâcko ŋic jaza‐fâreme jaŋe Seba upene qâtâcnerâ qizec‐ticne Joaberao behepie huwec. Jaŋe iŋuc epie Joabe e qeŋ qame momori jaŋe hae i beherâ hae‐jeŋic sâc râwiŋnembiŋ. Ehame Joabe e wâc ŋicwofuŋtao Jerusalem haeo risiewec.
Joabe e Israe momori sasawa jaŋere micne juwec. Eme Jojada ŋokâ‐ticne Benajazi ine Kereti â Peleti ŋic jaŋere micne juwec.
Ehame Adoramzi ine kiŋaŋ gie baniŋte mujarekicne jaŋe soŋaŋ‐jopawec â Ahiludu ŋokâ‐ticne Josafatazi ine dâŋ mujujec.
Ehame Sewazi ine qâqâreŋ ŋic juwec, erâ Zadoko â Abiata jahe ine taha bapa jupic.
Eme Jairi ŋic Ira e wâc Dawidire taha bapa jaha juwec.
Dawidizi ŋicwofuŋ juhame jara jahec â moc roroczi ʒuʒuhuc jaha fuahuc fowec. Iŋuc fuame Dawidizi Wofuŋ kio wâwâsic ecneme Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Saulo e Gibeoŋ ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopawecte e jahacne me garikiŋfâcne jaŋerao kiŋtofa fokac.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme ŋicwofuŋ e Gibeoŋ ŋic hefârec‐jopawec. Gibeoŋ ŋic jaŋe Israe mâcne, jaŋe Amori ŋic ʒanʒaŋne hâcne. Jaŋe ŋic i jaŋe ʒuhuckerâ juniŋte Israe ŋic jaŋe mupaŋke‐jarehuc akic‐jopambiŋ. Ehame ʒâhec ine juhapie Saulozi Israe ŋic â Judaŋic jaŋere erâ ʒoɋac ehuc jopa mizieocte manasuwec.
Eme Dawidizi Gibeoŋ ŋic wio‐jarerâ muwec, “No wemo wiac eŋarepemu? No wiac weniŋuc jaha epe tiŋkeme ŋoŋe Wofuŋte biŋefâc jaŋere manapie sâckeocmu?”
Ŋicwofuŋ e iŋuc mume Gibeoŋ ŋic jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ: “Nâŋe mecne â Saulo me garikiŋfâcne mecne nâŋere ŋondeŋko dâŋ fokac i siliwa me golzi sâcne mi bataraocmu. Erâ Israe ŋic izi me izi hâmome irec wâc manapene mi taraocmu.” Iŋuc mupie ŋicwofuŋzi wio‐jarerâ muwec, “Wemo wiac jaha eŋarepemurâ maŋkeŋgopieŋ?”
Iŋuc wio‐jareme jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ: “Israe mâreŋko mi junaŋte bâsowec‐nâpohuc omaec‐nâpoocte maŋkewec
ŋic ere soctofa 7 nâretec Gibeoŋ haeo ʒira Wofuŋte maio Wofuŋ tiki‐ticnaoa bituac‐jopanʒepeneŋ.” Iŋuc mupie ŋicwofuŋzi muwec: “Sâcne, ŋarepemu.”
Erâ ŋicwofuŋ e Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo Saulo ŋokâ‐ticne Jonataŋ mujomirecnewec irec erâ Saulo ŋosa‐ticne Mefibose Jonataŋte ŋokâ hâcne e akickewec.
Ehuc Aja otâ‐ticne Rizipa erao Saulore ŋokâ jajahec fuapic ʒâŋe‐jekic Aromoni â Mefibose jahe rocjofawec. Erâ ʒuhuckerâ Mehola ŋic Bariʒilai ere ŋokâ Aderiele â Saulo otâ‐ticne Meraba erâ jahere ŋokâfâc 5 jumbiŋ jaŋe rocjopawec.
Erâ Gibeoŋ ŋic jareme jaŋe tikio Wofuŋte maio bituac‐jopapie 7 jaŋe mâmâc hâmombiŋ. Erâ i padi bâbâroŋ qa roro dameŋko iŋuc embiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Aja otâ‐ticne Rizipa e târu raŋɋa rorâ qorac mocko rumackewec. Erâ i qa roro dameŋko fuŋkerâ iŋuc ewec. Ehuc wipe qowi jaŋe fisinʒipiŋte ʒoaŋko â ŋafeo ruc bahuc juwec. Iŋuc ehuc juhame hoezi fuŋkerâ qâŋɋâŋ hecjopawec.
Aja otâ‐ticne Rizipa, e Saulozi ŋokac mamare rocjopawec jaŋeraonec moc e wiac iŋuc ehuc juhame Dawidizi biŋe manawec.
Manarâ ra Jabesi‐Gileade hae rune jaŋeraonec Saulo â ŋokâ‐ticne Jonataŋ jahere siec rowec. Jabesi‐Gileade haeonec jaŋe Bete‐Saŋ haeo ŋic ŋokac guru sâko jaŋere tomaonec kamierâ bacjofa wisembiŋ. Filisa ŋic jaŋe Giliboa tikio Saulo â Jonataŋ jofahuc toma ira hâcne behec‐jofapie fopic.
Eme Dawidi e Saulo â ŋokâ‐ticne Jonataŋ jahere siec rorâ fisime ŋic 7 bituac‐jopambiŋ jaŋere siec wâc ro qâzuc embiŋ.
Ehuc Saulo â ŋokâ‐ticne Jonataŋ jahere siec mecne â gâcne jaŋere siec mecne i Benjamiŋ mâreŋko Zela haeo mamac ŋosa‐jekic Kisi ere ʒâŋeruŋ gufukicne ira ducjopambiŋ. Ehuc ŋicwofuŋzi mutâcnewec irec sâc efârembiŋ. Iŋuc epie tarame mâreŋ‐jeŋicte erâ numupie Anutuzi mana‐jarewec.
Juku Filisa ŋic jaŋe Israe ŋic jaŋehec ʒika mocwâc fuŋkembiŋ. Eme Dawidi e ŋicfâcne jaŋehec mâmâc hurâ ʒika qaku boc betaŋkewec.
Ehame ŋicsâko mako jaŋere ɋâric moc, ʒâŋene Isibi‐Benobo, eki Dawidi qaocte manasuwec. E sându‐ticne aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bakicnere ŋemâc‐ticne i 300 ewec â ʒika‐ticne ombâŋnao jomawec.
Ehame Zeruja ŋokâ‐ticne Abisaizi fisirâ Dawidi bafickehuc Filisa ŋic qarâ qâhâmowec. Iŋuc eme Dawidi e ŋicfâcne jaŋehec ʒikao mocwâc mi rajâmbâŋkeocte heckecnembiŋ. Juku Israere ʒoctamaczi omaezacte hâwic‐jopame iŋuc hâcne embiŋ.
Eme irec faicnao Gobo haeo Filisa ŋic jaŋehec mocwâc qaqac embiŋ. Ehame Husaŋic Sibekaizi ŋicsâko jaŋere ɋâric moc ʒâŋene Safe qâhâmowec.
Ehame Gobo haeoa Filisa ŋic jaŋehec mocwâc qaqac embiŋ. Eme Betelehem haeonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Jare‐Oregim ere ŋokâ Elihanaŋzi Gitiŋic Goliata qâhâmowec. E sându‐ticne i wâtuŋ neŋgocne iŋucne.
Eme Gati haeo ʒika mocwâc fuawec. Eme hae ira ŋic ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec moc juwec e ŋicsâko jaŋere ɋâric jaha. E me kike motec‐ticne i 6 sasawa, qâhâckeme ʒare‐jeŋic 24 ewec.
E Israe ŋic hesuac‐jopakume Dawidi hahac‐ticne Simei ere ŋokâ Jonataŋzi qâhâmowec.
Ŋic jahec â jahec i jaŋe ŋicsâko jaŋere ɋâriczi Gati haeo jumbiŋ. Ehuc Dawidi â ŋicfâcne jaŋere meo fehuc hâmo‐fârembiŋ.
Dawidi e Saulo â ŋic gâcne sasawa jaŋe râsi ecnehapie Wofuŋzi jaŋere meonec batarawec dameŋ ira Wofuŋ muteŋ bâteŋ ecnehuc gae ʒiŋuc hefuawec:
“Wofuŋ e qânâ tiki‐nane â huec‐nane â babatara‐nane.
Anutu‐nane e nore jâc, dapeŋ‐ticnao soŋkekopac. E maro‐nane, â bâbâpiaŋte wâtuŋ‐nane â hae sanaŋ‐nane, no erao soŋkekopac. E ŋeŋezic‐nane, e wiac hâhâwicne fua‐nareme ŋezicnuekac.
No Wofuŋ, mumuteŋte hozi, e wira wâwâsic ecneekopac, eme râsifâc‐nane jaŋeraonec bataracnuekac.
“Hâmocte temboŋzi qâurucnuwec, sisipiricte rumizi bârârâŋnuwec.
Hâmoc haere niŋgiŋzi hehawicnuwec, hâmocte bitiŋ bâmbeŋkepo.
“Bipic tara‐nareme Wofuŋ wâsickepo, Anutu‐nanezi baficnuocte ki owâ ecnepo. Ufuŋ‐ticnao marac fânâŋ‐nane manawec, kio owa‐nanezi hazec‐ticnao qaqazuwec.
“Eme mâreŋzi ɋiɋiteckerâ suriŋkewec; sambâŋte hobeteŋnezi wâc suriŋkehuc ɋarac ɋarac qawec; i ere kimbeŋte iŋuc fuawec.
Sâke hawec‐ticnaonec hosâc wahawec, micticnaonec ʒocbâruŋ wefuwec, ʒoc kine liŋnerâ râwiŋnewec.
E sambâŋ bârâriehuc tara wahawec, kike rurumaŋ‐ticnao duŋdapâc fowec.
Kerubim fainao ŋehuc sawao warewec, mâŋâŋte faio ŋehuc wareha honekicne.
Dapâczi foŋkehuc ŋaqi ecnewec, karorac ɋâfoŋne opâneheczi orâŋkehuc boze ecnewec.
Mai‐ticnao tatamac fowec irecnec ʒoc kinezi iiŋkehuc bâruŋkewec.
Wofuŋzi wâc sambâŋko ɋuŋ hewec, Femicne Sâkozi dâŋfânâŋ ewec.
E tepe‐ticne qâtâcneme râwiŋnerâ rame tâtiembiŋ, bâbâric‐ticne wicke‐jareme hâwic‐jopame wisembiŋ.
Eme hâwec ʒâkâŋ fâhâŋne wirictowec, â mâreŋte hobeteŋne tâtâc fuawec. Wofuŋte hahanecko, sâke rombâŋ‐ticnere fânâŋte iŋuc hâcne fuawec.
“E faic juhuc meticne sicnerâ rocnuwec, ʒâkâŋ sâkoonec fârecnume wefupo.
Râsi wânʒâŋ‐nanere meonec bataracnuwec, â qaisocnumbiŋ jaŋere tâpirizi siricnuha, sifu mejeŋickonec bâhocnuwec.
Dameŋ gâgâpâcne maicnume quruŋ herâ fisi‐narembiŋ, ehame Wofuŋzi ine sacfozic enarewec.
E unucnurâ toma sâkoo râecnuwec, nore aŋackewecte bataracnuwec.
“Wofuŋ e tiŋne jupo irec furine narewec, menane ɋaɋacne honehuc okacne bazu‐narewec.
No Wofuŋte hata paŋʒâic bâjâpepo, â sindaŋ ehuc Anutu‐nane mi râpeckepo.
Tiŋne juju‐ticnere dâŋ i dameŋ sâc hone dendeŋneekopac, â sâcmutâc dâŋticnaonec moc mi qâsorieekopac.
No ere maio bahacmâc jupo, â kiŋhec ezipore bâec bahuc jupo.
Irec Wofuŋzi tiŋne juju‐nanere sâcko okacne narewec, eebapa‐nane ɋaɋacne fome ʒâŋenezi honewec irec sâcko.
“Ŋic maŋuruchec e maŋuruc hawari fuacneekic, ŋic siocmâc e siocmâc hawari fuacneekic.
Ŋic maŋɋaɋachec e maŋɋaɋac hawari fuacneekic, ŋic bâbâŋoricne e bâbâŋoricne hawari fuacneekic.
Ine hâcne, ŋic waha qaqane bafic‐jopaekic, â maŋfefehec jaŋe bawahac‐jopazore hone jâjâpec‐jopaekic.
Jâmbomac, o Wofuŋ, go nore lambe, go Anutu‐nanezi dapâc‐nane batamaeekic.
Jâmbomac, gohec râsi guru sâcne qâtâtiec‐jopapemu, Anutu‐nane gohec qânâsac sâcne qambaraŋkepemu.
Anutu kecʒi e hata‐ticne qarâ biaŋ, Wofuŋte dâŋ i fâri fideteŋ, ere dapeŋko soŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma sabec‐jopaekac.
“Wiac Wofuŋtao ʒuhuckehuc mo Anutu mo jukac? Me Anutu‐nâŋectao ʒuhuckehuc mo qânâ sanaŋ mo domakac?
Anutu kecʒi e nore dapeŋ sanaŋ, eki hâcne hata‐naneo ʒârâ ʒâpâ bârâriewec.
Kike râe‐narewec i kâte bulimakao jaŋere kike iŋucne, erâ tiki toŋko âkendâŋnuwec.
E menane ʒika gie qazucnewec, eme aeŋ bâbâroŋzi tepe neŋgoc bakicne i sâcne fârehuc juekopac.
Goki sâsâoc maro biaŋge tahacnumeŋ, eme baficgezi bâsokacnuwec.
Go âte sanaŋkepemurâ mâreŋ sawane bâfua‐naremeŋ, eme kike‐nanezi biric borocne mi ewec.
No râsifâc‐nane jâpec‐jopa raku siric‐jopapo, erâ omaec‐jopaku jaha risiepo.
No jopa mizierâ henʒaŋ‐jopakupe fahareniŋte eipiembiŋ, kike‐nanere rurumaŋko rândiŋkerâ fombiŋ.
Ʒika qaqare tâpiri joma‐naremeŋ, ehuc râsifâc‐nane bârokawec‐jopatec docke‐narembiŋ.
Go râsifâc‐nane jâpec‐jopatec râpecnurâ wisembiŋ, eme qaisocnumbiŋ jaŋe imac‐jopapo.
Jaŋe ʒâŋe fipie bafic moc mi fuawec, jaŋe Wofuŋtao kio wâwâsic epie okacne mi bâtikie‐jarewec.
Henʒaŋ‐jopakupe rufe iŋucne embiŋ, no henʒaŋ qanʒaŋ‐joparâ âtenʒaŋ‐jopaku hae ʒoŋao jawa sânʒâŋ bebehene irec sâc behec‐jopapo.
“Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋehec ʒika fowefume baficnumeŋ, qâpuc guru jaŋere micne râecnumeŋ, ŋicguru kâuc bacjopapo jaŋe kiŋaŋ qanarembiŋ.
Ŋic furunezi fisirâ dape‐narembiŋ, biŋe‐nane manarâ izia micnane reŋkembiŋ.
Ŋic furune jaŋe hâbi‐jeŋic goroŋkewec, eme ɋarac ɋarac qahuc huec‐jeŋickonec wahambiŋ.
“Wofuŋ go jukomec. Qânâ sanaŋ‐nane go muteŋguzo, bâbâpiaŋ‐nanere qânâ sanaŋ, Anutu‐nane go muteŋ bâteŋ egarezo.
Anutu goki hâcne mana‐narehaŋ okacne bazu‐jarepo, go hâcne ŋicguru bâuruŋ‐jopatec nore rurumaŋko raʒimbiŋ.
Go hâcne râsifâc‐nane jaŋeraonec bataracnumeŋ, goki bafaharecnutec râsifâc‐nane siric‐jopapo, goki hâcne ʒika qaqa jaŋeraonec bataracnumeŋ.
“O Wofuŋ, go iŋuc emeŋte qâpuc jaŋere guruo muafecgupe, â ʒâŋege mumuteŋ gae hecnepe.
Go ŋicwofuŋge no ʒeri aŋac sâko tahacnukic, â wokemaŋ ruacge no aki anonoc bâfua‐narekic, Dawidi no â ɋâricfâc‐nane tatara tâmiric.”
Ʒi Dawidire dâŋ tatarane: Isaire ŋokâ Dawidi e toŋko hekicne â Jakobore Anutuzi wokemaŋ ruacnewec erâ Israe guruo miti mânec hehe saric jukac e ʒiŋuc mukac:
“Wofuŋte Mârozi norao dâŋ muwec, dâŋticnezi micnaneo fokac.
Israere Anutuzi dâŋ muwec, Israere qânâ sanaŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Moc e Anutu araŋ bacnehuc hata fâretiŋko ŋic rauc‐jopaekac,
e furic tatamac iŋucne tamae‐jareekac, furic qânikiŋ biaŋko ʒoaŋzi tamaeekac irec sâc eekac, hoe heme sopâc kecɋaŋ jaŋe âkeʒuhuc fua biaŋ eeŋgopieŋ iŋuc ejareekac.’
Ficnane i Anutuhec ŋejâmbâŋkekac. Eki hâcne nohec ʒâʒâfic tatara tâmiric bâfuawec, e wiac sasawa bâtâcne bâtimuŋ eku basanaŋke‐fârewec. E bafic‐nane â aŋac‐nane fokac i mume fua biaŋ efâre‐jâmbâŋkeocmu hâcne.
Ŋic miti tâmiric jaŋe qiŋambu ʒârâ behekicne iŋucne. I mezi sâcne mi rorone hâcne.
Ŋic moc e wiac i omaeoctemurâ aeŋ me gunu wiaczi qanʒaŋneme waha ŋeha ʒoczi ʒarâ ʒâseŋke‐fâreekac.”
Dawidire ŋicfâc tâpiri ɋicwânʒâŋ‐jeŋichec ʒiŋuczi jumbiŋ: Takemoŋ ŋic ʒâŋene Jose‐Basebe. E ŋic momori wânʒâŋ jahec â moc jumbiŋ jaŋere femicne juwec. Eki hâcne sându‐ticnezi ʒoaŋ mocjahao ŋic 800 âke hâmoc‐jopawec.
Ehame ŋic momori wânʒâŋ jahec â moc jaŋere ŋondeŋko Jose‐Basebe erao ŋic moc ʒuhuckerâ juwec ʒâŋene Eleaʒa. E Ahohi ŋic, Dodore ŋokâ hâcne. E Dawidihec juha Filisa ŋic ʒikare tumaŋnepie Israe ŋic jaŋe dockerâ wisembiŋ.
Wisepie Eleaʒazi faharerâ Filisa ŋic jopaku meticne hâmome ʒika‐ticne basanaŋkerâ domawec. Eme Wofuŋzi ʒoaŋ ira aŋac ʒeri sâko bâfua‐jarewec. Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe ŋic jopakicne i jaŋere ŋaqi qoruc hetaraniŋte sawa risierâ bâjâpembiŋ.
Ehame ere râpeo ŋic moc juwec ʒâŋene Sama, e Harari ŋic Age ere ŋokâ. Eme, Filisa ŋic jaŋe Lehi haeo mâreŋ ŋondeŋ moc basac gie sâko fowec ira tumaŋnembiŋ. Tumaŋnepie Israe ŋic jaŋe wisembiŋ.
Wisepie Sama e ijaha sanaŋkerâ domahuc Filisa ŋic jopawec. Iŋuc eme Wofuŋzi aŋac ʒeri sâko bâfua‐jarewec.
Eme qa roro dameŋko Filisa ŋic jaŋe Refaim wâneŋ teuŋ âterâ fohapie Dawidi micnefâc‐ticne 30 jaŋeraonec jahec â moc jaŋe Adulum qânâ hawecko humbiŋ.
Dawidi e dameŋ ira ficsanaŋko ŋehuc juwec â Filisa momori jaŋe ine Betelehem hae rorâ ira ŋembiŋ.
Eme Dawidi e ʒoaŋ mocko opâre aŋacke sâqoreme ʒiŋuc muwec: “Mozi moc Betelehem haere motâcko opâ nombâŋ ŋekac irecnec opâ nareme nazapo!”
Iŋuc mume manarâ ŋic tâpiri ɋicwânʒâŋ‐jeŋichec jaŋe faharerâ Filisa ŋic jaŋere teuŋmaŋko fotâcnerâ Betelehem haere motâcko opâ nombâŋ ŋewec irecnec opâ fiarâ bara Dawidi râcnembiŋ. Eme e opâ i mi nânâ Wofuŋte biŋe hoŋkehuc
ʒiŋuc muwec: “O Wofuŋ, no wiac iŋucne moc mi epemu. No ŋic juju‐jeŋic qaisockembieŋ ʒi jaŋere soc sâcne mi nâpemu.” Iŋuc muhuc qikiŋnewec. Ŋic tâpiri ɋicwânʒâŋ‐jeŋichec jahec â moc jaŋe mâsi iŋuc hâcne ehuc jumbiŋ.
Ehame Zeruja ŋokâ‐ticne Joabere ɋa Abisai e micne 30 jaŋere femicne juwec. E sându‐ticnezi râsi 300 âke hâmoc‐jopahuc micne jahec â moc jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec ewec.
E ŋic 30 jaŋe qâhuc‐jopa‐fârerâ micne‐jeŋic juwec hâcne. Erâ e sifu ŋic jahec â moc jaŋere sâc mi bâfuawec.
Â Jojada ŋokâ‐ticne Benaja e Kabezele haeoneczi ŋic tai tâpirihec juhuc wiac gâcne bocjaha ebac ewec. E Moabi ŋic momori wânʒâŋ jajahec jofawec. Erâ sinou wahahuc fowec dameŋ ira hurâ laioŋ moc nombâŋko hurâ domaha honerâ qâhâmowec.
Erâ Aigita ŋicsaric moc qâhâmowec wâc. Aigita ŋic e sându bajuwec â Benaja e ine tubac sawa barâ rawec. Eme ra Aigita ŋic bâfuarâ sându bajuwec i jâcc rorâ e jahacne sânduzia âke hâmowec.
Jojada ŋokâ‐ticne Benaja e wiac iŋuc ehuc micne 30 jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec ewec.
Iŋuc eme Dawidizi momori fuŋfuŋfâcne jaŋere micne âkendâŋnewec. Ehame ŋic jahec â moc jaŋere sâc ine sifu mi bâfuawec.
Erâ Joabe ɋaticne Asahele e ŋic 30 jaŋeraonec moc. Erâ gâcne jaŋere ʒâŋe ine ʒiŋuc: Betelehem haeonec Dodore ŋokâ Elihanaŋ.
Â Haroda haeonec Sama â Haroda haeonec jaha ŋic moc ʒâŋene Elika.
Erâ Palati ŋic moc ʒâŋene Helezi â Tekoa haeonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Ikesi ere ŋokâ Ira.
Erâ Anatoti haeonec Abieʒe â Husaŋic Mebunai.
Erâ Ahohi ŋic Zalimoŋ â Netofa haeonec Maharai.
Erâ Netofa haeonec jaha ŋic moc ʒâŋene Bana ere ŋokâ Helebe â Gibea haeonec Benjamiŋ ŋic moc ʒâŋene Ribai ere ŋokâ Itai.
Erâ Piratoŋ haeonec Benaja â Gasi opâonec Hidai.
Erâ Arobati ŋic Abi‐Aboŋ â Bahurim haeonec Aʒamaweta.
Erâ Salaboŋ haeonec Eliaba, e Jaseŋ ŋokâfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec â Jonataŋ.
Erâ Harari ŋic Sama â Harari ŋic jaha ʒâŋene Sararire ŋokâ Ahiam.
Erâ Maka haeonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Ahasibai ere ŋokâ Elifele â Ahitofe ŋokâ‐ticne Giloni ŋic Eliam.
Erâ Karamele haeonec Hezero â Aribi ŋic Parai.
Erâ Zoba haeonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Nataŋ ere ŋokâ Igali â Gadeŋic Bani.
Erâ Amoŋŋic Zeleke â Beroti haeonec Naharai. E Zeruja ŋokâ‐ticne Joabere maro bapa juwec.
Erâ Itiri ŋic Ira â Itiri ŋic jaha Garebe.
Erâ Hitiŋic Uria. Ʒare‐jeŋic qâqâhâc 37 ewec.
Wofuŋ kimbeŋ‐ticnezi Israe ŋic jaŋerao mocwâc bâruŋkeme Dawidi esoc qafeŋ ecnehuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Go rarâ Israe ŋic â Judaŋic wosec‐jopac.”
Eme irec ŋicwofuŋzi momori jaŋere micne e jahacnehec juwec, ʒâŋene Joabe, e âzâcnerâ muwec: “Go rarâ Israe ŋicguru Daŋ mâreŋkonec ware raku Bere‐Seba haeo fisikac mâreŋ ŋondeŋ ira ŋic ŋokac juŋgopieŋ i wosec‐jopac. Eme no ŋic ŋokac wezimuc juŋgopieŋ jaŋere ʒare manazepac.”
Iŋuc mume Joabezi ŋicwofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋicwofuŋ‐nane go juhuc honehaŋtec Wofuŋ Anutugezi ŋic ŋokac arec 100 irec sâc basawec‐jopazejec. Eme ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, go irec wemocte boc egarekac?”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋ e Joabe â momori micne gâcne boc decjopakume jaŋe faharerâ Israe ŋic wosec‐jopaniŋte rambiŋ.
Erâ Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ wâneŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋko Aroe hae ŋekac ira fohuc gie‐jeŋic fuŋkerâ Gade â Jazere haeo rambiŋ.
Eme irecnec ine Gileade haeo rambiŋ, erâ fotâcnerâ Hitiŋic jaŋere mâreŋko hae moc ʒâŋene Kadesi ira fisimbiŋ. Erâ fotâcnerâ raku Daŋ haeo fisimbiŋ. Eme irecnec ine bâŋorierâ Sidoŋ haeo rambiŋ.
Erâ Tiro hae sacsanaŋ‐ticnehec ira fisirâ Hiwiŋic â Kanaaŋ ŋic jaŋere hae sasawa i jufârembiŋ. Izi Judare Negebe mâreŋko Bere‐Seba haeo rambiŋ.
Eme mâreŋ i jufârerâ mosa 9 â ʒoaŋ gie bapa 20 tarame Jerusalem haeo mocwâc fisimbiŋ.
Fisirâ Joabezi ŋic ŋokac wosec‐jopakicne jaŋere ʒare i ŋicwofuŋ râcnewec. Israe maŋnao ŋic ʒika‐jeŋichec momori wânʒâŋ 800 tauseŋzi jumbiŋ â Judaŋic jaŋerao ine 500 tauseŋ jumbiŋ.
Ŋic ŋokac wosec‐jopame tarame Dawidire maŋzi mi sâcke‐jâmbâŋkewec. E ʒiŋuc muhuc Wofuŋ âzâcnewec: “No wiac epe sâqore‐jâmbâŋkewec. O Wofuŋ, go kiŋaŋŋicge nore kiŋ bahac i bârâriecmurâ numu‐garekopac. No wiac mutucne jâmbâŋ epo hâcne.”
Eme hae fureme Dawidi e fahareme findaŋdâŋ mumu ŋicticne Gade erao Wofuŋte dâŋzi ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Go rarâ Dawidi ʒiŋuc âzâcnec: ‘Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: No wiac jahec â moc bâmocke‐garekopac. Irec go gahac, moc me moc mutec bafisi‐garepemu.’”
Eme irec Gadezi Dawidirao fisirâ âzâcnehuc muwec: “Mâreŋgao jara jahec â moc roroc fuaocte egarekac? Me râsi jaŋe mosa jahec â moc kikeo kikeo egarepie wise wise juzo mukomec? Me mâreŋgao ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc hucukic mimicne moc fuaocte egarekac? No sorecnujec erao dâŋ okacne weniŋuc barâ risiepemu i aimuŋ jaha manatâc qâtâc ec.”
Iŋuc mume Dawidizi Gade ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No busâqoc ŋemâcnere faio jukopac; irec ŋicmeo mi fehuc Wofuŋ e jahac buuruc‐ticne qârâŋnea fokacte sifu ere meo fezepac.”
Eme irec Wofuŋzi mume Israe ŋic jaŋerao hucukic mimicnezi furictea fuarâ fohame juku dameŋ bakicne i maickewec. Ehame Daŋ mâreŋkonec raku Bere‐Seba haeo fisikac mâreŋ ŋondeŋ ira ŋic ŋokac 70 tauseŋzi hâmombiŋ.
Eme aŋelozi Jerusalem hae bâsiroweocte mene bâfeŋneme Wofuŋ e wiac hâhâwicne fuazo ewec irec maŋne risieme ŋic jaŋerao ima gie bahuc juwec aŋelo e ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “I sâcne, bâniniŋkec.” Eme Wofuŋte aŋelo e Jebusi ŋic Arauna ere padi qaqa toma heririŋnao domawec.
Ehame Dawidi e aŋelozi ŋic jopahuc juwec i honerâ Wofuŋ âzâcnerâ muwec, “Noni hâcne sâqocne bâfuapo, no wiac hehesicne epo, lama guru ʒi jaŋe ine wiac moc mi embiŋ. Irec no nahacne â wiacfâc‐nane nâŋe sawa bâtiŋ‐nâpozemec.”
Eme Gade e ʒoaŋ ijaha Dawidirao fisirâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go ferâ Jebusi ŋic Arauna ere padi qaqa toma fokac ira Wofuŋte alata moc bac.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Dawidi e Wofuŋzi mutâcnewec irec sâc Gadere dâŋ reŋkerâ ferawec.
Ehame Arauna e ʒâŋe firâ ŋicwofuŋ â kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne eraopec rapie honec‐joparâ ra ŋicwofuŋ dapecnehuc maŋfuŋ‐ticnao ʒâŋe mai‐ticne mâreŋko hetutuckewec.
Ehuc muwec, “Ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, go wemocte kiŋaŋ qaqage norao warekomec?” E iŋuc mume Dawidizi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “No padi qaqa tomage ʒi furine bahuc Wofuŋte alata moc bapemurâ warekopac. Eme hucukic mimicne fuarâ ŋic ŋokac imac‐jopakac i omaezejec.”
Iŋuc mume Araunazi Dawidi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, go wiac honetec sâckekac sâc i rorâ bâzi rikezemec. Bulimakao ŋicne ʒi qowi bâzire biŋe, jâczi qârândiŋ bakicne â bulimakao jaŋere kioŋ forakac ʒizi ine ʒoc ezejec.
O ŋicwofuŋ, wiac sasawa ʒi go qikiŋne‐garekopac.” Iŋuc murâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋ Anutugezi mana‐garezejec.”
E iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Aricne, no goraonec furine bapemu. No furi tâmiric Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane qowi bâzi mi rikecnepemu.” Iŋuc murâ Dawidi e padi qaqa toma â bulimakao i siliwa ŋemâc‐ticne 50 izi furine bawec.
Erâ ira Wofuŋte alata moc barâ qowi bâzi â wama bâzi rikewec. Iŋuc eme Wofuŋzi mâreŋ ira nunumu‐ticne manarâ mume Israe guruo hucukic mimicne fowec i omaewec.
Ŋicwofuŋ Dawidi e jara bocjaha bazurâ ŋicqizec jâmbâŋ ewec. Ehame sahac‐ticne qoruc wiaczi foŋke‐bipiehapie sifu mi hâroŋkewec.
Iŋuc eme ŋicwofuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqafâc jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ŋicwofuŋ‐nâŋec, nâŋe naru ʒeŋoŋ moc bâfua‐garepene maŋfuŋgao juhuc kiŋaŋ qagarezejec. Ehuc ŋafeo me faigao fohuc hehâroŋguzejec.”
Jaŋe iŋuc muhuc Israe hae mâreŋ sâc naru sahac hawari biaŋ moc bâfuaniŋte babasa gie bambiŋ. Ehuc Sunami mâreŋkonec naru moc ʒâŋene Abisaga bâfuarâ ŋicwofuŋtao bafisimbiŋ.
Naru e sahac hawari‐ticne biaŋne jâmbâŋ. E ŋicwofuŋ jauŋkehuc kiŋaŋ qacnewec, â ŋowe ŋonâŋ juju ine mi jupic.
Eme Hagitire ŋokâ ʒâŋene Adonia, e sahac fefe ehuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “No ŋicwofuŋ ezepac!” Iŋuc muhuc keretac â becâsicko rara ŋic rocjopahuc kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne 50 maŋfuŋ‐ticnao juniŋte rocjopawec wâc.
Mamac‐ticnezi ine dameŋ ira me ira ʒiŋuc wiocnehuc mu bâtiŋ moc mi ecnewec, “Go wemocte iŋuc ekomec?” Eme ŋic e sahac hawari‐ticne biaŋne jâmbâŋ. E Abisalom fuame faicnao fuawec.
Ŋic e Zerujare ŋokâ Joabe â taha bapa Abiata jahehec dâŋ muc manac embiŋ, ehame jahe dâŋticne dopekepic.
Â taha bapa Zadoko â Jojadare ŋokâ Benaja â porofete Nataŋ, erâ Simei â Rei â Dawidire momori fuŋfuŋfâc, ŋic tâpiri sâkohec hâcne, jaŋe ine Adonia erao mi ʒuhuckembiŋ.
Eme Adonia e lama bulimakao ŋicne â bulimakao wokemaŋ sâkohec rocjoparâ qoruc qaqajac ŋic ere opâ heririŋnao qânâ sâko moc ŋewec ʒâŋene Sohelete, ira taha bâzi rikewec. Ehuc ŋicwofuŋte ŋokâfâc, ɋafâcne sasawa hâcne, erâ Judaŋic gâcne ŋicwofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnembiŋ jaŋe mâmâc hefârec‐jopawec.
Porofete Nataŋ â Benaja â ŋicwofuŋte momori fuŋfuŋfâc erâ hahac‐ticne Salomo jaŋe ine mi hefârec‐jopawec.
Eme Nataŋ e Salomore neŋgoc Batiseba ʒiŋuc wiocnewec: “Hagitire ŋokâ Adonia e bomboŋ‐nâŋec Dawidizi kâuc bahame biac ŋicwofuŋ ejec, i goki moc manamec me?
Irec ʒi hazec râec, go gahacne â ŋokâge Salomo ŋohere juju weniŋuc erâ ŋezickecmu irec dâŋ moc gazape.
Ajoc, go ʒiŋuczia ŋicwofuŋ Dawidirao rarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnec: ‘Ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, go mârâc jaha kiŋaŋ naruge no dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupaŋke‐naremeŋ i: “No râriehape ŋokâge Salomozi âkehocnurâ ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋeo ŋezejec.” Eme ʒi fuŋne weniŋucte Adoniazi ŋicwofuŋ ejec?’
Erâ manac, go ŋicwofuŋhec dâŋ muc manac ehuc juhapire jaha no fisirâ dâŋge dopeckehuc binaŋ gâcne ʒuhuckerâ bape taraocmu.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Batiseba e ŋicwofuŋ juwec ficmaŋ ira raʒiwec. Ŋicwofuŋ e ine ŋicqizec jâmbâŋ ewecte Sunami ŋokac Abisagazi kiŋaŋ qacnehuc juwec.
Ehame Batiseba e ŋicwofuŋte maio fodaperâ ʒâŋe mai‐ticne mâreŋko hetutuckeme ŋicwofuŋzi wiocnehuc muwec: “Go wemo wiacte warekomec?”
Wiocneme dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “O bomboŋ‐nane, go Wofuŋ Anutugere maio kiŋaŋ naruge no ʒiŋuc mupaŋke‐naremeŋ: ‘No râriehape ŋokâge Salomozi âkehocnurâ ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋeo ŋezejec!’
Ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, ʒi ine mi manahuc juhaŋtec mi Adoniazi ŋicwofuŋ ezejec i!
Ehuc bulimakao ŋicne gâcne â bulimakao wokemaŋ sâkohec erâ lama wiac guru sâko rocjoparâ taha bâzi rikewec. Ehuc ŋicwofuŋ gore ŋokâfâc sasawa erâ taha bapa Abiata â momori jaŋere micne Joabe hefârec‐jopahuc kiŋaŋŋicge Salomo ine mi hefârewec.
Iŋuc ewecte Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ‐nane gorao ʒâŋe fifâreŋgopieŋ. Go râriehaŋtec mozi ŋicwofuŋ juocmu i mufua‐jarecmurâ woŋec juŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Erâ ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, juku ʒiŋuc fuazacte hâwicnukac: Go mamacfâcge jaŋerao ʒuhuckehuc hâmorâ ʒâŋeruŋko fohaŋtec no â ŋokâ‐nane nâhe kiŋhec ezipeckohec.”
Eme Batiseba e ŋicwofuŋhec dâŋ dâŋ ehuc domahame porofete Nataŋzi fisiwec.
Fisime ŋicwofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Manakic, porofete Nataŋ e warejec domakac.” Eme porofete e ŋicwofuŋte maio fuarâ ʒâŋe mai‐ticne mâreŋko hetutuckewec.
Erâ ŋicwofuŋ ʒiŋuc wiocnewec: “O ŋicwofuŋ, go gahac mutec Adoniazi âkehocgurâ ŋicwofuŋ gie bakac me weniŋuc?
E miŋecgac hâcne hurâ bulimakao ŋicne gâcne â bulimakao wokemaŋ sâkohec erâ lama wiac guru sâko rocjopajec i taha bâzi rikekac. Ehuc ŋicwofuŋ gore ŋokâfâc sasawa â momori jaŋere micne erâ wâc taha bapa Abiata mâmâc hefârec‐jopame jaŋe ehec tiwâ bâzi â opâ wiac nâŋgopieŋ, erâ owackehuc ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: ‘Ŋicwofuŋ Adonia e dameŋ ʒora juraʒihuc juzejec.’
Kiŋaŋŋicge no â taha bapa Zadoko â Jojadare ŋokâ Benaja erâ kiŋaŋŋicge Salomo nâŋe ine mi hefârec‐nâpojec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, go mozi âkehocgurâ ŋicwofuŋ gie baocmu i kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋe kâuc bahuc juhapene go gahac manatec wiac ʒi fuajec me weniŋuc?”
Porofete e dâŋ iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋ Dawidizi manarâ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Batiseba wiracnepie wareoc!” Eme e warerâ ŋicwofuŋte maio domawec.
Ehame ŋicwofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋ e jujâmbâŋkekacte ʒârâ hâriŋ fuŋne fuŋne irecnec bataracnu‐fârewec.
Eme no Wofuŋ Israere Anutu hâcne ere maio ʒiŋuc mujomire‐garepo: ‘Ŋokâge Salomo e juku âkehocnurâ ŋicwofuŋ gie rauckezejec.’ Iŋuc mupore miŋecgac mupe fârine fua‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.”
Mume Batiseba e fodapecnerâ ʒâŋe mai‐ticne mâreŋko hetutuckehuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋicwofuŋ‐nane Dawidi go dameŋ ʒora juraʒihuc juzemec!”
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Dawidizi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋoŋe taha bapa Zadoko â porofete Nataŋ erâ Jojadare ŋokâ Benaja wira‐jarepie warenʒepieŋ.” Iŋuc mume wira‐jarepie ŋicwofuŋte maio ware fuambiŋ.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane fekicne rocjopapie ware bafic‐ŋopahuc ŋokâ‐nane Salomo nore doŋgi faio râerâ Gihoŋ opâo bahunʒepieŋ.
Eme taha bapa Zadoko â porofete Nataŋ jahe wokemaŋ ruacnepire Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ ezejec. Ehame qeŋ qahuc ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Ŋicwofuŋ Salomo e juraʒihuc juzejec!’
Iŋuc efârerâ jowa wefupie eki âkehocnurâ ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋe‐naneo ŋehuc Israe ŋic guriŋ bajarezejec. E Israe â Juda ŋicguru jaŋere micne sâko eocte mutarakopac hâcne.”
Eme Jojadare ŋokâ Benajazi ŋicwofuŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Iŋuc hâcne fuazejec! Ehame ŋicwofuŋ‐nane gore Wofuŋ Anutuzi mume sanaŋkezejec!
Ehuc ŋicwofuŋ‐nane go dope hutuŋ egarehuc juwec iŋuc jaha Salomo ecnezejec. Ehuc ŋicwofuŋ juju‐ticnere ʒâŋe biŋe bâsokame ŋicwofuŋ‐nane Dawidi gore ʒâŋe biŋe sirickezejec.”
Eme taha bapa Zadoko â porofete Nataŋ â Jojadare ŋokâ Benaja erâ Kereti â Peleti momori guru jaŋe Salomo ŋicwofuŋ Dawidire doŋgi faio râerâ Gihoŋ opâo bahumbiŋ.
Eme taha bapa Zadoko e bulimakao ʒuŋeo wokemaŋ opâ qapie hurâ domawec i Wofuŋte qoruc bozeonec rorâ Salomo ruacnewec. Ehame qeŋ qahapie ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋe owackehuc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋicwofuŋ Salomo e juraʒihuc juzejec!”
Tarame ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋe hehâckerâ Salomo bâjâpehuc risiembiŋ. Erâ ʒeri bari ehuc gae wopie kike fânâŋ‐jeŋicte erâ mâreŋzi ɋiɋiteckewec.
Eme Adonia e jahacne â tiwâ ʒepecte hefârec‐jopawec jaŋe nânâ nâfârehuc fânâŋ i manambiŋ. Â Joabe e qeŋfânâŋ manarâ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Haeo ojowa sâko fuakac i fuŋne weniŋucte?”
E dâŋ iŋuc muha muhame izia taha bapa Abiatare ŋokâ Jonataŋzi fisiwec. Fisime Adoniazi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Warec, ŋic fârine go, biŋedâŋ biaŋne moc mecne bafisikic.”
Iŋuc mume Jonataŋzi Adonia dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: Aricne, no biŋedâŋ ʒiŋuc bawarekopac: “Ŋicwofuŋ‐nâŋec Dawidi e Salomo ŋicwofuŋ juocte âkendâŋnejec.
Ehuc taha bapa Zadoko â porofete Nataŋ â Jojadare ŋokâ Benaja erâ Kereti â Peleti momori ejareme ŋicwofuŋte doŋgi faio râembieŋ.
Eme taha bapa Zadoko â porofete Nataŋ jahe ŋicwofuŋ eocte Gihoŋ opâo wokemaŋ ruacnepirec. Iŋuc epire tarame irecnec ʒeri bari ehuc wefurâ hae sâkoo ojowa sâko epie fânâŋ‐jeŋic manambieŋ hâcne.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, Salomo e ʒi biac ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋeo ŋekac.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne fekicne jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ‐nâŋec Dawidi bubiaŋ dâŋ âzâcneniŋte erao fisihuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnembieŋ: ‘Anutugezi Salomore ʒâŋe biŋe bâsokame gahacne ʒâŋe biŋe sirickezejec, â guriŋ bapa gie‐ticne basanaŋkeme gahacne jâuruzejec.’ Iŋuc mupie ŋicwofuŋ e fofo‐ticnao ŋehuc fodape‐jarejec.
Erâ wâc dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazajec: ‘Wofuŋ Israere Anutu e mumbiaŋkezo. Eki hâcne mana‐nareme soctofafâc‐nane jaŋeraonec moczi ʒâŋe‐nanezi honehape âkehocnuhuc ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋe‐naneo ŋekac.’”
Eme Adoniazi hefârec‐jopawec jaŋe dâŋ i manarâ fâfâre sâqorehuc faharerâ siŋsaŋ qafârembiŋ.
Ehame Adoniazi Salomore hâwickewec. Irec faharerâ ra alata ʒuŋenao menezi hehawickewec.
Eme ŋic gâcnezi Salomorao fisirâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Manakic, Adonia e ŋicwofuŋ Salomo gore hâwickeme alata ʒuŋenao hehawickehuc ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Ŋicwofuŋ Salomo e ʒikazi kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne no mi qâhâmocnuocte mujomire‐narezejec.’”
Eme Salomozi muwec: “Ŋic e siocmâc juocmuo sahac‐ticne moc mi bâuwapemu. Wiac hehesic moc ebac eocmuo ine hâmozejec.”
Ŋicwofuŋ Salomo e iŋuc murâ ŋic sorec‐jopame ra Adonia alataonec rorâ jowa warembiŋ. Eme ŋicwofuŋte maio fuarâ fodapecneme Salomozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Sâcne, ficgao rac.”
Eme Dawidi hâmoc dameŋ‐ticne qândâŋkewecte ŋokâ‐ticne Salomo uŋdâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Mâreŋ sâc ŋic nâŋâc hâmonaŋte mukicnere ʒi hâmoc dameŋ‐nane maickekac wâc. Irec go sanaŋkerâ ŋic fârine juzemec.
Ehuc Wofuŋ Anutugezi wiac mutâcne‐gareekac i reŋke‐fârezemec, erâ hata‐ticnao âte rahuc dâŋsanaŋ â sâcmutâc â mumutâc erâ mumutaniŋ dâŋ, Mosere sâcmutâc dâŋko qâreŋke‐fârekicne fokac i ninic jaha reŋke‐fârezemec. Iŋuc ecmuo ine wiac sasawa ebac etec fârio qaocmu â ira me ira rahuc mi bititiecmu.
Ehame Wofuŋ e no dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupaŋke‐narewec irec fârine bâfuaocmu: ‘Ŋokâfâcge jaŋe hata‐jeŋic soŋaŋkehuc nore maio ʒoɋac erâ aimuŋ â siocmâc jufâreniŋmuo ine noni mupe Israe kikefuŋte ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋeo ŋic moc mi basa‐jâmbâŋkeniŋmu.’
“Eme Zerujare ŋokâ Joabe e wiac gâgâpâcne moc enarewec i goki wâc manakic. E Israere momori guru jaŋere micne jahec Nerare ŋokâ Abene â Jeterare ŋokâ Amasa jahe kosa jofahuc wama dameŋko ʒika qaqa gie bame socjekiczi umbika‐ticne â kikehuhu‐ticne ruacnewec.
Go maŋɋârâŋ fogarekac irec sâc ehuc ŋic jaŋɋâŋhec keci akicketec wama faio mi hâmozejec.
Â Gileade ŋic Bariʒilai ere ŋokâfâc ine ehâmo‐jarehuc juzemec, ehuc mana‐jarehaŋtec gore teboo nânâ nâhuc junʒepieŋ. Manakic, no hahacge Abisalomte hâwicnume wisehuc juhape jaŋe hâcne âgo enarembiŋ.
Erâ manac, Gerare ŋokâ Simei e gohec jukac wâc, e Benjamiŋ mâreŋko Bahurim hae ŋekac irecnec. No Mahanaim haeo razo ehape dameŋ ira eki hâcne mâretec sâwecnuwec. Eme irec faicnao nohec bâbâfuac enacte Jordaŋ opâo hufâme no Wofuŋte maio ʒiŋuc mupaŋkecnepo: ‘No ʒikare micko mi râecgupemu.’
Ŋic e ine akicketec mi juzejec. Go ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jukicte weniŋuc ecnetec sâckeocmu i gahac manakic. E jaŋɋâŋhec erâ sifu qatec soc ruahuc hâmozejec.”
Eme Dawidi e apa ŋosafâc‐ticne mârâc jaha hâmombiŋ jaŋerao ʒuhuckehuc hâmome hae qizecko duckembiŋ.
E Israe kikefuŋ jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ juhame jara 40 tarawec. E Heboroŋ haeo jara 7 â Jerusalem haeo ine jara 33 ŋicwofuŋ juwec.
Eme Salomo e mamac‐ticne Dawidire eri ŋeŋeo ŋehame uucmaŋ‐ticne sanaŋ qaŋqaŋne fowec.
Eme Hagitire ŋokâ Adonia e Salomore neŋgoc Batisebarao fisime ʒiŋuc wiocnewec: “Go wamao warekic me?” Eme muwec: “Ine hâcne, no wamao fâkopac.”
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “No dâŋ piticne gazazo manasukopac.” Mume muwec: “Sâcne, mutec manape.”
Eme muwec: “Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma norao ʒâŋe fihuc no ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic jupemurâ muhapie uucmaŋ i nore biŋe ewec, i gahac manakomec; eme sifu Wofuŋzi maname fowecte ŋicwofuŋ gie nowac rohuc ɋananere meo râekicne.
Eme ʒi nunumu mocjaha mac numu‐garepe dâŋnane mi qikiŋnezemec.” Iŋuc mume ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Dâŋge mutec manape.”
Eme muwec: “Go ŋicwofuŋ Salomo âzâcnetec eki Sunami ŋokac ʒâŋene Abisaga nareme ŋonâŋ‐nane ezac. Salomozi gore dâŋ mi qikiŋneocmu.”
Eme Batisebazi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Sâcne, no gore dâŋ i ŋicwofuŋ âzâcnepemu.”
Eme Batiseba e Adonaire dâŋ i ŋicwofuŋ Salomo mufuacneocte ere ficko fewec. Feme ŋicwofuŋ e fahare ere maŋfuŋko rahuc fodapecnerâ risie eri ŋeŋe‐ticnao mocwâc waha ŋewec. Eme ŋicwofuŋ neŋgoc‐ticnere ŋeŋe moc bâfuarâ mefârenaopec hecnepie waha ŋewec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “No wiac piticnere mocjaha mac numu‐garepe dâŋnane mi qikiŋnezemec.” Eme ŋicwofuŋzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Neŋgoc‐nane, go dâŋge mutec manape, erâ wemocko qikiŋnepemu.”
Iŋuc mume muwec: “Sunami ŋokac ʒâŋene Abisaga e hahacge Adoniare ŋonâŋ eocte sâcne râcnezo me mâcne?”
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Salomo e neŋgoc‐ticne dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go Sunami ŋokac Abisagazi Adoniare biŋe eocte numu‐narekic, iŋuc jaha ŋicwofuŋ gie i erea eocte numu‐narenʒaŋ me! E hâcne hahac‐nane jukac, erâ taha bapa Abiata â Zerujare ŋokâ Joabe jahe wâc erao qohotakopirec.”
Ŋicwofuŋ Salomo e dâŋ iŋuc murâ Wofuŋte maio mupaŋkehuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Anutuzi baficnuhame Adoniazi dâŋ muwec irec okacne qape hâmozejec.
Anutuzi basanaŋnuhuc mamac‐nane Dawidire eri ŋeŋeo râecnurâ mupaŋkewec irec sâc uucmaŋ moc bâfua‐narewec ere maio musanaŋkekopac hâcne: Adonia e miŋecgac jaha hâmozejec.”
Iŋuc murâ ŋicwofuŋ Salomozi Jojadare ŋokâ Benaja soreme eki rarâ Adonia qâhâmowec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ e taha bapa Abiata ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ajoc, go Anatoti hae mâreŋko giegaŋge fokac ira rac. Manakic, go hâmocte biŋe enʒaŋ. Eme sifu miŋecgac mi qâhâmocgupemu. Go mârâc jaha mamac‐nane Dawidire maio Wofuŋ Anuture katapa reŋkemeŋ, erâ ʒârâ hâriŋ faio juhame ehec mâmâc jumeŋ irec erâ akicgukopac.”
Salomozi iŋuc muhuc Abiata jâpeme Wofuŋte taha bapa ŋic mocwâc mi juwec. Ehame Wofuŋzi mârâc Silo haeo Elire kikefuŋfâc jaŋere findaŋdâŋ muwec i deŋkewec hâcne.
Eme Joabe e mârâc jaha Abisalomtao ine mi qohotaweczi irec biŋe mana‐fârerâ Adoniarao qohotawecte hâwickeme gasackehuc Wofuŋte qoruc bozeo raʒirâ alata ʒuŋenao menezi hehawickewec.
Eme ŋic jaŋe, “Joabezi wiserâ Wofuŋte qoruc bozeo raʒirâ alata heririŋnao domakac,” iŋuc muhuc ŋicwofuŋ Salomo mufuacnepie Jojadare ŋokâ Benaja sorehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ajoc, go rarâ qâhâmoc!”
Eme Benajazi Wofuŋte qoruc bozeo fisirâ Joabe ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go wahacmurâ ŋicwofuŋzi mume gazakopac!” Eme muwec: “Mâcne, no ʒira hâmopemu.” Iŋuc mume Benaja e risierâ Joabezi dâŋ muwec irec binaŋ i ŋicwofuŋ bacne‐fârewec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “E gazajec sâc iŋuc qâhâmorâ duckec! E fuŋne tâmiricko soc kosa hoŋkewec irec kiŋ no â mamac‐nanere garikiŋfâc nâŋeraonec bârâriec.
E mamac‐nane Dawidizi mi manahame ŋic jajahec e jahacne sâc jâuruhuc tiŋne â pectâc jupic jahe ʒikazi qâhâmoc‐jofawec, moc Nerare ŋokâ Abene, Israere momori guru jaŋere micne, â moc ine Judare momori guru jaŋere micne Jetera ŋokâ Amasa. Jahe kosa jofahuc kiŋ hurewecte okacne fisicnezejec.
Ŋic jahere socte kiŋzi Joabe e jahacne â ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋerao fohuc juzejec; Dawidi â ɋâricfâc‐ticne erâ garikiŋfâcne jaŋerao â eri ŋeŋe‐ticnao ine Wofuŋte wama fohuc juzejec sanaŋ.”
Eme Jojadare ŋokâ Benaja e rarâ Joabe qâhâmome ficticne mâreŋ burocnao ŋewec ira duckembiŋ.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi Jojodare ŋokâ Benaja e Joabere tuc qarâ momori jaŋere micne juocte âkendâŋnewec, â taha bapa Zadokozi Abiata âkehockeocte mucnewec.
Eme irec faicnao ŋicwofuŋzi Simei hefârerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Jerusalem hae ʒira fic moc barâ ira ŋeŋe juju ehuc ira me ira mi rajâmbâŋkezemec.
Go ʒoaŋ mocko hae beherâ Kidoroŋ opâ fotâcnerâ hae mocko racmuo ine hâmo‐jâmbâŋkecmu, i manapaŋkezemec. Bahacgere erâ hâmo‐jâmbâŋkecmu hâcne.”
Eme Simeizi ŋicwofuŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go dâŋ mukomec i manape sâckekac. Erâ ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, go kiŋaŋŋicge no dâŋ nazakomec irec sâc epemu.” Eme Simeizi Jerusalem haeo dameŋ ʒora jufewec.
Jufeme jara 3 tarahame Simeire kiŋaŋ motec jahec jahe wisecnerâ Makare ŋokâ Akisi, Gati haere ŋicwofuŋ erao rapic. Ehame ŋic jaŋe Simei ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Manakic, motec jahecge Gati haeo jukopirec.”
Simei e iŋuc manarâ doŋgi‐ticne sate râecnerâ kiŋaŋ motec jahec‐ticne basac‐jofaocte Akisirao Gati haeo rawec. Raku bâfuac‐jofarâ irecnec bârisiec‐jofawec.
Eme Simei e Jerusalem haeonec Gati haeo rarâ risiewec irec biŋe i Salomo mufuacnembiŋ.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopame Simei ecnepie fisime ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No Wofuŋte maio mupaŋkehuc uŋdâŋ ʒiŋuc gazapo: ‘Go ʒoaŋ mocko hae ʒi beherâ ira me ira racmuo ine hâmo‐jâmbâŋkecmu, i manapaŋkezemec.’ Iŋuc mupe go dâŋ ʒiŋuc bârisie‐naremeŋ: ‘Go dâŋ mukomec i manape sâckekac, no reŋkepemu.’
Eme go wemocte Wofuŋte maio dâŋ mupaŋkemeŋ i mi soŋaŋkehuc sâcmutâc dâŋnane huckemeŋ?”
Ŋicwofuŋzi iŋuc muhuc Simei ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go mamac‐nane Dawidi wiac hehesicne fuŋne fuŋne ecnemeŋ i gahac mana‐fârekic, eme ʒi ine Wofuŋzi hehesicgere okacne bazu‐gareocmu.
Ŋicwofuŋ Salomo norao ine Wofuŋte jambuŋ fozejec â Dawidire eri ŋeŋe i Wofuŋte maio ŋehuc juzejec sanaŋ.”
Ŋicwofuŋzi iŋuc murâ Jojadare ŋokâ Benaja mucneme rarâ Simei qâhâmowec. Eme Salomozi ŋicwofuŋ gie baha uucmaŋ‐ticnezi soka sanaŋ ewec.
Eme Salomo e Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Farao ehec kikimo ehuc otâ‐ticne rowec. Erâ Dawidire haeo jowa fisirâ e jahacne fic erâ Wofuŋte ufuŋ â qânâsac hae râreckehuc baku batarawec.
Jowa fisiwec dameŋ ira Wofuŋte ʒâŋere fic biac mi bambiŋte ŋic ŋokac jaŋe furu mâreŋko taha bâzi rike jumbieŋ.
Salomore maŋzi Wofuŋtao domaha mamac‐ticne Dawidizi dâŋ mutâcnecnewec sâc wiac ebac ewec; mâc furu mâreŋko taha bâzi â hosâc âsu biaŋ ririke i ʒuhuckerâ ewec wâc.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi taha bâzi rikeocte Gibeoŋ haeo rarâ qowi bâzi 1 tauseŋ rikewec. Ira bâzi ririkere furu mâreŋ kâcɋene sâko fowec hâcne.
Eme Wofuŋzi Gibeoŋ haeo Salomo guŋko fuacnehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No wemo wiac tahacgupemurâ egarekac i nazatec manape!”
Eme Salomozi dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go kiŋaŋŋicge mamac‐nane Dawidi maŋjauŋ sâko ecnehuc juhaŋtec gorao qohotahuc tiŋne â pectâc juhuc wiac ebac ewec. Iŋuc eme ʒuhuckerâ maŋjauŋ sâko jaha ecnehuc ŋokâ moc tahackemeŋ eki dameŋ ʒi eri ŋeŋe‐ticnao ŋehuc jukac.
O Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane, ʒi ine kiŋaŋŋicge no enaretec mamac‐nane Dawidire tuc qarâ ŋicwofuŋ jukopac. Erâ no motec ɋâri juhuc ŋicwofuŋ giere fuŋne biac mi mana tarakopac.
Erâ kiŋaŋŋicge no mac ʒi ŋicfâcge bâwosâec‐jopameŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko domakopac. Jaŋe ŋic ŋokac guru sâko ʒare‐jeŋic fejâmbâŋkekacte ŋic moczi sâcne mi wosec‐jopaocmu.
Irec go kiŋaŋŋicge nore maŋ mamanasu bâsokatec biaŋne â sâqocnere fuŋne hone tarahuc ŋicfâcge jaŋere dâŋ sâcne mutarazepac. Ŋicfâcge jaŋe guru sâko irec mozi dâŋjeŋic mutarame sâckeocmu?”
Salomozi wiac iŋucnere Wofuŋ numucneme maname biaŋkewec.
Irec dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go mamana biaŋ rohuc mumutara gie fârine bacmurâ numu‐narehuc juju ʒoricne jufecmurâ me moneŋ mafa sâko rauckecmurâ me râsifâcge jaŋe hâmo sipiric eniŋmurâ mi numu‐naremec.
Manakic, irec erâ nunumugere sâcko egarehuc maŋɋârâŋ â mamana sâko bâfua‐garepe izi ŋic mârâc jumbiŋ â ʒâhec jufeniŋmu jaŋere mamana sirickecmu.
Eme wiac gâcnere mi numu‐naremec i wâc ʒuhuckerâ garepemu, moneŋ mafa sâko mecne erâ ʒâŋe biŋe sâko mâmâc. Irec gore dameŋko ŋicwofuŋ gâcne juniŋmu jaŋe gore sâc mi bâfuanʒepieŋ.
Go nore hatao juhuc dâŋsanaŋ â sâcmutâc dâŋnane mamacge Dawidizi ewec irec sâc ehuc reŋkecmuo ine raŋɋa raŋɋa jambuŋguhuc jupemu.”
Eme Salomozi ɋârerâ ʒiŋuc mana tarawec: Â, ʒi guŋ manakopac. Iŋuc muhuc Jerusalem haeo ferâ Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapa irec maŋfuŋko domahuc qowi bâzi â wama bâzi wiac rikerâ fekicnefâc‐ticne tiwa bâzi ejarewec.
Eme dameŋ ira sasec ŋokac jajahec jahe ŋicwofuŋ dâŋ âzâcnenicte erao rapic.
Erâ ŋokac moczi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “O bomboŋ‐nane, go dâŋ gazape manac: No â ŋokac kecʒi nâhe fic mocjahao ŋec foc eekoperec. Eme nâhe ira ŋehuc no motec moc ropo.
Ehame ʒoaŋ gie bapa 3 tarame ŋokac kecʒi e motec moc rowec wâc. Nâhe fic ira bucjâmbâŋ‐nâhec jupec, ŋic me ŋokac moczi nâhehec moc mi jujâmbâŋkembiŋ.
Eme ŋokac kecʒi e ŋafeo guŋ fohuc motec‐ticne fohâmowec.
Erâ ŋafe ʒâŋiŋko faharerâ kiŋaŋ naruge no guŋ fohape nore motec nowac rorâ bumaŋ‐ticnao râewec â e jahacne motec hâmocne ine norao râewec.
Eme hae fureme motec‐nane moŋ gumezore faharehuc honepe motec e hâmocne fowec. Ehame hae fure taniŋkeme hone‐hâmorâ ʒiŋuc mana tarapo: Motec keci e moc e noni mi ropo.”
Iŋuc mume ŋokac âgo‐ticnezi muwec: “I burec, motec ɋâricne jukac e nore, gore motec ine hâmojec.” Mume âgonezi muwec: “Burec, nore motec e ɋâricne, â gore ine hâmojec.” Iŋuc muhuc ŋicwofuŋte maio mu qaqatarac epic.
Iŋuc epire ŋicwofuŋzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc jasawec: “Moczi ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Motec ɋâricne ʒi nore, â hâmocne i gore,’ â moczi ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Aricne, hâmocne i gore, â ɋâricne i nore.’”
Erâ ŋicwofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Ajoc, sâqe sâko moc baware‐nareniŋ!” Eme sâqe moc râcnembiŋ.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi muwec: “Ajoc, ŋoŋe motec ɋâricne e ʒâʒâŋiŋ jaha qâfâuckerâ dâkâne ŋifec i ŋokac moc râcnehuc dâkâne ŋifec i âgo‐ticne râcneniŋ.”
Iŋuc mume motec ɋâricnere neŋgoc e motec‐ticnere busâqoc fekicne manahuc ŋicwofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Bomboŋ‐nane iŋuc misac, sifu motec ɋâricne e râcneniŋ, qapie mi hâmooc!” Eme âgonezi ine ʒiŋuc muwec: “Eki me noni mi rauckezeperec irec qâfâuckeniŋ!”
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi muwec: “Motec ɋâricne mi qâhâmoniŋ, ŋokac bâbâni dâŋ mujec e râcneniŋ, eki hâcne neŋgoc roro‐ticne ekac.”
Eme Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe ŋicwofuŋzi dâŋ weniŋuc erâ mutarawec irec biŋe manarâ ere hâwic‐jopawec. Jaŋe ʒiŋuc honembiŋ: Anutuzi maŋɋârâŋ tahackewecte mumutara gie sâcne baocmu.
Ŋicwofuŋ Salomo e Israe kikefuŋ sasawa guriŋ bajarewec.
Ehame ŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋe micnefâc‐ticne jumbiŋ: Zadokore ŋokâ Aʒaria e taha bapa juwec.
Sisare ŋokâ jahec Elihore â Ahia jahe qâqâreŋ ŋic jupic, eme Ahiludure ŋokâ Josafata eki dâŋ mumuŋic fekicne juwec.
Jojadare ŋokâ Benaja e momori jaŋere micne juwec erâ Zadoko â Abiata jahe taha bapa jupic.
Eme Nataŋte ŋokâ Aʒaria e mâreŋ dâkâne irec micne bapa jumbiŋ jaŋe qizec‐joparâ juwec. Eme Nataŋte ŋokâ moc ʒâŋene Ʒabudu e ŋicwofuŋte âgo juwec.
Ahisa e ŋicwofuŋte ficko wiac fowec i soŋaŋke jujec, â Abedare ŋokâ Adoniram eki ine ŋic jabane jaŋe kiŋaŋ gie bahuc jumbiŋ jaŋere soŋaŋ juwec.
Mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne irec micne bapa 12 jaŋe Israe mâreŋ sâcke‐fârerâ Salomo kiŋaŋ qacnehuc jumbiŋ. Jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ â wiacfâcne nânâ wiac bâfua‐jare jumbieŋ, micne bapa moczi mosa mocte biŋe â moczi mosa mocte bâfua jujec, iŋuczi iŋuc ejumbieŋ.
Jaŋere ʒâŋe biri ʒiŋuc: Moc Beŋ‐Hure, Eferaim tiki mâreŋko juwec.
Moc Beŋ‐Deke, e Makazi, Salabim, Bete‐Semesi, Eloŋ â Bete‐Hanaŋ hae soŋaŋ‐jopawec.
Moc Beŋ‐Hesede, e Aruboti haeo juhuc Soko hae â Hefere mâreŋ mâmâc soŋaŋ‐jopawec.
Moc Beŋ‐Abinada, e Salomore otâ Tafati roweczi Doro hae mâreŋ soŋaŋke‐fârewec.
Moc Ahiludure ŋokâ Bana ere hae mâreŋ ʒiŋuc: Tanaki â Megido erâ Bete‐Seaŋ sasawa. I Zaretaŋ hae heririŋnao Jesere juwicnaopec forawec. Hae mâreŋ‐ticne i Bete‐Seaŋnec raku Abe‐Mehola haeo, Jokemeam hae ocniŋucnao fisiwec hâcne.
Moc Beŋ‐Gebe, e Ramoti haeo Gileade mâreŋko juwec. Ehuc Manasere ŋokâ Jairi ere haefâc Gileade mâreŋko ŋerambiŋ â Arigoba hae mâreŋ Basaŋ mâreŋko forawec i mâmâc soŋaŋ‐jopawec. I hae 60 jaŋe sacsanaŋ â aeŋzi motâc babasanaŋ‐jeŋichec.
Moc ine Idore ŋokâ Ahinada e Mahanaim haeo juwec.
Moc Ahimazi, e Naftali mâreŋ soŋaŋkewec. Ŋokac‐ticne Salomore otâ moc ʒâŋene Basemata.
Moc Husaire ŋokâ Bana, e Ase â Aloti mâreŋ i jahere soŋaŋ juwec.
Moc Paruare ŋokâ Josafata, e Isasa mâreŋko juwec.
Moc Elare ŋokâ Simei, e Benjamiŋ mâreŋ soŋaŋkewec.
Erâ moc ine Urire ŋokâ Gebe, eki Gileade mâreŋko juhuc Amori ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ â Basaŋ mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ Ogo jahere mâreŋ fowec i soŋaŋkewec. Ehame micne bapa moczi micne bapa keci jaŋe qâhâc‐jopa‐fârewec.
Eme Juda â Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe fua sawec eku hâwecmecko moŋgeŋ forakac irec sâc embiŋ. Jaŋe nânâ opâ moc mi basahuc bubiaŋ faio jumbiŋ hâcne.
Eme Salomozi uucmaŋ gurune gurune Eufrata opâonec fuŋkerâ raku Filisa mâreŋko fisirâ Aigita mâreŋte mao hu tarawec, i jaŋe soŋaŋ‐jopahuc juwec. Eme jaŋe juwec sâc sahac taha wiac râcnehuc kiŋaŋ qacnehuc jumbiŋ.
Ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne Salomo nânâ wiac ʒiŋuc bafisicnembiŋ: Poroŋ uucne qaŋqaŋ târu 30, erâ poroŋ uucne gâgâpâc târu 60,
bulimakao wokemaŋ sâkohec 10 erâ bulimakao sapa sâkoonec 20, erâ lama 100. Erâ wâc kâte qowi gâcne nânâne â qâqâc wiac wokemaŋ sâkohec mâmâc.
E Eufrata opâ ʒiŋucpec Tifisa haeonec fuŋkerâ raku Gaza haeo tarakac mâreŋ ŋondeŋ ira ŋicwofuŋ jurambiŋ jaŋe soŋaŋ‐jopa‐fârewec. Ehame ŋifec â ŋifec jumbiŋ jaŋerao wâc wama sâko fowec.
Ehame Juda â Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe Salomozi juwec sâc Daŋ mâreŋkonec huraku Bere‐Seba haeo tarawec ŋondeŋ ira mana mezac tâmiric juhuc waiŋ gie â jâmbo jufu wiac‐jeŋic soŋaŋkehuc jumbiŋ.
Eme Salomo e keretac fâfâre becâsic 40 tauseŋ domacnembiŋ erâ becâsicko rara momori ŋic 12 tauseŋ jucnembiŋ.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Salomo â ŋic ehec juhuc nânâ nâjumbieŋ jaŋere nânâ i micne bapa mucjopakicne jaŋe ru sâc moczi mosa mocte â moczi mosa mocte nânâ iŋuc bâfuapie wiac moc mi basa‐jâmbâŋkembiŋ.
Eme gie mujarekicne sâc becâsic jaŋere nânâ wiac i jumbiŋkoa bafisi‐jare jumbieŋ.
Eme Anutuzi Salomo mamana sâko â maŋɋârâŋ bâfuacnehuc maŋticne bâsokame mamana‐ticnezi ʒâkâŋ ɋârâŋ iŋucne ewec.
Eme Salomore maŋɋârâŋzi ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec ŋic jumbiŋ jaŋere maŋɋârâŋ me Aigita ŋic jaŋere maŋɋârâŋ i mâmâc siricke‐fârewec.
Ere mamanazi ŋic gâcne jaŋere mamana jâuru‐fârewec. Eʒarai ŋic ʒâŋene Etaŋ ere mamana mecne, Maholare ŋokâfâc Hemaŋ, Kalokolo â Daroda jaŋere mamana mecne i mâmâc jâuruwecte ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnezi ŋicne ŋicne rârec rârec jurambiŋ jaŋerao haŋ bafârewec.
E muqâqiŋ dâŋ 3 tauseŋ mufuarâ gae hefuakume 1 tauseŋ 5 iŋuc ewec.
E wiac fuŋne fuŋne jaŋere dâŋ mufuawec. Jâc jaŋere dâŋ i jâmâzâc Lebanoŋ tikio doma rakac irecnec fuŋkerâ mu wahaku kueŋ kueŋ jâcko fuaekac erao mutarawec. E qowi kâcɋene jaŋere dâŋ, wipe jaŋere dâŋ, erâ wiac foforâ jueŋgopieŋ â opâ qowi jaŋere dâŋ i mufârewec.
Mâreŋ sâc ŋicne ŋicne â ŋicwofuŋ jurambiŋ jaŋe Salomo maŋɋârâŋ‐ticnere biŋe manambiŋte irec fuŋne mananiŋte erao fisimbiŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Salomo mamac‐ticnere tuc qaocte ŋicwofuŋ âkendâŋnembiŋ irec biŋe i Tiro ŋicwofuŋ Hiramzi manawec. E maŋticnezi dameŋ sâc Dawidirao domawec. Irec kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne gâcne jaŋe Salomorao sorec‐jopame rambiŋ.
Eme Salomozi okacne dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnehuc ŋic gâcne Hiramtao sorec‐jopawec wâc:
“Go mamac‐nane Dawidire fuŋne manakomec. E Wofuŋ Anutu‐ticnere biŋe fic moc baocte maŋkewec. Mâc rârec rârec ʒikazi ʒika forawecte fic i baocte quŋkewec. Ʒâhec ine Wofuŋzi râsifâc‐ticne bawahac‐jopaocte manacnewec.
Eme dameŋ ʒi Wofuŋ Anutu‐nanezi rârec rârec wama sâko bâfua‐nareme râsifâc‐nane mi juŋgopieŋ â aka wâc mi fokac.
Erâ manakic, Wofuŋzi mamac‐nane Dawidi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘No gore âkehoc ŋokâge eri ŋeŋegao râepe ŋeocmu eki ʒâŋe‐nanere fic moc baocmu,’ dâŋ irec sâcko no Wofuŋ Anutu‐nanere biŋe fic moc bazo mukopac.
Irec go mutec ŋicfâcge jaŋe Lebanoŋ tikio jâmâzâc nore biŋe qafarapie kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe bafic‐jopanʒepieŋ; eme no kiŋaŋŋicfâcge jaŋere gie furi i goki mutec sâc râe‐garezepac. Go gahac wâc manakic, Sidoŋŋic jaŋe jâc qaqafarare fuŋne mana‐hâmoeŋgopieŋ, nâŋere ŋicfâc jaŋe ine mi manaeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme Hiram e Salomore dâŋ i manarâ bubiaŋ sâko manahuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ʒoaŋ ʒi Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkezo! Eki hâcne Dawidi ŋokâ moc mamanahec tahackewecte ŋic ŋokac guru sâko sâcne soŋaŋ‐jopaocmu.”
Iŋuc murâ Hiramzi Salomo dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go dâŋ râe‐naremec i manapac. Go jâmâzâc â wetejâc irec dâŋ nazamec i egarekac sâc epemu.
Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe jâc i Lebanoŋ tikionec bawaharâ hâwecmecko râeniŋmu. Eme mupe jâcombâŋne qâturepie ʒae fuame hâwecko bahuku hae mutâcnecmu ira râeniŋmu. Eme hetâtiepie goki ine okacne narehuc no â wiacfâc‐nane nâŋe nânâ wiac bâfua‐nârezemec.”
Eme Hiram e Salomozi muwec irec sâcko jâmâzâc â wetejâc râecnehuc juwec.
Eme Salomo e Hiram okacne bazucnehuc wiacfâc‐ticne jaŋere manasuhuc padi târu 20 tauseŋ â oliwa qanʒaŋnekicne irec pake 20 tauseŋ jaha râcnewec. Jara sâc iŋuc râcnehuc juwec.
Ehame Wofuŋzi Salomo mupaŋkecnewec sâc maŋɋârâŋ bâfuacnewec; eme Hiram â Salomo jahere ŋondeŋko wama fowecte ʒâʒâfic moc epic.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Salomozi Israe kikefuŋ jaŋeraonec ŋic 30 tauseŋ kiŋaŋ qaqa gie baniŋte bâwosâec‐jopawec.
Erâ mosa sâc ŋic 10 tauseŋ Lebanoŋ tiki mâreŋko sorec‐jopame rajumbieŋ. Jaŋe ira mosa wâŋ juku risierâ mosa 2 hae‐jeŋicko jujumbieŋ. Ehame Adoniramzi soŋaŋ‐jopahuc juwec.
Eme ŋic 70 tauseŋ jaŋe Salomore mafa wiac hâpo jumbieŋ, â ŋic 80 tauseŋ jaŋe ine tikio qânâ qâfâucke jumbieŋ.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, jaŋerao ŋic micne 3 tauseŋ 300 ʒuhuckerâ jumbiŋ. Jaŋe gie qizeckehuc ŋic gie bahapie hone soŋaŋ ejare jumbieŋ.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi giedâŋ mujareme sâc ficte hobeteŋ râezore qânâ kâcɋene â furi sâko he bâfâuc ehuc ropie warewec.
Ehame Salomo â Hiram jahere fic bapa ŋic â Gebali ŋic jaŋe fic bazore qânâ wiac mecne â jâc wiac mecne i he fasaec ehuc ba akic efârembiŋ hâcne.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec waharâ juwefukupie jara 480 eha Salomozi Israe ŋic jaŋerao ŋicwofuŋ gie bahuc juhame jara 3 â mosa 2 ewec, mosa ʒâŋene Ʒiwi, dameŋ ira hâcne Salomozi fuŋkerâ Wofuŋte ufuŋ bawec.
Ŋicwofuŋ Salomozi Wofuŋte ufuŋ bawec irec sâc ʒiŋuc: Ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc kubi 60, otecne‐ticnere sâc kubi 20, hâŋ bafekicne ine kubi 30 irec sâc.
Eme fic fârinao hae gâŋgâŋ moc bawec irec otecnere sâc kubi 20, â fic mainao ʒuhuckewec irec sâc kubi 10.
Eme râreckehuc qâqâtâc kataŋ râewec, râpenao bâpitiwawec â maŋnao ine bâsokawec.
Erâ fic fârine â furufic i orâŋkehuc fic ʒuhucne barâ maŋne maŋne âke tâcne rawec.
Fic ʒuhucne i feŋgaŋne 3. Juwic otec‐ticnere sâc kubi 5, ʒâʒâŋiŋko 6 â feŋgaŋne faicpec irec otecnere sâc kubi 7. Fic sâpenao feŋgaŋne feŋgaŋne raʒi fowec ira jâc otecne mâc iticnehuc râe rakicne.
Eme taha ufuŋ bambiŋko mâsi ʒiŋuc fuawec: Qânâ wiac i qanaŋ ba akic efârekicnere ufuŋ bahapie hama me râric me aeŋ wiacte fânâŋ moc mi fuawec.
Ficʒuhuc juwicnere motâc i fic fâreopec domawec, eme irecnec riri oorâŋ râreckehuc bakicne i feŋgaŋne ʒâʒâŋiŋko fewec, eme irecnec riri moczi feŋgaŋne faicpec fewec.
Salomo e iŋuc ehuc fic baku bafârerâ fic tapane ine jâmâzâc jâczi bawec.
Erâ e fic orâŋkehuc ʒuʒuhucne bafârewec wâc, feŋgaŋne moc i hâŋne‐ticne kubi 5, erâ fic i jâmâzâc â wetejâczi basanaŋkewec.
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ Salomorao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋoŋe dâŋsanaŋ‐nane bâninipehuc mumutâc â sâcmutâc dâŋnane mana rereŋ erâ hata mutâcne‐ŋarepo sâc wiac ebac efâreniŋmuo ine no go â mamacge Dawidi findaŋdâŋ ŋasapo i mupe fârio qaocmu.
Ehame no Israe ŋicfâc‐nane ŋoŋere ŋondeŋko juhuc moc mi behec‐ŋopapemu.”
Eme Salomo e Wofuŋte fic baku bâzickewec.
Eme ɋâriŋkonec fuŋkerâ feku faic tapanao fisiwec fic sâpene i jâmâzâc paraŋzi foŋke‐fârerâ ɋâriŋne i wete paraŋzi bârârâŋnewec.
Eme ficmaŋne râpenaopec ira jâmâzâc paraŋzi ficmaŋne moc âke tâcnewec, i sâcticne kubi 20. Paraŋ‐ticne i ɋâriŋkonec feku fic tapanao iticnewec. Ficmaŋne izi furu dindiŋ hâcne.
Eme ficmaŋne irecnec ficmaŋne fârine ʒuhuckerâ rawec i sâcticne kubi 40.
Ficmaŋne i jâmâzâc paraŋzi foŋke‐fârekicnere qânâ hohonene moc mi ewec. Eme jâczi hândâŋ qarâ fâuckeme âri fuaekac irec sâc hawari paraŋko metâ barakicne.
Eme Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapa irec ŋeŋe hae fuaocte ficmaŋne râpenaopec furu dindiŋ irec maŋne âke tâcnewec hâcne.
Ficmaŋne irec ʒoricne â otecne kubi 20, â hâŋnere kubi 20 jaha. Eme irec paraŋ i gol findowakicnezi foŋke‐fârewec erâ ficmaŋne irec motâc fuŋnao ira jâmâzâc jâczi alata moc barâ râewec.
Erâ Salomo e ficmaŋne i gol findowakicnezi foŋke‐fârerâ furu dindiŋ irec mainao kâpâcwâru moc golzi bakicne i fârewec.
Ine hâcne ficmaŋne sasawa i golzi foŋkeku foŋke‐fârewec. Erâ alata furu dindiŋte motâc fuŋnao ŋewec i golzia wâc foŋkewec.
Eme furu dindiŋte biŋe kerubim jajahec jahere hawari i oliwa jâczi bacjofawec. Ʒoricne‐jekicte sâc i kubi 10.
Eme kerubim mocte fakec ŋifec â ŋifec i kubi 5. Irec fakec jajahec jahere sâc i kubi 10 ewec.
Eme kerubim moc ere sâc i kubi 10 jaha. Kerubim jajahec jahere sâc â hawari mocjaha.
Â ʒoricne‐jekicte sâc i wâc mocjaha, kubi 10.
Kerubim jajahec i furu dindiŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋnao râec‐jofame domapic. Eme kerubim jahere fakec qaratierâ domapic irec mocte fakec ŋifeczi ficsâpe ŋifecne âke uawec â mocte fakec ŋifeczi sâpe ŋifecne âke uawec wâc. Â fafakec jahec‐jekiczi ʒâʒâŋiŋko bâbâfuac epic.
Eme kerubim jahec i golzi foŋjofawec wâc.
Eme Salomozi mume metâ bapa jaŋe fic sâpene sasawa i kerubim â hâmujâc erâ âri wiac irec hawari bapie sâcke‐fârewec, i furu dindiŋ ira mecne â furufic ira wâc mâmâc.
Erâ mume furu dindiŋ â furufic irec ɋâriŋ i golzi foŋke‐fârembiŋ.
Furu dindiŋte motâc i mume oliwa jâczi bambiŋ. Kataŋ‐ticne jajahec â wâtuŋ wiac‐ticne i ba akic epie tikine 5 ewec.
Ine hâcne, motâc kataŋ jajahec i oliwa jâczi bakicne, eme jahere faio ine kerubim â hâmujâc erâ âri wiac irec hawari metâ barâ golzi foŋke‐fârembiŋ.
Eme mume tiri ufuŋte motâc irec wâtuŋ i oliwa jâczia bambiŋ wâc, wâtuŋ irec tikine 4.
Â motâc kataŋ jahec‐ticne i mume wete paraŋzi bambiŋ, eme kataŋ moc e ki otec‐ticne jajahec â kataŋ moc e iŋuc jaha bambiŋ.
Erâ mume kerubim â hâmujâc erâ âri wiac irec hawari metâ bapie hawarine fuawec sâc golzi foŋke‐fârembiŋ.
Eme ufuŋ râreckerâ hae ʒoŋa piticne fowec i qânâ he akic ekicne feŋgaŋne 3 â jâmâzâc jâc feŋgaŋne wâŋ iŋuc râerâ bambiŋ.
Salomozi ŋicwofuŋ jume jara 4 irec mosa ʒâŋene Ʒiwi ira Wofuŋte ufuŋ fuŋkerâ bambiŋ.
Eme juhame jara 11 irec mosa 8 ʒâŋene Bulu wahaha ufuŋ â wiac‐ticne sâcmutâc fowec irec sâc râe tara‐fârerâ bâzickembiŋ. Jara 7 baku batarambiŋ hâcne.
Eme Salomozi jara 13 e jahacne ficwiac baku bafârewec.
