Rubeŋ â Gade jahere ɋâricfâc erâ Manase guru dâkâne jaŋeraonec 44 tauseŋ 760 jaŋe ŋic hâhâwicmâc, â ʒikafac jâmbâŋ, erâ maro â ʒika â tepe wiac‐jeŋichec juhuc ʒikare ʒawiembiŋ.
Eme jaŋe Hagiri ŋic, â Jeturu, Nafisi â Nodaba ŋic jaŋehec qaqac embiŋ.
Eme râsi jaŋe Rubeŋ, Gade â Manase guru dâkâne jopaniŋte babafic epie guru jajahec â nâfocne jaŋe ʒikaoa domahuc Anutu kio wâwâsic ecnepie eki erao râŋkembiŋte mana‐jarehuc Hagiri ŋic â bafic‐jopambiŋ ŋic guru i jaŋe Israe ŋic jaŋere meo râec‐jopawec.
Eme qowifâc‐jeŋic ʒiŋuc bacjopa rambiŋ: Kamele 50 tauseŋ â lama 250 tauseŋ â doŋgi 2 tauseŋ, erâ ŋic ɋâricne 100 tauseŋ iŋuc bacjopa rambiŋ.
Anutuzi ʒika gie bawecte erâ ŋic bocjahazi hâmombiŋ. Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere hae mâreŋko jukuhapie kâpâcwâru dameŋ‐jeŋic maickewec.
Manase guru dâkâne jaŋe fua sawec mâretec ehuc mâreŋ ʒiŋuc ira ŋeŋe juju embiŋ: Basaŋ, Baali‐Herimoŋ, Seniri â Herimoŋ tiki.
Eme garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc irec micne ine ʒiŋuc: Efere, Isi, Eliele, Aʒariele, Jeremia, Hodawia â Jadiele. Ŋic i jaŋe garikiŋ sâc irec micne juhuc ʒâŋe biŋe rarahec â momori wânʒâŋ jujumbieŋ.
Erâ jaŋe apa ŋosafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere Anutu e sindaŋ ecnehuc, eki ʒâŋe fai‐jeŋicko mâreŋ rune jopa jâpec ejarewec jaŋere nemuɋâŋ wiac irec sasec sâko bâfuahuc ira siŋkembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Israere Anutuzi Asiria ŋicwofuŋ Puli, ʒâŋe‐ticne moc Tigela‐Pilese, e ecneme fisirâ Rubeŋ â Gade jahere ɋâricfâc â Manase guru dâkâne jaŋe bacjopa rawec. Bacjopa rarâ Hala, Haboro, Hara â Goʒaŋ opâ ira guruc‐jopawec juŋgopieŋ.
Lewire ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Geresom, Kohati â Merari.
Eme Kohatire ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Amaram, Izara, Heboroŋ â Uʒiele.
Eme Amaramte ɋâricfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Aroŋ, Mose â Miriam. Eme Aroŋte ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Nadaba, Abihu, Eleaʒa â Itama.
Eme Eleaʒa e Pinehasire mamac â Pinehasi e ine Abisuare mamac.
Eme Abisua e Bukire mamac â Buki e ine Uʒire mamac.
Eme Uʒi e Ʒerahiare mamac â Ʒerahia e ine Merajotire mamac.
Eme Merajoti e Amariare mamac â Amaria e ine Ahitibure mamac.
Eme Ahitibu e Zadokore mamac â Zadoko e ine Ahimazire mamac.
Eme Ahimazi e Aʒariare mamac â Aʒaria e ine Johanaŋte mamac.
Eme Johanaŋ e Aʒariare mamac. Eme eki hâne Jerusalem haeo Salomozi ufuŋ bawec ira taha bapa juwec.
Eme Aʒaria e Amariare mamac â Amaria e ine Ahitubure mamac.
Eme Ahitubu e Zadokore mamac â Zadoko e ine Salumte mamac.
Eme Salum e Hilikiare mamac â Hilikia e ine Aʒariare mamac.
Eme Aʒaria e Serajare mamac â Seraja e ine Jozadacte mamac.
Eme Wofuŋzi Juda â Jerusalem jahe Nebukanezare meo râec‐jofawec dameŋ ira Jozadac e kâpâcwâruo fewec.
Lewire ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Geresom, Kohati â Merari.
Eme Geresomte ŋokâ jahec jahere ʒâŋe ine ʒiŋuc: Libini â Simei.
Eme Kohatire ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Amaram, Izara, Heboroŋ â Uʒiele.
Eme Merarire ŋokâ jahec ine ʒiŋuc: Mali â Musi. Eme Lewire kikefuŋ jaŋe garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc ine ʒiŋuc:
Geresom, eme ere ŋokâ Libini â Libinire ŋokâ Jahati â Jahatire ŋokâ ine Ʒima.
Eme Ʒimare ŋokâ Joa â Joare ŋokâ Ido â Idore ŋokâ Ʒera â Ʒerare ŋokâ ine Jeateria.
Eme Kohatire ŋokâ ine Aminada, â Aminadare ŋokâ Kora â Korare ŋokâ ine Asiri.
Eme Asirire ŋokâ Elikana â Elikanare ŋokâ Ebiasafa â Ebiasafare ŋokâ ine Asiri.
Eme Asirire ŋokâ Tahati â Tahatire ŋokâ Uriele â Uriele ere ŋokâ Uʒia â Uʒiare ŋokâ ine Saulu.
Eme Elikanare ŋokâ jahec jahere ʒâŋe ine Amasai â Ahimoti.
Eme Ahimotire ŋokâ Elikana â Elikanare ŋokâ Zofai â Zofaire ŋokâ ine Nahati.
Eme Nahatire ŋokâ Eliaba â Eliabare ŋokâ Jeroham â Jerohamte ŋokâ ine Elikana.
Eme Samuere ŋokâ jahec jahere ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc: Mârâc ŋokâ Joele, eme ere râpeo ine Abia.
Eme Merarire ŋokâ ine Mali, â Malire ŋokâ Libini â Libinire ŋokâ Simei â Simeire ŋokâ ine Uʒa.
Eme Uʒare ŋokâ Simea â Simeare ŋokâ Hagai â Hagaire ŋokâ ine Asaja.
Ʒâʒâfic katapazi ŋesanaŋkeme jufehuc Dawidizi Wofuŋte ufuŋko gae gie baniŋte ŋic ʒi jaŋe râec‐jopawec.
Eme jaŋe tutumaŋte qoruc boze ira gie bahuc juhapie juku Salomozi Jerusalem haeo Wofuŋte ufuŋ bawec. Jaŋe gie‐jeŋic i ââkehocko bahuc jumbiŋ.
Ŋic â ŋokâfâc‐jeŋic ʒi jaŋe gie bahuc jumbiŋ: Kohatire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋe: Gae hehe ŋic Hemaŋ, e Joele ŋokâ‐ticne, Samuere ŋosa hâcne.
Eme Samue e Elikanare ŋokâ â Elikana e Joramte ŋokâ â Joram e Eliele ere ŋokâ â Eliele e ine Toare ŋokâ.
Eme Toa e Zufure ŋokâ â Zufu e Elikanare ŋokâ â Elikana e Mahatare ŋokâ â Mahata e ine Amasaire ŋokâ.
Eme Amasai e Elikanare ŋokâ â Elikana e Joele ere ŋokâ â Joele e Aʒariare ŋokâ â Aʒaria e ine Zefaniare ŋokâ.
Eme Zefania e Tahatire ŋokâ â Tahati e Asirire ŋokâ â Asiri e Ebiasafare ŋokâ â Ebiasafa e ine Korare ŋokâ.
Eme Kora e Izarare ŋokâ â Izara e Kohatire ŋokâ â Kohati e Lewire ŋoka â Lewi e ine Israere ŋokâ.
Ehame qomâ‐ticne Berekiare ŋokâ Asafa e Hemaŋte fâreo domawec. Berekia e Simeare ŋokâ.
Eme Simea e Mikaere ŋokâ â Mikae e Basejare ŋokâ â Baseja e ine Malikiare ŋokâ.
Eme Malikia e Etenire ŋokâ â Eteni e Ʒerare ŋokâ â Ʒera e ine Adajare ŋokâ.
Eme Adaja e Etaŋte ŋokâ â Etaŋ e Ʒimare ŋokâ â Ʒima e ine Simeire ŋokâ.
Eme Simei e Jahatire ŋokâ â Jahati e Geresomte ŋokâ â Geresom e ine Lewire ŋokâ.
Ehame qanaopec ine qomâfâc‐jekic Merarire ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec Kisire ŋokâ Etaŋ eki micne domawec. Eme Kisi e Abadire ŋokâ â Abadi e ine Malukure ŋokâ.
Eme Maluku e Hasabiare ŋokâ â Hasabia e Amaziare ŋokâ.
Eme Hilikia e Amazire ŋokâ, Amazi e Banire ŋokâ â Bani e ine Semere ere ŋokâ.
Semere e Malire ŋokâ â Mali e Musire ŋokâ, Musi e Merarire ŋokâ â Merari e ine Lewire ŋokâ.
Ehame Lewiŋic qomâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe Anuture ufuŋ qoruc bozeo gie sasawa i baniŋte âkendâŋ‐jopakicne.
Eme Aroŋte ŋokâfâc jaŋe Anuture kiŋaŋŋic Mosezi mutâcne‐jarewec irec sâcko Israe ŋic jaŋere erâ furu dindiŋte gie bahuc alatao qowi bâzi â hosâc âsu rike jumbieŋ.
Eme Aroŋte ŋokâ ine Eleaʒa â Eleaʒare ŋokâ Pinehasi â Pinehasire ŋokâ ine Abisua,
â Abisuare ŋokâ Buki â Bukire ŋokâ Uʒi â Uʒire ŋokâ ine Ʒerakia.
Eme Ʒerakiare ŋokâ Merajoti â Merajotire ŋokâ Amaria â Amariare ŋokâ ine Ahitubu.
Eme Ahitubure ŋokâ Zadoko â Zadokore ŋokâ ine Ahimazi.
Mâreŋ majeŋickoa hae mâreŋ ro rauc embiŋ sâc hae‐jeŋic ʒiŋuc ŋerawec: Aroŋte ɋâricfâc, Kohatire garikiŋ hâcne, jaŋere ɋâsâi qambiŋ.
Ehuc Juda mâreŋko Heboroŋ hae ŋewec i mecne â rârec rârec mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec forawec i mâmâc jarembiŋ.
Ehuc hae irec hesarac mâreŋ â hae piic piic ine Jefune ŋokâ‐ticne Kalebe râcnembiŋ.
Eme Aroŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe ŋeŋezic hae â mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec ʒiŋuc jarembiŋ: Heboroŋ, Libina, Jatiri â Esitemoa,
Hileŋ, Debiri;
Asaŋ â Bete‐Semesi.
Eme Benjamiŋ guru jaŋeraonec ine Geba, Alemeti â Anatoti hae iŋuc jarembiŋ. Iŋuc ejarepie garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc hae‐jeŋic 13 ŋerawec.
Eme Kohati guru gâcne sâko jaŋere ɋâsâi mocwâc qahuc Manase guru dâkâne jaŋeraonec hae 10 jarembiŋ.
Eme Isasa, Ase, Naftali â Manase jaŋeraonec ine Basaŋ mâreŋko hae 13 Geresomte ɋâricfâc garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc jarembiŋ.
Eme Rubeŋ, Gade â Sebuloŋ guru jaŋeraonec ine hae 12 Merarire ɋâricfâc garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc jarembiŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Lewi guru hae â mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec iŋuc hâcne jarembiŋ.
Erâ Juda, Simeoŋ â Benjamiŋ guru jaŋeraonec hae faic mukicne i wâc iŋuc jaha ɋâsâi qahuc jarembiŋ.
Eme Kohatire ŋokâfâc jaŋere garikiŋfâc gâcne jaŋe Eferaim guruo mâreŋ jarekicne ira hae rombiŋ.
Jaŋe ŋeŋezic hae ʒiŋuc hâcne jarekicne: Eferaim tiki mâreŋko Sikem hae i mâreŋ sopâc kecɋâŋhec â Geʒera hae i wâc mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec,
Jokemeam hae i mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec, Bete‐Horoŋ hae i wâc mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec â Gatirimoŋ hae i wâc mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec.
Erâ Ajaloŋ hae i mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec â Gate‐Rimoŋ hae i wâc mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec.
Eme Manase guru dâkâne jaŋeraonec hae â mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec Kohatire ɋâricfâc gâcne sâko ʒiŋuc jarembiŋ: Anera â Bileam.
Eme Geresomte ɋâricfâc jaŋe ine Manase guru dâkâne jaŋeraonec hae â mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec ʒiŋuc jarembiŋ: Basaŋ mâreŋko Golaŋ â Asitaroto.
Eme Isasa guru jaŋeraonec hae â mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec ine ʒiŋuc: Kedesi â Daberata,
Ramoti â Anem.
Eme Ase guru jaŋeraonec hae â mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec ine ʒiŋuc: Masali â Abadoŋ,
Hukoko â Rehobo.
Eme Naftali guru jaŋeraonec hae â mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec ine ʒiŋuc jarembiŋ: Galilaia mâreŋko Kedesi hae i â Hamoŋ erâ Kiriataim.
Eme Merarire ɋâricfâc gâcne sâko jaŋe Sebuloŋ guru jaŋeraonec hae â mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec ine ʒiŋuc jarembiŋ: Rimono â Taboro.
Erâ Jordaŋ ŋifecnao ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec Jeriko hae ŋewecko ine Rubeŋ guru jaŋeraonec hae â mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec ʒiŋuc jarembiŋ: Mâreŋ burocnao Bezere hae â Jaza
erâ Kedemoti â Mefata.
Eme Gade guru jaŋeraonec hae â mâreŋ sopâc kecɋaŋhec ine ʒiŋuc jarembiŋ: Gileade mâreŋko Ramoti hae i â Mahanaim,
erâ Hesiboŋ â Jazere.
Isasare ŋokâfâc jahec â jahec jaŋere ʒâŋe ine ʒiŋuc: Tola, Pua, Jasubu â Simoroŋ.
Eme Tolare ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Uʒi, Refaja, Jerile, Jamai, Ibesam â Semue. Ŋic jaŋe hâcne gaŋne gaŋne fua sawec ewefumbiŋ sâc jaŋere micne â momori wânʒâŋ jâmbâŋ jumbiŋ. Eme Dawidire dameŋko jaŋere ʒarezi 22 tauseŋ 600 ewec.
Eme Uʒire ŋokâ ine Iʒirahia. Eme Iʒirahiare ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Mikae, Obadia, Joele â Isia, jaŋe memoczi ŋic fekicne jumbiŋ.
Eme kikefuŋ‐jeŋicko ʒuhuckerâ fua wefumbiŋ sâc momori guru 36 tauseŋ jumbiŋ. Ŋic i jaŋe ŋonâŋ â ŋokâfâc‐jeŋic bocjaha jujarembiŋ.
Eme Isasare garikiŋfâc soctofafâc‐jeŋic gaŋne gaŋne fua wefumbiŋ sâc ŋic momori wânʒâŋ wosec‐jopakicne ʒare‐jeŋic 87 tauseŋ.
Benjamiŋte ŋokâfâc jahec â moc jaŋere ʒâŋe ine ʒiŋuc: Bela, Bekere â Jediae.
Eme Belare ŋokâfâc memoc jaŋere ʒâŋe ine ʒiŋuc: Eziboŋ, Uʒi, Uʒiele, Jerimoti â Iri. Jaŋe kikefuŋ‐jeŋicko micne juhuc momori wânʒâŋ jumbiŋ. Eme gaŋne gaŋne fua wefumbiŋ sâc biric‐jopapie ʒare‐jeŋic 22 tauseŋ 34 ewec.
Eme Bekere ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Ʒemira, Joasi, Elieʒe, Elioenai, Omiri, Jeremoti, Abia, Anatoti â Alemeti.
Ŋic i jaŋe Bekere ŋokâfâc sasawa. Jaŋe kikefuŋ‐jeŋicko micne juhuc momori wânʒâŋ jumbiŋ. Eme gaŋne gaŋne fua wefumbiŋ sâc biric‐jopapie ŋic momori wânʒâŋ ʒare‐jeŋic 20 tauseŋ 200 ewec.
Eme Jediae ŋokâ‐ticne ine Bilihaŋ; â Bilihaŋte ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Jeusi, Benjamiŋ, Ehudu, Kenana, Ʒetaŋ, Tarasisi â Ahisaha.
Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne Jediae ere ŋokâfâc sasawa; jaŋe kikefuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao micne juhuc momori wânʒâŋ jumbiŋ. Eme gaŋne gaŋne fua wefumbiŋ sâc ʒikare baʒawiec‐jopakicne ʒare‐jeŋic 17 tauseŋ 200 ewec.
Eme Supim â Hupim jahe ine Irire ŋokâ jahec, â Husim e ine Aherire ŋokâ.

Eme Makirizi Hupim â Supim jahere seŋ ŋonâŋ‐ticne rowec, ʒâŋene Maka. Eme motec mocwâc ʒuhuckerâ fuawec, ʒâŋene Zelafiha. Eme Zelafiha e otâfâcne sasawa fuambiŋ.

Eme Eferaimzi ŋonâŋ‐ticne mocwâc iqickeme ŋokâ moc kiweckerâ rowec. Rome wiac hâhâwicnezi kikefuŋ‐ticnao fuawecte ʒâŋene Beria muwec.

Eme Lewiŋic jaŋeraonec ine ʒiŋuc: Hasubure ŋokâ Semaja, Hasubu e Aʒarikamte ŋokâ â Aʒarikam e ine Hasabiare ŋokâ. Semaja e Merarire ɋâric moc.

Eme haere sacmotâc soŋaŋ ine ʒiŋuc: Salum, Akubu, Talimoŋ â Ahimaŋ, eme soctofa‐jeŋic Salumzi ine jaŋere fekicne juwec.
Ŋic i jaŋe ŋicwofuŋte haesac ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec i soŋaŋkehuc juniŋte mujarekicne. Jaŋe Lewiŋic jaŋere hae turuŋne irec haere sacmotâc soŋaŋ jumbiŋ hâcne.
Eme Korere ŋokâ Salum, apa ŋosa jahec‐ticne Ebiasafa â Kora e mecne erâ apa ŋosafâcne jaŋere kikefuŋfâc, soctofafâc‐ticne Koraŋic hâcne, jaŋe gie i ruckerâ qoruc bozere motâc soŋaŋkehuc jumbiŋ. Jaŋe apa ŋosafâc‐jeŋic jaŋe Wofuŋte teuŋ i ruckerâ motâc‐ticne soŋaŋke jumbieŋ irec sâc jaha ehuc jumbiŋ hâcne.
Eme Eleaʒare ŋokâ Pinehasi e Wofuŋzi ehec juhame juwicnao Israe ŋic qaŋeŋ‐jopahuc juwec.
Eme Meselemiare ŋokâ Ʒekaria e qoruc boze irec motâc soŋaŋ juwec.
Eme motâcko soŋaŋ juniŋte bâwosâec‐jopakicne sasawa jaŋere ʒare 212 ewec. Jaŋe hae‐jeŋicko gaŋne gaŋne fua wefumbiŋ sâc biric‐jopakicne. Eme Dawidi â micne Samue jahe mana‐jarepire sâckeme gie ira râec‐jopapic.
Eme irec jaŋe jaŋacne â ŋokâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe Wofuŋte ufuŋ, qoruc boze hâcne, irec motâc soŋaŋ gie i qizeckerâ jumbiŋ.
Ehuc haere sacmotâc ʒoaŋ wewefunao â huhunao, erâ faic â juwic fowec i soŋaŋkehuc jumbiŋ.
Ehame soctofafâc‐jeŋic hae boze‐jeŋicko jurambiŋ jaŋe dameŋ sâc ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarame fisirâ bafic‐jopaniŋte mujarekicne.
Eme Lewi guruonec haere sacmotâc soŋaŋ micne jahec â jahec jaŋe Wofuŋte ufuŋ maŋne maŋne â ira wiac furi sâko forawec i qizeckerâ soŋaŋkembiŋ.
Ehuc Anuture ufuŋ i râreckehuc ira ŋeŋe juju embiŋ. Ufuŋ hone soŋaŋ ee â furic sâc motâc roro gie i jaŋere faio fowec hâcne.
Eme jaŋeraonec ŋic gâcne jaŋe râqâc wiac soŋaŋkehuc batac bawarec epie sâc woseniŋte mujarekicne.
Ehame gâcne jaŋe ine ŋeŋe â râqâc tirine â poroŋ uucne â waiŋ â wokemaŋ â hosâc âsu ririkere wiac â âsu biaŋ gâcne i soŋaŋkeniŋte âkendâŋ‐jopakicne.
Ehame taha bapa jaŋeraonec gâcne jaŋe wiac âsu biaŋ i râe bâmoc ehuc jâricke jumbieŋ.

Eme Filisa ŋic jaŋe Israe ŋic jaŋehec qaqac eku Israe ŋic jaŋe wisepie Giliboa tikio qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ.
Erâ Filisa ŋic jaŋe Saulo â ŋokâfâcne jâpec‐jopahuc kikeo kikeo ejarembiŋ. Ehuc Saulore ŋokâfâc Jonataŋ, Abinada â Malikisua qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ.
Eme râsi jaŋe Saulo bâqiŋkehuc kikeo kikeo ecnehapie tepeŋic gâcne jaŋe bâfuarâ ʒâpâ murumbiŋ.
Murupie Saulozi maro babaju‐ticne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Sahac tofa‐jeŋic mi hezukicne ʒi jaŋe fisirâ mu ruruc enarenʒipiŋte go sânduge rorâ izi âke‐hâmocnuc.” Eme maro babaju‐ticne e hâwicke sâqoreme wiac iŋucne eocte mi afeckewec. Irec Saulo e jahacne sându rorâ âkendâŋnehuc micnao hewâcnewec.
Eme maro babaju‐ticne e Saulozi hâmome honerâ iŋuc jaha sându‐ticne rorâ âkendâŋnehuc micnao hewâcneme mâmâc jaha hâmopic.
Iŋuc ehuc Saulo e jahacne â ŋokâfâcne jahec â moc erâ wiacfâc‐ticne mâmâc jaha hâmombiŋ.
Ehame Israe ŋic wâneŋko jumbiŋ jaŋe momorifâc‐jeŋic wisembiŋ i honec‐jopambiŋ, ehuc Saulo â ŋokâfâcne hâmombiŋ irec biŋe manarâ hae‐jeŋic behe‐fârerâ wisembiŋ. Wisepie Filisa ŋic jaŋe fisirâ ira ŋeŋe juju embiŋ.
Hae fureme Filisa ŋic jaŋe qâŋɋâŋ jaŋere ŋaqi qoruc wiac hetara‐jareniŋte fisirâ Saulo â ŋokâfâcne Giliboa tikio hâmocne fohapie honec‐jopambiŋ.
Honec‐joparâ Saulo e qizec‐ticne qâtâcnehuc maruku‐ticne hetaracnembiŋ. Iŋuc erâ kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopapie Filisa mâreŋ sâckerâ rahuc nemufâc‐jeŋic â ŋic ŋokac sâko jaŋerao biŋe biaŋ barambiŋ.
Eme Filisa ŋic jaŋe Saulore maruku i nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ufuŋko râembiŋ â qizec‐ticne ine Dagoŋ nemure ufuŋko ɋetickepie domawec.
Ehame Jabesi‐Gileade hae rune jaŋe Filisia ŋiczi Saulo wiac ecnembiŋ irec biŋe manambiŋ.
Manarâ ŋic tâpirihec jaŋe faharerâ Saulo â ŋokâfâcne jaŋere ɋâŋɋâŋ i rorâ Jabesi haeo bafisimbiŋ. Ehuc siec‐jeŋic i hae ira boriŋfuŋko duckembiŋ. Iŋuc erâ ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 nânâ sowa jumbiŋ.
Saulo e Wofuŋte dâŋ qâsuahuc sâcmutâc‐ticne mi reŋkewec â hâmockicne jaŋe guriŋ bacneniŋte wira wâwâsic ejarewec irec erâ iŋuc hâcne hâmowec.
E Wofuŋzi guriŋ bacneocte wira basac mi ewec. Irec Wofuŋzi e qâhâmorâ uucmaŋ i Isai ŋokâ‐ticne Dawidirao râewec.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Heboroŋ haeo Dawidirao tumaŋne‐fârerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Manakic, nâŋe gore soc â biuc.
Juwicnao Saulo e ŋicwofuŋ juhame jaha go Israe momori ʒikao bânie‐jarehuc mocwâc bârisiec‐jopameŋ. Ehame Wofuŋ Anutugezi ʒiŋuc gazawec: ‘Go Israe ŋicfâc‐nane soŋaŋ‐jopahuc fekicne‐jeŋic juzemec.’”
Irec Israe micne sasawa jaŋe Heboroŋ haeo ŋicwofuŋ Dawidirao tumaŋne‐fârembiŋ. Eme Dawidizi ira Wofuŋte maio jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic eme jaŋe Wofuŋzi Samuerao dâŋ muwec irec sâcko wokemaŋ ruacnehuc Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ âkendâŋnembiŋ.
Eme Dawidi â Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋe Jerusalem haeo rambiŋ. Ira mâreŋ rune Jebusi ŋic jaŋe jumbiŋte hae irec ʒâŋe wâc Jebusi mujumbieŋ.
Jebusi hae rune jaŋe ine Dawidi ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Go ʒira mi warezemec.” Iŋuc mupie Dawidi e sifu Zioŋ ficsanaŋ, ʒâhec Dawidire hae qizec mujumbieŋ i rowec.
Erâ muwec, “Ŋic moczi fuŋkerâ Jebusi ŋic jopaocmu e momori jaŋere micne â fekicne juocmu.” Iŋuc mume Zeruja ŋokâ‐ticne Joabezi fuŋkerâ fewec, irec eki micne ewec.
Eme Dawidi e ficsanaŋ ira ŋeŋe juju ewec. Irec hae ŋondeŋ i Dawidire hae mujumbieŋ.
Eme Dawidi e Milo ficsanaŋ irecnec fuŋkerâ hae bahame kikic efârewec. Ehame Joabezi hae ŋondeŋ gâcne sâko bâpiaŋke‐fârewec.
Erâ Dawidi e Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi ehec juwecte ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec erahuc juwec.
Ŋic ʒi jaŋe Dawidire ŋicfâc tapiri ɋicwânʒâŋhec jaŋere micne juhuc Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic jaŋere dâŋ muwec irec sâcko ŋicwofuŋ âkendâŋnehuc Israe ŋic jaŋehec mâmâc uucmaŋ‐ticnao hone bafic ecnehuc qaqa sanaŋ embiŋ.
Dawidire ŋicfâc tâpiri ɋicwânʒâŋhec jumbiŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe biri ine ʒiŋuc: Hakimoni ŋic Jasobeam e ŋic qacmomori jahec â moc jaŋere micne juwec. Eki hâcne sându‐ticnezi ʒoaŋ mocjahao ŋic 300 âke hâmoc‐jopawec.
Ehame ŋic tâpirihec jahec â moc jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋic moc Jasobeamtao ʒuhuckerâ juwec ʒâŋene Eleaʒa. E Ahohi ŋic Dodo ere ŋokâ.
E Dawidihec Pasidamim haeo juha Filisa ŋic jaŋe ira ʒikare tumaŋnembiŋ. Mâreŋ ŋondeŋ ira padi gie sâko moc fowec. Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Filisa ŋic jaŋere hâwic‐jopame wisembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Eleaʒa e ijaha sanaŋkerâ domahuc mâreŋ ŋondeŋ i ŋezickerâ Filisa ŋic jopawec. Iŋuc eme Wofuŋzi ŋezic‐jopaha sanaŋkembiŋ.
Filisa momori ŋic jaŋe Refaim wâneŋko teuŋ âterâ fohapie ŋic micne 30 jaŋeraonec jahec â moc jaŋe Adulam qânâ hawecko Dawidirao humbiŋ.
Dawidi e dameŋ ira ficsanaŋko ŋehuc juwec â Filisa momori jaŋe ine Betelehem hae rorâ ŋembiŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ mocko wiac mocte aŋacke sâqoreme ʒiŋuc muwec: “E, mozi Betelehem haere motâcko opâ nombâŋ ŋekac irecnec opâ moc nareme nazapo!”
Iŋuc mume manarâ ŋic tâpiri ɋicwânʒâŋ‐jeŋichec jahec â moc jaŋe faharerâ Filisa ŋic jaŋere teuŋ fotâcnerâ Betelehem haere motâcko opâ nombâŋ ŋewec irecnec opâ fiarâ bara Dawidi râcnembiŋ. Eme e opâ i mi nânâ Wofuŋte biŋe hoŋkehuc
ʒiŋuc muwec: “No wiac iŋucne Anutu‐nanere maio moc mi ejâmbâŋkepemu. No ŋic ʒi jaŋe juju‐jeŋic qaisockehuc opâ bawarembieŋte sâcne mi nâpemu. No opâ irec manape jaŋere soc tinac ekac.” Iŋuc muhuc qikiŋnewec. Ŋic tâpiri ɋicwânʒâŋ‐jeŋichec jahec â moc jaŋe mâsi iŋuc hâcne ehuc jumbiŋ.
Ehame Joabere ɋa Abisai e ŋic micne 30 jaŋere femicne juwec. E sându‐ticnezi râsi 300 âke‐hâmoc‐jopahuc micne jahec â moc jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec ewec.
E ŋic 30 jaŋe qâhuc‐jopa‐fârerâ micne‐jeŋic juwec. Ehuc sifu ŋic jahec â moc jaŋere sâc mi bâfuawec.
Â Jojada ŋokâ‐ticne Benaja e Kabezele haeoneczi ŋic tai tâpirihec juhuc wiac gâcne bocjaha ebac ewec. E Moabi ŋic momori wânʒâŋ jajahec jofawec. Erâ sinou wahahuc fowec dameŋ ira hurâ laioŋ moc nombâŋko hurâ domaha honerâ qâhâmowec.
Erâ Aigita ŋic ʒoricne ʒora sâcticne 5 kubi e qâhâmowec wâc. Aigita ŋic e sându‐ticne i wâtuŋ neŋgocne iŋucne bajuwec â Benaja e ine tubac sawa barâ rawec. Eme ra Aigita ŋic bâfuarâ sându bajuwec i jâoc rorâ e jahacne sânduzia âke‐hâmowec.
Jojada ŋokâ‐ticne Benaja e wiac iŋuc ehuc micne jahec â moc jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec ewec.
E ŋic 30 jaŋe qâhuc‐jopa‐fârerâ ʒâŋe rara sâkohec juwec, erâ sifu ŋic jahec â moc jaŋere sâc mi bâfuawec. E iŋuc eme Dawidizi momori fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋere micne âkendâŋnewec.
Momori guru jaŋeraonec ŋic tai tâpiri‐jeŋichec ʒiŋuczi jumbiŋ: Joabere ɋa Asahele â Betelehem haeonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Dodo ere ŋokâ Elihanaŋ.
Â Haroda haeonec Samoti â Peloni ŋic Helezi.
Erâ Tekoa haeonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Ikesi ere ŋokâ Ira â Anatoti haeonec Abieʒe.
Â Husati ŋic Sibekai â Ahoki ŋic Ilai.
Erâ Netofa haeonec Maharai â Netofa haeonec jaha ŋic moc ʒâŋene Bana ere ŋokâ Heleda.
Erâ Benjamiŋ guru jaŋere hae Gibea irecnec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Ribai ere ŋokâ Itai â Piratoŋ haeonec Benaja.
Erâ Gasi opâ forakac mâreŋ irecnec Hurai â Arobati ŋic Abiele.
Â Baharum haeonec Aʒamaweta â Salaboŋ haeonec Eliaba.
Erâ Giʒoni ŋic Hasem â Harari ŋic moc ʒâŋene Sage ere ŋokâ Jonataŋ.
Â Harari ŋic jaha moc ʒâŋene Sakari ere ŋokâ Ahiam â Urure ŋokâ Elifali.
Â Mekerati ŋic Hefere â Peloni ŋic Ahia.
Erâ Karamele haeonec Hezero â Ezibaire ŋokâ Narai.
Â Nataŋte ɋa Joele â Hagirire ŋokâ Mibehara.
Â Amoŋŋic Zeleke â Beroti haeonec Naharai, e Zeruja ŋokâ‐ticne Joabere maro babaju juwec.
Erâ Itiri ŋic Ira â Itiri ŋic jaha Garebe.
Erâ Hitiŋic Uria â Alaire ŋokâ Ʒabadi.
Erâ Rubeŋte ɋâric Siʒa ere ŋokâ Adina, e Rubeŋ guru jaŋere micne bapa juwec. Ehame ŋic tai tâpiri‐jeŋichec 30 jaŋe ehec jumbiŋ.
Erâ Makare ŋokâ Hanaŋ â Mitini ŋic Josafata.
Erâ Sama â Aroe ŋic moc ʒâŋene Hotam ere ŋokâ Jeiele.
Erâ Simirire ŋokâ Jediae â ɋaticne Tiziŋic Joha.
Erâ Mahawi ŋic Eliele â Jeribai â Josawai ŋic, i jaŋe hâcne Elenaŋte ŋokâfâc. Erâ Moabi ŋic Itama.
Erâ Eliele â Obede â Mezobai ŋic Jasiele.
Ŋic ʒi jaŋe Dawidizi rac warec eocte Kisi ŋokâ‐ticne Saulore erâ quŋkerâ juhame Zikilaga haeo Dawidirao fisimbiŋ. Jaŋe ŋic tâpiri ɋicwânʒâŋ‐jeŋichec Dawidi ʒikao bafickembiŋ jaŋere guruonec.
Jaŋe tepeŋic erâ tepe motec qâtâcneniŋte mi efefecke jumbieŋ â tacbaŋ‐jeŋicko qânâ râerâ mefârezi â qanazi sâcne qâtâcne jumbieŋ wâc. Jaŋe Benjamiŋ guruonec Saulore soctofafâc.
Eme micne i Ahieʒezi juwec. Eme ere râpeo Joasi; jahe mâmâc jaha Gibea haeonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Sema ere ŋokâ jahec. Ehame jahere râpeo ine Aʒamawetare ŋokâ jahec Jeʒiele â Peleti. Erâ Anototi haeonec Beraka â Jehuc.

Erâ Gibeoŋ haeonec Isimaja; e ŋic 30 jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋic tai tapirihec juwec erâ ekizia ŋic 30 jaŋere micne juwec. Erâ Gedera haeonec Jeremia â Jahaʒiele â Johanaŋ â Joʒabada.
Erâ Eluʒai â Jerimoti â Bealia â Semaria â Harufi ŋic Sefatia.
Erâ Koraŋic Elikana; Isia, Aʒarele, Joezere â Jasobeam.
Erâ Gedoro haeonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Jeroham ere ŋokâ jahec Joele â Ʒebadia.
Eme Dawidi e mâreŋ burocnao ficsanaŋko juhame Gade guru jaŋeraonec ŋic kecʒiŋuczi erao ʒuhuckembiŋ: Maro â sându bajuhuc ʒika qaqa saric, erâ ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic i laioŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe mai tinac â gagasac‐jeŋic i qerazi tikio gasackeekac iŋucne. Ʒâŋe‐jeŋic ine ʒiŋuc:
Micne Eʒere, eme ere juwicnao Obadia, eme ere juwicnao Eliaba.
Ehame ere juwicnao Misimana, eme ere juwicnao Jeremia.
Eme ere juwicnao Atai, eme ere juwicnao Eliele.
Ehame ere juwicnao Johanaŋ, eme ere juwicnao Eliʒabada â ere juwicnao Jeremia
â ere juwicnao ine Makebanai.
Gadeŋic i jaŋe hâcne momori jaŋere micne. Eme tâpiri‐jeŋic boc mi fowec jaŋe momori ŋic 100 micne bajareniŋte mukicne â tâpiri ɋicwânʒâŋ‐jeŋichec jaŋe ine ŋic 1 tauseŋ jaŋere micne bapa.
Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne fuŋfuŋke mosa ira Jordaŋ opâzi rumi sâko fisirâ qaŋeŋne sâcke‐fârerâ fohame fotâcnerâ Jordaŋ opâ rârec rârec ʒoaŋ wewefunao â huhunao ŋic jumbiŋ i jaŋe jâpec‐jopapie wisembiŋ.
Ehame Dawidi e ficsanaŋko juhame Benjamiŋ â Judaŋic gâcne jaŋe erao fisimbiŋ.
Eme Dawidi e ra bâfuac‐joparâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe âgo enarehuc baficnuniŋte warembieŋko ine maŋzi hehâroŋ‐ŋopapemu, me ŋoŋe kisâfâc‐nane jaŋerao doc bacnuniŋte warembieŋko ine norao bahac mi fokacte apa ŋosafâc‐nâŋec jaŋere Anutuzi honehuc okacne bazu‐ŋarezejec.”
Iŋuc mume ŋic 30 jaŋere micne Amasai e Mârozi maŋne baafeckeme ʒiŋuc muwec: “O Isaire ŋokâ, nâŋe gohec domaŋgopeneŋ, gorao wama fozejec. Anutugezi baficgukacte babaficfâcge jaŋerao wama jaha fozejec!” E iŋuc mume Dawidizi rocjoparâ momorifâcne jaŋere micne âkendâŋ‐jopawec.
Ehame Dawidi e Filisa ŋic jaŋehec Saulo râsi fisicnehame Manase ŋic gâcne jaŋe wiserâ Dawidirao ʒuhuckembiŋ. Erâ ine Filisa ŋic fekicne jaŋe muc manac erâ ʒiŋuc muhuc Dawidi sorembiŋte mi bafic‐jopawec: “E behec‐nâporâ bomboŋ‐ticne Saulo erao wiseme hâmocte biŋe enʒipeŋkohec.”
Eme Dawidi e Zikilaga haeo fisihame Manase ŋic ʒiŋuczi wiserâ erao ʒuhuckembiŋ: Adena, Joʒabada, Jediae, Mikae, Joʒabada, Elihu â Ziletai. Ŋic i jaŋe Manase ŋic tauseŋ gurune gurune jaŋere micne hâcne.
Jaŋe Dawidi bafickehuc râsi ututuŋ fisi jumbieŋ jaŋehec qaqac ejumbieŋ. Jaŋe ŋic tâpiri ɋicwânʒâŋ‐jeŋicheczi momori guru jaŋere micne jumbiŋ hâcne.
Ehame ŋic jaŋe ʒoaŋ gie bapa sâc Dawidi bafickeniŋte erao ʒuʒuhuc jaha fisikupie Anuture momori guru iŋucne momori guru sâko jâmbâŋ embiŋ.
Eme momori gurune gurune Wofuŋ dâŋticnere sâcko Saulore uucmaŋ i rorâ Dawidirao râeniŋte ʒika wiac‐jeŋichec Heboroŋ haeo fisimbiŋ jaŋere ʒare ʒiŋuc:
Judaŋic 6 tauseŋ 800 jaŋe sându maro wiac‐jeŋichec fisimbiŋ.
Eme Simeoŋ guru irecnec ŋic tâpiri‐jeŋichec hâhâwic tâmiric 7 tauseŋ 100 iŋuczi jumbiŋ.
Eme Lewi guru jaŋeraonec ine 4 tauseŋ 600 fisimbiŋ.
Erâ Aroŋte kikefuŋkonec ŋic fekicne Jojada ehec ŋic 3 tauseŋ 700 fisimbiŋ.
Erâ Zadoko e ŋicmotec ʒoɋac sâko‐ticneheczi mamac‐ticnere kikefuŋkonec ŋic micne 22 rocjopawec.
Eme Saulore soctofafâc Benjamiŋ guruonec 3 tauseŋ fisimbiŋ; mârâc jaŋeraonec guru sâkozi Saulo kikefuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋerao qohotarâ jumbiŋ.
Ehame Eferaim guru jaŋeraonec ine ŋic 20 tauseŋ 800‐zi ʒoɋac sâko‐jeŋichec â apa ŋosafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere kikefuŋko ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec jumbiŋzi fisimbiŋ.
Erâ Manase guru dâkâne jaŋeraonec ŋic 18 tauseŋ jaŋe Dawidi ŋicwofuŋ âkendâŋneniŋte ʒâŋe‐jeŋic mupie fisimbiŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋe weniŋuc jaha epie sâckeocmu, irec dameŋte fuŋne mamana Isasa guruonec ŋic fekicne 200 â soctofafâc‐jeŋic micjeŋic reŋke jumbieŋ jaŋe mâmâc fisimbiŋ.
Ehame Sebuloŋ guruonec ʒika qaqa saric jaŋe maŋ mocjaha ehuc Dawidi bafickeniŋte ʒikare wiac sasawa bâmockerâ fisimbiŋ.
Eme Naftali guruonec momori micne 1 tauseŋ â ŋic 37 tauseŋ jaŋe sându maro‐jeŋichec fisimbiŋ.
Eme Daŋ guruonec ŋic 28 tauseŋ 600 jaŋe ʒikare ʒawierâ fisimbiŋ.
Eme Ase guruonec momori ŋic ʒikare baʒawiec‐jopa‐hâmokicne 40 tauseŋzi fisimbiŋ.
Ehame Rubeŋ, Gade â Manase guru dâkâne Jordaŋ ŋifecnao jumbiŋ jaŋe 120 tauseŋzi ʒikare wiac sasawa bâmockerâ fisimbiŋ.
Momori i jaŋe sasawa ʒika qaqare sâcko birickerâ Dawidi Israe ŋic qâqâhâc sâko jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ âkendâŋneniŋte maŋ mocjaha ehuc Heboroŋ haeo fisimbiŋ hâcne. Ehame wâc Israe ŋic gâcne sâko jaŋe Dawidi ŋicwofuŋ âkendâŋneniŋte maŋ mocjaha embiŋ.
Erâ qomâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe nânâ opâ bâmocke‐jarembiŋte ira Dawidihec ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc juhuc nânâ opâ i nâmbiŋ.
Ehame diguracfâc‐jeŋic Isasa â Sebuloŋ â Naftali jaŋe doŋgi â kamele â becâsic faio nânâ poroŋ jâmbozi bakicne â hândâŋ wiac ʒoaŋko râepie kereŋkekicne, erâ waiŋ â wokemaŋ â lama bulimakao bafisihuc domambiŋ. Israe guruo aŋac ʒeri sâko fuawecte iŋuc hâcne embiŋ.
Dawidi e momori tauseŋ gurune gurune â 100 gurune gurune jaŋere micne sasawa jaŋehec dâŋ muc manac embiŋ.
Ehuc Israe ŋic tutumaŋ‐jeŋicko ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋoŋe manapie sâckekacko â Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi maname sâckeme Israe ŋic mâreŋ sâc juraŋgopieŋ jaŋerao mecne â taha bapa â Lewiŋic hae mâreŋ‐jeŋic sopâc kecɋaŋnehec ira juŋgopieŋ jaŋerao mâmâc dâŋ râepene rame ʒira warenʒepieŋ.
Warepie Anutu‐nâŋecte ʒâʒâfic katapa i mocwâc bârisienʒepeneŋ. Nâŋâc Saulore dameŋko behe sanaŋke‐jâmbâŋkembeŋ hâcne.”
Eme ŋic sasawa jaŋe dâŋ i manapie sâckeme tutumaŋ‐jeŋiczi qâtâc hewec.
Eme Dawidizi Anuture ʒâʒâfic katapa Kiriati‐Jearim haeonec bârisieniŋte Israe ŋic Aigita hae Sihoro irecnec raku Hamati haere motâcko fisiwec mâreŋ ŋondeŋ ira jumbiŋ jaŋe hetumaŋ‐jopawec.
Eme Dawidi â Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋe Wofuŋ Anutu e kerubim qâhuc‐jofarâ juhame ʒâŋe‐ticne riwaseckembiŋ ere ʒâʒâfic katapa bârisieniŋte Juda hae Bala, Kiriati‐Jearim hâcne, ira rambiŋ.
Ehuc Anuture ʒâʒâfic katapa i Abinadare fickonec rorâ keretac ɋâricnao herâ bawarembiŋ. Ehame Uʒa â Ahio jahe keretac guriŋ bapic.
Ehame Dawidi â Israe ŋic jaŋe ʒeŋgoma Anuture maio ʒoɋachec jaha gae â kulele â gita â woŋgâŋ â kaŋkuc â qeŋjeŋichec domahuc ʒeri sâko embiŋ.
Iŋuc erâ raku Kidoŋte padi qâqâmârâŋ tomao fisimbiŋ. Eme ira bulimakao jaŋe heguc qâguruc epie Uʒazi katapa i basanaŋkewec.
Uʒa e katapa bâuawecte Wofuŋzi mana gâpârecnerâ qame mai‐ticnaoa hâmowec.
Eme Dawidi e Wofuŋte kimbeŋzi Uʒarao fua tâcnewec irec maname ŋemâckewec. Eme mâreŋ ŋondeŋ irec ʒâŋe Peresuʒa mukicne, eme ʒâŋe i dameŋ ʒi fokac jaha.
Eme ʒoaŋ ira Dawidizi Anuture hâwickeme ʒiŋuc muwec: “No Anuture katapa wemocko ficnaneo barapemu?”
Dawidi e iŋuc murâ katapa i hae qizec‐ticnao e jahacne ficko mi barawec. E rorâ Gitiŋic Obededomte ficko heme ŋewec.
Eme Anuture katapazi Obededomte ficko wiacfâcne jaŋehec mosa jahec â moc ŋewec. Eme Wofuŋzi Obededom â wiacfâcne erâ wiac focnewec jaŋe ehâmo‐jarewec.
Eme Tiro ŋicwofuŋ Hiramzi Dawidirao kiŋaŋŋic sorec‐jopawec. Ehuc jâmâzâc jâc wiac râecnewec. Erâ qânâzi fic bapa ŋic â kamunda râec‐jopame jaŋe rarâ Dawidire fic moc bambiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Dawidizi ʒiŋuc mana tarawec: Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ jupemurâ Wofuŋzi hume keteŋ enarewec â Israe ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere erâ uucmaŋ‐nane bafaharewec.
Eme Dawidi e Jerusalem haeo ŋonâŋfâc‐ticne mocwâc ʒuhuckerâ rocjopawec. Rocjopame naru motecfâc‐ticne gâcne ʒuhuckerâ fuambiŋ.
Eme naru motec Jerusalem haeo fuambiŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc: Samua, Sobabe, Nataŋ â Salomo,
Ibiha, Elisua â Elipaleti,
Noga, Nefege â Jafia,
Elisama, Beliada â Elifele.
Israe ŋic jaŋe Dawidi wokemaŋ ruacnerâ ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic âkendâŋnembiŋ. Filisa ŋic jaŋe biŋe iŋuc manarâ e bâfuarâ qaniŋte fisimbiŋ. Eme Dawidi e biŋe‐jeŋic manarâ jopaocte rawec.
Ehame Filisa ŋic jaŋe Refaim wâneŋko râsi ututuŋ fisimbiŋ.
Eme Dawidi e Wofuŋ wiocnehuc muwec, “No Filisa ŋic râsi sâcne fisi‐jarepemu me? Go nore meo sâcne râec‐jopacmu?” Iŋuc wiome Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Sâcne fec, eme no Filisa ŋic gore meo râec‐jopa‐jâmbâŋkepemu.”
Iŋuc muhuc âzâcneme Dawidi e mâreŋ ŋondeŋ moc, ʒâŋene Baali‐Perazim, ira ferâ Filisa ŋic bawahac‐jopawec. Ehuc muwec: “Anutuzi bânie‐narehuc opâ rumi iŋucne erâ menaneonec kisâfâc‐nane âke rârâec‐jopawec.” Irec hâcne mâreŋ ŋondeŋ irec ʒâŋe Baali‐Perazim mukicne.
Eme Filisa ŋic jaŋe nemuɋâŋ wiac‐jeŋic ijaha hetararâ wisepie Dawidizi ŋic ejareme rikembiŋ.
Eme Filisa ŋic jaŋe Refaim wâneŋko mocwâc râsi fisimbiŋ.
Eme Dawidi e Anutu mocwâc mu wioc ecneme Anutuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go ferâ izia mi jopazemec. Go getâc‐jopahuc rarâ râpe‐jeŋicko binawec jâc domakackopec fisi‐jarezemec.
Erâ kike fânâŋ‐jeŋiczi sawao fotâcneme manarâ izia ʒika fuŋkezemec. Anutu no bânie‐garehuc Filisa momori ŋic jopapemu hâcne.”
Eme Dawidi e Anutuzi mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko ewec. Ehuc Filisa ŋic Gibeoŋ haeonec jopa jopa raku Geʒera haeo fisiwec.
Eme Dawidire ʒâŋe biŋezi mâreŋ sâc rafârewec. Ehame Wofuŋzi ŋic gurune gurune ejareme e araŋ bacnembiŋ.
Juku Dawidi e hae qizec‐ticnao e jahacne fic bafârerâ Anuture qorac tapa katapa irec hae heʒâwewec. Ehuc irec boze moc bawec.
Erâ muwec, “Lewiŋic jaŋe sawa Anuture katapa reŋkenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ e jaŋe hâcne Wofuŋte katapa reŋkehuc raŋɋa raŋɋa e kiŋaŋ qacneniŋte rowosâec‐jopawec.”
Erâ Dawidi e mâreŋ heʒâwewec ira Wofuŋte katapa bafisiniŋte Israe ŋic ʒeŋgoma Jerusalem haeo hetumaŋ‐jopawec.
Ehuc Aroŋte ŋokâfâc â Lewiŋic ʒiŋuc hetumaŋ‐jopawec:
Kohatire ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec micne Uriele erâ qomâfâc‐ticne 120.
Merarire ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec ine micne Asaja erâ qomâfâc‐ticne 220.
Geresomte ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec micne Joele erâ qomâfâc‐ticne 130.
Elisafaŋte ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec micne Semaja erâ qomâfâc‐ticne 200.
Heboroŋte ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec ine micne Eliele erâ qomâfâc‐ticne 80.
Uʒielere ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec micne Aminada erâ qomâfâc‐ticne 112.
Dawidi e iŋuc ehuc taha bapa Zadoko â Abiata erâ Lewire ɋâric Uriele, Asaja, Joele, Semaja, Eliele â Aminada jaŋe hetumaŋ‐jopawec wâc.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe Lewi guruo apa ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere kikefuŋko micne eŋgopieŋ. Irec ŋaŋacne â qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic ŋoŋe pectâc juhuc eemasaŋ gie barâ Israere Wofuŋ Anutu ere katapa bawarerâ ŋeŋe‐ticne heʒâwepo ira râepie ŋezejec.
Ŋoŋe qanaŋ jaha mi reŋkembiŋte â mutâcne‐nârekicne irec sâcko mu wioc mi ecnembeŋte Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi nâŋâcnao kimbeŋ‐ticnere fuŋne bataniŋkewec.”
Iŋuc jazame taha bapa â Lewire ɋaric jaŋe Israere Wofuŋ Anutu ere katapa bafisiniŋte eemasaŋ gie bambiŋ.
Eme Lewiŋic jaŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ Mosezi mutâcnewec irec sâcko Anuture katapa i pepeŋko reŋkembiŋ.
Erâ Dawidi e Lewi guruonec micne jaŋe qomâfâc‐jeŋic bâwosâec‐jopapie gae hehuc gita, kulele â kaŋkuc wiac qapie fânâŋkehuc fome ʒeri fânâŋ wâc faharehuc foocte jazawec.
Irec Lewire ɋâricfâc jaŋe Joele ŋokâ‐ticne Hemaŋ bâwosâembiŋ. Erâ qomâfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec ine Berekiare ŋokâ Asafa bâwosâembiŋ. Erâ qomâfâc‐jekic jaŋeraonec ine Kusajare ŋokâ Etaŋ bâwosâembiŋ.
Eme jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ jaŋere juwicnao birio ʒiŋuc bâwosâec‐jopambiŋ: Ʒekaria, Jaʒiele, Semiramo, Jehiele, Uni, Eliaba, Benaja, Maseja, Matitia, Elifelehu â Mikineja, erâ motâc soŋaŋ jajahec ine Obededom â Jeiele.
Eme gae hehe ŋic Hemaŋ, Asafa â Etaŋ jaŋe aeŋ bâbâroŋzi tela bakicne i qapie dâŋeocte mujarekicne.
Ehame Ʒekaria, Aʒiele, Semiramo, Jehiele, Uni, Eliaba, Maseja â Benaja jaŋe naru ŋokac jaŋere maracte sâcko kâriŋɋaŋ qaniŋte mujarekicne.
Ehame Matitia, Elifelehu, Mikineja, Obededom, Jeiele â Aʒaʒia jaŋe ine ŋic jaŋere maracte sâcko kaŋkuc qaniŋte mujarekicne.
Eme Lewi guruonec Kenania e gaere micne bapazi gae siric‐ticne mana tarawecte erâ gaeo micne bajareocte mucnekicne.
Eme Berekia â Elikana jahe Anuture katapa motâc soŋaŋkenicte mujactekicne.
Ehame taha bapa Sebania, Josafata, Netanele, Amasai, Ʒekaria, Benaja â Elieʒe jaŋe Anuture katapa bâniecnehuc qeŋ qaniŋte mujarekicne. Eme Obededom â Jehia jahe wâc Anuture katapa motâc soŋaŋkenicte mujactekicne.
Eme Dawidi â Israe soŋaŋ erâ momori tauseŋ gurune gurune jaŋere micne jaŋe Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapa Obededomte fickonec bawareniŋte kiwac qawac ehuc rambiŋ.
Eme Anutuzi Lewire ɋâricfâc Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapa reŋkembiŋ jaŋe bafic‐jopawecte jaŋe bulimakao ŋicne 7 â lama ŋicne 7 jaha bâzi rikecnembiŋ.
Dawidi e ŋaqi qaŋqaŋ rojuwec, erâ Lewire ɋâricfâc katapa reŋkembiŋ jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha ŋaqi qaŋqaŋ sasawa hembiŋ. Erâ gae hehe ŋic jaŋere micne Kenania e wâc iŋuc jaha ŋaqi qaŋqaŋ jaha rojuwec. Eme Dawidi e qoruc qaŋqaŋzi taha bapa ŋaqi bakicne i heme huwec wâc.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapa bafisihuc aŋara herâ kaŋkuc, gita, kulele, qeŋ â woŋgâŋ qapie fânâŋkehuc fowec.
Eme Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapazi Dawidire hae qizecko fisime Saulore otâ Mikali e qâqâtâc kataŋko firâ ŋicwofuŋ Dawidizi gae wohuc ʒeri bari eme honerâ maŋzi qaisockewec.
Eme jaŋe Anuture katapa bafisirâ Dawidizi irec qoruc boze fârewec irec maŋnao hepie ŋewec. Ehame Anuture maio qowi bâzi â wama bâzi rikembiŋ.
Eme Dawidi e qowi bâzi â wama bâzi i rikeme tarame Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo ŋic ŋokac jambuŋ‐jopawec.
Ehuc Israe ŋic â ŋokac buc poroŋ â qowi dâkâne erâ poroŋ waiŋ hândâŋhec bakicne i jarewec.
Erâ Dawidi e ʒuhuckerâ Lewire guruonec ŋic gâcne jaŋe Wofuŋ Anutu numu wâwâsic â daŋge mumuteŋ ecneniŋte âkendâŋ‐jopawec.
Asafa e micne juwec; eme ere râpeo ine ŋic ʒiŋuczi jumbiŋ: Ʒekaria, Jeiele, Semiramo, Jehiele, Matitia, Eliaba, Benaja, Obededom â Jeiele. Jaŋe gita kulele qaniŋte râec‐jopawec hâcne. Eme Asafa e telazi goŋgoŋ bakicne i qaocte mucnewec.
Eme taha bapa Benaja â Jahaʒiele jahe Anuture katapa maŋfuŋnao ʒuʒuhuc jaha qeŋ qahuc junicte mujactewec.
Eme ʒoaŋ ira Dawidizi fuŋkerâ Asafa â qomâfâcne jaŋe daŋge gae ʒi Wofuŋ hecneniŋte hefua‐jarewec.
Wofuŋ daŋge âzâcnehuc, ʒâŋe‐ticne mutaniŋkeniŋ; wiac bapa‐ticne ŋicne ŋicne mufua‐jareniŋ.
Gae hecneniŋ, mumumbiaŋ gae hecneniŋ, mâsi sâko‐ticne muromacke‐fâreniŋ.
Tiri ʒâŋe‐ticne mu ʒeri ecneniŋ, Wofuŋ wira basac ecneeŋgopieŋzi bubiaŋ mananʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ e jahacne â tâpiri‐ticnere fifisacne finʒepieŋ, ehuc ʒâŋe mai‐ticnao ʒuʒuhuc jaha junʒepieŋ.
E wiac bipinehec ewec ehuc mâsi bawec â mumutara dâŋ muwec irec manasuniŋ.
Kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Abraham ɋâricfâcne ŋoŋe, â Jakobore ŋokâfâc bâwosâecfâc‐ticne ŋoŋe iŋuc hâcne eniŋ!
Wofuŋ e hâcne Anutu‐nâŋec, e mumutara gie‐ticne mâreŋ sâc bahuc juekac.
Ʒâʒâfic‐ticnere manasu rahuc juzokac, ŋic gaŋne gaŋne 1 tauseŋ dâŋ mupaŋke‐jarewec i raŋɋa raŋɋa maŋkehuc juzokac.
Ʒâʒâfic i Abrahamhec ewec, erâ Isaka mujomirecnehuc mupaŋkewec.
Izi Jakobo dâŋsanaŋ râcnehuc basanaŋkewec, ehuc Israehec ʒâʒâfic fofo sanaŋ ewec.
Ʒiŋuc muhuc: “Go Kanaaŋ mâreŋ garepemu, merâfâcge rauckecmurâ biŋe qagarepo i hâcne.”
Dameŋ ira afecne mac jumbiŋ, jahec maczi mâreŋ ira jaba jumbiŋ.
Ŋicguru mockonec mocko ŋe qatara rambiŋ ŋicwofuŋ mocte uucmaŋkonec ra guru mocko ʒuhuckembiŋ.
Moczi ro waha âte ejarezacte aka hewec, â jaŋere erâ ŋicwofuŋ bâtiŋ‐jopawec.
Ehuc muwec, “Wokemaŋ ruacfâc‐nane mi bâuac‐jopazo, porofetefâc‐nane mi bâʒâic‐jopazo!”
Mâreŋ ŋic sasawa ŋoŋe Wofuŋ gae hecneniŋ, ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne bâbâpiaŋ‐ticnere binaŋ baniŋ.
Eri tatamac‐ticne i qâpuc jaŋerao mutaniŋkeniŋ, gie‐ticne wawarecnehec i ŋicne muromacke‐jareniŋ.
Wofuŋ e kâcɋene, irec e fehuc mumbiaŋkezo, nemu sasawa siric‐jopahuc e araŋ bacnezo.
Qâpuc nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ɋâŋ qâqâtâc, Wofuŋ e ine sambâŋne sambâŋne bâfuawec.
Ʒâŋe biŋe â ʒai ʒonʒoŋ‐ticnezi bâniecnekac, tiri ufuŋ‐ticnao tâpiri â aŋac ʒeri fokac.
Qâpuc ŋicguru ŋoŋe Wofuŋ muɋaɋackeniŋ, Wofuŋte tatamac â tâpiri‐ticne muɋaɋackeniŋ.
Wofuŋ e ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnere sâcko sâseniŋ; taha bafisirâ mai‐ticnao fuaniŋ! Tiri eri qonaŋkerâ Wofuŋ dapecneniŋ.
Mâreŋ sâc mai‐ticnao jâjâwâckeniŋ, jambomac, mâreŋ basanaŋkekicne qiŋ herâ ŋekac.
Sambâŋ e bubiaŋ manaoc â mâreŋ e ʒeri eoc, ehame ŋic gurune gurune ʒiŋuc jazaniŋ: “Wofuŋ e Fekicne Sâko jukac.”
Hâwec â irec maŋnao wiac qiriŋ qaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe fânâŋkeniŋ, sopâc â bec qowi jaŋe kiwaeniŋ.
Erâ kâtere jâc sasawa jaŋe Wofuŋte maio ʒeri gae heniŋ e mâreŋ sâc mumutara gie bazo warekacte iŋuc eniŋ.
Wofuŋ daŋge âzâcneniŋ, e uruc jauŋ‐ticnehec, â aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ foocmu.
Erâ ʒiŋuc wâc muzo: “O Anutu bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec, go bafic‐nâpoc, ehuc qâzuc‐nâporâ ŋic gurune gurune jaŋeraonec henusuc‐nâpoc; eme nâŋe tiri ʒâŋege daŋge âzâcnenʒepeneŋ, â mumbiaŋguhuc mu ʒeri enʒepeneŋ.
Israere Wofuŋ Anutu e muteŋkezo. Dameŋ tâmiric ewarekicne iŋuc jaha erahuc juzo.” Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe “Jâmbomac” muhuc Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkembiŋ.
Eme Dawidizi Asafa â qomâfâcne jaŋe ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapare maŋfuŋko juhuc hone maiŋ ecneniŋte râec‐jopawec.
Ehuc Obededom â qomâfâc‐ticne 68 jaŋe râec‐jopawec wâc. Erâ Jedutuŋ ŋokâ‐ticne Obededom â Hosa jahe ine motâc soŋaŋ junicte râec‐jofawec.
Erâ taha bapa Zadoko â qomâfâcne taha bapa gâcne jaŋe Gibeoŋ haeo furu mâreŋ fowec ira Wofuŋte tiri bozeo râec‐jopawec.
Jaŋe ira juhuc Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic jaza mutâc eme sâcmutâcte papia qizecko qâreŋkembiŋ fokac irec sâcko ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne ŋafe furec alatao gâbâ jaha Wofuŋ qowi bâzi rikecnehuc juniŋte râec‐jopawec hâcne.
Eme jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ jumbiŋ ine Hemaŋ â Jedutuŋ, erâ Wofuŋte aki anonoc fofo sanaŋ foekac irec daŋge âzâcneniŋte ʒâŋe‐jeŋic muhuc bâwosâec‐jopakicne jaŋe mâmâc.
Eme Hemaŋ â Jedutuŋ jahe gaere qeŋ â woŋgâŋ erâ gae tirine irec wiac gâcne bajupic. Eme Jedutuŋte ŋokâfâc jaŋe ine motâc soŋaŋkeniŋte bâwosâec‐jopambiŋ.
Wiac sasawa i tara‐fâreme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe fic hae‐jeŋic sâc rafârepie Dawidi e wâc iŋuc jaha wiacfâcne mu jambuŋ ejareocte hae‐ticnao risiewec.
Eme Dawidi e ficticnao ŋeŋe juju ehuc porofete Nataŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, no jâmâzâc fic ʒira ŋeŋe juju ekopac â Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapazi ine bozeo ŋekac.”
Iŋuc mume Nataŋzi Dawidi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go rarâ manakic sâc ec. Anutuzi gohec jukac hâcne.”
Eme ŋafe ira Wofuŋte dâŋ ʒiŋuc Nataŋtao fuawec:
“Go rarâ kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Dawidi ʒiŋuc âzâcnec: ‘Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: Goki ŋeŋe juju epemurâ fic moc mi banarezemec.
No Israe ŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa wefupoonecteaŋ fic mocko ŋeŋe juju mi ehuc bozeoa ŋeŋe juju ewarehuc jupozi jukopac.
No Israe ŋic jaŋehec mâreŋ ira me ira rac warec epo sâc ŋicfâc‐nane soŋaŋ‐jopaniŋte mumutara ŋic âkendâŋ‐jopapo jaŋeraonec moc dâŋ ʒiŋuc moc âzâcnepo me: “Go wemocte jâmâzâc jâczi fic moc mi banarekomec?” ’
Irec go kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Dawidi ʒiŋuc âzâcnezemec: ‘Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: No lama bâjâpec‐jopahuc kecɋaŋ gieo juhaŋtec Israe ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere fekicne jucmurâ rocgupo.
No ira me ira juekic sâc gohec juekopac. Erâ bânie‐garehuc kisâfâcge jopaekopac. Erâ ʒuhuckerâ mâreŋko ŋic ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec jaŋe iŋucne ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec jaha bacgupemu.
Erâ Israe ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe ŋeŋe hae moc bâfua‐jarepe ira jusanaŋkeniŋmu. Eme ŋeŋe hae jâmbâŋ‐jeŋic bâfua‐jarepe ira juhapie juwicnao ŋic repicne gâcnezi jopa sipiric ejarehuc ʒikare suru jâiŋ ejare jumbieŋ, mâsi wiac iŋucne mocwâc mi fuazejec.
Erâ juwicnao Israe ŋicfâc‐nane qaŋeŋ‐jopaniŋte mumutara ŋic râec‐jopape juhapie wiac fuawec iŋucne mocwâc mi fuarâ fozejec. No kisâfâcge bawahac‐jopa‐fârepemu. Erâ ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc mutaniŋke‐garekopac: Wofuŋ noni hâcne fic moc bagarepemu.
Erâ go juju dameŋge tareme apa ŋosafâcge qâtec‐jopahuc fohaŋtec ɋâricfâcge jaŋeraonec ŋokâge moc rowosâepe eki gore tuc qarâ juha no uucmaŋ‐ticne dope hutuŋ ecnepemu.
Iŋuc ecnehape eki fic moc banarezejec. Eme no uucmaŋ‐ticne dope hutuŋ ecnehape raŋɋa raŋɋa foocmu.
Erâ no mamac‐ticne ehape eki ŋokâ‐nane erâ juocmu, ehame gore juwicnao juwec e aki anonoc‐nane jâoc ropo irec sâc ecnehuc mi jâoc ropemu.
No ufuŋ‐naneo â uucmaŋ‐naneo e basanaŋke‐jâmbâŋkepemu, ehuc eri qaraweŋ‐ticne dope hutuŋ ecnehape raŋɋa raŋɋa foocmu.’”
Eme Nataŋ dâŋ sasawa âzâcne jâutuc ekicne irec sâcko binaŋ bahuc Dawidi âzâcne‐fârewec.
Eme Dawidi e bozeo raʒirâ Wofuŋ maickehuc waha ŋerâ ʒiŋuc numuwec: “O Wofuŋ Anutu, no ŋic waha qaqacne â garikiŋfâc‐nane jaŋe wâc ʒâŋe biŋe tâmiric, ehame go ine sifu jaha ehâmo‐narekomec.
O Wofuŋ Anutu, go wiac iŋucnere manatec wawahane eha kiŋaŋŋicgere garikiŋfâc â ŋic gaŋne gaŋne jufeniŋmu irec dâŋ i mâmâc naza nowatuc emeŋ.
Erâ kiŋaŋŋicge no bafaharecnukicte wemo dâŋ ʒuhuckerâ gazapemu? O Wofuŋ Anutu, go kiŋaŋŋicge nore fuŋne mana tara‐fâreekic.
O Wofuŋ, go kiŋaŋŋicgere erâ, â maŋgezi mukac irec sâcko wiac qeŋ bipinehec ʒi ehuc wiac sasawa i muaŋneekic.
O Wofuŋ Anutu, go iŋucne moc mi jume manaeŋgopeneŋ, goki sawa jukic hâcne.
Me Israe ŋicfâcge jaŋe weni jaŋehec sâc hecjopazo? O Anutu, go mâreŋko ŋicguru gâcne weni jaŋe ŋicfâcge bacjopacmurâ kiŋaŋ qaqa gieonec batarac‐jopazo fisimeŋ? Erâ ʒâŋe biŋege saweocte wiac qeŋ bipinehec ehuc ŋicguru weni jaŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec batarac‐joparâ hata‐jeŋic bâʒâwemeŋ, ehuc ŋicguru gâcne jopa jâpec ejaremeŋ?
Israe ŋic jaŋe hâcne ŋicfâcge erâ juraʒihuc juniŋte dope hutuŋ ejaremeŋ. Ehuc Wofuŋ go gahaczia Anutu‐jeŋic erâ jumeŋ.
O Wofuŋ Anutu, ʒi ine kiŋaŋŋicge â garikiŋfâcne jaŋere manasuhuc dâŋ mumeŋ i fosanaŋkeocte basanaŋkec, ehuc mumeŋ irec sâc ec.
Eme ʒâŋege i kecʒiŋuc muhuc basanaŋkerâ muaŋne rahuc junʒepieŋ: ‘Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu, eki hâcne Israere Anutu jukac.’ Ehame kiŋaŋŋicge Dawidi nore garikiŋfâc jaŋe ine gore maio juraʒihuc junʒepieŋ.
O Anutu‐nane, go gahac kiŋaŋŋicge no fic moc banarecmurâ naza nowatuc emeŋ. Irec kiŋaŋŋicge no hâbihec erâ nunumu ʒi numu‐garekopac.
O Wofuŋ, go Anutu fârine, goki hâcne wiac biaŋne ʒi kiŋaŋŋicge no mupaŋke‐naremeŋ.
Irec manatec sâckeme kiŋaŋŋicge nore garikiŋfâc jambuŋ‐jopazemec. Iŋuc ejaretec jaŋe gore maioa juraʒihuc junʒepieŋ. O Wofuŋ, go gahac jambuŋ‐jopameŋ jambuŋ izi jaŋerao fohuc juocmu sanaŋ.”
Eme irec faicnao Dawisizi Filisa ŋic joparâ bawahac‐jopahuc Gati hae jowac rowec.
Erâ Moabi ŋic jaŋe wâc bawahac‐jopame Dawidi kiŋaŋ qacnehuc sahac taha wiac râcnehuc jumbiŋ.
Erâ Zoba ŋicwofuŋ Hadadeze e Eufrata opâo ŋicwofuŋ tâpiri‐ticnere fuŋne bataniŋkeocte rahame Dawidizi Hamati haeopec qâhâmowec.
Erâ Dawidi e iŋuc ehuc eraonec keretac 1 tauseŋ â becâsicko rara ŋic 7 tauseŋ erâ momori kikezi rara 20 tauseŋ iŋuc jâoc rowec. E iŋuc ehuc keretac fâfâre becâsic jaŋere rua hetâcnewec, erâ keretac 100 jaŋere sâc sawa akic‐jopawec.
Eme Siria ŋic jaŋe Zoba ŋicwofuŋ Hadadeze bafickeniŋte Damasko haeonec fisipie Dawidizi Siria ŋic 22 tauseŋ qâhâmoc‐jopawec.
Iŋuc erâ Siria mâreŋko Damasko haeo momori râec‐jopawec. Ehame Siria ŋic jaŋe Dawidire rurumaŋko juhuc sahac taha wiac râcnehuc jumbiŋ. Eme Dawidi e ira me ira rawec sâc Wofuŋzi bafickehuc dopecke‐jâmbâŋkewec.
Erâ Dawidi e Hadadezere kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne jaŋe maro wiac golzi bakicne barâ jujumbieŋ i rorâ bara Jerusalem haeo râewec.
Erâ Dawidi e Hadadezere hae jajahec Tibihati â Kuŋ irecnec aeŋ bâbâroŋ bocjaha jâmbâŋ rowec. Eme Salomo e aeŋ bâbâroŋ izi hâcne râqâc sâko â wâtuŋ â râqâc wiac gâcne bawec.
Eme Hamati ŋicwofuŋ Tou e Dawidizi Zoba ŋicwofuŋ Hadadeze â momori gurufâc‐ticne jaŋe ʒeŋgoma bawahac‐jopawec irec biŋe manawec.
Manarâ Dawidi bubiaŋ dâŋ wiac azâcneocte ŋokâ‐ticne Hadoram soreme ŋicwofuŋ Dawidirao rawec. Hadadeze e dameŋ sâc Touhec ʒika qahuc juwec hâcne. Eme Tou e siliwa â gol â wiac gâcne erâ aeŋ bâbâroŋzi wiac bakicne i râeme rawec.
Eme Dawidi e ŋicguru gâcne, Edom â Moabi â Amoŋ â Filisa â Amaleke ŋic bawahac‐jopahuc jaŋeraonec siliwa â gol gâcne rorâ Wofuŋte biŋe qahuc râe jujec iŋuc jaha wiac i Wofuŋte biŋe qahuc râewec.
Eme Zeruja ŋokâ‐ticne Abisai e Edomŋic 18 tauseŋ Hâwec Wâneŋko jopawec.
Erâ Edom mâreŋko momori râec‐jopa rawec. Ehame Edomŋic jaŋe Dawidire rurumaŋko jumbiŋ. Eme Dawidi e ira me ira rawec sâc Wofuŋzi kime dopec ecnewec.
Dawidi e Israe ŋic ʒeŋgoma jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ juwec. Erâ ŋicfâcne sasawa wiac sâckoa ejarehuc mutiŋ bâtiŋ ejare jujec.
Ehame Zerujare ŋokâ Joabe e momori jaŋere micne juwec. Â Ahiludu ŋokâ‐ticne Josafata eki ine dâŋ mumufua juwec.
Ehame Ahitubu ŋokâ‐ticne Zadoko â Abiata ŋokâ‐ticne Abimelec jahe ine taha bapa jupic. Â Sawasazi ine qâqâreŋ ŋic juwec.
Ehame Jojada ŋokâ‐ticne Benaja eki ine Kereti ŋic â Peleti ŋic qaŋeŋ‐jopawec. Â Dawidi ŋokâfâc‐ticne jaŋe ŋicwofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic fekicne jumbiŋ.
Eme irec faicnao Amoŋ ŋicwofuŋ Nahasi e hâmome ŋokâ‐ticnezi tucticne qarâ ŋicwofuŋ juwec.
Juhame Dawidizi muwec, “Mamac‐ticnezi ehâmo‐narewecte no Nahasi ŋokâ‐ticne Hanuŋ ehâmocnezepac.” Iŋuc murâ mamac‐ticne hâmowec irec mu bâmiriŋ ecneniŋte Hanuŋtao kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopawec. Sorec‐jopame Dawidire kiŋaŋŋicfâc jaŋe Hanuŋ mu bâmiriŋ ecneniŋte raku Amoŋŋic jaŋerao fisimbiŋ.
Fisipie Amoŋŋic fekicne jaŋe Hanuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Dawidi e mamacgere maname feha bâmiriŋguniŋte ŋic ʒi sorec‐jopajec me? Go manatec iŋuc mi ezejec. Dawidi e kiŋaŋŋic jaŋe mâreŋ ʒi hone tâcneku imackeniŋte râec‐jopajec.”
Iŋuc mupie Hanuŋ e Dawidire kiŋaŋŋic rocjoparâ mecʒâwâ‐jeŋic hejarewec. Erâ ŋaqi qoruc‐jeŋic hoqaŋeŋ‐jeŋickoa bâtâcne‐jare‐fârerâ râec‐jopame rambiŋ.
Eme jaŋe mâretec mimiembiŋ; ehame Dawidizi biŋe manarâ kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopawec. Ehuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋoŋe Jeriko haeoa juhapie mecʒâwâ‐ŋeŋic wefume sâcne risienʒepieŋ.”
Eme Amoŋŋic jaŋe Dawidi mâsi repicne ecnembiŋ i ʒâŋitarâ Hanuŋ â ŋicfâcne jaŋe Mesopotamia Aram‐Maka â Zoba mâreŋkonec keretac â becâsicko rara ŋic rocjopaniŋte siliwa ŋemâc‐ticne 1 tauseŋ râepie rawec.
Eme keretac 32 tauseŋ rombiŋ. Ehame Maka ŋicwofuŋ e momorifâcne jaŋehec fisirâ Medeba maickehuc teuŋ âtembiŋ. Eme Amoŋŋic jaŋe ʒawierâ hae‐jeŋic ŋerawec irecnec ʒikao fisimbiŋ.
Eme Dawidizi biŋe manarâ Joabe â momori ŋic tâpirihec sasawa sorec‐jopawec.
Ehame Amoŋŋic jaŋe fisirâ hae motâcko ʒikare birickembiŋ. Â ŋicwofuŋ fisimbiŋ jaŋe ine jaŋackoaŋ mâreŋ taniŋnao birickembiŋ.
Eme Joabe e ʒikazi orâŋ bârâŋ ecnehuc fisiwec i honerâ Israe ŋic bâwosâec‐jopakicne jaŋe bâfâuc‐joparâ gâcne jaŋe Siria ŋic jaŋehec qaqac eniŋte biric‐jopawec.
Erâ ŋicfâc‐ticne gâcne jaŋe ɋaticne Abisairao râec‐jopame eki Amoŋŋic jaŋehec qaqac eniŋte biric‐jopawec.
Eme Joabezi muwec, “Siria ŋic jaŋe boc sanaŋkeniŋmuo ine goki baficnuzemec â Amoŋŋic jaŋe boc sanaŋkeniŋmuo ine noni fârâ baficguzepac.
Nâŋâc hâbihec ehuc ŋicfâc‐nâŋec jaŋere erâ â Anutu‐nâŋecte hae ŋerakac irec erâ sanaŋkehuc ʒika qanʒepeneŋ. Eme Wofuŋ e jahac manakac sâc ezejec.”
Iŋuc murâ Joabe â ŋicfâcne e jahacnehec jumbiŋ jaŋe Siria ŋic jaŋehec qaqac ehuc Siria ŋic jaŋe dockerâ wisembiŋ.
Eme Amoŋŋic jaŋe Siria ŋic jaŋe wisepie honerâ iŋuc jaha Joabe ɋaticne Abisaihec qaqac embiŋ i beherâ wisehuc hae sacmaŋko raʒimbiŋ. Raʒipie Joabe e Jerusalem haeo risiewec.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe Siria ŋic bawahac‐jopambiŋ. Irec Siria ŋic jaŋe kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopapie rarâ Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao Siria ŋic âgofâc‐jeŋic jumbiŋ jaŋe jowac‐jopapie Hadadezere momori micne Sofakazi bânie‐jareme fisimbiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Dawidizi biŋe manarâ Israe ŋic rocjopa‐fâreme Jordaŋ opâ fotâcnerâ jaŋerao fisimbiŋ. Ehuc jaŋehec qaqac eniŋte momorifâcne biric‐jopawec. Ehame Siria ŋic jaŋe iŋuc jaha momorifâc‐jeŋic biric‐joparâ Israe ŋic jaŋehec qaqac embiŋ.
Eku Israe ŋic jaŋere hâwic‐jopame wisembiŋ. Wisepie Dawidizi Siria ŋic keretacko jujune 7 tauseŋ jopawec, â kikezi rara momori 40 tauseŋ jopawec. Ehuc momori jaŋere micne Sofaka e wâc iŋuc jaha qâhâmowec.
Ehame Israe ŋic jaŋe Hadadezere rurumaŋko jumbiŋ ŋic i jaŋe bawahac‐jopambiŋ. Bawahac‐jopapie Dawidihec wama qaqac erâ ere rurumaŋko jumbiŋ. Siria ŋic jaŋe iŋuc juhuc Amoŋŋic mocwâc bafic‐jopaniŋte mi afeckembiŋ.
Ʒoaŋ dameŋ maickeme ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe ʒikao rajumbieŋ dameŋ ira Joabezi momori guru bânie‐jareme Amoŋŋic jaŋere mâreŋ imacke raku Raba haeo fisirâ hae somâckembiŋ. Dawidi e ine Jerusalem haeoa juwec. Eme Joabezi Raba hae i ima samaki bawec.
Eme Dawidizi ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋicte qizecko eridu ŋewec i heunuckewec. Heunuckerâ honeme ŋemâc‐ticne i 100 ewec. Erâ eridu sahacnao qânâ furi sâko moc ŋewec. Eme eridu i Dawidire qizecko hepie huwec. Eme Dawidi e hae irec mafa wiac bocjaha jâmbâŋ ameckerâ rawec.
Ehuc hae irec ŋic rocjoparâ ejareme sege â kinoŋ sanaŋ â râriczi gie bambiŋ. Dawidi e Amoŋŋic jaŋere hae ŋerawec ira iŋuc hâcne efârewec. Erâ e jahacne â ŋicfâcne jaŋe Jerusalem haeo risiembiŋ.
Eme irec faicnao Geʒere haeo Filisa ŋic jaŋehec mocwâc qaqac embiŋ. Ehame Husaŋic Sibekaizi ŋicsâko jaŋere ɋâric moc, ʒâŋene Sipai e qâhâmowec. Iŋuc ehuc Filisa ŋic bawahac‐jopambiŋ.
Juku Filisa ŋic jaŋehec qaqac mocwâc ekicne. Ehame Jairi ŋokâ‐ticne Elihanaŋzi Gitiŋic Goliata ere ɋa Lami e qâhâmowec. E sându‐ticne i wâtuŋ neŋgocne iŋucne.
Eme Gati haeo ʒika mocwâc fuawec. Eme hae ira ŋic ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec moc juwec e ŋicsâko jaŋere ɋâric jaha. E me kike motec‐ticne i 6 sasawa, qâhâckeme ʒare‐jeŋic 24 ewec.
E Israe ŋic hesuac‐jopakume Dawidi hahac‐ticne Simeare ŋokâ Jonataŋzi qâhâmowec.
Ŋic i jaŋe ŋicsâko jaŋere ɋâriczi Gati haeo jumbiŋ. Ehuc Dawidi â ŋicfâcne jaŋere meo fehuc hâmo‐fârembiŋ.
Eme Sataŋ e Israe ŋic râsi ejarehuc Dawidizi Israe ŋic wosec‐jopaocte esoc qafeŋ ecnewec.
Iŋuc eme Dawidizi Joabe â momori jaŋere micne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe rarâ Israe ŋic Bere‐Seba haeonec ware raku Daŋ mâreŋko fisikac mâreŋ ŋondeŋ ira ŋic ŋokac juŋgopieŋ jaŋe wosec‐jopaniŋ. Ehuc ware nazapie no ŋic ŋokac wezimuc juŋgopieŋ irec ʒare manazepac.”
Iŋuc mume Joabezi muwec, “Wofuŋzi ŋic ŋokacfâc‐ticne dameŋ ʒiŋuczia juŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc jâuruhuc 100 gurune gurune mocwâc ʒuhuc‐jopaocmu. Ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, jaŋe ʒeŋgoma gore rurumaŋko jufâreŋgopieŋ i! Bomboŋ‐nane, go wemocte irec boc egarekac? Go iŋuc ehuc Israe ŋic nâŋâcne faio kiŋ bâfuacmu.”
Joabe e iŋuc âzâcne‐bipieha sifu ŋicwofuŋ e jahacne dâŋzi sanaŋkeocte ʒoɋac ewec. Eme Joabe e faharerâ rahuc Israe ŋic âtec‐jopa‐fârerâ Jerusalem haeo mowâc risiewec.
Risierâ ŋic ŋokac wosec‐jopakicne qâqâhâc ʒare‐jeŋic i Dawidi râcnewec. Eme Israe maŋnao ŋic ʒika qaqare sâc jumbiŋ jaŋere ʒare i 1 milioŋ 100 tauseŋ â Juda maŋnao ŋic ʒika qaqare sâc jumbiŋ jaŋere ʒare 470 tauseŋ.
Erâ Joabe e ŋicwofuŋte mumutâc irec maname mi sâckewecte Lewi guru â Benjamiŋ guru jaŋe mi wosec‐jopawec.
Eme Anutu e wiac irec maname mi sâckeme Israe ŋic jopawec.
Iŋuc eme Dawidizi Anutu ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No hehesic sâko bâfuahuc wiac i epo, irec ʒiŋuc numu‐garekopac: Go kiŋaŋŋicge nore kiŋ bahac i bârâriezemec. No wiac mutucne jâmbâŋ epo hâcne.”
Eme Wofuŋzi Dawidire findaŋdâŋ mumu ŋic Gade ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec:
“Go rarâ Dawidi ʒiŋuc âzâcnec: ‘Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: No wiac jahec â moc bâmocke‐garekopac. Irec go gahac, moc me moc mutec bafisi garepemu.’”
Iŋuc muhuc âzâcneme Gade e Dawidirao fisirâ âzâcnehuc muwec, “Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Wemo wiac fua‐gareocte mukomec?
Jara jahec â moc roroc fuaocte mukic? Me mosa jahec â moc kisâfâcge jaŋe bâqiŋguhuc kikeo kikeo egareniŋte mukic? Me ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc Wofuŋte ʒika, hucukic mimicne moc hâcne, i mâreŋ ʒira fuame Wofuŋte aŋelozi Israe mâreŋ sâc ima gie baocte mukic?’ Irec sorecnujec erao dâŋ okacne weniŋuc barâ risiepemu i aimuŋ jaha manatâc qâtâc eku mupaŋkec.”
Iŋuc mume Dawidizi Gade ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No buʒâic ŋemâcnere faio fekopac; irec ŋicmeo mi fehuc Wofuŋ e jahac buuruc‐ticne ɋârâŋnea fokacte sifu ere meo fezepac.”
Eme irec Wofuŋzi mume Israe ŋic jaŋerao hucukic mimicne fuame Israe ŋic 70 tauseŋzi hâmombiŋ.
Eme Anutuzi Jerusalem hae bâsiroweocte aŋelo‐ticne sorewec. Eme aŋelo e hae bâsiroweocte ehame Wofuŋzi honeme mi sâckeme wiac hâhâwicne mi fuaocte aka hewec. Ehuc ima gie bahuc juwec aŋelo e ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Sâcne, ima gie bâniniŋkec.” Eme Wofuŋte aŋelo e Jebusi ŋic Oronaŋ ere padi qâqâmârâŋ tomao domawec.
Eme Dawidizi ʒâŋe firâ aŋelo e ʒika‐ticne barâ Jerusalem haeopec fâretiŋnehuc sambâŋ â mâreŋ ŋoŋondeŋ‐jekicko domaha honewec. Iŋuc honerâ Dawidi â soŋaŋ jaŋe mateŋ qonaŋkerâ ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic mâreŋko hetutuckembiŋ.
Iŋuc erâ Dawidizi Anutu ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Noni hâcne ŋic ŋokac wose qâreŋ ejareniŋte mujarepo. Noni hâcne wiac hehesicne jâmbâŋ ʒi epo. Lama guru keci jaŋe ine wiac moc mi embiŋ. Irec Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane, no ʒiŋuc numu‐garekopac: Sifu no nahacne â wiacfâc‐nane nâŋe sawa bâtiŋ‐nâpoc; ŋicfâcge jaŋere faio ine wiac hâhâwicne mi râezemec.”
Eme Wofuŋte aŋelozi Gade âzâcne mutâc eme Dawidirao rarâ, eki Jebusi ŋic Oronaŋ ere padi qâqâmârâŋ tomao Wofuŋte alata moc baocte âzâcnewec.
Eme Dawidi e Gadezi Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo dâŋ âzâcnewec i reŋkerâ ferawec.
Oronaŋ e ine padi qâmârâŋkehuc juku forisierâ aŋelo honewec. Eme ŋokâfâcne jahec â jahec mâmâc jumbiŋ jaŋe hâwic‐jopame soŋkembiŋ.
Ehame Dawidizi Oronaŋtao fisime Oronaŋzi honehuc padi qâqâmârâŋ toma‐ticnaonec erao rarâ dapecnehuc ʒâŋe mai‐ticne mâreŋko hetutuckewec.
Iŋuc eme Dawidizi Oranaŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go padi qâqâmârâŋ toma ʒi qikiŋne‐naretec furine bajâmbâŋkerâ ira Wofuŋte alata moc bape ŋic ŋokac jaŋerao wiac hâhâwicne fuarâ fokac i omaezejec.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Oronaŋzi Dawidi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “I sâcne roc; erâ ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, go gahac wiac manakic sâc ezemec. Erâ manac, no bulimakao ʒi taha bâzi ririkere râekopac â padi qâqâmârâŋ ɋaruc forakac ʒi ʒocte biŋe â padi ʒi taha bâzi ririkere biŋe. Wiac sasawa i ʒeŋgoma qikiŋne‐fârekopac.”
E iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋ Dawidizi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mâcne, no furine bajâmbâŋkepemu. No gore wiac i Wofuŋte biŋe moc mi ropemu, me wiac i me i moc furi tâmiric taha bâzi mi rikepemu.”
Iŋuc murâ Dawidizi mâreŋ ŋondeŋ irec furine gol ŋemâc‐ticne 600 Oronaŋ râcnewec.
Ehuc ira Wofuŋte alata moc barâ qowi bâzi â wama bâzi râehuc Wofuŋ numu wâwâsic ecnewec. Eme Wofuŋzi dâŋticne manahuc mume sambâŋkonec ʒoczi qowi bâzire alatao wahawec.
Iŋuc fuame Wofuŋzi aŋelo mutâcnecneme ʒika‐ticne i mocwâc kânoŋ‐ticnao râeme huwec.
Eme dameŋ ira Dawidi e Wofuŋzi Jebusi ŋic Oronaŋ ere padi qâqâmârâŋ tomao nunumu‐ticnere okacne bâtikiewec i manarâ ira taha bâzi rikewec.
Mosezi mâreŋ burocnao Wofuŋte tiri boze bawec i â bâzi ririkere alata jahe dameŋ ira Gibeoŋ haeo furu mâreŋko ŋepic.
Eme Dawidi e Wofuŋte aŋelozi ʒika gie bawec irec hâwickewecte Anutu mu wioc ecneocte ira razo moc mi afeckewec.
Eme Dawidizi muwec, “Ʒira hâcne Wofuŋ Anuture ufuŋ ŋezejec â alata ʒizi Israe ŋic jaŋere bâzi ririkere alata ezejec.”
Dawidi e ŋic furune Israe mâreŋko jumbiŋ jaŋe tumaŋne‐fâreniŋte jazawec. Ehuc Anuture ufuŋ bapare qânâ he qâfâuc ee ŋic jaŋe qânâ he qâfâuc eniŋte râec‐jopawec.
Erâ Dawidi e haesac motâcte biriŋ â babasanaŋ fuaocte aeŋ bocjaha jâmbâŋ râe guruc ewec. Erâ aeŋ bâbâroŋ i wowosene tâmiric râe guruc ewec wâc.
Erâ Sidoŋ â Tiroŋic jaŋe jâmâzâc katapa wowosene tâmiric Dawidirao bafisihuc domambiŋ.
Dawidi e ʒiŋuc muwec hâcne: “Ŋokâ‐nane Salomo e motec ɋâri erâ giere fuŋne mi manakac. Wofuŋte ufuŋ i ine hawari biaŋ â eri qaraweŋ‐ticnehec bapie ʒâŋe biŋe rara‐ticne mâreŋ sâc razejec. Eme no irec ʒaʒawie gie bazepac.” Dawidi e iŋuc murâ ɋaricne juweckoa ufuŋte wiac i emoc bâmoc efârewec.
Eme ŋokâ‐ticne Salomo hefârerâ Israere Wofuŋ Anutu ere ufuŋ moc baocte mucnewec.
Ehuc ŋiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋokâ‐nane, no Wofuŋ Anutu‐nanere ufuŋ moc bapemurâ manasuhuc juwarepo.
Ehame Wofuŋte dâŋzi norao ʒiŋuc fuawec: ‘Go soc bocjaha hoŋkemeŋ â ʒika mâretec qameŋ. Go mâreŋko nore maio soc boc hoŋkemeŋte ʒâŋe‐nanere ufuŋ moc mi bazemec.
Manakic, ŋokâge moc fuaocmu e ŋic wamane juocmu. Râsifâc‐ticne rârec rârec juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe ejarepe ʒika behepie wama fuarâ fozejec; ʒâŋe‐ticne ine Salomo muzo. No ere dameŋko mupe Israe ŋic jaŋerao wama â nacgumo roroc fuarâ foocmu.
Ŋokâge eki hâcne ʒâŋe‐nanere ufuŋ moc bazejec. Erâ e ŋokâ‐nane erâ juha noni mamac‐ticne erâ jupemu. Ehuc Israe maŋnao ŋicwofuŋ eri ŋeŋe‐ticne basanaŋkepe raŋɋa raŋɋa ŋerahuc juzejec.’
Irec ŋokâ‐nane, Wofuŋzi gohec juzejec. Ehame Wofuŋzi gore manasuhuc dâŋ muwec irec sâcko Wofuŋ Anutugere ufuŋ bâpiaŋkerâ bazemec.
Mocjaha, Wofuŋ e maŋɋârâŋ â mamana tara tahacguzejec. Erâ Israe ŋic rauc‐joparâ jucmurâ mugareme Wofuŋ Anutugere sâcmutâc i aimuŋ soŋaŋkezemec.
Iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic jaŋere erâ dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋ Moserao râewec i wâc aimuŋ jaha soŋaŋkecmuo ine gorao wiac fofo dunduŋ jaha fuahuc foocmu. Go sanaŋkerâ hâbi hâro juzemec. Mi hâwicguzejec, erâ wâc maŋguru tâmiric juzemec.
No ʒâic sâko manahuc Wofuŋte ufuŋ fuaocte gol ŋemâc‐ticne 100 tauseŋ â siliwa ŋemâc‐ticne 1 milioŋ erâ aeŋ bâbâroŋ â aeŋ omane ŋemâc bâbâfuare sâcko mi rârâene â wowosene tâmiric i râe guruc epo. Erâ katapa â qânâ i wâc râe bâmoc efârepo. Eme go ira gâcne ro ʒuhuc ezemec.
Go gie bapa ŋicfâcge afecne mi jugareŋgopieŋ: Qânâ he qâfâuc ee ŋic â qânâ râe biric ee ŋic â fic bapa ŋic, erâ gie bapa ŋic gâcne ʒare tâmiric.
Jaŋe gol â siliwa â aeŋ bâbâroŋ â aeŋzi wiac bapa saric. Ajoc, go faharerâ gie fuŋkec. Wofuŋzi gohec juzejec.”
Erâ Dawidi e Israe soŋaŋ jaŋe ŋokâ‐ticne Salomo bafickeniŋte ʒiŋuc muhuc jazawec:
“Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e ŋoŋehec jukac hâcne. E ŋifec â ŋifec wama sâckoa tahac‐ŋopawec. Eki hâcne mâreŋ ʒirec rune nore meo râec‐jopawec. Ehame mâreŋ ʒi rauckekicne irec rune jaŋe Wofuŋ â ŋicfâc‐ticne ŋoŋere rurumaŋko juŋgopieŋ.
Irec ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic bâfuaniŋte maŋ mamanasu‐ŋeŋic râepie fozejec. Ajoc, ŋoŋe faharerâ Wofuŋ Anuture ŋeŋe hae moc baniŋ. Erâ Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapa â Anuture râqâc tirine i Wofuŋte ufuŋ baniŋmu ira barâ râenʒepieŋ.”
Juku Dawidi e ŋic qizec jâmbâŋ erâ ŋokâ‐ticne Salomozi Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ juocte âkendâŋnewec.
Dawidi e Israe micne bapa sasawa â taha bapa â Lewiŋic hetumaŋ‐jopawec.
Lewi guruonec ŋic jaŋe jara‐jeŋic 30‐o domarâ fekac i wosec‐jopapie qâqâhâc ʒare‐jeŋic 38 tauseŋ ewec.
Eme Dawidizi muwec, “Ŋic 24 tauseŋ ʒi jaŋe Wofuŋte ufuŋko gie bahuc junʒepieŋ; â ŋic 6 tauseŋ jaŋe ine fekicne â mumutara ŋic junʒepieŋ.
Eme 4 tauseŋ jaŋe haesac motâc soŋaŋ junʒepieŋ â 4 tauseŋ guru moc jaŋe ine musi wiac bapa izi Wofuŋ ʒeri mumuteŋ ecnehuc junʒepieŋ.”
Erâ Dawidi e Lewi ŋokâfâcne ʒiŋuc jaŋere sâcko bâtâc bacjopa‐fârewec: Geresom, Kohati â Merari.
Eme Geresomte ŋokâ jahec ine Ladaŋ â Simei.
Eme Ladaŋte ŋokâfâc jahec â moc jaŋere ʒâŋe ine ʒiŋuc: Micne Jehiele â Ʒetam â Joele.
Eme Simeire ŋokâfâc wâc jahec â moc jaha jumbiŋ, jaŋere ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc: Selomoti â Haʒiele â Haraŋ. Ŋic i jaŋe Ladaŋte kikefuŋfâc jaŋere micne jumbiŋ.
Erâ Simeire ŋokâfâc gâcne jaŋe ʒiŋuc: Jahati â Ʒina â Jeusi â Beria. Ŋic jahec â jahec i jaŋe Simeire ŋokâfâc.
Jahati e micne juwec, eme ere râpeo ine Ʒiʒazi juwec. Eme Jeusi â Beria jahe ŋokâfâc‐jekic bocjaha mi jumbiŋ. Irec jahere manapie garikiŋ mocjaha ewec.
Eme Kohatire ŋokâfâc jahec â jahec ine ʒiŋuc: Amaram â Izara â Heboroŋ â Uʒiele.
Eme Amaramte ŋokâ jahec ine Aroŋ â Mose. Eme Aroŋ e wiac tirine jâmbâŋ mutirihuc juocte bâwosâekicne. Eme e â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnehuc ere maio hosâc âsu rikerâ ʒâŋe‐ticnao jambuŋdâŋ muhuc juniŋte râec‐jopakicne.
Â Anuture ŋic Mose ere ŋokâfâc jaŋe ine Lewi guruo ʒuhuc‐jopakicne.
Eme Mosere ŋokâ jahec jahere ʒâŋe Geresom â Elieʒe.
Geresomte ŋokâ ine micne Sebuele.
Elieʒere ŋokâ ine micne Rehabia. Elieʒe e ŋokâfâcne moc mi jucnembiŋ â Rehabiare ine bocjaha jâmbâŋ jumbiŋ.
Izarare ŋokâ ine micne Selomiti.
Heboroŋte ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Jeria, e micne juwec, eme ere râpeo ine Amaria, eme ere râpeo Jahaʒiele eme ere râpeo ine Jekameam.
Eme Uʒielere ŋokâ jajahec ine micne Mika â ere râpeo Isia.
Eme Merarire ŋokâ jahec jahere ʒâŋe ine Mali â Musi. Eme Malire ŋokâ jajahec jaha: Eleaʒa â Kisi.
Eleaʒa e ŋokâfâcne moc mi bâfuac‐jopahuc otâfâcne sawa bâfuac‐joparâ hâmowec. Ehame soctofafâc‐jeŋic Kisire ŋokâfâc jaŋe rocjopambiŋ.
Eme Musire ŋokâfâc jahec â moc ine ʒiŋuc: Mali, Edere â Jeremoti.
Lewiŋic i jaŋe garikiŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere micnefâc ʒare‐jeŋic birio buc buc wose qâreŋ ejarekicne. Eme jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac jaŋe Wofuŋte ufuŋko gie bahuc jumbiŋ.
Dawidi e ʒiŋuc hâcne muwec: “Israere Wofuŋ Ahutu e ŋicfâcne wama bâfua‐jarewec. Erâ e Jerusalem haeo hâcne jurahuc jaha jukac.
Eme irec Lewiŋic jaŋe qoruc boze me giere wiac i ʒuhuckerâ moc mi reŋke junʒepieŋ.”
Dawidi e dâŋ tatarane iŋuc muwecte Lewiŋic jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ fekac jaŋe qâreŋ‐jopambiŋ.
“Jaŋe ine Aroŋte ŋokâfâc bafic‐jopahuc Wofuŋte ufuŋko gie banʒepieŋ. Ehuc hae ʒoŋa â ufuŋ maŋne, erâ wiac tirine i ba emasaŋ ehuc Anuture ufuŋko gie gâcne banʒepieŋ.
Erâ jaŋe bafic‐jopahuc jaha Wofuŋte maio poroŋ furu mukicne rârâe â taha bâzi â poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric irec uucne â poroŋ rikekicne â taha wiac wokemaŋhec jârickekicne erâ ŋemâc bâbâfua â sâc meta wiac bajumbiŋ i mâmâc hone sonaŋ enʒepieŋ.
Erâ furic owâc sâc domahuc Wofuŋ daŋge mumuteŋ ecnenʒepieŋ.
Erâ sabata hombaŋko me mosa furune wahame, me tiwâ ʒepec dameŋko qowi bâzi ʒare mujarekicne i Wofuŋ rikecneniŋmu sâc Wofuŋte maio fuarâ junʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc tutumaŋ qoruc boze â furufic i hone sonaŋ ehuc qomâfâc‐jeŋic Aroŋte ŋokâfâc bafic‐jopapie jaŋe Wofuŋte ufuŋko gie banʒepieŋ.”
Aroŋte ɋâricfâc bâfâuc‐jopapie gurune gurune ʒiŋuc fuambiŋ: Aroŋte ŋokâfâc Nadaba, Abihu, Eleaʒa â Itama.
Eme Nadaba â Abihu jahe mamac‐jekic juhame naru motec tâmiric juhuc hâmopic. Irec Eleaʒa â Itama jahe taha bapa erâ jupic.
Eme Eleaʒare ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec Zadoko â Itamare ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec Abimelec jahe Dawidi bafickehapire gie‐jeŋic mujarekicne irec sâcko biric‐jopa rawec.
Eme Itamare ŋokâfâc siric‐jopahuc Eleaʒare ŋokâfâc jaŋerao ŋic micne ŋeŋemâcne jumbiŋte Eleaʒare birio garikiŋ sâc irec micne 16 râec‐jopambiŋ â Itamare ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec ine 8 râec‐jopambiŋ.
Ehuc Eleaʒare ɋâricfâc jaŋere ŋondeŋko mecne â Itamare ɋâricfâc jaŋere ŋondeŋko mecne furuficte â Anuture taha bapa jumbiŋte ɋâsâi qahuc râec‐jopambiŋ hâcne.
Ehame Lewire ɋâric moc, Netanele ŋokâ‐ticne qâqâreŋ ŋic Semaja e ŋicwofuŋte maio â fekicne jaŋere maio, erâ taha bapa Zadoko â Abiata ŋokâ‐ticne Abimelec, erâ taha bapa â Lewiŋic garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc micnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere maio ʒâŋe‐jeŋic qâreŋkewec. Eme garikiŋ mocte micne i Eleaʒare biŋe, â garikiŋ mocte micne i Itamare biŋe, iŋuc bâwosâec‐jopa rambiŋ.
Eme bâbâni jâmbâŋ ɋâsâi qapie Jojaribi âke fuawec; eme mocwâc qapie Jedaja âke fuawec.
Eme ʒuhuckerâ mocwâc qapie Harim âke fuawec; izi mocwâc qapie Seorim âke fuawec.
Eme mocwâc qapie Malikia âke fuawec; eme mocwâc qapie Mijamiŋ âke fuawec.
Eme ʒuhuckerâ mocwâc qapie Hakozi âke fuawec; izi mocwâc qapie Abia âke fuawec.
Eme izi mocwâc qapie Jesua âke fuawec; eme mocwâc qapie Sekania âke fuawec.
Ehame mocwâc qapie Eliasibi âke fuawec; izi mocwâc qapie Jakim âke fuawec.
Eme ʒuhuckerâ mocwâc qapie Hufa âke fuawec; izi mocwâc qapie Jesebea âke fuawec.
Eme ʒuhuckerâ mocwâc qapie Biliga âke fuawec; eme mocwâc qapie Imere âke fuawec.
Ehame mocwâc qapie Heʒiri âke fuawec; izi mocwâc qapie Hapizeze âke fuawec.
Eme mocwâc qapie Petahia âke fuawec; izi mocwâc qapie Jeheʒikele âke fuawec.
Ehame mocwâc qapie Jakiŋ âke fuawec; eme mocwâc qapie Gamulu âke fuawec.
Eme harierâ mocwâc qapie Delaja âke fuawec eme tatarane mocwâc qapie Mazia âke fuawec.
Israere Wofuŋ Anutuzi apa ŋosa‐jeŋic Aroŋ mutâcnecnewec irec sâcko eki Wofuŋte ufuŋko gie bazo fisiniŋte biri râe‐jarewec ŋic i jaŋere ʒâŋe biri ine hâcne.
Lewire ŋokâfâc gâcne sâko ine ʒiŋuc: Amaramte ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec Subaele. Eme Subaele ŋokâfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec ine Jedaja.
Eme Rehabiare ine ʒiŋuc: Rehabia ŋokâfâcne jaŋeraonec ine micne Isia.
Eme Izarare ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Selomoti. Eme Selomotire ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec ine Jahati.
Eme Heboroŋte ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Micne Jeria; eme ere râpeo Amaria; eme ere râpeo Jahaʒiele; eme ere râpeo ine Jekameam.
Eme Uʒielere ŋokâ ine Mika; â Mikare ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec ine Samiri.
Eme Mika ɋaticnere ʒâŋe Isia. Eme Isiare ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec Ʒekaria.
Eme Merarire ŋokâ jajahec jahere ʒâŋe Mali â Musi. Eme Jaʒijare ŋokâ ine Beno.
Eme Merarire ɋâric Jaʒijarao fuambiŋ ine Beno, Soham, Ʒakuru â Ibiri.
Eme Maliraonec ine Eleaʒa, e ŋokâfâcne moc mi fuambiŋ.
Eme Kisiraonec ine Kisi ŋokâ‐ticne Jeramele.
Eme Musire ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Mali, Edere â Jerimoti. Lewiŋic jaŋere ŋokâfâc garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc iŋuc hâcne jumbiŋ.
Erâ qomâfâc‐jeŋic Aroŋte ŋokâfâc hâcne jaŋere ɋâsâi qambiŋ iŋuc jaha garikiŋ sâc irec micne ʒi â ɋafâc‐jenic jaŋere ɋâsâi i ŋicwofuŋ Dawidi â Zadoko â Abimelec, erâ taha bapa â Lewiŋic garikiŋfâc‐jeŋicte micnefâc jaŋere maio qambiŋ.
Eme Dawidi â giere micne jaŋe Asafa â Hemaŋ â Jedutuŋ jaŋere ŋokâfâc tucne jaŋe gita kulele â woŋgâŋhec findaŋdâŋ muhuc juniŋte bâwosâec‐jopambiŋ wâc. Eme gie i bambiŋ ŋic i jaŋere ʒâŋe biri ʒiŋuc:
Asafare ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec ine ʒiŋuc: Ʒakuru, Josefe, Netania â Asarela. Ŋic i jaŋe Asafare rurumaŋko juhuc ŋicwofuŋte mumutâcko findaŋdâŋ mumbiŋ.
Eme Jedutuŋ ŋokâfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec ine ʒiŋuc: Gedalia, Zeri, Jesaja, Simei, Hasabia â Matitia. Jaŋe 6‐zi mamac‐jeŋic Jedutuŋte rurumaŋko juhuc kulelehec findaŋdâŋ muhuc Wofuŋ daŋge mumuteŋ ecnembiŋ.
Eme Hemaŋte ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec ine Bukia, Matania, Uʒiele, Sebuele â Jerimoti, Hanania, Hanani, Eliata, Gidaleti â Romamati‐Eʒe, Josebekasa, Maloti, Hotiri â Mahaʒio.
Ŋic i jaŋe ŋicwofuŋte findaŋdâŋ mumu ŋic Hemaŋ ere ŋokâfâc. Jaŋe Anutuzi Hemaŋ bafahareocte mupaŋkecnewec irec sâcko fuarâ jumbiŋ. Hemaŋ e Anutuzi ŋokâfâcne 14 â otâfâcne jahec â moc tahackewec.
Jaŋe ʒeŋgoma mamac‐jeŋicte rurumaŋko juhuc musio Wofuŋte ufuŋko woŋgâŋ â gita kulelehec Anuture ufuŋko gie bahuc jumbiŋ. Eme Asafa â Jedutuŋ â Hemaŋ jaŋe ine ŋicwofuŋte mumutâcko jumbiŋ.
Eme jaŋe â qomâfâc‐jeŋic Wofuŋ gae hecnehuc juniŋte qazu‐jarepie mana‐hâmombiŋ jaŋere qâqâhâc ʒare i 288.
Jaŋe kâcɋene â piticne, qaqazu â wosaekicne mâmâc gie‐jeŋicte ɋâsâi qambiŋ.
Eme bâbâni jâmbâŋ Asafare ʒâŋeo ɋâsâi qapie Josefe âke fuawec. Izi mocwâc qapie Gedalia â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme mocwâc qapie Ʒakuru â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme mocwâc qapie Iziri â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Izi mocwâc qapie Netania â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme mocwâc harierâ qapie Bukia â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme ʒuhuckerâ mocwâc qapie Jesarela â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Izi mocwâc qapie Jesaja â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme mocwâc qapie Matania â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme ʒuhuckerâ mocwâc qapie Simei â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Ehame mocwâc qapie Aʒarele â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme ʒuhuckerâ qapie Hasabia â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme mocwâc qapie Subaele â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme mocwâc qapie Matitia â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Izi ʒuhuckerâ qapie Jeremoti â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme mocwâc qapie Hanania â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Izi ʒuhuckerâ qapie Josebekasa â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme mocwâc qapie Hanani â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme ʒuhuckerâ qapie Maloti â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme mocwâc qapie Eliata â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme ʒuhuckerâ qapie Hotiri â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme ʒuhuckerâ mocwâc qapie Gidaleti â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Eme mocwâc qapie Mahaʒio â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Izi tatarane qapie Romamati‐Eʒe â ŋokâ qomâfâcne 12 jaŋe âke fuac‐jopawec.
Haesac motâc soŋaŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe biri kecʒiŋuc: Korare ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec Korere ŋokâ Meselemia, e Asafare ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec.
Eme Meselemiare ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc fuambiŋ: Mârâc ŋokâ Ʒekaria, eme ere râpeo Jediae fuawec. Eme ere râpeo Ʒebadia, eme ere râpeo Jataniele fuawec.
Eme ere râpeo Elam, eme ere râpeo Johanaŋ, eme ere râpeo Elihoenai fuawec.
Eme Obededom ere ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc fuambiŋ: Mârâc ŋokâ Semaja, eme ere râpeo Joʒabada, eme ere râpeo Netanele;
eme ere râpeo Amiele, eme ere râpeo Isasa, eme ere râpeo Peuletai, Obededom e Anutuzi jambuŋkewec hâcne.
Ehame ŋokâ‐ticne Semaja ere ŋokâfâc wâc fuambiŋ. Erâ jaŋe ŋic tâpiri sâkohec jumbiŋte kikefuŋfâc‐jeŋic qaŋeŋ‐jopahuc jumbiŋ.
Eme Semajare ŋokâfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Otini, Refaele, Obede â Eliʒabada. Eme ɋa jahecne Elihu â Semakia jahe ʒoɋac‐jekichec jaha.
Ŋic i jaŋe jaŋacne ŋokâ ɋafâc‐jeŋic jaŋe Obededomte ɋâricfâc sasawa. Jaŋe gie bapare ʒoɋac‐jeŋic fowec; qâqâhâc ʒare‐jeŋic 62.
Eme Meselemiare ŋokâ ɋafâc ʒoɋachec 18 jumbiŋ.
Eme Merarire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec Hosa ere ŋokâfâc ʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Micne Simiri, e mârâc fufua aricne, erâ sifu mamac‐ticnezi micne âkendâŋnewec.
Eme ere râpeo ine Hilikia, eme ere râpeo Tebalia, eme ere râpeo Ʒekaria, Hosare ŋokâ ɋafâc sasawa jaŋere ʒare 13.
Haesac motâc soŋaŋ i jaŋe micnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao ʒuhuckehuc qomâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe embiŋ irec sâc jaha ehuc kiŋaŋ gie‐jeŋic i Wofuŋte ufuŋko bahuc jumbiŋ.
Eme kâcɋene â piticne jaŋe garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc motâc‐jeŋic forawec irec ɋâsâi mâmâc qambiŋ.
Ehuc ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec motâc fowec irec ɋâsâi qapie Selemia âke fuawec. Eme ŋokâ‐ticne muketeŋ saric Ʒekaria ere wâc ɋâsâi qapie motâc faicpec irec soŋaŋ e âke fuawec.
Ehame Obededomte ɋâsâi qapie motâc juwicpec irec soŋaŋ e âke fuawec; ehame ŋokâfâcne jaŋe rowaŋfic qikiŋne‐jarembiŋ.
Eme Supim â Hosa jahere ɋâsâi qapie ʒoaŋ huhunao motâc fowec erâ hata hâŋ fekac ira Salekete motâc fowec irec soŋaŋ âke fuac‐jofawec. Ehame ŋifec â ŋifec soŋaŋ domambiŋ.
Ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec ira ʒoaŋ gie bapa sâc ŋic 6 jaŋe soŋaŋ domambiŋ â faicpec ira ʒoaŋ gie bapa sâc ŋic jahec â jaheczi jumbiŋ â juwicpec ira iŋuc jaha ʒoaŋ gie bapa sâc jahec â jaheczi jumbiŋ. Eme rowaŋfic ira ine ʒoaŋgie bapa sâc jajahec jajahec iŋuc jumbiŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ huhunaopec ʒae fowec ira jahec â jahec jaŋe hatao jumbiŋ â jajahec jahe ine ʒaeo jupic.
Korare ɋâricfâc â Merarire ɋâricfâc jaŋere guruoneczi haesac motâc soŋaŋ jumbiŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe biri ine hâcne.
Eme Lewiŋic jaŋeraonec Ahiazi Anuture ufuŋko ʒeŋaŋ ŋerawec i mecne â tahare ʒeŋaŋ mutirikicne i mâmâc soŋaŋkewec.
Eme Geresoŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ɋâric‐ticne moc Ladaŋ, eme erao fuambiŋ jaŋere micne ine Jehiele.
Eme Jehielere ŋokâ jajahec Ʒetam â ɋaticne Joele jahe Wofuŋ ufuŋ‐ticnere ʒeŋaŋ i soŋaŋkehuc jupic.
Eme Amaram â Izara â Heboroŋ â Uʒiele jaŋere ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec
ine Geresomte ŋokâ Mose ŋosa‐ticne Sebuelezi ʒeŋaŋ ŋerawec irec soŋaŋ kâcɋene juwec.
Eme ɋaticne Elieʒere ŋokâ Rehabia â Rehabiare ŋokâ Jesaja; eme Jesajare ŋokâ Joram â Joramte ŋokâ Ʒikiri â Ʒikirire ŋokâ Selomoti.
Eme Selomoti e â qomâfâcne jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ Dawidi â garikiŋ gurune gurune jaŋere micne erâ momori tauseŋ gurune gurune â 100 gurune gurune jaŋe tahare ʒeŋaŋ mutiripie ŋerawec irec soŋaŋ jumbiŋ.
Eme ʒikao wiac gâcne rokicne taha izi Wofuŋte ufuŋ ba bâpiaŋ eniŋte irec biŋe bâtirimbiŋ.
Erâ wâc findaŋdâŋ mumu ŋic Samue â Kisi ŋokâ‐ticne Saulo, erâ Nerare ŋokâ Abene â Zeruja ŋokâ‐ticne Joabe jaŋe wiac bâtirimbiŋ, ine hâcne taha bâtirikicne sasawa i Selomoti â qomâfâcne jaŋe hone soŋaŋ efârembiŋ.
Eme Izarare ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec Kenania â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe Israe ŋic jaŋere erâ sahackopec giere fekicne â mumutara ŋic âkendâŋ‐jopambiŋ.
Eme Heboroŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Hasabia â qomâfâcne ŋic ʒoɋac‐jeŋichec 1 tauseŋ 700 jaŋe Jordaŋ opâonec ʒoaŋ huhunaopec Israe ŋic jumbiŋ jaŋe Wofuŋte gie â ŋicwofuŋte gie bahapie hone soŋaŋ ejarembiŋ.
Eme Heboroŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Jeria e Heboroŋte ɋâricfâc gaŋne gaŋne fua wefumbiŋ â garikiŋ gurune gurune jaŋere micne juwec. Eme Dawidizi ŋicwofuŋ juhame jara 40 ewec dameŋ ira babasa gie bahuc jaŋere guruo momori ŋic ʒoɋac sâko‐jeŋichec Gileade mâreŋko Jazere haeo jupie bafuac‐jopambiŋ.
Eme Dawidizi Jeria â qomâfâcne ŋic ʒoɋac‐jeŋichec 2 tauseŋ 700 garikiŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere micne hâcne, jaŋe Rubeŋ guru â Gade guru â Manase guru dâkâne jaŋe Anuture gie â ŋicwofuŋte gie bahapie hone soŋaŋ ejareniŋte âkendâŋ‐jopawec.
Israe ŋic garikiŋ gurune gurune jaŋere micne â momori tauseŋ gurune gurune â 100 gurune gurune jaŋere micne, erâ fekicnefâc‐jeŋic jara sâc mosane mosane ââkehocko gie fuŋne fuŋne bahuc ŋicwofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnembiŋ jaŋere biri ʒi. Erâ wâc momori guru buc buc ʒare‐jeŋic 24 tauseŋ sasawa.
Eme Ʒabidie ŋokâ‐ticne Jasobeam e fuŋfuŋke mosa ira bâbâni guru jaŋe qizec‐jopawec. Ere guruo ŋic 24 tauseŋzi jumbiŋ.
E Perezere ɋâriczi fuŋfuŋke mosa ira momori micne sasawa jaŋere micne juwec.
Eme Ahohi ŋic moc ʒâŋene Dodai e mosa moc wahawec ira momori guru jumbiŋ jaŋe qizec‐jopawec. Ere guruo ŋic 24 tauseŋzi jumbiŋ.
Ehame mosa moc mocwâc wahawec ira micne moc juwec, e taha bapa Jojadare ŋokâ ʒâŋene Benaja. Ere guruo momori 24 tauseŋzi jumbiŋ.
Erâ Benaja eki hâcne ŋic 30 jaŋere guruo ŋic tâpiri ɋicwânʒâŋhec juwec, erâ ekizia wâc micne‐jeŋic juwec. Eme ere guru i ŋokâ‐ticne Amiʒabazi qizec‐jopawec.
Eme mosa moc mocwâc wahame Joabere ɋa Asahelezi guru moc qizec‐jopawec. Ehame ŋokâ‐ticne Ʒebadiazi tucticne qawec. Ere guruo momori 24 tauseŋzi jumbiŋ.
Ehame mosa moc mocwâc wahame Izara ŋic moc ʒâŋene Samehuti eki guru moc jaŋere micne juwec. Ere guruo momori 24 tauseŋzi jumbiŋ.
Eme mosa moc mocwâc wahame Tekoi ŋic moc ʒâŋene Ikesi ere ŋokâ Irazi guru moc jaŋere micne juwec. Eme ere guruo momori 24 tauseŋzi jumbiŋ.
Eme mosa moc mocwâc wahame Eferaimte ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec Peloni ŋic moc ʒâŋene Helezi eki guru moc qizec‐jopawec. Ere guruo momori 24 tauseŋzi jumbiŋ.
Eme mosa moc mocwâc wahame Husati haeonec Ʒera ŋic ʒâŋene Sibekai eki qizec‐jopawec. Ere guruo momori 24 tauseŋ jumbiŋ.
Izi mosa moc mocwâc wahame Anatoti haeonec Benjamiŋ ŋic moc ʒâŋene Abieʒe eki qizec‐jopawec. Eme ere guruo momori 24 tauseŋzi jumbiŋ.
Eme mosa moc mocwâc wahame Netofa haeonec Ʒera ŋic moc ʒâŋene Maharai eki guru moc qizec‐jopawec. Eme ere guruo momori 24 tauseŋzi jumbiŋ.
Izi mosa moc mocwâc wahame Piratoŋ haeonec Eferaimte ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Benaja eki guru moc qizec‐jopawec. Eme ere guruo momori 24 tauseŋzi jumbiŋ.
Izi juku mosa moc mocwâc wahame Netofa haeocnec Otinie ere ɋâric moc ʒâŋene Heledai eki guru moc qizec‐jopawec. Eme ere guruo momori 24 tauseŋzi jumbiŋ.
Israe guruo Rubeŋ guru jaŋere micne fekicne i Ʒikirire ŋokâ Elieʒezi juwec. Eme Simeoŋ guru jaŋere micne ine Makare ŋokâ Sefatiazi juwec.
Eme Lewi guru jaŋere micne ine Kemuele ere ŋokâ Hasabiazi juwec, â Aroŋ guru jaŋere micne ine Zadokozi juwec.
Eme Juda guru jaŋere micne ine Dawidi hahacfâcne jaŋeraonec moc ʒâŋene Elihu eki micne juwec; â Isasa guru jaŋere micne ine Mikaere ŋokâ Omirizi juwec.
Eme Sebuloŋ guru jaŋere micne ine Obadiare ŋokâ Isimajazi Juwec; â Naftali guru jaŋere micne ine Aʒariele ere ŋokâ Jeremotizi juwec.
Eme Eferaimte guru jaŋere micne ine Aʒaʒiare ŋokâ Hoseazi juwec; â Manase guru dâkâne jaŋere micne ine Pedajare ŋokâ Joelezi juwec.
Eme Manase guru dâkâne moc Gileade mâreŋko jumbiŋ jaŋere micne ine Ʒekariare ŋokâ Idozi juwec; â Benjamiŋ guru jaŋere micne ine Abenere ŋokâ Jasielezi juwec.
Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne Israe ŋicguru jaŋere micne bapa jumbiŋ.
Wofuŋzi sambâŋko bâpiŋ ŋeraŋgopieŋ irec sâc Israe ŋic bâfuac‐jopaocte mupaŋkewec, irec Dawidi e jara‐jenic 20 mi bazumbiŋ jaŋe mi wosec‐jopawec.
Zerujare ŋokâ Joabezi fuŋkerâ wosec‐jopawec, erâ mi wosec‐jopa‐fârewec. Dawidizi wose qâreŋ ejarewec irec erâ Wofuŋtaonec kimbeŋzi Israe ŋic jaŋere faio fewec. Eme irec ʒare‐jeŋic i ŋicwofuŋ Dawidire Binaŋ Qâhâcko mi râekicne.
Eme ŋicwofuŋte ʒeŋaŋ irec soŋaŋ i Adiele ere ŋokâ Aʒamawetazi juwec. Â hae sâkoo â hae piticko erâ ficsanaŋko ʒeŋaŋ ŋerawec irec soŋaŋ ine Uʒiare ŋokâ Jonataŋzi juwec.
Eme gieo mâreŋ he qanʒaŋ embiŋ jaŋere soŋaŋ ine Kelubure ŋokâ Eʒarizi juwec.
Eme waiŋ gie forawec irec soŋaŋ ine Ramati ŋic Simeizi juwec; â waiŋ opâne rowaŋficko râembiŋ irec soŋaŋ ine Sifimi ŋic Ʒabidizi juwec.
Eme Oliwa â fâricjâc wiac Sefela mâreŋko doma rawec irec soŋaŋ ine Gederi ŋic Baali‐Hanaŋzi juwec; â wokemaŋ râe guruc embiŋ irec soŋaŋ ine Joasizi juwec.
Eme lama bulimakao Saroŋ mâreŋko jumbiŋ irec soŋaŋ Saroŋ ŋic Sitiraizi juwec; â wâneŋko jumbiŋ irec soŋaŋ ine Adelaire ŋokâ Safatizi juwec.
Eme kamele soŋaŋ ine Isimae ŋic Obilizi juwec; â doŋgi ŋokacne irec soŋaŋ ine Meronoti ŋic Jedejazi juwec.
Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne ŋicwofuŋ Dawidire wiac sasawa forawec irec soŋaŋ jumbiŋ.
Dawidire mamac pitic Jonataŋ e ŋic mamana tarahec â qâqâreŋ ŋic juwecte dâŋko bafickehuc juwec. Eme e â Hakimonire ŋokâ Jehiele jahe ŋicwofuŋte ŋokâfâc hone maiŋ ejarepic.
Eme Ahitofe e iŋuc jaha ŋicwofuŋ dâŋko bafickehuc juwec â Areki ŋic Husai eki ine ŋicwofuŋte âgo mefâro juwec.
Eme Benajare ŋokâ Jojada â Abiata jahe Ahitofere tuc qapic. Eme Joabezi ŋicwofuŋte momori guru irec micne juwec.
Dawidi e Jerusalem haeo Israe ŋic fekicne sasawa ʒiŋuc hetumaŋ‐jopawec: Israe ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere fekicne â ŋicwofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnehuc gurune gurune jurambiŋ i jaŋere fekicne â momori tauseŋ gurune gurune â 100 gurune gurune jaŋere micne, erâ ŋicwofuŋ â ŋokâfâcne jaŋere bulimakao wiac irec soŋaŋ â ŋicwofuŋ ficticnere fekicne â ŋic tai tâpiri‐jeŋichec, erâ ŋic qac momori.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Dawidi e fahare domahuc muwec: “Qomâfâc‐nane â ŋicfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe manahapie mupe. No Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapare ŋeŋe hae â Anutu‐nâŋecte ââtesiŋ fic fuaocte maŋkehuc juwareekopac. Erâ fic i fuaocte wiac sasawa emoc bâmoc efârepo.
Eme Anutuzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Go momori ŋic juhuc soc hoŋkemeŋte ʒâŋe‐nanere fic moc mi bazemec.’
Erâ sifu Israere Wofuŋ Anutuzi mamac‐nanere garikiŋfâc sasawa jaŋeraonec Israe ŋic ŋoŋere ŋicwofuŋ juraʒihuc jupemurâ rowosâecnuwec. E Juda micne bapa rowosâewec hâcne. Eme Judare kikefuŋko mamac‐nanere garikiŋfâc â mamac‐nanere ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec ine no hone aŋac enarehuc Israe ŋic sasawa ŋoŋere ŋicwofuŋ jupemurâ âkendâŋnuwec.
Eme Wofuŋzi ŋokâfâc‐nane bocjaha narewec jaŋeraonec ine ŋokâ‐nane Salomozi Israe ŋic qaŋeŋ‐ŋopahuc Wofuŋte uucmaŋko eri ŋeŋeo ŋeocte rowosâewec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Ŋokâge Salomo e ŋokâ‐nane erâ juha noni mamac‐ticne erâ jupemurâ rowosâepore eki hâcne fic â hae ʒoŋa‐nane bazejec.
E dameŋ ʒiŋuczia jukac irec sâc jaha jufehuc sâcmutâc â mumutâc dâŋnane i aimuŋ jaha soŋaŋkeocmuo ine no uucmaŋ‐ticne dope hutuŋ ecnepemu.’
Irec ʒi Wofuŋte kikefuŋ, Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋere ʒâŋe faio â Anutu‐nâŋeczi manahame Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte sâcmutâc dâŋ mu gufuc ehuc mana taraniŋte ʒoɋac enʒepieŋ. Iŋuc ehuc mâreŋ biaŋ ʒi rauckerâ jufeku hâmopie ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe wâc ʒuhuckerâ juraʒihuc junʒepieŋ.
“Eme ŋokâ‐nane Salomo go ine mamacge nore Anutu e hone mana tarac ecnehuc maŋ â mamanage hâcbuc jaha qikiŋnecnerâ buafec faio kiŋaŋ qacnezemec. Wofuŋ e ŋic maŋ sâc wosaŋeŋ bahuc ŋiczi manasu biric eekac i ʒeŋgoma mana tara‐fâreekac. Go e basacmuo ine eki bâfuacguocmu. Me e râpeckecmuo ine eki wâc go râpecgu sanaŋkeocmu.
Wofuŋ e furufic‐ticne moc bacmurâ rowosâecguwecte go dâŋ ʒi mana‐jâmbâŋkezemec. Hâbi hâro juhuc bazemec.”
Dawidi e iŋuc mufârerâ taha ufuŋte hae gâŋgâŋ â ficticne gâcne, erâ ʒeŋaŋfic â ficmaŋne faic â maŋne ʒâʒâŋiŋ, erâ ʒâʒâfic katapa ŋeŋere ficmaŋ birickewec biri i ŋokâ‐ticne Salomo râcnewec.
Erâ Wofuŋ ufuŋ‐ticnere hae ʒoŋa â rârec rârec fic maŋne maŋne, erâ Anutu ufuŋ‐ticnere ʒeŋaŋfic â wiac bâtirikicne irec ʒeŋaŋfic i manasuwec sâc birickewec.
Erâ taha bapa â Lewiŋic jaŋere fic maŋne maŋne âke tâcnekicne â Wofuŋte ufuŋko gie bazo irec biri wâc mâmâc râcnewec. Erâ Wofuŋte ufuŋko gie bazo irec râqâc wiac sasawa irec biri wâc mâmâc.
Erâ gie baniŋmu sâc irec râqâc golzi bakicne gol irec ŋemâc â siliwazi râqâc bakicne siliwa irec ŋemâc i wâc birickewec.
Erâ gie bambiŋ irec sâc lambe dodoma golzi bakicne, â lambe ŋerawec, â lambe dodomao gol fowec irec ŋemâc i buc buc â lambere ŋemâc i mâmâc birickewec. Erâ lambe dodoma siliwazi bakicne â lambe‐jeŋic ŋerawec i lambe dodoma buc buc gie bambiŋ sâc ŋemâc‐jeŋic birickewec.
Erâ Wofuŋte maŋfuŋko poroŋ furu mukicne râembiŋ irec tebo ŋerawec ira gol râe rakicne irec ŋemâc i buc buc birickewec, ehuc siliwazi tebo bakicne irec sâc ijaha ewec.
Erâ sarac â oto â râqâc gol ɋaɋacnezi bakicne, erâ gomba golzi bakicne irec ŋemâc buc buc birickewec. Erâ siliwazi gomba bakicne irec sâc ijaha ewec.
Eme hosâc âsu ririkere alata gol rike sueŋkekicnezi bakicne irec ŋemâc i mâmâc birickewec. Erâ wâc kerubim jahe keretac golzi bakicne fainao ŋehuc fakec‐jekiczi Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapa sâockewec keretac irec biri i mâmâc râecnewec.
Ehuc muwec, “Wofuŋ e wiac i sasawa mutaniŋke‐nareme hone mana tarac ehuc birickepo. Irec gie sasawa i birickekicne irec sâcko bazo.”
Dawidi e iŋuc murâ ŋokâ‐ticne Salomo ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Sanaŋkerâ hâbi hâro juhuc bazemec, hâwicmâc â memeŋ garu tâmiric juzemec. Wofuŋ Anutu e nore Anutuzi gohec jukac. E hone suŋgiŋ me behe qaisoc mi egarehame juku Wofuŋ ufuŋ‐ticnere gie sasawa i tara‐fârezokac.
