Eme Salomore kiŋaŋ qaqafâc jaŋere ɋâricfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Sotaire ɋâricfâc, Hosoferetire ɋâricfâc, Perudare ɋâricfâc.
Jalare ɋâricfâc, Darikoŋte ɋâricfâc, Gidelere ɋâricfâc.
Sefatiare ɋâricfâc, Hatilire ɋâricfâc, Pokere Zebaimte ɋâricfâc â Amire ɋâricfâc.
Eme taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqafâc â Salomore kiŋaŋ qaqafâc jaŋere ŋokâfâc qâqâhâc ʒare‐jeŋic 392.
Eme guru kecʒiŋuc jaŋe Israe guruonec me mâcne irec fuŋne mecne, me kikefuŋ â apa ŋiric ŋurucfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere fuŋne mecne mi manahuc sifu Telemeha â Teleharesa â Kerubu â Adaŋ erâ Imere haeonec fisimbiŋ:
Delajare ɋâricfâc â Tobiare ɋâricfâc â Nekodare ɋâricfâc, qâqâhâc ʒare‐jeŋic ine 652.
Eme taha bapa jaŋere ɋâricfâc kecʒiŋuc jaŋe wâc fisimbiŋ: Habajare ɋâricfâc, Hakozire ɋâricfâc, Bariʒilaire ɋâricfâc, e Gileade ŋic Bariʒilaire otâfâc jaŋeraonec moc ŋonâŋ‐ticne rowecte kimo‐ticnere wase bambiŋ.
Eme guru i jaŋe ŋic gaŋne gaŋne fua wefumbiŋ jaŋere birio ʒâŋe‐jeŋic basambiŋ. Eme irec erâ jaŋe wâwânâŋhec muhuc taha bapa birio mi ʒuhuc‐jopambiŋ.
Eme jaŋe nânâ tirine i micwirec mi nânâ mâc juhapie juku taha bapa moc fuarâ dâŋ mumutarare ma Urim â Tumim jahe mu wioc ejacteocte mâreŋ soŋaŋ sâkozi jazawec.
Eme kikefuŋ qâqâhâc ʒare‐jeŋic i 42 tauseŋ 360.
Eme jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic ŋic â ŋokac 7 tauseŋ 337, iŋuczi jumbiŋ. Erâ gae hehe ŋic â ŋokac 200‐zi jumbiŋ.
Eme becâsicfâc‐jeŋic i 736 â bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic ine 245.
Â kamelefâc‐jeŋic i 435 â doŋgifâc‐jeŋic ine 6 tauseŋ 720, iŋuc jujarembiŋ.
Eme garikiŋne garikiŋne jaŋere micnefâc tucne jaŋe Jerusalem haeo Wofuŋte ufuŋ ŋewec ira fisirâ ŋeŋetac‐ticne mocwâc bafahareniŋte Anuture ufuŋte taha buafecko râembiŋ.
Jaŋe tâpiri‐jeŋicte sâcko gie irec kânoŋko gol ŋemâc‐ticne 61 tauseŋ â siliwa ŋemâc‐ticne 5 tauseŋ, erâ taha bapa ŋaqi 100 iŋuc râembiŋ.
Eme taha bapa â Lewiŋic erâ ŋic ŋokac tucne jaŋe Jerusalem hae â rârec rârec ira hae‐jeŋicko jumbiŋ. Ehame gae hehe ŋic â haesac motâc soŋaŋ â taha ufuŋko gie bambiŋ jaŋe iŋuc jaha hae‐jeŋicko jurambiŋ, â Israe ŋic jaŋe wâc hae‐jeŋic sâc jurambiŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋe hae‐jeŋic sâc juhapie mosa 7 wahame maŋ mocjaha ehuc Jerusalem haeo tumaŋne‐fârembiŋ.
Ehame Jozadacte ŋokâ Jesua â taha bapa âgofâc‐ticne erâ Sealitire ŋokâ Serubabe â soctofafâc‐ticne jaŋe faharerâ Anuture ŋic Mosere sâcmutâc dâŋko qâreŋkekicne irec sâcko qowi bâzi rikeniŋte Israere Anutu ere alata bambiŋ.
Jaŋe mâreŋ sâc irec ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere hâwic‐jopawecte alata i fuŋkerâ ŋeŋe‐ticnao bapie ŋewec. Eme jaŋe ira Wofuŋte qowi bâzi i furic owâc rikembiŋ.
Erâ mujarekicne irec sâcko tiri bozere hombaŋ ŋembiŋ. Ehuc mumutâc dâŋko ʒare mutâcne‐jarekicne irec sâc ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne qowi bâzi rike jumbieŋ.
Eme ira ʒuhuckerâ dameŋ sâc wiac kecʒiŋuc wâc rike râec ejumbieŋ: Qowi bâzi, mosa furunere taha bâzi, dameŋ mukicnao Wofuŋte tiwâ bâzi erâ buafecko Wofuŋ taha babacne.
Jaŋe mosa 7 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa fufuŋkenao fuŋkerâ Wofuŋ qowi bâzi rikecnembiŋ. Erâ ine Wofuŋte taha ufuŋ irec hobeteŋne i biac mi râembiŋ.
Eme irec jaŋe moneŋ i qânâzi fic bapa ŋic â kamunda jarembiŋ. Ehuc nânâ opâ â wokemaŋ ine Sidoŋ â Tiro ŋic jaŋe Lebanoŋ mâreŋkonec jâmâzâc jâc i Perisia ŋicwofuŋ Kiruzi mana‐jarewec irec sâc hâwecko Jope haeo bafisiniŋte jarembiŋ.
Eme jaŋe Jerusalem haeo Anuture ufuŋko fisirâ juwefukupie jara namba 2 irec mosa jajahec eha Sealitiere ŋokâ Serubabe â Jozadacte ŋokâ Jesua jahe gie fuŋkehapire qomâfâc‐jekic gâcne taha bapa â Lewiŋic erâ kâpâcwâru bacjopa rakicne jaŋe Jerusalem haeo risierâ bafic‐jopambiŋ. Erâ Lewiŋic jara‐jeŋic 20‐o domarâ faic fekac jaŋe Wofuŋte ufuŋ irec gie qizeckeniŋte âkendâŋ‐jopambiŋ.
Eme Jesua â ŋokâfâcne erâ soctofafâc‐ticne, erâ Judare ɋâricfâc Kadimiele â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe Henadadire ŋokâfâc â Lewiŋic â ŋokâfac‐jeŋic erâ soctofafâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec Anuture ufuŋ bambiŋ gieŋic i jaŋe hone soŋaŋ ejarembiŋ.
Eme ufuŋ bambiŋ jaŋe Wofuŋte taha ufuŋte hobeteŋne râepie tarame Israe ŋicwofuŋ Dawidizi mutâcnewec irec sâcko taha bapa jaŋe Wofuŋ ʒeri mumuteŋ ecneniŋte ŋaqi‐jeŋichec qeŋ barâ fisimbiŋ, â Asafare ɋâricfâc Lewi guru jaŋe woŋgâŋ‐jeŋichec fisimbiŋ.
Ehuc nareŋ gareŋko Wofuŋ daŋge â ʒeri mumuteŋ ecnehuc gae ʒiŋuc hembiŋ: “Wofuŋ e uruc jauŋ‐ticnehec, â aki anonoc‐ticne i Israe ŋic nâŋâcnao fofo sanaŋ foekac.” Ehame ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Wofuŋ ufuŋ‐ticnere hobeteŋ râepie tarawec irec Wofuŋ ʒeri mumuteŋ ecnehuc kâcɋene owackembiŋ.
Ehame bocjaha jaŋe ʒeri sâko ehuc owackembiŋ, erâ taha bapa â Lewiŋic bocjaha erâ garikiŋ sâc irec micne ŋicqizec jaŋe ine ufuŋ hobeteŋne râepie tarawec i honerâ ufuŋ raŋɋane ŋeme honembiŋzi owa ruruckerâ kiombiŋ.
Eme mâretec owa ruruckembiŋte ŋic ŋokac taicko juhuc fânâŋ manambiŋ jaŋe ʒerire owa â kifânâŋ i sâcne mi mana râwiŋ‐jofambiŋ.
Juda â Benjamiŋ guru kâpâcwâruo bacjopa rambiŋkonec risiembiŋ jaŋe Israere Wofuŋ Anuture taha ufuŋ i mocwâc bahuc juŋgopieŋ, kisâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe biŋe iŋuc manambiŋ.
Manarâ Serubabe â garikiŋ sâc irec micne jaŋerao rarâ ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Ŋoŋe eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha nâŋe Anutu‐ŋeŋic dapecneeŋgopeneŋ, irec ufuŋ i ŋoŋehec mâmâc banʒepeneŋ. Erâ nâŋe Asiria ŋicwofuŋ Esahadoŋzi bacnâpo fisi ʒira râec‐nâpowec dameŋ ira fuŋkerâ Anutu taha bâzi rikecnembeŋzi rikecnehuc juŋgopeneŋ.”
Jaŋe iŋuc mupie Serubabe â Jesua erâ Israe maŋnao garikiŋ sâc irec micne jaŋe kecʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Ŋoŋe nâŋehec Anutu‐nâŋecte ufuŋ moc mi baniŋmu. Nâŋe Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu ere ufuŋ i Perisia ŋicwofuŋ Kiruzi munârewec irec sâcko bucnâŋec banaŋmu.”
Inuc mupie ŋic ŋokac mâreŋ rune jaŋe Judaŋiczi ufuŋ ʒuhuckerâ banʒipiŋte mu bâdoc ejarehuc hâhâwic hejarembiŋ.
Ehuc Judaŋic jaŋere mamanasu qahuc dâŋgieo râec‐jopaniŋte ŋic micne furi jarembiŋ. Mâsi i Perisia ŋicwofuŋ Kirure dameŋko fuawec erâ wâc ere faicnao Perisia ŋicwofuŋ moc, ʒâŋene Dariusi ere dameŋko fuawec jaha.
Eme juku Ahasiwerozi fuŋkerâ ŋicwofuŋ erâ juwec dameŋ ira mâreŋ rune jaŋe Juda â Jerusalem hae mâreŋ rune dâŋ qajarehuc papia qâreŋkecnembiŋ.
Eme Arataʒeʒere dameŋko Bisilam â Mitiredate â Tabele, erâ âgofâc‐jeŋic sasawa jaŋe Perisia ŋicwofuŋ Arataʒeʒe e papia qâreŋkecnembiŋ. Erâ papia i Aramaia dâŋko qâreŋkekicnere bâtikiembiŋ.
Momori micne Rehum â qâqâreŋ ŋic Simisai jahe Jerusalem hae râsi rocnehuc papia moc qâreŋkerâ ŋicwofuŋ Arataʒeʒerao râepire rawec.
Papia i ŋic ʒiŋuc jaŋe qâreŋkembiŋ: Momori micne Rehum â qâqâreŋ ŋic Simisai erâ âgofâc‐jekic gâcne, mumutara ŋic â mâreŋ soŋaŋ â ŋic fekicne, erâ Perisia ŋic â Ereki ŋic â Babeŋic erâ Elamŋic Susa haeonec.
Erâ ŋic kâcɋene â fekicne Asinapazi ŋic gurune gurune rocjoparâ Samaria hae sâc â Eufrata opâ ocniŋuc mâreŋ fowec ira râec‐jopame jumbiŋ jaŋe mâmâc qâreŋkembiŋ.
Jaŋe papia kecʒiŋuc hâcne râepie rawec: “Ŋicwofuŋ Arataʒeʒe, kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge Eufrata opâ ʒiŋucpec juŋgopeneŋ nâŋe gore manasuhuc dâŋ ʒi râe‐gareŋgopeneŋ.
Judaŋic goraonec wefumbiŋ jaŋe Jerusalem haeo rafârembiŋ, iŋuc manazemec. Jaŋe maŋrâŋgeŋheczi hae sâqocne i mocwâc heɋârerâ baŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe haesacte hobeteŋ sasawa bâpiaŋkehuc bafâreŋgopieŋ.
Irec ŋicwofuŋ go kecʒiŋuc manapaŋkec: Hae ʒi heɋârerâ bahuc haesac ʒeŋgoma batara‐fâreniŋmuo ine sahac taha hatane fuŋne fuŋne i mi râeniŋmu, eme ŋicwofuŋ gorao moneŋ fisiekac hata i ʒickeocmu.
Nâŋe ŋicwofuŋ gohec jupene aŋacne eekacte go araŋ bagarehuc dâŋ ʒi mufua‐gareŋgopeneŋ.
Irec go apa ŋosafâcge jaŋere gie binaŋte papia qizecko dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac i bâfuacmurâ wose gufuc ezemec: Hae ʒirec rune jaŋe maŋrâŋgeŋhec erâ ŋicwofuŋ â mâreŋne mâreŋne irec râsi sanaŋ, jaŋe juwicnaonecteaŋ maŋrâŋgeŋ bâfua warehuc jumbiŋ. Eme irec hâcne hae ʒi sesuctac fuawec fokac.
Nâŋe ŋicwofuŋ go ʒiŋuc gazaŋgopeneŋ: Hae ʒi heɋârerâ bahuc haesac i batara‐fâreniŋmo ine go Eufrata opâ ʒiŋucpec mâreŋ fokac irec rune mocwâc mi jucmu.”
Eme ŋicwofuŋ e okacne ʒiŋuc râeme rawec: “Momori micne Rehum â qâqâreŋ ŋic Simisai erâ âgofâc‐jekic Samaria mâreŋko â Eufrata opâ ocniŋuc mâreŋ fokac ira juŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe bubiaŋ dâŋ râe‐ŋarekopac.
Papia râe‐narembiŋ i furu jaha wose‐narembiŋ.
Eme no ŋic gâcne ejarepe wose gufuc eku ʒiŋuc bâfuambiŋ: Jerusalem hae rune jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ râsi ejarehuc maŋsanaŋ â maŋrâŋgeŋ bâfua warehuc jumbiŋ sanaŋ.
Ehuc ŋicwofuŋ tai tâpiri sâko‐jeŋichec jaŋe Jerusalem hae soŋaŋkehuc Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ fokac i wâc mâmâc soŋaŋkembiŋ. Ehame sahac taha hatane fuŋne fuŋne jarehuc jumbiŋ.
Irec ŋoŋe ŋic keci qatara‐jarepie hae i mocwâc mi heɋârenʒepieŋ. Eme jaŋe mâc juhapie noni mutara‐jarepe banʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋicwofuŋtao sisipiric â ima samaki fuazacte wiac i aimuŋ jaha soŋaŋkehuc ebac enʒepieŋ.”
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Arataʒeʒere papia i Rehum â qâqâreŋ ŋic Simisai erâ âgofâc‐jekic wose‐jarepie jaŋe picpac jaha Jerusalem haeo Judaŋic jaŋerao rarâ, hae heɋârerâ bapa gie i beheniŋte tâpirihec jaha qatara‐jarembiŋ.
Eme Anuture ufuŋ Jerusalem haeo ŋewec irec gie i bâniniŋkembiŋ. Bâniniŋkepie foha juku Perisia ŋicwofuŋ Dariusizi ŋicwofuŋ erâ juha jara jajahec maickewec.
Eme porofete jajahec Hagai â Ido ŋokâ‐ticne Ʒekaria jahe Judaŋic Juda mâreŋko â Jerusalem haeo jumbiŋ jaŋe qâhuc‐joparâ juwec, Anutu hâcne, ere ʒâŋeo findaŋdâŋ jazapic.
Ehame Sealitiere ŋokâ Serubabe â Jozadacte ŋokâ Jesua jahe fuŋkerâ Anuture ufuŋ Jerusalem haeo ŋewec i heɋârerâ bapic. Ehame porofete gâcne jaŋe bafic‐jofarâ bambiŋ.
Eme dameŋ ijaha Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ fowec irec soŋaŋ Tatenai â Seta‐Boʒinai erâ âgofâc‐jekic jaŋe fisirâ kecʒiŋuc muhuc jazambiŋ: “Mozi ufuŋ ʒi baku bataraniŋte mana‐ŋarewec?”
Erâ wâc ʒiŋuc wio‐jarembiŋ: “Ufuŋ ʒi baŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋere ʒâŋe mo?”
Mâc Anutuzi ine Juda micne hone soŋaŋ ejarewecte mi bâniniŋ‐jopahuc irec biŋedâŋ moc Dariusirao rame bâfuarâ irec okacne papiao bârisie‐jareocte manasumbiŋ.
Eme Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ fowec irec soŋaŋ Tatenai â Seta‐Boʒinai erâ mâreŋ soŋaŋ âgofâc‐jekic Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao jumbiŋ jaŋe papia râepie ŋicwofuŋ Dariusirao rawec.
Jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ dâŋ binaŋ ecnehuc ʒiŋuc qâreŋkembiŋ: “Ŋicwofuŋ Dariusi, wama gorao fozejec.
Ŋicwofuŋ go ʒiŋuc manac: Nâŋe Juda mâreŋko Anutu fekicne sâko ere ufuŋ ŋekac ira rambeŋ. Ufuŋ i qânâ kâcɋene sâkozi bambiŋ â haesac i katapazi basanaŋkembiŋ. Erâ gie i aijakic jaha bapie fua‐hâmokac.
Eme nâŋe soŋaŋ micne ʒiŋuc muhuc wio‐jarembeŋ: ‘Mozi ufuŋ ʒi baku bataraniŋte mana‐ŋarewec?’
Erâ ŋic micne bajarepie gie i baŋgopieŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe qâreŋkerâ râepene fâme honecmurâ ʒâŋe‐jeŋicte wâc wio‐jarembeŋ.
Eme jaŋe okacne ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐nârembiŋ: ‘Nâŋe sambâŋ â mâreŋte Anutu ere kiŋaŋ qaqafâc. Nâŋe Israe ŋicwofuŋ fekicnezi mârâc jaha ufuŋ baku batarawec i mocwâc heɋâreŋgopeneŋ.
Apa ŋosafâc‐nâŋec jaŋe sambâŋte Anutu aaric bâfuacnepie Kaldea ŋic Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukanezare meo râec‐jopame eki ufuŋ ʒi bâsirowehuc ŋic ŋokac rocjoparâ Babe mâreŋko bacjopa rawec.
Ehame juku Babe ŋicwofuŋ Kiruzi fuŋkerâ ŋicwofuŋ ewec jara ira ŋicwofuŋ eki ufuŋ ʒi heɋârerâ banaŋte mana‐nârewec.
Ehuc Anuture ufuŋte kuʒi râqâc wiac gol â siliwazi bakicne i Nebukanezazi Jerusalem haeo taha ufuŋ ŋewec irecnec ro bararâ Babe taha ufuŋko râewec. Eme wiac i ŋicwofuŋ Kiruzi Babe taha ufuŋkonec bawaharâ e jahac ŋic moc ʒâŋene Sesibaza mâreŋ soŋaŋ âkendâŋnewec ere meo râewec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go kuʒi râqâc wiac ʒi rorâ bara Jerusalem haeo taha ufuŋ ŋekac ira râezemec. Erâ Anuture ufuŋ i mutec ŋeŋetac‐ticnaoa banʒepieŋ.”
Eme Sesibaza e warerâ Jerusalem haeo Anuture ufuŋ ŋekac irec hobeteŋ râewec. Eme dameŋ irecnecteaŋ bawefuhuc jaha juŋgopeneŋ, erâ mi tarakac.’
Irec ŋicwofuŋ go manatec sâckeme Babe mâreŋko ira ŋicwofuŋte papia raŋɋane qâzuckekicne fokac ira wose gufuc ezemec. Ehuc ŋicwofuŋ Kiruzi Jerusalem haeo Anuture ufuŋ mocwâc heɋârerâ baniŋte moc mana‐jarewec me mâcne i honezemec. Ehuc ŋicwofuŋ go dâŋ weniŋuc manasukic i râe‐nâretec honenʒepeneŋ.”
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Dariusizi mutâcne‐jareme Babe mâreŋko wiac raŋɋane râe guruc ekicne fic ira babassa gie fuŋkembiŋ.
Eme juku hae qizec Ekebatana Mede mâreŋko ŋewec ira papia foforiŋkekicnao dâŋ ʒiŋuc qâreŋ‐kekicne i bâfuambiŋ: “Dâŋ binaŋ moc.
Ŋicwofuŋ Kiruzi fuŋkerâ ŋicwofuŋ ewec jara ira dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc mutarawec: Anuture ufuŋ Jerusalem haeo ŋeha taha â qowi bâzi rike jumbieŋ ufuŋ i mocwâc heɋârerâ bazo. Erâ hobeteŋne i sanaŋnea râezo, erâ hâŋne â otecne i 60 kubi sasawa efârezejec.
Erâ qânâ i faio fefe râepie arec jahec â moc ezejec, â katapa ine arec mocjaha sawa râezo. Eme irec furi i ŋicwofuŋ kânoŋkonec rozo.
Erâ wâc Nebukanezazi Anuture taha ufuŋ Jerusalem haeo ŋewec irecnec kuʒi râqâc wiac gol â siliwazi bakicne i rorâ Babe mâreŋko bawarewec i mocwâc Jerusalem haeo bârisierâ Anuture taha ufuŋko ŋeŋe‐jeŋic sâc râezo.”
Papia i bâfuarâ wosepie Dariusizi dâŋ okacne kecʒiŋuc râe‐jareme rawec: “Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ fokac irec soŋaŋ Tatenai â Seta‐Boʒinai erâ mâreŋ irec soŋaŋ âgofâc‐ŋeŋic sasawa ŋoŋe mâc behec‐jopaniŋ.
Behec‐jopapie Anuture ufuŋ irec gie i ʒuhuckerâ baniŋ. Ehame Judaŋic jaŋere mâreŋ soŋaŋ â Juda soŋaŋ micne jaŋe Anuture ufuŋ i mocwâc ŋeŋetac‐ticnao heɋârerâ banʒepieŋ.
Erâ manaŋgopieŋ, no Juda soŋaŋ micne Anuture ufuŋ heɋârerâ bahapie ŋoŋe kecʒiŋuc ejareniŋte mutâcne‐ŋarekopac: Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ fokac irec sahac taha moneŋ ŋicwofuŋte kânoŋko huekac i ŋic keci jaŋe biac jâmbâŋ jarenʒepieŋ.
Erâ sambâŋ Anutu qowi bâzi rikecneniŋte bulimakao ŋicne me lama ŋicne â motecne, me padi me hâwec me waiŋ me wokemaŋ wiac Jerusalem haeo taha bapa jaŋe mupie sâc ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne ʒuʒuhuc jaha jarehuc junʒepien.
Iŋuc epie jaŋe Anutu taha bâzi âsu biaŋ rikecnehuc ŋicwofuŋ â ŋokâfâc‐ticne jaŋere erâ numunʒepieŋ.
Erâ wâc ʒiŋuc mutâcnekopac: Moc e mumutâc ʒi herisierâ moc muocmu e ine ficticnere wâtuŋ neŋgocne i qâunuckerâ âkendâŋnehuc ira bituanʒepieŋ â ficticne ine sesucne fuarâ fozejec.
Anutu e jahac ʒâŋe‐ticne ira foocte giene bawec, irec ŋicwofuŋ me ŋic izi me izi mumutâc ʒi hetikieocmu me Jerusalem haeo Anuture ufuŋ ŋekac i hetâtieocmuo ine Anutuzi e wâc iŋuc jaha bârârâŋnezejec. Dariusi noni mumutâc ʒi râekopac irec sâc jâmbâŋ aimuŋ efârezo.”
Eme Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ fowec irec soŋaŋ Tatenai â Seta‐Boʒinai erâ âgofâc‐jekic jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ Dariusizi dâŋ râehuc mutâcnewec irec sâc aimuŋ jaha ebac embiŋ.
Ehame Juda soŋaŋ jaŋe porofete Hagai â Ido ŋokâ‐ticne Ʒekaria jahe findaŋdâŋ mupic i bâjâpehuc ufuŋ baku batarambiŋ. Jaŋe Israere Anutu ere mumutâc erâ Perisia ŋicwofuŋ Kiru â Dariusi â Arataʒeʒe jaŋere mumutâc irec sâcko baku batarambiŋ hâcne.
Eme ufuŋ i Dariusizi ŋicwofuŋ jume jara 6 eha Adari mosa irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc ira bâzickembiŋ.
Eme Israe ŋic ŋokac â taha bapa â Lewiŋic erâ kâpâcwâru bacjopa rakicnaonec risiembiŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma Anuture ufuŋ ʒeri bubiaŋ faio mutirimbiŋ.
Eme Anuture ufuŋ mutirihuc taha bâzire wiac ʒiŋuc râembiŋ: sasawa ŋicguru ʒare‐jeŋicte sâc sâqocne tâtâmire taha noniŋ ŋicne 12.
Iŋuc erâ Mosere papia qizecko dâŋ qâreŋkekicne fokac irec sâcko Jerusalem haeo Anuture kiŋaŋ qaniŋte taha bapa guru‐jeŋic sâc â Lewiŋic guru‐jeŋic sâc râec‐jopambiŋ.
Eme fufuŋke mosare ʒoaŋ gie bapa 14 ira kâpâcwâruo bacjopa rakicnaonec risiembiŋ jaŋe aakic hombaŋ ŋembiŋ.
Taha bapa â Lewiŋic jaŋe ʒeŋgoma eemasaŋ gie bahuc ɋaɋacke‐fârembiŋ. Irec jaŋe kâpâcwâru bacjopa rakicnaonec risiembiŋ jaŋere biŋe mecne â taha bapa gorewacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere biŋe mecne erâ wâc jaŋe jaŋacne biŋe mâmâc aakic lama qa hezuc embiŋ.
Eme aakic lama i Israe ŋic kâpâcwâruonec risiembiŋ jaŋe mecne â mâreŋ rune ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere eebapa repicnaonec hockerâ Israere Wofuŋ Anutu fodapecneniŋte Israe ŋic jaŋerao ʒuhuckembiŋ jaŋe mecne mâmâc nâmbiŋ.
Ehuc poroŋ goreŋ tâmiric nânâ irec hombaŋ i ʒeri bubiaŋ faioa ŋehapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarawec. Wofuŋ e Asiria ŋicwofuŋte maŋ bâtikieme jaŋerao fome Anutu, Israere Anutu hâcne, ere ufuŋ bapa giere bafic‐jopawecte ʒeri bubiaŋ faio hombaŋ ŋembiŋ hâcne.
Eme irec faicnao Perisia ŋicwofuŋ Arataʒeʒe e ŋicwofuŋ gie‐ticne bahuc juhame jaha Aʒariare ŋosa Seraja ŋokâ‐ticne Eʒerazi risiewec. E apa ŋiric ŋurucfâc‐ticne ine ʒiŋuc: Hilikia,
Salum, Zadoko â Ahitubu,
Amaria, Aʒaria â Merajoti,
Ʒerakia, Uʒi â Buki,
Abisua, Pinehasi, Eleaʒa â taha bapa micne Aroŋ.
Eme Eʒera e hâcne Babe mâreŋkonec risiewec. E miti qaqazu erâ juhuc Israere Wofuŋ Anutuzi sâcmutâc dâŋ Mose râcnewec irec mamana saric juwec. E Wofuŋ Anutu‐ticnezi bafickewecte wiac sasaware ŋicwofuŋ numucneme manacnewec.
Ehame Arataʒeʒezi ŋicwofuŋ juhame jara 7 ewec dameŋ ira Israe ŋic tucne, erâ taha bapa â Lewiŋic â gae hehe ŋic â haesac motâc soŋaŋ â taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa tucne Jerusalem haeo risiembiŋ wâc.
Eme Eʒera e ŋicwofuŋzi gie‐ticne bahuc juhame jara 7 irec mosa wahame arec 5 ewec dameŋ ira Jerusalem haeo fisiwec.
E fufuŋke mosare ʒoaŋ gie bapa 1 ira Babe mâreŋkonec faharewecte rahuc juku mosa wahame arec 5 ewec irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 1 ira Jerusalem haeo fisiwec. E Anutu‐ticnere mesanaŋzi basanaŋkeme fisiwec hâcne.
Eʒera e Wofuŋte sâcmutâc irec mamana gie bahuc bâjâpeocte maŋticne domawec, ehuc Israe maŋnao dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc‐ticne i jaza qazuc eocte maŋkewec hâcne.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Arataʒeʒezi papia ʒiŋuc qâreŋkerâ taha bapa â miti qaqazu erâ Israe ŋic jaŋere Wofuŋte sâcmutâc â mumutâc irec mamana saric Eʒera e râcnewec:
“Ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ Arataʒeʒe noni taha bapa â sambâŋte Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋte qaqazu Eʒera gore bubiaŋ dâŋ ʒi râekopac.
No ʒiŋuc mutarakopac: Uucmaŋ‐naneo Israe ŋic jaŋeraonec ŋic i me i, me taha bapa me Lewiŋic jaŋe gohec Jerusalem haeo raniŋte maŋjeŋiczi afeckeme sâcne ranʒepieŋ.
Go ŋicwofuŋ â soŋaŋfâc‐nane 7 nâŋe Judaŋic â Jerusalem hae rune jaŋe Anutugere sâcmutâc dâŋ megao fokac irec sâcko juŋgopieŋ me weniŋuc irec fuŋne hone manac ecmurâ sorecguŋgopeneŋ.
Erâ ŋicwofuŋ â soŋaŋfâc‐nane nâŋe buafec jaha Israere Anutu Jerusalem haeo ŋeŋe juju eekac ere taha siliwa â gol râembeŋ i baracmurâ sorecguŋgopeneŋ wâc.
Erâ Babe mâreŋ sâko irec maŋnao siliwa â gol bâfuacmu i mecne, â ŋic ŋokac me taha bapa Jerusalem haeo Anuture ufuŋ ŋekac irec biŋe buafecko taha râembiŋ i mâmâc barazemec.
Eme go moneŋ izi aimuŋ jaha bulimakao ŋicne â lama ŋicne â motecne, erâ padi â waiŋzi taha i furine barâ Anutugere ufuŋ Jerusalem haeo ŋekac irec alata faio taha râezemec.
Erâ go â qomâfâcge ŋoŋe siliwa â gol nâfocne ŋeocmu i Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi guriŋ baŋareha iŋuc me iŋuc ezo eŋareocmu sâc enʒepieŋ.
Erâ kuʒi râqâc wiac Anutugere ufuŋte giere biŋe garekicne i Jerusalemte Anutu ere maio râezemec.
Erâ dameŋ ira me ira Anutugere ufuŋte wiac i me i moc basapie ine ŋicwofuŋte kânoŋkonec moneŋzi kitâcneme rorâ râezemec.
“Eme ŋicwofuŋ Arataʒeʒe no Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ fokac irec moneŋ soŋaŋ juŋgopieŋ sasawa jaŋe ʒiŋuc mujarekopac: Ŋoŋe taha bapa â sambâŋte Anutu sâcmutâc dâŋticnere qaqazu Eʒerazi wiac irec me irec muŋareme aimuŋ jaha ebac enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc siliwa ŋemâc‐ticne 100 â padi târu 100 â waiŋ ʒopo 100 â wokemaŋ ʒopo 100 jaha râcnenʒepieŋ, â hâwec ine ʒare tâmiric.
Sambâŋ Anutuzi wiac irec me irec mutâcne‐ŋareocmu irec sâc jaha ufuŋ‐ticnere ezo, juku kimbeŋ‐ticnezi ŋicwofuŋ no â ŋokâfâc‐nane nâŋere uucmaŋ imackezacte.
Erâ wâc ʒiŋuc ŋazaŋgopeneŋ: Taha bapa â Lewiŋic â gae hehe ŋic â motâc soŋaŋ â taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa, me Anuture ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa i me i jaŋe sahac taha fuŋne fuŋne râeniŋte ʒoɋac mi ejarenʒepieŋ.
“Eme Eʒera go ine Anutugere maŋɋârâŋ gare tahac ekicne fogarekac irec sâcko sâcmutâc mamana â mumutara ŋic âkendâŋ‐jopatec Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ fokac irec ŋic ŋokac juŋgopieŋ jaŋerao mumutara gie bahuc junʒepieŋ. Anutugere sâcmutâc dâŋ manaeŋgopieŋ ŋic iŋucne râec‐jopazemec, â ŋic gâcne sâcmutâc dâŋ mi manaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine qazu‐jarezemec.
Eme moc e Anutugere sâcmutâc dâŋ me ŋicwofuŋte sâcmutâc dâŋ mi reŋkeocmu e hâmocte biŋe ezejec. Me hâmocte biŋe mi eme guru‐ŋeŋickonec bârârienʒepieŋ, me mafa wiac‐ticne jâoc ronʒepieŋ, me kâpâcwâru ficko ŋeocte mutaracnenʒepieŋ.”
Apa ŋosafâc‐nâŋec jaŋere Wofuŋ Anutu e muac baafec ecnezo! Eki hâcne ŋicwofuŋte maŋ baafeckeme Wofuŋte ufuŋ Jerusalem haeo ŋekac i ericke bâpiaŋ enaŋte bafic‐nâpokac.
Erâ mume ŋicwofuŋ â soŋaŋ fekicnefâc‐ticne tâpirihec jaŋe nore manapie sâckewec. Eme Wofuŋ Anutu‐nanere mezi basanaŋnume hâbihec erâ Israe guru sâc irec micne jaŋe nohec mâmâc ranaŋte hetumaŋ‐jopapo.
Arataʒeʒe e ŋicwofuŋ juhame garikiŋ sâc irec micne â gaŋne gaŋne fua warembiŋ jaŋeraonec ŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋe nohec Babe mâreŋkonec risiembiŋ:
Pinehasire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec Geresom. Itamare ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec Danie. Dawidire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Hatusi,
e Sekaniare ɋâric. Eme Parosire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec Zekaria, eme ehec ŋic 150 wose qâreŋ ejarembiŋ.
Eme Pahati‐Moabire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Zerahiare ŋokâ Elie‐Hoenai, eme ere guruo ŋic 200‐zi jumbiŋ.
Eme Ʒature ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Jahaʒielere ŋokâ Sekania, eme ere guruo ŋic 300‐zi jumbiŋ.
Eme Adiŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Jonataŋte ŋokâ Ebede, eme ere guruo ŋic 50‐zi jumbiŋ.
Eme Elamte ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Ataliare ŋokâ Jesaja, eme ere guruo ŋic 70‐zi jumbiŋ.
Eme Sefatiore ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Mikaere ŋokâ Ʒebadia, eme ere guruo ŋic 80‐zi jumbiŋ.
Eme Joabere ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Jehiele ŋokâ‐ticne Obadia, eme ere guruo ŋic 218‐zi jumbiŋ.
Eme Banire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Josifiare ŋokâ Selomiti, eme ere guruo ŋic 160‐zi jumbiŋ.
Eme Bebaire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Bebaire ŋokâ Ʒekaria, eme ere guruo ŋic 28‐zi jumbiŋ.
Eme Aʒegadere ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Hakataŋte ŋokâ Johanaŋ, eme ŋic ehec jumbiŋ jaŋere ʒare ine 110.
Eme Adonikamte ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ʒâhec fisimbiŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe ine Elifele, Jeuele â Semaja, eme jaŋehec ine ŋic 60‐zi jumbiŋ.
Eme Bigiwaire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Utai â Ʒakuru, eme jahehec ŋic 70‐zi jumbiŋ.
No Ahawa mâreŋkopec opâ rakac ira hetumaŋ‐jopape teuŋ âterâ ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc jumbeŋ. Ehuc no ŋic ŋokac honec‐jopahuc Lewire ɋâricfâc basac‐jopapo.
Irec no ŋic micne â mamana saric ŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋe râec‐jopape rambiŋ: Elieʒe, Ariele, Semaja, Elenataŋ, Jaribi, Elenataŋ, Nataŋ, Ʒekaria â Mesulam erâ qaqazu Jojaribi â Elenataŋ jahe wâc mâmâc.
Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne Kasifia haere micne bapa ʒâŋene Ido erao sorec‐jopapo. Ehuc Ido â qomâfâcne taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa Kasifia haeo jumbiŋ jaŋe dâŋ kecʒiŋuc jazaniŋte mutâcne‐jarepo: “Ŋoŋe Anutu‐nâŋecte ufuŋko gie bapa ŋic sorec‐jopapie warenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Anutu‐nâŋeczi bafic‐nâpoha jaŋe mamana saric ŋic moc, ʒâŋene Serebia e â ŋokâfâcne â soctofafâcne ŋic 18 sorec‐jopapie fisi‐nârembiŋ. Serebia e Israere ŋokâ Lewi ere ŋokâ Malire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec moc.
Erâ wâc Hasabia â Merarire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec Jesaja e soctofafâc‐ticne â ŋokâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec ŋic 20‐zi fisimbiŋ.
Jaŋe Dawidi â micnefâc‐ticne jaŋe Lewiŋic hone bafic ejareniŋte taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqafâc 220 bâwosâec‐jopambiŋ jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ fisimbiŋ. Ŋic i jaŋe sasawa ʒâŋe‐jeŋic mukicne.
Eme nâŋe nâŋâcne â naru motecfâc‐nâŋec erâ wiac sasawa‐nâŋec nâŋe hata biaŋne fua‐nâreme ʒuhuckerâ ranaŋte Ahawa opâo Anutu‐nâŋecte maio rumehuc nânâ sowa junaŋte jazapo.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ e momori guru â becâsicko rara ŋic nâreme jaŋe rahapene hatao kisâfâc‐nâŋec jaŋere ŋezic‐nâponiŋte numucnezore mimiepo. No ʒiŋuc âzâcnepo irec: “Anutu‐nâŋec e wira basac ecneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mesanaŋ‐ticnezi basanaŋ‐jopaekac, â e râpeckeeŋgopieŋ ine behec‐jopame kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋzi ʒâseŋ‐jopaekac.”
Irec nâŋe nânâ sowa juhuc Anutu‐nâŋec hata biaŋnere numucnepene mana‐nârewec.
Eme no taha bapa micne 12 ʒiŋuc bâwosâec‐jopapo: Serebia, Hasabia â soctofafâc‐jekic 10.
Eme no ŋicwofuŋ â micne â fekicnefâc‐ticne erâ Israe ŋic mâmâc jumbiŋ jaŋe Anutu‐nâŋecte ufuŋ irec taha wiac siliwa â gol â kuʒi râqâc râembiŋ i ŋemâc bâbâfuare sâcko râepo.
Siliwa ŋemâc‐ticne 650 â kuʒi râqâc wiac siliwazi bakicne i moneŋ ŋemâc‐ticne 100 irec sâc, â gol ŋemâc‐ticne 100, wiac i sâcko râerâ mejeŋicko râepo.
Erâ oto 20 golzi bakicne i moneŋ 1 tauseŋzi furi bapanere sâc â kuʒi jajahec aeŋ bâbâroŋ ɋaɋacne â furi sâko gol iŋucne bakicne i wâc iŋuc jaha jarepo.
Ehuc kecʒiŋuc jazapo: “Ŋoŋe Wofuŋte biŋe qacŋopahuc mufiriec‐ŋopakicne â kuʒi râqâc wiac i bâtirikicne jaha, erâ siliwa â gol i apa ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere Wofuŋ Anutu e buafecko taha bacnekicne.
Irec ŋoŋe aimuŋ soŋaŋkehuc baraku Jerusalem haeo Wofuŋte ufuŋ maŋnao taha tapa fekicne â Lewiŋic erâ Israe guru garikiŋ sâc irec micnefâc jaŋere maio guruckenʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc jazape taha bapa â Lewiŋic jaŋe siliwa â gol erâ kuʒi râqâc wiac i barâ juku Jerusalem haeo Anutu‐nâŋecte ufuŋko bafisirâ râeniŋte rauckembiŋ.
Eme Jerusalem haeo ranaŋte fufuŋke mosare gie bapa 12 ira Ahawa opâonec faharembeŋ. Eme Anutu‐nâŋeczi bafic‐nâpohuc hatao kisâfâc‐nâŋec jaŋere meonec â somâmaŋkonec batarac‐nâpowec.
Eme Jerusalem haeo fisirâ ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc jumbeŋ.
Izi hae fureme ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â jahec ira Anutu‐nâŋecte ufuŋko siliwa, gol â kuʒi râqâc wiac i Uriare ŋokâ taha bapa Meremotire meo râembeŋ. Eme Pinehasire ŋokâ Eleaʒazi ehec juwec. Ehame Lewi guruonec ŋic ʒiŋuczi jahehec mâmâc jumbiŋ: Jesuare ŋokâ Joʒabada â Binuire ŋokâ Noadia.
Eme wiac sasawa wose‐fârerâ ŋemâc bâbâfuare sâcko ŋemâc‐ticne papiao qâreŋkembiŋ.
Eme dameŋ ira kâpâcwâru bacjopa rakicnaonec risiembiŋ ŋic ŋokac i jaŋe Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋere biŋe bulimakao ŋicne 12 â lama ŋicne 96 â lama motecne 77 erâ sâqocne tâtâmire taha noniŋ ŋicne 12, iŋuc Israere Wofuŋ Anutu e qowi bâzi rikecnembiŋ. Qowi i sasawa Wofuŋ bâzi rikecnembiŋ hâcne.
Ehuc ŋicwofuŋzi papia qâreŋkewec i mâreŋte guriŋ bapa ŋic â Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ fokac irec soŋaŋ jumbiŋ jaŋe jarembiŋ. Eme jaŋe ŋic ŋokac hone bafic ejarehuc Anuture ufuŋ dopeckembiŋ.
Eme wiac sasawa i efârepie tarame micne jaŋe fua‐narerâ ʒiŋuc nazambiŋ: “Israe ŋic ŋokac â taha bapa â Lewiŋic jaŋe mâreŋ rune ŋicne ŋicne kecʒiŋuc jaŋe dic bajarerâ pectâc mi jueŋgopieŋ: Kanaaŋ ŋic, Hitiŋic, Periʒi ŋic, Jebusi ŋic, Amoŋŋic, Moabi ŋic, Aigita ŋic â Amori ŋic.
Jaŋe mâreŋ rune jaŋere otâfâc i jaŋe jaŋacne â ŋokâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ŋonâŋfâc eniŋte rocjopaeŋgopieŋ. Iŋuc ehuc ŋicguru tirine jaŋe mâreŋ rune ŋicne ŋicne jaŋehec sisifuc efâreeŋgopieŋ. Ehame soŋaŋ micne â ŋic kâcɋene jaŋe bâbâsifuc irec micne baeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme no dâŋ i manarâ ŋaqi qoruc‐nane maŋne â sahacne bâsuckerâ qizec susuc â mecʒâwâ‐nane unuckerâ maŋnane gâckeme ŋepo.
Ehame kâpâcwâru bacjopa rakicnaonec risiembiŋ jaŋe Wofuŋtao mi siŋkembiŋte Israere Anutu dâŋticnere ɋarac ɋarac qambiŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma norao tumaŋne‐fârembiŋ. Eme no maŋnane gâckeme mâc ŋehuc juhape ŋafere taha bâzi ririke dameŋ maickewec.
Eme ŋafere taha bâzi ririke dameŋko nânâ sowa ŋehuc jupoonec faharerâ ŋaqi qoruc‐nane maŋne â sahacne suckekicne jaha rojuhuc dieŋzi herâ menane Wofuŋ Anutu‐nanerao sicnepo.
Ehuc kecʒiŋuc mupo: “O Anutu‐nane, no gorao ʒâŋe mai‐nane bâfeŋnepemurâ boc mimierâ weaŋkekopac. Kiŋ bahac‐nâŋeczi siric‐nâporâ fekac â kiŋnâŋeczi hefâku sambâŋko fisikac hâcne.
Apa ŋosafâc‐nâŋec jaŋere dameŋkonec juwarekupene dameŋ ʒi fisikac, dameŋ irec maŋnao kiŋsâkohec jumbeŋzi juŋgopeneŋ jaha. Erâ kiŋ bahac‐nâŋecte erâ nâŋe nâŋâcne â ŋicwofuŋ â taha bapafâc‐nâŋec nâŋe mâreŋne mâreŋne ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere meo ʒikare micko â kâpâcwâruo â mimi qaqa faio fefârembeŋ i dameŋ ʒiŋuczia fokac irec sâc.
Ʒi ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec go dameŋ bembeŋne mac sawa ŋic ʒanʒaŋne ʒi nâŋe junaŋte mana‐nâremeŋ, ehuc go gahac tiri hae mâreŋ ʒira sac sapa enâremeŋ. Go iŋuc ehuc ʒâŋe‐nâŋec batamaerâ niŋgiŋko juju‐nâŋec i piticne mac baafecke‐nâremeŋ.
Nâŋe niŋgiŋko hâcne juŋgopeneŋ. Erâ Anutu‐nâŋec go niŋgiŋko juhapene sifu mi râpec‐nâpomeŋ. Anutu‐nâŋec, go ufuŋge âkendâŋnenaŋte Perisia ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere maio bâbâfirie gie bahuc aki anonoc enâremeŋ. I jaŋe âgo enârehapie sesuctacne i mocwâc heɋârerâ bapene Judea maŋnao â Jerusalem haeo ŋezic‐nâpocmurâ iŋuc hâcne enâremeŋ.
“O Anutu‐nâŋec, nâŋe wiac fuawec irec faicnao wemo dâŋ moc ʒuhuckerâ mupene sâckeocmu? Nâŋe sâcmutâc dâŋge râpeckembeŋ hâcne.
Go sâcmutâc dâŋ i kiŋaŋŋicfâcge porofete jaŋere micko râehuc kecʒiŋuc mutâcne‐nâremeŋ: ‘Ŋoŋe mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋte raʒiŋgopieŋ i mâreŋ rune ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe bâbiekupie wâwânâŋhec ewec, mâreŋ qaŋeŋne ŋifeckonec raku ŋifecko qatarakac i eebapa‐jeŋic mamakâcnezi fusucmarâ fome wâwânâŋhec efârewec hâcne.
Irec ŋoŋe ŋokâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere biŋe otâfâc‐ŋeŋic mi jarenʒepieŋ, me ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere biŋe otâfâc‐jeŋic mi rocjopanʒepieŋ. Erâ ŋoŋe jaŋere wama me juju hâmo irec mi fotarienʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc erâ ŋic sanaŋne juhuc mâreŋ ʒirec wiac biaŋne i nâ bac ehuc juku ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jarepie jaŋere biŋe fohuc juzejec sanaŋ.’
Eme eebapa sâqocne â kiŋnâŋec ŋemâcne irec okacne fai‐nâŋecko fewec i sasawa hone‐fârerâ ʒiŋuc manaŋgopeneŋ: Anutu‐nâŋec, go sâqocne‐nâŋecte okacnere sâc i bawahahuc enâremeŋ, ehuc ʒanʒaŋne mac ʒi mana‐nâretec juŋgopeneŋ.
Irec nâŋe sâcmutâc dâŋge mocwâc huckerâ ŋicne ŋicne wiac mamakâcne ebac eeŋgopieŋ jaŋehec ŋokac nareŋ gareŋ epene sâckeocmu me? Iŋuc enaŋmuo ine go nâŋere aaricgume omatac bacnâpotec huŋgaŋne mac moczi moc wiserâ mi juocmu.
O Israere Wofuŋ Anutu, go tiŋne rune, nâŋe ʒanʒaŋnezi hâcne wisembeŋ juŋgopeneŋ ʒi. Manakic, nâŋe kiŋheczi maigao juŋgopeneŋ, irec nâŋeraonec moczi moc gore maio sâcne mi domaocmu.”
Eʒera e Anuture ufuŋte maŋfuŋko qarâ numuhuc kiŋ bahac mutaniŋkerâ kiowec. E iŋuc ehame Israe guruonec kikefuŋ sâko, ŋic ŋokac â naru motec jaŋe erao tumaŋne‐fârembiŋ, ehuc kio sâqorembiŋ.
Ehame Elamte ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec Jehiele ŋokâ‐ticne Sekaniazi Eʒera kecʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Nâŋe mâreŋ ʒirec ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋokacfâc rocjopahuc Anutu‐nâŋec bunao bambeŋ. Erâ sifu Israe e hata‐ticne biaŋne moc bâfuazo murâ sâcne bâfuaocmu.
Irec nâŋâc Anutu‐nâŋechec ʒâʒâfic moc ehuc bomboŋ‐nâŋec gore mumutâcte sâcko mecne â Anutu‐nâŋecte sâcmutâc dâŋte erâ ɋarac ɋarac qaŋgopieŋ jaŋere dâŋte sâcko mâmâc ŋokac ʒi naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec behec‐jopanʒepeneŋ, erâ i sâcmutâc dâŋte sâcko enʒepeneŋ.
Ajoc, faharec i gore gie, erâ nâŋe gohec maŋ mocjaha eŋgopeneŋ; irec sanaŋkerâ ezo.”
Iŋuc mume Eʒera e faharerâ taha bapa micne â Lewiŋic erâ Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋe dâŋ mukicne irec sâc mujomirerâ eniŋte ejarewec. Eme jaŋe mujomirembiŋ.
Eme Eʒera e Anuture ufuŋmaŋkonec waharâ Eliasibire ŋokâ Johanaŋte ficmaŋko ferâ nânâ opâ qikiŋnerâ mâc waha fowec. E kâpâcwâruonec risiembiŋ jaŋe Wofuŋtao mi siŋkembiŋ irec ki busâqoc ewec hâcne.
Eme kâpâcwâruonec risiembiŋ jaŋe Jerusalem haeo tumaŋne‐fâreniŋte dâŋ musawepie Juda mâreŋko â Jerusalem haeo sâcke‐fârerâ rawec.
Eme moc e ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc irec maŋnao mi fisime ine fekicne â soŋaŋ jaŋe mupie mafa â jufu mumuc‐ticne i jâoc rohuc e jahacne ine kâpâcwâruonec risiembiŋ kikefuŋ i jaŋeraonec tuŋkezo.
Eme irec Judaŋic â Benjamiŋ guru jaŋe ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc irec maŋnao Jerusalem haeo tumaŋnembiŋ. Tutumaŋ i mosa 9 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 20 ira embiŋ. Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Anuture ufuŋ maŋfuŋko hae ʒoŋa kâcɋene ira wiac irec erâ â hoe micsâko hewecte ɋarac ɋarac qahuc ŋembiŋ.
Eme taha bapa Eʒera e fahare domahuc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe sâcmutâc dâŋ huckerâ mâreŋ mockonec ŋokac rocjopahuc Israere kiŋ bâŋɋârâŋkembiŋ.
Eme irec apa ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere Wofuŋ Anutu erao kiŋ bahac‐ŋeŋic mutaniŋkerâ micticne reŋkenʒepieŋ. Erâ mâreŋ ʒirec ŋicne ŋicne â mâreŋ mockonec ŋonâŋfac‐ŋeŋic jaŋerao ʒuʒuhuc‐ŋeŋic fokac i hetâcnenʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume kikefuŋ jaŋe owa kâcɋene owackehuc kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Iŋuc hâcne; nâŋe goki mukomec iŋuc jâmbâŋ enʒepeneŋ.
Erâ ine ŋic ŋokac bocjaha juŋgopeneŋ â hoe micsâko hekac wâc, irec nâŋe sawao ʒira sâcne mi domanaŋmu. Erâ wâc gie ʒi ʒoaŋ gie bapa mocjaha me jajahec ira bapane mi ekac, nâŋe wiac i ehuc bahac bâfua‐jâmbâŋkembeŋ hâcne.
Irec fekicnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe kikefuŋ sâko jaŋere okacne domanʒepieŋ. Ehame hae‐nâŋec sâc ira mâreŋ mockonec ŋokac rocjopambiŋ ŋic i jaŋe soŋaŋ â mumutara ŋic jaŋehec dameŋ mukicnaoa fisi‐fârenʒepieŋ. Iŋuc epene juku wiac irec Anutu‐nâŋecte kimbeŋzi nâŋâcnao bâruŋkehuc fokac i râriezejec.”
Eme Asahele ŋokâ‐ticne Jonataŋ â Tikiware ŋokâ Jazeja jahe sawa dâŋ i âgo mi ecnepic; Mesulam â Lewiŋic jaŋeraonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Sabetai jahe ine dâŋ i dopeckepic.
Eme kâpâcwâruonec risiembiŋ jaŋe iŋuc hâcne embiŋ. Eme Eʒerazi garikiŋ sâc irec ŋic micne buc buc ʒâŋe‐jeŋic muhuc bâwosâec‐jopawec. Eme jaŋe mosa 10 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 1 ira dâŋ i mu honec eniŋte waha ŋembiŋ.
Eme juku fufuŋke mosare ʒoaŋ gie bapa 1 ira ŋic mâreŋ mockonec ŋokac rocjopambiŋ jaŋe wose biric ejarepie tarawec.
Eme taha bapa jaŋere ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec mâreŋ mockonec ŋokac rocjopambiŋ i ʒiŋuc bâfuac‐jopambiŋ: Maseja, Elieʒe, Jaribi â Jozadacte ŋokâ Jesuare ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Gedalia â qomâfâcne.
Jaŋe ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic behec‐jopaniŋte mupaŋkerâ kiŋ tatarare taha bâzi rikeniŋte buc buc sapaonec lama ŋicne bafisimbiŋ.
Eme Imerere ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine ŋic ʒiŋuc jaŋe mâreŋ mockonec ŋokac rocjopambiŋ: Hanani â Ʒebadia.
Harimte ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Maseja, Elia, Semaja, Jehiele â Uʒia.
Pasahurure ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Elioenai, Maseja, Isimae, Netanele, Joʒabada â Elasa.
Eme Lewiŋic jaŋeraonec ine Joʒabada, Simei, Kelaja (e Kelita hâcne), Petahia, Juda â Elieʒe.
Eme gae hehe ŋic jaŋeraonec ine Eliasibi, haesac motâc soŋaŋ jaŋeraonec ine Salum, Telem â Uri.
Erâ Israe ŋic jaŋerao ine Parosire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec Ramia, Iʒija, Malikia, Mijamiŋ, Eleaʒa, Hasabia â Benaja.
Elamte ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Matania, Ʒekaria, Jehiele, Abadi, Jeremoti â Elia. Ʒature ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Elioenai, Eliasibi, Matania, Jeremoti, Ʒabadi â Aʒiʒa.
<range>
Bebaire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Johanaŋ, Hanania, Ʒabai â Atelai.
Banire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Mesulam, Adaja, Jasubu, Seali â Jeremoti.
Pahati‐Moabire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Adana, Kelali, Benaja, Maseja, Matania, Bezalele, Binui â Manase.
Harimte ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Elieʒe, Isia, Malikia, Semaja, Simeoŋ,
Benjamiŋ, Maluku â Semaria.
Hasumte ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Matenai, Matata, Ʒabadi, Elifele, Jeremai, Manase â Simei.
Banire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Madai, Amaram, Ueli,
Benaja, Bedeja, Keluki,
Wania, Meremoti, Eliasibi,
Matania, Matenai â Josu.
Binuire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Simei,
Selemia, Nataŋ, Adaja,
Mahanadebai, Sasai, Sarai,
Aʒarele, Selemia, Semaria,
Salum, Amaria â Josefe.
Nebore ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Jeiele, Matitia, Ʒabadi, Ʒebina, Jadai, Joele â Benaja.
Ŋic i jaŋe sasawa hâcne mâreŋ mockonec ŋokac rocjopambiŋ, erâ naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec behec‐jopambiŋ.
Hakalia ŋokâ‐ticne Nehemia ere dâŋ. Arataʒeʒe e ŋicwofuŋ juhame jare 20 eme no Kisilewo mosao Susa hae sâkoo juhape wiac kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
Soctofafâc‐nane jaŋeraonec moc ʒâŋene Hanani e ŋic gâcne jaŋehec Juda mâreŋkonec fisimbiŋ. Fisipie no Judaŋic kâpâcwâruo mi fefe mâreŋ‐jeŋickoa jumbiŋ jaŋere â Jerusalem haere mu indiŋ ejarepo.
Eme jaŋe ʒiŋuc nazambiŋ: “Kâpâcwâruo mi rara Juda mâreŋkoa jumbiŋ jaŋerao wiac hâhâwicne fuame mimi faio juŋgopieŋ. Jerusalem haere sac i heropiekicne â motâc‐ticne sasawa i ʒoczi imacke‐fârewec.”
Eme no dâŋ i manarâ waha ŋehuc kiopo. Erâ ki busâqoc ehuc juhape ʒoaŋ gie bapa bocjaha tarawec. Erâ nânâ sowa juhuc sambâŋte Anuture maio numuhuc jupo.
Ehuc kecʒiŋuc mupo: “O sambâŋ Wofuŋ Anutu, go Anutu sâko â gereŋ gereŋne, maŋzi ʒâficgueŋgopieŋ jaŋehec ʒâʒâficge i soŋaŋkehuc aki anonoc ejareekic.
Go ʒâŋe firâ hazec râehuc nunumu‐nane ʒi manazemec. Kiŋaŋ qaqage noni kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge Israe ŋic nâŋe nâŋâcnere erâ maigao ŋafe ʒoaŋ sâc numuekopac. Ehuc Israe ŋic nâŋe sâqocne bâfuahuc bugao bambeŋ i mufuaekopac. Jâmbomac, no â mamac‐nanere garikiŋfâc nâŋe sâqocne bambeŋ hâcne.
Nâŋe wiac repic qapicne egarehuc sâcmutâc dâŋ â dâŋsanaŋ erâ mumutâc dâŋ kiŋaŋŋicge Mose mutâcnecnemeŋ i mi soŋaŋkembeŋ.
Go dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc kiŋaŋŋicge Mose mutâcnecnemeŋ i manasuzemec: ‘Ŋoŋe norao mi siŋkeniŋmuo ine noni ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐ŋopapemu.
Me norao mocwâc risierâ sâcmutâc dâŋnane soŋaŋkehuc mana rereŋ eniŋmuo ine behe qaisoc ejarekicnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mâreŋ wiwicko juipiehapie no sifu irecnec qânusuc‐joparâ ʒâŋe‐nane foocte hae mâreŋ bâwosâepo ira mocwâc bârisiec‐jopapemu.’
Jaŋe gore kiŋaŋ qaqa â ŋic ŋokacfâc. Go gahac tâpiri sâkogezi â mesanaŋgezi bâfiriec‐jopameŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go kiŋaŋ qaqage nore nunumure mecne â ʒâŋege araŋ bacnehuc mana ʒiziweeŋgopieŋ kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge i jaŋere nunumure mâmâc hazec râe‐hâmozemec. No ʒoaŋ ʒira gie bape fârinehec eocte mana‐narezemec. Ehuc ŋic kecʒirec ʒâŋe faio buurucge nowatuzemec.” No dameŋ ira ŋicwofuŋte waiŋ soŋaŋ jupo.
Arataʒeʒe e ŋicwofuŋ juhame jara 20 ewec dameŋ ira mosa Nisaŋte ʒoaŋ mocko waiŋ rorâ ŋicwofuŋ râcnepo. No juwicnao ʒâŋe mai‐ticnao busâqoc hawari mi jujupac.
Irec ŋicwofuŋzi wio‐narehuc muwec: “Go huc mi bacguha wemocte ʒâŋe maige busâqoc hawari ekac? No honecgupe maŋ kukumbuc faio jukomec tinac ekac.” E iŋuc wio‐nareme mâretec hâwicnuwec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnepo: “Ŋicwofuŋ go juraʒihuc juzemec sanaŋ! Apa ŋosafâc‐nane ducjopakicne hae mâreŋ i â haesac motâc ʒoczi rikekicnere sesucne fuarâ foha weniŋuc busâqoc tâmiric jupemu?”
No iŋuc mupe ŋicwofuŋzi wio‐narerâ muwec, “Go wemo wiacte numu‐narekomec?” Iŋuc wio‐nareme sambâŋte Anutu numucnepo.
Numucnerâ ŋicwofuŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnepo: “O ŋicwofuŋ, go manatec sâckeha â kiŋaŋ qaqage no honecnutec biaŋkekacko ine Juda mâreŋko apa ŋosafâc‐nane ducjopakicne hae ira sorecnutec rarâ hae i heɋârerâ bazepac.”
Eme ŋokac wofuŋ e gâjoŋne ŋifecnao ŋehame ŋicwofuŋzi wio‐narerâ muwec, “Go mo dameŋko razo mukomec â mo dameŋko risiecmu?” Ine hâcne, ŋicwofuŋ e sorecnuocte maname sâckewec; eme no dameŋ bacnepo.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnepo: “Ŋicwofuŋ, go manatec sâckekacko ine Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ fokac irec soŋaŋ juŋgopieŋ jaŋere papia qâreŋkerâ narezemec. Eme jaŋe mana‐narepie fotâcnerâ raku Juda mâreŋko fisizepac.
Erâ jâckâtegere soŋaŋ Asafa ere papia wâc qâreŋkezemec. Eme eki taha ufuŋte ficsanaŋ motâc‐ticnere â haesac erâ no nahac ŋeŋe juju epemu fic irec katapa wiac narezejec.” Eme Anutu‐nanere mesanaŋzi basanaŋnuwecte ŋicwofuŋ e numucnepo sâc mana‐narewec.
Eme no Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ fokac irec soŋaŋ jaŋerao fisirâ ŋicwofuŋte papia jarepo. Ŋicwofuŋ e becâsicko rara ŋic â momori jaŋere fekicnefâc jaŋehec sorecnuwec.
Eme Horoni ŋic Saŋbalati â Amoŋŋic kiŋaŋ qaqa Tobia jahe biŋe i manarâ manapire mi sâcke‐jâmbâŋkewec. Jahe ŋic moczi Israe ŋic juju bapa‐jeŋicte bafic‐jopaocte fisime honerâ mâretec takic‐jopawec hâcne.
Eme no Jerusalem haeo fisirâ juhape ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc tarawec.
Tarame ŋafeo faharepe ŋic afecne mac nohec mâmâc faharembiŋ. Ehame Jerusalem haere wiac epemurâ Anutuzi maŋnaneo dâŋ râewec i ŋic moc mi mufua‐jarepo. Erâ no qowi moc aricne, mâc fainao ŋehuc rapo i sawa doma‐narewec.
Eme no ŋafeoa Wâneŋ Motâc ira hurâ rapo. Raku Kâte Qâto Opâ Nombâŋ ira fisirâ fotâcnerâ Homotâcko fisipo. Ehuc Jerusalem haesac hetâtiekicne â motâc‐ticne ʒoczi imacke‐fârewec i hone manac efârepo.
Eme izi Opâ Ʒâŋe Motâcko fisirâ fotâcnerâ Ŋicwofuŋte Opâ Ʒâkâŋko fisipo. Eme ira qowi fainao ŋehuc rapo izi fotâcneocte hata basawec.
Iŋuc eme no ŋafeoa wâneŋko ferâ haesac honepo. Izi mocwâc risierâ Wâneŋ Motâcko fotâcnerâ haeo raʒipo.
Ehame ŋic fekicne jaŋe, no wena rapo â wemo wiac jaha epo i moc mi manambiŋ. No Judaŋic me taha bapa me soŋaŋ micne me ŋic fekicne me ŋic gâcne sâko hae heɋârerâ baniŋmu jaŋe irec dâŋ i juwicnao biac mi mufua‐jarepo.
Eme no ʒiŋuc jazapo: “Ŋoŋe juju repicnao juŋgopieŋ â Jerusalem hae sesucne fuawec fokac â motâc‐ticne sasawa ʒoczi ʒafârewec i hone‐fâreŋgopeneŋ. Ajoc, nâŋâc Jerusalem haesac banaŋ! Ehuc mimi busâqoc faio boc mi junʒepeneŋ.”
Erâ no Anutu‐nanere mesanaŋzi bâwâzâŋnuwec â ŋiwofuŋzi dâŋ nazaweo i mâmâc mufua‐jarepo. Jazape mumbiŋ, “Nâŋâc faharerâ banaŋ.” Iŋuc murâ gie biaŋ i baniŋte meo roroc embiŋ.
Ehame Horoni ŋic Saŋbalati â Amoŋŋic kiŋaŋ qaqa Tobia â Araba ŋic Gesem jaŋe biŋe manarâ mana wahac‐nâpohuc mu surec enârehuc mumbiŋ, “Ŋoŋe keci wemo wiac baŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe ŋicwofuŋ maŋrâŋgeŋ bâfuacneŋgopieŋ hâcne.”
Jaŋe iŋuc mupie dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarepo: “Sambâŋ Anutuzi bafic‐nâpome juhâc qâhâmonaŋmu irec kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne nâŋe faharerâ banaŋmu, ehuc ŋoŋere dâŋ i mi mananaŋmu â ʒâŋe biŋe‐ŋeŋic i Jerusalem haeo wâc mi foocmu.”
Eme taha bapa fekicne Eliasibi e taha bapa qomâfâc‐ticne jaŋehec fuŋkerâ Lama Motâc bambiŋ. Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc mutirirâ wâtuŋ â motâc‐ticne mâmâc râembiŋ. Erâ ʒuhuckerâ barakupie Hameare ʒae â Hananere ʒae ira fisiwec.
Ehame Jeriko ŋic jaŋe jahere tofanao iticnerâ bambiŋ. Eme jaŋere tofanao iticnerâ Imirire ŋokâ Ʒakuruzi bawec.
Ehame Hasenare ŋokâfâc jaŋe Hâwec Qowi Motâc bambiŋ. Erâ wâtuŋ‐ticne âkendâŋnehuc otecne â motâc erâ babasanaŋ wiac‐ticne râe‐fârembiŋ.
Eme jaŋere tofanao iticnerâ Uriare ŋokâ Hakozi ŋosa‐ticne Meremoti eki bâpiaŋkewec. Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ Berekiare ŋokâ Meseʒabe ŋosa‐ticne Mesulamzi bâpiaŋkewec. Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ Banare ŋokâ Zadokozi bâpiaŋkewec. Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ Tekoi ŋic jaŋe bâpiaŋkembiŋ. Ehame fekicnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ine bomboŋ‐jeŋicte gie qâtec‐joparâ mi bambiŋ.
<range>
Ehame Paseare ŋokâ Jojada â Besodejare ŋokâ Mesulam jahe Motâc Raŋɋane bâpiaŋkepic. Jahe wâtuŋ‐ticne âkendâŋnehuc otecne â motâc erâ babasanaŋ wiac‐ticne râe‐fârepic.
Eme jahere tofanao iticnerâ Gibeoŋ ŋic Melatia â Meronoti ŋic Jadoŋ jahe bâpiaŋkepic. Erâ Eufrata opâ ocniŋucnao mâreŋ fokac irec soŋaŋ ere rurumaŋko Gibeoŋ â Mizipa ŋic jumbiŋ jaŋe mâmâc bambiŋ.
Jaŋere tofanao iticnerâ Harihajare ŋokâ gol bapa Uʒielezi bâpiaŋkewec. Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ âsu biaŋ bapa ŋic jaŋeraonec moc ʒâŋene Hanania eki bâpiaŋkewec. Jaŋe Jerusalem hae iŋuc bâpiaŋkehapie raku Sac Qaratiekicne ira fisiwec.
Eme Hananiere tofanao iticnerâ Hurure ŋokâ Refajazi bâpiaŋkewec. E Jerusalem hae dâkâne irec mâreŋ i qizeckerâ juwec.
Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ Harumafare ŋokâ Jedaja e ficticne ŋifecnao sac fowec i bâpiaŋkewec. Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ Hasabinejare ŋokâ Hatusizi bâpiaŋkewec. Eme Harimte ŋokâ Malikia â Pahati‐Moabire ŋokâ Hasubu jahe hae dâkâne moc â Ʒafe Ʒae i bâpiaŋkepic.
<range>
Eme jahere tofanao iticnerâ Halohesire ŋokâ Salum otâfâcne jaŋe bafickehapie bâpiaŋkewec. Salum e Jerusalem hae dâkâne moc irec soŋaŋ juwec.
Eme Hanuŋ â Ʒanoa haere ŋecjucfâc jaŋe Wâneŋ Motâc i bâpiaŋkembiŋ. Bâpiaŋkerâ otecne â motâc erâ babasanaŋ wiac‐ticne râe‐fârerâ haesac i I tauseŋ kubi ʒuhuckerâ barakupie Homotâcko fisiwec.
Ehame Rekabare ŋokâ Malikia e Bete‐Hakerem hae mâreŋ qizeckehuc juweczi Homotâc i bâpiaŋkewec. Bâpiaŋkerâ otecne â motâc erâ babasanaŋ wiac‐ticne râe‐fârewec.
Eme Kolohoʒere ŋokâ Salum e Mizipa hae mâreŋ qizeckerâ juweczi Opâ Ʒâŋe Motâc bâpiaŋkewec. Bâpiaŋkehuc bupune herâ otecne â motâc erâ babasanaŋ wiac‐ticne râe‐fârewec. Ehuc ŋicwofuŋte ʒariŋ gieo Sela Opâ Nombâŋte sac i bahame raku Dawidire hae qizecko riri hukac ira fisiwec.
Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ Aʒibukere ŋokâ Nehemiazi bâpiaŋkeme raku Dawidire ʒâŋeruŋ gie ŋifecnao fisi fotâcnerâ opâ ʒâkâŋ jaba bakicne ira fisiwec; erâ irecnec fotâcnerâ ŋic qac momori jaŋere ficko fisiwec. Nehemia e Bete‐Zuru haere mâreŋ dâkâne soŋaŋkehuc juwec.
Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ Lewiŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋe bâpiaŋkembiŋ: Banire ŋokâ Rehum, â ere tofanao iticnerâ Hasabiazi mâreŋ‐ticnao bâpiaŋkewec. Hasabia e Keila mâreŋ dâkâne moc qizeckerâ juwec.
Eme jahere tofanao iticnerâ qomâfâc‐jekic ʒiŋuc jaŋe bâpiaŋkembiŋ: Henadadire ŋokâ Bawai, e Keila mâreŋ dâkâne moc i qizeckerâ juwec.
Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ Jesuare ŋokâ Eʒerezi, heâŋ moc ʒâŋene Râricne ira ʒikare wiac guruckekicne irec ŋifecnao sac fowec i bâpiaŋkewec. Eʒere e Mizipa hae qizeckerâ juwec.
Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ Ʒabaire ŋokâ Barukuzi sac tofane moc Râricne irecnec bâpiaŋkeha raku taha bapa fekicne Eliasibire ficmotâcko fisiwec.
Ehame Uriare ŋokâ Hakozi ŋosa‐ticne Meremoti e tofane moc Eliasibire ficmotâckonec bâpiaŋkehame raku Eliasibire fic tofanao fisiwec.
Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ Jordaŋ Wâneŋte taha bapa jaŋe bâpiaŋkembiŋ.
Ehame jaŋere tofanao iticnerâ Benjamiŋ guru â Hasubu ŋic jaŋe ficjeŋic ŋifecnao sac fowec i bâpiaŋkembiŋ. Eme jaŋere tofanao iticnerâ Masejare ŋokâ Anania ŋosa‐ticne Aʒaria eki jahacne fic heririŋko sac fowec i bâpiaŋkewec.
Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ Henadadire ŋokâ Binuizi tofane moc Aʒariare fickonec fuŋkerâ bâpiaŋkehame raku Râricne ira fisiwec.
Erâ raku tuturuŋnao fisiwec. Eme Uʒaire ŋokâ Palalizi momori soŋaŋ jaŋere hae ʒoŋa heririŋnao ŋicwofuŋte fic faicnao ʒae fowec â Râricne irec ŋifecnao sac i bâpiaŋkewec. Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ Parosire ŋokâ Pedaja
â taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa Ofele haeo jumbiŋ jaŋe Opâ Motâc â ʒae ferâ domawec irec ŋifecnao bâpiaŋkehapie raku masune mocko fisiwec.
Eme jaŋere tofanao iticnerâ Tekoi ŋic jaŋe tofane moc ʒae sâko ferâ domawec irec ŋifecnao bâpiaŋkehapie raku Ofele haere sacko fisiwec.
Ehame taha bapa jaŋe Becâsic Motâc faicnao buc buc ficjeŋic ŋifecnao sac bâpiaŋkembiŋ.
Eme jaŋere tofanao iticnerâ Imere ŋokâ‐ticne Zadoko e wâc iŋuc jaha ficticnere ŋifecnao bâpiaŋkewec. Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ Sekaniare ŋokâ Semajazi bâpiaŋkewec. Semaja e Ʒoaŋ Wewefunao Motâc irec soŋaŋ juwec.
Eme Semajare tofanao iticnerâ Selemiare ŋokâ Hanania â Zalafare ŋokâ namba 6 ʒâŋene Hanuŋ, jahe ŋondeŋne moc bâpiaŋkepic. Ehame jahere tofanao iticnerâ Berekiare ŋokâ Mesulamzi e jahacne ficmaŋ ŋifecnao bâpiaŋkewec.
Eme ere tofanao iticnerâ golzi eri wiac bapa ŋic jaŋeraonec moc, ʒâŋene Malikia, eki bâpiaŋkehame raku Bibiric Motâc ŋifecnao taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqafâc jaŋere fic â nareŋ gareŋ ŋic jaŋere fic ira fisi fotâcnerâ raku tuturuŋnere ficmaŋ faicne ira fisiwec.
Eme tuturuŋnere ficmaŋ faicne â Lama Motâc jahere ŋoŋondeŋko ira golzi eri wiac bapa ŋic â nareŋ gareŋ ŋic jaŋe bâpiaŋkembiŋ.
Ehame Saŋbalati e nâŋe haesac bahuc jumbeŋ irec biŋe manarâ mâretec aaricke sâqorewec. Aarickeme Judaŋic mu gâgâwi enârewec.
Ehuc qomâfâc‐ticne â Samaria momori jaŋere maio kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Judaŋic betaŋkekicne keci jaŋe wemo wiac eŋgopieŋ? Jaŋe wiac sasawa mocwâc heɋâreniŋmu me? Jaŋe taha bâzi rikeniŋmu me? Jaŋe ʒoaŋ gie bapa mocjaha irec maŋnao bafâreniŋmu me? Jaŋe qânâ ʒoczi ʒakicne i jawa guruonec rorâ bapie qânâ mocwâc eocmu?”
Eme Amoŋŋic Tobia e ere heririŋko domahuc muwec, “Iŋuc hâcne, jaŋe wiac baŋgopieŋ keci i kâte qâto moczi fainao feocmuo ine ŋenʒaŋneocmu.”
O Anutu‐nâŋec, go manac, nâŋe suŋgiŋ‐nâpokicne. Go musopec‐jeŋic i bâtikietec jaŋe jaŋacne faio fezejec, ehuc batac bawarec ejarerâ kâpâcwâru bacjopa rapie mâreŋ mocko juniŋte qikiŋ‐jopazemec.
Go kiŋjeŋic mi hefackezemec â sâqocne‐jeŋic mi bâtâmirezemec. Jaŋe hae sac bapa ŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe faio go maŋbâiŋ egareŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Nâŋe ine haesac ʒuhuckerâ bakupene kikic efârerâ hâŋne‐ticne i nâfockewec. Iŋuc fuame ŋic ŋokac jaŋe gie i ʒoɋachec bambiŋ.
Eme Saŋbalati â Tobia erâ Araba ŋic â Amoŋŋic â Asidode ŋic jaŋe, Jerusalem haesac i ʒoɋachec ququŋke tâmiric bahuc sawane forawec i biac bâzicke‐fârezo eŋgopieŋ, biŋe iŋuc manarâ aaric‐jopa sâqorewec.
Irec jaŋe fisira Jerusalem haeo ʒika qahuc hae rune maŋ bâsifuc ejareniŋte tumaŋne‐fârembiŋ.
Eme irec jaŋe fisinʒipiŋte Anutu‐nâŋec numucnehuc ŋafe â ʒoaŋ ŋeŋezicfâc‐nâŋec juniŋte soŋaŋ âkendâŋ‐jopambeŋ.
Erâ ine Juda mâreŋ rune jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Tagi roro jaŋere tâpiri i omaekac â jawa wiac ine ŋemâcnea fokac, irec nâŋâc gie i sâcne mi banaŋmu.”
Ehame kisâfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Jaŋe mi manahapie me mi honec‐nâpohapie nâŋâc ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko fisirâ jopahuc gie i bâniniŋkenʒepeneŋ.”
Eme Judaŋic râsi ŋondeŋko jurambiŋ jaŋe nâŋerao fisirâ arec 10 ʒiŋuc nâzâmbiŋ: “Hae mâreŋ juŋgopieŋ sâc irecnec râsi fisi‐nâreniŋmu.”
Eme no sac râpenao hae sahao mâreŋ uuruŋne forawec ira garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc ŋic ʒika â sându â tepe‐jeŋichec râec‐jopapo.
Erâ no fahare fifisacne fihuc soŋaŋ micne â ŋic fekicne erâ ŋic ŋokac sâko ʒiŋuc jazapo: “Ŋoŋe jaŋere mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec. Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ e kâcɋene â qeŋ bipinehec i manasunʒepieŋ, ehuc ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic â otâfâc‐ŋeŋic â ŋonâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic erâ fic hae‐ŋeŋicte ʒika qanʒepieŋ.”
Ehame kisâfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe, Judaŋic jaŋere dâŋ maŋkembeŋ i jaŋe biac manambiŋ, erâ dâŋ birickembeŋ i Anutuzi hetâtie‐nârewec iŋuc mana tararâ behembiŋ. Irec nâŋe buc buc gie‐nâŋecko mocwâc risiembeŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ ira fuŋkerâ jufehuc gieŋicfâc‐nane bâfâuc‐jopape dâkâne jaŋe sac bambiŋ â dâkâne jaŋe sându maro â tepe erâ maruku barâ domambiŋ. Ehuc micnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe Juda kikefuŋ sacgie bambiŋ jaŋere râpeo domambiŋ.
Ehame tagi bambiŋ jaŋe mejeŋic moczi gie bambiŋ â mejeŋic moczi ine ʒikare wiac bambiŋ.
Eme sac bambiŋ jaŋe buc buc ʒika‐jeŋic rorâ gâjoŋ‐jeŋicko hafepie domaha gie bambiŋ. Ehame ŋic qeŋ qawec e nore gâjoŋkoa juwec.
Eme no soŋaŋ micne â ŋic fekicne erâ ŋic ŋokac gâcne sâko ʒiŋuc jazapo: “Gie i kâcɋene â qaratiekicne, erâ nâŋâc sacgieo sawa ʒora sasawa domaŋgopeneŋ.
Irec ŋoŋe hae mâreŋ ira me ira juhuc qeŋfânâŋ manarâ nâŋerao ʒira fisi‐fârenʒepieŋ. Ehame nâŋâcne ʒika i Anutu‐nâŋeczi qaocmu.”
Nâŋe iŋuc erâ sacgie bambeŋ, ehuc ŋic dâkâne jaŋe furic râeme fuŋkerâ sându barâ jukuhapie hae ŋafeme bâpiŋ wefuwec.
Erâ no dameŋ ira ŋic ŋokac wâc ʒiŋuc jazapo: “Ŋic sasawa â kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ŋeŋic ŋoŋe Jerusalem haeoa ŋec foc enʒepieŋ, ehuc ŋafeo soŋaŋ‐nâŋec junʒepieŋ â ʒoaŋko gie banʒepieŋ.”
Irec no nahacne mecne â qomâfâc‐nane mecne â gieŋicfâc‐nane â ruc bapa ŋic bâjâpecnuhuc jumbiŋ mecne nâŋeraonec moczi moc ŋaqi qoruc‐ticne moc mi heunuckewec. Nâŋe buc buc ʒikare wiac i menâŋeckoa fowec.
Juda ŋic ŋokac omane jaŋe Judaŋic qomâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere manapie mi sâckeme dâŋsâko bâfuambiŋ.
Ehuc gâcne jaŋe ʒiŋuc hâcne mumbiŋ: “Nâŋe ŋokâ otâfâc‐nâŋec jaŋehec bocjaha eŋgopeneŋ, irec jacgoŋ qikiŋne‐nârepie nâhuc junʒepeneŋ.”
Ehame gâcne jaŋe wâc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Nâŋe rorocte erâ hesarac mâreŋ‐nâŋec â waiŋ gie‐nâŋec â ficnâŋec qikiŋnenaŋte muŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme gâcne jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Naŋe hesarac mâreŋ â waiŋ gie‐nâŋec izi moneŋ jaba kitâcneme ŋicwofuŋte sahac taha râembeŋ.
Nâŋere soc biuc i qomâfâc‐nâŋec jaŋere soc biuc irec sâc, â naru motecfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha jaŋere naru motecfâc jaŋere sâc jaha. Erâ ine sifu nâŋe otâ ŋokâfâc‐nâŋec kiŋaŋ qaqa erâ juniŋte fotarie‐jareŋgopeneŋ, erâ otâfâc‐nâŋec gâcne biac kiŋaŋ qaqa bacjopakicne. Ehame ŋic gâcne jaŋe hesarac mâreŋ â waiŋ gie‐nâŋec nâwoc rombiŋte iŋuc me iŋuc ezore tâpiri basaŋgopeneŋ.”
No dâŋ mumbiŋ i manarâ aaricnu sâqorewec.
Ehuc dâŋ irec manatâc qâtâc eku soŋaŋ micne â ŋic fekicne dâŋ mujarepo. Ehuc ʒiŋuc jazapo: “Ŋoŋe Judaŋic qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic tofa bafehuc bazu‐ŋareniŋte fotarie‐jareŋgopieŋ.” Iŋuc murâ jaŋere dâŋ munaŋte mupe tutumaŋ sâko fuawec.
Eme no ʒiŋuc jazapo: “Nâŋâc tâpiri‐nâŋecte sâc Judaŋic qomâfâc‐nâŋec ŋic gurune gurune jaŋerao râec‐jopakicne i mocwâc bârisiec‐jopambeŋ. Ehame ŋoŋe ʒi qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic moneŋte erâ qikiŋ‐jopapie nâŋe mocwâc furi bacjopapene risieniŋte muŋgopieŋ me?” No iŋuc jazape jaŋe dâŋ basarâ mâc niniŋkerâ ŋembiŋ.
Eme no ʒiŋuc jazapo: “Ŋoŋe wiac eŋgopieŋ i biaŋne aricne. Ŋoŋe Anutu araŋ bacnehuc, kisâfâc‐nâŋec ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe mu surec enârenʒipiŋte sacfozic sâcne mi foniŋmu me?
Erâ wâc no â qomâfâc‐nane â gieŋicfâc‐nane nâŋe moneŋ â jacgoŋ jaba jarepene tofa fuawec i sifu behe‐jarenaŋte mukopac.
Â ŋoŋe miŋecgac jaha hesarac mâreŋ â waiŋ gie â oliwa gie â ficjeŋic erâ moneŋ sasawa â jacgoŋ â waiŋ â wokemaŋ jowac rombiŋ i mocwâc bâtikie‐jarenʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc jazape jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Nâŋe wiac i bârisie‐jarehuc jaŋeraonec wiac mocte moc mi munaŋmu. Go mukomec irec sâcko enaŋmu hâcne.” Jaŋe iŋuc mupie no taha bapa hetumaŋ‐joparâ ejarepe mupaŋkembiŋ irec sâcko eniŋte mujomirembiŋ.
Erâ no ŋaqi‐nane ititiŋkehuc mupo, “Ŋic i me i moczi mumupaŋ ʒirec sâcko ebac mi eocmuo ine Anutuzi e wâc iŋuc jaha ficticnaonec â gie‐ticnaonec ititiŋkezejec. Iŋuc eme ŋic e mafa tâmiric erâ hapetac juzejec.” No iŋuc mupe kikefuŋ jaŋe “Jâmbomac” muhuc Wofuŋ muteŋ bâteŋ ecnembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic jaŋe mupaŋkembiŋ irec sâc hâcne embiŋ.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, Arataʒeʒezi ŋicwofuŋ juhame jara 20 ewec dameŋ ira Judaŋic jaŋere mâreŋ soŋaŋ âkendâŋnumbiŋ. Eme jara 12 jufehape e jahacne ŋicwofuŋ juju jara 32 ewec. Eme no nahacne â qomâfâc‐nane mecne nâŋe dameŋ ŋondeŋ irec maŋnao mâreŋ soŋaŋte nânâ biŋe mukicne i moc mi nâmbeŋ.
Mâreŋ soŋaŋ raŋɋane nore juwicnao jumbiŋ jaŋe ŋic ŋokac jaŋere faio tagi afecne mi hembiŋ. Ehuc ʒoaŋ sâc siliwa moneŋ 40 irec sâc nânâ â waiŋ jowac rombiŋ. Ehame kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic jaŋe wâc ŋic ŋokac ŋicbomboŋ ejarembiŋ. No ine Anutu araŋ bacnehuctecne iŋuc mi epo.
Erâ wâc no sacgie i paŋpaŋnea bahuc domapo, ehuc mâreŋ moc mi rauckepo. Ehame gieŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe giere ijaha tumaŋne‐fârembiŋ.
Eme Judaŋic â ŋic fekicne 150 jaŋe nore ficko nânâ nâjumbieŋ. Erâ ŋic gurune gurune rârec‐nâporâ jumbiŋ irecnec fisi‐nârembiŋ jaŋe ine mi wosec‐jopakicne.
Irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa sâc nânâ ʒiŋuc bâmocke‐narekicne: Bulimakao mocjaha â lama hone wosâc ekicne 6, erâ qâqâc wâc iŋuc jaha bâmocke‐narembiŋ. Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa 10 tarame sâc waiŋ ʒopo mâretec gurucke‐narembiŋ. Erâ no wiac sasawa i ŋic ŋokac jaŋe tagi bâmâmâcke‐jarekicnere mâreŋ soŋaŋte nânâ biŋe fuaocte mukicne irec sâc fua‐nareocte mi fotarie‐jarepo.
O Anutu‐nane, go ŋic ŋokac jaŋere wiac sasawa efârepo irec mana‐naretec biaŋkezejec.
Eme Saŋbalati â Tobia â Araba ŋic Gesem erâ râsifâc‐nâŋec gâcne jaŋe, noni sac bakupe sawane moc mi fowec irec biŋe manambiŋ. (No ine dameŋ ira motâc wiac mi ɋeticke‐fârepo.)
Eme Saŋbalati â Gesem jahe dâŋ râe‐narehuc kecʒiŋuc mupic: “Go Ono wâneŋko waretec hae mocko bâbâfuac enʒepeneŋ.” Erâ jahe sipiricnunicte maŋkehuc mupic.
Irec no jaherao kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopahuc kecʒiŋuc mupo: “No gie sâko moc bakopacte sâcne mi hufâpemu. No fahare ŋoherao hufâhape giezi wemocko mâc foocmu.”
Eme jahe arec jahec â jahec dâŋ ijaha râe‐narepire no dâŋ hawarine ijaha wâc bâtikie‐jactepo.
Ehame Saŋbalati e arec 5 dâŋ ijaha muhuc papia qâreŋkerâ kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne jarehuc norao sorec‐jopawec.
Papia irec maŋnao dâŋ ʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne fowec: “Ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe gore dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhapie Gesemzi wâc ijaha mukac: Go â Judaŋic ŋoŋe maŋrâŋgeŋ bâfuazo eŋgopieŋte sac bakomec hâcne. Erâ go ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic ecmurâ manasukic.
Erâ go gahacnere manasuhuc Jerusalem haeo dâŋ ʒiŋuc musaweniŋte porofete âkendâŋ‐jopameŋ: ‘Juda mâreŋko ŋicwofuŋ moc jukac.’ Eme dâŋ i hâcne ŋicwofuŋ âzâcneniŋmu. Irec go waretec dâŋ ʒi muc manac epene taraoc.”
Eme no ʒiŋuc muhuc dâŋ râecnepe rawec: “Go wiac mukomec iŋucne moc mi ekicne, i go gahacne maŋko fuac dâŋ.”
Jaŋe ʒiŋuc manasuhuc hâhâwic henâreniŋte dâŋ i mumbiŋ: “Gie i mi batarahuc bâniniŋkepie fozejec.” O Anutu, ʒi menane basanaŋkec.
Eme no Delajare ŋokâ Mehetabe ŋosa‐ticne Semaja e ficticne motâc herâ ŋehame raʒipo. Eme ʒiŋuc muwec: “Nâhâc Anuture taha ufuŋmaŋko tumaŋnerâ taha ufuŋte motâc i sasawa hefârezeperec. Ŋic guzo muŋgopieŋ jaŋe ŋafeo hâcne wareniŋmu.”
Mume ʒiŋuc mupo: “No mo ŋicte hâwicnume wisepemu, erâ no iŋucnezi taha ufuŋko ferâ sâcne jupemu me? Irec no mi fepemu.”
No ʒiŋuc hone mana tarac epo hâcne: Semaja e Anutuzi mi sorewec, e Tobia â Saŋbalati jahe furi râcnepicte no râsi enarehuc findaŋdâŋ muwec.
E iŋuc eme no hâhâwic bâfuarâ hata ira âtehuc hehesic bâfuapemurâ furi râcnekicne. Erâ no mu surec enarehuc ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane bâsâqoreniŋte iŋuc embiŋ.
O Anutu‐nane, go Tobia â Saŋbalati jahe wiac sasawa epic irec sâcko okacne jactezemec. Erâ wâc porofete ŋokac Noadia â porofete gâcne sâko hâhâwic henareniŋte mumbiŋ jaŋe wâc mâmâc.
Eme sac i ʒoaŋ gie bapa 52 baku Elule mosare ʒoaŋ gie bapa 25 ira batarambeŋ.
Eme kisâfâc‐nâŋec ŋic gurune gurune rârec‐nâporâ jumbiŋ jaŋe biŋe manarâ hâwic‐jopame hâbi‐jeŋic goroŋkewec. Jaŋe gie i Anutu‐nâŋecte babaficko baku batarambeŋ, iŋuc mana tarambiŋ hâcne.
Ehame dameŋ ira Judaŋic fekicne jaŋeraonec papiazi Tobiarao fisiwec â Tobiaraonec papiazi jaŋerao wâc fisiwec.
E Arare ŋokâ Sekaniore kimo juwecte Juda mâreŋko ŋic bocjaha jaŋe bafickeniŋte mupaŋkembiŋ hâcne. Eme ŋokâ‐ticne Johanaŋzi Berekiare ŋokâ Mesulamte otâ ŋonâŋ‐ticne rowec.
Erâ jaŋe nore maio eebapa‐ticne i mumbiaŋkembiŋ, ehuc dâŋnane i wâc âzâcnembiŋ. Ehame Tobiazi hâhâwic henareocte papia râehuc jaha domawec.
Haesac bakupene tara‐fâreme no motâc âkendâŋne‐fârepo, ehuc motâc soŋaŋ â gae hehe ŋic â Lewiŋic âkendâŋ‐joparâ
Jerusalem hae hone soŋaŋ enicte ɋanane Hanani â ficsanaŋte soŋaŋ Hanania râec‐jofapo. Hanania e ŋic bocjaha jaŋere sâc jâuruhuc Anuturao qohotarâ e araŋ bacnehuc juwec.
Eme no jahe ʒiŋuc jasapo: “Jerusalem haere motâc i fohame juku ʒoaŋ qasanaŋkeme jaha rozo, erâ momori jaŋe soŋaŋ domahapie jaha motâc herâ basanaŋkezo. Erâ Jerusalem haeonec ŋic jaŋeraonec soŋaŋ râec‐jopapie gâcne jaŋe haesac mujarekicne ira domahapie gâcne jaŋe ficjeŋic ŋifecnao domanʒepieŋ.”
Hae i qaratiekicne â kâcɋene, â irec maŋnao ŋic ŋokac jumbiŋ ine afecne mac, erâ fic gâcne ʒuhuckerâ mi bakicne.
No ŋic kâcɋene â fekicne erâ ŋic ŋokac hetumaŋ‐joparâ ŋic gaŋne gaŋne fua warembiŋ sâc wose qâreŋ ejarepemurâ Anutuzi mutâcne‐narewec. Eme no bâbâni warembiŋ jaŋe gaŋne gaŋne fua warembiŋ sâc irec papia qizec i bâfuapo. Ehuc ira dâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne fowec i honepo:
Mâreŋ ʒirec ŋic ŋokac Babe ŋicwofuŋzi kâpâcwâru bacjoparâ amec‐jopa rawec jaŋeraonec bocjaha jaŋe Jerusalem haeo â Juda mâreŋko hae‐jeŋic ŋerawec sâc risiembiŋ.
Jaŋe ŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋehec risiembiŋ hâcne: Serubabe, Jesua, Nehemia, Aʒaria, Ramia, Nahamani, Morodekai, Bilisaŋ, Misipereti, Bigiwai, Nehum â Bana. Â Israe ŋic risiembiŋ jaŋere ʒare ine ʒiŋuc:

Eme haesac motâc soŋaŋ kecʒiŋuc jaŋere ɋâricfâc: Salumte ɋâricfâc, â Atere ere ɋâricfâc, â Talimoŋte ɋâricfâc, â Akubure ɋâricfâc, â Hatitare ɋâricfâc, â Sobaire ɋâricfâc jaŋe sasawa qâqâhâc ʒare‐jeŋic 138.
Eme taha ufuŋko kiŋaŋ qaqa jumbiŋ ine kecʒiŋuc jaŋe: Zihare ɋâricfâc, â Hasufare ɋâricfâc â Tabaotire ɋâricfâc.
Erâ Kerosire ɋâricfâc, â Siare ɋâricfâc â Padoŋte ɋâricfâc.
Erâ Lebanare ɋâricfâc, â Hagabare ɋâricfâc â Salamaire ɋâricfâc.
Erâ Hanaŋte ɋâricfâc, â Gidelere ɋâricfâc â Gaharire ɋâricfâc.
Erâ Reajare ɋâricfâc, â Reziŋte ɋâricfâc â Nekodare ɋâricfâc.
Erâ Gaʒamte ɋâricfâc, â Uʒare ɋâricfâc â Paseare ɋâricfâc.
Erâ Besaire ɋâricfâc, â Meunimte ɋâricfâc â Nefuhesimte ɋâricfâc.
