Eme Salomore kiŋaŋ qaqafâc jaŋere ɋâricfâc ine kecʒiŋuc: Sotaire ɋâricfâc, â Soferetire ɋâricfâc â Peridare ɋâricfâc.
Erâ Jalare ɋâricfâc, â Darikoŋte ɋâricfâc â Gidelere ɋâricfâc.
Erâ Sefatiare ɋâricfâc, â Hatilire ɋâricfâc, â Pokere‐Zebaimte ɋâricfâc â Amoŋte ɋâricfâc.
Eme taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqafâc â Salomore kiŋaŋ qaqafâc jaŋere ɋâricfâc qâqâhâc ʒare‐jeŋic 392.
Eme guru kecʒi jaŋe apa ŋiric ŋurucfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe Israe guruonec me mâcne irec fuŋne mi manahuc sifu Telemeha â Teleharesa â Kerubu â Adoŋ erâ Imere haeonec fisimbiŋ:
Delajare ɋâricfâc, â Tobiare ɋâricfâc â Nekodare ɋâricfâc ine 642.
Erâ wâc taha bapa jaŋere ɋâricfâc ʒiŋuczi fisimbiŋ: Hobajare ɋâricfâc, â Hakozire ɋâricfâc â Bariʒilaire ɋâricfâc; Bariʒilai e ine Gileade ŋic Bariʒilaire otâfâc jaŋeraonec moc ŋonâŋ‐ticne rome kimo‐ticnere wase bambiŋ.
Eme guru i jaŋe hâcne gaŋne gaŋne fua wefumbiŋ biri ira ʒâŋe‐jeŋic basambiŋ. Eme irec erâ jaŋe wâwânâŋhec mujarehuc taha bapa birio mi ʒuhuc‐jopambiŋ.
Irec mâreŋ soŋaŋzi jazawec, “Ŋoŋe nânâ tirine i mi nânâ mâc juhapie juku taha bapa moc Urim â Tumim ɋâsâi irec fuŋne mamana fuazejec.”
Kikefuŋ qâqâhâc ʒare‐jeŋic i 42 tauseŋ 360.
Eme jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic ŋic â ŋokac 7 tauseŋ 337 jumbiŋ. Erâ gae hehe ŋic â ŋokac 245‐zi jumbiŋ.
Eme becâsicfâc‐jeŋic 736 â bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic ine 245. Â kamelefâc‐jeŋic 435 erâ doŋgifâc‐jeŋic 6 tauseŋ 720 iŋuc jujarembiŋ.
Eme garikiŋne garikiŋne jaŋere micnefâc gâcne jaŋe taha ufuŋte kânoŋko taha râembiŋ. Ehame mâreŋ soŋaŋzi gol ŋemâc‐ticne 1 tauseŋ â oto 50 erâ taha bapa jaŋere ŋaqi 530 kânoŋko râeme huwec.
Eme garikiŋne garikiŋne jaŋere micnefâc gâcne jaŋe giere kânoŋko gol ŋemâc‐ticne 20 tauseŋ â siliwa ŋemâc‐ticne 2 tauseŋ 200 iŋuc râepie huwec.
Ehame ŋic ŋokac tiwâne sâko jaŋe gol ŋemâc‐ticne 20 tauseŋ â siliwa ŋemâc‐ticne 2 tauseŋ erâ taha bapa jaŋere ŋaqi 67 iŋuc râembiŋ.
Eme taha bapa â Lewiŋic â motâc soŋaŋ â gae hehe ŋic â ŋic ŋokac gâcne â taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqafâc erâ Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋe hae‐jeŋic sâc risie‐fârembiŋ. Eme mosa namba 7 maickeme Israe ŋic jaŋe hae‐jeŋic sâc jurambiŋ hâcne.
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma Opâ Motâcte hae ʒoŋao tumaŋnehuc hâmbâŋ mocjaha embiŋ. Ehuc miti qaqazu Eʒera e Mosere sâcmutâc dâŋte papia qizec Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic jarewec i bawareocte âzâcnembiŋ.
Eme mosa 7 irec gie bapa fufuŋkenao ŋic â ŋokac erâ ŋic mamana tarahec jaŋe tumaŋ nehapie taha bapa Eʒera e sâcmutâc dâŋ i jaŋerao barawec.
Erâ Opâ Motâcko hae ʒoŋa maickehuc ŋic â ŋokac erâ ŋic mamana tarahec jaŋere ʒâŋe maio furictea fuŋkerâ wosehame juku guŋpitic ewec. Ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ine sâcmutâc dâŋte papia qizecko dâŋ fowec i mananiŋte hazec râe‐hâmombiŋ.
Eme miti qaqazu Eʒera e tutumaŋ irec biŋe jâczi kanʒeri bambiŋ ira ferâ domawec. Ehame gâjoŋne ŋifec fâreopec ine ŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋe domambiŋ: Matitia, Sema, Anaja, Uria, Hilikia â Maseja. Eme qana‐ticnaopec ine kecʒiŋuc jaŋe domambiŋ: Pedaja, Misae, Malikia, Hasum, Hasibadana, Ʒekaria â Mesulam.
Eme Eʒera e ŋic ŋokac jowaru ferâ domawecte papia qizec i ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋere ʒâŋe faio qaratiewec, qaratiehame ŋic ŋokac jaŋe faharerâ domambiŋ.
Eme Eʒera e Wofuŋ Anutu fekicne muac baafec ecnewec. Ehame ŋic ŋokac jaŋe mejeŋic bafaharehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnehuc mumbiŋ: “Jâmbomac, jâmbomac.” Iŋuc muhuc daperâ ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic mâreŋko hetutuckehuc Wofuŋ mu wâwâsic ecnembiŋ.
Eme Jesua, Bani, Serebia, Jamiŋ, Akubu, Sabetai, Hodia, Maseja, Kelita, Aʒaria, Joʒabada, Hanaŋ, Pelaja â Lewiŋic jaŋe ŋic ŋokac ijaha domahapie sâcmutâc dâŋ irec fuŋne jazambiŋ. Jaŋe Anuture sâcmutâcte papia qizec i ŋeŋnea wosembiŋ. Erâ dâŋ wosembiŋ sâc irec fuŋne ŋic ŋokac jaŋe mana taraniŋte mu rituc ejarembiŋ.
<range>
Eme mâreŋ soŋaŋ Nehemia â taha bapa â miti qaqazu Eʒera erâ Lewiŋic jaŋe ŋic ŋokac qazu‐jarehuc ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Ʒoaŋ ʒi Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte tiri ʒoaŋ, irec ŋoŋe ki busâqoc wiac mi enʒepieŋ.” Ŋic ŋokac jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋ i manarâ kiombiŋte iŋuc jazambiŋ hâcne.
Eme Eʒerazi jazarâ muwec, “Ŋoŋe hae‐ŋeŋic sâc râwiŋnerâ wokemaŋ â waiŋ aŋacnehec nâhuc tucne âgo gâcne nânâ wiac mi bâmockembiŋ jaŋe nâ gumec ejarenʒepieŋ. Ʒoaŋ ʒi Wofuŋ‐nâŋecte tiri ʒoaŋ hâcne. Erâ Wofuŋte ʒeri ee izi hâbi‐ŋeŋic ekacte ki busâqoc mi enʒepieŋ.”
Irec Lewiŋic jaŋe ŋic ŋokac bâniniŋ‐jopahuc kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ʒoaŋ ʒi tiri ʒoaŋ, irec ŋoŋe niniŋkerâ ki busâqoc mi eniŋ.”
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe dâŋ mutaniŋke‐jarekicne i mana tarambiŋte nânâ opâ nâhuc tucne âgo gâcne nâ gumec ejarehuc ʒeri bari eniŋte hae‐jeŋic sâc râwiŋnembiŋ.
Izi hae fureme ŋic ŋokac sasawa garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc jurambiŋ jaŋere micnefâc jaŋe taha bapa â Lewiŋic jaŋehec sâcmutâc dâŋ irec mamana gie baniŋte miti qaqazu Eʒerarao fisi tumaŋnembiŋ.
Ehuc Israe ŋic jaŋe mosa 7 wahame tiwâ bâzi ehuc rehac bozeo juniŋte Wofuŋzi Mose sâcmutâc ecnewec irec dâŋ i sâcmutâc papiao qâreŋkekicne fome bâfuambiŋ.
Erâ jaŋe hae‐jeŋic sâc â Jerusalem haeo dâŋ ʒiŋuc mutaniŋkehuc musaweniŋte mukicne: “Ŋoŋe dâŋ qâreŋkekicne irec sâcko boze baniŋte tiki mâreŋko rarâ haeonec â kâteonec oliwa tieŋne â ɋareŋ â woŋgaŋ erâ jâc rehacnehec gâcne bafisinʒepieŋ.”
Eme irec ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ra rorâ bafisihuc buc buc ficbupu‐jeŋic sâc â hae ʒoŋac‐jeŋic sâc â Anuture ufuŋte hae ʒoŋao â Opâ Motâcte hae ʒoŋao â Eferaim Motâcte hae ʒoŋao boze barambiŋ.
Eme kâpâcwâruonec risiembiŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma boze barâ ira ŋeŋe juju embiŋ. Israe ŋic jaŋe Nuŋte ŋokâ Josuare dameŋkonecteaŋ wiac iŋucne moc mi ewefuhuc jumbiŋ. Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc mâretec kiwac qawac embiŋ.
Ehame Eʒera e hombaŋ fuŋkehuc Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋte papia qizec i ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne wosehuc juhame juku hombaŋ tarawec. Jaŋe tiwâ bâzi hombaŋ i ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 ŋembiŋ. Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa 8 ira ine mumutâc dâŋte sâcko tutumaŋ sâko epie tarawec.
Eme mosa ijaha irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 24 ira ŋic ŋokac tumaŋnerâ jumbiŋ jaŋe nânâ sowa juhuc mateŋ barâ qizec‐jeŋic ʒafe ruambiŋ.
Erâ Israe ŋic jaŋe ŋic jabane hecke‐jarerâ buc domahuc jaŋe jaŋacne â apa ŋosafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sâqocne â kiŋ bahac i mufuambiŋ.
Erâ jaŋe dodoma‐jeŋickoa domahuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋicte sâcmutâc papia qizec i aue jahec â moc mocwâc ʒuhuckerâ wosembiŋ; â aue jahec â moc ira ine Wofuŋ Anutu dapecnehuc sâqocne‐jeŋic mufuambiŋ.
Eme Lewiŋic jaŋere ririo ŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋe domambiŋ: Jesua, Bani, Kadimiele, Sebania, Buni, Serebia, Bani â Kenani. Jaŋe owa ruruckehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋic wâsickembiŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc Lewiŋic Jesua, Kadimiele, Bani, Hasabeneja, Serebia, Hodia, Sebania â Petahia jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Ajoc, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic juju hati e kecʒiŋuc muhuc muac baafec ecneniŋ: Ʒâŋe rarage fekicne sâkozi jambuŋ â mumuteŋ sasawa jowaru‐fâreekac i muac baafec ecnezo.”
Eme Eʒerazi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Wofuŋ, go mocjahazi Wofuŋ jukomec, goki hâcne sambâŋne sambâŋne jaŋere sambâŋ i aŋelofâc‐ticne jaŋehec bâfuac‐jopameŋ. Erâ mâreŋ â fainao wiac forakac sasawa, erâ hâwec â maŋnao wiac forakac sasawa i mâmâc bâfua‐fâremeŋ, erâ wâc hone akic ejareekic. Ehame sambâŋko aŋelo jaŋe go dape‐gareeŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu goki hâcne Abram rowosâerâ Kaldea ŋic jaŋere hae Uru irecnec jowa warerâ Abraham ʒâŋe i râcnemeŋ.
Erâ maŋticne gorao siŋkerâ fowec i honerâ Kanaaŋ ŋic â Hitiŋic â Amori ŋic â Periʒi ŋic â Girigasi ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ ʒi ɋâricfâc‐ticne tahac‐jopacmurâ ehec ʒâʒâfic emeŋ. Erâ go tiŋne rune jukomecte mumupaŋ gere fârine bâfuameŋ.
“Erâ go apa ŋosafâc‐nâŋec jaŋe Aigita mâreŋko fific guguriŋ faio jumbiŋ i honemeŋ â Hâwec Bâbâroŋko wâsicgupie mana‐jaremeŋ.
Ehuc go Farao â kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne erâ mâreŋ‐ticnao ŋic ŋokac jumbiŋ jaŋerao wiac ʒâŋe furu â fuŋne qaqa mâsi bâfuameŋ. Jaŋe apa ŋosafâc‐nâŋec wiac repic qapicne ejarembiŋ i go hone manac emeŋ hâcne. Go iŋuc ehuc juhaŋtec ʒâŋe biŋege fuawec, erâ dameŋ ʒiŋuczia fokac jaha.
Erâ go hâwec bârâwiŋketec apa ŋosafâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mâreŋ kereŋnao fotâcnembiŋ. Go iŋuc ehuc jopa jâpec ejarembiŋ jaŋe ine qânâ moc tuŋkepene opâ ʒâkâŋ irec fâhâŋnao hurârâŋneekac irec sâc tuŋjopameŋ. Go ʒoaŋko karorac maŋko juhuc bânie‐jaremeŋ â ŋafeo hata honehuc raniŋte ʒocbâruŋ maŋko juhuc jowac‐jopameŋ.
<range>
Go sambâŋkonec Sinai tikio waharâ jaŋehec dâŋ muc manac emeŋ, ehuc mumutâc fâretiŋ â sâcmutâc fârine, erâ dâŋsanaŋ â sâcmutâc dâŋ i jare tahac emeŋ.
Erâ i kiŋaŋŋicge Mosere micko râehuc tiri sabatage irec fuŋne jaza mutâc ejarehuc sâcmutâc sanaŋ, dâŋsanaŋ erâ sâcmutâcge tahac‐jopameŋ.
Jaŋe nânâre hâmopie go sambâŋkonec nânâ jaremeŋ, â opâre hâmopie qânâ hârâckonec opâ bâfua‐jaremeŋ. Ehuc mâreŋ jarecmurâ mupaŋke‐jaremeŋ i rarâ ro rauc eniŋte jazameŋ.
“Eme apa ŋosafâc‐nâŋec jaŋe hehesic bâfuahuc maŋsanaŋ erâ sâcmutâc sanaŋge mi reŋkembiŋ.
Jaŋe qaqatara bâfuahuc ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko fuŋne qaqa mâsi bâfuameŋ irec nikec‐jopawec. Ehame maŋsanaŋ erâ Aigita mâreŋko kâpâcwâru gie‐jeŋicko mocwâc risieniŋte micne bapa moc âkendâŋnembiŋ. Erâ ine Anutu go kiŋ bebehege mai jaha fokac, go aki anonoc â buurucgehec, kimbeŋge i urucne â erâ‐eesanaŋge i ɋârâŋne irec mi râpec‐jopameŋ.
Jaŋe bulimakao motecnere hawari wâc ba akic ehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: ‘Anutu‐ŋeŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec batarac‐ŋoparâ bacŋopa wefuwec ʒi hâcne.’ Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc mu surec hâhâwicne embiŋ.
Go buurucge kâcɋenea foekacte mâreŋ burocnao mi râec‐jopameŋ. Karoraczi ʒoaŋko hata bânie‐jarehuc mi rârâŋnewec, me ŋafeo hata raniŋte ʒocbâruŋzi tamae‐jarehuc mi hâpowec.
Go Mâro biaŋgezi jaza qazuc eocte tahac‐jopameŋ, ehuc ʒuʒuhuc jaha mana gumec‐jopameŋ â opâre hâmopie opâ jaremeŋ wâc.
Go jara 40 mâreŋ burocnao hone kitaŋ ejaretec wiac moc mi basambiŋ. Erâ ŋaqi qoruc‐jeŋic sucke ʒaŋ mi ewec â kike‐jeŋic wâc mi siwiŋnewec.
Erâ go uucmaŋne uucmaŋne â ŋicne ŋicne mejeŋicko râec‐jopahuc mâreŋ‐jeŋic wâc tahac‐jopameŋ. Iŋuc ejaretec jaŋe Hesiboŋ haere ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋte mâreŋ â Basaŋ mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ Ogore mâreŋ i ro rauc embiŋ.
Go ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic i sambâŋko bâpiŋ iŋucne basawec‐jopameŋ, ehuc apa ŋosafâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋte jazahuc ʒira hâcne jowac‐jopa waremeŋ.
Eme irec ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ware mâreŋ ʒi ro rauc embiŋ. Ehame go ʒâŋe fai‐jeŋicko mâreŋ rune, Kanaaŋ ŋic hâcne, bawahac‐jopahuc mâreŋ ʒirec ŋicne ŋicne â ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mejeŋicko râec‐jopameŋ. Jaŋe iŋuc me iŋuc ejareniŋte iŋuc hâcne emeŋ.
Eme jaŋe hae sacsanaŋ‐jeŋichec â mâreŋ‐jeŋic guecnehec i mâmâc ro rauc efârembiŋ. Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc ficmaŋko mafa wiac biaŋne fusucmarâ fowec i mecne, â opâ nombâŋ â waiŋ gie â oliwa gie â jâchândâŋ nânânere jâcne bocjaha jâmbâŋ i mâmâc ro rauc embiŋ. Ehuc i nâ gapec erâ soka pupuŋ ehuc eehâmoge fekicne irec mana ʒiziwembiŋ.
“Erâ jaŋe sifu jaha qaqatara bâfuahuc maŋrâŋgeŋ egarerâ sâcmutâc dâŋge râpeckehuc porofetefâcge jaŋe gorao bârisiec‐jopaniŋte uŋ jazapie qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ. Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc wiac mamakâcne mâretec embiŋ.
Eme go irec kisâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere meo râec‐jopatec jaŋe ejarepie ʒâic serereŋ maŋnao jumbiŋ. Eme ʒâic serereŋ dameŋ‐jeŋicko go kio wâwâsic egarepie sambâŋgao juhuc mana‐jaremeŋ. Erâ buurucge ɋârâŋnea fokacte ŋeŋezicfâc‐jeŋic bâfuac‐jopatec jaŋe kisâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere meonec batarac‐jopambiŋ.
Eme wamao jufeku maigao hehesic mocwâc bâfuapie go râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere meo qikiŋ‐jopatec jaŋe rauc‐joparâ bawahac‐jopambiŋ. Ehame jaŋe mocwâc gorao risierâ kio wâwâsic egarepie go sambâŋko juhuc mana‐jaremeŋ, ehuc dameŋ bocjaha buurucgere sâcko batarac‐jopameŋ.
Ehuc sâcmutâc dâŋgao bârisiec‐jopacmurâ uŋ jazameŋ. Eme jaŋe sifu maŋsanaŋ erâ sâcmutâc sanaŋge mana rereŋ mi embiŋ â mumutâc dâŋge ŋiczi reŋkehuc bajuhapie juju bâfua‐jareekac i wâc qâsuambiŋ, erâ maŋ â hazec gâc juhuc dâŋ moc mi manambiŋ.
Erâ go jara bocjaha buuruc qajarehuc jumeŋ, ehuc Mâroge ecnetec eki porofetefâc‐jeŋic baafec‐jopame uŋ jazapie jaŋe sifu hazec mi râembiŋ. Eme go irec mâreŋne mâreŋne irec ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere meo râec‐jopameŋ.
Erâ ine go buuruc sâkohec irec mi bâsirowec‐jopa‐fâremeŋ. Go aki anonoc â buuruc Anutu hâcne.
“O Anutu‐nâŋec, go Anutu fekicne â tâpiri sâkohec â qeŋ bipinehec hâcne; go ʒâʒâfic â aki anonoc soŋaŋkeekic irec Asiria ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere dameŋkonecteaŋ nâŋe nâŋâcne â ŋicwofuŋfâc‐nâŋec â fekicnefâc‐nâŋec â taha bapafâc‐nâŋec â porofetefâc‐nâŋec â apa ŋosafâc‐nâŋec erâ ŋic ŋokac sasawa nâŋere faio ŋemâc fewec fokac i honetec wiac afecne mi ezejec.
Erâ go wiac fua‐nârehuc fokac i fâretiŋ jaha jauŋ faio enârehaŋtecne nâŋe ine epene sâqorewec.
Erâ ŋicwofuŋfâc‐nâŋec â fekicnefâc‐nâŋec â taha bapafâc‐nâŋec â apa ŋosafâc‐nâŋec jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋ i mi soŋaŋkembiŋ, erâ sâcmutâc sanaŋge â uŋdâŋge jaremeŋ irec wâc maŋhazec mi râembiŋ.
Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc uucmaŋ‐jeŋicko â eehâmo sâkoge tahac‐jopameŋ erâ mâreŋ guec sâkohec jaremeŋ ira juhuc kiŋaŋ mi qagarembiŋ, ehuc eebapa‐jeŋic sâqocne i wâc mi râpeckembiŋ.
Manakic, nâŋe dameŋ ʒi kiŋaŋ qaqa juŋgopeneŋ. Nâŋe apa ŋosafâc‐nâŋec jaŋe jâchândâŋ â wiac biaŋne gâcne nâ bac ehuc ʒeri faio juniŋte mâreŋ tahac‐jopameŋ ira hâcne kiŋaŋ qaqa juŋgopeneŋ.
Erâ mâreŋ ʒira moneŋ mafa fuaekac i sâqocne‐nâŋecte erâ ŋicwofuŋ rauc‐nâporâ juniŋte âkendâŋ‐jopameŋ jaŋerao raekac. Jaŋe bomboŋ enârehuc nâŋe nâŋâcne â bulimakaofâc‐nâŋec aŋac‐jeŋicte sâcko wiac kosa enâreŋgopieŋ, irec nâŋe ʒâic serereŋ faio juŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme wiac sasawa fua warewec irec erâ nâŋe ʒâʒâfic‐nâŋec fofo sanaŋ moc ehuc qâreŋkeŋgopeneŋ. Eme fekicnefâc‐nâŋec â Lewiŋicfâc‐nâŋec â taha bapafâc‐nâŋec jaŋe ma basanaŋkehuc ʒâŋe‐jeŋic râeŋgopieŋ.
Eme ŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋe ʒâŋe‐jeŋic râembiŋ: Hakaliare ŋokâ mâreŋ soŋaŋ Nehemia â Zedekia.
Seraja, Aʒaria â Jeremia.
Pasahuru, Amaria â Malikia.
Hatusi, Sebania â Maluku.
Harim, Meremoti â Obadia.
Danie, Ginetoŋ â Baruku.
Mesulam, Abia â Mijamiŋ.
Mazia, Biligai â Semaja. Ŋic i jaŋe taha bapa hâcne.
Eme Lewiŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe ine kecʒiŋuc: Aʒaniare ŋokâ Jesua â Henadadire ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec ine Binui â Kadimiele.
Erâ qomâfâc‐jeŋic Sebania, Hodia, Kelita, Pelaja â Hanaŋ.
Mika, Rehobo â Hasabia.
Ʒakuru, Serebia â Sebania.
Hodia, Bani â Beninu.
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋere micnefâc ine ʒiŋuc jaŋe: Parosi, Pahati‐Moabi, Elam, Ʒatu â Bani.
Buni, Aʒegade â Bebai.
Adonia, Bigiwai â Adiŋ.
Atere, Hisikia â Aʒuru.
Hodia, Hasum â Bezai.
Harifi, Anatoti â Nebai.
Magapiase, Mesulam â Heziri.
Meseʒabe, Zadoko â Jadua.
Pelatia, Hanaŋ â Anaja.
Hosea, Hanania â Hasubu.
Halohesi, Pilaha â Sobeke.
Rehum, Hasabena â Maseja.
Ahia, Hanaŋ â Anaŋ.
Maluku, Harim â Bana.
Ehame ŋic ŋokac tiwâne sâko â taha bapa â Lewiŋic â motâc soŋaŋ â gae hehe ŋic â taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqafâc, erâ Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋ bajuhuc mâreŋne mâreŋne irec ŋicne ŋicne bâec bajarembiŋ jaŋe â ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic â ŋokâ otâfâc‐jeŋic erâ ŋic mamana saric â mamana tarahec jaŋe sasawa.
qomâfâc‐jeŋic ŋic kâcɋene jaŋehec qâfâsâerâ Anuture kiŋaŋŋic Mosezi Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋ jarewec irec sâcko juniŋte mumupaŋ maŋnao raʒimbiŋ. Erâ i Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋecte sâcmutâc sanaŋ â mumutâc â dâŋsanaŋ hone manac ehuc ebac eniŋte iŋuc hâcne embiŋ.
Nâŋe mâreŋ ʒirec ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe otâfâc‐nâŋec mi jarenʒepeneŋ me jaŋere otâfâc ŋokâfâc‐nâŋec jaŋere biŋe wâc mi rocjopanʒepeneŋ.
Erâ mâreŋ ʒirec ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe jacgoŋ me wiac gâcne furi baniŋte sabata hombaŋko bafisiniŋmuo ine nâŋe sabata hombaŋko me gie bapa tirine mocko furine mi banʒepeneŋ. Erâ jara 7 ira he sarac mi enʒepeneŋ â tofa‐nâŋec wâc mâc behenʒepeneŋ.
Eme nâŋe Anuture ufuŋte giere moneŋ moc, ʒâŋene seke, irec dâkâne moc jara sâc râehuc junaŋte musanaŋkeŋgopeneŋ.
Eme moneŋ izi hâcne wiac kecʒiŋuc kitâcnezejec: Poroŋ furu mukicne â ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne nânâ bâzi â qowi bâzi ririkere wiac â sabata hombaŋte â mosa furunere tiwâ bâzire wiac, â tiwâ bâzi mupaŋkekicne irec wiac, â wiac tirine gâcne erâ Israe ŋic jaŋere sâqocne tâmireocte taha bâzi ririkere wiac, erâ Anutu‐nâŋecte ufuŋte giere wiac sasawa.
Erâ wâc taha bapa â Lewiŋic â ŋic ŋokac nâŋe garikiŋ‐nâŋec sâc jarane jarane dameŋ mukicnao sâcmutâc dâŋko qâreŋkekicne irec sâcko Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋecte alatare ʒoc bafisinaŋte ɋâsâi qaŋgopeneŋ.
Erâ nâŋe mâreŋ‐nâŋeckonec nânâ â jâc sasawa irec fâri i jarane jarane bâsuhuc Wofuŋte ufuŋko bafisinaŋte muŋgopeneŋ.
Erâ wâc sâcmutâc dâŋko qâreŋkekicne irec sâcko Anutu‐nâŋecte ufuŋko â taha bapa ira Anuture kiŋaŋ qahuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋerao ŋokâfâc‐nâŋec â bulimakaofâc‐nâŋec â lama noniŋfâc‐nâŋec mârâc fufua jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha râec‐jopanaŋte muŋgopeneŋ.
Ehuc padi bâsukicne sahacnehec â jâc sasawa irec fâri â waiŋ erâ wokemaŋ i taha bapa jaŋerao â Anuture ufuŋ maŋne maŋne ira bafisinaŋte muŋgopeneŋ wâc. Erâ Lewiŋic jaŋe hae boze‐nâŋec sâc irecnec teŋkonec wâŋ qânusuckeeŋgopieŋ, irec mâreŋ‐nâŋeckonec wiac teŋkonec wâŋ i jaŋerao bafisinaŋte muŋgopeneŋ.
Ehame Aroŋte ɋâric taha bapa eki ine Lewiŋic jaŋe teŋkonec wâŋ roniŋmu dameŋ ira qâtec‐jopazejec. Eme Lewiŋic jaŋe wiac teŋkonec wâŋ roeŋgopieŋ irecnec mocwâc teŋkonec wâŋ jaha rorâ Anutu‐nâŋecte ufuŋ maŋne maŋne rowaŋ forakac ira râenʒepieŋ.
Ehame Israe ŋic â Lewire ɋâricfâc jaŋe taha wiac‐jeŋic jacgoŋ â waiŋ â wokemaŋ i furuficte kuʒi râqâc wiac ŋekacko â taha bapa jaŋe kiŋaŋ qahuc jueŋgopieŋ â motâc soŋaŋ â gae hehe ŋic jaŋe jueŋgopieŋ fic maŋne maŋne ira bafisi râenʒepieŋ. Nâŋe Anutu‐nâŋecte ufuŋ i mi hone takirenaŋmu.
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋere micne bapafâc jaŋe Jerusalem haeo jumbiŋ. Irec ŋic ŋokac tiwâne sâko jaŋe ŋicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋeraonec teŋkonec wâŋ, teŋkonec wâŋ, iŋuczi iŋuc Jerusalem haeo ra juniŋte ɋâsâi qambiŋ, â 9 guru sasawa jaŋe ine hae‐jeŋicko jumbiŋ.
Eme Jerusalem haeo juniŋte afeckehuc fuambiŋ jaŋe ŋic ŋokac jaŋe jambuŋ‐jopambiŋ.
Mâreŋ irec ŋic fekicne kecʒiŋuc jaŋe Jerusalem haeo jumbiŋ: Juda hae sâc ira ine Israe ŋic â taha bapa â Lewiŋic â taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqafâc gâcne erâ Salomore kiŋaŋ qaqafâc jaŋere ɋâricfâc gâcne jaŋe buc buc hae mâreŋ‐jeŋic sâc jurambiŋ.
Ehame Jerusalem haeo ine Judare ɋâricfâc mecne â Benjamiŋte ɋâricfâc mecne mâmâc jumbiŋ. Judare ɋâricfâc jaŋe ine kecʒiŋuc: Uʒiare ŋokâ Ataja. E apa ŋosafâcne ʒiŋuc: Ʒekaria, Amaria, Sefatia â Mahalale. Erâ e Perezere ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec.
Erâ Barukure ŋokâ Maseja, e apa ŋosafâcne ʒiŋuc: Kolohoʒe, Haʒaja, Adaja, Jojaribi â Ʒekaria, e ine Silo ŋicte ɋâric.
Eme Perezere ɋâricfâc ŋic hâbi‐jeŋichec Jerusalem haeo jumbiŋ sasawa jaŋere ʒare 468.
Eme Benjamiŋte ɋâricfâc ine ʒiŋuc: Mesulamte ŋokâ Salu; e apa ŋosafâcne ʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Joede â Pedaja â Kolaja â Maseja â Itiele erâ Jesaja.
Eme ere râpeo Gabai â Salai; jaŋe 928‐zi jumbiŋ.
Eme Zikirire ŋokâ Joele eki jaŋe qaŋeŋ‐jopahuc juwec. Ehame Hasenuare ŋokâ Juda eki ine ere râpeo juhuc hae hone soŋaŋ ehuc juwec.
Eme taha bapa jaŋeraonec ine ʒiŋuc: Jojaribire ŋokâ Jedaja â Jakiŋ.
Erâ Hilikiare ŋokâ Seraja, e apa ŋosafâcne ine ʒiŋuc: Mesulam â Zadoko â Merajoti erâ Ahitubu. Erâ e Anuture ufuŋko hone soŋaŋ gie bahuc juwec.
Eme qomâfâc‐jeŋic ufuŋko gie bahuc jumbiŋ jaŋehec qâqâhâc ʒare‐jeŋic 822. Erâ Jerohamte ŋokâ Adaja, e apa ŋosafâcne ʒiŋuc: Peladia â Amazi â Zekaria â Pasahuru erâ Malikia.
Eme qomâfâc‐ticne garikiŋ sâc irec micne ʒare‐jeŋic 242. Erâ Aʒarele ŋokâ‐ticne Amasai, e apa ŋosafâcne ʒiŋuc: Ahazai â Mesilemoti â Imere.
Erâ qomâfâc‐jeŋic tai tâpiri sâko‐jeŋichec 128‐zi jumbiŋ. Eme jaŋere micne ine Hagedolomte ŋokâ Ʒabidiezi juwec.
Eme Lewiŋic jaŋeraonec ine ʒiŋuc: Hasubure ŋokâ Semaja, e apa ŋosafâcne ʒiŋuc: Aʒarikam â Hasabia â Buni.
Eme Lewiŋic jaŋeraonec fekicne Sabetai â Joʒabada jahe Anuture ufuŋ sahacnao gie qizeckepic.
Eme Mikare ŋokâ Mataniazi nunumuo daŋge mumu irec micne bapa juwec. E apa ŋosa jahecne ine Ʒabadi â Asafa. Ehame qomâfâcne jaŋeraonec Bakabukiazi ere râpeo juwec. Erâ Samuare ŋokâ Abeda e wâc mâmâc, e apa ŋosa jahecne ine Galali â Jedutuŋ.
Eme Lewiŋic sasawa tiri haeo jumbiŋ ʒare‐jeŋic 284.
Eme motâc soŋaŋ Akubu â Talimoŋ jahe qomâfâc‐jekic jaŋehec ʒare‐jeŋic 172, iŋuczi motâc soŋaŋkehuc jumbiŋ.
Ehame Israe ŋic tiwâne sâko â taha bapa erâ Lewiŋic gâcne jaŋe Juda hae ŋerawec ira hae mâreŋ ro rauc embiŋ sâc jurambiŋ.
Â taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa jaŋe ine Ofele haeo jumbiŋ. Ehame Ziha â Gisipa jahe taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa jaŋe qizec‐joparâ jupic.
Eme Banire ŋokâ Uʒizi Lewiŋic Jerusalem haeo jumbiŋ jaŋe hone soŋaŋ ejarehuc Anuture ufuŋte gie qizeckehuc juwec. Eme Uʒire apa ŋosafâcne ine ʒiŋuc: Hasabia, Matania â Mika. Uʒi e Asafare ɋâric, Anuture ufuŋko gae hehe ŋic jumbiŋ jaŋere ɋâric hâcne.
Gae hehe ŋic jaŋe ʒoaŋ gie bapa sâc gie weniŋuc baniŋmu irec sâcmutâc i ŋicwofuŋzi ejarewec.
Ehame Judare ŋokâ Ʒerare ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec moc ʒâŋene Petahia, Meseʒabere ŋokâ hâcne, e ŋicwofuŋte micte ŋic ŋokac jaŋerao wiac sasawa fuawec irec mumutâc ŋic juwec.
Eme Judaŋic tucne jaŋe hesarac mâreŋko hae ʒiŋuc ŋerawec ira jumbiŋ: Kiriati‐Araba, Diboŋ â Jekabazele, erâ hae bozefâc‐jeŋic.
Erâ Jesua, Molada Bete‐Pelete.
Erâ Haza‐Sua â Bere‐Seba â hae bozefâcne.
Erâ Zikilaga â Mekona â hae bozefâcne.
Erâ Enerimoŋ, Zora â Jaramuti.
Erâ Ʒanoa â Adulam â hae bozefâc‐jekic, erâ Lakisi hae â hesarac mâreŋ‐ticne, erâ Aʒeka â hae bozefâcne. Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc Bere‐Seba haeonec mâreŋ fuŋkerâ raku Hinom wâneŋko fisiwec i ro rauc efârembiŋ.
Eme Benjamiŋ guruonec ŋic jaŋe hae ʒiŋuc ira ŋeŋe juju embiŋ: Geba â Mikimasi â Aja erâ Bete â hae bozefâcne.
Erâ Anatoti â Nobo â Anania.
Erâ Hazoro â Rama â Gitaim.
Erâ Hadidi â Zeboim â Nebalati.
Erâ Lode â metâ bapa ŋic jaŋere wâneŋ ʒâŋene Ono.
Ehame Juda mâreŋko Lewiŋic jaŋere mâreŋ rukec gâcne i Benjamiŋ guru jaŋere mâreŋhec iitic ewec.
Eme taha bapa â Lewiŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋe Sealitiere ŋokâ Serubabe â Jesua jahehec mâmâc warembiŋ: Seraja, Jeremia â Eʒera.
Amaria, Maluku â Hatusi.
Sekania, Rehum â Meremoti.
Ido, Ginetoi â Abia.
Mijamiŋ, Madia â Biliga.
Semaja, Jojaribi â Jedaja.
Salu, Amoko, Hilikia â Jedaja. Ŋic i jaŋe Jesuare dameŋko taha bapa â qomâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere micne jumbiŋ.
Eme Lewiŋic ine ʒiŋuc: Jesua, Binui, Kadimiele, Serebia, Juda â Matania. Matania e qomâfâcne jaŋehec daŋge mumuteŋ gae qizeckembiŋ.
Ehame qomâ jahec‐jeŋic Bakabukia â Uno jahe jaŋere ŋifecnao gieo domapic.
Eme Jesua e Jojakimte mamac â Jojakim e Eliasibire mamac â Eliasibi e Jojadare mamac.
Â Jojada e Jonataŋte mamac â Jonataŋ e ine Jaduare mamac.
Eme Jojakimte dameŋko ine taha bapa kecʒiŋuc jaŋe garikiŋ sâc irec micne jumbiŋ: Serajare guruo Meraja â Jeremiare guruo ine Hanania.
Eme Eʒerare guruo ine Mesulam â Amariare guruo ine Johanaŋ.
Eme Malukure guruo ine Jonataŋ â Sebaniare guruo ine Josefe.
Eme Harimte guruo ine Adana â Merajotire guruo ine Helekai.
Eme Idore guruo Ʒekaria â Ginetoŋte guruo ine Mesulam.
Eme Abiare guruo ine Ʒikiri, â Miniamiŋ â Moadia jahere guruo ine Pilitai.
Eme Biligare guruo Samua â Semajare guruo ine Jonataŋ.
Eme Jojaribire guruo ine Matenai â Jedajare guruo ine Uʒi.
Eme Salaire guruo ine Kalai â Amokore guruo ine Ebere.
Eme Hilikiare guruo ine Hasabia â Jedajare guruo ine Netanele.
Ehame Eliasibi, Jojada, Johanaŋ â Jadua jaŋere dameŋko Lewiŋic jaŋere garikiŋ sâc irec micne qâreŋ‐jopakicne. Erâ taha bapa jaŋere ʒâŋe qâreŋkehuc juhapie juku Perisia ŋic Dariusizi ŋicwofuŋ ewec.
Eme Lewire ɋâricfâc garikiŋ‐jeŋic sâc irec micne jaŋere ʒâŋe i Binaŋ Qâhâc papia qizecko qâreŋkekicne foha juku Eliasibire ŋokâ Johanaŋte dameŋ maickewec.
Eme Lewiŋic micnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe ine kecʒiŋuc: Hasabia, Serebia, Kadimiele ŋokâ‐ticne Jesua. Jaŋe qomâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ŋifecko domahapie jaŋehec Anuture ŋic Dawidizi sâcmutâc ejarewec irec sâcko nareŋ gareŋ â ââkehoc ehuc daŋge â ʒeri mumuteŋ ehuc jumbiŋ.
Ehame Matania, Bakabukia, Obadia, Mesulam, Talimoŋ â Akubu jaŋe motâc soŋaŋ juhuc motâcko rowaŋfic ŋerawec irec soŋaŋ doma jumbieŋ.
Ŋic i jaŋe Jesuare ŋokâ Jozadac ŋosa‐ticne Jojakimte dameŋko, erâ mâreŋ soŋaŋ Nehemia â taha bapa â miti qaqazu Eʒera jahere dameŋko jumbiŋ.
Jerusalem haesac mutiriniŋte dameŋ maickewec ira Lewiŋic hae‐jeŋic sâc jurambiŋkonec Jerusalem haeo jowac‐jopa fisipie gae hehuc bubiaŋ â daŋge mumuteŋ i woŋgâŋ â gita â kulelehec ehuc hombaŋ ŋeniŋte bâwosâec‐jopambiŋ.
Eme gae hehe ŋic jaŋere ɋâricfâc jaŋe Jerusalem hae rârec rârec â Netofati ŋic jaŋere hae ŋerawec irecnec fisirâ tumaŋnembiŋ.
Erâ wâc Bete‐Giligali haeonec â Geba â Aʒamaweta mâreŋkonec fisimbiŋ. Gae hehe ŋic jaŋe Jerusalem hae rârec rârec ira hae boze‐jeŋic barambiŋ hâcne.
Eme taha bapa â Lewiŋic jaŋe jaŋacnao eemasaŋ gie bambiŋ; erâ ŋic ŋokac jaŋerao wâc eemasaŋ gie bahuc haesac â motâc‐ticne i mâmâc emasaŋkembiŋ.
Eme no Judaŋic fekicne sac faio jowac‐jopa fepo, erâ daŋge gae hembiŋ jaŋe guru jajahec sâko âkendâŋ‐jopapo. Eme guru moc jaŋe sac faio Homotâcko fâreopec rambiŋ.
Eme jaŋere râpeo ine Hosaja â Judaŋic fekicne dâkâne jaŋe rambiŋ.
Erâ Aʒaria, Eʒera â Mesulam
erâ Juda, Benjamiŋ, Semaja â Jeremia jaŋe mâmâc rambiŋ.
Ehame taha bapa jaŋere ɋâricfâc tucne kecʒiŋuc jaŋe qeŋjeŋichec bâjâpec‐jopambiŋ: Jonataŋte ŋokâ Ʒekaria; ere apa ŋosafâc ine kecʒiŋuc: Semaja, Matania, Mikaja, Ʒakuru â Asafa.
Erâ Ʒekaria qomâfâc‐ticne Semaja, Aʒarele, Malalai, Gilalai, Mai, Netanele, Juda â Hanani jaŋe wâc qeŋjeŋichec bâjâpec‐jopambiŋ. Jaŋe Anuture ŋic Dawidizi gaere wiac bawec i barâ rambiŋ; ehame miti qaqazu Eʒerazi bânie‐jarewec.
Eme jaŋe Opâ Ʒâŋe Motâc ira fisirâ fofotâc jaha Dawidire hae qizecte ririo fehuc Dawidi ficticne faicnao fotâcnerâ ʒoaŋ wewefunao Opâ Motâcko fisimbiŋ.
Ehame daŋge gae hembiŋ guru moc jaŋe qanaopec rambiŋ. Eme no ŋic ŋokac dâkâne jaŋehec Ʒafe Ʒae faicnao sac faio Dadapic Sac ira rambeŋ.
Erâ Eferaim Motâc faicnao fotâcnerâ ra Motâc Raŋɋane â Hâwec Qowi Motâc erâ Hanane Ʒae â Hamea Ʒae i fotâcnerâ Lama Motâcko wâc fisimbeŋ, ehuc Momori Motâc ira fisirâ niniŋkembeŋ.
Eme daŋge gae hembiŋ guru i jaŋe mâmâc jaha Anuture ufuŋko domambiŋ. Erâ no â ŋic fekicne nohec jumbiŋ nâŋe wâc mâmâc domambeŋ.
Ehame taha bapa Eliakim, Maseja, Miniamiŋ, Mikaja, Elioenai, Ʒekaria â Hanania jaŋe qeŋjeŋichec domambiŋ.
Erâ Maseja, Semaja, Eleaʒa, Uʒi, Johanaŋ, Malikia, Elam â Eʒere jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha. Ehame gae hehe ŋic jaŋe Jezerahiazi micne bajareme gae hembiŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ ira Anutuzi ʒeri bari sâko eniŋte bufahac qajareme taha bâzi sâko rikehuc ʒeri bari embiŋ. Erâ ŋokac naru motec jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha ʒeri embiŋ. Eme Jerusalem haeo ʒeri fuawec irec fânâŋ i taicko jumbiŋzi manambiŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ ira ŋic gâcne rowaŋfic maŋne maŋne forawec irec soŋaŋ âkendâŋ‐jopambiŋ. Jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋte sâcko taha bapa â Lewiŋic jaŋere biŋe gie ɋâricnaonec nânâ â taha wiac gâcne teŋkonec wâŋ i haene haene ŋic jaŋe bafisipie soŋaŋkeniŋte râec‐jopambiŋ hâcne. Judaŋic jaŋe taha bapa â Lewiŋic hone maiŋ gie bambiŋ irec kiwac qawac embiŋ hâcne.
Ehame taha bapa â Lewiŋic, erâ gae hehe ŋic â motâc soŋaŋ jaŋe Dawidi â ŋokâ‐ticne Salomo jahe sâcmutâc râepic irec sâcko Anutu‐jeŋicte gie bahuc eemasaŋ gie i wâc mâmâc bambiŋ.
Mârâc jaha Dawidi â Asafa jahere dameŋko gae hehe ŋic jaŋere micne jumbiŋ jaha â Anutu daŋge mumuteŋ ecnezore gae wâc forawec.
Eme Serubabe â Nehemia jahere dameŋko Israe ŋic sasawa jaŋe gae hehe ŋic â motâc soŋaŋ jaŋere nânâ biŋe ʒoaŋ sâc jare jumbieŋ. Eme jaŋe bâtâc barâ Lewiŋic jare jumbieŋ; ehame Lewiŋic jaŋe bâtâc barâ Aroŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋere biŋe râe jumbieŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ ira jaŋe Mosere papia qizec i ŋic ŋokac wose‐jarembiŋ. Ehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne i bâfuambiŋ: Amoŋŋic me Moabi ŋic moczi Anuture kikefuŋko moc mi raʒi‐jâmbâŋkezejec.
Jaŋe Israe ŋic nânâ opâ mi bâmocke‐jarehuc Bileam furi râcnepie eki sâwec‐jopawec. Erâ sifu Anutu‐nâŋeczi sâwec i hetikieme jambuŋ ewec.
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe sâcmutâc i manarâ ŋic jaba jaŋeraonec fua sawec embiŋ jaŋe Israe guruonec bâtâc bacjopambiŋ.
Eme irec juwicnao ine taha bapa Eliasibi e Anuture ufuŋ maŋne maŋne i hone soŋaŋ eocte âkendâŋnekicne, erâ e Tobiahec ʒuʒuhuc‐ticne fowec.
Irec e mârâc nânâ bâzi â wiac âsu biaŋ furi sâko â kuʒi râqâc erâ jacgoŋ â waiŋ â wokemaŋ taha wiac i sâcmutâc sanaŋte sâcko Lewiŋic â gae hehe ŋic â motâc soŋaŋ jaŋere biŋe, erâ taha bapa jaŋere biŋe taha râekicne guruckepie ŋewec ficmaŋ kâcɋene i Tobia baʒawiecnewec.
No wiac i fuahuc fowec dameŋ ira Jerusalem haeo mi jupo. Babe ŋicwofuŋ Arataʒeʒe e ŋicwofuŋ gie‐ticne bahuc juha jara 32 ewec dameŋ ira erao risiepo. Erâ piticne juferâ ŋicwofuŋzi mana‐nareme mocwâc risiepemurâ numucnepo.
Eme Jerusalem haeo fisirâ ine Eliasibizi mâsi repicne kecʒiŋuc eme honepo: E Anuture ufuŋte hae ʒoŋao ficmaŋ moc Tobiare biŋe baʒawiewec.
Iŋuc honerâ aaricnu sâqoreme Tobiare ŋeŋe wiac i ficmaŋkonec rorâ sârockepe sahacnao hufârewec.
Iŋuc erâ ŋic ejarepe ficmaŋ i emasaŋkembiŋ. Eme no Anuture ufuŋte kuʒi râqâc wiac â nânâ bâzi erâ wiac âsu biaŋ furi sâko i mocwâc bârisierâ ira râepo.
Eme Lewiŋic jaŋere nânâ biŋe mi jarekicne i wâc honepo. Jaŋe iŋuc epie Lewiŋic â gae hehe ŋic jaŋe gie bahuc jumbiŋ i hetararâ hesarac mâreŋ‐jeŋic sâc wiserâ rambiŋ.
Eme no irec micne jaŋere manape sâqoreme ʒiŋuc mupo: “Anuture ufuŋ i wemocte râpeckekicne?” Iŋuc murâ hetumaŋ‐joparâ dodoma‐jeŋic sâc râec‐jopa rapo.
Ehame Judaŋic jaŋe jacgoŋ â waiŋ â wokemaŋ teŋkonec wâŋ i rowaŋficko bafisi râembiŋ.
Eme no rowaŋficte moneŋ soŋaŋ taha bapa Selemia â qâqâreŋ ŋic Zadoko â Lewi guruonec Pedaja, iŋuc âkendâŋ‐jopapo. Erâ jaŋere manape sâckeme babafic‐jeŋic ine Ʒakurure ŋokâ Matania ŋosa‐ticne Hanaŋ e hâcne râepo. Eme qomâfâc‐jeŋic wiac kâdoc qaqa‐jare izi gie‐jeŋic ewec.
O Anutu‐nane, go wiac ʒirec erâ manasucnuc, ehuc no gore ufuŋte â giere eehâmo gie bapo i mi bârârâŋnec.
Eme no dameŋ ira Judaŋic jaŋe sabata hombaŋko waiŋ âte pisickepie honec‐jopapo, erâ jacgoŋ ropie gurune gurune feme doŋgi faio râembiŋ. Erâ wâc waiŋ opâne â hândâŋne â jâmbo hândâŋ erâ tagi fuŋne fuŋne i mâmâc sabata hombaŋko Jerusalem haeo bafisimbiŋ. Eme no nânâ furi bapa gie bambiŋ ʒoaŋ ira uŋ jazapo.
Eme Tiro mâreŋkonec ŋic Jerusalem haeo jumbiŋ jaŋe wâc hâwec qowi â wiac fuŋne fuŋne bambiŋ i sabata hombaŋkoa Jerusalem haeo Judaŋic jaŋerao bafisipie furine bambiŋ.
Jaŋe iŋuc epie no Judaŋic fekicne jaŋere manape sâqoreme dâŋ ʒiŋuc mujarepo: “Ŋoŋe wemocte sabata hombaŋ sipirickehuc mâsi repicne ʒi eŋgopieŋ?
Apa ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mâsi ijaha embiŋ. Ehame Anutu‐nâŋeczi hae ʒira wiac hâhâwicne ʒi bâfuahuc fai‐nâŋecko râewec. Ehame ŋoŋe sifu sabata hombaŋ sipirickehuc Anutu kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋ hâhâwicne jâmbâŋzi Israe ŋic fai‐nâŋecko feocte muŋgopieŋ me?”
Eme sabata hombaŋ maickehame hae ŋafezo ewec dameŋ ira Jerusalem haesac motâc hepie hehe jaha fohame juku sabata hombaŋ taraocte mujarepo. Ehuc sabata hombaŋko tagi wiac moc mi bafisiniŋte kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐nane gâcne motâcne motâcne ira soŋaŋ râec‐jopapo.
Ehame wiac fuŋne fuŋne irec furi bapa â nareŋ gareŋ ŋic jaŋe arec mocjaha me jajahec Jerusalem haesac râpeo fombiŋ.
Eme no uŋdâŋ jazahuc ʒiŋuc mupo: “Ŋoŋe wemocte haesac fuŋnao ŋec foc eŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe mâsi keci mocwâc epie dâŋgieo râec‐ŋopapemu.” No iŋuc ejarepe jaŋe sabata hombaŋko fifisi i behe sanaŋkembiŋ.
Eme no Lewiŋic jaŋe eemasaŋ gie barâ fisi motâc soŋaŋkehapie sabata hombaŋzi tiri foocte mujarepo. O Anutu‐nane, go irec wâc manasu‐narehuc aki anonocge ɋârâŋnea fokac irec sâcko akicnuc.
Eme no dameŋ ira Judaŋic jaŋe Asidode, Amoŋ â Moabi ŋokac rocjopambiŋ i wâc honec‐jopapo.
Eme naru motecfâc‐jeŋic dâkâne jaŋe Asidode dâŋ mumbiŋ. Ine hâcne, jaŋe ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere dâŋ muhuc Judadâŋ sâcne mi mumbiŋ.
Iŋuc epie no mana sâqore‐jarerâ sâwec‐jopahuc gâcne jopapo, ehuc qizec susuc‐jeŋic unuckepo. Erâ ejarepe kecʒiŋuc muhuc Anuture ʒâŋeo mujomirembiŋ: “Nâŋe otâfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe jaŋere ŋokâfâc mi jarenaŋmu, â ŋokâfâc‐nâŋec me nâŋe nâŋâcne biŋe jaŋere otâfâc wâc mi rocjopanaŋmu.
Israe ŋicwofuŋ Salomo e ŋokac iŋucne jaŋerao hâcne sâqorewec. Ŋic gurune gurune jaŋerao ŋicwofuŋ e iŋucne moc mi jumbiŋ, e Anutu‐ticnezi hone aŋac ecnehuc Israe ŋic qaŋeŋ‐joparâ juocte ŋicwofuŋ âkendâŋnewec. Erâ sifu ŋokac jabane jaŋe e wâc ecnepie sâqorewec.
Irec nâŋe ŋokac jabane rocjoparâ eebapa repic qapicne ʒi ehuc Anutu‐nâŋec bunao mocwâc mi banʒepeneŋ.”
Eme taha bapa fekicne Eliasibire ŋokâ Jojadare ŋokâfâc jaŋeraonec moczi Horoni ŋic Saŋbalatire kimo juwec. Irec e jâpepe rawec.
O Anutu‐nane, jaŋe taha bapa juju erâ taha bapa â Lewiŋic jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ekicne i bâbiembiŋ, go irec manasuhuc okacne jarezemec.
No iŋuc ehuc wiac jabane sasawa irecnec bâfiriec‐jopapo, erâ taha bapa â Lewiŋic jaŋere gie biricke‐hâmorâ ŋic buc buc gie‐jeŋicko râec‐jopapo.
Iŋuc erâ no tahare biŋe ʒoc â jâcfâri bâsukicne i bafisiniŋte ʒâfo wâc bajarepo. O Anutu‐nane, go irec wâc mâmâc manasuhuc ehâmo‐narezemec.
Wiac kecʒirec binaŋ bakicne i Ahasiwerozi India mâreŋkonec fuŋkerâ raku Etiopia mâreŋko tarakac, mâreŋ ŋondeŋ ira mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne 127 forawec irec ŋicwofuŋ juha fuawec.
Ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero e dameŋ ira hae qizec‐ticne Susa ira juhuc ŋicwofuŋ gie bawec.
Bahuc jume jara jahec â moc eha fekicnefâc‐ticne â kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne erâ Perisia â Mede mâreŋkonec momori micne â mâreŋ dâkâne gâcne irec soŋaŋ micne jaŋe tiwâ bâzi qajareme fisiwec.
Ehame uucmaŋ‐ticnere moneŋ mafa â ŋicwofuŋ juju‐ticnere wiac furi sâko erâ eri qaraweŋ i jowatuhuc juhame ʒoaŋ gie bapa 180 tarawec.
Tarame ŋicwofuŋ e hae qizec‐ticne Susa ira ŋic jufârembiŋ, fekicne â wahakicne jaŋere tiwâ bâzi moc ficticnere hae ʒoŋao qame fisiwec. Eme nâhuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 tarawec.
Hae ʒoŋare qoruc ââketâc qaŋqaŋ â keŋkeŋne i muc hahameŋne â âmuc âmucne izi finʒuŋ siliwazi bakicne ira basanaŋkerâ qânâ wâtuŋko ɋetickembiŋ, ehuc fofo wiac gol â siliwazia bakicne i qânâ fuŋne fuŋne furi sâkozi hata bakicne irec qaŋeŋnao hepie ŋewec.
Waiŋ opâ ine tase hawarine fuŋne fuŋne ira hoŋkepie hume jarembiŋ; waiŋ opâ i ŋicwofuŋ e rowaŋ‐ticnao bocjaha focnewecte buafec jaha jare gumec eme nâ gapec embiŋ.
Ŋicwofuŋ e ŋic jaŋe aŋac‐jeŋicte sâc sawa waiŋ opâ nâniŋte manasuhuc kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne sâcmutâc ejareme irec sâcko jarehuc ʒoɋac moc mi ejarembiŋ.
Eme ŋokac wofuŋ Wasiti e wâc iŋuc jaha ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero erific‐ticnao ŋokac jaŋere tiwâ bâzi moc qame fisiwec.
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 ira ine waiŋ opâzi ŋicwofuŋ maŋticne bâsifuckeme ʒeri ehuc kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne fekicne Mehumaŋ, Bireta, Harebona, Bigita, Abagita, Setari â Karikasi jaŋe ŋokac wofuŋ Wasiti e eridu‐ticnehec ŋicwofuŋte maio jowa wareniŋte mutâcne‐jarewec. Ŋokac e sahac hawari‐ticne biaŋne, irec ŋicwofuŋzi ŋic ŋokac jowatuocte manasuwec.

Eme ŋokac wofuŋ Wasiti eki ine kiŋaŋ qaqa ŋic fekicne jaŋe ŋicwofuŋte dâŋ âzâcnepie qatarawec. Iŋuc eme ŋicwofuŋ e maŋʒoc‐ticne fuame aaricke sâqorewec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ e sâcmutâc dâŋ â ŋic ŋokac eebapa‐jeŋicte fuŋne manambiŋ ŋic i jaŋe mu wioc ejare jujec, irec sâc jaha mamana ŋicfâc‐ticne dameŋte fuŋne mana jumbieŋ jaŋe mu wioc ejarewec.
Dameŋ ira ŋicwofuŋte maŋfuŋko Perisia â Mede mâreŋkonec mamana ŋic fekicne 7 kecʒiŋuc jaŋe jumbiŋ: Karasena, Setari, Adamata, Tarasisi, Meresi, Maresena erâ Memukaŋ. Jaŋe hâcne ŋicwofuŋ uucmaŋ‐ticnere ŋic fekicne juhuc ŋicwofuŋ iqicke jumbieŋ. Irec jaŋe kecʒiŋuc muhuc wio‐jarewec:
“Ŋokac wofuŋ Wasiti e ŋic fekicne jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero nore dâŋ âzâcnepie qatarawec, irec e weniŋuc ecnehuc sâcmutâc dâŋnâŋecte sâcko bâtiŋnenaŋmu?”
Iŋuc wio‐jareme Memukaŋ e ŋicwofuŋ â ŋic fekicne jaŋere maio kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋokac wofuŋ Wasiti e ŋicwofuŋ sawa mâcne, ŋic fekicne â ŋic gâcne sasawa ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero uucmaŋ‐ticnao jufâreŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc bawahac‐jopawec.
Ŋokac wofuŋzi mâsi ewec i ŋokac sasawa jaŋe mana‐fâreniŋmu, ehuc ŋowefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere manapie wawahane eha ʒiŋuc muniŋmu hâcne: ‘Ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero e ŋokac wofuŋ Wasitizi mai‐ticnao fuaocte mume dâŋticne qatarawec.’
Irec Perisia â Mede ŋokac fekicne jaŋe miŋecgac jaha ŋokac wofuŋzi mâsi ewec irec biŋe manarâ ŋic fekicne dâŋbinaŋ ejarehuc mana wahac‐jopapie aaric boc fuaocmu.
Irec ŋicwofuŋ, go manatec sâckekacko ine Perisia â Medeŋic jaŋere sâcmutâc fokac, sâcmutâc sanaŋ iŋucne moc kecʒiŋuc muhuc hae sâc râetec razejec: Wasiti e ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero nore maio mocwâc mi fuazejec. Go iŋuc erâ ŋokac biaŋne moc ŋeŋetac‐ticnao âkendâŋnetec ŋokac wofuŋ erâ juzejec.
Erâ ŋicwofuŋ go sâcmutâc râetec rarâ uucmaŋge sâcke‐fâreme ŋokac sasawa jaŋe manarâ ŋowefâc‐jeŋic fekicne â wahakicne mâmâc sâsec‐jopa‐fârenʒepieŋ.”
Eme ŋicwofuŋ â fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe dâŋ i manarâ bubiaŋ manambiŋ, ehuc ŋicwofuŋ e Memukaŋzi dâŋ muwec irec sâc ewec.
Ehuc mâreŋ‐ticnere dâkâne sasawa ira papia râeme rafârewec. Ine mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne qâreŋ hawari‐jeŋic forawec â ŋic ŋokac dâŋmarac‐jeŋicte sâcko râeme rawec, i ŋic sasawa jaŋe ficjeŋicte micne juhuc ŋokacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere dâŋ mutaraniŋte iŋuc ewec.
Juku ʒâhec ine ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero aaric‐ticne fâre wahame Wasitizi mâsi ewec irec mecne â mumupaŋ dâŋticne weniŋuc mukicne irec mâmâc manasuwec.
Iŋuc eme kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ŋicwofuŋ, go mutec naru ʒeŋoŋ hawari biaŋ bâwosâec‐jopapie gore biŋe junʒepieŋ.
Erâ gokizia uucmaŋgere mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne forakac irec ŋic micne mucjopatec jaŋe naru ʒeŋoŋ hawari biaŋ hâcne bâtumaŋ‐joparâ hae qizec Susa ira ŋokacficko guruc‐jopanʒepieŋ. Ehuc ŋicwofuŋte ŋic fekicne Hegai ere meo râec‐jopanʒepieŋ. Eki hâcne ŋokac soŋaŋ jukac.
Ehame ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ e me e manacnetec sâckeha Wasitire okacne ŋokac wofuŋ âkendâŋnezemec.” Dâŋ iŋuc mupie ŋicwofuŋzi maname biaŋkeha iŋuc ewec.
Eme Susa hae qizec ira Benjamiŋte guruonec Judaŋic moc juwec ʒâŋene Morodekai; e Jairi ere ŋokâ, Jairi e ine Simeire ŋokâ â Simeizi Kisire ŋokâ.
Morodekai e Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukanezazi Juda ŋic ŋokac â ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic Jekonia kâpâcwâruo bacjopa rawec dameŋ ira Jerusalem haeonec mâmâc barakicne.
Ŋic eki mamac pitic‐ticnere otâ Hadasa, Esite hâcne, e bekâ juwecte gume jowac ecneha sokawec. Naru e sahac hawari‐ticne biaŋne â gâjoŋ sereŋ. Neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne hâmopire Morodekaizi rorâ e jahacne otâ iŋucne bajuwec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ e sâcmutâc dâŋticne râeme rame naru ʒeŋoŋ bocjaha bâtumaŋ‐joparâ Susa hae qizecko Hegaire meo râec‐jopambiŋ dameŋ ira Esite mâmâc ŋicwofuŋte ficko jowa rarâ ŋokac soŋaŋ juwec ere meoa râembiŋ.
Hegai e ine naru ere maname biaŋkewec â sâckewec. Irec e wokemaŋ âsu biaŋ â nânâ wiac biaŋne afeckerâ râcnehuc kiŋaŋ narufâcne 7 ŋicwofuŋte fickonec bâwosâec‐joparâ râcnewec. Erâ naru e jahacne â kiŋaŋ narufâcne jaŋe ŋokacfic maŋne biaŋnao râec‐jopawec wâc.
Esite e Morodekaizi mic muac ecnewecte e jahacne âgo soctofafâc‐ticne â qomâfâc‐ticne mi mufuac‐jopawec.
Morodekai eki ine Esite weniŋuc ehuc jukac irec fuŋne manaocte ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne ŋokacficte hae ʒoŋao rac warec ehuc juwec.
Naru ʒeŋoŋ rocjopa jumbieŋ jaŋe sahac eemasaŋ gie bahuc juhapie mosa 12 tara jujec. Mosa 6 irec maŋnao saife âsu â wokemaŋ rua jumbieŋ â mosa 6 ira ine tokic â huc âsu rua jumbieŋ. Eme juku gie i tarame ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwerore maio buc buc fuaniŋte dameŋ maicke jujec.
Ehame naru moc e ŋokacfickonec wiac i me i barazo mume manacne jumbieŋ.
Eme naru jaŋe owâcne ŋicwofuŋte ficko fejumbieŋ â furicte ine mocwâc waha jumbieŋ. Waharâ ine ŋokacfic moc ŋicwofuŋ ŋokacfâc‐ticne mamare jumbieŋ ira rajumbieŋ. Ŋokac i jaŋe ine ŋicwofuŋte ŋic fekicne Sasigaʒezi soŋaŋ‐jopahuc juwec. Ehame naru jaŋe ŋicwofuŋtao kosa mocwâc mi rajumbieŋ, e jahac mana‐jareme biaŋkeha ʒâŋe‐jeŋic muhuc hefârec‐jopame sâc ficticnao fejumbieŋ.
Juku Morodekai e mamac pitic‐ticne Ahibai ere otâ Esite hâcne, e jahacne otâ fuŋfuŋ tinac bajuwec e ŋicwofuŋtao feocte dameŋ‐ticne maickewec. Eme Esite e maŋticnere wiac i me i ŋicwofuŋ ficko bafeocte mi muwec, mâc ŋicwofuŋte fekicne ŋokac soŋaŋ juwec, Hegai hâcne, eki âzâcnewec irec sâc sawa bafewec. Ehame Esite honembiŋ ŋic ŋokac i jaŋe sasawa manacnepie biaŋkewec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero e guriŋ bapa gie bahuc jume jare 7 eha mosa 10, Tebeti mosa hâcne, ira Esite ŋicwofuŋte ficko jowa fembiŋ.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ e ŋokac gâcne jaŋere aŋackewec irec sâc sirickehuc Esitere boc ecnewec; ehuc naru ʒeŋoŋ gâcne jaŋere maname wawahane eha Esitere maname fefene ewec. Irec ehâmocnehuc eri hendiŋ qizecnao hecneme hume Wasitire âkehoc ŋokac wofuŋ âkendâŋnewec.
Ŋicwofuŋ e iŋuc erâ Esite sâsehuc fekicne â kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere tiwâ bâzi sâko moc qame fisiwec. Ehuc mume mâreŋ‐ticne dâkâne dâkâne forawec ira hombaŋ ŋehapie ŋicwofuŋzi bubiaŋ wiac aameo jarewec.
Eme naru ʒeŋoŋ mocwâc hefârec‐jopapie arecne jajahec ewec dameŋ ira Morodekaizi ŋicwofuŋ fic motâcko ŋewec.
Esite eki ine Morodekaizi mutâcnecnewec irec sâc ehuc âgo soctofafâc‐ticne â qomâfâc‐ticne mi mufuac‐jopawec. E juwicnao Morodekaihec juhuc micticne reŋke jujec irec sâc jaha reŋkewec.
Eme Morodekai e ŋicwofuŋ ficte motâcko ŋewec dameŋ ira ŋic fekicne jajahec, Bigita â Teresi, jahe motâc soŋaŋ jupiczi aaric‐jofame ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero qâhâmozo mupic.
Ehame dâŋjekic i Morodekaire hazecko hume ŋokac wofuŋ Esite âzâcnewec, eme Esite e Morodekaire micte ŋicwofuŋ mufuacnewec.
Eme dâŋ irec fuŋne bataniŋkerâ honepie fârine eme ŋic jahe jâcko bituac‐jofambiŋ. Erâ irec dâŋ i ŋicwofuŋte maio Binaŋ Qâhâc papia qizecko qâreŋkembiŋ.
Eme wiac i tara‐fâreme ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero e Agagi ŋic Hamedatare ŋokâ Hamaŋ sâsehuc ŋic fekicne gâcne ehec mâmâc jumbiŋ jaŋere micne âkendâŋnewec.
Ehame ŋicwofuŋte kiŋaŋŋicfâc sacmotâcko domambiŋ jaŋe sasawa dieŋzi hecnehuc fodapecnembiŋ; i ŋicwofuŋzi iŋuc eniŋte mutâcne‐jarewec hâcne. Morodekaizi ine dieŋzi hecnehuc mi fodapecnewec.
Iŋuc eme ŋicwofuŋte kiŋaŋŋicfâc sacmotâcko domambiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc wiocnembiŋ: “Go wemocte ŋicwofuŋte dâŋ qatarakomec?”
Eme jaŋe ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne iŋuc âzâcnepie Morodekaizi mi manawec. Eme ere qaqatara i okac tâmiric foocmu me okacnehec eocme irec fuŋne bataniŋkeniŋte Hamaŋ âzâcnembiŋ. Morodekaizi “No Judaŋic jukopac” iŋuc hâcne jazawec.
Eme Morodekai e dieŋzi henarehuc mi fodape‐narekac, Hamaŋzi iŋuc honerâ aaricke sâqorewec.
Erâ ine Morodekai bucticne bâsiroweocte mi manasuwec. Hamaŋ e Morodekaizi Judaŋic jukac, iŋuc âzâcnepie manarâ Morodekai qomâfâc‐ticne â âgo soctofafâc‐ticne Ahasiwerore uucmaŋko jumbiŋ jaŋe sasawa bâsirowec‐jopa‐fâreocte maŋkewec.
Ahasiwero e ŋicwofuŋ jume jara 12 eha mosa namba 1, mosa Nisaŋ hâcne, ira Hamaŋte maio ɋâsâi ʒâŋene Puru i qambiŋ. Erâ ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne â mosane mosane qafekupie mosa 12, Adari mosa i hâcne wahawec. Ehame irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 13 maickeme behembiŋ.
Behepie Hamaŋzi ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Uucmaŋgao mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne forakac ira ŋic guru fuŋmoc jaŋe siŋsaŋ qarâ juŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâcmutâc dâŋ i ŋicguru gâcne nâŋâcne sâcmutâc fokac irec sâc aricne. Jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ gore sâcmutâc dâŋ mi reŋkeeŋgopieŋ. Iŋuc ehuc juhapie go sifu mana‐jaretec ʒuhuckerâ jupie mi sâckeocmu.
Irec go manatec sâckeha mumutara dâŋ qâreŋkerâ râetec rame bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârenʒepieŋ. Ehame no siliwa moneŋ teŋ tauseŋ ŋic gore moneŋ mafa wiac soŋaŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋere meo râepe jaŋe gore moneŋ katapao behepie huzejec.”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋzi meo fefe‐ticne manehec i batararâ Hamedatare ŋokâ Judaŋic jaŋere râsi juwec, Agagi ŋic Hamaŋ hâcne, e râcnewec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Moneŋ i gore biŋe, â ŋic ŋokac keci jaŋe gore biŋe jaha, irec go gahac manakic sâc ejarezemec.”
Eme mosa wâŋ irec gie bapa 13 ira ŋicwofuŋte qâreŋŋic hetumaŋ‐jopapie jaŋe Hamaŋzi mutâcnewec irec sâcko ŋicwofuŋte mâreŋ soŋaŋ â guriŋ bapafâc‐ticne mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne jurambiŋ erâ ŋic gurune gurune fekicnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sâcmutâc dâŋ moc qâreŋkembiŋ. Ehuc mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne ŋic jurambiŋ jaŋere qâreŋ hawario â dâŋmaracko qâreŋkembiŋ. Sâcmutâc dâŋ i ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwerore micte qâreŋkerâ tataranao ere ma hembiŋ.
Papia i mosa namba 12, ʒâŋene Adari, irec gie bapa 13 ira Judaŋic sasawa, kâcɋene â piticne erâ ŋokac naru motec bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârerâ mafa wiac‐jeŋic fiuckeniŋte kiŋaŋŋic jaŋe ŋicwofuŋte micte mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne forawec ira picpac jaha barambiŋ.
Ehame mâreŋ dâkâne sâc irec ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒoaŋ dameŋ ira ʒawierâ juniŋte sâcmutâc dâŋte papia irec rehacne moc i hae sâc râepie rafârewec.
Eme hae qizecko sâcmutâc dâŋ i ŋic ŋokac wose‐jarehapie kiŋaŋŋic jaŋe ŋicwofuŋte micte bâruŋ jaha hae sâc barambiŋ hâcne. Ehame ŋicwofuŋ â Hamaŋ jahe waiŋ opâ nâhuc ŋehapire Susa hae rune jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋ i manarâ fâfâre sâqorembiŋ.
Eme Morodekai e wiac sasawa fuawec irec biŋe manarâ ŋaqi‐ticne bâsuckerâ mateŋ qonaŋkerâ ʒafe ruawec. Erâ hae ʒâʒâŋiŋko rarâ owackehuc kio ŋâŋâtâc ewec.
Ehuc ŋicwofuŋ ficte sacmotâc fuŋko ferâ domawec. Sacmotâc ira ine ŋic jaŋe mateŋ qonaŋkerâ moc mi fejumbieŋ.
Ehame ŋicwofuŋte sâcmutâc dâŋ i mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne ra fisiwec sâc ira Judaŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko ki busâqoc â uwâuŋa fuarâ foha nânâ sowa jumbiŋ, ehuc ŋic bocjaha jaŋe mateŋ qonaŋkerâ ʒafe rua‐fârembiŋ.
Eme ŋokac wofuŋ Esite e kiŋaŋ naru â soŋaŋfâc‐ticne jaŋe fisirâ dâŋ binaŋ ecnepie maŋ kukumbuc boc ecnewec. Irec e Morodekaizi ŋaqi moc heme huocte râeme rame qikiŋnewec.
Iŋuc eme Esitezi ŋicwofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic moc, ʒâŋene Hataka e hefârerâ wiac weniŋuc fuawec irec fuŋne manaocte Morodekairao soreme rawec. Ŋic eki hâcne Esitere kiŋaŋ qaocte mucnekicne.
Eme Hataka e Morodekaizi ŋicwofuŋ fic sacmotâc‐ticnere hae ʒoŋao domawec ira rawec.
Ra fisime Morodekai e wiac sasawa fuacnewec irec dâŋ âzâcne‐fârewec, ehuc Judaŋic bâsirowec‐jopaniŋmu irec erâ Hamaŋzi ŋicwofuŋte moneŋ katapao moneŋ wezimuc râeme huocte mupaŋkewec i mâmâc âzâcnewec.
Ehuc Judaŋic bâsirowec‐jopazore Susa haeo sâcmutâc qâreŋkekicne irec rehacne moc râcnewec wâc, i Esite jâuturâ fuŋne âzâcne mutâc eme eki ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere erâ ŋicwofuŋtao nunumu gie baocte iŋuc ewec.
Eme Hataka e Morodekaizi dâŋ muwec i rarâ Esite âzâcne‐fârewec.
Iŋuc eme Esitezi Hataka dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc Morodekairao soreme risiewec:
“Ŋicwofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic â ŋicwofuŋte mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne ŋic juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc mana‐fâreŋgopieŋ: Ŋic me ŋokac moc e mi hefârehapie sifu ŋicwofuŋte hae ʒoŋao raʒiocmu e hâmo‐jâmbâŋkeocmu. Mocjaha, ŋicwofuŋzi gunu‐ticne golzi bakicne i ŋic moctao sicneocmu e sawa akickeniŋmu. No ine hefârecnupie ŋicwofuŋtao mi fefe mâc juhape ʒoaŋ gie bapa 30 tarakac.”
Eme Hataka â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe Esitezi dâŋ jazawec i Morodekai âzâcne‐fârembiŋ.
Âzâcnepie Esite dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecneniŋte jazawec: “Go ʒiŋuc mi muzemec: Judaŋic sasawa jaŋe sipirickepie no ŋicwofuŋte ficko jukopacte sâcne jupemu.
Manakic, go dameŋ ʒira dâŋemâc jucmuo ine Judaŋic gâcne nâŋere babafic â babatara i mâreŋ mockonec fua‐nâreha go â mamacgere wiacfâc ŋoŋe ine sipiricke‐fâreniŋmu. Go dameŋ sâqocnao bafic‐nâpocmurâ ŋokac wofuŋ âkendâŋgukicne mecne.”
Eme Esite e dâŋ i manarâ Morodekai ʒiŋuc âzâcneniŋte jazawec:
“Ajoc, go rarâ Susa haeo Judaŋic juŋgopieŋ jaŋe hetumaŋ‐jopa‐fâretec nore erâ sowa junʒepieŋ, ehuc ʒoaŋko mecne ŋafeo mecne nânâ opâ moc mi nâhuc juhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc tarazejec. Ehame no â kiŋaŋ narufâc‐nane nâŋe wâc iŋuc jaha sowa junaŋmu. Iŋuc epene tarame no sâcmutâc fokac i mana‐bipiehuc sifu ŋicwofuŋtao fezepac; eme irec erâ nuzo murâ nupie hâmozepac.”
Eme Morodekai e dâŋ i manarâ ra Esitezi mutâcnecnewec irec sâc efarewec.
Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 3 ira Esitezi ŋokac wofuŋ ŋaqi wiac‐ticne heme hume ŋicwofuŋte fic ŋifecnao hae ʒoŋa fowec ira ra domawec. Â ŋicwofuŋ e ine ficmaŋko motâc ocniŋucnao eri ŋeŋe‐ticnao ŋewec.
Ehuc ŋokac wofuŋ Esite e hae ʒoŋao domaha honerâ bubiaŋ manahuc gunu‐ticne golzi bakicne baŋewec i erao sicnewec. Iŋuc eme Esitezi maŋfuŋnao rarâ gunu tofanao bâuawec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mu wioc ecnewec: “Ŋokac wofuŋ Esite, go wemo wiacte warerâ mukomec? Go wiac irec me irec egareme mutec garepemu. Me uucmaŋ‐nane ŋifecnere mutec wâc garepemu.”
Iŋuc mume Esitezi muwec: “Ŋicwofuŋ, go manatec sâckeha go gahacne â Hamaŋ ŋohe gore tiwâ bâzi rike bâmoc epac i fârâ nânic.”
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi kiŋaŋŋicfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe biac jaha Hamaŋ jowa warepie Esitezi mukac irec sâc ezeperec.” Eme ŋicwofuŋ â Hamaŋ jahe Esitezi tiwâ bâzi rike bâmoc ewec i rarâ nâpic.
Ehuc waiŋ opâ nârâ ŋehuc ŋicwofuŋzi Esite ʒiŋuc mu wioc ecnewec: “Go wemo wiacte numu‐narekomec? Go wiac irec me irec egareme mutec garepemu. Me wemo wiacte mukomec? Go uucmaŋ‐nane ŋifecnere mutec wâc garepemu.”
Eme Esitezi kecʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “No ʒiŋuc muhuc numu‐garekopac:
Ŋicwofuŋ, go nore manatec biaŋkeme nunumu dâŋnanere manatec sâckekacko go gahacne â Hamaŋ ŋohe tomâcko tiwâ bâzi rike bâmoc epemu i ware nâzepirec. Ehame no dameŋ ijaha dâŋ nazacmu irec sâc epemu.”
Eme Hamaŋ e ʒoaŋ gie bapa ira ʒeri bari ehuc bubiaŋ faio hahata rawec. Raku ŋicwofuŋte sacmotâcko fisime Morodekaizi hone takirerâ ɋarac ɋarac qahuc ŋeweckonec mi faharewec. Iŋuc eme Hamaŋzi honerâ ere aaricke sâqorewec.
Erâ sifu aaric mana‐bipiehuc ficticnao risiewec. Risierâ âgofâc‐ticne â ŋonâŋ‐ticne Ʒeresi jaŋe hefârec‐jopame fisimbiŋ.
Fisipie Hamaŋzi moneŋ mafa sâko‐ticne irec binaŋ mecne, ŋokâfâcne jaŋere binaŋ mecne erâ ŋicwofuŋzi sâsehuc ʒâŋe biŋe sâko tahackeme ŋic fekicne â ŋicwofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic gâcne jaŋere sâc sirickewec irec binaŋ i mâmâc bajarewec.
Ehuc ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋokac wofuŋ Esitezi ŋic e me e mâcne, no hâcne ŋicwofuŋhec tiwâ bâzi nanacte hefârec‐nâfojec. Erâ tomâcko wâc iŋuc jaha ŋicwofuŋhec erao ranacte nâsâjec.
Ehame Judaŋic Morodekaizi ŋicwofuŋte sacmotâcko ʒuhuckerâ ŋeocmuo ine no sifu wiac irec manape fârine mi eocmu.”
Iŋuc jazame ŋonâŋ‐ticne Ʒeresi â âgofâcne sasawa jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Go mutec bibitua wâtuŋ moc kubi 50 irec sâc banʒepieŋ. Erâ tomâcko furicte ŋicwofuŋ âzâcnetec mume Morodekai bituanʒepieŋ. Iŋuc epie honerâ ŋicwofuŋhec tiwâ bâzi nâzore bubiaŋ faio razepirec.” Eme Hamaŋ e dâŋ i maname biaŋkeha bibitua wâtuŋ baniŋte ŋic jazawec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ e ŋafe ira maŋhâhâŋ ecneme guŋɋâri juwec, ehuc ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne wiac fua wefuwec irec binaŋ qâhâc papia i mume bafisirâ wosecnembiŋ.
Wosecnehuc ine ŋicwofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic fekicne jajahec, Bigitana â Teresi jahe motâc soŋaŋ juhuc ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero qâhâmonicte mupire Morodekaizi manarâ mufuac‐jofawec irec binaŋ wosecnembiŋ hâcne.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi manarâ ʒiŋuc muhuc wio‐jarewec: “Morodekai e mufuac‐jofawec irec erâ sâsehuc furine wemo wiac râcnekicne?” Iŋuc wiome kiŋaŋ qacnehuc jumbiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Aricne, e wiac i me i moc mi râcnekicne.”
Mupie ŋicwofuŋzi muwec: “Hae ʒoŋao mozi ware domakac?” Wiowec dameŋ ŋondeŋ ijaha Hamaŋ e kecʒiŋuc manasuhuc ŋicwofuŋte hae ʒoŋao fisi domawec hâcne: No ŋicwofuŋ âzâcnepe mume bibitua wâtuŋ bakicne ira Morodekai bituanʒepieŋ.
Irec kiŋaŋŋic jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Hamaŋzi ware hae ʒoŋao domakac.” Iŋuc âzâcnepie ŋicwofuŋzi muwec: “Ecnepie wefuoc.”
Eme Hamaŋ e ficko feme ŋicwofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnewec: “Ŋic moczi ŋicwofuŋ no sâsecnuzore afeckeme weniŋuc ecnepe sâckeocmu?” Mume Hamaŋ e ʒiŋuc manasuwec: “Ŋicwofuŋ e ŋic moc mâcne, no hâcne sâsecnuocte mukac.”
Iŋuc manasuhuc ŋicwofuŋ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “O ŋicwofuŋ, go ŋic sâsezo mukomec e ʒiŋuc ecnetec sâckeocmu:
Go mutec ŋicwofuŋ ŋaqi go gahac rojumeŋ erâ becâsic eri hendiŋ wiac‐ticnehec go gahac bajumeŋ i bawarenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ŋicwofuŋ gore kiŋaŋŋic fekicne moc râcnepie eki ine ŋicwofuŋ go ŋic sâsezo mukic e hecneme huzejec. Ehame ŋic e ecneme becâsicko ferâ ŋehame barâ rahuc hahaŋne barâ ʒiŋuc muzejec: ‘Ŋicwofuŋzi ŋic moc sâseocte afeckeme e iŋuc hâcne ecnezo.’”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋzi Hamaŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ajoc, go mukomec irec sâc jâmbâŋ ehuc ŋaqi â becâsic rorâ Judaŋic Morodekai nore sacmotâcko ŋekac e râcnezemec. Go dâŋ mumec i efârezemec.”
Eme Hamaŋ e ŋaqi wiac Morodekai hecneme huwec. Erâ ecneme becâsicko ferâ ŋeha bâniecnehuc hahaŋne barâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋicwofuŋzi ŋic moc sâseocte afeckeme e iŋuc hâcne ecnezo.”
Iŋuc epie tarame Morodekaizi ŋicwofuŋte sacmotâcko risiewec. Â Hamaŋ eki ine ʒâŋe mai‐ticne bâsoŋkerâ busâqoc manahuc ficticnao gasackerâ rawec.
Ra fisirâ wiac fuacnewec irec binaŋ i ŋonâŋ‐ticne Ʒeresi â âgofâcne bajarewec. Bajareme âgofâcne â ŋonâŋ‐ticne Ʒeresi jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Go miŋecgac Morodekaire maio fuŋkerâ bawahacgukicne irec manac: E Judaŋic fârine jukacko ine ere maio mocwâc sanaŋkerâ mi domacmu.”
Jaŋe Hamaŋhec dâŋ muha muhapie izia ŋicwofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic fekicne jaŋe fisirâ, Esitezi tiwâ bâzi rike bâmoc ewec i nânicte bâruŋ jaha jowa rambiŋ.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ â Hamaŋ jahe ŋokac wofuŋ Esite ehec tiwâ bâzi nânicte rapic.
Erâ ʒoaŋ namba 2 ira waiŋ opâ nâhuc ŋicwofuŋzi Esite mocwâc ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnewec: “O ŋokac wofuŋ Esite, go wemo wiacte numu‐narekomec? Go wiac irec me irec numu‐naretec garepemu. Wemo wiacte mukomec? Go uucmaŋ‐nane ŋifecnere mutec wâc garepemu.”
Iŋuc mume ŋokac wofuŋ Esitezi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “O ŋicwofuŋ, go nore manatec sâcke biaŋ ekacko ine nunumu‐nanere erâ no nahac â ŋicfâc‐nane nâŋe akic‐nâpozemec.
Nâŋe sipiric‐nâporâ qâhâmoc‐nâpohuc bâsirowec‐nâponiŋte furi bacnâpokicne hâcne. Nâŋe moneŋzi furi bacnâpohuc kiŋaŋ ŋic ŋokac sawa bacnâponʒapiŋ muzac irec dâŋ moc mi muzapo, â ʒârâ hâriŋ iŋucnere erâ wemocko ŋicwofuŋ micneneŋ ecnezapo.”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero e ŋokac wofuŋ Esite ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnewec: “Mo ŋiczi wena juhuc wiac iŋucne ezo maŋkekac?” Eme Esitezi muwec: “Ŋic repic qapicne keci Hamaŋ hâcne eki râsi enârehuc iŋuc ekac.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Hamaŋ e ŋicwofuŋ â ŋokac wofuŋ jahere maio bipicne tarame ɋarac ɋarac qawec.
Ehame ŋicwofuŋ e aaric sâko manarâ tiwâ bâzi nâhuc ŋembiŋkonec faharerâ hae ʒoŋao huwec; â Hamaŋ e ine ficmaŋkoa ŋehuc, ŋicwofuŋ e wiac hâhâwicne enareocmu iŋuc manahuc Esitezi akickeocte numucnewec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ e waiŋ opâ nâhuc ŋembiŋko risierâ ʒiŋuc honewec: Hamaŋ e Esite foweckoa waha fodapecnewec. Iŋuc honerâ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Hâc, ŋic keci e ficnaneoa ŋokac wofuŋ bâbieocte ekac me?” Ŋicwofuŋ e dâŋ iŋuc muha muha izia Hamaŋ ʒâŋe maine qofackembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie ŋicwofuŋte kiŋaŋ qahuc domambiŋ jaŋeraonec moc ʒâŋene Harebona e kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Manaŋgopieŋ, Morodekai e ŋicwofuŋte kiŋaŋ biaŋne qawec, eme ere bibituare wâtuŋ Hamaŋzi mume kubi 50 irec sâc biac bakicne i Hamaŋte hae ʒoŋao wisepie huwec domakac.”
Ŋic e iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋzi muwec: “Ajoc, ira bituaniŋ.” Eme jaŋe Morodekaire bibitua wâtuŋ bakicne ira hâcne Hamaŋ bituambiŋ. Iŋuc epie ŋicwofuŋte aaric fâre wahawec.
Eme ʒoaŋ ira ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero e Judaŋic jaŋere râsi, Hamaŋ hâcne, ere fic i ŋokac wofuŋ Esite râcne tahac ewec. Ehame Esitezi Morodekaire fuŋne ŋicwofuŋ âzâcneme manarâ Morodekai hefâreme ŋicwofuŋte maio fuawec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ e meo fefe‐ticne maqâreŋhec Hamaŋ jâoc rowec i meticnaonec rorâ Morodekai râcnewec. Eme Esitezi ine Hamaŋte fic irec soŋaŋ Morodekai âkendâŋnewec.
Esite e iŋuc erâ ŋicwofuŋ fodapecnerâ kiohuc Agagi ŋic Hamaŋ e Judaŋic bâsirowec‐jopaocte sâcmutâc dâŋ hehesicne bâfuawec i ŋicwofuŋzi bârârieocte numucnewec.
Iŋuc eme Ahasiwerozi ŋicwofuŋ gunu‐ticne golzi bakicne i Esiterao sicnewec.
Eme Esitezi faharerâ ŋicwofuŋte maio domawec. Ehuc kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “O ŋicwofuŋ, go nore manatec biaŋkeha dâŋ mukopac irec wâc manatec sâckeme ine mutec sâcmutâc dâŋ moc qâreŋkerâ râepie rarâ Hamaŋte dâŋ qâsuazejec. Agagi ŋic Hamaŋ e Hamedatare ŋokâzi hâcne ŋicwofuŋ gore mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne ira Judaŋic juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopa‐fâreocte dâŋ qâreŋkeme rawec.
Eme ʒi ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere faio wiac hâhâwicne fezo ekac i no hone manac erâ weniŋuc epemu, me soctofafâc‐nane bâsirowec‐jopapie no weniŋuc erâ sâcne jupemu?”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwerozi ŋokac wofuŋ Esite â Judaŋic Morodekai ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Manakopirec, Hamaŋ e Judaŋic bâsirowec‐ŋopaocte muwecte mupe bituambiŋ, erâ wâc ficticne i Esite go gare tahac epac.
Irec ŋohe ŋicwofuŋ nore ʒâŋeo âkehotahuc Judaŋic jaŋere dâŋ iŋuc me iŋuc moc qâreŋkezo murâ qâreŋkezepirec, ehuc nore maqâreŋ râezepirec. Sâcmutâc dâŋ moc i ŋicwofuŋ nore ʒâŋeo âkehotahuc qâreŋkerâ maqâreŋ‐nane râeniŋmu i mocwâc qâsuapie moc rârâene mi eocmu.”
Ŋicwofuŋ e dâŋ iŋuc mutarame mosa namba 3, ʒâŋene Siwaŋ, irec gie bapa 23 ira qâreŋŋicfâc‐ticne hetumaŋ‐jopambiŋ. Eme jaŋe Morodekaizi mutâcne‐jarewec irec sâc Judaŋic jaŋere erâ sâcmutâc dâŋ moc qâreŋkembiŋ. Ehuc India mâreŋkonec fuŋkerâ raku Etiopia mâreŋko tarakac mâreŋ ŋondeŋ ira mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne forawec irec soŋaŋ â guriŋ bapa ŋic â ŋic fekicne jaŋerao râepie rawec. Mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne forawec ine 127. Sâcmutâc dâŋ i ine mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne ŋic jurambiŋ jaŋere qâreŋ hawario â dâŋmaracko qâreŋkehuc Judaŋic jaŋere qâreŋ hawario â dâŋmaracko wâc mâmâc qâreŋkembiŋ.
Papia i ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero ere ʒâŋeo âkehotahuc qâreŋkerâ ere maqâreŋ mâmâc râembiŋ. Eme sâcmutâc dâŋ irec papia i becâsicko rara kiŋaŋŋic jaŋe gasacke sâqorehuc barambiŋ. Becâsicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ŋicwofuŋte becâsicfâc jumbiŋ jaŋeraonec.
Sâcmutâc papia ira ŋicwofuŋzi Judaŋic jaŋe sanaŋkerâ juju‐jeŋic ŋezickeniŋte mana‐jarewec. Erâ i sawa mâcne, mâreŋ dâkâne moc irec rune jaŋe Judaŋic râsi ejarehuc jopaniŋte fisipie okacne bazu‐jarehuc ŋokac naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârehuc mafa wiac‐jeŋic wâc jowac roniŋte mâmâc mana‐jarewec.
Wiac i ine ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero ere mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne forawec ira mosa namba 12, ʒâŋene Adari, irec gie bapa 13 ira hâcne iŋuc eniŋte mukicne.
Erâ sâcmutâc dâŋ qâreŋkekicne irec rehacne moc moc mâreŋ dâkâne forawec sâc ira râepie rame ŋic ŋokac wose‐jarepie mananiŋte mukicne. Ehame Judaŋic jaŋe ʒoaŋ ijaha wâc ʒawierâ râsifâc‐jeŋic okacne bazu‐jareniŋte mukicne.
Dâŋ iŋuc qâreŋke‐fârerâ becâsicko rara kiŋaŋŋic ŋicwofuŋte micte râec‐jopapie rambiŋ. Ehame sâcmutâc dâŋ i Susa hae qizecko ira wâc ŋic ŋokac mâmâc wose‐jarembiŋ.
Eme Morodekai e ŋicwofuŋ ŋaqi keŋkeŋne â qaŋqaŋ, erâ golzi eri hendiŋ bakicne â ŋaqi sahacne moc qoruc hahameŋne â âmuc âmucne i sasawa heme hume ŋicwofuŋte fickonec wahahame Susa hae qizec irec rune jaŋe ofac hecnehuc ʒeri bari embiŋ.
Judaŋic jaŋerao wama fuame ʒâŋe biŋehec erâ bubiaŋ manahuc ʒeri embiŋ hâcne.
Erâ mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne forawec â hae sâko ŋerawec sâc ira ŋicwofuŋte mumutâc â sâcmutâc fisime Judaŋic jaŋerao ʒeri bubiaŋ fuame hombaŋ ŋehuc tiwâ bâzi nâmbiŋ. Ehame mâreŋ irec ŋic ŋokac bocjaha jaŋe Judaŋic jaŋere hâwic‐jopame ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: Nâŋe Judaŋic jaha.
Ŋicwofuŋte mumutâc â sâcmutâc i mosa namba 12, ʒâŋene Adari irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 13 ira fârinehec eocte mukicne. Erâ ine Judaŋic râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋe Judaŋic bawahac‐jopahuc jopa qâʒâic ejareniŋte mukicne ʒoaŋ ira hâcne Judaŋic jaŋe râsifâc‐jeŋic bawahac‐jopahuc jopa qâʒâic ejareniŋte mana‐jarekicne.
Irec Judaŋic jaŋe ʒoaŋ ira hâcne ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero ere mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne forawec ira hae‐jeŋic sâc tumaŋnehuc râsifâc‐jeŋic jumbiŋ ŋic i jaŋe hâcne bâsirowec‐jopambiŋ. Iŋuc epie ŋic jaŋe hâwic‐jopame moczi moc mi sanaŋkembiŋ.
Ehame mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne irec ŋic fekicne erâ mâreŋ soŋaŋ â guriŋ bapa erâ ŋicwofuŋ kiafâc‐ticne jaŋe Morodekai ere boc hâwic‐jopame Judaŋic bafic‐jopambiŋ.
Morodekai e ŋicwofuŋte ficko ŋic tâpiri sâkohec juwecte ere boc manapie feme ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne haŋ bawec.
Iŋuc fuame Judaŋic jaŋe râsifâc‐jeŋic ʒikazi jopa qâhâmoc ejarehuc, juwicnao qaisoc‐jopambiŋ ŋic i jaŋe kosa qa imac ejarembiŋ hâcne.
Ehuc Susa hae qizecko ine ŋic 500 jopa miziembiŋ.
Erâ Hamedatare ŋokâ, Judaŋic jaŋere râsi qizec Hamaŋ hâcne, ere ŋokâfâc 10 kecʒiŋuc jaŋe wâc qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ: Parasandata, Dalafoŋ, Asipata, Porata, Adalia, Aridata, Pamasita, Arisai, Aridai erâ Wajeʒata. Judaŋic jaŋe iŋuc ehuc râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere mafa wiac ine sifu ro rauc mi embiŋ.

<range>
Eme Susa hae qizecko ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopakicne jaŋere ʒare i ʒoaŋ ijaha ŋicwofuŋ mufuacnembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie ŋicwofuŋzi ŋokac wofuŋ Esite kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Judaŋic jaŋe Susa hae qizecko ŋic 500 jopahuc Hamaŋ ŋokâfâc‐ticne 10 mâmâc qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ. Jaŋe ʒira iŋuc ehuc ine nore mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne forakac ira weniŋuc embiŋ? Erâ sifu go wiac irec me irec numu‐naretec mana‐garepemu.”
Iŋuc mume Esitezi muwec: “Ŋicwofuŋ, go manatec sâckekacko ine Susa haeo Judaŋic juŋgopieŋ jaŋe mana‐jaretec ʒoaŋ ʒirec sâcmutâc fokac irec sâc jaha tomâcko wiac enʒepieŋ. Ehuc wâc mana‐jaretec Hamaŋ ŋokâfâc‐ticne 10 bituac‐jopanʒepieŋ.”
Âzâcneme ŋicwofuŋzi iŋuc hâcne fuaocte mutâcnewec, ehame Hamaŋ ŋokâfâcne 10 bituac‐jopambiŋ.
Eme Judaŋic jaŋe mosa Adari irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 14 ira Susa haeo tumaŋnehuc ŋic 300 mocwâc qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ. Ehuc sifu mafa wiac‐jeŋic ine ro rauc moc mi embiŋ.
Judaŋic gâcne ŋicwofuŋte mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne forawec ira jumbiŋ jaŋe iŋuc jaha juju‐jeŋic ŋezickeniŋte tumaŋnembiŋ, ehuc qaisoc‐jopambiŋ ŋic i jaŋe okacne bazu‐jarehuc ŋic 75 tauseŋ qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ, mafa wiac‐jeŋic ine sifu ro rauc moc mi embiŋ.
Wiac i mosa Adari irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 13 ira ekicne; ʒoaŋ gie bapa 14 ira ine ŋemanarâ tiwâ bâzi nâhuc ʒeri bari embiŋ.
Judaŋic Susa haeo jumbiŋ jaŋe ine ʒoaŋ gie bapa 13 â 14 ira mâmâc qâturerâ ʒika gie bambiŋ. Erâ ʒoaŋ 15 ira ine ŋemanarâ tiwâ bâzi nâhuc ʒeri bari embiŋ.
Eme irec hâcne Judaŋic hae pitic sâc ʒoricko juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe mosa Adari irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 14 ira hombaŋ ŋerâ tiwâ bâzi nâ nareŋ gareŋ ehuc ʒeri bari eeŋgopieŋ.
Eme Morodekai e wiac fua‐fârewec irec dâŋ qâreŋke‐fârewec. Ehuc ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero ere mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne bembeŋko me ʒoricko forawec ira Judaŋic jumbiŋ jaŋerao papia râeme rafârewec.
E iŋuc ehuc Judaŋic jaŋe jarane jarane mosa Adari irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 14 â 15 ira hombaŋ ŋeniŋte mupaŋke‐jarewec.
Jaŋe mosa â ʒoaŋ gie bapa ira hâcne râsifâc‐jeŋic bawahac‐jopapie ʒâic busâqoc‐jeŋiczi ŋerisieme ʒeri bubiaŋ bâfuambiŋ, erâ ki busâqoc dameŋ‐jeŋic herisierâ hombaŋ dameŋ fua‐jarewec. Irec jaŋe ʒoaŋ ira tiwâ bâzi nâhuc ʒeri bari eniŋte â nânâ wiac biaŋne nâ nareŋ gareŋ ehuc hapetacfâc‐jeŋic wâc jare gumec eniŋte jazawec.
Judaŋic jaŋe Morodekaizi qâreŋke‐jarewec irec sâcko hombaŋ ŋembiŋ iŋuc jaha ʒuhuckerâ ŋerahuc juniŋte mupaŋkembiŋ.
Jaŋe Hamedata ŋokâ‐ticne, Judaŋic jaŋere râsi Agagi ŋic Hamaŋ, eki hâcne Judaŋic jopa sipiric ejarehuc bâsirowec‐jopaocte manasurâ ɋâsâi ʒâŋene Puri qawec irec iŋuc embiŋ.
Esitezi Hamaŋte fuŋne ŋicwofuŋ âzâcneme manarâ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mutâcnehuc qâreŋkewec: Hamaŋ e Judaŋic wiac repicne ejareocte manasu biric ewec i ŋerisierâ e jahacne faio fezejec, ehame e jahacne â ŋokâfâcne jaŋe mâmâc bibitua wâtuŋko bituac‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Eme Judaŋic jaŋe irec hâcne ɋâsâi ʒâŋene Puri irec manasuhuc hombaŋ‐jeŋicte ʒâŋe Purim hombaŋ mumbiŋ. Ehuc papiao dâŋ sasawa qâreŋkekicne fowec, erâ wiac sasawa fua‐jareme hone manac embiŋ irec erâ â jaŋe jaŋacne â ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic erâ bâjâpecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere erâ mâmâc hombaŋ i jarane jarane mumupaŋte sâcko â dameŋ mukicnao ŋeniŋte mupaŋkembiŋ wâc.
<range>
Ehuc mimiŋzi ɋâric fic sâc â hae sâc erâ mâreŋ sâc hombaŋ irec manasuhuc juhapie Judaŋic ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko Purim hombaŋzi mi sifuckeocte â ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe hombaŋ irec wâc manasuhuc juniŋte mâmâc mupaŋkembiŋ.
Eme ŋokac wofuŋ Esite, Abihaire otâ hâcne, eki Judaŋic Morodekaizi Purim hombaŋte papia namba 2 qâreŋkekicne fowec i basanaŋkeocte manacnehuc qâreŋkewec.
Ehuc wâc Ahasiwerore uucmaŋko mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne 127 ira Judaŋic sasawa jurambiŋ jaŋerao wama â dâŋ fâri qizecne fosanaŋkeocte papia râeme rawec.
I Morodekai â ŋokac wofuŋ Esite jahe mutâcne‐jarepire irec sâcko mecne, erâ jaŋe jaŋacne â ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere erâ sowa juju â ki busâqoc eere dameŋ mupaŋkembiŋ irec sâcko mâmâc Purim hombaŋ i dameŋ‐ticnao jaha ŋeniŋte mu bâmoc ejarehuc qâreŋke‐jarewec.
Ŋokac wofuŋ Esitere sâcmutâc dâŋ izi Purim hombaŋte dâŋ i basanaŋkewec hâcne. Erâ dâŋ i papiao wâc qâreŋkekicne fokac.
Ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero e mâreŋ rune â hâwecmecko ŋic jurambiŋ jaŋe sahac taha moneŋ râeniŋte mutâcne‐jarewec.
Â ŋicwofuŋ gie‐ticnere â tâpiri‐ticnere dâŋ, erâ Morodekai bafahareme ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec ewec irec binaŋ i furu jaha Mede â Perisia ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere Binaŋ Qâhâc papiao qâreŋkekicne fokac.
Morodekai e ŋicwofuŋ Ahasiwero ere mefâro juwec hâcne. Ehuc ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋerao juju hâmo fuarâ foocte giene bahuc juwec, erâ wamadâŋ sawa jazahuc juwec. Irec Judaŋic qomâfâc‐ticne sasawa jaŋe e sâsehuc manacnepie boc fejâmbâŋkewec.
Uzi mâreŋko ŋic moc juwec ʒâŋene Hiobe. E Anutu araŋ bacnehuc erao qohota sanaŋkewec, erâ bahac tâmiric â siocmâc juhuc sâqocne qikiŋnewec.
Ehame ŋokâfâcne 7 â otâfâcne jahec â moc fuarâ jucnembiŋ.
Â qowifâc‐ticne ine kecʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Lamafâc‐ticne 7 tauseŋ, kamelefâc‐ticne 3 tauseŋ, bulimakaofâc‐ticne ŋicne 1 tauseŋ â doŋgifâc‐ticne ŋokacne ine 500, iŋuc jumbiŋ. Ehame kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne guru sâko jucnehapie ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec ŋic gurune gurune jurambiŋ jaŋe siric‐jopa‐fârehuc ŋic ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec juwec.
Ŋokâfâc‐ticne jaŋe ine buc buc dameŋ‐jeŋic maickeme sâc tiwâ bâzi bâmockehuc hahac ɋa â seŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec nâniŋte hefârec‐jopa jumbieŋ.
Eme tiwâ bâzi nâpie tarame Hiobe e hae fufurecte faharerâ ŋokâ otâfâc‐ticne jaŋe bahac fâsâc eniŋte manasuhuc jaŋere erâ taha bâzi rike jujec. E ʒiŋuc muhuc iŋuc ejujec: “Ŋokâfâc‐nane jaŋe wiac i ehuc sâqocne bâfuarâ Anutu bunao bambieŋ mecne.” Hiobe e dameŋ sâc iŋuc hâcne ejujec.
Eme ʒoaŋ mocko aŋelo jaŋe Wofuŋte maio tumaŋnehapie Sataŋ e ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko mâmâc fisirâ domawec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Sataŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnewec: “Go wenirec warekomec?” Iŋuc wiocneme Sataŋzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “No mâreŋ sâc fotâcne‐fârehuc juku warekopac.”
Iŋuc mume Wofuŋzi Sataŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go iŋuc juhuc kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Hiobe e moc hone manac ecnemeŋ me? Manakic, mâreŋko ŋic e iŋucne moc mi juŋgopieŋ, e bahac tâmiric â siocmâc juhuc Anutu no araŋ banarerâ sâqocne qikiŋneekac.”
Iŋuc mume Sataŋzi Wofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, Hiobe e go araŋ mâc mi bagareekac.
Goki e jahacne â ŋokac naru motecfâcne erâ wiac focnekac sasawa i ŋezic‐jopa‐fâreekic, ehuc wiac ebac eekac sâc i jambuŋketec fua biaŋ efâreha lama bulimakaofâc‐ticne sawe mâririackeeŋgopieŋte iŋuc eekac.
Irec no ʒiŋuc gazakopac: Go wiac focnekac sasawa i jâoc rofâretec acmâc jaha sâwecgurâ behecguocmu.”
Iŋuc mume Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Sâcne, wiac focnekac sâc i gore meo râe‐fârekopac, irec iŋuc me iŋuc ecnezo murâ ecnec, mâc sahac‐ticne ine mi bâuazemec.” Iŋuc âzâcneme Sataŋ e Wofuŋ beherâ rawec.
Eme ʒoaŋ mocko Hiobere ŋokâ otâfâc jaŋe hahac‐jeŋicte ficko tiwâ bâzi nâhuc ŋembiŋ.
Ŋehapie kiŋaŋŋic moczi Hioberao fisirâ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Bulimakaofâcge ŋicne jaŋe gieo mâreŋ bâfâuckehuc jumbieŋ â doŋgifâcge jaŋe ŋifecnao sopâc nâhuc domambieŋ.
Ehame Sabaŋic jaŋe ututuŋ jaha râsi fisirâ kiŋaŋŋicfâcge ʒikazi qâhâmoc‐jopahuc doŋgi bulimakao ʒeŋgoma ro bacjopa rambiŋ. Eme no buc wiserâ biŋe gazapemurâ warekopac.”
E dâŋ muha muha izia kiŋaŋ motec moczi fisirâ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Anuturaonec ɋuŋ parandaŋ sâko heha bâbâriczi waha lamafâcge â soŋaŋfâc‐jeŋic ʒâhâmoc‐jopame no buc wiserâ biŋe gazapemurâ warekopac.”
Eme e dâŋ mi mutaraha kiŋaŋ motec moczi fisirâ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Kaldea ŋic guru jahec â moc jaŋe fisirâ kiŋaŋŋicfâcge ʒikazi qâhâmoc‐jopahuc kamelefâcge amec‐jopa rambieŋ. Eme no buc wiserâ biŋe gazapemurâ warekopac.”
E dâŋ muha muha izia kiŋaŋ motec moczi fisirâ Hiobe dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋokâ otâfâcge jaŋe hahac‐jeŋicte ficko nânâ opâ nâhuc ŋembieŋ.
Ŋehapie mi mâreŋ sawaonec mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋneheczi fisirâ fic ro bafaharerâ beheme waharâ qanʒaŋnehuc qâhâmoc‐jopa‐fârezejec i. Eme no buc wiserâ biŋe gazapemurâ warekopac.”
Iŋuc mume Hiobe e faharerâ busâqoc manahuc ŋaqi‐ticne bâsuckewec. Ehuc qizec‐ticne ʒafe ruacnerâ mâreŋko hetutuckerâ fowec.
Ehuc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “No neŋgoc bumaŋkonec metariŋ fuapo, irec hâmorâ metariŋ jaha rapemu, Wofuŋzi narewec, Wofuŋzia nowac rokac, irec Wofuŋte ʒâŋe muteŋkekopac.”
Hiobe e wiac iŋuc fuacneme Anutu mana sâqorecnehuc bahac moc mi bâfuawec.
Eme ʒoaŋ mocko aŋelo jaŋe Wofuŋte maio mocwâc tumaŋnehapie Sataŋ e ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko mâmâc fisirâ Wofuŋte maio domawec wâc.
Eme Wofuŋzi Sataŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnewec: “Go wenirec warekomec?” Iŋuc wiocneme Sataŋ e dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “No mâreŋ sâc fotâcne‐fârehuc juku warekopac.”
Iŋuc mume Wofuŋzi Sataŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go iŋuc juhuc kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Hiobe moc hone manac ecnemeŋ? Manakic, mâreŋko ŋic e iŋucne moc mi juŋgopieŋ, e bahac tâmiric â siocmâc juhuc Anutu no araŋ banarehuc sâqocne qikiŋneekac. Go e fuŋne tâmiricko sipirickecmurâ esoc qafeŋ enaretec mana‐garepo; ehame eki ine sifu norao qohotahuc juekac.”
Sataŋzi ine Wofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, ŋic moc e juju‐ticne ŋezickeocte wiac‐ticne sasawa qikiŋne‐fâreocmu.
Irec go sahac‐ticne bâuatec acmâc jaha sâwecgurâ behecguocmu.”
Sataŋ e iŋuc mume Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Sâcne, no e gore meo râekopac, go wiac iŋuc me iŋuc ecnezo murâ ecnec, mâc juju‐ticne ine mi jâoc rozemec.”
Eme Sataŋ e Wofuŋ beherâ ra Hiobe wicwakoc bâfuacneme sahac‐ticne sâcke‐fârewec.
Ehame ʒafeo ŋehuctecne bac hahacdaczi wicsâŋiŋ hegâkoŋkewec.
Iŋuc ehuc ŋeha ŋonâŋ‐ticnezi âzâcne muwec: “Hâc, go wiac fua‐garekac i mana‐bipiehuc Anuturao qohotakomec? Go e sâweckerâ hâmoc me!”
Hiobezi ine dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go ŋokac mutucne jaŋe dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ irec sâc mukomec. Anutuzi wiac biaŋne tahac‐nâfome bubiaŋ faio ro amec ehuc jupec, eme ʒi eraonec jaha wiac ʒâʒâicne ware‐nâcteme qikiŋnepere sâckeocmu me?” Hiobezi ʒâic sâko manahuc sifu Anutu dâŋ babahacne moc mi âzâcnewec.
Hiobere âgofâc jahec â moc kecʒiŋuc jaŋe jumbiŋ: Temaŋŋic Elifaʒi, Suhiŋic Bilidadi erâ Namati ŋic Zofari. Jaŋe Hiobezi ʒâic serereŋ manahuc ŋekac, biŋe iŋuc manarâ e iqickehuc hone manac ecneniŋte mumockembiŋ.
Erâ jaŋe ra fisirâ taic domahuc Hiobe honerâ mi ʒâŋitambiŋ. Ʒâhec ine ʒâŋitarâ kio wâuŋa ehuc ŋaqi‐jeŋic bâsuckerâ busâqoc sâko manahuc ʒafe ruambiŋ.
Iŋuc erâ mâreŋko waha qâterâ ŋehapie ŋafe ʒoaŋ 7 tarawec. Ehame Hiobe e ʒâic serereŋ sâko manawecte ehec dâŋ wiac muc manac moc mi embiŋ.
Eme juku Hiobe e fuŋkerâ mu huacbuc ehuc fufua dameŋ‐ticne sâweckewec.
Ehuc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec:
“Fufua dameŋ‐nane i sâwecte biŋe ezejec, â neŋgoc‐nanezi fuŋkerâ kiwecnuwec ŋafe i wâc iŋuc jaha.
O Anutu, go mutec ʒoaŋ i dapâc ezejec, ehuc ʒoaŋ irec mocwâc mi manasuzemec, â tatamacge sakarecnezemec.
Go mutec ʒoaŋ i ŋaferâ dapâc siŋsiŋ ezejec, ehame karoraczi fuarâ ʒoaŋ sâockezejec.
Go mutec ŋafe ira dapâc qisiric fuazejec, erâ ŋafe i ʒoaŋ gie bapa birionec bârâriezemec, ehame mosare birio wâc omaezejec.
Ŋafe ira ɋâric mocwâc mi fuapie ʒeri fânâŋ tâmiric fohuc juzejec.
Qaŋgec bapa mujaretec ʒoaŋ i sâweckenʒepieŋ, oâ sâko ʒâŋene Lewiataŋ suruckepie momori eekac jaŋe iŋuc hâcne enʒepieŋ.
Go mutec bâpiŋ sâkozi mocwâc mi tamaezejec, ehame ŋafe ira hae mocwâc mi furezejec.
Ŋafe izi neŋgoc‐nanere bumaŋkonec fuapemurâ aka mi hehuc ʒâic busâqoc maŋko râecnuwecte sâweckezo wâc.
“No wemocte neŋgoc bumaŋko mi hâmopo, me fuarâ izia wemocte mi omaepo?
Neŋgoc‐nanezi wemocte qicnuwec, â wemocte moŋ gumecnuwec?
No dameŋ ira hâmozapo muzac ʒiŋuczia ʒâŋeruŋko fomanazapo.
Ŋicwofuŋ â babaficfâc‐jeŋic hae sesuc heɋârehuc bâpiaŋkembiŋ jaŋehec fozapo hâcne.
Me ŋic fekicne ficjeŋic gol â siliwazi hefusembiŋ jaŋe iŋucne fozapo.
Me naru motec hâmocne fuaeŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc wemocte mi fuapo?
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ʒâŋe ʒâŋeruŋko hâcne gie‐jeŋic hetaraeŋgopieŋ, â betaŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ira fomanaeŋgopieŋ.
Kâpâcwâru ŋic jaŋe ira hâcne âke mâteŋ‐jopaekac, ehame soŋaŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere owa fânâŋ mocwâc mi manaeŋgopieŋ.
Ira hâcne kâcɋene mecne piticne mecne mâmâc fomanaeŋgopieŋ, â kiŋaŋ qaqa jaŋe bomboŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere meo mocwâc mi jueŋgopieŋ.
“Kihuhuŋ‐jopaekac jaŋe Anutuzi wemocte tatamac bâfua‐jareekac, a busâqoc manahuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe wemocte juju tahac‐jopaekac?
Jaŋe hâmocte woŋec juipieeŋgopieŋ, ehuc moneŋ mafare mâcne, ʒâŋeruŋte manapie fefene eekac,
Jaŋe ʒâŋeruŋko huniŋte boc ejareekac, eme ira fohuctecne ʒeri sâko bâfuaeŋgopieŋ.
Anutu e wemocte ʒâhec juju‐jeŋicte fuŋne hesoŋke‐jarehuc hata‐jeŋic sasawa hebâzicke‐jareekac?
Mu huacbuc‐nane izi nânâ‐nane eekac, â kio huse ee‐nanezi ine opâ sâro iŋucne wahaekac.
Hâhâwic bâfua‐nareekac wiac sasawa izi fai‐naneo fefâreekac.
No wama faio mâcne, sisi hâhâŋ faio juekopac, ehame ʒârâ hâriŋ wiaczi moc mi behecnuekac.”
Hiobe e iŋuc mume Temaŋŋic Elifaʒizi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec:
“No dâŋ tâmiric ʒuhuckerâ sâcne mi ŋepemu, irec ʒi dâŋ mupe manatec mi sâqoreoc.
Manakic, go ŋic bocjaha dâŋ jaza qazuc ehuc jumeŋ, ehuc docke betaŋ ekicne jaŋe basanaŋ‐jopameŋ.
Go ŋic fâfâc‐jopaha dopec‐jopahuc jumeŋ, â ɋarac ɋarac qahapie mu keteŋ ejaremeŋ.
Ʒi ine ʒâic busâqoc wiaczi go gahacne maicguha, bipic tatara egareme maŋge omaezo ekac.
Go Anutu araŋ bacneekic izi mi bâmiriŋguekac? Me tiŋne jujugezi mamanac juju mi bâfua‐gareekac me?
“Go mana honec: Ŋic bahacmâc moczi moc sipirickewec? Me ŋic tiŋne moczi moc hâmo sipiric ewec me?
No ʒiŋuc manaekopac: Ŋic moczi sâqocnere gie baocmu e irec fârine juku ijaha roocmu.
Ŋic sâqocne jaŋe Anuture micrombâŋzi sipiric‐jopaocmu, â kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋzi ʒâseŋ‐jopaocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe laioŋ iŋucne owackeeŋgopieŋ, Anutuzi ine bâniniŋ‐jopahuc micsiec‐jeŋic qazuekac.
Laioŋ jaŋe qowi tâmiric juhuc hâmo sipiric eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc ijaha ehapie naru motecfâc‐jeŋic siŋsaŋ qaeŋgopieŋ.
“Dameŋ mocko biŋedâŋ moc kamierâ hazec‐naneo hume dâŋ saŋucne sawa manapo.
I ŋafeo guŋko wiac hone manac eeŋgopeneŋ iŋuc tinac fuame honerâ guŋ ɋâri jupo.
Ehuc fâfârerâ ɋarac ɋarac qapo, â me kike‐nane jâjâwâckewec.
Ehame sawa sâqocnezi nowarume sahac‐nanezi araraŋ kiwec.
Eme no wiac moc ŋic hawari tinac domaha honepo, erâ hone dendeŋnehuc sifu mi hone tarapo. Ehame fic hae tiŋbenoŋ fuarâ foha dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc fuame manapo:
‘Ŋic moczi moc Anuture maio tiŋke biaŋ erâ sâcne juocmu? Me ŋic moczi moc bâbâfua‐ticnere maŋfuŋko maŋɋaɋac erâ sâcne domaocmu me?
Anutu e sambâŋko kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mi manasiŋ‐jopaekac, erâ wâc aŋelofâc‐ticne jaŋere maname wawahane eekac.
E iŋuc eekaczi wemocko mâreŋŋic me mâreŋkonec wiac gâcne kikezi ââtenʒaŋkene i moc manasiŋ‐jopaocmu.
Ŋic moc e furicte sâcne juocmu mecne erâ ine hae mi ŋafeha ututuŋ jaha hâmoocmu.
Ehame wiac focnekac sasawa i rofâreniŋmu; eme ŋic e fuŋne weniŋucte hâmokopac i kâuc bahuc hâmoocmu hâcne.’
“Ajoc, Hiobe, go wira owa ec! Eme moczi moc okacne bâtikie‐gareocmu me mâcne i honezemec. Go aŋelo e me e wira wâwâsic sâcne ecnecmu me?
Ŋic mutucne e kimbeŋ aaric‐ticnezi sipirickeekac, â mamana tara‐ticne tâmiric e maŋʒoc‐ticnezi qâhâmoekac.
No ŋic mutucne moc e eebapa‐ticnezi gâtâne bame honehape izia fic hae‐ticne ʒaŋkerâ sesuctac fuarâ fowec.
Naru motecfâcne jaŋe juju hâmo basaeŋgopieŋ, ehame dâŋgieo moczi moc dâŋjeŋic mi dopeckeekac.
Gie‐ticnao nânâ fârine fuame nânâre hâmoeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe fisirâ ro nâc eniŋmu, ehuc fâpâ ʒârâ âke ropierâ roniŋmu wâc.
Manakic, wiac hehesicnezi giegaŋko mi fuaekac, â sisipiriczi mâreŋ maŋkonec wâc mi wefuekac, erâ mafare andac eeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe moneŋ mafa wiac‐ticne roniŋte ʒoɋac eniŋmu.
Ʒoc uucnezi iiŋnerâ sawao feekac iŋuc jaha ŋiczi sisipiric bâfuaocte maŋne domaekac.
“Manakic, no go muzac ine Anuturao rarâ fuŋne‐nane mufuacnezapo.
Eki hâcne wiac qeŋ bipinehec baekac i ŋiczi mi mana taraeŋgopeneŋ, e mâsi sâko wowosene tâmiric bahuc juekac hâcne.
Eki mume mâreŋko hoe heekac, erâ ekizia wâc mume opâzi giegaŋ‐nâŋec bâgunuckeekac.
Eki waha qaqane jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe bafaharec‐jopaekac, erâ busâqochec jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe bubiaŋ qajareekac.
Eeatuc ŋic jaŋere dâŋ hetâtieme gie bapie fârimâc eekac.
E maŋfânâŋhec jaŋere eeatuc dâŋ bârisieme bitiŋ erâ kicjopaekac, ehame mamana biri‐jeŋic biac omaekac.
Jaŋe ʒoaŋ ɋaɋacko sifu dapâcko tinac jueŋgopieŋ, â guŋpiticko sifu ŋafeo tinac basac qasac raeŋgopieŋ.
Anutu eki ine bekâ mâsiŋ jaŋe ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere ʒikare micko fenʒipiŋte ŋezic‐jopaekac, â qarâ suriŋne jaŋe tâpirihec jaŋere meonec batarac‐jopaekac.
E iŋuc ehuc ro waha âte ejarekicne jaŋerao jujure mamanac bâfuaekac, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere mic bâbâzickeekac.
“Anutu e ŋic moctao bâbâtiŋ gie bame ŋic ere manape ʒerine eocmu, irec go qa bâtiŋ egareme manatec mi sâqorezejec.
Anutu e ʒâpâ nâpoekaczi mocwâc ʒure foŋ enâreekac wâc, â meticnezi bâʒâic‐nâporâ mocwâc bâmâteŋ‐nâpoekac.
E dameŋ sâc sisipirickonec bataracguocmu.
Roroc fuame hâmozicte hone maiŋ egarehuc ʒika dameŋko dede sâsâoc egareocmu wâc.
Anutu e kisâfâcge jaŋere ʒikadâŋte sabecguocmu, erâ sisipiricte ŋezicgume mi hâwicguocmu.
Bâbâʒâic me roroc fua‐gareme manatec mi quŋkezejec, â qowi mimicne jaŋere wâc mi hâwicguzejec.
Mâreŋ qânâ tâmiricko gie he sarac ecmu, ehame qowi mimicne jaŋe âgo egareniŋmu.
Iŋuc fuame ficbozegao juhâc qâhâmocmu, ehuc lamafâcge furu jaha juhapie hone soŋaŋ ejarecmu.
Ɋâricfâcge jaŋe bocjaha fua raniŋmu, â apa ŋosafâcge jaŋe sopâc kecɋaŋ iŋucne sawe mâririackeniŋmu.
Padizi dameŋ ʒora gieo domaku woze qeuc eme qa roro eeŋgopieŋ, eme go irec sâc jaha dameŋ ʒora juhâc qâhâmohuc ŋicqizec jâmbâŋ erâ hâmozemec.
Manakic, wiac fua‐nâreme hone manac eeŋgopeneŋ irec fuŋne mana taranaŋte dameŋ ʒora mamana gie bawefuhuc jumbeŋ. Irec dâŋ muwarepac i fârine jâmbâŋ, go mana maŋ ehuc mana biaŋkezemec.”
Elifaʒi e dâŋ iŋuc mume Hiobezi kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec:
“Jei, ʒârâ â busâqoc‐nane i ŋemâc bâbâfuare sâcko râenʒapiŋ me!
Iŋuc epie muzac hâwecmecko moŋgeŋ fokac irec ŋemâc i sirickezac. No irec hâcne dâŋ mupe sifuckejec.
Anutu bapafâre e tepe motec‐ticnezi murucnuwec, eme irec ʒâiczi sahac‐nane siricke‐fâreha maŋnanezi omaezo ekac. Anuturaonec wiac hâhâwicnezi ʒuʒuhuc jaha fai‐naneo fekac hâcne.
Doŋgi jaŋe kecɋaŋ nâhuc manapie taraekac, â bulimakao jaŋe sopâc nâhuc mi owackeeŋgopieŋ.
Mozi nânâ wiac aŋac tâmiric hâwec mi hehuc sâcne nâocmu? Me qâqâc hândâŋ âpâunere mozi maname aŋacne eocmu?
No wiac mamakâcne iŋucne mi nâekopac me nânâ wiac gâcne sasawa nârâ wâc mamaŋucne enareekac.
“Hâc, Anutu e nunumu‐nane wemocte mi manaekac, â nunumu‐nanere fârine wâc wemocte mi bâfua‐nareekac?
Anutu e qâhâmocnuzac, ehuc juju‐nane nowac rozac me!
E iŋuc enareme muzac no ʒâic sâko mana‐bipiehuc ʒeri bari erâ kiwac qawac ezapo. Anutu e tirine i manakopac, irec no dâŋticne moc mi bâsuepo.
No wemo tâpiri moc fonarekacte ʒuhuckerâ jupemu? Me wemo juju biaŋne moc fua‐nareocte woŋec jupemu?
No qânâzi bacnukicne me? Me sahac‐nane i aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bakicne me?
No mocwâc biaŋkepemurâ tâpiri basakopac, erâ ira me ira rarâ babafic moc bâbâfua irec hatane basakopac wâc.
“Ŋic moc e maŋticne omaeha Anutu mocwâc mi manasiŋkeocmu, iŋuc ehame âgofâc‐ticne jaŋe sifu iqickerâ mu keteŋ ecnenʒepieŋ.
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋe ine opâ sâkozi hoe tâmiricko qaŋeŋne qahuc pitiwaekac irec sâc erâ eatucnuŋgopieŋ.
Opâ sâko jaŋe hoe dameŋko ɋiɋicne fisieŋgopieŋ, ʒoaŋ dameŋko ine fâre wahahuc ʒicke kereŋ eeŋgopieŋ.
<range>
Âbârâ ŋic jaŋe opâ bâfuaniŋte babasa gie baku qâsorierâ mâreŋ sawao hâmo sipiric eeŋgopieŋ.
Tema â Seba haeonec âbârâ ŋic jaŋe opâre fifisacne fieŋgopieŋ.
Erâ raku opâo fisirâ basahuc bipic tatara ejareekac.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no honec‐ŋopape opâ sâkozi eekac irec sâc eŋgopieŋ tinac ekac. Ŋoŋe norao wiac hâhâwicne fuakac i honerâ bipic tatara eŋarekac hâcne.
‘Ŋoŋe taha wiac moc nareniŋ.’ Me ‘Moneŋ mafa‐ŋeŋic gâcnezi baficnupie ʒuhuckerâ juzapo.’ No iŋuc moc ŋazapo me?
Me ‘Ŋoŋe râsi‐nanere meonec bataracnuniŋ,’ iŋuc moc ŋazapo me? Me ‘Bâʒâicnueŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋere niŋgiŋkonec firuecnuniŋ,’ iŋuc moc mupo me?
“Sâcne, ŋoŋe bahac moc wena bâfuapo i mutaniŋkeniŋ, eme no niniŋkerâ dâŋŋeŋicte hazec râepemu.
Ŋic tiŋne moczi dâŋ mume manape fârine eocmu, ŋoŋe ine mu tutuc enarepie manape fâri tâmiric ekac.
No maŋnane omaeha dâŋ mupe ŋoŋe manapie racne ekac, ehame ine wemocte dâŋnanere okacne bârisieŋgopieŋ?
Ŋoŋe bekâ mâsiŋ juŋgopieŋ jaŋere ɋâsâi qahuc tofa babazure behec‐jopaniŋmu, ehuc âgo fuŋfuŋfâc‐ŋeŋic wâc moneŋte erâ qikiŋ‐jopaniŋmu.
“Ʒi ine hone dendeŋnuniŋ, no ŋoŋere maio burec moc mi epemu.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ kosa mumbieŋ i tarakac, mocwâc ʒuhuckerâ mi muhasickeniŋ, no dâŋ fârine muhape, maŋgâŋ dâŋ mocwâc mi munareniŋ.
Ŋoŋe nore ʒiŋuc manaŋgopieŋ hâcne: E burec ekac, ehuc tiŋne â hehesic i sâcne mi mana râwiŋ‐jofakac.
“Ŋiczi mâreŋko ʒâic gie sâko bahuc jueŋgopeneŋ, juju dameŋ‐nâŋec i kiŋaŋ qaqa jaŋere juju dameŋ irec sâc.
Kiŋaŋ qaqazi jâcmumucko ŋeocte ecneekac â gieŋiczi gie furire woŋec juekac.
Eme no irec sâc jaha ehuc mosane mosane bibiaŋte woŋec maŋgâŋ juekopac, ehame ŋafe sâc ʒâic busâqoc fua‐nareekac.
No waha guŋ fohuc ʒiŋuc muekopac: ‘Hae fureme faharezapo me!’ no risimbiŋne qahuc hae fureocte enareekac hâcne.
Umbeŋ â wânâŋzi sahac‐nane sâcke‐fâreekac, wicnane somieekac, izi mi ʒoraha pupucnerâ mocwâc fâuckeekac.
Wiac âsu biaŋ moc mana manahapene izia rârâŋneekac irec sâc jaha bibiaŋ dameŋ‐nane nowaru‐fâreekac.
“O Anutu, juju‐nane i nokafe sawa, go irec manasuc, juju biaŋ‐nane i biac omaekac.
Go ʒiŋuczia jupe honecnuekiczi juku mocwâc mi honecnucmu, go norao ʒâŋe fihuc juhaŋtec jaha omaepemu.
Karoraczi tâtierâ omaeekac irec sâc jaha omaerâ hâmoc haeo huocmuzi mocwâc mi wefuocmu.
E ficticnao mocwâc mi risieocmu, â ehec jumbiŋ jaŋe ine ere nikec‐jopaocmu.
“No irec hâcne niniŋkerâ dâŋemâc mi ŋepemu, buʒâiczi ɋârâŋkehuc maŋnane kidapeha dâŋ muzepac, ehuc maŋnanezi mana gâpârehuc muheŋɋâŋ ezepac.
No hâwecte oâ sâko iŋucne irec kâpâcwâru bacnukomec me?
No tâpiri ropemurâ waha fomanaekopac, ehuc ʒiŋuc muekopac: ‘Fomanahape ʒâic‐nane mâteŋkezejec!’
No iŋuc muhape goki maŋʒâŋe‐nane bâtikietec wiac hâhâwicne hone manac ehuc bipic‐nane taraekac.
Iŋuc fua‐nareme bituazore enareekac, ehuc ʒâic busâqoc sâko manahuc hâmozo muekopac.
No mâreŋko ʒuhuckerâ jujure takicnukac, juju‐nane i nokafe sawa, irec go behecnuzemec.
Ŋic e wemo macticnere manacnetec boc fefene eekac? Â wemo‐ticnere manasucnehuc hone maiŋ ecneekic?
Go furic sâc ŋic hone soŋaŋ ejareekic, ehuc eesâicko râec‐jopaekic.
Go dameŋ bembeŋne mac moc behecnutec no buc juhuc maŋnane mocwâc fuazac me.
Go fekicne jukicte no iŋucnezi sâqocne bahuc wemocko moc bawahacguzapo. Go wemocte ma âkendâŋnuhuc tepe motecge norao qâtâcnetec wareekac? Wemocte nore manatec tagi sâkoge tinac epe hetaracnukomec?
Go qaqatara‐nane bârâriehuc kiŋ bahac‐nane wemocte mi bâtâmire‐narekomec? No ʒiŋuczia hâcne ʒâŋeruŋko hurâ fopemu, eme omaehape mocwâc mi bâfuacnucmu.”
