Hiobe e iŋuc mume Suhiŋic Bilidadizi dâŋ okacne kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec:
“Micgaonec dâŋ racne sasawa wahakac i mo dameŋko moc behecmu?
Manakic, Anutu e wiac sâctiri moc mi eekac, erâ dâŋ tiŋne i moc mi muhasickeekac.
Otâ ŋokâfâcge jaŋe sâqocne bahuc Anutu bunao bapie juju bapa‐jeŋicte sâcko okacne bazu‐jarewec hâcne.
Irec go Anutu bapafâre e wira wâwâsic ecnehuc aki anonoc egareocte numucnezemec.
Go iŋuc ehuc maŋɋaɋachec â siocmâc juhaŋtec Anutuzi mocwâc maicgurâ hone soŋaŋ egarehuc go â wiacfâcge ŋoŋe juju biaŋ tahac‐ŋopaocmu.
Anutu e iŋuc egarehuc mafa mâriri mârâc fogarewec irec sâc sirickehuc tahacguocmu.
“Ŋic mârâc jumbiŋ jaŋe maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ mujumbieŋ irec mu gufuc ec, ehuc mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe weniŋuc mana tarambiŋ i hone manazemec.
Nâŋâc ɋâricne fuambeneŋ tinac ekacte wiac moc mi manaeŋgopeneŋ, juju dameŋ‐nâŋec i owâ ririŋte nâkumuc fuaekac iŋucne.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec mârâc jumbiŋ jaŋere dâŋ honec, ehuc jaŋe weniŋuc mujumbieŋ i mana tarazemec.
“Hehembaŋ i opâ sohoŋ tâmiricko sâcne mi fuaekacte mâreŋ kereŋnao mi bâfuaeŋgopeneŋ.
Opâzi ʒicke kereŋ eme wiac i soka sanaŋ mi ehuc ɋaŋa ururuc eha hetâcnerâ wiac i me i bapane mi eekac.
Anuture nikec‐jopaekac ŋic i jaŋe hehembaŋte sâc, jaŋe Anutu râpeckerâ jujure woworic mocwâc mi bâfuaniŋmu.
Jaŋe bameŋte qâruruo roweckepie tâcneocmu, â ŋaferuŋ mucko basanaŋkezo muhuc bâtâcneniŋmu.
Jaŋe ficjeŋic ʒaŋkekicne ira roweckepie rândiŋkeocmu me dopeckezo epie sifu ŋenʒaŋnerâ waha qaocmu.
Ŋic hehesicne jaŋe, hoezi hofâ qinʒiŋ tâpiri jareme fua sokac erâ hae mâreŋ sâcke‐fâreeŋgopieŋ irec sâc.
Gâtâ‐jeŋiczi qânâ râreckehuc basanaŋkeekac, erâ sachawecko raʒic wefuc ehuc qiŋ herâ domaekac.
Eme ŋiczi unucke behec epene dodoma tacticne sawa foocmu.
Manakic, ŋic hehesicne e irec sâc hâcne, e omaeme jujutac‐ticnao ŋic moczi fuarâ juocmu.
“Erâ manac: Anutu ŋic bahacmâc mi behec‐jopaocmu, â ŋic hehesicne jaŋe wâc mi bafic‐jopaocmu.
E micge baafeckeme gâgâwi faio jucmu, ehame nameŋ bipicgao ʒeridâŋzi sasawa fohuc juzejec.
Eme qaisocgueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mimi bâfua‐jareocmu â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere fic hae bâsiroweocmu.”
Bilidadizi iŋuc âzâcneme Hiobe e dâŋ okacne kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec:
“Eha, dâŋ mukomec i mârâc jaha mana‐fârepo; mâc ine ŋiczi weniŋuc erâ Anuture maio bahac fâsâc domaocmu?
Me ŋiczi Anutuhec dâŋ mu qaqatarac sâcne eocmu? Aricne, e Anutuzi wiocneme arecne wâŋ tauseŋ eocmuo ine okacne mocjaha mac bâtikiecneocte eipieocmu.
Manakic, Anutu e maŋɋârâŋ â tâpiri sâkohec juekac, irec ŋic moczi sanaŋkerâ maŋbâiŋ sâcne mi ecneocmu.
E tiki ututuŋ jaha bârâriec‐jopaekac, ehuc aaricko bâsirowec‐jopaekac.
Anutuzi mume homeŋ bame mâreŋzi ɋiɋiteckeekac, erâ mâreŋte ŋesiŋ i wâc qiriŋ qaekac.
Anutu e ʒoaŋ aka hecneme mi wefuocmu, â bâpiŋ hecke‐jareme mi tamaeniŋmu.
E moczi moc bafickeha sambâŋ mi qaratiewec, erâ temboŋzi huhuckerâ feha fainao âte sanaŋkehuc rawec. Eki hâcne bâpiŋ bâfuac‐jopahuc kecʒiŋuc jaŋe wâc râec‐jopawec:
Raru, demeŋ ɋafâc, rowaŋ qosac erâ juwic mâreŋte bâpiŋ wiac.
E wiac qeŋ bipinehec, ŋiczi mi mamana tarane â mâsi wiac wowosene tâmiric baekac.
Manakic, Anutu e nowarume mi ʒâŋitaekopac, me fâre niniŋkehuc rame mi hone taraekopac wâc.
E wiac i me i nâwoc rozo mume mozi aka hecneocmu? Me mozi ʒiŋuc moc wiocneocmu: ‘Go wemo wiac ekomec?’
“Anuture aariczi biac mi omaekac, e râsifâc‐ticne jaŋe Rahaba oâ sâkozi maŋbâiŋ ecneha bafickembiŋte bâsirowec‐jopawec.
Anuture fuŋne iŋuc fohame no weniŋuc erâ dâŋ okacne sâcne bâtikiecnepemu?
No bahacmâc juipiehuc dâŋ okacne bâtikiecnepemurâ eipiekopac, irec e mumutara‐nane jukacte mana‐nareocte numucnezo sawa manasukopac.
No ere maio fuapemurâ mana‐narezac mecne, erâ ine sifu dâŋnanere hazec mi mecne râezac.
Eki hâcne mume fuŋne tâmiricko wiac hâhâwicnezi fuarâ sipiricnuekac.
E nokafe hezipore aka henareekac, ehuc wiac enareekac sasawa izi mamana sâqoc sawa bâfua‐nareekac.
No sanaŋkerâ Anutu ʒoɋac sâcne ecnepemu? Me dâŋgieo râezo mupe mozi sâcne ecneme raocmu?
No nahac bahacmâc â siocmâc juekopac, erâ ine sifu dâŋ mupe sâqoreekac. No kiŋ tâmiric juekopac, erâ ine sifu Anutuzi mana‐nareme kiŋhec jukopac tinac eekac.
No bahacmâc juekopac, erâ ine juju‐nanere manape fârine mi eekac, irec no ʒuhuckerâ juzore takicnukac.
Juju biaŋne me sâqocne i erao fuŋne mocjaha efâreekac, irec no ʒiŋuc mukopac: E ŋic bahacmâc â sindaŋne mâmâc bâsirowec‐jopaekac.
Ŋic bahacmâc moc e wiac hâhâwicne fuacneme ututuŋ jaha hâmome Anutuzi hâhâwic‐ticnere erâ gâwiecneocmu.
Anutu e mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ i ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere meo râewec fokac, ehuc mumutara ŋic ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ bacjopawec. Me Anutuzi wiac i mi ewecko ine mo ŋiczi ewec?
“Ŋiczi gasackeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc ʒoaŋ gie bapa‐nanezi gasackehuc juju biaŋ moc mi bâbâfua‐nare mâc nowarueŋgopieŋ.
Â juju dameŋ‐nane i woke marojâczi bakicnere gasackehuc raekac irec sâc beraŋnea gasackehuc ratâmireekac. Pizu pizuzi qâqâc motecne honerâ tara wahaekac irec sâc hâcne.
No ʒâic‐nanere nikecnuocte ʒeri bubiaŋ hawari bâfuarâ dâŋ gâgâwi ezepac.
No iŋuc muhape jaha ʒâic busâqoc‐nanezi mocwâc maicnume ʒiŋuc manaekopac: Anutu e nore maname kiŋhec ekac.
Anutu e nore maname iŋuc ekacte no wemocte tiŋke biaŋ epemurâ maŋgâŋ giene bapemu?
Sâqocne‐nane fokac i saifezi ʒure bâtâmirec eene mi ekac.
Me eene muzac ine Anutu e sifu sohoŋ dodocko tuŋnume huzapo, eme ŋaqi qoruc‐nane ɋaɋacne i mocwâc babajune mi ezac.
Anutu e ŋic muzac ine dâŋ okacne sâcne bâtikiecnezapo, ehame dâŋgie bahuc dâŋnâhec mufâsâezapec.
Ʒi ine ŋicŋondeŋ‐nâhec moc mi jukacte moczi moc Anutu â no dâŋnâhec sâcne mi mutara‐nâcteocmu.
Anutu e ʒuhuckerâ mocwâc mi bâtiŋnuzejec, e norao wiac hâhâwicne bârârieme omaezejec.
E iŋuc eme no maŋnanere fuŋne manakopacte ere hâhâwic mi bajuhuc dâŋnane sâcne mupemu.
“No ʒuhuckerâ juzore takicnukac, irec mu heŋɋâŋ dâŋnane i manabâc tâmiric mufuapemu, erâ buʒâiczi maŋnane bâumbeŋkeha dâŋ mupemu.
Ehuc Anutu dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnepemu: Go mi behecnuc, erâ fuŋne weniŋucte mana‐naretec sâqorekac i nazac.
Bâʒâicnukomec i manatec biaŋkekac me? Me go gahacne mezi wiac bâfuameŋ i qaisockehuc ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere juju hone ʒiziweckomec i wâc manatec sâckekac me?
Me ŋiczi wiac hone manac eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc sawa hone manac eekic me?
Mâreŋŋic nâŋere juju dameŋ fokac irec sâc jaha gore juju dameŋ wâc fokac me?
Iŋuc mi fokacko ine wemocte kiŋ bahac‐nane moc bâfuacmurâ babasa gie bakomec, ehuc sâqocne‐nanere fuŋne bajaŋgeŋkecmurâ ʒoɋac ekomec?
No kiŋ bahac tâmiric jukopac, erâ moczi moc gore meonec sâcne mi bataracnuocmu i go mana‐jâmbâŋkekomec.
Go gahacne mezi bâfuacnumeŋ, erâ ine me izia bâsirowecnuzo ekomec.
Go mâreŋ qâhâckerâ bâfuacnumeŋ i moc manasunʒaŋ me! Me mocwâc gâc wândoc epemurâ mukomec me?
Go mamac‐nanezi bâfuacnuocte tâpiri râcnemeŋ, erâ gokizia wâc mana‐narehaŋ neŋgoc‐nanere bumaŋko fua sokac epo.
Go hâcne sahac biuchec bâfuacnumeŋ, ehuc siec â rua râec‐jofahuc sahac‐nane basanaŋkemeŋ.
Go maŋjauŋ enarehuc juju tahacnumeŋ, erâ wâc ehâmo‐naretec biaŋne juwarepo.
Ʒi ine kecʒiŋuc mana tarakopac: Go wiac i fuŋnehec enare warehuc jumeŋ.
Go nore ʒiŋuc manasumeŋ: E sâqocne baocmu me mâcne, iŋuc muhuc hone jâjâpecnuhuc jumeŋ; i sâqocne‐nane mi bâtâmirecmurâ iŋuc hâcne emeŋ.
No sâqocne bape izia mana‐naretec bahacnehec eekac, ŋifec ine wiac biaŋne ebac epe sifu manatec sâqoreekac. Irec no mana hâtâwehuc mimiekopac.
No wiac i me i ebac epe biaŋke‐bipieha sifu laioŋ momori iŋucne erâ jâpecnuekic, erâ i sawa mâcne, go sipiricnucmurâ mâsi wiac fuŋne fuŋne baekic.
Go dameŋ sâc ŋiczi musâqorecnuniŋte fânoc hejareekic, ehame nore erâ aaricgezi ɋârâŋkeme kisâfâc‐nane ɋâricne mocwâc bâfuac‐jopaekic.
“Go wemocte mana‐naretec neŋgoc bumaŋkonec fuapo? No ŋiczi moc mi honecnuhapie biac hâmozapo me!
No neŋgoc bumaŋkonec fuarâ izia ʒâŋeruŋko huzapo me! Eme mi fuapo irec sâc eme muzac biaŋkezac.
Mâreŋko juju dameŋ‐nane i biac qosackezo ekac, irec go behecnutec piticne mac juhâmorâ hâmozepac.
No dameŋ mi ʒoraha hae mâreŋ dapâc qisiricko â hâmocte nâkumucko rarâ mocwâc mi risie‐jâmbâŋkepemu.
Hae mâreŋ ira duŋdapâc qisiric â wiac gâgâpâcne foha tatamaczi omaeme dapâczi dapâc jaha fohuc juekac.”
Hiobe e iŋuc mume Namati ŋic Zofarizi dâŋ okacne kecʒiŋuc muhuc bâtikiecnewec:
“Go mumusifuc dâŋ bocjaha mukomec irec okacne mi bâtikie‐garehuc wemocko mâc râepene foocmu. Me ŋic moczi dâŋ racne bocjaha murakume dâŋticne fârine moc eocmu me?
Go dâŋ kosa wosekomec izi sâcne bâniniŋ‐nâpoocmu me? Me mu âke sisic boc etecne sâcne mi qatara‐garenaŋmu me?
Go kecʒiŋuc hâcne mukomec: ‘No dâŋ mukopac i fârine sasawa, erâ Anuture maio bahac fâsâc domakopac wâc.’
Ojai, Anutu e jahac dâŋ okacne bâtikie‐garezac me! Ehuc e jahacne miczi dâŋ gazame sâckezac.
Wiac bocjaha ŋiczi mi mamana tarane fokacte eki maŋɋârâŋ ʒâkâŋnehec irec fuŋne gazazac me! Eme go fuŋnege ʒiŋuc mana taranʒaŋ: Anutu e kiŋge fokac irec sâcko mâcne, baafeckehuc bâtiŋguekac hâcne.
“Anuture tâpiri â biŋe rara‐ticne i qeŋ bipinehec, Go irec fuŋne sâcne hone mana tarac ecmu me?
Karoraczi Anutu aka sâcne mi hecneocmu, goki ine ira fezore quŋke sâqoreocmu. Anutu e hâmoc haere fuŋne manaekac, goki ine kâuc baekic.
Anuture biŋe rara biaŋ i mâreŋ qaŋeŋne sâcke‐fârerâ raekac, â hâwec sâko sirickeekac wâc.
Anutuzi fisirâ dâŋgieo râecguha mozi aka moc hecneocmu?
Anutu e ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere fuŋne manaekac, ehuc eebapa‐jeŋic sâqocne honeekac wâc.
Kâte doŋgi ŋokacne moczi motecne rome ŋic hawari roocmu dameŋ ira ŋic mutucne jaŋe wâc mamanahec eniŋmu.
“O Hiobe, go maŋge bârisiec, erâ mege Anuturao sicnehuc numuzemec.
Go wiac sâqocne megao fokacko behetec raoc, eme wiac sindaŋnezi ficgao mi fozejec.
Go iŋuc erâ mimi tâmiric qac firic jaha sâcne jucmu, ehuc hâhâwic tâmiric juhuc wama faio sanaŋkerâ juzemec.
Rumizi fâre wahaekac irec sâc jaha ʒârâ ʒâpâ fâre wahaocmu, ehame ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio jumeŋ irec nikecguocmu.
Iŋuc fuame gorao dapâczi herisieme tatamac eocmu, ehuc jujugezi ʒoaŋ tatamac irec sâc jâuruocmu.
Eme go wama faio juhuc Anuturao rowecketec eki ŋezicgume juhâc qâhâmocmu.
Ehuc râsi jaŋere hâhâwic mocwâc mi bajucmu, ehame ŋic ŋokac bocjaha jaŋe bafic‐jopacmurâ numu‐gareniŋmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine wiseniŋte hata basarâ fifisacne fihuc maŋjeŋic gâckeocmu, jaŋe hâmoczi rocjopaocte irec mamana sawa juniŋmu hâcne.”
Eme Hiobezi dâŋ okacne kecʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarewec:
“Jâmbomac, ŋoŋe ŋic sasawa jaŋere mic mecne, irec ŋoŋe juku hâmopie maŋɋârâŋzi ŋoŋehec mâmâc omaeocmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no ŋoŋere sâc mamanahec jaha juekopac, no ŋoŋere wahamicne aricne; ŋoŋe dâŋ muŋgopieŋ i mozi moc kâuc baekac?
No ŋic tiŋne â bahac fâsâc juekopac, erâ ine âgofâc‐nane ŋoŋe sifu âke sisic enarehuc gâgâwi enareŋgopieŋ. Noni hâcne Anutu numucnepe mana‐nare jujec.
Ŋoŋe ʒârâ ʒâpâ tâmiric jueŋgopieŋzi no qaisocnuhuc mu ruruc enareŋgopieŋ, erâ no biac rândiŋkezo ehape waha qazejec muhuc tuŋnuŋgopieŋ.
Fiuc roro â miti tâmiric jaŋe ine tâpiri‐jeŋicte manapie Anutu‐jeŋic eha wama faio jueŋgopieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe qowi jaŋe wio‐jarepie ŋaza qazuc eniŋmu, me sawa wipe jaŋe wio‐jarepie ŋazaniŋmu jaha.
Ŋoŋe mâreŋ qowi mecne, hâwec qowi mecne mu wioc ejarepie maŋɋârâŋte fuŋne ŋaza qazuc eniŋmu wâc.
Anutuzi wiac sasawa bâfuac‐jopa‐fârewec i jaŋe kâuc mi baŋgopieŋ.
Anutuzi hâcne wiac jujune sasawa hone soŋaŋ ejareekac, â ŋic nâŋâc ʒeŋgoma ere tâpirio jufâreeŋgopeneŋ.
Nânâ i aŋacnehec me aŋac tâmiric muhuc nâhoneeŋgopeneŋ, irec sâc jaha hazec‐nâŋeczi dâŋ manarâ mana wosâc enʒepeneŋ.
Ŋicraŋɋa jaŋe maŋɋârâŋhec â ŋicqizec jaŋe mamana tarahec.
“Anutu e ine maŋɋârâŋ â tâpiri rune, e hâcne mamanasu â mamana tara‐ticnehec.
Eki fic moc hetâtieme mozi heɋârerâ baocmu? Me ŋic moc kâpâcwâru bahame mozi bataraocmu?
Eki hoe aka hecneme opâ jaŋe kereŋke‐fâreniŋmu, erâ ekizia wâc mume rumi fisirâ mâreŋ qofackehuc âke dumeocmu.
Anutu e tâpiri â sasanaŋ‐ticnehec, eeatuc ŋic â ŋic eatuc‐jopakicne jaŋe mâmâc ere rurumaŋko juŋgopieŋ.
E ŋic fekicne jaŋere maŋɋârâŋ qame wahaekac, â mumutara ŋic maŋmutuc bacjopaekac.
E ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe eri ŋeŋe‐jeŋickonec tuŋjoparâ kâpâcwâru bacjopaekac.
E taha bapa ŋic ŋaqi qoruc hetara‐jareekac â ŋic tâpirihec bawahac‐jopaekac.
E dâŋ mumu ŋic bâniniŋ‐jopaekac, â ŋicraŋɋa maŋɋârâŋ jowac roekac.
E ŋic qac momori jaŋere faio aaric‐ticne hoŋkeme feekac, â mâreŋte guriŋ bapa jaŋere tâpiri wâc qame wahaekac.
E wiac soŋsoŋko fokac i hewirickeekac, â duŋdapâc qisiric fokac ira tatamac‐ticne bâfuaekac.
E ŋic gurune gurune basawec‐jopahuc basanaŋ‐jopaekac, erâ ekizia wâc bawahac‐jopahuc bâsirowec‐jopaekac.
E guriŋ bapafâc‐jeŋic mutuc bacjopaekac, ehuc maŋ bâsifuc ejareme qac qâsoric ehuc jueŋgopieŋ.
Iŋuc ejareme dapâcko babarâ juhuc biric boroc erâ maŋjeŋic omaeekac.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe wiac sasawa muŋgopieŋ i ʒâŋe fâri‐nanezi hone‐fârepo, â hazec‐nanezi mana‐fârerâ mana tarapo.
Ŋoŋe mamana foŋarekac sâc ijaha wâc no fonarekac, no ŋoŋere wahamicne mi jukopac.
No ŋoŋe dâŋ ŋazapemurâ mâcne, bapafâre rune dâŋ âzâcnepemurâ manasukopac, no Anutuhec dâŋgie bapemurâ enarekac hâcne.
Ŋoŋe maŋmutuc‐ŋeŋicte fuŋne taniŋkezacte burecdâŋzi foŋkeeŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe dota mutucne jaŋe ŋic bâpiaŋ‐jopaniŋte eipieeŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc.
Jâi, ŋoŋe niniŋkerâ jupie muzac mana‐ŋarepe maŋɋârâŋhec juŋgopieŋ ezac.
Ŋicbureŋ, ŋoŋe hazec râehapie fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋke‐ŋarepe, ehuc dâŋ okacne bâtikie‐ŋarepe mana‐hâmoniŋ.
Ŋoŋe burecdâŋ muŋgopieŋ i Anuture erâ muŋgopieŋ me? Me ere dâŋ basanaŋkeniŋte sioc eŋgopieŋ me?
Ŋoŋe dâŋgieo e bafickehuc dâŋticne dopeckeniŋte muŋgopieŋ me?
Anutuzi fuŋne‐ŋeŋic bataniŋkehuc mana‐ŋareme biaŋkeocmu me? Me ŋic eatuc‐jopaeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc ŋoŋe Anutu sâcne eatuckeniŋmu?
Nâŋe Anuture dâŋ dopeckeŋgopeneŋ, ŋoŋe burec iŋuc ehuc qoricnuniŋmuo ine eki fuŋne‐ŋeŋic bataniŋke‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.
Iŋuc eŋareme tâpiri‐ticnere bipic tatara eŋareocmu, ehuc ere hâwic‐ŋopaocmu.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ muŋgopieŋ i racne sasawa, erâ dâŋ okacne bâtikie‐nareŋgopieŋ i fâri tâmiric jaha.
“Ŋoŋe niniŋkehuc mana‐narehapie dâŋnane muzepac, eme irec okacne wiac i me i fua‐narezo murâ fua‐narezejec.
No upe‐nane wiwiticko sicnehuc juju‐nane qikiŋ nezo ʒawiekopac.
No juju biaŋnere woworic‐nane fârimâc ekac, irec Anutuzi qâhâmocnuzo murâ qâhâmocnuzejec, erâ no sifu ere maio fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkezepac.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ere maio fuaniŋte hâwic‐jopaekac, no ine hâbihec erâ fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkecnepe akicnuocmu mecne.
Ŋoŋe hazec râehapie fuŋne‐nane muɋaɋacke‐ŋarepe aimuŋ jaha mana‐hâmonʒepieŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no Anuturao fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkehuc ʒiŋuc manapaŋkepemu: Anutu e dâŋnane dopeckeocmu.
O Anutu, go dâŋgieo râecnuzo mukomec me? Go iŋuc etec no niniŋkerâ omaezore afeckepemu.
Mocjaha, go wiac jajahec jahere numu‐garepe mana‐naretec gore hâwicnume mi soŋkepemu.
Go mocwâc mi bâʒâicnuc, erâ wiac hâhâwicne fai‐naneo râetec ferâ mocwâc mi sipiricnuzejec.
O Anutu, go fuŋkerâ dâŋ mutec okacne bâtikie‐garepemu, me manatec mi sâckeme ine noni fuŋkerâ mupe goki okacne bâtikie‐narezemec.
Kiŋ bahac‐nane wezimuc fokac, erâ wemo hehesicne moc bâfuapo i nazatec manape.
Go wemocte honecnutec râsige tinac ehape ʒâŋe maige bâsoŋke‐narekomec?
No mâŋâŋzi rehac ficne sueme raekac irec sâc juhape hâhâwic henarezo ekic me? Erâ sopâc hahaŋkekicne irec sâc ehape ficne suecnuzo mukomec me?
Go bâbâtiŋ hâhâwicne fai‐naneo râetec fekac, ehuc ɋie‐naneo wiac ebac epo irec okacne wâc mâmâc bazu‐narekomec.
Go kike‐nane jâc fifitacko râekomec, ehuc hata rahape ruc banarehuc kike hata‐nane hetâcnekomec.
Go iŋuc enaretec no jâczi semune ehuc gârecke ʒaŋ eekac irec sâc jaha ekopac, â wâfu qoʒazaŋzi ŋaqi qoruc nanʒaŋnepie ʒaŋkeekac, irec sâc jaha ʒaŋkekopac.
“Ŋic ŋokackonec fuaeŋgopeneŋ nâŋâc juju dameŋ‐nâŋec bembeŋne â neneŋ gie‐ticnehec.
Nâŋâc ʒariŋ ârizi fuarâ ŋeindaŋnehuc mocwâc mârâŋkeekac, erâ nâkumuczi ʒoraha hae ŋafeme biac omaeekac irec sâc eeŋgopeneŋ hâcne.
Eme no irec sâc jaha juhape go honecnu‐bipiehuc dâŋgieo râecnuzo mukomec me?
Ŋic wâwânâŋhec jaŋeraonec ŋic wâwânâŋ tâmiriczi sâcne fufuane me? Aric kereŋne jâmbâŋ!
Go ŋic juju dameŋ‐nâŋecte ʒâfo bahuc mosa dameŋ‐nâŋec biac mupaŋkemeŋ, erâ i jâurunʒipeŋte aka henâremeŋ wâc.
Irec go behecnurâ norao ʒâŋe mocwâc mi fizemec, eme no wama faio kiŋaŋ qaqa gie bahuc juju dameŋ‐nanere ʒeri bubiaŋ manazepac.
“Jâc moc qapene mocwâc gitec hezo murâ heocmu mecne.
Jâc tucne â gâtâne i mâreŋmaŋko hâmozo eha
opâ ruacnepene mocwâc gitec herâ jâc ɋâricne iŋucne soka sanaŋ eocmu.
Ŋiczi ine irec sâc aricne, e hâmome taraekac, e iŋuc me iŋuc mocwâc mi eocmu.
Dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira opâ jaŋe ʒicke‐fâreniŋmu â hâwec sâkozi wâc kereŋkeocmu.
Hâmokicne jaŋe mocwâc mi fahareniŋmu, jaŋe qânikiŋzi fosanaŋkeha mocwâc mi ɋâre‐jâmbâŋkeniŋmu, aricne, jaŋe guŋsanaŋ fohapie moczi moc mi wiwic‐jopaocmu.
Go hâmoc haeo ɋâricne soŋnucmurâ enarekac, eme no ira soŋkerâ juhape aaricge fâre wahazejec, ehame nore manasuhuc ʒâfo moc bacmu i maickezejec.
Ŋic hâmoocmuzi mocwâc sâcne ɋârerâ risieocmu me? Iŋuc eene moc fome muzac no ʒârâ ʒâpâ dameŋ ʒi omaeme dameŋ biaŋne moc fua‐nareocte woŋec juzapo.
Eme go dameŋ ira wira‐naretec dâŋ okacne bâtikie‐garezapo, ehame meqâreŋge no honecnucmurâ egarezac.
Ehuc juju bapa‐nane mocwâc soŋaŋkehuc sâqocne‐nanere nikecguzac.
Erâ go sâqocne‐nane bârârie‐narehuc bâtâmirenʒaŋ, ehuc hehesic‐nane sasawa i wâc bârârâŋnenʒaŋ.
“Manakic, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira tiki jaŋe fâuckerâ ʒaŋkeniŋmu, â haroŋaŋ jaŋe ŋerârieniŋmu.
Opâzi qânâ âeckekume pitiwaekac, â hoe micsâkozi mâreŋ wokemaŋne jowa‐fâreekac irec sâc jaha goki ŋicte woworic qatec wahaekac.
Go ŋic tâpiri‐ticne bawaharâ behetec ratâmireekac â hawari‐ticne hetikiehuc maigaonec bârârie sanaŋkeekic.
E mi manaha ŋokâfâcne jaŋe ʒâŋe biŋehec eeŋgopieŋ, erâ wâc mi manaha mocwâc omae‐jareekac.
E jahacne sahacte sawa ʒâic manaekac, ehuc e jahacnerea ki busâqoc eekac.”
Eme Temaŋŋic Elifaʒi e Hiobe dâŋ okacne kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec:
“O Hiobe, go dâŋ mukomec i racne â fârimâc sasawa.
Manakic, go dâŋ wosekomec i ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi mi mumune, erâ juju bapa‐ticne i dâŋ racne keciŋucnezi wâc mi dopeckeocmu.
Go ŋic jaŋe Anutu araŋ bacnehuc juhapie aka hejarekomec, ehuc numucnehapie wâc hecke‐jarekomec.
Go maŋgezi mumu hehec egareha dâŋ keci mukomec, ehuc burecŋic jaŋere dâŋ hawari ehuc fuŋnege hesoŋkekic.
Irec noni mâcne, go gahacne dâŋzi dâŋgieo râecguhuc mugâpâre‐gareocmu.
“Goki fuŋkerâ mâreŋko jumeŋ me? Me go fuarâ juhaŋtec Anutuzi tiki bâfua‐fârewec me?
Me Anutuzi wiac mana biric ewec i goki moc hone manac emeŋ me? Me maŋɋârâŋhec juju i go buc jukic me?
Manakic, goki wiac manakomec i nâŋe manaeŋgopeneŋ wâc, erâ go mamana tara fogarekac sâc ijaha nâŋe wâc fonârekac.
Maŋɋârâŋ qazu‐nârekicne i gore mamaczi mi fuarâ juha ŋic jaŋɋâŋhec jumbiŋ jaŋe hâcne nâzâ qazuc epie manambeŋ.
Anutuzi mu bâmiriŋ egarezo mume wemocte qikiŋ nekomec? Â dâŋ wama ruaine irec manatec wemocte fâri tâmiric ekac?
Go wemocte buge taŋtaŋ âeckeha ʒâŋe bâbâroŋ honec‐nâpokomec?
Erâ wemocte Anutu aaric manacnehuc dâŋ keciŋucne bocjaha wose rakomec?
Ŋic ŋokackonec fuakicnezi jâmbomac bahac fâsâc moc juocmu me? Me Anuture maio kiŋ tâmiric moc domaocmu me?
Manakic, Anutu e aŋelofâc‐ticne jaŋerao mi fohoreweekac erâ sambâŋte ŋecjucfâc jaŋere wâc maname mi sâcke‐hâmoekac.
Ehame ŋic sindaŋne â mamakâcne e wiac hehesicne i nânâ opâ iŋucne gapec tâmiric nâ bac eekaczi wemocko bahac fâsâc erâ kiŋ tâmiric juocmu.
“O Hiobe, go manahaŋtec dâŋ moc gaza mutâc epe, ehuc wiac hone manac epo irec binaŋ bagarepe.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋeraonec dâŋ fârine manambiŋ i moc mi hesoŋkehuc mu qazuc enarembiŋ.
Jaŋe mâreŋ‐jeŋicko ŋic jabane moc mi jumbiŋte mozi moc eatuc‐jopame Anutu râpeckenʒapiŋ.
Ŋic sindaŋnezi ŋic âgofâc‐ticne bâʒâic‐jopaocmu e mâreŋko jufeocmu sâc hâhâwic bajuocmu.
Wiac hâhâwicnere fânâŋzi hazec‐ticnao huocmu, erâ wama faio sâcne mac jukopac muhame ʒikaŋiczi fisicneocmu.
E ʒikare biŋe ekopac muhuc hâmoc wisecneocte maname quŋkeocmu.
E nânâ wena moc bâfuape muhuc koŋkoŋkehuc juekac, ehuc ʒiŋuc manapaŋkeekac: No sisipiricte biŋe hâcne.
Ehuc ŋicwofuŋ moczi ʒikao raocte ʒawiehuc juekac, irec sâc sisipiriczi nore woŋec foha hâhâwic faio hume serereŋ juekopac.
Ŋic moc e Anutu bapafâre râsi ecnehuc maŋbâiŋ ecneocmu e wiac iŋuc hâcne fuacneocmu.
Ŋic iŋucnezi pepec ehuc maro‐ticne he bâfeŋnerâ kiwaehuc Anutuhec juju gie baocte ʒoɋac eekac.
E ʒâŋe mai‐ticnao wokemaŋ ruaekac erâ nânâ âmbâŋ nâhuc biuc wokemaŋ sâkohec eekac.
Ŋic eki hâcne hae ima bakicne i ro rauc ewec, â fic ʒocte biŋe qahuc behekicne ira ŋec juc ewec, irec ine fic hae i ʒikazi imackeocmu.
Ŋic iŋucnezi mafa mâriri sâkohec mi eocmu, erâ wiac focnekac i fofo sanaŋ fohuc fua sawec wâc mi eocmu.
E dapâc wisecne‐bipieocmu, ehuc jâc moc ʒoczi ʒahuc tieŋ taeŋne ʒâtâmireekac, me mâŋâŋzi âri‐ticne ficne sueme ratâmireekac irec sâc eocmu.
E mutuc erâ wiac sisirowenao roweckeocmu ine irec fârine wiac sisirowene jaha fuacneocmu.
Ehame dameŋ‐ticne mi taraha jâczi ururuckerâ mocwâc mi fieekac irec sâc jaha eocmu.
E waiŋ qaŋeŋnezi hândâŋ‐ticne woze qeuc mi ehuc mâtâckeekac, me oliwa jâczi ârickerâ qasawa eekac irec sâc.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ɋâric tâmiric juku omaeniŋmu â fic hae‐jeŋic hotâ moneŋzi bakicne i ʒoczi ʒâseŋke‐fâreocmu.
Ŋic iŋucne jaŋe sisipiric fuaocte mamana gie bahuc hehesic bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, ehame eeatuczi maŋjeŋic fusucmarâ foekac.”
Elifaʒizi dâŋ iŋuc âzâcneme Hiobezi dâŋ okacne kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec
“No dâŋ keciŋucne mârâc jaha biac mana‐fârepo, ŋoŋe ine mu bâmiriŋ enarezo muhuc mâc bâʒâicnuŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ racne muŋgopieŋ i wezimucko moc beheniŋmu? Me wemo wiaczi maŋbâiŋ eŋareha dâŋ keciŋucne sasawa boc bâtikie‐nareŋgopieŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no ŋoŋere sâc jurâ muzac ine ŋoŋe dâŋ mufâreŋgopieŋ ijaha wâc muzo murâ muzapo. Erâ dâŋ muŋgopieŋ irec qâtâc heŋarehuc dâŋ wokemaŋ bocjaha eŋare raku dâŋŋeŋic qazo murâ qazapo.
Erâ ŋifec ine dâŋ ŋazahuc hâbi sâcne qazu‐ŋarezapo, ehuc dâŋ murahuc jaha bâmiriŋ‐ŋopazapo wâc.
“Eme ʒi dâŋ i me i mupe ʒâic‐nanezi sifu mi behecnuocmu, â niniŋkerâ dâŋemâc ŋehuc wâc mi afeckepemu.
Anutu e tâpiri‐nane bâomaewec, ehuc otâ ŋokâfâc‐nane qâhâmoc‐jopawec.
E râsi enarehuc ro basanaŋ enarewec, irec sahac‐nane waha‐fâreme siec sawa ekopac, â ŋic jaŋe honecnupie kiŋhec jukopac tinac ekac.
Anutu e nore aaric manahuc bâsuc qâsucnuekac, erâ mic kizu‐narehuc ʒâŋe bâbâroŋ honecnuekac.
Ŋic jaŋe mu ruruc enareeŋgopieŋ, erâ orâŋnu‐fârehuc me tatapezi mauc‐naneo nueŋgopieŋ.
Anutuzi ŋic sindaŋne jaŋerao qikiŋnuwec, â ŋic hehesicne jaŋere meo râecnuwec.
No wama faio juhâmopo, ehame Anutuzi ine upe‐naneo rocnurâ qa tutuŋ enarehuc qanʒaŋnuwec. E tepe motec‐ticnezi murucnuocte ma âkendâŋnuwec.
E orâŋ bârâŋ enarehuc tepe motec qâtâcneme sahac‐nane kimârâŋkehuc sipiricke‐fâreekac.
E ʒuʒuhuc jaha ʒâpâ nume soc ruahuc foekopac, e momori ŋic jaŋe râsifâc‐jeŋic jopaeŋgopieŋ irec sâc enareekac hâcne.
No makuc barâ mateŋ qonaŋkerâ jukopac, erâ tâpiri‐nane omaeme ʒafe ruarâ ŋekopac.
No kio wâwâsic epe ʒâŋe mai‐nane bâruŋkewec, â ʒâŋe hâpi‐nane siwiŋnerâ kitutuckewec.
Erâ no wiac sindaŋne moc mi bâfuapo, â Anuturao nunumu i maŋɋaɋac juhuc numuekopac.
“O mâreŋ, go wiac gâgâpâcne maŋgâŋ enarekicne i mi hesoŋkezemec, â dâŋnane mutiŋneniŋte kio wâwâsic egarepe mi bâniniŋnuzemec.
Manaŋgopieŋ, sambâŋko mumutiŋ ŋic moc jukac eki hâcne baficnuhuc dâŋnane mutiŋne‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.
No âgofâc‐nane jaŋe sâke kiki enarehapie Anutuzi ʒâŋeuc‐nane honehuc nunumu‐nane manaocte mukopac.
Ŋic moczi âgo‐ticne bafickehuc dâŋgieo dâŋticne dopeckeekac, irec sâc moczi moc Anuture maio nore dâŋ dopeckeocte enarekac.
No jara‐nane afecne sawa fokac, i tarame hata rapemu irecnec mocwâc ririsiene mi fokac.
“No juju dameŋ‐nane biac qosackekac, erâ maŋnane wâc omaekac, ehame ʒâŋeruŋzi sawa woŋec‐nane fokac.
Ŋic jaŋe rârec bârârec mu ruruc enareeŋgopieŋ, ehuc mu âke sisic enarepie honec‐jopaekopac.
“O Anutu, no siocmâc jukopacte dâŋnanere kiwiric nowac roc, moczi moc dâŋnane sâcne mi dopeckeocmu.
Go gahac maŋ mamanasu‐jeŋicte motâc hemeŋ, irec gokizia aka hejaretec jaŋe sowine huc ʒâic fuacnekac, iŋuc munarehuc bubiaŋ mi mananʒepieŋ.
Muqâqiŋ dâŋnâŋec moc ʒiŋuc fokac: Ŋic moczi âgofâc‐ticne moneŋte erâ doc bacjopaocmuo ine naru motecfâcne jaŋe ʒârâ hâriŋ faio feniŋmu.
“Eme ŋic jaŋe muqâqiŋ dâŋ irec manasuhuc mu ruruc enareeŋgopieŋ, ehuc ʒâŋe mai‐naneo tâfecnueŋgopieŋ.
No ʒâic busâqoc faio juhuc ʒâŋe hâpoc tinac ekopac, â me kike‐nane wâc sisiŋ ekac.
Irec tiŋne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe honecnupie hâhâwicne eekopac, â ŋic bahac fâsâc jaŋe nore ŋic hehesicne muhuc mana sâqore‐nareeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe hata‐jeŋic paŋʒâic jaha bâjâpeeŋgopieŋ, erâ bahacmâc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe sanaŋ qaŋqaŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
Ajoc, ŋoŋe ʒeŋgoma harierâ dâŋŋeŋic mocwâc muzo murâ muniŋ, ehame no sifu ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec moc mi bâfuapemu.
Juju dameŋ‐nane biac wise tâmirewec, mamana biri‐nane i fâri tâmiric ewec â woworic‐nane wâc omaewec.
Âgofâc‐nane jaŋe ʒiŋuc nazaŋgopieŋ: ‘Dapâczi herisieme tatamac ekac, irec go tatamaczi maicguzo ekac,’ no ine sifu dapâcko jaha ŋekopac.
No hâmoc haere sawa mamanac jukopac, no ira hâcne hurâ dapâczi foŋnuha fopemu.
Ehuc ʒâŋeruŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnepemu: ‘Go hâcne mamac‐nane,’ â umbeŋzi nâcnuniŋmu jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazapemu: ‘Ŋoŋe hâcne neŋgoc seŋfâc‐nane.’
Ehame woworic‐nane wena moc fua‐nareocmu? Me mozi moc honerâ nowatuocmu?
No hâmoc haeo huhape jujure woworic‐nanezi mocwâc mi bâjâpecnuocmu.”
Eme Suhiŋic Bilidadi e Hiobe dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec:
“O Hiobe, ŋic go iŋucne jaŋe niniŋkerâ dâŋemâc moc sâcne mi ŋeniŋmu me? Go dâŋ moc beherâ hazec râehaŋtec dâŋ gazanʒapeŋ me!
Go wemocte nâŋere manatec bulimakao jaŋere sâc mutuc matacne eŋgopeneŋ tinac ekac?
Manakic, go gahacne aariczi bâʒâicgukac. Me mâreŋzi gore erâ tuhutac sâcne fuarâ foocmu? Me tiki jaŋe gore jâmbâŋ erâ moc ŋerârieniŋmu me?
“Ŋic sindaŋnere ʒoc tatamac bâhâponiŋmu, eme mocwâc mi bâruŋkeocmu.
Ficboze‐ticnao tatamaczi herisieme dapâc eocmu, â lambe‐ticne domakac i ficne hâponiŋmu.
E âte sanaŋkeweczi âte qindoc ekac, â e jahacne dâŋzi bitiŋ ecneha raʒime kikac.
E jahacne kikezi ecneme rândiŋkerâ uficko jowakac, erâ wâc kike‐ticnezia fâreme nombâŋko hukac.
E bitiŋzi kike‐ticne rorâ basanaŋkekac.
E wiwitic soŋsoŋko râekicne i bâfuame rokac, â hatagâŋ‐ticnao nombâŋ ropie hukac.
E hata raekac sâc wiac hâhâwicnezi orâŋ bârâŋ ecnehuc kikeo kikeo ecneekac.
E moneŋ mafa sâko focneweczi nânâre hâmo sipiric ekac, â sisipiriczi rârec bârârec woŋec‐ticne fokac.
Wic ukicneheczi sahac‐ticne sâcke‐fâreme me kike‐ticne gârecke ʒaŋ ekac.
E ficboze‐ticnao juhâmoweckonec fâre ferâ ŋicwofuŋ moc ʒâŋene Hâmoc ere maŋfuŋko râeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ ficboze‐ticne opâsic â saifezi ʒure emasaŋ epie ŋic furune jaŋe ira ŋec juc eniŋmu.
Mâreŋmaŋko gâtâ‐ticne kereŋkeme hâmokac â tieŋ taeŋnezi ɋaŋa ururuc ekac.
Ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnezi bembeŋko mecne ʒoricko mecne rârâŋne‐fârekac, ehame ŋic moczi moc ere mocwâc mi manasukac.
E ŋic ŋondeŋkonec tuŋkepie raocmu, â tatamac‐ticne sârockepie dapâcko huocmu.
E ɋâricfâc‐ticne moc mi fuarâ juniŋmu, â fic hae‐ticnao ʒâŋetucfâc‐ticne wâc omaeniŋmu.
Ʒoaŋ wewefunao me huhunao jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe biŋe‐ticne manarâ gâgâmârâhuc bipic tatara ejareocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe iŋuc hâcne fua‐jareocmu, jaŋe Anutu tatara ecneeŋgopieŋte wiac iŋuc hâcne fua‐jareme omae‐fâreniŋmu.”
Bilidadi e iŋuc mume Hiobezi dâŋ okacne kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec:
“Ŋoŋe dâŋ nazahuc bâʒâicnuŋgopieŋ i wezimucko moc beheniŋmu?
Ŋoŋe mu ruruc enarekupie arec 10 ekac, ehuc musoriŋnuniŋte sifu mi mimieŋgopieŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no wiac hehesicne moc bâfuape muzac ine bahac i no nahacne biŋe ezac.
Ŋoŋe ŋaŋacne ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: ‘Nâŋe e sirickerâ biaŋne juŋgopeneŋ,’ iŋuc muhuc ʒârâ ʒâpâ‐nanere manapie bahac‐nanere okacne ekac.
Wiac ʒi Anutuzi maŋgâŋ bâfua‐narewec, e bitiŋ râe‐nareme kicnuocte iŋuc ewec i ŋoŋe mi honeŋgopieŋ me?
No bâbâʒâic‐ticnere manape mi sâckeha owacke‐bipieekopac, erâ dâŋnane mutiŋneocte wira wâwâsic ecnepe arictac eekac.
Anutuzi hata‐nane hebâzickeme razore quŋkekopac, erâ wâc ekizia mume hatagâŋ‐naneo dapâc fuarâ fokac.
E moneŋ mafa‐nane nowac rofârewec, ehuc ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane wâc bawahame rârâŋnewec.
E râpe‐naneo â mai‐naneo rârec bârârec enarehuc nukac, erâ jâc fârehuc unuckeeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc jaha mamanac‐nane unuckerâ behecnume betaŋkerâ hâmozo ekopac.
Anutuzi nore aarickeme kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋ tuŋke‐narekac, ehuc, râsi‐nane sâqoc qaqocne muhuc mana wahacnukac.
E momorifâc‐ticne jaŋe râsi enareniŋte sorec‐jopame ficboze‐nane râreckehuc teuŋ âterâ somâcnuŋgopieŋ.
“Anutu e qomâfâc‐nane ejareme râpecnurâ taic juŋgopieŋ; â hone manac enare jumbieŋ jaŋe mana‐narepie ŋic furune tinac ekopac.
Soctofafâc‐nane â âgofâc‐nane jaŋe behecnu‐fârembiŋ.
Iqicnurâ ficnaneo ŋeŋe fofo ejumbieŋ jaŋe nore nikec‐jopawec, â kiŋaŋ narufâc‐nane jaŋe nore mafa â jaba muhuc ʒâŋe ruruŋnueŋgopieŋ.
Kiŋaŋ qaqa‐nane wiracnepe dâŋ okacne mi bâtikie‐nareekac, â baficnuocte numucnepe qataraekac.
Ŋonâŋ‐nane e micâsu‐nanere takickeekac, â hahac ɋafâc‐nane jaŋe bâec bacnueŋgopieŋ.
Naru motec jaŋe qaisocnueŋgopieŋ, ehuc honecnurâ nifepupu enareeŋgopieŋ.
Âgo fuŋfuŋfâc‐nane jaŋe honecnurâ mamakâc‐jopaekac, â maŋzi ʒâfic‐jopahuc jupo jaŋe wâc râsi enareeŋgopieŋ.
No sahac‐nane waha‐fâreme siec sawa jukopac, â busâqocko juhape juju‐nane omaezo ekac.
Ŋoŋe ine âgofâc‐nane, irec nore busâqoc moc mananʒapiŋ me!
Ŋoŋe Anutuzi fific guguriŋ enarekac irec sâc jaha wemocte enareŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe bâʒâicnu warembiŋ i manapie mi sâckekac me?
“Dâŋ mukopac i moc qâreŋkenʒapiŋ me! Qâreŋ i papia qizec moc maŋnao râenʒapiŋ.
Qâreŋ i aeŋzi qânâ sanaŋko heutuckepie fofo sanaŋ fohuc juzac me!
No manakopac: Fifirue‐nane jukac, eki hâcne mimic mâreŋ faio domazokac.
Eme sahac‐nane ʒaŋke‐fâreha sahac biuc tâmiric Anutu honezokopac.
Riŋnane rorâ domaha honepemu, nahacne ʒâŋezi honepemu, moczi mâcne. Bunane bâruŋkerâ afec tâpiacne ekac.
Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: ‘Nâŋe weniŋuc erâ bâʒâickenaŋmu?’ Erâ ‘Ʒârâ ʒâpâ fuacnekac irec fuŋne i e jahacnao fokac.’
Irec ŋazape mananiŋ: Ŋic kiŋ iŋucne hureeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒikare biŋe, irec ŋoŋe ʒikare hâwic‐ŋopaoc. Erâ ʒiŋuc wâc mananiŋ: Mumutara‐nâŋec moc jukac.”
Hiobe e iŋuc mume Namati ŋic Zofarizi dâŋ okacne kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec:
“O Hiobe, go dâŋ mutec maŋnane sâqoreme irec okacne bâtikie‐garepemurâ bunane bâruŋkekac.
Go mu bawahac enârehuc dâŋ mukomec irec okacne gazapemurâ moc mi quŋkekopac.
Juwicnaonecteaŋ mâreŋko ŋic fuarâ juwefumbiŋ dameŋ irec maŋnao ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ʒeri bubiaŋ faio dameŋ ʒora boc mi jujumbieŋ i go mi manakic me?
<range>
Jaŋe pepec‐jeŋiczi soka ʒorac erâ feku sambâŋ âke uaocmu mecne, erâ soka sanaŋ efeku qizec‐jeŋiczi karorac heuaocmu mecne,
erâ sifu jaŋe jaŋacne ho iŋucne ʒaŋke omaec eniŋmu, ehame honec‐jopa jumbieŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc mu wioc eniŋmu: ‘Jaŋe wena?’
Jaŋe hosâc iŋucne omaeniŋmu, â guŋ manahuc mana ɋâɋârerâ manapene arictac eekac irec sâc arictac eniŋmu.
Eme honec‐jopa jumbieŋ jaŋe mocwâc mi honec‐jopaniŋmu, â ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋ hae irecnec rârierâ siroweniŋmu.
Ehame ŋokâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ine ŋic hapetac hone jauŋ ejareniŋmu, ehuc mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ŋic moneŋ mafa jowac rombiŋ i bârisie‐jareniŋmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe socɋâri jaŋe iŋucne sanaŋkerâ tâpirihec eeŋgopieŋ, erâ sifu dameŋ mi ʒoraha ʒâŋeruŋko huniŋmu.
“Ŋic sindaŋne e sâqocnere maname aŋacne eha hesoŋkehuc bajuekac, erâ aŋac‐ticne manahuc juocte sakareekac.
<range>
Eme aŋac i hobu‐ticnao hurâ herisiehuc sopâc homare micopâ irec sâc eekac.
E moneŋ mafa wiac fiuc rorâ ɋâckeekac i Anutuzi ecneme hobu‐ticnaonec mocwâc wefume maŋuekac.
E wiac sâqocne nâkâcneekac i homare micopâ irec sâc, irec qotâzi ŋic kicjopame hâmoeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha hâmoekac.
E wokemaŋ opâne me baŋac me susu mâririhec fuame hone aŋac ezacte aka hecnekicne.
E mafa wiac hure hemârec eekac i jâoc roniŋmu, ehame nareŋ gareŋ ehuc moneŋ mafa bâfuawec i bubiaŋ manahuc babaju i wâc mi eocmu.
E ŋic hapetac bâʒâic‐jopahuc hone qâoma ejarewec, â ŋic gâcne jaŋere fic wiac kâŋgâc jowac rowecte iŋuc hâcne fuacneocmu.
“Ŋic bu mâmâcnezi wiac sâcticne sirickeha ro qâzuc eekac, erâ sifu fosanaŋkeme ʒeri bubiaŋ mamana i moc mi eekac.
E nânâ âmbâŋ naha tiwâne moc mi foekac, iŋuc eekacte moneŋ mafa sâko‐ticne omaeocmu.
E wiac sasawa mazuc mâriri focne‐bipieha ʒârâ hâriŋte tâpirizi qa sipiric ecneme arictac eocmu.
E wiac i me i nâzo murâ nâzejec, ehame Anutuzi kimbeŋ â aaric‐ticne hoŋkeme ere faio feocmu.
E aeŋzi ʒika bakicne i wisecneocte muha tepe motec aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bakicne izi kimârâŋkeocmu.
Ehuc bunao raʒirâ râpenao hemârâŋkeme, tepe motec micnao soc fome honerâ bipic tatara ecneocmu.
Ehame wiac sasawa râe qâzuc ewec i sipirickerâ omaeocmu, â ŋicmezi ʒoc mi ruqekicne izi e jahacne mecne â wiacfâcne mâmâc ʒâseŋ‐jopa‐fâreocmu.
Sambâŋzi kiŋticne bataniŋkeocmu, â mâreŋzi râsi ecnehuc dâŋticne mutaraocmu.
Anuture aariczi rumi iŋucne fisicnerâ moneŋ mafa wiac‐ticne qâurucke‐fâreocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe wiac iŋuc hâcne fua‐jareocte Anutuzi mupaŋkewec.”
Eme Zofari e iŋuc mume Hiobezi dâŋ okacne kecʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarewec:
“Ŋoŋe hazec râehapie dâŋ ŋazape mananiŋ; ŋoŋe iŋuc eniŋmuo ine manape bâmiriŋnuŋgopieŋ eocmu.
Irec ŋoŋe mana‐narehapie dâŋ ŋazape, eme mupe tarame ine ʒuhuckerâ mu ruruc enarezo murâ enareniŋ.
No ŋic jaŋehec mu qaqatarac mi ekopac, erâ ʒi maŋnane omaekac i fuŋnehec.
Ŋoŋe moc honecnuniŋ me! Erâ bipic‐ŋeŋic tarame fâsâerâ ŋeniŋ!
No wiac fua‐narewec irec manasurâ sahac‐nane gâgâmârâha ɋarac ɋarac qakopac.
Anutuzi wemocte ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe mana‐jareme tâpirihec erâ mafa sâkohec juku ŋicqizec eeŋgopieŋ?
Ehame naru motec ŋosafâc‐jeŋic jaŋe wâc ʒâŋe fai‐jeŋicko biaŋne soka sanaŋ eeŋgopieŋ.
Anutuzi ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe mi bâtiŋ‐jopaekac, â wiacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe wâc wama faio juhapie wiac hâhâwicne moczi moc mi sipiric‐jopaekac.
Bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic jaŋe hufiŋne mi juhuc biaŋne fua sawec eeŋgopieŋ.
Naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe lama motecne iŋucne mamasiri ehuc kiwac qawac eeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ gae woŋgâŋ ehuc kulele fâzeeŋgopieŋ, â mimi ŋokaczi dâŋeme manarâ ʒeri bari eeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe juju‐jeŋic wama faio jutaraeŋgopieŋ, ehuc ʒâic wiac moc mi manahuc hâmoeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe Anutu ʒiŋuc âzâcneeŋgopieŋ: ‘Go behec‐nâpoc, nâŋe gore eebapa hone mana tarac enaŋte takic‐nâpoekac.
Bapafâre go mo, irec nâŋe go kiŋaŋ qagarenaŋmu, me go numu‐garepene fârine wemo wiac moc bâfua‐nârecmu?’
Jaŋe ʒiŋuc hâcne mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Wiac fârine i nâŋe nâŋâcne tâpirio bâfuaeŋgopeneŋ.’ Irec no jaŋere dâŋzi âgo moc mi enareekac.
“Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere lambe moc ficne hâpokicne me? Me wiac hâhâwicnezi moc fua‐jareekac me? Me Anutuzi aaricko qa bâtiŋ moc ejareekac me?
Me mâŋâŋzi padi jawa bawiseekac irec sâc moc ejareme wiseeŋgopieŋ?
Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: ‘Anutu e naru motec jaŋe mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sâqocnere erâ qa bâtiŋ ejareekac.’
Iŋuc mâcne, Anutu e sâqocne bapa jaŋe jaŋacne bâtiŋ‐jopazejec, ehame sâqocne‐jeŋicte iŋuc ejareekac i mana taranʒepieŋ.
Ŋic moc e juju dameŋ‐ticne tarazo ehame naru motecfâc‐ticne jaŋe faicnao juhâmoniŋmu me mâcne irec mana mezac moc eocmu me?
Ŋic moczi Anutu mamana moc sâcne qazucneocmu? Me Anutu bapafâre ere dâŋ moc sâcne mutiŋneocmu?
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe huc ʒâic â mana mezac tâmiric wama faio juku hâmoeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe biuc wokemaŋ sâkohec, â siec ɋârâc‐jeŋic fufusuc jaha foha hâmoeŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Â ŋic gâcne jaŋe ine jujuhâmo moc mi fua‐jareha ʒaic fâro faio juku hâmoeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ ŋic i me i jaŋe mâmâc hâmopie ducjopaeŋgopieŋ, ehame umbeŋzi fai‐jeŋicko gerec gerec baekac.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, no maŋŋeŋicko dâŋ fokac i manakopac, â wiac hehesicne enareniŋte dâŋ birickeŋgopieŋ i kâuc mi bakopac.
Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc wioŋgopieŋ: ‘Ŋic fekicne ere fic wena? Â ŋic hehesicnezi ŋec juc eekac ere boze wena?’
Hae mâreŋ honeniŋte rac warec ehuc jueŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋehec dâŋ muc manac moc embiŋ me? Ehuc dâŋ bajueŋgopieŋ i moc manambiŋ me?
Manarâ muzac ʒiŋuc mananʒapiŋ: Anutuzi aaric faio bâbâtiŋ gie baekac dameŋ ira ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ŋezic‐jopaekac.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe mozi mai qanʒaŋ jaha fuŋne‐jeŋic mutaniŋkeocmu, me wiac hehesicne ebac eeŋgopieŋ irec okacne bazu‐jareocmu?
Ŋic sindaŋnezi hâmome ʒâŋeruŋko reŋke raeŋgopieŋ, ehuc ʒâŋeruŋ‐ticne hone soŋaŋ eeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ ŋic guru sâko jaŋe qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne rame bâjâperâ raeŋgopieŋ, ehuc nombâŋko hume aimuŋ jaha hemackeeŋgopieŋ.
Ehame ŋoŋe ine weniŋuc enareŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe mumusifuc â dâŋ racne izi bâmiriŋnuzo eŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe dâŋ bâtikie‐nareŋgopieŋ i burec dâŋ sasawa.”
Hiobe e iŋuc mume Temaŋŋic Elifaʒizi dâŋ okacne kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec:
“Ŋiczi Anutu bafickepene erao wiac bibiaŋkene i moc fokac me? Aricne, ŋiczi maŋɋârâŋhec juipiehuc sifu Anutu babafickene i mi fokac.
Anutuzi tiŋne jujuge irec maname moc biaŋkeocmu? Me bahac fâsâc jucmu izi sâcne moc bafickeocmu?
Go araŋ bacnehuc juekicte dâŋgieo râecguhuc qa bâtiŋ egarekac me?
Aricne, go hehesicge guru sâko, â kiŋge tatara tâmiric fokacte iŋuc egarekac.
Go qomâfâcge jaŋerao tofage fowec i bazu‐gareniŋte woŋec juhuc ŋaqi qoruc wiac‐jeŋic jowac rotec biuctac erâ jumbiŋ.
Go nânâre hâmohuc docke betaŋ embiŋ jaŋe nânâ opâ jare gumec mi emeŋ.
Go ŋic tâpirihec â ʒâŋe biŋehec jumeŋte mâreŋ furu jaha ro rauc emeŋ.
Go hozec jaŋe hone bafic mi ejaremeŋ, â bekâ mâsiŋ jaŋe bâʒâic‐jopahuc wâcwiac‐jeŋic jowac romeŋ.
Eme irec hâcne wiwiticzi rârecguhuc foha honerâ ututuŋ jaha bipic tatara egarekac.
Tatamacgezi herisierâ dapâc eha wiac moc mi honekomec, â opâ rumizi qâurucguzo ekac.
“Anutu e sambâŋne sambâŋne jowaru‐fârerâ faic jâmbâŋ jukac, ehuc bâpiŋ faic jaha ŋeraŋgopieŋ jaŋerao mi fime wahaekac me?
Goki ine ʒiŋuc mu wioc ekomec: ‘Anutuzi wemo wiac moc manaekac? E karoraczi foŋkeha fimârâŋkehuc honec‐nâporâ dâŋnâŋec sâcne mutaraocmu me?’
Erâ wâc ʒiŋuc manasukomec: ‘E sambâŋ â mâreŋ jahere ŋoŋondeŋko rac warec ehuc karorac ɋâfoŋnezi sâockeme mi honec‐nâpoekac.’
Go ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe hata raŋɋa‐jeŋic bâjâpe ware jumbieŋ ijaha âtecmurâ mukomec me?
Manakic, jaŋe dameŋ‐jeŋic mi maickeha omae‐fârembiŋ, rumizi rocjopame hâmo miziec efârembiŋ hâcne.
Jaŋe Anutu ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: ‘Go behec‐nâpoc,’ erâ ʒiŋuc manambiŋ wâc: ‘Anutu e bapafârezi juipiehuc iŋuc me iŋuc sâcne mi enâreocmu.’
Iŋuc muhapie Anutuzi sifu jaha mafa mâriri bâfua‐jareme juhâmombiŋ. No ine ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere dâŋ mana maŋ mi ezepac.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe bâbâtiŋ fua‐jareme ŋic biaŋne jaŋe honec‐joparâ bubiaŋ manaeŋgopieŋ, â bahac tâmiric jaŋe gâwie‐iareeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc iŋuc eeŋgopieŋ: ‘Kisâfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe imac‐jopakicne, â wiac fojarewec i ʒoczi ʒâseŋke‐fârewec.’
“O Hiobe, go manac: Go Anutu râsi mocwâc mi ecnehuc ehec maŋ mocjaha erâ juzepirec; go iŋuc etec jambuŋgume juhâc qâhâmocmu.
Micticnaonec mu qaqazuc dâŋ wahame manazemec, ehuc dâŋticne mana maŋ erâ juzemec.
Go Anuturao risiehuc maŋhuhuŋ juzemec, ehuc ficgao wiac hehesicne ebac eeŋgopieŋ i bârârietec arictac ezejec.
Go gol wiac fogarekac i behetec omaezejec, â Ofiri mâreŋkonec gol i opâo qânâ ŋerakac jaŋere ŋondeŋko hefacketec rârâŋnezejec.
Go Anutu bapafâregere manatec furi sâko ezejec, eme eki gol â siliwa guru sâko irec sâc egarezejec.
Go iŋuc ehuc erao roweckecmuo ine ʒiŋuc mana taracmu: Eki hâcne ʒeri bubiaŋ fârine bâfua‐nareekac.
Erâ e numucnetec mana‐gareocmu, â mumupaŋ dâŋ mumeŋ i wâc soŋaŋkehuc jucmu.
Go gie batec fârinehec efâreocmu, â tatamaczi hatage batamaeocmu.
Anutuzi ŋic maŋfefehec bawahac‐jopaekac, â maŋhuhuŋ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine bâpiaŋ‐jopaekac.
Go bahac tâmiric jucmu ehuc wiac ebac etec sâckeocmuo ine Anutuzi ʒârâ ʒâpâonec bataracguocmu.”
Elifaʒi e iŋuc mume Hiobezi dâŋ okacne kecʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarewec:
“No sifu ʒiŋuczia wâc Anuture manape mi sâckekac, no kio wâwâsic ehape meticnezi bâmâcnukac jaha.
Jai, no wena rarâ e bâfuapemu i moczi moc nazame manazapo me! Me e wena jukac i moczi moc nazame manarâ ra erao fisizapo!
Erâ dâŋ bajukopac i âzâcnezapo, ehuc wiac ebac epe sâckeekac irec fuŋne wâc mujâmbâŋkezapo.
Eme eki dâŋ okacne weniŋuc bâtikie‐narezac i wâc manazapo.
E râsi sâko enarehuc tâpiri‐ticnere fuŋne norao moc bataniŋkezac me? Aricne, e dâŋ âzâcnehape hazec râerâ dâŋnane manazac.
No siocmâc jukopacte Anutuhec dâŋgie sâcne bazapo, eme eki dâŋnane mutarahuc kiŋnane behe sanaŋkezac.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, no ʒoaŋ wewefunao rahuc Anutu basa‐bipieekopac, â ʒoaŋ huhunao rahuc babasa gie bape arictac jaha wâc eekac.
Anutu e faic mâreŋko gie bahuc juha moc mi honeekopac, me juwic mâreŋko ra juhame ere ʒâŋe fipe rame arictac eekac wâc.
Eki ine hata raekopac sâc i mana‐fâreekac, irec e moc esâicnuocmuo ine ʒiŋuc honeocmu: Ŋic e maŋɋaɋac juekac.
No ere kike hata bâjâperâ raekopac, ehuc qanaopec me fâreopec rahuc hata‐ticne moc mi beheekopac.
No mumutâc dâŋticne mana rereŋ eekopac, ehuc no nahacne maŋte dâŋ mâcne, ere micdâŋ bâjâpeekopac hâcne.
Anutu e ŋiczi iŋuc me iŋuc ecnepene hec hetikic moc mi eocmu, e wiac i me i ezo murâ ejâmbâŋkeocmu.
E nore dâŋ iŋuc me iŋuc maŋkerâ bajukac i fârinehec eocte giene baocmu, erâ nore dâŋ sawa mâcne, e dâŋ wiac iŋucne gâcne wâc maŋkerâ jukac jaha.
No irec hâcne hâwicnume ere maio ɋarac ɋarac qaekopac, erâ irec manasuhuc maŋnane gâckeekac.
Anutuzi bawahacnume hâbi‐nane goroŋkeekac, e bapafârezi hâhâwic henareme ʒâic busâqoc faio juekopac.
Dapâczi foŋnume wiac moc mi honeekopac i jâmbomac, erâ i dapâczi mâcne, Anutuzi bâʒâicnume maŋnane omaeekac.
“Anutu e okac babazure ʒâfo wemocte mi râeekac, â kiŋaŋ qacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋere dâŋ mutiŋneocte wemocte dameŋ mi baekac?
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe mâreŋ‐jeŋic bâsokaniŋte ma âke sueeŋgopieŋ, erâ lama fiuc rocjoparâ jaŋacne lamafâc jaŋehec bâturec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe bekâ mâsiŋ jaŋere doŋgi kâŋgâc jowac roeŋgopieŋ, â hozec jaŋe sahac taha‐jeŋic râeniŋte moneŋ basahapie jaŋere bulimakao sakareeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ ŋic qarâ suriŋne hatao bâfuac‐joparâ jâpec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic hapetac ejarepie wiserâ ra soŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
Iŋuc ejarepie hapetac jaŋe jaŋacne â naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere nânâ bâfuaniŋte kâte doŋgi iŋucne mâreŋ burocnao babasa gie baeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe hapetac ʒoɋac ejarepie gie‐jeŋicko nânâ qa roro eeŋgopieŋ, erâ waiŋ bâtirikicne i wâc ro nusec eeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋaqi qoruc‐jeŋic arictacte ŋafeo biuctac foeŋgopieŋ, â mâmâteŋ dameŋko bilaŋke rufaniŋte basaeŋgopieŋ.
Tikio hoe sâko heekac izi hembânâŋ‐jopaekac, â fic basahuc ine qânâuŋko jâjâwâckehuc ŋeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe bekâ mâsiŋ kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic bacjopaeŋgopieŋ, â qarâ suriŋne jaŋere tofa taraocte naru motecfâc‐jeŋic rocjopaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic hapetac jaŋe ŋaqi qoruc tâmiric biuctac jueŋgopieŋ, erâ bomboŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere nânâ qa roro eipiehuc sifu nânâre hâmoeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe oliwa hândâŋne bâpisickepie opâne wahaekac, â waiŋ hândâŋ‐jeŋic âte pisickehuc sifu opâre wâc hâmoeŋgopieŋ.
Haeo hâmozo eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere ki owa fuaekac, â ʒâpâ jopakicne jaŋe babafic moc fua‐jareocte wira wâwâsic eeŋgopieŋ, ehame Anutuzi ine sifu mi mana‐jareekac.
“Ŋic gâcne jaŋe tatamac râsi ecneeŋgopieŋ, ehuc Anuture eebapa hone mana tarac eniŋte takic‐jopaekac â hata‐ticne wâc mi bâjâpeeŋgopieŋ.
Ʒikaŋic jaŋe ŋic hapetac â qarâ suriŋne jopaniŋte furic araraŋtea fahareeŋgopieŋ, â ŋafeo ine ŋic jaŋere wâcwiac fiuckeeŋgopieŋ.
Boe sau ŋic jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha hae ŋafeocte woŋec jueŋgopieŋ, ehuc ŋic moczi moc mi hone tarac‐nâpozejec muhuc ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic sâockeeŋgopieŋ.
Fiuc roro jaŋe ŋafeoa ficmotâc heropierâ wiac fiuc roeŋgopieŋ, ʒoaŋko ine tatamac dic bacnehuc soŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ʒoaŋ tatamacte hâwic‐jopaekac, dapâc qisiricte ine manapie âgo babafic‐jeŋic eekac.
“Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe eebapa‐jeŋiczi opâ rumi iŋucne erâ jowac‐jopame arictac eeŋgopieŋ, â mâreŋ ruckerâ jueŋgopieŋ i Anutuzi sâweckeekac, irec hesarac gie baniŋte mocwâc mi raeŋgopieŋ.
Maniŋ titikuczi ʒoaŋ fârorocte kereŋkerâ omaeekac, irec sâc jaha sâqocne bapazi ŋic jujune jaŋere mâreŋkonec rârâŋneocmu.
Eme neŋgoc‐ticnezi mecne, me ŋic gâcne jaŋe mecne ere mocwâc mi manasuniŋmu, ehame umbeŋzi nanʒaŋneme arictac eocmu.
“E hozec bâʒâic‐jopawecte â ŋokac hufiŋne hone bafic mi ejarewecte iŋuc hâcne fuacneocmu.
Anutu e mesanaŋ‐ticnezi ŋic tâpirihec jaŋe bawahac‐jopaekac, ehuc juju‐jeŋic jowac rome hâmoeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe Anutuzi wama faio juniŋte mana‐jarezo murâ mana‐jareocmu, erâ wâc hata‐jeŋicko rahapie dameŋ sâc hone jâjâpec‐jopaocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe iŋuc ejareme dameŋ bembeŋne mac gie‐jeŋic bapie fârinehec eocmu, izi ine ututuŋ jaha hofâ qinʒiŋ iŋucne ururuckeniŋmu. Jaŋe sopâc kecɋaŋ qâtâcnepene ɋaŋaekac irec sâc jaha ɋaŋaniŋmu.
Fuŋne iŋuc fokac i mozi mickeocmu? Me mozi dâŋnanere maname burec eha dâŋ moc sâcne muocmu?”
Hiobe e iŋuc mume Suhiŋic Bilidadizi dâŋ okacne kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec:
“Anutu e tâpiri ɋuŋɋasaŋ sâko‐ticnehec, irec ŋic jaŋe ʒeŋgoma araŋ bacnenʒepieŋ; e sambâŋ uucmaŋ‐ticnao wama bâfuawec fokac.
Aŋelofâc‐ticne kiŋaŋ qacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mozi sâcne wosec‐jopaocmu? Me tatamac‐ticnezi hae mâreŋ moc wena mi tamaeekac?
Ŋic bahacmâc moczi Anuture maio sâcne juocmu? Me ŋic ŋokackonec fuakicne moczi maŋɋaɋac sâcne domaocmu?
Manakic, mosare tatamaczi ere maio uucne mi riŋkeekac, â bâpiŋ jaŋere tatamaczi ɋaɋac taeŋne wâc mi eekac.
Anutu e jaŋere fuŋne iŋuc honeekacko ine ŋic e gisic â umbeŋ jaŋere sâc sawa juhame wemocko moc honeme biaŋkeocmu.”
Bilidadi e iŋuc mume Hiobezi dâŋ okacne kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec:
“Eha i, no ŋic tâpiri â sasanaŋ tâmiric jukopacte go sowine baficnucmurâ ʒoɋac sâko ekomec.
Jei, ŋic maŋɋârâŋ tâmiric â mutuc matacne no sowine baficnuhuc mamana sâko tahacnukomec.
Erâ go muc: More mârozi maŋgao juhuc baafecguha dâŋ keci mukomec, â dâŋ sasawa mukomec i mozi mana‐fâreomu?
Hâmoc haezi ɋiɋiteckeekac, â ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe hâwic‐jopaha ɋarac ɋarac qaeŋgopieŋ.
Hâmoc hae hâcne i Anuture maio tâtâc fokac, wiac izi me izi sâcne moc mi sâockeocmu.
Anutuzi faic mâreŋte qânikiŋ qaratiewec fokac, â mâreŋ ine sawao hewec ŋekac.
Anutu eki hâcne mume hoe opâzi karorac maŋnao ŋeekac, ehuc soŋaŋkeha karoracko fusucmarâ sifu mi fâuckeekac.
Erâ ekizia wâc mume mosazi karorac maŋnao soŋkeekac.
Eki hâwec qaŋeŋne râehame dapâc â tatamac âke râwiŋ‐jofawec.
Erâ ekizia wâc mume ɋuŋ parandaŋ heme tiki jaŋe qiriŋ qaeŋgopieŋ.
E tâpiri‐ticnezi hâwec bâniniŋkeme benoŋ bawec, â maŋɋârâŋ focnekacte Rahaba oâ sâko imackewec.
Ere micrombâŋzi karorac ficne sueme rahame qânikiŋ fuawec, â mesanaŋ‐ticnezi oâ sâko keci wisehame qâhâmowec.
Manakic, wiac mukopac keci i tâpiri‐ticnere jauraŋne sawa, nâŋe dâŋsaŋuc‐ticne sawa manaeŋgopeneŋ. Tâpiri ɋuŋɋasaŋ‐ticnere fuŋne ine mozi sâcne mana taraocmu?”
Hiobezi iŋuc jazahuc ʒuhuckerâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec:
“Anutu jujune e bapafârezi dâŋnane mi mutiŋnehuc busâqoc bâfua‐narekac erao ɋetickehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupaŋkekopac:
No nokafe hehuc jufepemu sâc â Anuture Mâro jujunezi juju bâfua‐nareocmu sâc
micnaneonec dâŋ hehesicne moc mi wahazejec, â nameŋ‐nanezi burecdâŋ moc mi muzejec.
No bahacmâc jukopac, iŋuc manapaŋkehuc jufekuhape hâmoc dameŋ‐nane maickeme ʒiŋuc moc mi ŋazapemu: Ŋoŋe nore dâŋ muŋgopieŋ i fârine sasawa.
Maŋnanezi mumu hehec mi enarekac, irec no bahacmâc jukopac, dâŋ i moc mi behe‐jâmbâŋkepemu.
“No râsi enarehuc dâŋnane qaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe, ŋic sindaŋne â kiŋhec okacne fua‐jareekac sâc ijaha fua‐jarezejec.
Anutuzi ŋic hehesicne juju‐jeŋic jowac roha wemo wiaczi woworic‐jeŋic eocmu?
Wiac hâhâwicnezi maic‐jopahame Anutu wira wâwâsic ecnepie sâcne moc mana‐jareocmu me?
Aricne, jaŋe dameŋ sâc Anutu bapafâre e numucnehuc ere aŋac manapie muzac sâckezac.
Ŋoŋe mana‐narehapie Anutu tâpiri ɋuŋɋasaŋ‐ticnere fuŋne ŋaza qazuc epemu, ehuc Anutu bapafâre e dâŋ weniŋucne mana biric ewec i wâc mutâcne‐ŋarepemu.
Opoŋ, ŋoŋe ŋaŋac wiac i hone manac efârembiŋzi wemocte dâŋ racne keci boc muŋgopieŋ?
“Ŋic sindaŋne â ʒâʒâicne jaŋe Anutu bapafâre eraonec okacne bâbâtiŋ kecʒiŋuc fua‐jareocmu:
Jaŋe ŋokâfâc‐jeŋic bocjaha fuarâ juniŋmu mecne, erâ sifu ʒikao rarâ hâmo‐fâreniŋmu, â naru motecfâc‐jeŋic gâcne jaŋe nânâre hâmo sipiric eniŋmu.
Ŋokâfâc‐jeŋic ʒanʒaŋne mac jaŋe ine huc mimicnezi rocjopame omaepie hozecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ki mamakuc mi ejareniŋmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe moneŋ wiac rufere sâc fojareha ŋaqi qoruc wiac‐jeŋic ŋic gâcne jaŋere sâc sirickehuc bajuniŋmu mecne.
Iŋuc fojarehame ŋic tiŋne jaŋe jowac rorâ bajuniŋmu, â ŋic sioc tâmiric jaŋe moneŋ‐jeŋic bâtâc baniŋmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe fic baeŋgopieŋ i ŋeŋe sanaŋ aricne, i bameŋte qâruru irec sâc, erâ kiŋaŋ qaqazi gie soŋaŋkeekac ere boze wamba iŋucne.
Jaŋe moneŋ mafa ɋâfoŋne fojareha jufeku ŋafe mocko waha guŋ foniŋmu, izi hae fureme faharerâ basaniŋmu.
Wiac hâhâwicnezi rumi sâko iŋucne fisi‐jareocmu, ehame mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋneheczi ficne suec‐jopame wise tâmireniŋmu.
Â jowareczi wâc iŋuc jaha ficne suec‐jopame fic hae‐jeŋic beherâ ratâmireniŋmu.
Eme wise‐bipiehapie mâŋâŋzi moc mi akic‐jopahuc imac‐jopaocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe iŋuc fua‐jareme ŋic tucne jaŋe, sowine wiac iŋuc fua‐jarekac muhuc nifepupu ejareniŋmu.
“Mâreŋmaŋko siliwa â gol fokac i ŋic jaŋe wise gufuc ehuc rorâ ʒocko rike dockepie ɋaɋackeekac.
Erâ aeŋ omane â bâbâroŋ iŋuc jaha mâreŋmaŋko qânâhec bobohotac erâ fokac i ŋic jaŋe wâc wise gufuc ehuc rorâ ʒocko rike dockepie wosâeekac.
Mâreŋmaŋko duŋdapâc fokac i ŋic jaŋe lambezi batamaepie omaeekac, ehame ira qânâ wiac forakac irec fuŋne mananiŋte wise gufuc ehuc gie sâko baeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋic jujuo me rac warec eeŋgopieŋko mâcne, taicko sawa hawec sâko wise gufuc ehuc repao hurâ qaŋatierâ domahuc ŋiczi hone manac mi ejarehapie gie baeŋgopieŋ.
Mâreŋ fainao nânâ monʒaŋ fuarâ foekac, â maŋnao wiac foraekac i ine ʒoczi qânâ ʒâtâcne fâuckerâ foekac irec sâc.
Mâreŋ maŋnao qânâ gâcne bâfuaeŋgopieŋ i qânâ furi sâko, â qânâo gol uucnezi wâc bohotarâ foekac.
“Hawec gufueŋgopieŋ irec maŋne i piʒu piʒu jaŋe mi honeeŋgopieŋ, â tucwipe jaŋe wâc irec faicnao mi sâoeŋgopieŋ.
Laioŋ jaŋe mecne me qowi momori gâcne jaŋe mecne mâreŋ ira rac warec moc mi eeŋgopieŋ.
“Ŋic jaŋe haroŋaŋ sâko henʒaŋ qanʒaŋneeŋgopieŋ, erâ tiki fuŋnao wise gufuc epie tiki jaŋe rândiŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
Tiki maŋnao qânâ sanaŋ fokac i gufu koparic ehuc qânâ furi sâko bâfuaeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ opâ hatane hatane i hebâzickehuc mâreŋ maŋnao wâcwiac soŋkerâ fokac i wâc bataniŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
“Maŋɋârâŋte fuŋne i wenirec bâfuazo? Â mamana tara irec fuŋne i wena fokac?
Ŋic nâŋâc irec hata moc mi manaeŋgopeneŋ, â ŋic jujune nâŋâcne mâreŋko sâcne mi bâbâfuane.
Hâwec ʒâkâŋ sâko fâhâŋnaonec dâŋ ʒiŋuc wefukac: ‘Maŋɋârâŋ i norao bâbâfuane mi ekac.’
Maŋɋârâŋ i golzi rorone mi ekac, â siliwazi furi bapane wâc mi fokac.
Maŋɋârâŋ i Ofiri mâreŋko gol fokac ihec sâc hehene mi ekac, erâ qânâ furi sâkore furizi irec sâc wâc mi bâfuakac.
Maŋɋârâŋ i gol irec sâc boc sirickekac, erâ eri wiac gol â galasi furi sâkozi bakicne irec sâc mâmâc jâurukac.
Maŋɋârâŋ i wiac qame hukicne, qânâ furi sâko fuŋne fuŋne irec sâc siricke‐fârekac hâcne.
Maŋɋârâŋ i wiac qeŋ bipinehec, irec qânâ furi sâko bâbâŋeŋ me gol ɋaɋacne ihec sâc hehene mi ekac.
“Hâc, eme maŋɋârâŋ i wenirec fuaekac, â mamana tara irec fuŋne wena fokac?
Wiac jujune jaŋe sâcne mi honeeŋgopieŋ, â sawa wipe jaŋe fururuc qahuc wâc mi honeeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ hâmoc â sisipiric jahe ʒiŋuc mukopirec: ‘Nâhe irec biŋe bâroŋ sawa manaekoperec.’
“Anutu e irec fuŋne buc manaekac, â maŋɋârâŋ wena bâbâfuane i eki wâc buc manaekac.
Eki hâcne ʒâŋe fime rame mâreŋ qaŋeŋne honeekac, â sambâŋ rurumaŋnao wiac sasawa fokac i hone‐fâreekac wâc.
Eki hâcne mâŋâŋ tâpiri‐ticne râcnewec, erâ hâwec sâcticne wâc mutâcnewec.
Erâ ekizia wâc hoezi wena heocte mupaŋkewec, â karoraczi gâpâreha bâbâriczi ɋuŋ parandaŋte hata baocte mucnewec.
Anutu e dameŋ ira hâcne maŋɋârâŋte fuŋʒuhucne hone tararâ bataniŋkewec, erâ basanaŋkehuc irec fuŋne mutaniŋkewec.
Ehuc ŋic kecʒiŋuc jazawec: ‘Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ araŋ babacne izi maŋɋârâŋ fârine, erâ hehesic râpeckerâ juju izi mamana tara fârine.’”
Hiobe e ʒuhuckerâ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec:
“Jei, Anutuzi mârâc jaha hone soŋaŋ enareme juhâc qâhâmopo juju iŋucne mocwâc fua‐nareme juzapo me!
Anutu e dameŋ ira hâcne nohec hati juwec, ehuc dapâcko juhape tamae‐narewec.
No dameŋ ira Anutuzi fic hae‐nane hone maiŋ ecnehuc hâpo heâroŋ enareha ŋic ʒoɋac sasanaŋhec jupo.
Anutu bapafâre e dameŋ ira hâcne nohec juha naru motecfâc‐nane jaŋe qazu orâŋ enarehuc jumbiŋ.
Noniŋ bulimakaofâc‐nane jaŋe susu bocjaha bâfua‐nare jumbieŋ, â oliwa jâcnane i mâreŋ kereŋnao sarape sifu fua biaŋ ewec.
Hae soŋaŋ micne jaŋe tumaŋnehapie sâc no qâtec‐joparâ ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ŋeŋe juju ejupac.
Ehame ŋic motec jaŋe honecnurâ izia soŋke jumbieŋ, â ŋicqizec jaŋe araŋ banarehuc fahare jumbieŋ.
Ŋic fekicne jaŋe dâŋjeŋic bâniniŋkerâ dâŋemâc ŋejumbieŋ,
â ŋic ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha dâŋ tâmiric ŋejumbieŋ.
Hone manac enarembiŋ ŋic i jaŋe sasawa wiac ebac epo irec muac baafec enare jumbieŋ.
No ŋic hapetac jaŋe wira wâwâsic enarepie manarâ hone bafic ejare jupac.
Ŋic jaŋe sipirickezo ehapie bafic‐jopape mumbiaŋnu jumbieŋ, â hozec jaŋe ehâmo‐jarepe ʒeri bari ejumbieŋ.
No dameŋ sâc wiac ebac epe tiŋke biaŋ efâre jujec.
No ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ jaŋe jowa qataŋ ejare jupac, â kike demba jaŋe dope hutuŋ ejare jupac wâc.
No ŋic hapetac mamac ejarehuc bâmec bajare jupac, â ŋic furune wiac qacne gâpâcne fua‐jarewec iŋuc jaha wâc hone bafic ejare jupac.
No ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere tâpiri bawaha jupac, ehuc bâʒâic‐jopa jumbieŋ jaŋe ŋezic‐jopa jupac.
No ʒiŋuc manasuhuc jupo: ‘No jufeku ŋicqizec jâmbâŋ epemu, ehuc fic hae‐naneo hâmoc biaŋne hâmopemu.
No jâc moczi gâtâne sicnerâ opâ bâfuaekac, â tieŋ taeŋne maniŋ titikuczi bâgunuckeekac irec sâc erâ jufepemu.
Ʒâŋe biŋe sâko‐nane wawahane mi eocmu, â tâpiri‐nane wâc mi omaeocmu.’
“No ŋic jaŋe niniŋkerâ ŋehapie dâŋ jaza jupac, erâ hazec râehapie dâŋ mutâcne‐jare jupac.
Eme dâŋ mutarape jaŋe okacne mi bârisie jumbieŋ; dâŋnane i hoe sisic iŋucne fai‐jeŋicko wahame mana sakac ejumbieŋ hâcne.
Ŋic jaŋe ʒoaŋ fârorocte takic‐jopame hoere ejareekac irec sâc jaŋe dâŋnanere boc ejare jujec.
Jaŋere ʒâic busâqoczi nore ʒeri bubiaŋ sâcne mi bawaha jujec, ehame no mu âkeriŋ ejarepe qacfiric ejumbieŋ.
No ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc qizec‐jopahuc hata mutâcne‐jare jupac, erâ ŋicwofuŋ moczi momorifâcne bânie‐jarehuc sâcmutâc ejareekac irec sâc ejare jupac, ehuc hâbi‐jeŋic goroŋkeme basanaŋ‐jopa jupac.
“Ŋic socɋâri jaŋe nore sâc mi eŋgopieŋzi gâwie‐nareŋgopieŋ. No mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere manape jawa qaqane eha qâtofâc‐nane bafic‐jopahuc lamafâc‐nane soŋaŋ‐jopaniŋte mupie muzac mi mana‐jarezapo.
Jaŋe ŋicguru rorokacnezi nore gie moc baniŋte tâpiri basanʒapiŋ.
Jaŋe ŋic hapetacte nânâre hâmo sipiric ehuc kâteonec wâcwiac gâtâne unucke nâc ejumbieŋ.
Jaŋe wawec â wifu hândâŋne nâjumbieŋ, â qaqanaczi nânâ‐jeŋic ejujec.
Fiuc roro owackecnehuc jâpeeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc jaha owacke‐jarehuc jâpec‐jopa jumbieŋ.
Eme opâwâcko â haroŋaŋ ŋoŋondeŋko soŋke jumbieŋ, erâ qânâuŋko â mâreŋ tucduŋko juju fofo ejumbieŋ.
Jaŋe qowi iŋucne kâteo juhuc owacke jumbieŋ, ehuc jâcfuŋko heheâroŋ erâ ŋejumbieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋicguru waha qaqane â ʒâŋe biŋe tâmiric, irec mâreŋ‐nâŋeckonec jâpec‐jopapie wise‐fârembiŋ.
“Jaŋe dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ware mu gâgâwi enareŋgopieŋ, ehuc juju‐nanere qâqiŋ qahuc âke sisic enareŋgopieŋ.
Erâ nore manapie mamakâcne eha dic banareŋgopieŋ, me ware honecnurâ tâfecnuniŋte acmeruŋ mi eŋgopieŋ.
Anutuzi bârokawecnuhuc tâpiri‐nane bawahawecte manabâc tâmiric râsi sanaŋ enareŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Ŋicguru ʒororone keci jaŋe onʒoŋ jaha ro fâre enarehuc jâpecnuzo eŋgopieŋ, ehuc sipiricnuniŋte ʒawiehuc roroc eŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe wisezipore aka henarehuc imacnuzo eŋgopieŋ, ehame moczi moc mi hecke‐jarekac.
Râsi jaŋe sac henʒaŋnerâ haeo fisieŋgopieŋ jaŋe irec sâc jaha fisi‐nareŋgopieŋ.
Sisipiriczi maicnume bipic‐nane tarakac, ehame mâŋâŋzi rehac ficne sueme raekac irec sâc jaha ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane rârâŋnekac, erâ mâŋâŋzia karorac ficneme raekac irec sâc jaha jujuhâmo‐nane omaekac.
“No ʒi hâmozo ekopac hâcne, ʒârâ hâriŋ‐nanezi moc mi afeckekac.
Ŋafeo siec bibiric‐nane sasawa ʒâicnu‐fâreekac, ehame ʒâic serereŋ dameŋ‐nanezi moc mi behecnukac.
Tâpiri sâko moczi sahac‐nane fiŋiŋiŋnume manape ŋaqi fâŋfâŋne rojukopac tinac ekac.
Anutuzi tuŋnume sohoŋmaŋko hukopac, ehuc rufe â ʒafe iŋucne ekopac.
Erâ Anutu go wira wâwâsic egarepe micnaneo mi roekic, â numu‐garepe wâc mi mana‐nareekic.
Go busâqoc moc mi mana‐narehuc râsi sanaŋ enareekic, ehuc tâpiri mesanaŋgezi nu jâpec enarehuc juekic.
Go mâŋâŋ sâko manacnehaŋ ficne suecnuekac, â mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋneheczi qâtuŋnuekac.
Jei, no manakopac, go hâmocte meo râecnuzo ekomec, hâmoc hae ŋic ʒeŋgoma nâŋere biŋe mukicne ira râecnukomec hâcne.
“Go wemocte sisipiriczi imacnuha baficnucmurâ wira wâwâsic egarehape qa bâʒâic enarekomec?
No ŋic ʒârâ hâriŋ faio jumbiŋ jaŋere erâ kio wâwâsic mi egare jupac me? Me qarâ suriŋne jaŋere busâqoc mi mana jupac me?
No jujuhâmo â tatamacte mamanac jupo, ehame ine ʒârâ hâriŋ â duŋdapâc izi fua‐narewec.
No ʒâic serereŋ manahuc bu ʒaʒamaŋ‐nane fâuckekac, ʒâic dameŋ‐nanezi sawa maicnurâ fokac.
Wiac moczi moc mi bâmiriŋnukacte busâqoc manahuc makuc bahuc jukopac, ehuc ŋic tutumaŋko faharerâ baficnuniŋte numu‐jareekopac.
Marac fânâŋ‐nane i kâte qâto jaŋe âgofâc‐jeŋic basac‐jopahuc qauu qaeŋgopieŋ, â qera jaŋe dâŋeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc ekac.
Sahac‐nane ʒocnehec efârehuc gâpârerâ iriweckekac.
No mârâc jaha woŋgâŋ qahuc ʒeri bubiaŋ gae hejupac, â dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ine makuc bahuc busâqoc gae sawa heekopac.
“No naru ʒeŋoŋ e me e hone sasec moc mi ecnepemurâ mupaŋkepo.
No mumupaŋ i qâsuazapoo ine Anutu bapafâreraonec okacne weniŋucne fua‐narezac? Me eraonec furine biaŋne moc rozapo?
E ŋic sindaŋne sipiric‐jopaekac â ŋic hehesicne imac‐jopaekac.
Anutuzi wiac ebac eekopac sâc mana‐fâreekac, â hata raekopac sâc hone‐fâreekac wâc.
“No wiac sindaŋne moc mi epo i musanaŋkekopac, erâ ŋic gâcne wâc moc mi eatuc‐jopapo.
Me wiac iŋucne moc epoo ine Anutu e jahac ŋemâc bâbâfuare sâcko râecnuhuc fuŋne‐nane bataniŋkezejec, ehuc, bahac tâmiric jukopac i honezejec.
No hata tiŋne râpeckerâ ʒâŋe‐nanezi wiac hehesicne honehuc maŋnanezi mana aŋac erâ menanezi wiac sâqocne moc bâuapoo
ine gie wiac‐nane sipiricke‐fârezejec, â wiac he sarac ekopac i fua sokac eme ŋic gâcne jaŋe nânʒepieŋ.
“No maŋnane ŋic mocte ŋokactao domaha ficticnere motâcko soŋkerâ ere woŋec moc jupoo
ine no nahacne ŋonâŋ manacnepe ŋic mocte ʒegoc bahuc ehec fozejec.
Erâ ine moc e wiac iŋucne bâfuaocmuzi sindaŋ hârindaŋ eocmu, eme irec okacne mumutara ŋic jaŋe hâmocko râeniŋmu.
Wiac izi ʒoc ima‐ticnehec iŋucne erâ wiac sasawa fonarekac i ʒâseŋke‐fârezac.
“Kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐nane jaŋe nore manapie sâqoreme nazapie dâŋjeŋic mana jupac.
No iŋuc mi ezapo muzac ine Anutuzi fua‐nareme wemocko ere maio domazapo, me dâŋnane mutiŋneocte fisime wemo dâŋ moc âzâcnezapo?
No bâfuacnuwec Anutu ekizia kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐nane wâc bâfuac‐jopawec.
“No ŋic hapetac bafic‐jopapemurâ moc mi takicnu jujec, â hozec jaŋe batac qatac ehuc juhapie hone bafic ejare jupac.
Me bekâ mâsiŋ jaŋe nânâre hâmo sipiric ehapie nânâ wiac mi sakare‐jare jupac.
No ɋie‐jeŋickonecteaŋ mamac ejare jupac, â neŋgoc bumaŋkonec fuambiŋ dameŋ ira hâcne fuŋkerâ hone maiŋ ejare warehuc jupo.
Me ŋic jaŋe ŋaqi qoruc tâmiric jumbiŋ â hapetac jaŋe bilaŋke basahuc juhapie
honec‐joparâ no nahacne lamafâc jaŋere kanʒaŋzi ŋaqi qoruc bakicne i jarehuc jupo.
No dâŋgieo râecnupie sanaŋkepemu iŋuc muhuc bekâ mâsiŋ jopa sipiric moc mi ejarepo.
Me iŋuc ewiac moc epoo ine irec okacne menane qazunʒepieŋ, â ɋawe‐nane unuckenʒepieŋ.
No Anuturaonec okacnere hâwicnume wiac iŋucne moc mi eekopac.
“No maŋnane moneŋ mafao râepe mi fowec, me gol ɋaɋacnezi woworic‐nane wâc mi ewec.
Menanezi gie bape mafa mâriri fua‐nareme mafa wiac i honehuc sifu maŋfefe mi epo.
No ʒoaŋ e tatamac‐ticnere erâ dieŋzi mi hecnepo, â mosa e oŋa rarac‐ticnere erâ wâc mi dapecnepo.
No maŋnane jaherao râepe soŋsoŋ foha mi qâsoriepo, erâ wâc menane sicne‐jactehuc araŋ moc mi bajactepo.
Ŋic moc e iŋuc eocmuzi Anutu mickeocmu, irec no wiac iŋucne moc ezapo muzac mumutara ŋic jaŋe hâmocko râecnunʒapiŋ.
“Kisâfâc‐nane jaŋe ʒârâ hâriŋ fua‐jareme moc mi ʒeri bari epo, me sisipiriczi imac‐jopame honec‐joparâ bubiaŋ wâc mi manapo.
No mi sâwec‐jopapo, â hâmoczi rocjopaocte nunumu gie wâc mi bapo, irec no bahac tâmiric jukopac.
Nore gie bahuc jueŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe fuŋne‐nane ʒiŋuc mana taraeŋgopieŋ: E ŋic furune dameŋ sâc âgo ejarehuc juekac.
No ŋic mâreŋ honeniŋte rac warec eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hae ʒoŋao fonʒipiŋte ficnaneo hefârec‐jopaekopac.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe sâqocne‐jeŋic hesoŋkeeŋgopieŋ, no ine iŋuc moc mi eekopac.
Ŋic jaŋe nore dâŋ moc weniŋuc muniŋmu muhuc hâwicnume kiŋ bahac‐nane moc mi hesoŋkeekopac. Â mu âke sisic‐jeŋicte rumerâ dâŋemâc juju me ficko soŋkerâ ŋeŋe i wâc mi eekopac.
Jei, ŋic moczi dâŋnane moc manazac me! No ʒiŋuc musanaŋkekopac: Dâŋ mukopac i fârine sasawa, irec Anutu bapafâre eki dâŋ okacne bâtikie‐narezejec. Jei, kisâfâc‐nane jaŋe qoricnuhuc dâŋ muŋgopieŋ i papiao qâreŋkepie bajuzapo me!
Ehuc upenaneo qonaŋkerâ juzapo, â ŋic jaŋe honeniŋte jowatuzapo.
Erâ wiac ebac epo sâc i Anuture maio acmeruŋ tâmiric domahuc âzâcne‐fârezapo.
“No mâreŋ he sarac ekopac i kâŋgâc ehuc mâreŋ irec rune moc mi jâoc ropo.
Erâ nânâ monʒaŋ he sarac epie fârine fuawec gieŋic i jaŋe sakare‐jarehuc buc mi nâhuc jupo.
No wiac iŋucne moc epoo ine padi jacgoŋ jahere âkehoc hofâ qinʒiŋ â opac wiac sawa fuarâ fozejec.” Hiobere dâŋ sasawa i ʒira hâcne tarakac.
Hiobe e qizec qahuc, “No bahacmâc jukopac” iŋuc muhuc dâŋticne mutarawecte ŋic jahec â moc jaŋe ʒuhuckerâ dâŋ okacne mi bâtikiecnehuc mâc niniŋkerâ ŋembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Ram guruonec Buʒiŋic Barakere ŋokâ ʒâŋene Elihu e Hiobezi jahacnere maname sâckeha Anuture maname sâqorewecte boc aarickewec.
Erâ Hiobere âgofâc jahec â moc jaŋe Hiobe dâŋ bâtikiecnehuc bahac‐ticnere fuŋne bataniŋkezo eipiembiŋte jaŋere wâc iŋuc jaha aarickewec.
Mâc e ŋicmotec juwecte jaŋe dâŋjeŋic muhapie dâŋemâc ŋewec.
Ʒi ine Hiobezi dâŋticne mutarame okacne ʒuhuckerâ bâtikiecneniŋte tâpiri basapie honec‐joparâ aarickewec hâcne.
Iŋuc ehuc fuŋkerâ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc jazawec: “No motec ɋâri â ŋoŋe ine ŋicqizec, irec maŋnaneo dâŋ fokac i ŋazazore hâwicnume behepac.
No maŋnanezi ʒiŋuc manasupac: Ŋicqizec jaŋe dâŋjeŋic nazaŋ gazaŋ ehuc maŋɋârâŋ‐jeŋicte fuŋne bataniŋkenʒepieŋ.
Erâ ʒi ine ʒiŋuc manakopac: Jara bocjahazi maŋɋârâŋ mi bâfua‐nâreekac, aricne, Anutu bapafârere Mârozi maŋnâŋecko hurâ bâfua‐nâreekac.
Ŋicqizec jaŋe sawa maŋɋârâŋhec mi jueŋgopieŋ, me jaŋe sawa biaŋne â sâqocne irec fuŋne mamana tara i wâc mi fokac.
Irec ʒiŋuc mukopac: ‘Ŋoŋe dâŋnanere hazec râeniŋ, ehame maŋnaneo dâŋ fokac i hâcne ŋazape.’
“Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe dâŋŋeŋic muc manac ehapie no tatakic tâmiric ŋehuc ʒiŋuc manapac: Jaŋe dâŋ muku maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ moc bâfuarâ muniŋmu me mâcne, iŋuc muhuc woŋec ŋepac hâcne.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ muhapie no manatâc qâtâc epac, ehuc ine ʒiŋuc mana tarapac: Hiobezi dâŋ mujec i ŋoŋe mutiŋnehuc okacne biaŋne jaha bâtikiecneniŋte eipie sâqorembieŋ.
Irec ŋoŋe wemocko ʒiŋuc moc muniŋmu: Nâŋe maŋɋârâŋhec juŋgopeneŋ. Ŋoŋe eipiembiŋte Anutu e jahac dâŋ okacne bâtikiecnezejec.
Hiobe e no mâcne, ŋoŋe dâŋ ŋazajec, no nazame muzac ine ŋoŋe okacne bâtikiecnembieŋ irec sâc mi bâtikiecnezapo.
“O Hiobe, jaŋe dâŋ basarâ okacne bâtikie‐gareniŋte eipieŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Eme jaŋe niniŋkerâ dâŋ muniŋte quŋkehuc mâc domahapie no wâc iŋuc jaha ʒuhuckerâ dâŋemâc sâcne domapemu me?
Aricne, no ʒi hâcne dâŋ okacne bâtikie‐garepemu, ehuc maŋnaneo dâŋ fokac i gazapemu.
Manakic, no dâŋ muzore fâcfâc boc âkecnukac, irec ʒuhuckerâ dâŋemâc mi ŋepemu.
Me dâŋ mumure hata basahuc waiŋ ɋâricnezi ʒopo fusucmarâ âte fâuckeekac irec sâc âte fâuckepemu.
Irec no dâŋ okacne bâtikie‐gare‐jâmbâŋkehuc maŋnane fâre wahazejec.
No mana‐ŋarepe feriŋ wahariŋ eha ŋic moc me moc mi mumbiaŋkepemu.
No ŋic mumumbiaŋ‐jopa i moc mi eekopac, moc epe muzac Anutuzi biac bâsirowecnuzac.
“O Hiobe, go ʒi dâŋnanere hazec râec, ehuc dâŋ sasawa mukopac i mana‐fârec.
Manakic, no okacne bâtikie‐garezo micnane aŋkekopac, ehuc maŋnaneo dâŋ fokac i muzo ekopac.
Dâŋnane sioc tâmiric sasawa, â dâŋ mupemu i wâc fârine jaha.
Anuture Mârozi bâfuacnuwec, â bapafârere nokafezi juju bâfua‐narewec.
Go dâŋ okacne bâtikie‐narezo murâ bâtikie‐narezemec. Go dâŋge biaŋne manasu biric erâ nore maio domazemec.
Manakic, nâhâc Anuture maio sâc mocjaha ekoperec, eki hâcne nâhâc mâmâc jaha afezi bâfuac‐nâfowec.
Irec go nore mi hâwicguzejec, no ʒoɋac sâko egarehuc mi bawahacgupemu.
“Go nore maio dâŋ mutec manapac, ehuc micfânâŋgere hazec râepac.
Go kecʒiŋuc hâcne mukomec: ‘No kiŋ tâmiric jukopac, no wiac hehesicne moc mi epo, â bahac moc mi bâfuapore maŋɋaɋac jukopac hâcne.
Anutuzi ine maŋgâŋ râsi enarehuc qa bâtiŋ enarekac.
E kike‐nane jâc fifitacko râehuc eebapa‐nane i me i honeocte ruc banareekac.’
“Manakic, no ʒiŋuc gazakopac: Go dâŋ mukomec i mi sâckekac; Anutu e ŋic mamana siricke‐fâreekac.
Ehame go wemocte ere manatec sâqoreha ʒiŋuc mukomec: ‘E dâŋnane i me i irec okacne moc mi bâtikie‐nareekac’?
Anutu e dâŋ mumure hata‐ticne fuŋne fuŋne fokac i ŋiczi hone takireeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋic nâŋâc ŋafeo guŋ fohapene Anutuzi guŋqâhâŋ enârehuc dâŋ nâzâekac.
Iŋuc enârehuc hazec‐nâŋec bâuŋtoekac, ehuc uŋ sawaŋ enâreme hâwic‐nâpoekac.
Nâŋâc maŋfefe mi ehuc sâqocne râpeckenaŋte Anutuzi iŋuc hâcne enâreekac.
Nâŋâc ʒikare micko fenʒipeŋte ŋezic‐nâpoekac, â nombâŋ mecnaonec wâc rocnâpoekac.
“Anutu e ŋic bâtiŋ‐nâpohuc mume huc fua‐nâreekac, â siec bibiric‐nâŋec ʒâicke‐fâreekac.
Ŋic hucheczi nânâre boc mi ecneekac, ehuc nânâ aŋacnere wâc maname mamakâcne eekac.
E sahac‐ticne waha‐fâreme siec sawa eekac.
Ehuc hâmoc haere biŋe eekac hâcne.
Ehame Anuture aŋelofâc guru dindiŋ jaŋe ŋic nâŋâc tiŋne jujure fuŋne nâzâ nâwotuc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec moczi ŋic e bafickeocte fuaocmuo
ine ere busâqoc manahuc Anutu ʒiŋuc âzâcneocmu: ‘No kiwiric‐ticne rokopacte bataratec hâmoc haeo mi huzejec.’
Eme eki manacneme ŋic e ɋiɋic qarâ mârâc tâpirihec juwec irec sâc jaha mocwâc bâfuarâ juocmu.
Ehuc Anutu numucneme micnao roocmu, erâ bubiaŋ manacnehuc araŋ bacneocmu, ehame Anutuzi manacneme kiŋfâsâc eocmu.
Ŋic e iŋuc fuacneme hofao fuŋne‐ticne ʒiŋuc mutaniŋkeocmu: ‘No sâqocne bâfuapo, ehuc wiac ebac epe sâqorewec, ehame Anutuzi ine sifu akicnuwec.
E iŋuc ehuc hâmockonec bataracnuwecte juju mocwâc fua‐nareme tatamacko jukopac.’
“Manakic, Anutu e wiac iŋucne ŋic nâŋâcnao arecne arecne baekac.
Erâ i ŋic juju‐nâŋec ŋezickehuc bârisie‐nâreme bubiaŋ faio ʒuhuckerâ junaŋte iŋuc eekac.
O Hiobe, go dâŋnanere hazec râec, ehuc niniŋkerâ ŋehaŋte dâŋ mupe.
Me dâŋ okacne bâtikie‐narezo murâ bâtikie‐naretec manazepac; go wiac ebac etec sâckewec; i jâmbâŋ mutaniŋkepemurâ enarekac hâcne.
Me dâŋ okacne arictac ekacko ine mâc niniŋkerâ dâŋnanere hazec râehaŋtec weniŋuc erâ maŋɋârâŋhec ezo irec fuŋne qazu‐garepe.”
Elihu e ʒuhuckerâ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec:
“O ŋicbureŋ, ŋoŋe ‘Maŋɋârâŋhec juŋgopeneŋ’ iŋuc muŋgopieŋte ʒi dâŋnanere hazec râeniŋ.
Nâŋâc nânâ wiac nâhonehuc, biaŋne me sâqocne irec fuŋne mana taraeŋgopeneŋ; iŋuc jaha ŋoŋe wemocte dâŋ moc manahuc, i maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ me mâcne irec fuŋne mi mana taraŋgopieŋ?
Irec ʒi dâŋ fuakac i biaŋne me sâqocne i mana wosâc erâ fârine mutaniŋkenaŋ.
Hiobe e ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘No bahacmâc jukopac, ehame Anutuzi ine sifu dâŋnane mi dopeckeekac.’
E ʒiŋuc hâcne mukac: ‘No burec ehuc, bahac bâfuapo iŋuc wemocko mupemu. No bahacmâc juhape sifu huc wic bâbâsomiene tâmiric fua‐narewec.’
Ŋoŋe ŋic Hiobe iŋucne moc honec‐jopa jumbieŋ me? E Anutu araŋ moc mi bacneekac.
E ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere guruo juocte aŋackeekac, ehuc ŋic hehesicne jaŋere hata wâc âteekac.
E ʒiŋuc hâcne muekac: ‘Ŋic moc e Anuture dâŋ mana rereŋ eocmu e wiac fârine i me i moc mi bâfuaocmu.’
“Ŋic mamanahec ŋoŋe irec hâcne dâŋnanere hazec râeniŋ: Anutu bapafâre erao eebapa sindaŋne â hehesicne moc mi fokac.
E ŋic nâŋâc wiac ebac eeŋgopeneŋ irec katucne bazu‐nâreekac, ehuc juju bapa‐nâŋecte sâcko furine nâreekac wâc.
Jâmbomac, Anutu bapafâre e wiac sindaŋne moc mi eekac, erâ dâŋnâŋec moc mi muhasickeekac.
Anutu e mo ŋic mozi tâpiri bâfuacnewec? Me mozi mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec guriŋ bapa âkendâŋnewec?
Anutu e jahacne sawa manasuhuc juju bâbâfua Mâro‐ticne nâwoc rome muzac
ine ŋic nâŋâc ʒeŋgoma hâmorâ mocwâc gâc wândoc efârenʒapeŋ.
“Ŋoŋe maŋɋârâŋhec juŋgopieŋko hazec râehapie dâŋ ŋazape mananiŋ.
Anutu e mumutiŋ dâŋ qaisockehuc guriŋ bapa gie baekac, ŋoŋe iŋuc muhuc tiŋne â tâpiri rune qorickezo muŋgopieŋ me?
Anutuzi hâcne ŋicwofuŋ â guriŋ bapa ŋic fekicne gâcne jaŋe sindaŋ hârindaŋ ehuc bâbâsifuc gie bapie mana‐jareme gâpâreekac.
Eki ŋic ʒeŋgoma bâfuac‐nâpowecte ŋic fekicne me moneŋ mafa sâkohec jaŋere maname feha hapetac jaŋere maname wawahane moc mi eekac.
Jaŋe ŋafeo ututuŋ jaha hâmoniŋmu. Anutu e ŋafe ʒâŋiŋkoa fisi‐jareme siroweniŋmu, e gie sâko moc mi bahuc acmâc jaha jopaocmu hâcne.
“Ŋic nâŋâc hata raeŋgopeneŋ i Anutuzi hone‐fâreekac.
Ŋiczi dapâc qisiric maŋnao raʒirâ Anuture maio soŋkerâ juju i moc mi fokac.
Ŋic nâŋâc Anuture maio fuapene dâŋnâŋec mutaraocte ʒâfo moc mi banâreekac.
E ŋic tâpirihec mu indiŋ boc mi ejarehuc mâc bârâriec‐jopaekac, ehuc âkehocfâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopaekac.
E eebapa‐jeŋicte fuŋne hone mana tarac eekacte ŋafeoa tuŋjopahuc qanʒaŋ‐jopaekac.
E ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ŋic gâcne jaŋere ʒâŋe faio imac‐jopaekac hâcne.
Jaŋe Anutu bâjâpeniŋte takic‐jopame behembiŋ, â sâcmutâc dâŋticne râpeckembiŋte iŋuc ejareekac.
Jaŋe ŋic qarâ suriŋne qa bâʒâic ejarepie Anutu kio wâwâsic ecnepie wira wâwâsic‐jeŋic manawec.
E ŋic nâŋâcne wira wâwâsic mi manaocmuo ine mozi dâŋ moc sâcne mucneocmu? Â ʒâŋe mai‐ticne bâsoŋke‐nâreocmuo ine ŋic mocjaha me guru sâkozi sâcne mi honenaŋmu.
Ehame ŋic ʒâʒâicne jaŋe guriŋ bapa gie bahapie aka wâc sâcne mi hejarenaŋmu.
“Hiobe, go Anuturao sâqocnege mufuahuc sâqocne mocwâc mi bacmurâ mupaŋkemeŋ me?
Go Anutuzi bahacge gaza gowatuc eocte moc numucnemeŋ? Â wiac hehesicne râpecke‐fârecmurâ musanaŋkemeŋ me?
Anutuzi wiac ebac eekac irec manatec mi sâckeha eki gore dâŋ reŋkehuc wiac ebac eocte mukic me? Erâ i nore wiac mâcne, i gore wiac, irec maŋgao dâŋ fokac i nâzâzemec.
Ŋic mamanahec jaŋe dâŋnanere manapie sâckeocmu, â ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe nore dâŋ manarâ ʒiŋuc muniŋmu:
‘Hiobe e ŋic mutucne jaŋe dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ irec sâc mukacte fâri tâmiric efârekac.’
Irec ŋoŋe dâŋticne mana wosâc ehuc ʒiŋuc mananiŋmu: E ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha mukac hâcne.
E sâqocne‐ticne râpeckeocte mi ecnekac, irec ʒâŋe fai‐nâŋecko âke sisic dâŋ muhuc Anutu maŋbâiŋ ecnekac.”
Elihuzi ʒuhuckerâ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec:
“O Hiobe, go ‘Anuture maio bahacmâc jukopac,’ iŋuc mutec mi sâckekac.
Me Anutu ʒiŋuc wiocnetec wâc mi sâckeocmu: ‘Nore sâqocnezi go wiac moc sâcne egareocmu me? No sâqocne tâmiric juhape wiac biaŋne moc mi fua‐narewec i.’
Irec ʒiŋuc manac: Go â âgofâcge ŋoŋe mâmâc dâŋ okacne bâtikie‐ŋarezo ekopac.
Faic qânikiŋ fokac ira ʒâŋe fitec feoc, erâ karoraczi gowaru ferâ fokac i wâc honezemec.
Irec go iŋucnezi sâqocne bahuc Anutu wemo wiac moc ecnecmu? Me hehesic bocjaha bâfuahuc e sâcne moc bawahacmu me?
Go tiŋne juhuc Anutu wiac mocte sâcne moc bafickecmu me? Aricne, e goraonec wiac i me i moc roocte mi muekac.
Go sâqocne bahuc ŋic âgofâcge jaŋe hâcne bâʒâic‐jopacmu, â wiac biaŋne ebac ehuc jaŋe hâcne bafic‐jopacmu.
“Ŋic jaŋe fific guguriŋ faio juhuc kio huse eeŋgopieŋ, ehuc, moczi bafic‐nâpozejec muhuc wira wâwâsic eeŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc ine dapâc qisiricko juhuc Anutu bâbâfua‐jeŋiczi bafic‐jopaocte tâpiri focneekac e mi riwaseckeeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc Anutu maŋɋârâŋ tahac‐nâpome wipe qowi jaŋere sâc jâuruŋgopeneŋ e mi numucneeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe maŋfefe ehuc ŋic sindaŋne jueŋgopieŋte babafic fua‐jareocte kio wâwâsic ehapie Anutuzi mi bafic‐jopaekac.
Anutu e bapafâre runezi ŋic iŋucne hone manac mi ejareekacte wira wâwâsic ecnepie fâri tâmiric eekac hâcne.
O Hiobe, go ‘Anutu mi honeekopac’ mukomeczi sifu rumerâ ere woŋec juzemec, gore dâŋ erao fokac.
Go ʒiŋuc hâcne manasuhuc jukomec: Anutu e mi bâtiŋ‐nâpoekac erâ sâqocne bapene iŋuc me iŋuc wâc mi enâreekac.
Go iŋuc muhuc fuŋne mi mana tarahuc dâŋ kosa murakomec, irec ʒuhuckerâ dâŋ mutec fâri tâmiric jaha eocmu i tâtâc fokac.”
Eme Elihuzi ʒuhuckerâ Hiobe dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go mi takicguha ʒuhuckerâ hazec râezemec, ehame no Anuture micte dâŋ gazape manazemec.
No ŋic mamana sâkohec jukopacte mamana fonarekac irec sâcko dâŋ muhuc Anutu bâbâfua‐nane e tiŋne rune jukac irec fuŋne mutaniŋkezepac.
No ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi gore maio domape honecnukomec, irec no dâŋ gazakopac i fârine sasawa.
“Manakic, Anutu e tâpiri sâko‐ticnehec, erâ mamana tara â maŋɋârâŋ irec fuŋqizecne jukacte ŋic kosa behe qaisoc mi enâreekac.
E sâqocne bapa mi akic‐jopaekac, ŋic tac qararacne jaŋere dâŋ ine mutiŋnehuc dopeckeekac.
E ŋic tiŋne ŋezic‐jopaekac, ehuc mana‐jareme ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe iŋucne gie‐jeŋic bahuc juhapie ʒâŋe biŋe‐jeŋic fuarâ raŋɋa raŋɋa foekac.
Me ŋic jaŋe sâqocne‐jeŋicte kâpâcwâru ficko ferâ ŋehapie
Anutuzi eebapa‐jeŋic sâqocne â qaqatara erâ maŋfefe‐jeŋicte fuŋne bataniŋkeekac.
Ehuc uŋsawaŋ dâŋticnere hazec râehuc hehesic‐jeŋic râpeckeniŋte fânoc hejareekac.
Ehame jaŋe Anutu dâŋticne mana rereŋ ehuc kiŋaŋ qacneniŋmuo ine wama faio juhâc qâhâmohapie dameŋ‐jeŋic taraocmu.
Me dâŋticne mana rereŋ mi eniŋmuo ine ŋic mutucne jaŋe iŋucne hâmorâ hâmoc haeo huniŋmu.
“Ŋic hehesicne jaŋe aariczi aaric bâfuaeŋgopieŋ ehuc Anutuzi qa bâʒâic ejareme maŋjeŋic bârisiehuc bafic‐jopaocte wira wâwâsic mi ecneeŋgopieŋ.
Sasecte ʒoczi ŋic ʒacjopame hâmoeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha jaŋe socɋâri juhuc juju‐jeŋic omaekac.
Anutuzi ŋic jaŋe fuŋne‐jeŋic mana taraniŋte ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio râec‐jopaekac, â ʒârâ hâriŋ bâfua‐jarehuc maŋhazec‐jeŋic bâuŋtoekac.
Anutu e go iŋuc jaha ʒârâ hâriŋkonec bataracgume mârâc jaha mazuc mâriri fogarewec irec sâc mocwâc fua‐gareme wama faio juhâc qâhâmocmurâ manasuhuc jukac.
“Ehame goki ine ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere sâc ehuc dâŋ muhasickekomecte okacne fua‐garekac hâcne.
Go aariczi maŋge fusucmame mu âke sisic ezicte â moneŋ mafazi fârecgume hata qâsoriezicte rucge bahuc juzemec.
Wira wâwâsicgezi fâri tâmiric eocmu â go gahacne tâpirizi wâc sâcne mi baficguocmu.
Go hae ŋafeocte boc mi hejâpezemec, ŋafeo hâcne ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe sipiricke‐fâreeŋgopieŋ.
Irec go aimuŋ juhuc ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere hata mi âtezemec, hata iŋucnao razicte hâcne ʒârâ hâriŋzi fua‐garewec.
Manakic, Anutu e tâpiri sâko‐ticnehec, e qaqazu sasawa jowaru‐fârehuc fekicne sâko jukac.
Mo ŋiczi Anutu eebapa‐ticnere dâŋ mutâcnecneocmu? Me mozi ʒiŋuc sâcne âzâcneocmu: ‘Go wiac ebac etec sâqoreekac.’
“Irec go manac: Ŋic jaŋe juwicnaonecteaŋ Anutu muteŋke wefuhuc jumbiŋ, go irec manasuhuc iŋuc jaha wâc muteŋkezemec.
Anutuzi wiac ebac ewec sasawa i ŋic jaŋe hone‐fârembiŋ, mocjaha, mamana tara ine sifu mi mana tarambiŋ.
Manakic, ŋic nâŋâc Anutu fekicne juju‐ticnere fuŋne mi manaeŋgopeneŋ, â jara dameŋ‐ticne i wâc wowosene tâmiric.
Anutu eki hâcne mume mâreŋ â hâwec jahere rombâŋzi sawao feekac, izi ine herisierâ hoe eekac.
Erâ ekizia mume hoezi karorac maŋkonec waharâ ŋic nâŋâc ʒeŋgoma heŋgumuŋ‐nâpoekac.
Karoraczi weniŋuc erâ rac warec eekac, â ɋuŋ parandaŋzi weniŋuc erâ herâ fârehuc raekac i ŋic nâŋâc moc mi mana taraeŋgopeneŋ.
Erâ ekizia wâc mume bâbâriczi sawa hetâcnerâ tamae raekac, ehame hâwec fâhâŋnao sifu dapâc qisiric jaha fokac.
E iŋuc ehuc ŋifec ŋic nâŋâc okacne bazu‐nâreekac, â ŋifec ine nânâ opâ aameo tahac‐nâpoekac.
E mejahec‐ticnezi bâbâric basanaŋkeha hata‐ticnao jaha bâricnehuc raekac.
Ehame ɋuŋ parandaŋzi fuŋne‐ticne ʒiŋuc bataniŋkeekac: E wiac sindaŋne sasawa i honehuc bune qâʒâfickeekac.
“Wiac iŋucne fuame hâcne buhândâŋ‐nanezi fâfârerâ ɋarac ɋarac qaekac.
Oi, ŋicbureŋ, ŋoŋe sasawa Anutu marac fânâŋ‐ticnere hazec râeniŋ, ehuc micticnaonec parandaŋ fânâŋ wahaekac i wâc mananiŋ.
Eki hâcne mume bâbâric‐ticnezi mâreŋ qaŋeŋne ŋifeckonec sawa hetâcnehuc ŋifecko ra qataraekac.
Bâbâriczi iŋuc ehame Anutu marac fânâŋ sâko‐ticnezi jai jowarecko rame micʒonʒoŋ‐ticne mana‐fâreeŋgopeneŋ, ehame bâbâriczi sueme sue bâricne raekac.
Anuture micte wiac fuaekac i hone wawarecnehec, erâ i ŋiczi mi mamana tarane.
Eki hâcne mume mâreŋko sinou wahaekac, erâ wâc ekizia mume hoe micsâko heekac.
E iŋuc ehuc ŋic ʒeŋgoma giere aka henâreekac, ehame ŋic bâfuac‐nâpowec nâŋâc ʒiŋuc mana taraeŋgopeneŋ: I Anuture gie hâcne.
Wiac i fuame qowi jaŋe wiwiri hawec‐jeŋicko ra soŋkerâ ŋec foc eeŋgopieŋ.
Mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋneheczi tiki mâreŋkonec wahaekac, â mâŋâŋ mâmâteŋ sâko‐ticnehec i wâc tiki mâreŋkonec jaha fisiekac.
Anuture micrombâŋzi aisi bâfuaekac, ehame opâ jaŋe sanaŋke‐fâreeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ Anutuzia wâc mume hoe heocte karoraczi gâpâreekac, ehame karoraczi bâbâric‐ticne bârâwiŋneme sâcke‐fâreekac.
Karoraczi Anuture mic reŋkerâ ririsiehuc rac warec eekac, ehuc mâreŋ ira me ira fuarâ Anutuzi gie mutâcnecneekac i bafâreekac.
Anutu e ŋic nâŋâc dameŋ mocko bâtiŋ‐nâpoocte, â dameŋ mocko ehâmo‐nâreocte mume mâreŋko hoe heekac.
“O Hiobe, go ʒiŋuc manac: Anutuzi wiac qeŋ bipinehec ebac eekac i moc hone warec ezemec.
Anutu e weniŋuc erâ wiac i jaŋe giedâŋ mujareekac, ehuc bâbâric mucneme karorac maŋkonec waharâ tamaehuc raekac, i go moc manaekic me?
Me Anutu e wiac bapa sariczi karorac bâfuame weniŋuc erâ faic sawao ririsiehuc rac warec eekac irec fuŋne go wâc manaekic me?
Aricne, go jowarec mâŋâŋzi qahuc hae mâreŋ qâkereŋkeme fâroroc‐ticnere fofoŋac hecmu sawa.
Go Anutuzi sambâŋ qaratieha sâcne bafickecmu, me aeŋ wiac rike sueŋkepene sanaŋkeekac irec sâc sambâŋ batec sanaŋkerâ foocmu me?
Maŋnâŋec omaeha dâŋ munaŋte quŋkeŋgopeneŋte Anutu wemo dâŋ moc âzâcnenaŋmu i goki qazu‐nârec.
No Anutuzi dâŋnane manaocte mocwâc mi numucnepemu, no iŋuc epe imacnuzacte hâwicnume behekopac hâcne.
“Mâŋâŋ qahuc karorac ficne sueme tâtieha qânikiŋ fuame ʒoaŋ ʒâziriŋko fipene ʒâŋe‐nâŋec âke hâpome fiqe ruruc eeŋgopeneŋ.
Faic mâreŋkonec furic râehame ware fisikac, ehame Anutu huriri saŋguac â huriri bojac bojac‐ticne hone ʒâireŋgopeneŋ.
Anuture tâpiri i qeŋ bipinehec, irec ere maŋfuŋko sâcne mi ra fisinaŋmu, e tiŋne rune jukacte ŋic dâŋnâŋec mutiŋne‐fâreekac.
Ehame, ‘nâŋe maŋɋârâŋhec juŋgopeneŋ’, iŋuc mueŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe hone takic ejareekac. Irec ŋic nâŋâc ʒeŋgoma ere hâwic‐nâpozejec.”
Eme Wofuŋ e ʒâʒâkiriŋ mâŋâŋmaŋko juhuc Hiobe dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mu wioc ecnewec:
“Go mo ŋic mo irec maŋɋârâŋ‐nanere manabâc ekomec? Manakic, go iŋuc ehuc mutucgere fuŋne sawa bataniŋkekic.
Irec go ŋic jâmbâŋ jukomecko faharerâ bifuŋge jomac, ehame no dâŋ mu wioc egarepe okacne bâtikie‐narec.
“Go wena juhaŋtecne mâreŋ bâfuapo? Irec go mamana sâko moc fogarekacko nazac.
Mozi sosoka‐ticnere sâc moc mutâcne‐narewec, me mozi sâcticne manaocte mucsâc fârewec?
Wâtuŋ wiac‐ticne i wemo wiaczi dopeckeme qiŋ herâ domakac? Me mozi bâpiŋ jaŋe ʒeri gae hehapie â Anutu aŋelofâcne jaŋe kiwac qawac ehuc semuja hehapie jâmâ wâtuŋ‐ticne râeme huwec?
<range>
“Hâwec sâko e mâreŋmaŋkonec qâcqâc qahuc wefume mozi fofo‐ticnao foocte kanaŋ hecnewec?
Noni hâcne hâweŋzi foŋkehuc karoraczi rufacnepo.
Noni hâcne hâwec maticne bafârepo, ehuc motâc hecnehuc basanaŋkepo.
Erâ wâc nonizia ʒiŋuc âzâcnepo: ‘Go ʒira ware mickezemec, ʒira hâcne siri sâkogezi bazuhuc fozejec.’
“O Hiobe, go ɋiegaonecteaŋ fuŋkerâ juwefuhuc mutec hae moc furewec me?
Me goki mutec hae fureme tatamaczi mâreŋ sâcke‐fâreha ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe haesoŋ‐jeŋickonec moc wahambiŋ me?
Ʒoaŋ tatamacko mâreŋ wâcne facne jaŋe qoruc hawari biaŋ irec sâc fua tâcneeŋgopieŋ.
Ʒoaŋte tatamaczi ŋic sindaŋne batamaec‐jopahame gie‐jeŋic sâqocne baniŋte quŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
“Go hâwec ʒâkâŋ maŋnao hurâ hâwec ʒâŋene moc honemeŋ, me hâwec fâhâŋnao rac warec moc emeŋ me?
Me hâmoc hae dapâc qisiric sanaŋ‐ticnehec irec motâc i ŋic moczi moc gowatuwec me?
Mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec sâc weniŋuc fokac i go moc manakomec me? Go wiac mukopac sasawa irec fuŋne moc manakicko dâŋ okacne bâtikie‐narec.
“Ʒoaŋ tatamac i wenirec ware fuaekac, â dapâc qisiricte qizecne wena fokac i go moc manakomec me?
Jahe wena ra mickenicmu i goki sâcne jasa jofatuc ecmu? Me sâcne bârisiec‐jofacmu?
Go wiac i sâcne efârecmu, i no manakopac, go ʒiŋuczia ŋicqizec jâmbâŋ jukomec, erâ go juhaŋtecne jaha mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ bâfuapo i!
“No sinou â aisi hândâŋ râe guruc eekopac situâc ficnane i go moc ra honemeŋ me?
No wiac i ʒârâ hâriŋ â ʒika dameŋte biŋe bâmockerâ râe guruc eekopac hâcne.
Ʒoaŋ wefuekac â mura mâŋâŋzi fuŋkerâ qawareku fisiekac go hae hata ira moc rameŋ me?
“Mozi hoe micsâkore wâc moc bawec, me mozi ɋuŋ parandaŋte hata bâʒâwewec?
Me mozi mume hoezi ŋic mi jujuo tuhu mâreŋko heekac?
Me mozi mâreŋ hâfu roroc ekicne i bâgunuckeme sopâc kecɋaŋ wefuekac?
“Hoere mamac moc jukac me? Me mozi maniŋ titikucte mamac bâbâfua ekac?
Aisi â titikuc i mo neŋgocte bumaŋkonec fuame opâ sasawa jaŋe sanaŋkerâ qânâ iŋucne eeŋgopieŋ â hâwec fainezi aisi efâreekac?
<range>
“Go demeŋ ɋafâc jaŋe sâcne dâtâc‐jopacmu? Me bobiri ʒâʒâfic‐ticne sâcne goroŋkecmu me?
Goki mutec bâpiŋ sasawa jaŋe dameŋ‐jeŋicko fua soŋ eniŋmu? Me mombaŋ bâpiŋ neŋgoc motec jaŋere hata sâcne jaza jowatuc ecmu me?
Go karoracte mumutâc fokac i moc manakicko ine mutec mâreŋte biŋe wâc sâcne eocmu me?
“Go karorac giedâŋ mucnetec gâpârehuc hoe erâ waha sâcne hembânâŋguocmu me?
Me bâbâriczi bâricneocte âzâcnetec sâcne waha fua‐garerâ ʒiŋuc gazaocmu: ‘No gore kiŋaŋ qapemurâ warekopac hâcne?’
Opâ rumi fisiocmu i mozi gararaweŋ wipe jazame manaeŋgopieŋ? Me hoe heocmu i mozi qâqâc ŋicne jaŋe mufua‐jareme manaeŋgopieŋ?
Maŋɋârâŋhec moczi karorac sâcne woseocmu me? Me mozi karorac herisierâ hoe hoŋkeme wahame
mâreŋzi qâhâckerâ bobohotac eekac?
“Laioŋ jaŋe qânâ hawec‐jeŋicko fohapie me sopâc uupicko ruc bahuc juhapie kâcɋene jaŋere nânâ sâcne bâfuacmu me laioŋ motecne jaŋe nânâ gumec‐jopatec nâ gapec sâcne eniŋmu me?
