<range>
Kâec kâec jaŋe nânâre hâmohuc sawao rac warec ehapie me motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe nânâre numu‐narepie mozi nânâ wiac‐jeŋic bâfua‐jareekac?
“Kâte noniŋ jaŋe mo dameŋko motec rocjopaeŋgopieŋ i go moc manakomec me? Me kâte bulimakao jaŋe motec rocjopahapie moc honec‐jopaekic?
Jaŋe mosa wezimuc kiwec‐jopa juku motec rocjopaeŋgopieŋ, go irec dameŋ moc manakomec me?
Jaŋe waha fohuc motec rocjoparâ izia mocwâc âke mâteŋ‐jopaekac.
Eme motec jaŋe neŋgoc mamac jaŋehec kâteo juhuc soka sanaŋ erâ behec‐jopa wiseeŋgopieŋ.
“Mozi kâte doŋgi rambaŋko râec‐jopawec, me mozi firuec‐jopame kosa rac warec eeŋgopieŋ?
Noni hâcne mâreŋ burocnezi fic hae‐jeŋic eocte ira râec‐jopapo, erâ wâc nonizia mana‐jarepe hâwec wâneŋko jueŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe hae fânâŋ sâko‐jeŋichec dic bajareeŋgopieŋ, ehame ŋic ŋoŋere gie baniŋte moczi moc sâcne bâmâteŋ‐jopaocmu.
Tiki mâreŋzi nânâ opâ bâfua‐jareekac, jaŋe ira hâcne juhuc sopâc kecɋaŋ biaŋne bâfuaniŋte babasa gie baeŋgopieŋ.
“Â kâte bulimakao momori jaŋe gore gie sâcne baniŋmu, me ŋafeo gore sapaoa sâcne domaniŋmu me?
Go bulimakao iŋucne jaŋe kioŋ râe‐jaretec mâreŋ bâbâfâuc sâqe sâcne fâreniŋmu, me giegao râec‐jopatec mâreŋ bambanʒaŋ sarac i wâc sâcne fâreniŋmu me?
‘Jaŋe tâpiri sâko‐jeŋichec,’ go iŋuc muhuctecne gie ŋemâcne mujaretec sâcne bagareniŋmu me?
Jaŋe qa roro dameŋko nânâ wiacge sâcne baware‐gareniŋmu, me jacgoŋ bâbâmârâŋ tomaonec hândâŋne ro nusec sâcne egareniŋmu me?
“Qera e fafakec‐ticne fâro jaha fucfuc qaekac, erâ ine sifu qeʒo iŋucne furuc furuc qahuc sawao mi raekac.
E hândâŋ‐ticne mâreŋ nuruŋko râeekac, â sohoŋ hehetaniŋ hândâŋ‐ticne e ine taicko ŋehuc hoticnezi hâroŋkeha juku âteʒuekac.
Qera e, ŋic me qowi wiac jaŋe fisirâ âtenʒaŋneniŋmu, iŋuc mi muhuc sohoŋ hehetaniŋ‐ticne kosa râeekac hâcne.
Eme juku âteʒume hone jauŋ mi ecneekac, ehuc hândâŋ râeocte ʒâic manaekac irec mocwâc mi manasuekac.
Noni hâcne qera maŋmutuc bâfuapore iŋuc eekac, no maŋɋârâŋ moc mi bâfuacnepo.
Gagasac‐ticne ine hâhâwicne jâmbâŋ, irec ŋic â qâto wise‐nâreekac.
“O Hiobe, becâsic tâpiri‐jeŋic i goki moc râe‐jaremeŋ, me upe gere‐jeŋic i goki bâfua‐jaremeŋ me?
Goki mujaretec hâpic gisic jaŋe iŋucne tara he tara he raeŋgopieŋ, me masu fura qapie ŋic ŋoŋe hâwic‐ŋopaekac me?
Jaŋe tâpiri‐jeŋicte manapie feha mejeŋiczi mâreŋ fârâeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe boc mi hâwic‐jopaekac, â ʒikare erâ wâc mi wiseeŋgopieŋ.
Rufâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ʒikare wiac bajueŋgopieŋ izi fânâŋkehuc ʒoaŋko bâricneekac.
Becâsic jaŋe tâpiri wânʒâŋ‐jeŋichecte gagasac jaha raeŋgopieŋ, ʒikare qeŋ dâŋeme mocwâc niniŋkerâ sâcne mi domaniŋmu.
Qeŋ dâŋeme sâc masu fura qaeŋgopieŋ, erâ taicko rahuc ʒikare âsu fâreeŋgopieŋ, ehuc momori micne jaŋe dâŋ mutâcne‐jarepie manaeŋgopieŋ.
“Goki piʒu piʒu jaŋe furuc furuc qaqare fuŋne qazu‐jaremeŋte fafakec‐jeŋic mâreŋ juwicpe qaratieeŋgopieŋ me?
Me tucwipe sâko jaŋe sareŋ‐jeŋic hozi‐jeŋicko baniŋte gore dâŋte woŋec moc jueŋgopieŋ me?
Aricne, jaŋe jâc ʒoricnao fic hae baeŋgopieŋ, ehame jâcbotâŋ susukune izi fic hae sanaŋ‐jeŋic eekac hâcne.
Eme irecnec fahare sâohuc nânâ qowi bâfuaniŋte wosaŋeŋ gie baeŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc wiac âsu gârecnezi fârec‐jopame nâniŋte tumaŋneeŋgopieŋ, â motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ine qowi socnehec nâeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ Hiobe dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“O Hiobe, go Anutu bapafâre nore manatec sâqorekac, go iŋuc ekomecte dâŋ gaza‐fârepac irec okacne bâtikie‐narec.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Hiobezi Wofuŋ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec:
“O Wofuŋ, no iŋucnezi dâŋ okacne moc weniŋuc bâtikie‐garepemu? No dâŋ iŋuc me iŋuc ʒuhuckerâ muzore mi enarekac.
No mârâc dâŋ muhuc gâcne musifuckepo, irec ʒi dâŋ i me i mocwâc mi mupemu.”
Iŋuc mume Wofuŋ e ʒâʒâkiriŋ mâŋâŋmaŋko juhuc Hiobe dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go ŋic jâmbâŋ jukomecko faharerâ bifuŋge jomac, ehame no dâŋ mu wioc egarepe okacne bâtikie‐narec.
‘Wofuŋ e wiac ʒi maŋgâŋ enareme mi sâckekac,’ go nore iŋuc muhuc gahacnere manatec tiŋne hawari ekac me?
No tâpiri fonarekac irec sâc jaha gorao moc fokac? Me nore marac fânâŋ i ɋuŋ parandaŋ iŋuc fokac irec sâc jaha go moc fogarekac me?
“Go tâpiri iŋucne moc fogarekacko ine faharerâ tatamac â ʒâŋe biŋe qonaŋketec izi erige ezejec, ehuc ʒai ʒonʒoŋ â huriri qâreŋge bâfuatec izi ŋaqige ezejec.
Go kimbeŋgere ʒoc ruqetec bâruŋkezejec, ehame maŋfefehec jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâfuac‐jopahuc bawahac‐jopazemec.
Jâmbomac, jaŋe siŋjeŋic qatarahuc bawahac‐jopa‐jâmbâŋkezemec, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine juju‐jeŋickoa henʒaŋ qanʒaŋ‐jopazemec.
Ehuc mâreŋmaŋko ducjopa‐fârezemec, â hâmoc haeo kâpâcwâru bacjopazemec.
Go iŋuc moc sâcne efârecmuo ine noni mumbiaŋgupemu, ehuc wiac i go gahacne tâpirio ekomec i mutaniŋkepemu.
“Go qowi sâko mako moc ʒâŋene Behemoto e honec; no go bâfuacgupo iŋuc jaha e bâfuapo, e bulimakao iŋucne sopâc kecɋaŋ nâekac.
Erâ sifu sasanaŋ‐ticne i fekicne jâmbâŋ, â sahac‐ticnere rua sasawa i sanaŋ qaŋqaŋne.
Gecticnezi ine qândâoŋnerâ jâmâzâc jâc iŋucne fe domakac â kike‐ticnere rua i râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne.
Siec wiac‐ticne sasawa i aeŋ bâbâroŋ sanaŋne iŋucne, â me kike‐ticne ine aeŋ sanaŋne irec sâc.
“Qowi wiac bâfuac‐jopa‐fârepo jaŋeraonec e hâcne hone wawarecnehec bâfuapo, tâpiri‐ticne i bâbâfua‐ticne noni sawa bawahapemu.
Qowi mimicne gâcne jaŋe tikio mamasiri eeŋgopieŋ e tiki irecnec hâcne nânâ bâfuaekac.
E gugucjâcte fuŋnao fomanaekac, ehuc ʒamac ʒamac maŋko soŋkerâ foekac.
Gugucjâczi mumuc qacneekac, â kakikic jâcte tieŋ taeŋnezi ficboze ecneekac.
Opâ rumi sâko fisime mi hâwickeekac, â opâzi ʒâŋe mainao âeckeme mâc baŋaŋkerâ foekac.
Moczi moc hawiczi hehawickerâ roocmu? Me mozi sâkenao finʒuŋ râerâ fâre wefuocmu?
“Go oâ sâko ʒâŋene Lewiataŋ e hawicko sâcne rocmu? Me nameŋ‐ticne bofackehuc mecqaŋeŋnehec muczi sâcne basanaŋkecmu?
Me go masune sâcne qâqâ hafecmu, me hawiczi mecqaŋeŋ‐ticnao sâcne hetec huocmu?
E behetec ra juocte numu‐gareocmu me? Me go ere busâqoc manacmurâ kio wâwâsic moc egareocmu?
Me gohec ʒâʒâfic ehuc dameŋ tâmiric kiŋaŋ qagarehuc juocte mupaŋkeocmu?
Me kiŋaŋ narufâcge jaŋehec mamasiri eniŋte wipe mâteŋne iŋucne sâcne bajucmu?
Me opâ qowi roro ŋic jaŋe furi‐ticne bafec bawahac ehuc dâŋgie moc baniŋmu? Me âbârâ ŋic jaŋe nareŋ gareŋ gie baniŋte sâcne hezuniŋmu?
Go sahac‐ticne sasawa saozi sâcne âke mârâŋke‐fârecmu? Me tepe motec sâkozi qizec‐ticne sâcne muru fâuckecmu?
Manakic, go ehec arec wâŋ sawa juju gie bacmu, erâ irec faicnao mocwâc bazore mi egareocmu; ehuc ehec juju gie bacmu irec moc mi nikecguocmu.
Ŋic moc e Lewiataŋ honeocmuzi hâbi‐ticne goroŋkeme mâreŋko waha qaocmu.
Lewiataŋ suruckepene momori jâmbâŋ eocmu, ehame ŋic moczi ere maio sâcne mi domaocmu.
Mozi ehec juju gie bahuc sâcne juocmu? Ŋic moczi iŋuc sâcne moc mi ejâmbâŋkeocmu, i aric kereŋne jâmbâŋ.
“Irec go hazec râehaŋ Lewiataŋ kike‐ticnere gazape manac, ehuc sosoka â tâpiri ɋicwânʒâŋ‐ticnere fuŋne wâc gaza mutâc epe.
Sahac‐ticne i ŋic moczi sâcne mi âkehockeocmu, erâ sahac‐ticne râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋnere ŋic moczi wâc sâcne mi âke mârâŋkeocmu.
Micsiec‐ticne gereŋ gereŋ qakicne i birihec domaha moczi moc micticne sâcne bâiŋdaŋkeocmu me?
E râpe siecnao garac‐ticne sanaŋ qaŋqaŋne birio râe‐fârekicne, erâ i qânâ takirekicne iŋucnezi keketeŋ jâmbâŋ forakac.
I keketeŋ â iitic jâmbâŋ fokacte ŋondeŋnao ira sawazi raʒic wefuc sâcne mi eekac.
Jaŋe ʒiʒimic keketeŋ erâ foŋgopieŋte moczi moc sâcne mi bârâwiŋ‐jopaocmu.
E kisiec qame ʒoc fuaekac, â ʒâŋe‐ticne i ʒoaŋzi wefuocte furic râeekac irec sâc bâruŋkeekac.
Micticnaonec ʒocbâruŋ wahaekac, erâ wâc ʒoc uucne wefuhuc iiŋkerâ raekac.
Ŋic ŋoŋe hofâ qinʒiŋ rikepie hosâc feekac irec sâc jaha hosâzi sâkenaonec wahaekac.
Micrombâŋ‐ticnezi ʒoc ficneme bâruŋkeekac, â micticnaonec ʒocbâruŋ wefuekac.
E upe‐ticne tâpiri sâkohecte ŋic jaŋe honerâ hâwic‐jopa‐fâreekac.
Sahac‐ticne i aeŋ iŋucne râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne sasawa, irec ŋondeŋnao urucne moc mi fokac.
Maŋticne i qânâ iŋucne hâhâwic‐ticne tâmiric, i buse iŋucne takirekicne â sanaŋ qaŋqaŋne jâmbâŋ.
Lewiataŋ e fahareme ŋiczi sawa mâcne, nemu jaŋe wâc honerâ hâwic‐jopame bititie sâqoreeŋgopieŋ.
E ʒikazi qa qâpuriŋ sâcne mi ecneekac erâ damu me tepe motec me biriŋ sâkozi tâpiri‐ticne wâc mi bawahaekac.
E aeŋte maname sopâc tinac eekac, â aeŋ bâbâroŋ sanaŋnere maname jâc semune tinac eekac.
E tepe moteczi muruzo epie mi wiseekac, â qânâ wickecnepie maname gâc tinac eekac.
Qândiŋte maname siŋsiŋ tinac eekac, â ŋic jaŋe damu wickecnepie mâc gâwie‐jareekac.
Meʒârâic‐ticne i kuʒi dâkâ micnehec iŋucne, irec hata rahuc sohoŋ wiac bâdoc qâdockeekac.
E hâwec hefâuckeme qaŋqaŋ eekac, â opâ ʒâkâŋko hume kuru bâbâc wefuekac.
E fifia bahuc rame opâzi fâuckehuc râpefuŋnao irisuckeekac, ehuc qârâhâc fuaekac.
Mâreŋko qowi ere sâc moc mi juŋgopieŋ, e wiac irec me irec hâhâwic moc mi bajuekac.
E qowi kâcɋene â piticne honec‐jopame wawahane efâreeŋgopieŋ, eki hâcne qowi momori sasawa jaŋere femicne juekac.”
Wofuŋ e dâŋ mutarame Hiobezi okacne kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec:
“O Wofuŋ, goki hâcne tâpiri rune jukomec i manakopac, erâ wiac i me i ezo murâ moc mi eipiecmu i wâc kâuc mi bakopac.
Go ʒiŋuc wio‐narekomec: ‘Ŋic mamana tâmiric go wemocte maŋɋârâŋ‐nanere manabâc ekomec?’ Irec ʒiŋuc muhuc gazakopac: No wiac fuŋne fuŋne â mâsi wiac qeŋ bipineheczi mamana‐nane sirickeekac irec fuŋne mi mana tarahuc mutuc erâ dâŋ musifuckepo.
Go hazec râehape dâŋ nazacmurâ mumec, erâ wâc dâŋ nazatec okacne bâtikie‐garepemurâ nazamec.
No juwicnao ŋic gâcne jaŋe sawa gore dâŋ mupie hazeczi manapo, ʒi ine ʒâŋe fâri‐nanezi go gahacne honecgukopac.
Irec no dâŋ muwarepo i manasurâ mimiekopac, ehuc ʒafe ruarâ rufemaŋko ŋehuc maŋnane bârisiekopac.”
Eme Wofuŋ e Hiobehec dâŋ mutara‐fârerâ Temaŋŋic Elifaʒi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go â âgo jahecge ŋoŋe Hiobezi fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkewec irec sâc mi mutaniŋkembiŋte kimbeŋ‐nanere ʒocbâruŋ fai‐ŋeŋicko râepe fekac.
Irec ŋoŋe bulimakao ŋicne 7 â lama ŋicne 7 jaha rocjoparâ kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Hioberao bacjopa rarâ kiŋŋeŋic taraocte qowi bâzi rikenʒepieŋ. Ehame kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Hiobezi ŋoŋere erâ numu‐nareme nunumu‐ticne manarâ kiŋ hurembiŋ irec okacne mi bazu‐ŋarepemu. Ŋoŋe Hiobezi fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkehuc dâŋ fârine muwec irec sâc mi embiŋ.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Temaŋŋic Elifaʒi â Suhiŋic Bilidadi erâ Namati ŋic Zofari jaŋe Wofuŋzi mutâcne‐jarewec irec sâc embiŋ; ehame Wofuŋzi Hiobere nunumu manawec.
Hiobe e âgofâc‐ticne jahec â moc jaŋere erâ numume tarame Wofuŋzi mocwâc ehâmocnehuc mârâc jaha wiac sasawa focnewec irec sâc sirickehuc wiac râcne tahac ewec.
Iŋuc ecneme Hiobe hahac ɋa seŋ qofâc‐ticne erâ âgofâcne sasawa jaŋe erao fisirâ ehec tiwâ bâzi nâmbiŋ. Ehuc Wofuŋzi wiac ʒârâ ʒâpânehec fai‐ticnao râeme fowec irec busâqoc manacnehuc mu bâmiriŋ ecnembiŋ. Iŋuc ehuc moneŋ â meo fefe wiac golzi bakicne râcne‐fârembiŋ. Ehame Wofuŋ e mârâc jaha Hiobe jambuŋkewec irec sâc jâuruhuc jambuŋkewec. Eme irec fârine wiac kecʒiŋuc fuacnewec: Lama 14 tauseŋ, kamele 6 tauseŋ, bulimakao 2 tauseŋ â doŋgi 1 tauseŋ.

Erâ ŋokâfâcne 7 â otâfâcne jahec â moc ʒuhuckerâ fuacnembiŋ wâc.
Eme mârâc otâ‐ticnere ʒâŋe Jemima muwec, â ere râpeo fuawec ere ʒâŋe Kezia muwec, erâ ʒâhec otâ‐ticnere ʒâŋe i Kereŋ‐Hapuc iŋuc muwec.
Hiobe otâfâc‐ticne jaŋe sasawa sahac hawari biaŋ, jaŋe iŋucne mâreŋ sâc ŋokac moc mi jumbiŋ. Ehame mamac‐jeŋiczi merâfâc wiac‐ticne bâtâc bahuc ŋokâfâcne jarewec iŋuc jaha wâc otâfâcne kâdoc qajarewec.
Hiobe e biaŋkerâ jara 140 sâko ʒuhuckerâ juwec, ehuc apa ŋosafâc‐ticne fua fepie honec‐jopa‐fârewec.
Iŋuc ehuc dameŋ ʒora jufeku ŋicqizec jâmbâŋ erâ hâmowec.
Ŋic kecʒiŋuc ere manape ʒerine ekac: E ŋic hehesicne jaŋere tutumaŋko mi juekac, me sindaŋne jaŋere hata mi âteekac, me mu âke sisicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko mi ŋeekac.
Iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋte sâcmutâc dâŋ ine mana aŋac eekac, â sâcmutâc‐ticne ŋafe ʒoaŋ sâc manatâc qâtâc eekac.
E jâc moc opâmecko sarakicne iŋucne, fârine i dameŋkoa fuaekac â rehacne mi ɋaŋaekac; eme gie wiac baocmu i fua biaŋ efâreocmu.
Ŋic hehesicne jaŋe ine iŋucne mâcne, jaŋe padi jawa mâŋâŋzi bawiseekac iŋucne.
Irec hehesicne jaŋe dâŋgieo qiŋ herâ mi domaniŋmu, â sindaŋne jaŋe tiŋne jaŋere tutumaŋko mi sanaŋkeniŋmu.
Wiac Wofuŋzi tiŋne juju jaŋere hata maname fokac i. Â hehesicne jaŋere hata ine raku sifucke sanaŋkeekac.
Qâpuc jaŋe wemocte jufâfânâŋ eeŋgopieŋ, â ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe dâŋ racne mana biric eeŋgopieŋ?
Wofuŋ â Mesia‐ticne râsi ejacteniŋte, mâreŋ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe meo roroc eeŋgopieŋ, â ŋicbomboŋ jaŋe ââte sanaŋ ehuc mueŋgopieŋ:
“Kâpâcwâru‐jekic hezupene wahaoc, niŋgiŋ‐jekic hetâcnepene rârieoc.”
Sambâŋko ŋeekaczi gâwiekac, Wofuŋzi honec‐jopahuc mu âke sisic ejareekac.
Erâ ine mana gâpâre‐jarehuc jazaocmu, kimbeŋko hâhâwic hejarehuc ʒiŋuc muocmu:
“Noni hâcne ŋicwofuŋ‐nane âkendâŋnepo, Zioŋko, nahacne tiri tikio.”
Wofuŋte mumupaŋ musokape. E ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go ŋokâ‐nane, go hâcne miŋecgac bâfuacgukopac.
Numu‐naretec ŋicne ŋicne biŋe qagarepe, mâreŋ qaŋeŋne rauckecmurâ qikiŋne‐garepe.
Goki aeŋ ɋaruczi qazuc‐jopazemec, afezi kuʒi bakicne iŋucne qanʒaŋ‐jopazemec.”
Irec ŋicwofuŋ ŋoŋe maŋfânâŋhec enʒepieŋ, mâreŋte guriŋ bapa, uŋdâŋ mananʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ araŋ bacnehuc kiŋaŋ qacnenʒepieŋ, jâjâwâckehuc kikene muduckenʒepieŋ.
E kimbeŋ qaŋareme hatao sipirickenʒipiŋte, kimbeŋ‐ticne afecnea bâruŋkeocmu. Ere dapeŋko soŋkeniŋmu sasawa jaŋere manapene ʒeri bubiaŋ eekac.

O Wofuŋ, guguriŋfâc‐nane jaŋe guru sâko; bocjahazi fahare râsi enareŋgopieŋ.
Bocjahazi nore kecʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: “E Anutuzi sâcne mi bafickeocmu.”
Wofuŋ go ine rârec rârec sabecnuekic, â keteŋ‐nane juhuc hâbi‐nane henareekic.
No hahaŋne bahuc Wofuŋ wiracneekopac, eme tiri tiki‐ticnao domahuc micnaneo roekac.
No waha fope guŋzi qâmâcnujec. Eme Wofuŋzi dopecnuekacte ɋârepac.
Ŋic teŋ tauseŋ jaŋe râsi enarehuc orâŋnuhapie, no jaŋere sifu mi hâwicnuocmu.
O Wofuŋ go faharec! Anutu‐nane, bataracnuc! Go râsifâc‐nane mauc‐jeŋicko jopaekic, ŋic hehesicne micsiec‐jeŋic qazuekic.
Sisipirickonec babatara i Wofuŋtao fokac. Jambuŋgezi gurufâcge qârufa‐jarezejec.

Sacfozic Anutu‐nane, go wira‐garepe mana‐narec. No gâŋgâŋko fohape sawane bâfua‐nareekiczi aki anonoc enarehuc nunumu‐nane manac.
Ŋicbureŋ, ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane ro waha âte eku wezimucko beheniŋmu? Dâŋ jawanere aŋac â burecte wosaŋeŋ gie, i mo dameŋko hetaraniŋmu?
No Wofuŋte biŋe epemurâ ro sakac enarewec, i ŋoŋe hone taranʒapiŋ me. No wira wâwâsic ecnepe Wofuŋzi manaekac.
Kimbeŋ qazo qaniŋ, mâc sindaŋ ine mi eniŋ. Fofo‐ŋeŋicko fohuc maŋzi mana wosâeniŋ, ehuc niniŋkeniŋ.
Taha fâri biaŋ râeniŋ, â mamanac‐ŋeŋic Wofuŋtao fooc.
Bocjahazi mueŋgopieŋ, “Wemocko wiac biaŋ moc honenʒapeŋ!” Wofuŋ, go ʒâŋe maige bâfeŋnetec tamae‐nâreoc.
Go nore maŋko aŋac ʒeri fekicne bâfuameŋ; nânâ mâriri dameŋ‐jeŋicko bubiaŋ mamana i wahakac.
Maŋbahac fâsâc waha fohape guŋzi qâmâcnuzejec; Wofuŋ gore micte hâcne wamao ŋec juc eekopac.

O Wofuŋ, go dâŋnanere hazec râec, huhuse‐nane mi mana takirec.
Manahaŋ owa‐nanezi hazecgao qaqazuoc, Wofuŋ Sâko â Anutu‐nane, nunumu‐nane gorao hâcne hefakac.
O Wofuŋ, go furickoa marac fânâŋ‐nane manaekic, uupictea taha bâmocke‐garerâ gore ʒâŋe fiekopac.
Eebapa repicne hohonebâc i Anutu gorao mi fokac, sâqocnezi gore maŋfuŋko jufofo i arictac.
Penaroŋ eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe gore maio mi domaniŋmu, sâqocne bapa sasawa jaŋere takicguekac.
Burecdâŋ eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopaekic, sochâro â eeatuc ŋic jaŋere takicguekac.
No ine miriŋge sâc tâmiric fokacte, ufuŋgao raʒizo mukopac. No tiri ufuŋge maickehuctecne, araŋ bagarehuc dape‐garepemu.
O Wofuŋ, go râsifâc‐nane jaŋere erâ, gahacne tiŋne hatao jowacnuzemec; hatage mai‐naneo bâwâneŋkezemec.
Jaŋere micko jâmbomac dâŋ moc mi fuaekac, sisipiric ine maŋkerâ jueŋgopieŋ; marac‐jeŋic i hâmoc qâŋɋâŋ bâbâfua, nameŋ‐jeŋic i wokemaŋ rurua.
Anutu, go mutec kiŋjeŋiczi kimuŋ‐jopazejec, ehame jaŋacne bitiŋko kinʒepieŋ. Sindaŋ boc eeŋgopieŋte tuŋjopazemec, go hâcne fegarembiŋ i.
Dapeŋgao soŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine ʒeri efârenʒepieŋ, jaŋe bubiaŋ gae hehuc jaha domanʒepieŋ. Â goki ine sacfozic ejarezemec, eme ʒâŋegere aŋac‐jopaekac jaŋe kiwae‐garenʒepieŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go hâcne ŋic tiŋne jambuŋkeekomec, go aki anonocge maruku iŋucnezi rufacneekomec.

O Wofuŋ, go kimbeŋko mi hanecnuzemec, erâ aaricko qa bâtiŋ mi enarezemec.
O Wofuŋ, no weaŋkekopacte wiac urucko enarec, me kike‐nane jâjâwâckekacte basanaŋnuc.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane wâc mâretec jâjâwâckekac Wofuŋ go muc, mo dameŋko taraocmu?
Wofuŋ go fotikiec, juju‐nane asao roc. Aki anonocgere erâ sisipirickonec bataracnuc.
Hâmocko gore mamanasu mi fokac i. Me hâmoc haeo mozi muga bagareocmu?
No husehuc foku rokawekopac; ŋafe sâc ʒâŋeuc‐nanezi fofo‐nane bânâŋke‐fâreekac, kiokupe bilaŋke‐nane bâŋgumuŋke‐fâreekac.
Busâqoc manakupe ʒâŋe‐nane kitutuckekac, kisâfâc‐nane jaŋe enarekupie ʒâŋe‐nane bâniniŋkekac.
Sâqocne bapa, ŋoŋe behecnu‐fâreniŋ, Wofuŋzi kifânâŋ‐nane manajec;
Wofuŋzi kio wâwâsic‐nane manajec, Wofuŋzi nunumu‐nane ro sakac ejec.
Kisâfâc‐nane sasawa jaŋe qurutuarâ weaŋkeniŋmu, ɋeŋfâfâc jaha risiehuc mimi‐jeŋic mananiŋmu.

O Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane, no gore dapeŋko soŋkekopac; guriŋnuŋgopieŋ sasawa jaŋeraonec baficnurâ bataracnuc.
Râsi e laioŋ iŋucne kisucnuzackohec, ehuc moczi mi ŋezicnuha omaecnuzackohec.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane, no keci jâmbomac epoo, eebapa repicne menaneo bohotakacko,
no âgo moc wamane juha wiac gâgâpâcne ecnepoo, me moczi râsi enareme nânâ mafa jâoc ropoo,
ine râsi e manacnehaŋ jâpecnuku bâfuacnuzejec, erâ âtefacnume mâreŋko qarâ fozepac, ehame ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane rufemaŋko duckezejec.
O Wofuŋ, go kimbeŋgehec faharec, go râsifâc‐nane ʒonʒoŋ maickehuc fejarec, go okac babazure dâŋ mumeŋzi nore erâ mana ɋâɋârec!
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe tumaŋnehuc rârecgunʒepieŋ, eme jowaru‐fârerâ faic ocna ŋeŋegao ŋezemec.
Wofuŋ go ŋicne ŋicne dâŋ mutara‐jareekic. No tiŋne‐nanere sâcko mutara‐narec, Wofuŋ; norao maŋtaniŋ fokac, irec sâcko hâcne.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere sâqocne omaeoc me! Ŋic tiŋne ine goki kime dopec ecnezemec, maŋ â mamanasu ba esâic ecneekiczi, Anutu tiŋne rune go hâcne.
Anutuzi maro‐nane jukac, eki hâcne ŋic maŋhumuc ŋezic‐jopaekac.
Anutu e mumutara tiŋne, erâ e ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne bune gâpâreekac.
Ŋic moc e maŋne mi bârisieme, Anutuzi sâqe‐ticne ʒâmuekac. Tepe‐ticnao gurutuc âteme hujec.
Ʒikare wiac hâmoc bâbâfuanehec bâmockewec, tepe qâtâcneme ʒocbâruŋnehec ra kicjopaekac.
Manakic, ŋic moc e maŋticnao sâqocne râe qâzuc eekac, eme sindaŋ kiweckehuc juku gibioc roekac.
E nombâŋ rorâ ba akic eekac, erâ nombâŋ bâmockewecko e jahac huekac.
Sisipiric bâfuawec izi ŋerisierâ runere sahacko kiekac, e jahacne sindaŋzi waha utu maine hefâuckeekac.
Wofuŋ mumutiŋ‐ticnere erâ daŋge âzâcnezepac, Wofuŋ, Femicne sâko, ʒâŋe‐ticne mumuteŋ gae hecnezepac.

O Wofuŋ, Wofuŋ‐nâŋec, ʒâŋegere micʒonʒoŋ mâreŋ sâc râreckehuc mo iŋucne fua rakac; go hâcne ɋuŋ ɋasaŋge sambâŋko musokaŋgopieŋ.
Gegecne â susuonec jaŋere mickonec hâcne. Kisâfâcge jaŋere erâ sacsanaŋ âkendâŋnemeŋ, râsi â okac babazu ŋic dâŋ fâsâe‐jareocte.
Sambâŋko ʒâŋe fihuc meqâreŋge honekopac, mosa â bâpiŋ basarickehuc râe rameŋ.
Go ŋic e wemomac‐ticnere manasucneekic, â ŋicte ɋâric wemo‐ticnere hone maiŋ ecneekic?
Sifu bafahare gahacne wahamicnao râemeŋ, ʒâŋe biŋe bâfuacnehuc tatamaczi erickemeŋ.

Iama bulimakao sasawa, kâte qowi wâc iŋuc jaha.
Erâ wâc sawa wipe â hâwec qowi, hâwecte hatagâŋko rac warec juekac, wiac i mâmâc sasawa.
O Wofuŋ, Wofuŋ‐nâŋec, ʒâŋegere micʒonʒoŋ mâreŋ sâc râreckehuc mo iŋucne fua rakac!

Maŋ hâcbuc jaha Wofuŋ go daŋge gazape, eebapage wawarecnehec sasawa musokape.
Bubiaŋ manahuc kiwae‐garepe, Femicne sâko go ʒâŋege mumuteŋ gae hecnepe.
Râsifâc‐nane jaŋe rârâpe wisehuc, fâfâc‐jopame maigao sipirickembiŋ.
Goki hâcne dâŋ nane ɋaɋacne i mu fâretiŋ emeŋ, go mumutara tiŋnezi eri ŋeŋegao ŋemeŋ hâcne.
Go ŋicne ŋicne hanec‐jopahuc sindaŋŋic bâsirowec‐jopameŋ, ehuc ʒâŋe‐jeŋic bâtâmiretec omatac fuawec.
Râsi omae‐fârepie sesuctac fofo sanaŋ fuawec, hae sâko‐jeŋic ŋerawec i wâtuŋne qârisiemeŋ, eme biŋe‐jeŋicte ninikec sanaŋ fuawec.
Wofuŋ e ine guriŋ bapa‐ticne dameŋ tâmiric foocmu, mumutara ŋeŋe‐ticne hesanaŋkeweczi qiŋ herâ ŋeocmu.
Mâreŋte faio mumutara gie bâtiŋnehuc baocmu, ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere dâŋ sâcjeŋicko mutiŋneocmu.
Wofuŋ e keke suec suec ejarekicne jaŋere huec sanaŋ, ro waha âte ejarehapie huec ejareekac.
Wofuŋ, ʒâŋege mana maŋ eeŋgopieŋzi gorao roweckeeŋgopieŋ, go wira basac egareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mi behec‐jopaekic.
Wofuŋ Zioŋko ŋec juc eekac e mumuteŋ gae hecneniŋ, gie baekac i ŋicne ŋicne jaŋerao musokaniŋ.
E socte kiŋ bataraekaczi manasuc‐jopaekac, qarâ suriŋne jaŋere wiwirare mi nikeckeekac.
O Wofuŋ, go aki anonoc enarec, qaisocnueŋgopieŋ jaŋere meo ʒâic bâfuaekopac honec; hâmocte motâckonec bafaharecnuekic hâcne.
Eme wiac embiaŋkeekic irec binaŋ bafârezepac, ehuc Zioŋte otâ ere hae ʒoŋao, hone baficgere ʒeri bari ezepac.
Qâpuc guru jaŋe jaŋac nombâŋ bâmockembiŋko hutâmirembiŋ, wiwitic soŋsoŋko râembiŋzi kike‐jeŋicko kiwec.
Wofuŋ e okacne dâŋ mujarehuc fuŋne‐ticne bataniŋkewec, ŋic sindaŋne eebapa‐jeŋiczi ufic ejareme jowambiŋ.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe hâmoc haeo hunʒepieŋ, ŋicguru Anuture ninikec jueŋgopieŋ sasawa jaŋe hâcne.

O Wofuŋ, go faharec! Ŋiczi pepec sâko mi ezejec. Ŋic gurune gurune gore maio dâŋgie banʒepieŋ.

O Wofuŋ, go wemocte taicko domahuc jukomec? Ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋko wemocte soŋkeekic?
Sindaŋŋic jaŋe pepec ehuc hapetac fific guguriŋ ejareeŋgopieŋ; jaŋac dâŋbitiŋ râeeŋgopieŋ ira kicjopazejec.
Sindaŋŋic e maŋticnere aŋac irec penaroŋ eekac, moneŋ mafare andac eekaczi Wofuŋ musoriŋkerâ râpeckeekac.
E sâke bâbâc ehuc Wofuŋte moc mi muekac, ʒiŋuc sawa manasuekac: “Anutu e mi jukac.”
Dameŋ sâc wiac ebac eme mâriri fuacneekac; gore okacdâŋ faic fokac, mi mamana‐ticne; kisâfâcne sasawa ine fura‐jareekac.
Maŋnezi manasuekac: “Mi rândiŋkepemu, dameŋne dameŋne ʒârâ hâriŋ moc mi maicnuocmu.”
Micticnao mumusoriŋ â eeatuc â ima bapa fuserâ fokac, nameŋnere rurumaŋko bâbâsifuc â hehesic soŋkerâ fokac.
E hae sâc somâ barâ foekac, soŋkerâ ŋeku ŋic bahacmâc qâhâmoekac, ŋic mamakucne honeocte ʒâŋenezi ruc baekac.
Laioŋzi uupicko foekac iŋuc soŋkerâ ŋeekac, ŋic mamakucne hâpoocte ruc bahuc ŋeekac hâcne, eku hâporâ repa‐ticnezi basanaŋkeekac.
Huacbucne qakume betaŋkeekac, tâpiri wânʒâŋ‐ticnere rândiŋke qaekac.
Ŋic sindaŋne e maŋnezi muekac, “Anutu e nikeckejec, ʒâŋe maine bâsâockejec, moc mi honeocmu.”
O Wofuŋ, go faharec; o Anutu go baficnuc! Ŋic qarâ suriŋne jaŋere mi nikecguoc!
Ŋic sindaŋhec e wemocte Anutu musoriŋkekac? Wemocte maŋnezi mukac, “Dâŋgie mi nareocmu?”
Go honeekic. Ʒâic serereŋ fuame qâoma mi eekic. Giene bacmurâ mamanagao râetec foekac. Huacbucnezi gore mamanac juekac, â goki bekâ mâsiŋ mamac rau ecneekic.
Go sindaŋŋic â sâqocne bapa meombâŋ‐ticne qazuzemec; eebapa‐ticne repicne irec bâbâtiŋ gie bazemec; bakutecne omae‐fârezejec.
Wofuŋ e Wofuŋ Sâko juraʒihuc juocmu sanaŋ, qâpuc guru jaŋe mâreŋ‐ticnaonec ratâmirenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ, go maŋhuhuŋ jaŋere wira wâwâsic dâŋ manaekic, go maŋjeŋic hutuŋkeekic â hazec râe‐jareekic;
ehuc bekâ mâsiŋ â ro waha âte ejarekicne, jaŋe ŋezic‐jopahuc dâŋjeŋic mutiŋneekic; eme mâreŋŋic moczi wiac gâgâpâcne mocwâc mi bâfuazejec.
No Wofuŋte dapeŋko soŋkekopac. Eme weniŋucte ʒiŋuc nazaŋgopieŋ? “Ŋoŋe wipe iŋucne tiki mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko wiseniŋ;
manaŋgopieŋ, sindaŋŋic jaŋe tepeo gurutuc âtepie hukac, erâ motecne tikocko heŋgopieŋ, dapâcko ŋic maŋhumuc muruc‐jopaniŋte.
Eme wiac ŋesiŋne qatarahapie, ŋic tiŋnezi wemo wiac moc eocmu?”
Wofuŋ e tiri ufuŋ‐ticnao jukac, Wofuŋte eri ŋeŋe sambâŋko ŋekac. Ira ŋehuc ʒâŋe fikac, mâreŋŋic ŋokac hone qârâwiŋ ejarekac.
Wofuŋ e tiŋne â hehesicne ba esâic ejareekac, moc e ʒikare aŋackeme ere takicke‐jâmbâŋkeekac.
Sindaŋŋic jaŋere faio ʒoc â kâmbâc sâqocne mume waha heocmu; mâŋâŋ sanaŋ ʒoc fâroroc‐ticnehec kâdoc qajareocmu.
Wofuŋ e tiŋne hâcne, eebapa tiŋnere aŋackeekac; ŋic maŋhumuc jaŋe ʒâŋe maine honeniŋmu.

O Wofuŋ, kuku! Ŋic mitihec arictac embiŋ, mâreŋŋic nâŋere ŋondeŋko dâŋfârio qoqohota omaembiŋ.
Mâmâc sasawa eeatuc eec eeŋgopieŋ, maŋjeŋicko râsidâŋ foha micbipic‐jeŋiczi âgodâŋ eeŋgopieŋ.
Micbipic wokemaŋ rua‐jareekac, â nameŋ penaroŋ dâŋ muekac, i Wofuŋzi hetâcne‐jarezac me!
Jaŋe ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: “Nameŋ‐nâŋeczi sanaŋkenaŋmu, micbipiczi bafic‐nâpoha mozi bawahac‐nâpoocmu?”
Qarâ suriŋne jaŋere ʒârâ hâriŋte erâ, â tac qararacne jaŋere kio wâwâsicte erâ Wofuŋzi mukac, “No ʒiŋuczia faharerâ maŋhâhâŋ ejarekac jaŋe juju biaŋ jarepemu.”
Wofuŋte mumupaŋ dâŋ i dâŋsaric, siliwa uucne kuʒio arec 7 rikekupie opâ eekac, ehuc ɋaɋac taeŋne fuaekac iŋucne hâcne.
O Wofuŋ, go dâŋ i basanaŋkehuc sabec‐nâpozemec, eme ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe wiac moc mi enârenʒepieŋ,
sindaŋŋic jaŋe ŋifec gafac masu wânʒâŋ juipiehapie, â mâreŋŋic ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko juju bapa repicnezi ɋârâŋke‐bipiehame.

Wofuŋ, go nore nikecgu sanaŋkekac i wezimucko taraocmu? Go ʒâŋe maige bâsoŋke‐nareekic i mo dameŋko taraocmu?
Buʒâic manahuc jukopac i wezimucko mâteŋkeocmu? Ʒoaŋ sâc busâqoc bajukopac i mo dameŋko omaeocmu? Kisâ‐nanezi nifepupu enareekac i wezimucko beheocmu?
O Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane, go fitec wareoc, micnaneo roc. Ʒâŋe‐nane batamaec, hâmocte guŋzi qâmâcnuzacte,
kisâ‐nanezi docke‐narekac muzacte, râsifâc‐nane jaŋe rândiŋkepe ʒeri enʒipiŋte.
No ine aki anonocgere mamanac jukopac, bâbâpiaŋgere erâ maŋzi ʒeri ekopac. No Wofuŋ gae hecnepe, e âgo jauŋ enarekac hâcne.
Mutucne jaŋe maŋjeŋiczi mueŋgopieŋ: “Anutu moc mi jukac.” Jaŋe repicne, eebapa‐jeŋic mamakâcne, moczi moc wiac biaŋne mi eekac.
Wofuŋ e sambâŋkonec fime wahaekac, ehuc mâreŋŋic ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko mamanahec moc juhuc, Anutu wira basac ecneeŋgopieŋ me mâcne i honeekac.
Jaŋe qâsoriekicne sasawa, ʒeŋgoma repirembiŋ; moczi moc wiac biaŋne mi eekac, arictac jâmbâŋ.
Sâqocne bapa, ŋicfâc‐nane ki sipiric ejareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe qicqucne jufâreŋgopieŋ me? Jaŋe Wofuŋ noraonec nânâ nâipiehuc, sifu no mi wâsicnueŋgopieŋ.
Dameŋ mocko bipic tatara embiŋ, ine Anutuzi tiŋne guru qâtec‐jopawecko.
Ŋoŋe ŋic qarâ suriŋne hata‐ticne hesifuckezo muhapie, eki Wofuŋte dapeŋko soŋkeme qurutuaniŋmu.
Zioŋkonec Israerao bâbâpiaŋ fuazac me! Wofuŋzi ŋicfâcne jaŋere juju hata herisieocmuo ine Jakobozi ʒeri eocmu, â Israezi bubiaŋ manaocmu.
O Wofuŋ, mozi qoruc bozegao ŋec foc eocmu? Mozi tiri tikigao juocmu?
Bahacmâc juhuc wiac‐ticne ebac eekac, â maŋticnaonec dâŋ fârinea utuekac eki.
Erâ nameŋnezi micko âkec dâŋ mi eekac, me âgo‐ticne sâqocne moc mi ecneekac, me qomâ‐ticne mi musoriŋkeekac ŋic iŋucne hâcne.
Erâ ŋic tuŋjopakicne jaŋere maname wahaekac, â Wofuŋ araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine sâsec‐jopaekac; erâ wâc Anuture maio dâŋ moc mupaŋkerâ, ʒâhec honeme ŋemâckeme sifu fârine bâfuaekac.
Moc ine moneŋ‐ticne ŋic qikiŋne‐jareekac, i okacne fehuc risiecneocte manasuhuc mi eekac; erâ wâc ŋic bahacmâc ere dâŋ muhasickeocte moneŋ râcnezo mupie qikiŋneekac. Wiac iŋucne eocmu e qiŋ herâ domaocmu.
O Anutu, go hone kitaŋ enarec, no gore dapeŋko soŋkekopac.
No Wofuŋ âzâcnekopac, “Go Wofuŋ‐nane, go maŋboreŋ‐nane mocjaha junarekic.”
Â mâreŋ ʒira mitiŋic juŋgopieŋ jaŋere mukopac, jaŋe furi sâkofâc‐nane, jaŋerao aŋac‐nane fokac.
Nemu mocte wowosâe jaŋe maŋʒârâ bocjaha fua‐jareekac. No soczi taha bapa gie‐jeŋicte takicnukac, â nemu ʒâŋe‐jeŋic mu bâuac mi epemu.
Hesarac mâreŋ â nânâ kâdoc‐nane i Wofuŋzi ekac, go hâcne mâreŋ biŋe‐nane basanaŋkekic.
Gaŋrukec mâreŋ biaŋnao râe‐narekicne, merâfâc‐nane honepe aŋacne ekac.
Wofuŋ, dâŋ mu henunuc enareekac, e muafeckekopac, ŋafeo buhândâŋ‐nanezi wâc mu qâmoc enareekac.
No Wofuŋ maŋzi fârepe mai‐naneo domahuc juekac, e fâre‐naneo domaha biric boroc mi epemu.
Irec bunane biaŋkeme maŋzi mu ʒeri ekopac, erâ sahac‐nanezi wâc sâcne ŋec foc eocmu.
Go qaisocnutec hâmoc haeo mi ʒâziŋkepemu, â tiriŋicge behetec gârecke ʒaŋ mi eocmu.
Go jujure hata nowatuekomec; go hâcne juekicko bubiaŋ guru fufusuc fokac, mefâregao aŋac bajukic i mi tatarane.
O Wofuŋ, dâŋ tiŋne manac! Wâwâsic‐nanezi bâfuacguoc! Eatuc tâmiric numu‐garekopac, hazec râec!
Goki dâŋnane mutarazemec, gore ʒâŋezi wiac hone jaŋgeŋkeocmu.
Go maŋnane esâickecmu me ŋafeo iqicnucmu, me ba esâic enarecmuo, ine mamanasu sâqocne mi bâfuacmu. Micnanezi aka mi qambaraŋkeekac.
Ŋic jaŋe wiac kosa ehapie, no gore mic reŋkehuc, ʒika qaqa jaŋere hata mi âtepo.
No gore itiroc bâjâpehuc jupo, hatage mi âte sifuckepo.
No wâsicgukopac, Anutu, go micnaneo sâcne rocmu; hazec râerâ dâŋnane manac.
Mâsi bahuc aki anonocgere fuŋne bataniŋkec; râsi wise‐jarehuc mefâregao dapeŋ bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, ŋic i jaŋere bâbâpiaŋ juekic.
Ʒâŋe hândâŋge iŋucne bajucnuzemec, fakec rurumaŋgao hefacnuzemec,
ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe sipiricnuzo eŋgopieŋ, râsifâc‐nane jaŋe hâmoc bâfua‐nareniŋte somâ râe‐nareŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Wokemaŋ dâŋjeŋiczi busâqoc mamana bâniniŋke‐jarewec, micjeŋicko penaroŋ dâŋ fuaekac.
Jaŋe bâjâpecnu wareku orâŋnuŋgopieŋ, hetapaicnupie mâreŋko qarâ fopere ejarekac.
Laioŋzi qowi kiocte ʒawieekac iŋuc eŋgopieŋ, laioŋ motecne uupicko ruc barâ foekac irec sâc.
O Wofuŋ, go fahare maic‐joparâ herândiŋ‐jopac! Ʒikazi juju‐nane sindaŋŋic jaŋere meonec batarac.
O Wofuŋ go megezi ŋic jaŋeraonec bataracnuc, juju kâdoc‐jeŋic mâreŋte wiacko fokac jaŋeraonec hâcne. Wiac bâmocke‐jaremeŋ izi hobu‐jeŋic fusucmazejec, naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe wâc sâcjopame jaŋere ɋiefâc jaŋe tiwâne ronʒepieŋ.
No ine tiŋke biaŋ ekicnezi gore ʒâŋe mai honezepac, mana ɋâɋârehuc hawarige honerâ gapecnuzejec.

O Wofuŋ, tâpiri‐nane, no maŋzi jauŋgukopac.
Wofuŋ e qânâ tiki‐nane â huec‐nane â babatara‐nane. Anutu‐nane e nore jâc, dapeŋ‐ticnao soŋkekopac. E maro‐nane â bâbâpiaŋte wâtuŋ‐nane â hae sanaŋ‐nane.
No Wofuŋ, mumuteŋte hozi, e wira wâwâsic ecneekopac, eme râsifâc‐nane jaŋeraonec bataracnuekac.
Hâmocte repazi hariŋnuwec, sisipiricte rumizi bârârâŋnuwec;
hâmoc haere niŋgiŋ qâfisecnuwec, hâmocte bitiŋ bâmbeŋkepo.
Bipic tara‐nareme Wofuŋ wâsickepo, Anutu‐nanezi baficnuocte ki owa epo. Ufuŋ‐ticnao marac fânâŋ‐nane manawec, ki owa‐nanezi hazec‐ticnao qaqazuwec.
Eme mâreŋzi ɋiɋiteckerâ suriŋkewec; tikire hobeteŋne wâc ɋarac ɋarac qawec; i ere kimbeŋte iŋuc fuawec.
Sâke hawec‐ticnaonec hosâc wahawec, micticnaonec ʒocbâruŋ wefuwec, ʒoc kine iiŋnerâ râwiŋnewec.
E sambâŋ bârâriehuc tara wahawec, kike rurumaŋ‐ticnao duŋdapâc fowec;
kerubim fainao ŋehuc sawao warewec, mâŋâŋte faio acmâc jaha wahawec.
Dapâczi foŋkehuc ŋaqi ecnewec, karorac opâneheczi orâŋkehuc ficboze ecnewec.
Mai‐ticnao tatamac fowec irecnec hoe sanaŋ hândâŋne â ʒoc uucne, karorac‐ticne hemârâŋkerâ wahawec.
Wofuŋzi wâc sambâŋko ɋuŋ hewec, Femicne Sâkozi dâŋfânâŋ ewec, hoe sanaŋ hândâŋne â ʒoc uucnehec.
E tepe‐ticne qâtâcneme râwiŋnerâ rame tâtiembiŋ, bâbâric‐ticne wicke‐jareme hâwic‐jopame wisembiŋ.
Eme hâwec ʒâkâŋ fâhâŋne tâtâc fuawec, â mâreŋte hobeteŋzi fua taniŋkewec. O Wofuŋ, hahanec dâŋgere iŋuc ewec, kimbeŋgere micrombâŋ hâcne.
E faic juhuc meticne sicnerâ rocnuwec, ʒâkâŋ sâkoonec fârecnume wefupo.
Râsi wânʒâŋ‐nanere meonec bataracnuwec, â qaisocnumbiŋ jaŋere tâpirizi siricnuha sifu mejeŋickonec bâhocnuwec.
Dameŋ gâgâpâcne maicnume quruŋ herâ fisi‐narembiŋ, ehame Wofuŋzi ine sacfozic enarewec.
E unucnurâ toma sâkoo râecnuwec, nore aŋackewecte bataracnuwec.
Wofuŋ e tiŋne jupo irec furine narewec, menane ɋaɋacne honehuc okacne bazu‐narewec.
No Wofuŋte hata paŋʒâic bâjâpepo, â sindaŋ ehuc Anutu‐nane mi râpeckepo.
Tiŋne juju‐ticnere dâŋ i dameŋ sâc hone dendeŋneekopac, â dâŋsanaŋ‐ticne moc mi bâsuepe raekac.
No ere maio bahacmâc jupo, â kiŋhec ezipore bâec bahuc jupo.
Irec Wofuŋzi tiŋne juju‐nanere sâcko okacne narewec, menane ɋaɋacne fome ʒâŋenezi honewec irec sâcko.
Ŋic maŋuruchec e maŋuruc hawari fuacneekic, ŋic siocmâc e siocmâc hawari fuacneekic.
Ŋic maŋɋaɋac e maŋɋaɋac hawari fuacneekic, ŋic bâbâŋoricne e bâbâŋoricne hawari fuacneekic.
Ine hâcne, ŋic waha qaqane bafic‐jopaekic, â maŋfefe ʒâŋe fieŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine bawahac‐jopaekic.
Jâmbomac, goki lambe qaze‐nareekic, go Wofuŋ Anutu‐nanezi dapâc‐nane batamaeekic.
Jâmbomac, gohec râsi guru sâcne qâtâtiec‐jopapemu, no Anutu‐nane gohec qânâsac sâcne qambaraŋkepemu.
Anuture hata i qarâ biaŋ, Wofuŋte dâŋ i fâri fideteŋ, ere dapeŋko soŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma sabec‐jopaekac.
Wiac Wofuŋtao ʒuhuckehuc mo Anutu mo jukac? Me Anutu‐nâŋectao ʒuhuckehuc mo qânâ sanaŋ mo domakac?
Anutu eki hâcne tâpiri joma‐narewec, erâ wâc hata‐naneo ʒârâ ʒâpâ bârâriewec.
Kike râe‐narewec i kâte bulimakao jaŋere kike iŋucne, erâ tikitoŋko âkendâŋnuwec.
E menane ʒika gie qazucnewec, eme aeŋ tepe neŋgoc sâcne fârehuc juekopac.
Goki sâsâoc maro biaŋge tahacnumeŋ, â mefâregezi âkesiŋnumeŋ, erâ hone maiŋ enarehaŋ sokapo.
Go âte sanaŋkepemurâ mâreŋ sawane bâfua‐naremeŋ, eme kike‐nanezi biric borocne mi ewec.
No râsifâc‐nane jâpec‐jopa raku siric‐jopapo, erâ omaec‐jopaku jaha risiepo.
Henʒaŋ‐jopakupe fahareniŋte eipiembiŋ, kike‐nanere rurumaŋko rândiŋkerâ fombiŋ.
Ʒika qaqare tâpiri joma‐naremeŋ, ehuc râsifâc‐nane bârokawec‐jopatec docke‐narembiŋ.
Go râsifâc‐nane ejarekutec râpecnurâ wisembiŋ, eme qaisocnumbiŋ jaŋe imac‐jopapo.
Jaŋe kio wâwâsic embiŋ, eme ŋeŋezic moc mi fuawec; i Wofuŋtao embiŋ, eme dâŋ okacne mi risiewec.
Henʒaŋ‐jopakupe mâŋâŋzi rufe ficne sueekac iŋucne embiŋ, hae ʒoŋaonec jawa sânʒâŋ beheeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc behec‐jopapo.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋehec ʒika qawefuhape baficnumeŋ, qâpuc guru jaŋere micne râecnumeŋ, ŋicguru kâuc bacjopapo jaŋe kiŋaŋ qanarembiŋ.
Biŋe‐nane manarâ izia micnane reŋkembiŋ, ŋic furunezi fisirâ dape‐narembiŋ.
Ŋic furune jaŋe hâbi‐jeŋic goroŋkewec, eme ɋarac ɋarac qahuc huec‐jeŋickonec wahambiŋ.
Wofuŋ e jukac. Qânâ sanaŋ‐nane e muteŋkezo, bâbâpiaŋ Anutu‐nane e mucne bacnezo.
Anutu eki hâcne mana‐nareha okacne bazu‐jarepo, e hâcne ŋicguru bâuruŋ‐jopame nore rurumaŋko raʒimbiŋ.
E hâcne râsifâc‐nane jaŋeraonec bataracnuwec. Jâmbomac, goki bafaharecnutec râsifâc‐nane siric‐jopapo, jâmbomac, goki ʒika qaqa jaŋeraonec bataracnumeŋ.
Wofuŋ, go iŋuc emeŋte qâpuc jaŋere guruo muafecgupe, â ʒâŋege mumuteŋ gae hecnepe.
Go ŋicwofuŋge aŋac ʒeri tahackekic, â wokemaŋ ruacnemeŋ aki anonoc bâfuacnekic, Dawidi â ɋâricfâcne tatara tâmiric.

Sambâŋ jaŋe Anuture eri tatamac mufuaeŋgopieŋ, meqâreŋ‐ticne qânikiŋzi musokaekac.
Ʒoaŋ moczi ʒoaŋ âgone dâŋ qâmockecneekac, ŋafe moczi ŋafe âgone biŋe âzâcneekac.
I mumac qamanac eene mâcne, me nazaŋ gazaŋ wâc arictac, marac fânâŋ hazeczi mi mamanane;
eha sifu micfânâŋ‐jeŋiczi mâreŋ sâcke‐fâreekac, â dâŋjeŋiczi mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao fisiekac. Ira hâcne Anutuzi ʒoaŋ boze bacnewec.
Eme eki socɋâri moczi ficticnaonec fahareekac irec sâc wefuekac, ehuc momori ŋic iŋucne hata‐ticne âteocte aŋackeekac.
Wewefu‐ticne sambâŋ qaŋeŋnao wefuekac, â huhu‐ticne sambâŋ dowaŋnao huekac, â fâroroc‐ticnezi wiac moc mi bâtiriekac.
Wofuŋte sâcmutâc dâŋ i qarâ biaŋ, maŋ qâqâtâc âke ɋâreekac; Wofuŋte mumutaniŋ dâŋ i fârine, ŋic maŋtac maŋɋârâŋ bacjopaekac;
Wofuŋte muqâmoc dâŋ i fâretiŋ, ʒeri bubiaŋ bâfuaekac; Wofuŋte sâcmutâc sanaŋ i nanaŋ ʒurec ʒurecne, ŋicʒâŋe batamaeekac;
Wofuŋ araŋ babacne i ɋaɋacne, dameŋ sâc fohuc juocmu; Wofuŋte mumutâc dâŋ i fâri fideteŋhec, erâ tiŋne sasawa.
Erâ i gol sirickehuc furi sâko ekac, gol emataucke‐hâmokicne mâmâc sirickekac; erâ wâc baŋacte aŋac qâhucke‐fârekac, â bore wâc iŋuc jaha.
Dâŋ i sasawazi kiŋaŋŋicge nore uŋsawaŋ eekac wâc; moczi reŋkeocmu e furine fekicne roocmu.
Erâ mozi bâbâsifuc‐ticne hone taraocmu? Bahac soŋne mutâmire‐narec.
Maŋfefe bahac irec wâc sabecnuzemec, izi ŋicbomboŋ mi enarezejec. Eme no ŋicsaric juhuc, bahac ŋemâcne mi bâfuapemu.
Go micbipic‐nanere dâŋ â maŋnanere mamanasu, i hone manac etec sâckezejec, o Wofuŋ, jâcnane â bâbâpiaŋ‐nane.

Wofuŋ e ʒârâ ʒâpâ dameŋko dâŋge manazejec, Jakobore Anutuzi sabecguzejec.
E tiri ufuŋko juhuc baficguzejec, â Zioŋkonec dope bâfua‐garezejec.
Go taha bacnehuc juekic irec manasuzejec, â bâzi rikecnehuc juekic i mana biaŋkezejec.
Aŋacgezi wiac fâreekac i tahacguzejec, â mamana birige fokac irec fârine bâfua‐garezejec.
Eme ʒikao sanaŋketec saoreŋ qanʒepieŋ, â Anuture ʒâŋeo filac‐nâŋec fârepene fezejec. Wofuŋzi nunumuge mana‐fârezejec.
Miŋecne manakopac, Wofuŋzi ŋicwofuŋ wokemaŋ ruacnewec e bafickekac; tiri sambâŋ‐ticnao juhuc manacnekac. ehuc mefâre‐ticnezi bafickekac.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe keretacko me becâsicko roweckeeŋgopieŋ, nâŋâc ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec ere ʒâŋeo roweckeŋgopeneŋ.
Jaŋe rândiŋkerâ waha jopaekac, nâŋâc ine qiŋ herâ domanaŋmu.
O Wofuŋ, go ŋicwofuŋ ʒikao sasanaŋ tahackec. Wiwira‐nâŋec manazemec.

O Wofuŋ, ŋicwofuŋzi gore tâpirio bubiaŋ manakac, â bafickemeŋte wemo afecne kiwaekac!
Goki maŋticnere aŋac tahackemeŋ, â nunumu‐ticne mi qatarameŋ.
Gore jambuŋzi wiac biaŋ bâfuacnemeŋ, â ŋicwofuŋ du golzi bakicne qizecnao hemeŋ.
Jujure numu‐garewec, eme juju tahackemeŋ, jarane jarane, tatara tâmiric.
Goki baficketec ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne faharewec, eri tatamac â ɋuŋɋasaŋ bâfuacnemeŋ.
Jambuŋ sâkohec jusanaŋkerâ juocte mucnemeŋ, gore maio bubiaŋ manahuc jusarickeocte râemeŋ.
Ŋicwofuŋ e Wofuŋte roweckekac hâcne, eme Femicnere aki anonoczi dopeckeme qiŋ herâ domaocmu.
Megezi râsifâcge sasawa bâfuac‐jopaocmu, mefâregezi gore takic‐jopaekac jaŋe bâfuac‐jopaocmu.
Goki ʒoc iŋucne fua tâcnehuc ʒâmiziec‐jopacmu. Wofuŋ e kimbeŋ‐ticnezi ɋâcjopaocmu, â ʒocbâruŋzi ʒâseŋ‐jopaocmu.
Go ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic mâreŋkonec bâsirowec‐jopacmu, ɋiefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mâreŋŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko omaeniŋmu.
Jaŋe eatuc ehuc wiac sâqocne egareniŋte manasueŋgopieŋ, sifu fârine mi bâfuaniŋmu.
Tepegezi ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋicko ma bacmu, ehuc qa jâpec ejaretec wiseniŋmu.
O Wofuŋ, go tâpirigehec faharec! Ɋicwânʒâŋge gae hehuc muafeckenaŋmu.

Anutu‐nane, Anutu‐nane, wemocte behecnukomec? Wemocte mi babaficnu â ki owa‐nane mi mamana taic jukic?
O Anutu‐nane, no ʒoaŋko ki owa epe dâŋ mi bârisiekic, erâ ŋafeo wâc epe bâbâmiriŋ mi fua‐narekac.
Erâ sifu manakopac, go tiri jukomec, â Israe ŋic jaŋere mumuteŋzi gore eri ŋeŋe ekac.
Mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe gorao roweckembiŋ, roweckepie goki batarac‐jopameŋ.
Wira wâwâsic egarepie asao rocjopameŋ; gorao roweckembiŋte mi qurutuambiŋ.
No ine ɋâsu, no ŋic mâcne; ŋiczi nifepupu enareŋgopieŋ, ŋic ŋokac jaŋe mana wahacnuŋgopieŋ.
Honecnueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mururuc enare‐fâreeŋgopieŋ, mecpiroc enarehuc qizec fofotaric enarerâ mueŋgopieŋ:
“E mamanasiŋ‐ticne Wofuŋtao râeme fowecte eki bataraoc, â ere ecnekacte asa feferaŋko rooc me!”
Goki hâcne neŋgoc bumaŋkonec enaretec fuapo, goki moŋ nâhuc fohape ŋezicnumeŋ.
Fuapoonecteaŋ gorao fosiŋnerâ foekopac, neŋgoczi rocnuweckonecteaŋ Anutu‐nane erâ juekic.
Irec ʒi ʒârâ ʒâpâzi bâmbeŋnukacko, â babafic‐nane moc mi jume honekopacko, goki taicko mi mac junarec.
Râsi bocjahazi bulimakao iŋucne somâcnuŋgopieŋ, Basaŋkonec bulimakao momori jaŋe orâŋnuŋgopieŋ;
no maicnuhuc micjeŋic aŋkeŋgopieŋ, laioŋ wânʒâŋ iŋucnezi owacke‐nareŋgopieŋ.
Opâ iŋucne hoŋnupie ŋeratierâ fokopac, me kike bibiric‐nane ŋetara‐fârejec; buhândâŋ‐nane sâfâ iŋucne ejec, bumaŋ‐naneo oopâne fuahuctecne.
Tâpiri‐nanezi hahaŋkerâ kuʒi dâkâ iŋucne ejec, nameŋ‐nanezi ŋaŋarac‐naneo bohotakac, hâmocte meo râecnukomec hâcne.
Ojai, sâqocne bapa guruzi orâŋnuŋgopieŋ, qâto iŋucne rârec bârârec doma raŋgopieŋ, me kike‐nane âke mârâŋkembieŋ.
Siec‐nane tâtâc fuame sâcne wowosene ekac, râsifâc‐nane jaŋe fipie wareme honecnuhuc kiwaeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋaqi‐nane ɋâsâi qahuc rusâc eŋgopieŋ, â rurufa‐nane rune âke fuaocte ɋâsâi qaŋgopieŋ.
Erâ Wofuŋ go ine taicko mi juc! Tâpiri‐nane, go ʒocnehec ware baficnuc!
Juju‐nane ʒikaonec batarac, mocjaha‐mae qâto jaŋere meonec batarac.
Laioŋ jaŋere michaweckonec rocnuc, kâte bulimakao jaŋere ʒuŋeonec bataracnuc.
No ʒâŋe biŋege qomâfâc‐nane mutaniŋke‐jarepe, kikefuŋ guruo ʒeri mumuteŋ egarepe:
“Wofuŋ araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe e mumbiaŋkeniŋ, Jakobore ɋâricfâc sasawa, ŋoŋe e sâseniŋ, Israere gurufâc sasawa, ŋoŋe dapecneniŋ.
Ŋic qarâ suriŋne e ʒârâ hâriŋ fuacneme, mi mana wahacnewec â ere mi takickewec. Erâ ʒâŋe maine mi bâsoŋkecnehuc, ki owa ecneme manawec.”
Tutumaŋ sâkoo eebapagere mumbiaŋgupemu, go araŋ bagareeŋgopieŋ jaŋere maio mumupaŋ‐nanere tofa bazupemu.
Qarâ suriŋne jaŋe nâku gapec‐jopazejec; wira basac ecneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe Wofuŋ muteŋkenʒepieŋ; maŋŋeŋic firieha jurahuc junʒepieŋ!
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe Wofuŋte manasurâ mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaonec erao fisiniŋmu, qâpuc gurune gurune jaŋe mai‐ticnao fodapeniŋmu.
Guriŋ bapa i Wofuŋte gie biŋe, e ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere femicne.
Mâreŋte fekicne sasawa jaŋe eraoa dieŋzi heniŋmu, rufeo huhune jaŋe ere maio dape‐fâreniŋmu, erâ juju‐jeŋic sakareniŋte eipieniŋmu jaŋe wâc mâmâc.
Ʒâhec jujune jaŋe kiŋaŋ qacneniŋmu; ŋiczi ʒâhec fufua jaŋe Wofuŋte biŋe jazaniŋmu.
Ehuc bâbâpiaŋ gie bakicne irec biŋe ŋicguru ʒâhec fufuane jaŋe jaza qazuc eniŋmu.
Wofuŋ e lama‐ticne nore soŋaŋ, no wiac moc mi basapemu.
Kecɋaŋ geunao enareme waha fomanaekopac, opâ heririŋ toma biaŋnao jowacnuekac.
E maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane gumeqiŋneekac. E ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnere erâ, tiŋne hatao jowacnu raekac.
Wâc tucduŋ fotâcnehape duŋdapâczi foŋnume, sifu sisipiricte mi hâwicnuocmu; wiac go nohec jukic i, ɋarucge â gunuge jahe hemiriŋnukopirec.
Go tiwâ ʒepec bâmocke‐nareekic, kisâfâc‐nane jaŋere maio. Go qizec‐nane tokic ruacneekic, â kâdoc‐nane hefuseekic.
Mâreŋko jufehuc jupemu sâc, juju biaŋ â miriŋ qâtecnunicmu, â Wofuŋte ufuŋko ŋec domac ehape, juju dameŋ‐nane tarazokac.
Mâreŋ â tagi‐ticne i Wofuŋzi rune jukac, mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ â ŋecjucfâc‐ticne.
Hâwecko ŋesiŋ‐ticne qandaŋkewec, opâ sâkoo qasanaŋ‐ticne râewec.
Mozi Wofuŋte tikio feocmu? Mozi tiri hae‐ticnao domaocmu?
Meticne ɋaɋacne â maŋticne taniŋne, erâ eeatuc giere mi manasuekac, â mumupaŋ burecne mi eekac e hâcne.
Ŋic iŋucnezi Wofuŋtaonec jambuŋ roocmu, â Anutu bâbâpiaŋzi dâŋticne mufâsâeocmu.
Ine ere ejareekac guru i hâcne, Jakobore Anutu maickezo muŋgopieŋ jaŋe.
Haesac motâc sâko, aŋkeniŋ! Motâc mimiŋ, ŋeindaŋke‐hâmoniŋ! Eme ʒâŋe rara Wofuŋ Sâko e wefuoc.
Ʒâŋe rara Wofuŋ Sâko e mo? E Wofuŋ, tâpiri sanaŋ, e Wofuŋ, momori wânʒâŋ.
Haesac motâc sâko, aŋkeniŋ! Motâc mimiŋ, ŋeindaŋke‐hâmoniŋ! Eme ʒâŋe rara Wofuŋ Sâko e wefuoc.
Ʒâŋe rara Wofuŋ Sâko e mo? E sambâŋ momori jaŋere Wofuŋ, e hâcne ʒâŋe rara Wofuŋ Sâko.
No maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane Wofuŋ gorao sâsepe hefakac.
O Anutu‐nane, go manasiŋgukopac, irec manahaŋ mi qurutuazepac, kisâfâc‐nane jaŋe nifepupu mi enarenʒepieŋ.
Jâmbomac, gore mamanac juŋgopieŋzi mi qurutuanʒepieŋ, otec ɋeticne jaŋe ine bawahac‐jopatec mimienʒepieŋ.
Eebapage nowatutec hone manac ezepac, Wofuŋ; hatage forakac i qazu‐narezemec.
Dâŋfârige maŋnao jowacnuhuc qazu‐narezemec, go hâcne bâbâpiaŋ Anutu‐nane, ʒoaŋ ʒora gore mamanac juekopac.
Wofuŋ, buuruc â aki anonocgere manasuzemec, i hâcne fufuŋke tâmiric fowarehuc juwec.
Socɋâri juhuc sindaŋ â qaqatara epo i mi manasuzemec, aki anonocgere sâcko ine manasu‐narezemec, i gahacne biaŋte erâ ezemec, Wofuŋ.
Wofuŋ e maŋuruc â tiŋne rune, irec ŋic sindaŋne tiŋne hata jowatuekac.
Maŋhuhuŋ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe eebapa tiŋnao jowac‐jopaekac, ehuc jahacne hata qazu‐jareekac.
Wofuŋte hata sasawa i aki anonoc â erâ‐eesanaŋ, ʒâʒâfic â sâcmutâc‐ticne basanaŋkeeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ira jowac‐jopaekac.
O Wofuŋ, ʒâŋe biŋegere erâ kiŋnane behezemec, kiŋnane i ŋemâcne.
Ŋic wenizi Wofuŋ araŋ bacneekac, e hâcne hata âteocte mucnekicne i jâutuocmu.
Eme e jahacne sâcne juhâmoocmu, â ɋiefâcne jaŋe mâreŋ rauckeniŋmu.
Araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe Wofuŋzi âgo ejareekac, erâ ʒâʒâfic‐ticne mutaniŋke‐jareekac.
No Wofuŋtaopec jaha ʒâŋe fihuc juekopac, eki kike‐nane wiwitickonec qâunuckeocmu.
Wofuŋ, goki maicnurâ âgo enarec me, no bebekâne juhuc huacbuc ekopac.
Buʒâiczi ɋârâŋkehuc maŋnane kidapekac, irec ʒârâ hâriŋkonec bataracnuc.
Qarâ suriŋne â buʒâichec jukopac i honec me, ehuc sâqocne bâtâmire‐nare‐fârec.
Kisâfâc‐nane guru mo iŋucnezi rerepic qaisocnuŋgopieŋ i honec.
Juju‐nane ŋezickehuc bataracnuc, dapeŋgao soŋkekopacte mi qurutuazepac.
No Wofuŋ gore mamanac jukopacte, bahac fâsâc â siocmâc jujuzi sabecnuzejec.
O Anutu, go ʒârâ hâriŋ sasawaonec Israe batarazemec.
O Wofuŋ, go dâŋnane mufâsâezemec, no maŋ humuc hata‐mae juekopac, â Wofuŋ go paŋnea manasiŋguekopac.
Wofuŋ, go esâicnurâ fuŋne‐nane bajaŋgeŋkec, maŋnane â mamanasu‐nane hone wosâec.
Aki anonocge hone dendeŋneekopac, gorao qohotahuc hata‐nane juekopac.
Eeatuc ŋic jaŋehec ŋec domac mi eekopac, gibioc‐jeŋichec jaŋere guruo mi juekopac.
Sâqocne bapa jaŋehec jujure takicnuekac, â sindaŋne jaŋehec ŋeŋe wirec mi ŋepemu.
Menane ʒurekupe ɋaɋackeme, Wofuŋ, alatage râreckeekopac.
Ehuc daŋge gae hesokarâ heekopac, â mâsige sasawa mutaniŋkeekopac.
O Wofuŋ, no fic haegere aŋacnukac, ʒâŋe rarage fokac hae mâreŋ i hâcne.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋehec mi bâsirowecnuzemec, soc nânâ jaŋehec juju‐nane mi hetâcnezemec.
Jaŋe hâcne wiac hehesicne manasu biric eeŋgopieŋ, â bâbâmiriŋ moneŋzi mefâre‐jeŋic fusucmakac.
No ine maŋ humuc hata‐mae juekopac, firuecnuhuc anonocnuzemec.
Kike‐nanezi mâreŋ wâwâneŋko âte ʒakiekopac; ŋic tutumaŋ sâkoo Wofuŋ mucne bacnepemu.
Wofuŋ e tatamac‐nane â bâbâpiaŋ‐nane, no more hâwicnuocmu? Wofuŋ e juju‐nanere sâsâoc, no more mezarepemu?
Ŋic sindaŋnezi musoriŋnuhuc, quruŋ herâ fisiniŋmu, kisâfâc‐nane hâcne, jaŋe fâfâc‐jopame rândiŋkeniŋmu.
Momori guru jaŋe toma âterâ fopie, bipic tatara mi epemu; ʒika sâko moc fisi maicnume, sifu hâbi hâro jupemu.
Wiac mocjahare Wofuŋ numucneekopac, irec maŋhâhâŋ enareekac: Wofuŋte fickoa ŋec juc ehape juju dameŋ‐nane tarazejec; â Wofuŋte jauŋ biaŋ hone aŋac ehuc, ufuŋ‐ticnao mu wioc ehuc ŋezepac.
Eki hâcne dameŋ sâqocnao, boze‐ticnao soŋnuocmu, qoruc boze‐ticnao sabecnuocmu, â qânâ tikio bafecnuocmu.
Eme ʒi qizec‐nane bâfeŋneme fehuc, râsifâc‐nane rârec bârârec jowarupemu, ehuc qoruc boze‐ticnao taha bacnepemu, â ʒeri bari ehuc bâzi rikecnepemu; Wofuŋ gae hecnehuc musi bacnepemu.
O Wofuŋ, hahaŋne bahuc wirape manac, aki anonoc enarehuc micnaneo roc!
Goki mumeŋ, “Ʒâŋe mai‐nane basarâ bâfuaniŋ.” Irec maŋnanezi ʒiŋuc gazakac: “Wofuŋ gore ʒâŋe mai bâfuapemurâ basakopac hâcne.”
Ʒâŋe maige mi bâsoŋke‐narec, kiŋaŋŋicge no kimbeŋko mi bâsuecnuc. Baficnuhuc juekiczi mi behecnuc, go bâbâpiaŋte Anutu‐nane.
Neŋgoc mamac jahe behecnupic, Wofuŋzi ine hefârocnukac.
Wofuŋ, go hatagere fuŋne qazu‐narec, râsifâc‐nane jaŋere erâ hata jaŋgeŋnao jowacnuc.
Guriŋnuniŋte harac eŋgopieŋ jaŋerao mi qikiŋnuc; micko âkec ŋiczi dâŋnane muŋgopieŋ hâcne, maŋʒoc‐jeŋiczi gâmâc gâfâŋ wefukac.
No Wofuŋte uruc jauŋ honepemu i manakopac, jujune jaŋere mâreŋko hâcne.
Wofuŋte woŋec juzemec; sasanaŋ bâfuarâ hâbige rozemec; jâmbomac Wofuŋte woŋec juzemec.
Wofuŋ, jâcnane, go wira‐garekopac, qepoŋ hawari mi enarec. Go dâŋemâc etec no nombâŋko humbiŋ jaŋere sâc ezipohec.
No baficnucmurâ wira‐garepe; marac fânâŋ‐nane manazemec. No tiri ufuŋgaopec mejahec‐nane bafaharec‐jofakopac.
Go sindaŋŋic jaŋehec mi bârâriecnuzemec, sâqocne bapa jaŋerao mi ʒuhucnuzemec; jaŋe âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec wamadâŋ i mueŋgopieŋ, ehuc maŋjeŋicko ine wiac hehesicne manasu biric eeŋgopieŋ.
Go gie‐jeŋicte sâcko okacne bâtikie‐jarezemec, eebapa‐jeŋic sâqocne irec sâcko; wiac ebac embiŋ i manahuc ejarezemec, fârine bâfuambiŋ irec furine ronʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe Wofuŋte meqâreŋ mi ʒâŋitaeŋgopieŋte, â eebapa‐ticne mi hone taraeŋgopieŋte, eki qafarac‐joparâ mocwâc mi bafaharec‐jopaocmu.
Wofuŋ muteŋkezo! Eki hâcne wira wâwâsic ecnekupe mana‐narejec.
Wofuŋ e tâpiri‐nane â maro‐nane; maŋnane erao roweckeekac; irec baficnume maŋnanezi kiwaeekac, eme gae hecnehuc daŋge âzâcneekopac.
Wofuŋ e ŋicfâcne tâpiri bâfua‐jareekac, â ŋicwofuŋ wokemaŋ ruacnewec e ʒikao huec sanaŋ ecneekac.
Ŋicfâcge asao rocjopazemec, merâfâfâcge jambuŋ‐jopazemec. Goki lama soŋaŋ ejarehuc, bacjopa jurahuc juzemec.
Sambâŋte aŋelo, Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ, Wofuŋte tatamac â tâpiri musokaniŋ.
Ajoc, Wofuŋte ʒâŋe biŋe muac baafec ecneniŋ, tiri eri qonaŋkerâ Wofuŋ dapecneniŋ.
Wofuŋte marac fânâŋ hâwec faicnao fuakac, Anutu tatamac runezi ɋuŋ hekac, hâwec sâko faicnao Wofuŋzi jukac.
Wofuŋte marac fânâŋ i ɋicwânʒâŋnehec, Wofuŋte marac fânâŋ i qeŋ bipinehec.
Wofuŋte marac fânâŋzi jâmâzâc qazukac, Lebanoŋte jâmâzâc Wofuŋzi qanʒaŋnekac.
Lebanoŋ tiki ecneme bulimakao motec tinac kiwaekac, Sirioŋ tikizi kâte bulimakao sâckekac.
Wofuŋte marac fânâŋzi ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne fuakac.
Wofuŋte marac fânâŋzi tuhu mâreŋ itiriŋkekac, Wofuŋzi Kadesi tuhu mâreŋ itiriŋkekac.
Wofuŋte marac fânâŋzi boriŋjâc ʒâkiriŋkekac, erâ kâtene kâtene imackekac; eme ufuŋ‐ticnao ʒeŋgoma ʒiŋuc wiraŋgopieŋ: “Anutu muteŋkezo!”
Wofuŋ e eri ŋeŋe‐ticnao rumi faicnao ŋekac, Wofuŋ e guriŋ bapa gie‐ticne barâ barahuc juzokac.
Wofuŋ e ŋicfâcne tâpiri tahac‐jopazejec! Wofuŋ e ŋicfâcne wamazi jambuŋ‐jopazejec!

Wofuŋ, go bafaharecnumeŋte muafecgupe; go râsifâc‐nane mana‐jaretec pepecne mi enarembiŋ.
O Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane, no kuku qagarepo, eme goki ɋiɋicne bacnumeŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go qâqâtâc‐nane hâmoc haeonec baefumeŋ, nombâŋte biŋe jaŋeraonec jujuo bârisiecnumeŋ.
Mitiŋicfâc‐ticne ŋoŋe Wofuŋ mumuteŋ gae hecneniŋ, â tiri ʒâŋe‐ticnere daŋge âzâcneniŋ.
Kimbeŋ‐ticne dameŋ bembeŋne mac fuaekac, aki anonoc‐ticne ine fohuc juha juju dameŋ taraekac. Ŋafeo ki mamakuc iqic‐nâpoekac, hae fureme ine ʒeri bubiaŋ fuaekac.
No ine manape fâsâeha kecʒiŋuc mupo: “No biric boroc moc mi epemu.”
Wofuŋ, go maŋuruc qanarehuc, tiki sanaŋ tinac râecnumeŋ. Erâ ine ʒâŋe maige bâsoŋke‐naretec, bipic tatara enarewec.
Eme Wofuŋ, go kio wâwâsic egarepo, ʒiŋuc muhuc numu‐garepo:
“No nombâŋko hupemuo, hâmoc‐nanezi wemo fârine bâfuaocmu? Rufezi sâcne mumbiaŋguocmu? Erâ‐eesanaŋge sâcne muromackeocmu?
Wofuŋ, go manarâ aki anonoc enarec! O Wofuŋ, go baficnuc!”
Eme go kinane hetikietec gae wowo fuawec, go busâqocte mateŋ hetara‐naremeŋ, ehuc ʒeri bubiaŋte eri hendiŋ henaretec huwec.
Ine maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi dâŋemâc mi juhuc mumbiaŋguocte. O Wofuŋ, Anutu‐nane, no daŋge gazarâ gaza ehuc juzepac.

O Wofuŋ, no gore dapeŋko soŋkekopac; qurutuapemurâ moc mi mana‐narezemec, tiŋnegere erâ bataracnuzemec.
Noraopec hazec râec, tarec jaha bataracnuc! Qânâuŋ enarehuc sabecnuc! Huec sanaŋ enarehuc ŋezicnuc!
Ine hâcne, qânâuŋ â huec‐nane domakomec; ʒâŋe biŋegere erâ jowa qataŋ enarec.
Bitiŋ soŋsoŋko râe‐narembiŋkonec unucnuc, go hâcne dapeŋ‐nane jukomec.
Megao maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane râekopac, goki furi‐nane bameŋ, o Wofuŋ, erâ‐eesanaŋ Anutu.
Nemuɋâŋ jabane bajueŋgopieŋ jaŋere takicguekac, no ine Wofuŋ gorao qohotaekopac.
No aki anonocgere aŋacnuha bubiaŋ manakopac, goki huacbuc‐nane ʒâŋitameŋte, â maŋʒârâ fua‐nareha hone jauŋ enaremeŋte.
Erâ râsifâc‐nane jaŋere meo mi râecnuhuc, kike‐nane tomao râetec âte sanaŋkepo.
O Wofuŋ, no bugâpâcko jukopacte aki anonoc enarec; ki busâqoc ekupe ʒâŋe‐nane kitutuckekac, erâ maŋ qâqâtâc â sahac‐nane betaŋkekac.
Busâqocko juhape juju‐nane omaezo ekac, husehuc juhape jara‐nane tarazo ekac. Qarâ suriŋne jukuhape tâpiri‐nane wahakac, â me kike‐nane hâmo ɋaŋac ekac.
Kisâfâc‐nane sasawa nifepupu enareeŋgopieŋ, qomâfâc‐nane jaŋe bâec bacnueŋgopieŋ; manacnuŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâhâwic banareeŋgopieŋ, hae ʒoŋao honecnueŋgopieŋzi wise‐nareeŋgopieŋ.
Hâmokicne jaŋere nikec‐jopaekac iŋuc nore ninikec fuakac, kuʒi qanʒaŋnekicne tinac ekopac.
Bocjahazi saŋuc ʒiŋuc qapie manaekopac: “Wiac hâhâwicne.” Ehuc juju‐nane nowac roniŋte turerâ dâŋ nazaŋ gazaŋ eeŋgopieŋ.
No ine Wofuŋ go manasiŋguhuc ʒiŋuc muekopac: “Go nore Anutu.”
Dameŋ‐nane gore meo fokac; râsi enarehuc guriŋnueŋgopieŋ, jaŋere meonec bataracnuzemec.
Ʒâŋe maigezi kiŋaŋŋicge no tamae‐narezejec; aki anonocgezi baficnuzemec.
O Wofuŋ, go wâsicgukopacte, qurutuapemurâ moc mi mana‐narezemec. Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe qurutuahuc, dâŋ fâsâe‐jareha hâmoc haeo hunʒepieŋ.
Burecŋiczi penaroŋ â sahac fefe ehuc, ŋic tiŋne juekac e musoriŋkeeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe nâŋguŋ enʒepieŋ.
Buurucge i araŋ bagareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâmocke‐jaremeŋ, erâ buuruc hâcne ŋicmaio gore dapeŋko soŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâfua‐jaremeŋ, buuruc i mo iŋucne sâko!
Go ʒâŋe maigere sâsâoczi ŋic jaŋere ʒikadâŋte sabec‐jopaekic. Go bozegao soŋjopatec, râsidâŋzi mi sipiric‐jopaekac.
No Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkepe! E hae sanaŋko juhape mâsi bahuc, aki anonoc‐ticne bâfua‐narewec.
No jâmbomac hâwicnume mupo, “Ʒâŋe maigaonec bârâriecnurâ taicko râecnukicne.” Eme baficnucmurâ kuku qagarepe, sifu ki owa‐nane manameŋ.
Mitiŋicfâc‐ticne sasawa, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ maŋzi jauŋkeniŋ! Ŋic siocmâc jaŋe Wofuŋzi hone kitaŋ ejareekac, maŋfefe jaŋe ine okacne bafehuc jareekac.
Wofuŋte woŋec juŋgopieŋ sasawa, ŋoŋe hâbi‐ŋeŋic ronʒepieŋ â maŋŋeŋic mi wahazejec.
Ŋic moc bahac‐ticne behekicne, â sâqocne‐ticne bâtâmirekicne, ere manape ʒerine ekac.
Ŋic moc Wofuŋzi manacneme kiŋhec mi eekac, â maŋticnao eatuc mi fokac, ere manape ʒerine ekac.
No sâqocne‐nane hesoŋkezo mupe sahac‐nane wahawec, ʒoaŋ ʒora husehuc jupo Irec.
Ŋafe ʒoaŋ sâc megezi badapecnumeŋ, eme maŋwamboŋ‐nane kereŋkewec, ʒoaŋ sanaŋ qakume wiac hahaŋkeekac irec sâc.
No sâqocne‐nane mufua‐garepo, â hehesic‐nane mi hefackepo; no mupo, “Bahac‐nane Wofuŋ mufuacnepe.” Eme sâqocne‐nanere kiŋtofa behemeŋ.
Irec mitihec juekaczi ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋko numu‐garezejec; eme opâ rumi sâko fisiocmu, izi siwiŋne fehuc e mi heuaocmu.
Go maro enarehuc ʒârâ ʒâpâre sabecnuekic, ehuc rârec rârec sisipiricte erâ ŋezicnuekic.
Wofuŋzi mukac: Hata âtecmurâ mugarekicne, i qazu‐garehuc gowatupe, no ʒâŋe‐nanezi hone soŋaŋ egarepe.
Becâsic me doŋgi, mamana tâmiric, jahere sâc mi ezemec. Jahe micko kikizi bâmâteŋ‐jofazo, i tâmiric mi bâjâpec‐nâponicmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne e maŋʒârâ bocjaha fuacneekac; Wofuŋtao qohotaekac e ine aki anonoczi bârârâŋkeocmu.
Ŋic tiŋne ŋoŋe Wofuŋ bubiaŋ manacnehuc ʒeri eniŋ; maŋsioc tâmiric juŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe kiwae‐fâreniŋ.
Ŋic tiŋne ŋoŋe Wofuŋ bubiaŋ manacneniŋ! Siocmâc jujuzi mumuteŋ gae hepie sâckeocmu.
Musi bahuc Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ, gita mucne teŋzi musi bacneniŋ.
Gae ɋâricne moc hefuacneniŋ, musi basarickehuc gae marac sâko heniŋ.
Wofuŋte dâŋ i dâŋfâri hâcne, â gie‐ticne sasawa eeatuc tâmiric baekac.
E tiŋne juju â mumutiŋ dâŋte aŋackeekac; Wofuŋte aki anonoczi mâreŋ fuserâ fokac.
Wofuŋte dâŋzi sambâŋne sambâŋne bâfuawec, erâ mosa ʒoaŋ â bâpiŋfâc‐jeŋic micrombâŋ‐ticnere fuambiŋ.
E hâwec sâko i kiruŋko tinac qoŋgiŋkeme huwec, ʒâkâŋ ʒora i kânoŋko tinac ŋiewec.
Mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ e Wofuŋ araŋ bacnezejec, ŋecjucfâcne sasawa mai‐ticnao ɋarac ɋarac qahuc domanʒepieŋ.
Wiac eki muha izia fuawec i! Wiraha izia fahare domawec i!
Wofuŋzi qâpuc jaŋere mumupaŋ qame wahaekac, ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere dâŋbiri hetâtieekac.
Wofuŋte mumupaŋ i fofo sanaŋ, maŋticnere mamana biri, i ŋic gaŋne gaŋne jaŋerao fârio qaekac.
Ŋicguru Wofuŋzi Anutu ejarekac jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, eki rauc‐jopaocte bâwosâec‐jopawec jaŋe hâcne.
Wofuŋ e sambâŋkonec fime wahame, mâreŋŋic sasawa honec‐nâpoekac.
Eri ŋeŋe‐ticnao ŋeha ʒâŋenezi mâreŋte ŋecjucfâc qâuc‐jopa‐fâreekac.
Eki hâcne maŋjeŋic ba akic efârewec, erâ wâc eebapa‐jeŋic hone râwiŋne‐fâreekac.
Ŋicwofuŋ moc e momori gurufâcne jaŋe sâcne mi ŋezickeniŋmu; â momori moc e tâpiri sâko‐ticnezi sâcne mi baficke‐hâmoocmu.
Ʒikare becâsic ere erâ râsi sâcne mi sanaŋke‐jarezo, e tâpiri sâko‐ticnezi rune sâcne mi bafickeocmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ, â aki anonoc‐ticnere mamanac jueŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ʒâŋe‐ticnezi hone maiŋ ejareekac,
juju‐jeŋic hâmockonec bataraocte, eme roroc dameŋko ɋâricne juniŋte iŋuc eekac.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nâŋeczi Wofuŋte woŋec juekac, e babafic‐nâŋec â maro‐nâŋec.
Jâmbomac, nâŋe tiri ʒâŋe‐ticnao roweckeeŋgopeneŋte ere bubiaŋ manaeŋgopeneŋ.
O Wofuŋ, gore mamanac jueŋgopeneŋte, aki anonocgezi nâŋerao fosanaŋkezejec.

No Wofuŋ dameŋ sâc mumbiaŋkezepac; mumuteŋ‐ticnezi micnaneo ʒuʒuhuc jaha fozejec.
Wofuŋte qâqiŋ qahuc juzepac, eme ʒârâ ʒâpâo juŋgopieŋ jaŋe manarâ aŋac‐jopazejec.
Nohec mâmâc Wofuŋ musokanʒepeneŋ, babafic ehuc ʒâŋe‐ticne muafeckenʒepeneŋ.
No Wofuŋ wira basac ecnepo sâc micnaneo rowec, ehuc hâhâwic‐nane qamase‐fârewec.
Erao ʒâŋe fihuc firic qâric eniŋ, eme ʒâŋe mai‐ŋeŋic mimiʒu qâʒuʒu mi ezejec.
Ŋic huacbucne ʒizi wirame Wofuŋzi manawec, ehuc ʒârâ ʒâpâ‐ticne jâoc rofârewec.
Wofuŋ araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe aŋelo‐ticnezi heririŋ‐jeŋicko ju fofo ehuc batarac‐jopaekac.
Oi, esâicke honerâ mananiŋ: Wofuŋ e buuruchec! Ŋic moczi ere dapeŋko soŋkeocmu ere manape ʒerine ekac.
O mitiŋicfâc‐ticne, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ araŋ bacnenʒepieŋ; e araŋ bacneniŋmu jaŋe wiac moc mi basaniŋmu.
Laioŋ motecne jaŋe nânâ wiacte hâmoeŋgopieŋ; â Wofuŋ wira basac ecneeŋgopieŋ, ŋic i jaŋe wiac biaŋne moc mi basaeŋgopieŋ.
O motecfâc‐mae, ware hazec râehapie no Wofuŋ araŋ babacne irec fuŋne ŋazape.
Mo ŋic mozi dameŋ ʒora juocte manasukac, â ʒoaŋ bocjaha jufehuc wiac biaŋne nâ bac eocte ecnekac?
Nameŋgezi sâqocne bazacte soŋaŋkezemec, â micbipicgezi eeatuc gie bazacte aka hecnezemec.
Sâqocne râpeckerâ eehâmo gie bazemec; wama bâfuarâ irec hata bâjâpezemec.
Wofuŋ e tiŋne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋeraopec ʒâŋe fiekac, â wira wâwâsic ecneeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao hazec râeekac.
Wofuŋ e ʒâŋe mainezi sâqocne bapa maic‐jopaekac, ine ʒâŋe biŋe‐jeŋic mâreŋkonec bârârieocte.
Tiŋne juju jaŋe kuku qapie Wofuŋzi manaekac, ehuc ʒârâ hâriŋ fua‐jareekac sâc jowac roekac.
Wofuŋzi bu heheric ejareekac jaŋe qâtec‐jopaekac, â maŋjeŋic ima qakicne jaŋe bafic‐jopaekac.
Tiŋne juju e ʒârâ hâriŋ bocjaha fuacneekac; Wofuŋzi ine wiac iŋucne sasawaonec bataraekac.
E me kikene sasawa hone maiŋ eekac, irec mocjaha mac moczi mi herickecneocmu.
Sâqocnezi sindaŋŋic qâhâmoocmu; â tiŋne juju qaisockeniŋmu jaŋe kiŋhec eniŋmu.
Wofuŋzi kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne firuec‐jopaekac; ere dapeŋko soŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec moczi kiŋhec mi eocmu.
O Wofuŋ, goki no râsi enareŋgopieŋ jaŋe râsi ejarec, nohec juju gie baŋgopieŋ jaŋehec juju gie bac!
Maruku maŋne sahacne hetec hume fahare ŋezicnuc!
Sându ʒika rorâ, jâpecnuŋgopieŋ jaŋe maic‐jopac! Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane âzâcnec: “No gore ŋeŋezic.”
Juju‐nane omaeocte muŋgopieŋ, ŋic i jaŋe mimi busâqoc bâfua‐jarec! Sipiricnuniŋte manasuŋgopieŋ, jaŋe emâmâŋkerâ weaŋkenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋte aŋelozi hetapaic‐jopame, padi jawa iŋucne tâtienʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋte aŋelozi jâpec‐jopa rame, dapâcko âte sowarierâ jopazejec.
Jaŋe fuŋne tâmiricko bitiŋ râe‐narembiŋ, fuŋne tâmiricko omaepemurâ nombâŋ ronarembiŋ.
Sisipiric acmâc jaha fisi‐jarezejec, bitiŋ râe‐narembiŋ izi jaŋacne kicjopazejec, nombâŋ‐jeŋicko hurâ omaenʒepieŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ bubiaŋ manacnepemu, e baficnukacte kiwac qawac epemu.
Me kikefâc‐nane muniŋmu, “O Wofuŋ, mozi gore sâc jukac? Go qarâ suriŋne e ŋic qac momorihec ere meonec bataraekic, â hapetac huacbucne e fiuc rorore meonec bataraekic.”
Burec micko âkec ŋiczi maicnueŋgopieŋ, erâ wiac kâuc bakopac irec wio‐nareeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe wiac biaŋnere okacne sâqocne bâtikie‐nareeŋgopieŋ, enarekupie bekâ mâsiŋ iŋucne jukopac.
No ine huc bacjopame busâqoc ŋaqi rojupo, sowa juhuc sahac‐nane qapo, qizeczi dunduŋ hurâ numuhuc jupo.
Âgo qomâ moc hâmome eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc epo, me neŋgoc‐nane hâmome ezapo, irec sâc dunduŋ dadape rac warec jupo.
No dâŋzi fâfâcnume ine aŋac‐jopaha tureŋgopieŋ, no wiac enareniŋte manasuhuc tumaŋneŋgopieŋ; ŋic pâpârâcne, ʒâŋe furu‐nane, iŋucnezi musoriŋnuhuc domaŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe sâke kiki dâŋ muhuc muhuc, noraopec mic kikiaric kiŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ, go hone qâoma eku mo dameŋko behecmu? Ʒika‐jeŋickonec bataracnuc, juju‐nane laioŋ mickonec batarac.
Eme no tutumaŋ sâkoo daŋge gazapemu, ŋic guru dindiŋko mumbiaŋgupemu.
Maŋgâŋ râsi enareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mana‐jaretec, sowine wiac fuacnekac muhuc mi aŋac‐jopazejec; â fuŋne tâmiric qaisocnueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒâŋe bazuc mi enarenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe wamadâŋ mi mueŋgopieŋ; erâ ŋic wamane juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine eatuc‐jopaniŋte mamanasu gie baeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe noraopec mâretec aŋkehuc ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: “Jei, ʒâŋe fâri‐nâŋeczi qame honembeneŋ i!”
Wofuŋ, go i honemec i! Irec dâŋemâc mi juc! O Wofuŋ, behecnurâ taicko mi juc!
O Anutu, Wofuŋ‐nane, qiriŋ qarâ ɋârec, erâ dâŋnane dopeckehuc mutiŋnec.
Wofuŋ, Anutu‐nane, tiŋnegere sâcko ŋezicnuc, jaŋe nore erâ aŋac mananʒipiŋte.
Jaŋe maŋzi ʒiŋuc mi munʒepieŋ: “Sowine, iŋuc hâcne fuacneocte mueŋgopeneŋ, nâŋâc sanaŋkekupene juju‐ticne omaekac.”
No ʒârâ ʒâpâ fua‐nareme aŋac‐jopakac, jaŋe ejaretec qurutuarâ mimienʒepieŋ. No pepecne enareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe mimizi ŋecjopakume weaŋkenʒepieŋ.
Â nore dâŋzi fârine fua taniŋkeocte mueŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ine bubiaŋ manahuc ʒeri bari enʒepieŋ; ehuc munʒepieŋ, “Wofuŋ e kâcɋene sâko, e kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne juhâmoocte aŋackekac.”
Eme nameŋ‐nanezi tiŋnege mutaniŋkezejec, â dameŋ sâc mugac bagarezejec.

Sindaŋŋic e maŋfâhâŋ‐ticnao sâqocnezi qafeŋdâŋ râehuc juekac; ʒâŋe mai‐ticnao Anuture hâhâwic mi fokac.
E jahacne maŋ eatuckehuc muekac, “Hehesic‐nane i mi fua taniŋkeocmu, â irec mamana sâqoc mi fuaocmu.”
Micdâŋ‐ticne i mumusifuc â eeatuc; mana tarahuc wiac biaŋne ee i behewec.
Fofo‐ticnao wiac repicne manasu biric eekac, bibiaŋte hata mi âteekac â sâqocne mi qikiŋneekac.
O Wofuŋ, aki anonocgezi feku sambâŋ heuakac, erâ‐eesanaŋgezi feku karoracko fisikac.
Tiŋnegezi Anuture tiki iŋucne qiŋ herâ ŋekac, mumutiŋge hâwec ʒâkâŋ sâko iŋucne, Wofuŋ, go ŋic â qowi bafic‐nâpoekic.
Anutu gore aki anonoc furi sâko‐ticne mo iŋucne! Mâreŋŋic jaŋe fakec rurumaŋgao soŋkeeŋgopieŋ;
ehuc ficgaonec mâriri sâko nâ bac eeŋgopieŋ, â aŋacgere opâ fifisine gumec‐jopaekic.
Gorao hâcne jujure opâ ʒâŋe fokac, â gore tatamacko tatamac honeeŋgopeneŋ.
Go manacgueŋgopieŋ jaŋe aki anonocge ʒuhucke‐jarehuc juzemec, â maŋsioc tâmiric jaŋe bâbâpiaŋge tahac‐jopazemec.
Ŋic penaroŋhec ere kikezi mi âtecnuzejec, â sindaŋŋicte mezi mi jâpecnuzejec.
Dameŋ mocko sâqocne bapa jaŋe raŋe foraniŋmu, herândiŋ‐jopakicne, sâcne mocwâc mi fahareniŋmu.
Ŋic repicne jaŋere erâ maŋge mi sâqorezejec, sâqocne bapa jaŋere erâ buge mi faharezejec.
Jaŋe kecɋaŋ iŋucne biac ururuckeniŋmu, â qinʒiŋ ârâŋ ɋâɋâri iŋucne biac ɋaŋaniŋmu.
Wofuŋtao roweckehuc eehâmo gie bazemec, eme mâreŋgao juhuc nânâ mi basacmu.
Wofuŋte aŋac manahuc juzemec, eme maŋgezi wiac muocmu i tahacguocmu.
Jujuge Wofuŋte meo râezemec, erao rowecketec guriŋ bagareocmu.
Eme e bibiaŋge tatamac iŋucne bararuŋkeocmu, â tiŋne jujuge ʒoaŋ gereŋ gereŋ iŋucne.
Wofuŋte maio niniŋkerâ woŋec‐ticne juzemec; moc e gie repicne manasu biric eku baocmu, eme gie‐ticne fârine fuame buge mi faharezejec.
Aaric geŋkezemec, kimbeŋ bâec bacnezemec! Maŋge mi fârorockezejec, izi sâqocne bâfuacmu.
Sâqocne bapa jaŋe hâcne juju‐jeŋic hetâcnezo, Wofuŋte woŋec juniŋmu jaŋe ine mâreŋ rauckeniŋmu.
Sindaŋŋic e piticne sawa juferâ omaeocmu, go ŋeŋe hae‐ticnao fisi ʒâŋe firâ e basacmu.
Ʒâic mana‐bipiehuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine mâreŋ rauckeniŋmu, ehuc mazuc mâriri bâfuarâ aŋac faio juniŋmu.
Ŋic repicnezi ŋic tiŋne dâŋ qacneekac, ehuc mic kikiaric kicneekac;
Wofuŋzi ine ŋic repicne gâwiecneekac, dameŋ‐ticne bembeŋkeme honeekacte.
Sindaŋŋic jaŋe sâqe unuckeeŋgopieŋ â tepe âpâreeŋgopieŋ, ŋic hapetac â qarâ suriŋne jopaniŋte, â tiŋne juju sipiric‐jopaniŋte;
sâqe‐jeŋiczi jaŋacne bu âke mârâŋkeocmu, â tepe‐jeŋic bazuzo.
Ŋic tiŋne juekac e wiac afecne rauckeocmu izi fekac, â sindaŋŋic bocjaha mazuc mâriri fojareocmu izi wahakac.
Wemocte? Sindaŋŋic e mene qazuzo; â ŋic tiŋne juekac e ine Wofuŋzi dope hutuŋ ecneocmu.
Wofuŋ e bahacmâc jaŋere dameŋ mana‐fârekac, â wiac rauckembiŋ i fosanaŋkerâ foocmu.
Jaŋe dameŋ sâqocnao mimi qaqa mi fua‐jareocmu, â roroc dameŋko sifu nâ gapec ehuc juniŋmu.
Sindaŋŋic jaŋe ine sipirickeniŋmu; Wofuŋte râsifâc jaŋe ʒariŋ âri biaŋ iŋucne omaeniŋmu, hosâc iŋucne qaʒueniŋmu hâcne.
Sindaŋŋic e wiac jaba roku okacne sâcne mi bâtikieekac, ŋic tiŋne e ine bokifac ehuc ŋic wiac tahac‐jopaekac.
Wemocte? Wofuŋte jambuŋ rokicnezi mâreŋ rauckeniŋmu, â sâwec‐jopawec jaŋe ine arictac eniŋmu.
Ŋiczi hata âte sanaŋkerâ juju i Wofuŋtaonec fuaekac, ine ŋic moc eebapa‐ticnere mana biaŋkerâ iŋuc ecneekac.
Iŋucnezi rândiŋkehuc sifu mâreŋko mi qaekac, i Wofuŋzi menao rorâ basanaŋkeekacte.
No socɋâri jupozi juku ŋicqizec ekopac, ehuc honehape ŋic tiŋnezi qarâ suriŋne moc mi ewec, â ɋiefâcne jaŋe nânâre mu huacbuc ee i wâc arictac.
E dameŋ sâc bokifac juekac â wiac buafec beheekac, â ɋâricfâcne jaŋe mâririre rowaŋ wâc eeŋgopieŋ.
Go sâqocne geŋkecnehuc eehâmo gie bazemec, iŋuc erâ sâcne juraʒihuc jucmu.
Wofuŋ e tiŋne jujure mana aŋac eekac, e mitiŋicfâc‐ticne mi behec‐jopaekac. Tiŋne jaŋe hone maiŋ ejareme juraʒihuc juniŋmu, sindaŋne jaŋere ɋâricfâc ine bâsirowec‐jopaocmu.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe mâreŋ rune eniŋmu, ehuc mâreŋ fainao hati jurahuc juniŋmu.
Ŋic tiŋne ere mickonec dâŋ fâri biaŋ wahaocmu, nameŋ‐ticnezi gie bame bâbâtiŋ fuaocmu.
Anutu‐ticnere sâcmutâc dâŋ maŋticnao fokac, irec hata‐ticne biric boroc mi âteekac.
Ŋic sindaŋnezi tiŋne ruc bacneekac, â juju‐ticne sipirickeocte maŋkehuc juekac.
Meticnao feocte ine Wofuŋzi mi manaekac, dâŋgieo dâŋticne sâqorezacte aka wâc heekac.
Wofuŋte woŋec juhuc ere hatao ninipezemec, eki bafaharecgume mâreŋ rune ezokic, â sindaŋne jaŋe sirowepie hone aŋac ejarezokic.
Ŋic sindaŋne moc pepec sâko eme honehuc jupo, e ʒamana jâc iŋucne mâreŋ sâockerâ domawec.
Dameŋ mocko fotâcnehuc dodoma tacne honepo, fârinere ʒâŋe fipo, erâ basa‐bipiepo.
Ŋic bahacmâc e ʒâŋitazemec, â siocmâc e hone tarazemec; wamare gie baekac e hâcne ɋâric fuacne raniŋmu.
Sâcmutâc dâŋ qâqâsua ine sisipiriczi qanʒaŋ‐jopaocmu, â sindaŋne jaŋere ɋâricfâc ʒikazi omaec‐jopaocmu.
Tiŋne jaŋere babafic Wofuŋtaonec wareocmu, ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋko ere dapeŋko soŋkeniŋmu.
Wofuŋzi ŋezic‐jopahuc batarac‐jopaocmu, sindaŋne jaŋeraonec batarac‐jopahuc bâpiaŋ‐jopaocmu, ere dapeŋko soŋkeŋgopieŋte iŋuc ejareocmu.

O Wofuŋ, go aaric mana‐narehuc mi hanecnuzemec, â kimbeŋ qanarehuc qa bâtiŋ mi enarezemec.
Gore tepe moteczi kimârâŋnumbieŋ, â megezi badapecnukac.
Mamana sâqocgere erâ mesahac‐nane ɋiɋicne moc mi fokac, sâqocne‐nanere erâ me kike‐nane furu moc mi fokac.
Hehesic‐nanezi nowaru ferâ qâurucnukac, tagi sâko iŋucne erâ kihâmocnukac.
Wicnane gâreckehuc âsu fikac, mutuc‐nanere erâ risimbiŋne qakopac.
No miŋgeŋkerâ dunduŋ dadape jukopac, ʒoaŋ ʒora ki mamakuc ehuc jukopac.
Ʒâiczi hoqaŋeŋ‐nane fusucmarâ isirickekac, sahac biuc‐nane dâkâne ɋiɋicne moc mi fokac.
No dockerâ betaŋke sâqorekopac, bunaneo ʒâic serereŋ fokacte owackehuc jukopac.
Wofuŋ, go harac huacbuc‐nanere kâuc mi bakomec, â husehuc jukopac i mana‐fârekic.
Buhândâŋ‐nane ʒocnehec âtekac, tâpiri‐nanezi behecnukac, â ʒâŋe‐nanere tatamac i wâc hâpokac.
Âgo qomâfâc‐nane jaŋe huc ʒâic‐nanere bâec bacnuŋgopieŋ, â soctofafâc‐nane jaŋe taic jaha juŋgopieŋ.
Juju nowac rozo muŋgopieŋ jaŋe bitiŋ râe‐nareŋgopieŋ, â ʒârâ ʒâpâ bâfua‐narezo maŋkeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine doc bacnuniŋte ʒoaŋ ʒora dâŋ manasu biric ehuc juŋgopieŋ.
No ine qepoŋ tinac ehuc dâŋ mi manaekopac, erâ nâŋguŋ tinac ehuc micnane mi aŋkeekopac.
Jâmbomac, no ŋic moc dâŋ mi manaekac iŋucne, â micticnao okacne mumu mi fokac ere sâc jukopac.
Erâ Wofuŋ, no gore woŋec jukopac; Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane, goki dâŋ bâtikie‐narecmu.
Ʒiŋuc mukopac: “Jaŋe âke sisic enarehuc mi ʒeri enʒepieŋ, â kike‐nanezi biric boroc eha penaroŋ dâŋ mi enʒepieŋ.”
No rândiŋkezo ekopac hâcne, â ʒâic‐nanezi moc mi behecnukac.
No hehesic‐nane mufuakopac, â sâqocne‐nanere busâqoc manakopac.
Erâ no maŋgâŋ râsi enareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe tâpirihec, â fuŋne tâmiric qaisocnueŋgopieŋ jaŋe guru sâko.
Â biaŋnere okacne sâqocne enareeŋgopieŋ, ŋic i jaŋe kisâfâc‐nane juŋgopieŋ; ine biaŋnao qohotaekopacte iŋuc eeŋgopieŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go mi behecnuc! Anutu‐nane, go mi behecnuc!
Go fâro barâ baficnuc, o Wofuŋ, go hâcne bâbâpiaŋ‐nane.

No mupo, “Nameŋ‐nanezi sipiricnuzacte eebapa‐nane soŋaŋkehuc juzepac; â sindaŋŋic jaŋe qâtecnuhuc juniŋmu sâc, micbipic‐nane micko kiki râecnezepac.”
No nâŋguŋ erâ dâŋemâc jupo; eme izi jauŋ mi bacnuwec, maŋʒâic‐nane ɋârâŋkewec.
Maŋnaneo hâhâwic fusucmarâ fome manatâc qâtâc epe ʒocsâko ʒacnuwec. Ehame dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupo:
“Wofuŋ, dameŋ tatara‐nanere manasupe, â dameŋ‐nane sâcticne hone jaŋgeŋkepe, juju‐nane ratâmirekac i mana tarape.
Manakic, go jara dameŋ‐nane bembeŋne mac bâfuameŋ, â juju dameŋ‐nane i honetec arictac tinac eekac, ine hâcne ŋic sasawa juju‐nâŋec i nokafere sâc.
Jâmbomac, ŋiczi nâkumuc tinac rac warec eekac, wemo wiac mo fârinere ojowa sâko fuaekac? Ŋiczi wiac hure hemârec eekac i mozi rauckeocmu?
“Eme, Wofuŋ, ʒi wemo wiacte woŋec jukopac? Mamanac‐nane gorao fokac.
Kiŋ bahac‐naneonec bataracnuc, eme mutucne jaŋe mu ruruc mi enarenʒepieŋ.
No dâŋemâc jukopac, micnane mi aŋkekopac. Wemocte? Goki iŋuc fua‐nareocte mumeŋ i!
Go tagi râe‐naremeŋ i nowac roc; megere tâpiri wânʒâŋzi omaecnukac.
Goki ŋic moc sâqocnere haneckehuc bâtiŋnecmu, eme eri‐ticne i bobojacte eri iŋucne omaeocmu; jâmbomac, ŋic e nokafe sawa.
“O Wofuŋ, nunumu‐nane manac, wiwira‐nanere hazec râec, ʒâŋeuc‐nane honehuc qâoma mi ec! No gorao ŋicmanac fisihuc gowarukopac, kâcɋenefâc‐nane sasawa jaŋere sâc mafa jukopac.
No behecnuhuc ʒâŋe mocko fitec rame firiepe, erâ jufeku hae ʒi beherâ ratâmirezepac.”

No maŋuruc jaha Wofuŋte woŋec jupo, eme noraopec fohorehuc wiwira‐nane manawec.
E sisipiricte nombâŋkonec baefucnuwec, sohoŋ râqâcnaonec unucnuwec; erâ kike‐nane qânâ faio râeme âte ʒakiepo.
E gae ɋâricne moc micnaneo râewec, Anutu‐nâŋecte mumuteŋ gae. I ŋic bocjahazi manarâ araŋ bacneniŋmu, erâ Wofuŋtao roweckeniŋmu.
Ŋic moc maŋnezi Wofuŋtao roweckeocmu, â maŋfefe jaŋerao mi fohoreocmu, me burecŋic qac qâsoricne mi bâjâpec‐jopaocmu, ŋic iŋucnere manape ʒerine ekac.
O Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane, go nâŋere manasuhuc mâsi â gie fuŋne fuŋne baekic i ʒarene fekac; ŋic me wiac moczi gohec sâc hehene mi ekac. No i muiŋ musawec ehuc binaŋne bazo mupe, sâcne mumufârene mi eocmu.
Taha bâzi fuŋne fuŋnere mi egareekac, hazeczi dâŋ mamana ine bâfua‐naremeŋ; qowi hâcbuc ririke me sâqocnere taha bapa, i fua‐gareocte mi muekic.
Eme mupo, “Manakic, no fisikopac, miti papiao nore dâŋ qâreŋkekicne fokac:
Anutu‐nane, no micge reŋkepere aŋacnukac, â sâcmutâc dâŋge maŋnaneo fokac.”
Bâbâpiaŋte biŋedâŋ tutumaŋ sâkoo mufuapo, no micbipic‐nane aka mi hecnepo, i Wofuŋ, go gahac manakic.
No bâbâpiaŋ giegere dâŋ i maŋnaneo mi hefackepo, erâ‐eesanaŋgere â aki anonocgere biŋe mupo; no tutumaŋ sâkore maio buurucge â dâŋfârige mi hesoŋkepo.
O Wofuŋ, go buurucge mi sakare‐narec, aki anonoc â jauŋfârige izi ʒimicnu basanaŋ ezejec.
Ʒâic fâro fuŋne fuŋnezi bârârâŋnuŋgopieŋ, hehesic‐nane mi wowose‐fârenezi qâurucnuŋgopieŋ; jaŋe qizec susuc‐nanere ʒare jâuruŋgopieŋ, eme maŋnane wahakac.
O Wofuŋ, manatec sâckeha bataracnuzemec, o Wofuŋ, fâro barâ ware baficnuc.
Juju‐nane hetâcnezo muŋgopieŋ, jaŋe mâmâc sasawa qurutuarâ mimienʒepieŋ; no sisipiric fua‐nareocte ejarekac, jaŋe gorao qâwiwickerâ mamakucne enʒepieŋ.
No “sowine, sowine” munareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe mimi‐jeŋic manarâ sahac‐jeŋic gâgâmârâzejec.
Â go wira basac egareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ine ʒeri ehuc bubiaŋ mana‐garenʒepieŋ; gore bâbâpiaŋte ejareekac, jaŋe dameŋ sâc munʒepieŋ, “Wofuŋ e kâcɋene.”
No jâmbomac ŋic hapetac â qarâ suriŋne, irec Wofuŋ goki hone maiŋ enarec. Go hâcne babafic‐nane â ŋeŋezic‐nane, o Anutu‐nane, ŋeŋec ʒeʒepec mi ezemec!

Hapetac hone maiŋ ejareekac ŋic ere manape ʒerine ekac; dameŋ sâqocnao Wofuŋzi e ŋezickeocmu.
Wofuŋzi e hone soŋaŋ ecneme jufehuc juocmu, eme mâreŋ irec ŋic jaŋe mu ʒeri ecneniŋmu; â râsifâcne jaŋe wiac moc ecnezo mupie mi qikiŋne‐jareocmu.
Huc fohame Wofuŋzi dope hutuŋ ecneocmu, â ʒâic wiac‐ticne bâmâteŋkecne‐fâreocmu.
No ine mupo, “Wofuŋ go aki anonoc enarec; bâpiaŋnuc, no sâqocne bahuc bugao bapo hâcne.”
Râsifâc‐nane jaŋe qaisocnuhuc ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: “E wezimucko hâmome ʒâŋe‐ticne omaeocmu?”
Moc e iqicnuocte fisiekac e eatuc dâŋ muekac, ehuc maŋnezi wiac repicne mana biric eekac; izi hae ʒoŋao hurâ muiŋ musawec eekac.
Qaisocnueŋgopieŋ sasawa jaŋe saŋucko dâŋ muc manac eeŋgopieŋ; wiac gâgâpâcne fua‐nareocte mamanasu gie baeŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: “Wiac repicne moczi sahacnao bohotajec, irec fokackonec mocwâc mi fahareocmu.”
Erâ wâc âgo fâri‐nane, maŋzi ʒâfickehuc jupo, erâ nânâ wirec nâ juperec, eki wâc bunaneo bakac.
O Wofuŋ, go ine aki anonoc enarezemec, ehuc mocwâc ɋiɋicne bacnutec okacne bâtikie‐jarezepac.
Râsi‐nanezi bawahacnurâ saoreŋ mi qaocmuo, ine ʒiŋuc mupemu: Go nore mana biaŋkekomec.
Go ine maŋtaniŋ juekopacte dopecnuhuc jumeŋ, erâ âkendâŋnutec maigao domahuc jaha juekopac.
Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu, e dameŋ tâmiric muteŋkehuc juzo. Jâmbomac jâmbâŋ.

Kâte bulimakaozi opâ basahuc hâmoekac, iŋuc hâcne maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi Anutu gore hâmokac.
Maŋnanezi Anutu jujune gore boc hâmokac: Mo dameŋko fisirâ Anutu ʒâŋe maige honepemu?
Ŋafe ʒoaŋ sâc ʒâŋeuc‐nanezi nânâ‐nane eekac, ʒoaŋ ʒora ʒiŋuc nazahuc juŋgopieŋte: “Anutuge wena?”
No ʒâic manahuc wiac manasukopac i mufuape maŋnane urueoc: Ŋic guru dindiŋ biri ʒora jaŋere ŋondeŋko, Anuture ufuŋko rajumbeneŋ; ehuc hombaŋte ʒeri gae bafehuc hepene irec micʒonʒoŋzi baafec‐nâpowec.
Maŋnane go wemocte boc gâpârekic? Â wemocte boc hâhâŋkekic? Anuture woŋec juc! E ʒâŋe mai‐nanere babafic â Anutu‐nane jukacte daŋge âzâcnepemu.
No Jordaŋ â Herimoŋ mâreŋko â Miʒa tikio juhuc, maŋnane wahakacte Anuture manasukopac.
Opâ sâro‐ticnezi rucneme ʒâkâŋzi ʒâkâŋ wiracnekac; jei, siri sâkogezi qâurucnu‐fârekac.
Ʒoaŋ sâc wiraekopac, “Wofuŋ aki anonoc‐ticne fuaoc!” Ŋafe sâc gae‐ticnezi micnaneo foekac, â juju‐nanere Anutu e numucneekopac.
Anutu qânâ‐nane âzâcneekopac, “Nore wemocte nikecguwec? No râsizi bâuruŋnume wemocte maku ehuc jukopac?”
Râsifâc‐nane jaŋe mu ruruc enarepie ʒâic fâro repicne manaekopac, dameŋ sâc ʒiŋuc nazahuc jueŋgopieŋ hâcne: “Anutuge wena?”
Maŋnane go wemocte boc gâpârekic? Â wemocte boc hâhâŋkekic? Anuture woŋec juc! E ʒâŋe mai‐nanere babafic â Anutu‐nane jukacte daŋge âzâcnepemu.
O Anutu, miti tâmiric jaŋere ŋezicnuhuc dâŋnane dopeckec, ŋic eeatucne â hehesine jaŋeraonec bataracnuc!
Dapeŋ‐nane Anutu go hâcne; no ira soŋkeekopac; irec wemocte behecnukomec? No râsizi bâuruŋnume wemocte maku erâ jukopac?
Tatamacge â ʒâziriŋ dâŋge râetec wareoc, izi jowacnuzejec. Jowacnu fâkume tiri tikigao â ŋeŋe jujugao fisizepac.
Eme Anutu gore alata bâqiŋkepemu, joroc Anutu‐nane go maicgupemu, erâ musi bahuc mumuteŋ gae hegarepemu, o Anutu, nore Anutu.
Maŋnane go wemocte boc gâpârekic? Â wemocte boc hâhâŋkekic? Anuture woŋec juc! E ʒâŋe mai‐nanere babafic â Anutu‐nane jukacte daŋge âzâcnepemu.

O Anutu, go mârâc jaha, mimiŋne jaŋere dameŋko, gie fâri basarickehuc bameŋ, i kâcɋenefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe binaŋne banârepie, hazec fâri‐nâŋeczi manambeŋ.
Go gahacne mezi qâpuc guru jâpec‐jopameŋ, ehuc ŋicfâcge sarac‐jopameŋ; go ŋic gurune gurune bâsirowec‐jopameŋ, ehuc jaŋe basawec‐jopameŋ.
Jaŋe jaŋacne ʒikazi mâreŋ i mi rombiŋ, â jaŋacne mezi sasanaŋ mi bâfuambiŋ; aricne, go jaŋere aŋacguwecte mefâregezi â ʒâŋe maigere tatamaczi bâfua‐jaremeŋ.
Go Wofuŋ Sâko â Anutu‐nane jukomec, goki mutec Jakobozi sasanaŋ bâfuaekac.
Gore tâpirire râsifâc‐nâŋec bâsuec‐jopaeŋgopeneŋ, ʒâŋegere erâ âtemac‐jopaeŋgopeneŋ.
No tepe‐nanere mamanac mi juekopac, â ʒika sâqe‐nanezi wâc sâcne mi baficnuekac.
Goki ine râsifâc‐nâŋec jopanaŋte bafic‐nâpoekic, â qaisoc‐nâpoeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâtâtiec‐jopaekic.
Anutu gore mu qâqiŋ ʒuʒuhuc jaha eeŋgopeneŋ, erâ tofamâc daŋge mumuteŋ egarehuc junaŋmu.
Eme go sifu suŋgiŋ‐nâpohuc mimi faio râec‐nâpomeŋ, â momorifâc‐nâŋec mi qâtec‐jopameŋ.
Goki manahaŋ râsifâc‐nâŋec wise‐jarembeŋ, eme jaŋe mafa wiac‐nâŋec nâwoc rombiŋ.
Goki enâretec lama hehezure biŋe jaŋere sâc embeŋ, â qâpuc gurune gurune jaŋerao bâtâtiec‐nâpomeŋ.
Go ŋicfâcge wiac afecnere qikiŋ‐jopameŋ, furine ŋemâcne bazu‐gareniŋte mi mumeŋ.
Goki manahaŋ mendâŋ‐nâŋecko juŋgopieŋzi âke sisic enâreeŋgopieŋ, ŋicguru rârec rârec mu ruruc enârehuc gâwie‐nâreeŋgopieŋ.
Goki enâretec qâpuc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere mu qâqiŋ embeŋ, â ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe mana wahac‐nâpohuc gâwie‐nâreeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋafe ʒoaŋ sâc mimizi ŋecnukume, ʒâŋe mai‐nane bâsoŋkehuc dunduŋ dadape juekopac,
i âke sisic â mumusoriŋ ŋic dâŋjeŋic manahuc juekopacte, â râsi â qaqaisoc ŋic honec‐jopahuc juekopacte iŋuc eekopac.
Nâŋe gore mi nikec‐nâpoha, â ʒâʒâficge mi hetâcnehuc eatucguhapene, wiac sasawa i sifu fai‐nâŋecko fewec.
Maŋnâŋeczi go mi râpecguhame, â kike‐nâŋeczi hatage mi kizuhame,
go sifu kâte qâto jaŋere hae mâreŋko qanʒaŋ‐nâpohuc duŋdapâc maŋnao râec‐nâpomeŋ.
Anutu ʒâŋegere nikec‐nâpozacko, me nemuɋâŋ jabane numu hefârec ejarenʒapeŋko,
Anutu goki mi hone tarac‐nâponʒaŋ me? Go ŋicmaŋko dâŋ soŋne mana jaŋgeŋkeekic i!
Aricne, gore erâ ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne qa imac enâreeŋgopieŋ, â lama qa hezuc eejarene jaŋere sâcko râec‐nâpoŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ, qiriŋ qac! Wemocte guŋ fokomec? Mana ɋâɋârec! Bebehe sanaŋ mi behec‐nâpoc!
Wemocte ʒâŋe maige bâsoŋkekomec, ehuc imac‐nâpokicne â bâuruŋ‐nâpokicne irec nikecgukac?
Jei, maŋ qâqâtâc‐nâŋec i rufeo bâutuckekicne; sahac‐nâŋec i mâreŋko bohotarâ fokac.
Fahare bafic‐nâpoc! Aki anonocgere erâ batarac‐nâpoc!

Biŋedâŋ biaŋnezi maŋnane fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkekac; gae‐nanere dâŋ ŋicwofuŋ mufuacnepe; nameŋ‐nanezi qâqâreŋ ŋicsaric moc ere kirifi iŋucne.
Hawari biaŋge mâreŋŋic gâcne jaŋere siricke‐fârekac; micbipicge kereŋ bareŋne, Anutuzi jambuŋgu sanaŋkekacte iŋuc ekac.
Qac momori, go ʒika sâqege becsahachec ombâŋgao jomac, eri qaraweŋ ɋuŋɋasaŋgehec go!
Ʒai ʒonʒoŋgehec ʒikare keretacko ɋicwânʒâŋ jaha rac! Ʒâziriŋ dâŋ dopeckezemec, tiŋne juju ŋezickezemec! Mefâregezi wiac hâhâwicne bâfuame honezemec.
Tepe motecge mictara, râsifâcge buhândâŋ‐jeŋicko kizejec, ŋicne ŋicne maigao rândiŋkerâ jopazejec.
Ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋege Anuturaonec, ŋeŋe sanaŋ ŋeocmu, ŋicwofuŋ gunuge i bâbâtiŋ gunu.
Go tiŋne jauŋkehuc sindaŋ qaisockeekic. Irec Anutu, gore Anutu hâcne, eki wokemaŋ rua‐garewec, ʒerire wokemaŋ i âgofâcge ruaeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jâurukac,
Ŋaqigere âsu mumundoŋ i ʒineŋ saŋkarac â tokic âsu; erificge i elefaŋte micsieczi bakicne, maŋnao musi bapie mana aŋac eekic.
Kiŋaŋ narufâcge jaŋere guruo ŋicwofuŋ gâcne jaŋere otâfâc wâc juŋgopieŋ, mefâregao ŋonâŋge Ofiri mâreŋkonec gol qonaŋke domakac.
Otâ‐mae manac, ʒâŋe fitec wareme hazec râec: Mame sâkofâcge â mamacgere ficte nikecguzejec.
Ŋicwofuŋ e hawari biaŋgere ecneocmu, erâ e kâcɋenege jukacte dapecnezemec.
Tiro hae rune jaŋe taha barâ fisiniŋmu, mafa sâkoheczi âgo bacguniŋte wiac amecke wareniŋmu.
Ficmaŋko ŋicwofuŋte otâ erickekicne ŋekac, ŋaqi‐ticne golzi basarickekicne.
Ŋaqi qâreŋ biaŋ rojuha ŋicwofuŋtao jowa wareŋgopieŋ, naru ʒeŋoŋ âgofâc‐ticne eraoa jowac‐jopa fisiŋgopieŋ.
Ʒeri bari ehuc bubiaŋhec jowac‐jopa fisipie ŋicwofuŋ erific‐ticnao feŋgopieŋ.
O ŋicwofuŋ, ŋokâfâcge jaŋe kâcɋenefâcge jaŋere jujutacko juniŋmu; goki hâcne mâreŋ sâc ŋicbomboŋ âkendâŋ‐jopacmu.
No ʒâŋe biŋege ŋic gaŋne gaŋne jaŋerao bafaharepemu; irec ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe tatara tâmiric muteŋguhuc juniŋmu.

Anutu e dapeŋ sâko‐nâŋec â tâpiri‐nâŋec, ʒârâ ʒâpâo mi hetiric‐nâpohuc bafic‐nâpoekac.
Irec mâreŋ e hetikieme bipic tatara mi enaŋmu, tiki jaŋe hâwecmaŋko huzo murâ huniŋ.
Siri jaŋe fânâŋ ehuc wânʒâŋnehec qaniŋ, tiki mâreŋkopec hewiwickekupie qiriŋ qaoc.
Rowaŋkonec opâ ʒâŋene ʒâŋene fisihuc Anuture haeo aŋac ʒeri bâfuaŋgopieŋ; hae i Femicne sâkore ŋeŋe hae hâcne.
Anutu e maŋnao jukacte qiriŋ mi qaocmu, Anutu e furic uupictea ŋezickeocmu.
Ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe iima sâko eŋgopieŋ, ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋe ɋiɋitecke rakac, Anuture marac fânâŋte mâreŋ tâpirine goroŋkekac:
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi nâŋâcnehec jukac, Jakobore Anutuzi huec sanaŋ‐nâŋec ekac.
Wofuŋzi gie baekac i moc ware honeniŋ, mâreŋko ima sâko bâfuaekac hâcne.
Mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao ʒikane ʒikane bâniniŋkeekac, tepe bazuekac, damu âte ʒuekac, â ʒikare keretac ʒoczi rikeekac.
“Niniŋkerâ, no Anutu jukopac i mana taraniŋ, ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe sâsecnupie fekopac, mâreŋte faio sâsecnupie fekopac hâcne.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi nâŋâcnehec jukac, Jakobore Anutuzi huec sanaŋ‐nâŋec ekac.

Ŋicne ŋicne, me qahuc aŋara heniŋ! Anutu fânâŋkecnehuc ʒeri gae heniŋ!
Wofuŋ, Femicne sâko, e qeŋ bipinehec, e mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec Wofuŋ Sâko jukac.
E ŋicne ŋicne bawahac‐jopame dape‐nârembiŋ, qâpuc guru jaŋe nâŋâcne kiŋaŋ qaqa embiŋ.
E merafâc mâreŋ qizec‐nâŋec bâwosâe‐nârewec, Jakobore ecnewecte furi sâko i râcnewec.
Anutu e aŋara faio hâŋ jaha fewec, qeŋfânâŋ fuahame Wofuŋ e fewec.
Anutu mumuteŋ gae hecneniŋ, hecneniŋ! Wofuŋ Sâko‐nâŋec mumuteŋ gae hecneniŋ, hecneniŋ!
Anutu e mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec Wofuŋ Sâko jukac, mumuteŋ gae hesarickerâ hecneniŋ!
Anutu e ŋicne ŋicne guriŋ bajarekac, Anutu e tiri ŋeŋe‐ticnao ŋekac.
Ŋicne ŋicne fekicnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe turehuc Abrahamte Anuture ŋicfâc eŋgopieŋ. Mâreŋ sâc maro‐jeŋic Anutuzi rauckekac, eki jowaru‐fârerâ fekac.

Wofuŋ e kâcɋene, e Anutu‐nâŋecte hae sâkoo samarierâ mumbiaŋkenʒepeneŋ.
Tiri tiki‐ticne hawari biaŋ fejec ŋekac, mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋe hone aŋac eeŋgopieŋ. Zioŋ tiki faic mâreŋkopec ŋekac, Wofuŋ Sâkore hae.
Erific‐ticne Anutuzi aimuŋ sabeckeekac, i hone manac ehuc jukicne.
Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe hehenusuc erâ mâmâc quruŋ herâ fisimbiŋ.
Izi honerâ warecke sâqorembiŋ; erâ bipic tara‐jareme wisembiŋ.
Mâreŋ ira ɋarac ɋarac qambiŋ hâcne, ŋokac moczi motec roocte gozi kiekac iŋuc embiŋ.
Ʒoaŋ wewefuonec mâŋâŋ mutec fisirâ Tarasisi haeonec woke qanʒaŋ‐jopawec.
Biŋene manambeŋ irec sâc jaha ʒâŋezi honembeŋ, Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋte haeo, Anutu‐nâŋecte hae sâkoo hâcne; hae i Anutuzi ŋeŋe sanaŋ ŋeocte mucnewec.
O Anutu, nâŋe taha ufuŋgere maŋnao aki anonocgere manasumbeŋ.
O Anutu, ʒâŋe biŋegezi mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao rawecte mumumbiaŋgezi iŋuc jaha raekac; mefâregao bâbâpiaŋ fusucmawec fokac.
Zioŋ tiki e irec bubiaŋ manakac; Juda otâfâcne jaŋe mumutiŋgere erâ ʒeri bari eeŋgopieŋ.
Zioŋ orâŋkehuc bârâreckenʒepieŋ, ehuc rucbapa ficne ficne wosenʒepieŋ.
Qânâsac‐ticne hone qârâwiŋ enʒepieŋ, ficsâko maŋne jufârenʒepieŋ, ehuc ʒâhec fuaniŋmu jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazanʒepieŋ:
“Anutu, nâŋâcne Anutu, e jurâ juraʒihuc juocmu, ehuc tatara tâmiric jowa qataŋ enâreocmu.”

Ŋicne ŋicne ŋoŋe dâŋ ʒi mananiŋ, mâreŋte ŋecjucfâc sasawa, hazec râeniŋ!
Ŋic omane mecne, ŋicbomboŋ mecne, mafahec â hapetac mâmâc sasawa.
