Micbipic‐nanezi maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ mufuaocmu, maŋzi mana wosâehuc dâŋ hukicne bâwirickepemu.
Mu qâqiŋ dâŋte hazec râepemu, musi fânâŋ manahuc kesaic dâŋnane mutaniŋkepemu.
Ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋko râsifâc‐nane jaŋe qaisocnuhuc jâpe orâŋ enarepie wemocko hâwicnuocmu?
Ŋic i jaŋe mâriri‐jeŋicte mamanac jueŋgopieŋ, â mafa sâko‐jeŋicte penaroŋ eeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic moczi e jahacne kiwiric sâcne mi roocmu i! Â juju‐ticnere furi Anutu wâc mi bazucneocmu.
Jujure furi i fekicne sâko, roipiehuc juha dameŋ omaeocmu.
Irec juju sanaŋ sâcne mi juocmu, â nombâŋ geŋkeocte eipieocmu.
Mamanahec jaŋe wâc hâmopie honeocmu, mutucne â kâpâne jaŋe mâmâc siroweniŋmu, ehuc moneŋ mafa‐jeŋic gâcne behe‐jareniŋmu.
Jaŋacne ʒâŋezi mâreŋ sâko gâcne wase bambiŋ ŋic iŋucne jaŋe wâc ʒâŋeruŋzi ŋeŋe hae sanaŋ‐jeŋic eocmu, eme ira dameŋne dameŋne fohuc juniŋmu.
Ŋiczi juju saricko mi jurahuc juocmu, e qowi siroweeŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc.
Ine mutuc erâ jaŋacne mamanac jueŋgopieŋ, jaŋere hata i hâcne; â wiac fojarekac irec mana biaŋkeeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe iŋucko tara‐jarezokac.
Jaŋe lama iŋucne hâmoc haeo râec‐jopazo, eme hâmoczi soŋaŋ‐jeŋic eocmu. Ʒâŋeruŋko hupie sahac hawari‐jeŋic ʒaŋkeocmu, hâmoc haezi ŋeŋe juju‐jeŋic eocmu.
Anutuzi ine maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanere kiwiric roocmu, ehuc hâmoc haere tâpirionec bataracnuocmu, eki hâcne no rocnuocmu.
Irec ŋic moc e mafa sâkohec eocmuo, â gorewac‐ticnere ʒâŋe biŋe feocmuo, go irec mi mezacguzejec.
E hâmohuc wiac moc mi amecke raocmu, â ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnezi mi bâjâpeocmu.
Moc e ɋâricne juhuc juju‐ticnere mana aŋac eocmu, â ɋiɋicne jume gâcnezi wâc muafeckeniŋmu,
eme sifu kâcɋenefâc‐ticne jaŋere guruo raocmu, erâ qâtec‐jopahuc tatamac basahuc jaha juocmu.
Ŋiczi juju saricko mi jurahuc juocmu, e qowi siroweeŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc.
Qac momori, Wofuŋ Anutu, e dâŋehuc mâreŋ wiracnekac, wiwira‐ticne ʒoaŋ wewefuonec raku huhunao fisikac.
Zioŋ, hawari biaŋte fâri wâmbuŋ, irecnec Anutuzi tamaehuc fua tâcnekac.
Anutu‐nâŋec e fisikac, erâ dâŋemâc mi jukac, ʒocbâruŋzi ʒa ʒâtâc ehuc bâniecnekac, mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋneheczi râreckehuc bâjâpekac.
E wirame faic sambâŋko fekac â mâreŋko wahakac, ŋicfâcne dâŋjeŋic mutaraocte:
“Fuŋfuŋfâc‐nane hetumaŋ‐jopa‐nareniŋ, taha banarehuc nohec ʒâʒâfic embiŋ jaŋe hâcne.”
Eme sambâŋzi mumutiŋ‐ticnere fuŋne bataniŋkekac, Anutu e jahac mumutara gie bakacte hâcne.
“Kikefuŋ‐nane go manahaŋ noni dâŋ gazape, o Israe, noni mutaniŋgupe, no hâcne Anutu, gore Anutu.
No taha bapagere erâ mi hanecgukopac, â bâzi ririkege i honehuc jukopac.
No fic haegaonec bulimakao ŋicne, me sapagaonec noniŋ ŋicne moc mi ropemu.
Kâteo qowi juŋgopieŋ i nore sasawa, â tiki sâc wiac jujune jurakac i iŋuc jaha.
No sawao wipe juŋgopieŋ i manac‐jopa‐fârekopac, â sopâcko wiac qiriŋ qahuc fokac i nore jaha.
“No nânâre hâmorâ muzac go mi gazazapo, mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ â irec faio wiac fokac i rucke‐fârekopac i!
No bulimakao biucne moc nâekopac? Me noniŋ socne moc nâekopac?
Go Anutu daŋge âzâcnetec izi taha bâzige ezejec, ehuc Femicne sâko dâŋ mupaŋkecnemeŋ irec fârine bâfuazemec.
Erâ ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋko wâsicnuzemec, eme bataracgupe muafecnuzemec.”
Â ŋic sindaŋne e ine Anutuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnekac: “Go mozi mana‐gareha sâcmutâc dâŋnane woseekic, me micgezi ʒâʒâfic‐nanere dâŋ bâuaekic?
Go bâbâtiŋ qaisockeekomec i! Â dâŋnane râpeckeekic i!
Go fiuc roro ŋic moc honerâ âgo baekic, â boe sau ŋic jaŋehec ŋec domac eekic.
“Go micbipicgezi gie repicne baocte manacneekic, â nameŋgezi eeatuc gie baekac.
Go qomâge musoriŋkeekic, â hahac ɋafâcge micko âkec ejareekic.
Go wiac iŋucne ehuc jutec no dâŋemâc jupo; eme nore mumeŋ, e nore sâc jaha jukac. Miŋecgac ine hanecguhuc tutuc qagarekopac.
“Anuture ninikec jueŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe dâŋ ʒi mana‐hâmonʒepieŋ. Noni hesuec‐ŋopape ŋeŋezic basanʒipiŋ ine!
Moc e daŋge nunumu‐ticnezi taha banareocmu, iŋucnezi sâsecnuocmu; â moc e hata‐ticne bahacmâc juocmu, e ine Anuture bâbâpiaŋ jâutupemu.”


O Anutu, go aki anonocgere erâ nore buge sâqoreoc, buurucge fufusuc fokac irec sâcko kiŋ bahac‐nane bâtâmirec.
Hehesic‐nane ʒure bataniŋ enare‐fârec, â sâqocne‐nane bârâriehuc baɋaɋacnuc.
No bahac‐nane hone tarakopac, â sâqocne‐nanezi mai enarehuc jukac.
Sâqocne bahuc go hâcne bugao bapo, â wiac epo i goki honetec repirekac. Go mumutiŋgezi dâŋfâri eocmu, â mumutaragezi ɋaɋacne eocmu.
Jei, no hehesic maŋkonec fuapo, â neŋgoczi sâqocnehec kiwecnuwec.
Jei, maŋzi siocmâc foocte egareekac; maŋfâhâŋko mamana fârine qazu‐narec.
Sanu rehaczi bataniŋnutec ɋaɋackezepac, ʒurecnutec sinoure sâc sirickehuc qaŋqaŋ fuazepac.
Ʒeri bubiaŋzi bâfusecnuzemec, eme me kike qambaŋaŋkemeŋ i mocwâc biaŋkezejec.
Sâqocne‐nanere ʒâŋe maige bâsoŋkezemec, â bahac‐nane bâtâmire‐fârezemec.
O Anutu, go maŋɋaɋac bâfua‐narezemec, â mâro ɋâricne râe‐naretec maŋkehuc qiŋ hezepac.
Ʒâŋe maigaonec mi sârocnuzemec, â gore Tiri Mâro mi nowac roc.
Bâbâpiaŋgere aŋac mocwâc heɋâre‐narec, â micrereŋte aafec bâfua‐narec.
Eme no qaqatara ŋic hatage qazu‐jarepe, â sâqocne bapazi maŋjeŋic gorao bârisienʒepieŋ.
Anutu, bâbâpiaŋ‐nanere Anutu, go soc rurua fuazacte baficnuc; eme nameŋ‐nanezi tiŋnegere mu ʒeri ezejec.
O Wofuŋ, go bipic‐nane baandaŋnec, eme micnanezi mumuteŋge musokazejec.
Go taha babagarere mi aŋacguekac; no bâzi rike‐garepe manatec mi sâckezac.
Ŋicmaŋ busâqoczi kidapekicne irec Anutuzi maname taha bâzi fârine eocmu. O Anutu, ŋicmaŋ busâqoczi kidapekicne â bâuruŋkekicne i goki mi suŋgiŋkecmu.
Aki anonocgere sâcko Zioŋ ehâmocnezemec; ehuc Jerusalemte qânâsac heɋârezemec.
Eme taha bâzi jâmbâŋte aŋacguocmu, qowi bâzi â bâzi hâcbuc rikekicne, eme bulimakao ŋicne alatagao rike‐garezo.


Ŋic tâpiri wânʒâŋ, go mitiŋic wiac gâgâpâcne ecnehuc wemocte penaroŋ ehuc juekic? Go ʒoaŋ ʒora sisipiric gie mana biric eekic.
Nameŋge resa mictara iŋucne, docbapa fuŋqizecne go!
Go biaŋne qaisockehuc sâqocne âgo ecneekic, dâŋfâri mumure takicguha burecte aŋacguekac.
Sisipiric bâbâfua irec dâŋte egareekac, nameŋge eeatuc dâŋte hozine.
Anutuzi bâsirowecgume omaecmu, qoruc bozegaonec rocgurâ bârâriecguocmu, jujune jaŋere mâreŋkonec unucguocmu.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe honerâ hâwic‐jopaocmu, erâ gâwiecnehuc ʒiŋuc muniŋmu:
“Sowine, ŋic eki hâcne Anuture dapeŋko mi soŋkehuc, moneŋ mafa sâko‐ticnao roweckewec, â jahacne mâririre mamanac juwec.”
No ine oliwa jâc ɋâricne iŋucne, Anuture ficko domakopac, no Anuture aki anonocte mamanac juhuc jukopac sanaŋ.
Anutu, goki wiac ekomec, irec dameŋ sâc daŋge gazahuc jupe. Erâ ʒâŋe biaŋge i mitiŋicfâcge jaŋere maio musokape.

Mutucne jaŋe maŋjeŋiczi mueŋgopieŋ: “Anutu moc mi jukac.” Jaŋe repicne, hehesic‐jeŋic mamakâcne, moczi moc wiac biaŋne mi eekac.
Anutu e sambâŋkonec fime wahaekac, ehuc mâreŋŋic ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko mamanahec moc juhuc, Anutu wira basac ecneeŋgopieŋ me mâcne, i honeekac.
Jaŋe qâsoriekicne sasawa, ʒeŋgoma repirembiŋ. Moczi moc wiac biaŋne mi eekac, arictac jâmbâŋ.
Sâqocne bapa, ŋicfâc‐nane ki sipiric ejareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe maŋfânâŋ tâmiric jufâreŋgopieŋ me? Jaŋe Anutu noraonec nânâ nâipiehuc, sifu no mi wâsicnueŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe bipic tatara hâhâwicne ejareocmu, bipic tatara iŋucne moc mi fua warewec. Anutu e somâ râe‐gareniŋmu jaŋere me kike hezu qazuocmu. Anutuzi behec‐jopawecte goki imac‐jopacmu.
Zioŋkonec Israerao bâbâpiaŋ fuazac me! Anutuzi ŋicfâcne jaŋere juju hata herisieocmuo, Jakobozi ʒeri eocmu, â Israezi bubiaŋ manaocmu.


O Anutu, go ʒâŋegere erâ baficnuc, â tâpirigezi ŋezicnuc.
O Anutu, go nunumu‐nane manac, micdâŋ‐nanere hazec râec.
Ŋic pepecheczi nuniŋte faharembieŋ, ŋic qac momoriheczi juju‐nane nowac rozo muŋgopieŋ; jaŋe Anuturao ʒâŋe mi fieŋgopieŋ.
Manakic, Anutu e babafic‐nane, Wofuŋ e juju‐nanere dope.
Râsifâc‐nane okacne sâqocne risie‐jarezejec. Wofuŋ, go erâ‐eesanaŋgere sâcko bâsirowec‐jopazemec.
Eme no maŋafec jaha taha bâzi egarepemu, ehuc gore ʒâŋe muafeckehuc muzepac, go buurucge fekicne.
Go hâcne ʒârâ hâriŋ sasawaonec bataracnumec, eme no ʒâŋezi râsifâc‐nane honec‐jopahuc saoreŋ qakopac.

O Anutu, go nunumu‐nanere hazec râec, â wâwâsic dâŋnane mi wisecnec.
Mana‐narehuc dâŋ okacne bârisie‐narec; ʒârâ hâriŋ‐nanezi siricnukac.
Râsi owa‐jeŋicte â sindaŋŋic ʒika fânâŋ‐jeŋicte maŋnane hâhâŋkekac. Jaŋe ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio râecnuŋgopieŋ, â aaric mana‐narehuc qaisocnuŋgopieŋ.
Maŋnanezi ʒâic serereŋ manakopac, â hâmocte hâhâwiczi sipiricnukac.
Ɋarac ɋarac qahuc domakopac, bipic‐nane tarame gâgâmârâkopac.
Ʒiŋuc mukopac: “Jei, hapâ iŋucne fakechec ezapo! Ine fururuc qahuc wiserâ raku biaŋnuzac.
Jei, no taicko jâmbâŋ razapo, erâ mâreŋ tuhuo soŋkezapo.
No ʒocnehec raku sâsâoc moc bâfuarâ hoe mâŋâŋ sâkore ira soŋkerâ ŋezapo.”
O Wofuŋ, biri‐jeŋic hetâtiehuc dâŋjeŋic bâsifuckec. No hae sâkoo qaqac â rârâsi honekopac;
ŋafe ʒoaŋ sâc haesac râreckehuc domaŋgopieŋ, â maŋnao eesifuc â kikisâ fokac.
Ŋondeŋnao sisipiric fua rakac, â nareŋ gareŋ toma‐ticnao fific guguriŋ â eeatuc i moc mi omaekac.
Mumusoriŋ i râsi moczi mi enarekac, i sâcne desuezapo; pepecne eenare i jabane moczi mi ekac, i sâcne rârierâ soŋkezapo;
mâcne, i goki enarekic, âgo qomâ‐nanezi, mâmâc juhuc hohonec eekopereczi;
qâqâtec juhuc dâŋ mumac qamanac ejuperec, hombaŋko Anuture ufuŋko mâmâc fejuperec.
Hâmoczi ɋeŋfâfâc jaha rocjopazejec, ɋâricnea hâmoc haeo utuckenʒepieŋ, bipic tatara ejareha ʒâŋeruŋ‐jeŋicko hunʒepieŋ.
No ine Anutu wira wâwâsic ecnekopac; eme Wofuŋzi sisipirickonec bataracnuocmu.
Owâcne mecne, furicte mecne, ʒoaŋko mecne, huacbuc dâŋnane mu huse epemu, eme eki dâŋmarac‐nane manaocmu.
Eki bataracnume wamao raʒipemu, eme wiac enarezo murâ quŋkeniŋmu, jaŋe ŋic bocjahazi wiac enareniŋte birickembiŋ hâcne.
Anutuzi mana‐narerâ bawahac‐jopaocmu, e mumutara ŋeŋeo mârâc jaha fuŋkerâ ŋeweczi; jaŋe maŋjeŋic mi bârisieŋgopieŋte, â Anutu araŋ mi bacneeŋgopieŋte.
E qomâ‐nanezi âgofâcne jopaocte meticne bafaharewec, â jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic‐ticne hetâcnewec.
E micbipic‐ticne fâsâcne wokemaŋ iŋucne, ehame sifu ʒika maŋkeekac; dâŋticne urucne, tokicte sâc, izi sifu damu erâ âkec‐jopaekac.
Tagige Wofuŋ qârâriecnec, eki sâcne dopecguocmu; e ŋic tiŋnezi biric boroc eocte moc mi manacneekac.
O Anutu, go tuŋjopatec sisipiricte nombâŋko huniŋmu, soc nânâ â eeatuc ŋic, juju‐jeŋic nâfocne sawa i wâc mi jutaraniŋmu. No ine Anutu, gorao roweckekopac.

O Anutu, go nore buge sâqoreoc, ŋiczi jâpecnuŋgopieŋ; ʒoaŋ ʒora ʒikaŋiczi guriŋnuŋgopieŋ.
Râsifâc‐nane jaŋe ʒoaŋ ʒora jâpecnuŋgopieŋ, bocjahazi sahac fefe ehuc râsi enareŋgopieŋ.
Hâhâwiczi fua‐nareekac, dameŋ ira gorao roweckeekopac.
No Anutuhec juhuc dâŋticne mumbiaŋkeekopac, Anuturao roweckehuc hâwic tâmiric juekopac, ŋiczi wemo enareniŋmu?
Dameŋ sâc hata‐nane hesifuckeniŋte ʒoɋac eeŋgopieŋ, mamanasu‐jeŋiczi bâsâqorecnuniŋte gie baeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe heâckerâ ruc banareeŋgopieŋ, kike hata‐nanere hetâc roeŋgopieŋ, juju‐nane omaeocte hejâpeeŋgopieŋ.
Irec sindaŋ‐jeŋicte okacne jarezemec! O Anutu, go kimbeŋko ŋicguru i qâfiec‐jopazemec!
Ʒika kipo i wose‐fâremeŋ, ʒâŋeuc‐nane wose qâreŋ etec papiagao mi fokac me?
Eme no wirapemu dameŋ ira râsifâc‐nane bâsuec‐jopazo. No manakopac, Anutu e no âgo enarekac.
Anutu, dâŋticne mumbiaŋkeekopac, Wofuŋ, dâŋticne mumbiaŋkeekopac,
Anutu erao hâcne roweckehuc hâwic tâmiric juekopac, ŋiczi wemo enareniŋmu?
O Anutu, no dâŋ mupaŋkepo i fârine bâfuape, no daŋge bâzi taha bagarepe.
Go juju‐nane hâmockonec batarameŋ, â kike‐nane biric boroc ezacte basanaŋkemeŋ. Irec ʒi Anuture maio, jujure tatamacko jupemu.

Buuruc enarec, o Anutu, go buuruc enarec, no gore dapeŋko soŋkekopac. No fakecgere rurumaŋko soŋkerâ ŋehape, sisipiricte mâŋâŋzi fotâcnerâ razejec.
No Anutu, Femicne sâko, e wiracnekopac; gie‐ticne norao bataraocmu, Anutu e hâcne.
E sambâŋkonec okacne bâtikie‐narehuc baficnuocmu, imacnuŋgopieŋ jaŋe mimi bâfua‐jareocmu; Anutu e aki anonoc â jauŋ fâri‐ticne soreocmu.
No laioŋ, ŋic kisucke nâc ejareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋere ŋondeŋko fokopac; micsiec‐jeŋic i damu â tepe, nameŋ‐jeŋic ine sâqe mictara.
Anutu, go fahare sambâŋ qâhuckerâ fezemec, eri tatamacgezi mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ sâckezejec.
Jaŋe kike‐nanere bitiŋ râepie maŋnane wahawec; jaŋe hata‐naneo nombâŋ rombiŋ, erâ jaŋac ʒâziŋkerâ humbiŋ.
O Anutu, maŋzi qiŋ herâ domakopac, maŋzi qiŋ herâ domakopac, no gae hehuc musi bape.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane, mana ɋâɋârec, kulele â gita, mana ɋâɋârec, no furic wiwickepe mana ɋâɋâreoc.
O Wofuŋ, no qâpuc jaŋere ŋondeŋko daŋge gazape, no ŋicguru jaŋere ŋondeŋko mumbiaŋgupe.
Aki anonocgezi feku sambâŋ heuakac, jauŋ fârigezi feku karoracko fisikac.
Anutu go fahare sambâŋ qâhuckerâ fezemec, eri tatamacgezi mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ sâckezejec.

Nemu ŋoŋe jâmbomac mumutara gie fârine baeŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe mâreŋŋic dâŋjeŋic tiŋnea mutaraeŋgopieŋ?
Aricne, maŋzi bâbâsifuc mana biric eeŋgopieŋ, â mâreŋko jâjâiŋ bâbâʒâic kâdoc qajareeŋgopieŋ.
Sindaŋŋic jaŋe neŋgoc bumaŋkonecteaŋ qac qâsoric eeŋgopieŋ, fuarâ izia qâsoriehuc burecdâŋ eeŋgopieŋ.
Marasiŋ sâqocne homa iŋucne kisoŋne jueŋgopieŋ, sopâc homa qepoŋne ere sâc hâcne.
E qaŋgec bapa dâŋmarac‐jeŋic mi manaekac, qaŋgecte fuŋne mamanazi emâmâŋkeekac.
O Anutu, goki micsiec‐jeŋic qanʒaŋnec, Wofuŋ, go laioŋ motec ʒuŋe‐jeŋic unuckec!
Ejaretec opâ iŋucne ŋetâtiehuc omaenʒepieŋ, qinʒiŋ iŋucne ɋaŋa ururuc erâ hâmonʒepieŋ.
Gâwâc hahaczi ŋeŋerâ raku hâmo ʒaŋ eekac iŋucne, me ŋokac kiwecheczi dameŋne mi maickeha kogoc rome, bumâŋ‐ticnere fârinezi tatamac mi honehuc omaeekac iŋucne.
Kuʒi ɋâricne ʒoczi mi ʒasanaŋkeha qâtipepie raekac, irec sâc hetapaic‐jopatec ratâmirenʒepieŋ.
Tiŋne jujuzi okac babazu honerâ ʒeri eocmu; kike‐ticnezi sindaŋŋic ere soc ruaocmu.
Eme ŋic jaŋe muniŋmu, “Jâmbomac, tiŋne jujuzi furi bâfuaekac; jâmbomac, Anutu jukac, ehuc mâreŋko mumutara gie baekac.”

Anutu‐nane, go râsifâc‐nane jaŋeraonec bataracnuc, nuniŋte fahareŋgopieŋ jaŋe nunʒipiŋte sabecnuc.
Sâqocne bapa jaŋere meonec bataracnuc, â soc nânâ jaŋe imacnunʒipiŋte ŋezicnuc.
Honekic, jaŋe juju‐nane hetâcneniŋte ruc baŋgopieŋ, ŋic qac momoriheczi nuniŋte roroc eŋgopieŋ. Wofuŋ, no qaqatara me sâqocne moc mi ehape eŋgopieŋ.
Hehesic‐nane moc mi foha quruŋ herâ fisi birickeŋgopieŋ, irec fahare ware sacfozic enarehuc honec‐jopac.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu, go mana ɋâɋârerâ qâpuc guru sasawa bâtiŋ‐jopac; docbapa repicne jaŋeraonec moc mi akickezemec!
Hae owâeme sâc risie warerâ qâto iŋucne qâŋkeeŋgopieŋ, ehuc haemaŋko rarac wawarec eeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ owa ruruckehuc dâŋfânâŋ sâko erâ ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: “Dâŋepene mozi manaocmu?”
Wofuŋ, go ine gâwie‐jarekomec, qâpuc guru sasawa mana wahac‐jopakomec.
O tâpiri‐nane, no mumumbiaŋ gae hegarepe; o Anutu, go hâcne huec sanaŋ‐nane.
Anutu‐nane e aki anonoc‐ticneheczi bâfuacnuocmu, Anutu‐nanezi manaha râsifâc‐nane honec‐jopahuc saoreŋ qapemu.
Mi qâhâmoc‐jopac, ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe nikec‐jopazacte. Tâpirigezi ejaretec biric boroc enʒepieŋ, erâ herândiŋ‐jopazemec, o Wofuŋ, maro‐nâŋec.
Micbipic‐jeŋickonec dâŋ wahaekac i sindaŋ hârindaŋne; irec penaroŋ â sosopec â burecdâŋ‐jeŋic, izi ufic ejareme ira jowanʒepieŋ.
Kimbeŋko bâsirowec‐jopakutec omaenʒepieŋ. Eme ŋic sasawa jaŋe ʒiŋuc mananʒepieŋ: Anutu e Jakoborao guriŋ bapa gie baekac, guriŋ bapa izi raku mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao tarakac.
Hae owâeme sâc risie warerâ qâto iŋucne qâŋkeeŋgopieŋ, ehuc haemaŋko rarac wawarec eeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe nânâ basahuc ra ju ware ju eeŋgopieŋ, â mi gapec‐jopame kio kâroŋ eeŋgopieŋ.
No ine tâpirigere mumuteŋ gae hepemu, furictea aki anonocgere ʒeri gae hesokapemu. Goki hâcne huec sanaŋ enaremeŋ, â ʒârâ ʒâpâ fuame dapeŋ enaremeŋ.
O tâpiri‐nane, no mumumbiaŋ gae hegarepemu. O Anutu, go hâcne huec sanaŋ‐nane, Anutu go aki anonocge bâfua‐nareekic.


Anutu, go behec‐nâpomeŋ, ehuc bâtâtiec‐nâpomeŋ; go kimbeŋ qanâremeŋ, ʒi mocwâc hefâroc‐nâpoc.
Goki mâreŋ itiriŋkekutec fâuckewec; ʒi suriŋkehuc fokacte fâfâuc‐ticne hemasec.
Go gurufâcge ʒâic ŋemâcne bâfua‐jaremeŋ, go maŋsifuc opâ gumec‐nâpotec nâmbeŋ.
Araŋ bagareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe filac âkendâŋne‐jaremeŋ, râsire tepe wisecnehuc ira qâzuckerâ domaniŋte.
Mefâregezi bafic‐nâpohuc nunumu‐nâŋec manac, eme jorocfâcge jaŋerao bâbâpiaŋ fuazejec.
Anutuzi tiri ufuŋ‐ticnao ʒiŋuc muwec: “No kiwaehuc Sikem hae bâtâc bapemu, â Sukoti wâneŋ kâdoc qapemu.
Gileade rauckekopac, Manase i wâc nore; Eferaim i momori dunane, Juda i ŋicwofuŋ gunu‐nane.
Moabi e kike ʒuʒure râqâc‐nane, Edomtao kikehuhu‐nane wickepemu, Filisa mâreŋ saoreŋ qacnepemu.”
Mozi hae basanaŋkekicnao bara râecnuocmu? Mozi Edomko jowacnu raocmu?
Anutu, go jâmbomac suŋgiŋ‐nâpomec me? Go momorifâc‐nâŋec râpec‐jopatec buc jueŋgopieŋ.
Râsi jopanaŋte hone bafic enârec; ŋiczi babafic‐nâpo i fârimâc.
Anutuhec sâcne momori wânʒâŋ enaŋmu; eki râsifâc‐nâŋec ro waha âte ejareocmu.

O Anutu, go wiwira‐nane manac, nunumu‐nanere hazec râec.
Hâhâwicte hobu‐nane taŋtaŋ âeckekac; mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao domahuc wira‐garekopac. Qânâ ʒorao, nahac fefenere sâc mi ekac, ira jowacnu fezemec.
Go hâcne sâsâoc‐nane, râsire maio huec sanaŋ enarekic.
Dameŋ sâc gore qoruc bozeo ŋec juc ezapo! Fakecgere rurumaŋko soŋkerâ juzapo me!
O Anutu, go mumupaŋ‐nane manameŋ, ehuc ʒâŋege araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ, jaŋehec merâfâc qikiŋne‐naremeŋ.
Ŋicwofuŋ juju‐ticne bâʒorazemec, eme jara bocjaha jurahuc juzejec.
E Anutu gore maio ŋeŋe‐ticnao ŋesanaŋkezejec, mutecne aki anonoc â jauŋ fârizi hone maiŋ ecnehuc juzejec.
Eme no mumupaŋ‐nanere fârine ʒoaŋ sâc bâfuahuc, ʒâŋege mumumbiaŋ gae hecnehuc jaha juzepac.

Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi Anuturao ʒâŋe fihuc niniŋkekac, eraonec bâbâpiaŋ fisi‐nareekac.
Eki sawa qânâ sanaŋ â babafic‐nane ekac, erâ huec‐nane ekacte qiriŋ boc mi qapemu.
Ŋoŋe ŋic moctao quruŋ herâ ra tuŋkezo muŋgopieŋ, qânâsac hârehuc otewekicne iŋucne waha qarâ foocte, mâsi i wezimucko beheniŋmu?
Ine hâcne e ʒai ʒoŋʒoŋ‐ticnehec domakacte bawahazo muŋgopieŋ. Burecte aŋac sâko‐jeŋic fokacte, miczi mumbiaŋkehuc maŋzi sopeckeeŋgopieŋ.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane, go Anuturao ʒâŋe fihuc niniŋkezemec, erao mamanac‐nane fokac.
Eki sawa qânâ sanaŋ â babafic‐nane ekac, erâ huec‐nane ekacte qiriŋ boc mi qapemu.
Bâbâpiaŋ â ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanere ŋesiŋ i Anutu; Anutu e huec sanaŋ â qânâuŋ‐nane.
O qomâfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe erao dameŋ sâc roweckenʒepieŋ, maŋŋeŋicte fuŋne e bataniŋkecnenʒepieŋ; Anutu e hâcne qânâuŋ‐nâŋec ekac.
Mâreŋŋic jaŋe nokafe sawa, ŋicbomboŋ jaŋe wâc ɋârâc ɋârâcne, ŋemâc bâbâfuare sâcko mâmâc afecke‐fâreniŋmu, mâmâc nokafere sâc jaha eniŋmu.
Jâiŋko wiac hohotâckere mi manasunʒepieŋ, fiuckonec wiac bâbâfuare maŋgâc wâc mi enʒepieŋ; â moneŋ mafa sawe‐ŋareocmuo, ine ira mi mana utuckenʒepieŋ.
Anutuzi dâŋ moc muwec i manape arecne 2 ewec: Tâpiri rune i Anutu noni jukopac.
Erâ Wofuŋ, goki aki anonoc rauckehuc, ŋic eebapa‐jeŋicte furine jareekic.

O Anutu, go nore Anutu, no honecguzo fifisacne fikopac, maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi gore hâmokac. Sahac biuc‐nanezi wâc gore hâhâŋkekac, i mâreŋ opâ tâmiric, kereŋke hahaŋ ekicne iŋucne.
Irec tiri ufuŋko gore ʒâŋe fipo, tâpiri â eri tatamacge honepemurâ.
Gore aki anonoczi furi sâko ehuc juju sirickekacte, micbipic‐nanezi mumbiaŋguzepac.
Eme jufepemu sâc muteŋguhuc juzepac; menane bafaharehuc ʒâŋege wâsickezepac.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane gumeqiŋnetec manape, siec ɋârâc â wokemaŋ nâ gapec ekopac eekac. Micbipic‐nanezi ʒeri ehuc mumbiaŋguekopac.
Ine ŋafeo fofo‐naneo dameŋ ʒora gore manasuhuc fope iŋuc fua‐nareekac.
Goki hâcne hone bafic enarehuc juekicte, fakec rurumaŋgao ʒeri gae hehuc foekopac.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi go hariŋguekac, â mefâregezi dope hutuŋ enareekic.
Â juju‐nane sipirickeniŋte ʒoɋac eeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ine mâreŋ hofâhâŋnao ʒâziŋkeniŋmu.
Jaŋe ʒikare micko râec‐jopazo, â kâte qâto jaŋere nânâ eniŋmu.
Ŋicwofuŋ e ine Anuture bubiaŋ manaocmu. Â Anuture ʒâŋeo ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ dâŋ muniŋmu, jaŋere ʒâŋe biŋe fahareocmu; â burecŋic ine micjeŋic fitec qazo.

O Anutu, no mu huacbuc epe mana‐narec, râsizi mu hâhâwic enarekacte juju‐nane sabeckec.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe kamiehuc doc bacnuŋgopieŋte, â sâqocne bapa jaŋe dâŋ qanareŋgopieŋte soŋnuc.
Jaŋe nameŋ‐jeŋic ʒâmukupie sâqe iŋucne eekac, dâŋ hâtânezi tepe motec ejareme tikocko heeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ somâckerâ fohuc ŋic bahacmâc qâtâcnecneeŋgopieŋ, hâwicmâc ɋeŋfâfâc muruniŋte.
Wiac repicne eniŋte qaqafeŋ eeŋgopieŋ, kamiehuc bitiŋ râeniŋte muc manac eeŋgopieŋ, ehuc mueŋgopieŋ, “Mozi honec‐nâpoocmu?
Mozi sindaŋ gie‐nâŋecte fuŋne rituocmu? Nâŋâc hatane soŋsoŋ foocte mana sarickehuc ʒaeckembeneŋ.” Ŋic maŋ mamanasu‐ticne utuckekicne fokac.
Ehame Anuture tepe moteczi kicjopaocmu, ɋeŋnea muruc‐jopame fâfâreniŋmu.
Jaŋacne nameŋzi hehawic‐jopame rândiŋkepie honec‐jopaniŋmuzi mu ruruc ejareniŋmu.
Eme ŋic sasawa jaŋe hâhâwic mananiŋmu; ehuc Anutuzi wiac ekac irec mu binaŋ eniŋmu, â eebapa‐ticnere manatâc qâtâc eniŋmu.
Ŋic tiŋnezi Wofuŋte bubiaŋ mananʒepieŋ, â ere dapeŋko soŋkenʒepieŋ. Maŋsioc tâmiric sasawa jaŋe mu ʒeri enʒepieŋ.

Mumuteŋ i go egarezo, Anutu, Zioŋko; mumupaŋte fârine go bâfua‐garezo.
Nunumu manaekicte gorao hâcne mâreŋŋic sasawa fisieŋgopieŋ.
Bahac bâfua fekupene siric‐nâpoha goki hâcne kiŋ behe‐nâreekic.
Go ŋic moc bâwosâerâ hefâretec, fisi ufuŋgere hae ʒoŋao juocmu, ere manapene ʒerine eocmu. Ficgere mâriri nâ gapec enʒepeneŋ, tiri ufuŋgere hâcne.
Go mâsi hâhâwicne bahuctecne, nunumu‐nâŋec manarâ batarac‐nâpoekic, bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋecte Anutu go; erâ mâreŋ â hâwec qaŋeŋnao juŋgopieŋ, jaŋe go jaha woricgueŋgopieŋ.
Go tâpiri hetec hume tiki râec‐jopameŋ, eme qiŋ herâ ŋeŋgopieŋ.
Go hâwec siri fânâŋ‐ticne, â ŋicne ŋicne ojowa‐jeŋic, bâmâteŋketec tiŋbenoŋ fuaekac.
Eme mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ mecqaŋeŋnao juŋgopieŋ, jaŋe fuŋne qaqa mâsigere bipic tara‐jareekac; go ʒoaŋ wewefu‐ticne â huhu‐ticne, bubiaŋ afusecnetec kiwac qawac eekac.
Go mâreŋ iqickerâ bâgunuckeekic, eme mâriri biaŋ fuaekac, Anuture opâ i opâ ɋârâŋ. Go mâreŋ bâmocke baʒawiec ekutec, nânâ wiac fâri biaŋ fuaekac.
Go opâwâc‐ticnao râehuc tikine heɋâreekic, hoe mutec heme mâreŋ urueekac, eme jambuŋketec wiac fua‐hâmoekac.
Go qa roro dameŋ buafecgezi erickekomec, hatage nânâ mâririhec sasawa.
Sopâc wâneŋne wâneŋne ira rame fusucmarâ juŋgopieŋ, tikine tikine jaŋe kiwaeŋgopieŋ.
Noniŋ bulimakaozi hae mâreŋ foŋkeŋgopieŋ, giene giene padi jacgoŋ bârârâŋnekac; ʒeŋgoma ʒeri epie gae micʒonʒoŋ faharekac.
Anutu aŋara hecneniŋ, mâreŋ ŋecjucfâcne sasawa ŋoŋe!
Ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne bafaharehuc gae hecneniŋ! mumumbiaŋ gae hesarickerâ heniŋ!
Anutu ʒiŋuc âzâcneniŋ: “Eebapage bipinehec. Tâpiri sâkogere erâ râsifâcge jaŋe dape‐gareeŋgopieŋ.
Mâreŋne mâreŋne maigao dunduŋ hunʒepieŋ, ehuc mumumbiaŋ gae hegarenʒepieŋ, ʒâŋegere mumumbiaŋ gae henʒepieŋ.”
Warerâ Anutuzi wiac ewec i hone manac eniŋ: Ŋicŋondeŋko wiac eekac i bipinehec.
E hâwec hetikieme mâreŋ kereŋne ewec; ŋic jaŋe opâ sâko kikezi fotâcnembiŋ; irec hâcne bubiaŋ manacnenʒepeneŋ.
Tâpiri‐ticnezi guriŋ bapa gie tofamâc baekac, ʒâŋe‐ticnezi ŋicne ŋicne hone soŋaŋ ejareekac; irec râŋgeŋne jaŋe pepecne ehuc mi faharenʒepieŋ.
Ŋicne ŋicne, Anutu‐nâŋec muteŋkeniŋ, mumumbiaŋ‐ticnere marac fânâŋ fuaoc;
eki bâwâzâŋ‐nâpome juju guruoa juŋgopeneŋ, kike‐nâŋec soŋaŋkeme âte sowarierâ mi nâpojec.
O Anutu, go ba esâic enâremeŋ, siliwa esâickeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc enâremeŋ.
Go manahaŋ uficko jowambeŋ; go fai‐nâŋecko tagi ŋemâcne râemeŋ;
go ŋic mana‐jaretec qizec‐nâŋecko âtembiŋ; go manahaŋ ʒocko â opâo humbeŋ; eme sifu baefuc‐nâporâ toma sâkoo râec‐nâpomeŋ.
No ufuŋgao qowi bâzi barâ fâpemu, mumupaŋ‐nanere fârine bâfua‐garepemu.
Ʒârâ hâriŋ maŋnao juhuc, micbipic‐nanezi mupaŋkepo i hâcne.
Lama wokemaŋnehec rike‐garepemu, erâ lama ŋicnere âsu mumundoŋ; noniŋ bulimakao wâc bâmocke‐garepemu.
Anutu araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe ware‐fârerâ mananiŋ, eme no wiac enarewec i binaŋ baŋarepe.
Micbipic‐nanezi samarierâ wiracnepo, â nameŋ‐nanezi e muafeckewec.
Maŋnanezi wiac hehesicne maŋkezac muzac, Wofuŋzi dâŋnanere hazec mi râezac.
Erâ Anutu e jâmbomac hazec râewec, â nunumu‐nane manawec.
Anutu e muteŋkezo, e nunumu‐nane mi mana takirewec, â aki anonoc‐ticne mi sakare‐narewec.

Anutuzi aki anonoc enârerâ jambuŋ‐nâpozejec, â ʒâŋe mai‐ticnezi tamae‐nârezejec.
Eme mâreŋko hatage hohone tara fuazejec, â ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe bâbâpiaŋge hone taranʒepieŋ.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe, Anutu, go mumbiaŋgunʒepieŋ, ŋicguru ʒeŋgoma jaŋe mumbiaŋgunʒepieŋ.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe bubiaŋ manarâ ʒeri gae henʒepieŋ, goki ŋicguru dâŋjeŋic mutiŋnehuc mutaraekicte, â mâreŋko ŋicne ŋicne jowac‐jopaekicte.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe, Anutu, go mumbiaŋgunʒepieŋ, ŋicguru ʒeŋgoma jaŋe mumbiaŋgunʒepieŋ.
Mâreŋzi babasawe‐ticnere fârine tahac‐nâpokac, Anutu‐nâŋec, Anutu eki jambuŋ‐nâpokac.
Anutuzi jambuŋ‐nâpokacte mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao mâmâc sasawa e araŋ bacnenʒepieŋ.

Anutuzi fahareme râsifâcne jaŋe tâtieeŋgopieŋ, e qaisockeeŋgopieŋzi wisecneeŋgopieŋ.
Hosâczi tâtieekac iŋuc bâtâtiec‐jopaekac, wokemaŋ ʒocko ʒâseŋkeekac irec sâc, sindaŋŋic jaŋe Anuture maio siroweeŋgopieŋ.
Tiŋne jaŋe ine Anuture maio aŋac â bubiaŋ manaeŋgopieŋ, â ʒeri bari ehuc kiwaeeŋgopieŋ.
Anutu gae hecneniŋ, ʒâŋe‐ticne muafeckeniŋ, karorac faio juekac e gae moc hefuacneniŋ, ʒâŋe‐ticne Wofuŋ, mai‐ticnao kiwaeniŋ.
Anutu e tiri hae‐ticnao bekâ mamac ejareekac, â hozec roroŋ sasabec ejareekac.
Anutuzi qarâ suriŋne fic hae bâfua‐jareekac, niŋgiŋ‐jopakicne firuec‐jopame juhâmoeŋgopieŋ; maŋrâŋgeŋ jaŋe ine mâreŋ hahaŋkekicnao juniŋmu.
O Anutu, go ŋicfâcge bânie‐jarehuc, mâreŋ tuhuo âte âte rameŋ,
dameŋ ira mâreŋ ɋiɋiteckewec â sambâŋkonec hoe wahawec, Anutu gore maio. Sinai hâcne Anutu gore maio ɋiɋiteckewec, Israere Anutu gore maio.
Anutu, go hoe micsâko hesietec wahawec, fuŋfuŋfâcge betaŋkepie sâc bâgunuc‐jopameŋ.
Lama gurufâcge jaŋe ira ŋeŋe hae bâfuambiŋ, Anutu, buurucgere hapetac hone maiŋ ejaremeŋ.
Wofuŋzi bubiaŋ biŋedâŋ mufuawec; ŋokac hâmbâŋ sâkozi kiŋaŋ rahuc dâŋ bârâwiŋkembiŋ:
“Ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe momorifâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec wiseŋgopieŋ.” Ŋokac haeo ŋeŋenezi mafa mateŋ kâdoc qaŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe hapâ fakecne siliwazi ɋorockekicne iŋucne, â mâmâŋ‐jeŋic i gol sâsârekicne ârâŋ ɋâri irec sâc. Ehame wemocte lama sapaoa ŋezo muŋgopieŋ?
Bapafârezi ŋicwofuŋ qâtâtiec‐jopawecko, Zalimoŋ tikio sinou wahawec.
O tiki sâko mako, Basaŋ tiki, o tiki qoŋne qoŋne, Basaŋ tiki!
Tiki qoŋne qoŋne go wemocte Anuture tiki iiŋguuŋ ecnekomec? Tiki ira hâcne Wofuŋzi jusanaŋkeocte bâwosâewec.
Anuture ʒika keretac tauseŋne tauseŋne bocjaha, irec faio Wofuŋzi Sinai beherâ tirificko fisiwec.
Go faic hefâmeŋ, niŋgiŋ‐jopakicne jowac‐jopameŋ; ŋic jaŋere guruo taha fua‐garewec, râŋgeŋne jaŋerao mâmâc; ine go ira Wofuŋ Anutu jucmurâ iŋuc emeŋ.
Wofuŋ muteŋkezo, e ʒoaŋ sâc de âsic enâreekac, Anutu e bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec.
Anutu‐nâŋec e bâbâpiaŋ Anutu; Wofuŋ Anutu e hâmockonec babatarac‐nâpo irec hata focnekac.
Anutu e râsifâcne jaŋere qizec hefâuckeocmu, ŋic moc sindaŋ hata‐ticnao juocmu, ere utu mai hefâuckeocmu.
Wofuŋzi muwec, “No Basaŋkonec bârisiec‐jopapemu, no hâwec ʒâkâŋkonec bârisiec‐jopapemu;
eme kikege sâcne socko ʒurecmu, â qâtofâcge nameŋ‐jeŋic râsi jaŋeraonec suanʒeŋ fua‐jareocmu.”
O Anutu, ʒeri hombaŋgere ŋic biri ʒora tiri ufuŋgao honec‐jopakicne. Anutu Wofuŋ Sâko gore biri ʒora hâcne.
Gae hehe jaŋe micne bambiŋ, musi bapa jaŋe ʒâhec rambiŋ, ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko naru ŋokaczi woŋgâŋ qambiŋ:
“Tutumaŋ sâkoo Anutu muteŋkezo, Wofuŋ e Israere opâ ʒâŋe.”
Benjamiŋ guru pitic jaŋe micne bajarehuc raŋgopieŋ, Juda guruonec ŋicbomboŋ, guru sâko raŋgopieŋ, erâ Sebuloŋte ŋicbomboŋ â Naftalire ŋicbomboŋ.
Tâpirigere fuŋne bataniŋkec, o Anutu; go ŋezic‐nâpohuc tâpiri bâfua‐nâremeŋ i fosanaŋkezejec.
Jerusalem taha ufuŋge ŋekac irec erâ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe taha bagare fisinʒepieŋ.
Saparac uupicko qowi juŋgopieŋ jaŋe hanec‐jopazemec, kâte bulimakao guru kâcɋene â piticne mâmâc. Moneŋte harac eŋgopieŋ jaŋe âtenʒaŋ‐jopazemec, ʒikare aŋac‐jopakac ŋicguru i bâtâtiec‐jopazemec.
Aigita mâreŋkonec ŋic fekicnezi ʒocnehec fisiŋgopieŋ, Etiopia mâreŋkoneczi mejeŋic Anutu sicnecneŋgopieŋ.
Mâreŋte ŋicguru, Anutu gae hecneniŋ, Wofuŋ mumumbiaŋ gae hecneniŋ.
E sambâŋte sambâŋ, esecne fuawec irec faio rac warec juekac, eme marac fânâŋ sâko‐ticne râwiŋkeme, mâreŋ sâc manaeŋgopeneŋ.
Anuture tâpiri muafeckeniŋ, ʒai ʒonʒoŋ‐ticnezi Israe ɋorockekac, tâpiri‐ticnezi karoracko fuakac.
Anutu tirific‐ticnao jukac i bipinehec; Israere Anutu eki ŋicfâcne tâpiri â sasanaŋ hejareme huekac. Anutu muteŋkenaŋ!

O Anutu, go baficnuc! Opâzi biac wefujec upe‐naneo qakac.
No sohoŋko âte utuckehuc ââtesiŋ basakopac; ʒâkâŋko hupe rumizi qâurucnukac.
Owackeku marac‐nane bieme betaŋkekopac, Anutu‐nanere woŋec juku ʒâŋe bâniniŋ enarekac.
Maŋgâŋ qaisocnuŋgopieŋ jaŋere ʒare i qizec susuc‐nane sirickekac. Tâpiri‐jeŋichec jaŋe burec ehuc sipiricnuzo eŋgopieŋ. No wiac moc mi fiuckepo, eha bâtikiepemurâ muŋgopieŋ.
O Anutu, no mutuc epo irec fuŋne manakic, wiac esifuckepo i kâuc mi bakic.
Go woricguhuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe nore erâ mi qurutuanʒepieŋ, o Anutu, Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ. Israere Anutu, go wira basac egareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe nore erâ mimi faio mi fenʒepieŋ.
Nore faio dâŋ fewec â mimi qaqa enarekicne, i gore qâqâiŋne fua‐narewec hâcne.
Qomâfâc‐nane jaŋe mana‐narepie jabane ekopac, neŋgoc‐nanere ɋâricfâc jaŋe ʒâŋe ruruŋnuŋgopieŋ.
Gore ficte erâ bunane ʒoc ʒarâ ʒâfitacnukac, â go musoriŋgueŋgopieŋ jaŋere mumusoriŋzi nore faio fekac.
No kiorâ sowa juhuc sahac‐nane bâʒâickepo, eme jaŋe hanecnuhuc musâqorecnumbiŋ.
No busâqocte erâ mateŋ qonaŋkerâ jupo, eme jaŋe âke sisic enarehuc jumbiŋ.
Ŋic ŋokac jaŋe hae ʒoŋao turerâ nore mu binaŋ eeŋgopieŋ, â waiŋ opâ nâhuc nore ʒoraŋ gae heeŋgopieŋ.
No ine nunumu‐nane, Wofuŋ gorao sorepe hefâekac. O Anutu, buurucge fufusuc fokacte dameŋ ira me ira manatec sâckeha mana‐narezemec.
Go jauŋ fârigeheczi baficnutec sohoŋ dodocko mi âte utuckezepac; râsifâc‐nane jaŋeraonec, â opâ ʒâkâŋkonec bataracnuzemec.
Rumizi mi qâurucnuzejec, â ʒâkâŋzi mi ɋâcnuzejec, â nombâŋzi mi nâkâcnuzejec.
O Wofuŋ, go mana‐narec, aki anonocge aŋacne; bumâteŋ sâkogere erâ norao fohorec.
Kiŋaŋŋicge no ʒâŋe maige mi bâsoŋke‐narec, no mezacnukacte biac mana‐narec.
Maŋfuŋ‐naneo warerâ firuecnuc, râsifâc‐nane jaŋere erâ rambaŋko râecnuc.
Mimi qaqa enarekicne â musoriŋnukicne, i goki mana‐fârekomec; â râsifâc‐nane kâuc mi bacjopakic.
Mimizi ŋecnukume bunane herickekac, busâqoc mana‐nareniŋte ʒâŋe fipo, erâ basapo, bâbâmiriŋ bâfuapemurâ eipiepo.
Nânâre okacne marasiŋ sâqocne narembiŋ, opâre hâmope opâ ʒaʒacne gumecnumbiŋ.
Jaŋacne tebozi wiwitic ejarezejec, â tiwâ bâzi‐jeŋiczi bitiŋ ejarezejec.
Go ʒâŋe‐jeŋic bâhâpotec tiŋtuŋ qanʒepieŋ, hoqaŋeŋ‐jeŋiczi qiric qârâc qahuc juzejec.
Aaricge hoŋketec fai‐jeŋicko fezejec, kimbeŋgere ʒocbâruŋzi qâhâsâc‐jopazejec.
Hae‐jeŋic tuhu fuazejec, ficjeŋicko ŋic moc mi juzejec.
Go ŋic qa bâtiŋ ejaremeŋ jaŋe fific guguriŋ ejareŋgopieŋ, â ŋic ʒâpâ jopameŋ jaŋe ʒâic bâsoka‐jareŋgopieŋ.
Go kiŋzi kiŋ ʒuhucke‐jarezemec, moc mi jowac rotec maigao bahac fâsâc enʒepieŋ.
Juju sanaŋte papiao ʒâŋe‐jeŋic hetâmirezemec, tiŋne jaŋere birio mi râec‐jopazemec.
No ine qarâ suriŋne â ʒâic hati jukopac; Anutu goki baficnurâ sabecnuzemec.
No Anutu gae hecnehuc muteŋkepemu, no daŋge âzâcnehuc muafeckepemu.
Wofuŋ e irec mana biaŋkeocmu, bulimakao ʒuŋenehec â sârânehec bâzi rikecnepe muzac ine maname wawahane ezac.
Ro waha âte ejarekicne jaŋe i honerâ ʒeri enʒepieŋ; Anutu wira basac ecneeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic firiezejec.
Wofuŋ e tac qararacne jaŋere dâŋ manaekac, e fuŋfuŋfâcne niŋgiŋko foeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mi suŋgiŋ‐jopaekac.
Sambâŋ â mâreŋ jahe e mumbiaŋkezepirec, hâwec â maŋnao wiac qiriŋ qaŋgopieŋ sasawa jaŋe mâmâc.
Anutu e Zioŋ sisipirickonec bataraocmu, â Juda mâreŋko hae sesuc heɋâreocmu; eme kiŋaŋŋicfâcne jaŋe irec rune erâ junʒepieŋ.
Kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe hotâckenʒepieŋ, eme ʒâŋe‐ticnere aŋac‐jopaekaczi maŋnao junʒepieŋ.

O Anutu, go bataracnucmurâ manatec sâckezejec! O Wofuŋ, go fâro barâ baficnuc!
Juju‐nane nowac rozo muŋgopieŋ, jaŋe mimi faio râec‐jopatec weaŋkenʒeieŋ. Sisipiric fua‐nareocte maŋkeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ejaretec qurutuarâ risienʒepieŋ.
“Sowine, sowine” munareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe mimizi ŋemiziec‐jopazejec.
Go wira basac egareeŋgopieŋ sasawa, jaŋe aŋac‐jopame bubiaŋ mana‐garenʒepieŋ. Bâbâpiaŋgere ejareekac sasawa, jaŋe dameŋ sâc “Anutu e kâcɋene” mugarenʒepieŋ.
No ine hapetac â qarâ suriŋne jukopac, o Anutu, go tarec jaha warec! Go babafic‐nane â fifirue‐nane, o Wofuŋ, ŋeŋec ʒeʒepec mi ezemec!
O Wofuŋ, no gore dapeŋko soŋkekopac; go mana‐naretec mimi faio moc mi fezepac.
Tiŋnegere sâcko asao rocnuhuc firuecnuc; norao hazec râerâ bâpiaŋnuc.
Goki qânâuŋ enarehuc sabecnuc, huec sanaŋ enarehuc ŋezicnuc, go hâcne qânâ‐nane â huec‐nane.
O Anutu, go sindaŋŋic jaŋere meonec bataracnuc, ŋic hehesicne â ʒâic bâbâfuare aŋac mamana jaŋere meonec.
O Wofuŋ, go hâcne woricgukopac, no ɋieonecteaŋ Wofuŋ gore mamanac jupo.
Fuapoonecteaŋ gorao roweckehuc jupo, goki hâcne neŋgoc bumaŋkonec baefucnumeŋ; irec go jaha muteŋguhuc juekopac.
Ŋic bocjahazi nore manapie sowi tinac eekac; ehame goki ine paŋnea sabecnuekic.
Gore mumuteŋzi micnaneo fusucmaekac, ʒoaŋ ʒora muafecguhuc juekopac.
No ŋicqizec ehape mi mac suŋgiŋnuzemec, tâpiri‐nane betaŋkeme mi behecnuzemec.
Râsifâc‐nane jaŋe nore dâŋ muŋgopeŋ, hâmopemurâ ejarekac jaŋe muc manac eŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc muŋgopieŋ, “Anutuzi e behewec, jâpe raku hâponiŋ me, moczi moc mi ŋezickeocmu.”
O Anutu, go taicko mi junarec, Anutu‐nane, go fâro barâ ware baficnuc.
Qoricnueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mimierâ omaenʒepieŋ; no sisipiric fua‐nareocte mueŋgopieŋ, jaŋere faio mimi qaqa â nifepupu fezejec.
No ine ʒuʒuhuc woricguhuc jupemu, â ʒâŋe biŋege basawehuc jaha jupemu.
Micnanezi eebapage tiŋne irec binaŋ bazejec, dameŋ sâc bâbâpiaŋ giege musokazejec; irec ʒarezi mamana‐nane sirickekac.
Wofuŋ Anutu gore tâpirire biŋe bâroŋ bafisipemu; gore tiŋne gie sawa muafeckepemu.
O Anutu, go ɋie‐naneonecteaŋ wiac qazu‐narehuc jumeŋ, eme no mâsi bapage mutaniŋkehuc jaha juekopac.
Irec no ŋicraŋɋa epe jaŋɋâŋ âkecnume, Anutu, go sifu mi behecnuzemec. Eme no ŋic gaŋne gaŋne fua raniŋmu, jaŋe tâpirige mutaniŋke‐jarezepac.
Anutu go tiŋnegezi feku sambâŋ heuakac. Goki wiac kâcɋene sâko eekic; mozi Anutu gore sâc jukac?
Go manahaŋ ʒârâ hâriŋ bocjaha bâfuac‐nâpowec; eme ʒi mocwâc bâfiriec‐nâpocmu, â mâreŋ hukicnaonec mocwâc baefuc‐nâpocmu.
Erâ nore ʒâŋe wâc bafaharecmu, â bâbâmiriŋ bâfua‐narecmu.
O Anutu‐nane, no iŋuc jaha kâriŋɋaŋ qahuc jauŋ fârigere mumbiaŋgupemu. No gita qahuc muteŋ bâteŋ egarepemu, Israere Tiri rune go.
Micbipic‐nanezi go muteŋguhuc ʒeri ezepac, â maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane firuemeŋte e iŋuc jaha ezejec.
Â nameŋ‐nanezi dameŋ sâc tiŋnege mutaniŋkezejec. No sipiricnuzo mumbiŋ jaŋe bawahac‐jopatec mimi fai‐jeŋicko fewec.
O Anutu, go mumutiŋge ŋicwofuŋ tahackezemec, ŋicwofuŋte ŋokâ tiŋne jujuge râcnezemec.
E ŋic ŋokac gurufâcge dâŋjeŋic mutiŋnehuc muzejec, â hapetacfâcge sâcmutâc dâŋte sâcko ejarezejec.
Tiki jaŋe mâreŋ rune mâriri bâfua‐jarenʒepieŋ, â mâreŋ facne jaŋe iŋuc jaha.
E ine hapetac ŋezic‐jopahuc dâŋjeŋic muzejec, qarâ suriŋne kime dopec ejarezejec, â fejareeŋgopieŋ ine bâuruŋ‐jopazejec.
Juju dameŋ‐ticne i ʒoaŋ qahuc juocmu irec sâc juzejec, erâ wâc mosa ŋehuc juocmu sâc, dameŋne dameŋne.
Hoezi qinʒiŋ qakicnao heekac, e irec sâc ezejec, â mâreŋ kereŋne bâgunuckeekac iŋucne.
Juju dameŋ‐ticnao ŋic tiŋnezi jusarickenʒepieŋ, â wama fohuc jaha juha mosa hâmozejec.
Hae mâreŋ ruckeocmu i ŋifec hâwecko fisizejec, â ŋifec hâweckoa ratarazejec, erâ Eufrata opâ sâkoonec domarâ raku mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao mickezejec.
Râsifâcne jaŋe maŋfuŋnao fodapenʒepieŋ, kisâfâcne rufe muduckenʒepieŋ.
Tarasisionec â nucne nucne irec ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe taha bacne fisinʒepieŋ; Arabia â Etiopia mâreŋkonec micne bapa jaŋe sahac taha râcnenʒepieŋ.
Ŋicwofuŋ sasawa jaŋe dieŋzi hecnenʒepieŋ, ŋicguru ʒeŋgoma kiŋaŋ qacnenʒepieŋ.
E ŋic hapetaczi kuku qacneme hone kitaŋ ecneocmu, â qarâ suriŋne me hone bafic tâmiric e iŋuc jaha ecneocmu.
Ŋic bebetaŋne â hapetac ere bune sâqoreocmu, â tac qararacne juju‐jeŋic sabeckeocmu.
Fific guguriŋ â bâbâʒâic maic‐jopaha batarac‐jopaocmu, â socjeŋicte maname furi sâko ekac.
E dameŋ ʒora juzejec, â Saba mâreŋkonec gol tahackenʒepieŋ. Ere erâ ʒuʒuhuc numuhuc junʒepieŋ, ehame Anuture jambuŋzi erao wahahuc juzejec.
Nânâ monʒaŋ mazuc mâriri fuazejec, tikine tikine sawe mâririackezejec; jufu mumuc Lebanoŋte sâc ezejec. Haene haene ŋic ŋokac fua sawec enʒepieŋ, kecɋaŋzi gieo fuaekac iŋucne.
Ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne fofo sanaŋ foraʒizejec, ʒoaŋzi ŋeŋe sanaŋ ŋeekac irec sâc. Ŋiczi ere ʒâŋeo iticnehuc jajambuŋ enʒepieŋ, â ŋicne ŋicne e muteŋkenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu, e muteŋkezo, e buc mâsi sâko baekac.
Tatamac ʒâŋe‐ticne muteŋkehuc juzo, eri tatamac‐ticnezi mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ fusezejec. Jâmbomac jâmbâŋ.
Dawidi, Isaire ŋokâ, ere nunumu gae ʒira tarakac.
Anutu e ŋic siocmâc jâmbomac buuruc ejareekac, maŋjeŋic ɋaɋacne foekac jaŋe hâcne.
No ine kike‐nane fâfâckezo ejec, no âte sowarierâ nuzo ejec.
No ŋic sindaŋne sahackopec juju biaŋ‐jeŋic honehuc penaroŋ‐jeŋicte erâ maŋnane fârorockejec.
Jaŋe ʒâic serereŋ moc mi fojarekac, sahac‐jeŋic ɋiɋicne â wokemaŋhec.
Wiac babasa me ʒârâ ʒâpâ, ŋic gâcne fua‐jareekac, izi ŋic keci jaŋe moc mi rocjopaekac.
Irec maŋfefezi qoqonaŋ‐jeŋic ekac, â pepeczi ŋaqi‐jeŋic eme rojueŋgopieŋ.
Wokemaŋzi ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic âke fusucmame wefurâ ŋeekac, â bujeŋickonec wiac repicne huhuckeme wefuekac.
Jaŋe âke sisic dâŋ hâtâne mueŋgopieŋ, â pepec ehuc ŋic fejareniŋte ejareekac.
Masu‐jeŋic bâfeŋnerâ sambâŋkopec dâŋ mupie feekac, erâ nameŋ‐jeŋiczi mâreŋko wiac fokac i kosa mu surec eeŋgopieŋ.
Eme ŋic jaŋe ine mana‐jarepie sâckeekac, eme mumbiaŋ‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: “Anutuzi wemocko manaocmu? Femicne sâko erao mamana fokac me?”
Kec, manaŋgopieŋ, sindaŋŋic fuŋne‐jeŋic iŋuc fokac. Erâ wiac mocte mana mezac mi ehuc, moneŋ‐jeŋic basaweeŋgopieŋ.
Jei, no maŋnane maŋgâŋ soŋaŋkepe ɋaɋacne fowec, â menane ʒure ɋaɋackepe wânâŋ mi bohotawec.
Anutu, goki manahaŋtec ʒoaŋ ʒora ʒâic fua‐nare jujec, â hae fureme sâc kâcbiŋ kihuc jupo.
No ʒiŋuc muzapo: “Dâŋ muŋgopieŋ ijaha mupe,” ine fuŋfuŋfâcge maŋzi behec‐jopazapo hâcne.
Irec wiac i mana tarapemurâ mamanasu gie bapo; erâ manape quŋkeme emâmâŋkepo.
Izi Anuture dâŋbiri soŋnere maŋnao raʒirâ, miŋecne ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere hata tofane hone tarapo.
Jâmbomac, go mâreŋ sosowaricnao râec‐jopaekic, eme rândiŋkerâ jopahuc qanʒaŋ‐jopaekac.
Jaŋe ɋeŋfâfâc jaha sipirickeeŋgopieŋ, bipic tara‐jareha omaeeŋgopieŋ.
Guŋ manaku mana ɋâɋârepene arictac eekac, iŋuc hâcne hawari‐jeŋicte ninikec fuaocmu.
Mârâc maŋnanezi mana hâtâwepo, â bunane fârorockewec,
dameŋ ira mutuc matacne epo, maigao qowi maŋ tâmiric tinac epo.
Mâcne, no sifu goheckoaŋ juhuc jupemu; goki mefâre‐naneo basanaŋnukomec.
Go dâŋbirigere sâcko jowacnuekic, â ʒâhec eri tatamacko râecnuzokic.
Go mocsâkoa sambâŋko junareekic, â mâreŋko go basacguhuc wiac mocte mi enarekac.
Maŋ sahac jahec‐nane docke betaŋ ezo murâ enic: Anutu go ine maŋnanere wâtuŋ â boreŋ‐nane fofo sanaŋ.
Jâmbomac, go behecgurâ raniŋmu jaŋe omaeniŋmu; go eatuc egareniŋmu jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopacmu.
No ine Anutu gore maŋfuŋko jupe aŋacne ekac. No Wofuŋ Anutu gorao roweckekopac; go wiac eekic sasawa i muiŋ musawec epemu.
O Anutu, go wemocte bebehe sanaŋ behec‐nâpomeŋ? Kimbeŋgere hosâczi wemocte sapagere lama guru jâpec‐jopahuc jukac?
Kikefuŋfâcge esecne rocjopameŋ jaŋere manasuc! Fuŋfuŋfâcge juniŋte furi‐jeŋic bameŋ jaŋe hâcne. Erâ Zioŋ tiki, ŋeŋe haege sakaremeŋ irec wâc manasuc!
Sesuctac foku fofone ewec i rârâ honec: Râsi e tiri ufuŋko wiac hetâtie‐fârewec.
Râsifâcge jaŋe tiri hae ʒoŋagao owa sâko embiŋ, jaŋe jaŋacne filac fârepie feha ma âkendâŋnembiŋ.
Motâc faicpec jâczi hendiŋ bakicne fowec, i râriczi henʒaŋ qanʒaŋnembiŋ.
Erâ jâczi metâ basarickekicne doma rawec, i râric â hamazi hezu henʒaŋ embiŋ.
Jaŋe tiri ufuŋge turuŋkepie ʒawec, ʒâŋegere fic bâsâqore‐fârembiŋ.
Jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Nâŋâc omaec‐jopanʒepeneŋ,” ehuc hae piicko nunumufic ʒoczi rike‐fârembiŋ.
Tirima‐nâŋec mocwâc mi doma rame honeŋgopeneŋ; ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko porofete moc mi junârekac; eme wiac kecʒi mo dameŋko taraocmu i mi manaŋgopeneŋ.
O Anutu, râsi e wezimucko mururuc i beheocmu? Kisâ e ʒâŋege musoriŋkehuc jaha juocmu me?
Go fuŋne weniŋucte akic‐jopakic? Mefârege wemocte sakarekic?
Anutu go mârâc jaha Wofuŋ Sâko‐nane jumeŋ, ehuc mâreŋŋic ŋondeŋko bâbâpiaŋ gie bajumec.
Go tâpirigezi hâwec bâtâcnemeŋ, â ʒâkâŋte momori utune hefâuckemeŋ.
Go oâ qizecne qanʒaŋnemeŋ, erâ biucne kâte qowi jaretec nâmbiŋ.
Go qânâ hefâucketec opâ ʒâŋe fuawec, â opâ fifisine hezicketec kereŋkewec.
Go ʒoaŋte rune jukic â ŋafere iŋuc jaha, goki hâcne mosa â ʒoaŋ râec‐jofameŋ.
Mâreŋ qaŋeŋne gokizia basanaŋke‐fâremeŋ; hoemaŋ â ʒoaŋ dameŋ i goki wâc mutec fuawec.
Wofuŋ, go râsizi mu ruruc ekac irec manasuzemec, ŋicguru hehesicnezi ʒâŋege musoriŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋicfâcge jaŋe râsi jaŋere meo mi râec‐jopazemec; qarâ suriŋnefâcge jaŋere jujure ninikec mi ezemec.
Ʒâʒâficgere mana mezac ezemec; haesoŋko sindaŋte toma bocjaha forakac.
Ro waha âte ejarekicne jaŋere faio mimi mi fezejec; hapetac â qarâ suriŋne jaŋe ʒâŋege mumbiaŋkenʒepieŋ.
O Anutu, go faharerâ gahacne dâŋ ŋezickec; hehesicne jaŋe ʒoaŋ ʒora mu ruruc egareeŋgopieŋ irec manasuc.
Râsifâcge jaŋere dâŋ ojoware mi nikecguoc. Kisâfâcge jaŋere micʒonʒoŋ ʒuʒuhuc hefakac i manac.

Daŋge gazaŋgopeneŋ, o Anutu, nâŋe daŋge gazaŋgopeneŋ; ʒâŋege riwaseckeeŋgopeneŋzi mâsigere binaŋ baeŋgopeneŋ.
“No dameŋ bapo i maickeme mumutara gie‐nane bâtiŋnehuc bapemu.
Mâreŋ â ŋecjucfâcne biric boroc ezo murâ eniŋ, noni mâreŋ wâtuŋne keteŋkepo.
No maŋfefehec jazapemu, ‘Penaroŋ mi eniŋ,’ â ŋic sindaŋne jazapemu, ‘Pepecne mi eniŋ.
Maŋfefehec jaŋe penaroŋ mi eniŋte â sahacfefe jaŋe pepecdâŋ mi eniŋte jazaekopac.’”
Mumutara gie i ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec me huhunaonec me mâreŋ tuhuonec mi fuaekac;
Anutu e buc mumutara gie baekac, ehuc ŋic moc bawahaekac â moc bâfeŋneekac.
Wofuŋ e meticnezi râqâc moc badomakac, irec maŋnao waiŋ opâ momori bâmockekicne ŋekac; eme i hâcne qoŋgiŋke‐jareme mâreŋŋic sindaŋne jaŋe nâku fâhâŋne hâtâ qiŋqiŋne wâc nâzickeniŋmu.
No ine dameŋ sâc ʒeri bari epemu, no Jakobore Anutu mumuteŋ gae hecnepemu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere tâpiri bawaha‐fârezo ŋic tiŋne jaŋere tâpiri ine bafaharezo.

Juda mâreŋko Anuture fuŋne manakicne, ʒâŋe‐ticne Israe mâreŋko bafaharekicne fokac.
Ŋeŋe juju‐ticne Jerusalem haeo bâfuakicne, Zioŋ tikio fic hae‐ticne ŋekac.
Irec hâcne tepe motec qazu qanʒaŋ ewec, erâ wâc sându maro â ʒikare wiac sasawa.
O Anutu, go bipinehec jâmbâŋ, ɋuŋɋasaŋgezi tiki ŋeŋe sanaŋ siric‐jopakac.
Hâbi hâro jaŋe mafa mateŋ jowac rokicne, jaŋe rândiŋkerâ guŋko utuckembiŋ, ʒikare ŋicsaric sasawa mejeŋic betaŋkewec.
Jakobore Anutu goki hanec‐jopakutec becâsic â keretac qiriŋmâc waha fombiŋ.
Jâmbomac, go hâhâwicne, kimbeŋgezi fahareme mozi gore maio sâcne domaocmu?
Mumutara dâŋgezi sambâŋkonec fuame mâreŋ e bipic tatara erâ niniŋkewec.
I Anutu goki mâreŋŋic ro waha âte ejarekicne jaŋe bafic‐jopacmurâ dâŋ mutarazo faharemeŋ dameŋ ira iŋuc fuawec.
Ʒikare nâfocne jaŋe mumbiaŋguniŋmu, ŋic kimbeŋ‐jeŋiczi ŋerisieme mumuteŋ‐jeŋic eocmu.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic taha bacneniŋte mupaŋkenʒepieŋ, erâ mumupaŋ‐ŋeŋicte fârine bâfuanʒepieŋ; ŋic rârec bârârec juraŋgopieŋ sasawa ŋoŋe Anutu araŋ babacnene e taha bacnenʒepieŋ.
Eki micne bapa maŋfefe juŋgopieŋ jaŋe bawahac‐jopaekac; â mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe wiac hâhâwicne ejareekac.

No owa ruruckerâ Anutu wiracnekopac, wiracnehuc mukopac, “Wâwâsic‐nane manac!”
No ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋko Wofuŋ wira basac ecneekopac; ŋafeo docke betaŋ tâmiric menane bafahareekopac, maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi bâbâmiriŋ qikiŋneekac.
No Anuture manasurâ husehuc foekopac, manatâc qâtâc ezo mupe maŋnane gâckeekac.
Ʒâŋe‐nane tâpâune bârâŋgeŋketec guŋ tâmiric foekopac, maŋnanezi mezackekume dâŋezo eipieekopac.
Dameŋ esecne juwefukicne i bâjâpehuc wiac fuawec i manasu‐fâreekopac.
No ŋafeo maŋnanezi mana wosâc eekopac â mâro‐nanezi mana gufuc erâ ʒiŋuc wioekopac:
Wofuŋ e bebehe sanaŋ behec‐nâpokac me? Âgo jauŋ mocwâc mi enâreocmu?
Aki anonoc‐ticne ʒicke sanaŋkewec me? Mumupaŋ‐ticnere fârine omatac fuawec me?
Anutu e buuruc enâreocte nikeckewec? Kimbeŋ‐ticnezi miriŋ‐ticne fitec qawec me?
Eme mupo, “Femicne mefâre‐ticne hetikiejec, irec erâ bunane qâoriŋkekac.”
Wofuŋ goki mârâc gie bameŋ i manasupe, jâmbomac, esecne mâsi bameŋ i honehuc ŋepe.
Giege baekic sasawa i mana biric epe, wiac tâpirihec i mana wosâehuc jupe.
O Anutu, gore hata i tiri moc. Anutu sâko‐nâŋec go iŋucne moc wena jukac?
Anutu go hâcne mâsi bapa Anutu, ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko tâpirige bataniŋkemeŋ.
Tâpiri megezi ŋicfâcge firuec‐jopameŋ, Jakobo â Josefe ŋokâfâc‐jekic jaŋe hâcne.
O Anutu, opâ jaŋe go honecgurâ fâfârembiŋ, â ʒâkâŋ jaŋe honecgurâ ɋarac ɋarac qambiŋ.
Karorac jaŋe opâ hoŋkepie wahawec, sambâŋzi ɋuŋ parandaŋ hewec, tepe motecgezi ŋifec â ŋifec bâricnehuc wahambiŋ.
Mâŋâŋ ʒâkiriŋkeme ɋuŋgere fânâŋ fuawec, bâbâriczi hae mâreŋ batamaewec, mâreŋzi fâfârerâ ɋiɋiteckewec.
Hatage hâwec fofotâc âte rameŋ, kikegezi ʒâkâŋ sâko fotâcnemeŋ, eme sifu kike hatage mi honekicne.
Ŋicfâcge lama guru iŋucne jowac‐jopameŋ, Mose â Aroŋ jahere meo hâcne.
Ŋicbureŋ, mumutâc‐nanere hazec râeniŋ, micdâŋ‐nanezi hazec‐ŋeŋicko huoc.
Qâqiŋdâŋ micnaneonec wahazo ekac, kesaic dâŋ raŋɋane mufuazo ekopac.
Mimiŋe jaŋe binaŋ banârehuc jupie mana maŋ embeŋ, mamana‐nâŋecko fokac,
i hâcne ɋâricfâc‐nâŋec mi hesoŋke‐jarehuc, jufeniŋmu jaŋe mufua‐jarezo: Wofuŋzi gie sâko bawec, â tâpiri‐ticne, â mâsi bawec irec binaŋne hâcne.
Dâŋsanaŋ Jakobo erao âkendâŋnewec, Israe guru sâcmutâc biricke‐jarewec, i wâc ɋiefâc‐jeŋic jazahuc juniŋte, Wofuŋzi apafâc‐nâŋec mupaŋke‐jarewec.
Ʒâhec‐guru hazec‐jeŋicko huocte muwec, ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic, mi fuakicne hâcne.
Eme jaŋe wâc fahare ɋiefâc‐jeŋic binaŋ bajarepie, maŋjeŋic Anuturao siŋkerâ foha, eki wiac ewec irec mi nikec‐jopazejec, â mumupaŋ‐ticne reŋkehuc junʒepieŋ.
Mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sâc mi junʒepieŋ, jaŋe ŋic maŋrâŋgeŋ â qaqaharicne jumbiŋ; maŋjeŋic biric borocne fohuc juwec, mâro‐jeŋic Anuturao mi qohotawec.
Eferaimte ɋâricfâc, tepe babaju, jaŋe ʒika dameŋko hâwic‐jopame wisembiŋ.
Jaŋe Anuture ʒâʒâfic mi soŋaŋkembiŋ, â sâcmutâc bâjâpezo takic‐jopawec.
Eki juwicnao gie sâko bawec, â mâsi jowatuwec, irec nikec‐jopawec.
Mimiŋne jaŋere maio wiac bipinehec ewec, Aigita mâreŋko, Zoaŋ wâneŋko.
E hâwec bâfâucke‐jareme fotâcnembiŋ, ŋifec â ŋifec tufa iŋucne domawec.
Ʒoaŋ domaha karoracko bânie‐jarewec, â ŋafeo ʒoczi batamae‐jarewec.
E mâreŋ tuhuo qânâ hefâucke‐jareme opâ ɋârâŋnea, ʒâkâŋkonec tinac nâmbiŋ.
Qânâonec opâ fifisine wahawec, erâ fusi‐ticnehec rahuc domawec.
Eme sifu ʒuhuckerâ sâqocne bahuc Anutu bunao bambiŋ, Femicne sâko tuhuo pepecne ecnembiŋ.
Anutu maŋjeŋiczi esâickehuc andac‐jeŋicte sâcko nânâre mumbiŋ.
Anutu pepec ecnehuc mumbiŋ, “Tuhuo nânâ sâcne bâmocke‐nâreocmu me?
E qânâ i jâmbomac qâfâuckeme opâ ɋârâŋne wahahuc domawec; eme nânâ wâc sâcne tahac‐nâpoocmu, â ŋicfâcne qowi bâfua‐jareocmu me?”
Wofuŋ e dâŋ i manarâ maŋne faharewec; maŋʒoc‐ticnezi Jakobo bâruŋkecnewec, kimbeŋ‐ticnezi Israe fahac fisicnewec,
jaŋe Anutu mi manasiŋkembiŋte, â bafic‐ticnere mamanac mi jumbiŋte.
Ehame sifu karorac wira‐jareme sambâŋ motâcne motâcne aŋkewec.
Eme manazi hoe iŋucne wahawec, nânâ i sambâŋkonec jareme nâmbiŋ.
Aŋelo nânâ i mâreŋŋiczi nâmbiŋ, ehuc hata nâsiŋ‐jeŋic mi basambiŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec mâŋâŋ soreme rawec, ra juwic mâreŋkonec mâŋâŋ jâpeme wefuwec.
Ehuc qowi beheme hoe tinac wahawec, sawa wipe ɋârâŋne, hâwec moŋgeŋ iŋucne.
Hae toma‐jeŋicko behec‐jopame boze sâc rârec rârec waharâ fombiŋ.
Andac‐jeŋicte jarewecte afecne mi nâmbiŋ, nâku nâku gapec‐jopawec.
Eme aŋac‐jeŋic mi taraha, â qowi micjeŋicko foha,
Anuture kimbeŋzi fahare‐jarerâ, ŋicfâc‐jeŋic tâpiri wânʒâŋ qâhâmoc‐jopawec, Israe ŋicʒeŋoŋ ɋiɋicne qâfiec‐jopawec.
Eme jaŋe sifu ʒuhuckerâ sâqocne bambiŋ, mâsi‐ticne mana suahuc e mi manasiŋkembiŋ.
Irec mume ʒoaŋ‐jeŋic nokafe iŋucne hesackewec, â jara‐jeŋic ʒâic fâro maŋko bazumbiŋ.
Jopame sâc e wâsickembiŋ, ehuc maŋ bârisierâ Anutu wira basac ecnembiŋ.
Jaŋe Anutuzi qânâ sanaŋ‐jeŋic domawec, â Femicne sâko Anutuzi fifirue‐jeŋic juwec, irec mocwâc manasumbiŋ.
Erâ micbipic‐jeŋiczi âkeac ecnehuc nameŋ‐jeŋiczi burecdâŋ âzâcnembiŋ.
Maŋjeŋiczi ine erao sanaŋne mi qohotawec, â ʒâʒâfic‐ticne mi basanaŋkembiŋ.
Eki ine busâqoc mana‐jarehuc kiŋjeŋic behewec, ehuc mi bâsirowec‐jopawec. E dameŋ sâc kimbeŋ‐ticne bâuruŋkewec, â aaric‐ticne manacneme mi ʒâseŋ‐jopawec.
Jaŋe mâreŋŋic sawa jumbiŋ irec manasuwec, nokafe iŋucne, rarâ mi ririsiene.
Opopo, jaŋe dameŋne dameŋne mâreŋ sawao pepecne ecnembiŋ, â mâreŋ tuhuo buʒâic bâfuacnembiŋ.
Jaŋe e esâickerâ esâicke ecnehuc jumbiŋ, ehuc Israere Tiri juju maŋbâiŋ ecnembiŋ.
Jaŋe tâpiri sanaŋ‐ticnere mi manasuhuc jumbiŋ, â râsiraonec batarac‐jopawec irec nikec‐jopawec.
E Aigita mâreŋko fuŋne‐ticne bataniŋkewec, â Zoaŋ wâneŋko mâsi‐ticne bâfuawec.
E opâne opâne bâtikie‐jareme soc ewec, eme nâniŋte quŋke sâqorembiŋ.
E nusuc neŋgec râe‐jareme kicjopambiŋ, â qaqec bâfua‐jareme imac‐jopambiŋ.
E mâriri‐jeŋic qokic biŋe qajarewec, â gie‐jeŋicte fârine ɋirikiŋ qikiŋne‐jarewec.
E waiŋ gie‐jeŋic hoe sanaŋzi qanʒaŋnewec, â jâchândâŋ‐jeŋic aisizi sipirickewec.
E lama bulimakao gurufâc‐jeŋic huc repicne bâfua‐jareme hâmo miziec embiŋ.
E kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋ tuŋke‐jarewec, aaric, mamana sâqoc, â bâbâʒâic, â sisipiricte aŋelo guruhec.
E ima qaqa‐ticne aka mi hecnehuc, â juju‐jeŋic hâmoc mi sakarecnehuc huc sâqocnere micko râec‐jopawec.
E Aigita ŋic mârâc ŋokâ‐jeŋic, Hamte ɋâricfâc tâpiri‐jeŋicte hozine, i hae sâc qâhâmoc‐jopa‐fârewec.
Erâ ŋicfâcne bânie‐jareme faharembiŋ, eme tuhuo lama guru iŋucne jowac‐jopawec.
Aimuŋ hone maiŋ ejareme hâwicmâc jumbiŋ, râsifâc‐jeŋic ine hâweczi qâuruc‐jopawec.
Izi tiri mâreŋ‐ticnao bacjopa fisiwec, mefâre‐ticnezi tiki ruckewec ira hâcne.
Erâ mai‐jeŋicko qâpuc guru jâpec‐joparâ mâreŋ‐jeŋic kâdoc qahuctecne ŋeŋetac‐jeŋicko Israe guru râec‐jopawec.
Jaŋe ine sifu Anutu Femicne sâko esâickehuc pepec ecnembiŋ, â mumutaniŋ dâŋticne mi bâjâpembiŋ.
Jaŋe mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere hata âtehuc Anutu râpeckerâ bunao bambiŋ, ehuc tepe neŋgocne hehesicne iŋucne embiŋ.
Jaŋe tiki sâc alata bahuc maŋbâiŋ ecnembiŋ, â nemuɋâŋ bajupie bune heâriŋkewec.
Anutu e i manarâ maŋnao aaric fusucmame Israe guru behec‐jopa sanaŋkewec.
E Silo haeo ŋeŋe juju‐ticne râpeckewec, ŋicŋondeŋko qoruc boze fârecnekicne i behewec.
E tâpiri‐ticnere ma â eri‐ticne i qikiŋneme râsi jaŋe rombiŋ.
Ŋicfâcne ʒikare micko râec‐jopawec, â fuŋfuŋfâcne kimbeŋ qajarewec.
Eme ŋicmotecfâc‐jeŋic ʒoczi ʒacjopawec, â naru ŋokacfâc‐jeŋic ŋic tâmiric jumbiŋ.
Taha bapafâc‐jeŋic ʒikare nânâ embiŋ, eme hozecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ki soŋgâŋ mi embiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ e guŋkonec tinac mana ɋâɋârewec, momori moczi waiŋ nâhuc owackeekac iŋuc ewec.
Erâ râsifâcne hetapaic‐jopame wisembiŋ, mimi tatara tâmiric bâfua‐jarewec.
Josefere ɋâricfâc ine qikiŋ‐jopawec, â Eferaimte guru mi rowosâewec.
Irec okacne Juda guru sakarewec, â Zioŋ tiki joroc‐ticne hâcne.
Tirific‐ticne tiki sanaŋ iŋucne heme ŋewec, mâreŋ sâko ŋeŋe sanaŋ hewec ŋekac irec sâc.
Erâ kiŋaŋ motec‐ticne Dawidi e bâwosâerâ lama sapaonec rowec.
E lama neŋgoc motec hone maiŋ ejarewec, irec okacne Jakobo kikefuŋ guru soŋaŋ‐jopaocte, â Israe fuŋfuŋfâcne hone kitaŋ ejareocte, Wofuŋzi rowosâewec hâcne.
Eme eki aimuŋ hone maiŋ ejarewec, â mepapac jaha jowa qataŋ ejarewec.
O Anutu, qâpuc jaŋe haemaŋgao raʒimbiŋ, tiri ufuŋgao wâwânâŋ bâfuambiŋ, Jerusalem hae ima bambiŋ.
Jaŋe kiŋaŋŋicfâcge fâri ombâŋ‐jeŋic sawa wipe jaŋere micko râembiŋ, tiri ŋicfâcge biuc‐jeŋic kâte qowi jarembiŋ.
Erâ socjeŋic Jerusalem hae rârec opâ iŋucne hesiepie rawec; mozi moc ducjopazac!
Bembeŋko juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe mecpiroc enâreeŋgopieŋ; ŋic rârec rârec juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe mu ruruc enârehuc gâwie‐nâreeŋgopieŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go kimbeŋ qanâreku mo dameŋko behecmu? Aaricgezi ʒoc iŋucne bâruŋkeku mo dameŋko qaʒueocmu?
Kimbeŋge qâpuc kâuc bacguŋgopieŋ jaŋere faio hoŋkec, ŋicguru ʒâŋege mi wâsickeeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao.
Jaŋe hâcne Jakobo ki qâsuc ecnembiŋ, â hae mâreŋ‐ticne imackembiŋ.
Mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋere kiŋte mi mana gâpâre‐nârec, buurucgezi biac ware bâfuac‐nâpooc; nâŋe mâretec docke betaŋ eŋgopeneŋ.
Go ʒâŋe biŋegere erâ bafic‐nâpoc, o bâbâpiaŋ Anutu‐nâŋec! Ʒâŋegere erâ batarac‐nâpohuc sâqocne‐nâŋec bâtâmirec.
Qâpuc jaŋe wemocte muniŋmu, “Anutu‐jeŋic weni?” Kiŋaŋŋicfâcge socjeŋic hoŋkekicne irec kiŋ qâpuc jaŋerao bataratec honenʒepeneŋ.
Niŋgiŋ‐jopakicne jaŋere wâwâsiczi bâfuacguzejec, â hâmoniŋte biŋe qacjopakicne jaŋe mesanaŋgezi firuec‐jopatec junʒepieŋ.
Râpec‐nâpohuc juŋgopieŋzi, Wofuŋ, go mu ruruc egarembiŋ, irec furine arec 7 jaretec sahac‐jeŋicko fezejec.
Â ŋicfâcge nâŋe, lama guru soŋaŋ‐nâpoekic hâcne, ine daŋge gazahuc junʒepeneŋ raŋɋa raŋɋa; â ɋâricfâc‐nâŋec gaŋne gaŋne fua raniŋmu, jaŋe ʒâŋe biŋege mutaniŋke‐jarehuc junʒepeneŋ.

Israere lama soŋaŋ, hazec râec! Josefe guru lama iŋucne soŋaŋ‐jopaekic, â kerubim jaŋere faicnao ŋeekic, go fua tâcnec!
Eferaim â Benjamiŋ â Manase jaŋere maio hâbige hetec hume ware bafic‐nâpoc.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, go heɋârec‐nâpoc; ʒâŋe maigezi tamaeme biaŋ‐nâpozejec.
O Wofuŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, gurufâcge jaŋe numu‐gare‐bipiehapie kimbeŋ qajareku mo dameŋko behecmu?
Goki mutec ʒâŋeuc‐jeŋiczi nânâ‐jeŋic ruacneha nâeŋgopieŋ, ʒâŋeuczi nânâ opâ‐jeŋic eekac.
Goki mutec ŋicne ŋicne rârec‐nâpohuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe nifepupu enâreeŋgopieŋ, râsifâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mu gâgâwi enâreeŋgopieŋ.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, go heɋârec‐nâpoc; ʒâŋe maigezi tamaeme biaŋ‐nâpozejec.
Go Aigita mâreŋkonec waiŋ qizec unuckemeŋ, erâ qâpuc guru jâpec‐jopahuc sarameŋ;
go mâreŋ bâburockecnemeŋ, eme gâtâ barâ mâreŋ bârârâŋnewec.
Tieŋnezi tikine tikine mumuc qajarewec, â qaŋeŋnezi jâmâzâc sâko sâockewec;
tieŋne sicneme ŋifec raku hâwec bâfuawec, â ŋifec raku Eufrata opâ sâkoo fisiwec.
Eme wemocte qânâsac‐ticne hetâtiemeŋ, eme sicne fotâc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe fârine batara nâc eeŋgopieŋ?
Kâtebec ŋicne jaŋe gâtâne qâfieeŋgopieŋ, â kâte qowi jaŋe gupiŋne kitâcne nâc eeŋgopieŋ.
O Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, mocwâc forisiec, sambâŋkonec fitec wahame honec, ehuc waiŋ qizec kecʒirec moc mana mezac ec.
Go hâcne ukicne mefâregezi sarameŋ, go hâcne nuucne jauŋketec fua sokac ewec.
Jaŋe ʒoczi rikembiŋ erâ wâc hetâcnembiŋ; gore kimbeŋ ʒâŋezi bâsirowec‐jopazejec.
Mefâregere ŋic ine megezi bâsâockezemec, ŋicte ɋâric jauŋkehaŋ soka‐garewec e sabeckezemec.
Eme nâŋe mocwâc mi râpecgunʒepeneŋ; juju ɋâri nârec, eme ʒâŋege muafeckenaŋmu.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, go heɋârec‐nâpoc; ʒâŋe maigezi tamaeme biaŋ‐nâpozejec.

Anutu tâpiri‐nâŋec e gae bafehuc hecneniŋ, Jakobore Anutu kiwaecneniŋ.
Mumuteŋ gae fuŋkehuc woŋgâŋ qaniŋ, kulele marac faŋfaŋ â gita fâzeniŋ.
Mosa wahaocmuo qeŋ dâŋezejec, erâ wâc hombaŋ‐nâŋecko, toŋ heocmuo mâmâc.
Israe kikefuŋ iŋuc mutâcnecnewec, Jakobore Anutuzi mupaŋkewec.
Aigita mâreŋ maickehuc faharewecko, Josefe sâcmutâc iŋuc ecnewec. Dâŋ moc hazec furu‐nane manakopac:
“Ɋawegao tagi fowec i qatarapo, megao sasac fowec i gowac ropo.
Ʒâicmaŋko wira‐naretec baficgupo, ɋuŋ parandaŋte haesoŋko juhuc mana‐garepo, Meriba opâo esâicgupo.
“Gurufâc‐nane, manahapie uŋ ŋazape; Israe guru, dâŋnane mananʒapiŋ me!
Ŋoŋe nemu jabane moc mi bajunʒepieŋ, guru moc jaŋere nemu mi dapecnenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ noni gore Anutu jukopac, Aigita mâreŋkonec jowacgu warepo no hâcne; go micge aŋketec bâfuse‐garepe.
“Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe ine dâŋnanere hazec mi râembiŋ; Israe guru jaŋe micnane mi reŋkembiŋ.
Eme maŋsanaŋ‐jeŋicte faio fehuc mana‐jarepe, jaŋacne mamana biri bâjâpembiŋ.
Jâi, ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe hazec râe‐narenʒapiŋ! Israe guru jaŋe nore hata âtenʒapiŋ me!
Eme noni râsifâc‐jeŋic biac bawahac‐jopazapo, â menanezi kisâfâc‐jeŋic imac‐jopazac.
Eme Wofuŋte takic‐jopaekac jaŋe e mezarecnenʒapiŋ, â ʒâic dameŋ‐jeŋiczi tatarane mi ezac.
Ŋoŋe ine waizeŋ uucne aŋac baŋacne kâdoc qaŋarezapo, â qânâonec baŋac gumeqiŋ‐ŋopazapo.”
Anutu e nemu tutumaŋko domakac, nemu jaŋerao mumutara gie bakac.
“Ŋoŋe dâŋ muhasickehuc mumu, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋerao rorowecke, i wezimucko beheniŋmu?
Ŋic ɋerone â bekâne jaŋere dâŋ dopeckeniŋ, qarâ suriŋne â hapetac sacfozic ejareniŋ.
Ŋic dodocne â tac qararacne sabec‐jopahuc ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere meonec batarac‐jopaniŋ!”
Jaŋe ine wiac kâuc bahuc moc mi mana taraŋgopieŋ, dapâcko qicquc qahuc juŋgopieŋ; eme mâreŋ ŋesiŋne ŋeŋgoroŋke‐fârekac.
Noni mupo, ŋoŋe nemu juŋgopieŋ, Femicne sâko ere motecfâc sasawa;
eme sifu ŋic iŋucne hâmonʒepieŋ, ŋicbomboŋ rândiŋkeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc enʒepieŋ.
O Anutu, go faharerâ mâreŋko mumutara gie bac, ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe gore sasawa.

O Anutu, go mi fâsâec, Anutu, go niniŋkerâ dâŋemâc mi juc.
Honec me, râsifâcge ojowa qaŋgopieŋ, qaisocgueŋgopieŋ jaŋe pepec eŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋicfâcge doc bacjopaniŋte dâŋ birickeŋgopieŋ, sabec‐jopaekic jaŋe wiac ejareniŋte meo roroc eŋgopieŋ.
Muŋgopieŋ, “Ajoc, ŋicguru i omaec‐jopanaŋ, eme Israe ʒâŋe somarezejec.”
Jâmbomac, jaŋe muc manac eku maŋ mocjaha embiŋ, go râsi egarehuc ʒâʒâfic sanaŋ eŋgopieŋ:
Edom ŋicguru â Isimaere ɋâricfâc, Moabi ŋicguru â Hagiri kikefuŋ;
Gebale â Amoŋ â Amaleke ŋic, Filisa mâreŋ â Tiro hae rune;
eme Asiriazi jaŋerao wâc ʒuhuckekac, eki hâcne Lotire ɋâricfâc neŋgoc ŋesiŋ ejarekac.
Go mârâc Midiaŋ wiac ecnemeŋ ijaha ejarezemec, erâ Sisera â Jabiŋ Kisoŋ opâo ejactemeŋ iŋuc;
jaŋe Eŋdoro hae ŋifecnao bâsirowec‐jopatec, sahac biuc‐jeŋiczi mâreŋ irec guec ewec.
Ŋicbomboŋ‐jeŋic Orebe Ʒebe jahe iŋucne enʒepieŋ, â micnefâc‐jeŋic ine Ʒeba Ʒalimuna jahere sâc.
Jaŋe hâcne mumbiŋ, “Anuture gie hata sakarepene nâŋâcne ezejec.”
O Anutu‐nane, goki mutec rehac hâmocne me padi jawa mâŋâŋzi ficne sueekac iŋuc enʒepieŋ.
Ʒoczi jâckâte ʒâseŋkeekac, â ʒocbâruŋzi sopâc tiki bârârâŋneekac,
irec sâc bâbâricgezi jâpec‐jopazejec, â mâŋâŋgezi bipic tatara bâfua‐jarezejec.
Mimizi ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic bâsoŋkeme, Wofuŋ, gore ʒâŋe wâsickenʒepieŋ.
Mimizi fai‐jeŋicko ferâ fohuc juzejec, erâ ŋecjopakume omaenʒepieŋ.
Ʒiŋuc mananʒepieŋ: Wofuŋ ʒâŋe bajukomec, goki mocjaha mâreŋte faio Femicne sâko juekic.

O Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, gore fic hae i aŋac baŋacne jâmbâŋ.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi Wofuŋ gore hae ʒoŋare ecneekac, erâ irec hâmohuc juekac. Bunanezi â mesahac‐nanezi Anutu jujune go ʒeri egarehuc gae hegareekac.
Qendeczi ficticne bâfuakac, sawa hehetâczi hândâŋ motec eocte jawa‐ticne hekac, i gore alatao hâcne, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Wofuŋ Sâko‐nane â Anutu‐nane.
Ficgao juhuc mumuteŋ gae hati hegareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac.
Ŋiczi Zioŋ hata mana maŋ ehuc goraonec tâpiri bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac.
Jaŋe ʒâŋeuc wâneŋ fotâcnepie, opâ ʒâŋe fua raekac, â furic hoezi bâgunuckeekac.
Rahuc tâpiri ɋâricnezi ɋâricne bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, eku Zioŋko Anutu gohec bâbâfuac eeŋgopieŋ.
O Wofuŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, go nunumu‐nane manac, Jakobore Anutu, go hazec râec.
O Anutu, go maro‐nâŋec jukomeczi fitec wareoc, wokemaŋ ruacnekicnege ʒâŋe mai‐ticne honec.
Gore hae ʒoŋao ʒoaŋ mocjaha juju izi fekac, hae gâcnao ʒoaŋ wâŋ tauseŋ jujuzi ine wahakac; Anutu‐nanere ficte motâc soŋaŋ dodoma, irec manape aŋacne eha, ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere ficko jujure takicnukac.
Wofuŋ Anutu e ʒoaŋ â maro hâcne, e aki anonoc â ʒâŋe biŋe tahac‐nâpoekac. Wofuŋ e siocmâc jueŋgopieŋ ŋic iŋucne jaŋe wiac biaŋne moc mi sakare‐jareekac.
O Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, ŋic gorao roweckeekac ere manape ʒerine ekac.

Wofuŋ, go mâreŋge aki anonoc ecnemeŋ, go Jakobo wiac ŋemâcne fuacnewec i hetikiecnemeŋ.
Go ŋicfâcge hehesic‐jeŋicte kiŋ behe‐jaremeŋ, â sâqocne‐jeŋic bâtâmire‐jare‐fâremeŋ.
Go kimbeŋge bâuruŋke‐fâremeŋ, â aaricgere ʒocbâruŋ bâhâpomeŋ.
O bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋecte Anutu, mocwâc heɋârec‐nâpoc, â mamana sâqoc baju‐nâreekic i behec.
Go mamana sâqoc tatara tâmiric enârehuc jucmu me? Â aaricge mimiŋzi ɋâric foraocte mukic me?
Go mocwâc mi heɋârec‐nâpotec, ŋicfâcge bubiaŋ mana‐garenʒapiŋ me?
O Wofuŋ, go aki anonocge nâwotuc, â bâbâpiaŋge tahac‐nâpoc.
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ muzo ekac i manape, e jâmbomac gurufâcne wamadâŋ jazazo ekac, mitiŋicfâc‐ticne hâcne; mâc mutuc hatao mi risienʒepieŋ.
Jâmbomac, e araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâbâpiaŋzi maic‐jopakac, eme mâreŋ‐nâŋecko eri tatamac fofezejec.
Buuruc â siocmâc jahe bâbâfuac enicmu, tiŋne juju â wama jahe mumuduc enicmu.
Siocmâczi mâreŋkonec âkeʒurâ feocmu, tiŋne jujuzi sambâŋkonec fime wahaocmu.
Eme Wofuŋzi wâc jambuŋ tahac‐nâpoocmu, â mâreŋ‐nâŋeczi mâriri‐ticne bâfuaocmu.
Tiŋne jujuzi bâniecneocmu, â kike hata‐ticne soŋaŋkeocmu.
O Wofuŋ, go hazec râerâ dâŋnane manac, no waha qaqane â hapetac.
No mitihec jukopacte juju‐nane soŋaŋkec, kiŋaŋŋicge no gorao roweckekopacte baficnuc.
Go Anutu‐nanezi aki anonoc enarec; o Wofuŋ, no ʒoaŋ ʒora wira‐garehuc jukopac.
Kiŋaŋŋicge no bunane bâmiriŋkec, maŋnane, Wofuŋ, gorao sâsepe hefakac.
O Wofuŋ, go buuruc ehuc kiŋ bebehere afeckeekic, â wira‐gareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe aki anonoc boc ejareekic.
O Wofuŋ, go nunumu‐nanere hazec râec, wira wâwâsic egarekopac i manac.
Ʒârâ hâriŋ fua‐nareme sâc wâsicguekopac, goki hâcne micnaneo roekic.
O Wofuŋ, nemu jaŋeraonec moczi gore sâc mi jukac, erâ wâc gie goki bameŋ iŋucne moc mi bakicne.
Qâpuc guru bâfuac‐jopameŋ jaŋe fisirâ, Wofuŋ, gore maio dapeniŋmu, ehuc gore ʒâŋe muafeckeniŋmu.
Go hâcne kâcɋene jukiczi mâsi baekic, go mocjahazi Anutu jukomec.
O Wofuŋ, go hatage qazu‐narec, eme dâŋfârigere maŋnao juzepac; maŋnane qâzucketec ʒâŋege araŋ bacnezepac.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane, no maŋ hâcbuc jaha, go muteŋgupe, erâ ʒâŋege muafeckehuc juzepac raŋɋa raŋɋa.
Go aki anonoc fekicne enarehuc juekic hâcne; go juju‐nane hâmoc haere ʒâkâŋkonec baefumeŋ.
O Anutu, ŋic ʒaubacnezi imacnuniŋte faharembieŋ; ŋic masu wânʒâŋheczi roroc embieŋ, juju‐nane hetâcnezo muŋgopieŋ; erâ jaŋe gorao ʒâŋe mi fiŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ, go ine Anutu maŋuruc â aki anonocgehec, kimbeŋge uneŋne, â maŋgao aki anonoc â jauŋ fâri fusucmawec fokac.
Noraopec fotikierâ nore buge sâqoreoc; kiŋaŋŋicge no tâpiri henaretec huoc, â kiŋaŋ narugere ŋokâ no baficnuc.
No âgo enarekic irec fuŋne bataniŋkec; eme qaisocnuŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc honenʒepieŋ: Wofuŋ, go baficnuhuc bâmiriŋnukomec; iŋuc honerâ mimienʒepieŋ.
Anutuzi hae wâtuŋne wickeme huwec, i tiri tikio ŋekac.
Wofuŋ e Zioŋ sacmotâc‐ticnere aŋac‐ticne fokac, i Jakobore ŋeŋe hae siricke‐fârekac.
O Anuture hae qizec, gore binaŋ baeŋgopieŋ i qeŋ bipinehec.
Manacnuŋgopieŋ i gâcne mucjopape: Aigita â Babe; erâ wâc Filisa mâreŋ â Tiro â Etiopia. Jaŋe mueŋgopieŋ, “Ŋic kecʒi e ira fuawec.”
Zioŋte ine ʒiŋuc mumune: “Ŋicne ŋicne ira fuambiŋ,” â Femicne sâkozi hume keteŋ ecnekac.
Wofuŋzi ŋicguru qâreŋ‐jopahuc ʒiŋuc râeekac: “Ŋic kecʒi e ira fuawec.”
Eme jaŋe gae wohuc ʒiŋuc heeŋgopieŋ: “Bâbâpiaŋ‐nane i gorao fofârekac.”

O Wofuŋ, Anutu‐nane, no ʒoaŋko wâsicguekopac, â ŋafeo gore maio owackehuc foekopac.
Nunumu‐nanezi fâ bâfuacguzejec, ki owa‐nanere hazec râezemec!
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi ʒâic manaku gapeckekac, â juju‐nanezi hâmoc hae bâqiŋkekac.
Ŋiczi nore manapie nombâŋko hukopac ekac, jujure tâpiri‐nanezi hesackekac.
Qâŋɋâŋne jaŋere ŋondeŋko fokopac tinac ekac, qâhâmoc‐jopakicne ʒâŋeruŋko foeŋgopieŋ iŋucne tinac; erâ megaonec batarac‐jopakicne, eme mocwâc mi manasuc‐jopaekic jaŋe iŋucne.
Go biac mâreŋmaŋko tuŋnutec hukopac, nombâŋ ʒorao, duŋdapâc maŋko.
Kimbeŋgezi mâretec ŋemacnukac, â sirigezi qâurucnu‐fârekac.
Go âgofâc‐nane ejaretec bâec banareŋgopieŋ, jaŋe nore manapie wiac hâhâwicne ekac; motâc henarekicnere qiŋquŋkehuc fokopac.
Ʒâic busâqoczi enarekume ʒâŋe‐nane sisifucne ekac; no ʒoaŋ sâc, Wofuŋ, go wâsicguhuc foekopac, me jahec‐nane goraopec sicnehuc juekopac.
Go hâmokicne jaŋerao mâsi moc baekic me? Qâqâtâc‐jeŋiczi faharerâ muteŋgueŋgopieŋ me?
Ʒâŋeruŋko aki anonoc moc mutaniŋkeeŋgopieŋ me? Me hâmoc haeo jauŋ fârige moc musokazo?
Dapâcmaŋko mâsigere fuŋne manaeŋgopieŋ me? Â ninikec mâreŋko bâbâpiaŋge fua tâcnerâ foekac?
No ine, Wofuŋ, go wira wâwâsic egareekopac, uupictea nunumu‐nanezi fâ bâfuacguekac.
O Wofuŋ, go wemocte suŋgiŋnuekic? go wemocte ʒâŋe maige bâsoŋke‐nareekic?
No ɋieonecteaŋ huc ʒâichec juhuc hâmoc bâqiŋke jupac, enaretec bipic tatara juwefuku maŋnane omaekac.
Kimbeŋgere ʒocbâruŋzi norao fisi fotâcnewec, goraonec wiac hâhâwicnezi imacnuwec;
ʒoaŋ ʒora opâ rumi iŋucnezi bârârecnuwec, eku qâurucnuwec.
Âgo qomafâc‐nane ejaretec dic banareŋgopieŋ, ehame duŋdapâczi ju qâtec enarekac.

O Wofuŋ, no aki anonocgere mumumbiaŋ gae hati hehuc juzepac; micbipic‐nanezi jauŋ fârige musokape, eme ɋâric fua raniŋmuzi manahuc junʒepieŋ.
Aki anonocge dodoma sanaŋ âkendâŋnemeŋ, jauŋ fârige i sambâŋ iŋucne fofo sanaŋ foocmu.
Go mumeŋ, “Ŋicnane bâwosâepo ehec ʒâʒâfic sanaŋ epec, ehuc kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Dawidi ʒiŋuc âzâcnepo:
‘No ɋâricfâcge jusanaŋkeniŋte mupaŋke‐garekopac, â ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋege ɋâric gaŋne gaŋne jufeniŋmu, jaŋerao ŋesanaŋkerâ ŋehuc juzejec.’”
Sambâŋne sambâŋne jaŋe, Wofuŋ, gore mâsi bapa mumbiaŋkenʒepieŋ, tiriŋic jaŋere tutumaŋzi jauŋ fârige muafeckezejec.
Sambâŋko mo ŋic mo Wofuŋ gohec sâc hehene? Sambâŋ aŋelo jaŋeraonec mozi Wofuŋ go iŋucne jukac?
Anutu go hâcne aŋelo micne jaŋe araŋ bagareeŋgopieŋ, go rârec bârârec egareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe siric‐jopahuc qeŋ bipinehec juekic.
O Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, go erâ‐eesanaŋgezi rârecguha, Wofuŋ, go iŋucnea mozi tâpirihec jukac?
Goki hâwec qac momori‐ticnere guriŋ baekic, siri‐ticne fahareha goki bâniniŋkeekic.
Go Aigita mâreŋ qâŋɋâŋ iŋucne banʒaŋnemeŋ, râsifâcge tâpiri megezi qâtâtiec‐jopameŋ.
Sambâŋ i gore wiac, â mâreŋ i gorea wâc; sambâŋ mâreŋ â maŋnao wiac fokac i gokizia bâfuameŋ.
Mâreŋ faic â juwic i goki bâfuac‐jofameŋ; Taboro â Herimoŋ jahe ʒeri ehuc ʒâŋege mumbiaŋkeekopirec.
Meombâŋge qac momori‐ticnehec, mege sanaŋne, mefârege bâfeŋnerâ domakic.
Tiŋne juju â bâbâtiŋ izi eri ŋeŋegere hobeteŋ, aki anonoc â jauŋ fâri jahe bânie‐gareekopirec.
Hombaŋte ofac hehe manaŋgopieŋ jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, Wofuŋ, ʒâŋe maigere tatamacko juŋgopieŋ jaŋere hâcne.
Jaŋe ʒâŋegere erâ dameŋ sâc kiwaeeŋgopieŋ, â tiŋnege muafeckeeŋgopieŋ.
Go hâcne eri tatamac‐jeŋic â tâpiri‐jeŋic, aki anonocgere erâ tâpiri‐nâŋeczi fua tâcnekac.
Maro‐nâŋec i Wofuŋzi rauckekac hâcne, â ŋicwofuŋ‐nâŋecte ru i Israere tiri Wofuŋzi jukac.
Mârâc jaha mitiŋicge maŋko fuac ecnehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnemeŋ: “No ŋicsanaŋ moc qizecnao eri hendiŋ hecnepo, ŋicguru jaŋeraonec moc bâwosâerâ fekicne âkendâŋnepo.
No kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Dawidi hâcne bâfuapo, erâ tiri wokemaŋ‐nane ruacnepo.
Menanezi hati jowa qataŋ ecnezejec, meombâŋ‐nanezi tâpiri hecneme huzejec.
Râsi moczi e eatuckehuc doc mi bazejec, ŋic sindaŋne moczi e mi bawahazejec.
Kisâfâcne mai‐ticnao qanʒaŋ‐jopapemu, â e qaisockeniŋmu jaŋe qâfiec‐jopapemu.
Jauŋ fâri‐nane â aki anonoc‐nane jahe e qâtehuc juzepirec, â nore ʒâŋeo tâpiri‐ticnezi faharerâ domazejec.
Noni hâwec meticnere rurumaŋko râepemu, â opâ sâko râcnepe mefâre‐ticnezi soŋaŋkezejec.
Eki ʒiŋuc nazaocmu: ‘Go mamac‐nane, Anutu‐nane, â bâbâpiaŋ‐nanere qânâ sanaŋ.’
Â noni e mârâc fufua âkendâŋnepemu, mâreŋ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere micne.
Aki anonoc‐nanezi e basanaŋkehuc jowa jupemu, â ʒâʒâfic‐nane i paŋnea focnehuc juocmu.
Motec ŋosa birifâc‐ticne tofamâc forahuc juzejec, â ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋe‐ticne keteŋkepe sambâŋte sâc ezejec.
“Ɋâricfâcne jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋnane behehuc mumutâc dâŋnane mi bâjâpeniŋmuo,
erâ wâc dâŋsanaŋ‐nane qambaraŋkehuc mumupaŋ‐nane qâsuaniŋmuo ine
noni bahac‐jeŋicte erâ kâcbiŋzi bâtiŋ‐jopapemu, â hehesic‐jeŋicte erâ bâʒâic‐jopapemu.
E ine aki anonoc‐nane mi jâoc ropemu, me jauŋ fâri‐nane mi omaecnepemu.
No ʒâʒâfic‐nane mi bâŋgoroŋkepemu, â micnaneonec dâŋ wahawec i mi hetikiepemu.
No tiri juju‐naneo ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ sanaŋ mupaŋkepo: ‘No Dawidi burec moc mi ecnepemu;
ere ɋâric biri tofamâc jurahuc junʒepieŋ, â ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋe‐ticne mai‐naneo ʒoaŋ domakac ere sâc ezejec.
Mosa râekicne irec sâc ŋehuc juzejec, sambâŋ foocmu sâc ŋesanaŋkezejec.’”
Eme ʒi ine sifu behemeŋ â suŋgiŋkemeŋ, wokemaŋ ruacnemeŋ ere erâ kimbeŋzi maŋge fusekac.
Kiŋaŋŋicgehec ʒâʒâfic epic i hetâtiemeŋ, eri hendiŋ‐ticne mâreŋko behetec waha gâpârewec.
Go qânâsac‐ticne qâropie‐fâremeŋ, hae sanaŋ‐ticne hetâtiemeŋ.
sicne fotâc eeŋgopieŋ sasawa jaŋe wiac‐ticne fiuckeeŋgopieŋ, digurafâcne jaŋe mu ruruc ecneeŋgopieŋ.
Râsifâcne mana‐jaretec sanaŋkecnembiŋ, kisâfâcne mana‐jaretec ʒeri bari embiŋ.
Jei, sâqe‐ticne masune bahasickemeŋ, ehuc ʒikamaŋko dope hutuŋ mi ecnemeŋ.
Meticnaonec ŋicwofuŋ gunu‐ticne batarameŋ, eri ŋeŋe‐ticne hetuŋketec mâreŋko qawec fokac.
Qacfiric jujure dameŋ‐ticne hetâcnehuc fai‐ticnao mimi busâqoc râemeŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go soŋkepaŋkehuc juku mo dameŋko fuacmu? Kimbeŋgere ʒocbâruŋzi wezimucko qaʒueocmu?
O Wofuŋ, juju dameŋ‐nâŋec bembeŋne fokac i manac me, ŋicte ɋâric sasawa sisirowene bâfuac‐nâpomeŋ irec manasuc.
Mozi moc jufehuc juku hâmoc geŋkecneocmu? Mozi juju‐ticne hâmoc haere tâpirire sâcne ŋezickeocmu?
O Wofuŋ, go mârâc jaha aki anonocge Dawidi siocmâc mupaŋkecnemeŋ i fârine weni?
O Wofuŋ, kiŋaŋŋicge nifepupu enareeŋgopieŋ irec manasuc me! Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere mumusoriŋ dâŋ maŋnaneo bajukopac.
O Wofuŋ, dâŋ izi hâcne mimi qaqa enâreeŋgopieŋ, ehuc wokemaŋ ruacnemeŋ e hata jume sâc mimi bâfuacneeŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ muteŋkehuc juzo raŋɋa raŋɋa. Jâmbomac jâmbâŋ.
Wofuŋ, goki dameŋne dameŋ sâc huec sanaŋ enâre warehuc jumeŋ.
Tiki jaŋe huhuckerâ mi fehapie, â sambâŋ mâreŋ mi bâfuac‐jofahuc goki Anutu jumeŋzi jurâ juraʒizokic.
Goki mutec ŋic jaŋe rufeo risie raeŋgopieŋ, eha wâc muekic, “Ŋoŋe harierâ wareniŋ.”
Jara wâŋ tauseŋ i gore maio jac ʒoaŋ tarajec irec sâc eekac, me ŋafe dâkâne sawa irec sâc.
Go ŋic ofaŋ‐jopatec raeŋgopieŋ; juju‐jeŋic i guŋ manaeŋgopeneŋ iŋucne, me furicte hofâ qinʒiŋ wefuekac iŋucne tinac.
Hofâ qinʒiŋ e furicte ɋârerâ haŋ baekac, hae owâeme ɋaŋarâ ururuckeekac.
Gore kimbeŋzi hâcne ʒâtâmirec‐nâpoekac, aaricgezi hecnâpokume siroweeŋgopeneŋ.
Go sâqocne‐nâŋec ʒâŋe maigao birickemeŋ, wiac soŋsoŋko embeŋ i tatamacko fua‐gareekac.
Jei, ʒoaŋ gie bapa‐nâŋec kimbeŋgere erâ beraŋnea wise tâmireeŋgopieŋ; jara‐nâŋec i aŋ baeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc tinac jutaraeŋgopeneŋ.
Juju‐nâŋecte dameŋ i jara 70 eekac, â riŋkoa sawa 80 bâfuaekac; maŋnao wiac fuaekac i neneŋ â ʒâic, erâ biac qosackeme ratâmireeŋgopeneŋ.
Mozi aaricgere tâpiri wânʒâŋ mana wosâeekac, â araŋ bagarehuc kimbeŋgere manasuekac?
Irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa‐nâŋecte sâc qazu‐nâretec maŋɋârâŋhec enʒepeneŋ.
O Wofuŋ, risie‐nârec; ʒâic wezimucko taraocmu? Kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge nâŋere buge sâqoreoc me.
Furictea aki anonocgezi bâgunuc‐nâpoc, eme juju dameŋ‐nâŋec sâc ʒeri ehuc bubiaŋ mananʒepeneŋ.
Bâʒâic‐nâpo warehuc jumeŋ, ʒoaŋ gie bapa irec sâc jaha bubiaŋ qanârehuc juzemec; â ʒârâ ʒâpâ honehuc jukicne jara irec sâc.
Gie baekic i kiŋaŋŋicfâcge fua taniŋke‐jarezejec, â ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe eri tatamacge honenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋecte aki anonoczi fai‐nâŋecko wahazejec, eme menâŋecte gie goki jambuŋke‐nârezemec, jâmbomac, menâŋecte gie jambuŋkezemec.
Moc e Femicne sâkore sâsâocko juekac, â Bapafâre ere mumucko ŋec foc eekac,
e Wofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcneocmu: “Qânâuŋ‐nane â huec‐nane, Anutu‐nane, no gorao roweckekopac.”
Eki wosaŋeŋ bapare bitiŋkonec bataracguocmu, â huc sâqocnezi rocguzacte ŋezicguocmu.
E suhuc‐ticnezi bâsoŋguocmu, â fakec rurumaŋ‐ticnao sâsâoc bâfuaocmu; jauŋ fâri‐ticnezi maro maruku egarekac.
Go ŋafeo sisipiric wiacte mi hâwicguocmu, â ʒoaŋko tepe motec fisiekac irec mi mezacguocmu.
Ŋafere huc hâmocte mi gâgâmârâcmu, â ʒoaŋko ima fuaekac irec manabâc mi ecmu.
Gâjoŋgao ŋic wâŋ tauseŋ farazo murâ faraniŋ, mefâregao teŋ tauseŋ hâmozo murâ hâmoniŋ, ehame sifu sisipiriczi go mi rocguocmu.
Go ʒâŋezi sawa firâ honehaŋtec, ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe okacne roniŋmu.
Go Wofuŋzi huecge eocte bâwosâemeŋte, â Femicne sâkozi hae sanaŋge eocte sakaremeŋte,
sisipiricte wiac moczi mi bâfuacguocmu, â ʒârâ ʒâpâ moczi ficbozege mi bâqiŋkeocmu.
E aŋelofâc‐ticne mutâcne‐jareme, hata jucmu sâc hone soŋaŋ egareniŋmu.
Jaŋe mefaio bahucgupie qânâzi kikege moc mi hezejec.
Go laioŋ faio â qotâ faio âtecmu, ehuc laioŋ motec â homa âtemac‐jofacmu.
“E norao qohotakacte no e ŋezickepemu; e ʒâŋe‐nane manakacte no e sâockepemu.
E wira‐nareme no micnao ropemu, ʒârâ ʒâpâ fuacneme no e qâtepemu, â sisipirickonec batarahuc ʒâŋe biŋe bâfuacnepemu.
No juju‐ticne bâʒoracnepe juku gapeckezejec, erâ bâbâpiaŋ‐nane jâutupe honezejec.”

Wofuŋ daŋge ââzâcne i wiac furi sâko, Femicne sâko ʒâŋege mumumbiaŋke i aŋacne.
Furicte aki anonocge mutaniŋkezo, â ŋafeo jauŋ fârige musokazo.
Ehuc gita mucne teŋzi musi bahuc woŋgâŋ qazo, erâ wâc kulele fâze sarickehuc fâzezo.
O Wofuŋ, go gie batec honerâ bunane biaŋkekac, megere qâreŋ honehuc ʒeri gae heekopac.
O Wofuŋ, go gie baekic i qeŋ bipinehec, mamanasuge i qame hukicne jâmbâŋ!
Ŋic maŋ tâmiriczi kâuc baekac, mutucnezi sâcne mi mana taraekac.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe kecɋaŋ iŋucne fua ɋârâŋkehuc, â sâqocne bapa jaŋe fua biaŋ eipiehuc sifu sisipiric sanaŋte biŋe eeŋgopieŋ;
ehame, Wofuŋ, go ine faic jusanaŋkerâ jucmu.
Eme jei, Wofuŋ, râsifâcge jaŋe siroweniŋmu, â sâqocne bapa jaŋe tâtie‐fâreniŋmu.
Go ine tâpiri‐nane kâte bulimakaore iŋucne râemeŋ, goki wokemaŋ ɋâricne rua‐naremeŋ.
Ʒâŋe‐nanezi râsifâcne‐nane waha jopame honec‐jopakopac; â sâqocne bapa qaisocnueŋgopieŋ jaŋe wiac hâhâwicne fua‐jareme hazec‐nanezi biŋene manakopac.
Tiŋne jaŋe hâmu jâcne iŋucne fua biaŋ eeŋgopieŋ, Lebanoŋ tikire jâmâzâc iŋucne fua sokac eeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe Wofuŋte ficko sarac‐jopakicnere Anutu‐nâŋecte hae ʒoŋao fua biaŋ eeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe raŋɋaŋke‐bipiehuc fâri bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, maŋopâ‐jeŋic fofo sanaŋ â rehac‐jeŋic qacfirichec.
Izi Wofuŋte siocmâc juju mutaniŋkeekac; e qânâ sanaŋ‐nane, â hehesic moc erao mi fokac.
Wofuŋ e guriŋ bapa; ʒai ʒonʒoŋzi ŋaqi‐ticne ekac. Wofuŋ e ŋaqi heme huwec, erâ tâpiri jomawec. E mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ keteŋkewec ŋekac; qiriŋ moc mi qaocmu.
Eri ŋeŋegere hobeteŋ esecne râekicne; go dameŋ tâmiricko juwaremeŋ.
O Wofuŋ, hâwec ʒâkâŋ jaŋe fânâŋkembiŋ, hâwec ʒâkâŋ jaŋe fânâŋ sâko embiŋ, hâwec ʒâkâŋ jaŋe fânâŋ hâhâwicne sâko eŋgopieŋ.
Opâ sârore tâpiri sirickekac, hâwec sirire tâpiri sirickekac, Wofuŋ faic jukac eki tâpiri wânʒâŋhec ekac.
Goki dâŋ musanaŋkemeŋ i fofo sanaŋ; ficgere maqâreŋ i tirimoc; o Wofuŋ, wiac i tofamâc foraʒihuc juocmu.
O Wofuŋ, okac babazu Anutu, okac babazu Anutu, go fua tâcnec!
Mâreŋte mumutara go faharec, ŋic maŋfefe eebapa‐jeŋicte okacne jarec.
O Wofuŋ, ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe kiwac qawac eku mo dameŋko beheniŋte mukic?
Jaŋe sahac fefe ehuc penaroŋ eeŋgopieŋ, erâ pepecdâŋ mueŋgopieŋ, sâqocne bapa jaŋe.
O Wofuŋ, jaŋe gurufâcge ro waha âte ejareeŋgopieŋ, â merâfâcge ba sipiric ejareeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe hozec erâ mafa fisikicne qa jâpec ejareeŋgopieŋ, â bekâ ine qâhâmoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc mueŋgopieŋ, “Wofuŋ e mi honekac, Jakobore Anutu e mi manakac.”
Ŋic maŋ tâmiric jâmbâŋ ŋoŋe mana jaŋgeŋkeniŋ me! Mutucne ŋoŋe wezimucko mamanahec eniŋmu?
Hazec râewec e dâŋ mi manaekac me? Ʒâŋe ba akic ewec e wiac mi honeekac me?
Ŋicguru bâtiŋ‐jopaekac e kâcbiŋ mi bajukac me? Eki hâcne ŋic mamana qazu‐jareekac i!
Wofuŋ e ŋic maŋ mamanasu‐jeŋicte kâuc mi baekac, nokafere sâc sawa eŋgopieŋ i hâcne manakac.
Wofuŋ, go ŋic moctao bâbâtiŋ gie bacmu, me sâcmutâcge qazucnecmu, ere manape ʒerine ekac.
E hâcne ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋ taracneme jujumana fuacneocmu, ehame ŋic sindaŋnezi nombâŋko huocmu.
Wofuŋ e gurufâcne mi suŋgiŋ‐jopaocmu, â merâfâcfâcne mi behec‐jopaocmu.
Ŋic tiŋne erao mumutiŋ risieocmu hâcne, eme siocmâc sasawa jaŋe bâjâpeniŋmu.
Mozi ŋic sindaŋne râsi ejarehuc no ŋezicnuocmu? Mozi sâqocne bapa bâsuec‐jopahuc sacfozic enareocmu?
Wofuŋzi no mi baficnume muzac, qâqâtâc‐nanezi biac niniŋ siarereŋ mâreŋko juzac.
“Kike‐nanezi âte sowariekac” muhape, Wofuŋ, gore aki anonoczi âkesiŋnuwec.
Maŋnaneo memezac bocjaha fuame, gore bâbâmiriŋzi âke ɋârecnuekac.
Micne bapa sindaŋne jaŋe sâcne gohec ʒâʒâfic eene me? Jaŋe hâcne mumupaŋ‐jeŋiczi wiac bâsâqoreeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋic tiŋne ere juju sipirickeniŋte meo roroc eeŋgopieŋ, erâ ŋic bahacmâc hâmocte biŋe qaŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋzi ine hae sanaŋ‐nane ewec, â Anutu‐nanezi qânâuŋ‐nane ewec.
Eki hâcne hehesic‐jeŋicte okacne bazu‐jareocmu, â sindaŋ‐jeŋicte erâ bâsirowec‐jopaocmu; Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi bâsirowec‐jopaocmu.
O warepie Wofuŋ gae hecnenaŋ, huec sanaŋ â bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec ʒeri fânâŋ sâko ecnenaŋ.
Mai‐ticnao fuahuc daŋge âzâcnenaŋ, mumumbiaŋ gae hecnehuc kiwaecnenaŋ.
Wofuŋ e hâcne Anutu sâko, erâ nemu sasawa jaŋere Femicne sâko.
Ere meo mâreŋ wâcne wâcne fokac, â tikine tikine i ere jaha.
Hâwec i wâc ere, eki hâcne bawec, â mâreŋ kereŋne i menezi ba akic ewec.
O warepie e sâsehuc dapecnenaŋ, Wofuŋ bâbâfua‐nâŋec ere maio dieŋzi henaŋ.
E hâcne Anutu‐nâŋec, â nâŋâc sapa‐ticnere ŋicguru, erâ wâc ere mere lamafâc juŋgopeneŋ. Ŋoŋe miŋecgac hâcne dâŋticne mananʒapiŋ me!
Meriba opâo maŋsanaŋ ekicne iŋuc mi enʒepieŋ, erâ ʒoaŋ moc Masao, mâreŋ tuhuo embiŋ.
Mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe dameŋ ira esâicnumbiŋ, i wiac bapa‐nane hone‐bipiehuc embiŋ.
No jara 40 ŋicguru i jaŋere takicnuhuc juwec, eme mupo, “Ŋic i jaŋe maŋjeŋic qac qâsoricne, jaŋe hata‐nane moc mi hone manac eŋgopieŋ.”
Iŋucte kimbeŋ qajarehuc mumupaŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupo: “Jaŋe nore jujumana hae mâreŋko moc mi raʒinʒepieŋ.”
O ŋicbureŋ, Wofuŋ gae ɋâricne hecneniŋ, mâreŋŋic ʒeŋgoma, Wofuŋ gae hecneniŋ.
Wofuŋ gae hecnehuc ʒâŋe‐ticne muteŋkeniŋ, ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne bâbâpiaŋ gie‐ticnere binaŋ baniŋ.
Eri tatamac‐ticne i qâpuc mutaniŋke‐jareniŋ, gie‐ticne wawarecnehec i ŋicne ŋicne jaŋerao muiŋ musawec eniŋ.
Wofuŋ e kâcɋene, irec e fehuc mumbiaŋkezo, nemu sasawa siric‐jopahuc e araŋ bacnezo.
Qâpuc nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ɋâŋ qâqâtâc, Wofuŋ e ine sambâŋne sambâŋne bâfuawec.
Ʒâŋe biŋe â ʒai ʒonʒoŋ‐ticnezi bâniecnekac, tiri ufuŋ‐ticnao tâpiri â eri qâreŋ focnekac.
Ŋic gurune gurune ŋoŋe Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ, Wofuŋte tatamac â tâpiri‐ticne musokaniŋ.
Wofuŋ e ʒâŋe‐ticnere sâcko sâseniŋ; taha bafisirâ hae ʒoŋa‐ticnao feniŋ.
Tiri eri qonaŋkerâ Wofuŋ dapecneniŋ; mâreŋ sâc mai‐ticnao jâjâwâckeniŋ!
Ŋicne ŋicne ʒiŋuc mufua‐jareniŋ: “Wofuŋ guriŋ bakac.” Jâmbomac, e mâreŋ qasanaŋkewec qiŋ herâ ŋekac; e ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere dâŋ sâcjeŋicko mutaraocmu.
Sambâŋ e bubiaŋ manaoc â mâreŋ e ʒeri eoc, hâwec â maŋnao wiac qiriŋ qaŋgopieŋ jaŋe fânâŋkeniŋ.
Sopâc â bec qowifâcne jaŋe kiwaeniŋ, erâ kâtere jâc sasawa jaŋe ʒeri gae heniŋ.
I Wofuŋzi warekacte ere maio eniŋ; e mâreŋ sâc mumutara gie baocte warekac. E mâreŋko mumutara gie‐ticne bâtiŋnehuc baocmu, â ŋicne ŋicne dâŋjeŋic jâmbomacko mutaraocmu.
Wofuŋzi guriŋ bakacte mâreŋ e ʒeri eoc, hâwec mâreŋ biri ʒora jaŋe bubiaŋ mananiŋ!
Karorac â duŋdapâczi e râreckerâ fokac; tiŋne â mumutiŋ izi eri ŋeŋe‐ticnere hobeteŋ ekac.
Ʒoczi bâruŋkehuc bâniecnekac, ehuc râsifâcne rârec rârec ʒâseŋ‐jopakac.
Bâbâric‐ticnezi hae mâreŋ batamaekac; mâreŋzi honerâ ɋarac ɋarac qakac.
Tiki jaŋe Wofuŋte maio du âtehuc dockeŋgopieŋ, mâreŋ sâko mâreŋte Wofuŋ ere maio.
Sambâŋne sambâŋne jaŋe tiŋne‐ticne mutaniŋkeŋgopieŋ, â ŋicne ŋicne eri tatamac‐ticne honeŋgopieŋ.
Ɋâŋ qâqâtâc babaju jaŋe mimi faio feŋgopieŋ, ɋâŋjeŋicte penaroŋ eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne; nemu sasawa mai‐ticnao dapeŋgopieŋ.
Zioŋ e manarâ ʒeri ekac, Juda hae sâc jaŋe aŋac‐jopakac; Anutu gore mumutiŋte iŋuc fuakac.
Wofuŋ, go mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec guriŋ bapa jukic hâcne, go nemu sasawa siric‐jopahuc fejâmbâŋkerâ jukic.
Wofuŋ e sâqocne qaisockeeŋgopieŋ jaŋere ecneekac, e tiriŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere juju soŋaŋkeekac, ehuc ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere meonec batarac‐jopaekac.
Ŋic bahacmâc e tatamaczi uŋ hecneekac, â maŋhumuc e bubiaŋ fuacneekac.
Bahacmâc ŋoŋe Wofuŋ ʒeri ecneniŋ, â tiri ʒâŋe‐ticne daŋge âzâcneniŋ.
Ŋicbureŋ, Wofuŋ gae ɋâricne hecneniŋ, e mâsi wawarecnehec bawec! E mefâre‐ticnezi â tiri meombâŋ‐ticnezi râsi sanaŋke‐jarewec.
Ʒika giere fârine fuawec i Wofuŋzi mufuawec, e qâpuc jaŋere maio bâbâtiŋ‐ticnere fuŋne rituwec.
E Israe kikefuŋ aki anonoc â jauŋ fâri ejare warehuc jukicne, irec manasuwec. Mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao juŋgopieŋ, jaŋe sasawa Anutu‐nâŋecte bâbâpiaŋ gie honembiŋ.
Mâreŋŋic sasawa, Wofuŋ ʒeri ecnehuc semuja heniŋ! Samarierâ ʒeri gae hehuc e muafeckeniŋ!
Wofuŋ mumuafec gae hecnehuc gita qaniŋ, gita qahuctecne musi sâko baniŋ.
Qeŋ dâŋeha mimi ŋokac ficneniŋ, erâ Wofuŋ Sâko Wofuŋ semuja hecneniŋ.
Hâweczi fânâŋkeoc, â maŋnao qiriŋ qaŋgopieŋ jaŋe fânâŋkeniŋ. Mâreŋ e iŋuc jaha eoc, eme fainao juŋgopieŋzi bafickeniŋ.
Opâ rumi jaŋe me qaniŋ, tiki jaŋe qâturerâ ʒeri gae heniŋ.
Wofuŋzi warekacte ere maio eniŋ, e mâreŋ guriŋne baocte warekac. E mâreŋ dâŋne mutiŋnehuc mutaraocmu, ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere dâŋ sâcjeŋicko mutaraocmu.
Wofuŋ e guriŋ bakac; ŋicne ŋicne ɋarac ɋarac qaniŋ. E kerubim faicnao ŋekacte mâreŋ e ɋiɋiteckeoc.
Wofuŋ e Zioŋko kâcɋene jukac, e ŋicne ŋicne siric‐joparâ fekicne jukac.
Ʒâŋege kâcɋene â bipinehec i muafeckeniŋ. E tiri moc!
Wofuŋ Sâko tâpirigehec, tiŋne rune, go wiac sâckoa foocte qâzuckemeŋ. Goki Jakoborao mumutiŋ â tiŋne juju hatane basanaŋkemeŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec muafeckeniŋ, eri ŋeŋe fuŋnao dunduŋ huniŋ. E tiri moc!
Taha bapa jaŋere guruo Mose â Aroŋ jucnepic. Ʒâŋe‐ticne riwaseckembiŋ jaŋere guruo Samuezi jucnewec. Jaŋe Wofuŋ wâsickembiŋ, eme micjeŋicko rowec.
E karorac ɋâfoŋnere maŋnao ŋehuc dâŋ jazawec; jaŋe mumutaniŋ dâŋticne basanaŋkembiŋ, â sâcmutâc dâŋticne jarewec i reŋkembiŋ.
O Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec, go dâŋ bâtikie‐jaremeŋ, go kiŋ bebehe Anutu jujaremeŋ, erâ wâc hehesic‐jeŋicte okacne jaremeŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec e muafeckeniŋ, erâ tiri tiki‐ticnao waha fodapeniŋ! Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec e tiri moc hâcne.
Mâreŋne mâreŋne Wofuŋ semuja hecneniŋ.
Bubiaŋ manahuc Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacneniŋ, gae hecnehuc mai‐ticnao fuaniŋ.
Wofuŋ e Anutu jukac i mananiŋ. Meticnao fuambeŋte eki rauc‐nâpokac; nâŋâc ŋicfâc‐ticne â sapa‐ticnere lama guru.
