Daŋge bacnehuc motâc sâko‐ticnao feniŋ, mumbiaŋkehuc hae ʒoŋa‐ticnao fuaniŋ, daŋge âzâcneniŋ, ʒâŋe‐ticne muafeckeniŋ.
Wofuŋ e uruc jauŋ‐ticnehec jukac, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ foocmu, â erâ‐eesanaŋ‐ticne mimiŋzi ɋâric forahuc juocmu.
No aki anonoc â bâbâtiŋ irec gae hepe, ehuc Wofuŋ, go musi bagarepe.
Erâ bahacmâc jujure hata soŋaŋkepe. Jei, go wezimucko norao warecmu? No fic hae‐nanere maŋko maŋtaniŋ hata âtezo mukopac.
Erâ eebapa mamakâcne mi hone dendeŋnepemu. Hata kizurâ jujure takicnukac, wiac iŋucnezi norao bohotazacte.
Maŋ qaqaharicne irec bâec bapemu, sâqocnere kâuc bazepac.
Moc e âgo‐ticne soŋsoŋko musoriŋkeme, no e bâniniŋkepemu. Pepec ʒâŋehec â maŋ penaroŋhec, e manacnepe mi juocmu.
Mâreŋko ŋic siocmâc juŋgopieŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe fipemu, iŋucnezi nohec ŋec juc eene. Moc e bahacmâc hata âtehuc juocmu, iŋucnezi kiŋaŋ qanarezejec.
Moc e bâkiri baekac, e nore ficmaŋko mi juzejec. Moc e burecdâŋ eekaczi nore maio mi domaocmu.
Hae fureocmu sâc no mâreŋko ŋic sindaŋne sasawa bâsirowec‐jopapemu. Eme Wofuŋte hae qizecko sâqocne bapazi omaenʒepieŋ.

O Wofuŋ, go nunumu‐nane manac; kinanezi fârâ gorao fisioc.
Norao hâhâwic dameŋ maickeme, ʒâŋe maige mi bâsoŋke‐narezemec. Go hazec râe‐narec; no wira‐garepemu ʒoaŋ ira micnaneo biac rozemec.
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa‐nanezi hosâc iŋucne ratâmireeŋgopieŋ; me kike‐naneo ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne ʒacnuekac.
Bunane kecɋaŋ iŋucne hâmo ɋaŋac eekac, eme nânâ nâzore nikecnuekac.
No samarierâ owackekupe, siec‐nanezi biuc‐naneo bohotaekac.
No mâreŋ tuhuo piʒu piʒu iŋucne ekopac, â hae sesuctacko qâoŋ wipe iŋucne.
No guŋɋâri fohuc juekopac, ficbupuo wipe moc bucticne ŋehuc kioekac iŋucne.
Râsifâc‐nane jaŋe dameŋ sâc musoriŋnueŋgopieŋ, nifepupu enarehuc sâwecnueŋgopieŋ.
Ʒafezi nânâ tinac enareekac, â ʒâŋeuc‐nanezi opâhec sisifuc eme nâekopac.
Aaricgere â kimbeŋgere fârine fuakac hâcne. Goki bafaharecnuku mocwâc behecnumeŋ.
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa‐nane i owa ririŋte nâkumuc fuaekac iŋucne; no kecɋaŋ iŋucne hâmo ɋaŋac ekopac.
Wofuŋ, go ine eri ŋeŋegao ŋesanaŋkeekic; ʒâŋege ɋâric jaŋerao fosanaŋkeocmu.
Goki faharerâ Zioŋ busâqoc manacnecmu; e aki anonoc ecnezore dameŋ maickekac, ʒâfo bakicne i fuakac hâcne.
Kiŋaŋŋicfâcge jaŋe qânâ‐ticnere aŋac‐jopakac, â sesuc‐ticnere busâqoc manaŋgopieŋ.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe Wofuŋ gore ʒâŋe araŋ bacneniŋmu, â mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋzi eri tatamacgere hâhâwic eniŋmu.
Wofuŋ e Zioŋ mocwâc heɋâreocmu hâcne, e eri tatamac‐ticnehec fua tâcneocmu.
E bebekâne jaŋere nunumure hazec râeocmu, â wâwâsic‐jeŋic mi suŋgiŋkeocmu.
Dâŋ ʒi ɋâric ʒâhec fuaniŋmu jaŋere biŋe qâreŋkezo, eme kikefuŋ miŋecnea fuaocmuzi Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkezejec.
E faic tiri hae‐ticnaonec fime wahawec, Wofuŋzi sambâŋkonec mâreŋko fime wahawec.
Ehuc kâpâcwâru ŋic huhuse‐jeŋic manawec, â hâmocte biŋe qacjopakicne jaŋe firuec‐jopawec.
Eme ŋiczi Zioŋko Wofuŋte ʒâŋe mutaniŋkenʒepieŋ, â Jerusalem hae wâc mumbiaŋkenʒepieŋ.
Ira hâcne ŋicne ŋicne heâckerâ tumaŋne‐fâreniŋmu, ŋicwofuŋ â gurufâc‐jeŋic jaŋe Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacneniŋmu.
E hata ombâŋko tâpiri‐nane bâomaekac, ehuc juju dameŋ‐nane bâmbembeŋkekac.
Eme wâsicgukopac, “O Anutu‐nane, go jarage tatara tâmiric fohuc juocmuzi, no dameŋ‐nane mi taraha mi bârâriecnuc.”
Go fufuŋkenao mâreŋte hobeteŋne râemeŋ, â sambâŋne sambâŋne jaŋe megere qâreŋ.
Jaŋe siroweniŋmu, go ine jusanaŋkekic; jaŋe ŋaqi iŋucne raŋɋaŋkeniŋmu. Eme ŋaqi heherisie iŋucne herisiec‐jopatec, jaŋe hawari moc eniŋmu.
Go ine jukiczi juraʒihuc jucmu, â jarage moc mi taraocmu.
Kiŋaŋŋicfâcge jaŋere naru moteczi juhâmoniŋmu, â ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe gore maio jusanaŋkeniŋmu.
O maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane, go Wofuŋ muteŋkec, erâ maŋnaneo wiac sasawa, go tiri ʒâŋe‐ticne muteŋkec.
O maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane, go Wofuŋ muteŋkec, â wiac biaŋne egare warehuc juwec irec mi nikecguoc.
E kiŋ bahacge behe‐fâreekac, â huc ʒâicge bâniniŋke‐fâreekac.
E jujuge sisipirickonec bataraekac, erâ aki anonoc â buuruczi ericguekac.
E juekic sâc wiac qâmie‐gareme ro aŋac eekic, erâ tucwipe iŋucne hati firierâ juhâmoekic.
Wofuŋ e bâbâtiŋ gie baekac, â ro waha âte ejarekicne jaŋe ŋezic‐jopa‐fâreekac.
E hata‐ticne Mose qazucnewec, wiac bapa‐ticne Israe ŋic jowatuwec.
Wofuŋ e buuruc â aki anonoc‐ticnehec, kimbeŋ‐ticne uneŋne â miriŋ‐ticne ɋârâŋne.
E aaric dâŋ hati mi enâreocmu, â kimbeŋ‐ticne tofamâc mi bajuocmu.
E sâqocne‐nâŋecte sâc wiac mi enâreekac, â hehesic‐nâŋecte sâc okacne mi bazuekac.
Sambâŋzi mâreŋ qâhuckehuc fejâmbâŋkerâ ŋekac, araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe irec sâc aki anonoc ejareekac.
Ʒoaŋ wewefune â huhune jahe rârâwiŋ jâmbâŋ fokopirec, irec sâc kiŋ bahac‐nâŋec nâwoc rorâ taicko bawiseekac.
Mamac moc e ɋiefâcne jaŋere bune sâqoreekac, irec sâc Wofuŋ e araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe busâqoc mana‐jareekac.
Nâŋâc wemo wiaczi bacnâpokicne i kâuc mi baekac i. Gâc wândockonec fuambeŋ i manasuekac.
Ŋic e juju dameŋ‐ticne kecɋaŋte fua hâmoc iŋucne, erâ e ʒariŋ ârire sâc fua biaŋ eekac.
Ehame mâŋâŋzi ficne sueme omatac fuaekac, â ŋeŋetac‐ticnezi e kâuc baekac.
Wofuŋte aki anonoc ine dameŋ tâmiricko fuakicnezi, dameŋ tâmiric jaha forahuc juzokac, araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao hâcne. Â tiŋne‐ticnezi naru motec apa ŋosa jaŋerao forahuc juzokac.
Ine ehec ʒâʒâfic ekicne i basanaŋkerâ bajuniŋmu, ehuc sâcmutâc dâŋticne reŋkeniŋmu jaŋerao hâcne.
Wofuŋ e eri ŋeŋe‐ticne sambâŋko hewec ŋekac, â guriŋ bapa‐ticnezi wiac ʒeŋgoma qâhâckekac.
O aŋelofâcne, tâpiri wânʒâŋ‐ŋeŋichec, marac‐ticnere hazec râehuc micticne reŋkeeŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe hâcne Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ.
O momorifâc‐ticne sasawa, kiŋaŋ qaqazi mamana‐ticnere sâcko gie baeŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe hâcne Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ.
O meqâreŋfâcne sasawa, uucmaŋ‐ticnao ira me ira juraŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe hâcne Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ. O maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane, go Wofuŋ muteŋkec.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane, go Wofuŋ muteŋkec. O Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane, go kâcɋene sâko eri tatamac â ʒai ʒonʒoŋge hetec hume jukomec.
Go tatamaczi qoruc egareme rufarâ juekic, go sambâŋ i selific iŋucne fâremeŋ ŋegarekac.
Go erificgere woke qâtâc opâ faio râemeŋ, karorac âzâcnetec keretac egarewec, mâŋâŋte fakec faio rac warec eekic.
Mâŋâŋ sorec‐jopatec dâŋge baraeŋgopieŋ, ʒocbâruŋ mujaretec kiŋaŋ qagareeŋgopieŋ.
Go mâreŋ i hobeteŋ‐ticnao basanaŋkerâ râemeŋ, eme qiŋ herâ ŋekac, qiriŋ moc mi qaocmu.
Go rumi sâko qoruc iŋucnezi mâreŋ qofackemeŋ, eme opâ jaŋe tiki qâuruckembiŋ.
Erâ hanec‐jopatec tâtiembiŋ, ehuc parandaŋgere fânâŋte wisembiŋ.
Tiki jaŋe faharembiŋ â wâc jaŋe humbiŋ, ehuc mupaŋke‐jaremeŋko sanaŋkerâ ŋembiŋ.
Ma bajaremeŋ i mocwâc mi jâuruniŋmu, â mâreŋ mocwâc mi qofackeniŋmu.
Mâreŋ wâwâcnao opâ ʒâŋe bâfuameŋ, eme opâzi tiki ŋondeŋko rahuc foekac.
Qowine qowine nâruac‐jeŋic fuawec, kâte doŋgi jaŋe opâre hâmorâ nâqiŋneeŋgopieŋ.
Opâ mecnao sawa wipe jaŋe ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋ, jâctieŋko ŋehuc gae‐jeŋic heeŋgopieŋ.
Go faic ŋehuc tiki gumecqiŋ‐jopaekic, mâreŋzi giegere fârine nâ gapec eekac.
Go mutec bulimakao sopâc kecɋaŋ fua‐jareekac, â nânâ monʒaŋ, ine ŋiczi he sarac eocte. E giene bakume mâreŋkonec nânâ fuaekac.
Erâ waiŋ bâfuacneme nâhuc aŋac manaekac. Tokic bâfuame ruarâ ʒâŋe maine sâsâreekac, erâ wâc poroŋ bâfuame ŋicmaŋ qacfiric eekac.
Wofuŋzi jâckâte‐ticne opâzi bâgunuckeekac, Lebanoŋ tikio jâmâzâc sarawec i hâcne.
Jacmaŋko wipe jaŋe sareŋ‐jeŋic baeŋgopieŋ, qeʒo e bizojâcko fic hae eekac.
Tiki ʒora i kâte noniŋ jaŋere ŋeŋe juju, qânâuŋko mâreŋpecne jaŋe soŋkerâ foeŋgopieŋ.
Go dameŋ qâtâc‐ticne fuaocte mosa râemeŋ, â ʒoaŋ e huhu‐ticnere dameŋ manaekac.
Goki dapâc bâfuatec hae ŋafeekac, eme kâte qowi jaŋe qiriŋ qafâreeŋgopieŋ.
Laioŋ motec jaŋe qowi‐jeŋicte owackeeŋgopieŋ, ehuc Anuturaonec nânâ basa raeŋgopieŋ.
Ʒoaŋ wefume fâre suruckeeŋgopieŋ, ehuc jawa‐jeŋicko soŋkerâ foeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋiczi ine gie‐ticnao fahare raekac, erâ he sarac ehuc juha hae ŋafeekac.
O Wofuŋ, go wiac bâfuameŋ ʒarene fekicne! Mana sarickehuc bâfua‐fâremeŋ, mâreŋ i meqâreŋgezi fusucmawec fokac.
Hâwec fokac ocni, qaratiekicne sâko, maŋnao wiac ʒare tâmiric gerec gerec bahuc fokac, wiac jujune kâcɋene â piticne.
Ira wokezi rac warec ehuc jueŋgopieŋ, gaʒu gaʒu wâc râemeŋ, hâwec masirickeocte.
Goki dameŋ mukicnao nânâ jarecmurâ, gorao ʒeŋgoma ʒâŋe fieŋgopieŋ.
Goki jaretec ro nuse eeŋgopieŋ, mege baratietec wiac biaŋ nâ gapec eeŋgopieŋ.
Ʒâŋe maige bâsoŋketec bipic tara‐jareekac, nokafe‐jeŋic jowac rotec hâmoeŋgopieŋ, ehuc gâc wândocko risie raeŋgopieŋ.
Micrombâŋge ficne‐jaretec harierâ fuaeŋgopieŋ, eme mâreŋ ʒâŋe maine mocwâc qacfiric eekac.
Wofuŋte ʒâŋe biŋe forahuc jaha juzejec, Wofuŋ e meqâreŋ‐ticne hone aŋac ezejec.
Mâreŋko firâ râqâreme mâreŋ ɋiɋiteckeocmu, tiki bâuac‐jopame hosâc qaniŋmu.
Jupemu sâc Wofuŋ gae hecnepemu, juju fonareocmu sâc Anutu‐nane muteŋkepemu.
Mamanasu gie bakopac i mac maname sâckezejec, no Wofuŋ mana aŋac ecnehuc jupemu.
Ŋic hehesicne mâreŋko omaenʒapiŋ me, sindaŋne jaŋe hâcne arictac enʒapiŋ. Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane, go Wofuŋ muteŋkec. Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ.
Wofuŋ daŋge âzâcneniŋ, erâ ʒâŋe‐ticne wâsickeniŋ; wiac bapa‐ticne ŋicne ŋicne mufua‐jareniŋ.
Gae hecneniŋ, mumumbiaŋ gae hecneniŋ, mâsi sâko‐ticne mutaniŋke‐fâreniŋ.
Tiri ʒâŋe‐ticne mu ʒeri ecneniŋ, Wofuŋ wira basac ecneeŋgopieŋzi bubiaŋ mananʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋte â tâpiri‐ticnere fifisacne finʒepieŋ, ʒâŋe maine honeniŋte ʒuʒuhuc jaha henʒiriŋnenʒepieŋ.
E wiac bipinehec ewec irec manasuniŋ, mâsi bawec â mumutara dâŋ muwec,
kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Abraham ɋâricfâcne ŋoŋe hâcne, Jakobore ŋokâfâc, bâwosâecfâc‐ticne ŋoŋe!
Wofuŋ e hâcne Anutu‐nâŋec, bâbâtiŋ gie‐ticne mâreŋ sâc fua raekac.
Ʒâʒâfic‐ticnere manasu rahuc juzokac, dâŋ mupaŋkewec i raŋɋa raŋɋa maŋke juzokac, ɋâric biri gaŋne 1000 irec sâc.
Ʒâʒâfic i Abraham ehec epic, erâ mujomirehuc Isaka mupaŋkecnewec.
Izi Jakobo sâcmutâc râcnehuc basanaŋkewec, Israehec ʒâʒâfic fofo sanaŋ ewec.
Ʒiŋuc muhuc: “Go Kanaaŋ mâreŋ garepemu, merâfâcge rauckecmurâ biŋe qagarepo i hâcne.”
Dameŋ ira afecne mac jumbiŋ, jahec maczi mâreŋ ira jaba jumbiŋ.
Ŋicguru mockonec mocko ŋe qatara rambiŋ, ŋicwofuŋ mocte uucmaŋkonec ra guru mocko ʒuhuckembiŋ.
Moczi ro waha âte ejarezacte aka hewec, â jaŋere erâ ŋicwofuŋ bâtiŋ‐jopawec.
Ehuc muwec, “Rowosâec‐jopakicnefâc‐nane mi bâuac‐jopazo, porofetefâc‐nane mi bâʒâic‐jopazo.”
Eme mâreŋ ira roroc fuaocte, â hobure dope qatara‐fâreocte muhuc
ine qanaŋ ŋic moc soreme bânie‐jarewec: Josefe hâcne doc bapie kiŋaŋ qaqa ewec.
Kike‐ticne jâc fifitacko râembiŋ, aeŋko basanaŋkepie fowec.
Ekume findaŋdâŋ‐ticne fârio qawec, â Wofuŋte dâŋzi fuŋne‐ticne rituwec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi kiŋaŋ soreme firuembiŋ, ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere guriŋ bapazi rambaŋko râewec;
erâ ficticnere micne sâko âkendâŋnewec, â wiac‐ticne hone soŋaŋ efâreocte mucnewec.
Eme ŋicbomboŋfâcne giedâŋ jazawec, â kiafâcne maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ qazu‐jarewec.
Ekume Israezi Aigita mâreŋko rawec, Jakobozi Hamte mâreŋko jaba juwec.
Â Wofuŋzi ine ŋicfâcne jambuŋ‐jopame, jaŋe saweku râsifâc‐jeŋic siric‐jopambiŋ.
Erâ ejareme maŋjeŋic risieme ŋicfâcne qaisoc‐jopambiŋ, â kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne wiac gâgâpâcne ejarembiŋ.
Eme kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Mose sorewec, erâ wâc bâwosâec‐ticne Aroŋ.
Jahe ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko fuŋne qaqa mâsi‐ticne bapic, Hamte mâreŋko wiac bipinehec bâfuapic.
Eki mume mâreŋ dapâc efârewec; jaŋe ine dâŋticne mana suambiŋ.
E opâ‐jeŋic hetikieme soc efârewec, ehuc opâ qowi‐jeŋic qâhâmoc‐jopawec.
Qaqec fisi mâreŋ sâc gerec gerec bambiŋ, ehuc ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ficmaŋko wâc fembiŋ.
Eki mume neŋgec qâŋhec qâŋhec fisimbiŋ, â nusuczi mâreŋ sâckerâ fombiŋ.
Hoere okacne aisi hândâŋ jarewec, â bâbâriczi hae mâreŋ imackewec.
Waiŋ‐jeŋic â jâmbo‐jeŋic qanʒaŋnewec, â mâreŋ‐jeŋicte jâcwiac qazuwec.
Ere micte ɋirikiŋ fisimbiŋ, â ɋirikiŋ motecne ʒare tâmiric.
I jaŋe mâreŋ irec jâcrehac nâfârembiŋ, â gieo nânâ monʒaŋ omaembiŋ.
Erâ mârâc fufuafâc‐jeŋic qâhâmoc‐jopa‐fârewec, ŋic tâpiri‐jeŋicte fârinere hata qaqasune hâcne.
Erâ mana‐jareme siliwa â gol ameckerâ rambiŋ, â gurufâc‐jeŋic jaŋeraonec ŋic moczi moc kikene mi fâfâckewec.
Rapie Aigita ŋic jaŋe aŋac‐jopawec. Wemocte? Hâhâwic bajarembiŋte.
Eki ine karoraczi mumuc ejareocte qaratie‐jarewec, â ŋafeo ʒoc râeme tamae‐jarewec.
Jaŋe âzâcnepie sirikic bâfua‐jarewec, â sambâŋkonec poroŋ mâririhec tahac‐jopawec.
E qânâ bâmârâŋkeme opâ sâronehec wahawec, erâ mâreŋ sawao fusinehec rahuc fowec.
E tiri mumupaŋ‐ticne manasuwecte iŋuc ewec, erâ kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Abraham ere manasuwecte.
Iŋuc ehuc ŋicfâc‐ticne ʒerimaŋko jowac‐jopawec; bâwosâecfâc‐ticne jaŋe gae hehuc bâjâpembiŋ.
Eme qâpuc jaŋere mâreŋ tahac‐jopawec; ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe wiac hure hemârec embiŋ, i hâcne tahac‐jopame rauckembiŋ.
Irec fârine ʒiŋuc fuaocte: Jaŋe mumupaŋ‐ticne basanaŋkerâ bajunʒepieŋ, â sâcmutâc dâŋticne reŋkenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ!
Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ! Wofuŋ daŋge âzâcneniŋ, e uruc jauŋ‐ticnehec, â aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ foocmu.
Mozi Wofuŋte eebapa tâpirinehec i sâcne mutaniŋkeocmu, me ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne mutaniŋkeme sâckeocmu?
Tiŋnere hata âteeŋgopieŋ jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, dameŋ sâc wiac etiŋnehuc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere hâcne.
O Wofuŋ, go ŋicfâcge âgo ejarecmuo nore manasuzemec, jaŋe batarac‐jopacmuo no wâc baficnuzemec.
Eme no bâwosâecfâcge mâriri‐jeŋic hone aŋac ezepac, ehuc ŋicfâcge bubiaŋ manapie ʒeri ezepac, â merâfâcfâcge jaŋehec mu ʒeri ezepac.
Mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe sâqocne bambiŋ nâŋe ijaha embeŋ, nâŋe bahac bâfuambeŋ, erâ wâc sindaŋ embeŋ.
Mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe Aigita mâreŋko jumbiŋ, ira Anuture mâsi bapa hone qâoma embiŋ, â fehuc ehâmo‐jarewec irec mi manasumbiŋ, erâ Hâwec Bâbâroŋko Femicne sâko pepec ecnembiŋ.
Eme e sifu ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnere erâ bafic‐jopawec, ehuc tâpiri sâko‐ticnere fuŋne bataniŋkewec.
E Hâwec Bâbâroŋ haneckeme kereŋkewec, eme ʒâkâŋko, mâreŋ burocnao tinac jowac‐jopawec.
Iŋuc ehuc râsi jaŋere ŋezic‐jopawec, â kisâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere meonec batarac‐jopawec.
Eme hâweczi râsifâc‐jeŋic qofac‐jopawec, jaŋeraonec moczi tiwâne mi juwec.
Iŋuc fuame dâŋticne mana ʒakiembiŋ, â mumumbiaŋ gae hecnembiŋ.
Erâ ine gie bawec irec biac nikec‐jopawec, â mumutâc dâŋticnere woŋec mi jumbiŋ.
Jaŋe mâreŋ tuhuo andac sâko ehuc, Anutu mâreŋ sawao esâickembiŋ.
Eme wiac numucnembiŋ i jarewec, erâ ine huc ima‐ticnehec mume fisi jopawec.
Eme guru‐jeŋickonec gâcnezi Mose iiŋguuŋ ecnepie, â Wofuŋte tiriŋic Aroŋ mana sâqorecnepie,
mâreŋzi micne aŋkerâ Dataŋ ɋâckewec, erâ wâc Abiram qâjâpecfâcne hemac‐jopawec.
Erâ ʒoczi ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko bâruŋkerâ, ŋic sindaŋ hârindaŋne ʒâseŋ‐jopawec.
Jaŋe Horebe tikifuŋko bulimakao motec barâ, ɋâŋ qâqâtâc mai‐ticnao dunduŋ humbiŋ;
jaŋe Anuture eri tatamac qikiŋnehuc, bulimakao kecɋaŋ nânâ ere hawari sâsembiŋ.
Jaŋe Anutu bâbâpiaŋ‐jeŋicte nikec‐jopawec, e Aigita mâreŋko gie sâko bawec irec manapie wahawec;
e Hamte mâreŋko â Hâwec Bâbâroŋko, mâsi bipinehec bawec i mana suambiŋ.
Eme bâsirowec‐jopaocte mume, Mose, bâwosâec‐ticne, eki sacfozic ejarerâ oso bahuc, kimbeŋ‐ticne bâmâteŋkeme furu jumbiŋ.
Eme jaŋe mâreŋ biaŋ i qikiŋnembiŋ, ehuc mumupaŋ dâŋticne mi mana ʒakiembiŋ;
qoruc boze‐jeŋicko kâroŋ qahuc fombiŋ, â Wofuŋte marac fânâŋte hazec mi râembiŋ.
Eme mâreŋ tuhuo sipiric‐jopaocte, mene bâfeŋnehuc mupaŋke‐jarewec.
Ehuc ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic qâpuc ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐jopahuc, mâreŋne mâreŋne râec‐jopa raocte muwec.
Eme jaŋe Baali Peoro nemu erao qohotambiŋ, â hâmokicne tiwâ bâzi ejarekicne i nâhuc jumbiŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋ maŋticne bâiŋnembiŋ; eme ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko hucukic sâqocne moc fuawec.
Eme Pinehasizi fahare sacfozic ejareme, huc hâmoc qaʒue wahawec.
E iŋuc ewecte mimiŋzi ɋâric, tatara tâmiric manacnepie biaŋkewec.
Izi Meriba opâo kimbeŋ‐ticne bâiŋnepie, jaŋere erâ Mosezi wiac eme sâqorewec.
Jaŋe Mâro‐ticne râŋgeŋkecnembiŋte, Mosezi dâŋ fâfâcnehec muwec.
Jaŋe Wofuŋte mumutâc dâŋ qatarahuc, qâpuc guru mi bâsirowec‐jopambiŋ.
Mâcne, jaŋe jaŋehec sisifuc epie, eebapa‐jeŋic qazu‐jarepie ijaha embiŋ.
Ehuc nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic kiŋaŋ qajarembiŋ; eme izi bitiŋ ejarewec.
Jaŋe otâ ŋokâfâc‐jeŋic demoŋ bâzi rike‐jarembiŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc soc bahacmâc hoŋkembiŋ, otâ ŋokâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere soc hâcne. I Kanaaŋ mâreŋte nemu bâzi rike‐jarembiŋ, eme irec socte kiŋzi mâreŋ sâweckewec.
Wiac i ehuc wâwânâŋ sâko bâfuambiŋ, â ʒâʒâfic ekicne i hetâcnembiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋte kimbeŋzi ŋicfâcne bâruŋke‐jarewec, â fuŋfuŋfâcne jaŋere mamakâckewec.
Irec qâpuc jaŋere meo râec‐jopame, qaisoc‐jopambiŋzi ŋicwofuŋ ejarembiŋ.
Râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋe hâcne ro waha âte ejarekupie, rurumaŋ‐jeŋicko huacbucne erâ jumbiŋ.
Eki gâbâ batarac‐jopa jujec; ehame jaŋe ine pepec ecne jumbieŋ; ekupie hehesic‐jeŋiczi qa bâutuc ejarewec.
Eme kio owa‐jeŋiczi ra bâfuame sâc, sifu fific guguriŋkonec hone bafic ejare jujec.
E jaŋere erâ ʒâʒâfic‐ticnere manasu jujec, â buuruc sâko‐ticnere sâcko busâqoc mana‐jare jujec.
Ehuc niŋgiŋko bacjopa jumbiŋ jaŋe ejareme, iŋuc jaha busâqoc mana‐jare jumbieŋ.
O Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec, go bafic‐nâpoc, â qâpuc jaŋeraonec henusuc‐nâpoc; eme nâŋe tiri ʒâŋege daŋge âzâcnenʒepeneŋ, â mumbiaŋguhuc mu ʒeri enʒepeneŋ.
Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu, e muteŋkezo. Dameŋ tâmirickonec ewarekicne, i foraku dameŋ tâmirickoa tarazejec. Ŋic ʒeŋgoma munʒepieŋ, “Jâmbomac.” Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ!
Wofuŋ daŋge âzâcneniŋ, e uruc jauŋ‐ticnehec; â aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ foocmu.
Wofuŋzi firuec‐jopawec jaŋe iŋuc munʒepieŋ, ʒârâ hâriŋkonec batarac‐jopawec jaŋe hâcne.
E mâreŋne mâreŋne irec henusuc‐jopawec, ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec â huhunaonec, mâreŋ faickonec â juwickonec.
Gâcne jaŋe mâreŋ tuhuo qac qâsoric erâ jumbiŋ, ehuc ŋichae wiac irec hata moc mi bâfuambiŋ.
Nânâ opâre hâmohuc, maŋjeŋic omaezo ewec.
Eme harac eku Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnepie, ʒârâ ʒâpâonec batarac‐jopawec.
E hata dândâŋnao jowac‐jopame, hae ŋeŋene mocko fisimbiŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ uruc jauŋ‐ticnere daŋge âzâcnenʒepieŋ, e ŋic nâŋâcnao mâsi sâko baekacte.
E opâre hâmoeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâgunuc‐jopaekac, â nânâre sâqoreeŋgopieŋ jaŋe wiac biaŋne jareme nâ gapec eeŋgopieŋ.
Gâcne jaŋe dapâcko qiŋquŋkehuc ŋembiŋ, niŋgiŋ‐jopahuc aeŋzi basanaŋ‐jopakicnere huacbuc embiŋ;
ine Anuture dâŋ pepec sisiric ecnembiŋte, â Femicne sâkore uŋdâŋ mana suambiŋte.
Eme jaŋe ʒâic gie baku maŋjeŋic wahawec, qarâ suriŋne erâ babafic basambiŋ.
Eme harac eku Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnepie, ʒârâ ʒâpâonec batarac‐jopawec.
E aeŋ niŋgiŋ‐jeŋic hetâcnehuc, dapâcko qiŋquŋkehuc jumbiŋkonec baefuc‐jopawec.
Irec Wofuŋ uruc jauŋ‐ticnere daŋge âzâcnenʒepieŋ, e ŋic nâŋâcnao mâsi sâko baekacte.
E motâc sanaŋ heropieekac, â aeŋ aka qazuekac.
Gâcne jaŋe sindaŋ eku huc bacjopawec, â hehesic‐jeŋicte erâ ʒâic fua‐jarewec.
Jaŋe nânâ sasawa qikiŋne‐fârembiŋ, â hâmocte motâc bâqiŋkembiŋ.
Eme harac eku Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnepie, ʒârâ ʒâpâonec batarac‐jopawec.
E dâŋticne soreme fisi bâpiaŋ‐jopawec, ehuc ʒâŋeruŋkonec baefuc‐jopawec.
Irec Wofuŋ uruc jauŋ‐ticnere daŋge âzâcnenʒepieŋ, e ŋic nâŋâcnao mâsi sâko baekacte.
Erâ daŋge tahare wiac bacne fisinʒepieŋ, â ʒeri gae hecnehuc wiac bapa‐ticne musokanʒepieŋ.
Gâcne jaŋe moŋgeŋko hurâ wokeo fembiŋ, hâwec sâko fotâcnehuc âbârâ gie baniŋte.
Jaŋe Wofuŋte wiac bapa honembiŋ, ʒâkâŋ faio mâsi baekac i hâcne.
Ere micdâŋte mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋ fisirâ, hâwec siri ʒocnehec bafaharewec.
Sambâŋkopec fembiŋ, hârâckopec humbiŋ, ehuc ŋic hâbi‐jeŋic goroŋkewec.
Ʒâŋe‐jeŋic bâniniŋkeme, biric boroc ehuc maŋjeŋic omaewec.
Eme harac eku Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnepie, ʒârâ ʒâpâonec batarac‐jopawec.
E mâŋâŋ ecneme qaʒuewec, â hâwec siri niniŋkewec.
Niniŋ siarereŋ fuame aŋac‐jopawec, eme siluŋ hejâpembiŋko rafisimbiŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ uruc jauŋ‐ticnere daŋge âzâcnenʒepieŋ, e ŋic nâŋâcnao mâsi sâko baekacte.
Jaŋe ŋic ŋokac tutumaŋko Wofuŋ muafeckenʒepieŋ, â soŋaŋ tutumaŋko mumbiaŋkenʒepieŋ.
E opâ sâko hetikieme moŋgeŋ kereŋne fuaekac, opâ ʒâŋezi mâreŋ hahaŋkekicne eekac.
Me mâreŋ guec biaŋzi hâfu roroc eekac, i runezi sindaŋ gie bapie iŋuc fuaekac.
Erâ wâc mâreŋ burocnao riqic bâfuaekac, kereŋnao opâ ʒâŋe mume wefuekac.
Erâ ira ŋic tac qararacne râec‐jopame, fic hae bâfuarâ jueŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe gie he sarac ehuc waiŋ wâc saraeŋgopieŋ, eku mazuc mâriri sâkohec eeŋgopieŋ.
Jambuŋ‐jopame jaŋacne wâc fua sawec eeŋgopieŋ, â hae qowifâc‐jeŋic afecne mi saweeŋgopieŋ.
Moczi moc ro waha âte ejarekupie, ʒârâ hâriŋ â memezac fua‐jareocmu, me ʒare‐jeŋic wahame busâqoc mananiŋmuo,
ine ŋicbomboŋ mimi qaqa ejareocmu, â tuhuo râec‐jopame qac qâsoric eniŋmu.
Bebekâne ine ʒârâ hâriŋkonec batarac‐jopaocmu, â ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic bec qowi iŋucne saweniŋmu.
Ŋic siocmâc jaŋe i honerâ bubiaŋ mananiŋmu, â ŋic sindaŋne sasawa jaŋe dâŋ fâsâe‐jareocmu.
Moc e maŋɋârâŋ jukaczi wiac i hone‐hâmozejec, â ŋicne ŋicne Wofuŋ uruc jauŋ‐ticnere fuŋne mana‐hâmonʒepieŋ.

Maŋnane ʒawiekac, o Anutu, maŋnane ʒawiekac; no gae hepemu; no mumumbiaŋ gae hepemu; maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane go mana ɋâɋârec.
Gita kulele ŋohe mana ɋâɋârenic, furic wiwickepe mana ɋâɋâreoc.
O Wofuŋ, no qâpuc jaŋere ŋondeŋko daŋge gazape, no ŋicguru jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhuc mumbiaŋgupe.
Buurucgezi feku sambâŋ heuakac, jauŋ fârigezi feku karoracko fisikac.
Anutu, go fahare sambâŋ qâhuckerâ fezemec, eri tatamacgezi mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ sâcke‐fârezejec.
Mefâregezi bafic‐nâpohuc nunumu‐nâŋec manac, eme jorocfâcge nâŋerao bâbâpiaŋ fuazejec.
Anutuzi tiri ufuŋ‐ticnao ʒiŋuc muwec: “No kiwaehuc Sikem hae bâtâc bapemu, â Sukoti wâneŋ kâdoc qapemu.
Gileade rauckekopac, Manase i wâc nore; Eferaim e momori dunane, Juda e ŋicwofuŋ gunu‐nane.
Moabi e kike ʒuʒure râqâc‐nane; Edomtao kikehuhu‐nane wickecnepemu; Filisa mâreŋ saoreŋ qacnepemu.”
Mozi hae basanaŋkekicnao barâ râecnuocmu? Mozi Edomko jowacnu raocmu?
Anutu, go jâmbomac suŋgiŋ‐nâpomec me? Go momorifâc‐nâŋec râpec‐jopatec buc jueŋgopieŋ.
Râsi jopanaŋte hone bafic enârec; ŋiczi babafic‐nâpo i fârimâc.
Anutuhec sâcne momori wânʒâŋ enaŋmu; eki râsifâc‐nâŋec ro waha âte ejareocmu.
Mumumbiaŋ Anutu‐nane, go dâŋemâc mi juc.
Ŋic sindaŋne â burecne jaŋe micaaŋ maicnumbiŋ, ehuc nameŋ‐jeŋiczi siocdâŋ nazambiŋ.
Jaŋe qaqaisoc dâŋ wicke‐narembiŋ, â maŋgâŋ râsi enarembiŋ.
No jauŋ bacjopahape qoricnueŋgopieŋ, jaŋere erâ numuhape iŋuc enareeŋgopieŋ.
Ine hâcne biaŋnere okacne sâqocne nareeŋgopieŋ, maŋjauŋte okacne qaisocnueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic sindaŋne moc ecnetec dâŋticne muzejec, repicne moczi dâŋko râezejec.
Mumutara ŋic eki dâŋticne mugâpârezejec, nunumu‐ticnere maname bahac jaha ezejec.
Juju dameŋ‐ticne qosackezejec, mafa‐ticne i furunezi rauckezejec.
Naru motecfâcne bekâ enʒepieŋ, â ŋonâŋ‐ticne hozec ezejec.
Ɋâricfâcne jaŋe mamacte ficsesuc râpeckerâ, qafec qawahac juhuc nânâre numunʒepieŋ.
Moneŋ jaba râcnewec ŋic eki mafa‐ticne sakareme, omane jaŋe gie‐ticnere fârine bajunʒepieŋ.
Moczi moc âgo jauŋ mi ecnezejec, erâ moczi moc bekâfâcne jaŋere busâqoc mi manazejec.
Ɋâricfâcne omae‐fârenʒepieŋ, biri‐jeŋic ŋosa jaŋerao tarazejec.
Mamacfâcne hehesic‐jeŋicte Wofuŋzi manasuzejec, â neŋgoc‐ticnere sâqocne mi bâtâmirezejec.
I Wofuŋte maio fome honehuc juzejec; eme mâreŋko ine ŋic ere ninikec sanaŋ fuazejec.
Wemocte? E jauŋ gie baocte mi mamanasu, qarâ suriŋne â hapetac fific bacjopawec, â buheheric bâfua‐jarekicne jaŋe hâmocko râec‐jopawec.
E sâwecte ecnewecte sâweczi qazejec, jambuŋte takickewecte jambuŋ basazejec.
E sâwecdâŋ i ŋaqi iŋucne heme huwec, irec sâweczi sahac biucko â siec wamboŋ‐ticnao huzejec.
Erâ hoe ŋaqi tinac ecnehame rufazejec, â umbika tinac ecnehame joma juzejec.
Wofuŋtaonec gie furi izi kisâfâc‐nane fua‐jarezejec, musâqorecnuhuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne.
O Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane, goki ine ʒâŋe biŋegere erâ sacfozic enarec! Aki anonoc furi sâko fogarekacte bataracnuc!
No qarâ suriŋne â hapetac jukopac, ehame bu ʒaʒamaŋ‐nane fâuckekac.
Hae owâeme nâkumuczi omaeekac irec sâc ekopac, â mâŋâŋzi bisirec bawiseekac irec sâc.
Sowa juku dieŋ‐nane qiric qârâc eme, sahac kekereŋ epo jukopac.
Kisâfâc‐nane mu ruruc enareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe honecnurâ qizec fofotaric eeŋgopieŋ.
O Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane, go baficnuc, aki anonocgere sâcko bataracnuc.
Megere qâreŋ fuakac i jowatutec honeniŋ; Wofuŋ, goki hâcne wiac ʒi emeŋ.
Jaŋe sâwecdâŋ muzo murâ muniŋ, ehame goki jambuŋge bâfuac! Kisâfâc‐nane jaŋe qurutuanʒepieŋ; ehame kiŋaŋŋicgezi bubiaŋ manazejec.
Qoricnueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mimizi ŋecjopazejec, mimi‐jeŋiczi bilaŋke iŋucne erâ foŋjopazejec.
Micnanezi Wofuŋ daŋge musokahuc âzâcnezepac, ŋicguru sâkoo e mumbiaŋkezepac.
Eki ŋic tac qararacne mefâre‐ticnao domaekac hâcne, ehuc hâmoocte mutaracneeŋgopieŋ jaŋere meonec bataraekac.
Wofuŋzi nore Wofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ware fâre‐naneo ŋehaŋtec râsifâcge guruc‐jopape kikegere ââtesiŋ enʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋzi Zioŋkonec ŋicwofuŋ gunuge tâpiri sâkonehec i sicnekac. Râsifâcge jaŋere ŋondeŋko guriŋ bapa gie bac!
Ŋicfâcge jaŋe maŋafec jaha fisi‐garepie goki momori gurufâcge tiri tikio jowac‐jopa racmu. Ŋafe furec hehe‐jekicko titikuc fuaekac, irec sâc socɋâricfâcge fisi‐gareniŋmu.
Wofuŋ e dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupaŋkewec, i maŋne risieme mi beheocmu: “Goki Melikisede ere sâcko taha bapa juraʒihuc jucmu sanaŋ.”
Wofuŋ e mefâregao domakac; e kimbeŋ dameŋ‐ticnao ŋicwofuŋ qanʒaŋ‐jopaocmu.
Ŋic gurune gurune jaŋerao okac babazu gie bame, qâŋɋâŋ guru fufusuc fuaniŋmu, qizec qanʒaŋne‐jareme mâreŋ sâckerâ foraniŋmu.
E hatamecko opâ fia nâc eocmu, ehuc qacboc‐ticnehec domaocmu.
Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ! No Wofuŋ maŋ hâcbuc jaha daŋge âzâcnepe, ŋic siocmâc jaŋere ŋondeŋko â kikefuŋ guruo.
Wofuŋte meqâreŋ i bipinehec, irec aŋac fojareekac jaŋe mana wosâeeŋgopieŋ.
Wiac bapa‐ticne i ʒâŋe biŋe â ʒai ʒonʒoŋhec, â tiŋne‐ticne tofamâc fohuc juocmu.
E mâsi sâko‐ticne manasuhuc junaŋte ma moc bâfuawec; Wofuŋ e aki anonoc â buuruchec.
E araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe nânâ bâfua‐jareekac; e ʒâʒâfic‐ticnere manasuhuc jaha juekac.
E ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere mâreŋ i ŋicfâc‐ticne jarehuc, wiac tâpirihec eekac irec fuŋne jowatuwec.
Meticnezi gie baekac i siocmâc â tiŋne; sâcmutâc‐ticne i eeatuc tâmiric,
izi fofo sanaŋ foocte keteŋke‐hâmowec, ŋiczi siocmâc â maŋhumuc juhuc reŋkeniŋte.
E kikefuŋfâc‐ticne firuec‐jopawec, ehuc ʒâʒâfic‐ticne fofo sanaŋ foocte mupaŋkewec. Ʒâŋe‐ticne tiri moc â bipinehec.
Wofuŋ araŋ babacne izi maŋɋârâŋte hata fufuŋkene ekac; irec giene baniŋmuzi wiac mana utuckeniŋmu. Ere ʒâŋe biŋe foraʒihuc jaha juocmu.
Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ! Moc e Wofuŋ araŋ bacnehuc, sâcmutâc‐ticnere bubiaŋ sâko manaekac, ere manape ʒerine ekac.
Ɋâricfâcne jaŋe mâreŋko tâpirihec juniŋmu, tiŋne jaŋere guruzi jambuŋhec eniŋmu.
Ficticnao wiac sasawa mazuc mâriri foocmu, â tiŋne‐ticnezi foraʒihuc juocmu.
Siocmâc jaŋe dapâcko tatamac fua‐jareocmu; ŋic tiŋnezi aki anonoc â buuruchec juekac.
Moc e buafec erâ ŋic wiac jaba jareekac e sâcne juhâmoocmu; â dâŋgieo râepie dâŋticne sâcne mume biaŋkeocmu.
Ŋic tiŋnezi ra ioc ware ioc moc mi eocmu, irec ŋiczi ere raŋɋa manasuhuc juniŋmu.
E biŋedâŋ sâqocnere boc mi mezackeocmu, maŋnezi Wofuŋtao roweckehuc qiŋ herâ domaocmu.
E hâbi heme hume hâhâwic tâmiric jufeku râsifâcne sanaŋke‐jarerâ saoreŋ qaekac.
E boki bahuc hapetac wiac tahac‐jopaekac; tiŋne juju‐ticnezi foraʒihuc juocmu; eme ŋiczi sâsekupie ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnezi feocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋnezi e honerâ aarickeekac, erâ mic kikiaric kiku omaeekac; sindaŋnezi wiac fuaocte muekac i fârimâc eekac.
Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ! Wofuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa ŋoŋe e mumbiaŋkeniŋ, Wofuŋ ʒâŋe‐ticne mumbiaŋkeniŋ.
Wofuŋte ʒâŋe i ʒiŋuczia muteŋkerâ, dameŋ tâmiric muteŋke rahuc juzo.
Ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec domarâ raku huhunao, i Wofuŋte ʒâŋe jaha mumbiaŋkehuc juzo.
Wofuŋ e ŋicne ŋicne jowarurâ fewec jukac, eri tatamac‐ticnezi sambâŋ sirickerâ fekac.
Mozi Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec ere sâc jukac? E faic eri ŋeŋe‐ticnao ŋekac.
Ehuc fime juwic wahame, sambâŋ â mâreŋ honenʒaŋ‐jofaekac.
E qarâ suriŋne wândockonec bâfeŋneekac, â hapetac jawa guruonec bafahareekac.
Erâ râeme micne bapare gâjoŋko ŋeekac, ehuc ŋicfâcne jaŋere micne bapa qâteekac.
E ŋokac hufiŋne bafickeme ficte eri eekac, ehuc mume ɋâricfâcne fuapie bubiaŋ manaekac. Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ!
Israezi Aigita mâreŋkonec faharewecko, â Jakobore kikefuŋzi ŋicguru dâŋmarac‐jeŋic furune jaŋe behec‐jopawecko,
Judazi Wofuŋte tiri ufuŋ ewec, â Israezi uucmaŋ‐ticne ewec.
Eme hâweczi honerâ wisewec, â Jordaŋzi fotikierâ rawec.
Tiki jaŋe lama ŋicne tinac tarambiŋ, â mâreŋ facne jaŋe lama motec tinac kiwaembiŋ.
Hâwec, go wemoczi bâʒâicgume wisekic? Jordaŋ, go wemocte fotikierâ rakomec?
Tiki, ŋoŋe wemocte lama ŋicne tinac taraŋgopieŋ? Mâreŋ facne, ŋoŋe wemocte lama motec tinac kiwaeŋgopieŋ?
O mâreŋ, go Wofuŋte maio ɋiɋiteckec, Jakobore Anutu ere maio.
Eki hâcne qânâ hetikieme opâ ʒâkâŋ ekac, erâ buse hetikieme opâ ʒâŋe fuakac.
Nâŋe mâcne, Wofuŋ, nâŋe mâcne, gahacne ʒâŋe ine eri qaraweŋ bâfuacnec, aki anonocge â jauŋ fârigere erâ.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe wemocte ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Anutu‐jeŋic weni?”
Anutu‐nâŋec e sambâŋko jukac, ehuc wiac mana biaŋkeekac sâc bâfuaekac.
Jaŋere nemuɋâŋ ine siliwa â gol, ŋicmezi ba akic ekicne.
Mic fojareha dâŋ mi mueŋgopieŋ; ʒâŋe fojareha wiac mi honeeŋgopieŋ.
Hazec fojareha sifu dâŋ mi manaeŋgopieŋ; sâke‐jeŋic fokac, â âsu ine mi manaeŋgopieŋ.
Me fojareha wiac ba bâuac mi eeŋgopieŋ; jaŋe kike‐jeŋichec, hata ine mi jueŋgopieŋ; erâ marac‐jeŋiczi dâŋfânâŋ mi eeŋgopieŋ.
Ɋâŋ bâfuaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe wâc ɋâŋ iŋucne tinac, erâ ɋâŋte mamanac jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ɋâŋte sâc jaha.
O Israe, Wofuŋtao roweckec! Eki babafic‐ŋeŋic â maro‐ŋeŋic jukac.
O Aroŋte kikefuŋ, Wofuŋtao roweckeniŋ! Eki babafic‐ŋeŋic â maro‐ŋeŋic jukac.
Wofuŋ araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe Wofuŋtao roweckeniŋ! Eki babafic‐ŋeŋic â maro‐ŋeŋic jukac.
Wofuŋzi manasuc‐nâpohuc juwec, eki jambuŋ‐nâpoocmu, eki Israe kikefuŋ jambuŋkeocmu, eki Aroŋ kikefuŋ jambuŋkeocmu.
E Wofuŋ araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe jambuŋ‐jopaocmu, piticne mecne kâcɋene mecne jambuŋ‐jopaocmu.
Wofuŋ e basawec‐ŋopazejec, ŋoŋe â ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic.
Wofuŋ sambâŋ â mâreŋ bâfuac‐jofawec eki jambuŋ‐ŋopazejec.
Sambâŋ i Wofuŋte sambâŋ, mâreŋ ine ŋic nâŋâc nârewec.
Hâmokicne jaŋe Wofuŋ mi mumbiaŋkeeŋgopieŋ, niniŋ siarereŋ haeo raeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâcne,
nâŋâc ine Wofuŋ muteŋkenʒepeneŋ, ʒiŋuczia fuŋkerâ dameŋ tâmiric erahuc junʒepeneŋ. Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ!
Wofuŋzi wira wâwâsic‐nane manaekacte no e maŋzi jauŋkekopac.
Oc, e hazec râe‐nareekac, irec no jupemu sâc wâsickehuc juzepac.
Hâmocte bitiŋzi rocnuwec, hâmoc haere uficzi orâŋnuwec, eme hâhâwic â bipic tatara fua‐narewec.
Eme no Wofuŋte ʒâŋe wâsickepo: “O Wofuŋ, juju‐nane asao roc!”
Wofuŋ e aki anonochec â tiŋne, Anutu‐nâŋec e buuruchec.
Wofuŋ e ŋic maŋhumuc hone maiŋ ejareekac, no betaŋkehape eki baficnuwec.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane, go jujumanagao risiec, Wofuŋzi ehâmo‐garekac.
Go maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane hâmockonec batarameŋ, ʒâŋeuc‐nane bâkereŋkemeŋ, kike‐nane fâfâckezacte sabeckemeŋ.
Eme ʒi Wofuŋte maio, jujune jaŋere guruo jukopac.
“No mâretec sâqorekopac,” iŋuc mupo, erâ sifu manasiŋkepo.
No maŋnane gâckeme mupo, “Ŋic jaŋe burechec sasawa.”
Wofuŋzi wiac sesic qeqeri tahacnuwec, irec okacne wemo râcnepemu?
No waiŋzi taha bâzi bâfeŋnehuc Wofuŋte ʒâŋe riwaseckepe.
No ŋic ŋokacfâcne sasawa jaŋere maio, Wofuŋ dâŋ mupaŋkecnepo irec fârine bâfuape.
Mitiŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere hâmoczi Wofuŋte maio furi sâko ekac.
O Wofuŋ, no gore kiŋaŋŋic jukopac; kiŋaŋŋicge no kiŋaŋ narugere ŋokâ. Goki kâpâcwâru‐nane firuemeŋ.
No daŋgere taha bafisi‐garehuc, Wofuŋ gore ʒâŋe riwaseckepe.
Ŋic ŋokacfâcne sasawa jaŋere maio, Wofuŋ dâŋ mupaŋkecnepo irec fârine bâfuape.
I Wofuŋ ufuŋ‐ticnere hae ʒoŋao epemu, Jerusalem rune, ŋoŋere ŋondeŋko. Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ!
Ŋicne ŋicne, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ; ŋicguru ʒeŋgoma, ŋoŋe e muafeckeniŋ!
Aki anonoc‐ticnezi nâŋâcnao tâpirihec fuakac, Wofuŋte jauŋ fârizi fofo sanaŋ fokac. Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ!
Wofuŋ daŋge âzâcneniŋ, e uruc jauŋ‐ticnehec; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Eme Israezi muzejec: “Oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.”
Eme Aroŋte kikefuŋzi muzejec: “Oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.”
Eme Wofuŋ araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe munʒepieŋ: “Oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.”
Ʒâic busâqoc faio juhuc Wofuŋ wâsickepo, eme Wofuŋzi mana‐narerâ rambaŋko râecnuwec.
Wofuŋzi no siŋnukacte mi hâwicnukac, ŋic jaŋe wemo enareniŋmu?
Wofuŋzi no baficnuocte siŋnukac, irec no sanaŋkehuc râsifâc‐nane saoreŋ qajarepemu.
Wofuŋte dapeŋko sosoŋke izi fekac, ehame ŋicko rorowecke izi wahakac.
Wofuŋte dapeŋko sosoŋke izi fekac, ehame ŋicbomboŋko rorowecke izi wahakac.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe ʒeŋgoma somâcnumbiŋ, eme Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo qanʒaŋ‐jopapo.
Jaŋe orâŋnuhuc somâcnumbiŋ, eme Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo qanʒaŋ‐jopapo.
Jaŋe baŋac neŋgoc iŋucne bârârâŋnumbiŋ, hârijâc rehacnezi bâruŋkeekac iŋuc enarembiŋ, eme Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo qanʒaŋ‐jopapo.
Hâhâwicne decnukupie farazo epo, eme Wofuŋzi ine baficnuwec.
Wofuŋ e tâpiri‐nane â mumuteŋ‐nane; e sisipirickonec babatara‐nane ewec.
A, tiŋne guru jaŋere qoruc bozeo saoreŋ â ʒeri gae fuakac: “Wofuŋ mefârenezi gie ɋicwânʒâŋ bakac,
Wofuŋ mefârenezi faharekac, Wofuŋ mefârenezi gie ɋicwânʒâŋ bakac.”
No mi hâmopemu, ɋâricne jupemu, ehuc Wofuŋ wiac bapa‐ticne mutaniŋkepemu.
Wofuŋ e ʒocnehec bâtiŋnuwec, erâ hâmocte meo ine mi râecnuwec.
Taha ufuŋte motâc ronareniŋ, eme no ira raʒirâ Wofuŋ daŋge âzâcnepe.
Wofuŋte sacmotâc ʒine hâcne, tiŋne jaŋe ira raʒiniŋmu.
Go micnaneo romeŋte daŋge gazakopac, micnaneo rorâ sisipirickonec bataracnumeŋ.
Ficbapa ŋic jaŋe wâtuŋ surehuc behembiŋ, wâtuŋ izi mi jâmâ wâtuŋ ezejec i!
Wiac i Wofuŋte micte iŋuc fuame, ŋiczi honepene mâsi furune ekac.
Dameŋ ʒi hâcne Wofuŋzi bâfuawec, irec maŋnao ʒeri ehuc bubiaŋ mananaŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go bafic‐nâpoc! O Wofuŋ, fâri biaŋ fua‐nârezejec!
Wofuŋte micte warekac e mumbiaŋkenaŋ; Wofuŋte fickoneczi jambuŋ‐ŋopaŋgopeneŋ.
Wofuŋ e Anutu, eki tatamac nârewec. Ʒunʒuŋko reso bândeŋne rakupie alata ʒuŋenao fisizejec.
Go Anutu‐nane, go hâcne daŋge gazape. Go Anutu‐nane, go hâcne muafecgupe.
Wofuŋ daŋge âzâcneniŋ, e uruc jauŋ‐ticnehec; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Hata bahacmâc jueŋgopieŋ, jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, Wofuŋte sâcmutâc hata âteeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne.
Mumutaniŋ dâŋticne bâwâzâŋkeeŋgopieŋ, jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, maŋ hâcbuc jaha wira basac ecneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne,
wiac hehesicne moc mi ehuc, ere kike hata bâjâpeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe.
Go mumutâcge aijakic jaha reŋkenaŋte mupaŋkemeŋ.
Jei, no dâŋsanaŋge reŋkehuctecne, hata paŋnea âtehuc juzapo me!
Mumupaŋ dâŋge hone dendeŋnehuc jupemuo, mimizi nore faio mi feocmu.
No mumutâc dâŋge tiŋne i mana maŋ eku maŋ hâcbuc jaha daŋge gazapemu.
No dâŋsanaŋge reŋkezo mukopac; go mi behecnu sanaŋkezemec!
Ŋic socɋâri moczi weniŋucko sâcne maŋɋaɋac juocmu? E dâŋgere sâcko hata‐ticne soŋaŋkehuc sâcne eocmu.
No maŋ hâcbuc jaha wira basac egareekopac; go qataŋnuhaŋ mumupaŋge mi qâsuazepac.
No sâqocne bahuc bugao bazipore, dâŋge maŋnaneo qâzuckepe foekac.
O Wofuŋ, no muteŋgukopac, go dâŋsanaŋge qazu‐narezemec.
Micgere mumutâc dâŋ sasawa, i micbipic‐nanezi mufuaekopac.
Mumutaniŋ hatagere aŋacnukac, i moneŋ mafare aŋac mamana irec sâc.
Mumutâc dâŋgere manatâc qâtâc epemu, â hatage hone dendeŋnehuc jupemu.
Dâŋsanaŋge mana ʒiziwepemu, â dâŋgere ninikec mi jupemu.
Kiŋaŋŋicge ehâmo‐narezemec, eme jufehuc dâŋge reŋkezepac.
Ʒâŋe‐nane bâtâcnetec sâcmutâc dâŋgere qâreŋ biaŋ hone jaŋgeŋkezepac.
No mâreŋko jaba jukopacte, mumupaŋ dâŋge mi bâsoŋke‐narezemec.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi mumutâc dâŋgere dameŋ sâc hâmohuc juekac.
Ŋic pepecne â sâwechec jaŋe hanec‐jopaekic, jaŋe hâcne mumupaŋ dâŋge râpeckeeŋgopieŋ.
Mimi busâqoc fua‐narekac i nowac roc, no mumutaniŋ dâŋge bajuekopac.
Ŋic micne jaŋe dâŋ qanarehuc juhapie, kiŋaŋŋicge no sifu dâŋsanaŋge manatâc qâtâc eekopac.
Mumutaniŋ dâŋgezi aŋac bâfua‐nareekac, ehuc uŋ sawaŋ‐nane eekac.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi gâc wândocko bohotakac; irec dâŋgere sâcko mocwâc bâfiriecnuc.
Juju‐nanere fuŋne gazape mana‐naremeŋ; irec dâŋsanaŋge qazu‐narec.
Mumutâcgere hata nowatu‐hâmoc, eme no mâsi biaŋgere manatâc qâtâc epe.
Buʒâiczi maŋnane bârokawekacte, dâŋgere sâcko basanaŋnuc.
Burecte hata bârârietec taic raha, sâcmutâc dâŋge qâmie‐narec.
Siocmâc jujure hata ro sakac epo, irec mumutâc dâŋge mai fonarekac.
Mumutaniŋ dâŋgao qohotaekopac; o Wofuŋ, go manahaŋ mi qurutuazepac.
Go maŋnane bâŋɋârâŋkekicte, sâcmutâc dâŋgere hatao âte rapemu.
O Wofuŋ, go dâŋsanaŋgere hata qazu‐narec, eme no mi kikizu raku tofanao fisizepac.
Mamana tahacnutec sâcmutâc dâŋge bajuhuc, maŋ hâcbuc jaha reŋkezepac.
Sâcmutâc dâŋgere hatao jowacnuzemec; no irec aŋac‐nane fokac.
Maŋnane fâretec moneŋ huhurere andac râpeckehuc, mumutaniŋ dâŋgao qohotazejec.
Ʒâŋe‐nane bâtikietec wiac sisirowenao mi fizepac; ehuc hatagao juju bâfua‐narec.
Araŋ bagareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe wiac jarezo mupaŋkemeŋ, wiac irec fârine kiŋaŋŋicge norao bâfuazemec.
Mimihec jujure hâwicnukacte manahaŋ nowaruzejec; gore mumutâc dâŋ ine biaŋne.
Jâmbomac, no mumutâc dâŋgere maŋhâhâŋ enarekac, irec tiŋnegezi juju bâfua‐narec.
O Wofuŋ, aki anonocgere fârine norao fuazejec, â mumupaŋgere sâcko baficnuzemec.
Eme mu ruruc enareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe dâŋ sâcne bâtikie‐jarepemu, no gore dâŋko hâcne roweckeekopac.
No dameŋ sâc dâŋfâri mupemurâ tâpiri mi nowac rozemec, no mumutiŋ dâŋgere mamanac jukopac hâcne.
No sâcmutâc dâŋge ʒuʒuhuc bajupemu, ehuc moc mi behepemu.
No mumutâc dâŋgere mu wioc epo, irec rambaŋko sâcne rac warec jupemu.
Erâ no mimi gaŋgaŋ tâmiric ŋicwofuŋ maio, mumutaniŋ dâŋgere mu binaŋ epemu.
No sâcmutâc dâŋgere aŋacnuekacte, irec dâŋ muhuc mana ʒiziweekopac.
Erâ sâcmutâc dâŋgere manape fejâmbâŋkeekac, ehuc dâŋsanaŋgere manatâc qâtâc eekopac.
Kiŋaŋŋicge no dâŋ nazameŋ irec fârine bâfuac, go enaretec irec woŋec juekopac hâcne.
Mumupaŋ dâŋgezi bâgunucnuwec, izi ʒârâ hâriŋko bâmiriŋnuekac.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe mâretec mu ruruc enareeŋgopieŋ, eme no ine sâcmutâc dâŋge mi râpeckeekopac.
O Wofuŋ, go mumutâc dâŋge esecne mufuameŋ, no irec manasupe bâmiriŋnuekac.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋge râpeckeeŋgopieŋ, irec mâretec aaricnuekac.
Jaba mâreŋ‐naneo ʒi jukopacko, dâŋsanaŋgezi ʒeri gae‐nane eekac.
O Wofuŋ, no ŋafeo ʒâŋegere manasuhuc foekopac, ehuc sâcmutâc dâŋge basanaŋkeekopac.
Mumutâc dâŋge bajukuhape, wiac fâri biaŋ i fua‐narewec.
Wofuŋ, go kâdoc biaŋ‐nane; irec no dâŋge bajuzo mupaŋkekopac.
No maŋ hâcbuc jaha numu‐garekopac: “Mumupaŋgere sâcko aki anonoc enarec.”
Go wiac eekic no irec manasurâ, mumutaniŋ dâŋge mana maŋ ezo enarekac.
No ŋeŋec ʒeʒepec mi ehuc fâro barâ sâcmutâc dâŋge reŋkeekopac.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere uficzi orâŋnume, sifu sâcmutâc dâŋgere mi nikecnuekac.
No ŋafe ʒâʒâŋiŋko faharerâ, mumutâc dâŋge tiŋne irec mumbiaŋguekopac.
Araŋ bagarehuc mumutâc dâŋge reŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe âgo ejare‐fâreekopac.
O Wofuŋ, aki anonocgezi mâreŋ fusucmawec; irec go dâŋsanaŋge qazu‐narezemec.
O Wofuŋ, go mumupaŋ dâŋgere sâcko kiŋaŋŋicge no ehâmo‐naremeŋ.
No sâcmutâc dâŋge mana ʒakiekopacte maŋɋârâŋ â mamana tara qazu‐narezemec.
Go mi bawahacnuhaŋ qac qâsoric ehuc jupo; ʒiŋuczia ine dâŋge bâjâpekopac.
Go uruc jauŋgeheczi eehâmo gie baekic, irec dâŋsanaŋge qazu‐narezemec.
Pepec‐jeŋicheczi micko âkec enarembiŋ, no ine mumutâc dâŋge maŋ hâcbuc jaha honehuc juekopac.
Maŋjeŋic râŋgeŋkerâ mumuŋ jâc sahac iŋucne ewec; no ine sâcmutâc dâŋgere bubiaŋ fonarekac.
Goki sowine bawahacnumeŋ; iŋuc etecne dâŋsanaŋgere fuŋne manapo.
Gol â siliwa guru sâkore manape wahaha micgere sâcmutâc dâŋte manape fekac.
Megezi sahac‐nane bâfuarâ ba akic emeŋ; ʒi ine mamana tahacnutec sâcmutâc dâŋge manazepac.
Araŋ bagareeŋgopieŋzi honecnurâ aŋac‐jopaocmu, noni dâŋge worickehuc jupo hâcne.
O Wofuŋ, no manakopac, okac babazuge tiŋne, go jauŋ fârigere erâ bawahacnumeŋ.
Aki anonocgezi bâmiriŋnuzejec, kiŋaŋŋicge no mupaŋke‐naremeŋ irec sâcko.
Buurucgezi fisi iqicnume juzepac; sâcmutâc dâŋge mana ʒiziweekopac i.
Pepecnehec jaŋe maŋgâŋ ro waha âte enarembiŋte, goki mimi qaqa ejarezemec; no ine mumutâc dâŋge manasuhuc jupemu.
Araŋ bagareeŋgopieŋ â mumutaniŋ dâŋge maŋkeeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ejaretec norao ʒuhuckenʒepieŋ.
Maŋnanezi dâŋsanaŋgao paŋʒâic qohotazejec, eme moc mi qurutuazepac.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi bâbâpiaŋgere hâmohuc jukac, dâŋgezi fâri fideteŋ eocte woŋec juekopac.
Ʒâŋe‐nanezi mumupaŋgere fârine honeocte fiipieku betaŋkekac, ehuc wiokac: “Mo dameŋko bâmiriŋnuocmu?”
No ʒopo ʒuo foku hahaŋkeekac iŋucne epo, erâ sifu dâŋsanaŋgere mi nikecnuwec.
Kiŋaŋŋicge nore ŋafe ʒoaŋ wezimuc fokac? Fific guguriŋ enareeŋgopieŋ jaŋere dâŋ mo dameŋko mutaracmu?
Ŋic pepecne jaŋe wiwitic râe‐narembieŋ, sâcmutâcgere sâcko mi jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne.
Sâcmutâc dâŋge i dâŋ fârine sasawa; jaŋe ine bureczi nu jâpec eeŋgopieŋte baficnuc!
Jaŋe mâreŋko juju‐nane hetâcnezo embieŋ, eme sifu mumutâc dâŋge mi behekopac.
Go aki anonocgere erâ juju‐nane akickec; eme no micgere mumutaniŋ dâŋ reŋkezepac.
O Wofuŋ, gore dâŋ i sambâŋko sanaŋne keteŋkekicne fokac.
Jauŋ fârige mimiŋzi ɋâric fosanaŋkekac; â mâreŋ ine hobeteŋne râemeŋte ŋesanaŋkekac.
Gore micdâŋte miŋecgac ŋekac jaha â wiac sasawa jaŋe go kiŋaŋ qagareŋgopieŋ.
Sâcmutâc dâŋgezi bubiaŋ mi qanarezacko ine maŋʒâiczi sipiricnume omaezapo.
Mumutâc dâŋgere moc mi nikecnuzokac, izi hâcne bâgunucnutec juekopac.
Go runane jukomecte baficnuc, no mumutâc dâŋgere wiohuc juekopac.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe nuniŋte somâ barâ foeŋgopieŋ, no ine mumutaniŋ dâŋge maŋkehuc juekopac.
Wiac qarâ biaŋ sasawa i sifu babahacne fuame honeekopac, gore sâcmutâc dâŋzi ine roma roma bakicne.
Sâcmutâc dâŋgere aŋacnuekac i fuŋmoc jâmbâŋ! Ʒoaŋ ʒora mana utuckehuc juekopac.
Sâcmutâc dâŋgezi maŋɋârâŋ bâfua‐narekume, râsifâc‐nane siric‐jopaekopac; no tofamâc maŋke juekopac hâcne.
Mamanahec ehuc qaqazufâc‐nane qâhuc‐jopaekopac, mumutaniŋ dâŋge mana utuckeekopac irec hâcne.
Wiac mana wosâehuc ŋicraŋɋa siric‐jopaekopac, mumutâc dâŋge hone jaŋgeŋkekopac irec hâcne.
Kike‐nanezi hata sâqocne i me i âtezacte aka hecneekopac, i dâŋge reŋkepemurâ iŋuc eekopac.
Go mumutâc dâŋge qazu‐naremeŋte, no moc mi râpeckeekopac.
Dâŋge manape aŋac ʒizine eekac, izi baŋacte aŋac sirickekac i!
Gore mumutâc dâŋzi mamana tara bâfua‐nareekac; irec hata hehesicne geŋke‐fâreekopac.
Dâŋgezi kike‐nane lambe ecneekac, â hata‐naneo tatamac bâfuaekac.
No mumutâc dâŋge tiŋne i bâjâpepemurâ, Anutu gore maio mupaŋkehuc mujomirepo.
No ro waha âte enarekicne; o Wofuŋ, go dâŋgere sâcko bâgunucnuc.
O Wofuŋ, no afeckehuc miczi taha bagarepe manatec sâckezejec, eme mumutâc dâŋge qazu‐narezemec.
No dameŋ sâc hâmoczi maicnuekac, ehame sâcmutâc dâŋge mi nikecnuekac.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe bitiŋ râe‐narembieŋ, no ine mumutâc dâŋge mi râpeckekopac.
Mumutaniŋ dâŋgezi merâfâc fofo sanaŋ‐nane ekac; ŋicbureŋ, i buhândâŋ‐nane ekac.
No dâŋsanaŋge reŋkepere maŋnane qafeŋkekopac, i dameŋ sâc eraku etarapemu.
Ŋic maŋ sosohoc jaŋere takicnuekac, sâcmutâc dâŋgere ine aŋacnuekac.
Go dapeŋ‐nane â maro‐nane, no dâŋge maŋzi worickekopac.
Sâqocne bapa, ŋoŋe behecnu raniŋ, eme Anutu‐nanere sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkepe.
Mumupaŋgere sâcko dopecnutec juzepac, eme mamanac‐nanezi fârimâc eme mi qurutuazepac.
Basanaŋnutec bâbâpiaŋ bâfuazepac, erâ dâŋsanaŋge ʒuʒuhuc jaha bajuzepac.
Qâsoriehuc dâŋsanaŋge râpeckeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe behec‐jopaekic; jei, eeatuc gie‐jeŋic fârimâc eekac.
Mâreŋko ŋic sindaŋne sasawa jaŋere manatec jawa eekac; irec mumutaniŋ dâŋgere aŋacnuekac.
Go araŋ bagarehuc sahac‐nane gâgâmârâekac, â mumutara dâŋgere mezacnuekac.
Wiac tiŋne â biaŋne ewarehuc jupo; irec bawahacnueŋgopieŋ jaŋerao mi qikiŋnuc.
Kiŋaŋŋicge no sacfozic enarec, ehuc penaroŋhec jaŋe mana‐jaretec mi bawahacnunʒepieŋ.
Mumupaŋge tiŋne irec fârine fuaocte ʒâŋe‐nanezi fiipieku betaŋkekac.
Kiŋaŋŋicge no aki anonocgere sâcko wiac enarec, ehuc dâŋsanaŋge qazu‐narec.
No kiŋaŋŋicge jukopacte mamana tara tahacnuc, eme mumutaniŋ dâŋge mana jaŋgeŋkezepac.
Ŋic jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋge huckembieŋ; irec Wofuŋ goki okacne bazu‐jarecmurâ dameŋne maickekac.
Irec no sâcmutâc dâŋgere fehuc aŋacnukac, gol â gol ematauckekicne irec aŋac‐nane wahakac.
Erâ no mumutâc dâŋgere sâcko hata tiŋne juekopac, burec hatane hatane irec takicnuekac.
Mumutaniŋ dâŋge i eri‐ticnehec; irec maŋnanezi ira qohotaekac.
Dâŋgere fuŋne ritupie tatamac fuaekac, eme ŋic maŋhumuc jaŋe wiac mana jaŋgeŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
No sâcmutâc dâŋgere boc enareekacte maŋhâhâŋ ehuc micaaŋ jukopac.
Norao fotikierâ aki anonoc enarec; ʒâŋegere aŋac‐jopaekac jaŋe iŋuc hâcne ejareekic.
Dâŋgere sâcko hata âte ʒakierâ juzepac, eme wiac hehesicne moczi ŋicbomboŋ mi enarezejec.
Ŋic jaŋe bawahacnunʒipiŋte jaŋeraonec bataracnuzemec, eme no mumutâc dâŋge bâjâpezepac.
Ʒâŋe maigezi kiŋaŋŋicge no tamae‐narezejec, ehame dâŋsanaŋge qazu‐narezemec.
Ŋic jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋge mi reŋkeeŋgopieŋte ʒâŋeuc‐nane fusinehec wahahuc foekac.
O Wofuŋ, go tiŋne rune, â okac babazuge sâckoa fuaekac.
Go mumutaniŋ dâŋge sâcticne manahuc basanaŋkemeŋ, jauŋ fârigere sâcko jâmbâŋ.
Kisâfâc‐nane jaŋe dâŋgere nikec‐jopakacte no bunane bâruŋkekac.
Mumupaŋ dâŋge i esâicke tarakicne, irec kiŋaŋŋicge noni maŋzi jauŋkekopac.
No ŋic omane â qarâ suriŋne, erâ sifu mumutâc dâŋge irec mi nikecnuekac.
Tiŋnege i tiŋne fofo sanaŋ, â sâcmutâc dâŋge i dâŋ fâri qizecne.
Ʒâic â ʒârâ hâriŋ bâfuacnuekacko sâcmutâc dâŋgezi bubiaŋ bâfua‐nareekac.
Gore mumutaniŋ dâŋ i tiŋne fohuc juzokac, irec mamana tara bâfua‐narec, eme sâcne jupemu.
No maŋ hâcbuc jaha wira‐garekopac: Wofuŋ, go mana‐narec. No dâŋsanaŋge reŋkehuc jupemu.
No wâsicgukopac: Go baficnuc; eme no mumutaniŋ dâŋge soŋaŋkepe.
No hae mi fureha fahare wira‐gareekopac; erâ dâŋgere woŋec juekopac.
Ŋafe ʒora ɋâricne fohuc juekopac, ehuc mumupaŋ dâŋgere manatâc qâtâc eekopac.
Aki anonocgere erâ marac fânâŋ‐nane manac; o Wofuŋ, mumutiŋgere sâcko juju‐nane hone maiŋ ezemec.
Dâŋ qanareeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe bâjâpecnuŋgopieŋ; sâcmutâc dâŋge ine râpeckerâ jueŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ, go ine bâqiŋnurâ jukomec. â sâcmutâc dâŋge i fârinehec sasawa.
Mumutaniŋ dâŋgezi mârâc jaha mufuame manapo; Gore dâŋ i fofo sanaŋ foocte râemeŋ.
Ʒârâ hâriŋ‐nane honerâ bataracnuc, no sâcmutâc dâŋgere mi nikecnuekac.
Dâŋnane muku firuecnuzemec, erâ mumupaŋgere sâcko juju ɋâricne tahacnuzemec.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe bâbâpiaŋzi mi bâqiŋ‐jopaekac, jaŋe dâŋsanaŋge qâoma ecneeŋgopieŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go buurucge ɋârâŋne, irec mumutiŋgere sâcko juju tahacnuzemec.
Bocjahazi fific guguriŋ â râsi enareeŋgopieŋ, eme no ine mumutaniŋ dâŋge mi beheekopac.
No nâme nikecne honec‐joparâ mamakâcnuekac, jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋge mi reŋkeeŋgopieŋte.
Fitec wareme honec, no mumutâc dâŋge âgo ecnekopac. Wofuŋ, go aki anonocgere sâcko juju ɋâri bâfua‐narezemec.
Dâŋge sasawa qâhâckerâ ʒâŋene dâŋfâri muzo, â mumutâc dâŋge tiŋne i fofo sanaŋ fofâreocmu.
Ŋic fekicne jaŋe maŋgâŋ fific guguriŋ enareeŋgopieŋ, nore maŋzi ine dâŋgere maname bipinehec eekac.
No mumupaŋ dâŋgere bubiaŋ manaekopac, i mafa sâko bâfuahuc bubiaŋ manaeŋgopieŋ irec sâc.
No burecdâŋte takicnuekac â mamakâcnuekac, sâcmutâc dâŋgere ine aŋac manaekopac.
Gore mumutâc dâŋ tiŋne irec erâ ʒoaŋ sâc arec 7 mumbiaŋguekopac.
Sâcmutâcgere aŋac‐jopaekac jaŋe juju biaŋ bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, hata jupie wiac moczi mi fâfâc‐jopaekac.
No Wofuŋ gore bâbâpiaŋte mamanac jukopac, ehuc sâcmutâc dâŋge reŋkehuc juekopac.
Maŋnanezi mumutaniŋ dâŋge bâjâpeekac, irec hâcne mâretec aŋacnuekac.
No mumutâc â mumutaniŋ dâŋge reŋkeekopac, go hata‐nane i kâuc moc mi baekic.
O Wofuŋ, mu wâwâsic‐nanezi fâ bâfuacguzejec; eme dâŋgere sâcko mamana tara tahacnuzemec.
Nunumu‐nanezi maigao fisizejec; mumupaŋgere sâcko bâpiaŋnuzemec.
Micbipic‐naneonec mumuteŋ sâronehec wahazejec; goki dâŋsanaŋge qazu‐nareekicte.
Nameŋ‐nanezi dâŋgere ʒeri gae hezejec, sâcmutâc dâŋge tiŋne sasawa fokacte.
Megezi baficnuocte ʒawiehuc juzejec, no mumutâc dâŋge sakarepore.
O Wofuŋ, no bâpâpiaŋgere maŋhâhâŋ enareekac, â sâcmutâc dâŋgere bubiaŋ manaekopac.
Mana‐naretec juzepac, ehuc mumbiaŋguzepac, â mumutâcgezi baficnuzejec.
No lama sifuckekicne iŋucne qâsoriepore go kiŋaŋicge no basacnuzemec; no sâcmutâc dâŋgere mi nikecnuekac.
No ʒârâ hâriŋko juhuc, Wofuŋ ʒiŋuc wâsickekopac, i mana‐narezejec:
“O Wofuŋ, ŋic micbipic‐jeŋic burecnehec â nameŋ‐jeŋic siocnehec, jaŋeraonec bataracnuzemec.”
Eeatuc ŋic ŋoŋe Anutuzi wemo eŋareocmu? Erâ wemo okacne bâfua‐ŋareocmu?
Ʒikare tepe motec mictara, erâ tepe motec ʒockisoŋ i!
Jei, no wemocte Meseke mâreŋko jaba jukopac! No wemocte Kedera mâreŋte qoruc bozeo jukopac!
No dameŋ ʒora, wamare takic‐jopaekac, ŋic iŋucne jaŋerao juekopac.
No ŋic wamane; erâ dâŋ muipiehape jaŋe ʒika bâmockeeŋgopieŋ.
Tiki mâreŋkopec qâhâŋnerâ fikopac. Babafic‐nane wenirec moc wareocmu?
I Wofuŋtaonec warekac, sambâŋ mâreŋ bâfuawec eraonec hâcne.
Eki manaha kikege qiriŋ mi qaocmu, kitaŋge guŋzi mi qâmâckeocmu.
Manakic, Israe hone kitaŋ ecneekac, e guŋ tâmiriczi ɋâricne hati juekac.
Wofuŋ e kitaŋge, Wofuŋ e mumucge, fâregao domakac hâcne.
Irec ʒoaŋko ʒoaŋzi qa bâʒâic mi egareocmu, â ŋafeo mosazi wâc mi sipiricguocmu.
Wofuŋ e sisipiric sasaware sabecguekac, e hâcne jujuge sabeckeekac.
Fahare racmuo â fisi focmuo Wofuŋzi sabecguekac, dameŋ ʒi eekaczi erahuc juzokac sanaŋ.
Ʒiŋuc nazapie bubiaŋ manapo: “Wofuŋte ufuŋko fenaŋ!”
Joe Jerusalem, kike‐nâŋeczi gore sacmaŋko âterâ domambeŋ.
Joe Jerusalem, hae sâko heɋârerâ bakicne, saczi râreckeme qâzuc jaha qiŋ herâ ŋekac.
Eme kikefuŋ birine birine feeŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋte kikefuŋ biri, Israe musanaŋkecnekicne irec sâko, Wofuŋte ʒâŋe daŋge mumuteŋ ecneniŋte.
Ira hâcne dâŋgiere eri ŋeŋe ŋerakac, Dawidire kikefuŋ jaŋere eri ŋeŋe.
Jerusalem haeo wama foocte numuniŋ: “Gore ejareekac jaŋe juhâmonʒepieŋ.
Sacmaŋgao wama fohuc juzejec; ficmaŋgao jujuhâmo fozejec.”
Âgo qomâfâc‐nane jaŋere erâ ʒiŋuc mukopac: “Sacmaŋgao wama fozejec.”
Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec ufuŋ‐ticnere erâ jujuhâmo fua‐gareocte numukopac.
Sambâŋ eri ŋeŋegao ŋekomec; gorao qâhâŋnerâ fipe hefakac.
Manakic, kiŋaŋ motec jaŋe bomboŋ‐jeŋicte meo ʒâŋe fieŋgopieŋ, â kiŋaŋ naru jaŋe ŋokac bomboŋ‐jeŋicte meo ʒâŋe fieŋgopieŋ, iŋuc hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋectao, buuruc enâreocte ʒâŋe fihuc jueŋgopeneŋ.
Buuruc enârec, o Wofuŋ, buuruc enârec! Ŋiczi suŋgiŋ‐nâpokupie gapec‐nâpokac.
Ŋic ʒoraŋne jaŋere âke sisicte â ŋic maŋfefe jaŋere mururuc dâŋte mâretec gapepec‐nâpokac.
“Wofuŋ e sacfozic mi enâreme muzac weniŋuc fua‐nârezac?” Israe, go muc!
“Ŋic jaŋe wiac enâreniŋte faharembiŋko Wofuŋ e sacfozic mi enâreme muzac,
ine aaric‐jeŋicte ʒoc bâruŋkewecko, ɋâricne jaha ɋâcnâponʒapiŋ hâcne.
Erâ rumizi âke tarac‐nâpozac, â opâ sâronezi âke utuc‐nâpozac.
Erâ opâ sâko jaŋe qâuruc‐nâpo‐fârenʒapiŋ.”
Wofuŋ e micsiec‐jeŋicko mi râec‐nâpowecte muteŋ bâteŋ ecnezo!
Wipezi wosaŋeŋ bapa wisecneekac, iŋuc wise‐jarembeŋ. Wiwitic tâcnewec, rambaŋko juŋgopeneŋ.
Babafic‐nâŋec i Wofuŋzi jukac, sambâŋ â mâreŋ bâfuac‐jofawec eki hâcne.
Wofuŋtao roweckeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe Zioŋ tiki iŋucne; Zioŋ e qiriŋ mi qahuc qiŋ herâ ŋesanaŋkekac.
Tikizi Jerusalem hae orâŋkerâ ŋeraŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ e iŋuc hâcne ŋicfâcne orâŋ‐jopaekac; ʒiŋuczia ekaczi eraʒihuc juocmu sanaŋ.
Tiŋne juju ŋic mâreŋ kâdoc qajarekicne i ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ gunuzi mi soŋaŋkehuc juzejec. Wemocte? Ine tiŋne juju ŋic jaŋe wâc eebapa sindaŋne ba bâuac enʒipiŋte.
O Wofuŋ, go ŋic biaŋne uruc jauŋ ejarezemec, maŋjeŋicko siocmâc fokac jaŋe hâcne.
Â qâsoriehuc hata hehesicne âteeŋgopieŋ, ine Wofuŋ goki sâqocne bapa jaŋehec bârâriec‐jopazemec. Israe kikefuŋko wama fozejec!
Wofuŋzi Zioŋte kâpâcwâru ŋic bârisiec‐jopaocmuo manapene guŋ manaŋgopeneŋ tinac eocmu.
Dameŋ ira gâgâwizi micnâŋec fusucmaocmu, â ʒeridâŋzi nameŋ‐nâŋec sakareocmu. Dameŋ ira qâpuc jaŋe muniŋmu: “Wofuŋzi wiac fekicne ejarekac.”
Wofuŋzi wiac fekicne enârewec, irec bubiaŋ manaŋgopeneŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go juju hata‐nâŋec herisiec, Ʒoaŋ Mâreŋko opâ hata herisieekic iŋuc.
Kiohuc hândâŋ tieeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ʒeri ehuc fârine qa roro eniŋmu.
Kikione ejareha wiac ukicne amecke raeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ʒâhec fârine defisihuc ʒeri bari eeŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋzi fic mi baocmuo, fic bapa ŋic jaŋe gie bâipieniŋmu; Wofuŋzi hae mi soŋaŋkeocmuo, ruc bapa ŋic e maŋgâŋ guŋɋâri juocmu.
Ŋoŋe maŋgâŋ furicte faharerâ, gie baŋafeku guŋdameŋ jâurueŋgopieŋ, erâ ʒâic gie bahuc nânâ nâeŋgopieŋ. Jorocfâcne jaŋe baku guŋ fohapie jareekac.
Oi, ŋokâ guru sâko i Wofuŋte taha biaŋ, â bifuŋkonec fuakicne jaŋe wiac furi sâko.
Socɋâri juhuc ŋokâ bâfuac‐jopakicne, i ʒikaŋic tepe motec focnekac irec sâc.
Moc e i mi basaocmuzi sâcne juhâmoocmu, â râsifâcne jaŋehec tomao dâŋgie bahuc mi qurutuaocmu.
Wofuŋ araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, ere hata âtehuc juniŋmu jaŋe hâcne.
Megezi gie bacmu irec fârine fuame nâcmu, erâ bubiaŋ manahuc sâcne juhâmocmu.
Ŋonâŋgezi ficmaŋgao domaocmu, i waiŋ jâcne fâri rarau iŋucne. Ɋiefâcge jaŋe oliwa gitecne iŋucne teboge râreckerâ ŋeraniŋmu.
Manakic, ŋic moc Wofuŋ araŋ bacneocmu, erao jambuŋ iŋuc hâcne fuaocmu.
Wofuŋ e Zioŋko juhuc jambuŋguzejec! Jerusalem haere mazuc mâriri i jufecmu sâc ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne honezemec!
Ŋosafâcge fuapie honec‐jopazemec! Israe kikefuŋko wama fozejec!
Israe e ʒiŋuc muzejec: “Jaŋe ɋieonecteaŋ fific guguriŋ enarembiŋ,
jambomac, jaŋe ɋieonecteaŋ fific guguriŋ enarembiŋ, erâ sifu mi bawahacnumbiŋ.
Jaŋe râpe‐naneo mâreŋ bâbâfâuc gie bahuc wâcʒora bâfua rambiŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋ e ine tiŋne jukacte ŋic sindaŋne repa‐jeŋic hetâcnewec.
Zioŋ qaisockeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe sasawa qurutuarâ risie ranʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe ficbupuo qinʒiŋ fua fuahuc hâmo ɋaŋac eekac irec sâc enʒepieŋ.
Qinʒiŋ i moczi moc mi qaeŋgopieŋ, me bara bulimakao mi gumec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Â sicne fotâc eeŋgopieŋzi ʒiŋuc mi mueŋgopieŋ: “Wofuŋte jambuŋzi faigao feoc, Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo jambuŋguŋgopeneŋ.”
O Wofuŋ, no nombâŋ fâhâŋnao juhuc, go wira‐garekopac.
Wofuŋ, go marac fânâŋ‐nane manac, owackehuc wâsicgukopac irec hazec râec!
O Wofuŋ, go kiŋtofa bajunʒaŋ muzac, mozi moc sanaŋkerâ domazac?
Erâ gorao ine kiŋ bebehe fokac, i ŋic nâŋe go araŋ bagarenaŋte.
No Wofuŋ woŋeckekopac, maŋnanezi woŋeckekac, erâ mumupaŋ dâŋticne worickekopac.
Maŋnanezi Wofuŋ woŋeckekac, ine ŋafe soŋaŋ jaŋe ʒoaŋ hejâpeeŋgopieŋ i sirickehuc hejâpekopac, i sirickehuc hejâpekopac.
Israe kikefuŋ, go Wofuŋ worickec. Wofuŋtao hâcne aki anonoc fokac, erao kiwiric roro ɋârâŋnea fokac.
Eme e Israe kikefuŋte kiwiric rome kiŋticne tara‐fâreocmu.
O Wofuŋ, no maŋfefe mi juekopac, â pepec ʒâŋe mi fiekopac. No dâŋ wiac qame hukicne, nore sâc jâurukac, i mu bâuac mi eekopac.
Mâcne, no maŋnane bâmâteŋkehuc bâniniŋkepo. Kogoc moŋ nâ gapec eku neŋgocte qicko foekac, maŋnanezi irec sâc niniŋkerâ fokac.
Israe kikefuŋ, Wofuŋ worickezemec, ʒiŋuczia erâ tofamâc erahuc juzemec.
O Wofuŋ, Dawidizi neneŋ qâqâreŋ ehuc juwec, irec manasuzemec.
Ehuc Wofuŋ, Jakobore Tâpiri wânʒâŋ go hâcne, mujomire‐garehuc ʒiŋuc muwec:
“No qoruc boze‐naneo biac mi fepemu, â fofo‐naneo biac mi waha fopemu;
no sifu mana takirehuc, ʒâŋe‐nane guŋ sakarecnepemu;
ehuc qanaŋ Wofuŋ gore ŋeŋe hae bâfuapemu, Jakobore Tâpiri wânʒâŋ go hâcne fic moc bagarepemu.”
Oc, nâŋe Efarata haeo, qorac tapa katapare biŋe manambeŋ, erâ Jara wâneŋko fârine bâfuambeŋ.
Ajoc, warepie ficticnao raʒinaŋ, kike‐ticnere ââtesiŋko dunduŋ hunaŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go fahare ŋeŋemana haegao rac, go â tâpiri qorac tapa katapage.
Taha bapafâcge jaŋe tiŋne juju hepie huzejec, â mitiŋicfâcge jaŋe ʒeri bari enʒepieŋ.
Kiŋaŋŋicge Dawidire erâ, wokemaŋ ruacnemeŋ e mi suŋgiŋkezemec.
Wofuŋzi Dawidi dâŋ moc mujomirecnewec, dâŋ fârine, moc mi bebehene: “Gore bifuŋkonec fuaniŋmu jaŋeraonec moc eri ŋeŋegao hepe ŋeocmu.
Ŋokâfâcge jaŋe ʒâʒâfic â sâcmutâc dâŋnane qazu‐jarepemu i baju sanaŋkeniŋmuo ine ŋokâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe iŋuc jaha, eri ŋeŋegao tatara tâmiric ŋehuc junʒepieŋ.”
Jâmbomac Wofuŋzi Zioŋ rowosâewec, ehuc ira ŋeŋe juju eocte ʒiŋuc muhuc sakarewec:
“Ŋeŋemana hae sanaŋ‐nane ʒine hâcne, irec enarekacte ʒira ŋec juc epemu.
No nânâ rowaŋ‐ticne fehuc jambuŋkepemu, hapetacfâcne gumec‐jopape nâ gapec eniŋmu.
Taha bapafâcne tiŋne juju hejarepe huocmu, â mitiŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe ʒeri bari eniŋmu.
Ira hâcne Dawidi tâpiri‐ticne mupe fahareocmu, ŋicwofuŋ wokemaŋ ruacnehuc tatamac bâmockecnepo.
Râsifâcne mimi qaqa hejarepe huocmu; ere qizecko ine eridu sâsârehuc ŋeocmu.”
Honeniŋ, qoqomâzi qâturerâ ŋec juc eniŋmu, izi wiac aŋacne â bubiaŋnehec i!
I wokemaŋ furi sâko qizecko hoŋkepie, irecnec qâniniperâ waha mecʒâwâ mâmâc ruacneekac iŋucne; Aroŋte mecʒâwâo wahawec hâcne, erâ irecnec fotâcnerâ, waha ŋaqi‐ticne mecqaŋeŋne mâmâc ruacnewec.
Erâ wâc Herimoŋ tikire titikuc iŋucne, izi waharâ Zioŋ tiki mâreŋ bâgunuckeekac. Ira hâcne Wofuŋzi jambuŋ fârine jareocte muwec, juju fofo sanaŋ hâcne.
Ajoc, Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋic sasawa ŋoŋe Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ, ŋafeo Wofuŋte ufuŋko domaeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe hâcne.
Meŋeŋic tiri ufuŋkopec bâfeŋneniŋ, ehuc Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ.
Wofuŋ e Zioŋko juhuc jambuŋguzejec, sambâŋ â mâreŋ bâfuac‐jofawec eki hâcne.
Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ! Wofuŋte ʒâŋe mumbiaŋkeniŋ, Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋicfâc, ŋoŋe mumbiaŋkeniŋ.
Wofuŋte ufuŋko domaŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe, Anutu‐nâŋec ufuŋ‐ticnere hae ʒoŋao domaŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe!
Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ, Wofuŋ e uruc jauŋhec. Ʒâŋe‐ticne gae hecneniŋ, e miriŋ biaŋhec.
Wofuŋ e Jakobo sakarewec hâcne, Israezi ere eocte bâwosâewec.
No manakopac, Wofuŋ e kâcɋene; Wofuŋ‐nâŋeczi nemu sasawa siric‐jopakac.
Wofuŋ e wiac maname sâckeme sâc eekac, sambâŋko â mâreŋko, hâwecko â ʒâkâŋ ʒorao.
Eki hâcne mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaonec karorac ejareme fahareeŋgopieŋ, erâ hoere ɋuŋ bâbâric bâfuaekac, â rowaŋ‐ticnaonec mâŋâŋ soreme wareekac.
Eki hâcne Aigita ŋic mârâc fufuafâc‐jeŋic jopawec, ŋic mecne, qowi mecne.
E Aigita mâreŋ gorao mâsi qâreŋ bâfuahuc Farao â ŋicfâcne imac‐jopawec.
E ŋicguru bocjaha qâtâtiec‐jopawec, â ŋicwofuŋ tâpirihec qâhâmoc‐jopawec:
Sihoŋ, Amori ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ, Ogo, Basaŋ mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ, â Kanaaŋ mâreŋte ŋicne ŋicne.
Erâ mâreŋ‐jeŋic merâfâc muhuc Israe ŋicfâcne jarewec.
O Wofuŋ, gore ʒâŋe tofamâc foraʒiocmu, Wofuŋ, go ʒâŋe biŋege mimiŋzi ɋâric foocmu.
Wofuŋ e ŋicfâcne jaŋere dâŋ dopeckeocmu, â kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne busâqoc mana‐jareocmu.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere nemuɋâŋ i siliwa â gol, ŋicmezi ba akic ekicne.
Mic fojareha dâŋ mi mueŋgopieŋ; ʒâŋe fojareha wiac moc mi honeeŋgopieŋ.
Hazec fojareha sifu dâŋ mi manaeŋgopieŋ; erâ micjeŋicko nokafe moc mi fokac.
Ɋâŋ bâfuaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ɋâŋ iŋucne enʒepieŋ! Erâ ɋâŋte‐mamanac jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha.
Israe kikefuŋ, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ! Aroŋte kikefuŋ, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ!
Lewi kikefuŋ, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ! Wofuŋ araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ!
Zioŋkoneczi Wofuŋ muteŋkezo! Jerusalem haeo juekac e hâcne muteŋkezo! Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkeniŋ!
Wofuŋ daŋge âzâcneniŋ, e uruc jauŋ‐ticnehec; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Nemu jowarurâ Anutu jukac e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Ŋicbomboŋ jowarurâ Wofuŋ jukac e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Buc mâsi sâko baekac e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Mamanaheczi sambâŋ bâfuawec e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Opâ faio mâreŋ qaratiewec e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Tatamac kâcɋene bâfuawec e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Hae fureha guriŋne baocte ʒoaŋ bâfuawec e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Hae ŋafeha guriŋne baniŋte mosa bâpiŋ bâfuac‐jopawec e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Aigita mâreŋko mârâc fufuafâc‐jeŋic jopawec e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Ŋondeŋ‐jeŋickonec Israe kikefuŋ baefuc‐jopawec e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Mesanaŋ‐ticne bâfeŋnerâ iŋuc ejarewec e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Hâwec Bâbâroŋ bâfâuckeme jajahec epic e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Israe guru ejareme ʒâʒâŋiŋ jaha fotâcnembiŋ e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Farao â ŋicfâcne Hâwec Bâbâroŋko sâroc‐jopame humbiŋ e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Ŋicfâcne mâreŋ tuhuo jowac‐jopame rambiŋ e daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Ŋicwofuŋ kâcɋene jopa jâpec ejarewecte daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Ŋicwofuŋ ʒâŋe biŋehec qâhâmoc‐jopawecte daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Amori ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ Sihoŋ qawecte daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Basaŋ mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ Ogo qawecte daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Erâ mâreŋ‐jeŋic merâfâc muhuc ŋicfâcne jarewecte daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Israe mâreŋ merâfâc râcnewecte daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Eki hâcne qarâ suriŋne juhapene manasuc‐nâpowec; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Erâ râsifâc‐nâŋec jaŋere meonec batarac‐nâpowec; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Eki hâcne wiac jujune sasawa nânâ gumec‐jopaekac; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Sambâŋte Anutu daŋge âzâcneniŋ; oc, aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ fokac.
Babe mâreŋte opâ mecnao, Zioŋte manasuhuc kiohuc ŋembeŋ.
Ehuc kakikic jâc tieŋnao, gita‐nâŋec ɋetickepene domawec.
Ocna rucnâpombiŋ jaŋe gae henaŋte munârembiŋ, bâbâʒâicfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe ʒeri enaŋte ʒiŋuc nâzâmbiŋ: “Zioŋte gae‐ŋeŋic moc hepie mananaŋ.”
Nâŋe weniŋuc Wofuŋte gae moc mâreŋ jabao juhuc henaŋmu?
Jerusalem, gore nikecnuocmuo ine mefâre‐nane hâmo ɋaŋac ezejec.
Go mi maŋguhuc jupemuo, me Jerusalem haere manape aŋacte micne sâko mi eocmuo ine nameŋ‐nanezi ŋaŋarac‐naneo bohotazejec.
Wofuŋ, go Jerusalem hae imackembiŋ dameŋ ira Edomte ɋâricfâc jaŋe wiac embiŋ, i manasu‐jarezemec. Ʒiŋuc wirambiŋ: “Qâropieniŋ, qâropieniŋ, wâtuŋne herisie‐fâreniŋ!”
Babe rune, ima qaqa! Moczi nâŋe enâremeŋ ijaha egareocmu e juhâc qâhâmozejec!
Moczi kogocfâcge qânâo hefâuc‐jopaocmu e juhâc qâhâmozejec!
Wofuŋ, no maŋ hâcbuc jaha daŋge gazape, nemu jaŋere maio mumumbiaŋ gae hegarepe.
Tiri ufuŋgaopec dunduŋ hupe, ehuc aki anonoc â jauŋ fârigere erâ, ʒâŋege mumbiaŋkepe. Go ʒâŋege â mumupaŋ dâŋge bafaharetec, wiac sasawa qâhuckerâ fewec.
No wira‐garepo dameŋ ira micnaneo romeŋ, â maŋte tâpiri bâsoka‐naremeŋ.
Mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ sasawa jaŋe micdâŋge manambiŋte, Wofuŋ, go mumbiaŋgunʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe Wofuŋ wiac bapa‐ticnere gae henʒepieŋ; Wofuŋte eri tatamac i fekicne sâko hâcne.
Wofuŋ e fekicnezi wahakicne hone maiŋ ejareekac, maŋfefe ine taicko hone tarac‐jopaekac.
No ʒârâ hâriŋ maŋko juhape, go juju‐nane hone kitaŋ eekic; râsifâc‐nane imaŋ gomaŋ‐jeŋicte, mege sicnehuc aka hejareekic; mefâregezi baficnuekac.
Wofuŋ, go bâbâpiaŋ giege norao bataracmu. O Wofuŋ, aki anonocge fofo sanaŋ foekac; go megere gie mi behezemec.
O Wofuŋ, go gufu koparic enareekic â mana jaŋgeŋnuekic.
No waha ŋeekopac me fahare domaekopac i manaekic, â mamanasu‐nane taicko juhuc hone taraekic.
Hata juju‐nane â fofomana‐nane ba esâic ecneekic, â wiac eenanere kâuc moc mi baekic.
Â dâŋ moc nameŋ‐naneo mi fua tâcneha, Wofuŋ, goki biac paŋʒâic jaha mana jaŋgeŋkeekic.
Go râpe‐naneo â mai‐naneo somâcnuekic, â mege nore faio râeekic.
Wiac irec fuŋne qame hukicne ehuc siricnukac, â fekicne jâmbâŋ ekacte manapemurâ qatataŋnekopac.
No Mâroge beherâ wena moc razapo? Me ʒâŋe maige wisecnehuc wena moc soŋkezapo?
Sambâŋko fezapoo go ira maicnunʒaŋ; hâmoc haeo hu fozapoo go bâfuacnunʒaŋ wâc.
Furic qânikiŋte fakec faio raku, hâwec qaŋeŋnao fisi ŋezapoo,
ine ira wâc gore mezia jowa qataŋ enarezac, â mefâregezi bâwâzâŋnuzac jaha.
No ʒiŋuc muzapo: “Duŋdapâczi bârârâŋnuoc, â tatamac forakac i ŋafe‐fâreoc,”
eme sifu dapâczi gore maio dapâc mi ezac, â ŋafe i honetec ʒoaŋ jaha ezac; dapâczi gorao tatamac hawari eekac hâcne.
Goki hâcne râpe hândâŋ‐nane ba akic emeŋ, neŋgoc bumaŋko go gahac fuŋkerâ qâhâcnumeŋ.
Go mâsi qâreŋge qeŋ bipinehecte daŋge gazakopac, wiac bapage qame hukicne! Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane wâc hone jaŋgeŋkeekic.
Me kike‐nanere fuŋnere kâuc mi baekic; no soŋsoŋko bâfuacnukicne, neŋgocte bumaŋko basaricnukicne.
Ʒâŋegezi juju‐nanere bâpâŋ honemeŋ, â gore papiao mâreŋko juju‐nanere ʒoaŋ gie bapa dameŋ i qanaŋ birickekicne fowec.
O Anutu, mamanasugere manape furi sâko ekac! Ʒare‐ticne i qeŋ bipinehec!
Wemocko wosezapo, moŋgeŋ sirickekac! No mana ɋâɋârerâ gohec jaha jupemu.
O Anutu, go ŋic sindaŋne jopanʒaŋ me, â socnânâ jaŋe behecnu ranʒapiŋ me!
Jaŋe hâcne ʒaubac egareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe sâqocne maŋkehuc pepec egareeŋgopieŋ.
O Wofuŋ, gore takic‐jopaekic i jaŋere mi takicnukac me? Â go musuacgueŋgopieŋ jaŋere mi mamakâcnukac me?
Jaŋere mamana sâqoc fârine bajukopac, mana‐jarepe râsifâc‐nane eŋgopieŋ.
O Anutu, ba esâic enarerâ maŋnanere fuŋne manac, esâicnurâ mamanasu‐nane mana jaŋgeŋkec.
No hata hehesicnao juzipore hone wosâc ec, erâ juju sanaŋte hatao jowacnuc.

O Wofuŋ, go ŋic sâqocne jaŋeraonec bataracnuc, ŋic qac momorihec ʒika‐jeŋicte ŋezicnuc.
Jaŋe maŋjeŋiczi dâŋ repicne birickeeŋgopieŋ, ehuc ʒika ʒuʒuhuc bâiŋneeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe nameŋ‐jeŋic qâteckepie homare ʒuŋe iŋucne eekac, â bipic‐jeŋicte maŋnao qotâre micopâ fokac.
O Wofuŋ, go ŋic sindaŋne mejeŋicte sabecnuc, ŋic qac momorihec ʒika‐jeŋicte ŋezicnuc; jaŋe kike‐nane qataraniŋte manasuŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic maŋfefeheczi bitiŋ râe‐narembiŋ, uficko jowapemurâ fâre‐narembiŋ, â hatamecko nombâŋ ronarembiŋ.
No Wofuŋ âzâcnekopac: Go Anutu‐nane; o Wofuŋ, go wira wâwâsic‐nanere hazec râec!
O Wofuŋ, nore Wofuŋ, babafic sanaŋ‐nane, go ʒika dameŋko sabecnumeŋ.
O Wofuŋ, ŋic sindaŋne aŋac‐ticnere fârine mi fuazejec, wiac sâqocne maŋkekac i fâri fideteŋ mi ezejec.
Râsi jaŋe orâŋnuhuc pepec erâ mi bawahacnunʒepieŋ, micdâŋ‐jeŋic hehesicne izi ŋerisierâ rune imac‐jopazejec.
Mutec ʒoc kinezi waha qofac‐jopazejec; tuŋjopatec nombâŋko hurâ mocwâc mi faharenʒepieŋ.
Mumusoriŋ ŋic moczi mâreŋko sanaŋkerâ mi domazejec; ŋic qac momorihec e ʒârâ ʒâpâzi ɋeŋfâfâc jaha dope‐ticne qatarame waha qarâ fozejec.
No manakopac, Wofuŋzi ŋic qarâ suriŋne dâŋticne dopeckeocmu, â ŋic hapetac ŋezickehuc dâŋticne mutiŋkeocmu.
Jâmbomac, ŋic tiŋne juju jaŋe gore ʒâŋe daŋge âzâcneniŋmu, â ŋic siocmâc jaŋe maigao ŋec juc eniŋmu.
O Wofuŋ, no wâsicgukopac, fâro jaha ware baficnuc; wira‐garepe marac fânâŋ‐nane manac.
Nunumu‐nanere manatec hosâc âsu biaŋ ezejec, me bâbâfeŋke‐nanezi ŋafere taha bâzi egarezejec.
O Wofuŋ, go micnane rucbapa râecnezemec, bipic‐nanere motâc soŋaŋkehuc juzemec.
Maŋnanezi wiac sâqocne mi worickezejec; eebapa sindaŋne ba bâuac mi ezepac; gie hehesicne baeŋgopieŋ jaŋehec ââgo ehuc jaŋeraonec wiac aŋacne ro nâc ezore takicnuzejec.
Ŋic tiŋne juekaczi urucko qa bâtiŋ me mu bâtiŋ enarezejec, ŋic sindaŋnezi ine qizec‐nane tokic mi ruacnezejec. Nunumu‐nanezi eebapa‐ticne sindaŋne ʒuʒuhuc jaha râsi ecneekac hâcne.
Eme dâŋ mumutara jaŋere meo râec‐jopapie ʒiŋuc mananiŋmu: Wofuŋte dâŋ i fârine.
Qânâ hefâuckerâ dâkâne behepie iriŋ tierâ foraekac, siec‐jeŋic iŋuc behepie hâmoc haere motâcko foocmu.
No ine ʒâŋe gorao fihuc jukopac, o Wofuŋ Anutu; dapeŋgao soŋkekopac, juju‐nane hâmoc mi behecnec.
Sâqocne bapa jaŋe nombâŋ bitiŋ enareeŋgopieŋ, irec sabecnuzemec.
No furu juhape, ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe jaŋacne bitiŋzi kicjopazejec.

Hahaŋne bahuc Wofuŋ dâŋ âzâcnekopac, erâ wâc hahaŋne bahuc Wofuŋ wâsickekopac.
No mu huacbuc‐nane guruckecnekopac, ehuc ʒârâ hâriŋ‐nane mufuacnekopac.
No maŋnane gâckehame goki ine fuŋne‐nane manakic; no hatagâŋ juekopacko jaŋe kamierâ bitiŋ râe‐narembiŋ.
No fâreopec fihuc ruc bakopac, eme moczi hone ʒâŋitac mi enarekac; sâsâoc moc bâfuapemurâ basakopac; moczi hone jauŋ mi enarekac.
O Wofuŋ, no wâsicgukopac, ehuc mukopac: “Huec‐nane go, juju mâreŋte kâdoc‐nane go.”
No betaŋkekopacte wâwâsic‐nane manac. Jâpecnueŋgopieŋ jaŋere meonec bataracnuc; jaŋe sanaŋkehuc siricnuŋgopieŋ.
Kâpâcwâruonec firuecnuc, eme ʒâŋege muafeckepemu. Goki ehâmo‐narecmuo ine tiŋne jaŋe fisi orâŋnuniŋmu.
O Wofuŋ, go nunumu‐nane manac, wâwâsic‐nanere hazec râec! Jauŋ fârigere sâcko micnaneo roc, erâ tiŋnegere sâcko.
Kiŋaŋŋicge nohec dâŋgie mi bac, ŋic jujune moczi maigao bahacmâc mi jukac.
Jei, râsizi maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanere wosaŋeŋ bakac, juju‐nane qâfieme mâreŋko waha qakac, dapâcko râecnume esecne hâmombiŋ jaŋere sâc ekopac.
Irec maŋnane gâckeme bu ʒaʒamaŋ‐nane fâuckezo ekac.
No dameŋ raŋɋanere manasukopac, gie bameŋ i maŋzi honehuc ŋekopac, wiac ebac emeŋ irec manatâc qâtâc ekopac.
No menane goraopec sicnekopac, maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi gore ecnekac, i mâreŋ hahaŋkekicnezi opâre hâmoekac irec sâc.
O Wofuŋ, go micnaneo biac rozemec, maŋnane omaekac! Ʒâŋe maige mi bâsoŋke‐narec, nombâŋko hueŋgopieŋ jaŋe iŋucne ezipore.
No gorao roweckekopacte furictea aki anonocge nowatuzemec. Hata jupemurâ mukic i qazu‐narezemec; maŋnane gorao sâsepe hefakac.
O Wofuŋ, râsifâc‐nane jaŋere meonec bataracnuc; no gore dapeŋko soŋkekopac.
Go nore Anutu jukicte gore micrereŋ qazu‐narec; Mâro biaŋgezi hata wâwâneŋko jowacnuzejec.
O Wofuŋ, go ʒâŋegere erâ juju‐nane hone kitaŋ ecnezemec! Tiŋnegere sâcko ʒârâ hâriŋkonec baefucnuc.
Erâ uruc jauŋgere sâcko râsifâc‐nane bâsirowec‐jopazemec, â fific bacnueŋgopieŋ jaŋe omaec‐jopa‐fârezemec, noni gore kiŋaŋ qaqa jukopacte.
Wofuŋ qânâ sanaŋ‐nane e muteŋkezo; e menane juju giere baafeckewec, â memotec‐nane ʒika qazucnewec.
E tâpiri‐nane â huec‐nane, e hae sanaŋ‐nane â babafic‐nane, maro‐nane â rorowec‐nane; e ŋicne ŋicne rurumaŋ‐naneo râec‐jopawec.
O Wofuŋ, go ŋic e wemo macticnere manasucnehuc, hone maiŋ ecneekic?
Ŋic e nokafe iŋucne sawa mac, â juju dameŋ‐ticnezi nâkumuc fotâcneekac irec sâc.
Wofuŋ, go sambâŋ bârâriehuc tara wahac; tiki bâuac‐jopatec hosâc qaniŋ.
Râsifâcge bâbâric wicke‐jarehuc bâtâtiec‐jopac, tepe motecge qâtâcne‐jaretec siŋsaŋ qaniŋ.
Faicnec mege sicnerâ ro baefucnuc, rumi sâkoonec fâre surucnuc, ŋic jabane jaŋere meonec bataracnuc.
Jaŋe micbipic‐jeŋiczi gibioc dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ, â mefâre‐jeŋiczi eeatuc gie baeŋgopieŋ.
O Anutu, no gae ɋâricne moc hefua‐garepe, gita mucne teŋ izi musi bagarepe.
Goki ŋicwofuŋ ʒikao sasanaŋ tahac‐jopaekic, go kiŋaŋŋicge Dawidi ʒikao ŋezickeekic.
Go hâmoc bâbâfua ʒika irec ŋezicnuzemec, â ŋic jabane jaŋere meonec bataracnuzemec; jaŋe micbipic‐jeŋiczi gibioc dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ, â mefâre‐jeŋiczi eeatuc gie baeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋokâfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe socɋâri juhuc ʒareŋsuc iŋucne soka fienʒepieŋ, â otâfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe erific tuturuŋnao metâ qâreŋ heeŋgopieŋ, iŋucne fuanʒepieŋ.
Rowaŋfic‐nâŋecko nânâ mâriri fusucmame dameŋne dameŋne nâhuc junʒepeneŋ. Lamafâc‐nâŋec jaŋe sawe mâririackerâ, tauseŋ â teŋ tauseŋ fuanʒepieŋ.
Bulimakaofâc‐nâŋec jaŋe kiwechec erâ, motec sahac furu biaŋne rohuc junʒepieŋ; hae ʒoŋa‐nâŋecko ki uu moc mi fuazejec.
Ŋicguru wiac iŋuc fua‐jareme juhâmoniŋmu, Wofuŋzi Anutu jujareha juhâmoniŋmu hâcne.
Anutu‐nanezi Wofuŋ Sâko jukic, go muafecgupe, ehuc ʒâŋege tatara tâmiric mumbiaŋkepe.
No ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne mugac bagarehuc jupe, ehuc ʒâŋege tatara tâmiric muteŋkepe.
Wofuŋ e kâcɋene, e muteŋ bâteŋ ecnezo, sosoka‐ticnere sâc mi mamana tarane.
Mimiŋne jaŋe ɋâric guru wiac bapage musoka‐jare rahuc junʒepieŋ, â mâsi sâkoge mutaniŋke‐jarenʒepieŋ.
Ʒai ʒonʒoŋgere eri tatamac biaŋte, â mâsi bapagere manatâc qâtâc ehuc juzepac.
Ŋiczi gie qeŋ bipinehec baekic irec muc manac enʒepieŋ, â noni kâcɋene sâko jukic irec dâŋ binaŋ epemu.
Jaŋe uruc jauŋge guru fufusuc irec biŋe munʒepieŋ, â tiŋnegere ʒeri gae henʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ e aki anonoc â buuruchec, kimbeŋ biac mi qaekac â maŋjauŋ‐ticne fekicne.
Uruc jauŋ‐ticnezi mâmâc sâko rocjopaekac, â meqâreŋfâcne busâqoc mana‐jare‐fâreekac.
Wofuŋ, go meqâreŋfâcge jaŋe ʒeŋgoma daŋge gazanʒepieŋ, â mitiŋicfâcge sasawa jaŋe muteŋgunʒepieŋ.
Guriŋ bapagere eri tatamac muafeckenʒepieŋ, â tâpirige musokanʒepieŋ.
Eme gie tâpirihec baekic izi mâreŋŋic hazec‐jeŋicko huzejec, â guriŋ bapagere eri tatamacte kâuc mi banʒepieŋ.
Gore uucmaŋ i uucmaŋ fofo sanaŋ, â guriŋ bapage i mimiŋzi ɋâric fohuc juocmu. Wofuŋ e dâŋticne siocmâc sasawa, â wiac bapa‐ticne sasawa i qâreŋ biaŋ.
Wofuŋ e rândiŋkezo eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe dopec‐jopaekac, â badapec‐jopakicne jaŋe bafaharec‐jopaekac.
Ʒeŋgoma gorao ʒâŋe fieŋgopieŋ, goki dameŋ mukicnao nânâ jarecmurâ.
Go mege baratieekic, eme wiac jujune sasawa jaŋe nâ aŋac eku gapec‐jopaekac.
Wofuŋ e tiŋne juhuc wiac‐ticne ebac efâreekac, e uruc jauŋhec juhuc gie‐ticne bafâreekac.
Wofuŋ e mu wâwâsic ecneeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe sasawa fisi qâtec‐jopaekac, siocmâc mu wâwâsic ecneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne.
Araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ sasawa jaŋe wiac mueŋgopieŋ i jareekac, wiwira‐jeŋic manarâ bafic‐jopaekac.
Wofuŋ e maŋzi jauŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe sasawa hone maiŋ ejareekac, ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine bâsirowec‐jopaekac.
No micnanezi Wofuŋte ʒâŋe biŋe mutaniŋkezepac, â mâreŋŋic sasawa jaŋe tiri ʒâŋe‐ticne tatara tâmiric muteŋkehuc junʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ! Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane go Wofuŋ muteŋkec!
No jufehuc jupemu sâc Wofuŋ muteŋkezepac, juju fonareocmu sâc Anutu‐nane ʒeri gae hecnezepac.
Ŋoŋe ŋicbomboŋ jaŋerao mi roweckenʒepieŋ, mâreŋŋic jaŋe bafic‐nâponiŋte tâpiri mi fojarekac.
Nokafe‐jeŋic qândâŋkeme wândocko risieniŋmu, eme ʒoaŋ ijaha dâŋ birickembiŋ i omaeocmu.
Moc e Jakobore Anutuzi babafic‐ticne ekac, â Wofuŋ Anutu‐ticne worickehuc juekac, ŋic iŋucnezi sâcne juhâmoocmu.
Wofuŋ eki hâcne sambâŋ mâreŋ bâfuac‐jofawec, erâ hâwecmaŋko wiac fokac i bâfua‐fârewec, erâ hec hetikic tâmiric siocmâc juekac.
Eki ro waha âte ejarekicne ŋezic‐jopaekac, â tac qararacne nânâ bâfua‐jareekac; Wofuŋzi niŋgiŋ‐jopakicne firuec‐jopaekac.
Wofuŋ e ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ ʒâŋe fifi bacjopaekac, Wofuŋ e badapec‐jopakicne bafaharec‐jopaekac, Wofuŋ e tiŋne juju maŋjauŋ ejareekac.
Wofuŋ e ŋic jabane hone soŋaŋ ejareekac, â hozec bekâ dope hutuŋ ejareekac; ŋic sindaŋne mamana biri‐jeŋic ine hesifuckeekac.
Wofuŋ e guriŋ bapa gie bahuc juocmu sanaŋ; Zioŋ gore Anutu e mimiŋzi ɋâric iŋuc erahuc juocmu. Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ!
Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ! Anutu‐nâŋec gae hecnezo i aŋacne; mumuteŋ gae hezo i biaŋkekac â sâcke‐hâmokac.
Wofuŋ e Jerusalem hae sesuc heɋârekac, e Israe ŋic bâtâtiec‐jopakicne i qânusuc‐jopakac;
bu heheric ejarekicne jaŋe bâmunaŋ‐jopakac, ehuc wicjeŋic foŋke‐jarekac.
E bâpiŋ ʒare‐jeŋic musanaŋkeekac, ehuc ʒâŋe‐jeŋic mufâreekac.
Wofuŋ‐nâŋec e kâcɋene, â tâpiri sâko‐ticnehec, erâ mamana tara‐ticne sâc tâmiric.
Wofuŋ e bawahac‐jopakicne dope hutuŋ ejareekac; ŋic sindaŋne ine qâfiec‐jopame mâreŋko waha foeŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ daŋge gae bâfeŋnerâ hecneniŋ, Anutu‐nâŋec gitazi musi bacneniŋ!
E karoraczi sambâŋ bâsâockeekac, ehuc mâreŋte biŋe hoe bâfuaekac, â tikio qinʒiŋ mume wefuekac.
E qowi nânâ bâfua‐jareekac, kâec kâec motecne jaŋe wiracnepie iŋuc jaha ejareekac.
E becâsic tâpiri‐ticnere aŋac mi manaekac, â ŋicte tâpiri wânʒâŋ hone aŋac mi eekac;
e araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ â aki anonoc‐ticnere mamanac jueŋgopieŋ, jaŋere ine aŋackeekac.
Jerusalem, go Wofuŋ mumbiaŋkec, Zioŋ, go Anutuge ʒeri gae hecnec!
E haesacgere motâc basanaŋkewec, â haemaŋgao ŋokâfâcge jambuŋ‐jopawec.
E mâreŋgere mao wama bâfuawec, â nânâ fâri hândâŋne gumeqiŋguekac.
E mumutâc dâŋticne mâreŋko soreekac, eme micdâŋ‐ticnezi ʒocnehec gasackeekac.
E sinou soreme kateŋ iŋucne wahaekac, erâ wâc aisi uucne ʒafe tinac tieekac.
E aisi hândâŋne qânâ hândâŋ tinac wickeekac, eme mâmâteŋ fuame mozi sanaŋkerâ domaocmu?
Erâ ekizia mupaŋkeme aisi hândâŋzi opâ eekac, â mâŋâŋ‐ticne soreme opâ fusinehec fisiekac.
E dâŋticne Jakobo mufuacnewec, Israezi dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋticne manawec.
Ŋicguru gâcne jaŋerao iŋuc moc mi ewec, irec jaŋe mumutâc dâŋticnere kâuc baeŋgopieŋ. Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ!
Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ! Sambâŋkonec Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ, faic irec, ŋoŋe muteŋkeniŋ.
Aŋelofâcne sasawa, ŋoŋe muteŋkeniŋ, momori gurufâcne, ŋoŋe muteŋkeniŋ.
Mosa ʒoaŋ, ŋohe muteŋkeniŋ, bâpiŋ tamaeŋgopieŋ sasawa, ŋoŋe muteŋkeniŋ.
Sambâŋte sambâŋ, go muteŋkec, sawao opâ fokic, go muteŋkec.
Jaŋe Wofuŋte ʒâŋe muteŋkeniŋ, eki hâcne mume fuambiŋ.
Eki hâcne ŋeŋe sanaŋ ŋeniŋte râec‐jopawec; eki aka hejarewec i mi huhuckene.
Mâreŋkonec ŋoŋe Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ: Hâwecte oâ sâko â hâwec ʒâkâŋ sasawa ŋoŋe;
ʒoc â aisi hândâŋ, sinou â hâweŋ, erâ mâŋâŋ micticne reŋkeekic go;
tiki â mâreŋ facne sasawa, jâc hândâŋnehec â jâmâzâc sasawa;
qowi sasawa, kâteo â haeo, homa gisic â wipe fakec‐ŋeŋichec;
mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ â ŋic gurune gurune, ŋicbomboŋ â mâreŋte mumutara ŋic sasawa;
ŋicʒeŋoŋ â ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ, ŋic ŋokac qizec â naru motec!
Jaŋe ʒeŋgoma Wofuŋte ʒâŋe muteŋkeniŋ; ere ʒâŋe mocjaha fekicne sâko, eri tatamac‐ticnezi mâreŋ â sambâŋ qâhuckekac.
E kikefuŋfâc‐ticne ʒâŋe biŋe‐jeŋic bafaharewec; izi mitiŋicfâcne ʒeri mumuteŋ bâfua‐jarekac, Israe ŋic bufuŋfâcne jaŋe hâcne. Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ!
Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ! Wofuŋ gae ɋâricne moc hecneniŋ, mitiŋic jaŋere tutumaŋko mumuteŋ gae hecneniŋ.
Israezi bâbâfua‐ticne bubiaŋ manacneoc, Zioŋte ŋokâfâc Wofuŋ Sâko‐jeŋic ʒeri ecneniŋ!
Gae wohuc ʒâŋe‐ticne mumbiaŋkeniŋ, woŋgâŋ qahuc gitazi musi bacneniŋ.
Wofuŋ e ŋicfâcne mana‐jareme biaŋkekac, ere maio rumerâ juŋgopieŋ jaŋe sasanaŋzi eric‐jopakac.
Mitihec jaŋe ʒeri ehuc kiwaeniŋ, fofo‐jeŋicko fohuc mumuteŋ gae heniŋ.
Micjeŋicko Anuture mumumbiaŋzi fooc, â mejeŋiczi sâqe bune râpene mictara i baniŋ.
Ehame ŋicne ŋicne jaŋerao kiŋ babatara, â ŋic gurune gurune jaŋerao okac babazu fuazejec.
Â ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic kâpâcwâru bacjopazo, fekicnefâc‐jeŋic aeŋzi basanaŋ‐jopazo.
Jaŋerao mumutara dâŋ qanaŋ qâreŋkekicne irec fârine bâfuazo. Izi mitiŋicfâcne sasawa jaŋere eri qoqonaŋ eocmu. Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ!
Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ! Anutu tiri ufuŋ‐ticnao muteŋkeniŋ! Sambâŋ sanaŋ‐ticnao muteŋkeniŋ!
Wiac bapa‐ticne tâpirihec irec muteŋkeniŋ! Ʒai ʒonʒoŋ‐ticne qeŋ bipinehec irec muteŋkeniŋ!
Qeŋ qacnehuc muteŋkeniŋ! Kulele â gitazi musi bacnehuc muteŋkeniŋ!
Gae woŋgâŋ ecnehuc muteŋkeniŋ! Qiroŋ mimi ŋokac ficnehuc muteŋkeniŋ!
Kaŋkuc qa fânâŋ ehuc muteŋkeniŋ! Kaŋkuc fânâŋ sâko qahuc muteŋkeniŋ!
Nokafe hehuc juŋgopieŋ sasawa, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ! Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ!
Dawidire ŋokâ Salomo, Israe ŋicwofuŋ hâcne, ere muqâqiŋ dâŋ sasawa ʒi.
Muqâqiŋ dâŋ ʒizi maŋɋârâŋ â mumutâc dâŋ biaŋne hone mana tarac enaŋte â dâŋ qame hukicne wâc mana taranaŋte bafic‐nâpoocmu.
Dâŋ izi hâcne weniŋuc erâ mamanahec juzo â siocmâc tiŋne â biaŋne juju irec fuŋne sâcne qazu‐nâreocmu.
Ehuc ŋic babititicne jaŋe jujure fuŋne jaza mutâc eha maŋfârihec eniŋmu â ŋic socɋâri jaŋe wâc mamana â maŋɋârâŋ qazu‐jareocmu.
Ehame maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe dâŋ ʒi wose manac epie mamana‐jeŋic fua ɋârâŋkeocmu â maŋfânâŋhec jaŋe wâc bafic‐jopahuc juju hata biaŋnao jowa qataŋ ejareocmu.
Ehame muqâqiŋ dâŋte fuŋne â ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋere dâŋ herâricne â suŋsuŋne i sâcne mana taraniŋmu.
Wofuŋ araŋ babacne izi maŋɋârâŋte hata fufuŋkene ekac. Ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe maŋɋârâŋ dâŋte manapie wawahane eha mananiŋte takic‐jopaekac.
Motec‐mae, go mamacgezi dâŋ gaza qazuc eekac i manazemec, â neŋgocgezi dâŋ muekac irec hazec wâc râezemec.
Iŋuc ehuc jahere dâŋte manatec qizecgere eridu â upegere qoqonaŋ ezejec.
Motec‐mae, go ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe esâicgupie mi docke‐jarezemec.
Jaŋe ʒiŋuc mecne gazaniŋmu: “Ajoc, go waretec ra ŋic maŋhumuc e me e bâfuarâ qâhâmonaŋ. Nâŋâc ŋic biaŋne fuŋne tâmiric mâc qâhâmonʒepeneŋ.
Jaŋe biaŋne â ɋiɋicne juhapie bâfuac‐joparâ jopapene hâmorâ foranʒepieŋ.
Ehame moneŋ mafa wiac‐jeŋic fuŋne fuŋne bâfuarâ ficnâŋecko râe guruc epene fusucmazejec.
Irec ware qâtec‐nâpoc, eme wiac fiuc ronaŋmu sâc bâtâc banʒepeneŋ.”
Motec‐mae, go ŋic iŋucne jaŋehec mi juhuc dic bajarezemec.
Jaŋe wiac hehesicne eniŋte ʒoɋac erâ ʒikare goŋgoricne heeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ʒoaŋko wipe jaŋe honec‐jopahapie ufic fârepie mi jowaniŋmu.
Ŋic iŋucne jaŋe burec ehuc jaŋe jaŋacne bitiŋ râepie kicjopaocmu.
Ŋic ʒika qahuc wiac fiuc roniŋmu jaŋe ʒikare biŋe jaha eniŋmu, fiuc roro jaŋe iŋuc hâcne fua‐jareocmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, maŋɋârâŋzi ŋic baafec‐jopaekac jaŋe hata upeo me hae ʒoŋao maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ.
Erâ haesac motâcko â ŋic tutumaŋko maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ musokaeŋgopieŋ wâc.
O ŋic mutuc matacne! Ŋoŋe mutuc‐ŋeŋic i mo dameŋko moc omaeocmu? Me mamana sâkore mu âke sisic ehuc mamana qiqikiŋ i wezimucko moc beheniŋmu?
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe mu bâtiŋ eŋarepie dâŋjeŋic mananʒepieŋ, jaŋe hâcne uŋ sawaŋ biaŋne eŋarehuc ŋoŋe wâc mamanahec eniŋte dâŋ ŋazaeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe wira hefârec eŋarembiŋ, ehame ŋoŋe ine dâŋjeŋicte hazec mi râembiŋ, â mejeŋic sicne‐ŋarepie mi rombiŋ.
Ŋoŋe uŋsawaŋ dâŋjeŋic qâsuahuc mu bâtiŋ eŋarezo mupie takic‐ŋopame qikiŋnembiŋ.
Irec sisipiric fua‐ŋareme honec‐ŋoparâ gâwie‐ŋareniŋmu, â wiac hâhâwicnezi fai‐ŋeŋicko feme mu âke sisic eŋareniŋmu wâc.
Wiac izi mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋnehec iŋucne fisi‐ŋarehuc ʒâic fâro â ʒârâ hâriŋ bâfua‐ŋareme iŋuc hâcne eŋareniŋmu.
Iŋuc fua‐ŋareme maŋɋârâŋte wira wâwâsic epie arictac eocmu. Ehuc ira me ira maŋɋârâŋ bâfuaniŋte basa‐bipieniŋmu hâcne.
Ŋoŋe dameŋ sâc maŋɋârâŋte manapie wiac wawahane eha Wofuŋ araŋ bacneniŋte takic‐ŋopame qikiŋnembiŋ.
Ŋoŋe uŋsawaŋ dâŋjeŋicte moc mi eŋareha mu bâtiŋ eŋarezo mupie râŋgeŋkembiŋ.
Irec ŋoŋe juju bapa‐ŋeŋicte fârine rohapie wiac ebac embiŋ irec okacne fisi‐ŋareocmu hâcne.
Ŋic mamana tâmiric jaŋe maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ qikiŋneeŋgopieŋte hâmoniŋmu, â ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe manabâc tâmiric kosa jueŋgopieŋte sipirickeniŋmu.
Maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ mana maŋ eocmu ŋic eki ine hâhâwic tâmiric wama faio juhâc qâhâmoocmu.
Motec‐mae, no dâŋ gaza qazuc ekopac i manazemec, ehuc wiac i me i ecmurâ gazape mi nikecguzejec.
Go maŋɋârâŋ dâŋte hazec râezemec, ehuc mana taracmurâ esâickehuc giene bazemec.
Erâ mamana saric â maŋzi wiac mamana tara fua‐gareocte nunumu gie bazemec.
Go siliwa moneŋ me boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ duckekicne bâfuacmurâ babasa gie banʒaŋ, irec sâc jaha giene batec mamana fua‐garezejec.
Iŋuc ecmuo ine Wofuŋ araŋ babacne irec fuŋne mecne, â Anuture fuŋne i mâmâc mana taracmu.
Maŋɋârâŋ i Wofuŋzi tahac‐nâpoekac, erâ mamana saric â mamana tara i eraonec jaha ware‐nâreekac.
Eki hâcne ŋic tiŋne â siocmâc bafic‐jopaekac â ŋezic‐jopaekac.
Ehuc, ŋic âgofâc‐jeŋic bafic‐jopahuc dâŋjeŋic mutiŋne‐jareeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe sapec‐jopaekac, â e jahacnao qohotahuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe hone soŋaŋ ejareekac.
Go maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ manacmuo ine wiac biaŋne â tiŋnere hata hone taracmu, ehuc irec sâcko ebac ehuc jucmu.
Erâ go maŋɋârâŋhec jaha jutecne mamanagezi bubiaŋ bâfua‐gareocmu.
Mamana saric â maŋzi wiac mamana tara izi ŋezicguocmu,
