ehuc wiac hehesicne ezicte aka hegareocmu. Ehame ŋic dâŋ kosa muhuc bâbâsifuc bâfuaeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao ra qohotazicte hata hebâzicke‐gareocmu.
Ŋic iŋucne jaŋe dapâcte hatao juniŋte tiŋne jujure hata râpeckeeŋgopieŋ,
erâ wiac hehesicne ehuc bubiaŋ manaeŋgopieŋ, â wiac sindaŋnere aŋac bajueŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe hata‐jeŋic keke poricne â hatagâŋ‐jeŋic i bac bâŋoricne.
Go maŋɋârâŋhec jucmuo ine ŋokac sâqocnezi dâŋ wokemaŋzi wiac ehuc esâicgume sâcne sanaŋkerâ dâŋticne hetapâickecmu.
Ŋokac iŋucnezi ŋowe‐ticne maŋzi beheekac, ehuc mumupaŋ dâŋticnere wâc nikeckeekac.
Go ŋokac ere ficko moc racmuo ine hâmoc haere hatao racmu hâcne. Manakic, ere ficko rara izi hâmockicne jaŋere mâreŋko rara irec sâc ekac.
Ŋic moczi ŋokac e iqickeocmuo ine mocwâc mi risieocmu, ehuc juju hata mocwâc mi bâfuaocmu.
Irec go ŋic biaŋne jaŋere itiroc bâjâpehuc tiŋne juzemec.
Ŋic tiŋne â bahacmâc jaŋe hâcne mâreŋko dameŋ ʒora jufeniŋmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine Anutuzi hofâ qinʒiŋ iŋucne mâreŋkonec unuc‐jopahuc bâsirowec‐jopaocmu hâcne.
Motec‐mae, no dâŋ gaza qazuc eekopac irec moc mi nikecguzejec, â wiac ebac ecmurâ mutâcne‐gareekopac i manasuhuc juzemec.
Dâŋ wiac qazu‐gareekopac i bajucmuo ine dameŋ ʒora juhâc qâhâmocmu.
Go âgo miriŋ â siocmâc juju i moc mi râpeckezemec, ehame izi hâcne upegere qoqonaŋ â maŋgere fosiŋ erâ fozejec.
Go iŋuc ecmuo ine Anutu mecne â ŋic jaŋe mecne mâmâc mana‐garepie biaŋkeocmu.
Go gahacne mamanao mi roweckehuc Wofuŋte dapeŋko soŋkerâ juzemec.
Erâ wiac sasawa ebac ehuc Wofuŋte manasuzemec, eme eki juju hata fâretiŋ jaha gaza gowatuc eocmu.
Go mamanagere manatec fefene boc mi ezejec, ehuc wiac hehesicne râpeckehuc Wofuŋ mocjaha araŋ bacnezemec.
Go iŋuc ecmuo ine izi hâcne nârâ bibiaŋ irec sâc egareha wicge somieocmu â ʒâicge wâc mâteŋkeocmu.
Giegaŋgao nânâ monʒaŋ wiac fuaekac sâc irecnec biaŋne gâcne rorâ bâzi rikehuc Wofuŋ muac baafec ecnezemec.
Go iŋuc ecmuo ine nânâficgezi fufusuc jaha foocmu, â waiŋ giegao mazuc mâriri fuame ficge hefusetec tiwâne foocmu.
Motec‐mae, Wofuŋzi bâtiŋgume manatec wawahane mi ezejec.
Wofuŋ e ŋic moc jauŋkezo murâ ba bâtiŋ ecneekac; e mamac moczi ŋokâ‐ticne qa bâtiŋ ecneekac irec sâc eekac hâcne.
Ŋic moc maŋɋârâŋ â mamana tarahec juekac ere manape ʒerine ekac.
Wiac izi hâcne siliwa â gol jahere sâc sirickehuc wiac furi sâko jâmbâŋ ekac.
Maŋɋârâŋzi qânâ furi sâko irec sâc wâc jâurukac, â wiac i me i bajuzo muekic izi irec wahamicne.
Maŋɋârâŋzi juju dameŋge bâʒoraocmu, ehuc moneŋ mafa â ʒâŋe biŋe wâc bâfua‐gareocmu.
Maŋɋârâŋhec juocmuzi bubiaŋ â wama faio juocmu.
Maŋɋârâŋhec juniŋmu jaŋe juhâc qâhâmoniŋmu, ehame izi hâcne juju fârine bâfua‐jareocmu.
Wofuŋ e maŋɋârâŋhec jukacte mâreŋte hobeteŋ râewec, â mamana tara focnekacte qânikiŋ qaratiewec fokac.
E maŋɋârâŋheczi mume opâ jaŋe fisieŋgopieŋ, â karoraczi opâ hoŋkeme mâreŋko hoe wahaekac.
Motec‐mae, go maŋɋârâŋ â mamana tarage soŋaŋkehuc juhaŋtec moc mi sifucke‐garezejec.
Wiac izi hâcne juju biaŋ â jujuhâmo bâfua‐gareocmu.
Go iŋuc ecmuo ine hatagao sâcne racmu â kikege wâc mi fâfâcguocmu.
Go wiac irec me irec mi hâwicguha waha guŋ biaŋne fohaŋtec hae fureocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere wiac hâhâwicnezi mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋnehec iŋucne fisiekac, irec sâc jaha ututuŋ fisi‐garezacte mana mezac mi ecmu.
Wofuŋzi hone soŋaŋ egareha sâcne jucmu, eki hâcne wiwiticko fezicte kikege sapeckeocmu.
Go tâpiri fogarekac sâc ŋic qarâ suriŋne jaŋe ehâmo‐jarezemec.
Go miŋecgac jaha ŋic âgoge bafickezo manasukicko tomâckore biŋe mi râetec fozejec.
Me ŋic âgoge moc gorao roweckehuc maŋfuŋgao juekac e râsi ecnehuc wiac sâqocne moc mi ecnezemec.
Ŋic moczi wiac hehesicne i me i mi egareha fuŋne tâmiricko ehec dâŋ mu qaqatarac mi ezepirec.
Ŋic ʒâʒâicne tâpiri‐jeŋicte iiŋguuŋ mi ejarezemec, ehuc jaŋe wiac eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha mi ezemec.
Wofuŋzi ŋic hehesicne jaŋe hâcne qaisoc‐jopaekac â ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ine âgo ejareekac.
E ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere fic hae sâweckeekac â ŋic tiŋne jaŋere ine jambuŋkeekac.
Ehuc ŋic mu âke sisicne jaŋe gâwie‐jareekac â maŋhuhuŋ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine mana biaŋ‐jopaekac.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec eniŋmu â ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe ine mimi busâqoczi fai‐jeŋicko feocmu.
Motecfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe mamac‐ŋeŋic noni wiac ŋaza qazuc eekopac irec hazec râerâ mana hâmoniŋ, ehuc maŋzi mamana tara bâfuanʒepieŋ.
Wiac qazu‐ŋareekopac i biaŋne sasawa, irec manasuhuc junʒepieŋ.
No neŋgoc mamac jahec‐nane jahere motec wârâŋne mocsâkoa juhape
mamac‐nanezi wiac qazu‐narewec. Ehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc naza jujec: “Dâŋ gazaekopac sâc irec ninikec moc mi bâbâfua manasuhuc juzemec. Erâ sâcmutâc dâŋnane mana rereŋ ehuc sâcne juhâc qâhâmocmu.
Go maŋɋârâŋ â maŋzi wiac mana utuckehuc mamana tara i bâfuazemec, ehuc dâŋ gazaekopac i mi qâsuazemec.
Go maŋɋârâŋ mi râpeckecmuo ine izi hâcne sapecguocmu, â mana maŋ ecmuo ine soŋaŋguocmu.
Manakic, go maŋɋârâŋhec ecmurâ ʒoɋac sâko ezemec, ʒoɋac izi hâcne maŋɋârâŋhec jujure fufuŋkene ekac. Go wiac irec me irec mâcne, maŋzi wiac mamana tara irec manatec furi sâko eha bâfua‐jâmbâŋkezemec.
Maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ mana maŋ etec izi ʒâŋe biŋe sâko bâfua‐garezejec, â maŋzi hâpo heâroŋ ecnetec eri qoqonaŋge eocmu.
Go iŋuc etec eri hendiŋ â eriduge eocmu hâcne.”
Motec‐mae, go dâŋnanere hazec râec, ehuc dâŋ gazaekopac sâc manatec fârine eha bajuhuc dameŋ ʒora jufezemec.
No maŋɋârâŋte fuŋne gaza gowatuc epo, ehuc siocmâc jujure hatao jowacgupo.
Irec go hatagao rahaŋtec wiac moczi aka moc mi hegareocmu â gasackerâ racmuo ine kikege wâc mi fâfâckeocmu.
Wiac qazu‐garekicne irec manasuhuc juzemec, â mamana bâfuameŋ izi hâcne jujuge dopeckeekacte biaŋne soŋaŋkezemec.
Go ŋic hehesicne jaŋere hata mi âtezemec â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere itiroc wâc mi bâjâpezemec.
Go jaŋere hata râpeckerâ dic bacnehuc wiac hehesicne mi ezemec, iŋuc ehuc gahacne hatao ʒuhuckerâ razemec.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe wiac hehesicne mi eniŋmuo ine guŋ sâcne mi foniŋmu, â ŋic moc mi bâʒâickeniŋmuo ine guŋɋâri jaha foniŋmu.
Wiac sindaŋne â ʒâʒâicne ebac ee izi hâcne nânâ opâ‐jeŋic eekac.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋere hata i furic oŋa rarac iŋucne, oŋa rarac i ʒoaŋ wefume fuŋkerâ mâreŋ tamae rahuc hae fure‐fâreekac.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere hata ine dapâc qisiric iŋucne, irec jaŋe wiac izi me izi kike‐jeŋic fâfâckeme waha jopaekac i mi hone taraeŋgopieŋ.
Motec‐mae, go hazec râe‐hâmohaŋtec dâŋ gazape manazemec.
Go dâŋnanere ninikec moc mi bâfuahuc maŋzi mana sakac ezemec.
Moc e dâŋnane mana tarahuc bajuocmuo ine izi hâcne nârâ bibiaŋ‐ticne ehuc juju bâfuacneocmu.
Go maŋge soŋaŋkezemec, izi hâcne juju bâbâfuagere hobeteŋne ekac.
Erâ go burecdâŋ moc mi muzemec, ehuc mumusifuc â eeatuc dâŋ wâc mi bajuzemec.
Go dunduŋ dadape fihuc mâcne, ʒâŋe dândâŋne fihuc wiac maicgurâ fokac i honezemec.
Go wiac moc ezo murâ mana‐hâmohuc etecne fârine biaŋne fuaocmu.
Ehame hata hehesicne qikiŋnerâ tiŋne hatao âtehuc ŋifec me ŋifec qâsorierâ raʒic wefuc mi ezemec.
Motec‐mae, go hazec râehuc maŋɋârâŋ â mumutâc dâŋnane manazemec.
Go iŋuc ecmuo ine weniŋuc erâ juju biaŋne bâfuazo i mana taracmu, ehame dâŋmumugezi mamanagere fuŋne mutaniŋkeocmu.
Manakic, boe sau ŋokacte dâŋzi baŋac iŋucne aŋacnehec eekac, e micticnezi wokemaŋ dâŋ muʒiziwehuc muekac.
Irec go qanaŋ dâŋticnere manatec aŋacne eocmu, ʒâhec ine gorao kegoc hâtâne me sâqe bune râpene mictara irec sâc eocmu.
Ŋokac iŋucnezi hâmoc haeo jowacgu raocmu, e hata ira hâcne raekac.
Ŋokac e jujure hataoa mi juekac, erâ go hone manac mi ecnehaŋtec qâsorierâ kosa barasa raekac.
Motec‐mae, no dâŋ gazakopac ʒi manarâ moc mi nikecguzejec.
Go ŋokac iŋucne dic bacnehuc ficticnere motâc moc mi maickezemec.
Sifu ecmuo ine ʒâŋe biŋegezi ŋic gâcne jaŋere maio wawahane eha socɋâri jaha juhuc ŋic jaŋere meo fetec mi akicguniŋmu.
Ine hâcne, ŋic furune jaŋe moneŋ mafa wiacge gowac rohapie gie bahuc wiac hure‐fâremeŋ i gâcne jaŋere biŋe eocmu.
Wiac iŋuc fua‐gareme hâmozo erâ kio huse ehuc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mucmu:
“Jei, no mu bâtiŋ enarezo mupie wemocte qatarapo, ehuc uŋdâŋ‐jeŋic mi manapo?
No qaqazufâc‐nane jaŋere dâŋ wemocte qikiŋnepo â ŋic wiac naza qazuc embiŋ jaŋere dâŋte hazec wâc wemocte mi râepo?
No iŋuc ehuc ŋic ŋondeŋko juhape ututuŋ jaha mimi qaqa fai‐naneo fezo ewec.”
Go gahacne ŋonâŋtao qohotahuc maŋge erao sawa râetec fozejec.
Ŋokac gâcne jaŋehec juhuc naru motec bâfuac‐jopacmu jaŋe âgo egarehuc sâcne mi baficguniŋmu.
Naru motecfâcge jaŋe soka‐fârerâ ŋic furune moc mi bafickehuc go gahacne sawa baficguhuc junʒepieŋ.
Irec go ŋokacge naru ʒeŋoŋ jaha rotec ŋonâŋge ewec ehec bubiaŋ faio jaha juzepirec.
Ŋokac e gâjoŋ sereŋ hawari biaŋ â totoc fara tacnezi âgo jauŋ egareme bubiaŋ manazemec, erâ e gore ecneha jauŋ bacgume manatec sâckezejec.
Motec‐mae, go wemocte ŋokac kosa jujune erao maŋge râetec foocmu, me wemocte ŋic mocte ŋokac hâpohuc susu‐ticne ro fâre ecmu?
Manakic, Wofuŋzi wiac ebac eekomec i hone‐fâreekac, ehuc hata raekomec sâc ruc bagarehuc juekac.
Ŋic sindaŋne e sâqocne‐ticnezi wiwitic ecneha ira feme kiekac.
E jahacnao bâbâtiŋ gie sâcne mi baekacte hâmoocmu hâcne, â mutuc matacne juekacte ʒâŋeruŋko wâc huocmu.
Motec‐mae, go ŋic âgoge bafickehuc tofa‐ticne bazucmurâ moc mupaŋkemeŋ me?
Ehame go gahacne mumupaŋ dâŋzi bitiŋ egareha rocguwec me?
Motec‐mae, go iŋuc wiac moc fua‐gareme ŋic ere meo femeŋko ine gahacne sahac ŋezickecmurâ kecʒiŋuc ezemec: Go picpac jaha erao rarâ akicguocte numucnezemec.
Irec go hesacke furic ehuc guŋ mi fozemec.
Go wipezi eekac iŋuc ehuc bitiŋ heunuckerâ wisezemec, erâ beczi wosaŋeŋ bapa ŋic honerâ qârucnerâ wisehuc juju‐ticne bâfuaekac irec sâc ezemec.
Ŋic roroc qaŋqaŋne jaŋe fiu qoʒazaŋ jaŋere eebapa honerâ maŋɋârâŋ bâfuanʒepieŋ.
Fiu qoʒazaŋ jaŋe soŋaŋ micne me ŋicwofuŋ me guriŋ bapafâc‐jeŋic aricne,
erâ sifu hoemaŋ dameŋte manasuhuc nânâ wiac‐jeŋic ʒoaŋ dameŋkoa ro qâzuc eeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic roroc qaŋqaŋne e mo dameŋko ojoŋ juju‐ticne moc beheocmu? Me wezimucko moc faharerâ gie baocmu?
E ʒiŋuc hâcne muekac: “No me ʒâʒâfic qarâ guŋ piticne mac fope.”
E iŋuc muhuc guŋ fohame roroczi ʒikaŋic jaŋe iŋucne ututuŋ jaha fisicnerâ bawahaocmu.
Ŋic repic qapicne â sindaŋ hârindaŋne jaŋe gibioc dâŋ muhuc jueŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc esâic‐ŋopaniŋte ʒâŋe bazuc eŋareeŋgopieŋ â kikezi âte ʒifuŋ‐ŋopaeŋgopieŋ erâ mezi sâsâc eŋareeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc hehesic bâfuaniŋte maŋzi dâŋ manasu biric eeŋgopieŋ, ehuc doc bapa gie bahuc jueŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe iŋuc eeŋgopieŋte sisipiriczi ututuŋ jaha fisi‐jarerâ bâsirowec‐jopame mocwâc mi juniŋmu.
Wofuŋ e eebapa 7 kecʒiŋuc jaŋere maname mamakâcne eha râsi ejareekac: Pepec ʒâŋe fifi, micbipiczi wokemaŋ dâŋ mumu, ŋic bahacmâc qâqâhâmoc‐jopa, dâŋ repicne manasu biric ee, wiac hehesicne ezore fâro hata rara, dâŋgieo domahuc dâŋ muhasickerâ burec ee, erâ âgo ŋondeŋko juhuc iiriac â kikisâ bâbâfua.

Motec‐mae, go mamacgere sâcmutâc dâŋ mana rereŋ ehuc juzemec, erâ wâc neŋgocgezi wiac qazu‐garewec irec moc mi nikecguzejec.
Go dâŋjekic maŋgao râetec foha paŋʒâic jaha bajuzemec.
Ehame hata ira me ira racmurâ jowa qataŋ egarezejec, ehuc ŋafeo ŋezicguzejec â ʒoaŋko wâc baficguzejec.
Sâcmutâc dâŋjekiczi lambe iŋucne tamae‐garezejec, â mumutiŋ dâŋjekiczi juju hata biaŋne irec fuŋne gaza mutâc ezejec.
Sasec ŋokac jaŋerao qohotazicte me ŋokac gâcne jaŋere wokemaŋ dâŋzi bâdocguzacte jahere dâŋzi hâcne aka sâcne hegareocmu.
Ŋokac hawari‐jeŋic biaŋne izi mi woricguzejec, me ʒâŋe rârâqâc honecgupie ririfirerâ mi docke‐jarezemec.
Ŋic moc e hata ŋokac nânâ poroŋ mocjaha maczi furine bazo murâ baocmu, mâc boe sau gie bapazi ine juju‐ticne fârine sipiricke‐fâreocmu.
Go ʒocmimiŋ hâpohaŋtec ŋaqige akickeocmu me?
Me ʒoc kine fainao âtehaŋtec kikege mi ʒaocmu me?
Manakic, ŋic moczi ŋic mocte ŋonâŋhec foocmu e irec sâc fuacneocmu. Moc e iŋuc eocmuzi ʒâic manaocmu hâcne.
Ŋic moc e nânâre hâmohuc fiuc roocmuo ine ŋic jaŋe manacnepie boc mi sâqoreocmu.
Mocjaha, fiuc rohame izia bâfuaniŋmuo ine wiac irec furine râeha arec 7 eocte mucneniŋmu, e wiac focnekac sâc râe‐fâreocmu hâcne.
Ŋic moc e boe sau gie baekaczi maŋ mamanasu tâmiric juhuc jahacne juju sipirickeekac.
Ŋic e qahuc ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne bawahapie waha qaqane erâ juocmu.
Ŋokacte ŋowezi hâcne ŋic e manauŋkehuc okacne bazucneocte ʒoɋac sâko ehuc moc mi akickeocmu.
Ehame furine râcnezo mupie qikiŋneocmu, â wiac izi me izi aaric‐ticne wâc mi bâmâteŋkeocmu.
Motec‐mae, go dâŋ gazaekopac i manasuhuc juzemec, ehuc sâcmutâc dâŋnanere moc mi nikecguzejec.
Go sâcmutâc dâŋnane mana rereŋ erâ juhâc qâhâmocmu. Go ʒâŋe hândâŋge soŋaŋkeekic irec sâc jaha mu qaqazuc dâŋnane soŋaŋkezemec.
No dâŋ gaza qazuc eekopac i dameŋ sâc paŋʒâic jaha bajuzemec, ehuc maŋgao qâreŋketec fozejec.
Go maŋɋârâŋte manatec seŋgere sâc ezejec, â maŋzi wiac mamana tara irec manatec âgo fuŋfuŋge ezejec.
Jahe hâcne ŋic gâcne jaŋere ŋonâŋfâc jaŋerao mecne, â esâicguhuc wokemaŋ dâŋ egareeŋgopieŋ ŋokac i jaŋerao mâmâc razicte aka hegareekopirec.
No dameŋ mocko ficnaneo ŋehuc qâqâtâc kataŋko ʒâŋe fipe rawec.
Eme ŋicmotec socɋâri mamanasu tâmiric jaŋere ŋondeŋko motec mutuc matacne moc jume honepo.
E hata sâko fotâcnerâ hata ŋeŋehasicko boe sau ŋokac moc juwec irapec rarâ ere ficko fisiwec.
Erâ i hae ŋafeme dapâc foha iŋuc ewec.
Ehame ŋokac e mi fickonec waharâ bâfuazejec i! Ŋokac e hata ŋokac jaŋere rurufa â eri qoqonaŋ wiac iŋucne rojuwec, ehuc eesâic gie baocte mâsi fuŋne fuŋne ewec.
E mimi tâmiric hata sâkoo sisi hâhâŋ faio ifi aifi jaha rac warec ewec.
Ehuc doma qatara rarâ hata ŋeŋehasicko domawec, izi irecnec ra hata sâkoo domawec, izi rarâ wiac nareŋ gareŋ eere tomao domawec.
Iŋuc ehuc motec mutucne e honerâ izia hâpo mumuduc ecnerâ sasec ʒâŋe fihuc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“No miŋecgac qowi bâzi rikepacte qowi tiwâne fonarekac.
Irec no fickonec waharâ gore ʒâŋe fihuc juku bâfuacgukopac hâcne.
Manakic, no Aigita mâreŋkonec fofo qoruc erinehec i biac fofo‐naneo rumackepac.
Ehuc siŋsiŋ saŋkarac â ʒineŋ sâfânâŋ wiac âsu biaŋ i wâc biac râe‐fârepac.
Irec go biac waretec waha hâhâpoc erâ fohuc ʒeri bubiaŋ manahuc fohapere hae furezejec.
Ŋowe‐nanezi ʒira mi jukac, e ʒoricko rawec.
Ehuc moneŋ bocjaha amecke rawec, irec juku Sonda 2 tarame risieocmu.”
Ŋokac e iŋuc muhuc motec esâickeme wokemaŋ dâŋticnere dockewec.
Eme izia bulimakao qa hezuc eniŋte baraeŋgopieŋ, me qowi moczi bitiŋ mi hone tarahuc ututuŋ jaha raʒime kime foha
ŋic jaŋe fisirâ tepe moteczi murupie hâmoekac, irec sâc ehuc ŋokac bâjâpeme ficticnao fepic. E wipezi sisipiric fokac i mi mana tarahuc uficko jowaekac irec sâc jaha ehuc juju‐ticne omaeocmu i mi mana tarawec.
Irec motec‐mae, go hazec râe‐hâmohuc micdâŋ‐nane manazemec.
Go ŋokac iŋucnezi maŋ bâsifuc egareme hata‐ticne moc mi bâjâpezemec.
Ŋokac e ŋic bocjaha sipiric‐jopawec, erâ ŋic guru sâko bâdoc‐jopame hâmo‐fârembiŋ. Irec go ere ficko fecmuo ine hâmoc haere hatao racmu. Izi hâcne hâmoc haere hata bembeŋne ekac.
<range>
Maŋɋârâŋzi wirakac, â mamana tarazi owackerâ dâŋ mukac, irec hazec râerâ mananiŋ!
E tiki botâŋko mecne, hata sâko heririŋko mecne, â hata ŋeŋehasicko mâmâc domahuc iŋuc ekac.
Erâ hae mendâŋko â haesac motâcko wâc domahuc ʒiŋuc muhuc wirakac hâcne:
“O ŋicbureŋ, no ŋoŋe hâcne wira‐ŋarekopac, â marac fânâŋ‐nane i mâreŋ sâc ŋic ʒeŋgoma ŋoŋerao fuakac.
Maŋhumuc juŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe mamana bâfuaniŋ, â ŋic mutucne ŋoŋe maŋfânâŋhec eniŋ.
Ŋoŋe dâŋnane biaŋne i mana maŋ eniŋ, micnaneonec dâŋ wahaekac i tiŋne sasawa.
No dâŋ muekopac i fârine sasawa, â burecdâŋ ine qaisockeekopac.
No dâŋ jâmbomac sasawa muekopac, sioc â mumusifuc dâŋ ine mi eekopac.
Ŋic mamana tarahec jaŋe dâŋnane mana tiŋneeŋgopieŋ; â maŋ mamanasuhec jaŋe mana tara‐fâreeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋ siliware manapie omane eha dâŋnanere manapie fârine ezejec, erâ gol ɋaɋacnere wâc manapie wawahane eha mamana tara irec manapie furi sâko ezejec.
“Maŋɋârâŋ no qânâ furi sâko jaŋere sâc sirickeekopac, â wiac furi sâko i me i nohec sâc hehene mi eekac.
Maŋɋârâŋ no mamana tara‐nanehec, erâ mamana saric â mumutiŋ i wâc fonareekac.
Ŋic moc e Wofuŋ araŋ bacneocmuzi hehesic qikiŋneocmu no irec hâcne sahac fefe â penaroŋ, eebapa sâqocne â burecdâŋ i râpecke‐fâreekopac.
No mamana tara â tâpiri‐nanehec, irec dâŋ manasu biric erâ fârine wâc bâfuaekopac.
No ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe guriŋ bapa gie baniŋte, â ŋic fekicne jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋ biaŋne râeniŋte bafic‐jopaekopac.
Mâreŋte guriŋ bapa ŋic, gawamaŋ me ŋic ʒâŋe biŋehec jaŋe noni hâcne dopec‐jopahape gie‐jeŋic baeŋgopieŋ.
No maŋjauŋ enareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe maŋjauŋ jaha wâc ejareekopac, â wira basac enareeŋgopieŋzi bâfuacnueŋgopieŋ.
Norao hâcne mazuc mâriri â ʒâŋe biŋe, erâ mumutiŋ â jujuhâmo bâbâfuane fokac.
Noraonec wiac roniŋmu i gol ematauckekicne â siliwa ɋaɋacne irec sâc jâuruocmu.
No tiŋne jujure hatao raekopac, ehuc ŋic jaŋere dâŋ mutiŋnehuc mutaraekopac.
Ehuc maŋjauŋ enareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bafic‐jopahape mafa mâriri fua‐jarerâ ficjeŋic fusucmaekac.
“Wofuŋ e wiac sasawa moc mi fuarâ foha bâbâni no hâcne fuŋkerâ bâfuacnuwec.
E mârâc sasac jaha jâmbâŋ mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ moc mi bâfuahuc no hâcne râecnuwec.
Hâwec sâko me opâ ʒâŋe moc mi fuarâ foha no hâcne fuapo.
Tiki kâcɋene â piticne jaŋe ŋeŋe‐jeŋicko moc mi ŋehapie noni hâcne fuapo.
Anutuzi mâreŋ me jufu sesuc me mâreŋ qâhâcne huŋgaŋne mac moc mi bâfuaha no hâcne fuarâ jupo.
No fuarâ juhape Anutuzi sawa qânikiŋ râewec, â hâwec qaŋeŋne fâretiŋnewec.
Ehuc faic karorac qaratiewec â juwic hâwec sâko ʒâŋene bâmârâŋkewec.
Erâ no fuarâ juhape jaha mâreŋte hobeteŋne râehuc hâwec sâko fofo‐ticnao foocte mutaracnewec.
Ehame no ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne Anuture heririŋko ʒeri faio juhuc bubiaŋ bâfuacnepe mana‐nareme biaŋkewec.
Iŋuc enareme mâreŋte manape ʒerine ewec, â ŋic jaŋere wâc manape biaŋkewec.
“Irec ŋicmotecfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe dâŋnanere hazec râeniŋ, erâ dâŋ ŋazaekopac i mana rereŋ ehuc juhâc qâhâmoniŋmu.
Dâŋ ŋaza qazuc ekicne i mana hâmonʒepieŋ, erâ maŋɋârâŋhec juhuc mi qâsuanʒepieŋ.
No ŋic moczi kecʒiŋuc eocmu ere manape ʒerine eocmu: Dâŋnanere hazec râeocmu, me ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne ficmotâc‐naneo fisirâ motâc râpeo maŋɋârâŋ nore woŋec domaocmu.
Ŋic moc e no bâfuacnuocmuzi juju bâfuaocmu, ehame Wofuŋzi manacneme biaŋkeocmu.
Me ŋic moc e no qaisocnuocmuzi hâmocte aŋackeocmu hâcne.”
Maŋɋârâŋ e ficticne baocte wâtuŋ 7 âkendâŋne‐fârewec.
Erâ tiwâ bâzi bâmockeocte qowi moc qa hezuc ewec â waiŋ opâ‐ticne i wiac âsu biaŋneheczi bâsifuckewec, erâ wâc tela kasoŋ wiac râe‐fârewec.
Ehuc kiŋaŋ narufâcne jaŋe haetoŋko domahuc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc musokahuc muniŋte sorec‐jopawec:
“Ŋic ŋokac mamana tâmiric ŋoŋe wefuniŋ!” Â ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe wâc ʒiŋuc jazaekac:
“Ŋoŋe wefurâ nânâ‐nane â waiŋ opâ wiac âsu biaŋneheczi bâsifuckepac i nâ bac eniŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic ŋokac mamana tâmiric jaŋe behec‐joparâ maŋzi wiac mamana tara irec hata bâjâpehuc juhâc qâhâmonʒepieŋ.”
Go ŋic mu âke sisicne moc mu bâtiŋ ecnecmuo ine mimi qaqa faigao feocmu. Me ŋic hehesicne moc dâŋ mucnecmuo ine eki râsi egarehuc bâʒâicguocmu.
Irec go ŋic mu âke sisicne mu bâtiŋ moc mi ecnezemec, sifu ecnecmuo ine qaisocguocmu. Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec dâŋ mucnecmuo ine âgo egareocmu.
Go ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec dâŋ i me i moc âzâcnetec maŋɋârâŋ‐ticne soka sanaŋ eocmu. Me ŋic tiŋne moc dâŋ i me i âzâcne qazuc ecmuo ine mamana‐ticne soka ŋedâmârec eocmu.
Wofuŋ araŋ babacne izi maŋɋârâŋte hata fufuŋkene ekac. Go Tiri rune mana ʒakiehuc maŋzi mamana tara bâfuacmu.
Maŋɋârâŋzi jarage bafehuc jujuge bâʒoraocmu.
Manakic, go maŋɋârâŋhec jucmuo ine irec fârine biaŋne fua‐gareocmu, me maŋɋârâŋ râpecketec irec okacne ʒâic busâqoc fua‐gareocmu.
Wiac moc ʒâŋene mutuc matac e ŋokac mamana tâmiriczi mimi tâmiric jaha dâŋmarac sâko eekac ere sâc.
E ficticnere motâcko me haetoŋko ŋeŋerâ juekac.
Ehuc ŋic ŋokac hata‐jeŋic sâc rac warec eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc wira hefârec ejareekac:
“Ŋic ŋokac mamana tâmiric, ŋoŋe wefuniŋ!” Â ŋic mutucne jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazaekac:
“Opâ fiuc rokicne i nâpie aŋac ʒizine eekac, â nânâ poroŋ fiuc rokicne i wâc nâpie aŋac baŋacne jâmbâŋ eekac.”
Ŋic ŋokac eatuc‐jopaekac jaŋe, ira rarâ hâmonaŋmu i mi mana taraeŋgopieŋ, ehuc mârâc ira rambiŋ jaŋe biac hâmoc haeo humbiŋ, i wâc kâuc baeŋgopieŋ.
Motec moc maŋɋârâŋhec juocmu e mamac‐ticne bubiaŋ qacneocmu; â motec mutucnezi ine neŋgoc‐ticne ʒâic busâqoc bâfuacneocmu.
Wiac sindaŋne ehuc moneŋ mafa bâbâfua izi sâcne mi bafic‐nâpoocmu, bâmec bapa giezi ine hâmockonec batarac‐nâpoocmu.
Wofuŋ e ŋic tiŋne jaŋe nânâre hâmo sipiric eniŋte mi manasuekac, ehuc ŋic hehesicne jaŋe râsi ejarehuc buchâro‐jeŋic qame wahaekac.
Ŋic ojoŋnezi hapetac erâ juocmu, gie ʒoɋachec baocmuzi ine moneŋ mafahec eocmu.
Ŋic mamanaheczi qa roro dameŋ maickeme nânâ wiac qa roro eocmu, â moc e qa roro dameŋko guŋ foocmuzi ine wiac miminehec bâfuaocmu.
Ŋic biaŋnere faio wiac biaŋne jaha feocmu, â ŋic sindaŋne e maŋticnao ʒârâ foekac i dâŋticnezi tapa baekac.
Ŋic biaŋne jaŋe ehâmo‐nârehuc jumbiŋte manasuc‐jopaeŋgopeneŋ, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere ine biac nikec‐nâpoekac.
Ŋic mamanahec jaŋe mumutâc dâŋ mana maŋ eeŋgopieŋ, dâŋ racne mueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine sipirickeniŋmu.
Ŋic sioc tâmiriczi wama faio juhâc qâhâmoocmu, ŋic siochec ere fuŋne ine biac bataniŋkeniŋmu.
Ŋic moc e bahac hesoŋkehuc ʒârâ hâriŋ bâfuaocmu, â moc e wiac mocte maname sâqoreme mufuahuc wamare gie baocmu.
Ŋic biaŋnere dâŋzi jujure opâ ʒâŋe tinac eekac, â ŋic sindaŋne e maŋticnao ʒârâ foekac i dâŋticnezi tapa baekac.
Qaqaisoc eeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe ʒika bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic maŋjauŋhec jaŋe ine ŋic âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋere bahac hone qâoma eeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic mamanahec jaŋe dâŋ fârine jaha mueŋgopieŋ, ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe ine bâtiŋ‐jopazo.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe mamana sâko fua‐jareocte ʒoɋac sâko eeŋgopieŋ, ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe ine dâŋ mupie sisipiric fuaekac.
Ŋic mafa sâkohec e moneŋ mafa‐ticnezi bafickeekac, â ŋic qarâ suriŋne jaŋe ine hapetac juku sipirickeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic biaŋne e juju‐ticnere fârine jujuhâmo bâfuaekac, â ŋic hehesicne ine juju‐ticnere fârine sisipiric bâfuaekac.
Ŋic moc e mu bâtiŋ ecnepie mana maŋ erâ sâcne juocmu, â ŋic moc mu bâtiŋ ecnepie qikiŋnerâ hata qâsorieocmu.
Ŋic moc e burecdâŋ muocmuzi ŋic âgofâc‐ticne qaisoc‐jopaocmu, â moc e gupe micko âkec eocmuzi ine ŋic mutuc matacne erâ juocmu.
Sâqocne bâfuazo eeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe dâŋ bocjaha woseeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe ine dâŋ afecne sawa mueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic biaŋnere dâŋ i siliwa ɋaɋacne irec sâc, â ŋic sindaŋnere maŋ mamanasu izi ine wiac fâri tâmiric.
Ŋic biaŋnere dâŋzi ŋic ŋokac bocjaha bafic‐jopaekac, ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe ine mutuc‐jeŋicte erâ hâmoeŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋzi ŋic moc jambuŋkeme wiac fofo dunduŋ focneocmu, ehame ŋic e jahac ʒoɋac ehuc wiac moc ʒuhuckerâ bâbâfua i sâcne mi eocmu.
Ŋic mutucnezi wiac hehesicne ehuc aŋac manaekac, â ŋic mamanaheczi ine maŋɋârâŋte maname wiac biaŋne eekac.
Ŋic tiŋne e wiac irec me irec ecneocmu sâc bâfuaocmu, â ŋic sindaŋne e ine wiac irec me irec hâwickeocmu i hâcne fuacneocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe sisipiricte mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋneheczi ficne suec‐jopame siroweeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic sioc tâmiric jaŋe ine dameŋ sâc juhâc qâhâmoeŋgopieŋ.
Go ŋic ojoŋnezi gore gie moc baocte mi mucnezemec, e saŋeŋ me ʒamaŋ nâpene micsiec‐nâŋec ariweekac irec sâc, me ʒoczi hosâc‐nâpome ʒâŋe‐nâŋeczi hâhâtâweekac iŋucne.
Go Wofuŋ araŋ bacnehuc dameŋ ʒora jufecmu, ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine dameŋ‐jeŋic mi maickeha biac hâmoeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe wiac biaŋnere mamanac juhuc bubiaŋ faio jueŋgopieŋ, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine wiac irec me irec mamanac sawa jueŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ e ŋic bahacmâc jaŋe ŋezic‐jopaekac â ŋic hehesicne jaŋe ine bâsirowec‐jopaekac.
E ŋic tiŋne jaŋe juju‐jeŋickonec batac bawarec mi ejareocmu, ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine mâreŋ‐jeŋicko mi ŋehâmoniŋmu.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋere mickonec maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ sawa wahaekac, ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe nameŋ‐jeŋic ine hetâcne behec ezo.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe dâŋ biaŋne mueŋgopieŋ, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine dâŋ simbiŋne mueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋemâc bâbâfuare sâc sâcti qâtiri bajueŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe Wofuŋzi qaisoc‐jopaekac, â ŋemâc bâbâfuare sâc sâckoa bajueŋgopieŋ jaŋere ine maname sâckeekac.
Ŋic sahac fefe jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mimi qaqa ejarehuc bawahac‐jopaekac, â ŋic maŋhuhuŋ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine maŋɋârâŋ bâfua‐jareekac.
Ŋic biaŋne jaŋe siocmâc juju‐jeŋiczi jowa qataŋ ejareekac, ŋic otec keŋgoŋne jaŋe ine eeatuc‐jeŋiczi bâsirowec‐jopaekac.
Moneŋ mafazi dameŋ sâkoo sâcne mi ŋezic‐nâpoocmu, siocmâc juju‐nâŋeczi ine hâmockonec batarac‐nâpoocmu.
Nâŋâc siocmâc junaŋmuo ine juju‐nâŋec fâretiŋ jaha foocmu, ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine jaŋacne jujuzi bawahac‐jopaocmu.
Ŋic siocmâc jaŋe tiŋne juju‐jeŋiczi ŋezic‐jopaekac, â doc bapa ŋic jaŋe ine eeatuc‐jeŋiczi bitiŋ ejareha ira raʒipie kicjopaekac.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe hâmohapie woworic‐jeŋiczi wâc omaeocmu, moneŋ mafao roweckehuc juju izi fâri tâmiric eocmu hâcne.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ʒârâ hâriŋkonec batarac‐jopazo, ehuc jaŋere okacne ŋic sindaŋne ʒârâ hâriŋko râec‐jopazo.
Ŋic hehesicne jaŋere dâŋzi ŋic âgofâc‐jeŋic sipiric‐jopaekac, â ŋic tiŋne jaŋere maŋɋârâŋ dâŋzi ine bafic‐jopaekac.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe hae maŋnao juhâc qâhâmohapie ʒeri bubiaŋ fuarâ foekac, ehame ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe hâmopie ʒeri ehuc kiwac qawac eeŋgopieŋ.
Hae moc irec maŋnao ŋic jaŋe tiŋne juhapie hae irec ʒâŋe biŋe faharehuc foekac, ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere dâŋzi ine hae bâsâqoreekac.
Ŋic maŋ mamanasu tâmiriczi ŋic âgo‐ticne manacneme wawahane eha râpedâŋ ecneekac, â ŋic mamana taraheczi ine dâŋemâc juekac.
Gupe baekac ŋic e dâŋ moc âzâcnehuc mic muac ecneeŋgopeneŋ i kosa mutaniŋkeekac, â ŋic aki metânezi ine maŋticnao râeme foekac.
Ŋicguru moc jaŋe guriŋ bapa tâmiric juniŋmuo ine siŋsaŋ qahuc sipiricke‐fâreniŋmu, mumutâc ŋic bocjaha jujarepie ine sâcne juniŋmu.
Ŋic furune jaŋe tofa‐jeŋic bazunaŋte numu‐nârepie bafic‐jopahuc busâqoc bâfuanʒipeŋte biac mi mupaŋkenʒepeneŋ, irec moc e wiac iŋucnere mumupaŋ dâŋ mi muocmuzi sâcne juocmu.
Ŋokac biaŋnere manapene fefene eekac, â ŋokac iriŋ biriŋnere ine manapene wawahane eekac. Ŋic otec ɋeticnezi moneŋ mafa moc mi bâfuaocmu, ŋic ʒoɋacheczi ine mafa mâririhec eocmu.
Ŋic maŋjauŋheczi ŋic gâcne bafic‐jopahuc e jahacne sahac bafickeocmu, â moc e ine ŋic âgofâcne bâʒâic‐jopahuc e jahacne sahac bâʒâickeocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe wiac fârine moc mi hureeŋgopieŋ, â wiac tiŋne ebac eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine irec fârine biaŋne jaha bâfuaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic moc e wiac tiŋne jaha ebac eocte sanaŋkeocmu e juhâmoocmu, â moc e sâqocne bâfuaocte ʒoɋac eocmu eki ine hâmo‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.
Wofuŋ e ŋic maŋʒoc‐jeŋichec jaŋe qaisoc‐jopaekac, â maŋ ɋaɋacne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere ine maname biaŋkeekac.
Go ʒiŋuc manapaŋkec: Ŋic hehesicne jaŋe okacne fua‐jareocmu, ŋic tiŋne â ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ine juhâc qâhâmoniŋmu.
Ŋokac sahac hawari biaŋzi mimi jaŋgeŋ juekac e, golzi finʒuŋ bakicne i bec masunao râepene foipieha sifu mâreŋ suahuc sohoŋ ruaekac irec sâc eekac.
Ŋic tiŋnere woworic gie i raku bibiaŋkoa fisiocmu, ŋic sindaŋnere wosaŋeŋ gie raku kimbeŋ sanaŋ bâfuaocmu.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe moneŋ‐jeŋic mi sakarehuc boki bapie moneŋ mafa sifu ʒuhuckerâ fua‐jareekac, â ŋic gâcne jaŋe ine sakarehuc sifu kitac qatac erâ jueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic moc e wiac‐ticne buafec jaha qikiŋneme sifu fofo dunduŋ fuarâ focneocmu, â ŋic moc e ŋic âgofâcne bafic‐jopame jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha bafickeniŋmu.
Ŋic moc e padi jacgoŋ‐ticne furi fekicne roocte sakareme sâweckeniŋmu, â moc e ine furi wahakicne i hone‐bipiehuc sifu furi bajareme mumbiaŋkeniŋmu.
Moc e wiac biaŋnere gie baocte henʒiriŋneocmu ere manapie biaŋkeocmu, â moc e gie hehesicne baocmu ere faio ine hehesic jaha feocmu.
Moneŋ mafa‐jeŋicko roweckeniŋmu ŋic i jaŋe jâcrehac mârâŋkerâ wahaekac irec sâc waha jopaocmu, â ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ine jâcrehac fie ruruckeekac irec sâc eniŋmu.
Ŋic moc e wiacfâcne ʒârâ hâriŋ bâfua‐jareocmu e wiac biaŋne moc mi bâfuaocmu, â ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋere kiŋaŋ qaqa erâ juniŋmu.
Ŋic moc e tiŋne juocmuzi irec fârine juju hotâckeocmu, â ŋic moc e ʒâʒâicne juocmuzi ine juju‐ticne sipirickeocmu.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe juju‐jeŋicte fârine mâreŋko roniŋmuo ine ŋic sindaŋne â hehesicne jaŋe juju‐jeŋicte fârine wâc rojâmbâŋkeniŋmu.
Ŋic moc e mamana tarahec juocmuzi mu bâtiŋ ecnepie maname biaŋkeocmu, â ŋic mutuc matacnezi ine mu bâtiŋ qikiŋneocmu.
Wofuŋ e gie biaŋne hone aŋac ejareekac, â ŋic wiac hehesicne mana biric eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine mana gâpâre‐jareekac.
Ŋic moc e wiac sindaŋne eocmuzi sâcne qiŋ herâ mi domaocmu, ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ine tie farane mi eniŋmu.
Ŋonâŋ biaŋnezi ŋowe‐ticnere eridu tinac eekac, â ŋokac moc e ŋowe‐ticne mimi qaqa ecneocmuzi ine, umbeŋzi ŋic siec‐ticne nâekac irec sâc eocmu.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe dâŋ biaŋne maŋkerâ jueŋgopieŋ, ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine eeatuc dâŋ sawa nâzâeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere dâŋ izi ʒika iŋucne ŋic bâʒâic‐jopaekac, â ŋic tiŋne jaŋere dâŋzi ine ŋic ʒâic busâqoc faio juhapie bafic‐jopaekac.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe waha jopame omaeniŋmu, â ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ine mimiŋzi ɋâric jufehuc juniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe mamanahec jupie ŋic jaŋe mumbiaŋ‐ŋopaniŋmu, â mutuc matacne juhapie ine mana wahac‐ŋopaniŋmu.
Ŋic moc e maŋhuhuŋ juhuc nânâre hâmozacte gie bame biaŋkeocmu, â ŋic moc e ine ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne sawa feocte manasuhuc ojoŋ juocmuzi nânâre hâmoocmu.
Ŋic biaŋne jaŋe qowifâc‐jeŋic aijakic jaha hone maiŋ ejareniŋmu, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine hone qâoma ejareniŋmu.
Ŋic moc e ʒoɋachec jaha hesarac gie baocmuzi nânâ sâcne bâfuaocmu, â ŋic moc e mutuc erâ qâoma juocmuzi ine roroc qaŋqaŋne juocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe wiac hehesicne sawa eniŋte maŋkeeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ine sanaŋkerâ domaniŋte manasueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic sindaŋne e jahacne dâŋzi bitiŋ ecneha raʒime kiocmu, â ŋic siocmâc eki ine ʒârâ hâriŋko mi feocmu.
Ŋic moc e miczi dâŋ muekac irec sâcko wiac roekac, â moc e mezi gie baekac irec sâc jaha wiac roekac.
Ŋic mutuc matacne e jahacne maname sâckeekac, â ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi ine ŋic gâcne jaŋere dâŋ manaekac.
Ŋic mutucnezi maŋʒoc‐ticnere fuŋne onʒoŋ jaha bataniŋkeekac, ŋic mamanahec musoriŋkepie ine mamana sâqoc biac mi bâfuaekac.
Ŋic sioc tâmiriczi dâŋ fârine sawa muekac, â burecŋiczi ine eeatuc dâŋ muekac.
Ŋic maŋʒochec ere dâŋzi ʒika iŋucne kicnâpoekac, â ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec ere dâŋzi ine âgo bacnâpoekac.
Jâmbomac dâŋzi forahuc juocmu sanaŋ, â burecdâŋzi ine biac omaeocmu.
Wiac hehesicne mana biric eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere maŋko eeatuc foekac, â wiac biaŋne mana biric eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine bubiaŋ bâfuaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe wiac hâhâwicne mi fua‐jareekac, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio boc feeŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ e burecŋic jaŋere maname mamakâcne eekac, â ŋic sioc tâmiric jaŋere ine maname biaŋkeekac.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe mamana‐jeŋic boc mi mutaniŋkeeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic mutucne jaŋe ine mutuc‐jeŋicte fuŋne musokaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic moc e gie ʒoɋachec baocmuzi ʒâŋe biŋehec erâ guriŋ bapa ŋic juocmu, â moc e ine ojoŋ juocmuzi kiŋaŋ gie sawa bahuc juocmu.
Mana mezac ee izi ŋic maŋnâŋec bawahaekac, â âgodâŋzi ine bubiaŋ bâfua‐nâreekac.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe sâqocne wisecneeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine hata hehesicnao rahuc qâsorieeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic ojoŋnezi wiac irec me irec ecneme sâcne mi bâfuaocmu, â ŋic moczi gie ʒoɋachec baocmu e ine wiac fofo dunduŋ fuarâ focneocmu.
Ŋic moc e siocmâc juocmuzi jujure hatao raocmu, â moc e ine sindaŋ hârindaŋ eocmuzi hâmocte hatao raocmu.
Motec maŋɋârâŋhec e mamacnezi mu bâtiŋ ecneme dâŋticne manaocmu, â motec ʒaubacnezi ine dâŋticnere takickeme qikiŋneocmu.
Ŋic biaŋne jaŋe dâŋjeŋicte fârine biaŋne jaha roeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic eeatucne jaŋe ine bâbâʒâic gie baniŋte boc ejareekac.
Ŋic moc e micticne soŋaŋkeocmuzi juju‐ticne ŋezickeocmu, â moc e ine manabâc mi ehuc dâŋ kosa muocmuzi juju‐ticne sipirickeocmu.
Ŋic ojoŋnezi wiac irec me irec boc ecneha sifu mi bâfuaocmu, â ŋic moc e gie ʒoɋachec baocmuzi ine wiac irec me irec ecneocmu sâc bâfuaocmu.
Ŋic siocmâc jaŋe burecdâŋ qaisockeeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe wiac mu bac epie miminehec â mamakâcne eekac.
Tiŋne jujuzi ŋic bahacmâc ŋezic‐jopaekac, sâqocnezi ine ŋic sindaŋne bawahac‐jopaekac.
Ŋic hapetac gâcne jaŋe ŋic moneŋ mafa sâkohec jaŋere hawari eeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic mafa mâririhec gâcne jaŋe wiac‐jeŋic foipieha sifu ŋic hapetac jaŋere hawari jueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic moneŋ mafa sâkoheczi juju‐ticne ŋezickeocte afeckerâ kiwiric‐ticne râeocmu, â ŋic hapetaczi ine iŋuc eocte eipieocmu.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe lambe tatamac sâko iŋucne, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine lambe tatamac gâkowaekac irec sâc.
Ŋic ʒaubacne jaŋe bahac fuŋne fuŋne bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe ine ŋic âgofâc‐jeŋic dâŋko bafic‐jopaniŋte ejareekac.
Gie fâro faio sawa bahuc moneŋ mafa bâfuaeŋgopeneŋ i biac mocwâc omaeekac, â gie sâko aijakic jaha bahuc bâfuanaŋmuo ine ʒuhuckerâ fua‐nâreocmu.
Mamanac juju‐nâŋeczi fârimâc eme maŋnâŋec wahaocmu, â wiac mocte enâreha fârine fuame mamanac‐nâŋeczi soka ŋedâmârec eocmu.
Ŋic moc e Anuture dâŋ fâri hândâŋne qâsuaocmuzi okacne roocmu, â moc e Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋ araŋ bacneocmuzi ine sâcne juocmu.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋere mu qaqazuc dâŋ izi jujure opâ ʒâŋe iŋucne, dâŋ izi hâcne hâmocte bitiŋko fenʒipeŋte hecke‐nâreekac.
Ŋic mamanahec jaŋere manapene fefene eekac, doc bapa ŋic jaŋe ine hâmoc sanaŋte hatao raeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi gie i me i moc baocte qanaŋ mamanasu gie baocmu, â ŋic mutuc matacnezi ine iŋuc moc mi ehuc mutuc‐ticnere fuŋne bataniŋkeocmu.
Biŋe mumu ŋic hehesicnezi wiac hâhâwicne bâfuaekac, â kiŋaŋŋic biaŋnezi ine wamadâŋ bafisiekac.
Ŋic moc e giedâŋ biaŋne qikiŋneocmuzi ŋic hapetac â wawahane eocmu, â moc e mu bâtiŋ dâŋ mana rereŋ eme ine ere manapene fefene eocmu.
Wiac irec me irec aŋac‐nâpome fârine bâfuarâ bubiaŋ manaeŋgopeneŋ, ŋic mutucne jaŋe ine wiac hehesicne râpeckeniŋte takic‐jopaekac.
Ŋic moc e ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec qâtec‐joparâ juhuc maŋɋârâŋhec jaha eocmu, â ŋic mutuc matacne âgo ejarehuc ine sipirickeocmu.
Sâqocne bapa jaŋe okacne rorozi kikeo kikeo ejareekac, â ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ine katucne jujuhâmo roeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic biaŋnere moneŋ mafa izi naru motec ŋosafâc‐ticne jaŋere biŋe eocmu, â sâqocne bapa jaŋere moneŋ mafazi ine ŋic tiŋne jaŋere biŋe eocmu.
Ŋic hapetac jaŋere nânâ wiac i mâreŋ furunao bocjaha fuazac, mâc ŋic hehesicne jaŋe mâreŋ irec aka hejarembiŋ.
Go ŋokâge qaisockehuc qa bâtiŋ mi ecnecmu, maŋzi jauŋkehuc ine qa bâtiŋ sâcne ecnecmu.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe nânâ wiac moc mi basaeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine nânâ âmbâŋ nâipiehuc dameŋ sâc nânâre hâmoeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋokac maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe ficnâŋec ba eric eeŋgopieŋ, â mutuc matacne jaŋe ine hetâtieŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic moc e siocdâŋ qikiŋnehuc Wofuŋ araŋ bacneocmu, â moc e siocdâŋ bajuhuc Wofuŋ qaisockeocmu.
Ŋic mutuc matacne moc e jahacne maname feha mujaŋ bocjaha woseocmu, â ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec ere dâŋzi ine jahacne ŋezickeocmu.
Bulimakao jaŋe bafic‐nâpohuc mâreŋ mi bâfâuckeniŋmuo ine padi jacgoŋ afecne sawa fua‐nâreocmu, jaŋe gie bafic‐nâpopie ine bocjaha fua‐nâreocmu.
Mumutaniŋ ŋic siocmâc eki dâŋ fârine sawa muekac, â siochec eki ine burecdâŋ sasawa muekac.
Ŋic âke sisicnezi maŋɋârâŋhec moc mi eocmu, ŋic mamanaheczi ine afeckerâ mamana tara bâfuaocmu.
Go ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋehec mi juzemec, jaŋe mamana biaŋne i me i moc sâcne mi qazu‐gareniŋmu.
Ŋic mamanahec jaŋe hata‐jeŋic fâretiŋ jaha rahuc maŋɋârâŋ‐jeŋic bataniŋkeeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe ine mamana mi fojareha mutuc erâ mueŋgopieŋ: Nâŋe mamanahec.
Ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe manabâc mi ehuc sâqocne bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic biaŋne jaŋe ine sâqocne‐jeŋic tâmireocte ejareekac.
Maŋnâŋecko bubiaŋ me busâqoc fuaekac i ŋic moczi honerâ babafic‐nâpone mi eekac.
Ŋic sindaŋnere ficzi tâtiehame ŋic tiŋnere fic i sanaŋkerâ ŋeocmu.
Ŋic nâŋâc hata moc honerâ biaŋne muhapene sifu hata izi raku hâmoc haeo mecne fisikac.
Ŋic moc e busâqocko juipiehuc sifu mu gâgâwizi busâqoc‐ticne tapa baocmu. Dameŋ gâcnao bubiaŋ tarame busâqoc fuaekac.
Ŋic sâqocne moc e eebapa‐ticnere sâcko okacne roocmu, â ŋic biaŋne moc e wâc iŋuc jaha eebapa‐ticnere sâcko furine roocmu.
Ŋic mutuc matacnezi dâŋ sasawa irec maname fârine eekac, â ŋic mamanaheczi ine hata‐ticne hone tarahuc raekac.
Ŋic mamanaheczi bahac wiac bâfuazacte aimuŋ jaha juekac, â ŋic mutuc matacnezi ine maŋne bâruŋkeme wiac manabâc tâmiric eekac.
Ŋic maŋʒoc‐ticneheczi wiac mutucne eekac, â ŋic maŋuruchec eki ine wama ruaine juekac.
Ŋic mamana tâmiric jaŋe mutuc‐jeŋicte fârine mutuc jaha roeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic mamana saric jaŋe ine mamana tara ro rauc eeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic sâqocne jaŋe ŋic biaŋne jaŋere maio dapenʒepieŋ, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ŋic tiŋne jaŋere motâcko rumerâ domanʒepieŋ.
Ŋic hapetac jaŋere takic‐nâpome âgo boc mi ejareeŋgopeneŋ, â ŋic moneŋ mafa sâkohec jaŋere ine boc aŋac‐nâpome âgo bacjopaeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋic moc e ŋic âgofâc‐ticne qaisoc‐jopaocmuzi kiŋ hureocmu, â moc e ŋic hapetac ehâmo‐jareocmuzi ine ʒeri bubiaŋ bâfuaocmu.
Wiac sâqocne manasu biric eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hehesic bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, â wiac biaŋnere gie baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine ŋic âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mana‐jarepie fefene eha jaŋerao roweckeeŋgopieŋ.
Go gie ʒoɋachec bahuc jujugere ŋesiŋ sâcne bâfuacmu, ojoŋ juhuc dâŋgie sawa bahuc jucmuo ine ŋesiŋ basarâ ŋesawa ecmu.
Maŋɋârâŋhec juju izi ŋic mamana saric jaŋere eri hendiŋ ekac, â mutuczi ine ŋic mamana tâmiric jaŋere qâ ʒere ekac.
Ŋic moc e dâŋgieo dâŋ fâri qizecne mutaniŋkeocmuzi ŋic âgofâc‐ticne jaŋere juju ŋezickeocmu, â moc e ine burecdâŋ muocmuzi ŋic âgofâc‐ticne doc bacjopaocmu.
Ŋic moc e Wofuŋ araŋ bacneocmuzi erao rowecke sanaŋkeocmu, e iŋuc ehuc naru motecfâc‐ticne jaŋere qânâuŋ eocmu.
Wofuŋ araŋ babacne izi jujure opâ ʒâŋe ekac, moc e opâ i nâhuc hâmoc getâckeocmu.
Ŋicwofuŋ moc e kikefuŋfâc‐ticne guru sâko jucnepie ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec eocmu, â kikefuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋe tâmiric ine ŋic omane tinac eocmu.
Ŋic moc e buuruchec juocmuzi mamana‐ticnere fuŋne bataniŋkeocmu, â moc e maŋʒoc‐ticnehec juocmuzi ine mutuc‐ticnere fuŋne bataniŋkeocmu.
Ŋic moc e wama ruaine juhuc sahac‐ticne gume jowac eocmu, â moc e maŋʒârâ‐ticnehec juocmuzi ine siec bibiricko wicsanaŋ fuaekac irec sâc eocmu.
Ŋic moc e hapetac jaŋe bâʒâic‐jopahuc bâbâfua‐ticne wâwânâŋ ecneocmu, â moc e qarâ suriŋne jaŋe ehâmo‐jarehuc bâbâfua‐ticne araŋ bacneocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne e eebapa‐ticnezi bawahaekac, â ŋic biaŋne e ine siocmâc juju‐ticnezi ŋeŋezic‐ticne eekac.
Maŋɋârâŋzi ŋic mamanahec jaŋere maŋko ŋeŋe juju eekac, â ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋere maŋko ine maŋɋârâŋ basaeŋgopeneŋ.
Tiŋe jujuzi ŋic ʒâŋe biŋe‐jeŋic bafahareekac, â eebapa sâqocnezi ine mimi busâqoc bâfua‐jareekac.
Ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐jeŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋere manapie biaŋkeekac, â maizi qambaraŋ ejareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine bâtiŋ‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Dâŋ okacne urucnezi aaric bawahaekac, â dâŋ fâfâcneheczi ine maŋʒoc bâfuaekac.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec ere mickonec mamana dâŋ biaŋne sawa wahaekac, â ŋic mutuc matacne eki ine mutucdâŋ sawa muekac.
Wofuŋ e mâreŋ ira me ira wiac fuaekac sâc hone manac efâreekac, ehuc wiac biaŋne me sâqocne ebac ehapene hone jâjâpec‐nâpoekac.
Dâŋ biaŋnezi juju bâfua‐nâreekac, â dâŋ gâgâpâcnezi ine maŋnâŋec bâsâqoreekac.
Motec mutucnezi mamac‐ticnere mubâtiŋ dâŋ qaisockeekac, â mana maŋ eekaczi ine maŋɋârâŋhec eekac.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe moneŋ mafa ɋâfoŋne fojareekac, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere huhure wiac ine sifuckeekac.
Ŋic mutucne jaŋe mâcne, maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe mamana dâŋ musaweeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic siocmâc jaŋe Wofuŋ numucnepie maname biaŋkeekac, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe taha bâzi rikecnepie ine maname mamakâcne eekac.
Wofuŋ e ŋic sindaŋ hârindaŋne jaŋere eebapa honeme gâgâpâcne eekac, â wiac tiŋne ebac eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine maŋzi ʒâfic‐jopaekac.
Moc e wiac hehesicne ebac eocmu ere faio okacne hâhâwicne feocmu, ehame bâbâtiŋ qikiŋnehuc hâmoocmu.
Hâmoc haere fuŋne Wofuŋte maio tâtâc fohame ine wemocko ŋiczi maŋticnere fuŋne moc Wofuŋte maio sâcne hesoŋkeocmu.
Ŋic mu âke sisicnezi bâbâtiŋte takickeekac, â ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe dâŋzi bafickeniŋte wâc mi ecneekac.
Ŋic moc e bubiaŋ maname ʒâŋe maine fie ruruckeocmu, â moc e busâqoc maname ine ʒâŋe maine ki humimic eocmu.
Ŋic mamanaheczi mamana gie ʒuhuckerâ baocte ecneekac, â ŋic mutuc matacnezi ine mutucdâŋ sawa muhuc juocte ecneekac.
Ŋic waha qaqane jaŋere juju i biaŋne aricne, â juhâc qâhâmoeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine juju‐jeŋicte manapie ʒerine eekac.
Hapetac juhuc Wofuŋ araŋ babacne irec manapene fefene ezejec, â moneŋ mafahec ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio juju irec ine manapene wawahane ezejec.
Maŋjauŋ enârehuc nânâ monʒaŋ wiac sawa gumec‐nâpopie sifu manapene fefene ezejec, â qaisoc‐nâpohuc qowi biuc wokemaŋ sâkohec nârepie manapene wawahane ezejec.
Ŋic maŋʒocheczi ʒikadâŋ bâfuaekac, â ŋic buurucheczi ine wamadâŋ bâfuaekac.
Ŋic moc e ojoŋ juocmuzi dameŋ sâc ŋemâc bâfuaocmu, â moc e siocmâc juocmuzi ine ʒâic busâqoc tâmiric juocmu.
Motec maŋɋârâŋheczi mamac‐ticne bubiaŋ qacneocmu, â motec mutucnezi ine neŋgoc‐ticne qaisockeocmu.
Ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe mutuc‐jeŋicte manapie bubiaŋnehec eekac, â ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe ine wiac ebac epie tiŋke biaŋ efâreekac.
Ŋic âgofâcge jaŋe baficguhapie dâŋwiacge mu biric etec fârinehec eocmu, â i tâmiric ine fârimâc eocmu.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe dâŋ muniŋte eipiehapie dameŋ ijaha ŋic moczi dâŋ fârine jazame manapie bubiaŋnehec eocmu.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi hâmoc haere hatao mâcne, jujure hatao raekac.
Wofuŋzi ŋic pepec penaroŋhec jaŋere fic hae hetâc qâtâtieekac, â hozec jaŋere wâcwiac ine ŋezickehuc akickeekac.
Wofuŋ e ŋic sindaŋne maŋ mamanasu‐jeŋicte maname wiac mamakâcne eekac, â ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋere dâŋte ine maname aŋac baŋacne eekac.
Ŋic moc e eeatuc ehuc moneŋ mafa hureocmuzi wiacfâcne ŋemâc bâfua‐jareocmu, â moc e bâbâmiriŋ mi roocmuzi ine dameŋ ʒora juhâc qâhâmoocmu.
Ŋic biaŋne jaŋe dâŋ okacne bâtikieniŋte mana tara‐hâmorâ bâtikieeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine dâŋ manabâc tâmiric kosa mupie sâqoreekac.
Wofuŋ e ŋic tiŋne jaŋere nunumu manaekac, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere ine suŋgiŋkeekac.
Ŋic ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic fie ruruckeme honerâ ʒeri eeŋgopeneŋ, â biŋedâŋ biaŋne moc manarâ maŋnâŋec qacfiric eekac.
Ŋic moc e mubâtiŋ dâŋte hazec râerâ mana maŋ eocmuzi ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋere ŋondeŋko sâcne juocmu.
Ŋic moc e mu qaqazuc dâŋ qikiŋneocmuzi e jahacne juju qaisockeocmu, â ŋic moc e mubâtiŋ dâŋ mana maŋ eocmuzi ine maŋɋârâŋ fehuc bâfuaocmu.
Wofuŋ araŋ bacnehuc juju izi maŋɋârâŋte mamana gie fârine ekac. Ŋoŋe ʒâŋe biŋehec ezo murâ qanaŋ maŋhuhuŋ junʒepieŋ.
Ŋic nâŋâc wiac irec me irec dâŋ mu biric ezo murâ enaŋmu, ehame irec dâŋ mumutara ine Wofuŋzi eocmu.
Ŋic nâŋâc wiac ebac ehuc manapene tiŋke biaŋ eekac, mâc fuŋne weniŋucte eeŋgopeneŋ i ine Wofuŋzi buc manaekac.
Go gie moc bazo murâ Wofuŋzi jambuŋke‐gareocte numucnehuc batec fârinehec eocmu.
Wofuŋ e wiac sasawa fuŋnehec bâfuac‐jopa‐fârewec, ehuc ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine sisipiricte biŋe râec‐jopawec.
Wofuŋ e ŋic pepec penaroŋhec jaŋere maname mamakâcne eekac, irec jaŋe okacne rojâmbâŋkeniŋmu.
Go Anutu manasiŋkehuc erao qohotatec sâqocnege bâtâmireocmu, â Wofuŋ araŋ bacnehuc jutec wiac hâhâwicne moc mi fua‐gareocmu.
Nâŋâc Wofuŋzi juju bapa‐nâŋec honeme biaŋkeha râsifâc‐nâŋec âgo ejarepene jaŋe âgo jaha enâreniŋmu.
Nâŋâc siocmâc juhapene wiac afecne sawa fua‐nâreme manapene mi sâqorezejec, â eeatuc ehuc moneŋ mafa bocjaha bâfuanaŋmuo ine sâqoreocmu.
Maŋnâŋeczi juju hata‐nâŋecte dâŋ manasu biric eekac, ehame Wofuŋzi ine hata fâretiŋ jaha nâzâ nâwotuc eekac.
Ŋicwofuŋ e Anuture micte dâŋ muekac, irec e moc mi musifuckehuc dâŋ fârine sawa muekac.
Wofuŋzi ŋemâc bâbâfuare sâc â sâcmeda wiac i sâckoa fofâreocte muekac, wiac sasawa i eki hâcne bâfua‐fârewec.
Hehesic bâbâfua izi ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere maio mamakâcne eha tiŋne jujuzi eri ŋeŋe‐jeŋicte hobeteŋne eekac.
Ŋicwofuŋ e dâŋ fâri hândâŋne manaocte ecneekac, irec dâŋ fârine muniŋmu ŋic i jaŋe hâcne âgo ejareocmu.
Ŋicwofuŋ e maŋʒoc‐ticne fuame ŋic moc qâhâmozacte ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe mu bâmâteŋ ecneeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋicwofuŋ e ʒâŋe mai‐ticne fie ruruckeme honepene âgo hawari eekac, ehame ʒoaŋ dameŋko hoezi mâreŋ bâgunuckeekac irec sâc enâreekac.
Nâŋâc gol me siliwa babaju irec manapene wawahane eha maŋɋârâŋ â mamanahec juju irec ine manapene fefene ezejec.
Ŋic biaŋne jaŋe sisipiricte hata geŋkeeŋgopieŋ, irec ŋoŋe hata‐ŋeŋic hone‐hâmohuc ranʒepieŋ; ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc juju‐ŋeŋic ŋezickeniŋmu.
Sahac fefezi sisipiricte hata baekac, â pepec penaroŋzi ine sâc ijaha ehuc bawahac‐nâpoekac.
Ŋic hapetac â maŋhuhuŋ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋehec juju irec manapene fefene ezejec, â ŋic pepec penaroŋ eeŋgopieŋ jaŋehec juhuc kâdoc qaqa irec ine manapene wawahane ezejec.
Ŋic moc e Anuture dâŋ âzâcne qazuc ekicne i mana rereŋ eocmuzi juhâc qâhâmoocmu, â moc e Wofuŋtao roweckehuc juocmu ere manapene ʒerine eocmu.
Ŋic moc e maŋɋârâŋhec jume honerâ ŋic mamana sarichec mucneeŋgopieŋ, ehame dâŋ biaŋne mume aŋac‐jopaha mana ʒakieeŋgopieŋ.
Maŋɋârâŋzi ŋic mamanahec jaŋerao opâ ʒâŋe iŋucne eekac, â ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe wiac qaqazu‐jare izi ine dameŋ sisipiric eekac.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋ heczi dâŋ muzo murâ qanaŋ mana biric eekac, erâ ie dâŋ mume ŋic jaŋe aŋac‐jopaha mana ʒakieeŋgopieŋ.
Dâŋ biaŋnezi aŋac baŋacne eekac, erâ maŋnâŋecko aŋac bâfuahuc sahac‐nâŋec baafeckeekac.
Ŋic nâŋâc hata moc honerâ biaŋne mecne muhapene sifu hata izi raku hâmoc haeo fisikac.
Ŋic moc e nânâ nâ gapec eocte aŋac manahuc gie‐ticne ʒoɋachec baocmu.
Ŋic hehesicne jaŋe wiac hehesicne jaha eniŋte manasueŋgopieŋ, ehame dâŋjeŋiczi ʒoc iŋucne bâruŋkerâ ima gie baekac.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe gupe micko âke dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ, ehuc ŋic âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao fâfâuc bâfuaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic ʒâʒâicne jaŋe ŋic âgofâc‐jeŋic eatuc‐jopahuc sisipiricko râec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic ʒâŋe bazuc enâreeŋgopieŋ jaŋere ruc banʒepeneŋ, â sumâŋ kieŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒika qaniŋte maŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe dameŋ ʒora jufeeŋgopieŋ, ehame jaŋɋâŋ‐jeŋic honepene eri hendiŋ‐jeŋic eekac.
Ŋic qac momori ere manapene wawahane eha ŋic kimbeŋ‐ticne bembeŋne ere ine manapene fefene ezejec. Erâ moc e ŋic guru sâko bawahac‐jopaocmu ere wâc iŋuc jaha manapene wawahane ezejec, â moc e maŋrâŋgeŋ‐ticne bawahaocmu ere ine manapene fefene ezejec.
Ŋic jaŋe Anuturaonec dâŋ mananiŋte mu wioc ecnehuc ɋâsâi qaeŋgopieŋ, eme dâŋ okacne ine Anutu e jahac bâtikie‐jareekac.
Nânâ gukuckekicne i wama faio nâhuc sifu irec manapene fefene ezejec, â sisi hâhâŋ faio tiwâ bâzi nânâ irec ine manapene wawahane ezejec.
Kiŋaŋ qaqa maŋɋârâŋheczi bomboŋ‐ticnere ŋokâ hehesicne mu bâtiŋ ecnehuc sâcne bawahaocmu, e iŋuc erâ motec ere hahac ɋafâc jaŋere sâc jaha wâc ehuc merâfâc wiac rauckeocmu.
Ŋic jaŋe gol â siliwa wiac i ʒocko rike esâic epie wosâeekac irec sâc jaha Anutuzi ŋic maŋnâŋec ba esâic eekac.
Ŋic hehesicne jaŋe dâŋ hehesicnere hazec râeeŋgopieŋ, â burecŋic jaŋe dâŋ sisipirichec i mana rereŋ eeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic moc e ŋic hapetac moc mu âke sisic ecneocmuzi Mamac bâbâfua‐ticne e wâc mâmâc ecneocmu, â moc e ŋic âgo‐ticne wiac hâhâwicne moc fuacneme honerâ bubiaŋ manaocmuzi ine bâbâtiŋte biŋe eocmu.
Ŋic mocte motecfâc jaŋe mamac‐jeŋicte manapie fefene eekac, irec sâc jaha ŋicqizec jaŋe ŋosafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere manapie fefene wâc eekac.
Ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe dâŋ fârine mupie boc mi biaŋkeekac, â ŋic fekicne jaŋe burecdâŋ mupie sâqore‐jâmbâŋkeekac.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe bâbâmiriŋ moneŋte manapie qaŋgec tinac eha izi gie i me i bazo murâ sâcne baocmu.
Ŋic jaŋe âgo egareniŋte manasukicko ine wiac esâqore‐garembiŋ irec kiŋ behe‐jarezemec. Jaŋe wiac egarembiŋ irec dâŋ i giŋkeme giŋ murahuc jutecne âgo ʒuʒuhuc‐ŋeŋic i tâcne‐fâreocmu.
Ŋic mamanahec e arec mocjaha sawa mu bâtiŋ ecnepene mana‐hâmoocmu, â ŋic mutuc matacne e ine arec 100 qa bâtiŋ ecnepene sifu mi manaocmu.
Wiac hâhâwicnere qaqafeŋ gie baniŋmu ŋic hehesicne i jaŋerao hâmoczi hata kiŋaŋ ʒocnehec raeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc fisiocmu.
Qowi mimicne ʒâŋene bea e motecfâcne jâoc rofârepie momori eha sifu jâuruzo murâ sâcne jâurunaŋmu mecne, â ŋic mutucne maŋsifuc‐ticnehec ere ine hâwic‐nâpo‐jâmbâŋkeme wisecnenʒepeneŋ.
Ŋic jaŋe wiac biaŋne eŋarehapie okacne wiac hehesicne bâtikie‐jareniŋmuo ine hehesiczi ficmaŋ‐ŋeŋicko mi omaeocmu.
Dâŋ fuŋkerâ muhuc mu qaqatarac ee i opâ kanaŋ hehapene hawec fuaekac irec sâc ekac, irec dâŋ fuŋkehuc izia mocwâc behezo.
Wofuŋ e ŋic sindaŋne mumbiaŋ‐jopaeŋgopieŋ jaŋere mecne, â ŋic tiŋne musâqorec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ jaŋere mâmâc maname mamakâcne eekac.
Ŋic moc e mamana tâmiric mutuc matacne juekaczi mamana roocte moneŋ beheme wemo fârine moc fuacneocmu?
Ŋic ââgo eeŋgopieŋzi maŋjauŋ eec eeŋgopieŋ, â qoqomâ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe wiac ŋemâcne i babaficko de âsic eeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic moc e maŋ mamanasu tâmiric juocmuzi mutuc erâ ŋic âgo‐ticnere tofa bazuocte mupaŋkeocmu.
Ŋic moc e mu qaqataracte aŋac bajuocmuzi sâqocnere aŋackeocmu, â moc e sahac fefe dâŋ muekaczi ʒârâ hâriŋ hefâreocmu.
Ŋic moc e maŋ mamanasu‐ticne sâqocne foha wiac ebac eme sifu mi biaŋkeocmu, â moc e dâŋ simbiŋne muhuc juocmuzi sisipiric bâfuaocmu.
Motec moc e wiac mutucne ebac eekaczi mamac‐ticne ʒâic busâqoc sawa bâfuacneekac.
Bubiaŋ faio juju izi nârâ bibiaŋ iŋucne erâ basanaŋ‐nâpohuc bâpiaŋ‐nâpoekac, â busâqoc faio juju izi ine tâpiri‐nâŋec bawahaekac.
Mumutara ŋic hehesicne jaŋe soŋsoŋko bâbâmiriŋ moneŋ rohuc dâŋgieo dâŋ muhasickeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic mamanaheczi wiac biaŋne ebac eocte mana tara‐fâreekac, â ŋic mamana tâmiric eki ine hata basaekac.
Motec mutuc matacne e mamac‐ticne ʒâic busâqoc bâfuacnehuc neŋgoc roro‐ticne iŋuc jaha ʒâic fâro bâfuacneekac.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe sahac taha moneŋ râeniŋte mujarepene mi sâckeocmu, â ŋic biaŋne jaŋe ʒika kiniŋte mupene sâqore‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.
Ŋic mamana taraheczi dâŋ bocjaha kosa mi muocmu, â ŋic maŋ mamanasuheczi maŋwamahec juocmu.
Ŋic mutuc matacnezi dâŋ moc mi muhuc mâc niniŋkerâ ŋeocmu ere wâc manapene mamana â maŋɋârâŋhec jukac eocmu.
Ŋic moc e ŋic gâcne âgo mi ejareocmuzi e jahacne sawa manasuhuc juocmu, ehuc ŋic gâcne jaŋe wiac irec me irec manapie sâckeha eki maname sâqoreocmu.
Ŋic mutucnezi wiac mana taraekac me mâcne irec manabâc mi eekac, ehuc e jahacne maŋko dâŋ fokac i sawa manaekac.
Ŋic moczi wiac sindaŋne eocmu ere faio mimi busâqoc feocmu, ehame ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne omaeme mu âke sisic ecneniŋmu.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋere mickonec dâŋ wahaekac i manapene maŋɋârâŋte fuŋɋizecne ehuc opâ ʒâkâŋ ɋârâŋne â opâ fifisine irec sâc tinac eekac.
Ŋic sindaŋne âgo ejarehuc ŋic bahacmâc jaŋere dâŋ muhasickepene mi sâckeocmu.
Ŋic mutuc matacnezi fuŋkerâ dâŋ mu qaqatarac ehuc ʒika hotâckeocmu.
Ŋic mutuc matacnezi dâŋ muhuc juju‐ticne sipirickeekac, e jahacne dâŋzi bitiŋ ecneha raʒime kiekac hâcne.
Ŋic nâŋâc gupe micko âkec dâŋ irec manapene aŋacne eha maŋnâŋecko râepene hurâ foekac.
Ŋic ojoŋ juekac â ŋic wiac ima baekac jahe sâcjekic mocjaha.
Anuture dâŋ i huec sanaŋ iŋucne, irec ŋic tiŋnezi ira ferâ wamao sâcne ŋec foc eocmu.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe moneŋ mafa wiac‐jeŋicte manapie haesac sanaŋ ʒoricne irec sâc ehuc ŋezic‐nâpokac tinac eekac.
Ŋic maŋhuhuŋ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere manapene fefene eekac, â ŋic pepec penaroŋhec jaŋe ine sisipiricte hatao raeŋgopieŋ.
Go qanaŋ dâŋte hazec râezemec izi ʒâhec dâŋ okacne bâtikiezemec, go iŋuc mi ecmuo ine mutuc erâ mimi faio fecmu.
Ŋic moc e jujure ʒoɋac focneocmuzi huc ʒâic fuacneme sâcne qamaseocmu, â ʒoɋac‐ticne omaeme ie maŋticne gâcke‐fâreocmu.
Ŋic mamana sarichec jaŋe dameŋ sâc mamana ʒuhuckerâ roniŋte afeckerâ giene baeŋgopieŋ.
Go ŋic ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec ere maio fuazo murâ ine bubiaŋte wiac moc afeckerâ bacne razemec.
Ŋic moc e dâŋgieo dâŋticne fuŋkerâ mume manapie fârine eekac, izi ʒâhec ine kisâ‐ticnezi ŋifecne mume fâri tâmiric eekac.
Ŋic jajahec ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec jahe dâŋgieo dâŋ mu qaqatarac epire ɋâsâi qapie dâŋjekicte fuŋne taniŋkeekac.
Go qomâge baficketec eki wâc ŋifec sacsanaŋge erâ ŋezicguocmu, me ehec mu qaqatarac etec râpecguocmu.
Ŋic moc e dâŋ muocmu irec sâc jaha fârine bâfuaocmu.
Dâŋ sasawa mueŋgopeneŋ izi ŋifec juju‐nâŋec ŋezickeekac, â ŋifec ine sipirickeekac; irec dâŋ muekic sâc fârine bâfuarâ manatec sâckezejec.
Go ŋokac rohuc wiac biaŋne rocmu, ehame Wofuŋzi ehâmo‐gareekac irec fuŋne taniŋkeocmu.
Ŋic hapetaczi dâŋ mume nunumu hawari eekac, â ŋic moneŋ mafaheczi dâŋ mume ine ʒâʒâicne eekac.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe âgo hawari burec burec sawa enâreeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic gâcne jaŋe ine hahac ɋa jaŋe ââgo eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc sirickehuc âgo enâreeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic hapetaczi siocmâc juocmu izi fefene eocmu, â ŋic moneŋ mafaheczi burecdâŋ muocmu izi wawahane eocmu.
Ŋic moc e mamana tâmiric jume mi sâckeocmu, â moc e hata raocte ʒoɋac boc ehuc hata qâsorieocmu.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe wiac mutucne ehuc sisipiric bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, ehuc Wofuŋtao âki heeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic moneŋ mafa sâkohec e âgo bocjaha fuacneeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic hapetac e ine âgofâc‐ticne jaŋe râpeckeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic moc e dâŋgieo domahuc dâŋ musifuckeocmu e okacne roocmu, â moc e burecdâŋ muocmuzi bâbâtiŋ sâcne mi wisecneocmu.
Ŋic bocjaha jaŋe ŋic ʒâŋe biŋehec bâbâmiriŋ dâŋ jazaeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic bokifac jaŋehec ââgo ehuc juniŋte boc ejareekac.
Ŋic hapetac e hahac ɋafâc‐ticne jaŋe qaisockeeŋgopieŋte âgofâc‐ticne jaŋe wâc behe‐jâmbâŋkeeŋgopieŋ; ehame e âgo bacjopaocte gie sâko bâipiehuc juekac.
Go gahacne manasuhuc mamana fuŋne fuŋne rozemec, erâ mamana rokomec i bajuhuc juhâc qâhâmozemec.
Ŋic moc e dâŋgieo domahuc dâŋ muhasickeocmuzi bâbâtiŋ roocmu, â ŋic moc e burecdâŋ muocmuzi sipirickeocmu.
Ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe moneŋ mafa sâkohec mi junʒepieŋ, â kiŋaŋ qaqa jaŋe ŋic fekicne ŋicbomboŋ mi ejarenʒepieŋ.
Ŋic mamanahec e kimbeŋ aaric‐ticne sâcne fâre wahaocmu, â ŋic moczi wiac sâqocne moc ecneme hone takirehuc behecneme sâcke‐hâmoocmu.
Ŋicwofuŋzi aarickeme owackeekac i laioŋte owa iŋucne, â âgo miriŋ‐ticnezi ine titikuczi kecɋaŋ bâgunuckeekac irec sâc ekac.
Motec mutuc matacnezi mamac‐ticne sipirickeekac, â ŋokac râŋgeŋnere dâŋzi hoe micpiic heekac irec sâc ehuc tatakic bâfua‐nâreekac.
Fic hae â moneŋ mafa wiac i neŋgoc mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋere merâfâc roeŋgopeneŋ, â ŋokac mamanahec ine Wofuŋzi sawa bâfua‐nâreekac.
Go ojoŋ juzo murâ juzemec, erâ guŋ fohuc nânâre hâmozemec.
Ŋic moc e Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋ mana rereŋ eocmuzi juhâc qâhâmoocmu, â moc e qâsuaocmuzi ine hâmo sipiric eocmu.
Ŋic hapetac ehâmo‐jarehuc manapie Wofuŋ ecneŋgopeneŋ ezejec, eki hâcne okacne bazu‐ŋareocmu.
Ŋoŋe naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic piticne jaba juhapie qa bâtiŋ ejarenʒepieŋ, iŋuc mi eniŋmuo ine sisipiric hatao rahapie bafic‐jopaŋgopieŋ eocmu.
Ŋic moc e dameŋ sâc aaric onʒoŋ jaha manahuc juocmuo ine ecnepene furi râezejec, â hone qâoma ecnenaŋmuo ine aaric‐ticnere ʒoczi nâŋâcne faio feocmu.
Go ŋic jaŋe baficguhuc dâŋ biaŋne gazapie mana rereŋ ezemec, go iŋuc erâ juku maŋɋârâŋhec ecmu.
Ŋic nâŋâc mamanazi wiac fuŋne fuŋne irec dâŋ mana biric ezo murâ sâcne enaŋmu, ehame Wofuŋte micdâŋzi ine fârinehec eocmu.
Buchâro nânâ i wiac mamakâcne. Nâŋâc ŋic hapetac ere manapene fefene eha burecŋicte manapene wawahane eekac.
Go Wofuŋ araŋ bacnehuc juzemec. Go iŋuc ehuc dameŋ ʒora wama faio juhâc qâhâmohaŋtec sisipiric wiac izi me izi moc mi maicguocmu.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe qâoma sâko ehuc nânâ wiac micjeŋicko râeniŋte takic‐jopame mâc ŋeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic pepec penaroŋhec jaŋe qa bâtiŋ ejarepie fuŋne‐jeŋic mananʒepieŋ, ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe mu bâtiŋ ejarepie ine mamana‐jeŋic ɋârâŋkeocmu.
Motec sindaŋne â qaqaharicnezi sawa mamac‐ticne bâʒâickeocmu â neŋgoc‐ticne ficticnaonec jâpeme raocmu.
O motec‐mae, go ʒuhuckerâ mamana rozore takicguocmuo ine juwicnao mamana romeŋ i wâc nikecguocmu.
Mumutaniŋ ŋic hehesicnezi dâŋgie tiŋnere maname fâri tâmiric eekac, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe wiac hehesicnere aŋac‐jopaekac.
Kâcbiŋ i ŋic mu âke sisic eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere biŋe bâfuakicne, ŋic mutucne sahac fefe eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne ʒikare biŋe.
Ŋic jaŋe opâ sanaŋ bocjaha nârâ mutuc bacjopame bebe qahuc dâŋ ojowa kosa eeŋgopieŋ. Opâ sanaŋ nâku maŋsifuc ee i wiac mutucne.
Ŋoŋe laioŋ owa‐ticnere hâwic‐ŋopaekac irec sâc jaha ŋicwofuŋ aaric‐ticnere hâwic‐ŋopazejec. Ŋoŋe ŋicwofuŋ maŋbâiŋ ecnehuc manapie juju‐nâŋec doc baŋgopeneŋ ezejec.
Ŋic mutucne jaŋe dâŋ mu qaqatarac eeŋgopieŋ; mu qaqatarac tâmiric juju izi ine wiac biaŋne ekac.
Ŋic moc e gie hesarac dameŋko qâoma juocmuzi qa roro dameŋ maickeme nânâ basaocmu.
Ŋic maŋ mamanasu‐nâŋec i nombâŋ ʒoricnao opâ ŋeekac irec sâc, i ŋic mamana taraheczi sawa fâreme wefuocmu.
Ŋic bocjaha jaŋe jaŋacne manapie tiŋne â biaŋne juŋgopeneŋ eekac, ehame sifu ŋic biaŋne moc bâfuanaŋte babasa gie sâko baeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋic moc e siocmâc juhuc wiac tiŋne ebac eekac ere naru motecfâc jaŋere manapene ʒerine eekac.
Ŋicwofuŋ e dâŋ mumutara ŋeŋe‐ticnao ŋehuc wiac hehesicne hone ʒâŋitac efâreocmu.
Ŋic moczi ʒiŋuc sâcne muocmu: “No sâqocne tâmiric juekopacte maŋnanezi mumu hehec mocwâc mi enareekac?”
Ŋemâc bâbâfuare sâc â meda wiac sâctiri babaju i Wofuŋte maio wiac mamakâcne eekac.
Naru motec jaŋe eebapa‐jeŋiczi fuŋne‐jeŋic bataniŋkeekac, eme honec‐jopapene biaŋne â siocmâc jueŋgopieŋ irec fuŋne taniŋkeekac.
Wofuŋ e dâŋ mananaŋte hazec‐nâŋec râewec, â wiac hone taranaŋte ʒâŋe‐nâŋec wâc bâfuawec.
Go guŋgie sawa bahuc dameŋ sipirickecmuo ine hapetac erâ jucmu, â guŋɋâri juhuc gie ʒoɋachec bacmuo ine nânâ mâriri fofo dunduŋ fua‐gareocmu.
Ŋic moc e wiac furine baocte ehuc, “Furine boc fekac,” iŋuc manasurâ situâc rune ʒoɋac ecneme furine bawahacneme rorâ rahuc sahac‐ticne muteŋkeocmu.
Gol â qânâ furi sâko fuŋne fuŋne forakac, erâ sifu maŋɋârâŋ dâŋzi wiac i sasawa sirickerâ qânâ fuŋmoc furi sâko irec sâc ekac.
Ŋic moczi mutuc erâ ŋic âgo‐ticnere tofa bazuocte mupaŋkeocmuo ine ŋaqi qoruc‐ticne hotâ jâoc rorâ râepene foha mumupaŋ‐ticnere fârine bâfuazejec.
Go sioc ehuc wiac nânâne bâfuarâ nâtec qanaŋ aŋacne eocmu, izi ʒâhec ine nâkâcnehuc manatec maracgao hâtâ qiŋqiŋne eocmu.
Dâŋ biaŋne mutâcne‐garehapie irec sâcko gie batec fârinehec eocmu, irec go dâŋ manasu biric ehâmorâ ie ʒikao razemec.
Doc bapa ŋiczi dâŋ soŋne sâcne mi bajuocmu, irec ŋic moc dâŋ bocjaha woseekac e dic bacnenʒepieŋ.
Go neŋgoc mamac jahecge sâwec‐jofacmuo ine lambezi dapâcko hâpoekac irec sâc jujugezi omaeocmu.
Go biac jaha moneŋ mafa sâkohec ezepac, iŋuc muhuc fâro faio giene mi bâhâmocmuo ine ʒâhec soka sawec ehuc biaŋne mi baficguocmu.
Go ʒiŋuc mi muzemec: “Sâqocnere okacne i no nahac bazupemu,” aricne, go Wofuŋtao sawa roweckehuc juhaŋtec eki sâcne baficguocmu.
Ŋemâc bâbâfuare sâc wiac sâctiri bajueŋgopieŋ jaŋe Wofuŋzi qaisoc‐jopaekac.
Mâreŋŋic nâŋâc juju‐nâŋecte hata mi mana taraeŋgopeneŋ; Wofuŋzi sawa mutâcne‐nâreekacte raeŋgopeneŋ.
Go wiac irec me irec fâro faio ʒiŋuc mi muzemec: “I Wofuŋte biŋe.” Go ʒâhec irec busâqoc manahaŋtec mumupaŋgezi bitiŋ egarezacte iŋuc mi ezemec.
Ŋicwofuŋ maŋɋârâŋheczi ŋic sindaŋne hone ʒâŋitac ejarerâ busâqoc mi mana‐jarehuc qa bâtiŋ ejareekac.
Wofuŋ e maŋ hohone runezi maŋnâŋec batamaehuc maŋnâŋecte fuŋne bajaŋgeŋkeekac.
Ŋicwofuŋ moc guriŋ bapa gie‐ticne siocmâc, fâretiŋ â aijakic jaha bahuc juocmuzi ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋe‐ticne basanaŋkeocmu.
Nâŋâc ŋicmotec jaŋe tâpiri‐jeŋicte hone warec ejareeŋgopeneŋ â ŋicraŋɋa jaŋe ine jaŋɋâŋ‐jeŋicte araŋ bajareeŋgopeneŋ.
Dameŋ gâcnao ʒika â wiac hâhâwicne sâko fua‐nâreme sawa eebapa‐nâŋec hehesicne qaisockehuc râpeckeeŋgopeneŋ.
Wofuŋ e opâ sâko guriŋ bacneme hata‐ticnaoa raekac irec sâc jaha ŋicwofuŋte mamanasu soŋaŋkeekac.
Ŋic nâŋâc wiac ebac eeŋgopeneŋ sâc i manapene sâckeekac, Wofuŋzi ine fuŋne weniŋucte wiac eeŋgopeneŋ i hone mana tarac eekac.
Wofuŋ e taha bâzire mâcne, bâbâtiŋ â tiŋne juju biaŋne irec maname fefene eekac, irec go wiac sasawa fâretiŋ jaha ebac efârezemec.
Pepec ʒâŋe fifi â maŋfefe ee, wiac sâqocne izi hâcne ŋic sindaŋne mufuac‐jopaekac.
Go giege aijakic jaha manasu biric ehuc batec fârine bocjaha fua‐gareocmu, â fâro faio bahuc ine fârine basacmu.
Go sioc ehuc mafa mâriri bâfuaekomec izi mi ʒoraha hâmocte micko râecgurâ mocwâc omaeocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe eebapa tiŋne qikiŋneeŋgopieŋte jaŋacne eebapa repicnezi bitiŋ ejareha raʒipie kicjopaekac.
Kiŋ bahac bâfuaeŋgopieŋzi hata hehesicnao raeŋgopieŋ, bahac fâsâc jaŋe ine wiac ebac epie tiŋke biaŋ efâreekac.
Ŋokac râŋgeŋne ehec fic biaŋnao juju izi wiac wawahane eekac, â e tâmiric kâte bozeo buc juju izi ine wiac fefene eekac.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe dameŋ sâc wiac hehesicnere boc ejareekac, jaŋe ŋic mocte busâqoc moc mi manaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic mu âke sisicne qa bâtiŋ ejarepie mutucne jaŋe honerâ mamanahec eniŋmu, ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe ine wiac qazu‐jarepie ʒuhuckerâ mamana fua‐jareocmu.
Tiŋne rune e ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere mamanasu hone manac efâreekac, ehuc sisipiricko râec‐jopaekac.
Ŋic moc e hapetac jaŋere wira wâwâsicte hazec mi râeocmuo ine juku e jahacnere wira wâwâsic eme e wâc iŋuc jaha mi bafickezo.
Ŋic moczi gore aaric manahame go soŋsoŋko wiac moc râcne tahac etec aaric‐ticne qaʒue wahaocmu.
Mumutiŋ gie biaŋne bapie ŋic tiŋne jaŋe bubiaŋ mananiŋmu, â ŋic hehesicne jaŋe ine bipic tatara ejareocmu.
Ŋic moc e mamana biaŋne qikiŋneocmuzi hâmokicne jaŋe qâtec‐jopaocmu.
Ŋic moc e sahacte wiacko mamaŋ gugutuŋ hurâ juhuc waiŋ â nânâ wiac nâ râmbe eocmuzi ŋic mafa sâkohec mi juocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ŋic tiŋne jaŋere faio wiac ʒârâ ʒâpânehec râezo mueŋgopieŋ izi ŋerisierâ jaŋe jaŋacne faio feekac.
Ŋokac râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne â hâdi boŋkekicne ehec juju i wiac wawahane, â mâreŋ burocnao buc juju izi ine wiac fefene.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe moneŋ mafa wiac‐jeŋic biaŋne qâzuckepie fojareekac, â ŋic mutuc matacne â iric iricne jaŋe ine bâfuaeŋgopieŋ sâc kosa behepie rafâreekac.
Ŋic moc e tiŋne juju â miriŋ babac ee irec henʒiriŋneocmuzi ʒâŋe biŋehec erâ juhâmoocmu.
Momori ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi ŋic tâpirihec jaŋere haesac sanaŋ henʒaŋ qanʒaŋneocmu, ehuc hae sanaŋ‐jeŋic ro rauc sâcne eocmu.
Ŋic moc e micticne soŋaŋkeocmuzi ʒârâ hâriŋ faio boc mi feocmu.
Sahac fefe juhuc pepec penaroŋ â picʒoŋ eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere “ŋic mu âke sisicne” muzo.
Ŋic moc e giere takickeme ojoŋ juocmuzi e jahacne sahac sipirickeocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe dameŋ sâc ŋic âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋere wâcwiac irec andac eeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ine wiac‐jeŋic mi sakarehuc buafec jaha qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe taha bâzi rikepie Wofuŋzi maname mamakâcne eekac, jaŋe maŋjeŋicko wiac qame gâpâcne foha bâzi rikepie iŋuc hâcne mana‐jareekac.
Mumutaniŋ ŋic burecnezi sipirickeocmu, â moc e dâŋticne manatâc qâtâc ehuc fâretiŋ jaha muocmuzi ine juhâc qâhâmoocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe râsi ʒâŋe fieŋgopieŋ, â ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ine hata‐jeŋic mana taraeŋgopieŋ.
Maŋɋârâŋ â mamana tara erâ mumutâc dâŋ biaŋne wiac i sasawa Wofuŋte maio wiac omane efâreekac.
Ŋoŋe becâsicfâc‐ŋeŋic ʒikare baʒawiec‐jopazo murâ baʒawiec‐jopanʒepieŋ, â ʒikao sasanaŋ bâbâfua i ine Wofuŋzi bâfua‐ŋareocmu.
Ŋoŋe moneŋ mafa sâkohec eniŋte mâcne, ʒâŋe biŋehec juniŋte eŋarezejec, â ŋic jaŋe bubiaŋ qaŋareniŋmu irec manapie fefene eha siliwa â gol irec manapie wawahane ezejec.
Wofuŋzi mafaŋic â hapetac mâmâc bâfuac‐jopawecte fuŋne‐jekic bârâwiŋ mi fokac.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe sisipiriczi maic‐jopame honerâ kizueŋgopieŋ, â ŋic maŋɋârâŋ tâmiric jaŋe ine hone‐bipiehuc rarâ sipirickeeŋgopieŋ.
Go maŋhuhuŋ juhuc Wofuŋ araŋ bacnetec moneŋ mafa â ʒâŋe biŋe fua‐gareme dameŋ ʒora juhâc qâhâmocmu.
Go jujuge ŋezickezo murâ ine hata heririŋko wiwitic wiac râepie foha ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe raʒipie kicjopaekac i kizuzemec.
Go naru motec jaŋe juju hata biaŋne qazu‐jarezemec, eme jaŋe jufeniŋmu sâc irec manasuhuc juniŋmu.
Ŋic moneŋ mafahec jaŋe ŋic hapetac ŋicbomboŋ ejareeŋgopieŋ, â moneŋ hotâ roeŋgopieŋ jaŋe moneŋ jareeŋgopieŋ jaŋere mic sâcko gie baeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic moc e wiac sindaŋnere gie baocmu e juku irec fârine sisipiric roocmu, bâbâtiŋ hâhâwicnezi fuacnehuc bâsiroweocmu hâcne.
Ŋic moc e afeckerâ nânâ wiac‐ticne ŋic hapetac kâdoc qajareocmu e jambuŋkezo.
Ŋic mu âke sisicne e jâpepie raha ŋoŋerao ʒika â mu qaqatarac erâ mumusifuc wiac gâcne i wâc omaeocmu.
Ŋic dâŋ wokemaŋnehec mueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ŋicwofuŋzi âgo ejareekac, â Wofuŋzi maŋ ɋaɋacne jueŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋere maname biaŋkeekac.
Wofuŋ e ŋic mamana tarahec jaŋere dâŋ dopeckeekac, â burecŋic jaŋere dâŋ ine qame wahaekac.
Ŋic ojoŋnezi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc ficko ŋeekac: “Laioŋzi hae ʒoŋao jukacte huhape nâcnuzackohec.”
Boe sau ŋokac ere dâŋ i nombâŋ iŋucne, irec Wofuŋzi qaisoc‐jopaekac jaŋe ira hâcne hueŋgopieŋ.
Naru motec jaŋe ɋieonecteaŋ fuŋkerâ wiac mutucne kosa eeŋgopieŋ, ehame bâbâtiŋko râec‐jopapene ine beherâ sâcne mac jueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic moneŋ mafa sâkohec wiac jare tahac eniŋmuo me ŋaŋac mafa mâririhec eniŋte ŋic hapetac bâʒâic‐jopaniŋmuo ine ŋoŋe ŋaŋacne hapetac erâ juniŋmu.
Go hazec râehaŋtec ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe dâŋ gâcne mumbiŋ i qazu‐garepe mamana gie bazemec.
Go iŋuc erâ ʒâhec manasuhuc ŋic gâcne jaza qazuc ehuc bubiaŋ manacmu.
Go Wofuŋtao roweckecmurâ manasuhuc maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ ʒi hâcne gaza mutâc ekopac.
No gore erâ maŋɋârâŋ â mumutâc dâŋ 30 sâko qâreŋkepo.
Erâ no dâŋ fâri qizecne qazu‐garepemu wâc, eme go irec mu wioc egarepie okacne bâtikie‐jarecmurâ mi eipiecmu.
Go ŋic hapetac e hapetac juekacte wiac‐ticne kâŋgâc mi jâoc rozemec, â ŋic moc e dâŋgieo wiʒec tâmiric domaha mu bawahac mi ecnezemec.
Wofuŋzi ŋic iŋucne jaŋe bafic‐jopahuc juju‐jeŋic jowac roeŋgopieŋ jaŋere juju jowac roocmu hâcne.
Go ŋic maŋʒochec jaŋe âgo mi ejarezemec.
Go jaŋere eebapazi bitiŋ egareha raʒitec kicguzacte jaŋerao mi qohotazemec.
Go ŋic mocte tofa bazucmurâ moc mi mupaŋkezemec.
Manakic, go mumupaŋgere fârine bâfuazo eipiehuc juhaŋtec wiac gâcne gowac rohuc fofo mâkige wâc mâmâc gowac roniŋmu.
Apa ŋosafâcge jaŋe mâreŋ ma râembiŋ i baʒic baefuc mi ezemec.
Ŋic moc e gie‐ticne basarickehuc baocmu e ŋic omane jaŋe mâcne, ŋicwofuŋ kiŋaŋ qaqajare irec sâc bâfuaocmu.
Go ŋic fekicne moc ehec nânâ nâcmuo ine ŋic weniŋucne ehec ŋekopac i manasuzemec.
Ehuc go nânâ bocjaha nâekicko sifu âmbâŋ mi nâzemec.
E esâicguhuc nânâ aŋacne râe bâmoc eha go hone fâfârerâ gapec tâmiric mi nâzemec.
Go maŋɋârâŋhec juhuc moneŋ mafa sâko bâfuacmurâ tâpirige mi sipirickezemec.
Manakic, tucwipezi furuc furuc qahuc ratâmireekac irec sâc jaha moneŋ mafagezi fakecnehec erâ ratâmireocmu.
Go ŋic buchâro ehec nânâ mi nâzemec, me nânâ aŋacne râe bâmoc eekac irec andac wâc boc mi ezemec.
E nânâ garehuc ŋifec ine upegao baocmu. Ehuc maŋticnezi gorao mi domaha miczi burec erâ ʒiŋuc gazahuc eatucguocmu: “Ware nânâ opâ nâc.”
Go ere nânâ wiac nârâ maŋucmu, ehuc daŋgedâŋ âzâcnetec fârimâc eocmu.
Go ŋic mutuc matacne ere maio dâŋ mi muzemec, e maŋɋârâŋ dâŋge mi mana tarahuc qaisockeocmu.
Apa ŋosafâcge jaŋe mâreŋ ma râembiŋ i baʒic baefuc mi ezemec, erâ bekâ mâsiŋ jaŋere mâreŋ wâc mi jowac rozemec.
Wofuŋ e jaŋere ŋeŋezic hâcne, irec dâŋgieo jaŋere dâŋ dopeckehuc gore dâŋ bawahaocmu.
Go qaqazugere dâŋte hazec râehuc tâpiri fogarekac sâc mamana gie bazemec.
Go naru motec bâtiŋ‐jopazore manabâc mi ezemec, jaŋe kâcbiŋ kirâ mi hâmoniŋmu,
aricne, kâcbiŋ kirâ juju bapa‐jeŋic biaŋkeocmu.
O motec‐mae, go maŋɋârâŋhec erâ jucmuo ine bunane biaŋkeocmu.
Micbipicgaonec maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ wahame manarâ ʒeri bari epemu.
Go sâqocne bapa jaŋere erâ maŋge mi bâruŋkezejec, Wofuŋ ine dameŋ sâc araŋ bacnehuc juzemec.
Go iŋuc ehuc juhaŋte woworicgezi mi omaeocmu.
O motec‐mae, no gazape manac: Go maŋɋârâŋhec juzemec, ehuc hata fâretiŋko jaha maŋ mamanasuge râetec fozejec.
Go ŋic waiŋ âmbâŋ nânâ me nânâ gapecmâc nâeŋgopieŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko boc mi juzemec.
Opâ sanaŋ â bec qowi âmbâŋ nânâ ŋic i jaŋe hapetac erâ juniŋmu, ehuc ojoŋ fohuc ŋaqi qoruc basaniŋmu.
Go mamac bâbâfuage ere dâŋ manahuc juzemec, â neŋgocgezi ŋokac qizec erâ juha mi qaisockezemec.
Go dâŋ fâri qizecne, maŋɋârâŋ, maŋsowa juju â mamana tara i furine barâ bajuhuc moneŋte erâ mocwâc mi qikiŋnezemec.
Ŋic tiŋnere mamaczi ʒeri eocmu, â ŋic moc e motec‐ticnezi maŋɋârâŋhec jume bubiaŋ manaocmu.
Go juju bapagezi neŋgoc mamac jahecge bubiaŋ qajactezemec, ehame neŋgoc rorogezi gore erâ ʒeri bari ezejec.
O motec‐mae, go maŋge norao râetec fooc, ehame kike hata‐nane honehuc juzemec.
Hata ŋokac iriŋ biriŋne â sasec ŋokac jaŋe bitiŋ egarehapie raʒitec kihâmocguocmu:
Ŋokac i jaŋe hâcne fiuc roro ŋic jaŋe iŋucne ruc bahuc jueŋgopieŋ, ehuc ŋic bocjaha eatuc‐jopapie ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic behec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Mozi ʒârâ ʒâpâo â busâqoc faio juekac, me mozi mu qaqatarac â muheŋɋâŋhec juekac, me mozi fuŋne tâmiricko wic fuacneekac, me mozi ʒâŋe bâruŋhec juekac?
Waiŋ opâ nâhuc ŋehapie ŋafe ʒâŋiŋkeekac, erâ waiŋ opâ fuŋne fuŋne bâsifuckerâ nâeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe hâcne wiac i fua‐jareekac.
Go waiŋ opâ bâbâroŋ â ɋaɋac taeŋne i opâ nânâ kiruŋko du âtehuc wefume hone aŋac erâ sifu âmbâŋ mi nâzemec.
Manakic, go waiŋ opâ gapecmâc nâku guŋ fohaŋtec hae fureme manatec homa momorizi kicnume huc fua‐nareekac irec sâc egareocmu.
Ehame ʒâŋege bâniniŋkeme wiac ʒâŋe furu honecmu, erâ mamanasuge sifuckeha dâŋ musifuckecmu.
Go ŋic moczi wokeo rahuc maŋuekac, â hâwec siri sâko qaha jâmâ wâtuŋko wiserâ feekac irec sâc ecmu.
Ehuc kecʒiŋuc mucmu: “Ŋic jaŋe mi manahape numbieŋ mecne, jaŋe qa bâʒâic enarembieŋ me weniŋuc i mi manasukopac. No wemocte mi ɋârekopac? No waiŋ opâ ʒuhuckerâ nâzore enarekac.”
Go ŋic hehesicne jaŋe iiŋguuŋ mi ejarezemec, ehuc jaŋehec ââgo ecmurâ mi fotariezemec.
Jaŋe bâbâʒâic gie baniŋte maŋjeŋic domaekac, â micjeŋickonec dâŋ wahaekac i sisipiric dâŋ sasawa.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi ficticne basarickeocmu, â ŋic mamanaheczi ficticne basanaŋkeme ŋehuc juocmu.
Ŋic mamana sarichec e ficticne maŋne maŋne ba bâpiaŋ ehuc wiac furi sâko râe raocmu.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi ŋic sasanaŋhec sirickeekac, â ŋic mamanaheczi ŋic tâpirihec ere sâc jâuruekac.
Go maŋɋârâŋ dâŋzi basanaŋgupie ʒikao sâcne racmu, â dâŋ biaŋne bocjaha mutâcne‐garepie irec sâcko ʒika qahuc sâcne sanaŋkecmu.
Maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ i ŋic mutuc matacne ere sâc sirickeekac, irec e tutumaŋko dâŋwiac fârine muc manac ehapie dâŋ biaŋne moc muocte quŋkeocmu.
Ŋic moc e wiac hehesicne eocte mana biric eocmu ere ŋic sindaŋne muniŋmu.
Ŋic mutuc matacnezi wiac kosa manasu biric eme sâqoreekac, â ŋic mu âke sisicne ere ine manapie mamakâcne eocmu.
Go dameŋ biaŋnao docke betaŋ ecmuo ine dameŋ ŋemâcnao iŋuc jaha betaŋke‐jâmbâŋkecmu.
Go ŋic moc hâmocko râezo ehapie mejeŋickonec bataracmurâ mâcne afecne mi ezemec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc wâc mi muzemec: “No ŋic e mi manakopac.” Manakic, Anutu e dâŋ iŋucne i weniŋucte mukomec i manakac, e maŋgere fuŋne manahuc hone jâjâpecguekac. Eki hâcne ŋic eebapa‐jeŋicte okacne bazu‐jareekac.
Motec‐mae, go baŋac nâzemec, baŋac i wiac biaŋne hâcne. Baŋac opâne qâŋnaonec ro nâc etec maracgao aŋacne eocmu.
Eme go irec sâc jaha mamana tara â maŋɋârâŋ mana maŋ etec maŋ qâqâtâcge bâpiaŋkezejec.
Go ŋic tiŋne ere wiac fiuc rocmurâ ficticne mi somâckezemec, me fic hae‐ticne wâc mi hetâtiezemec.
Manakic, ŋic tiŋne e gâbâ jaha waha qarâ sifu mocwâc fahareekac, â ŋic sindaŋne e ine sisipiriczi bâsiroweocmu.
Go kisâge wiac hâhâwicne fuacnehame bubiaŋ mi manazemec.
Go iŋuc etec Wofuŋzi honerâ maname mi sâckeha kisâge ŋezickezacte iŋuc mi ezemec.
Go ŋic hehesicne jaŋere erâ maŋge mi faharezejec, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe wâc iiŋguuŋ mi ejarezemec.
Ŋic hehesicne jaŋe juku omaeniŋmu â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere lambe tatamac i hâpoocmu.
O motec‐mae, go Wofuŋ â ŋicwofuŋ jahe mâmâc jaha araŋ bajactezemec, ehuc dâŋjekic qataraeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋere ŋondeŋko mi juzemec.
Sisipiriczi ŋic iŋucne jaŋe ututuŋ jaha maic‐jopaocmu. Ehame Wofuŋ â ŋicwofuŋ jaheraonec sisipiric weniŋucne fuaocmu i goki moc manakic me?
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋ wâc: Mumutara ŋic e ŋic bârâwiŋ‐joparâ gâcne jaŋere dâŋ muafeckehuc gâcne jaŋere mu mâmâckeme mi sâckeocmu.
E ŋic bahachec jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazaocmu mecne: “Ŋoŋe bahac tâmiric,” iŋuc jazame mâreŋ sâc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe e qaisockehuc sâweckeniŋmu.
Â ŋic bahachec bâtiŋ‐jopaniŋmu mumutara ŋic i jaŋere ʒâŋe biŋe feha bubiaŋ manahuc juhâc qâhâmoniŋmu.
Dâŋ okacne fâretiŋ jaha mumu izi maŋ mocjaha jujure ma ekac.
Go qanaŋ hae ʒoŋage emasaŋkerâ nânâ giege he sarac ezemec, izi ʒâhec ine ficge bazemec.
Go fuŋne tâmiricko ŋic âgoge dâŋgieo mi râezemec, erâ dâŋticne wâc mi muhasickezemec.
Go ʒiŋuc mi muzemec: “E wiac enarewec irec sâc jaha ecnezepac, no okacne bazucnepemu hâcne.”
No ŋic ojoŋne â mutuc matacne ere giegaŋ â waiŋ gie fotâcnerâ rahuc wiac ʒiŋuc honepo:
Giegaŋ‐ticne i ʒârâ uupic â hofâ qinʒiŋzi sâcke‐fârewec, â râreckerâ sac fowec i ʒaŋke‐fârewec.
Eme no iŋuc honerâ manatâc qâtâc ehuc ʒiŋuc mana tarapo:
No rarâ guŋ piticne fopemu me ŋemanahuc sawa ropemuo
ine hapetac jujuzi fiuc roro iŋucne maicnuocmu â roroczi ʒikaŋic iŋucne fisi‐nareocmu.
Salomore muqâqiŋ dâŋ gâcne Juda ŋicwofuŋ Hisikiare qâreŋŋicfâc jaŋe qâreŋkembiŋ ʒine hâcne.
Anutu e wiac sasawa maŋbuc‐ticne maname foekacte araŋ bacneeŋgopeneŋ, â ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe ine wiac nâzâ mutâc eeŋgopieŋ irec sâsec‐jopaeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe maŋjeŋicko dâŋ weniŋuc foekac i mi manaeŋgopeneŋ, jaŋere mamanasu i nâŋâcne mamanasu sirickeekac, i qânikiŋ faic jâmbâŋ ferâ fokac â hâwec fâhâŋne juwic jâmbâŋ hurâ fokac irec sâc.
Ŋoŋe siliwa ʒocko rikepie wosâeme metâ bapazi wiac biaŋne i me i bazo murâ sâcne baocmu.
Ŋoŋe ŋic sindaŋne ŋicwofuŋte maionec bârâriec‐jopahapie guriŋ bapa gie‐ticne fâretiŋ jaha sâcne bahuc juocmu.
Go ŋicwofuŋte maio sahacge mi bafezemec, â ŋic fekicne jaŋe wâc mi âkehoc‐jopazemec.
Manakic, jaŋe ʒiŋuc gazapie sâckeocmu: “Go ʒira ware mai jaha ŋec,” ŋic fekicne ere maio ŋeŋege ŋic mocte biŋe qikiŋnecmurâ gazapie miminehec eocmu.
Go wiac hone manac eekic i acmâc jaha tutumaŋko mi muzemec, i ʒâhec ŋic moczi fuarâ goki dâŋ mucmu irec fuŋne bataniŋkehuc mimi busâqoc bâfua‐gareme weniŋuc ecmu?
Go âgogehec dâŋŋekic fokacko ine ehec mufâsâezepirec, ehuc ŋic mocte fuŋne mi mufuazemec.
Iŋuc mi ecmuo ine dâŋge mananiŋmu jaŋe mimi qaqa egarepie ʒâŋe biŋege sâqorerâ fohuc juocmu.
Dâŋ musarickehuc mukicne i ʒuŋe gâpiŋ ʒeŋaŋhec mâmâc râekicne irec sâc.
Ŋic mamanahec moczi ŋic âgo‐ticne hazec râeha uŋ sawaŋ ecneocmu ere manapene furi sâko ezejec.
Ʒoaŋ fârorocko opâ mâteŋne nâpene bâgunuc‐nâpoekac irec sâc jaha biŋedâŋ baraekac kiŋaŋŋic metâne eki bomboŋ‐ticne ecneekac.
Taha wiac râeniŋte dâŋ sawa muhuc fârine mi bâfuaeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe mâŋâŋzi karorac ficneme omaeha hoe mi heekac irec sâc.
Ŋic fekicne ere maio rumerâ juhuc dâŋ âzâcnekupene maŋticne urueme mana‐nâreocmu.
Go baŋac bâfuarâ aŋacte sâc sawa nâzemec, irec sâc jâuruhuc nâcmuo ine maŋucmu.
Go ŋic âgoge riŋkoa sawa iqickezemec, gâbâ jaha iqicketec gore takickeme qaisocguzacte.
Ŋic moc e ŋic âgo‐ticne micko âkec ecneocmu e ʒika me qândiŋ me tepe motec micneheczi hâhâmocko kiekac irec sâc eocmu.
Dameŋ ŋemâcnao doc bapa ŋic moctao rorowecke izi ine micsiec‐nâŋec goroc goroc eha ɋoza nâeŋgopeneŋ, me kike‐nâŋec demba qame hata raeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc ekac.
Me mutuc erâ mâmâteŋ dameŋko hâroŋkenʒepeneŋ muhuc ŋaqi qoruc wiac‐nâŋec hetaranaŋmu irec sâc eocmu. Ŋic moc e maŋ kukumbuc faio juha gae hecnepene ine hâweczi wic ʒaekac irec sâc eocmu.
Râsige nânâre hâmoha nânâ gumezemec, â opâre hâmoha opâ gumezemec.
Go iŋuc ecnetec mimiehuc ʒara mara eha Wofuŋzi okacne bazu‐gareocmu.
Murazi karorac ficne sueme qâhâckerâ hoe heekac irec sâc jaha gupe micko âkeczi aaric bâfuaekac.
Ŋokac râŋgeŋne ehec fic biaŋnao juju izi wiac wawahane eekac, â e tâmiric kâte bozeo buc juju izi ine wiac fefene eekac.
Mâreŋ ʒorickonec biŋe biaŋ wareme mamana izi ine opâre hâmohuc opâ mâteŋne nâpene bâgunuc‐nâpoekac irec sâc ekac.
Ŋic tiŋne moc e ŋic hehesicne dockecneocmu e opâ ʒâŋe sohoŋnehec me opâ nombâŋko marasiŋ sâqocne behepene hume opâ sâqoreekac irec sâc eocmu.
Go baŋac bocjaha nâtec mi sâckeocmu iŋuc jaha ŋic jaŋe mumbiaŋguniŋte ʒoɋac ejaretec mi sâckeocmu.
Go kimbeŋ aaricge mi bawahacmuo ine hae moc sac tâmiric ŋeocmu irec sâc ecmu; hae iŋucne i râsi jaŋe fisirâ qa heropiec eniŋmu.
Ʒoaŋ dameŋko hoe micsâko heme mi biaŋkeekac, me hoe dameŋko ʒoaŋ ʒâʒâicne qame wâc mi sâckeekac iŋuc jaha ŋic mutuc matacne mumbiaŋkepene mi sâckeocmu.
Fuŋne tâmiricko sâwec‐nâpopie fâri tâmiric eocmu, wiac i sawa hehetâc wipe jaŋe hehetâcnehuc nâworueŋgopieŋ irec sâc ekac.
Becâsiczi kâcbiŋ kizejec â doŋgi micko kiki râecnezo erâ ŋic mutucne qa bâtiŋ ecnezo.
Go ŋic mutucne wiwio‐ticnere okacne bâtikiecnecmuo ine go gahacne wâc e iŋucne mutuc jaha ecmu.
Ŋic moczi e jahacnere maname maŋɋârâŋhec jukopac, iŋuc ezacte go wiwio‐ticne mutucnere okacne mutucne jaha bâtikiecnezemec.
Ŋic moczi ŋic mutucne moc biŋedâŋ‐ticne baraocte soreocmu ere manapene e jahacne kike hetâcnekac irec sâc eocmu; e iŋuc ehuc sisipiric hotâckeocmu hâcne.
Ŋic mutuc matacnezi muqâqiŋ dâŋ muocmu i ŋic moczi kike‐ticne demba qame hata raekac irec sâc eocmu.
Ŋic moczi ŋic mutucne mumbiaŋkeocmu e ine ŋic moczi mutuc erâ tacbaŋko qânâ basanaŋkeme mi raekac ere sâc eocmu.
Ŋic mutuc matacne moczi maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ muocmu e ŋic moc opâ sanaŋ nâku maŋne sifuckeme meticnaonec ʒârâ unuckeocte eipieocmu irec sâc eocmu.
Ŋic moczi ŋic mutucne moc rorâ kiŋaŋ qaqa‐ticne baocmu e ŋic hatapecne fotâcnehapie kosa muruc‐jopaekac ŋic ere sâc eocmu.
Ŋic mutuc matacne moczi wiac mutucne eha arec jajahec eocmu e qâtozi nânâ wiac maŋurâ mocwâc risierâ nâekac irec sâc eocmu.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋ tâmiric moczi no maŋɋârâŋhec jukopac muhame ŋic mutucne jâmbâŋ moczi ere sâc sirickehuc biaŋne juocmu.
Ŋic ojoŋnezi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc ficko feekac: “Laioŋzi hae ʒoŋao jukac.”
Motâczi beŋgu hahasic‐ticnao domahuc rac warec eekac irec sâc jaha ŋic ojoŋnezi fofo‐ticnao fohuc foc forisic eekac.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe qâoma sâko ehuc nânâ wiac micjeŋicko râeniŋte takic‐jopame mâc ŋeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic ojoŋnezi e jahacnere maname feha ŋic 7 jaŋe maŋ mamanasu‐jeŋicko dâŋ fokac i mufuapie maname wawahane ekac.
Ŋic moc e ŋic âgo‐ticnere dâŋ muocte mi manacnehapie sifu muocmu e ŋic moczi hatao rahuc qâto furune moc hazecnao roocmu ere sâc eocmu.
Ŋic moczi ŋic âgo‐ticne eatuckerâ ʒiŋuc muocmu: “No mâc ʒoraŋ sawa ekopac,” e ŋic mutuc matacne moczi ʒoc kosa turuŋkeme wiac ʒafâreekac me tepe motec kosa qâtâcneme raekac ere sâc eocmu.
<range>
Ʒoc mocwâc mi henusuckepene hâpoocmu, â gupe micko âkec behepene dâŋ mu qaqataraczi wâc omaeocmu.
Ʒoc râqâcnere kinezi ʒoc tucne qâhâsâekac â ʒoc henusuckepene ʒahuc foekac irec sâc jaha ŋic râŋgeŋnezi qaqatara bâfuaekac.
Ŋic nâŋâc gupe micko âkec ee irec manapene afeckeha boc bajueŋgopeneŋ.
Eeatuc dâŋ muhuc maŋ mamanasu‐nâŋecte fuŋne jâmbâŋ hesoŋkenaŋmuo ine afezi hapec dodocne bahuc sahacnao qâreŋ wiac baeŋgopieŋ irec sâc enaŋmu.
Ŋic moczi qaisocguocmu e maŋticnao eeatuc foha micbipiczi sawa wokemaŋ dâŋ gazaocmu.
E dâŋ mume manatec aŋac baŋacne eocmu mecne, erâ ine qaqaisoc dâŋzi maŋnao fusucmarâ fokacte dâŋticne mi mana ʒakiezemec.
E qaqaisoc dâŋticne hesoŋkeocmu mecne, erâ sifu wiac hehesicne ebac eekac i ŋic jaŋe hone manac eeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic hehesicne moc e ŋic gâcne jaŋere nombâŋ roocmuzi e jahac juocmu, â moc e mâreŋ ŋedumerâ ŋic ŋemac‐jopaocte gufume e jahacne ŋemackeocmu.
Go ŋic moc qaisockerâ burec ecnehuc sipirickecmu; dâŋ gâgâpâcnezi sisipiric bâfuaekac hâcne.
Go tomâckore manasuhuc sahac fefe mi ezemec. Tomâcko wiac iŋuc me iŋuc fuaocmu i go mi manaekic.
Go gahac sahacge mi mumbiaŋkezemec, ŋic gâcne jaŋe mumbiaŋgupie sâckeocmu.
Qânâ i wiac ŋemâcne â moŋgeŋ i wâc wiac ŋemâcne jaha, erâ sifu ŋic mutucne moczi maŋbâiŋ enâreocmu i jahere sâc sirickerâ mocwâc ŋemâcne jâmbâŋ eocmu.
Aaric i wiac gâgâpâcne â sisipiric‐ticnehec, mamanauŋzi ine irec sâc jâururâ mocwâc mamakâcne jâmbâŋ ekac.
Hofao mu bâtiŋ ee izi wiac biaŋne, â maŋjauŋ aputacne izi ine wiac fâri tâmiric.
Âgogezi bâʒâicgume manatec mi sâqorezejec, â râsigezi hâpo qâqâic egareme ine rucge bazemec.
Ŋic moc e nânâ wiac gâcne nâ gapec erâ baŋacte maname aŋacmâc eocmu, â moc e ine nânâre hâmo sâqorehuc wiac hâtânere wâc maname aŋacne eha nâocmu.
Ŋic moc e fic hae‐ticne beherâ kosa juocmu e wipe jaŋe sareŋ‐jeŋic beherâ sawao rac warec ehuc jueŋgopieŋ irec sâc eocmu.
Wokemaŋ âsu â huc âsu izi bubiaŋ bâfua‐nâreekac, â wiac ʒârâ hâriŋneheczi ine busâqoc bâfua‐nâreekac.
Go gahacne âgofâc me mamacgere âgofâc jaŋere mi nikecguzejec. Go ʒârâ hâriŋ faio juhuc hahac ɋafâcge jaŋe baficguniŋte mi numu‐jarezemec; jaŋe ʒoricko juhapie âgoge moczi bembeŋko juhuc baficgume biaŋkeocmu.
O motec‐mae, go maŋɋârâŋhec jutec bunane biaŋkezejec, ehame nore dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ jaŋe okacne sâcne bâtikie‐jarepemu.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe sisipiriczi maic‐jopame hone tarahuc kizueŋgopieŋ; â ŋic maŋɋârâŋ tâmiric jaŋe ine hone‐bipiehuc rarâ sipirickeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic moczi mutuc erâ ŋic âgo‐ticnere tofa bazuocte mupaŋkeocmuo ine ŋaqi qoruc wiac‐ticne hotâ jâoc rorâ râepene foha mumupaŋ‐ticnere fârine bâfuazejec.
Go furi uupicte hahaŋne bahuc âgoge wiracnerâ furi biaŋ âzâcnetec maname sâwecnukac tinac eocmu.
Ŋokac râŋgeŋnere dâŋ i hoe micpiic furicte erâ hehuc domaha hae ŋafeekac irec sâc ehuc tatakic bâfua‐nâreekac.
Manakic, ŋic moc e mâŋâŋ bâniniŋkeocmu me mefâre‐ticnezi wokemaŋ opâne basanaŋkeocmu e ŋokac iŋucnere dâŋ wâc sâcne bâniniŋkeocmu.
Wiac aeŋzi bakicne i aeŋzia ʒâmueŋgopeneŋ irec sâc jaha nâŋâc ŋic âgofâc‐nâŋec jaŋeraonec mamana roeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋic moc e nemuja jâc hone soŋaŋ ecneocmuzi fârine fuame sâcne nâocmu, â kiŋaŋ qaqa moc e bomboŋ‐ticne hone bafic ecneocmu e irec furine roocmu.
Nâŋâc opâo fipene hume mumuc‐nâŋec jaha honeeŋgopeneŋ, iŋuc jaha maŋnâŋecko fipene hume fuŋne‐nâŋec hone taraeŋgopeneŋ.
Hâmoc haezi ŋic ʒuʒuhuc jaha rocjopaocte ecneekac, irec sâc jaha ŋic ʒâŋe‐nâŋeczi wiac ʒâŋe furu honeocte boc ecneekac.
Siliwa â gol i ʒocko rike esâic eeŋgopeneŋ, ŋicte fuŋne ine ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnezi bataniŋkeekac.
Go ŋic mutuc matacne qâhâmozo qatecne mutuc‐ticnezi sifu mi omaeocmu.
Ŋicne ŋicne nâŋâc juju sanaŋ mi jueŋgopeneŋ, iŋuc jaha mafa mâriri i wâc fofo sanaŋ mi foekac, irec go lama bulimakaofâcge hone soŋaŋ biaŋne ejarezemec.
<range>
Ehuc sapao nânâ wiac‐jeŋic saratec fuame râec‐jopatec nâhuc fua sawec enʒepieŋ.
Go iŋuc etec lama kanʒaŋnezi ŋaqi qoruc bâfua‐gareocmu, â noniŋfâcge gâcne jaŋe moneŋte râec‐jopatec moneŋ fuaocmu izi mâreŋ ɋâricne kitâcne‐gareocmu.
Ehame noniŋ gâcne jaŋere susuzi ine go gahacne â wiacfâcge erâ kiŋaŋ narufâcge ŋoŋere nânâ eocmu.
