Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe moczi mi jâpec‐jopaha jaŋac wiseeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ine laioŋ iŋucne sanaŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic guru moc jaŋe micne‐jeŋiczi mamana â maŋɋârâŋhec juhuc guriŋ bajareha sâcne sanaŋkerâ juniŋmu, â guru moc jaŋe qaqatara â hehesic boc bâfuapie micnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe bâipiec‐joparâ ââkehoc eniŋmu.
Guriŋ bapa ŋic moczi ŋic hapetac bâʒâic‐jopaocmu e hoe mâŋâŋ sâkozi giegaŋ ima baekac irec sâc eocmu.
Ŋoŋe sâcmutâc dâŋ qatarahuc ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe bafic‐jopaniŋmu, â sâcmutâc dâŋ mana rereŋ eniŋmuo ine râsi ejareniŋmu.
Ŋic hehesicne jaŋe tiŋne hata kâuc baeŋgopieŋ, â Wofuŋ araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine mana taraeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic hapetaczi siocmâc juocmu ere manapene fefene eocmu, â ŋic moneŋ mafa sâkoheczi siochec juocmu ere ine manapene wawahane eocmu.
Ŋicmotec moc e sâcmutâc dâŋ mana rereŋ eocmuzi maŋɋârâŋhec juocmu, â moc e ŋic kosa jujune jaŋe âgo ejareocmuzi ine mamac‐ticne mimi qaqa ecneocmu.
Ŋic moc e ŋic âgofâc‐ticne eatuc‐jopahuc wiac‐jeŋic sâctiri jowac rorâ e jahacne moneŋ mafa bâsokaocmuo ine Anutuzi mocwâc jâoc rorâ ŋic hapetac jare tahac eocmu.
Ŋic moczi sâcmutâc dâŋ mana rereŋ mi eocmu e Anutuzi nunumu‐ticnere maname mamakâcne eocmu.
Go ŋic sioc tâmiric moczi hata hehesicnao raocte manasuhuc doc barâ nombâŋ romeŋ ira go gahac hucmu; â bahac tâmiriczi ine furi sâko roocmu.
Ŋic moneŋ mafa sâkohec jaŋe jaŋacne manapie maŋɋârâŋhec juŋgopeneŋ eekac, â ŋic hapetac mamana tarahec jaŋe ine fuŋne‐jeŋic hone taraeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe guriŋ bapa gie‐jeŋic tâpirihec bapie ŋic jaŋe ʒeŋgoma ʒeri eniŋmu, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe guriŋ bapa gie bapie ine ŋic jaŋe soŋkeniŋmu.
Ŋic moc e bahac‐ticne hesoŋkeocmuzi mi juhâmoocmu, â moc e bahac‐ticne mufuarâ râpeckeha Anutuzi aki anonoc ecneocmu.
Ŋic moc e Wofuŋ araŋ bacneocmu ere manapene ʒerine eocmu, â moc e maŋrâŋgeŋ bâfuaocmuzi ine sipirickeocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne moczi ŋic hapetac guriŋ bajareha bititieniŋmu, e laioŋ â bea jahe nânâ opâre hâmohuc momori eekopirec irec sâc eocmu hâcne.
Guriŋ bapa ŋic moczi mamana tâmiric juhuc ŋic ʒâʒâicne eocmu, â moc e sioc wiac qikiŋneocmuzi ine guriŋ bapa gie‐ticne dameŋ ʒora barahuc juocmu.
Ŋic moc e ŋic âgonere soc hoŋkewecko ine ŋic moczi moc mi bafickeha wise wise jukuhame hâmoc dameŋ‐ticne maickezejec.
Ŋic moc e sioc tâmiric juhuc biaŋkeocmu, â moc e siochec juocmuzi sipirickeocmu.
Ŋic moc e gie‐ticne he sarac eocmuzi nânâ mâriri sâko bâfuaocmu, â moc e gie bapa dameŋ sipirickeocmuzi ine hapetac erâ juocmu.
Ŋic sioc tâmiric dameŋ ʒora juhâc qâhâmoocmu, â moc e moneŋ mafa sâkohec eocte ʒoɋac eocmu e ine bâbâtiŋ fuacneocmu.
Ŋic mana wosâc ejarepene mi sâckeocmu. Mumutara ŋic gâcne jaŋe bâbâmiriŋ moneŋ huŋgaŋne mac sawa rohuc wiac hehesicne eniŋte manapie mi quŋkeocmu.
Ŋic moc e wiac buchâro nâ bajuc eekaczi moneŋ mafa bâfuaocte ʒoɋac sâko ehuc ʒâhec roroc fuacneocmu i mi manasuocmu.
Ŋic âgoge mu bâtiŋ ecnetec ʒâhec mana‐gareme biaŋkeocmu, â wokemaŋ dâŋ ecnetec ine ʒâhec mana‐gareme sâqoreocmu.
Moc e neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne jahere wiac fiuc rohuc ʒiŋuc muocmu: “Izi bahac mi ekac,” iŋuc muocmu e sisipiric ŋic jaŋere âgo jaha eocmu.
Ŋic moc e nânâ âmbâŋ nâekaczi dâŋ bâfuaekac, â moc e Wofuŋtao roweckeekaczi ine juhâmoocmu.
Moc e jahacne maŋ mamanasuo roweckeocmuzi ŋic mutucne eocmu, â moc e ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋere dâŋ mana rereŋ eocmuzi ine juhâc qâhâmoocmu.
Ŋic moc e ŋic hapetac bafic‐jopaocmuzi sifu wiac moc mi basaocmu, â moc e hapetac hone takic ejareocmu e ine ŋic bocjaha jaŋe sâweckeniŋmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe tâpirihec epie ŋic gâcne jaŋe soŋkeniŋmu, â tâpiri‐jeŋic omaeme ine ŋic tiŋne jaŋe mocwâc guriŋ bapa gie baniŋmu.
Go ŋic jaŋe qa bâtiŋ egarepie sâc râŋgeŋkecmuo ine dameŋ mocko qanʒaŋ banʒaŋgupie mocwâc mi jucmu.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ŋic ŋokac guriŋ bajarehapie ʒeri bari eniŋmu, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe guriŋ bajarehapie ine ki busâqoc eniŋmu.
Go maŋɋârâŋte manatec wiac furi sâko eha mamacgezi gore maname fefene eocmu, â moc e sasec ŋokac jaŋerao qohotaocmuzi ine moneŋ mafa wiac‐ticne sipirickeocmu.
Ŋicwofuŋ moc e guriŋ bapa gie tiŋne baocmuzi mâreŋ‐ticne bafahareocmu, â moc e moneŋte sawa manasuhuc gie baocmuzi ine mâreŋ‐ticne ima baocmu.
Ŋic moc e âgofâcne wokemaŋ dâŋ ejareocmuzi e jahacne bitiŋ baocmu.
Ŋic hehesicne jaŋe jaŋacne hehesiczi bitiŋ ejareha raʒipie kicjopaekac, â ŋic siocmâc jaŋe ine bubiaŋ faio rambaŋ jueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe qarâ suriŋne jaŋere dâŋ dopeckeeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine jaŋere mana mezac moc mi eeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic pepec penaroŋ jaŋe hae moc irec rune maŋbâiŋ ejareniŋmu, â ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe ine buuruc qajareniŋmu.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi ŋic mutucne moc dâŋgieo râeocmuo ine ŋic mutucne eki mâc gâwiecneocmu, erâ wâc aaric manacnehuc dâŋ sâqocne mucneocmu.
Ŋic socnânâ jaŋe ŋic sioc tâmiric qaisockeeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ine juju‐ticne ŋezickeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe kimbeŋ aaric‐jeŋic mi bawahahuc tomao bataniŋkeeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe ine wiac iŋucne hetapaickehuc uruerâ jueŋgopieŋ.
Guriŋ bapa ŋic moczi burecdâŋte hazec râeocmuo ine gieŋicfâc‐ticne fekicne jaŋe burecŋic jaha efâreniŋmu.
Ŋic hapetac mecne â kisâfâc‐jeŋic mecne jaŋe mâmâc Wofuŋzia ʒâŋe hândâŋ râe‐jarewec.
Ŋicwofuŋ moc e ŋic waha qaqane jaŋe dopec‐jopaocmuo ine guriŋ bapa gie‐ticne i dameŋ ʒora barahuc juocmu.
Naru motec jaŋerao mumutiŋ â bâbâtiŋ gie bapene biaŋkeocmu, me jaŋe jaŋacne maŋte wiac ebac eniŋmuo ine neŋgocfâc‐jeŋic mimi qaqa ejareniŋmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe guriŋ bapa gie bahuc juhapie wiac sâqocnezi soka ŋedâmârec eocmu, â ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ŋic sindaŋne waha jopame honec‐joparâ ʒeri eniŋmu.
Go ŋokâge qa bâtiŋ ecnetec neneŋ bâneneŋ mi egareha ere bubiaŋ manahuc jucmu.
Ŋicguru moc jaŋe Anutu guriŋ bapa‐ticnere takic‐jopame sâcmutâc tâmiric kosa juniŋmu, â ŋicguru moc jaŋe Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋ mana rereŋ eniŋmu jaŋere manapene ʒerine eocmu.
Go kiŋaŋ qaqa moc dâŋ sawa âzâcnehuc sâcne mi bâtiŋnecmu, ine dâŋge hazeczi sawa manahuc mana rereŋ mi eocmu.
Ŋic moc e dâŋticne manasu biric mi ehâmohuc kosa muocmu e ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋere waha micne erâ juocmu.
Kiŋaŋ qaqa moc e ɋieonecteaŋ wiac irec me irec mume râcne tahac enaŋmuo ine juku sokarâ wiac‐nâŋec sasawa ro rauc eocte muocmu.
Ŋic maŋʒochec jaŋe mu qaqatarac erâ dâŋgie sâko bâfuaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic pepec penaroŋhec jaŋe waha jopaocmu, â ŋic maŋhuhuŋ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere manapene fefene eocmu.
Hata kecʒiŋuc fokacte fiuc roro ŋic ere babaficzi juju‐ticne qaisockeekac: E dâŋgieo domahuc dâŋ fârine mufuame bâtiŋneniŋmu, â dâŋ fârine hesoŋkeocmuo ine Anutuzi sâweckeocmu.
Ŋic jaŋere hâhâwic bajupene bitiŋzi kicnâpoocmu tinac eocmu, â Wofuŋtao roweckehuc junaŋmuo ine eki huec sanaŋ enâreocmu.
Ŋic bocjaha jaŋe ŋic fekicnezi mana‐jareme biaŋkeocte maŋjeŋic domaekac, erâ Wofuŋzi sawa ine dâŋnâŋec mutarame sâckeocmu.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ŋic sindaŋne qaisoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine ŋic tiŋne qaisoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Kecʒi Jakere ŋokâ, Masaŋic Aguru ere dâŋ hâcne: “Anutu e nohec mi juekacte boc bititieekopac.
No ŋic mâcne, qowi iŋucne juekopac, ŋic nâŋâc mamanahec erâ junaŋte mukicne mamana i no mi fonarekac.
No maŋɋârâŋhec jupemurâ mamana gie moc mi bapo, irec no Anuture fuŋne kâuc baekopac wâc.
Mozi moc sambâŋko ferâ mocwâc risie wahawec? Me mozi mâŋâŋ moc basanaŋkewec? Me mozi qoruc‐ticne rorâ opâ moc foŋkewec? Me mozi mâreŋ qaŋeŋne râe basanaŋ efârewec? Go ŋic e jahacne me ŋokâ‐ticnere ʒâŋe moc manakicko muc!
“Anutu e mumupaŋ dâŋticne sasawa irec fârine bâfua‐fâreekac, â ere dapeŋko soŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ŋezic‐jopa‐fâreekac.
Anutu e tutuc qagarehuc burecŋic mugarezacte eki dâŋ muwec ira gahacne maŋte dâŋ moc mi ʒuhuckezemec.”
O Anutu, no hâmoc dameŋ‐nane mi maickeha wiac jajahec jahere numu‐garepe mana‐narezemec:
Burec â waburac ezipore baficnuzemec, ehuc tâpiri‐nanere sâc moneŋ mafa nare tahac ezemec, â nânâ wiac i hobu‐nanere sâc sawa narezemec.
No nânâ mafa sâkohec erâ, “Go tâmiric sâcne jupemu,” iŋuc muhuc behecguzipore me hapetac juhuc fiuc rorâ Anutu gore ʒâŋe wâwânâŋ ecnezipore iŋuc hâcne enarezemec.
Go kiŋaŋ qaqa mocte fuŋne bomboŋ‐ticnerao mi musâqorezemec, go iŋuc etec sâwecgume ʒâic busâqoc manazicte.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe mamacfâc‐jeŋic sâwec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, ehuc neŋgocfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere manapie fefene wâc mi eekac.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe sohoŋhec juipiehuc jaŋacnere manapie ɋaɋacne juŋgopeneŋ tinac eekac.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe jaŋacnere manapie fefene eha ŋic âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ine manapie wawahane eekac.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe hapetac â qarâ suriŋne kisuec‐jopahuc wiac‐jeŋic jowac roeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe iŋuc ehuc jaŋacne juju dopeckeeŋgopieŋ.
Hurameŋ e otâ jahec‐ticne jajahec jukopirec jahere ʒâŋe mocjaha ʒiŋuc fokac: “Narec, Narec.” Wiac jahec â jahec kecʒiŋuc jaŋe nâ gapec moc mi eeŋgopieŋ:
Hâmoc hae, ŋokac hufiŋne, mâreŋ kereŋne â ʒocbâruŋ.
Ŋic moc e neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne jahe ŋic ŋokac qizec ehapire gâwie‐jactehuc qaisoc‐jofaocmu e kâec kâec wipezi ʒâŋe‐ticne ripozejec â tucwipezi sahac biuc‐ticne nâzejec.
Wiac jahec â jahec kecʒiŋuc jaŋere fuŋne qame hukicne fokacte mi mana taraekopac:
Moc i tucwipezi sawao rac warec eekac, â moc i homazi haroŋaŋ faio foforâ raekac, â moc i wokezi hata‐ticne bâfuarâ hâwec fotâcneekac, erâ moc ine ŋic ŋokac jajahec jahe maŋ rârâec eekopirec.
Boe sau ŋokaczi wiac ʒiŋuc eekac: E sasec gie barâ opâ ruahuc ʒiŋuc muekac: “No bahac moc mi bâfuapac i.”
Wiac jahec â jahec kecʒiŋuc jaŋere manapene mi eene eekac:
Kiŋaŋ qaqazi ŋicwofuŋ erâ juju, ŋic sindaŋnezi nânâ mâriri sâkohec juju;
ŋokac qaisockekicnezi ŋic roro, erâ kiŋaŋ naruzi ŋokac bomboŋ‐ticne ââkehocke.
Qowi jahec â jahec kecʒiŋuc juŋgopieŋ jaŋe piticne jâmbâŋ erâ sifu mamana tarahec:
Qoʒazaŋ jaŋe tâpiri tâmiric erâ sifu ʒoaŋ dameŋko nânâ wiac‐jeŋic ro qâzuc efâreeŋgopieŋ.
Mandaŋ jaŋe tâpiri tâmiric jaha erâ sifu mâreŋ gufurâ fic hae eeŋgopieŋ.
Hâpic jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ tâmiric juhuc sifu birihec raeŋgopieŋ.
Ʒereac jaŋe mezi roroc‐jopane, erâ sifu ŋicwofuŋte ficko jueŋgopieŋ.
Wiac jahec â jahec kecʒiŋuc jaŋe hata rahapie honec‐jopahuc aŋac‐nâpoekac:
Moc i laioŋ; e tâpiri‐ticnezi qowi gâcne jaŋere tâpiri sirickeha wiac irec me irec moc mi hâwickeekac.
Â moc i noniŋ â qâqâc ŋicne, erâ moc i ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe momorifâc‐jeŋic micne bajareeŋgopieŋ.
Go mutuc erâ pepec penaroŋ ehuc wiac hehesicne manasu biric moc emeŋko ine beherâ mocwâc mamana gie bazemec.
Susu kiruŋko itiriŋkekupene wokemaŋ fuaekac. Ŋic moc e sâkenao hepene soc ruaekac, â ŋic maŋbâiŋ ejarepene ʒika fuaekac.
Ŋicwofuŋ Lemue e neŋgoc‐ticnezi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcne qazuc ewec:
“Joroc ŋokâ‐nane, go nunumu‐nanere fârine hâcne, no wemo dâŋ moc gazapemu?
Go tâpirige sasec gieo mi qâmiezemec, â moneŋge i ŋokac jaŋerao mi sipirickezemec. Manakic, iŋucne jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ wâc sipiric‐jopambiŋ.
O Lemue, go manac: Ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe waiŋ opâ mi nânʒepieŋ, â opâ sanaŋ gâcne irec andac wâc mi enʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe opâ sanaŋ nâhuc sâcmutâc dâŋte nikec‐jopaekac, ehame ŋic qarâ suriŋne hone takirec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Opâ sanaŋ i ŋic ʒâic sâko manahuc hâmozo eŋgopieŋ jaŋere biŋe.
Jaŋe hâcne nâhuc bawaha qaqane â busâqoc faio jueŋgopieŋ irec nikec‐jopazejec.
“Go ŋic nâŋguŋne â ba bititicne jaŋere dâŋ muhuc bafic‐jopazemec.
Go jaŋe bafic‐jopahuc dâŋjeŋic mutiŋnezemec, ehuc ŋic waha qaqane â qarâ suriŋne jaŋere dâŋ fâretiŋ jaha muhuc dopec‐jopazemec.”
Mozi ŋokac biaŋne moc sâcne bâfuaocmu? Ŋokac biaŋne moc e qânâ furi sâko irec sâc sirickeekac.
Ehame ŋowe‐ticnezi erao roweckerâ juhuc batac qatac mi eocmu.
Ŋokac iŋucne e jufeekac sâc ŋowe‐ticne busâqoc moc mi bâfuacnehuc biaŋne jauŋkehuc juekac.
E qâoma moc mi ehuc he fufu â ŋaqi qoruc ɋâɋâtâ gie ʒuʒuhuc jaha baekac.
E mafa woke iŋucne nânâ wiac mâreŋ ʒorickonec rome fisiekac.
E furic qârurure faharerâ wiacfâc‐ticne jaŋere nânâ rike bâmoc ehuc kiŋaŋ narufâcne giedâŋ mujareekac.
E gie hehe mâreŋ moc honerâ e jahac gie bahuc moneŋ hotâckeekac izi furine baocmu.
E gie ʒoɋac sasanaŋhec baekac.
E wiac ebac ehuc irec maname fârine sasawa eekac, ehame gie bahuc juhame ŋafe ʒâŋiŋkeekac.
E he fuocte muc jâmume feekac.
E ŋic hapetac â qarâ suriŋne jauŋ bacjopaekac.
E wiacfâcne jaŋere ʒoc bocjaha roekacte mâmâteŋ dameŋko jaŋere mana mezac mi eekac.
E fofo baekac, erâ wâc ŋaqi qoruc‐ticne ɋâtâekac.
Iŋuc eme ŋowe‐ticne e ʒâŋe biŋehec ehuc ŋic micne juekac.
Ŋokac e maŋguc â hewiac furâ nareŋ gareŋ tomao furire râeekac.
E sasanaŋhec jume ŋic jaŋe manacnepie fefene eekac, â juku ʒâhec wiac fuaocmu irec mi hâwickeekac.
E micticnaonec maŋɋârâŋ â âgo miriŋ dâŋ sawa wahaekac.
E dameŋ sâc gie ʒoɋachec bahuc wiacfâcne jaŋe hone bafic ejareekac.
Ehame naru motecfâcne jaŋe manacnepie fefene eha ŋowe‐ticnezi mumbiaŋkeekac.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcneekac: “Ŋokac gâcne jaŋe biaŋne jaha, goki ine jaŋere sâc sirickehuc biaŋne jâmbâŋ jukomec.”
Sahaczi babanic i eatuc‐ticnehec â sahac hawari biaŋne i oomaene, ŋokac moc Wofuŋ araŋ bacnehuc juocmu e ine mumbiaŋkezo.
E gie‐ticne sasawa baekac irec furine rozejec, ehame ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeŋgoma muac baafec ecnenʒepieŋ.
Dawidire ŋokâ Miti Mumu Ŋiczi Jerusalem haeo ŋicwofuŋ juwec ere dâŋ ʒine hâcne.
Miti Mumu Ŋic e dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: Wiacte wiac forakac i fâri tâmiric, â juju i wâc fâri tâmiric jaha.
Ŋoŋe mâreŋko juhuc gie ʒocnehec baeŋgopieŋ irec fârine wemo wiac mo bâfuaeŋgopieŋ?
Ŋic gaŋne gaŋne jaŋe fua omaec eeŋgopieŋ, â mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ e ine foweczi fohuc juekac jaha.
Ehame ʒoaŋzi huc wefuc eekac, ehuc mocwâc wefuocte wefuekacko risieekac.
Mâŋâŋ e juwic mâreŋkonec wefuekac erâ wâc faic mâreŋkonec wahaekac, iŋuc ehuc mâreŋ râreckehuc mocwâc risieekac.
Opâ sâko sasawa jaŋe hâwecko hueŋgopieŋ, ehame sifu hâweczi mi qâmbâriŋkeekac; erâ opâ jaŋe qizec‐jeŋicko risierâ mocwâc fuŋkerâ raeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic nâŋâc wiac sasawa ebac ehuc docke betaŋ eeŋgopeneŋ, ehuc irec fuŋne munaŋte dâŋ basaeŋgopeneŋ. Ʒâŋe‐nâŋeczi wiac tatakic tâmiric honeekac â hazec‐nâŋeczi tatakic tâmiric dâŋ manaekac.
Wiac fuarâ fowec izia mocwâc fuarâ foocmu â wiac ebac ekicne ijaha mocwâc ebac eniŋmu; mâreŋko wiac furune moc mi fuaekac.
Irec wiac moc fuame honerâ ʒiŋuc sâcne muniŋmu: “Honec, wiac keci furune?” Aricne, i mârâc jaha jâmbâŋ, nâŋâc mi fuarâ juhapene biac fuarâ fowec hâcne.
Mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe juhapie wiac fuawec i moc mi manasueŋgopeneŋ iŋuc jaha ŋic jufenʒoŋgopieŋ me ʒiŋuczia jueŋgopeneŋ dameŋ ŋondeŋ irec maŋnao wiac fua raocmu i wâc mi manasunʒoŋgopieŋ.
Miti Mumu Ŋic no Jerusalem haeo Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ jupo.
Ehuc ŋic nâŋâc mâreŋko wiac sasawa ebac eeŋgopeneŋ irec fuŋne hone mana tarac epemurâ mamana gie sâko bahuc jupo. Manaŋgopieŋ, Anutu e ŋic nâŋâc gie munârewec i wiac ŋemâcne â ʒâic busâqoc‐ticnehec.
Ŋic nâŋâc mâreŋko wiac sasawa ebac eeŋgopeneŋ i hone‐fârepo, ehuc ʒiŋuc mana tarapo: I fâri tâmiric sasawa, mâŋâŋ mezi rorâ basanaŋkezo eipieŋgopeneŋ irec sâc.
Wiac hehesicne i bâbâpiaŋkenere sâc mi eekac, â wiac mi foha basahuc sâcne mi woseeŋgopeneŋ.
No maŋnanezi ʒiŋuc manapo: “No ŋic maŋɋârâŋ sâkohec jukopac, juwicnao Jerusalem haeo guriŋ bapa gie bahuc jumbiŋ ŋic i jaŋere sâc sirickehuc maŋɋârâŋhec jukopac hâcne. Irec no maŋɋârâŋ â mamana tara jahere fuŋne manakopac.”
No iŋuc manahuc maŋɋârâŋ â mamana tara erâ mutuc matacne irec fuŋne mana tarapemurâ gie sâko bahuc jupo. Ehuc ʒiŋuc mana tarapo: Gie i mâŋâŋ mezi rorâ basanaŋkezo eipieeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc jaha.
Maŋɋârâŋ fekicne fonâreocmuo ine mana mezac bocjaha enaŋmu, â mamana sâkohec junaŋmuo ine ʒâic busâqoc wâc boc mananaŋmu.
No maŋnanezi ʒiŋuc manapo: “No bubiaŋ faio jujuhâmo irec fuŋne manazepac.” Iŋuc muhuc ʒiŋuc mana tarapo: I wiac fâri tâmiric jaha.
Erâ ʒiŋuc wâc mana tarapo: Mu gâgâwi ee i wiac mutucne, â bubiaŋ faio juju izi wâc mi bafic‐nâpoekac.
Eme maŋɋârâŋhec jujure boc enareme ʒiŋuc mupaŋkepo: No waiŋ opâ nârâ sahac‐nane afeckeme bubiaŋ faio juzepac. No ʒiŋuc hâcne manasupo: Ŋic nâŋâc mâreŋko dameŋ bembeŋne sawa juhuc iŋuc mecne epene biaŋkeocmu.
No gie sâko bape fârinehec efârewec. Ehuc fic wiac‐nane barâ waiŋ gie he sarac epo.
Erâ monʒaŋ gie â jufu gie‐nane bahuc jâc fuŋne fuŋne sarapo wâc.
No opâ nombâŋ ropo, eme irecnec opâzi rahuc jâc wiac i bâgunucke‐fârewec.
No kiŋaŋ qaqa ŋic ŋokac furi bacjopapo, â no nahacne ficko kiŋaŋ qaqa fuambiŋ wâc. No lama bulimakao bacjopa jupo i juwicnao Jerusalem haeo guriŋ bapa ŋic jaŋe bacjopa jumbiŋ jaŋere sâc sirickewec.
Erâ no mâreŋ sâc ŋicwofuŋ soŋaŋ‐jopahuc jupo jaŋere kânoŋkonec siliwa â gol ro qâzuc epo. Ehuc gae hehe ŋic ŋokac rocjopape gae henarehuc jumbiŋ; ehame hone aŋac ejarepemurâ ŋokacfâc‐nane bocjaha junarembiŋ wâc.
No iŋuc ehuc ʒâŋe biŋehec erâ juwicnao Jerusalem haeo jumbiŋ jaŋe siric‐jopa‐fârerâ maŋɋârâŋ‐nanehec jaha jupo.
No wiac i me i rorâ bajuzo enareme rorâ bajupo, ehuc wiac bubiaŋnehec moc mi bâsuepo. No gie sasawa bafârepo izi bubiaŋ bâfua‐narewec, erâ bubiaŋ izi gie furi‐nane ewec.
Eme ʒâhec ine wiac ebac efârepo â gie sâko bahuc jupo irec manasurâ ʒiŋuc mana tarapo: I wiac fâri tâmiric sasawa, erâ mezi mâŋâŋ rorâ basanaŋkezo eipieeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc; erâ wâc ʒiŋuc mana tarapo: Mâreŋko juhuc wiac fârine moc bâbâfuane mi fokac.
Ine hâcne, ŋicwofuŋ moc e wiac furune moc mi ehuc, ere juwicnao ŋicwofuŋ juwefumbiŋ jaŋe wiac ebac embiŋ i sawa sâcne ebac eocmu. No iŋuc mana tararâ maŋɋârâŋhec juju â mamana tâmiric mutuc matacne juju irec fuŋne manapemurâ mamanasu gie bapo:
Baku ʒiŋuc mana tarapo: Tatamaczi dapâc sirickerâ fefene eekac iŋuc jaha maŋɋârâŋzi mutuc matacne sirickerâ fefene eekac.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe hata‐jeŋic hone tarahuc raeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic mutucne jaŋe ine dapâcko qiŋquŋkehuc jueŋgopieŋ. Ŋifec ine ʒiŋuc wâc mana tarapo: Maŋɋârâŋhec me mutuc matacne jueŋgopeneŋ nâŋâc wiac hâhâwicne sâc ijaha fua‐nâreocmu.
No iŋuc mana tararâ ʒiŋuc mupo: “Ŋic mutucne wiac fua‐jareocmu ijaha no fua‐nareme ʒiŋuc mupemu: No wemocte maŋɋârâŋhec jupo?” Iŋuc murâ mupo: “Maŋɋârâŋhec juju‐nane i wiac fâri tâmiric jaha.”
Juku ŋic moczi moc maŋɋârâŋhec jumbiŋ jaŋe moc mi manasuc‐jopaocmu, â ŋic mutuc matacne jumbiŋ jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha mi manasuc‐jopaocmu. Ŋic jaŋe juku nâŋâcne nikec‐jopa‐fâreocmu hâcne. Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec mecne â ŋic mutuc matacne mecne nâŋâc mâmâc sasawa hâmo‐fârenaŋmu.
No iŋuc mana tarahuc juwefuhape wiac biaŋnezi mâcne, ʒârâ hâriŋzi sawa fua‐narewecte juju‐nane qaisockepo. Wiac ebac epo i fâri tâmiric efârewec, nâŋâc mezi mâŋâŋ rorâ basanaŋkezo eipieeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc ewec hâcne.
No gie sâko bahuc wiac sasawa hure hemârec efârepo i kecʒiŋuc muhuc manape fâri tâmiric ewec: Âkehocnuocmuzi raucke‐fâreocmu.
E maŋɋârâŋhec juocmu me mutuc matacne juocmu i mozi manakac? Ehame no mâreŋko maŋɋârâŋhec juhuc gie barâ wiac bâfuapo i sifu ro rauc efâreocmu. Irec wiac bâfua‐fârepo i manape fâri tâmiric jaha ekac.
No iŋuc murâ, gie ʒocne fârone bahuc jupo irec busâqoc manapo.
Ʒiŋuc honeeŋgopeneŋ: Nâŋâc mamana â maŋɋârâŋ bâfuarâ mamana sarichec juhuc gie bapene fârine fuaekac i ŋic moczi giene mi bapa mâc juku ro rauc eekac. I wâc iŋuc jaha fâri tâmiric eekac â mi sâckeekac.
Nâŋâc mâreŋko gie ʒocne fârone bahuc jueŋgopeneŋ, eme irec fârine wemo wiac moc fua‐nâreekac?
Nâŋâc wiac ebac eeŋgopeneŋ izi dameŋ sâc busâqoc â aaric bâfua‐nâreekac, ehame ŋafeo wâc guŋ sâcne mi foeŋgopeneŋ. Irec i fâri tâmiric jaha eekac.
Fuŋne iŋuc fokacte ŋic nâŋâc wiac hure hemârec eeŋgopeneŋ irec aŋac manarâ nânâ opâ nâhuc juhapene biaŋkeocmu mecne. No iŋuc manahuc ŋifec ʒiŋuc mana tarapo wâc: I Anuturaonec jaha ware‐nâreekac.
Iŋuc mi fome muzac ine wemocko nânâ opâ nâhuc wiac gâcnere bubiaŋ wâc mananʒapeŋ.
Anutu e mana‐jareme biaŋkeekac ŋic i jaŋe hâcne maŋɋârâŋ â mamana tara â ʒeri bubiaŋ tahac‐jopaekac. Ŋifec ine ŋic hehesicne jaŋe gie bapie fârine fuame ro qâzuc eniŋte mujareekac; i ŋic gâcne mana‐jareme boc biaŋkeekac jaŋe jareocte iŋuc eekac. Erâ sifu irec wâc mâmâc manape fâri tâmiric eekac, ine mezi mâŋâŋ rorâ basanaŋkezo eipieeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc.
Mâreŋko wiac sasawa kecʒiŋuc jaŋe Anutuzi dameŋ bajareme sâc fuaeŋgopieŋ:
Fufua â hâmoc dameŋ, hesarac â qa roro dameŋ.
Qaqac â bâbâsomie dameŋ, fic hae ima bapa â bâbâpiaŋ dameŋ.
Busâqoc â bubiaŋ dameŋ, ki mamakuc â gae wowo dameŋ.
Ŋowe ŋonâŋ juju â sowa juju dameŋ. eehâmo â qaqaisoc dameŋ.
Wiac basarâ bâbâfua â behepene sisifucke irec dameŋ, wiac qâqâzucke â bebehe irec dameŋ.
Wiac bâsucke behec â ɋâtâ bâpiaŋ ee irec dameŋ, dâŋemâc juju â dâŋehuc juju irec dameŋ.
Maŋjauŋhec juju â rârâsi dameŋ, ʒika â wama dameŋ.
Ŋic nâŋâc gie‐nâŋec bahuc fârine wemo wiac bâfuaeŋgopeneŋ?
Anutuzi gie ŋemâcne fai‐nâŋecko râewec i hone tarakopac.
E wiac sasawa jaŋere dameŋ i fâretiŋ jaha râe‐fârewec. Erâ wâc ŋic nâŋâc wiac fua raocmu irec fuŋne mananaŋte woworic râe‐nârewec, ehuc ine sifu eebapa‐ticnere fuŋne mana taranʒipeŋte tâpiri mi qikiŋne‐nâreekac.
Irec no ʒiŋuc mana tarapo: Ŋic nâŋâc mâreŋko junaŋmu sâc wiac i me i mi ebac ee mâc ʒeri bubiaŋ sawa manahuc jupene sâckezejec.
Erâ ʒiŋuc mana tarapo wâc: Nâŋâc nânâ opâ nâeŋgopeneŋ â gie bapene fârine fuame ʒeri eeŋgopeneŋ izi Anuturaonec taha hâcne.
Erâ wâc ʒiŋuc manakopac: Anutuzi wiac sasawa ebac eekac i fofo sanaŋ, ŋic nâŋâc ira ʒuhuckerâ wiac moc bapa, me irecnec wiac moc ro behec ee i mi fokac. Anutu e ŋic nâŋâc araŋ bacnehuc junaŋte wiac iŋuc hâcne bâfua‐fârewec.
Wiac fuaekac me juku fuaocmu i mârâc jaha biac fua‐fârewec, Anutu e wiac izia fuarâ fua eocte giene baekac hâcne.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, no ʒuhuckerâ wiac kecʒiŋuc wâc honepo: Mâreŋko mumutiŋ gie â eebapa tiŋne foocte mukicne ira wiac hehesicne foekac.
Iŋuc honerâ maŋnanezi ʒiŋuc manasupo: Anutu e gie â wiac sasawa irec dameŋ bawecte ŋic tiŋne â hehesicne jaŋere dâŋ sâckoa mutaraocmu.
Erâ ʒiŋuc manasupo wâc: Anutu e ŋic nâŋâc ʒiŋuc nâzâ nâwotuc eocte ba esâic enâreekac: Ŋoŋe qowi jaŋere sâc sirickerâ biaŋne mi jueŋgopieŋ.
Irec qowi jaŋe wiac fua‐jareekac sâc ijaha nâŋâc fua‐nâreekac. Jaŋe hâmoeŋgopieŋ sâc ijaha nâŋâc hâmoeŋgopeneŋ, jaŋe nâŋâcne sâc jaha bâfuac‐jopakicne. Ŋic nâŋâc jaŋere sâc jâuruhuc biaŋne mi jueŋgopeneŋ. Jaŋere juju mecne â nâŋâcne juju mecne i wiac fâri tâmiric jaha.
Jaŋe mecne â nâŋâc mecne mâmâc hae mâreŋ ijaha rafârenaŋmu. Nâŋâc mâmâc jaha mâreŋkonec fuambeŋ irec mâmâc jaha mâreŋko risie hunaŋmu.
Ŋic nâŋâcne mârozi faic feocmu â qowi jaŋere mârozi juwic huocmu i mozi mana taraekac?
Irec kecʒiŋuc mana tarapo: Ŋic nâŋâc gie bapene fârine fuame irec manasuhuc ʒeri bubiaŋ epene sâckezejec. Wiac moc eene mi fokac. Nâŋâc juku hâmohapene wemo wiac moc fua‐nâreocmu i mananaŋte hatane basaeŋgopeneŋ.
Eme no mâreŋko wiac hehesicne fua rakac i mocwâc hone‐fârehuc ʒiŋuc hone tarapo: Bâʒâic‐jopakicne jaŋe kiohuc juhapie moczi moc mi bâmiriŋ‐jopawec. Râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋe tâpirihec jumbiŋte moczi moc mi bâmiriŋ‐jopawec hâcne.
Irec no hâmokicne jaŋere manape ʒerine eha ɋâricne juŋgopieŋ jaŋere manape busâqocnehec ekac.
Erâ wâc biac mi fuarâ jumbiŋ, ehuc mâreŋko wiac hehesicne fua rakac i mi honembiŋ jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac i fuŋmoc. Wemocte, i hâmokicne me ɋâricne juŋgopieŋ jaŋere manaekopac irec sâc jâurukac.
No ŋic jaŋe gie ʒocne fârone bahuc jueŋgopieŋ irec fuŋne kecʒiŋuc hone mana tarac epo: Jaŋe ŋic âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋe wiac bajueŋgopieŋ irec sâc sirickehuc fua‐jareocte iŋuc hâcne eeŋgopieŋ. Erâ izi wiac fârine mâcne, i mezi mâŋâŋ rorâ basanaŋkezo eipieeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc jaha ekac.
Ŋic mutuc matacnezi ojoŋ juhuc nânâre hâmo sipiric eekac i jâmbomac.
Erâ ine wiac sisirowenao qohotahuc irec gie ʒocnehec bahuc mâcne, wiac afecne sawa hurehuc maŋwama bâfuapene sâcke‐hâmoocmu.
Erâ no mâreŋko wiac moc kecʒiŋuc fuame honeekopac:
Ŋic moc e naru motec me hahac ɋafâc‐ticne tâmiric buc juhuc gie ʒocne fârone baekac, ehuc moneŋ mafa hure hemârec eekac irec maname mi sâckeekac. Ehame ʒiŋuc mi wioekac: “No ʒâic gie sâko i more erâ bahuc ʒeri bubiaŋ mi bâfuaekopac?” No mâsi iŋucnere wâc manape wiac racne â busâqocnehec eekac.
Ŋic jajahec jahe babafic ehuc gie bapire fârine biaŋne fuaocmu, irec ŋic moc e bucticne mâcne, âgonehec mâmâc jupire sâckeocmu.
Ehame jaheraonec moczi waha qame âgonezi sâcne bafahareocmu, â bucticne juhuc waha qame ine mo âgo‐ticnezi bafahareocmu, i aricne i!
Me mâmâteŋ dameŋko ŋic jajahec jahe mâmâc jaha fohuc heheâroŋ sâcne enicmu, â ŋic moc e buc fohuc ine fâfâreocmu.
Me ŋic moc e buc juhame râsizi fisirâ bawahaocmu, ŋic jajaheczi babafic ehuc ine râsi sâcne jâpenicmu. Repa moc muc jahec â moczi bapene mi tâcneocmu.
Ŋic waha qaqane moc e mâreŋ‐ticnere ŋicwofuŋ âkendâŋnezo murâ sâcne âkendâŋneniŋmu, â moc e kâpâcwâru ficko ŋekicnezi ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋeo râepie ŋezo murâ sâcne ŋeocmu; izi juku ŋicqizec erâ mutuc ehuc uŋsawaŋ dâŋ qikiŋneme manacnepie wawahane eocmu, â ŋicmotec hapetaczi maŋɋârâŋhec jume ere ine manapie fefene eocmu.
<range>
No ŋic sasawa mâreŋko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere manasuhuc ʒiŋuc mana tarapo: Jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec hâcne ŋicmotec moczi ŋicwofuŋ âkehockeocmu.
Ŋicwofuŋ moc e ŋic guru dindiŋ sâko guriŋ bajareocmu mecne, erâ ine wiac ebac ehuc juku hâmohame sifu ŋic moczi irec mocwâc manasuhuc ʒeri bari mi eocmu. Erâ i wiac racne jaha, mezi mâŋâŋ rorâ basanaŋkezo eipieeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc ekac.
Go taha ufuŋko fezo murâ rucjarige bahuc fezemec. Ferâ Wofuŋ dâŋticnere hazec râetec mana‐garepe fefene eocmu, â ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe tiŋne â hehesic jahere fuŋne mi mana tarahuc bâzi rikeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc etec ine mana‐garepe wawahane eocmu.
Go dâŋ moc muzo murâ qanaŋ manasu biric ezemec, ehuc Anuture maio fâro faio mumupaŋ dâŋ mi muzemec. Anutu e sambâŋko jukac, â go ine mâreŋko jukomec, irec dâŋ afecne sawa muzemec.
Go mana mezac boc ehuc guŋ sâqocne bocjaha manacmu, â dâŋ bocjaha mu raʒic wefuc ehuc mumusifuc dâŋ mucmu hâcne.
Go Anuturao mumupaŋ dâŋ moc mucmuo ine irec fârine bâfuacmurâ ʒoɋac ezemec. E ŋic mutucne jaŋere mi ecneekac, irec go mumupaŋgere fârine bâfuazemec. Go, mumupaŋ‐nanere fârine sâcne mi bâfuapemu, iŋuc muhuc mumupaŋ dâŋ moc mi muzemec.
<range>
Dâŋ musifuckehuc sâqocne bâfuazicte nameŋge soŋaŋkezemec. Go ʒâhec taha bapare maio ʒiŋuc muzicte iŋuc ezemec: No fâro ehuc musifuckepac. Go wemocte dâŋgezi Anutu aaric bâfuacnehuc giegere fârine hetâtieocte mukomec?
Go guŋ bocjaha manaekicte dâŋ racne boc muekic, erâ sifu Anutu araŋ bacnetec sâckezejec.
Go kia gawamaŋ jaŋe ŋic qarâ suriŋne bâʒâic‐jopahuc dâŋgieo mi bafic‐jopaniŋmu â dâŋjeŋic mi dopeckeniŋmuo ine mi wareckezemec. Kia fekicne jaŋe kia wahakicne ŋezic‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, â gawamaŋ kâcɋenezi kiafâc‐ticne fekicne â wahakicne mâmâc ŋezic‐jopa‐fâreekac.
Irec mâreŋ moc e ŋicwofuŋ‐ticne jume sâckeocmu.
Ŋic moc e moneŋte boc ecneocmuzi moneŋte harac jaha ehuc juocmu, â ŋic moc e moneŋ mafa sâkohec eocte manasuhuc wiac sasawa rozo muocmu i mi bâfuaocmu. Irec hata i fâri tâmiric jaha ekac.
Ŋic moc e moneŋ mafa sâkohec juocmu e ŋic bocjaha jaŋe nânâ jare gumec eocte muniŋmu, ehame wemo wiac fârine moc bâfuaocmu? E mâc ʒiŋuc sawa mana taraocmu: No mafa mâriri sâkohec juekopac.
Kiŋaŋ qaqa moc e nânâ wiac bocjaha me afecne sawa nâhuc sifu guŋ biaŋne foocmu, â ŋic moneŋ mafa sâkoheczi ine wiac sasawa‐ticnere mana mezac boc ehuc guŋɋâri juocmu.
No mâreŋko wiac hâhâwicne kecʒiŋuc fuame honeekopac: Ŋic jaŋe ʒâhec wiac i me i moc basanʒipiŋte moneŋ‐jeŋic ro qâzuc eeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ juku wiac kosa ehuc behepie omae‐fâreha naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jareniŋte basaeŋgopieŋ. Ŋic nâŋâc mâreŋko metariŋ fuambeŋ iŋuc jaha juku hâmorâ metariŋ jaha ranaŋmu. Nâŋâc gie sâko bahuc jueŋgopeneŋ, erâ sifu irec fârine i me i moc mi baranaŋmu.
<range>
Wiac izi mi sâckeekac. Nâŋâc fuambeŋ irec sâc jaha ranaŋmu. Nâŋâc ʒocne fârone ehuc mezi mâŋâŋ rorâ basanaŋkezo gie sâko baeŋgopeneŋ, ehuc irec fârine wemo wiac bâfuaeŋgopeneŋ?
Dapâcmaŋko juju, â busâqoc â memezac â aaric â huc ʒâic faio juju bâfuaeŋgopeneŋ hâcne.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no wiac ʒiŋuc hone mana tarac ekopac: Nâŋâc Anutuzi juju dameŋ bembeŋne nârewec irec maŋnao gie bapene fârine fuaekac irec ʒeri ehuc nânâ opâ nâpene biaŋkeocmu. Ŋic nâŋâc iŋuc hâcne enaŋte munârekicne.
Anutu e ŋic nâŋâc moneŋ mafa â fic hae nâre tahac ehuc irec bubiaŋ mananaŋte mana‐nâreocmuo ine daŋge mumuteŋ enʒepeneŋ, ehuc gie bapene fârine fuaekac i bubiaŋ manahuc nâ bac enʒepeneŋ. Wiac i Anuturaonec taha moc hâcne.
Ŋic nâŋâc ʒeri bubiaŋ faio junaŋte Anutuzi mana‐nârewec, irec juju dameŋ‐nâŋec bembeŋnere mana mezac boc mi enʒepeneŋ.
No mâreŋko juhuc ŋic jaŋerao wiac hehesicne kecʒiŋuc fuame honepe mi sâckeekac:
Anutu e ŋic moc e me e moneŋ mafa â ʒâŋe biŋe â fic hae erâ wiac gâcne sasaware ecneekac i mâmâc râcne‐fâreocmu mecne. Erâ ine ŋic e wiac i nâ bac ehuc bubiaŋ manazacte aka hecneha ŋic furune moczi nâ bac ehuc bubiaŋ manaocmu. Mâsi iŋucne i wiac fâri tâmiric erâ mi sâcke‐jâmbâŋkeekac.
Ŋic moc e dameŋ ʒora jufehame naru motecfâc‐ticne 100 fuacneniŋmu mecne, ehame jujuhâmo moc mi bâfuahuc juku hâmome biaŋne mi duckeniŋmuo ine ere manape wawahane eha kogoc hâmocne fuawec ere ine manape fefene eocmu.
Kogoc iŋucnezi fuarâ izia dapâcko sifuckeme ere nikec‐nâpoekac.
E ʒoaŋ tatamac moc mi honeocmu â jujure fuŋne wâc mi manaocmu, erâ sifu ŋic e sirickehuc jujumana haeo raocmu.
Kogoc iŋucnezi ŋic moc jara 2 tauseŋ jufehuc jujuhâmo mi bâfuaocmu ere sâc sirickeocmu hâcne. Erâ jahe sifu hae ijaha rakopirec.
Ŋic nâŋâc gie sasawa baeŋgopeneŋ i nânâ opâ‐nâŋec bâfuanaŋte baeŋgopeneŋ, erâ ine sâcnâŋec bâfua‐bipiehuc sifu manapene mi sâckeekac.
Ehame ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi weniŋuc ehuc ŋic mutuc matacne sirickeme biaŋkeekac? Â ŋic qarâ suriŋne e juju biaŋnere fuŋne manaocmu izi sâcne bafickeocmu me?
Nâŋâc wiac fonâreekac irec manapene sâckezejec, me fonâre‐bipieha ʒuhuckerâ ronaŋte mupene ine sâqoreekac. Erâ i wiac fâri tâmiric jaha, mezi mâŋâŋ rorâ basanaŋkezo eipieeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc ekac.
Wiac sasawa fua raekac i fuaocte Anutuzi mârâc jaha maname fowec. Irec nâŋâc ʒiŋuc manaeŋgopeneŋ: Tâpiri‐nâŋec sirickehuc juekac ehec dâŋ mu qaqatarac sâcne mi enaŋmu.
Sifu ehuc dâŋ bocjaha mupene fâri tâmiric jaha eme wemo wiac biaŋne moc fua‐nâreocmu?
Ŋic nâŋâc mâreŋko juju dameŋ‐nâŋec bembeŋne â fâri tâmiric erâ mumuc iŋucne fuarâ omaeekac irec maŋnao weniŋuc jupene biaŋkeocmu i mo ŋiczi moc manaekac? Me ŋic nâŋâc juku hâmopene faicnao mâreŋko wemo wiac moc fuarâ foocmu i wâc mozi manarâ sâcne nâzâocmu?
Ʒâŋe biŋehec juju izi wokemaŋ âsu biaŋ irec sâc sirickekac, â hâmoc dameŋ‐nâŋeczi fufua dameŋ‐nâŋec wâc sirickekac.
Hâmoczi woŋec‐nâŋec fokac i ɋâricne jueŋgopeneŋ nâŋâc manasuhuc junʒepeneŋ, irec nâŋâc gae wohuc ʒeri sâko eeŋgopieŋ hae mâreŋ ira mâcne, makuc baeŋgopieŋ ira rapene biaŋkeocmu.
Ʒâic fâro faio juju izi mu gâgâwi faio juju sirickeme biaŋkekac, i ŋifec busâqoc bâfua‐nâreekac â ŋifec ine mamanasiŋ‐nâŋec basanaŋkeekac.
Ŋic mutuc matacne e dameŋ sâc jujuhâmore sawa manasuekac, â ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec eki ine hâmocte mâmâc manasuekac.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi mu tutuc enâreme manapene fefene ezejec, â ŋic mutuc matacne jaŋe mumbiaŋ‐nâpopie manapene wawahane ezejec.
Ŋic mutucne moczi gâwieme qiŋambu ʒârâ ʒocko râepene ʒahuc parac heekac irec sâc eekac, erâ izi wiac fâri tâmiric jaha ekac wâc.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec moczi ŋic moc eatuckeocmu e ŋic mutucnere sâc bâfuaocmu, â moc e bâbâmiriŋ moneŋ roocmuzi maŋ mamanasu‐ticne sipirickeocmu.
Gie fuŋkehuc mâcne, baku batararâ manapene biaŋkezejec. Sahac fefe juju i wiac wawahane â bumâteŋ faio juju izi ine wiac fefene.
Go kimbeŋ aaric biac mi bâfuazemec, aaric i ŋic mutucne jaŋere maŋko fic hae eekac.
Go ʒiŋuc mu wioc moc mi ezemec: “Dameŋ raŋɋanao wemocte wiac sasawa biaŋne fofârewec?” Wiwio iŋucne i maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ aricne.
Mâreŋko ŋic jueŋgopeneŋ sasawa nâŋâc maŋɋârâŋhec efârenʒepeneŋ; maŋɋârâŋhec juju i merâfâc wiac babaju irec sâc jaha ekac.
Moneŋzi ŋezic‐nâpoekac irec sâc jaha maŋɋârâŋzi ŋezic‐nâpoocmu; maŋɋârâŋte fuŋne manaeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋere juju i maŋɋârâŋzi basanaŋkeekac hâcne.
Go Anutuzi wiac ebac ewec irec manasuhuc juzemec; eki wiac i me i moc bame sâqorewecko ine ŋic moczi moc sâcne bâtiŋneocmu me?
Go gie wiacge batec hatacke‐hâmome ʒeri bubiaŋ faio juzemec, me sâqore‐gareme ine ʒiŋuc manazemec: Anutu e jujuhâmo â ʒârâ ʒâpânehec juju i mâmâc mume fua‐nâreekac, irec nâŋâc wemo ʒuhuckerâ maic‐nâpoocmu i mi manaeŋgopeneŋ.
Juju‐nane i fâri tâmiric ewec, ehame sifu wiac ʒiŋuc fuaekac i hone‐fârepo: Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe tiŋne jaha juhuc hâmo sipiric eeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine sindaŋne jaha juhuc dameŋ ʒora jufeeŋgopieŋ.
Irec go jujuge biac sipirickezicte tiŋne â maŋɋârâŋhec boc mi juzemec.
Erâ ŋifec ine dameŋge mi taraha biac hâmozicte sindaŋ â mutuc matacne wâc boc mi juzemec.
Go wiac ŋifecne ehuc ŋifecne wâc mi behezemec. Erâ Anutu araŋ bacnehuc wiac iŋuc me iŋuc ebac etec biaŋkeocmu.
Maŋɋârâŋzi ŋic bafic‐nâpoekac i guriŋ bapa ŋic 10 jaŋe hae moc bafickeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jâurukac.
Ŋic moczi dameŋ sâc tiŋne juhuc bahac moc mi bâfuaocmu i mâreŋko moc mi fokac.
Kiŋaŋ qaqagezi sâwecgukac, go dâŋ iŋuc moc manazicte ŋic jaŋe dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ sasawa irec hazec mi râezemec.
Erâ go dameŋ gâcnao ŋic sâwec‐jopameŋ i go gahac manaekic wâc.
No maŋɋârâŋhec juhuc wiac sasaware fuŋne bataniŋkepemurâ manasupo, ehuc kecʒiŋuc mupo: No maŋɋârâŋ fârine bâfua‐hâmozepac, iŋuc muhuc boc eipiepo.
Jujure fuŋne weniŋuc fokac i mozi mana taraocmu? Jujure fuŋne i qame hukicne, irec mana taranaŋte eipieŋgopeneŋ.
Erâ no sifu mana tarapemurâ giene ʒoɋachec bapo, ehuc maŋɋârâŋ â wiwio‐nanere fârine bâfuapemurâ fotac qatariepo. Erâ ine ʒiŋuc sawa mana tarapo: Sindaŋne juju i wiac mutuc matacne â mutuc matacne juju i wiac gâgâpâcne.
No iŋuc hone tarahuc ŋokacte fuŋne ʒiŋuc mana tarapo wâc: Ŋokac e hâmocte sâc jâuruhuc wiac hâtâ qiŋqiŋne iŋucne ekac. E âgo egareha izi bitiŋ iŋucne erâ kicguocmu, â hâpocgume kâpâcwâruzi basanaŋgukac tinac eocmu. Ŋic moc e Anutuzi manacneme biaŋkeekaczi ŋokac sâcne wisecneocmu, â ŋic hehesicne e ine ŋokaczi eatuckeme erao qohotaocmu.
Miti Mumu Ŋiczi dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukac: No wiwio‐nanere fârine bâfuapemurâ giene barâ ba ewarehuc iŋuc hâcne mana tarapo.
Erâ wiwio‐nanere okacne gâcne wâc bâfuapemurâ giene bape arictac ewec. No iŋuc ehuc ŋic 1 tauseŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋic mocjaha sawa bâfuarâ manacnepe fefene ewec, â ŋokac biaŋne ine moc mi bâfuapo.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no wiac kecʒiŋuc sawa hone tarapo: Anutu e ŋic tiŋne â biaŋne bâfuac‐nâpowec, ehame ŋic nâŋâc ine mamana biri hatane fuŋne fuŋne bâfuaeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi sawa wiacte wiac irec fuŋne mana taraekac. E maŋɋârâŋhec jume ʒâŋe mai‐ticne râŋgeŋnezi urueha fie ruruckeekac.
Go ŋicwofuŋzi dâŋ mutâcne‐gareme mana rereŋ ezemec, ehuc ine Anuturao mumupaŋ dâŋ i ututuŋ jaha mi muzemec.
Ŋicwofuŋ e wiac i me i ezo murâ eocmu, irec go ere maio fuarâ wiac irec me irec maname mi sâckeha qizec boc mi qazemec.
Ŋicwofuŋte dâŋ i tâpiri‐ticnehec, irec ŋic moczi ʒiŋuc sâcne mi âzâcneocmu: “Go wemo wiac ekomec?”
Go dâŋticne mana rereŋ erâ sâcne jucmu, â ŋicwofuŋte dâŋ i mo dameŋko weniŋuc ehuc reŋkezo i ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi mana taraekac.
Wiac sasawa ebac enaŋte dameŋ â hata bâfua‐nârekicne, ehame juku wiac weniŋucne fuaocmu i kâuc bahuc boc ŋemâckeeŋgopeneŋ, i mozi moc nâzâme mananʒapeŋ.
<range>
Ŋic nâŋâc hâmoc sâcne mi wisecnenaŋmu â hâmoc dameŋ‐nâŋec âke suepene feocte tâpiri wâc mi fonâreekac. Hâmochec ʒika gie bapa i jujumana tâmiric, â eeatuc moc bâfuahuc sâcne wâc mi behenaŋmu.
Ŋic jaŋe mâreŋko wiac ebac eeŋgopieŋ irec mamanasu gie bahuc wiac i sasawa mana tara‐fârepo. Ŋic gâcne jaŋe tâpirihec jueŋgopieŋ â gâcne jaŋe ine ŋic tâpirihec jaŋere rurumaŋko juhuc ʒâic manaeŋgopieŋ.
No ŋic sindaŋne ʒâŋeruŋko ducjopapie honec‐jopapo, erâ ŋic jaŋe ʒâŋeruŋ gieonec risiehuc ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ɋâricne juhuc hae‐jeŋicko wiac gâgâpâcne ejumbieŋ irec mumbiaŋ‐jopapie manapo. Wiac i wâc fâri tâmiric jaha.
Ŋic jaŋe wemocte afeckerâ wiac hehesicne boc eeŋgopieŋ? I okacne biac mi fisi‐jareekac irec.
Sâqocne bapa moc e wiac hehesicne eme arecne 100 mecne eha sifu ʒuhuckerâ jufeku ŋicqizec eocmu. Erâ no ine sifu ʒiŋuc manakopac: Anutu araŋ bacnehuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe araŋ bapa‐jeŋicte jujuhâmo bâfuaniŋmu,
â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ine jujuhâmo bâfuahuc dameŋ ʒora mi juniŋmu. Jaŋe Anutu araŋ mi bacneeŋgopieŋte juju dameŋ‐jeŋic i nâkumuc iŋucne fuarâ omaeocmu.
Erâ i wâc fâri tâmiric jaha ekac. Manakic, mâreŋko wiac kecʒiŋuc fuaekac hâcne: Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe okacne fua‐jareocte mukicne i ŋic tiŋne jaŋere faio feekac, â ŋic tiŋne jaŋe juju bapa‐jeŋicte furi roniŋte mukicne i ine ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe roeŋgopieŋ. No irec hâcne mukopac: Wiac i fâri tâmiric jaha ekac.
Irec ŋic nâŋâc ʒeri bubiaŋ faio junaŋte mukicne i hata i me i âtehuc mâcne, nânâ opâ nâhuc ʒeri bubiaŋ ee hata i mocjaha fonârekac. Anutuzi juju dameŋ banârewec irec maŋnao ʒâic gie sâko bahuc wiac i sawa sâcne enaŋmu.
No maŋɋârâŋhec erâ mâreŋko wiac fuarâ foekac irec fuŋne manapemurâ ʒoɋac sâko ehuc ʒiŋuc sawa mana tarapo: Nâŋâc ʒoaŋko me ŋafeo guŋɋâri juhuc mamana gie barâ
Anutuzi wiac ebac eekac irec fuŋne i sifu mi mana taranaŋmu. Nâŋâc irec mamana gie samarierâ bahuc sifu mi mana taranaŋmu. Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe irec fuŋne manaŋgopeneŋ, iŋuc muhuc sifu kâuc baeŋgopieŋ wâc.
No wiac sasawa irec manatâc qâtâc boc ehuc ʒiŋuc mana tarapo: Anutu e ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec â tiŋne jaŋere eebapa irec guriŋ bahuc maŋjauŋ â aaric‐jeŋicte guriŋ i wâc mâmâc baekac. Irec ŋic nâŋâc wemo wiaczi maic‐nâpoocmu i nâŋâc moc mi manaeŋgopeneŋ.
Wiac fuaocmu i ŋic mâmâc sasawa rocnâpoocmu, ŋic tiŋne â hehesicne, biaŋne â sâqocne, mitihec â miti tâmiric, Anutu araŋ bacneeŋgopeneŋ me mi bacneeŋgopeneŋ, nâŋâc mâmâc rocnâpo‐fâreocmu. Ine hâcne, sâqocne bapa wiac fuacneocmu sâc ijaha ŋic biaŋne fuacneocmu, â mumupaŋ dâŋ mi muocmu e ŋic mumupaŋ dâŋ mume wiac fuacneocmu irec sâc jaha fuacneocmu.
Ŋic mâmâc sasawa okacne sâc ijaha rofâreeŋgopeneŋ izi hâcne mâreŋko wiac gâcne fuarâ foekac i sirickehuc sâqoreekac. Ŋic jaŋe mâreŋko jufeeŋgopieŋ sâc mamanasu hehesicne â gâgâpâcne bajuku hâmorâ hâmokicne jaŋerao ʒuhuckeeŋgopieŋ.
Â moc e mâreŋko ɋâricne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko juha woworic‐ticne foekac jaha; qâto moc juocmuzi laioŋ hâmocnere sâc sirickeocmu.
Ɋâricne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe juku hâmonaŋmu i manaeŋgopieŋ, â hâmokicne jaŋe ine wiac moc mi manaeŋgopieŋ. Ehuc ʒuhuckerâ furi roro i mi eniŋmu, â ŋic moczi moc jaŋere mocwâc mi manasuniŋmu.
Jaŋe hâmohapie maŋjauŋ‐jeŋic â aaric‐jeŋic â ʒoɋac‐jeŋic i mâmâc omae‐fâreocmu. Jaŋe mâreŋko wiac i me i fuaocmu ira ʒuhuckerâ gie moc mi baniŋmu.
Ajoc, go nânâge nâhuc bubiaŋ manac, â waiŋ opâge nâhuc ʒeri ec, go iŋuc ecmurâ Anutuzi mârâc jaha biac mana‐gareme sâckewec.
Irec go dameŋ sâc ʒeri bubiaŋ faio juzemec.
Ŋokacgere egareekac ehec ʒeri bubiaŋ faio juzemec, Anutuzi mâreŋ ʒira juju fâri tâmiric garewec i fogareha iŋuc hâcne ezemec. Ehuc juju dameŋge fâri tâmiric sasawa irec ʒeri bubiaŋ manazemec, go mâreŋko ʒâic gie sâko bahuc juhaŋtec ʒeri bubiaŋ i sawa fua‐gareocmu hâcne.
Go gie i me i ʒoɋachec bazemec, i wemocte? Hâmokicne jaŋere haeo racmu ira gie me mamana me mamana tara me maŋɋârâŋ moc mi fokacte iŋuc hâcne ezemec.
Erâ no mâreŋko wiac kecʒiŋuc wâc fuame honepo: Ŋic gasackeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mao fisirâ furi mi roeeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic ʒoɋachec jaŋe ʒikao mi sanaŋkeeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe nânâ wiac boc mi bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, â mamana sâkohec jaŋe moneŋ mafa boc mi hureeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic mamana sarichec jaŋe gie fekicne boc mi rauckeeŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe sasawa wiac busâqocnehec fua‐jareekac hâcne.
Ŋic nâŋâc dameŋ banârekicne i moc mi manaeŋgopeneŋ. Ine qowi jaŋe mi manahuc bitiŋko raʒipie kicjopaekac, â hâwec qowi jaŋe wâc mi manahuc wasaŋko jowaeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha ŋic nâŋâc mi manahuc juhapene dameŋ sâqocnezi ututuŋ jaha maic‐nâpoekac.
No mâreŋko wiac kecʒiŋuc wâc fuame honerâ manape boc fefene ewec:
Mâreŋ mocko hae piticne moc ŋewec, erâ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe afecne sawa. Ehame ŋicwofuŋ tâpirihec moczi momorifâc‐ticne jaŋehec fisirâ hae i somâckembiŋ. Somâckerâ qânâsac âkeʒurâ haeo feniŋte ʒae wiac bambiŋ.
Erâ hae irec maŋnao ŋic hapetac moczi maŋɋârâŋhec juwec. E maŋɋârâŋ dâŋticnezi hae i râsifâc‐ticne jaŋere meonec batarawec. Ehame ʒâhec ine ŋic ere mocwâc mi manasumbiŋ.
No iŋuc honerâ ʒiŋuc mana tarapo: Maŋɋârâŋzi tâpirire sâc sirickehuc wiac fefene ekac; ŋic gâcne jaŋe ine ŋic waha qaqanere maŋɋârâŋ qaisockeeŋgopieŋ â dâŋticne wâc qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋicguru mutuc matacne jaŋere micnezi dâŋ musokahuc mume hazec mi râenʒepeneŋ, ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi dâŋ urucne mume ine mana rereŋ epene biaŋkeocmu.
Maŋɋârâŋzi ʒikare wiac sirickehuc gie biaŋne baekac, â bâbâsifuc ŋic mocjaha maczi ine wiac biaŋne bocjaha ima baekac.
Mâkâc hâmocne jaŋe wokemaŋ âsu biaŋko hupie wokemaŋzi âsu sâqocne fiocmu, irec sâc jaha dâŋ mutuc matacne afecnezi maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ bawahaocmu.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi wiac fâretiŋ jaha ebac eekac, â ŋic mutuc matacnezi ine wiac hehesicne ebac eekac.
Ŋic mutuc matacnezi ŋic furune mutuc mujarehuc e jahacne fuŋne bataniŋkeekac.
Ŋicwofuŋgezi aaric mana‐gareme sifu giege mi behezemec, go mâteŋne jutec kiŋge beheocmu mecne.
No mâreŋ sâc ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe wiac hehesicne kecʒiŋuc epie honepo:
Jaŋe ŋic mutucne jaŋere meo gie fekicne râehuc ŋic moneŋ mafa sâkohec jaŋere meo ine gie omane râeeŋgopieŋ.
No kiŋaŋ qaqa jaŋe becâsic faio ŋehapie ŋic fekicne jaŋe kiŋaŋ qaqa jaŋere sâc kikezi rahapie honec‐jopapo.
Go nombâŋ moc rocmuo ine gahaczia hucmu, â ficsâpe moc heropiehaŋ homazi kicguocmu.
Qânâ wiac rohuc juhapene qânâzia ŋemac‐nâpoocmu, â ʒoc hesuckepene izia nâpoocmu.
Râricge micmâŋ eha mi ʒâmucmuo ine gie sâko gareocmu, irec qanaŋ mamanasu gie barâ wiac ebac etec sâckeocmu.
Go homa moc biac kicguha faicnao sawa bâmâteŋkecmu i fâri tâmiric eocmu.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec e dâŋ muocmu izi hâcne ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne bafahareocmu, â ŋic mutuc matacne e ine dâŋticnezia sipirickeocmu.
E fuŋkerâ dâŋ mutucne muekac, erâ muraku dâŋ gâgâpâcne jâmbâŋ muhuc mutaraekac.
Ŋic mutuc matacnezi dâŋ ʒuʒuhuc jaha muekac. Ŋic nâŋâc wemo wiaczi maic‐nâpoocmu i mi manaeŋgopeneŋ, erâ juku hâmopene irec faicnao wemo wiac fuaocmu i ŋic moczi moc sâcne wâc mi nâzâocmu.
Ŋic mutuc matacnezi hae‐ticnere hata basahuc gie sâko baku docke betaŋ eocmu.
Opoŋ, mâreŋ mocte ŋicwofuŋzi ɋie hawari juocmu â fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe ŋafe ʒora tiwâ bâzi sâko nâhuc juhapie hae fureme mâreŋ i sâqorerâ foocmu.
Â mâreŋ moc irec ŋicwofuŋzi ŋic sanaŋne juocmu â fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe tiwâ bâzi‐jeŋic dameŋkoa nâ bac ehuc opâ sanaŋ nâpie maŋjeŋic mi sifuckeme mâreŋ izi ine biaŋne foocmu.
Ŋic moc e ojoŋ juhuc ficbupu‐ticne mi bâpiaŋkeha hoe wahame juku ficticne ʒaŋkeocmu.
Nâŋâc tiwâ bâzi nâhuc bubiaŋ manaeŋgopeneŋ â waiŋ opâ nâhuc ʒeri bari eeŋgopeneŋ, erâ ine wiac i moneŋ tâmiric mâc rorâ nânâne mi fokac.
Ŋoŋe ŋicwofuŋ‐ŋeŋic hofao me soŋsoŋko mi sâweckenʒepieŋ, erâ ficŋeŋicko ŋehuc ŋic moneŋ mafa sâkohec jaŋe wâc mi sâwec‐jopanʒepieŋ; wipe jaŋe dâŋŋeŋic manarâ ra dâŋrune jazanʒipiŋte iŋuc mi enʒepieŋ.
Go moneŋge qikiŋnetec izi gie bame juku ʒuhuckerâ fua‐gareocmu.
Erâ gie mocjahare sawa mâcne, gie 7 me 8 irec biŋe qikiŋnezemec. Go mâreŋko wemo ŋemâc moc fua‐gareocmu i mi manakicte iŋuc hâcne ezemec.
Karoraczi qâzuckerâ gâpârehuc hoe heekac, â jâc moczi juwicpec me faicpec fararâ ijaha foocmu.
Go hoe mâŋâŋ jahere soŋaŋ bahuc gie he sarac mi ecmuo ine qa roro dameŋ maickeme fârine basacmu.
Neŋgoc bumaŋko ŋic ɋâricne weniŋuc ehuc maŋ sahachec fuaekac i mi manaeŋgopeneŋ, iŋuc jaha wâc Anutu bapafâre rune e gie bapa‐ticnere fuŋne mi manaeŋgopeneŋ.
Go furicte â owâcne gie he sarac ezemec; go wiac wenimoizi biaŋkeocmu â wenimoizi sâqoreocmu, me mâmâc jaha fua biaŋ eniŋmu i mi manaekicte iŋuc hâcne ezemec.
Tatamac i wiac biaŋne, irec ʒâŋe‐nâŋeczi ʒoaŋ tatamac honerâ bubiaŋ manaeŋgopeneŋ.
Go mâreŋko jufecmu sâc bubiaŋ manazemec, ehuc dameŋ ʒoricne me bembeŋne jufehuc ʒiŋuc manasuzemec: No juku hâmorâ dameŋ ʒora fopemu. Wiac fuaocmu sasawa i fâri tâmiric efâreocmu.
Ŋic ŋokac socɋâri ŋoŋe aŋac faio junʒepieŋ, erâ socɋâri jaha juhuc bubiaŋ manarâ ʒeri bari enʒepieŋ. Ehuc ine wiac ebac eniŋmu irec Anutuzi juku dâŋgieo râec‐ŋopaocmu i manasunʒepieŋ.
Wiac irec me irec mana mezac ehuc busâqoc mi enʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe dameŋ ʒora socɋâri mi juniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe socɋâri jaha juhuc bâbâfua‐ŋeŋicte manasuhuc junʒepieŋ: juku ʒâhec ine ʒârâ ʒâpâ dameŋ maic‐ŋopame ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Nâŋe jujure mocwâc mi aŋac‐nâpoekac.”
Dameŋ ira hâcne mosa ʒoaŋ â bâpiŋ jaŋere tatamaczi gâpâreocmu â karoraczi mocwâc mi tâtieocmu.
Ehame meŋeŋic bafic‐ŋopahuc juwec i betaŋkeocmu, â kike‐ŋeŋic sanaŋkerâ domaekac i jâjâwâckeocmu, â micsiec‐ŋeŋic gâcne mârâŋkeme nânâ wiac‐ŋeŋic kidockezo eipieniŋmu, erâ wâc ʒâŋ‐ŋeŋiczi dapâc eme wiac honepie sisifucne eocmu.
Hae ʒoŋao fânâŋ wiac fuame sâcne mi mananiŋmu, ehuc padi toŋtoŋko âeckepie irec fânâŋ wâc mi mananiŋmu, â gae wohuc woŋgâŋ qapie irec fânâŋ i wâc iŋuc jaha mocwâc mi mananiŋmu, mâc wipe jaŋe dâŋepie ine guŋkonec mana ɋâɋâreniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe dameŋ ira tiki mâreŋko juhuc hâwic‐ŋopaocmu, â hata raniŋte boc eipieniŋmu. Ehame jaŋɋâŋzi âkec‐ŋopaocmu â sasecte tâpiri‐ŋeŋic wâc omaeocmu. Nâŋâc jujumana hae‐nâŋecko rahapene hae ʒoŋao ki mamakuc fuarâ foocmu.
Juju‐nâŋecte niŋgiŋzi tâcneocmu, â lambe‐nâŋec golzi bakicne i waha qanʒaŋneocmu, erâ opâ pakere muc i tâcneha pake e jahacne wâc qanʒaŋneocmu.
Sahac‐nâŋec mâreŋzi bakicnere mocwâc mâreŋ jaha eocmu, â qâqâtâc‐nâŋec Anutuzi nârewec e ine mocwâc e jahacnao risieocmu.
Erâ wiac i sasawa fâri tâmiriczi fâri tâmiric ekac, Miti Mumu Ŋiczi iŋuc mukac.
Erâ ine Miti Mumu Ŋic e maŋɋârâŋhec juwecte wiac manawec sâc i sifu ʒuhuckerâ ŋic ŋokac jaza qazuc ewec. Ehuc muqâqiŋ dâŋ gâcne gâcne i jâmbomac me burec irec fuŋne bataniŋkeocte mamana gie sâko bawec.
Erâ bâbâmiriŋ dâŋ mu qâreŋ ewec sâc i dâŋ fârine sasawa efârewec.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ i lama soŋaŋ jaŋere gunu tetecne iŋucne. Erâ i soŋaŋ sâko‐nâŋec, Anutu hâcne, eki tahac‐jopawec.
Ŋokâ‐mae, no dâŋ moc gazape manac: Ŋic jaŋe papia qizec bocjaha qâreŋkeeŋgopieŋ, eme go papia i sasawa irec mamana gie ʒoɋachec bahuc betaŋkezicte rucjarige bahuc juzemec.
Erâ dâŋ muwarekicne irec fârine mocjaha fokac i wâc gazape manac: Go Anutu araŋ bacnehuc sâcmutâc dâŋticne reŋkezemec. Ŋic nâŋâc wiac i hâcne enaŋte bâfuac‐nâpokicne.
Anutu e wiac sasawa, biaŋne me sâqocne, erâ wâc soŋsoŋko ebac ekicne irec sâcko dâŋnâŋec mutaraocmu.
Salomore gae fekicne ʒine hâcne.
Ei, go masugezi muducnucte enarekac. Maŋjauŋgezi waiŋ opâ sirickerâ aŋacne eekac.
Rurua wokemaŋ opâge i âsu biaŋ‐ticnehec, â ʒâŋe biŋege i opâ âsu biaŋ irec sâc, eme naru jaŋe irec hâcne gore boc ejareekac.
Jowacnutec gohec mâmâc gasackerâ ranac. O ŋicwofuŋ, go ficgao râecnuzemec, eme nâŋe gore bubiaŋ manahuc ʒeri bari enaŋmu, ehuc waiŋ opâ mumbiaŋkeeŋgopeneŋ i sirickehuc go muac baafec egarenaŋmu. Naru jaŋe gore ejareme sâcke‐jâmbâŋkekac.
O Jerusalemte otâfâc, no sahac‐nane gâpâre‐bipieha sifu hawari biaŋ juekopac. Sahac‐nane i Kedaŋic jaŋere qoruc boze iŋucne, erâ Salama ŋic jaŋere fofo qoruc irec sâc.
Sahac‐nane gâgâpâc irec boc mi hone sâqorecnuniŋ, ʒoaŋzi sahac‐nane rikeme iŋuc hâcne eekac. Hahac ɋafâc‐nane jaŋe aaric mana‐narembiŋ, ehuc waiŋ gie‐jeŋicte soŋaŋ râecnumbiŋte no nahacne waiŋ gie hone soŋaŋ mi epo.
Joroc biaŋ‐nane, go nazac: Lamafâcge mâreŋ wena râec‐jopaekic, â guŋpiticko wena ejaretec fomanaeŋgopieŋ? No wemocte âgofâcge jaŋere lama guruo naru qâsoriekicne tinac jupemu?
O ŋokac hawari biaŋ mocjaha, go mi manakicko ine lama jaŋere kike hata bâjâperâ razemec, ehuc lama motecfâcge lama soŋaŋ jaŋere boze heririŋnao râec‐jopazemec.
Joroc biaŋ‐nane, no gore manape Farao keretac‐ticnere becâsicfâc jaŋere sâc ekomec.
Maucge erickekicnere boc biaŋkekac, â upegao eri qoqonaŋ furi sâko râekicne fokac.
Nâŋe eri wiac golzi bagarehuc ŋondeŋnao siliwazi kubu bakicne i mâmâc râenaŋmu.
Ŋicwofuŋ e nânâ nâocte waha ŋehame eri qoqonaŋ‐nanere âsu biaŋzi sâkene babatarawec.
Joroc biaŋ‐nane e hâpo heâroŋ enareme manape ʒariŋ ɋitickekicnezi amec‐naneo fokac tinac ekac.
No ere manape Eŋgedi mâreŋte waiŋ gieonec ʒariŋ âsunehec tinac ekac hâcne.
O joroc biaŋ‐nane, go sahac hawari biaŋ, go ʒâŋe kereŋ biaŋ‐nane!
O joroc biaŋ‐nane, go sahac hawari biaŋ, go boc biaŋne jâmbâŋ ekomec. Manakic, qinʒiŋ geunezi fofo‐nâhec tinac ekac,
â jâmâzâc jâczi ficnâhec tinac ekac erâ wete becʒi wiaczi sâpene â tapane tinac ekac.
No Saroŋ mâreŋkonec ʒariŋ moc iŋucne, erâ wâneŋko firindoac fuaekac irec sâc.
Aricne, joroc biaŋ‐nane e firindoac ʒârâ uupicko fuaekac irec sâc naru jaŋere ŋondeŋko juekac.
Joroc biaŋ‐nane e woraŋjâczi jâc omane jaŋere ŋondeŋko domaekac irec sâc ŋic socɋâri jaŋere ŋondeŋko juekac.
E maŋjauŋ sâko enarehuc waiŋ gie‐ticnao jowacnu rawec.
Ehuc waiŋ hândâŋne nareme nâqiŋnepo â woraŋ gumecnume nâpe bâgunucnuwec, no ere boc enare sâqorekac i!
Meqana‐ticnezi qizec roŋgâŋ enarewec â mefâre‐ticnezi hâpocnuwec.
O Jerusalemte otâfâc, no tiki noniŋ â kâte bulimakao jaŋerao ɋetickehuc ŋaza sanaŋkepe: Ŋoŋe joroc biaŋ‐nane kosa mi wiwickeniŋ, e jahac mana ɋâɋârerâ faharezejec.
Mananiŋ! Joroc biaŋ‐nane warekac. Tikine tikine â facne facne tara he tara he warekac hâcne.
Joroc biaŋ‐nane e tiki noniŋ iŋucne, â kâte bulimakao motecnezi ŋicne irec sâc. Honeniŋ, sac râpenao warejec domakac, ehuc qâqâtâc kataŋko ʒâŋe fime wefukac.
Joroc biaŋ‐nane e kecʒiŋuc muhuc nazakac: “Kogoc biaŋ‐nane, go faharerâ warec. Manakic, mâmâteŋ dameŋ i tarakac, â hoe dameŋ i wâc tarakac jaha.

Kâteo jâc wiac mocwâc fie âric eŋgopieŋ â wipe jaŋe dâŋ hawari biaŋne eŋgopieŋ erâ hapâ jaŋe jâchândâŋko hehefârec ehuc tumaŋneeŋgopieŋ.
O joroc biaŋ‐nane, go nemuja fârinezi woze qeuc eme â waiŋzi ârickehuc âsu biaŋ fiha norao warezemec.
O kogoc biaŋ‐nane, qânâ â mâreŋ hawecko soŋkerâ juekic go fua taniŋketec ʒâŋe maige honehape dâŋetec maracge manazepac, go ʒâŋe hawarige biaŋne â marac faŋfaŋ jâmbâŋ jukomec hâcne.
Ŋoŋe puruŋ jaŋe ŋafeo fisirâ suc qeuc me hândâŋ wiac gâcne nâ sipiric ehapie honec‐joparâ rocjopa‐nârenʒepieŋ.”
Joroc biaŋ‐nane e nore biŋe eha noni wâc ere biŋe ekopac, e lamafâc‐ticne sapa biaŋnao râec‐jopaekac.
O joroc biaŋ‐nane, go hae owâeha nâkumuc ʒorame norao warezemec. Go tiki noniŋ â kâte bulimakao motecnezi ŋicne tiki mâreŋko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc ezemec.
No maŋnanezi ʒâfickeekopac e hâcne ŋafene ŋafene guŋɋâri juhuc basapo, basahuc mi bâfuapo, â wiracnepe okacne mi bâtikie‐narewec.
Eme no ʒiŋuc mupo: “No faharerâ hae sâkoo razepac, ehuc hae hata sâc â hae ʒoŋa sâc babasa gie bazepac.” No iŋuc murâ ra basaku mi bâfuapo, â wiracnepe okacne wâc mi bâtikie‐narewec.
Eme ruc bapa ŋic jaŋe hae soŋaŋ juhuc bâfuacnupie ʒiŋuc wio‐jarepo: “Ŋoŋe maŋnanezi ʒâfickeekopac e moc honembieŋ me?”
Erâ no wio‐jarerâ jowaruhuc izia maŋnanezi ʒâfickeekopac e bâfuapo. Ehuc mocwâc behecnurâ razacte ro basanaŋkerâ neŋgoc‐nanere ficko jowa rapo, erâ neŋgoc‐nanezi rocnuwec ficmaŋ ira râepo.
O Jerusalemte otâfâc, no tiki noniŋ â kâte bulimakao jaŋerao ɋetickehuc ŋaza sanaŋkepe: Ŋoŋe joroc biaŋ‐nane kosa mi wiwickenʒepieŋ, e jahac mana ɋâɋârerâ faharezejec.
Mâreŋ burocnaonec wemo wiac warekac? Wiac i honepene âbârâ ŋic jaŋeraonec wiac âsu biaŋ fuŋne fuŋne ʒocko râepene ʒame hosâc feekac irec sâc ekac.
Honeniŋ! Ŋicwofuŋ Salomo e kanʒe‐ticnao reŋkerâ wareŋgopieŋ, ehame Israe ʒikaŋic tâpirihec 60 jaŋe orâŋ bârâŋ ecnehuc ʒâhec bâni ecneŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ʒika sâqe‐jeŋichec sasawa erâ ʒika qaqa saric. Jaŋe ŋafeo râsi fisipie jopa jâpec ejareniŋte ʒikare wiac‐jeŋic baju‐fâreŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Ŋicwofuŋ Salomozi mume kanʒe‐ticne i Lebanoŋ tikionec jâc wiaczi bambiŋ.
Ehuc reŋ wiac‐ticne i siliwazi bahuc rorowec‐ticne golzi bambiŋ, erâ ŋeŋe‐ticne i Jerusalemte otâfâc jaŋe qoruc furi sâkozi ba akic embiŋ.
Zioŋte otâfâc, ŋoŋe haeonec waharâ ŋicwofuŋ Salomo ofac hecneniŋ. E bâbâture dameŋ, ʒeri bubiaŋ dameŋ‐ticnao neŋgoc‐ticnezi eri hendiŋ hecneme huwec i herâ warekac hâcne.
O âgo biaŋ‐nane, go sahac hawarige biaŋne jâmbâŋ, ʒâŋe hândâŋge i kuŋkuŋ wipere ʒâŋe iŋucne rurufa maŋko ŋehuc fikomec, erâ qizec susucge ʒoricne i noniŋ jaŋe Gileade heâŋkonec kiwae raʒic wefuc ehuc wahaeŋgopieŋ irec sâc ekac.
Micsiecge i lama neŋgocne kanʒaŋ‐jeŋic bâtâcnepie opâ ruarâ wefueŋgopieŋ irec sâc qaŋqaŋ jâmbâŋ ekac. Jaŋe motecfâc‐jeŋic funʒuŋ fâri sasawa motec tâmiric moc mi jueŋgopieŋ.
Bipicge i muc bâbâroŋ irec sâc â memasu bembeŋ, mauc jahecge ŋifec â ŋifec i rurufa maŋnao bojazaŋ iŋucne bâruŋkerâ fokac.
Upege i Dawidire ficsanaŋ irec sâc, fic ira ʒika ŋic saric jaŋere wiac fuŋne fuŋne ɋetickekicne domakac.
Susu jahecge i tiki noniŋ motec jajahec jahe ʒariŋ maŋnao qinʒiŋ nâhuc domakopirec irec sâc.
No hae owâeha nâkumuc ʒorame ʒariŋ âsu biaŋ â hosâc âsu ririke tikio fepemu.
Joroc biaŋ‐nane, go sahac hawari biaŋ jâmbâŋ, go sahac fâsâc jukomec hâcne.
O ŋokac biŋe‐nane, go Lebanoŋ tiki beherâ warezemec, eme nohec mâmâc tiki mâreŋ i beherâ razeperec. Go Amana, Seniri â Herimoŋ tiki botâŋkonec biac wahazemec, laioŋ jaŋere jujuonec â lepad jaŋere tiki mâreŋkonec wahazemec.
O ŋokac biŋe âgo‐nane, go maŋ bâsifuc enaretec maŋnane gorao fâfârewec, go ʒâŋe râqâc honecnutec maŋnane gorao fâfârewec, qoqonaŋgere qânâ furi sâc mocjahazi maŋnane bâsifuckewec hâcne.
O ŋokac biŋe âgo‐nane, maŋge norao domame biaŋke‐jâmbâŋkekac, maŋge nore domame aŋacnukac i manape waiŋ opâre aŋacnuekac irec sâc sirickekac, â rurua wokemaŋ opâgere âsunezi wiac âsu biaŋ gâcne sirickekac wâc.
O ŋokac biŋe‐nane, bipicge i aŋac baŋacne, â nameŋ rurumaŋgao baŋac â susu fokac tinac ekac, erâ ŋaqigere âsu i Lebanoŋ tikire âsu irec sâc.
O ŋokac biŋe âgo‐nane, go ʒariŋ gie motâc herâ ki bakicne irec sâc, â opâ ʒâŋe bâbâzickekicne iŋucne.
Go jufu gie iŋucne, maŋnao jâc nâkicne â hâmu ɋoza wiac doma rakac.
Erâ ʒariŋ wiac âsunehec â wiac nânânezi âsu biaŋ fuŋne fuŋne fua rakac wâc.
Go jufu gieo opâ ʒâŋe fokac izi nombâŋkonec wefurâ ɋiɋicne raekac irec sâc, â Lebanoŋ tikionec opâ sâko wahaekac iŋucne.
O jowarec, go fuŋkerâ qawarec, O mula, go iŋuc jaha qawarec, ehuc jufu gie‐nane fificnepire âsu biaŋ‐ticne ŋeiŋnerâ razejec. Ehame joroc biaŋ‐nanezi jufu gie‐ticnao warerâ jâcfâri aŋac baŋacne nâ bac ezejec.
No jufu gie‐nane, ŋokac biŋe âgo‐nane hâcne erao warekopac, ehuc ʒariŋ wiac‐nane âsunehec â wiac nânânezi âsu biaŋ i ro qâzuc ekopac, erâ baŋac‐nane opâne â bitune nâkopac, â waiŋ opâ â susu‐nane i wâc mâmâc nâkopac. O âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋe nânâ opâ wiac i nâkupie maŋŋeŋic ŋokac jaŋerao wâc qohotazejec.
No maŋɋâri fohuc guŋ ʒiŋuc manapo: Joroc biaŋ‐nanezi motâcko heickerâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Joroc âgo biaŋ‐nane, go maŋgezi biaŋne ʒâficnuekicte motâc ronarec. Maniŋ titikuczi qizec‐nane bâŋgumuŋkekac, â hoe ʒâmbâŋzi qizec susuc‐nane hembânâŋkekâc.”
No ŋaqi‐nane biac hetarapac, irec weniŋuc erâ mocwâc hepe huocmu? Â kike‐nane biac ʒurepac, irec weniŋuc sohoŋ mocwâc âtepemu?
No iŋuc muhape joroc biaŋ‐nanezi meticne motâcko sicneme wefume honerâ hobu‐nane taŋtaŋ âeckewec.
Eme no fahare joroc biaŋ‐nane motâc rocnehape menaneonec wokemaŋ opâ âsu biaŋzi waharâ motâc mebapane ruacnewec.
Ehame joroc biaŋ‐nane motâc rocnepe e mocwâc mi domahuc biac risie rawec. No iŋuc honerâ maŋnane gâckewec. Eme basarâ mi bâfuapo, â wiracnepe micnaneo wâc mi rowec.
Eme ruc bapa ŋic jaŋe hae soŋaŋkehuc juku bâfuacnurâ ʒâpâ nuhuc ŋaqi‐nane sahacne nowac rorâ bawisembiŋ. Haesacte ruc bapa ŋic jaŋe iŋuc hâcne enarembiŋ.
O Jerusalemte otâfâc, no dâŋ ʒiŋuc ŋaza‐jâmbâŋkepe mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe joroc biaŋ‐nane bâfuarâ âzâcnenʒepieŋ: No ere mâretec enarekac.
O ŋokac hawari biaŋ mocjaha, go fuŋne weniŋucte joroc biaŋgere manatec ŋic gâcne jaŋere sâc sirickekac? Go fuŋne weniŋucte joroc biaŋgere manatec ŋic gâcne jaŋere sâc sirickeha giedâŋ keci munârekomec?
Joroc biaŋ‐nane e ʒâŋe mai‐ticne bâric bâricnehuc socsoc eekac, e ŋic tauseŋne tauseŋne jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhame biac ʒâŋitazo.
Qizec‐ticne i gol ematauckekicne tinac â qizec susuc‐ticne i mimiŋgeŋ â gâgâpâc, kâec kâecte suhuc iŋucne.
Ʒâŋe hândâŋ jahec‐ticne i hapâ jajahec jahe opâ ruarâ sahac‐jekic ɋaɋac taeŋne eha opâmecko ŋeekopirec irec sâc.
Mauc jahec‐ticne jahe mâreŋ bureŋ bakicnao ʒariŋ â wiac âsu biaŋ fuŋne fuŋne foekac irec sâc, â bipic‐ticne i wâc ʒariŋ âsu biaŋ iŋucne.
Meombâŋ jahec‐ticne i roŋ golzi barâ fainao qânâ furi sâko birickekicne irec sâc, â fâri ombâŋ‐ticne i elefaŋte ʒuŋezi ba akic erâ fainao qânâ furi sâko jaha bohotakicne iŋucne.
Kike jahec‐ticne i qânâ wâtuŋ gol râqâcko râepie hurâ domaekac irec sâc, â hawari‐ticne i Lebanoŋ tikionec jâmâzâc iŋucne.
Dâŋmarac‐ticne i boc aŋacne jâmbâŋ, â sahac hawari‐ticne i biaŋne sasawa. O Jerusalemte otâfâc, joroc âgo biaŋ‐nane ere fuŋne iŋuc hâcne.
O ŋokac hawari biaŋ mocjaha, joroc biaŋge e wena rawec? Joroc biaŋge e hata wenimoira rawec i nâzâtec baficguhuc basanʒepeneŋ.
Joroc biaŋ‐nane e ʒariŋ gie‐ticnao ʒineŋjâc domakacko ira hurâ rawec, e ira rac warec ehuc aŋac manaocte â ʒariŋ âsu biaŋ ro qâzuc eocte iŋuc ewec.
No joroc biaŋ‐nanere biŋe, â joroc biaŋ‐nane e nore biŋe, e lamafâc‐ticne ʒariŋ ŋondeŋko soŋaŋ‐jopaekac hâcne.
O joroc biaŋ‐nane, go Tiriza hae biaŋne irec sâc jaha, â Jerusalem hae aŋac baŋacne iŋucne, ehuc ŋifec ine momori ŋic jaŋere manapene hâhâwicne eekac irec sâc wâc ekomec.
Ʒâŋe jahecgezi maŋ bâsifuc enarekopirecte boc mi honecnuzemec. Qizec susucge ʒoricne i noniŋ jaŋe Gileade heâŋkonec kiwae raʒic wefuc ehuc wahaeŋgopieŋ irec sâc ekac.
Micsiecge i lama neŋgocne jaŋe opâ ruarâ wefueŋgopieŋ irec sâc qaŋqaŋ jâmbâŋ ekac. Jaŋe motecfâc‐jeŋic funʒuŋ fâri sasawa, motec tâmiric moc mi jueŋgopieŋ.
Mauc jahecge ŋifec â ŋifec i rurufa maŋnao bojazaŋ iŋucne bâruŋkerâ fokac.
Ŋokac fekicne 60 â ŋokac mamare 80 erâ naru ŋokac wowosec‐jopane tâmiric iŋuc juŋgopieŋ.
Ehame ine joroc biaŋ‐nane mocjahazi sawa âgo biaŋ‐nane jukac, e neŋgoc‐ticnere otâ mocsâkoazi neŋgoc roro‐ticne araŋ bacnehuc juekac. Naru ŋokac gâcne jaŋe e honerâ mu ʒeri ecneeŋgopieŋ, erâ ŋokac fekicne â ŋokac mamare jaŋe iŋuc jaha ehuc mumbiaŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
“Furic tatamac â mosa ʒoaŋ erâ bâpiŋ jaŋere tatamacte sâc jaha tamaekac e mo?”
No wâneŋko wiac ârinehec fuaekac i hone aŋac epemurâ kaŋa gieo hupac. Erâ wâc waiŋzi biac fiekac â bojazaŋzi âri qakac me mâcne i mâmâc honepemurâ ira hupac hâcne.
Eme mamanasu‐nanezi ututuŋ jaha jowacnu rarâ joroc biaŋ‐nanezi keretacko ŋewec ira râecnuwec.
O Sulam naru ŋokac, go foforisietec hone warec egarenaŋ! Hâc, ŋoŋe Sulam naru ŋokaczi gae wowo ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko gae wohuc rac warec eha wemo wiac mo honeniŋmu?
O naru ŋokac fekicne, no kike tapegere manape boc biaŋkekac. Gozi jahecge i qânâ furi sâko irec sâc, ŋic mamana saric moczi bâfuawec tinac ekac.
Funʒuŋge i râqâc oorâŋ iŋucne, ira waiŋ opâ wiac âsu biaŋhec bâsifuckekicne ŋehuc juekac, â bururuge i padi sesucne ʒariŋ âsu biaŋzi râreckehuc domakac irec sâc.
Susu jahecge i noniŋ motecne jajahec jahere sâc, tiki noniŋ motecne funʒuŋ fâri iŋucne hâcne.
Upege i ficsanaŋ elefaŋte ʒuŋezi bakicne irec sâc, â ʒâŋe hândâŋ jahecge i Hesiboŋ haeo Batarabim sacmotâc ŋifecnao opâ riqic ŋekac iŋucne, â sâke tetecge i Lebanoŋte ficʒora Damasko haeopec ŋekac irec sâc.
Qizecge i Karamele tiki iŋucne ferâ ŋekac, â qizec susucge ʒoricne waha domakac i gâgâpâc jâmbâŋ, ehame ŋicwofuŋzi hone rârâqârehuc maŋticne gorao qohotaekac.
O joroc biaŋ‐nane, naru ŋokac hone aŋacne, sahac hawari biaŋge kereŋ bareŋne.
Go fâujâc iŋucne ferâ domakomec, â susu jahecge jahe fâu fârine irec sâc.
No ʒiŋuc mupo: No fâujâc hahaŋko ferâ fârine rohape susu jahecgezi waiŋ ɋiti iŋucne ezepirec, â micâsugezi ine woraŋ ââsu irec sâc ezejec.
Ehame go arec faio dâŋ nazatec manape waiŋ opâ aŋac ʒizine nâkâcnepene quŋquŋke tâmiric biaŋne huekac irec sâc ezejec.
No joroc biaŋ‐nanere biŋe, e nore mâretec ecnekac hâcne.
Joroc biaŋ‐nane, go warec, eme jufu gieo rarâ jâwecjâc fuŋnao guŋ fonac.
Hae fureme ine waiŋ gieo rarâ waiŋ i âpâu‐ticnehec fokac me biac fâuckejec, erâ bojazaŋ wâc âri qakac me mâc fokac i honezeperec. Eme no ira hâcne maŋzi ʒâficgupemu.
O joroc biaŋ‐nane, ira gâgâsere âsu biaŋ biac fuakac, erâ jâchândâŋ aŋacne â nânâne fuŋne fuŋne, raŋɋane â ɋâricne i gore biŋe râe biric efârepo hâcne.
Jai, go hahac‐nane fuarâ neŋgoc‐nanere susu nanʒaŋ me! Go iŋuc etec muzac no ira me ira bâfuacguhuc muducgupe ŋic jaŋe mi mana sâqore‐narenʒapiŋ.
Ehame no jowacgurâ neŋgoc‐nanere ficko râecgupe maŋ rârâec eere fuŋne qazu‐narenʒaŋ. Ehuc waiŋ opâ wiac âsu biaŋhec bâsifuckekicne i â mandariŋ opâ gare gumec ezapo.
Ehame meqanagezi qizec roŋgâŋ‐nane ezac, â mefâregezi hâpocnunʒaŋ.
O Jerusalemte otâfâc, ŋoŋe joroc biaŋ‐nane kosa mi wiwickenʒepieŋ, e jahac mana ɋâɋârerâ faharezejec.
Mâreŋ burocnaonec warehuc joroc biaŋ‐ticne erao roweckekac e mo? No neŋgocgezi gozi kime rocguwec woraŋjâc irec fuŋnao wiwicgupo.
Meo fefe mahec rojueŋgopieŋ irec sâc maŋgao â meombâŋgao râecnuzemec. Maŋzi ʒâʒâfic irec tâpiri i hâmocte tâpiri irec sâc sanaŋne jâmbâŋ ekac, â ʒâŋeruŋzi âgo mi bacnâpoekac irec sâc jaha mamanauŋheczi jauŋ tâmiric juekac. Maŋ rârâec ee i wiac fofo sanaŋ, wiac moczi moc mi bawahaocmu.
Rumi sâkozi sâcne mi jowa raocmu â opâ sâkozi wâc mi qâuruckeocmu. I ŋic moczi moneŋ mafa wiac sâko‐ticnezi furine baocte mume muzac ine mu ruruc boc ecnenʒapiŋ.
Nâŋe qonâŋec piticne moc jukac e susu‐ticne kucguŋne ŋekac, irec ŋic moczi biŋe qacnenaŋte ware mume qonâŋec e weniŋuc ecnenaŋmu?
E qânâsac iŋucne fome fainao siliwa hendiŋ hecnepene huocmu, me motâc iŋucne domame jâmâzâc katapazi foŋkenaŋmu.
No qânâsac iŋucne ehape susu jahec‐nane jahe ficʒora‐ticne irec sâc ferâ ŋekopirec, ehame honecnume wamane jukopac tinac ekac.
Salomo e Baali‐Hamoŋ mâreŋko waiŋ gie‐ticne moc fokac, i ŋic gâcne jaŋe hotâ bajuhuc soŋaŋkeniŋte jarewec, ehuc fârine fuame ro nâc ehuc furine ru sâc siliwa moneŋ wâŋ tauseŋ râcneniŋte mujarewec.
Nore waiŋ gie i no nahacne biŋe jâmbâŋ, irec Salomo go moneŋge wâŋ tauseŋ i fogarezo murâ fogarezejec, â soŋaŋ gie baeŋgopieŋ jaŋere moneŋ 200 fojarezo murâ fojarezejec wâc.
O ŋokac biŋe‐nane, go jufu gieo juhaŋte âgofâc‐nane jaŋe dâŋmaracge mananiŋte hazec râeeŋgopieŋ, irec dâŋ mutec noni maracge manazepac wâc.
O joroc biaŋ‐nane, go biac ware hofao fuazemec, ehuc tiki noniŋ me kâte bulimakao motecnezi ŋicne jaŋe tikio wiac âsu biaŋ fuaekacko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc ezemec.
Ʒi Amozire ŋokâ Jesaja e ʒâŋene raruŋkeme Juda mâreŋte â Jerusalem haere wiac hone manac ewec irec dâŋ. Ine Uʒija, Jotam, Ahaʒi â Hisikia jaŋe Juda ŋicwofuŋ juwarehuc juhapie wiac i fuacnehuc juwec.
Sambâŋne sambâŋne ŋoŋe mananiŋ, â mâreŋ go hazec râec; Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “No naru motec gume bâsokac ejarehuc hone maiŋ ejarepo, eme jaŋe ine fenarembiŋ.
Bulimakao e ruticne ʒâŋitaekac, â doŋgi e bomboŋ‐ticnezi nânâ oto bâfuacnewec i manaekac; Israe e ine mamana mi focnekac, ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe maŋ tâmiric juŋgopieŋ.”
Jei, ŋicguru sindaŋ hârindaŋne, kiŋ bahac qâŋkerâ juju, sâqocne bapa jaŋere ɋâricfâc, naru motec kekeporicne. Jaŋe Wofuŋ râpeckembiŋ, Israere Tiri Wofuŋ mana suambiŋ, ehuc e beherâ rârâpe wisembiŋ.
Ŋoŋe fecnehuc jaha juŋgopieŋte wemo‐ŋeŋicko ʒuhuckerâ qa bâtiŋ eŋarezo? Qizec e furu jaha huc ecnekac, maŋ e furu jaha betaŋkekac.
Kike tape â qizec botâŋ ŋoŋondeŋ‐jekicko sahac moc furu mi fokac; qa hepârâc ekicne â ʒikare micrâfâc â wic soc sâŋiŋnehec sasawa; i ba bâpisic â ʒure foŋ mi ecnekicne, â wokemaŋ ruacnehuc mi bâuruekicne.
Mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic tuhu fuawec fokac, hae sâko‐ŋeŋic ŋerawec i ʒoczi ʒâseŋkewec; mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicte fârine i ŋic furunezi ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko ro nâc eeŋgopieŋ, hae mâreŋ i jabanezi qa imac embiŋ iŋucnea fokac.
Eme waiŋ gieo boze wamba ŋeekac, Zioŋte otâ e irec sâc mac behepie ŋekac; wâruhaŋ maŋko gie boze ŋeekac irec sâc, me hae moc somâmaŋko ŋeekac iŋucne.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi ʒikare uucne moc mi akic‐jopa‐nâreme muzac, ine Sodom iŋucne enʒapeŋ, â Gomorare sâc bâfuanʒapeŋ.
Sodomte micne ŋoŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ mananiŋ! Gomora ŋic ŋoŋe Anutu‐nâŋecte mumutâc dâŋ irec hazec râeniŋ.
Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Taha wiac‐ŋeŋic guru sâko izi wemo enareocmu? Lama ŋicne bâzi rike‐nareeŋgopieŋ irec mecne â bulimakao biuc sâko jaŋere wokemaŋte mâmâc takicnukac. Erâ bulimakao ŋicnere socte me lamare me noniŋ ŋicnere wâc mi aŋacnukac.
“Ŋoŋe mai enareniŋte fisieŋgopieŋko hae ʒoŋa‐nane âtenʒaŋneniŋte mozi muŋarewec?
Taha fârimâc mocwâc mi bafisiniŋ, hosâc âsure mamakâcnukac, mosa ɋârire hombaŋ â sabata hombaŋ â tutumaŋte ʒâfo bapamanaŋgopieŋ, hehesic juju â hombaŋ tutumaŋ, i bâturepie ââkeacnukac.
Mosa ɋâri‐ŋeŋic â hombaŋ tutumaŋ‐ŋeŋic i maŋnanezi qaisockeekac, iŋeŋiczi hâcne kimâcnuha mana ʒâireekopac.
Ŋoŋe meŋeŋic bâfeŋne‐narepie ʒâŋe‐nane bâsoŋke‐ŋarepemu; eme nunumu bocjaha numupie no sifu hazec mi râepemu; meŋeŋic soc ruacne‐fârekicne i!
Maŋsahac‐ŋeŋic ʒure ɋaɋackeniŋ; eebapa‐ŋeŋic sâqocne fokac i ʒâŋe‐naneonec bârârieniŋ, ehuc sâqocne beheniŋ.
Eehâmore aafec gie baniŋ; bâbâtiŋ fua sanaŋkeocte henʒiriŋneniŋ, ŋic pepec eejare fuakac i bâtiŋneniŋ; bekâ mâsiŋ dâŋjeŋic dopeckeniŋ, hozec sacfozic fojareniŋ.”
Wofuŋzi mukac: “Ajoc, warepie dâŋ mu bâtikic enaŋ: Hehesic‐ŋeŋic saŋ bâroŋ iŋucne fokacko sifu sinou iŋucne qaŋqaŋ fuazejec: â qoruc somboroŋ iŋucne fokacko sifu lama kanʒaŋ iŋucne fuazejec.
Ŋoŋe aafec bâfuarâ micrereŋhec eniŋmuo mâreŋte fâri biaŋ fua‐ŋareme nâniŋmu.
Â qikiŋnehuc râŋgeŋkeniŋmuo ine ʒikazi kimiziec‐ŋopaocmu. Dâŋ i Wofuŋte mickonec wahakac hâcne.”
Ojai, hae pectâc biaŋ juwicnao bâbâtiŋte neŋgocne ŋeweczi weniŋuc erâ boe saure hozine ekac! Mârâc tiŋne jujure ŋeŋe hae eweczi miŋecgac ʒika qaqare ŋeŋe hae ekac.
Siliwagezi ŋetikierâ qânâ tinac ewec, waiŋge i opâhec bâsifuckekicne.
Micnefâcge jaŋe doc bapa ŋic erâ fiuc roro ŋic jaŋere âgofâc embiŋ. Jaŋe sasawa bâbâmiriŋ moneŋte ejareme bubiaŋ wiac roniŋte ra rowec ware rowec eeŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe bekâ mâsiŋ dâŋgieo mi ŋezic‐jopaeŋgopieŋ â hozec jaŋere dâŋ jaŋerao mi fisiekac.
Irec Fekicne sâko, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu tâpiri rune, ere micdâŋ ʒiŋuc fuakac: “No kisâfâc‐nane okacne bazu‐jarepemu â kimbeŋ‐nanezi râsifâc‐nane rua‐jarerâ maŋnane mâteŋkeocmu.
No menane goraopec bâfeŋnepemu, erâ siliwa jawage opâ ʒaʒacnezi ʒure‐garepe fârine wosâeme jawa bârâriepemu.
Eme mumutara ŋicfâcge esecne jugarembiŋ, iŋucne mocwâc bâfuac‐jopa‐garepemu, â mumutâc ŋic bâbâni jumbiŋ iŋucne; eme faicnao ʒâŋege tiŋne juju â jauŋ fâri hae mugareniŋmu.”
Zioŋ e bâbâtiŋ fuacneha firuezo, â maŋnao juhuc maŋjeŋic bârisieniŋmu jaŋe tiŋne jujure faio firuec‐jopazo.
Kâcɋene fejarehuc jujune â sindaŋŋic jaŋe ine mâmâc bâsirowec‐jopazo, eme Wofuŋ râpeckembiŋ jaŋe omaeniŋmu.
Eme boriŋjâcte aŋac‐ŋopaekac irec mimienʒepieŋ â jufu bâtirimbiŋ irec weaŋkenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc boriŋ rehacne ururuckeekac irec sâc enʒepieŋ, â jufuzi opâ basarâ hahaŋkeekac iŋucne.
Eme ŋic tâpiri sanaŋ eki semune ehuc mujawezejec, â meqâreŋ‐ticnezi ʒoc uucne ezejec! Eme jahe turerâ qâqâhâsâc erâ ʒapire moczi moc ʒoc mi qâhâpozejec.
Amozire ŋokâ Jesaja e Juda mâreŋte â Jerusalem haere dâŋ wiac hone manac ewec ʒi.
Ʒâhec dameŋko wiac ʒiŋuc fuaocmu: Wofuŋte ufuŋ irec tikizi qiŋ herâ ŋehuc tiki sasawa jaŋere micne eocmu; ehuc mâreŋ facne qâhuc‐jopa‐fâreocmu; eme ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe ira heâckerâ fisiniŋmu.
Eme ŋicguru bocjahazi fisirâ muniŋmu: “Warepie Wofuŋte tikio fenaŋ, Jakobore Anutu ere ufuŋko. Eme eki hata‐ticne nâzâ nâwotuc eme gâŋticnao âtehuc junʒepeneŋ.” Zioŋkonec sâcmutâc râwiŋneocmu, â Jerusalemkonec Wofuŋte dâŋ haŋ baocmu hâcne.
Eki ŋicne ŋicne ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko mumutiŋ gie baocmu, ehuc ŋicguru bocjaha dâŋ mutiŋne‐jareocmu. Eme jaŋe ʒika‐jeŋic bâtikiepie kinoŋ fuaocmu â damu‐jeŋiczi gie sâqe eocmu; guru moczi guru moctao râsi moc mi fisiocmu â ʒikare ʒaʒawie gie i omaeocmu.
Ajoc, Jakobore kikefuŋ warepie Wofuŋte tatamacko junaŋ.
Go ine ŋicfâcge, Jakobore kikefuŋ, ʒiŋucte qikiŋ‐jopameŋ: Jaŋe ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec qaŋgec mâsi amecke jueŋgopieŋ, â Filisa ŋic iŋucne faŋfaŋzi fusec‐jopaekac, â ŋic jabane jaŋehec meo roroc eeŋgopieŋ.
Mâreŋ‐jeŋic siliwa â golzi fusucmawec, boreŋ‐jeŋic oomaene tâmiric; mâreŋ‐jeŋic becâsiczi fusucmawec, ʒika keretac‐jeŋic oomaene tâmiric.
Mâreŋ‐jeŋic nemuɋâŋzi fusucmawec eme meqâreŋ‐jeŋic dapecneeŋgopieŋ, mejeŋiczi wiac ba akic embiŋ i hâcne sâseeŋgopieŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc ŋiczi wawahane erâ qoro tutucne embiŋ; eme go irec kiŋ mi behe‐jarecmu.
Go qânâuŋko raʒi tâmirec, â rufemaŋko soŋke sanaŋkec; go Wofuŋte tâpiri wânʒâŋ wisecnec, ehuc tatamac ɋuŋɋasaŋ‐ticnaonec râriec.
Ŋicte penaroŋ ʒâŋe bawahazo, â ŋic jaŋere maŋfefe bâuruŋkezo; eme ʒoaŋ ira Wofuŋ e buc fahare hâŋ domaocmu.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e dameŋ bawec fokac, ira pepec penaroŋhec sasawa dâŋgie jareocmu â wiac faharerâ doma rakac i bawaha‐fâreocmu.
Lebanoŋte jâmâzâc sasawa ʒoricne ʒora â Basaŋte boriŋjâc bâuruŋ‐jopa‐fâreocmu.
Erâ wâc tiki ʒora sasawa râsi ejareocmu â mâreŋ facne ferâ ŋerakac i iŋuc jaha.
Erâ wâc fic hâŋʒora sasawa râsi ejareocmu, â qânâsac basanaŋkekicne i iŋuc jaha.
Erâ wâc Tarasisi woke sasawa râsi ejareocmu, â wiac basarickekicne sasawa i iŋuc jaha.
Eme ŋicte pepec sisiric badapezo â ŋic jaŋere penaroŋ bawahazo, ehame ʒoaŋ ira Wofuŋ e buc fahare hâŋ domaocmu.
Eme nemuɋâŋ jaŋe omae‐fâreniŋmu.
Â ŋiczi qânâuŋko â mâreŋ hawecko raʒihuc Wofuŋ tâpiri wânʒâŋ‐ticne wisecneniŋmu â tatamac ɋuŋɋasaŋ‐ticne fuame rârieniŋmu. Eki dameŋ ira mâreŋ hâhâwic hecneocte fahareocmu.
Dameŋ ira ŋiczi nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic dape‐jareniŋte siliwa â golzi bambiŋ i hâcne ʒuc â mindi mindi behe‐jareniŋmu.
I qânâuŋko â haroŋaŋ hawecko raʒihuc Wofuŋ tâpiri wânʒâŋ‐ticne wisecneniŋte â tatamac ɋuŋɋasaŋ‐ticne fuame rârieniŋte iŋuc eniŋmu. Eki dameŋ ira mâreŋ hâhâwic hecneocte fahareocmu.
Ŋic e sâke‐nâŋecko nokafe fokac irec sâc, irec e râpeckeniŋ me! Ere wemo wiac fârine muzo.
Wiac mananiŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, e Jerusalem haeonec â Juda mâreŋkonec dope â rowaŋ furu jaha bârârieocmu, nânâre rowaŋ sasawa â opâre rowaŋ sasawa.
Ehuc ŋic tâpiri sâkohec â momori ŋic, dâŋ mumutiŋ ŋic â porofete, findaŋdâŋ mumu â ŋicsoŋaŋ;
erâ 50 gurune gurune jaŋere micne bapa, ŋic ʒâŋe biŋehec â dâŋte micne, metâ bapa â qaŋgec mamana saric, jaŋe mâmâc bârâriec‐jopaocmu.
Iŋuc fuame mupe motec ɋârizi ŋicbomboŋ ejareniŋmu â pepec‐jeŋicheczi guriŋ bajareniŋmu.
Eme guru sâko jaŋe fecko fec eec eniŋmu i hahac ɋa â âgo bagozia eec eniŋmu; socɋâri jaŋe ŋicqizec pepec ejareniŋmu, â omanezi ŋicraŋɋa bawahac‐jopaniŋmu.
Eme moczi soctofa‐ticne, mamac‐ticnere guruonec, erao qohotahuc ʒiŋuc âzâcneocmu: “Go ŋaqi faine fogarekacte micne bapa junârec, ehuc jawa guru kecʒi guriŋ bac.”
Mume eki dameŋ ira ʒiŋuc muocmu: “No wic bâbâsomie gie mi bapemu, ficnaneo nânâ mecne ŋaqi mecne basakopac, irec ŋic jaŋere micne bapa mi mucnuzo.”
Jerusalem hae e fâfâckewec hâcne, â Juda mâreŋ e rândiŋke qawec; i dâŋjeŋiczi â eebapa‐jeŋiczi Wofuŋ râsi ecnehuc eri ʒâŋe mai‐ticne gâc hecnembiŋ irec.
Jaŋe ra rowec ware rowec‐jeŋiczi mutaniŋ‐jopaekac, Sodom ŋic iŋucne sindaŋ‐jeŋic mi hesoŋkehuc musaweeŋgopieŋ. Jei, sisipiric‐jeŋic jaŋe jaŋac bâfuaŋgopieŋ.
Tiŋne juju jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, jaŋe sâcne juhâmoniŋmu, eebapa‐jeŋicte fârine fuame ro nâc eniŋmu hâcne.
Sindaŋŋic ine jei! Harac huacbuc fuacneocmu, meticnezi wiac ewec sâc ijaha ecnezo hâcne.
Ojai, ŋicfâc‐nane ɋienezi bâʒâic‐jopaeŋgopieŋ â ŋokaczi mumutâcfâc‐jeŋic eŋgopieŋ. O ŋicfâc‐nane, micnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe qac qâsoric ehuc hata rara‐ŋeŋic hesifucke‐ŋarembiŋ.
Wofuŋ e mumutara gie‐ticne baocte faharejec, ŋicfâcne dâŋjeŋic mutiŋneocte domakac.
Wofuŋ e ŋicfâcne jaŋere soŋaŋ micnefâc dâŋko râec‐joparâ ʒiŋuc muhuc fuŋne‐jeŋic ritukac: “Ŋoŋe hâcne waiŋ gie ima bambiŋ, hapetac wiac jowac rokicne i ficŋeŋicko fokac.
Ŋoŋe weniŋucte ŋicfâc‐nane ro waha âte ejareŋgopieŋ, ehuc qarâ suriŋne ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic qanʒaŋneŋgopieŋ?” Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ Anutu ere dâŋ iŋuc.
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Zioŋte otâfâc jaŋe sahac fefe eeŋgopieŋte, â upe qahuc rac warec jueŋgopieŋte â ruruc bâbâc ehuc ʒâŋe fieŋgopieŋte, erâ dameŋ sâc enʒic emoric jueŋgopieŋte, â kike okac rojueŋgopieŋte,
irec okacne Wofuŋzi Zioŋte otâfâc utu karuc bâfua‐jareocmu, erâ ŋaqi heutu‐jareme biuctac domaniŋmu.
Ʒoaŋ ira Wofuŋzi eri‐jeŋic jowac roocmu, kike okac â ʒânoŋ bebesa â ajo mata
hazec pâŋi â megâŋ â rurufa qâreŋ
qizec eri â maŋguc bâroŋ â umbika; opâ âsu mumundoŋ â qaŋgec seroŋ,
meo fefe â sâke maŋŋuruc,
hombaŋ ŋaqi â hoe ŋaqi, mâŋâŋ qoruc â kâdoc,
hawari hohone â ombâŋ ŋaqi, duʒora â qârufac.
Wiac i jowac rofâreha âsu mumundoŋte okacne âsu gârec fuaocmu, â umbikare okacne repa; qizec gerere okacne utu pârâc fuaocmu, ŋaqi qâreŋ biaŋte okacne târu wamba, â sahac hawari biaŋte okacne mimi.
Ŋicfâcge damuzi kimiziec‐jopaocmu, qac momorifâcge ʒikazi omaec‐jopaocmu.
Eme Zioŋte sacmotâc qoroc hefâreocmu, â tuhu fuaha jahacne makuerâ mâc ŋeocmu.
Eme dameŋ ira ŋokac 7 jaŋe ŋic mocjaha ro basanaŋkerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcneniŋmu: “Nânâ i nâŋe nâŋâc bâfuarâ nanaŋmu, â ŋaqi wâc nâŋe nâŋâc bâfuarâ rojunaŋmu; mocjaha mana‐nâretec ʒâŋege rorâ bajunʒepeneŋ, eme mimi faio jueŋgopeneŋ i tarazejec.”
Dameŋ ira Israe maŋnao ʒikare uucne juniŋmu jaŋere biŋe Wofuŋte giteczi hawari biaŋ â erinehec fuaocmu, â mâreŋte fârinezi ʒeri aŋac bâfua‐jareocmu.
Eme Zioŋko nâfocne juniŋmu â Jerusalemko tiwâne ŋec juc eniŋmu jaŋe tiri mujarezo, Jerusalem haeo juniŋte qâreŋ‐jopakicne sasawa jaŋe hâcne.
Ine qanaŋ Wofuŋzi Zioŋte otâfâc wânâŋ‐jeŋic ʒure ɋaɋackeocmu, â Jerusalem haeo socte kiŋ fokac i bâbâtiŋte â ʒaʒataniŋte mârozi ʒumururuckeocmu.
Eme Wofuŋzi Zioŋ tikire hae mâreŋ â tutumaŋ irec faicnao ʒoaŋko karorac bâfuaocmu â ŋafeo hosâc â ʒocbâruŋ bâfuaocmu; Wofuŋte eri tatamaczi hâcne ŋic â wiac sasawa irec faicnao fohuc sabec‐joparâ sâoc‐jopaocmu.
Izi ʒoaŋko fârorocte mumuc qajareocmu, erâ wâc hoe mâŋâŋte ŋezic‐jopahuc sâoc‐jopaocmu.
Ajoc, manahapie joroc âgo‐nane gae hecnepe, âgo‐nane waiŋ jufu‐ticnere gae hâcne. Joroc âgo‐nane e waiŋ jufu moc rauckewec, i mâreŋ facne guec wokemaŋnehecko fowec.
E mâreŋ heruerâ qânâ rome waha‐fârewec, erâ waiŋ mucne biaŋne i sarawec; e ʒâʒâŋiŋko qânâfic ʒora bafewec, â waiŋ bâbâpisicte oto sâko wâc ba akic ewec. Iŋuc eku waiŋ hândâŋ fuaocte woŋec juwec, eme fârine ine waiŋ hândâŋ ʒaʒacne fuawec.
Ajoc, Jerusalem hae fâri â Juda mâreŋ rune, waiŋ jufu‐naneo me no nahacnao dâŋ fokac i mutaraniŋ!
No waiŋ jufu‐nane gie bacnehuctecne wenimoi moc hetarape fowec? Irec fârine bâfuaocte ʒâŋe fihape, weniŋucte waiŋ hândâŋ ʒaʒacne fuawec?
Eme ʒi waiŋ jufu‐nane mâsi ecnepemu, i mufua‐ŋarepe mananiŋ. No rârec rârec kamacsac fokac i bârâriepe qowi jaŋe fisi rehacne nâniŋmu; erâ wâc qânâsac‐ticne hetâtiepe ŋiczi fisirâ âtenʒaŋneniŋmu.
No behepe foku uupic wânʒâŋ fuazejec, tieŋne bâtâcne emasaŋ mi ezo â fuŋne mâreŋ mi hecnezo eme hofâ â fâpâ wiaczi bârârâŋneocmu; erâ karorac wâc aka hecnepe hoezi moc mi bâgunuckeocmu.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e waiŋ jufu‐ticne i Israe kikefuŋ guruzi ekac; Juda mâreŋ irec ŋic jaŋe jufu biaŋ‐ticne eŋgopieŋ. Eme bâbâtiŋte ʒâŋe fiha wemo wiac fuawec? Ʒika! Tiŋne jujure ʒâŋe fiha wemo wiac fuawec? Ki uu!
Jei, ŋic keci jaŋe! Ficne ficne kâŋgâc ro rauc eraŋgopieŋ â giene giene ro sakac efâreŋgopieŋ, ekupie sawane moc mi foocmu, jaŋezia hae mâreŋ i rucke‐fâreniŋmu.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere dâŋ nore hazecko huwec ine ʒiŋuc: “Jâmbomac, fic bocjahazi tuhutac ŋeraniŋmu, ficsâko, ficbiaŋ i ru tâmiric sasawa efâreocmu.
Waiŋ jufu gie dâkâne 10 sâko irec fârine fuaocmu i pake mocjaha irec sâc sawa; â padi ukic târu moc saraniŋmu irec fârine fuaocmu ine râqâc mocjaha irec sâc sawa.”
Jei, ŋic keci jaŋe! Furicte faharerâ izia opâ momori nâniŋte harac eeŋgopieŋ, erâ ŋafeo dameŋ ʒora waiŋ nâhuc ŋekupie maŋjeŋic fârorocke sâqoreekac.
Jaŋe tiwâ ʒepec‐jeŋicko waiŋ nâhuc, gita kâriŋɋaŋ â woŋgâŋ qahuc mimi ŋokac ficneeŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋte eebapare ine mi manasuhuc meqâreŋ‐ticnere ʒâŋe mi fieŋgopieŋ.
Irec râsi jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane acmâc jaha niŋgiŋ‐joparâ bacjopa raniŋmu; ŋicbomboŋfâc‐jeŋic nânâre hâmoniŋmu, â ŋic guru dindiŋfâc‐jeŋic opâre sipirickeniŋmu.
Irec hâmoc hae e ŋic âmbâŋ nânâ iŋucne, e michawec‐ticne aŋke sâqorekac, ehuc Jerusalemte fekicne guru â omane guru ɋâcjopakac, erâ maŋnao ojowa qahuc foeŋgopieŋ â ʒeri bari ehuc domaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc.
Eme ŋic badapec‐jopazo â ŋicne ŋicne bawahac‐jopazo â penaroŋ ʒâŋe fieŋgopieŋ jaŋe maŋhuhuŋ eniŋmu.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi ine bâbâtiŋ gie‐ticnere faio fekicne erâ domaocmu, Tiri Anutu e tiŋne‐ticnere fuŋne bataniŋkeme tiri juju‐ticne tâtâc fuaocmu.
Eme lama jaŋa jaŋe jaŋacne mâreŋko tinac qinʒiŋ nâniŋmu, â jabanezi mafaŋic jaŋere tuhuo nâ gapec eniŋmu.
Jei, ŋic keci jaŋe! Eeatucte repazi hehesic fâreeŋgopieŋ, keretacte repazi tinac sâqocne fâreeŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: “E fâro baoc me, gie‐ticne ʒocnehec bame honenaŋ me; Israere Tiri rune mumupaŋ‐ticnere fârine bâqiŋ‐nâpohuc ware fisime ʒâŋitanaŋ!”
Jei, ŋic keci jaŋe! Sâqocne mumbiaŋkehuc biaŋne musâqoreeŋgopieŋ, dâpâcte tatamac muhuc tatamacte dapâc mueŋgopieŋ, hâtânere nocne muhuc nocnere hâtâne mueŋgopieŋ.
Jei, ŋic keci jaŋe! Jaŋacnere manapie maŋɋârâŋhec juŋgopeneŋ eekac, â jaŋacnere manapie wiac mana tarahuc eŋgopeneŋ eekac.
Jei, ŋic keci jaŋe! Waiŋ nânâre sawa ʒoɋac sâko eeŋgopieŋ, â opâ momori bâmockeniŋte sawa ɋicwânʒâŋ eeŋgopieŋ;
bâbâmiriŋ moneŋte erâ ŋic bahachec dâŋ mutaracneeŋgopieŋ, ehuc ŋic bahacmâc ine tiŋne juju‐ticne mi mutaniŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
Irec ʒoczi sopâc nanameŋkerâ ʒâseŋkeekac, â kecɋaŋ hâmocnezi ʒocbâruŋko omaeekac, irec sâc gâtâ‐jeŋiczi gârecke ʒaŋ eocmu, â âri‐jeŋiczi rufe tinac ŋeiŋneocmu; jaŋe Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋte sâcmutâc hetapaickembiŋ â Israere Tiri rune mana suambiŋte iŋuc fua‐jareocmu.
Irec Wofuŋte kimbeŋzi ŋicfâcne bâruŋke‐jarewec, erâ meticne wickerâ hecjopawec, eme tiki jaŋe ɋiɋiteckembiŋ; â qâŋɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic jawa iŋucne erâ hae ʒoŋao forambiŋ. Eme sifu kimbeŋ‐ticnezi mi qaʒue wahawec, â menezi mi betaŋkehuc qiŋ herâ domakac jaha.
E ŋicguru moc taicko juŋgopieŋ jaŋe qeŋ qajareme mananiŋmu, erâ mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao juhapie woric‐jopaocmu. Eme honeniŋ, ɋeŋnea ʒocnehec fisiŋgopieŋ!
Ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko moczi moc mi betaŋkekac me rândiŋkezo ekac, ŋeŋemana me guŋ fofo i arictac, umbika‐jeŋic moc mi goroŋkekac, kikehuhu‐jeŋicte mucne moc mi tâcnekac.
Tepe motec‐jeŋic qâteckekicne, tepe neŋgoc gurutucne fârepie bâmbâŋ qakac, becâsicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere kike ʒârâic buse tinac, keretac ʒafeŋgâŋne oorâŋ mâŋâŋ tinac forisiekac.
Owa‐jeŋic laioŋ ŋokacnere owa iŋucne, laioŋ socɋâri tinac owackeŋgopieŋ; ŋuruŋkehuc qowi‐jeŋic kirâ bawiseŋgopieŋ, eme moczi moc mi jowac roocmu.
Eme irec erâ ʒoaŋ ira fânâŋ sâko fuaocmu i hâwec siri sâko irec fânâŋ iŋucne. Ehame mâreŋko ʒâŋe firâ honezo, mi dapâc hâhâwicne fuazejec i! Â tatamac i wâc hâweŋ karoraczi sâockekume dadapâcne jaha fuaocmu.
Ŋicwofuŋ Uʒija hâmowec jara dameŋ ira ʒiŋuc honepo: Wofuŋ e eri ŋeŋe fekicne ʒorao ŋeha ŋaqi‐ticne qaŋeŋnezi ufuŋ fusucmawec.
Ŋewec irec faicnao serafim domambiŋ fakec‐jeŋic mocte 6 mocte 6 jaha. Fakec jajaheczi ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic sâockembiŋ, jajaheczi kike‐jeŋic sâockembiŋ, â jajaheczi furuc furuc qambiŋ.
Ehuc jaŋaczia wiwira ehuc kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Tiri, tiri, tiri, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ; eri tatamac‐ticnezi mâreŋ sâc fuse rakac!”
Eme wiwira‐jeŋicte marac fânâŋ fuame ficte woke qâtâc ɋiɋiteckewec, â hosâczi fic fusucmawec.
Eme wirarâ mupo: “Jei, wenac epe, ʒi sipirickepemu, no micbipic‐nane wâwânâŋhec, â ŋicguru micbipic‐jeŋic wâwânâŋhec jaŋere ŋondeŋko juekopac; ehame ʒâŋe‐nanezi Fekicne sâko, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, e honekopac.”
Eme serafim jaŋeraonec moc e fitaczi alataonec ʒoc kine moc rorâ norao furuc furuc qarâ warewec.
Erâ izi micnane heuarâ muwec: “Honec, ʒi bipicge heuajec. Irec kiŋge bârâriekicne â sâqocnege bâtâmirekicne.”
Eme no Wofuŋ dâŋmarac‐ticne ʒiŋuc fuame manapo: “No mo sorepe? Mozi hata kiŋaŋ ranâreocmu?” Eme mupo: “No ʒi, sorecnuc.”
Eme muwec: “Rarâ ŋicguru keci ʒiŋuc jazac: ‘Mamana i mananiŋ, erâ mi mana taraniŋ; hohone i honeniŋ, erâ mi ʒâŋitaniŋ.’
Ŋicguru ʒi maŋjeŋic basanaŋkec, â hazec‐jeŋic bâbâzickec, ʒâŋe‐jeŋic bâhâpoc; eme ʒâŋe‐jeŋiczi wiac mi hone taranʒepieŋ, â hazec‐jeŋiczi wiac mi mana taranʒepieŋ, â maŋjeŋiczi wiac mi manasu‐hâmonʒepieŋ, ehuc maŋjeŋic mi bârisiepie mi bâpiaŋ‐jopazo.”
Eme no mupo: “O Wofuŋ, i mo dameŋte woŋec?” Eme muwec: “Wiac fuaocmu irec woŋec: Hae sâko ŋeraŋgopieŋ i sesuctac fuarâ tuhu eniŋmu, ficzi ŋic ŋokac tâmiric ŋeraocmu, â mâreŋ i kâte uupiczi bârârâŋneocmu.
Erâ Wofuŋzi ŋic taicko bârâriec‐jopame, haene haene behe‐fârekupie niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ foocmu.
Eme tiwâne teŋkonec wâŋ irec sâc juhapie sifu sisipiric hâsine harierâ fisi‐jareocmu eme jâmiŋ me beŋjâc qafarapene fuŋgâtâne sawa ŋeekac iŋuc fuaocmu. Fuŋgâtâne izi hâcne tiri ukic ŋeocmu.”
Juda ŋicwofuŋ Ahaʒi, Jotamte ŋokâ, Uʒijare ŋosa, ere dameŋko Siria ŋicwofuŋ Reziŋ â Israe ŋicwofuŋ Peka, Remaliare ŋokâ, jahe Jerusalem rauckenicte momori rocjoparâ fisipic, erâ ro rauc enicte eipiepic.
Dawidire tuc qarâ juwec e dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnepie manawec: “Siria â Eferaim jahe ʒâʒâfic ekopirec.” Eme dâŋ i manarâ e jahacne â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere buhândâŋ ɋarac ɋarac qawec, mâŋâŋ fisirâ kâtejâc itiriŋkeekac irec sâc.
Wofuŋzi ine Jesaja ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go faharerâ ŋokâge Sea Jasubu jowatec ra Ahaʒi bâfuanic, ine faicpec riqic ŋekac irec opâwâc tarakacko hatamecko qoruc qaqajac ŋic ere mâreŋko hâcne.
Bâfuarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnec: ‘Aimuŋ juhuc buge mâteŋkeoc, mi hâwicguoc. Ʒocmimiŋ jajahec hosâc qahuc fokopirec ʒi, Reziŋ â Siria erâ wâc Remaliare ŋokâ aaric‐jeŋicte ʒoc hâcne, irec maŋge mi omaeoc.
Siria e Eferaim â Remaliare ŋokâhec dâŋ qagarehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋte:
“Ajoc, Juda mâreŋko ferâ hâhâwic bâfua‐jarenaŋ, erâ mâreŋ i nâŋâc ruckerâ maŋnao Tabele ere ŋokâ âkendâŋnepene ŋicwofuŋ ejarezejec.”
