Wofuŋ Anutuzi ine ʒiŋuc mukac: Dâŋ i mi sanaŋkezejec, â fârine mi fuazejec.
Siria ere qizec Damasko, â Damasko ere qizec Reziŋ. (Iŋuc ine mi fofeocmu jara 65 mi taraha Eferaim qâtâtiezo, eme jaŋe ŋicguru moc buc mi juniŋmu.)
Â Eferaim ere qizec Samaria â Samariare qizec Remaliare ŋokâ. Â ŋoŋe mi mana ʒakieniŋmuo ine sanaŋkerâ mi jufeniŋmu.’”
Eme Wofuŋzi Ahaʒi harierâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Go mutec Wofuŋ Anutugeraonec fuŋne qaqa mâsi moc juwickonec jâmbâŋ, hâmoc haeonec, me faickonec jâmbâŋ fua‐garezejec.”
Ahaʒi eki ine muwec: “No wiac iŋucnere Wofuŋ sâcne mi esâickepemu.”
Eme Jesajazi muwec, “Dawidire ɋâricfâc ŋoŋe mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe ŋic tatakic bâfua‐jareeŋgopieŋ irec manapie afeckekacte Anutu‐nane iŋuc jaha ecneeŋgopieŋ me?
Irec Wofuŋ e jahac fuŋne qaqa mâsi moc bâfua‐ŋareocmu. Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋokac socɋâri e motec kiweckerâ roocmu, erâ ʒâŋe‐ticne Imanue muocmu.
Motec e sâqocne qiqikiŋ â biaŋne sasakare irec mamana fuacneme susu râqârekicne â baŋac nâhuc juocmu.
Â motec e sâqocne qiqikiŋ â biaŋne sasakare irec mamana mi fuacneha ine ŋicwofuŋ jajahec, hâhâwic‐jekic bajuŋgopieŋ jahe mâreŋ‐jekic biac tuhu fuarâ foocmu.
Wofuŋ e go â ŋicfâcge â mamacgere kikefuŋ ŋoŋerao wiac hâhâwicne bâfuaocmu, wiac iŋucne Eferaimzi Juda beheweckonec juwefukicne dameŋ ŋondeŋ irec maŋnao moc mi fuawec; Asiria ŋicwofuŋ hâcne mume fisiocmu.”
Dameŋ ira Wofuŋzi Aigita mâreŋte opâ sâko gecnao neŋgec juŋgopieŋ fuŋgaŋke‐jareocmu, â Asiria mâreŋko bitu juŋgopieŋ jaŋe wâc fuŋgaŋke‐jareocmu.
Eme jaŋe fisi‐fârerâ opâwâcko â hârâc huec, jâc dutune dutune â sopâc kecɋaŋ bârârâŋne‐fârerâ foniŋmu.
Dameŋ ira Wofuŋ e opâ sâko ocniŋucnaonec sâqe kiruŋ giedâŋ mucneocmu, Asiria ŋicwofuŋ hâcne, erâ sâqe izi qizec susuc â kike ʒâwâ‐ŋeŋic rofâreocmu, ehuc mecʒâwâ mâmâc omaeocmu.
Dameŋ ira ŋic moczi bulimakao ŋokacne socɋâri moc â lama jajahec iŋuc sawa bacjopa juocmu.
Eme qowi iŋucnezi susu bocjaha bâfuacnepie susu râqârekicne nâhuc juocmu; mâreŋ ira ŋic tiwâne juniŋmu jaŋe sasawa susu râqârekicne â baŋac nâhuc juniŋmu hâcne.
Hae mâreŋ mocko dameŋ ʒiŋuczia waiŋ jâcne wâŋ tauseŋ domaŋgopieŋ, furi‐jeŋic 500 kina, mâreŋ iŋucnao dameŋ ira bacmandaŋ â fâpâ uupic fuaocmu.
Bacmandaŋ â fâpâ uupiczi mâreŋ i rofâreha ŋiczi ira fisiocte tepe neŋgoc‐ticne fitackerâ tepe motec‐ticne ameckerâ fisiocmu.
Â mâreŋ facne facne kinoŋzi he bâfâuc ehuc jukicne, ira ŋiczi bacmandaŋ â fâpâ uupicte hâhâwic erâ mocwâc mi fisiniŋmu, aricne, mâreŋ i lama bulimakao qikiŋne‐jarepie âtehuc juniŋmu.
Eme Wofuŋzi nazarâ muwec: “Tafe sâko moc rorâ qâreŋ ŋiczi wowosene qâreŋkehuc ʒiŋuc râec: ‘Ʒi Biacfiuc Fârosakac ere wiac’.”
Eme no mumutaniŋ ŋicfâri jajahec, fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkenicte rocjofapo: Taha bapa Uria, erâ Ʒekaria, Jeberekiare ŋokâ.
Erâ ŋonâŋ‐nane porofete ŋokac erao rape motec kiweckerâ rowec. Eme Wofuŋzi nazarâ muwec, “Ʒâŋene Biacfiuc Fârosakac muzemec.
I ʒiŋucte: Motec e ‘Mamac‐mae’ â ‘Neŋgoc‐mae’ sâcne mi muhame Damaskore mafa â Samariare mâriri i Asiria ŋicwofuŋtao ameckerâ raniŋmu.”
Eme Wofuŋzi harierâ ʒiŋuc nazawec:
“Ŋicguru keci jaŋe Siloa opâ munaŋne i suŋgiŋkehuc Reziŋ â Remalia ŋokâ‐ticne jahere maio hâbi‐jeŋic goroŋkekac.
Irec ʒiŋuc manac, Wofuŋzi Eufrata irec fusine ɋiɋicne â bocjaha sore‐jarekac: Asiria ŋicwofuŋ â tâpiri ɋuŋɋasaŋ‐ticne hâcne, eme izi moŋgeŋ‐ticne qâuruckerâ tucduŋ‐ticne fotâcne‐fâreocmu.
Erâ rumi‐ticnezi âkeʒurâ Juda mâreŋ fotâcnehuc qâuruckeme upe‐jeŋicko qaocmu; o Imanue, fafakec‐ticne qaratieme mâreŋge ŋifec â ŋifec qofacke‐fâreocmu.”
Ŋic gurune gurune aaric mana‐bipiehuc bipic tatara enʒepieŋ, mâreŋ wiwickonec ŋoŋe hazec râe‐fârenʒepieŋ. Wiac emoc bâmoc eku bipic tatara enʒepieŋ, wiac emoc bâmoc eku bipic tatara enʒepieŋ hâcne.
Dâŋ mu biric enʒepieŋ, eme fârimâc ezejec; dâŋ musanaŋkenʒepieŋ, eme waha qazejec. Anutu e nâŋehec jukac hâcne.
Wofuŋzi mesanaŋ‐ticne fai‐naneo râehuc ŋicguru ʒi jaŋere hata âtezipore uŋ ʒiŋuc nazawec:
“Ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe manapie doc bapa dâŋ ekac, dâŋ irec manapie doc bapa dâŋ mi efârezejec, erâ jaŋe hâwic‐jopakac wiac irec hâwic‐ŋopame ɋarac ɋarac mi qanʒepieŋ.
Aricne, ŋoŋe Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere manapie tirimoc ezejec; ŋoŋe ere manapie hâhâwicne â araŋ babacne ezejec.
Eme eki tiri jujure fuŋqizecne eocmu, erâ Israe guru jajahec ine kike hehepiric qânâ â heheariwe buse ejacteocmu, â Jerusalem rune wiwitic â bitiŋ ejareocmu.
Eme bocjahazi ira heariwerâ waha jopahuc qanʒaŋ‐jopaocmu, erâ wâc bitiŋko kicjopame roc‐jopazo.”
Mumutaniŋ dâŋ i foforierâ ʒâfickezepac, mu qaqazu dâŋ i mamana motecfâc‐nane jaŋere maŋko râehuc basanaŋkezepac.
Wofuŋ, ʒâŋe mai‐ticne Jakobore kikefuŋ bâsoŋke‐jarekac, e hâcne woŋeckepemu â ere mamanac jupemu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no â motec jahec‐nane, Wofuŋzi narec‐jofawec, nâŋe Israe maŋnao Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Zioŋ tikio juekac, eraonec ma â sowi eŋgopeneŋ.
Eme jaŋe ʒiŋuc ŋazaniŋmu: “Ŋoŋe bawe â faŋfaŋ indiŋ‐jopapie saŋucko â fufuŋgaŋko dâŋ mufua‐ŋarenʒepieŋ.” Me ŋicguru moc jaŋe nemufâc‐jeŋic sâcne mi indiŋ‐jopaniŋmu me? Me jujune jaŋere erâ hâmokicne jaŋerao iindiŋ mi râezo me?
Mu qaqazuc dâŋ â mumutaniŋ dâŋ irapec hazec râezo! Jaŋe dâŋ muŋgopieŋ i bajuku ine jâmbomac furic tatamac moc mi bâbâfuane.
Ŋic iŋucne jaŋe busâqoc mana utuckehuc â nânâre sâqorehuc hae mâreŋ sicne fotâc eniŋmu. Ehuc nânâre hâmoku mana gâpârerâ ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic â Anutu‐jeŋic musoriŋ‐jofaniŋmu.
Ehuc ʒâŋe faic fipie feocmu â juwic mâreŋko fipie huocmu; erâ manaŋgopieŋ, wiac honeniŋmu i busâqoc â dapâc â hâhâwicte uupic wânʒâŋ, irec duŋdapâcko raʒi sanaŋkeniŋmu.
Erâ hâhâwic maŋko juhapie dapâc fowec i mi fosanaŋkeocmu. Mârâc dameŋko Wofuŋzi Sebuloŋ â Naftali mimi busâqoc bâfua‐jactewec, ʒâhec dameŋko ine riqic hata, Jordaŋ ocniŋuc mâreŋ fokac, qâpuc jaŋere hae mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe biŋe bafahareocmu.
Ŋicguru dapâcko hata juŋgopieŋzi ʒoctamac sâko honeŋgopieŋ, â mâreŋ dapâcnao ŋec juc eŋgopieŋ jaŋe tamae‐jarekac.
Go ŋicguru basawec‐jopakic â bubiaŋ bâŋɋârâŋke‐jarekic; maigao ʒeri eŋgopieŋ i nânâ nânâsuo ʒeri fuaekac irec sâc, â râsi jaŋere mafa bâtâc bahuc aŋac‐jopaekac iŋuc hâcne.
Tagi kimac‐jopawec â reŋ ɋawe‐jeŋic nâwec â bâbâʒâic ŋic ere ɋaruc i qazu behec ekic, Midiaŋte dameŋko fuawec irec sâc.
Momori ʒikao kike saoŋ qaeŋgopieŋ jaŋere kikehuhu â ŋaqi soc rurua i ʒocte nânâ efârekac.
Nâŋâc ɋie moc fua‐nârekac, ŋokâ moc tahac‐nâpokicne, eme guriŋ bapa gie i ere ɋaweo foocmu. Ʒâŋe‐ticne ʒiŋuc muzo: “Mâsi‐Hata‐Bâbâfua, Tâpiri‐Anutu, Juju‐Sanaŋ‐Mamac, Wama‐Ŋicwofuŋ.”
Guriŋ bapa gie‐ticne ŋeratie rame wama fofo sanaŋ foocmu, Dawidire eri ŋeŋeo â mâreŋ sâc guriŋ baocmu; eme ere bâbâtiŋ â tiŋne jujuzi eri ŋeŋe‐ticne bafaharerâ dopeckeme ʒiŋuczia ŋekaczi ŋerahuc juzokac. Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere ʒoɋaczi wiac i bâfuaocmu.
Wofuŋzi Jakobo okacdâŋ moc râecnewec, dâŋ izi Israe fainao waha qaocmu.
Eme ŋic sasawa hone manac eniŋmu, Eferaim guru â Samaria rune, maŋfefe â penaroŋ ehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ jaŋe hâcne:
“Qoracfic ʒaŋkewec irec okacne busefic banaŋmu, nemuja farawec irec âkehoc jâmâzâc saranaŋmu.”
Eme Wofuŋzi guguriŋfâc‐jeŋic tâpiri jareocmu, â râsifâc‐jeŋic suruc‐jopame fisi‐jareniŋmu.
Siria ŋic ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec â Filisa ŋic huhunaopec, jaŋe Israe ŋic mauc fufusuc ki nâc ejareŋgopieŋ. Eme sifu kimbeŋ‐ticnezi mi qaʒue wahakac, â menezi mi betaŋkehuc qiŋ herâ domakac jaha!
Eme ŋicguru jopa bâtiŋ ejarewec jaŋe erao mi risiembiŋ, â Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e wira basac mi ecnembiŋ.
Irec Wofuŋzi Israe qizecne â gecne mâmâc hetâcnewec, fuŋne â botâŋne i ʒoaŋ mocjahao iŋuc hâcne ecnewec.
Ŋic raŋɋaŋne â ʒâŋe biŋehec jaŋe qizecne eŋgopieŋ, â porofete burecdâŋ mumufua jaŋe ine gecne.
Ŋicguru ʒi micne bajareŋgopieŋ jaŋe jojowac ŋic bâbâsifucne â bâjâpec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe sisipiricte biŋe eŋgopieŋ.
Irec Wofuŋzi ŋicmotecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere mi aŋackekac, â hozec bekâfâc‐jeŋic busâqoc mi mana‐jarekac. Jaŋe ʒeŋgoma sindaŋne â sâqocne bapa hâcne, â micjeŋiczi mutucdâŋ sasawa mueŋgopieŋ. Eme sifu kimbeŋ‐ticnezi mi qaʒue wahakac, â menezi mi betaŋkehuc qiŋ herâ domakac jaha!
Sindaŋ hârindaŋzi ʒoc iŋucne bâruŋkekac, i ʒoczi sopâc â saparac ʒâtâcneekac erâ wâc kâte uupicko qâhâsârâ ʒaekac iŋucne, eme hosâcnezi ririsiehuc hâŋ feekac.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋte kimbeŋ izi hâcne ʒocbâruŋ erâ mâreŋ ʒâtâcnekac, eme ŋicguru jaŋe ʒocte nânâ eŋgopieŋ, â qoqomâzi aakic mi eŋgopieŋ.
Fâreopec ki nâc ejarerâ mi sâcjopakac, qanaopec ɋâcjoparâ mi gapec‐jopakac; qoqomâzi nânâc eŋgopieŋ.
Manasezi Eferaim nakac â Eferaimzi Manase nakac, erâ turerâ Juda râsi ecnekopirec. Eme sifu kimbeŋ‐ticnezi mi qaʒue wahakac; â menezi mi betaŋkehuc qiŋ herâ domakac jaha!
Jei, sâcmutâc dâŋ hehesicne ââkendâŋ ŋic ŋoŋe! Jei, ro waha âte eejare dâŋ qâreŋkehuc ŋeŋe ŋoŋe!
Ŋic qarâ suriŋne jaŋere dâŋzi mumutiŋ ŋic mai‐jeŋicko fârimâc eocte guriŋne baeŋgopieŋ, â ŋicfâc‐nane hapetac mumutiŋ sakare‐jareeŋgopieŋ. Hozec wiac biŋe‐jeŋic bâkiri bajareeŋgopieŋ, â bekâ mâsiŋ jaŋere wiac kâŋgâc jowac roeŋgopieŋ.
Okac dameŋ maic‐ŋopame wenac eniŋmu? Â mâŋâŋ sâqocne taickonec fisime wena raniŋmu? Morao wiserâ rapie bafic‐ŋopaocmu? Mafa mâriri‐ŋeŋic wena soŋkepie foocmu?
Kâpâcwâru ŋic jaŋere guruo babarâ juju, me qâhâmoc‐jopakicne ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko fofo, wiac i sawa fua‐ŋareocmu. Eme sifu kimbeŋ‐ticnezi mi qaʒue wahakac, â menezi mi betaŋkehuc qiŋ herâ domakac jaha.
Jei, Asiria e kimbeŋ‐nanere ɋaruc â aaric‐nanere kâcbiŋ ekac.
No ŋicguru sindaŋne jopaocte sorekopac, kimbeŋ‐nane hurembiŋ jaŋerao giedâŋ mucnekopac; e mafa‐jeŋic jowac rohuc huhure‐jeŋic rauckezejec, ro waha âte ejarekume hatao goteŋ iŋucne enʒepieŋ.
Eki ine iŋuc mi maŋkekac â maŋnezi iŋuc mi manasukac; e sisipiric gie baocte aŋackekac, â ŋicguru omaec‐jopaocte mukac i afecne mâcne.
E ʒiŋuc hâcne manasukac: “Micnefâc‐nane jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ sasawa i!
Kalono hae e Kakemisi hae ere sâc mi ewec me? Hamati hae e Arapada hae ere sâc mi ewec me? Samaria e Damasko ere sâc mi ewec me?
Menanezi ŋicguru jopapo jaŋere nemuɋâŋzi Jerusalemnec â Samarianec jaŋere siric‐joparâ kâcɋene domambiŋ, eme no sifu mi bâipiec‐jopapo.
Irec no Samaria â ɋâŋ qâqâtâcfâcne wiac ejarepo, sâc ijaha Jerusalem â nemuɋâŋfâcne mi ejarepemu me?”
Eme ʒiŋuc fuaocmu: Wofuŋzi Zioŋ tikio â Jerusalemko gie‐ticne batara‐fârerâ Asiria ŋicwofuŋ maŋfefe‐ticnere â pepec ʒâŋe fifi‐ticnere okacne râcneocmu.
E ʒiŋuc hâcne mukac: “No menanere tâpirizi gie i bapo â mamana fonarekacte maŋɋârâŋ‐nanezi epo; no ŋicguru mâreŋ‐jeŋicte ma bârâriepo â moneŋ mafa rowaŋ‐jeŋic omaepo, erâ eri ŋeŋeo ŋembiŋ jaŋe herândiŋ‐jopapo, i bulimakao ŋicnezi mâsi eekac irec sâc.
Ŋicguru jaŋere mafa mâriri rowaŋ i menanezi wawaŋ sesuc iŋucne bâfuawec; â ŋiczi wawaŋ hândâŋ ro amec eeŋgopieŋ, iŋuc mâreŋ sâc wiac ro nusec epo. Eme moczi moc fakecnezi qiriŋ mi qawec, me micne aŋkerâ dâŋ wâc mi dâŋewec.”
Hâc, ŋic nâŋâc râriczi jâc wiac qaeŋgopeneŋ, râric izi sâcne pepecne enâreocmu? Me sege baeŋgopeneŋ izi penaroŋ dâŋ muocmu? Hutizi wemocko ŋic rorâ fotarieocmu? Me ɋaruczi wiac jujune rorâ bâfeŋneocmu?
Irec Wofuŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, e Asiria momori biuc sâkohec jaŋe hucsanaŋ sore‐jareocmu, â eri qaraweŋ‐jeŋic turuŋkeme bâruŋkerâ ʒoc iŋucne ʒaocmu.
Israe ere tatamac izi hâcne ʒoc eocmu, Tiriŋic‐ticne eki ʒocbâruŋ eocmu; erâ fâpâ uupic â sopâc‐jeŋic i ʒoaŋ mocjahao ʒarâ ʒâseŋkeocmu.
Eme jâckâte â jufu‐jeŋicte eri biaŋ i Wofuŋzi bâsiroweme fuŋgâtânehec omaeocmu, hucŋic moczi fofeku mâc omaeekac irec sâc.
Ekume jâckâte‐jeŋicte tiwâne jahec mac domaocmu, ʒarene motec piticne moczi wose qâreŋ eene.
Dameŋ ira Israe ŋic tiwâne â Jakobore kikefuŋ nâfocne jaŋe imac‐jopawec erao mocwâc mi roweckeniŋmu; mâcne, jaŋe Wofuŋ, Israere Tiri rune erao jâmbomacko roweckeniŋmu.
Tiwânezi risieniŋmu, Jakobore tiwânezi momori Anutu erao risieniŋmu.
Israe ŋicguruge hâwecte moŋgeŋ iŋucne sawe‐bipieniŋmuo sifu tiwâne sawa risieniŋmu. Ima bâroŋ mupaŋkekicne izi bâbâtiŋhec opâ rumi iŋucne fisiocmu.
Wofuŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, eki mâreŋ sasawa ira ima bâroŋ fuaocte mupaŋkewec irec sâcko bâfuaocmu.
Irec Wofuŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, e ʒiŋuc mukac: “O ŋicfâc‐nane, Zioŋko juŋgopieŋ, mârâc Aigita jaŋe ɋaruczi ŋopahuc kâcbiŋ fotarie‐ŋarembiŋ irec sâc Asiria ŋic jaŋe eŋarehapie mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec.
Dameŋ bembeŋne mac tarame kimbeŋ‐nane omaeocmu, eme aaric‐nanezi jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopaocte fahareocmu.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi ʒika fotarie‐jareocmu, Midiaŋ ŋic Orebe qânâo jopawec iŋuc; erâ gunu‐ticne hâwecko sicneocmu i Aigita ŋic ejarewec iŋuc eocmu.
Eme dameŋ ira Asiriare mafa ɋawegaonec ŋetara wahaocmu â tagi‐ticne upefuŋgaonec rârieocmu.”
Râsi jaŋe Rimoŋ haeonec faharerâ Ajata haeo fisiŋgopieŋ, Migiroŋ hae jâururâ mafa‐jeŋic Mikimasi haeo guruckeŋgopieŋ.
Qaqahasicnao fotâcnerâ Geba haeo ŋafeme fombiŋ. Rama hae rune ɋarac ɋarac qaŋgopieŋ, Saulore Gibea irec rune wiseŋgopieŋ.
Galim haeru owa ruruckeniŋ! Laisa ŋic ŋoŋe hazec râeniŋ! Anatoti rune ŋoŋe micjeŋicko roniŋ!
Madamena jaŋe tâtieŋgopieŋ, Gebim rune wise tâmireŋgopieŋ.
Miŋec ʒoaŋ Noboo fisirâ hae i sakareniŋmu; biac Zioŋ ŋecjucfâcne jaŋere tiki, Jerusalem tiki hâcne, i mejeŋic wickehuc ackeniŋmu.
Manakic, Wofuŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, e ɋicwânʒâŋhec ehuc jâc botâŋne fackeocmu, â ʒorarâ fekicne qafarac‐jopaocmu, ehuc fefec sisiric ekicne jaŋe bâuruŋ‐jopaocmu.
Kâte mimiŋ uupicnehec râriczi kiocmu, â Lebanoŋ jâmâzâc hawari biaŋ i faraocmu.
Isai jâctuczi gitec heocmu, fuŋgâtâ‐ticnaonec gitecne moczi wefurâ fârine bâfuaocmu.
Wofuŋte Mârozi ere faio fohuc juocmu, maŋɋârâŋ mâro â maŋfânâŋ mâro, mumutâc mâro â tâpiri mâro, mamana mâro â Wofuŋ araŋ bapa mâro.
E Wofuŋ araŋ babacnere aŋac bajuocmu. E ʒâŋezi sawa honehuc dâŋ mi mutaraocmu, me hazeczi sawa manahuc sâcne mi musanaŋkeocmu;
e hapetac jaŋe tiŋne jujure sâcko dâŋ mutara‐jareocmu, â mâreŋko maŋhuhuŋ juŋgopieŋ dâŋjeŋic sâckoa dopeckeocmu, e micticnere gunuzi mâreŋ qaocmu, â micbipic‐ticnere rombâŋzi sindaŋŋic qâhâmoocmu.
Tiŋne jujuzi ombâŋ ŋaqi‐ticne eocmu, â erâ‐eesanaŋzi becsahac‐ticne eocmu.
Eme kâte qâto e lama motecnehec jojowac junicmu, â qowi mimicne lepad, e noniŋ motecnehec fofo wirec fonicmu. Bulimakao motecne â kâcɋene wokemaŋhec jahe laioŋhec ââgo eniŋmu, ehame motec ɋienezi hone soŋaŋ ejareocmu.
Bulimakao â qowi mimicne bea jaŋe qâqâtec juhuc nânâ nâniŋmu; â motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mâmâc ŋec foc eniŋmu; laioŋzi ine bulimakao iŋucne kecɋaŋ nâocmu.
Motec susuoneczi qotâ e jâchawecko foha masirickeocmu, â motec gegecnezi sopâc homa usuraŋkeocmu.
Tiri tiki mâreŋ‐nane ŋifec â ŋifec, ira bâbâʒâic â sisipiric moc mi fuaocmu; Wofuŋte fuŋne mamanazi mâreŋ fusucmaocmu, hâweczi ʒâkâŋ‐ticne bârârâŋne‐fâreekac irec sâc.
Dameŋ ira Isai gitecnezi qâpuc ŋicguru ma doma‐jareocmu, ma i bâfuaniŋte ŋicne ŋicne babasa gie baniŋmu, â fic hae‐ticne eri tatamacnehec ŋeocmu.
Dameŋ ira Wofuŋzi meticne harierâ sicneme arec 2 eocmu, ehuc ŋicfâc‐ticne tiwâne juraŋgopieŋ bârisiec‐jopaocmu; Asiriaonec, Aigitaonec, Patarosionec, Etiopianec, Elamkonec, Sinaonec, Hamationec â Hâwec mâreŋkonec nusec‐jopaocmu.
E qâpuc ŋicguru ma âkendâŋne‐jareocmu â Israe guruonec tuŋjopakicne qâzuc‐jopaocmu; ehuc mâreŋ qaŋeŋne 4 irecnec Judaŋic bâtâtiec‐jopakicne jaŋe qânusuc‐jopaocmu.
Eme Eferaimzi Juda iiŋguuŋ ecneekac i omaeocmu, â Juda qaisockeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe siroweniŋmu. Eferaimzi Juda iiŋguuŋ mi ecneocmu â Judazi Eferaim mi qaisockeocmu.
Jahe hâweckopec Filisa ŋic tiki‐jeŋicko ʒocnehec fenicmu, erâ ʒoaŋ wewefuopec ŋic fisi‐jarerâ mafa‐jeŋic jowac ronicmu. Erâ Edom â Moabi ŋicguru rauc‐jopanicmu, ehame Amoŋŋic jaŋe micjekic reŋkeniŋmu.
Eme Wofuŋzi Aigita mâreŋte hâwec raʒikicne i mume omae‐fâreocmu, erâ meticne Eufrata opâopec sicnehuc micrombâŋ fâronezi ficneme tâtiehuc opâ piticne 7 fuame ŋiczi fotâcnepie kike‐jeŋic mi bânâŋkeocmu.
Eme ŋicfâc‐ticne tiwâne juniŋmu jaŋere biŋe Asirianec hata sâko fua‐jareocmu, Israe ŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec warezo ehapie hata fua‐jarewec irec sâc.
Dameŋ ira kecʒiŋuc muzokic: “O Wofuŋ no daŋge gazape; go kimbeŋ qanaremeŋ, eme kimbeŋgezi râriehame bâmiriŋnumeŋ.
“Jâmbomac, Anutu e bâbâpiaŋ‐nane; mamanasiŋ fonarekacte mi hâwicnukac. Wofuŋ Anutu e tâpiri‐nane â mumuteŋ gae‐nane, eki sisipirickonec bataracnuwec.”
Ŋoŋe bâbâpiaŋte opâ ʒâŋeonec ʒeri ehuc fia nâc eniŋmu.
Erâ dameŋ ira kecʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Anutu daŋge âzâcneniŋ, ʒâŋe‐ticne wâsickeniŋ. Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋerao eebapa‐ticne muromackeniŋ, ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne faharekac i mufua‐jareniŋ.
“Wofuŋ e gie basarickewecte mucne bacneniŋ, erâ mâreŋne mâreŋne muromackeniŋ.
Zioŋ ŋecjucfâcne ʒeri bari eniŋ, Israe ere Tiri rune ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko fekicne jukac.”
Jesaja, Amozire ŋokâzi Babe haere bararuŋ dâŋ hone manac ewec ʒine hâcne:
Tiki burocnao qeŋ qajareniŋ, owa ruruckerâ wira‐jareniŋ; meoric qajarepie ŋicbomboŋ jaŋere motâc sâkoo raʒiniŋ.
Bâwosâec‐jopakicnefâc‐nane jaŋe no nahac giedâŋ mujarepo, qac momorifâc‐nane kiwac qawac boc eeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe kimbeŋ‐nanere fârine bâfuaniŋte biac hefârec‐jopapo.
Mananiŋ! Tiki botâŋko ojowa sâko fuakac, ŋic guru dindiŋ jaŋere micʒonʒoŋ iŋucne. Mananiŋ! Ŋicwofuŋ â gurufâc‐jeŋic erâ ŋic gurune gurune tumaŋnepie fânâŋ sâko fuakac. Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e momori guru hone manac ejarekac.
Jaŋe mâreŋ ʒorickonec ware fisiŋgopieŋ, mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaonec hâcne. Wofuŋ â kimbeŋ‐ticnere babaficfâc jaŋe mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ bâsiroweniŋte fisiŋgopieŋ!
Kio owa eniŋ! Wofuŋte dameŋ bembeŋkekac i; sisipiric tinac tâpiri runeraonec wareocmu hâcne.
Irec ŋic mejeŋic furu jaha betaŋke‐fâreocmu, â ŋic sasawa maŋjeŋic omae‐fâreocmu.
Jaŋe bipic tatara ejareha me kike‐jeŋic râŋgeŋkeocmu â ʒâic fua‐jareocmu; ŋokac gozi kicjopame risimbiŋne qaeŋgopieŋ irec sâc eniŋmu, jaŋe sasawa ʒâŋezi hohone eniŋmu, ehuc ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic i ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne eocmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ dameŋ‐ticne i qeŋ bipinehec, aaric â kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋhec fisiocmu, ine mâreŋ ima bahuc, fainao sâqocne bapa juŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopaocmu hâcne.
Sambâŋko bâpiŋ ŋeraŋgopieŋ raru â demeŋ ɋafâc hawari fuŋne fuŋne jaŋe tatamac‐jeŋic sakareniŋmu; ʒoaŋ e wefu wefuhuc jaha gâpâreocmu â mosa e tatamac‐ticne sakareocmu wâc.
Eme no mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ sindaŋ‐ticnere okacne râcnehuc ŋic hehesicne jaŋe kiŋ bahac‐jeŋicte jopa bâtiŋ ejarepemu; ŋic ʒaubacne pepec penaroŋ‐jeŋic qape omaeocmu, â ŋic bâbâʒâic jaŋere sahac fefe i bawahapemu.
Noni mupe ŋiczi afecne sawa erâ gol ematauckekicne fokac irec sâc mi juniŋmu, â mâreŋŋiczi Ofiri mâreŋko gol forakac irec sâc wâc mi bâfuaniŋmu.
No irec hâcne sambâŋ itiriŋkepemu, â mâreŋ e qiriŋ qahuc ŋeŋe‐ticnaonec ŋerârieocmu, i Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere aaric â kimbeŋ‐ticnere dameŋko fuaocmu.
Noniŋ hetâtiec‐jopakicne â lama guru ŋic moczi ro qâzuc mi ejareekac, irec sâcko juhuc moc e jahacne guruo ʒuhuckeocmu, â moc e jahacne hae mâreŋko wiserâ raocmu.
Ehame bâfuac‐jopaniŋmu sâc âke hâmoc‐jopaniŋmu â rocjopaniŋmu sâc ʒikare nânâ eniŋmu.
Â ɋiefâc‐jeŋic ine ʒâŋe fai‐jeŋicko henʒaŋ qanʒaŋ‐jopaniŋmu; ficjeŋickonec mafa wiac fiuc rorâ bawiseniŋmu â ŋokacfâc‐jeŋic bâsâqorec‐jopaniŋmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no Medeŋic qafeŋ‐jopape râsi ejarenʒepieŋ; jaŋe siliware manapie fârimâc eekac â gol irec aŋac wâc mi bajueŋgopieŋ.
Tepe‐jeŋiczi ŋicmotec muruc‐jopaniŋmu, ɋâric jaŋe neŋgoc bumaŋkoa fohapie mi akic‐jopaniŋmu, â ʒâŋe‐jeŋiczi naru motec honec‐joparâ busâqoc mi mana‐jareniŋmu.
Eme ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere femicne, Kaldea ŋic jaŋere eri tatamac, Babe hae hâcne, e Anutuzi Sodom â Gomora bâsirowec‐jofawec irec sâc jaha fuacneocmu.
Mimiŋzi ɋâric tuhutac fohuc juocmu sanaŋ; Araba ŋic moczi qoruc boze‐ticne ira moc mi fâreocmu, â lama soŋaŋ jaŋe lamafâc‐jeŋic mâreŋ ira moc mi ejarepie waha fomananiŋmu.
Aricne, kâte qowi mimicne jaŋe ira waha fomananiŋmu, â ficjeŋic i bioc bioc wipezi fusucmaniŋmu; hae mâreŋ ira qera jaŋe juhapie kâpâ jaŋe gae woniŋmu.
Ŋicwofuŋ ficko kâte qâtozi qâŋkehuc juniŋmu, â eri aŋac ficko qowi mimicne jaŋe juniŋmu; wiac iŋuc fuaocte dameŋne bembeŋkezo ekac â ʒoaŋ gie bapa‐ticne boc mi ʒoraha fisiocmu.
Eme Wofuŋ e Jakobore busâqoc manahuc Israe ŋic harierâ bâwosâec‐joparâ mame sâko hae‐jeŋicko râec‐jopame juniŋmu. Ehame jaba jaŋe qâtec‐joparâ Jakobore kikefuŋko ʒuhuckeniŋmu.
Eme Israe kikefuŋzi ŋic gurune gurune rocjoparâ hae mâreŋ‐jeŋicko bacjopa raniŋmu; ehuc rauc‐jopapie Wofuŋte mâreŋko kiŋaŋ ŋic ŋokacfâc‐jeŋic erâ juniŋmu. Israe ŋic jaŋe iŋuc ehuc mârâc kâpâcwâru bacjopambiŋ qâpuc i jaŋe hâcne kâpâcwâruo râec‐jopaniŋmu â guguriŋfâc‐jeŋic jumbiŋ jaŋe ŋicbomboŋ ejareniŋmu.
Eme Wofuŋ e ʒârâ hâriŋ â ʒâic serereŋ â kiŋaŋ qaqa gie ŋemâcne faigao fowec i gowac rome maŋge âke urueocmu dameŋ ira
Babe ŋicwofuŋ âke sisic gae kecʒiŋuc muhuc hecnezemec: “Opoŋ, fenârewec e hombaŋ ŋekac i, â nâŋerao bâbâʒâic fuawec i tarakac!
Wofuŋ e ŋic hehesicne jaŋere ɋaruc bazuwec, ŋicbomboŋ jaŋere gunu hâcne.
Ŋicbomboŋ e hâcne aaricko ŋic gurune gurune ʒuhuckeme ʒuhuc jopa rahuc juwec, â kimbeŋko ŋicne ŋicne qâhuc‐jopahuc aakic tâmiric jopa jâpec ejarewec.
Ʒi ine mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ e niniŋ qiririŋ â nacgumo roroc fuarâ foha ŋiczi ʒeri fânâŋ sâko eŋgopieŋ.
Eme wetejâc â Lebanoŋte jâmâzâc jaŋe wâc gore bubiaŋ manahuc ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: ‘Go waha fohaŋte moczi moc qafarac‐nâpoocte mocwâc mi wefuekac.’
Juwic hâmoc haeo biŋege fisime qiriŋ fuakac, mâreŋte guriŋ bapa juku hâmo‐fârembiŋ jaŋe hâcne qiriŋ qaŋgopieŋ, erâ wâc ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere ŋicwofuŋfâc jumbiŋ, jaŋe eri ŋeŋe‐jeŋickonec fahare‐fârezo eŋgopieŋ.
Eme jaŋe micne mic sâc fuŋkerâ ʒiŋuc gazaniŋmu: ‘Nâŋe betaŋkembeŋ iŋuc jaha betaŋkemeŋ! Go nâŋere sâc jaha emeŋ i!’
Sahac fefege i hârâcko tuŋkekicne, â kulelegere fânâŋ i iŋuc jaha; wiac âsu gârecnezi fofoge eha umbeŋzi bilaŋke egarekac.
“Ojai, bâpiŋ sâko tatamacnehec furic qânikiŋte oŋararac biaŋ go weniŋuc ehuc sambâŋkonec tararâ mâreŋko wahameŋ! Ŋic gurune gurune qâhuc‐jopameŋzi weniŋuc erâ qanʒaŋgupie mâreŋko fokomec.
Go maŋgao dâŋ ʒiŋuc manasu biric emeŋ: ‘No sambâŋko fepemu, ehuc Anuture bâpiŋ faicnao eri ŋeŋe‐nane bâfeŋnerâ hepe ŋeocmu; nemu jaŋere tutumaŋ tiki faic mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao ŋekac ira hâcne waha ŋepemu.
No karorac jâuru‐fârerâ fezepac, ehuc Femicne sâko ere sâc bâfuazepac.’
Ʒi ine hâmoc haeo tuŋgukicne, nombâŋ fâhâŋnao hâcne.
Eme mârâc honecgumbiŋzi hone dendeŋguhuc ʒiŋuc manasuhuc muniŋmu: ‘Mume mâreŋ qiriŋ qawec erâ ŋicwofuŋ â gurufâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ɋarac ɋarac qambiŋ ŋic keci hâcne me?
Eki hâcne mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ ima bawec â hae sâko ŋerawec i heroc qâropiewec, â kâpâcwâru ŋicfâc‐ticne hae mâreŋ‐jeŋicko risieniŋte moc mi mana‐jarewec.’
Ŋic gurune gurune ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic sasawa jaŋe ʒâŋe biŋe‐jeŋic mi omaeha ʒâŋeruŋ‐jeŋic sâc foraŋgopieŋ.
Go ine ʒâŋeruŋgao mâcne, jâcgitecne batara behec ekicne irec sâc jaha taicko behecgukicne; ehame qâhâmoc‐jopakicne â sâqezi âkec‐jopakicne jaŋe qofacguŋgopieŋ, wiac âsu gârecne âte gâreckekicne qânâ nombâŋko behepie huekac irec sâc.
Go hae mâreŋge sipirickemeŋte â gurufâcge qâhâmoc‐jopameŋte ŋicwofuŋ âgofâcge jaŋehec ʒâŋeruŋko mâmâc fofo i mi ecmu. “Sâqocne bapa ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe mocwâc mi mujâmbâŋkezo.
Mamac‐jeŋic ere hehesicte erâ ŋokâfâcne qâhâmoc‐jopazore wiac emoc bâmoc eniŋ, jaŋe mocwâc faharerâ mâreŋ rauckenʒipiŋte â fic hae epie mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ sâcke‐fârezacte.”
“No faharerâ râsi ejarezepac,” Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere dâŋ iŋuc. “No Babe haere ʒâŋe â ŋic ʒanʒaŋne mecne erâ naru motec apa ŋosa mecne jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopazepac,” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
“Noni hae i hetikiepe homa jaŋere fic hae ezejec, ehame sohoŋ fuarâ fozejec, erâ no sisipiricte oofaŋzi ofaŋne behec ecnepe omaezejec,” Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere dâŋ iŋuc.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mujomirehuc mupaŋkewec: “Jâmbomac, no dâŋ mana biric epo i deŋkezejec, erâ mupaŋkepo sâc i fârine fua‐fârezejec!
No Asiria ŋic mâreŋ‐naneo jukac e henʒaŋnezepac â tiki‐naneo âtenʒaŋnezepac; eme ŋic qâhuc‐jopahuc tagi fai‐jeŋicko râewec i bârâriezo â ɋawe‐jeŋicko reŋ râewec i wâc qatarazo.”
Mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec mumupaŋ mukicne ine hâcne â Wofuŋzi ŋic gurune gurune jaŋerao tâpiri‐ticne bataniŋkeekac ine hâcne.
Oc, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e dâŋ iŋuc mupaŋkewecte mozi moc qame wahaocmu? Erâ meticne bâfeŋnekicne i mozi mume wahaocmu?
Ŋicwofuŋ Ahaʒi hâmowec jara dameŋ ira bararuŋ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Filisa mâreŋ sâko, go ɋaruczi qa bâʒâic egarewec ɋaruc i herickewecte ʒeri mi ezemec, ʒiŋucte: Homare bumaŋkonec qotâ moc fuaocmu â ere ɋâriczi sopâc homa sopinehec fuaocmu.
Dameŋ ira qarâ suriŋne jaŋe tiki‐naneo nânâ nâhuc juniŋmu, â hapetac jaŋe wama faio juhâmoniŋmu; ɋâricfâcge jaŋe ine mupe nânâre hâmo sipiric eniŋmu â ʒanʒaŋnefâcge jaŋe qâhâmoc‐jopapemu.
Motâc sâko, go kio wâuŋa ec; hae sâko go owa ruruckec, Filisa mâreŋ sâko, go ɋarac ɋarac qac! Faic mâreŋkonec hosâc ware fisikac hâcne, â momori jaŋeraonec moczi betaŋkerâ gurufâc‐ticne moc mi behec‐jopaocmu.”
Qâpuc jaŋeraonec kiŋaŋ ware fisimbiŋ jaŋe dâŋ weniŋuc bâtikie‐jarezo? “Wofuŋ e Zioŋ haere wâtuŋ râeme huwec, eme maŋnao gurufâc‐ticne tac qararacne jaŋe soŋkerâ juniŋmu.”
Ojai, Arimoabi hae i ŋafe mocjahao ima samaki bapie omaewec i! Ojai, Kirimoabi hae i ŋafe mocjahao ima samaki bapie omaewec!
Diboŋ hae rune jaŋe kio wâwâsic eniŋte bâzi ririkere tikio feŋgopieŋ; Moabi rune jaŋe Nebo tikio â Medeba ira kio wâuŋa eŋgopieŋ. Qizec‐jeŋic ropie utu pârâc sasawa fuawec, â mecʒâwâ‐jeŋic i hefârekicne jaha.
Mateŋ qonaŋkerâ hae hata‐jeŋicko jueŋgopieŋ; ficbupu‐jeŋicko mecne, furi bapa tomao mecne busâqoc fuame ʒeŋgoma kisâko kioŋgopieŋ.
Hesiboŋ â Eleale haeo kio owa epie fânâŋne rakume Jahazi haeo manaŋgopieŋ; irec Moabi momorifâcne jaŋe jâjâwâckepie maŋjeŋic gâckekac.
Maŋnanezi Moabire erâ kio owa ekac, fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe wise raku Zoari, Egela hae namba 3 ira fisiŋgopieŋ. Ojai, Luhiti tiki hata i kiohuc feŋgopieŋ; ojai, Horonaim hata rahuc ima qaqa fuawec irec kio owa eŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Ojai, Nimirim haere opâzi ʒicke kereŋ eme mâreŋ burocne fuakac; eme sopâczi hâmo ɋaŋac ekac â monʒaŋ wiac ururuckekac erâ kecɋaŋ geune i omaekac.
Irec nânâ mafa â huhure wiac fojarewec i ame susuckerâ Kakikic opâ fotâcnembiŋ.
Ojai, kio owazi Moabi mâreŋ râreckehuc fokac, â ki uu‐jeŋicte fânâŋzi raku Egelaim â Bere‐Elim hae ira fisikac.
Jei, Dimoŋte opâ i soczi fusucmakac, eme no sifu mupe Dimoŋ wiac moc ʒuhuckerâ fuacneocmu i kecʒiŋuc: Moabi wisekicnefâc‐ticne â mâreŋ irec ŋic uucne jaŋe laioŋ moc fua‐jareocmu hâcne.
Mâreŋ ŋicwofuŋte lama amec‐jopa ranʒepieŋ, ehuc Sela hae mâreŋkonec tuhu mâreŋ fotâcne raku Zioŋte otâ ere tikio fisinʒepieŋ.
Moabi otâfâcne jaŋe wipezi fururuc qahuc kosa rac warec eeŋgopieŋ, me sareŋkonec jâpec‐jopakicne irec sâcko Aronoŋ opâ fotâcneeŋgopieŋko siŋsaŋ qarâ juniŋmu.
“Go dâŋ mu biric enârehuc mumutiŋ gie bac; mumucge mutecne ʒoaŋ ɋaɋacko ŋafe iŋucne ezejec; eha jopa jâpec ejarekicne jaŋe soŋjopazemec, â wisehuc juŋgopieŋ jaŋe mi mac mufuac‐jopazemec.
Moabi mâreŋkonec wisekicne jaŋe ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jaba juniŋte mana‐jarenʒepieŋ, â ima qaqa ere erâ huec sanaŋ ejarenʒepieŋ. Eme guguriŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe omaepie ima bapa tarame ŋicbomboŋ ejarehuc jumbiŋzi mâreŋ beherâ ratâmireniŋmu.
Eme maŋjauŋte ŋesiŋko eri ŋeŋe moc fuarâ Dawidire qoruc bozeo ŋeha fainao mumutara ŋic ŋeocmu e siocmâc juhuc mumutiŋte henʒiriŋnehuc tiŋne juju fuarâ foocte ʒoɋac bâfuaocmu.”
Nâŋe Moabi sahac fefe‐ticne hâhâwicne jâmbâŋ irec biŋe manambeŋ, maŋfefe, sâke bâbâc, pepec penaroŋ â jawadâŋ‐ticne irec biŋe hâcne.
Irec Moabi jaŋe jaŋaczia kio owa eec eniŋ, jaŋe ʒeŋgoma kio owa eniŋ. Ehuc Kiri‐Heresi haeonec nânâ poroŋ waiŋ hândâŋnehec irec mu heŋɋâŋ ehuc busâqoc mananiŋ!
Eme Hesiboŋte jufu gie, Sibema irec waiŋ gie i hâmo ɋaŋac ewec; tieŋ taeŋne haŋ barâ raku Jazereo mecne, mâreŋ burocnao mecne fisiwec, â qaŋeŋne qaratierâ hâwec fotâcnewec i ŋicne ŋicne fekicnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe âte tâcnembiŋ.
No irec hâcne Jazere ŋic jaŋehec Sibema waiŋ fuŋqizecnere ki mamakuc ekopac, â Hesiboŋ â Eleale hae ŋohe ʒâŋeuc‐nanezi rua‐ŋactekopac, i fâri fufua â qa roro dameŋko râsi jaŋere saoreŋ fuawec irec.
Eme jufu gieo ʒeri â bubiaŋ i omaewec, â waiŋ gieo ʒeri gae â semuja mocwâc mi heeŋgopieŋ; waiŋ bapa ŋic jaŋe waiŋ hândâŋne oto sâkoo mocwâc mi âte pisickeeŋgopieŋ, â qa roro ŋic jaŋere ʒeri fânâŋ i bâniniŋkekicne.
Irec maŋnanezi Moabire erâ mimi ŋokac iŋucne ki mamakuc ekac; â bunane Kiri‐Heresi ere erâ sâqorekac.
Eme Moabi jaŋe tikio ferâ taha bapa gie samarierâ baniŋmuo me nemu ufuŋko raʒirâ nunumu gie baniŋmuo ine sifu bâipieniŋmu.
Wofuŋzi mârâc jaha Moabire dâŋ muwec ine hâcne.
Miŋecgac ine Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Jara jahec â moc, gie motec jaŋere jara dameŋ iŋucne, i tarame Moabire tâpiri â ŋicfâc‐ticne guru sâko jaŋere ʒare waha‐jâmbâŋkeme ŋic ʒanʒaŋne â betaŋkekicne sawa juniŋmu!”
Manaŋgopieŋ, Damasko i hae fâri mocwâc mi ŋeŋe ʒaŋkerâ sesuctac fuarâ foocmu.
Hae piticfâc‐ticne gâcne ŋerakac i wâc sesuctac jaha fosanaŋkehuc qowi hae eocmu, ehame jaŋe ira juhapie moczi moc mi jâpec‐jopaocmu.
Eferaim huec sanaŋ‐jeŋic i omae‐jareocmu â Damasko rune ŋicwofuŋ juju‐jeŋic iŋuc jaha; eme Israe ŋic jaŋere tâpiri wahawec irec sâc jaha Aram ŋic ʒanʒaŋne jaŋere wahaocmu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme dameŋ ira Jakobore ʒâŋe biŋe qaʒueocmu, â sahac opâ‐ticne kereŋkeme siec sawa eocmu.
Qa roro ŋic e padi kikene meticnezi bâturerâ fârine hetâcneekac irec sâc fuaocmu; me ŋic moczi Refaim wâcko padi kikene ro nusec eocmu irec sâc jaha fuaocmu.
Fârine bâtirikicne ʒâhec ro nusec ee ine afecne mac; oliwa jâc itiriŋkepie fârine gâcne sâko waha‐fâreme jâc botâŋnao hândâŋne 2 me 3 â tieŋnao 4 me 5 irec sâc sawa mac ŋeocmu; Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu ere dâŋ iŋuc.
Dameŋ ira mâreŋŋic jaŋe bâbâfua‐jeŋic ʒâŋitahuc Israere Tiri rune erao ʒâŋe finiŋmu.
Jaŋe alata wiac, jaŋe jaŋacne meɋâreŋ hâcne, i mocwâc honepie fârine mi eocmu, â mejeŋiczi metâ wiac bambiŋ, Asera irec ɋâŋ qâqâtâc â ʒoaŋ nemure wâtuŋ ira wâc ʒâŋe mi finiŋmu.
Dameŋ ira hae sanaŋ‐jeŋic sesuctac foraniŋmu i Hiwiŋic â Amori ŋic jaŋe hae‐jeŋic Israe ŋic jaŋere erâ behepie sesuctac forambiŋ irec sâc; mâreŋ niniŋ siarereŋ foocmu hâcne.
I ʒiŋucte: Go bâbâpiaŋge Anutu ere nikecguwec, ehuc qânâ sanaŋ â tâpirige irec wâc mi manasumeŋ; irec ʒariŋ gie biaŋne bazo murâ bac, â mâreŋ furunaonec ukicne rorâ râezo murâ râec.
Eme saracmu ʒoaŋ ijaha bâsokacmu mecne â ukicne râekic i furictea ecnetec âri qaocmu mecne erâ sifu ʒârâ hâriŋ â ʒâic busâqoc mi tatarane fuaocmu dameŋ ira fârine basacmu.
Jei, ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere kike quruŋ i hâweczi fânâŋkeekac irec sâc fuakac; â ŋicne ŋicne ojowa‐jeŋic i opâ rumizi fânâŋkeekac irec sâc.
Ŋicne ŋicne ojowa‐jeŋic i opâ sâko bocjaha fânâŋkeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc fuakac; Wofuŋzi ine dâŋ mujareme taicko wiseniŋmu, mâŋâŋzi tikio jawa wiac bawiseekac irec sâc, â ʒâʒâkiriŋ mâŋâŋzi rufe ficne sueme feekac iŋucne.
Opoŋ, owâ ririŋte wiac hâhâwicne fuakac, hae mi fure taniŋkeha biac omaeŋgopieŋ. Wiac‐nâŋec kâŋgâc nâwoc rohuc ʒika qaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe okacne iŋuc fua‐jareocmu, â fiuc serereŋ enâreeŋgopieŋ jaŋe katucne ijaha fua‐jareocmu.
Jei, Etiopiare opâ sâko ocniŋucnao mâreŋ fokac, i gisic jaŋere fakec fânâŋzi sâcke‐fâreekac.
Mâreŋ i hâcne kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne Nilu opâ hatao sorec‐jopame woke papacne irec faio opâ bâjâpehuc raeŋgopieŋ. Hata kiŋaŋ kike afec, ŋoŋe ŋic ʒoricne â sahac fâsâc jaŋerao raniŋ, ʒorickonec â bembeŋkoneczi hâhâwic bajareeŋgopieŋ, tâpiri wânʒâŋ â ima bapa‐jeŋichec â opâ sâkozi mâreŋ‐jeŋic qâfâuckekac ŋic i jaŋerao hâcne raniŋ.
Mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne sasawa â mâreŋne mâreŋne juraŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe tikio ma âkendâŋnepie domakac ira ʒâŋe fipie razejec, â qeŋ qapie hazec râenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc nazawec hâcne: “Ʒoaŋ ɋaɋacko sawazi gerec gerec baekac, me qa roro dameŋte fârorocko hoe sisicte karorac ŋeekac, no irec sâcko ŋeŋe‐naneo aimuŋ ŋehuc ʒâŋe fipemu.”
Eme qa roro dameŋ mi maickeha âri qaqa dameŋ tarame waiŋ hândâŋ qeuezo eha ine runezi tieŋne sâqezi hetâcneocmu â qaŋeŋne hetâcne behec eocmu.
Jaŋe ʒeŋgoma tikio tucwipe â mâreŋko jueŋgopieŋ qowi jaŋere nânâ eniŋmu; eme wipe jaŋe ʒoaŋ dameŋko â mâreŋ qowi sasawa jaŋe mâmâteŋ dameŋko ira ju fofo eniŋmu.
Dameŋ ira ine ŋic ʒoricne â sahac fâsâc, jaŋe Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ taha bafisicneniŋmu; ʒorickoneczi mecne bembeŋkoneczi mecne hâhâwic bajareeŋgopieŋ, tâpiri wânʒâŋ â ima bapa‐jeŋichec, opâ sâkozi mâreŋ‐jeŋic qâfâuckekac ŋicguru i jaŋe Zioŋ tikio, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere ʒâŋe fokacko iŋuc eniŋmu hâcne.
Honeniŋ, Wofuŋ e karorac gagasac‐ticnehec irec faio ŋehuc ra Aigita mâreŋko fisikac. Fisime Aigitare nemufâc jaŋe ere maio ɋarac ɋarac qaniŋmu; â Aigita ŋic jaŋe maŋjeŋic omaeocmu.
Eme no Aigita ŋic jaŋe suru jâiŋ ejarepe jaŋackoaŋ rârâsi eniŋmu, ehuc hahac ɋa â âgo bago â haene haene â ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe jaŋaczia qaqac eniŋmu hâcne.
Iŋuc ehuc Aigita ŋic hâbi‐jeŋic goroŋkeocmu â mumupaŋ‐jeŋic qape wahame nemu â qaŋgec bapa, bawe â faŋfaŋ mu wioc ejarenʒepieŋ.
Eme no Aigita ŋic jaŋe bomboŋ râŋgeŋ bârâŋgeŋne moc ere meo râec‐jopapemu; eme ŋicwofuŋ ʒâʒâicne moczi bomboŋ ejareocmu, Wofuŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Nilu opâ sâkozi fâre wahame ʒicke kereŋ eocmu;
eme opâ hatane hatane jaŋe âsu finiŋmu, â Aigita opâ sâko jaŋe ʒickerâ kereŋ seŋseŋkeniŋmu, ehame saparac â ʒamac ʒamac i hâmo qanʒaraŋ eocmu.
Nilu opâ micnao kânoŋ bapa wiac â wiac gâcne sarakicne sasawa i hâmo ʒaŋ eha mâŋâŋzi ficne sueme tâtie‐fâreocmu.
Eme qowi gie bapa ŋic jaŋe ki mamakuc eniŋmu, â hawic‐jeŋic opâo behe jumbieŋ jaŋe harac huacbuc eniŋmu.
Gec siŋiŋ baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe qurutuaniŋmu â he wiac fueŋgopieŋ jaŋe weaŋkeniŋmu.
Wiac irec gie bapa ŋic jaŋe busâqoc mananiŋmu â moneŋ gie baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe buheric ejareocmu.
Zoaŋ haere ŋic fekicne ŋoŋe ŋic mutuc matacne, â Farao dâŋte babaficfâc‐ticne ŋoŋe ŋicguru maŋ tâmiric. Ŋoŋe fuŋne weniŋucte Farao ʒiŋuc âzâcneeŋgopieŋ: “No mamana ŋic jaŋeraonec fuapo, no ŋicwofuŋ esecne jumbiŋ jaŋere ɋâric.”
Mamana ŋicfâcge jaŋe weni? Jaŋe Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi Aigita mâreŋte dâŋ mupaŋkewec i mufua‐garehuc gazaniŋ me!
Zoaŋ haere ŋic fekicne jaŋe ŋic mutucne embiŋ, â Memfisi haere ŋic fekicne jaŋe eatuc‐jopakicne; Aigita ŋic gurune gurune micnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ŋicfâc‐jeŋic ejarepie qâsoriembiŋ.
Wofuŋ e maŋsifuc bâfua‐jarewec; eme jaŋe ŋicfâc‐jeŋic bânie‐jarepie eebapa‐jeŋic sifuckeekac, ine ŋic moczi opâ momori nâku maŋne sifuckeme maŋuhuc biric boroc eekac irec sâc eeŋgopieŋ.
Eme Aigita mâreŋte ŋic ʒâŋe biŋehec me ʒâŋe biŋe tâmiric jaŋe gie moc ʒuhuckerâ bapa i mi eniŋmu.
Dameŋ ira Aigita ŋic jaŋe ŋokac iŋucne eniŋmu, eha Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi meticne fotariehuc jaŋeraopec bâfeŋneme bipic tara‐jareha hâwic‐jopaocmu.
Eme Aigita ŋic jaŋe Juda mâreŋte manapie hâhâwicne eocmu; ehame Juda mâreŋte manasu‐jarepie sâc hâwic‐jopaocmu, i Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi dâŋ mupaŋkewec fokac irec.
Dameŋ ira Aigita mâreŋko hae sâko 5 irec rune jaŋe Kanaaŋte dâŋmarac eniŋmu, ehuc Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere biŋe erâ juniŋte mujomireniŋmu; hae i jaŋeraonec moc irec ʒâŋe Ʒoaŋ Hae muniŋmu.
Dameŋ ira Aigita mâreŋ wâmbuŋnao Wofuŋte alata moc ŋeocmu â qaŋeŋnao Wofuŋte qânâ wâtuŋ moc domaocmu.
Izi hâcne Aigita mâreŋko Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere ma â mumutaniŋ eocmu; eme fific guguriŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere erâ Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnepie babafic moc sore‐jareocmu, eme eki juju gie bahuc batarac‐jopaocmu.
Eme Wofuŋ e fuŋne‐ticne Aigita ŋic bataniŋke‐jareme Aigita jaŋe dameŋ ira Wofuŋ hone taraniŋmu, erâ bâzi rikecnerâ taha bacnehuc kiŋaŋ qacneniŋmu â Wofuŋtao dâŋ mupaŋkerâ fârine bâfuaniŋmu wâc.
Eme Wofuŋ e Aigita ŋic jopaocmu, joparâ wâc bâmiriŋ‐jopaocmu; eme jaŋe Wofuŋtao risieniŋmu; eki ine mu huacbuc‐jeŋic manarâ bâpiaŋ‐jopaocmu.
Dameŋ ira Aigita mâreŋkonec hata moc fuarâ raku Asiria mâreŋko fisiocmu, ehame Asiria ŋic â Aigita ŋic jaŋe iiqic ehuc juniŋmu, ehuc qâturerâ Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnehuc juniŋmu.
Dameŋ ira Israezi Aigita â Asiria qâtec‐jofahuc guru namba 3 eocmu, ehuc mâreŋ wâmbuŋnao jambuŋhec juocmu.
Eme Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc muhuc jambuŋ‐jopaocmu: “Aigita ŋicguru‐nane â Asiria meqâreŋ‐nane â Israe ŋic fuŋfuŋfâc‐nane ŋoŋerao jambuŋ‐nanezi fotâcnerâ fozejec.”
Asiria ŋicwofuŋ Saragoŋzi momori jaŋere micne sâko soreme Asidode haeo fisirâ somâckerâ ro rauc ewec.
Dameŋ ira Wofuŋzi Jesaja, Amozire ŋokâ hâcne, dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ajoc, go qorucge qatarac â kikehuhuge heunuckec!” Eme iŋuc erâ qoruc tâmiric â kikehuhu tâmiric mâc juwec.
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Jesaja e jara 3 qoruc â kikehuhu tâmiric mâc juwec, izi Aigita â Etiopia mâreŋ jahere ma â sowi ewec.
Irec sâcko Asiria ŋicwofuŋzi Aigita ŋic ʒikao rocjopakicne â Etiopia ŋic kâpâcwârure biŋe mucjopakicne jaŋe bacjopa raocmu, socɋâri mecne ŋic ŋokac qizecne mecne, qoruc â kikehuhu tâmiric biuctac jâmbâŋ; i Aigita ŋic jaŋerao mimi fuaocte iŋuc eocmu.
Eme Etiopia mâreŋte ʒâŋe fifi jumbiŋ â Aigita mâreŋte manapie fefene ewec jaŋe mâreŋ i jahere erâ bipic tara‐jareme mimieniŋmu.
Eme hâwecmecko ʒira juraŋgopieŋzi dameŋ ira kecʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Ojai, Asiria ŋicwofuŋte meonec batarac‐nâponiŋte jâcsanaŋfâc‐nâŋec mujarehuc ra mu wâwâsic ejarembeŋ jaŋe wiac iŋucne fua‐jarewecko nâŋâckoaŋ weniŋuc erâ sâcne wisenaŋmu?’”
Ʒâʒâkiriŋ mâŋâŋ hâhâwicne juwic mâreŋkonec ware fisiekac irec sâcko mâreŋ burocnaonec, â mâreŋ sâqocnaonec wiac moc fisikac.
Ʒâŋe‐nane bâtâcneme wiac hâhâwicne kecʒiŋuc honepo: Soroŋ qaqazi soroŋ qaocmu â ima qaqazi ima qaocmu. Elam, go ware fec, Media go somâ râec! Babe haere erâ harac huacbuc ee i bâniniŋke‐fârezepac.
Irec buʒâic enarekac i ŋokac gozi kicjopame ʒâic manaeŋgopieŋ irec sâc; no wiac i hone manac erâ maŋnane gâckeme bipic‐nane tarakac.
Maŋnane fâfârekac, bipic‐nane tarame weaŋkekopac; no mârâc jaha owâ ririŋte manape biaŋke jujec miŋecgac ine manape hâhâwicne ekac.
Tiwâ ʒepe bâmockeeŋgopieŋ, fofo rumackeeŋgopieŋ, nânâ opâ nâeŋgopieŋ. Ajoc, ŋic fekicne ŋoŋe faharerâ maro saŋ jâwec ruacneniŋ!
Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc nazawec hâcne: “Go ra ruc bapa ŋic âzâcnetec domahuc wiac honeocmu sâc mufuazejec.
Ehuc ŋic jajaheczi becâsic jajahecko ŋehuc hehendeŋ wareŋgopieŋ, me doŋgi birinehec me kamele birinehec, iŋuc honec‐joparâ hazec râe‐jâmbâŋkezejec.”
Eme honec‐jopaweczi ʒiŋuc muhuc owackewec: “O Wofuŋ, no ruc bapa ficko ʒoaŋ ʒora domaekopac â dodoma‐naneo domahuc ŋafe sâc ʒâŋe fihuc juekopac.
Erâ manaŋgopieŋ, becâsicko ŋic jajahec jajaheczi hehendeŋ ware fisiŋgopieŋ.” Iŋuc murâ muwec: “Babe hae sâko tâtiewec, tâtie‐jâmbâŋkewec hâcne; ehame nemufâc‐ticne jaŋere ɋâŋ qâqâtâc i mâreŋko henʒaŋ qanʒaŋ‐jopa‐fârekicne.”
O ŋicfâc‐nane sipiric‐ŋopakicne â âtenʒaŋ‐ŋopakicne, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu eraonec dâŋ manapo i hâcne mufua‐ŋarekopac.
Seiri mâreŋkonec ŋic moczi ʒiŋuc wira‐narekac: “Ruc bapa ŋic, ŋafe bembeŋne me ʒoricne fokac? Ruc bapa ŋic, ŋafe biac taraocmu me?”
Ruc bapa ŋiczi muwec: “Hae i furezo ekac; erâ dapâc fokac jaha. Ŋoŋe wiac irec me irec manazo murâ mocwâc risie ware wionʒepieŋ.”
Dedaŋ ŋic, Arabia mâreŋ fotâcnehuc jueŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe hae ŋafeme kâte qâhâcko waha guŋ fonʒepieŋ.
O Tema mâreŋ rune, ŋoŋe opâre hâmoŋgopieŋ jaŋe opâ gumec‐jopanʒepieŋ, â wisehuc juŋgopieŋ jaŋe nânâ jare gumec enʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe ʒikare wiseŋgopieŋ, sâqe unuckekicne â tepe âpârekicne â ʒikare tâpiri wânʒâŋ irec wiseŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Irec Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Jara moc, kiŋaŋ qaqa jaŋere jara dameŋ iŋucne, i tarazo eha Kedara ŋic ɋuŋɋasaŋ‐jeŋic sasawa omaeocmu.
Eme Kedara ŋicguru tepeŋicfâc‐jeŋic nâfocne juniŋmu jaŋere ʒare i afecne mac.” Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu eki iŋuc muwec hâcne.
Ŋoŋe weniŋuc eŋareme ficbupuo fefârembiŋ,
hae‐ŋeŋic ojowa â fânâŋ sâkozi fusucmaekac â ficsanaŋ‐ŋeŋicko ʒeri sâko foekac ŋoŋe. Qâhâmoc‐jopakicnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe sâqezi mi âke hâmoc‐jopawec â ʒikao mi jopakicne.
Micnefâcge jaŋe sasawa wise‐fârembiŋ, jaŋe tepe moc mi qâtâcnehapie kâpâcwâru bacjopakicne, â momorifâcge jaŋe ʒoricko wise‐bipiehapie rocjoparâ niŋgiŋ‐jopa‐fârembiŋ.
Irec ʒiŋuc mukopac: “Norao mi fipie wareoc, no ki kâcɋene kiozo ekopac; ŋoŋe ŋicfâc‐nane sipiric‐jopakicne irec mu bâmiriŋ enareniŋte ʒoɋac mi eniŋ!”
Wofuŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki hâcne mume ʒoaŋ mocko findaŋdâŋ mamana wâneŋ ira bipic tatara â ima qaqa â maŋ bâsifuc‐ticnehec fuaocmu; ehame qânâsac herickeocmu â tikiopec owa sâko fuaocmu.
Eme Elamŋic jaŋe tepe motec‐jeŋic biac hâniŋko râepie hume keretac â becâsichec warehuc juŋgopieŋ, â Kiriŋic jaŋe maro‐jeŋic sicnepie hukac.
Irec ʒiŋuc fuaocmu: Wâneŋ biaŋge i ʒikare keretaczi fusucmaocmu â momori becâsicko rarazi haesacte motâckopec birickehuc domaniŋmu.
Ehame Judazi ŋeŋezic‐ticne basaocmu. Ehuc dameŋ ira kâte bozeo ʒikare rowaŋ fokacko ʒâŋe fiocmu.
Eme Dawidire hae sâko irec qânâsac i fâucke ʒaŋ eme hawecne bocjaha fuame hone bâpiaŋ embiŋ â juwic riqickonec opâ fiambiŋ.
Erâ Jerusalemte ficbiri woserâ qânâsac bâpiaŋkehuc basanaŋkeniŋte fic wiac gâcne heropiembiŋ.
Erâ qânâsac jajahec jahere ŋondeŋko riqic raŋɋanere opâzi qâzuckeocte nombâŋ moc rombiŋ. Ehuc wiac i fuaocte giene bawec erao ʒâŋe mi fimbiŋ â i bâfuaocte mârâc mana biric ewec ere mi manasumbiŋ.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Anutu hâcne, eki dameŋ ira kio wâwâsic â mu mamakuc eniŋte â qizec susuc bâtâcneniŋte â târuzi mateŋ barâ hepie huocte muŋarewec.
Ŋoŋe ine aŋac ʒeri faio juhuc lama bulimakao qa hezuc ejarehuc tiwâ bâzi â waiŋ opâ nâhuc ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ i: “Tomâcko hâmonaŋmure nânâ opâ nâjâmbâŋkezo!”
Irec Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mume hazec‐naneo hume manapo: “Kiŋ bahac keci jâmbomac moc mi ŋowac rozo, foŋareha jaha hâmonʒepieŋ!” Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e iŋuc muwec.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Ajoc, go soŋaŋ keci, ʒâŋene Sebena, fic wiac soŋaŋkehuc juekac erao rarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnec:
Go fuŋne wemocte ʒira juekic â mozi ʒira jugareme mutec ʒâŋeruŋ moc gore biŋe gufumbiŋ? Goki wama faio focmurâ mutec mâreŋ facnao, qânâ hâŋko ʒâŋeruŋge gufumbiŋ i.
Manakic, Wofuŋ e ŋic qac momori go wânʒâŋnehec tuŋguocmu erâ wâc sanaŋne rocguocmu.
Rocgurâ bârusucgume bali iŋucne etec wicgume mâreŋ qaratiekicnao racmu. Bomboŋgere kikefuŋ mimi qaqa ejareekic ŋic go mâreŋ ira hâmozemec â keretacfâcge eri‐jeŋichec ijaha omaenʒepieŋ.
No iŋuc ehuc soŋaŋ giege gowac rozepac, ehame fekicne jujuge omae‐garezejec.
No dameŋ ira kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Eliakim, Hilikiare ŋokâ, e wira hefârec ecnepemu.
Erâ gore gie ŋaqi i hecnepe huocmu â gore umbika jomacnehuc guriŋ bapagere tâpiri ere meo râepe foha Jerusalem hae rune â Judare kikefuŋ mamac ejarezejec.
No Dawidire kikefuŋte ki i ɋawenao ɋetickepe domaocmu, eme i bajuhuc motâc bâŋgoroŋkeme moczi mi basanaŋkeocmu me basanaŋkeme moczi mi bâŋgoroŋkeocmu.
Eme no wâtuŋ iŋucne mâreŋ sanaŋnao keteŋkepe domazejec, ehuc mamacnere kikefuŋte eri ŋeŋe erâ ŋezejec.
Ehame mamac‐ticnere kikefuŋ sâko irec tagi, naru motec, apa ŋosa, ʒocŋifec â ocfâc‐ticne, ŋic omane â ʒâŋe biŋehec jaŋe sasawa erao qohota‐fâreniŋmu.
Irec Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Dameŋ ira mâreŋ sanaŋnao wâtuŋ keteŋkekicne i rândiŋkerâ waha qaocmu, ehame erao qohotambiŋ jaŋe mâmâc waha qahuc qanʒaŋ‐jopaocmu, Wofuŋzi muwecte iŋuc fuaocmu.”
Tiro haere okacdâŋ. O Tarasisi woke sâko, Tiro hae ima bakicnere kio owa eniŋ, fic hae omae‐fârewec hâcne. Jaŋe Kipiro nuckonec risiehuc biŋe bâroŋ i manambiŋ.
Hâwecmecko ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe niniŋkeniŋ! Sidoŋte âbârâ ŋic hâwec fotâcnehuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâriri bâfua‐ŋare jumbiŋ.
Sihoro opâ mecko wiac nânâne â Nilu opâ ʒiŋuc ocniŋuc padi jacgoŋ fuawec i opâ sâko fotâcnehuc Sidoŋ haeo barakicne, eme ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere furi bapa toma erâ ŋemeŋ.
Sidoŋ, go mimiec, hâwecmecko hae sanaŋ ŋekac izi ʒiŋuc mukacte: “No gozi kicnume naru motec roroc‐jopa i mi epo, â ŋicmotec me naru ŋokac i wâc mi hone maiŋ ejarehape sokambiŋ.”
Tirore biŋe bâroŋzi Aigita mâreŋko fisime ŋic jaŋe manarâ ɋarac ɋarac qaniŋmu.
Hâwec fotâcnerâ Tarasisi haeo raniŋ; hâwecmecko ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe kio owa eniŋ!
Mârâc sasac jaha fuawec â maŋnao ʒeri sâko fowec erâ ŋic guru gâcne jaŋehec jaba juocte kike‐ticnezi ʒoricko rajujec, hae keci hâcne me?
Tiro haezi ŋic gâcne jaŋe eridu tahac‐jopa jujec â âbârâ ŋicfâcne jaŋe ŋicbomboŋ erâ jujumbieŋ erâ nareŋ gareŋ gie bapafâcne jaŋere ʒâŋe biŋe fejujec, ehame hae e wiac i fuacneocte mozi mupaŋkewec?
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki mupaŋkewec, i pepec penaroŋ sasawa qame wahaocte â mâreŋ sâc boc sâsec‐jopambiŋ jaŋe ba jawa ejareocte.
Tarasisi rune, ŋoŋe niŋgiŋ‐ŋeŋic mocwâc mi fokacte Nilu opâzi roma baekac irec sâc ehuc mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic sâcke‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ e meticne hâweckopec sicneme ŋicne ŋicne â ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ɋarac ɋarac qambiŋ; e Kanaaŋ mâreŋko ficsanaŋ ŋerawec i tâtie‐fâreocte mupaŋkewec.
Ehuc muwec: “O Sidoŋ rune, go hâcne ro waha âte egarekicne, go ʒeri bari mocwâc mi ezemec. Ajoc, go Kipiro nucko ra juzemec, eme ira ŋeŋemana wâc mi fua‐garezejec.”
Manaŋgopieŋ, Asiria jaŋe mâcne, Kaldea ŋic jaŋe hae ima bapie qowi jaŋere biŋe ewec. Jaŋe somâ bapare ʒae ʒora bapie fewec, erâ ŋicwofuŋ fic heropierâ hae hetâc qâtâtiembiŋ.
Tarasisi woke rune, ŋoŋe hae sanaŋ‐ŋeŋic ima bakicnere kio owa eniŋ!
Dameŋ ira Tiro haere ninikec fuame jara 70 taraocmu, i ŋicwofuŋ mocjahare juju dameŋ tinac. Eme jara 70 tarame sasec ŋokac mocte gae hembiŋko dâŋ fokac irec sâcko Tiro hae fuacneocmu, ine kecʒiŋuc:
“Sasec ŋokac nâme ninikec egarekicne go mimi ŋokac rorâ hae sâkoo rac warec ehuc ficnezemec â gae bocjaha hezemec, eme ŋiczi gore mocwâc manasunʒepieŋ.”
Jara 70 tarame Wofuŋzi Tiro hae manacneha moneŋ gie‐ticnao mocwâc risieocmu, ehuc mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec faio ŋicne ŋicne juraŋgopieŋ jaŋehec âbârâ gie baocmu.
Mâc gie furi i ro qâzuc me râe guruc mi ee Wofuŋte biŋe qame foocmu; izi Wofuŋte maio jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe nânâ mâriri â ŋaqi qoruc biaŋ bâfua‐jarezejec.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ e mâreŋ ima bame tuhu fuarâ foocmu, ehame mâreŋ hetikiehuc ŋecjucfâc‐ticne bâtâtiec‐jopaocmu.
Eme ŋic omane mecne, taha bapa mecne, kiŋaŋŋic mecne, bomboŋ‐ticne mecne, kiŋaŋ ŋokac mecne, ŋokac bomboŋ‐ticne mecne, âbârâ ŋic mecne, furi bapa ŋic mecne, wiac jaba babaju mecne, rune mecne, moneŋ jaba babaju mecne, moneŋ rune mecne jaŋe sasawa sâc mocjaha fua‐jare‐fâreocmu.
Mâreŋ i ima bajâmbâŋkeme tuhu jâmbâŋ fuarâ foocmu; Wofuŋzi irec dâŋ muwec hâcne.
Mâreŋ e kereŋkehuc fâucke ʒaŋ ekac, â mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ e weaŋkehuc bâŋeŋkekac, erâ mâreŋŋic fekicne jaŋe docke betaŋ eŋgopieŋ.
Mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe sâcmutâc â dâŋsanaŋ qatarahuc ʒâʒâfic fofo sanaŋ hetâcnembiŋ iŋuc ehuc mâreŋ gâc hecnembiŋ hâcne.
Irec Wofuŋzi mâreŋ sâweckehame fainao jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe kiŋjeŋicte okacne fisi‐jareocmu; ehame mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne gâcne sâko sipirickepie ŋic afecne sawa juniŋmu.
Waiŋ opâzi sâqorekac, waiŋ qizecne hâmo ʒaŋ ekac â bubiaŋ faio jumbiŋ jaŋe ki busâqoc eŋgopieŋ.
Woŋgâŋ fânâŋ aŋacne i niniŋkekac, bubiaŋ manaeŋgopieŋ jaŋere ʒeri gae i omaekac â mimi ŋokac dâŋte bubiaŋ mamana i tarakac.
Jaŋe ʒeri gae hehuc waiŋ opâ nânâ i mocwâc mi eniŋmu â opâ sanaŋ nâeŋgopieŋzi manapie aŋac tâmiric eocmu.
Hae sâko i ima bakicne sesuctac fokac, ficticne sasawa ki bafârekicnere moczi moc sâcne mi feocmu.
Hae hatao waiŋ opâre ki busâqoc eŋgopieŋ, bubiaŋ sasawa i tara‐fârewec, hae sâc aŋac ʒeri fowec i omaewec.
Hae ima bakicne fokac â motâc sâko‐ticne henʒaŋ qanʒaŋnekicne.
Mâreŋte faio ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere ŋondeŋko oliwa jâc itiriŋkepie hândâŋne wahaekac irec sâc fuaocmu hâcne, me waiŋ fâri fufua dameŋ tarame hândâŋ tiwâne ro nusec eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc.
Ŋic jaŋe marac fânâŋ‐jeŋic bafehuc ʒeri eŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ ɋuŋɋasaŋ‐ticnere semuja hepie fânâŋne ʒoaŋ huhunaonec ware fisikac.
Irec ʒoaŋ wewefunao mâreŋ forakac sâc Wofuŋ muteŋ bâteŋ ecneniŋ â hâwec heririŋko ira Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu ʒâŋe‐ticne muteŋkeniŋ!
Mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaonec mumuteŋ gae irec fânâŋ ʒiŋuc wareme manambeŋ: “Tiŋne rune e mumbiaŋkezo!” Noni ine mukopac: “No sâqorerâ betaŋkehuc jukopac, jei, no wenac epe? Fiuc rorozi fiuc roeŋgopieŋ, fiuc roro jaŋe momori ehuc fiuc rojâmbâŋkeeŋgopieŋ.”
Mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne ŋoŋere faio wiac hâhâwicne feha nombâŋ roŋareniŋmu â bitiŋ râe‐ŋareniŋmu.
Eme ʒiŋuc fuaocmu: Moc e wiac hâhâwicnere fânâŋte wiseocmu e nombâŋko huocmu, â moc e nombâŋkonec wefuocmu e bitiŋzi kiocmu. Hoe micsâko heocte faic motâc aaŋ fokac â mâreŋte hobeteŋ i qiriŋ qakac hâcne.
Mâreŋ e fâuckeme hârâc fuakac, mâreŋ e hahaŋkerâ ʒaŋkekac, mâreŋ e mâretec qiriŋ qahuc fokac.
Mâreŋ e ŋic moc maŋne bibiriwame biric boroc eekac iŋuc eocmu, me boze burec burec mac bakicne iŋucne qiriŋ qaocmu, sindaŋ‐ticnezi bâmâckeme waha qarâ mocwâc fahareocte eipieocmu.
Eme dameŋ ira Wofuŋzi sambâŋ momori jaŋe sambâŋko ba bâtiŋ ejareocmu â mâreŋ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe mâreŋko ejareocmu.
Ehuc kâpâcwâru ŋic iŋucne hetumaŋ‐joparâ nombâŋko behec‐jopame huniŋmu â kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐joparâ motâc basanaŋkeocmu eme ʒoaŋ bocjaha tarame dâŋjeŋic mutara‐jareocmu.
Iŋuc fuame mosazi bâruŋkeocmu â ʒoaŋ tatamaczi weaŋkeocmu; Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ŋicwofuŋ guriŋ bapa gie‐ticne Zioŋ tikio â Jerusalem haeo fuŋkeocmu hâcne; ehuc eri qaraweŋ‐ticne i micnefâcne jaŋere maio bataniŋkeocmu.
O Wofuŋ, go nore Anutu, no muac baafec egarehuc ʒâŋege mumbiaŋkekopac; goki hâcne mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bameŋ â mârâc jaha mumutâc dâŋ mana biric emeŋ i jâmbomac â fârine jâmbâŋ.
Goki hâcne hae sâko ima bameŋ, ficsanaŋ heroc qâropiemeŋ, râsi jaŋere erific bâsirowemeŋ; eme mocwâc heɋârehuc mi baniŋmu.
Irec hâcne ŋicguru tâpiri‐jeŋichec jaŋe sâsecguniŋmu â ŋicguru qac momori jaŋe hae‐jeŋic sâc araŋ bagareniŋmu.
Goki hâcne ŋic qarâ suriŋne jaŋere jâcsanaŋ â hapetac keke suec suec ejarekicne jaŋere huec sanaŋ. Go hoe mâŋâŋ hâhâwicnere qânâuŋ â ʒoaŋ fârorocte nâkumuc ejaremeŋ, i tâpirihec jaŋere micrombâŋ hoe micsâkozi fic sâpenao heekac iŋucne tinac, â mâreŋ burocnao ʒoaŋ fârone iŋucne fuaekacte iŋuc ejaremeŋ.
Go râsi jaŋere ojowa bâniniŋkekomec; karoraczi ʒoaŋ sâockeme fâroroc‐ticne mâteŋkeekac irec sâc bâbâʒâic ŋic aŋara‐jeŋic niniŋkewec.
Eme Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e tiki kecʒira ŋicne ŋicne tiwâ bâzi moc rike‐jareocmu, ehuc wiac wokemaŋhec â waiŋ opâ aŋacne jare gumec eocmu, nânâ wiac âsu mumundoŋ â wokemaŋhec â waiŋ opâ fowefuhuc juku aŋacne jâmbâŋ ewec i.
Erâ e qâruruzi ŋic gurune gurune foŋjopakicne â bilaŋke ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere faio qaratiekicne fokac i tiki ʒira bârârie‐jareocmu.
E hâmocte tâpiri qame omae sanaŋkeocmu. Wofuŋ Anutu e ŋic sasawa ʒâŋeuc‐jeŋic bâkereŋkeocmu, ehuc mâreŋ sâc ŋicfâc‐ticne mimi busâqoc jowac rofâreocmu. Wofuŋzi iŋuc muwec hâcne.
Ʒoaŋ ira kecʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Honeniŋ, keci Anutu‐nâŋec hâcne, eki bafic‐nâpoocte woŋeckembeŋ; woŋec‐ticne jumbeŋ Wofuŋ e hâcne. Irec ʒeri bari ehuc hone bafic enâreekacte bubiaŋ mananʒepeneŋ!”
Eme Wofuŋ e tiki kecʒi akickehuc meticne râeme foocmu; Moabi ŋic jaŋe ine juŋgopieŋkoa âtenʒaŋ‐jopaocmu, i ŋiczi sopâc sohoŋmaŋko âte utuckeeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc.
Eme jaŋe irec maŋnao fohuc, ŋic moczi fifia baocte mene sicneekac irec sâc mejeŋic sicneniŋmu, Wofuŋzi ine sifu pepec‐jeŋic â mejeŋicte gie sâko i mâmâc bawahaocmu.
Ehuc qânâsac‐jeŋic sanaŋne â ʒoricne i hefâc qâfâuckehuc mâreŋko tuŋkeme waharâ rufemaŋko huocmu.
Dameŋ ira Juda mâreŋko gae kecʒiŋuc heniŋmu: “Nâŋe hae sanaŋ‐nâŋec ŋekac, Wofuŋzi ŋezickeocte qânâsac sanaŋ maŋne sahacne bacnewec.
Sacmotâc ropie aŋkeoc, eme ŋic tiŋnezi siocmâc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe haeo fenʒepieŋ.
Moc e maŋticne gorao fosanaŋkeocmu e hâcne wama bâfuacnecmu, e gorao roweckekac irec.
Dameŋ sâc Wofuŋtao roweckehuc junʒepieŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu e hâcne haroŋaŋ ŋeŋe sanaŋ.
Eki hâcne hae ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnehec ira ŋec juc embiŋ jaŋe bawahac‐jopawec, ehuc hae sanaŋ i hetâtiewec, hetâtie‐jâmbâŋkeme mâreŋko waha qawec, erâ rufemaŋko tuŋkeme hurâ fowec.
Ehame qarâ suriŋne â waha qaqane jaŋe kikezi âtenʒaŋnenʒepieŋ.”
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋere hata i fâretiŋ fokac, goki hâcne tiŋne jaŋere hata hewâneŋkeekomec.
O Wofuŋ, mumutiŋ dâŋgere mamanac jueŋgopeneŋ, ehuc maŋ qâqâtâc‐nâŋeczi ʒâŋegere â mumuteŋgere ecneekac.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi ŋafeo gore ecneekac, â mârozi maŋnaneo juekac, e wira basac egareekac. Eme mumutiŋ dâŋgezi mâreŋko fuame mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe tiŋnere fuŋne mananiŋmu hâcne.
Ŋic hehesicnezi ine aki anonocte fârine fuacneme sifu tiŋne jujure fuŋne mi manaocmu. Aricne, e Wofuŋte maqâreŋ hone‐bipiehuc mâreŋko eebapa tiŋne fokacko sifu sindaŋ eocmu jaha.
O Wofuŋ, mege bâfeŋnetec domaha sifu mi honeŋgopieŋ; ŋicfâcge jaŋere erâ ʒoɋac bâfuaekic i honerâ mimienʒepieŋ, râsifâcge jaŋere erâ kimbeŋgere ʒoc bâruŋkekac izi ʒâseŋ‐jopazejec.
O Wofuŋ, nâŋe ine wama bâfua‐nârezemec, nâŋe wiac ebac embeŋ sâc i goki hâcne bafic‐nâpotec bafârembeŋ.
O Wofuŋ, Anutu‐nâŋec, goki sawa mâcne, wofuŋ gâcne jaŋe bomboŋ enârembiŋ wâc, mâc gore mocjaha manasuhuc ʒâŋege muteŋkehuc juŋgopeneŋ.
Hâmombiŋ jaŋe ɋârerâ mocwâc mi juniŋmu; hâmokicne jaŋe mi fahareniŋmu; goki irec hâcne iqic‐jopahuc bâsirowec‐jopameŋ, iŋuc etec jaŋere nikec‐nâpo sanaŋkewec.
Ŋifec ine Israe ŋic basawec‐nâpomeŋ, o Wofuŋ, basawec‐nâpomeŋ hâcne, ehuc huriri qâreŋge bataniŋkerâ mâreŋ‐nâŋecte ma sasawa bâsoka‐fâremeŋ.
O Wofuŋ, nâŋe ʒârâ hâriŋko juhuc, wira basac egarembeŋ, goki ba bâtiŋ enârehaŋte saŋucko numu‐garembeŋ.
Ŋokac kiwecheczi motec roocte dameŋ maickeha gozi kime risimbiŋne qahuc owackeekac irec sâc jaha gore maio fua‐nârewec, o Wofuŋ!
Nâŋe kiwechec juhuc gozi kicnâpowec, eme motec ropene mâŋâŋ ewec; mâreŋte bâbâpiaŋ bâfuanaŋte eipiembeŋ â mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne mi fuambiŋ.
Hâmokicnefâcge jaŋe ine ɋârerâ juniŋmu, â qâŋɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe fahareniŋmu, rufemaŋko foraŋko foraŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe mana ɋâɋârerâ ʒeri eniŋ; titikucge i tatamacte titikuc hâcne, irec mâreŋzi ŋic hâmocne bârisiec‐jopaocmu.
Ajoc, ŋicfâc‐nane ŋoŋe ficmaŋ‐ŋeŋicko raʒirâ motâc basanaŋkeniŋ, erâ dameŋ bembeŋne mac soŋkerâ juhapie kimbeŋzi mâteŋkezejec.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ e mâreŋŋic hehesic‐jeŋicte okacne bazu‐jareocte biac hae‐ticne beherâ warezo ekac; eme mâreŋ e jahac fai‐ticnao soc hoŋkekicne i bataniŋkeocmu, ehuc qâhâmoc‐jopakicnefâc‐ticne mocwâc mi ŋemac‐jopaocmu.
Dameŋ ira Wofuŋ e ʒika‐ticne sanaŋne â kâcɋene â tâpirihec izi Lewiataŋ, homa wiwisene hâcne, â homa qaqaharicne ʒâŋene Lewiataŋ jaha, jahe okacne bazu‐jacteocmu, erâ hâwecko oâ jukac e qâhâmoocmu.
Dameŋ ira dâŋ ʒiŋuc fuaocmu: “Waiŋ gie biaŋne i gae hecneniŋ!
Wofuŋ no hâcne soŋaŋ‐ticne; no gâbâ jaha opâ ruacneekopac, sisipiric wiac moc fuacnezacte ŋafe furec soŋaŋkehuc juekopac.
No aaric mi bajukopac; mâc fâpâ uupic â sopâc fuame honerâ râsi ecnehuc turuŋkepe ʒafâreocmu!
Nore dapeŋko soŋkehuc wama qanare‐jâmbâŋkeniŋmuo ine iŋuc mi epemu.”
Juku Jakobozi gâtâ baocmu â Israezi gitec herâ fiehuc âri qaocmu, eme fârine fuarâ mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ sâcke‐fâreocmu.
Wofuŋ go kisâfâc‐jeŋic jopameŋ irec sâc Israe ŋic moc jopameŋ me? Me râsifâc‐jeŋic qâhâmoc‐jopameŋ irec sâc moc qâhâmoc‐jopameŋ me?
Aricne, behec‐jopatec kâpâcwâruo bacjopa rambiŋ izi okacne bazu‐jaremeŋ ewec, ehame kagu mâŋâŋ fuawec ʒoaŋ ira micrombâŋge sanaŋnezi ficnec‐jopahuc jâpec‐jopameŋ.
Iŋuc fuawecte Jakobore kiŋtofa tarakac, eme kiŋ babatara irec fârine wiac kecʒiŋuc fuaocmu: Alatare qânâ sasawa qâfâuckeme qorac qanʒaŋnekicne iŋucne eocmu, â Asera ɋâŋ qâqâtâc‐ticne â nemure wâtuŋ wiac i mocwâc mi âkendâŋnepie domaocmu.
Hae sanaŋ i niniŋ siarereŋ fokac, fic hae behekicne i mâreŋ burocne iŋucne tuhutac fokac, ehame bulimakao jaŋe ira ju fofo ehuc jâc dutu rehacne nâfâreeŋgopieŋ.
Eme tieŋne hâmo‐fâreme ŋic jaŋe bazuniŋmu, ehame ŋokac jaŋe fisirâ ʒoc ruqepie ʒaocmu. Jaŋe ŋicguru maŋ mamanasu tâmiric, irec bâbâfua‐jeŋiczi busâqoc mi mana‐jareocmu â bâfuac‐jopaweczi aki anonoc mi ejareocmu.
Eme dameŋ ira Wofuŋzi Eufrata opâonec fuŋkerâ padi hândâŋne qâmârâŋke ware raku Aigita mâreŋte opâo qâmârâŋke taraocmu. Israere ɋâricfâc ŋoŋe ine buc buc ro nusec eŋarezo.
Dameŋ ira qeŋsâko qapie dâŋeocmu, eme Asiria mâreŋko qac qâsoric ekicne jaŋe mecne â jopa jâpec ejarepie Aigita mâreŋko rambiŋ jaŋe mâmâc fisirâ Jerusalem ira tiri tikio Wofuŋ dapecneniŋmu.
Jei, Eferaimte hae biaŋ, go ŋic waiŋ opâ gapecmâc nâeŋgopieŋ jaŋere hae; go ŋic waiŋ opâzi maŋ bâsifuc ejareha qizec‐jeŋicko eriduzi joŋtawezo ekac iŋucne.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ e ŋic qac momori â tâpirihec moc jucnekac, eki hâcne fisirâ hoe sanaŋ aisihec â mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋnehec â hoe micsâko rumi bâbâfuane iŋucne ehuc ŋic qârândiŋ‐jopame mâreŋko waha foniŋmu!
Eferaim maŋsifuc opâ nâ areŋ eene jaŋere eridu hone aŋacne, hae‐jeŋic hâcne, i kikezi âtenʒaŋneniŋmu.
Ehame mâreŋ guecnehec irec heririŋnao tiki faio eridu hone aŋacne joŋtawezo ekac, i fâri fufua dameŋ maickezo eha nemuja hândâŋnao eeŋgopieŋ sâc ijaha ecneniŋmu, ine kecʒiŋuc, ŋiczi hone aŋac ehuc izia batararâ nâeŋgopieŋ.
Dameŋ ira Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e jahac ŋicfâc‐ticne nâfocne eri hendiŋ â fiŋe biri biaŋ ejareocmu.
Ehuc mumutara ŋic e mâro‐ticne râcneocmu â râsi hae motâckonec jâpec‐jopaniŋmu jaŋe tâpiri sâko qikiŋne‐jareocmu.
Eme jaŋe iŋuc jaha waiŋ opâ nâku maŋjeŋic sifuckeekac, â opâ sanaŋ nâku biric boroc eeŋgopieŋ. Taha bapa â porofete jaŋe opâ sanaŋ nâku maŋjeŋic sifuckeekac; waiŋ opâzi jopaekac hâcne. Jaŋe opâ sanaŋ nâku maŋjeŋic bibiriwame findaŋdâŋ musifuckeeŋgopieŋ â dâŋ mumutarao biric boroc eeŋgopieŋ.
Tebo fainao wiac mamaŋune fofâreekac â sohoŋ goteŋzi wiac sasawao bohotaekac.
“Hâc, porofete e mamana i mo ŋic mo qazucneocte mukac â findaŋdâŋ i mo ŋic mo âzâcne mutâc eocte mukac? Motec geune â moŋ miŋecne mac qikiŋnekicne jaŋe me?
Dâŋ ʒiŋuc fuaekac: Moc ʒi ec, moc keci ec, moc ʒi bac, moc keci bac, ʒira piticne moc, kecira piticne moc.”
Oc, Wofuŋ e dâŋ mi manaeŋgopieŋko â marac furuo ŋicguru ʒi dâŋ jazaocmu.
Ʒiŋuc jazawec eki hâcne iŋuc eocmu: “Jujumana hae ʒine hâcne, tâpiri‐jeŋic betaŋkekicne jaŋe ejarepie jumananiŋ; jujumana toma ʒine hâcne.” Jaŋe ine dâŋ i manazore mi ejarewec.
Irec Wofuŋte dâŋ jaŋerao kecʒiŋuc fuaocmu: “Moc ʒi ec, moc keci ec, moc ʒi bac, moc keci bac, ʒira piticne moc, kecira piticne moc.” Eme jaŋe hatao rahuc rârâpe waha jopame me kike‐jeŋic hericke ʒaŋ ezejec, me uficko jowapie rocjopanʒepieŋ.
Irec âke sisic ŋicbomboŋ ŋoŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ mananiŋ, Jerusalem ŋic ŋokac keci jaŋere micnefâc ŋoŋe!
Ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ hâcne: “Hâmochec biac muc manac embeŋ, â hâmoc haehec ʒâʒâfic‐nâŋec fokac; irec sisipiricte rumi sâko fisi fotâcneocmu izi nâŋe mi rocnâpoocmu; bureczi sac hafembeŋ izi sâoc‐nâpokac, â eeatuczi boze bambeŋ ira soŋkeŋgopeneŋ.”
Irec Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Mananiŋ, no Zioŋko ŋesiŋ sanaŋ fuaocte qânâ hekopac, qânâ i qânâ saric, esâicke honekicne, tuturuŋte qânâ furi sâko, keteŋke‐hâmokicne: ‘Manasiŋkeocmuzi docke pârâc mi eocmu!’
Eme mupe mumutiŋ dâŋzi sâcmeda ezejec, â tiŋne jujuzi sigeli ezejec, ehame hoe sanaŋzi burecte sac henʒaŋneocmu, â opâ rumizi eeatucte boze qâuruckeocmu.”
Dameŋ ira hâmochec mucmanac‐ŋeŋic fârimâc eocmu, â hâmoc haehec ʒâʒâfic‐ŋeŋic tâcne ʒaŋ eocmu; eme sisipiricte rumizi fotâcnehuctecne qanʒaŋ‐ŋopame mâreŋko waha qarâ foniŋmu.
Dameŋne dameŋne fotâcneocmu sâc rocŋopaocmu, hae fureocmu sâc fisirâ fotâcneocmu, ʒoaŋko mecne, ŋafeo mecne. Eme findaŋdâŋ manaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bipic‐jeŋic taraocmu.
Fofo i bembeŋnere fainao fâretiŋ fofore sâc mi ekac â bilaŋke i piticnere rufazore eipieŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ e gie‐ticne fuŋmoc i bataraocte â eebapa bipic tataranehec i eocte Perazim tikio ewec iŋuc jaha ehuc fahareocmu â Gibeoŋ wâneŋko ewec irec sâc jaha ehuc aaric sâko manaocmu.
Niŋgiŋ‐ŋeŋic sanaŋke‐ŋarezacte mu âke sisic‐ŋeŋic ʒiŋuczia behenʒepieŋ; manaŋgopieŋ, no Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eraonec dâŋ ʒiŋuc manapo: Mâreŋne mâreŋne sisipiric sâko fuaocte mupaŋkekicne.
Ŋoŋe hazec râerâ micfânâŋ‐nane mananiŋ; niniŋkerâ dâŋnane mananiŋ!
Hesarac ŋic jaŋe sara mama eniŋte gie ʒuʒuhuc jaha he rikec eeŋgopieŋ me? Me mâreŋ‐jeŋic ʒuʒuhuc jaha hefâuckehuc hec hetikic eeŋgopieŋ me?
Aricne, jaŋe mâreŋ bâburockerâ monʒaŋ wiac irec hândâŋne tieeŋgopieŋ â padi jacgoŋ mâreŋ bâwosâekicnao birio râerâ qaŋeŋnao sâo wiac saraeŋgopieŋ. Me iŋuc mi eeŋgopieŋ me?
Iŋuc hâcne epie sâckeocte Anutu‐jeŋiczi jaza mutâc eekac.
Jaŋe padi hândâŋne i paraŋzi me keretacte ʒafeŋgâŋzi mi hemârâŋkeeŋgopieŋ, aricne, ɋaruczi qapie ŋemârâŋkeekac.
Padi hândâŋne qanʒaŋnezo me? Aricne, jaŋe ʒuʒuhuc jaha qâmârâŋkehuc iŋuc mi eeŋgopieŋ â becâsicfâc‐jeŋic keretachec ejarepie padi faio rac warec ehuc kosa mi âtenʒaŋneeŋgopieŋ wâc.
I Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere micte jaha iŋuc eeŋgopieŋ; ere mamana biri i qame hukicne, erâ wiac eme bame biaŋkeekac.
Jei, Ariele, Ariele hae sanaŋ go! Dawidizi mârâc jaha rucgurâ basanaŋguwec! Ŋoŋe jara moc tarame sâc moc ʒuhuckerâ jufenʒepieŋ, ehuc hombaŋ fuame sâc ŋehuc junʒepieŋ.
No Ariele bâʒâickepe busâqoc â kio owa fuazejec, eme Ariele fârine ŋenarezejec.
No rârec rârec toma âterâ momori râec‐jopape jaŋe somâcguhuc sac bagareniŋmu.
Eme mâreŋko fohuc dâŋ mutec wefuocmu â micfânâŋge rufemaŋko fuaocmu; ehame micfânâŋge i bawe micfânâŋ tinac mâreŋmaŋkonec wefuocmu, â dâŋmaracgezi rufemaŋkonec saŋuc tinac wefuocmu.
Râsifâcge guru sâko jaŋe ine rufe uuc iŋucne tâtienʒepieŋ, â bâbâʒâicfâcge guru sâko jaŋe mâŋâŋzi jawa ficne sueme wiseekac iŋucne enʒepieŋ. Ehame ututuŋ jâmbâŋ ʒiŋuc fuaocmu:
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ɋuŋ parandaŋ â homeŋ â fânâŋ sâko â hoe mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋnehec â ʒocbâruŋ ʒa ʒâtâc eene irec maŋnao juhuc iqicguocmu.
Eme ŋicne ŋicne Ariele râsi ecneeŋgopieŋ sasawa jaŋe mecne erâ e jahacne â sacsanaŋ‐ticne ʒika bâfuacnehuc imackeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc ŋafeo guŋko wiac hone manac epene fâri tâmiric eekac irec sâc efârenʒepieŋ.
Ʒiŋuc fuaocmu: Ŋic moc nânâre hâmorâ “nânâ nâkopac” guŋko iŋuc manasuhuc mana ɋâɋârerâ nânâ fârine basaocmu, me moc e opâre hâmorâ “opâ nâkopac” guŋko iŋuc manahuc mana ɋâɋârerâ opâre hâmohuc jaha betaŋkeocmu, irec sâc jaha ŋicne ŋicne sasawa Zioŋ tiki râsi ecneniŋmu jaŋe fua‐jarezejec.
Maŋŋeŋic omaeha bipic tatara eŋarezejec, ŋaŋac ʒâŋe‐ŋeŋic bâsoŋkerâ tiŋtuŋ qanʒepieŋ! Erâ waiŋ opâ mi nâhuc maŋsifuc eŋarezejec, erâ opâ sanaŋ wâc mi nâhuc biric boroc enʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋzi mutara‐ŋareme guŋ qâmâc‐ŋopawec, â ʒâŋe hândâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic, porofete hâcne, jaŋe bâhâpoc‐jopawec erâ qizecfâc‐ŋeŋic, findaŋdâŋ mumuŋic hâcne, jaŋe qârufac‐jopawec.
Eme wiac kecirec bararuŋ dâŋ mukicne sasawa i ŋoŋe manapie papia qizec sâfâzi basanaŋkekicnao dâŋ fokac irec sâc ekac. I ŋic jaŋe âgo‐jeŋic moc wowosere fuŋne mamana ʒiŋuc muhuc râcneniŋmu: “Ʒi moc wosec,” eme muocmu: “Sâfâzi basanaŋkekicnere sâcne mi wosepemu.”
Me ŋic moc wowosere fuŋne mi mamana e râcnehuc muniŋmu: “Ʒi moc wosec,” eme muocmu, “No wowosere fuŋne mi manakopac.”
Eme Wofuŋzi muwec: “Ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe mâc sahaczi sawa mai enarerâ micbipic‐jeŋiczi sâsecnuhuc maŋjeŋiczi ine qikiŋnueŋgopieŋ; erâ araŋ banareeŋgopieŋ i ŋicdâŋ mu qaqazuc ehuc sawa eeŋgopieŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no irec hâcne ŋicguru ʒi jaŋerao wiac qeŋ bipinehec mocwâc bâfuapemu, wiac bipinehec â ʒâŋe furu hâcne, ehame mamana ŋicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere maŋɋârâŋzi omaezejec â mamana tarazi aputac ezejec.”
Jei, dâŋ manasu biric erâ Wofuŋte maio sanaŋne hesoŋkeeŋgopieŋ, â dapâcko wiac ebac ehuc mueŋgopieŋ: “Mozi honec‐nâpoocmu â mozi manac‐nâpoocmu?”
Oi ŋoŋe, wiac sasawa qac qâtikic efâreeŋgopieŋ. Kuʒi bapa e afehec sâc mocjaha ekopirec me, irec wiac bâfuakicnezi bâbâfua‐ticne ʒiŋuc sâcne âzâcneocmu: “Goki mi bâfuacnumeŋ?” Me kuʒi wiaczi wemocko kuʒi bapare ʒiŋuc muocmu: “E giere fuŋne mi manakac?”
Manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ bembeŋne mac fokac i tarame Lebanoŋ jâckâtezi hawarine hetikierâ jufu gie eocmu, â jufu gie fokac izi ine jâckâte eocmu.
Dameŋ ira qepoŋ jaŋe papiao dâŋ qâreŋkekicne fokac i mananiŋmu â tiŋtuŋ jaŋe dapâc qisiric fimârâŋkehuc wiac hone manac eniŋmu.
Eme maŋhuhuŋ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe Wofuŋte bubiaŋ mocwâc mananiŋmu â ŋic qarâ suriŋne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe Israere Tiri rune ere ʒeri bari eniŋmu.
Bâbâʒâic ŋic jaŋe arictac eniŋmu â ŋic âke sisicne jaŋe omaeniŋmu, erâ sindaŋ eniŋte maŋjeŋic domaekac jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârezo hâcne.
Sawadâŋte erâ ŋic sâqocne bapa mucjopaeŋgopieŋ, â mumutara ŋic e motâcko gie‐ticne bahuc juhame dâŋzi bitiŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ, erâ ŋic bahacmâc jaŋere dâŋ fuŋne tâmiricko muhasickeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne iŋuc fua‐jareocmu.
Irec Wofuŋ e mârâc jaha Abraham firueweczi Jakobore kikefuŋ jaŋere ʒiŋuc muwec: “Jakobore kikefuŋ jaŋe mocwâc mi qurutuanʒepieŋ â ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋiczi mocwâc mi weaŋkezejec.
Aricne, jaŋe ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko menanere maqâreŋ, ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic hâcne honec‐joparâ ʒâŋe‐nane tiri foocte ʒoɋac eniŋmu, ehuc Jakobore Tiri rune nore manapie fejâmbâŋkeha Israere Anutu no araŋ banareniŋmu.
Eme maŋjeŋic sifuckeekac jaŋe mamana biaŋ fua‐jareocmu, â mu kâroŋ eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe dâŋ jaza qazuc epie mananiŋmu.”
Wofuŋzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukac: “Jei, naru motec maŋrâŋgeŋhec ŋoŋe dâŋ manasu biric eeŋgopieŋ i nore mamana biri aricne, ehuc no mi mana‐ŋarehape ʒâʒâfic eeŋgopieŋ; ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc sâqocne fainezi faine bahuc jueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe no mi wio‐narehuc Aigita mâreŋko huzo eŋgopieŋ, ira Faraore tâpirio roweckeniŋte â Aigita mâreŋte mumucko soŋkeniŋte.
Irec Faraore tâpirizi ŋerisierâ mimi qaqa eŋarezejec, â Aigita mâreŋte mumucko sosoŋke izi wâc ŋerisierâ mimi busâqoc bâfua‐ŋarezejec.
Fekicnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe Zoaŋ haeo humbiŋ â sorec‐jopakicnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe Hanesi haeo fifisi i sâcne fisimbiŋ;
erâ ine ŋicguru i jaŋerao bafic moc mi bâfuahuc mâc qurutua‐fâreniŋmu, kime dopec mi eŋarehapie mimi busâqoc â mu âke sisic sawa fua‐ŋareocmu hâcne.”
Negebe mâreŋte qowi mimicne irec okac dâŋ: Laioŋ ŋicne â ŋokacne, qotâ â oâ furuc furuc qaqane juŋgopieŋko, ʒâic serereŋ â hâhâwic mâreŋ hâcne, ira mafa wiac‐jeŋic doŋgi faio, â moneŋ boreŋ‐jeŋic kamele faio râerâ baraŋgopieŋ, i ŋicguru sâcne mi babafic‐jopane jaŋerao hâcne.
Aigita ŋic jaŋere bafic i racne â fâri tâmiric. No irec hâcne ʒâŋe‐jeŋic ʒiŋuc mupo: “Jaŋe pepec penaroŋheczi mâc fâsâerâ ŋeŋgopieŋ.”
Go ine ʒiŋuczia rarâ dâŋ i ʒâŋe fai‐jeŋicko tafeo râec, erâ papia qizecne moc ira wâc qâreŋkec, eme dameŋ mocte mumutaniŋ dâŋ fohuc juzejec sanaŋ.
Jaŋe ŋicguru maŋrâŋgeŋhec â naru motec kekeporicne hâcne, jaŋe Wofuŋte mumutâc dâŋ mananiŋte mi ejareekac.
Jaŋe findaŋdâŋ mumuŋic ʒiŋuc jazaeŋgopieŋ: “Ŋoŋe findaŋdâŋ mi munʒepieŋ!” Â porofete ʒiŋuc jazaeŋgopieŋ: “Ŋoŋe dâŋ fârine aricne, bâbâmiriŋ dâŋ hazecte nâpene sawa nâzânʒepieŋ.
Hata sanaŋ beheniŋ â hata fâretiŋ râpeckeniŋ, ehuc Israere Tiri rune ere dâŋ mocwâc mi mupie mananʒepeneŋ.”
Irec hâcne Israere Tiri runezi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋoŋe dâŋ ʒi qikiŋnerâ hata hehesicne â sisifucnere manapie biaŋkeha ira âte raeŋgopieŋ.
Irec kiŋŋeŋiczi ficsâko moc wâtuŋne gâreckekicne ututuŋ hericke ʒaŋ erâ rândiŋkeocmu irec sâc eŋareocmu.
Me ŋic moczi manabâc mi ehuc kuʒi moc hefâc qâfâuckeme dâkâne piic piic eocmu, eme dâkâne izi me izi ʒafeonec ʒoc uuc roro me nombâŋkonec opâ fifia irec sâc mi eocmu, ŋoŋe irec sâc hâcne henʒaŋ‐ŋopazo.”
Wofuŋ Anutu, Israere Tiri rune e kecʒiŋuc muwec hâcne: “Ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic bârisierâ niniŋkepie bafic‐ŋopazo; niniŋkerâ norao roweckehuc juju izi tâpiri‐ŋeŋic eocmu.” Ŋoŋe ine takic‐ŋopame mumbiŋ:
“Aricne, nâŋe becâsic faio gasackerâ ranʒepeneŋ!” Irec sâcne gasackerâ ratâmireniŋ; erâ moc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Becâsic gagasac sâkohec jaŋere faio ranʒepeneŋ,” irec jâpec‐ŋopaniŋmuzi gasackehuc siric‐ŋopanʒepieŋ.
Ŋic wâŋ tauseŋ jaŋe ŋic mocjahazi aŋara heme wiseniŋmu, ŋoŋe ine ŋic 5 jaŋe aŋara hepie manahuc wise tâmirepie ʒanʒaŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe tiki botâŋko jâmâ moc domakac me mâreŋ facnao wâtuŋzi ma domakac irec sâc afecne sawa domaniŋmu.
Irec Wofuŋ e aki anonoc eŋareocte woŋec jukac, e ŋoŋere busâqoc manaocte afeckekac, Wofuŋ e mumutiŋ Anutu hâcne; irec ere woŋec jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac.
O Zioŋ ŋic ŋokac, Jerusalem haeo ŋeŋe juju eeŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe mocwâc mi kionʒepieŋ; Wofuŋ e jâmbomac wira wâwâsic‐ŋeŋicte busâqoc mana‐ŋareocmu, e manarâ izia bafic‐ŋopaocmu.
Erâ Wofuŋ e fific guguriŋte â ʒârâ hâriŋte nânâ opâ gumec‐ŋopaocmu; eme qaqazu‐ŋeŋiczi sifu mocwâc mi soŋkeha ʒâŋe‐ŋeŋiczi e honehuc juniŋmu.
Ehuc fâreopec me qanaopec razo epie râpefuŋ‐ŋeŋicko dâŋ ʒiŋuc fuame hazec‐ŋeŋiczi mananiŋmu: “Hata ʒi fokac, ira raniŋ!”
Eme ŋoŋe nemu hawari â ɋâŋ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋic siliwa â golzi foŋkekicne irec manapie wiac wâwânâŋnehec eocmu; erâ wiac mamakâcne muhuc hetâtierâ ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Ratâmirec!”
Eme mâreŋko wiac sara mama ecmu i Wofuŋzi mume hoezi bâgunuckeocmu eme gieo wiac nânâne fuaocmu i mâriri â wokemaŋnehec sasawa. Ehame lama bulimakaofâcge jaŋe dameŋ ira mâreŋ qaratiekicnao kecɋaŋ nâhuc juniŋmu.
Erâ bulimakao ŋicne â doŋgi mâreŋ bâbâfâuc gie baniŋmu jaŋe ine kecɋaŋ sapac â saraczi hec hetikic ehuc hâwechec bâsifuckekicne i hâcne nânʒepieŋ.
Eme ʒika sâko fuame ficsanaŋ waha qanʒaŋneocmu dameŋ ira tiki ʒorao â mâreŋ facnao sasawa opâ piticne â kâcɋene fuarâ foocmu.
Ehame mosare tatamac i ʒoaŋte tatamac iŋucne eocmu, â ʒoaŋte tatamaczi fehuc ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 irec tatamacte sâc eocmu. Wofuŋ e ŋicfâc‐ticne ʒikao ʒâpâ jopakicne jaŋe ʒure foŋ ejarehuc ʒika‐ticnere micrâfâc bâsomie‐jareocmu dameŋ ira iŋuc hâcne fuaocmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ e jahac ʒorickonec ware fisikac, ehame kimbeŋ‐ticne bâruŋkekac â bu ʒaʒamaŋ‐ticne fâuckekac micbipic‐ticnao kimbeŋ fusucmarâ fokac â nameŋ‐ticne i ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne wiac ʒa ʒâtâc eene irec sâc.
Micrombâŋ‐ticne i opâzi rumi fisiha ŋic jaŋe âtepie upe‐jeŋicko qaekac irec sâc, i ŋicne ŋicne sisipiricte sajazi wosâec‐jopaocte; erâ ŋic gurune gurune qac qâsoric eere micko kiki râe‐jareocte fisikac hâcne.
Eme ŋoŋe hombaŋ ŋehuc ŋafeo gae heeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha gae heniŋmu, â ŋiczi Israere qânâ sanaŋ, Wofuŋte tiki hâcne, ira mimi ŋokac ficnehuc raeŋgopieŋ, irec sâc jaha maŋzi ʒeri bari eniŋmu.
Eme Wofuŋ marac fânâŋ‐ticne qeŋ bipinehec fuame mananiŋmu, â meticne i kimbeŋ wânʒâŋnehec â ʒocbâruŋ ʒa ʒâtâc eene iŋucne â mâŋâŋ hâhâwicne â hoe micsâko â hoe sanaŋ aisihec irec maŋnao wahame honeniŋmu.
Eme Wofuŋ e ɋaruc‐ticnezi Asiria ŋic jopame marac fânâŋ‐ticnere ɋarac ɋarac qaniŋmu.
Eme ʒiŋuc fuaocmu: Wofuŋ e bâbâtiŋ ɋaruc‐ticnezi jopaocmu sâc woŋgâŋ dâŋeha â kulele fânâŋkeha mene bâfeŋnerâ fotariehuc jopaocmu hâcne.
Ʒoc ʒaza nombâŋ i mârâc jaha ro bâmoc ekicne, ehuc ŋicwofuŋte manasuhuc ʒoricne â kâcɋene rokicne wâc; maŋnao ʒocfiki bakicne i hâhâwicne, eme Wofuŋte micrombâŋzi paura sâqocne rikepene bâruŋkeekac irec sâc ficneme bâruŋkeocmu.
Jei, Aigita ŋic jaŋe bafic‐jopaniŋte jaŋerao hueŋgopieŋ, jaŋe becâsic â ʒika keretac bocjahare manapie feha becâsicko rara ŋic sasanaŋ‐jeŋicte erâ jaŋerao roweckeeŋgopieŋ, ehuc Israere Tiri rune erao ʒâŋe mi fieŋgopieŋ â Wofuŋ wira basac mi ecneeŋgopieŋ!
Eki ine maŋɋârâŋhec juhuc mume sisipiric fuaekac, e dâŋticne fâri tâmiric eocte moc mi muekac; aricne, e sâqocne bapa guru â ŋic sindaŋne bafic‐jopaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc râsi ejareocmu.
Aigita ŋic jaŋe Anutu mâcne, jaŋe ŋic sawa, â becâsicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mâro aricne, jaŋe soc biuc sawa. Wofuŋ e meticne sicneme Israe ŋic bafic‐jopaeŋgopieŋzi biric boroc eniŋmu â bafic‐jopakicne jaŋe rândiŋkeniŋmu, jaŋe mâmâc jaha hâmo sipiric eniŋmu hâcne.
Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc nazawec hâcne: Laioŋ kâcɋene me piticne moc e qowi‐ticne sakarehuc ŋuruŋneha lama soŋaŋ guru sâko tumaŋnehuc orâŋkepie ojowa‐jeŋicte mi fâfâreocmu â fânâŋ‐jeŋicte mi hâwickeocmu irec sâc Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi Zioŋ tiki botâŋnao ʒika qaocte wahaocmu.
Wipe jaŋe furuc furuc qahuc motecfâc‐jeŋic ŋezic‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, irec sâc jaha Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi Jerusalem ŋezickeocmu, ŋezickehuc bataraocmu, â akickehuc bafickeocmu.
O Israere ŋicfâc, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ râpeckerâ behe sanaŋkembiŋzi erao mocwâc risieniŋ!
Manaŋgopieŋ, meŋeŋiczi nemuɋâŋ siliwa â golzi bahuctecne sâqocne bâfuambiŋ i dameŋ ira ʒeŋgoma qikiŋne behec eniŋmu.
“Eme Asiria ŋic jaŋe ʒika kiniŋmu i ŋic ʒika aricne, â ʒikazi nâcjopaocmu i mâreŋ ŋic jaŋere ʒika aricne, jaŋe ʒikare hâhâwicte wiseniŋmu â ŋicmotecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe kâpâcwâru giere biŋe eniŋmu.
Fekicne‐jeŋiczi hâhâwicte erâ omaeocmu â micnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe maŋjeŋic gâckeme filac beheniŋmu,” Zioŋko ʒocticne ʒahuc fokac â Jerusalemko ʒafe‐ticne ŋekac, Wofuŋ ere dâŋ iŋuc.
Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋicwofuŋ moc fuarâ tiŋne jujure hata bâjâpehuc guriŋ bapa gie baocmu â fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe soŋaŋ gie‐jeŋic mumutiŋ dâŋte sâcko bahuc juniŋmu.
Jaŋe sasawa jâcdapeŋ iŋucne, ŋiczi mâŋâŋte erâ ira soŋkeeŋgopeneŋ; jaŋe hoe micsâko heme qânâuŋzi ŋic sâoc‐nâpoekac irec sâc; jaŋe mâreŋ burocnao opâ fifisine iŋucne â mâreŋ fâronao haroŋaŋ sâko irec mumuc iŋuc efâreniŋmu.
Ehame ʒâŋe fifi jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒâŋe mi hâmonʒaniŋmu â hazeczi mamana jaŋe hazec hâric mananiŋmu.
Fâro faio wiac kosa eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe maŋ mamanasuhec eniŋmu, â dâŋ fâcke turuŋ ehuc mueŋgopieŋ jaŋere nameŋzi afeckeme dâŋ ɋicɋâc jaha musarickeniŋmu.
Eme ŋic sindaŋne e “fekicne” mocwâc mi mucnezo, erâ ŋic hehesicne ere manapene ŋic biaŋne mocwâc mi eocmu.
Ŋic sindaŋne e ʒaucbac dâŋ muocmu â maŋticnezi sâqocnere mamana gie bahuc sindaŋ hârindaŋ eocmu erâ Wofuŋte dâŋ musifuckeocmu, ehuc nânâ opâre hâmoeŋgopieŋ jaŋe nânâ opâ sakare‐jareocmu.
Ŋic sâqocne ere mamana i sâqocne jaha, irec ŋic qarâ suriŋne jaŋe burecdâŋzi imac‐jopaocte mamana gie baekac, ehuc ŋic hapetac e dâŋgieo dâŋticnere sanaŋkeme sifu burecdâŋzi imackeocmu.
Ŋic biaŋne e wiac biaŋnere manatâc qâtâc eekac, ehuc wiac biaŋne ebac eocte sanaŋkerâ domaekac.
Ajoc, ŋokac manabâc tâmiric jueŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe marac fânâŋ‐nane mananiŋ! Naru ŋokac ŋaŋacnere manapie fâsâekac ŋoŋe dâŋnanere hazec râeniŋ!
Oi, manabâc tâmiric ŋoŋe, jara moc tarame maŋŋeŋiczi hâhâŋkeocmu, manaŋgopieŋ, waiŋ fârine roro dameŋ i ŋowaruocmu, â jâchândâŋ roro dameŋ i wâc mi fuaocmu.
Manabâc tâmiric jueŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe hâwic‐ŋopaha ɋarac ɋarac qanʒepieŋ, â ŋaŋacnere manapie feekac ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋiczi hâhâŋkezejec; ŋaqi wiac hetara‐fârerâ mateŋ qonaŋkenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe buŋeŋic bofackehuc jufu gie biaŋne â waiŋ qizec fâri rarau irec ki mamakuc eniŋ!
Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere gieo fâpâ uupic â qinʒiŋ sanaŋ wefukac, erâ hae sâkoo ficne ficne ʒeri bubiaŋ omaeocmu irec mâmâc kioniŋ!
Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋicwofuŋ fic i behepie fictac ŋeocmu â hae maŋnao ojowa fokac i omaeme niniŋ siarereŋ fuaocmu, ficsanaŋ â ficʒora hâŋ bafekicne izi qânâ hawec iŋucne erâ foocmu sanaŋ, ehame kâte doŋgi jaŋe bubiaŋ manahuc maŋnao ju fofo eniŋmu â qinʒiŋ fuame lama bulimakao jaŋe nâhuc juniŋmu.
Iŋuc fokuhame sambâŋkonec Mârozi fai‐nâŋecko wahaocmu, eme mâreŋ burocnezi ŋerisierâ guecnehec eocmu â mâreŋ guecnehecte manapie kâte mâreŋ biaŋ eocmu.
Ehame mâreŋ burocnao mumutiŋ dâŋ fuaocmu â tiŋne juju i mâreŋ guecnao ira foocmu.
Eme tiŋne jujuzi wama bâfuaocmu â tiŋne jujure fârine jujumana â wamao juju fuarâ foocmu sanaŋ.
Eme ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe fic hae biaŋnao ŋehuc jujumana mâreŋko hâhâwic tâmiric juniŋmu.
Hoe sanaŋzi jâckâte sipiricke‐fâreocmu, â hae sâko e waha qaqane jâmbâŋ eocmu.
Opâ sasawa irec heririŋnao gie he sarac eniŋmu, erâ bulimakao â doŋgifâc‐ŋeŋic ejarepie aka tâmiric rac warec eniŋmu ŋoŋere manape ʒerine ekac.
Jei, sisipiric ŋic go, gahacne mi sipiricgukicne! Jei, gâcne jaŋere wiac kâŋgâc jowac rohaŋtec gahacne wiac moc mi gowac rombiŋ. Go sisipiric gie batec tarame gahacne sipiricguzo wâc, â gâcne jaŋere wiac kâŋgâc jowac rofâretec tarame gahacne wiac i gowac rozo wâc.
O Wofuŋ, go nâŋere busâqoc manac, nâŋe gore mamanac juŋgopeneŋ, go furic sâc mesanaŋgezi bacnâpo juhuc ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋko babafic‐nâŋec juzemec.
Ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe fânâŋ sâkore wiseniŋmu, â go gahacne faharetec ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe tâtieniŋmu.
Ɋirikiŋzi monʒaŋ nâfâreekac irec sâc mafa mateŋ‐ŋeŋic ŋowac ropie omaeocmu, â ɋirikiŋ motecnezi gasackeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc gasackerâ ro rauc eniŋmu.
Wofuŋ e fekicne jâmbâŋ, e faic fejâmbâŋkerâ jukac hâcne; eki mume mumutiŋ dâŋ â tiŋne juju izi Zioŋ hae sâcke‐fârerâ foocmu.
Eme eki juju dameŋgere hobeteŋne eocmu, ehame bâbâpiaŋ â maŋɋârâŋ â mamana tara tahacgume ɋâfoŋne fogareocmu; Wofuŋ araŋ babacne izi Zioŋ ʒeŋaŋ‐ticne eocmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋic qac momori jaŋe hae ʒoŋao kio huse eŋgopieŋ, â wamare biŋe mumu jaŋe ki kâcɋene kioŋgopieŋ.
Hata sâkozi niniŋ siarereŋ fokac â ŋiczi hata rac warec ee i omaewec. Ʒâʒâfic hetâcnekicne, â mumutaniŋ ŋic qaisoc‐jopakicne, erâ ŋicte manapie wawahane eekac.
Mâreŋ hawarine i mamakucne ekac, Lebanoŋ tiki e mimierâ hâmo qanʒaraŋ ekac; Saroŋ wâneŋ e mâreŋ burocne iŋucne erâ Basaŋ mâreŋ â Karamele tiki jahe jâc garaŋ garaŋ iŋucne.
Wofuŋzi ine mukac: “No ʒi qâhâŋnerâ fahare hâŋ ferâ fekicne domapemu hâcne.
Ŋoŋe jacgoŋ dopâne hâmo kereŋ ekicne kiweckerâ jawane roniŋmu; nokafe‐ŋeŋiczi ʒoc iŋucne erâ ŋoŋe ŋaŋacne ʒâseŋ‐ŋopaocmu.
Eme ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe ʒacjopa‐fâreme huc iŋucne eniŋmu, fâpâ uupic hetâcnekicne iŋucne ʒocko ʒatâmirec‐jopaocmu.”
Taicko juraŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe wiac ebac epo i mananiŋ â bembeŋko juŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe tâpiri‐nane ʒâŋitaniŋ!
Zioŋ haeo sâqocne bapazi fâfâreŋgopieŋ â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ɋarac ɋarac qahuc ʒiŋuc mu wioc eŋgopieŋ: “Mozi ʒoc ʒa ʒâtâc eene irec maŋfuŋko sâcne ŋeocmu? Mozi ʒocmimiŋ fofo sanaŋko ŋec juc eocmu?”
Moc e tiŋne juhuc dâŋ fârine muocmu me moc e ŋic jâiŋ‐jopahuc moneŋ mafa huhure i qaisockeocmu, me bâbâmiriŋ moneŋ rozacte meticne soŋaŋkeocmu, me ʒikare saŋuczi hazecnao huzacte hazec‐ticne bâbâzickeocmu, me wiac sâqocne honebâckezacte ʒâŋe‐ticne bâsoŋkeocmu,
ŋic eki hâcne faic tikitoŋko ŋec juc eocmu, ehame qânâuŋzi ficsanaŋ‐ticne eocmu; nânâ poroŋ‐ticne râcnekicnere mi basaocmu â opâ‐ticne mi ʒickeocmu.
Ʒâŋegezi ŋicwofuŋ hawari biaŋ‐ticnehec honecmu, ehuc ʒâŋe fitec rame mâreŋ moc qaratiekicne fokac i mâmâc ʒâŋitacmu.
Maŋ mamanasuge i wiac hâhâwicnere manatâc qâtâc ekac, ine ʒiŋuc: “Moneŋ wose biric ewec e weni? Takesi moneŋ sigelio râewec e weni? Ficʒora hâŋ bafekicne wose qâreŋ ewec e weni?”
Ŋicguru repicne marac buŋbuŋ sâkohecte dâŋjeŋic mi mamanane â dâŋ mu ŋâtâŋ epie mi taniŋkeekac jaŋe hâcne mocwâc mi honec‐jopacmu.
Zioŋ hae, tutumaŋ wiac‐nâŋecte hae sanaŋ honec! Ʒâŋegezi Jerusalem hae i jujumana hae â qoruc boze ŋeŋe sanaŋ iŋucne ŋeha honecmu; fâzâ‐ticne i mocwâc mi unuckeniŋmu â repa‐ticne sasawa i mocwâc mi tâcneocmu.
Wofuŋ e ine ira ɋuŋɋasaŋ‐ticnehec erâ opâ â opâ sâko irec okacne junâreocmu, ehame opâ irec faio woke piticne â kâcɋene jaŋe rac warec mi eniŋmu.
Wofuŋ e dâŋ mumutara‐nâŋec, Wofuŋ e guriŋ bapa‐nâŋec, Wofuŋ e Femicne‐nâŋec, eki hâcne nâŋâc bafic‐nâpoocmu.
Repa wiacge ŋeŋgoroŋkeha jâmâ qiŋ herâ mi domaocmu â rac mi fâretiŋkeocmu. Eme mafa mateŋ bocjaha kâdoc babac eniŋmu, ehame kike demba jaŋe mafa mateŋ ro sakac eniŋmu wâc.
Eme haeru moczi ʒiŋuc moc mi muocmu: “No huc bacnukac.” Ŋic ŋokac ira ŋec juc eniŋmu jaŋe sâqocne‐jeŋic bâtâmire‐jarekicne.
Ŋicne ŋicne ŋoŋe ware mananiŋ, â ŋic gurune gurune ŋoŋe hazec râeniŋ! Mâreŋ â mâreŋte faio wiac fusucmarâ fokac, erâ mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ â ŋecjucfâc‐ticne ŋoŋe sasawa mana‐fâreniŋ.
Wofuŋ e ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe aaric mana‐jarekac â kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒoc i momorifâc‐jeŋic bâruŋke‐jarekac, e sisipiricte biŋe mujarehuc ʒikare nânâ eniŋte qikiŋ‐jopawec hâcne.
Eme qâhâmoc‐jopakicnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mâc behec‐jopapie foraniŋmu, ehuc qâŋɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic âsu fihuc foniŋmu; ehame socjeŋiczi tiki rua‐jareme urueniŋmu.
Sambâŋko bâpiŋ gurune gurune ŋeraŋgopieŋ jaŋe sirowe‐fâreniŋmu, â sambâŋ e papia bataforieeŋgopieŋ iŋuc foforieocmu; eme gurufâc‐ticne jaŋe waiŋ rehacne me jâmbojâc rehacne ɋaŋa ururuc erâ mârâŋkeekac irec sâc mârâŋkerâ wahaniŋmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, ʒika‐nanezi sambâŋko kimbeŋ nâ gapec erâ waha Edomko okac babazu gie baocmu, ŋicguru sisipiricte biŋe râec‐jopapo jaŋerao hâcne.
Wofuŋte ʒika i soc â wokemaŋhec sasawa, lama â noniŋ irec soc erâ lama ŋicne râpe hândâŋne irec wokemaŋ hâcne. Wofuŋ e Bozera hae ira taha bâzi gie â Edom mâreŋko qa hezuc ee sâko bâfuaocmu.
Kâte bulimakaozi bulimakao biuc sâko jaŋehec hâmoniŋmu, â bulimakao ŋicnezi motecne jaŋe ŋicne tâpiri sâko jaŋehec sipirickeniŋmu. Eme soczi hae mâreŋ‐jeŋic isirickeocmu â mâreŋ i wokemaŋhec sasawa foocmu.
Wofuŋte okac babazu dameŋ maickeocmu. Zioŋ kikefuŋ râsi ejarembiŋ jaŋere okac babazu jara dameŋ hâcne.
Eme Edomte opâ jaŋe ŋerisierâ waha kufaŋ sâŋiŋ eniŋmu â mâreŋ‐ticnezi ŋerisierâ paura sâqocne eocmu; mâreŋ‐ticnezi kufaŋ sâŋiŋ erâ bâruŋkeocmu.
Ehuc ŋafeo mecne ʒoaŋko mecne mi hâhâpo, hosâcne ŋezume ŋezu fehuc domaocmu sanaŋ. Mâreŋ i mimiŋzi ɋâric ima bakicne jaha foocmu, ehame ŋic moczi ira sicne fotâc moc mi eocmu hâcne.
Gafu hâro â homa jaŋe rauckeniŋmu, erâ ŋafe wipe â kâec kâec jaŋe ira ŋec foc eniŋmu. Ehame Wofuŋzi ima baocte sâcmeda fâreocmu â niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ foocte ma baocmu.
Zioŋ fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ juju fuaocte mocwâc mi muniŋmu, erâ micnefâc‐ticne jaŋe ʒeŋgoma omaeniŋmu.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ ficko fâpâ uupic fuarâ foocmu â ficsanaŋ ira ʒâŋ opac fuame kâte qâto â qera jaŋere ŋeŋe hae eocmu.
Eme ŋifec qowi mimicne â kâte qâto â ŋifec ine kâpâ jaŋe âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec bâbâfuac eniŋmu, erâ ŋafere demoŋzi ira ŋeŋemana hae‐ticne bâfuaocmu.
Qotâ e jâc semunao juju fofo ehuc hândâŋ râerâ fomackekume âteʒuocmu; erâ tucwipe jaŋere hozi ira fuaocmu wâc, ehame moczi moc âgone moc mi basaocmu.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋte papiao dâŋ ʒiŋuc fokac i wose gufuc erâ mananʒepieŋ: Jaŋeraonec moc mi basazo, moczi âgo tâmiric moc mi juocmu. Wofuŋte mickonec mumupaŋ dâŋ iŋuc hâcne wahawec â Mâro‐ticnezi hetumaŋ‐jopawec.
Eme e jahac mâreŋ bâtâc bajareocte qaŋgec qawec, ehuc meticnezi sâcmeda fârehuc kâdoc qajarewec; eme jaŋe irec rune erâ jusanaŋkenʒepieŋ, â mimiŋzi ɋâric maŋnao ŋec juc ehuc juranʒepieŋ.
Tuhu mâreŋ â mâreŋ burocne jahe kiwac qawac ezepirec â mâreŋ sawa i ʒeri ezejec, ehuc faroqac iŋucne âri qazejec.
