Ârine mâretec fuame ʒeri bari ehuc gae hezejec. Lebanoŋte ʒâŋe rara erâ Karamele tiki â Saroŋ wâneŋte eri qaraweŋ fuacnezejec. Jaŋe Wofuŋte ʒâŋe rara â Anutu‐nâŋecte eri qaraweŋ honenʒepieŋ.
Mejeŋic betaŋkekicne â dieŋ‐jeŋic sâqorekicne jaŋe dopec‐jopahuc basanaŋ‐jopapie qiŋ herâ domanʒepieŋ.
Ehuc maŋjeŋic gâckekicne jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazaniŋ: “Ŋoŋe hâbi‐ŋeŋic hepie hume hâhâwic tâmiric junʒepieŋ. Manaŋgopieŋ, Anutu‐ŋeŋic e jukac! E okac babazu gie baocte fisiocmu; Anutu ŋic okacne jareekac e hâcne ware bafic‐ŋopaocmu.”
Iŋuc fuame tiŋtuŋ jaŋe ʒâŋe fifi eniŋmu â qepoŋ jaŋe hazec‐jeŋic uŋtoocmu.
Puriŋ jaŋe kâte bulimakao iŋucne gasackeniŋmu â nâŋguŋ jaŋe nameŋ‐jeŋic forisieme ʒeri gae heniŋmu. Manaŋgopieŋ, mâreŋ burocnao opâ ʒâŋene â mâreŋ sawao opâ sâko fuarâ foraocmu.
Ehame dameŋ juwicnao mâreŋ opâ tâmiric fowec ira riqic fuarâ foocmu â kereŋke hahaŋ ekicnao opâ ʒâŋene wefuocmu. Mârâc kâte qâto jaŋe juju fofo embiŋ ira sohoŋ fuaocmu â sopâc irec okacne saparac â ʒamac ʒamac wefuocmu.
Eme ira hata sâko hewâneŋkekicne moc fuame ʒâŋene “Tiri Hata” muzo. Ŋic hehesicne jaŋe ira moc mi âtehuc juhapie ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere biŋe sawa foocmu. Ehame jaŋe ira rahapie ŋic mutucnezi kosa rac warec mi enʒepieŋ.
Laioŋ jaŋe ira moc mi juniŋmu â qowi mimicnezi wâc mi âteniŋmu, jaŋe ira basac‐jopazo; ehame batarac‐jopakicne jaŋe ine ira rahuc juniŋmu.
Â Wofuŋzi rambaŋko râec‐jopawec jaŋe ira risieniŋmu, erâ Zioŋko fisirâ aŋara heniŋmu; ehame bubiaŋ fofo sanaŋzi fua‐jareocmu, ʒeri â bubiaŋ fua‐jareme busâqoc â kio husezi omaeocmu.
Hisikia e ŋicwofuŋ juha jara 14 eme Asiria ŋicwofuŋ Sanheribe eki râsi fisirâ Judare hae basanaŋkekicne sasawa ro rauc ewec.
Erâ Asiria ŋicwofuŋ e Lakisi haeo ŋehuc Rabasake â momori bocjaha Hisikiarao sorec‐jopame Jerusalem haeo rambiŋ. Eme micne e faicpec riqicte opâwâc qoruc qaqajac ŋic ere mâreŋ heririŋnao hata sâko fokac ira ra domawec.
Domahame ŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋe erao rambiŋ: Ŋicwofuŋ ficte micne sâko Eliakim, Hilikiare ŋokâ hâcne, â qâqâreŋ ŋic Sebena erâ Asafare ŋokâ Joa micne sâko‐jeŋic hâcne.
Eme Rabasakezi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Hisikia âzâcneniŋ, ŋicwofuŋ sâko, Asiria ŋicwofuŋ hâcne, e ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Ʒi wemo wiaczi dapeŋ egareha roweckehuc juekic?
Go manatec dâŋ sawazi ʒikare mamana â tâpiri bâfuaocmu ekac me? Go morao roweckehuc no râpecnumeŋ?
Ojai, go kâcbiŋ gunu herickekicne keci, Aigita hâcne, erao roweckekomec; eme gunu ira roweckeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mejeŋic âke mârâŋkeekac i. Eme Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Farao e ŋic sasawa erao roweckeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe iŋuc hâcne ejareekac.
Go ʒiŋuc mecne nazacmu, “Nâŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec erao roweckeeŋgopeneŋ.” Hâc, eme weniŋuc? Hisikia e furu mâreŋ â Wofuŋ taha babacnere alata wiac ŋerawec i bârâriehuc Juda â Jerusalem ŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec, “Ŋoŋe alata kecʒirec maŋfuŋko sawa dapehuc numunʒepieŋ,” Wofuŋ Anutu ere mukomec me?
Ajoc, bomboŋ‐nane, Asiria ŋicwofuŋ hâcne, ehec fuŋne babataniŋ gie banic me! Eme honenaŋ: No becâsic 2 tauseŋ garepemu, goki ine becâsicko rara ŋic irec sâc jaha sâcne bâfuac‐jopacmu me weniŋuc?
I eipiehuc ine wemocko bomboŋ‐nanere kiŋaŋŋic wawahane jaŋeraonec momori micne mocjaha mac sâcne jâpetec risieocmu? Eme go iŋucnezi ine keretac â ŋic becâsicko rarare Aigita jaŋerao ʒâŋe fihuc juekic!
Me weniŋuc? No Wofuŋzi mi mana‐nareha mâreŋ ʒi râsi ecnehuc ima qapemurâ wefupo me? Aricne, Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc nazawec: Go ferâ mâreŋ keci râsi ecnehuc ima qazemec!’”
Eme Eliakim â Sebena â Joa jaŋe Rabasake ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Kiŋaŋŋicfâcge nâŋe Aramaio dâŋko dâŋ nâzâzemec, nâŋe dâŋ i sâcne manaŋgopeneŋ; ŋic ŋokac qânâsacko ŋeŋgopieŋ jaŋere maio nâŋehec Hebiraio dâŋko muc manac mi ezemec.”
Rabasakezi ine muwec: “Hâc, dâŋ bajukopac i bomboŋ‐nanezi ŋoŋe â bomboŋ‐ŋeŋic ŋoŋe sawa ŋazapemurâ sorecnuwec me? Aricne, e ŋic qânâsacko ŋeŋgopieŋ â ŋoŋehec mâmâc ho fâzi‐ŋeŋic nâniŋte mukicne jaŋerao mâmâc mupemurâ sorecnuwec.”
Rabasakezi iŋuc murâ ra mai domahuc Hebiraio dâŋko hahaŋne bahuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋicwofuŋ sâko, Asiria ŋicwofuŋ hâcne, ere dâŋ mananiŋ! Eki ʒiŋuc mukac:
‘Ŋoŋe Hisikia manacnepie mi eatuc‐ŋopazejec, e nore meonec batarac‐ŋopaocte tâpiri mi focnekac.
Erâ ʒiŋuc muhuc Wofuŋtao roweckeniŋte ŋazame mi mananʒepieŋ wâc: “Wofuŋ e jâmbomac batarac‐nâpoocmu, ehuc hae sâko ʒi Asiria ŋicwofuŋte meo feocte mi manaocmu.”
Asiria ŋicwofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukacte Hisikia dâŋticne mi mananʒepieŋ: Ŋoŋe nohec wama babac erâ haeonec wahanʒepieŋ; iŋuc erâ ŋoŋe sasawa ŋaŋacne waiŋ â nemuja nâhuc junʒepieŋ, erâ opâ i ŋaŋacne nombâŋkonec fiarâ nâhuc junʒepieŋ wâc.
Iŋuc ehuc juhapie noni fâ fisirâ mâreŋ mocko jowac‐ŋopa rapemu, mâreŋ i ŋaŋacne mâreŋ iŋucne, ira padi mecne, waiŋ mecne, nânâ mecne â waiŋ gie mecne forakac hâcne.
Hisikiazi ʒiŋuc muhuc maŋ bâsifuc mi eŋarezejec: “Wofuŋzi batarac‐nâpoocmu.” Ŋicguru gâcne jaŋere nemuzi mâreŋ‐jeŋic Asiria ŋicwofuŋ ere meonec moc batarambiŋ me?
Hamati â Arapada hae jahere nemufâc weni? Sefarawaim haere nemu jaŋe weni? Â Samaria mâreŋte nemufâc jaŋe weni? Jaŋe Samaria nore meonec moc batarambiŋ me?
Me mâreŋ irec nemu sasawa jaŋeraonec mozi mâreŋ‐ticne nore meonec batarawecte Wofuŋzi Jerusalem hae nore meonec bataraocte muŋgopieŋ?’”
Jaŋe ine mâc fâsâerâ domahuc dâŋ moc mi bâtikiecnembiŋ, i ŋicwofuŋte dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc fowecte iŋuc embiŋ: “Ŋoŋe dâŋ moc mi bâtikiecnenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Hilikiare ŋokâ Eliakim, ŋicwofuŋ ficte micne juwec, e â qâreŋŋic Sebena erâ Asafare ŋokâ, micne sâko Joa hâcne, jaŋe ŋaqi‐jeŋic bâsuckerâ Hisikiarao risierâ Rabasakezi dâŋ muwec irec binaŋ bacnembiŋ.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Hisikia e dâŋ i manarâ ŋaqi‐ticne bâsuckerâ târuzi mateŋ heme hume Wofuŋte ufuŋko fewec.
Erâ ŋicwofuŋ ficte micne Eliakim â qâreŋŋic Sebena erâ taha bapa kâcɋene sasawa jaŋe wâc târuzi mateŋ hepie hume Amozire ŋokâ, porofete Jesaja hâcne, erao sorec‐jopame rambiŋ.
Rarâ âzâcnembiŋ: “Hisikiazi ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Ʒoaŋ ʒizi fuŋmoc, fific guguriŋ â bâbâtiŋ erâ miminehec, erâ naru motec fuazo ehapie ŋokac jaŋe rocjopaniŋte eipieŋgopieŋ irec sâc.
Rabasake e Anutu jujune musoriŋkeocte bomboŋ‐ticne, Asiria ŋicwofuŋ hâcne, eki soreme ware dâŋ muwec i Wofuŋ Anutugezi manawec mecne; manawecko mume okacne fuacnezejec. Irec go ŋic nâfocne juŋgopieŋ jaŋere erâ numuzemec.’”
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Hisikia kiŋaŋŋicfâcne jaŋe Jesajarao fisimbiŋ.
Fisipie Jesajazi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Bomboŋ‐ŋeŋic âzâcneniŋ, ‘Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Asiria ŋicwofuŋ kiŋaŋŋicfâcne jaŋe musoriŋnuhuc dâŋ mupie manameŋ irec mi hâwicguzejec.
Manakic, no maŋ bâsifuc ecnepemu eme sawadâŋ manarâ mâreŋ‐ticnao risiezejec, risieme mupe e jahacne mâreŋko ʒikare nânâ ezejec.’”
Asiria ŋicwofuŋzi Lakisi hae biac behewec, Rabasake e risiehuc dâŋ iŋuc manarâ ra Libina hae rune jaŋehec qaqac eha bâfuawec.
Asiria ŋicwofuŋ e Etiopia ŋicwofuŋ Tirihaka ere dâŋ biŋe ʒiŋuc manawec: “E gohec ʒika qaocte biac warehuc jukac.” Eme iŋuc manarâ Hisikiarao ʒiŋuc muhuc kiŋaŋ râec‐jopame rambiŋ:
“Ŋoŋe Juda ŋicwofuŋ Hisikia ʒiŋuc âzâcneniŋ: ‘Anutugezi mi eatucguzejec; go erao roweckehuc ʒiŋuc mukicte mukopac: Jerusalem haezi Asiria ŋicwofuŋ ere meo mi feocmu.
Manakic, Asiria ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe mâreŋ sâc wiac qacne gâpâcne ejarehuc sipiric‐jopambiŋ i go gahac biŋene manameŋ. Irec go wemocko sisipiriczi hetiricguocmu?
Me mamacfâc‐nane jaŋe ŋic gurune gurune bâsirowec‐jopambiŋ i jaŋere nemuzi moc bafic‐jopambiŋ me? Ine Goʒaŋ, Haraŋ, Rezefe â Edeŋ hae rune Telasa mâreŋko jumbiŋ jaŋere mukopac.
Me Hamati â Arapada â Sefarawaim â Hena â Iwa hae i jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe weni?’”
Eme Hisikia e kiŋaŋ fisimbiŋ jaŋere meonec papia rorâ wosehuc Wofuŋte ufuŋko ferâ Wofuŋte maio qaratiewec.
Qaratierâ ʒiŋuc muhuc Wofuŋ numucnewec:
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu, go kerubim jaŋere faicnao ŋehuc juekic, go mocjahazi mâreŋ ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere Anutu, goki hâcne sambâŋ â mâreŋ bâfuac‐jofameŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go hazec râerâ manac; o Wofuŋ, ʒâŋe firâ honec; erâ Sanheribezi Anutu jujune go musoriŋguocte dâŋ râeme warewec i mana‐fârezemec.
O Wofuŋ, Asiria ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe jâmbomac ŋicne ŋicne mâreŋ‐jeŋichec imac‐jopambiŋ.
Ehuc nemuɋâŋ qâqâtâcfâc‐jeŋic i ʒocko behec‐jopapie ʒacjopa‐fârewec; jaŋe nemu fârine aricne, jaŋe jâc â qânâ, ŋicmezi ba akic ekicne hâcne; irec bâsirowec‐jopaniŋte mi eipiembiŋ.
O Wofuŋ, Anutu‐nâŋec, ʒi ine ere meonec batarac‐nâpoc, eme mâreŋ ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe gore ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ: Wofuŋ e mocjahazi Anutu.”
Eme Jesaja, Amozire ŋokâ hâcne, e Hisikiarao dâŋ ʒiŋuc râeme rawec: “Wofuŋ Israere Anutu eki ʒiŋuc mukac: Go Asiria ŋicwofuŋ Sanheribe ere numu‐naremeŋ.
Eme irec Wofuŋzi ere dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ, Zioŋte otâ hâcne, e qaisocguhuc mu âke sisic egarekac, â Jerusalemte otâ eki râpefuŋgao gâwie‐garekac.
‘Go mo âke sisic ecnemeŋ â mo sâke itic ecnemeŋ? Go mo musoriŋkehuc penaroŋ ʒâŋe fitec fewec? Israere Tiri rune no hâcne iŋuc enaremeŋ!
Go kiŋaŋŋicfâcge jaŋere micko dâŋ râehuc Wofuŋ no musoriŋnumeŋ, ehuc mumeŋ, No keretac‐nane bocjahare tiki botâŋne fefârepo, erâ Lebanoŋ qaŋeŋnao fisipo. No jâmâzâc‐ticne ʒoricne ʒora â wetejâc‐ticne biaŋne i qafarapo; no tiki‐ticne ʒoricne ʒora fejâmbâŋkepo â jâckâte‐ticne fârine ira wâc hupo.
No nombâŋ rope opâ fuame nâpo, erâ kike tape‐nanezi Aigita mâreŋte opâ sâko sasawa âtec‐jopape kereŋ seŋseŋkembiŋ.
‘No iŋuc fuaocte esecne manape fowec â mârâc sasac jaha mana biric epo i go mi manameŋ me? Ʒi ine mupe fuakac, eme go hae sanaŋ ima bacjopatec tuhu fuazejec.
Ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe ine tâpiri‐jeŋic wahame fâfârehuc qurutuambiŋ, jaŋe gieo monʒaŋ wiac â kecɋaŋ geune erâ wâc ficbupuo hofâ qinʒiŋ fuarâ soka sokahuc jaha ururuckeekac, irec sâc embiŋ.
‘Go waha ŋeekic me fahare raekic me ware fisiekic i no manaekopac, erâ kimbeŋ qahuc râsi enarehuc juekic i kâuc mi baekopac wâc.
Go râsi enarehuc jukicte â pepec penaroŋgere biŋe hazec‐naneo huwecte no hawic‐nanezi sâkegao hehawicguhuc micko kiki‐nane micgao râepe raʒime hata waremeŋ ijaha egarepe risie razemec.’
“Eme wiac kecʒiŋuczi Hisikia go ma egarezejec: Jara ʒirec maŋnao wiac sasawa e jahac fuakac i nânʒepieŋ, jara faicnao sâc ijaha enʒepieŋ, erâ jara namba 3 ira ine ŋoŋe ŋaŋac he sarac â qa roro enʒepieŋ, ehuc waiŋ gie sarapie fârine fuame nânʒepieŋ.
Eme Juda kikefuŋte ʒikare nâfocne juniŋmu, ŋic ʒanʒaŋne hâcne, jaŋe juwicpec gâtâ mocwâc baniŋmu â faicpec fârine bâfuaniŋmu.
Eme Jerusalem haeonec ŋic ʒanʒaŋne â Zioŋ tikionec ʒikare nâfocne jaŋe ŋeratierâ juniŋmu hâcne. Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere ʒoɋaczi wiac iŋuc bâfuaocmu.
“Irec Wofuŋ e Asiria ŋicwofuŋte ʒiŋuc mukac: E hae kecʒirec maŋnao mi wefuzejec, ehuc tepe wâc qâtâcneme maŋnao mi fisizejec, erâ marohec warerâ sac huckeocte ʒae mi bazejec.
E hae ʒirec maŋnao moc mi wewefu hata ware fisiweckoa risiezejec, Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
Iŋuc ecnehuc no nahacnere â kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Dawidi ere erâ hae ʒi ŋezickehuc râsire meonec batarapemu.”
Eme Asiria momori jaŋe teuŋ‐jeŋicko tumaŋnerâ ŋehapie Wofuŋte aŋelozi fua‐jarerâ ŋic 185 tauseŋ qâhâmoc‐jopawec, eme hae fureme ŋic gâcne jaŋe faharerâ mi qâŋɋâŋ sasawa forapie honec‐jopanʒepieŋ!
Iŋuc fuame Asiria ŋicwofuŋ Sanheribe e hae i beherâ mâreŋ‐ticnao risie rawec erâ Niniwe haeo ŋec juc ewec.
Eme ira dameŋ mocko nemu‐ticne Nisiroka ere ufuŋko numuhuc juhame ŋokâ jahec‐ticne Adiramelec â Sareze jahe ʒikazi qâhâmopic. Eme Ararata mâreŋko wisepire ŋokâ‐ticne Esahadoŋ eki tucticne qarâ ŋicwofuŋ juwec.
Dameŋ ira Hisikia e hucsâko bame hâmozo ewec. Ehame Amozire ŋokâ, porofete Jesaja e erao fisirâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: Go wiacfâcge mâzoc‐joparâ ʒawiec, go ɋiɋic mocwâc mi qahuc hâmo‐jâmbâŋkecmu hâcne.”
Iŋuc mume Hisikiazi sâpeopec forisierâ Wofuŋ numu wâwâsic ecnewec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “O Wofuŋ, no gore maio siocmâc â maŋ hâcbuc jupo, ehuc goki manatec biaŋkeekac i hâcne ebac epo, go irec manasuc mac!” Hisikia e iŋuc murâ ki kâcɋene kiowec.
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ Jesajarao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Go ra Hisikia âzâcnec, Wofuŋ, apage Dawidi ere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: No nunumuge manahuc ʒâŋeucge honepac; irec manac, go juju dameŋge bâʒorape jara 15 ʒuhuckerâ juzemec.
Erâ no go â hae ʒirec rune ŋoŋe Asiria ŋicwofuŋ ere meonec batarac‐ŋoparâ hae kecʒi ŋezickepemu.
“Eme Wofuŋzi dâŋ mupaŋkewec i Wofuŋzia fârine bâfuaocmu irec ma kecʒiŋuc fuame honezemec:
No ʒoaŋzi huzo ehame Ahaʒi ficticnere mumuc ʒorakac i mupe ʒoaŋzi risie wefume mocwâc bembeŋkezejec.” Eme ʒoaŋzi risieme mumuc mocwâc bembeŋkewec.
Juda ŋicwofuŋ Hisikia e hucsâko foku biaŋkerâ gae kecʒiŋuc hefuarâ qâreŋkewec:
No maŋnanezi ʒiŋuc mupo: Juju dameŋ‐nane mi qosackeha biac hâmoc haeo hupemurâ munarekicne, ehame jara‐nane nâfocne fokac i nowac rokicne.
No mupo: Wofuŋ e ŋic jujune jaŋere mâreŋko mocwâc mi honepemu erâ mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhuc ŋic mocwâc mi honec‐jopapemu.
Boze‐nane heropiekicne â lama soŋaŋte qoruc boze iŋucne noraonec bârâriekicne; ŋokac jaŋe he fuku muc wiac qâzuckerâ râeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc no juju‐nane râekopac; Wofuŋzi juju‐nane muc iŋucne bâtâcnekac; hae mi ŋafeha behecnume omaekopac.
No wira wâwâsic ehuc juhape hae fureekac, eki ine laioŋ iŋucne siec‐nane sasawa bazuekac; e furicte fuŋkerâ bâʒâicnuhuc juhame hae ŋafeekac.
No sawa hehetâc wipe â hapâ iŋucne dâŋ dâŋ eekopac. Faicpec ʒâŋe fihuc juhape ʒâŋeuc‐nane wahaekac. O Wofuŋ, ʒâic busâqoc fua‐narekac, go baficnuc.
Ʒi ine weniŋuc mupe? E jahac dâŋ mupaŋke‐narewec irec fârine bâfuawec. Bunanezi hâhâtâwekacte guŋɋâri juekopac.
O Wofuŋ, ŋiczi gore erâ jueŋgopeneŋte, maŋnanezi gorao hâcne siŋkerâ foekac; irec mutec mocwâc ɋiɋic qarâ biaŋkezepac!
Manakic, ʒâic busâqoczi maŋ wama bâfua‐narewec; goki ine maŋnanezi sisipiricte nombâŋko huzacte ŋezicnumeŋ, ehuc kiŋnane behe‐fâremeŋ.
Hâmokicne jaŋe mi muteŋgueŋgopieŋ â hâmoc e wâc muteŋ bâteŋ mi egareekac, erâ nombâŋko hueŋgopieŋzi jauŋ fârigere woŋec sâcne mi juniŋmu.
Jujune jaŋe sawa muteŋgueŋgopieŋ, ine no miŋecgac muteŋgukopac irec sâc. Mamaczi naru motecfâcne jauŋ fârigere fuŋne mutâcne‐jareme manaeŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ e baficnuocte afeckewec, irec jufenaŋmu sâc Wofuŋte ufuŋko gitazi musi bahuc gae hecnehuc junʒepeneŋ.
Jesaja e kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋoŋe qaqanac jâc sahacne fâzerâ uucne sisiwiŋ‐ticnao râepie biaŋkezejec.”
Hisikiazi ine muwec: “No Wofuŋte ufuŋko mocwâc fepemurâ wemo ma mo fuame honezepac?”
Dameŋ ira Baladaŋte ŋokâ ʒâŋene Merodac‐Baladaŋ, Babe ŋicwofuŋ hâcne, e papia â bubiaŋte wiac Hisikiarao râeme rawec. E Hisikia huc bame foku mocwâc ɋiɋic qawec irec biŋe manawecte iŋuc ewec.
Eme Hisikia e irec bubiaŋ manarâ kiŋaŋŋic jaŋe boreŋ ʒeŋaŋfic‐ticne jowatuwec, ine siliwa mecne, gol mecne, wiac âsu biaŋhec mecne, wokemaŋ furi sâko mecne â ʒikare wiac irec fic mecne, erâ wâc moneŋ boreŋficko wiac forawec i sasawa jowatu‐fârewec. Ŋicwofuŋ ficticnao â mâreŋ‐ticne sasawao wiac fofârewec i Hisikiazi moc mi hesoŋke‐jarehuc jowatu‐fârewec hâcne.
Eme porofete Jesaja e ŋicwofuŋ Hisikiarao ra ʒiŋuc mu wioc ecnewec: “Ŋic keci jaŋe wemo dâŋ gazambieŋ erâ wenirec ware fua‐garembieŋ?” Hisikiazi muwec: “Jaŋe mâreŋ ʒorickonec, Babe haeonec hâcne norao ware fisimbieŋ.”
Eme muwec: “Jaŋe ficgao wemo wiac honembieŋ?” Hisikiazi muwec: “Jaŋe ficnaneo wiac fokac sâc hone‐fârembieŋ, no boreŋ ʒeŋaŋfic‐naneo wiac moc mi hesoŋke‐jarepac.”
Iŋuc mume Jesajazi Hisikia ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere dâŋ manac!
Manakic, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira wiac sasawa ficgao fokac i mecne, erâ mamacfâcge jaŋe juwefuhuc boreŋ mafa wiac râe guruc ejumbieŋ i mâmâc Babe mâreŋko barâ raniŋmu; wiac huŋgaŋne mac moc mi foocmu, Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
Ehame ŋokâfâcge fua‐gareniŋmu jaŋeraonec gâcne wâc bacjopa raniŋmu, eme jaŋe Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere ficko kiŋaŋ qaqa erâ juniŋmu.”
Eme Hisikiazi Jesaja ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋte dâŋ nazakomec i biaŋne.” E ʒiŋuc manahuc muwec: “No nahacne juju dameŋko wama â jujuhâmo foocmu hâcne.”
Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋicfâc‐nane bâmiriŋ‐jopahuc bubiaŋ dâŋ jazaniŋ!
Jerusalem hae hone ʒemuraŋ ecnehuc dâŋ âzâcneniŋ, erâ hahaŋne bahuc mupie manazejec: Kiŋaŋ qaqa juju‐ticne tarawec â kiŋ bahac‐ticne behecnekicne, i Wofuŋte meonec sâqocne‐ticne sasawa irec okacne fehuc rowecte iŋuc ecnekicne.
Wiwira moc ʒiŋuc fuakac: “Mâreŋ tuhuo Wofuŋte hata bâʒâweniŋ, â mâreŋ sawao Anutu‐nâŋecte hata sâko moc hepie wâneŋkeoc.
Wâcne wâcne hemase‐fârezo, tikine facne hezu hewâneŋ ezo, hehesicne hetiŋnezo â babahacne hefâsâezo.
Eme Wofuŋte huriri qâreŋ fua taniŋkeme mâreŋŋic jaŋe ʒeŋgoma honenʒepieŋ,” Wofuŋte mickonec dâŋ iŋuc wahawec hâcne.
Dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc fuawec: “Dâŋ muromackec!” Eme mupo: “No wemo dâŋ muromackepemu?” Mâreŋŋic jaŋe ʒeŋgoma kecɋaŋ iŋucne, â hawari biaŋ‐jeŋic i ʒariŋ gieo domakac irec sâc.
Wofuŋte micrombâŋzi waha ficneme kecɋaŋ e hâmo ɋaŋac eekac â ʒariŋ e ururuckeekac; jâmbomac, ŋic jaŋe kecɋaŋ iŋucne hâcne.
Kecɋaŋzi hâmo ɋaŋac eekac â ʒariŋzi ururuckeekac, Anutu‐nâŋecte dâŋ ine fohuc juocmu sanaŋ.
Zioŋ biŋe biaŋ mumu, go tiki ʒorao fec, Jerusalem biŋe biaŋ mumu, go dâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋnehec muc, go dâŋ hahaŋne bahuc mi hâwicguzejec; ehuc Juda hae ŋerakac jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazac: “Honeniŋ, Anutu‐ŋeŋic jukac i!”
Honeniŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu e tâpiri sâkohec fisikac, meticne sanaŋkeme guriŋ bapa gie bakac; honeniŋ, furi‐ticne ehec mâmâc ware fisikac â wiac hure hemârec ewec izi bâniecnekac.
E gurufâc‐ticne jaŋe lama soŋaŋ iŋucne hone soŋaŋ ejareocmu; lama motecne meticnezi qâzuc‐joparâ amec‐jopa rahuc neŋgocne jaŋe ine aimuŋ jowac‐jopaocmu.
Mozi meticnezi hâwec fiarâ sâcticne manaocmu, me mozi memotec‐ticne qaratiehuc sambâŋte sâc baocmu, me mozi mâreŋko rufe fokac i sâc bapa otoo fiame sâcne hufâreocmu, me mozi tiki â facne facne sigelio sâcne râeme feme ŋemâc‐jeŋic manaocmu?
Mo ŋiczi Wofuŋ Mâro‐ticne sâcmutâc ecnewec, me mozi bafickehuc dâŋ birickecnewec?
Me mo ŋic mo mu wioc ecneme mamana bâfuacnewec, me mozi tiŋne hatare fuŋne âzâcne mutâc ewec, me mozi mamana tara qazucnewec, me mozi maŋɋârâŋte hata âzâcne jâutuc ewec?
Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere maname, pakeonec opâ ʒâmbâŋne moc wahaekac irec sâc eŋgopieŋ, erâ moŋgeŋ uucne moc sigelio fokac iŋucne; manaŋgopieŋ, nucne nucne jaŋere sâc i gâc iŋucne mac.
Â Lebanoŋte jâckâte i ʒocte sâc mi ezac erâ qowi wiac‐ticne i bâzi ririkere sâc wâc mi ezac.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe ere maio nokafe sawa, jaŋere maname wiac omane â jawane eŋgopieŋ ekac.
Ŋoŋe Anutu e mohec sâc hezo muŋgopieŋ? Me wemo wiac mo ba akic epie ere hawari iŋucne eocmu?
Metâ bapazi ɋâŋ qâqâtâc bâfuaekac, â golzi eri wiac bapa eki golzi foŋkerâ sahacnao siliwazi kâpâcwâru basanaŋkeekac i me?
Me moc e hapetac juhuc ɋâŋ qâqâtâc iŋucne taha râeocte quŋkeocmuzi ine jâcsanaŋ moc gârecke ʒaŋ mi eene bâwosâeocmu. Erâ metâ bapa saric ŋic moc bâfuarâ ɋâŋ qâqâtâc sanaŋne domaocmu iŋucne moc fasaecneocte jâc i râcneocmu.
Ŋoŋe kâuc baŋgopieŋ me? Â mananiŋte mi eŋarekac me? Fuŋnaonecteaŋ mi ŋazakicne me? Me mâreŋte hobeteŋnezi weniŋuc nâzâ nâwotuc ekac i hone wosâc mi embiŋ me?
Anutuzi hâcne mâreŋ jâuru‐fârerâ faic jâmbâŋ eri ŋeŋeo ŋekac, ehame mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe ine ɋirikiŋ iŋucne erâ juŋgopieŋ; eki sambâŋ i qoruc iŋucne qaratiekac â selific ŋiczi maŋnao ŋec juc eene irec sâc fârekac.
Eki mume ŋicwofuŋ fekicne juju‐jeŋic omaeocmu â mâreŋte guriŋ bapa ŋic tâpiri‐jeŋic bawahame arictac eocmu.
Jaŋe ɋâricne mac sarac‐jopakicne â ɋâricne mac tiec‐jopakicne erâ fuŋne‐jeŋiczi mâreŋko ɋâricne mac jaha gâtâ bahame ficne suec‐jopame hâmo ɋaŋac eniŋmu, eme mâŋâŋ sâkozi padi jawa iŋucne bawisec‐jopaocmu.
Eme no ʒi more hawari jukopacte ehec sâc hecnuzo muŋgopieŋ? Tiri runezi iŋuc muhuc wiokac.
Faic fipie feme hone taraniŋ: Bâpiŋ ŋeraŋgopieŋ i mozi bâfuac‐jopawec? Mume guru‐jeŋicko furu jaha fua taniŋkeeŋgopieŋ â ʒâŋe‐jeŋic mufâreekac eki hâcne bâfuac‐jopawec; e tâpiri sâko‐ticnehec â sasanaŋ‐ticne bipinehec irec moczi moc mi sifuckeocmu.
Jakobo, go wemocte dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukomec, â Israe go wemocte dâŋ ʒiŋuc ekomec: “Wofuŋ e hata‐nane kâuc baekac â Anutu‐nanezi dâŋnane sâcne mi dopeckeekac?”
Go kâuc barâ ʒiŋuc mi manameŋ? Wofuŋ e juju sanaŋ Anutu juweczi jukac, eki hâcne mâreŋ qaŋeŋne bâfuawec; e docke pârâc mi eekac â maŋɋârâŋ‐ticne i mamana tarane aricne.
E betaŋkekicne jaŋe tâpiri qikiŋne‐jareekac â rokawekicne jaŋe sasanaŋ bâsoka‐jareekac.
Motec socɋâri jaŋe betaŋkepie tâpiri‐jeŋic omaeocmu â ŋicmotec jaŋe wâc docke pârâc ehuc rândiŋkeniŋmu.
Wofuŋtao roweckeniŋmu jaŋe ine tâpiri ɋâricne bâfuaniŋmu, jaŋe tucwipe iŋucne fafakechec erâ furuc furuc qahuc feniŋmu, jaŋe gasackeku mi dockeniŋmu erâ hata raku wâc mi betaŋkeniŋmu.
Nucne nucne ŋoŋe nore maio niniŋkeniŋ â ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe tâpiri‐jeŋic mocwâc fua‐jarezejec! Jaŋe mai ware fuarâ dâŋ munʒepieŋ, ehame dâŋgie i mâmâc jaha banʒepeneŋ.
Mozi ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec ŋic moc suru jâiŋ ecneme ira me ira fisirâ ʒika qahuc sanaŋkeekac? Me ŋicne ŋicne ere meo râec‐jopame ŋicwofuŋ qâhuc‐jopaekac, ehuc ʒika‐ticnezi qanʒaŋ‐jopame rufe iŋucne eeŋgopieŋ â tepe‐ticnezi muruc‐jopame padi jawa iŋucne eeŋgopieŋ?
E kike‐ticnezi hatagâŋ juwicnao moc mi âtewecko ira jopa jâpec ejarehuc sisipiric moc mi bâfuaekac.
Mozi iŋuc eekac â mume fuaekac? Me mozi fuŋnaonecteaŋ ŋic gaŋne gaŋne wira‐jareme fua wefueŋgopieŋ? Bâbâni jupozi jukopac erâ ʒâhec juniŋmu jaŋerao ijaha juzokopac, Wofuŋ noni hâcne.
Nucne nucne jaŋe iŋuc honerâ hâwic‐jopawec â mâreŋ qaŋeŋne jaŋe ɋiɋiteckembiŋ jaŋe ware mai fuambiŋ hâcne.
Jaŋe sasawa babafic ehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc nazaŋ gazaŋ eeŋgopieŋ: “Go hâbige roc!”
Ehame metâ bapa e golzi wiac bapa esockekac, â hamazi wiac qajacneekac eki ine aeŋzi wiac bapa esockekac, ehuc kizi rike bâzickerâ mukac: “Biaŋkekac.” Iŋuc murâ ŋeŋgoroŋkezacte biriŋzi qasanaŋkekac.
O Israe kiŋaŋ qaqa‐nane, Jakobo bâwosâecgupo, âgo‐nane Abraham ere ɋâric,
go mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaonec ro sakac egarepo â mâreŋ tuturuŋnaonec wira hefârec egarepo, ehuc ʒiŋuc gazapo, “Go hâcne kiŋaŋ qaqa‐nane, no hone suŋgiŋ mi egarehuc rowosâecgupo.”
No gohec jukopacte mi hâwicguzejec, no Anutuge jukopacte maŋge mi gâckezejec; no hâcne basanaŋguhuc baficgupemu, ehuc mefâre‐nane sanaŋnezi dopecgupemu.
Manakic, râsi egareeŋgopieŋ sasawa jaŋe qurutuapie mimi busâqoc fua‐jarezejec, â kisâfâcge jaŋe tâpiri‐jeŋic arictac eme sipirickenʒepieŋ.
Gohec juju gie baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe basac‐joparâ mocwâc mi bâfuac‐jopacmu â gohec ʒika gie baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe omaerâ arictac efâreniŋmu.
No Wofuŋ, gore Anutuzi hâcne mefâregao rocgurâ ʒiŋuc gazakopac: “Go mi hâwicguoc, no hâcne baficgupemu.”
O Jakobo, go mâreŋko ɋâsu fokac iŋucne jukomeczi mi hâwicguzejec, â Israe guru pitic go mi fâfârezemec! No hâcne baficgupemu, erâ Israere Tiri rune no fifiruege jukopac, Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
Manakic, no mupe go padi ââkenʒaŋ gitu ɋâricne ɋâfoŋne â ŋemâcne iŋucne ezemec, ehuc tiki facne facne qâfâucke qanʒaŋ etecne mâreŋ uucne efârezejec.
Eme sawao behetec feme mâŋâŋzi bawiseocmu â mâŋâŋ sâkozi qâtâtieocmu. Goki ine Wofuŋte manasuhuc ʒeri bari ezemec, ehuc Israere Tiri rune ere bubiaŋ manahuc mumbiaŋkezemec.
Qarâ suriŋne â hapetac jaŋe opâ basapie arictac eme nameŋ‐jeŋic kereŋkeha Wofuŋ no hâcne bafic‐jopapemu. Israere Anutu no mi behec‐jopapemu.
Noni mupe tiki botâŋko opâ fuaocmu â mâreŋ wâwâneŋko opâ ʒâŋe wefuocmu; noni mupe mâreŋ burocnao opâ riqic fuazejec â mâreŋ kereŋnezi opâ fisihuc fozejec.
Noni mupe mâreŋ burocnao jâmâzâc, jâmiŋ, ʒariŋ â oliwa jâc fuazejec; noni mupe mâreŋ sawao wete, becʒi â niwijâc mâmâc jaha fuarâ doma razejec.
Eme ŋic sasawa jaŋe i honehuc fuŋne ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ: Wiac i Wofuŋte mezi bawec â Israere Tiri rune eki bâfuawec.
Wofuŋzi mukac: “Ŋoŋe dâŋ bajuŋgopieŋ i mufuaniŋ, â Jakobore Wofuŋ Sâkozi mukac: Dâŋŋeŋic wemozi dopeckeniŋmu i muniŋ.”
Ŋoŋe mupie nemufâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ware fua taniŋkerâ, wiac fuazokac i hâcne nâzânʒepieŋ. Ehame mârâc jaha wiac fuawec irec fuŋne mecne erâ weniŋuc ehuc fârinehec ewec irec fuŋne i mâmâc nâzâ mutâc epie manarâ maŋzi manatâc qâtâc enʒepeneŋ, me wiac ʒâhec fuazokac irec dâŋ mupie mananʒepeneŋ wâc.
Juku wiac fuazokac irec dâŋ mupie fuŋne‐jeŋic mana tararâ ʒiŋuc jazanʒepeneŋ: Ŋoŋe nemu! Ajoc, ŋoŋe wiac biaŋne me sâqocne moc epie nâŋe sasawa hone warec ehuc fâfârenʒepeneŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe fârine‐ŋeŋic aricne, â gie‐ŋeŋic i fâri tâmiric jaha; eme bâwosâec‐ŋopaocmuzi mamakâcne eocmu.
No faic mâreŋkonec ŋic moc wareocte esoc qafeŋ ecnepe ware fisiwec, ʒoaŋ wewefunaoneczi ʒâŋe‐nane muhuc wira wâwâsic enareocmu e hâcne; eki ŋicwofuŋ fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe mâreŋ dodocne iŋucne âte docjopaocmu erâ kuʒi bapazi afe âtenʒaŋneekac irec sâc âtenʒaŋ‐jopaocmu.
Mozi fuŋnaonecteaŋ musokame mananʒapeŋ, me esecne nâzâme manarâ ʒiŋuc munʒapeŋ, “E fârine mukac?” Aricne, moczi moc mi musokawec, moczi moc mi nâzâwec, ŋoŋeraonec moczi findaŋdâŋ moc mi manawec.
Noni hâcne fuŋkerâ Zioŋ dâŋ âzâcnekopac, ehuc Jerusalem biŋe biaŋ mumu ŋic moc bâfuacnekopac.
Erâ no ʒâŋe fihuc basac‐jopaekopac, ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko dâŋ mumu ŋic moc mi jukac, irec mu wioc ejarepe okacne mi bârisie‐nareeŋgopieŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, jaŋe furu jaha fâri‐jeŋic aricne, â gie‐jeŋic i fâri tâmiric jaha; nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe wiac omane â jawa sawa.
Honeniŋ, keci kiŋaŋŋic‐nane, no e hâcne dopeckeekopac, e ŋicnane bâwosâekicne, no e hone aŋac ecneekopac. No Mâro‐nane ere faio râepe bafickeha ŋicne ŋicne mumutiŋ dâŋ musoka‐jareocmu.
E dâŋ hahaŋne bahuc ojowa sâko mi eocmu â hae ʒoŋao dâŋmarac‐ticne fuame mi mananiŋmu.
Bo paruczi qakicne i qâtâcne behec mi eocmu, â ʒoc kine mi âte hâpoocmu; mumutiŋ dâŋ fâretiŋ bâtâcne bâtimuŋ eme maniŋ biaŋ fuaocmu.
E jahacne docke pârâc mi ehuc giene bakume mâreŋko tiŋne juju fuarâ foocmu; ehame nucne nucne jaŋe mumutâc dâŋticnere woŋec ŋeniŋmu.
Sambâŋ bâfuarâ qaratieme forakac, mâreŋ â fainao wiac fua rakac i bâdâmâreekac, mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne nokafe ficne‐jareekac â fainao rac warec eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe jujure mâro jareekac, Wofuŋ Anutu eki hâcne ʒiŋuc mukac:
“Wofuŋ no hâcne tiŋne‐nanere erâ wira hefârec egarepo, erâ meo bacgu juhuc ŋezicgupemu, ehuc no ŋicguru jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic fuaocte â ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ʒoc tamac ecmurâ râecgupemu.
Eme tiŋtuŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe bâtâcnezemec â niŋgiŋko ŋeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mecne erâ kâpâcwâru ficko ŋehuc dapâcko qiŋquŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc goroŋ‐jopatec wahanʒepieŋ.
Noni Wofuŋ, ʒâŋe‐nane iŋuc hâcne; no ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane mocte biŋe eocte mi manasupemu â ʒai ʒonʒoŋ‐nane nemu jaŋerao fotâcneocte wâc mi manapemu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no mârâc dâŋ mupo i fârinehec ewec, eme ʒi dâŋ ɋâricne ŋazakopac; wiac ɋâricne mi fua tâcnehame dâŋne ŋazape manaŋgopieŋ hâcne.”
Hâwec faio rac warec eeŋgopieŋ â maŋnao wiac fusucmarâ foekac, nucne nucne â ŋecjucfâc‐jeŋic ŋoŋe Wofuŋ gae ɋâricne hecneniŋ, ehuc mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaoneczi ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne mumbiaŋkeniŋ.
Mâreŋ burocne â ira hae ŋerakac jaŋe mecne erâ Kedara ŋic qoruc boze ruckerâ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc ʒeri fânâŋ epie fua‐fârezejec; qânâ hawecko ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒeri bari enʒepieŋ â tiki botâŋko domahuc kiwac qawac enʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe Wofuŋ muac baafec ecnenʒepieŋ â nucne nucne ira ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne musokanʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ e ŋic qac momori iŋucne ʒikare faharekac â momori iŋucne ʒika qaocte bune wefukac; e hahaŋne bahuc semuja hekac â ŋic qac momori iŋucne râsifâcne jopazo rakac.
No dameŋ ʒora mâc fâsâerâ jupo, no niniŋkerâ maŋnane bâmâteŋkepo; ʒi ine ŋokac gozi kime owackeekac irec sâc owackepemu, no husehuc nokafe kâcɋene hepemu.
No mupe tikire â facnere jâckâte omaeocmu â kecɋaŋ‐ticne hâmo ɋaŋac efâreocmu; erâ mupe opâ sâkozi mâreŋ kereŋne eocmu â riqic wiaczi ʒicke‐fâreocmu.
Eme no tiŋtuŋ jaŋe hata kâuc baeŋgopieŋ ira jowac‐jopa rapemu; â hatagâŋ mi honembiŋ ira bacjopa rapemu, no bânie‐jarehuc mupe dapâczi ŋerisierâ tatamac eocmu; â wâcne facne hezu hemasec epe mâreŋ wâneŋkeocmu. Wiac i sasawa moc mi behehuc ejâmbâŋkepemu.
Eme nemu jaŋerao roweckehuc ɋâŋ qâqâtâc ba akic ekicne jazaeŋgopieŋ, “Ŋoŋe hâcne nemufâc‐nâŋec,” jaŋe rârâpe rahuc qurutuanʒepieŋ.
Qepoŋ ŋoŋe mananiŋ, â tiŋtuŋ ŋoŋe ʒâŋe firâ honeniŋ!
Mozi kiŋaŋŋic‐nanere sâc tiŋtuŋ erâ jukac, me mozi biŋe mumu‐nane sorepe raocmu ere sâc qepoŋ erâ jukac? Mozi Wofuŋte âgo fuŋfuŋ â kiŋaŋŋic ere sâc tiŋtuŋ erâ jukac?
E wiac bocjaha honehuc sifu mi hone taraekac â hazec‐ticne uŋto‐bipieha mi mana‐hâmoekac.
Wofuŋ e tiŋne juju‐ticnere erâ sâcmutâc dâŋticne tâpiri â eri qaraweŋhec fuaocte maname biaŋkewec.
Jaŋe ine ŋicguru wiac‐jeŋic fiuckekicne â jowac rokicne; jaŋe sasawa nombâŋko niŋgiŋhec foeŋgopieŋ â kâpâcwâru ficko soŋjopapie ŋeeŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe mafa mateŋ iŋucne rocjopakicne, ehame fifirue‐jeŋic moc mi jukac; jaŋe wiac‐jeŋic jowac rokicne eme moczi ʒiŋuc moc mi mukac: “Bârisie‐narec.”
Ŋoŋeraonec mozi irec hazec râeocmu me mana‐hâmorâ maŋkeme foha jufeocmu?
Mozi Jakobo fiuc roro ŋic qikiŋne‐jarewec, â Israe soroŋ qaqa jaŋere meo râewec? Wofuŋ bunao bambeŋ eki hâcne ewec! Jaŋe ine hata‐ticne âteniŋte takic‐jopawec â sâcmutâc dâŋticne mana rereŋ mi embiŋ.
E irec hâcne kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋ â ʒika bipinehec fai‐jeŋicko hoŋkeme fewec; izi rârec‐jopahuc ʒâseŋ‐jopaha mi mana tarambiŋ, ʒacjopaha sifu maŋjeŋic mi uŋtowec.
Ʒi ine Jakobo go bâfuacguwec â Israe go bacguwec Wofuŋ eki ʒiŋuc mukac: “No hâcne firuecgupo irec mi hâwicguzejec; no ʒâŋege muhuc wira hefârec egarepo: Go nore biŋe.
Go opâ fotâcnehaŋte no gohec jupemu, eme opâzi mi qâurucguzejec; go ʒoc huckehaŋtec ʒoczi mi ʒacguzejec â ʒocbâruŋzi mi ʒâseŋguzejec.
No hâcne Wofuŋ gore Anutu, no Israere Tiri rune, fifiruege. No Aigita gore erâ behehuc kiwiricge rokopac, erâ Etiopia â Sebe mâreŋ jahe gore okacne qikiŋ‐jofakopac.
No honecgupe furi sâko â ʒâŋe biŋehec ekomec erâ maŋnanezi go ʒâficgukopacte gore erâ ŋic gâcne behec‐jopakopac â jujuge fuaocte manasuhuc ŋic gurune gurune qikiŋ‐jopakopac.
No gohec jukopacte mi hâwicguzejec; no ɋâricfâcge ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec jowac‐jopa warepemu â ʒoaŋ huhunaonec hetumaŋ‐ŋopapemu.
Faic mâreŋkonec jaŋe jazapemu: ‘Râec‐jopaniŋ,’ â juwic mâreŋkonec jaŋe wâc jazapemu: ‘Mi sakarec‐jopaniŋ’; ŋoŋe ŋokâfâc‐nane ʒorickonec jowac‐jopa warenʒepieŋ â otâfâc‐nane mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaonec jaŋe mâmâc.
Nore ʒâŋe bajuŋgopieŋ, â ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane fuaocte bâfuac‐jopapo erâ menanezi bacjopapo, jaŋe hâcne ware‐fârenʒepieŋ.”
Ŋicguru ʒâŋe‐jeŋic foipiehame wiac mi honeeŋgopieŋ â hazec‐jeŋic foipiehame dâŋ mi manaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ejarepie fua taniŋkenʒepieŋ!
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe heâckerâ fisi‐fârenʒepieŋ â ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe tumaŋne‐fârenʒepieŋ. Eme mana honenaŋ, jaŋeraonec mozi dâŋ ʒi sâcne mutâcne‐nâreocmu â mârâc jaha wiac fuawec irec fuŋne mutaniŋkeme sâcne mananaŋmu? Jaŋe mumutaniŋ ŋicfâc‐jeŋic jowac‐jopa warepie fuŋne‐jeŋic bataniŋkenʒepieŋ, eme manarâ muzo: “Dâŋ i fârine.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋoŋe mumutaniŋ ŋicfâc‐nane, â kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane bâwosâec‐ŋopapo, eme, no hâcne Wofuŋ, ŋoŋe iŋuc manarâ mana ʒakiehuc mana taranʒepieŋ. No juwarehuc jupo dameŋ irec juwicnao nemu moc mi bâfuakicne, â no jupemu irec faicnao iŋuc jaha moc mi fuarâ juocmu.
No mocjahazi Wofuŋ fârine, no iŋucne bâbâpiaŋ moc mi jukac.
No iŋuc hâcne mufua‐ŋarepo â bafic‐ŋopahuc ŋazapo, no ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jaba moc mi jupo; eme ŋoŋe mumutaniŋ ŋicfâc‐nane juŋgopieŋ.” Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
“No hâcne Anutu fârine juwarehuc jupozi miŋecgac sâc ijaha jukopac; ŋic moczi nore meonec ŋic babatarac‐jopane mi fokac; no gie baekopac i mozi aka moc heocmu?”
Wofuŋ, fifirue‐ŋeŋic â Israere Tiri rune, e ʒiŋuc mukac: “No ŋoŋere erâ Babe haeo kiŋaŋ sorepe raocmu, ehame kâpâcwârure babasanaŋ sasawa batarape wahaocmu, eme Kaldea ŋic jaŋere ʒeri bubiaŋzi ŋerisieme ki busâqoc fuaocmu.
No Wofuŋ ŋoŋere Tiri rune, no Israere bâbâfua â Wofuŋ Sâko‐ŋeŋic.”
Hâwecmaŋko hata bawec â opâ sâkoo gâŋ bâfuawec,
keretac â becâsic, momori â tâpirihec jaŋe ejareme ʒikao rambiŋ, ehuc guruhec waha jopame mocwâc mi faharembiŋ, lambe iŋucne gâkowarâ hâpo‐jâmbâŋkembiŋ, Wofuŋ e hâcne ʒiŋuc mukac:
“Mârâc wiac fuawec irec mocwâc mi manasunʒepieŋ â esecne fowec irec manatâc qâtâc wâc mi enʒepieŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no wiac ɋâricne moc bâfuazo ekopac, eme ʒi biac fuazo eha hone ʒâŋitac mi eŋgopieŋ me? No mâreŋ tuhuo hata bapemu â mâreŋ burocnao opâ mupe fuarâ foocmu.
No ŋicfâc‐nane bâwosâec‐jopakicne jaŋe opâ gume qiŋjopapemurâ mâreŋ tuhuo opâ ʒâkâŋ â mâreŋ burocnao opâ sâko bâfuapemu, irec kâte qowi qera â kâte qâto jaŋe mumbiaŋnuniŋmu hâcne.
Ŋicguru ʒi nore biŋe erâ juniŋte baʒawiec‐jopapo jaŋe ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane musokanʒepieŋ!
“O Jakobo, go wira hefârec mi enaremeŋ â Israe go nore erâ gie sâko moc mi bameŋ, aricne!
Go lamafâcge hâcbuc ririkere biŋe i nore manasuhuc mi râemeŋ, erâ taha bâzigezi mi sâsecnumeŋ; no taha rârâere tagi faigao mi râepe fewec, erâ hosâc âsu biaŋte micneneŋ mi egarepo.
Go moneŋzi wiac âsu biaŋhec furine mi banaremeŋ â taha bâzigere wokemaŋzi mi gume qiŋnumeŋ. Sâqocnegezi ine gie sâko bâfua‐naremeŋ â hehesicgezi maŋbâiŋ enaremeŋ.
“Noni hâcne nahacnere erâ qaqatarage bâtâmirehuc jukopac, erâ hehesicgere mocwâc mi manasupemu.
Go manasu‐naretec dâŋgie banaŋ; go dâŋge sasawa wose biric ec, eme bahacmâc jukomec irec fuŋne taniŋkezejec.
Apagezi sâqocne bawec, erâ dâŋ mumuŋicfâcge jaŋe nore dâŋ qatarambiŋ.
Eme no irec erâ furuficte micne gie‐jeŋic jowac rope ŋic omane embiŋ erâ Jakobo e sisipiricte biŋe qahuc Israe ere mupe mimi busâqoczi fainao fewec.
“Ʒi ine Jakobo kiŋaŋŋic‐nane, â Israe bâwosâecgupo go manac!
Bâfuacguwec â neŋgoc bumaŋko fuŋkerâ baʒawiecguwec erâ baficguhuc juekac, Wofuŋ eki hâcne ʒiŋuc mukac: Jakobo kiŋaŋŋic‐nane, â Israe bâwosâecgupo go mi hâwicguzejec.
Manakic, no mâreŋ hahaŋkekicnao opâ hoŋkepemu â mâreŋ kereŋnao opâ mupe fuarâ foocmu; no Mâro‐nane ecnepe ɋâricfâcge jaŋerao wahaocmu â jambuŋ‐nanezi apa ŋosafâcge jaŋere faio feocmu.
Eme jaŋe kecɋaŋzi opâ ŋondeŋko â kakikic jâczi opâ sâko heririŋnao fua sokac eekac irec sâc fua sawec enʒepieŋ.
Moc e muocmu: ‘No Wofuŋte biŋe,’ â moc e ʒâŋe‐ticne Jakobo muocmu, erâ moc e jahacne meo ‘Wofuŋte erâ jukopac’ iŋuc qâreŋkehuc ʒâŋe‐ticne Israe muocmu.”
Wofuŋ, Israere Wofuŋ Sâko â fifirue, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ hâcne, e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Nonizia bâbâni â ʒâhec, no mocjahazi Anutu fârine jukopac.
Mozi no iŋucne jukac? Moc jukacko muzejec, erâ fuŋne‐ticne nore maio mutaniŋkehuc nazazejec. Juku wiac fuazokac i weni jaŋe esecne mufuambiŋ? Moc embiŋko ine wemo wiac ʒâhec fuaocte mukicne i wâc nâzânʒepieŋ!
Ŋoŋe hâwic‐ŋopaha mi fâfârenʒepieŋ; no juwicnao mi mufua‐ŋarepo â mi ŋazapo me? Eme ŋoŋe irec biŋe mumufâc‐nane embiŋ juŋgopieŋ! Mozi Anutu no iŋucne moc jukac? Haroŋaŋ moc mi fome manakopac!”
Ɋâŋ qâqâtâc bapa jaŋe ŋic mutucne sasawa, â wiac basarickehuc baeŋgopieŋ izi wâc fâri tâmiric; irec ɋâŋ wiac numu‐jareniŋmu jaŋe wiac hone manac moc mi ehuc qurutuaniŋmu.
Mozi nemu me ɋâŋ qâqâtâc gie mi bapane fasaeocmu me aeŋzi ba akic eocmu?
Manaŋgopieŋ, âgofâc‐ticne jaŋe qurutua‐fâreniŋmu, â metâ bapa ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe ŋic sawa jaha; eme i â i jaŋe mâmâc tumaŋnerâ domaniŋmuo ine sifu bipic tatara ejareha qurutua‐fâreniŋmu.
Aeŋzi wiac bapa e aeŋ ʒocko rike dockerâ ba akic eekac, erâ hamazi hejacneme hawarine fuaekac, e mesanaŋ‐ticnezi irec gie baekac, ehuc nânâre hâmohuc dockeekac â opâ wâc mi nâhuc betaŋkeekac.
Kamunda eki ine muc fârehuc kirifizi ma baekac; e jâc fasaehuc biriŋzi qâreŋ oorâŋ baekac, ehuc ŋic hawari iŋucne ba akic eekac, ŋic hawari biaŋne â ficko dodomane iŋucne hâcne.
E jâmâzâc jâc qafaraocte raekac, eme jâmiŋ me boriŋ me kâteo jâc wiac gâcne bâwosâeekac. E jâmâzâc sarame hoe heme mâreŋzi bâgunuckeme sokaekac.
Izi ŋic ʒoc bâfuacneekac, eme ʒocticne ʒame sahac‐ticne hâroŋkeekac; ŋifecne ruqerâ nânâ poroŋ rikeekac â ŋifecnezi ine ɋâŋ fasaerâ numucneekac, nemuɋâŋ fasaerâ dieŋzi hecneekac hâcne.
Jâc dâkâne moc ʒocko râeme ʒaekac â dâkâne moczi qowi ʒegoc barâ nâ gapec eekac, ehuc ʒoc ruahuc muekac: “Aija, hâroŋnukac â ʒoc biaŋne ruakopac i!”
Jâc dâkânezi ine nemu‐ticnere ɋâŋ qâqâtâc fuaocte fasaeekac, fasae‐fârerâ dieŋzi hecnehuc dapecnerâ ʒiŋuc muhuc numucneekac: “Go Anutu‐nane jukicte baficnuzemec!”
Jaŋe wiac moc mi hone mana tarac eeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ʒâŋe‐jeŋic bâhâpokicnere tiŋtuŋ qaeŋgopieŋ â maŋjeŋiczi wiac moc mi manaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic moc maŋticne uŋtoha manatâc qâtâc moc mi eekac â mamana‐ticne moc mi fuaekac, e wemocko ʒiŋuc moc muocmu: “No jâc ŋifecne ʒocko râepe ʒawec, ehame ʒoc mimiŋnao nânâ â bec rikerâ nâ gapec epo, irec wemocko jâc ŋifecne fasaehuc wiac mamakâcne barâ jâcombâŋ iŋucnere maŋfuŋko dapepemu?”
Moc e gie fâri tâmiric baocmu e maŋticnezi eatuckehuc sioc ecnewec muzo; eme irec hâcne juju‐ticne ŋezickehuc ʒiŋuc sâcne mi muocmu: “Mefâre‐naneo wiac badomakopac i burec wiac moc mecne?”
O Jakobo â Israe, go irec manasuc, go hâcne kiŋaŋŋic‐nane; go kiŋaŋŋic‐nane junarecmurâ baʒawiecgupo; o Israe, no gore mi nikecnuocmu.
No hehesicge karorac iŋucne bârâriekopac â sâqocnege i hâweŋ iŋucne ficne sue‐garekopac. No firuecgupo irec norao risiezemec.
Wofuŋzi iŋuc ewecte sambâŋne sambâŋne semuja heniŋ â mâreŋ fâhâŋne fâhâŋne ŋoŋe ʒeri eniŋ; tikine tikine ŋoŋe aŋara hehuc ʒeri fânâŋ eniŋ, kâtere maŋnao jâc doma rakac sasawa ŋoŋe mâmâc! Wofuŋ e Jakobo firuewec erâ Israe ŋic jaŋerao ʒâŋe‐ticne bataniŋkeocmu hâcne.
Neŋgoc bumaŋko fuŋkerâ baʒawiecguwec Wofuŋ fifiruege e hâcne ʒiŋuc mukac: “No Wofuŋ, noni hâcne wiac sasawa bâfua‐fârepo, no sambâŋne sambâŋne bucnane fârehuc bâdâmârepo erâ mâreŋ qaratiepo; ehame mozi moc baficnuzac?
No siocŋic jaŋe sowidâŋ mupie mupe fâri tâmiric eekac, â qaŋgecŋic mutuc bacjopaekopac; no maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe bârisiec‐jopape wiseeŋgopieŋ, erâ mamana gie‐jeŋic hetikiepe mutuc jaŋere sâc eekac.
No kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere dâŋ basanaŋkepemu erâ biŋe mumufâc‐nane jaŋe mumupaŋ dâŋ musokambiŋ i mupe fârinehec eocmu; no Jerusalem haere ʒiŋuc mupemu: ‘Ŋecjucfâc‐ticne mocwâc fuanʒepieŋ,’ â Juda haefâc‐ticne jaŋere mupemu: ‘Jaŋe heɋârec‐jopahuc bazo, erâ sesuctac i noni bâpiaŋkepemu.’
No hâwec ʒâkâŋ âzâcnepemu: ‘Ʒicke kereŋ ec, noni mupe opâge kereŋke‐fâreocmu.’
No Kirure mukopac: ‘E lama soŋaŋ‐nane, irec dâŋ mana biric epo i eki fârine bâfuazejec,’ ehuc Jerusalemte ʒiŋuc muzejec, ‘E mocwâc heɋârehuc bazo’; â taha ufuŋte muzejec: ‘Wâtuŋ‐ticne râepie huoc!’”
Wofuŋ e Kirure maio ŋicne ŋicne qâhuc‐jopaocte â ŋicwofuŋ umbika‐jeŋic goroŋkerâ jowac roocte Kiru wokemaŋ ruacnerâ mefârenao rowec. Ehuc ere maio motâc ropie aŋkeocte â motâc sâko mi heniŋte ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“No nahac bânie‐garehuc hata bâʒâwe‐garepemu, no motâc aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bakicne i qanʒaŋnehuc aeŋ babasanaŋ‐ticne hezupemu.
No wiac fâri biaŋ dapâcko soŋkekicne â boreŋ ʒeŋaŋko râekicne i garepemu, eme ʒiŋuc mana tarazemec: Ʒâŋe‐nane muhuc wira‐narekac e Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu hâcne.
No kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Jakobo â bâwosâekicne‐nane Israe ere erâ ʒâŋege muhuc wira‐garepo, ehuc go mi mana taracnuhaŋtec sifu ʒâŋe biŋe sâko bâfua‐garepo.
No mocjahazi Wofuŋ jukopac, Anutu no iŋucne moc mi jukac, aricne! Go mi manacnuhaŋtec becsahac joma‐garepo.
Irec ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec â huhunaonec ŋiczi ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ: E iŋucne moc mi jukac, aricne; e mocjahazi Wofuŋ jukac hâcne.
Noni hâcne ŋifec tatamac bâfuahuc ŋifec dapâc bâfuaekopac; noni mupe ŋifec wama fuarâ foha ŋifec ʒârâ hâriŋ fuaekac; wiac i sasawa Wofuŋ noni hâcne mupe fua‐fâreekac.
“Sambâŋne sambâŋne ŋoŋe hoe pisiŋ pisiŋ henʒepieŋ â karorac ŋoŋe tiŋne juju i hoe iŋucne hoŋkepie wahazejec. Eme mâreŋzi aŋkerâ bâbâpiaŋ â tiŋne juju âke suec‐jofame mâmâc wefuzepirec; Wofuŋ noni hâcne wiac i bâfuaekopac.
“Jei, ŋic e kuʒi dâkâne dâkâne jaŋere sâc juhuc weniŋuc erâ bâbâfua‐ticne aaric dâŋ mucneocmu? Afezi kuʒi bapa ʒiŋuc sâcne âzâcneocmu: ‘Go wemo wiac bakomec’? Me, wiac bâfuakicnezi ʒiŋuc sâcne âzâcneocmu: ‘Go mege aricne’?
Jei, mozi mamac ʒiŋuc âzâcneocmu: ‘Ɋâric wemocte bâfuakic?’ Me neŋgoc âzâcneocmu: ‘Go wemocte motec kiweckerâ rokomec?’”
Wofuŋ, Israere Tiri rune â bâbâfua e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋoŋe naru motecfâc‐nane jaŋere erâ mu wioc enarezo muŋgopieŋ me? Me meqâreŋ‐nanere dâŋ mutâcne‐nareniŋte muŋgopieŋ me?
No hâcne mâreŋ bâfuapo erâ fainao ŋic juŋgopieŋ i nonizia bâfuac‐jopapo. Nore mezi sambâŋ fârepo forakac, erâ momorifâcne bâpiŋ sasawa giedâŋ mujarepo.
No tiŋne juju‐nanere erâ ŋic moc esoc qafeŋ ecnepo, no hata‐ticne hewâneŋke‐fârepemu wâc. Eki hâcne hae sâko‐nane heɋârerâ bazejec â kâpâcwâru ŋicfâc‐nane firuec‐jopazejec, erâ i furire me bâbâmiriŋ wiacte mi ezejec.” Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Aigitaonec moneŋ mafa â Etiopiaonec huhure wiac i gore biŋe eocmu, â Sebaŋic ʒoricne jaŋe ware gore biŋe eniŋmu. Jaŋe bâjâpecguniŋmu, ehuc me kike‐jeŋic kâpâcwâruzi bândeŋnekicne foha ware fodape‐garerâ mumbiaŋguhuc ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Anutu fârine e gorao mocjaha jukac, e iŋucne moc mi jukac, aric kereŋne jâmbâŋ!’”
O Israere Anutu, bâbâpiaŋ rune, go jâmbomac Anutu soŋne.
Ɋâŋ qâqâtâc baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc sasawa qurutuarâ mimi busâqoc fua‐jareme mimiehuc junʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ e bâbâpiaŋ fofo sanaŋzi Israe bâpiaŋkeocmu, eme e mi qurutuahuc mimi busâqoc tâmiric juraʒihuc juocmu sanaŋ.
Sambâŋ â mâreŋ bâfuac‐jofawec, â mâreŋte hobeteŋne râewec, erâ mâreŋ i tuhu fuarâ foocte mâcne, fainao ŋiczi ŋec juc eniŋte bâfuawec, Wofuŋ Anutu e hâcne ʒiŋuc mukac: “Noni sawa Wofuŋ, moczi aricne.
No soŋsoŋko me mâreŋ dapâcko dâŋ mi mupo, no Jakobore ɋâricfâc jaŋe ʒiŋuc wâc mi jazapo: ‘Ŋoŋe basacnu‐bipienʒepieŋ.’ Noni Wofuŋ hâcne, no dâŋ tiŋne muekopac â dâŋ fârine muratieekopac.
“Ŋicne ŋicne irec ʒanʒaŋne sasawa ŋoŋe qâturerâ bembeŋko ware fuaniŋ! Manaŋgopieŋ, ɋâŋ qâqâtâc‐jeŋic hâpo jueŋgopieŋ, â bafic‐jopaocte tâpiri mi focnekac, nemu iŋucne mu wâwâsic ecneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe maŋ mamanasu‐jeŋic aricne.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ bajuŋgopieŋ i mufuanʒepieŋ, ehuc ʒiŋucte mâmâc muc manac enʒepieŋ: Dâŋ keci i mozi esecne mufuawec, mozi mârâc jaha jâmbâŋ muiŋnewec? Wofuŋ noni mi epo me? Norao moc ʒuhuckerâ Anutu juju i mi fokac, no Anutu tiŋne â bâbâpiaŋ rune, no iŋucne moc mi jukac.
“Mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaonec sasawa ŋoŋe norao risie warepie bâpiaŋ‐ŋopape! Noni hâcne Anutu, no iŋucne moc mi jukac.
No nahacnao ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ dâŋ mupo, ehame micnaneonec dâŋ tiŋne wahawec izi fârinehec ezejec, kecʒiŋuc: ‘Ŋic ʒeŋgoma jaŋe dieŋzi henare‐fârenʒepieŋ â ru sâc micjeŋiczi muafecnunʒepieŋ.’
“Ehuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Bâbâpiaŋ â tâpiri i Wofuŋtao mocjaha fokac.’ Râsi ecneeŋgopieŋ sasawa jaŋe ine erao fuarâ mimi busâqoc bâfuanʒepieŋ.
Israere ɋâricfâc jaŋe ʒeŋgoma Wofuŋtao tiŋne juju bâfuarâ e mumbiaŋkehuc junʒepieŋ.”
Beli nemu e betaŋkewec, Nebo nemu e waha qawec, ɋâŋ qâqâtâc‐jekic i doŋgi â kamele jaŋere faio râepie fewec; ŋoŋe wiac hâporâ jujumbieŋ i hâcne qowi betaŋkekicne jaŋere tagi ewec.
Jahe mâmâc jaha docke betaŋ ekopirec, jahe tagi baafeckenicte eipiehuc jahe jahacne kâpâcwâru ficko rakopirec.
“Jakobore kikefuŋ jaŋe mecne â Israere kikefuŋ irec ŋic ʒanʒaŋne mecne, neŋgoc bumaŋkonec fuapie fuŋkerâ dope hutuŋ eŋarehuc juwarepo â neŋgoc bumaŋkonec fuapie âsi qataŋ eŋarehuc juwefupo ŋoŋe nore dâŋte hazec râe‐fâreniŋ.
No jupo iŋuc jaha juhape ŋoŋe jufeku ŋic ŋokac raŋɋa eniŋmu, no de âsic eŋarehuc juhape jaŋɋâŋzi âkec‐ŋopaocmu. No de âsic eŋarepozi eŋarehuc juzepac, no hâpoc‐ŋopahuc ŋezic‐ŋopazepac.
“Ŋoŋe mohec sâc mocjaha epemurâ muŋgopieŋ, me mohec sâc hecnuzo muŋgopieŋ? Me more hawari jaha epemurâ erao ʒuhucnurâ sâc bacnuŋgopieŋ?
Jaŋe kânoŋkonec gol hoŋkepie wahaekac â siliwa sigelio râepie feekac erâ golzi wiac bapa e nemuɋâŋ bajareocte furine râcneeŋgopieŋ, erâ e dieŋzi herâ numucneeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ɋâŋ i hâpo raku dodoma‐ticnao âkendâŋnepie domaekac, eme ira domahuc moc mi waha raocmu. Ehame moczi mu wâwâsic ecneme dâŋ moc mi bâtikiecneocmu, ehuc ʒârâ hâriŋ‐ticnaonec mi bataraocmu.
“Maŋrâŋgeŋhec ŋoŋe irec manasurâ mimieniŋ, erâ maŋzi manatâc qâtâc eniŋ.
Fuŋnaonecteaŋ wiac fowarewec irec manasuniŋ: No hâcne Anutu, norao ʒuhuckerâ moc mi jukac; no hâcne Anutu, no iŋucne moc mi jujâmbâŋkekac.
No hâcne ʒâhec wiac fuazokac i fuŋnaonecteaŋ mutaniŋkehuc juwefupo, â wiac fuawec irec dâŋ i mârâc sasac jaha mufuapo, ehuc mupo: ‘No dâŋ mupaŋkepo i deŋkeocmu â mana biric efârepo i wâc fârine bâfuapemu.’
No ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec tucwipe moc wiracnepemu, e mâreŋ ʒorickonec ŋic moc hâcne, eki mumupaŋ‐nanere fârine bâfuazejec. No dâŋ mupaŋkepo sâc i mupe deŋkezejec, no mana biric epo sâc i fârine bâfuazepac.
“Maŋrâŋgeŋhec juhuc bâbâpiaŋ maickerâ mi jueŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe nore dâŋte hazec râeniŋ.
Noraonec bâbâpiaŋ i mupe maic‐ŋopazo ekac, taicko mocwâc mi fokac, ehame bafic‐ŋopazore ŋeŋec ʒeʒepec mi epemu. No mupe Zioŋko bâbâpiaŋ fuarâ fozejec â huriri qâreŋ‐nane i Israe erao fua taniŋkezejec.”
O ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ, Babere otâ, go popoonec waharâ wândocko ŋec! Kaldea ŋic jaŋere otâ go eri ŋeŋe tâmiric mâc mâreŋko waha ŋec! Manakic, gore ʒiŋuc mocwâc mi muzo: Joroc kogoc sahac hawari biaŋgehec.
Go kiŋaŋ naru iŋucne gie omane bahuc juzemec, go rurufage batararâ ŋaqi ʒorage heunuckec â qorucge qafiruŋkerâ dokâge mâc foha opâ fotâcnec.
Go biuctac jutecne mimige tâtâc fuazejec. No okac babazu gie bahuc ŋic moc mi akickepemu.
Fifirue‐nâŋec, Israere Tiri rune, ʒâŋene “Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ” e iŋuc mukac.
Kaldea ŋic otâ‐jeŋic, go niniŋkerâ ŋec erâ dapâcko raʒic; manakic, go ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋokac bomboŋ mocwâc mi mugarezo!
No ŋicfâc‐nane kimbeŋ qajarehuc â biŋefâc‐nane ŋic omane mujarehuc gore meo râec‐jopape fembiŋ; goki ine busâqoc mi mana‐jaremeŋ, ehuc ŋic ŋokac qizecne jaŋere faio tagi ŋemâcne jâmbâŋ râetec fewec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc manasumeŋ: “Noni hâcne ŋokac bomboŋ juraʒihuc jupemu sanaŋ,” ehuc ʒâhec wiac weniŋuc fuaocmu irec manasuhuc manatâc qâtâc mi emeŋ.
“No hâcne jukopac ʒi, no iŋucne moc mi jukac; no hozec erâ juju i mi epemu erâ ŋokac mesawane wâc mi jujâmbâŋkepemu,” go iŋuc muhuc aŋac faio â manabâc tâmiric jukomeczi kecʒiŋuc manac:
Hozec juju â naru motec tâmiric juju, wiac jajahec izi ʒoaŋ mocjahao ututuŋ jaha fua‐gareocmu; jâmbomac, i qaŋgec bapa mâsige bocjaha â riuc bapare tâpiri sâkoge foipie‐gareha sifu fua‐gare‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.
Go sindaŋ ehuc manabâc tâmiric jumeŋ, ehuc mumeŋ: “Moczi moc mi honecnuekac”; maŋfânâŋ erâ mamanagezi maŋ bâsifuc egareme qâsoriehuc maŋgezi ʒiŋuc mumeŋ: “No hâcne jukopac ʒi, no iŋucne moc mi jukac.”
Ʒi ine ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio ferâ qaŋgec batec mi rârieocmu; sisipiriczi sahacgao feocmu i sahac tahage râetec sifu mi hetiricguocmu. Ima bâroŋ ʒâŋe furuge moc izi hâcne maicguocmu.
Qaŋgec wiacge â riuc ripage bocjaha ɋiegaonecteaŋ bahuc juwefumeŋ i fua taniŋkerâ bac me! Eme izi sâcne baficguocmu mecne â wiac mukicne i jâpeme raocmu mecne.
Go dâŋ bocjaha manasu biric ehuctecne betaŋkemeŋ; irec sambâŋte fuŋne mamana â bâpiŋte fuŋne mamana jaŋe fua taniŋkerâ baficgunʒepieŋ; jaŋe hâcne go wemo wiac fua‐gareocmu i mosa wahaekac sâc mufua‐gareeŋgopieŋ.
Manakic, jaŋe ʒoczi sopâcko herâ ʒâseŋkeekac irec sâc, ʒocbâruŋko sahac‐jeŋic ŋezickeniŋte eipieniŋmu, i ʒocmimiŋzi sahac‐nâŋec hâroŋkeekac iŋucne mâcne, erâ orâŋkehuc ruaeŋgopeneŋ iŋucne wâc aricne.
Ɋiegaonecteaŋ âgo ejarecmurâ gie sâko bameŋ, me gohec wiac nareŋ gareŋ ehuc jumbiŋ jaŋe iŋucne sasawa; jaŋe tâtierâ moc e mocko raocmu â moc e mocko raocmu, ehuc moczi moc mi baficguocmu.
Jakobore kikefuŋ, Israe ʒâŋe muŋarekicne, Judare bifuŋkonec fuambiŋ, â Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo ɋetickehuc dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ erâ dâŋ fâri qizecnere â tiŋne hatao mi juhuc sifu Israere Anutu mutaniŋkeeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe hazec râeniŋ!
Ŋoŋe tiri haere ʒâŋe bajuhuc Israere Anutu, ʒâŋene Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, erao roweckeeŋgopieŋ hâcne.
“Juwicnao wiac fuawec i mârâc jaha mufuapo, irec dâŋ i micnaneonec wahawec erâ musokape manambiŋ; eme no ututuŋ jaha mupe fârinehec ewec.
I ʒiŋuc manahuc epo: Go râŋgeŋ bârâŋgeŋne â upe ruage i aeŋ iŋucne â ʒâŋe maige i aeŋ bâbâroŋ irec sâc.
No esecne gazapo â mi fuahame mufua‐garepo i ʒiŋuc muzicte: ‘Nemu‐nanezi ewec, â nemuɋâŋ‐nane jâczi fasaekicne â aeŋzi bakicne eki mume fuawec!’
“Go wiac i hone manac efârerâ mutaniŋkezore mi mukomec me? No miŋecgac fuŋkerâ dâŋ ɋâricne â soŋne kâuc bahuc jumeŋ i mufua‐garepe manazemec.
Mârâc jaha mâcne, ʒine hâcne wiac i bâfuakopac; go juwicnao irec biŋe moc mi manameŋ, kecʒiŋuc muzicte: ‘Hâc, i mârâc jaha manapo i!’
Aricne, go irec dâŋ moc mi manameŋ, kâuc bahuc jumeŋ hâcne, erâ dameŋ ira hazecge mi uŋtowec. No ine fuŋnege ʒiŋuc manapo, go doc bapa, erâ ʒâŋege ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: Neŋgoc bumaŋkonecteaŋ maŋrâŋgeŋhec juju.
“No ʒâŋe‐nanere erâ kimbeŋ‐nane qamasekopac â go mi sipirickecmurâ gore manasuhuc ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanere erâ bunane bâmâteŋkekopac.
Manakic, no siliwa ʒocko rikepie wosâeekac irec sâc mâcne, ʒârâ hâriŋte ʒocbâruŋko ba esâic egarekopac.
Ʒâŋe‐nane musoriŋkenʒipiŋte no nahacnere erâ ejâmbâŋkekopac; â ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane i ŋic moc râcnepe mi rauckezejec.
“O Jakobo, go dâŋnanere hazec râec, â Israe hefârecgupo go manac: No ijaha jupozi jukopac, no bâbâni erâ wâc ʒâhec.
Nore mezi mâreŋte hobeteŋne râewec â mefâre‐nanezi sambâŋ fârewec forakac; no wira‐jactehape izia mâmâc jaha faharepic domakopirec.
“Ŋoŋe sasawa tumaŋnerâ mananiŋ! Jaŋeraonec mozi wiac i sasawa musokawec? Wofuŋzi maŋjauŋ ecneekac eki hâcne dâŋ mu biric ewec irec fârine Babe hae rune jaŋerao bâfuaocmu â Kaldea ŋic jaŋerao meticnere fuŋne bataniŋkeocmu.
Noni hâcne mupo, noni wira hefârec ecnepo, noni mupe ware fisiwec, eme gie‐ticne bame fârinehec eocmu.
Ŋoŋe nore maio ware fuarâ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mananiŋ: No fuŋnaonecteaŋ dâŋ soŋne moc mi mupo, aricne, no juhape jaha wiac fuarâ fowarewec.” Ʒi ine Wofuŋ Anutuzi no â Mâro‐ticne nâhe sorec‐nâfowec.
Wofuŋ, fifiruege, Israere Tiri rune eki ʒiŋuc mukac: “Noni Wofuŋ gore Anutu, noni hâcne juhâmocmurâ dâŋ qazu‐gareekopac ehuc hata âtecmurâ mugarekicne ira jowacguekopac.
Go micdâŋ‐nane mana rereŋ enʒaŋ muzac wamage i opâ sâko iŋucne ezac â tiŋne jujuge i hâwec siri qaekac iŋucne.
Ehame naru motecfâcge jaŋere ʒare i moŋgeŋ iŋucne ezac â ɋâricfâcge jaŋe moŋgeŋ uucne iŋucne fuanʒapiŋ; eme ʒâŋe‐jeŋic i nore maio sifuckerâ mi omaezac.”
Ŋoŋe Babe haeonec wahaniŋ, Kaldea mâreŋkonec wiserâ raniŋ! Erâ ʒeri fânâŋ ehuc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc musawepie mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao fisime mananʒepieŋ: “Wofuŋ e kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Jakobo firuewec.”
Jaŋe mâreŋ sawao jowac‐jopaha opâre moc mi hâmombiŋ; e qânâ bâmârâŋkeme opâ waha‐jarewec, e qânâ qâfâuckeme opâ sâronehec wahahuc fowec.
“Ŋic hehesicne jaŋerao wama fuarâ fofo i mi fokac,” Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
Nucne nucne ŋoŋe dâŋ mupe mananiŋ, â ʒorickonec ŋicne ŋicne ŋoŋe hazec râeniŋ: Wofuŋzi fuapoonecteaŋ hefârecnuwec, neŋgoc bumaŋko fohape ʒâŋe‐nane mufuawec.
E micnane ʒika micnehec iŋucne bâfuawec, ehuc meticnezi bâsoŋnuwec; e tepe motec mictara iŋucne bacnuwec, ehuc foŋticnao soŋnuwec.
Erâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Israe go kiŋaŋ qaqa‐nane, no gorao hâcne ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane bafaharepemu.”
No ine ʒiŋuc manasupo: “No gie sâko maŋgâŋ bapo, â tâpiri‐nane i fârine moc mi bâfuahuc maŋgâŋ jâmbâŋ sipirickepo; eme Wofuŋ e sifu dâŋnane dopeckekac â furi‐nane i Anutu‐nanerao fokac.”
Ʒi ine neŋgoc bumaŋko fuŋkerâ kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne bâfuacnuwec Wofuŋ eki hâcne Jakobore ŋicfâc erao bârisiec‐jopapemurâ â Israe ŋic erao hetumaŋ‐jopapemurâ mukac; Wofuŋzi nore maname fekac hâcne, â Anutu‐nanezi tâpiri‐nane ekac.
E ʒiŋuc mukac: “Go Jakobore kikefuŋ gurune gurune bafaharec‐jopazore sawa mâcne, â Israere ŋic tiwâne mocwâc bârisiec‐jopazore sawa kiŋaŋŋic‐nane mi bacgukopac, aricne, go ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ʒoctamac râecgupe bâbâpiaŋ‐nanezi raku mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao fisizejec.”
Ŋic jaŋe hone suŋgiŋ ecneeŋgopieŋ â ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe qaisockeeŋgopieŋ erâ ŋicbomboŋ jaŋere kiŋaŋ qaqa jukac e hâcne Wofuŋ, Israere fifirue â Tiri runezi ʒiŋuc âzâcnekac: “Ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe honecgurâ gore maio faharenʒepieŋ â fekicne jaŋe fodape‐garenʒepieŋ, i Wofuŋ erâ‐eesanaŋ â Israere Tiri runezi go bâwosâecgupo nore erâ iŋuc enʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “No aki anonoc dameŋko mana‐garepo â bâbâpiaŋte dameŋko baficgupo, erâ ŋezicguhuc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic fuaocte râecgupo, eme go mâreŋ bafaharerâ merâfâc wiac ima bakicne i kâdoc qajarezemec.
Ehuc kâpâcwâru ŋic ʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘Ŋoŋe wahaniŋ,’ â dapâcko ŋeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe jazac, ‘Ŋoŋe fua taniŋkeniŋ!’ Jaŋe hatamecko nânâ nâhuc junʒepieŋ â tiki burocne sasawa ira nânâ opâ‐jeŋic bâfuanʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe nânâ opâre moc mi hâmonʒepieŋ â mâŋâŋ fâronezi me ʒoaŋzi qa qâʒâic mi ejarezejec, i busâqoc mana‐jareekaczi jowac‐jopa raku opâ ʒâŋeo râec‐jopaocmu irec.
No tiki‐nane sasawa hewâneŋkepe hata efâreocmu â hata sâko‐nane mupe biaŋkezejec.
Manakic, gâcne jaŋe ʒorickonec wareniŋmu, â gâcne jaŋe mâreŋ faickonec â ʒoaŋ huhunaonec â gâcne jaŋe Sewenim mâreŋkonec fisiniŋmu.”
Sambâŋne sambâŋne ŋoŋe semuja heniŋ, mâreŋ go ʒeri fânâŋ ec, â tiki ŋoŋe kiwac qawac eniŋ! Wofuŋ e ŋicfâc‐ticne bâmiriŋ‐jopawec, e qarâ suriŋnefâc‐ticne busâqoc mana‐jarewec hâcne.
Zioŋ kikefuŋ eki ʒiŋuc mukac: “Wofuŋ e behecnuwec, Wofuŋ‐nanezi nore nikeckewec.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋokac moc e weniŋuc erâ kogoc‐ticnere sâcne nikeckeocmu, ehuc bumaŋ‐ticnaonec motec fuawec ere busâqoc mi manaocmu? Ŋokac jaŋe irec moc nikec‐jopaocmu mecne, no ine gore moc mi nikecnuocmu.
Manakic, no metape jahec‐naneo qâreŋgupo, qânâsacge i dameŋ sâc honehuc jukopac.
Heɋârehuc bâpiaŋguniŋmuzi fâro ehuc fisiŋgopieŋ; sipiricguhuc ima bacgumbiŋ jaŋe ine behecgurâ raŋgopieŋ.
Go qâhâŋnerâ rârec rârec ʒâŋe fitec rame honec: Jaŋe sasawa qâturerâ gorao fisiŋgopieŋ. Wofuŋzi mukac: No jujâmbâŋkekopaczi mukopac, go ŋic i jaŋe sasawa eri iŋucne qonaŋ‐jopazemec, ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ moczi umbika‐ticne jomaekac irec sâc jomac‐jopazemec.
“Jâmbomac, fic haege heropiekicne sesucne sawa fokac â mâreŋge ima bakicne i piticnere dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ŋecjucfâc‐ticne mocwâc mi sâcjopaocmu, ehame sipiricgumbiŋ jaŋe ʒoricko jufâreniŋmu.
Eme naru motec tâmiric jukomec gore ɋâricfâc fuarâ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mupie hazecgao huocmu: ‘No hae mâreŋ ʒirec manape piticne ekac, irec go sawane moc bâfua‐naretec ŋec juc ezepac.’
Goki ine maŋgao ʒiŋuc mucmu: ‘Keci jaŋe mozi rocjopa‐narewec? No hufiŋne erâ naru motec tâmiric jupo, no kâpâcwâruo bacnu rakicne â jâpecnukicne; ehame keci jaŋe mozi hone maiŋ ejareha sokambiŋ? No tiwâne bucnane jupo i! Eme keci jaŋe wenirec warembiŋ?’”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, no menane ŋicne ŋicne jaŋeraopec bâfeŋnepemu â ŋic gurune gurune qeŋ qajarepemu; eme jaŋe ŋokâfâcge amec‐jopa wareniŋmu â otâfâcge âsic‐jopaniŋmu.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi mamac nânâ bâfâuc egarehapie ŋokac wofuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe neŋgoc egareniŋmu. Erâ dape‐garehuc ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋiczi mâreŋko hetutuckeniŋmu, ehuc kikegao gâc wândoc fokac i apuruniŋmu. Iŋuc fuame nore ʒiŋuc mana taracmu: E hâcne Wofuŋ, ere mamanac jueŋgopieŋzi mi qurutuaniŋmu.”
Ŋic tâpirihec moc e ʒikao mafa mateŋ‐ticne rowec i sâcne jâoc rozo me? Me kâpâcwâru bacjopakicne jaŋe ŋic qac momori ere meonec sâcne batarac‐jopazo me?
Manakic, Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Jâmbomac, kâpâcwâru bacjopakicne jaŋe ŋic tâpirihec ere meonec sâcne babatarac‐jopane â ŋic qac momori e mafa mateŋ rowec sâcne jâjâoc rone wâc. Eme râsi egareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe no nahac râsi ejarezepac, ehuc nonizia wâc ŋokâfâcge bafic‐jopazepac.
Bâbâʒâicfâcge jaŋe ejarepe jaŋacne biuc nânʒepieŋ â jaŋacne soc i waiŋ opâ iŋucne nâkupie maŋsifuc ejarezejec. Eme mâreŋŋic sasawa jaŋe nore ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ: Wofuŋzi hâcne Jakobore tâpiri wânʒâŋ erâ wâc bâbâpiaŋ â fifirue‐ticne jukac.”
Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Hâc, neŋgoc‐ŋeŋic behehuc sorepo irec pasi weni? Me mo ŋictao tofa‐nane fowecte erao furire erâ qikiŋ‐ŋopazapo? Manaŋgopieŋ, no sâqocne‐ŋeŋicte erâ qikiŋ‐ŋopapo â neŋgoc‐ŋeŋic e sindaŋ‐ŋeŋicte erâ sorepe rawec.
No wemocte warerâ ŋic moc mi bâfuac‐jopapo, no wemocte wirape micnaneo moc mi rombiŋ? Menane bâmbembeŋkekicne irec fifirue gie sâcne mi bapemu me? Me babatara gie bazore tâpiri‐nane omaewec me? Manaŋgopieŋ, hahanec dâŋnanere hâwec kereŋkeocmu â opâ sâko jaŋe ʒickerâ kereŋkeniŋmu, eme qowifâcne jaŋe opâ basahuc hâmo gârec erâ âsu finiŋmu.
No sambâŋ i dapâczi foŋkepemu â târu hecnepe hurâ ŋaqi‐ticne eocmu.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi ŋic betaŋkekicne mu keteŋ ejarepemurâ micnane baafeckewec. E furic sâc wiwicnuekac, wosâekicne jaŋere sâcko dâŋ manapemurâ hazec‐nane bâuŋtoekac hâcne.
Wofuŋ Anutu e hazec‐nane bâuŋtowec, ehame no mi râŋgeŋkecnepo erâ wâc rârâpe mi wisepo.
Qa bâʒâic enarembiŋ jaŋe râpe‐nane sicne‐jarepo, â mecʒâwâ‐nane unuckembiŋ jaŋe mauc jahec‐nane sicne‐jarepo; musâqorecnuhuc tâfecnupie ʒâŋe mai‐nane mi bâsoŋkepo.
Wofuŋ Anutu eki ine baficnuekacte mi qurutuapemu; no irec hâcne ʒâŋe mai‐nane bârisiepe qânâ sanaŋ iŋucne ewec. Erâ manakopac, mimi busâqoczi fai‐naneo mi feocmu.
Nore dâŋ dopeckeekaczi bembeŋko jukac. Mozi dâŋko râecnuzo mukac? Nâhe mâmâc mai fua taniŋkenac. Mozi dâŋko râsi enareocmu? E norao ware fuazejec.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ Anutuzi baficnuekac irec mozi musâqorecnuocmu? Manaŋgopieŋ, wâfuzi ŋaqi qoruc nanʒaŋnepie omaeekac irec sâc jaŋe ʒeŋgoma ʒaŋkerâ omaeniŋmu.
Ŋoŋeraonec moczi Wofuŋ araŋ bacneocmu e kiŋaŋŋic‐ticnere dâŋ mana rereŋ ezejec, â moc e dapâcko ʒoc moc mi tamaecneha hata raocmuzi Wofuŋte ʒâŋere mamanac juhuc Anutu‐ticnerao roweckezejec.
Manaŋgopieŋ, ʒoc ruqeeŋgopieŋ â waha qazeeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe sasawa ŋaŋacne ʒocbâruŋko â waha qazembiŋ irec maŋnao raʒinʒepieŋ. Wiac i ʒâic serereŋ manahuc foniŋte menanezi bâfua‐ŋareocmu.
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Tiŋne jujure henʒiriŋneeŋgopieŋ â Wofuŋ wira basac ecneeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe dâŋ mupe mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe haroŋaŋzi bacŋopakicne haroŋaŋ i honeniŋ, â nombâŋkonec qânâ rorâ bacŋopakicne nombâŋ i honeniŋ!
Ŋoŋe mamac‐ŋeŋic Abraham erao ʒâŋe fipie raoc, â Sarazi rocŋopawec erao mâmâc. Manaŋgopieŋ, e ɋâric tâmiric buc juhame rowosâepo, erâ jambuŋkehuc basawepo.
Jâmbomac, Wofuŋ e Zioŋ mu bâmiriŋ ecneocmu, ehuc fic hae‐ticne heropiekicne sasawa i bafahareocmu â mâreŋ‐ticne niniŋ siarereŋ fokac i hetikieme Edeŋ mâreŋ iŋucne eocmu, erâ mâreŋ‐ticne hahaŋkekicne i hetikieme Wofuŋte jufu gie irec sâc eocmu. Iŋuc fuame hae irec maŋnao ʒeri bubiaŋ â daŋge mumuteŋ erâ gaere micʒonʒoŋ fuame mananiŋmu.
“Ŋic gurune gurune ŋoŋe dâŋ mupe mananiŋ â ŋicne ŋicne ŋoŋe dâŋnanere hazec râeniŋ; noraonec hâcne mumutâc dâŋ fuarâ raocmu â mumutiŋ dâŋnane i ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere ʒoctamac eocmu.
Dâŋnane tiŋnezi maic‐ŋopakac â bâbâpiaŋ‐nane i fuawec; menanezi ŋic gurune gurune jaŋerao okac babazu gie bapemu â nucne nucne jaŋe ŋezic‐jopapemurâ nore mamanac juniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe qâhâŋnerâ sambâŋkopec ʒâŋe finiŋ â mâreŋko fipie huoc! manaŋgopieŋ, sambâŋ e hosâc iŋucne omaeocmu â mâreŋ e ŋaqi iŋucne sucke ʒaŋ eocmu, erâ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe mâkâc iŋucne hâmoniŋmu. Nore bâbâpiaŋzi ine fofo sanaŋ foocmu â erâ‐eesanaŋ‐nane i tatarane tâmiric.
“Tiŋnere fuŋne manaeŋgopieŋ â maŋŋeŋicko sâcmutâc dâŋnane foekac ŋoŋe mupe mananiŋ! Ŋoŋe ŋiczi qaisoc‐ŋopapie mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec â mu ruruc eŋarepie sahac‐ŋeŋic mi gâgâmârâzejec.
Manaŋgopieŋ, jaŋe wâfu qoʒazaŋzi ŋaqi iŋucne nâcjopaniŋmu â kurumbuczi ŋaqi ʒâwânehec iŋucne nâcjopaniŋmu. Nore bâbâpiaŋzi ine fofo sanaŋ foocmu â hone bafic ee‐nane i mimiŋzi ɋâric fohuc juocmu sanaŋ.”
Wofuŋte me, go sanaŋ qaŋqaŋkec, ehuc tâpirihec ec! Go mârâc sasac jaha jâmbâŋ, ŋic gaŋne gaŋne fuŋkerâ juhapie sanaŋkemeŋ irec sâc sanaŋ qaŋqaŋkec! Me mozi Rahaba qâfâuckewec â oâ âke mârâŋkewec, i goki mi emeŋ me?
Me mozi mume hâwec ʒâkâŋ sâko kereŋkewec; me firuec‐jopakicne jaŋe hâwec fotâcneniŋte mozi mume hâwec fâhâŋnezi hata ewec, i goki mi emeŋ me?
Eme Wofuŋ e firuec‐jopakicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe risierâ ʒeri fânâŋ ehuc Zioŋko fisiniŋmu, eme jaŋerao bubiaŋ fofo sanaŋ foocmu. Eme ʒeri bubiaŋ fua‐jareha mu mamakuc â kio wâwâsic izi ine omaeocmu.
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “No hâcne hemiriŋguekopac; go ine mo, irec ŋic hâmoeŋgopieŋ jaŋere mecne â ŋicte ɋâric kecɋaŋ iŋucne hâmo ɋaŋac eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere mâmâc hâwicguekac?
Ehame Wofuŋ bâbâfuage sambâŋ fârewec forakac â mâreŋte hobeteŋ râewec ere nikecguekac, ehuc râsigezi sipiricguocte maŋne domawec ere aaricte wâc dameŋ sâc hâwicguekac. Ʒi ine bâʒâicguekac ere aaric i weni?
Ŋic kâpâcwâru bakicne e biac jaha firueniŋmu, eme hâmorâ nombâŋko mi huocmu â nânâ‐ticne wâc mi basaocmu.
No Wofuŋ, gore Anutu hâcne, no hâwec itiriŋkepe siri‐ticne wânʒâŋnehec qaekac, no ʒâŋe‐nane ‘Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ’.
No dâŋnane micgao râepo erâ menanere mumucko soŋgupo, ehuc sambâŋ fârepo â mâreŋte hobeteŋ râepo erâ Zioŋ rune ʒiŋuc jazapo: ‘Ŋicfâc‐nane ŋoŋe hâcne.’”
O Jerusalem, go mana ɋâɋârerâ faharec! Go Wofuŋ menao kimbeŋ‐ticnere râqâc bajuwec irecnec nâmeŋ, ehuc maŋsifuc bâbâfuare râqâc irec fârine nâku nâzickemeŋ.
Naru motec rocjopa‐fârewec jaŋeraonec moczi moc mi jowawec â naru motec hone maiŋ ejareha sokambiŋ jaŋeraonec moczi menao moc mi rowec.
Wiac jajahec, ima bapa â sisipiric, nânâre hâhâmo â ʒika izi faigao feme gore erâ mozi ki mamakuc ewec me hemiriŋguwec?
Sâeczi uficko jowarâ foekac, irec sâc motecfâcge jaŋe Wofuŋte kimbeŋ â Anutugere hahanec dâŋ izi gapec‐jopame haere hata sosohocko hâmocne tinac fombiŋ.
Irec bâʒâicgukicne â waiŋ opâ mi nâmeŋzi sifu maŋsifuc egarekac go ʒiŋuc manac:
Wofuŋ Anutuge, e ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere dâŋ dopeckeekaczi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, no maŋsifuc râqâc, kimbeŋ‐nanere râqâc hâcne, megezi badomakic i gowac rokopac; eme go ʒuhuckerâ mocwâc mi nâzemec.
Eme no râqâc i bâbâʒâicfâcge ʒiŋuc gazambiŋ jaŋere meo râepemu: ‘Go mâreŋko waha foc, eme nâŋe gore faio âterâ ranʒepeneŋ.’ Eme jaŋe faigao âterâ raniŋte go waha fohaŋtec râpegezi mâreŋhec sâc mocjaha erâ hata iŋucne ewec.”
O Zioŋ, go mana ɋâɋârec, ehuc tâpiri rorâ sanaŋkec! O Jerusalem, tiri hae, go eri ŋaqige hetec huoc! Manakic, ŋic ma tâmiric â wânâŋhec jaŋe haemaŋgao mocwâc mi raʒinʒepieŋ.
O Jerusalem hae, kâpâcwâru bacgukicne, go sahacgaonec gâc wândoc itiriŋketec wahame faharec; o Zioŋte otâ, upegao niŋgiŋ fokac i firuetec wahaoc.
Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: “Ŋoŋe furi tâmiric bacŋopa rakicne irec moneŋ tâmiric jaha batarac‐ŋopazo.
Wofuŋ Anutu e kecʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe Aigita mâreŋko jaba juniŋte mârâc jaha ira humbiŋ; eme ʒâhec Asiria ŋic jaŋe fuŋne tâmiricko bâʒâic‐jopambiŋ.
Ʒiŋuczia ine ʒira wemo wiac fua‐narekac, Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac; ŋicfâc‐nane furi tâmiric bacjopa rakicne i; bomboŋ ejareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe aŋara heeŋgopieŋ, ehuc ʒâŋe‐nane i ʒoaŋ sâc ʒuʒuhuc jaha musoriŋkeeŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
Irec ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe ʒâŋe‐nane mana taranʒepieŋ; ehuc ʒoaŋ ira ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ, noni hâcne dâŋ ʒiŋuc muekopac: No ʒine hâcne.”
Kiŋaŋ warekac, joroc kike biaŋ, ohec ohec, tiki hatao biŋe biaŋ barâ fisikac. Wama dâŋ muhuc juju biaŋte biŋe bawarekac, ehuc bâbâpiaŋ dâŋ musokakac. Zioŋ âzâcnekac: “Anutugezi ŋicwofuŋ gie bakac.”
Hazec râeniŋ, ruc bapa ŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic qâturerâ ʒeri gae marac sâko heŋgopieŋ, ʒâŋezi hohonec ehuc mana ʒiziweŋgopieŋ: Wofuŋzi Zioŋko risie warekac.
Ajoc, Jerusalem hae sesucne sesucne, gae micʒonʒoŋ‐ŋeŋic fuaoc, Wofuŋzi ŋicfâcne bâmiriŋ‐jopakac, Jerusalem niŋgiŋ‐ticne goroŋkekac.
Wofuŋzi tiri tâpiri‐ticne bâfuakac, ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere maio. Mâreŋ qaŋeŋne jaŋe iŋuc jaha Anutu‐nâŋecte bâbâpiaŋ hone‐fâreniŋmu.
Wiserâ raniŋ, wiserâ raniŋ, Babe haeonec waharâ raniŋ, ehuc wiac mamakâcne ba bâuac moc mi eniŋ; Wofuŋte râqâc wiac ameckeeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe hae irec maŋnaonec waharâ raniŋ, â maŋsahac‐ŋeŋic ʒure ɋaɋackeniŋ!
Ŋoŋe fâro ehuc mi wahanʒepieŋ erâ ʒocnehec mi wisenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋzi bânie‐ŋareocmu â Israere Anutu e râpefuŋ‐ŋeŋicko fâhuc juocmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, kiŋaŋŋic‐nane e gie‐ticne bame fârinehec eocmu, e fahareme dopeckezo, eme fekicne sâko erâ juocmu.
Sahac‐ticne ŋic gâcne jaŋere sâc mi bâfuahuc mamakâcne ewec â hawari‐ticne i ŋic nâŋâcne iŋucne wâc aricne, irec ŋic bocjaha jaŋe e honehuc bipic‐jeŋic taraocmu.
Eme ŋicguru bocjahazi iŋuc jaha wareckeniŋmu, ehame ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe ere erâ fâsâerâ domaniŋmu; jaŋe wiac ʒâŋe furu honeniŋmu â dâŋ hazec furu mananiŋmu irec.
Biŋedâŋ hazec‐nâŋecko huwec i mozi mana ʒakiewec? Â Wofuŋte mâsi qâreŋ i mo ŋiczi hone tarawec?
E mai‐ticnao jâcbâpâŋ iŋucne fua sokac ewec, â mâreŋ hahaŋkekicnao jâcgâtâ gitec heekac irec sâc. E weniŋuc erâ hawari‐ticne qacfiricne eha honebâckenʒapeŋ, â weniŋuc erâ qâreŋ biaŋ‐ticne moc fuame ere aŋac‐nâpozac?
Ŋiczi mana takic ecnehuc bâsuembiŋ, e ʒâicmaŋko juhuc ʒârâ hâriŋ rauckewec, ŋic moc hone takic ecnehuc ʒâŋe titiki fieŋgopeneŋ ere sâc, mana takic ecnepie honepene omane ewec.
Jâmbomac, e nâŋâcne ʒârâ hâriŋ dewec, â nâŋâcne ʒâic âsickewec. Nâŋâc ine mumbeŋ, e ʒikare biŋe, Anutuzi qa bâʒâic ecnekac hâcne.
Nâŋâcne qaqatarare erâ soc ruawec, nâŋâcne hehesicte qanʒaŋnembiŋ. Fainao ʒika fewec izi bâpiaŋ‐nâpowec, â ere wiczi nâŋâcne wic bâsomiewec.
Nâŋâc mâmâc sasawa lama iŋucne qâsoriembeŋ, maŋ bucnâŋec hatane hatane âtembeŋ. Eme Wofuŋzi hehesic‐nâŋec sasawa i ere faio râe‐fârewec.
Jaŋe imackepie e mana uruewec, ehuc micticne moc mi aŋkewec; lama motecne hezuniŋte baraeŋgopieŋ, me neŋgocne kanʒaŋ bâbâtâc ŋic erao fâsâerâ domaekac, iŋuc hâcne micticne mi aŋkewec.
Fific guguriŋ ecneku dâŋticne mutararâ tuŋkepie rawec. Eme juha jumbiŋ jaŋeraonec mozi ʒiŋuc manazac: Nore gurufâc nâŋere qaqatarare erâ qakicne? Ehuc mâreŋko juju nâŋâcne guruonec bârâriekicne?
Ʒâŋeruŋ‐ticne i ŋic sindaŋne jaŋerao mucnembiŋ i hâmohame mafaŋic moctao bâfuacnembiŋ. Ʒika moc mi bâuwaha â micticnao eeatuc dâŋ moc mi foha iŋuc ecnekicne.
Sifu Wofuŋzi maname sâckeha qanʒaŋnembiŋ, ehuc ʒâic sâko bâfuacnembiŋ. Eme kiŋ taraocte e jahac sâqocnere due bame tarame ɋâricfâcne fuapie honec‐jopazejec â dameŋ ʒora juraʒizejec, â Wofuŋte dâŋbiri giene bakume fârio qazejec.
Maŋticnezi ʒâic serereŋ manawecte fârine fuame honerâ maŋne taraocmu. Tiŋne rune, kiŋaŋŋic‐nane e mamana‐ticnezi ŋic bocjaha bafic‐jopame tiŋkeniŋmu, â kiŋbahac‐jeŋic i eki âsickeocmu.
Irec hâcne fekicne jaŋehec wiac kâdoc qacnepemu, â ʒika furi i momori jaŋehec bâtâc babac enʒepieŋ, e juju‐ticne qikiŋnehuc hâmocko utuckewecte, â sâqocne bapa jaŋere guruo huwecte. Erâ i bocjaha jaŋere sindaŋ âsickewec hâcne, ehuc sâqocne bapa jaŋere erâ numuwec.
“Ŋokac hufiŋne, motec mi roro go bubiaŋ manazemec, â gozi mi kicguekac go ʒeri ehuc kiwaezemec. Ŋokac ŋichec e ɋâric afecne fuacnehapie ɋâri hozezi naru motec bocjaha rocjopaocmu hâcne, Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
Go qoruc bozegere hae bâsokac, â ŋec juc eekic, irec qoruc mi sakarehuc qaratiec; repage fâretec raoc â fâzâge qatec hurâ sanaŋkeoc.
Go fâreopec mecne â qanaopec mecne qaratiehaŋtec ɋâricfâcge jaŋe ŋicne ŋicne rauc‐jopaniŋmu, ehuc hae behekicne i heɋârerâ ira ŋec juc eniŋmu.
“Mi hâwicguoc, go mi qurutuacmu; jaŋe mimi qaqa mi egareniŋmu, irec go mimi gaŋgaŋ mi ezemec, go socɋâri juhaŋtec mimi qaqa egarekicne irec nikecguzejec â hozec erâ busâqoc faio jumeŋ irec mocwâc mi manasuzemec.
Manakic, mamac bâbâfuagezi ŋowege jukac, ʒâŋe‐ticne ‘Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ’; Israere Tiri runezi fifiruege jukac, ʒâŋene ‘Mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec Anutu’.
Wofuŋzi hâcne ŋokac behekicne iŋucne busâqoc faio juhaŋtecne hefârecguwec; ŋic moc e socɋâri juhuc ŋokac bawec i wemocko qaisockeocmu, Anutugezi iŋuc mukac.
No dameŋ ŋondeŋ bembeŋne mac behecgupo, ʒi ine buuruc fekicne egarehuc hefârecgukopac.
Dameŋ ŋondeŋ mac moc kimbeŋ‐nanezi fâfâcnehec fahareme ʒâŋe mai‐nane jâmbomac bâsoŋke‐garepo, ʒi ine maŋjauŋ fofo sanaŋhec maŋuruc qagarekopac, Wofuŋ bâbâpiaŋgezi iŋuc hâcne mukac.
“No ʒi manape Noarao ekicne irec sâc ekac: Opâ rumi sâkozi mâreŋne mâreŋne mocwâc mi qâuruckeocte mupaŋkepo, iŋuc hâcne kimbeŋ mocwâc mi qagarezo â mumu hehec wâc mi egarezo mupaŋkekopac.
Tiki jaŋe râriezo murâ rârienʒepieŋ, mâreŋ facne jaŋe ŋeŋe‐jeŋic behezo murâ behenʒepieŋ, nore aki anonoczi ine moc mi rârie‐garezejec, â wamare ʒâʒâfic‐nanezi moc mi ŋeŋgoroŋkezejec, Wofuŋ maŋuruc qagareekaczi iŋuc hâcne mukac.
“O hae imacgukicne, go hoe mâŋâŋzi sipiricgukac, â bâbâmiriŋ moc mi fua‐garekac. Manakic, sacgere qânâ i simeŋzi basarickepemu, â hobeteŋge buse sanaŋzi râepemu.
Sacgere qenʒoŋne i qânâ sâsârekicnezi ba akic epemu, motâc sâkoge i qânâ bâbâroŋzi erickepemu, â sac fârine i wâc qânâ furi sâkozia bafârezo.
Motecfâcge sasawa Wofuŋzi mamana qazu‐jarezejec, eme wama fofo dunduŋ fojarezejec.
Go bâbâpiaŋ dâŋko basanaŋguzo; fific guguriŋzi taicko foha â sisipiriczi wâc mi maicguha hâhâwic tâmiric juzemec.
Manakic, ʒika moc fuaocmuo i nore micte aricne; moc e râsi egarehuc guocmu e ʒikagere nânâ eocmu.
Manakic, aeŋzi wiac bapa ŋic e ʒocmimiŋ ficneme ʒaha eebapa‐ticnere sâcko ʒikare wiac ba akic eekac e noni hâcne bâfuapo, â sisipiric ŋic e sisipiric gie baocte nonizia bâfuapo.
Go râsi egarehuc ʒikare wiac bakicne i fâri tâmiric efâreocmu; â dâŋko râecguniŋmu sasawa jaŋere fuŋne dâŋgieo rituzemec. Wiac izi hâcne Wofuŋ kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere merâfâc eekac â noraonec bâbâpiaŋ‐jeŋic fua‐jareekac, Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Me, opâre hâmoŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe opâo ware‐fâreniŋ, â moneŋ tâmiric juŋgopieŋzi ware wiac furi mâc ro nâc eniŋ. Ware waiŋ opâ â susu furine baniŋ, moneŋ tâmiric â okac babazu tâmiric rorâ nâniŋ.
Wemocte wiac mi nânânere moneŋ‐ŋeŋic beheŋgopieŋ? Â nâ gapec mi eenere ʒâic gie baŋgopieŋ? Dâŋnane paŋʒâic manarâ wiac biaŋne nâniŋ, wiac wokemaŋnehec nâhuc mana ʒiziweniŋ.
Hazec‐ŋeŋic râerâ norao wareniŋ, ehuc dâŋ manapie maŋ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋic ɋâreoc; eme Dawidihec ʒâʒâfic epec irec feŋeŋko ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic sanaŋ ezepac.
E hâcne ŋicguru jaŋere mumutaniŋ âkendâŋnepo, erâ micne â mumutâc jujareocte mucnepo.
Manakic, ŋicne ŋicne ʒâŋe ruruŋ‐jopakic i wira‐jarezemec, â kâuc bacguŋgopieŋzi gorao quruŋ herâ fisiniŋmu. Wofuŋ Anutuge â Israere Tiri rune ere erâ eniŋmu, eki gore ʒâŋe biŋe bafaharewec hâcne.
“Wofuŋ e bâbâfuane biaŋ juhame basanʒepieŋ, e bembeŋko juhame wiracnenʒepieŋ.
Sâqocne bapa e hata‐ticne behezejec, â hehesicnezi mamanasu‐ticne qikiŋnezejec; ehuc Wofuŋtao risieme maŋuruc qacneocmu, Anutu‐nâŋectao wareme kiŋticne buafec jaha behecneocmu.
Wiac nore mamanasu i ŋoŋere mamanasu mâcne, â ŋoŋere hata i nore hata mâcne, i Wofuŋzi mukac.
Sambâŋzi mâreŋ beherâ faic jâmbâŋ fokac, irec sâc nore hatazi ŋoŋere hata beherâ fekac, â nore mamanasuzi ŋoŋere mamanasu sirickekac.
“Hoe â titikuc jahe sambâŋkonec wahaekopirec, erâ ira mi ririsie mâreŋ bâgunuckeekopirec, ehuc gume he siwiŋ ecnekupire wâcwiac âkeʒuekac, eme hesaracte ukic â hobure nânâ fuaekac,
sâc ijaha nore mickonec dâŋ wahaocmuzi ezejec; i aputac erâ norao mâc mi risiezejec. Mâcne, no mana biric ecnekopac gie i bazejec, â hata kiŋaŋ sorekopac irec fârine bâfuazejec.
“Irec ŋoŋe ʒeri ehuc fahare ranʒepieŋ, eme wamao jowac‐ŋopazo. Rahapie mâreŋ tikine â facne jaŋe ʒeri bari eniŋmu, â kâtere jâczi ofac heŋareniŋmu.
Fâpâ uupic irec okacne ʒariŋ âkeʒuocmu, â ʒâŋte okacne ware imbirua fuaocmu. Eme i honehuc Wofuŋ muteŋkehuc juniŋmu; i ma fofo sanaŋ mi bâbârâriene eocmu.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Mumutiŋ dâŋ soŋaŋkenʒepieŋ â eebapa tiŋne bâfuanʒepieŋ, bâbâpiaŋ‐nane fuaocte â tiŋne juju‐nane fua taniŋkeocte dameŋne bembeŋkekac hâcne.
Ŋic moc e iŋuc eocmu ere manape ʒerine eocmu, â ŋic moc e hata i basanaŋkehuc sabata hombaŋ mi sipirickeocmu â meticne gie sâqocne bazacte soŋaŋkeocmu ere wâc manape ʒerine jaha eocmu.”
Ŋic jabane Wofuŋtao roweckeekaczi ʒiŋuc mi muzejec: “Wofuŋ e ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec behecnu‐jâmbâŋkekac”; erâ aputac bakicnezi ʒiŋuc wâc mi muzejec: “Manakic, no jâc hâmocne iŋucne.”
Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: “Ŋic aputac bacjopakicnezi sabata hombaŋ‐nane ŋefârehuc wiac aŋacnuekac i bâwosâerâ ʒâʒâfic‐nane sanaŋne bajuniŋmu,
jaŋe ficnaneo â haemaŋ‐naneo ma â ʒâŋe jarepemu, izi naru motechec juju sirickeocmu; no ʒâŋe fofo sanaŋ, mi hehetâmirene moc jarepemu hâcne.
“Eme ŋic furunezi Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacneniŋte â Wofuŋ ʒâŋe‐ticnere aŋac‐jopaha kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne erâ juniŋte erao qohotaeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic sasawa sabata hombaŋ mi sipirickeeŋgopieŋ erâ ʒâʒâfic‐nane soŋaŋkerâ bajueŋgopieŋ,
jaŋe hâcne tiri tiki‐naneo jowac‐jopa fepemu, erâ nunumu ficnaneo bubiaŋ qajarepemu; qowi hâcbuc ririkene â taha bâzi‐jeŋic i alata‐naneo rikepie mana aŋac epemu; ficnanere ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc muzo hâcne: Ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere nunumu fic.
Israe ŋic bâtâtiec‐jopakicne bâtumaŋ‐jopaekac, Wofuŋ Anutu hâcne e ʒiŋuc mukac: No hetumaŋ‐jopakicnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao ŋic gâcne wâc ʒuhuc‐jopahuc jupemu.”
Sopâc qowi sasawa â kâte qowi sasawa ŋoŋe ware nânâ nâniŋ!
Israere ruc bapa ŋicfâc jaŋe ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ, jaŋe mamana tâmiric sasawa, jaŋe qâto dâŋemâcne sasawa, qâŋkeniŋte eipieŋgopieŋ, jaŋe mâc fohuc guŋ manaeŋgopieŋ, otec fofore boc aŋac‐jopaekac hâcne.
Jaŋe qâto iŋucne nânâ âmbâŋ nâpie moc mi gapec‐jopaekac. Lama soŋaŋ jaŋe mamana tâmiric jaha, jaŋe ʒeŋgoma jaŋacne hatao raeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ru sâc moneŋ mafa huhure‐jeŋicte sawa manasueŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc mueŋgopieŋ: “Warepie waiŋ opâ rorâ nanaŋ, opâ sanaŋ âmbâŋ nânʒepeneŋ; eme miŋecgac fuakac sâc ijaha tomâcko fuazejec, erâ mocwâc aŋac ʒizinehec ezejec.”
Ŋic tiŋnezi sipirickeekac, eme moczi irec busâqoc moc mi manaekac; ŋic biaŋne hâmo sipiric ehapie moczi moc maname mi quŋkeekac. Jâmbomac, ŋic tiŋne e hehesicte erâ sipirickeekac.
Hata‐jeŋic fâretiŋ rahuc jueŋgopieŋ, i jaŋe wamao juniŋmu erâ fofo‐jeŋicko fomananiŋmu.
Qaŋgec bapa ŋokac ere motecfâc, boe sau â sasec ŋokac eraonec fuakicne ŋoŋe hâcne bembeŋko ʒira ware domaniŋ!
Ŋoŋe mo mu ruruc ecnezo muŋgopieŋ, me more dâŋ muniŋte micŋeŋic boc aŋkeme nameŋ qaŋgopieŋ? Me ŋoŋe qaqatara â eeatuc irec ɋâricfâc mi juŋgopieŋ me?
Ŋoŋe hâcne jâc ɋâricne nâkumuchec doma rakac irec fuŋnao ŋehuc maŋŋeŋiczi ɋâŋ qâqâtâcte bâruŋkeekac, ŋoŋe hâcne opâ wâcko haroŋaŋ uuŋnao naru motec hezu rikec ejareeŋgopieŋ.
Go opâ wâcko qânâ fâfâsâcne gahacne biŋe bâwosâec‐jopameŋ, eme qânâ i jaŋe okacne bâfua‐garenʒepieŋ. Go jaŋe hâcne taha bâzire waiŋ opâ hoŋke‐jaremeŋ â bâzi rike‐jaremeŋ. Eme wiac iŋucnezi bunane sâcne bâmâteŋkeocmu me?
Go tiki ʒoricne ʒora irec botâŋnao fofoge rumackemeŋ, erâ ira ferâ taha bâzi rikemeŋ wâc.
Motâc â motâcte wâtuŋ râpenao mage râemeŋ; go râpecnurâ fofoge bâpiaŋkemeŋ, erâ rumackerâ waha fomeŋ; go jaŋehec maŋ mocjaha erâ sasec gie bahuc mimi‐jeŋic honemeŋ.
Go wokemaŋ opâne â wiac âsune furi sâko bocjaha ameckerâ Moleke nemu erao rameŋ; go kiŋaŋŋicfâcge taicko sorec‐jopatec rambiŋ, i hârâcko sorec‐jopatec humbiŋ hâcne.
Go hata fuŋne fuŋne âtehuc ʒâic gie bahuc jumeŋ, ehuc sifu ʒiŋuc mi mumeŋ: “Gie i maŋgâŋ jaha bakopac.” Aricne, go irec tâpiri hati bâfuameŋte mi betaŋkemeŋ.
Go mo araŋ bacnehuc hâwicgume no eatucnumeŋ, ehuc nore mi manasumeŋ â manatec mi ŋemâckewec? Me fuŋne ʒiŋuc mi fokac me: No dameŋ ʒora dâŋemâc soŋkerâ jupo irec nore mi hâwicguwec?
No tiŋne juju â eebapage weniŋuc fokac irec fuŋne bataniŋkepe mi baficguocmu.
Go wira wâwâsic etecne ɋâŋ qâqâtâcfâcge fuŋne fuŋne jaŋe baficguzo murâ baficgunʒepieŋ. Jaŋe mâŋâŋzi ficne suec‐jopame raniŋmu, ehuc nakafezi wefurâ omaeekac irec sâc omaeniŋmu. Norao roweckeocmuzi ine mâreŋ rauckeocmu â tiri tiki‐nane i ere biŋe eocmu.
Eme dâŋ ʒiŋuc fuaocmu: “Mâreŋ bâburockeniŋ, bâburockehuc hata bâʒâweniŋ, ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere hatao aka wiac fokac i bârârieniŋ!”
Femicne â Fekicne sâko juraʒihuc juekac sanaŋ, ʒâŋene Tiri rune, eki ʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: “No faic jâmbâŋ tiri haeo juekopac, erâ maŋjeŋic ima qakicne â bawahakicne jaŋerao mâmâc, i maŋjeŋic bawahakicne bafaharepemurâ â maŋjeŋic ima qakicne qâzuckepemurâ iŋuc eekopac.
No aaric dâŋ hati mi mujarepemu me kimbeŋ i tofamâc mi qajarepemu, i mâro‐jeŋic mecne â maŋ qâqâtâc no nahac bâfua‐jarepo mecne izi nore maio rokawezacte.
Jaŋe buchâro ehuc sâqorembiŋte aaricnume jopapo, no ʒâŋe mai‐nane bâsoŋkehuc kimbeŋ qapo; jaŋe ine sifu râpecnurâ jaŋe jaŋacne maŋte hata âtembiŋ.
No hata‐jeŋic honepo erâ sifu bâpiaŋ‐jopapemu; no jowac‐jopa rarâ hemiriŋ‐jopapemu, ehame busâqoc mana‐jareeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao daŋge mumuteŋ fuazejec.
Ŋic ʒoricko me bembeŋko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋerao wama fârine fua razejec, eme no bâpiaŋ‐jopapemu, Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
Ŋic hehesicne jaŋe ine hâwec siri sâko qaekac iŋucne, i benoŋ baocte eipieha siri‐ticnezi sohoŋ â jawa qâsueme tiŋko feekac.
Ŋic hehesicne jaŋe wama mi bâfuaniŋmu,” Anutu‐nanezi iŋuc mukac.
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Hahaŋne bahuc wirazemec, maracge mi bawahac, maracge bâfeŋnetec qeŋ iŋucne dâŋezejec; ŋicfâc‐nane sindaŋ‐jeŋic mu rituc ejarec â Jakobore kikefuŋ jaŋere sâqocne bataniŋkec.
Jaŋe ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne wira basac enareeŋgopieŋ, ehuc hata‐nane mana taraniŋte aŋac‐jopaekac; jaŋe ŋicguru moczi eebapa tiŋne bâfuambiŋ irec sâc â Anutu‐jeŋicte jojowac dâŋ mi râpeckembiŋ iŋucne; jaŋe mumutiŋ dâŋ biaŋne mutara‐jarepemurâ numu‐nareeŋgopieŋ, ehuc Anutu no maicnuniŋte ejareekac.
Eha ʒiŋuc wioeŋgopieŋ: ‘Nâŋe sowa juhapene wemocte mi honec‐nâpoekic â sahac‐nâŋec bâʒâickepene wemocte hone manac mi eekic?’ Manaŋgopieŋ, sowa juju dameŋ‐ŋeŋicko aŋac‐ŋeŋicte gie baeŋgopieŋ, ehuc gieŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic bâʒâic‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe dâŋ mumuc â kikisâ bâfuaniŋte â mehuhuŋ repicnezi hehec eniŋte sowa jueŋgopieŋ. Ŋoŋe dameŋ ʒi sowa jueŋgopieŋ sowa iŋucnezi hata hebâzickeme Anutuzi dâŋmarac‐ŋeŋic sâcne mi manaocmu.
Me sowa kecʒiŋucnere moc aŋacnuzac me? Ʒoaŋ moc ira ŋiczi sahac‐ticne bâʒâickeocmu, ehuc qizec‐ticne saparac iŋucne hasickerâ domaocmu, me târu rufarâ ʒafe heririŋko foocmu? Ŋoŋe mâsi iŋucnere sowa fârine mueŋgopieŋ? Me ʒoaŋ iŋucnere mueŋgopieŋ: Wofuŋzi irec ecnekac?
“No ine wiac kecʒiŋucte manape sowa fârine eekac: Sâqocnere niŋgiŋ hetâcnezo, reŋte muc bâŋgoroŋkezo, kâpâcwâru bacjopakicne firuec‐jopazo â tagi râe‐jarekicne i hetara‐jare‐fârezo.
Dâŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne mukicne: Nânâre hâmoekac e nânâ gumezemec, qarâ suriŋne â jabane jaŋe ficgao râec‐jopazemec, ŋic biuctac jume honerâ qoruc râcnezemec â ŋic âgofâcge bafic‐jopazemec.
Go iŋuc etecne ʒoctamacgezi furic iŋucne tamaeocmu â huc wicge i biac somie biaŋ eocmu; tiŋne jujugezi bânie‐gareocmu â Wofuŋte huriri qâreŋzi bâjâpecguocmu.
Eme wiratec Wofuŋzi dâŋ bâtikie‐gareocmu; go kio wâwâsic ecnetec ʒiŋuc muocmu: ‘No ʒine hâcne.’ “Ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋickonec tagi mecne, me bubutoŋ ââecke mecne â sowidâŋ mumu mecne i bârârieniŋmu,
â ŋic nânâre hâmoekac e nânâ râcne gumec eniŋmu erâ ŋic maŋticne omaewec i gume qiŋneniŋmu ine tatamac‐ŋeŋiczi dapâcko ʒoc iŋucne uŋ heocmu â dapâc‐ŋeŋiczi ŋerisierâ ʒoaŋ gereŋ gereŋne iŋucne eocmu.
Eme Wofuŋ e dameŋ sâc jowacguhuc juocmu, ehuc mâreŋ burocnao maŋ qâqâtâcge bâgunuckeocmu, erâ me kikege basanaŋkeocmu. Eme go jufu gie opâ ruacnekicne me opâ ʒâŋe mi ʒiʒickene iŋucne ecmu.
Ŋicfâcge jaŋe hae sesucne sesucne dameŋ ʒora fowefuwec i heɋârerâ bâpiaŋkenʒepieŋ; erâ ŋic gaŋne gaŋne juwefuhuc qânâsacte hobeteŋ râe jumbieŋ i mocwâc bâpiaŋkepie sanaŋne fozejec. Ehame ʒiŋuc mugarenʒepieŋ: E hawec hehebâzicke ŋic â ŋiczi ira mocwâc ŋeŋe juju eniŋte fic hae bâpiaŋkeekac.
“Go sabata hombaŋ sipirickezicte kikege soŋaŋkehuc tiri ʒoaŋ‐naneo gie maŋgere kosa mi bacmu, ehuc sabata irec ʒâŋe ‘ʒeri bubiaŋ hombaŋ’ murâ Wofuŋ nore tiri ʒoaŋ irec ʒâŋe ‘araŋ bapa ʒoaŋ’ mucmu, erâ gahacne hata mi âtehuc sâsecmu, me gahacne maŋte gie mi bacmu â dâŋ omane mi mucmu,
ehuc Wofuŋ nore aŋac manahuc jutec baficguhape mâreŋte faio sâcne ququŋke tâmiric jurahuc jucmu; eme no mamacge Jakobo ere merâfâc gare tahac epemu.” Wofuŋzi iŋuc hâcne muwec.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ meticne i bembeŋne aricne, irec bafic‐ŋopaocte mi eipieocmu, â hazecfoŋ wâc mi juekac, irec dâŋ manaocte mi quŋkeocmu.
Kiŋ bahac‐ŋeŋiczi ine ŋoŋe â Anutu‐ŋeŋic ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko aka fokacte â sâqocne‐ŋeŋiczi Wofuŋ sâockekacte dâŋŋeŋic mi manaekac.
Meŋeŋicko soc bohotaekac â memotec‐ŋeŋic i kiŋ bahachec, micbipic‐ŋeŋickonec burecdâŋ wahaekac â nameŋ‐ŋeŋiczi sindaŋdâŋte saŋuc qaekac.
Moczi moc dâŋgieo wiac tiŋnere dâŋ moc mi dopeckeekac â moczi mumutara dâŋ biaŋne moc mi muekac. Aricne, wiac omanao roweckehuc siocdâŋ mueŋgopieŋ, â wiac hâhâwicne kiweckerâ sisipiric roeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe homa hândâŋ fomackepie âkeʒuekac, â qâruru bieeŋgopieŋ; moc e hândâŋ‐jeŋic nâocmuzi hâmoocmu me âtenʒaŋneme qotâ wefuocmu.
Qâruru bieeŋgopieŋ izi ŋaqi mi bapane â wiac baeŋgopieŋ i ŋiczi mi rurufane. Eebapa‐jeŋic i eebapa sâqocne â mejeŋiczi sindaŋ bâfuaekac.
Sâqocnere kike afec jueŋgopieŋ â ŋic bahacmâc jaŋere soc hoŋkeniŋte hata ʒocnehec raeŋgopieŋ. Mamanasu‐jeŋiczi wiac hehesicne manasu biric eeŋgopieŋ, hata‐jeŋicko ima samaki â sisipiric foekac.
Wamare hata kâuc baeŋgopieŋ â hata‐jeŋicko mumutiŋ dâŋ moc mi bâbâfuane; jaŋe hata‐jeŋic hehasickembiŋ, eme ira raocmuzi wamare kâuc baocmu.
Irec mumutiŋ dâŋzi mi maic‐nâpoekac â bâbâpiaŋzi nâŋerao mi ware fisiekac. Nâŋe tatamacte woŋec juhuc mi dapâc honenʒepeneŋ i, erâ ʒoaŋ ʒâziriŋte ʒâŋe fieŋgopeneŋzi dapâc qisiricko jueŋgopeneŋ.
Nâŋe ŋic ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ iŋucne ficsâpeo babarâ raeŋgopeneŋ ehuc ʒâŋe tâmiric jaŋe iŋucne babarâ jueŋgopeneŋ. Nâŋe dapâcko quŋkeeŋgopeneŋ iŋuc jaha ʒoaŋ ɋaɋacko eeŋgopeneŋ, nâŋe sahac ɋiɋichec jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋic hâmokicne iŋucne.
Nâŋe ʒeŋgoma kâte qowi iŋucne ŋuruŋneeŋgopeneŋ â hapâ iŋucne dâŋeeŋgopeneŋ; mumutiŋ dâŋte woŋec ŋepene arictac eekac â bâbâpiaŋte woŋec jupene mi bâqiŋ‐nâpoekac.
Qaqatara‐nâŋec i gore maio guru sâko fokac i, â sâqocne‐nâŋeczi mufuac‐nâpokac; qaqatara‐nâŋeczi mai‐nâŋecko fokac â sâqocne‐nâŋec i kâuc mi baŋgopeneŋ.
Kecʒiŋuc: Maŋrâŋgeŋ, Wofuŋ ninikec â Anutu‐nâŋec rârâpecke, sindaŋ hârindaŋ ee â qaqatara, burecdâŋ manasu biric erâ manabâc tâmiric mumu.
Mumutiŋ dâŋ bâsuepene rawec â tiŋne juju i taicko wisewec fokac, siocmâc juju i tomao waha qawec, â dâŋ fâretiŋ mumu i âgo mi ecneeŋgopeneŋ.
Dâŋ siocmâc mumu i omaewec, eme moc e sâqocne qikiŋneocmu e mafa wiac‐ticne fiuc roniŋmu. Wofuŋ e wiac i honewec, ehuc mumutiŋ dâŋ omaewec irec maname sâqorewec.
Eme e ŋic fârine moc mi jume honewec â moczi moc bafickeocte mi fuawecte wareckewec; irec e jahacne mezi bafickewec â tiŋne juju‐ticnezi dopeckewec.
E tiŋne juju i maruku iŋucne rufawec erâ aeŋdu, ʒâŋene bâbâpiaŋ i heme huwec; e okac babazuzi ŋaqi‐ticne eha heme huwec â ʒoɋac‐ticne i mâmâteŋ ŋaqi iŋucne rufawec.
