E eebapa‐jeŋicte sâcko furine jareocmu, kisâfâc‐ticne kimbeŋ qajareocmu, râsifâc‐ticne okacne bazu‐jareocmu, nucne nucne jaŋe okacne bazu‐jare‐fâreocmu hâcne.
Eme Wofuŋ ʒâŋe‐ticne i ʒoaŋ huhunaoneczi araŋ bacnenʒepieŋ â ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec jaŋe huriri qâreŋ‐ticnere manapie bipinehec ezejec; Wofuŋ e micrombâŋ‐ticnezi opâ sâko fusinehec ficne sueme raocmu irec sâc fisiocmu hâcne.
“Zioŋko jueŋgopieŋ â Jakobore kikefuŋkoneczi sâqocne râpeckeniŋmu jaŋe ine fifirue fua‐jareocmu.” Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
Wofuŋzi mukac: “No kecʒiŋuc muhuc jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ekopac: Mâro‐nane faigao wahawec jukac â dâŋnane micgao râepo fokac i gahacne mickonec â ɋâricfâcge jaŋere mickonec moc mi wawaha mimiŋzi ɋâric forahuc juzejec.”
Faharerâ tamaec, ʒoctamacge fisikac, Wofuŋte huriri qâreŋzi tamae‐garekac.
Manakic, dapâczi mâreŋ qofackekac, dâpâc qisiriczi ŋicne ŋicne foŋjopakac; ehame gorao Wofuŋzi ʒoaŋ iŋucne wefukac, ere huriri qâreŋzi gorao uucne riŋkekac.
Eme ŋicne ŋicne tatamacgao fisiniŋmu, â ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe huriri bâbâricgao wareniŋmu.
Qâhâŋnerâ rârec rârec fitec rame honec: Ʒeŋgoma tumaŋnembieŋ gorao wareŋgopieŋ; ŋokâfâcge wiwickonec fisiniŋmu, otâfâcge meo bacjopa wareniŋmu.
Eme go hone aŋac erâ ʒâŋege qârucneocmu, maŋgezi mana ʒiziwerâ ʒeri bari ecmu, i hâwecte mâririzi gore biŋe ekacte, â ŋicne ŋicne mafa‐jeŋic gorao warekacte.
Kamele guru sâkozi bârârâŋguniŋmu, kamele socɋâri Midiaŋ â Efanec, erâ wâc Sebanec mâmâc fisiniŋmu. Jaŋe gol â hosâc âsu bagare wareniŋmu, ehuc Wofuŋte ʒâŋe biŋe musokaniŋmu.
Kedaranec lama guru jaŋe gore erâ heâckembiŋ, Nebajotinec lama ŋicne jaŋe gore biŋe embiŋ. Manape biaŋkeha alata‐naneo fenʒepieŋ, eme biŋe rara ficnane jai jowarecnehec ezejec.
Keci weni jaŋe karorac tinac ɋeŋjaha wareŋgopieŋ? ehuc hapâzi sareŋ‐ticnao risie heekac irec sâc eŋgopieŋ?
Woke gomba nore erâ heâckeŋgopieŋ, Tarasisionec racwoke jaŋe micne baŋgopieŋ, i ŋokâfâcge wiwickonec wokec‐jopa wareniŋte, â moneŋ mafa‐jeŋic mâmâc ameckerâ fisiniŋte. I Wofuŋ gore Anutu ere ʒâŋere eŋgopieŋ, Israe guru Tiri Wofuŋ‐jeŋic ere hâcne, eki ʒâŋe biŋege bafahare‐garewecte.
Ŋic jabanezi qânâsacge bagareniŋmu, ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe kiŋaŋ qagareniŋmu. No kimbeŋ‐nanere jâmbomac hetapaicgupo, ʒi ine anonoc‐nanere ehâmo‐garekopac.
Sacmotâcge aaŋ domahuc juzejec, ʒoaŋko me ŋafeo mi hezo. Eme ŋicne ŋicne mafa mâriri‐jeŋic fehuc fozejec, â ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic birihec fisirâ fenʒepieŋ.
Ŋicne ŋicne â ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic gore kiŋaŋ qaniŋte qikiŋneniŋmu jaŋe siroweniŋmu, ŋicne ŋicne i jaŋe hâcne sipiricke‐jâmbâŋkeniŋmu.
Lebanoŋ tikire eri qaraweŋ gorao fisiocmu, wete, becʒi â jâmâzâc hâcne, i tirific‐nanere hae ʒoŋa erickeocte; eme no kike‐nanere ââtesiŋ ericke bâpiaŋ epemu.
Bâʒâicgumbiŋ jaŋere ɋâricfâc jaŋe gorao dadape fisiniŋmu â qaisocgumbiŋ sasawa jaŋe maŋfuŋgao fodapeniŋmu, ehuc ʒâŋege ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Wofuŋte hae sâko”, “Israere Tiri rune ere Zioŋ”.
Behe qaisoc egarehuc gorao sicne fotâc moc mi embiŋ; irec okacne bafaharecgupe eri qaraweŋhec erâ juzemec, eme mimiŋzi ɋâric hone ʒiziwecguhuc junʒepieŋ.
Go ŋicne ŋicne jaŋeraonec susu nâhuc juzemec â ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe moŋ gumecgupie nâzemec, ehuc ʒiŋuc mana tarazemec: Bâbâpiaŋge i Wofuŋ no hâcne, â fifiruege i Jakobore tâpiri rune no hâcne.
No aeŋ bâbâroŋte okacne gol bafisipemu â aeŋte okacne siliwa, jâcte okacne aeŋ bâbâroŋ erâ qânâre okacne aeŋ, iŋuc bafisipemu. No wama bâfua‐garepe izi soŋaŋguzejec â tiŋne juju bâfua‐garepe izi eebapagere guriŋ bazejec.
Hae mâreŋgao bâbâʒâic me ima me sisipiric irec biŋe mocwâc fuame mi manazemec, go qânâsacge irec ʒâŋe “Bâbâpiaŋ” â sacmotâcgere ʒâŋe “Mumuteŋ” muzemec.
Ʒoaŋte tatamac â mosare tatamaczi mocwâc mi tamae‐garezejec; aricne, Wofuŋzi ʒoctamacge fofo sanaŋ â Anutugezi huriri qâreŋge juzejec.
Ʒoaŋgezi mocwâc mi huocmu â mosagezi mi pitiwaocmu, aricne, Wofuŋzi ine ʒoctamacge fohuc juocmu sanaŋ, ehame ki mamakuc dameŋge taraocmu.
Ŋicgurufâcge jaŋe ʒeŋgoma tiŋne juniŋmu; jaŋe jufu gie‐nanere gitecne â meqâreŋ‐nane juhuc mâreŋ tatara tâmiric rauckepie mumuteŋ‐nane fuazejec.
Ŋic guru piticnezi sawerâ guru sâko fuanʒepieŋ â qarâ suriŋnezi ŋicguru tâpirichec enʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ no hâcne dameŋne maickeme ɋeŋjaha fuaocte giene bapemu.
Wofuŋ Anutu Mâro‐ticnezi nore faio wahawec, i gie ʒiŋuc bapemurâ Wofuŋzi rua‐narewec: Hujukicne bubiaŋ dâŋ jazapemurâ, â bu qâqânducne jauŋ‐jopapemurâ sorecnuwec kâpâcwâru ŋic rambaŋ jujure biŋedâŋ jazazo, niŋgiŋhec jaŋe niŋgiŋ goroŋke‐jareocmu i mufua‐jarezo.
Wofuŋte aki jara biaŋ musawezo, erâ wâc Anutu‐nâŋecte okac dameŋte muzo, eme busâqoc ehuc juŋgopieŋ jaŋe fie ruruckenʒepieŋ.
Zioŋ maŋnao ki mamakuc ehuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mateŋte okacne hendiŋ jarezo, ʒafe ʒure‐jarehuc tokic rua‐jarezo, ehame kire okacne mumuteŋ gae fuazejec. Ʒâŋe‐jeŋic ine tiŋne jujure jâcne muzo, eme Wofuŋte jufu gie epie ere mumuteŋ fuazejec.
Jaŋe fic sesuc raŋɋane heɋârerâ banʒepieŋ, wiac mârâc jaha mâreŋko waha qawec fokac i bafaharenʒepieŋ, erâ hae ima bakicne mimiŋzi ɋâric fowarewec i giene bakupie harierâ fuazejec.
Eme ŋic jabane jaŋe hae qowifâc‐ŋeŋic soŋaŋ‐jopaniŋmu, mâreŋ mockoneczi nânâ â waiŋte hesarac gie baŋareniŋmu.
Ŋoŋere ʒâŋe ine Wofuŋte taha bapa muzo, ŋiczi Anutu‐nâŋecte kiŋaŋŋicfâc muŋareniŋmu; ŋicguru gâcne jaŋere mâriri nâniŋmu, jaŋeraonec mafa bajuhuc mana aŋac eniŋmu.
Mimi faio jumbiŋ irec furine fehuc ŋarezo, bawahac‐ŋopakicnere aŋac faio juniŋmu; erâ mâreŋ dâkâne jajahec jajahec rauckeniŋmu, â bubiaŋ tofamâc mana rahuc juniŋmu.
Wofuŋ no wiac tiŋkerâ foocte enareekac, fiuc â bâbâsifucte ine takicnuekac. Irec no furi aickerâ jarepemu, erâ jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic sanaŋne epemu.
Ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic i mâreŋ sâc manac‐jopanʒepieŋ, ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe oso gitecfâc‐jeŋic hone ʒâŋitac ejarenʒepieŋ. Hone manac ejareniŋmuzi ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: Ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe Wofuŋzi jambuŋ‐jopawec.
No Wofuŋ bubiaŋ sâko manacnepe, maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi Anutu‐nane ʒeri ecneoc! E bibiaŋkere ŋaqi henareme huwec, titiŋkere rurufa biaŋ rufa‐narewec: Ŋicʒeŋoŋ moczi eri hendiŋ heme huekac irec sâc, â ŋokac ʒeŋoŋzi kubu qonaŋkeekac iŋuc hâcne.
Mâreŋkonec jâc bac wiac âkeʒurâ wefuekac, â gieo nânâ monʒaŋ bâpâŋ qarâ wefuekac, irec sâc Wofuŋ Anuture micte tiŋne juju fua biaŋ eocmu, eme ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere maio mumumbiaŋ fuaocmu.
No Zioŋte erâ dâŋ muhuc juhape â Jerusalemte erâ gie bahuc juhape tiŋne juju‐ticnezi huriri qâreŋ iŋucne fuazejec â bâbâpiaŋ‐ticnezi waha bâruŋkeekac irec sâc bâruŋkezejec.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe tiŋne jujuge honenʒepieŋ â ŋicwofuŋ ʒeŋgoma jaŋe huriri qâreŋge ʒâŋitanʒepieŋ; eme Wofuŋzi ʒâŋege ɋâricne moc mugareme ŋic jaŋe muhuc junʒepieŋ.
Go Wofuŋte biŋe juhuc eridu biaŋne iŋucne jucmu â Anutugere biŋe juhuc ŋicwofuŋ hendiŋ iŋucne ecmu.
“Behecgukicne”, ʒâŋege iŋuc mocwâc mi muzo, â mâreŋgere ʒâŋe i “Mâreŋ burocne” mocwâc mi muzo wâc; gore ʒâŋe i ʒiŋuc mugarezo: “Joroc‐nane”, â mâreŋgere ʒâŋe ine ʒiŋuc fuazejec “Ŋokac ŋowehec”, i Wofuŋzi gore aŋackekacte â mâreŋge i ŋowehec eocmu irec.
Ŋicmoteczi ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ moc roocmu irec sâc motecfâcge jaŋe raucguniŋmu, â ŋiczi ŋokac biŋe‐ticne mana aŋac ecneocmu irec sâc jaha Anutugezi mana aŋac egareocmu.
O Jerusalem, no qânâsacgere ruc bapa ŋic juniŋte râec‐jopapo, eme jaŋe ʒoaŋko mecne ŋafeo mecne dâŋemâc mi junʒepieŋ: Wofuŋ manasucnehuc juniŋte mukicne ŋoŋe ŋeŋemana mi enʒepieŋ.
Erâ ʒoɋac ecnehuc juhapie Jerusalem mocwâc heɋârerâ mume mâreŋko ʒâŋe biŋehec ŋezejec.
Wofuŋzi tâpiri mefâre‐ticne ira ɋetickehuc ʒiŋuc mupaŋkewec: “No padi jacgoŋge i râsifâcge jaŋe mocwâc mi jarepe nâniŋmu, â waiŋ opâ fua‐gareocte gie sâko bahuc jumeŋ i jaba jaŋe nâniŋte wâc mi mana‐jarepemu.
Mâcne, qa roro eeŋgopieŋzi nânʒepieŋ, ehuc Wofuŋ no muteŋ bâteŋ enarenʒepieŋ, â waiŋ hândâŋne ro nusec eeŋgopieŋzi opâne tirific‐nanere hae ʒoŋao nânʒepieŋ.”
Motâc sâko fotâcnerâ wahaniŋ! Ŋic jaŋere hata bâʒâweniŋ; mâreŋ bâburockeniŋ, bâburockepie hata fuaoc, qânâ bârârieniŋ, ŋic gurune gurune jaŋeraonec risie wareniŋte qeŋ qajareniŋ!
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ e dâŋ ʒiŋuc râeme raku mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao fisikac: “Zioŋte otâ âzâcneniŋ, manakic, bâbâpiaŋgezi fisikac; manakic, furi‐ticne ameckerâ ware fisikac â wiac hure hemârec ewec izi bâniecnekac.”
Ʒâŋe‐jeŋic ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Tiri ŋicguru” â “Wofuŋ firuec‐jopawecfâc‐ticne”; gore ʒâŋe ine ʒiŋuc muzo: “Gore mu wioc ekicne”, erâ wâc: “Hae sâko mi behe sanaŋkekicne”
Bozera haeonec ŋaqi bâbâroŋ rorâ warekac, ehuc ŋaqi qoruc eri qaraweŋnehec Edom mâreŋkonec tâpiri sâkohec fisikac e mo? “Tiŋne jujure dâŋ muekopac â ŋic bâpiaŋ‐jopazore tâpiri fonareekac Wofuŋ no hâcne.”
Ŋaqige wemocte bâbâroŋ ekac â qorucge i ŋic waiŋ hândâŋne âte pisickeekac ere qoruc iŋucne?
“No waiŋ hândâŋne bucnane âte pisickepo, ehame ŋic gurune gurune jaŋeraonec moczi nohec moc mi juwec. No kimbeŋko âte pisic‐jopapo â aaricko âtenʒaŋ‐jopapo. Ehame socjeŋiczi ŋaqi‐nane ruacnewecte qoruc wiac‐nane bâbie‐fârepo.
No okac babazure moc manape fowec, eme irec fârine bâfuapemurâ jara dameŋ maickewec hâcne.
Eme no rârec rârec ʒâŋe fipe rame babafic‐nane moc mi honepo, moczi moc mi baficnuwecte wareckepo. Iŋuc fuame nahacne mezi baficnuwec â kimbeŋ qajarehuc sanaŋkepo.
No kimbeŋko ŋic gurune gurune âtenʒaŋ‐jopapo â aaricko henʒaŋ‐jopapo, ehuc socjeŋic mâreŋko hoŋkepe rawec.”
No Wofuŋ aki anonoc‐ticne â eebapa‐ticne bipinehec i wiac enâre‐fârewec irec sâcko muteŋkezepac, erâ juju‐ticne â aki anonoc‐ticne fufusuc irec sâcko Israe kikefuŋ buuruc ɋârâŋne enârewec irec wâc manasuzepac.
E ʒiŋuc muwec: “Jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane hâcne, ŋokâfâc‐nane eeatuc tâmiric,” e iŋuc muhuc babafic‐jeŋic erâ juwec.
Ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋ‐jeŋicko kiŋaŋŋiczi me aŋelozi mâcne, e jahac maŋjauŋ â buuruc‐ticnere erâ bafic‐jopahuc firuec‐jopawec; e fuŋnaonecteaŋ dameŋ sâc bafaharec‐joparâ âsic‐jopawec.
Jaŋe ine maŋrâŋgeŋhec juhuc Tiri Mâro‐ticne bunao bambiŋ; irec e jahac râsi ejarehuc jaŋehec ʒika qawec.
Iŋuc eme jaŋe mârâc jaha kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Mose juwec ere hâcne manasuhuc mu wioc embiŋ: Lama gurufâc‐ticne jaŋere soŋaŋ juocte opâonec bawefuwec e weni? Â maŋnao Tiri Mâro‐ticne râeme huwec, e weni?
Me tâpiri mesanaŋ‐ticnezi Mose bafickeocte muwec, me ʒâŋe‐ticne fofo sanaŋ foocte opâ bâfâucke‐jarewec e weni?
Me mana‐jareme becâsiczi mâreŋ burocnao raekac irec sâc hâwec ʒâkâŋ fotâcnembiŋ, ehame kike‐jeŋic mi fâfâckewec e weni?
Bulimakao jaŋe wâneŋko huraeŋgopieŋ irec sâc Wofuŋte Mârozi jumananiŋte râec‐jopawec. Go ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec ecmurâ ŋicfâcge iŋuc hâcne jowac‐jopahuc jumeŋ.
Go sambâŋkonec, tiri hae biaŋgaonec hâcne fitec wahame honec. Ʒoɋac â tâpirige weni? Maŋjauŋ â buurucge i wemocte sakare‐nârekomec?
Goki hâcne mamac‐nâŋec, Abrahamzi ine nâŋe kâuc bacnâpokac â Israezi ʒâŋeruruŋ‐nâpokac; o Wofuŋ, goki mamac‐nâŋec â fifirue‐nâŋec, fuŋnaonecteaŋ ʒâŋege iŋuc hâcne fowarehuc juwec.
O Wofuŋ, go wemocte hone qâoma enârehaŋ hatage beheeŋgopeneŋ â maŋsanaŋ eeŋgopeneŋ, ehuc gore mi hâwic‐nâpoekac? Kiŋaŋŋicfâcge â mefâregere kikefuŋ gurune gurune nâŋe mocwâc maic‐nâpoc.
Tiriŋic gurufâcge nâŋe tirificge dameŋ bembeŋne sawa ŋenârewec, eme râsifâc‐nâŋec jaŋe fisirâ wâwânâŋ ecnembiŋ.
Go fuŋnaonecteaŋ guriŋ bapa gie moc mi bajaremeŋ â ʒâŋege mi bajumbiŋ ŋic iŋucne jaŋere sâc embeŋ.
Go sambâŋ fotâcnerâ wahanʒaŋ, eme tiki jaŋe gore maio qiriŋ qanʒapiŋ me! I ʒoczi nâŋ qaqa wiac ʒâseŋkeekac â opâ ʒarâ du âteekac irec sâc, ehuc râsifâcge jaŋe ʒâŋegere fuŋne bataniŋke‐jaretec mananʒapiŋ, eme ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe gore maio ɋarac ɋarac qanʒapiŋ.
Ehame go wiac hâhâwicne, nâŋe irec ʒâŋe mi fieŋgopeneŋ, i moc enʒaŋ, go wahanʒaŋ me, eme tiki jaŋe gore maio qiriŋ qanʒapiŋ!
Fuŋnaonecteaŋ Anutu mocte biŋe mâcne, gore mocjaha ʒiŋuc hone manac ekicne: Gorao roweckeekac e bafickehuc juekic.
Buafec jaha tiŋne jujure gie baeŋgopieŋ â gore hatao juhuc manasucgueŋgopieŋ jaŋehec bâbâfuac eekic. Manakic, go aaric manameŋ, nâŋe ine sifu sâqocne bambeŋ, ehuc dameŋ ʒora râpecguhuc jumbeŋ.
Nâŋe iŋuc ehuc ʒeŋgoma ŋic wâwânâŋhec iŋucne embeŋ, â eebapa‐nâŋec tiŋne i ŋaqi sohoŋ ruacnekicne irec sâc ewec. Nâŋe ʒeŋgoma jâc rehacne iŋucne hâmo ɋaŋac eeŋgopeneŋ â sâqocne‐nâŋeczi mâŋâŋ iŋucne erâ ficne suec‐nâpoekac.
Moczi moc ʒâŋege mi riwaseckeekac me gorao roweckeocte mi afeckeekac; go ʒâŋe maige bâsoŋke‐nâremeŋ ehuc kiŋbahac‐nâŋeczi bâmâc‐nâpoocte qikiŋ‐nâpomeŋ hâcne.
Erâ Wofuŋ, go sifu mamac‐nâŋec jukomec, nâŋe afe, goki ine kuʒifâcge bacnâpomeŋ, nâŋe ʒeŋgoma meqâreŋfâcge.
O Wofuŋ, go aaric boc mi manac, ehuc sâqocne‐nâŋecte mi mac manasu‐nârehuc juzemec. Go mana honec, nâŋe ʒeŋgoma ŋicfâcge mi juŋgopeneŋ me?
Tiri hae sâkofâcge jaŋe sesuctac embiŋ, Zioŋ i sesuctac ewec wâc, Jerusalem i niniŋ siarereŋ fokac hâcne.
Tirific‐nâŋec eri qaraweŋnehec, maŋnao mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe muteŋ bâteŋ egarehuc jumbiŋ i ʒocte nânâ ewec, ehame wiac ʒâŋe rara biaŋ‐nâŋec i wâc ima bafârekicne.
O Wofuŋ, go wiac i hone takirezo mukic me? Erâ dâŋemâc juhuc boc badapec‐nâpozo mukomec me?
Nore mu wioc mi ejumbieŋzi wira basac enareniŋte mana‐jarepo, â wira basac mi enare jumbieŋ jaŋe bâfuacnuniŋte mana‐jarepo. Ŋicguru moc ʒâŋe‐nane mi riwasecke jumbieŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazapo: “No ʒi, no ʒi!”
No ŋicguru maŋrâŋgeŋhec jaŋe hata biaŋnao mi juhuc jaŋacne maŋte hata âtembiŋ jaŋe dameŋ ʒora meoric qajarehuc jupo.
Jaŋe dameŋ sâc tâtâcko sâke kiki enarehuc jufu gieo taha baeŋgopieŋ â qânâ faio hosâc âsu rikeeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ʒâŋeruŋko ŋeeŋgopieŋ â ŋafeo qânâ hawecko ŋec foc eeŋgopieŋ; jaŋe bec nâeŋgopieŋ â wiac mamakâcnere sic oto‐jeŋicko foekac.
Jaŋe mueŋgopieŋ: “Go jukomecko juc, go nore manatec ŋic furune eha mi bâqiŋnuc.” Iŋuc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe dameŋ sâc ʒoc ʒahuc hosâcnezi gapec‐ŋopaekac irec sâc enareeŋgopieŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, nore maio dâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne fokac: “No dâŋemâc mi jupemu, aricne, okacne bazu‐jare‐jâmbâŋkepemu.
Jaŋe tiki faio hosâc âsu rikembiŋte â mâreŋ facnao ʒaubac enarembiŋte jaŋacne sâqocne mecne â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sâqocne irec okacne i mâmâc bazu‐jarepemu. Jâmbomac, eebapa‐jeŋic raŋɋanere okacne bazu‐jare‐jâmbâŋkepemu,” Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Waiŋ hândâŋne opâne foha honerâ mueŋgopieŋ, ‘Maŋnao jambuŋ fokacte mi sipirickezo,’ eme no kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere erâ sâc ijaha ehuc ŋic ʒeŋgoma mi sipiric‐jopazepac.
Noni mupe Jakoboraonec ɋâric fua sawec enʒepieŋ â Judaraonec moczi tiki wiac‐nane rauckeocte fuazejec. Bâwosâec‐jopakicnefâc‐nane jaŋe hâcne rauckenʒepieŋ â kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe ira ŋec juc enʒepieŋ.
Eme ŋicfâc‐nane wira basac enareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe Saroŋ wâneŋ rauckepie lamafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere hae mâreŋ ezejec â Akoro wâneŋzi bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic jaŋere juju fofo hae ezejec.
Ŋoŋe ine Wofuŋ no râpecnueŋgopieŋ â tiri tiki‐nanere nikec‐ŋopaekac, ehuc Gade nemu nânâ opâ râe bâmoc ecneeŋgopieŋ â Meni nemu waiŋ opâ qoŋgiŋkecneeŋgopieŋ.
Irec no râec‐ŋopape ʒikare biŋe enʒepieŋ, ehuc ʒika kiniŋte ʒeŋgoma dunduŋ dadape enʒepieŋ, i ŋoŋe wira‐ŋarepe micnaneo mi rombiŋte â dâŋ ŋazape mi manambiŋte; ŋoŋe nore maio wiac sâqoreekac i hâcne embiŋ, â mana aŋac mi eekopac i hâcne bâwosâembiŋ.”
Irec hâcne Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Jei, kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe nânâ fojareha ŋoŋe nânâ basanʒepieŋ, jei, kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe opâ nahapie ŋoŋe opâre hâmonʒepieŋ, jei, kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe ʒeri bari ehapie ŋoŋe qurutuanʒepieŋ.
Jei, kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe maŋzi ʒeri ehuc kiwac qawac ehapie ŋoŋe ine ki busâqoc ehuc bu heheric eŋareha kio huse enʒepieŋ.
Ʒâŋe‐ŋeŋic i bâwosâec‐jopakicnefâc‐nane qikiŋne‐jarepie jaŋe sâwecdâŋ muniŋte bajunʒepieŋ, kecʒiŋuc: ‘Wofuŋ Anutuzi mume hâmozemec’. Kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere ʒâŋe ine moc muzo.
Eme moc e mâreŋko e jahacnere manasuhuc jambuŋdâŋ muocmu e Anutu fârine nore ʒâŋe muzejec, â moc e mâreŋko mumupaŋ dâŋ muocmu e Anutu fârine norao ɋetickehuc muzejec; mârâc ʒârâ hâriŋ fowec irec ninikecne fuawec â mai‐naneonec râriewec hâcne.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, no sambâŋ â mâreŋ ɋâricne bâfuac‐jofapemu; eme mârâc wiac fowec irec mocwâc mi manasuzo â irec dâŋ maŋzi manatâc qâtâc mocwâc mi ezo.
Wiac bâfuapemu irec dameŋ sâc bubiaŋ manahuc ʒeri bari erahuc junʒepieŋ; no mupe Jerusalemzi ʒeri hae erâ ŋezejec â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere erâ bubiaŋ fuazejec.
Ehame no Jerusalemte ʒeri bari ehuc ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere bubiaŋ manazepac, eme hae maŋnao kifânâŋ me mu mamakuc i mocwâc fuame mi manazo.
Hae irec maŋnao ɋie moc fuarâ ʒoaŋ jahecmac sawa jurâ hâhâmo i mocwâc mi fuazejec, me ŋicqizec moc e jara dameŋ‐ticne mi jutarahuc hâhâmo i wâc mi fuazejec; aricne, moc e jara‐ticne 100 bazurâ hâmoocmu ere muzo, e motec; â moc e jara 100 mi bâfuahuc hâmoocmu ere muzo, e sâweckekicne.
Jaŋe fic barâ maŋnao ŋec foc eniŋmu, â waiŋ gie he sarac erâ fârine fuame nâniŋmu.
Jaŋe fic bapie ŋic gâcne jaŋe maŋnao ŋec foc ee i aricne, me gie he sarac epie fârine fuame gâcne jaŋe nânâ i wâc aricne; ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere juju dameŋ i jâcte dameŋ iŋucne ezejec; â bâwosâec‐jopakicnefâc‐nane jaŋe mejeŋiczi gie bambiŋ irec fârine jaŋac ro nâc enʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe gie maŋgâŋ mi banʒepieŋ â naru motec rocjopapie ututuŋ hâhâmo i mi fuazejec; Wofuŋzi jambuŋ‐jopawec jaŋere ɋâricfâc jaŋe hâcne; eme apa ŋosafâc‐jeŋic fuapie mâmâc juniŋmu.
Eme ʒiŋuc fuaocmu: Jaŋe mi wirahapie no biac mana‐jarepemu, erâ jaŋe dâŋ muha muhapie okacne bâtikie‐jarepemu.
Kâte qâto â lama jahe ââgo ehuc nânâ wirec nânicmu, laioŋ e bulimakaozi kecɋaŋ nâekac iŋuc jaha nâocmu, â gâc wândoczi homare nânâ eocmu. Jaŋe wiac busâqoc me sisipiricnehec i nore tiri tikio ira me ira moc mi bâfuaniŋmu,” Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Sambâŋzi eri ŋeŋe‐nane â mâreŋ e kike‐nanere ââtesiŋ; irec ŋoŋe wemo fic me hae moc banarepie maŋnao jumanazapo me?
Wiac fokac sasawa i menanezi bafârepo, irec nore biŋe efârekac, Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac. No ŋic kecʒiŋucne hone maiŋ ecneekopac: Maŋhuhuŋ â bu hehericne juekac â dâŋnanere ɋarac ɋarac qaekac.
“Moc e bulimakao ŋicne qa hezuc eocmu e ŋicqaqa ere sâc; moc e lama bâzi rikeocmu e ŋic moczi qâto upene qapirickeekac ere sâc; moc e taha bâzi rikeocmu e ŋic moc becsoczi taha baekac ere sâc, â moc e hosâc âsu rikeocmu e nemuɋâŋ araŋ bacneekac ere sâc. Jaŋe hâcne jaŋacne hata ba wosâc embiŋ â qâpuc wiac mamakâcnere aŋac‐jopaekac.
Irec no iŋuc jaha bâʒâic‐jopazore aŋacnuocmu â wiac bipic tatarane mupe fai‐jeŋicko feocmu; no wirape moczi moc micnaneo mi rowec â dâŋ mupe mi manambiŋ irec. Jaŋe nore maio wiac sâqoreekac i hâcne embiŋ â no mana aŋac mi eekopac i hâcne ba wosâc embiŋ.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ manarâ ɋarac ɋarac qaeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe dâŋticne kecʒiŋuc mananiŋ: “Qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic qaisoc‐ŋopaeŋgopieŋ â ʒâŋe‐nanere erâ bâsuec‐ŋopaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe muŋgopieŋ, ‘Wofuŋ e huriri qâreŋ‐ticne bataniŋkezac eme bubiaŋ‐ŋeŋic honenʒapeŋ me.’ Iŋuc mueŋgopieŋzi qurutuanʒepieŋ.
“Haeonec ojowa â taha ufuŋkonec fânâŋ keci mananiŋ me! I Wofuŋte marac fânâŋ i! E râsifâc‐ticne okacne bazu‐jarekac.
“Ŋokac moc e gozi mi kiha kogoc rowec, ʒâic mi manahuc biac motec rowec hâcne.
Mozi mâsi iŋucnere dâŋ moc manawec? Me mozi mâsi iŋucne moc honewec? Me mâreŋ moc irec ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒoaŋ mocjahao fuambiŋ? Me ŋicguru weni jaŋe beraŋ jaha fua‐fârembiŋ? Zioŋ eki ine gozi fuŋkerâ kiha izia ŋokâfâc‐ticne rocjopawec.
No kogoc jaŋe neŋgoc bumaŋkonec fuaniŋte muekopaczi wemocko aka hejarepemu? No ɋie fufuare hata bâfuaekopaczi hata i weniŋuc erâ hebâzickepemu?” Anutuzi iŋuc mukac.
“Ŋoŋe Jerusalem hae rune jaŋehec bubiaŋ mananiŋ, â hae irec aŋac‐ŋopaekac ŋoŋe sasawa ere erâ kiwac qawac eniŋ, â ere erâ mu mamakuc embiŋ ŋoŋe sasawa ehec ʒeri bari eniŋ.
Eme miriŋ‐ticnere moŋ gumec‐ŋopame nâ gapec enʒepieŋ; erâ eri tatamac‐ticnere mâriri irec aŋac‐ŋopa‐jâmbâŋkezejec.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: “Manakic, no mupe wamazi erao opâ sâko iŋucne qaratiezejec, â ŋicne ŋicne jaŋeraonec mafa mâriri i opâzi roma baekac irec sâc fua‐jarezejec; naru motecfâc‐ticne gâjoŋ‐jeŋicko hâpoc‐jopaniŋmu â qicjopahuc hâpo mumuduc ejareniŋmu.
Neŋgoc moczi kogoc‐ticne bâmiriŋkeekac irec sâc noni bâmiriŋ‐ŋopapemu; ŋoŋe Jerusalemko bâbâmiriŋ bâfuaniŋmu hâcne.
Eme ŋoŋe honerâ maŋŋeŋiczi ʒeri enʒepieŋ, ehame mesahac‐ŋeŋiczi kecɋaŋ geune iŋucne soka sanaŋ ezejec. Eme ʒiŋuc manazo: Wofuŋ e kiŋaŋŋicfâcne jaŋe meticnezi dope hutuŋ ejareekac â râsifâcne jaŋe ine kimbeŋ qajareekac.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ e jahacne ʒoc iŋucne fisiocmu â keretac‐ticne mâŋâŋ hâhâwicne iŋucne wareocmu; eme okac babazu‐ticne i kimbeŋ aaric‐ticnehec fisiocmu â hahanec dâŋticne i ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne fuaocmu.
Wofuŋ e mumutara gie bame ʒoczi mâreŋ ʒâseŋkeocmu â ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere dâŋ mutarame ʒikare biŋe eniŋmu; ehame Wofuŋte ʒikazi ŋic jopaocmu jaŋere ʒare i fejâmbâŋkeocmu.
“Nemure jufu gieo raniŋte maŋsahac‐jeŋic bâtirihuc baɋaɋackeeŋgopieŋ â taha bapa moc ʒâʒâŋiŋko domaekac e bâjâpeeŋgopieŋ erâ bec â gisic me ʒuc wiac mamakâcne nâeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc jaha bâsirowec‐jopazo,” Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
“No eebapa‐jeŋic â maŋ mamanasu‐jeŋic manakopac, erâ ŋicne ŋicne dâŋ marac fuŋne fuŋne mueŋgopieŋ jaŋe hetumaŋ‐jopapemurâ fisikopac, eme jaŋe fisirâ huriri qâreŋ‐nane honenʒepieŋ.
Eme no ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ma moc âkendâŋnepemu, ehuc jaŋeraonec ʒikare nâfocne gâcne sorec‐jopape jaŋe Tarasisi, Puti â Ludi tepeŋic erâ Tubali â Jawaŋ ŋicguru jaŋerao ranʒepieŋ, erâ ʒoricko nucne nucne biŋe‐nane mi manambiŋ â huriri qâreŋ‐nane mi honembiŋ jaŋerao mâmâc fisinʒepieŋ; ehuc ŋicne ŋicne huriri qâreŋ‐nanere dâŋ jazanʒepieŋ.
Erâ ŋicne ŋicne jaŋeraonec qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic sasawa Wofuŋte tahare biŋe râec‐jopaniŋte becâsic faio, keretac faio, reŋ faio, doŋgi faio â kamele faio Jerusalemko tiri tiki‐naneo amec‐jopa fisiniŋmu; i Israe ŋic jaŋe tahare wiac oto ɋaɋacnao Wofuŋ nore ufuŋko bafeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc.
Eme no ŋic i jaŋeraonec gâcne wâc mucjopape taha bapa ŋic â taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa, Lewiŋic hâcne junʒepieŋ,” Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
“Sambâŋ â mâreŋ ɋâricne bâfuac‐jofape nore maio fosanaŋkenicmu irec sâc jaha ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mi siroweniŋmu â ʒâŋe biŋe‐ŋeŋic mi wahaocmu.
Mosa wahaekac sâc â sabata hombaŋ sâc mâreŋŋic ʒeŋgoma jaŋe nore maio fodapeniŋte fisinʒepieŋ,” Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
“Ŋic sindaŋ ehuc bunaneo bambiŋ jaŋere qâŋɋâŋ rarâ honec‐jopanʒepieŋ; umbeŋ‐jeŋiczi mi hâmozejec â ʒoczi ʒacjopahuc mi hâpozejec, ehame mâreŋŋic sasawazi jaŋere manapie mamakâcne ezejec.”
Benjamiŋ mâreŋko Anatoti haeo taha bapa jumbiŋ jaŋere guruonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Hilikia ere ŋokâ Jeremiazi dâŋ mutaniŋkewec ʒine hâcne.
Erao Wofuŋte dâŋ fuawec ine Amoŋte ŋokâ Josia e Juda mâreŋko ŋicwofuŋ gie bahuc juhame jara 13 ewec dameŋ ira.
Erâ irec faicnao Josiare ŋokâ Jojakimzi Juda mâreŋko ŋicwofuŋ juhame mocwâc fuacnewec, erâ fuacne rakuhame Josiare ŋokâ Zedekia eki Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ juha jara 11 tarame mosa namba 5 ira Jerusalem rune kâpâcwâruo bacjopa rambiŋ.
Wofuŋte dâŋ ine kecʒiŋuc fua‐narewec:
“No neŋgoc bumaŋko mi bâfuacguhuc biac manacgupo, â neŋgoczi mi rocguhame biac rowosâecgupo, erâ ŋic jaŋere porofete jucmurâ mugarepo.”
Mume mupo, “Jei, Wofuŋ Anutu, go manac: No motec ɋârizi weniŋuc erâ ŋic dâŋ jazapemu?”
Wofuŋzi ine ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go ʒiŋuc mi muzemec, ‘No motec ɋâri’, aricne, ŋic i me i jaŋerao sorecgupe rafârezemec, erâ dâŋ gaza mutâc ekopac sâc mufua‐jarezemec.
Go jaŋere mi hâwicguzejec, no hâcne ŋezicguhuc bataracguzore gohec jupemu. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Eme Wofuŋ e meticne sicnerâ micnaneo bâuahuc ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Manakic, no dâŋnane micgao râekopac.
Erâ mamakic, no miŋecgac ŋicne ŋicne â ŋicwofuŋ â gurufâc‐jeŋic jaŋere fekicne âkendâŋgukopac, eme go qâfiec‐joparâ heropiec‐jopazemec, go imac‐joparâ sipiric‐jopazemec, ŋifec ine heheɋâre â hesarac gie bazemec.”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec: “Jeremia, go wemo wiac honekic?” Eme mupo, “No fâricjâc tieŋne moc fieha honekopac.”
Eme Wofuŋzi nazawec, “Go sâcne honekomec, no dâŋnane fârinehec eocte ɋâricne juhuc soŋaŋkeekopac hâcne.”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao kecʒiŋuc mocwâc fuame arec jajahec ewec: “Go wemo wiac honekomec?” Eme mupo, “No kuʒi moc du âtehuc ŋeha honekopac, ehame kuʒi micnezi faic mâreŋkonec ʒiŋucpec maickekac.”
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Faic mâreŋkonec hâcne sisipiriczi mâreŋ ʒirec ŋecjucfâc sasawa fisi‐jareocmu.
Manakic, no faic mâreŋkonec ŋicwofuŋ â gurufâc‐jeŋic kâcɋene piticne sasawa wira‐jarepemu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Eme jaŋe fisirâ ru sâc ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋe‐jeŋic Jerusalem haere motâc fuŋnao â rârec rârec sac fokac irec fuŋnao, erâ Juda hae sasawa irec mendâŋko râsi ejarehuc hepie ŋezejec.
Eme no hehesic‐jeŋicte erâ dâŋgieo râec‐jopahuc dâŋ mutara‐jarepemu, jaŋe no râpecnurâ nemu gâcne bâzi rike‐jarehuc jaŋacne meqâreŋ wiac dape‐jarembiŋ irec.
Goki ine becsahacge jomarâ ra dâŋ mutâcne‐garekopac sâc jazazemec. No jaŋere maio mimi qaqa egarezipore hâhâwic mi bajarezemec.
Erâ manac: No miŋecgac tâpiri qikiŋne‐garepe hae basanaŋkekicne â aeŋ wâtuŋ â aeŋ bâbâroŋzi sac bakicne iŋuc ekomec. Irec mâreŋ sâko mecne, Juda ŋicwofuŋfâc‐ticne mecne, fekicnefâc‐ticne mecne, taha bapafâc‐ticne mecne â ŋic ŋokac omane mâmâc sanaŋke‐jare‐fârezemec.
Jaŋe râsi egarehuc ʒika qaniŋmu, erâ ine bawahacguniŋte eipieniŋmu, no ŋezicguhuc bataracguzore gohec jupemu hâcne. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Go Jerusalemko ra dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mutec ŋic hazec‐jeŋicko huzejec, Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Go socɋâri juhuc maŋge norao domawec â biŋe‐nane juhuc maŋjauŋ enaremeŋ, erâ mâreŋ sawao â he sarac mi eenao bâjâpecnumeŋ no irec manasukopac.
Israe ŋic jaŋe dameŋ ira Wofuŋ nore tiriŋicfâc jumbiŋ, nânâ bâbâsu‐nane hâcne. Eme irec kosa nâmbiŋzi kiŋ nâfuambiŋ, ehame sisipiriczi fai‐jeŋicko fewec. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Jakobore kikefuŋ â Israere kikefuŋ gurune gurune ŋoŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ mananiŋ.
Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe wemo wiacte mana‐narepie sâqoreme behecnurâ nemu jabane jaŋerao qohotahuc jaŋacne wâc ŋic jabane embiŋ?
Ehuc ʒiŋuc moc mi mumbiŋ, ‘Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐nâpome wefumbeŋ â mâreŋ sawao, mâreŋ burocne hârâc‐ticnehec kereŋne â dapâcnehec, ŋiczi sicne fotâc me ŋec juc mi eeŋgopieŋko jowa qataŋ enârewec, Wofuŋ e wena?’
Eme no mâreŋ moc jufu gie‐ticnehec ira fârine â mâriri fokac i nâ gapec eniŋte râec‐ŋopapo. Ŋoŋe ine ira fisirâ mâreŋ no nahacne biŋe fowec i bâsâqorehuc bâbiepie mamakâcne ewec.
Taha bapa jaŋe ʒiŋuc mu wioc mi embiŋ, ‘Wofuŋ e wena?’ Sâcmutâc dâŋ mamana jaŋe mi mana taracnumbiŋ, soŋaŋ jaŋe râpecnumbiŋ, porofete jaŋe Baali nemu ere ʒâŋeo findaŋdâŋ mumbiŋ, ehuc bafic‐jopaniŋte tâpiri mi fojareekac jaŋerao qohotambiŋ.
“Irec hâcne no ŋoŋehec mecne, ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋehec mecne dâŋgie mocwâc mi bahuc jupemu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Ŋoŋe hâwec fotâcnerâ Kipiro nucko raniŋ, me Kedara mâreŋ ira kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopapie ra fuŋne ŋazapie mana‐hâmoniŋ, ehuc wiac kecʒiŋuc moc fuawec me mâcne i honeniŋ.
Ŋicguru moc weni jaŋe nemufâc‐jeŋic behec‐joparâ furune moc rocjopambiŋ? Eme jaŋere nemufâc i nemu fârine aricne. Nore ŋicfâc jaŋe ine huriri‐jeŋic no behecnurâ nemu moc mi babafic‐jopane i rombiŋ.
O sambâŋ, go irec hâcne weaŋkezemec, go fâfârerâ ɋarac ɋarac hâhâwicne qazemec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe sâqocne jajahec bâfuac‐jofaeŋgopieŋ, moc i opâ ʒâŋe jujune no hâcne behecnueŋgopieŋ, â moc i opâ nombâŋ mâreŋ hahaŋkekicnao ropie opâ hurâ rafâreekac.
“Israe e kiŋaŋ qaqa me? Me niŋgiŋko fuawec me? Irec wemocte ro bâtâtiec ecneeŋgopieŋ?
Laioŋ jaŋe ere owackeeŋkopieŋ, kâcɋene owackeeŋgopieŋ hâcne, mâreŋ‐ticne imackembiŋ â hae sâko‐ticne ŋerakac i turuŋkepie ʒame niniŋ siarereŋ fuawec forakac.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, Memfisi â Tapanese haeonec jaŋe qizec rogarepie utu pârâc juzemec.
Wiac i sasawa gahacne kiŋte erâ faigao fekac i! Go Wofuŋ Anutuge no hata jowacguzo muekopac sâc râpecnuekic hâcne.
Eme ʒi wemo wiac moc bâfuacmurâ Nilu opâ nâzore Aigita mâreŋko rakomec? Me wemo wiac moc bâfuacmurâ Eufrata opâ nâzore Asia mâreŋko rakomec?
Gahacne hehesiczi bâtiŋguocmu â qaqataragezi okacne bazu‐gareocmu. Irec ʒiŋuc hone mana tarac ezemec: Wofuŋ Anutuge no behecnuekic â araŋ mi banareekic i wiac hehesicne â hâtâne, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Go mârâc jaha fuŋkerâ kiŋaŋ giege hetarahuc juwefumeŋ â niŋgiŋge hetâcnemeŋ, ehuc mumeŋ, ‘No kiŋaŋ moc mi qapemu.’ Erâ ine tiki toŋne toŋne ira mecne, â jâc dodomane sasawa irec fuŋnao mecne sasec ŋokac iŋucne waha fomeŋ.
No waiŋ ukicne biaŋne â fârine sasawa saracgupo, eme go weniŋuc erâ ŋerisiehuc waiŋ kâteo fuakicne â waiŋ jawane irec sâc emeŋ?
Irec go sahacge moŋgeŋ uucnezi hecmuo me saife bocjahazi ʒurecmuo ine kiŋ bahacge i nore maio sifu wânâŋ jaha foocmu, Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Go weniŋuc erâ muekic, ‘No wânâŋhec mi juekopac, no Baali nemu jaŋerao mi qohotaekopac.’ Go wâneŋ uuruŋko hurâ weniŋuc ehuc juekic i honec, erâ wiac ebac emeŋ i manasuc me! Go kamele ŋokacne kike afec hata‐ticne kosa rac warec eekac iŋucne.
Go kâte doŋgi ŋokacne iŋucne, e mâreŋ sawao juku maŋticne ewec, eme su qahuc nokafe boc heekac, mozi andac‐ticne sâcne bawahaocmu? Moczi e bâfuaocte ecneekaczi babasa gie sâko mi bahuc su qaqa dameŋ‐ticnao ra biac bâfuaocmu.
Kikegao wic fuazacte soŋaŋkezemec, â maracge kereŋkezacte manabâc ezemec. Goki ine mukomec, ‘Aricne, mi epemu, no ŋic jabane jaŋere enareekacte jaŋerao qohotapemu hâcne.’
“Fiuc roro ŋic moc bâfuapie qurutuaocmu irec sâc jaha Israe kikefuŋ â ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic, fekicnefâc‐jeŋic, taha bapa â porofetefâc‐jeŋic mâmâc qurutuaniŋmu.
Jaŋe jâc âzâcneeŋgopieŋ, ‘Goki hâcne mamac‐nâŋec,’ â qânâ âzâcneeŋgopieŋ, ‘Goki hâcne rocnâpomeŋ.’ Jaŋe no mi maicnuhuc râpecnumbiŋ hâcne. Ʒârâ dameŋ‐jeŋicko ine mueŋgopieŋ, ‘Faharerâ bafic‐nâpoc me!’
Hâc, ŋaŋacnere manasuhuc nemufâc‐ŋeŋic bâfuac‐jopambiŋ jaŋe weni? Ejarepie fahareniŋ me! Eme ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋ‐ŋeŋicko sâcne bafic‐ŋopaniŋmu me weniŋuc irec fuŋne taniŋkezejec. O Juda kikefuŋ, go haege ŋerakac irec sâc jaha nemufâcge doma raŋgopieŋ hâcne.
“Ŋoŋe wemocte dâŋgie nareeŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe ʒeŋgoma râpecnumbiŋ i, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
No naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic bâtiŋ‐jopa‐bipiepo, jaŋe bâbâtiŋ‐nane qâsuambiŋ. Ʒika‐ŋeŋiczi laioŋ iŋucne erâ porofetefâc‐ŋeŋic nâcjopawec.
O mâreŋ ʒirec rune, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ nore dâŋ mananiŋ: No Israe kikefuŋ ŋoŋe mâreŋ burocne me mâreŋ dapâc qisiric iŋucne moc eŋarehuc jupo me? Ŋicfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe wemocte ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: ‘Nâŋe rambaŋko juŋgopeneŋ, irec gorao mi risie fanaŋmu?’
Ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ moczi eri qoqonaŋ‐ticnere moc nikeckeocmu? Me ŋic mocte ŋokac biŋe moczi heticne erinehec moc beheme foocmu me? Ŋicfâc‐nane ŋoŋe ine nore ʒoaŋ gie bapa wowosene tâmiric nikec‐ŋopawec.
“Go boe sau hatage racmurâ mana sarickehuc guriŋne baekic. Irec hata hehesicne âtehuc juku biac maŋge ewec.
Ehame ŋaqigao qarâ suriŋnezi bahacmâc jaŋere soc bohotaekac, jaŋe ine wiac moc fiuc rohapie mi bâfuac‐jopameŋ, aricne.
Erâ goki wiac i sasawa mana‐bipiehuc mukomec, ‘No kiŋ tâmiric, kimbeŋ‐ticne norao fowec i omaewec.’ Manakic, ‘No sâqocne mi bapo,’ go iŋuc mukicte dâŋko râecgupemu.
Go wemocte manabâc tâmiric ra rowec ware rowec ekomec? Asiria ŋic jaŋe behecgupie qurutuameŋ iŋuc jaha Aigita ŋic jaŋere erâ qurutuacmu.
Ehuc jaŋeraonec wâc mimi busâqoc faio wahazemec, erâ dopecguniŋte woric‐jopameŋ jaŋe hâcne Wofuŋ noni qikiŋ‐jopapo, irec jaŋerao jujuhâmo sâcne mi bâfuacmu.”
Erâ Wofuŋzi dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋic moc e ŋonâŋ‐ticne beheme ra ŋic moc rorâ juku mârâc ŋowe‐ticnerao sâcne mocwâc risieme roocmu me? Iŋuc eene fome muzac mâreŋ i boe sau mâreŋ ezac i! Goki ine ŋic bocjaha jaŋehec sasec gie bameŋzi norao sâcne risiecmu me? Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Go qâhâŋnerâ tiki mâreŋ burocnaopec ʒâŋe firâ honec: Go wena moc mi mana‐jaretec bâsâqorecgumbiŋ? Go Araba ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ sawao ruc bahuc ŋeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha ehuc hatamecko sasecŋic jaŋere woŋec ŋehuc jumeŋ, ehuc sasec â hehesicgezi mâreŋ bâsâqoremeŋ.
Irec hâcne hoere aka fuame hoe afecne me ŋemâcne i omae‐fârewec. Goki ine boe sau ŋokac iŋucne maŋrâŋgeŋ erâ mimi jaŋgeŋ jumeŋ.
Ʒi ine ʒiŋuc wira‐narekomec: ‘O Mamac‐nane, no socɋâri juhape go âgo enaremeŋ i!
Go mamana sâqoc tatara tâmiric enarecmurâ mukic, â aaricgezi tofamâc foraocte mukomec me?’ Jâmbomac, go iŋuc hâcne muekic, erâ ine sâqocne bazore manatec mi quŋkeekac.”
Eme Wofuŋ e Josiazi ŋicwofuŋ juwec dameŋ ira ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Israe e qaqatara ŋokaczi wiac ebac ewec i moc honemeŋ me? E tiki ʒora sasawa ira ferâ jâc dodomane sasawa irec fuŋnao rarâ sasec gie bahuc juwec.
Eme no ʒiŋuc manapo, ‘Wiac i efârerâ norao risieocmu.’ Eki ine mi risiewec. Ehame qoticne eeatucne, Juda hâcne, e i honewec.
Eme no Israe maŋrâŋgeŋhec e sasec gie‐ticnere erâ pasi râcnehuc behepo, i qoticne eeatucne, Juda hâcne, e honewec. Hone‐bipiehuc mi hâwickeha ra sasec gie jaha bawec.
Eme sasec gie‐ticnere maname afeckeha mâreŋ bâsâqorewec, ehame qânâ â jâc araŋ babajare izi sasec gie‐ticne ewec.
Eme qoticne eeatucne, Juda hâcne, e iŋuc jaha wiac sasawa hone‐bipiehuc maŋticne norao hâcbuc mi râewec, aricne, burec burec sawa norao risiewec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Israe maŋrâŋgeŋne ere kiŋzi wawahane foha Juda eeatucne ere kiŋzi fekac.
Go rarâ mâreŋ faicpec dâŋ kecʒiŋuc musokahuc muzemec: ‘Israe maŋrâŋgeŋne go risiezemec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. No buuruc‐nanehecte mamana sâqoc tatara tâmiric mi baju‐ŋarepemu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Mocjaha, kiŋge hone tarac. Go Wofuŋ Anutuge no râpecnurâ jâc dodomane sasawa irec fuŋnao nemu jabane jaŋerao ra qohota ware qohota ehuc jumeŋ, Ehuc dâŋnane mana rereŋ mi emeŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Naru motec râŋgeŋne ŋoŋe risieniŋ, no hâcne bomboŋ‐ŋeŋic, no hae mockonec ŋic moc â guru mockonec ŋic jajahec, iŋuc iŋuc rocjoparâ Zioŋko râec‐ŋopapemu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“‘Erâ no maŋnanezi mana ʒiziwec‐jopaekopac, ŋic iŋucne hâcne soŋaŋ râec‐jopape jaŋe mamana â maŋɋârâŋhec juhuc soŋaŋ‐ŋopanʒepieŋ.
Eme ʒiŋuc fuaocmu: Dameŋ ira fua sawec erâ mâreŋ ŋefusucmahuc ʒiŋuc mocwâc mi muniŋmu: “Oc, ʒi Wofuŋte ʒâʒâfic katapa”. Erâ irec mocwâc mi manasuhuc mu wioc eniŋmu me basaniŋmu, â ɋâricne mocwâc mi baniŋmu.
Mâcne, dameŋ ira Jerusalem haere “Wofuŋte eri ŋeŋe hâcne” muniŋmu, ehame ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe Wofuŋ ʒâŋe‐nanere erâ tumaŋneniŋmu, ehuc râŋgeŋkerâ maŋjeŋic hehesicne irec sâcko mocwâc mi juniŋmu.
Dameŋ ira Juda kikefuŋ â Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe qâturerâ mâmâc jaha faic mâreŋkonec risierâ mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere biŋe mâreŋ jarepo ira fisiniŋmu.
“‘Eme ʒiŋuc manapo: No ŋokâ‐nane mugarehuc mâreŋ fâri biaŋ jâmbâŋ moc ŋicguru gâcne jaŋere sâc sirickekac i hâcne garepemu. Erâ ʒiŋuc wâc manapo: “Mamac‐nane”, go iŋuc munarehuc bâjâpecnuhuc juku mocwâc mi râpecnucmu.
Jei, ŋokac moczi ŋowe‐ticne eatuckeekac iŋuc jaha Israe kikefuŋ ŋoŋe no eatucnumbiŋ. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.’”
Oi, mananiŋ! Israe ŋic jaŋe hata hehesicne âtehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋicte nikec‐jopame râpeckembiŋte tiki burocnao kio ŋâŋâtâc â kio wâwâsic‐jeŋicte fânâŋ fuakac.
“Naru motecfâc‐nane maŋrâŋgeŋhec ŋoŋe risieniŋ, eme qaqatara‐ŋeŋic behepemu.” Mume muniŋmu: “Manakic, go Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec jukicte nâŋe ʒi gorao fâŋgopeneŋ.
Jâmbomac, tikine tikine ojowa fua raekac i burec sasawa, Israere bâbâpiaŋ ine jâmbomac Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec gorao mocjaha fokac.
“Mamacfâc‐nâŋec wiac hure hemârec embiŋ i socɋâri juhapene nemu repicnezi biac fuŋkerâ lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic mecne, naru motecfâc‐jeŋic mecne mâmâc nâcjopa wefuku nâcjopa‐fârewec.
Mimi‐nâŋeczi fofo enârehame waha fonʒepeneŋ â mimi busâqoczi foŋnâpozejec. Nâŋe sâqocne bahuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec bunao bambeŋ hâcne, nâŋe mecne, mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mecne, ɋie‐nâŋeckonecteaŋ iŋuc ehuc juwefumbeŋzi miŋecgac eeŋgopeneŋ jaha, ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋecte dâŋ mana rereŋ mi embeŋ.”
Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “O Israe, go maŋge bârisiecmuo norao sâcne risiecmu. Go nemuɋâŋfâcge ʒâŋe mai‐naneonec bârâriec‐jopahuc ra qohota ware qohota mi ecmuo,
erâ dâŋge mujomirezo murâ Wofuŋte ɋetickehuc, ‘Wofuŋ e jujâmbâŋkekac’ muhuc jâmbomacko â mumutiŋ dâŋko erâ sioc mi ehuc mujomirecmuo ine ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo jajambuŋ â ʒeri bari eec eniŋmu.”
Wofuŋ e Judare ŋicfâc â Jerusalem ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe ʒiŋuc hâcne jazawec: “Gie ɋâricne he rikec eniŋ, â fâpâ uupicko sara mama ine mi eniŋ.
Judare ŋicfâc â Jerusalemte ŋecjucfâc ŋoŋe Wofuŋ nore biŋe eniŋte maŋŋeŋickonec sâqocne unucke behec enʒepieŋ, i eebapa‐ŋeŋic hehesicnere erâ kimbeŋ‐nanezi ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne fuarâ ʒahuc fome muzac ine moczi moc bâhâpoocte eipiezac.”
Dâŋ kecʒiŋuc Juda mâreŋko muiŋ musawec eniŋ, â Jerusalem haeo wâc musokaniŋ: “Hae mâreŋ rârec rârec qeŋ qaniŋ, ehuc hahaŋne bahuc mupie mananiŋ, ‘Ŋoŋe tumaŋnepie hae sanaŋ ŋerakac ira raʒinʒepeneŋ.’
Ajoc, wiserâ Zioŋko raniŋ, ŋec domac mi eniŋ! Wiac hâhâwicne â sisipiric sâko faic mâreŋkonec mupe warekac hâcne.
Laioŋ e ŋicne ŋicne sipiric‐jopaekaczi biac kâte uupic‐ticnaonec wefukac, e mâreŋge ima baocte faharerâ hae mâreŋ‐ticne behewec hâcne. Haege ŋerakac i sipiricke‐fâreme sesuctac fuarâ foocmu.
Ŋoŋe irec hâcne mateŋ qonaŋkerâ ki ŋâŋâtâc â kio wâwâsic ehuc muniŋ: Wofuŋ kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋzi mi behec‐nâpokac.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Dameŋ ira ŋicwofuŋ mecne, ŋic fekicne mecne hâbi fafara ejareocmu, ehame taha bapa maŋjeŋic omaeocmu â porofete bipic‐jeŋic taraocmu.”
Eme mupo, “O Wofuŋ Anutu, go jâmbomac ŋicguru ʒi â Jerusalem rune jaŋe mâretec eatuc‐jopahuc ʒiŋuc jazameŋ: ‘Wamazi ŋoŋerao fuarâ fozejec’; ʒi ine ʒikazi fai‐jeŋicko feha juju‐jeŋic omaezo ekac i.”
Dameŋ ira ŋicguru ʒi â Jerusalem rune jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazazo: “Mâreŋ sawao tiki burocne ŋerakac irecnec mâŋâŋ fâronezi waharâ fâretiŋ jaha ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋeraopec rakac, erâ i bâbâwosâe me babataniŋ gie baocte aricne,
mâŋâŋ i mocwâc hâhâwicne, nore micte fisikac. Ʒi ine no nahac dâŋ mutara‐jarepemu hâcne.”
Honeniŋ, karorac ɋâfoŋne iŋucne fisikac, ʒika keretac wiac‐ticne i mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋnehec iŋucne. Becâsicfâc‐ticne jaŋere gagasac i tucwipe jaŋere gagasac sirickekac, jei, sisipiricte biŋe eŋgopieŋ i!
Jerusalem, go maŋge ʒure bataniŋ etec hehesicge omaeme ŋezicguzo, maŋgao mamana sâqocne fokac i mo dameŋko moc behetec raocmu?
Oi, mananiŋ, Daŋ mâreŋkonec dâŋfânâŋ warekac â Eferaim tiki mâreŋkonec biŋe bâroŋ fisikac.
Ŋicne ŋicne sawaŋdâŋ qajareniŋ, â Jerusalemko dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazaniŋ: “Mâreŋ ʒorickonec somâ bapazi warerâ Juda hae ŋerakac i râsi ejarehuc semuja heŋgopieŋ.
Jerusalem e fenarewecte râreckehuc gie soŋaŋzi eekac iŋuc ehuc ruc baŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Wiac i juju â eebapagere erâ faigao fekac, wiac hâtâne fua‐garekac â jujuge sipirickezo ekac i hehesicgere fârine hâcne.”
Jei, busâqoc, jei, busâqoc! No ʒâic repicne manakopac, bunane herickekac, bunane ʒâʒâficne qakac. Wemocko niniŋkerâ juzapo? Ʒi qeŋfânâŋ â ʒikare ojawa manakopac hâcne.
Sisipiriczi sisipiric irec biŋe fisikac, mâreŋ sasawa imacke‐fârekicne, fic wiac‐nane ututuŋ jâmbâŋ â qoruc boze‐nane ɋeŋfâfâc jaha sipirickekicne.
Sându maro honeekopac â qeŋfânâŋ manaekopac i mo dameŋ omae‐nareocmu?
“Jâmbomac, ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe maŋ tâmiric, jaŋe no kâuc bacnueŋgopieŋ, jaŋe naru motec mutucne â mamana tâmiric, wiac sâqocne mana sarickeeŋgopieŋ, wiac biaŋnere ine kâuc baeŋgopieŋ.”
Jei, no mâreŋko fipe rame sisifucne â sawane foha honepo, erâ sambâŋko fipe feme tatamac‐ticne basapo.
Jei, no tiki honec‐jopape ɋiɋiteckembiŋ â mâreŋ facne sasawa qiriŋ qahuc ŋembiŋ.
Jei, no ʒâŋe fipe rame ŋic moc mi jume honepo, â sawa wipe wise‐fârembiŋ.
Jei, no ʒâŋe fipe rawec, eme hae mâreŋ nânâ mâririhec fowec i ŋerisieme mâreŋ burocne foha honepo, â hae‐ticne sasawa i ima bafârekicne, i Wofuŋ kimbeŋ sanaŋ‐ticnere erâ iŋuc fuawec.
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc hâcne muwec: “Mâreŋ sasawa tuhutac fuarâ fozejec, bâbâsirowe ine mi bâsirowe‐fârezepac.
Irec mâreŋ makuc baocmu â faic sambâŋ e gâpâreocmu. No iŋuc mupo â mana biric epo hâcne, erâ irec bunane mi sâqoreocmu â maŋnane wâc mi risieme behepemu.”
Becâsicko rara ŋic â tepeŋic jaŋere ojoware erâ haene haene ŋic jaŋe wiseniŋmu, kâte uupicko rucneniŋmu â qânâuŋko raʒirâ soŋkeniŋmu, hae sasawa tuhu foha moczi moc maŋnao ŋec juc mocwâc mi eocmu.
Sipiricgukicne go ine wemo ecmu? Go ŋaqi bâbâroŋ hetec huocmu me eri wiac golzi bakicne qonaŋkecmuo me ʒâŋe maige jâwec ruacnecmuo ine sahac bapa i sifu maŋgâŋ jaha ehuc jucmu. Sahacgere sasec ejareekac jaŋe qaisocguhuc jujuge gowac rozo maŋkehuc jueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋokac moc gozi kime kio owa eekac, me ŋokac moc mârâc motec‐ticne rohuc kio huse eekac, kio owa iŋucne manapo, Zioŋte otâ ere kio owa hâcne, e nokafe hehuc meticne sicnerâ muwec: “Jei, ŋic ʒika qaqa jaŋere maio weaŋkekopac.”
Jerusalem haere hata forakac sâc fotâcne rac warec ehuc mana honeniŋ: Ŋoŋe hae ʒoŋa‐ticnao ŋic moc e wiac tiŋne ebac ehuc juha, me siocmâc juocte ecneha bâfuaniŋmuo ine haere kiŋ behepemu.
“Wofuŋ e jujâmbâŋkekac”, jaŋe iŋuc muipiehuc mumupaŋ‐jeŋic i me i mupie burecne eekac.
O Wofuŋ, go siocmâc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne hone maiŋ ejareekic, goki jopa bâtiŋ ejaretec jaŋe manapie wawahane ewec, â bâsirowec‐jopahaŋtec bâbâtiŋge qikiŋnembiŋ; ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic râŋgeŋkewec i haroŋaŋ sanaŋne irec sâc jâuruwec, jaŋe maŋjeŋic bârisieniŋte takic‐jopawec.
Eme no ʒiŋuc mupo: “Jaŋe ŋic ŋokac omane, jaŋe Wofuŋte hata â Anutu‐jeŋicte mumutâc dâŋ kâuc baeŋgopieŋte mutuc eeŋgopieŋ.
Irec no ŋic kâcɋene jaŋerao moc rarâ dâŋ jazapemu, jaŋe Wofuŋte hata â Anutu‐jeŋicte mumutâc dâŋ manaeŋgopieŋ mecne.” Jaŋe ine iŋuc jaha kiŋaŋ gie‐jeŋic hetara‐fârehuc niŋgiŋ hetâcne‐fârembiŋ.
Irec laioŋzi kâteonec wefurâ kisuc‐jopaocmu â kâte qâtozi sipiric‐jopaocmu, erâ qowi mimicne lepad e hae‐jeŋic râreckehuc ruc baocmu, eme ŋic jaŋe wahapie sâc kisuc qâsuc‐jopaocmu, i sindaŋ â qaqatara‐jeŋic hâhâwicne irec.
“No weniŋuc erâ sâqocne bâtâmire‐garezapo? Naru motecfâcge jaŋe behecnumbiŋ, ehuc nemu fâri tâmiric jaŋerao ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ. No nânâ mâriri bâfua‐jarepo, jaŋe ine rujeŋic no behecnurâ sasec ficko tumaŋnembiŋ.
Jaŋe becâsic ŋicne wokemaŋ sâko â andachec iŋucne, moc e âgo‐ticnere ŋokac buroro ecneekac â moc e âgo‐ticnere ŋokac iŋuc jaha ecneekac.
Eme no wiac irec mi bâtiŋ‐jopazapo me? Me ŋicguru iŋucne okacne mi bazu‐jarezapo me? Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Waiŋ giegaŋ‐jeŋicko raʒirâ sipirickeniŋ, ima ine mi bafâreniŋ. Waiŋ qaŋeŋne hetâcneniŋ, jaŋe Wofuŋ nore biŋe aricne.
Israe kikefuŋ â Juda kikefuŋ jaŋe boc qaisocnueŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Jaŋe Wofuŋ mickehuc ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ, “E iŋuc mi eocmu, wiac hâhâwicne fai‐nâŋecko moc mi feocmu, nâŋe ʒika â roroc mi bâfuanaŋmu.
Porofete jaŋere dâŋ i fânâŋ sawa, jaŋe dâŋ fârine mi bajueŋgopieŋ, irec wiac i jaŋacne faio fezejec.”
Irec Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, jaŋe dâŋ iŋucne mueŋgopieŋte no dâŋnane micgao râepe ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne ezejec, eme izi ŋicguru ʒi ʒoc iŋucne epie ʒâseŋ‐jopazejec.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no mupe ʒorickonec ŋicguru moc ware fisirâ Israe kikefuŋ ŋoŋe râsi eŋareniŋmu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Jaŋe ŋicguru sanaŋne â mârâc jaha fuarâ mimiŋzi ɋâric juwefumbiŋ. Ŋoŋe ŋic i dâŋmarac‐jeŋic kâuc baeŋgopieŋ, â dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ i fuŋne mi mana taraeŋgopieŋ.
Tepe motec‐jeŋicte hâniŋ i ʒâŋeruŋ micaaŋ iŋucne, jaŋe ŋic qac momori sasawa.
Jaŋe nânâ mâririge mecne, padige mecne i nâfâreniŋmu, ŋokâfâcge mecne otâfâcge mecne mâmâc omaec‐jopaniŋmu; lamafâcge mecne bulimakaofâcge mecne i nâmiziec‐jopaniŋmu; jaŋe waiŋ â jâmbo hândâŋ wiacge nâfâreniŋmu â hae sanaŋge ŋerakac ira roweckehuc juekic i hâcne ʒikazi henʒaŋ qanʒaŋneniŋmu.”
“Dameŋ ira iŋuc jaha mi bâsirowec‐ŋopa‐fârepemu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
‘Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec e wemocte wiac i sasawa enârewec?’ Ŋic jaŋe iŋuc mu wioc epie ʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘Ŋoŋe no behecnurâ ŋaŋacne mâreŋko nemu jabane kiŋaŋ qajarembiŋ, iŋuc jaha mâreŋ moc ŋaŋac rune mi juŋgopieŋko ŋic furune kiŋaŋ qajarenʒepieŋ.’”
Jakobore kikefuŋko dâŋ kecʒiŋuc musokanʒepieŋ, â Juda mâreŋko mupie mananʒepieŋ:
“O ŋicguru mutuc matacne â maŋ tâmiric, ʒâŋehec juhuc wiac mi honeeŋgopieŋ â hazechec juhuc dâŋ mi manaeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe dâŋ ʒi mananiŋ:
Ŋoŋe nore mi hâwic‐ŋopaekac me? Ŋoŋe nore maio ɋarac ɋarac mi qaeŋgopieŋ me? Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. No hâwec mecqaŋeŋnao moŋgeŋ râepo, eme izi aka fofo sanaŋ foha hâweczi sâcne mi jâururâ wefuocmu, siri sâko qahuc qâipieocmu, hâhâwicne fânâŋkehuc sifu mi wefuocmu.
Ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe ine maŋjeŋic râŋgeŋne â qaqaharicne, jaŋe hata kizurâ wisembiŋ.
Ehuc maŋjeŋiczi ʒiŋuc moc mi mumbiŋ: ‘Nâŋâc Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec araŋ bacnenaŋ, eki hâcne mume hoe ʒoaŋ sâckoa fuaekac â ekizia wâc mume qa roro â nânâsu i dameŋ mukicnao sâckoa fua‐nâreekac.’
Hehesic‐ŋeŋiczi ine wiac irec hata hesifucke‐ŋarewec, â sâqocne‐ŋeŋiczi wiac biaŋne sakare‐ŋarewec.
Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋic hehesicne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe wosaŋeŋ bapa iŋucne kamierâ ruc baeŋgopieŋ, â bitiŋzi ŋic kicjopaocte râe‐jareeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋiczi hejeŋicko wipe qowi ŋiepie fusucmaekac, irec sâc jaha eeatuczi ficjeŋic fusucmarâ fokac; jaŋe iŋuc ehuc bomboŋ erâ juhapie mafa mâriri fua‐jareekac, ehame wokemaŋ â biuc sâkohec eeŋgopieŋ.
Micjeŋickonec dâŋ hehesicne wahahuc foekac, bekâ mâsiŋ jaŋe juhâmoniŋte dâŋjeŋic mumutiŋ dâŋte sâcko mi mutaraeŋgopieŋ, â qarâ suriŋne jaŋere dâŋ tutumaŋko mi dopeckeeŋgopieŋ.
Eme no wiac iŋucnere mi bâtiŋ‐jopazapo me? Me ŋicguru iŋucne jaŋe okacne mi bazu‐jarezapo me? Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Mâreŋ ʒira wiac hâhâwicne â mamakâcne fuaekac.
Porofete jaŋe burec ehuc findaŋdâŋ mueŋgopieŋ, â taha bapazi jaŋehec maŋ mocjaha ehuc guriŋ bapa gie baeŋgopieŋ, eme ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe iŋuc hâcne foocte ejareekac. Mâc, wiac i tara‐fâreme ŋoŋe wenac eniŋmu?
Faic mâreŋkonec wiac hâhâwicne â sisipiric sâko wareocte faharekac, irec Benjamiŋte ɋâricfâc ŋoŋe Jerusalem hae maŋnaonec wiseniŋ! Tekoa haeo qeŋ qaniŋ â Bete‐Kerem haeo ira hosâc heniŋ.
No Zioŋte otâ hone jauŋ ecnehape aŋac faio soka sanaŋ ewec e hâcne sipirickepemu.
Lama bulimakao soŋaŋ jaŋe qowifâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec fisicneniŋmu, ehuc hae rârec rârec qoruc boze‐jeŋic fâreniŋmu, â ru sâc qowifâc‐jeŋic ejarepie nânâ nâhuc juniŋmu.
Jaŋe ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Zioŋ rune jaŋehec ʒika qanaŋte sowa juhuc ʒawienaŋ! Ajoc, ʒoaŋ ɋaɋackoa ferâ jopanaŋ me!” Iŋuc murâ muniŋmu: “Jei, ʒoaŋ biac huzo ekac â mumuc biac ʒorakac.
Ajoc, ŋafeo fenaŋ, erâ erific ŋerakac sâc ima banaŋ!”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: “Jâc wiac qafaraniŋ, ehuc Jerusalem haere somâ râehuc mâreŋ facne moc baniŋ. Jei, hae sâko irec maŋnao bâbâʒâic sasawa fokacte okacne fuacnezejec hâcne.
Opâ ʒâŋeonec opâ wefuekac irec sâc jaha hae ira sâqocnezi fuaekac, hae maŋnao bâbâʒâic â sisipiric irec dâŋ fohuc juekac; erâ ʒârâ ʒâpâ â ʒika dameŋ sâc mai‐naneo fuame honeekopac.
O Jerusalem, go uŋdâŋ manac! Maŋnanezi behecgurâ ima bacgupe hae sesuctac fuarâ fozicte.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋiczi waiŋ qizecko fârine bâtirikicne ʒâhec ro nusec eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha Israe ŋic nâfocne ro nusec ejarezemec; waiŋ gie bapazi waiŋ qaŋeŋnao harierâ hândâŋne basaekac iŋuc jaha ehuc Israe ŋic rocjopa‐fârezemec.”
Eme mupo: “Weni jaŋe mu tutuc ejarepemu, â weni jaŋe uŋsawaŋ dâŋ jazape mananiŋmu? Manakic, jaŋe hazec‐jeŋic bâzickekicne, dâŋ sâcne mi manaeŋgopieŋ. Jâmbomac, jaŋe Wofuŋ dâŋgere manapie ʒoraŋ eha mana aŋac mi eeŋgopieŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ gore kimbeŋzi fusucmacnukac, no bâmunaŋkezore eipiekopac.” Iŋuc mupe Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Naru motec hae ʒoŋao juŋgopieŋ jaŋere faio hoŋkec, â ŋicmotec tumaŋnerâ juŋgopieŋ jaŋere faio mâmâc. Ŋowe ŋonâŋ jaŋe mecne, ŋic ŋokac qizecne jaŋe mecne, erâ hâmoc dameŋ‐jeŋic bembeŋkekac jaŋe mâmâc kâpâcwâru bacjopa razo.
Fic wiac‐jeŋic mecne, gie wiac‐jeŋic mecne, â ŋokacfâc‐jeŋic i mâmâc ŋicguru moc jaŋere biŋe eniŋmu, no menane sicnehuc mâreŋ ʒirec ŋecjucfâc‐ticne râsi ejarepemu hâcne. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Ŋic omane mecne, fekicne mecne, jaŋe mâmâc sasawa burecko moneŋ mafa hureniŋte andac eeŋgopieŋ, Erâ porofete â taha bapa jaŋe wâc ʒeŋgoma eatuc ehuc jueŋgopieŋ.
Wama moc mi fohame sifu ‘Wama, wama’ muhuc ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere huc wic burec burec mac sawa bâsomieeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe wiac mamakâcne ehuc moc mimiembiŋ me? Aricne, jaŋe moc mi mimiehuc mimi jaŋgeŋ jueŋgopieŋ i! Irec waha jopaocmu jaŋehec mâmâc waha jopazejec, eme no bâtiŋ‐jopapemu dameŋ ira fâfâc‐jopame rândiŋkenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋoŋe hata fokac i ra honeniŋ, ehuc mârâc jaha hata weniŋuc fowec â bibiaŋte hata i wena fokac irec mu wioc erâ bâfuarâ ranʒepieŋ, ehuc jujumana bâfuanʒepieŋ. Jaŋe ine mumbiŋ, ‘Mi ranaŋmu.’
Eme no ruc bapa ŋic râec‐jopahuc mupo, ‘Ŋoŋe qeŋfânâŋte hazec râeniŋ.’ Jaŋe ine mumbiŋ, ‘Nâŋe irec takic‐nâpokac.’
Irec jaŋe wemo wiac fua‐jareocmu i ŋicne ŋicne ŋoŋe mananiŋ, â kikefuŋ go wâc mana tarac.
Mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ go manac: Noni mupe wiac hâhâwicne ŋicguru ʒi jaŋere faio feocmu, i jaŋe jaŋac wiac mana biric embiŋ irec fâricne; jaŋe dâŋnane mana rereŋ mi embiŋ â sâcmutâc dâŋnane qikiŋnembiŋ hâcne.
Iŋuc ehapie Seba mâreŋkonec wiac âsu biaŋ â mâreŋ ʒorickonec musijâc sahacne izi wemo enareocmu? Qowi hâcbuc ririke‐ŋeŋicte mocwâc mi aŋacnukac, â taha bâzi‐ŋeŋicte wâc mi enarekac.
Irec Wofuŋ no ʒiŋuc mukopac: ‘Manakic, no ŋicguru ʒi jaŋere hatao kike hehepiric qânâ hepe ŋeraocmu, eme ira herâ waha jopaocmu, mame ŋokâ â âgo bago jaŋe mâmâc ira sipirickeniŋmu.’”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, ŋicguru moc jaŋe faic mâreŋkonec wareniŋte ʒawieŋgopieŋ, ŋicguru sâkozi mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaonec wareniŋte fahareŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Jaŋe tepe damu‐jeŋichec, jaŋe momori jâmbâŋ, ŋic moc mi akic‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, ojowa‐jeŋic i hâwec siri sâkore fânâŋ iŋucne, jaŋe becâsic faio wareŋgopieŋ, ehuc ʒika qaniŋte birickehuc Zioŋte otâ go râsi egareŋgopieŋ.”
Jerusalem hae rune jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Nâŋe biŋe‐jeŋic manarâ menâŋec betaŋkekac, erâ hâwic‐nâpoha ŋokac moczi motec roocte gozi kime ʒâic manaekac irec sâc ʒâic manaŋgopeneŋ.
Irec nâŋe gieo mi ranʒepeneŋ, â hata sâkoo wâc mi junʒepeneŋ, ira hâcne râsi jaŋe ʒika gie baŋgopieŋ, â rârec rârec hâhâwic sâko fokac.”
Eme Wofuŋzi muwec: “O ŋicfâc‐nanere otâ, go mateŋ qonaŋkec, erâ ʒafe ruarâ ŋokâ mocjaha sawa jurâ hâmome mamakucne eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha ki mamakuc hâhâwicne ezemec, sisipiric ŋic e ututuŋ jâmbâŋ fisi‐gareocmu irec.
“Jeremia, go ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere juju â eebapa hone tarahuc ba esâic ecmurâ mugarepo.
Jaŋe ʒeŋgoma râŋgeŋke sanaŋkembiŋ, ehuc afeckerâ micko âkec eeŋgopieŋ; jaŋe qânâ â aeŋ iŋucne sisipiric gie bafâreeŋgopieŋ.
Ʒoc ficnepie bâruŋkewec, eme aeŋ wiac ʒocko rikepie mi wosâewec; gie i maŋgâŋ bakicne, ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe wosâerâ mi râriembiŋ.
Irec ʒâŋe‐jeŋic ʒiŋuc muzo: ‘Siliwa qaisockekicne’; i Wofuŋ noni qikiŋ‐jopapo irec.”
Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ Jeremiarao fuawec i kecʒiŋuc:
“Wofuŋte taha ufuŋ irec motâcko ra domahuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Juda mâreŋ rune Wofuŋ mai ecneniŋte motâc ʒi fotâcneeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe ʒeŋgoma Wofuŋte dâŋ ʒi mananiŋ!
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu hâcne, eki ʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe juju â eebapa‐ŋeŋic bâtiŋnepie biaŋkezejec, eme no hae ʒira ʒuhuckerâ juniŋte mana‐ŋarepemu.
Ŋoŋe burecdâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc ira mi roweckenʒepieŋ, ‘Ohec, Wofuŋte taha ufuŋ, Wofuŋte taha ufuŋ, Wofuŋte taha ufuŋ ʒine hâcne.’
“Ŋoŋe jâmbomac juju â eebapa‐ŋeŋic bâtiŋnepie biaŋkeocmuo â ŋaŋackoaŋ sâcmutâc dâŋ tiŋnere sâcko wiac ebac eec eniŋmuo
erâ ŋic jabane me hozec bekâ fific mi bacjopaniŋmuo, me ŋic bahacmâc jaŋere soc hae ʒira mi hoŋkeniŋmuo â ŋaŋac sipirickenʒipiŋte nemu jabane jaŋerao mi qohotaniŋmuo
ine mana‐ŋarepe mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic mârâc jaha mâreŋ tahac‐jopapo ʒira ʒuhuckerâ juraʒiniŋmu sanaŋ.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe maŋgâŋ jaha eeatuc dâŋko roweckeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe fiuc roeŋgopieŋ, ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, sasec gie baeŋgopieŋ, burecko ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ, Baali nemu hosâc âsu rikecneeŋgopieŋ â nemu jabane mârâc kâuc bacjopambiŋ jaŋerao qohotaeŋgopieŋ.
Eme weniŋuc? Mâsi i eeŋgopieŋzi fic ʒira nore ʒâŋe fokacko mai‐naneo fuazo muŋgopieŋ me? Ehuc muŋgopieŋ, ‘Nâŋe ʒira sâcne juŋgopeneŋ’, iŋuc murâ wiac mamakâcne sasawa keci ʒuhuckerâ eniŋte maŋkeŋgopieŋ.
Fic kecʒira nore ʒâŋe fokac i ŋoŋe honepie fiuc roro ŋic jaŋere qânâuŋ tinac ekac me? Jâmbomac, no nahac wâc honepe iŋuc tinac ekac, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Ajoc, ŋoŋe ficnane Silo haeo ŋewec erâ mârâc jaha ʒâŋe‐nane ira foocte mupo ira hâcne raniŋ, ehuc Israe ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere hehesicte erâ ficnane weniŋuc ecnepo i honeniŋ!
Wiac sindaŋne i sasawa embiŋ â no uŋ sawaŋ ʒoɋachec eŋare‐bipiehape mi manambiŋ erâ wira‐ŋare‐bipiehape micnaneo mi rombiŋ. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Irec ʒi, fic kecʒira nore ʒâŋe fokac â ŋoŋe manapie huec sanaŋ‐ŋeŋic ekac, erâ mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic hae tahac‐jopapo i Silo ecnepo sâc ijaha ecnezepac.
Ehuc ʒâŋe mai‐naneonec tuŋŋopazepac, i qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic, Eferaimte ɋâricfâc hâcne, furu jaha tuŋjopa‐fârepo irec sâc.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Jeremia, goki ine ŋic i jaŋere erâ mi numuzemec â jaŋere erâ wira wâwâsic ehuc ʒoɋac mi enarezemec, no mi mana‐garepemu irec.
Jaŋe Juda mâreŋko hae ŋerakac irec maŋnao â Jerusalem haere hata forakac ira wiac ebac eeŋgopieŋ i go mi honeekic me?
Naru motec jaŋe ʒoc ro nusec eeŋgopieŋ â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ʒoc ruqueeŋgopieŋ, ŋokac jaŋe ine sawa qânikiŋ irec ŋokac wofuŋ ere nânâ poroŋ rikeniŋte poroŋ ɋâricne ba hetikic eeŋgopieŋ; erâ no bâiŋnuniŋte nemu jabane waiŋzi taha hoŋke‐jareeŋgopieŋ.
Ehame jâmbomac no moc bâiŋnueŋgopieŋ me? Me jaŋe jaŋaczia bâbâiŋ eec erâ qurutuaeŋgopieŋ?
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu no kecʒiŋuc mukopac: Manakic, kimbeŋ â aaric‐nane i hae mâreŋ ʒirec faio feocmu, eme ŋic faio mecne, qowi faio mecne, gieo jâc doma rakac irec faio mecne, erâ mâreŋte wiac fârine fua raekac irec faio mâmâc ferâ mi hâhâpo ʒarahuc foocmu.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋoŋe qowi hâcbuc ririkene i taha bâzi‐ŋeŋichec qâturerâ râeniŋ, erâ qowi nâjâmbâŋkeniŋ me!
No mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa wahahuc qowi hâcbuc ririke me taha bâzi irec dâŋ moc mi jazahuc sâcmutâc ejarepo.
Aricne, ʒiŋuc ine mutâcne‐jarepo, ‘Ŋoŋe dâŋnane mana rereŋ epie no Anutu‐ŋeŋic juhape ŋoŋe ŋicfâc‐nane junʒepieŋ, ehuc hata mutâcne‐ŋarepemu sâc i juhâc qâhâmoniŋte âte rahuc junʒepieŋ.’
Jaŋe ine mi manambiŋ â hazec‐jeŋic i nore dâŋte wâc mi râembiŋ, aricne, jaŋe jaŋacne mamanasu biri bâjâpembiŋ â maŋrâŋgeŋ‐jeŋicte hata hehesicne âtembiŋ, ehuc no mi maicnuhuc râpecnumbiŋ hâcne.
Mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec wahambiŋ dameŋ ira fuŋkerâ kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane sasawa, porofete hâcne, jaŋe dameŋne dameŋne ŋoŋerao sorec‐jopapozi sorec‐jopahuc juekopac.
Jaŋe ine dâŋnane mi manambiŋ â hazec‐jeŋic i nore dâŋte mi râembiŋ wâc; aricne, jaŋe mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic siric‐jopahuc maŋrâŋgeŋ embiŋ.
“Jeremia, go dâŋ i furu jaha jaza‐fâretec dâŋge sifu mi mananiŋmu â wira‐jaretecne micgao mi roniŋmu.
Irec ʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte mumutâc dâŋ mana rereŋ mi eeŋgopieŋ â bâbâtiŋ qâsuaeŋgopieŋ i ŋicguru ʒi ŋoŋe hâcne. Siocmâc juju‐ŋeŋic i omaewec, â irec dâŋ micŋeŋicko mocwâc mi fokac.
Irec qizec susuc‐ŋeŋic bâtâcnerâ behepie rahame tiki burocnao ki mamakuc eniŋ; Wofuŋ e ŋicguru kimbeŋ qajarewec jaŋe suŋgiŋ‐jopahuc behec‐jopawec hâcne.’
“Judare ɋâricfâc jaŋe wiac hone aŋac mi ecneekopac i hâcne embiŋ, jaŋe nore ʒâŋe fokac fic ira wâwânâŋ bâfuaniŋte wiac‐jeŋic mamakâcne, ɋâŋ qâqâtâc hâcne, i âkendâŋnembiŋ. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Erâ naru motecfâc‐jeŋic ʒocko rikec‐jopaniŋte Beŋ‐Hinom wâneŋko bâzi ririke hae Tofete bambiŋ. No ine wiac iŋucnere dâŋ moc mi mutâcne‐jarepo, erâ nore maŋkonec wiac iŋucnere dâŋ moc mi fuawec wâc.
Irec ʒiŋuc mananiŋ: Dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira Tofete mecne, Beŋ‐Hinom wâneŋ mecne irec ʒâŋe jâmbâŋ mocwâc mi muhuc ‘Sisipiric Wâneŋ’ muniŋmu; Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Jaŋe mâreŋ gâcne basahuc qâŋɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic Tofete haeo ducjopaniŋmu hâcne.
Eme ŋicguru keci qâŋɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic i sawa wipe â kâte qâto jaŋere nânâ eniŋmu, jaŋe nâcjopahapie moczi moc mi jâpec‐jopaocmu.
Eme no Juda mâreŋko hae ŋerakac â Jerusalem haeo hata forakac sâc ʒeri bubiaŋ fua raekac i mecne, erâ ŋic ŋokac roroc ehuc ʒeri wiac eeŋgopieŋ i mâmâc bâniniŋke‐fârepemu, mâreŋ i tuhutac fuarâ fozejec hâcne.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ ʒiŋuc fokac: “Dameŋ ira Judare ŋicwofuŋfâc â fekicnefâcne â taha bapa â porofete erâ Jerusalem ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋere siec wiac i ʒâŋeruŋ‐jeŋickonec wisepie wefuocmu.
Ehame mosa ʒoaŋ â bâpiŋ jaŋere tatamacko qandaŋkeniŋmu, i ine maŋjeŋic jaŋerao râepie domaha kiŋaŋ qajare jumbieŋ â jaŋerao qohotahuc mu wioc ejarerâ fodape‐jare jumbieŋ irec; eme ro nusec me duducke i mocwâc mi eniŋmu, aricne, jawa iŋucne eme behepie mâreŋte guec eocmu.
Eme ŋicguru repicne ʒi jaŋere nâfocne ira me ira jâpec‐jopape ra juniŋmu jaŋe jujure mâcne, hâmocte manapie aŋacne eocmu. Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
“Jeremia, go ŋicfâc‐nane jazazemec, Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋic mâreŋko waha jopame mocwâc mi fahareeŋgopieŋ me? Me moc e qâsorieocmuzi hata mocwâc i risieocmu me?
Ŋicguru ʒi, Jerusalem hae rune hâcne, jaŋe ine wemocte dameŋ sâc qâsoriehuc jueŋgopieŋ, ehuc eeatucko qohotahuc risieniŋte qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ?
No hazec râerâ manapo: Jaŋe burecdâŋ muhuc jueŋgopieŋ, moczi moc hehesic‐ticnere busâqoc moc mi manaekac, ehuc wemocko muzac, ‘Jei, no weniŋuc epo?’ Aricne, ʒeŋgoma becâsiczi ʒikao kosa gasacke sâqoreeŋgopieŋ irec sâc hata‐jeŋicko fâro rahuc qâsorieeŋgopieŋ.
Sawao qeʒo juekac e dameŋ‐ticne manaekac, â buni mecne, sawa hehetâc wipe mecne, koneŋ mecne jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha ririsie dameŋ‐jeŋic manaeŋgopieŋ. Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe ine Wofuŋ nore mumutâc dâŋte kâuc baeŋgopieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe wemocko ʒiŋuc muniŋmu, ‘Nâŋe maŋɋârâŋhec â Wofuŋte sâcmutâc dâŋ i fonârekac wâc?’ Manaŋgopieŋ, qâqâreŋ ŋic jaŋe dâŋ hetikiehuc qâreŋkepie burecdâŋ ewec.
Maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe qurutuaniŋmu, ehuc bipic tatara ejareme jaŋacne dâŋzi ufic ejareha ira jowaniŋmu. Manakic, jaŋe Wofuŋ nore dâŋ qâsuambiŋte jaŋacne mamanazi wemocko moc bafic‐jopaocmu?
Irec ŋokacfâc‐jeŋic i ŋic furune jarepemu, â gie wiac‐jeŋic i mâreŋ‐jeŋic rauckembiŋ jaŋe qikiŋne‐jarepemu. Fekicne mecne, wahakicne mecne jaŋe ʒeŋgoma burecko moneŋ mafa hureniŋte andac eeŋgopieŋ hâcne; porofete â taha bapa jaŋe wâc ʒeŋgoma eatuc ehuc jueŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe wama moc mi fohame ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere huc wic burec burec bâsomie‐jarehuc ‘Wama wama’ mueŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe wiac mamakâcne bâfuambiŋte mimiepie muzac sâckezac, jaŋe ine mimi‐jeŋic jaŋgeŋkekicnere mimi busâqocte kâuc baeŋgopieŋ. Irec gâcne waha jopaocmu jaŋehec mâmâc waha jopazejec; no bâtiŋ‐jopapemu dameŋ ira fâfâc‐jopame rândiŋkenʒepieŋ hâcne, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Erâ dâŋnane moc ʒiŋuc fokac: No jaŋerao fârine ro nusec epemurâ fisi waiŋ qizecko hândâŋne basaekopac, â jâmbojâcko hândâŋne basaekopac wâc, ehame rehacne ɋaŋarâ hâmoekac; irec ŋiczi ofaŋne behec ejareniŋte biac mutâcne‐jarepo.”
Jaŋe wioŋgopieŋ, “Wemo wiacte niniŋkerâ ŋeŋgopeneŋ? Ajoc, tumaŋnerâ hae sanaŋko rarâ sipirickenaŋ me! Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec e sipirickenaŋte maname fokac, nâŋac Wofuŋ bunao bahuc sâqocne bambeŋte qotâre micopâ gumec‐nâpoocmu hâcne.
Nâŋâc wamare ʒâŋe fihapene wiac biaŋne i me i moc mi fua‐nârewec; jei, bâbâpiaŋ dameŋte enâre‐bipieha wiac bipic tataranehec fuawec fokac.
“Becâsicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere nokafe fânâŋ i Daŋ mâreŋkonec fisime manaeŋgopeneŋ, becâsicfâc‐jeŋic ŋicne jaŋere dâŋfânâŋte mâreŋzi ɋiɋitecke‐fâreekac. Jaŋe ware fisirâ mâreŋ fainao wiac fuarâ fokac i nâmizieniŋmu, erâ hae sâko â ŋecjucfâc‐ticne i mâmâc omaec‐jopaniŋmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no qotâ homa wiac ejarepe fisi‐ŋareniŋmu, eme qaŋgecte fuŋne mamanazi bâmâteŋ‐jopaniŋte eipiehapie kicŋopaniŋmu.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
No ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio juhape wiac moczi bâpiaŋnuocmu i mi fokac, no busâqoc mana utuckehuc juekopac.
Keci manac, ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere oowa â marac fânâŋzi mâreŋ ʒorickonec ʒiŋuc fisikac: “Wofuŋ e Zioŋko mocwâc mi jukac me? Â ŋicwofuŋ‐ticnezi hae maŋnao mi jukac me?” “Jaŋe wemocte ɋâŋ qâqâtâczi â mâreŋ jabaonec nemuɋâŋzi bâiŋnumbiŋ?”
“Nânâ bâbâsu dameŋ i jâurukicne, â ʒoaŋ dameŋ i tarakac wâc, ehame babafic moc mi fua‐nârewec.”
Ŋicfâc‐nane ba sipiric ejarekicnere buheric enarekac no busâqoc manahuc bipic tatara ekopac.
Gileade haeo wokemaŋ moc mi fokac me? Me dota ira moc mi jukac me? Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere bâbâpiaŋ i wemocte mi fuakac?
Ojai, qizec‐nane i opâ ʒâkâŋ eha ʒâŋeuc‐nane i opâ ʒâŋe iŋucne ezac me! Eme no ŋafe ʒoaŋ ŋicfâc‐nane qâhâmoc‐jopakicne jaŋere erâ kiohuc juzapo.
Ojai, mâreŋ sawao boze‐nane moc ŋeme muzac no ŋicfâc‐nane behec‐joparâ ira ra juzapo! Jaŋe boe sau ŋic sasawa, erâ ŋicguru eeatuc‐jeŋichec.
Nameŋ‐jeŋic i tepeo gurutuc âtepie huekac irec sâc ecneŋgopieŋ, ehame jauŋ fârizi mâcne, burecdâŋzi mâreŋ‐jeŋicko sanaŋkeekac; jaŋe hehesiczi hehesic bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, ehuc no mi manacnueŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Ŋoŋe ʒeŋgoma âgofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere sawaŋ‐ŋeŋic qahuc junʒepieŋ, ehuc qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋerao wâc mi roweckenʒepieŋ; jaŋe docbapa sasawa â âgofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe wâc micko âkec eeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ʒeŋgoma âgofâc‐jeŋic eatuc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, ehuc moczi moc dâŋ fâri qizecne mi muekac; jaŋe nameŋ‐jeŋiczi burecdâŋ muocte esockeeŋgopieŋ, erâ qac qâsoric eku risieniŋte mi afeckeeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe bâbâʒâiczi bâbâʒâic â eatuczi eatuc bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, ehuc no manacnuniŋte ine mi ejareekac, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Irec Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, no ʒocko rikec‐jopahuc ba esâic ejarepemu. Iŋuc mi ehuc ine ŋicfâc‐nane weniŋuc ejarepe sâckeocmu?
Jaŋe nameŋ‐jeŋic i tepe motec hâmoc bâbâfua iŋucne, eatuc dâŋ muekac hâcne; miczi âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec wamadâŋ mueŋgopieŋ, maŋjeŋiczi ine bitiŋ râe‐jareniŋte dâŋne manasu biric eeŋgopieŋ.
Wiac iŋucnere mi bâtiŋ‐jopazapo me? Â ŋicguru iŋucne okacne mi bazu‐jarezapo me? Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Tiki jaŋere erâ ki mamakuc eniŋ, â mâreŋ sawao lama bulimakao sopâc kecɋaŋ fua‐jarewec irec kio owa eniŋ, i hâmo ɋaŋac ekicnere moczi moc sicne fotâc mi eocmu, â lama bulimakao jaŋe ira mocwâc mi dâŋepie mananiŋmu; sawa wipe mecne, qowi mecne jaŋe mâmâc jaha irecnec wiserâ ratâmirembiŋ.
No Jerusalem hae qâropiepe ŋetâc qâtâtieme hae sesucne fuarâ foocmu, ehuc kâte qâto jaŋere ŋeŋe hae eocmu; no Judare hae sâko ŋerakac i wâc ima bape maŋnao ŋiczi ŋeŋe juju mocwâc mi eniŋmu.”
Mâreŋ i fuŋne weniŋucte sipirickerâ tuhu mâreŋ iŋucne niniŋ siarereŋ foha moczi moc sicne fotâc mi eekac? Irec fuŋne i mo ŋiczi maŋɋârâŋhec juhuc mana tarazac? Me Wofuŋ, go micdâŋge i mo ŋic âzâcnetec mufuazac?
Jeremiazi iŋuc wiome Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋnane jarepo i behembiŋ, â dâŋnane mana rereŋ mi embiŋ, ehuc irec sâcko mi jumbiŋ.
Jaŋe ine maŋrâŋgeŋ ehuc jaŋacne dâŋ reŋkembiŋ, â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe qazu‐jarembiŋ irec sâc ehuc Baali nemu fuŋne fuŋne bâjâpec‐jopambiŋ.
Irec Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Manakic, no ŋicguru ʒi kegocjâc hâtâ qiŋqiŋne â qotâre micopâ gumec‐jopapemu.
No bâtâtiec‐jopape ŋicne ŋicne, jaŋacne â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mi manac‐jopambiŋ, jaŋere ŋondeŋko siŋsaŋ qarâ juniŋmu, ehame mupe râpefuŋ‐jeŋicko ʒika fuame hâmo sipiric efârenʒepieŋ.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋoŋe irec manasurâ ŋokac ki soŋgâŋ eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe wira‐jarepie warenʒepieŋ, ehuc ki mamakucte fuŋne mamana ŋokac jaŋe wâc fisiniŋte dâŋ râepie razejec.
Eme jaŋe berec jaha ware fisirâ nâŋere erâ ki mamakuc epie ʒâŋeuc‐nâŋec bocjaha wahazejec.
Manac, Zioŋkonec kigaere fânâŋ fisime manaŋgopeneŋ: ‘Jei, ro waha âte enârekicne i hâhâwicne, â fai‐nâŋecko mimi busâqoc fewec i hâhâwicne jaha. Jaŋe fic hae‐nâŋec heroc qâropiembiŋte mâreŋ‐nâŋec behembeŋ.’”
Ŋokac bureŋ, ŋoŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ mananiŋ, â micdâŋ‐ticnere hazec râeniŋ; otâfâc‐ŋeŋic ki soŋgâŋ eere fuŋne qazu‐jareniŋ, ehuc ŋaŋackoaŋ kigae qaqazuc eniŋ.
Hâmoczi ficne ficne rocnâpohuc ŋicwofuŋ ficko raʒiwec wâc, ehuc naru motec jaŋe hae ʒoŋao â ŋicmotec jaŋe tutumaŋte tomao juhapie mâmâc rocjopawec hâcne.
Go jazac, “Wofuŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac: ‘Ŋic qâŋɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe jawa iŋucne gieo forahuc mâreŋte guec enʒepieŋ, erâ qa roro ŋic jaŋe râpefuŋ‐jeŋicko padi ɋiti râepie foraekac irec sâc fohapie moczi moc ro nusec mi ejareocmu.’”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Maŋɋârâŋheczi maŋɋârâŋ‐ticnere erâ mumuteŋ dâŋ mi muzejec, tâpiriheczi tâpiri‐ticnere erâ mumuteŋ dâŋ mi muzejec, â moneŋ mafaheczi moneŋ mafa‐ticnere erâ mumuteŋ dâŋ mi muzejec wâc.
Aricne, moc e mumuteŋ dâŋ muzo murâ ine maŋɋârâŋhec juhuc no manacnukacte erâ muzejec. Wemocte? Wiac no Wofuŋ jukopaczi mâreŋko aki anonoc, sâcmutâc dâŋ tiŋne â tiŋne jujure hata bâfuaekopac i! No wiac iŋucnere mana aŋac eekopac hâcne, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira sahacko maheczi ma tâmiric tinac jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma bâtiŋ‐jopapemu.
Ine Aigita ŋic mecne, Judaŋic mecne, Edomŋic mecne, Amoŋŋic mecne, Moabi ŋic mecne, erâ mâreŋ burocnere ŋecjucfâc qizec susuc‐jeŋic naki ŋifec â ŋifec sawa bâtâcneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc. Qâpuc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe jâmbomac sahacko ma tâmiric jueŋgopieŋ, Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe ine furu jaha sahacko ma i foipie‐jareha maŋjeŋiczi mâc foekac.”
O Israe kikefuŋ, ŋoŋe Wofuŋzi dâŋ ŋazakac i mananiŋ.
E kecʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: “Ŋoŋe qâpuc gurune gurune jaŋere hata âtepie maŋŋeŋic mi ezejec, jaŋe sambâŋko sowi fuame honerâ hâwic‐jopaekac, ŋoŋe ine mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec.
Kâteo jâc qapie metâ bapa e râriczi he fasaec ekume wiac ŋicmezi ba akic ekicne fuaekac.
Erâ siliwa â golzi ba eric ecnerâ rândiŋkezacte hama â biriŋzi qasanaŋkeekac.
Nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ŋiczi wipe wiac hâhâwic ejareniŋte gieo ŋic hawari baeŋgopieŋ iŋucne, jaŋe dâŋ moc mi mueŋgopieŋ â hata juju‐jeŋic mi fokacte ŋiczi hâpoc‐jopa raeŋgopieŋ hâcne. Jaŋe wiac hâhâwicne moc bâfuaniŋte tâpiri mi fojarekacte jaŋere mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec, ŋifec ine wiac biaŋne moc eniŋte iŋuc jaha tâpiri mi fojarekac.”
O Wofuŋ, go iŋucne moc mi jujâmbâŋkekac, go tâpirihecte fekicne jukomec, ʒâŋe biŋege i qeŋ bipinehec fokac hâcne.
Mo ŋiczi ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere Wofuŋ Sâko gore mi hâwickeocmu? Go hâcne araŋ bagarezo! Ŋicne ŋicne mamanafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko â guriŋ bapa gie baeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao go iŋucne moc mi jujâmbâŋkekac, aricne.
Jaŋe mutucne â maŋ tâmiric sasawa; nemuɋâŋte qaqazu gie bapa i wiac racne, jaŋe jâc sawa.
Tarasisi haeonec siliwa qajacnekicne, â Ufaʒi mâreŋkonec gol bafisieŋgopieŋ. Eme ɋâŋ qâqâtâc bapa â golzi wiac bapa jaŋe basarickeeŋgopieŋ, ehuc ŋaqi âmuc âmucne â bâbâroŋ hejarepie huekac; wiac i sasawa metâ bapa jaŋere meqâreŋ hâcne.
Wofuŋzi ine Anutu fârine â Anutu jujune, erâ Wofuŋ Sâko juweczi juocmu sanaŋ. Mâreŋzi kimbeŋ‐ticnere ɋiɋiteckeekac â ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe aaric‐ticnere sâcne mi sanaŋkerâ domaniŋmu.
Irec jaŋere ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: “Nemu jaŋe sambâŋ â mâreŋ mi bâfuac‐jofambiŋ, jaŋe mâreŋko â sambâŋ rurumaŋko sirowe‐fârenʒepieŋ.”
Anutu e ine tâpiri‐ticnezi mâreŋ bâfuawec â maŋɋârâŋ‐ticnezi mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec hobeteŋne râewec, erâ mamana‐ticnezi sambâŋ qaratiewec.
Eki mume ɋuŋ heme sambâŋko hoere fânâŋ fuawec, eki hâcne mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaonec karorac ejareme fahareŋgopieŋ. Â bâbâric bâfuame hoe heekac, erâ rowaŋ‐ticnaonec mâŋâŋ soreme fisiekac.
Ŋic jaŋe ʒeŋgoma mutucne â mamana tâmiric, golzi wiac bapa jaŋe ɋâŋ qâqâtâc‐jeŋicte erâ qurutuaeŋgopieŋ; nemuɋâŋ‐jeŋic i wiac eatucne, juju tâmiric hâcne.
Jaŋe wiac racne â gâgâwinehec, bâbâtiŋ dameŋ maic‐jopame siroweniŋmu.
Anutuzi Jakobore rowaŋ jukac e jaŋere sâc aricne, eki hâcne wiac sasawa bâfua‐fârewec. Israe ŋic jaŋe fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne; ʒâŋe‐ticne Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ.
Somâmaŋko jukomec go mâreŋge behecmurâ mafa wiacge ro qâzuc ec!
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: “Manaŋgopieŋ, no mâreŋ ʒirec rune dameŋ ʒi hâcne fific bacjopahuc hetapaic‐jopape fuŋne‐jeŋic mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Jei, nu bâʒâic enarekicne i hâhâwicne, â wicnane i mi bâbâsomiene. No ine ʒiŋuc manapo: “Hucnane ine hâcne, no irec ʒâic sanaŋkerâ manazepac.”
Qoruc boze‐nane ima bakicne, â qoruc bozere muc wiac i tâcne‐fârekicne; naru motecfâc‐nane jaŋe behecnurâ ratâmirembiŋ, qoruc boze‐nane i moczi mocwâc mi fâreocmu, â seli qoruc‐nane wâc mi ɋetickepie waha domaocmu.
Lama soŋaŋ jaŋe mutuc matacne jumbiŋ, ehuc Wofuŋte mu wioc mi embiŋ; irec gie bapie fâri tâmiric ewec, â lama guru‐jeŋic i tâtie‐fârewec.
Hazec râeniŋ, dâŋ biŋe fuakac! Mananiŋ, biac warekac i! Fânâŋ sâko faic mâreŋkonec warekac hâcne, i Juda hae sâko ŋerakac sâc ima bafâreme kâte qâto jaŋere ŋeŋe hae eocte.
O Wofuŋ, no manakopac, mâreŋŋic e juju hata‐ticne e jahacne tâpirio âte siŋkerâ sâcne mi raocmu, erâ moc e hata‐ticne rahuc fâretiŋ raocte tâpiri wâc mi focnekac.
O Wofuŋ, go aaricko mâcne, tiŋnegere sâcko bâtiŋnuzemec, omaezipore iŋuc enarezemec.
Kimbeŋge ŋicne ŋicne go kâuc bacguŋgopieŋ jaŋere faio hoŋkec, ʒâŋege mi riwaseckeeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao hâcne; jaŋe Jakobo ki qâsuc ecnembiŋ, ki qâsuc ecnehuc nâmiziembiŋ, ehuc hae mâreŋ‐ticne imackembiŋ.
Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ Jeremiarao fisiwec i kecʒiŋuc:
“Ʒâʒâfic kecʒirec dâŋ i Judare ŋicfâc â Jerusalem hae rune jazatec mananiŋ.
Ehuc muzemec, Wofuŋ Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋic moc e ʒâʒâfic kecʒirec dâŋ mana rereŋ mi eocmuzi sâwecte biŋe ezejec.
No dâŋ i hâcne mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec â ʒârâ ʒâpâonec jowac‐jopa wahahuc jaza mutâc epo, ehuc mupo: No dâŋ ŋaza mutâc epo sâc mana rereŋ efârenʒepieŋ. Eme ŋoŋe ŋicfâc‐nane juhapie noni Anutu‐ŋeŋic juzepac.
Erâ mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic dâŋ mupaŋke‐jarepo irec fârine bâfuahuc mâreŋ moc susu â baŋac qâmbâriŋkeekac i jarezepac; eme irec sâc fuawec fokac hâcne.” Mume mupo, “Wofuŋ, iŋuc hâcne fuaoc.”
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go dâŋ i sasawa Juda hae ŋerakac ira mecne â Jerusalem haere hata forakac ira mâmâc muromackehuc muzemec. Ŋoŋe ʒâʒâfic kecʒirec dâŋ manarâ reŋkenʒepieŋ.
No mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa wahahuc fuŋkerâ uŋ sawaŋ hati ejare warehuc ʒiŋuc jazahuc jupozi jukopac: Dâŋnane reŋkeniŋ.
Jaŋe ine mana rereŋ mi embiŋ â hazec‐jeŋic ira wâc mi râembiŋ, aricne, jaŋe ru sâc maŋjeŋic râŋgeŋne â hehesicne irec sâcko jumbiŋ. Eme no irec hâcne ʒâʒâfic kecʒirec dâŋ reŋkeniŋte mutâcne‐jare‐bipiehape mi reŋkembiŋte dâŋ muwarekicne irec fârine jaŋere faio fefâreocte mupo.”
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ nazawec: “Juda kikefuŋ â Jerusalem hae rune jaŋe no râsi enareniŋte mumockembiŋ i manakopac.
Jaŋe mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere hata hehesicnao risiembiŋ; jaŋe hâcne dâŋnane mananiŋte qikiŋnembiŋ, ehuc nemu jabane jaŋerao qohotahuc kiŋaŋ qajarembiŋ. Israe â Juda kikefuŋ jaŋe mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo i hetâcnembiŋ hâcne.
Irec Wofuŋ no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Manakic, noni mupe sisipiriczi fua‐jarerâ moc mi bâtiric‐jopaocmu, ehame wira wâwâsic enarepie mi mana‐jarepemu.
Eme Juda hae ŋerakac irec rune jaŋe mecne â Jerusalem ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe mecne hosâc rike‐jarehuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋerao ra wâsic‐jopanʒepieŋ; jaŋe ine ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋko sâcne mi bafic‐jopa‐jâmbâŋkeniŋmu.
O Juda, go haege ŋerakac irec sâc jaha nemufâcge bâfuac‐jopameŋ, â Jerusalem haeo hata forakac irec sâc Baali nemu hosâc âsu rikecneniŋte alata wiac bambiŋ.
“Goki ine ŋicguru i jaŋere erâ mi numuzemec, me jaŋere erâ mu huacbuc wâc mi ezemec; jaŋe ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋ‐jeŋicko wira wâwâsic enarepie mi mana‐jâmbâŋkepemu hâcne.
Joroc biaŋ‐nane e wiac hehesicne ewecte ficnaneo wemocko ʒuhuckerâ juocmu? Mumupaŋ me qowi bâzi ririkege izi sâqocnege sâcne bâtâmire‐gareme ʒeri bubiaŋ ecmu me?
Wofuŋ no ʒâŋege mârâc ʒiŋuc mupo, ‘Oliwa jâc dutu ɋâri fie ruruckekicne â fâri rarau’, fânâŋ sâko fuame fuŋnao ʒoc ruqepe tieŋ taeŋne ʒâseŋke‐fâreocmu.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ noni hâcne Israe â Juda kikefuŋ sarac‐jopapo, ʒi ine hehesic‐jeŋicte erâ wiac hâhâwicne fua‐jareocte mukopac; jaŋe bâiŋnuniŋte Baali nemu hosâc âsu rikecnehuc jumbiŋ hâcne.”
Wofuŋ e maŋbâwiŋ enareme manapo; e dameŋ ira hâcne eebapa‐jeŋicte fuŋne nowatume hone tarapo.
No lama motec urucne hezuniŋte ro baraeŋgopieŋ iŋucne jupo, ehuc, râsi enarehuc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mumockembiŋ i kâuc bapo: “Jâc fâri wâmbuŋne i sipirickehuc jujune jaŋere mâreŋkonec qâfiepene ʒâŋe‐ticnere mocwâc mi manasuzo.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, go ine mumutara ŋic tiŋne, go maŋ mamanasu ba esâic ecneekiczi ine okacne bazu‐jarecmu i nowatutec honezepac, no dâŋnane gorao râepe fokac hâcne.
Anatoti haeonec ŋiczi juju‐nane sipirickeniŋte dâŋne birickehuc mueŋgopieŋ, “Go gupene hâmozicte Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo findaŋdâŋ mi muzemec.”
Irec Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ŋic i jaŋere ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, no qa bâtiŋ ejarepemu, ehame ŋicmotecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ʒikare nânâ eniŋmu, erâ ŋokâ otâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe nânâre hâmo sipiric eniŋmu.
Jaŋere ŋic ʒanʒaŋne moc mi juniŋmu, no hâcne Anatoti rune jaŋere faio bâbâtiŋ dameŋ‐jeŋicko wiac hâhâwicne mupe feocmu.”
O Wofuŋ, go tiŋne rune, irec no gohec dâŋgie bape go dâŋ tiŋne sasawa mucmu; eme no sifu dâŋ mocjaha gohec muzo ekopac. Ŋic hehesicne jaŋe wemocte juhâmoeŋgopieŋ, â doc bapa ŋic jaŋe wemocte wiac sasawa mâririhec fua‐jareekac?
Goki jâc iŋucne sarac‐jopaekic, eme jaŋe gâtâ barâ fua sokac erâ fârine bâfuaeŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe micjeŋiczi sâsecguhuc maŋjeŋiczi ine qikiŋgueŋgopieŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go nore fuŋne manakic, go honecnuekic â maŋnane gorao domaekac me mâcne irec fuŋne bataniŋkeekic. Go lama qa hezuc ejareniŋte rocjopaeŋgopieŋ irec sâc ŋic keci jaŋe rocjopazemec, ehuc qa hezuc dameŋte woŋec bâtâcko râec‐jopazemec.
Mâreŋ hahaŋkeekac â gieo wiac rehacnehec hâmo ɋaŋac efâreekac i mo dameŋko moc taraocmu? Mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋere hehesicte erâ qowi mecne, wipe mecne omaeeŋgopieŋ. Ŋiczi ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ hâcne: “Nâŋe hata âteeŋgopeneŋ i eki mi honeekac.”
Eme Wofuŋzi muwec: “Go ŋic kikezi rarâ jaŋehec hata raku betaŋkecmuo ine weniŋuc erâ becâsic jaŋehec sisiric gie bacmu? Me mâreŋ moc wama fokacko ira sawa hâhâwicmâc jucmuo ine Jordaŋ kâte uupicko weniŋuc ecmu?
Qomâfâcge â mamacgere kikefuŋ jaŋe doc bacgueŋgopieŋ wâc, jaŋe râpefuŋgao hahaŋne bahuc wira owa egareeŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe âgodâŋ gazapie dâŋjeŋic sifu mi manazemec.
“No ficnane behepo â biŋefâc‐nane qikiŋ‐jopapo, erâ joroc biaŋ‐nane e râsifâc‐ticne jaŋere meo râepo.
Biŋefâc‐nane jaŋe nore maio kâte laioŋ iŋucne embiŋ, jaŋe dâŋmarac‐jeŋic bafehuc owacke‐narembiŋ; no irec hâcne qaisoc‐jopakopac.
Biŋefâc‐nane jaŋe wipe qâqâreŋ iŋucne me? Irec tucwipe jaŋe rârec rârec tumaŋnehuc ruc bacneeŋgopieŋ? Ajoc, kâte qowi sasawa ŋoŋe tumaŋneniŋ, erâ ware qowi nâniŋ!
Lama soŋaŋ bocjahazi waiŋ gie‐nane sipirickembiŋ, ehuc nore giegaŋ fowec i âtenʒaŋnembiŋ â gie biaŋ‐nane i ima bajâmbâŋkembiŋ.
Jaŋe mâretec imackembiŋ, ehame nore maio sesuctac fuawec fokac; mâreŋ sasawa imacke‐fârekicne ŋic jaŋe ine irec busâqoc moc mi manaŋgopieŋ.
Sisipiric ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ burocnere facne facne bazurâ wahambiŋ, i Wofuŋtaonec ʒika hâcne, eme izi mâreŋ qaŋeŋne mockonec fuŋkerâ gie‐ticne baware raku qaŋeŋne mocko batarakac; ehame wiac jujune i me i wama moc mi fuacnekac.
Jaŋe padi hândâŋne tiembiŋzi wiac ʒârânehec qa roro embiŋ; jaŋe ʒâic gie sawa bambiŋ, fârine ine mi rombiŋ. Jaŋe Wofuŋ kimbeŋ‐ticne hâhâwicne irec erâ nânâ bâbâsu‐jeŋicte qurutuambiŋ.”
Diguracfâc‐nane repicne jaŋe Israe ŋicfâc‐nane mâreŋ biŋe qajarepo i ba bâuac embiŋte Wofuŋzi jaŋere ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, no mâreŋ‐jeŋickonec qâfiec‐jopapemu â Juda kikefuŋ jaŋe ŋondeŋ‐jeŋickonec unuc‐jopapemu wâc.
Unuc‐joparâ ʒâhec ine mocwâc busâqoc mana‐jarerâ ru sâc apa ŋosa mâreŋ‐jeŋicko jowac‐jopape risieniŋmu.
Jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane Baali ere ʒâŋeo ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ dâŋ muniŋte hatane qazu‐jare jumbieŋ, sâc ijaha ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere hata âtepie maŋjeŋic eocmuo, â nore ʒâŋeo ɋetickehuc, ‘Wofuŋ e jujâmbâŋkekac’, iŋuc muniŋmuo ine ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋec juc ehuc soka biaŋ enʒepieŋ.
Dâŋ mi mananiŋmu ŋicguru i jaŋe ine unuc‐jopa‐jâmbâŋkerâ bâsirowec‐jopapemu. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go ra umbika moc furine barâ jomazemec, erâ opâo mi râetec huzejec.”
Eme no Wofuŋzi muwec irec sâcko umbika furine barâ jomapo.
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ mocwâc fua‐nareme arecne jajahec ewec, ine kecʒiŋuc:
“Go umbika furine barâ jomameŋ i rorâ Eufrata opâo rarâ ira haroŋaŋ hawecko soŋkezemec.”
Eme Wofuŋzi naza mutâc ewec irec sâcko ra Eufrata opâo soŋkepo.
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa bocjaha tarame Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go faharerâ Eufrata opâo ra umbika ira soŋkecmurâ gazapo i ro barezemec.”
Eme no Eufrata opâo rarâ umbika soŋkepoonec wiserâ ropo. Erâ honepo: Umbika e sâqorewecte wiac irec me irec babajunere sâc mocwâc mi ewec.
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “No irec sâc jaha Juda â Jerusalem jahere pepec penaroŋ sâko bawahape arictac ezejec.
Ŋicguru hehesicne keci, nore dâŋ mananiŋte qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ, ehuc maŋrâŋgeŋ‐jeŋicte hata âtehuc nemu jabane kiŋaŋ qajarehuc fodape‐jareniŋte jaŋerao qohotaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe umbika kecʒi wiac irec me irec mocwâc mi babajune irec sâc jaha enʒepieŋ.
Umbika ŋicte ombâŋko bohotahuc fosanaŋkeekac irec sâc jaha Israe kikefuŋ â Juda kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋe norao qohota‐hâmohuc ŋicfâc‐nane â ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane â mumuteŋ‐nane â eri‐nane erâ juniŋte hefârec‐jopapo, jaŋe ine mi manambiŋ.
“Jeremia, go Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazac: ‘Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Waiŋ kiruŋ sasawa ira waiŋ opâ qapie hurâ fusucmaekac.” ’ Eme jaŋe ʒiŋuc gazaniŋmu: ‘Waiŋ kiruŋ sasawa ira waiŋ opâ qapene huocmu i nâŋe moc kâuc baŋgopeneŋ me?’
Iŋuc gazapie jazazemec, ‘Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Manaŋgopieŋ, no mâreŋ ʒirec ŋecjucfâc sasawa â Dawidire tuc qarâ eri ŋeŋe‐ticnao ŋicwofuŋ ŋeeŋgopieŋ, â taha bapa â porofete erâ Jerusalem hae rune sasawa jaŋe ejarepe opâ sanaŋ gapemâc nâku maŋsifuc ejarezejec.
Erâ nonizia ejarepe ŋic âgofâc‐jeŋic qanʒaŋ‐jopaniŋmu, â mame ŋokâ jaŋe qâqâhâmoc eniŋmu. No mi ŋezic‐jopapemu â busâqoc mi mana‐jarepemu, no buuruc wâc mi ejarehuc sipiric‐jopapemu. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.’”
Wofuŋzi dâŋ muwecte pepec penaroŋ mi ehuc hazec râerâ mananʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe dapâc mi fuaha â ŋafezi tiki mi foŋke‐fârehame kike‐ŋeŋic hepirickenʒipiŋte Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic araŋ bacnehuc sâsenʒepieŋ; ŋoŋe tatamacte ʒâŋe fihapie eki mume mâreŋ gâpâreme dapâc qisiric fuazacte iŋuc hâcne enʒepieŋ.
Mi mananiŋmuo ine no pepec penaroŋ‐ŋeŋicte erâ soŋsoŋko mâretec kiohuc jupemu; Wofuŋte lama guru kâpâcwâru bacjopa raniŋmure ʒâŋeuc‐nane bocjaha wahahuc domaocmu.
Ŋicwofuŋ â neŋgoc‐ticne ŋokac bomboŋ jahe ʒiŋuc jazac: “Eridu‐ŋekic ʒâŋe rara biaŋ i qizec‐ŋekickonec biac hockerâ wahawecte ŋeŋe omanao waha ŋezepirec!”
Negebe wâneŋko hae ŋerakac irec motâc basanaŋke‐fârekicne, moczi rome mi aŋkeocmu; Juda kikefuŋ ʒeŋgoma kâpâcwâru bacjopa rapie nâfocne moc mi juniŋmu.
“Ŋoŋe qâhâŋnerâ fipie rame faic mâreŋkonec warehuc juŋgopieŋ jaŋe honec‐jopaniŋ. Lama guru gorao râec‐jopakicne jaŋe weni, lama gurufâcge biaŋne jaŋe hâcne?
Eme go gahac âgo egareniŋte boc hefârec‐jopameŋ jaŋe bomboŋ egareniŋte mujareme weniŋuc mucmu? Go ŋokac gozi kime ʒâic fâro manaekac ʒâic iŋucne mi manacmu me?
Eme ‘Wiac busâqocnehec iŋucne wemocte fai‐naneo fekac’, go iŋuc mu wioc erâ ʒiŋuc manazemec: Kiŋ bahacge ŋemâcnere erâ ŋaqi qoruc hetara‐garepie mimige fuazejec.
Etiopia ŋic e sahac‐ticne sâcne hetikieme moc eocmu me? Me qowi mimicne lepad e sahac‐ticne qâqâreŋ hetikieme moc eocmu me? Iŋuc fome muzac ine sâqocne bahuc jueŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha wiac biaŋne ezo murâ sâcne enʒapiŋ.
Irec no mâreŋ sawaonec mâŋâŋ sâkozi padi jawa bawiseekac irec sâc bâtâtiec‐ŋopapemu.
Wiac fua‐gareocte mupo â kâdoc qagarepo iŋuc hâcne. Go nore nikecgume burecdâŋko roweckemeŋte
no ŋaqi qoruc hetara‐garepe mimige tâtâc fuazejec.
No boe sauge mecne, sasecgere ojawa mecne, sasec giege repicne mecne erâ tikio â gieo qâpuc wiac mamakâcne bajuekic i mâmâc hone manac efârepo hâcne. Jei, Jerusalem, go mo dameŋko wiac i qikiŋnerâ ɋaɋacne moc jucmu?”
Wofuŋzi Jeremia rorocte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Juda mâreŋzi makuc bakac â hae‐ticne ŋerakac ira kio uu eŋgopieŋ; ŋic ŋokacfâc‐ticne jaŋe mâreŋko ŋehuc ki busâqoc eŋgopieŋ, â Jerusalem haere ki owa fuakac.
Fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic opâre sorec‐jopaŋgopieŋ, eme jaŋe opâ nombâŋko fisirâ opâ moc mi bâbâfua ʒopo tacne bârisieŋgopieŋ; jaŋe mimiehuc busâqoc manarâ rurufa hepie hukac.
Hoe mi heme mâreŋzi hahaŋkekacte hesarac ŋic jaŋe busâqoc manahuc qizec‐jeŋic foŋkerâ soŋkeŋgopieŋ.
Kecɋaŋ mi fokacte kâte bulimakao jaŋe tomao motecne ro behec ejareŋgopieŋ wâc.
Kâte doŋgi jaŋe tiki burocnao domahuc sawa roniŋte kâte qâto iŋucne nakafe heŋgopieŋ; kecɋaŋ wiac arictacte ʒâŋe‐jeŋic sururu ekac.
“O Wofuŋ, hehesic‐nâŋeczi mutaniŋ‐nâpoha goki ʒâŋegere erâ bafic‐nâpoc; nâŋe qaqatara wemo afecne bâfuahuc bugao bambeŋ hâcne.
Israe mamanac‐ticne i gorao fokac, goki hâcne ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋko babafic‐ticne jukomec; go wemocte mâreŋ‐nâŋecko ŋic jabane tinac jukomec, me ŋic moczi ŋicmanac fisirâ ŋafe mocjaha sawa foocmu irec sâc ekomec?
Go wemocte ŋic moczi bafic‐jopaocte eipiekac iŋucne tinac? Wofuŋ, go ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko jukic, â nâŋe gore ʒâŋe rombeŋ, irec go mi mac behec‐nâpoc!”
Wofuŋ e ŋicguru ʒi jaŋere kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Jaŋe afeckerâ ra qohota ware qohota ehuc manabâc tâmiric kike afec jueŋgopieŋ. Irec Wofuŋ no hone aŋac mi ejarekopac, aricne, no hehesic‐jeŋicte manasuhuc sâqocne‐jeŋicte bâtiŋ‐jopapemu.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec wâc: “Go ŋicguru keci jaŋe ehâmo‐jarepemurâ mi numuzemec.
Jaŋe sowa juhapie wira wâwâsic‐jeŋic sifu mi manapemu; jaŋe qowi hâcbuc rikeniŋmu me taha bâzi rike‐narepie no sifu mi aŋacnuocmu, aricne, no ʒika â roroc â huc hâmoc izi bâsirowec‐jopapemu.”
Mume mupo: “Wofuŋ‐nane Anutu, manakic, porofete jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazaeŋgopieŋ: ‘Ŋoŋe ʒika moc mi fuame honeniŋmu, erâ roroczi wâc mi fua‐ŋareocmu, aricne, wama fofo sanaŋ ine ŋarepe hae mâreŋ ʒira foocmu.’”
Wofuŋzi ine ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Porofete jaŋe nore ʒâŋeo âke hotahuc burecdâŋ mueŋgopieŋ; no jaŋe mi sorec‐jopapo, erâ wâc dâŋ moc mi mutâcne‐jarepo â jaŋehec dâŋ mi dâŋepo. Jaŋe bararuŋ dâŋ burecne â findaŋdâŋ racne erâ maŋjeŋicte eatuc dâŋ ŋazaeŋgopieŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ no jaŋere ʒiŋuc mukopac: No mi sorec‐jopahape sifu nore ʒâŋeo âke hotahuc mueŋgopieŋ, ‘Ʒika me roroc hae mâreŋ ʒira mi fuaocmu’; porofete iŋuc mueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒika â roroczi omaec‐jopaocmu hâcne.
