Ehame ŋic findaŋdâŋ manaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha ʒika â roroczi jopa mizieme Jerusalem hae ʒoŋao foraniŋmu, eme moczi moc mi ducjopaocmu, jaŋe â ŋokac naru motecfâc‐jeŋic mâmâc. No hehesic‐jeŋicte okacne fai‐jeŋicko râepe feocmu hâcne.
“Goki ine dâŋ kecʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘Ʒâŋeuc‐nane ŋafe furec bocjaha wahahuc domazejec, ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere otâ ʒeŋoŋ e qa imac ecnekicne, e mocwâc biaŋkeocte sâc mi ekac hâcne.
No gieo rarâ honekopac, ʒikazi qâhâmoc‐jopakicne sawa foraŋgopieŋ, me haeo ferâ honekopac, nânâre hâhâmo irec ʒaic manahuc juŋgopieŋ. Erâ i sawa mâcne, porofete â taha bapa jaŋe ŋic ba bititicne iŋucne mâreŋ fotâcnehuc juŋgopieŋ.’”
Wofuŋ, go Juda behe sanaŋkemeŋ, me Zioŋte takicgukac me? Go wemocte ba imac enâretec bibiaŋte hata‐nâŋec arictac ewec? Nâŋe wama worickehuc juhapene wiac biaŋne moc mi fuaekac, bâbâpiaŋ dameŋte worickehuc juhapene jei, wiac bipic tataranehec fuaekac i!
O Wofuŋ, nâŋe nâŋâcne hehesic erâ wâc mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋere kiŋ bahac i mâmâc hone taraŋgopeneŋ, nâŋe sâqocne bahuc bugao bambeŋ hâcne.
Irec go sifu ʒâŋegere erâ hone suŋgiŋ mi enârezemec; eri tatamacgere ŋeŋe biaŋ ba jawa mi ecnezemec; go nâŋehec ʒâʒâfic emeŋ irec manasuhuc mi hetâcnezemec.
Ŋicne ŋicne nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko hoe bapa fârine moc juŋgopieŋ me? Me sambâŋ e jahac mume hoe moc heekac me? Wiac Wofuŋ i goki hâcne ekomec i! Anutu‐nâŋec, nâŋe gore mamanac juŋgopeneŋ, goki hâcne wiac i bâfua‐fârehuc juekic.
Eme Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Mose me Samue jahe nore maio fuapire muzac no ŋicguru ʒi sifu busâqoc moc mi mana‐jarezapo. Ʒâŋe mai‐naneonec jâpec‐jopatec ranʒepieŋ!
Eme jaŋe ‘Wena ranaŋmu’, iŋuc mu wioc epie jazazemec, ‘Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Huc hâmocte biŋe e hâmozejec, ʒikare biŋe e ʒikare nânâ ezejec, nânâre hâhâmore biŋe e nânâre hâmozejec, kâpâcwâruo rarare biŋe e kâpâcwâruo razejec.” ’
“Wofuŋ noni jaŋerao sisipiricte wiac 4 fuaocte mupemu ine kecʒiŋuc: Ʒikazi qâqâhâmoc‐jopa, qâtozi kisoŋ‐joparâ rara, erâ sawa wipe â mâreŋ qowi jaŋe nâ sipiric eejare.
No iŋuc ejarepe mâreŋko ŋicwofuŋ â gurufâc‐jeŋic sasawa jaŋe honec‐joparâ bipic tatara ejarezejec, i Juda ŋicwofuŋ Manase, Hisikiare ŋokâ hâcne, eki Jerusalemko wiac efârewec irec erâ iŋuc epemu.
“O Jerusalem, mozi busâqoc moc mana‐gareocmu? Mozi gore erâ mu mamakuc eocmu? Mozi jujugere mu wioc egareocte gorao fâ fisiocmu?
Goki hâcne behecnumeŋ â râpecnumeŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc; irec no râsi egarehuc sipiricgupemurâ menane sicnepo no busâqoc mana‐garezore takicnukac.
Jaŋe maŋjeŋic mi bârisiembiŋte hae‐jeŋic ŋerakac ira oofaŋzi ofaŋ‐jopapo, ehuc naru motecfâc‐jeŋic omaec‐jopahuc ŋicfâc‐nane sipiric‐jopapo.
Hozecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe hâwecmecko moŋgeŋ fokac irec ʒare jâurumbiŋ; ŋicmotec neŋgocfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe sisipiric ŋiczi ʒoaŋ ɋaɋackoa fua‐jareocte mucnepo, ehuc mupe ʒârâ hâriŋzi â wiac bipic tataraneheczi ututuŋ bâfuac‐jopawec.
Eme ŋokâ 7 rocjopame jucnembiŋ ŋokac e ɋaŋa ururuc ewec, ehame maŋticne omaewec; woze qeuc mi ehame ɋâŋgicne rokicne, e qurutuame mimizi fainao fewec. Nâfocnefâc‐jeŋic ine râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒika irec biŋe qikiŋ‐jopapemu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Jei, neŋgoc‐nane, go wemocte rocnumeŋ? Mâreŋne mâreŋne nore erâ dâŋgie â rârâsi fuaekac i! No moneŋ hotâ moc mi jarepo â jaŋe wâc no hotâ mi narembiŋ, ehame sifu ŋic sasawazi sâwecnueŋgopieŋ.
Jâmbomac, Wofuŋ, no wiac biaŋnere kiŋaŋ qagarepo, erâ ʒârâ hâriŋ â fific guguriŋ dameŋko râsi jaŋere erâ wira wâwâsic egarepo.
Aeŋ faic mâreŋkonec wareekac â aeŋ bâbâroŋ i ŋic moczi sâcne bazuocmu me?
“Hae mâreŋge sâckerâ sâqocne bâfua rameŋ irec okacne mafa mâririge â moneŋ boreŋge i fiuc roro ŋic jaŋe tofamâc qikiŋne‐jarepemu.
Erâ mupe mâreŋ kâuc bakomec ira râsifâcge jaŋere kiŋaŋ qahuc juzemec; kimbeŋ‐ŋaŋere ʒocbâruŋ fuarâ ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ʒahuc fokac hâcne.”
Eme Jeremiazi muwec: “Wofuŋ, go kâuc mi bakic; manasucnuhuc iqicnuzemec, erâ nu jâpec eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe nore erâ okacne jarezemec. Omaezipore mi akic‐jopazemec, gore erâ fai‐naneo mimi feekac i manac me!
Dâŋgezi ware bâfuacnume mana maŋ eekopac, dâŋgezi bubiaŋ bâfua‐nareekac, â maŋzi mana ʒiziweekopac; o Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, no gore ʒâŋe ropo i.
No dâŋ ʒoraŋ ee jaŋere guruo mi ŋeekopac, ehuc kiwac qawac mi eekopac; Megezi roʒakiecnuhuc mamana sâqocgezi bâfusecnumeŋte buc mac ŋeekopac.
Ʒâic‐nanezi wemocte tatarane mi ekac? Wicnane wemocte somiezo mi ehuc fofo sanaŋ juekac? Go jâmbomac opâ ʒiʒicne tinac enarehuc eatucnuzo maŋkeekic me?”
Eme irec Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Go risietec no sâcne hefârocgupemu, eme harierâ nore maio domazemec. Go jawadâŋ behehuc fârinea mucmuo ine mana‐garepe nahacne mic erâ juzemec. Eme jaŋe gorao roweckenʒepieŋ, go ine jaŋerao mi roweckezemec.
Eme noni mupe ŋicguru keci jaŋere maio aeŋsac sanaŋ iŋucne erâ qiŋ herâ domazemec. Jaŋe herândiŋguniŋte juju gie baniŋmu erâ sâcne bawahacguniŋmu; wiac noni gohec jukopacte ŋezicgupe sanaŋke‐jarecmu i!
No ŋic repicne jaŋere meonec bataracgupemu, â qac momori jaŋere ŋezicgupemu. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Go mâreŋ ʒira ŋokac naru motec tâmiric juzemec.
Wofuŋ no naru motec hae mâreŋ ʒira fuaeŋgopieŋ â neŋgocfâc‐jeŋic rocjopaeŋgopieŋ erâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic mâreŋ ʒira bâfuac‐jopaeŋgopieŋ jaŋere ʒiŋuc mukopac:
Jaŋe huc repicne bacjopame hâmonʒepieŋ. Ehame jaŋere ki mamakuc mi fuaocmu â moczi mi ducjopaocmu; jaŋe mâc jawa iŋucne mâreŋko fohuc mâreŋte guec bâfuanʒepieŋ. Jaŋe ʒikazi kimiziec‐jopaocmu â nânâ basahuc hâmohapie qâŋɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic i sawa wipe â mâreŋ qowi jaŋere nânâ eniŋmu.”
Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac wâc: “Go ki mamakuc eere ficko moc mi fezemec, â soŋgâŋte wâc mi razemec, erâ busâqoc mi mana‐jarezemec. No ŋicguru keci jaŋe wama‐nane erâ aki anonoc â buuruc‐nane jowac ropo hâcne, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme mâreŋ ʒira kâcɋene mecne piticne mecne hâmopie moc mi ducjopaniŋmu, â jaŋere erâ ki mamakuc ee me memotec hehetâc me qizec bâbâtâc i wâc mi eniŋmu.
Me hâmoc fuame ki mamakuc eekac ŋic e bâmiriŋkeniŋte soŋgâŋko nânâ rârâcne i mi eniŋmu; me neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne hâmopire mu bâmiriŋ eecne i wâc omaeocmu.
Tiwâ bâzire tumaŋneniŋmu fic ira ferâ jaŋehec ŋehuc nânâ opâ nâzemec.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu no kecʒiŋuc mukopac hâcne: Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋaŋacne juju dameŋko hae mâreŋ kecʒirec mana aŋac â ʒeri bubiaŋ â ŋic ŋokac roroc ehuc ʒeri wiac ee i mupe ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko omaeocmu.
“Eme dâŋ i sasawa ŋicguru keci jazatec ʒiŋuc wio‐gareniŋmu: ‘Wofuŋ e wemocte wiac hâhâwicne sâko keci fai‐nâŋecko fefâreocte muwec, nâŋe wemo kiŋ bahac moc bâfuahuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec bunao bambeŋ?’
Iŋuc mu wioc egarepie jazazemec: ‘Wofuŋte dâŋ ʒiŋuc fokac. Mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe behecnurâ nemu jaŋerao qohotarâ kiŋaŋ qajarehuc fodape‐jare jumbieŋ, ehuc no qaisocnurâ sâcmutâc dâŋnane qâsua jumbieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ine mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic siric‐jopahuc sâqocne fehuc baeŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe ru sâc maŋrâŋgeŋ â hehesic juhuc wiac ebac eeŋgopieŋ, ehuc nore dâŋ mi manaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe iŋuc eeŋgopieŋte mâreŋ ʒirecnec tuŋŋopape mâreŋ moc, ŋoŋe kâuc baŋgopieŋ â mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe wâc kâuc bambiŋ, ira hâcne ranʒepieŋ; eme ira nore jauŋ basahuc ŋafe furec nemu kiŋaŋ qajarehuc juniŋmu.’”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira ʒiŋuc mocwâc mi muniŋmu, ‘Wofuŋzi jujâmbâŋkekac, eki hâcne Israe ŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopame warembiŋ’,
aricne, kecʒiŋuc ine muniŋmu, ‘Wofuŋ jujâmbâŋkekac, eki hâcne Israe ŋic faic mâreŋkonec â mâreŋ sâc tuŋjopame rambiŋ irecnec batarac‐jopawec.’ No hâcne mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ qikiŋne‐jarepo ira bârisiec‐jopazepac.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac wâc: “Manaŋgopieŋ, no opâ qowi roro ŋic bocjaha hefârec‐jopape wasaŋko fârec‐jopanʒepieŋ; eme ʒâhec wosaŋeŋ bapa bocjaha hefârec‐jopape ware tikine tikine â facne facne â qânâ hawec sâc ficne qosac qosac ehuc rocjopanʒepieŋ wâc.
Ʒâŋe‐nanezi hata‐jeŋic sasawa hone jâjâpehape nore maio sosoŋko i sâcne mi eniŋmu, kiŋ bahac‐jeŋic ʒâŋe mai‐naneo tâtâc fokac.
No qanaŋ kiŋ bahac â sâqocne‐jeŋicte okacne bafehuc bazu‐jarepemu, i mâreŋ‐nane nemuɋâŋ‐jeŋicte âsu gârezi bâsâqorembiŋte â mâreŋ nore biŋe fowec i wiac‐jeŋic mamakâcnezi bâfusembiŋte.”
O Wofuŋ, go tâpiri‐nane â dapeŋ‐nane, go ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋko huec sanaŋ‐nane. Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaonec gorao fisirâ ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe burec wiac, nemuɋâŋ racne â fâri tâmiric i sawa bajumbiŋ.
Ŋiczi nemu fârine sâcne bâbâfuac‐jopane me? Arictac, ŋiczi nemu bâfuakicne i fârine aricne!”
“Irec manac, no dameŋ ʒi fuŋne‐nane qazu‐jarepemu, ehuc tâpiri â sasanaŋ‐nane bataniŋke‐jarepe ʒâŋe‐nane ‘Wofuŋ’ i mana taranʒepieŋ.”
“Juda kikefuŋ gore sâqocne i aeŋ kirifizi qâreŋkekicne; kirifi tetecnere qânâ furi sâko izi maŋgere tafeo â alatagere ʒuŋeo heutuckekicne.
Naru motecfâcge jaŋere aŋacguekac sâc ijaha alata wiacge â Asera nemuɋâŋ wiacgere manasuekic. Wiac i jâc ɋâricnere fuŋne â tikitoŋko ŋegare rakac.
Irec mâreŋge sasawa ira sâqocne boc bâfuakicnere mafa wiacge â boreŋ ʒeŋaŋge â bâzi ririkere toma forakac i râsi jaŋere biŋe qafârekopac.
Eme mâreŋ garepo i behetec fozejec; eme no mupe mâreŋ moc kâuc bakomec ira râsifâcge jaŋere kiŋaŋ qahuc juzemec; ŋoŋe kimbeŋ‐nanere ʒoc ruqembiŋte ʒahuc foocmu sanaŋ.”
Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Moc e ŋic jaŋerao roweckeocmu me sahac biuczi tâpiri‐ticne eocte muocmu ehuc maŋticnezi Wofuŋ no qikiŋnuocmu e sâwecte biŋe ezejec.
E jâc garaŋ garaŋne mâreŋ sawao domakac iŋucne, ehuc wiac biaŋne fuaocmu i moc mi honeocmu; e mâreŋ burocnao â hahaŋkekicnao â guec tâmiricko erâ ŋiczi ŋec juc mi eeŋgopieŋko juzejec.
“Moc e Wofuŋ norao roweckeekac â Wofuŋ noni huec‐ticne eekopac ŋic iŋucnere jambuŋkekicne muzo.
E jâc moc opâmecko sarakicne iŋucne, gâtâne opâopec râeme huekac, e ʒoaŋ fârorocte mi ɋaŋaekac, â rehacne fie ruruckehuc fua biaŋ eekac; e roroc dameŋko wâc mana mezac mi ehuc fârine ʒuʒuhuc jaha bâfua rahuc juekac.”
Ŋic maŋsioc‐ticnezi wiac gâcne siricke‐fâreekac, maŋ i repic qapicne hâcne; mozi fuŋne‐ticne mana taraocmu?
“Wofuŋ noni hâcne maŋ â mamanasu ba esâic ecneekopac, i ŋic sasawa juju‐jeŋicte â eebapa‐jeŋicte fârine irec okacne bazu‐jarepemurâ iŋuc eekopac.”
Ŋic moczi eeatucko moneŋ mafa hureekac e wipe moc e jahacne hândâŋ mâcne, mocte ŋefackeme âteʒuocmu irec sâc; e juju‐ticne jufeku ombâŋnao fisime sifuckecneocmu, eme tataranao ŋic mutuc matacne erâ juocmu.
Ohec, Anutu huriri qâreŋ‐ticnere ŋeŋe, fuŋnaonecteaŋ fekicne sâko ŋewec. Ohec, tiri ufuŋ‐nâŋec.
O Wofuŋ, Israere mamanac gorao fokac i! Go behecguniŋmu jaŋe ʒeŋgoma qurutuaniŋmu; go râpecguniŋmu jaŋere ʒâŋe rufemaŋko qâreŋkezo; jaŋe jujure opâ, Wofuŋ go hâcne behembiŋte.
Wofuŋ, goki bâpiaŋnutec biaŋkezepac, goki baficnutec babafic fârine bâfuazepac; go hâcne mumbiaŋguekopac.
Manakic, jaŋe ʒiŋuc nazaeŋgopieŋ: “Wofuŋ dâŋticne wena? Fârinehec eoc me!”
No ine ʒârâ hâriŋ bâfuacmurâ mi jâiŋgupo, erâ okac dameŋ biac fisiocte wâc mi mupo, i go manakomec. Micbipic‐nanezi dâŋ mufuawec i gore maio tâtâc fokac.
Ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋko huec sanaŋ‐nane jukomeczi wiac hâhâwicne mi mac enarezemec.
Nu jâpec enareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe qurutuanʒepieŋ, no ine manahaŋ mi qurutuazepac; jaŋe bipic tatara ejarezejec, no ine manahaŋ mi enarezejec. Goki mutec sisipiric dameŋ fisi‐jarezejec ehame siec‐jeŋic qazuc qanʒaŋ ejarezemec!
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go ŋic jaŋere motâc sâko â Juda ŋicwofuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋe raʒic wefuc eeŋgopieŋ ira, erâ Jerusalemte motâc sasawa ira mâmâc ra doma‐fârezemec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘Judare ŋicwofuŋfâc â Judare ŋicfâc ʒengoma erâ Jerusalemte hae rune sasawa motâc ʒira raʒic wefuc eeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ mananiŋ!
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe juju‐ŋeŋicte erâ rucjari‐ŋeŋic baniŋ, ehuc sabata hombaŋko mafa wiac moc mi bahuc Jerusalemte motâcko raʒinʒepieŋ.
Ficŋeŋickonec wâc iŋuc jaha sabata hombaŋko mafa wiac moc mi bawahanʒepieŋ, ehuc sabata hombaŋ i mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic mutâcne‐jarepo irec sâc tiri foocte manasuhuc gie wiac i me i moc mi banʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe ine mi manambiŋ â dâŋnanere hazec wâc mi râembiŋ, aricne, jaŋe maŋrâŋgeŋ ehuc dâŋnane qikiŋnembiŋ â bâbâtiŋ‐nane i qaisockembiŋ.’”
Wofuŋzi mukac: “Ʒi dâŋnane mana‐jâmbâŋkerâ sabata hombaŋko mafa wiac moc mi bahuc hae kecʒirec motâc fotâcneniŋmu, ehuc sabata hombaŋ tiri foocte manasuhuc gie wiac i me i moc mi baniŋmuo
ine hae kecʒirec motâc i ŋicwofuŋ â fekicne jaŋe fotâcnerâ raʒiniŋmu. Ine Dawidire ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋeo ŋeeŋgopieŋ â becâsicko â keretacko raeŋgopieŋ jaŋe â fekicnefâc‐jeŋic mecne, erâ Judare ŋicfâc â Jerusalem haeo ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋ sasawa jaŋe mecne; eme hae i ŋesanaŋkeocmu.
Eme Juda mâreŋko hae ŋerakac irecnec â Jerusalem hae rârec rârec irecnec â Benjamiŋ mâreŋkonec mecne; wâneŋkonec â tikionec erâ Negebe mâreŋkonec mâmâc bâzi ririkere qowi â taha bâzire wiac â wiac âsu biaŋ bafisiniŋmu, erâ Wofuŋ nore taha ufuŋko baferâ daŋge taha râeniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe ine dâŋnane qatarahuc sabata hombaŋ tiri foocte mi manasuniŋmu, erâ mafa wiac bahuc Jerusalemte motâcko kosa raʒic wefuc eniŋmuo ine motâc‐ticne turuŋkepe ʒaocmu; eme Jerusalem haeo ŋicwofuŋ fic ŋerakac i ʒocte nânâ efâreha ʒoczi moc mi hâpoocmu.”
Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ Jeremiarao fuawec i kecʒiŋuc:
“Ajoc, go juwic hurâ kuʒi bapa ere ficko fezemec, eme ira dâŋnane gazape manazemec.”
Eme no hurâ kuʒi bapa ere ficko ferâ honepo, e kuʒi bahuc ŋewec.
Eme kuʒi moc bakume sâqoreme afe izia kuʒi moc baocte maname biaŋkeme sâc bawec.
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Kuʒi bapa kecizi eekac sâc ijaha Israere kikefuŋ ŋoŋehec sâcne mi epemu me? Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Manakic, afezi kuʒi bapare meo fokac iŋuc jaha Israe kikefuŋ ŋoŋe nore meo juŋgopieŋ.
No dameŋ mocko ŋicguru moc me ŋicwofuŋ moc â gurufâc‐ticne jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopapemurâ me imac‐jopapemurâ me sipiric‐jopapemurâ dâŋne epemu.
Eme uŋ sawaŋ ejarepo ŋicguru i jaŋe maŋjeŋic bârisierâ hehesic‐jeŋic behepie busâqoc manahuc maŋnane risieme wiac hâhâwicne ejarezo mupo i fârine mi bâfuapemu.
Dameŋ mocko ine ŋicguru moc me ŋicwofuŋ moc â gurufâc‐ticne jaŋe heɋârec‐jopahuc sara mama ejarepemurâ mupaŋkepemu.
Jaŋe ine, no wiac hone aŋac mi ecneekopac i hâcne ehuc dâŋnane qataraniŋmuo ine wiac biaŋne ejarepemurâ mupaŋke‐jarepo i fârinehec ezacte aka hecnepemu.
Eme ʒi Judare ŋicfâc â Jerusalem ŋecjucfâc‐ticne ʒiŋuc jazac: ‘Wofuŋzi mukac, Manaŋgopieŋ, no wiac hâhâwicne fai‐ŋeŋicko feocte dâŋne mana biric ehuc jukopac. Irec ŋoŋe sasawa hata hehesicnaonec risierâ juju â eebapa biaŋne bâfuaniŋte giene banʒepieŋ.’
“Jaŋe ine muniŋmu: ‘Iŋuc misac, nâŋe nâŋâcne mamana biri bâjâpenʒepeneŋ, ehuc maŋnâŋec râŋgeŋne â hehesicne irec sâcko wiac ebac efârenʒepeneŋ.’”
Irec Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋoŋe ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko mu wioc eniŋ: Mozi dâŋ iŋucne moc manawec? Naru ʒeŋoŋ Israe e wiac hâhâwicne bâfuawec hâcne!
Lebanoŋko sinou fokac i Sirioŋ tikire faio fofo sanaŋ mi foocmu me? Me tikionec opâ mâteŋne â fifisine wahaekac i ʒicke kereŋ moc eocmu me?
Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe ine nore nikec‐jopawec, jaŋe nemu jabane hosâc âsu rike‐jareeŋgopieŋ, eme jaŋe ejarepe hata‐jeŋic ira fâfâc‐jopaha rândiŋke qa eeŋgopieŋ, ehuc hata sâckoo mâcne, hata kosa raeŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc mâreŋ‐jeŋic imackepie mimi busâqoc‐ticne i jaŋerao tatara tâmiric foocmu; eme i jâuruniŋmuzi bipic tatara ejareha qizec fofotaric eniŋmu.
No râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere maio kagu mâŋâŋ eekac irec sâc jaha ehuc qâtâtiec‐jopapemu, â sisipiric dameŋ‐jeŋicko râpec‐jopape ʒâŋe mai‐nane basaniŋmu.”
Eme ŋic jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Ajoc, Jeremia dâŋ qacnenaŋ! Taha bapa jaŋerao sâcmutâc dâŋ â mamanahec jaŋerao mamana biri â porofete jaŋerao porofete dâŋ i biac mi omaewec hâcne. Irec nâŋâc e jahacne dâŋzi bitiŋ râecnepene ira kizejec, nâŋâc dâŋticne i me i mana rereŋ moc mi enʒepeneŋ.”
Iŋuc mupie Jeremiazi ʒiŋuc numuwec: “O Wofuŋ, go dâŋnanere hazec râec, ehuc kisâfâc‐nane dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ i manac!
Biaŋnere okacne sâqocne bâtikiepie sâckeocmu me? Jaŋe juju‐nane omaeocte nombâŋ ronarembiŋ hâcne. No maigao domahuc jaŋere erâ dâŋ biaŋne gazapo â kimbeŋgezi fai‐jeŋickonec rârieocte numu‐garepo irec manasuc!
Irec mutecne naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe nânâre sipirickenʒepieŋ, â ʒikare micko fenʒepieŋ; ŋokacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe naru motec tâmiric hozec erâ junʒepieŋ, ŋicfâc‐jeŋic ine huc hâmoczi rocjopazejec, â ŋicmotecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ʒika fuame ʒikare nânâ enʒepieŋ.
Go ʒikaŋic ejaretec ututuŋ fisi‐jarepie ficjeŋickonec ki mamakucte fânâŋ fuazejec. Jaŋe rocnuniŋte nombâŋ ronarembiŋ, â wiwiticzi kike‐naneo kiocte soŋsoŋko râembiŋ hâcne.
O Wofuŋ, nuniŋte dâŋ sâqocne mana biric eeŋgopieŋ i goki mana‐fârekic, irec mutec kiŋ bahac‐jeŋic okac tâmiric mi fozejec, â sâqocne‐jeŋic maigao fokac i mi bâtâmirezemec, aricne, fâfâc‐jopame maigao waha jopazejec, ehame kimbeŋ dameŋgao katucne bazu‐jarezemec.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go rarâ hapec afezi bakicne moc furine bac, erâ ŋic jaŋere soŋaŋ kâcɋene gâcne â taha bapa fekicne gâcne rocjopazemec.
Rocjoparâ motâc sahacnao kuʒi dâkâne gurukeeŋgopieŋko Beŋ‐Hinom wâneŋ fuŋkerâ hurakac ira hurâ dâŋ gazapemu sâc mufua‐jarezemec.
Ehuc muzemec, ‘Judare ŋicwofuŋfâc â Jerusalem hae rune ŋoŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ mananiŋ! Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu eki ʒiŋuc mukac: Manaŋgopieŋ, noni mupe hae mâreŋ ʒi wiac hâhâwicne fuacneocmu, eme biŋene mananiŋmu sâc jaŋe hazec‐jeŋic ʒâickezejec.
I ʒiŋucte fuazejec: Jaŋe no behecnumbiŋ, ehuc nemu furune, jaŋe mecne, mamacfâc‐jeŋic mecne â Judare ŋicwofuŋfâc mecne mi manac‐jopambiŋ, jaŋe hosâc âsu rike‐jarehuc hae mâreŋ ʒi bâbiembiŋ, â ŋic bahacmâc jaŋere soc hae ʒira hoŋkepie fusucmarâ fowec.
Erâ ŋokâfâc‐jeŋic Baali nemu bâzi rikecneniŋte tikio alata wiac barambiŋ; noni ine irec dâŋ moc mi mupo â jaŋe mi mutâcne‐jarepo, erâ maŋnaneo wiac iŋucnere dâŋ moc mi fuawec.
Irec mananiŋ: Dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira hae mâreŋ ʒirec ʒâŋe i Tofete me Beŋ‐Hinom wâneŋ mi muhuc, Jopa Sipiric Eejare wâneŋ muniŋmu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme Juda â Jerusalem rune jaŋere mamana i batackepemu, ehuc râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere hâhâwic wisehapie ʒikare micko râec‐jopazepac, ehuc mupe juju‐jeŋic jowac rozo muŋgopieŋ jaŋere mezi wâc sipiric‐jopazejec. Eme qâŋɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic i sawa wipe â mâreŋ qowi behe‐jarepe jaŋere nânâ enʒepieŋ.
No hae ʒi mupe wiac bipic tataranehec fuacneme mu âke sisic ecneniŋmu, eme jâuruhuc rac warec eniŋmu sâc jaŋe ŋifec bipic tatara ejareha ŋifec ine bâbâtiŋ‐ticnere nifepupu ecneniŋmu.
Râsi ejarehuc juju‐jeŋic jowac rozo muŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋko somâ bajarehuc fiŋiŋiŋ‐jopahapie mupe naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere biuc nânʒepieŋ, ehuc jaŋaczia nânâc enʒepieŋ wâc.’
“Eme go hapec i ŋic gohec mâmâc raniŋmu jaŋere ʒâŋe faio qanʒaŋnezemec.
Ehuc jazazemec, ‘Anutu Tapiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: Hapec â kuʒi wiac qanʒaŋnepie bâbâpiaŋkene mocwâc mi eekac irec sâc jaha ŋicguru â hae ʒi henʒaŋ qanʒaŋ‐jopapemu hâcne. Eme ducjopazore mâreŋ gâcne basahuc Tofete ira ducjopanʒepieŋ.
No hae mâreŋ ʒi â ŋecjucfâc‐ticne iŋuc hâcne ejarepemu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc; irec hae sâko i Tofete iŋucne ezejec.
Jerusalemte fic wiac â Juda ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere fic i Tofete iŋucne mamakâcne efârezejec; eme fic bupu sâc juhuc sambâŋko bâpiŋ ŋeraŋgopieŋ jaŋe hosâc âsu rike‐jare jumbieŋ â nemu furune taha bâzi hoŋke‐jare jumbieŋ, fic i sasawa hâcne.’”
Eme Jeremia e findaŋdâŋ mufuaocte Wofuŋzi Tofete haeo soreme raweckonec risierâ Wofuŋte taha ufuŋ irec hae ʒoŋao ferâ ŋic ŋokac ʒeŋgoma ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: Manaŋgopieŋ, no hae sâko ʒi â hae piticfâc‐ticne sasawa jaŋerao sisipiric fuaocte uŋ sawaŋ ejarepo i maŋrâŋgeŋ juhuc dâŋnane mi manaŋgopieŋte mupe fârio qafârezejec.”
Eme Imere ere ŋokâ, taha bapa Pasahuru e Wofuŋte taha ufuŋko soŋaŋ sâko juweczi Jeremiare findaŋdâŋ i manawec.
Manarâ porofete Jeremia qarâ me kikene jâc fifitacko râeme kindeŋneme fowec; ine Wofuŋte taha ufuŋte motâc moc fowec ʒâŋene Benjamiŋte Motâc faicpec ira.
Hae fureme ine Pasahuru e Jeremia jâc fifitackonec batarame Jeremiazi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋ e gore ʒâŋe Pasahuru beherâ ‘Ŋifec gafac ŋic hâhâwic eejare’ iŋuc mukac.
Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: Manakic, no mupe go gahacnere hâwicguha âgofâcge ʒeŋgoma jaŋe gore hâwic‐jopazejec. Go ʒâŋe fârigezi honehaŋ jaŋe râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒikare nânâ enʒepieŋ, eme Judare ŋicfâc sasawa jaŋe Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere meo râec‐jopape eki Babe haeo bacjopa rarâ ʒikazi qâhâmoc‐jopazejec.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, hae ʒirec rowaŋ â gie‐jeŋicte huhure wiac â boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ erâ Juda ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere moneŋ mafa i furu jaha râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere meo râepemu, eme jaŋe ro nusec erâ Babe haeo baraniŋmu.
Pasahuru go ine wiacfâcge sasawa jaŋehec Babe haeo bacŋopa rapie ira hâmopie ducŋopaniŋmu; go gahacne mecne â âgofâcge findaŋdâŋ burecne jazahuc jumeŋ jaŋe mâmâc.”
O Wofuŋ, go mu bâdoc enaretec mi sanaŋkepo, gore tâpirizi nore sirickeme sanaŋke‐naremeŋ; ehame dameŋne dameŋne nore manapie gâgâwinehec eekac, â ŋic sasawa jaŋe âke sisic enareeŋgopieŋ.
No dâŋ muekopac sâc owa ruruckehuc ʒiŋuc muekopac: “Bâbâʒaic â sisipiric!” I Wofuŋ gore dâŋzi ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne mu âke sisic â mu gâgâwi bâfua‐nareekac irec.
“Ere mocwâc mi manasupemu me ere ʒâŋeo miti mocwâc mi mupemu,” iŋuc muhape ine maŋnaneo ʒocbâruŋ tinac fuawec, ehuc siec‐naneo fosanaŋkehuc ʒacnuwec, eme no irec ʒâic manaku betaŋkepo.
Bocjahazi saŋucko dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupie manaekopac: “Rârec rârec wiac hâhâwicne fuarâ fokac, irec dâŋgieo râeniŋ, dâŋgieo râenaŋ me!” Âgo enareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe waha nuocmu me mâcne, irec ruc banarehuc mueŋgopieŋ: “E sâcne mecne eatuckepene menâŋecko feme okacne bazucnenaŋmu.”
Wofuŋ goki ine ŋic qac momori iŋucne nohec juekicte râsifâc‐nane jaŋe fâfâc‐jopatec sâcne mi sanaŋke‐nareniŋmu. Mimi busâqoc‐jeŋic i tatarane tâmiric â mi ninikecne jâmbâŋ.
O Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, go ŋic tiŋne ba esâic ejareekic, erâ maŋ â mamanasu hone taraekic go mana‐naretec okac babazuge jaŋerao fuame honezepac, no dâŋnane gore meo râepo hâcne.
Wofuŋ gae hecneniŋ, Wofuŋ muteŋkeniŋ! Eki hâcne qarâ suriŋne jaŋe ŋic hehesicne jaŋere meonec batarac‐jopaekac.
Fufua dameŋ‐nane i sâwecte biŋe ezac, neŋgo‐nanezi rocnuwec dameŋ i moc mi jambuŋkezo!
“Ŋokâge moc fuawec,” biŋe biaŋ i mamac‐nanerao bara bubiaŋ sâko qacnewec ŋic e sâwecte biŋe jaha ezac.
E Wofuŋzi hae gâcne busâqoc mi mana‐jarehuc ima bacjopawec irec sâc fuacneme sâckezac; e furicte kio owa irec fânâŋ â guŋpiticko ʒika fânâŋ manahuc jume sâckezac.
E neŋgocte bumaŋko fohape qâhâmocnume muzac sâckezac, eme neŋgoc‐nanezi ʒâŋeruŋ‐nane ezac â dameŋ sâc motec kikiwechec juzac.
No wemocte buʒaic â maŋʒârâ sawa hone manac ezore â juju‐nane mimi busâqoc faio jutarazore neŋgoc bumaŋkonec fuapo?
Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ Jeremiarao fuawec irec binaŋ. Ine ŋicwofuŋ Zedekiazi Malikiare ŋokâ Pasahuru â taha bapa Zefania, Masejare ŋokâ hâcne, jahe mu wioc ecnenicte Jeremiarao sorec‐jofawec dameŋ ira fuawec.
“Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza e nâŋâcnehec ʒika qakacte go nâŋâcnere erâ Wofuŋ mu indiŋ ecnezemec; eme Wofuŋ e mârâc mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bawec iŋucnea moc bahuc Nebukaneza ecneme behec‐nâporâ razac mecne.”
Jeremia eki ine ʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Ŋohe Zedekia kecʒiŋuc âzâcnezepirec, ‘Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: Manaŋgopieŋ, ʒikare wiac meŋeŋicko badomahuc Babe ŋicwofuŋ â Kaldea ŋic sac râpenao somâc‐ŋopahapie jopahuc juŋgopieŋ wiac i mupe hae kecʒirec maŋnao risie‐fârezejec.
Erâ no nahac me sicnehuc meombâŋ‐nane tâpiriheczi aaricko â kimbeŋko erâ bu ʒaʒamaŋ‐nane fâuckeha ŋoŋehec ʒika qapemu.
Ehuc hae ʒirec ŋecjucfâc, ŋic mecne qowi mecne jopapemu; ehame huc hâmoczi rocjopame omaenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc mukac: Dameŋ irec faicnao ine Judare ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia e mecne â kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne mecne â ŋic ŋokac hae ʒirec maŋnao juhapie huc hâmoczi me ʒikazi me roroczi getâc‐jopawec jaŋe mâmâc Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza â râsifâc‐jeŋic juhuc juju‐jeŋic jowac roniŋte manasuŋgopieŋ jaŋere meo râec‐jopapemu; eme eki busâqoc mana‐jarehuc ŋeŋezic me aakic‐jopa i moc mi ehuc ʒikare micko râec‐jopazejec.’
“Erâ ŋicguru keci jazazemec, ‘Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Manaŋgopieŋ, no jujure hata mecne, hâmocte hata mecne mâmâc ŋaza ŋowatuc ekopac.
Moc e hae ʒirec maŋnao ŋeocmu e ʒikare nânâ eocmu, me nânâ basahuc hâmoocmu, me huc hâmoczi roocmu; â moc e ine hae beherâ Kaldea ŋic somâc‐ŋopaŋgopieŋ jaŋerao ʒuhuckeocmu eki ine juocmu â juju‐ticne i ʒikare mateŋ iŋucne focneocmu.
No bâbâpiaŋ mâcne, sisipiric bâfuacnepemurâ hae keci maickepo, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Hae i Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere meo feha turuŋkeme ʒâseŋkezejec.’
“Eme Juda ŋicwofuŋ ere kikefuŋfâc jazac, ‘Wofuŋte dâŋ mananiŋ,
Dawidire kikefuŋ ŋoŋe! Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Furic sâc dâŋgie baniŋ, ehuc ŋic bomac‐jopakicne jaŋe bâbâʒâic ŋic ere meonec batarac‐jopaniŋ. I eebapa‐ŋeŋic sâqocnere erâ kimbeŋ‐nanezi ʒoc iŋucne fuarâ bâruŋkeme moczi moc hehâpozore eipiezacte iŋuc enʒepieŋ.” ’
“Manakic, wâneŋko haroŋaŋ faio ŋesanaŋkeekic hae go hâcne râsi egarezo mukopac, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Ŋoŋe hâcne mueŋgopieŋ, ‘Mozi râsi enâreocmu? Mozi ficsanaŋ‐nâŋecko wefuocmu?’
No eebapa‐ŋeŋicte fârine irec sâcko bâtiŋ‐ŋopapemu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. No kâte‐ticnao ʒoc ruqepemu, eme izi wiac hae râreckehuc fokac i ʒâseŋke‐fâreocmu.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Go hurâ Judare ŋicwofuŋ ere ficko ferâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc mufuazemec:
‘Judare ŋicwofuŋ, Dawidire eri ŋeŋeo ŋekomec, go â kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge erâ motâc ʒirâ raʒic wefuc eeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe mâmâc Wofuŋte dâŋ mananiŋ!
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe mumutiŋ dâŋ â tiŋne juju dopeckehuc junʒepieŋ, ehuc ro waha âte ejarekicne jaŋe bâbâʒâic ŋic ere meonec batarac‐jopanʒepieŋ; ŋic jabane â hozec bekâ jaŋe fific mi bacjopanʒepieŋ, erâ ŋic jopa qâʒâic eejare me soc bahacmâc hohoŋke i hae ʒira wâc mi fuazejec.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ keci mana rereŋ ejâmbâŋ‐keniŋmuo ine ŋicwofuŋ Dawidire eri ŋeŋeo ŋeniŋmu jaŋe fic kecʒirec motâcko mocwâc wefunʒepieŋ, erâ jaŋe mecne, kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic mecne â ŋicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mâmâc becâsic keretacko ŋehuc rac warec enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ keci mi mananiŋmuo ine erific ʒi sesuctac fuarâ foocte no nahacnao ɋetickehuc mupaŋkekopac, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Wofuŋ no Juda ŋicwofuŋ erific‐ticnere ʒiŋuc mukopac: “‘No gore manape Gileade mâreŋ iŋucne â Lebanoŋ tiki botâŋne irec sâc ekomec; ʒi ine ima bacgupe hae sesucne â tuhutac erâ fozemec.
No ŋic sipiricguniŋte ʒikare wiac‐jeŋichec bâwosâec‐jopapemu, eme jaŋe jâmâzâcge biaŋne jâmbâŋ i qafararâ ʒocko behepie ʒazejec.
“‘Eme ŋicne ŋicne guru sâko jaŋe hae ʒi jâuruhuc jaŋackoaŋ muc manac erâ ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Wofuŋ e fuŋne weniŋucte hae sâko keci wiac iŋucne ecnewec?”
Iŋuc mu wioc epie ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jareniŋmu: “Jaŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋic ehec ʒâʒâfic ekicne i hetâcnerâ nemu gâcne jaŋe fodape‐jarehuc kiŋaŋ qajare jumbieŋte.” ’”
Ŋoŋe hâmokicne ere mi kioniŋ, â ere mu mamakuc wâc mi eniŋ, aricne, mâreŋ‐ticne beherâ rawec ere ine jâmbomac kionʒepieŋ, eki hâcne mocwâc mi risieocmu, â fufua mâreŋ‐ticne mocwâc mi honeocmu.
Josiare ŋokâ, Juda ŋicwofuŋ Salum hâcne, e mamac‐ticne Josia ere tuc qarâ ŋicwofuŋ juweczi mâreŋ ʒi beherâ rawec, ere hâcne Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “E ʒira mocwâc mi risie wareocmu.
Aricne, e kâpâcwâru barâ barambiŋ ira hâmozejec, mâreŋ ʒi ine mocwâc mi honezejec.”
“Jei, ŋic keci! E sindaŋ ehuc ficticne baekac, â eebapa repicne ehuc fic maŋne maŋne bâfuaekac, erâ âgo‐ticne, kiŋaŋ mâc qanarezejec muhuc gie furi mi râcneekac.
Ehuc muekac, ‘No ficsâko maŋne maŋne kâcɋene iŋucne moc bape, ehuc qâqâtâc kataŋ‐ticne barâ maŋne jâmâzâc paraŋzi bâpiaŋkerâ peŋ bâbâroŋzi rikepemu.’
Go fic jâmâzâczi bacmurâ ʒoɋac ehuc ŋicwofuŋ jujugere fuŋne bataniŋkezo mukomec me? Mamacgezi weniŋuc ewec? E nânâ opâ nâhuc juwec, erâ mumutiŋ dâŋ â tiŋne juju foocte giene bawec. Iŋuc ehuc sâcne juhâmowec.
E ro waha âte ejarekicne â qarâ suriŋne jaŋere dâŋ dopeckewecko wiac biaŋkerâ fowec; eme ŋic iŋucnere, no mana taracnukac, mi muzo me? Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Gore ʒâŋe â mamanasuzi ine moneŋ mafare â ŋic bahacmâc jaŋere soc hoŋkezore erâ ŋic fific bacjopahuc bâʒâic‐jopazore sawa domaekac.”
Irec Wofuŋzi Josiare ŋokâ, Juda ŋicwofuŋ Jojakim hâcne ere ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ere mu mamakuc ehuc ʒiŋuc mi muniŋmu: ‘O hahac‐nane, o seŋnane!’ Erâ ʒiŋuc wâc mi muniŋmu: ‘O bomboŋ fekicne, o eri qaraweŋ‐ticnehec!’
Aricne, e doŋgi iŋucne duckenʒepieŋ, fârerâ ra Jerusalem haere motâc ocniŋuc taicko behepie fozejec.”
“Go Lebanoŋ tikio ferâ kio owa ec, Basaŋ mâreŋko marac fânâŋge fuaoc; kifânâŋgezi fuarâ Abarim tikionec wahaoc, jorocfâcge jaŋe henʒaŋ‐jopa‐fârekicne irec.
Go mana mezac tâmiric juhaŋtec dâŋ gazapo, goki ine mumeŋ, ‘No manaŋore takicnukac.’ Go ɋiegaonecteaŋ iŋuc ehuc jumeŋ hâcne, ehuc dâŋnane mana rereŋ mi emeŋ.
Ʒi ine mâŋâŋzi lama soŋaŋfâcge ficne suec‐jopame raniŋmu, ehame jorocfâcge jaŋe kâpâcwâruo bacjopa raniŋmu wâc. Iŋuc fuame hehesicge sasawa irec erâ mimi busâqoczi faigao feme qurutuazemec.
Lebanoŋ tikio ŋec juc ehuc jâmâzâc hahaŋko sareŋge ba akic ekomec go ŋokac gozi kime ʒâic serereŋ manaekac ʒâic irec sâc fua‐gareme kio huse wemo afecne ecmu!”
Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “No jujâmbâŋkekopacte ine Jojakimte ŋokâ Konia, Juda ŋicwofuŋ hâcne, go mefâre‐naneo meo fefe maqâreŋhec iŋucne fotec muzac sifu hetaracguzapo.
No jujuge sipirickezo muŋgopieŋ â hâhâwic bajareekic jaŋere meo râecguzepac, ine Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza â Kaldea ŋic jaŋere meo hâcne.
No go â neŋgocge rocguwec e mâmâc jaha mâreŋ mocko, mi fuapicko ira hâcne tuŋŋofape juku hâmozepirec.
Â risienicte maŋ hâhâŋ eŋacteekac mâreŋ ira ine moc mi risiezepirec.”
Eme Jeremiazi muwec: “Ŋic keci, ʒâŋeŋe Konia e kuʒi sâqocne qanʒaŋnekicne me râqâc qaisockekicne iŋucne me? E â ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋe wemocte mâreŋ moc mi manambiŋko tuŋjopakicne â jâpec‐jopakicne?
O mâreŋ, mâreŋ, mâreŋ, go Wofuŋte dâŋ manac!
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: ‘Ŋic keci e naru motec tâmiric, fuŋne‐ticne iŋuc qâreŋkeniŋ; e mâreŋko juocmu sâc ba bititic ehuc juzejec, â ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec moczi Dawidire eri ŋeŋeo ŋehuc Judare ŋicwofuŋ juocte hatane mi fuacnezejec.’”
“Jei, lama soŋaŋ ŋoŋe, sapa‐nanere lama guru mi soŋaŋ‐jopahuc bâtâtiec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ!” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
Irec Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e ŋicfâc‐ticne soŋaŋ‐jopaeŋgopieŋ soŋaŋ i jaŋere ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋoŋe lama gurufâc‐nane hone maiŋ moc mi ejarehuc bâtâtiec‐jopambiŋ â jâpec‐jopambiŋ. Manaŋgopieŋ, no eebapa‐ŋeŋic sâqocnere erâ bâtiŋ‐ŋopapemu! Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme no lama gurufâc‐nane ʒanʒaŋne mâreŋne mâreŋne behec‐jopapo irecnec qânusuc‐joparâ jowac‐jopa ware sapa‐jeŋicko râec‐jopapemu, eme fua sawec enʒepieŋ.
No soŋaŋ râec‐jopape hone soŋaŋ ejarenʒepieŋ, eme jaŋe mocwâc mi hâwic‐jopaha gâgâmârânʒepieŋ, ehame moczi mocwâc mi sifuckezejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira Dawidire oso gitecne tiŋne moc mupe fuaocmu, eme eki ŋicwofuŋ juhuc guriŋ bapa gie‐ticne mamanahec bazejec â mâreŋko mumutiŋ dâŋ â tiŋne juju foocte giene bahuc juzejec.
Eme ere juju dameŋko Juda bâbâpiaŋ fuacneocmu â Israezi wama faio juocmu; ʒâŋe‐ticne ine ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Wofuŋ e tiŋne‐nâŋec.’
“Irec manac, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira ʒiŋuc mocwâc mi muniŋmu, ‘Wofuŋ e jujâmbâŋkekacte Israe ŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopame wahambiŋ.’
Aricne, ʒiŋuc muniŋmu, ‘Wofuŋ e jujâmbâŋkekacte Israere ɋâricfâc jaŋe jaŋacne mâreŋko ŋec juc eniŋte faic mâreŋkonec â ira me ira bâtâtiec‐jopaweckonec jowac‐jopa warewec.’”
Porofete jaŋere dâŋ: Maŋnane ʒâickeha bunane herickekac, me kike bibiric‐nane ŋetaraha jâjâwâckekac. No ŋic opâ sanaŋ nâku biric boroc eekac iŋucne, â ŋic moc waiŋzi maŋ bâsifuc ecneekac irec sâc; no Wofuŋte maio â tiridâŋ‐ticnere maio iŋuc hâcne ekopac.
Mâreŋ i boe sau ŋiczi fusucmarâ juŋgopieŋ hâcne, ehame sâwecte erâ hae mâreŋzi busâqoc hawari ekac, â mâreŋ burocnao kecɋaŋ wiac hâmo ɋaŋac ekac. Jaŋe wiac sâqocnere henʒiriŋnehuc juŋgopieŋ, â hehesiczi tâpiri‐jeŋic ekac.
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Porofete mecne, taha bapa mecne jaŋe mâmâc jaha ŋic sindaŋne; jei, ficnaneoa eebapa‐jeŋic hehesicne bâfuakopac hâcne.
Irec hata‐jeŋic i hata fâfâsâcne iŋucne ezejec, eme dapâcko ira rahuc âte sowarierâ waha jopazejec. No bâbâtiŋ jara dameŋ‐jeŋicko wiac hâhâwicne mupe fai‐jeŋicko feocmu hâcne, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Samaria mâreŋko porofete juŋgopieŋ jaŋerao wiac mamakâcne honepo wâc; jaŋe Baali ere ʒâŋeo âke hotahuc findaŋdâŋ mumbiŋ, ehuc ŋicfâc‐nane maŋ bâsifuc ejarembiŋ.
Jerusalem haeo porofete juŋgopieŋ jaŋerao ine wiac sindaŋ hârindaŋ hâhâwicne honepo. Jaŋe boe sau ehuc burecdâŋko wiac ebac eeŋgopieŋ, erâ sâqocne bapa jaŋe sâqocne‐jeŋic mi beheniŋte dopec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ. No jaŋere manape Sodomŋic iŋucne efâreŋgopieŋ, â ŋecjufâc‐ticne jaŋere manape Gomora ŋic jaŋere sâc eŋgopieŋ.”
Irec Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ noni porofete jaŋere dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukopac: “Manakic, no kegocjâc hâtâ qiŋqiŋne â qotâra micopâ gumec‐jopapemu; Jerusalem haeonec porofete jaŋeraonec hâcne wiac hehesicnezi haŋ barâ mâreŋ fusucma‐fârekac.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Porofete findaŋdâŋ ŋazaeŋgopieŋ jaŋere dâŋ mi mananʒepieŋ, jaŋe eatuc‐ŋopaeŋgopieŋ sawa; jaŋe Wofuŋte mickonec dâŋ mâcne, jaŋe jaŋacne maŋko fuac dâŋ ŋazaeŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋte dâŋ qaisockeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe dameŋ sâc ʒiŋuc jazaeŋgopieŋ, ‘Ŋoŋe sâcne juhâc qâhâmoniŋmu’, â maŋrâŋgeŋ‐jeŋicte hata âtehuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jaza‐fâreeŋgopieŋ, ‘Ŋoŋe wiac hâhâwicne moc mi fua‐ŋareocmu.’”
Jaŋeraonec mozi Wofuŋte dâŋficko domahuc dâŋticne hone manac moc ewec? Me mozi dâŋticne mana rereŋ moc ewec?
Manakic, Wofuŋtaonec mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋnehec, kimbeŋ‐ticne hâcne â ʒâʒâkiriŋ mâŋâŋ fuarâ ŋic hehesicne jaŋere qizecko wahaocmu.
Wofuŋ e kimbeŋ‐ticne i wiac mana biric ewec sâc fârine fua‐fâreme sawa bâruŋkeocmu. Ŋoŋe irec fuŋne dameŋ tataranao hone mana tarac eniŋmu.
“Porofere keci jaŋe noni mi sorec‐jopahape jaŋac gasackembiŋ, no dâŋ mi jazahape jaŋac findaŋdâŋ mumbiŋ.
Jaŋe jâmbomac nore dâŋficko domaku wahanʒapiŋ muzac ine ŋic ŋokacfâc‐nane nore dâŋ mufua‐jarenʒapiŋ, ehuc hata‐jeŋic hehesicnaonec â eebapa‐jeŋic repicnaonec bârisiec‐jopanʒapiŋ.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “No Anutu bembeŋko sawa jujune â taicko mi jujune me?
Ŋic moczi sâcne haesoŋ mocko soŋkepaŋkeme no basapemu me? No sambâŋ mâreŋ ŋefuserâ mi jukopac me?
Porofete gâcne nore ʒâŋeo âke hotahuc findaŋdâŋ burecne mueŋgopieŋ, ehuc ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: ‘No guŋko dâŋ iŋuc manapac, iŋuc manapac’, i jaŋere dâŋ kâuc mi bakopac.
Porofete jaŋe maŋjeŋicko burecdâŋ babaju, â findaŋdâŋ burecne mumu, â maŋjeŋicte eeatuc mumusawe i wezimucko behenʒoŋgopieŋ?
Guŋ manarâ irec dâŋ nazaŋ gazaŋ eeŋgopieŋ i ŋicfâc‐nane nore ʒâŋe nikec‐jopaocte manasuhuc eeŋgopieŋ hâcne, mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe iŋuc jaha Baali nemu kiŋaŋ qacnehuc ʒâŋe‐nane nikec‐jopawec.
Porofete moc e guŋ manajecko irec binaŋ bazo murâ bazejec, â moc e nore dâŋ moc manajecko ine dâŋnane fâretiŋ jaha muzejec. Padi jawane â fârine i wemocko bâturec‐jofazo?
Dâŋnanere fuŋne kecʒiŋuc fokac i mi honeŋgopieŋ me? E ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne, erâ hamazi qânâ sâko qâfâuckepene dâkâ piic piic eekac irec sâc. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Irec mananiŋ, porofete moczi mocte mickonec dâŋnane manahuc fiuc roroc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe râsi ejarekopac.
Erâ manaŋgopieŋ, porofete jaŋacne nameŋzi dâŋ murâ, Wofuŋzi mukac, muhuc burec eeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe wâc râsi ejarekopac.
Erâ no Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mupe mananiŋ: Noni mi sorec‐jopahape â dâŋ moc mi mutâcne‐jarehape porofete gâcne jaŋe guŋ burecnere findaŋdâŋ muniŋmu, erâ irec binaŋ bahuc ŋic ŋokacfâc‐nane jowac‐jopapie burec â eeatuc dâŋjeŋic reŋkehuc qâsorieniŋmu, porofete iŋucne jaŋe râsi ejarekopac. Jaŋe gie bapie ŋic ŋokac jaŋerao fârine biaŋne moc mi fuaekac. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Jeremia, go ŋicguru keci jaŋe, me porofete moczi, me taha bapa moczi ʒiŋuc mu wioc egareniŋmu, ‘Wofuŋte tagi i wemo wiac mo?’ ine jazazemec, ‘Tagi i ŋoŋe hâcne, no hetara behec eŋarepemu.’ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Porofete moczi me taha bapa moczi me ŋic jaŋeraonec eki me eki ‘Wofuŋte dâŋ ine hâcne’, dâŋ iŋuc muocmu ŋic e â wiacfâcne jaŋe mâmâc bâtiŋ‐jopapemu.
Ŋaŋackoaŋ nazaŋ gazaŋ ehuc mu wioc ʒiŋuc enʒepieŋ: ‘Wofuŋzi dâŋ weniŋuc bâtikiewec?’ Me ‘Wofuŋzi dâŋ weniŋuc muwec?’
‘Wofuŋte tagi’, dâŋ i ine mu bâuac mocwâc mi enʒepieŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Anutu‐nâŋec hâcne, ere dâŋ musifuckepie ŋaŋacne dâŋzi tagi eŋarezacte.
Irec porofete ʒiŋuc mu wioc ecnezemec: ‘Wofuŋ e dâŋ weniŋuc bâtikie‐garewec?’ Me ‘Wofuŋ e dâŋ weniŋuc muwec?’
Ŋoŋe ine ‘Wofuŋte tagi,’ dâŋ iŋuc mupie Wofuŋzi muocmu, ‘Ŋoŋe “Wofuŋte tagi,” ’ dâŋ i mi muniŋte muac‐ŋopa‐bipiehape sifu muniŋmuo
ine tagi iŋucne bafaharec‐ŋoparâ ŋoŋe mecne â mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic hae ŋarepo i mâmâc mai‐naneonec behec‐ŋopape sipirickeniŋmu.
Eme mupe mimi tatara tâmiric â mimi qaqa fofo sanaŋ â mi ninikecne izi fai‐ŋeŋicko fezejec.”
Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza eki Judare ŋicwofuŋ Jekonia, Jojakimte ŋoka hâcne, e â Judare ŋic fekicne â fic bapa erâ aeŋzi wiac bapa jaŋe mâmâc Jerusalemkonec Babe haeo bacjopa rawec. Eme manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ irec faicnao Wofuŋzi kâdoc jajahec jâmbo hândâŋnehec Wofuŋte taha ufuŋte hae ʒoŋao ŋeha nowatume honepo.
Kâdoc mocko jâmbo hândâŋ biaŋne jâmbâŋ fowec, jâmbo hândâŋne bâbâni qeueekac irec sâc; kâdoc moc ira ine jâmbo hândâŋ sâqocne jâmbâŋ fowec, jâmbo hândâŋne mi nânâne, gâreckekicne hâcne.
Eme Wofuŋzi nazawec: “Jeremia, go wemo wiac honekomec?” Mume mupo, “Jâmbo hândâŋne, jâmbo hândâŋ biaŋne i biaŋne jâmbâŋ, â jâmbo hândâŋ sâqocne i sâqocne jâmbâŋ, gâreckekicnere mocwâc mi nânâne.”
Mupe tarame Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc nazawec:
“Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Jâmbo hândâŋ biaŋne ʒi hone ʒiziwekopac, ehuc manahape Judaŋic mâreŋ ʒirecnec Kaldea mâreŋko bacjopa rambiŋ jaŋe irec sâc jaha hone ʒiziwec‐jopakopac.
Erâ hone akic ejarehuc juku jowac‐jopape mâreŋ ʒira risienʒepieŋ; eme no heɋârec‐joparâ mocwâc mi sipiric‐jopapemu, no sarac‐joparâ mocwâc mi qâfiec‐jopapemu.
Erâ no maŋ mamanasu tahac‐jopahape jaŋe no Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ. Eme jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane juhapie no Anutu‐jeŋic juzepac, jaŋe maŋjeŋic bârisie‐jâmbâŋkehuc maicnunʒepieŋ.
“No Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia â fekicnefâc‐ticne â Jerusalemte ŋic nâfocne, â mâreŋ ʒirec ŋic ʒanʒaŋne erâ Aigita mâreŋko mâckerâ juŋgopieŋ jaŋe ŋiczi jâmbo hândâŋ sâqocne, gâreckekicnere mocwâc mi nâhuc beheeŋgopieŋ sâc ijaha ejarepemu.
Noni mupe mâreŋte ŋicguru sasawa honec‐joparâ hâwic‐jopazejec. Ehame behec‐jopapemu sâc mâreŋ irec ŋic jaŋe mu ruruc ejarehuc mu qâqiŋ dâŋ ejarenʒepieŋ, erâ nifepupu ejarehuc sâwecdâŋ muranʒepieŋ.
Eme mupe ʒika mecne, roroc mecne, huc hâmoc mecne fua‐jareme jaŋe â mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic mâreŋ jarepo ira sirowe‐fârenʒepieŋ.”
Nebukaneza e Babe ŋicwofuŋ juhame jara wâŋ ewec, â Juda ŋicwofuŋ Jojakim, Josiare ŋokâ hâcne, e ŋicwofuŋ juhame jara 4 ewec dameŋ ira Judare ŋicfâc sasawa jaŋere erâ Jeremiarao dâŋ fuawec ʒine hâcne.
Eme porofete Jeremia e Juda ŋicguru sasawa â Jerusalem ŋecjucfâc‐ticne ʒeŋgoma jaŋe dâŋ i jazahuc kecʒiŋuc muwec:
“Amoŋte ŋokâ Josia e Juda ŋicwofuŋ jume jara 13 eha Wofuŋte dâŋ fuŋkerâ norao fuawec; erâ fua wefukuhame jara 23 sâko tarakac, ehame no hati mutaniŋke‐ŋarehuc jupo, ŋoŋe ine moc mi manambiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ e dameŋ sâc kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne sasawa, porofete hâcne, ŋoŋerao sorec‐jopahuc juwec, ŋoŋe ine mi manambiŋ â dâŋticne mananiŋte hazec mi râembiŋ.
E ʒiŋuc nazawec hâcne: ‘Ŋoŋe ru sâc hata hehesicne â eebapa‐ŋeŋic sâqocne râpeckenʒepieŋ; iŋuc erâ Wofuŋ noni ŋoŋe â mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ tahac‐ŋopapo ira jurâ ju ehuc juniŋmu sanaŋ.
Ŋoŋe nemu gâcne jaŋerao qohotahuc kiŋaŋ mi qajarenʒepieŋ â mi fodape‐jarenʒepieŋ, erâ wiac hâhâwicne eŋarezipore eebapa‐ŋeŋiczi mi bâiŋnunʒepieŋ.’
Ŋoŋe ine dâŋnane mi manambiŋ, irec eebapa‐ŋeŋiczi bâiŋnumbiŋte wiac hâhâwicne fua‐ŋarezejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Irec Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋoŋe dâŋnane mi manambiŋte
no faic mâreŋkonec ŋicguru sasawa jaŋere mecne erâ Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza, kiŋaŋ qaqa‐nane ere mecne, dâŋ râe‐jarepe rame jaŋe ware mâreŋ ʒi â ŋecjucfâc‐ticne erâ ŋicne ŋicne rârec rârec juraŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe râsi eŋarenʒepieŋ. Eme no sipiric‐ŋopa‐jâmbâŋkepe ŋiczi honec‐ŋoparâ bipic tatara ejarezejec, ehame mu ruruc â âkebic sanaŋ eŋarenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme no ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋickonec aŋac ʒeri â ʒeri bubiaŋ â ŋic ŋokac roroc ehuc ʒeri fânâŋ eeŋgopieŋ â hâmu fâfâze irec fânâŋ erâ lambe tatamac i bârâriezepac.
Mâreŋ sasawazi sesuctac fuarâ tuhu fozejec, ehame ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere kiŋaŋ qahuc juhapie jara 70 tarazejec.
Juku jara 70 tarame ine Babe ŋicwofuŋ â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe kiŋjeŋicte okacne bazu‐jarepemu, ehuc Kaldea ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ imackepe sesuctac fuarâ fozejec sanaŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
No mâreŋ i hâcne râsi ecnerâ dâŋ muhuc jupo i mupe fârinehec efâreocmu; papia kecʒirec maŋnao dâŋ qâreŋke‐fârekicne fokac, ine Jeremiazi ŋicne ŋicne findaŋdâŋ‐jeŋic muwec i hâcne.
Eme jaŋe iŋuc jaha ŋicguru kâcɋene â ŋicwofuŋ fekicne jaŋere kiŋaŋ qaqa erâ junʒepieŋ, ehame juju â eebapa‐jeŋicte furine jarepemu.”
Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc hâcne nazawec: “Go menaneonec waiŋ râqâc kimbeŋzi fusekicne ʒi rorâ ŋicne ŋicne jaŋerao sorecgupe rarâ ejaretec nânʒepieŋ.
Eme jaŋe nârâ biric boroc epie mupe ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ʒika fuame honerâ maŋsifuc ejarezejec.”
Iŋuc mume Wofuŋte meonec râqâc rorâ Wofuŋzi ŋicne ŋicne jaŋerao sorecnuwec sâc rarâ ejarepe nâmbiŋ.
Ine Jerusalem hae â Juda mâreŋko hae ŋerawec sâc erâ ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic â fekicnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe hâcne. Hae izi sesuctac â niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ foocte, erâ ŋic gâcnezi mu ruruc ejarehuc sâwecdâŋ muraniŋte iŋuc ejarepo; eme dameŋ ʒi iŋuc hâcne fuawec fokac.
Erâ ŋic kecʒi jaŋe mâmâc gumec‐jopape nâmbiŋ: Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Farao â kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne â fekicnefâc‐ticne erâ ŋicfâc‐ticne sasawa.
Erâ ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ŋic sahac hawari fuŋne fuŋne juŋgopieŋ jaŋe; erâ Uzi mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ sasawa â Filisa mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ sasawa, ine Asikaloŋ â Gaza â Ekoroŋ erâ Asidode mâreŋ nâfocne irec ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe hâcne.
Erâ Edom â Moabi â Amoŋ mâreŋ rune jaŋe.
Erâ Tirore ŋicwofuŋ sasawa â Sidoŋte ŋicwofuŋ sasawa, erâ hâwec ocniŋuc hâwecmecko ŋicwofuŋ juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe.
Erâ Dedaŋ â Tema â Buʒi irec rune â qizec susuc‐jeŋic naki ŋifec â ŋifec bâtâcneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe.
Erâ Arabia mâreŋ irec ŋicwofuŋ sasawa, â ŋic sahac hawari fuŋne fuŋne mâreŋ sawao juraŋgopieŋ jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ sasawa.
Erâ Ʒimiri irec ŋicwofuŋ sasawa, â Elamte ŋicwofuŋ sasawa erâ Mede mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ sasawa.
Erâ faic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ bembeŋko me ʒoricko juŋgopieŋ sasawa, ine hâcne mâreŋte faio ŋic gurune gurune ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋichec sasawa; mâc Babe ŋicwofuŋ eki ine gâcne nâfârepie ʒâhec nâzejec.
“Go iŋuc ejarehuc jazazemec: ‘Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: Nâku maŋsifuc eŋareme maŋunʒepieŋ, erâ waha ŋopame mocwâc mi faharenʒepieŋ; no ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ʒika bâfuapemu irec erâ iŋuc enʒepieŋ.’
“Jaŋe ine megaonec râqâc rorâ nâniŋte qikiŋneniŋmuo ine jazazemec, ‘Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe nâjâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ!
Manaŋgopieŋ, hae nore ʒâŋe rowec erao hâcne fuŋkerâ ʒârâ hâriŋ bâfuakopac, ehame bâbâtiŋzi ŋoŋe wemocko ŋowaruzac! No mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne ʒeŋgoma ʒika bâfua‐jarepemu i ŋoŋe wâc mi ŋowaruocmu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.’
“Irec go jaŋere findaŋdâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc jaza‐fârezemec: ‘Wofuŋ owa‐ticnere fânâŋzi faickonec wahaocmu, â tiri ufuŋ‐ticnaonec marac fânâŋ‐ticne fuame mananiŋmu. E owa kâcɋene owackeme ŋeŋe hae‐ticne sâcke‐fâreocmu, ehame waiŋ hândâŋne âte pisickehuc aŋara heeŋgopieŋ irec sâc mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne sasawa râsi ejarehuc aŋara heocmu.
Eme irec fânâŋ i mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao ra fisiocmu. Wofuŋ e ŋicne ŋicne dâŋko râec‐joparâ jaŋerao dâŋgie bahuc kiŋhec jaŋe mutara‐jareme ʒikare biŋe eniŋmu. Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.’
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: Jei, wiac hâhâwicnezi ŋicne ŋicne fua‐jare raocmu, â mânâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋnehec moczi mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaonec fuarâ fisiocmu.
“Wofuŋzi qâhâmoc‐jopaocmu jaŋe ʒoaŋ dameŋ ira mâreŋ qaŋeŋne ŋifeckonec fuŋkerâ foware raku ŋifecko fotaraniŋmu; jaŋere erâ ki mamakuc moc mi fuaocmu, erâ ro nusec ejarerâ duducjopa i wâc mi fuaocmu, aricne, jaŋe mâreŋ faio jawa iŋucne fohuc mâreŋte guec enʒepieŋ.
“Lama soŋaŋ ŋoŋe kio huse erâ owackeniŋ, lama rune ŋoŋe ʒafeo rândiŋke qarâ risimbiŋne qaniŋ; qa hezuc eŋarezore dameŋ maickekac hâcne, henʒaŋ‐ŋopapie kuʒi furi sâko waha qanʒaŋneekac irec sâc enʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc fuame lama soŋaŋ jaŋe dapeŋ basa‐bipieniŋmu, â rune jaŋe wiseniŋte eipieniŋmu.
Mananiŋ! Lama soŋaŋ jaŋere kio owa â rune jaŋere ki uu fuakac, i Wofuŋzi kecɋaŋ gie‐jeŋic sipirickekacte
â sapa biaŋne i Wofuŋ kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋte erâ imackekicnere.
E laioŋ iŋucne kâte uupic‐ticnaonec wefuwec; eme mâreŋ‐jeŋic i ʒika sisipiric‐ticnehecte â kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋte tuhutac fuawec fokac.”
Juda ŋicwofuŋ Jojakim, Josiare ŋokâ hâcne, e ŋicwofuŋ gie‐ticne fuŋkeha Jeremiarao Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: Go Wofuŋ nore taha ufuŋte hae ʒoŋao ferâ domazemec. Ehuc Judare hae sâko ŋerakac irecnec ŋic taha ufuŋ‐naneo fodape‐nareniŋte fisiŋgopieŋ jaŋe dâŋ jazacmurâ mutâcne‐garepo sâc jazazemec. Ehuc dâŋ moc mi hesoŋkezemec.
Eme jaŋe manarâ maŋjeŋic bârisiehuc hata‐jeŋic hehesicne behe‐fâreniŋmu mecne, eme no busâqoc mana‐jarehuc maŋnane risieme eebapa‐jeŋic sâqocnere erâ wiac hâhâwicne fua‐jareocte mupo i aka hecnepe fozejec.
Goki ine jazac, ‘Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe dâŋnane qikiŋnehuc sâcmutâc dâŋ ŋarepo i mana rereŋ mi eniŋmuo,
ehuc kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane, porofete hâcne, dameŋ sâc ŋoŋerao sorec‐jopaekopac jaŋere dâŋ mananiŋte takic‐ŋopaocmuo
ine Silo hae ecnepo sâc ijaha ufuŋ ʒi ecnepemu, erâ mupe mâreŋte faio ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe hae ʒirec sâwecdâŋ muranʒepieŋ.’”
Eme taha bapa â porofete â ŋic ŋokac gâcne sâko jaŋe Jeremiazi dâŋ i Wofuŋte taha ufuŋko muhame manambiŋ.
Eme Jeremia e Wofuŋzi ŋic ŋokac sasawa dâŋ jazaocte mutâcnecnewec sâc i mutarame izia taha bapa â porofete erâ ŋic ŋokac gâcne sâko jaŋe e rorâ mumbiŋ: “Go hâmo‐jâmbâŋkezemec.”
Erâ mumbiŋ, “Go Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo âke hotahuc wemocte findaŋdâŋ ʒiŋuc mumec: ‘Taha ufuŋ ʒi i Silo hae wiac fuacnewec iŋucnea fuacnezejec, â hae ʒi ima bapie sesutac fuarâ fozejec’?” Iŋuc murâ ŋic ŋokac ʒeŋgoma jaŋe Wofuŋte taha ufuŋko qâturerâ Jeremia râsi ecnembiŋ.
Eme Judaŋic fekicne jaŋe wiac irec biŋe manarâ ŋicwofuŋte fickonec waharâ Wofuŋte taha ufuŋko ferâ Motâc Ɋârio waha ŋembiŋ.
Ehame taha bapa â porofete jaŋe ŋic fekicne â ŋic ŋokac sasawa ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ, “Ŋic keci e ʒikare biŋe ekac, i ŋoŋe ŋaŋac hazec‐ŋeŋiczi manahapie hae ʒi râsi ecnehuc findaŋdâŋ muwec irec.”
Jeremia eki ine ŋic fekicne sasawa â ŋic ŋokac gâcne sâko ʒiŋuc jaza‐fârewec: “Wofuŋ e jahac ufuŋ â hae sâko ʒi irec findaŋdâŋ hazec‐ŋeŋiczi manambiŋ i mufuapemurâ sorecnuwec.
Irec ʒi juju â eebapa biaŋne bâfuaniŋ, ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic ere mumutâc dâŋ mana rereŋ eniŋ; eme wiac hâhâwicne fua‐ŋareocte muwec i busâqoc manahuc maŋne risieme aka hecneme fozejec.
No nahac ine meŋeŋicko fepac domakopac ʒi, irec ŋoŋe manapie biaŋkekac me sâckekac irec sâcko wiac enareniŋ.
Ʒiŋuc ine mana‐jâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ: Qâhâmocnuniŋmuo ine ŋic bahacmâc nore soczi ŋoŋere faio â hae sâko ʒi erâ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋere faio feocmu, i Wofuŋzi dâŋ keci sasawa hahaŋne bahuc mufua‐ŋarepemurâ sorecnuwec irec.”
Jeremiazi iŋuc mume ŋic fekicne â ŋic ŋokac ʒeŋgoma jaŋe taha bapa â porofete ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Ŋic kecʒi e ʒikare biŋe aricne, e Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋecte micte dâŋ nâzâjec hâcne.”
Eme mâreŋ irec soŋaŋ kâcɋene gâcne jaŋe faharerâ ŋic ŋokac tumaŋnembiŋ ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ:
“Juda ŋicwofuŋ Hisikia juwec dameŋ ira Morese haeonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Mika, e porofete fua taniŋkerâ Juda ŋic ŋokac jaza‐fârewec, ‘Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi mukac: Zioŋ tiki i nânâ gie iŋucne hec hetikic eniŋmu, â Jerusalem hae i ima bapie sesutac foha taha ufuŋte tikio kâte uupic fuazejec.’
Iŋuc jazame Juda ŋicwofuŋ Hisikia â Judaŋic jaŋe e moc qâhâmombiŋ me? Aricne, jaŋe Wofuŋte hâwic‐jopaha mu huacbuc ecnembiŋ. Eme Wofuŋ e busâqoc mana‐jarehuc maŋne risieme sisipiric wiac fua‐jareocte muwec i aka hecneme fowec. Nâŋâc wiac hâhâwicne sâko fai‐nâŋecko feocte giene bazo eŋgopeneŋ hâcne.”
Eme ŋic moc juwec ʒâŋene Uria, Semajare ŋokâ, Kiriati‐Jearim haeonec, eki iŋuc jaha Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo âke hotahuc findaŋdâŋ muwec. Ehuc Jeremiazi ewec irec sâc jaha hae â mâreŋ ʒirec findaŋdâŋ muwec hâcne.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Jojakim â ʒikaŋic erâ fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe dâŋticne manapie mi sâckeme ŋicwofuŋzi qâhâmoocte muwec. Uria eki ine irec biŋe manarâ hâwickeme Aigita mâreŋko wisewec.
Iŋuc eme ŋicwofuŋ Jojakimzi Akaborore ŋokâ Elenataŋ erâ ŋic gâcne ehec mâmâc raniŋte Aigita mâreŋko sorec‐jopawec.
Eme jaŋe Uria rorâ Aigita mâreŋkonec jowa warerâ ŋicwofuŋ Jojakimtao râembiŋ; eki ine ʒikazi qâhâmorâ qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne ŋic ŋokac omane jaŋere ʒâŋeruŋ gieo beheniŋte muwec.
Safaŋte ŋokâ Ahikam eki ine Jeremia e ŋic ŋokac jaŋere meo feme qâhâmonʒipiŋte ŋezickewec.
Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia, Josiare ŋokâ hâcne, e ŋicwofuŋ gie‐ticne fuŋkerâ juhame Jeremiarao Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go muc â kioŋ wiac bâfuarâ upegao râezemec.
Erâ Jerusalem haeo kiŋaŋ fisirâ Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekiarao fuambiŋ jaŋe ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic kecʒiŋuc i jaŋere dâŋ jaretec baranʒepieŋ: Edom ŋicwofuŋ, Moabi ŋicwofuŋ, Amoŋ ŋicwofuŋ, Tiro ŋicwofuŋ â Sidoŋ ŋicwofuŋ.
Erâ bomboŋfâc‐jeŋic dâŋ kecʒiŋuc jazaniŋte mujarezemec: ‘Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu eki ʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe bomboŋfâc‐ŋeŋic kecʒiŋuc jazanʒepieŋ:
“Mâreŋ mecne, erâ mâreŋte faio ŋic â qowi juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe mecne i noni hâcne menane sicnehuc tâpiri sâko‐nanezi bâfuac‐jopapo, irec e me e râcnezo murâ râcnepemu.
Ʒi ine mâreŋ i sasawa kiŋaŋ qaqa‐nane Nebukaneza, Babe ŋicwofuŋ hâcne, ere meo râepe fokac, ehuc kâte qowi jaŋe wâc kiŋaŋ qacneniŋte mujarepo.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe e ŋokâ‐ticne erâ ŋosa‐ticnere kiŋaŋ qahuc jufekupie e jahacne mâreŋ‐ticnere dameŋ maickezejec wâc; maickeme ŋicguru kâcɋene â ŋicwofuŋ tâpirihec jaŋe rauckepie kiŋaŋ qaqa‐jeŋic ezejec.
“‘ “Ŋicguru moc ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋichec kiŋaŋ qacneniŋte qikiŋneniŋmu me Babe ŋicwofuŋte tagi mi deniŋmu jaŋe ʒikazi me roroczi me huc hâmoczi bâtiŋ‐jopa raku Babe ŋicwofuŋ ecnepe bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârezejec; Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Irec porofete me findaŋdâŋ omane mumu me guŋ fuŋne mamana me mâsi bapare fuŋne mamana me qaŋgec bapa jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc ŋazapie mi mananʒepieŋ: ‘Ŋoŋe Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere kiŋaŋ qaqa moc mi jujâmbâŋkeniŋmu.’
Jaŋe mâreŋ‐ŋeŋickonec jâpec‐ŋopaniŋte â noni bâtâtiec‐ŋopape sipirickeniŋte findaŋdâŋ burecne ŋazaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋicguru moc Babe ŋicwofuŋ tagi‐ticne dehuc kiŋaŋ qacneniŋmu jaŋe ine mana‐jarepe mâreŋ‐jeŋickoa gie he sarac ehuc ŋec juc enʒepieŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.” ’”
Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia e ine ʒiŋuc muhuc dâŋ ijaha âzâcnepo: “Ŋoŋe Babe ŋicwofuŋ tagi‐ticne dehuc e jahacne â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere kiŋaŋ qahuc mi sipirickerâ sâcne juniŋmu.
Ŋicguru moc Babe ŋicwofuŋ kiŋaŋ mi qacneniŋmu jaŋe sipirickeniŋte Wofuŋzi muwec. Eme go â ŋicfâcge ŋoŋe wemocte dâŋ i mana‐bipierâ ʒika â roroc â huc hâmoczi ŋopame hâmoniŋte muŋgopieŋ me?
‘Ŋoŋe Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere kiŋaŋ mi qajâmbâŋkeniŋmu’, porofete iŋuc ŋazaeŋgopieŋ jaŋere dâŋ mi mananʒepieŋ, jaŋe findaŋdâŋ burecne ŋazaeŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Wofuŋte dâŋ ʒiŋuc: No jaŋe mi sorec‐jopapo, aricne, jaŋe nore ʒâŋeo âke hotahuc findaŋdâŋ burecne ŋazaeŋgopieŋ i behec‐ŋopape ŋoŋe mecne â porofete findaŋdâŋ ŋazaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mecne mâmâc sipirickeniŋte iŋuc eeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme no taha bapa â ŋic ŋokac ʒi sasawa ʒiŋuc jazapo, “Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Porofetefâc‐ŋeŋic findaŋdâŋ kecʒiŋuc ŋazaeŋgopieŋ jaŋere dâŋ mi mananʒepieŋ, ‘Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ taha ufuŋ‐ticnere râqâc wiac i dameŋ mi ʒoraha Babe haeonec risie wareocmu,’ findaŋdâŋ i burec ehuc ŋazaeŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Ŋoŋe dâŋjeŋic mi manahuc Babe ŋicwofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnenʒepieŋ, iŋuc erâ sâcne juniŋmu; hae ʒi wemocte sesutac fuarâ foocte muŋgopieŋ?
Jaŋe porofete fârine moc juŋgopieŋko â Wofuŋ nore dâŋ fojarekacko ine Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ no mu wâwâsic enarepie mupe nore taha ufuŋko mecne, Juda ŋicwofuŋte ficko mecne â Jerusalem haeo mecne râqâc wiac nâfocne fokac i Babe haeo mi baranʒepieŋ.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ no wâtuŋ mecne, râqâc sâko â ŋeŋe wiac‐ticne mecne, erâ taha ufuŋte wâcwiac ʒanʒaŋne hae ʒira fokac, irec dâŋ mukopac.
Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza e Jojakimte ŋokâ, Judare ŋicwofuŋ Jekonia erâ Judare â Jerusalemte ŋic fekicne sasawa Jerusalem haeonec Babe haeo bacjopa rawec dameŋ ira beheme fowec.
Irec Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu no taha ufuŋko â Juda ŋicwofuŋ ere ficko erâ Jerusalem haeo râqâc wiac ʒanʒaŋne fokac irec ʒiŋuc mukopac hâcne:
Wiac i Babe haeo baranʒepieŋ, eme ira foha juku dameŋ moc maickeme no irec manasurâ mupe hae mâreŋ ʒira mocwâc risiezejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Eme jara dameŋ ijaha, Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia e gie‐ticne fuŋkerâ bahuc juhame mosa 4 tarame Aʒurure ŋokâ, porofete Hanania e Gibeoŋ haeoneczi Wofuŋte ufuŋko taha bapa â ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋere maio dâŋ ʒiŋuc nazawec:
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu eki ʒiŋuc mukac: No Babe ŋicwofuŋ e tagi‐ticne fai‐ŋeŋicko râewec i ŋowac ro behepemu.
Jara jajahec mi taraha Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza e Wofuŋte ufuŋkonec râqâc wiac hae ʒirecnec Babe haeo barawec i mupe ʒira mocwâc risie warezejec.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, Jojakimte ŋokâ Juda ŋicwofuŋ Jekonia e â Juda mâreŋkoneo ŋic Babe haeo bacjopa rakicne sasawa jaŋe wâc mâmâc jowac‐jopape hae mâreŋ ʒira risie‐fâreniŋmu, no Babe ŋicwofuŋ e tagi‐ticne fai‐ŋeŋicko râewec i ŋowac ro behec epemu hâcne, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Eme porofete Jeremia e porofete Hanania â taha bapa erâ ŋic ŋokac sasawa Wofuŋte ufuŋko domambiŋ jaŋere maio dâŋ âzâcnewec.
Ehuc muwec: “Jâmbomac, Wofuŋ e iŋuc ezejec! Go findaŋdâŋ mumec irec fârine Wofuŋzi bâfuazejec, ehuc mume ufuŋ‐ticnere râqâc wiac mecne â kâpâcwâru ŋic sasawa mecne Babe haeonec ʒira risie warenʒepieŋ.
Mâc gore maio â ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋere maio dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mufuape manazemec:
Porofete gâcne, go â no nâhâc mi fuarâ juhapere mâmâc jaha fuŋkerâ juwefumbiŋ jaŋe mâreŋ bocjaha â ŋicguru sâko ŋicwofuŋhec jaŋere findaŋdâŋ muhuc ʒikare â rorocte â huc hâmocte dâŋ mumbiŋ.
Wamare findaŋdâŋ muhuc jukac porofete e jâmbomac Wofuŋzi soreme mukac me weniŋuc, irec fuŋne i findaŋ‐ticnere fârine fuame sawa mana tarazo.”
Eme porofete Hanania e Jeremia kioŋ‐ticne upenaonec jâoc rorâ qazuwec.
Qazurâ ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋere maio kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Jara jajahec mi taraha ine Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza ere tagi ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere faio fokac i jowac ro behec epemu.” Jeremia eki ine mâc behec‐joparâ rawec.
Eme porofete Hanania e Jeremia kioŋ‐ticne upenaonec jâoc rorâ qazuwec, dameŋ irec faicnao Wofuŋte dâŋ Jeremiarao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Go rarâ Hanania âzâcnec, ‘Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Go kioŋ jâczi bakicne qazu behec emeŋ, noni ine irec okacne aeŋzi kioŋ i bâfuapemu.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac hâcne: No ŋicne ŋicne ʒi sasawa jaŋere faio aeŋ tagi râepe feocmu, eme Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza ere kiŋaŋ qahuc junʒepieŋ; erâ jaŋe sawa mâcne, kâte qowi jaŋe wâc ere meo qikiŋ‐jopakopac.’”
Eme porofete Jeremia e Hanania ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Hanania, go manac, Wofuŋ e go mi sorecguwec, go ine ŋic ŋokac keci jaŋe eatuc‐jopatec burecko roweckeeŋgopieŋ.
Irec Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Manakic, no mâreŋkonec bârâriecgupemu, go dâŋgezi qafeŋ‐jopatec Wofuŋ no râsi enarembiŋte jara ʒijaha hâmozemec.’” Eme porofete Hanania e jara ijaha mosa namba 7 ira hâmowec.
<range>
Porofete Jeremia e Jerusalem haeo ŋehuc soŋaŋ micne kâpâcwâru bacjopa rakicne irec ʒanʒaŋne erâ taha bapa â porofete â ŋic ŋokac sasawa, Nebukanezazi Jerusalem haeonec Babe haeo bacjopa rawec jaŋe papiarae‐jarewec irec dâŋ ʒine hâcne.
Ine ŋicwofuŋ Jekonia â neŋgoc‐ticne mecne, kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne erâ Juda mâreŋkonec â Jerusalem haeonec ŋic fekicne jaŋe mecne, erâ fic bapa â aeŋzi wiac bapa ŋic jaŋe mâmâc Jerusalem haeonec bacjopa rakicne, dameŋ irec faicnao papia râeme rawec.
Papia i Safaŋte ŋokâ Elasa â Hilikiare ŋokâ Gemaria jahe ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia eki Babe haeo ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza erao sorec‐jofame barapic.
Papiare dâŋ ine kecʒiŋuc: “Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e Jerusalem haeonec Babe haeo bacjopa rakicne jaŋe ʒiŋuc jaza‐fârekac:
‘Ŋoŋe fic barâ maŋnao juju fofo enʒepieŋ, erâ nânâ gie bâra fârine fuame nânʒepieŋ!
Ŋoŋe ŋokac rocjoparâ motec bâfuac‐jopanʒepieŋ, erâ ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic ŋokac jarenʒepieŋ â otâfâc‐ŋeŋic ŋicko râec‐jopanʒepieŋ; eme jaŋe naru motec rocjopapie ŋoŋe mâreŋ ira fua sawec epie ʒare‐ŋeŋic mi wahazejec.
Ŋoŋe hae mâreŋ jowac‐ŋopa rapo ira wama foocte giene banʒepieŋ, erâ hae mâreŋ irec erâ Wofuŋ no numu‐narenʒepieŋ; mâreŋ ira wama foha ŋoŋe wama faio jaha juhâmoniŋmu hâcne.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Porofete me findaŋdâŋ mumufâc‐ŋeŋic ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe eatuc‐ŋopazo epie mi mana‐jarenʒepieŋ, ehuc guŋ manaeŋgopieŋzi irec dâŋ mupie hazec mi râenʒepieŋ wâc.
Jaŋe nore ʒâŋeo âke hotahuc findaŋdâŋ ŋazapie burec eekac hâcne, no jaŋe moc mi sorec‐jopapo, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.’”
Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Babe hae jara dameŋ 70 taracneme iqic‐ŋopapemu. Eme mumupaŋ dâŋ biaŋne fokac i fârinehec eocte hae mâreŋ ʒira jowac‐ŋopape risie wareniŋmu.
No ŋoŋere dâŋ weniŋuc mana biric eekopac i mana‐jâmbâŋkekopac, wamare dâŋ hâcne, sisipiricte dâŋ aricne; ine juju worickehuc jueŋgopieŋ i ŋarepemurâ iŋuc eekopac, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme ŋoŋe wira wâwâsic enarepie mana‐ŋarepemu.
Ŋoŋe wira basac enareku bâfuacnuniŋmu ine maŋ hâcbuc jaha wira basac enarepie
mana‐ŋarepe bâfuacnuniŋmu hâcne. Eme no kâpâcwâruonec batarac‐ŋopahuc mâreŋ sâc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐ŋopapo irecnec ro nusec eŋarerâ jowac‐ŋopape hae mâreŋ beherâ raniŋte mupo ijaha mocwâc risie warenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
“Ŋoŋe ine mueŋgopieŋ, ‘Wofuŋ e Babe haeo porofete bâfuac‐jopame junâreŋgopieŋ.’
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ e ŋicwofuŋ Dawidire eri ŋeŋeo ŋekac ere dâŋ mecne, â ŋic ŋokac hae ʒirec maŋnao jufâreŋgopieŋ, qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic kâpâcwâruo mi bacjopa rakicne, jaŋere dâŋ mâmâc bajukac.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Jâmbomac, no mupe ʒika â nânâre hâhâmo erâ huc hâmoc fua‐jarezejec, ehame jâmbo hândâŋne sâqorekicne ŋiczi mocwâc mi nânâne irec sâc enʒepieŋ.
Eme ʒika â roroc erâ huc hâmoc izi jâpec‐jopame mâreŋte ŋicguru sasawazi honec‐joparâ hâwic‐jopaocmu; ŋicne ŋicne ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko bâtâtiec‐jopapo jaŋe jaŋerao sâc hehuc sâwecdâŋ muniŋmu â bipic tatara ejareocmu, ehame mu ruruc â mu âkebic ejareniŋmu.
I dâŋnane mana rereŋ moc mi embiŋte iŋuc fua‐jareocmu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. No dameŋ sâc kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane, porofete hâcne, ŋoŋerao sorec‐jopape fâmbiŋ, ŋoŋe ine sifu mi manambiŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Kâpâcwâru ŋic mupe Jerusalemkonec Babe haeo bacjopa rakicne ŋoŋe sasawa Wofuŋ nore dâŋ mananʒepieŋ.’
“Kolajare ŋokâ Ahaba erâ Masejare ŋokâ Zedekia jahe Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere ʒâŋeo âke hotahuc findaŋdâŋ burecne ŋazaekopirecte Israere Anutuzi jahere ʒiŋuc mukac: Manaŋgopieŋ, no Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza ere meo râec‐jofape ʒâŋe fai‐ŋeŋicko qâhâmoc‐jofazejec.
Eme Judare ŋicfâc sasawa Babe haeo bacjopa rakicne jaŋe jahere qâqiŋ qahuc sâwecdâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc juniŋmu: ‘Wofuŋzi mume Zedekia â Ahaba fua‐jactewec sâc ijaha go fua‐garezejec, jahe Babe ŋicwofuŋzi ʒocko rikec‐jofame hâmopic hâcne.’
Jahe Israe ŋondeŋko sindaŋ ehuc âgofâc‐jekic jaŋere ŋokac jaŋehec boe sau ejupirec, ehuc no mi mutâcne‐jactehape nore ʒâŋeo âke hotahuc burecdâŋ muromacke jupirec. No i manakopaczi mutaniŋkekopac, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Semaja Nehelam haeonec e ine ʒiŋuc âzâcnezemec:
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu eki kecʒiŋuc mukac: Go gahacne maŋte Jerusalemte ŋic ŋokac sasawa â Masejare ŋokâ, taha bapa Zefania hâcne, erâ taha bapa sasawa jaŋerao papia kecʒiŋuc râetec rawec:
‘Wofuŋ e taha bapa Jojada ere okacne taha bapa râecguwec, i Wofuŋte ufuŋko maŋjeŋic sifuckekicnezi findaŋdâŋ burecne mueŋgopieŋ jaŋere rucjari bahuc jâc fifitacko â aeŋ niŋgiŋko râec‐jopacmurâ iŋuc ewec.
Eme ʒi wemocte Anatoti haeonec Jeremiazi ŋoŋerao findaŋdâŋ muhuc juekac e aka mi hecnekomec?
Eki hâcne papia moc kecʒiŋuc râe‐nâreme Babe haeo ware fisiwec i: “Kâpâcwâru dameŋ‐ŋeŋic i ʒoricne fokac, irec fic barâ maŋnao juju fofo enʒepieŋ, erâ nânâ gie bapie fârine fuame nâhuc junʒepieŋ.” ’”
Taha bapa Zefania eki ine papia porofete Jeremia wosecnewec.
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ Jeremiarao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Kâpâcwâru ŋic sasawa dâŋ ʒiŋuc râe‐jaretec razejec, ‘Wofuŋ e Nehelam hae rune Semaja ere dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukac: Semaja e mi sorehape findaŋdâŋ ŋazahuc burecdâŋko roweckeniŋte eatuc‐ŋopawec.
Irec Wofuŋ no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Manaŋgopieŋ, no Nehelam rune Semaja â ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋe irec okacne bazu‐jarepemu. Ɋaricfâcne jaŋeraonec moczi ŋicguru ʒi jaŋere ŋondeŋko moc mi juzejec, ehuc ŋicfâc‐nane jujuhâmo bâfua‐jarepemu i wâc mi honezejec, e ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋ no râsi enareniŋte mu qafeŋ ejarewec irec. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.’”
Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ Jeremiarao fuawec i ʒiŋuc:
Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “No dâŋ gazapo sâc i papia mocko qâreŋke‐fârezemec.
Manakic, dameŋ moc maikeocmu ira Israe â Juda ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe kâpâcwâruonec batarac‐joparâ ine mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic mâreŋ jarepo ira bârisiec‐jopape rauckenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋ e Israere â Judare dâŋ muwec i kecʒiŋuc:
“Hâhâwicte erâ kio owa fuame manakopac, wama aricne, bipic tatara sawa fokac.
Mu wioc erâ honeniŋ, ŋiczi motec rocjopazo eŋgopieŋ me weniŋuc? No wemocte ŋic sasawa jaŋe ŋokac gozi kicjopame eeŋgopieŋ iŋuc ehuc mejeŋic gâjoŋ‐jeŋicko râehapie honec‐jopaekopac, ehame ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic weaŋke‐fârekac?
Jei, dameŋ keci i dameŋ hâhâwicne, iŋucne moc mi fowec, i Jakobore ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋ hâcne; e ine sifu irecnec batarazo.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere dâŋ ʒiŋuc: “Dameŋ ira kecʒiŋuc fuaocmu: No tagi ɋawe‐jeŋickonec jowac ro behec erâ niŋgiŋ‐jeŋic hetâcnepemu, eme jaŋe ŋic jabane jaŋere kiŋaŋ mocwâc mi qanʒepieŋ.
Aricne, jaŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋic no mecne â ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic Dawidi âkendâŋne‐jarepemu e mecne mâmâc kiŋaŋ qanâctenʒepieŋ.
“Kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Jakobo go mi hâwicguzejec, â Israe go mi fâfârezemec. Manakic, no mâreŋ ʒorickonec bataracgupemu, â ɋâricfâcge jaŋe kâpâcwâru mâreŋ‐jeŋickonec batarac‐jopapemu. Eme Jakobozi mâreŋ‐ticnao risierâ sahac mâteŋ ŋezejec, erâ juhâc qâhâmoha moczi moc hâhâwic mi ecnezejec. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
No hâcne baficguzore gohec jupemu; ŋicne ŋicne ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko bâtâtiecgupo jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopapemu, go ine mi bâsirowecgupemu; aricne, sâcge manahuc bâtiŋgupemu, wemocko akicguhuc mi bâtiŋguzapo. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: “Sipiricgukicne i hâhâwicne â wic fogarekac i mi bâbâsomiene.
Moczi moc dâŋge mi dopeckeocmu, wicgere marasiŋ i mi fokac, â mocwâc ɋiɋic qacmu i wâc mi fokac.
Âgofâcge jaŋe sasawa gore nikec‐jopawec, jaŋe gore mu wioc mocwâc mi eeŋgopieŋ; i noni kiŋ bahacge â hehesicge bocjahare râsi egarehuc qa bâtiŋ hâhâwicne egarepo irec.
Go sipiricgukicne â ʒâicge mi oomaene, irec wemocte boc owackekomec? No kiŋ bahacge â hehesicge bocjaha fokacte wiac i egarepo hâcne.
Irec go ɋâcgumbiŋ jaŋe ɋâcjopa‐fârezo wâc, go sipiricgumbiŋ sasawa jaŋe kâpâcwâruo bacjopa razo wâc; mafa wiacge gowac rombiŋ jaŋe wiac‐jeŋic jowac rozo, â wiac fiuc rombiŋ sasawa jaŋere wiac i mupe fiuc roniŋmu jaha.
No mocwâc bâpiaŋguhuc wicge bâsomiepemu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Jaŋe gore ʒiŋuc mumbiŋte: ‘Qaisockekicne’, erâ ‘Zioŋ hâcne hone suŋgiŋ ecnekicne.’”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manaŋgopieŋ, no Jakobo qoruc boze‐ticne ŋehâmoocte mocwâc heɋârepemu, â jufofo hae‐ticne busâqoc manacnepemu, ehame hae i me i ŋeŋetac‐ticnao heɋârehuc banʒepieŋ, â ŋicwofuŋ fic i mârâc ŋeweckoa ŋezejec.
Eme ira mumuteŋ gae â mu gâgâwi irec fânâŋ fuazejec; no basawec‐jopape ʒare‐jeŋic mi wahazejec, no ʒâŋe biŋe bâfua‐jarepe moczi ro waha âte mocwâc mi ejarezejec.
Naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mârâc jaha jumbiŋ sâc ijaha erâ junʒepieŋ, â kikefuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe nore maio qiŋ herâ domanʒepieŋ; bâbâʒâicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe ine sasawa bâtiŋ‐jopapemu.
Ŋicbomboŋ‐jeŋic e jaŋacne guruonec moc fuazejec, â guriŋ bapa‐jeŋic e jaŋacne ŋondeŋkonec jaha; eme no manacnehape mai‐naneo ware fuazejec, me mi manacnehape moczi moc juju‐ticnere manabâc mi ehuc nore maio kosa moc fuazac?
Eme ŋoŋe ŋicfâc‐nane juhapie no Anutu‐ŋeŋic juzepac. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋtaonec mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋnehec, kimbeŋ‐ticne hâcne fuarâ warekac; oorâŋ mânâŋ hâhâwicnezi ŋic hehesicne jaŋere faio waha qaocmu.
Eme Wofuŋ e gie‐ticne mana biric ewec sâc i fârine bâfua‐fâreme sawa kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋzi hâpoocmu. Ŋoŋe irec fuŋne i dameŋ tataranao mana taraniŋmu.
“No dameŋ ira hâcne Israere kikefuŋ birine birine jaŋere Anutu juhape jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane jufârenʒepieŋ.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Israe ŋic jaŋe juju mana mâreŋ‐jeŋicko raniŋte rambiŋ, dameŋ ira ʒikare micko mi fembiŋ, ŋic nâfocne i jaŋe mâreŋ sawao aki anonoc bâfuambiŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋ no taickonec ware fua‐jarehuc mupo: No maŋjauŋ eŋarehuc jupozi jukopac, irec aki anonoc‐nane moc mi sakare‐ŋareekopac.
O ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ Israe! No bâɋârecgupe faharerâ domazemec, go sahacge mocwâc erickezemec, ehuc gae woŋgâŋ eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere birio huzemec.
Samaria tiki mâreŋko waiŋ gie mocwâc sarazemec, eme saraniŋmuzi fârine fuame nânʒepieŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ moc maickeocmu ira Eferaim tiki mâreŋko ruc bapa jaŋere wiwira kecʒiŋuc fuaocmu: ‘Ajoc, Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋectao Zioŋko fenaŋ!’”
Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Jakobo ʒeri bubiaŋ ecneniŋ, â ŋicne ŋicne micne‐jeŋic kiwac qawac ecneniŋ! Hahaŋne bahuc ʒiŋuc muhuc muteŋkeniŋ, ‘Wofuŋ e ŋicfâcne jaŋe bafic‐jopawec, Israe ŋic ʒanʒaŋne jaŋe hâcne.’
Manaŋgopieŋ, no faic mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa warepemu, â mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaonec ro nusec ejarepemu, erâ ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko tiŋtuŋ, kike demba, kiwechec â kogochec juŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc; eme jaŋe ŋic guru sâkozi ʒira risie warenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe kiohuc risieniŋmu, eme noni bâmiriŋ‐jopahuc jowac‐jopahape wareniŋmu; ehuc wâneŋ hatao mi fâfâc‐jopaha opâo fisinʒepieŋ; no Israe mamac ecnehuc jahape Eferaim e mârâc ŋokâ‐nane jukac hâcne.
“Ŋicne ŋicne ŋoŋe Wofuŋ nore dâŋ mananiŋ, erâ nucne nucne taicko forakac ira musaweniŋ: ‘Israe bâtâtiec‐jopapo no ro nusec erâ lama soŋaŋzi lamafâcne soŋaŋ‐jopaekac irec sâc hone maiŋ ejarepemu.’
Wofuŋ no Jakobo firuepo, ehuc tâpiri‐ticne sirickehuc jukac ere meonec batarapo hâcne.
Jaŋe fisirâ Zioŋ tikio ʒeri gae heniŋmu, ehuc Wofuŋ noraonec taha wiac kecʒiŋucte mana ʒiziweniŋmu: Padi jacgoŋ, waiŋ, wokemaŋ, lama motecne â bulimakao; eme juju‐jeŋic i hoezi jufu gie bâgunuckeekac irec sâc ehame nânâ opâre mocwâc mi hâmoniŋmu.
Iŋuc fuame ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ jaŋe gae wohuc bubiaŋ mananiŋmu, erâ ŋic socɋâri â ŋicqizec jaŋe ʒeri eniŋmu. No ki mamakuc‐jeŋic hetikiepe ʒeri fuazejec, â bâmiriŋ‐jopahuc busâqoc irec okacne bubiaŋ qajarepemu.
No taha bapa mâriri tahac‐jopape bubiaŋ faio junʒepieŋ, â ŋicfâc‐nane jauŋ bacjopape gapec‐jopazejec. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Rama haeo ojowa, ki uu â mu mamakuc sâko fuakac. Rahezi ɋiefâcne jaŋere kiokac; ɋiefâcne jaŋere erâ bâmiriŋkeniŋte eipieŋgopieŋ, wiac omae‐fârembiŋte hâcne.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Go ojowa â ki uu behetec ʒâŋeucge kereŋkezejec; manakic, ʒâic giegere furine i fokac, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Jaŋe râsi jaŋere mâreŋkonec risie wareniŋmu.
Ɋâricfâcge jaŋe juju biaŋne fua‐jareocmu, â ŋokâfâcge jaŋe mame sâko hae‐jeŋicko mocwâc risieniŋmu hâcne. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
No Eferaimzi mu mamakuc ehuc mume manapo, ‘Go bâtiŋnumeŋ, eme no bulimakao râŋgeŋne iŋucne bâbâtiŋte fuŋne manapo. Go Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane jukicte risiepemurâ mana‐naretec maŋnane bârisiezepac.
No go behecgurâ busâqoc manapo, ehuc fuŋne‐nane mana tararâ mimiehuc amec‐nane bofackepo. No qurutuarâ maŋnane omaekac, no socɋâri juhuc wiac miminehec bâfuapo irec okacne fua‐narekac hâcne.’
Eferaim e ŋokâ biaŋ‐nane â joroc‐nane mi jukac me? No râsi ecnehuc dâŋticne muekopac sâc sifu ere mocwâc manasuekopac hâcne; irec maŋnanezi ere ecneekac, no busâqoc manacnezore enarekac. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Go qânâzi ma âkendâŋnehuc hatare wiac gâcne râe razemec, ehuc hata rameŋ i hone dendeŋnec! Israe ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ go risiec, hae wiacge ŋerakac ira risie warezemec!
Israe ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ, go râpecnumeŋzi wemocte maŋjahec boc ekomec? Manakic, Wofuŋ no mâreŋko mâsi ɋâricne moc bâfuapemu, ine ʒiŋuc: Ŋokaczi ŋic ŋezickehuc juocmu.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “No kâpâcwâruonec batarac‐jopapemu dameŋ ira Juda mâreŋko â hae sâko‐ticne ŋerakacko dâŋ ʒiŋuc mocwâc muniŋmu: ‘O tiŋnere ŋeŋe hae â tiri tiki, Wofuŋzi jambuŋguzejec!’
Eme Juda hae sâko‐ticne sasawa jaŋe irec maŋnao jufârenʒepieŋ, hesarac ŋic â lama bulimakao bajuhuc mâreŋ râreckeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc.
No hâcne rokawekicne jaŋe gumeqiŋ‐jopapemu â betaŋkekicne jaŋe bâgunuc‐jopape âke mâteŋ‐jopa‐fârezejec.”
Iŋuc nazahame guŋkonec ɋârerâ ʒâŋe fitâcnepo, ehuc guŋte aŋac manapo.
Wofuŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac: “Manakic, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira Israe kikefuŋ â Juda kikefuŋ jambuŋ‐jopape ŋic mecne qowi mecne ukichec erâ fua sawec enʒepieŋ.
Eme qâfiec‐jopazore â heropiec‐jopazore â sipiric‐jopazore â bâsirowec‐jopazore erâ bâʒâic‐jopazore ruc bajarehuc jupo irec sâc jaha heɋârec‐jopazore â sarac‐jopazore hone soŋaŋ ejarehuc jupemu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Dameŋ ira ʒiŋuc mocwâc mi muniŋmu: ‘Mimiŋne jaŋe waiŋ hândâŋ ʒaʒacne nâjumbieŋte ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere micsiec ariweekac.’
Aricne, ŋic sasawa jaŋe jaŋacne kiŋte erâ hâmoniŋmu, â waiŋ hândâŋ ʒaʒacne nâniŋmu sâc micsiec‐jeŋic ariweocmu.”
Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira noni Israe kikefuŋ â Juda kikefuŋ jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ɋâricne moc bâfuapemu.
No mârâc jaha mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopapemurâ mejeŋicko rohuc jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo, ʒâʒâfic iŋucne mâcne. Ʒâʒâfic i rujeŋic no juipiehape sifu mana suacnuhuc bâtâcnembiŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme dameŋ mukicne i maickeme Israe kikefuŋ jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epemu ine kecʒiŋuc: No sâcmutâc dâŋnane maŋjeŋicko râepe huocmu, erâ buhândâŋ‐jeŋicko qâreŋkepe foocmu, eme no Anutu‐jeŋic jupemu, â jaŋe kikefuŋfâc‐nane juniŋmu. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme ŋic moczi moc âgofâcne me qomâfâcne jaŋehec ʒiŋuc muhuc qaqazu gie mocwâc mi baniŋmu: ‘Wofuŋte fuŋne mananiŋ!’ Mâcne, jaŋe wahakicnezi mecne fekicnezi mecne mâmâc manacnu‐fâreniŋmu. Fuŋne ʒiŋucte manacnuniŋmu: No kiŋjeŋic behe‐jarepemu, ehuc sindaŋ‐jeŋicte mocwâc mi manasupemu. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Ʒoaŋzi ʒoaŋ sâc tamaeocte muekac, â mosa bâpiŋ ŋafe sâc tamaeniŋte mutâcne‐jareekac, â hâweczi qiriŋ qame siri‐ticne fânâŋkeocte muekac ʒâŋe‐ticne Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki hâcne ʒiŋuc mukac:
“Mumutâc sanaŋ i hâcne nore maio moc arictac eocmuo ine Israere ɋâricfâc jaŋe nore maio ŋicguru moc buc erâ juju i iŋuc jaha arictac jâmbâŋ eocmu. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Faic sambâŋte sâc bapane fome muzac me mâreŋte hobeteŋne duŋ ira fokac i mana gufuc eene ezac ine no Israe ɋâricfâcne jaŋe wiac ewefuhuc jumbiŋ irec erâ wâc behec‐jopa‐fârezapo. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira Wofuŋ nore hae sâko i Hananele ere fic hâŋ bafekicne irecnec fuŋkerâ heɋâre ware raku Tuturuŋ Motâc sâko domakac ira bataraniŋmu.
Ehame sâc meda ine ʒuhuckerâ râepie dândâŋne raku Garebe tikio fisizejec, erâ ira ŋehasickerâ Goaopec razejec. Eme ŋic qâŋɋâŋ â ʒafe wâneŋ â hae mâreŋ foraku Kidoroŋ opâo mickekac erâ ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec Becâsic Motâc irec tuturuŋko tarakac i sasawa Wofuŋ nore biŋe ehuc tiri fozejec. Eme sisipiric me ima bapa i ira mocwâc mi fua‐jâmbâŋkezejec.”
<range>
Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia e ŋicwofuŋ juha jara 10 ewec, â Nebukaneza e ŋicwofuŋ juha jara 18 eme Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ Jeremiarao fuawec ʒine hâcne.
Dameŋ ira Babe ŋicwofuŋ momorifâc‐ticne jaŋe Jerusalem hae somâ bambiŋ, ehame Jeremia e Juda ŋicwofuŋte hae ʒoŋao momori jaŋe soŋaŋ jumbiŋko kâpâcwâruo ŋewec.
Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia eki ʒiŋuc muhuc kâpâcwâru barâ ira râeme ŋewec hâcne: “Go wemocte findaŋdâŋ ʒiŋuc mumeŋ: ‘Wofuŋzi mukac: Manaŋgopieŋ, no hae ʒi Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere meo râepe rauckezejec.
Eme Juda ŋicwofuŋ e Kaldea jaŋe sâcne mi wise‐jareocmu, aricne, e Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere meo râepe fejâmbâŋkeocmu, eme jahe nazaŋ gazaŋ ehuc hohone ezepirec.
Eme e Zedekia Babe haeo baraocmu, ira juhame iqickezepac. Ŋoŋe Kaldea ŋic jaŋehec ʒika qahuc sâcne mi sasaŋkeniŋmu. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.’”
Eme Jeremiazi muwec: “Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
Manakic, mamac wârâŋge Salum ere ŋokâ Hanamelezi gorao fisirâ muocmu, ‘Go mâreŋ‐nane Anatoti haeo fokac i furine bac; gore ʒâŋe bâbâni fokacte furine bacmurâ sâcmutâczi mana‐garekac.’
Eme Wofuŋzi muwec irec sâcko fuarâ mamac wârâŋ‐nanere ŋokâ Hanamele e momori jaŋere hae ʒoŋao fisirâ nazawec: ‘Benjamiŋ mâreŋko Anatoti hae ira mâreŋ‐nane fokac i furine bac; goki hâcne furine barâ rauckecmurâ sâmutâczi mana‐garekac; gore biŋe eocte furine bac me!’ Iŋuc mume mana tarapo: Wofuŋte dâŋ ine hâcne.
“Eme no mamac wârâŋ‐nanere ŋokâ Hanamele eraonec Anatoti haeo mâreŋ fowec i rorâ furine siliwa moneŋ 17 râcnepo.
Ehuc furi bapare papia qâreŋkerâ maqâreŋ râerâ ŋic gâcne ejarepe honehapie moneŋ i woserâ râcnepo.
Izi ine furi bapare papia basanaŋkekicne â mi basanaŋkekicne i mâmâc rocjofapo.
Erâ mamac wârâŋ‐nanere ŋokâ Hanamele ere maio mecne â papiao ʒâŋe‐jeŋic râembiŋ ŋic i jaŋere maio mecne, erâ Judaŋic gâcne momori jaŋere sacmaŋko ŋefârembiŋ jaŋere maio mâmâc Masejare ŋosa, Neriare ŋokâ Baruku e hâcne râcnepo.
Ehuc mai‐jeŋicko domahuc Baruku ʒiŋuc mutâcnecnepo:
‘Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: Go papia ʒi, furi bapare papia basanaŋkekicne â mi basanaŋkekicne i rorâ hapec mocko râetec hurâ dameŋ ʒora fozejec.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: Fic mecne, mâreŋ mecne, waiŋ gie mecne i mâreŋ ʒira mocwâc furine bahuc juzo.’”
Eme furi bapare papia i Neriare ŋokâ Baruku râcnerâ Wofuŋtao ʒiŋuc muhuc numupo:
“O Wofuŋ Anutu, sambâŋ â mâreŋ i goki hâcne tâpiri sâkogezi â mesanaŋgezi bâfuac‐jofameŋ. Go wiac moc ezo murâ mi eipiekic.
Go ŋic tauseŋne tauseŋne maŋzi ʒâfic‐jopahuc juekic, â mamac jaŋere kiŋtofa i ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere faio gurucke rahuc juekic. O Anutu sâko tâpiri rune, go Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, ʒâŋege iŋuc hâcne.
Mamana birige kâcɋene sâko â eebapage i tâpirinehec, ʒâŋegezi ŋic ʒeŋgoma hata‐jeŋic honeekic, ehuc ŋicne ŋicne ru sâc hata raeŋgopieŋ irec sâcko okacne bazu‐jareekic.
Go Aigita mâreŋko mâsi â wiac ʒâŋe furu bahuc jumeŋ, erâ Israe â ŋic gâcne jaŋerao dameŋ ʒiŋuczia bahuc juekic jaha; ehuc ʒâŋe biŋege bâfuameŋ i miŋecgac tâtâc fokac wâc.
Go Israe ŋicfâcge jaŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec mâsi â wiac ʒâŋe furu bahuc tâpiri â mesanaŋge sicnerâ wiac hâhâwicne sâko bâfuahuc jowac‐jopatec wahambiŋ.
Ehame mâreŋ ʒi mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic jarecmurâ mupaŋkemeŋ i hâcne jaremeŋ; mâreŋ moc susu â baŋac fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeekac hâcne.
Eme jaŋe raʒirâ rauckehuc gore dâŋ mana rereŋ mi ejumbieŋ, â sâcmutâc dâŋgere sâcko wâc mi jujumbieŋ, erâ goki wiac eniŋte mutâcne‐jaremeŋ i qatara‐fâre jumbieŋ jaha; iŋuc epie mutec ʒârâ hâriŋ sasawa ʒi fai‐jeŋicko fewec hâcne.
Manakic, hae roniŋte somâre ʒae i âke suepie biac hae sac maŋfuŋko ware ŋekac, ehame ʒika â nânâ babasa â huc hâmoc fokacte hae i biac somâ bapa Kaldea ŋic jaŋere meo feocmu. Goki dâŋ mumeŋ i fâricnehec ewec hâcne, go gahac honekic i!
O Wofuŋ Anutu, go ine hae i Kaldea ŋic jaŋere meo fezo eha sifu ʒiŋuc nazameŋ: ‘Go ŋic gâcne rocjopatec honehapie mâreŋ moneŋzi furine bazemec.’”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ Jeremiarao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Manakic, Wofuŋ noni hâcne wiac jujune sasawa irec Anutu, no wiac mocte moc mi eipiepemu.
Irec no hae ʒi Kaldea ŋic jaŋere meo, â Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza ere meo râepe ro rauc ezejec.
Kaldea ŋic jaŋe hae ʒi somâ baeŋgopieŋzi maŋnao wefurâ turuŋkepie ʒazejec, erâ bâiŋnuniŋte ficbupu gâcne wâwâneŋ bakicne irec faio Baali nemu hosâc âsu rikecne jumbieŋ â waiŋ wiac nemu gâcne jaŋere taha muhuc hoŋke‐jare jumbieŋ fic i mâmâc ʒazejec.
Israe ŋic â Judaŋic jaŋe ɋie‐jeŋickonecteaŋ wiac hone aŋac mi ecneekopac i hâcne ejumbieŋ; Israe ŋic jaŋe hâcne dameŋ sâc eebapa‐jeŋiczi bâiŋnuhuc jumbiŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Hae ʒi bambiŋ dameŋ ira rune jaŋe fuŋkerâ bâiŋnuhuc juwefukuhapie kimbeŋ â aaric mana‐jarehuc jupozi jukopac, irec hae i ʒâŋe mai‐naneonec bârâriepemu.
I Israe ŋic â Judaŋic jaŋe jaŋac mecne, ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic mecne, fekicnefâc‐jeŋic mecne, taha bapa â porofetefâc‐jeŋic mecne, Juda mâreŋ rune mecne, erâ Jerusalem ŋecjucfâcticne mecne, jaŋe mâmâc bâiŋnuhuc hehesic bâfua‐fârembiŋte iŋuc epemu.
Jaŋe maicnurâ mâcne, râpecnurâ domambiŋ, ehuc dameŋ sâc dâŋ jaza qazuc ehuc jupo i sifu mi manambiŋ â bâbâtiŋte takic‐jopawec wâc.
Jaŋe nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic mamakâcne i ine taha ufuŋ nore ʒâŋe fokac i gâc hecneniŋte ira baferâ âkendâŋ‐jopambiŋ.
Jaŋe naru motecfâc‐jeŋic Moleke nemu ere biŋe qahuc rikec‐jopaniŋte Beŋ‐Hinom wâneŋko Baali nemu ere bâzi ririke toma bambiŋ. No ine wiac iŋucne moc mi mutâcne‐jarepo â jaŋe wiac mamakâcne iŋucne ehuc Juda eatuckepie sâqocne baocte moc mi manasupo.
“‘Hae ʒi ʒika â roroc â huc hâmoczi qakume Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere meo feocmu’, ŋoŋe iŋuc mueŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ Israere Anutu noni ine hae irec dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukopac:
Manakic, no aaric â kimbeŋ â mamana sâqoc mâretec mana‐jarehuc mâreŋ sâc bâtâtiec‐jopapo irecnec mocwâc ro nusec ejarerâ jowac‐jopape hae mâreŋ ʒira risierâ wamao junʒepieŋ.
Eme jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane juhapie no Anutu‐jeŋic juzepac.
Eme no maŋ mamana mocjaha â juju hata mocjaha tahac‐jopape dameŋ sâc no araŋ banarehuc junʒepieŋ, i jaŋe jaŋacne â ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic juhâc qâhâmoniŋte iŋuc ejarepemu.
Erâ no jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic fofo sanaŋ epemu, ehuc ehâmo‐jarepemurâ moc mi râpec‐jopazepac, â no araŋ babanare irec fuŋne qazu‐jarepe jaŋe maŋzi manahuc no wâc mi râpecnunʒepieŋ.
Aricne, no hone aŋac ejarehuc ehâmo‐jarepemu, ehuc maŋ â qâqâtâc‐nane jaŋerao furu jaha râepe foha mâreŋ ʒira jâmbomacko sarac‐jopapemu.”
Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: “No ŋicguru ʒi jaŋere faio ʒârâ hâriŋ sâko hâcne râepe fewec, iŋuc jaha wiac biaŋne mupaŋke‐jarekopac sâc i tahac‐jopa‐fârepemu.
Eme mâreŋte fuŋne ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ, ŋic â qowi tâmiric tuhutac fokac, erâ Kaldea ŋic jaŋere meo fewec, ira hâcne mâreŋ mocwâc furine bazo.
Moneŋzi mâreŋ furine baniŋmu, ehuc furi bapare papia qâreŋkerâ ŋic gâcne ejarepie ware honehapie basanaŋkeniŋmu. Benjamiŋ mâreŋko â Jerusalem rârec rârec â Juda hae ŋerakac â tiki mâreŋ â wâneŋko â Negebe mâreŋko hae ŋerakac ira iŋuc hâcne eniŋmu; no busâqoc faio juju‐jeŋic i hetikiepe bubiaŋ faio juju‐jeŋic fuaocmu irec. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Eme Jeremia e momori jaŋere sacmaŋko niŋgiŋko jaha juhame Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ mocwâc fuacneme arec jajahec ewec, ine kecʒiŋuc:
“Wiacte wiac bâfua‐fâreekac â fua taniŋkeocte manatâc qâtâc eekac, ʒâŋene Wofuŋ, eki hâcne ʒiŋuc mukac:
Go wira basac enaretec micgao ropemu, ehuc wiac qeŋ bipinehec â qame hukicne, goki kâuc baekic i hâcne gaza gowatuc epemu.
Hae kecʒirec fic â Juda ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere fic â somâre ʒae wiac ima qahuc râsi sanaŋke‐jarenʒepeneŋ muhuc heropiembiŋ, fic irec Wofuŋ Israere Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac:
No hehesic‐jeŋic sasawa irec erâ hae ʒi ʒâŋe mai‐nane bâsoŋkecnehuc aaricko â kimbeŋko jopapo ŋic i jaŋere qâŋɋâŋ i Kaldea ŋic jaŋe ware ʒika qahuc fic i hefuseniŋmu.
Manakic, no hae i heɋârerâ bâpiaŋkepemu, ehuc rune jaŋe wama fofo dunduŋ â fofo sanaŋ bâfua‐jarepemu.
Erâ Juda â Israe ŋic busâqoc faio juju‐jeŋic i hetikiepe bubiaŋ faio juju‐jeŋic fua‐jareocmu, ehame bâpiaŋ‐jopapemu.
Jaŋe sâqocne bahuc bunaneo bambiŋ irec kiŋ bârâriehuc baɋaɋac‐jopapemu, â sindaŋ ehuc râpecnumbiŋ irec kiŋ bahac i bâtâmire‐jare‐fârepemu.
Eme Jerusalem hae i wiac biaŋne sasawa ecnepe mâreŋko ŋicne ŋicne mananiŋmu sâc jaŋere maio mumuteŋ‐nane â aŋac‐nane â ʒeri‐nane â ʒâŋe rara biaŋ‐nane ezejec. Eme wiac biaŋne â wama bâfuacne‐fârepe honerâ bipic tatara ejareha ɋarac ɋarac qanʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Hae mâreŋ ʒira, ŋoŋe ŋic â qowi tâmiric tuhutac fokac ira wiac kecʒiŋucte fânâŋ mocwâc fuame mananʒepieŋ:
Aŋac ʒeri â daŋge bubiaŋ â ŋic ŋokac biŋe qaqac eejare; erâ Wofuŋte ufuŋko daŋge taha bafehuc hahaŋne barâ ʒiŋuc muniŋmu, jaŋere ʒeri fânâŋ mâmâc: ‘Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e mumbiaŋkeniŋ! Wofuŋ e uruc jauŋ‐ticnehec hâcne, â aki anonoc‐ticne fofo sanaŋ foocmu!’ No mâreŋ ʒira busâqoc faio juju fokac i hetikiepe mârâc bubiaŋ faio juju fowec irec sâc fuarâ fozejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Mâreŋ ʒi ŋic â qowi tâmiric tuhutac fokac erâ hae‐ticne ŋerakac ira mâreŋ kecɋaŋnehec mocwâc fuazejec, eme lama soŋaŋ jaŋe ira lamafâc‐jeŋic ejarepie waha fomananʒepieŋ.
Tiki mâreŋko me wâneŋko me Negebe mâreŋko me Benjamiŋ mâreŋko me Jerusalem rârec rârec me Juda mâreŋko hae ŋerakac ira lama wosec‐jopaekaczi soŋaŋ‐jopahame mocwâc sicne fotâc enʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira Israe â Juda kikefuŋ jaŋere mumupaŋ dâŋbiaŋ mupo i fârio qaocmu.
Ehame ʒoaŋ dameŋ ira mupe Dawidire oso gitecne tiŋne moc fuazejec, eme eki hâcne mâreŋko gie‐ticne mumutiŋ dâŋ â tiŋnere sâcko bahuc juzejec.
Dameŋ ira Juda bafickezo â Jerusalemko wama foocmu, ehame hae irec ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Wofuŋ e tiŋne‐nâŋec.’”
Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: “Israe kikefuŋte eri ŋeŋeo ŋic babasa i Dawidirao mi fuazejec.
Eme ŋic moc dameŋ sâc nore maio qowi bâzi rikeocte me taha bâzi rikeme hosâc‐ticne feocte me bâzire qowi qa hezuc eocte ŋic babasa i Lewire taha bapafâc jaŋerao mi fuazejec.”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ Jeremiarao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
