“Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: No ŋafe â ʒoaŋ jahehec ʒâʒâfic epo i ŋoŋe sâcne hetâcnepie ŋafe furec sâckoa mocwâc mi eocmuo
ine kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Dawidi ehec ʒâʒâfic epo i iŋuc jaha sâcne hetâcnezo, eme ŋokâ‐ticne moc mi fuarâ eri ŋeŋe‐ticnao ŋicwofuŋ ŋeocmu, â Lewi guruonec taha bapa, kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐nane jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo i wâc sâcne hetâcnezo.
Sambâŋko bâpiŋ ŋerakac i sâcne mi wowosene â hâwecmecko moŋgeŋ forakac i fiahuc sâcticne sâcne mi mamanane, eme no kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Dawidire ɋâricfâc â Lewire guruonec nore kiŋaŋ qahuc juniŋmu jaŋe basawec‐jopape irec sâc jaha enʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ Jeremiarao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋic keci jaŋe dâŋ muhuc jueŋgopieŋ i moc hone manac ekomec me? Ine ʒiŋuc: ‘Wofuŋ e ŋicguru jajahec bâwosâec‐jofawec i hâcne hone suŋgiŋ ejactekac.’ Jaŋe iŋuc muhuc ŋicfâc‐nane qaisoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, ehuc jaŋere manapie ŋicguru moc buc mocwâc mi juŋgopieŋ ekac.
Irec Wofuŋ no ʒiŋuc mukopac: No ŋafe â ʒoaŋ jahehec ʒâʒâfic epo, erâ sambâŋ â mâreŋ jahere sâcmutâc râepo i moc behepe omaeocmuo
ine Jakobo â kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Dawidi jahere ɋâricfâc jaŋe wâc hone suŋgiŋ ejarepemu. Erâ jaŋere guruonec Abraham â Isaka erâ Jakobo ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ mocwâc mi rowosâec‐jopapemu. No busâqoc faio juju‐jeŋic i hetikiepe bubiaŋ faio juju fua‐jareme aki anonoc ejarepemu hâcne.”
Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza e momori gurufâc‐ticne ʒeŋgoma â mâreŋ sâc ŋicguru ere meo jufârembiŋ erâ ŋicguru gâcne sasawa jaŋehec Jerusalem â hae piticfâc‐ticne furu jaha somâc‐jopambiŋ dameŋ ira Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ Jeremiarao fuawec i kecʒiŋuc:
“Wofuŋ Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: Go ra Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia e dâŋ âzâcnerâ muc, Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Manakic, no hae ʒi Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere meo râepe feme turuŋkeme ʒazejec.
Ehame go ere meonec waharâ sâcne mi wisecmu, aricne, jaŋe rojâmbâŋgurâ ere meo râecgupie fecmu, eme Babe ŋicwofuŋ ehec ʒâŋezi hohonec enicmu â miczi dâŋ nazaŋ gazaŋ enicmu, erâ irec faicnao Babe haeo razemec.’
Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia go ine Wofuŋte dâŋ manac! Wofuŋ e gore ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Go ʒikare nânâ mi ecmu.
Go wamao hâmozemec. Eme apa ŋosafâcge go mi fuarâ juhaŋtec mârâc jaha ŋicwofuŋ juwefumbiŋ jaŋe hâmopie hosâc âsu rike‐jare jumbieŋ iŋuc jaha go rike‐garerâ gore ʒiŋuc muhuc makuc baniŋmu: “Jai, bomboŋ‐nâŋec!” ’ No iŋuc eniŋte mupo hâcne. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Eme porofete Jeremia e dâŋ i sasawa Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia Jerusalem haeo âzâcne‐fârewec.
I Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere momorifâc jaŋe Jerusalem hae â Juda mâreŋte hae nâfocne ŋepic, Lakisa â Aʒeka hâcne biac somâ bacjofahapie iŋuc ewec; Judare hae basanaŋkekicne jaŋeraonec hae i jahe hâcne nâfocne ŋepic.
Ŋicwofuŋ Zekedia e kiŋaŋ qaqa rambaŋko rârâec‐jopa irec dâŋ moc mufua‐jareocte Jerusalem hae rune ʒeŋgoma jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ewec; eme faicnao Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ Jeremiarao fuawec irec binaŋ ʒi.
Ʒiŋuc fuaocte ʒâʒâfic embiŋ: Ŋic sasawa jaŋe Hebiraio kiŋaŋŋic ŋokacfâc‐jeŋic firuec‐jopanʒepieŋ, ehame Judaŋic moczi Judaŋic qomâ‐ticne mocwâc ecneme kiŋaŋ qaqa‐ticne mi juzejec.
Eme ŋic fekicne mecne wahakicne mecne ʒâʒâfic embiŋ jaŋe sasawa dâŋ i mana rereŋ embiŋ, ehuc kiŋaŋŋic ŋokacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mocwâc mi bacjopapie jujareniŋte firuec‐jopambiŋ; ine hâcne jaŋe dâŋ mana rereŋ ehuc rambaŋ juniŋte firuec‐jopambiŋ.
Juku ʒâhec ine maŋjeŋic risieme kiŋaŋŋic ŋokac firuec‐jopambiŋ jaŋe mocwâc rocjoparâ bawahac‐jopahuc kiŋaŋ qaqa bacjopambiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Wofuŋte dâŋ Jeremiarao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Wofuŋ Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: No mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec, kiŋaŋ qaqa jumbiŋkonec hâcne batarac‐joparâ kecʒiŋuc muhuc jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo,
‘Ŋoŋeraonec moczi Hebiraio qomâ‐ticne furine bame kiŋaŋ qaqa‐ticne jukume jara 7‐ko firuezejec; e jara 6 sawa kiŋaŋ qaŋareme firuepie rambaŋ juzejec hâcne.’ Mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ine dâŋnane mana rereŋ mi embiŋ, â dâŋnanere hazec‐jeŋic wâc mi râembiŋ.
Ŋoŋe ine maŋŋeŋic bârisierâ nore maio wiac tiŋkeekac i ehuc ŋic kiŋaŋ qaqahec sasawazi qomâfâc‐jeŋic firuec‐jopaniŋte dâŋne mumbiŋ. Ehuc nore ʒâŋe fokac fic ira mai‐naneo ʒâʒâfic embiŋ.
Ʒi ine maŋŋeŋic risieme ru sâc kiŋaŋŋic ŋokacfâc‐ŋeŋic rambaŋko juniŋte ejareme sâc firuec‐jopakicne jaŋe kiŋaŋ qaqa mocwâc bacjopaniŋte ʒoɋac erâ rocjopahuc ʒâŋe‐nane bâsâqorembiŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Ŋoŋe dâŋnane mana rereŋ mi embiŋ, ehuc ru sâc qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic rambaŋko juju i mi bâfua‐jarembiŋte noni rambaŋ fuŋmoc mupe fua‐ŋarezejec; ine ʒika â huc hâmoc erâ roroczi ŋoŋerao niŋgiŋ tâmiric gie bazejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Eme mupe mâreŋko ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe honec‐ŋoparâ bipic tatara ejarezejec.
“Â ʒâʒâfic‐nane hetâcnembiŋ erâ nore maio ʒâʒâfic embiŋ irec dâŋ mana rereŋ wâc mi embiŋ jaŋe bulimakao motecne hefâuckepie dâkâne jajahec eha ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko fotâcnembiŋ irec sâc ejarepemu.
Ehuc Juda fekicnefâc‐ticne â Jerusalemte fekicnefâc, â ŋicwofuŋte soŋaŋ sâko, â taha bapa erâ mâreŋ irec ŋic ŋokac omane bulimakao hefâuckekicne irec ŋondeŋnao fotâcnembiŋ
jaŋe hâcne râsifâc‐jeŋic â juju‐jeŋic sipirickeniŋte muŋgopieŋ jaŋere meo râec‐jopape fenʒepieŋ, eme qâŋɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic i sawa wipe â kâte qowi jaŋere nânâ enʒepieŋ.
Eme Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia â fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe iŋuc jaha râsifâc‐jeŋic â juju‐jeŋic sipirickeniŋte muŋgopieŋ jaŋere meo râec‐jopapemu, Babe ŋicwofuŋ momorifâc‐ticne behec‐joparâ rambiŋ jaŋere meo hâcne.
Manakic, no dâŋ mutâcne‐jarehuc ejarepe hae ʒira risienʒepieŋ; eme ʒika qaku ro rauc ehuc turuŋkepie ʒazejec. Ehame Judare hae ŋerakac i ima bape tuhutac fozejec. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Josiare ŋokâ Jojakim e Judare ŋicwofuŋ juhame Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ Jeremiarao fuawec i kecʒiŋuc:
“Go Rekaba kikefuŋ jaŋerao rarâ dâŋ jazahuc jowac‐jopatec Wofuŋ nore ufuŋko fic maŋne mocko fepie waiŋ opâ gumec‐jopazemec.”
Dâŋ iŋuc fua‐nareme no Habaziniare ŋosa, Jeremia mocte ŋokâ Jaʒania e mecne â hahac qafâcne â ŋokâfâcne mecne erâ Rekaba kikefuŋ furu jaha jaŋe mâmâc rocjopapo.
Rocjoparâ Wofuŋte ufuŋko Igedalia ere ŋokâ Hanaŋ, Anuture ŋic fârine hâcne, ere motecfâc jaŋere ficmaŋko râec‐jopapo. Ficmaŋ izi ine ŋic fekicne jaŋere ficmaŋ irec heririŋnao â Salumte ŋokâ Maseja, motâc soŋaŋ juwec ere ficmaŋ faicnao fowec.
Eme Rekaba kikefuŋkonec ŋic jaŋe waiŋ râqâc fusucmakicne â kap râe‐jarehuc jazapo: “Waiŋ opâ nâniŋ!”
Jaŋe ine mumbiŋ: “Nâŋe waiŋ opâ mi nâeŋgopeneŋ, i Rekaba ŋokâ‐ticne, mamac‐nâŋec Jonadaba eki hâcne ʒiŋuc mutâcne‐nârewecte, ‘Ŋoŋe waiŋ opâ moc mi nâhuc junʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe mecne â ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic fua rahuc juniŋmu jaŋe mecne.
Ŋoŋe fic moc mi banʒepieŋ, â wiac hândâŋne moc mi tienʒepieŋ, erâ waiŋ gie he sarac me ro rauc mi enʒepieŋ wâc; ŋoŋe ine qoruc bozeo ŋec foc erahuc junʒepieŋ, iŋuc ehuc mâreŋ jaba juŋgopieŋ ira dameŋ ʒora jufenʒepieŋ.’
Eme nâŋe mimiŋne‐nâŋec Jonadaba, Rekabare ŋokâ hâcne, e dâŋ mutâcne‐nârewec i mana rereŋ efârembeŋ, irec nâŋe mecne ŋokac naru motecfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mecne waiŋ opâ moc mi nâeŋgopeneŋ.
Erâ fic wiac barâ maŋnao juju fofo ee i wâc mi eeŋgopeneŋ, â waiŋ gie me nânâ gie me wiac gâcne irec ukicne i wâc mi rauckerâ bajueŋgopeneŋ.
Nâŋe qoruc bozeo ŋeŋe juju ehuc mimiŋne‐nâŋec Jonadabazi dâŋ mutâcne‐nârewec sâc i mana rereŋ efârembeŋ hâcne.
Eme Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza e mâreŋ ʒirec râsi fisime mumbeŋ, ‘Ajoc, Kaldea momorifâc‐jeŋic â Siria momorifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere hâhâwicte erâ Jerusalem haeo fenʒepeneŋ.’ Iŋuc murâ Jerusalem haeo wefumbeŋ juŋgopeneŋ hâcne.”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ Jeremiarao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e kecʒiŋuc mukac: Go ra Judare ŋicfâc â Jerusalem hae rune ʒiŋuc jazac: Ŋoŋe bâbâtiŋ bâsuehuc dâŋnane mana rereŋ eniŋte takic‐ŋopakac me? Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Rekabare ŋokâ Jonadaba e ɋâricfâcne jaŋe waiŋ opâ mi nâniŋte muac‐jopawec, eme jaŋe dâŋticne mi qatarambiŋ; ehuc waiŋ opâ moc mi nâhuc jumbiŋzi juŋgopieŋ jaha, i mimiŋne‐jeŋic ere sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkeniŋte. No dâŋ ʒuʒuhuc jaha ŋazahuc jupo, ŋoŋe ine dâŋnane mi manambiŋ.
Eme no kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane sasawa, porofete hâcne mu qâmoc ʒiŋuc eŋareniŋte ʒuʒuhuc jaha ŋoŋerao sorec‐jopapo: ‘Ŋoŋe ru sâc maŋŋeŋic bârisierâ hata hehesic‐ŋeŋic behenʒepieŋ, ehuc eebapa biaŋne bâfuarâ nemu jaŋerao qohotahuc kiŋaŋ mi qajarenʒepieŋ; iŋuc epie ŋoŋe â mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ ŋarepo ira jusanaŋkeniŋmu.’ Ŋoŋe ine hazec‐ŋeŋic râehuc dâŋnane mi manambiŋ.
Jâmbomac, Rekabare ŋokâ Jonadaba ere ɋâricfâc jaŋe mimiŋne‐jeŋiczi sâcmutâc jarewec i mana rereŋ embiŋ; ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe ine nore dâŋ moc mi manambiŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu hâcne, no kecʒiŋuc mukopac: Manaŋgopieŋ, no Judare ŋicfâc â Jerusalem hae rune sasawa jaŋere faio ʒârâ hâriŋ feocte uŋ sawaŋ ejarepo i mupe fârio qafâreocmu, i dâŋ jazape mi manambiŋte â wira‐jarepe okacne mi bâtikie‐narembiŋte.”
Rekaba kikefuŋ jaŋe ine Jeremiazi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu eki kecʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe mimiŋne‐ŋeŋic Jonadaba ere sâcmutâc dâŋ manahuc mumutâc dâŋticne furu jaha mana rereŋ embiŋ â dâŋ mutâcne‐ŋarewec irec sâcko jâmbâŋ wiac ebac embiŋ.
Irec Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Jonadaba, Rekabare ŋokâ hâcne, e dameŋ sâc ŋic moc nore maio kiŋaŋ qaqa gie baocte mi basa‐jâmbâŋkezejec.”
Josiare ŋokâ Jojakim e Judare ŋicwofuŋ jume jara 4 eha Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ kecʒiŋuc Jeremiarao fuawec:
“Go papia foforiekicne moc rorâ Israere dâŋ â Judare dâŋ erâ ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere dâŋ gazapo i qâreŋke‐fârec, ine Josiare dameŋko fuŋkerâ gazapozi gazahuc juwefuku miŋecgac gazakopac jaha dâŋ i hâcne.
Eme Juda kikefuŋ jaŋe sisipiric sasawa fua‐jareocte manasuhuc jukopac, irec biŋe manarâ ru sâc hata‐jeŋic hehesicne beheniŋmu mecne; iŋuc epie no kiŋ bahac‐jeŋic â sâqocne‐jeŋic bâtâmirepemu.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme Jeremiazi Neriare ŋokâ Baruku hefârewec, eme Wofuŋ e dâŋ âzâcne‐fârewec i Baruku e Jeremiazi âzâcne mutâc ewec sâc papiao qâreŋkewec.
Ehame Jeremiazi Baruku ʒiŋuc muhuc mutâcnecnewec: “No Wofuŋte ufuŋko fepere aka henarekicnere sâcne mi fepemu.
Irec goki ferâ Wofuŋte dâŋ gaza mutâc epe sâc papiao qâreŋkemec i Wofuŋte ufuŋko ŋic ŋokac nânâ sowa jujure hombaŋte fisihapie wose‐jarezemec, erâ Juda hae ŋerakackonec ŋic wefuŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc wose‐jarezemec.
Iŋuc etec jaŋe mu huacbuc ehuc Wofuŋte maio daperâ ru sâc eebapa‐jeŋic hehesicne i beheniŋmu mecne; Wofuŋzi ŋicguru ʒi kimbeŋ repicne qajarehuc aaric sâko mana‐jareocte muwec hâcne.”
Eme Neriare ŋokâ Baruku e porofete Jeremiazi dâŋ âzâcne mutâc ewec i mana rereŋ efârehuc Wofuŋte dâŋ papiao qâreŋkewec i Wofuŋte ufuŋko ŋic ŋokâc wose‐jarewec.
Eme Josiare ŋokâ, Judare ŋicwofuŋ Jojakim e ŋicwofuŋ jume jara 4 â mosa 9 tarazo ewec dameŋ ira ine Jerusalem hae rune ʒeŋgoma â Juda hae ŋerawec irec ŋic ŋokac Jerusalem haeo fisimbiŋ sasawa jaŋe Wofuŋte maio sowa jujure hombaŋ moc ŋeniŋte mumbiŋ.
Ŋehapie Baruku e Jeremiare dâŋ papiao qâreŋkekicne i Wofuŋte ufuŋko wose‐jarewec, ine Safaŋte ŋoka qâreŋŋic Gemaria ere ficmaŋko ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋere maio wosewec hâcne. Ficmaŋ izi ine Wofuŋ ufuŋ‐ticnere hae ʒoŋa faicpec Motâc Ɋâricnere heririŋko ŋewec.
Eme Mikaja e Gemariare ŋokâ â Safaŋte ŋosazi Wofuŋte dâŋ papiao qâreŋkekicne i mana‐fârewec.
Manarâ ŋicwofuŋte ficko hurâ qâreŋŋic ere ofisio fewec. Ferâ ŋic fekicne kecʒiŋuc jaŋe tumaŋnehapie honec‐jopa‐fârewec: Qâreŋŋic Elisama â Semajare ŋokâ Delaja â Akaboro ere ŋokâ Elenataŋ â Safaŋte ŋokâ Gemaria â Hananiare ŋokâ Zedekia erâ fekicne gâcne sasawa.
Mikaja eki ine Barukuzi ŋic ŋokac papiaonec dâŋ wose‐jareme manawec i jaza‐fârewec.
Jazame ŋic fekicne sasawa jaŋe Netaniare ŋokâ Jehudi, Selemiare ŋosa, Kusire apa hâcne e Baruku ʒiŋuc âzâcneocte erao sorembiŋ: “Go ŋic ŋokac papia wose‐jaremec i hâcne rorâ wahazemec.” Eme Baruku, Neriare ŋokâ hâcne, e papia i rorâ jaŋerao huwec.
Eme jaŋe âzâcnerâ mumbiŋ: “Go waha ŋehuc wose‐nârec!” Iŋuc mupie Barukuzi wose‐jarewec.
Eme jaŋe dâŋ i mana‐fârerâ hohonec ehuc bipic tara‐jareme Baruku âzâcnembiŋ, “Nâŋe dâŋ i furu jaha ŋicwofuŋ âzâcnenʒepeneŋ!”
Baruku ine ʒiŋuc wiocnembiŋ: “Go muc, dâŋ i weniŋuc erâ qâreŋke‐fâremeŋ; eki mume sâc qâreŋkemeŋ me weniŋuc?”
Barukuzi ine dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarewec: “Jeremia e dâŋ i sasawa miczi nazame tindezi papiao qâreŋkepo.”
Eme ŋic fekicne jaŋe Baruku âzâcnembiŋ: “Go â Jeremia ŋohe ra soŋkenic, ehuc wena junicmu i ŋic moc mi jazapire mananʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc âzâcnerâ papia i qâreŋŋic Elisama ere ficmaŋko soŋkerâ ŋicwofuŋte hae ʒoŋao fembiŋ, ehuc wiac fuawec irec dâŋ ŋicwofuŋ âzâcne‐fârembiŋ.
Âzâcnepie ŋicwofuŋzi Jehudi e papia roocte sorewe; eme eki qâreŋŋic Elisamare ficmaŋkonec ro bafisiwec, bafisirâ ŋicwofuŋ â ŋic fekicne ŋicwofuŋ orâŋkehuc doma‐fârembiŋ jaŋe wose‐jarewec.
Eme mosa namba 9 maickewecte ŋicwofuŋ e hoe dameŋte ficko ŋehame maŋfuŋnao ʒafeo ʒoc ʒahuc fowec.
Eme Jehudi e ombâŋne 3 me 4 wosewec sâc ŋicwofuŋ e sâqe moteczi bâtâcnerâ ʒocko beheme huwec; iŋuc ekume ine papia i ʒafeo ʒoc ʒahuc fowec ira hurâ ʒafârewec hâcne.
Ŋicwofuŋ â kiŋaŋŋicfâcne jaŋe ʒeŋgoma dâŋ i mana‐farerâ sifu bipic‐jeŋic mi tarawec; ehame ŋaqi‐jeŋic wâc mi bâsuckembiŋ.
Eme Elenataŋ â Delaja erâ Gemaria jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ papia mi rikeocte ʒoɋachec numucnepie mi mana‐jarewec wâc.
Aricne, ŋicwofuŋ e ŋokâ‐ticne Jeramele â Aʒariele ere ŋokâ ʒâŋene Seraja erâ Abedere ŋokâ Selemia jaŋe qâreŋŋic Baruku â porofete Jeremia rocjofaniŋte mujarewec, Wofuŋzi ine soŋjofawec.
Eme Baruku e Jeremiazi dâŋ âzâcne mutâc ewec sâc qâreŋkewec irec papia i ŋicwofuŋzi ʒocko beheme ʒafâreme Wofuŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc Jeremiarao fuawec:
“Go papia ɋâricne moc roc, erâ papia raŋɋanao dâŋ fowec â Juda ŋicwofuŋ Jojakimzi rikewec ijaha harierâ qâreŋke‐fârezemec.
Eme Juda ŋicwofuŋ Jojakim ere dâŋ ine ʒiŋuc muzemec, ‘Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Go papia keci kecʒiŋuc muhuc ʒocko behetec ʒawec: “Wemocte ʒiŋuc qâreŋkemeŋ: Babe ŋicwofuŋ e fisi‐jâmbâŋkerâ mâreŋ ʒi ima bahuc ŋic â qowifâc‐ticne bâsirowec‐jopaocmu?”
Irec Wofuŋ no Juda ŋicwofuŋ Jojakim gore ʒiŋuc mukopac: Ɋâricfâcge jaŋeraonec moczi Dawidire eri ŋeŋeo mi ŋezejec, ehame qâŋɋâŋge i mâc kosa behepie ʒoaŋ fârorocko â ŋafe mâmâteŋko fozejec.
Eme go gahacne â ɋâricfâcge erâ kiŋaŋŋicfâcge ŋoŋe kiŋ bahac‐ŋeŋicte okacne bazu‐ŋarepemu; ehuc ŋoŋe mecne, Jerusalem hae rune mecne â Judare ŋicfâc mecne sisipiric wiac fua‐ŋareocte uŋdâŋ ŋaza‐fârepe mana suambiŋ i mupe fârio qaocmu.’”
Eme Jeremia e papia ɋâricne moc rorâ Neriare ŋokâ qâreŋŋic Baruku e râcnewec, eme Juda ŋicwofuŋ Jojakim eki papia ʒocko beheme ʒawec irec dâŋ i Jeremiazi âzâcne mutâc ewec sâc furu jaha mocwâc qâreŋkewec. Erâ i sawa mâcne, dâŋ iŋucne gâcne bocjaha râe ʒuhuc ekicne.
Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza e Jojakimte ŋokâ Konia ere okacne Josiare ŋokâ Zedekia ŋicwofuŋ âkendâŋneme eki Juda mâreŋko ŋicwofuŋ gie bahuc juwec.
Mâc e jahacne mecne, kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne mecne â mâreŋ irec ŋic ŋokac mecne jaŋe porofete Jeremiazi Wofuŋte dâŋ jazawec i mana takirembiŋ.
Ehame ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia e sifu Selemiare ŋokâ Jehuka erâ Masejare ŋokâ taha bapa Zefania jahe porofete Jeremia ʒiŋuc âzâcnenicte erao sorec‐jofawec: “Go Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec e nâŋere erâ wira wâwâsic ecnezemec!”
Jeremia e ine kâpâcwâru ficko biac mi râembiŋte ŋic ŋondeŋko rac warec ehuc jaha juwec.
Dameŋ ira Faraore momorifâc jaŋe râsi fisiniŋte Aigita mâreŋ biac behembiŋ, eme Kaldea ŋic Jerusalem somâ bahuc jumbiŋzi biŋe‐jeŋic manarâ Jerusalem beherâ rambiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ porofete Jeremiarao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Wofuŋ Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: Juda ŋicwofuŋzi no mu wioc enarenicte ŋic jajahec sorec‐jofame warepic jahe e ʒiŋuc âzâcnezepirec, ‘Manakic, Farao momorifâc‐ticne bafic‐ŋopaniŋte warehuc jumbiŋ jaŋe mocwâc Aigita mâreŋ‐jeŋicko risiezo eŋgopieŋ.
Kaldea ŋic jaŋe ine risie ware hae ʒi somâ barâ ro rauc ehuc turuŋkepie ʒaocmu.
Irec Wofuŋ no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc maŋŋeŋic mi eatuckenʒepieŋ: “Kaldea ŋic jaŋe behec‐nâporâ rasanaŋkeniŋmu,” jaŋe mi rajâmbâŋkeniŋmu, aricne.
Me Kaldea ŋic jaŋere momorifâc ŋoŋehec ʒika gie baeŋgopieŋ i sanaŋkerâ jopa‐fârepie muzac ŋic ʒâpâ jopakicne nâfocne sawa jaŋe sifu ru sâc qoruc boze‐jeŋic konec faharerâ hae ʒi turuŋkepie ʒazac.’”
Farao momorifâc‐ticne jaŋe fisizo ehapie Kaldea ŋic jaŋe Jerusalem hae beherâ rambiŋ.
Rahapie Jeremia e Benjamiŋ mâreŋko rarâ ira soctofafâc‐ticne jaŋehec mâreŋ rukec qaqare dâŋ moc fuawec i mutaraocte Jerusalem hae behezo ewec.
Ehuc ine Benjamiŋ Motâcko fisime ŋic moc ʒâŋene Iria, Selemiare ŋokâ â Hananiare ŋosa hâcne, e ira momori soŋaŋ domaweczi Jeremia ʒiŋuc muhuc aka hecnewec: “Go Kaldea ŋic jaŋerao wisezo ekic.”
Jeremiazi ine muwec: “Burec, no Kaldea ŋic jaŋerao wisezo mi ekopac.” Iria eki ine dâŋ i mana‐bipiehuc Jeremia rorâ ŋic fekicne jaŋerao barawec.
Eme ŋic fekicne jaŋe ine Jeremiare aaric‐jopame qarâ qâreŋŋic Jonataŋ ere ficko kâpâcwâru bambiŋ, fic i mutarapie kâpâcwâru fic ewec hâcne.
Iŋuc ehuc Jeremia fic maŋne moc, haroŋaŋko gufukicne erâ opâ nombâŋhec ira râepie ŋeha ʒoaŋ bocjaha tarawec.
Juku ʒoaŋ mocko ine ŋicwofuŋ Zedekiazi dâŋ râeme rame Jeremia erao jowa fembiŋ. Eme ŋicwofuŋzi erific‐ticnao kamierâ wiocnehuc muwec: “Wofuŋte dâŋ moc fokac me?” Jeremiazi muwec: “Fokac.” Erâ muwec: “Go Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere meo fecmu.”
Iŋuc murâ ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia dâŋ ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ âzâcnewec: “No go â kiŋaŋŋicfâcge me ŋicguru ʒi ŋoŋe wemo wiac sâqocne moc eŋarepore kâpâcwâru ficko râecnumbiŋ?
Me porofetefâc‐ŋeŋic dâŋ ʒiŋuc ŋaza jumbieŋ jaŋe weni, ‘Babe ŋicwofuŋ e ŋoŋe me mâreŋ ʒi râsi mi fisi‐ŋareocmu?’
Irec ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, ʒi mupe manac: Go nunumu‐nane kecʒiŋuc mana‐narec mac: No qâreŋŋic Jonataŋ ere ficko hâmozipore mutec ira mocwâc mi bârisiecnunʒepieŋ.”
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Zedekiazi mume Jeremia e momori ŋic jaŋere hae ʒoŋao bara soŋaŋkehuc jumbiŋ. Ehuc ira ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne nânâ poroŋ bapa jaŋeraonec nânâ poroŋ hâcbuc moc râcnehuc jukupie haeo nânâ poroŋ omae‐fâreme sawa behembiŋ. Iŋuc ehapie Jeremiazi momori jaŋere hae ʒoŋao juwec hâcne.
Mataŋ ere ŋokâ Sefatia â Pasahurure ŋokâ Gedalia â Selemiare ŋokâ Juka erâ Malikiare ŋokâ Pasahuru jaŋe Jeremiazi ŋic ŋokac sasawa dâŋ kecʒiŋuc jazawec i mana‐fârembiŋ:
“Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Moc e hae ʒira ŋeocmuzi ʒikare nânâ eocmu, â nânâre me huc hâmocte sipirickeocmu; â moc e Kaldea ŋic jaŋerao wiseocmu e ine juju‐ticne ŋezickehuc ʒikare nâfocne erâ juocmu.
Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: Hae ʒi i jâmbomac Babe ŋicwofuŋ momorifâc‐ticne jaŋere meo feme ro rauc eniŋmu.”
Iŋuc mume ŋic kâcɋene jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ âzâcnembiŋ, “Ŋic keci mutec qâhâmonʒepieŋ! E dâŋ iŋucne jazahuc hae ʒirec maŋnao momori ʒanʒaŋne juŋgopieŋ jaŋe mecne erâ ŋic ŋokac gâcne sasawa jaŋe mecne maŋjeŋic bawahaekac; ŋic e ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe juhâmoniŋte mâcne, sipirickeniŋte manasuhuc juekac.”
Ŋicwofuŋ Zedekiazi ine muwec: “Sâcne, meŋeŋicko feoc, ŋicwofuŋ e ŋoŋere dâŋ qaocte tâpiri mi focnekac i!”
Iŋuc mume Jeremia rorâ ŋicwofuŋte ŋokâ Malikia ere opâ nombâŋ momori jaŋere hae ʒoŋao fowec ira behepie huwec, ine repazi niŋgiŋkerâ râepie huwec. Opâ nombâŋko ine opâ aricne, sohoŋ sawa fowecte Jeremiazi sohoŋmaŋko hurâ bâutuckewec.
Ebemelec, Etiopianec ŋic kâcɋene moc e ŋicwofuŋte erificko juweczi Jeremia opâ nombâŋko behepie huwec irec biŋe manawec. Ehame ŋicwofuŋ e dameŋ ira Benjamiŋ Motâcko ŋewec.
Irec Ebemeleczi ŋicwofuŋte erific beherâ ŋicwofuŋtao ra ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec:
“O ŋicwofuŋ‐nane, ŋic keci jaŋe porofete Jeremia wiac ecne‐fârerâ opâ nombâŋko behepie huwec i mâsi sâqoc qaqocne; e haeo nânâ poroŋ omaekacte ira nânâ tâmiric ŋeku hâmoocmu i!”
Mume ŋicwofuŋzi Etiopia ŋic Ebemelec âzâcnewec, “Go ʒirecnec ŋic jahec â moc rocjopatec ra Jeremia e hâmozacte nombâŋkonec fârepie wefuzejec!”
Eme Ebemelec e ŋic i rocjoparâ ŋicwofuŋte ficko mafafic rurumaŋnao fic maŋne moc fowec irecnec qoruc wambane â ŋaqi wiac suckekicne i rorâ repao niŋgiŋkerâ opâ nombâŋko Jeremiarao râeme huwec.
Izi ine Etiopia ŋic Ebemeleczi Jeremia ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go qoruc wamba â ŋaqi wiac suckekicne i repazi nâguzacte fitackec.” Mume Jeremiazi iŋuc ewec.
Eme jaŋe Jeremia repazi opâ nombâŋkonec fârepie wefuwec. Iŋuc epie Jeremia e momori jaŋere hae ʒoŋao juwec.
Ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia e porofete Jeremiazi Wofuŋte ufuŋko motâc namba 3 ira fuacneocte dâŋ râeme rawec. Eme Jeremia e ra fisime ŋicwofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No dâŋ moc wio‐garezo ekopac, irec go wiac moc mi hesoŋke‐narezemec.”
Eme Jeremiazi Zedekia âzâcnewec, “No dâŋ gazape qâhâmocnuniŋte mucmu i! Â dâŋ gaza mutâc epe ine sifu mi mana‐narecmu.”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋ Zedekiazi Jeremia bucko kamierâ mupaŋkecnewec, “Juju bâfua‐nârewec Wofuŋ e jujâmbâŋkekacte no mi qâhâmocgupemu â ŋic jujuge sipirickezo muŋgopieŋ jaŋere meo wâc mi râecgupemu.”
Eme Jeremiazi Zedekia âzâcnewec, “Wofuŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ â Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: Go Babe ŋicwofuŋ fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋerao hucmuo ine jucmu, eme hae ʒi turuŋkepie mi ʒahame go â wiacfâcge ŋoŋe sâcne juniŋmu.
Babe ŋicwofuŋ fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋerao mi hucmuo ine hae ʒi Kaldea ŋic jaŋere meo feme turuŋkepie ʒaocmu, ehame go gahacne wâc sâcne mi wise‐jarecmu.”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋ Zedekiazi Jeremia ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No Judaŋiczi Kaldea ŋic jaŋere guruo biac humbiŋ juŋgopieŋ jaŋere hâwicnukac; jaŋere meo râecnupie penaroŋ ehuc kosa enarenʒipiŋkohec.”
Jeremiazi ine muwec: “Jaŋere meo mi râecguniŋmu, go Wofuŋte dâŋ gazakopac i manarâ sâcne juhâmocmu â jujuge mi sipirickeniŋmu.
Go qatararâ jaŋerao mi hucmuo ine Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc naza nowatuc ewec i fârinehec eocmu:
Manakic, Juda ŋicwofuŋte erificko ŋokac nâfocne juniŋmu jaŋe sasawa Babe ŋicwofuŋ fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋerao amec‐jopa hupie kecʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Ojai, ŋic âgofâcge jaŋe eatucguhuc bawahacgumbiŋ, eme ʒi sohoŋmaŋko juhaŋtecne behecguŋgopieŋ.’
Ŋokac naru motecfâcge sasawa jaŋe ine Kaldea ŋic jaŋerao amec‐jopa huniŋmu, erâ go gahacne wâc sâcne mi wise‐jarecmu, aricne, rocgurâ Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere meo râecgupie fecmu â hae ʒi turuŋkepie ʒaocmu.”
Eme Zedekiazi Jeremia âzâcnewec, “Gohec dâŋ muc manac ekoperec irec biŋe ŋic moczi moc mi manazejec, manapie ʒikare biŋe ezicte.
Me gohec dâŋ muc manac ekoperec i fekicne jaŋe manarâ gorao fisirâ muniŋmu, ‘Go ŋicwofuŋ dâŋ âzâcnemeŋ me ŋicwofuŋzi go gazawec i nâzâc! Mufua‐nâretec akicgunaŋmu.’
Iŋuc mupie ine ʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘No ŋicwofuŋ dapecnerâ Jonataŋte ficko mocwâc mi risiepemurâ mana‐nareocte numucnepo, no ira hâmozipore.’”
Eme ʒâhec ine jâmbomac ŋic fekicne sasawa jaŋe Jeremiarao fisirâ mu wioc ecnepie ŋicwofuŋzi dâŋ âzâcne mutâc ewec sâc jazawec. Eme dâŋ muc manac ekicne irec biŋe moc mi manambiŋte niniŋkerâ behembiŋ.
Jeremiazi ine momori jaŋere hae ʒoŋao jukuhame dameŋ maickeme râsi jaŋe Jerusalem hae ro rauc embiŋ.
Zedekia e Juda ŋicwofuŋ erâ juhame jara 9 tataranao mosa namba 10 ira Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza e momorifâc‐ticne sasawa rocjopame fisirâ Jerusalem hae somâckembiŋ.
Eme juku Zedekia e ŋicwofuŋ juhame jara 11 irec mosa 4 â ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 9 ira haesac âeckekupie hawec fuawec.
Eme Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere ŋic fekicne kecʒiŋuc jaŋe haeo ferâ motâc ʒâʒâŋiŋko domawec ira waha ŋembiŋ: Nerega‐Sareze, Samega‐Nebo, Sasakim ŋic fekicne jaŋere micne, Nerega‐Sareze, qaŋgec bapa jaŋere micne erâ Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere ŋic fekicne gâcne sasawa.
Ehame Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia â momorifâcne sasawa jaŋe honec‐joparâ wisembiŋ, ehuc ŋicwofuŋte jufu gieopec ra sac jajahec jahere ŋondeŋko motâc domawec i fotâcnerâ ŋafeo hae beherâ Jordaŋ wâneŋkopec rambiŋ.
Kaldea momori ŋic jaŋe ine jâpec‐jopa raku Jeriko mâreŋ burocnao Zedekia bâfuambiŋ; erâ ro Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza Hamati mâreŋko Ribela haeo ŋewec erao barambiŋ. Eki ine dâŋticne mutarawec.
Erâ Babe ŋicwofuŋzi mume Ribela haeo ira Zedekiazi honeha ŋokâfâc‐ticne qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ, erâ Judaŋic fekicne sasawa jaŋe iŋuc jaha Babe ŋicwofuŋzi mume qâhâmoc‐jopa‐fârembiŋ.
Zedekia e jahacne ine mume ʒâŋene âke hâpombiŋ, erâ Babe haeo baraniŋte kâpâcwâruzi niŋgiŋkembiŋ.
Ŋicwofuŋte erific â hae rune jaŋere fic wiac i Kaldea ŋic jaŋe rikepie ʒâseŋkewec, erâ Jerusalem haere qânâsac i heroc qâropiembiŋ.
Ŋicwofuŋ momori fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋere micne ʒâŋene Nebuʒaradaŋ e ŋic ŋokac ʒanʒaŋne haeo jumbiŋ â erao wisembiŋ jaŋe kâpâcwâru bacjoparâ Babe haeo amec‐jopa rawec.
Ŋic hapetac, fic hae tâmiric gâcne ine ŋicwofuŋ momori fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋere micne Nebuʒaradaŋzi Juda mâreŋkoa juniŋte mana‐jarehuc waiŋ gie â mâreŋ jarewec.
Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukanezazi momori fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋere micne Nebuʒaradaŋ e Jeremiare dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcne mutâc ewec:
“Go mutec bafisipie hone soŋaŋ ecnehuc sahac‐ticne moc mi bâʒâickezemec, aricne, e jahac dâŋ gazame sâc ine wiac ecnezemec.”
Eme ŋicwofuŋ momorifâc‐ticne jaŋere micne Nebuʒaradaŋ â ŋic fekicne jaŋere micne Nebusaʒibaŋ â qaŋgec bapa micne‐jeŋic Nerega‐Sareze erâ Babe ŋicwofuŋ fekicnefâc‐ticne sasawa
jaŋe kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopapie Jeremia momori jaŋere hae ʒoŋaonec bafisipie rambaŋko juocte Gedalia, Ahikamte ŋokâ, Safaŋte ŋosa hâcne erao râembiŋ. Iŋuc epie ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋondeŋko juwec hâcne.
Jeremia e momori jaŋere hae ʒoŋao jaha juhame Wofuŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fuacnewec:
“Go ra Etiopia ŋic Ebemelec âzâcnec, ‘Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: Manakic, no hae ʒirec findaŋdâŋ mupo i bâbâpiaŋ mâcne, sisipiric fuacneocte mupe fârio qaocmu; dameŋ ira gore ʒâŋe faio fârinehec eocmu hâcne.
Go gahacne ine dameŋ ira bataracgupemu, eme go ŋic hâhâwic bajareekic jaŋere meo moc mi râecgunʒepieŋ.
Aricne, go ʒikare nânâ ezicte no ŋezicgu‐jâmbâŋkepemu, eme norao roweckehuc jumeŋte mi sipirickehuc jujuge ʒuhuckerâ juzemec. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.’”
Ŋicwofuŋ momori fuŋfuŋfâcne jaŋere micne Nebuʒaradaŋ e Jeremia bâfuarâ Rama haeo ira rame Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ fuacnewec. Jeremia e dameŋ ira kâpâcwâru ŋic Jerusalem haeonec â Juda mâreŋkonec Babe haeo bacjopa raniŋte rambiŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko niŋgiŋhec mâmâc rawec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ momori fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋere micnezi Jeremia hefârerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋ Anutuge e hae mâreŋ ʒi wiac hâhâwicne i hâcne fuacneocte dâŋne mufuawec.
Erâ Wofuŋ bunao bahuc dâŋticne mana rereŋ mi embiŋte dâŋ muwec i fârine bâfuame wiac keci fua‐ŋarekac hâcne.
Erâ manac, no ʒi mege kâpâcwâruzi basanaŋkekicne i firue‐garekopac; eme go gahac, nohec Babe haeo razo murâ razeperec eme no ira hone soŋaŋ egarepemu; me nohec Babe haeo razore mi egarekacko beherâ ŋezemec. Manakic, mâreŋ bocjaha forakac, irec go ira me ira razore manatec sâckekacko razemec.
Ŋezo murâ ine Gedalia, Ahikamte ŋokâ, Safaŋte ŋosa hâcne erao risie razemec; Babe ŋicwofuŋzi ŋic e hâcne Juda mâreŋte soŋaŋ âkendâŋnewec, irec ŋic ŋokac jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ ehec juzo murâ juzemec, me ira me ira razore manatec sâckekacko razemec.” Momori micne e iŋuc murâ hatare nâsiŋ â bubiaŋte wiac râcnehuc soreme rawec.
Eme Jeremia e Ahikamte ŋokâ Gedalia erao Mizipa haeo rawec, erâ ehec ŋic ŋokac nâfocne mâreŋ ira jumbiŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko juwec.
Momori micne jaŋe ŋicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec hae mâreŋ ira siŋsaŋ qarâ juhuc ʒiŋuc mana‐fârembiŋ: Babe ŋicwofuŋ e Ahikamte ŋokâ Gedalia mâreŋ soŋaŋ âkendâŋnehuc ŋic ŋokac naru motec â mâreŋ irec ŋic omane Babe haeo mi bacjopa rakicne jaŋe hone maiŋ ejareocte mucnewec.
Iŋuc manarâ ŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋe ŋicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec Mizipa haeo Gedalia erao ra fisimbiŋ: Netaniare ŋokâ Isimae, Karea ŋokâ jahec‐ticne Johanaŋ â Jonataŋ, Tanahumeti ere ŋokâ Seraja, Efai Netofa haeonec ere ŋokâfâc erâ Makati ŋokâ‐ticne Jeʒania.
Eme Ahikamte ŋokâ, Safaŋte ŋosa Gedalia e jaŋe â ŋicfâc‐jeŋic ʒiŋuc musanaŋke‐jarehuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe Kaldea ŋic kiŋaŋ qajareniŋte mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec; ŋoŋe mâreŋ ʒijaha juhuc Babe ŋicwofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnehuc sâcne juhâmoniŋmu.
No nahac Mizipa haeo ŋehuc Kaldea ŋic warehuc juniŋmu sâc jaŋere maio dâŋmumu‐ŋeŋic erâ jupemu. Ŋoŋe ine waiŋ â oliwa hândâŋne â wiac gâcne i qa roro dameŋko rowaŋ‐ŋeŋicko râe guruc erâ hae ro rauc embiŋ sâc ira ŋec juc enʒepieŋ.”
Babe ŋicwofuŋ e ŋic nâfocne jaŋe Juda mâreŋko juniŋte mana‐jarehuc Gedalia Ahikamte ŋokâ, Safaŋte ŋosa hâcne soŋaŋ âkendâŋne‐jarewec i Judaŋic Moabi me Amoŋ me Edom mâreŋko me mâreŋ ira me ira juhuc biŋene mana‐fârembiŋ.
Irec Judaŋic sasawa hae mâreŋ sâc bâtâtiec‐jopakicne irecnec risierâ Juda mâreŋko Mizipa haeo Gedalia erao fisimbiŋ. Erâ waiŋ hândâŋ mecne, jâcfâri mecne i mâriri sâkohec fuame ro guruc embiŋ.
Kareare ŋokâ Johanaŋ â momori micne jaŋe hae mâreŋ ira siŋsaŋ qarâ jurambiŋzi ra Mizipa haeo Gedalia erao fuambiŋ.
Ehuc âzâcnembiŋ, “Amoŋŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ Balisi e Netaniare ŋokâ Isimaezi qâhâmocguocte soreme fisiwec go i moc manakic me?” Ahikamte ŋokâ Gedalia e ine dâŋjeŋicte maname fârine mi ewec.
Eme Johanaŋ, Kareare ŋokâ hâcne, e Mizipa ira Gedalia kamierâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mana‐naretec ra Netaniare ŋokâ Isimae qâhâmozepac, eme ŋic moczi moc mi manazejec. E wemocko qâhâmocgume Judaŋic gorao tumaŋne‐fârehuc rârecguŋgopieŋzi mocwâc tâtiepie Judaŋic nâfocne jaŋe wâc sipirickeniŋmu?”
Ahikamte ŋokâ Gedalia e ine Karea ŋokâ‐ticne Johanaŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go iŋuc mi ejâmbâŋkezemec, go Isimaere dâŋ mukic i burec.”
Eme mosa namba 7 ira Isimae, Netaniare ŋokâ â Elisamare ŋosa hâcne, e ŋicwofuŋ guruonec fuakicne â ŋicwofuŋte ŋic kâcɋene moc juweczi ŋic 10 jaŋehec Mizipa haeo Ahikam ŋokâ‐ticne Gedalia erao fuambiŋ; eme ira mâmâc ŋehuc nânâ nâmbiŋ.
Ehuc Netania ŋokâ‐ticne Isimae â ŋic 10 ehec jumbiŋ jaŋe faharerâ Ahikamte ŋokâ Gedalia, Safaŋte ŋosa hâcne e ʒikazi qambiŋ; iŋuc ehuc Babe ŋicwofuŋzi mâreŋ soŋaŋ âkendâŋnewec ŋic e hâcne qâhâmombiŋ.
Erâ Isimae â ŋicfâcne jaŋe Judaŋic Gedaliahec Mizipa haeo jumbiŋ jaŋe mecne â Kaldea momori ŋic ira jumbiŋ jaŋe mâmâc qâhâmoc‐jopa‐fârembiŋ.
Gedalia qâhâmombiŋ irec biŋe ŋic moczi moc mi manaha hae furewec.
Hae fureme ine Sikem, Silo â Samaria haeonec ŋic 80 busâqocte erâ mecʒâwâ‐jeŋic bâtâcnekicne â ŋaqi‐jeŋic bâsuckekicne â sahac‐jeŋic kosa hetâcnekicne jaŋe taha bâzi â hosâc âsu ririkere wiac Wofuŋte taha ufuŋko bafeniŋte fisimbiŋ.
Eme Netaniare ŋokâ Isimae e bâfuac‐jopaocte Mizipa haeonec kio kio waha rawec, raku bâfuac‐joparâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ware Ahikamte ŋokâ Gedalia erao feniŋ.”
Eme hae ʒâʒâŋiŋko fe fisipie Isimae Netaniare ŋokâ e â ŋic ehec jumbiŋ jaŋe qâhâmoc‐joparâ mi opâ nombâŋko behec‐jopapie hunʒepieŋ i!
Jaŋeraonec ŋic 10 jaŋe ine Isimae ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Mi qâhâmoc‐nâpoc, nâŋe wiac kecʒiŋuc gieo soŋkembeŋ fonârekac: Jacgoŋ, padi, wokemaŋ â baŋac.” Iŋuc mupie âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec mi qâhâmoc‐jopahuc mâc behec‐jopawec.
Isimaezi ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopawec jaŋere qâŋɋaŋ i opâ nombâŋko behec‐jopame humbiŋ; nombâŋ i kâcɋene, erâ i ŋicwofuŋ Asa eki Israe ŋicwofuŋ Basazi râsi fisihame mume rombiŋ. Nombâŋ ira hâcne Netaniare ŋokâ Isimaezi mume ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopakicne jaŋe behec‐jopapie hurâ fusembiŋ.
Ŋicwofuŋ momori fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋere micne Nebuʒaradaŋ eki ŋic ŋokac nâfocne Mizipa haeo jumbiŋ â ŋicwofuŋ otâfâcne jaŋe Ahikamte ŋokâ Gedaliazi soŋaŋ‐jopaocte erao râec‐jopawec. Eme Netaniare ŋokâ Isimae e ŋic ŋokac nâfocne i jaŋe hâcne rocjoparâ Amoŋŋic jaŋere mâreŋko wiseocte kâpâcwâruo bacjopa rawec.
Eme Kareare ŋokâ Johanaŋ â momori micne gâcne sasawa ehec jumbiŋ jaŋe Netaniare ŋokâ Isimaezi mâsi repic qapicne efârewec irec biŋe manambiŋ.
Manarâ ŋicfâc‐jeŋic rocjopa‐fârerâ Netaniare ŋokâ Isimae ehec ʒika qaniŋte rambiŋ; raku Gibeoŋ hae heririŋko opâ ʒâkâŋ sâko fowec ira bâfuambiŋ.
Eme ŋic ŋokac Isimaehec jumbiŋ jaŋe Kareare ŋokâ Johanaŋ â momori micne sasawa ehec fisimbiŋ jaŋe honec‐joparâ bubiaŋ mana‐fârembiŋ.
Ehuc Isimaezi Mizipa haeonec amec‐jopa rawec ŋic ŋokac i jaŋe sasawa e râpeckerâ Kareare ŋokâ Johanaŋtao rafârembiŋ.
Netaniare ŋokâ Isimae ine ŋic 8 jaŋehec wiserâ Amoŋŋic jaŋerao rambiŋ.
Netaniare ŋokâ Isimae e Ahikamte ŋokâ Gedalia qâhâmorâ ŋic ŋokac nâfocne Mizipa haeonec amec‐jopa rawec jaŋe hâcne Kareare ŋokâ Johanaŋ â momori micnefâc‐ticne jaŋe rocjopambiŋ. Ine ŋic mecne, momori mecne, ŋokac naru motec mecne erâ ŋic fekicne mâmâc, jaŋe Johanaŋzi Gibeoŋ haeonec bârisiec‐jopawec hâcne.
Erâ raku Betelehem hae bâqiŋkehuc Kimiham tomafic ira ŋemanambiŋ, erâ irecnec Aigita mâreŋko raniŋte manasumbiŋ.
Netaniare ŋokâ Isimae e Ahikamte ŋokâ Gedalia, Babe ŋicwofuŋzi mâreŋ soŋaŋ âkendâŋnewec e hâcne qâhâmowecte Kaldea ŋic jaŋere hâwic‐jopaha raniŋte mumbiŋ.
Eme momori micne sasawa â Kareare ŋokâ Johanaŋ â Hosajare ŋokâ Aʒaria erâ ŋic ŋokac fekicne wahakicne sasawa
jaŋe porofete Jeremiarao rarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Go dâŋnâŋec manarâ Wofuŋ Anutuge ŋic ʒanʒaŋne mac ʒi nâŋere erâ numucnezemec. Go gahacne ʒâŋezi honekic, nâŋe bocjaha jumbeŋzi afecne sawa embeŋ juŋgopeneŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ Anutuge e wena ranaŋte â wemo wiac ebac enaŋte nâzâ nâwotuc ezejec.”
Eme porofete Jeremiazi jazawec: “Sâcne, manakopac, dâŋ muŋgopieŋ irec sâcko Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic numucnepemu, eme Wofuŋzi dâŋ okacne bâtikie‐nareme sâc ŋazapemu; no dâŋ moc mi hesoŋke‐ŋarepemu.”
Jaŋe ine Jeremia ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Wofuŋ Anutugezi dâŋ nâzâ mutâc ecmurâ nâŋerao sorecguocmu i mutec mana rereŋ mi efârenaŋmuo ine Wofuŋ e jahac mumutaniŋ ŋicnâŋec fârine â siocmâc ehuc fuŋne‐nâŋec rituzejec.
Nâŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋectao sorecguŋgopeneŋ e dâŋ biaŋne me sâqocne nâzâme ine sifu dâŋticne mana rereŋ enʒepeneŋ; iŋuc hâcne juhâmonaŋte Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋecte micdâŋ mana rereŋ enʒepeneŋ.”
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 10 tarame Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ Jeremiarao fuawec.
Eme Kareare ŋokâ Johanaŋ â momori micne ehec jufârembiŋ erâ ŋic ŋokac fekicne wahakicne jaŋe sasawa hefârec‐jopawec.
Erâ jazawec, “Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu, e wâwâsic dâŋŋeŋic âzâcnepemurâ sorecnumbiŋ eki hâcne ʒiŋuc mukac:
‘Ŋoŋe mâreŋ ʒira jusanaŋkeniŋmuo ine bafaharec‐ŋoparâ mocwâc mi bârândiŋ‐ŋopapemu, â sarac‐ŋoparâ mi qâfiec‐ŋopapemu, no wiac hâhâwicne eŋarepo irec busâqoc manakopac hâcne.
Ŋoŋe Babe ŋicwofuŋ hâhâwic bacneeŋgopieŋ i behenʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe ere mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc; no bafic‐ŋopahuc ere meonec batarac‐ŋopapemurâ ŋoŋehec jukopac hâcne.
No buuruc eŋarepemu, eme eki busâqoc mana‐ŋarehuc mâreŋ‐ŋeŋickoa juniŋte mutara‐ŋarezejec.’
‘Nâŋe mâreŋ ʒira mi junʒepeneŋ’, ŋoŋe iŋuc muhuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte dâŋ qatarahuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ muniŋmu:
‘Aricne, nâŋe Aigita mâreŋko ʒika mi fokacko â ʒikare qeŋfânâŋ mi fuaocmu erâ nânâre mi hâmonaŋmu ira ra junʒepeneŋ.’
Iŋuc muniŋmuo ine Juda guruonec ŋic nâfocne juŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ mananiŋ: Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Ŋoŋe jâmbomac Aigita mâreŋko razore qizec qahuc ira juniŋte raniŋmuo
ine ʒikare hâhâwic bajuŋgopieŋ ʒika izi hâcne Aigita mâreŋ ira bâfuac‐ŋopaocmu, erâ rorocte mezac‐ŋopakac roroc izi Aigita mâreŋko fisi‐ŋareme sipirickeniŋmu hâcne.
Aigita mâreŋko ra juniŋte qizec qaŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe ira ʒikare nânâ efâreniŋmu, erâ nânâre â huc hâmocte sipirickeniŋmu; eme sisipiric mupe fai‐jeŋicko feocmu i jaŋeraonec moczi moc mi wisecnerâ juocmu.’
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e kecʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: ‘Aaric â kimbeŋ‐nanezi Jerusalem ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋere faio fewec iŋuc jaha kimbeŋ‐nane Aigita mâreŋko raniŋmu ŋoŋere faio hoŋkepe feocmu; eme ŋoŋe sâwecte biŋe ehapie ŋic gâcnezi honec‐ŋoparâ bipic tatara ejarezejec, musâqorec‐ŋopapie mimi busâqoc fai‐ŋeŋicko fezejec, ehame hae mâreŋ ʒi mocwâc mi honenʒepieŋ.’
O Judaŋic nâfocne, ŋoŋe Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc ŋazakac, ‘Aigita mâreŋko mi ranʒepieŋ!’ Irec no miŋecgac uŋdâŋ ŋazakopac i mana‐jâmbâŋkeniŋ me!
Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic erao sorecnuhuc ŋaŋac juju‐ŋeŋic ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio râezo embiŋ: ‘Go nâŋere erâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec numucnezemec, eme Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec e dâŋ i me i mume nâzâ‐fâretec mana rereŋ enʒepeneŋ.’
Eme no dâŋ i hâcne miŋecgac mufua‐ŋarekopac, ŋoŋe ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte dâŋ mufua‐ŋare‐fârepemurâ ŋoŋerao sorecnuwec i ŋazape mana rereŋ moc mi eŋgopieŋ.
Irec ʒiŋuc mana‐hâmonʒepieŋ: Ŋoŋe rarâ juniŋte eŋarekac hae mâreŋ ira hâcne ʒikare nânâ ehuc wâc rorocte â huc hâmocte sipirickenʒepieŋ.”
Eme Jeremia e Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋiczi dâŋ âzâcne‐fârehuc jaŋerao sorewec i ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaza‐fârewec.
Jaza‐fâreme Hosajare ŋokâ Aʒaria â Kareare ŋokâ Johanaŋ erâ ŋic râŋgeŋne gâcne sasawa jaŋe Jeremia kecʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Go burec ekomec, Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec e ʒiŋuc nâzâcmurâ mi sorecguwec, ‘Ŋoŋe Aigita mâreŋko juniŋte mi ranʒepieŋ.’
Aricne, Neriare ŋokâ Baruku eki ine Kaldea ŋic jaŋere meo râec‐nâpoocmurâ manasuhuc mu qafeŋ egareekac hâcne, jaŋe qâhâmoc‐nâponiŋte me Babe haeo kâpâcwâruo bacnâpo raniŋte iŋuc eekac.”
Eme Kareare ŋokâ Johanaŋ â momori micne sasawa erâ ŋic ŋokac gâcne sâko jaŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ qatarahuc Juda mâreŋko mi ŋembiŋ.
Aricne, Kareare ŋokâ Johanaŋ â momori micne sasawa jaŋe Juda guruonec ŋic ʒanʒaŋne ŋicne ŋicne jaŋerao bâtâtiec‐jopakicnaonec Juda mâreŋko ŋec juc eniŋte risiembiŋ jaŋe hâcne rocjopa‐fârembiŋ.
Ine ŋic ŋokac naru motec mecne, ŋicwofuŋte otâfâc mecne, â ŋicwofuŋ momori fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋere micne Nebuʒaradaŋzi Ahikamte ŋokâ Gedalia, Safaŋte ŋosa erao ŋic râec‐jopa‐fâreme jumbiŋ jaŋe mecne, erâ porofete Jeremia â Neriare ŋokâ Baruku jahe mâmâc rocjopambiŋ.
Rocjoparâ Wofuŋte dâŋ mana rereŋ mi ehuc ine Aigita mâreŋko rambiŋ; raku Tapanese haeo fisimbiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ i Tapanese hae ira Jeremiarao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Go qânâ kâcɋene rorâ Tapanese ira Faraore ficmotâc fuŋnao Judaŋiczi honehapie mâreŋko duckezemec.
Erâ jazazemec, ‘Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: Manakic, no kiŋaŋŋic‐nane, Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza hâcne, ecnepe ware fisirâ qânâ duckepac ʒirec fainao eri ŋeŋe‐ticne heme ŋezejec, erâ ŋeŋe botâŋnao qoruc bupu erinehec fâreme domazejec.
E ware Aigita mâreŋte tâpiri qame wahaocmu, ehame hâmocte biŋe i hâmocko râec‐jopaocmu, â kâpâcwârure biŋe i kâpâcwâruo bacjopa raocmu, erâ ʒikare biŋe i ʒikazi jopaocmu.
Erâ nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋere taha ufuŋ i turuŋkeme ʒaocmu â nemuɋâŋ wiac i baraocmu. Erâ lama soŋaŋ moczi ŋaqi‐ticnaonec fitic wiac ro behec eekac irec sâc Aigita mâreŋ ecnehuc wâcwiac‐ticne jâoc roocmu; ehame moczi aka mi hecneha mocwâc risie raocmu.
Ʒoaŋte nemu mujumbieŋ ere jâmâ wâtuŋ qânâzi bakicne i qazurâ Aigita mâreŋte nemufâc jaŋere ufuŋ ʒoczi rikeme ʒafâreocmu.’”
Judaŋic sasawa Aigita mâreŋko Migidoli â Tapanese â Memfisi haeo erâ Patarosi mâreŋko jumbiŋ jaŋere dâŋ Jeremiarao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: Jerusalem hae â Juda mâreŋko hae gâcne sâko ŋerakac jaŋe wiac hâhâwicne mupe fua‐jare‐fârewec i ŋoŋe ŋaŋec hone manac embiŋ. Erâ manaŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ima bacjopakicne miŋecgac sesuctac foraŋgopieŋ jaha.
I hehesic‐jeŋicte iŋuc ejarekicne; jaŋe ra nemu furune, jaŋe mecne ŋoŋe mecne â mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mecne mi manac‐jopambiŋ, jaŋe hosâc âsu rike‐jarerâ kiŋaŋ qajarehuc bâiŋnumbiŋ hâcne.
No kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane sasawa, porofete hâcne, jaŋe dameŋ sâc ʒiŋuc ŋazaniŋte sorec‐jopa jupac: ‘Ŋoŋe wiac mamakâcne qaisockeekopac i moc mi enʒepieŋ.’
Jaŋe ine dâŋnane mi manambiŋ â hazec‐jeŋic wâc mi râembiŋ, irec hehesic‐jeŋic mi behehuc ʒuhuckerâ nemu hosâc âsu rike‐jare jumbieŋ.
Eme irec hâcne kimbeŋ â aaric‐nanere ʒocbâruŋzi Juda hae ŋerawec ira mecne â Jerusalem haeo mecne mâmâc bâruŋkewec; ehame hae wiac ʒaŋkerâ tuhune qarâ foweczi miŋecgac fokac jaha.
“Ʒi ine Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu hâcne, no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Judare ɋâricfâc, ŋoŋe wemocte guru‐ŋeŋicko ŋic ŋokac naru motec â ɋie jaŋe sirowe‐fâreniŋte wiac hâhâwicne sâko iŋucne bâfuaŋgopieŋ?
Ŋoŋe wemocte sipirickeniŋte â mâreŋko ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko sâwecte biŋe â mimi busâqocte biŋe eniŋte Aigita mâreŋko juzore fisirâ nemu hosâc âsu rike‐jareŋgopieŋ, ehuc eebapa‐ŋeŋic izi hâcne no bâiŋnuŋgopieŋ?
Ŋoŋe mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic â Juda ŋicwofuŋfâc â ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe hehesic embiŋ irec mecne erâ ŋoŋe ŋaŋac â ŋokacfâc‐ŋeŋic Juda mâreŋko â Jerusalem haeo hehesic bâfuambiŋ irec mâmâc biac nikec‐ŋopawec me?
Ŋoŋe ine irec busâqoc moc mi manambiŋ erâ mi manahuc juŋgopieŋ; ŋoŋe nore mi hâwic‐ŋopawec â nore sâcmutâc â dâŋsanaŋ ŋoŋe â mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic ŋarepo irec sâcko wâc mi jumbiŋ.
“Irec Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Manaŋgopieŋ, no Judaŋic bâsirowec‐ŋopa‐fârepemurâ râsi eŋarepe sisipiric fua‐ŋarezejec.
Eme Judaŋic ʒanʒaŋne Aigita mâreŋko rarâ juniŋte mumbiŋ jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopapemu, jaŋe Aigita mâreŋko sipiricke‐fâreniŋmu, ʒikare â rorocte hâmo sipiric eniŋmu; fekicne mecne wahakicne mecne jaŋe mâmâc ʒikare nânâ eniŋmu â nânâre hâmo sipiric eniŋmu hâcne, eme ŋic gâcnezi jaŋerao qâqiŋ qahuc sâwecdâŋ â sosopec dâŋ â mu hâhâwic dâŋ â mumusâqoc dâŋ muniŋmu.
Ehame Aigita mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ jaŋe Jerusalem hae rune ejarepo irec sâc jaha ejarehuc ʒika â roroc â huc hâmoc izi bâtiŋ‐jopapemu.
Eme Judaŋic ʒanʒaŋne Aigita mâreŋko juniŋte fisimbiŋ jaŋeraonec moczi moc Juda mâreŋko risieocte sâcne mi wiserâ ra juocmu; jaŋe risierâ ira ŋec juc eniŋte maŋhâhâŋ ejare‐bipieha mi risieniŋmu hâcne, jahecmaczi sawa wiserâ risieniŋmu.”
Ŋonâŋfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe nemu hosâc âsu rike‐jare jumbieŋ, iŋuc manambiŋ ŋic i jaŋe mecne, â ŋokac guru sâko domambiŋ jaŋe mecne, erâ ŋic ŋokac Aigita â Patarosi mâreŋko jufârembiŋ jaŋe mâmâc Jeremia dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ:
“Go Wofuŋte micte dâŋ nâzâmec i mana rereŋ mi enaŋmu.
Aricne, nâŋe dâŋ mupaŋkembeŋ sâc irec fârine bâfuanaŋmu hâcne, ine kecʒiŋuc: Sawa qânikiŋ irec ŋokac wofuŋ e nâŋe mecne, mamacfâc‐nâŋec mecne, ŋicwofuŋfâc‐nâŋec mecne â kâcɋenefâc‐nâŋec mecne Juda mâreŋko hae ŋerakac ira â Jerusalem haeo ejumbeneŋ irec sâc jaha hosâc âsu rikecnehuc waiŋzi taha râcnenaŋmu. Nâŋe dameŋ ira nânâ fonârewecte nâ gapec embeŋ, ehuc sâcne juhapene wiac hâhâwicne moc mi fua‐nârewec.
Sawa qânikiŋ irec ŋokac wofuŋ hosâc âsu ririkecne â waiŋzi taha hohoŋkecne i behembeŋ dameŋ ira hâcne fuŋkerâ wiacte wiac basahuc juhapene ʒika â roroczi sipiric‐nâpoekac.”
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ mumbiŋ, “Nâŋe sawa qânikiŋ irec ŋokac wofuŋ hosâc âsu rikecneeŋgopeneŋ â waiŋzi taha hoŋkecneeŋgopeneŋ, ehuc nânâ poroŋzi hawari‐ticne bahuc rikeeŋgopeneŋ â waiŋzi taha hoŋkecneeŋgopeneŋ i ŋowefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe kâuc bahapie eeŋgopeneŋ me?”
Iŋuc mupie Jeremia e ŋicguru ʒeŋgoma, ŋic â ŋokac erâ gâcne sâko dâŋ iŋucne bâtikiecnembiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Macne, ŋoŋe mecne, mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mecne, ŋicwofuŋfâc‐ŋeŋic mecne, fekicnefâc‐ŋeŋic mecne â ŋic ŋokac gâcne jaŋe mecne Juda mâreŋko hae ŋerakac ira â Jerusalem haeo hosâc âsu rike jumbieŋ, Wofuŋ e irec manasurâ bune ʒâʒâfic qawec.
Wofuŋ e juju â eebapa‐ŋeŋic hehesicne â mamakâcne i ʒuhuckerâ hone manac eocte takickewec. Eme irec hâcne mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic i tuhutac fuawec; ehame ŋiczi honepie bipic tataranehec â sâwechec ewec. Eme tuhutac fuarâ foweczi miŋecgac iŋucnea fokac.
Ŋoŋe hosâc âsu rikehuc Wofuŋ bunao bambiŋ, ehuc dâŋticne mana rereŋ mi embiŋte â sâcmutâc dâŋticne â dâŋsanaŋ‐ticne erâ mumutaniŋ dâŋticne irec sâcko mi jumbiŋte wiac hâhâwicne kecizi fai‐ŋeŋicko fewec i miŋecgac fokac jaha.”
Erâ Jeremia e ŋicguru ʒeŋgoma â ŋokac sasawa jaŋe ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Juda mâreŋkoneczi Aigita mâreŋko jufâreŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ ʒi mananiŋ:
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e kecʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe â ŋokacfâc‐ŋeŋic micŋeŋiczi dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupaŋkerâ meŋeŋiczi irec fârine bâfuaeŋgopieŋ: ‘Nâŋe sawa qânikiŋte ŋokac wofuŋ hosâc âsu rikecnenaŋte â waiŋzi taha hoŋkecnenaŋte dâŋ mupaŋkembeŋ i soŋaŋkehuc junʒepeneŋ.’ Sâcne, murâ iŋuc eniŋ, ehuc mumupaŋ dâŋŋeŋicte fârine bâfua‐jâmbâŋkeniŋ!
Irec Juda mâreŋkoneczi Aigita mâreŋko jufâreŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe Wofuŋ nore dâŋ mananiŋ: No ʒiŋuc mukopac hâcne: Manaŋgopieŋ, no ʒâŋe sâko‐naneo ɋetickehuc ʒiŋuc mupaŋkekopac: Juda mâreŋkoneczi Aigita mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ ŋoŋeraonec moczi ʒâŋe‐nane mu bâuac ehuc ʒiŋuc mocwâc mi muzejec, ‘Wofuŋ Anutu e jujâmbâŋkekac.’
Jâmbomac, bâbâpiaŋ mâcne, sisipiric fua‐ŋareocte ruc bahuc jukopac; ehame Juda mâreŋkonec Aigita mâreŋko juŋgopieŋzi ʒikare â nânâre hâmo sipiric enʒepieŋ, iŋuc eku arictac efârenʒepieŋ.
Â ʒika maŋnaonec wiseniŋmuzi ine Aigita mâreŋkonec Juda mâreŋko risieniŋmu, erâ i afecne maczi sawa eniŋmu; ehuc Juda mâreŋkoneczi Aigita mâreŋko juniŋte rambiŋ irec ŋic ʒanʒaŋne jaŋe nore dâŋzi me jaŋacne dâŋzi fârinehec ewec i mana tara‐fâreniŋmu.
Eme irec maqâreŋ kecʒiŋuc fua‐ŋarezejec: No hae mâreŋ ʒira hâcne bâtiŋ‐ŋopapemu; eme uŋdâŋ ŋazapo i jâmbomac fârio qaocmu, iŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc ŋazakopac: Manaŋgopieŋ, no Farao Hofara, Aigita ŋicwofuŋ hâcne, e râsifâc‐ticne â juju‐ticne sipirickezo muŋgopieŋ jaŋere meo râepemu, ine Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia e Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza ere meo râepo irec sâc, e hâcne râsi ecnehuc juju‐ticne sipirickezo muwec.”
Josiare ŋokâ Jojakim e Juda ŋicwofuŋ jume jara 4 eha Neriare ŋokâ Baruku e Jeremiazi dâŋ âzâcne mutâc ewec sâc i papiao qâreŋkewec. Ehame porofete Jeremia e dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e Baruku gore dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukac:
Go mukomec, ‘Jei, no ʒâic manahuc juhape Wofuŋ e wiac busâqocnehec ʒuhuckerâ râe‐narekac i! No kio huse eku dockerâ maŋfâsâc mi juekopac.’
Irec go Baruku âzâcnec, Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Manakic, no wiac mupe fuawec i mocwâc sipirickeekopac, â wiac sarapo i mocwâc unuckeekopac, ine mâreŋ sasawa iŋuc ecneekopac.
Ehame go gahacne wiac fekicne fua‐gareocte egarekac me? I mi mac ezemec! Manakic, no mupe mâreŋŋic sasawa sisipiric fua‐jareocmu, go ine hae mâreŋ ira me ira ra sisipiric tâmiric jucmurâ mana‐garekopac.”
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere erâ Wofuŋte dâŋ porofete Jeremiarao fuawec ʒine hâcne.
Aigita mâreŋte dâŋ â Aigita ŋicwofuŋ, ʒâŋene Farao Neko ere momori guru irec dâŋ. Jaŋe Eufrata opâo, Kakemisi haeo domahapie Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza eki jopawec. Ine Josiare ŋokâ Jojakim e Juda ŋicwofuŋ erâ juhame jara 4 ewec dameŋ ira.
“Ŋoŋe maro piticne â kâcɋene hepie hume ʒikare ware birickeniŋ!
Becâsic becsahac wiac râe‐jare‐fârerâ ŋaŋacne wâc ferâ ŋeniŋ, aeŋdu hepie huoc, damu sându qâteckeniŋ, â maruku wâc hepie huoc!
Hâc, no ine wemo honekopac? Jaŋe hâwic‐jopaha wiseŋgopieŋ i! Qac momorifâc‐jeŋic bawahac‐jopakicnere siŋsaŋ qahuc wise wisehuc risie fi mi eŋgopieŋ. Rârec rârec hâhâwic sasawa, Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
Ŋic kike afeczi eipierâ sâcne mi wiseocmu, â ŋic tâpiri wânʒâŋheczi sahac‐ticne sâcne mi ŋezickeocmu. Faic mâreŋko Eufrata opâ mecnao fâfâc‐jopame waha jopaocmu hâcne.
“Mozi Nilu opâ iŋucne siwiŋnerâ sokakac, ehuc opâ‐ticnezi opâ sâko iŋucne ruminehec fisikac me?
Aigita mâreŋzi hâcne Nilu opâ iŋucne siwiŋnerâ sokakac, â opâ‐ticne i opâ sâko iŋucne ruminehec fisikac. Ehuc mukac: No sokarâ mâreŋ qofackepemu, ehuc hae ŋerakac ine ima bahuc ŋecjucfâc‐jeŋic bâsirowec‐jopapemu.
Ajoc, becâsic ŋoŋe gasackeniŋ, keretac ŋoŋe ʒocnehec raniŋ! Ŋic qac momori ŋoŋe ʒikare afeckeniŋ, Etiopia â Puti mâreŋ rune maro hepie huekac â Ludi mâreŋkonec tepere fuŋne mamana ŋoŋe hâcne.
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa i Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere ʒoaŋ, okac babazure ʒoaŋ hâcne, e ira râsifâc‐ticne jaŋere okac babazu gie baocte. Ʒika‐ticnezi dameŋ ira ŋic nâcjopahuc socjeŋic nâ gapec tâmiric nâku biric boroc eocmu. Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e fâic mâreŋko Eufrata opâo taha bâzi moc fuacneocte giene baocmu hâcne.
O Aigita ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ, go Gileade haeo ferâ wokemaŋ rozemec! Go marasiŋ wiac bocjaha i maŋgâŋ rohuc juekic, go mocwâc mi biaŋkemu.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe mimi busâqocgere biŋe manaŋgopieŋ, â kio owage i mâreŋ sâckerâ fokac. Momori moc e momori âgo‐ticnehec hehetuŋ ehuc rândiŋkerâ mâmâc jaha mâreŋko waha jofaekac hâcne.”
Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza e Aigita mâreŋ ima baocte fisizo ewec irec dâŋ Wofuŋzi porofete Jeremia âzâcnewec i kecʒiŋuc:
“Aigita mâreŋko musaweniŋ, â Migidoli ira mufuaniŋ; Memfisi â Tapanese haeo ira mufuaniŋ wâc, ehuc muniŋ: ‘Go sanaŋkerâ ʒawiehuc domac, wiac rârecguhuc fokac i ʒikazi ɋâcke‐fâreocmu hâcne.’
Qac momorige e fuŋne weniŋucte sanaŋkerâ mi domahuc rândiŋkewec? I Wofuŋzi herândiŋkewec irec.
Guru sâkofâcge jaŋe fâfâc‐jopame waha jopawec, ehame ʒiŋuc nazaŋ gazaŋ embiŋ: ‘Ajoc, fific gururiŋfâc‐nâŋec jaŋere ʒikare erâ fahare guru‐nâŋecko â fufua hae mâreŋ‐nâŋecko risienaŋ.’
Farao, Aigita ŋicwofuŋ ere ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc muniŋ: ‘Dameŋ qâtirihuc ojawa qaqa.’
“Wofuŋ Sâko, ʒâŋene Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: No jujâmbâŋkekopacte Taboro tikizi tiki gâcne jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋekac, â Karamele tikizi hâwec heririŋko ŋekac irec sâc ŋic moczi ware fisiocmu.
Aigita ŋecjucfâc‐ticne ŋoŋe wisezore he wiac‐ŋeŋic bâmockeniŋ! Memfisi hae ʒoczi ʒâseŋkeme sesuctac fuarâ foocmu.
“Aigita mâreŋ e bulimakao ŋokacne ɋâricne hawari biaŋ iŋucne, e hâcne faic mâreŋkonec neŋgeczi râsi fisicneocmu.
Momorifâc‐ticne mâreŋ ira jaba juhuc moneŋte erâ ʒika gie baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bulimakao wokemaŋnehec iŋucne; jei, jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha fotikierâ mâmâc wiseniŋmu, jaŋe sisipiric dameŋ‐jeŋic, bâbâtiŋ dameŋ‐jeŋic hâcne izi maic‐jopame mi sanaŋkeniŋmu.
“Fânâŋ‐ticne i homazi foforâ juhuc fânâŋkeekac iŋucne; râsifâc‐ticne jaŋe tâpirihec fisiniŋmu, ehuc jâc qafaraeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc râric barâ fisi‐jareniŋmu.
Jaŋe jâckâte‐ticne uupicnehec i sifu qafaranʒepieŋ, jaŋe ɋirikiŋ jaŋere ʒare jâurueŋgopieŋ, mi wowosec‐jopane.
Aigitare otâ e qurutuaocmu, e faic mâreŋkonec ŋicguru moc jaŋere meo feocmu hâcne. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manaŋgopieŋ, no Tebeŋ mâreŋkonec Amoŋ nemu mecne â Farao mecne erâ Aigitare nemu â ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe okacne fisi‐jarepemu, Farao erao qohotaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne.
No juju‐jeŋic sipirickezo muŋgopieŋ jaŋere meo râec‐jopapemu; Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza â kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne kâcɋene jaŋere meo hâcne. Juku wiac i fua tarame Aigita mâreŋko ŋic mârâc jaha ŋeŋe juju ejumbieŋ irec sâc mocwâc ŋeŋe juju enʒepieŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Jakobo go ine mi hâwicguzejec, â Israe go mi fâfârezemec; manakic, no hâcne mâreŋ taickonec bataracgupemu erâ ɋâricfâcge jaŋe kâpâcwâruo juŋgopieŋ mâreŋ irecnec jowac‐jopa warepemu; eme Jakobo e mâreŋ‐ticnao risierâ wama faio juzejec, erâ mana mezac tâmiric juha moczi moc mu hâhâwic mi ecnezejec.
Kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Jakobo no gohec jukopacte mi hâwicguzejec. Tuŋgupe ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko hurâ jumeŋ jaŋe sasawa bâsirowec‐jopapemu, go ine mi bâsirowecgupemu. Aricne, mana manahuc sawa bâtiŋgupemu, okacne tâmiric mâc jâmbâŋ jucmurâ ine mi manakopac. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Farao e ʒika qahuc Gaza hae ima mi bahame Filisa jaŋere biŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ porofete Jeremiarao fuawec ʒine hâcne.
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Manaŋgopieŋ, faic mâreŋkonec opâ sâko warehuc jukac, fisirâ rumi iŋucne roma roma baocmu, ehuc mâreŋ â fainao wiac forakac, erâ hae maŋnao ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc qâuruc‐jopa‐fâreocmu. Eme ŋic jaŋe owa bitaŋ enʒepieŋ, â mâreŋ ŋecjufâc‐ticne jaŋe kio huse efârenʒepieŋ.
Becâsicfâc‐ticne jaŋere kike fânâŋ â keretac â ʒafeŋgâŋnere fânâŋ irec erâ mamac jaŋe naru motecfâc‐jeŋic honec‐jopaniŋte mi fotikieniŋmu, bipic tatara ejareha maŋjeŋic gâckeme iŋuc eniŋmu.
I Filisa ŋic jaŋe sipiricke‐fâreniŋte â Tiro â Sidoŋ jaŋere âgofâc nâfocne juŋgopieŋ jaŋe wâc siroweniŋte dameŋne maickekacte iŋuc eniŋmu. Wofuŋ noni hâcne Filisa ŋic, Kafatori nuc irecnec ŋic ʒanʒaŋne sipiric‐jopapemu.
Gaza haezi makuc bakac, â Asikaloŋ haezi niniŋkekac. Anaka ŋic irec ʒanʒaŋne ŋoŋe sahac‐ŋeŋic hetâcneeŋgopieŋ i wezimucko beheniŋmu?
Ŋoŋe muŋgopieŋ: ‘Jei, Wofuŋte ʒika go wezimucko ŋemanacmu? Go becsahacgao risierâ huc, erâ niniŋkerâ fohuc juzemec!’
Mâc Wofuŋ noni giedâŋ mucnepore wemocko ŋemanaocmu? No hâcne Asikaloŋ hae â hâwec mâreŋ ira ra râsi ejareocte mutâcnecnepo.”
Moabi mâreŋte dâŋ. Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Jei, Nebo hae i ima bakicne, â Kiriataim hae i mimi qaqa ecnerâ rauckekicne. Hae sanaŋ i qurutuawec â heroc qâropiekicne.
Moabi ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne omaewec. Sisipiric fuacneocte râsi jaŋe Hesiboŋ haeo dâŋticne mana biric ehuc ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: ‘Ajoc, mâreŋ i imackenaŋ, eme irec rune ŋicguru mocwâc mi junʒepieŋ!’ Eme Madameŋ haeo go iŋuc jaha bâniniŋguzo, eme ʒikazi kikeo kikeo egarehuc bâjâpecguocmu.
“Mananiŋ! Horonaim haeonec kio owa ʒiŋuc fuarâ warekac, ‘Ima samaki â sisipiric sâko!’
Moabi i ima bakicne, eme irec kio owa epie Zoari haeo ira manaŋgopieŋ.
Jei, Luhiti haeo kiohuc feŋgopieŋ, jei, Horonaim heâŋko wahahuc sisipiricte erâ kio owa epie dâŋ ʒiŋuc fuakac:
Wiseniŋ, juju‐ŋeŋic ŋezickeniŋ; kâte doŋgi irec sâcko mâreŋ burocnao juniŋ!
Go ficsanaŋ ŋerakac â moneŋ mafa wiage fogarekac irec manatec fewecte gowac rozo, â Kemosi nemu e taha bapafâc‐ticne jaŋehec kâpâcwâru ficko ranʒepieŋ.
Sisipiric ŋic e hae ŋerakac sâc fisi‐jareocmu, hae moc mi akickeocmu; ŋic opâ qacnerâ juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe omaeniŋmu â wâneŋne wâneŋne jaŋe sisipiricte biŋe eniŋmu, ine Wofuŋ noni mupo irec sâcko.
“Moabi fafakec râcnepie furuc furuc qarâ wisezejec; hae‐ticne ŋerakac i sesuctac fuarâ fozejec, maŋnao ŋic mocwâc mi junʒepieŋ!
“Moc e Wofuŋte gie ʒoɋac tâmiric mâc bâpârâckeocmu e sâwecte biŋe ezejec, â ŋic moc e ʒika‐ticne soczi ruacnezacte aka hecneocmu e iŋuc jaha sâwecte biŋe ezejec.
“Moabi ŋic jaŋe juwicnaonecteaŋ wama faio juwarembiŋ. Ehuc moseŋ e mâreŋ ijaha sesuc‐ticne barâ ba eekac irec sâc jaha jaŋe mâreŋ‐jeŋicko jurâ ju embiŋ, ehame batac bawarec mi ejarekicne, â kâpâcwâruo moc mi bacjopa rakicne. Irec juju‐jeŋic aŋacnehec foweczi fokac, â hosâc‐jeŋic mi omaewec.
“Irec manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira ine gie bapa ŋic râec‐jopape fisi‐jarerâ rowaŋfic‐jeŋic heroc qâropieniŋmu â ʒocjeŋic hetâc qâtâtieniŋmu.
Iŋuc fuame Moabi ŋic jaŋe nemu‐jeŋicte mimierâ qurutuanʒepieŋ, ine Israe kikefuŋzi Bete haeo roweckehuc mimierâ qurutuawec irec sâc.
“Ŋoŋe wemo‐ŋeŋiczi ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Nâŋe ŋic qac momorihec â ʒikaŋic fârine?’
Ima bapazi Moabi mâreŋ â hae‐ticne sasawa fisi‐jareocmu, ehame ŋicmotecfâc‐jeŋic sanaŋne jaŋe ʒikare nânâ eniŋmu. Wofuŋ Sâko, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Moabi sisipiric dameŋ‐ticne bembeŋkekac, â ʒârâ ʒâpâ‐ticne i biac jaha maickezo ekac.
Râreckehuc ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋ â ʒâŋe‐ticne manaeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe sasawa busâqoc manacneniŋ, ehuc muniŋ: ‘Ŋicwofuŋ gunu sanaŋ biaŋ i weniŋmu erâ hericke ʒaŋ ewec’?
“Diboŋ hae rune, ŋoŋe popoonec waharâ rufe faio ŋeniŋ, Moabi mâreŋte ima bapazi fisi‐ŋarerâ ficsanaŋ‐ŋeŋic heroc qâropieocmu hâcne.
Aroe haere ŋecjucfâc, ŋoŋe hatamecko ra ʒâŋe fipie raoc! Ehuc ŋic ŋokac wisehuc juŋgopieŋ jaŋe wio‐jarehuc muniŋ, ‘Wemo wiac moc fuawec?’
Moabi e qurutuawec, maŋticne omaewec hâcne; kio huse â kio owa eniŋ! Ehuc Moabi ima bakicne i Aronoŋ opâo fisirâ mufuaniŋ.
“Mareŋ wâneŋ sâko i okacne fisicnewec, hae kecʒiŋuc jaŋe fisi‐jarewec hâcne: Holoŋ, Jaza â Mefata,
erâ Diboŋ â Nebo â Bete‐Dibilataim,
erâ Kiriataim â Bete‐Gamulu â Bete‐Meoŋ,
erâ Kerioti â Bozera erâ Moabi mâreŋko hae sâko gâcne sasawa, bembeŋko me ʒoricko ŋeraŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc.
Moabi tâpiri‐ticne bawahakicne â mene qazukicne, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Opâ sanaŋ gumepie maŋne sifuckezejec, e Wofuŋ râsi ecnehuc sahac fefe boc ewec irec. Moabi e waha qarâ e jahacne mamaŋu ruame ŋic jaŋe honerâ mu gâgâwi ecnenʒepieŋ.
Me goki Israe mu gâgâwi mi ecnehuc jumeŋ me? E fiuc roro jaŋere ŋondeŋko moc bâfuakicne, irec ere dâŋ mu bâuac ehuc qizec fofotaric ecnehuc jumeŋ me?
“O Moabi mâreŋte ŋecjucfâc, ŋoŋe hae sâko beherâ qânâ hawecko juniŋ me! Ŋoŋe sâro fozic wipe jaŋe hârâc mecko sareŋ‐jeŋic baeŋgopieŋ irec sâc eniŋ!
Nâŋe Moabi sahac fefe‐ticnere manambeŋ, sahac fefe‐ticne i hâhâwicne. E pepec ʒâŋehec, penaroŋhec, pepec sâkohec â maŋfefehec.
Wofuŋ no pepec penaroŋ‐ticne manakopac; jawadâŋ‐ticne i racne â eebapa‐ticne i wiac fârine aricne.
No irec hâcne Moabi jaŋere erâ kio huse ekopac, Moabi sasawa jaŋere erâ kio owa ekopac, â Kiri‐Heresi ŋic jaŋere erâ makuc bakopac.
O Sibemanec waiŋ qizec, no gore erâ kiokopac i Jazere haere kiombiŋ irec sâc sawa mâcne, fehuc kiokopac hâcne. Qaŋeŋfâcge jaŋe hâwec fotâcnerâ haŋ baraku Jazere haeo fisimbiŋ. Sisipiric ŋic eki ine ro nusec dameŋko fisirâ nânâ wiacge â waiŋ hândâŋge imackewec.
Bubiaŋ â ʒeri i mâreŋ guec‐ticnehec â Moabi mâreŋ ira arictac ewec; noni mupe oto sâko ŋerakac ira waiŋzi omaezejec, waiŋ bapazi waiŋ hândâŋne aŋara hehuc mocwâc mi âte pisickeniŋmu, aŋara heniŋmu i aŋara fârine aricne.
“Hesiboŋ â Eleale rune kio owa‐jeŋicte fânâŋ i raku Jahazi ira fisikac; jaŋe marac fânâŋ‐jeŋic bafaharepie Zoarionec Horonaim â Egela‐Selisia fisikac, i Nimirim opâzi ʒicke kereŋ ekac wâc.
No Moabi ira bâzi ririkere tikio ferâ nemu‐jeŋic hosâc âsu rikecneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne omaec‐jopapemu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Irec maŋnanezi Moabi mâreŋte erâ ŋafe wipe iŋucne dâŋehuc kio huse ekac, â Kiri‐Heresi ŋic jaŋere erâ maŋnanezi ŋafe wipe iŋucne dâŋehuc kio huse ekac; i huhure wiac‐jeŋic sipirickewecte.
“Qizec â mecʒâwâ‐jeŋic i bâtâcne‐fârekicne; mesahac‐jeŋic sasawa hetâcnekicne â mateŋ qonaŋkepie waha domakac.
Moabi mâreŋte ficbupu sâc wâwâneŋ bakicne irec faio â hae ʒoŋa sâc ira ki mamakuc fua‐fârekac; i noni Moabi mâreŋ kuʒi qaisockehuc qanʒaŋnekicne irec sâc qanʒaŋnepo, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Jei, qanʒaŋnekicne i sâc moc, â kio huse eeŋgopieŋ i sâc moc! Jei, Moabi e fotikierâ mimiehuc wisekac i sâc moc! Ehame râreckehuc ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋzi nifepupu ecneeŋgopieŋ, ehuc ere manapie bipic tataranehec ekac.”
Wofuŋ no ʒiŋuc mukopac hâcne: “Manaŋgopieŋ, moczi tucwipe iŋucne Moabi râsi fisicnerâ fakecne qaratiehuc sâocke‐fâreocmu.
Ehame hae ŋerakac i ro rauc eniŋmu â ficsanaŋ wiac i sakareniŋmu. Dameŋ ira Moabi qac momorifâc‐ticne jaŋere maŋ i ŋokac moc motec roocte gozi kime maŋne gâckeekac irec sâc eocmu.
Moabi qa sipiric ecnepie ŋicguru mocwâc mi juocmu, e Wofuŋ no fenarehuc penaroŋ ewec irec.
O Moabi ŋecjucfâc, ŋoŋe hâhâwic â nombâŋ â wiwitic wiac izi maic‐ŋopazejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme moc e wiac hâhâwicne wisecneocmu e nombâŋko huzejec, â moc e nombâŋkonec wefuocmuczi wiwiticko ferâ kizejec. No Moabi rune jaŋere faio wiac i hâcne okac babazu dameŋ‐jeŋicko râepe feocmu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Ŋic wiseniŋmu jaŋe betaŋkerâ Hesiboŋ haere mumucko domaniŋmu; Hesiboŋ haeonec ine ʒoc â Sihoŋte fickonec ʒocbâruŋ fuarâ Moabi ŋic ojowa qaŋgopieŋ jaŋere qizec ʒâseŋkeocmu.
Jei, Moabi rune! Kemosi nemu ŋicfâc‐ticne ŋoŋe sipiric‐ŋopakicne; naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe rocjoparâ kâpâcwâruo bacjopa rakicne hâcne.
No ine dameŋ tataranao Moabi kâpâcwâruo juju‐ticne i mupe arictac eocmu.” Wofuŋzi Moabi mâreŋte okacdâŋ muwec i ʒira tarakac hâcne.
Amoŋŋic jaŋere dâŋ. Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Israe e ŋokâfâcne moc mi jucneŋgopieŋ me? Me merâfâc‐ticne rauckeniŋte irec ŋic wâc arictac me? Eme Milikom nemu e Gade mâreŋ wemocte rauckewec, â ŋicfâcne jaŋe wemocte hae sâko‐ticne ŋerakac irec maŋnao ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋ?
Irec mananiŋ: Dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira Amoŋŋic jaŋere hae sâko Raba irec mupe ʒikare ojowa fuacnezejec; eme hae i sesuctac fuarâ foha hae piticfâc‐ticne ʒoczi ʒâseŋ‐jopazejec. Eme Israe e mâreŋ‐ticne jâoc rombiŋ i mocwâc jowac rozejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“O Hesiboŋ hae, go ima bapazi fisi‐garekacte kio owa ezemec; Rabare otâfâc ŋoŋe wira wâwâsic enʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe mateŋ qonaŋkehuc ki mamakuc eniŋ, ehuc ŋaŋaczia sahac‐ŋeŋic hetâc qâtâcneniŋ! Milikom nemu e taha bapafâc‐ticne â fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋehec kâpâcwâru ficko raniŋmu hâcne.
Naru maŋrâŋgeŋne micrereŋ tâmiric go mâriri rowaŋgao roweckehuc wemocte opâwâcgere penaroŋ boc ekomec, ehuc mukomec, ‘Mozi sâcne sanaŋke‐nareocmu?’
Manakic, no mupe rârecguhuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec wiac hâhâwicnezi fua‐garezejec, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Eme ŋoŋe ru sâc bâtâtiec‐ŋopazo, ehame wiseniŋmu jaŋe moczi moc mi hetumaŋ‐jopaocmu.
Eme juku ʒâhec ine Amoŋŋic kâpâcwâruo juju‐jeŋic i mupe arictac eocmu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Edomŋic jaŋere dâŋ. Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Temaŋ hae mâreŋko maŋɋârâŋ arictac efârewec me? Fuŋne mamana jaŋe mamana‐jeŋic omaewec â maŋɋârâŋ‐jeŋic sifuckewec me?
O Dedaŋ mâreŋ rune, ŋoŋe ʒirecnec wiserâ ra soŋkepaŋkeniŋ! No Esau, Edom hâcne sisipiric‐ticne, okac dameŋ‐ticne hâcne i fainao râepe feocmu irec.
Waiŋ hândâŋne bâtâcneeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe fisi‐garerâ hândâŋ nâfocne mi behepie foocmu, ŋafeo fiuc roro jaŋe fisirâ ejareme sâc roniŋmu.
No hâcne Esau wiac‐ticne jâoc rofârekopac, â haesoŋ‐ticne ŋerakac i bataniŋke‐fârekopac, irec soŋkeocte eipiekac. Naru motecfâcne mecne, qomâfâc‐ticne â diguracfâc‐ticne jaŋe mâmâc jopa sipiric ejarekicne, eme arictac ewec.
Bekâfâcge behec‐jopatec noni hone maiŋ ejarezepac, â hozecfâcge jaŋe norao roweckenʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, opâ ʒaʒacne nânâ irec sâc mi jumbiŋzi sifu nâjâmbâŋkeniŋmuo ine go wemocko bâbâtiŋ tâmiric mâc jufecmu? Aricne, go bâbâtiŋ tâmiric moc mi juhuc opâ ʒaʒacne nâjâmbâŋkezemec jaha.
No nahacne ʒâŋeo ɋetickehuc mupaŋkepo; ŋic gâcnezi Bozera haere qâqiŋ qahuc mu hâhâwic â mimi busâqoc â sâwecdâŋ munʒepieŋ, ehame hae piticfâc‐ticne sasawa jaŋe sesuctac fuarâ fonʒepieŋ sanaŋ. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Eme Jeremiazi muwec: No Wofuŋtaonec biŋedâŋ moc manapo, ehame ŋicne ŋicŋe jaŋerao kiŋaŋŋic moc ʒiŋuc muocte sorewec: “Ŋoŋe qâturerâ Edom râsi fisicneniŋ, ʒikare fahareniŋ!
Manakic, ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko bawahacgupe qaisocgunʒepieŋ.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe gore hâwic‐jopame honec‐joparâ maŋge sifuckeme maŋfefe emeŋ, haroŋaŋ hawecko me tiki botâŋko jukomec go hâcne. Go tucwipe iŋucne sareŋge hahaŋko jâmbâŋ batecne no sifu irecnec tuŋgupe huzemec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Edom e niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ foha ŋic sasawa jâuruniŋmu jaŋe bipic tatara ejareocmu, â qa bâtiŋ ecnekicne irec mu ruruc ecneniŋmu.
Ine Sodom â Gomora â hae gâcne rârec‐jofahuc ŋerambiŋ jaŋe sisipiric fua‐jarewec irec sâc jaha fuacneme ŋiczi ira ŋec juc mocwâc mi enʒepieŋ, â hae maŋnao jaba juju i wâc mi fuazejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Manakic, laioŋ e Jordaŋ uupickonec wefurâ lama jaŋere sapao fisiekac irec sâc jaha ututuŋ jâpec‐jopape wisenʒepieŋ; ehame ŋic moc biac bâwosâekicne e irec soŋaŋ juocte mucnepemu. Me no iŋucne mozi moc jukac? Me mozi moc dâŋgieo râecnuocmu? Me mo soŋaŋzi nore maio sanaŋkerâ domaocmu?
Irec Wofuŋ no Edom mâreŋte dâŋ mupaŋkepo i mecne â Temaŋ mâreŋ rune jaŋere dâŋ mana biric epo i mâmâc mananiŋ: Jei, lama wahakicne jaŋe wâc mâmâc bawisec‐jopaniŋmu. Jâmbomac, wiac fua‐jareocmu irec erâ sapa‐jeŋic weaŋkerâ foocmu.
Jaŋe rândiŋkerâ jopame fânâŋ sâko fuame mâreŋzi ɋiɋiteckeocmu, ehame kio owa‐jeŋic i Hâwec Bâbâroŋko mananiŋmu.
Manakic, moczi tucwipe iŋucne faharerâ furuc furuc qahuc Bozera hae râsi fisicnerâ fafakecne qaratiehuc sâockeocmu. Dameŋ ira Edom qac momorifâc‐ticne jaŋere maŋ i ŋokac moc gozi kime maŋne omaeekac irec sâc eocmu.”
Damasko irec dâŋ. “Hamati â Arapada hae rune jaŋe biŋe bâroŋ moc manambiŋte qurutuambiŋ. Mana mezac ehapie maŋjeŋic omaekac, maŋwama bâfuaniŋte eipieŋgopieŋ.
Damasko hae rune jaŋe maŋjeŋic betaŋkeme wiseniŋte fotikiembiŋ, jaŋe ɋarac ɋarac qaŋgopieŋ; ehame ŋokac gozi kime hâwickeha ʒâic manaekac irec sâc ejarekac.
Jei, hae ʒâŋe biŋehec â ʒeri‐ticnehec i sesuctac jâmbâŋ fuarâ fokac i!
Irec ŋicmotecfâc‐ticne jaŋe hae ʒoŋa‐ticnao hâmoniŋmu, â ʒikaŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe ʒoaŋ ira sipiricke‐fâreniŋmu; Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme no Damasko haere sac turuŋkepe ʒaocmu, ehame Beŋhada erific wiac‐ticne ʒâseŋkezejec.”
Kedara mâreŋ rune â Hazoro hae irec ŋicguru ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋichec Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukanezazi jopawec jaŋere dâŋ. Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ajoc, ŋoŋe Kedara mâreŋ râsi ecnehuc ira ranʒepieŋ, ehuc ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec ŋic jopanʒepieŋ!
Qoruc boze‐jeŋic â lamafâc‐jeŋic jowac rozo, bilaŋke â wâcwiac‐jeŋic gâcne mâmâc; kamelefâc‐jeŋic bacjopa razo, ehame ŋic ʒiŋuc mu ojowa ejarenʒepieŋ: ‘Rârec rârec wiac hâhâwicne fofârekac i!’
Hazoro rune, ŋoŋe wiseniŋ, Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza e wiac repicne eŋarezo maŋkekacte â sipiric‐ŋopaocte dâŋne manasu biric ekacte bâruŋ jaha ra tâmirerâ soŋkepaŋkeniŋ me! Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Ajoc, ŋoŋe faharerâ ŋicguru mana mezac tâmiric wama faio jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe râsi fisi‐jareniŋ; jaŋe hae‐jeŋicte motâc babasanaŋ‐ticne aricne, bucjeŋic juŋgopieŋ hâcne, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Kamelefâc‐jeŋic jowac ronʒepieŋ, â hae qowifâc‐jeŋic guru sâko i ŋoŋere biŋe ezejec. Noni ine qizec susuc‐jeŋic naki ŋifec â ŋifec bâtâcneeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe hâcne mâreŋ sâc bâtâtiec‐jopapemu, erâ mupe rârec rârec irecnec sisipiriczi maic‐jopazejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme Hazoro hae i kâte qâto jaŋere ŋeŋe hae ezejec, ehuc sesuctac fohuc juzejec sanaŋ. Ehame moczi moc ira ŋec juc mocwâc mi ezejec, â ŋic moczi maŋnao ju fofo wâc mi ezejec.”
Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia e ŋicwofuŋ gie‐ticne fuŋkerâ juha Elamŋic jaŋere dâŋ Wofuŋtaonec porofete Jeremiarao fuawec ine ʒiŋuc:
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, no Elamŋic tâpiri‐jeŋicte ŋesiŋ, tepe‐jeŋic hâcne i bazu‐jarepemu.
Ehuc mupe mâreŋ tuturuŋne 4 irecnec mâŋâŋ 4 jaŋe fisirâ Elamŋic jopapie faic â juwic, ŋifec â ŋifec rafârenʒepieŋ. Erâ Elamŋic qâtâtiec‐jopakicne jaŋe ŋicguru juraŋgopieŋ sasawa jaŋerao sâckerâ fisiniŋmu.
Râsi ejarehuc juju‐jeŋic sipirickezo muŋgopieŋ jaŋere maio ejarepe maŋjeŋic gâckezejec; ehame sisipiric, maŋnanere ʒocbâruŋ hâcne, i fai‐jeŋicko râepe fezejec, â mupe ʒikazi bâjâpec‐jopa rahuc nâmiziec‐jopazejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
No dâŋ mumutara ŋeŋe‐nane Elam mâreŋko hepe ŋezejec, erâ ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic mecne, fekicnefâc‐jeŋic mecne mâmâc bâsirowec‐jopazepac.
Dameŋ tataranao ine Elamte faio wiac hâhâwicne râepe fewec i bârâriezepac, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋ e Babe hae â Kaldea mâreŋte dâŋ porofete Jeremia ere micko râeme mufuawec i kecʒiŋuc:
“Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko dâŋ binaŋ ʒiŋuc ejarepie mananʒepieŋ, ehame filac fârepie fezejec! Dâŋ moc mi hesoŋkehuc musaweniŋ: ‘Babe hae i ro rauc ekicne, Beli nemuzi qurutuawec, â Merodac nemu e henʒaŋ qanʒaŋnekicne; nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe qurutuambiŋ, â ɋâŋ qâqâtâcfâc‐jeŋic henʒaŋ qanʒaŋ‐jopakicne.’
“Faic mâreŋkonec hâcne ŋicguru moc jaŋe râsi fisi‐jarerâ mâreŋ‐jeŋic ima baniŋmu, eme ŋic moczi moc ira ŋec juc mocwâc mi ezejec, aricne, ŋic mecne qowi mecne irecnec wiserâ ratâmirenʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Dameŋ ira Israe ŋic â Judaŋic jaŋe mâmâc jaha kiohuc ware fisiniŋmu, ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋic no wira basac enareniŋmu.
Jaŋe Zioŋ hatare mu wioc eniŋmu, ehuc irapec ʒâŋe fihuc muniŋmu: ‘Ajoc, nâŋâc Wofuŋtao qohotarâ ʒâʒâfic fofo sanaŋ moc enʒepeneŋ, eme irec ninikec moc mi fua‐jâmbâŋkezejec.’
“Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe lama sifuckekicne iŋucne; soŋaŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe eatuc‐jopapie qac qâsoric embiŋ, jaŋe ejarepie tiki mâreŋko rac warec ehuc jumbiŋ, ehuc mâreŋ tikine facne bazu behec eku sapa‐jeŋicte nikec‐jopawec.
Eme bâfuac‐jopambiŋ sâc jaŋe nâcjopambiŋ, â kisâfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mumbiŋ, ‘Nâŋe kiŋ mi hotâckeŋgopeneŋ, jaŋe Wofuŋ sapa‐jeŋic fârine, mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe worickehuc jumbiŋ e hâcne bunao bambiŋ irec.’
“Ajoc, ŋoŋe Babe haeonec wiseniŋ, Kaldea ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ beheniŋ, ehuc lama ŋicne jaŋe gurufâc‐jeŋic bânie‐jareeŋgopieŋ irec sâc eniŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no faic mâreŋkonec ŋicne ŋicne guru sâko mu qafeŋ ejarepe Babe hae râsi fisicnenʒepieŋ, ehuc meo roroc erâ sanaŋkehuc rauckenʒepieŋ, tepe motec‐jeŋic ine ʒikaŋic fârinezi metariŋ mi risieekac e iŋucne.
Iŋuc fuame Kaldea mâreŋ i ʒikare mateŋ eocmu, eme mateŋ roniŋmu jaŋe sâcjopa‐fârezejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Oi, nore mâreŋkonec wiac fiuc rombiŋ ŋoŋe bubiaŋ manazo murâ mananiŋ, â ʒeri ezo murâ eniŋ, ehuc bulimakao motecne kecɋaŋ geunao kiwac qawac eeŋgopieŋ iŋuc eniŋ, â becâsic ŋicnezi dâŋsâko dâŋeekac iŋuc dâŋeniŋ!
Neŋgoc‐ŋeŋiczi ine qurutua‐jâmbâŋkeocmu â rocŋopawec e mimieocmu; jâmbomac, e ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere wahamicne ehuc mâreŋ burocne â kereŋne â sawane iŋucne ezejec.
I Wofuŋ kimbeŋ‐nanere erâ tuhutac fuame niniŋ siarereŋ fojâmbâŋkeocmu; eme Babe hae jâuruniŋmu sâc jaŋe bipic tatara ejareocmu, â ʒârâ ʒâpâ‐ticnere mu ruruc ecneniŋmu.
Tepeŋic sasawa ŋoŋe Babe hae somâ baniŋ, jaŋe sâqocne bahuc Wofuŋ bunaneo bambiŋte tepe qâtâcnepie haeo feoc, tepe motec moc mi sakareniŋ!
Rârec rârec ʒiŋuc muhuc aŋara heniŋ: E dockewec, wâtuŋ‐ticne rândiŋke qawec, qânâsac‐ticne heroc qâropiekicne. Wofuŋ nore okac babazu dameŋ fuakacte okacne bazucneniŋ; eki wiac ewec sâc ijaha ecnenʒepieŋ.
Wiac hândâŋne tieeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mecne â qa roro dameŋko sâqe mictarazi gie baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc bâsirowec‐jopaniŋ! Eme ŋic gâcne jaŋe ru sâc ʒikazi hâmoc bâfuaekac i hâhâwic bacnerâ guru‐jeŋicko risieniŋmu, â ru sâc jaha mâreŋ‐jeŋicko wiserâ raniŋmu.
“Israe kikefuŋ e lama moc laioŋ jaŋe jâpepie qac qâsoric eekac irec sâc; e qanaŋ Asiria ŋicwofuŋte nânâ ewec, izi ʒâhec ine Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza eki siec‐ticne kinʒaŋnewec.
Irec Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Manakic, no Asiria ŋicwofuŋ okac bazucnepo irec sâc jaha Babe ŋicwofuŋ â mâreŋ‐ticne ejactepemu.
Erâ Israe e juju‐ticnao bârisiepe Karamele tikio â Basaŋ mâreŋko nânâ nâhuc juzejec, erâ Eferaim tiki mâreŋko â Gileade ira wâc nâku gapeckezejec.
Dameŋ ira Israe kiŋticnere mu wioc ehuc sifu mi bâfuaniŋmu. Ehame Juda sâqocne‐ticne wâc basaniŋmu, no ŋic nâfocne juniŋte mana‐jarepemu jaŋe sâqocne bâtâmire‐jarepemu irec. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Go Merataim mâreŋ râsi ecnehuc ira razemec, erâ Pekodo ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe wâc râsi fisi‐jarezemec. Ehuc joparâ bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârezemec, â dâŋ gaza mutâc epo i efârezemec. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Mâreŋ‐jeŋicko ʒikare ojowa â sisipiric sâko fuawec fokac.
Jei, mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec hama sâko i hefâuckekicne â qanʒaŋnekicne i! Jei, Babe hae e ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe honepie wiac bipic tataranehec ewec i!
O Babe hae, no bitiŋ râe‐garepo, eme go qicqucne juhuc ferâ mi kicguzejec i! Go Wofuŋ no râsi enaremeŋte bâfuacgurâ rocgupo.
Wofuŋ no ʒika rowaŋ‐nanere motâc rorâ kimbeŋ‐nanere sându maro rope wahakac; ine hâcne, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore gie Kaldea ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko fuakac.
Mâreŋ tuturuŋne sâc irecnec râsi fisicneniŋ â! Padi jacgoŋ rowaŋfic‐ticne baandaŋkeniŋ, ehuc padi iŋucne ro guruc ecnerâ ʒoczi rikepie wiac nâfocne moc mi fozejec.
Bulimakaofâc‐ticne ŋicne qâhâmoc‐jopa‐fâreniŋ, hezuc‐jopaniŋte bacjopa raniŋ! Jei, dameŋ‐jeŋic maickekac, okacne babazu‐jare dameŋ hâcne!
“Mananiŋ! Babe mâreŋ beherâ wiseŋgopieŋzi mu ojowa eŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi okac babazu gie bawec, taha ufuŋ‐ticnere okac babazu gie hâcne, irec biŋe Zioŋko musokaniŋte iŋuc eŋgopieŋ.
“Tepeŋiczi tepe tikokoc herâ qâtâcneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe Babe hae râsi ecneniŋte hetumaŋ‐jopa‐fâreniŋ! Eme ra somâ bahapie ŋic moczi moc mi wisezejec. E Wofuŋ Israere Tiri rune no pepec penaroŋ enarewecte eebapa‐ticnere sâcko okacne bazucneniŋ, ehuc wiac eŋarehuc juwec irec sâc jaha ecnenʒepieŋ.
Irec ŋicmotecfâc‐ticne jaŋe hae ʒoŋa‐ticnao ʒikare nânâ enʒepieŋ, â momorifâc‐ticne jaŋe ʒoaŋ ira sipiricke‐fârenʒepieŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Manakic, pepec penaroŋhec go hâcne râsi egarepemu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. No okacne bazu‐garepemurâ dameŋge maikekac hâcne.
Pepec penaroŋhec e dameŋ ira fâfâckeme waha qame moczi mocwâc mi bafaharezejec. Eme no hae‐ticne ŋerakac i turuŋkepe ʒazejec, ehuc rârec rârec wiac forakac i ʒâseŋke‐fârezejec.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Israe ŋic mecne â Judaŋic mecne jaŋe mâmâc jaha fific bacjopakicne. Eme kâpâcwâru ficko bacjopa rambiŋ jaŋe sasawa sakarec‐jopahuc firuec‐jopaniŋte takic‐jopakac.
Fifirue‐jeŋic ʒâŋene Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ine sanaŋne. Eki hâcne dâŋjeŋic dopecke‐jâmbâŋkehuc bafic‐jopame mâreŋko wama fuazejec, Babe ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe ine ejareme sisi hâhâŋ faio junʒepieŋ.
“Kaldea ŋic mecne, Babe ŋecjucfâc‐ticne mecne, fekicnefâc‐ticne mecne erâ ŋicfâc‐ticne mamanahec jaŋere faio ʒikazi fezejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Faŋfaŋdâŋ mumu jaŋere faio ʒikazi feme ŋic mutucne enʒepieŋ. Qac momorifâcne jaŋere faio ʒikazi feme maŋjeŋic omaezejec.
Becâsicfâc‐jeŋic â keretac‐jeŋic erâ ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ŋic sahac hawari fuŋne fuŋnehec juŋgopieŋ jaŋere faio ʒikazi feme ŋokac iŋucne enʒepieŋ. Boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ fojarekac sâc i ʒika fuame ŋiczi fiuc ronʒepieŋ.
Ʒoaŋ sanaŋne qame opâ wiac‐ticne ʒicke kereŋ ezejec. Wiac mâreŋ i nemuɋâŋ jaŋere mâreŋ i! Â ŋicfâcne jaŋe nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic repicne irec erâ maŋjeŋic sifuckekac i!
“Irec Babezi kâte qowi â kâte qâto jaŋere ŋeŋe hae ezejec â hae maŋnao qerazi juzejec wâc; ŋiczi ine ira ŋec juc mocwâc mi enʒepieŋ, â moczi maŋnao ju fofo mocwâc mi ejâmbâŋkezejec.
Anutuzi Sodom â Gomora erâ hae rârec‐jofahuc ŋerambiŋ jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopawec irec sâc jaha fuame ŋic moczi hae ira ŋec juc mocwâc mi ezejec, erâ moczi moc maŋnao ju fofo ee i wâc aricne. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Manakic, faic mâreŋkonec ŋicguru moc ware fisiniŋmu; ŋicguru kâcɋene sâko erâ ŋicwofuŋ bocjaha jaŋe mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaonec jâmbâŋ faharerâ wareniŋmu hâcne.
Jaŋe tepe â sându‐jeŋichec, jaŋe ŋic ʒâʒâicne â busâqoc‐jeŋic tâmiric. Ojowa‐jeŋic i hâwec sirizi fânâŋkeekac iŋucne, jaŋe becâsicko rara ŋic, jaŋe ʒikaŋic iŋucne fisirâ Babe rune go râsi egareniŋmu.
“Babe ŋicwofuŋ e jaŋere biŋe manarâ mene betaŋkekac; e hâhâwic ehuc ŋokac moczi gozi kime fâfâreekac irec sâc ekac.
“Manakic, laioŋzi Jordaŋ uupickonec wefurâ lama jaŋere sapao fisiekac irec sâc no bâruŋ jaha jâpec‐jopape wisenʒepieŋ; eme ŋic biac bâwosâekicne e hâcne âkendâŋnepe ŋicbomboŋ ejarezejec. Mozi nore sâc moc jukac, me mozi dâŋgieo moc râecnuocmu, me mo soŋaŋzi nore maio sanaŋkerâ domaocmu?
Irec Wofuŋ no Babe haere dâŋ mupaŋkepo i mecne â Kaldea mâreŋte dâŋ mana biric epo i mâmâc mananiŋ, kecʒiŋuc: Jei, lama wahakicne jaŋe wâc bacjopa raniŋmu, jâmbomac, wiac fua‐jareocmu irec erâ sapa‐jeŋic weaŋkerâ foocmu.
Eme mâreŋzi wiwira ʒiŋuc manarâ ɋiɋiteckeocmu: Babe hae i ro rauc ekicne! Ehame kio owa‐ticne fuame ŋicne ŋicne hazec‐jeŋicko huocmu.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, no sisipiric ŋic moc qafeŋkepe Babe hae â Kaldea mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne fisi‐jarezejec.
No Babe haeo ŋic oofaŋ‐jeŋichec sorec‐jopape ofaŋne behec enʒepieŋ, ehuc hae mâreŋ nânâ mafa wiac‐ticne jâoc ronʒepieŋ; i sisipiric dameŋko rârec rârec irecnec fisirâ hae somâ bahuc iŋuc hâcne eniŋmu.
Tepeŋic jaŋe tepe tikocko hezo eipienʒepieŋ, â marukuheczi penaroŋ ehuc mi domanʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe ŋicmotecfâc‐jeŋic mi akic‐jopanʒepieŋ, ehuc momorifâc‐jeŋic bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Eme qâhâmoc‐jopakicne i Kaldea ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko â âke mârâŋ‐jopakicne jaŋe hae ʒoŋa‐jeŋicko foranʒepieŋ.
Kaldea mâreŋ i Israe Tiri rune no bunaneo bahuc kiŋhec efârewecte Israe â Juda jahe Anutu‐jekic, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ hâcne no behec‐jofape hozec iŋucne moc mi juzepirec.
“Babe hae mâreŋkonec wiseniŋ, ehuc ere kiŋte erâ mi sipirickehuc ru sâc juju‐ŋeŋic ŋezickenʒepieŋ. Dameŋ i Wofuŋ nore okac babazu dameŋ hâcne, no eebapa‐ticnere okacne râcnepemu.
Babe e Wofuŋ nore meo gol râqâc iŋucne ŋeme mâreŋ sâc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe hone aŋac ehuc waiŋ opâ‐ticne gapecmâc nâpie maŋjeŋic sifuckewec.
Babe haezi ututuŋ waha qahuc qanʒaŋnewec, irec erâ kio owa eniŋ! Ʒâic‐ticnere wokemaŋ rorâ ruacne honeniŋ, eme biaŋke wiac moc eocmu me weniŋuc.
‘Nâŋe Babe bâpiaŋkezo mumbeŋ, e ine bâbâpiaŋkenere sâc mi ewec; irec e beherâ mâreŋ‐nâŋec sâc rafârenaŋ, erao okac babazu fuawec i feku sambâŋ heuakac, â faic karorac fokacko fe fisikac.’
Wofuŋ e bafic‐nâpohuc fuŋne‐nâŋec bataniŋkewec, irec Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋecte eebapa i Zioŋko muromackenaŋ.
“Tepe motec qâteckeniŋ! Maro hepie huoc! Wofuŋ e Babe bâsiroweocte manasuhuc Mede ŋicwofuŋ qafeŋ‐jopame momori wânʒâŋ eŋgopieŋ, izi Wofuŋ okac babazu gie‐ticne, taha ufuŋ‐ticnere okac babazu gie hâcne.
Babe haere qânâsackopec filac fârepie feoc, rucgereŋ juniŋ, soŋaŋ râec‐jopaniŋ â ruc bapa ŋic ejarepie ruc bahuc domaniŋ! Wofuŋ e Babe ŋecjucfâc‐ticne wiac ejareocte mana biric ewec i fârine bâfuaocte ekac hâcne.
Jei, opâ sâko heririŋnao ŋec juc ekomec, â boreŋ ʒeŋaŋge guru sâko fokac go hâmoc dameŋge maickekac â juju dameŋge bâtâcnekicne.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi e jahacne ʒâŋeo ɋetickerâ mupaŋkehuc muwec: Jâmbomac, haemaŋgao ŋic jaŋe jagitotoc iŋucne juipiehapie ine râsi jaŋe sifu fisi‐garehuc semuja hegarenʒepieŋ.
“Tâpiri‐ticnezi mâreŋ bâfuawec â maŋɋârâŋ‐ticnezi mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec hobeteŋne râewec, erâ mamana‐ticnezi sambâŋ qaratiehuc râe rawec
eki hâcne ɋuŋmaŋko dâŋeme sambâŋ rurumaŋnao opâ fânâŋ sâko fuaekac, eki hâcne hoe heocte bâbâric bâfuaekac, â rowaŋ‐ticnaonec mâŋâŋ soreme fisiekac.
Mâreŋŋic jaŋe furu jaha mutucne â mamana tâmiric, golzi wiac bapa sasawa jaŋe ɋâŋ qâqâtâc‐jeŋicte qurutuaeŋgopieŋ, nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe wiac jabane â mi jujune irec.
Jaŋe wiac fârine aricne, wiac hone gâgâwine hâcne; jaŋe bâbâtiŋ dameŋ‐jeŋicko siroweniŋmu.
Anutuzi Jakobore rowaŋ jukac e jaŋere sâc aricne, e hâcne wiac sasawa irec bâbâfua, Israe ŋic jaŋe fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne, ʒâŋe‐ticne Anutu Tapiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Babe go hama‐nane â ʒika‐nane ehuc jumeŋ, iŋuc junarehaŋ no ŋicne ŋicne henʒaŋ‐jopapo erâ ŋicwofuŋ â gurufâc‐jeŋic sipiric‐jopapo.
No hama izi becâsic â becâsicko rara ŋic henʒaŋ qanʒaŋ‐jopapo, erâ keretac â ŋic fainao ŋeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc.
No hama izi ŋic mecne ŋokac mecne, ŋic ŋokac qizecne erâ socɋâri, ŋicmotec â ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ jaŋe henʒaŋ‐jopapo.
No hama izi soŋaŋ â qowifâc‐jeŋic mecne, hesarac ŋic â bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic giere bafic‐jopaeŋgopieŋ mecne, erâ wâc kia sâko â momori micne jaŋe mâmâc henʒaŋ‐jopapo.
“No Babe â Kaldea mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne sasawa jaŋe Zioŋ sindaŋ ecnembiŋ irec okacne ʒâŋe fai‐jeŋicko bazu‐jarepemu. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Sisipiric tiki go manac: Mâreŋ sâc sisipiric bâfuameŋ go râsi egarepemu, gorao hâcne tâpiri‐nanere fuŋne bataniŋkehuc haroŋaŋ faionec tuŋgupe hurâ tiki ʒoczi ʒâseŋkekicne iŋucne ezemec.
Eme goraonec wâtuŋ ropie izi jâmâ wâtuŋ eha râepie huekac i arictac ezejec, me jâc wiac woke qâtâcte biŋe ropie fifisi i wâc arictac jaha ezejec; go hae mâreŋ ima bacgukicne iŋuc fohuc juzemec sanaŋ. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Ŋoŋe mâreŋko filac fârepie feoc! Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko qeŋ qapie dâŋeoc! Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe Babe hae râsi ecneniŋte baʒawiec‐jopaniŋ! Ŋoŋe Ararata â Mini erâ Asekena ŋicguru jaŋe hefârec‐jopapie râsi fisicnenʒepieŋ! Ʒikare micne râec‐jopaniŋ â becâsic ine jagitotoc guru sâko iŋucne bacjopa wareniŋ.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe râsi ecneniŋte baʒawiec‐jopaniŋ, ine Mede mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ â ŋic fekicne â kia sâkofâc‐jeŋic erâ uucmaŋ‐jeŋicko ŋic juraŋgopieŋ sasawa jaŋe hâcne.
Mâreŋ i qiriŋ qahuc ɋiɋiteckeocmu, Wofuŋzi Babe hae mâreŋte dâŋ mana biric ewec i fârine bâfuahuc ima bame tuhutac fuarâ foocmu irec.
Babe qac momorifâc‐ticne jaŋe ʒika gie behembiŋ, ehuc ficsoŋ‐jeŋic ŋerakac sâc ira ŋeŋgopieŋ; jaŋe tâpiri‐jeŋic omaeme ŋokac jaŋe iŋucne embiŋ juŋgopieŋ. Ficjeŋic turuŋkepie ʒakac, â motâc babasanaŋ‐jeŋic i wâc qazukicne.
Hae qizec‐ticne orâŋkehuc ro rauc ekicne irec dâŋ Babe ŋicwofuŋ âzâcneniŋte kiŋaŋŋic â biŋe mumu jaŋe ʒuʒuhuc jaha fisihuc domaŋgopieŋ.
Opâ rendac ŋebâzickerâ soŋaŋkeŋgopieŋ, aka sanaŋ wiac ʒoczi rikepie ʒakac, ehame momori hâbi‐jeŋic goroŋkekac.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Israere Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: Babe haere otâ e nânâ rowaŋficko mâreŋ âtepie sanaŋkeekac irec sâc; eme dameŋ bembeŋne sawa tarame okac dameŋ maickeocmu.”
Zioŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: “Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza e sipiricnuhuc nâcnuwec, e kuʒi tacne iŋucne behecnuwec, e oâ iŋucne erâ ɋâcnume hobu‐ticne fusucmawec, e hae mâreŋ biaŋnaonec jâpecnuwec. No â soctofafâc‐nane wiac sâqocne enârekicne irec kiŋtofa Baberao fozejec.” Â Jerusalemzi ʒiŋuc muzejec: “Socnane hoŋkekicne irec kiŋ i Kaldea mâreŋ rune jaŋerao fozejec.”
<range>
Irec Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, no dâŋge dopeckehuc âkehocgurâ okac babazu gie bapemu. Noni mupe opâ sâko‐ticne kereŋkezejec, â opâ ʒâŋe‐ticne ʒickezejec.
Babe hae ima bapie sesuctacne fuarâ fome kâte qâto jaŋere fic hae ezejec; i ŋic tâmiric foha gâcnezi honehuc bipic tatara ejareha mu ruruc ecnenʒepieŋ.
“Jaŋe babafic ehuc laioŋ iŋucne owackeeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe laioŋ motecne iŋucne ŋuruŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe bujeŋic bâruŋkeme tiwâ ʒepec moc bâmocke‐jarepemu, ehuc maŋsifuc opâ gumec‐jopapemu; eme jaŋe docke betaŋ erâ guŋsanaŋ foku mocwâc mi ɋârenʒepieŋ.
Lama â noniŋ hezuc‐jopaniŋte bacjopa raeŋgopieŋ irec sâc mupe bacjopa raniŋmu.
“Jei, Babe hae i ro rauc ekicne, mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe biŋe i bawahakicne i! Jei, ŋicne ŋicne Babe hae honerâ bipic tatara ejarewec i!
Hâweczi wefurâ Babe hae bârârâŋnewec, â siri sâko‐ticnezi fânâŋkehuc qâuruckewec.
Hae‐ticne ŋerawec i tuhu erâ niniŋ siarereŋ fuawec, mâreŋ kereŋne â burocne hâcne; moczi moc maŋnao ŋec juc mocwâc mi ejâmbâŋkeocmu â ŋic moczi ira sicne fotâc wâc mi eocmu.
Eme no Babe haeo Beli nemu okacne râcnepemu, ehuc wiac ɋâckewec i gozi bape micticnaonec maŋume wahazejec, erâ ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe erao mocwâc mi heâckerâ ranʒepieŋ. Babe hae irec qânâsac i heropiekicne hâcne. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Ŋicfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe hae irec maŋnaonec wiserâ raniŋ, ŋoŋe sasawa Wofuŋ kimbeŋ‐nanere ʒocbâruŋzi sipiric‐ŋopazacte juju‐ŋeŋic ŋezickeniŋ!
Erâ maŋŋeŋic mi omaezejec, â mâreŋ ira sawadâŋ moc fuame manarâ mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec. Ine jara moc sawadâŋ moc â jara moc ira sawadâŋ moc fuaocmuo, me bâbâʒâic fuaocmu, me ŋicbomboŋ moczi ŋicbomboŋ âgo‐ticne râsi ecneocmuo ine mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira Babe haere ɋâŋ qâqâtâcfâc bâsirowec‐jopapemu, ehame hae mâreŋ i weaŋke‐fâreocmu â qâhâmoc‐jopakicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe sasawa hae maŋnao foraniŋmu.
Eme sambâŋ â mâreŋ jahere maŋnao wiac jufâreekac izi Babe haere mu ʒeri ezejec, i ima bapafâcne jaŋe faic mâreŋkonec fisicneniŋmu irec. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Israe qâhâmoc‐jopakicnefâc‐ticne jaŋere erâ Babe ima bazo, ine Babe haere erâ mâreŋ sâc ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopakicne irec sâc.
“Ʒika wisecnembiŋ ŋoŋe ine ŋeŋe râqâc mi ehuc ranʒepieŋ! Ŋoŋe ʒoricko juhuc Wofuŋ nore manasunʒepieŋ, ehuc maŋŋeŋic Jerusalemko râepie domazejec.
‘Nâŋe mimi qaqa enârekicnere mimi busâqoc manaeŋgopeneŋ; mimizi ŋecnâpome ʒâŋe mai‐nâŋec bâsoŋkehuc jueŋgopeneŋ, i ŋic jabanezi Wofuŋ ufuŋ‐ticnere tiri wiac ima bambiŋte.’
