“Irec manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira Babe nemuɋâŋfâcne okacne bazu‐jarepemu, eme hae mâreŋ‐ticne sasawa ira ʒâpâ âkec‐jopakicnezi kio huse enʒepieŋ.
Eme Babe hae bafekupie sambâŋ heuaocmuo me qânâsac‐ticne hâŋ bafekupie huhuckene mi eocmuo ine no sifu sisipiric ŋic sorec‐jopape fisicnenʒepieŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Mananiŋ! Babe haeonec kio owa fuarâ fânâŋne warekac, erâ ima sâko irec fânâŋ Kaldea ŋic jaŋere mâreŋkonec fisikac.
Ine hâcne, Wofuŋ no Babe ima bahuc hae maŋnao ojowa sâko foekac i bâniniŋkekopac; râsi jaŋe hâwec siri iŋucne fisihuc opâ sâko fânâŋkeekac irec sâc fânâŋkeŋgopieŋ, micʒonʒoŋ‐jeŋic fuakac i hâhâwicne.
Sisipiric ŋic e Babe fisicnekac hâcne; eme hae irec momorifâc kâpâcwâru bacjopaniŋmu â tepe neŋgoc‐jeŋic i bazuniŋmu; Wofuŋ no okac babazu Anutu, irec okac bazu‐jare‐jâmbâŋkepemu.
Fekicnefâc‐ticne mecne, mamana ŋicfâc‐ticne mecne, mâreŋ soŋaŋfâc‐ticne mecne, kia sâkofâc‐ticne mecne, erâ qac momorifâc‐ticne mecne jaŋe opâ sanaŋ gumec‐jopape guŋzi qâmâc‐jopame foku mocwâc mi ɋârenʒepieŋ; Wofuŋ Sâko, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Babe haere qânâsac kâcɋene i heroc qâropiepie mâreŋhec sâc mocjaha ezejec, â motâc mimiŋ‐ticne i ʒoczi rikepie ʒazejec. Iŋuc fuame dâŋ ʒiŋuc fokac i fârio qaocmu: Ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe wiac ebac epie fâri tâmiric eekac, â ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe gie sâko bakupie fârine fuame ʒocte biŋe eekac.”
Juda ŋicwofuŋ Zedekia e ŋicwofuŋ jume jara 4 eha, Neriare ŋokâ Seraja, Masejare ŋosa hâcne, e ŋicwofuŋhec Babe haeo razo eme porofete Jeremiazi dâŋ âzâcne mutâc ewec ʒine hâcne. Seraja e hata jujure mumutâc â soŋaŋ juwec.
Jeremia eki ine Babe hae wiac hâhâwicne fuacneocte mukicne irec dâŋ i papiao qâreŋke‐fârewec, ine Babere dâŋ qâreŋkekicne i sasawa hâcne.
Erâ Jeremiazi Seraja ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Babe haeo fisirâ dâŋ ʒi ʒoɋac erâ wose‐jare‐fârezemec.
Erâ muzemec, ‘Wofuŋ, go gahac hae ʒi râsi ecnehuc bâsirowecmurâ mumeŋ, i maŋnao ŋic mecne qowi mecne mocwâc mi juhapie tuhutac fuarâ fosanaŋkeocte iŋuc emeŋ.’
Eufrata opâo behetec hutâmirezejec. Ehame ʒiŋuc muzemec, ‘Babe hae e irec sâc jaha tâmirezejec, eme wiac hâhâwicne mupe fainao feocmu i hetararâ mocwâc mi faharezejec!’” Jeremiare dâŋ i ʒira hâcne tarakac.
<range>
Zedekia e jara‐ticne 21 bazume ŋicwofuŋ âkendâŋnepie juwec. Erâ Jerusalem haeo ŋicwofuŋ gie‐ticne bahuc jukuhame jara 11 tarawec. Neŋgoc‐ticne ʒâŋene Hamuta e Lebina haeonec Jeremia wase‐ticnere otâ.
Zedekia e Wofuŋzi wiac honeme sâqoreekac i hâcne ehuc juwec, ine Jojakimzi ejujec irec sâcko jâmbâŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ e juku kimbeŋ‐ticnere erâ Jerusalem â Juda behec‐jofawec. Zedekia eki ine Babe ŋicwofuŋ râpeckewec.
E ŋicwofuŋ juhame jara namba 9‐ko mosa namba 10 â ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 10 jaha ira Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza momorifâcne rocjopa‐fâreme Jerusalem hae râsi fisicnembiŋ. Fisirâ hae somâckehuc rârec rârec ʒae bambiŋ.
Iŋuc erâ somâ bahuc juwefukuhapie Zedekia ŋicwofuŋ juju dameŋ‐ticnere jara namba 11 maickewec.
Eme mosa namba 4 â ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 9 ira haeo roroc sâkozi ɋârâŋkeme hae mâreŋ irec ŋic jaŋe nânâ omae‐fâreha basambiŋ.
Ehame râsi jaŋe haeo feniŋte sac âkeʒupie hata fuawec. Eme ŋicwofuŋ â momorifâcne sasawa jaŋe honerâ ŋafeo sac jajahec ŋondeŋ‐jekicko ŋicwofuŋte ʒariŋ gieo moc domawec i fotâcnerâ wisembiŋ. Ine Kaldea ŋic jaŋe hae sâko orâŋkehuc juhapie jaŋe Jordaŋ wâneŋkopec rambiŋ.
Eme Kaldea momori ŋic jaŋe ine ŋicwofuŋ jâpe raku Jeriko wâneŋko, ŋicfâcne jaŋe beherâ tâtiehapie bâfuambiŋ.
Erâ ŋicwofuŋ bâfua rorâ Hamati mâreŋko Ribela haeo Babe ŋicwofuŋ ŋewec erao barambiŋ. Eme eki dâŋ mutaracnewec.
Ehuc mume Zedekia ŋokâfâcne jaŋe mamac‐jeŋicte ʒâŋe faio qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ, erâ Judaŋic fekicne Ribela haeoa jopa‐fârembiŋ wâc.
Erâ mume Zedekia jahacne ʒâŋene riporâ aeŋ niŋgiŋko râembiŋ. Erâ Babe ŋicwofuŋzia mume Babe haeo bararâ kâpâcwâru ficko râepie ira ŋehuc juhame hâmoc dameŋ‐ticne maickewec.
Nebukaneza e Babe ŋicwofuŋ juhame jara 18 tarawec; eme irec faicnao mosa 5 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa namba 10 ira ine Nebuʒaradaŋ e Babe ŋicwofuŋ momori fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋere micne juhuc ŋicwofuŋte kiŋaŋ qahuc juweczi Jerusalem haeo fisiwec.
Fisirâ Wofuŋte taha ufuŋ mecne, ŋicwofuŋte erific mecne â Jerusalemte fic wiac sasawa i turuŋkeme ʒawec.
Â qânâsac Jerusalem hae râreckehuc fowec i Kaldea momori jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ momori fuŋfuŋfâcne jaŋere micne ehec jumbiŋzi heroc qâropiembiŋ.
Eme ŋicwofuŋte momori fuŋfuŋfâc jaŋere micne Nebuʒaradaŋ e ŋic qarâ suriŋne mecne, â haeo ŋic nâfocne behec‐jopapie jumbiŋ jaŋe mecne, â wiserâ Babe ŋicwofuŋ erao ʒuhuckembiŋ jaŋe mecne, erâ metâ bapa ŋic ʒanʒaŋne jaŋe mâmâc bacjopa rawec.
Momori fuŋfuŋfâc jaŋere micne Nebuʒaradaŋ e mâreŋ irecnec ŋic wahakicne jaŋeraonec gâcne jaŋe waiŋ gie bahuc he sarac eniŋte behec‐jopame ŋembiŋ.
Wofuŋte taha ufuŋko wâtuŋ aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bakicne domawec, erâ râqâc irec ŋeŋe wiac â opâ râqâc sâko aeŋ bâbâroŋzia bakicne ŋewec i Kaldea ŋic jaŋe henʒaŋ qanʒaŋnerâ aeŋ bâbâroŋ‐ticne Babe haeo furu jaha barambiŋ.
Erâ kuʒi mecne, sapac mecne, sâqe mecne, soc titiere râqâc mecne, hosâc âsu ririkere râqâc mecne, erâ wâcwiac gâcne sasawa aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bakicne â ufuŋko taha giere baju jumbieŋ i wâc rorâ mâmâc barambiŋ.
Erâ râqâc wiac piic piic, ʒoc uucnere faŋ, soc titiere râqâc, kuʒi wiac, kendo dodoma, hosâc âsu ririkere râqâc erâ taha bâzire râqâc, ine hâcne wiac sasawa gol â siliwa jâmbâŋzi bakicne i momori fuŋfuŋfâc jaŋere micnezi barawec.
Wâtuŋ jajahec, opâ râqâc sâko â bulimakao hawari 12 derâ doma rambiŋ, erâ Wofuŋ ufuŋ‐ticnere râqâc irec ŋeŋe wiac ŋicwofuŋ Salomozi mume bambiŋ, wiac i sasawa irec aeŋ bâbâroŋzi sigelio fefere sâc jâuruwec.
Wâtuŋte ine ʒiŋuc: Wâtuŋ moc ʒoricne‐ticnere sâc 18 kubi, â oorâŋ‐ticne i muc râepie orâŋkeha 12 kubi ewec; wâtuŋ i maŋ hawecnehec, sahacnere ɋâfoŋne ine memotec 4 irec sâc ewec.
Wâtuŋ fainao utune moc aeŋ bâbâroŋzi barâ râekicne i 5 kubi ferâ domawec; utune rârec rârec ine eri qâreŋ mizekicne â wiac moc jâchândâŋ tinac râekicne, wiac i aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bafârekicne hâcne. Eme wâtuŋ namba 2 irec wiac ijaha fowec.
Qaŋeŋnao wiac jâchândâŋ tinac orâŋkehuc râekicne irec ʒare 96, â jâchândâŋ eri mimize râreckehuc fowec irec qâqâhâc ʒare ine 100.
Ŋicwofuŋte momori fuŋfuŋfâc jaŋere micne e taha bapa sâko Seraja â babafic‐ticne Zefania erâ motâc soŋaŋ jahec â moc jaŋe bacjopa raocte rocjopawec.
Jerusalem haeonec micne sâko moc momori jaŋere soŋaŋ juwec e mecne â ŋicwofuŋhec jumbiŋ ŋic i jaŋeraonec 7 haeoa juhapie mâmâc rocjopawec; erâ momori micne ere qâreŋŋic, hesarac ŋic jaŋe gie baniŋte qâreŋ‐jopa jujec, ŋic e hâcne erâ hesarac ŋic 60 haeoa juhapie bâfuac‐jopambiŋ jaŋe iŋuc jaha rocjopawec.
Nebuʒaradaŋ, momori fuŋfuŋfâc jaŋere micnezi ŋic i jaŋe hâcne rocjoparâ Babe ŋicwofuŋ Ribela haeo ŋewec erao bacjopa rawec.
Babe ŋicwofuŋ eki ine mume Hamati mâreŋko, Ribela haeo hâcne qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ. Ehame Juda kikefuŋ jaŋe mâreŋ‐jeŋickonec kâpâcwâruo bacjopa rambiŋ.
Nebukaneza e Juda ŋic ŋokac bacjopa rawec jaŋere ʒare ʒi: Ŋicwofuŋ erâ juhame jara 7 ewec dameŋ ira 3023 bacjopa rawec.
Ŋicwofuŋ erâ juhame jara 18 ewec dameŋ ira Jerusalem haeonec ŋic 832 bacjopa rawec.
Ŋicwofuŋ erâ juhame jara 23 ewec dameŋ ira Nebuʒaradaŋ, momori fuŋfuŋfâc jaŋere micne eki Judaŋic 745 bacjopa rawec. Qâqâhâc ʒare‐jeŋic ine 4600.
Eme Juda ŋicwofuŋ Jojakiŋ e kâpâcwâruo jukuhame jara 36 â mosa 11 erâ ʒoaŋ gie bapa 24 tarame ine Babe ŋicwofuŋ Ewi‐Merodaczi akickehuc mume kâpâcwâruonec wahawec. Ine ŋicwofuŋ gie‐ticne fuŋkewec jara ira iŋuc ewec.
Erâ âgo ecnehuc ŋeŋe‐ticne bafeme ŋicwofuŋ gâcne ehec Babe haeo jumbiŋ jaŋere ŋeŋe biri irec micnao ŋewec.
Eme Jojakiŋ e kâpâcwâru ŋaqi‐ticne hetararâ ŋicwofuŋhec nânâ nâhuc jukuhame hâmoc dameŋ‐ticne maickewec.
Sahacte dope wiac irec ʒiŋuc ekicne: Babe ŋicwofuŋ e ʒoaŋ sâc dope wiac‐ticne râcnehuc juhame hâmoc dameŋ‐ticnao tarawec.
Jei, hae keci ŋic ŋokac jaŋe fusucmarâ ŋembiŋ i weniŋuc erâ niniŋ siarereŋ fuawec fokac? E mârâc jaha ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko kâcɋene ŋeweczi hozec iŋucne ewec, â haene haene irec fekicne ŋeweczi kiŋaŋ qaqa ewec i!
E ŋafeo mâretec kiohuc juha ʒâŋeuc‐ticne sâke qicmuŋnao wahahuc domakac. Jorocfâc‐ticne sasawa jaŋeraonec moczi mu bâmiriŋ moc mi ecneekac. Âgofâc‐ticne jaŋe e furu jaha beherâ râsifâc‐ticne embiŋ juŋgopieŋ.
Juda mâreŋ rune jaŋe ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio fehuc kiŋaŋ qaqa erâ kâpâcwâruo rambiŋ; erâ ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko hâhâŋkehuc jueŋgopieŋ, eme fific guguriŋ faio juhapie fisi‐jarehuc jâpec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Zioŋte hata i qoroc hewec fokac i ŋic moczi moc hombaŋte erâ ira rac warec mocwâc mi eeŋgopieŋ irec. Hae sâkore motâc mimiŋ sasawa i ima bakicne mâc fokac; ehame taha bapafâc‐ticne kio owa eŋgopieŋ â naru ʒeŋoŋfâc‐ticne jaŋe busâqoc hawari domaŋgopieŋ; hae e makuc bakac hâcne.
Kisâfâc‐ticne jaŋe pepec penaroŋ ehuc juŋgopieŋ, râsifâc‐ticne jaŋe bubiaŋ manaŋgopieŋ, i Wofuŋzi sâqocne‐ticne bocjahare erâ ʒârâ hâriŋ bâfuacnewecte; naru motecfâc‐ticne jaŋe fific guguriŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere maio kâpâcwâruo bacjopa rakicne.
Zioŋ otâ‐ticnere ʒâŋe rara biaŋ i omae‐fârewec. Fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe kâte bulimakaozi kecɋaŋ basaeŋgopieŋ irec sâc; erâ jâpec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ jaŋere maio docke betaŋ ehuc wiseeŋgopieŋ.
Jerusalem e juwicnaonecteaŋ wiac biaŋne focne warehuc juwec irec fific guguriŋ â ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋ‐ticnao manasuekac. Ŋic ŋokacfâcne jaŋe kisâfâc‐ticne jaŋere meo ferâ bafic basapie râsi jaŋe hone suŋgiŋ ecnehuc sisipiric‐ticnere mu ruruc ecnembiŋ.
Jerusalem hae e sâqocne boc bawecte mamakâcne ewec; eme mârâc jaha muac baafec ecnembiŋzi miŋecgac qaisockeŋgopieŋ, i biuctac‐ticne honembiŋte. E jahacne ine kio uu ehuc ʒâŋe mai‐ticne bâsoŋkekac.
Ŋaqi‐ticne i wânâŋhec, e ʒâhec wiac fuacneocmu irec mi manasuwec; irec waha qawec i hâhâwicne jâmbâŋ, ehame moczi moc mi bâmiriŋkeha ʒiŋuc mukac: “O Wofuŋ, râsizi sanaŋkerâ ʒeri ekacte ʒârâ hâriŋ‐nane honec me!”
Râsizi boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ‐ticne rofâreocte mene sicnewec; jâmbomac, ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe tiri ufuŋ‐ticnao raʒipie honec‐jopawec, i gore kikefuŋko mi ʒuhuckeniŋte aka hejaremeŋ jaŋe hâcne.
Ŋecjucfâc‐ticne sasawa jaŋe kio huse ehuc nânâ basaŋgopieŋ; ehuc hâmo sipiric enʒipiŋte boreŋ wiac furi sâko‐jeŋic nânâre râehuc ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: “O Wofuŋ, go ʒâŋe fitec wahame honecnuzemec, no qaisocnukicne hâcne!”
“Nowaruŋgopieŋ sasawa ŋoŋe wemocte busâqoc moc mi mana‐nareŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe ʒâŋe fipie wareme honecnuniŋ! Wofuŋzi kimbeŋ sâko‐ticnere dameŋko bâtiŋnume ʒâic fua‐nareme manakopac, ʒâic iŋucne ŋoŋe moc manambiŋ me?
“E faickonec ʒocbâruŋ tuŋkeme waharâ siec‐naneo raʒiwec. E kike‐nanere bitiŋ râewec, eme izi kicnume rârâpe rândiŋkerâ waha qapo; e ima bacnume dameŋ sâc huc ʒâicko fohuc juekopac hâcne.
“Qaqatara‐nane qâtureme tagi‐nane ewec; e jahacne mezi basanaŋkewec; erâ fai‐naneo râeme fokac. Eki bâdocnume tâpiri‐nane weaŋkewec; Wofuŋ e ŋic bâipiec‐jopaekopac jaŋere meo râecnuwec hâcne.
“Wofuŋ e qac momorifâc‐nane jumbiŋ jaŋe qaisoc‐jopa‐fârewec; eki hâcne ŋicmotecfâc‐nane sipiric‐jopaocte râsi hetumaŋ‐jopame fisimbiŋ. Wofuŋ e waiŋ hândâŋne âte pisickeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc Judare otâ ʒeŋoŋ âte pisickewec.
“No irec hâcne kiohuc jukopac, â ʒâŋeuc‐nane bocjaha wahahuc domakac. Bâbâmiriŋ‐nane e maŋnane basanaŋkeocte tâpiri focnekaczi taicko jukac; naru motecfâc‐nane sipiric‐jopakicne, râsizi sanaŋkewec hâcne.”
Zioŋ e meticne sicnekac, mâc bâbâmiriŋ‐ticne ine moc mi jukac; Wofuŋ e ŋic rârec rârec jaŋe Jakobo râsi ecneniŋte mujarewec; ehame Jerusalem e jaŋere ŋondeŋko wiac mamakâcne ewec.
“Wofuŋ e wiac enareme sâckewec, no micdâŋ‐ticne qatarahuc jupo irec. Ŋic gurune gurune ŋoŋe mananiŋ, ehuc ʒâic manakopac i honeniŋ! Ŋic ŋokac socɋârifâc‐nane jaŋe kâpâcwâruo bacjopa rakicne.
“No jorocfâc‐nane wira‐jarepo, jaŋe ine eatucnumbiŋ. Taha bapafâc‐nane â soŋaŋfâc‐nane jaŋe juju‐jeŋic fuaocte nânâ opâre babasa gie baku mi haeo hâmo sipiric enʒepieŋ i!
“O Wofuŋ, go honecnuc, no hâhâwic bakopac â bunane herickekac. No maŋrâŋgeŋhec jupo, irec maŋnaneo ʒâic serereŋ fuawec fokac. Hae ʒoŋao ʒika, â ficmaŋko ine huc hâmoc, wiac izi naru motecfâc‐nane rocjopakac.
“No ʒiŋuc kio huse epe manambiŋ: ‘No bâbâmiriŋ‐nane arictac!’ Kisâfâc‐nane jaŋe ʒârâ ʒâpâ‐nanere biŋe mana‐fârembiŋ, erâ go gahac mutec fua‐narewec irec bubiaŋ manambiŋ wâc. Irec dameŋ moc bameŋ i gokizia mutec fuame jaŋe nore sâc jaha enʒepieŋ.
“Eebapa‐jeŋic hehesicne sasawa i gore maio taniŋkezejec. Eme qaqatara‐nane sasawa irec okacne bazu‐naremeŋ iŋuc jaha jaŋe bazu‐jarezemec. Huhuse‐nane i hâhâwicne eha bu heheric enarekac.”
Jei, Wofuŋ e aaric manahuc Zioŋte otâ dapâc maŋnao râewec i! E Israe ʒai ʒonʒoŋ‐ticne boc ferâ fowec i qame wahawec, e aaric dameŋ‐ticnao ââtesiŋ‐ticnere moc mi manasuwec.
Wofuŋ e Jakobore ŋeŋe hae irec busâqoc moc mi manahuc furu jaha ima bawec. E aaric manahuc Juda otâ‐ticnere ficsanaŋ heroc qâropiewec; e uumaŋ‐jeŋic ima bahuc guriŋ bapafâcne hetapaic‐jopame rufeo waha qapie ʒâŋe biŋe‐jeŋic omaewec.
E aaric sâko manahuc Israe tâpiri‐ticne bawahawec, ehuc râsi fisipie ŋicfâcne mi bafic‐jopaocte mefâre‐ticne sakarewec; ʒoc ruqepene ʒahuc ŋeratierâ wiac rârec rârec ʒâseŋke‐fâreekac, ʒoc iŋucne Jakobore kikefuŋko râeme ʒawec.
E râsi iŋucne tepe‐ticne âpârehuc mefâre‐ticnezi sisipiric gie baocte domawec; e Zioŋte otâ ere qoruc bozeo wiac hawari biaŋ fowec i imacke‐fârewec, ehuc aaric‐ticne ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne hoŋkecnewec.
Wofuŋ e râsi iŋucne erâ Israe bâsirowewec; e erific‐ticne ima bafârewec â ficsanaŋ‐ticne heroc qâropie‐fârewec; ehuc mume Juda otâ‐ticnere faio ki busâqoc â ʒârâ hâriŋ bocjaha fewec.
E boze‐ticne i gie iŋucne sipirickehuc tutumaŋ hae‐ticne imackewec; Wofuŋzi gie‐ticne bahame Zioŋko hombaŋ â sabata irec ninikec fuawec, ehame kimbeŋ aaricko ŋicwofuŋ â taha bapa behec‐jopawec.
Wofuŋ e alata‐ticne qaisockehuc behewec â tirific‐ticne hone suŋgiŋ ecnewec, ehuc Zioŋ erific‐ticnere qânâsac i râsi jaŋere meo râewec. Eme Israe jaŋe hombaŋko Wofuŋte tiri ufuŋko fânâŋke jumbieŋ irec sâc râsi jaŋe ojowa sâko embiŋ.
Wofuŋ e Zioŋ otâ‐ticnere qânâsac ima baocte mupaŋkewec; e mucsâc fârehuc ma bawec, ehuc meticnezi sisipiric gie baocte manacnewec, e ʒae â qânâsac jahe makuc banicte mujactewec; eme ʒi busâqocnehec foekopirec.
Motâc sâko‐ticnezi mâreŋmaŋko huwec, e aeŋ babasanaŋ‐ticne sipirickerâ qazuwec; ŋicwofuŋ â fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐jopakicne; sâcmutâc dâŋte sâcko wiac ebac ee i omaewec, â porofetefâc‐ticne jaŋe Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ fuame hone manac ee i wâc arictac ewec.
Zioŋ otâ‐ticnere kâcɋenefâc jaŋe mâc fâsâerâ mâreŋko ŋeeŋgopieŋ; jaŋe ʒafe ruahuc mateŋ qonaŋkeeŋgopieŋ; Jerusalemte ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ jaŋe qizec‐jeŋic mâreŋko hetutuckerâ ŋeeŋgopieŋ.
No kiohuc jukuhape ʒâŋe‐nane ʒâicnukac â hobu‐nane fâuckezo ekac. Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere otâ ere ʒârâ hâriŋte erâ bu heheric enarekac, i ɋie â hata jujune jaŋe hae ʒoŋao hâmo betaŋ eeŋgopieŋ irec.
Jaŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc neŋgocfâc‐jeŋic wâsic‐jopaeŋgopieŋ: “Nânâ opâ weni?” Jaŋe iŋuc muhuc ŋic ʒâpâ jopakicne irec sâc hae ʒoŋao betaŋkeeŋgopieŋ, eme neŋgocfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe amec‐jopa rahapie hâmoeŋgopieŋ hâcne.
O Jerusalemte otâ, no weniŋuc erâ dopecguhuc gore dâŋ mupemu me mohec sâc hecgupemu? O ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ, Zioŋte otâ, go mohec sâc hecguhuc bâmiriŋgupemu? Manakic, ʒârâ ʒâpâge i hâwec sâko iŋucne, irec mo ŋiczi sâcne bâpiaŋguocmu?
Porofetefâcge jaŋe findaŋdâŋ burecne â racne hone manac erâ mufua‐garembiŋ, ehuc kiŋtofage hesoŋkehuc wiac hâhâwicne aka mi hecnembiŋ; aricne, jaŋe qaŋgecdâŋ burecne â eeatuc dâŋ hone manac erâ mufua‐garembiŋ hâcne.
Hatao gowaruhuc honecgueŋgopieŋ sâc me pocpoc qagareeŋgopieŋ; jaŋe Jerusalem otâ‐ticne go mu âke sisic egarehuc qizec fofotaric eeŋgopieŋ, ehuc mueŋgopieŋ, “Hae kereŋ biaŋ â mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec bubiaŋ bâbâfua mugareeŋgopieŋ, hae go hâcne me?”
Râsifâcge sasawa jaŋe mâretec sopecgueŋgopieŋ, ehuc mu âke sisic erâ mic kiki aric kihuc ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: “Nâŋe e ima bambeŋ! Ia, nâŋe dameŋ i fuaocte enâre jujec, eme ʒi maic‐nâpome honeŋgopeneŋ hâcne!”
Wofuŋ e maname fowec i hâcne fârine bâfuawec, e mârâc sasac jaha uŋsawaŋ dâŋ mufuawec i mume deŋkewec; ehame busâqoc moc mi manahuc ima gie bawec; e râsifâcge bafic‐jopame gore bubiaŋ manambiŋ erâ kisâfâcge jaŋere tâpiri bafewec.
O Zioŋte otâ, go hahaŋne bahuc Wofuŋ wâsickec! Ehuc ŋafeo mecne ʒoaŋko mecne kiotecne ʒâŋeucge bocjaha wahahuc domazejec! Go kigie bakutec ʒâŋe hândâŋge bâruŋkezejec.
Go ŋafeo faharerâ ruc bapa dameŋ maickeocmu sâc wira wâwâsic ezemec, ehuc Wofuŋte maio maŋgere fuŋne opâ iŋucne hoŋkezemec. Naru motecfâcge hae ʒoŋa tuturuŋne tuturuŋne ira nânâre hâmo sipiric eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere erâ mege erao sicnezemec.
O Wofuŋ, go ʒâŋe firâ honec! Go mo ŋic mo wiac iŋucne ecnemeŋ? Me ŋokac jaŋe ɋiefâc‐jeŋic rocjoparâ hone maiŋ ejareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe nâcjopaniŋte mukic me? Me taha bapa â porofete jaŋe Wofuŋte furuficko qâhâmoc‐jopaniŋte mukic me?
Hae ʒoŋao ŋic socɋâri â ŋicqizec jaŋe rufeo foraŋgopieŋ; naru ʒeŋoŋ â ŋicmotecfâc‐nane jaŋe ʒikare nânâ embiŋ; go kimbeŋ dameŋgao qâhâmoc‐jopameŋ, busâqoc moc mi mana‐jarehuc qa hefâuc ejaremeŋ hâcne.
Go rârec rârec râsifâc‐nane jaŋe hombaŋ mocte erâ fifisine tinac hefârec‐jopameŋ; eme Wofuŋ gore kimbeŋ dameŋ ira moczi moc wiserâ mi juwec. Me faio bacjopa jupo â hone maiŋ ejarehape sokambiŋ jaŋe hâcne râsizi qâmiziec‐jopawec.
Anutu e kimbeŋ‐ticnere kâcbiŋzi ʒârâ ʒâpâ bâfuawec i ŋic norao hâcne.
E ʒoɋac ehuc duŋdapâcko jowacnume raʒipo.
Jâmbomac, e ʒoaŋ ʒora harierâ meticne bafaharehuc nuekac.
E sahac biuc‐nane ecneme hâmo ɋaŋac ewec, ehame siec‐nane qazu‐fârewec.
E mume wiac hâtâne â ʒârâ hâriŋzi somâcnurâ fowec.
E mârâc jaha hâmombiŋ jaŋe iŋucne dapâcko jupemurâ râecnuwec.
E orâŋnuhuc qânâsac bawecte wisezore eipieekopac; e aeŋ niŋgiŋ ŋemâcne qanareme huwec.
No wira wâwâsic ehape e sifu nunumu‐nane mana takireekac.
E qânâ sâkozi hata‐nane hebâzickewec, ehuc hatagâŋ‐nane hezickeme sifuckewec.
E kâte qowi mimicnezi ruc baekac â laioŋzi soŋsoŋko foekac irec sâc enareekac.
E qac qâsoric epemurâ enarewec, erâ kisuc qâsucnuhuc omaecnuwec.
E tepe motec‐ticne gurutucko herâ âpârehuc ma bacnuwec.
E tepe motec‐ticnezi buhândâŋ‐naneo murucnuwec.
Eme ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe mana wahacnuhuc gâwie‐nareeŋgopieŋ, ehuc ʒoaŋ sâc norao iticnehuc mu qâqiŋ gae heeŋgopieŋ.
E wiac hâtânezi bâfusecnuwec, ehuc opâ hâtâ qiŋqiŋne gumecnuwec.
Eki enareme micsiec‐nane qânâ hândâŋko kizu‐fârepo, ehuc menezi ʒafeo bânduŋnuwec.
E maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanere wama nowac rowecte juju biaŋ‐nane omaewec.
Eme mupo, “Wofuŋtaonec tâpiri‐nane i omaewec, â erao roweckehuc juju‐nane i arictac ewec.”
No ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio qafec qawahac juekopac go irec manasuzemec, erâ wiac hâtâ qiŋqiŋne â opâ mimicne gumecnumeŋ irec mâmâc.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi dameŋ sâc irec manasuekac, ehuc dunduŋ dadape foekac.
No ine irec manatâc qâtâc ehuc worickeekopac.
Wofuŋte aki anonoc mi omaeekac, â buuruc‐ticne i tatara tâmiric.
I hae fureocmu sâc ɋâricnezi ɋâricne fua raekac, go erâ‐eesanaŋge fekicne.
Maŋnanezi mukac, “Wofuŋ e boreŋ‐nane, irec no ere mamanac jupemu.”
Wofuŋte woŋec juhuc maŋzi wira basac ecneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bubiaŋ qajareekac.
Niniŋkerâ woŋec juju i wiac fâri biaŋ, Wofuŋte bâbâpiaŋ i hâcne woŋeckezo.
Ŋic moc e motec‐ticnao tagi deocmu, izi wiac fâri biaŋ jaha eocmu.
Wofuŋzi tagi ɋawenao râecneme kihâmoha sifu niniŋkerâ bucmac‐ticne ŋezejec.
Wândocko maku erâ ŋezejec, ehame bafic moc fuacneocmu mecne.
Mauc‐ticne ʒika qaqa sicnecnezejec, ehuc mimi fainao feme kinduŋ bânduŋ juzejec.
I ʒiŋucte ezejec: Bebehe sanaŋ i Wofuŋtao mi fokac.
Aki anonoc‐ticne i guru fufusuc fokacte ŋic moc bâʒâickeku sifu harierâ jauŋkeocmu.
E buafec jaha mâreŋŋic wiac buqâqânducne â busâqocnehec mi bâfua‐jareekac.
Mâreŋ sâc kâpâcwâru ŋic kikezi âtec‐jopa‐fâreniŋmu,
me Femicne ere maio ŋic mocte dâŋ musifuckeniŋmu,
me dâŋgieo ŋic mocte dâŋ muhasickeniŋmu i Wofuŋzi moc mi honeocmu me?
Mo ŋiczi Wofuŋ e mi mutâcneha wiac moc fuaocte muocmu?
Me wiac sâqocne â biaŋne i Femicnezi mume mi fuaekac me?
Ŋic e mâreŋko juhuc wemo wiacte mu kâroŋ eekac? E jahacne sâqocnere maname sâqoreoc me!
Nâŋâc juju â eebapa‐nâŋec ba esâic ecnehuc fuŋne‐nâŋec mana jaŋgeŋkerâ Wofuŋtao risienaŋ.
Wofuŋ sambâŋko jukac erao maŋnâŋec sâsehuc menâŋec bâfeŋnenaŋ!
“Nâŋe behecgurâ qaqatara bâfuambeŋ, irec go kiŋnâŋec i mi bâtâmiremeŋ.
“Go kimbeŋzi ʒikage eme jâpec‐nâpomeŋ, ehuc busâqoc moc mi mana‐nârehuc qâhâmoc‐nâpomeŋ.
Go karorac maŋnao soŋkerâ juhaŋtecne nunumu‐nâŋeczi gorao sâcne moc mi hefâ fisiwec.
Goki enâretecne ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere ŋondeŋko jawa rasa iŋucne erâ mamakâcne embeŋ.
“Râsifâc‐nâŋec sasawa jaŋe musoriŋ‐nâpohuc jueŋgopieŋ.
Iima â sisipiric sâko izi nombâŋ enâreha bipic‐nâŋec tarawec.
Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe boc sipiric‐jopakicnere ʒâŋeuc‐nane bocjaha wahahuc domakac.
“Ʒâŋeuc‐nane i tatara tâmiric ʒuʒuhuc jaha wahahuc domaocmu hâcne.
Ehame Wofuŋ e sambâŋkonec fime wahame honezejec.
Hae sâko‐nanere otâfâc wiac fua‐jare‐fârewec i honerâ ʒâŋe‐nane ʒâicnukac.
“Maŋgâŋko râsi enarehuc jumbiŋzi no wipe iŋucne nu jâpec enarembiŋ.
Jaŋe juju‐nane sipirickeniŋte nombâŋko behecnupie hupe qânâ wicke‐narembiŋ.
Eme opâzi qâurucnume mupo: ‘Jei, no omaezo ekopac.’
“O Wofuŋ, no nombâŋ fâhâŋnao ŋehuc ʒâŋege riwaseckepo.
No ʒiŋuc mupe marac fânâŋ‐nane manameŋ: ‘Go baficnucmurâ wira wâwâsic‐nanere hazec râezemec!’
No riwasecgupo ʒoaŋ ira maicnuhuc ʒiŋuc nazameŋ: ‘Go mi hâwicguoc!’
“O Wofuŋ, goki dâŋnane dopeckehuc juju‐nane bâfiriemeŋ.
O Wofuŋ, ro waha âte enarekicne i go honemeŋ, irec gokizia dâŋnane mutarac.
Râsi enarehuc dâŋ manasu biric embiŋ, â okac babazu gie bambiŋ i go hone‐fâremeŋ wâc.
“O Wofuŋ, râsi enarehuc dâŋ sasawa manasu biric erâ musoriŋnumbiŋ i go manameŋ.
Erâ râsifâc‐nane jaŋe ʒoaŋ ʒora micbipic‐jeŋiczi nore dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ â wiac manasu biric eeŋgopieŋ i mâmâc manameŋ.
Go honec‐jopac: Jaŋe waha ŋeeŋgopieŋko me fahare domaeŋgopieŋko ine ʒoraŋ gae henareeŋgopieŋ.
“O Wofuŋ, mejeŋiczi wiac ebac embiŋ irec sâcko okacne bâtikie‐jarezemec.
Goki maŋjeŋic mutuc batec sâwecgezi fai‐jeŋicko fezejec.
O Wofuŋ, go kimbeŋko qa jâpec ejareku sambâŋgere rurumaŋko bâsirowec‐jopazemec!”
Opoŋ, golzi weniŋuc erâ joŋtawewec? Gol ɋaɋacne izi weniŋuc erâ hetikieme moc ewec? Qânâ furi sâko i hata sosohoc sâc hesiepie ŋerakac!
Zioŋte ŋokâfâc ʒâŋe biŋehec, golzi sawa furi babacjopane, jei, jaŋere manapie afezi kuʒi bakicne â kuʒi bapa ere meqâreŋ irec sâc eŋgopieŋ i!
Kâte qâto jaŋe motecfâc‐jeŋic moŋ gumec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere otâ eki ine kâteo qera jauŋ tâmiric juekac e iŋucne.
Ɋie jaŋe opâre hâmopie nameŋ‐jeŋiczi gâpi‐jeŋicko bohotaekac, â naru motec jaŋe nânâre mu huacbuc epie moczi moc jare gumec mi eekac.
Mârâc jaha nânâ wiac aŋacnehec nâjumbieŋzi hae ʒoŋao juhuc hâmo sipiric eeŋgopieŋ, â qoruc furi sâko rumacke‐jarekicne jaŋe jawa faio foeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere otâ e kiŋticnezi Sodom haere hehesic jâuruwec. Hae i ŋiczi ima gie moc mi bahapie ututuŋ bâsirowekicne.
Zioŋ fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe sinoure sâc jâuruhuc ɋaɋac taeŋne erâ susure sâc wâc sirickehuc ɋaɋacne jâmbâŋ embiŋ; sahac‐jeŋic ine haroŋaŋ bâbâroŋ irec sâc jâuruhuc bâbâroŋ jâmbâŋ ewec, â sahac hawari‐jeŋic ine qânâ keŋkeŋne furi sâko iŋucne.
Ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic i mâsic hawari jâuruhuc gâpâre‐jâmbâŋkewec irec gâcnezi hae ʒoŋao mocwâc mi ʒâŋitac‐jopambiŋ; sahac‐jeŋiczi muzuckerâ siec‐jeŋicko bohotahuc ʒoc iŋucne kereŋkewec.
Ʒikare nânâ ehuc ɋeŋnea hâmombiŋ irec ʒâic i afecne, â nânâre hâmohuc ʒâic manaku hâmo sipiric embiŋ izi ine wiac ŋemâcne jâmbâŋ.
Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere sisipiric dameŋko ŋokac buuruchec jaŋe naru motecfâc‐jeŋic kuʒio rikec‐jopapie nânâ‐jeŋic embiŋ.
Wofuŋ e aaricko gie sâko baocte manawec, ehuc kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋ hoŋkewec; e Zioŋko ʒoc ruqeme ʒawec, ehuc haere hobeteŋne ʒâseŋkewec.
Râsi somâ bapa jaŋe Jerusalem hae irec motâc fotâcnerâ raʒiniŋmu, dâŋ i mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ mecne â mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec ŋecjucfâcne jaŋe mecne mi mana ʒakiembiŋ.
Wiac hâhâwicne fua‐jarewec i porofetefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sâqocnere erâ â taha bapafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere hehesicte erâ fuawec; jaŋe hâcne hae irec maŋnao ŋic tiŋne jaŋere soc hoŋkembiŋ.
Jaŋe ŋic tiŋtuŋ iŋucne hae ʒoŋao qac qâsoric ehuc jumbiŋ, ehame ŋaqi‐jeŋicko soc bohotawecte ŋiczi ba bâuac sâcne mi embiŋ.
Jaŋe honec‐joparâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Wiseniŋ, wâwânâŋheczi wareŋgopieŋ! Wiseniŋ, wiseniŋ me! Ba bâuac moc mi ejareniŋ!” Iŋuc ejarepie jaŋe ŋic wiwisene â hahata jujune embiŋ, ehame ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko dâŋ ʒiŋuc fuawec: “Jaŋe nâŋâcnehec moc mi junʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋ e jahac bâtâtiec‐jopawec, erâ mocwâc honec‐jopaocte mi ecnewec; taha bapa jaŋe mi sâsec‐jopakicne, â ŋic kâcɋene jaŋe uruc jauŋ mi ejarekicne.
Nâŋe babaficte maŋgâŋ ʒâŋe fihuc jaha juhapene ʒâŋe‐nâŋeczi betaŋkewec. Nâŋe ʒâŋe fifi‐nâŋecko domahuc ŋicguru moc jaŋere ʒâŋe fimbeŋ, jaŋe ine babafic‐nâponere sâc mi embiŋ.
Kikeo kikeo enârekicnere hae ʒoŋa‐nâŋecko wemocko sâcne rac warec enʒapeŋ; hâmoc dameŋ‐nâŋec bembeŋkewec, juju dameŋ‐nâŋec qosackewec, hâmoc dameŋ‐nâŋec maickewec hâcne.
Jâpec‐nâpombiŋ jaŋe tucwipe sambâŋ rurumaŋnao sâoekac irec sâc jâurumbiŋ, jaŋe tikio nâpo jâpec embiŋ â mâreŋ sawao ruc banârembiŋ.
Wofuŋzi wokemaŋ ruacnewec, juju‐nâŋecte fosiŋ hâcne, e nombâŋ‐jeŋicko hume rombiŋ, nâŋâc ine ere ʒiŋuc manambeŋ, “Nâŋâc ere mumucko ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko junʒepeneŋ.”
O Edomte otâ, go ʒeri ehuc bubiaŋ manac, Uzi mâreŋ irec rune go. Gorao waiŋ râqâc fâ fisiocmu wâc, eme i nâku maŋsifuc egareme ŋaqige hetararâ biuctac jucmu.
O Zioŋte otâ, gore kiŋtofa i batarakicne, Wofuŋzi mume kâpâcwâruo mocwâc mi bacgu raniŋmu. Edomte otâ gore hehesicte okacne ine bazu‐gareocmu, ehuc bahacge bataniŋkeocmu.
O Wofuŋ, go fai‐nâŋecko wiac fewec irec manasuc, go ʒâŋe fitec wareme mimi qaqa enârekicne i honec!
Merâfâc‐nâŋec i ŋic furune jaŋere meo râekicne â fic hae‐nâŋec i ŋic jabane jaŋe rauckembiŋ.
Nâŋe mamac tâmiric, bekâ mâsiŋ embeŋ juŋgopeneŋ, neŋgocfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe hozec iŋucne.
Opâ nâeŋgopeneŋ i moneŋzi furine baeŋgopeneŋ â ʒoc wiac‐nâŋec i wâc furinehec.
Ɋawe‐nâŋecko tagi foha nâpo jâpec eeŋgopieŋ, eme nâŋe docke betaŋ ehuc ŋemanazo mupene mi mana‐nâreeŋgopieŋ.
Nâŋe nânâ bâfuanaŋte Aigita â Asiria ŋic dape‐jarehuc me sicne‐jarembeŋ.
Mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe sâqocne barâ omaembiŋ, nâŋe ine kiŋtofa‐jeŋic âsickehuc jueŋgopeneŋ.
Kiŋaŋ qaqazi ŋicbomboŋ enâreeŋgopieŋ eha moczi moc jaŋere meonec batarac‐nâpoocmu i mi fokac.
Nâŋe tuhu mâreŋko ʒika fuarâ fokacte juju‐nâŋec qikiŋnezo ehuc nânâ‐nâŋec bâfuarâ roeŋgopeneŋ.
Eme nânâre hâmo sâqorehuc sahac‐nâŋeczi docke betaŋ efâreekac.
Râsi jaŋe Zioŋko ŋokac bâsâqorec‐jopambiŋ erâ Juda hae ŋerakac irec naru ʒeŋoŋ jaŋe wâc mâmâc.
Fekicne jaŋe rocjopahuc bituac‐jopambiŋ â kâcɋene jaŋe ro waha âte ejarembiŋ.
Ŋicmotec jaŋe ejarepie jacgoŋ babanʒaŋ gie baeŋgopieŋ â motec jaŋe ine ʒoc hâpohapie fâfâc‐jopaekac.
Micne jaŋe hae ʒoŋao tumaŋnerâ ŋeŋe i behembiŋ â ŋicmotec jaŋe woŋgâŋ mocwâc mi qaeŋgopieŋ.
Maŋnâŋecte ʒeri bubiaŋ i omaewec â gae wowo‐nâŋeczi rirehame ki mamakuczi fuawec.
Eridu i qizec‐nâŋeckonec hockerâ wahawec; jei, nâŋe sâqore‐fârembeŋ i!
Maŋhuc fua‐nârewec â ʒâŋe‐nâŋec hâpozo ewec i wiac kecʒiŋucte:
Zioŋ tikizi niniŋ siarereŋ fokac â kâte qâto jaŋe ira sicne fotâc eeŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ, go ine guriŋ bapa gie bahuc jucmu sanaŋ, â eri ŋeŋege i ŋic gaŋne gaŋne ŋesanaŋke‐jareocmu.
Ehame wemocte nâŋere nikecgu sanaŋkekac, erâ wemocte dameŋ ʒora behec‐nâpozo mukomec?
O Wofuŋ, go gahacnao bârisiec‐nâpoc me! Eme risiepene juju dameŋ‐nâŋec mârâc fowec i heɋâre‐nârec.
Me go jâmbomac behec‐nâpo sanaŋkemeŋ? Me kimbeŋgezi fai‐nâŋecko boc fofeocte mukic me?
No jara‐nane 30 irec mosa 4‐re ʒoaŋ gie bapa 5 ira kâpâcwâru ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko Kebara opâo juhape maŋʒâŋe‐nane tâcneme sambâŋ aŋkeha Anuturaonec wiac fuame honepo.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Jojakiŋ e kâpâcwâruo ŋehame jara 4 â mosa 3 erâ gie bapa 4 tarawec.
Tarame ʒoaŋ gie bapa 5 ira Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ Buʒire ŋokâ taha bapa Eʒekie no Kaldea ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko Kebara opâo juhape fua‐narewec. Erâ no ira juhape Wofuŋzi basanaŋnuwec.
No ʒâŋe fipe rame mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋnehec â karorac ɋâfoŋne, tatamac sâkozi orâŋkehuc fowec i faic mâreŋkonec ware fisime honepo, ehame ʒoczi tamaehuc fowec. Eme ʒoc irec maŋnao wiac moc aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bâricnehuc tamaeekac irec sâc tamaewec.
Eme irec maŋnaonec wiac gâcne i wiac jujune 4 iŋucnezi wefu fisimbiŋ, jaŋere hawari i ŋic hawari iŋucne.
Ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic ine ru sâc jahec â jahec â fafakec‐jeŋic iŋuc jaha jahec â jahec fojarewec.
Kike‐jeŋic i sorondoŋ â kike tape‐jeŋic i bulimakao motecnere kike râqâc iŋucne, jaŋe aeŋ bâbâroŋ ʒâmupie bâruŋkeekac irec sâc bâruŋkembiŋ.
Fafakec‐jeŋicte rurumaŋko wiac moc ŋicme hawari iŋucne fojarewec, erâ ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic â fafakec‐jeŋic irec fuŋne ine ʒiŋuc:
Jaŋe fafakec‐jeŋic iitic efâreha sâckoa birihec rafârehuc foc fotikic mi embiŋ.
Ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋicte hawari ine ʒiŋuc fojarewec: Jaŋe ru sâc mai‐jeŋicko ŋic hawari, ŋaki ŋifeckopec laioŋ hawari, ŋaki ŋifeckopec bulimakao ŋicnere hawari â râpeopec tucwipe hawari iŋuc fojarewec.
Wiac jujune jaŋe ru sâc fafakec 4 fojarewec. Fafakec jajahec jahe faicpec qaratiehuc fakec gâcne jaŋehec iitic epic â fakec jajahec jahe ine ombâŋ‐jeŋic qofackehuc fopic.
Eme mârozi baafec‐jopame ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic fowec sâc tikic fotikic tâmiric dândâŋne rafârembiŋ.
Wiac jujune jaŋere ŋondeŋko ine wiac moczi ʒocmimiŋ me waha bâruŋkeekac iŋuc bâruŋkehuc rac warec ewec, erâ mâretec bâruŋkeha maŋnao bâbâric fuawec.
Ehame wiac jujune jaŋe bâricnehuc rac warec embiŋ.
Eme no wiac jujune 4 jaŋerao fipe rame jaŋere heririŋko ʒafeŋgâŋ 4 jaha mâreŋko ŋepie honec‐jopapo.
Ʒafeŋgâŋ i jaŋe hawari‐jeŋic mocjaha sasawa, erâ qânâ furi sâko iŋucne bâricnembiŋ, erâ wâc ʒafeŋgâŋ mocte maŋnao ʒafeŋgâŋ moc râekicne tinac ewec.
Jaŋe faic â juwic, ŋifec â ŋifec rahuc tikic fotikic tâmiric dândâŋnea rafârembiŋ.
Ʒafeŋgâŋne 4 jaŋe mecqaŋeŋ‐jeŋichec â biriŋ‐jeŋichec sasawa, ehame mecqaŋeŋ‐jeŋicko ʒâŋe hândâŋ bocjahazi sâcke‐fârerâ ŋerawec.
Wiac jujune jaŋe hata rapie ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋe heririŋ‐jeŋicko mâmâc rambiŋ, me wiac jujune jaŋe mâreŋkonec faharerâ sawao fepie ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋe mâmâc faharembiŋ.
Eme mârozi jowa qataŋ ejareme sâc rambiŋ, ehame ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋe mâmâc rambiŋ, wiac jujune jaŋere mârozi ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋehec mâmâc juwec irec.
Ine hâcne wiac jujune jaŋere mârozi ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋehec mâmâc juwecte wiac jujune jaŋe rapie sâc ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋe mâmâc rambiŋ, jaŋe domapie sâc mâmâc domambiŋ, jaŋe faharepie sâc mâmâc faharembiŋ.
Wiac jujune jaŋere qizec botâŋko wiac hahameŋne moczi qaratierâ qânâ furi sâko iŋucne bâricnehuc fowec.
Eme wiac hahameŋnere rurumaŋko fafakec‐jeŋic qaratierâ ʒuʒuhuc embiŋ; ehame wiac jujune jaŋe ru sâc fafakec‐jeŋic jajaheczi ɋoroc‐jopa‐fârewec.
Jaŋe rahapie fafakec‐jeŋicte fânâŋ i opâ ɋiɋicnere fânâŋ iŋucne â tâpiri rune ere ɋuŋ parandaŋ fânâŋ iŋucne erâ ŋic guru sâko jaŋere kike fânâŋ iŋucne manapo; jaŋe niniŋkerâ domahuc fafakec‐jeŋic behepie waha doma rawec.
Iŋuc doma rahapie faic irecnec dâŋfânâŋ moc qizec botâŋ‐jeŋicko wahame manapo.
Eme wiac hahameŋne irec faicnao wiac moc eri ŋeŋe tinac ŋeme honepo; hawarine qânâ furi sâkozi kedanehec iŋucne. Eri ŋeŋe fainao ine moczi ŋic hawari tinac ŋeme honepo.
Erâ no gâjoŋ‐ticnaonec wiac moc aeŋ bâbâroŋ iŋucne bâruŋkerâ feha rârec rârec ʒoc fua rame honepo, erâ gâjoŋ‐ticnaonec jaha wiac moc ʒoc iŋucnea wahahame rârec rârec tatamac sâko fuame honepo wâc.
Rârec rârec tatamac sâko fuawec i hoere huriri karoracko fuaekac irec sâc. Wofuŋte huriri qâreŋ irec hawari iŋucne hâcne fuawec. Eme no honerâ mâreŋko hetutuckerâ fohuc ŋic moczi dâŋ mume manapo.
Eme eki ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Ŋicte ɋâric, go fahare domatec dâŋ gazape.”
Iŋuc nazame Anuture Mârozi maŋnaneo hurâ baafecnume fahare domapo, ehuc dâŋ nazame manapo.
Kecʒiŋuc: “Ŋicte ɋâric, no Israe ŋic jaŋerao sorecgupe razemec. Jaŋe ŋicguru qaqatarahec, jaŋe pepec enarembiŋ, ehuc jaŋe jaŋacne mecne â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mecne dâŋnane qatarahuc jumbiŋzi juŋgopieŋ jaha.
Ŋicguru i jaŋe sindaŋ hârindaŋne â maŋrâŋgeŋhec, irec no jaŋerao sorecgupe dâŋ ʒiŋuc fuŋkerâ jazazemec: ‘Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac.’
Iŋuc fuŋkerâ jazatec jaŋe mananiŋmu me qataraniŋmu ine sifu ʒiŋuc mana taraniŋmu: Ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko porofete moc jukac.
Ŋicte ɋâric, go ŋic repicne me sindaŋ hârindaŋne jaŋe rârecgupie omeqaqa faio tinac ŋehuc sifu jaŋe jaŋacne me dâŋjeŋicte mi hâwicguzejec, â râsi ʒâŋe honecgupie maŋge mi gâckezejec. Jaŋe kikefuŋ qaqatarahec hâcne.
Eme jaŋe mananiŋmu me qikiŋneniŋmu go sifu dâŋnane jaza‐jâmbâŋkezemec, jaŋe kikefuŋ qaqatarahec hâcne.
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go ine dâŋ gazape manahuc kikefuŋ qaqatarahec jaŋe iŋucne mi ezemec, go micge aŋkerâ wiac garepemu i nâzemec.”
Eme fipe rame mi moczi papia foforiekicne badomahuc meticne noraopec sicnehame honezepac i!
Eme nore maio qaratieme ʒiŋuc honepo: Maine â râpene i qâreŋhec sasawa, ʒâic busâqoc â makuc erâ bu qâqânduc dâŋ qâreŋkekicnezi fowec hâcne.
Eme eki ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Ŋicte ɋâric, go maigao wiac fokac i nâzemec, papia foforiekicne ʒi hâcne nârâ ra Israe ŋic jaŋe dâŋ jazazemec.”
Iŋuc mume micnane aŋkepe papia nâpemurâ narewec.
Ehuc ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Ŋicte ɋâric, go papia i nârâ gapecguzejec.” Iŋuc mume nâpo; eme micnaneo baŋac iŋucne aŋacnehec ewec.
Eme ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Ŋicte ɋâric, go Israe kikefuŋ jaŋerao rarâ dâŋnane jazazemec.
Go ŋicguru dâŋmarac‐jeŋic furune â ŋemâcne jaŋerao mâcne, Israe kikefuŋ jaŋerao sorecgukopac hâcne.
Manakic, no ŋicguru bocjaha dâŋmarac‐jeŋic furune â ŋemâcne, erâ goki mi mamana tarane iŋucne jaŋerao mi sorecgukopac. Iŋucne jaŋerao sorecgupe muzac dâŋge mananʒapiŋ.
Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe nore dâŋ mi manaeŋgopieŋte gore dâŋ wâc mi mananiŋmu, jaŋe ŋic repicne â maŋrâŋgeŋhec irec.
Manakic, jaŋe ŋifec maŋsanaŋ â maŋrâŋgeŋ eŋgopieŋte go ŋifec iŋuc jaha ecmurâ basanaŋgupo.
Go qânâ furi sâkozi sanaŋ qaŋqaŋne irec sâc ecmurâ basanaŋgupo, irec râsi ʒâŋe honecgupie mi hâwicguzejec, jaŋe kikefuŋ qaqatarahec hâcne.”
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Ŋicte ɋâric, go dâŋ sasawa gazakopac i mana maŋ ezemec.
Ehuc Judaŋic qomâfâcge kâpâcwâru ficko ŋeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao razemec. Eme jaŋe mananiŋmu me qikiŋneniŋmu, go sifu ʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘Dâŋ ŋazakopac i Wofuŋ Anuture dâŋ.’”
Dâŋ iŋuc mume tarame Mârozi baafecnuwac. Ehame Wofuŋte huriri qâreŋzi faharerâ feme râpefuŋ‐naneo fânâŋ sâko moc fuame manapo.
Wiac jujune jaŋere fafakeczi bâbâfuac embiŋ â ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋe heririŋ‐jeŋicko gasackepie fânâŋ sâko iŋucne fuawec hâcne.
Mârozi baafecnuhuc jowa qataŋ enareme rapo. Ehuc Wofuŋte mezi bâmâcnuhuc esocnume buʒâic faio rapo hâcne.
Raku kâpâcwâru ŋic Kebara opâo Telabibi hae jumbiŋ jaŋerao fisipo. Ehuc nânâŋguŋne enareme jaŋere ŋondeŋko ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 dâŋemâc jupo.
Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 i tarame Wofuŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fua‐narewec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric go manac, no Israe kikefuŋ jaŋere ruc bapa ŋic râecgukopac; irec go nore mickonec dâŋ manacmu sâc nore micte erâ hazec qâuŋ jazahuc juzemec.
No ŋic hehesicne ʒiŋuc âzâcnepemu: ‘Go hâmo‐jâmbâŋkecmu,’ dâŋ iŋuc âzâcnepe go uŋdâŋ mi âzâcnecmuo â hata‐ticne hehesicnaonec risierâ juju‐ticne asao roocte mi esockecmuo ine ŋic e sâqocne‐ticnehec hâmome ere kiŋzi gore faio feocmu.
Mâc ŋic hehesicne e uŋ sawaŋ ecne‐bipiehaŋ sifu hata‐ticne hehesicne â sindaŋ‐ticne mi beherâ juku sâqocne‐ticnere okacne hâmoocmu, goki ine jujuge asao rokomecte jucmu.
Erâ ŋic tiŋne moc e tiŋne juju‐ticne râpeckerâ sâqocne bame no hata‐ticnao oc hecnepe âke hâmoocmu, ine goki uŋdâŋ mi âzâcnemecte sâqocne‐ticnere okacne hâmoocmu hâcne, juwicnao wiac biaŋne ewec irec mi muzo, eme honepe goki qakomec ekacte ere kiŋzi gore faio feocmu.
Me ŋic e sâqocne mi baocte uŋ sawaŋ ecnetec dâŋge mana ʒakierâ sâqocne mi baocmuo ine jujâmbâŋkeocmu, ehame go wâc jujuge asao rokomecte jucmu.”
Eme no ira juhape Wofuŋ e meticnezi basanaŋnuhuc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc nazawec: “Ajoc, go faharerâ wâneŋko rac, eme no ira dâŋ gazapemu.”
Iŋuc nazame faharerâ wâneŋko rapo; rarâ mi Wofuŋte huriri qâreŋ Kebara opâo honepo iŋucnea fuame honezepac i! Honerâ mâreŋko hetutuckerâ fopo.
Ehame Mârozi maŋnaneo hurâ baafecnume fahare domapo, eme ʒiŋuc muhuc nazawec: “Go ficgao ferâ motâc ki barâ ŋezemec.
O ŋicte qâric, manakic, jaŋe niŋgiŋguhuc muczi basanaŋgupie ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko sâcne hurâ mi jucmu.
Jaŋe kikefuŋ qaqatarahec juŋgopieŋte no nameŋge ŋaŋaracgao bohotape nâŋguŋ erâ uŋdâŋ mocwâc mi jazazemec.
Mâc no gohec dâŋehuc micge baafeckepe dâŋ ʒiŋuc fuŋkerâ jazazemec, ‘Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac.’ Eme moc e dâŋ i manazo murâ manazejec â moc e qikiŋnezo murâ qikiŋnezejec; jaŋe kikefuŋ qaqatarahec hâcne.
“O ŋicte ɋâric, go qânâ dadapic moc rorâ maŋfuŋgao râerâ fainao heutuckehuc Jerusalem haere hawari bazemec.
Ehuc hae rârec rârec somâ bapare ʒae â sac wiac, mâreŋ toŋne erâ râsi jaŋere toma â sac ââke mârâŋ tuŋ irec hawari mâmâc bazemec.
Iŋuc erâ aeŋ dadapic moc rorâ go â hae ŋondeŋ‐ŋekicko râetec sac iŋucne erâ ŋezejec. Eme go hae maickehaŋtec somâmaŋko ŋezejec. Goki hâcne somâckerâ juzemec, eme izi hâcne Israe kikefuŋ wiac fua‐jareocmu irec ma ezejec.
“Go qanaopec waha fohaŋtec Israe ŋic jaŋere sâqocne i gore faio râepe feocmu, ehame ʒoaŋ gie bapa focmu irec sâc sâqocne‐jeŋic âsickecmu hâcne.
Go ʒoaŋ gie bapa 190 Israe kikefuŋ jaŋere sâqocne âsickehuc jucmurâ mugarekopac, jaŋe jara 190 bâbâtiŋko juniŋmu irec sâsâcne.
Eme dameŋ irec faicnao fâreopec waha fohuc Juda kikefuŋ jaŋere sâqocne ʒoaŋ gie bapa 40 irec sâcko âsickehuc juzemec. Ʒoaŋ gie bapa 40 i jara 40 irec sâsâcne.
Eme go Jerusalem hae somâ bakicne i maickerâ mege ŋaqi tâmiric biuctac sicnehuc haere findaŋdâŋ muzemec.
Manakic, no muczi basanaŋgupe ŋifec me ŋifec sâcne mi fotikiehuc juhaŋtec somâ bapa dameŋge tarazejec.
“Go padi jacgoŋ, gai uucne, basac erâ kasaŋ hândâŋ rorâ kuʒi mocjahao bâsifuckerâ nânâ poroŋ bazemec. Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa 190 fohuc jucmu sâc nânâ i hâcne nâhuc juzemec.
Erâ go kosa mâcne, sigelizi aafecne mufua‐gareocmu i ŋafe furec irec sâc bâtâc barâ nâzemec.
Â opâ i wâc iŋuc jaha ʒoaŋte sâc bâtâc barâ nâhuc juzemec. Ʒoaŋ mocte biŋe kiruŋ moc â ʒoaŋ mocte biŋe kiruŋ moc, iŋuczi iŋuc.
Go nânâ i ŋic jaŋe honehapie ŋichozi rikerâ nâhuc juzemec.”
Erâ Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Israe ŋic jaŋe ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐jopape nânâ poroŋ wâwânâŋnehec i hâcne nâhuc junʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc nazame kecʒiŋuc mupo: “O Wofuŋ Anutu, manakic, no wiac gâgâpâcne iŋucne moc mi nâhuc jupo, erâ ɋieonecteaŋ juwefuhuc wiac mâc hâmokicne me kisuc qâsuckekicne me gârecke ʒaŋ ekicne i wâc iŋuc jaha moc mi nâjupac.”
Iŋuc mupe eki ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Manakic, no mana‐garepe ŋichozi mâcne, bulimakao hozi nânâ poroŋge rikezemec.”
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Ŋicte ɋâric, go manac: No mupe Jerusalem haeonec jaŋe nânâ afecne sawa fojarezejec, irec jaŋe hâwic‐jopame nânâ sigelizi mufua‐jareme sâc sawa nâniŋmu â opâ mutâcne‐jarekicne irec sâc nâhuc bipic‐jeŋic taraocmu.
Jaŋe nânâ opâ‐jeŋic omaezo eha nânâre hâmohuc hohonec erâ bipic tatara ejareocmu, jaŋe hehesic‐jeŋicte erâ sipirickeniŋmu hâcne.
“O ŋicte ɋâric, go sâqe ʒora micnehec moc rorâ sâqe kiruŋ iŋucne bahuc qizec susuc â mecʒâwâge rorâ sigelio râerâ guru jahec â moc bacjopazemec.
Ehuc guru moc i somâ bapa dameŋ tarame hae ʒâʒâŋiŋko ʒocko behetec ʒazejec; â guru moc i hae orâŋkehuc ʒikazi qâtâtiezemec, erâ guru moc i ine mâŋâŋko behetec ficneme raha ʒikahec bâjâperâ rapemu.
Ehame qizec susuc jahec mac rorâ ŋaqigao basanaŋkezemec.
Ehuc gâcne mocwâc rorâ ʒocko behetec ʒaoc, eme irecnec hâcne ʒoc fuarâ Israe kikefuŋ sâcke‐fâreocmu.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “No Jerusalem hae i ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâfuarâ râepe ŋekac, ehame hae mâreŋ gâcnezi râreckerâ fokac.
Eme e ŋic gurune gurune â mâreŋne mâreŋne jaŋere sâc jâuruhuc sâcmutâc â dâŋsanaŋ‐nane qatara sanaŋkewec, e sâcmutâc dâŋnane qikiŋnehuc dâŋsanaŋ‐nanere sâcko mi juju qatarawec hâcne.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic noni ʒiŋuc mukopac: Ŋoŋe ŋic gurune gurune orâŋ‐ŋopahuc juŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc jâuruhuc maŋrâŋgeŋ sâko bâfuarâ dâŋsanaŋ‐nanere sâcko mi jumbiŋ â sâcmutâc dâŋnane mi reŋkembiŋ erâ ŋic gurune gurune rârec‐ŋopahuc juŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâcmutâc wâc mi reŋkembiŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Noni hâcne râsi eŋarehuc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere maio okacne bazu‐ŋarepemu.
“No sindaŋ wiac‐ŋeŋic sasawa irec erâ mâsi furune moc, mârâc mi fua‐ŋarewec erâ juku wâc mi fua‐ŋarezokac i hâcne ŋoŋerao epemu.
Ine ʒiŋuc, ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko mamac jaŋe naru motecfâc‐jeŋic nâcjopaniŋmu â naru motec jaŋe mamacfâc‐jeŋic nâcjopaniŋmu. Ehame no okacne bazu‐ŋarehuc ʒanʒaŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic bâtâtiec‐jopape faic â juwic erâ ŋifec â ŋifec rafâreniŋmu.
Wofuŋ Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Ŋoŋe eebapa‐ŋeŋic sâqocne â hehesicnezi tiri ufuŋ‐nane hegâpârembiŋ, irec no jujâmbâŋkekopacte bâsirowec‐ŋopapemu, ehuc busâqoc mana‐ŋarehuc moc mi akic‐ŋopapemu.
Ŋoŋeraonec ŋic tucne jaŋe huc mimicnezi rocjopaocmu â rorocte hâmo sipiric eniŋmu, tucnezi rârec rârec ʒika fokac irec micko fefâreniŋmu, erâ tucne jaŋe ine mupe tâtierâ mâreŋ qaŋeŋne fokac sâc rafârehapie no ʒikahec rahuc jopa jâpec ejarepemu.
“Iŋuc ejarepe aaric‐nanere fârine fuame kimbeŋ‐nane wahaocmu â maŋnane mâteŋkeocmu. Iŋuc fuame jaŋe ʒiŋuc mana tarahuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Wofuŋ e ʒoɋac‐ticnere erâ aaric mana‐nârehuc kimbeŋ qanârewec.’
Erâ manakic, no mupe Jerusalem hae‐ŋeŋic niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ foha ŋicne ŋicne râreckehuc juŋgopieŋ jaŋe, ŋic ira sicne fotâc eniŋmu jaŋere maio rune ŋoŋe mu ruruc eŋareniŋmu.
No kimbeŋ aaricko dâŋŋeŋic mutarahuc okacne bazu‐ŋarepe ŋicne ŋicne orâŋ‐ŋopahuc juŋgopieŋ jaŋe ŋoŋere manapie mamakâcne eha âke sisic eŋareniŋmu; ŋifec ine uŋsawaŋ‐jeŋic eha hâwic‐jopazejec. No Wofuŋzi hâcne mukopac.
No imac‐ŋopapemurâ roroc fufuare tepe motec, sisipiricte tepe motec hâcne, i qâtâcnepemu. No mupe roroc fua‐ŋareme nânâ poroŋ‐ŋeŋic omaezejec.
Erâ nonizia mupe roroc fua‐ŋareme qowi mimicne jaŋe naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic nâ sipiric ejareniŋmu. Ŋoŋerao huc mimicne â soc rurua fuaha ʒikare meo râec‐ŋopapemu. No Wofuŋzi hâcne mukopac.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fua‐narewec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Israe tiki mâreŋkopec fitec rahame irec findaŋdâŋ muzemec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc muzemec: Israe tiki mâreŋ, go Wofuŋ Anuture dâŋ manac: Wofuŋ Anutu e Israe tiki mâreŋ â facne facne erâ opâ wâcne wâŋgoroŋ â wâneŋne wâneŋne ŋoŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc ŋazakac: Manaŋgopieŋ, noni hâcne ʒikare biŋe râec‐ŋopahuc ɋâŋufuŋ wiac‐ŋeŋic tikio ŋerakac i imacke‐fârepemu.
Alata wiac‐ŋeŋic i ima bazo â hosâc âsu alata wiac i qanʒaŋnezo, ehame no qâhâmoc‐jopakicnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe nemufâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere maio behec‐jopape foraniŋmu.
Erâ no Israe ŋic ŋoŋere qâŋɋâŋfâc i nemufâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere maio guruc‐jopapemu, ehuc siec wiac‐ŋeŋic i alata‐ŋeŋic râreckerâ bâtâtiehuc râe rapemu.
Hae‐ŋeŋic tâtie‐fâreme nemuɋâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere fic hae i niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ foocmu. Ehame alata wiac‐ŋeŋic i henʒaŋnepie omaeocmu, â nemuɋâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe qanʒaŋ‐joparâ sipiric‐jopaniŋmu. Erâ hosâc âsu ririke alata‐ŋeŋic i heropiehuc meqâreŋ‐ŋeŋic ima bafâreniŋmu.
Eme no Wofuŋ jukopac, i ŋoŋe mana taraniŋte qâhâmoc‐jopakicnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko foraniŋmu.
“Eme no gâcne ŋoŋe akic‐ŋopape ʒika wisecnehuc mâreŋ sâc tâtierâ ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko juniŋmu.
Eme ŋoŋe ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko kâpâcwâruo juhuc nore manasuniŋmu. Ŋoŋe wiac mamakâcne ehuc maŋŋeŋiczi qikiŋnurâ nemu jaŋerao ʒâŋe fihuc qohotapie aaricnume qanʒaŋ‐ŋopapo i hâcne manasuniŋmu. Ehuc ŋoŋe ŋaŋacnere â eebapa‐ŋeŋicte manapie wiac mamakâcne eocmu hâcne.
Ehuc nore ʒiŋuc mana taraniŋmu: Eki hâcne Wofuŋ jukac, e ʒârâ hâriŋ wiac keci fai‐nâŋecko râeme feocte qanaŋ uŋdâŋ nâzâwec i fârimâc mi ewec.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Israe kikefuŋ eebapa‐jeŋic mamakâcnere erâ me qahuc kike âteicke‐jarerâ ʒiŋuc muzemec: ‘Jei!’ Jaŋe ʒikare â rorocte erâ huc mimicnere sipirickeniŋmu hâcne.
Ehuc ʒoricko juocmu e huc mimicnere hâmoocmu â bembeŋko juocmuzi ʒikare biŋe eocmu, me wiac izi bâtirime juocmu eki ine roroc fuame sipirickeocmu. No iŋuc ehuc kimbeŋ qajarepemu hâcne.
Qâhâmoc‐jopakicnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko alata wiac‐jeŋic râreckehuc foraniŋmu, me tikine tikine â tiki botâŋne sâc erâ jâc dodomane â boriŋjâc fuŋnao â nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic hosâc âsu biaŋ rike‐jare jumbieŋko ira forapie honec‐joparâ, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu.
Eme no menane sicnehuc râsi ejarepemu, ehuc mâreŋ‐jeŋic imackepe niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ foocmu. Ŋeŋe hae‐jeŋic mâreŋ sawaonec fuŋkerâ raku Ribela haeo tarakac ira hâcne wiac iŋuc ejarepe jaŋe no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fua‐narewec:
“O ŋicte ɋâric, Wofuŋ Anutu no Israe mâreŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukopac: Dameŋge tarakac. Mâreŋge qaŋeŋne jahec â jahec irec dameŋ tarakac hâcne.
Ʒi dameŋge tarazo eha kimbeŋ‐nanezi ŋecjucfâcge jaŋere faio feocmu, ehame juju‐jeŋicte sâcko dâŋjeŋic mutarahuc eebapa‐jeŋic mamakâcnere okacne bazu‐jarepemu.
Ehuc no busâqoc mana‐jarerâ moc mi akic‐jopapemu, wiac mamakâcnezi ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ʒuhuckerâ foha eebapa‐jeŋicte okacne bazu‐jarepemu hâcne. Iŋuc ejarepe jaŋe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manaŋgopieŋ, sisipiriczi sisipiric ware fisikac.
Dameŋ tarazo ekac, tarazo ekac hâcne. Manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ tataranezi maic‐ŋopakac.
O mâreŋ ʒirec ŋecjucfâc, sisipiriczi bâmbeŋ‐ŋopakac, dameŋ maickekac i ʒeri bubiaŋ dameŋ mâcne, ʒâic busâqoc dameŋ.
No dameŋ mi ʒoraha kimbeŋ qahuc aaric mana‐ŋarepemu, ehuc juju‐ŋeŋicte sâcko dâŋŋeŋic mutarahuc eebapa‐ŋeŋic mamakâcnere okacne bazu‐ŋare‐fârepemu.
Erâ no busâqoc mana‐ŋarehuc moc mi akic‐ŋopapemu, wiac mamakâcnezi ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ʒuhuckerâ foha eebapa‐ŋeŋicte okacne bazu‐ŋarepemu hâcne. Iŋuc eŋarepe ŋoŋe, no hâcne Wofuŋ juhuc imac‐ŋopakopac i mana taraniŋmu.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, sisipiric dameŋzi biac maic‐ŋopakac hâcne. Juju â eebapa hehesicnezi fua ɋârâŋkeha pepec penaroŋzi sueme sue fua fewec.
Bâbâʒâiczi soka ŋedâmârec erâ hehesicte fuŋqizecne ewec. Irec moczi moc ʒuhuckerâ mi juocmu, ehame moneŋ mafa‐ŋeŋic me mazuc mâriri‐ŋeŋic i wâc mi foŋareocmu, â ʒâŋe biŋe‐ŋeŋic i wâc iŋuc jaha omaeocmu.
Dameŋ bembeŋkekac, irec moc e wiac furine baekac e bubiaŋ mi manazejec, â moc e furire erâ wiac râeekaczi busâqoc mi ezejec. Kimbeŋ aaric i mâmâc sâko‐ŋeŋic eocmu hâcne.
Furire erâ wiac râeekac e dameŋ ʒora juipiehame wiac izi me izi sifu ere biŋe mocwâc mi eocmu. Kimbeŋ aaric‐nanezi fai‐ŋeŋicko fosanaŋkeha ŋoŋe kiŋŋeŋicte erâ juju‐ŋeŋic sâcne mi ŋezickeniŋmu. fai‐jeŋicko fohuc bâmâc‐jopawecte moczi moc ʒikare mi afeckewec.
<range>
Hae râpeo ʒika fuakac â haemaŋko ine huc mimicne â roroczi fuarâ fokac, irec gieo juekaczi ʒikare micko feocmu, â haeo juekaczi roroc â huc mimicnere biŋe eocmu.
Me wiac izi bâtiric‐jopaocmu jaŋe tikio ferâ juhuc kâec kâec jaŋe opâwâcko nânâ‐jeŋicte maku eeŋgopieŋ irec sâcko kiŋjeŋicte mu mamakuc eniŋmu.
Mejeŋiczi ɋaŋaha dieŋ‐jeŋiczi jâjâwâckeocmu.
Jaŋe târuzi mateŋ barâ qonaŋkeeŋgopieŋ, ehuc hâwic‐jopame fâfâre sâqoreniŋmu, jaŋe mimi busâqoczi fai‐jeŋicko feha utu pârâc fua‐jare‐fâreocmu.
Jaŋe siliwa‐jeŋic hae ʒoŋao behepie foocmu â goljeŋicte manapie mamakâcne eocmu. Wofuŋte okac dameŋko siliwa â goljeŋiczi sâcne mi ŋezic‐jopaocmu. Wiac izi sâcne mi gapec‐jopaocmu â hobu‐jeŋic sâcne mi fusucmaocmu, jaŋe i hâcne bajuhuc kiŋ hurembiŋ.
Eri wiac‐jeŋic gol â siliwazi bakicne i bajuhuc sahac fefe boc embiŋ, ehuc wiac izi hâcne nemuɋâŋ mamakâcne â qâpuc wiac repicne gâcne ba akic embiŋ, eme no irec mupe wiac wâwânâŋnehec eocmu.
Ehame ŋic furune â sindaŋne mana‐jarepe ro rauc epie mateŋ‐jeŋic eha bajupie wâwânâŋhec ezejec.
Jaŋe tiri ufuŋ‐nane wâwânâŋ ecnembiŋte râpec‐jopapemu. Eme ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe raʒirâ wiac qacne gâpâcne ecnehuc
imackepie niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fozejec. “Mâreŋ ira soc bocjaha hoŋkeeŋgopieŋ â haeo ŋic boc bâʒâic‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Eme no irec ŋicguru repic qapicne jaŋe ejarepe fic wiac‐jeŋic ro rauc enʒepieŋ; no tâpiri sâko‐jeŋic bawahape tiri ufuŋ wiac‐jeŋic wâwânâŋnehec ezejec.
Eme hâhâwic fua‐jareme wama basaniŋmu.
Sisipiriczi sisipiric â biŋe bâroŋzi biŋe bâroŋ fisiocmu, ehame porofetezi findaŋdâŋ muocte âzâcne‐bipieniŋmu, erâ taha bapa jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋte fuŋne mocwâc mi mana taraniŋmu â soŋaŋ micne jaŋere maŋɋârâŋzi wâc omaeocmu.
Ŋicwofuŋzi maku eocmu â ŋic fekicne jaŋe hâhâwic sâko bâfuaniŋmu, erâ ŋic omane jaŋe bipic tatara ejareocmu. No eebapa‐jeŋicte sâcko wiac ejarepemu, ehuc jaŋacne sâcmutâc dâŋte sâcko dâŋjeŋic mutara‐jarepemu. Eme jaŋe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu.”
Jara 6 irec mosa namba 6 jaha â irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 5 ira Judaŋic jaŋere soŋaŋ micne jaŋehec nore ficko ŋehapene Wofuŋ Anuture tâpirizi norao fua taniŋkewec. Iŋuc fuame mi wiac moc ŋic hawari tinac honezepac i!
Gâjoŋ‐ticne juwicnao ʒoc ʒahuc fowec â irec faicnao wiac moc aeŋ bâbâroŋ iŋucne bâruŋkehuc tamaewec.
E wiac moc me tinac izi sicnerâ qizec gere‐naneo rorâ fârecnuwec, ehame maŋnane ŋerisieme manape Mârozi sambâŋ â mâreŋ ŋondeŋ‐jekicko bacnu ferâ Jerusalem haeo râecnuwec tinac ewec. Ehuc miti ufuŋte hae ʒoŋa piticne irec motâc faic mâreŋ maickerâ fokac â maŋbâiŋ bâbâfua nemuɋâŋ ŋeekac ira hâcne râecnuwec.
Eme no Israere Anutu ere huriri qâreŋ mârâc jaha wâneŋko fuame honepo irec sâc fua‐narewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Ŋicte ɋâric, go faic mâreŋkopec fitec feoc.” Eme no faic mâreŋkopec fipe feme alatare sacmotâc faic mâreŋkopec fokac ira maŋbâiŋ bâbâfua nemuɋâŋ ŋeme honepo.
Ehame Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Ŋicte ɋâric, Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe ufuŋ‐naneonec jâpecnuniŋte wiac mamakâcne sâko ehuc jueŋgopieŋ i moc honekic me? Erâ go wiac mamakâcne honemeŋ irec sâc sirickehuc honecmu jaha.”
Eme eki jowacnume hae ʒoŋare motâcko fisirâ ʒiŋuc honepo: Sâpeo hawec fuarâ fowec.
Eme dâŋ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Ŋicte ɋâric, go sâpe bâmârâŋkec.” Eme bâmârâŋkerâ mi motâc moc domame honezepac i!
Ehame ʒuhuckerâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go raʒirâ ʒira wiac mamakâcne sâko eeŋgopieŋ i honezemec.”
Iŋuc nazame raʒirâ wiac kecʒiŋuc honepo: Sâpeo rârec rârec ira wiac babarâ jujune â qowi repicne erâ Israe kikefuŋ jaŋere nemuɋâŋ irec hawari wiac bakicne.
Eme jaŋere heririŋko Israe kikefuŋte soŋaŋ micne 70 domahapie Jaʒania, Safaŋte ŋokâ hâcne, e ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko domawec. Jaŋe sasawa hosâc âsu ririkere râqâc badomahapie hosâczi ŋezuhuc fewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc wio‐narewec: “Ŋicte ɋâric, Israe kikefuŋte soŋaŋ micne jaŋe ru sâc hawari doma rakac i rauckehuc dapâcko hosâc âsu rike‐jareŋgopieŋ i moc honekomec me? Jaŋe ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ hâcne: ‘Wofuŋzi mi honec‐nâpoekac, e mâreŋ‐nâŋec qâmâtâ ecnewec.’”
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go wiac mamakâcne honemec irec sâc sirickehuc honecmu jaha.”
Izi ine Wofuŋ ufuŋ‐ticnere motâc faic mâreŋ maickerâ fowec ira jowacnume mi ŋokac jaŋe Tamuʒi nemure kiohapie honec‐jopazepac i!
Eme ʒiŋuc wio‐narewec: “O ŋicte ɋâric, go wiac ʒi honekomec me? Go wiac mamakâcne honemec irec sâc sirickehuc honecmu jaha.”
Iŋuc murâ jowacnume Wofuŋ ufuŋ‐ticnere hae ʒoŋa piticnao raʒipec. Eme Wofuŋ taha ufuŋ‐ticnere hae ʒoŋa alata ŋondeŋ‐jekicko motâc fuŋnao ŋic 25 domahapie honec‐jopapo. Jaŋe Wofuŋte taha ufuŋ râpeckehuc ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec ʒâŋe firâ ʒoaŋ fodapecnehuc numucnembiŋ.
Eha ʒiŋuc nazawec: “O ŋicte ɋâric, go wiac i honekomec me? Judaŋic jaŋe wiac mamakâcne irec manapie aafecne eha wiac repicne gâcne ʒuhuckerâ bâfuapie mâreŋ sâcke‐fâreekac. Jaŋe bâmiriŋnu‐bipiehuc sifu maŋbâiŋ enareeŋgopieŋ.
Eme no irec hâcne ʒuhuckerâ aaric mana‐jarepemu, ehuc busâqoc mana‐jarehuc mi akic‐jopapemu. Jaŋe wira wâwâsic enare‐bipiehapie sifu micjeŋicko moc mi ropemu.”
Eme Mârozi owackerâ kecʒiŋuc mume manapo: “Jerusalem haere okac babazu gie baniŋte muŋarekicne ŋoŋe momori wiac‐ŋeŋic barâ bembeŋko warenʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume ŋic 6 jaŋe momori wiac‐jeŋic barâ motâc faicpec irecnec wahambiŋ. Ŋic moczi ine qoruc qarâ tinde â feda kikene becsahac‐ticnao râerâ jaŋehec mâmâc wahawec. Eme jaŋe raʒirâ alata aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bakicne irec maŋfuŋko domambiŋ.
Israere Anutu ere huriri qâreŋzi kerubimte faio foweckonec waharâ ficmotâcko fowec. Ehame Wofuŋzi ŋic qoruc qarâ tinde â feda kikene bajuwec e wiracnewec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Jerusalem haeo wiac mamakâcne fuarâ fokac, irec go hae i fotâcnehuc haere ki busâqoc eeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋere ʒâŋe maio ma bazemec.”
Erâ ŋic gâcne jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazame manapo: “Ŋoŋe e bâjâperâ hae fotâcnehuc ʒika gie banʒepieŋ, ehuc ŋic busâqoc mana‐jarehuc moc mi akic‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic raŋɋa mecne, socɋâri mecne, naru mecne, ɋiene mecne â ŋokac mâmâc qâhâmoc‐jopanʒepieŋ; mâc ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋicko ma bakicne jaŋe ine ba bâuwac moc mi ejarenʒepieŋ. Gie i ine tiri ufuŋ‐naneo domarâ fuŋkenʒepieŋ.” Iŋuc mume jaŋe soŋaŋ micne tiri ufuŋko jumbiŋ jaŋerao fuŋkembiŋ.
Eme dâŋ ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ jazawec: “Tiri ufuŋ wâwânâŋ ecnehuc qâhâmoc‐jopakicne jaŋe ufuŋte hae ʒoŋao behec‐jopapie fusucmarâ foranʒepieŋ. Ajoc, faharerâ fuŋkeniŋ!” Eme jaŋe fahare haeo rarâ ʒika gie fuŋkembiŋ.
Eme jaŋe ʒika qahuc juhapie no nahackoaŋ buc juhuc mâreŋko hetutuckerâ ʒiŋuc muhuc wirapo: “O Wofuŋ Anutu, go Jerusalem haere boc aaricguhame Israe ŋic nâfocne sipiric‐jopa‐fârezo mukomec me?”
Iŋuc mupe ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Israe â Juda kikefuŋ jaŋere kiŋ i boc ferâ fokac, soczi hae mâreŋ sâckerâ fokac â hehesiczi hae fusucma‐fârekac. Jaŋe ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ hâcne: ‘Wofuŋzi mâreŋ‐nâŋec qâmâtâ ecnewec, Wofuŋ e mi honec‐nâpoekac.’
No ine busâqoc mana‐jarehuc moc mi akic‐jopapemu, aricne, no eebapa‐jeŋicte okacne fai‐jeŋicko râepe feocmu.”
Iŋuc mume ŋic qoruc qarâ tinde â feda kikene bajuwec eki risierâ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “No wiac mutâcne‐naremeŋ irec sâc efârepo.”
No ʒâŋe fipe feme mi kerubim jaŋere qizec botâŋko wiac moc eri ŋeŋere hawari iŋucne qânâ furi sâko safirizi bakicne honezepac i!
Eme ŋic qoruc qarâ domawec e Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋe ririsiehapie kerubim jaŋere rurumaŋko raʒirâ ŋondeŋ‐jeŋickonec ʒoc kine ameckerâ haeo behetec iiŋnehuc tâtiezejec.” Eme ʒâŋe fai‐naneo raʒiwec.
Raʒihame kerubim jaŋe taha ufuŋ ŋifecne juwic mâreŋkopec domambiŋ, ehame karorac moczi taha ufuŋte hae ʒoŋa piticne sâcke‐fârewec.
Eme Wofuŋte huriri qâreŋzi kerubim jaŋeraonec faharerâ taha ufuŋte motâc fuŋko sâckerâ fowec, eme karoraczi taha ufuŋ fusucma‐fâreha Wofuŋte huriri qâreŋ irec ʒâziriŋzi hae ʒoŋa‐ticne batamae‐fârewec.
Kerubim jaŋere fafakec irec fânâŋ fuame hae ʒoŋao domambiŋzi manambiŋ, fânâŋ i Anutu tâpiri runezi dâŋeekac iŋucne tinac.
“Go ʒafeŋgâŋ ririsieeŋgopieŋ â kerubim ŋondeŋ‐jeŋickonec ʒoc rozemec,” Wofuŋ e ŋic qoruc qarâ domawec dâŋ iŋuc âzâcneme raʒirâ ʒafeŋgâŋ ŋifecnao domawec.
Eme kerubim moczi âgofâcne jaŋerao meticne sicnehuc ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ʒoc ʒahuc fowec irec tucne gâcne rorâ ŋic qoruc qarâ domawec e râcneme rorâ hurawec.
Kerubim jaŋe fafakec rurumaŋ‐jeŋicko ŋicme hawari fowec.
Eme no ʒâŋe fipe rame kerubim jaŋere ŋondeŋko ʒafeŋgâŋ 4 honec‐jopapo, kerubim jaŋe ru sâc ʒafeŋgâŋ‐jeŋic mocjaha mocjaha sasawa. Ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋere hawari ine qânâ furi sâko iŋucne bâricnehuc ŋembiŋ.
Jaŋe hawari‐jeŋic mocjaha sasawa, erâ wâc ʒafeŋgâŋ mocte maŋnao ʒafeŋgâŋ moc râekicne tinac ewec.
Kerubim jaŋe mâreŋ faic â juwic, ŋifec â ŋifec rahuc tikic fotikic tâmiric dândâŋnea rafârembiŋ, ehame ʒafeŋgâŋ bâbânizi rawec ijaha âgofâcne jaŋe bâjâperâ tikic fotikic tâmiric jaha rafârembiŋ.
Kerubim sahac‐jeŋicko, râpe‐jeŋicko, mejeŋicko, fafakec‐jeŋicko erâ ʒafeŋgâŋ‐jeŋicko ʒâŋe hândâŋ bocjahazi sâcke‐fârerâ ŋerawec.
Ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋe ine ʒafeŋgâŋ ŋeŋe risiene, ʒâŋe‐jeŋic iŋuc mupie manapo.
Kerubim jaŋe ru sâc ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic 4; ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic moc ine kerubim iŋucne, â moc ine ŋic hawari iŋucne, â moc ine laioŋ hawari iŋucne erâ moc i ine tucwipere hawari iŋucne.
Eme kerubim jaŋe faharerâ sawao fembiŋ. Ine Kebara opâo wiac jujune honec‐jopapo jaŋe hâcne.
Eme kerubim jaŋe rapie sâc ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋe mâmâc rambiŋ, â kerubim jaŋe mâreŋ beherâ fahareniŋte fafakec‐jeŋic qaratiepie ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋe moc mi behec‐jopambiŋ.
Wiac jujune jaŋere mârozi ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋehec mâmâc juwecte wiac jujune jaŋe domambiŋ sâc ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋe mâmâc domambiŋ, me faharerâ rambiŋ sâc jaŋe mâmâc rambiŋ.
Iŋuc fuame Wofuŋte huriri qâreŋzi taha ufuŋte motâckonec rârierâ kerubim jaŋere qizec botâŋko sanaŋkerâ domawec.
Kerubim jaŋe ine fafakec‐jeŋic hedâmârerâ fahare sawao fembiŋ. Eme no honehape ʒafeŋgâŋ‐jeŋichec mâmâc rambiŋ. Raku Wofuŋ ufuŋ‐ticnere motâc ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec fowec ira domahapie Israere Anutu ere huriri qâreŋzi qizec botâŋ‐jeŋicko sanaŋkerâ domawec.
Wiac jujune i jaŋe hâcne Israere Anutu ere rurumaŋko Kebara opâo honec‐jopapo, ehuc ʒiŋuc mana tarapo, jaŋe kerubim hâcne.
Jaŋe ru sâc ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic 4, erâ fafakec‐jeŋic 4 jaha, fafakec‐jeŋic rurumaŋnao ŋicme hawari fowec.
Hawari‐jeŋic ine Kebara opâo honec‐jopapo jaŋere sâc. Eme jaŋe buc buc dândâŋnea rafârembiŋ.
Mârozi baafecnuhuc Wofuŋ ufuŋ‐ticnere motâc ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec fowec ira jowa qataŋ enareme rapo. Ra fisirâ mi motâc raraʒio ŋic 25 domahapie honec‐jopazepac i! Ehuc jaŋere ŋondeŋko fekicne jahec‐jeŋic Aʒurure ŋokâ Jaʒania â Benajare ŋokâ Pelatia jahe honec‐jofapo.
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Ŋicte ɋâric, ŋic keci jahe hâcne hae ʒira dâŋ wiac hehesicne â qacne gâpâcne manasu biric eekopirec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc muekopirec: ‘Fic hae bapare dameŋ biac mi maickekac, hae ʒizi kuʒi enâreha nâŋe ine qowi eŋgopeneŋ.’
Irec ŋicte ɋâric, go râsi ejactehuc findaŋdâŋ‐jekic muzemec.”
Eme Wofuŋte Mârozi norao waharâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go jazac, Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: O Israe kikefuŋ, ŋoŋe iŋuc hâcne manasueŋgopieŋ â maŋŋeŋicko dâŋ fuarâ fokac i wâc manakopac.
Ŋoŋe hae ʒira ŋic bocjaha qâhâmoc‐joparâ behec‐jopapie qâŋɋâŋzi hae ʒoŋa‐ticne fusucmarâ fokac.
Irec hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Ŋoŋe ŋic qâhâmoc‐joparâ hae ʒâʒâŋiŋko behec‐jopambiŋ jaŋe hâcne qowi ehapie hae ʒizi kuʒi ekac, ŋoŋe ine hae ʒirecnec bacŋopa razo.
Ŋoŋe ʒikare hâwic‐ŋopaekac, no ine sifu ʒikare micko râec‐ŋopapemu, Wofuŋ Anutu no iŋuc mukopac.
No hae ʒirecnec rocŋoparâ ŋic furune jaŋere meo râec‐ŋopahuc okacne bazu‐ŋarepemu.
Ŋoŋe ʒikare nânâ ehapie Israe mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao bâbâtiŋko râec‐ŋopape, no Wofuŋ jukopac, i mana taranʒepieŋ.
Hae ʒizi kuʒi‐ŋeŋic mi eocmu â ŋoŋe wâc qowifâc‐ticne mi eniŋmu. No Israe mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao bâtiŋ‐ŋopapemu hâcne.
Eme no Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe sâcmutâc dâŋnanere sâcko mi jumbiŋ â mumutâc dâŋnane mana rereŋ mi embiŋ, aricne, ŋoŋe ŋicne ŋicne rârec‐ŋopahuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere mumutâc dâŋte sâcko wiac ebac embiŋ hâcne.”
Eme no findaŋdâŋ muhuc domahape Benajare ŋokâ Pelatia e rândiŋke qarâ hâmowec. Iŋuc fuame no mâreŋko hetutuckerâ kâcɋene wirahuc ʒiŋuc mupo: “O Wofuŋ Anutu, go Israe ŋic nâfocne jaŋe wâc omae‐fâreniŋte mukomec me?”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fua‐narewec:
“O ŋicte ɋâric, qomâfâcge gohec kâpâcwâruo mâmâc juŋgopieŋ Israere kikefuŋ sasawa hâcne ŋoŋere dâŋ i Jerusalem haere ŋecjucfâc jaŋe ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: ‘Jaŋe Wofuŋ beherâ taicko juŋgopieŋ, irec mâreŋ ʒi nâŋe ro rauc enaŋte nârekicne!’
Irec jazac, ‘Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac: No ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko guruc‐joparâ mâreŋne mâreŋne bâtâtiec‐jopahape jaŋe sifu mâreŋ ra jumbiŋ ira dameŋ gâcnao nore manapie ŋeŋezic‐jeŋic jukopac jaha ewec.’
Irec jazac, ‘Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: No ŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec qâzuc‐ŋoparâ mâreŋne mâreŋne bâtâtiec‐ŋopakicnaonec henusuc‐ŋoparâ Israe mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic ŋarepe mocwâc rauckeniŋmu.’
Eme jaŋe ira fisirâ wiac mamakâcne â hehesicne i bârârie‐fâreniŋmu.
No buhândâŋ ɋâricne jarepemu â Mâro ɋâricne maŋjeŋicko râepe huocmu. Maŋjeŋicko busezi buhâdâŋ fokac i ro bârâriec ehuc biuczi buhândâŋ moc râe‐jarepemu.
Ehame jaŋe sâcmutâc‐naneo ninipenʒepieŋ â mumupaŋ‐nane reŋkenʒepieŋ, ehuc jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane juhapie no Anutu‐jeŋic erâ jupemu.
Maŋjeŋic nemuɋâŋko â wiac mamakâcnao râepie foocmu ine eebapa‐jeŋicte okacne bazu‐jarepemu, Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Dâŋ iŋuc mutarame kerubim jaŋe fafakec‐jeŋic heratierâ rapie ʒafeŋgâŋ jaŋe mâmâc rambiŋ, ehame Israere Anutu ere huriri qâreŋzi faic‐jeŋicko jaha domawec.
Erâ Wofuŋte huriri qâreŋ i haemaŋkonec wefurâ tiki haere ʒoaŋ wewefunao ŋewec ira fe domawec.
Ehame manape Mârozi baafecnuhuc enareme kâpâcwâru ŋic Kaldea mâreŋko jumbiŋ jaŋerao rapo tinac ewec erâ wiac hone manac epo i omaewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi wiac naza nowatuc ewec i sasawa kâpâcwâru ŋic jaza‐fârepo.
Wofuŋte dâŋ ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc fua‐narewec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go ŋicguru qaqatarahec jaŋere ŋondeŋko jukomec, jaŋe ʒâŋe fojare‐bipieha sifu mi honeeŋgopieŋ â hazec fojare‐bipieha sifu mi manaeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋicguru qaqatarahec hâcne. Ŋicte ɋâric, go irec hâcne ʒoaŋko honecguhapie kâpâcwâruo huhure he wiacge bâmockerâ hata fuŋkezemec. Go kâpâcwâru ŋic iŋucne haege beherâ mocko rahaŋtec jaŋe ŋicguru qaqataraheczi sifu mana taraniŋmu mecne.
Kâpâcwâruo rarare mafa wiac bâmockekicne i ʒoaŋkoa honecguhapie jaha bawahazemec, erâ hae owâeme honecguhapie jaha kâpâcwâru ŋic iŋucne hae beherâ razemec.
Ehuc honecguhapie qânâsac âke mârâŋkerâ hawec fuame ira fotâcnerâ huzemec.
Erâ honecguhapie jaha mafa wiacge hâporâ dapâcko razemec. Ehuc ʒâŋege bâsoŋkerâ hae mâreŋ mi honezemec; gorao wiac fuakac izi Israe kikefuŋ jaŋerao fuaocmu irec sâsâcne ekac.”
Eme no wiac mutâcne‐narekicne sâc efârepo. No kâpâcwâruo rarare mafa wiac‐nane ʒoaŋkoa bawahapo, erâ hae owâeme no nahacne mezi qânâsac bâmârâŋkepo. Ehuc jaŋe honecnuhapie mafa wiac‐nane hâporâ dapâcko raʒipo.
Hae fureme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, Israe kikefuŋ qaqatarahec jaŋe go ʒiŋuc mi wio‐garembiŋ me: ‘Go wemo wiac ekomec?’
Irec jazac, ‘Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Wiac ʒi fuakac i Jerusalem haere ŋic fekicne ere mecne, erâ Israe kikefuŋ hae maŋnao juŋgopieŋ jaŋere biŋe mâmâc ekac.’
Erâ jazac, ‘Norao wiac fuajec izi ŋoŋerao fuaocmu irec sâsâcne ekac. No wiac fua‐narejec iŋucnea ŋoŋerao fuazejec, ŋoŋe kâpâcwâruo bacŋopa raniŋmu hâcne.’
Eme ŋic fekicne ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jukac e mafa wiac‐ticne hâporâ dapâcko razejec; e qânâsac bâmârâŋkerâ ira fotâcnerâ raʒizejec, ehuc ʒâŋe mai‐ticne bâsoŋkerâ mâreŋ moc mi honezejec.
Ehame no wiwitic‐nane hepe ira raʒime rozejec; eme Kaldea ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko Babe haeo barâ rapemu, eki ine mâreŋ i mi hohone juku ira hâmozejec.
Eme babaficfâc‐ticne â momorifâc‐ticne ehec jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâtâtiec‐jopape mâreŋ faic â juwic erâ ŋifec â ŋifec rafârenʒepieŋ; ehuc mupe ʒikazi bâjâpec‐jopazejec.
No ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko â mâreŋne mâreŋne ira bâtâtiec‐jopape ra juhuc, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.
No ine ŋic gâcne akic‐jopape ʒika â roroc erâ huc mimicne wise‐jareniŋmu, ehuc eebapa‐jeŋic mamakâcnere fuŋne i mâreŋ raniŋmu sâc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋerao mufuanʒepieŋ erâ, no Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ i norao harierâ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go fâfâre hehejac ehuc hâwicguha nânâ opâge nâzemec.
Ehuc ŋic omane jazazemec, Wofuŋ Anutu e Jerusalem ŋecjucfâc‐ticne â Israe mâreŋ irec ʒiŋuc mukac: Jaŋe juju‐jeŋic hehesicnere erâ mâreŋ‐jeŋic ima samaki bafârepe maŋhâhâŋ faio juhuc hâwic‐jopaha nânâ opâ‐jeŋic nânʒepieŋ.
Erâ hae sâc ŋic juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe imac‐jopape omaehapie hae mâreŋ i tuhutac fuarâ niniŋ siarereŋ foocmu hâcne. Iŋuc fuame, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, Israe ŋic jaŋere mu âke sisic dâŋ kecʒiŋuc wemocte fuaekac? ‘Dameŋ boc âke suekacte findaŋdâŋ mukicne i fârine mi fuakac.’
Irec ʒiŋuc jazac: ‘Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: No mu âke sisic dâŋ i qatara‐jarepe Israe ŋic jaŋe mocwâc mi munʒepieŋ.’ Erâ wâc ʒiŋuc jazac: ‘Findaŋdâŋ mukicne i fârio qafâreocte dameŋne maickekac hâcne.
Irec Israe kikefuŋko findaŋdâŋ burecne mumu me Anuture micdâŋ kosa mumu i mocwâc mi fua‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.
Aricne, Wofuŋ no hâcne dâŋ i me i muzo murâ mupe fârio qaocmu. Mocwâc behepe mi foocmu, kikefuŋ qaqatarahec ŋoŋe juhapie jaha mupe fârinehec eocmu, Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.’”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao mocwâc kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go manakic, Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Porofetezi wiac hone manac eekac i juku jaha fârinehec eocmu â findaŋdâŋ muekac i ʒâhec dameŋte biŋe.’
Irec go jazac, Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: ‘No dâŋnane i me i dameŋ ʒora mocwâc mi behepe foocmu, aricne, mupe izia fârinehec eocmu, Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.’”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Israe ŋic porofetefâc‐jeŋic burecne jaŋere findaŋdâŋ muzemec, ehuc maŋjeŋicte porofete dâŋ kosa mueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘Ŋoŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ mananiŋ.’
Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Jei, porofete mutucne jaŋe jaŋacne maŋ mamanasu bâjâpehuc wiac hone manac moc mi eeŋgopieŋ.
O Israe ŋic, porofetefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe kâte qâtozi jawa ŋondeŋko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc.
Jaŋe Israe ŋiczi Wofuŋte ʒika dameŋko sanaŋkerâ domaniŋte qânâsacko hawec fuame ferâ mi hebâzickembiŋ.
Jaŋe Wofuŋzi mi sorec‐jopahame micko âkec ecnehuc ʒiŋuc mupie findaŋdâŋ â porofete dâŋjeŋic i burecne ewec: ‘Wofuŋzi mukac.’ Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋzi dâŋjeŋicte fârine bâfuaocte woŋec jumbiŋ.
No dâŋ moc mi muhape ʒiŋuc muhuc qoricnumbiŋ: ‘Wofuŋzi mukac.’ Ŋoŋe iŋuc erâ findaŋdâŋ wiac burecne hone manac ehuc nore micdâŋ kosa mi mufuambiŋ me?”
Irec hâcne Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe burec â eeatuc ehuc findaŋdâŋ mumbiŋte râsi eŋarekopac. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Porofete wiac burecne hone manac eeŋgopieŋ â findaŋdâŋ burecne mueŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne râsi ejarekopac; jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋehec mi junʒepieŋ â ʒâŋe‐jeŋic i Israe kikefuŋte ʒâŋe birio râepie mi fozejec, erâ mâreŋ‐jeŋicko mocwâc mi risienʒepieŋ. Eme no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe wama moc mi fohame ‘Wama fokac’ muhuc ŋicfâc‐nane eatuc‐jopapie qâsoriembiŋ â ŋic jaŋe qânâsac bahapie sahacne hâpezi burec burec ruacnembiŋte iŋuc ejarepemu.
Irec go ŋic gie i baŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Qânâsac i rândiŋkeocmu. Hoe micsâkozi aisihec heocmu â mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋnehec qame qânâsac rândiŋkeocmu hâcne.
Rândiŋkeme ŋic jaŋe ʒiŋuc wio‐ŋareniŋmu: ‘Hâpe faine ruacnekicne i weni?’”
Irec Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “No kimbeŋ aaricko mupe mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋnehec qaha hoe micsâko aisihec hehuc sac sipirickeocmu.
Ŋoŋe sac hâpezi ruacnembiŋ i hetâtiepe mâreŋko waha qarâ fome hobeteŋ‐ticnezi kosa forazejec. Sac rândiŋkeha ŋoŋe mâmâc sipirickehuc, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.
No iŋuc epe aaric‐nanezi fârinehec eha qânâsac mecne â ŋic hâpe ruacnembiŋ jaŋe mâmâc sipirickenʒepieŋ. Iŋuc fuame ʒiŋuc ŋazapemu: Qânâsac mecne â ŋic hâpezi ruacnembiŋ jaŋe mâmâc omae‐fârembiŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋere porofetezi Jerusalem haere findaŋdâŋ mumbiŋ, erâ wama moc mi foha sifu ‘Wama fokac’ mumbiŋ jaŋe hâcne omae‐fârembiŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Ŋicte ɋâric, goki ine ŋicfâcge jaŋere ŋokacfâc maŋjeŋicte findaŋdâŋ mueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mu hanec ejarehuc findaŋdâŋ jaha jazazemec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc muzemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Jei, ŋokac ŋoŋe ŋic juju‐jeŋic sipirickeniŋte maŋguc‐ŋeŋicko qaŋgec wiac esorierâ rojueŋgopieŋ â irec ufic i ŋic sâcjeŋic honehuc ba akic erâ fârepie ira jowaeŋgopieŋ. Ŋoŋe ŋifec ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere juju sipirickeniŋte mueŋgopieŋ â ŋifec ine ŋaŋacne jujure manasuhuc gâcne jaŋere juju ŋezickeniŋte mueŋgopieŋ me?
Ŋoŋe ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere ŋondeŋko padi afecne â nânâ poroŋ dâkânere ro waha âte enarembiŋ, ehuc ŋic hâmocte biŋe mi ekicne jaŋe qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ â jujure biŋe mi ekicne jaŋe ine akic‐jopambiŋ. Ŋicfâc‐nane burecdâŋte hazec râeŋgopieŋ jaŋe burec ejarehuc wiac iŋuc hâcne embiŋ.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe ŋic sipiric‐jopaniŋte qaŋgec wiac bajueŋgopieŋ i râsi ecnehuc meŋeŋickonec bârâriepemu, ehuc ŋic sipiric‐jopaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe wipe iŋucne rambaŋko râec‐jopape junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic sipirickeniŋte ufic fâreeŋgopieŋ, ufic‐ŋeŋic i hâcne bâtâcnehuc ŋicfâc‐nane ŋoŋeraonec batarac‐jopape meŋeŋicko mocwâc mi fenʒepieŋ. Iŋuc eŋarepe, no Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.
No ŋic tiŋne ejarepe hâbi gogoroŋ mi embiŋ; ŋoŋe ine maŋ wawaha dâŋ jazahuc ŋic hehesicne jaŋe hata‐jeŋic sâqocne beherâ juju bâfuaniŋte esoc qafeŋ mi ejarembiŋ.
Irec ŋoŋe maŋko fuac wiac i hone manac mocwâc mi enʒepieŋ â findaŋdâŋ burecne i wâc mi munʒepieŋ. No ŋicfâc‐nane meŋeŋickonec batarac‐jopapemu. Eme no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Israe ŋic soŋaŋ gâcne jaŋe norao fisirâ mai‐naneo waha ŋembiŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fua‐narewec:
“O ŋicte ɋâric, ŋic ʒi jaŋe maŋjeŋic nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao râepie foekac, ehuc wiac sâqocnezi eatuc‐jopame waha jopaekac i hâcne honebâckeeŋgopieŋ. Eme ŋic iŋucne jaŋe mu wioc enarepie no dâŋ okacne sâcne bâtikie‐jarepemu me?
Irec go ʒiŋuc muhuc jazazemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: Israe kikefuŋ ŋoŋeraonec ŋic e me e moczi maŋticne nemuɋâŋfâc‐ticne jaŋerao râeme foekac me wiac sâqocnezi eatuckeme waha qaekac i hâcne honebâckehuc porofeterao raocmu e nemuɋâŋfâc‐ticne jucne‐bipiehapie Wofuŋ noni hâcne dâŋ okacne bâtikiecnepemu.
Iŋuc ecnepe ŋic nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao qohotahuc no râpecnumbiŋ jaŋe fâfârerâ hemâtâc‐jopaocmu.
“Irec hâcne Israe kikefuŋ ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic bârisierâ nemuɋâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic behec‐jopanʒepieŋ, ehuc wiac mamakâcne bacjopa jueŋgopieŋ i râpec‐jopa‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Israe ŋic moczi me jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋic furune jueŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec moczi no râpecnurâ maŋticne nemuɋâŋfâc‐ticne jaŋerao râeme fohame me wiac sâqocnezi eatuckeme waha qaekac i hâcne honebâckehuc sifu no mu wioc enareocte porofeterao raocmu ine Wofuŋ no nahac hâcne okacne bâtikiecnepemu.
No ŋic e mu âke sisicte biŋe eocte râsi ecnehuc ŋic jaŋere ma âkendâŋnepe izi uŋsawaŋ‐jeŋic ezejec. Ehuc ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋeraonec bârâriepe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.
Eme porofete e ŋic jaŋere eatuc dâŋ manarâ okacne bâtikie‐jareocmu ine Wofuŋ noni eatuckepo tinac eocmu. Irec no râsi ecnehuc Israe ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋeraonec bârâriepemu.
Eme okacne i porofete â dâŋ mu wioc eekac ŋic i jahere biŋe mâmâc ezejec.
Iŋuc fuame Israe ŋic jaŋe mocwâc mi râpecnunʒepieŋ me qaqatara bâfuahuc maŋjeŋic mi hegâpârenʒepieŋ, aricne, jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane juhapie no Anutu‐jeŋic erâ juzepac; Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, manakic, mâreŋ moc irec rune jaŋe no qaisocnuhuc râpecnuniŋmu ine râsi ejarehuc nânâ gie‐jeŋic sipirickepemu. Ehuc roroc bâfua‐jarehuc ŋic mecne qowi mecne mâmâc imac‐jopapemu.
Ehame Noa, Danie â Hiobe ŋic jahec â moc i jaŋe ira junʒapiŋ muzac tiŋne juju‐jeŋicte erâ jaŋe jaŋacne juju sawa ŋezickenʒapiŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
No mâreŋ mocko ira mupe qowi mimicnezi fuarâ mâreŋ rune ki sipiric ejarepie omaenʒapiŋ muzac ŋic gâcne jaŋe qowire hâwic‐jopame ira sicne fotâc mi enʒapiŋ.
Eme no jujâmbâŋkekopacte ŋic jahec â moc keci jaŋe ira junʒapiŋ muzac naru motecfâc‐jeŋic wâc sâcne mi ŋezic‐jopanʒapiŋ, aricne, jaŋe jaŋacne juju sawa ŋezickehapie mâreŋ i niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fozac. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Me mâreŋ ira ʒika fuame mupe ʒikazi mâreŋ fotâcnehuc ŋic â qowi kimiziec‐jopame muzac
ŋic jahec â moc keci jaŋe no Wofuŋ jukopacte naru motecfâc‐jeŋic sâcne mi ŋezic‐jopanʒapiŋ, aricne, jaŋe jaŋacne juju sawa ŋezickenʒapiŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Me mâreŋ ira mupe huc sâqocne fuame muzac me ŋic â qowi sipirickeniŋte aaric mana‐jarehuc ʒika bâfua‐jarezapo muzac ine no Wofuŋ jukopacte
Noa â Danie erâ Hiobe jaŋe naru motecfâc‐jeŋic wâc sâcne mi ŋezic‐jopanʒapiŋ, aricne, jaŋe tiŋne juju‐jeŋicte erâ jaŋe jaŋacne juju sawa ŋezickenʒapiŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc hâcne mukac: “No Jerusalem hae okacne bazucnehuc ŋic â qowifâc‐ticne omaeniŋte bâbâtiŋ wiac 4 mupe fuaocmu, ine kecʒiŋuc: Ʒika, roroc, qowi mimicne â huc sâqocne.
Erâ sifu ŋic afecne jaŋe naru motecfâc‐jeŋic haeonec jowac‐jopapie wahaniŋte ŋezic‐jopapemu. Eme jaŋe wahapie ŋoŋe juju â eebapa‐jeŋic honerâ buŋeŋic mâteŋkeme ʒiŋuc mananiŋmu: Wofuŋzi Jerusalem haeo wiac hâhâwicne ebac ewec i sâckewec.
Ŋoŋe juju â eebapa‐jeŋic honerâ ʒiŋuc mana tarahuc buŋeŋic mâteŋkeocmu: Wofuŋ e wiac ebac ewec i kosa mâcne, fuŋnehec efârewec. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, waiŋjâczi jâc wiac gâcne kâteo doma rakac i moc siric‐jopaocmu me?
Waiŋjâc izi wiac gâcne moc bapane me? Me ŋiczi irec tieŋne moc rorâ ira wiac moc ɋeɋetickene me?
Aricne, i ʒocte biŋe eekac. Eme tieŋne moc tofane ŋifec â ŋifec ʒoczi ʒâtâcnehuc ombâŋne ʒâgâpâreme izi wiac moc bapane eocmu me?
Manakic, furu jaha fohuc wiac i me i bapanere sâc mi ewecko wemocko ʒâgâpârekicnezi wiac i me i moc bazo.
Irec hâcne Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac: No kâtejâc jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec waiŋjâc rorâ ʒocte biŋe râepo irec sâc jaha Jerusalem haere ŋecjucfâc qikiŋ‐jopapemu.
No râsi ejarepemu, eme jaŋe ʒoc wisecnepie ʒoczi sifu ʒâtâmirec‐jopaocmu. Wiac iŋucne fuame, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe no behecnumbiŋte mâreŋ‐jeŋic imackepe niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fozejec. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao harierâ kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Jerusalem hae rune eebapa‐jeŋic mamakâcne i jaza jowatuc etec mana taranʒepieŋ.
Ehuc jazac: Wofuŋ Anutu e Jerusalem haere dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: Apa ŋosafâcge jaŋe Kanaaŋ mâreŋko juhapie go ijaha fuameŋ; mamacge e Amori ŋic â neŋgocgezi ine Hitiŋic jaŋeraonec.
Go fuameŋ dameŋ ira funʒuŋgere muc mi hetâcnembiŋ â opâ wâc mi rua‐garembiŋ, erâ hucâsu mi rua‐garehuc qoruczi wâc mi foŋgumbiŋ.
Ŋic moczi gore busâqoc manahuc wiac keci iŋucne moc mi egarewec, aricne, go fuameŋ dameŋ ira qaisocguhuc rambaŋko kosa behecgukicne.
“Eme go soc ruahuc me kikege râe fâretiŋ ehaŋtec no ira fotâcnerâ honecguhuc ʒiŋuc gazapo: ‘Go juzemec,
ehuc jâc iŋucne soka sanaŋ ezemec.’ Eme go soka sanaŋ erâ ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ emeŋ, ehame susuge hasickeme qizec susucge haŋsâko ewec. Ŋifec ine ŋaqi tâmiric erâ biuctac jumeŋ.
“Eme no goraopec mocwâc fotâcnerâ ʒiŋuc honecgupo: Go biac ŋic rorore sâc emeŋ. Iŋuc honecgurâ ŋaqi‐nane hegarepe hurâ biuctacge sâockewec. Ehame rocgupemurâ mupaŋkehuc gohec ʒâʒâfic epe nore biŋe emeŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Iŋuc erâ opâ rua‐garehuc wânâŋ ʒure emasaŋ erâ wokemaŋ rua‐garepo.
Erâ ŋaqi qâreŋnehec â kikehuhu hegarepe huwec, erâ umbika joma‐garerâ qoruc hahameŋne qagarepo.
Ehuc eri qoqonaŋ wiac râe‐garepo, erâ megao kisueŋ hegarepe feha upegao qoqonaŋ wiac qonaŋke‐garepo.
No sâke finʒuŋ râe‐garehuc pâŋi warawa hazecgao râepo, erâ qizecgao eri hendiŋ biaŋne moc hegarepe huwec.
Erâ qoqonaŋ wiacge i gol â siliwazi bakicne â ŋaqi wiacge i qoruc furi sâko qâreŋneheczi bafârekicne hâcne. Go nânâ poroŋ erâ baŋac â wokemaŋ nâhuc jumeŋ, ehuc hawari biaŋ jâmbâŋ erâ ŋokac wofuŋ iŋucne jumeŋ.
No hâcne eri qoqonaŋ wiac furi sâko râe‐garepe hawarige biaŋne fuame irec biŋezi ŋicne ŋicne sâcjopa‐fârewec. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Goki ine sahac hawari â ʒâŋe biŋegere manatec fefene eha sasec gie bameŋ, ehuc ŋic ira sicne fotâc embiŋ jaŋe ro fâre ejaremeŋ.
Go ŋaqi wiacge gâcne sasec giere erâ furu mâreŋko râe rumac ehuc ira sasec gie bameŋ hâcne. Wiac iŋucne mârâc jaha moc mi fuawec, erâ wâc juku mi fuazokac.
Go eri wiac furi sâko gol â siliwazi bakicne noni garepo i hâcne rorâ gahacne biŋe ɋâŋ qâqâtâc ŋic hawari iŋucne barâ jaŋehec sasec gie bameŋ.
Ehuc ŋaqige qâreŋnehec hejaretec hume wokemaŋ â hosâc âsu nore biŋe qakicne i jaŋe rike râec ejaremeŋ.
Erâ nânâ wiac garepo, nânâ poroŋ uucne, wokemaŋ â baŋac gumecguhuc jupo i wâc iŋuc jaha rorâ bubiaŋ qajarehuc mai‐jeŋicko râe guruc emeŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Go naru motecfâcge nore biŋe bâfuac‐jopameŋ jaŋe hâcne ɋâŋ qâqâtâcfâcge jaŋere biŋe hezu rikec ejaremeŋ. Go wiac mamakâcne gâcne ebac etec mi sâckewecte
naru motecfâc‐nane hezu rikec ejaremeŋ me?
Go ɋieo soc ruahuc ŋaqi tâmiric biuctac fomeŋ â me kikege râe fâretiŋ emeŋ i wiac mamakâcne ehuc sasec gie bameŋ dameŋ ira nikecgu‐fârewec hâcne.
“Jei jei, Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Go wiac hehesicne gâcne erâ irec faicnao hae ʒoŋa sâc bâzi ririke alata â ɋâŋufuŋ bameŋ.
Hata ŋeŋehasic forakac sâc ira iŋuc hâcne emeŋ, erâ ŋic ira sicne fotâc embiŋ jaŋe ro fâre ejarehuc hawari biaŋge hesifuckerâ sasec gie batec boc ɋârâŋkewec.
Go diguracfâcge ŋic repicne, Aigita ŋic hâcne, jaŋehec wâc sasec gie boc bahuc maŋbâiŋ enaremeŋ.
Manakic, no irec hâcne râsi egarehuc wiac biŋe qagarepo i sakare‐garerâ râsifâcge Filisa ŋokac jaŋere meo râecgupo, jaŋe hâcne juju bapage sâqocnere erâ mimiembiŋ.
Go sasec gie gapecmâc bameŋte Asiria ŋic jaŋehec sâc iŋuc jaha jumeŋ, ehuc sifu mi sâcguwec.
Erâ Kaldea âbârâ ŋic jaŋehec wâc sasec gie bameŋte sasecgezi boc ɋârâŋkewec, erâ izi wâc sifu mi sâcguwec.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Opoŋ, saseczi maŋge sâcke‐fârewecte go sasec ŋokac râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne iŋucne erâ wiac i sasawa efâremeŋ.
Go hata ŋeŋehasic sâc ɋâŋufuŋge bafâremeŋ â hae ʒoŋa sâc bâzi ririke alata wâc barameŋ. Ehuc sasec giere furi qikiŋnehuc sasec ŋokac fârine jaŋere sâc jâmbâŋ mi emeŋ.
Go sasec ŋokac fuŋmoc, go ŋowege mâcne, ŋic furune jaŋe wira hefârec ejaremeŋ hâcne.
Hae mâreŋ gâcnao sasec ŋokac jaŋe gie‐jeŋicte furi roeŋgopieŋ, goki ine iŋuc mi ehuc mâreŋ sâc irecnec ŋic gorao fisirâ gohec sasec gie baniŋte furine jaremeŋ.
Go irec hâcne sasec ŋokac gâcne jaŋere sâc aricne, go sâc moc jumeŋ. Ŋic moczi moc gohec sasec gie baocte mi bâjâpecguwec, erâ go furine moc mi garehapie gokizia jarehuc jumeŋ. Go irec hâcne sasec ŋokac sâc moc jâmbâŋ jumeŋ.”
O sasec ŋokac, go irec hâcne Wofuŋte dâŋ manazemec.
Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Go sasec ŋic âgofâcge jaŋehec sasec gie bahuc biuctac juhaŋtec mimige tâtâc fuarâ fowec, â ɋâŋ qâqâtâcfâcge jaŋe bocjaha, erâ naru motecfâcge jaŋe ɋâŋ qâqâtâcfâcge jaŋere biŋe qikiŋ‐jopahuc socjeŋic hoŋkemeŋ.
Manakic, no wiac irec erâ sasec ŋic âgofâcge ʒeri bubiaŋ mana‐jaremeŋ jaŋe mecne â behe qaisoc ejaremeŋ jaŋe mecne mâmâc mâreŋ ŋifec â ŋifec irecnec hetumaŋ‐jopape râsi fisi‐garenʒepieŋ. Ehame jaŋere maio ŋaqi qorucge hetara‐garepe biuctac domatec honecgunʒepieŋ.
Eme no ŋokac jaŋe ŋowefâc‐jeŋic ro behec ejareeŋgopieŋ â soc hoŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe okacne bazu‐jareekopac irec sâc jaha go egarepe kimbeŋ â ʒoɋac‐nane wahazejec.
No sasec ŋicfâcge jaŋere meo râecgupe jaŋe ɋâŋufuŋ wiacge â alata ŋerakac i heroc qâropienʒepieŋ; ehuc ŋaqige heunuckerâ eri wiacge gowac ropie biuctac erâ juzemec.
Jaŋe tutumaŋko âkendâŋgurâ qânâzi hecguhuc ʒikazi qâtâc bâtâcguniŋmu.
Ehuc ficwiacge ʒoc turuŋkepie ʒame ŋokac bocjaha jaŋere maio dâŋge mutaranʒepieŋ; ehame no sasec giere aka hegarepe go furine mocwâc mi râezemec.
No iŋuc egarehuc kimbeŋ‐nane bâmâteŋkepemu â ʒoɋac‐nane behepemu; no uruehuc aaric mocwâc mi manapemu.
Manakic, go socɋâri jujugere nikecgume wiac i sasawa ehuc maŋbâiŋ enaremeŋte no eebapagere okacne bazu‐garepemu. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc. “Go wiac mamakâcne ehuc sasec gie moc ʒuhuckerâ mi bameŋ me?
Manakic, ŋic mu âke sisic dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ jaŋe go mu âke sisic jaha egarehuc ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Naru e neŋgoc‐ticnezi juwec sâc ijaha jukac.’
Go neŋgocgere otâ hâcne, e ŋowe motecfâcne qaisoc‐jopawec. Go hahac qofâcge jaŋere tofane jaha, jaŋe ŋowe motecfâc‐jeŋic behe qaisoc ejarembiŋ. Neŋgocge e Hitiŋic jaŋeraonec â mamacge e Amori ŋic.
Hahacge e Samaria hâcne, e narufâcne jaŋehec mâreŋ faicpec juwec; erâ qoge Sodom e â narufâcne jaŋe ine mâreŋ juwicpec ira jumbiŋ.
Go jaŋe wiac ebac embiŋ irec sâc mâcne, â jaŋe wiac mamakâcne bajumbiŋ irec sâc wâc mi bajumeŋ, aricne, go dameŋ mi ʒoraha jaŋere sâc sirickehuc wiac gâgâpâcne ebac emeŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu no ʒiŋuc mujâmbâŋkekopac: Go narufâcge jaŋehec wiac ebac emeŋ irec sâc qoge Sodom â narufâcne jaŋe mi embiŋ.
Manakic, qoge Sodom e wiac ʒiŋuc eme kiŋnehec ewec: E jahacne â narufâcne jaŋe sahac fefe embiŋ, ehuc jaŋe nânâ mâriri sâkohec erâ moneŋ mafa fofo dunduŋ fojareha manabâc tâmiric jumbiŋ. Ehame ŋic hapetac â qarâ suriŋne hone bafic moc mi ejarembiŋ.
Jaŋe penaroŋ erâ nore maio wiac mamakâcne epie honerâ bâsirowec‐jopapo.
Goki wiac hehesicne bâfuameŋ irec ŋifecne moc Samariazi mi bâfuawec. Go jaŋere sâc sirickehuc wiac mamakâcne bâfuameŋ, irec hahac qofâcge honec‐jopape tiŋne hawari juŋgopieŋ tinac ekac.
Mimi busâqoczi hahac qofâcge jaŋere faio feocte mumeŋ irec sâc jaha gore faio fezejec. Gore hehesiczi jaŋere hehesic boc sirickekacte jaŋe tiŋne hawari juŋgopieŋ tinac ekac. Irec mimi busâqoczi gore faio feme hahac qofâcge jaŋe tiŋne hawari juŋgopieŋ tinac jaha eocmu.
“Fai‐jeŋicko wiac hâhâwicne fokac i bârâriehape juju biaŋnao mocwâc risienʒepieŋ. Sodom â Samaria hae piticfâc‐jekic jaŋe mâmâc iŋuc ejarehuc go sâc ijaha egarepemu.
Eme mimi busâqoczi faigao feme wiac ebac emeŋ irec mimiehuc jaŋe mu bâmiriŋ ejarezemec.
Eme hahac qo jahecge Sodom â Samaria erâ otâfâc‐jekic jaŋe mârâc juju‐jeŋicko risiehapie go â otâfâcge ŋoŋe wâc iŋuc jaha mârâc juju‐ŋeŋicko risie‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Go hehesicge mi bajaŋgeŋkehapie sahac fefe emeŋ dameŋ ira hahacge Sodom e mu âke sisic mi ecnemeŋ me?
Ʒi ine Edom otâfâc‐ticne â âgo diguracfâc‐ticne jaŋe nifepupu egareŋgopieŋ, ehame Filisa otâfâc‐ticne rârec rârec juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe iŋuc jaha egarehuc qaisocguŋgopieŋ.
Sasec gie bameŋ â wiac mamakâcne emeŋ irec okacne faigao fewec fokac hâcne. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Go wiac hehesicne ebac emeŋ irec sâcko okacne bazu‐garepemu. Go ʒâʒâfic hetâcnehuc mumupaŋ dâŋ qâsuameŋ hâcne.
Erâ no sifu socɋâri jumeŋ dameŋ ira gohec ʒâʒâfic epo irec manasuhuc gohec ʒâʒâfic fofo sanaŋ moc epemu.
Eme no hahac qo jahecge otâ jahecge junicte gorao râec‐jofape go eebapa raŋɋagere manasuhuc mimiezemec. Ehame jahe gohec ʒâʒâfic ekicne irec maŋnao jaha juzepirec.
Ehame gohec ʒâʒâfic epe no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana tarazemec.
