Eme wiac ebac emeŋ irec kiŋ behe‐garepe go irec manasurâ mimiehuc dâŋemâc juzemec. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Israe kikefuŋ dâŋ herâricne â suŋsuŋne moc jazazemec.
Ehuc muzemec: Wofuŋ Anutu e kecʒiŋuc mukac: Tucwipe sâko moc fafakec sâkohec â ʒâcʒoranehec erâ suhuc‐ticne qâreŋneheczi Lebanoŋ tikio fisirâ jâmâzâc jâc botâŋnao hewec.
Herâ ŋehuc gupiŋne hezurâ âbârâ gie baeŋgopieŋ hae mâreŋ ira barâ wisewec, ehuc jaŋere hae sâko mocko râewec.
Iŋuc erâ mâreŋ irec nuucne moc rorâ mâreŋ guec‐ticnehec ira opâ heririŋko niwijâc iŋucne sarawec.
Eme bâpâŋnezi soka ŋedâmârec ehuc haŋ qaŋeŋ sâkohec ewec, ehuc tieŋ taeŋnezi tucwipe e jahacnaopec sicnewec â gâtânezi ine domaweckoa huwec. Eme waiŋ qizecne fua taniŋkerâ tieŋ taeŋne sicnehuc rehacnehec ewec.
“Eme tucwipe sâko moc fafakec sâkohec â ʒâcʒora sâkohec juwec, ehame eki opâ biaŋne rua‐narezejec muhuc waiŋ qizecnezi gâtâne eraopec râeme rawec â tieŋ taeŋne e jahacnaopec sicnewec.
Waiŋzi biaŋne fua sokac erâ fie ruruckehuc hândâŋ fârihec eocte mâreŋ biaŋne opâ heririŋko fowec ira sarakicne i mana‐bipiehuc sifu iŋuc ewec.
Irec jazac, Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc muhuc wiokac: Waiŋ iŋucnezi sâcne fua sokac eocmu? Bâbâni tucwipezi gâtâ‐ticne unuckehuc tieŋ taeŋne hetâcneme rehacne fie ruruckekicne i mi ururucke‐fâreocmu me? I ŋic afecnezi gie sâko mi bahuc mâc unuckeniŋmu hâcne.
Unuckerâ mocko sarapie sâcne fua sokac eocmu me? Aricne, ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec mâŋâŋzi ficne sueme hâmo ɋaŋac eocmu, fuawec mâreŋ ijaha hâmoocmu hâcne.”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ harierâ norao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Go Israe kikefuŋ qaqatarahec ʒiŋuc jazac: No dâŋ suŋsuŋne ŋazapac irec fuŋne moc manaŋgopieŋ me? Irec fuŋne ʒiŋuc: Babe ŋicwofuŋ e Jerusalem haeo fisirâ ŋicwofuŋ â fekicnefâc‐ticne rocjoparâ Babe mâreŋko bacjopa rawec.
Ehuc ŋicwofuŋte kikefuŋkonec ŋic moc rorâ ehec ʒâʒâfic moc ehuc ecneme mumupaŋ dâŋ muwec.
Eme Israe uucmaŋ i mocwâc mi fehuc wawahane erâ juocte â ʒâʒâfic‐ticne basanaŋkepie foocte Juda mâreŋte ŋic fekicne bacjopa rawec hâcne.
Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋzi ine Babe ŋicwofuŋ râŋgeŋkecnehuc, Aigita ŋicwofuŋzi baficnuhuc momori â becâsic guru sâko râe‐narezejec muhuc erao kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopame rambiŋ. Eme e sâcne fârine bâfuaocmu me? Ŋic moc iŋuc eekaczi okacne sâcne wisecneocmu me? E ʒâʒâfic hetâcneocmuzi juju‐ticne sâcne ŋezickeocmu me?
Wofuŋ Anutu no jujâmbâŋkehuc ʒiŋuc mukopac: E Babe haeo ŋicwofuŋ jukackoa hâmozejec. Hae ira hâcne Babe ŋicwofuŋzi ŋicwofuŋ gie jaha mucnewec, eki ine ŋicwofuŋte mumupaŋ dâŋ qâsuahuc ʒâʒâfic‐ticne hetâcnewec.
Babeŋic jaŋe ŋic bocjaha sipiric‐jopaniŋte somâ bapa mâreŋ toŋne hefeniŋmu â sac hafeniŋmuo ine Farao â momorifâc‐ticne guru sâko jaŋe fisirâ Judaŋic mi bafic‐jopaniŋmu.
Juda ŋicwofuŋ e mumupaŋ dâŋ qâsuahuc ʒâʒâfic hetâcnewec, e Babe ŋicwofuŋhec maŋ mocjaha ehuc meo babac epic, erâ sifu wiac keci ewecte okacne fuacnezejec.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu no kecʒiŋuc mukopac: E mumupaŋ dâŋnane qâsuawec â ʒâʒâfic‐nane hetâcnewec irec no jujâmbâŋkekopacte okacne bazucnepemu.
No bitiŋ râecnepe ira kizejec â wiwitic hecnepe ira rozejec. E doc bacnuwecte Babe haeo bararâ dâŋgiere biŋe râepemu.
Ehame momorifâc‐ticne bâwosâec‐jopakicne jaŋe ʒikare biŋe efâreniŋmu â ŋic nâfocne jaŋe mâreŋ qaŋeŋne sâc bâtâtiec‐jopape rafâreniŋmu. Iŋuc fuame ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ: I Wofuŋzi hâcne muwec.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “No nahac jâmâzâc botâŋne irec tieŋne rorâ sarapemu, no botâŋ susukucnaonec gupiŋne dodocne moc qazurâ tiki ʒoricnere botâŋko sarapemu.
Israe mâreŋte tiki ʒorao sarapemu hâcne; eme ira tieŋ taeŋne râehuc fârinehec eocmu. Ehame jâmâzâc biaŋne soka ŋedâmârec eme qowi fuŋne fuŋne jaŋe irec fuŋnao ŋec foc ehapie wipe hawari fuŋne fuŋne jaŋe tieŋ taeŋnao sareŋ‐jeŋic râeniŋmu.
Eme Wofuŋ noni jâc bembeŋne bâʒorac‐jopapemu â jâc ʒoricne bâmbeŋ‐jopapemu, ehuc fie ruruckeekac i mupe hâmo ururuc eocmu â hâmo ururuc ekicne i mupe fie ruruckeocmu, ehame gieo jâc doma raŋgopieŋ jaŋe no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu, Wofuŋ noni hâcne mukopac iŋuc epemu.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ fuawec:
“Ŋoŋe wemocte Israe mâreŋte qâqiŋ qahuc mu âke sisic dâŋ keʒiŋuc boc muhuc jueŋgopieŋ, ‘Mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe jâchândâŋ ʒaʒacne nâmbiŋte naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mic aaric ejareekac’?
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac: No jujâmbâŋkekopacte mu âke sisic dâŋ i Israe ŋic ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko mocwâc mi fuazejec.
Manaŋgopieŋ, juju i nore biŋe sasawa, mamacte juju i nore biŋe, â ŋokâre juju i nore biŋe jaha, irec moc e sâqocne baocmuzi hâmozejec.
“Ŋic moc e tiŋne juhuc sâcmutâc dâŋte sâcko wiac ebac eocmu,
e tiki botâŋko nemure tiwâ bâzi mi nâocmu, me Israe kikefuŋ jaŋere nemuɋâŋko ʒâŋe mi fiocmu, me âgo‐ticnere ŋokac mi bâsâqoreocmu, me ŋokac mosa dameŋ‐ticne maickehame erao mi raocmu.
E ŋic moc mi eatuckehuc wiac irec me irec kifac râcnewec i bârisiecneocmu, me wiac kâŋgâc mi jowac roocmu, me nânâre hâmo sipiric eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe nânâ gumec‐jopaocmu, me biuctac jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ŋaqi hejareme huocmu.
Me moneŋ hotâ jareocmuzi juku irec sâc sirickehuc bârisiecneniŋte mi muocmu, me wiac hehesicne ba bâuac mi ehuc ŋic dâŋjeŋic mutiŋnerâ wiac sâckoa ejareocmu.
Erâ mumutâc dâŋnane mana maŋ erâ sâcmutâc‐nane aijakic jaha bâjâpe‐fâreocmu ŋic eki hâcne bahac fâsâc erâ jujâmbâŋkeocmu. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Ŋic bahac fâsâc juekac ere ŋokâ moc fuarâ ŋic ʒâʒâicne eocmu me soc hoŋkeocmu, me wiac mukicne keci moc mi efâreocmu,
ehuc tiki botâŋko nemure tiwâ bâzi nâocmu, me âgo‐ticnere ŋokac bâsâqoreocmu.
Â ŋic hapetac me tac qararacne bâʒâic‐jopaocmu, me fiuc serereŋ gie baocmu, me âgo‐ticnere kifac mi bârisieocmu, me nemuɋâŋ jaŋerao ʒâŋe fiocmu, me wiac mamakâcne gâcne ebac eocmu.
Erâ moneŋ hotâ jareocmu irec sâc sirickehuc jowac roocte muocmu. Eme weniŋuc, wiac iŋucne eocmuzi sâcne juocmu me? Aricne, e mi juzejec, e wiac hehesicne keci ebac eocmuo ine hâmo‐jâmbâŋkezejec, â socticnere kiŋzi e jahacne faio fezejec.
“Me eraonec ŋokâ moc fuarâ mamac‐ticne wiac hehesicne ebac ewec i honerâ hâwickeme hata hehesicne ijaha mi âteocmu.
E tiki botâŋko nemure tiwâ bâzi mi nâhuc Israe kikefuŋte nemuɋâŋ jaŋerao ʒâŋe mi fiocmu, erâ âgo‐ticnere ŋokac wâc mi bâsâqoreocmu.
E ŋic moc mi bâʒâic‐jopaocmu â kifac moc mi roocmu, e fiuc tâmiric juhuc nânâre hâmoeŋgopieŋ jaŋe gumec‐jopaocmu â biuctac jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ŋaqi hejareme huocmu.
E wiac hehesicne ba bâuac mi eocmu, erâ moneŋ hotâ jareocmu irec sâc sirickerâ bârisiecneniŋte mi muocmu, aricne, e mumutâc dâŋnane mana maŋ erâ sâcmutâc‐nane bâjâpeocmu; irec e mamac‐ticnere hehesicte erâ mi hâmohuc jujâmbâŋkezejec.
Mamac‐ticnezi ine ŋic fific bacjopawec â âgo‐ticnere wiac fiuc rowec, erâ ŋic ŋondeŋko wiac sâqocne ebac ewecte hehesic‐ticnere erâ hâmozejec.
“Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc mecne wioŋgopieŋ: ‘Ŋokâ e wemocte mamac‐ticnere kiŋte erâ mi bâtiŋnezo?’ Iŋuc wioŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc mananiŋ: Ŋokâ e wiac tiŋne â fâretiŋ jaha ebac ehuc mumutâc dâŋnane mana maŋ ewec â sâcmutâc‐nane aijakic jaha bâjâpewecte jujâmbâŋkezejec.
Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋic sâqocne baocmu e hâcne hâmoocmu. Ŋokâ e mamac‐ticnere kiŋte erâ mi hâmoocmu â mamac e ŋokâ‐ticnere kiŋte erâ wâc mi hâmoocmu. Ŋic tiŋne e tiŋne juju‐ticnere fârine bâfuaocmu, â ŋic hehesicne e juju‐ticne hehesicnere fârine bâfuaocmu jaha.
“Me ŋic hehesicne moczi maŋticne bârisiehuc sâqocne ebac ewec i qikiŋne‐fârerâ sâcmutâc dâŋnane mana rereŋ efârehuc wiac tiŋne â biaŋne eocmu e mi hâmohuc jujâmbâŋkeocmu.
Ehame wiac gâgâpâcne ebac ewec i mocwâc mi manasupemu, aricne, e eebapa‐ticne tiŋnere erâ juzejec.
No ŋic hehesicnezi hâmome bubiaŋ mi manapemu, aricne, e hata raŋɋa‐ticne râpeckehuc juocmu ine manape biaŋkeocmu. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Me ŋic tiŋne moczi hata‐ticne tiŋne râpeckerâ ŋic hehesicne jaŋe wiac mamakâcne fuŋne fuŋne eeŋgopieŋ i eocmu e wemocko juocmu. Aricne, e mârâc wiac tiŋne ebac ewec irec mocwâc mi manasupemu. E râpecnuhuc sâqocne bâfuawec irec hâmozejec.
“Ŋoŋe ine sifu ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Wofuŋzi wiac ebac eekac i fâretiŋ aricne.’ Irec Israe kikefuŋ ŋazape mananiŋ: No mâcne, ŋoŋe hâcne wiac ebac epie fâretiŋ mi eekac.
Ŋic tiŋne moczi tiŋne juju‐ticne râpeckerâ wiac hehesicne bâfuaocmu e hâmoocmu, e wiac hehesicne bâfuaocmu irec erâ hâmoocmu hâcne.
Ŋifec ine ŋic hehesicne moczi juju‐ticne hehesicne râpeckerâ wiac biaŋne â tiŋne ebac eocmu eki ine juocmu.
E fuŋne‐ticne hone ʒâŋitac erâ hehesic bâfuawec i râpeckewecte mi hâmohuc jujâmbâŋkeocmu.
Israe kikefuŋ ŋoŋe ine sifu ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Wofuŋzi wiac ebac eekac i fâretiŋ aricne.’ Irec Israe kikefuŋ ŋazape mananiŋ: No mâcne, ŋoŋe hâcne wiac ebac epie fâretiŋ mi eekac.
“O Israe kikefuŋ, no irec hâcne eebapa‐ŋeŋicte sâcko ru sâc dâŋŋeŋic mutarapemu. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc. Hehesic‐ŋeŋiczi sipiric‐ŋopazacte maŋŋeŋic bârisierâ sâqone‐ŋeŋic râpecke‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe no râpecnuhuc sâqocne bâfuambiŋ i behe‐fârenʒepieŋ, ehuc maŋɋâri â juju ɋâri bâfuanʒepieŋ. O Israe kikefuŋ, ŋoŋe wemocte hâmoniŋte mueŋgopieŋ?
Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋic e me e moczi hâmome no bubiaŋ mi manapemu, irec ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic bârisierâ junʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Go Israe ŋic fekicne jajahec jahere makuc gae moc hefuazemec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc muzemec: Neŋgoc‐ŋekic e laioŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko laioŋ ŋokacne mo iŋucne juwec! E laioŋ motecne jaŋere guruo ŋec foc ehuc hone soŋaŋ ejarehame soka sanaŋ embiŋ.
Eme motecne moc gume jowac ecnekume wiac sâko ewec, ehuc qowi qaqare fuŋne manawec, â ŋic wâc jopa nâc ewec.
Ehame ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe ere biŋe manarâ sawaŋ qaqac embiŋ, ehuc nombâŋ rocnepie huwec; eme hawiczi hehawickehuc fâre wefurâ Aigita mâreŋko barambiŋ.
Iŋuc fuame neŋgocnezi ere woŋec juipieku motecne moc gume jauŋ ecnekume wiac sâko jaha ewec.
E laioŋ gâcne jaŋere ŋondeŋko kiwac qawac ewec, ehuc laioŋ tâpirihec irec sâc bâfuawec, e qowi qaqare fuŋne mana tarawec, â ŋic wâc jopa nâc ewec.
E ficsanaŋ‐jeŋic kiroc qâropiewec, â hae‐jeŋic imackewec; ehame hae mâreŋ â ira ŋec juc embiŋ jaŋe owa fânâŋ‐ticnere bipic tatara ejarewec.
Eme ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe somâ râecnehuc bitiŋ bacne‐fârembiŋ; jaŋe ufic hecnembiŋ, erâ nombâŋ rocnepie ira huwec.
Jaŋe hawiczi hehawickehuc katapa maŋko râerâ Babe ŋicwofuŋ erao barambiŋ; marac fânâŋ‐ticne Israe tikio mocwâc mi mananiŋte kâpâcwâru ficko râembiŋ hâcne.
Neŋgocge e waiŋ qaŋeŋne opâ heririŋ waiŋ gieo sarakicne iŋucne, e opâ boc fowecte fâri rarau â tieŋ taeŋ sâkohec ewec.
Tieŋne moczi sokarâ ŋicwofuŋ gunu ewec. E tieŋ taeŋne gâcne siric‐jopahuc ʒoricne ʒora fewec; e boc ferâ domawec â tieŋ taeŋ sâkohec ewecte ŋiczi hone‐fârembiŋ.
Eme waiŋ qizecne e aaricko unuckerâ mâreŋko behekicne; ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec mâŋâŋzi ficneme kereŋkewec, â hândâŋ‐ticne mâtâckerâ waha‐fârewec; tieŋne sanaŋne izi hâmo kereŋ eme ʒoczi ʒâseŋkewec.
Ʒi ine mâreŋ burocnao sarakicne, mâreŋ kereŋne â opâ tâmiricko hâcne.
Eme waiŋ qizeckonec ʒoc wefurâ tieŋ taeŋne â fârine ʒâseŋke‐fârewec, ehame tieŋne sanaŋne i mocwâc mi fowec, â ŋicwofuŋ gunu i wâc omaewec. Gae ʒizi makuc gae eocte hefuakicnere makuc gae ewec hâcne.
Jara 7 irec mosa namba 5 â irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 10 ira Israe soŋaŋ micne gâcne jaŋe Wofuŋ mu wioc ecneniŋte fisirâ nore maio waha ŋembiŋ.
Ehame Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Israe soŋaŋ micne dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc jazac: Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe no mu wioc enareniŋte wareŋgopieŋ me? No jujâmbâŋkekopacte mu wioc moc mi enarenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
O ŋicte ɋâric, me goki dâŋjeŋic mutarazo ekomec me? Iŋuc ezo murâ ine mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere hehesic irec fuŋne ritu‐jaretec mananʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: No Israe ŋic bâwosâec‐jopapo dameŋ ira Aigita mâreŋko Jakobore ɋâricfâc maic‐jopahuc fuŋne‐nane bataniŋkerâ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mupaŋke‐jarepo: No ŋoŋere Wofuŋ Anutu.
Erâ ʒiŋuc hâcne mupaŋke‐jarepo: No Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐ŋopa waharâ mâreŋ moc ŋoŋere biŋe bâwosâekicne ira râec‐ŋopapemu. Mâreŋ i boc biaŋne jâmbâŋ erâ guec sâko‐ticnehec.
Erâ ʒiŋuc jazapo: Ŋoŋe wiac mamakâcne hone ʒiziweeŋgopieŋ i ru sâc behe‐fârenʒepieŋ, ehuc Aigita ŋic jaŋere ɋâŋ qâqâtâc bajuhuc maŋŋeŋic mi hegâpârenʒepieŋ; no hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic jukopac.
Eme jaŋe ine dâŋnane qatarahuc mi manambiŋ, jaŋe wiac mamakâcne hone ʒiziwembiŋ i ru sâc mi behembiŋ â Aigita ŋic jaŋere ɋâŋ qâqâtâc i wâc mi qikiŋnembiŋ. “Iŋuc embiŋte Aigita mâreŋko jaha juhapie no kimbeŋ aaric‐nane furu jaha fai‐jeŋicko râepe feocte manasupo.
Erâ no ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanezi ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere maio wawahane ezacte iŋuc mi epo. No Israe ŋic Aigita mâreŋko jumbiŋ jaŋe irecnec jowac‐jopa wahapemurâ ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere maio fuŋne‐nane bataniŋkepo hâcne.
Iŋuc ehuc Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa waharâ mâreŋ burocnao râec‐jopapo.
Ira ine dâŋsanaŋ â sâcmutâc dâŋnane jarepo; mâreŋŋic jaŋe dâŋ i mana rereŋ epie juju fua‐jareomu hâcne.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, sabata hombaŋ‐nane wâc jarepo, izi ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko ma eha ʒiŋuc mana taraniŋte: Wofuŋzi jahacne biŋe bâtiric‐nâpowec.
Eme Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe ine mâreŋ burocnao fenarembiŋ, jaŋe dâŋsanaŋ‐nane mana rereŋ epie muzac juju fua‐jarezac. Jaŋe ine iŋuc mi embiŋ â sâcmutâc dâŋnanere sâcko mi juhuc sabata hombaŋ‐nane qâsuambiŋ. “Iŋuc epie mâreŋ burocnao kimbeŋ‐nane fai‐jeŋicko râepe feme omaeniŋte manasupo.
Erâ no ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanezi ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere maio rârâpene ezacte iŋuc mi epo. No jaŋere maio hâcne Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa wahapo.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, mâreŋ burocnao ʒiŋuc mupaŋke‐jarepo wâc; no mâreŋ biaŋne jâmbâŋ â guec‐ticnehec biŋe qaŋarepo ira moc mi jowac‐ŋopa raku râec‐ŋopapemu.
Jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋnane qikiŋnehuc dâŋsanaŋ‐nanere sâcko mi jumbiŋte â sabata hombaŋ‐nane qâsuahuc maŋjeŋic nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao râepie fowecte iŋuc ejarepo.
Erâ no sifu busâqoc mana‐jarerâ akic‐jopahuc mâreŋ burocnao mi bâsirowec‐jopapo.
“Eme no ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic mâreŋ burocnao dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazapo: Ŋoŋe mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere dâŋsanaŋ â sâcmutâc dâŋ mana rereŋ mi enʒepieŋ, â nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao qohotahuc juhapie maŋŋeŋic mi gâpârezejec.
No hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic jukopac, irec dâŋsanaŋ‐nane bâjâpehuc sâcmutâc dâŋnane aijakic jaha bajunʒepieŋ.
Ehuc sabata hombaŋ‐nane bâtiripie ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko ma erâ foha, no hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic i mana taranʒepieŋ.
Ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ine dâŋnane mi bâjâpembiŋ â sâcmutâc dâŋnane aijakic jaha mi bajumbiŋ. I mana rereŋ epie muzac juju fua‐jarezac, jaŋe sabata hombaŋ‐nane qâsuambiŋ wâc. “Iŋuc epie mâreŋ burocnao aaric‐nane furu jaha fai‐jeŋicko râepe feocte manasupo.
Erâ no ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanezi ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere maio rârâpene ezacte sifu iŋuc mi epo. No jaŋere maio hâcne Israe ŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa wahapo.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, mâreŋ burocnao ʒiŋuc mupaŋke‐jarepo wâc: No ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐ŋopape mâreŋ sâc râwiŋ qârâwiŋnenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋnane mi reŋkehuc dâŋsanaŋ‐nane qikiŋnembiŋ, â sabata hombaŋ‐nane qâsuambiŋ, erâ mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere nemuɋâŋfâc hone aŋac ejarembiŋte iŋuc hâcne mupaŋke‐jarepo.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, no dâŋsanaŋ â mumutâc dâŋ repicne sisipiricnehec wâc jarepo.
Erâ no mana‐jarehape nemuɋâŋ wiac taha bajarehuc maŋjeŋic hegâpârembiŋ. No bipic tatara ejareocte mârâc motecfâc‐jeŋic bâzi rikec‐jopaniŋte mana‐jarepo hâcne. No hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac, jaŋe i mana taraniŋte iŋuc epo.
“O ŋicte ɋâric, go irec hâcne Israe kikefuŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc jazazemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe wâc doc bacnuhuc ʒâŋe‐nane musoriŋkembiŋ.
No mâreŋ biŋe qajarehuc mupaŋke‐jarepo ira jowac‐jopape fisirâ mâreŋ toŋne me jâc fie ruruckekicne honembiŋ sâc ira bâzi rikerâ nemuɋâŋ jaŋere taha wiac gâcne râehuc maŋbâiŋ enarembiŋ. Jaŋe ira hâcne hosâc âsu biaŋ rikehuc waiŋzi taha bâzi hoŋkembiŋ.
Eme no ʒiŋuc muhuc wio‐jarepo: Ŋoŋe mo mâreŋ toŋnao fec wahac eeŋgopieŋ? Eme jaŋe mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe ‘Furu Mâreŋ’ mumbiŋzi muhuc jueŋgopieŋ jaha.
Irec Israe kikefuŋ ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere sâc bâfuarâ maŋŋeŋic hegâpârehuc ɋâŋ wiac‐jeŋic mamakâcnere erâ qâsoriezo muŋgopieŋ me?
Ŋoŋe taha wiac‐ŋeŋic râehuc me motecfâc‐ŋeŋic bâzi rikec‐jopahuc nemuɋâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic kiŋaŋ qajarerâ maŋŋeŋic hegâpâreeŋgopieŋ hâcne. O Israe kikefuŋ, eme ŋoŋe ʒiŋuczia mu wioc enarezo muŋgopieŋ me? No jujâmbâŋkekopacte mu wioc moc mi enarenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Maŋŋeŋicko dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac i fârine moc mi fuazejec: ‘Nâŋe ŋicne ŋicne â mâreŋ sâc irec ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere sâc ehuc nemuɋâŋ jâc â qânâzi bakicne araŋ bacnenʒepeneŋ.’”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “No jujâmbâŋkekopacte tâpiri wânʒâŋ‐nanere fuŋne bataniŋkerâ aaric mana‐ŋarehuc Wofuŋ eŋarepemu.
No aaric mana‐ŋarehuc tâpiri menane bâfeŋnekicnezi ŋicne ŋicne jaŋeraonec â mâreŋ sâc bâtâtiec‐ŋopakicne irecnec bâturec‐ŋopahuc bacŋopa warepemu.
Ehuc mâreŋ burocnao ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko jowac‐ŋopa rarâ maic‐ŋopahuc dâŋgieo râec‐ŋopapemu.
No mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe Aigita mâreŋte mâreŋ burocnao dâŋgieo râec‐jopapo sâc ijaha ŋoŋe eŋarepemu. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
No gunu‐nane sicnepe irec rurumaŋnao fotâcnehapie wosec‐ŋopahuc eŋarepe raʒiniŋmu.
No bâtâc bacŋopahuc fenareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe â râpecnueŋgopieŋ ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋickonec bârâriec‐jopapemu; no jaba jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâreŋ irecnec batarac‐jopapemu. Mâc Israe mâreŋko raraʒi ine mi enʒepieŋ. Iŋuc fuame no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi ŋoŋere dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “O Israe kikefuŋ ŋoŋe nore dâŋ qikiŋnezo muŋgopieŋko ra ru sâc nemuɋâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic kiŋaŋ qajareniŋ, mâc taha rârâe â ɋâŋ qâqâtâc araŋ babajare‐ŋeŋic izi tiri ʒâŋe‐nane mocwâc mi hegâpârenʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Tiri tiki‐nane Israere tikio hâcne mâreŋ ira Israe kikefuŋ ŋoŋe ʒeŋgoma kiŋaŋ qanarenʒepieŋ, ehame no ira aki anonoc eŋarehuc taha wiac‐ŋeŋic â nânâ bâbâsu â wiac‐ŋeŋic gâcne sasawa bâtirikicne i râe‐nareniŋte ŋaza mutâc epemu.
No ŋicne ŋicne jaŋeraonec â mâreŋ sâc bâtâtiec‐ŋopakicne irecnec hetumaŋ‐ŋopa‐fârerâ taha‐ŋeŋicte âsu mumundoŋ manahuc ehâmo‐ŋarepemu hâcne. Iŋuc eŋarehuc, no Tiri rune jukopac, irec fuŋne ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere maio bataniŋkepemu.
No mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ jare tahac epemurâ mupaŋkepo, Israe mâreŋ hâcne, ira râec‐ŋopape, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac, i mana taranʒepieŋ.
Eme ŋoŋe ira juhuc eebapa‐ŋeŋic raŋɋanezi maŋŋeŋic bâsâqorembiŋ irec manasunʒepieŋ, ehuc wiac hehesicne ebac embiŋ irec erâ ŋaŋacnere manapie mamakâcne ezejec.
O Israe kikefuŋ, no hehesic â eebapa‐ŋeŋic sâqocnere erâ mâcne, ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanere erâ iŋuc eŋarepe, ŋoŋe no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go juwic mâreŋ maickerâ ŋic uŋ sawaŋ ejarezemec, ehuc Negebe kâte mâreŋte findaŋdâŋ muzemec.
Ehuc kâte mâreŋ i ʒiŋuc âzâcnezemec: Go Wofuŋte dâŋ manac. Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Manakic, no gorao ʒoc ruqepemu, eme bâruŋkehuc jâc hâmocne â ɋâricne mâmâc ʒâseŋke‐fâreocmu. Ehuc ʒocbâruŋzi tatarane tâmiric ʒahuc mâreŋ faic â juwic irec ŋic ʒâfitac‐jopaocmu.
Ehame ŋic jaŋe ʒeŋgoma ʒiŋuc mana taracnunʒepieŋ: Wofuŋ e hâcne turuŋkeme ʒawec, irec moczi sâcne mi qâhâpoocmu.”
Mume kecʒiŋuc mupo: “O Wofuŋ Anutu, ŋic jaŋe nore ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: ‘E kesaic dâŋ sasawa muhuc juekac!’”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Jerusalem hae maickehuc tiri ufuŋte uŋsawaŋ dâŋ muzemec, erâ Israe mâreŋte findaŋdâŋ muzemec.
Ehuc mâreŋ rune ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Manakic, no râsi eŋarehuc ʒika‐nane becsahackonec unuckerâ ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic tiŋne â hehesicne jopa‐fârepemu.
No iŋuc eŋarepemure ʒika‐nane unuckerâ juwic mâreŋte ŋic mecne, â faic mâreŋte ŋic mecne mâmâc jopa‐fârepemu.
Iŋuc ejarepe ŋic jaŋe sasawa ʒiŋuc mana taracnunʒepieŋ: Wofuŋ e becsahackonec ʒika unuckeweczi mocwâc mi esorieocmu.
O ŋicte ɋâric, go irec hâcne kio huse ezemec, go ʒâic busâqoc sâko manahuc jaŋere maio kio mamakuc ezemec.
Eme ‘Wemocte kio mamakuc ekomec,’ iŋuc wio‐garepie ʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘No biŋedâŋ manapo irec, biŋedâŋ izi fârinehec eme maŋŋeŋic gâcke‐fâreha meŋeŋic ɋaŋa‐fâreocmu. Erâ hâbi‐ŋeŋic goroŋke‐fâreha dieŋ‐ŋeŋic ŋetara‐fâreocmu. Manaŋgopieŋ, biŋedâŋ i fârio qafâreocmu.’” Wofuŋ Anuture dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go findaŋdâŋ muhuc ʒiŋuc muc: Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Ʒika i ʒâmukicne â wokemaŋ ruacnekicne.
Ŋic jopazore ʒâmu taeŋkekicne, erâ bâricneocte manasuhuc wokemaŋ ruacnekicne hâcne! Irec wemocko bubiaŋ moc manazo? O ŋokâ‐nane, go bâbâtiŋte kâcbiŋ qaisocke‐fâremeŋ.
Irec ʒika i wokemaŋ ruacneniŋte biac râekicne, ʒika qaqa ŋic ere meo feocte biac ʒâmukicne â wokemaŋ ruacnekicne.
O ŋicte ɋâric, ʒika izi ŋicfâc‐nane sipiric‐jopaocmu, ehuc Israe ŋic fekicne sasawa jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋehec kimiziec‐jopaocmu wâc, irec kio wâuŋa ec. Go irec busâqoc manarâ mesahacge qânʒiŋkezemec.
Eesâiczi maic‐ŋopakac, eme ŋoŋe sifu bâbâtiŋte kâcbiŋ qaisockepie eesâiczi sawa mâcne, wiac faic mukicne izi maic‐ŋopa‐fâreocmu hâcne.” Wofuŋ Anutu ere dâŋ iŋuc.
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go findaŋdâŋ muc, ehuc me qatec ʒikazi arecne arecne gie bazejec; ʒika i ima sâko bapare ʒika, irec ŋic rârec‐jopahuc imac‐jopazejec.
Eme maŋŋeŋic gâckeha ŋic bocjaha waha jopazejec. No ʒika izi sacmotâc‐jeŋic sâc ima bacjopaocte manacnepo. Jei, ʒika i bâricneocte ruacnekicne â sisipiric gie baocte ʒâmu taeŋkekicne.
Fâreopec â qanaopec foc fotikic ehuc nâtâcnezejec.
Eme no iŋuc jaha me qahuc juhape aaric‐nane tarazejec. Wofuŋ noni hâcne iŋuc mukopac.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao harierâ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Babe ŋicwofuŋte ʒikazi wareocte hata jajahec bacjofazemec, ehame jahe mâmâc jaha mâreŋ mocjahaonec ware fisizepirec. Erâ hata haeopec fuŋkerâ rakacko ira hatare mumutâc ma âkendâŋnezemec.
Ʒikazi ŋifec Amoŋŋic jaŋere hae qizec Raba â ŋifec ine Juda mâreŋko â Jerusalem hae sanaŋko fisiocte iŋuc hâcne ezemec.
Babe ŋicwofuŋ e hata sosohoc ekopirecko hatare fuŋne manaocte ɋâsâi qaocmu, ehuc tepe motec hehesac‐jopaocmu, â ɋâŋ qâqâtâc mu wioc ejarehuc qowi bugâpâcne honeocmu.
Eme mefârenao ɋâsâi irec seroŋ wiac foocmu izi Jerusalem hae maickerâ foocmu; e ira hâcne ojowa sâko qahuc aŋara heocte â sac ââke mârâŋ tuŋ râeocte â somâ bapare ʒae wiac â mâreŋ toŋne baocte wiac iŋuc fuaocmu.
Mâc Israe ŋic jaŋe ine mumupaŋ dâŋ sanaŋne mumbiŋte findaŋdâŋ irec manapie burecne ewec. Anutu eki ine kiŋjeŋicte manasuhuc râsi jaŋere meo feniŋte mutaraocmu.
“No Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukopac: Ŋoŋe fenarehuc eebapa hehesicnere manasu‐narembiŋ, â sâqocne‐ŋeŋic i eebapa‐ŋeŋicko fua taniŋkewec. Ŋoŋe juju‐ŋeŋic hehesicnere manasu‐narembiŋte râsi jaŋere meo fefâreniŋmu.
O Israe ŋic fekicne, miti tâmiric â ŋic sindaŋne gore dameŋ taraha bâbâtiŋzi maicgukac hâcne.
Wofuŋ Anutu no gore ʒiŋuc mukopac: Go du kakambu â eri hendiŋge hetarazemec; wiac ʒiŋuczia fokac i juku iŋucnea mi foocmu. Wiac waharâ fokac i juku bafaharezo, â wiac ferâ fokac i juku bawahazo.
No wiac ima samaki bape foha irec rune jâmbâŋ fuazejec; fuame wiac sasawa e râcne‐fârepemu.
“O ŋicte ɋâric, go findaŋdâŋ muhuc ʒiŋuc muzemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi Amoŋŋic mu âke sisic‐jeŋicte manasuhuc ʒiŋuc mukac: Jei, ʒika i sisipiric gie baocte becsahackonec unuckekicne, erâ bâbâric iŋucne bâricneocte wokemaŋ ruacnekicne.
Ehame ŋic jaŋe maŋko fuac dâŋzi eatucguhuc findaŋdâŋ burecne gazambiŋ. Eme ʒika i ŋic miti tâmiric â sindaŋne bâbâtiŋ dameŋ‐jeŋic maickekacte jaŋere upeo feme taraocmu.
Irec ʒika i mocwâc fofo‐ticnao esoriec. Eme fuameŋ mâreŋ ira hâcne dâŋge mutarapemu.
Ehuc no aaric‐nanere ʒoc i faigao ficnepe ʒaocmu, erâ ŋic sindaŋne sisipiric gie bajâmbâŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋere meo râecgupemu.
Go ʒocte biŋe ezemec, ehame socge i mâreŋgaoa wahazejec; eme ŋiczi go mocwâc mi manasucgunʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ noni hâcne iŋuc mukopac.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go soc hoŋkeekac hae irec dâŋ mutarazemec. Ehuc eebapa‐ticne mamakâcne i mutaniŋkecne‐fâretec fuŋne‐ticne mana tarazejec.
Ehuc muzemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Jei, hae e dameŋ‐ticne maickeocte jahaczia ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere soc hoŋkeekac â wâwânâŋhec eocte ɋâŋ qâqâtâc bâfuaekac.
Go soc hoŋkehuc kiŋ huremeŋ, erâ ɋâŋ qâqâtâc bâfuahuc wâwânâŋhec emeŋ; iŋuc ehuc jara dameŋge mukicne i bâmbeŋkemeŋ hâcne. Eme no irec mupe ŋicne ŋicne mu âke sisic egarehapie mâreŋ sâc ira mu ruruc egareniŋmu.
Ʒâŋe biŋege wâwânâŋ ecnekicnere â haege bâbâsifuczi fusucmarâ fokacte ŋic ʒorickonec â bembeŋkonec jaŋe mu âke sisic egareniŋmu hâcne.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, Israe ŋic fekicne ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe tâpiri‐jeŋicko roweckehuc soc hoŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
Neŋgoc mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic qaisoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ â ŋic jabane hae‐ŋeŋicko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâʒâic‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, erâ hozec bekâ jaŋe dope hutuŋ moc mi ejareeŋgopieŋ.
Wiac‐nane bâtirikicne i qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ â sabata hombaŋ‐nane qâsuaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic tucne jaŋe eeatuc ehuc soc hoŋkeeŋgopieŋ â tucne jaŋe tikitoŋko tiwâ bâzi nâ bac eeŋgopieŋ, erâ tucne jaŋe wiac sindaŋne gâcne eeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic guru moc jaŋe mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere gec qoruc firuepie biuctac foeŋgopieŋ, â guru moc jaŋe ŋokac mosa dameŋ‐jeŋicko bâsâqorec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Moc e âgo‐ticnere ŋokac bâsâqoreekac, â moc e joŋao‐ticne bâsâqoreekac, eha moc e seŋ ʒocŋifec‐ticne bâsâqoreekac jaha.
Ŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic gâcne jaŋe furi roniŋte erâ soc hoŋkeeŋgopieŋ. Ŋoŋe âgofâc‐ŋeŋic moneŋ hotâ jarembiŋ irec ʒare boc bafehuc bârisie‐ŋareniŋte ʒoɋac ejareeŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe nore nikec‐ŋopawec hâcne. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, moneŋ‐jeŋic kâŋgâc jowac rombiŋ, â ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko soc hoŋkembiŋ irec erâ menane fotarie‐ŋarepemu.
No ŋoŋehec dâŋgie bapemu dameŋ ira hâbi‐ŋeŋic sâcne foocmu, me meŋeŋic sâcne sanaŋkeocmu me? Wofuŋ noni hâcne mukopacte ejâmbâŋkepemu.
No ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐ŋopape mâreŋ sâc râwiŋ qârâwiŋ eniŋmu, iŋuc eŋarehuc wâwânâŋ‐ŋeŋic ʒure‐fârepemu.
Ehame ŋoŋe ŋaŋacne kiŋte erâ ʒâŋe biŋe‐ŋeŋic ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere maio wawahane eocmu. Wiac iŋuc fua‐ŋareme no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu.”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“O ŋicte ɋâric, manakic, Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe nore maio jawa efârembiŋ, jaŋe ŋiczi aeŋ bâbâroŋ â bol â aeŋ erâ led ʒocko rike wosâc eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc ehuc siliwa jawane iŋucne embiŋ hâcne.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu no kecʒiŋuc mukopac: Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe sasawa jawa embiŋte no Jerusalem haeo qânusuc‐ŋopapemu.
Ŋic jaŋe siliwa me aeŋ bâbâroŋ me aeŋ me bol ʒocko rikepie ʒahuc opâ eekac irec sâc jaha noni kimbeŋ aaric‐nanere ʒocko râec‐ŋopape ʒacŋopaha wosâeniŋmu.
No Jerusalem haeo qâzuc‐ŋopahuc iŋuc hâcne eŋarepe wosâe‐fâreniŋmu.
Ine hâcne siliwazi ʒocko ʒahuc opâ eekac irec sâc ŋoŋe ira wosâehuc, Wofuŋ noni hâcne kimbeŋ‐nane faic‐ŋeŋicko râepe fewec i mana taraniŋmu.”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“O ŋicte ɋâric, go Jerusalem hae rune ʒiŋuc jazazemec: ‘Ŋoŋe nore kimbeŋ dameŋko hoezi mâreŋ ʒure bâgunuc moc mi ewec irec sâc eŋgopieŋ.’
Manakic, ŋic fekicnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe laioŋzi qowi kisuc qâsuckehuc owackeekac irec sâc, jaŋe ŋic jaŋere moneŋ mafa wiac‐jeŋic jowac roniŋte qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ, iŋuc epie hae maŋnao hozec bocjaha fuambiŋ.
Taha bapafâc‐jeŋic jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋnane musifuckehuc wiac bâtirikicne i wâwânâŋ ecnembiŋ. Jaŋe wiac bâtirikicne â omane i mi bâtâc bacjofambiŋ, erâ wiac mamakâcne â ɋaɋacne irec fuŋne ŋic jaza qazuc wâc mi embiŋ, jaŋe sabata hombaŋ‐nane qâsuahuc Tiri rune no ʒaubac enarembiŋ.
Fekicnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe kâte qâtozi qowi jopa nâc ehuc soc hoŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc, jaŋe moneŋ mafa kâŋgâc jowac roniŋte ŋic sipiric‐jopambiŋ.
Porofetefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe maŋko fuac â findaŋdâŋ burecne muhuc ŋic jaŋere sâqocne forârâŋnembiŋ. Ehuc Wofuŋ no dâŋ moc mi mufua‐jarehape sifu burec ehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: ‘Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac.’
Mâreŋ irec ŋic jaŋe bâbâʒâic gie bahuc fiuc serereŋ embiŋ, jaŋe ŋic hapetac â qarâ suriŋne ro waha âte ejarembiŋ, ehuc ŋic jabane fuŋne tâmiricko bâʒâic‐jopambiŋ.
Eme no hae i bâsirowezipore ŋeŋezic ŋic moc fuarâ sac bahuc nore maio sacfozic domaocte babasa gie bakupe moc mi fuawec.
Irec no kimbeŋ aaric‐nane fai‐jeŋicko râepo; ehame kimbeŋ‐nanere ʒoczi ʒâtâmirec‐jopawec. No eebapa‐jeŋicte okacne bazu‐jarepo hâcne. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“O ŋicte ɋâric, go manakic, mârâc jaha ŋokac jajahec jupic, jahe neŋgoc mocjahazi rocjofawec.
Jahe Aigita mâreŋko ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ juhuc sasec gie bapic. Ehuc mana‐jarepire ŋic jaŋe susu‐jekicko ro fârec embiŋ.
Mârâc fufua ere ʒâŋe Ohola â qoticnere ʒâŋe ine Oholiba. Eme jahe nore biŋe erâ naru motec bâfua‐narepic. Ohola ʒâŋe i Samariare â Oholiba ʒâŋe i Jerusalemte mukicne.
“Ohola e nore biŋe jaha juhuc sasec gie bawec, e Asiria ŋic jorocfâc‐ticne boc honebâc‐jopawec.
Asiria gawamaŋ ŋic fekicne â momori ŋic micne jaŋe ŋaqi qoruc bâbâroŋzi furi sâko roju jumbieŋ, jaŋe ŋic socɋârizi hawari biaŋ sasawa, erâ becâsicko juju ŋic.
Asiria ŋic bâwosâec‐jopakicne i jaŋe sasawa honebâc‐jopawec hâcne, ehuc ɋâŋ qâqâtâcfâc‐jeŋic bacjopa juhuc maŋ mamanasu‐ticne hegâpârewec.
Aigita ŋic jaŋehec sasec gie bahuc juwec i wâc mi behewec. E socɋâri juhame ŋic jaŋe ehec juhuc susu‐ticnao ro fârec erâ erao sasec gie bambiŋ.
Eme no irec hâcne Asiria ŋic jorocfâc‐ticne hone sasec ejarewec jaŋere meo râepo.
Jaŋe ine ŋaqi heunuckecnepie biuctac juwec, jaŋe naru motecfâcne bacjopa wisembiŋ, e jahacne ine qâhâmombiŋ. Iŋuc ehuc okacne bazucnehapie ŋokac gâcne jaŋe mu âke sisic ecnembiŋ.
“Iŋuc fuame qoticne Oholiba eki honewec. Hone‐bipiehuc hahac‐ticnezi sasec gie bahuc juwec irec sâc sirickehuc bawec.
E iŋuc jaha Asiria gawamaŋ ŋic fekicne â momori micne ʒikare wiac râe jumbieŋ jaŋe honebâc‐jopawec. Jaŋe ŋic socɋârizi hawari biaŋ sasawa, erâ becâsicko juju ŋic.
Eme no qoticne honepe e iŋuc jaha wâwânâŋhec ewec, hahac qo jahe eebapa‐jekic mocjaha fowec hâcne.
Erâ Oholiba e ine sasec gie‐ticne ʒuhuckerâ bawec. E Kaldea ŋic jaŋere hawari peŋ bâbâroŋzi qânâsac‐jeŋicko bapie fome honewec.
Jaŋe ombâŋ‐jeŋicko becsahac jomambiŋ, â qizec‐jeŋicko duʒora hepie huwec, jaŋe momori micne sasawa, erâ Babeŋic Kaldea mâreŋko fuambiŋ iŋucne.
E jaŋe hâcne honebâc‐joparâ Kaldea mâreŋ‐jeŋicko kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopame rambiŋ.
Eme Babeŋic jaŋe fisirâ ehec fohuc sasec gie bambiŋ, ehuc jaŋe bâsâqorekupie jaŋere takickeme râpec‐jopawec.
E sasec gie‐ticne mimi tâmiric tâtâcko iŋuc bahuc juhame no hahac‐ticnere takicnuwec, iŋuc jaha ere takicnume râpeckepo.
Eki ine Aigita mâreŋko socɋâri juhuc sasec gie bawec, irec manasuhuc sau gie‐ticne ʒuhuckerâ bawec.
E sasec ŋicfâc‐ticne doŋgi â becâsic ŋicne jaŋere sâc jumbiŋ jaŋere mâretec ecnewec.
Aigita ŋic jaŋe susuge ro fârec ehapie go socɋâri juhuc sasec gie bameŋ, irec manasuhuc mocwâc egarewec.”
O Oholiba, Wofuŋ Anutu e irec hâcne kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, sasec ŋicfâcge jaŋere takicgume râpec‐jopameŋ jaŋe hâcne ejarepe mâreŋ ŋifec â ŋifec irecnec râsi fisi‐gareniŋmu.
Babeŋic â Kaldea ŋic sasawa, Pekodo â Sowa erâ Koa hae mâreŋkonec ŋic, erâ Asiria ŋic sasawa, ŋic iŋuczi fisiniŋmu hâcne. Jaŋe ŋic socɋâri sahac hawari biaŋ, jaŋe gawamaŋ ŋic kâcɋene â kia sâko, momori micne â momori ŋicguru, jaŋe becâsicko rara ŋic sasawa.
Jaŋe faic mâreŋkonec ʒika keretac‐jeŋic â ŋic guru sâko jaŋehec fisiniŋmu, jaŋe maro kâcɋene â piticne erâ aeŋdu rojuhuc mâreŋ ŋifec â ŋifeckonec râsi fisi‐gareniŋmu hâcne. Ehame jaŋe sâcmutâc‐jeŋicte sâcko dâŋ mutara‐gareniŋte mana‐jarepemu.
Eme no aaric mana‐garepe wiac qacne gâpâcne egareniŋmu. Jaŋe sâkege â hazecge hetâc qâtâcnepie nâfocnefâcge jaŋe ʒikare biŋe eniŋmu. Jaŋe naru motecfâcge amec‐jopa rahapie ʒanʒaŋnefâcge jaŋe ine ʒocte biŋe eniŋmu.
Jaŋe ŋaqi qorucge hetarahuc eri wiacge gowac rofâreniŋmu.
Wiac i mupe fua‐gareha Aigita mâreŋko fuŋkerâ sasec â sindaŋ wiac ebac ehuc juwefumeŋ i arictac efârezejec. Ehame go Aigita ŋic jaŋerao ʒâŋe mocwâc mi fizemec â jaŋere mocwâc mi manasuzemec.
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: Manakic, qaisoc‐jopahuc juekic â takicgume râpec‐jopameŋ jaŋere meo râecgupemu hâcne.
Jaŋe qaisocguhuc wâcwiac hure hemârec emeŋ i gowac rofârepie biuctac erâ domazemec, ehame sasec giere fuŋne fua taniŋkezejec.
Go nemuɋâŋ araŋ bajarehuc wâwânâŋhec emeŋte â ŋicne ŋicne jaŋehec sasec gie bameŋte wiac iŋucne hâcne faigao feocmu.
Hahacgezi hata hehesicne âtewec ijaha âtemeŋte ere ʒâic fârore râqâc gore meo râepe fezejec.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Go hahacgere râqâc ʒoricne â kâcɋene irecnec ʒâic fârore wiac nâhuc juzemec, ehame mu gâgâwi â mu ruruc egarenʒepieŋ, râqâc i fusucmarâ fokac;
irec nâku maŋsifuc egareme ʒâic busâqoc bâfuacmu. Hahacge Samaria ere râqâc hâcne i ʒâic serereŋ â sisipiricte râqâc.
Maŋnao wiac fokac i nâku nâzickehuc qizec susucge unuckezemec, erâ susuge hetâcnezemec. Wofuŋ Anutu noni iŋuc hâcne mupo.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu noni dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukopac: Go nore nikecgume râpecnumeŋte sasec â sindaŋgere okacne faigao fezejec.”
Eme Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc nazawec: “Ŋicte ɋâric, go Ohola â Oholiba jahere dâŋ sâcne mutaracmu me? Go eebapa‐jekic mamakâcne i mutaniŋke‐jactezemec.
Jahe boe sau gie bapic, erâ ʒika qahuc soc hoŋkepic. Nemuɋâŋfâc‐jekic jaŋehec sasec gie bahuc motecfâc‐jekic nore biŋe fuambiŋ jaŋe taha rikec‐jopapic.
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc enarepic: Ʒoaŋ gie bapa ijaha tirific‐nane bâsâqorehuc sabata hombaŋ‐nane qâsuapic.
Jahe naru motecfâc‐jekic nemu jaŋere biŋe hezuc‐jopapic ʒoaŋ ijaha tirific‐nane wâwânâŋ ecnenicte ira fepic. Manakic, jahe nore ficko wiac iŋuc hâcne epic.
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ ŋic mâreŋ ʒorickonec fisiniŋte kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopapire rambiŋ. Eme jaŋe fisipie jaŋere erâ opâ ruahuc ʒâŋe mai‐jekic jâwec ruacnerâ sahac‐jekic erickepic.
Erâ ŋeŋe biaŋnao ŋehuc maŋfuŋ‐jekicko tebo moc herâ hosâc âsu â wokemaŋ‐nane râepire ŋewec.
Ehame haeo ojowa fânâŋ sâko fuame ŋic omane â Saba mâreŋ burocnaonec ŋic maŋsifuchec mâmâc ejarepire fisimbiŋ. Eme ʒorickonec fisimbiŋ jaŋe ŋokac jahere meo maŋguc kisueŋ wiac hejactepie fewec â qizec‐jekicko eri hendiŋ biaŋ hejactepie huwec.
“Eme no irec ʒiŋuc mupo: Jei, ŋokac e boe sau gie bawefuhuc juku ŋokac qizec ewec. Eme ŋic jaŋe ehec sasec gie mocwâc baniŋmu.
Jaŋe erao sasec gie baniŋte fisimbiŋ, sasec ŋokac Ohola â Oholiba jaherao fisimbiŋ hâcne.
Ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ine boe sau ŋic â ʒika qaqa jaŋere dâŋ sâcmutâc dâŋko fokac irec sâcko dâŋjekic mutara‐jacteniŋmu. Jahe boe sau gie bapa â ʒika qaqa ŋokac hâcne.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋic guru gâcne jaŋe fisi‐jacterâ imac‐jofahuc wiac‐jekic jofac rofârenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe qânâzi hecjofahuc ʒikazi qâtâc bâtâc‐jofanʒepieŋ, ehuc naru motecfâc‐jekic qâhâmoc‐joparâ fic wiac‐jekic ʒoczi turuŋkepie ʒafârezejec.
No wiac iŋucne hâcne mupe fua‐jacteme mâreŋ ira sasec gie bapa i omaezejec, ehame ŋokac gâcne jaŋe honerâ jahe sasec gie bapic ijaha banʒipiŋte hâwic‐jopazejec.
Ŋohe sasec gie bajupirec â nemu wiac araŋ bajarehuc kiŋ bâfua jupirec irec okacne fua‐ŋactezejec. Ehame no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana tarazepirec.”
Jara namba 9 irec mosa 10 â irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 10 jaha ehame Wofuŋte dâŋ norao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go ʒoaŋ gie bapa ʒirec ʒâŋe qâreŋkec. Babe ŋicwofuŋ e ʒoaŋ ʒira hâcne Jerusalem hae somâckekac.
Ehame kikefuŋ qaqatarahec jaŋere kesaic dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc muzemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: Go kuʒi ʒocko hetec ŋeha opâ qatec huoc.
Erâ qowi dâkâne biaŋne ŋefacne â ɋawene hâcne i râetec huha siecne bâwosâekicne izi bâfusucmazemec.
Go qowi biaŋne jâmbâŋ moc rorâ hezu rikec ezemec, erâ kuʒi rurumaŋnao ʒoc ruqetec, siecne mecne biucne mecne mâmâc ʒazejec.”
Irec Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Jei, soc hohoŋke hae! Jei, kuʒi hufeŋ bakicne! Hufeŋ‐ticne moc mi omaehuc fokac jaha. Irec qowi dâkâne dâkâne furu jaha kuʒionec rozemec.
Soc hoŋkewec i haeo fokac jaha, e soczi rufemaŋko huzacte mâreŋko mâcne, qânâ faio hoŋkewec hâcne.
Maŋnane bâruŋkeme okacne bazucnepemurâ mâreŋko mâcne, qânâ faio soc hoŋkeme tâtâc foocte manacnepo.
Irec hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu noni ʒiŋuc mukopac: Jei, soc hohoŋke hae, no ʒocfiki sâko bapemu.
Irec ʒoc bocjaha guruckerâ ruqetec ʒaoc, eme biuc i ʒâdockeha opâ sicne hoŋketec raha siecne ʒâgâpârezejec.
Iŋuc fuame kuʒi tacne ʒocko hetec ŋehuc fârone ezejec; ehame kuʒi sahacne bâruŋkeme maŋnao wânâŋ wiac fokac i ʒâtâcneme hufeŋ‐ticne wâc omaezejec.
No ʒâic gie barâ bâipiepo, ehame hufeŋ sanaŋ‐ticne i mi omaewec.
Hufeŋ‐ticne i sasec boe sau hâcne. No ʒure ɋaɋackepemurâ muhape go wâwânâŋgere erâ mi ɋaɋackemeŋte wâwânâŋhec jaha juhaŋtec okacne bazu‐garepe kimbeŋ‐nane tarazejec.
Wofuŋ noni hâcne iŋuc mukopac. Irec dameŋne maickeme ejâmbâŋkepemu. No busâqoc mana‐garehuc moc mi akicgupemu, â maŋnane wâc mi risieocmu. Aricne, no juju â eebapagere sâcko dâŋ mutara‐garepemu. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“O ŋicte ɋâric, manakic, no ŋonâŋge maŋzi jauŋkeekic e ututuŋ jaha gowac ropemu. Ehame go sifu ʒâŋeucge wahame ki mamakuc mi ezemec.
Kio ŋâŋâtâc kâcɋene mi ehuc soŋgâŋ wâc mi qazemec. Duʒorage â kikehuhu hetec huoc, mecʒâwâge mi sâockezemec â soŋgâŋ nânâ râe‐garepie mi nâzemec.”
No furicte ŋic ŋokac dâŋ jazapo â hae owâeme ŋonâŋ‐nane hâmowec. Eme hae fureme dâŋ nazakicne irec sâc epo.
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒiŋuc nazambiŋ: “Go wiac keci ekomec irec fuŋne sâcne nâzâcmu me?”
Iŋuc mupie ʒiŋuc jazapo: “Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
‘Go Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe jazazemec: Wofuŋ Anutu e ʒiŋuc mukac: Manaŋgopieŋ, no tiri ufuŋ‐nane hegâpârepemu. Ŋoŋe ira hâcne roweckehuc sasanaŋ bâfuambiŋ â ʒâŋe‐ŋeŋiczi hone ʒiziwembiŋ, erâ maŋ manasu‐ŋeŋic ira râepie fowec. Naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic ira hetarac‐jopambiŋ jaŋe ʒikare biŋe enʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc fua‐ŋareme ŋoŋe noni wiac epo irec sâc jaha enʒepieŋ. Mecʒâwâ‐ŋeŋic mi sâockenʒepieŋ, erâ soŋgâŋ nânâ râe‐ŋarepie mi nânʒepieŋ.
Duʒora â kikehuhu‐ŋeŋic hepie huzejec. Ŋoŋe ki mamakuc mi ehuc kiŋŋeŋiczi kidapec‐ŋopame ʒâic busâqoc mamanac enʒepieŋ.
Eʒekie e eebapa‐ŋeŋicte maqâreŋ ehame wiac efârewec irec sâc jaha ŋoŋe enʒepieŋ. Eme wiac i fua‐fâreme ŋoŋe no hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.’
“Eme jaŋe taha ufuŋ sanaŋko roweckehuc sasanaŋ bâfuarâ ʒâŋe biŋehec embiŋ â ʒâŋe‐jeŋiczi hone ʒiziwembiŋ, erâ maŋ mamanasu‐jeŋic râepie fowec i hâcne bârâriehuc naru motecfâc‐jeŋic sipiric‐jopapemu
dameŋ ira ʒikare nâfocne moczi fisirâ biŋedâŋ gazaocmu.
Eme dameŋ ijaha micge tâcneme nâŋguŋ mocwâc mi juhuc dâŋecmu. Ehame go jaŋere maqâreŋ ehaŋte jaŋe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Amoŋŋic maic‐jopahuc okacdâŋ‐jeŋic muzemec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anuture dâŋ mananiŋ. Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Râsi jaŋe tiri ufuŋ‐nane hegâpârembiŋ â Israeŋic mâreŋ‐jeŋic imackembiŋ, erâ Juda kikefuŋ kâpâcwâruo bacjopa rambiŋ. Eme ŋoŋe wiac i honerâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Sowine!”
Ŋoŋe iŋuc mumbiŋte no ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec ŋicguru jaŋere meo râec‐ŋopape rauc‐ŋopanʒepieŋ, ehuc jaŋe ware fisirâ ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋec juc ehuc nânâ opâ wiac‐ŋeŋic nâhuc junʒepieŋ.
No Raba hae imackepe kamele jaŋere toma ezejec, â Amoŋŋic jaŋere hae gâcne ŋerakac i lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sac sapa ezejec. Iŋuc fuame ŋoŋe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.’
Ŋoŋe me qahuc kike‐ŋeŋic âteickerâ Israe mâreŋ ʒâic fâro‐ticne honerâ mu ruruc ecnembiŋte
no menane sicnehuc rocŋoparâ ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere meo râec‐ŋopapemu. Eme ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec â mâreŋ sâc irecnec wâc bârâriec‐ŋoparâ bâsirowec‐ŋopapemu. Iŋuc eŋarepe ŋoŋe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Moabi ŋic jaŋe ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: Manaŋgopieŋ, Judaŋic jaŋe mâreŋ sâc ŋicguru gâcne jaŋere sâc jaha juŋgopieŋ.
Iŋuc muŋgopieŋte no Moabi tiki mâreŋte eri qaraweŋ hae jahec â moc kecʒiŋuc jaŋe hâcne bârâriec‐jopapemu: Bete‐Jesimo, Baali‐Meoŋ erâ Kiriataim. Iŋuc epe Moabi mâreŋ i rambaŋ foocmu.
Ehame no Moabi mâreŋ â Amoŋŋic jaŋere mâreŋ i mâmâc ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec ŋic qikiŋne‐jarepe ro rauc enʒepieŋ, eme ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe mocwâc mi manasuc‐jopaniŋmu.
Eme no Moabi ŋic okacne bazu‐jarepe jaŋe no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Edomŋic jaŋe Juda kikefuŋ jaŋerao okac babazu gie bahuc kiŋsâko hurembiŋ.
Irec no Edom mâreŋ râsi ecnehuc ŋic mecne qowi mecne mâmâc bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârepe mâreŋ i tuhutac fuarâ foocmu. Jaŋe Temaŋ haeo fuŋkerâ ʒikare biŋe erakupie Dedaŋ haeo tarazejec.
No Israe ŋicfâc‐nane ejarepe kimbeŋ aaric‐nane fuawec irec sâcko Edomŋic jaŋerao okac babazu gie banʒepieŋ. Eme jaŋe okac babazu gie‐nanere fuŋne mananʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Filisa ŋic jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane râsi sanaŋ â mu âke sisic ejarehuc sipiric‐jopambiŋte okac babazu gie bambiŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu no kecʒiŋuc mukopac: Manaŋgopieŋ, no Filisa ŋic jaŋe râsi ejarepemu, ehuc Kereti ŋic mecne â hâwecŋic ʒanʒaŋne jaŋe mecne mâmâc bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârepemu.
No okacne ŋemâcne bazu‐jarehuc kimbeŋ aaric faio bâtiŋ‐jopapemu. Eme bâbâtiŋ‐nanezi fai‐jeŋicko feme jaŋe no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu.”
Eme jara 11 irec mosa wâŋte gie bapa wâŋ jaha ira Wofuŋte dâŋ norao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go manakic, Tiro hae e Jerusalemte ʒiŋuc muwec: ‘Sowine, ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere motâc foweczi omaewec. Hae i imackekicnere motâc sâko aŋke‐narewec, irec no mâriri sâkohec epemu.’
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu no kecʒiŋuc mukopac: O Tiro hae, manakic, no râsi egarekopac, ehuc hâweczi siri‐ticne beheme wefuekac irec sâc ŋicne ŋicne ejarepe râsi fisi‐garenʒepieŋ.
Fisirâ qânâsacge qanʒaŋnehuc ficʒorage hetâtienʒepieŋ; ehame no mâreŋge guec‐ticne âkehockepe sawa fuarâ fozejec.
Hae e nuc iŋucne foha ŋic jaŋe ira wasaŋ‐jeŋic râe fâretiŋ epie ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere mafa mateŋ ezejec. Wofuŋ Anutu noni hâcne iŋuc mukopac.
Hae piticfâc‐ticne mâreŋ sâkoo ŋeraŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine ʒikare biŋe enʒepieŋ. Iŋuc fua‐jareme jaŋe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: “O Tiro hae, no mupe faic mâreŋkonec ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ, Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza hâcne, e becâsic â keretac erâ becâsicko rara ŋic â momori guru dindiŋ jaŋehec fisi‐gareocmu.
E hae piticfâcge mâreŋ sâkoo ŋeraŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒikazi jopa‐fâreocmu; e râsi egarehuc somâcgurâ mâreŋ toŋne bagareocmu, ehuc marozi sâsâoc râe‐gareocmu wâc.
E qânâsacge ââke mârâŋ tuŋzi âeckekume rândiŋkeocmu â râric‐ticnezi ficʒorage sasawa hetâc qâtâtieocmu.
Becâsicfâc‐ticne guru sâko jaŋe gasackerâ warepie rufezi sâocguocmu. Hae moc ima bakicne foha feeŋgopieŋ irec sâc fohaŋtec haemaŋgao hefâha becâsic â keretac wiac‐ticnere fânâŋte erâ haesacge ɋiɋiteckeocmu.
Becâsicfâc‐ticne jaŋe hae hata wiacge âtenʒaŋnehapie ŋicfâcge ʒikazi jopa‐fâreme qânâ wâtuŋfâcge sanaŋne jaŋe mâreŋko rândiŋke qafâreniŋmu.
Jaŋe moneŋ mafa wiacge gowac rofâreniŋmu â wiac hure hemârec eekic izi jaŋere mafa mateŋ eme bawiseniŋmu. Jaŋe qânâsacge henʒaŋ qanʒaŋneniŋmu â fic wiacge biaŋne i hetâc qâtâtieniŋmu, ehuc qânâ â katapa erâ jawa wiac gâcne i hâwecko behepie hufâreocmu.
Eme ʒeri bubiaŋ fânâŋ‐ŋeŋic bâniniŋkepe ŋiczi mocwâc mi mananʒepieŋ.
No hae ʒoŋagao mupe haroŋaŋ sawa fuarâ fozejec, eme ira ŋiczi wasaŋ‐jeŋic râe fâretiŋ ehuc junʒepieŋ. Hae i mocwâc heɋârerâ mi bâpiaŋkezo; Wofuŋ noni hâcne iŋuc mukopac.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi Tiro hae dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnekac: “Manakic, sisipiric dameŋge maickeme haemaŋgao ʒika qahuc ŋic jopapie ki owa fuame nucne nucne jaŋe irec fânâŋte ɋiɋiteckeniŋmu.
Iŋuc fuame hâwecmecko ŋic fekicne juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe eri ŋeŋe‐jeŋickonec waharâ eri qaraweŋ‐jeŋic hetaraniŋmu, ehuc mateŋ qonaŋkerâ ɋarac ɋarac qaniŋmu. Jaŋe honecgurâ bipic tatara ejareme mâreŋko ŋehuc fâfâre hehejac eniŋmu.
Ehuc gore erâ makuc gae moc ʒiŋuc muhuc hefuaniŋmu: ‘Jei, hae ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec, go hâwecmecko ŋehuc weniŋuc erâ sipirickehuc omaemeŋ. Go â ŋicfâcge ŋoŋe hâwecko rac warec ehuc tâpiri‐ŋeŋicte fuŋne bataniŋke jumbieŋ. Ehuc mâreŋ sâkoo bataniŋkepie, ŋic jaŋe ŋoŋere hâwic‐jopa jujec.
Ʒi ine sisipiric dameŋge maickeme hâwecmecko ŋic juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe bipic tatara ejarekac, â nucne nucne jaŋe gorao ima sâko fuawec i honerâ fâfâreŋgopieŋ.’”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: “No ima bacgupe hae sâko gâcne jaŋe sesuctac fuarâ foraŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha fozemec, no hâwec sâko ecnepe wefurâ ʒâkâŋ‐ticnezi qâurucguocmu.
Erâ ŋic mârâc jaha juku hâmorâ hâmoc haeo humbiŋ jaŋerao wâc sârocgupe huzemec, ehuc mârâc hâmombiŋ jaŋehec mâreŋ jujuwicnao hae mârâc jaha ima bacjopakicne ira hurâ juzemec. Iŋuc fuame ŋic ɋâricne jaŋehec mocwâc mi juzemec, â gorao ŋic mocwâc fuarâ mi junʒepieŋ.
No bâsirowecgu‐jâmbâŋkepe omae‐fârezemec. Eme ŋic jaŋe basacgu‐bipiehuc sifu mocwâc mi bâfuacgunʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“O ŋicte ɋâric, go Tiro haere makuc gae moc hefuac.
Ehuc Tiro hae hâwecmecko ŋeekaczi mâreŋ sâc ŋicne ŋicne â nucne nucne jaŋehec âbârâ gie baekac e ʒiŋuc âzâcnec: Wofuŋ Anutu e dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “O Tiro hae, go kecʒiŋuc mumeŋ: ‘No wokere sâc biaŋne jâmbâŋ.’
Giegaŋge i hâwec ʒâʒâŋiŋko fokac; gieŋicfâcge jaŋe sahac hawarige basarickehuc bambiŋ.
Paraŋ wiacge i Seniri mâreŋkonec bizojâczi bafârembiŋ; â jâmânere ine Lebanoŋ tikionec jâmâzâc rombiŋ.
Foige i Basaŋ mâreŋkonec boriŋjâc he fasaec embiŋ; â wokere maŋne ine Kipiro nuckonec jâczi bambiŋ, ehuc elefaŋte ʒuŋenezi ba eric embiŋ.
Aigita mâreŋkonec qoruc qâreŋ biaŋhec izi rac bapie mage ewec; â woke bupune ine Kipiro nuckonec qoruc furi sâko bâbâroŋ â bugeneheczi ɋâtâmbiŋ.
Sidoŋ â Arawada haeonec ŋic jaŋe foi qaqafâcge erâ juhapie, gahacne ŋic mepapac jaŋe guriŋ bapafâcge erâ jumbiŋ.
Gebali haeonec ŋic kâcɋene â ŋic mepapac jaŋe gore maŋko juhuc kikisuge sâfâzi ʒimickembiŋ; Woke sasawa â ŋicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe gorao fisirâ, gohec âbârâ gie bambiŋ.
“Perisia â Ludi â Puti ŋic jaŋe ʒikaŋicfâcge erâ jumbiŋ, jaŋe maro erâ aeŋdu wiac‐jeŋic gorao hepie ŋehuc juwec; jaŋe hâcne ʒâŋe biŋege fuaocte giene bambiŋ.
Arawada haeonec ŋic jaŋe go gahacne ŋicfâc jaŋehec ruc bapa ŋic erâ jumbiŋ. Ehame Gamada ŋic jaŋe ficʒorage hâŋ bafekicne ira ferâ ŋembiŋ, ehuc maro‐jeŋic qânâsacko râepie qâfeŋneme hawari biaŋge fuawec.
“Go mafa mâririge fofo dunduŋ fogarewecte Tarasisi ŋic jaŋe gohec âbârâ gie bambiŋ, ehuc siliwa, aeŋ â wapa erâ led izi goraonec wiac gâcne furine bambiŋ.
Jawaŋ, Tubali erâ Meseke ŋic jaŋe gohec wiac nareŋ gareŋ embiŋ; jaŋe goraonec wiac furine baniŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa â aeŋ bâbâroŋzi râqâc wiac bakicne i amec‐jopa fisimbiŋ.
Bete‐Togarama mâreŋkonec ŋic jaŋe goraonec wâcwiac kitâcne‐jareocte becâsic â doŋgi bacjopa fisimbiŋ.
Rodo nuckonec ŋic jaŋe gohec wâc nareŋ gareŋ embiŋ, ehame hâwec mâreŋte ŋicne ŋicne siricfâcge jufârembiŋ jaŋe goraonec wiac furine baniŋte elefaŋte ʒuŋe â bonejâc wiac bafisi‐garembiŋ.
Go mafa mâririge fofo dunduŋ fogarewecte Edomŋic jaŋe gohec âbârâ gie bahuc jumbiŋ, ehuc goraonec wiac i qânâ â qoruc furi sâko â qoruc qâreŋ biaŋ erâ qoruc hahameŋne â kubu wiac erâ qânâ furi sâko bâbâroŋ izi furine bambiŋ.
Juda â Israe ŋic jaŋe gohec nareŋ gareŋ ehuc goraonec wâcwiac i padi â oliwa â jâmbo hândâŋne erâ baŋac â wokemaŋ wiac izi furine bambiŋ.
Damasko ŋic jaŋe gohec âbârâ gie bambiŋ wâc, ehuc wiac hawari fuŋne fuŋne fogarewec i Heliboŋ mâreŋkonec waiŋ â lama kanʒaŋ wiac izi furine bambiŋ.
Wedaŋ â Jawaŋ ŋic jaŋe Uʒali mâreŋkonec aeŋ wiac ba akic ekicne bafisi‐garembiŋ, ehuc musijâc uucne â wiac âsu biaŋ gâcne i goraonec wiac furi baniŋte bafisimbiŋ wâc.
Dedaŋŋic jaŋe ine becâsicko ŋeŋere qoruc wiac bafisi‐garembiŋ.
Arabia ŋic â Kedara ŋic fekicne jaŋe gohec nareŋ gareŋ eniŋte lama bulimakao â noniŋ wiac amec‐jopa fisimbiŋ.
Seba â Rama haeonec ŋic jaŋe goraonec wiac furine baniŋte wiac âsu biaŋ fuŋne fuŋne â qânâ furi sâko erâ gol bafisimbiŋ.
Haraŋ, Kane, Edeŋ, Asihuru â Kilimadi ŋic jaŋe gohec âbârâ gie bambiŋ wâc.
Jaŋe ŋaqi qoruc biaŋne â ŋaqi ʒora qoruc furi sâko â qâreŋneheczi bakicne erâ ɋâriŋko rurumac qoruc foforierâ muczi basanaŋkekicne i bafisi‐fârembiŋ.
Tarasisionec woke jaŋe wiac i sasawa furire biŋe bafisi‐gare jumbieŋ hâcne. “Iŋuc egarepie mafa mâriri sâkohec etec ʒâŋe biŋegezi hâwecne hâwecne sâcke‐fârerâ fowec.
Foi qaqa ŋicfâcge jaŋe foicgupie hâwec ʒâʒâŋiŋko rameŋ. Ehame ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec mâŋâŋzi fisirâ qanʒaŋguwec.
Eme mafa mâririge mecne nareŋ gareŋ eere mafa wiac mecne, wokeŋic â guriŋ bapa ŋicfâcge mecne, woke ʒiʒimic ŋicfâcge mecne nareŋ gareŋ gie bapa ŋicfâcge mecne, momorifâcge gohec jumbiŋ mecne, erâ ŋic gâcne gohec jumbiŋ jaŋe sasawa sisipiric dameŋge maickeme hâwec fâhâŋnao hufârembiŋ.
Guriŋ bapafâcge jaŋe ki owa epie mâreŋzi ɋiɋiteckewec.
Ehame foi qaqa ŋic jaŋe woke‐jeŋickonec tararâ waha‐fârembiŋ. Wokeŋic â guriŋ bapa ŋic sasawa jaŋe moŋgeŋko ferâ domahuc
gore erâ kio ŋâŋâtâc ehuc owa ruruckembiŋ. Jaŋe rufe fiapie fai‐jeŋicko feme ʒafemaŋko fohuc risimbine qambiŋ.
Jaŋe gore erâ qizec‐jeŋic utu pârâc bambiŋ, â mateŋ qonaŋke‐fârembiŋ, ehuc gore erâ wâuŋa qahuc ki mamakuc embiŋ.
Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc gore makuc gae moc ʒiŋuc hefuambiŋ: ‘Mozi Tirore sâc hâwec ʒâʒâŋiŋko moc sipirickewec?
Go hâwecko rac warec erâ nareŋ gareŋ gie bahuc ŋic bocjaha bubiaŋ qajaremeŋ; mafa mâririge ɋâfoŋne foweczi mâreŋne mâreŋne ŋicwofuŋ dope hutuŋ ejaremeŋ.
Ʒi ine hâwec sirizi qanʒaŋgume, hâwec fâhâŋnao hujâmbâŋkemeŋ; ehame furi bapare wiac â wokeŋic sasawa jaŋe gohec mâmâc hufârembiŋ.
Irec hâwecmecko ŋic ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe honecgurâ bipic tatara ejare‐fârekac; ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe fâfâre sâqorepie hawari‐jeŋic memezacne ekac.
Ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere âbârâ gie bapa ŋic jaŋe mu ruruc egareŋgopieŋ; go ɋeŋfâfâc jaha sipirickemeŋ i, go omae‐jâmbâŋkemeŋ hâcne.’”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Tiro haere ŋicwofuŋ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnezemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Go maŋfefe bâfuahuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc muekic: ‘No nemu, no hâcne hâwec sawao nemu jaŋere ŋeŋeo ŋeekopac.’ Gahacnere ‘No nemu jukopac â nemure mamanasu fonarekac,’ iŋuc muekiczi sifu nemu mi ehuc ŋic sawa juekic.
Gore maŋɋârâŋ i jâmbomac Daniere maŋɋârâŋ sirickekac; â gore maio wiac soŋsoŋ moc mi fokac.
Maŋɋârâŋ â mamana saric fogarekacte moneŋ mafa hure hemârec emeŋ, ehuc gol â siliwa râe guruc emeŋ.
Go nareŋ gareŋ gie bapare mamana tara fogarekacte moneŋ mafa sâkohec emeŋ, eme moneŋ mafage fua ɋârâŋ ewec irec sâc jaha maŋfefege fua‐garewec.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu no dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukopac: Manakic, go nemu mamana fonarekac muekicte,
no mupe ŋic furune â repic qapicne jaŋe râsi fisi‐garenʒepieŋ; ehuc ʒikazi guhuc mamana saric â ʒâŋe biŋege bawahanʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe sârocgupie nombâŋko huzemec, ehuc ʒikazi qâhâmoc‐jopakicne jaŋe iŋucne erâ hâwec ʒâkâŋko hurâ hâmo sipiric ezemec.
Eme go nemu aricne, ŋic sawa juekiczi, sifu qa sipiric egarepie, jaŋere maio ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ sâcne mucmu me: ‘No nemu?’
Go sahac‐jeŋicko ma mi bakicne jaŋere hâmocte sâc ŋic furune jaŋere meo ferâ hâmozemec. No Wofuŋ Anutuzi mukopac hâcne.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Tiro ŋicwofuŋ ere makuc gae moc hefuahuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnezemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Go fuarâ ŋic tiŋne jâmbâŋ mamana sâkohec â sahac hawari biaŋhec jumeŋ.
Go Anuture jufu gie Edeŋko hâcne jumeŋ; ehame qânâ furi sâko fuŋne fuŋne kecʒiŋuc jaŋe erige embiŋ: Bâbâroŋ, bâbâŋeŋ, ɋaɋacne â âmuc âmucne, kedane, ɋaɋacne kiruŋ iŋucne, keŋkeŋne, bâbâroŋ soc iŋucne erâ ârâŋ ɋâri. Hazec warawa â eri wiacge gâcne i golzi bakicne, wiac i fuameŋ dameŋ ira bâfua‐garekicne.
Go kerubim micne wokemaŋ ruacnekicne iŋucne tinac, ehuc Anuture tiri tikio juhuc qânâ findowakicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko rac warec emeŋ.
Go fuameŋkonecteaŋ bahac tâmiric juwefuhuc ʒâhec kiŋ bâfuameŋ.
Go nareŋ gareŋ gie sâko bahuc sindaŋ fuŋne fuŋne erâ sâqoremeŋ, irec no wiac omane iŋucne Anuture tikionec bârâriecgupe kerubim micnezi qânâ findowakicne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec jâpecguwec.
Go sahac hawari biaŋgere erâ maŋfefe emeŋ, ehuc ʒâŋe biŋegere erâ maŋɋârâŋge hesifuckemeŋ. Eme no irec hâcne mâreŋko tuŋgupe waha qameŋ; erâ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere maio fuŋnege bataniŋkepe honecgurâ mu gâgâwi egarembiŋ.
Go nareŋ gareŋ gie sisifucne bahuc kiŋsâko hurerâ furufic‐nane gâc hecnemeŋ; eme no hâcne mupe irecnec ʒoc fuarâ ʒâseŋguwec; ehame ŋiczi honecgu‐fârehapie ʒafe efâremeŋ.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋeraonec gâcnezi hone manac egareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bipic tatara ejarekac, go ɋeŋfâfâc jaha sipirickemeŋ, go omae‐jâmbâŋkemeŋ hâcne.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Sidoŋ hae maickerâ findaŋdâŋ muzemec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “O Sidoŋ hae, go manac: No râsi egarehuc tâpiri‐nanere fuŋne gorao bataniŋkepemu. Eme tiri juju‐nanere fuŋne bajaŋgeŋkehuc okacne bazu‐garepe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana tarazemec.
No mupe huc hâmoc fua‐gareocmu, â hae ʒoŋagao soc hoŋkeniŋmu; ehame ʒikazi mâreŋ ŋifec â ŋifeckonec fisi‐garerâ qa sipiric egareocmu. Iŋuc fua‐gareme, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana tarazemec.
“Israe kikefuŋ rârec‐jopahuc qaisoc‐joparâ mu âke sisic ejarembiŋ ŋic i jaŋere ʒârâ hâriŋzi Israe ŋic ba sipiric me ba bâʒâic mocwâc mi ejarezejec. Eme jaŋe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “No Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐jopakicnaonec ro qâzuc ejarerâ ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere maio tiri juju‐nanere fuŋne bataniŋkepe mâreŋ‐jeŋic kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Jakobo râcne tahac epo ira ŋec juc enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ira juhâc qâhâmohuc fic hae‐jeŋic barâ waiŋ saranʒepieŋ. No ŋic rârec‐jopahuc bâʒâic‐jopambiŋ jaŋerao okac babazu gie bahape Israe ŋic jaŋe juhâc qâhâmonʒepieŋ. Ehuc no hâcne Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋic jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Jara namba 10 irec mosa 10 â irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 12 ira Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Farao maickerâ e mecne â Aigita ŋic sasawa mecne jaŋe okacdâŋ jazazemec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc muzemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “O Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Farao, manakic, no râsi egarepemu. Go oâ sâko erâ opâ ʒâkâŋko fohuc kecʒiŋuc muekic: ‘Nilu opâ i nore biŋe jâmbâŋ, i noni hâcne bâfuapo.’
Manakic, no mecqaŋeŋgao hawiczi hehawicgupe, opâ qowi jaŋe sahac garacgao bohota‐fâreniŋmu. Ehame opâonec fârecgupe go gahacne â opâ qowi sahacgao bohotaeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe mâmâc wefu‐fâreniŋmu.
Erâ go â opâ qowifâcge ŋoŋe mâreŋ burocnao behec‐ŋopapemu. Eme ira mâreŋ sawao fohapie moczi moc rocŋoparâ mi ducŋopaniŋmu. Kâte qowi â sawa wipe jaŋere nânâ eniŋte behec‐ŋopapemu hâcne.
“Iŋuc fuame Aigita mâreŋ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ. Go Israe kikefuŋ gunu wawaucne iŋucne ejaremeŋ.
Jaŋe âkesiŋguhapie mejeŋicko herickerâ nâpârâc‐jopameŋ, me gorao roweckehapie hericketec foameŋkembiŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Manakic, no mupe ʒika fua‐garerâ ŋic mecne qowi mecne jopa sipiric efâreocmu.
Eme Aigita mâreŋ i niniŋ siarereŋ erâ tuhutac fuarâ foocmu. Iŋuc fuame, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu. “Go ʒiŋuc mumeŋ: ‘Nilu opâ i nore biŋe jâmbâŋ, noni hâcne bâfuapo.’
Manakic, no irec hâcne go â opâfâcge râsi eŋarepe Aigita mâreŋ e Migidoli hae ira fuŋkerâ niniŋ siarereŋ erâ tuhutac fuarâ raku Etiopia mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao, Siene haeo hâcne taraocmu.
Eme ŋic mecne qowi mecne mâreŋ ira sicne fotâc mocwâc mi epie tuhutac erâ foha jara 40 tarazejec.
Eme no Aigita mâreŋ ima bape mâreŋ ima bacjopakicne gâcne jaŋere ŋondeŋko niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fozejec. Ehame haefâcne ŋeraŋgopieŋ jaŋe hae bâsirowec‐jopakicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko sesuctac fuarâ fohapie jara 40 jaha tarazejec. No Aigita ŋic jaŋe ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐jopape mâreŋ sâc siŋsaŋ qafârenʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Juku jara 40 tarame Aigita ŋic gurune gurune jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐jopakicne irecnec qâzuc‐jopapemu.
Ehuc ʒârâ hâriŋ‐jeŋic bârârierâ Patarosi mâreŋko, fufua mâreŋ‐jeŋicko hâcne ira mocwâc bârisiec‐jopape ŋicguru wawahane erâ junʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋicguru wawahane jâmbâŋ juhuc ŋicguru gâcne jaŋere maio fefene erâ mi junʒepieŋ. No bawahac‐jopa‐jâmbâŋkepe ŋic gurune gurune jaŋerao guriŋ bapa gie mocwâc mi banʒepieŋ.
Ehame Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe Aigita ŋic jaŋerao mocwâc mi roweckenʒepieŋ, jaŋe Aigita ŋiczi bafic‐jopaniŋte wira‐jarehuc sâqocne bâfuambiŋ irec manasunʒepieŋ. Eme jaŋe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Jara namba 27 irec mosa namba wâŋ â irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa wâŋ jaha ehame Wofuŋte dâŋ norao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, manakic, Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza eki momorifâc‐ticne ejareme Tiro hae roniŋte gie sâko bambiŋ. Ehuc wâcwiac de âsic ekupie qizec‐jeŋic pârâcke‐fârewec â ɋawe‐jeŋic nâpârâcke‐fârewec. Ehame Tiro hae râsi ecnehuc gie sâko bambiŋ irec furine e jahacne mecne â momorifâcne mecne moc mi fua‐jarewec.
Irec hâcne Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Manakic, Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza e Aigita mâreŋ râcnepe moneŋ mafa wiac‐jeŋic kâŋgâc jowac rome momorifâc‐ticne jaŋere gie furi ezejec.
Jaŋe nore micte gie bambiŋte gie furi‐jeŋic i Aigita mâreŋ qikiŋne‐jarepemu hâcne. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“No dameŋ ira Israe kikefuŋ mana‐jarepe tâpiri mocwâc fua‐jareocmu, erâ micge baafeckepe dâŋnane acmeruŋ tâmiric jazahuc juzemec. Eme jaŋe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, findaŋdâŋ muhuc ʒiŋuc jazazemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋoŋe ki owa eniŋ: ‘Jei, dameŋ hâhâwicne fuakac!’ Dameŋ moc maickekac,
Wofuŋte dameŋ hâcne maickekac, dameŋ i dameŋ sâqocne, erâ ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere sisipiric dameŋ.
Ʒikazi Aigita ŋic jaŋere faio feme, qâhâmoc‐jopakicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe mâreŋko foraniŋmu â moneŋ mafa wiac‐ticne bawiseniŋmu, erâ ficsanaŋ wiac‐ticne heroc qâropieniŋmu, eme Etiopia ŋic jaŋe honerâ bipic tatara ejareocmu.
“Ehame Etiopia â Puti â Ludi, â Arabia â Libia mâreŋkonec ŋic jaŋe mecne, erâ Aigita ŋic jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic erâ jumbiŋ ŋic i jaŋe mecne mâmâc ʒikare biŋe efâreniŋmu.”
Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Aigita mâreŋ dopeckeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe waha jopazejec, ehame tâpiri‐ticne fekicne i omaezejec. Migidoli fuŋkerâ raku Siene ira mickekac mâreŋ ŋondeŋ irec ŋic jaŋe ʒikare biŋe efârenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme Aigita mâreŋ i mâreŋ gâcne niniŋ siarereŋ foraŋgopieŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko niniŋ siarereŋ jaha fuarâ fozejec, â haefâc‐ticne jaŋe hae gâcne ima bacjopakicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko sesuctac fuarâ ŋeranʒepieŋ.
Eme no Aigita mâreŋ ʒoc turuŋkepe ʒame, dodopecfâc‐ticne jaŋe sipirickepie, mâreŋ rune jaŋe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.
“Dameŋ ira kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe wokeo raku Etiopia ŋic manabâc tâmiric juŋgopieŋ jaŋe ututuŋ jaha fisi‐jareniŋmu; ehame sipirickepie Aigita ŋic jaŋe biŋe‐jeŋic manarâ mâretec hâwic‐jopaocmu. Manaŋgopieŋ, sisipiric i fua‐jâmbâŋkeocmu hâcne!”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “No Babe ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza ecnepe Aigita ŋic jaŋere moneŋ mafa jowac rome omaezejec.
E â ŋicfâc‐ticne guru repic qapicne jâmbâŋ, jaŋe mâreŋ imackeniŋte fisiniŋmu; ehuc ʒikazi mâreŋ â ŋic imac‐jopapie qâŋɋâŋ jaŋe mâreŋ sâcke‐fârerâ foraniŋmu.
Eme no mupe Nilu opâ ʒickeme mâreŋ i ŋic hehesicne jaŋere meo râepemu, erâ ŋic furune jaŋe mana‐jarepe mâreŋ â ira wiac sasawa forakac i ima bacjopa‐fâreniŋmu. No Wofuŋzi hâcne mukopac.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “No Memfisi haeo nemuɋâŋ â ɋâŋ qâqâtâc wiac i sipiric‐jopape omaeniŋmu. Aigita mâreŋko ŋic fekicne mocwâc mi junʒepieŋ, ehame mâreŋ rune jaŋe hâhâwic hejarepemu.
No Patarosi mâreŋ imackepe niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fozejec, â Zoaŋ hae i ʒoc turuŋkepe ʒazejec; ehame Tebesi hae okacne bazucnepemu.
Erâ Aigita jaŋere fic hae sanaŋ, ʒâŋene Pelusium, i imackehuc Tebesi ŋic guru sâko jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopapemu.
No Aigita mâreŋ ʒoc turuŋkepe ʒaha Pelusiumzi ɋiɋiteckezejec; Tebesi hae ima bahuc sac wiac‐ticne hetâc qâtâtieniŋmu.
Oŋ â Pibeseti haeonec ŋic socɋâri jaŋe ʒikare biŋe ehapie, ŋokac jaŋe kâpâcwâru ficko rafâreniŋmu.
No Tapanesi haeo Aigita ŋicwofuŋte gunu bazupe, ira dapâc sâko fuame tâpiri‐ticne omaeocmu; hae i dudubizi sâockeha narufâc‐ticne jaŋe kâpâcwâru ficko rafâreniŋmu.
No iŋuc ejarehuc Aigita mâreŋ okacne bazucnepemu hâcne. Eme jaŋe, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Jara namba 11 irec mosa wâŋ â irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 eha Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, manakic, no Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Farao meombâŋ‐ticne qazupo, eme moczi he foŋ mi ecnehame mocwâc biaŋkerâ ʒika qaqare sâc mi ewec.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Manakic, no Aigita ŋicwofuŋ e râsi ecnehuc meticne moc sanaŋne â moc herickekicne i mâmâc jaha qazuc‐jofape ʒika beheocmu.
Â Aigita ŋic jaŋe bâtâtiec‐jopape mâreŋ sâc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko siŋsaŋ qarâ juniŋmu.
No Babe ŋicwofuŋ tâpiri râecnehuc ʒika‐nane meticnao râepemu; Farao e ine mejahec‐ticne qazuc‐jofape Babe ŋicwofuŋte maio ŋic ʒâpâ jopakicne jaŋe iŋucne kio huse ezejec.
No Babe ŋicwofuŋ mejahec‐ticne basanaŋkehape Farao mejahec‐ticne ɋaŋanicmu, eme no Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ. Eme no ʒika‐nane Babe ŋicwofuŋ ere meo râepe eki Aigita mâreŋ râsi ecnehuc imackezejec.
Ehame no Aigita jaŋe bâtâtiec‐jopape mâreŋ sâc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko siŋsaŋ qarâ junʒepieŋ. Iŋuc fua‐jareme no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Jara namba 11 irec mosa 3 â irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa wâŋ eha Wofuŋte dâŋ norao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Farao â ŋic gurufâc‐ticne jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazazemec: “Mozi ŋicwofuŋ jujugere sâc bâfuakac?
Manakic, no Lebanoŋte jâmâzâc jâcko sâc hecgupe; jâc e tieŋ taeŋ sâkoneheczi nâkumucnehec, e ʒoric kikiŋne jâmbâŋ, â botâŋnezi karorac heuakac.
Opâzi bâgunuckeha jâc i mâreŋ opânehec fowecte boc ʒorawec, opâzi jâc domawec mâreŋ i sâcke‐fârewec, ehame jâc gâcne doma rambiŋ jaŋerao opâ afecne sawa rawec.
Iŋuc ecnekicnere jâc sasawa siric‐jopa‐fârerâ fewec; opâ bocjaha fowecko domawecte tieŋ taeŋne ʒorahuc ŋedâmârewec.
Ehame sawa wipe sasawa jaŋe tieŋ taeŋnao sareŋ‐jeŋic râe‐fârembiŋ; â kâte qowi jaŋe rurumaŋnao fua sawec embiŋ; ehame ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe mumucnao ŋec juc embiŋ.
Gâtâne opâmaŋko fowecte tieŋ taeŋne soka biaŋ eha jâcsâko erâ domawec.
Anuture jufu Edeŋko jâmâzâc gâcne doma rambiŋ jaŋe ere sâc sâcne mi bâfuambiŋ, â wetejâc tieŋ taeŋne jaŋe ere sâc wâc aricne; marojâc gâcne jaŋe tieŋ taeŋ‐ticnere sâc mi bâfuambiŋ â Anuture jufuo jâc izi me izi hawari biaŋ iŋucne wâc mi embiŋ.
No tieŋ taeŋ bocjaha bâfuacnepe hawari biaŋ ewec, ehame Anuture jufuo jâc doma rambiŋ jaŋe liŋguuŋ ecnembiŋ.”
Irec Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Jâc e boc ʒorawecte botâŋnezi karorac heuawec, erâ e boc ʒora‐jâmbâŋkewecte maŋfefe bâfuawec.
Eme no irec hâcne mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋere ŋic fekicne moc ere meo râepe feocmu, eme eki sindaŋ‐ticnere sâcko wiac ecneocmu. No biac tuŋkepo hâcne.
Ŋicguru furune â repic qapicne jaŋe jâc i hetâc qâtâcnerâ behepie foocmu. Tikio mecne â wâneŋko mecne tieŋ taeŋne waha‐fârerâ hericke ʒaŋ ehuc mâreŋ opânehecko foraocmu; ehame mâreŋ sâc irecnec ŋic jaŋe nâkumuc‐ticne beherâ wise‐fâreniŋmu.
Eme sawa wipe jaŋe qâŋɋâŋnao waha herâ ŋeniŋmu, â kâte qowi jaŋe tieŋ taeŋnere maŋnao ŋec foc eniŋmu.
Mâsi i jâc izi me izi opâ heririŋko domahuc soka ʒora enʒipiŋte me botâŋ‐jeŋiczi karorac heuanʒipiŋte fuawec, erâ jâc gâcne jaŋe opâzi bâgunuc‐jopame jaŋere sâc jaha enʒipiŋte mâsi i fuawec. Jaŋe hâmocte biŋe efâreniŋte mukicne hâcne, eme ŋic hâmorâ nombâŋko humbiŋ jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ huniŋmu.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Hâmoc haeo huocmu dameŋ ira mâreŋmaŋko opâ fokac i ecnepe ʒicke kereŋ ezejec, erâ opâ sâko aka hejarepe kereŋke‐fârenʒepieŋ. Eme Lebanoŋ tiki mâreŋ i hahaŋke‐fâreha jâc wiac‐ticne hâmo ururuc efâreocmu.
Eme jâc i gâcne jaŋe hâmorâ hâmoc haeo humbiŋ jaŋerao tuŋkepe hume ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe fânâŋ‐ticnere fâfâreniŋmu. Iŋuc fuame jâc wiac biaŋne gâcne Edeŋ jufuo opâ heririŋko domaku gârecke ʒaŋ embiŋ jaŋe honerâ âke mâteŋ‐jopaocmu.
Jei, nâkumuc‐ticnao ŋec juc embiŋ jaŋe hâmo sipiric ehuc ehec mâmâc ʒikazi jopakicne jaŋerao hâmoc haeo huniŋmu.
O Farao, go tâpiri â ʒâŋe biŋegehec, go Edeŋ jufuo jâc doma rambiŋ jaŋeraonec jâc wenimoihec sâc hecgupe? Go Edeŋ jufuonec jâc jaŋehec hâmoc haeo huzemec: Go sahac‐jeŋicko ma mi bakicne, erâ ʒikazi jopakicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko hurâ fozemec. “Farao â ŋic gurufâc‐ticne jaŋe wiac iŋuc hâcne fua‐jarezejec. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Jara namba 12 irec mosa 12 jaha â irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa wâŋ ira Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Farao ere makuc gae moc ʒiŋuc hefuazemec: No ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko laioŋ iŋucne jukopac, gahacne iŋuc muekiczi laioŋ mâcne, hâwecko oâ juekac iŋucne juekic. Ehuc hâwec ficne sueekic, â opâ masirickeekic â kikegezi âtetec opâ sohoŋ eekac.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac: No ŋic gurune gurune ejarepe wasaŋ‐nane behe‐garepie wasaŋko jowatec fârecgupe tiŋko wefucmu.
Eme no mâreŋko behecgupe, tomao fohaŋtec sawa wipe jaŋe gore faio herâ ŋeniŋmu, â mâreŋne mâreŋne irec kâte qowi jaŋe fisirâ nâcguku gapec‐jopaocmu.
No tiki mâreŋko biucge râe rapemu, â biucge bânâŋkerâ âsu fikac i wâneŋko behepe fusucmaocmu.
No socge hoŋkepe mâreŋ ruacne‐fâre raku tiki mâreŋko taraocmu, ehame opâ jaŋe soc sasawa efâreniŋmu.
No bâsirowecguhuc sawa qânikiŋ sâockepe bâpiŋ jaŋe gâpâreniŋmu, ehame mupe karoraczi ʒoaŋ bâsoŋkeocmu, â mosa tatamac‐ticne omaeocmu.
No sambâŋ tatamac sasawa bârâriehuc dapâc bâfua‐garepemu, ehame gore mâreŋko dapâc qisiric fuarâ foocmu. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Eme no ŋicfâcge jaŋehec mâreŋ furune mi mamana‐ŋeŋicko kâpâcwâruo bacŋopa rape ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe ŋoŋere biŋe manarâ busâqoc eniŋmu.
No jaŋere ʒâŋe faio ʒika‐nane fotariepe ŋic bocjaha jaŋe gore erâ bipic tatara ejarezejec â ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe gore erâ hâwic‐jopazejec. Jaŋe waha guocmu ʒoaŋ ira ru sâc juju‐jeŋicte manasuhuc ɋarac ɋarac qanʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac hâcne: “Babe ŋicwofuŋte ʒikazi gore faio fezejec.
Noni mupe ŋic qac momori â repic qapicne jaŋere ʒikazi ŋic guru sâkofâcge omaec‐jopaocmu. “Jaŋe Aigita mâreŋte ʒâŋe biŋe bawahapie ŋicfâc‐ticne guru sâko sipiricke‐fâreniŋmu.
No qowifâc‐jeŋic opâ heririŋko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârepe ŋic mecne qowi mecne opâ âtepie sohoŋ mocwâc mi ezejec.
Eme no mupe sohoŋ omaeme opâzi ɋaɋackerâ wokemaŋ iŋucne fâre fâsâerâ rahuc foocmu. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
No Aigita mâreŋ ima bape niniŋ siarereŋ fua‐fâreocmu â ŋecjucfâc‐ticne qâhâmoc‐jopa‐fârepe no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu.
Gae ʒizi makuc gae eme henʒepieŋ, ŋicne ŋicne ŋokacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe hâcne henʒepieŋ; jaŋe Aigita mâreŋ â ŋicfâc‐ticne guru sâko irec erâ maku ehuc gae i henʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Jara namba 12 irec mosa wâŋ â irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 15 eha Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Aigita mâreŋ ŋicfâc‐ticne guru sâko jaŋere erâ ki busâqoc ec, ehuc e jahacne mecne â ŋicne ŋicne ʒâŋe biŋe sâkohec jaŋere ŋokacfâc mecne mâmâc tuŋjopatec ŋic nombâŋko humbiŋ jaŋerao hunʒepieŋ wâc.
‘Me ŋoŋe ŋic weni jaŋe siric‐jopahuc hawari biaŋ juŋgopieŋ? Aricne, ŋoŋe hujâmbâŋkeniŋ, erâ sahac‐jeŋicko ma mi bakicne jaŋehec foniŋ.’
Ʒikazi jopa qâhâmoc ejarewec jaŋere ŋondeŋko waha jopazejec, ehame ŋicfâc‐ticne guru sâko jaŋe mâmâc waha jopazejec.
Ŋic qac momori jaŋe hâmoc haeo juhuc Aigita ŋic â babaficfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Sahac‐jeŋicko ma mi bakicne â ʒikazi jopa sipiric ejarekicne jaŋe waharâ qiriŋmâc foraŋgopieŋ.’
“Asiria ŋicwofuŋ â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe ʒikao hâmo sipiric efârerâ ira humbiŋ wâc, ʒâŋeruŋ‐jeŋic ira hâcne forakac.
Ʒâŋeruŋ‐jeŋic i nombâŋ tuturuŋnao râe rakicnere ira foraŋgopieŋ. Ŋicfâcne jaŋere ʒâŋeruŋzi e jahacne ʒâŋeruŋ râreckehuc forakac hâcne. Asiria ŋic jaŋe mârâc jaha mâreŋko juhuc ʒârâ ʒâpâ bâfuambiŋ, ʒi ine ʒikazi jopa‐fâreme hâmombiŋ.
“Elam ŋicwofuŋ e ira fokac wâc, ehame ŋicfâc‐ticne guru sâko jaŋere ʒâŋeruŋzi ere ʒâŋeruŋ râreckehuc forakac. Jaŋe ʒikao hâmo‐fârembiŋ, ehuc ŋic ma tâmiric hâmoc haeo hufârembiŋ. Jaŋe mâreŋko juhuc wiac hâhâwicne bâfuambiŋzi hâmokicne jaŋehec mimi busâqoc eŋgopieŋ.
Ŋicwofuŋ e ŋic gurufâc‐ticne jaŋehec ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopakicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko râec‐jopakicne, ehame jaŋere ʒâŋeruŋzi ere ʒâŋeruŋ râreckehuc forakac. Jaŋe ma tâmiriczi ʒikare biŋe efârembiŋ hâcne. Jaŋe mâreŋko juhuc wiac hâhâwicne bâfuambiŋzi hâmokicne jaŋehec mimi busâqoc eŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe qâhâmoc‐jopakicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko râec‐jopakicne hâcne.
“Meseke â Tubali erâ ŋicfâc‐jekic guru sâko jaŋe ira mâmâc foŋgopieŋ, ehame ʒâŋeruŋ‐jeŋiczi jaŋere ʒâŋeruŋ râreckehuc forakac. Jaŋe ma tâmiriczi mâreŋko juhuc wiac hâhâwicne bâfuambiŋte ʒikare biŋe efârembiŋ.
Jaŋe ŋic qac momorihec mârâc jaha juku hâmombiŋ jaŋehec mi foŋgopieŋ. Ŋic qac momorihec jaŋe ʒikare wiac‐jeŋichec hâmorâ hâmoc haeo hupie ʒika‐jeŋiczi roŋgâŋ‐jeŋic eha maro‐jeŋiczi rurufa‐jeŋic ewec. Jaŋe mâreŋko qac momorihec jumbiŋte ŋic jaŋe boc hâwic‐jopa jujec.
Farao goki ine ŋic qac momorihec jaŋerao mâcne, go ma tâmiric juhuc ʒikao hâmo sipiric ekicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko hurâ fozemec.
“Edom mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ â fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe ira mâmâc foŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe tâpirihec jumbiŋ, erâ sifu ŋic ʒikare nânâ embiŋ jaŋerao ʒuhuc‐jopakicne. Irec ŋic ma tâmiric jumbiŋ â mârâc jaha nombâŋko humbiŋ jaŋehec hurâ foŋgopieŋ.
“Faic mâreŋkonec ŋic fekicne â Sidoŋ haere ŋic jaŋe sasawa ira foŋgopieŋ wâc. Jaŋe tâpiri sâkohec juhuc wiac hâhâwicne bâfuambiŋzi sifu qurutuarâ ʒikare nânâ embiŋ jaŋehec sipirickembiŋ. Jaŋe ʒikao hâmombiŋ jaŋehec ma tâmiric foŋgopieŋ, erâ nombâŋko humbiŋ jaŋehec mimi busâqoc bâfuaŋgopieŋ.
“Iŋuc fua‐jare‐fâreme Faraozi honerâ maŋticne fâre wahaocmu. Farao â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe ʒikare nânâ efârembiŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Farao e mâreŋko juhuc ʒârâ ʒâpâ bâfuawec, irec e jahacne mecne â ŋicfâc‐ticne guru sâko jaŋe mecne mâmâc ŋic ma tâmiric ʒikao hâmo sipiric ekicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko hurâ fofârenʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go ŋicfâcge jaŋe dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc jazac: No mâreŋ mocko ʒika bâfuape mâreŋ rune jaŋe jaŋacnaonec ŋic moc bâwosâerâ ruc bapa ŋic‐jeŋic âkendâŋneniŋmu.
Eme ruc bapa ŋic e râsi jaŋe fisipie honec‐joparâ qeŋ ficnehuc ŋic ŋokac uŋ sawaŋ ejareocmu.
Iŋuc ejareme ŋic moczi qeŋfânâŋ manarâ ruc mi bahame ʒikazi fisirâ qa imac ecneme socticnere kiŋzi e jahacne faio feocmu.
E qeŋfânâŋ mana‐bipiehuc ruc mi bawecte socticnere kiŋzi e jahacne biŋe eocmu hâcne. Moc e ine qeŋfânâŋ manarâ ruc baocmuzi juju‐ticne ŋezickeocmu.
Me ruc bapa ŋic e râsi jaŋe fisipie honec‐joparâ qeŋ qahuc ŋic ŋokac uŋ sawaŋ mi ejareha ʒikazi ŋic moc qa imac ecneocmuo ine ŋic e sâqocne‐ticnere hâmoocmu, socticnere kiŋ ine ruc bapa ŋic ere faio râepe feocmu.
“O ŋicte ɋâric go manac, no Israe kikefuŋ jaŋere ruc bapa ŋic râecgukopac; irec go nore mickonec dâŋ manacmu sâc nore micte erâ hazec qâuŋ jazahuc juzemec.
No ŋic hehesicne ʒiŋuc âzâcnepemu: ‘Go hâmo‐jâmbâŋkecmu,’ dâŋ iŋuc âzâcnepe go uŋdâŋ mi âzâcnecmuo â hata‐ticne hehesicnaonec risierâ juju‐ticne asao roocte mi esockecmuo ine ŋic e sâqocne‐ticnehec hâmome ere kiŋzi gore faio feocmu.
Mâc ŋic hehesicne e uŋ sawaŋ ecne‐bipiehaŋ sifu hata‐ticne hehesicne â sindaŋ‐ticne mi beherâ juku sâqocne‐ticnere okacne hâmoocmu, goki ine jujuge asao rokomecte jucmu.
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Israe kikefuŋ ʒiŋuc jazac: Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc hâcne mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Qaqatara â hehesic‐nâŋeczi bâmâc‐nâpoekacte irec erâ hâmo sipiric eeŋgopeneŋ, irec weniŋuc sâcne junaŋmu?’
Irec ʒiŋuc jazac: Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac: No jujâmbâŋkekopacte ŋic hehesicne jaŋe hâmopie boc mi aŋacnuekac, aricne, jaŋe hata‐jeŋic sâqocne beherâ juniŋte enareekac. Irec Israe kikefuŋ, go hata sâqocne beherâ risiec, go wemocte hâmozo mukomec?
O ŋicte ɋâric, go ŋicfâcge ʒiŋuc jazac: Ŋic tiŋnezi hehesic bâfuame tiŋne juju‐ticnezi mi ŋezickeocmu. Ehame ŋic hehesicnezi hehesic‐ticne beheme hehesic juju‐ticnezi mi bawahaocmu. Ŋic tiŋnezi sâqocne baocmu ine juwicnao tiŋne juwec juju izi mi bafickeocmu.
No ŋic tiŋne ʒiŋuc âzâcnepemu: ‘Go jujâmbâŋkezemec,’ iŋuc âzâcnepe tiŋne juju‐ticnao roweckehuc sâqocne baocmuo ine eebapa‐ticne tiŋne i mocwâc mi manasuzo, aricne, e sâqocne bawec irec erâ hâmozejec.
Ŋifec ine ŋic hehesicne ʒiŋuc âzâcnepemu: ‘Go hâmo‐jâmbâŋkezemec.’ Iŋuc âzâcnehape sâqocne‐ticne beherâ eebapa biaŋne â tiŋne bâfuaocmu,
ehuc wiac kifac râcnekicne i mecne â wiac fiuc rowec i mâmâc bârisierâ sâcmutâc dâŋte sâcko juhuc hehesic mi bâfuaocmu e mi hâhâmo jujâmbâŋkeocmu.
Ehame sâqocne bawec i mocwâc mi manasuzo. E sâcmutâc dâŋte sâcko wiac‐ticne ebac ewecte jujâmbâŋkeocmu hâcne.
“Ŋicfâcge jaŋe ine wiac tiŋne ebac mi ehuc ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Wofuŋzi wiac tiŋne ebac mi eekac.’
Ŋic tiŋnezi hata tiŋne beherâ hehesic bâfuaocmuo irec erâ hâmoocmu.
Me ŋic hehesicnezi hata hehesicne beherâ sâcmutâc dâŋte sâcko juhuc wiac tiŋne ebac eocmu e ine irec erâ juocmu.
Ŋoŋe ine mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Wofuŋzi wiac tiŋne ebac mi eekac.’ O Israe kikefuŋ, no ru sâc juju bapa‐ŋeŋicte sâcko dâŋ mutara‐ŋarepemu hâcne.”
Nâŋe kâpâcwâru ficko ŋehuc juhapene jara 12 â mosa 10 erâ ʒoaŋ gie bapa 5 ehame ŋic moc Jerusalem haeonec wisekicnezi norao warerâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Râsi jaŋe hae biac ro rauc embiŋ.”
Ŋic e mi fisihame Wofuŋzi ŋafeo basanaŋnuhuc micnane baafeckeme mocwâc dâŋ dâŋ epo. Izi hae fureme ŋic e fisiha dâŋehuc nâŋguŋne mocwâc mi jupo.
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, Israe mâreŋ ima bakicne ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Abraham e ŋic mocjahazi mâreŋ ro rauc efârewec, nâŋe ine ŋic bocjaha irec mâreŋ i rauckenaŋte mana‐nârekicne.’
Irec hâcne ʒiŋuc jazac: Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe qowi socnehec nâeŋgopieŋ, ehuc ɋâŋ qâqâtâcfâc‐ŋeŋic honec‐jopahuc araŋ bajareeŋgopieŋ, ehuc soc hoŋkeeŋgopieŋ. Ŋic iŋucnezi mâreŋ rauckezo mupie sâckeocmu me?
Ŋoŋe ʒika‐ŋeŋicte manapie tâpiri‐ŋeŋic eha wiac mamakâcne ebac eeŋgopieŋ, ehuc ŋoŋe ru sâc âgofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere ŋokac bâsâqorec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ. Ŋoŋe ŋic iŋucnezi mâreŋ rauckezo mupie sâckeocmu me?
Irec ʒiŋuc jazac: Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: No jujâmbâŋkekopacte mâreŋ ima bakicnao jueŋgopieŋzi ʒikare biŋe enʒepieŋ, ehame mâreŋ rambaŋko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe kâte qowi jaŋerao behec‐jopape ɋâcjopanʒepieŋ â ficsanaŋko â qânâ hawecko jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe huc mimicne fua‐jareme sipirickenʒepieŋ.
Eme no mâreŋ ima bape niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fozejec. Ehame ʒai ʒonʒoŋ‐ticne omaezejec. Eme Israe tiki mâreŋko ima fuarâ foha ŋiczi sicne fotâc mocwâc mi enʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe wiac mamakâcne ebac embiŋte mâreŋ‐jeŋic ima samaki bape, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taraniŋmu.
“Ŋicte ɋâric, manakic, ŋicfâcge jaŋe qânâsac heririŋ me ficmotâc sâc doma rahuc jaŋe jaŋackoaŋ gore dâŋ ʒiŋuc muc manac eeŋgopieŋ: ‘Ajoc, warepie Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ ware fisikac irec fuŋne mananaŋ!’
Eme jaŋe ŋicmanac hawari fisirâ gore maŋfuŋko nore ŋicfâc jaŋere hawari erâ ŋeeŋgopieŋ, ehuc dâŋ muekic sâc mamana i manaeŋgopieŋ, mâc rereŋke ine mi eeŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe micjeŋiczi ‘Dâŋ biaŋne mukomec,’ iŋuc muhuc maŋjeŋic moneŋ mafa wiac ira râepie foekac.
Jaŋe gore manapie gae mânec biaŋne woŋgâŋge qasarickehuc marac furuo hefuakic eekac. Jaŋe dâŋ muekic sâc mamana i manaeŋgopieŋ, rereŋke ine mi eeŋgopieŋ.
Mâc wiac fuaocte mukicne i juku fua‐jâmbâŋkeme ʒiŋuc mana taraniŋmu: Jâmbomac, ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko porofete moc juwec.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Israe lama soŋaŋ jaŋere okacdâŋ muzemec. Ehuc ʒiŋuc muzemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Jei, Israe lama soŋaŋ ŋoŋe lama nânâ gumec‐jopaniŋte muŋarekicnezi mi ŋaŋac gugumec enʒepieŋ i!
Ŋoŋe hâcne susure wokemaŋ nâhuc ŋaqi lama kanʒaŋzi bakicne i rojueŋgopieŋ, erâ qowi wokemaŋ sâkohec hezu nâc eeŋgopieŋ, ehuc lamafâc‐ŋeŋic ine nânâ mi gumec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Lama betaŋkekicne jaŋe mi bafic‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, huchec jaŋe mi bâpiaŋ‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, puriŋne jaŋe he foŋ mi ejareeŋgopieŋ, qâsoriekicne jaŋe mi bârisiec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ â sifuckekicne jaŋe mi basac‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, aricne, ŋoŋe ʒocne mâsâcne ejarehuc fejarembiŋ.
Lama soŋaŋ arictacte lama jaŋe siŋsaŋ qafârembiŋ, ehuc kâte qowi jaŋere nânâ embiŋ.
Lamafâc‐nane jaŋe siŋsaŋ qahuc tiki mâreŋko tikine tikine fotâcne qâqâwiric rambiŋ; jaŋe mâreŋ sâc siŋsaŋ sirec perec qahuc juhapie ŋic moczi wira basac moc mi ejarewec.
“Irec lama soŋaŋ ŋoŋe Wofuŋ no dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukopac i mananiŋ:
Wofuŋ Anutu no jujâmbâŋkehuc ʒiŋuc mukopac: Lama soŋaŋ arictacte lamafâc‐nane sisipiricte biŋe ehuc kâte qowi jaŋere nânâ embiŋ; ehame lama soŋaŋfâc‐nane jaŋe lamafâc‐nane wira basac ejarerâ nânâ mi gugumec‐jopa jaŋaczia gugumec embiŋ.
Irec lama soŋaŋ ŋoŋe Wofuŋ nore dâŋ mananʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Manaŋgopieŋ, no lama soŋaŋ râsi eŋarehuc lamafâc‐nane meŋeŋickonec rocjopapemu, ehuc aka râe‐ŋarepe lama nânâ mocwâc mi gumec‐jopanʒepieŋ, me ŋoŋe ŋaŋac wâc iŋuc jaha gugumec mocwâc mi enʒepieŋ. Ehame no lamafâc‐nane soŋaŋ ŋoŋere mickonec batarac‐jopape mocwâc mi nâcjopanʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Manaŋgopieŋ, ʒi no nahac lamafâc‐nane wira basac ejarehuc hone manac ejarepemu.
Soŋaŋ biaŋne moczi lamafâc‐ticne siŋsaŋ qapie wira basac ejareekac irec sâc no lamafâc‐nane sisipiric me ʒika dameŋko mâreŋ sâc bâtâtiec‐jopapie siŋsaŋ qambiŋ irecnec wira hefârec ejarehuc bârisiec‐jopapemu.
Ehuc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋeraonec â mâreŋne mâreŋne irecnec jowac‐jopa warerâ jaŋacne mâreŋko râec‐jopapemu. Erâ Israe tiki mâreŋko me opâ heririŋko me ŋiczi ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋko ira gume jowac ejarepemu.
No kecɋaŋ geunao râec‐jopape Israe tiki mâreŋko nânâ‐jeŋic bâfuanʒepieŋ, erâ ira fomanahuc nânâ opâ biaŋne nâ gapec enʒepieŋ.
No nahac lamafâc‐nane jaŋere soŋaŋ erâ jupemu, ehuc ejarepe fomananiŋmu, Wofuŋ Anutu no iŋuc mukopac.
No lama sifuckekicne jaŋe wira basac ejarepemu, erâ siŋsaŋ qambiŋ jaŋe bârisiec‐jopapemu, puriŋne ekicne jaŋe he foŋ ejarepemu, betaŋkekicne jaŋe bafic‐jopapemu, â soka sanaŋ ekicne jaŋe hone maiŋ ejarepemu. No soŋaŋ gie fâretiŋ jaha bahuc lama soŋaŋ‐jopapemu hâcne.
“O lama gurufâc‐nane, Wofuŋ Anutu no ŋoŋere manasuhuc ʒiŋuc mukopac: Manaŋgopieŋ, no lama ŋicne â ŋokacne erâ noniŋ ŋicne hone qârâwiŋ eŋarehuc dâŋŋeŋic mutarapemu.
Ŋoŋe kecɋaŋ biaŋne nâhuc mi sâcŋopame kecɋaŋ tiwâne kikezi hofackeeŋgopieŋ me? Â opâ ɋaɋacne nâhuc iŋuc jaha manapie mi sâckeha opâ gâcne kikezi âtepie sohoŋnehec eekac me?
Ehame lamafâc‐nane jaŋe kecɋaŋ hofackekicne â opâ kikezi âtekicne i nâniŋte mueŋgopieŋ me?
“Irec Wofuŋ Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Manaŋgopieŋ, no nahac lama wokemaŋ sâkohec â siec sawa ŋoŋe hone qârâwiŋ eŋarehuc dâŋŋeŋic mutarapemu.
Ŋoŋe gâcne hetuŋ‐jopahuc betaŋkekicne jaŋe ʒuŋe‐ŋeŋiczi hecjopakupie siŋsaŋ qaeŋgopieŋte iŋuc eŋarepemu hâcne.
No lamafâc‐nane ŋezic‐jopape sisipiricte biŋe mocwâc mi enʒepieŋ, no lama ŋoŋe hone qârâwiŋ eŋarehuc dâŋŋeŋic mutarapemu.
Ehuc lamafâc‐nane jaŋere soŋaŋ mocjaha, kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Dawidi hâcne, e âkendâŋnepe gume jowac ejarezejec.
Eme Wofuŋ noni hâcne Anutu‐jeŋic juhape kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Dawidi e ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko micne‐jeŋic erâ juzejec. Wofuŋ no hâcne iŋuc mukopac.
“No jaŋehec wamare ʒâʒâfic moc bâfuahape qowi mimicne jaŋe mâreŋ irecnec râriepie lamafâc‐nane mâreŋ burocnao juhâc qâhâmohuc kâteo ŋec foc enʒepieŋ.
Erâ no jaŋe mecne â tiki‐nane râreckehuc mâreŋ forakac i mâmâc jambuŋkepemu, ehuc hoe sisic i dameŋ‐ticnao mupe hehuc mâreŋ bâgunuckeocmu.
Ehame jâc wiac doma rakac i fâri rarauhec efâreocmu â giegaŋko wiac forakac i qaqa qeqeuhec eocmu; iŋuc fuame jaŋe mâreŋ ira juhâc qâhâmoniŋmu. Eme no kioŋ‐jeŋic hezurâ kiŋaŋ qaqa bacjopambiŋ ŋic i jaŋere meonec batarac‐jopape no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana taranʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere meo mocwâc mi fenʒepieŋ â qowi mimicnezi wâc mi nâcjopanʒepieŋ, jaŋe juhâc qâhâmohapie moczi moc hâhâwic mi hejarezejec.
Eme no giegaŋ‐jeŋic jambuŋkepe mazuc mâriri fuame nânâre hâmo sipiric mocwâc mi enʒepieŋ, â ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe mu âke sisic ejarehuc mocwâc mi bâʒâic‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Eme no Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋiczi jaŋehec juhape jaŋe Israe kikefuŋzi nore ŋicfâc erâ juŋgopieŋ i mana taranʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Ŋoŋe hâcne sacnanere lamafâc erâ juhapie no Anutu‐ŋeŋic jukopac. Wofuŋ Anutu nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ŋicte ɋâric, go Seiri tiki maickehuc okacdâŋ‐ticne muzemec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnezemec: Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac: O Seiri tiki mâreŋ, manakic, no râsi egarehuc ima bacgupe niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fozemec.
No haefâcge ŋeraŋgopieŋ jaŋe sipiric‐jopape sesuctac fuarâ fohapie, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana tarazemec.
Go rârâsi sanaŋ erâ juhuc Israe ŋic jaŋe ʒârâ hâriŋ â bâbâtiŋ dameŋ sâko‐jeŋicko ʒikare meo râec‐jopameŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu no jujâmbâŋkekopacte ʒiŋuc mukopac: Go soc hoŋkehuc kiŋ bâfuameŋte gore soc iŋuc jaha hoŋkeniŋte mukopac. Go ira me ira jucmu sâc socge hoŋkeniŋmu hâcne.
No Seiri tiki mâreŋ imackepe niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ foha ira sicne fotâc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopapemu.
Ehuc tiki mâreŋge i ʒikao hâmombiŋ jaŋere qâŋɋâŋzi hefusepe tikine tikine â wâcne wâcne erâ opâne opâne sâcke‐fârerâ foraniŋmu.
No imacgupe tuhutac sanaŋ fuarâ fohaŋ hae sasawage ira ŋiczi ŋec juc mocwâc mi enʒepieŋ. Iŋuc fua‐gareme, no hâcne Wofuŋ jukopac i mana tarazemec.
“Wofuŋ no Juda â Israe mâreŋko juhape jaha go sifu pepecne ehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc mumeŋ: ‘No ŋicguru i jahe â mâreŋ‐jekic ro rauc ejarepe nore biŋe enʒepieŋ.’
Irec hâcne no Wofuŋ Anutu jujâmbâŋkekopacte ʒiŋuc mukopac: Go kimbeŋ aaricko qaisoc‐jopahuc jumeŋ irec sâc jaha go egarepemu, ehuc dâŋge mutarape fuŋne‐nane mana tarazemec.
Erâ ʒiŋuc mananʒepieŋ wâc: Israe tiki mâreŋte dâŋ ʒiŋuc musâqorembiŋ i Wofuŋ no mana‐fârepo: ‘Tiki mâreŋ i ima bakicnere nâŋere biŋe eocte mana‐nârekicne.’
Ŋoŋe iŋuc muhuc pepecne enarerâ râsi enarehuc fenarepie manapo.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutu no ʒiŋuc mukopac: No ima bacgupe niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fohaŋ mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋe hone gâgâwi egarenʒepieŋ.
