Iŋuc eme ŋicwofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “O Beletesaza, go guŋte me fuŋne mumure maŋge mi ŋemâckezejec.” Mume Beletesaza eki dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “O bomboŋ‐nane, go guŋ manameŋ i qaisocgueŋgopieŋ jaŋerao fârinehec ezac â irec fuŋne i râsifâcge jaŋerao taniŋkezac!
Jâc honemeŋ i sokarâ ʒora feku botâŋnezi sambâŋ âke uwame ŋic mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao jumbiŋ jaŋe honembiŋ.
Erâ rehac‐ticne biaŋne â hândâŋne bocjaha irec ŋic sasawa nânâ bâfua‐jarewec, erâ kâte qowi jaŋe mumuc‐ticnao fomanambiŋ â tieŋnao wipe jaŋe waha herâ ŋembiŋ jâc irec fuŋne kecʒiŋuc:
Jâc i ŋicwofuŋ go hâcne, go hâcne kâcɋene â tâpirihec, ʒâŋe biŋegezi ŋedâmârerâ sambâŋko fisikac â guriŋ bapa giegezi mâreŋ qaŋeŋne sâckekac.
Erâ ŋicwofuŋ go ruc bapa ŋic tirine moczi sambâŋkonec waharâ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mume hone manac emeŋ: ‘Jâc qâfierâ imackezemec, ehuc tucne fuŋgâtânehec ine mâreŋko behetec aeŋ me aeŋ bâbâroŋzi niŋgiŋkerâ basanaŋkeme kecɋaŋ gieo ŋezejec. Ehame maniŋ titikuczi bâŋgumuŋkeha qowi jaŋehec kecɋaŋ nâhuc juhame jara 7 tarazejec.’
O ŋicwofuŋ, dâŋ kecirec fuŋne kecʒiŋuc fokac: I Femicne sâko ere mumupaŋ, i gore erâ fuakac.
Go hâcne ŋicguruonec jâpecgupie kâte qowi jaŋehec ŋeŋe juju ecmu; erâ egarepie bulimakao iŋucne kecɋaŋ nâhuc juhaŋtec maniŋ titikuczi bâŋgumuŋguha jara 7 taraocmu. Iŋuc fuame ʒiŋuc mana taracmu: Femicne sâko e mâreŋ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere Wofuŋ jukac jaha, ehuc uucmaŋ‐jeŋic i ŋic mocte meo râezo murâ râeocmu.
Erâ jâctuc fuŋgâtânehec mâreŋkoa behetec ŋeocte mukicne dâŋ irec fuŋne kecʒiŋuc: Sambâŋ Wofuŋzi wiac sasawa irec guriŋne baekac, go iŋuc mana taracmuo ine uucmaŋzi fogareocmu.
O ŋicwofuŋ, go irec hâcne dâŋnane mana maŋ ehuc juzemec. Go tiŋne juhuc sâqocne qikiŋne behec ezemec â bâʒâic‐jopakicne jaŋe ehâmo‐jarehuc hehesicge râpeckezemec. Go iŋuc ehuc dameŋ ʒora juhâc qâhâmocmu.”
Wiac i sasawa ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza erao fârio qawec.
Juku mosa 12 tarame Babe haeo erific‐ticnere bupu qaqadape bakicne ira rac warec ewec.
Ehuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋicwofuŋ hae sanaŋ‐nane erâ ŋeocte â ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane ferâ foocte tâpiri wânʒâŋ‐nanezi Babe hae sâko bapo ʒiŋe hâcne.”
Ŋicwofuŋ e dâŋ iŋuc muha izia sambâŋkonec dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc fuawec: “O ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza, gore dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukicne: Uucmaŋ i gowac rokicne.
Irec ŋicguruonec jâpecgupie kâte qowi jaŋehec ŋeŋe juju ecmu; erâ egarepie bulimakao iŋucne kecɋaŋ nâhuc juhaŋtec jara 7 taraocmu. Iŋuc fua‐gareme ʒiŋuc mana taracmu: Femicne sâko e mâreŋ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere Wofuŋ jukac jaha, ehuc uucmaŋ‐jeŋic i ŋic mocte meo râezo murâ râeocmu.”
Dâŋ i fuaha izia Nebukanezarao fârinehec ewec. E ŋicguruonec jâpepie bulimakao iŋucne kecɋaŋ nâhuc juwec; ehame maniŋ titikuczi fuame sahac‐ticne bânâŋke‐fâreme qizec susuc‐ticnezi tucwipere suhuc tinac ewec â ʒârâic‐ticnezi wipe jaŋere ʒârâic iŋucne ewec.
Eme dameŋ i tarame Nebukaneza no sambâŋko fipe feme maŋ mamanasu‐nane mocwâc uŋtome Femicne sâko, jujufâre hâcne, e araŋ bacnehuc muteŋ bâteŋ ecnepo. Ere uucmaŋzi hâcne fofo sanaŋ â guriŋ bapa gie‐ticne i mimiŋzi ɋâric foraʒihuc juocmu.
Mâreŋte ŋecjucfâc jaŋe waha qaqane sasawa, irec sambâŋko tâpirihec jueŋgopieŋ me mâreŋko ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe iŋuc me iŋuc ejarezo murâ ejareocmu. Ehame moczi moc qataracnehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc ââzâcnene mi fokac: “Go wemo wiac ekomec?”
Dameŋ ijaha maŋ mamanasu‐nane mocwâc uŋtowec, erâ uucmaŋ‐nanere ʒâŋe biŋe omaezacte ɋuŋɋasaŋ â eri qaraweŋ‐nane mocwâc fuawec wâc. Eme kia sâko â soŋaŋ micnefâc‐nane jaŋe mocwâc maicnumbiŋ. Ehame ŋicwofuŋ gie hefârockerâ bahape tâpiri mocwâc fua‐narewec.
Nebukaneza no irec hâcne sambâŋ Wofuŋ Sâko muteŋkekopac, erâ sâsehuc araŋ bacnekopac; e gie bapa‐ticne sasawa i fârine hâcne â hata‐ticne i tiŋne fokac. Maŋfefehec jueŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe bawahac‐jopaekac.
Ŋicwofuŋ Belesaza e ŋicfâc‐ticne fekicne 1 tauseŋ jaŋere erâ tiwâ bâzi sâko moc qame fisime mai‐jeŋicko waiŋ opâ nâwec.
Erâ waiŋ opâ nâku maŋticne sifuckezo eha, mamac‐ticne Nebukanezazi Jerusalem taha ufuŋkonec râqâc wiac gol â siliwazi bakicne rowec i bawareniŋte muwec. E ŋicwofuŋ e jahacne â fekicnefâc‐ticne â ŋonâŋfâc‐ticne erâ ŋonâŋ ocfâc‐ticne jaŋe râqâc irecnec nâniŋte iŋuc ewec.
Eme râqâc wiac gol â siliwazi bakicne â Jerusalem taha ufuŋkonec, Wofuŋte fickonec hâcne rokicne i bawarembiŋ. Bawarepie ŋicwofuŋ mecne, fekicnefâc‐ticne mecne, ŋonâŋfâc‐ticne â ŋonâŋ ocfâc‐ticne mecne jaŋe mâmâc râqâc irecnec waiŋ nâmbiŋ.
Ehuc nemuɋâŋ gol me siliwa me aeŋ bâbâroŋ me aeŋ jâmbâŋ me jâc me qânâzi ba akic ekicne i muteŋkembiŋ.
Iŋuc ehapie izia mi ŋicmezi fuarâ ŋicwofuŋte ficko lambe dodoma ŋifecnao sâpeo dâŋ qâreŋkezejec i! Qâreŋkehame ŋicwofuŋzi me râpene honewec.
Honerâ weaŋkewec, erâ maŋ kukumbuc ecneme fâfârehuc me kikene ɋarac ɋarac qawec.
Iŋuc fuacneme qaŋgec bapa â Kaldea ŋic â bâpiŋte fuŋne mamana ŋic erao bacjopa raniŋte owa ruruckewec. Eme Babe haeonec mamana ŋic jaŋe fisipie ŋicwofuŋzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Moc e dâŋ keci woserâ fuŋne naza mutâc eocmu e ŋaqi furi sâko hecnepe huocmu, erâ qoqonaŋ golzi bakicne i qonaŋkecnepemu, ehuc mupe nore uucmaŋko guriŋ bapa ŋic namba 3 erâ juocmu.”
Eme ŋicwofuŋte mamana ŋic jaŋe erao rafârembiŋ, ehuc qâreŋ i woserâ irec fuŋne mutâcnecneniŋte ine eipiembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie ŋicwofuŋ Belesaza e maŋ kukumbuc kâcɋene ecneme weaŋkewec. Ehame fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe bipic tatara ejarewec.
Eme ŋokac wofuŋ e ŋicwofuŋte dâŋ manarâ nânâficko raʒirâ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “O ŋicwofuŋ, go dameŋ tâmiric jufezemec, go maŋge mi gâckezejec â mi weaŋkezemec.
Manakic, gore uucmaŋko ŋic moc jukac e nemu tirine jaŋere mamana focnekac. Mamacge juwec dameŋ ira maŋ mamanasu â maŋɋârâŋ erâ mamana sâko i ŋic erao bâfuakicne. Irec mamacge ŋicwofuŋ Nebukaneza eki qaŋgec bapa â fuŋne qaqa â mamana ŋic â bâpiŋte fuŋne mamana ŋic jaŋere micne âkendâŋnewec.
Ŋic e ʒâŋene Danie, erâ ŋicwofuŋzi ʒâŋe‐ticne moc Beletesaza muwec. E guŋte fuŋne â muqâqiŋ dâŋ mutâcneocte â dâŋ ŋemâcne muafeckeocte mamana tara â maŋɋârâŋ erâ maŋ mamanasu focnekac. Irec go Danie wiracnetec warerâ wiac irec fuŋne gaza mutâc ezejec.”
Eme Danie ŋicwofuŋtao jowa warembiŋ. Iŋuc epie ŋicwofuŋzi Danie dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mamac‐nane, ŋicwofuŋ hâcne, eki Judaŋic kâpâcwâru bacjopa warewec jaŋeraonec moc Danie go hâcne.
Eme no gore fuŋne ʒiŋuc mupie manapo: E nemu tirine jaŋeraonec mamana focnekac, erâ maŋ mamanasu â mamana tara â maŋɋârâŋ i wâc focnekac.
Eme ʒi ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec â mamanahec jaŋe qâreŋ keci woserâ fuŋne naza mutâc eniŋte jowac‐jopa warembiŋ, jaŋe ine iŋuc eniŋte eipiembiŋ.
Gore ine ʒiŋuc mupie manapo: Eki wiac irec me irec fuŋne sâcne mutaniŋkeocmu â wiac ŋemâcne irec dâŋ wâc sâcne muafeckeocmu. Irec go qâreŋ keci woserâ fuŋne sâcne naza mutâc ecmuo ine mupe ŋaqi furi sâko hegarepie huocmu â qoqonaŋ golzi bakicne qonaŋke‐gareniŋmu. Eme uucmaŋ‐naneo guriŋ bapa ŋic namba 3 erâ juzemec.”
Iŋuc mume Daniezi ŋicwofuŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Bubiaŋ wiac i fogareoc, me ŋic moc râcnezo murâ râcnec; no ine sifu qâreŋ keci wose‐garerâ fuŋne gaza mutâc epemu.
O ŋicwofuŋ, Anutu Femicne sâkozi mamacge Nebukaneza manacneme sâckehame uucmaŋ‐ticnao tâpiri â ʒâŋe biŋe erâ ɋuŋɋasaŋ sâkohec juwec.
Eme Anutuzi tâpiri sâko râcnewecte ŋic gurune gurune â ŋicne ŋicne erâ dâŋne dâŋne jaŋe ere maio ɋarac ɋarac qahuc hâwic‐jopawec; eki ŋic e me e qazo murâ qawec, me akickezo murâ akickewec, ehuc e me e bafaharezo murâ bafaharewec, me bawahazo murâ bawahawec.
Mâc maŋfefe erâ maŋrâŋgeŋ bâfuahuc penaroŋ eme ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋe‐ticnaonec tuŋkekicne â ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne jâoc rokicne.
E ŋicguruonec jâpekicne â maŋticne i qowimaŋ tinac ewec, erâ kâte doŋgi jaŋehec ŋeŋe juju ewec; e bulimakao iŋucne kecɋaŋ gumembiŋ â maniŋ titikuczi fuame sahac‐ticne bânâŋke‐fârewec. Iŋuc fuacnekume ʒiŋuc mana tarawec: Anutu Femicne sâko e mâreŋ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere Wofuŋ jukac, irec uucmaŋ‐jeŋic i ŋic mocte meo râezo murâ râeocmu.
Eme ŋokâ‐ticne Belesaza goki ine wiac i sasawa mana‐bipiehuc maŋge moc mi bârisiemeŋ.
Aricne, go sambâŋte Anutu penaroŋ ecnehuc ufuŋ‐ticnere râqâc wiac mutec bafisipie go gahacne mecne, fekicnefâcge mecne, ŋonâŋfâcge erâ ŋonâŋ ocfâcge ŋoŋe mâmâc râqâc irecnec waiŋ opâ nâmbiŋ. Erâ i sawa mâcne, go ɋâŋ qâqâtâc maŋ mamanasu tâmiric gol me siliwa me aeŋ bâbâroŋ me aeŋ jâmbâŋ me jâc me qânâzi bakicne jaŋe hâcne muteŋ bâteŋ ejaremeŋ. Juju bâfua‐garehuc hatage sasawa soŋaŋkeekac Anutu e ine araŋ moc mi bacnehuc jumeŋ.
“Eme irec hâcne qâreŋ kecʒi eraonec fuawec.
Sâpeo qâreŋ fuawec ine kecʒiŋuc: ‘Mene, Mene, Teke Ufasiŋ.’
Dâŋ qâreŋ irec fuŋne kecʒiŋuc fokac: Mene irec fuŋne kecʒiŋuc: Anutuzi uucmaŋgere ʒoaŋ gie bapa wose biric erâ bârâriewec.
Teke irec fuŋne ʒiŋuc: Sigelio râecgupie ŋemâcge afecne sawa fuawec.
Ufasiŋ irec fuŋne ʒiŋuc: Uucmaŋge kâdoc qarâ Medeŋic â Perisia ŋic jarekicne.”
Eme Belesazazi mume Danie ŋaqi furi sâko hecnepie huwec â qoqonaŋ moc golzi bakicne qonaŋkecnembiŋ. Ehuc Daniezi ŋicwofuŋte uucmaŋko guriŋ bapa ŋic namba 3 juocte mutâcnecnewec.
Ŋafe ijaha ine Kaldea ŋicwofuŋ Belesaza e qâhâmombiŋ.
Ehame Medeŋic ʒâŋene Dariusi eki jara 62 bazurâ tucticne qawec.
Eme Dariusizi maname sâckeme soŋaŋ micne 120 râec‐jopa rakume uucmaŋ‐ticne sâcke‐fârembiŋ.
Ehame jaŋere guriŋ bapa ŋic jahec â moc ʒuhuckerâ râec‐jopakicne jaŋeraonec moc Danie hâcne. Eme ŋicwofuŋ neneŋ boc ecnenʒipiŋte soŋaŋ micne i jaŋe gie‐jeŋicte binaŋ ŋic jahec â moc jaŋe bajareniŋte jazakicne.
Danie eki ine mamana sâkohec juwecte guriŋ bapa ŋic â soŋaŋ micne siric‐jopa‐fârewec; irec ŋicwofuŋzi uucmaŋ‐ticnere fekicne âkendâŋneocte manasuwec.
Eme guriŋ bapa ŋic â soŋaŋ micne jaŋe Danie gie‐ticnere bâbâsifuc moc bâfuarâ dâŋgieo râeniŋte manasumbiŋ; erâ e gie‐ticne bâbâsifuc tâmiric biaŋne bâhâmowecte bahac‐ticne basambiŋ.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Nâŋâc Danie keci ere dâŋ moc mi bâfuanaŋmu, mâc Anutu‐ticnere sâcmutâc dâŋzi weniŋuc mutâcnecneekac irec fuŋne manahuc bâfuanaŋmu mecne.”
Eme guriŋ bapa ŋic â soŋaŋ micne jaŋe quruŋ herâ ŋicwofuŋtao fisirâ kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “O ŋicwofuŋ Dariusi, jusanaŋkerâ juzemec!
Go mâreŋ sâko qâhâckerâ guriŋne baekic irec maŋnao guriŋ bapa ŋic â soŋaŋ fekicne wahakicne, erâ wâc kansol â dâŋsoŋaŋ juŋgopeneŋ nâŋe sasawa maŋ mocjaha erâ dâŋ moc gazanaŋte wareŋgopeneŋ. Go dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mupaŋkerâ papiao qâreŋketec mumutâc dâŋ ezejec: ‘Ŋafe ʒoaŋ 30 irec maŋnao ŋic moczi wiac mocte numuzo murâ no mi numu‐narehuc nemu moc me ŋic moc numucneocmu e laioŋ jaŋere nombâŋko behepie huzejec.’
Irec ŋicwofuŋ, go mumutâc dâŋ i âkendâŋnerâ gahacne mezi ʒâŋe qâreŋge râetec mi hehetâmirene ezejec, Mede â Perisia ŋic nâŋâcne hata sanaŋ mi qâqâsuane fokac irec sâc hâcne.”
Eme ŋicwofuŋ Dariusi e mumutâc papiao ʒâŋe qâreŋ‐ticne râewec.
Mumutâc papiao ʒâŋe qâreŋ fuame basanaŋkekicne, dâŋ i Daniezi manarâ ficticnao rawec. Ficticne feŋgaŋne moc ira maŋne moc fowec irec qâqâtâc kataŋ Jerusalem haeopec qâtiŋnekicne domawec. Eme e ira ʒoaŋ sâc arec 3 dieŋzi herâ Anutu numucnehuc daŋge âzâcne jujec, irec sâcko ewec.
Danie Anutu‐ticne maickehuc numu wâwâsic ecnehuc juhame ŋic keci jaŋe gasacke rarâ bâfuambiŋ.
Izi ŋicwofuŋtao fisirâ mumutâc dâŋ irec ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnembiŋ: “O ŋicwofuŋ, go mumutâc dâŋ ʒiŋuc râemec: Ŋic moczi ʒoaŋ 30 irec maŋnao wiac mocte numuzo murâ ŋicwofuŋ no mi numu‐narehuc nemu me ŋic moc numucneocmu, eme laioŋ jaŋere nombâŋko behezo. Erâ dâŋ i musanaŋkehuc ʒâŋe qâreŋge mi râemec me?” Mupie ŋicwofuŋzi muwec: “Dâŋ i basanaŋkekicne fokac, Mede â Perisia ŋic nâŋâcne hata sanaŋ mi qâqâsuane irec sâcko basanaŋkekicne.”
Eme jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ: “Juda mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopa warekicne jaŋere guruonec ŋic mac ʒâŋene Danie e ŋicwofuŋ go mana wahacguhuc, ʒâŋe qâreŋge râehuc mumutâc dâŋ basanaŋkemeŋ i mâmâc maname wawahane ekac, ehuc ʒoaŋ sâc arec 3 nunumu gie baekac.”
Ŋicwofuŋ e dâŋ i manarâ bune mâretec sâqorewec. Ehuc Danie sisipirickonec bataraocte mamanasu gie bahuc juhame ʒoaŋ huwec.
Eme ŋic keci jaŋe ŋicwofuŋtao ʒocnehec fisirâ âzâcnembiŋ: “O ŋicwofuŋ, go manac, Mede â Perisia ŋic nâŋâcne hata sanaŋ ʒiŋuc fokac: Ŋicwofuŋzi mumutâc me mumupaŋ dâŋ moc âkendâŋneocmu i hehetâtiene mi fokac.”
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi mume Danie ra ro baware laioŋ jaŋere nombâŋko behepie huwec. Ehame ŋicwofuŋzi Danie ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Anutuge, kiŋaŋ ʒuʒuhuc jaha qacnehuc juekic eki ŋezicguzejec.”
Iŋuc muha qânâ moc qârândiŋkepie ra nombâŋ micne ŋebâzickeme ŋicwofuŋzi sâfâ fitec qambiŋko e jahacne maqâreŋ heutuckeme fowec, moczi moc Danie wiac iŋuc me iŋuc ecnenʒipiŋte.
Ehame ŋicwofuŋzi erific‐ticnao rarâ ŋafeo nânâ mi nâwec, ehuc ŋokacfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec moczi erao fezacte aka hejarewec, erâ guŋte wâc mi ecnewec.
Hae fure pârâckeme izia ŋicwofuŋzi faharerâ laioŋ jaŋere nombâŋko ʒocnehec rawec.
Erâ Danie nombâŋko ŋewec nombâŋ i bâqiŋkehuc busâqoc maracko owa ruruckerâ wiracnehuc muwec: “O Danie, Anutu jujunere kiŋaŋ qaqa, Anutu ʒuʒuhuc jaha kiŋaŋ qacneekic e sâcne ŋezicgume laioŋ jaŋe akicgumbieŋ me?”
Eme Daniezi ŋicwofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “O ŋicwofuŋ, jusanaŋkerâ juzemec!
Anutuzi aŋelo‐ticne soreme warejec; erâ laioŋ micjeŋic bâbâzickeme wiac moc mi enarembieŋ. No honecnume bahacmâc epe iŋuc enarejec. Â ŋicwofuŋ‐nane go wâc wiac hehesicne moc mi egarepo.”
Ŋicwofuŋ e ine bubiaŋ sâko manawec, ehuc Danie nombâŋkonec fârepie wefuocte muwec. Irec fârepie wefuwec hâcne. Ehuc sahacnao ʒâpâ moc mi honembiŋ, i Anutu manasiŋkewecte iŋuc fuawec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi mume Danie dâŋgieo râembiŋ ŋic i jaŋe â ŋokac naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mâmâc rocjoparâ laioŋ jaŋere nombâŋko behec‐jopapie humbiŋ. Eme huha huhapie jaha mi laioŋ jaŋe kisuc qâsuc‐jopahuc siec‐jeŋic kinʒaŋ qanʒaŋne‐fârenʒepieŋ i!
Wiac iŋuc fuame ŋicwofuŋ Dariusizi ŋic gurune gurune â ŋicne ŋicne erâ dâŋne dâŋne mâreŋ sâc jurambiŋ jaŋerao papia moc ʒiŋuc qâreŋkerâ râeme rawec: “Wamazi ŋoŋerao qaja fuserâ fozejec.
No mumupaŋ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc râekopac: Nore uucmaŋko ŋic juraŋgpieŋ jaŋe Danie Anutu‐ticnere hâwic‐jopame araŋ bacnenʒepieŋ. Eki hâcne Anutu jujune, juraʒihuc juzokac; ere uucmaŋ i fofosanaŋ, erâ guriŋ bapa gie‐ticne i tatarane tâmiric.
Danie laioŋ jaŋere tâpirionec batarawec, eki hâcne firuec‐nâpohuc akic‐nâpoekac, e sambâŋko â mâreŋko wiac ʒâŋe furu ehuc mâsi baekac.”
Iŋuc fuame Daniezi Dariusi â Perisia ŋic Kiru jahe ŋicwofuŋ jupic dameŋ ira juhâc qâhâmowec.
Babe ŋicwofuŋ Belesaza e ŋicwofuŋ gie‐ticne bahuc jume jara wâŋ eha Danie e maŋʒâŋe‐ticne tâcneme guŋko wiac hone manac ewec. Ehuc irec dâŋ i qâhâckerâ kecʒiŋuc muhuc qâreŋkewec:
“No maŋʒâŋe‐nane tâcneme guŋko wiac kecʒiŋuc fuame honepo: Sambâŋkonec mâŋâŋ 4 jaŋe sanaŋne qapie hâweczi siri sâko qawec.
Ehame hâwecmaŋkonec qowi sâko 4 wefumbiŋ, hawari‐jeŋic fuŋne fuŋne.
Bâbâni wefuwec e laioŋte hawari iŋucne erâ fakec‐ticnehec, fakec‐ticne ine tucwipere fakec iŋucne. Eme honehape fakec jahec‐ticne unuc‐jofambiŋ, unuc‐jofarâ mâreŋkonec bâfeŋnehuc ecnepie kike jahec‐ticnezi ŋiczi âterâ domaeŋgopeneŋ iŋuc âterâ domahame ŋic mamanasu fuacnewec.
Eme honehape qowi moc wefuwec, qowi namba 2 e beare hawari iŋucne. E ŋifecpeaŋ sawa faharehuc tambaraŋ siec jahec â moc kisoŋnewec. Ehame dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnekicne: ‘Ajoc, go faharerâ biuc bocjaha nâzemec.’
Izi ine qowi moc wefume honepo; e qowi mimicne, ʒâŋene lepad, ere hawari iŋucne. Râpenao wipe fafakec 4 iŋucne focnewec, erâ e qizecne 4 jaha; qowi e tâpiri sâko râcnekicne.
Eme ʒuhuckerâ guŋ manahuc qowi namba 4 wefume honepo. Qowi i ine wiac hâhâwicne, momori â tâpiri sâko‐ticnehec; e micsiec‐ticne i kâcɋene erâ aeŋzi bakicne, e wiac sasawa nâhuc kinʒaŋ qanʒaŋnewec, ehuc tiwâne fome kike‐ticnezi âtenʒaŋnewec. E hawarine qowi bâbâni wefumbiŋ jaŋere hawari iŋucne mâcne, e fuŋmoczi ʒuŋene 10 bajuwec.
Eme no ʒuŋe i hone honehape mi ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ʒuŋe piticne moc wefu fisizejec i! Wefu fisihuc ine ʒuŋe 10 i jaŋeraonec 3 âkesuec‐jopame ŋeunuckerâ wahambiŋ. Erâ ʒiŋuc honepo: Ʒuŋe piticne ʒâŋe hândâŋ focnewec i ŋicʒâŋe iŋucne, erâ micticnaonec penaroŋ dâŋ wahawec.
Eme no honehape eri ŋeŋe wiac hepie ŋeha ŋicqizec jâmbâŋ moczi waha ŋewec; e ŋaqi‐ticne i sinou iŋucne qaŋqaŋ jâmbâŋ; â qizec susuc‐ticne ine kateŋ ɋaɋacne iŋucne. Ʒocuuc erereŋnezi eri ŋeŋe‐ticne ewec, â ŋeŋe‐ticnere ʒafeŋgâŋ i ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne hâcne.
Eme ere maŋfuŋkonec ʒocbâruŋ fuarâ fehuc domawec. Ehame ŋic tauseŋne tauseŋne jaŋe e kiŋaŋ qacnembiŋ, â teŋ tauseŋ gurune gurune jaŋe ere maio domambiŋ; erâ dâŋgie bahuc papia qaratie‐fârepie fowec.
“Eme ʒuŋe e penaroŋ dâŋ mume no ʒuhuckerâ hone dendeŋnepo. Erâ honehape jaha qowi i qâhâmorâ qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne sipirickehuc ʒocko behepie ʒawec.
Qowi gâcne jaŋere tâpiri i wâc jowac rokicne, mâc juju‐jeŋic ine dameŋ mukicne irec sâc bâʒorakicne.
Eme no guŋko wiac moc ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ honepo: Sambâŋ karoracko moczi fisiwec e hawari‐ticne ŋic hawari iŋucne, fisime ŋicqizec erao jowa rambiŋ.
Eme ŋic gurune gurune â ŋicne ŋicne â dâŋne dâŋne jaŋe kiŋaŋ qacneniŋte tâpiri â ʒâŋe biŋe erâ uucmaŋ bâfuacnekicne. Tâpiri‐ticne i sanaŋne â tatarane tâmiric, erâ uucmaŋ‐ticne i ŋiczi moc mi sisipirickene.
“Danie no maŋnane gâckeme guŋko wiac hone manac epo i manasurâ maŋ kukumbuc enarewec.
Irec domambiŋ jaŋeraonec moc maickehuc wiac kecirec fuŋne naza‐jâmbâŋkeocte numucnepo. Numucnepe eki wiac fuawec irec fuŋne mutâcne‐narewec.
Kecʒiŋuc: ‘Qowi sâko 4 i jaŋe mâreŋko ŋicwofuŋ 4 fuarâ juniŋmu irec sâsâcne.
Fekicne sâkore tiriŋicfâc jaŋe ine uucmaŋ i ro rauc erâ ɋaŋɋaŋ ɋâriaŋ juraʒihuc juniŋmu sanaŋ.’
“Iŋuc nazame qowi namba 4 irec fuŋne mana‐jâmbâŋkezore boc enarewec, qowi e âgofâcne jaŋere sâc aricne, e hawari fuŋmoc. E boc hâhâwicne, micsiec‐ticne i aeŋzi bakicne â ʒârâic‐ticne i aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bakicne jaha. E rârec rârec wiac forawec i kinʒaŋne‐fârehuc nâkâcnewec, ehuc tiwâne fome kike‐ticnezi âtenʒaŋnewec.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, no qowi qizecnao ʒuŋe 10 domapie honec‐jopapo, erâ ʒuŋe moc wefu fisihuc ʒuŋe jahec â moc âke suec‐jopame ŋeunuckerâ wahambiŋ, â ʒuŋe i ʒâŋe hândâŋhec, erâ micticnaonec sahac mumuteŋ dâŋ wahawec, eha âgofâcne gâcne siric‐jopawec, irec fuŋne i mâmâc manazore enarewec.
Eme no ʒuhuckerâ honehape ʒuŋe izi tiriŋic jaŋehec qaqac eku sanaŋkewec.
Ehame ŋicqizec jâmbâŋzi fisirâ Femicne sâko tiriŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere dâŋ mutarawec. Eme dameŋ maickeme tiriŋic jaŋe uucmaŋ jare taha ekicne.
“Mârâc dâŋ nazawec ŋic ekizia mocwâc ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Qowi namba 4 irec fuŋne kecʒiŋuc: Mâreŋko uucmaŋ namba 4 fuaocmu, uucmaŋ i ine gâcne jaŋere sâc aricne, i sâc moc, izi mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ bawaharâ ima bahuc âtenʒaŋ qanʒaŋne‐fâreocmu.
Ʒuŋe 10 irec fuŋne kecʒiŋuc: Uucmaŋ kecirec maŋnao ŋicwofuŋ 10 jaha fuarâ juniŋmu, fua‐fârepie ʒâhec moc fuaocmu e gâcne jaŋere sâc aricne, e sâc moc juhuc ŋicwofuŋ jahec â moc bawahac‐jopaocmu.
E Femicne sâko penaroŋ dâŋ âzâcnehuc tiriŋicfâc‐ticne bâʒâic‐jopaocmu, ehuc hombaŋ dameŋ â sâcmutâc dâŋ bârâriehuc moc bâfuaocte manasuocmu. Eme tiriŋic jaŋe ere meo ferâ juhapie jara jahec â moc â nâfocne taraocmu.
Tarame mumutara gie bahuc tâpiri‐ticne bawaharâ e jahacne qapie arictac eocmu.
Eme sambâŋ rurumaŋko uucmaŋ forakac sâc ira tâpiri â guriŋ bapa â fekicne juju fokac i Femicne sâkore tiriŋicfâc jaŋere biŋe eocmu. Eme jaŋere uucmaŋ i tatarane tâmiric forahuc juocmu sanaŋ, ehame guriŋ bapa ŋic gâcne sasawa jaŋe kiŋaŋ qajarehuc micjeŋic reŋkeniŋmu.’
“Wiac hone manac ewarepo irec dâŋ i ʒira hâcne tarakac. Danie no nahacne fuŋne ine ʒiŋuc: Wiac hone manac ewarepo i manasurâ boc mezacnume weaŋkepo. Erâ no sifu wiac i maŋkerâ jukopac.”
Belesaza e ŋicwofuŋ jume jara 3 eha Danie no maŋʒâŋe‐nane ŋerisieme wiac moc honepo; ine bâbâni wiac honepo irec râpenao honepo hâcne.
Wiac kecʒiŋuc honepo: No Elam mâreŋko hae qizec Susa ira juhuc Ulai opâo domapo.
Ehuc fipe rame lama ŋicne moc opâ mecnao domahame honepo. Lama ʒuŋene jajahec, erâ ʒuŋe jahec‐ticne i ʒoricne, moczi ine âgone sirickerâ domawec. Ʒuŋe ʒoricne eki ʒâhec ʒâhec wefu fisiwec.
Eme lama ŋicne e ʒoaŋ huhunaopec mecne faicpec mecne â juwicpec mecne rahuc qowi gâcne hecjopaocte qiqizec qawec, ehame qowi moczi moc mi sanaŋkecnewec, erâ ere tâpirionec wiac moc babatarane mi ewec. E iŋuc me iŋuc ezo murâ ehuc sahac‐ticne muteŋkewec.
Eme no wiac honepo i manasuhuc domahape mi ʒoaŋ huhunaonec noniŋ ŋicne moc mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ fotâcnerâ ware fisizejec i! Ehuc kikezi mâreŋ moc mi âte uawec. Erâ noniŋ e ʒâŋe jahec‐ticnere ŋondeŋko ʒuŋene kâcɋene moc mai jaha domawec.
Eme noniŋ eki lama ʒuŋe jahec‐ticnehec opâmecko domahame honepo erao ʒocnehec gasackerâ rawec.
Eme no honehape lama ŋicne aaric sâko manacnehuc bâqiŋkerâ hehuc lama ʒuŋe jahec‐ticne hezuwec. Ehame lama ŋicnezi sanaŋkecneocte tâpiri basawec. Irec noniŋzi mâreŋko hetuŋkehuc kikenezi wiriŋac hehame moczi moc ere tâpirionec lama babatarane mi ewec.
Eme noniŋ ŋicnezi sahac‐ticne boc bafekume ʒuŋe‐ticne kâcɋene i herickeme dodomatac‐ticnao ʒuŋene 4 wefurâ mâreŋ qaŋeŋne 4 maicke‐fârerâ domambiŋ.
Eme ʒuŋe domambiŋ jaŋeraonec mocte ombâŋko ʒuŋe piticne moc sohoc herâ wefuhuc mâreŋ juwicpec â ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec fokac i mecne erâ mâreŋ biaŋne i mâmâc maic‐jopahuc mâretec sokawec.
Erâ soka feku mi sambâŋ momori jaŋerao fisizejec i! Fisirâ jaŋeraonec gâcne mecne, erâ bâpiŋ jaŋeraonec gâcne mâmâc mâreŋko hetuŋ‐jopame wahapie kikezi âtenʒaŋ‐jopawec.
Jâmbomac, e sambâŋ momori jaŋere micne ere sâc bâfuaocte sahac‐ticne boc bafewec, ehuc ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne taha bâzi rikecne jumbieŋ i sakarecnewec â tiri ufuŋ‐ticnere ŋeŋe hae i ima bawec.
Sambâŋ momori jaŋe ere meo râec‐jopakicne, ehame ʒoaŋ sâc tiwâ bâzi rike jumbieŋ i qatara‐jarehuc mitio tiŋne juju â eebapa i qaisockehuc râsi ecnewec. Ehame gie‐ticnezi soka ŋedâmârec ewec.
Eme no tiriŋic moczi dâŋ mume manapo, ehame tiriŋic âgone moczi dâŋ okacne bâtikiecnewec. Bâbâni dâŋ muwec eki ʒiŋuc muhuc âgone wiocnewec: “Ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne tiwâ bâzi aka hehe â wiac mamakâcne ebac ee erâ tiri ufuŋ â hae mâreŋ biaŋne ima bapa maŋʒâŋezi honeŋgopeneŋ i mo dameŋko moc taraocmu?”
Iŋuc wiocneme âgone dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋafe furec 2 tauseŋ â 300 tarame wiac i taraocmu. Eme irec faicnao tiri ufuŋ mocwâc emasaŋkerâ bâpiaŋkeniŋmu.”
Eme Danie no wiac hone manac epo i mana tarazore ehape mi wiac moc ŋic hawari iŋucnezi nore maio fuarâ domazejec i!
Ehame ŋic moczi Ulai opâ mecnao domahuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc wirahuc mume manapo: “Gabirie, go ŋic keci wiac hone manac ejec irec fuŋne âzâcne mutâc etec mana tarazejec.”
Eme Gabiriezi maŋfuŋnaneo warewec. Wareme hâwicnume ʒâŋe mai‐nanezi mâreŋko hetutuckerâ fopo. Eme eki ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Ŋicte ɋâric, go manac: Wiac hone manac emec i dameŋ tatarare biŋe ekac.”
Eme eki dâŋ nazahame guŋzi qâmâcnume mâreŋko hetutuckerâ fopo. Eki ine wiwicnuhuc bafaharecnume domapo.
Eme ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Manakic, dameŋ bakicne i taraocmu, irec no kimbeŋ dameŋ taraocmu ira wiac fuazokac i gaza mutâc epe.
Lama ŋicne ʒuŋe jahec‐ticnehec honemec i Mede â Perisia jahere ŋicwofuŋ irec sâsâcne.
Noniŋ ŋicnezi ine Grik mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ irec sâsâcne; erâ ʒâŋe hândâŋ jahec‐ticnere ŋondeŋko ʒuŋe kâcɋene moc mai jaha domawec izi ŋicwofuŋ bâbâni fuarâ juocmu irec sâsâcne jaha.
Eme ʒuŋe herickeme okacne ʒuŋe 4 wefumbiŋ jaŋere fuŋne i kecʒiŋuc: Ŋicwofuŋ bâbâni fuarâ juocmu ere uucmaŋzi tâtieme ŋicwofuŋ 4 fuarâ juniŋmu, mâc jaŋe ere tâpirire sâc mi bâfuaniŋmu.
Eme dameŋ‐jeŋic tarazo eha sindaŋ boc ekupie ŋicwofuŋ pepecne â doc bapare fuŋne mamana moczi fuaocmu.
E ŋic tâpiri sâkoheczi sisipiric sâko bâfua raocmu, ehuc wiac i me i ebac ezo murâ moc mi eipieocmu. E ŋic tâpirihec jaŋe mecne â tiri ŋic ŋokac mâmâc sipiric‐jopaocmu.
E eatuc gie baocte dâŋ manasu biric ehuc ʒoɋac eme fârinehec eocmu. Erâ pepec penaroŋ ehuc ŋic bocjaha ututuŋ jaha sipiric‐jopaocmu. Eme juku fekicne jaŋere Femicne e wâc râsi ecneme ŋic tâpirizi mâcne, tâpiri moczi qanʒaŋneocmu.
Ŋafe furec jahere dâŋ mufua‐garekicne i fârine jâmbâŋ, erâ sifu wiac hone manac emeŋ i fuaocte dameŋ ʒoricne fokacte mi mufuazemec.”
Eme Danie no betaŋkerâ ʒoaŋ gâcnao huhucne enarewec; izi âke mâteŋnume faharerâ ŋicwofuŋ kiŋaŋ ʒuhuckerâ qacnepo, ehuc wiac hone manac epo irec ine warecke sâqorerâ fuŋne mi mana tarahuc jupo.
Ahasiwero ŋokâ‐ticne Dariusi e Mede mâreŋko fuakicnezi Kaldea ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ erâ juwec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ gie‐ticne bahuc juhame jara 1 mi taraha Danie no miti papiao dâŋ kecʒiŋuc wosehuc jara dameŋte manatâc qâtâc epo: Wofuŋte dâŋ Jeremiarao ʒiŋuc fuawec: Jerusalem hae tâtierâ jara 70 sesuctac fuarâ foocmu.
Erâ no sowa juhuc mateŋ qonaŋkerâ ʒafe ruahuc Wofuŋ Anutu maickehuc wâsickepo.
Erâ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mutaniŋkehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane numucnepo: “O Wofuŋ, go Anutu kâcɋene â hâhâwicne sâko, go maŋzi ʒâficguhuc sâcmutâc dâŋge mana rereŋ eeŋgopieŋ jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ehuc aki anonoc ejareekic.
Nâŋe sâqocne bahuc hehesic bâfuambeŋ, nâŋe sindaŋ ehuc râpecgumbeŋ, erâ nâŋe sâcmutâc dâŋge huckehuc mumutâc dâŋge behembeŋ.
Ehuc kiŋaŋŋicfâcge, porofete hâcne, jaŋe gore micte erâ ŋicwofuŋ â fekicnefâc‐nâŋec erâ mamacfâc‐nâŋec â mâreŋ‐nâŋecte ŋic ŋokac gâcne sâko dâŋ nâzâhuc juhapie mana rereŋ mi embeŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go tiŋne rune, nâŋe ine mimi busâqoczi fai‐nâŋecko fewec fokac i Judaŋic me Jerusalem hae rune me Israe ŋic sasawa bembeŋko me ʒoricko juŋgopeneŋ nâŋe hehesic ehuc bugao bapene mâreŋ sâc bâtâtiec‐nâpomeŋte iŋuc hâcne fua‐nârewec.
O Wofuŋ, nâŋe wiac hehesicne egarembeŋte mimi busâqoczi nâŋere faio mecne â ŋicwofuŋ â fekicnefâc‐nâŋec erâ wâc mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋere faio mâmâc fewec fokac.
Nâŋe go râpecgumbeŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec gorao ine sifu uruc jauŋ â kiŋ bebehe fokac.
Nâŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec gore dâŋ mana rereŋ mi embeŋ, â kiŋaŋŋicfâcge porofete jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋge mutâcne‐nârembiŋ irec sâcko wâc mi jumbeŋ.
Aricne, Israe ŋic nâŋe mâmâc sasawa sâcmutâc dâŋge huckehuc behembeŋ, ehuc dâŋge mi mamana qikiŋnembeŋ. Irec kiŋaŋŋicge Mose ere sâcmutâc dâŋko sâwecdâŋ qâreŋkekicne fokac i sâqocne bahuc bugao bambeŋte nâŋerao fârio qawec.
Go nâŋe â guriŋ bapafâc‐nâŋec uŋsawaŋ dâŋ nâzâmeŋ i mutec wiac hâhâwicne sâko fuarâ fai‐nâŋecko fehuc fârinehec ewec hâcne. Irec Jerusalem hae wiac fuacnewec wiac iŋucne sâko mâreŋ gâcnao moc mi fua‐jâmbâŋkewec.
Mosere sâcmutâc dâŋko okacnere dâŋ qâreŋkekicne fokac irec sâcko fai‐nâŋecko fewec; nâŋe ine eebapa‐nâŋec sâqocne i beherâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec gore dâŋ fâri qizecne mana rereŋ ehapene honec‐nâpotec biaŋkeocte mamanac moc mi jumbeŋ.
Irec hâcne Wofuŋ, go wiac hâhâwicne mana biric emeŋ i mutec fai‐nâŋecko fewec. O Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec, go wiac ebac eekic i tiŋne sasawa, nâŋe ine dâŋge mana rereŋ mi embeŋ.
O Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec, go ŋicfâcge Aigita mâreŋkonec mesanaŋgezi bacjopa wahameŋ, ehame ʒâŋe biŋege fua taniŋkewec i miŋecgac fokac jaha, nâŋe ine sâqocne bahuc wiac sindaŋne embeŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go bâbâpiaŋ giegere erâ kimbeŋ aaricge Jerusalem haeonec â tiri tikigaonec bârâriezemec. Nâŋe nâŋâcne â mamacfâc‐nâŋec nâŋere hehesicte â kiŋ bahacte erâ ŋic rârec rârec juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe Jerusalem hae mecne â ŋicfâcge nâŋe mâmâc mu ruruc enâreeŋgopieŋ.
O Wofuŋ‐nâŋec, go kiŋaŋŋicgere nunumu â wira wâwâsic i manazemec. O Wofuŋ, tiri ufuŋge sipirickekicne i gahacne biaŋte erâ ʒâŋe maigezi âke tamaezemec.
O Anutu‐nâŋec, go hazec râerâ manac, ehuc ʒâŋe firâ sipiric‐nâpokicne nâŋe mecne â ʒâŋe biŋege fokac hae i mâmâc honec‐nâpozemec. Nâŋe tiŋne juju‐nâŋecte erâ mâcne, buuruc sâkogere erâ wira wâwâsic egareŋgopeneŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go manac. O Wofuŋ, go kiŋnâŋec behec, o Wofuŋ, go hazec râerâ bafic‐nâpoc. O Anutu‐nâŋec, go gahacne biaŋte erâ ŋeŋec ʒeʒepec mi ec! Hae sâkoge â ŋicfâcge nâŋe hâcne gore ʒâŋe bajuŋgopeneŋ.”
No nahacne â Israe ŋicfâc‐nane nâŋere sâqocne mufuahuc iŋuc mupo, ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐nane tiri tiki‐ticnere wira wâwâsic ecnepo hâcne.
Eme nunumu gie bahape jaha, Gabirie mârâc maŋnane ŋerisieme honepo, eki hâcne owa ririŋte taha bapa dameŋko furuc furuc qarâ norao fisiwec.
Fisirâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “O Danie, no maŋɋârâŋ â mamana tara garepemurâ wahakopac.
Manakic, go fuŋkerâ wira wâwâsic ehaŋtec dâŋ moc fua‐narewec, eme no Anutuzi maŋjauŋ egarekacte dâŋ i hâcne gazapemurâ ʒi fua‐garekopac. Irec go dâŋ i manatâc qâtâc erâ wiac hone manac emeŋ irec fuŋne mana tarazemec.
“Ŋicfâcge â tiri haege jaŋere jara dameŋ 490 mukicne i tarame qaqatara â sâqocne erâ sindaŋte aka fuame kiŋjeŋic behe‐jarezo. Eme tiŋne juju fofo sanaŋ fua‐jareme mu bararuŋ â findaŋdâŋzi fârinehec eocmu. Iŋuc fuame tiri ufuŋ wokemaŋ ruacnezo wâc.
Irec ʒi manahuc mana tarac: Jerusalem hae heɋârehuc bâbâpiaŋkere dâŋ fuawec dameŋ irecnec juwefukuhapie jara 49 taraha ŋic fekicne moc wokemaŋ ruacnekicne eki hâcne fuaocmu. Eme irec faicnao ine hae i hata â hae ʒoŋa‐ticnehec bâpiaŋkehuc juhapie jara 434 taraocmu. I dameŋ hâhâwicnere maŋnao iŋuc eniŋmu.
Eme jara 434 tarame wokemaŋ ruacnekicne moc dâŋgie tâmiric kosa qâhâmopie arictac eocmu. Eme ŋic fekicne mocte ŋicfâc jaŋe fisirâ hae â tiri ufuŋ ima baniŋmu. Eha tataranao ʒika â wiac hâhâwicne mukicne izi rumi iŋucne ʒocnehec fisime taraocmu.
Ŋic fekicne eki ine ŋic bocjaha jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic sanaŋ ehapie jara 7 taraocmu. Erâ dameŋ irec maŋnao ine taha bâzi â taha wiac gâcne irec aka heme omaeocmu. Ehame irec okacne ɋâŋ qâqâtâc mamakâcne moc âkendâŋnepie domaocmu. Domakume ine okacne mukicne izi fisirâ sisipiric ŋic ere faio feme taraocmu.”
Kiru e Perisia ŋicwofuŋ jume jara 3 eha Danie, ʒâŋe‐ticne moc Beletesaza mukicne, erao bararuŋ dâŋ moc fuawec. Eme dâŋ i fârine jâmbâŋ erâ wâc wiac hâhâwicnere mukicne. Danie eki ine dâŋ i manarâ irec fuŋne mana tarawec.
Danie no dameŋ ira ki mamakuc ehuc juhape sonda 3 tarawec.
No wiac aaŋacne moc mi nâpo â qowi me waiŋ opâzi micnaneo moc mi huwec, erâ wokemaŋ moc ni rurua juhape sonda 3 tarawec hâcne.
Eme no mosa namba 1 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 24 ira opâ sâko moc ʒâŋene Tigirisi irec mecnao domapo.
Ehuc fipe rame ŋic moc qoruc ʒoranehec domaha honepo, ŋic e gâjoŋnao umbika moc Ufaʒi mâreŋkonec golzi bakicne i rodomawec.
Sahac hawari‐ticne i qânâ furi sâko weweaŋne iŋucne, ʒâŋe mai‐ticne i bâbâric iŋucne, ʒâŋe jahec‐ticne i waha tamaeekac irec sâc, me kike‐ticne i aeŋ bâbâroŋzi bâricneekac irec sâc, â dâŋ marac fânâŋ‐ticne i ŋic guru sâko jaŋere dâŋ marac fânâŋ iŋucne.
Eme Danie no wiac fuawec i bucnane hone manac epo, ŋic nohec jumbiŋ jaŋe ine hone manac mi ehuc mâc ɋarac ɋarac boc qambiŋ, ehuc soŋkezo wisembiŋ.
Wisepie wiac bipic tatarane keci fuawec i buc juhuc hone manac epo; eme sasanaŋ‐nane omaeha ʒâŋe mai‐nane weaŋkeme betaŋke‐jâmbâŋkepo.
Iŋuc fuame no ŋic dâŋ marac fânâŋ‐ticne manapo, ehuc mâreŋko hetutuckerâ hâmocne hawari fopo.
Ehame meticnezi rocnurâ bafaharecnume ɋarac ɋarac qahuc menanezi bâsiŋnehuc dieŋzi herâ ŋepo.
Eme ŋic eki ʒiŋuc nazawec: “O Danie, maŋjauŋ egarekicne, no dâŋ gazakopac i hazec hâric jaha manarâ faharec, no ʒi gorao sorecnukicne hâcne.” Dâŋ iŋuc nazahame manarâ ɋarac ɋarac qahuc faharepo.
Faharepe ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Danie, go mi hâwicguoc, go wiac hone manac emeŋ irec fuŋne mana taracmurâ Anutugere maio maŋhuhuŋ jumeŋte dâŋge fuŋnaonecteaŋ manakicne. Eme no irec hâcne warepo.
Perisia mâreŋte ŋic fekicne eki ʒoaŋ gie bapa 21 râsi enarehuc aka henarewec. Eme Mikae, aŋelo fekicne jaŋeraonec moc hâcne, eki ine baficnuocte fisime behepe Perisia mâreŋte ŋic fekicne ehec juju gie bapic.
No ine ŋicfâcge jaŋe ʒâhec dameŋko wemo wiac fua‐jarezokac irec dâŋ gazape mana taracmurâ warekopac; wiac fuame hone manac emeŋ i ʒâhec dameŋte biŋe hâcne.”
Dâŋ iŋuc nazahame no ʒâŋe mai‐nane mâreŋko hetutuckerâ mumutucne enareme fopo.
Ehame moczi mi ŋic hawari iŋucne fuarâ micbipic‐nane bâuazejec i! Bâuame micnane aŋkerâ mai‐naneo domawec e dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnepo: “O bomboŋ‐nane, no wiac fuame hone manac epo, irec me kike‐nane ɋarac ɋarac qame tâpiri‐nane omaewec.
Eme ʒi bomboŋ‐nanere kiŋaŋŋic no tâpiri â nokafe basahuc bomboŋ‐nane gohec wemocko dâŋ muc manac enacmu?”
Eme ŋic hawari iŋucne fuawec e mocwâc bâuacnuhuc basanaŋnuwec.
Ehuc muwec: “O ŋic maŋjauŋ sâko egarekicne, go mi hâwicguoc; go wamao hâbi hâro juzemec.” E iŋuc nazahame sanaŋkerâ ʒiŋuc mupo: “O bomboŋ‐nane, go basanaŋnumecte dâŋ nazazemec.”
Eme muwec: “No fuŋne weniŋucte gorao warekopac i moc manakic me? Ʒi ine risiepe Perisia mâreŋte fekicne ehec qaqac enacmu; eme e bawaha‐fârepe Grik mâreŋte fekicnezi ware fisiocmu.
No jahe bawahac‐jofazore ŋic moczi moc mi baficnuocmu, aricne, aŋelo fekicne Mikae e mocjahazi baficnuocmu. Qanaŋ ine dâŋ fâri qizecnere papiao dâŋ qâreŋkekicne fokac i gazape manazemec.
“No ine Mede ŋic Dariusi e ŋicwofuŋ jume jara 1 eha faharerâ (Mikae) bafickehuc basanaŋkepo wâc.
“Ʒi dâŋ fârine gaza mutâc epemu. Manakic, Perisia mâreŋko ira ŋicwofuŋ jahec â moc ʒuhuckerâ fuaniŋmu. Eme ŋicwofuŋ namba 4 fuaocmu ere mafa mâriri izi ŋic gâcne jaŋere siricke‐fâreocmu. Eme moneŋ mafa wiac‐ticne bocjaha fuacneme tâpirihec erâ ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe Grik ŋicwofuŋ râsi ecneniŋte qafeŋ‐jopaocmu.
Irec faicnao ine ŋicwofuŋ moc tâpiri sâkohec fuarâ uucmaŋ kâcɋenere guriŋ bapa gie baocmu, ehuc e jahacne maŋte wiac i me i ezo murâ mi quŋkeocmu.
Eme uucmaŋ‐ticne izi fua ɋârâŋkerâ foha qâjâpecfâc‐ticne jaŋe bâfâuckerâ mâreŋ qaŋeŋne 4 ira kâdoc qapie rafâreocmu. Ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋe ine moc mi jarepie rauckeniŋmu. Eki uucmaŋ rauckerâ bajuwec irec sâc qâjâpecfâc‐ticne jaŋe mi bajuniŋmu. Uucmaŋ‐ticne bâfâucke‐jâmbâŋkerâ qâjâpecfâc‐ticne jaŋacne â ŋic gâcne ro rauc eniŋmu.
“Eme juwic mâreŋkonec ŋicwofuŋ e tâpiri sâkohec eocmu, mâc fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec moczi sirickerâ guriŋ bapa gie jaha baocmu, ehame uucmaŋ‐ticne i mâretec fua ɋârâŋkeocmu.
Eme jahe jara wezimuc tarame ʒâʒâfic enicmu, ehame juwic mâreŋkonec ŋicwofuŋ ere otâzi faic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ erao fisime ŋonâŋ‐ticne rome ʒâʒâfic‐jekic i basanaŋkenicmu. Mâc ʒâʒâfic irec fârine biaŋne mi fuarâ foocmu â ɋâricfâc‐jekic jaŋe mâreŋ ira wâc mi jusanaŋkeniŋmu. Aricne, ŋokac mecne, jume jujufâc‐ticne mecne, ɋâric‐ticne mecne erâ ŋowe‐ticne mecne jaŋe mâmâc doc bacjopahuc behec‐jopaniŋmu.
“Dameŋ ira ŋokacte soctofa moczi fuarâ ŋicwofuŋte tuc qaocmu, ehuc faic mâreŋkonec ŋicwofuŋ ere momorifâc râsi ejarehuc hae sanaŋ‐jeŋicko raʒirâ sanaŋkehuc ima bacjopaocmu.
Erâ nemuɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic â râqâc wiac furi sâko gol me siliwazi bakicne, i Aigita mâreŋko barâ raocmu. Ehuc jara gâcnao faic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ ehec rârâsi mi enicmu.
Eme irec faicnao faic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋzi juwic mâreŋko râsi fisirâ juku mocwâc e jahacne mâreŋko risieocmu.
“Eme juku ŋokâfâcne jaŋe ʒika bâiŋnehuc momori guru sâko hetumaŋ‐jopaniŋmu. Ehame jaŋeraonec moczi momorifâcne rocjopame rumi wânʒâŋnehec iŋucne mâreŋ fotâcne raku râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere hae sanaŋko fisiniŋmu.
Iŋuc fuame juwic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ e aaricke sâqoreme fisirâ faic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ ehec qaqac enicmu. Eme faic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ e momori guru sâko hetumaŋ‐jopame sifu juwic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ ere meo fefâreniŋmu.
Fefârepie juwic irec ŋicwofuŋ e penaroŋ ehuc ŋic tauseŋ guru bocjaha qâhâmoc‐jopaocmu. Erâ e sifu sanaŋkerâ mi juocmu.
I faic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ eki mârâc momori guru rocjopawec irec sâc sirickehuc rocjopaocmu hâcne. Erâ juku dameŋ‐ticne maickeme momori guru sâko â ʒikare wiac sasawa‐ticnehec ware fisiocmu.
“Dameŋ ira ŋic bocjahazi faharerâ juwic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ râsi ecneniŋmu. Ehame gahacne guruonec ŋic ʒâʒâicne gâcne jaŋe findaŋdâŋ mocte fârine bâfuaniŋte giene baniŋmu wâc, erâ irec fârine mi bâfuahuc waha jopaocmu.
Eme faic mâreŋkonec ŋicwofuŋzi fisirâ somâ bahuc hae sanaŋ roocmu. Ehame juwic mâreŋkonec momori guru jaŋe sâcne mi sanaŋkecneniŋmu, â momori rowosâec‐jopakicne jaŋe sanaŋkecneniŋte tâpiri basaniŋmu wâc.
Irec juwic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ râsi ecnehuc fisiocmuzi e jahacne maŋte iŋuc me iŋuc ezo murâ eocmu, ehame moczi moc mi sanaŋkecneocmu. E mâreŋ biaŋnao jusanaŋkehuc mâreŋ i furu jaha ro rauc eocmu.
Ehuc juwic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ ere uucmaŋ i wâc ro rauc efâreocte maŋne domaocmu. Ehuc juwic mâreŋ sipirickeocte ŋicwofuŋhec ʒâʒâfic burec burec ehuc otâ‐ticne e ŋonâŋ‐ticne eocte qikiŋnecneocmu. Erâ sifu wiac manasu biric ewec i fârio mi qaocmu.
Eme irec faicnao hâwec heririŋko ŋic juraŋgopieŋ jaŋerao wâc ra fisirâ bocjaha kâpâcwâru bacjopaocmu. Ehame momori micne moczi sanaŋkerâ pepec‐ticne bawahahuc okacne bazucneocmu.
Erâ irec faicnao e jahacne mâreŋte fic hae sanaŋkopec risiezo ehame sisipiriczi maickeme mocwâc mi honeniŋmu.
“Eme ere âkehoc ŋicwofuŋ moc fuaocmu e kia moc soreme ra mâreŋ biaŋ i fotâcnehuc takesi moneŋ roocmu; ŋicwofuŋ eki ine dameŋ bembeŋne sawa juhame tâtâcko qaqac ehuc mâcne, soŋsoŋko kosa qâhâmoniŋmu.
Ere âkehoc ŋic moc behe qaisoc ecnekicne â eri ŋeŋeo ŋeocte mi manacnekicne eki hâcne fua tâcneocmu. E ututuŋ fisirâ ŋic mu bâdoc ejarehuc ŋicwofuŋ gie rauckeocmu.
Eki hâcne râsifâc‐ticne rumi iŋucne fisi‐jarehuc jopa qâhâmoc ejareocmu, ehuc ʒâʒâfic eere ŋic fekicne e sâc ijaha ecneocmu.
Ehuc ʒâʒâfic embiŋ ŋic i jaŋe hâcne dameŋ ira fuŋkerâ eatuc‐jopaocmu, ehuc ŋic afecne rocjoparâ ʒika qahuc sanaŋkeocmu.
Eme ŋiczi mi manahapie ututuŋ jaha mâreŋ biaŋne guec‐ticnehec ira fisirâ mamac ŋosafâcne jaŋe mâsi moc mi embiŋ i hâcne ehuc mafa mateŋ â wiac gâcne fiuckekicne i ŋicfâc‐ticne kâdoc qajareocmu. Ehuc hae basanaŋ‐jopakicne jaŋe imac‐jopaocte irec dâŋ i dameŋ bembeŋne sawa mana biric eocmu.
E tâpirihec erâ hâbi‐ticne rohuc momori guru sâko rocjoparâ juwic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ râsi fisicneocmu. Eme juwic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ e iŋuc jaha momori guru kâcɋene sâko jâmbâŋ rocjopame qaqac eniŋmu. Mâc ŋicfâc‐ticne gâcne jaŋe doc bapie sâcne mi sanaŋkeocmu.
Ehame nânâ nâ gumec ejareocmu jaŋe hâcne eki sipirickeocte giene baniŋmu, erâ râsi jaŋe momorifâc‐ticne jâpec‐jopahuc bocjaha qâhâmoc‐jopaniŋmu.
Ŋicwofuŋ jajahec jahe ine jahackoaŋ eeatuc ehuc mamana gie banicmu, ehuc tebo ijaha ŋehuc burecdâŋ nazaŋ gazaŋ enicmu, mâc dameŋ‐jekic bakicne i biac mi maickeocmure irec fârine wâc biac mi fuaocmu.
Eme faic mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ e mafa mâriri sâkohec mâreŋ‐ticnao risieocmu. Mâc maŋticnezi tiri ʒâʒâfic râsi ecnehuc wiac mana biric ewec irec fârine bâfuarâ mâreŋ‐ticnao risieocmu hâcne.
“Eme juku dameŋ bakicne i maickeme juwic mâreŋ mocwâc râsi fisicneocmu, mâc juwicnao sanaŋke‐jarewec irec sâc mi eocmu.
Kitim mâreŋkonec woke jaŋe râsi fisicnepie hâwickeme risieocmu. Risiehuc aaricke sâqoreme tiri ʒâʒâfic râsi ecneocmu. Erâ risierâ tiri ʒâʒâfic qikiŋnembiŋ ŋic i jaŋere dâŋte hazec rârâe juocmu.
Eme momorifâc‐ticne jaŋe fuarâ taha ufuŋ â ficsanaŋ‐ticne wâwânâŋ ecnehuc ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne taha bâzi rikeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe aka hejareniŋmu, ehuc wiac mamakâcne sisipiric‐ticnehec i âkendâŋnepie domaocmu.
Eme ʒâʒâfic hetâcneniŋmu jaŋe eatuc‐jopahuc bâdoc‐jopame erao qohotaniŋmu, Anuturao qohotaniŋmu jaŋe ine sanaŋkerâ okacne bârisiecneniŋmu.
Guru‐jeŋicko maŋɋârâŋhec juŋgopieŋ jaŋe ŋic bocjaha qazu‐jarepie mamanahec eniŋmu, mâc dameŋ gâcnao ʒikare â ʒocte biŋe eniŋmu me kâpâcwâru bacjopahuc mafa wiac‐jeŋic fiuckeniŋmu.
Waha jopame bafic piticne moc fua‐jareocmu, ehame ŋic bocjahazi eatuc‐jopahuc jaŋerao ʒuhuckeniŋmu.
Eme mamanahec jaŋeraonec gâcne jaŋe dameŋ gâcnao waha jopaocmu wâc, i dameŋ tataranao sanaŋkerâ nanaŋ ʒurec ʒurec jaha domaniŋte iŋuc hâcne fua‐jareocmu. Anutuzi ʒâfo bawec i biac mi maickewec irec iŋuc fuaocmu.
“Eme ŋicwofuŋ e maŋticnere wiac kosa eocmu, ehuc sahac‐ticne bafehuc muteŋkerâ nemu bawahac‐jopa‐fâreocmu. E nemu jaŋere fekicne, Anutu hâcne, ere dâŋ qacne gâpâcne muocmu wâc. Eme iŋuc me iŋuc eme fârine tinac ehame kimbeŋ dameŋ taraocmu, ehame wiac fuaocte mupaŋkekicne i fua taraocmu hâcne.
E mamacfâc‐ticne jaŋere nemu araŋ mi bajareocmu, me ŋokac jaŋere joroc nemu me nemu i me i jaŋe wâc mi sâsec‐jopaocmu, aricne, jaŋe sasawa mana wahac‐jopahuc e jahacnere mocjaha maname fefene eocmu.
E hae sanaŋ sasawa irec nemu mocjaha araŋ bacneocmu, mamacfâc‐ticne kâuc bambiŋ nemu i hâcne gol, siliwa â qânâ furi sâko erâ taha wiac fekicne i râcne tahac eocmu.
Ehuc nemu furune araŋ bajareniŋmu ŋic i jaŋe hâcne hae sanaŋ‐ticne ŋerakac irec soŋaŋ râec‐jopaocmu; erâ e jahacnere manapie feocmu ŋic i jaŋe bafaharec‐jopahuc ŋic bocjaha soŋaŋ‐jopaniŋte âkendâŋ‐jopaocmu, ehuc furire erâ mâreŋ kâdoc qajareocmu.
“Dameŋ tataranao juwic mâreŋkonec ŋicwofuŋzi râsi ecneocmu. Faic mâreŋkonec ŋicwofuŋ eki ine mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋ qaekac irec sâc keretac â becâsicko rara ŋic erâ woke wiachec fisicneocmu. Ehuc rumi iŋucne mâreŋ dâkâne dâkâne fotâcne rahuc sâcke‐fâreocmu.
Erâ mâreŋ biaŋnao wâc fisiocmu, ehame ŋic 10 tauseŋ gurune gurune jaŋe hâmoniŋmu. Ŋic kecʒiŋuc jaŋe ine ere meonec batarac‐jopazo: Edom â Moabi erâ Amoŋŋic nâfocne jaŋe hâcne.
E meticne sicnehuc mâreŋne mâreŋne râsi ejare raku Aigita mâreŋ wâc mâmâc ecneocmu.
E Aigita mâreŋte gol â siliwa â mafa wiac gâcne furi sâko i mâmâc raucke‐fâreocmu; ehame Libia â Etiopia ŋic jaŋe e bâjâpeniŋmu.
Mâc ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec â faic mâreŋkonec biŋe bâroŋ gâcne fisime mana fâfârerâ kimbeŋ aaric sâko manahuc ŋic bocjaha jopa sipiric ehuc bâsirowec‐jopaocte fahare raocmu.
Ehuc ŋicwofuŋ qoruc boze‐ticne i hâwec â tiri tiki biaŋne ŋondeŋ‐jekicko fâreme ŋeocmu, ehame moczi moc mi bafickehapie hâmoocmu.
“Dameŋ ira aŋelo micne sâko Mikae e Israe ŋic âgofâcge ŋezic‐jopaekaczi fua tâcneocmu. Ehame ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋ fuaocmu dameŋ iŋucne i ŋic fua wefumbiŋkonecteaŋ moc mi fuarâ fowec. Ŋicfâcge ʒâŋe‐jeŋic juju sanaŋte papiao qâreŋkekicne fokac jaŋe ine dameŋ ira batarac‐jopazo.
Eme hâmorâ mâreŋmaŋko foeŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec bocjahazi ɋârerâ fahareniŋmu, ehuc gâcne jaŋe juju sanaŋte biŋe ehapie gâcne jaŋe ine mimi busâqoc â sisipiric sanaŋte biŋe eniŋmu.
Ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe sambâŋ tatamac iŋucne tamaeniŋmu, â ŋic bocjaha tiŋne jujure hatao jowac‐jopambiŋ ŋic i jaŋe ine bâpiŋ iŋucne tamaehuc juniŋmu sanaŋ.
Danie goki ine dâŋ gaza gowatuc ekicne i ŋic moc mi jajaza papia sâfâzi basanaŋkerâ mâc râetec foha dameŋ tarazejec. Eme dameŋ ira ine ŋic bocjaha jaŋe wose gufuc ekupie mamana‐jeŋic fua ɋârâŋkezejec.”
Eme Danie no ʒâŋe fipe rame mi aŋelo opâ ʒiŋuc ocniŋuc domahapire honec‐jofazepac i!
Ehuc aŋelo moc opâ faicnao qoruc ʒora rodomawec e ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnepo: “Wiac hâhâwicne keci mo dameŋko taraocmu?”
Eme aŋelo opâ faicnao qoruc ʒora rodomawec eki mejahec‐ticne sambâŋkopec sicnehuc juju sanaŋ rune erao ɋetickehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupaŋkewec: “Jara jahec â moc â nâfocne taraocmu. Eme tiri ŋic ŋokac jaŋerao sisipiric gie baekac ere tâpiri omaeha wiac i sasawa tara‐fâreocmu hâcne.”
No dâŋ i manarâ fuŋne mi mana tarapo, irec ʒiŋuc muhuc wiopo: “O bomboŋ‐nane, wiac kecirec fârine juku weniŋuc fuazokac?”
Eme muwec: “Danie, go razemec, dâŋ keci ŋic hesoŋke‐jarehuc sâfâzi basanaŋkekicne iŋuc foha juku dameŋ taraocmu hâcne.
Ŋic bocjahazi maŋjeŋic ʒure ʒumururuc epie ɋaɋac taeŋne eocmu; ŋic hehesicne jaŋe wiac hehesicne jaha eniŋmu, ehuc mamana tarahec mi eniŋmu, maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe ine mana taraniŋmu.
Taha bâzi ririkere aka hehuc wiac mamakâcne sisipiric‐ticnehec ebac eniŋmu dameŋ ira fuŋkerâ jufekuhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 1 tauseŋ 290 taraocmu.
Ŋic moc e ʒoaŋ gie bapa 1 tauseŋ 335 taraocte woŋec jufeocmu ere manape ʒerine eocmu.
Go ine rahuc jukuhaŋtec dameŋge tarazejec. Eme ʒâŋeruŋko foku dameŋ tataranao faharerâ wiac kâdoc qagarekicne i rauckezemec.”
Juda ŋicwofuŋ Uʒija, Jotam, Ahaʒi â Hisikia jaŋe tuczi tuc juwefuhapie Jeroboam, Jehoasire ŋokâ hâcne, e Israe ŋicwofuŋ juwec dameŋ ira Wofuŋte dâŋ i Berire ŋokâ Hosea erao fuawec.
Wofuŋ e dâŋticne bâbâni Hosea mufuacnehuc kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go rarâ sasec ŋokac moc rorâ naru motec bâfuac‐jopazemec, i mâreŋ ʒirec rune jaŋe Wofuŋ râpeckehuc sasec gie boc baeŋgopieŋ irec.”
Eme rarâ Dibilaimte otâ, ʒâŋene Gomera e ŋonâŋ‐ticne rowec, eme eki motec kiweckerâ rowec.
Eme Wofuŋzi Hosea âzâcnewec, “Go ʒâŋe‐ticne Jesere muzemec! Dameŋ bembeŋne sawa fokac i tarame no Jesere haeo soc wahawec irec kiŋ i Jehu wiacfâcne jaŋerao batarapemu, ehuc Israe kikefuŋko ŋicwofuŋ juju i mutarape omaeocmu.
No ʒoaŋ ira Jesere wâneŋko Israere tepe neŋgoc i qazupemu.”
Eme ŋokac e mocwâc kiweckerâ juku naru moc rowec. Eme Wofuŋzi Hosea âzâcnewec: “Go ʒâŋene ‘Uruc jauŋ mi ecnekicne’ iŋuc muzemec. No Israe kikefuŋ maŋjauŋ mocwâc mi ejarepemu, â kiŋjeŋic mocwâc mi behe‐jarepemu irec.
Juda kikefuŋ jaŋe ine aki anonoc ejarerâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋic juhuc bafic‐jopapemu, tepe me tubac me ʒika me becâsic me becâsicko rara ŋic wiac izi ine mi bafic‐jopapemu.”
“Uruc jauŋ mi ecnekicne” e moŋ qikiŋneme neŋgocnezi mocwâc kiweckerâ motec moc rowec.
Eme Wofuŋzi muwec: “Go ʒâŋe‐ticne ‘Nore kikefuŋ aricne’ iŋuc muzemec, ŋoŋe nore kikefuŋ mi juŋgopieŋ â no ŋoŋere Anutu wâc mi jukopacte iŋuc ezemec.”
Israe kikefuŋfâcne jaŋere ʒare i hâwecmecko moŋgeŋ forakac irec sâc fuarâ junʒepieŋ, moŋgeŋ i sâcticne mi mamanane â mi wowosene. Eme “Ŋoŋe nore kikefuŋ aricne” iŋuc muŋareeŋgopieŋ irec okacne kecʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Anutu jujune ere kikefuŋ.”
Eme Judare kikefuŋ mecne, Israere kikefuŋ mecne jaŋe mâmâc qâturehuc micne‐jeŋic mocjaha âkendâŋnerâ mâreŋne mâreŋne irecnec fisiniŋmu; eme Jesere dameŋ i dameŋ fekicne moc eocmu.
Ŋoŋe hahac ɋafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: “Kikefuŋfâc‐nane”, â seŋ qofâc‐ŋeŋicte jaŋere ine, “Uruc jauŋ eŋarekicne.”
“Neŋgoc‐ŋeŋic e dâŋko râe‐jâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ, e ŋonâŋ‐nane mi jukac, â no ŋowe‐ticne wâc mi jukopac irec; e ʒâŋe mai‐ticnaonec sasec ŋokacte mai kura bârâriezejec, â boe saure eri wiac susu ŋondeŋko qonaŋkeme waha domakac i mâmâc bârâriezejec.
Iŋuc mi eocmuo ine noni ŋaqi heunuckecnepe fufua dameŋ‐ticnao fowec irec sâc erâ biuctac domazejec; noni mupe mâreŋ burocne iŋucne ezejec, â mâreŋ hahaŋkekicne iŋucnea eha opâ sakarecnepe opâre hâmo sipiric ezejec.
Naru motecfâc‐ticne jaŋe sasec ŋokacte ɋâricfâc juŋgopieŋte mi akic‐jopapemu.
Neŋgoc‐jeŋic e sasec gie bahuc kiwec‐jopaweczi wiac miminehec ewec i kecʒiŋuc muhuc ewec: ‘No sasecŋicfâc‐nane bâjâpec‐jopahuc juzepac, jaŋe hâcne nânâ opâ â ŋaqi qoruc â wokemaŋ erâ opâ wiac nânâne gâcne i nâre tahac eeŋgopieŋ.’
No irec hâcne hata‐ticne fâpâ uupiczi aka hecnerâ mai‐ticnao qânâsac moc bape hata‐ticne basazejec.
Eme sasecŋicfâc‐ticne bâjâpec‐jopa‐bipiehuc basac‐joparâ muocmu: ‘No faharerâ mârâc ŋowe‐nanerao risiezepac, no ehec jupo dameŋ ira sâcne juhâmopo.’”
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Noni hâcne wiac kecʒiŋuc râcne tahac epo i mi mana tarawec: Padi jacgoŋ, waiŋ â wokemaŋ, erâ siliwa â gol bocjaha râcnepo i Baali nemure behewec.
No irec hâcne padi jacgoŋ‐nane i qa roro dameŋko, â waiŋ opâ‐nane i dameŋ‐ticne maickeme mocwâc ro sakac epemu, ehuc ŋaqi qoruc mimi‐ticne sâockeocte râcnepo i wâc iŋuc jaha jâoc ropemu.
Erâ mimi‐ticne i sasecŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere maio bajaŋgeŋkehape moczi moc nore meonec mi batarazejec.
Noni mupe bubiaŋ‐ticne sasawa, â hombaŋ â mosa wahame ʒeri bubiaŋ â sabata erâ hombaŋte tutumaŋ wiac‐ticne i sasawa omae‐fârezejec.
Ehame no waiŋ qaŋeŋ‐ticne â jâmbojâc‐ticne sipirickepemu. Wiac irec hâcne ʒiŋuc muwec: ‘I sasecŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe sasec giere furi narembiŋ.’ No ine wiac i mupe uupic wânʒâŋ fuame kâte qowi jaŋe nâhuc junʒepieŋ.
Eme hombaŋ sâc Baali nemu hosâc âsu rike‐jarehuc e jahacne sahac ʒânoŋ bibiri â maŋguc resoneheczi erickewec, erâ sasecŋicfâc‐ticne bâjâpec‐jopahuc nore nikeckewec irec okacne bazucnepemu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Manakic, no irec hâcne mu baafec ecnehuc mâreŋ sawao jowa rarâ bâbâmiriŋ dâŋ âzâcnepemu.
Erâ no ira waiŋ gie‐ticne râcnepemu, ehuc Akoro Wâneŋ i mupe jujuhâmore motâc ezejec. Eme e ira dâŋnane manaocmu, naru‐ticne Aigita mâreŋkonec wefurâ ehuc juwec irec sâc eocmu hâcne.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “E dameŋ ira ‘Baali‐nane’ mâcne, ‘Ŋowe‐nane’ iŋuc munareocmu.
No Baali ʒâŋe‐jeŋic micticnaonec bârâriepemu, eme ʒâŋe wiac irec mocwâc mi manasuzejec.
No dameŋ ira Israe jaŋere erâ kâte qowi â sawa wipe erâ mâreŋko wiac foforâ juekac jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic moc epemu, ehuc tepe neŋgoc â ʒika erâ ʒikare wiac gâcne mâreŋkonec bârâriepemu, erâ ejarepe wama faio ŋec juc enʒepieŋ.
No ŋokac‐nane rocgupe juzemec sanaŋ, no tiŋne â mumutiŋ dâŋko jowacgurâ maŋjauŋ â buuruc egarehuc ŋonâŋ‐nane rocgupemu hâcne.
No erâ‐eesanaŋ‐nanere erâ ŋonâŋ‐nane rocgupemu, eme Wofuŋ no hâcne mana taracnuzemec.
“No dameŋ ira sambâŋ manacnehape mâreŋ gume hesiwiŋ ecnezejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme mâreŋzi padi jacgoŋ â waiŋ erâ wokemaŋ âgo ejareme fuahuc Jesere dopeckenʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc fuame nore biŋe juocte âkendâŋnepemu, ehuc ‘Uruc jauŋ mi ecnekicne’ e jauŋkepemu, â ‘Nore kikefuŋ aricne’ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazapemu: ‘Ŋoŋe nore kikefuŋfâc,’ eme jaŋe muniŋmu, ‘Go nâŋere Anutu.’”
Eme Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go harierâ ra ʒuhuc bâtâc ŋokac sasec‐ticnehec moc erao maŋge râetec fozejec; ine Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe nemu jabane jaŋerao qohotahuc nânâ poroŋ waiŋ hândâŋnehec jare tahac ejumbieŋ irec aŋac‐jopaekac i Wofuŋzi mana‐bipiehuc sifu maŋticne jaŋerao râeme foekac irec sâc.”
Iŋuc nazame noni siliwa moneŋ 15 â padi pake 15 jaha izi ŋokac e furine bapo.
Erâ âzâcnepo: “Go norao dameŋ ʒora sasec tâmiric juhuc ŋic moctao mi qohotazemec, ehame noni iŋuc jaha gohec mi fopemu.”
Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe dameŋ ʒora ŋicwofuŋ tâmiric â ŋic fekicne tâmiric, taha bâzi tâmiric â nemure qânâ wâtuŋ tâmiric, taha bapare qoqonaŋ ŋaqi tâmiric â nemuɋâŋ ficmaŋko dodomane tâmiric jufeniŋmu hâcne.
Dameŋ irec faicnao ine Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe risierâ Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋic â Dawidi ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic wira basac ejactenʒepieŋ, erâ dameŋ tataranao Wofuŋ araŋ fârine bacnehuc buuruc‐ticne honenʒepieŋ.
O Israe kikefuŋ, ŋoŋe Wofuŋte dâŋ mananiŋ! Maŋjauŋ â siocmâc juju â Anutu mamana tara i mâreŋko mi fokacte Wofuŋzi mâreŋte ŋecjucfâc jaŋe dâŋgieo râec‐jopakac.
Jaŋe sâwecdâŋ mueŋgopieŋ, burec eeŋgopieŋ, ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, fiuc roeŋgopieŋ, boe sau eeŋgopieŋ, wiac i ɋârâŋkeha soc ruruac ehuc kiŋ hotâckeeŋgopieŋ.
Irec hâcne mâreŋzi makuc bakac, â fainao ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋzi hâmo betaŋ efâreeŋgopieŋ; erâ kâte qowi mecne, sawa wipe mecne, erâ wâc hâwec qowi jaŋe mâmâc sipirickeeŋgopieŋ.
Iŋuc fuahame ŋic moczi âgo‐ticne dâŋgieo mi râezejec, â moczi âgone dâŋ mi mucnezejec; o taha bapa, gore dâŋ ine noni mutarapemu.
Go ʒoaŋko fâfâcguzejec, ehame porofete e ŋafeo gohec mâmâc fâfâc‐ŋofazejec; eme neŋgoc egarekac e imackepemu.
Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe mamana tara mi fojarewecte sipiric‐jopakicne, go ine mamana tara qikiŋnemeŋte no behecgupe taha bapa mi junarezemec. Go Anutugere mumutâc dâŋ irec nikecguwecte no ŋokâfâcge jaŋere wâc nikecnuocmu.
Taha bapa jaŋe fehuc fua sawec embiŋ, irec sâc jaha hehesic bocjaha ehuc bunaneo bambiŋ, irec no ʒâŋe biŋe‐jeŋic bârisiepe mimi qaqanehec ezejec.
Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe kiŋte taha bâzi râepie ro nâc eeŋgopieŋ, ehuc ŋic jaŋe kiŋ bâfuahuc taha bocjaha bafisiniŋte ejareekac.
Irec ŋic jaŋe wiac fua‐jareocmu sâc ijaha taha bapa fua‐jarezejec; no juju‐jeŋic bâtiŋnehuc eebapa‐jeŋicte okacne bazu‐jarepemu.
Jaŋe nânâ nâpie mi gapec‐jopazejec, â sasec gie bahuc mi sawenʒepieŋ, i sasec gie baniŋte Wofuŋ no râpecnumbiŋ hâcne.
Waiŋ raŋɋane me ɋâricne nâpie maŋsifuc ejareekac.
Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe wiac jâczi bakicne i mu indiŋ ecneeŋgopieŋ, ehame gunu‐jeŋiczi mufua‐jareekac. Sasec giere mamanasuzi maŋsifuc bâfua‐jarewec, eme sâqocne baniŋte Anutu‐jeŋic râpeckembiŋ.
Tiki botâŋko taha bâzi, â mâreŋ facnao hosâc âsu biaŋ rikeeŋgopieŋ; ine boriŋ, jâmiŋ â niwijâczi mumuc biaŋne qaha jâc jaŋere fuŋnao iŋuc eeŋgopieŋ. Irec otâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe sasec gie baniŋmu, â joŋaofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe sau gie baniŋmu.
Eme otâfâc‐ŋeŋic sasec gie baniŋmu, me joŋaofâc‐ŋeŋic sau gie baniŋmu no mi bâtiŋ‐jopapemu; i jaŋe jaŋac wâc qâsorierâ sasec ŋokac jaŋehec juhuc sasec ŋokac mucjopakicne jaŋehec taha bâzi rikeeŋgopieŋte. Iŋuc fuame ŋic ŋokac jaŋe mutuc ehuc sipirickeeŋgopieŋ.
Israe, go sasec gie bahaŋtecne Judaŋiczi kiŋ bahac mi bâfuazejec. Ŋoŋe Giligali haeo mi ranʒepieŋ, me Betaweŋ nemu ufuŋko wâc mi fenʒepieŋ, ehuc Wofuŋ jujune erao ɋetickehuc dâŋ i me i mi mupaŋkenʒepieŋ.
Israe e bulimakao râŋgeŋne iŋucne râŋgeŋkewec, iŋuc eme Wofuŋzi wemocko manacneme lama iŋucne mâreŋ qaratiekicnao nânâ nâhuc juocmu.
Eferaim e nemu jabane jaŋerao ʒuhuckewec, irec e behepie juoc!
Jaŋe opâ sanaŋ nâpie maŋjeŋic sifuckeme sasec gie baeŋgopieŋ, ehuc wiac miminehec irec manapie feha ʒâŋe biŋe‐jeŋic bawahaeŋgopieŋ.
Maŋsifucte mâŋâŋzi foŋjoparâ ficne suec‐jopawec, irec alatafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere erâ qurutuaniŋmu.
Taha bapa ŋoŋe dâŋ ʒi mananiŋ, â Israe kikefuŋ ŋoŋe hazec mi qaniŋ; ŋicwofuŋ wiacfâcne ŋoŋe hazec râeniŋ! Mumutara dameŋzi maic‐ŋopazo ekac; ŋoŋe Mizipa haeo bitiŋ iŋucne embiŋ, â Taboro tikio ufic moc fârekicne iŋucne hâcne.
Ŋoŋe Sitim haeo nombâŋ ʒora iŋucne embiŋ, eme no irec hâcne bâtiŋ‐ŋopa‐fârekopac.
No Eferaimte fuŋne mana‐jâmbâŋkekopac, â Israe e nore maio sosoŋkene mi fokac. Eferaim, go qâpuc wiac ehuc jumeŋ, â Israe e maŋwânâŋhec ewec.
Jaŋe Anutu‐jeŋictao risienʒipiŋte eebapa‐jeŋiczi aka hejareekac, â sasecte mamanasuzi maŋjeŋicko fokacte Wofuŋ mi mana taraeŋgopieŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋe jaŋacne pepec penaroŋzi mutaniŋ‐jopaekac, irec Israe mecne, Eferaim mecne mâmâc jaha kiŋjekicte erâ waha jofaocmu, ehame Juda e jahacne mâmâc waha qaocmu.
Jaŋe lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic bâzire biŋe bacjopa rarâ Wofuŋ wira basac ecneniŋmu, erâ e râpec‐jopawecte mi bâfuaniŋmu.
Jaŋe Wofuŋ râpeckembiŋ, ehuc naru motec bâfuac‐jopambiŋ jaŋe jabane embiŋ. Irec mosare hombaŋzi jaŋe mecne â giegaŋ‐jeŋic mâmâc imac‐jopa‐fâreocmu.
Gibea haeo qeŋ qaniŋ, Rama haeo qeŋ bâsokahuc qaniŋ. Betaweŋ haeo aŋara heniŋ, Benjamiŋ mu hâhâwic ecneniŋ!
Okac dameŋ maickeme Eferaimko niniŋ siarereŋ fuazejec, no Israe ŋicguru jaŋere ŋondeŋko dâŋ mufuapo i deŋkeocmu.
Juda fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe, ŋic mâreŋte ma âke suepie raekac iŋucne embiŋ; no kimbeŋ‐nane opâ iŋucne fai‐jeŋicko hoŋkepemu.
Eferaim e wiac jabane bâjâpezore maŋkewecte eebapa‐ticne imackehuc fific guguriŋ ecnekicne.
No ine Eferaim wâfu qoʒazaŋ, â Juda kikefuŋ fiu kurumbuc jaŋe iŋucne ejacteekopac.
Eme Eferaim ŋic jaŋe hucjeŋic honehapie Juda kikefuŋ jaŋe sisiwiŋ‐jeŋic ʒâŋitambiŋ, ehuc Eferaim jaŋe Asiria mâreŋko rambiŋ, â Juda kikefuŋ jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ sâkorao dâŋ râepie rawec. Eki ine hucŋeŋic bâniniŋkeocte â sisiwiŋ‐ŋeŋic qasume tackeocte tâpiri mi focnekac.
No Eferaim laioŋ iŋucne râsi ecnekopac, â Juda kikefuŋ laioŋ motec ɋâri iŋucne erâ kisuc qâsuc‐joparâ bacjopa rakopac, eme no bacjopa rahape ŋic moczi sâcne moc mi batarac‐jopaocmu.
No nahacne haeo risie juhape jaŋe kiŋ bahac‐jeŋic hone tararâ maicnunʒepieŋ, ehuc ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋ‐jeŋicko wira basac enarehuc ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ:
“Ajoc, nâŋâc Wofuŋtao risienaŋ, eki hâcne kisuc qâsuc‐nâpoweczi mocwâc bâpiaŋ‐nâpoocmu, e nâpoweczi mocwâc ʒure foŋ enâreocmu.
E ʒoaŋ jajahec tarame ɋiɋicne bacnâpoocmu, ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha bafaharec‐nâpome ere maio junʒepeneŋ.
Nâŋâc mana taranʒepeneŋ, Wofuŋ mana taranaŋte henʒiriŋnenʒepeneŋ. E furic qânikiŋ iŋucne fua‐jâmbâŋkeocmu e hoe sâko iŋucne fai‐nâŋecko wahaocmu, qa roro dameŋ maickezo eha hoe fisirâ mâreŋ bâgunuckeekac irec sâc fisi‐nâreocmu.”
O Eferaim, go weniŋuc egarezepac, â Juda, go wâc weniŋuc egarezepac? Maŋjauŋ‐ŋeŋic i furic barâ omaeekac iŋucne, â titikuczi waharâ furictea kereŋkeekac irec sâc.
No irec hâcne porofete jaŋe doc enarehapie henʒaŋ qanʒaŋ‐jopaekopac, â micdâŋ‐nanezi qâhâmoc‐jopaekopac; ehame bâbâtiŋ‐nanezi i tatamac iŋucne fuazejec.
No taha bâzire mâcne, maŋjauŋte enareekac, qowi bâzi ririkere mâcne, Anutu no mana taracnuniŋte enareekac hâcne.
Jaŋe Adam haeo ʒâʒâfic‐nane hetâcnembiŋ, ehuc ira hâcne râpecnumbiŋ.
Gileade hae i ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere hae, soczi bâbie‐fârekicne.
Fiuc roro jaŋe hatao ŋic meo fârec ejareeŋgopieŋ, irec sâc jaha taha bapa jaŋe eeŋgopieŋ, ehuc Sikem haere hatao ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe jâmbomac wiac hehesicne ebac eeŋgopieŋ.
No Israe tiri ufuŋko wiac mamakâcne honeekopac, ira Eferaimzi qâpuc wiac dapecneekac, â Israezi wâwânâŋ sâko bâfuaekac.
O Juda, gore qa roro dameŋ i bakicne fokac wâc.
No ŋicfâc‐nane bafic‐jopahuc Israe bâpiaŋkehape Eferaimte sâqocne â Samariare hehesic i fua taniŋkeekac. Jaŋe eeatuc bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, fiuc rorozi ficko ferâ wiac fiuckeeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe hae ʒoŋao ŋic wiac kâŋgâc jowac roeŋgopieŋ.
Eme no hehesic‐jeŋic sasaware mi nikecnuekac i jaŋe mi mana taraeŋgopieŋ; eebapa‐jeŋic sâqocne izi orâŋ‐jopaekac, ehuc nore maio fua taniŋkeekac.
Jaŋe hehesic‐jeŋiczi ŋicwofuŋ bubiaŋ qacneeŋgopieŋ, â eeatuc epie ŋic fekicne jaŋe honepie biaŋkeekac.
Jaŋe boe sau ŋic sasawa, jaŋe poroŋ nombâŋko râeniŋte ʒoc ruqepie buse ʒaekac iŋucne, i poroŋ bapazi poroŋte gie gâcne bahuc juhapie ʒoc e jahac ʒahuc foekac.
Ŋic fekicne jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ‐nâŋec hombaŋ‐ticnao waiŋ opâ ʒaʒacne gumepie maŋsifuc ecneekac, ehame mu ruruc ecneeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe meoric qajareekac.
Eatuczi maŋjeŋicko ʒoc iŋucne ʒaekac, kimbeŋ‐jeŋiczi ŋafe ʒora mâc ʒâpârâckeekac, hae fureme ine ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne uŋ herâ ʒaekac.
Jaŋe sasawa poroŋ nombâŋko ʒoc ʒaekac iŋucne, jaŋe guriŋ bapafâc‐jeŋic ʒâseŋ‐jopaeŋgopieŋ. Ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe rândiŋkerâ waha jopa‐fârewec, ehame jaŋeraonec moczi no wira wâwâsic moc mi enarewec.
Eferaim e ŋicguru gâcne jaŋehec sisifuc embiŋ, e nânâ poroŋ rikehuc mi hetikiekicne iŋucne.
E mi manahuc ŋic jabane jaŋe tâpiri‐ticne sipirickeeŋgopieŋ, â mi manahame biac jaŋɋâŋ âeckekac.
Israe pepec penaroŋ‐jeŋiczi fuŋne‐jeŋic bataniŋke‐bipieha jaŋe sifu Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋictao mi risieŋgopieŋ, â irec erâ wira basac wâc mi ecneŋgopieŋ.
Eferaim ŋic jaŋe hapâ iŋucne, rucgereŋ â maŋfânâŋ tâmiric hâcne; jaŋe ŋifec Aigita wira wâwâsic ecneeŋgopieŋ, â ŋifec ine Asiria mâreŋko babaficte raeŋgopieŋ.
Eme rapie sâc ufic‐nane râe‐jarepe jowaniŋmu, no sawa wipe iŋucne muruc‐jopape wahaniŋmu, no kikefuŋfâc‐jeŋic mufua‐jarekicne irec sâcko bâtiŋ‐jopapemu.
Jei, jaŋe wemocte behecnumbiŋ? Jaŋe qaqatara bâfuahuc râpecnumbiŋte sisipiriczi fai‐jeŋicko fezejec! Jaŋe burec enareeŋgopieŋte wemocko moc batarac‐jopapemu.
Jaŋe fofo‐jeŋicko fohuc kio owa kosa eeŋgopieŋ, â maŋzi mu huacbuc eenare ine mi eeŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe padi jacgoŋ â waiŋ fua‐jareocte sahac‐jeŋic hezuhuc no fenareeŋgopieŋ.
No hâcne tâpiri bâfua‐jarepo, jaŋe ine râsi enareniŋte manasueŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe Baali nemu erao ra qohotaeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe tepe neŋgoc urucne iŋucne. Fekicnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe pepecdâŋ boc eeŋgopieŋte ʒikare nânâ enʒepieŋ. Iŋuc fuame Aigita mâreŋko mu gâgâwi ejareniŋmu.
Go qeŋ qatec dâŋeoc! Râsi moc tucwipe iŋucne Wofuŋte ficko sâorâ wahakac; jaŋe ʒâʒâfic‐nane hetâcnerâ sâcmutâc dâŋnane râsi ecnembiŋte iŋuc fua‐jarekac.
Eme kecʒiŋuc wira wâwâsic enareeŋgopieŋ: “O Anutu‐nâŋec, Israe ŋic nâŋe go manacgueŋgopeneŋ i!”
Israe ŋic jaŋe wiac biaŋne qikiŋnembiŋ, irec râsi jaŋe jopa jâpec eniŋmu.
Jaŋe mi mujarehape ŋicwofuŋ âkendâŋ‐jopambiŋ, â no mi manahape ŋic fekicne mucjopambiŋ; siliwa â goljeŋiczi nemure ɋâŋ qâqâtâc bambiŋ i sisipiricte biŋe eocmu.
O Samaria, no bulimakao qâqâtâcge qikiŋnekopac, kimbeŋ‐nanezi bâruŋke‐jarekac; ŋoŋe mo dameŋko qâpuc eebapa tâmiric juniŋmu?
Bulimakao qâqâtâc i Israe jaŋere metâ bapa moczi bawec, erâ i Anutu aricne. Samarianec bulimakao i hefâc qâfâuckepie dâkâ piic piic fuaocmu.
Jaŋe wiac ebac embiŋ i manapie afeckewec, â irec okacne i ŋemâcne jâmbâŋ fua‐jareocmu. Padi sarapie âkeʒurâ wefu sokarâ fâri tâmiric ârine sawa domaocmu, me fârine moc fuaocmuo ine ŋic jabane jaŋe nâniŋmu.
Israe ŋic sipiric‐jopakicne, eme ʒi ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko râqâc behekicne tinac erâ juŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe kâte doŋgizi bucticne hata raekac irec sâc Asiria mâreŋko fembiŋ, Eferaim e bubiaŋte wiac jarehuc âgo bacjopawec hâcne.
Jaŋe ŋicne ŋicne âgo bacjopambiŋte no bâtâtiec‐jopapemu, eme jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ me fekicne wokemaŋ rurua‐jare i dameŋ bembeŋnea behenʒepieŋ.
Eferaim jaŋe alata wiac bocjaha bambiŋ i eebapa‐jeŋic sâqocnere alata hâcne.
No sâcmutâc dâŋnane bocjaha qâreŋke‐jarepe muzac sifu manapie dâŋ furune ezac.
Jaŋe taha bâzire aŋac‐jopaekac, ehame qowi bâzi rike nâc eeŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ no ine wiac irec mi enareekac. No hehesic‐jeŋicte manasurâ kiŋjeŋicte okacne bazu‐jarepemu, eme Aigita mâreŋko risienʒepieŋ.
Israe e bâbâfua‐ticne nore nikeckeme erific wiac baraha Judazi hae sanaŋ bocjaha bawec. No ine hae wiac‐ticne turuŋkepe ʒazejec, ehuc ficsanaŋ wiac‐ticne ʒâseŋke‐fârezejec.
O Israe, go qâpuc wiacte sasec gie bahuc Anutu râpeckemeŋte â padi bâbâmârâŋ tomao ira sasec giere furi rozore egarewecte bubiaŋ mi manazemec, â ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe iŋucne kiwac qawac mi ezemec.
Padi â waiŋ rowaŋ izi gume basanaŋ mi egareocmu, ehame waiŋ ɋâricnezi sâqore‐gareocmu wâc.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋte mâreŋko mi junʒepieŋ, aricne; Eferaim go Aigita mâreŋko risiezemec, erâ Asiria mâreŋko nânâ wâwânâŋhec nâhuc juzemec.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ waiŋ mi tahackeniŋmu, ehuc taha bâzi ririke‐ŋeŋiczi bubiaŋ wâc mi qacneniŋmu. Nânâ poroŋ‐ŋeŋic i ŋic makuc baeŋgopieŋ jaŋere nânâ poroŋ iŋucne, irec nâniŋmu sâc maŋŋeŋic wâwânâŋhec efâreocmu; poroŋ‐ŋeŋic i hobure biŋe sawa, Wofuŋte ufuŋko ine mi bafezo.
Eme ŋoŋe tutumaŋ hombaŋko, â jara sâc Wofuŋte hombaŋ ŋeeŋgopieŋ ira wemo ezo muŋgopieŋ?
Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe Asiria mâreŋko ranʒepieŋ, Aigita mâreŋzi bâturec‐ŋopazejec, â Memfisi haeo ducŋopazo. Siliwa wiac‐ŋeŋic furi sâko i sopâc fuarâ bârârâŋnezejec, â qoruc boze‐ŋeŋicko fâpâ uupic fuarâ fozejec.
Go kiŋ bahacge â qaqaisocge hâhâwicne fokacte bâbâtiŋ dameŋ â okac babazu dameŋ maicgukac hâcne. Israezi ʒiŋuc muhuc owackeekac: “Porofete e ŋic mutucne â mamana ŋic e ŋic maŋsifuchec.”
Eferaim ŋic jaŋe porofete qoruc boze‐ticnao ruc bacneeŋgopieŋ, ehuc hata‐ticnao wiwitic râecneeŋgopieŋ, â Anutu‐ticnere ufuŋko râsi ecneeŋgopieŋ wâc.
Jaŋe mârâc jaha Gibea haeo embiŋ irec sâc jaha ehuc sâqocnere nombâŋko huutuckembiŋ, irec Wofuŋ e hehesic‐jeŋicte manasuhuc sâqocne‐jeŋicte okacne bazu‐jareocmu.
No Israe ŋic jaŋe, mâreŋ sawa sâpâtâckonec waiŋ hândâŋne bâfuaeŋgopeneŋ irec sâcko bâfuac‐jopapo, â mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe jâmbo hândâŋne bâbâni fuaekac irec sâc. Jaŋe Baali‐Peoro tikio fisirâ Baali nemure biŋe ehuc sâqore‐jâmbâŋkembiŋ, erâ joroc‐jeŋichec sâc mocjaha ehuc mamakâc embiŋ.
Eferaim e ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnezi wipe iŋucne ratâmirekac; naru motec kikiwec‐jopa me roroc‐jopa i arictac efârekac.
Me naru motecfâc‐jeŋic hone kitaŋ ejarepie sokaniŋmuo ine noni jowac rofârepemu, eme ŋic arictac eniŋmu. Jei, no behec‐jopape jaŋe jaŋackoaŋ weniŋuc eniŋmu!
No ʒiŋuc honekopac: Eferaim e ɋâricfâc‐ticne râec‐jopame rambaŋ juhapie wosaŋeŋ bapa ŋic jaŋe bâfuac‐jopahuc muruc‐jopaniŋmu.
O Wofuŋ, go wiac moc ejarec! Wemo wiac mo ejarecmu? Go ŋokacfâc‐jeŋic hufiŋne bacjopatec moŋjeŋic ʒickezejec!
Giligali haeo hehesic‐jeŋic guru fufusuc fokac, eme no ira hâcne fuŋkerâ qaisoc‐jopapo. No eebapa‐jeŋic repicnere erâ ficnaneonec jâpec‐jopape wisenʒepieŋ, no maŋjauŋ mocwâc mi ejarepemu; fekicnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe qaqatara ŋic sasawa.
Eferaim ŋic jaŋe jopakicne, gâtâ‐jeŋic i kereŋkekicne fokac, jaŋe fârine mocwâc mi bâfuanʒepieŋ. Me sifu bâfuaniŋmuo ine no joroc motec biaŋfâc‐jeŋic qâhâmoc‐jopapemu.
Jaŋe dâŋticne mana rereŋ mi embiŋte Anutu‐nanezi behec‐jopaocmu, eme ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko qac qâsoric ehuc junʒepieŋ.
Israe e waiŋ qizec fâri rarau hândâŋne qaekac irec sâc juwec. E fua sawec ewec sâc alata wiac bocjaha bawec; mâreŋ‐ticnao wiac fua biaŋ ewec sâc nemure qânâ wâtuŋ âkendâŋne rawec.
Maŋjeŋicko eeatuc fokac, irec ʒi kiŋ bahac‐jeŋic âsickeniŋmu. Wofuŋzi alata‐jeŋic heropieocmu â qânâ wâtuŋ‐jeŋic qazuocmu.
Jaŋe biac ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: “Nâŋe Wofuŋ araŋ mi bacnembeŋte ŋicwofuŋ tâmiric juŋgopeneŋ. Me ŋicwofuŋ moc jurâ muzac weniŋuc erâ sâcne bafic‐nâpozac?”
Jaŋe dameŋ sâc dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ i fâri tâmiric, â ʒâʒâfic ehuc dâŋ mupaŋkeeŋgopieŋ i racne jaha; irec mumutiŋ dâŋjeŋic i gieo hofâ sâqocne fuaekac irec sâc ekac.
Samaria ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe Betaweŋ haeo bulimakao nemu‐jeŋic ŋewec irec mana mezac eeŋgopieŋ, ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe irec erâ mu mamakuc eeŋgopieŋ, â taha bapafâcne jaŋe eri qaraweŋ‐ticne jâoc rokicnere kio huse eeŋgopieŋ.
Ɋâŋ qâqâtâc e jahacne Asiria mâreŋko bararâ ŋicwofuŋ sâko tahackeniŋmu. Eme Eferaim e mimi‐ticne manaocmu, â Israe e ɋâŋ qâqâtâc‐ticnere erâ qurutuaocmu.
Samariare ŋicwofuŋ e jâc dâkâne opâ faio ratâmireekac irec sâc sirowezejec.
Israe jaŋe Betaweŋ tikio nemu araŋ bajarehuc sâqorembiŋ tiki i jaŋe sipirickeniŋmu, eme alata‐jeŋicte faio fâpâ uupic â sopâc fuazejec. Ehame ŋic jaŋe tiki ʒiŋuc jazaniŋmu: “Ŋoŋe waha ŋefac‐nâponiŋ,” â mâreŋ facne jaŋere muniŋmu: “Ŋoŋe fai‐nâŋecko waharâ bârârâŋ‐nâponiŋ!”
Israe ŋic jaŋe Gibea haeo ira fuŋkerâ sâqocne bahuc juwefumbiŋ; jaŋe ira hâcne râsi enarembiŋ. Irec ŋic hehesicne jaŋere erâ Gibea haeo ʒikazi rocjopame mi sâckeocmu me?
No maŋnanezi manakopac irec sâcko okacne bazu‐jarepemu; kiŋ bahac bâutuckehuc bâfuambiŋte bâtiŋ‐jopape ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe qâturerâ râsi ejarenʒepieŋ.
Eferaim e, bulimakao giere fuŋne qazucnekicnezi padi afeckerâ âte mârâŋkeekac iŋucne. No upe‐ticne sanaŋne honerâ kioŋ râecnepo, ehuc Eferaim ecnepe gie bawec; Juda e ine mâreŋ hehefâuc gie baha Jakobozi mâreŋ babanʒaŋ gie bazejec.
Ŋoŋe tiŋne jujure ukic tienʒepieŋ, izi maŋjauŋte fârine fuame ro nusec enʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ wira basac eecnere dameŋ fokacte gie ɋâricne he sarac enʒepieŋ, eme fisirâ mume tiŋne juju i hoe iŋucne waha‐ŋarezejec.
Ŋoŋe mâreŋ hefâuckehuc hehesicte ukicne râeeŋgopieŋ, eme fârine fufua dameŋko eebapa sindaŋne bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, â burecte hândâŋ nâeŋgopieŋ. Ŋoŋe keretac wiac‐ŋeŋic â ʒikaŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic guru sâko jaŋerao roweckehuc jumbiŋ.
Irec ŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋko ʒika fuazejec, â ficsanaŋ‐ŋeŋic ima bafârenʒepieŋ, ine ŋicwofuŋ Salamaŋzi ʒika qahuc Betarabe hae ima bawec irec sâcko. Dameŋ ira neŋgoc â naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mâmâc henʒaŋ qanʒaŋ‐jopakicne.
O Israe kikefuŋ, ŋoŋe sindaŋ‐ŋeŋic repicnere iŋuc hâcne fua‐ŋarezejec. Israe ŋicwofuŋ e hae fufurecte biac omae‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.
Israe e socɋâri juha maŋnane erao fowec, ehame ŋokâ‐nane e Aigita mâreŋkonec wiracnepe wefuwec.
Eme no wira‐jarepe sâc behecnurâ wisembiŋ, jaŋe Baali nemu taha bâzi rike‐jarehuc ɋâŋ qâqâtâc hosâc âsu rike‐jare jumbieŋ wâc.
No nahac Eferaim ŋic jaŋe hata rarare fuŋne qazu‐jarepo, noni hâcne hâpoc‐jopapo; jaŋe ine noni bâpiaŋ‐jopapo i kâuc bambiŋ.
No buuructe muczi â maŋjauŋte repazi fârec‐jopapo, erâ hâpo mickukuc ejarehuc daperâ nânâ jare gumec epo.
Ʒi ine norao wareniŋte takic‐jopaekac, irec Aigita mâreŋko risie‐bipiehapie Asiria runezi ŋicwofuŋ ejarezejec.
Ʒikazi hae‐jeŋic sâc gie bahuc burecŋicfâc‐jeŋic nâcjopazejec, ehuc docbapa dâŋjeŋicte ɋâcjopazejec.
Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋe behecnuniŋte maŋjeŋic domaekac, irec hâcne tagi de âsic eniŋte mukicne i moczi moc mi qâsua‐jarezejec.
O Eferaim, no wemocko behecguzapo! O Israe, no wemocko râpecguzapo! No wemocko Adama hae iŋucne hone suŋgiŋ egarezapo! No wemocko Ʒeboim hae ecnepo sâc ijaha egarezapo! No buroro enarekac â bunane bâruŋkekac hâcne.
No kimbeŋ sâqocne mi qaŋarepemu, â Eferaim go mocwâc mi sipiricgupemu, no ŋic aricne, no Anutu hâcne, no Tiri runezi ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko jukopac, no sipiric‐ŋopapemurâ mi fâ fisikopac.
Jaŋe Wofuŋ bâjâpeniŋmu, eme eki laioŋ iŋucne owackeocmu; jâmbomac, e owackeme ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe hâwec mâreŋkonec ɋarac ɋarac qahuc fisiniŋmu.
Jaŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec wipe iŋucne, â Asiria mâreŋkonec hapâ iŋucne fâfârehuc fisiniŋmu, eme no fic hae‐jeŋicko bârisiec‐jopapemu, Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
Eferaim ŋic jaŋe burec boc enarehuc jumbiŋ, â Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe eatucnuhuc râpecnumbiŋ, erâ Juda e Anutu erâ‐eesanaŋ Tiri rune erao wâc mi qohota sanaŋkeekac.
Eferaim e wiac fârimâc irec aŋackeekac, â ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec wiac sisipiricnehec bâjâpeekac, ehuc ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne burec â bâbâʒâic bâsokaekac. Jaŋe Asiria jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ehuc Aigita mâreŋko oliwa wokemaŋ râepie raekac.
Irec hâcne Wofuŋzi Judaŋic jaŋe dâŋko râec‐jopaocmu, â Jakobo juju bapa‐ticnere erâ bâtiŋneocmu, ehuc eebapa‐ticnere sâcko okacne bazucneocmu.
E neŋgocte bumaŋko fohuc hahacne biac eatuckewec, juku ŋic tâpirihec eme Anutuhec juju gie bapic.
E aŋelohec juju gie baku sanaŋkewec, e kiorâ busâqoc manacneocte numucnewec. E Anutu Bete haeo bâfuame dâŋ âzâcnewec.
Wofuŋ e Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, ʒâŋe‐ticne Wofuŋ hâcne.
“Go Anutugezi baficguha risiezemec, go maŋjauŋ â mumutiŋ dâŋ paŋʒâic bajuzemec, ehuc dameŋ sâc Anutugere mamanac juzemec.”
Eferaim e furi bapa ŋiczi sigeli burecne moc meticnao badomahuc ŋic wiac sâctiri jowac roocte aŋackeekac.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc muekac: “Aija, no mafa mâririhec, nahacne biŋe wiac bocjaha hure hemârec epo, eme wiac fonarekac sasawa irec ŋiczi ʒiŋuc sâcne mi muniŋmu: ‘Jâiŋko hotâckeme kiŋnehec ewec.’”
No Aigita mâreŋko fuŋkerâ Wofuŋ Anutuge juwarepozi jukopac, no hâcne mugarepe qoruc bozeo mocwâc ŋec juc ecmu, ine mârâc jaha tutumaŋ dameŋko ehuc jumeŋ irec sâc.
No porofete dâŋ jazahuc jupo, no hâcne maŋbâwiŋ bocjaha ejarepo, erâ porofete jaŋere micko kesaic dâŋ râepe mutaniŋkembiŋ.
Jaŋe Gileade haeo wiac hehesicne ejumbieŋte sipirickenʒepieŋ, â Giligali haeo bulimakao nemu bâzi rike‐jare jumbieŋte alata wiac‐jeŋic ima bapie giegaŋko qânâ guruckepie ŋeekac irec sâc ezejec.
(Jakobozi Aram mâreŋko wisewec, Israe e ira ŋokacte erâ kiŋaŋ qaqa ewec, ŋokacte erâ qowi soŋaŋ juwec hâcne.)
Eme Wofuŋzi porofete moc ecneme eki Israe ŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopame wefumbiŋ, â porofete moc ecneme soŋaŋ‐jopahuc juwec.
Eferaim ŋic jaŋe Wofuŋ bunao bahuc maŋbâiŋ ecnembiŋ, irec mume socte kiŋ fai‐jeŋicko feocmu; ehame Wofuŋ e mimi qaqa ecnembiŋte okacne bazu‐jareocmu.
Eferaim e dâŋ muwec sâc ŋiczi hâhâwic embiŋ, ehuc Israe ŋondeŋko e manacnepie fewec; juku ine Baalire kiŋaŋ qahuc kiŋ bahac bâfuarâ hâmowec.
Ʒi ine sâqocne giŋkeme giŋ bâfua rahuc ɋâŋ qâqâtâc aeŋzi baeŋgopieŋ, siliwa‐jeŋiczi nemuɋâŋ basarickeeŋgopieŋ hâcne, ine metâ bapa jaŋere gie sasawa. Ehuc mueŋgopieŋ: Ɋâŋ qâqâtâc bâzi rike‐jareniŋ, â ŋiczi bulimakao qâqâtâc muduc‐jopaniŋ!
Jaŋe iŋuc eeŋgopieŋte furicte hâweŋ fuaekac, me titikuczi furictea fuarâ omaeekac irec sâc enʒepieŋ, erâ mâŋâŋzi padi jawa ficne sueme raekac, me hosâczi qâuŋko fotâcnerâ omaeekac irec sâc jaha omaenʒepieŋ.
No ine Aigita mâreŋko fuŋkerâ Wofuŋ Anutuge juwarepozi jukopac, eme go Anutu furune moc mi manaekic, bâbâpiaŋ i no hâcne, moc mi jujâmbâŋkekac.
No hâcne mâreŋ sawao â mâreŋ kereŋnao hone soŋaŋ egarepo.
Mâc jaŋe ine nânâ mâriri fojareha nâ gapec embiŋ, ehuc maŋfefe erâ nore nikec‐jopawec.
Irec no laioŋ iŋucne ejarezepac, â qowi mimicne lepad iŋucne hatao ruc bajarezepac.
No bea neŋgocnezi motecfâcne rocjopapie momori eekac irec sâc erâ kicjopazepac, ehuc amec‐jeŋic kisuc qâsuckerâ laioŋ iŋucne erâ nâcjopazepac; qowi mimicne jaŋe kisuc qâsuc‐jopanʒepieŋ hâcne.
O Israe, no sipiricgupemu, ehame mozi moc sâcne baficguocmu?
Ŋicwofuŋgezi baficguocmu e weni? Me fekicnefâcge dâŋgiere baficguniŋmu jaŋe sasawa weni? Go jaŋere ʒiŋuc mumeŋ hâcne: “Ŋicwofuŋ â ŋic fekicne râec‐jopa‐narezemec!”
No aaricko ŋicwofuŋ râe‐garekopac, erâ kimbeŋ‐nanere mocwâc gowac rokopac.
Eferaim kiŋ bahac‐ticne i râe basanaŋ ekicne fokac, â sâqocne‐ticne i râe guruc ekicne fokac wâc.
Eferaim fuazo eme neŋgocnezi gozi kiwec, mâc e motec mutucne, irec dameŋne maickeme neŋgoc bumaŋkonec fuaocte mi manasuwec.
No riŋjeŋic rope hâmoc haeonec wefunʒepieŋ, me hâmockonec batarac‐jopazepac me? O hâmoc, go hucge sâqocne i weni? O hâmoc hae, go sisipiricge weni? Buuruc i norao mocwâc mi fokac.
Eferaim e opâ ŋoŋondeŋko ʒamac ʒamac iŋucne fua biaŋ eocmuo ine sifu Wofuŋte mâŋâŋ ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec â mâreŋ sawaonec fisirâ qame opâ nombâŋ‐ticne kereŋkeocmu, â opâ ʒâŋe‐ticne ʒickeocmu; ehame boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ‐ticne â mafa wiac biaŋ‐ticne jâoc rofâreocmu.
Samaria ŋic jaŋe Anutu‐jeŋic fecnembiŋte kiŋjeŋic âsickehuc junʒepieŋ. Jaŋe ʒikazi nâcjopazejec, ɋiefâc‐jeŋic henʒaŋ qanʒaŋ‐jopanʒepieŋ, â ŋokac kiwechec jaŋe bujeŋic sâqezi hefâucke‐jarenʒepieŋ.
O Israe, go Wofuŋ Anutuge erao risiezemec, go kiŋ bahacgere erâ fâfâcguwec hâcne.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ ʒi bajuhuc Wofuŋtao risierâ âzâcneniŋ: “Go sâqocne‐nâŋec bâtâmire‐fârec, erâ ehâmo‐nârec, eme nâŋe micbipic‐nâŋeczi muteŋ bâteŋ egarenʒepeneŋ.
Asiriazi mi bafic‐nâpozejec, nâŋe becâsic faio rac warec mi enʒepeneŋ, ehuc meqâreŋ‐nâŋec i ʒiŋuc mocwâc mi âzâcnenʒepeneŋ: ‘Anutu‐nâŋec’. Bekâ mâsiŋ jaŋe gorao aki anonoc bâfuaeŋgopieŋ hâcne.”
No ine maŋrâŋgeŋ‐jeŋic bâuruepemu, ehuc buafec jaha maŋjauŋ ejarepemu; no kimbeŋ‐nane bârâriepo hâcne.
No titikuc iŋucne erâ Israe bâgunuckepemu, eme ʒariŋ iŋucne âri qazejec, â jâmâzâc iŋucne gâtâ sicneme huzejec.
Ehame fierâ qaratieme oliwa jâc iŋucne biaŋkerâ domazejec, ehuc âsune Lebanoŋ jâckâtere âsu biaŋ iŋucne fizejec.
Jaŋe risierâ nore mumucko ŋec foc enʒepieŋ, ehuc padi jacgoŋ iŋucne fua biaŋ erâ waiŋte sâc âri qanʒepieŋ, ehame âsu‐jeŋic i Lebanoŋ waiŋte âsu biaŋ irec sâc fizejec.
O Eferaim, nemuɋâŋ jaŋe wemo wiac moc egareniŋmu? Noni hâcne mana‐garehuc jowacgupemu, no wetejâc ɋâricne iŋucne erâ domazepac, ehame wiac fârine noraonec hâcne rohuc jucmu.
Mamanahec juekaczi dâŋ ʒirec fuŋne manazejec, â maŋfârihec juekaczi mana tarazejec. Wofuŋte hata i tiŋne sasawa, irec ŋic tiŋne jaŋe ira raeŋgopieŋ, qaqatara ŋic jaŋe ine ira fâfâc‐jopame waha jopaekac.
Wofuŋte dâŋ Petuere ŋokâ Joele erao fuawec ʒiŋe hâcne.
Ŋicraŋɋa ŋoŋe mananiŋ, â ŋic ŋokac sasawa ŋoŋe hazec râe‐fâreniŋ! Wiac ʒi fuawec iŋucne ŋoŋere dameŋko, me mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere dameŋko moc fuawec me?
Ŋoŋe irec binaŋ naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic bajarenʒepieŋ, eme jaŋe ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic jazanʒepieŋ, â ŋosafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe apafâc‐ŋeŋic binaŋ ijaha bajarenʒepieŋ wâc.
Hâpic repicne jaŋe fisirâ wiac nânâne gâcne nâhuc gâcne nâ bâtiric epie fowec, i hâpic âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋe arecne arecne fisirâ nâraku nâmiziembiŋ.
Waiŋ opâ ɋâricne ŋowac rokicnere âmbâŋ nâ areŋ eeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe mana ɋâɋârerâ kio owa eniŋ.
Râsi tâpiri sâkohec â wowosene tâmiric jaŋe mâreŋ‐nane ima baniŋte ware fisimbiŋ, micsiec‐jeŋic i laioŋte micsiec iŋucne, â laioŋ ŋokacnere micʒârâ irec sâc.
Jaŋe waiŋ qizec‐nane ima bambiŋ, â jâmbojâc‐nane sipirickembiŋ, ehuc sahacne nâhockepie qaŋqaŋ fua‐fârewec.
Ŋoŋe ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ moc ŋicbiŋe‐ticne hâmome mateŋ qonaŋkerâ kio mamakuc eekac irec sâc kio mamakuc enʒepieŋ.
Taha bâzire wiac â waiŋzi taha bâzi rârâe i Wofuŋte ufuŋko omae‐fârewec, eme taha bapa, Wofuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa hâcne, jaŋe busâqoc manahuc juŋgopieŋ.
Giegaŋ wiac ima bafârekicne, irec mâreŋzi makuc bakac; padi jacgoŋ wiac sipirickekicne, â waiŋ jâcne hâmo ɋaŋac ewec, â oliwa jâczi ururucke‐fârewec.
Gieo wiac fârine arictac efârewecte he sarac eeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe padi â jacgoŋ basahuc bipic tatara eŋarezejec, â waiŋ gie rune ŋoŋe kio owa enʒepieŋ.
Waiŋ qizecne i hâmo ɋaŋac ewec, jâmbojâczi ururuckewec, hâmeŋ fâric â nemuja erâ jâc wiac gâcne sasawa i hâmo ɋaŋac efârembiŋ hâcne. Ehame ŋic ʒeri bubiaŋ‐jeŋiczi hetikieme ki busâqoc fuawec.
O taha bapa, ŋoŋe mateŋ qonaŋkerâ kio mamakuc eniŋ, â alatao gie baeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe kio owa eniŋ. O Anutu‐nanere kiŋaŋ qaqafâc, ŋoŋe Anutu‐ŋeŋicte ufuŋko taha bâzi rârâe, â waiŋzi taha bâzi i omaewecte taha ufuŋko ferâ ŋafeo mateŋ‐ŋeŋichec juniŋ.
Ŋoŋe nânâ sowa jujure dameŋ moc mupaŋkenʒepieŋ, ehuc kikefuŋ hetumaŋ‐jopanʒepieŋ. Erâ micne bapa â ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋe ejarepie Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte ufuŋko tumaŋne‐fârehuc Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnenʒepieŋ.
Jei, dameŋ ʒi ʒâic dameŋ! Wofuŋte dameŋ sâko maickekac hâcne, ehuc tâpiri rune eraonec sisipiric‐ticnehec fisikac i.
Jei, nânâ wiac‐nâŋec i ʒâŋe fai‐nâŋecko omaewec, â ʒeri bubiaŋ i Anutu‐nâŋecte ficko arictac ewec wâc.
Wiac ukicne sarambiŋ i ɋaŋa‐fârekac, â nânâ ficne ficne rowaŋ tacne forakac; erâ nânâ mâriri mi fuawecte nânâfic gâcne mâc ŋehuc hericke ʒaŋ efârekac.
Nânâ‐jeŋic omae‐fârewecte qowi jaŋe owackeŋgopieŋ, bulimakao jaŋe betaŋkeŋgopieŋ, â lama jaŋe hâmo sipiric eŋgopieŋ.
O Wofuŋ, ʒoczi sopâc mâreŋko qowi jaŋere nânâ ʒafârewec, â ʒocbâruŋzi gieo jâc wiac doma rawec i ʒâseŋke‐fârewec, irec gorao kio wâwâsic ekopac.
Opâ ʒicke‐fârewec, â ʒoczi wiac nânâne ʒâseŋke‐fârewecte kâte qowi jaŋe iŋuc jaha gorao kio owa eŋgopieŋ.
Zioŋko qeŋ qaniŋ, tiri tiki‐naneo owacke sâqorehuc fânâŋkeniŋ! Wofuŋte dameŋ sâkozi biac maickekacte Juda mâreŋte ŋecjucfâc jaŋe ɋarac ɋarac qafâreniŋ!
Ʒoaŋ ira hae mâreŋ gâpâreme dapâc fuaocmu, karorac ɋâfoŋne â dapâc qisiric fuaocmu hâcne. Dudubi karoraczi mâreŋ sâckeekac, irec sâc râsi guru sâko â tâpirihec jaŋe tiki botâŋ sâc fuarâ qaratieŋgopieŋ. Wiac iŋucne mârâc jaha moc mi fuawec, erâ mimiŋzi ɋâric jufeniŋmu sâc mi fuazokac wâc.
Ʒoczi wiac ʒâseŋkeekac irec sâc wiac nâmizieŋgopieŋ, eme râpefuŋ‐jeŋicko wiac tiwâne moc mi fokac. Mai‐jeŋicko mâreŋ fokac i Edeŋ jufu gie iŋucne, â râpefuŋ‐jeŋicko niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fokac, jaŋe wiac moc mi akickeŋgopieŋ.
Hawari‐jeŋic i becâsic jaŋere hawari iŋucne, â gagasac‐jeŋic i becâsic jaŋe ʒikao gasackeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc.
Jaŋe ʒika keretaczi fânâŋkeekac irec sâc fânâŋkehuc tiki botâŋ sâc fuahuc raŋgopieŋ, â ʒoczi sopâc ʒahuc fânâŋkeekac, me ʒikaŋic guru sâko jaŋe ʒikao raniŋte ʒawierâ semuja hehuc fânâŋkeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc fânâŋkeŋgopieŋ.
Fisipie ŋicne ŋicne bipic‐jeŋic tarame weaŋke‐fâreŋgopieŋ.
Momori ŋic jaŋe ʒika qaniŋte tararâ raeŋgopieŋ irec sâc raŋgopieŋ, ʒikaŋic iŋucne qânâsacko ferâ qambaraŋkeŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe moc mi qâsoriehuc hata‐jeŋickoa dândâŋne raŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe hatao hehetuŋ mi ehuc ru sâc hata‐jeŋickoa raŋgopieŋ, râsi jaŋere tepe wiac hone‐bipiehuc fotâcnerâ raŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Jaŋe hae sâko rauckeniŋte ʒoɋac sâko eŋgopieŋ, erâ qânâsacko fe qambaraŋkerâ fic sâc babarâ feŋgopieŋ, ehuc fiuc roro iŋucne qâqâtâc kataŋko raʒiŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Jaŋe fisipie mâreŋzi qiriŋ qakac, â sambâŋzi ɋiɋiteckekac; mosa â ʒoaŋ jahe gâpârekopirec, â bâpiŋ tatamaczi gâkowakac.
Wofuŋ e momorifâc‐ticne bânie‐jarehuc dâŋeme ɋuŋ hawari ekac; momorifâc‐ticne jaŋe guru dindiŋ, â dâŋ rereŋfâcne jaŋe tâpiri sâkohec. Jei, Wofuŋte dameŋ i dameŋ sâko erâ dameŋ hâhâwicne, irec mozi sanaŋkerâ domaocmu?
Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ajoc, ŋoŋe ʒiŋuczia nânâ sowa juhuc ki busâqoc erâ maŋŋeŋic bârisie‐jâmbâŋkerâ norao risieniŋ!
Ŋoŋe busâqoc fârine manahuc maŋŋeŋic bârisieniŋ, ŋaqi sawa mi bâsuckeniŋ.” Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic erao risie‐jâmbâŋkeniŋ! E hâcne aki anonoc‐ticnehec â buuruc‐ticnehec, e kimbeŋ‐ticne uneŋne â miriŋ‐ticne ɋârâŋne, e okac babazure mâcne, kiŋ bebehere manasuhuc juekac.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec e busâqoc manahuc maŋne moc risieocmu mecne, erâ ehâmo‐nârehuc mume padi â jacgoŋ fuaocmu. Iŋuc fuame nâŋâc taha bâzi â waiŋzi taha sâcne râcnenaŋmu.
Zioŋ tikio qeŋ qaniŋ, ehuc nânâ sowa jujure dâŋ mupaŋkeniŋ, erâ tutumaŋ moc fuaocte ʒâfo baniŋ.
Ŋic ŋokac hetumaŋ‐jopahuc baʒawiec‐jopaniŋ; ehuc ŋic ŋokac qizecne erâ naru motec kâcɋene â susuonec jaŋe mâmâc ejarepie fisi‐fârenʒepieŋ. Â socɋâri jaŋe wâc tutumaŋko fuarâ junʒepieŋ.
Taha bapa, Wofuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqafâc, jaŋe hae gâŋgâŋ â alata ŋondeŋ‐jekicko ira kiohuc ʒiŋuc numunʒepieŋ: “O Wofuŋ, go ŋicfâcge nâŋe busâqoc mana‐nârec, ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe biŋefâcge nâŋe qaisoc‐nâporâ gâwie‐nârehuc ʒiŋuc munʒipiŋte: ‘Anutu‐jeŋic weni?’”
Eme Wofuŋ e mâreŋ‐ticnere mana mezac ehuc ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere busâqoc manawec.
Ehuc ŋicfâc‐ticne dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc bâtikie‐jarewec: “Manaŋgopieŋ, no padi, waiŋ â wokemaŋ râe‐ŋarepe nâ gapec enʒepieŋ, erâ ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhapie mocwâc mana wahac‐ŋopaniŋte mi mana‐jarepemu.
“No faic mâreŋkonec râsifâc‐ŋeŋic bâsuec‐jopape behec‐ŋoparâ mâreŋ burocnao ranʒepieŋ; bânieŋgopieŋzi ra Hâwec Hâmocnao hunʒepieŋ, â ʒâhec juŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine Mâreŋ Ŋoŋondeŋ Hâwecko hurâ hâmo gârec ehuc âsu finʒepieŋ, jaŋe wiac hâhâwicne eŋarembiŋte iŋuc hâcne ejarepemu.
“O mâreŋte ŋecjucfâc, ŋoŋe mi hâwic‐ŋopaoc, Wofuŋ e wiac qeŋ bipinehec bâfuawecte bubiaŋ manahuc ʒeri enʒepieŋ.
Â qowi ŋoŋe wâc mi hâwic‐ŋopaoc, mâreŋ burocnere sopâc kecɋaŋzi fie rurucke‐fârekac hâcne; jâc wiac i hândâŋ fârihec efârekac, erâ jâmbojâc â waiŋ qizecne jaŋe fâri rarauhec efâreŋgopieŋ.
“Zioŋte ŋic ŋokac, ŋoŋe bubiaŋ mananiŋ, ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic ʒeri bari ecneniŋ! Eki hâcne mume qanaŋ jaha hoe heŋarewec, erâ mârâc jaha ejujec iŋuc jaha miŋecgac mume hoe ʒoaŋ sâckoa fua‐ŋarekac.
“Irec padi bâbâmârâŋ fic i padizi fusucmaocmu, erâ waiŋ â wokemaŋzi pake wiac i fusucmarâ qâmbâriŋkeocmu.
Hâpic gurune gurune jaŋe jara sâc wiac‐ŋeŋic nâmiziembiŋ, irec okacne bâfua‐ŋarepemu; Hâpic jaŋe hâcne momorifâc‐nane, i noni sorec‐jopape fisi‐ŋarembiŋ.
“Ŋoŋe nânâ mâriri fua‐ŋareme nâ gapec enʒepieŋ, ehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi ŋoŋerao mâsi sâko bawec e hâcne muteŋkenʒepieŋ. Ehame ŋicfâc‐nane ŋoŋerao mimi qaqa mocwâc mi fuazejec.
Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ: No Israe ŋic ŋoŋere ŋondeŋko juekopac, Wofuŋ no hâcne Anutu‐ŋeŋic, moczi moc mi jukac. Irec ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋerao mimi qaqa mocwâc mi fuazejec.
“Eme juku Mâro‐nane ŋic ʒeŋgoma sâcke‐jarepemu, ehame otâ ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe findaŋdâŋ muhuc juniŋmu, erâ ŋicqizecfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe guŋ fârine mananiŋmu, â socɋârifâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe maŋzi wiac ʒâŋe furu honeniŋmu.
Erâ dameŋ ira kiŋaŋ qaqa ŋic ŋokacfâc‐ŋeŋic Mâro‐nane tahac‐jopapemu wâc.
“Ehuc mupe faic sambâŋko â juwic mâreŋko wiac ʒâŋe furu fuaocmu, soc â ʒoc â hosâc sâko fuaocmu hâcne.
Wofuŋte dameŋ i bipic tataranehec maickeme ʒoaŋzi gâpâreocmu â mosazi sosoc eocmu.
Eme Wofuŋte ʒâŋe riwaseckehuc juniŋmu jaŋe dameŋ ira sisipirickonec batarac‐jopa‐fârezo. Wofuŋzi muwec irec sâcko Zioŋ tikio â Jerusalem haeo ŋeŋezic fuaocmu hâcne; ehame Wofuŋzi hefârec‐jopaocmu jaŋe sisipiriczi riric‐jopaha juniŋmu.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, no dameŋ ira Juda mâreŋko â Jerusalem haeo ʒârâ ʒâpâ fokac i bârâriepemu.
Ehuc ŋicne ŋicne hetumaŋ‐joparâ Wofuŋte mumutara wâneŋko bacjopa hupemu. Ira Israe biŋefâc‐nane jaŋere erâ dâŋgieo râec‐jopapemu. Jaŋe ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐jopambiŋ, ehuc mâreŋ‐nane bâtâc bambiŋte iŋuc ejarepemu.
Jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere erâ qaŋgec qambiŋ, erâ motec moc râepie sasec ŋokac kitâcnewec, â naru moc râepie waiŋ opâ kitâcneme nâmbiŋ.
