“Tiro â Sidoŋ â Filisa mâreŋ rune ŋoŋe no wemo enarezo muŋgopieŋ? Wiac eŋarepo irec okacne bazu‐nareniŋte muŋgopieŋ me? Moc bazu‐narezo muniŋmuo ine bâruŋ jaha bârisie‐ŋarepe ŋaŋacne faio feocmu.
Ŋoŋe hâcne wiac‐nane furi sâko, siliwa â gol i fiuc rorâ nemu ufuŋ‐ŋeŋicko bafembiŋ.
Ŋoŋe Juda â Jerusalem ŋic ŋokac jaŋacne hae mâreŋkonec rocjoparâ taicko râec‐jopahuc moneŋte erâ Grikŋic qikiŋne‐jarembiŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, ʒi ine moneŋte erâ taicko râec‐jopambiŋkonec ejarepe risie warenʒepieŋ, ehame no irec okacne bazu‐ŋarepe fai‐ŋeŋicko fezejec.
Ehuc noni otâ ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic Judaŋic jaŋere meo râec‐jopape feniŋmu, eme jaŋe ŋicguru moc mâreŋ ʒoricko juŋgopieŋ, Sebaŋic hâcne, jaŋerao râec‐jopahuc furi‐jeŋic roniŋmu, Wofuŋzi iŋuc muwec hâcne.
“Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko dâŋ ʒiŋuc musokaniŋ: ‘Ajoc, ʒika qazore ʒawieniŋ, ŋic tâpirihec esoc qafeŋ ejareniŋ. Ʒikaŋic ʒeŋgoma hefârec‐jopapie warenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe kinoŋ‐ŋeŋic bâtikiepie ʒika fuazejec, â sâqe‐ŋeŋiczi damu ezejec; ehame ŋic dodocnezi ʒiŋuc muzejec: “No ŋic qac momori jukopac.”
Ŋic rârec rârec juraŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe bâruŋ jaha fisi‐fârerâ wâneŋko tumaŋneniŋ.’” O Wofuŋ, go momorifâcge jowac‐jopatec ijaha wahanʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe faharerâ Wofuŋte mumutara wâneŋko fisinʒepieŋ, eme no ira hâcne ŋicguru rârec rârec juraŋgopieŋ jaŋere dâŋ mutarapemu.
Qa roro dameŋ maickekacte sâqe mictara roniŋ, â waiŋ hândâŋ katapazi fusucmakacte fe âte pisickeniŋ. Hehesic‐jeŋic bocjaha izi hae mâreŋ sâcke‐fârekac hâcne.”
Wofuŋte dameŋ maickekacte mumutara wâneŋko ŋic guru dindiŋzi guru sâko fisiŋgopieŋ.
Mosa â ʒoaŋ jahe gâpârekopirec, erâ bâpiŋ tatamaczi gâkowakac.
Wofuŋ e Zioŋko owackeocmu, â marac fânâŋ‐ticne Jerusalem haeo fuame sambâŋ â mâreŋ jahe ɋiɋiteckenicmu, ehame Wofuŋ e Israe gurufâc‐ticne jaŋere dapeŋ â huec sanaŋ eocmu.
“Iŋuc fuame ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ: No Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic jukopac, ehuc Zioŋko tiri tiki‐naneo ŋec juc eekopac. Eme Jerusalem i tiri hae erâ ŋeha ŋic jabanezi mocwâc sicne fotâc mi enʒepieŋ.
“Eme dameŋ ira waiŋ mâriri sâko fuaocmu, erâ bulimakao jaŋe mâreŋ facne sâcke‐fâreniŋmu. Juda mâreŋko opâwâc forakac ira opâ fifisine erâ foocmu, erâ Wofuŋte ufuŋkonec opâ ʒâŋe moc fisihuc Sitim wâneŋ bâgunuckeocmu.
“Aigita ŋic jaŋe Judaŋic jaŋerao sindaŋ bâfuahuc mâreŋ‐jeŋicko ŋic bahacmâc jaŋere soc hoŋkembiŋte mâreŋ‐jeŋic i tuhutac fuazejec, â Edom mâreŋ i niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fozejec.
Juda mâreŋ â Jerusalem hae ira ine ŋic jaŋe mimiŋzi ɋâric jurahuc junʒepieŋ.
Soc hoŋkembiŋ jaŋe moc mi akic‐jopahuc kiŋjeŋic batarapemu, Wofuŋ no Zioŋko ŋec juc eekopac hâcne.”
Tekoa haeonec lama soŋaŋ jumbiŋ jaŋeraonec ŋic moc ʒâŋene Amosi ere dâŋ ʒiŋe hâcne. E maŋʒâŋene tâcneme Israe ŋic jaŋerao wiac fuaocmu i honewec. Eme jufehapie jara 2 tarame homeŋ sâko bawec. Ine Uʒijazi Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ juwec, â Jeroboam, Jehoasire ŋokâ hâcne, eki Israere ŋicwofuŋ juwec dameŋ ira wiac i honewec.
Ehuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Wofuŋ owa‐ticnere fânâŋ Zioŋkonec warekac, â Jerusalem haeonec marac fânâŋ‐ticne fisikac; ehame lama jaŋere kecɋaŋzi ɋaŋa ururuc ekac, â Karamele tiki botâŋnao jâc wiac sasawa hâmo qanʒaraŋ efârekac.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Damasko hae rune jaŋe sindaŋnezi sindaŋne bâfuambiŋte no okacne bazu‐jarezo mupo, dâŋ i mi hetâtiepemu, jaŋe aeŋ keretac sâqe micneheczi Gileade mâreŋ rune sipiric‐jopambiŋte.
No irec hâcne ŋicwofuŋ Haʒaele fic hae‐ticne turuŋkepe ʒazejec, ehuc ŋicwofuŋ Beŋhada ere ficsanaŋ wiac ʒâseŋkezejec.
No Damasko haere motâc babasanaŋ qazupemu, ehuc Aweŋ wâneŋte ŋecjucfâcne qâmiziec‐jopapemu, erâ Bete‐Edeŋkonec ŋicwofuŋ gunu bajuekac e iŋuc jaha qape omaeocmu. Ehame Siria mâreŋ rune jaŋe Kiri mâreŋko kâpâcwâru ficko raniŋmu.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Gaza hae rune jaŋe wiac sindaŋnezi sindaŋne bâfuambiŋte no okacne bazu‐jarezo mupo, dâŋ i mi hetâtiepemu, jaŋe ŋic ŋokac naru motec furu jaha Edomŋic jaŋere meo râec‐jopambiŋte kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic bacjopa jumbiŋ hâcne.
Eme no irec hâcne Gaza haere sac turuŋkepe ʒahuc ficsanaŋ‐ticne ŋerakac i ʒâseŋkezejec.
Erâ no Asidode ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe mecne, â Asikaloŋ haere ŋicwofuŋ gunu bajuekac e mâmâc bâsirowec‐jopapemu. No Ekoroŋ ŋic râsi ejarepemu, ehame Filisa ŋic nâfocne juŋgopieŋ jaŋe wâc siroweniŋmu.” Wofuŋ Anuture dâŋ iŋuc.
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Tiro hae rune jaŋe wiac sindaŋnezi sindaŋne bâfuambiŋte no okacne bazu‐jarezo mupo, dâŋ i mi hetâtiepemu, jaŋe ŋic ŋokac naru motec furu jaha Edomŋic jaŋere meo râec‐jopahuc, âgo ʒâʒâfic‐jeŋic fowec irec mi manasumbiŋ.
No irec hâcne Tiro haere sac turuŋkepe ʒahuc ficsanaŋ‐ticne ŋerakac i ʒâseŋkezejec.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Edomŋic jaŋe wiac sindaŋnezi sindaŋne bâfuambiŋte no okacne bazu‐jarezo mupo, dâŋ i mi hetâtiepemu, jaŋe qomâfâc‐jeŋic busâqoc moc mi mana‐jarehuc ʒikazi jopa jâpec ejarembiŋ, ehuc kimbeŋ aaric‐jeŋic sakarehuc raŋɋa raŋɋa bajumbiŋ.
No irec hâcne mupe ʒoczi Temaŋ mâreŋko fuarâ ʒazejec, ehuc Bozera haere ficsanaŋ ʒâseŋke‐fârezejec.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Amoŋŋic jaŋe wiac sindaŋnezi sindaŋne bâfuambiŋte no okacne bazu‐jarezo mupo, dâŋ i mi hetâtiepemu, jaŋe mâreŋ‐jeŋicte ma bâsokaniŋte Gileade haeo ŋokac kiwechec jumbiŋ jaŋe mi akic‐jopahuc bujeŋic hefâuckembiŋ.
No irec hâcne Raba haere sac turuŋkepe ʒazejec, ehuc ficsanaŋ‐ticne i ʒika qahuc aŋara hehapie ʒâʒâkiriŋ mâŋâŋzi tâpirihec ficneme ʒâseŋke‐fârezejec.
Ehame ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic e fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋehec mâmâc kâpâcwâru ficko bacjopa raniŋmu.” Wofuŋtao dâŋ iŋuc.
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Moabi ŋic jaŋe wiac sindaŋnezi sindaŋne bâfuambiŋte no okacne bazu‐jarezo mupo, dâŋ i mi hetâtiepemu, jaŋe Edom ŋicwofuŋ siec‐ticne ʒocko râepie ʒahuc huc iŋucne duŋtowec.
No irec hâcne mupe Moabi mâreŋko ʒoc fuarâ ʒazejec, ehuc Kerioti hae ficsanaŋ‐ticne ʒâseŋke‐fârezejec. Ehame Moabi ŋic jaŋe qeŋ dâŋehame ʒikare fânâŋ â micʒonʒoŋ irec maŋnao hâmonʒepieŋ.
Eme no ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko guriŋ bapa ŋic jukac e bâsirowehuc fekicnefâc‐jeŋic ehec mâmâc qâhâmoc‐jopapemu.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Judaŋic jaŋe wiac sindaŋnezi sindaŋne bâfuambiŋte no okacne bazu‐jarezo mupo, dâŋ i mi hetâtiepemu, jaŋe Wofuŋ nore sâcmutâc dâŋ qâsuahuc dâŋsanaŋ‐nane mi reŋkembiŋ, ehuc mamacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe nemu wiac burecne bâjâpec‐jopahuc jumbiŋ nemu izi hâcne eatuc‐jopapie qâsoriembiŋ.
No irec hâcne mupe Juda mâreŋko ʒoc fuarâ ʒazejec, ehuc Jerusalem ficsanaŋ‐ticne ʒâseŋke‐fârezejec.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Israe ŋic jaŋe wiac sindaŋnezi sindaŋne bâfuambiŋte no okacne bazu‐jarezo mupo, dâŋ i mi hetâtiepemu, jaŋe ŋic tiŋne moneŋte erâ qikiŋ‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic tac qararacne kikehuhure erâ behec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋic qarâ suriŋne ro waha âte ejareeŋgopieŋ, ehuc qoro tutucnefâc‐jeŋic qaisoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, ehame mame ŋokâ jaŋe naru ŋokac mocjaha erao rahuc tiri ʒâŋe‐nane wâwânâŋ ecneeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋaqi qoruc hotâ jowac rorâ bajuhuc alata sasawa maŋfuŋ‐jeŋicko rumackerâ foeŋgopieŋ, erâ ŋic gâcnezi kiŋ babatara moneŋ râepie izi waiŋ opâ furine barâ Anutu‐jeŋicte ficko nâeŋgopieŋ.
“Noni hâcne bânie‐ŋarehuc Amori ŋic bâsirowec‐jopapo, jaŋe jâmâzâc jâc iŋucne ŋic ʒoricne, â sasanaŋ‐jeŋic i bonejâc irec sâc; eme no sifu faic tieŋnao hândâŋne fuawec â juwic gâtâne sicneme huwec i mâmâc bâsirowe‐fârepo.
Erâ Amori ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ ro rauc eniŋte nonizia wâc Aigita mâreŋkonec batarac‐ŋoparâ mâreŋ sawao jowac‐ŋopa warehuc juhape jara 40 tarawec.
Erâ nonizia ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋeraonec gâcne porofete juniŋte bâwosâec‐jopapo, â ŋicmotecfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋeraonec gâcne Anutu nore biŋe jusanaŋkeniŋte bâtiric‐jopapo. O Israe ŋicbureŋ, no iŋuc moc mi epo me?” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
“Ŋoŋe ine ŋic bâtiric‐jopakicne jaŋe waiŋ opâ gumec‐jopambiŋ, ehuc porofete ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ, ‘Ŋoŋe findaŋdâŋ mi munʒepieŋ.’
“Manaŋgopieŋ, mâreŋ âteeŋgopieŋ i noni mupe qiriŋ qaocmu, ine keretaczi mafa sâko derâ hewic qâwic ehuc raekac irec sâc.
Eme kike afec juekaczi wiserâ raocte sifu eipieocmu, â sasanaŋheczi tâpiri basaocmu, erâ momori ŋic e juju‐ticne sâcne mi ŋezickeocmu.
Tepeŋic e sanaŋkerâ sâcne mi domaocmu, â kike afeczi sâcne mi wiseocmu, erâ becâsicko rara ŋic e juju‐ticne sâcne mi ŋezickeocmu.
Ehame ŋic momori wânʒâŋ jaŋeraonec hâbihec juekaczi ʒoaŋ ira ʒikare wiac‐ticne beherâ metariŋ wiseocmu.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
O Israe ŋic guru sâc, Wofuŋzi ŋoŋere ʒiŋuc mukac: Aigita mâreŋkonec batarac‐ŋoparâ jowac‐ŋopa warepo ŋoŋere okacdâŋ kecʒiŋuc bajukopac i mupe mananiŋ:
“Mâreŋko ŋic gurune gurune juraŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec ŋoŋe sawa rowosâec‐ŋopapo, irec no hehesic‐ŋeŋic sasaware erâ bâtiŋ‐ŋopapemu.
“Ŋic jajaheczi muc manac mi ehuc hata wirec sâcne ranicmu me?
Me laioŋ moczi kâteo qowi mi kihuc owa sâko sâcne eocmu? Me laioŋ motec ɋârizi qowi mi bâfuarâ qânâ hawec‐ticnao fohuc dâŋeocmu me?
Me mâreŋko bitiŋ mi foha wipe moc sâcne kiocmu? Me wiac moczi bitiŋko mi raʒiha fuc herâ sâcne fahareocmu?
Me hae moc wena qeŋ dâŋeme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe mi fâfâreniŋmu, me Wofuŋzi mi muhame hae moc ira wiac hâhâwicne moc fuaocmu me?
Jâmbomac, Wofuŋ Anutu e kiŋaŋŋicfâc‐ticne porofete jaŋe dâŋticne soŋne mi mufua‐jarehuc wiac moc mi eocmu.
Laioŋzi owackeme mozi hâhâwic tâmiric juocmu? Wofuŋ Anutuzi dâŋ mume mozi qâoma ehuc findaŋdâŋ mi muocmu?”
Asiria ŋicwofuŋ ficko â Aigita mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ ficko dâŋ kecʒiŋuc musokapie mananʒepieŋ: “Ŋoŋe Samaria mâreŋte tikio tumaŋnenʒepieŋ, ehuc hae mâreŋ ira ojowa sâko â bâbâʒâic fokac i hone manac enʒepieŋ.”
“Ficsanaŋ‐jeŋicko sindaŋ â bâbâʒâic faio fefec he feeŋgopieŋzi wiac tiŋne eniŋte kâuc baeŋgopieŋ.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
Irec Wofuŋ Anutuzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Râsi jaŋe hae mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic orâŋkeniŋmu, ehuc sacsanaŋ‐ŋeŋic heroc qâropierâ ficsanaŋ‐ŋeŋickonec wiac fiuc roniŋmu.”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Lama soŋaŋ moczi laioŋ mickonec lama kike hâŋne jajahec â hazec ŋifecne sawa roocmu, irec sâc jaha Israe ŋic Samaria mâreŋko jueŋgopieŋzi bilaŋke â fofo qoruc furi sâko i sawa barâ wiseniŋmu.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu hâcne, ere dâŋ ʒiŋuc fokac i manarâ Jakobore kikefuŋ mutaniŋke‐jareniŋ:
“No Israe ŋic sindaŋ‐jeŋicte okacne bazu‐jarepemu, dameŋ ira Bete haeo alata ŋerakac i sipirickehuc alata ʒuŋe‐jeŋic hezupe mâreŋko waha qaocmu.
Eme no hoe dameŋte fic mecne, â ʒoaŋ dameŋte fic mecne i mâmâc heroc qâropiepemu, ehame fic elefaŋte ʒuŋenezi ba eric ekicne, â fic sâko mako gâcne i mâmâc omae‐fâreocmu.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
“Basaŋ mâreŋte bulimakao Samaria tikio jueŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe dâŋ ʒi mananiŋ! Ŋoŋe ŋic qarâ suriŋne fific bacjopaeŋgopieŋ, â hapetac jaŋe imac‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, erâ ŋowefâc‐ŋeŋic ʒiŋuc jazaeŋgopieŋ: ‘Waiŋ opâ bawarepie nanaŋ!’
Ŋoŋere hâcne Wofuŋ Anutuzi tiri juju‐ticnere erâ ʒiŋuc mupaŋkewec: Manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ moc maic‐ŋopaocmu ira hawicko rocŋoparâ bacŋopa raniŋmu, jei, ʒâŋetucfâc‐ŋeŋic mâmâc rocjopa‐fâreniŋmu.
Eme ŋoŋe sac hawec sâc râpeo soŋsoŋ hufâreniŋmu, ehame tuŋŋopapie Herimoŋ tikiopec ranʒepieŋ.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
“Bete haeo rarâ qaqatara gie ʒuhuckerâ baniŋ, Giligali haeo rarâ qaqatara bâŋɋârâŋkehuc eniŋ, furic sâc taha bâzi‐ŋeŋic rikeniŋ, erâ ʒoaŋ jahec â moc tarame sâc teŋkonec wâŋŋeŋic râeniŋ!
Daŋge taha râeniŋte poroŋ goreŋhec rikeniŋ, erâ buafec faio taha rârâe‐ŋeŋicte dâŋ musokaniŋ. Israe ŋic ŋoŋe iŋuc hâcne eniŋte boc aŋac‐ŋopaekac.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
“Noni hâcne mupe hae‐ŋeŋic sâc nânâ poroŋ babasa fuame nânâ wiac‐ŋeŋic omae‐fârewec, ŋoŋe ine sifu norao mi risiembiŋ.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
“Noni hâcne qa roro dameŋte mosa jahec â moc juwicnao hoe sakare‐ŋarepo. Ehuc mupe hae mocko hoe hewec â hae moc i mâc fowec, ehame giegaŋ moc i hoezi bâgunuckewec, â giegaŋ moc i mâc fohuc hâmo ɋaŋac ewec.
Iŋuc fuame hae 2 me 3 irec rune jaŋe hae mocko opâ nâniŋte rarâ nâpie mi gapec‐jopawec. Eme ŋoŋe sifu norao mi risiembiŋ.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
“Noni mupe jacgoŋ‐ŋeŋic ʒararaŋ ʒahuc hâmo ɋaŋac ewec, ehuc nânâ â waiŋ gie‐ŋeŋic imacke‐ŋarepo, ehame nemuja â oliwa jâc wiac‐ŋeŋic i ɋirikiŋzi nâfârewec, ŋoŋe ine sifu norao mi risiembiŋ.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
“No mupe Aigita mâreŋko huc hâmoc fuawec, sâc ijaha mupe ŋoŋe fua‐ŋarewec, no ŋicmotecfâc‐ŋeŋic ʒikazi jopa sipiric ejarepo, ehuc becâsicfâc‐ŋeŋic ŋowac rorâ bacjopa rapo, erâ ŋeŋe juju embiŋ toma ira mupe âsu fuarâ sâke‐ŋeŋicko fewec, ŋoŋe ine sifu norao mi risiembiŋ.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
“Anutu noni mârâc jaha Sodom â Gomora hae ima bacjofapo, irec sâc jaha ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ima sâko bâfuapo. Iŋuc eŋarepe ŋoŋe ʒockonec tucne moc rokicne irec sâc embiŋ, erâ sifu norao mi risiembiŋ.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
“O Israe ŋic, no irec hâcne wiac mukicne eŋarepemu, eme iŋuc eŋarepemure ŋoŋe Anutu‐ŋeŋic nore maio fuaniŋte ʒawienʒepieŋ.”
Manaŋgopieŋ, tiki â mâŋâŋ bâfuac‐jofawec, erâ maŋ mamana biri‐ticne ŋic mufua‐jareekac, ehuc mume fureekac â ŋafeekac, erâ wâc mâreŋ facne sâc âterâ raekac, e Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, ʒâŋe‐ticne iŋuc fokac.
O Israe kikefuŋ, no ŋoŋere erâ makuc bahuc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mupe mananiŋ:
“Israe ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ e waha qawec fokac i mocwâc mi fahareocmu, e mâreŋ‐ticnao raŋe foha moczi mocwâc mi bafahareocmu.”
Wofuŋ Anutu e dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Hae mockonec ŋic wâŋ tauseŋzi ʒikao rarâ gâcne sâko hâmopie nâfocne 100 sawa juniŋmu, â hae mockonec 100 jaŋe rapie nâfocne 10 sawa risieniŋmu; Israe kikefuŋ ŋoŋerao iŋuc hâcne fuaocmu.”
Wofuŋ e Israe kikefuŋ ʒiŋuc ŋazakac hâcne: “Ŋoŋe no wira basac enarehuc sâcne juniŋmu.
Bete ufuŋ ine moc mi iqickenʒepieŋ, ehuc Giligali haeo mi raʒinʒepieŋ, â Bere‐Seba haeo sicne fotâc wâc mi enʒepieŋ; Giligali rune jaŋe kâpâcwâruo raniŋmu, â Bete ufuŋzi siroweocmu hâcne.”
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ wira basac ecnehuc sâcne juniŋmu, iŋuc mi epie ine Wofuŋzi mume ʒoc fuarâ Josefere kikefuŋ, Israe kikefuŋ hâcne ʒacŋopaocmu, ehame moczi moc sâcne mi qâhâpoocmu.
Jei, ŋoŋe mumutiŋ dâŋ bârisiepie dâŋ hâtâne eekac, â tiŋne juju i behe qaisoc ecneeŋgopieŋ!
Bâpiŋ ʒâŋe‐jeŋic demeŋ ɋafâc â bobiri bâfuac‐jopawec, erâ dapâc qisiricte mume hae furic baekac, â ʒoaŋ tatamac herisieme hae ŋafeekac, erâ hâwec opâne wiracneme mâreŋte faio qaratiewec fokac, e ʒâŋe‐ticne Wofuŋ hâcne.
Eki hâcne mume ŋic tâpirihec jaŋe sisipiric ututuŋ fua‐jareekac, ehame ficsanaŋ wiac ima bajarepie omaeekac.
Hae ʒoŋao ŋehuc mumutiŋ gie baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe râsi ejareeŋgopieŋ, â dâŋ fâri qizecne mueŋgopieŋ jaŋe qaisoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic qarâ suriŋne ro waha âte ejarehuc padi jacgoŋ‐jeŋic i takisire biŋe muhuc jowac roeŋgopieŋte qânâ fasaekicnezi fic bambiŋ ira ŋeŋe juju mi enʒepieŋ; erâ waiŋ gie biaŋne he sarac embiŋ i fârine fuame opâne mi nânʒepieŋ.
No manakopac, qaqatara‐ŋeŋic i guru sâko, â kiŋŋeŋic i bocjaha; ŋoŋe ŋic tiŋne fific guguriŋ ejareeŋgopieŋ, â bâbâmiriŋ moneŋ rohuc dâŋgieo hapetac jaŋere dâŋ muhasickeeŋgopieŋ.
Dameŋ ʒi ŋemâcne, irec maŋɋârâŋheczi dameŋ iŋucnao niniŋkerâ juzac.
Ŋoŋe sâqocnere mâcne, biaŋnere henʒiriŋnehuc junʒepieŋ, iŋuc ehuc juniŋmu, eme Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki mumbiŋ irec sâcko ŋoŋehec juocmu.
Ŋoŋe sâqocne qaisockehuc biaŋnere eŋarezejec, ehuc hae ʒoŋao ŋic jaŋere dâŋ muhuc mumutiŋ gie bâhâmonʒepieŋ. Iŋuc epie Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e Josefere kikefuŋ nâfocne akic‐jopaocmu mecne.
Irec Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki hâcne ʒiŋuc mukac: “Hae ʒoŋa sâc ki soŋgâŋ fuaocmu, â hae hata sâc dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc kio wâwâsic eniŋmu: ‘Jei, jei!’ Hesarac ŋic jaŋe ki mamakuc eniŋte hefârec‐jopaniŋmu, â ki soŋgâŋte fuŋne mamana jaŋe kigae heniŋte jazapie fisiniŋmu.
Eme waiŋ gie forakac sâc ira ki soŋgâŋ eniŋmu wâc; no ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko fotâcne rapemu, irec wiac i fua raocmu.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
Jei ŋoŋe, Wofuŋ dameŋ‐ticnere maŋhâhâŋ eŋareekac! Wofuŋte dameŋzi wemo wiac moc bâfua‐ŋareocmu? Dameŋ izi tatamac mâcne, dapâc bâfua‐ŋareocmu hâcne.
Ŋic moc e laioŋte wisehame qowi mimicne moc ʒâŋene bea eki bâfuaocmu, me ficko ferâ meticnezi sâpeo bâsiŋnehame homazi kiocmu, irec sâc jaha fua‐ŋareocmu.
Jâmbomac, Wofuŋte dameŋ i tatamac aricne, dapâcnehec fuaocmu, dapâc qisiric fuame ʒoaŋ ʒâziriŋ‐ticne basaniŋmu hâcne.
“No hombaŋ wiac‐ŋeŋic qaisockehuc hone suŋgiŋ ecneekopac, â hombaŋ tutumaŋ‐ŋeŋicte mi aŋacnuekac.
Qowi bâzi me taha bâzi rike‐narepie sifu manape mi biaŋkeocmu, â bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic biuc sâkohec i taha bâzire rike‐narepie hone takirepemu wâc.
Gae‐ŋeŋicte fânâŋ i mai‐naneo omaezejec, â woŋgâŋ fânâŋ‐ŋeŋic manazore takicnuekac.
Mumutiŋ dâŋzi ine opâ fusinehec iŋucne rahuc fozejec, â tiŋne jujuzi ine opâ fifisine iŋucne fohuc juzejec.
“Israe kikefuŋ, ŋoŋe jara 40 sâko mâreŋ sawao juhuc qowi bâzi me taha bâzi moc rike‐nare jumbieŋ me?
Ŋoŋe nemu‐ŋeŋic Sakutu â bâpiŋ nemu‐ŋeŋic Kaiwaŋ jahere hawari ba akic erâ bacjofa jueŋgopieŋ.
Eme no irec hâcne Damasko hae ocniŋucnao kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐ŋopape junʒepieŋ.” Wofuŋ, ʒâŋene Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e iŋuc mukac.
“Jei, ŋicne ŋicne micne bajareeŋgopieŋ, ŋicguru i jaŋere fekicnefâc ŋoŋe! Jei, ŋoŋe Zioŋ haeo maŋbahac fâfâsâc jueŋgopieŋ, â Samaria tikio mana mezac tâmiric ŋehapie Israe kikefuŋ jaŋe fua‐ŋareeŋgopieŋ!
Ŋoŋe Kalene haeo ra honenʒepieŋ, erâ irecnec Hamati haeo ranʒepieŋ, izi Filisa mâreŋko Gati haeo hurâ honenʒepieŋ! Jaŋe ŋicguru ʒi moc siric‐jopahuc biaŋne jueŋgopieŋ? Me jaŋere mâreŋzi ŋoŋere jâuruhuc qaratiewec fokac me?
Oi ŋoŋe, ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋ mana suahuc sisipiric â bâbâʒâic i fârepie fisiekac.
“Jei, elefaŋte ʒuŋenezi fofo‐jeŋic ba eric ekicnao foeŋgopieŋ, â ŋeŋe‐jeŋic sâc otec foeŋgopieŋ, ehuc lama guruonec motecne rorâ hezu rike nâc eeŋgopieŋ, â bulimakao motecne i fickonec rorâ qa nâc eeŋgopieŋ!
Jei, woŋgâŋ qahuc gae wewepâ wiac eeŋgopieŋ, â Dawidi sâckehuc musi wiac bâfuaeŋgopieŋ!
Jei, jaŋe râqâc sâkoonec waiŋ opâ nâeŋgopieŋ, â sahac‐jeŋicko wokemaŋ âsu biaŋ ruaeŋgopieŋ, ehuc Josefere kikefuŋfâc sipirickehapie mana mezac mi ejareeŋgopieŋ!
Jaŋe irec hâcne kâpâcwâru ŋic bânie‐jarepie kâpâcwâru ficko ranʒepieŋ, ehame fofo‐jeŋicko otec fohuc ojowa kosa qaeŋgopieŋ i omaezejec.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi mukac, Wofuŋ Anutu e jahacnao ɋetickehuc ʒiŋuc mupaŋkewec: “No Jakobo maŋ fefe‐ticnere manape tatakicne eekac, â ficsanaŋ‐ticne qaisockehuc hae â maŋnao wiac forakac i râpecke‐fârekopac.”
Eme fic mocko ŋic nâfocne 10 juniŋmuo jaŋe sifu hâmonʒepieŋ wâc.
Eme ŋic hâmokicne mocte soctofazi qâŋɋâŋ duckeocte fickonec bawahahuc fic tuturuŋnao moc ŋeocmu e ʒiŋuc wiocneocmu: “Gohec moczi moc jukac me?’ Mume muocmu: “Aricne”; ehuc ʒuhuckerâ muocmu: “Dâŋ behec, ʒi Wofuŋte ʒâŋe mumune mi ekac.”
Irec mananiŋ: Wofuŋzi mume ficŋeŋic kâcɋene mecne, piticne mecne i mâmâc heroc qâropieniŋmu.
Becâsic jaŋe haroŋaŋ faio sâcne gasackeniŋmu? Me bulimakao jaŋe mâreŋ bâbâfâuc sâqe fârepie hâwec sâcne nâfâuckeocmu me? Ŋoŋe ine mumutiŋ dâŋ bârisiepie qotâre micopâ tinac ewec, â tiŋne jujure fârine bârisiepie kegocjâcte hâtâ iŋucne ewec.
Ŋoŋe wiac fâri tâmiric irec ʒeri eŋgopieŋzi penaroŋ ehuc mueŋgopieŋ: “Nâŋe nâŋâcne tâpirio siŋkehuc sanaŋkembeŋ.”
“O Israe kikefuŋ, ŋoŋe mananiŋ: No ŋicguru moc ejarepe râsi eŋarenʒepieŋ, eme jaŋe Hamati hae ramicnao ira fuŋkerâ fific guguriŋ eŋare rakupie Araba wâneŋte opâwâcko tarazejec.” Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e iŋuc mukac.
Wofuŋ Anutu e maŋko fuac enarerâ wiac kecʒiŋuc nowatume honepo: Kecɋaŋ ʒorakicne i ŋicwofuŋte biŋe bâtâcnepie ʒâhec tucne âke sueme Wofuŋzi mume hâpic fuŋmoc guru sâko fuambiŋ.
Eme hâpic i jaŋe mâreŋ irec kecɋaŋ i nâmiziehapie honerâ mupo: “O Wofuŋ Anutu, go Jakobore kikefuŋ kiŋjeŋic behe‐jarecmurâ numu‐garekopac. Jaŋe wemocko moc sanaŋkerâ juniŋmu? Jaŋe guru pitic sawa i!”
Eme Wofuŋ e irec busâqoc manahuc maŋne risieme ʒiŋuc muwec: “Wiac i mi fuazejec.”
Eme Wofuŋ Anutu e wiac kecʒiŋuc nowatume honepo: Wofuŋ Anutu e okac babazu gie baocte mume ʒoc fuarâ mâreŋmaŋko opâ ʒâkereŋkewec â giegaŋ wiac‐jeŋic forawec i ʒâseŋke‐fârewec wâc.
Iŋuc fuame honerâ mupo: “O Wofuŋ Anutu, go wiac i behecmurâ numu‐garekopac. Jakobore kikefuŋ jaŋe wemocko sanaŋkerâ juniŋmu? Jaŋe guru pitic sawa i!”
Eme Wofuŋ e irec busâqoc manahuc maŋne risieme ʒiŋuc muwec: “Wiac i wâc mi fuazejec.” Wofuŋ Anuture dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme Wofuŋ e wiac kecʒiŋuc nowatume honepo: Wofuŋ e qânâsac dândâŋne bakicne irec fainao domahuc mucsâc moc râeme wahawec.
Iŋuc erâ Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc wio‐narewec: “Amosi, go wemo wiac honekomec?” Wiome mupo: “No mucsâc moc honekopac.” Eme Wofuŋzi muwec: “Manakic, no Israe ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere ŋondeŋko mucsâc moc râekopac; no mocwâc jowaruhuc mi akic‐jopapemu.
No Isakare nemu bâzi ririkere furu mâreŋ ima bapemu, â Israe ɋâŋfic wiac‐jeŋic hetâtiepemu, ehuc Jeroboam kikefuŋfâcne jaŋe râsi ejarehuc ʒikazi jopapemu.”
Eme Bete haeonec taha bapa Amazia e Israe ŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ Jeroboamtao dâŋ ʒiŋuc râeme rawec: “Amosi e Israe ŋic ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko juhuc go râsi egarehuc ŋic maŋbâiŋ ejareekac, eme mâreŋ rune jaŋe dâŋticnere manapie boc ŋemâckeekac.
Amosi e ʒiŋuc hâcne muekac: ‘Jeroboam e ʒikao hâmoocmu, â râsi jaŋe Israe ŋic mâreŋ‐jeŋickonec rocjoparâ kâpâcwâruo bacjopa raniŋmu.’”
Erâ Amazia e Amosi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “O porofete, go Juda mâreŋko wiserâ razemec, erâ ira findaŋdâŋ muhuc nânâge bâfuazemec.
Bete haeo ine porofete dâŋ mocwâc mi muzemec, hae ʒi ŋicwofuŋte furu hae, uucmaŋ‐ticnere furu ufuŋ hâcne.”
Iŋuc mume Amosi e Amazia dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc bâtikiecnewec: “No porofete aricne, â porofete mocte qâjâpec wâc aricne, no lama bulimakao soŋaŋ, erâ jâmbojâc irec gie bahuc juekopac.
Wofuŋzi ine qowi soŋaŋ gieonec rocnurâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Go rarâ Israe ŋicgurufâc‐nane findaŋdâŋ jazazemec.’
“Irec ʒi Wofuŋte dâŋ manac. Go Israere ŋicfâc, Isakare kikefuŋ hâcne, jaŋe porofete dâŋ mi jazapemurâ â uŋ sawaŋ mi ejarepemurâ nazakomec.
Irec Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Ŋonâŋgezi haeo boe sau gie bahuc juocmu, â otâ ŋokâfâcge jaŋe ʒikao hâmoniŋmu, erâ mâreŋge i mucsâc fârehuc bâtâc baniŋmu; gahacne ine qâpuc mâreŋko hâmocmu, erâ Israe ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ‐jeŋickonec rocjoparâ kâpâcwâruo bacjopa rajâmbâŋkeniŋmu.’”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi wiac kecʒiŋuc nowatuwec: Sasac mocko jâchândâŋ quecne ŋeme honepo.
Eha ʒiŋuc wio‐narewec: “Amosi, go wemo wiac honekomec?” Mume mupo: “No sasac mocko jâchândâŋ quecne ŋeme honekopac.” Eme Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Israe ŋicgurufâc‐nane jaŋere dameŋ qosackekac hâcne, irec no mocwâc jowaruhuc mi akic‐jopapemu.
Ŋokac naru ŋicwofuŋte ufuŋko gae heeŋgopieŋ jaŋe dameŋ ira kio uu eniŋmu, ehame qâŋɋâŋ bocjaha fuame ira me ira kosa behec‐jopapie niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ foocmu.” Wofuŋ Anuture dâŋ iŋuc.
Ŋic hapetac ro waha âte ejareeŋgopieŋ, â mâreŋ ʒirec ŋic qarâ suriŋne sipiric‐jopaeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe dâŋ ʒi mananiŋ.
Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc wiac i eeŋgopieŋ hâcne: “Mosa ɋâricne wahaekac irec hombaŋ i wezimucko tarame padi jacgoŋ wiac furi bapa fuaocmu? Me sabata hombaŋ ŋeŋe i mo dameŋko tarame padi rowaŋficte motâc ronaŋmu, ehuc padi sâcticne bawahahuc furi‐ticne fehuc ronaŋmu, â sigeli bâsifuckerâ ŋic eatuc‐jopanaŋmu?
Erâ ŋic qarâ suriŋne jaŋe siliwazi furi bacjopanaŋmu, â hapetac jaŋe kikehuhu jajaheczi furi‐jeŋic banaŋmu, erâ padi jawane râehuc moneŋ jaha ronaŋmu?”
Jakobore kikefuŋ jaŋe Wofuŋte manapie feha Wofuŋ e jahacnao ɋetickehuc ʒiŋuc mupaŋkewec: “No eebapa‐jeŋicte moc mi nikecnu‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.
Mâreŋ e wiac iŋucnere erâ mi ɋiɋiteckeocmu me? Â ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe ki busâqoc mi eniŋmu me? Me Nilu opâ sâkozi siwiŋnerâ feku mocwâc fâre wahaekac irec sâc mâreŋzi huhuckerâ feku mi uruŋkerâ huocmu me?”
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Eme no dameŋ ira ʒoaŋ ecnepe guŋpiticko gâpâreme mâreŋ i ʒoaŋ ɋaɋackoa dapâc eocmu.
No ʒeri hombaŋ‐ŋeŋic hetikiepe busâqoc hombaŋ eocmu, â ʒeri gae‐ŋeŋic hetikiepe ki makuc gae efâreocmu. No mateŋ qonaŋke‐ŋare‐fârepemu â mupe ŋic sasawa jaŋe qizec‐jeŋic ropie utu pârâc fua‐fâreocmu. Ki mamakuc fuaocmu, i motec mocsâkoazi juku hâmome ki mamakuc fuaekac irec sâc. Ʒoaŋ irec tataranao busâqoczi ŋemâckerâ hâtâne eocmu.”
Wofuŋ Anutuzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira mupe roroc fuaocmu, erâ i nânâ opâ jahere roroc aricne, Wofuŋ dâŋticnere roroc fuame mananiŋte eipieniŋmu.
Jaŋe hâwec ŋifeckoneczi hâwec ŋifecko, â mâreŋ faickonec ʒoaŋ wewefunao rahuc domaniŋmu, ehuc Wofuŋte dâŋ bâfuaniŋte rac warec ehuc basa‐bipieniŋmu.
“Dameŋ ira naru ʒeŋoŋ sahac hawari biaŋ, â motec ʒeŋoŋ jaŋe opâre hâmohuc marac‐jeŋic kereŋkeme rândiŋkeniŋmu.
Eme ‘Daŋ, go nemuge jujâmbâŋkekac’ erâ ‘Bere‐Seba hae, go joroc nemuge jujâmbâŋkekac,’ iŋuc muhuc Samariare nemu ŋokac ʒâŋene Asima erao ɋetickehuc dâŋ mupaŋkeeŋgopieŋzi waha jopame mocwâc mi faharenʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋ e alata fuŋnao domahame honepe ʒiŋuc muwec: “Go bupu wâtuŋ qataratec fic bupunezi waharâ ŋic ŋemac‐jopazejec, eme nâfocne juniŋmu jaŋe ʒikazi qâmiziec‐jopapemu; ehame jaŋeraonec moczi sahac‐ticne ŋezickehuc mi wiseocmu.
“Jaŋe hâmokicne jaŋere haeo hupie muzac no sifu rocjopazapo, me sambâŋko fepie muzac sifu fârec‐jopape wahanʒapiŋ.
Jaŋe Karamele tikio ferâ soŋkepie muzac no sifu bâfuac‐joparâ rocjopazapo, me mai‐naneonec wiserâ hâwec fâhâŋnao hurâ soŋkepie muzac no mupe hâwec homazi kicjopazac.
Me râsifâc‐jeŋic jaŋe jâpec‐jopapie kâpâcwâru ficko rapie muzac no sifu mupe ʒikare nânâ enʒapiŋ; no biaŋkeniŋte mâcne, sipirickeniŋte ʒâŋe ʒârâ honec‐jopakopac.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi mâreŋ bâuwame dockeme ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe makuc baniŋmu, ehame Nilu opâ sâkozi siwiŋnerâ feku mocwâc fâre wahaekac irec sâc mâreŋzi huhuckerâ feku uruŋkerâ huocmu.
Mâreŋ fainao mume sambâŋzi uuŋne bawec fokac, â irec fainao erific‐ticne maŋne maŋne râe rawec, erâ hâwec opâne wiracnehuc mume mâreŋte faio qaratiewec fokac, e ʒâŋe‐ticne Wofuŋ hâcne.
Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: “O Israe ŋicbureŋ, no honec‐ŋopape Etiopia ŋic jaŋe iŋucne mi eŋgopieŋ me? No Israe ŋic apafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe Aigita mâreŋkonec mi jowac‐jopa warepo me? Me Filisa ŋic jaŋe Kafatori nuckonec, â Siria ŋic jaŋe Kiri mâreŋkonec wâc mi jowac‐jopa warepo me?
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu e ŋicwofuŋ â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe hehesic bâfuambiŋte ʒâŋe bâbâroŋ honec‐jopahuc ʒiŋuc mukac: No mâreŋkonec bâsirowec‐jopapemu. Mocjaha, Jakobore kikefuŋ jaŋe ine ʒeŋgoma mi bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârepemu.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, no ʒiŋuc epemurâ mupaŋkekopac: No Israe ŋic jaŋe ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko ba ikisiŋ ejarepemu, i saja sâko ba ikisiŋ ehapie padi fârine mâreŋko mi wahaekac irec sâc ejarepemu.
Ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere ŋondeŋko sâqocne bapa jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒikazi nâmiziec‐jopa‐fârezejec, jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ hâcne: ‘Sisipiriczi nâŋe maic‐nâporâ mi rocnâpoocmu.’
“No dameŋ ira Dawidire boze tâcne ʒaŋ ekicne i mocwâc heɋârehuc ʒeŋkepemu, â hetâtiekicne i mocwâc bâpiaŋkepemu, eme mârâc jaha ŋewec irec sâc jaha bape ŋeocmu hâcne.
Eme jaŋe Edomŋic nâfocne mecne, â ŋicne ŋicne ʒâŋe‐nane bajueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc rauc‐jopanʒepieŋ.” Wofuŋ e wiac i eocmu ere dâŋ iŋuc.
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira qa roro ŋic e gie‐ticne bahuc juhame jaha hesarac ŋiczi fisiocmu, â waiŋ hândâŋne âte pisickehuc juhapie jaha gâcnezi hesarac gie baniŋte fisiniŋmu; ehame tikio waiŋ fusucmarâ foocmu â mâreŋ facne facne ira fârine bocjaha fuaocmu.
Eme no mupe Israe ŋicgurufâc‐nane jaŋere jujuhâmo mocwâc fua‐jarezejec, eme jaŋe hae‐jeŋic sesucne sesucne heɋârerâ bâpiaŋkehuc maŋnao ŋec juc enʒepieŋ, ehuc waiŋ gie bapie fârine fuame opâne nâhuc junʒepieŋ, â gie wiac gâcne he sarac erâ fârine nâhuc junʒepieŋ wâc.
Eme no mâreŋ‐jeŋicko sarac‐jopape junʒepieŋ, eme mâreŋ tahac‐jopapo irecnec mocwâc mi unuc‐jopanʒepieŋ.” Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋiczi iŋuc mukac.
Obadia e maŋʒâŋe‐ticne raruŋkeme wiac hone manac ewec. Wofuŋ Anutuzi Edomŋic jaŋere dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac: Wofuŋ e kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne ŋicne ŋicne jaŋerao soreme rarâ Wofuŋte dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazame manambeŋ: “Ajoc, faharepie Edomŋic jaŋehec qaqac enaŋte fenʒepeneŋ!”
Wofuŋzi Edom guru âzâcnekac: Manakic, no ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko bawahacgupe qaisocgu‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Maŋfefegezi eatucguwec, qânâ hawecko me tiki botâŋko ŋec juc eekic go maŋgezi ʒiŋuc manasuekic: “Mozi sâcne mâreŋko tuŋnume hupemu?”
Go tucwipe iŋucne faic jâmbâŋ ferâ jutec muzac, me ficgezi bâpiŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋeme muzac no sifu irecnec tuŋgupe wahanʒaŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Fiuc roro jaŋe ŋafeo ficgao fisirâ wiac aŋac‐jopaekac sâc roeŋgopieŋ, me waiŋ gie bapa jaŋe waiŋ giegao ferâ hândâŋne ro nusec ehuc gâcne bâtiripie foekac; jei, ʒi ine furu jaha imacgukicne.
O Esau, jaŋe boreŋ ʒeŋaŋge soŋkekicne i karaŋ bahuc rofârembiŋ.
Gohec ʒâʒâfic embiŋzi eatucguhuc mâreŋgaonec jâpecgumbiŋ, gohec wama faio jumbiŋ jaŋe sanaŋkerâ qâhucgumbiŋ, â âgofâcge gohec nânâ wirec nâmbiŋzi bitiŋ râe‐garehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: Mamana tara focnewec i weni?
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Jâmbomac, no dameŋ ira Edom mâreŋte ŋic imac‐jopapemu, â maŋɋârâŋhec juju i Esau tiki mâreŋko mupe omaeocmu.
Temaŋ haeonec ŋic qac momorihec jaŋe bipic tatara ejareocmu, â Esau tiki mâreŋko ʒika qaqa ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopa‐fârepemu.
Go Jakobore ɋâricfâc, qomâfâcge hâcne, jaŋerao sindaŋ wiac fuŋne fuŋne bâfuameŋte ima bacgupie ʒâŋe biŋege omae‐jâmbâŋkezejec.
Râsi jaŋe fisirâ mafa wiac‐jeŋic jowac rorâ barambiŋ, â haemaŋko ferâ Jerusalem haere qaŋgec qambiŋ, go dameŋ ira mâc hone qâoma ejaremeŋ, ehuc râsi jaŋere âgo emeŋ.
Go qomâfâcge jaŋere ʒâic busâqoc dameŋko aŋac ʒeri mi enʒaŋ, â Juda kikefuŋ sisipiric dameŋ‐jeŋicko bubiaŋ mi mananʒaŋ, erâ ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio juhapie mi gâwie‐jarenʒaŋ.
Go ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere ʒâic busâqoc dameŋko hae‐jeŋicko ferâ aŋac ʒeri ehuc moneŋ mafa wiac‐jeŋic mi jowac rotec muzac sâckezac.
Go hata sosohocko domahuc wisezo embiŋ jaŋe aka mi hejaretec muzac sâckezac, â ʒikare nâfocne jaŋe ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋ‐jeŋicko râsire meo mi râec‐jopatec muzac sâckezac jaha.
Wofuŋte dameŋzi ŋicne ŋicne maic‐jopakac. Irec go ŋic wiac ejaremeŋ sâc ijaha go egarezo. Go wiac emeŋ izi hâcne ŋerisierâ gahacne faio feocmu.
Ŋicfâc‐nane ŋoŋe tiri tiki‐naneo weaŋ sicne nâmbiŋ, iŋuc jaha ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe nârâ nâ ehuc maŋjeŋic bibiriwame omae‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Ŋic tucne jaŋe sisipiriczi riric‐jopaha Zioŋ tikio junʒepieŋ, ehame tikizi tirine erâ ŋezejec. Eme Jakobore kikefuŋ jaŋe mâreŋ‐jeŋic mocwâc rauckenʒepieŋ.
Jakobo â Josefere kikefuŋ jahe ʒoc iŋucne erâ, ʒoczi jawa ʒâseŋkeekac irec sâc Esaure kikefuŋ ʒâseŋke‐fârepire Esaure ŋic nâfocne moc mi junʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ e iŋuc hâcne muwec.
Negebe mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ jaŋe Esaure tiki mâreŋ rauckenʒepieŋ, â mâreŋ uruŋnao juŋgopieŋzi Filisa mâreŋ ro rauc enʒepieŋ. Eme Eferaim â Samaria hae mâreŋ i wâc iŋuc jaha jaŋere biŋe eha Benjamiŋte ɋâricfâc jaŋe Gileade mâreŋ ro sakac enʒepieŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋere momori guru kâpâcwâruonec waharâ Foinike mâreŋ ro rauc erakupie Zarefati haeo tarazejec, â Jerusalem haeonec kâpâcwâru bacjopa rakicnezi Sefarada mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine Negebe mâreŋko hae ŋerakac i raucke‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Israe ŋic ŋezic‐jopakicne jaŋe Zioŋ tikio ferâ Esau tiki mâreŋte guriŋ bapa gie bahuc junʒepieŋ. Ŋicwofuŋte gie izi ine Wofuŋte biŋe ezejec.
Wofuŋte dâŋ Amitaire ŋokâ Jona erao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Ajoc, go ʒawierâ Niniwe hae sâkoo rac, erâ hae irec rune uŋdâŋ jazac, sindaŋ‐jeŋicte fânâŋzi norao fisikacte hahaŋne bahuc jazazemec hâcne!”
Jonazi ine Wofuŋte ʒâŋe maionec wiserâ Tarasisi haeo raocte Jope haeo hurawec. Ira woke moc Tarasisi haeo razo eha bâfuawec. Erâ Wofuŋ wisecnerâ jaŋehec Tarasisi haeo raocte woke furine barâ fewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi mume mâŋâŋ hâhâwicne qame hâwec sâqore‐jâmbâŋkeme wokezi fâuckezo ewec.
Eme wokeŋic jaŋe hâwic‐jopame nemufâc‐jeŋic ru sâc wira wâwâsic ejarembiŋ. Erâ wokezi afeckeocte wokere mafa wiac gâcne i hâwecko behepie huwec. Jona e ine woke fâhâŋnao hurâ guŋsanaŋ fowec.
Ehame wokere kapiteŋzi hurâ Jona ʒiŋuc muhuc dâŋ mucnewec: “Go fuŋne weniŋucte guŋ fokomec? Ajoc, faharerâ nemuge wira wâwâsic ecnec, eme eki mecne busâqoc mana‐nârehuc ŋezic‐nâpoha mi sipirickenaŋmu.”
Eme jaŋe jaŋackoaŋ kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ajoc, qaŋgec qanaŋ, eme more erâ wiac hâhâwicne ʒi fua‐nârekac irec fuŋne taniŋkezejec.” Jaŋe iŋuc murâ qaŋgec qapie Jona âke fuawec.
Âke fuame ʒiŋuc wiocnembiŋ: “Go nâzâc, wiac ʒi more erâ fai‐nâŋecko fekac? Go wemo gie bahuc juekic erâ wenirec warekomec? Go mâreŋ wenirec erâ ŋicguru weni jaŋeraonec?”
Eme eki ʒiŋuc muwec: “No Hebiraio ŋic, erâ no, sambâŋ Wofuŋ Anutu hâwec â mâreŋ bâfuac‐jofawec, e hâcne araŋ bacneekopac.”
Iŋuc mume ŋic jaŋe mâretec hâwic‐jopame ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ec, go wemo wiac emeŋ?” E Wofuŋ wisecnewec irec fuŋne qanaŋ mufua‐jarewecte manasuhuc iŋuc âzâcnembiŋ.
Eme hâwec sâqore‐jâmbâŋkeha ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnembiŋ: “Weniŋuc egarepene hâwec benoŋ baocmu?”
Eki muwec: “Rocnurâ hâwecko behecnupie hupe benoŋ baocmu. No manakopac, hâwec sâqore‐jâmbâŋkekac i nore erâ ekac hâcne.”
Ŋic jaŋe ine woke moŋgeŋkopec raocte samarierâ foickehuc gie sâko bambiŋ, hâweczi ine siri sâko qawecte eipiembiŋ.
Irec Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “O Wofuŋ, go ŋic kecʒirec erâ mi bâsirowec‐nâpoc, go micdâŋgere sâcko wiac eekicte ŋic kecʒi hâwecko behepene hume irec kiŋ i nâŋerao mi batarazemec.”
Jaŋe iŋuc muhuc Jona rorâ hâwecko behepie hume benoŋ bawec.
Ŋic jaŋe ine Wofuŋte mâretec hâwic‐jopame bâzi hezu rikec ecnehuc wiac biaŋne gâcne eniŋte mumupaŋ dâŋ mumbiŋ wâc.
Ehame Wofuŋzi hâwec qowi sâko moc ecneme ware Jona ɋâckewec. Eme Jona e qowimaŋko foha ŋafe ʒoaŋ jahec â moc tarawec.
Eme Jona e qowimaŋko fohuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐ticne kecʒiŋuc muhuc numucnewec:
“No ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio fohuc Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnepe mana‐narewec. No hâmoc haeo juhuc kio wâwâsic egarepe go wira wâwâsic‐nane manameŋ.
Go ʒâkâŋ sâkoo tuŋnutec hupo, hâwec ʒâkâŋ fâhâŋnao hâcne, eme ʒâkâŋ sâkozi foŋnuwec, hâwec siri â temboŋgezi qâurucnu‐fârewec.
Eme kecʒiŋuc manapo: ‘No ʒâŋe maigaonec tuŋnukicne irec tiri ufuŋge wemocko mocwâc honepemu.’
Opâ sâkozi qâurucnume juju‐nane omaezo ewec, ʒâkâŋ sâkozi foŋnuwec â hâwecte gagaraczi qizec‐nane qâfisewec.
No mâreŋ fuŋnezi hâwecmaŋko hurâ tarakac irec sâc hujâmbâŋkepo, eme mâreŋko ririsiere motâc basanaŋkekicne fowec; goki ine nombâŋkonec mocwâc bawefucnumeŋ, o Wofuŋ, Anutu‐nane.
Maŋnane betaŋkehame Wofuŋ gore manasupo, eme nunumu‐nanezi gorao hefâku tiri ufuŋgao fisiwec.
Nemuɋâŋ jabane dape‐jareniŋmu jaŋe jâcsanaŋ‐jeŋic râpeckeniŋmu.
No muteŋ bâteŋ egarehuc taha bagarepemu; no dâŋ mupaŋkepo i ejâmbâŋkepemu hâcne. Wiac Wofuŋ go ŋeŋezic‐nâŋec jukomec i!”
Eme Wofuŋ e qowi mucneme Jona tiŋko maŋume fewec.
Eme irec faicnao Wofuŋte dâŋzi Jonarao mocwâc fuame jajahec ewec ine kecʒiŋuc:
“Ajoc, go ʒawierâ Niniwe hae sâkoo rac, erâ hae rune dâŋ gazape sâc jazazemec.”
Iŋuc mume Jonazi faharerâ Wofuŋte micte Niniwe haeo rawec. Niniwe i hae sâko mako ŋewec, hae i fotâcneniŋte rahuc juhapie ʒoaŋ jahec â moc tara jujec.
Eme Jona e fuŋkerâ haeo ferâ rahame ʒoaŋ moc tarame dâŋ hahaŋne bahuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋafe ʒoaŋ 40 sawa fokac, tarame Niniwe hae siroweocmu.”
Eme Niniwe hae rune jaŋe Anuture dâŋ mana ʒakiembiŋ â sowa juju fuaocte ʒâfo bambiŋ, ehuc kâcɋene mecne piticne mecne jaŋe mâmâc mateŋ hepie hufârewec.
Eme irec biŋe Niniwe ŋicwofuŋtao ra fisiwec. Fisime manarâ eri ŋeŋe‐ticnaonec waharâ eri ŋaqi‐ticne hetararâ mateŋ jaha heme hume ʒafeo waha ŋewec.
Erâ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc râeme raku Niniwe hae sâcke‐fârewec: “Ŋicwofuŋ â fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: Moczi moc nânâ wiac mi nâjâmbâŋkezejec, ŋic â qowi mecne, lama bulimakao mecne, jaŋe nânâ opâ moc mi nânʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ŋic â qowi mateŋ hepie hufâreme Anutu samarierâ kio wâwâsic ecnenʒepieŋ, erâ eebapa sâqocne i ru sâc râpecke‐fârehuc ŋic bâbâʒâic‐jopa i behenʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc epene Anutuzi busâqoc mana‐nârehuc maŋne risieme kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋ bâuruŋkerâ akic‐nâpome mi mecne sirowenaŋmu.”
Jaŋe iŋuc ehuc hata‐jeŋic sâqocne râpeckepie Anutuzi honewec. Honerâ busâqoc mana‐jarehuc maŋne risieme okacne fisi‐jareocte muwec i behewec.
Iŋuc eme Jona e mâretec mana sâqorerâ aarickewec.
Ehame Wofuŋ kecʒiŋuc numucnewec: “O Wofuŋ, no mâreŋ‐naneo juhuc irec hâcne mupo, erâ dameŋ ira iŋucte hâcne Tarasisi haeo rapemurâ wisepo; fuŋnege manapo, go aki anonoc â buurucgehec, kimbeŋge uneŋne â eehâmoge ʒâkâŋnehec, erâ ŋic kiŋ behe‐jarehuc âgo eejare i mai fogarekac.
Irec, Wofuŋ, go manahaŋtec hâmozepac; no hâmocte boc enareha jujure takicnukac.”
Eme Wofuŋ e dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go aaric manakic i sâckekac me?”
Eme Jona e haeonec waharâ hae mendâŋko ʒoaŋ wewefuopec boze barâ maŋnao mumucko ŋewec, hae iŋuc me iŋuc fuacneme i honeocte.
Ŋehame Wofuŋ Anutu e mume turajâc moc ututuŋ fua sokac ewec, i Jona mumuc biaŋ bâfuacneme bune urueocte. Eme Jona e turare boc aŋackewec.
Eme ŋafeo fohapie hae mi fure taniŋkeha Anutuzi paruc moc ecneme fisi tura fuŋne nâŋgârâŋkeme ururuckewec.
Izi ʒoaŋ wefume Anutuzi mume ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec mâŋâŋ fârone qawec. Eme ʒoaŋzi Jona qizecnao âeckekume docke sâqorerâ hâmoocte ecneme muwec: “No juju qikiŋnehuc hâmocte manape biaŋkekac.”
Eme Anutuzi Jona âzâcnewec: “Go turare aaricgukac i sâckekac me?” Jonazi muwec: “Aaricnukac i sâckekac, â hâmozo mukopac i sâckekac jaha.”
Eme Wofuŋzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go tura giene moc mi bamec â mi jauŋketec fua sokac ejec, i ŋafe mocko fuajec â ŋafe mocko omaejec, eme irec buge sâqorekac.
Eme Niniwe hae sâkoo ŋic ŋokac naru motec jaŋere ʒare 120 tauseŋ jâurukac jaŋe hata i me i âteniŋte kâuc baeŋgopieŋ, â bec qowi wemo afecne juŋgopieŋ wâc. Eme jaŋere erâ bunane mi sâqoreocte mukomec me?”
Jotam, Ahaʒi â Hisikia jaŋe Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ tuczi tuc juwefumbiŋ dameŋ ira Samaria â Jerusalem hae jahere erâ Wofuŋte dâŋ ŋic moc ʒâŋene Mika, Morese haeonec, erao fuame hone manac ewec ine kecʒiŋuc:
O ŋic gurune gurune ŋoŋe mana‐fâreniŋ, erâ mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ â fainao wiac fusucmarâ foraŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe hazec râe‐fâreniŋ, ehame Wofuŋ Anutu e tiri ufuŋ‐ticnaonec waharâ fuŋne‐ŋeŋic rituzejec.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ e faharerâ ŋeŋe hae‐ticnaonec waharâ mâreŋ facne sâc âtehuc raocmu.
Baŋac sâfâ ʒocko rikepene docke ʒaŋ eekac, me opâzi hârâcko qambaraŋkerâ huekac, irec sâc tiki jaŋe Wofuŋte kike rurumaŋko docke ʒaŋ eniŋmu, â wâneŋ jaŋe fâuckeniŋmu.
Wiac i sasawa Jakobore kikefuŋ qaqatara‐jeŋicte â Israe kikefuŋ hehesic‐jeŋicte erâ fuaocmu. Jakobore kikefuŋ jaŋere qaqatara irec fuŋne wena fokac? I Samaria haeo hâcne! Â Juda kikefuŋ jaŋere hehesic i wena fuaekac? I Jerusalemko hâcne!
No irec hâcne Samaria hae ima bape sesucne fuarâ fozejec, eme waiŋ gie he sarac eere mâreŋ efârezejec. No qânâ wiac‐ticne tuŋkepe wâneŋko hufâreme hobeteŋ‐ticne tâtâc fuarâ fozejec.
Ɋâŋ qâqâtâc‐ticne henʒaŋ qanʒaŋne‐fârezo, â wiac tahackekicne i ʒoczi ʒâseŋkezejec, eme no nemuɋâŋ‐ticne ima bafârepemu; jaŋe boe saure furizi kitâc‐jopawecte mocwâc boe saure furi jaha enʒepieŋ.
No ine wiac fuaocmu irec kio uu epemu, ehuc ŋaqi faine hetararâ kikehuhu tâmiric mâc jupemu; no busâqoc ehuc kâte qâto iŋucne qâu qapemu, â qera motecne iŋucne fuŋgaŋkepemu.
Sisipiric fisi‐jarewec i mocwâc bâbârâriene mi ekac, biac Juda mâreŋko fotâcnerâ fisiwec, erâ ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere motâcko, Jerusalem haeo hâcne warekac.
Ŋoŋe irec dâŋ Gati haeo mi musokanʒepieŋ, erâ moc mi kionʒepieŋ; Bete‐Leafara haeo rufemaŋko foc forisic ehuc risimbiŋne qanʒepieŋ.
O Safiri hae rune, ŋoŋe hata‐ŋeŋicko mimi busâqoc faio raniŋ, Zanaŋ rune jaŋe hae‐jeŋickonec mocwâc mi wahaniŋmu, â Bete‐Ezele haere busâqoczi ŋoŋerao fotâcnerâ fokac.
Wofuŋtaonec wiac hâhâwicnezi Jerusalem haere motâcko fisikacte Maroti hae rune jaŋe jujuhâmore woŋec ŋeipieŋgopieŋ.
O Lakisi hae rune, ŋoŋe becâsic umbika râe‐jarehuc keretac fâreniŋte baʒawiec‐jopaniŋ, ŋoŋe hâcne Zioŋ kikefuŋ hehesicte micne bajarembiŋ, erâ Israere qaqatara i ŋoŋerao fua taniŋkewec.
Ŋoŋe Morese‐Gati hae rune mâmâzoc papia jarenʒepieŋ; Akaʒibi fic hae i nâŋere biŋe ŋekac, Israe ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe iŋuc muhapie dâŋjeŋic racne ezejec.
O Maresa kikefuŋ, noni mupe bomboŋ ɋâricne moc fua‐garerâ raucguzejec; Israere ʒâŋe biŋe omaeocmu, irec sâc jaha Adulam hae omaezejec.
Naru motec jorocfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere busâqocte erâ qizec‐ŋeŋic rorâ utu pârâc junʒepieŋ; jaŋe behec‐ŋoparâ kâpâcwâruo raniŋmure ŋafe wipe iŋucne utu pârâc erâ junʒepieŋ.
Jei, wiac hehesicne eniŋte fofo‐jeŋicko fohuc manasu biric eeŋgopieŋ, eme tâpiri fojarekacte hae fureme fârine bâfuaeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe giegaŋte andac ehuc kâŋgâc jowac roeŋgopieŋ, me ficte andac ehuc ro rauc eeŋgopieŋ; jaŋe ŋic moc â wiacfâcne ro waha âte ejarehuc mâreŋ wiac‐jeŋic jowac roeŋgopieŋ.
Irec Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋic iŋucne wiac hâhâwicnezi kidapec‐jopaocte manasu biric ekopac, i fua‐ŋareme sâcne mi hetaraniŋmu, erâ wemocko mocwâc qâhâŋnerâ sâke fific eniŋmu, i dameŋ hâhâwicne fuaocmu hâcne.
Dameŋ ira âke sisic gae moc heŋareniŋmu, ehuc ki busâqoc erâ ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Nâŋe sipirickeŋgopeneŋ; jei, mâreŋ‐nâŋec i ŋic jabane jaŋere meo râeme fekac, e jâmbomac gie wiac‐nâŋec nâwoc rorâ kâpâcwâru bacnâpoŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâtâc bajarekac i!”
Iŋuc fuame Wofuŋte kikefuŋko ŋic moczi giegaŋ rukec mocwâc mi qanâreocmu.
Ŋoŋe mueŋgopieŋ: “Miti muhuc dâŋ wiac iŋucne mi muzo, mimi i wemocko fai‐nâŋecko feocmu.”
Jakobore kikefuŋ i sâweckekicne me? Me Wofuŋ e maŋʒârâ‐ticnehec me? Eki wiac iŋuc moc eekac me? Tiŋne hatao jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe dâŋticnezi mi jauŋ‐jopaekac me?
Ŋoŋe hâcne ŋicfâc‐nane râsi ejareeŋgopieŋ, â ŋic wawahane ŋaqi hetara‐jareeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe maŋhumuc juhuc sicne fotâc ehapie â ʒikare moc mi manasuhapie iŋuc ejareeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere ŋokacfâc fic hae biaŋ‐jeŋickonec jâpec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, erâ ɋiefâc‐jeŋic wiac tahac‐jopapo i jowac rosanaŋkeeŋgopieŋ. Ehuc ʒiŋuc jazaeŋgopieŋ:
“Ajoc, fahare ratâmireniŋ, ʒira ŋeŋe mana hae mâcne, ʒi wâwânâŋ fokacte sisipiric ima‐ticnehec fuaocmu.”
“Waiŋ â opâ momori irec dâŋ ŋazape,” ŋic moczi fisirâ burec â sawadâŋ iŋuc jazame muzac ere manapie miti mumuŋic‐jeŋic ezac.
O Jakobore ɋâricfâc, no ʒeŋgoma hetumaŋ‐ŋopapemu, â Israe nâfocne ro nusec ejarepemu. Henusuc‐jopape ture‐fâreniŋmu, lama jaŋe sapao feeŋgopieŋ, â sopâcko heâckeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc. Ŋic guru sâko micʒonʒoŋ‐jeŋic fuaocmu.
Micne baocmuzi aka bârâriehuc bânie‐jareme quruŋ herâ motâc fotâcnehuc waharâ raniŋmu. Eme Wofuŋ e Femicne‐jeŋiczi bânie‐jarehuc micne‐jeŋic eocmu.
Eme no ʒiŋuc mupo: “Jakobore kâcɋenefâc, â Israe kikefuŋte micne guru, ŋoŋe mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe hâcne tiŋne jujure guriŋ baniŋte muŋarekicne i!
Ŋoŋe ine wiac biaŋne qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ, â sâqocnere manapie aŋacne eekac; ŋoŋe ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere sahac âkehockeeŋgopieŋ, ehuc siec‐jeŋickonec biuc‐jeŋic hehockeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋicfâc‐nane jaŋere biuc nâeŋgopieŋ, â sahac‐jeŋic âkehockerâ siec‐jeŋic qazu qanʒaŋ eeŋgopieŋ; ŋoŋe bec qowi oto kuʒio râeniŋte dâkâ pitic baeŋgopieŋ, irec sâc hetâc qâtâc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ hâcne.”
Eme jaŋe juku Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnepie micjeŋicko mi roocmu; jaŋe hehesic bâfuambiŋte ʒâŋe mai‐ticne bâsoŋke‐jareocmu.
Ŋicfâc‐nane eatuc‐jopapie qâsorieeŋgopieŋ, micjeŋicko nânâ fome “Wama” mueŋgopieŋ, â nânâ wiac jare gumec mi epie râsi ejareeŋgopieŋ, porofete iŋucne jaŋere Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac:
“Ŋoŋerao dapâc fuame maŋʒâŋe‐ŋeŋic hâpome wiac mocwâc mi honenʒepieŋ, erâ maŋmutuc fua‐ŋareme findaŋdâŋ muniŋte eipienʒepieŋ. Porofete ŋoŋe tatamaczi mocwâc mi tamae‐ŋarezejec, gâpâreme ŋoŋerao dapâc fuazejec.
Ehame porofete ŋoŋere faio mimi fezejec, â faŋfaŋdâŋ mumu ŋic ŋoŋe qurutuanʒepieŋ, ehuc Anuturaonec dâŋ mi fua‐ŋareme busâqoc manahuc micbipic‐ŋeŋic bâsoŋke‐fârenʒepieŋ.”
Noni ine Jakobore kikefuŋ qaqatara‐jeŋic â Israe ŋic hehesic‐jeŋic jaza jowatuc epemurâ Wofuŋtaonec tâpiri â Mâro â tiŋne juju erâ hâbi rorâ juekopac.
Jakobo kikefuŋte kâcɋenefâc, â Israe kikefuŋte micne guru ŋoŋe dâŋ ʒi mananiŋ! Ŋoŋe hâcne mumutiŋ dâŋ qaisockeeŋgopieŋ, â wiac sasawa tiŋne foha esifuckeeŋgopieŋ.
Meŋeŋicko soc bohotarâ foha Zioŋko fic hae baeŋgopieŋ, â bâbâsifuc bâfuahuc Jerusalem hae heɋârerâ baeŋgopieŋ.
Fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋe bâbâmiriŋ wiac rohuc ŋic dâŋjeŋic mutaraeŋgopieŋ, â taha bapafâc‐ticne jaŋe furire erâ ŋicfâc‐jeŋic dâŋ jaza mutâc eeŋgopieŋ, erâ porofete jaŋe moneŋte erâ findaŋdâŋ mueŋgopieŋ. Ehuc sifu Wofuŋtao roweckeeŋgopeneŋ muhuc ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: “Wofuŋ e ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko jukac, irec wiac hâhâwicne moc mi fua‐nâreocmu.”
Irec ŋoŋere erâ Zioŋ i giere mâreŋ iŋucne bâfâuckenʒepieŋ, â Jerusalem hae i sesucne fuarâ fozejec, erâ taha ufuŋte tikio ine kâte uupic fuazejec.
Ʒâhec dameŋko wiac kecʒiŋuc fuaocmu: Wofuŋte ufuŋ irec tikizi qiŋ herâ ŋehuc tiki sasawa jaŋere micne eocmu; ehuc mâreŋ facne qâhuc‐jopa‐fâreocmu, eme ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe heâckerâ ira fisiniŋmu.
Eme ŋicguru bocjaha jaŋe fisirâ muniŋmu: “Warepie Wofuŋte tikio fenaŋ, Jakobore Anutu ere ufuŋko hâcne. Eme eki hata‐ticne nâzâ nâwotuc eme âtehuc junʒepeneŋ.” Zioŋkonec sâcmutâc dâŋ mu râwiŋneniŋmu, â Jerusalemkonec Wofuŋte dâŋ haŋ baocmu hâcne.
Eme Wofuŋzi ŋicguru bocjaha ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko mumutiŋ gie baocmu, ehuc ŋicne ŋicne dâŋ mutiŋne‐jareocmu. Eme jaŋe ʒika‐jeŋic bâtikiepie kinoŋ fuaocmu, â damu‐jeŋiczi gie sâqe eocmu; guru moczi guru moctao râsi moc mi fisiocmu, â ʒikare ʒaʒawie gie i omaeocmu.
Jaŋe ru sâc waiŋ â jâmbo gie‐jeŋicko ŋec juc efâreniŋmu, ehame moczi moc hâhâwic mi hejareocmu. Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere micdâŋ iŋuc.
Ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe ru sâc nemufâc‐jeŋic jaŋere ʒâŋeo roweckehuc jueŋgopieŋ, nâŋe ine Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec ere ʒâŋeo roweckehuc junaŋmu sanaŋ.
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: No dameŋ ira ŋic puriŋne jaŋe hetumaŋ‐jopapemu, ehuc qa bâtâtiec ejarekicne, erâ qa bâʒâic ejarepo jaŋe henusuc‐jopapemu.
Puriŋne jaŋe ukicne juniŋte rocjopapemu, â taicko bacjopa rakicne jaŋe ŋicguru sâko bacjopapemu, eme Wofuŋ no Zioŋ tikio dameŋ ʒiŋuczia fuŋkerâ wofuŋ ejare rahuc jupemu sanaŋ.
O lama soŋaŋ jaŋere ficsanaŋ, Zioŋ otâ‐ticnere tiki go, mârâc jaha gorao ŋicwofuŋ juju fowec, Jerusalem haere uucmaŋ hâcne, i mocwâc fua‐garezejec.
Go wemocte kio owa sâko ekomec? Go ŋicwofuŋ moc mi jugarekac me? Me dâŋte babaficge sipirickewecte ŋokac gozi kicjopame ʒâic manaeŋgopieŋ irec sâc ekomec me?
O Zioŋte otâ, go ŋokac jaŋe gozi kicjopame foc fotikic ehuc kio huse eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc ejâmbâŋkezemec. Go miŋecnea hae ʒi beherâ tomao ju fofo raku Babe haeo fisizemec. Ira juhaŋtec Wofuŋzi firuecguhuc râsifâcge jaŋere meonec bataracguocmu.
Ʒi ine ŋicguru bocjahazi qâturerâ râsi egarehuc ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: “Zioŋ e ro waha âte ecnezo, eme wiac hâhâwicne fuacneme hone ʒiziwenʒepeneŋ.”
Jaŋe Wofuŋzi wiac manaekac i mi mana taraeŋgopieŋ, â mamana biri‐ticnere kâuc baeŋgopieŋ. Eki hâcne padi iŋucne dâtâc‐joparâ bâbâmârâŋ tomao râe guruc ejarewec.
O Zioŋte otâ, go faharerâ bâbâmârâŋ gie bac, eme no ʒuŋege aeŋzi bagarepemu, â kike sârâge aeŋ bâbâroŋzi râe‐garepemu, eme go ŋicguru bocjaha henʒaŋ qanʒaŋ‐joparâ wiac‐jeŋic hure hemârec embiŋ i Wofuŋte biŋe qazemec, â mafa mâriri wiac‐jeŋic i mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec Wofuŋ ere biŋe râezemec.
Ʒi ine râec‐nâpohuc sac bambiŋ i somâc‐nâpokicne hâcne, jaŋe Israe guriŋ bapa ŋicticne kâcbiŋzi mainao qaŋgopieŋ.
O Betelehem Efarata, go Judare hae wawahane, gorao hâcne micne sâko moc fuarâ Israe ŋicfâc‐nane gume jowac ejarezokac. E fuŋne‐ticne mârâc sasac jaha fuarâ fowec.
Irec Wofuŋzi behec‐joparâ juhame ŋokac moc motec roocte mukicne ere dameŋ maickeocmu. Eme dameŋ ira hâcne qomâfâc‐ticne nâfocne jaŋe Israe kikefuŋ jaŋerao risieniŋmu.
Eme e qiŋ herâ domahuc lamafâc‐ticne Wofuŋte tâpirio, â Wofuŋ Anutu‐ticnere ʒâŋezi batamaehame hone soŋaŋ ejareocmu. Eme jaŋe hâhâwic tâmiric juhapie ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnezi haŋ barâ raku mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao fisizejec.
Ehame eki wama bâfua‐nâreocmu. Asiria ŋic jaŋe ware fisirâ mâreŋ‐nâŋecko âtepie nâŋe soŋaŋ â ŋic fekicne bocjaha âkendâŋ‐jopapene râsi ejareniŋmu.
Erâ ʒikahec domahuc Asiria mâreŋ soŋaŋkenʒepieŋ, i Nimorodi mâreŋko hâcne ʒikahec jaha domahuc guriŋ bapa gie banʒepieŋ. Asiria ŋic jaŋe mâreŋ‐nâŋecko fisirâ rocnâpopie mejeŋickonec batarac‐nâponiŋmu hâcne.
Eme Jakobore ŋic ʒanʒaŋne jaŋe ŋicguru bocjaha jaŋere ŋondeŋko Wofuŋtaonec titikuc iŋucne erâ juniŋmu, me hoezi kecɋaŋ bâgunuckeekac irec sâc; hoe titikuc e ŋicte woŋec mi foekac, erâ ŋic jaŋerao ʒâŋe mi fiekac.
Laioŋzi kâte qowi gâcne jaŋere ŋondeŋko juekac, erâ laioŋ motec ɋârizi lama guruo raʒihuc lama bomac‐joparâ kisuc qâsuc‐jopahame moczi sâcne mi batarac‐jopaocmu, irec sâc Jakobore ŋic ʒanʒaŋne jaŋe ŋicne ŋicne, â ŋicguru bocjaha jaŋere ŋondeŋko juniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe qacbochec erâ fific guguriŋfâc‐ŋeŋic sanaŋke‐jarenʒepieŋ, ehuc râsifâc‐ŋeŋic bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: No dameŋ ira becâsicfâc‐ŋeŋic juŋgopieŋ i bâsirowec‐jopapemu, â keretac wiac‐ŋeŋic i ima bapemu.
Mâreŋ‐ŋeŋicko hae wiac ŋerakac i ima bapemu, â ficsanaŋ wiac‐ŋeŋic sasawa i heroc qâropie‐fârepemu.
Meŋeŋiczi qaŋgec wiac bajueŋgopieŋ i qape arictac eha faŋfaŋdâŋ mumuŋic mocwâc mi juŋarenʒepieŋ.
Ɋâŋ qâqâtâc â nemure qânâ wâtuŋ wiac ŋoŋerao doma rakac i henʒaŋ qanʒaŋnepemu, eme ŋoŋe ŋaŋacne meqâreŋ wiac i mocwâc mi fodape‐jarenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋerao Asera nemu ere ɋâŋwâtuŋ doma rakac i qârândiŋkerâ hae wiac‐ŋeŋic ima bapemu.
Ŋicne ŋicne micrereŋ tâmiric jumbiŋ jaŋe kimbeŋ aaric mana‐jarehuc okacne bazu‐jarepemu.
Wofuŋzi dâŋ mukac i mananiŋ: Ajoc, faharerâ tiki maic‐jopahuc dâŋgie baniŋ, eme mâreŋ facne facne jaŋe dâŋmarac‐ŋeŋic mananiŋ!
Wofuŋ e dâŋgie baocmu i tiki ŋoŋe mananiŋ, â mâreŋte hobeteŋ go irec hazec râec; Wofuŋ e Israe ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋehec dâŋgie bahuc dâŋjeŋic mutaraocmu.
“O ŋicfâc‐nane, no wemo eŋarepo? Weniŋuc eŋarepe tatakic bâfuambiŋ? Irec mupie manape!
No Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐ŋopa warehuc niŋgiŋkonec batarac‐ŋopapo hâcne. No Mose â Aroŋ erâ Miriam jaŋe ejarepe micne baŋarembiŋ.
O ŋicfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe Moabi ŋicwofuŋ Balakezi dâŋ manasu biric ehame Beoro ŋokâ‐ticne Bileam eki okacne weniŋuc âzâcnewec i manasuniŋ. Erâ Sitim haeonec Giligali haeo rahapie wiac fuawec irec mâmâc manasurâ Wofuŋ eehâmo‐nanere fuŋne mana taranʒepieŋ.”
“No wemo wiac moc ameckehuc Wofuŋte maio fuarâ Anutu Femicne dapecnezepac? Qowi bâzi ririkene me bulimakao motec ɋâri amec‐joparâ sâcne fuacnepemu me?
Wofuŋ e lama ŋicne wâŋ tauseŋ irec moc aŋackeocmu, me opâ sâko teŋ tauseŋ irec sâc wokemaŋ opâ râcnepe maname biaŋkeocmu? Me qaqatara‐nanere mârâc motec‐nane tahackepe sâckeocmu? Soc biuc‐nanere fârine hâcne râcnepe sâqocne hurepo i omaeocmu me?”
O mâreŋŋic, go weniŋuc jutec biaŋkeocmu i gaza gowatuc ekicne; go wiac tiŋne ebac ehuc maŋjauŋhec erâ Anutugere maio maŋhuhuŋ jucmurâ Wofuŋzi mugareekac hâcne.
Wofuŋ araŋ bacnepene biaŋkeekac. Wofuŋte dâŋzi hae sâkoo ʒiŋuc fuakac: “Mafa â haeru tumaŋneŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe hazec râeniŋ!
Boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ kâŋgâc jowac rokicne, me sigeli bâbâsifuc repicne ŋic sindaŋne jaŋere ficko domakac jaha, no irec moc nikecnuocmu me?
Me ŋic moc e sigeli â ŋemâc‐ticne bâsifuckerâ bajuekac, ere manape kiŋfâsâc jukac eocmu me?
Hae ira moneŋ mafahec jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe wiac repicne ebac eeŋgopieŋ, â ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋe burecdâŋ eeŋgopieŋ, erâ nameŋ‐jeŋiczi eatuc gie baekac.
No irec hâcne fuŋkerâ kiŋgere erâ ima bacgupe niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fozemec.
Ehuc nânâ nâtec sifu mi gapecguzejec, â nânâre hâhâmo i gorao mi omaezejec. Me wiac moc bârârierâ soŋketec sifu mi fogarezejec, me moc fogareocmuo ine mupe ʒikare biŋe ezejec.
Go wiac hândâŋne gieo tietec fârine fuame qa roro mi ezemec; go oliwa hândâŋne âte pisickerâ gahacne wokemaŋ opâne mi ruazemec, go waiŋ hândâŋne âte pisickerâ opâne wâc mi nâzemec.
Ŋoŋe ŋicwofuŋ Omiri ere dâŋsanaŋ mana rereŋ embiŋ, â Ahabare kikefuŋ jaŋere eebapa bâjâpembiŋ, ehuc mamana biri‐jeŋicte sâcko jumbiŋ. Eme no irec hâcne hae‐ŋeŋic ima bapemu, â hae rune ŋoŋere mupe mu ruruc eŋarenʒepieŋ, erâ ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe musoriŋ‐ŋopanʒepieŋ.”
Jei, jâc hândâŋne batara‐fârekicne, â waiŋ gieonec hândâŋ fârine rofârekicnere basaeŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc jaha jukopac; ehuc waiŋ hândâŋne moc mi bâfuakopac, â jâmbo hândâŋ qeucne nâpemurâ basakopac wâc.
Mâreŋko ŋic mitinezi omaembiŋ, â ŋicŋondeŋko ŋic siocmâc moc mi juŋgopieŋ; jaŋe ʒika qaniŋte ruc babac eeŋgopieŋ, ehuc jaŋe jaŋaczia uficko jowaniŋte ufic rârâec eeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe mejeŋiczi bahac bâfuaniŋte ʒoɋac eeŋgopieŋ, ŋic fekicne â mumutara ŋic jaŋe bâbâmiriŋ moneŋ roniŋte mueŋgopieŋ, â ŋic kâcɋene jaŋe aŋac‐jeŋicte sâcko dâŋ mutarahuc dâŋ tiŋne muhasickeeŋgopieŋ.
Biaŋnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋe qiŋambu ʒârâ iŋucne jueŋgopieŋ, â ŋicfâc‐jeŋic tiŋne jaŋe ʒârâ uupic irec sâc. Iŋuc juhapie rucbapafâc‐jeŋic jaŋe okac dameŋte findaŋdâŋ mumbiŋ i maickeme bipic tatara ejareocmu.
Diguracfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋerao mi siŋkenʒepieŋ, â âgofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋerao mi roweckenʒepieŋ; â ŋokac gohec mâmâc juekac ere ruc bahuc micge soŋaŋkezemec.
Wiac kecʒiŋuc fuaocmu irec erâ iŋuc enʒepieŋ: Ŋokâzi mamac‐ticne qaisockeocmu, otâzi neŋgocnere dâŋ qataraocmu, jojoŋao jahe rârâsi enicmu â ŋic mocte garikiŋfâc jaŋe jaŋaczia kikisâ erâ juniŋmu.
No ine Wofuŋtao ʒâŋe fihuc jupemu, ehuc bâbâpiaŋ‐nane Anutu ere woŋec jupemu, ehame Anutu‐nanezi dâŋnane manaocmu.
O râsifâc‐nane, ŋoŋe honec‐nâpohuc bubiaŋ mi mananʒepieŋ, nâŋe waha nâpowec i sifu mocwâc faharenaŋmu, erâ dapâcmaŋko ŋehapene Wofuŋzi batamaec‐nâpoocmu.
Nâŋe sâqocne bahuc Wofuŋ bunao bambeŋ, irec kimbeŋ‐ticne âsickerâ juhapene dâŋnâŋec mutara‐nârezejec. Eme nâŋe tiŋne juju‐ticne honenaŋte jowac‐nâpome tatamacko fisinaŋmu.
Râsifâc‐nâŋec jaŋe honenʒepieŋ wâc, ehame dâŋ kecʒiŋuc nâzâmbiŋte fai‐jeŋicko mimi fezejec: “Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic weni?” Eme hatao sohoŋ iŋucne âte docjopapie ʒâŋe‐nâŋeczi hone ʒiziwec‐jopanaŋmu.
Dameŋ moc maickeme qânâsacge mocwâc heɋârehuc bâpiaŋkeniŋmu, ehuc mâreŋgere ma i bâsokaniŋmu.
Dameŋ ira hâcne ŋic kecʒiŋuczi gorao fisiniŋmu: Asiria mâreŋkonec raku Aigita mâreŋko tarakac, â Aigita mâreŋkonec raku Eufrata opâ sâkoo mickekac, erâ hâwec ŋifeckonec hâwec ŋifecko â tiki mockoneczi tiki mocko tarakac, mâreŋ ŋondeŋ irecneczi fisi‐gareniŋmu hâcne.
Mâreŋ‐jeŋic ine ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋere eebapa sâqocnere erâ niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ foocmu.
Ŋicfâcge, lamafâcge hâcne, jaŋe rârec rârec mâreŋ guec‐ticnehec fohame mâreŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋ kâtemaŋko bucjeŋic jueŋgopieŋ, irec gunuge bajuhuc soŋaŋ‐jopazemec, ehuc mana‐jaretec mârâc jaha ejumbieŋ irec sâc jaha ehuc Basaŋ â Gileade mâreŋko nânâ bâfuarâ nâhuc junʒepieŋ.
Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐nâpo warehuc wiac bipinehec nâwotutec honembeŋ, irec sâc jaha nâwotutec honenʒepeneŋ.
Eme ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe wiac i honerâ tâpiri‐jeŋicte manapie wawahane eme mimienʒepieŋ, ehuc maŋjeŋic gâckeha fâsâerâ dâŋemâc domanʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe homa â wiac gâcne jaŋe foforâ rahuc rufe nâeŋgopieŋ irec sâc enʒepieŋ, jaŋe ɋarac ɋarac qahuc ficsanaŋ‐jeŋickonec waharâ fâfârehuc Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec maickenʒepieŋ, ehuc ere hâwic‐jopazejec.
Mozi Anutu go iŋucne juhuc sâqocne bâtâmireekac, me ŋicfâc‐ticne ʒanʒaŋne jaŋere qaqatara beheekac? Goki ŋic aki anonoc eejare irec manatec biaŋkeekacte kimbeŋge mimiŋzi ɋâric forahuc juocte mi muekic.
Goki hâcne busâqoc mocwâc manacmu, ehuc kiŋtofa‐nâŋec sasawa âte‐hâmorâ hâwec ʒâkâŋ fâhâŋnao behetec hutâmireocmu.
Go mârâc jaha mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec mupaŋke‐jaremeŋ irec sâcko Jakobo â Abraham jahere ɋâricfâc jaŋe jauŋ fâri â aki anonoc ejare rahuc jucmu sanaŋ.
Niniwe haere findaŋdâŋ. Nahum e Elekosi haeoneczi wiac hone manac ewec irec papia.
Wofuŋ e Anutu ʒoɋac‐ticnehec, erâ wâc kimbeŋ‐ticneheczi okac babazu gie baekac. Wofuŋ e râsifâc‐ticne okacne bazu‐jareekac, â kisâfâc‐ticne kiŋjeŋic bajuekac.
Wofuŋ e kimbeŋ‐ticne uneŋne, â tâpiri‐ticne i ɋârâŋne, e kiŋ bahachec jaŋe moc mi akic‐jopaekac. E karoraczi kike‐ticnere rufe eha âterâ raekac, erâ mâŋâŋ ɋicwânʒâŋnehec â ɋuŋ parandaŋ irec maŋnao juhuc fisiekac.
E hâwec dâŋ mucneme kereŋkeekac, ehuc mume opâ sâkozi ʒicke kereŋ efâreekac. Ehame Basaŋ â Karamele mâreŋko jâc wiac ururucke‐fâreekac, â Lebanoŋ eri qaraweŋ‐ticne somareekac.
Tiki jaŋe ere maio qiriŋ qaeŋgopieŋ, â mâreŋ facne jaŋe ŋenʒaŋnerâ omaeeŋgopieŋ; mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec faio ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe weaŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
Mamana sâqoc‐ticnere mozi sanaŋkerâ domaocmu, â kimbeŋ‐ticnezi bâruŋkerâ ʒacnâpoha mozi juocmu? Aaric‐ticne i ʒoc uucne iŋucne hoŋkeme ʒahuc haroŋaŋ ʒâfâuckeocmu hâcne.
Wofuŋtao roweckeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe uruc jauŋ ejareekac, â ʒârâ hâriŋ dameŋko huec sanaŋ‐jeŋic eekac erao soŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hone manac ejareekac.
Râsifâc‐ticne ine mume rumi sâkozi qâuruc‐jopaekac, â kisâfâc‐ticne jaŋe dapâcko tuŋjopame hueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ râsi ecnehuc wemo dâŋ moc manasu biric eeŋgopieŋ? Eki furu jaha ŋopa mizieocmu, ehuc râsifâc‐ticne ŋoŋerao okac babazu gie arecne jajahec mi baocmu.
Jaŋe fâpâ uupic qâtâcne behec ekicne irec sâc ehapie ʒoczi jawa hahaŋkekicne iŋucne ʒâseŋ‐jopaocmu.
Wofuŋ râsi ecnehuc dâŋ manasu biric ewec, â ŋic doc bacjopahuc juwec e ŋoŋeraonec mi fuawec me?
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Jaŋe ŋic sasanaŋhec â bocjaha, erâ sifu rândiŋkehuc omae‐fâreniŋmu. Juda go biac bâtiŋgupo, irec mocwâc mi bâtiŋgupemu.
Â ɋawegao reŋ râekicne fokac i hâcne qazupemu, erâ niŋgiŋge hetâcnepemu wâc.”
Asiria, gore ine Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mutâcnewec: “Ʒâŋe biŋege mocwâc mi muhuc junʒepieŋ; no ine nemufâcge jaŋere fickonec ɋâŋ qâqâtâc wiac jâczi â aeŋzi ba akic ekicne i ro behec epemu. Go ŋic sindaŋne juekicte mupe ʒâŋeruŋge fuazejec.”
Honeniŋ! Biŋe biaŋ â wamadâŋ bafisirâ muromackezo ekac e biac tikio ware fuakac i! O Juda, go hombaŋge ŋefârehuc Wofuŋtao dâŋ mupaŋkemeŋ irec fârine bâfuazemec, sindaŋŋic e bâsirowekicnere hae mâreŋgao mocwâc sicne fotâc mi eocmu hâcne.
O Niniwe hae, sisipiric ŋiczi fisi‐garezo ekac, irec go haesacko ruc bapa ŋic râec‐jopahuc hata soŋaŋkezemec, erâ bifuŋge jomarâ hâbihec juzemec.
(Wofuŋ e Jakobo â Israe jahere waiŋ qizec emasaŋkerâ bâpiaŋkeocmu, ima bapa ŋic jaŋe waiŋ qizecne ima bahuc qaŋeŋne mâmâc sipirickembiŋ irec.
Ŋicfâc‐ticne tâpiri wânʒâŋhec jaŋere maro i bâbâroŋ, â momorifâc‐ticne jaŋe ŋaqi saŋ bâbâroŋ iŋucne rojuŋgopieŋ; keretac wiac‐ticne mume birickerâ ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne tamaeŋgopieŋ, â becâsic jaŋe kâŋ herâ fahare hâŋ domaŋgopieŋ.
Keretac jaŋe haere hatao fâfâcnehec gasackerâ raŋgopieŋ, ehuc gagasac jaha hae ʒoŋao rac warec ehuc domaŋgopieŋ; jaŋe waha iŋucne bâruŋkeŋgopieŋ, â bâbâric iŋucne tamaeŋgopieŋ.
Momori micne hetumaŋ‐jopakicne jaŋe rahuc hehetuŋ erâ gasackehuc sacko fisirâ sâsâoc boze‐jeŋic biac wirepie domakac.
Opâ kanaŋte motâc ropie ŋicwofuŋ ficko juŋgopieŋ jaŋe fâfârerâ hemâtâc‐jopakac.
Ŋicwofuŋ ŋonâŋ‐ticne e ine ŋaqi‐ticne heunuckerâ kâpâcwâruo baraŋgopieŋ, ehame kiŋaŋ narufâcne jaŋe hapâ iŋucne kio huse eŋgopieŋ, ehuc amec‐jeŋic bomackeŋgopieŋ.
Niniwe hae i opâ nombâŋ mockonec opâzi rafâreekac irec sâc, ehame, “Domaniŋ, domaniŋ!” iŋuc muhuc wirapie moczi moc mi forisiekac.
Siliwa mecne, gol mecne fiucke‐fâreniŋ! Moneŋ mafa me wiac furi sâko i oomaene tâmiric ɋâfoŋnea fokac.
Ima samaki â niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fokac. Ŋic maŋjeŋic omaeme kike‐jeŋic ɋarac ɋarac qakac, â sahac‐jeŋiczi ʒâic fârohec eha ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋiczi weaŋkekac.
Laioŋ jaŋere fofo hae wena, â motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere qânâ hawec i wena? Laioŋ e qowi qarâ hae ira hâcne kisoŋkerâ rajujec, â motecfâcne jaŋe hae ira juhapie moczi moc serereŋ mi ejare jujec.
Laioŋ ŋicnezi ŋokac motecfâcne jaŋere sâc qowi qajujec; qowi qawec â kisuc qâsuckewec i bararâ qânâ hawecko â fofo hae‐ticnao râeme fuse jujec.
Manakic, no râsi egarerâ keretac wiacge ʒoczi turuŋkepe ʒazejec, ehame laioŋfâcge motecne jaŋe ʒikare nânâ enʒepieŋ. Go wiac fiuc rotec sesuc sembureŋ fewec i mupe omaezejec, eme kiŋaŋŋicfâcge jaŋere marac fânâŋ mocwâc mi fuazejec, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Jei, soc hohoŋke hae keci, irec maŋnao ŋic kosa imac‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, erâ eeatuc â fiuczi fusucmarâ foekac, fiuc roro gie i erao moc mi taraekac!
Keci mananiŋ, râsi jaŋe ŋâŋârâczi becâsic jopapie fânâŋkekac, â ʒika keretaczi fisime fânâŋ‐ticnezi heumaŋkekac, becâsic jaŋe gasackeŋgopieŋ, â keretac jaŋe heherâ fisiŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic jaŋe becâsicko ŋehuc ʒocnehec fisiŋgopieŋ, sâqe‐jeŋiczi bâricneha damu‐jeŋiczi qaqac ekac; ŋic qâhâmoc‐jopakicne jaŋe guru sâko, qâŋɋâŋjeŋic i wowosene tâmiric. Ŋic jaŋe ira rahuc fâfâc‐jopakac.
Wiac i sasec hae hawari biaŋ ere sasec giere erâ fuakac, e hâcne sasec gie‐ticnezi ŋicne ŋicne doc bacjopaekac, â ŋic gurune gurune maŋ bâsifuc ejareekac.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, no râsi egarekopac, ehuc qorucge qafiruŋkepe biuctac domahaŋtecne ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe mimige honenʒepieŋ.
No sohoŋ rua‐garehuc mimi qaqa egarepe ŋic maio mamakucne ezemec.
Eme honecguniŋmu jaŋe râpecguhuc muniŋmu: ‘Niniwe hae e imackekicne, mozi ere busâqoc moc manaocmu?’ Bâbâmiriŋ ŋic wenirec bâfuac‐joparâ ejarepe ra bâmiriŋkeniŋmu?”
Niniwe hae, go Tabesi hae irec sâc sirickehuc biaŋne moc ŋeekic me? E Nilu opâ heririŋ ŋehame opâzi râreckehuc fowec, erâ opâzia sacsanaŋ‐ticne erâ fowec.
Etiopia â Aigita mâreŋ jahe tâpiri‐ticnere rowaŋ erâ fohuc jupic, â Puti â Libia ŋic jaŋe wâc babaficfâc‐ticne erâ jumbiŋ.
Ehame sifu ŋecjucfâc‐ticne imac‐joparâ kâpâcwâruo bacjopa rambiŋ; naru motecfâc‐ticne jaŋe hae ʒoŋao henʒaŋ qanʒaŋ‐jopambiŋ, â fekicnefâc‐ticne jaŋere erâ qaŋgec qambiŋ, erâ ŋicfâc‐jeŋic kâcɋene jaŋe aeŋ niŋgiŋko râec‐jopambiŋ.
Eme go iŋuc jaha maŋge bibiriwame maŋmutuc fua‐garezejec. Go râsi jaŋere maio haesoŋko soŋkezo murâ eipiecmu.
Ficsanaŋ wiacge i nemuja jâczi fua qeuec eekac irec sâc. Ehame itiriŋkepie hândâŋne ŋetara wahame ŋic jaŋe ro nâc eeŋgopieŋ.
Manakic, momorifâcge jaŋe ŋokac hawari sasawa. Haegere motâc i râsifâcge jaŋere maio aaŋ fokac, ʒoczi motâc babasanaŋge ʒâtâmirewec hâcne.
Somâ rârâe dameŋko opâ basazicte qanaŋ fiatec haeo fezejec, ehame ficsanaŋ wiacge basac qasanaŋkezemec, â afe fokacko rarâ âte dockera izi fic bapa qânâ bazemec.
Eme sifu ira ʒoczi ʒâtâmirecguocmu, â ʒikazi nâmiziecguocmu, i hâpic jaŋe wiac nanʒaŋneeŋgopieŋ irec sâc fua‐gareocmu. Ŋoŋe hâpic â ɋirikiŋ jaŋe sawe mâririackeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha sawezo murâ sawenʒepieŋ.
Me âbârâ gieŋicfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe sambâŋko bâpiŋ ŋeraŋgopieŋ jaŋere sâc sirickezo murâ sirickenʒepieŋ; erâ sifu hâpic jaŋe ine fakec‐jeŋic hedâmârerâ fahare ratâmireeŋgopieŋ irec sâc ehuc omaeniŋmu.
Fekicnefâcge jaŋe ɋirikiŋ iŋucne, â qâreŋŋicfâcge jaŋe hâpic jaŋere sâc, jaŋe mâmâteŋ dameŋko qânâsacko ferâ ŋeeŋgopieŋ, ʒoaŋ wefume ine fahare raeŋgopieŋ, eme mâreŋ wena raeŋgopieŋ i ŋic moczi moc mi manaekac.
O Asiria ŋicwofuŋ, soŋaŋfâcge jaŋe guŋ biac foŋgopieŋ, â fekicnefâcge jaŋe qâmâc‐jopakac, ehame momorifâcge jaŋe tiki mâreŋko siŋsaŋ qarâ juhapie mozi moc hetumaŋ‐jopazac.
Ʒâpâ gukicne i bâbâpiaŋkenere sâc mi ekac â wicsâkoge i wâc bâbâsomienere sâc aricne. Biŋege mananiŋmu sâc mu âke sisic egarehuc me qagareniŋmu, hehesicgezi dameŋ sâc bawahac‐jopahuc juwec hâcne.
Porofete Habakuc e maŋʒâŋe‐ticnezi wiac hone manac ewec irec dâŋ.
O Wofuŋ, no mu wâwâsic egarehuc juhape wezimucko moc mana‐narecmu? “Jei, bâʒâicnu‐fâreeŋgopieŋ!” No iŋuc muhuc wira wâwâsic egarehape mi baficnuekic i.
Go wemocte wiac hehesicne nowatutec honeekopac, â ŋic bâʒâic‐jopapie hone qâoma ejareekic? Fiuc â bâbâʒâiczi mai‐naneo foha mu qaqatarac â rârâsi epie honeekopac wâc.
Iŋuc fuame sâcmutâc dâŋzi tâpirimâc eekac, â tiŋne hatazi mi fua taniŋkeekac. Ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe ŋic tiŋne bawahac‐jopahuc jueŋgopieŋ, â mumutiŋ dâŋ muhasickeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋerao ʒâŋe fipie rame warecke sâqorehuc bipic tatara enʒepieŋ. No ŋoŋere dameŋko gie fuŋmoc bapemu, irec biŋe ŋazapie muzac mi mana ʒakienʒapiŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no Kaldea ŋic râŋgeŋne â qac momorihec jaŋe qafeŋ‐jopape faharerâ ŋic furune jaŋere fic hae wiac ro rauc eniŋte mâreŋne mâreŋne fotâcnerâ raeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋic hâhâwicne â aaŋgiŋne juhuc tiŋne jujure sâcmutâc i maŋjeŋicte kosa âkendâŋneeŋgopieŋ.
Becâsicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere gagasaczi qowi mimicne ʒâŋene lepad ere gagasac sirickehuc kâte qâto jaŋere gagasac sirickeekac jaha. Ŋicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe becâsicko bune bune raeŋgopieŋ, ine hâcne, jaŋe ʒorickonec ware fisieŋgopieŋ, ehuc sisipiric gie baniŋte tucwipezi qowi qaocte sâoekac irec sâc eeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe bâbâʒâic gie baniŋte biŋe bâroŋzi mâreŋ sâcke‐fâreme fisieŋgopieŋ, ehuc ŋic kâpâcwâru bacjopaeŋgopieŋ i moŋgeŋ fokac irec sâc.
Jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ mana wahac‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, â guriŋ bapa ŋic mu âke sisic ejareeŋgopieŋ. Ficsanaŋte manapie gâgâwinehec eha mâreŋ facne barâ ferâ domahuc ro rauc eeŋgopieŋ.
Iŋuc erâ mâŋâŋ iŋucne fotâcnerâ raeŋgopieŋ; ŋic iŋucne jaŋe jaŋacne tâpirire manapie Anutu‐jeŋic eekac.
O Wofuŋ, Tiri Anutu‐nane, go fuŋnaonecteaŋ juwarehuc jumeŋte mi hâmonaŋmu. O Wofuŋ, go mumutara gie baniŋte mujaremeŋ. O Haroŋaŋ, go bâbâtiŋ gie baniŋte hefârec‐jopameŋ.
Ʒâŋege ɋaɋacne fokacte wiac sâqocne honezo mi egareekac, ehame wemocte ŋic sindaŋnezi ŋic tiŋne ɋâckeocte eme hone qâoma ecneekic?
Go ŋic ejaretec hâwec qowi iŋucne eeŋgopieŋ, â wiac ru tâmiric foforâ juekac irec sâc bâfuaeŋgopieŋ.
Râsi jaŋe hehawic‐jopa‐fâreeŋgopieŋ, â wasaŋ‐jeŋic behepie jowa‐fâreeŋgopieŋ, erâ ufic‐jeŋic fârehapie ira jowaeŋgopieŋ, irec jaŋe bubiaŋ manahuc ʒeri eeŋgopieŋ.
Irec erâ wasaŋ‐jeŋic taha bâzi ecnehuc ufic‐jeŋic hosâc âsu rikecneeŋgopieŋ, eme wiac izi hâcne moneŋ mafa â nânâ mâriri sâko bâfua‐jareekac.
Jaŋe dameŋ sâc ŋicne ŋicne wasaŋzi ro hesiec ejarehuc busâqoc tâmiric qâhâmoc‐jopapie sâckeocmu me?
No ruc bapemu, ehuc ruc bapa fic ira domahuc ʒâŋe fipemu, ine Wofuŋtao dâŋgie bapo irec okacne weniŋuc nazame manapemurâ iŋuc epemu.
Eme Wofuŋ e dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐narewec: “Maŋzi wiac hone manac ekomec i tafeo aijakic qâreŋketec quŋquŋke tâmiric wosenʒepieŋ.
Wiac hone manac ekomec i wiac fârine, erâ dameŋne maickeme fuaocmu, erâ fuaocte dameŋne qândâŋkekac hâcne. Dameŋ‐ticne qâsuame sifu woŋec juzemec, juku dameŋ‐ticne maickeme fua‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.
Manakic, ŋic maŋsiocheczi qurutuaocmu, â ŋic tiŋne e mamanasiŋ‐ticnere erâ juocmu.
Jei, ŋic ʒâʒâicne â waiŋ opâ âmbâŋ nâ areŋ eene! E micticne ʒâŋeruŋ aaŋ foekac iŋucne, erâ wâc hâmoc iŋucne nânâ gapemâc nâekac. E ŋicne ŋicne hetumaŋ‐jopaekac, â ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe e jahacne biŋe erâ juniŋte ro qâzuc ejareekac.”
Eme ŋic jaŋe ʒoraŋ gae hecnehuc mu âke sisic ecnerâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Jei, ŋic gâcne jaŋere wiac e jahacne biŋe eocte ro qâzuc eme tofa‐ticne fuaekac, i wezimucko moc beheocmu?”
Tofa‐jeŋic gorao fokac ŋic i jaŋe faharerâ onʒoŋ jaha râsi fisi‐garehuc wiac gowac ropie bipic tatara egareocmu.
Go gahac ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere wiac kâŋgâc jowac rorâ ŋicsoc hoŋkehuc hae mâreŋ imackerâ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne bâʒâic‐jopameŋte ŋic tiwâne jaŋe iŋuc jaha wiacge gowac roniŋmu.
Jei, burec ehuc mafa wiac hurerâ ficticnao râe guruc eocmu, ehuc sisipiric wisecnerâ juhâmoocte huec sanaŋ‐ticne baocmu!
Go dâŋ manasu biric ehuc ŋic gurune gurune sipiric‐jopameŋ, irec fârine gahacne kikefuŋko mimi qaqa fuaocmu, ehame jujugezi sipirickeocmu hâcne.
Qânâ jaŋe ficte sâpe erâ domahuc owackeniŋmu, ehame sore safatariŋ jaŋe dâŋ okacne bâtikieniŋmu hâcne.
Jei, soc hoŋkehuc hae sâko baekac, erâ sindaŋ ehuc fic biri ʒora bâfua raekac!
Manaŋgopieŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere micte ʒiŋuc fuaekac: Ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe gie baeŋgopieŋ i ʒocte biŋe sasawa, ehame ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe ʒâic gie i mâc maŋgâŋ baeŋgopieŋ.
Hâwec ʒâkâŋ sâko fokac irec sâc jaha Wofuŋ huriri qâreŋ‐ticnezi hae mâreŋ fusucmarâ fohame ŋic jaŋe hone mana tarac efâreniŋmu.
Jei, ŋic moc waiŋ â opâ momori bâsifuckerâ âgofâc‐ticne gumec‐jopame maŋjeŋic sifuckeha biuctac jupie honec‐joparâ bubiaŋ manaocmu!
Manakic, mimi busâqoczi bâumbeŋgume ʒâŋe biŋege omaezejec. Go gahacne wâc maŋsifuc opâ nârâ biric boroc ezemec. Wofuŋte mefâreo râqâc fokac izi gorao fisime ʒâŋe biŋegezi omaeme mimi busâqoc fua‐gareocmu hâcne.
Go ŋic jaŋere soc hoŋkehuc hae mâreŋ sâko bâʒâickerâ ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jopa sipiric ejaremeŋte Lebanoŋ tiki imackekicne izi ŋemacgurâ bârârâŋguocmu. Â kâte qowi sipiric‐jopakicne jaŋe wâc hâhâwic sâko bâfua‐gareniŋmu.
Metâ bapa eki ɋâŋ qâqâtâc fasaeekac, me aeŋzi hawari wiac burecne baekac, izi wemocko moc bafic‐nâpoocmu? Metâ bapa e ɋâŋ qâqâtâc dâŋemâcne fasaerâ e jahacne meqâreŋko roweckeekac hâcne.
Jei, ŋic moc eki wiac jâczi bakicne ʒiŋuc âzâcneocmu: Go mana ɋâɋârec, me qânâ âzâcneocmu, go faharec! Wiac iŋucnezi findaŋdâŋ sâcne muocmu me? Manakic, wiac i siliwa â golzi bohotahuc foŋkekicne, erâ nokafe moc mi heekac.
Wofuŋ eki ine tiri ufuŋ‐ticnao juekac, irec mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ e ere maio tiŋbenoŋ fuarâ fozejec.
Porofete Habakuc ere nunumu dâŋ moc ʒi.
O Wofuŋ, go gie bameŋ irec dâŋ binaŋ manapo, i manasurâ ɋarac ɋarac qakopac. Go jara sâc giege heɋârerâ bahuc mocwâc fua tâcnezemec. Erâ aaric manahuc sifu buurucgere manasuzemec.
Wofuŋ Tiri rune e Temaŋ hae mâreŋkonec, â Paraŋ tikionec ware fisiwec, ehame huriri qâreŋ‐ticnezi sambâŋ sâcke‐fârewec, â mumuteŋ‐ticnezi mâreŋ fusucma‐fârerâ fowec.
Tatamac‐ticne i ʒoaŋ tatamac iŋucne, â ʒâziriŋ‐ticnezi meticnao tamaewec, ehame tâpiri‐ticne irec maŋnao soŋkerâ fowec.
Huc hâmoczi bâniecnewec, â sisipiriczi râpefuŋnao bâjâpewec.
E niniŋkerâ domahame mâreŋzi ɋiɋiteckewec, e ŋicne ŋicne honec‐jopahuc itiriŋ‐jopawec. Iŋuc eme tiki ŋeŋe sanaŋ jaŋe fâuckerâ ŋetâtiembiŋ, â mâreŋ facne jaŋe uruŋkerâ humbiŋ. E jahacne ine hata sanaŋ‐ticnao jaha rahuc juwec.
No Kusaŋŋic jaŋe ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio ferâ juhapie honec‐jopapo, â Midiaŋ ŋic jaŋe ɋarac ɋarac qambiŋ.
O Wofuŋ, go becâsic faio me keretac faio sanaŋkerâ rahuc opâ kâcɋene sasawa aaric mana‐jaremeŋ me? Me hâwec manacnetec sâqorewec me?
Go tepe neŋgocne gurutuc herâ motecne tikocko he fâremeŋ. Ehuc mutec mâreŋ fâuckeme opâ kâcɋene fua‐fârewec.
Tiki jaŋe honecgurâ qiriŋ qambiŋ, karorac jaŋe opâ hoŋkepie hoe micsâko hewec, â hâwec sirizi fânâŋkewec.
Go mege bâfeŋnetec mosa â ʒoaŋ jahe niniŋkerâ ŋepic, jahe tepe motecgere ʒâziriŋ â damugere tatamac fuame weaŋkepic hâcne.
Go aaric manahuc mâreŋ sâc âterâ rameŋ, ehuc kimbeŋko ŋicne ŋicne âtenʒaŋ‐jopameŋ.
Go ŋicfâcge bafic‐jopazore, â wokemaŋ ruacnemeŋ e dopeckezore waha rameŋ. Go ŋic sindaŋnere qizec qanʒaŋnemeŋ, ehuc ficticnere woke qâtâc hetâtierâ wâtuŋ‐ticne qârisie‐fâremeŋ.
Momorifâc‐ticne jaŋe guru bâgic enâreniŋte ʒâʒâkiriŋ mâŋâŋ iŋucne warerâ soŋsoŋko ŋic hapetac ɋâcjopaniŋte ehapie tepe motecgezi qizec‐jeŋicko murumeŋ.
Becâsicfâcge jaŋe hâwec fotâcnerâ rapie hâwec siri sâko qahuc fânâŋkewec.
Eme no irec fânâŋ manarâ mesahac‐nane jâjâwâckeha bipic tatara enarekac, erâ me kike‐nane betaŋke‐fâreme hata razo ehape kike‐nanezi ɋarac ɋarac qakac. No wiac nâwoc roeŋgopieŋ ŋicguru i jaŋerao ʒârâ hâriŋ fuaocte niniŋkerâ woŋec jupemu.
Jâmbojâczi mi ârickeocmu, â waiŋ qaŋeŋnao fârine mi fuaocmu, â oliwa jâczi fâri tâmiric jaha domaocmu, â giegaŋko nânâ basaniŋmu. Lama jaŋe sipiricke‐fâreniŋmu, â bulimakao jaŋe ficko omaeniŋmu.
Wiac iŋuc fua‐fâreme no sifu Wofuŋte erâ ʒeri epemu, bâbâpiaŋ‐nane Anutu ere erâ kiwaepemu hâcne.
Wofuŋ Anutu eki hâcne tâpiri‐nane, e kike‐nane kâte bulimakao jaŋere kike iŋucne bâfua‐narehuc jowacnume tiki botâŋko âte sanaŋkerâ raekopac.
Wofuŋte dâŋ i Amoŋte ŋokâ Josiazi Juda ŋicwofuŋ erâ juhame Zefaniarao fuawec. Zefania e ine Kusire ŋokâ, Kusizi ine Gedaliare ŋokâ, Gedalia e ine Amariare ŋokâ, â Amariazi Hisikiare ŋokâ, iŋuc fuarâ jumbiŋ.
“No mâreŋte faio wiac fofârekac i ʒeŋgoma bâsirowe‐jâmbâŋkepemu,” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
“No ŋic mecne, qowi mecne, sawa wipe mecne, â opâ qowi mecne jaŋe mâmâc sasawa omaec‐jopa‐fârepemu. Erâ ŋic hehesicne jopahuc mâreŋŋic ʒeŋgoma bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârepemu,” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
“No Judaŋic â Jerusalem ŋecjucfâc‐ticne mâmâc râsi ejarepemu, erâ Baali nemu araŋ babacne irec wiac i mâreŋ ʒirecnec ro bârâriec ehuc taha bapa burecne jaŋe omaec‐jopapemu wâc.
Â wiac kecʒiŋuc eeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe mâmâc bâsirowec‐jopapemu: Ficbupuo ferâ mosa ʒoaŋ â bâpiŋ dape‐jareeŋgopieŋ, â fodaperâ Wofuŋtao ɋetickehuc dâŋnâŋec mupaŋkenʒepeneŋ, iŋuc muhuc burec erâ Milikom nemu erao mupaŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ Wofuŋ bâjâpehuc juku râpeckembiŋ, ehuc wira basac me mu wioc mi ecneeŋgopieŋ.”
Wofuŋ Anuture maio niniŋkeniŋ! Wofuŋte dameŋ maickekac hâcne. Wofuŋ e taha bâzi râe bâmoc ehuc hefârec‐jopakicne jaŋe biric‐jopakac.
Wofuŋzi kecʒiŋuc mukac: “No taha bâzi dameŋ ira micne bapa â ŋicwofuŋte ŋokâfâc jaŋe katucne jarepemu, erâ ŋic jabane jaŋere eebapao raʒieŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc.
No dameŋ ira qâpuc mamanasiŋ bâjâpeeŋgopieŋ erâ eeatuc â bâbâʒâic gie bahuc fekicne‐jeŋicte fic hefuseeŋgopieŋ jaŋe okacne jare‐fârepemu.”
Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc mukac: “Dameŋ ira Jerusalem haere motâc moc ʒâŋene Opâ Qowi Motâc, irecnec kio owa moc fuame mananiŋmu, â hae ɋâricnaonec ki ojowa, â hae toŋnaonec wâc fânâŋ sâko fuaocmu.
Âbârâ gie bapa ŋic jaŋe sipiric‐jopakicne, â siliwa moneŋ sigelio râe jumbieŋ ŋic i jaŋe wâc bâsirowec‐jopakicne, irec hae dâkâne mocte uuruŋnao ŋec juc eeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe kio owa eniŋ!
Eme no dameŋ ira hâcne Jerusalem haere fuŋne bajaŋgeŋkepemu, ehuc nânâ mafa wiac‐jeŋicko qohota sanaŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe okacne bazu‐jarepemu, maŋjeŋiczi ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne: ‘Wofuŋ e wiac biaŋne mecne sâqocne mecne moc mi enâreocmu.’
Moneŋ mafa wiac‐jeŋic i fiuc roro jaŋere biŋe ezejec, â hae‐jeŋic i niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fozejec. Eme fic wiac mocwâc bâpiaŋkerâ baniŋmuo ine sifu maŋnao ŋec foc mi enʒepieŋ, me waiŋ gie bapie fârine fuaocmuo ine wâc mi nânʒepieŋ.”
Wofuŋte okac dameŋ maickehuc biac qândâŋke‐fârekac. Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋte dameŋ i dameŋ hâtâne, irec ŋic qac momorihec jaŋe wâc kiohuc owa ruruckeniŋmu.
Dameŋ i kimbeŋ aaric dameŋ, erâ wâc ʒârâ hâriŋ â ʒâic dameŋ, sisipiric â ima qaqa dameŋ, dapâc â dapâc siŋsiŋ irec dameŋ, erâ karorac â dapâc qisiric irec dameŋ.
Dameŋ ira qeŋfânâŋ â ʒikare aŋara hehe fuame hae sanaŋ â fic hâŋ bakicne jaŋe wemocko sanaŋkerâ ŋeniŋmu.
Ŋic jaŋe wiac hehesicne ehuc Wofuŋ no bunaneo bambiŋte hâhâwic hejarepe ŋic jaŋe ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ iŋucne erâ qic qucne junʒepieŋ. Socjeŋic i rufe iŋucne hoŋkezo, â sahac biuc‐jeŋic i sohoŋ iŋucne âte dockezo.
Wofuŋ kimbeŋ‐ticnere dameŋko siliwa â gol wiac‐jeŋiczi mi ŋezic‐jopaocmu, aricne. Mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ i kimbeŋ‐ticnere ʒocbâruŋzi ʒâseŋke‐fâreocmu. Ehame mâreŋte ŋecjucfâc jaŋe furu jaha ututuŋ hâmo miziec efâreniŋmu.
O ŋicguru qâomane, ŋoŋe qâture‐fârerâ tumaŋnenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe padi jawa mâŋâŋzi ficne sueme raekac irec sâc eŋarehuc mi jâjâpec‐ŋopa mâc juhapie, me Wofuŋ kimbeŋ‐ticnezi fai‐ŋeŋicko mi fefe mâc fohame, me Wofuŋte okac dameŋzi biac mi maic‐ŋopahame iŋuc hâcne enʒepieŋ.
Mâreŋko maŋhuhuŋ juhuc sâcmutâc dâŋticne mana rereŋ efâreeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe Wofuŋ wira basac ecnenʒepieŋ, erâ tiŋne hatare henʒiriŋnehuc maŋuruc junʒepieŋ. Iŋuc ehuc Wofuŋte okac dameŋko aakic bâfuaniŋmu mecne.
Gaza â Asikaloŋ hae jahe niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fonicmu; Asidode hae râsi jaŋe ʒoaŋ ɋaɋackoa fisirâ hae rune jâpec‐jopapie raniŋmu, â Ekoroŋ hae i hetâtieniŋmu wâc.
Jei, Kreta ŋicguru hâwecmecko ŋeŋe juju eeŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ e râsi eŋarehuc ʒiŋuc mukac: O Kanaaŋ, Filisa ŋic jaŋere mâreŋ, no ima bacgupe ŋecjucfâcge jaŋe omae‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Â mâreŋ hâwec heririŋko fokac i lama bulimakao jaŋere biŋe ezejec.
Iŋuc fuame hâwec heririŋko mâreŋ forakac i Judaŋic ʒanʒaŋne jaŋere biŋe ehame lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic râec‐jopahuc jaŋacne ine hae ŋafeme sâc Asikaloŋ haeo ŋec foc enʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋiczi iqic‐joparâ busâqoc faio juju‐jeŋic i bârârieha bubiaŋ faio juju fua‐jareocmu hâcne.
Israere Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “No Moabi ŋic jaŋere mumusoriŋ dâŋ, â Amoŋŋic jaŋere qaqaisoc dâŋ i mâmâc mana‐fârepo, jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane musoriŋ‐jopahuc mâreŋ‐jeŋicte manapie wawahane ewec.
No jujâmbâŋkekopaczi ʒiŋuc mupaŋkekopac: Moabi mâreŋ i Sodom hae iŋucne ezejec, â Amoŋ mâreŋ i Gomora irec sâc, ehuc hae mâreŋ ira fâpâ ʒârâ â qânâ siec fuame burocne erâ fozejec. Ehame ŋicfâc‐nane ʒanʒaŋne jaŋe wiac‐jeŋic jowac rohuc mâreŋ‐jeŋic rauckeniŋmu.”
Wiac izi hâcne maŋfefe‐jeŋicte okacne fua‐jareocmu jaŋe Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere ŋicfâc musoriŋ‐jopahuc mana wahac‐jopambiŋ irec.
Wofuŋzi wiac hâhâwicne ejareocmu; jei, e mâreŋte nemu fuŋne fuŋne bâsirowec‐jopa‐fâreocmu, ehame ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe ru sâc mâreŋ‐jeŋickoa juhuc Wofuŋ dapecneniŋmu.
Etiopia ŋic ŋoŋe wâc iŋuc jaha ʒika‐nanere nânâ enʒepieŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ e meticne sicnerâ faic mâreŋ, Asiria hâcne, i râsi ecnehuc ima bame Niniwe haezi mâreŋ burocne irec sâc kereŋkerâ foocmu.
Eme lama bulimakao mecne, kâte qowi mecne, jaŋe haemaŋko waha fomananiŋmu; tucwipe â mâreŋpecne qowi jaŋe sesuctacko fic hae‐jeŋic banʒepieŋ; ŋafe wipezi qâqâtâc kataŋko ŋehuc dâŋezejec, â kâec kâeczi ine motâcfuŋko ira ŋehuc dâŋezejec. Jâmâzâc jâczi fic basarickekicne i Wofuŋzi ima baocmu hâcne.
Hae ʒerinehec ŋewec ine hâcne, e jahacnere maname feha ʒiŋuc mujujec: “No mocjahazi fekicne sâko.” Ʒi ine niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ fohuc mi kâte qowi jaŋere ŋeŋe hae ezejec i! Ehame ŋic sicne fotâc eeŋgopieŋ sâc mehuhuŋ‐jeŋic hehesackehuc mu âke sisic ecneeŋgopieŋ.
Jei, hae keci micrereŋ tâmiric râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne juhuc bâbâʒâic gie baekac hâcne!
E dâŋ fuame mi manaekac, â bâbâtiŋte takickeekac, e Wofuŋtao mi roweckeekac, ehuc Anutu‐ticne mi maickeekac.
Haemaŋko fekicnefâc‐ticne juŋgopieŋ jaŋe laioŋzi owackeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc ehuc jueŋgopieŋ, â dâŋ mumutara ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe kâte qâto iŋucne eeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe nânâ‐jeŋic nâhuc furictere biŋe tiwâne moc mi behepie foekac.
Porofetefâc‐ticne jaŋe ŋic ʒaubacne â burec‐jeŋichec, erâ taha bapafâc‐ticne jaŋe wiac tirine gâc hecnehuc sâcmutâc dâŋ muhasickeeŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋzi ine ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko tiŋne juhuc wiac moc mi bâsifuckeekac. E furicne furicne mumutiŋ gie‐ticnere fuŋne bajaŋgeŋkehuc dameŋ moc mi hetaraekac; ŋic hehesicne jaŋe ine sifu mimi tâmiric kosa jueŋgopieŋ.
“No ŋicguru gâcne bâsirowec‐jopahuc ficsanaŋ‐jeŋic ima bafârepo. Ehuc hae hata‐jeŋic sipirickepo, ira moczi moc rac warec sâcne mi eekac. Hae wiac‐jeŋic niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ foha maŋnao ŋic jaŋe ŋeŋe juju mocwâc mi eeŋgopieŋ.
Iŋuc fuame mupo: ‘Ʒi jâmbomac araŋ banarehuc mumutiŋ dâŋnane mananiŋmu, ehuc dâŋ jaza mutâc epo i mi nikec‐jopaocmu.’ Jaŋe ine ʒoɋac erâ eebapa‐jeŋic sâqocne i sueme sue bafembiŋ.”
Irec Wofuŋte dâŋ ʒiŋuc fokac: “Ŋoŋe nore woŋec junʒepieŋ, dameŋ maickeme no mumutaniŋ ŋic erâ fahare domapemu. Mumupaŋ‐nane ʒiŋuc fokac: No ŋic gurune gurune qâzuc‐jopahuc ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec hetumaŋ‐jopapemu, i aaric â kimbeŋ‐nanere ʒoc kine hesiepe fai‐jeŋicko feocte iŋuc epemu. Mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ i ʒoɋac‐nanere ʒocbâruŋzi ʒâseŋke‐fâreocmu hâcne.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, no dameŋ ira ŋic gurune gurune micbipic‐jeŋic bârisiepe ɋaɋackezejec, eme Wofuŋ nore ʒâŋe riwaseckehuc maŋ mocjaha erâ kiŋaŋ qanare‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Bâtâtiec‐jopakicnefâc‐nane jaŋe Etiopia opâ sâko ocniŋucnaonec ware fisirâ numu‐narehuc taha banareniŋmu.
“Ŋoŋe sâqocne fuŋne fuŋne bahuc bunaneo bambiŋ, irec erâ dameŋ ira mimi faio mocwâc mi râec‐ŋopazo. Pepec penaroŋ ehuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋickonec bârâriec‐jopapemu hâcne, ehame ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha tiri tiki‐naneo penaroŋhec mocwâc mi juniŋmu.
No ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic maŋhuhuŋ â waha qaqane jaŋe sawa bâtiric‐jopape juniŋmu, ehuc Wofuŋ nore ʒâŋeo roweckepie sâoc‐jopahape juniŋmu.
Israe ŋic ʒanʒaŋne jaŋe hâcne sâqocne mi baniŋmu, â burecdâŋ mi muniŋmu, erâ nameŋ‐jeŋiczi eeatuc mi eocmu. Jaŋe nânâ nâku waha fomanahapie moczi moc hâhâwic mi hejareocmu.”
O Zioŋte otâ, go gae hesokahuc hec! O Israe, go semuja hec! O Jerusalemte otâ, go bubiaŋ manahuc ʒeri bari ec!
Wofuŋ e kisâfâcge bârâriec‐jopawec, â râsifâcge bâsirowec‐jopawec. Israere Femicne, Wofuŋ hâcne, eki gohec jukacte wiac hâhâwicnezi mocwâc mi fua‐garezejec.
Dameŋ ira Jerusalem hae e dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnezo: “O Zioŋ, go mi hâwicguzejec, â mege mi betaŋkezejec.
Wofuŋ Anutuzi gohec juekac, e qac momoriheczi baficguekac hâcne. E gore bubiaŋ sâko manahuc maŋjauŋ‐ticnere erâ bâpiaŋguekac, erâ hombaŋ dameŋko ʒeri eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc gore erâ ʒeri eekac.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Sisipiriczi mimi bâfua‐garewecte no i hâcne bârâriepemu.
Manakic, no dameŋ ira bâbâʒâicfâcge jaŋe fisi‐jarerâ omaec‐jopapemu, ehuc kike demba jaŋe bâpiaŋ‐jopapemu, â bâtâtiec‐jopakicne jaŋe qâzuc‐jopapemu. No mimi gaŋgaŋ‐jeŋic hetikiepe ʒeri mumuteŋzi biŋe raranehec fuame mâreŋ sâc mana‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Qâzuc‐ŋopapemu dameŋ ira hâcne jowac‐ŋopape mame sâko hae‐ŋeŋicko risienʒepieŋ. Â busâqoc faio juju‐ŋeŋic hetikiepe bubiaŋ faio juju fua‐ŋareocmu dameŋ ira wâc mupe ʒâŋe biŋe‐ŋeŋiczi â mumuteŋ‐ŋeŋiczi mâreŋ sâc ŋic sâcjopa‐fârezejec.”
Dariusi e ŋicwofuŋ erâ juhame jara 1 â mosa 5 tarawec. Eme mosa 6 fufuŋkenao ira porofete Hagaizi Juda mâreŋ soŋaŋ Serubabe, Sealitiere ŋokâ, â taha bapa sâko Josua, Jozadacte ŋokâ hâcne, jahe Wofuŋte dâŋ ʒiŋuc jasawec:
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋicguru kecʒi jaŋe ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: Wofuŋte ufuŋ heɋârehuc bazore dameŋne mi maickekac.”
Eme porofete Hagaizi Wofuŋte dâŋ ʒuhuckerâ kecʒiŋuc muwec:
“Wofuŋte ufuŋ ima bakicnezi foha ŋaŋacne fic ba akic ekicnao ŋec foc eniŋte dameŋne maickekac me?
Irec hâcne Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki ʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe wiac ʒiŋuc fua‐ŋareekac irec manasuniŋ:
Ŋoŋe he sarac bocjaha embiŋ, fârine ine boc mi fua‐ŋarewec, ŋoŋe nânâ nâeŋgopieŋ, erâ sifu mi gapec‐ŋopaekac; ŋoŋe opâ nâeŋgopieŋ, erâ sifu mi sâcŋopaekac; ŋoŋe ŋaqi wiac hepie huekac, erâ sifu mi hâroŋ‐ŋopaekac; ŋoŋe moneŋ gie bahuc moneŋ rorâ kânoŋ‐ŋeŋic hawecnehecko ŋiepie hurâ wahaekac.
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki ʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe wiac fua‐ŋarewec irec moc manasunʒepieŋ.
Ehuc kâteo ferâ jâcsiec rorâ waha taha ufuŋ banʒepieŋ, eme no irec bubiaŋ manahape huriri qâreŋ‐nanezi fua tâcnezejec, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Ŋoŋe nânâ wiac bocjaha fua‐ŋareocte giene bapie fârine afecne sawa fuawec, eme i haeo bafisipie noni ficne suepe omaewec. Wemocte? Ŋoŋe ŋaŋacne fic wiac fuaocte ʒoɋac ehuc juhapie nore ficzi ŋetâtierâ ʒaŋke‐fârewec fokac irec. Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Irec sambâŋzi bâpiŋ titikuc aka hecnewec â mâreŋ e ine mazuc mâriri‐ticne sakarewec.
