Eme no mupe wiac kecʒiŋuczi kereŋke‐fârewec: Mâreŋ â tiki, jacgoŋ â waiŋ, oliwa wokemaŋ â mâreŋko wiac fua‐fâreekac, ehame ŋic â qowi erâ gie bapa‐jeŋicte fârine sasawa sipiricke‐fârewec.”
Iŋuc mume Sealitiere ŋokâ Serubabe â Jozadac ŋokâ‐ticne taha bapa sâko Josua, erâ ŋic ʒanʒaŋne jaŋe mâmâc sasawa Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋicte dâŋ mecne, â porofete Hagai ere dâŋ mecne mâmâc manarâ reŋkembiŋ, i Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋiczi jaŋerao porofete sorewec irec iŋuc embiŋ. Eme ŋic jaŋe Anuture hâwic‐jopame araŋ bacnembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Hagai e Wofuŋte biŋe mumuzi Wofuŋte micte ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No ŋoŋehec jukopac, Wofuŋ no iŋuc mupaŋkekopac.”
Eme Wofuŋ e Sealitiere ŋokâ Serubabe, Juda mâreŋ soŋaŋ hâcne, â Jozadac ŋokâ‐ticne taha bapa sâko Josua, erâ ŋic ŋokac gâcne sasawa esoc qafeŋ ejareme ʒoɋac sasanaŋ bâfuarâ ra Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ‐jeŋic hâcne, ere fic fuaocte giene fuŋkembiŋ.
Ine mosa namba 6 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 24 ira iŋuc embiŋ.
Dariusi e ŋicwofuŋ erâ juhame jara namba 2 irec mosa namba 7 â ʒoaŋ gie bapa 21 ira porofete Hagaizi ŋic ŋokac Wofuŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc jazawec:
“Go Sealitiere ŋokâ Serubabe, Juda mâreŋ soŋaŋ hâcne, â Jozadac ŋokâ‐ticne Josua taha bapa sâko, erâ ŋic ŋokac ʒanʒaŋne sasawa dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazac:
‘Ŋoŋeraonec moczi mârâc jaha fic keci eri qaraweŋ‐ticnehec ŋehame honewec? Â ʒiŋuczia ine hawarine weniŋuc fuame honeŋgopieŋ? Honepie wiac omane ekac me weniŋuc?
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: O Serubabe, go hâbige roc, â Jozadacte ŋokâ, Josua taha bapa sâko, go wâc hâbige roc, erâ mâreŋ ʒirecnec ŋic ŋokac sasawa ŋoŋe hâbi hârohec erâ junʒepieŋ. No ŋoŋehec juekopacte gie baniŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Aigita mâreŋkonec wahahapie dâŋ mupaŋke‐ŋarepo irec sâcko ŋoŋehec juekopac hâcne. Mâro‐nanezi ŋoŋehec juekacte mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Piticne jufenaŋmu, eme dameŋ moc ira noni sambâŋ â mâreŋ, hâwec â tiki itiriŋ‐jopapemu;
erâ ŋic gurune gurune ejarepe qiriŋ qafâreniŋmu. Eme boreŋ‐jeŋic ʒira ware‐fâreme noni mupe eri qaraweŋzi fic kecʒi fusucmaocmu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Siliwa mecne, gol mecne irec rune noni jukopac, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Ufuŋ kecʒirec eri tatamac mârâc fowec i wawahane ehame ʒâhec fuaocmuzi fefene jâmbâŋ eocmu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Eme hae mâreŋ kecʒira wama mupe fuaocmu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.’”
Dariusi e ŋicwofuŋ erâ juhame jara namba 2 irec mosa namba 9 â ʒoaŋ gie bapa 24 ira Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ porofete Hagai erao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki ʒiŋuc mukac: Go taha bapa numu‐jaretec wiwio kecʒiŋuc irec okacne bâtikie‐garenʒepieŋ:
‘Ŋic moc e qowi jambuŋkekicne ŋaqi qoruc‐ticnezi foŋkerâ bajuhuc nânâ poroŋ me nânâ rikekicne, me waiŋ me wokemaŋ, me wiac nânâne i me i heuwame tiri moc eocmu me?’” Eme taha bapa jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Aricne.”
Eme Hagaizi muwec: “Ŋic moc e ine qâŋɋâŋ moc bâuwahuc wâwânâŋhec erâ ʒâhec wiac keci jaŋe moc heuwac‐jopame wâwânâŋhec eniŋmu me?” Mume taha bapa jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Eha wemo, wâwânâŋhec eniŋmu hâcne.”
Iŋuc mupie Hagaizi muwec: “Ŋicguru ʒi nore maŋfuŋko juŋgopieŋ jaŋe jaŋacne fuŋne mecne â meqâreŋ‐jeŋicte fuŋne mecne i sâc ijaha fokac, irec wiac i me i tahare râeeŋgopieŋ i wâwânâŋnehec jaha eekac. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Erâ ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc mukopac: Ŋoŋe ʒi wiac weniŋuc fua‐ŋare raocmu i hone manac enʒepieŋ, ehuc fic kecʒirec wâtuŋ mi râepie huwec dameŋ ira wiac weniŋuc fua‐ŋarewec i wâc mâmâc manasunʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe padi gie mockonec târu 20 irec sâc ro ŋihec enaŋmu muhuc ra târu 10 irec sâc sawa fome rombiŋ, me waiŋ bapa ficko ira waiŋ pake 50 fiapene hurâ fusucmaocmu muhuc rarâ fiapie pake 20 sawa hurâ fusewec.
I ʒiŋucte fuawec: No bâʒâic‐ŋopahuc mupe giegaŋ‐ŋeŋicte fârine gâcne ʒoaŋ fâroroczi ʒâhâmome kenoŋkewec, â gâcne hoe sanaŋzi henʒaŋnewec, ŋoŋe ine maŋŋeŋic mi bârisiembiŋ. Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Irec ŋoŋe mosa namba 9 irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 24 ʒirecnec fuŋkerâ jufehuc wiac weniŋuc fua‐ŋare raocmu i hone manac enʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ nore taha ufuŋte wâtuŋ miŋecgac mocwâc râepie huhame wiac kecʒiŋuc hone manac enʒepieŋ:
Wiac ukicnezi rowaŋko jaha sâcne mocwâc mi foocmu, â waiŋ qizecne â jâmbojâc â hâmeŋ fâric â oliwa jâc jaŋe fâri tâmiric mi domaniŋmu, aricne, no miŋecgac hâcne fuŋkerâ jambuŋ‐ŋopa rahuc jupemu.”
Mosa irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 24 ira Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ kecʒiŋuc Hagairao fuame arecne jajahec ewec:
“Go Juda mâreŋ soŋaŋ Serubabe ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnec: No sambâŋ â mâreŋ itiriŋ‐jofazo ekopac.
Ehuc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋe herândiŋ‐jopa‐fârepe omaeniŋmu; no ŋic gurune gurune tâpiri‐jeŋic bawahahuc keretac â fainao ŋeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hetuŋ‐jopapemu, ehame becâsic mecne â irec faio ŋeeŋgopieŋ mecne jaŋe jaŋac qaqac ehuc qâqâhâmoc efâreniŋmu.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ no ʒiŋuc mukopac: No dameŋ ira kiŋaŋŋic‐nane Serubabe, Sealitiere ŋokâ hâcne, go rocgurâ mefâro‐nane bacgupemu, noni hâcne rowosâecgupo. Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Dariusi e ŋicwofuŋ erâ juhame jara 1 â mosa 7 tarawec. Ehame mosa namba 8 ira Berekiare ŋokâ â Idore ŋosa, porofete Ʒekaria hâcne, erao Wofuŋte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Wofuŋ e mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere boc aarickewec.
Irec ʒiŋuc muhuc jazawec: Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki kecʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe norao risiepie noni maic‐ŋopapemu. Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Ŋoŋe kâcɋenefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere sâc mi junʒepieŋ, mârâc jaha porofete jumbiŋ jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc jaza jumbieŋ: ‘Ŋoŋe hata‐ŋeŋic hehesicne â eebapa‐ŋeŋic sâqocne i moc behenʒepieŋ.’ Jaŋe ine dâŋnane mana rereŋ mi embiŋ, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe weni? Â porofete jaŋe juju sanaŋ moc jueŋgopieŋ me?
Kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐nane, porofete hâcne, uŋsawaŋ â dâŋsanaŋ‐nane jazapo i mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋerao fâri fideteŋnehec ewec. Eme jaŋe maŋjeŋic bârisierâ mumbiŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e juju â eebapa‐nâŋecte sâcko wiac enâreocte muwec irec sâc enârewec hâcne.”
Dariusizi ŋicwofuŋ juhame jara 2 tarazo eha mosa namba 11, ʒâŋene Sebata i maickewec. Eme mosa irec ʒoaŋ gie bapa 24 ira Idore ŋosa Berekiare ŋokâ, porofete Ʒekaria hâcne, erao Wofuŋte dâŋ fuawec. Fuacneme eki kecʒiŋuc muwec:
“Manaŋgopieŋ, no ŋafeo maŋʒâŋe‐nane ŋerisieme ŋic moc becâsic bâbâroŋko ŋehame honepac. E wâneŋko jâc dutu jaŋere ŋondeŋko domahame râpefuŋ‐ticnao becâsic gâgâpâc â bâbâroŋ erâ qaŋqaŋ domahapie honec‐jopapac.
Iŋuc honerâ ʒiŋuc wiopac: ‘O bomboŋ‐nane, jaŋere fuŋne weniŋuc?’ Iŋuc wiope aŋelo nohec dâŋejec eki ʒiŋuc nazajec: ‘No fuŋne‐jeŋic gaza gowatuc epemu.’
Eme jâc dutu jaŋere ŋondeŋko domajec ŋic eki ʒiŋuc nazajec: ‘Wofuŋzi mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec fuŋne hone manac eniŋte sorec‐jopawec jaŋe hâcne.’
Eme jaŋe Wofuŋte aŋelo jâc dutu jaŋere ŋondeŋko domajec e ʒiŋuc âzâcnembieŋ: ‘Manakic, nâŋe mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ fotâcnehuc ʒiŋuc honembeŋ: Mâreŋ e qiriŋmâc fokac.’
Iŋuc mupie Wofuŋte aŋelozi kecʒiŋuc mujec: ‘O Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ, go Jerusalem â Juda hae ŋerakac jaŋe aaric mana‐jarehuc juhaŋtec jara 70 tarawec, irec mo dameŋko busâqoc moc mana‐jarecmu?’
Eme Wofuŋzi aŋelo nohec dâŋejec e aki wama â bâbâmiriŋ dâŋ âzâcnejec.
Âzâcneme aŋelozi ʒiŋuc nazajec: ‘Go hahaŋne bahuc muc: Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: No Jerusalem â Zioŋ kikefuŋ ŋoŋere bunane boc bâruŋkekac.
Ŋicne ŋicne manabâc tâmiric jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine kimbeŋ hâhâwicne qajarekopac; jaŋe hâcne kimbeŋ afecne qaŋarehape sisipiric hâhâwicne fai‐ŋeŋicko râepie fewec.
Irec hâcne Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: No busâqoc manahuc Jerusalem mocwâc maickepo, irec ufuŋ‐nane mocwâc heɋârerâ bapie fuazejec, erâ mucsâc i Jerusalem haeo fârenʒepieŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere dâŋ iŋuc.
Erâ harierâ hahaŋne bahuc ʒiŋuc muzemec: Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: Hae‐nane ŋerakac ira mazuc mâriri mocwâc fuarâ fozejec, ehame no Zioŋ bâmiriŋkehuc Jerusalem hae mocwâc bâwosâepemu.’”
Eme no ʒâŋe fipe feme mi ʒuŋe 4 honec‐jopazepac i!
Ehuc aŋelo nohec dâŋewec e ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnepo: “Wiac keci jaŋere fuŋne weniŋuc?” Mupe muwec: “Ʒuŋe keci jaŋe hâcne Juda â Israe erâ Jerusalem qâtâtiec‐jopambiŋ.”
Eme Wofuŋ e aeŋ bapa ŋic 4 nowatuwec.
Eme mupo: “Jaŋe wemo gie baniŋte warembiŋ?” Mupe muwec: “Ʒuŋe 4 keci jaŋe Juda kikefuŋ bâtâtiec‐jopa‐jâmbâŋkepie mocwâc turerâ juniŋte eipiembiŋ. Aeŋ bapa ŋic 4 jaŋe ine Juda kikefuŋ qâturec‐jopaniŋte warembiŋ, ehuc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe kikefuŋ bâtâtiec‐jopaniŋte ʒuŋe‐jeŋic bâfeŋnembiŋ i hâcne hezu henʒaŋ eniŋte warembiŋ.”
Eme no ʒâŋe fipe feme mi ŋic moczi mucsâc badomahame honezepac i!
Iŋuc honerâ mupo: “Go wena rakomec?” Eme eki ʒiŋuc nazawec: “No Jerusalem haeo mucsâc fârehuc hâŋne â otecnere fuŋne manapemurâ rakopac.”
Eme aŋelo nohec dâŋewec e mai fuarâ domaha aŋelo moczi fuacnerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Ajoc, go ŋicmotec erao gasacke rarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnec: ‘Jerusalem maŋnao ŋic â qowi bocjaha juŋgopieŋte hae i sac tâmiric ŋezejec.
Ehame no nahac ʒoc iŋucne sac erâ râreckepemu, erâ ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko juhuc tatamac‐nanezi batamaec‐jopapemu, Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.’”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ajoc, ŋoŋe faic mâreŋkonec risieniŋ, noni hâcne mâreŋ tuturuŋne 4 ira bâtâtiec‐ŋopapo”; Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
Ajoc, Babe mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe risierâ Zioŋko wareniŋ.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe wiac ŋowac rofârembiŋ jaŋerao sorecnuhuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Moc e ba bâuac eŋareocmuzi bunaneo baocmu hâcne.
Manaŋgopieŋ, no râsi ejarehuc jopapemu, eme kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic jaŋere meo feniŋmu. Iŋuc fuame ŋoŋe nore ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ: Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki sorewec.
O Zioŋte otâ, go ʒeri bari ec! Manakic, no fârâ gore ŋondeŋko ŋeŋe juju epemu, Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
Iŋuc fuame ŋicguru bocjaha jaŋe dameŋ ira Wofuŋ norao qohotahuc ŋicfâc‐nane erâ juhapie no ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋeŋe juju epemu.
Eme ŋoŋe porofete nore ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki soreme nâŋerao warekac. Eme Wofuŋ e Judaŋic tiri mâreŋ ira fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne bacjopahuc Jerusalem hae mocwâc bâwosâeocmu.”
Wofuŋ e tiri ufuŋ‐ticnaonec faharerâ wahakacte ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe ere maio niniŋke‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Wiac i tarame Wofuŋzi taha bapa sâko Josua nowatume honepo. E Wofuŋte aŋelo ere maio domaha Sataŋzi dâŋko râeocte fâre‐ticnaopec domawec.
Wofuŋte aŋelozi ine Sataŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Sataŋ, Wofuŋzi dâŋ mugareoc, jâmbomac, Wofuŋ e Jerusalem hae bâwosâeweczi dâŋ mugareoc. Josua e ʒoctucne moc ʒockonec rokicne irec sâc i!”
Eme Josua e aŋelore maio ŋaqi wâwânâŋnehec ro domawec.
Eme aŋelozi kiŋaŋŋic mamai domambiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ŋaqi‐ticne wâwânâŋnehec i heunuckecneniŋ.” Josua e jahacne ine ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, no kiŋtofage behepo irec hombaŋ ŋaqi hegarepe huocmu.”
Iŋuc murâ muwec: “Qizecnao duʒora ɋaɋacne hecnepie huoc.” Eme Wofuŋte aŋelozi maŋfuŋnao domahame duʒora â ŋaqi ɋaɋacne hecnepie huwec.
Eme Wofuŋte aŋelozi Josua dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mutâcnecnewec:
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: Go nore kike hata bâjâpehuc kiŋaŋ biaŋne qanarecmuo ine ficnanere micne juhuc hae ʒoŋa‐nane soŋaŋkezemec. Ehame domaŋgopieŋ ʒi jaŋere ŋondeŋko jucmurâ mana‐garepemu.
O taha bapa sâko Josua, go â âgofâcge maigao ŋeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe wiac fuaocmu irec hata qaqasune juŋgopieŋzi mananiŋ: No oso gitec‐nane, kiŋaŋŋic hâcne, e mupe wareocmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, qânâ moc fainao ʒâŋe hândâŋ hawari 7 hekicne i Josua gore maio hepo ŋekac. Eme qânâ ira hâcne dâŋ moc heutuckepe foocmu, ehame ʒoaŋ mocjahao mâreŋ ʒirec kiŋtofa bârâriepemu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme ŋoŋe ʒoaŋ ira hâcne âgofâc‐ŋeŋic hefârec‐jopapie warerâ waiŋ qizec â nemuja jâcfuŋ‐ŋeŋicko waha ŋeniŋmu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere dâŋ iŋuc.”
Eme aŋelo nohec dâŋewec e harierâ fuahuc wiwicnuwec, i ŋic moc guŋkonec wiwickepene ɋâreekac irec sâc.
Erâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go wemo wiac honekomec?” Mume mupo: “No lambe dodoma moc golzi bakicne honekopac, ehuc fainao wokemaŋ ŋeŋe râqâc â lambe 7 erâ lambe qeŋqeŋ 7 jaha ŋerapie honec‐jopakopac wâc.
Ehuc lambe dodoma maŋfuŋnao ŋifec â ŋifec oliwa jâc jajahec domahapire honec‐jofakopac.”
Iŋuc murâ aŋelo nohec dâŋewec e ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnepo: “Bomboŋ‐nane, wiac keci irec fuŋne weniŋuc?”
Eme aŋelo nohec dâŋeweczi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐narewec: “Go wiac irec fuŋne mi manakomec me?” Mume mupo: “Bomboŋ‐nane, no mi manakopac.”
Eme ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Serubaberao Wofuŋte dâŋ fuawec ʒine hâcne: Ŋic sasanaŋ me tâpirio mâcne, Mâro‐nanere tâpirio wiac ee bapane fokac, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
O tiki sâko, go wemo wiac fârine mo? Go Serubabere maio fâucke ʒaŋ erâ wâneŋ ezemec. Eki hâcne ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ʒeri faio ‘Ohec ohec’ mucnehapie fic bupune hebâzickeme taraocmu.”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ i norao ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Serubabe e meticnezi fic kecʒirec hobeteŋne râewec, erâ e jahacne mezia fic kecʒi bâzickeocmu. Iŋuc fuame ŋoŋe porofete nore ʒiŋuc mananʒepieŋ: Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki nâŋerao soreme warewec.
Moc e wiac afecne fuŋkerâ fuawec dameŋ irec mana sâqoreweczi Serubabere meo bupure wiac ŋemâcne foha honerâ bubiaŋ manaocmu. “Lambe 7 jaŋe Wofuŋte ʒâŋe hândâŋ ehuc mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ hone‐fâreeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme no aŋelo ʒiŋuc wiocnepo: “Oliwa jâc jajahec lambe dodomare maŋfuŋko ŋifec â ŋifec domakopirec jahere fuŋne weniŋuc?”
Erâ harierâ wiocnepo: “Wokemaŋte qeŋqeŋ jajahec golzi bakicne jahere ŋifecnao oliwa jâc tieŋne jajahec fokopirec jahere fuŋne weniŋuc?”
Eki ine ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go irec fuŋne mi manakic me?” Eme mupo: “Bomboŋ‐nane, no mi manakopac.”
Mupe muwec: “Jahe mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec Wofuŋ ere kiŋaŋ qaqa jajahec wokemaŋ rua‐jactekicne hâcne.”
Eme no mocwâc ʒâŋe fipe feme papia foforiekicnezi mi sawao fuame honezepac i!
Eme aŋelozi ʒiŋuc muhuc wio‐narewec: “Go wemo wiac honekomec?” Mume mupo: “No papia foforiekicnezi sawao fotâcneme honekopac, hâŋnere sâc i 20 kubi â otecnere sâc i 10 kubi.”
Eme kecʒiŋuc nazawec: “Juda mâreŋ sâko irec sâwecdâŋ fuaocmu i kecira hâcne fokac. Irec fiuc roniŋmu jaŋe sasawa papia ŋifecnao dâŋ fokac irec sâcko bâsirowec‐jopazo, â mumupaŋ dâŋ burecne muniŋmu jaŋe ine papia ŋifecnao dâŋ qâreŋkekicne fokac irec sâcko bâsirowec‐jopazo.
No papia i râepe rarâ fiuc roro ŋic jaŋere ficko mecne erâ nore ʒâŋeo ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ dâŋ burecne mueŋgopieŋ jaŋere ficko mâmâc fezejec. Ferâ fohuc ficjeŋic jâc â qânâzi bakicne i sipiricke‐fârezejec, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere dâŋ iŋuc.”
Eme aŋelo nohec dâŋewec e warerâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Ʒâŋe fitec feme wiac fuakac i honec.”
Iŋuc mume mupo: “I wemo wiac?” Eme muwec: “Wiac fuakac i padire sâc bapa pake.” Erâ ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Juda mâreŋ sâko irec kiŋ bahac i irec sâc fokac hâcne.”
Iŋuc muhame pake tapane ŋehockeme mi maŋnao ŋokac moc ŋeha honezepac i!
Eme aŋelozi muwec: “Wiac keci sâqocnere fuŋqizecne.” Iŋuc murâ ŋokac pake maŋnao sârockeme hume aeŋ tapane i mocwâc pake micnao heme ŋewec.
Eme mocwâc ʒâŋe fipe feme mi ŋokac jajahec warepire honec‐jofazepac i! Ehame mâŋâŋzi fakac‐jekic bafaharewec; fakec‐jekic i qeʒore fakec iŋucne. Eme jahe sâc bapa pake i rorâ faic sawao bafepic.
Iŋuc epire aŋelo nohec dâŋewec e ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnepo: “Jahe pake wena bawisekopirec?”
Eme nazawec: “Sina mâreŋko ira fic moc bacnenicte bawisekopirec, eme ficticne bapire tarame ira hâcne ŋeŋe‐ticnao hepire ŋeocmu.”
Eme mocwâc ʒâŋe fipe feme mi keretac 4 jaŋe tiki jajahec ŋondeŋ‐jekicko fuarâ warepie honec‐jopazepac i! Tiki jajahec ine honec‐jofape aeŋ bâbâroŋ iŋucne ŋepic.
Keretac bâbâni fuawec irec becâsic jaŋe bâbâroŋ â ere râpeo fuawec irec becâsic jaŋe gâgâpâc.
Eme irec faicnao keretac moc fuawec irec becâsic jaŋe qaŋqaŋ â keretac tatarane fuawec irec becâsic jaŋe qâqâreŋ.
Eme aŋelo nohec dâŋ ewec e ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnepo: “Bomboŋ‐nane, wiac ʒi jaŋere fuŋne weniŋuc?”
Mupe ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Jaŋe sambâŋkonec mâŋâŋ 4, erâ ʒi mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnembiŋzi mâreŋ sâcke‐fâreniŋmu.
Keretac becâsic gâgâpâcheczi faic mâreŋkopec rahame keretac becâsic qaŋqaŋheczi ʒoaŋ huhunaopec raocmu; â keretac becâsic qâqâreŋheczi juwic mâreŋkopec rahame keretac becâsic bâbâroŋheczi ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec raocmu.”
Eme jaŋe fua‐fârerâ mâreŋte fuŋne hone manac eniŋte ʒoɋac embiŋ. Irec aŋelozi muwec: “Ajoc, ra mâreŋ fotâcneniŋ!” Eme jaŋe ra mâreŋ fotâcnembiŋ.
Ehame ʒiŋuc muhuc wira‐narewec: “Manakic, faic mâreŋkopec raŋgopieŋzi gie bahapie maŋnane taraocmu.”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Helidai, Tobia â Jedaja Babe mâreŋkonec risie warembiŋ jaŋeraonec taha wiac rorâ Zefaniare ŋokâ Josia ere ficko bafezemec.
Go jaŋeraonec siliwa â gol rohuc hendiŋ moc ba akic erâ taha bapa sâko Josua, Jozadacte ŋokâ ere qizecko hetec huzejec.
Ehuc âzâcnezemec: ‘Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “Manakic, ŋic moc ʒâŋene Oso gitecne e soka sanaŋ erâ Wofuŋte ufuŋ baocmu.
Eki hâcne Wofuŋte ufuŋ barâ ŋicwofuŋ iŋucne ʒâŋe biŋehec juocmu, ehuc eri ŋeŋe‐ticnao ŋehuc guriŋ bapa gie baocmu. Ehame taha bapa moc ere ŋeŋe‐ticnere maŋfuŋko domame jahe maŋ mocjaha erâ junicmu.” ’
Eme hendiŋ i Helidai, Tobia, Jedaja â Zefaniare ŋokâ Josia jaŋere manasuhuc juniŋte Wofuŋte ufuŋko hepie ŋezejec.
“Eme taicko jueŋgopieŋzi ware fisirâ bafic‐ŋopahapie Wofuŋte ufuŋ banʒepieŋ. Ehame ŋoŋe nore ʒiŋuc mana taraniŋmu: Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki nâŋerao sorewec. Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋicte dâŋ aafec faio mana rereŋ eniŋmuo iŋuc hâcne fuaocmu.”
Dariusi e ŋicwofuŋ juhame jara 3 tarame mosa namba 9, ʒâŋene Kisilewo, irec gie bapa 4 maickeme Wofuŋte dâŋ Ʒekariarao fuawec.
Bete‐Sareze e Regemelec â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe Wofuŋ bâmiriŋkeniŋte Jerusalem haeo sorec‐jopawec.
Erâ wâc Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere ufuŋko taha bapa â porofete jaŋe mâmâc ʒiŋuc mu wioc ejareniŋte sorec‐jopakicne: “Nâŋe jara bocjaha ki mamakuc ehuc sowa juwefumbeŋ sâc ijaha mosa namba 5‐ko ehuc junaŋte muŋgopieŋ me?”
Iŋuc mupie Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere dâŋ i norao ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Go mâreŋ ʒirec ŋic ŋokac â taha bapa ʒiŋuc wio‐jarezemec: Ŋoŋe jara 70 irec maŋnao mosa 5 â 7 sâc sowa juhuc makuc bambiŋ i jâmbomac nore manasuhuc embiŋ me weniŋuc?
Me nânâ opâ nâ bac eeŋgopieŋ i ŋaŋacnere manasuhuc mi eeŋgopieŋ me?
Jerusalem â rârec rârec hae ŋerambiŋ jaŋe sesuctac fuarâ mi fombiŋ â Negebe mâreŋ erâ wâneŋko ŋic jufârembiŋ dameŋ ira Wofuŋzi dâŋ keci porofetefâc‐ticne micjeŋicko râeme mi ŋazambiŋ me?”
Eme Wofuŋte dâŋ ʒi Ʒekariarao ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋoŋe ŋaŋackoaŋ mumutiŋ gie biaŋne bahuc maŋjauŋ eec erâ buuruchec junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe hozec bekâ â ŋic jabane me hapetacne jaŋe fific mi bacjopanʒepieŋ, ehuc ŋaŋaczia eebapa sâqocne maŋzi manasu biric i wâc mi enʒepieŋ.”
Jaŋe ine dâŋnane i mananiŋte qikiŋnembiŋ, erâ maŋrâŋgeŋ juhuc hazec‐jeŋic bâbâzickembiŋ.
Jaŋe maŋsanaŋ epie maŋjeŋiczi buse iŋucne ewec; ehame Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e mârâc jaha mumutiŋ â mumutâc dâŋ porofetefâc‐ticne jareme muhuc jumbiŋ i mana rereŋ mi embiŋ. Iŋuc epie Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki jaŋere boc aaricke sâqorewec.
Eme ʒiŋuc muwec: “No wira‐jarepe mi manambiŋ, irec jaŋe moc wira‐narepie no iŋuc jaha mi mana‐jarepemu.
No mâreŋ sâc ŋic furune jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐jopapo; eme ratâmirepie mâreŋ‐jeŋic niniŋ siarereŋ fuarâ foha ŋiczi ira sicne fotâc mi embiŋ. Mâreŋ biaŋ‐jeŋiczi tuhutac fuarâ fowec hâcne.”
Eme Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere dâŋ i norao ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac: No Zioŋ haere erâ ʒoɋac sâko ekopac, â ere erâ jaha aaric sâko manakopac.
Erâ Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc mukac: No Zioŋ haeo mocwâc risierâ Jerusalemko ŋeŋe juju epemu. Ehame Jerusalemte ʒâŋe i ‘Hae fâri biaŋ’ muniŋmu, â Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋte tiki irec ʒâŋe i ‘Tiri tiki’ muniŋmu.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: Jerusalemte hae ʒoŋao ŋic ŋokac qizecnezi mocwâc ŋec domac eniŋmu, ehuc jara bocjaha bazumbiŋte gunuhec juniŋmu.
Ehame naru motec jaŋe hae ʒoŋao fusucmarâ juhuc mamasiri eniŋmu.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki ʒiŋuc mukac: Wiac i dameŋ ira ŋicguru ʒi ʒanʒaŋnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere maio bipinehec eocmu, nore maio ine bipinehec moc mi eocmu. Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere dâŋ iŋuc.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki ʒiŋuc mukac: Manakic, no ŋicfâc‐nane ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec â huhunaonec batarac‐jopapemu.
Erâ mocwâc bârisiec‐jopape Jerusalem haeo ŋeŋe juju enʒepieŋ. Ehame jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane juhapie no Anutu‐jeŋic tiŋne â fârine erâ juzepac.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Wofuŋ ufuŋ‐ticnere hobeteŋ râembiŋ dameŋ ira porofete jaŋere mickonec dâŋ keci wahame manambiŋ ŋoŋe sanaŋkeniŋ.
Dameŋ irec juwicnao ŋic mecne qowi mecne gie furi mi rojumbieŋ, erâ ra ju ware ju embiŋzi râsire hâhâwic ejumbieŋ, i ŋic jaŋaczia rârâsi efâreniŋte qafeŋ‐jopapore iŋuc embiŋ.
No mârâc jaha ejarepo irec sâc ŋic ʒanʒaŋne ʒi mocwâc mi ejarepemu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Irec no mupe jaŋerao wama fuarâ fozejec; waiŋzi fâri rarauhec eha gieo wiac gâcne fua biaŋ ezejec, erâ sambâŋte titikuc wahahuc foha no ŋic ʒanʒaŋne ʒi ejarepe jaŋe wiac i rauckerâ baju‐fârenʒepieŋ.
O Israe â Juda kikefuŋ, ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe ŋoŋere ʒâŋeo qâqiŋ qahuc sâwec dâŋ mujumbieŋ, ʒi ine bafic‐ŋopape ŋoŋerao qâqiŋ qahuc jambuŋdâŋ munʒepieŋ. Irec hâhâwic tâmiric juhuc sanaŋkenʒepieŋ.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “No mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe maŋnane bârâŋgeŋkepie sisipiric wiac bâfua‐ŋarepemurâ maŋnanezi mupaŋkerâ busâqoc moc mi mana‐ŋarepo, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Mâc dameŋ ʒiŋuczia herisierâ Jerusalem â Juda kikefuŋ ŋoŋe ehâmo‐ŋarepemurâ mupaŋkepo irec mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec.
Ŋoŋe ine dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mana rereŋ enʒepieŋ: Ŋaŋackoaŋ dâŋ fâri qizecne muc manac ehuc haere motâc‐ŋeŋicte maŋfuŋko ŋehuc mumutara dâŋ tiŋne mupie wama fuarâ fozejec.
Ŋaŋackoaŋ dâŋ sâqocne manasu biric ine mi enʒepieŋ, erâ mumupaŋ dâŋ burecne irec wâc mi aŋac‐ŋopazejec, no wiac i sasawa bâsue‐fârekopac hâcne.” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere dâŋ i norao kecʒiŋuc fuawec:
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: Mosa namba 4, 5, 7 â 10 ira sowa juju dameŋ fuaekac irec Juda kikefuŋ ŋoŋe manapie bubiaŋ â aŋac ʒeri hombaŋ dameŋ ezejec. Irec ŋoŋe dâŋ fâri qizecne â wamare eŋarezejec.”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋic gurune gurune â hae bocjaha irec ŋecjucfâc jaŋe juku fisiniŋmu wâc.
Ehame hae moc jaŋe hae moc jaŋerao rarâ ʒiŋuc jazaniŋmu: ‘Ajoc, warepie Wofuŋ wira wâwâsic ecnenaŋte ranaŋ, ehuc Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e wira basac ecnenaŋ me! No nahacne ine mâmâc razo ekopac!’
Ŋic gurune gurune â ŋicne ŋicne tâpirihec jaŋe Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ wira basac ecnehuc mu wâwâsic ecneniŋte Jerusalem haeo fisiniŋmu hâcne.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: Dameŋ ira ŋicne ŋicne dâŋmarac‐jeŋic fuŋne fuŋne jaŋeraonec ŋic 10 jaŋe Judaŋic moc ŋaqi‐ticnao rorâ basanaŋkehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcneniŋmu: ‘Anutuzi ŋoŋehec jukac, nâŋe iŋuc manambeŋte mana‐nâretec ŋoŋehec mâmâc ranʒepeneŋ.’”
Findaŋdâŋ moc. Wofuŋtaonec dâŋ Hadarake mâreŋte biŋe fuawec i ʒine hâcne, erâ dâŋ izi Damasko hae wâc mâmâc rokac. Aram mâreŋko hae ŋeraŋgopieŋ jaŋere fuŋne mecne â Israe kikefuŋ gurune gurune jaŋere fuŋne i Wofuŋzi mâmâc hone manac eekac hâcne.
Erâ Hamati mâreŋzi mai foha Tiro â Sidoŋ hae jahe mamana fojacte‐bipieha sifu dâŋ i jaŋere biŋe mâmâc ekac.
Tiro e sacsanaŋ‐ticne moc bahuc siliwa‐ticne rufe iŋucne qâzuckewec, â golticne i sohoŋ iŋucne ɋârâŋne focnewec.
Wofuŋzi ine moneŋ mafa‐ticne jâoc rorâ hâwecko beheme huocmu, hae e jahacne ine ʒoczi ʒâseŋkeocmu.
Asikaloŋ rune jaŋe wiac i honerâ bipic tatara ejareocmu. Ehame Gaza hae rune jaŋe wâc hâwic‐jopame ɋarac ɋarac qaniŋmu, erâ Ekoroŋ hae rune jaŋe rorowec‐jeŋic omaeha iŋuc jaha eniŋmu. Gaza haeonec ŋicwofuŋ e ine sipirickeocmu, â Asikaloŋ hae i sesuctac fuarâ foocmu.
Asidode hae ira ŋicŋondeŋ jaŋe juniŋmu, ehame Filisa ŋic jaŋere pepec penaroŋ i bawahapemu.
No micjeŋickonec tiwâ bâzi sochec i bârâriepemu, â wiac mamakâcne kisoŋnerâ jueŋgopieŋ i jowac ropemu. Iŋuc ejarepe jaŋe ŋic ʒanʒaŋnezi Anutu‐nâŋecte biŋe jaha juhuc Judare ŋicguru moc iŋucne erâ juniŋmu; ehame Ekoroŋ rune jaŋe Jebusi ŋic jaŋere sâc erâ juniŋmu.
No ruc bapa ŋic iŋucne ufuŋ‐nane râreckehuc juhape ŋic jaŋe ira sicne fotâc mocwâc mi enʒepieŋ, â ŋic gâcnezi fific mocwâc mi bacjopanʒepieŋ; ʒi no nahac ɋâricne juhuc ruc bapemu hâcne.
O Zioŋte otâ, go ʒeri bari ec! O Jerusalem rune, go semuja hec! Manakic, ŋicwofuŋgezi gorao fakac e ŋic tiŋne â sanaŋne, e maŋ huhuŋheczi doŋgi faio fakac, doŋgi motecnere faio ŋehuc fakac hâcne.
Erâ e Eferaimte ʒika keretac wiac â Jerusalem haere becâsic i bâsirowec‐jopaocmu. Â ʒikare tepe wiac i wâc bazu behec ehuc ŋicne ŋicne wama bâfua‐jarehame guriŋ bapa gie‐ticnezi hâwec fotâcne behec rahuc Eufrata opâo â mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao sâcke‐fâreocmu.
Eme no gohec ʒâʒâfic epo ʒâʒâfic irec socte erâ kâpâcwâru ŋicfâcge nombâŋkonec fârec‐jopape wefuniŋmu.
Jujuhâmo fua‐ŋareocte woworic gie baeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe hae sanaŋ‐ŋeŋicko risieniŋ; no wiac bâmârehuc ŋarepemurâ mupaŋke‐ŋarekopac hâcne.
Juda e tepe‐nane eha âpârepo â Eferaimzi ine tepe motecne ewec. O Zioŋ, no ŋokâfâcge qafeŋ‐jopape Grikŋic jaŋere ŋokâfâc râsi ejarenʒepieŋ, ehame go ŋic qac momori ere ʒika iŋucne ezemec.
Eme Wofuŋ e fua‐jarerâ tepe qâtâcneme bâricnehuc raocmu, Wofuŋ Anutu e qeŋ qarâ juwic mâreŋkonec ʒâʒâkiriŋ mâŋâŋ irec maŋnao ware fisiocmu.
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ eki ŋezic‐jopame jaŋe tacbaŋ qaqa ŋic âte‐hâmoc‐jopaniŋmu, ehuc socjeŋic waiŋ opâ iŋucne nâkupie bujeŋiczi taha bapare râqâc iŋucne fuseocmu â alatare qenʒoŋnao soc ŋeekac irec sâc eocmu.
Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋic e dameŋ ira ŋicfâc‐ticne bafic‐jopahuc lama iŋucne hone maiŋ ejareocmu. Eme jaŋe eri hendiŋko qânâ furi sâkozi bâricnehuc tamaeekac irec sâc ehuc mâreŋ‐ticne sâcke‐fârerâ juhâmoniŋmu.
Oi, mâreŋ i biaŋne â mâririhec foocmu i! Ehame padi jacgoŋzi ŋic motec gume qiŋjopaocmu â waiŋ opâzi naru ʒeŋoŋ dopec‐jopaocmu.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ numucnepie hoe i dameŋ‐ticnaoa hezejec. Eki hâcne mume karorac fuaekac â hoe heekac, erâ ekizia wâc mume ŋic ru sâc gie‐jeŋicko nânâ monʒaŋ fua‐jareekac.
Ɋâŋ qâqâtâc jaŋe sioc eeŋgopieŋ â qaŋgec bapazi findaŋdâŋ burecne mueŋgopieŋ, ehuc guŋ fâri tâmiric manahuc irec fuŋne mueŋgopieŋ, â ŋic bâbâmiriŋ dâŋ racne jazaeŋgopieŋ. Irec hâcne ŋic jaŋe lama iŋucne qac qâsoric eeŋgopieŋ, ehuc soŋaŋ tâmiric jueŋgopieŋte ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio feeŋgopieŋ.
“No soŋaŋ jaŋe aaric mana‐jarepemu, â micne jaŋe ine okacne bazu‐jarepemu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ no lamafâc‐nane, Juda kikefuŋ hâcne, jaŋe hone maiŋ ejarepemu, erâ ʒikao sanaŋkerâ domaniŋte bafic‐jopapemu.
Eme guru‐jeŋickonec ŋic kecʒiŋuczi fuarâ juniŋmu: Ŋicwofuŋ, â momori jaŋere micne, erâ ŋic fekicne â tâpirihec sasawa.
Jaŋe mâmâc jaha ŋic qac momori iŋucne ʒika qahuc râsifâc‐jeŋic sohoŋko âte utuc‐jopaniŋmu. Eme Wofuŋzi jaŋehec juekacte sanaŋkerâ râsi jopapie becâsicko rara ŋic jaŋe qurutuaniŋmu.
“No Juda kikefuŋ basanaŋ‐jopahuc Josefe kikefuŋ bafic‐jopapemu. No busâqoc mana‐jarehuc bârisiec‐jopapemu, eme jaŋe mi behec‐jopapo irec sâcko junʒepieŋ; no Wofuŋ Anutu‐jeŋic jukopacte dâŋjeŋic manapemu.
Eme Eferaim ŋic jaŋe momori ŋic tâpirihec iŋucne erâ junʒepieŋ, ehame waiŋ opâ nârâ maŋjeŋiczi bubiaŋ manaeŋgopieŋ irec sâc enʒepieŋ. Eme naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe honerâ ʒeri eniŋmu, jaŋe Wofuŋte erâ ʒeri bari eniŋmu hâcne.
“No firuec‐jopapo, irec hetumaŋ‐jopapemurâ qeŋ qajarepemu, eme ŋic ʒare‐jeŋic mârâc jaha fowec irec sâc jaha mocwâc fuazejec.
No jâmbomac ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere ŋondeŋko bâtâtiec‐jopape rambiŋ, jaŋe ine mâreŋ ʒoricko juhuc nore manasueŋgopieŋte juku naru motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec risienʒepieŋ.
No Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopape mâreŋfuŋ‐jeŋicko risienʒepieŋ, erâ Asiria mâreŋkonec hetumaŋ‐joparâ Gileade â Lebanoŋ mâreŋko râec‐jopape hae mâreŋ i fusucma sâqorenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe Aigita hâwec fotâcnehapie Wofuŋzi hâwec siri bâniniŋkeocmu, ehame Nilu opâre ʒâkâŋzi ʒicke kereŋ eocmu. Asiria maŋfefe‐ticne i bawahaocmu, â Aigita ŋicwofuŋte gunu i rârieocmu.
Jaŋe Wofuŋte erâ sanaŋkeniŋmu, erâ ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnere manasuhuc juniŋmu,” Wofuŋte dâŋ iŋuc.
O Lebanoŋ, motâc sâkoge aŋkeoc, eme ʒoczi bâruŋkerâ jâmâzâc jâc wiacge ʒâseŋke‐fârezejec!
O wetejâc, jâmâzâc qafara‐fârekicne â jâc ʒâŋe biŋehec sipirickekicnere kio owa eniŋ! O Basaŋ mâreŋte boriŋjâc, ŋoŋe kâte wânʒâŋ kifârewecte kio wâuŋa eniŋ!
Mananiŋ, lama jaŋere kecɋaŋ gie sipirickekicnere soŋaŋ jaŋe kio uu eeŋgopieŋ! Mananiŋ, Jordaŋte jâckâte imackekicnere laioŋ jaŋe owa sâko eeŋgopieŋ!
Wofuŋ Anutu‐nanezi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Lama hehezure biŋe juŋgopieŋ jaŋere soŋaŋ juzemec.
Lama iŋucne furine baeŋgopieŋzi hezuc‐jopahuc kiŋ mi hureeŋgopieŋ, â furi roeŋgopieŋzi ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: ‘No iŋuc ehuc moneŋ sâkohec ekopacte Wofuŋ muteŋkezo!’ Ehame soŋaŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe wâc busâqoc mi mana‐jareeŋgopieŋ.
Irec no wâc mâreŋ ʒirec ŋecjucfâc jaŋere busâqoc mocwâc mi manapemu, Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Manakic, no ŋic ejarepe âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋere meo â ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic ere meo feniŋmu. Ehame jaŋe mâreŋ ima bahapie mejeŋickonec moc mi batarac‐jopapemu.”
No lama furi bapa ŋic jaŋe lama hehezure biŋe bâwosâec‐jopambiŋ irec soŋaŋ jupo. Ehuc gunu jajahec rocjofarâ moc irec ʒâŋe “Aki anonoc” â moc irec ʒâŋe “Maŋ mocjaha erâ juju” iŋuc mucjofapo. Iŋuc erâ lama soŋaŋ jupo.
Ehuc mosa mocjaha irec maŋnao soŋaŋ jahec â moc qâhâmoc‐jopapo. Jaŋe nore takic‐jopame qaisocnupie miriŋ‐nane sâqorewec.
Iŋuc fuame ʒiŋuc mupo: “No ŋoŋere soŋaŋ mocwâc ʒuhuckerâ mi jupemu; irec moc e hâmozo murâ hâmozejec â moc e sifuckezo murâ sifuckezejec, â tiwâne juniŋmu jaŋe jaŋaczia nânâc enʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ gunu‐nane ʒâŋene Aki anonoc i rorâ bazupo, ehuc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo i hâcne hetâcnepo.
Ʒâʒâfic i ʒoaŋ ira hâcne hetâcnekicne. Ehame lama furi bapa ŋic honecnumbiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc mana tarambiŋ: Keci Wofuŋte dâŋ hâcne.
Eme ʒiŋuc jazapo: “Ŋoŋe manapie sâckekacko gie furi‐nane nareniŋ, arictac eme beheniŋ.” Eme jaŋe gie furi‐nane siliwa moneŋ 30 narembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Nore manapie wawahane eha moneŋ garembiŋ i tahare katapao râetec huoc.” Eme no siliwa moneŋ 30 i rorâ Wofuŋte ufuŋko tahare katapao behepe huwec.
Eme gunu‐nane moc ʒâŋene “Maŋ mocjaha erâ juju” i bazupo wâc, iŋuc ehuc Juda â Israe qoqomâ juju‐jekic i hetâcnepo.
Eme Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go lama soŋaŋ burecnere gunu wiac i mocwâc rozemec.
Manakic, no mupe mâreŋ ʒira soŋaŋ moc fuaocmu e lama sipiric‐jopakicne jaŋe hone maiŋ mi ejareocmu, â qac qâsoric ekicne jaŋe wira basac mi ejareocmu, me wic fua‐jarekicne mi bâsomie‐jareocmu â docke betaŋ ekicne jaŋe wâc mi bafic‐jopaocmu. Aricne, e lama wokemaŋ biuc sâkohec nâcjopahuc siec‐jeŋic beheme raocmu.
Jei, soŋaŋ‐nane burecnezi lama behec‐jopaekac! Irec ʒikazi meombâŋ‐ticne qazuhuc fâreopec ʒâŋe hândâŋ‐ticne i âke hâpozejec! Meombâŋ‐ticnezi ɋaŋa‐fâreha fâreopec ʒâŋe hândâŋ‐ticne hâpo‐jâmbâŋkezejec!”
Findaŋdâŋ moc. Wofuŋzi Israe ŋic jaŋere dâŋ muwec ʒine hâcne. Sambâŋ qaratiewec fokac â mâreŋte hobeteŋne râewec, erâ wâc ŋicmaŋko Mâro ficneme huwec, Wofuŋ eki hâcne dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac:
“Manakic, no mupe Jerusalem hae i ŋic rârec rârec juŋgopieŋ jaŋere maŋsifuc opâ râqâc ezejec. Eme Jerusalem hae somâckehapie Juda e wâc ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio feocmu.
Eme ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe qâturerâ râsi ecneniŋmu dameŋ ira mupe Jerusalem haezi ŋicguru sasawa jaŋerao qânâ ŋemâcne iŋucne ezejec, ehame qânâ i bafahareniŋte eipiehuc jaŋe jaŋacne sipirickeniŋmu.
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: No ʒoaŋ ira becâsic sasawa hâhâwic hejarepemu, â becâsicko rara ŋic maŋmutuc bacjopapemu. No ŋic gâcne jaŋere becâsic ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ bacjopa‐fârehuc Juda kikefuŋ jaŋe ine hone maiŋ ejarepemu.
Iŋuc ejarepe Judaŋic gurune gurune jaŋe jaŋaczia ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Jerusalem kikefuŋ jaŋe Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ‐jeŋiczi sasanaŋ bâfua‐jareekac.’
“No dameŋ ira Judaŋic gurune gurune jaŋe ejarepe ʒocfiki maŋnao ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne â jawa sânʒâŋ ŋondeŋko waha iŋucne enʒepieŋ. Ehuc fâreopec me qanaopec fotikiehuc ŋicguru ŋifec â ŋifec juŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒâseŋ‐jopa‐fârenʒepieŋ, ehame Jerusalem hae rune jaŋe hae‐jeŋickoa ʒuhuckerâ junʒepieŋ.
“Wofuŋzi Juda sanaŋkeocte qanaŋ bafickeocmu, ehame Dawidi kikefuŋ‐ticnere ʒâŋe biŋe â Jerusalem ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋere ʒâŋe biŋezi Judare sâc mi sirickezejec.
Wofuŋ e dameŋ ira Jerusalem ŋecjucfâc‐ticne ŋezic‐jopaocmu. Ehame tâpiri tâmiric jueŋgopieŋzi dameŋ ira Dawidire sâc bâfuanʒepieŋ, â Dawidire kikefuŋ jaŋe Wofuŋ Anuture kikefuŋ iŋucne ehuc ŋic micne bajareekac aŋelo e iŋucne enʒepieŋ.
No dameŋ ira ŋicne ŋicne Jerusalem râsi ecneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bâsirowec‐jopa‐fârepemu.
“Eme no Dawidire kikefuŋ â Jerusalem ŋecjucfâc‐ticne jaŋerao busâqoc â mu huacbuc irec mâro râepe wahaocmu, eme âke mârâŋkembiŋ erao ʒâŋe fipie rame busâqoc manacneniŋmu, ehuc neŋgoc mamac jaŋe motec‐jeŋic mocjaha me mârâc fufua motec‐jeŋiczi hâmome kio owa eeŋgopieŋ irec sâc kio owa eniŋmu.
Dameŋ ira Jerusalem haeo mu mamakuc sâko fuaocmu i Megido wâneŋko Hadarimoŋ haeo fuawec irec sâc.
Mâreŋ ira ki mamakuc sâko fuaocmu ine kecʒiŋuc: Garikiŋ sâc jaŋe buc buc makuc baniŋmu. Dawidire garikiŋfâc jaŋe bucjeŋic eniŋmu â ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe wâc buc jaha eniŋmu. Ehame Nataŋte garikiŋfâc jaŋe bucjeŋic eniŋmu â ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe wâc buc jaha eniŋmu.
Erâ wâc Lewire garikiŋfâc jaŋe bucjeŋic eniŋmu; â ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe buc jaha eniŋmu; Simeire garikiŋfâc jaŋe bucjeŋic eniŋmu; â ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe wâc buc jaha eniŋmu.
Iŋuc fuame garikiŋ nâfocne juniŋmu jaŋe bucjeŋic efârehapie ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe wâc buc jaha eniŋmu.
“Dameŋ ira Dawidire kikefuŋ â Jerusalem rune jaŋere erâ opâ ʒâŋe moc wefurâ sâqocne â wâwânâŋ‐jeŋic ʒure‐fâreocmu.
“Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: No dameŋ ira nemu jaŋere ʒâŋe biŋe bârâriepe moczi mocwâc mi manasuc‐jopazejec, erâ mâreŋ irec porofete â mâro wâwânâŋne jaŋe wâc bâsirowec‐jopapemu.
Eme moc e porofete gie mocwâc bame neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne jahe ʒiŋuc âzâcnenicmu: ‘Go Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo âke hotahuc burecdâŋ mukomecte mi juzemec.’ Ehame e porofete maracko dâŋ mume neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne jahe âke‐hâmonicmu.
Dameŋ ira porofete sasawa jaŋe wiac hone manac ehuc findaŋdâŋ mueŋgopieŋ irec mimieniŋmu, ehuc ŋaqi ʒâwânehec hepie hume eatuc gie baeŋgopieŋ i mocwâc mi baniŋmu.
Aricne, jaŋe ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Nâŋe porofete aricne, nâŋe hesarac ŋic, nâŋe ɋieonecteaŋ mâreŋ rauckeeŋgopeneŋ.’
‘Hâc, eme amecgao wemo wicrâfâ fokac?’ Ŋic moczi porofete moc iŋuc wiocneme dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecneocmu: ‘Âgofâc‐nane jaŋere ficko qaqac epene fua‐narewec.’”
Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “O ʒika, go faharerâ lama soŋaŋ nore maŋfuŋko domakac e râsi ecnezemec. Go soŋaŋ qatec lama jaŋe siŋsaŋ qanʒepieŋ, ehame lama soŋaŋ wahakicne jaŋe wâc râsi ejarepemu.”
Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc mukac: “Mâreŋ ʒirecnec ŋic tucne sâko bâsirowec‐jopahape afecne sawazi juniŋmu.
Afecne sawa juniŋmu jaŋe ʒocko behec‐jopapemu, ehuc siliwa rikepie wosâeekac irec sâc ejarepemu, â gol esâickeeŋgopieŋ irec sâc jaha ba esâic ejarepemu. Eme jaŋe ʒâŋe‐nane muhuc riwasecnupie micjeŋicko ropemu. Ehuc mupemu: ‘Jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane,’ iŋuc mupe muniŋmu: ‘Wofuŋ e Anutu‐nâŋec.’”
Manaŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋte dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira mafa wiac‐ŋeŋic ŋowac rokicne i ŋoŋe honehapie kâdoc qaniŋmu.
No ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe Jerusalem râsi ecnehuc ʒika qaniŋte hetumaŋ‐jopapemu. Ehame hae ro rauc ehuc ficko mafa wiac forakac i fiuc rofâreniŋmu, ehuc ŋokac bâsâqorec‐jopaniŋmu. Hae rune gâcne jaŋe kâpâcwâruo bacjopa raniŋmu, â gâcne jaŋe haeoa juniŋmu.
Iŋuc fuame Wofuŋzi faharerâ ʒika dameŋko ʒika qawec irec sâc ehuc ŋicguru keci jopaocmu.
Erâ ʒoaŋ ira Jerusalem ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec oliwa tiki ŋekac ira âterâ domaocmu; ehame oliwa tikizi ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec fâuckerâ raku ʒoaŋ huhunao tarame ʒâʒâŋiŋko uuruŋ sâko moc fuaocmu, eme tiki ŋifecnezi mâreŋ faicpec rârieocmu â ŋifecnezi mâreŋ juwicpec rârierâ ŋeocmu.
Iŋuc fuame tiki‐nanere uuruŋko hurâ wiseniŋmu. Uuruŋ i raku Azela hae ira tarakac. Ŋoŋe Juda ŋicwofuŋ Uʒija juhame homeŋ sâko bame wisembiŋ irec sâc wiseniŋmu hâcne. Ehame Wofuŋ Anutu‐ŋeŋic e tiriŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋehec ware fisiocmu.
Dameŋ ira fâroroc me mâmâteŋ me hoe sanaŋ wâc mi fuaocmu.
Dameŋ ira ʒoaŋzi qahuc jaha foocmu, hae owâeme ʒoaŋ tatamac jaha foha hae ŋafe furec mocwâc mi eocmu, i Wofuŋte mamanao iŋuc fuaocmu.
Dameŋ ira Jerusalem haeonec opâ fofone moc fisihuc foocmu, ehuc opâ fauckerâ moczi ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec hâwec fokac ira rahame moczi ʒoaŋ huhunaopec hâwec fokac ira raocmu. Erâ opâ i ʒoaŋ dameŋko mecne hoe dameŋko mecne rahuc jaha foocmu.
Eme Wofuŋ e mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec Wofuŋ Sâko erâ juocmu; dameŋ ira e mocjahazi Wofuŋ juocmu, â ere ʒâŋe biŋe mocjahazi ferâ foocmu.
Eme Jerusalem hae juwicpec mâreŋ forakac i Geba haeonec fuŋkerâ raku Rimoŋ hae ira mickekac izi wâneŋ sâko fuarâ fofârezejec. Jerusalem haezi ine tiki toŋko jaha ʒuhuckerâ ŋezejec; ine Benjamiŋte motâckonec ware mârâc motâc, tuturuŋte motâc hâcne, ira fisizejec; erâ Hananere fic ʒoricne bafekicne irecnec ware ŋicwofuŋte waiŋ bâpisickeeŋgopieŋko ira tarazejec.
Eme Jerusalem haezi sâwec tâmiric ŋeha ŋic ŋokac jaŋe maŋnao wama faio juhâmonʒepieŋ.
Jerusalem hae râsi ecneniŋmu ŋic i jaŋere faio Wofuŋzi mume wiac hâhâwicne kecʒiŋuc feocmu: Jaŋe ɋâricne jaha juhapie biuc‐jeŋiczi gâreckezejec, erâ ʒâŋe hândâŋ‐jeŋiczi ŋeŋe‐ticnao jaha ŋehuc fâuckerâ omaeha nameŋ‐jeŋiczi micjeŋickoa fohuc gârecke ʒaŋ ezejec.
Dameŋ ira Wofuŋtaonec wiac bipic tataraneheczi fai‐jeŋicko feme jaŋe jaŋackoaŋ rârâsi ehuc qaqac eniŋmu.
Eme Juda e wâc mâmâc Jerusalem haemaŋko ʒika bâfuaocmu. Ehuc ŋicne ŋicne rârec rârec juraŋgopieŋ jaŋere moneŋ mafa, gol siliwa erâ ŋaqi wiac bocjaha ro qâzuc efâreniŋmu.
Ŋic jaŋerao wiac hâhâwicne fuaocmu sâc ijaha becâsic, doŋgi, kamele â qowifâc‐jeŋic gâcne jaŋerao fuaocmu wâc.
Eme ŋicne ŋicne Jerusalem râsi ecnehuc ʒika qambiŋ jaŋeraonec ŋic ʒanʒaŋne juniŋmu jaŋe jarane jarane Jerusalem haeo ferâ Wofuŋ Sâko, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ hâcne, e mai ecnehuc hombaŋ sâko ŋehuc junʒepieŋ.
Me ŋicguru moc jaŋe ferâ Wofuŋ Sâko, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ hâcne, e mai mi ecneniŋmuo jaŋerao hoe mi heocmu.
Eme Aigita ŋic jaŋe ferâ Wofuŋ mai mi ecneniŋmuo ine Wofuŋzi ŋicne ŋicne Jerusalem haeo ferâ hombaŋ ŋeniŋte mi ejareha wiac hâhâwicne bâfua‐jareekac irec sâc jaha mume jaŋere faio feocmu.
Wiac izi hâcne Aigita ŋic â ŋicne ŋicne hombaŋ sâko mi ŋeniŋmu jaŋere bâbâtiŋ eocmu.
Dameŋ ira becâsic jaŋere goŋgoŋko qâreŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkepie foocmu: “Wofuŋte erâ bâtirikicne”. Ehame Wofuŋte ufuŋko kuʒi wiac ŋerakac izi alata maŋfuŋko râqâc ŋerakac irec sâc ezejec.
Ehame Jerusalem haeo â Juda mâreŋko kuʒi ŋerakac sâc i bâtiripie Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere biŋ ŋezejec. Eme taha bâzi rikeniŋmu jaŋe fisirâ kuʒi i hâcne rorâ ira bâzire wiac rikenʒepieŋ. Iŋuc fuame Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere ufuŋko âbârâ gie bahuc wiac nareŋ gareŋ ee i mocwâc mi eniŋmu.
Maleakizi Wofuŋte dâŋ Israe ŋic mufua‐jarewec.
Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc mukac: “No maŋjauŋ eŋare warehuc juekopac.” Ŋoŋe ine ʒiŋuc muŋgopieŋ: “Go weniŋuc ehuc maŋjauŋ enâre warehuc juekic?” Iŋuc muhuc wioŋgopieŋte Wofuŋzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐ŋarekac: “Esau â Jakobo jahe hahac ɋa jâmbâŋ juhapire no sifu Jakobo maŋzi heme hariŋ ecnehuc Esau ine hone takirepo.
Ehuc hae mâreŋ‐ticne imackepe bec qowi jaŋere juju hae ewec.”
“Nâŋe henʒaŋ‐nâpokicne, erâ sifu hae sesuc mocwâc heɋârerâ banaŋmu,” Edomŋic jaŋe iŋuc muhapie Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc muocmu: “Jaŋe heɋârerâ bazo murâ banʒepieŋ, no ine mocwâc hetâtiepemu. Iŋuc fuame ŋic jaŋe honerâ ʒiŋuc mujareniŋmu: Ŋic hehesicne jaŋere mâreŋ. Ŋicguru i jaŋe Wofuŋzi kimbeŋ qajarehuc juocmu sanaŋ.”
Wiac i ʒâŋe fâri‐ŋeŋiczi honehuc ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Wofuŋ e Fekicne sâkozi Israe mâreŋ sâcke‐fârehuc jukac!”
“Ŋokâzi mamac‐ticne sâseekac, â kiŋaŋ qaqazi bomboŋ‐ticne araŋ bacneekac. Eme no Mamac juipiehape mozi sâsecnuekac? Â bomboŋ juipiehape mozi araŋ banareekac? Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ noni, ʒâŋe‐nane qaisockeeŋgopieŋ taha bapa ŋoŋe hâcne iŋuc ŋazakopac. Ŋoŋe ine muŋgopieŋ: ‘Nâŋe weniŋuc ehuc ʒâŋege qaisockeeŋgopeneŋ?’
Irec ʒiŋuc ŋazape: Ŋoŋe taha wiac sâqorekicne alata‐naneo râehuc iŋuc hâcne eeŋgopieŋ. Ehuc ʒiŋuc mu wioc eeŋgopieŋ: ‘Nâŋe weniŋuc epene wâwânâŋnehec eekac?’ Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc manaŋgopieŋte wâwânâŋnehec ekac: ‘Wofuŋte alata i gâc sâcne hecnezo.’
Ŋoŋe qowi ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ me kike demba me hucnehec bâzi rikeeŋgopieŋ i moc mi sâqoreekac me? Wiac iŋucne i mâreŋ soŋaŋ‐ŋeŋic râcnepie bune biaŋkeha mana‐ŋareme sâckeocmu me? Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
‘Ʒi ine Anutuzi aki anonoc enâreocte kio wâwâsic ecnenaŋ.’ Ŋoŋe iŋuc muhuc taha wiac iŋucne bafisipie mana‐ŋarepe sâckeocmu me? Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Alata‐naneo maŋgâŋ bâzi rikenʒipiŋte ŋoŋeraonec moczi taha ufuŋte motâc hefârezac me! No hone aŋac mi eŋarekopac, erâ wâc taha bâzi‐ŋeŋicte takicnuekac, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec fuŋkerâ raku huhunao tarakac ira ŋicne ŋicne juraŋgopieŋ jaŋerao ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane sâcke‐fârerâ fokac. Ehame mâreŋ sâc nore ʒâŋe muhuc hosâc âsu rikeeŋgopieŋ â taha biaŋne râeeŋgopieŋ, i ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanezi ŋicne ŋicne jaŋerao sâcke‐fârerâ fokacte iŋuc eeŋgopieŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Ŋoŋe ine ʒiŋuc muhuc ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane bawahaeŋgopieŋ: Wofuŋte alata i wiac omane, â fainao tahare wiac fokac i sâcne qaisockezo.
‘Keci neneŋ gie sâko,’ ŋoŋe iŋuc muhuc mecpiroc enareeŋgopieŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Ŋoŋe qowi momorizi kisuckekicne me puriŋne me hucnehec tahare biŋe bafisipie wemocko manape biaŋkeha ropemu? Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Ŋic moczi taha moc Wofuŋ nore biŋe râeocte mupaŋkerâ faicnao qowifâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋicne biaŋne moc jucne‐bipieha sâqocne moc râeocmu e eeatuc‐ticnere erâ sâwecte biŋe ezejec. No hâcne Wofuŋ Sâko jukopac, ehame ŋicne ŋicne jaŋerao ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanezi qeŋ bipinehec ekac, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“O taha bapa, uŋdâŋ ʒira fuakac i ŋoŋere biŋe ekac hâcne.
Ŋoŋe hazec râerâ ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane manariŋ qâriŋ mi eniŋmuo ine ŋaŋacne sâwec‐ŋopape jambuŋ‐ŋeŋiczi wâc sâwechec jaha eocmu. Ŋoŋe ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane manariŋ qâriŋ mi eeŋgopieŋte biac sâwec‐ŋopakopac hâcne, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Manaŋgopieŋ, taha bâzire qowi bacjopa fisiniŋmu jaŋere hozi ʒâŋe mai‐ŋeŋic ruacnerâ behec‐ŋopape jawa forakac ihec mâmâc bacŋopa raniŋmu. Ehame ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe wâc mana sâqore‐jarepemu.
Iŋuc fuame ʒiŋuc mana taranʒepieŋ: Lewire guru jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic‐nâŋec fokac i ʒuhuckerâ foocte uŋdâŋ ʒi ŋazapo, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
No jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo ine wamao jujuhâmo bâfua‐jarehape araŋ banareniŋte epo, eme jaŋe araŋ banarehuc ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanere erâ dape‐narembiŋ.
Micjeŋicko mu qaqazuc dâŋ fârine fohuc juhame bipic‐jeŋicko eeatuc dâŋ mi fuawec. Jaŋe norao qohotarâ wamao tiŋne juhuc ŋic bocjaha hata sâqocnaonec bârisiec‐jopambiŋ.
Taha bapa e Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore biŋe mumu jukacte dâŋticne muhuc mamana tarare guriŋ bazejec. Ehame ŋic jaŋe mu qaqazuc dâŋticne mananiŋte fotarienʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ine hata fâretiŋ beherâ mu qaqazuc dâŋŋeŋiczi ŋic bocjaha maŋ bâsifuc ejarepie fâfâc‐jopawec. Lewire guru jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo ʒâʒâfic i ŋoŋe hâcne bâbiembiŋ, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Ŋoŋe nore hata beherâ mu qaqazuc ehuc ŋic hone bârâwiŋ ejarembiŋte no wâc ŋic sasawa jaŋere maio hone suŋgiŋ â behe qaisoc eŋarepemu.”
Wiac nâŋâc mamac‐nâŋec mocjaha, â Anutu mocjahazi bâfuac‐nâpowec i! Eme wemocte mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ekicne i bâbiehuc nâŋâczia eeatuc eec eeŋgopeneŋ?
Judaŋic jaŋe eeatuc bâfuahuc Israe guru maŋnao â Jerusalem haeo wiac mamakâcne embiŋ. Ehuc nemu araŋ bajareeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋere otâfâc rocjopahuc, Wofuŋzi tiri ufuŋ hone aŋac ecneekac i bâbiembiŋ hâcne.
Irec ŋic mâsi iŋucne eekac e â ɋâricfâc‐ticne Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ taha bacneeŋgopieŋ i jaŋe hâcne Wofuŋzi bâsirowec‐jopame Jakobore kikefuŋko omaenʒepieŋ.
Â moc ʒiŋuc eeŋgopieŋ: Ŋoŋe Wofuŋte taha bafisipie hone aŋac ehuc meŋeŋickonec mi roekacte kio wâwâsic epie ʒâŋeuc‐ŋeŋiczi waharâ alata‐ticne sâcke‐fâreekac.
Ehame ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc wioeŋgopieŋ: “Wemocte mi roekac?” I ʒiŋucte: Go socɋâri juhuc ŋokac romeŋ i Wofuŋzi honehame behe qaisoc ecnemeŋ. Ŋokac e hâcne gohec ʒâʒâfic ehuc âgo babaficge â ŋonâŋge juwec.
Irec ŋic moc e mamana biaŋ huŋgaŋne focneweczi iŋuc moc mi ewec. E ine weniŋuc eekac? E ɋâricfâc‐ticne jaŋe fuarâ Anuture naru motecfâc jaha juniŋte manasu biric eekac. Irec moc e socɋâri juhuc ŋokac rowec e behe qaisoc ecnezacte maŋticnere soŋaŋ juzejec.
Wofuŋ Israere Anutu e kecʒiŋuc mukac: “No ʒuhuc bâtâc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mecne, â ŋic bâʒâic‐jopahuc kiŋ hureeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc hone takic ejareekopac, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Irec ŋoŋe ŋonâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic behe qaisoc ejarenʒipiŋte rucgereŋ‐ŋeŋic bahuc junʒepieŋ.”
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ micneneŋ ecneeŋgopieŋ. Iŋuc ŋazape ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: “Hâc, nâŋe weniŋuc ehuc micneneŋ ecneeŋgopeneŋ?” I ʒiŋuc muhuc eeŋgopieŋ hâcne: “Sâqocne baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe Wofuŋzi honec‐jopame biaŋkeha mana aŋac ejareekac.” Â moc ʒiŋuc wiohuc eeŋgopieŋ: “Anutu mumutiŋ rune e wena?”
“Manaŋgopieŋ, no kiŋaŋŋic‐nane sorepe hata bâʒâwe‐nareocte fakac, eme honecnuzo ʒoɋac eeŋgopieŋ Wofuŋ no hâcne taha ufuŋ‐naneo ututuŋ jaha fisipemu. Manaŋgopieŋ, ʒâʒâficte kiŋaŋŋic fisime honeniŋte boc eŋareekac e hâcne fakac, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Mâc fifisi dameŋ‐ticnao mozi sanaŋkerâ juocmu, â fua tâcneme mozi qiŋ herâ domaocmu? “Tâpiri‐ticne i ʒoczi wiac ʒame burockeekac irec sâc, â saifezi wânâŋ ʒure ɋaɋackeekac iŋucne.
Siliwa wiac ʒocko rikepie opâ ehuc wosâekac irec sâc Lewi ŋokâfâc‐ticne ʒure ɋaɋac‐jopahuc gol â siliwa iŋucne hone wosâc ejareocmu, iŋuc ejarekume Wofuŋte taha gie biaŋne banʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc epie Judaŋic â Jerusalem hae rune jaŋere taha i mârâc jaha Wofuŋtao aŋacnehec fowec irec sâc jaha eocmu.
“No mumutara gie bapemurâ maic‐ŋopakopac. Ehuc hafec qaŋgec ŋic â boe sau ŋic, â burec ehuc dâŋ mueŋgopieŋ, â gieŋic furi‐jeŋic bawahaeŋgopieŋ, â hozec bekâ bâuruŋ‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, erâ ŋic jabane hone qaisoc ejarehuc nore mi hâwic‐jopaekac, ŋic iŋucne jaŋere fuŋne biac ritupemu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Wofuŋ no hec hetikic‐nane mi fokac, â Jakobore ɋâricfâc ŋoŋe jumbiŋ sâc ijaha wâc juŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jumbiŋ dameŋ ira hâcne dâŋsanaŋ‐nane qâsuahuc mana rereŋ mi embiŋzi ewareeŋgopieŋ. Irec norao risiepie maic‐ŋopapemu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc. Ŋoŋe ine muŋgopieŋ: ‘Hâc, nâŋe mi behecgumbeŋ, irec weniŋuc erâ gorao risienaŋmu?’
Ŋiczi Anutu no sâcne eatucnuniŋmu me? Ŋoŋe hâcne iŋuc enareeŋgopieŋ. Iŋuc mupe ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Hâc, nâŋe weniŋuc ehuc eatucgueŋgopeneŋ?’ Ŋoŋe teŋkonec wâŋ â taha wiac furu jaha mi râehuc iŋuc eeŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Ŋicguru ʒi ŋoŋe ʒeŋgoma sâwec‐ŋopakicne. Erâ sifu eatucnuhuc jueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe teŋkonec wâŋ i furu jaha taha ufuŋko bafisipie rowaŋ‐naneo nânâ i fohuc juzejec. Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc esâicnupie mupe sambâŋkonec jambuŋzi ŋoŋerao fofo dunduŋ foocmu me mâcne, irec fuŋne taniŋkezejec, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
No qokic repicne jaŋe jâpec‐jopape gie‐ŋeŋicko wiac fârine fuarâ fokac i mi sipirickenʒepieŋ. Ehame gieo waiŋ qizecne doma rakac i fârinehec ezejec, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Eme mâreŋ‐ŋeŋiczi aŋac bâfua‐ŋareme ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe ŋoŋere manapie ʒerine eocmu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.”
Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Ŋoŋe pepecdâŋ enareeŋgopieŋ, iŋuc ŋazape dâŋ okacne ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐nareŋgopieŋ: ‘Hâc, nâŋe weniŋuc ehuc pepecdâŋ egareeŋgopeneŋ?’
Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc enareeŋgopieŋ: ‘Anutu kiŋaŋ qaqacne i maŋgâŋ qacneeŋgopeneŋ. Me sâcmutâc dâŋticne reŋkehuc Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ ere maio busâqoc hawari jupene wiac fârine wâc mi fua‐nâreekac.
Irec pepec penaroŋhec jaŋere manapene ʒerine eekac. Jaŋe hâcne hehesic bâfuahuc bubiaŋ faio jueŋgopieŋ. Iŋuc ehuc Anutu esâickepie wiac i me i moc mi fua‐jareekac.’”
Eme Wofuŋ araŋ bacnembiŋ jaŋa jaŋackoaŋ muc manac epie Wofuŋzi manawec. Ehame Wofuŋ sâsehuc ʒâŋe‐ticnere manapie fewec jaŋere manasuhuc ʒâŋe biri‐jeŋic ere maio qâreŋkekicne.
Irec Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: “No mumutara gie bapemu dameŋ ira jaŋe fuŋfuŋfâc‐nane fârine erâ juniŋmu. Ehame ŋic moczi ŋokâ‐ticne kiŋaŋ qacnehame akickeekac, irec sâc jaha akic‐jopapemu.
Iŋuc fuame ŋoŋe ŋic tiŋne â hehesicne, erâ Anutu kiŋaŋ qacneeŋgopieŋ â mi qacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mocwâc hone bârâwiŋ ejareniŋmu.
“Erâ manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ qândâŋkekac i ʒoc fâroroc sâko iŋucne. Eme izi ŋic pepec penaroŋ â hehesicne jaŋe rocjopame sopâc kecɋaŋ iŋucne hahaŋkeniŋmu. Ehame dameŋ warekac izi qizec susuc â siec‐jeŋic moc mi bâtirihuc ʒâseŋke‐fâreocmu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋ nore dâŋ iŋuc.
Â ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanere erâ araŋ banareeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋerao ine wamare dameŋ biaŋ bâbâpiaŋ‐ticnehec maickeocmu. Iŋuc fuame ŋoŋe aŋac baŋacne juniŋmu.
Eme no mumutara gie bapemu dameŋ ira ŋoŋe ŋic hehesicne kike‐ŋeŋiczi âtenʒaŋ‐jopakupie uucne eniŋmu, Anutu Tâpiri Ɋuŋɋasaŋ Wofuŋte nore dâŋ iŋuc.
“Israe ŋic ŋoŋere erâ Horebe tikio kiŋaŋic‐nane Mose ecnepe sâcmutâc sanaŋ â dâŋsanaŋ erâ mumutâc dâŋ fuŋne fuŋne ŋaza ŋowatuc ewec irec manasuhuc junʒepieŋ.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ sâko‐nane qeŋ bipinehec qândâŋkezo eha no porofete Elia sore‐ŋarepemu.
Erâ mâreŋ ʒi imackezipore Elia e mamac â naru motec jaŋe maŋ mocjaha ehuc sâsâsec erâ juniŋte gie baocmu.”
Ŋic gaŋne gaŋne fua wefukupie Jesu Kristo e Abraham â Dawidi jahere ɋâric fuawec.
Abrahamte bifuŋko Isaka fuawec. Isakare bifuŋko Jakobo fuawec. Jakobore bifuŋko Juda â hahac ɋafâcne fuambiŋ.
Judare bifuŋko Perese â Sera fuapic, jahe Tamazi rocjofawec. Peresere bifuŋko Hezoroŋ fuawec. Hezoroŋte bifuŋko Ram fuawec.
Ramte bifuŋko Aminada fuawec. Aminadare bifuŋko Nasoŋ fuawec. Nasoŋte bifuŋko Salamoŋ fuawec.
Salamoŋte bifuŋko Boasi fuawec, e Rahabazi rowec. Boasire bifuŋko Obede fuawec, e Rutizi rowec. Obedere bifuŋko Isai fuawec.
Isaire bifuŋko ŋicwofuŋ Dawidi fuawec. Ŋicwofuŋ Dawidire bifuŋko Salomo fuawec, e Uriare ŋonâŋzi rowec.
Salomore bifuŋko Rehoboam fuawec. Rehoboamte bifuŋko Abia fuawec. Abiare bifuŋko Asa fuawec.
Asare bifuŋko Josafata fuawec. Josafatare bifuŋko Joram fuawec. Joramte bifuŋko Usia fuawec.
Usiare bifuŋko Jotam fuawec. Jotamte bifuŋko Ahaʒi fuawec. Ahaʒire bifuŋko Hisikia fuawec.
Hisikiare bifuŋko Manase fuawec. Manasere bifuŋko Amoŋ fuawec. Amoŋte bifuŋko Josia fuawec.
Josiare bifuŋko Jekonia â hahac ɋafâcne fuambiŋ, ine Judaŋic Babe mâreŋko bacjopa rakicne dameŋ ira fuambiŋ.
Eme irec fainao Jekoniare bifuŋko Sealitie fuawec. Sealitiere bifuŋko Serubabe fuawec.
Serubabere bifuŋko Abiudu fuawec. Abiudure bifuŋko Eliakim fuawec. Eliakimte bifuŋko Aso fuawec.
Asore bifuŋko Zadoko fuawec. Zadokore bifuŋko Akim fuawec. Akimte bifuŋko Eliudu fuawec.
Eliudure bifuŋko Eleaʒa fuawec. Eleaʒare bifuŋko Mataŋ fuawec. Mataŋte bifuŋko Jakobo fuawec.
Jakobore bifuŋko Josefe fuawec, e Mariare ŋowe ewec. Â Mariazi ine Jesu rowec, ere ʒâŋe Kristo mukicne.
Fufua ine kecʒiŋuc fua warembiŋ: Abrahamtaonec fua fua wefukupie Dawidi fuawec i gaŋjeŋic 14. Â Dawidiraonec fua fua warekupie Judaŋic Babe mâreŋko bacjopa rakicne ine gaŋjeŋic 14 jaha. Â dameŋ irecnec fua fua warekupie Kristo fuawec iŋuc jaha gaŋjeŋic 14 ekac.
Jesu Kristo fuawec irec fuŋne kecʒiŋuc fokac: Neŋgoc‐ticne Maria e Josefe biŋe qacnepie rârâwiŋ juhapire Tiri Mârozi mâsi bame Maria e motec kiweckewec.
Iŋuc ecneme biŋe‐ticne Josefe e mitihec juwecte maŋnezi kecʒiŋuc muwec: No dâŋticne hofao râepe mimi fainao fezacte kamierâ behezepac.
Iŋuc eocte manasuhuc juhame Wofuŋte aŋelo moczi guŋko fuacnerâ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Josefe, go Dawidire ɋâriczi Maria ŋonâŋge rocmurâ manabâc mi ezemec, motec kiweckekac i Tiri Mâroraonec.
Motec roocmu ere ʒâŋe Jesu muzemec, eki hâcne gurufâc‐ticne sâqocnere niŋgiŋkonec batarac‐jopaocmu.”
Wiac sasawa fuawec i porofete moczi Wofuŋte micte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec i fârinehec eocte fuawec:
“Manaŋgopieŋ, naru ʒeŋoŋ moczi motec kiweckerâ roocmu, ere ʒaŋe Imanue muniŋmu.” (Nâŋâcne dâŋko: Anutuzi nâŋâcnehec jukac.)
Eme Josefe e guŋkonec ɋârerâ Wofuŋte aŋelozi dâŋ âzâcnewec i reŋkehuc Maria âgo ecnerâ ficticnao jowa fewec.
Â ŋowe ŋonâŋzi juju ine mi juhapire motec fuawec. Fuame Josefezi ʒâŋene Jesu muwec.
Herode ŋicwofuŋ juhame Jesu e Betelehem haeo Judaia mâreŋko fuawec. Eme dameŋ ira ʒoaŋ wewefuopec mâreŋ mockonec mamana ŋicbomboŋ Jerusalem haeo fisirâ mu wioc ehuc mumbiŋ,
“Judaŋic ŋoŋere ŋicwofuŋ geune fuawec e hae wena jukac? Nâŋe ocna mâreŋ‐nâŋecko bâpiŋ‐ticne honerâ dapecnehuc taha bacnenaŋte wareŋgopeneŋ.”
Iŋuc mupie ŋicwofuŋ Herode â Jerusalem hae rune jaŋe mâmâc manarâ fâfârembiŋ.
Eme Herodezi taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu hetumaŋ‐joparâ, Kristo e hae wena fuaocte mukicne muhuc esâic‐jopame
kecʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Betelehem haeo Judaia mâreŋko. Irec hâcne porofete moczi kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkewec:
Betelehem hae Judaia mâreŋko, go Judaiare hae qizec wawahane mâcne. Gorao hâcne micne sâko moc fuarâ Israe ŋicfâc‐nane gume jowac ejarezokac.”
Dâŋ i mupie manarâ Herodezi mamana ŋicbomboŋ soŋsoŋko hefârec‐joparâ bâpiŋ fuawec irec dameŋte aimuŋ jaha wio‐jareme âzâcnepie
manarâ Betelehem haeo raniŋte sorec‐jopahuc muwec, “Ŋoŋe ra ʒoɋac erâ mu basac eku motec bâfuarâ ware nazapie no iŋuc jaha rarâ dapecnehuc taha bacnezepac.”
Ŋicwofuŋzi iŋuc jazame rambiŋ. Ehame ocna mâreŋ‐jeŋicko bâpiŋ honembiŋ izi bânie‐jarehuc raku motec fowec fic irec faicnao sanaŋkerâ ŋewec.
Eme jaŋe bâpiŋ honerâ mu ʒeri mâretec embiŋ.
Erâ ficko ferâ motec â neŋgoc‐ticne Maria honec‐jofarâ dieŋzi hecnehuc taha bacnembiŋ, ehuc mafa katapa‐jeŋickonec gol â wiac âsu biaŋ furi sâko rorâ râcnembiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi guŋko qatara‐jareme jaŋe Heroderao mi risiehuc hata mocko raku mâreŋ‐jeŋicko fisimbiŋ.
Jaŋe risierâ rahapie Wofuŋte aŋelo moczi Josefe guŋko fuacnerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go fahare neŋgoc motec rocjofatec Aigita mâreŋko wiserâ ra nore dâŋte woŋec junʒepieŋ. Manakic, Herode e motec basaku bâfuarâ qaocte mukac.”
Mume Josefezi faharerâ neŋgoc motec rocjofame ŋafeoa Aigita mâreŋko wiserâ rambiŋ.
Eme ira juhapie Herode hâmowec. Wiac iŋuc fuame porofete moczi Wofuŋte micte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec i sanaŋkewec: “Ŋokâ‐nane Aigita mâreŋko juha wiracnepe risiewec.”
Mamana ŋicbomboŋ jaŋe Herode eatuckerâ rapie fuŋne manarâ aaric sâqocne manawec. Ehuc momori sorec‐jopame jaŋe ra Betelehem hae sâko â rârec rârec hae piic piic irec motec jara‐jeŋic jajahec me juwicnao jaŋe jopa‐fârembiŋ. I mamana ŋicbomboŋ jaŋere mickonec ʒâfo manawec irec sâcko ewec.
Eme dameŋ ira porofete Jeremia dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec i sanaŋkewec:
“Rama haeo ojowa fuakac, ki uu â mu mamakuc sâko. Rahezi ɋiefâcne jaŋere kiome bâmiriŋkeniŋte eipieŋgopieŋ. Wiac omae‐fârembiŋ hâcne.”
Herode e hâmome Wofuŋte aŋelo moczi Josefe Aigita mâreŋko mi guŋ qâhâŋ ecnehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnezejec i:
“Go ʒawierâ neŋgoc motec rocjofatec Israe mâreŋko risieniŋ. Motec qâhâmozo mumbiŋ jaŋe hâmombiŋ.”
Eme Josefezi neŋgoc motec rocjofame Israe mâreŋko risiembiŋ.
Risierâ Josefezi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc manawec: Akelao e mamac‐ticne Herode ere tuc qarâ Judaia mâreŋte ŋicwofuŋ ewec jukac. Dâŋ iŋuc manarâ ira ra juocte hâwickewec. Erâ guŋko dâŋ manarâ Galilaia mâreŋko rawec.
Erâ hae moc ʒâŋene Nazarete ira ra juwec. Eme porofete jaŋere dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac i fideteŋ ewec: “Ʒâŋe‐ticne Nazarete ŋic muniŋmu.”
Dameŋ ira Johane Miti Opâ fufuŋkezi Judaia mâreŋko fua tâcnerâ mâreŋ tuhuo ra juhuc miti kecʒiŋuc muwec:
“Sambâŋte uucmaŋzi maic‐ŋopakacte maŋŋeŋic bârisieniŋ.”
Ŋic erao hâcne porofete Jesajazi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec i qacnewec: “Mâreŋ tuhuo wiwira fuakac: Wofuŋte hata bâʒâweniŋ, â hezu hemasec ekupie wâneŋkeoc.”
Johane e ine ŋaqi moc kamele kanʒaŋnezi bakicne i rojuwec erâ becsahac moc ombâŋnao jomawec. Nânâ‐ticne ine baŋac â ɋâuc bisirec nâhuc juwec.
Eme Jerusalem haeonec â Judaia mâreŋkonec â Jordaŋ ʒiŋuc ocniŋuc ŋic heâckerâ erao rafârembiŋ.
Erâ sâqocne‐jeŋic mufuapie Jordaŋko opâ rua‐jarewec.
Eme farisaio â sadukaio Miti Opâre fisipie honec‐joparâ jazawec: “Homare ɋâric, ŋoŋe sâqocnere okacne fisizo ekac i wisecneniŋte mozi ŋazawec?
Ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic bârisiehuc irec sâcko fârine bâfuaniŋ me.
Erâ maŋŋeŋiczi ʒiŋuc mi muniŋ: Nâŋe Abrahamte ɋâricfâc. No ŋazape mananiŋ, Anutu e muzo murâ sâcne mume qânâ ʒizi Abrahamte ɋâric fuaniŋmu.
Râric biac jâcfuŋko râekicne. Irec jâc moc fâri tâmiric domame qafararâ ʒocko rikezo.
No maŋŋeŋic bârisieniŋte opâ sawa rua‐ŋareekopac. Râpefuŋ‐naneo warehuc jukac e ine tâpiri sâc moc focnekac, e sâko no iŋucne maczi mafahe decnepe mi sâckeocmu. Eki hâcne Tiri Mâro â ʒoc rua‐ŋareocmu.
E oofaŋ‐ticnehec warerâ nânâfic‐ticne ʒumururuckeocmu, ehuc nânâ fârine wosâerâ ficko râeme ŋeocmu, â jawa rasa wiac ofaŋne behec eme ʒocsanaŋko ʒaocmu.”
Dameŋ ira Jesu e Galilaia mâreŋkonec Jordaŋ opâo rarâ Johanezi Miti Opâ ruacneocte âzâcnewec.
Eme Johane e maname ŋemâckeme ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No iŋucnerao wemocte ware mukic? Goki no rua‐naretec sâckezac.”
Mume Jesuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Go miŋecgac manabâc behec, eme rereŋ gie jaha bapere sâckeoc.” Iŋuc mume Johanezi manacnewec.
Eme Jesu e opâ ruarâ izia Jordaŋkonec wefu wefuhuc honeha mi sambâŋ aŋkeme Anuture Mârozi hapâ tinac waha ere faio hezejec i!
Eme izia sambâŋkonec dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc wahawec: “Keci joroc Ŋokâ biaŋ‐nane, e hone aŋac ecneekopac.”
Eme Mârozi Jesu mâreŋ tuhuo jowa rawec, Sataŋzi esâickezejec muhuc.
Eme Jesu e ira ŋafe ʒoaŋ 40 nânâ sowa juku nânâre hâmowec.
Ehame Eesâic Runezi erao fuarâ âzâcne muwec, “Go Anuture Ŋokâ jukomecko mutec qânâ ʒizi poroŋ eoc me.”
Mume Jesuzi âzâcnewec, “Dâŋqâreŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac: ‘Ŋiczi nânâre sawa mi juhâmoocmu, Anuture mickonec dâŋ wahaekac sâc manahuc juhâmoocmu’.”
Mume Sataŋzi Jesu miti hae qizecko jowa rarâ taha ufuŋte bupu faio râewec.
Erâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Anuture Ŋokâ jukomecko ʒirec tara huc, ehuc dâŋqâreŋ moc ʒiŋuc fokac i manasuc: ‘E aŋelofâc‐ticne jaŋere meo râecguocmu’, â moc ʒiŋuc: ‘Jaŋe meo bahucgupie qânâzi kikege mi heocmu’.”
Mume Jesuzi kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Erâ dâŋqâreŋ moc ʒiŋuc fokac: Wofuŋ Anutu penaroŋ ecnehuc mi esâickezo.”
Mume Sataŋzi tiki ʒoricne ʒora mocko jowa ferâ domahuc mâreŋ sâc ŋic gurune gurune â aŋac fuŋne fuŋne sâko jâutuwec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Dieŋzi herâ numu‐naretec wiac i sasawa garepemu.”
Eme Jesuzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Sataŋ go behecnurâ rac. Dâŋqâreŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac: ‘Wofuŋ Anutuge dieŋzi herâ numucnezo, â e mocjaha kiŋaŋ qacnezo’.”
Iŋuc mume Sataŋzi beherâ rawec. Ehame aŋelo jaŋe fisirâ kime dopec ecnembiŋ.
Johane kâpâcwâru ficko râepie ŋehame Jesuzi irec biŋe manarâ Galilaia mâreŋko rawec.
Ehuc Nazarete hae beherâ Kafanaum haeo ŋeŋe juju ewec. Hae i riqicmecko, Sebuloŋ â Naftali mâreŋko ŋewec.
Iŋuc eme porofete Jesaja ere dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc fokac i sanaŋkewec:
“Sebuloŋ â Naftali mâreŋ, riqickopec, Jordaŋ ocniŋuc fokac, Galilaia, qâpuc jaŋere juju.
Ŋicguru dapâcko ŋeŋene jaŋe ʒocsâko honeŋgopieŋ, hâmo qanʒaraŋ mâreŋko ŋeŋene jaŋe tatamac fua‐jarekac.”
Dameŋ ira Jesuzi miti muhuc ŋic ʒiŋuc fuŋkerâ jazawec: “Sambâŋte uucmaŋ maic‐ŋopakacte maŋŋeŋic bârisieniŋ.”
Eme ʒoaŋ mocko Jesu e Galilaia riqic irec moŋgeŋko rac warec ehuc ŋic jajahec hahac ɋa honec‐jofawec, moc Simoŋ, ʒâŋe‐ticne moc Petoro, erâ ɋaticne Anderea. Jahe riqicko wasaŋ‐jekic behehuc domapic, qowi gie bapa ŋic jupic hâcne.
Eme honec‐jofarâ jasa muwec, “Ware no bâjâpecnunic, eme ŋicko gie bapa bacŋofapemu.”
Mume izia wasaŋ‐jekic beherâ bâjâpepic.
Eme ipec rarâ ŋic hahac ɋa jaha wâc bâfuac‐jofawec, Jakobo â ɋaticne Johane, jahe Ʒebedaiore ŋokâ jahec, mamac‐jekic Ʒebedaiohec wokeo ŋehuc wasaŋ he bâpiaŋ embiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi hefârec‐jofame woke â mamac behec‐jofarâ bâjâpepic.
Eme Jesu e Galilaia mâreŋ râreckehuc mitific sâc ferâ uucmaŋte Biŋebiaŋ jazawec â ŋic huc ʒâic‐jeŋichec ɋiɋicne bacjopawec.
Iŋuc eme biŋe‐ticne Siria mâreŋko haŋ bafâreme manarâ ŋic huc ʒâichec â demoŋhec â hâmo ɋârecne â ʒeke puriŋ erao amec‐jopa rapie bâpiaŋ‐jopa‐fârewec.
Eme Galilaia mâreŋkonec â hae 10 ŋerawec irecnec â Jerusalem haeonec â Judaia mâreŋkonec â Jordaŋ ʒiŋuc ocniŋuc ŋicguru sokawec jâmbâŋ qâturerâ bâjâpembiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi ŋic guru sâko hâcne honec‐joparâ tikio ferâ ŋehame motecfâcne maŋfuŋ‐ticnao rapie
miti kecʒiŋuc muhuc jaza qazuc ewec:
“Maŋjeŋicte manapie hapetac eekac jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, jaŋe hâcne sambâŋte uucmaŋ rauckeŋgopieŋ.
Ki busâqochec jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, jaŋe hâcne bubiaŋ qajarezo.
Maŋuruc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, jaŋe hâcne mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ hotâckeniŋmu.
Biaŋkeniŋte nânâ opâre hâhâmo hâmoeŋgopieŋ jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, jaŋe hâcne gapec‐jopaocmu.
Aki uruc‐jeŋichec jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, jaŋe hâcne Anutuzi aki uruc ejareocmu.
Maŋ ɋaɋacne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, jaŋe hâcne Anutu honenʒoŋgopieŋ.
Wamare guriŋne baeŋgopieŋ jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, jaŋe hâcne Anuture naru motec mujarezo.
Mitire erâ ʒika kâpâcwâru hotâckeeŋgopieŋ jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac, jaŋe hâcne sambâŋte uucmaŋzi ɋoroc‐jopaocmu.
Nore qâqâiŋne sopec‐ŋopahuc ŋopa jâpec ehuc sâqocnere micko âkec eŋareniŋmu ŋoŋere manape ʒerine ekac.
Ŋoŋe sambâŋko furi sâko roniŋmure bubiaŋ manahuc ʒerienʒepieŋ. Porofete mârâc jaha jumbiŋ jaŋe iŋuc jaha jopa jâpec ejarekicne.
“Ŋoŋe ŋic jaŋere hâwec. Hâweczi sâqoreme izi wemo ezo? I mâc hae ʒoŋao hesiepie rame ŋic jaŋe kikezi âteniŋmu.
Erâ ŋoŋe ŋic jaŋere lambe. Hae moc tiki taniŋko ŋeme wiac moczi mi sâockeocmu.
Me lambe qazerâ kuʒizi mi hetutuckeeŋgopeneŋ, i ŋeŋenao hepene ŋeekac, ehuc ficmaŋko ŋec foc eniŋmu jaŋe tamae‐jare‐fâreekac.
Irec ŋoŋere lambezi iŋuc jaha ŋic tamae‐jarezejec. Eme jaŋe juju bapa‐ŋeŋic honepie biaŋkeme sambâŋ Mamac‐ŋeŋic muteŋkenʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe sâcmutâc dâŋqâhâc â porofete jaŋere dâŋ qataraocte wahawec, nore iŋuc moc mupie. No qatarapere mâcne, reŋkepere fisipo.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Sambâŋ â mâreŋ fonicmu sâc sâcmutâc dâŋqâhâc iŋuc jaha fohuc juocmu, ehuc dâŋ uucne moc mâc foku mi omaeocmu, i fârinehec efâreocmu.
Irec ŋic moczi sâcmutâc dâŋ piticne mac moc qâsuahuc gâcne ijaha eniŋte qafeŋ‐jopaocmu, e sambâŋte kikefuŋ guruo ŋic wawahane juocmu, â moczi ine reŋkehuc gâcne ijaha eniŋte qafeŋ jopaocmu, e sambâŋte kikefuŋ guruo ŋic fekicne juocmu.
Irec ŋazape mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe miti qaqazu â farisaio jaŋere sâc mi jâuruhuc tiŋke biaŋ eniŋmuo sambâŋte kikefuŋ mi eniŋmu.
“Mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic dâŋ kecʒiŋuc jazakicne: ‘Go ʒika mi qazemec. Moc e ʒika qaocmu, e dâŋte biŋe ekac.’
Noni ine ʒiŋuc ŋazakopac: Moc e âgo‐ticne aaric manacneocmu, e dâŋte biŋe ekac. Moc e âgo‐ticne mimiec mamakâc mucneocmu, e micne bapa tutumaŋte biŋe ekac. Moc e âgo‐ticne maric maŋgâpâc mucneocmu, e ʒochârâcte biŋe ekac.
Irec go taha bâzi wiac alatao râezo ehuc ʒiŋuc manasucmu: Âgo‐nanehec fâfâuc‐nâhec fokac;
iŋuc manasucmuo taha wiacge behetec foha rarâ âgogehec dâŋ mufâsâerâ ie risierâ taha wiacge alatao râezemec.
Go kiare haeo mi fifisi hatao juhuc kisâgehec kiŋ bebehec ezepirec. Iŋuc mi etecne kisâgezi biac kiarao ra fuŋnege mume kiazi momori‐ticne ecneme kâpâcwâru ficko râecguocmu.
No jâmbomac gazape: Go ira ŋeku mâc mi wahacmu, âgogere tofa bazutec tara‐jâmbâŋkeme jaha wahacmu.
“Mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic kecʒiŋuc jazakicne: ‘Ŋowe ŋonâŋ ŋohe bebehec mi ezepirec.’
Noni ine ʒiŋuc ŋazakopac: Ŋic moczi ŋokac moc hone sasec ecneocmu, ine e jahacne ŋonâŋ biac maŋzi behejec muzo.
Irec ʒâŋege moczi sâqocnere bitiŋko râecguzo eme riporâ behezemec. Ʒâŋe furu juku hârâcko huzicte sifu ʒâŋe hândâŋge qaisockezemec.
Mefâregezi sâqocnere bitiŋko râecguzo eme hetâcne behezemec. Sahac furu juku sipirickerâ hârâcko huzicte sifu mege qaisockezemec.
Dâŋ raŋɋane kecʒiŋuc fokac: ‘Moc e ŋonâŋ‐ticne behezo murâ pasi râcnehuc sorezejec.’
Noni ine ʒiŋuc ŋazakopac: Moc e ŋonâŋ‐ticne beheocmu, e ŋokac sahacko râec ecnehuc kiŋsâko hureocmu. Mâc ŋokaczi boe sau bâfuawecko ŋicte kiŋ mi eocmu. Eme moc e ŋokac behekicne hâcne baocmu, e wâc ʒuhuc bâtâcte kiŋ hotâckeocmu.
“Mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic kecʒiŋuc jazakicne: ‘Go Anuture maio dâŋ mumupaŋ i burecko mi ezemec. Â mumupaŋ dâŋ murâ Wofuŋte maio reŋketec fârine fuazejec.’
Noni ine ʒiŋuc ŋazakopac: Anuture maio dâŋ mumupaŋ sasawa i behe‐fârenʒepieŋ. Â sambâŋko ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ i wâc ʒiŋucte behenʒepieŋ: Sambâŋ i Anuture ŋeŋe hae.
Mâreŋko ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ ine ʒiŋucte wâc behezo: Mâreŋ i Anuture ââtesiŋ. Â Jerusalem haeo ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ i ʒiŋucte behezo: Jerusalem i Wofuŋ sâkore hae.
Erâ qizec‐ŋeŋicko ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ i wâc behenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe qizec susuc‐ŋeŋic qaŋqaŋ moc âzâcnepie gâgâpâc eocmu me? Me gâgâpâc moc âzâcnepie qaŋqaŋ eocmu me? I aricne.
Irec dâŋŋeŋic ine jâmbomacte fârine jâmbomac ezejec, â aricnere fârine aricne jaha ezejec. Faicnao muraʒihuc mumu i sâqocne.
“Dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc mukicne i manaeŋgopieŋ: ‘Moczi ʒâŋege âke hâpome okacne âke hâpocnezemec, me moczi micsiecge hezume okacne hezucnezemec.
Noni ine ʒiŋuc ŋazakopac: Ba imac eŋarezo mupie sahac‐ŋeŋic mi ŋezickenʒepieŋ. Irec moczi maucge ŋifecne qame ŋifecne wâc sicnecnezemec.
Â moczi gohec iiriac erâ ŋaqige faine rome maŋne qikiŋnecnezemec.
Â moczi hata bembeŋne jowacte gazame go hata ʒoricne jowa razemec.
Â moczi wiac mocte numu‐gareme râcnezemec, me wiacge jaba bajuzo mume manacnezemec.
“Dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc mukicne i manaeŋgopieŋ: ‘Go âgoge maŋjauŋ ecnezemec â râsige qaisockezemec.’
Noni ine ʒiŋuc ŋazakopac: Râsifâc‐ŋeŋic âgo ejarenʒepieŋ â ŋopa jâpec eŋareeŋgopieŋ jaŋere erâ numunʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc sambâŋ Mamac‐ŋeŋicte naru motec fârine erâ juniŋmu. Eki hâcne mume ʒoaŋ‐ticnezi ŋic sâqocne â biaŋne mâmâc tamae‐ŋareekac, â hoe mume ŋic tiŋne â hehesic kosa heŋareekac.
Ŋoŋe maŋjauŋ eŋareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe sawa maŋjauŋ ejareniŋmu, ine wemocko tofane fome juku bazu‐ŋarezo? I miti râpeckembiŋzi eeŋgopieŋ wâc.
Me qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe sawa âgo ejareniŋmu, ine wemo wiac sâko eŋgopieŋ eocmu? Qâpuc jaŋe i mi eeŋgopieŋ me?
Irec ŋoŋe sambâŋ Mamac‐ŋeŋiczi tiŋne juekac irec sâc jaha junʒepieŋ.
“Ŋoŋe miti babaju i mâc ŋic mumuteŋte manasuhuc mi bajunʒepieŋ. Iŋuc moc epie sambâŋ Mamac‐ŋeŋiczi mi suanʒeŋ‐ŋopaocmu.
Irec go ŋic bâmec bajarehuc gâcnezi hone manac egareniŋte qeŋ mi qazemec. Mitiŋic burec burec jaŋe hâcne mitificko â tomao ŋic bâmec bajareeŋgopieŋ, gâcnezi honec‐joparâ muafec‐jopaniŋte. No jâmbomac ŋazape: Jaŋe furi‐jeŋic biac ropie tarakac.
Mâcne, go bâmec bajarehuc mefâregezi wiac ecmu i qanazi mi manazejec.
Iŋuc etecne bâmec eehâmoge soŋsoŋko fogareocmu. Eme Mamacge wiac soŋsoŋko hone manac eekaczi okacne bazu‐gareocmu.
“Ŋoŋe bucko numuniŋte mitiŋic racne jaŋe iŋucne mi enʒepieŋ. Jaŋe mitificko â tomao numuniŋte boc ejareekac, ine ŋiczi hone warec ejareniŋte iŋuc eeŋgopieŋ. No jâmbomac ŋazape, hone warec ejarepie izi furi‐jeŋic eme tarakac.
Go numuzo murâ ficgao ferâ motâc herâ Mamacge soŋsoŋko juekac erao numuzemec. Eme Mamacge soŋsoŋko wiac hone manac eekaczi fârine bâfua‐gareocmu.
Ŋoŋe nunumu mâc miczi mu raʒic wefuc ehuc mi munʒepieŋ. I miti tâmiric jaŋere mâsi. Jaŋe hâcne dâŋ bocjaha wose rakupene mana‐nâreocmu mueŋgopieŋ.
Irec ŋoŋe jaŋe iŋucne mi enʒepieŋ. Mamac‐ŋeŋic e mi numucnehapie wiac basaeŋgopieŋ i biac manaekac.
Irec ŋoŋe kecʒiŋuc muhuc numunʒepieŋ: ‘Sambâŋ Mamac‐nâŋec, gore ʒâŋe tiri fozejec.
Ware maŋ sâc mâreŋ sâc Wofuŋ enârec. Sambâŋko gore micrereŋ fokac, iŋuc jaha mâreŋko nâŋerao fuazejec.
Go miŋecgac nânâ sâcnâŋec nârezemec.
Kiŋtofa‐nâŋec behe‐nârec, nâŋe iŋuc jaha ŋic jaŋere kiŋtofa beheŋgopeneŋ.
Eesâicko mi râec‐nâpozemec. Sâqocnaonec bâhoc‐nâpozemec.’
Ŋoŋe ŋic jaŋere bahac behepie sambâŋ Mamac‐ŋeŋiczi ŋoŋere bahac iŋuc jaha beheocmu.
Me ŋoŋe ŋic jaŋere bahac bajupie Mamac‐ŋeŋiczi ŋoŋere bahac iŋuc jaha bajuocmu.
“Ŋoŋe sowa juhuc ʒâŋe mai‐ŋeŋic sorondoŋ mi ezejec. Mitiŋic racne jaŋe hâcne iŋuc ehuc ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic fâsâeme jueŋgopieŋ, ŋic gâcne jaŋe sowa juju‐jeŋicte ʒâŋitac‐jopaniŋte. No jâmbomac ŋazape, jaŋe suanʒeŋ‐jeŋic biac ropie tarakac.
Goki ine sowa juhuc qizecge tokic ruacnerâ ʒâŋe maige ʒurezemec.
Eme ŋic jaŋe sowa jujuge mi ʒâŋitanʒepieŋ, Mamacge soŋsoŋ juekac e buc manazejec. Eme e soŋsoŋko wiac hone manac eekaczi okacne bazu‐gareocmu.
“Ŋoŋe mâreŋte mafa, wâfu qoʒazaŋzi nânâne â ŋiczi fiuc rorone, i boc mi hurepie fezejec.
Ŋoŋe sambâŋte boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ, wâfu qoʒazaŋzi mi nânâne â ŋiczi fiuc mi rorone, i hurepie fezejec.
Manakic, ʒeŋaŋge foocmu ijaha maŋge foocmu.
Sahacgere lambe ine ʒâŋege. Ʒâŋege biaŋne fohuc sahacge sâcne batamaecneocmu,
ʒâŋege sâqoreme ine sahacge tiŋtuŋ qaocmu. Â maŋgere tatamaczi dapâc eme, opo, dapâc mo iŋucne fua‐gareme tiŋtuŋ qahuc jucmu.
Motec mocjahazi ŋicbomboŋ jajahec jahere kiŋaŋ sâcne mi qaocmu. E moc âgo ecnehuc moc hone takireocmu, ehuc moctao qohotahuc moc râpeckeocmu. Ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha Anuture gie mecne â moneŋ mafa qâqâhâc sâko irec gie mecne sâckoa sâcne mi bacjofaniŋmu.
“Irec ŋazape mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe juju‐ŋeŋicte mana mezac ehuc ʒiŋuc boc mi munʒepieŋ: Wemo wiac ba nâc enaŋmu? Me sahac‐ŋeŋicte mu heŋɋâŋ ehuc ʒiŋuc boc mi munʒepieŋ: Wemo wiac rojunaŋmu? Ŋoŋe muniŋ, juju‐ŋeŋiczi fârine me nânâzi fârine? Sahac‐ŋeŋiczi fârine me ŋaqizi fârine?
Ŋoŋe sawao wipe honeniŋ, jaŋe he sarac me qa roro me nâ rowaŋ mi eeŋgopieŋ. Eme sambâŋ Mamac‐ŋeŋiczi sifu nânâ bâfua‐jareekac. Eme weniŋuc, ŋoŋe jaŋere wahamicne me?
Me ŋoŋe tâpiri‐ŋeŋic moc fokacko mu waiʒoc ehuc sahac‐ŋeŋic sâcne basanaŋkerâ dameŋ ŋondeŋ bembeŋne mac jufeniŋmu?
Iŋuc eene mi fokacko ine wemocte ŋaqi qoructe mana mezac boc eeŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe firindoac kâteo fuarâ domaekac, irec fuŋne mananʒapiŋ me. E ŋaqi qoruc‐ticnere gie mi baekac.
Eme irec ŋazape mananiŋ: Salomo e eri qaraweŋ‐ticneheczi hawari biaŋ iŋucne mi rojuwec.
Eme kâteo âri wiac dodocne, miŋecgac iŋuc fuaekac â tomâcko iŋuc mârâŋkeekac, i Anutuzi sifu mume hawari biaŋ fuaekac. Eme ŋoŋe ŋaqi qoruc sâcne mi bâfua‐ŋareocmu me, mamanasiŋ gogoroŋ ŋoŋe?
Irec ŋoŋe mu mezac ehuc ʒiŋuc boc mi munʒepieŋ: ‘Wemo wiac ba nâc enaŋmu, wemo wiac rojunaŋmu?’
I qâpuc jaŋe hâcne maŋ mamanasu‐jeŋic ira duckepie foekac. Ŋoŋe wiac i tâmiric sâcne mi juniŋmu, i sambâŋ Mamac‐ŋeŋiczi manaekac.
Ŋoŋe ere sambâŋ miti â ere tiŋke biaŋ hata ira maŋ mamanasu‐ŋeŋic qanaŋ râepie fozejec, eme fainao wiac gâcne sasawa i wâc fua‐ŋareocmu.
Ŋoŋe tomâckore harac huacbuc mi enʒepieŋ. Tomâckore harac huacbuc i tomâckore biŋe. Ʒoaŋ gie bapa sâc ʒâic‐ticnezi jahacne biŋe fome sâckeocmu.
“Ŋoŋe ŋic okacne dâŋ mi mutara‐jarenʒepieŋ, eme Anutuzi ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha okacne dâŋ mi mutara‐ŋareocmu.
Ŋoŋe ŋic okacne dâŋ mutara‐jareniŋmu sâc ijaha Anutuzi ŋoŋe mutara‐ŋareocmu, â ŋic wiac ejareniŋmu sâc ijaha Anutuzi bârisie‐ŋareocmu.
Go wemocte âgogere ʒâŋeo gâc i honehuc gahacne ʒâŋeo jâcdâkâ fokac ine mi hone taraekomec?
Jâcdâkâ gahacne ʒâŋeo foipiehame go weniŋuc âgoge ʒiŋuc âzâcnetec sâckeocmu: ‘Go manahaŋ ʒâŋegao gâc fokac rogarepe.’
Burecŋic, go gahacne ʒâŋeo jâcdâkâ fokac i qanaŋ rorâ ie ʒâhec hone tarahuc âgogere ʒâŋeo gâc rotec sâckeocmu.
Ŋoŋe mitire wiac i qâto mi qikiŋne‐jarenʒepieŋ â boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ‐ŋeŋic i bec mi behe‐jarenʒepieŋ. Jaŋe wiac iŋucne mâc kikezi âterâ izia fotikierâ ŋaŋacne ki qâsuc eŋarenʒipiŋkohec.
“Numuku wiac roniŋmu, basaku fârine bâfuaniŋmu, motâcko heickepie roŋarezo.
Numuekaczi wiac roekac, basaekaczi fârine bâfuaekac, heickeekac e motâc aŋkecneekac.
Me ŋoŋeraonec mo ŋic e ŋokâ‐ticnezi poroŋte âzâcneme qorac râcneocmu?
Me qowire âzâcneme ɋâsu râcneocmu?
Aricne, ŋoŋe ŋic hehesicne iŋucnezi naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic nânâ mafa biaŋne jare gumec eeŋgopieŋ. Ehame Mamac‐ŋeŋic sambâŋko e sâc moczi ŋic ŋoŋe numucnepie wiac sâcne ŋare tahac mi eocmu me?
Ŋoŋe ŋic jaŋe wiac eŋareniŋte manasueŋgopieŋ, sâc ijaha wâc jaŋe ejarenʒepieŋ. Izi hâcne sâcmutâc dâŋqâhâc â porofete jaŋere dâŋ qâhâckekac.
“Ŋoŋe motâc fâŋfâŋnao sambâŋko raʒinʒepieŋ. Sisipiric hae irec motâc i kâcɋene â irec hata i sokawec. Ira hâcne ŋic bocjahazi raeŋgopieŋ.
Juju hae irec motâc ine fâŋfâŋne â irec hata i gâŋgâŋne. Eme ŋic afecne maczi i bâfuaeŋgopieŋ.
“Mitiŋic burec burec sahac‐jeŋic lama sahac â maŋjeŋic qâtomaŋ, momori jâmbâŋ, iŋucne jaŋere ruc bahuc junʒepieŋ.
Miti fârine‐jeŋicte ʒâŋitac‐jopaniŋmu. Safeo suc fârine fuame rozo? Me ʒaqeŋko saŋ fârine fuame rozo?
Aricne, jâc biaŋnao fârine biaŋne fuaekac, jâc sâqocnao fârine sâqocne fuaekac.
Jâc biaŋnao fârine sâqocne fufua i mi fokac, â jâc sâqocnao fârine biaŋne fufua i wâc mi fokac.
Irec jâc moc e fârine biaŋne mi fuame qâtâcnerâ ʒocko behezo.
No irec hâcne mupac: Miti fârine‐jeŋicte ʒâŋitac‐jopaniŋmu.
‘Wofuŋ‐nane, Wofuŋ‐nane’ munareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe furu jaha sambâŋte uucmaŋko mi raʒiniŋmu. Mamac‐nane sambâŋko ere mic reŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe sawa raʒiniŋmu.
Ŋic bocjahazi dameŋ sâkoo ʒiŋuc nazanʒoŋgopieŋ: ‘Wofuŋ‐nâŋec, hâc, nâŋe gore micte ŋic miti mi jazambeŋ? Me gore micte demoŋ mi jâpe‐jarembeŋ? Me gore micte gie sâko mi bambeŋ?’
Iŋuc mupie no kecʒiŋuc jazazokopac: ‘No moc mi manac‐ŋopakopac. Wise tâmireniŋ, sâqocne bapa ŋoŋe.’
“Ŋic moczi dâŋnane kecʒi manarâ reŋkeocmu, e ŋic mamana tara‐ticnehec iŋucne, ŋic moczi ficticne tikitoŋko bawec e iŋucne.
Bame ŋehame hoe mâŋâŋ sâko fisirâ fic bâipieme qiŋ herâ ŋewec. Tikitoŋko bakicnere sanaŋkerâ ŋewec hâcne.
Â ŋic moczi dâŋnane kecʒi manarâ qikiŋneocmu, e ine ŋic mutucne iŋucne, ŋic mutucne moczi ficticne opâ moŋgeŋko bawec e iŋucne.
Bame ŋehame hoe micsâko heme opâ rumi hâhâwicne fisirâ fic âeckeku âke rândiŋkerâ âkenʒaŋne‐fârewec.”
Jesuzi dâŋ kecʒi muku mufâreme ŋic jaŋe miti mumu‐ticnere mana warec ehuc bipic tara‐jarewec.
E runezi miti bâutuckehuc jazawec, miti qaqazu siric‐jopahuc sâc moc muwec.
Jesuzi tikionec wahahame ŋic ŋokac guru sâkozi bâjâpembiŋ.
Ehame ŋic moc wicsanaŋhec eki maŋfuŋ‐ticnao rarâ fodaperâ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋ, go tâpirige fokacte wicnane bâsomiezo murâ sâcne bâsomie‐narecmu.”
Mume Jesuzi meticne sicnerâ sahac‐ticne bâuahuc muwec, “I mana‐garekopacte wicge somieoc.” Mume izia wicticne somieme sahacne biaŋke‐fârewec.
Jesuzi iŋuc ecnerâ muwec, “Go irec biŋe ŋic moc mi jazazemec, ra sahacge taha bapa jâututec honezejec. Ehuc Mosere micdâŋko bâzi riketec wiac fuajec irec fuŋne mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Eme Jesuzi Kafanaum haeo ra fehame momori soŋaŋ moczi erao fisirâ wâsickehuc ʒiŋuc muwec:
“Wofuŋ, kiŋaŋ motec‐nane ʒâic ŋemâcne ecneme puriŋ erâ fokac.”
Mume âzâcnewec, “Noni fârâ bâpiaŋkepemu.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme momori soŋaŋzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Wofuŋ, no ŋic wemo biaŋnere nore ficko fâcmu, go ʒira juhuc dâŋ sawa mutec motec‐nane biaŋkeocmu.
No fekicne jaŋere kiŋaŋ qaqa, â nore wahamicne momorifâc‐nane juŋgopieŋ wâc. Eme jaŋeraonec moc ‘rac’ mupe raocmu, moc ‘warec’ mupe wareocmu, â kiŋaŋ motec‐nane ‘gie i bac’ mupe baocmu.”
Mume Jesuzi dâŋ i manarâ seckehuc, bâjâpembiŋ jaŋe jaza muwec, “No jâmbomac ŋazape, Israe ŋic ŋoŋerao mamanasiŋ sâc iŋucne mi bâfuaekopac.
Irec ʒiŋuc ŋazakopac: Ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec â huhunaonec ŋic bocjahazi fisirâ Abraham, Isaka â Jakobo jaŋehec sambâŋte uucmaŋko tumaŋnehuc tiwâ bâzi nâ ʒeri eniŋmu.
Ehame sambâŋte mârâc hefârec‐jopakicnezi ine dapâcko hurâ ki oowa ehuc mic kikiaric kiniŋmu.”
Iŋuc murâ momori soŋaŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go rac, mamanasiŋgere fârine fua‐gareoc.” Eme kiŋaŋ motec‐ticne dameŋ ijaha jâmbâŋ biaŋkewec.
Eme Jesuzi Petorore ficko ferâ safeŋ‐ticne huc ʒocnehec fome honewec.
Honerâ menao bame huc âke niniŋkewec. Eme ŋokac e faharerâ Jesu nânâ rike gumec ecnewec.
Ehame hae owâeme ŋic ŋokac demoŋhec bocjaha bacjopa fisimbiŋ. Eme Jesuzi demoŋ‐jeŋic micticnezi jâpec‐jopawec erâ ŋic gâcne huc ʒâic‐jeŋic bâmâteŋke‐fârewec.
Iŋuc eme porofete Jesajazi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkewec i sanaŋkewec: “E dodocne‐nâŋec nâwoc rowec â hucnâŋec âsickewec.”
Ŋic ŋokac bocjahazi Jesurao fisi orâŋkepie honec‐joparâ motecfâc‐ticne riqic ocniŋucnao wokecke raniŋte jazawec.
Eme razo ehapie miti qaqazu moczi maŋfuŋnao rarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Qaqazu, go ira me ira razo mutecne no bâjâpecgupemu.”
Mume Jesuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Qowi jaŋe hawec‐jeŋichec â sawa wipe jaŋe sareŋ‐jeŋichec, Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e ine fofo roŋgâŋ basaekac.”
Eme qâjâpecfâcne jaŋeraonec moczi âzâcnewec, “Wofuŋ, manatecne qanaŋ rarâ mamac‐nane duckerâ warezepac.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go bâjâpecnuhaŋtec qâŋɋâŋzia qâŋɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic ducjopanʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ wokeo feme motecfâcne jaŋe fepie rambiŋ.
Rahapie onʒoŋ jaha mâŋâŋ hâhâwicne fisirâ qame riqic sâqoreme sirizi wokemaŋko huwec. Ehame Jesu e guŋ fowec.
Eme motecfâcne jaŋe ra wiwickerâ âzâcnembiŋ, “Wofuŋ, ŋezic‐nâpoc, opâo huzo eŋgopeneŋ.”
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Mamanasiŋ gogoroŋ, ŋoŋe wemocte maŋŋeŋic biac betaŋkekac?” Iŋuc jazarâ faharerâ mâŋâŋ â riqic muac‐jofame benoŋ bawec.
Eme ŋic jaŋe i honerâ bipic‐jeŋic tarame mumbiŋ, “E ŋic mo iŋucne, irec mâŋâŋ â riqic jahe dâŋticne reŋkekopirec?”
Eme riqic fotâcnerâ ocniŋucnao Gadara ŋic jaŋere mâreŋko ra fisiwec. Fisime ŋic jajahec domoŋ‐jekichec ware e bâfuapic. Jahe ʒâŋeruŋ gieonec warerâ momori jâmbâŋ epire ŋic jaŋe hâwic‐jopame ira sicne fotâc mi embiŋ.
Eme jahe mi owackehuc ʒiŋuc muzepirec i: “Go Anuture Ŋokâzi weniŋuc enâctecmurâ warekomec? Go dameŋ mi maickeha ʒâic gie nâctezo mukomec me?”
Eme taicko bec guru sâko qondaŋko jumbiŋ.
Eme irec demoŋ jaŋe Jesu kecʒiŋuc muhuc numucnembiŋ: “Jâpec‐nâpozo murâ sorec‐nâpotec becmaŋko raʒinaŋ.”
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ajoc, wiseniŋ!” Eme jaŋe ŋic jahere maŋkonec wefurâ becmaŋko raʒimbiŋ. Raʒipie bec jaŋe mi heâŋko sururuerâ hurâ juwic riqic ŋewec ira hurâ hâmo‐fârenʒepieŋ i!
Eme soŋaŋ jaŋe wiserâ haeo ferâ bec jaŋere binaŋ â ŋic demoŋ‐jekichec jahere binaŋ ŋic mâmâc bajarembiŋ.
Bajarepie izia ŋic ŋokac mâmâc sasawa jaŋe Jesu honeniŋte haeonec wahambiŋ. Waha honerâ mâreŋ‐jeŋic beheocte mu hezuc ecnembiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi wokeo ferâ riqic mocwâc fotâcne warerâ e jahacne haeo fisiwec.
Fisime ŋic ʒeke puriŋ moc kanʒeo reŋke warembiŋ. Eme Jesuzi mamanasiŋ‐jeŋicte fuŋne honerâ ʒeke puriŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Motec‐nane, mi hâwicguoc, sâqocnege mutâmire‐garekicne.”
Iŋuc mume miti qaqazu gâcne maŋjeŋiczi kecʒiŋuc manasumbiŋ: “E Anutu âkehockekac.”
Eme Jesuzi maŋjeŋic hone tararâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Maŋŋeŋiczi wemocte dâŋ sâqocne manasuŋgopieŋ?
Wenimoizi afecne, ŋic ʒeke puriŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnezo: ‘Sâqocnege mutâmire‐garekicne,’ me ʒiŋuc âzâcnezo: ‘Fofoge hâporâ rac!’
Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e mâreŋko sâqocne bâbâtâmire gie baocte tâpiri focnekac irec fuŋne hone taraniŋ.” Iŋuc murâ ʒeke puriŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Fahare fofoge ameckerâ haegao rac.”
Mume ŋic e faharerâ hae‐ticnao rawec.
Eme ŋic guru sâko jaŋe i honerâ weaŋkerâ Anutu e tâpiri iŋucne ŋicmeo râewecte muteŋkembiŋ.
Eme Jesu e irecnec raku takesi roro ŋic moc ʒâŋene Mataio e moneŋfic‐ticnao ŋehame honerâ âzâcne muwec, “Go ware bâjâpecnuc.” Âzâcneme faharerâ bâjâpewec.
Eme e Jesu ficticnao nânâ nâocte hefâreme feme takesi roro â sâqocne bapa bocjaha fisirâ Jesu â motecfâcne jaŋehec nânâ mâmâc nâmbiŋ.
Iŋuc epie honec‐joparâ farisaio jaŋe motecfâcne ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Qaqazu‐ŋeŋic e wemocte takesi roro â sâqocne bapa jaŋehec mâmâc ŋehuc nânâ nakac?”
Dâŋ i Jesuzi manarâ jazawec, “Dokta e ɋiɋicne jaŋerao gie mi baekac, huchec jaŋerao baekac.
Ŋoŋe ine rarâ dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac irec fuŋne mana‐hâmonʒepieŋ: ‘No tiwâ bâzi ririkere mâcne, jauŋte enareekac.’ No ine tiŋne hefârec‐jopazore aricne, sâqocne bapa hefârec‐jopazore wahapo.”
Dameŋ ira Johanere motecfâc jaŋe Jesurao fisirâ ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnembiŋ: “Nâŋe â farisaio dameŋ sâc nânâ sowa jueŋgopeneŋ, â gore motecfâc jaŋe ine wemocte sowa tâmiric jueŋgopieŋ?”
Mupie jazawec, “Ŋicwofuŋ e kikefuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋehec juhame weniŋuc busâqoc erâ sowa juniŋmu? Juku ŋicwofuŋ jowac ropie ine sowa juniŋmu.
Mozi ŋaqi raŋɋanao qoruc ɋâricnezi ɋâtâocmu? Aricne, ɋâricnezi raŋɋane fâreme boc sucke tâc ezacte iŋuc mi eeŋgopieŋ.
Me mozi waiŋ ɋâricne ʒopo raŋɋanao qoŋgiŋkeme huocmu? Aricne, waiŋ ɋâricnezi ʒopo raŋɋane âte fâuckeme waiŋ mecne ʒopo mecne sipirickezacte iŋuc mi eeŋgopieŋ. Waiŋ ɋâricnezi ʒopo ɋâricnao hume aakic enicmu.”
Jesu e dâŋ i jazahuc domahame mitire micne moczi erao warerâ maŋfuŋ‐ticnao fodaperâ muwec, “Otâ‐nane miŋecne hâmokac, go jowacgupe ra bâuac, eme ɋâreocmu.”
Iŋuc âzâcnerâ rame Jesu e faharerâ motecfâcne jaŋehec bâjâperâ rambiŋ.
Rahapie ŋokac moc, soc rohuc juhame jara 12 ewec, eki mi Jesu râpefuŋnao ra ŋaqi‐ticne bâuazejec i.
Ehuc maŋnezi ʒiŋuc manasuwec: “Ŋaqi‐ticne sawa bâuarâ biaŋnuocmu.”
Eme Jesuzi fotikierâ erao ʒâŋe fihuc muwec, “Otâ‐mae, mi hâwicguoc, mamanasiŋgere biaŋgukac.” Mume izia ŋokac biaŋkewec.
Eme Jesu e raku soŋaŋte ficko ferâ ki soŋgâŋ fânâŋ manawec.
Manarâ jazawec, “Ŋoŋe hufâreniŋ, naru e mi hâmojec, e mâc guŋ fokac.” Mume gâwiecnembiŋ.
Eme ejareme hufârepie qâŋɋâŋ fowecko raʒirâ naru menao rome faharewec.
Eme irec biŋezi mâreŋ ira qareŋko rafârewec.
Eme Jesu e mâreŋ i beherâ rahame ŋic ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ jajaheczi bâjâpehuc wiwic jaha wiracnerâ mupic, “Go Dawidire ɋâriczi nâhere buge sâqoreoc.”
Eme raku ficko feme maŋfuŋnao rapire indiŋ‐jofarâ muwec, “Ʒâŋe‐ŋekic bâpiaŋkepere tâpiri fonarekac i mana ʒakiekopirec me?” Eme jahe mupic, “Ea, Wofuŋ, mana ʒakiekoperec.”
Iŋuc mupire ʒâŋe‐jekic bâuahuc muwec, “Mamanasiŋ‐ŋekicte fârine fua‐ŋacteoc.”
Mume ʒâŋe fitâcnepic. Eme Jesuzi mic muac ejactehuc ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Manakopirec, ŋohe irec biŋe ŋic moc mi jazapire mananʒepieŋ.”
Eme jahe dâŋ i mana‐bipiehuc rarâ biŋe‐ticne mupire mâreŋ fotâcne qâqâwiric rawec.
Eme jahe raha rahapire biac ŋic moc Jesurao barembiŋ. E demoŋ moczi ecneme nâŋguŋ ewec.
Eme demoŋ jâpecneme ŋic e dâŋ dâŋ ewec. Eme ŋic guru sâko fombiŋ jaŋe wareckerâ mumbiŋ, “Israe mâreŋko mârâc jaha wiac iŋucne moc mi fuame hone jumbeneŋ.”
