Farisaio jaŋe ine Jesure ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Demoŋ jaŋere fekicnezi bafickeme demoŋ jâpe‐jareekac.”
Eme Jesu e iŋuc hâcne ehuc hae kâcɋene piticne mâmâc jufârewec. Ehuc mitificne ficne miti qazu‐jarehuc uucmaŋte Biŋebiaŋ jazahuc juwec â huc wic ʒâic‐jeŋichec bâmâteŋ‐jopa‐fârewec.
Eme ŋic guru sâko honec‐joparâ jaŋere bune sâqorewec. Jaŋe lama soŋaŋ tâmiric juhuc qac qâsoric erâ qarâ suriŋne jueŋgopieŋ iŋuc tinac jumbiŋ hâcne.
Eme irec motecfâc‐ticne kecʒiŋuc jazawec: “Qa roro giezi kâcɋene, gie bapa ŋiczi ine afecne.
Irec ŋoŋe gie rune numucnepie gie bapa ŋic bâfuac‐jopame gie‐ticnao ranʒepieŋ.”
Jesu e motecfâcne 12 ejareme fisipie demoŋ jâpec‐jopaniŋte â huc wic ʒâic fuŋne fuŋne bâmâteŋke‐jareniŋte tâpiri râe‐jarewec.
Aposolo 12 jaŋere ʒâŋe ine ʒiŋuc: Micne Simoŋ, ʒâŋe‐ticne moc Petoro, â ɋaticne Anderea, erâ Jakobo Ʒebedaiore ŋokâ, â ɋaticne Johane.
Erâ Filipo â Batolomaio, erâ Toma â Mataio takesi roro, erâ Jakobo Alifaiore ŋokâ â Tadaio.
Erâ Simoŋ Kananaio â Juda Karioto haeonec, e juku Jesu doc bawec.
Eme motec 12 jaŋe hâcne jaza sorec ehuc muwec, “Ŋoŋe qâpuc mâreŋko mi âtenʒepieŋ â Samaria ŋic jaŋere hae ŋerakac ira mi ranʒepieŋ.
Israe ŋicguruonec lama qâsoriekicne jaŋe sawa iqic‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Rahuc miti ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Sambâŋte uucmaŋzi maic‐ŋopakac.’
Erâ huchec bâgunuc‐jopanʒepieŋ, hâmokicne bâɋârec‐jopanʒepieŋ, wicsanaŋhec bâsomiec‐jopanʒepieŋ â demoŋ jâpe‐jarenʒepieŋ. Erâ wiac furimâc ŋarekicnere furimâc ejarenʒepieŋ.
Moneŋ kâcɋene me piticne moc mi ŋihe amec enʒepieŋ.
He mi rupenʒepieŋ, fârire ŋaqi jajahec mâcne, kikehuhuhec mâcne, gunuhec wâc mâcne, mâc metariŋ junʒepieŋ. Gie bapa ŋic jaŋe wiac furimâc jare gumec ezo.
Hae ira me ira fisirâ qanaŋ haeru fuŋne‐jeŋicte mu wioc enʒepieŋ. Eme mocte manapie sâckeme ere ficko ferâ ijaha ŋeŋe fofo eku ranʒepieŋ.
Ficjeŋicko fehuc ʒiŋuc jazanʒepieŋ: ‘Wama ŋoŋerao fozejec.’
Eme ficrunezi jupie sâckeme dâŋŋeŋic jaŋerao fârinehec ezejec. Jupie mi sâckeme wamadâŋ‐ŋeŋicte fârinezi ŋoŋerao mocwâc risiezejec.
Hae mocko me fic mocko qikiŋ‐ŋopahuc dâŋŋeŋicte takic‐jopame râpec‐joparâ ranʒepieŋ, ehuc kike‐ŋeŋickonec gâc wândoc‐jeŋic âteickepie wahazejec.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Sodom Gomora ŋic okac dameŋko wiac wahakicne ejarehuc hae irec ŋic ine wiac ŋemâcne ejarezo.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, lama kâte qâto jaŋere ŋondeŋko mi sosorec‐jopane i noni ŋoŋe hâcne sorec‐ŋopakopac; irec ŋoŋe homa iŋucne aimuŋ junʒepieŋ, erâ hapâ iŋucne siocmâc junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic jaŋere sawaŋ‐ŋeŋic qahuc junʒepieŋ. Jaŋe dâŋfic‐jeŋicko bacŋopa raniŋmu, â mitific‐jeŋicko kâcbiŋzi ŋopaniŋmu.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, ŋoŋe nore motecfâc juŋgopieŋ irec erâ kia â ŋicwofuŋ jaŋerao bacŋopa rapie dâŋgie baniŋmu. Eme ŋoŋe jaŋere maio â qâpuc jaŋere maio sanaŋkerâ miti mutaniŋkenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe kiarao râec‐ŋopapie dâŋ weniŋuc munaŋmu muhuc mana mezac mi enʒepieŋ. Dameŋ ira dâŋ muniŋte i Mârozi maŋŋeŋicko râeocmu.
Iŋuc eŋareha dâŋ mupie ŋoŋere dâŋ mi eocmu, Mamac‐ŋeŋicte Mâro maŋŋeŋicko juocmu ere dâŋ eocmu.
Eme hahac moczi ɋaticne doc bame qaniŋmu â mamac moczi ŋokâ‐ticne doc bame qaniŋmu â naru motec jaŋe neŋgoc mamacfâc‐jeŋic kisâ ejarehuc doc bacjopapie jopaniŋmu.
Eme ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanere erâ ŋic sasawa jaŋe ŋoŋere manapie aaricnehec eocmu. Eme moc e miti paŋnea barâ domakume dameŋ‐ticne tarame sambâŋ hotâckeocmu.
Eme hae mocko juhapie ŋopa jâpec eŋarepie hae mocko wiserâ ranʒepieŋ. No jâmbomac ŋazape: Israe hae sâc ŋerakac i rakupie mi taraha Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋnezi fisiocmu.
“Moteczi wiʒec‐ticne sisiricke i mi fokac, â kiŋaŋ moteczi bomboŋ‐ticne sisiricke i wâc mi fokac.
Moteczi wiʒec‐ticnere sâc bâfuame sâckeocmu, â kiŋaŋ moteczi bomboŋ‐ticnere sâc bâfuame sâckeocmu jaha. Ficte micne Beezebulu mucnembiŋte garikiŋfâcne wiac iŋucnea fehuc ejareniŋmu.
Irec jaŋere mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec. Wiac soŋsoŋ fokac i foku mi foocmu, i juku bataniŋkezo, â wiac hemackekicne fokac i foku mi foocmu, i juku qaratie‐fârezo.
Noni gâmbuŋko dâŋ ŋazaekopac i guru sâkoo mufuanʒepieŋ, â arec faio ŋazaekopac i hofaoa musokanʒepieŋ.
Sahac‐ŋeŋic sawa qarâ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋic qaniŋte tâpiri basaniŋmu jaŋere mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec, qâqâtâc mecne sahac mecne mâmâc jaha sârockeme hârâcko huocte tâpiri focnekac ere ine hâwic‐ŋopazejec.
Sawa hehetâc wipe e wiac omane, e furine mi bazo, eme Mamac‐ŋeŋiczi mi manaha wemocko moc waha qaocmu.
Â ŋic ŋoŋerao ine qizec susuc‐ŋeŋicte ʒare i wâc mana‐fâreekac.
Irec ŋoŋe hâhâwicmâc junʒepieŋ, ŋoŋe sawa hehetâc mâcne, ŋoŋe ŋic.
“Moc e ŋic jaŋere maio muɋaɋacnuocmu, e noni iŋuc jaha sambâŋ Mamac‐nanere maio muɋaɋackepemu.
Moc e ŋic jaŋere maio mic bacnume e noni iŋuc jaha sambâŋ Mamac‐nanere maio mic bapemu.
Ŋoŋe nore ʒiŋuc mi munʒepieŋ: E wama bâfuaocte wahawec. No wama mâcne, ʒika bâfuapemurâ wahapo.
No ŋic bâfâuc‐jopazore wahapo hâcne, irec mame ŋokâ jahe fâfâuc enicmu â neŋgoc motec jahe fâfâuc enicmu â jojoŋao jahe fâfâuc enicmu.
Â ŋic moc e garikiŋfâc‐ticne jaŋeraoneczi kisâ ecneniŋmu.
Eme moc e neŋgoc mamac maŋjauŋ kâcɋene ejactehuc no piticne enareocmu, e nore biŋe mi juocmu, â moc e naru motecfâcne maŋjauŋ kâcɋene ejarehuc no piticne enareocmu, e nore biŋe wâc mi juocmu.
Â moc e maripoŋ‐ticne mi hâporâ bâjâpecnuocmu, e iŋuc jaha nore biŋe mi juocmu.
Moc e juju‐ticne ro sakac eocmu, e sifuckecneocmu, â moc e nore erâ juju‐ticne qikiŋneocmu, e ine bâfuaocmu.
“Ŋic moc e ŋoŋe hezu hewâneŋ eŋareocmuzi no enareocmu, â no hezu hewâneŋ enareocmuzi sorecnuwec e ecneocmu.
Ŋic moczi porofete moc porofete jukacte hezu hewâneŋ ecneocmu, e porofetere sâc furine roocmu. Â moczi mitiŋic moc mitiŋic jukacte hezu hewâneŋ ecneocmu, e mitiŋicte sâc furine roocmu.
No jâmbomac ŋazape, moczi wahakicne ʒi jaŋeraonec moc mac moc, nore motec jukacte, opâ ɋâricne fia gumec ecneocmu, wiac iŋucne maczi furi tâmiric wâc mi foocmu.”
Jesuzi motecfâcne 12 dâŋ iŋuc jaza qomac ejare‐fârerâ beherâ hae gâcnao miti jaza qazuc eocte rawec.
Eme Johane e kâpâcwâru ficko ŋehuc Kristozi gie bawec irec biŋe manarâ motecfâcne sorec‐jopame jaŋe rarâ
ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnembiŋ: “Ware‐nâreocte mukicne go hâcne me? Me mocte woŋec junʒepeneŋ?”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe risierâ wiac hone manac eŋgopieŋ irec binaŋ bahuc Johane âzâcnenʒepieŋ:
Tiŋtuŋzi ʒâŋe fitâcneŋgopieŋ, puriŋzi hata juŋgopieŋ, wicsanaŋheczi sahac fâsâc eŋgopieŋ, qepoŋzi dâŋ mamana eŋgopieŋ, hâmokicnezi ɋâreŋgopieŋ â waha qaqanezi Biŋebiaŋ manaŋgopieŋ.
Eme moc e mana gâpârehuc qiqikiŋ mi enareocmu, ere manape ʒerine ekac.”
Eme Johanere motecfâc jaŋe risierâ rahapie Jesu e ŋic jumbiŋ jaŋe Johanere ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe mâreŋ tuhuo wemo honeniŋte rambiŋ? Saparac moc mâŋâŋzi batac bawarec eme honeniŋte rambiŋ me?
Me ŋic moc ŋaqi‐ticne eri qaraweŋnehec honeniŋte rambiŋ? Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋic ŋaqi eri qaraweŋnehec jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ ficko juju fofo eeŋgopieŋ.
Me porofete moc honezo rambiŋ? No ŋazape mananiŋ, ŋoŋe ŋic hone jumbieŋ e porofete gâcne jaŋere sâc aricne, e sâc moc.
Ere hâcne dâŋqâreŋ moc kecʒiŋuc fokac: ‘Manakic, no biŋe mumu ŋicnane sorepe fâ maigao fuaocmu, erâ hatage bâʒâwehuc bânie‐gareocmu’.
No jâmbomac ŋazape, ŋokackonec fuakicne gâcne sasawa jaŋeraonec moczi Johane Miti Opâ fufuŋke mi qâhuckekac. Â sambâŋte uucmaŋ fua tâcneme maŋnao wahakicne juocmuzi sifu e qâhuckeocmu.
Johane Miti Opâ fufuŋkezi gie qizeckewec dameŋ ira sambâŋte uucmaŋ fuŋkerâ tâpirihec ŋezurâ fuaweczi fuaekac. Eme ŋic ɋicwânʒâŋ eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe uucmaŋ i rauckeeŋgopieŋ.
Porofete â Mose jaŋe mâmâc sasawa findaŋdâŋ mu qâreŋ ewarekupie Johanerao tarawec.
Eme ŋoŋe dâŋ kecʒi ro maŋ ezo murâ eniŋ: Elia wareocte mukicne i Johane hâcne.
Moc e hazecneheczi dâŋ i manazejec.
“Ŋicguru ʒi weni jaŋehec sâc hecjopape? Jaŋe naru motec iŋucne. Naru motec jaŋe hae ʒoŋao ŋehuc âgofâc‐jeŋic ʒiŋuc jazaeŋgopieŋ:
‘Gae hepene wemocte mi woŋgopieŋ; kimakuc hepene wemocte mi kioŋgopieŋ!’
Johanezi gie‐ticne fuŋkerâ nânâ qowi mi nânâ sowa jume honerâ mumbiŋ, ‘Demoŋzi ecnekac.’
Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋnezi waharâ nânâ qowi nâme honerâ mueŋgopieŋ, ‘Kec, e ŋic nâ âmbâŋne, takesi roro â sâqocne bapa jaŋere âgo.’ Anuture mamana biri e ine fârinehec eme fuŋne‐ticne taniŋkeekac.”
Dameŋ ira Jesuzi hae gâcnao gie bahuc tâpiri‐ticnere fuŋne bataniŋkeme hone‐bipiehuc maŋjeŋic mi bârisiembiŋte dâŋ fuŋkerâ kecʒiŋuc muhuc hanec‐jopawec:
“Jei, Koraziŋ rune, jei, Besaida rune. Ŋoŋerao mâsi hâhâwicne fuawec i Tiro Sidoŋ haeo fuame muzac, jaŋe mârâc jaha ki busâqoc ehuc maŋjeŋic bârisienʒapiŋ.
Irec ine ŋazape mananiŋ: Tiro â Sidoŋ haeonec ŋic jaŋe okac dameŋko katucne bawahahuc ejarezo â ŋoŋe ine katucne bafehuc eŋarezo.
Â Kafanaum rune go sambâŋko bafecguzo me? Aricne, go hârâcko tuŋguzo. Gorao mâsi hâhâwicne fuawec i Sodom haeo fuame muzac, hae i mi sirowehec dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ŋehuc juzac.
Irec ŋazape mananiŋ: Okac dameŋko Sodom haeonec katucne baafeckehuc ejarezo, â go ine katucne bâmâmâckehuc egarezo.”
Dameŋ ira Jesuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Mamac, sambâŋ â mâreŋ irec Wofuŋ, go mamana‐jeŋicte manapie kâcɋene eekac ŋic iŋucne jaŋe mitidâŋge bâsoŋke‐jareekic, â maŋjeŋicte manapie gegecne eekac jaŋe ine mufua‐jareekic, no irec muteŋgukopac.
Mamac, go iŋuc fua raocte manatec biaŋkewec hâcne.
Mamac‐nane e wiac sasawa râe‐nare‐fârewec. Eme irec ŋic moczi Ŋokâre maŋ mi mana taraekac, Mamaczi buc ʒâŋitaekac. Erâ Mamacte maŋ iŋuc jaha ŋic moczi mi mana taraekac, Ŋokâzi buc ʒâŋitaekac, erâ Ŋokâzi ŋic moc Mamacte fuŋne mufuacneme e wâc mana taraocmu.
“Koŋkoŋkehuc jueŋgopieŋ â kiutuc‐ŋopakicne jueŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe mâmâc sasawa norao ware‐fârepie bâgunuc‐ŋopape âke mâteŋ‐ŋopazejec.
No buuruc â maŋhuhuŋ jukopacte warepie nore isic râe‐ŋarepe fuŋne‐nane mana‐hâmonʒepieŋ. Eme qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋic jumana‐hâmozejec.
Nore isic i urucne â nore tagi i afecne.”
Dameŋ ira Jesuzi micne bajareme sabata hombaŋko gie ŋondeŋko rambiŋ. Rahuc motecfâcne jaŋe nânâre hâmorâ padi unuckerâ hândâŋne nâmbiŋ.
Iŋuc epie farisaio ŋic jaŋe i hone manac erâ Jesu âzâcne mumbiŋ, “Manakic, motecfâcge wiac eŋgopieŋ i sabata hombaŋko mi eene.”
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Dawidi â ŋicfâc‐ticne nânâre hâmohuc wiac embiŋ i ŋoŋe wose manac mi eeŋgopieŋ me?
Jaŋe Anuture ufuŋko ferâ poroŋ furu mukicne nâmbiŋ, poroŋ i e â ŋicfâcne jaŋe mi nânâne, taha bapa jaŋe micbuc‐jeŋic nâniŋte mana‐jarekicne.
Me taha bapa jaŋere sâcmutâc dâŋqâhâc fokac i wose manac mi eeŋgopieŋ? Jaŋe sabata hombaŋko taha ufuŋko gie bahuc hombaŋ sipirickepie bahac mi eekac i.
Noni ine ŋazape mananiŋ, mai‐ŋeŋicko domakac e ufuŋ sirickekac.
Dâŋqâreŋ moc ʒiŋuc fokac: ‘No tiwâ bâzi rike‐nareniŋte mâcne, jauŋhec juniŋte enarekac.’ Ŋoŋe dâŋ i manarâ muzac, bahac tâmiric ʒi maŋgâŋ dâŋ mi mujarenʒapiŋ.
Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e ine sabata hombaŋ irec rune jukac wâc.”
Iŋuc murâ irecnec rarâ mitific‐jeŋicko fewec.
Eme ira ŋic moc ŋewec e mene ɋaŋakicne. Eme ŋic jaŋe Jesu wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Ŋic sabata hombaŋko bâpiaŋ‐jopazo me aricne?” Jaŋe kâuc bahuc mâcne, bahac‐ticne moc bâfuarâ dâŋko râeniŋte manasuhuc mumbiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi micjeŋicko rorâ muwec, “Ŋoŋeraonec moczi lama mocjaha macticne sabata hombaŋko nombâŋko hume hombaŋte erâ beheme foocmu me?
Lama e wiac omane, ŋic ŋoŋe ine fârine. Irec sabata hombaŋko eehâmo gie i sâcne bapane.”
Iŋuc murâ ŋic âzâcnewec, “Mege fâretiŋnec.” Mume meticne sicneme biaŋkerâ ŋifecte sâc ewec.
Eme farisaio jaŋe i honerâ rafârerâ Jesu qaniŋte dâŋ mumockembiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi i manarâ hae mâreŋ i beherâ mocko rawec. Eme ŋic bocjahazi bâjâpepie bâpiaŋ‐jopa‐fârewec.
Eme jaŋe ŋic gâcne fuŋne‐ticne mi jazaniŋte mic muac sanaŋne ejarewec.
Iŋuc eme porofete Jesajazi findaŋdâŋ qâreŋkewec i fârinehec ewec, dâŋ kecʒiŋuc:
“Kecʒi kiŋaŋ motec‐nane, no e hâcne rowosâepo. E joroc biaŋ‐nane, ere maŋnane aŋackeekac. No Mâro‐nane ere faio râepe bafickeme qâpuc ŋicne ŋicne fâfâretiŋ dâŋ muromackejareocmu.
E mu hanec me mu owa mi eocmu, marac fânâŋ‐ticne tomao mi fuame mananiŋmu.
Bo paruczi qakicne i mi qâtâcne behec eocmu, â ʒoc kine mi beheme hâpoocmu. Iŋuc ehuc gie tâpiri jaha bakume fâretiŋ dâŋ bâtâcne bâtimuŋ eme maniŋ biaŋ fuaocmu.
Eme qâpuc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe maŋjeŋic ere ʒâŋe biŋeo ɋetickeniŋmu.”
Eme dameŋ ira ŋic moc demoŋzi ecneme tiŋtuŋ â nâŋguŋ ewec e Jesurao barambiŋ. Eme Jesuzi bâpiaŋkeme ŋic e dâŋ dâŋ ewec â ʒâŋe fiwec.
Eme ŋic hâmbâŋ sâko domambiŋ jaŋe i honerâ warecke sâqorerâ mumbiŋ, “Dawidire ɋâric wareocte mukicne ʒine hâcne wiac moc?”
Mupie farisaio jaŋe dâŋ i manarâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Burec, demoŋ jaŋere ŋicbomboŋ ʒâŋene Beezebulu, eki neŋgoc ŋesiŋ ŋecnehame demoŋ jâpec‐jopaekac.”
Eme Jesuzi maŋjeŋicko manarâ jaza muwec, “Mâreŋ moc irec ŋic jaŋe rârâsi kosa epie tuhu fuaocmu. Â hae moc me fic moc irec ŋic jaŋe kikisâ kosa epie hae‐jeŋic tâtieocmu.
Sataŋzia fâuckerâ Sataŋ jâpeme, gie‐ticne weniŋuc sanaŋkerâ foocmu?
Eme no Beezebulu ere neŋgoc ŋesiŋko demoŋ jâpec‐jopaekopacko, ŋaŋacne motecfâc jaŋe more ŋesiŋko demoŋ jâpec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ? Jaŋe hâcne qoqoric‐ŋeŋicte fuŋne bataniŋkeniŋmu.
No ine Anuture Mârozi neŋgoc ŋesiŋ ŋenarehame demoŋ jâpe‐jareekopacko Anuture Wofuŋ qâreŋzi maic‐ŋopakac hâcne.
Me mozi ŋic momori moc ŋeha ficticnao ferâ mafa jâoc roocmu? I aricne. Ŋic momori qanaŋ hâporâ me kikene qarâ ie mafa‐ticne jâoc rozo.
Moc e âgo mi enareocmuzi râsi enareocmu, â moc e gie‐nane hone maiŋ mi eocmuzi hetâtieocmu.
“Irec ŋazape mananiŋ: Sâqocne fuŋne fuŋne â dâŋ gâgâpâcne fuŋne fuŋne irec kiŋ i bebehene fokac, Mâro wiac gâgâpâcne eecne irec kiŋ i bebehene ine mi fokac.
Moc e Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne musoriŋkeocmu, e sâqocne i bâtâmirecnezo, moc e Tiro Mâro musoriŋkeocmu, e ine sâqocne i mâreŋko me sambâŋko mi bâtâmirecnezo.
Ŋoŋe jâc mocte biaŋne muhuc fâri‐ticnere iŋuc jaha biaŋne munʒepieŋ. Me jâc mocte sâqocne muhuc fâri‐ticnere iŋuc jaha sâqocne munʒepieŋ. Jâcte fuŋne fârinezi bataniŋkeekac.
Homare ɋâric, ŋoŋe sâqocnezi wemo dâŋ biaŋne mo muniŋmu? Maŋko wiac foekac ijaha micko wefuekac.
Ŋic biaŋnezi maŋrowaŋ‐ticne biaŋnaonec wiac biaŋne utuocmu, ŋic sâqocnezi maŋrowaŋ‐ticne sâqocnaonec wiac sâqocne utuocmu.
No ŋazape mananiŋ: Dâŋ racne fuŋne fuŋne irec dâŋgie okac dameŋko banʒoŋgopieŋ.
Dâŋ muekic izi fuŋnege bataniŋkeme rocguzo, me dâŋ muekic izi fuŋnege bataniŋkeme behecguzo.”
Iŋuc muhuc jazame miti qaqazu â farisaio tucne jaŋe dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ: “Qaqazu, go fuŋne qaqa mâsi moc batec fuame honenaŋ.”
Mupie jazawec, “Ŋic hehesicne â miti qiqikiŋ iŋucnezi fuŋne qaqa mâsire muŋgopieŋ me? Ŋoŋe mâsi furune moc aricne, porofete Jonarao fuawec ijaha fuame honeniŋmu.
Jona e ŋafe ʒoaŋ jahec â moc qowi sâkore bumaŋko fowec, iŋuc jaha Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋnezi ŋafe ʒoaŋ jahec â moc mâreŋmaŋko foocmu.
Okac dameŋko ine Niniwe haeonec ŋic jaŋe fuarâ ŋicguru ʒi fuŋne‐ŋeŋic ritupie katucne roniŋmu. I mâc mâcne, Niniwe haeonec jaŋe Jonazi uŋ jazame manarâ maŋjeŋic bârisiembiŋ; â ʒi domakac e Jona sirickekac.
Â juwic mâreŋkonec ŋokac wofuŋ e iŋuc jaha okac dameŋko ŋicguru ʒi fuŋne‐ŋeŋic ritume katucne roniŋmu. Erâ i mâc mâcne, ŋokac e Salomoraonec mamana fârine roocte mâreŋ qaŋeŋnaonec warewec; â ʒi domakac e Salomore sâc sirickekac.
“Demoŋzi ŋickonec wefurâ ra tuhuo miti qatarac juhuc ŋeŋe hae‐ticne basaocmu.
Basaku muocmu, ‘Ficnane beherâ warepo ijaha mocwâc risiezepac.’ Murâ risierâ honeocmu: Ru tâmiric, ʒure emasaŋ ekicne.
Iŋuc honerâ ra demoŋ âgofâc‐ticne 7, e jahacne sâc mâcne, repipicne jâmbâŋ iŋucne rocjopame ware fic ijaha ŋeŋe juju eniŋmu. Eme ŋic e mârâc jaha sâsâqocne juweczi ʒâhec sâqoc qaqore sanaŋkeocmu. Ŋicguru repicne ʒi ŋoŋerao iŋuc hâcne fuaocmu.”
Jesu e dâŋ i jazahuc juhame râpefuŋ‐jeŋicko neŋgoc ɋafâcne dâŋ âzâcneniŋte woŋec domambiŋ.
Ehame moczi âzâcnerâ muwec, “Manakic, neŋgoc ɋafâcge dâŋ gazaniŋte râpefuŋ‐nâŋecko woŋec domaŋgopieŋ.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Neŋgoc ɋafâc‐nane weni jaŋe?”
Iŋuc murâ motecfâcne domambiŋkopec mene sicnerâ muwec, “Honec‐jopaniŋ, neŋgoc ɋafâc‐nane ʒi.
Sambâŋ Mamac‐nanere mic reŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne neŋgoc qo ɋafâc‐nane.”
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa ira Jesuzi ficticnaonec waharâ riqic moŋgeŋnao rarâ ŋewec.
Ŋehame ŋic ŋokac guru sâko fisirâ tumaŋnepie honec‐joparâ woke mocko fewec. Eme e wokeo ŋehame ŋic hâmbâŋ sâko jaŋe moŋgeŋko domambiŋ.
Ehame kesaic dâŋ fuŋne fuŋne jazawec. Moc ine kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋic moczi wiac hândâŋne tieocte gieo rawec.
Ra tiehame hândâŋne gâcnezi waha hatao hewec. Ehame wipezi fisirâ nâfârewec.
Â hândâŋne gâcnezi qânâ siecko hewec. Ira mâreŋ faisuc sawa fowecte ââkeʒu i biac âkeʒuwec.
Erâ gâtâne râeme hurâ ine âke ariweme ʒoaŋzi wefurâ qame ururuckerâ hâmowec.
Â hândâŋne gâcnezi hofâ qinʒiŋ ŋondeŋko hewec. Eme âkeʒume hofâ qinʒiŋzi wefurâ hehâmowec.
A hândâŋne gâcnezi ine mâreŋ guecko herâ fârine bocjaha fuawec, jâcne mocte hândâŋne 100, jâcne mocte hândâŋne 60, jâcne mocte hândâŋne 30, iŋuc fuawec.
Moc e hazecneheczi dâŋ kecʒi manazejec.”
Dâŋ iŋuc jazame motecfâcne jaŋe maŋfuŋnao rarâ indiŋke mumbiŋ, “Go wemocte dâŋ suŋsuŋne jazaekomec?”
Eme eki kecʒiŋuc jazawec: “Sambâŋte uucmaŋko raraʒire dâŋ soŋne i ŋoŋe mananiŋte mukicne, gâcne jaŋe ine aricne.
Moc e wiac râcnekicne i bajume kiqecnecnezo, eme mâriri fuacnezejec, â moc e wiac râcnekicne mi bajume jâoc rozo, eme mâc juzejec.
Jaŋe ʒâŋe fiipiehuc wiac mi hone taraeŋgopieŋ, â hazeczi dâŋ mana‐bipiehuc fuŋne mi mana taraeŋgopieŋ, irec kesaic dâŋ jazaekopac.
Eme Jesajare findaŋdâŋ fokac i deŋkeekac, dâŋ kecʒiŋuc: ‘Hazeczi mamana i mananiŋmu, maŋzi mamana tara ine mi eniŋmu. Ʒâŋezi fifi i finiŋmu, wiac hohone tara ine mi eniŋmu.
Ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe maŋjeŋic sanaŋkekicne, â hazec‐jeŋic bâzickekicne, â ʒâŋe‐jeŋic hâmonʒambiŋ. Irec ʒâŋe‐jeŋiczi wiac mi hone taraeŋgopieŋ, â hazec‐jeŋiczi wiac mi mana taraeŋgopieŋ, â maŋjeŋiczi wiac mi manasu‐hâmoeŋgopieŋ, ehuc maŋjeŋic mi bârisiepie no wemocko bâpiaŋ‐jopazapo.’
Ŋoŋe ine ʒâŋe fifi â hazec rârâe jueŋgopieŋte ŋoŋere manape ʒerine ekac.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Porofete â mitiŋic bocjaha jaŋe ŋoŋe wiac hone manac eeŋgopieŋ i hone manac eniŋte ejare‐bipiehame sifu mi hone manac embiŋ.
“Eme ʒi hândâŋ titie dâŋ ŋazapac irec fuŋne mufua‐ŋarepe mananiŋ:
Ŋic moc miti manarâ maŋko mi bajuocmu, erao sâqocne runezi fisirâ maŋticnao hândâŋ tiekicne i ro bawiseekac. Ŋic e hâcne hatao hândâŋne hewec irec sâc.
Â qânâ siecko hewec sâc iŋucne juocmuzi miti manarâ izia aŋackeme maŋke juocmu.
Maŋticnao gâtâ mi bakicnere ine dameŋ bembeŋne sawa domaocmu. Izi fific guguriŋ â ʒika kâpâcwâru fuame rândiŋkeocmu.
Â hofâ qinʒiŋko hewec sâc iŋucne juocmuzi ine miti mamana i manaocmu. Erâ sahackopec wiac irec mamaŋ gugutuŋ juha moneŋ mafa mâriri irec aŋaczi eatuckehuc miti hehâmome fârimâc eocmu.
Mâreŋ guecko hewec sâc iŋucne juocmuzi ine miti manarâ maŋko bajuocmu. Eme moctao fârine 100, moctao 60, moctao 30, iŋuc fuaekac.”
Eme kesaic dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc muhuc jazawec: “Sambâŋte miti hata i ŋic moczi gie‐ticnao padi hândâŋne biaŋne râewec ehec sâc hepe.
Hândâŋne râerâ raha ŋic guŋ fofârehapie râsi‐ticnezi fisirâ padi ŋondeŋnao hofâ hândâŋ tierâ rucnewec.
Eme padi âkeʒurâ fârine fuazo ehame hofâ mâmâc wefuwec.
Eme kiŋaŋ motec jaŋe i honerâ gie rune âzâcne mumbiŋ, ‘Bomboŋ‐nâŋec, go giegao hândâŋ biaŋne sasawa râemeŋ, ehame hofâ wenirec fuakac?’
Wiocnepie muwec, ‘I râsi moczi tieme fuawec.’ Mume wiocnembiŋ, ‘Eme weniŋuc, ra unuckerâ behenaŋ me?’
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: ‘Aricne, ŋoŋe hofâ unuckehuc padi mâmâc unuckenʒipiŋkohec.
Padi â hofâ furu fohuc mâmâc fuazejec. Eme padi qaqa dameŋ maickeme gie bapa ŋic jazape jaŋe qanaŋ hofâ bâwosâerâ dâtâckerâ ʒocko rikenʒepieŋ â padi ine ficnaneo ropie fezejec.’”
Eme kesaic dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc muhuc jazawec: “Sambâŋte kikefuŋ e nemuja hândâŋ iŋucne. Ŋic moczi hândâŋ i hâcne jufu‐ticnao râewec.
Hândâŋ i piticne, jâchândâŋ gâcne irec wahamicne. Fua sokac erâ ine wiac nâkicne gâcne jowarurâ jâc eekac. Eme sawa wipe jaŋe fisirâ tieŋnao herâ ŋeeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme kesaic dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc jazawec: “Sambâŋ miti e hâmu goreŋne iŋucne. Ŋokac moczi hâmu goreŋne nânâ oto jahec â moc ihec bâsifuckeme isiricke‐fâreme aŋacnehec ewec.”
Jesuzi ŋic dâŋ jazawec i suŋsuŋne sasawa jazawec, dâŋ mai mi mutaniŋkerâ jazawec.
Iŋuc eme porofete moczi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec i sanaŋkewec: “Micnaneo kesaic dâŋ sasawa fuame mupemu, dâŋsoŋ mâreŋ fuaweckonecteaŋ fowarehuc juwec sanaŋ i hâcne mufuapemu.”
Eme Jesuzi ŋic râec‐jopame rahapie ficticnao fewec. Ferâ juhame motecfâcne jaŋe iqickerâ âzâcne mumbiŋ, “Go padi gieo hofâ fuawec kesaic dâŋ irec fuŋne mutec mananaŋ.”
Wiocnepie jazawec, “Ŋic hândâŋ biaŋ râeekac i Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne eki.
Gie ine mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ. Hândâŋ biaŋ ine mitire fuŋfuŋfâc.
Hofâ i sâqocne runere fuŋfuŋfâc. Râsi hofâ hândâŋ tiewec ine Sataŋ. Padi qa roro dameŋ ine dameŋ sâko. Gie bapa ine aŋelo jaŋe.
Hofâ unuckerâ ʒocko rikeeŋgopieŋ iŋuc hâcne dameŋ sâkoo fuazokac.
Ira Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋnezi aŋelofâc‐ticne sorec‐jopame mâreŋ sâc gurufâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec ŋic sâqocne bâbâiŋ â miti ima qaqa
i qânusuc‐joparâ ʒocsanaŋko behec‐jopapie huniŋmu. Ira ki oowa ehuc mic kikiaric kiniŋmu.
Â biaŋkekicne jaŋe Mamac‐jeŋicte uucmaŋko ʒoaŋ tatamac iŋucne tamaeniŋmu. Hazecneheczi dâŋ kecʒi manazejec.
“Sambâŋte miti hata i kecʒiŋuc: Boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ moc jufu gie mocko duo fowec. Eme ŋic moczi i bâfuarâ seucko râewec. Erâ bubiaŋ sâko manahuc wiac focnewec sasawa i ŋic qikiŋne‐jareme moneŋ râcnepie ra jufu i furine bawec.
“Erâ sambâŋte miti hata i kecʒiŋuc wâc: Ŋic moc e ʒuŋe gâpiŋte babasa gie bawec.
Baku ʒuŋe gâpiŋ moc micne kizukicne biaŋ bâfuarâ bec wiac‐ticne sasawa ʒuŋe rune qikiŋnecneme ʒuŋe gâpiŋ ere ewec.
“Sambâŋte kikefuŋ e wasaŋ iŋucne. Ŋic jaŋe wasaŋ hâwecko behepie hume qowi fuŋne fuŋne jowawec.
Fusucmame tiŋko fârepie feme qowi bâtâc bahuc nânâne i oto gombao ropie huwec â mi nânâne ine behepie rawec.
Mâreŋ dameŋne tarame iŋuc hâcne fuazokac. Ira aŋelo jaŋe mâreŋne mâreŋne rarâ ŋic biaŋkekicne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec ŋic sâqocne rowosâec‐joparâ
ʒocsanaŋko tuŋjopapie huniŋmu. Ira ki oowa ehuc mic kikiaric kihuc juniŋmu.”
Iŋuc murâ wio‐jarewec, “Ŋoŋe i sasawa mana taraŋgopieŋ me?” Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Mana taraŋgopeneŋ.”
Mupie jazawec, “Ine hâcne, miti qaqazu moczi sambâŋte miti hatare fuŋne manaekac, e ficte micne iŋucne erâ rowaŋ‐ticnaonec wiac fuŋne fuŋne, raŋɋane â ɋâricne, utu guruc eocmu.”
Jesu e kesaic dâŋ fuŋne fuŋne muku mufârerâ hae mâreŋ i beherâ rawec.
Erâ haefuŋ‐ticnao fisirâ mitificko ferâ miti qazu‐jareme ŋic jaŋe wareckerâ mumbiŋ, “Mamana sâko â mâsi sâko bapa i wenirec bâfuawec?
Nâŋâc fuŋne‐ticne manaŋgopeneŋ, e kapentare ŋokâ, neŋgoc‐ticne ʒâŋene Maria, â ɋafâc‐ticne ʒâŋe‐jeŋic Jakobo â Josefe â Simoŋ â Juda.
Erâ seŋfâc‐ticne nâŋâcnehec mâmâc juŋgopieŋ. Eme e wiac sasawa i wenirec bâfuawec?”
Iŋuc murâ quŋkecnehuc mana pitiwambiŋ. Eme Jesuzi jazawec, “Porofete moc e ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne hae mâreŋ gâcnao haŋ bahame haefâcne â fuŋfuŋfâcne jaŋe ine qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme hae irec ŋic jaŋe maŋjeŋic sakarembiŋte Jesuzi jaŋerao mâsi bocjaha mi bawec.
Dameŋ ira ŋicwofuŋ Herode eki Jesure biŋe manawec. Manarâ motecfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“I Johane Miti Opâ fufuŋke, eki hâmockonec ɋârerâ faharewecte tâpiri sâkohec jukac.”
Dâŋ i mâc mi muwec. Herode e juwicnao ɋaticne Filipo ere ŋonâŋ rowec, ʒâŋene Herodia, ŋokac ere erâ Johane me kikene qarâ kâpâcwâru ficko râewec.
Ine Johanezi dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcne jujec irec: “Go ŋokac e bameŋ i bahac ekac.”
Erâ Herodezi Johane qaocte manasuwec wâc. Mâc ŋic jaŋe Johane porofete mucnembiŋte jaŋere hâwickeme behewec.
Ehame Herode fufua dameŋ‐ticne maickeme ŋic fekicne jaŋe fisirâ erao tumaŋnerâ ŋehapie Herodia otâ‐ticnezi jaŋere maio gae wome Herodezi honeme aŋacne eme
kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No Anuture maio mupaŋkekopac, go irec me irec egareme mutec garepemu.”
Eme naru e neŋgocnezi qafeŋkeme ʒiŋuc muwec: “Go Johane Miti Opâ fufuŋke ere qizec râqâcko râerâ ʒiŋuczia narec.”
Iŋuc mume ŋicwofuŋ e fâfârerâ hemâtâckewec. Erâ Anuture maio mupaŋkewecte â ŋic ŋembiŋ jaŋerao dâŋticne wahazacte
sifu manacnerâ mume kiŋaŋ motec jaŋe rarâ Johane kâpâcwâru ficko upene qâtâcnerâ
qizecne râqâcko râepie hume barerâ naru râcnembiŋ. Eme naruzi neŋgoc‐ticne râcnewec.
Eme Johane qapie hâmome motecfâcne fisirâ qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne rorâ duckembiŋ. Duckerâ ra Jesu dâŋ binaŋ ecnembiŋ.
Jesu e Johanere biŋe manarâ mâreŋ i beherâ woke mocko ferâ mâreŋ tuhuo bucko juocte rawec. Rahame ŋic jaŋe biŋe manarâ haene haene hâmbâŋ sâko tiŋko raku ijaha fisimbiŋ.
Eme wokeonec waharâ ŋic guru sâko honec‐joparâ bune sâqoreme huchecfâc‐jeŋic ɋiɋic bacjopawec.
Iŋuc ehuc juhame hae owâeme motecfâc‐ticne jaŋe âzâcnerâ mumbiŋ, “Ʒi tuhuo juhapene hae owâekac, irec ŋic râec‐jopatec hae sâc rarâ nânâ bâfuanʒepieŋ.”
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wemocte raniŋte mujareŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe nânâ gumec‐jopaniŋ me.”
Jazame mumbiŋ, “Nâŋe ʒi poroŋ memoc â opâ qowi jajahec i mac sawa bajuŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme eki ʒiŋuc jazawec: “I norao bareniŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ ŋic ejareme kecɋaŋ gieo toma âterâ ŋembiŋ. Eme poroŋ memoc â opâ qowi jajahec rorâ sambâŋko fime feha mumuteŋ dâŋ muwec. Murâ bazurâ motecfâcne jareme jaŋe bârâwiŋnehuc ŋic jarembiŋ.
Eme jaŋe sasawa nâ gapec embiŋ. Ehame tiwâne ŋerawec i ropie hurâ sasac 12 fusewec.
Â nânâ qowi nâmbiŋ ŋic i jaŋere ʒare 5 tauseŋ, ŋokac naru motec mi wosec‐jopakicne.
Iŋuc erâ izia Jesuzi motecfâcne esoc‐jopame wokeo buc ferâ bâniecnehuc riqic ocniŋucnao risieniŋte rambiŋ.
Eme ŋic ŋokac râec‐jopame rafârepie e gâmbuŋ‐ticne tikio ferâ nunumu gie bawec. Iŋuc ehuc juhame hae ŋafeme e jahackoaŋ ira juhuc juwec.
Ehame wokezi raku riqic ʒâʒâŋiŋko fisiwec. Eme mâŋâŋ e rambiŋkopecnec warewecte siri kâcɋene qahuc woke bafe bâriŋ ecneme foicke‐bipiembiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi ŋafe furec hehe‐jekicko riqic âte âte raku bâqiŋ‐jopawec.
Iŋuc rahame motec jaŋe honerâ hâbi‐jeŋic goroŋkeme, “Bawe warekac” muhuc owackembiŋ.
Owackepie mu bâmiriŋ ejarehuc jazawec, “Buŋeŋic mâteŋkeoc, ʒi no nahac fâkopac, mi hâwic‐ŋopaoc.”
Mume Petorozi micnao rorâ muwec, “Wofuŋ, go gahac warekomecko mutec opâ faio gorao fâpe.”
Eme Jesuzi muwec, “Warec”. Mume Petorozi wokeonec waharâ opâ faio Jesuraopec rawec.
Rahuc mâŋâŋ sâko qame honerâ hâwickeme huzo ehuc Jesu wâsickehuc muwec, “Wofuŋ go rocnuc.”
Mume izia Jesuzi menao rohuc muwec, “Mamanasiŋ gogoroŋ go, wemocte maŋjahec ekomec?”
Iŋuc muhuc rome wokeo fepire mâŋâŋ niniŋkewec.
Eme wokeo ŋembiŋ ŋic i jaŋe Jesure maŋfuŋko fodapehuc mumbiŋ, “Go jâmbomac Anuture Ŋokâ.”
Eme riqic fotâcnerâ Genesarete mâreŋko moŋgeŋko fepie
ŋic jaŋe Jesu ʒâŋitarâ mupie hae rârec rârec rame ŋic jaŋe huchecfâc‐jeŋic amec‐jopa fisimbiŋ.
Eme jaŋe Jesu ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Manatec ŋaqige qaŋeŋnao barâ huc âke niniŋ‐nâpozejec.” Eme iŋuc embiŋ jaŋe ɋiɋic qafârembiŋ.
Dameŋ ira Jerusalem haeonec farisaio â miti qaqazu gâcne Jesurao fisirâ wiocnerâ mumbiŋ,
“Motecfâcge jaŋe wemocte kâcɋenefâc‐nâŋec jaŋere sâcmutâc dâŋ qâhuckeeŋgopieŋ? Ehuc nânâ nâniŋte mejeŋic mi ʒuʒure mâc nâeŋgopieŋ.”
Wiocnepie Jesuzi jazawec, “Â ŋoŋe ine wemocte ŋaŋacne sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkehuc Anutu e jahacne micdâŋ âke sipueŋgopieŋ?
Anuture dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac: ‘Go neŋgoc mamac jahecge sâsec‐jofazemec.’ Erâ moc ʒiŋuc: ‘Moc e neŋgoc mamac jahecne sâwecdâŋ jasaocmu e mi juzejec.’
Ŋoŋe ine ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Moc e neŋgoc me mamac‐ticne âzâcneocmu: Wiac go garehuc dopecguzapo i Anutu taha bacnepemu; e sâcne iŋuc ehuc mi sâsec‐jofazejec.
Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc Anuture dâŋ bâsuepie raha ŋaŋacne dâŋ heʒakiepie foekac.
Burecŋic ŋoŋere Jesajazi findaŋdâŋ kecʒiŋuc sâcne muwec:
‘Ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe micbipiczi sâsecnuhuc maŋjeŋiczi ine qikiŋnueŋgopieŋ.
Erâ dâŋ fârinere okacne ŋicdâŋ mu qaqazuc ehuc no mai enarepie honepe racne eekac.’”
Jesu e iŋuc jazarâ ŋic gâcne hefârec‐jopame fisipie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No dâŋ ŋazape manahuc mana taraniŋ:
Micŋeŋicko wiac raʒiekac izi mi hegâpârec‐ŋopaekac, micŋeŋickonec wiac wefuekac izi ine hegâpârec‐ŋopaekac.”
Iŋuc mume motecfâcne jaŋe jurâ jurâ maŋfuŋnao rarâ âzâcne mumbiŋ, “Go farisaio dâŋ jazatec mana gâpârembieŋ i manakic?”
Mupie jazawec “Jâc sasawa sambâŋ Mamac‐nanezi mi sarawec i unucke behec ezo.
Ŋoŋe mâc behec‐jopaniŋ, jaŋe tiŋtuŋzi tiŋtuŋ jaŋere hata bâbânie. Ŋic tiŋtuŋ jajaheczi jojowac enicmu, ine qâsorierâ serec jaha hârâcko hunicmu i.”
Eme Petorozi kecʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Go dâŋ suŋsuŋne nâzâmec, irec fuŋne ritutec mananaŋ.”
Mume Jesuzi muwec, “Hâc, ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha maŋ mamanasu tâmiric jueŋgopieŋ?
Fuŋne kecʒiŋuc mi manaŋgopieŋ: Miczi wiac nâpie buŋeŋicko hume getâckeme mocwâc hata‐ticnao wahaekac.
Â micŋeŋickonec wiac wahaekac ine maŋkonec, izi hâcne hegâpârec‐ŋopaekac.
Ŋicmaŋkonec wiac wefuekac ine mamanasu sâqocne, ʒika, boe sau, sasec, fiuc, burec, dâŋ gâgâpâcne.
Wiac iŋucnezi hegâpârec‐ŋopaekac. Â me mi ʒurehuc wiac nânâ izi mi hegâpârec‐ŋopaekac.”
Eme Jesu e mâreŋ i beherâ Tiro â Sidoŋ hae ŋepicko rawec.
Ra juhame Kanaaŋ ŋic qâpuc jaŋeraonec ŋokac moczi warerâ Jesu wira wâwâsic ecnehuc muwec, “Wofuŋ, go Dawidire ɋâriczi nore mac buge sâqoreoc me. Otâ‐nane e demoŋzi mâretec ecneekac.”
Iŋuc mume Jesuzi manarâ dâŋ moc mi bâtikiecnewec. Iŋuc eme motecfâc‐ticne jaŋe âzâcne mumbiŋ, “Go ŋokac soretec raoc, e râpefuŋ‐nâŋecko wira oowa warekac.”
Mupie jazawec, “No Israe ŋicguru lama iŋucne qâsoriekicne, jaŋerao sawa sorecnukicne.”
Muhame ŋokac e maŋfuŋnao fisirâ fodaperâ numucnehuc muwec, “Wofuŋ, go sifu mac baficnuc.”
Iŋuc mume ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Naru motec nânâ‐jeŋic jowac rorâ qâto gugumec‐jopa i mi sâckeocmu.”
Mume dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Wofuŋ, i sâcne mukic, erâ qâto jaŋe rufâc‐jeŋic jaŋere teboonec huŋgaŋne wahame i sifu mac nâeŋgopieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume âzâcnerâ muwec, “O ŋokac, mamanasiŋge fekicne, mukomec iŋuc egareoc.” Muhame izia otâ‐ticne biaŋkewec.
Eme Jesu e mâreŋ irecnec mocwâc risie wareku Galilaia riqic, ira fisiwec. Fisirâ tikio ferâ ŋehame
ŋic gurune gurune erao fisimbiŋ. Jaŋe ŋic sahac‐jeŋic ɋaŋakicne â tiŋtuŋ â ʒeke puriŋ â nâŋguŋ â huc ʒâichec amec‐jopa fisirâ Jesure maŋfuŋko guruc‐jopapie bâpiaŋ‐jopa‐fârewec.
Eme nâŋguŋzi dâŋ dâŋ embiŋ â puriŋzi hata juju embiŋ â sahac‐jeŋic ɋaŋakicnezi sanaŋkembiŋ â tiŋtuŋzi ʒâŋe fifi embiŋ. Eme ŋic jaŋe i hone manac erâ boc seckehuc Israe ŋic jaŋere Anutu mumbiaŋkembiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi motecfâcne hefârec‐joparâ jazawec, “No ŋic jaŋere bunane sâqorekac, jaŋe norao ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc juku nânâre hâmoŋgopieŋ. Eme nânâ tâmiric sorec‐jopape rarâ hatao sipirickenʒipiŋte manabâc ekopac.”
Mume motecfâc‐ticne jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ʒi tuhuo poroŋ sâko wenirec bâfuarâ ŋic guru dindiŋ iŋucne gumec‐jopapene nâpie sâcjopaocmu?”
Iŋuc âzâcnepie wio‐jarehuc muwec, “Ŋaŋacne poroŋ wezimuc fokac?” Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Poroŋ 7 â opâ qowi jahec mac.”
Eme manarâ mume ŋic jaŋe qâzuckerâ waha ŋerambiŋ.
Iŋuc epie poroŋ 7 â qowi i rorâ daŋge murâ bazuhuc motec jareme jaŋe kâdoc bahuc ŋic jare rambiŋ.
Jare rapie ŋic jaŋe mâmâc sasawa nâ gapec embiŋ. Eme tiwâne ŋerawec i ro qânusuc epie sasac 7 fusucmawec.
Nânâ nâmbiŋ ŋic i jaŋere ʒare 4 tauseŋ, ŋokac naru motec mi wosec‐jopakicne.
Eme ŋic râec‐jopame rapie e jahacne ine wokeo ferâ raku Magadaŋ mâreŋko fisiwec.
Eme farisaio â sadukaio ŋic jaŋe Jesurao fisirâ mu esâic ecnehuc mumbiŋ, “Go mutec sambâŋko fuŋne qaqa mâsi moc fuame honenaŋ.”
Mupie jazawec, “Ŋoŋe hae ŋafezo eme mueŋgopieŋ, ‘Furic karorac emasaŋkekacte tomâcko ʒoaŋ qaocmu.’
Â hae fureme mueŋgopieŋ, ‘Dudupi sâsâoc fuakacte hoe heocmu.’ Ŋoŋe karorac qânikiŋ irec fuŋne manaeŋgopieŋ, â dameŋ ʒirec fuŋne sâcne mi manaeŋgopieŋ me?
Ŋic hehesicne â miti qiqikiŋ ŋoŋe mâsi moc honeniŋte muŋgopieŋ. Ŋoŋe furune moc mâcne, Jonarao fuawec mâsi i sawa fuame honeniŋmu.” Iŋuc murâ behec‐joparâ rawec.
Eme motec jaŋe poroŋte nikec‐jopame foha Jesuhec riqic fotâcnerâ ocniŋucnao fisihuc manasumbiŋ.
Ehame Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe farisaio â sadukaio hâmu goreŋ‐jeŋic bâec bacnehuc paŋsawa junʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc jazame jaŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc nazaŋ gazaŋ embiŋ: “Poroŋ foha warembeneŋte iŋuc nâzâkac.”
Dâŋ muhapie hazec‐ticnao hume manarâ jazawec, “Oi, mamanasiŋ gogoroŋ, ŋoŋe wemocte poroŋ behembieŋ irec nazaŋ gazaŋ eŋgopieŋ?
No wiac epo irec biac nikec‐ŋopawecte mi manasuŋgopieŋ me? No poroŋ memoc izi ŋic 5 tauseŋ gumec‐jopape nâ gapec erâ tiwâne ro qânusuc epie sasac wezimuc fusewec?
Â poroŋ 7 izi ŋic 4 tauseŋ gumec‐jopape nâ gapec erâ tiwâne ro qânusuc epie sasac wezimuc fusewec?
No poroŋte mi ŋazapac i weniŋucte mi mana tarambieŋ? Farisaio â sadukaio goreŋ‐jeŋicte paŋsawa erâ junʒepieŋ, iŋuc mukopac.”
Dâŋ i jazame miŋecne mana‐hâmorâ mumbiŋ, “O, goreŋ jâmbâŋte mi mujec, farisaio â sadukaio miti mumu‐jeŋicte mujec.”
Jesu e Kaisarea hae, ŋicwofuŋ Filipozi mume bambiŋ, i bâqiŋkezo ehuc motecfâcne mu indiŋ ejarerâ muwec, “Ŋic jaŋe Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne ere mo muŋgopieŋ?”
Eme jaŋe âzâcnerâ mumbiŋ, “Gâcnezi Johane Miti Opâ fufuŋke mueŋgopieŋ, gâcnezi Elia, â gâcnezi Jeremia me porofete moc, iŋuc mueŋgopieŋ.”
Iŋuc muhuc âzâcnepie wio‐jarerâ muwec, “Â ŋaŋacne ine nore mo muŋgopieŋ?”
Wio‐jareme Simoŋ Petorozi muwec, “Go Kristo, Anutu juju sanaŋ ere Ŋokâ.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Simoŋ Jonare ŋokâ, gore manape ʒerine ekac, mamana i ŋicmaŋkonec mi fua‐garekac, sambâŋ Mamac‐nanezi mujaŋgeŋke‐garewec.
Irec gazape manac, go ʒâŋege Petoro, eme noni haroŋaŋ irec faio kikefuŋ gurufâc‐nane râec‐jopape hârâcte tâpirizi mi qâhoc‐jopaocmu.
Erâ no sambâŋ uucmaŋte ki garepemu. Eme go mâreŋko niniŋgiŋ gie batec sambâŋko wâc fârio qaocmu, â mâreŋko gogoroŋ gie batec sambâŋko wâc fârio qaocmu.”
Iŋuc murâ motecfâcne mic muac sanaŋne ejarehuc muwec, “No Kristo jukopac, irec ŋic moc mi jaza‐jâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ.”
Dameŋ ira Jesuzi fuŋkerâ, juku wiac fuacneocmu irec dâŋ motecfâcne mufua‐jarewec. Ehuc Jerusalem haeo feme soŋaŋ â taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu jaŋe wiac gâgâpâcne ecnehuc qapie hâmorâ ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha ɋârerâ fahareocmu, irec dâŋ jaza‐fârewec.
Jazame Petorozi bucko hefârerâ qataracnehuc muwec, “Wofuŋ, Anutuzi ŋezicgume wiac iŋucne mi mac fua‐gare‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.”
Mume fotikierâ Petoro ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Sataŋ go râriec, go hata ŋeŋezic enarekic, go dâŋ mukomec i Anuture dâŋ aricne, i ŋicdâŋ ekac.”
Dameŋ ijaha Jesuzi motecfâcne ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋic moczi no bâjâpecnuzo murâ maŋ sahac‐ticnere dâŋ qikiŋnehuc maripoŋ‐ticne hâporâ bâjâpecnuzejec.
Moc e juju‐ticne sakareme sifuckecneocmu, â moc e nore erâ qikiŋneme fuacneocmu.
Moc e mâreŋte wiac sasawa hure‐fâreku kinduŋ bânduŋ bajuhame juju‐ticne omaeme wemo wiac fârine focneocmu? Me juju‐ticnere kiwiric wemo wiac rome risiecneocmu?
Manaŋgopieŋ, Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e Mamac‐ticnere tatamaczi fainao uucne riŋkeha aŋelofâc‐ticne amec‐jopame wahaniŋmu, eme ŋic mâmâc sasawa juju bapa‐jeŋicte sâc okacne bazu‐jareocmu.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Domaŋgopieŋ ʒi ŋoŋeraonec gâcne hâmoczi mi bâqiŋ‐ŋopaha Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋnezi waharâ Wofuŋ juju‐ticne tâtâc bâfuame honenʒoŋgopieŋ.”
Jesu e ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 juraku Petoro, Jakobo â ɋaticne Johane rocjopame tiki tuhuo fembiŋ.
Eme ira mai‐jeŋicko domahuc hawarine fuŋmoc ewec. Ehuc ʒâŋe maine ʒoaŋ tatamac iŋucne tamaewec â ŋaqi‐ticne sawa tatamac iŋucne erâ findowawec.
Ehame Mose â Elia ijaha mai fuarâ ehec dâŋ muc manac embiŋ.
Iŋuc ehapie Petorozi Jesu ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋ, sowine ʒira juŋgopeneŋ, irec manatec boze jahec â moc bape, gore moc, Mosere moc â Eliare moc.”
Iŋuc muha muhame izia karorac oŋararacne moczi waharâ sâoc‐jopawec. Eme karorac maŋkonec dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc wahawec: “Keci joroc Ŋokâ‐nane, no e hone ʒiziweekopac. Ŋoŋe dâŋticne mananʒepieŋ.”
Motec jaŋe dâŋ i manarâ ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic mâreŋko hetutuckerâ ɋarac ɋarac qahuc fombiŋ.
Iŋuc ehapie Jesuzi maŋfuŋ‐jeŋicko rarâ bâuc‐jopahuc muwec, “Ŋoŋe faharerâ hâhâwic tâmiric juniŋ.”
Eme jaŋe ʒâŋe‐jeŋic fitâcnerâ Jesu sawa honembiŋ.
Eme tikionec wahahuctecne Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wiac ʒâŋe furu honembieŋ irec dâŋ biŋe ŋic mi jajaza juhapie Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e hâmockonec ɋârerâ faharezejec.”
Iŋuc jazame motecfâcne jaŋe wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Eli qanaŋ fisiocmu, miti qaqazu jaŋe wemocte dâŋ iŋuc mueŋgopieŋ?”
Wiocnepie jazawec, “Elia e fisirâ wiac bâtâcne bâtimuŋ efâreocte mukicne i jâmbomac.
Erâ ŋazape mananiŋ: Elia e biac fisirâ jume mi ʒâŋitahuc wiac kosa ecnembiŋ. Eme Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e wâc iŋuc jaha qa imac ecneniŋmu.”
Iŋuc mume jaŋe ʒiŋuc manambiŋ: I Johane Miti Opâ fufuŋke ere mukac.
Eme tikionec wahaku ŋic jaŋerao fisipie ŋic moczi warerâ Jesure maŋfuŋko fodaperâ muwec,
“Wofuŋ, go ŋokâ‐nanere buge sâqoreoc. E hâmo ɋârec hati ehuc ʒocko â opâo huekac.
Eme motecfâcge jaŋerao bawarepe bâpiaŋkeniŋte eipiembieŋ.”
Mume Jesuzi kecʒiŋuc muwec: “O mamanasiŋ tâmiric â gegec dodocne ŋoŋe, no ŋoŋehec hati jurâ ju ehuc âsi qataŋ eŋarepemu me?” Iŋuc murâ muwec, “Motec bareniŋ.”
Eme jaŋe iŋuc epie Jesuzi demoŋ dâŋ mucneme motec beherâ wiseme izia biaŋkewec.
Eme motecfâcne jaŋe bucko wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Nâŋe wemocte demoŋ jâpenaŋte eipiembeneŋ?”
Mupie jazawec, “Mamanasiŋ gogoroŋ‐ŋeŋicte. No jâmbomac ŋazape, mamanasiŋ fârine piicne mac, ʒocʒu hândâŋ iŋucne, foŋarehame tiki kecʒi ‘Ŋerârierâ kecocna rac’ âzâcnepie ŋerârieocmu. Ŋoŋe wiac mocte moc mi eipieniŋmu.[
Demoŋ iŋucne jaŋe ine wiac moczi mâcne, mâc nunumuzi â sowa jujuzi jâpec‐jopazo.]”
Eme juku motecfâcne jaŋe Galilaia mâreŋko erao heâckepie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Jupene mi ʒoraha Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e ŋic jaŋere meo feme
qâhâmopie ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc eha fahareocmu.” Iŋuc mume motec jaŋe manarâ bujeŋic hâhâtâwewec.
Eme Kafanaum haeo risiehapie taha ufuŋte takesi 10 toea rohuc jumbiŋ ŋic i jaŋe Petoro wiocne mumbiŋ, “Qaqazu‐ŋeŋiczi taha ufuŋte takesi 10 toea râeekac me?”
Eme Petorozi muwec, “Ea, râeekac.” Iŋuc murâ Jesure ficko ferâ dâŋ mi âzâcnehame e jahac indiŋkerâ muwec, “Simoŋ go weniŋuc mukomec? Mâreŋ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe weni jaŋeraonec takesi roeŋgopieŋ, wiacfâc‐jeŋic jaŋeraonec me omane jaŋeraonec?”
Eme, “Omane jaŋeraonec,” iŋuc mume Jesuzi âzâcnewec, “Sâcne mukic, eme irec hâcne naru motec jaŋe mâc juniŋmu.
Eme jaŋe nâŋâcnere manapie sâqorezacte riqicko rarâ hawic behetec hume qowi moc bâbâni kiocmu e fâretec wefume micne bâindaŋnerâ 20 toea bâfuacmu i rorâ nâhâcne biŋe qarâ jarezemec.”
Ʒoaŋ ira motec jaŋe Jesurao rarâ ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnembiŋ: “Sambâŋte uucmaŋko mozi micne sâko erâ jukac?”
Iŋuc mupie Jesuzi motec piticne moc ecneme wareme ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko râewec,
ehuc muwec, “No jâmbomac ŋazape: Ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic bawaharâ naru motec jaŋere sâcko mi juniŋmu, ine sambâŋte uucmaŋko mi raʒi‐jâmbâŋkeniŋmu.
Moc e motec kecʒiŋucne erâ rumehuc gâcne jaŋere wahakicne juocmu, e ine sambâŋte uucmaŋko micne barâ juocmu.
Eme ŋic moc e nore erâ motec kecʒiŋucne moc mamac rau ecneocmu e no mamac rau enareocmu.
“Moc e biŋefâc‐nane piicne jaŋeraonec mocjaha mac sâqoreocte suru jâiŋ ecneocmu, e buse sâko upenao qonaŋkerâ hâwec ʒâkâŋko sârockepie hume muzac, izi wiac aafecne fuacnekac ezac.
Oi, sâqocnere suru jâiŋ bâbâfua, i wiac hâhâwicne jâmbâŋ. Sâqocnere suru jâiŋ fufua i fuaocmu, wemocko mâc foocmu. Â ŋic moc sâqocnere suru jâiŋ bâfuaocmu, e ine wemo ecnezo? Oi, e wiac hâhâwicne jâmbâŋ ecnezo.
Irec megezi me kikegezi sâqocne hotâckezo eme hetâcne behec ezemec. Juju sanaŋko fisicmurâ sifu puriŋ erâ juzemec. Me kikehec sahac furu juku ʒocsanaŋko huzicte iŋuc hâcne ezemec.
Me ʒâŋegezi sâqocne hotâckezo eme riporâ behezemec. Juju sanaŋko fisicmurâ sifu ʒâŋe hâhâpo juzemec. Ʒâŋe furu juku ʒocsanaŋko huzicte iŋuc hâcne ezemec.
“Ŋoŋe aimuŋ ehuc piticnefâc‐nane jaŋere manapie wawahane mi ezejec. No irec ŋazape mananiŋ: Aŋelofâc‐jeŋic sambâŋko juŋgopieŋ jaŋe sambâŋ Mamac‐nanere ʒâŋe maio fuahuc jueŋgopieŋ.[
Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋnezi qac qâsoric ekicne basac‐jopaku bâfuac‐jopazore wahawec.]
Me ŋoŋe weniŋuc muŋgopieŋ? Ŋic moc lamafâc‐ticne 100 jaŋeraonec mocjahazi qâsorieme beheocmu? Me 99 jaŋe râec‐joparâ kâteo rarâ qâsoriekicne basaocmu?
No jâmbomac ŋazape, e basa‐jâmbâŋkeocmu. Basaku bâfuarâ 99 jaŋere mâcne, sifuckekicne ere bubiaŋ manaocmu.
Eme piticnefâc‐nane jaŋeraonec iŋuc jaha moczi moc mi sipirickeocte sambâŋ Mamac‐ŋeŋiczi muekac.
“Âgoge moczi gorao bahac bâfuame go ra bucko mu tutuc ecnezemec. Eme e dâŋge mana urueme manatec tarame mocwâc âgo egareocmu.
Â dâŋge qikiŋneme ŋic mocjaha me jajahec rocjofatec jahe fuŋne‐ticne mâmâc manahuc mu bâtiŋ ecnenʒepieŋ.
Eme dâŋwirec‐ŋeŋic qikiŋneme kikefuŋte meo râenʒepieŋ. Kikefuŋte dâŋ iŋuc jaha qikiŋneme manacnetec ŋic qâpuc â takesi roro jaŋere sâc ezejec.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Ŋoŋe mâreŋko niniŋgiŋ gie bapie sambâŋko wâc fârio qaocmu, â mâreŋko gogoroŋ gie bapie sambâŋko wâc fârio qaocmu.
Erâ moc ʒuhuckerâ mupe mananiŋ: Ŋoŋeraonec jajaheczi wiac mocte maŋjekic bâturepire mocjaha eme numupire sambâŋ Mamac‐nanezi mana‐jacteocmu.
Ŋic jajahec me jahec â moc nore erâ tumaŋnepie no ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko jupemu.”
Jesuzi dâŋ iŋuc mume Petorizo indiŋkerâ muwec, “Wofuŋ, âgo‐nane moczi sâqocne enareme kiŋticne arecne wezimuc behecnezepac? Arecne 7 behecnepe sâckeocmu me?”
Wiocneme Jesuzi muwec, “7 mâcne, 70 guru 7 behecne rahuc juzo.
Irec sambâŋte miti hata ine ŋicwofuŋ moczi wiac ewec ira sâc hehuc mupe mananiŋ: Ŋicwofuŋ moczi kiŋaŋ ŋicfâc‐ticne tofa‐ticne bazucneniŋte hefârec‐jopawec.
Eme moc jowa warembiŋ erao tofa‐ticne fowec ine 20 tauseŋ kina.
E tofa sâko i bazucneocte moneŋ basame ŋicwofuŋ e ŋic e jahacne â ŋokac motecfâcne â hae qowi â mafa wiac‐ticne ŋic jaŋe furine ropie e jahacne eocte muwec.
Iŋuc mume kiŋaŋŋic e ŋicwofuŋte maŋfuŋko fodaperâ kecʒiŋuc muhuc wâsickewec: ‘Ŋicwofuŋ‐nane go akicnutec no uneŋko moneŋ furu jaha bazu‐garepemu.’
Mu wâsic ecneme ŋicwofuŋ e bune sâqoreme akickerâ tofa sâko behecnewec.
Iŋuc ecneme fickonec waha rarâ kiŋaŋŋic âgo‐ticne moc bâfuawec, erao tofa‐ticne 10 kina fowec. E hâcne bâfuarâ qa tuŋtuŋ ecnehuc muwec, ‘Tofa‐nane ʒiŋuczia bazu‐narec.’
Eme âgo‐ticne maŋfuŋnao fodaperâ ʒiŋuc muhuc wâsickewec: ‘Go akicnutec no uneŋko tofa bazu‐garepemu.’
Wâsickeme dâŋticne mi mamana ra mume âgo‐ticne ʒiŋuc muhuc kâpâcwâru ficko râembiŋ: ‘Tofa bazucne‐fârerâ wahacmu.’
Eme âgofâc‐ticne jaŋe i hone manac erâ bujeŋic wefume ra ŋicwofuŋ dâŋ binaŋ ecne‐fârembiŋ.
Eme eki manarâ kiŋaŋŋic e mocwâc hefârerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Ŋic râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne go, wâsicnutec gore bunane sâqoreme tofa sâko‐nane qikiŋne‐garepac.
Eme no akicgupac iŋuc jaha go âgogere buge sâqoreme akickenʒaŋ me.’
Iŋuc murâ kimbeŋ sokawec qarâ momori jaŋerao râerâ muwec, ‘Ŋoŋe wiac qacne gâpâcne ecne fehuc juhapie tofa sâko‐nane bazu‐nare‐fâreme behenʒepieŋ.’
Ŋoŋe buafec jaha kiŋ bebehec mi epie sambâŋ Mamac‐nanezi wiac ŋemâcne jaha eŋareocmu.”
Jesu e dâŋ fuŋne fuŋne i mutararâ Galilaia mâreŋ beherâ Judaia mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao Jordaŋ ocniŋucnao rawec.
Rahame ŋic guru sâko jâmbâŋ jaŋe bâjâpembiŋ. Eme mâreŋ ira juhuc huchec jaŋe ɋiɋicne bacjopawec.
Ehame farisaio jaŋe esâickeniŋte fisirâ ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnembiŋ: “Moc e ŋonâŋ‐ticne wiac irec me irec beheme sâckeocmu?”
Mupie jazawec, “Ŋoŋe mitidâŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac i mi woseeŋgopieŋ me? Bâbâfua e mârâc jaha ŋic bâfuac‐jopaocte ŋic â ŋokac sâckoa bâfuac‐jofawec.
Bâfuac‐jofarâ muwec, ‘Irec hâcne ŋic moczi neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne behec‐jofarâ ŋonâŋ‐ticnerao qohotame jahe maŋ sahac mocjaha erâ junicmu.’
Eme jahe jajahec mi ehuc, mocjaha erâ junicmu. Anutuzi bâturec‐jofawecte ŋiczi mi bârâwiŋ‐jofazo.”
Iŋuc jazame jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Hâc, eme Mose e ŋokac moc behezo murâ pasi râcnehuc sorezo, iŋuc wemocte muwec?”
Mupie Jesuzi jazawec, “Mose e mâc maŋsanaŋ‐ŋeŋicte bebehec eniŋte mana urue‐ŋarewec. Fufuŋkenao ine hata iŋuc mi fowec.
Irec noni ŋazape mananiŋ: Moc e ŋonâŋ‐ticne beherâ moc roocmu e ʒuʒuhuc‐jekic bâtâcnehuc kiŋsâko hureocmu. Mâc ŋonâŋzi qanaŋ boe sau bâfuawecko ʒuhuc bâtâcte kiŋ i ŋowere mi eocmu.”
Iŋuc mume motec jaŋe âzâcnerâ mumbiŋ, “Ŋowe ŋonâŋ jahere fuŋne iŋuc fokacko ine ŋonâŋ tâmiric mâc mecne juzo.”
Mupie Jesuzi jazawec, “Dâŋ ʒi sasawazi mâcne, irec tâpiri jarekicne jaŋe sawa ro maŋ eniŋmu.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe neŋgoc bumaŋkonec ŋonâŋ tâmiric juniŋte aputac fuaeŋgopieŋ, gâcne jaŋe ŋiczi aputac bacjopakicne, gâcnezi ine sambâŋte miti hatare erâ aputac hawari jueŋgopieŋ. Moc e irec tâpiri focnekaczi dâŋ ʒi ro maŋ ezejec.”
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ɋiefâc‐jeŋic Jesurao bacjopa rarâ meticne qizec‐jeŋicko râerâ numuocte âzâcnembiŋ. Eme motecfâcne jaŋe hâhâwic hejarepie
Jesuzi muwec, “Ŋoŋe behehapie ɋie jaŋe norao wareniŋ, aka mi hejareniŋ. Iŋucne jaŋe hâcne sambâŋte uucmaŋ biŋe qajarekicne.”
Iŋuc murâ meticne qizec‐jeŋicko râewec. Erâ mâreŋ i beherâ mocko rawec.
Eme ŋicmotec moczi Jesurao fisirâ indiŋkerâ muwec, “Qaqazu, no mo gie biaŋne mo barâ juju sanaŋte biŋe epemu?”
Mume ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wiac biaŋnere wemocte wio‐narekomec? Biaŋne rune mocjaha jukac. Eme go juju sanaŋte biŋe ezo murâ sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkezemec.”
Eme eki, “Sâcmutâc dâŋ wenimoi” muhuc wiocneme Jesuzi muwec, “Go ʒika mi qazemec, ŋowe ŋonâŋ ŋohe bebehec mi ezepirec, go fiuc mi rozemec, go micko âkec mi ezemec,
go neŋgoc mamac jahecge sâsec‐jofazemec, erâ go gahacnere egareekac sâc ijaha âgogere egarezejec.”
Mume ŋic e ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “I reŋke warehuc jupo, irec moc weniŋuc ezepac?”
Iŋuc mume Jesuzi âzâcnewec, “Go bahac fâsâc ezo murâ ra moneŋ mafa wiacge ŋic hapetac qikiŋne‐jarezemec, eme sambâŋko boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ fua‐gareocmu. Erâ ware bâjâpecnuzemec.”
Ŋic e dâŋ i manarâ bune sâqoreme rawec, moneŋ mafa ɋâfoŋne focnewec irec.
Rame Jesuzi motecfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No jâmbomac ŋazape, moneŋ mafa sâkoheczi sambâŋte uucmaŋko raʒiniŋte ququŋkenehec eekac.
No irecteaŋ mocwâc ŋazape: Kamelezi buŋic hawecnao rarazi i wiac afecne, â moneŋ mafa sâkoheczi sambâŋte uucmaŋko raraʒi i wiac ŋemâcne.”
Motec jaŋe dâŋ i manarâ bipic‐jeŋic tarame mumbiŋ, “Hâc, eme mozi sambâŋko feocmu?”
Mupie Jesuzi honec‐jopahuc muwec, “I ŋiczi eene mi fokac, erâ sifu Anutuzi wiac i me i hatane bâfuaocte mi quŋkeocmu.”
Iŋuc muhuc jazame Petorozi micnao rorâ muwec, “Manakic, nâŋe wiac‐nâŋec sasawa râpecke‐fârerâ go bâjâpecgumbeneŋ, eme juku irec okacne wemo fua‐nâreocmu?”
Iŋuc wiome Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No jâmbomac ŋazape: Juku wiac sasawa ɋârerâ fua biaŋ ee dameŋko Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋnezi eri ŋeŋe‐ticnao ŋehame no bâjâpecnumbiŋ ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋe 12 ira ŋerahuc Israe ŋicguru 12 jaŋere dâŋ mutaranʒoŋgopieŋ.
Erâ moc e nore erâ hahac ɋa, seŋ baŋec, neŋgoc mamac, naru motec, hae jufu beheocmu, e okacne wiac qame hukicne jâmbâŋ raʒime raʒi rorâ fainao juju sanaŋ rauckeocmu.
Micne jaŋeraonec bocjahazi ʒâhec eniŋmu, â ʒâhec jaŋeraonec bocjahazi micne eniŋmu.
“Sambâŋte miti hata i gie rune moczi waiŋ gie‐ticnere erâ gieŋic rocjopaocte rawec irec sâc.
Erâ gâcne rocjoparâ gie bapa mocjahare furine 50 toea mufua‐jareme manapie sâckeme gie‐ticnao sorec‐jopame rambiŋ.
Eme 9 kilok ehame mocwâc rarâ ŋic gâcne hae ʒoŋao mâc ŋe domac epie honec‐joparâ
ʒiŋuc jazawec: ‘Waiŋ gie‐nane fokac, ra bapie furine sâcne ŋarepemu.’ Mume manarâ waiŋ gie‐ticnao rambiŋ.
Eme 12 kilok erâ wâc 3 kilok ehame rarâ iŋuc jaha rocjopawec.
Eme 5 kilok ehame mocwâc rarâ ŋic gâcne gie tâmiric mâc juhapie bâfuac‐joparâ jazawec, ‘Ŋoŋe wemocte ʒoaŋ ʒora qâoma ehuc juhapie hae owâekac?’
Jaŋe mumbiŋ, ‘Ŋâŋe gie moc mi munârekicne.’ Mupie jaza sorec erâ muwec, ‘Waiŋ gie‐nane fokac ra baniŋ.’
Gie runezi iŋuc eha ŋafeme soŋaŋ âzâcne muwec, ‘Go gie bapa ŋic hefârec‐joparâ moneŋ jarec, ehuc ʒâhec fisimbieŋ jaŋeraonec fuŋkerâ jare raku bâbâni fisimbieŋ jaŋerao jare tarazemec.’
Eme ʒâhec fisimbiŋ jaŋe ejareme warepie 50 toea, 50 toea jare‐fârewec.
Jareme bâbâni jaŋe honerâ furine bafehuc nâreocmu muhapie soŋaŋzi 50 toea jaha jarewec.
Iŋuc rorâ gie rune kâroŋ qacnembiŋ,
ehuc mumbiŋ, ‘Ʒâhec fisimbieŋ gie mâc âruckembieŋ, â nâŋe ine ʒoaŋ bâroŋ gieo ʒâic fâro manahuc domahapene ŋafejec, ehame wemocte ʒâhec jaŋehec sâc mocjaha nârekic?’
Iŋuc mupie gie runezi jaŋeraonec moc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Âgo, no mi bâsâqore‐garekopac, go 50 toeare gazape manatec sâckejec i.
Irec moneŋge rorâ rac. No ʒâhec fisimbieŋ jaŋe gohec sâc mocjaha jarepemurâ manape sâckejec.
No nahacne wiaczi iŋuc me iŋuc me iŋuc ezo murâ sâcne mi epemu me? Go buafec‐nanere erâ iiŋguuŋ ejarekomec me?’
Irec hâcne ʒâheczi micne eniŋmu â micnezi ʒâhec eniŋmu.”
Eme Jesu e Jerusalem haeo feocte motecfâcne 12 jaŋe sawa rocjopame jaŋackoaŋ rambiŋ. Hatao rahuctecne kecʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Manaŋgopieŋ, nâŋâc Jerusalem haeo feŋgopeneŋ. Eme Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu jaŋere meo feme jaŋe hâmoocte mucnerâ
qâpuc jaŋerao râepie jaŋe ima bâroŋ baku maripoŋko qapie hâmoocmu. Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc eha fahareocmu.”
Dameŋ ira Ʒebedaio ŋonâŋ‐ticnezi ŋokâ jahec‐ticne Jesure maŋfuŋko bacjofa rarâ fodapehuc wiac mocte numucnewec.
Eme wiocnerâ muwec, “Go wemo wiacte egarekac?” Eme eki muwec, “Go mutec ŋokâ jahec‐nane Wofuŋ sâko fua tâcnezokic dameŋ ira gâjoŋgao ŋifec â ŋifec ŋezepirec.”
Mume Jesuzi âzâcnewec, “Ŋoŋe fuŋne kâuc bahuc iŋuc muŋgopieŋ. Noni opâ ʒaʒacne nâpemu i ŋohe sâcne nânicmu me?” Eme jahe mupic, “Ea, sâcne nanacmu.”
Mupire jasawec, “Opâ ʒaʒacne nânâ i nânicmu, â gâjoŋ‐naneo ŋeŋe irec dâŋ mumu ine norao mi fokac, Mamac‐nanezi mujarewec i jaŋe ŋeŋe ira ŋeniŋmu.”
Eme motec 10 jaŋe dâŋ i manarâ âgo jahec‐jeŋic jahere mana sâqorembiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi hefârec‐joparâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Mâreŋ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe ŋic rauc‐jopahuc kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic bacjopaeŋgopieŋ, â fekicne jaŋe omane qâhuc‐joparâ ŋicbomboŋ ejareeŋgopieŋ, i manaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ine iŋuc mi enʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋeraonec moczi fekicne ezo murâ gâcne ŋoŋere wahamicne erâ juzejec.
Â micne ezo murâ gâcne ŋoŋere kiŋaŋ qaqa erâ juzejec.
Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e iŋuc jaha ŋoŋe kiŋaŋ qacneniŋte mâcne, e jahac kiŋaŋ qaqa gie bahuc ŋic bocjaha kiwiric‐jeŋic rorâ juju‐ticne qikiŋneocte wahawec.”
Jesu motecfâc jaŋe Jeriko hae fotâcnerâ rapie ŋic hâmbâŋ sâkozi bâjâpec‐jopambiŋ.
Ehame ŋic tiŋtuŋ jajahec hatamecko ŋehuc, Jesu ware rakac, mupie manarâ ʒocnehec wirahuc mupic, “Wofuŋ, go Dawidire ɋâriczi nâhere mac buge sâqoreoc.”
Boc wirapire ŋic jaŋe hecke‐jactehuc mu hâhâwic ejactembiŋ. Eme jahe mana‐bipiehuc fotarierâ wirahuc mupic, “Wofuŋ, go Dawidire ɋâriczi nâhere mac buge sâqoreoc.”
Eme Jesu e hatao domahuc ejacteme warepire wio‐jacterâ muwec, “Weniŋuc eŋactepere mukopirec?”
Mume kecʒiŋuc âzâcnepic: “Wofuŋ, ʒâŋe fifi bacnâfocmurâ mukoperec.”
Mupire Jesuzi bune sâqoreme ʒâŋe‐jekic bâuame izia ʒâŋe fipic. Erâ Jesu bâjâpepic.
Eme raku Jerusalem hae bâqiŋkezo embiŋ. Ehuc Betefage hae, Oliwa tiki fuŋnao ŋewec, ira fisirâ Jesuzi motecfâcne jaŋeraonec jajahec jasa sorec erâ
kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋohe raecko hae ŋekac ira rarâ doŋgi neŋgoc motec niŋgiŋko domakopirec honec‐jofarâ firuec‐jofarâ barec‐jofanic.
Ŋohe iŋuc epire moczi mu wioc eŋacteme muzepirec, ‘Wofuŋ e irec mukac.’ Iŋuc mupire qikiŋne‐ŋacteocmu.”
Wiac i mâc mâcne, porofete ere findaŋdâŋ deŋkeocte iŋuc ekicne. E dâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkewec:
“Zioŋte otâ âzâcneniŋ, Manakic, ŋicwofuŋgezi gorao fakac, e maŋuruczi doŋgio ŋehuc fakac, mafa dete motecnezi âsickeme fâkopirec.”
Eme motec jahe rarâ Jesure mic reŋkehuc
doŋgi neŋgoc motec bacjofa warepire fainao ŋaqi‐jeŋic rumackepie ferâ ŋewec.
Eme ŋic jaŋeraonec bocjahazi ŋaqi‐jeŋic hatao rumackembiŋ â tucnezi ʒariŋ bazurâ hatao herambiŋ.
Eme ŋic guru sâko roʒâc bâʒâŋiŋ ecnembiŋ jaŋe kecʒiŋuc muhuc ofac hecnembiŋ: “Ohec, Dawidire ɋâriczi ware‐nârec. Wofuŋte micte ware‐nârekomecte mumbiaŋgunaŋ. Ohec, Anutu faic sambâŋko.”
Eme Jerusalem haeo feme hae rune jaŋe bujeŋic fahareme fickonec waharâ mâreŋ qanʒaŋnerâ domahuc mumbiŋ, “Mozi wareme eŋgopieŋ?”
Mupie jazambiŋ, “Porofete Jesu, e Galilaia mâreŋko Nazarete haeo fuakicnezi.”
Eme Jesuzi taha ufuŋko ferâ wiac nareŋ gareŋ ehuc domambiŋ jaŋe jâpec‐joparâ moneŋ katapa â hapâ ŋeŋe herândiŋkewec; ehuc jazawec,
“Dâŋqâreŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac, ‘Ufuŋ‐nane i nunumu fic ezejec’, ŋoŋe ine epie fiuc sindaŋhec jaŋere qânâuŋ tinac ekac.”
Eme ira juhame ŋic tiŋtuŋ â puriŋ jaŋe erao rapie bâpiaŋ‐jopawec.
Iŋuc eme taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu jaŋe mâsi‐ticne honembiŋ â naru motec taha ufuŋko ofac hecnehuc “Ohec, Dawidire ɋâriczi ware‐nârekic” iŋuc mupie manambiŋ. Erâ irec â irec mâmâc mana gâpârembiŋ;
erâ Jesu âzâcne mumbiŋ, “Keci jaŋe ofac hegarepie manakomec?” Mupie muwec, “Manakopac. Erâ ŋoŋe mitidâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc fokac i mi woseeŋgopieŋ me: ‘Gegecne â susuonec jaŋere maŋ baafecketec micjeŋicko gore mumuteŋ fuakac’?”
Iŋuc jazahuc râpec‐joparâ Jerusalem haeonec hurâ Betania haeo ferâ ŋafeme fowec.
Eme furicte hae sâkoo risiehuc nânâre ecnewec.
Erâ hatamecko nemuja jâcne moc honerâ fuŋnao rarâ fârine basahuc rehacne sawa domame honewec. Honerâ jâc kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go hohozec erâ mâc domahuc juzemec sanaŋ.” Mume izia jâc e ururuckewec.
Eme motec jaŋe i honerâ wareckerâ mumbiŋ, “Jâc e weniŋuc erâ biac ɋaŋakac?”
Mupie Jesuzi jazawec, “No jâmbomac ŋazape, ŋoŋe maŋguru mi ehuc mamanasiŋ fârihec juniŋmu, eme jâcko mâsi fuajec i sawa mi baniŋmu; ŋoŋe tiki kecocni ʒiŋuc âzâcneniŋmu: ‘Tiki go hockerâ hâwecko rucnerâ huc’, eme dâŋŋeŋic reŋkeocmu.
Erâ wâc mamanasiŋ fârihec juhuc wiac irec me irec numupie fua‐ŋareocmu.”
Eme raku taha ufuŋko ferâ miti qazu‐jarehuc ŋehame taha bapa micne â soŋaŋ jaŋe erao rarâ ʒiŋuc muhuc indiŋkembiŋ: “Go ʒira wiac eekic i more micte eekomec? Mozi mugareme eekomec?”
Mupie Jesuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc bâtikie‐jarewec: “No dâŋ mocjaha sawa wio‐ŋarepe nazapie noni iŋuc jaha, more micte wiac eekopac, i okacne ŋazapemu.
Johane Miti Opâ gie‐ticne i wenirec fuawec, sambâŋkonec me ŋickonec?” Iŋuc muhuc wio‐jareme jaŋe, dâŋ wenimoi munaŋ, muhuc maŋguru erâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Nâŋâc ‘sambâŋkonec fuawec’ iŋuc mupene muocmu ‘Hâc, eme wemocte dâŋticne mi manambiŋ?’
Me ‘ŋickonec fuawec’ iŋuc munaŋte ine ŋic jaŋere hâwic‐nâpokac, jaŋe ʒeŋgoma Johane porofete mucneeŋgopieŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ Jesu ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Mi manaŋgopeneŋ.” Eme Jesuzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarewec: “Wiac murâ sâcne, eme noni iŋuc jaha, more micte wiac eekopac, okacne wâc mi ŋazapemu.
“Dâŋ moc ŋazape mana honeniŋ. Ŋic moc ere ŋokâ jajahec jupic. Eme qanaŋ ŋokâ‐ticne moc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Ŋokâ go miŋecgac ra waiŋ gie bac.’
Âzâcneme muwec, ‘Sâcne, mamac, bapemu.’ Iŋuc murâ ra qâoma ewec.
Ehame ʒâhec mamac e ŋokâ‐ticne moc dâŋ ijaha âzâcnewec. Âzâcneme muwec, ‘Mozi, mi bapemu.’ Iŋuc murâ ʒâhec bune sâqoreme sifu ra bawec.
Eme ŋoŋe mo moteczi mamac‐ticnere mic reŋkewec muŋgopieŋ?” Jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Dâŋ ʒâhec âzâcnewec e.” Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec, “No jâmbomac ŋazape: Takesi ro bâsifuc ŋic â sasec ŋokac jaŋe Anuture uucmaŋko raʒihapie ŋoŋe râpene eniŋmu.
Johane fisirâ tiŋne jujure hata ŋowatume ŋoŋe miti‐ticne qikiŋnehapie takesi ro bâsifuc ŋic â sasec ŋokac jaŋe mana ʒakiembiŋ. Jaŋe iŋuc epie ŋoŋe honec‐joparâ ʒâhec busâqoc bâfuarâ miti‐ticne mamana i sifu mi embiŋ.
“No kesaic dâŋ moc mupe mananiŋ. Bomboŋ moczi mâreŋ mocko waiŋ saraku sara‐fârerâ râreckehuc sac hafewec. Erâ fârinere giefic barâ soŋaŋ jaŋere fic iŋuc jaha bawec. Iŋuc efârerâ soŋaŋ râec‐joparâ mâreŋ mocko rawec.
Jukuhame fâri fufua dameŋ maickeme motecfâcne jaŋe fârine roniŋte sorec‐jopame rarâ soŋaŋ jaŋerao fisirâ mupie
soŋaŋ jaŋe motec rocjoparâ moc qa tuŋtuŋ ecnembiŋ â moc qarâ qâhâmombiŋ â moc qânâzi hembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie gie runezi manarâ harierâ motec bocjaha sorec‐jopame ra fisipie sâc ijaha ejarembiŋ.
Eme ʒâhec ŋokâ jâmbâŋ‐ticne ʒiŋuc manasuhuc sorewec: ‘Ŋokâ‐nane ra fisime honerâ araŋ bacneniŋmu.’
Eme soŋaŋ jaŋe ŋokâ jâmbâŋ‐ticne honerâ ʒiŋuc muhuc nazaŋ gazaŋ embiŋ: ‘Eki hâcne juku gie ʒi rauckeocmu, irec nâŋâc e qarâ gie ʒi sakarepene nâŋâcne ezejec.’
Iŋuc muhuc rorâ gieonec tuŋke tuŋke raku qâhâmombiŋ. “Gie rune e fisirâ soŋaŋ weniŋuc ejareocmu?”
Mume jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Wiac gâgâpâcne embiŋte wiac gâgâpâcne jaha ejareocmu.
Erâ gie‐ticnao soŋaŋ biaŋne râec‐jopame jaŋe dameŋ sâc fârine râcnehuc juniŋmu.”
Iŋuc mupie Jesuzi kecʒiŋuc muhuc ʒuhuckerâ jazawec: “Miti papiao dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc fokac i ŋoŋe moc mi woseeŋgopieŋ me? ‘Ficbapa ŋic jaŋe wâtuŋ surehuc behembiŋ, wâtuŋ izi mi jâmâ wâtuŋ ezejec i! Wiac i Wofuŋte micte iŋuc fuame ŋiczi honepene mâsi furune ekac.’
Irec ŋazape mananiŋ: Anuture uucmaŋ i ŋoŋe ŋowac rorâ ŋic furune jarezo. Eme jaŋe fârine‐ticne bâfuaniŋmu. [
Ŋic moczi jâmâ wâtuŋ ira herâ sahac‐ticne imackeocmu. Â wâtuŋzi ine ŋic mocte faio waha qarâ qâgâreckeocmu.]”
Kesaic dâŋ iŋuc mume taha bapa micne â farisaio jaŋe mana tararâ mumbiŋ, “Oc, i nâŋâcne mukac.”
Iŋuc murâ ro qaniŋte manasurâ, ŋic jaŋe Jesure porofete mumbiŋte ine hâwic‐jopame behembiŋ.
Jesu e kesaic dâŋ mocwâc ʒuhuckerâ kecʒiŋuc muwec:
“Sambâŋte kikefuŋ i ŋicwofuŋ moczi wiac ewec ira sâc hepe. Ŋicwofuŋ e ŋokâ‐ticne ŋokac râcneocte tiwâ bâzi sâko qame fisiwec.
Iŋuc erâ kiŋaŋ motecfâcne sorec‐jopame jaŋe ŋic ʒâfo qanaŋ ejarekicne jowac‐jopaniŋte rambiŋ.
Ra mupie qikiŋnepie ŋicwofuŋzi motec gâcne mocwâc jaza sorec ehuc muwec, ‘Ŋoŋe rarâ ŋic ʒâfo ejarekicne jazaniŋ: Manaŋgopieŋ, no tiwâ bâzi qape fisijec â bec bulimakao mupe hezu rikec embieŋ, ehuc wiac sasawa emoc bâmoc efârembieŋ, irec ŋoŋe warepie ŋic ŋokac bâturec‐jofahuc nâ ʒeri enʒepeneŋ.’
Eme jaŋe rarâ iŋuc jazapie dâŋ mana takirehuc moc e gie‐ticnao rawec, moc e ŋicmanac rawec.
Tucne jaŋe ine motec rocjoparâ râsi ejarehuc qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ.
Iŋuc epie ŋicwofuŋzi manarâ mana gâpârerâ momori ejareme jaŋe ʒika qaqa jopahuc hae‐jeŋic turuŋkepie ʒawec.
“Eme ŋicwofuŋ e kiŋaŋ motec ʒiŋuc jazawec: ‘Tiwâ ʒepec i rike bâmoc ekicne, eme ʒâfo ejarekicne jaŋe takic‐jopame qikiŋneŋgopieŋte
ŋoŋe bozene bozene rarâ bâfuac‐jopaniŋmu sâc rocjopapie warenʒepieŋ.’
Mume motec jaŋe bozene bozene jufârehuc ŋic kosa, biaŋne mecne sâqocne mecne mâmâc amec‐jopapie fisirâ tutumaŋ fic fusucmarâ ŋembiŋ.
Ŋehapie ŋicwofuŋzi honec‐jopaocte ferâ ŋic moc hombaŋ ŋaqi tâmiric ŋeme honewec;
erâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Âgo, go weniŋuc erâ hombaŋ ŋaqi tâmiric wefu ŋekomec?’ Mume ŋic e fâsâerâ ŋewec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋzi motecfâcne jazarâ muwec, ‘Ŋoŋe me kikene qarâ duŋdapâc maŋko sârockepie huoc. Ira ki oowa ehuc mic kikiaric kihuc fozejec.’
Hefârec‐jopakicnezi bocjaha, rowosâec‐jopakicnezi ine afecne.”
Jesuzi iŋuc jazame farisaio jaŋe ficjeŋicko rarâ, dâŋzi bitiŋ moc weniŋuc bapene kizejec, muhuc dâŋ bâwosâembiŋ.
Eku motecfâc‐jeŋic â Herodere ŋic tucne jaza sorec epie rarâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Qaqazu, nâŋe gore fuŋne manaeŋgopeneŋ, go dâŋ burec mi ehuc jâmbomac jaha muekic, â mitire hata i fekicne wahakicne sâckoa nâzâ nâwotuc eekomec. Ehuc fekicne fosâoc‐jopahuc dâŋ mi muhasickeekomec.
Irec wio‐garepene nâzâc: Sisa, takesi moneŋ râcneeŋgopeneŋ i manatec sâckekac me aricne?”
Mupie maŋsioc‐jeŋic hone tararâ muwec, “Burecŋic, ŋoŋe wemocte dâŋzi bitiŋ banareŋgopieŋ?
Ŋoŋe takesi moneŋ râeeŋgopieŋ i moc nowatupie honepe.” Mume 10 toea bâfuarâ jâutumbiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi wio‐jare muwec, “Hawari â qâreŋ ʒi more?”
Jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Sisare.” Iŋuc mupie jazawec, “Murâ Sisare biŋe i Sisa râcnenʒepieŋ, â Anuture biŋe i Anutu râcnenʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc muhuc jazame jaŋe wareckerâ beherâ rambiŋ.
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa ijaha sadukaio ŋic jaŋe Jesurao fisimbiŋ. Ŋic i jaŋe, hâmockonec fafahare mi fokac, iŋuc muhuc jumbiŋ. Jaŋe hâcne fisirâ dâŋ moc wiocnembiŋ,
ʒiŋuc muhuc: “Qaqazu, Mose e dâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkewec: ‘Ŋic moczi ɋâric tâmiric hâmome ɋanezi hozec‐ticne rozejec, ehuc hahac‐ticnere biŋe ɋâric bâfuazejec.’
Eme ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko hahac ɋa 7 jumbiŋ, ehuc mârâc hahac‐jeŋic ŋokac rorâ ɋâric tâmiric jurâ hâmome ɋanezi hozec‐ticne rowec.
E iŋuc jaha hâmome ɋaticne moczi hozec ijaha rowec. Iŋuczi iŋuc eku hahac ɋa 7 jaŋe mâmâc hâmo‐fârembiŋ.
Izi ʒâhec hozec‐jeŋic e wâc hâmowec.
Eme jaŋe mâmâc sasawa ŋokac ijaha rombiŋte fafahare dameŋko more ezokac?”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe miti â Anutu tâpiri‐ticne kâuc bahuc dâŋ musifuckeŋgopieŋ.
Fafahare dameŋko ŋic ŋokac roroc mocwâc mi enʒoŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe sambâŋ aŋelo iŋucne erâ mâc junʒoŋgopieŋ.
Eme ŋoŋe fafaharere muŋgopieŋte ŋazape. Anutu e dâŋ kecʒiŋuc ŋazawec i ŋoŋe wose manac mi eeŋgopieŋ me?
‘No Abraham â Isaka â Jakobo jaŋere Anutu.’ Ine hâcne, e hâmokicne jaŋere Anutu mâcne, e ɋâricne juju jaŋere Anutu.”
Jesuzi dâŋ iŋuc mume ŋic ŋokac guru sâko jaŋe miti mumu‐ticnere manapie bipinehec ewec.
Jesure dâŋzi sadukaio ŋic bâniniŋ‐jopawec, i farisaio jaŋe manarâ qâturerâ
âgo‐jeŋic moc sâcmutâc mamana saric e ecnepie Jesu esâickehuc kecʒiŋuc muwec:
“Qaqazu, sâcmutâc dâŋ wenimoizi qizecne sâko?”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go maŋge â qâqâtâcge â mamanasuge Wofuŋ Anutuge furu jaha qikiŋnecnetec fozejec.
Dâŋ izi sâcmutâc dâŋ fârine â femicne.
Erâ âgone moc fokac, jahe sâckoa ekopirec, ine kecʒiŋuc: Go gahacnere egareekac sâc ijaha âgogere egarezejec.
Sâcmutâc i jahe hâcne Mose â porofete jaŋere dâŋ qâhâcke‐fârekopirec.”
Farisaio ŋic qâturerâ juhapie Jesuzi mu indiŋ ejarerâ
kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋoŋe Kristore weniŋuc muŋgopieŋ, e more ɋâric?” Jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Dawidire.”
Mupie Jesuzi jazawec, “Eme Dawidi e Mârozi ecneme weniŋucte Kristo ‘Wofuŋnane’ mucnewec? Kecʒiŋuc muhuctecne:
‘Wofuŋzi nore Wofuŋ âzâcnewec, go ware fâre‐naneo ŋehaŋtec râsifâcge kikegere rurumaŋko guruc‐jopazepac’.
Irec Dawidi e ‘Wofuŋ‐nane’ mucnewec, iŋucnezi weniŋuc erâ ɋâric‐ticne ekac?”
Iŋuc muhuc wio‐jareme jaŋe dâŋ bâtikiecneniŋte efefeckembiŋ. Erâ ʒâhec mocwâc esâickeniŋte mi afeckembiŋ.
Dameŋ ira Jesuzi ŋic gâcne â motecfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Mosere ŋeŋetacko miti qaqazu â farisaio ŋeeŋgopieŋ.
Irec dâŋ ŋaza mutâc epie manarâ reŋkenʒepieŋ, â jaŋacne jujuo ine mi junʒepieŋ. Jaŋe miczi mumune i mueŋgopieŋ, â rereŋke ine mi reŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe tagi ŋemâcne bâmâckerâ fai‐ŋeŋicko râehuc jaŋacne metariŋ jueŋgopieŋ.
Wiac eeŋgopieŋ i ŋiczi honebâc‐jopaniŋte sawa eeŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe miti nunumuzi mâc qâʒere‐jeŋic eme qonaŋkerâ ma fuŋne fuŋne rorâ erioŋ barioŋ jueŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc tutumaŋko â mitificko ŋicbomboŋ ŋeŋeoa micne ŋeniŋte mueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic ŋokac omanezi hatao mu ʒeri ejareniŋte masu wânʒâŋ jueŋgopieŋ, erâ ʒâŋe‐jeŋic qaqazu mujarepie mananiŋte hazec râehuc jueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ine qaqazu muŋareniŋte mi munʒepieŋ. Qaqazu‐ŋeŋic mocjaha jukac, ŋoŋe ine qoqomâ sasawa.
Erâ mâreŋko ŋic mocte mamac mi munʒepieŋ, Mamac‐ŋeŋic mocjaha jukac, sambâŋko hâcne.
Erâ micne bapa muŋareniŋte wâc mi munʒepieŋ, micne bapa‐ŋeŋic mocjaha, Kristo hâcne.
Ŋoŋerao micne fekicne juocmuzi gâcne ŋoŋere kiŋaŋ qaocmu.
Moc e jahacne maŋte fehuc jume bawahazo, â moc e jahacne maŋte wahahuc jume bafezo.
“Jei, miti qaqazu â farisaio, burecŋic ŋoŋe! Ŋic jaŋe sambâŋte uucmaŋko raʒizo mupie hata âte bâzicke‐jareeŋgopieŋ. Ŋaŋacne mi raʒihuc jaŋe raʒizo mupie hecke‐jareeŋgopieŋ. [
Jei, miti qaqazu â farisaio burecŋic, ŋoŋe hozec bekâ nunumu ʒorazi bâmiriŋ‐jopahuc ficjeŋic kâŋgâc jowac roeŋgopieŋ. Eme irec okacne baafeckehuc mi eŋarezo.]
Jei, miti qaqazu â farisaio burecŋic, ŋoŋe ŋic mocjaha maczi ŋoŋere biŋe eocte mâreŋ â hâwec fotâcnerâ raeŋgopieŋ. Eme iŋucnezi ŋoŋerao ʒuhuckeme jowa jukupie hârâc kikefuŋte tofa jaha ehuc siric‐ŋopaekac.
Jei, micne bapa tiŋtuŋne ŋoŋe kecʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Taha ufuŋko ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ i racne, taha ufuŋko eri qaraweŋ wiac ŋekac ira ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ i fârine.’
Oi, ŋic maŋsanaŋ â mutucne, ufuŋ e tiri ŋeekacte eri qaraweŋ wiac‐ticnezi tiri jaha wâc eekac. Irec wenimoizi fârine jâmbâŋ ekac, ufuŋzi me eri qaraweŋ wiac‐ticnezi?
Erâ moc kecʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Alatao ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ i racne, â alata faio bâzi fokac ira ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ i fârine.’
Oi, ŋic tiŋtuŋne ŋoŋe, alata tiri ŋeekacte fainao bâzi râekicnezi tiri jaha eekac. Irec wenimoizi fârine jâmbâŋ ekac, alatazi me bâzizi?
Irec moc e alatao ɋetickehuc mupaŋkeme alata e jahacne erâ fainao wiac fokac i mâmâc roocmu.
Â moc e taha ufuŋko ɋetickehuc mupaŋkeme ine ufuŋ e jahacne â ufuŋko juekac e mâmâc roocmu.
Â moc e sambâŋko ɋetickehuc mupaŋkeme ine Anuture ŋeŋe â ŋeŋe rune e mâmâc roocmu.
“Jei, miti qaqazu â farisaio, burecŋic ŋoŋe! Wiac racne, romboc wifu qase wiac i teŋkonec wâŋ irec sâc Wofuŋte biŋe râeeŋgopieŋ, ehuc ŋifecne wiac fârine, mitio mu bâtiŋ, hone jauŋ â mamanasiŋ, ine behepie wahaekac. Moc reŋkehuc moc reŋkezo.
Micne bapa tiŋtuŋne, ŋoŋe sicŋeŋicko qoʒazaŋ huzacte saia baeŋgopieŋ, ehuc kamele wiac sâko acmâc ɋâckeeŋgopieŋ.
Jei, miti qaqazu â farisaio, burecŋic ŋoŋe! Oto râqâc‐ŋeŋic sahacne ʒure ɋaɋackeeŋgopieŋ, ehame irec maŋnao ine bajauc â râmbe fusucmarâ fokac.
Farisaio ŋic tiŋtuŋne go, qanaŋ râqâc maŋnao wiac fokac i ʒure emasaŋ etecne ʒâhec sahacne iŋuc jaha ɋaɋackezejec.
Jei, miti qaqazu â farisaio, burecŋic ŋoŋe! Ŋoŋe ʒâŋeruŋ iŋucne. Ʒâŋeruŋ e sahacnao ʒariŋzi erickekicne, maŋnao ine ŋicsiec â gârâŋ ɋâsu fokac.
Ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha sahac‐ŋeŋiczi ŋic maio tiŋne hawari eeŋgopieŋ, â maŋŋeŋic ine burec â miti ima qaqazi fusekicne.
Jei, miti qaqazu â farisaio, burecŋic ŋoŋe! Porofete jaŋere ʒâŋeruŋ baɋaɋackeeŋgopieŋ â mitiŋic raŋɋane jaŋere ʒâŋeruŋ gie bâʒureeŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jumbiŋko jurâ muzac, jaŋe bafic‐jopahuc porofete jopa sipiric mi enʒapeŋ.’
Ŋoŋe dâŋ iŋuc muhuc porofete jojopa jaŋere ɋâricfâc juŋgopieŋ fuŋne‐ŋeŋic mutaniŋkeeŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Kâcɋenefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe kiŋ fainezi faine râe wefumbiŋ, ŋoŋe ijaha ʒuhuckepie kiŋte sâc micne qazejec.
Homa neŋgoc motec ŋoŋe, kiŋte okacne hârâcko huhu maickeme wena moc wiserâ soŋkeniŋmu?
“Manaŋgopieŋ, no nahac ŋoŋerao porofete â mamana ŋic â miti qaqazu sorec‐jopape fisipie ŋoŋe gâcne jopa sipiric eniŋmu â gâcne maripoŋko jopaniŋmu â gâcne mitific‐ŋeŋicko kâcbiŋzi jopahuc, hae sâc rapie rahuc jopa roc ejareniŋmu.
Ekupie ŋic socbiaŋ‐jeŋic oma jâmbâŋ sipiricke warehuc jumbiŋ irec okacne ŋoŋerao fisiocmu. Mârâc jaha Abe eraonec ʒika fuŋkerâ sueme sue qawefuku. Berekia ŋokâ‐ticne Ʒekaria e taha ufuŋko alata fuŋko qahuc ʒika qatarambiŋ.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Ʒika sasawa irec kiŋ mâreŋ ʒirec rune ŋoŋerao batarazo.
“Jerusalem rune, Jerusalem rune, go wemocte porofete ʒikazi jopahuc mitiŋic gorao sorec‐jopakicne qânâzi hehâmoc‐jopaekic! Qâqâczi motecfâcne qânusuc‐joparâ fakecnezi ɋoroc‐jopaekac, iŋuc jaha noni ɋâricfâcge wemo afecne maŋfuŋ‐naneo qânusuc‐jopazo mupe qikiŋne warehuc jumbiŋ!
Irec fic hae‐ŋeŋic behepe tuhune qarâ fozokac hâcne.
Mupe mananiŋ, ŋoŋe mocwâc mi hohonecnu juraku ʒiŋuc muhuc honecnunʒoŋgopieŋ: Wofuŋte micte warekac e mumbiaŋkenaŋ.”
Jesu e taha ufuŋkonec waha rame motecfâcne jaŋe erao rarâ ufuŋte ficbiri hone qârâwiŋ eocte esockembiŋ.
Eme dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarewec: “Wiac sasawa ʒi ŋeme honeŋgopieŋ? No jâmbomac ŋazape, râsi jaŋe ufuŋ i heropiepie ŋetâ qâtâtiezokac.”
Eme Oliwa tikio ferâ ŋeme motecfâcne jaŋackoaŋ maŋfuŋnao rarâ wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Wiac mumec i wezimucko fuazokac? Erâ go gahacne fifisi dameŋ â mâreŋ hâmoc dameŋ‐ticne maickezo eha wemo sowi mo fuazokac?”
Iŋuc mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Juku maŋ bâsifuc eŋarenʒipiŋte sawaŋ‐ŋeŋic qahuc junʒepieŋ.
Ŋic bocjahazi fisirâ nore ʒâŋeo âke hotahuc, ‘No Kristo hâcne’ muhuctecne ŋic wemo afecne maŋ bâsifuc ejareniŋmu.
Erâ ʒika fârine â ojowane fuame manarâ maŋŋeŋic gâckeme dameŋ tarakac mi munʒepieŋ. Wiac i mâc jauraŋne fuaocmu.
Mâreŋne mâreŋne ŋic guru sâko guru pitic jaŋe rârâsi efârerâ ra qa ware qa ehuc qaqac ranʒoŋgopieŋ. Ehame roroczi roroc fuazokac, â homeŋ ra ba ware ba ezokac.
Erâ i mâc gozi kikine sawa fuazokac.
“Eme dameŋ ira bugâpâcko râec‐ŋopahuc ŋopa qâhâmoc eŋarenʒoŋgopieŋ. Erâ mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋe nore erâ aaric mana‐ŋarehuc qaisoc‐ŋopanʒoŋgopieŋ.
Wiac i fuame ŋic bocjahazi miti beherâ doc babac ehuc kikisâ enʒoŋgopieŋ.
Erâ wâc porofete jawane fisirâ ŋic bocjaha maŋ bâsifuc ejarenʒoŋgopieŋ.
Erâ miti ima qaqazi haŋ bame maŋjauŋ i ŋic bocjaha jâmbâŋ jaŋerao omaeocmu.
Eme moc e miti paŋnea barâ domakume ine dameŋ tarame rozo.
Eme uucmaŋte Biŋebiaŋ ʒizi haŋ barahuc ŋic gurune gurune fuŋne bataniŋke‐jare‐fâreme dameŋ taraocmu.
“Eme porofete Daniezi dâŋ qâreŋkewec i aimuŋ mac wose manac enʒepieŋ. Dâŋ i hâcne sanaŋkeme wiac mamakâcne sisipiric‐ticnehec tiri ufuŋko domame honeniŋmu.
Iŋuc honerâ Judaia mâreŋko juniŋmuzi tiki mâreŋko wiserâ ranʒepieŋ.
Ehuc moc e hae ʒoŋao juocmuzi ficmaŋ‐ticnao risie ferâ mafa‐ticne mi rozejec.
Â moc e gieo juocmuzi risierâ haeo mi rarâ ŋaqi bilaŋke‐ticne rozejec.
Jei, ŋokac kiwecheczi â susuonecheczi ine weniŋuc enʒoŋgopieŋ!
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ numucnepie maname wiwise‐ŋeŋic hoemaŋko me sabata hombaŋko mi fuazejec.
Eme dameŋ ira bâŋeŋkerâ weaŋsicne nânâ femicne sâko fuazokac, sâc iŋucne mâreŋ fuaweckonecteaŋ mi fuawec â ʒâhec wâc mi fuazokac.
Eme Wofuŋzi dameŋ i mi bâtâcneme muzac, ŋic moczi miti barâ jukume rorone i mi fua‐jâmbâŋkezac. Fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋere erâ ine dameŋ i bâtâcnezokac.
“Eme ‘Kristo e ʒira nâŋerao fuakac’, ‘Kristo e ocna jaŋerao fuakac’, dâŋ iŋuc ra mu ware mu epie mi mananʒepieŋ.
Dameŋ ira Kristo burec burec â porofete jabane fisirâ mâsi â wiac ʒâŋe furu hâhâwicne bahuc ŋic maŋ bâsifuc ejare‐fâreniŋmu. Ehuc Anuture fuŋfuŋfâc maŋjeŋic wâc bâsifuckeniŋte gie sâko baniŋmu. Erâ jaŋe maŋ bâsifuc eejarene mi fokacte eipieniŋmu.
No qanaŋ ŋazakopacte juku fuame mutuc mi enʒepieŋ.
Eme irec ‘Mâreŋ tuhuo Kristo fuame honembeneŋ’ mupie mi ranʒepieŋ, me ‘Fic ira me ira fuajec’ mupie i wâc mi mananʒepieŋ.
Bâbâriczi ŋifec ʒoaŋ wewefunao bâricneme tatamacnezi ŋifec ʒoaŋ huhunao qataraekac, Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne fifisi‐ticne sâc iŋucko fuazokac.
Âsu gâreczi keŋwipe fârec‐jopame fisi tumaŋneeŋgopieŋ.
“Ʒâic fâro â fific guguriŋ i qaʒueha ʒoaŋ gâpârezokac â mosare tatamac arictac ezokac â bâpiŋzi sambâŋkonec tararâ wahanʒoŋgopieŋ. Ehame sambâŋ qiriŋ qame tâpirine ŋeŋgoroŋkezokac.
Eme Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne ere maqâreŋ sambâŋko fuame ŋic mâreŋne mâreŋne kio wâwâsic ehapie Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e sambâŋ karorac faio tâpiri huriri sâko‐ticnehec fisime honenʒoŋgopieŋ.
Eme aŋelofâc‐ticne ejareme jaŋe qeŋ fânâŋ sâko ehuc mâreŋ ŋifec â ŋifec, faic â juwic bâwosâecfâc‐ticne qânusuc‐jopanʒoŋgopieŋ.
“Firindoacte hata fokac irec manasuhuc fuŋne mananʒepieŋ. E âric qame ʒoaŋ dameŋ bembeŋkekac mueŋgopieŋ.
Eme ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha, ŋazakopac wiac i fua‐fâreme ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: E bâqiŋ‐nâpojec, motâc râpeo domakac.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Mâreŋ ʒirec rune mi sisirowe jufehuc juhapie wiac sasawa fua tarazokac.
Sambâŋ â mâreŋ sirowezokopirec, â nore dâŋ ine mi sirowe‐jâmbâŋkezokac.
Erâ wiac fufua irec ʒoaŋ me aua dameŋ ŋic moczi mi mana‐jâmbâŋkekac. Sambâŋ aŋelo jaŋe iŋuc jaha mi manaŋgopieŋ, Ŋokâzi wâc iŋuc jaha mi manakac, Mamac e bucticne manakac.
Noa juwec dameŋ ira ŋic jaŋe wiac embiŋ, ijaha Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne ere fifisi dameŋ maickeha enʒoŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe rumi fisizo ehame nânâ qowi nâmbiŋ, huc ʒocʒu nâmbiŋ, ŋokac nareŋ gareŋ embiŋ. Qâoma iŋuc hâcne ehuc juhapie Noa wokeo fewec.
Eme izi rumi sâko fisirâ bârârâŋ‐jopawec. Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne ere fifisi dameŋko sâc ijaha enʒoŋgopieŋ.
Dameŋ ira ŋic jajahec gieo juhapire moc rohuc moc qikiŋnezo.
Ŋokac jajahec nânâ sufiehuc ŋehapire moc rohuc moc qikiŋnezo.
Wofuŋ‐ŋeŋiczi dameŋ ira me ira fisiocmu i mi manaŋgopieŋte maŋŋeŋiczi rucjari bahuc junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe fuŋne ʒiŋuc mananiŋ, hae mocte ŋic jaŋe, râsi ŋafe ira fisiniŋmu, dameŋ iŋuc manarâ mâŋɋâri jaha juhuc hae‐jeŋic soŋaŋkeniŋmu.
Eme Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e ine dameŋ mi manahapie fisiocmu, irec ŋoŋe wâc ʒawiehuc jaha junʒepieŋ.
“Ŋicbomboŋ moczi kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne jaŋere soŋaŋ moc râehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcneocmu: ‘No ra juhape go soŋaŋ‐jopahuc dameŋ sâc nânâ qowi sâckoa jarehuc juzemec.’ Eme e weniŋuc jume soŋaŋ miti â micrereŋhec mucnezo?
Soŋaŋ e gie mucnekicne i aimuŋ jaha bahuc juhame bomboŋ‐ticnezi fisirâ maname biaŋkeocmu.
No jâmbomac ŋazape, e soŋaŋ kâcɋene râehuc wiac‐ticne mâmâc sasawa soŋaŋkeocte mucneocmu.
Me ŋic e soŋaŋ sâqocne juhuc maŋticnezi ʒiŋuc muocmu: ‘Bomboŋ‐nane e jâpec mâcne, juku jaha risiezokac.’
Iŋuc muhuc kiŋaŋ qaqa qa imac ejarehuc opâ kâteo ra qâoma erâ juocmu.
Ehuc ŋicbomboŋ‐ticne fisiocmu dameŋ irec mi mamanasu mâc juhame e ututuŋ fisirâ
hetâc qâtâcnerâ miti bâbâsifuc ŋic jaŋere jujuo râeocmu. Ira ki oowa ehuc mic kikiaric kihuc foocmu.
“Sambâŋte kikefuŋ ine naru ŋokac 10 jumbiŋ jaŋerao sâc hepe: Jaŋe ŋicbomboŋ hatao bâfuaniŋte lambe‐jeŋic barâ rambiŋ.
Naru ŋokac 5 jaŋe mutucne â 5 jaŋe mamanahec.
Mutucne jaŋe lambe‐jeŋic sawa bambiŋ, kiruŋko opâne ine mi rombiŋ.
Mamanahec jaŋe ine lambe‐jeŋic rohuc kiruŋko opâne mâmâc bambiŋ.
Eme ŋicbomboŋ e jume ʒorame woŋec ŋeku dockerâ guŋ fombiŋ.
Fohapie ŋafe ʒâŋiŋkeme wiwira moc kecʒiŋuc fuawec: ‘Ŋicbomboŋ warekac, ajoc, faharerâ ra bâfuaniŋ!’
Eme naru ŋokac jaŋe mana ɋâɋârerâ faharerâ lambe‐jeŋic ba bâpiaŋ embiŋ.
Eme mutucne jaŋe mamanahec ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: ‘Nâŋe lambe‐nâŋec hâpokac, irec ŋoŋe opâ moc qoŋgiŋke‐nâreniŋ.’
Mupie mamanahec jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: ‘I wemocko ezo, opâ i mâmâc jaha mi sâcnâpoocmu. Ŋoŋe situâcko rarâ furine baniŋ‐ŋeŋic.’
Eme jaŋe lambe opâ furine bazo rahapie ŋicbomboŋ e fisirâ naru ŋokac ʒawierâ lambe‐jeŋichec domambiŋ jaŋe jowac‐jopame rambiŋ. Erâ haeo fisirâ ficko ferâ motâc ki barâ tiwâ bâzi nâhuc ŋembiŋ.
Ŋehapie naru ŋokac mutucne jaŋe warerâ wirahuc mumbiŋ, ‘Bomboŋ‐nâŋec, motâc ronârec mac.’
Wirapie jazawec, ‘No jâmbomac ŋazape, no ŋoŋe ʒâŋe ruruŋ‐ŋopakopac.’
Dameŋ mi manaŋgopieŋte maŋŋeŋiczi rucjari bahuc junʒepieŋ.
“Juki ŋicbomboŋ moczi ewec irec sâcko fuazokac. Ŋicbomboŋ moczi mâreŋ wiwicko raocte soŋaŋfâc‐ticne hefârec‐joparâ moneŋ‐ticne soŋaŋkecneniŋte bâtâc bajarewec.
Ehuc soŋaŋ moc moneŋfoŋ 5 râcnewec, moc foŋ 2 râcnewec, moc foŋ 1 râcnewec. I giere tâpiri fojarewec sâc manahuc iŋuc ejarewec. Moneŋ jare‐fârerâ rawec.
Raha rahame izia soŋaŋ moneŋfoŋ 5 roweczi fuŋkerâ giene bahuc kime kiŋ qakume moneŋfoŋ 5 jaha kitâcnewec.
Â âgone foŋ 2 rowec eki iŋuc jaha ekume foŋ 2 jaha kitâcnewec.
Foŋ mocjaha rowec eki ine bomboŋ‐ticnere moneŋ bararâ duckeme fowec.
Eme ŋicbomboŋ‐jeŋic dameŋ ʒora juku risiewec. Risierâ soŋaŋ moneŋte hetumaŋ‐jopawec.
Eme moneŋfoŋ 5 râcnekicne eki fisirâ foŋ furune 5 jaha râehuc muwec, ‘Bomboŋ‐nane, go moneŋfoŋ 5 naremeŋ, eme noni giene bahuc hotâckekupe 5 jaha mocwâc fuawec.’
Mume bomboŋ‐ticnezi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Kiŋaŋ motec biaŋne â micrereŋhec, go wiac omanere soŋaŋ sâcne jumeŋte noni wiac fârinere soŋaŋ râecgupemu, irec go bomboŋgere ʒerimaŋko raʒizemec.’
Iŋuc mume soŋaŋ foŋ 2 râcnekicne eki fisirâ muwec, ‘Bomboŋ‐nane, go moneŋfoŋ 2 naremeŋ, eme noni giene bahuc hotâckekupe 2 jaha mocwâc fuapic.’
Mume bomboŋ‐ticnezi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Kiŋaŋ motec biaŋne â micrereŋhec, go wiac omanere soŋaŋ sâcne jumeŋte noni wiac fârinere soŋaŋ râecgupemu, irec go Wofuŋgere ʒerimaŋko raʒizemec.’
“Mume ʒâhec moneŋfoŋ mocjaha râcnekicne eki fisirâ muwec, ‘Bomboŋ, no fuŋnege kecʒiŋuc manakopac, go ŋic gereŋ gereŋne, go gie he sarac mi ehuc nareckonec nânâ bâfuarâ gagarere muekic, erâ kise ficko mi guruckehuc mâc sawaonec bâfuarâ gagarere muekic.
Eme no irec hâwicnume moneŋge duckepe fowec, eme ʒi bârisie‐garekopac.’
Mume bomboŋ‐ticnezi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: ‘Go kiŋaŋ motec sâqocne â ojoŋne. No gie mi he sarac ehuc nareckonec nânâ bâfuarâ nanarere muekopac, â kise ficko mi guruckehuc mâc sawaonec nanarere muekopac,
nore iŋuc manahuc moneŋ‐nane moneŋŋic jaŋerao râetec jaŋe kime kiŋ qakupie sawehame risierâ rozapo.
Irec ŋoŋe moneŋfoŋ jâoc rorâ foŋ 10 bajukac e râcneniŋ.
Moc e wiac râcnekicne i bajume kiqecnecnezo, eme mâriri fuacnezejec, â moc e wiac râcnekicne mi bajume jâoc rozo, eme mâc juzejec.
Kiŋaŋ motec ojoŋne ine ro duŋdapâcko sârockepie huzejec. Ira ki oowa ehuc mic kikiaric kihuc fozejec.’
“Juku Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e sambâŋ hawari‐ticnehec â aŋelo guru ŋondeŋnao fisirâ eri ŋeŋe‐ticnao fe ŋezokac.
Ehuc ŋic mâreŋne mâreŋne hefârec‐jopame ere maio tumaŋne‐fârenʒoŋgopieŋ. Eme soŋaŋ moczi lama â noniŋ bâtâc bacjopaekac, iŋuc bâtâc bacjoparâ
lama fârenaopec guru bacjopaocmu â noniŋ qananaopec guru bacjopaocmu.
Iŋuc erâ Wofuŋ Sâko e fârenaopec ʒiŋuc jazaocmu: ‘Mamac‐nanezi jambuŋ‐ŋopawec ŋoŋe ware sambâŋ hae mâreŋ‐ŋeŋic rauckeniŋ, i mârâc jaha mâreŋ fuaweckonecteaŋ biŋe qaŋarekicne.
Ŋoŋe wiac kecʒiŋuc enarembiŋ irec: Nânâre enareme nânâ gumecnumbiŋ. Opâre enareme opâ gumecnumbiŋ. Ŋeŋe hae tâmiric juhape ŋoŋe hezu hewâneŋ enarembiŋ.
Ŋaqi basape ŋoŋe moc qikiŋne‐narembiŋ. Huc fohape ŋoŋe jauŋ bacnumbiŋ. Kâpâcwâru ficko ŋehape ŋoŋe iqicnumbiŋ.’
Iŋuc mume biaŋkekicnezi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecneniŋmu: ‘Wofuŋ, go wena moc nânâre egareme nânâ gumecgumbeŋ? Me wena moc opâre egareme opâ gumecgumbeŋ?
Me wena moc ŋeŋe hae tâmiric juhaŋtec hezu hewâneŋ egarembeŋ? Me wena moc ŋaqi basatec qikiŋne‐garembeŋ?
Me wena moc hucko me kâpâcwâru ficko ŋehaŋtec iqicgumbeŋ?’
“Mupie Wofuŋ e ʒiŋuc jazaocmu: ‘No jâmbomac ŋazape, qomâfâc‐nane wahakicne jaŋeraonec mocjaha mac âgo jauŋ ecnembiŋ i no enarembiŋ ekac.’
Iŋuc murâ qanaopec jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazaocmu: ‘Sâwec‐ŋopakicne, ŋoŋe Mamac‐nanezi Sataŋ â aŋelofâc‐ticne ʒocsanaŋ ruqe‐jarewec ira hurâ junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe kecʒiŋuc embiŋ irec: No nânâre enareme nânâ mi gumecnumbiŋ. Opâre enareme opâ mi gumecnumbiŋ.
Ŋeŋe hae tâmiric juhape hezu hewâneŋ mi enarembiŋ. Ŋaqi basape moc mi qikiŋne‐narembiŋ. Hucko â kâpâcwâru ficko fohape mi iqicnumbiŋ.’
Iŋuc jazame qanaopec jaŋe ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Wofuŋ, go wena moc nânâ opâ tâmiric, me ŋaqi fic hae tâmiric jutecne hone qâoma egarembeŋ? Me wena moc hucko me kâpâcwâru ficko fohaŋtec hone takic egarembeŋ?’
Mupie e ʒiŋuc jazaocmu: ‘No jâmbomac ŋazape, qomâfâc‐nane wahakicne jaŋeraonec mocjaha mac âgo jauŋ mi ecnembiŋ i no mi enarembiŋ ekac.’
Eme jaŋe sisipiric sanaŋ haeo huniŋmu, â biaŋkekicne jaŋe juju sanaŋ haeo feniŋmu.”
Jesu e dâŋ i sasawa muku mufârerâ motecfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Fureme aakic hombaŋ maickeocmu, i manaŋgopieŋ. Eme ira Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e ŋic jaŋere meo feme maripoŋko qaniŋmu.”
Eme dameŋ ira taha bapa micne â soŋaŋ jaŋe taha bapa sâko Kaifa ere tutumaŋ ficko fefârerâ
Jesu kamierâ rorâ qaniŋte dâŋ mumockembiŋ.
Ehuc mumbiŋ, “Hombaŋko misac, ŋic bâiŋ‐jopapene ʒika kosa fuazackohec.”
Eme Jesu e Betania haeo rarâ Simoŋ wicsanaŋ ecnewec ere ficko nânâ nâwec.
Nâhuc ŋehame ŋokac moczi erao rarâ opâ âsu biaŋ furi sâko ere qizecko hesieme ruacnewec.
Iŋuc eme motec jaŋe honerâ mu takic erâ mumbiŋ, “Wiac furi sâko wemocte sipirickekac?
Izi moneŋ bocjaha kitâcneme ŋic hapetac jarepene sâckezac.”
Mupie Jesuzi manarâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe wemocte ŋokac mumu hehec ecneŋgopieŋ me? Ŋokac e jauŋ bacnume biaŋkekac.
Ŋic hapetac dameŋ sâc ŋoŋerao juniŋmu, no ine ŋoŋerao boc mi jupemu.
No biac hâmope ducnuniŋmu, irec qanaŋ sahac‐nane mâzockekac.
No jâmbomac ŋazape, miti mâreŋne mâreŋne murahuc ŋokac kecʒi mâzocnukac irec biŋedâŋ mâmâc murapie haŋ baocmu.”
Eme motecfâcne 12 jaŋeraonec moc ʒâŋene Juda Karioto haeonec eki taha bapa micne jaŋerao rarâ
kecʒiŋuc jazawec: “No doc baŋarepe ŋoŋe moneŋ wezimuc nareniŋmu?” Wio‐jareme izia siliwa moneŋ 30 wose biric ecnepie rowec.
Rorâ Jesu doc bame roniŋte hone jâjâpehuc juwec.
Eme goreŋ sowa jujumbieŋ irec dameŋ maickeme motec jaŋe Sekiqanâcko Jesu indiŋkerâ mumbiŋ, “Nâŋe miŋecgac fic wena aakic tiwâ rike bâmoc egarenʒepeneŋ?”
Mupie jazawec, “Ŋoŋe haeo ferâ ŋicmae ʒiŋuc âzâcnenʒepieŋ: ‘Qaqazu‐nâŋec e gore mukac, dameŋ‐nane bembeŋkekacte gorao fârâ motecfâc‐nane jaŋehec aakic tiwâ nanaŋte mukopac.’”
Eme Jesuzi muwec dâŋ i motecfâcne reŋke‐fârerâ aakic tiwâ rike bâmoc embiŋ.
Hae ŋafeme Jesu e motecfâcne 12 rocjopame fic ira ferâ aakic tiwâ nâmbiŋ.
Nâhuc Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No jâmbomac ŋazape, ŋoŋeraonec moczi no doc bacnuocmu.”
Mume motec jaŋe bujeŋic mâretec sâqoreme moc moc wiocne rahuc mumbiŋ, “Wofuŋ, nore wiac moc murâ?”
Eme eki ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Sicko nohec mâmâc poroŋ âke uruckeperec eki doc bacnuocmu.
Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e mitio hata muʒâwecnekicne ira razo ekac hâcne. Â Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne doc baocmu e ine, jei, okacne mo iŋucne roocmu. Ŋic e neŋgoc bumaŋkonec mi fuame muzac, afeckecnezac.”
Iŋuc mume Juda doc bapa eki iŋuc jaha wiocnerâ muwec, “Qaqazu, nore wiac moc murâ?” Mume âzâcnewec, “Goki hâcne.”
Eme tiwâ nârâ Jesuzi poroŋ rorâ jambuŋkerâ bazurâ motecfâcne ʒiŋuc muhuc jarewec: “Ro nâniŋ, kecʒi fâri‐nane.”
Iŋuc murâ waiŋ râqâc rorâ daŋge murâ ʒiŋuc muhuc jarewec: “Ŋoŋe mâmâc sasawa nâniŋ,
kecʒi ʒâʒâfic ɋâricnere socnane. Ŋoŋere kiŋ taraocte qikiŋnekicne.
Erâ ŋazape mananiŋ, mâreŋko waiŋ opâ miŋecgac natarakopac, eme mocwâc mi nânâ juku Mamac‐nanere uucmaŋko ŋoŋehec waiŋ opâ fuŋmoc nânʒoŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme gae herâ haeonec rahurâ ocniŋuc Oliwa tikio fembiŋ.
Hatao rahuc Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋafe ʒira ŋoŋe nore mâmâc sasawa manapie sâqoreocmu. Dâŋqâreŋ moc kecʒiŋuc fokac i sanaŋkeocmu hâcne: ‘No soŋaŋ qape lama jaŋe siŋsaŋ qaniŋmu.’
Eme hâmockonec faharerâ ine Galilaia mâreŋko rahuc bânie‐ŋarepemu.”
Mume Petorozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Gâcne jaŋe mâmâc sasawa gore manapie sâqoreocmu mecne, â noni ine gore manape sâsâqore i moc mi epemu.”
Iŋuc mume Jesuzi âzâcnewec, “No jâmbomac gazape manac, goki ŋafe ʒira qâqâczi mi dâŋehame mic bacnutec jahec â moc eocmu.”
Eme Petorozi muwec, “Go gahacne guhuc no mâmâc nuzo mupie sifu mi mic bacgupemu.” Eme motec âgofâcne bafickerâ ijaha mumbiŋ.
Eme raku jufu moc ʒâŋene Gezemane ira fisirâ Jesuzi motec ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ʒira ŋehapie noni ocna rarâ numupemu.”
Iŋuc murâ Petoro â Ʒebedaio ŋokâ jahec‐ticne rocjopame rambiŋ. Rahuc fuŋkerâ hâhâwic manarâ me kikene fâfârewec.
Iŋuc ehuc jazarâ muwec, “Maŋnane hâhâtâweme hâhâmocne enarekac, irec ŋoŋe ʒira ŋehuc nohec mâmâc maŋɋâri junʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc jazarâ ipec rarâ ʒâŋe maine mâreŋko hetutuckerâ kecʒiŋuc muhuc numuwec: “Mamac‐nane, manatec eene ekacko ʒâic guru ʒi nowaruoc. Erâ nore dâŋ mâcne, gore dâŋ sanaŋkezejec.”
Iŋuc numurâ motec jahec â moc jaŋerao risierâ guŋ fohapie honec‐joparâ Petoro ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋoŋe nohec piticne ɋâricne sâcne mi junʒapiŋ me?
Eesâicko dockenʒipiŋte maŋɋâri juhuc numuniŋ. Maŋzi afeckekac, sahaczi ine ŋemâckekac.”
Eme mocwâc rarâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc numuwec: “Mamac‐nane, ʒâic guru ʒi nowaruocte manatec mi sâckeme sifu mana‐fârepe gore dâŋ sanaŋkezejec.”
