Iŋuc murâ risierâ motec jaŋe ʒâŋe‐jeŋic guŋtea eme qâmâc‐jopame fohapie bâfuac‐jopawec.
Irec mocwâc behec‐joparâ ra numume jahec â moc ewec. Dâŋ mârâc muwec ijaha muhuc numuwec.
Numu‐fârerâ motec jaŋerao risierâ jazawec, “Ŋoŋe guŋ jaha fohuc fomanaŋgopieŋ me? Ʒi dameŋ maickekac. Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e doc bapie sâqocne bapa jaŋere meo fekac.
Faharepie ranaŋ, ʒi docbapazi bâqiŋnukac ine.”
Iŋuc jazahuc domahame mi motec 12 âgo‐jeŋic Juda eki râsi guru sâko micne bajareme ututuŋ fisinʒepieŋ i! Taha bapa micne â soŋaŋ jaŋe sorec‐jopapie ʒika ɋaruc wiac barâ fisimbiŋ hâcne.
Eme docbapazi ine qanaŋ sâcmutâc kecʒiŋuc jazawec: “Muduckepe honerâ ine hâcne muhuc ronʒepieŋ.”
Eme fisirâ izia Jesurao rarâ, “O qaqazu‐nane” murâ muduckewec.
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Âgo, gie bazo muhuc waremec i bazemec.” Mume jaŋe ware rorâ mene bândeŋnembiŋ.
Eme Jesuhec jumbiŋ jaŋeraonec moczi sâqe‐ticne becsahackonec unuckerâ taha bapa sâko kiŋaŋ motec‐ticne qaocte hazecne qatarawec.
Iŋuc eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Sâqege becsahacko râec huoc. Moc e ʒika qarâ okacne ʒika jaha kiocmu.
Me go nore weniŋuc mukomec? Mamac‐nane numucnepe ʒiŋuczia mi aŋelo guru sâko 12 sorec‐jopame waha ŋezicnuniŋmu me?
Erâ waha ŋezicnupie ine mitio nore findaŋdâŋ mukicne i weniŋuc deŋkezac?”
Iŋuc murâ ŋicguru e roniŋte warembiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe nore manapie ʒika qaqa eme ʒika ɋaruc‐ŋeŋichec warerâ rocnuŋgopieŋ me? No ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne taha ufuŋko ŋic miti qazu‐jarehuc juekopac, ehame ŋoŋe ira mi rocnumbiŋ.
Erâ wiac ʒi ine porofete jaŋere dâŋ sanaŋke‐fâreocte fua‐fârekac.” Eme motec jaŋe mâmâc sasawa Jesu beherâ wise‐fârembiŋ.
Momori jaŋe Jesu rorâ taha bapa sâko Kaifa erao barambiŋ. Ere ficko hâcne miti qaqazu â soŋaŋ tumaŋnerâ ŋembiŋ.
Eme Jesu barahapie Petoro e hone ŋetarac ejarehuc ʒâhec rawec. Raku fisirâ taha bapa sâkore sacmaŋko raʒirâ kiŋaŋ motec jaŋere ŋondeŋko ʒiŋuc muhuc waha ŋewec: “Jesure dâŋ weniŋuc mutaraniŋmu, i ʒira ŋehuc hone manac ezepac.”
Eme taha bapa micne â micne guru furu jaha ŋehuc Jesure dâŋburec bâfuarâ qorickehuc ʒikao râeniŋte dâŋ mana wosâembiŋ.
Ehuc dâŋburec bocjaha mufuarâ manapie ŋemâcne mi eme basahuc jaha ŋembiŋ. Eku ŋic jajahec fuarâ
ʒiŋuc mupic: “Jesu e, ‘noni Anuture ufuŋ heropierâ ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha mocwâc bâzickepemu’ iŋuc mume manapec.”
Mupire taha bapa sâkozi faharerâ Jesu ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Gore dâŋ muŋgopieŋ i ŋifecne moc muzo mukomec me aricne?”
Mume Jesuzi dâŋemâc domawec. Iŋuc domame taha bapa sâkozi mocwâc ecnerâ muwec, “Anutu juju sanaŋ ere maio esâicgupe musanaŋkec, go Kristo Anuture Ŋokâ me mâcne?”
Esâickeme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ine hâcne mukomec. Erâ moc ŋazape mananiŋ: Juku Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e tâpiri rune ere fârenao domahuc sambâŋ karorac faio waha fisime hone ʒâirenʒoŋgopieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume taha bapa sâkozi dâŋ i maname gâpâreme maŋrâŋgeŋ bâfuarâ ŋicfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “E Anutu âkehockekac, irec wemocte mocwâc munaŋmu?
Dâŋ i ŋaŋac manarâ weniŋuc muŋgopieŋ?” Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “E ʒikare biŋe ekac.”
Iŋuc murâ Jesu ʒâŋe maine tâfeckehuc mehuhuŋzi he tutuŋ ecnembiŋ, â gâcnezi metatapezi maucnao qambiŋ.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Kristo go porofete jukomeczi muc, ŋic gukac ʒâŋene mo?”
Iŋuc ehuc juhapie Petoro e sacmaŋko hae ʒoŋao ŋewec. Ŋehame kiŋaŋ naru moczi erao rarâ muwec, “Goki hâcne Galilaia ŋic ehec juekomec.”
Eme eki ŋic ŋembiŋ jaŋere maio mic barâ muwec, “Go dâŋ mukomec i kâuc bakopac.”
Iŋuc murâ motâcko huzo ehame kiŋaŋ naru moczi honerâ ŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋic keci Jesu Nazarete haeonec ehec juekac.”
Jazame Petorozi Anuture maio mupaŋkehuc mocwâc mic barâ muwec, “No ŋic e mi honeekopac.”
Iŋuc murâ domahame ŋic jaŋe Petororao rarâ mumbiŋ, “Nâŋe dâŋ hawarige mana taraŋgopeneŋ, go jâmbomac jaŋere guruonec.”
Âzâcnepie mocwâc Anuture maio mupaŋkehuc dâŋ kosa muhuc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No ŋic e mi honeekopac.” Mume izia qâqâc dâŋewec.
Eme Jesuzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Qâqâczi mi dâŋeha go mic bacnutec jahec â moc eocmu”, dâŋ i manasurâ rarâ ki kâcɋene kiowec.
Hae fureme taha bapa micne â soŋaŋ jaŋe furu jaha tumaŋnehuc Jesu ʒika kirâ hâmoocte mupaŋkembiŋ.
Erâ mupie Jesu mejahecne bândeŋnerâ bararâ kia Pilato erao râembiŋ.
Hâmoocte mupaŋkembiŋ, i Juda docbapazi hone manac erâ, wemocte iŋuc epac, muhuc bune sâqoreme siliwa moneŋ 30 râcnembiŋ i ameckerâ taha bapa micne â soŋaŋ bârisie‐jarewec;
ehuc jaza muwec, “No burec erâ kiŋ tâmiricko doc bape sâqorekac.” Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Nâŋerao wemocte ware mukic? I go gahacne wiac.”
Iŋuc muhuc moneŋ qikiŋnepie bara taha ufuŋko wickeme feme siŋ herâ ra bituawec.
Eme taha bapa micne â soŋaŋ jaŋe siliwa moeŋ 30 qâzuckerâ mumbiŋ, “Moneŋ i ʒika furi, mitire katapao râepene mi sâckeocmu.”
Eme moneŋ izi wemo ezo, muhuc nazaŋ gazaŋ erâ kuʒi bapa ŋic ere mâreŋ, ŋic furune jaŋere ʒâŋeruŋ gie ira fuaocte furine bambiŋ.
Eme mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe Ʒikamâreŋ mupie sanaŋkewec fokac.
Eme porofete Jeremia ere dâŋ fârinehec ewec, dâŋ kecʒiŋuc: “Israe ŋic jaŋe furi‐ticnere sâc siliwa moneŋ 30 mumbiŋ,
ŋickitâc moneŋ izi hâcne kuʒi bapa ŋic ere mâreŋ furine bambiŋ. Wofuŋzi nazawec ijaha embiŋ.”
Eme jaŋe Jesu barapie kiare maio domahame kiazi wiocnerâ muwec, “Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ go hâcne me?” Eme Jesuzi muwec, “Ine hâcne mukomec.”
Eme taha bapa micne â soŋaŋ jaŋe qorickehuc domahapie dâŋ okacne moc mi bâtikie‐jarewec.
Iŋuc eme Pilatozi wiocnerâ muwec, “Gore dâŋ ŋemâcne mupie wemocte ŋifecne moc mi mukomec?”
Eme Jesuzi dâŋ moc mi âzâcne huŋgaŋkeme kiazi mâretec wareckewec.
Aakic hombaŋ sâc kia e Judaŋic jaŋe kâpâcwâru ŋic moc ʒâŋene mupie akickerâ firue‐jare jujec.
Eme dameŋ ira ʒika qaqa repicne moczi kâpâcwâru ficko fowec, ʒâŋene Baraba.
Eme ŋic tumaŋne‐fârerâ domahapie Pilatozi wio‐jarewec, “Mo akickepemurâ muŋgopieŋ, Baraba me Jesu, ʒâŋene moc Kristo mueŋgopieŋ?”
Judaŋic jaŋe Jesu mâc aaric manacnehuc erao râembiŋ, i manahuc hâcne iŋuc muwec.
Eme kia e dâŋ mumutara ŋeŋe‐ticnao ŋehame ŋonâŋ‐ticnezi erao dâŋ ʒiŋuc râeme rawec: “Go ŋic tiŋne ere dâŋ mi bâuac, no miŋecgac guŋ manahuc ere erâ ʒâic mâretec manapac.”
Ehame taha bapa micne â soŋaŋ jaŋe ŋic qafeŋ‐jopahuc mumbiŋ, “Mupie Baraba akickehuc Jesu qazejec.”
Eme kiazi mocwâc indiŋ‐joparâ muwec, “E me e akickepemurâ muŋgopieŋ?” Jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Baraba.”
Mupie jazawec, “Eme Jesu, ʒâŋene moc Kristo mueŋgopieŋ, ere weniŋuc ezepac?” Jazame micne mic sâc musereckehuc mumbiŋ, “E maripoŋko hâmooc!”
Eme kiazi mocwâc jazawec, “Wemo kiŋte?” Mume owa ruruckerâ mumbiŋ, “Maripoŋko hâmooc!”
Iŋuc epie Pilatozi bâmâteŋ‐jopa‐bipieme dâŋ ojowa fetone fepie mume opâ râcnepie meticne mai‐jeŋicko ʒurehuc muwec, “Ŋic tiŋne ere kiŋzi norao mi bohotazejec, i ŋoŋe qikiŋne‐ŋarekopac.”
Mume jaŋe micne mic sâc musereckehuc mumbiŋ, “Kiŋticne nâŋe â ɋârifâc‐nâŋec nâŋerao fozejec.”
Eme Baraba qikiŋne‐jarerâ Jesu becsahac biriŋneheczi qâʒâickerâ maripoŋko qaniŋte momori râe‐jarewec.
Eme kiare momorifâc gâcne jaŋe Jesu fickonec bawaharâ ficrâpeo sacmaŋko baferâ mupie momori mâmâc sasawa tumaŋnembiŋ.
Tumaŋne‐fârehuc Jesu e jahacne ŋaqi heunuckerâ momori ŋaqi bâbâroŋ hecnepie huwec.
Erâ mucʒârâzi hendiŋ ba akic erâ qizecnao hecnepie huwec. Erâ gunu moc râcnepie mefârenezi barâ domawec. Iŋuc erâ maŋfuŋnao ra dieŋzi hecnerâ sâckehuc mumbiŋ, “Ohec, Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ!”
Eme tâfeckehuc gunu jâoc rorâ izia qizecnao qambiŋ.
Qa sâsâc ecneku momori ŋaqi heunuckecnerâ e jahacne ŋaqi mocwâc hecnepie hume maripoŋko qaniŋte jowa rambiŋ.
Bararâ hatao ŋic moc bâfuambiŋ, ʒâŋene Simoŋ, Kirene haeonec, e ʒoɋac ecnepie Jesu maripoŋ bacneme rambiŋ.
Raku mâreŋ moc ʒâŋene Goligata, Kâtedâŋko utusiec, ira fisimbiŋ.
Fisirâ waiŋ opâ â hâhâtâ bâsifuckekicne gumezo mupie nâhonerâ qikiŋnewec.
Eme maripoŋko qambiŋ. Qapie domahame ŋaqi‐ticnere ɋâsâi qahuc bâtâc bambiŋ.
Iŋuc erâ waha soŋaŋ‐ticne ŋembiŋ.
Eme qizec botâŋnao fuŋne‐ticne kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne fowec: “Ʒi Jesu Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ.”
Eme ʒika qaqa jajahec ehec mâmâc maripoŋko joparâ moc ŋifec â moc ŋifec iŋuc râec‐jofambiŋ.
Eme ira rac warec embiŋ ŋic i jaŋe Jesu mufec muriŋ ecnehuc sâke kiki dâŋ âzâcnembiŋ.
Ʒiŋuc: “Si, taha ufuŋ heropierâ ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha bâzickezo mumeŋzi gahacne sahac ŋezickec me. Go Anuture Ŋokâ jukomecko maripoŋkonec wahac me.”
Eme taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu â soŋaŋ jaŋe iŋuc jaha âke sisic ecnehuc mumbiŋ,
“Ŋic gâcne bafic‐jopaweczi e jahacne sahac ŋezicke‐bipiekac. E Israe ŋic nâŋâcne ŋicwofuŋ jukacko maripoŋkonec wahame erao sâcne roweckenaŋmu.
Eki ‘no Anuture Ŋokâ’ muhuc mamanasiŋ‐ticne Anuturao râeme fowec, irec Anutuzi ere ecnekacko bataraoc me.”
Erâ ʒika qaqa ehec mâmâc jopakicne jahe iŋuc jaha mu ruruc ecnepic.
Iŋuc ecnehapie 12 kilok ira dapâc fuarâ mâreŋ sâckerâ fokuhame 3 kilok ewec.
Eme 3 kilok ira Jesuzi wiwic jaha wirarâ muwec, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani”. Kâtedâŋko: “Anutu‐nane, Anutu‐nane, wemocte behecnukomec?”
Eme domambiŋ jaŋeraonec tucnezi manarâ mumbiŋ, “Elia wâsickekac.”
Â ŋic moczi manarâ bâruŋ jaha gasacke rarâ hâwec sâmbiŋ moc rorâ baŋac opâ ʒaʒacnao âke uruckerâ huti tofanao bândeŋnerâ Jesu gumewec.
Ehame gâcnezi mumbiŋ, “Go behehaŋ, Elia jâmbomac ware batarame wahame honenaŋ.”
Eme Jesu e mocwâc kâcɋene wirame mâro‐ticne wefu‐fârewec.
Hâmome taha ufuŋko qoruc ââketâc sâko i mi faicnec ʒâʒâŋiŋ jaha suckeha waha tarazejec i! Erâ mâreŋ itiriŋkeme heâŋko qânâ fâuckeme hârâc rowec.
Eme ʒâŋeruŋ forawec i aŋkeme mitiŋic mârâc hâmombiŋ jaŋeraonec gâcnezi ɋârembiŋ.
Eme Jesu e jahacne micne barâ fahareme jaŋe ʒâŋeruŋ‐jeŋickonec wefurâ miti hae qizecko ferâ ŋic bocjaha fua‐jarembiŋ.
Momori soŋaŋ â ŋicfâc‐ticne Jesure soŋaŋ domambiŋ jaŋe ine homeŋ â wiac gâcne hone manac erâ weaŋkerâ mumbiŋ, “Ŋic ʒizi jâmbomac Anuture Ŋokâ juwec.”
Jesu qambiŋ ira ŋokac bocjaha taicko domahuc wiac hone manac embiŋ. Jaŋe Jesu Galilaia mâreŋkonec bâjâpe warehuc kiŋaŋ qacnembiŋ.
Maria Madala haeonec, erâ Maria wasene, Jakobo â Jose jahere neŋgoc, erâ ŋokac moc, Ʒebedaio ŋokâ jahec‐ticne jahere neŋgoc, jaŋe mâmâc jumbiŋ.
Hae owâeme Arimataia haeonec mafaŋic moc ʒâŋene Josefe, Jesure miti manahuc juwec, eki warewec.
Warerâ Pilatorao rarâ Jesu qâŋɋâŋ‐ticnere âzâcneme manarâ mume momori jaŋe qikiŋnecnembiŋ.
Eme Josefezi qâŋɋâŋ rorâ qoruc qaŋqaŋ furune moczi râpâckerâ barawec.
Bararâ qânâ hâŋko e jahacne ʒâŋeruŋ biŋe hawecne gufukicne ira Jesu râerâ qorac sâko moc qârândiŋkeme motâc ŋebâzickeme rawec.
Eme ʒâŋeruŋ ramicnao ira Maria Madala haeonec â Maria âgo‐ticne jahe ŋehuc honepic.
Hae fureme Sondagieo ira taha bapa micne â farisaio ŋic jaŋe qâturerâ Pilatorao rambiŋ.
Erâ mumbiŋ, “Bomboŋ‐nâŋec, nâŋe dâŋ moc manasumbeneŋ gazanaŋ. Burecŋic e ɋâricne juhuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: ‘Hâmorâ ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha ɋârerâ faharepemu.’
Eme motecfâcne jaŋe rarâ qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne fiuc bawiserâ ‘Hâmockonec faharejec’ muhuc burec ejarenʒipiŋte mutecne momori jaŋe ʒâŋeruŋko soŋaŋ paŋnea ŋehapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc tarazejec. Mârâc burec fohame ʒâhec bureczi fainao feme siwiŋnezacte manabâc erâ gazaŋgopeneŋ.”
Mupie Pilatozi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Sâcne, momori ŋarekopac. Jowac‐jopa rarâ ʒâŋeruŋ iŋuc me iŋuc manaŋgopieŋ sâc fitec qapie ŋezejec.”
Mume jaŋe momori jaŋehec rarâ ʒâŋeruŋ fitec qarâ qânâ faio doc sipuac râembiŋ.
Sabata hombaŋ tarame Sondao hae fufurecte Maria Madala haeonec â Maria âgone jahe ʒâŋeruŋ honenicte rapic.
Rahapire homeŋ sâko ɋeŋfâfâc jaha bame Wofuŋte aŋelo moczi sambâŋkonec waharâ qânâ tuŋkeme rârieme fainao ŋewec.
Hawari‐ticne bâbâric hawari â ŋaqi‐ticne qaŋqaŋ kisieckekicne.
Eme soŋaŋ jaŋe honerâ maŋjeŋic bâzickeme hâhâmocne ejareme forambiŋ.
Eme ŋokac rafisipire aŋelozi ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ŋohe mi hâwic‐ŋofaoc, no manakopac, ŋohe Jesu maripoŋko qakicne e honenicte warekopirec.
Erâ e ʒira aricne, e qanaŋ ŋazawec iŋuc erâ faharejec. Ŋohe ware fofotacne ʒi honenic.
Erâ biac rarâ motecfâcne ʒiŋuc jazanic: ‘Jesu e hâmockonec faharejec, erâ Galilaia mâreŋko rahuc bânie‐ŋareocmu, ŋoŋe ira honeniŋmu.’ Dâŋ ine hâcne ŋasakopac.”
Eme jahe biac jaha ʒâŋeruŋ râpeckerâ hâhâwic â ʒeri sâko mâmâc manahuc motecfâcne biŋedâŋ jazanicte gagasac jaha rapic.
Rahapire mi Jesuzi bâfuac‐jofazejec i! Bâfuac‐jofarâ jasawec, “Ʒeri enic.” Iŋuc mume jahe maŋfuŋnao fodaperâ kikenao ropic.
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ŋohe mi hâwic‐ŋofaoc, ra qomâfâc‐nane jazapire Galilaia mâreŋko fârâ honecnuniŋmu.”
Ŋokac jahe rahapire ʒâŋeruŋ soŋaŋ jaŋeraonec gâcne biac haeo gasacke ferâ mi wiac fuawec irec binaŋ taha bapa micne jaza‐fârenʒepieŋ i!
Eme jaŋe soŋaŋ hefârec‐joparâ jaŋehec dâŋ muc manac erâ momori moneŋ bocjaha jarembiŋ,
ehuc ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Ŋoŋe kecʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ, ‘Ŋafeo guŋ fohapene motecfâcne jaŋe fisirâ qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne fiuc rombieŋ.’
Dâŋ i kiazi manarâ wiac moc eŋarezacte mi hâwic‐ŋopazejec, nâŋe sâcne mu bâmâteŋ ecnenaŋmu.”
Iŋuc muhuc jazapie momori jaŋe moneŋ i rorâ dâŋ jazakicne i reŋkembiŋ. Eme irec burecdâŋ i Judaŋic jaŋerao haŋ barâ foweczi fokac jaha.
Motec 11 jaŋe ine Galilaia mâreŋko tiki moc Jesuzi qanaŋ mutâcne‐jarewec ira fembiŋ.
Ferâ e jahacne honerâ erao fodapembiŋ. Moc moczi ine maŋguru embiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi maŋfuŋ‐jeŋicko rarâ kecʒiŋuc muhuc jazawec: “Tâpiri sasawa sambâŋte â mâreŋte no nare‐fârekicne.
Irec ŋoŋe mâreŋne mâreŋne rahuc ŋic gurune gurune kikefuŋfâc‐nane bacjopanʒepieŋ, ehuc Mamac â Ŋokâ â Tiri Mâro ere ʒâŋeo ʒuhuc‐jopahuc Miti Opâ rua‐jarenʒepieŋ.
Â dâŋ ŋaza mutâc ehuc jupo i qazu‐jarepie reŋke‐fârenʒepieŋ. Erâ ŋazape mananiŋ, no ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne ŋoŋehec juhape mâreŋte dameŋ tarazokac.”
Jesu Kristo, Anuture Ŋokâ, ere Biŋebiaŋ fuŋkerâ fuawec irec dâŋ.
Porofete Jesajazi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkewec fokac: “Manakic, no kiŋaŋŋic‐nane sorepe eki bânie‐garehuc hata bagarezejec.
Mâreŋ tuhuo wiwira moc fuakac: Wofuŋte hata bâʒâweniŋ, hata‐ticne hepie wâneŋkeoc.”
Dâŋ irec sâcko Johane Miti Opâ fufuŋkezi mâreŋ burocnao fua tâcnerâ, maŋjeŋic bârisierâ Miti Opâ ruapie sâqocne‐jeŋic tâmireocte jazawec.
Eme Judaia mâreŋko â Jerusalem haeo ŋic jumbiŋ jaŋe hegarackerâ erao rarâ sâqocne‐jeŋic mufuapie Jordaŋko opâ rua‐jarewec.
Johane eki ine ŋaqi moc kamele kanʒaŋnezi bakicne i rojuwec erâ becsahac moc ombâŋnao jomawec. Nânâ‐ticne ine ɋâuc bisirec â baŋac nâhuc juwec.
Miti ine kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Râpefuŋ‐naneo warehuc jukac, e tâpiri sâc moc focnekac, e sâko no iŋucnezi mafahe decnepe mi sâckeocmu.
No opâ rua‐ŋareekopac, eki ine Tiri Mâro rua‐ŋareocmu.”
Eme dameŋ ira wiac kecʒiŋuc fuawec: Jesu Nazarete haeonec Galilaia mâreŋkonec ware fisime Johanezi Jordaŋko opâ ruacnewec.
Eme opâonec wefu wefuhuc mi wiac kecʒiŋuc honezejec i: Sambâŋ aŋkeme Mâro e hapâ iŋucne Jesurao wahawec.
Ehame sambâŋkonec dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc fuawec: “Go joroc Ŋokâ biaŋ‐nane, go hone aŋac egareekopac.”
Eme izia Mârozi ecneme mâreŋ burocnao rawec.
Rarâ ira ŋafe ʒoaŋ 40 juhame Sataŋzi esâickewec. E kâte qowi jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhame aŋelo jaŋe kime dopec ecnembiŋ.
Eme Johane kâpâcwâru ficko râepie fohame Jesu e Galilaia mâreŋko fisirâ Anuture uucmaŋ irec Biŋebiaŋ mufuahuc kecʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Dameŋ maickekac, Anuture uucmaŋzi iqic‐ŋopakac. Irec maŋŋeŋic bârisierâ Biŋebiaŋ i ro maŋ enʒepieŋ.”
Juku Jesuzi Galilaia riqic qacne rahuc Simoŋ â ɋaticne Anderea honec‐jofawec. Jahe riqicko wasaŋ‐jekic behehuc domapic. Jahe qowi gie bapa ŋic hâcne.
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ware no bâjâpecnunic, eme ŋicko gie bapa bacŋofapemu.”
Mume izia wasaŋ‐jekic beherâ e bâjâpepic.
Eme Jesuzi piticne rarâ Jakobo, Ʒebedaiore ŋokâ, â ɋaticne Johane bâfuac‐jofawec. Jahe wokeo ŋehuc wasaŋ‐jekic ʒâficke bâpiaŋ ehapire honec‐jofarâ izia
wira‐jacteme manarâ mamac‐jekic Ʒebedaio â gieŋic wokeo ŋehapie behec‐joparâ bâjâpepic.
Eme jaŋe Kafanaum haeo rambiŋ. Eme sabata hombaŋ maickeme Jesuzi mitificko ferâ miti jazawec.
Jazame ŋic jaŋe miti mumu‐ticnere manapie fefene jâmbâŋ ewec. E runezi miti bâutuckehuc jazawec, miti qaqazu jaŋere mumu i mi muwec.
Eme dameŋ ijaha mitific‐jeŋicko ŋic demoŋnehec moc ŋewec, eki owackerâ ʒiŋuc muwec:
“Jesu Nazarete haeonec, go nâŋere jujuo wemocte warekic? Go sipiric‐nâpocmurâ warekomec me? No ʒâŋitacgukopac, go Anuture Tiriŋic.”
Eme Jesuzi dâŋ mucnerâ muwec, “Go niniŋkerâ ŋickonec wefu rac.”
Mume demoŋzi ŋic ba bâsuec ecnehuc owa kâcɋene owackerâ wefu rawec.
Eme ŋic jaŋe bipic‐jeŋic tarame nazaŋ gazaŋ erâ mumbiŋ, “Hâc, i wemo wiac, i miti fuŋmoc, tâpiri sâkohec. Demoŋ dâŋ jazame iŋucnezi wâc micne reŋkeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme biŋe‐ticne biac jaha haŋ barâ Galilaia mâreŋ sâcke‐fârewec.
Eme izia mitifickonec waharâ Jakobo â Johane jahehec Simoŋ â Anderea jahere ficko fembiŋ.
Eme ira Simoŋ safeŋ‐ticne huc ʒocnehec bame fowec. Eme Jesu ficko feme biac âzâcnembiŋ.
Âzâcnepie erao rarâ menao rorâ bafaharewec. Iŋuc ecneme izia hucticne beheme nânâ rike gumec ejarewec.
Eme ʒoaŋ hume owâeme ŋic huc ʒâichec â demoŋhec ʒeŋgoma erao bacjopa warembiŋ.
Erâ hae rune mâmâc sasawa ficmotâckopec tumaŋne‐fârembiŋ.
Eme eki ŋic bocjaha huc fuŋne fuŋnehec ɋiɋic bacjopawec, erâ demoŋ bocjaha jâpe‐jarewec. Ehuc demoŋ jaŋe fuŋne‐ticne manambiŋzi mutaniŋkenʒipiŋte mic muac ejarewec.
Eme hae mi fureha furic dadapâcte faharerâ hae beherâ mâreŋ râricne mocko rarâ numuwec.
Eme Simoŋ â âgofâcne jaŋe bâjâpe raku
bâfuarâ âzâcnembiŋ, “Ŋic jaŋe basacgu‐fâreŋgopieŋ.”
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Nâŋâc hae rârec rârec ŋerakac sâc ranʒepeneŋ wâc. Ehuc miti jazazepac. No gie i hâcne bapemurâ warepac.”
Eme Galilaia mâreŋ fotâcne rac warec ehuc mitificne ficne mita jazahuc juwec â demoŋ jâpe‐jarehuc juwec.
Eme ŋic wicsanaŋhec moczi erao rarâ dieŋzi hecnerâ wâsickehuc muwec, “Go bâsomiecnuzo murâ sâcne bâsomiecnucmu.”
Mume Jesuzi ere bune sâqoreme meticne sicnerâ ŋic bâuahuc âzâcnewec, “Mana‐garekopacte fâsâec.”
Iŋuc âzâcneme izia wicticne somieme sahacne biaŋkewec.
Eme Jesuzi ŋic acmâc sorerâ dâŋ fâfâcnehec ecnehuc ʒiŋuc muwec:
“Manakic, go irec dâŋ binaŋ ŋic moc mi jazazemec. Go ʒiŋuczia taha baparao rarâ sahacge jâutuzemec, erâ fâsâekomec irec bâzi Mosere micdâŋte sâc riketec fuŋne mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Eme ŋic e rarâ dâŋ mume mi qareŋko razejec. Eme irec Jesu e hae kâcɋenao tâtâc raocte maname quŋkewecte hae herâricnao sawa juwec. Eme ira sifu ŋic rârec rârec qiŋ qururuŋko fisihuc domambiŋ.
Jesu e juku mocwâc Kafanaum haeo rarâ fic mocko feme hae rune jaŋe biac manarâ
bocjahazi ere hae ʒoŋao tumaŋnerâ fusucmarâ ficmotâc mâmâc ŋebâzickehapie miti jazawec.
Ehame ŋic 4‐zi ʒeke puriŋ moc erao reŋke fisimbiŋ.
Ehuc maŋfuŋnao râeniŋte ŋicguruo hetakirerâ ficbupuo ferâ Jesure qizec botâŋko bupu bâropiepie hawecne fuame ira ŋic ʒeke puriŋ kanʒehec râepie wahawec.
Iŋuc epie Jesuzi mamanasiŋ‐jeŋicte fuŋne hone manac erâ ŋic ʒeke puriŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Motec‐mae, sâqocnege bâtâmire‐garekicne.”
Eme miti qaqazu tucne ira ŋembiŋ jaŋe maŋjeŋiczi ʒiŋuc manasumbiŋ:
“Hâc, ŋic keci e wemo dâŋ mukac? E Anutu âkehockekac i! Mo ŋiczi sâqocne mutâmireekac, i Anutuzi buc eekac i!”
Iŋuc manasupie Jesu e maŋticnezi mana tara‐jarerâ jazawec, “Maŋŋeŋiczi wemocte dâŋ iŋucne manasuŋgopieŋ?
Wenimoizi afecne, ŋic ʒeke puriŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnezo: ‘Sâqocnege bâtâmire‐garekicne’ me ʒiŋuc âzâcnezo: ‘Fahare fofoge hâporâ rac’?
Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e mâreŋko sâqocne bâtâmireocte tâpiri focnekac irec fuŋne hone taraniŋ!” Iŋuc murâ ŋic ʒeke puriŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“No gazakopac, fahare fofoge ameckerâ ficgao rac.”
Mume izia ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋicko fofo‐ticne ameckerâ rawec. Eme ŋic jaŋe hone warec erâ Anutu mucne bacnehuc mumbiŋ, “Wiac ʒâŋe furu jâmbâŋ‐nâŋec fuame honeŋgopeneŋ.”
Jesu e iŋuc erâ mocwâc riqic moŋgeŋko huwec. Hume ŋic mâmâc sasawa bâjâpepie miti jazawec.
Eme irecnec raku Lewi Alifaiore ŋokâ moneŋfic‐ticnao ŋehame âzâcnerâ muwec, “Ware bâjâpecnuc.” Mume faharerâ bâjâpewec.
Erâ Jesu hefâreme ficticnao ferâ ŋehame takesi roro â sâqocne bapa bocjaha fisirâ Jesu â motecfâcne jaŋehec nânâ mâmâc nâmbiŋ. Ŋic iŋucne bocjahazi Jesu bâjâpembiŋ irec.
Eme farisaio jaŋere guruonec miti qaqazu tucne jaŋe Jesu e takesi roro â sâqocne bapa jaŋehec ŋehuc nânâ nâme honerâ motecfâcne ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Hâc, e wemocte takesi roro â sâqocne bapa jaŋehec ŋehuc nânâ nakac?”
Mupie Jesuzi manarâ jazawec, “Ɋiɋicne jaŋe doktare mi mueŋgopieŋ, huchec jaŋe ine mueŋgopieŋ. No ŋic tiŋne hefârec‐jopazore mâcne, sâqocne bapa hefârec‐jopazore wahapo.”
Johanere motecfâc â farisaio jaŋe dameŋ ira nânâ sowa jumbiŋ. Eme ŋic tucne jaŋe Jesurao rarâ ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnembiŋ: “Johanere motecfâc â farisaio jaŋere motecfâc jaŋe nânâ sowa juhapie gahacne motecfâc jaŋe wemocte sowa tâmiric jueŋgopieŋ?”
Wiocnepie Jesuzi jazawec, “Ŋicwofuŋ e kikefuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋehec juhame busâqoc erâ sowa juniŋmu me? Aricne, ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋichec juhuc wemocko sowa juniŋmu.
Juku ŋicwofuŋ jowac ropie basahuc busâqoc erâ sowa juniŋmu.
Nâŋâc ŋaqi raŋɋane suckekicnao qoruc susuc ɋâricne mi râerâ ɋâtâeŋgopeneŋ. Iŋuc epene muzac, ɋâricnezi raŋɋane fâreme tâcneme hawecne kâcɋene sâko fuazac.
Erâ wâc waiŋ opâ ɋâricne ʒopo raŋɋanao mi qoŋgiŋkepene huekac. Iŋuc epene muzac, waiŋzi ʒopo âte fâuckeme waiŋ mecne ʒopo mecne mâmâc sipirickezapic. Irec waiŋ ɋâricnezi ʒopo ɋâricnao hume sâckeocmu.”
Sabata hombaŋ mocko Jesu â motecfâc‐ticne jaŋe padi gie ŋondeŋko rambiŋ. Rahuc motecfâc‐ticne jaŋe fârine moc moc fuŋkerâ mezi bâtâcnembiŋ.
Epie farisaio jaŋe Jesu ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Honec, jaŋe sabata hombaŋko wiac mi eene eŋgopieŋ i!”
Eme Jesuzi jazawec, “Dawidi â ŋicfâc‐ticne nânâre hâmohuc wiac embiŋ i ŋoŋe wose manac mi eeŋgopieŋ me?
E Abiatazi taha bapa sâko juwec dameŋ ira Anuture ufuŋko ferâ poroŋ Anuture biŋe râekicne i rorâ nâhuc ŋicfâcne mâmâc jareme nâmbiŋ. Poroŋ i ŋic omane bâtâc bajarekicne, bâzi ririke micbuc‐jeŋic, eme i sifu nâmbiŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ muwec, “Sabata hombaŋ i ŋicte erâ fuawec, ŋiczi sabata hombaŋte erâ mi fuawec.
Eme Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e hombaŋ irec rune jukac wâc.”
Eme juku ŋic moc mene ɋaŋakicne mitificko ferâ ŋehame Jesu e ijaha fewec.
Feme jaŋe sabata hombaŋko ŋic bâpiaŋkeme honerâ dâŋko râeniŋte ruc bahuc ŋembiŋ.
Eme eki ŋic mene ɋaŋakicne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Fahare mai domac.”
Iŋuc murâ ŋic wio‐jarewec, “Hombaŋko wiac biaŋne me wiac sâqocne ezo, ŋic bâpiaŋ‐jopazo me sipiric‐jopazo?” Mume micnao mi rombiŋ.
Eme maŋsanaŋ‐jeŋicte bune sâqoreme mana gâpârehuc risic forisic honec‐joparâ ŋic âzânewec, “Mege fâre tiŋnec.” Mume ŋic e meticne fâre tiŋneme sanaŋkewec.
Eme farisaio jaŋe rarâ izia Herodere ŋicfâc jaŋehec tumaŋnerâ, weniŋuc erâ qanaŋ, muhuc dâŋgie bambiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi motecfâcne rocjopame riqicko rapie Galilaia mâreŋkonec ŋic guru sâko jaŋe bâjâpec‐jopambiŋ. Erâ jaŋe sawa mâcne, Judaia mâreŋkonec
erâ wâc Jerusalem haeonec â Idumaia mâreŋkonec â Jordaŋ ocniŋuckonec. Erâ Tiro Sidoŋ mâreŋkonec ŋic guru dindiŋ jaŋe mâmâc Jesu mâsi bapa‐ticnere biŋe manarâ qâtu bâturerâ fisimbiŋ.
Mârec qâretec fisihuc guriŋkepie motecfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Woke moc ware mai jaha ŋeoc.”
Ŋic bocjaha bâpiaŋ‐jopahuc juwec, irec huc wicheczi ere maŋfuŋko rarâ bâuaniŋte hehesuec â hehe qaqac boc embiŋte wokere muwec hâcne.
Eme demoŋheczi e honerâ mâreŋko fodapehuc kâcɋene wirahuc mumbiŋ, “Go Anuture Ŋokâ hâcne.”
Eme fuŋne‐ticne mupie haŋ bazacte Jesuzi mic muac sanaŋne ejarewec.
Eme tiki mocko ferâ maŋnezi manasu biric ejarewec ŋic i jaŋere mume erao tumaŋnembiŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc ŋic 12 ehec juniŋte motec bacjoparâ ŋic miti jazaniŋte mujarewec
â demoŋ jâpe‐jareniŋte tâpiri râe‐jarewec.
Ŋic 12 rocjopawec jaŋere ʒâŋe ʒiŋuc: Simoŋ, ʒâŋe ɋâri‐ticne Petoro mucnewec,
erâ Jakobo, Ʒebedaiore ŋokâ, â Jakobo ɋaticne Johane, jahere ʒâŋe Boanerges muwec, nâŋâcne dâŋko Parandaŋ motec,
erâ Anderea, Filipo, Batolomaio, Mataio, Toma, Jakobo Alifaiore ŋokâ, erâ Tadaio â Simoŋ Ʒelote
â Juda Karioto haeonec, e juku Jesu doc bawec.
Eme Jesuzi ficko feme ŋic guru sâkozi mocwâc ijaha tumaŋnepie e â motecfâcne jaŋe wemocko nânâ moc nanʒapiŋ.
Eme wiacfâc‐ticne jaŋe biŋe manarâ kecʒiŋuc muhuc roniŋte rambiŋ: “Maŋne sifuckekac.”
Eme miti qaqazu Jerusalem haeonec fisimbiŋ jaŋe ere ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Demoŋ jaŋere ŋicbomboŋ Beezebulu eki maŋnao jume ere tâpirizi demoŋ jâpe‐jareekac.”
Mupie hefârec‐joparâ dâŋ suŋsuŋne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Sataŋzi weniŋuc erâ Sataŋ jâpeocmu?
Mâreŋ moc irec ŋiczi fâuckerâ rârâsi kosa epie tuhu fuaocmu
â hae moc irec ŋiczi fâuckerâ rârâsi kosa epie hae tâtieocmu.
Â Sataŋzi fâuckerâ Sataŋ qa jâpec ecnekacko sâcne mi sanaŋkeocmu, e omaeocmu hâcne.
Me mozi ŋic momori moc ŋeha ficticnao ferâ mafa jâoc roocmu? I aricne, ŋic momori qanaŋ hâporâ me kikene qarâ ie mafa‐ticne jâoc rozo.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Sâqocne fuŋne fuŋne irec kiŋ i bebehene fokac, â dâŋ simbiŋne fuŋne fuŋne irec kiŋ i wâc bebehene fokac.
Â ŋic moczi Tiri Mâro ʒaubac ecneocmu ere kiŋ ine bebehene mi fokac, i aricne jâmbâŋ, e kiŋ tatarane tâmiric hotâckekac hâcne.”
Dâŋ i ere kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋte jazawec: “Maŋticnao demoŋ huwec jukac.”
Dâŋ iŋuc jazahame neŋgoc ɋafâc‐ticne fisirâ hae ʒoŋao domahuc jaŋerao wahaocte dâŋ mupie fewec.
Eme Jesu e ŋicŋondeŋko ŋehame ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Neŋgoc qo ɋafâcge juwic domahuc hefârecguŋgopieŋ.”
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Neŋgoc ɋafâc‐nane weni jaŋe?”
Iŋuc murâ ŋic orâŋkerâ ŋembiŋ jaŋerao ʒâŋe fihuc muwec, “Neŋgoc ɋafâc‐nane ʒi.
Anuture mic reŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne neŋgoc qo ɋafâc‐nane.”
Eme Jesuzi harierâ riqic moŋgeŋko hurâ miti fuŋkerâ jaza qazuc ewec. Ehame ŋic hâmbâŋ sâko fisi erao tumaŋnepie woke mocko fewec. Eme ŋic moŋgeŋko ŋerahapie e jahacne riqicko woke faio ŋehuc miti jazawec.
Ehuc kesaicdâŋ fuŋne fuŋne jazahuc moc ʒiŋuc muwec:
“Ŋazape mananiŋ, ŋic moczi wiac hândâŋne tieocte gieo rawec.
Rarâ tiehame hândâŋ gâcnezi hatao waha hewec. Ehame wipezi fisirâ nâfârewec.
Hândâŋne gâcnezi qânâ siec, mâreŋ bocjaha mi fowecko hewec. Ira mâreŋ faisuc sawa fowecte bâpâŋne biac wefuwec.
Ehame ʒoaŋzi wefurâ qame gâtâne aricnere ɋaŋarâ hâmowec.
Â hândâŋne gâcnezi hofâ qinʒiŋ ŋondeŋko hewec. Eme âkeʒume hofâ qinʒiŋzi wefurâ hehâmome fârimâc ewec.
Â hândâŋne gâcnezi ine mâreŋ guecko herâ âkeʒurâ fârine fua sawec ewec. Jâcne mocte hândâŋne 30, mocte 60, mocte 100, fârine iŋuc fuawec.”
Dâŋ i murâ ʒiŋuc mutarawec: “Hazecneheczi dâŋ kecʒi manazejec.”
Ŋic ŋokac gâcne rafârepie e jahacne motecfâc â fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne tucne jaŋe dâŋ irec fuŋnere wiocnembiŋ.
Wiocnepie muwec, “Anuture uucmaŋko raraʒire dâŋ soŋne i ŋoŋe mananiŋte mukicne, â ŋic râpene juŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine dâŋ suŋsuŋne sawa mananiŋte mukicne.
Jaŋe ʒâŋe fiipiehuc wiac mi hone taranʒepieŋ â hazec‐jeŋiczi mana‐bipiehuc mi mana taranʒepieŋ â maŋjeŋic mi bârisiepie ine kiŋ fojarezejec.”
Iŋuc murâ muwec, “Kesaic mupac irec fuŋne mi manaŋgopieŋ me? Eme kesaic dâŋ sasawa mupe weniŋuc mana taraniŋmu?
“Ŋic hândâŋ tieekac ine miti tieekac.
Hândâŋne hatao hewec sâc iŋucne juniŋmu jaŋe miti manapie maŋjeŋicko hurâ fohame Sataŋzi biac fisirâ maŋjeŋickonec ro bawiseekac.
Â hândâŋne qânâ siecko hewec sâc iŋucne juniŋmu jaŋe miti manahuc izia aŋac‐jopame maŋke juniŋmu.
Erâ maŋjeŋicko gâtâ mi bakicnere dameŋ bembeŋne mac bajuniŋmu. Izi mitire fific guguriŋ â ʒika kâpâcwâru fuame miti beherâ dockeniŋmu.
Â hândâŋne hofâ qinʒiŋko hewec sâc iŋucne jaŋe miti mamana i mananiŋmu;
ehame ine mâreŋte wiac irec mamaŋ gugutuŋ ee â moneŋ mafa sâkore aŋac â wiac fuŋne fuŋnere sasec izi maŋjeŋicko hurâ miti hehâmome fârimâc eocmu.
Â mâreŋ guecko hewec sâc iŋucne jaŋe miti manarâ bajuhuc fârine bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, gâcnezi 30, gâcnezi 60, gâcnezi 100, fârine iŋuc bâfuaeŋgopieŋ.”
Dâŋ moc ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Mozi lambe ficmaŋko baferâ kuʒizi hetutuckeocmu, me mozi ŋeŋe rurumaŋko heocmu? Aricne, ŋeŋe‐ticnao hepene ŋehuc tamaeocmu.
Wiac soŋsoŋ fokac i foku mi foocmu, i bataniŋkezo, â wiac hemackekicne fokac i foku mi foocmu, i qaratie‐fârezo.
Hazecneheczi dâŋ kecʒi manazejec.”
Iŋuc murâ muwec, “Ŋoŋe dâŋte ruc banʒepieŋ. Ŋaŋac wiac ehuc sâc bâfuaniŋmu, sâc ijaha risie‐ŋareocmu, erâ i sawa mâcne, fehuc risie‐ŋareocmu.
Moc e wiac râcnekicne bajume kiqecnecnezo, â moc e wiac râcnekicne mi bajume jâoc rozo.”
Jesuzi dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Anuture miti hata irec fuŋne ʒiŋuc: Ŋic moczi gieo wiac hândâŋne tieocmu.
Erâ ŋafeo â ʒoaŋko ju fofo ehame hândâŋ i âkeʒurâ wefuocmu, ŋic e fuŋne hone manac mi eha.
Mâreŋ e jahac hândâŋ gume hesiwiŋ ecneme âkeʒume qanaŋ bâpâŋ wefuekac, izi rehacne heekac, izi fârine râeekac.
Fârine wozeme qa roro eocmu, fâri roro dameŋ maickekac hâcne.”
Dâŋ moc ʒuhuckerâ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Anuture miti hata i wemo wiachec sâc hepe me wemo wiacko iticnerâ mupe?
I nemuja hândâŋ iŋucne. Hândâŋ i piticne, jâchândâŋ gâcne irec wahamicne.
Erâ sifu, mâreŋko râepene fua sokac erâ wiac nâkicne gâcne jâururâ jâcsâko eekac. Ehuc tieŋne heme sawa wipe jaŋe fisi mumucnao sâcne herâ ŋeeŋgopieŋ.”
Jesu e kesaic dâŋ fuŋne fuŋne muhuc miti jaza jujec. Ehuc mamana‐jeŋicte sâc jazawec.
Â mutaniŋkerâ jajaza ine mi jaza jujec. Mâc motecfâc‐ticne jaŋehec bucko juhuc fuŋne mufuarâ jaza jujec.
Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa ijaha hae owâeme motecfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Nâŋâc riqic ocniŋucnao raʒinaŋ.”
Jazame jaŋe ŋic guru sâko behec‐joparâ acmâc jaha wokeckerâ rambiŋ. Rapie woke gâcne bâbâjâpec rambiŋ.
Rahapie mâŋâŋ hâhâwicne fisirâ qame sirizi wokemaŋko hurâ fusezo ewec.
Ehame Jesu jahacne woke ʒâhecnao fofoo guŋ fowec. Eme motecfâcne jaŋe wiwickerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Qaqazu, riqicko huzo eŋgopeneŋ irec mi mezacgukac me?”
Mupie ɋârerâ mâŋâŋ muackehuc riqic ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go niniŋkerâ foc.” Mume mâŋâŋ niniŋkeme benoŋ fuawec.
Eme motec ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe wemocte hâwic sahac eŋgopieŋ, mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋic moc mi fokac me?”
Eme jaŋe bipic tatara ejareme nazaŋ gazaŋ erâ mumbiŋ, “E ŋic mo iŋucne, irec mâŋâŋ â riqic jahe micne reŋkekopirec!”
Eme riqic fotâcnerâ ocniŋucnao Gerasene mâreŋko fisimbiŋ.
Fisipie tiŋko feme ŋic demoŋnehec moczi ʒâŋeruŋ gieonec warerâ bâfuawec.
Ŋic e ʒâŋeruŋ gieo ju fofo ehuc momori eme me kikene muczi me kâpâcwâruzi bândeŋnepie mi sâckewec.
Ŋic jaŋe dameŋ sâc me kikene qapie muc hetâc qâtâcne jujec â kâpâcwâru ʒâʒâmu gie bakume hericke jujec. Eme ropie mâretec imac‐jopame bâipiembiŋ.
E ŋafe ʒoaŋ sâc ʒâŋeruŋ gieo â tiki tuhuo ju fofo ehuc owa sâko ehuc juwec â sahacne qânâzi qa sipiric ejujec.
Eme ŋic eki hâcne Jesu taicko honerâ erao gasacke rarâ kikefuŋnao fodaperâ owackerâ muwec:
“Jesu, Anutu sâkore Ŋokâ, go weniŋuc enarecmurâ warekomec? No Anuture maio gazakopac, go ʒâic gie mi narezemec.”
Jesuzi “Demoŋ go ŋickonec wefu rac” mume iŋuc hâcne âzâcnewec.
Eme Jesuzi wiocnerâ muwec, “Ʒâŋege mo?” Wiocneme muwec, “No ʒâŋe‐nane Gurusâko, nâŋe bocjahazi juŋgopeneŋ irec.”
Murâ ʒoɋac erâ numucnewec, “Nâŋe mâreŋ ʒi behenaŋte mi jâpec‐nâpozemec.”
Eme mâreŋ ira heâŋko becguru kâcɋene qondaŋko jumbiŋ.
Eme demoŋ jaŋe Jesuzi mana‐jareme becmaŋko huniŋte âzâcnembiŋ.
Mupie Jesuzi mana‐jareme demoŋ jaŋe ŋickonec wefurâ becmaŋko hupie bec jaŋe tapionec sururuerâ ra duŋ riqic fowec ira huhuc hâmombiŋ. Bec afecne mâcne, 2000 hâmombiŋ.
Eme soŋaŋ jaŋe gasacke rarâ ŋic hae gie sâc jurambiŋ dâŋ binaŋ ejarembiŋ. Jazapie jaŋe wiac fuawec honeniŋte fisi‐fârembiŋ.
Jesurao fisirâ honembiŋ: Ŋic demoŋ guru sâkohec juweczi maŋne wiŋkeme wamane â ŋaqihec ŋewec. Iŋuc ŋeme honerâ me kirâ domambiŋ.
Eme wiac hone manac embiŋzi ine ŋic demoŋhec juwec ere binaŋ â bec jaŋere binaŋ mâmâc bajarembiŋ.
Dâŋ i mana‐fârerâ Jesu e hae mâreŋ‐jeŋic beheocte numucnembiŋ.
Eme Jesu e wokeo feme ŋic demoŋhec juweczi bâjâpeocte numucnewec.
Eki ine qataracnehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go haegao rarâ wiacfâcge jaŋehec juhuc Wofuŋzi gorao mâsi sâko bahuc ehâmo‐garekac irec biŋe ŋic jazazemec.”
Mume ŋic e rarâ, Jesuzi wiac ecnewec irec biŋe hae 10 ŋerawec mâreŋ ira jufârehuc ŋic jazame jaŋe manarâ secke‐fârembiŋ.
Eme Jesu e wokeo ferâ ʒiŋucpec ware fisirâ moŋgeŋko waharâ domahame biac ŋic mâretec fisirâ tumaŋnembiŋ.
Ehapie mitific soŋaŋ moc, ʒâŋene Jairo, eki fisirâ Jesu honerâ kikefuŋnao fodaperâ fotariecnehuc
ʒiŋuc numucnewec: “Otâ‐nane hâmozo ekac, irec go warerâ megezi bâuarâ bâpiaŋketec juzejec.”
Âzâcneme manarâ rawec. Rahame ŋic guru sâko jaŋe bâjuŋ qâjuŋ ecnembiŋ.
Eme ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ŋokac moc juwec eki soc rohuc juhame jara 12 ewec.
Eme dokta bocjahazi erao gie bâipiehapie ʒâic wemo afecne manahuc juwec. Â irec furi moneŋ mafa‐ticne jarekume hesackewec. Eme sifu hucticne mi afeckehuc mâc ɋârâŋkecnewec.
Eme ŋokac eki hâcne Jesure biŋe manarâ ŋic ŋokac gâcne jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhuc râpefuŋnao rarâ ŋaqi‐ticne bâuawec.
I ʒiŋuc muhuc ewec: “Ŋaqi‐ticne sawa bâuarâ biaŋnuocmu.”
Bâuame izia socticne ʒickeme sahac‐ticne bâgunuckeme manawec.
Eme Jesu e tâpiri‐ticne moc wahame manarâ forisierâ wiohuc muwec, “Ŋaqi‐nane mozi bâuakac?”
Mume motecfâcne jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ŋic jaŋe hejâŋâŋgupie wemocte mukic, ‘Mozi bâuacnukac’?”
Eme Jesu eki ine bâuawec e ʒâŋitaocte hone wosâc ejarewec.
Ŋokac e ine sahac‐ticnao mâsi fuawec i manarâ maŋne heme ɋarac ɋarac qahuc Jesure maŋfuŋko fodapehuc fuŋne‐ticne mufuarâ âzâcnewec.
Eme eki ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋokac, mamanasiŋgere biaŋgukac. Irec go buge mâteŋkeha ra ɋiɋicne juzemec.”
Ŋokac dâŋ iŋuc âzâcnehuc domahame mitific soŋaŋte fickonec kiŋaŋ warerâ mumbiŋ, “Otâge hâmokac, irec wemocte qaqazu maŋgâŋ ecnetec raocmu.”
Eme Jesu e dâŋ i mana‐bipierâ soŋaŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mi hâwicguoc, mâc manasiŋnuc.”
Iŋuc murâ gâcne hecke‐jarehuc Petoro, Jakobo â ɋaticne rocjopame rambiŋ.
Ra soŋaŋte ficko fisirâ, ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ojowa sâko â ki mamakuc epie hone manac ewec.
Manarâ ficko ferâ ŋic ŋokac ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe wemocte kio soŋgâŋ boc eŋgopieŋ? Naru e mi hâmojec, e mâc guŋ fokac.”
Mume manarâ gâwiecnembiŋ. Eme ejareme hufârepie naru neŋgoc mamac jahecne â motecfâcne rocjopame naru fowecko raʒimbiŋ.
Erâ naru menao rorâ muwec, “Talita kumi”, nâŋâcne dâŋko: Naru, gazape faharec.
Mume izia naru faharerâ rac warec ewec. Naru jara‐ticne 12 bazuwec. Eme honerâ warecke sâqorembiŋ.
Eme eki ŋic mi jazaniŋte mic muac sanaŋne ejarewec erâ naru nânâ râcnepie nâocte jazawec.
Eme Jesu e hae mâreŋ i beherâ haefuŋ‐ticnao rame motecfâcne bâjâpembiŋ.
Ra juhame sabata hombaŋ maickeme mitificko ferâ miti jazawec. Eme ŋic bocjaha miti manahuc ŋembiŋ jaŋe wareckehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Wiac keci wenirec fuacnewec? Mamana sâko i mozi qazucnewec? Erâ wâc mâsi bapa sâko‐ticne i mo iŋucne!
E ficbapa ŋic i, Mariare ŋokâ, â Jakobo â Jose â Juda â Simoŋ hahac‐jeŋic hâcne, erâ seŋfâc‐ticne ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko jueŋgopieŋ wâc.” Iŋuc murâ quŋkecnehuc mana pitiwambiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Porofete moc e ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne hae mâreŋ gâcnao haŋ bahame haefâcne â soctofafâcne â fuŋfuŋfâcne jaŋe ine qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ.”
Iŋuc jumbiŋte jaŋerao mâsi baocte quŋkewec. E mâc ŋic huchec moc moc sawa mezi bâuac‐jopahuc ɋiɋicne bacjopawec.
Ehuc maŋjeŋic boc sakarembiŋte secke‐jarewec. Eme hae râreckerâ ŋerawec ira ra juhuc miti jaza qazuc ewec.
Eku motecfâcne 12 hefârec‐joparâ jajahec jajahec sasawa miti muniŋte fuŋkerâ sorec‐jopawec. Ehuc demoŋ jâpe‐jareniŋte tâpiri râe‐jarerâ ʒiŋuc jazawec.
“Ŋoŋe wiac moc mi baranʒepieŋ, gunu sawa, nânâ aricne, he aricne, moneŋ aricne.
Kikehuhu ine rojunʒepieŋ, erâ ŋaqi maŋne sahacne misac, mocjaha hepie huzejec.”
Iŋuc murâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Hae mocko fisirâ fic feniŋmu ijaha ŋec foc eku waha ranʒepieŋ.
Hae moc ira fisipie âgo mi eŋarehuc dâŋŋeŋic qikiŋnepie râpec‐joparâ kike‐ŋeŋickonec gâc wândoc‐jeŋic âteickepie wahame jaŋe fuŋne‐jeŋic mananʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume jaŋe rarâ ŋic maŋjeŋic bârisieniŋte miti jazambiŋ.
Ehuc demoŋ bocjaha jâpe‐jarembiŋ â huchec bocjaha wâc wokemaŋ rua‐jarehuc ɋiɋicne bacjopambiŋ.
Jesure biŋedâŋ haŋ baraku ŋicwofuŋ Heroderao fisime manawec. Manarâ muwec, “Johane Miti Opâ fufuŋke e hâmockonec ɋâreweczi tâpiri sâkohec jukac hâcne.”
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe ine Jesure ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “E Elia.” Gâcnezi mumbiŋ. “E porofete moc, porofete mimiŋne jaŋe iŋucne.”
Herodezi ine manarâ muwec, “Aricne, Johane upene qâtâcnepo e hâcne ɋârewec jukac.”
Herode e mârâcko momori ejareme Johane rorâ kâpâcwâru bambiŋ. Qanaŋ juwicnao Herodezi ɋaticne Filipo ere ŋonâŋ ʒâŋene Herodia jâoc rowec, ŋokac ere erâ Johane iŋuc ecnewec.
Ine Johanezi Herode ʒiŋuc âzâcnewecte: “Go ɋagere ŋonâŋ bameŋ i sâcmutâc qaqa ekac.”
Iŋuc mume Herodia e Johane aaric manacnehuc qaocte maŋne kâcɋene domawec, erâ ine hata basawec.
Herode eki ine Johanere ŋic tiŋne â mitihec muhuc araŋ bacnehuc ŋezickewec. Â micticnaonec dâŋ manarâ maŋgu qâŋguru ewec. Erâ sifu dâŋticne mana aŋac ewec.
Eme juku wiac kecʒiŋuc fuawec: Herode e fufua dameŋ‐ticne maickeme kia sâkofâcne â momori soŋaŋ kâcɋene â Galilaia mâreŋkonec ŋic fekicne hetumaŋ‐jopa‐fârerâ tiwâ ʒepec ejarewec.
Eme jaŋe tumaŋnerâ ŋehapie Herodia otâ‐ticne jaŋerao ferâ mai‐jeŋicko gae wowec. Gae wome Herode â ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe honerâ aŋac‐jopawec. Eme Herodezi naru ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go wiac irec me irec egareme mutec garepemu.”
Murâ Femicnere maio musanaŋkerâ muwec, “Wiac kosare mutec garepemu â mâreŋ‐nanere mutec i wâc bâtâc barâ ŋifecne qikiŋne‐garepemu.”
Eme naru e rarâ neŋgoc‐ticne wiocnerâ muwec, “No wemo wiacte mupe?” Mume eki âzâcnewec, “Johane Miti Opâ fufuŋke qizec‐ticnere muc.”
Eme naru e biac gasackerâ ŋicwofuŋtao rarâ muwec, “Go Johane Miti Opâ fufuŋke ere qizec ʒiŋuczia râqâcko râerâ narec.”
Mume ŋicwofuŋ e bune bocjaha sâqorewec. Erâ Femicnere maio mupaŋkewecte â ŋic ŋembiŋ jaŋerao dâŋticne wahazacte manacnewec.
Ehuc biac jaha momori moc ra Johane qizec‐ticne bareocte sorewec. Eme eki kâpâcwâru ficko rarâ Johane upene qâtâcnerâ
qizecne râqâcko râeme hume bafisi naru râcnewec. Râcneme naruzi neŋgoc‐ticnerao barawec.
Eme Johane motecfâcne biŋe manarâ ra qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne rorâ duckembiŋ.
Aposolo jaŋe hae mâreŋ jufârerâ risierâ Jesurao tumaŋnehuc wiac embiŋ bambiŋ â miti mumbiŋ irec binaŋ sasawa bacnembiŋ.
Bacne‐fârepie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Warepie tuhuo ranaŋ, ira piticne juhuc âke mâteŋ‐ŋopaoc.” Ŋic wemo afecne ʒuʒuhuczi ʒuʒuhuc fisihuc ra, fisihuc ra, iŋuc ehuc domapie wemocko ŋemanahuc nânâ opâ nanʒapiŋ.
Eme jaŋe bucjeŋic wokeo ferâ tuhuo rambiŋ.
Rahapie bocjahazi hone tarac‐joparâ haene haene qaja fuserâ tiŋko biac gasackerâ bâbâni ra fisimbiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi wokeonec waharâ ŋic ŋokac guru sâko honec‐joparâ, lama soŋaŋ tâmiric tinac jumbiŋte busâqoc mana‐jarewec. Iŋuc honec‐joparâ izia fuŋkerâ mitire dâŋ bocjaha jazawec.
Ehame qâqâtâc âkesue rame honerâ motecfâcne jaŋe erao rarâ mumbiŋ, “Ʒi tuhuo juhapene qâqâtâc biac âkesue rakacte
ŋic râec‐jopatec hae ŋerakac ira rarâ nânâ furine ba nâc enʒepieŋ.”
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ŋaŋac moc gumec‐jopaniŋ me.” Jazame mumbiŋ, “Nâŋe rarâ 20 kina nânâ furine barâ ware gumec‐jopanaŋte mukomec me?”
Eme eki jazawec, “Ŋaŋacne nânâ wezimuc fokac, ra honeniŋ.” Mume jaŋe ra honerâ âzâcnembiŋ, “Poroŋ memoc â opâ qowi jajahec.”
Eme mume ŋic jaŋe birickerâ kecɋaŋko hatane hatane ŋerambiŋ.
Biri moc 100, biri moc 50 iŋuc ŋerambiŋ.
Ŋefârepie poroŋ memoc â opâ qowi jajahec rorâ sambâŋko fime feha jambuŋkerâ bazurâ motecfâcne jareme jaŋe bârâwiŋnerâ ŋic jarembiŋ. Eme qowi bâtâc barâ jareme rorâ iŋuc jaha embiŋ.
Eme jaŋe mâmâc sasawa nâ gapec embiŋ.
Ehame poroŋ â qowi tiwâne ŋerawec i ropie hurâ sasac 12 fusewec.
Nânâ nâmbiŋ ŋic i jaŋe 5 tauseŋ.
Eme izia Jesuzi motecfâcne esoc‐jopame wokeo ferâ ocniŋucpec Besaida haeopec bânierâ rambiŋ, e jahacne ine ŋic ŋokac râec‐jopaocte ŋewec.
Ehuc mâzoc‐joparâ nunumu gie baocte tikio fewec.
Eme hae ŋafeme woke riqic ʒâʒâŋiŋko ra fisihame e gâmbuŋ‐ticne tiŋko juwec.
Eme mâŋâŋ rambiŋkonec warewecte woke foicke‐bipiepie honec‐joparâ ŋafe furec hehec‐jekicko riqic âte âte raku jaŋerao fisirâ jowaruzo ewec.
Eme jaŋe riqic faio rame honerâ bawe warekac muhuc owackembiŋ.
Jaŋe mâmâc sasawa honerâ hâbi‐jeŋic goroŋkewec. Iŋuc epie dâŋ bacjopahuc jazawec, “Buŋeŋic mâteŋkeoc, no nahac fâkopac, mi hâwic‐ŋopaoc.”
Iŋuc murâ woke‐jeŋicko feme mâŋâŋ niniŋkewec. Eme jaŋe maŋjeŋic omaeme niniŋkerâ ŋembiŋ.
Ine nânâ gumec‐jopawec irec fuŋne kâuc bambiŋzi maŋbâzic jaha jumbiŋ.
Riqic fotâcne‐fârerâ Genesarete mâreŋko fisirâ aŋga behepie huwec.
Eme wokeonec wahapie izia ŋic ŋokac jaŋe Jesu ʒâŋitarâ
hae sâc gasacke rarâ huchec kanʒeo râec‐joparâ ira me ira juwecko manarâ bacjopa fisimbiŋ.
Eme hae kâcɋene me piticne me fic boze fotâcnezo eme huchec bâfuac‐joparâ tomao râec‐joparâ âzâcnepie maname ŋaqi‐ticne qaŋeŋne bâuambiŋ. Eme bâuambiŋ sâc biaŋ‐jopa‐fârewec.
Eme farisaio â Jerusalem haeonec miti qaqazu gâcne fisirâ Jesurao tumaŋnembiŋ.
Ehuc motecfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec tucnezi mejeŋic mi ʒuʒure nânâ mâc ro nâc epie honec‐jopambiŋ.
Farisaio â Judaŋic mâmâc sasawa mejeŋic ʒurerâ jaha nânâ nâeŋgopieŋ. I mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere mumutâc dâŋ reŋkehuc iŋuc eeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ furi bapa tomaonec risierâ iŋuc jaha opâ rurua tâmiric nânâ mi ro nâc eeŋgopieŋ. Erâ sawa mâcne, kuʒi, râqâc, oto gomba ʒuʒure â wiac gâcnere mumutâc dâŋ bajueŋgopieŋ, i mimiŋzi ɋâric ewarehuc jumbiŋ.
Irec farisaio â miti qaqazu jaŋe Jesu wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Motecfâcge jaŋe wemocte mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋere mumutâc dâŋ qâsuarâ mejeŋic mi ʒuʒure wiac ro nâc eeŋgopieŋ?”
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Jesajazi burecŋic ŋoŋere hâcne findaŋdâŋ ʒiŋuc qâreŋke‐hâmowec: ‘Ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe micbipiczi sâsecnuhuc maŋjeŋiczi ine qikiŋnueŋgopieŋ.
Erâ dâŋ fârinere okacne ŋicdâŋ mu qaqazuc ehuc no mai enarepie honepe racne eekac.’
Ŋoŋe Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋ behepie wahaha ŋicdâŋ basanaŋkerâ bajueŋgopieŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ muwec, “Mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere mumutâc dâŋ qame qoŋgiŋ eniŋte Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋ qâqâsuare mâsi esarickeeŋgopieŋ hâcne, ŋoŋe.
Mose e dâŋ kecʒiŋuc ŋaza mutâc ewec: ‘Go neŋgoc mamac jahecge sâsec‐jofazemec. Moc e neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne mu surec ejacteocmuzi mi juzejec.’
Ŋoŋe ine ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: Ŋic moc e mamac‐ticne me neŋgoc‐ticne âzâcneocmu ‘Wiac garehuc dopecguzapo i Anutu taha bacnepemu’;
iŋuc âzâcneme ŋoŋe dâŋticne basanaŋkehuc, neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne jauŋ babajacte irec aka hecneeŋgopieŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc Anuture dâŋ igockepie raha ŋaŋacne dâŋ mimiŋzi ɋâric baju warekicne i heʒakiepie foekac. Erâ i sawa mâcne, wiac tucnere ijaha eeŋgopieŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ ŋic mocwâc hefârec‐jopame fisipie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No dâŋ ŋazape mâmâc sasawa manahuc mana taraniŋ:
Hobu‐ŋeŋicko wiac huekac izi mi hegâpârec‐ŋopaekac, maŋŋeŋickonec wiac wefuekac izi ine hegâpârec‐ŋopaekac.[
Hazecneheczi dâŋ kecʒi manazejec.]”
Iŋuc murâ ŋic behec‐joparâ ficko feme motec jaŋe dâŋ suŋsuŋne kecirec indiŋkembiŋ.
Indiŋkepie jazawec, “Hâc, ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha maŋ mamanasu tâmiric juŋgopieŋ? Fuŋne kecʒiŋucte mi manaŋgopieŋ? Hobu‐ŋeŋicko wiac huekac izi wemocko hegâpârec‐ŋopaocmu!
Izi maŋŋeŋicko mi fotâcneekac, i mâc hobu‐ŋeŋicko hume bâwosâeme hata‐ticnao wahaekac.” Jesu e iŋuc muhuc nânâre dâŋ mufâsâe‐fârewec.
Erâ moc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Maŋŋeŋickonec wiac wefuekac izi ine hegâpârec‐ŋopaekac.
Ŋicmaŋkonec wiac kecʒiŋuc wefuekac: Mamanasu mamakâcne, sasec gie, fiuc, ʒika, ŋokac roc behec,
andac, sindaŋ hârindaŋ, eeatuc, nâareŋ, liŋguuŋ, maricmaŋ gâpâc dâŋ mumu, penaroŋ, maŋmutuc.
Wiac sâqocne wosekopac izi hâcne maŋŋeŋickonec wefurâ hegâpârec‐ŋopaekac.”
Jesu e hae mâreŋ i beherâ raku Tiro Sidoŋ hae ŋepicko fisiwec. Fisirâ fic mocko ferâ gâcne jaŋe biŋe‐ticne mi mananiŋte muwec. Erâ wemocko soŋsoŋ juzac.
Fisi fisiha izia ŋokac moczi biŋe‐ticne manawec. E otâ macticne demoŋ moczi boc ecnewecte ware Jesu maŋfuŋnao fodapewec.
Ŋokac e Grikŋokac, Sirofoinikia hae mâreŋ irec rune. E otâ‐ticne demoŋ jâpecneocte âzâcnewec.
Âzâcneme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Naru motec jaŋe qanaŋ nâ gapec eniŋte mukicne. Irec jaŋe wemocko nânâ jowac rorâ qâto behe‐jarezo.”
Mume ŋokaczi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Wofuŋ, i manakopac, erâ qâto jaŋe naru motec jaŋere teboonec nânâ huŋgaŋne wahame sifu mac nâeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Dâŋ iŋuc mukicte mana‐garekopac, rac, demoŋzi otâge behejec.”
Eme ŋokac e rarâ ficticnao fisirâ honewec: Otâ‐ticne e demoŋzi beheme fofo‐ticnao niniŋkerâ fowec.
Jesu e Tiro haeonec risierâ Sidoŋ hae fotâcnerâ wareku Galilaia riqickopec hae 10 ŋerawec ira fisiwec.
Ira fisihame ŋic qepoŋ nâŋguŋ moc erao jowa rarâ meticnezi bâuaocte numucnembiŋ.
Numucnepie manarâ ŋic e râricne mocko râeme buc domame memotec‐ticne hazecnao râerâ tâfeckerâ nameŋnao bawec.
Erâ sambâŋko fime feha nokafe herâ muwec, “Efata”, Kâtedâŋko: Uŋtoc.
Mume hazecne uŋtowec â nameŋne forisieme dâŋ biaŋne dâŋewec.
Eme Jesu e biŋe i mi mufuaniŋte mic muac ejarewec. Erâ ejare‐bipieme jaŋe ʒoɋac erâ muromackembiŋ.
Jaŋe warecke sâqorerâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Wiac sasawa bame biaŋke‐fâreekac, wiac gâcne bahuc qepoŋ jaŋere hazec wâc bâuŋtoekac â nâŋguŋ jaŋe dâŋ bâfua‐jareekac.”
Dameŋ ira ŋic guru sâko Jesurao tumaŋnerâ nânâ tâmiric jupie motecfâcne hefârec‐joparâ jazawec,
“No ŋic jaŋere bunane sâqorekac, jaŋe norao ŋafe ʒoaŋ jahec â moc juku nânâre hâmoŋgopieŋ.
Eme nânâ tâmiric hae‐jeŋicko sorec‐jopape hatao rahuc nânâre hâmo sipiric eniŋmu, gâcne jaŋe mâreŋ ʒorickonec warembiŋ.”
Iŋuc mume motecfâcne jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Mâreŋ tuhuo ʒira nânâ sâko wenirec bâfuarâ ŋic iŋucne gumec‐jopapene sâcjopaocmu?”
Mupie wio‐jarerâ muwec, “Ŋoŋerao poroŋ wezimuc fokac?” Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Seweŋ.”
Âzâcnepie manarâ mume ŋic jaŋe qâzuckerâ mâreŋko waha ŋepie poroŋ 7 rorâ daŋge murâ bazuhuc motec jareme jaŋe bâtâc barâ ŋic jarembiŋ.
Erâ opâ qowi piicne jahec mac ŋewec i iŋuc jaha jambuŋkerâ mume ŋic bâtâc bajarembiŋ.
Eme ŋic jaŋe nârâ gapec‐jopawec. Erâ mâreŋko tiwâne ŋerawec i sasac 7 ira ropie hurâ fusucmawec.
Nânâ nâmbiŋ ŋic i jaŋere ʒare 4 tauseŋ. Nâpie sorec‐jopame risiembiŋ.
Ŋic jaŋe rapie izia motecfâcne jaŋehec wokeo ferâ raku Dalimanuta mâreŋko fisimbiŋ.
Ira juhapie farisaio ŋic jaŋe Jesurao fisirâ dâŋzi jâiŋkerâ sambâŋko fuŋne qaqa mâsi moc mume fuame honeniŋte mumbiŋ. I esâickehuc âzâcnembiŋ.
Âzâcnepie ʒâire‐jarehuc nokafe herâ muwec, “Ŋic iŋucnezi fuŋne weniŋucte fuŋne qaqa mâsire muŋgopieŋ? No jâmbomac ŋazape: Ŋic iŋucne fuŋne qaqa mâsi moc mi ŋowatu‐jâmbâŋkepemu.”
Iŋuc murâ behec‐joparâ motecfâcne rocjopame wokeo ferâ riqic ocniŋucnao raʒimbiŋ.
Eme motec jaŋe poroŋte nikec‐jopame foha raʒimbiŋ. Mocsâkoa wokeo fowec.
Ehame uŋdâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe farisaio â Herode hâmu goreŋ‐jeŋic bâec bacnehuc paŋsawa juŋʒepieŋ.”
Jazame jaŋackoaŋ nazaŋ gazaŋ erâ mumbiŋ, “I poroŋte nikec‐nâpome foha wareŋgopeneŋte nâzâkac.”
Dâŋ i muhapie hazec‐ticnao hume manarâ jazawec, “Poroŋte nikec‐ŋopajec irec wemocte muc manac eŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe fuŋne mi mana taraŋgopieŋ? Maŋŋeŋic moc mi uŋtokac me?
Ŋoŋe ʒâŋe‐ŋeŋic foipiehame wiac mi honeeŋgopieŋ â hazec‐ŋeŋic foipiehame dâŋ mi manaeŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe wiac hone manac ehuc ninikecne jueŋgopieŋ me?
No poroŋ 5 bâtâc barâ ŋic 5 tauseŋ gumec‐jopape tiwâne fome ropie sasac wezimuc hurâ fusewec?” Wio‐jareme mumbiŋ: “12”.
“Â poroŋ 7 bâtâc barâ ŋic 4 tauseŋ gumec‐jopape tiwâne fome ropie sasac wezimuc hurâ fusewec?” Jaŋe mumbiŋ: “7”.
Mupie jazawec, “Eme mamana‐ŋeŋic sifu mi fuakac me?”
Eme raku Besaida haeo fisipie ŋic tiŋtuŋ moc Jesurao bawarerâ mezi bâuaocte âzâcnembiŋ.
Âzâcnepie ŋic tiŋtuŋ menao rorâ hae râpeo bahurâ ʒâŋe‐ticne tâfec ruacnerâ mene qizecnao râehuc wiocnewec, “Wiac moc honekomec?”
Eme tiŋtuŋzi ʒâŋe firâ muwec, “No ŋic honec‐jopape jâc hawari tinac erâ rac warec eŋgopieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Jesu e menezi ʒâŋene bâuame ŋic e ʒâŋene biaŋkeme fiɋaɋackerâ bembeŋko â ʒoricko wiac sasawa hone‐hâmowec.
Eme Jesuzi sorehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go haeo mi fehuc mâc ficgao rac.”
Jesu e motecfâcne rocjopame Kaisarea hae, ŋicwofuŋ Filipozi mume bambiŋ, irec hae pitic ŋerawecko rambiŋ. Hatao rahuc Jesuzi motecfâcne indiŋ‐joparâ muwec, “Ŋic jaŋe nore mo muŋgopieŋ?”
Indiŋ‐jopame ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Johane Miti Opâ fufuŋke, â gâcne jaŋe Elia, â gâcnezi ine porofete moc, gore iŋuc muŋgopieŋ.”
Mupie esâic‐joparâ muwec, “Â ŋaŋacne ine nore mo muŋgopieŋ?” Eme Petorozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Kristo hâcne.”
Iŋuc mume ŋic gâcne mi mufua‐jareniŋte mic muac sanaŋne ejarewec.
Eme dameŋ ira fuŋkerâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc mufua‐jarewec: “Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋnezi juku ʒâic serereŋ manaocmu, â soŋaŋ â taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu jaŋe e beherâ qa imac ecneku qapie hâmorâ ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha fahareocmu.”
Dâŋ i mutaniŋkerâ jazawec. Jazame Petorozi bucko hefârerâ qataracnehuc dâŋ fuŋkerâ âzâcnewec.
Âzâcneme fotikierâ motec jaŋerao ʒâŋe fihuc Petoro mu tutuc ecnerâ muwec, “Sataŋ go râriec, go dâŋ maŋkekic i Anuture dâŋ mâcne, i ŋicdâŋ.”
Jesu e ŋic guru sâko jumbiŋ jaŋe â motecfâc‐ticne hefârec‐joparâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋic moczi no bâjâpecnuzo murâ maŋ sahac‐ticnere dâŋ râpeckehuc maripoŋ‐ticne hâporâ bâjâpecnuzejec.
Moc e juju‐ticne sakareme sifuckecneocmu â moc e nore erâ â Biŋebiaŋte erâ qikiŋneme fuacneocmu.
Moc e mâreŋte wiac sasawa hure‐fâreku kinduŋ bânduŋ bajuhame juju‐ticne omaeme wemo wiac fârine focneocmu?
Me juju‐ticnere kiwiric wemo wiac rome risiecneocmu?
Moc e ŋicguru miti qiqikiŋ â hehesicne ʒi jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhuc no nahacnere me miti‐nanere maname mimi gaŋgaŋnehec eocmu, ere Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋnezi iŋuc jaha Mamac‐ticnere sambâŋ tatamachec â tiri aŋelo jaŋehec fisirâ maname mimi gaŋgaŋnehec eocmu.”
Iŋuc murâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No jâmbomac ŋazape: Domaŋgopieŋ ʒi ŋoŋeraonec gâcne hâmoczi mi bâqiŋ‐ŋopaha Anuture Wofuŋ qâreŋzi tâpirinehec fua taniŋkeme honenʒoŋgopieŋ.”
Jesu e ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 juku Petoro, Jakobo â Johane rocjopame tiki tuhuo fembiŋ. Eme ira ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋicko domahuc fuŋmoc ewec.
Ehame ŋaqi‐ticne tamaerâ ɋaɋac taeŋne jâmbâŋ ewec, ŋiczi iŋucne mi bapane.
Eme Mose â Elia ijaha mai fua‐jarerâ Jesuhec dâŋ muc manac embiŋ.
Ehapie Petorozi Jesu dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Qaqazu, sowine ʒira juŋgopeneŋ. Irec boze jahec â moc baŋarenaŋ, gore moc, Mosere moc, Eliare moc.”
Motec jaŋe me kike tatara embiŋ, ehuc dâŋ kosa muwec.
Iŋuc ehapie karorac moczi waharâ sâoc‐jopawec. Eme karorac maŋkonec dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fuawec: “Keci joroc Ŋokâ biaŋ‐nane, ŋoŋe dâŋticne mananʒepieŋ.”
Dâŋ i manarâ izia rârec rârec firâ mi Jesu sawa jaŋerao domame honenʒepieŋ i.
Eme tikionec wahahuctecne Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wiac honembieŋ irec dâŋ biŋe ŋic mi jajaza juhapie Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e hâmockonec faharezejec.”
Jazame motec jaŋe dâŋ i maŋkehuc ʒiŋuc manasumbiŋ: Hâmockonec fafahare i wemo dâŋ?
Erâ Jesu wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Elia qanaŋ fisiocmu, miti qaqazu jaŋe dâŋ iŋuc wemocte mueŋgopieŋ?”
Wiocnepie jazawec, “Elia e jâmbomac qanaŋ fisirâ wiac bâtâcne bâtimuŋ eocmu. Erâ Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e ima barâ bâsueniŋmu, ere iŋuc qâreŋkekicne i fuŋne weniŋuc?
Eliare ine ʒiŋuc ŋazakopac: E biac fisirâ juhame jaŋe wiac kosa ecnembiŋ. Miti papiao ere qâreŋkekicne iŋuc hâcne ecnembiŋ.”
Tikionec waha‐fârerâ motec gâcne jaŋerao fisirâ honembiŋ: Ŋic mâretec orâŋ‐joparâ domahapie miti qaqazu tucne motec jaŋehec mu qaqatarac embiŋ.
Eme ŋic sasawa jaŋe Jesu honerâ izia fâfârerâ ra bâfuarâ mu ʒeri ecnembiŋ.
Eme eki wio‐jarewec, “Wemo wiacte mu qaqatarac eŋgopieŋ?”
Mume ŋic jaŋeraonec moczi fuarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Qaqazu, ŋokâ‐nane demoŋ nâŋguŋnezi ecneme gorao bawarekopac.
Motec e demoŋzi dameŋ sâc rorâ ba suriŋ ecneme mic sofororocne wefume mic kikihotac kihuc me kikene râŋgeŋkeekac. Eme motecfâcge jaŋe jâpecneniŋte jazape eipiembieŋ.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “O ŋic mamanasiŋ tâmiric ŋoŋe, no ŋoŋehec hati jurâ ju ehuc âsi qataŋ eŋarepemu me? Motec norao bawareniŋ.”
Mume motec erao barapie demoŋzi Jesu honerâ motec rârec bârârec ecneme me kikene jâjâwâckeme mâreŋko qarâ risimbiŋne qahuc fome mic sofororocne wefuwec.
Eme Jesuzi motec mamac‐ticne wiocnerâ muwec, “Wiac i wezimucne fuacnewec?” Mume ŋiczi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “I ɋieoa fuacnewec.
Demoŋ e motec sipirickeocte wemo afecne ʒocko â opâo tuŋkeme huhuc domaekac. Go ine tâpiri fogarekacko nâhere buge sâqoreme bafic‐nâfoc.”
Iŋuc muhuc wâsickeme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Tâpirire mukicte mupe manac, moc e mamanasiŋhec juocmuo wiac sasawa eene efâreocmu.”
Âzâcneme izia motecte mamaczi kâcɋene wirahuc muwec, “No manasiŋgukopac, go gahac mamanasiŋ‐nane gegec dodocne basanaŋke‐narec!”
Eme ŋic mâretec fisi sâqorehuc domapie honec‐joparâ demoŋ jâpehuc muwec, “Demoŋ qepoŋ nâŋguŋne go gazape, wefurâ wiserâ rac, erâ mocwâc mi risie ware huzemec!”
Mume demoŋzi kâcɋene owackehuc motec heunuckerâ âte tuŋkeme qarâ hâmocne tinac fowec. Fohame ŋic jaŋe honerâ mumbiŋ, “Hâmo‐jâmbâŋkejec.”
Iŋuc muhapie Jesuzi motec menao rorâ bafahareme domawec.
Eme Jesu e ficko feme motec jaŋe bucko wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Nâŋe wemocte jâpenaŋte eipiembeneŋ?”
Mupie jazawec, “Demoŋ iŋucne jaŋe wiac moczi mâcne, mâc nunumuzi jâpec‐jopazo.”
Eme jaŋe hae mâreŋ i beherâ Galilaia mâreŋ fotâcnerâ rambiŋ. Ine ŋic jaŋe biŋe‐ticne mananʒipiŋte kamierâ rambiŋ.
Rahuc motecfâcne ʒiŋuc hâcne muhuc jaza qazuc ewec: “Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e ŋic jaŋere meo feme qapie hâmorâ ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc eha fahareocmu.”
Iŋuc muhuc jazame dâŋticne kâuc barâ indiŋkeniŋte memeŋgaruc embiŋ.
Eme raku Kafanaum haeo fisimbiŋ. Fisirâ ficko ferâ motecfâcne indiŋ‐joparâ muwec, “Hatao wemo wiacte muc manac embieŋ?”
Indiŋ‐jopame mâc fâsâerâ ŋembiŋ; ine jaŋe hatao nâŋâcnaonec mozi micne sâko jukac muhuc mu qaqatarac embiŋ irec.
Eme waha ŋehuc motec hefârec‐jopa‐fârerâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Moc e micne juzo murâ gâcne sasawa jaŋere râpeo juhuc kiŋaŋ qaqa‐jeŋic ezejec.”
Iŋuc murâ motec piticne moc rorâ ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko râerâ menezi sabeckehuc jazawec,
“Moc e motec kecʒiŋucne nore erâ mamac rau ecneocmu eki no mamac rau enareocmu. Â no mamac rau enareocmuzi no nahacne mâcne, sorecnuwec e mamac rau ecneocmu.”
Eme Johanezi Jesu ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Qaqazu, nâŋe ŋic moc gore ʒâŋe muhuc demoŋ jâpec‐jopame honembeneŋ. Erâ nâŋâc mi bâjâpec‐nâpokacte qataracnembeneŋ.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Mi qataracnezo. Moc e nore ʒâŋe muhuc mâsi baocmu, iŋucnezi wemocko afeckerâ musâqorecnuocmu.
Gie‐nâŋec mi hetâtieocmuzi âgo babafic‐nâŋec eocmu.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Ŋic moczi ŋoŋe Kristore ŋicfâc juŋgopieŋte opâ sawa fia gumec eŋareocmu, jauŋ iŋucne mac i furimâc mi foocmu.
“Moc e biŋefâc‐nane piicne jaŋeraonec mocjaha mac sâqoreocte suru jâiŋ ecneocmu, e buse sâko upenao qonaŋkerâ hâwecko sârockepie hume muzac, izi wiac aafecne fuacnekac ezac.
Erâ megezi sâqocnere bitiŋko râecguzo eme hetâcnezemec. Go mefuru juku hârâcte ʒocsanaŋko huzicte sifu puriŋ erâ juju sanaŋko raʒizemec.[
Hârâcko umbeŋ‐jeŋic mi hâmoocmu â ʒoc mi hâpoocmu.]
Me kikegezi sâqocnere bitiŋko râecguzo eme hetâcnezemec. Go kike furu juku hârâcko huzicte sifu puriŋ erâ juju sanaŋko raʒizemec. [
Hârâcko umbeŋ‐jeŋic mi hâmoocmu â ʒoc mi hâpoocmu.]
Me ʒâŋegezi sâqocnere bitiŋko râecguzo eme ripozemec. Go ʒâŋe furu juku hârâcko huzicte sifu ʒâŋe fiŋgic erâ Anuture uucmaŋko raʒizemec.
Hârâcko umbeŋ‐jeŋic mi hâmoocmu â ʒoc mi hâpoocmu.
Ŋic mâmâc sasawa ʒoczi hâwec i rua‐jarezo.
Hâwec e wiac biaŋne. Izi nonocne eme ine weniŋuc ecnepie hâtânere tâpiri mocwâc fuaocmu? Ŋoŋe hâwechec junʒepieŋ erâ wama qaqac ehuc junʒepieŋ.”
Jesu e irecnec wahaku Judaia mâreŋko Jordaŋ ocniŋucnao fisiwec. Ira juhame ŋic hâhâwicne jâmbâŋ ŋetararâ mocwâc fisimbiŋ. Eme ejujec iŋuc harierâ miti jaza qazuc ewec.
Ehame farisaio jaŋe wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Ŋic moczi ŋonâŋ‐ticne beheme sâckeocmu me mâcne?”
I mâc esâickehuc mupie okacne ʒiŋuc wio‐jarewec: “Mose e irec dâŋ weniŋuc mufua‐ŋarewec?”
Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Ŋonâŋ moc behezo murâ pasi râcnehuc sorezo. Mose e irec mana‐nârewec.”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Mose e maŋsanaŋ‐ŋeŋicte erâ sâcmutâc dâŋ i qâreŋke‐ŋarewec.
Erâ fufuŋkenao Anutuzi ŋic bâfuac‐jopaocte ŋic â ŋokac râec‐jofawec.
Eme irec hâcne ŋic moczi neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne behec‐jofarâ ŋonâŋ‐ticnerao qohotame
jahe maŋsahac mocjaha erâ junicmu. Dâŋ iŋuc fokacte jahe jajahec mâcne, jahe mocjaha erâ jukopirec hâcne.
Anutuzi bâturec‐jofawec i ŋiczi mi bârâwiŋ‐jofazo.”
Eme ficko fisirâ motec jaŋe Jesu irecteaŋ mocwâc wiocnepie
fuŋne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋic moczi ŋonâŋ‐ticne beherâ moc baocmu, e ŋokac sahacko râec ecnehuc ʒuhuc bâtâcte kiŋsâko hureocmu.
Â ŋokac moczi ŋowe‐ticne beherâ moc baocmu, e iŋuc jaha ʒuʒuhuc‐jekic bâtâcnehuc kiŋsâko hureocmu.”
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ɋiefâc‐jeŋic Jesurao amec‐jopa rarâ mezi bâuac‐jopaocte mupie motec jaŋe hâhâwic hejarembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Jesuzi maname sâqoreme ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe behehapie ɋie jaŋe norao wareniŋ, aka mi hejareniŋ. Iŋucne jaŋe hâcne Anuture uucmaŋ biŋe qajarekicne.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Moc e ɋie jaŋere sâc ehuc Anuture uucmaŋ mi biŋeckeocmu e maŋnao mi raʒiocmu.”
Iŋuc murâ totoc‐jopahuc meticne qizec‐jeŋicko râerâ jambuŋ‐jopawec.
Jesu e mâreŋ i beherâ razo ehame ŋic moczi gasackerâ Jesurao fisirâ maŋfuŋnao fodapehuc wiocnewec, “Qaqazu biaŋ, no weniŋuc erâ juju sanaŋte biŋe epemu?”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Biaŋne wemocte munarekomec? Biaŋne rune Anutu mocjaha.
Erâ go sâcmutâc dâŋ manaekic, kecʒiŋuc: Go ʒika mi qazemec, ŋowe ŋonâŋ ŋohe bebehec mi ezepirec, go fiuc mi rozemec, go micko âkec mi ezemec, go ŋic wiac kâŋgâc mi jowac rozemec, go neŋgoc mamac jahecge sâsec‐jofazemec.”
Iŋuc muhuc âzâcneme ŋic e muwec, “Qaqazu, no i sasawa ɋie‐naneonecteaŋ reŋke warehuc juekopac.”
Eme Jesuzi honerâ ere ecneme âzâcnewec, “Mocjaha fokac, i ezemec, go rarâ moneŋ mafa wiacge ŋic hapetac qikiŋne‐jarezemec. Eme sambâŋko boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ fua‐gareocmu. Erâ ware bâjâpecnuzemec.”
Jesuzi iŋuc muhuc âzâcneme ŋic e bune sâqoreme mana ŋemâckerâ rawec, e moneŋ mafa ɋâfoŋne focnewec irec.
Rame Jesuzi fotikierâ motecfâcne honec‐jopahuc jazawec, “Moneŋ mafa sâkoheczi Anuture uucmaŋko raʒiniŋte ququŋkenehec eekac.”
Eme motec jaŋe dâŋ i manarâ fâfârepie harierâ jazawec, “Motecfâc‐nane, Anuture uucmaŋko raraʒi i wiac ŋemâcne.
Kamelezi buŋic hawecnao raraʒi i wiac afecne, â moneŋ mafa sâkoheczi Anuture uucmaŋko raraʒi i wiac ŋemâcne.”
Iŋuc mume manarâ weaŋkerâ mumbiŋ, “Hâc, eme mozi Anuture uucmaŋko raʒiocmu?”
Mupie Jesuzi honec‐joparâ muwec, “I ŋiczi eene mi fokac, erâ sifu Anutuzi wiac i me i hatane bâfuaocte mi quŋkeocmu.”
Petorozi dâŋ i manarâ Jesu ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, nâŋe wiac‐nâŋec sasawa râpecke‐fârerâ go bâjâpecgumbeŋ.”
Eme Jesuzi muwec, “No jâmbomac ŋazape: Moc e fic hae, hahac ɋa, seŋ qo, neŋgoc mamac, naru motec, jufu mumuc nore erâ â Biŋebiaŋte erâ beheocmu,
e okacne wiac qame hukicne jâmbâŋ raʒime raʒi roocmu. Ʒira mâreŋko fic hae, hahac ɋa, seŋ qo, neŋgoc, naru motec, jufu mumuc wiac i fific guguriŋ faio okacne fuacneocmu, erâ juku ʒâhec dameŋko juju sanaŋ rauckeocmu.
Erâ ine bâbâni jaŋeraonec bocjahazi ʒâhec eniŋmu â ʒâhec jaŋeraonec bocjahazi bâbâni eniŋmu.”
Jaŋe Jerusalem haeo feniŋte rambiŋ. Ehuc Jesuzi bânie‐jarehuc irapec rame wareckembiŋ. Â bâjâpec‐jopambiŋzi hâwic sahac jumbiŋ. Eme Jesuzi motecfâcne 12 mocbuc qâzuc‐joparâ wiac fuacneocmu irec dâŋ mufua‐jarehuc ʒiŋuc muwec:
“Manaŋgopieŋ, nâŋâc Jerusalem haeo feŋgopeneŋ. Eme ira Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu jaŋere meo feme jaŋe hâmoocte qâpuc jaŋerao râeniŋmu.
Eme jaŋe mu âke sisic ecnehuc tâfeckerâ becsahac biriŋneheczi qa qâʒâic ecnerâ qâhâmoniŋmu. Eme ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha mocwâc ɋârerâ fahareocmu.”
Eme Ʒebedaiore motec jahec Jakobo â Johane jahe Jesurao rarâ mupic, “Qaqazu, nâhe wiac irec me irec numu‐garepere enâctecmurâ numukoperec.”
Mupire wio‐jactewec, “Weniŋuc eŋactepere mukopirec?”
Eme jahe mupic, “Go manatecne juku tâpiri huririgao nâhe gâjoŋgao ŋifec â ŋifec ŋezeperec.”
Mupire Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ŋohe fuŋne kâuc bahuc iŋuc mukopirec. No opâ ʒaʒacne nâpemu i ŋohe sâcne nânicmu, â opâ fârone ruapemu i ŋohe sâcne ruanicmu me?”
Mume jahe mupic, “Ea, sâcne enacmu.” Mupire Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Noni opâ nâpemu i ŋohe jâmbomac nânicmu, â opâ ruapemu i ŋohe ruanicmu wâc.
Erâ gâjoŋ‐naneo ŋeŋe irec dâŋ mumu ine norao mi fokac, irec biŋe qajarekicne i jaŋe ŋeŋe ira ŋeniŋmu.”
Iŋuc epire motec gâcne jaŋe Jakobo â Johane mana‐jactepie sâqorewec.
Eme Jesuzi hefârec‐joparâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Mâreŋ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe ŋic rauc‐jopahuc kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic bacjopa jueŋgopieŋ â fekicne jaŋe omane qâhuc‐joparâ ŋicbomboŋ ejareeŋgopieŋ i manaeŋgopieŋ.
Â ŋoŋerao ine iŋuc mi fuazejec. Ŋoŋeraonec moczi fekicne ezo murâ âgofâc‐ticne jaŋere kiŋaŋ qaqa juzejec.
Â ŋoŋeraonec moczi micne‐ŋeŋic ezo murâ âgofâc‐ticne jaŋere gie bapa ŋic juzejec.
Wemocte? Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e ŋoŋe kiŋaŋ qacneniŋte mi wahawec e jahac kiŋaŋ qaqa gie bahuc ŋic bocjaha kiwiric‐jeŋic rora juju‐ticne qikiŋneocte wahawec.”
Jesu motecfâc jaŋe raku Jeriko haeo fisimbiŋ. Eme hae i fotâcnerâ rapie râpefuŋ‐jeŋicko ŋic guru sâko mâmâc rambiŋ. Ehame hatamecko ŋic tiŋtuŋ hapetac jâmbâŋ moc ŋewec, ʒâŋene Batimaio, Timaiore ŋokâ.
Eme eki Jesu Nazarete haeonec ware rakac mupie manarâ fâfâcnehec wirahuc muwec, “Jesu, go Dawidire ɋâriczi nore mac buge sâqoreoc!”
Boc wirame ŋic jaŋe niniŋkerâ ŋeocte mu hâhâwic ecnembiŋ. Eme eki dâŋjeŋic mana takirehuc fotarierâ wirawec, “Go Dawidire ɋâriczi nore mac buge sâqoreoc!”
Wirakume Jesuzi manarâ hatao domahuc muwec, “Ecnepie wareoc.” Mume ŋic jaŋe tiŋtuŋ wiracnehuc mumbiŋ, “Sahacge âke urueme fahare warec, hefârecgukac.”
Eme tiŋtuŋzi dâŋ i manarâ izia bilaŋke‐ticne hetararâ furutuc herâ faharerâ Jesurao rawec.
Ra fisime ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnewec: “Wemo egarepemurâ mukic?” Eme tiŋtuŋzi muwec, “Qaqazu‐nane, no ʒâŋe fifihec epemurâ enarekac.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go rac, mamanasiŋgere biaŋkekomec.” Muha izia ʒâŋe fifihec erâ Jesu bâjâperâ rawec.
Eme raku Jerusalem hae bâqiŋkezo ehuc Oliwa tikio Betefage â Betania hae ŋepicko fisimbiŋ. Ira fisirâ Jesuzi motec jajahec
sorec‐jofahuc muwec, “Hae raecko ŋekac ira ranic. Raferâ izia doŋgi motecne niŋgiŋko domakac i bâfuanicmu. Motecne i ŋiczi fainao mi ŋekicne furune. Eme i bâfuarâ firuerâ bawareniŋ.
Firuepire ŋic moczi, wemocte rokopirec, mume ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnenic: ‘Wofuŋ‐nâheczi irec mukac, erâ biac mocwâc râeme wareocmu.’”
Iŋuc muhuc jasame motec jahec rarâ doŋgi motecne ficmotâcko mai jaha niŋgiŋko domame bâfuarâ firuepic.
Firuepire ŋic domambiŋ jaŋe honec‐jofarâ mumbiŋ, “Hâc, mozi mume rokopirec?”
Mupie Jesuzi dâŋ jasawec i jazapire manapie tarawec.
Eme Jesurao bararâ fainao ŋaqi‐jeŋic râepie eki ferâ ŋewec.
Eme ŋic bocjahazi ŋaqi‐jeŋic hatao rumacke rambiŋ â tucnezi gieonec ʒariŋ bazurâ râe rambiŋ.
Eme ŋic guru sâko roʒâc bâʒâŋiŋ ecnembiŋ jaŋe kecʒiŋuc muhuc ofac hecnembiŋ: “Ohec, Wofuŋte micte ware‐nârekomec go mumbiaŋgunaŋ.
Apa‐nâŋec Dawidi ere guriŋ bapa risie‐nârekacte ʒerienaŋ. Ohec, Anutu fâic sambâŋko.”
Iŋuc ecnehapie Jerusalem haeo fe fisirâ Jesuzi taha ufuŋko raʒiwec. Raʒirâ wiac sasawa hone manac efârerâ hae biac owâeme waharâ motecfâc‐ticne 12 rocjopame Betania haeo fembiŋ.
Hae fureme jaŋehec Betania haeonec wahahuc Jesu nânâre hâmowec.
Ehuc fime rame jâmbo jâcne moc rehacnehec honerâ fârine ŋekac muhuc ra basawec: Fârine fufua dameŋ mi maickewecte rehacne sawa domawec.
Iŋuc honerâ jâc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Goraonec fârine nânâ i ŋic moczi mocwâc mi nâjâmbâŋkezejec.” Eme dâŋ i motecfâcne jaŋe manambiŋ.
Eme Jerusalem haeo fembiŋ. Eme Jesuzi taha ufuŋko ferâ ŋic ira wiac nareŋ gareŋ ehuc domambiŋ jaŋe jâpec‐joparâ moneŋ katapa‐jeŋic â hapâ ŋeŋe herândiŋkewec.
Erâ taha ufuŋko wiac iŋucne moc ba rac warec mi eniŋte muac‐jopawec.
Iŋuc ejarerâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Dâŋqâreŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac: Ficnane i mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋere nunumu fic ezejec. Ŋoŋe ine epie fiuc sindaŋhec jaŋere qânâuŋ tinac ekac.”
Iŋuc eme taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu jaŋe honerâ, weniŋuc erâ qapene arictac ezejec muhuc nazaŋ gazaŋ embiŋ. Erâ fuŋne ʒiŋucte ere hâwic‐jopawec: Ŋic mâmâc sasawa miti‐ticnere manapie bipine sâkohec ewec.
Eme Jesu â motecfâcne jaŋe hae owâeme sâc hae sâko beherâ rahuc jumbiŋ.
Hae fureme jâmbojâc domawecko mocwâc ra fisirâ honembiŋ: Jâc hâmo bâŋeŋ erâ domawec.
Eme Petorozi honerâ Jesu dâŋ muwec i manasurâ âzâcnewec, “Qaqazu honec, jâmbo jâc sâweckemec e ururuckejec domakac.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe Anutu manasiŋkehuc junʒepieŋ.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Moc e tiki kecocni hockerâ hâwecko huc âzâcneocmu, ehuc mupe sanaŋkeocmu me mâcne, maŋjahec iŋuc mi erâ manapaŋkehuc muocmu, i fârine fuaocmu.
Irec ŋazape mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe wiac irec me irec manasurâ numuniŋmu, ine biac roŋgopeneŋ muhuc mana ʒakiepie fua‐ŋareocmu.
Erâ numuzo murâ ŋic mocte kiŋtofa bajuŋgopieŋko behenʒepieŋ. Iŋuc epie sambâŋ Mamac‐ŋeŋiczi iŋuc jaha ŋoŋere kiŋtofa beheocmu.[
Me ŋoŋe ŋic jaŋere kiŋtofa bajupie sambâŋ Mamac‐ŋeŋiczi iŋuc jaha ŋoŋere kiŋtofa bajuocmu.]”
Jesu motecfâc jaŋe mocwâc Jerusalem haeo risiembiŋ. Risierâ Jesuzi taha ufuŋko ferâ juhame taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu â soŋaŋ erao fisirâ
indiŋkerâ mumbiŋ, “Go ʒira wiac eekic i more micte eekomec? Mozi iŋuc ecmurâ mugareme eekomec?”
Esâickepie dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarewec: “No dâŋ mocjaha sawa wio‐ŋarepe nazapie noni iŋuc jaha more micte wiac eekopac i okacne ŋazapemu.
Johane Miti Opâ gie‐ticne i wenirec fuawec, sambâŋkonec me ŋickonec? Mupie manape.”
Iŋuc jazame jaŋackoaŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc nazaŋ gazaŋ embiŋ: “Nâŋâc sambâŋkonec fuawec iŋuc mupene muocmu ‘Hâc, eme wemocte dâŋticne mi mana ʒakiembiŋ?’
Me ŋickonec fuawec iŋuc moc munaŋ?” Erâ iŋuc muniŋte ŋic jaŋere hâwic‐jopawec. Jaŋe ʒeŋgoma Johanere manapie porofete jâmbâŋ ewec.
Eme Jesu ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Nâŋe mi manaŋgopeneŋ.” Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wiac murâ sâcne, eme noni iŋuc jaha more micte ʒira wiac eekopac okacne wâc mi ŋazapemu.”
Jesu e fuŋkerâ dâŋ suŋsuŋne moc kecʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋic moczi mâreŋ mocko waiŋ saraku sara‐fârerâ sac hafewec. Erâ waiŋ bâbâpisic toma ba akic erâ soŋaŋ jaŋere fic barâ gie sasawa mejeŋicko râerâ mâreŋ mocko rawec.
Jukuhame fârine fufua dameŋ maickeme kiŋaŋ motec‐ticne moc fârine tucne roocte soreme ra fisime
soŋaŋ jaŋe rorâ qa imac ecnerâ jâpepie metariŋ risiewec.
Risieme runezi kiŋaŋ motec moc soreme rame qizecne hefâuckerâ sopeckembiŋ.
Eme runezi harierâ kiŋaŋ motec moc soreme jaŋerao fisime qambiŋ. Qapie runezi ŋic bocjaha sorec‐jopame ra fisipie soŋaŋ jaŋe ʒika bâfuarâ gâcne ʒâpâ jopambiŋ â gâcne hâmocne jopambiŋ.
Eme mocjaha jucnewec, joroc ŋokâ‐ticne hâcne, e ʒâhec ʒiŋuc muhuc soŋaŋ jaŋerao sorewec: ‘No nahacne ŋokâ araŋ bacnehuc akickeniŋmu.’
Eme soŋaŋ jaŋe ine ŋokâ‐ticne honerâ nazaŋ gazaŋ erâ mumbiŋ, ‘Eki hâcne juku gie rauckeocmu, ajoc, qanaŋ, eme gie ʒi nâŋâcne ezejec.’
Iŋuc muhuc rorâ qâhâmorâ qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne gie sahacnao behepie huwec.”
“Eme gie rune e weniŋuc eocmu? E fisirâ soŋaŋ i jopa qâhâmoc ejarerâ gie‐ticnao soŋaŋ biaŋne moc râec‐jopaocmu.
Miti papiao dâŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac i wose manac mi eeŋgopieŋ me? ‘Ficbapa ŋic jaŋe wâtuŋ surehec behembiŋ, wâtuŋ izi mi jâmâ wâtuŋ ezejec i!
Wiac i Wofuŋte micte iŋuc fuame ŋiczi honepene mâsi furune ekac.’”
Jesuzi iŋuc jazame micne bapa jaŋe e kâpâcwâru baniŋte manasurâ ŋic jaŋere hâwic‐jopame hata basambiŋ. Jaŋe ʒiŋuc mana tarambiŋ: Dâŋ i nâŋere mukac. Erâ roniŋte quŋkehuc mâc beherâ rambiŋ.
Judaŋic micne jaŋe farisaio ŋic gâcne â Herodere âgofâc tucne Jesu dâŋzi bitiŋ bacneniŋte sorec‐jopambiŋ.
Sorec‐jopapie Jesurao fisirâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Qaqazu, nâŋe gore fuŋne manaeŋgopeneŋ, go dâŋburec mi ehuc jâmbomac jaha muekic, erâ fekicne fosâoc‐jopahuc dâŋ mi muhasickeekic, go fekicne wahakicne mâmâc sasawa Anuture hata sâcne nâzâ nâwotuc eekic. Irec mutec mananaŋ, Sisa takesi moneŋ râcnepene sâckeekac me mâcne,
râcnezo me mi râcnezo?” Iŋuc mupie Jesuzi burec‐jeŋicte fuŋne mana tararâ jazawec, “Ŋoŋe wemocte dâŋzi bitiŋ banareŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe siliwa moneŋ moc bâfuarâ nowatupie honepe.”
Eme jaŋe moc râcnepie wio‐jarerâ muwec, “Hawari â qâreŋ ʒi more me?” Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Sisare”.
Iŋuc mupie jazawec, “Murâ Sisare biŋe i Sisa râcnenʒepieŋ â Anuture biŋe i Anutu râcnenʒepieŋ.” Iŋuc muhuc jazame jaŋe wareckembiŋ.
Jaŋe rahapie sadukaio ŋic tucne fisimbiŋ. Ŋic i jaŋe hâmockonec fafahare mi fokac iŋuc muhuc jumbiŋ. Jaŋe hâcne fisirâ mumbiŋ:
“Qaqazu, Mosezi kecʒiŋuc mu qâreŋ enârewec: ‘Ŋic moczi ŋokac rorâ ɋâric‐ticne mi fuahame hâmome ɋanezi hozec‐ticne rorâ hahac‐ticnere biŋe ɋâric bâfuazejec.’
Eme hahac ɋa 7 jumbiŋ, ehuc mârâc hahac‐jeŋic ŋokac rorâ ɋâric tâmiric jurâ hâmowec.
Hâmome ɋanezi hozec‐ticne rorâ iŋuc jaha ɋâric tâmiric jurâ hâmome ɋaticne moczi hozec ijaha rowec.
Iŋuczi iŋuc hahac ɋa 7 jaŋe ŋokac ijaha rorâ ɋâric tâmiric hâmo‐fârembiŋ. Eme ʒâhecko hozec‐jeŋic iŋuc jaha wâc hâmowec.
Eme ŋic 7 jaŋe mâmâc sasawa ŋokac ijaha rombiŋte juku dameŋ sâkoo fahare‐fârepie ŋokac e more ezokac?”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe dâŋ mana sifuckeeŋgopieŋ, i mâc mâcne, ŋoŋe miti papia â Anutu tâpiri‐ticne kâuc baeŋgopieŋ irec.
Juku hâmockonec faharerâ ŋic â ŋokac roroc mocwâc mi enʒoŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe sambâŋ aŋelo iŋucne erâ mâc junʒoŋgopieŋ.
Eme ŋoŋe hâmockonec fafaharere muŋgopieŋte ŋazape: Mose e jâcko ʒocbâruŋ fuame honerâ rame Anutuzi dâŋ âzâcnewec, binaŋ i wose manac eeŋgopieŋ me mâcne? Ine dâŋ kecʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘No Abraham â Isaka â Jakobo jaŋere Anutu.’
Ine hâcne, e hâmockicne jaŋere Anutu mâcne, e ɋâricne juju jaŋere Anutu. Ŋoŋe ine dâŋ boc mana sifuckeeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme Jesuhec mu bârisiec ehapie eki okacne musarickehuc bâtikie‐jareme miti qaqazu jaŋeraonec moczi manarâ Jesu fuacnerâ ʒiŋuc wiocnewec: “Sâcmutâc dâŋ wenimoizi qizecne sâko?”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Sâcmutâc dâŋ femicne ʒiŋuc fokac: ‘Israe ŋicbureŋ ŋoŋe mananiŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec e Wofuŋ fârine mocjaha.
Irec maŋge â qâqâtâcge â mamanasuge â tâpirige i Wofuŋ Anutuge furu jaha qikiŋnecnetec fozejec.’
Erâ dâŋ âgone moc kecʒiŋuc fokac: ‘Go gahacnere egareekac, sâc ijaha âgogere egarezejec.’ Sâcmutâc dâŋ i jahere femicne moc mi fokac.”
Iŋuc mume miti qaqazuzi dâŋ ijaha herisiecnehuc muwec, “Qaqazu, go dâŋ mutecne manape sâcke‐hâmokac, Anutu e jâmbomac Wofuŋ fârine mocjaha, erâ e iŋucne moc mi jukac.
Erâ e maŋ â mamanasu â tâpiri furu qikiŋnecnezo, â gahacnere egareekac irec sâc âgoge maŋjauŋ ecnezo, izi bâzi fuŋne fuŋne ririke sirickekac.”
Ŋic e iŋuc mume Jesuzi maname sâckeme ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Anuture uucmaŋ bâqiŋkekomec.” Eme dameŋ ira ŋic jaŋe Jesu wiocneniŋte manapie ŋemâckeme behembiŋ.
Eme Jesu e taha ufuŋko ŋic miti jazahuc ʒiŋuc muhuc indiŋ‐jopawec: “Kristo e Dawidire ɋâric, miti qaqazu jaŋe weniŋucte iŋuc mueŋgopieŋ?
Dawidi e jahac Tiri Mârozi ecneme ʒiŋuc muwec: ‘Wofuŋzi nore Wofuŋ âzâcnewec, Go ware fâre‐naneo ŋehaŋtec râsifâcge kikegere rurumaŋko guruc‐jopazepac.’
Irec Dawidi e Wofuŋ‐nane mucnewec, iŋucnezi weniŋuc erâ ɋâric‐ticne ekac?” Jesu e miti iŋuc muhuc jazame ŋic guru sâko jaŋe mana aŋac embiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi miti muhuc dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ jazawec: “Ŋoŋe miti qaqazu jaŋe bâec bajarenʒepieŋ. Jaŋe ŋaqi ʒora rojuhuc hatao ŋic bâfuac‐jopapie mu ʒeri ejareniŋte maŋjeŋic domaekac.
Erâ mitificko â tutumaŋ ficko ŋicbomboŋ ŋeŋeoa micne ŋeniŋte mueŋgopieŋ.
Iŋucnezi hozec jaŋere fic wiac kâŋgâc jowac roeŋgopieŋ, erâ nunumu ʒorazi hehesic‐jeŋic hefackeeŋgopieŋ. Ŋic i jaŋe juku okacne hâhâwicne ronʒoŋgopieŋ.”
Jesu e taha ufuŋko moneŋ rârâe katapa irec ŋifecnao ŋehuc honehame ŋic jaŋe moneŋ râepie huwec. Ehuc mafaŋic bocjaha jaŋe fisirâ moneŋ ŋemâcne râepie huwec.
Ehame hozec hapetac moczi fisirâ toea bâbâroŋ mocjaha mac moc râewec.
Eme Jesuzi i honerâ motecfâcne hefârec‐joparâ jazawec, “No jâmbomac ŋazape: Hozec hapetac kecizi moneŋ râekac, i gâcne jaŋere sâc jâurukac.
Gâcne jaŋe neŋgocne sâko fojarehame tucne sawa râembieŋ. Â hozec e hapetaczi focnewec sâc râe‐fârerâ mâc jâmbâŋ jukac.”
Eme Jesuzi taha ufuŋkonec waha rame motecfâcne jaŋeraonec moczi mu warec ehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Qaqazu honec, ufuŋ aŋac baŋac biaŋ, qânâ hâhâwicnezi basirickerâ bakicne.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ufuŋ sâko mako ŋehame honeekic? Juku ine râsi jaŋe heroc qâropiepie ŋetâc qâtâtiezokac.”
Eme Jesu â motecfâcne Oliwa tikio ferâ opâ ocniŋucnao ŋehapie ufuŋ e ʒiŋucnao ŋewec. Ira ŋehuc Petoro, Jakobo, Johane â Anderea jaŋe Jesu bucko wiocnerâ mumbiŋ,
“Wiac mumec i wezimucko fuazokac â dâŋ i sanaŋkezo eha sowi weniŋucne moc fuazokac?”
Eme Jesuzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc fuŋkerâ jazawec: “Juku maŋ bâsifuc eŋarenʒipiŋte sawaŋ‐ŋeŋic qahuc junʒepieŋ.
Ŋic bocjaha fuarâ nore ʒâŋeo mâc âke hotahuc muniŋmu ‘No Kristo’. Iŋuc muhuc ŋic bocjaha maŋ bâsifuc ejareniŋmu.
Erâ ʒika fârine â ojowane fuame manarâ maŋŋeŋic mi gâckezejec. Wiac iŋucne hâcne fuaocte mukicne, erâ fuame sifu dameŋ biac mi taraocmu.
Mâreŋne mâreŋne ŋic guru sâko guru pitic jaŋe rârâsi efârerâ ra qa ware qa ehuc qaqac ranʒoŋgopieŋ. Ehame homeŋ iŋuc jaha ra ba ware ba ezokac. Erâ roroczi roroc fua razokac. Erâ i mâc gozi kikine sawa ezokac.
“Ŋoŋe sawaŋ‐ŋeŋic qahuc junʒepieŋ. Jaŋe dâŋko râec‐ŋopaniŋmu â mitificko kâcbiŋzi ŋopaniŋmu. Erâ i sawa mâcne, kia â ŋicwofuŋ jaŋerao wâc bacŋopa rapie jaŋere maio domahuc nore erâ mumutaniŋ gie baniŋmu.
Erâ dameŋ ine jâpec mi taraocmu, qanaŋ Biŋebiaŋ mâreŋ sâc murapie haŋ baocte mukicne.
Eme kia jaŋerao bacŋopa rapie dâŋ weniŋuc munaŋmu muhuc mana mezac mi enʒepieŋ. Dameŋ ira Mârozi maŋŋeŋicko dâŋ râeocmu ijaha munʒepieŋ. Iŋuc ehuc dâŋ mupie ŋoŋere dâŋ mi eocmu, i Tiri Mârore dâŋ eocmu.
Eme ŋic jaŋe wiac kecʒiŋuc eniŋmu: Hahac moczi ɋaticne doc bame qaniŋmu â mamac moczi ŋokâ‐ticne doc bame qaniŋmu â naru motec jaŋe neŋgoc mamacfâc‐jeŋic kisâ ejarehuc doc bacjopapie jopaniŋmu.
Eme ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanere erâ ŋic mâmâc sasawa jaŋe ŋoŋere manapie aaricnehec eocmu. Eme moc e miti paŋnea barâ domakume dameŋ tarame rozo.
“Juku mamakâc qizecne sisipiric‐ticnehec, mi dodomanao domazokac. (Ŋoŋe dâŋ i aimuŋ mac wose manac enʒepieŋ.) Iŋuc fuame honerâ Judaia mâreŋkonec ŋiczi tiki mâreŋko wiserâ ranʒepieŋ.
Ehuc hae ʒoŋao juocmuzi ficmaŋ‐ticnao risie ferâ mafa‐ticne mi rozejec.
Â gieo juocmuzi haeo rarâ ŋaqi bilaŋke‐ticne mi rozejec.
Jei, ŋokac kiwecheczi â susuonecheczi ine weniŋuc enʒoŋgopieŋ!
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ numucnepie maname wiwise‐ŋeŋic hoemaŋko mi fuazejec.
Eme dameŋ ira bâŋeŋkerâ weaŋsic nânâ femicne sâko fuazokac, sâc iŋucne Anutuzi ŋic bâfuac‐jopaweckonecteaŋ mi fuawec â juku wâc mi fuazokac.
Wofuŋ e dameŋ i mi bâtâcneme muzac, ŋic moczi miti barâ jukume rorone i mi fua‐jâmbâŋkezac. Bâwosâecfâc‐ticne jaŋere erâ ine dameŋ bâtâcnewec.
Eme ‘Kristo e ʒira nâŋerao fuakac’, ‘Kristo e ocna jaŋerao fuakac’, dâŋ iŋuc mupie mi mananʒepieŋ.
Dameŋ ira Mesia burecne â porofete burecne fuarâ mâsi â wiac hâhâwicne bahuc ŋic maŋ bâsifuc ejareniŋmu. Ehuc bâwosâecfâc‐ticne jaŋere maŋ bâsifuckeniŋte gie sâko baniŋmu wâc. Erâ jaŋe maŋ bâsifuc eejarene mi fokacte eipieniŋmu.
Wiac i mi fuaha qanaŋ ŋazakopacte sawaŋ‐ŋeŋic qahuc junʒepieŋ.
“Eme bâŋeŋkerâ weaŋsic nânâ qaʒueha ʒoaŋ gâpârezokac â mosa tatamacne arictac ezokac
â bâpiŋ gâcne tararâ mâreŋko wahanʒoŋgopieŋ. Ehame sambâŋ qiriŋ qame tâpirine ŋeŋgoroŋkezokac.
Eme Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e karorac faio ŋehuc ɋuŋɋasaŋ bâric bâricnehec fisime jaŋe hone ʒâirenʒoŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc aŋelo sorec‐jopame jaŋe bâwosâecfâc‐ticne mâreŋ ŋifec â ŋifec, faic â juwic, sambâŋ â mâreŋ qaŋeŋ‐jekickonec qânusuc‐jopanʒoŋgopieŋ.
“Firindoaczi mâsi eekac irec manasuhuc fuŋne mananʒepieŋ. E âric qame honerâ mueŋgopieŋ ‘Ʒoaŋ dameŋ bembeŋkekac’.
Eme ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha, ŋazakopac wiac i fua‐fâreme ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘E maic‐nâpozo ehuc motâc râpeo domakac’.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Mâreŋ ʒirec rune mi sisirowe jufehuc juhapie wiac sasawa fua tarazokac.
Sambâŋ â mâreŋ jahe sirowezokopirec, nore dâŋ ine mi sirowe‐jâmbâŋkezokac.
Erâ dameŋ sâko irec ʒoaŋ me aua ŋic moczi mi mana‐jâmbâŋkekac, sambâŋko aŋelo jaŋe wâc mi manaŋgopieŋ, Ŋokâzi wâc mi manakac, Mamac e buc manakac.
“Dameŋ mi manaŋgopieŋte maŋŋeŋiczi rucjari bahuc numunʒepieŋ.
Ŋic moczi ficgie‐ticne beherâ mâreŋ wiwicko raocte kiŋaŋ motecfâcne gie mutâcne‐jarehuc wiac‐ticne hone qâzuc eniŋte jazaocmu â soŋaŋ e rucgereŋ biaŋne juocte âzâcneocmu.
Eme ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha rucgereŋ‐ŋeŋic biaŋne bahuc junʒepieŋ. Ficrune e owâcne me ŋafe ʒâŋiŋko me ŋafe furec hehec‐jekicko me furicte fisiocmu mi manaŋgopieŋte mukopac iŋuc hâcne ehuc junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe guŋ fohapie ututuŋ fisirâ bâfuac‐ŋopazackohec.
Erâ ŋoŋe â gâcne sâko mâmâc ʒiŋuc ŋazakopac: Maŋɋâri jaha junʒepieŋ.”
Goreŋ sowa juhuc aakic hombaŋ ŋeniŋte dameŋ Neŋgocgieo maickewec. Ehame irec juwicnao Mituâcko taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu jaŋe Jesu soŋsoŋko rorâ qaniŋte dâŋ mumockembiŋ.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Hombaŋkoa misac, ŋic bâiŋ‐jopapene ʒika kosa fuazackohec.”
Jesuzi Betania haeo Simoŋ wicsanaŋ ecnewec ere ficko ferâ ŋewec. Ira nânâ nâhuc ŋehame ŋokac moczi opâ âsu biaŋ furi sâko kiruŋnehec baferâ qizec‐ticnao furu jaha hesieme ruacnewec.
Ruacneme ŋic ŋembiŋ jaŋeraonec tucnezi mu takic erâ mumbiŋ, “Wiac furi sâko wemocte sipirickekac?
Opâ âsu biaŋ izi siliwa moneŋ 300 kitâcneme ŋic hapetac jarepene sâckezac me!” Iŋuc muhuc ŋokac dâŋ ɋeŋɋeŋne ecnembiŋ.
Mupie Jesuzi manarâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ŋokac e beheniŋ, wemocte mumu hehec ecneŋgopieŋ? Ŋokac e jauŋ bacnume biaŋkekac.
Ŋic hapetac dameŋ sâc ŋoŋerao juhapie jauŋ bacjopazo murâ bacjopanʒepieŋ, noni ine ŋoŋerao boc mi jupemu.
Ŋokac e eesâc‐ticne enarekac. No biac hâmope ducnuniŋmu, irec sahac‐nane qanaŋ mâzockekac.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Biŋebiaŋ mâreŋne mâreŋne mupie haŋ baocmu sâc, ŋokac kecʒi mâzocnukac ere manasuhuc biŋe‐ticne mâmâc mupie haŋ baocmu.”
Eme motec jaŋere âgo moc ʒâŋene Juda Karioto haeonec, eki taha bapa micne jaŋerao rarâ Jesu doc bajareocte mufua‐jarewec.
Iŋuc eme manarâ bujeŋic biaŋkeme furine moneŋ râcneniŋte mumbiŋ. Eme i manarâ Jesu kamierâ doc baocte hone jâjâpehuc juwec.
Goreŋ sowa juhuc aakic lama hezu rikec ezore dameŋ maickeme motec jaŋe Sekiqanâcko Jesu wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Aakic lama fic wena rike bâmoc egarenʒepeneŋ?”
Iŋuc mupie motec jajahec ʒiŋuc jasahuc sorec‐jofawec: “Ŋohe haeo ferâ ŋic moc opâ râqâchec bâfuarâ bâjâpenic,
erâ ficko feme ferâ fic rune ʒiŋuc âzâcnenic: ‘Qaqazu e gore ʒiŋuc mukac, fic maŋne wena motecfâc‐nane jaŋehec aakic lama nanaŋmu?’
Iŋuc âzâcnepire fic maŋne kâcɋene moc ŋeŋe fofo wiac rumacke emasaŋ ekicne i ŋofatume ira aakic lama rike bâmoc ezepirec.”
Eme motec jahec dâŋ i reŋkerâ haeo raferâ Jesuzi muwec sâc i bâfuarâ aakic lama rike bâmoc epic.
Eme hae ŋafeme e motecfâcne 12 jaŋehec fic maŋne ira fisimbiŋ.
Eme teboo nânâ nâhuc Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No jâmbomac ŋazape: Ŋoŋeraonec moczi no doc bacnuocmu, nohec nânâ nâhuc ŋeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋeraonec moczi hâcne.”
Mume motec jaŋe bujeŋic sâqoreme buc buc wiocnehuc mumbiŋ, “Go nore wiac moc murâ?”
Wiocnepie jazawec, “Motec 12 ŋoŋeraonec moczi nohec poroŋ sicko âke uruckerâ nakac eki hâcne.
Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e mitio hata muʒâwecnekicne ira razo ekac hâcne. Â Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne doc baocmu e ine, jei, okacne mo iŋucne roocmu! Ŋic e neŋgoc bumaŋkonec mi fuame muzac, afeckecnezac.”
Eme tiwâ nârâ Jesuzi poroŋ rorâ jambuŋkerâ motecfâcne ʒiŋuc muhuc jarewec: “Ro nâniŋ, kecʒi fâri‐nane.”
Iŋuc murâ waiŋ râqâc rorâ daŋge murâ jareme mâmâc sasawa nâmbiŋ.
Nahapie jazawec, “Ŋoŋehec ʒâʒâfic ezore socnane keci hâcne, i ŋic bocjaha ŋoŋere erâ qikiŋnekicne.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: No waiŋ opâ mocwâc mi nânâ juku Anuture uucmaŋko waiŋ opâ fuŋmoc nâzokopac.”
Eme gae herâ haeonec rahurâ ocniŋuc Oliwa tikio fembiŋ.
Fehuctecne Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe mâmâc sasawa miŋecgac nore manapie sâqoreocmu. Dâŋqâreŋ moc ʒiŋuc fokac i sanaŋkeocmu: ‘No soŋaŋ qape lama jaŋe siŋsaŋ qaniŋmu.’
Eme hâmockonec faharerâ ine Galilaia mâreŋko rahuc bânie‐ŋarepemu.”
Iŋuc mume Petorozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Jaŋe mâmâc sasawa gore manapie sâqoreocmu mecne, â no ine iŋuc mi egarepemu.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No jâmbomac gazape: Miŋecgac ŋafeo qâqâczi jajahec mi dâŋeha go jahec â moc mic bacnucmu.”
Mume Petoro qizec qarâ muwec, “Go gahacne guhuc no mâmâc nuzo mupie sifu mi mic bacgupemu.” Mume motec âgofâcne bafickerâ ijaha mufârembiŋ.
Eme raku jufu mocko fisimbiŋ, ʒâŋene Gezemane. Ira fisirâ motec ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ʒira ŋehapie no ocna rarâ numupe.”
Iŋuc murâ Petoro, Jakobo â Johane rocjopame rahuc hâhâwic fuŋkerâ me kike tatara ecnewec.
Iŋuc ecneme jazarâ muwec, “Maŋnane hâhâtâweme hâhâmocne enarekac, irec ŋoŋe ʒira ŋehuc nohec mâmâc maŋɋâri juniŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ ipec rarâ ʒâŋe maine mâreŋko hetutuckerâ ʒâic dameŋ i Mamacnezi maname eene eha rireocte numuwec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Mamac‐nane, go wiac moc mi bâipieekiczi mutec ʒâic guru kecʒi nowaruzejec. Erâ sifu nore dâŋ mâcne, gore dâŋ sanaŋkezejec.”
Iŋuc murâ risierâ guŋ fohapie honec‐joparâ Petoro ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Simoŋ, go wemocte guŋ fokomec? Go piticne ɋâricne sâcne mi junʒaŋ me?
Eesâicko dockenʒipiŋte maŋɋâri juhuo numuniŋ. Maŋzi afeckekac â sahaczi ine ŋemâckekac.”
Iŋuc jazarâ mocwâc rarâ, mârâc numuwec ijaha numuwec.
Numurâ risierâ guŋ jaha fopie honec‐jopawec. Jaŋe guŋkonec fi qeruruc erâ wemocko afeckerâ dâŋ moc âzâcnenʒapiŋ.
Eme mocwâc ra numurâ risiehame jahec â moc eme jazawec, “Ŋoŋe guŋ jaha fohuc fomanaŋgopieŋ me? Ʒi sâckekac. Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e sâqocne bapa jaŋere meo feocte dameŋne maickekac.
Faharepie ranaŋ, docbapazi bâqiŋnukac ine.”
Iŋuc jazahuc domahame izia motec âgo‐jeŋic moc, Juda Karioto haeonec, eki râsi guru micne bajareme ɋeŋfâfâc jaha fisimbiŋ. Taha bapa micne, miti qaqazu â soŋaŋ jaŋe sorec‐jopapie ʒika ɋaruc wiac barâ fisimbiŋ.
Docbapa eki ine madâŋ qanaŋ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Muduckepe honerâ ine hâcne muhuc deŋnea ro basanaŋkerâ barâ ranʒepieŋ.”
Eme fisirâ izia Jesurao rarâ “O Qaqazu‐nane” muhuc muduckewec.
Iŋuc eme honerâ rorâ basanaŋkembiŋ.
Ehapie motec domambiŋ jaŋeraonec moczi ʒika‐ticne unuckerâ taha bapa sâkore kiŋaŋ motec qaocte hazecne qatarawec.
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe nore manapie ʒika qaqa eme ʒika ɋaruchec fisirâ rocnuŋgopieŋ me?
No ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne taha ufuŋko ŋic miti qazu‐jarehuc juekopac, ehame ŋoŋe ira mi rocnumbiŋ. Erâ sifu enarepie miti papiao nore dâŋqâreŋ fokac i sanaŋkezejec.”
Eme mâmâc sasawa beherâ wise‐fârembiŋ.
Ehame ŋicmotec moc qoruc qaŋqaŋ‐ticneheczi e bâjâpehame rombiŋ.
Ropie qoruc hetararâ biuctac wisewec.
