Me ŋafe ʒâʒâŋiŋko me ŋafe furec hehec‐jekicko risierâ maŋɋâri juhapie bâfuac‐jopaocmu ine biaŋke‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.
Ŋoŋe fuŋne ʒiŋuc mananiŋ, hae moc irec ŋic jaŋe râsi ŋafe ira fisiniŋmu, dameŋ iŋuc manarâ maŋɋâri jaha juhuc hae‐jeŋic soŋaŋkeniŋmu.
Eme Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e iŋuc jaha mi manasuniŋmu dameŋ ira fisiocmure ʒawierâ junʒepieŋ.”
Jesu e dâŋ iŋuc mume Petorozi wiocnerâ muwec: “Wofuŋ go kesaic dâŋ ʒi bucnâŋecte me mâmâc sâko‐nâŋecte mukomec?”
Wiome Wofuŋzi dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Ŋicbomboŋ moczi kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne jaŋere soŋaŋ moc râehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcneocmu: ‘No ra juhape go soŋaŋ‐jopahuc dameŋkoa nânâ qowi sâcjeŋic jarehuc juzemec.’ Eme e weniŋuc jume soŋaŋ maŋhec â micrereŋhec mucnezo?
Soŋaŋ e gie mucnekicne i aijaki jaha bahuc juhame bomboŋ‐ticnezi fisiocmu, soŋaŋ iŋucnere manape ʒerine ekac.
No jâmbomac mupe mananiŋ: E ŋic i soŋaŋ kâcɋene râehuc wiac‐ticne mâmâc sasawa soŋaŋkeocte mucneocmu.
Me ŋic e soŋaŋ sâqocne juhuctecne maŋnezi ʒiŋuc muocmu: ‘Bomboŋ‐nane e jâpec mâcne, juku jaha risiezokac.’ Iŋuc muhuc kiŋaŋ qaqa qa imac ejareocmu, â qâoma erâ wiac kosa ehuc juocmu.
Ehuc ŋicbomboŋ‐ticne risieocmu dameŋ irec mi mamanasu nâme nikec juocmu, ine ŋicbomboŋ e ututuŋ fisirâ hetâc qâtâcnerâ miti bâbâsifuc ŋic jaŋere jujuo râeocmu.
Kiŋaŋ motec moc e bomboŋ‐ticnere micdâŋ mana‐hâmo‐bipiehuc qaqatara bâfuaocmu, e ʒika ŋemâcne kiocmu,
â moc e bomboŋ‐ticnere micdâŋ kâuc bahuc qaqatara bâfuaocmu, e ʒika afecne kiocmu. Moc e wiac ŋemâcne râcne tahac ecnekicnezi fârine ŋemâcne jaha bâfuame sâckeocmu. Â moc e gie kâcɋene mucnekicnezi ɋicwânʒâŋ kâcɋene jaha bâfuame sâckeocmu.
“No mâreŋko ʒoc ruqepe ʒaocte wahapo. Erâ i biac bâruŋ‐keocte bunane âeckeekac.
No opâ moc ruapemurâ munarekicne, eme i epe taraocte maŋnanezi ʒoʒoc fificne afecne mi enareekac.
Ŋoŋe nore ʒiŋuc mi munʒepieŋ: ‘E wama bâfuaocte wahawec.’ Aricne, no fâfâuc bâfuazore wahapo.
Irec ʒiŋuczia fuŋkerâ kecʒiŋuc fua raocmu: Fic moc irec ŋic 5 jaŋe fâuckerâ hehewic eniŋmu, ŋifec 2 â ŋifec 3.
Erâ mame ŋokâ jahe fâuckerâ hehewic enicmu â neŋgoc otâ jahe fâuckerâ hehewic enicmu â jojoŋaozi fâuckerâ hehewic enicmu.”
Iŋuc murâ ŋic ŋokac mâmâc sâko‐jeŋic ʒiŋuc jazawe: “Ŋoŋe mâreŋ âke gâpâreme honerâ izia mueŋgopieŋ, ‘Hoe warekac.’ Muhapie iŋuc eekac.
Mâreŋ emasaŋkeme honerâ mueŋgopieŋ, ‘Ʒoaŋ qaocmu.’ Muhapie iŋuc eekac.
Burecŋic, ŋoŋe karorac qânikiŋ irec fuŋne manaeŋgopieŋ, â dameŋ ʒirec fuŋne ine wemocte mi mana taraeŋgopieŋ?
Ŋoŋe weniŋucte hata tiŋne â hehesicne hone ʒâŋitâc mi eeŋgopieŋ?
Go kisâgehec dâŋŋekic kiarao baranicmu. Eme hatao rahuc qizec qacnetec dâŋŋekic mufâsâezepirec. Iŋuc mi etec kisâgezi kiarao mume eki manarâ momori‐ticne ecneme kâpâcwâru ficko râecguocmu.
No jâmbomac gazape: Go ira ŋeku mâc mi wefucmu, âgogere tofa bazutec tara‐jâmbâŋkeme jaha wefucmu.”
Dameŋ ijaha ŋic gâcne fisirâ juhuc Jesu dâŋ binaŋ ʒiŋuc ecnembiŋ: “Pilatozi mume momorifâcne jaŋe Galilaia mâreŋkonec ŋic â bâzi ririkere lama bulimakaofâc‐jeŋic mâmâc joparâ socjeŋic bâsifuckembiŋ.”
Dâŋ binaŋ iŋuc ecnepie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe wiac ŋemâcne i ejarekicnere ʒiŋuc moc mupie: ‘Kiŋjeŋic Galilaia ŋic gâcne jaŋere kiŋ sirickewec.’
Iŋuc mâcne, gâcne ŋoŋere kiŋ fokac jaha, irec maŋŋeŋic mi bârisieniŋmuo iŋuc jaha sipricke‐fâreniŋmu.
Me Jerusalemnec ŋic 18 Siloam hârâczi ŋemac‐jopawec jaŋere wâc ʒiŋuc mi munʒepieŋ: ‘Kiŋjeŋic Jerusalem haeonec ŋic gâcne jaŋere kiŋ sirickewec.’
Iŋuc mâcne, gâcne ŋoŋere kiŋ fokac jaha, irec maŋŋeŋic mi bârisieniŋmuo iŋuc jaha sipiricke‐fâreniŋmu.”
Dâŋ i mutararâ Jesuzi kesaic dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋic moczi jufu‐ticnao hâmeŋ moc sarame sokawec. Eme rune e fârine wasaocte ra basa jujec.
Eku jufu soŋaŋ‐ticne âzâcnerâ muwec: ‘No jâc kecʒirec fârine basahuc juhape jara jahec â moc ekac. Jâc e maŋgâŋ wemocte boc domaocmu, qafaratec qaoc.’
Mume soŋaŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Bomboŋ, go behehaŋ jara ʒi domaoc, ehame noni fuŋne kinoŋzi herâ jawa sânʒâŋ hepe
dameŋ mocte fârine fuaocmu me aricne i honezeperec. Aricne eme ʒâhec mutec hefarazo.’”
Jesu e sabata hombaŋ mocte mitificko ferâ miti jazawec.
Eme mitific ira ŋokac moc ŋewec, e demoŋ moczi ecneme jara 18 ruruhuc jaha ŋeŋe juju ewec, ehuc wemocko moc fâretiŋnezac.
Eme Jesuzi ŋokac e honerâ hefârerâ muwec: “Ŋokac go fâretiŋnecmurâ mukopac.”
Iŋuc murâ meticne qizecnao râeha izia fâretiŋnerâ Anutu muteŋkewec.
Jesu e ŋokac i sabata hombaŋko bâpiaŋkewecte mitific soŋaŋzi maname sâqoreme ŋic ŋokac jaza muwec: “Gie bapa 6 fokac ira warepie bâpiaŋ‐ŋopazejec, hombaŋko ine misac.”
Mume Jesuzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Oi burecŋic ŋoŋe, hombaŋko doŋgi bulimakaofâc‐ŋeŋic mi fickonec firuec‐joparâ opâo bacjopa raeŋgopieŋ me?
Ŋokac kecʒi e Abrahamte ɋâric, eme Sataŋzi niŋgiŋkeme jara 18 sâko ŋehuc juwec. Eme noni hombaŋko firuepe mi sâckekac me?”
Iŋuc mume kisâ ecnembiŋzi mimiembiŋ. Â ŋic ŋokac guru sâkozi ine mâsi biaŋ‐ticnere ʒeri embiŋ.
Jesu e dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Anuture uucmaŋ e wemo wiac iŋucne, wemohec sâc hepe?
E nemuja hândâŋ iŋucne. Ŋic moczi i jufu‐ticnao râeme âkeʒurâ jâc ewec. Eme sawa wipe jaŋe fisirâ tieŋnao herâ ŋeeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme moc ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Anuture uucmaŋ i wemohec sâc hepe?
E hâmu goreŋne iŋucne. Ŋokac moczi hâmu goreŋne nânâhec bâsifuckeme aŋac‐ticnezi nânâ isiricke‐fârewec.”
Jesu e Jerusalem haeo raocte hae sâko hae pitic rahuc miti jaza qazuc ewec.
Ehame ŋic moczi wiocnerâ muwec: “Wofuŋ, ŋic afecnezi mecne sambâŋko feniŋmu, me weniŋuc?” Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Motâc fâŋfâŋnao raʒiniŋte sama qamariehuc raʒinʒepieŋ. No ŋazape mananiŋ: Ŋic bocjahazi raraʒire muniŋmu, murâ sifu mi raʒiniŋmu.
Fic rune e motâc herâ ki bame ŋoŋe fisirâ râpenao domahuc heickerâ ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Wofuŋ, motâc ronârec.’ Mupie ʒiŋuc ŋazaocmu: ‘No ŋoŋere kâuc bakopac, ŋoŋe wenirec?’
Wio‐ŋareme okacne ʒiŋuc âzâcneniŋmu: ‘Nâŋe gohec juhuc nânâ opâ nâmbeŋ â hae‐nâŋecko miti mutec manambeŋ.’
Mupie ʒiŋuc ŋazaocmu: ‘Ŋazakopac i, ŋoŋe wenirec, no mi manac‐ŋopakopac, sâqocne bapa ŋoŋe behecnu‐fâreniŋ.’
Eme Abraham, Isaka, Jakobo â porofete sasawa Anuture uucmaŋko juhapie honec‐jopaniŋmu. Â ŋaŋacne ine qikiŋ‐ŋopakicnere râpenao mic kikiaric kihuc ki oowa ehuc juniŋmu.
Ehame mâreŋ ŋifec â ŋifec, faic â juwic, irec ŋic fisirâ Anuture uucmaŋko raʒirâ tiwâ nâ ʒeri eniŋmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, ʒâhecne jaŋeraonec gâcnezi bâbâni eniŋmu, â bâbâni jaŋeraonec gâcnezi ʒâhecne eniŋmu.”
Dameŋ ijaha farisaio ŋic tucne fisirâ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Herodezi guocte mukac irec mâreŋ ʒi beherâ biac rac.”
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe risie rarâ qâqâto e nore ʒiŋuc âzâcneniŋ: ‘Manakic, no miŋecgac â tomâcko ŋic demoŋ jâpe‐jarepemu â ɋiɋicne bacjopapemu, fureme batarapemu.
Miŋecgac â tomâc fureme hata rahuc juzepac. Porofete moc e Jerusalem haeo mi fisihame qaqane mi fokac.’”
Iŋuc murâ muwec, “O Jerusalem rune, go hâcne porofete ʒikazi jopahuc mitiŋic gorao sorec‐jopakicne qânâzi hehâmoc‐jopaekic. Qâqâczi motecfâcne qânusuc‐joparâ fakecnezi ɋoroc‐jopaekac, iŋuc jaha noni kikefuŋfâcge wemo afecne maŋfuŋ‐naneo qânusuc‐jopazo mupe qikiŋne warehuc jumbiŋ.
Irec fic hae‐ŋeŋic behepe tuhune fuazokac. Mupe mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe mocwâc mi hohonecnu juraku ʒiŋuc muhuc honecnunʒoŋgopieŋ: ‘Wofuŋte micte warekac e mumbiaŋkenaŋ.’”
Sabata hombaŋ mocko farisaio jaŋere micne bapa moczi Jesu nânâre hefâreme ficticnao fewec. Eme ŋic gâcnezi ijaha mâmâc ŋehuc dâŋticnere ruc bambiŋ.
Ehame ŋic moc sisiwiŋ sâko ecneweczi mi ferâ ijaha domazejec i.
Eme Jesuzi honerâ sâcmutâc mamana â farisaio wio‐jarerâ muwec: “Ŋoŋe muniŋ, sabata hombaŋo ŋicko bâbâpiaŋ gie bapane fokac me mâcne?”
Mume niniŋkerâ ŋembiŋ. Iŋuc epie menezi ŋic bâuahuc bâpiaŋkerâ soreme rawec.
Eme ficko ŋembiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Motec me bulimakao‐ŋeŋic moc hombaŋko nombâŋko hume behepie ŋeocmu, me hombaŋkoa sifu fârepie wefuocmu?”
Indiŋ‐jopame dâŋ ŋifecne âzâcneniŋte basarâ behembiŋ.
Eme ŋic gâcne nânâre mâmâc hefârec‐jopakicne jaŋe ŋeŋe mai jaha maŋjeŋicte erâ biac ŋepie honec‐joparâ sâc hehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Go ŋic moczi tiwâ bâzire hefârecgume maŋgere ŋeŋe mai jaha mi ŋezemec. Iŋuc ehaŋtecne hefârec‐jopakicne gâcne jaŋeraonec gore femicne moczi fisime
tiwâ runezi go ʒiŋuc gazaocmu: ‘I ere ŋeŋe, go rârierâ ŋec.’ Gazame ŋeŋe rârâpe ŋehuc gâgâmârâcmu.
Mâcne, moczi hefârecgume go ŋeŋe rârâpe ŋezemec. Ŋehaŋtecne tiwâ runezi honecgurâ ʒiŋuc gazaocmu: ‘Âgo, go ferâ ŋeŋe mai jaha ŋec.’ Iŋuc gazame ŋic gâcne jaŋere maio bubiaŋ manacmu.
Moc e e jahacne maŋte feme bawahazo, â moc e e jahacne maŋte wahame bafezo.”
Iŋuc murâ ŋic hefârewec e ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go tiwâ bâzi rikerâ âgo bagofâcge me seŋ sâme hahac ɋafâcge me haefâcge fekicne mi hefârec‐jopazemec. Jaŋe tiwâ bâzire hefârec‐jopatec go iŋuc jaha hefârecgurâ tofa bazu‐garepie taraocmu.
Iŋuc mâcne, tiwâ bâzi rikerâ waha qaqane â kike demba, ʒeke puriŋ â tiŋtuŋ, iŋucne hefârec‐jopazemec.
Eme ʒiŋucte manariŋguzo: Tofa i mâc fome juku mitiŋic fafahare dameŋ‐jeŋicko Anutuzi bazu‐gareocmu.”
Mume nânâ nâhuc ŋembiŋ jaŋeraonec moczi dâŋ i manarâ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Anuture uucmaŋko nânâ nâocmu ŋic iŋucnere manape ʒerine ekac.”
Mume Jesuzi binaŋ moc ʒiŋuc bawec: “Ŋic moczi tiwâ bâzi sâko qame fisime ŋic bocjaha hefârec‐jopawec.
Erâ wiac bâmocke‐fârerâ ŋic ʒâfo ejarekicne jaŋerao kiŋaŋ motec‐ticne soreme rarâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: ‘Wiac rike bâmoc efârekicnere wareniŋ.’
Jazame jaŋe wiac kosao ɋetickehuc qikiŋne‐fârembiŋ. Ehuc moc e muwec, ‘No mâreŋ moc furine bapo izi fârecnukacte honezo rakopac, go irec ŋicbomboŋge âzâcnetec maname mi sâqorezejec.’
Â moc e muwec, ‘No bulimakao 10 furine bac‐jopapo i ra amec‐jopa warepemu, go irec ŋicbomboŋge âzâcnetec maname mi sâqorezejec.’
Â moc e muwec, ‘No ŋokac ropore wemocko fâpemu.’
Iŋuc mupie kiŋaŋ moteczi risierâ bomboŋ‐ticne dâŋ binaŋ ecneme maname gâpârewec. Erâ kiŋaŋ motec‐ticne ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcne sorec ewec: ‘Go bâruŋ jaha bozene bozene jufârehuc ŋic roroc qaŋqaŋne â kike demba, ʒeke puriŋ â tiŋtuŋ rocjopatec warenʒepieŋ.’
Eme kiŋaŋ motec e iŋuc erâ bomboŋ‐ticne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Bomboŋ, go dâŋ mumec i epac, erâ fic ine fâfâoc fokac.’
Âzâcneme bomboŋzi ʒiŋuc muwec: ‘Irec go mocwâc rarâ haesoŋko ŋic juraŋgopieŋ fotarie‐jaretec ware‐jâmbâŋkerâ ficnane fusucmanʒepieŋ.
Erâ ŋazape mananiŋ: Ŋic bâbâni hefârec‐jopakicne jaŋe mâc jâmbâŋ ŋenʒepieŋ.’”
Eme ŋic guru sâko jâmbâŋ Jesu bâjâpepie fotikierâ ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Moc e nohec juzo murâ neŋgoc mamac, ŋokac motec, hahac ɋa seŋ baŋec jaŋe mi qaisoc‐jopaocmu, e motec jâmbâŋ‐nane sâcne mi erâ juocmu.
Moc e jahacne maripoŋ mi hâpora bâjâpecnuocmu, e motec jâmbâŋ‐nane sâcne mi erâ juocmu.
“Ŋoŋeraonec moczi wapafic sâko baocte qanaŋ furinere manarâ moneŋ‐ticne wose biric erâ eene me mi eene irec fuŋne bataniŋkeocmu.
Me iŋuc mi ehuc onʒoŋ jaha ficticne wiseme hume ʒaeckerâ moneŋ basarâ beheocmuo ine ŋic jaŋe hone manac erâ mu gâgâwi ecnehuc
ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Ŋic keci fazic erâ ficsâko wiseme hume eipierâ beheme ŋekac.’
Ŋicwofuŋ moczi ŋicwofuŋ âgo‐ticne qaocte onʒoŋ jaha râsi mi raocmu. E qanaŋ ʒiŋuc muocmu: ‘Nâŋe ʒi afecne juŋgopeneŋzi ocni bocjaha juŋgopieŋ jaŋe sâcne jopanaŋmu me mâcne?’
Iŋuc murâ e jahacne momorifâc jaŋere maname afeckeme rasi‐ticne hae‐ticnao juhame biac sahac taha‐ticne râecnehuc muocmu, ‘Wama fuame junac.’
Eme ŋoŋeraonec moc e iŋuc jaha wiac‐ticne sasawa mi qikiŋne‐fârerâ weniŋuc motec‐nane erâ juocmu.
“Hâwec i wiac aŋacne. Â nonocne eme ine weniŋuc ecnepene hâtâne‐ticne mocwâc fuaocmu, i aricne i!
Izi iŋuc me iŋuc eene mi fokac, i mâc hoŋkepene raocmu. Moc e hazec‐ticneheczi dâŋ kecʒi manazejec.”
Takesi roro â sâqocne bapa Jesurao miti‐ticne mananiŋte mâretec fisi jumbieŋ.
Epie farisaio â miti qaqazu jaŋe irec manapie sâqoreme Jesure ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋic e sâqocne bapa rocjoparâ iqic‐joparâ jaŋehec nânâ nâekac.”
Eme irec Jesuzi dâŋ suŋsuŋne moc ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Ŋoŋeraonec moc e lama 100 jucneniŋmu. Eme mocsâkoazi qâsorieme beheocmu me? Aricne, e gâcne sâko 99 tuhuo behec‐joparâ qâsoriekicne basaocmu.
Basaku bâfuarâ bubiaŋ manahuc âsickerâ
haeo fisirâ âgofâcne wira‐jarerâ muocmu: ‘Lama‐nane qâsoriekicne bâfuakopacte ʒeri enaŋ.’
No ŋazape mananiŋ, ŋic tiŋne 99 maŋ bâbârisiere mi mumu‐jarene jaŋere erâ sambâŋko ʒeri aafecne fuaha sâqocne bapa mocjaha maczi maŋne bârisieme ere erâ sambâŋko ʒeri fekicne fuaocmu.
“Ŋokac moczi siliwa moneŋ 10 bajuocmu. Bajuhame mocjaha wahame beheocmu me? Aricne, e waha qazerâ fic ofaŋne qâzuc ehuc basaocmu.
Basaku bâfuarâ ŋokac âgofâcne wira‐jarerâ ʒiŋuc jazaocmu: ‘Moneŋ‐nane sifuckejec i bâfuakopacte ʒeri enaŋ.’
Mupe mananiŋ, Anuture aŋelofâc jaŋe iŋuc jaha sâqocne bapa mocjahazi mac maŋne bârisieme bubiaŋ manaeŋgopieŋ.”
Jesuzi binaŋ moc ʒiŋuc bawec: “Ŋic moc ŋokâ jahec‐ticne jajahec jupic.
Juku ʒâhec ŋokâzi mamac‐ticne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Mamac, go moneŋ mafa nore biŋe qakicne i narec.’ Mume moneŋ mafa bâtâc barâ jactewec.
Eme ʒâhec ŋokâ e gie bapa afecne jurâ mafa wiac‐ticne bâmockerâ ame susuckerâ rawec. Erâ ocna sasec gie bahuc nânâ qowire nâ areŋ ehuc moneŋ mafa‐ticne ititiŋke‐fârewec.
Ititiŋke‐fârerâ juhame mâreŋ ira roroc sâko fuawec. Eme motec e kitac qatac eku
mâreŋ rune moc erao ra qohotame eki mume susubecfâc‐ticne soŋaŋ‐jopawec.
Ehuc bec jaŋere nânâ nâocte ecnewec i wâc sakarecnembiŋ.
Iŋuc juku maŋnezi mumu hehec ecneme ʒiŋuc muwec: ‘Mamac‐nanere kiŋaŋ qaqa wemo afecne juŋgopieŋ, eme jaŋe nânâ nâqiŋ qâqiŋ ehuc juhapie no ŋokâ‐ticnezi ʒira rorocte sipirickezo ekopac.
Irec no hae‐naneo rarâ mamac‐nanerao fisirâ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnezepac: Mamac, no sâqocne bape kiŋnanezi sambâŋko â gorao ŋemâckekac.
Irec wemocko ŋokâge mocwâc munarepie jupemu, go mâc kiŋaŋ motecge bacnutec juzepac.’
Iŋuc murâ ʒawierâ mamac‐ticnerao rawec. Raku hae upeo fisihame mamac‐ticnezi biac honerâ bune sâqoreme gasacke ra hâpo mumuduc ecnewec.
Eme motec e ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Mamac, no sâqocne bape kiŋnanezi sambâŋko â gorao ŋemâckekac, irec wemocko ŋokâge mocwâc munarepie jupemu.’
Iŋuc mume mamac‐ticnezi kiŋaŋ motec jazarâ muwec: ‘Ŋoŋe picpac jaha ŋaqi biaŋne jâmbâŋ moc baware hecnepie huoc, â megâŋ menao hecnepie feoc, â kikehuhu mâmâc râcneniŋ.
Erâ bulimakao motecne biuc sâko i hezu rikec epie nâhuc ʒeri enʒepeneŋ.
Ŋokâ‐nane e hâmoweczi mocwâc ɋârekac, erâ e qâsorieweczi mocwâc fuakac.’ Iŋuc mume ʒeri embiŋ.
“Ehame mârâc ŋokâ e gieo juweczi risierâ hae râpeo domahuc gae â ʒeri mic ʒonʒoŋ manarâ
kiŋaŋ motec moc ecneme fisime mu wioc ecnerâ muwec: ‘Wiac i wemocte?’
Eme eki muwec: ‘Ɋage ware fisikac. Eme sahac furu fisikacte mamac‐ŋekiczi mume bulimakao motecne biuc sâko i qa rikec eŋgopeneŋ.’
Iŋuc âzâcneme mârâc ŋokâ e kimbeŋ qarâ haeo feocte qikiŋnewec. Eme mamac‐ticnezi manarâ hae upeo hurâ mu bâmiriŋ ecnewec.
Ecneme mi mamana ʒiŋuc muwec: ‘Manakic, no jara wemo afecne kiŋaŋ qagarehuc juhuc dâŋge moc mi qatara‐gareekopac. Eme go noniŋ motecne mac moc mi qikiŋne‐naretec âgofâc‐nane jaŋehec nâ ʒeri embeŋ.
Â ʒâhec ŋokâge e gore moneŋ mafa sasec gie bahuc sipiricke‐fârewec, e iŋucnezi fisime mutec bulimakao motecne biuc sâko i hezu rikec ecneŋgopieŋ.’
Mume mamacnezi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Ŋokâ‐mae, go dameŋ sâc nohec juwareekiczi wiac mi basaekic, wiac sasawa wirec‐nâhec fokac.
Â ɋage e hâmoweczi mocwâc ɋârekac, erâ e qâsorieweczi mocwâc fuakac, irec ʒeri bubiaŋ epene sâckekac.’”
Jesuzi motecfâc‐ticne binaŋ moc ʒiŋuc bajarewec: “Ŋicbomboŋ sâko moc ere moneŋ mafa soŋaŋ moc juwec. Eme juku ere ʒiŋuc mupie manawec: ‘Soŋaŋ e mafa ro bâsifuc eekac.’
Iŋuc manarâ hefârerâ âzâcnewec: ‘No gore dâŋ weniŋuc mupie manapac? Go iŋucnezi soŋaŋ mocwâc mi jucmurâ mukopacte papiage bawaretec moneŋ mafare fuŋne bataniŋkezo.’
Mume soŋaŋ e maŋnezi ʒiŋuc muwec: ‘Ʒi bomboŋ‐nanezi soŋaŋ gie nowac rome wenac epemu? Gie he sarac ezore takicnukac, qafec qawahac juzore mimiekopac.
Miŋecne manakopac, bomboŋ‐nanezi jâpecnume ŋic âgofâc‐nane hezu hefâroc enarepie ficjeŋicko ŋeŋe epemurâ wiac ejarezepac.’
Iŋuc murâ bomboŋ‐ticnere tofa bajumbiŋ i jaŋe buc buc hefârec‐jopawec. Ehuc moc wiocnerâ muwec, ‘Bomboŋ‐nanere tofa gorao wezimuc fokac?’
Eme eki muwec, ‘Qowitiŋ 100.’ Mume ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Ajoc, papia ʒi rorâ 50 qâreŋkec.’
Iŋuc murâ moc wiocnewec, ‘Bomboŋ‐nanere tofa gorao wezimuc fokac?’ Eme eki muwec, ‘Padi târu 100.’ Mume ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Ajoc, papia ʒi rorâ 80 qâreŋkec.’
Iŋuc eme bomboŋ e manarâ soŋaŋ bâkiri bapa maŋfânâŋ‐ticnere muteŋkewec. Miti tâmiric jaŋe âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec wiac eniŋte maŋfânâŋ‐jeŋic kâcɋene fokac, mitihec ŋoŋe sâc iŋucne mi foŋarekac.
Irec mupe mananiŋ, ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha moneŋ mafa jawane ŋic qikiŋne‐jarepie jaŋe âgo bacŋoparâ juku i babaju dameŋne tarame juju sanaŋ ficjeŋicko hefârec‐ŋopapie junʒepieŋ.
“Moc e wiac omane metâo sâcne soŋaŋkeocmu, eki wiac fârine iŋuc jaha metâo sâcne soŋaŋkeocmu. Â moc e wiac omane bâsifuckeocmu, eki wiac fârine iŋuc jaha bâsifuckeocmu.
Ŋoŋe moneŋ mafa jawane metâo sâcne mi bajupie wiac fârine mozi ŋareocmu?
Â wiac jaba ŋarekicne i sâcne mi bajupie ŋaŋacne biŋe i mozi ŋareocmu?
Motec mocjahazi jajahec jahere kiŋaŋ sâcne mi qaocmu. E moc âgo ecnehuc moc hone takireocmu, â moctao qohotahuc moc râpeckeocmu. Ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha Anuture gie mecne â moneŋ mafa qâqâhâc sâko irec gie mecne sâckoa sâcne mi bacjofaniŋmu.”
Jesu e dâŋ i mume farisaio jaŋe moneŋ mafare sasec embiŋzi manarâ dâŋticne surembiŋ.
Epie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe hâcne ŋic jaŋere maio tiŋne hawari juniŋte ʒoɋac eeŋgopieŋ. Anutuzi ine maŋŋeŋicte fuŋne manaekac. Ŋic jaŋe wiac honepie tiŋne hawari eekac, i Anutuzi honeme mamakâcne eekac.
Sâcmutâc dâŋqâhâc â porofete dâŋ irec hata fowareku Johanerao mickewec. Irec faicnao ine Anuture uucmaŋ irec Biŋebiaŋ haŋ barakac. Eme ɋicwânʒâŋ eeŋgopieŋzi raʒieŋgopieŋ.
Sambâŋ â mâreŋ jahe sirowezo murâ sirowenicmu, â sâcmutâc dâŋ irec huŋgaŋne mac moc mâc foku arictac eene ine mi fokac.
Ŋic moc e ŋonâŋ‐ticne beherâ moc roocmu, e ʒuʒuhuc‐jekic bâtâcnehuc kiŋsâko hureocmu. Â moc e ŋokac behekicne i roocmu, e iŋuc jaha ʒuhuc bâtâcte kiŋ hureocmu.
“Ŋicbomboŋ moc juwec e ŋaqi erinehec furi sâko sasawa rojuwec, erâ ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne tiwa ʒepec nâ ʒeri ehuc juwec.
Ehame ŋic hapetac moc juwec, ʒâŋene Lazaro. E sahacne wic sasawa. Eme eki ŋicbomboŋte fic rurumaŋko fojujec.
Ehame ŋicbomboŋte fickonec nâkitâc wahame i nâocte aŋac focne jujec. Fohame qâto jaŋe fisirâ wicticne apurumbiŋ.
Eme juku hapetaczi hâmome aŋelo jaŋe jowa ferâ Abrahamte qicfuŋko râepie juwec. Eme ʒâhec ŋicbomboŋ e wâc hâmome duckembiŋ.
Eme e hârâcko hurâ ʒâic fâro sâko manahuc fime feme Abrahamte qicfuŋko Lazaro honewec.
Honerâ wirahuc muwec: ‘Abraham mamac‐nane, nore buge sâqoreme Lazaro soretec mebotâŋne sawa opâo âke uruckerâ ware nameŋ‐naneo bame mâteŋkezejec. No ʒira ʒocbâruŋko ʒâic serereŋ sâqocne manahuc jukopac.’
Mume Abrahamzi muwec: ‘Ŋokâ‐nane manakic, go mâreŋko aŋac faio jumeŋ i tarawec. Â Lazaro buzâqoc faio juwec i iŋuc jaha tarawec. Eme irec e bubiaŋhec juekac â go ine ʒâichec juekic.
Erâ wâc ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko hârâc sâko domakac, irec ʒireczi ŋoŋerao wemocko hufâzo â ŋoŋeraoneczi ʒira wemocko wefuzo.’
Eme ŋicbomboŋzi muwec, ‘Mamac‐nane, moc mupe mana‐narec;
ocna nore haeo ɋafâc‐nane memoc juŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ʒâic haeo ʒira warenʒipiŋte Lazaro soretec ra uŋdâŋ hazec qâuŋ jazazejec.’
Mume Abrahamzi muwec, ‘Aricne, Mose â porofete jaŋere micdâŋ fokac i mananʒepieŋ.’
Eme muwec, ‘Mamac‐nane Abraham, iŋuc mâcne, hâmokicne moczi ra jazame maŋjeŋic sâcne bârisieniŋmu.’
Eme muwec, ‘Jaŋe Mose â porofere jaŋere dâŋ qikiŋneeŋgopieŋko hâmokicne moczi ra jazame iŋuc jaha qikiŋneniŋmu.’”
Jesuzi motecfâcne dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Sâqocnere suru jâiŋ fufua i fuaocmu, weniŋuc mâc foocmu. Â ŋic moc sâqocnere suru jâiŋ bâfuaocmu, jei, e ine wemo ecnezo!
E ŋic hujukicne suru jâiŋ ejarezacte buse sâko upenao qonaŋkecnerâ hâwecko sârockepie hume muzac, izi wiac aafecne fuacnekac ezac.
Ŋoŋe soŋaŋ babac ehuc junʒepieŋ. Âgoge moczi bahac bâfua‐gareme tutuc qacnezemec. Tutuc qacnetec manarâ busâqoc bâfuame kiŋticne behecnezemec.
Erâ ʒoaŋ mocjahao bahac arecne 7 bâfua‐gararâ arec 7 gorao fisirâ muocmu, ‘Âgo, iŋuc egarepacte bunane sâqorekac,’ eme go irec sâc jaha wâc kiŋticne behecnehuc juzemec.”
Aposolo jaŋe Wofuŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc numucnembiŋ: “Go mamanasiŋ‐nâŋec basawe‐nârezemec.”
Mupie Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Mamanasiŋ fârine piicne mac, ʒocʒu hândâŋ iŋucne mac foŋareme muzac, ine nemuja jâc kecocni, ŋeunuckerâ tararâ hâwecko hurâ domaocte âzâcnepie eki micŋeŋic reŋkerâ iŋuc ezac.
“Ŋoŋeraonec moc e kiŋaŋ motec‐ticne gie baku me bulimakao soŋaŋ juku owâ ririŋte fisime ʒiŋuc sâcne âzâcneocmu me? ‘Go ficko wefu ŋehaŋte nânâ rike bâmoc egarepe.’
Aricne, e ʒiŋuc âzâcneocmu: ‘Ajoc, kambaŋ ɋaɋacne qarâ ŋafere nânâ rike râec enaretec nahape ʒâhec go gahacne rike nâc ezemec.’
Eme kiŋaŋ motec e gie mucnekicne i sawa bame bomboŋ‐ticnezi mâc maname taraocmu, â muteŋ bâteŋ ine wemocko ecneocmu.
Eme ŋoŋere fuŋne ijaha fokac. Ŋoŋe wiac muŋarekicne i efârerâ ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Nâŋe kiŋaŋ motec ba bititicne, wiac munârekicne i sawa mac epârâckeŋgopeneŋ.’”
Jesu e Jerusalem haeo raocte Galilaia mâreŋ fotâcnerâ Samaria mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao fisiwec.
Fisirâ hae mocko fehame ŋic wicsanaŋ‐jeŋichec 10 jaŋe honerâ taic domahuc
wira wâwâsic ecnehuc mumbiŋ: “O Qaqazu Jesu, go nâŋere mac buge sâqoreoc.”
Eme honec‐joparâ ʒiŋuc jazawe: “Ŋoŋe rarâ sahac‐ŋeŋic taha bapa jowatunʒepieŋ.” Mume jaŋe raha rahapie sahac‐jeŋic fâsâewec.
Eme jaŋeraonec mocsâkoazi sahacne fâsâeme honerâ risiewec. Risierâ hahaŋne bahuc Anutu muteŋkehuc
Jesure kikefuŋko fodaperâ daŋge âzâcnewec. Eme ŋic e Samaria mâreŋkonec.
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋic 10 fâsâembieŋ, gâcne sâko 9 jaŋe weni?
Jaŋe risierâ Anutu daŋge âzâcneniŋte mi muhuc mâc qâoma erâ rahapie ŋic qâpuc keczi e mocjahazi warekac me?”
Iŋuc murâ ŋic e ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mamanasiŋgere biaŋkekomec, irec fahare rac.”
Farisaio jaŋe Jesu wiocnerâ mumbiŋ: “Anuture uucmaŋ wezimucko fua tâcneocmu?” Eme jazawec: “Anuture uucmaŋ tâtâc mi fuaocmu,
irec wemocko honerâ ʒiŋuc muzo: ‘O ʒira fuakac, o ocna fuakac.’ Manaŋgopieŋ, Anuture uucmaŋ i ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko fuawec fokac.”
Erâ motecfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Juku dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e ʒoaŋ mocjaha tâtâcko fuame honeniŋte eŋare‐bipieha sifu mi honeniŋmu.
Dameŋ ira kecʒiŋuc ŋazaniŋmu: ‘O ʒira nâŋerao fuakac, o ocna jaŋerao fuakac.’ Mupie mi ranʒepieŋ â manapie jâmbomac mi ezejec.
Bâbâric e sambâŋ ŋifec bâricneme ŋifec qâninipe‐fâreekac, irec sâc Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne ere fifisi fuazokac.
Qanaŋ ine ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne râpeckepie ʒâic gie sâko baocte mucnekicne.
Noa juwec dameŋ ira ŋic jaŋe wiac embiŋ ijaha Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne ere fifisi dameŋ maickeha enʒoŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe nânâ qowi nâmbiŋ, huc ʒocʒu nâmbiŋ, ŋokac nareŋ gareŋ embiŋ. Qâoma iŋuc hâcne ehuc juhapie Noa wokeo feme rumi sâkozi fisirâ ʒeŋgoma bârârâŋ‐jopawec.
Â Loti juwec dameŋ ira iŋuc jaha embiŋ. Jaŋe nânâ qowi huc ʒocʒu i nâmbiŋ, wiac nareŋ gareŋ i embiŋ, gie hesac qasarac i embiŋ, fic gie bapa i bambiŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc juhapie Loti e Sodom hae râpeckeme sambâŋkonec kâmbâc â ʒoc wahame ŋic ʒeŋgoma sipirickembiŋ.
Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e juku fua taniŋkezokac dameŋ ira ŋic jaŋe sâc ijaha eniŋmu.
Eme ira moc e hae ʒoŋao juocmuzi ficmaŋ‐ticnao mi risie ferâ mafa‐ticne rozejec, â moc e gieo juocmuzi haeo mi risiezejec.
Ŋoŋe Loti ŋonâŋ‐ticnere manasunʒepieŋ.
Moc e juju‐ticne ŋezickezo mume sifuckecneocmu, â moc e juju‐ticne qikiŋneme e fuacneocmu.
No mupe mananiŋ, ŋafe ira ŋic jajahec fofo wirec fohapire moc rohuc moc qikiŋnezo.
Ŋokac jajahec nânâ sufiehuc ŋehapire moc rohuc moc qikiŋnezo.[
Ŋic jajahec gieo domahapire moc rohuc moc qikiŋnezo.]”
Jesu e dâŋ i mufâreme motec jaŋe wiocnerâ mumbiŋ: “Wofuŋ, i wena fuazokac?” Eme muwec, “Âsu gâreczi keŋwipe fârecjopame fisirâ tumaŋneeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme motecfâcne jaŋe mi rokawehuc ʒoaŋ gie bapa sâc numecnehuc juniŋte irec Jesuzi binaŋ moc kecʒiŋuc bajarewec:
“Hae mocko kia moc juwec, eki Anutu mecne â ŋic mecne araŋ mi bajarewec.
Eme hae ijaha ŋokac hozec moc juwec, eki kia erao hâcne hati rarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcne jujec: ‘Go kisâ‐nanere ŋezicnuc.’
Eme kia e hozecte dâŋ dameŋ ʒora mana takirehuc juwec. Juku maŋnezi ʒiŋuc muwec: ‘No Anutu mecne â ŋic mecne araŋ mi bajareekopac i jâmbomac,
erâ hozec e micneneŋ sâqocne enarehuc juekacte sifu bafickezepac, juku fisirâ nuzackohec.’”
Wofuŋ e binaŋ i bafârerâ muwec, “Kia râŋgeŋnezi dâŋ muwec i manaŋgopieŋ me?
Eme Anuture weniŋuc mueŋgopieŋ, e fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne ŋafe furec wâsickehuc jaha jupie ʒika ŋondeŋkonec mi batarac‐jopaocmu me? Muŋgopieŋ, mana takirehuc juocmu me?
Aricne, e jume mi ʒoraha batarac‐jopaocmu. Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e juku mocwâc fisirâ mâreŋko mamanasiŋ bâfuaocmu me?”
Ŋic gâcne jaŋacne manapie tiŋne eha âgofâc‐jeŋic mana wahac‐jopambiŋ jaŋere qâqiŋdâŋ moc ʒiŋuc muwec:
“Ŋic jajahec taha ufuŋko ferâ numupic. Moc e farisaio â moc e takesi roro.
Farisaio e hâŋ domahuc e jahacnere ʒiŋuc manasuhuc numuwec: ‘O Anutu, ŋic gâcne jaŋe ʒika qaeŋgopieŋ, fiuc serereŋ eeŋgopieŋ, sasec mamakâc eeŋgopieŋ. No jaŋe iŋucne mâcne, me takesi roro kecocni e iŋucne wâc mâcne. Eme no irec hâcne daŋge gazakopac.
No Sonda sâc irec gie bapa jajahec sowa juekopac â moneŋ mafa hurerâ teŋkonec wâŋte sâc mitire biŋe qaekopac.’
Takesi roro eki ine tuturuŋko domahuc fime feocte mimierâ menezi amecne bofackehuc ʒiŋuc numuwec: ‘O Anutu, ŋic sâqocne no mi mac behecnuzemec.’
Manaŋgopieŋ, takesi roro e Anutuzi kiŋticne behecne‐fâreme ficticnao risiewec, farisaio e ine focnewec. Moc e jahacne maŋte feme Anutuzi bawahaocmu, â moc e jahacne maŋte wahame Anutuzi bafeocmu.”
Eme ŋic ŋokac jaŋe ɋiefâc‐jeŋic Jesurao amec‐jopa rarâ mezi bâuac‐jopaocte mupie motec jaŋe hâhâwic hejarembiŋ.
Jesuzi ine hefârec‐jopahuc muwec: “Ŋoŋe behehapie naru motec norao wareniŋ, mi hecke‐jareniŋ. Iŋucne jaŋe hâcne Anuture uucmaŋ bine qajarekicne.
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Moc e ɋie jaŋere sâc ehuc Anuture uucmaŋ mi biŋeckeocmu, e maŋnao mi raʒiocmu.”
Eme soŋaŋ moczi Jesu wiocnerâ muwec: “Qaqazu biaŋ, no weniŋuc erâ juju sanaŋte biŋe epemu?”
Jesuzi muwec, “Biaŋne wemocte munarekomec? Biaŋne rune Anutu mocjaha.
Erâ go sâcmutâc dâŋ manaekic, kecʒiŋuc: Ŋowe ŋonâŋ ŋohe bebehec mi ezepirec, go ʒika mi qazemec, go fiuc mi rozemec, go micko âkec mi ezemec, go neŋgoc mamac jahecge sâsec‐jofazeme.”
Mume soŋaŋzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “I ɋieo fuŋkerâ reŋke warehuc juekopac.”
Mume Jesuzi manarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mocjaha fokac, i ezemec, go rarâ moneŋ mafage ŋic hapetac qikiŋne‐jarezemec, eme sambâŋko boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ fua‐gareocmu. Erâ ware bâjâpecnuzemec.”
Eme ŋic e moneŋ mafa ɋâfoŋne focnewecte dâŋ i manarâ bune boc sâqorewec.
Iŋuc eme Jesuzi honerâ muwec, “Moneŋ mafa mâririheczi Anuture uucmaŋko raʒiniŋte ququŋkenehec boc eekac.
Kamelizi buŋic hawecnao raraʒi i wiac afecne, â moneŋ mafa mâririheczi Anuture uucmaŋko raraʒi i wiac ŋemâcne.”
Mume manahuc domambiŋ ŋic i jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Hâc, eme mozi sambâŋko feocmu?”
Eme Jesuzi jazawec, “Wiac ŋiczi eniŋte quŋkeeŋgopieŋ i Anutuzi hatane bâfuaocte mi quŋkeekac.”
Eme Petorozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, nâŋe wiac‐nâŋec sasawa râpecke‐fârerâ go bâjâpecgumbeŋ.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No jâmbomac ŋazape: Moc e hae‐ticne me ŋokac motecfâcne, me hahac ɋa seŋ baŋecfâcne, me neŋgoc mamac jahecne Anuture uucmaŋte erâ behec‐jopaocmu,
e irec okacne ʒira mâreŋko wiac fekicne tahackezo, â juku sambâŋko juju sanaŋ tahackezo.”
Jesu e motecfâcne hefârec‐joparâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Manaŋgopieŋ, nâŋâc Jerusalem haeo feŋgopeneŋ. Eme porofete jaŋe Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne ere findaŋdâŋ qâreŋkembiŋ i sanaŋke‐fâreocmu.
E ŋic qâpuc jaŋere meo feme jaŋe mu ruruc ecnerâ qa imac ecnehuc tâfeckeniŋmu,
erâ becsahac biriŋneheczi qa qâʒâic ecnerâ qahâmoniŋmu. Eme ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha hâmockonec ɋârerâ fahareocmu.”
Iŋuc mume jaŋe kâuc bambiŋ. Dâŋ i manapie quŋkeme fuŋne mananiŋte mana ririfirembiŋ.
Jesu e raku Jeriko hae bâqiŋkewec. Ehame hatamecko ŋic tiŋtuŋ moc nânâ moneŋte numuhuc ŋewec.
Eme ŋic guru sâko hata ira rapie kike fânâŋ‐jeŋic manarâ fuŋnere wiojareme
mumbiŋ, “Jesu Nazarete haeonec warekac.”
Mupie manarâ hahaŋne bahuc wirarâ muwec, “Jesu go Dawidire ɋâriczi nore mac buge sâqoreoc me!”
Iŋuc eme ŋic bâniembiŋ jaŋe niniŋkerâ ŋeocte dâŋ mucnembiŋ. Eme eki dâŋjeŋic mana takirehuc fotarierâ wirawec, “Go Dawidire ɋâriczi nore mac buge sâqoreoc.”
Eme Jesuzi manarâ hatao domahuc muwec, “Ŋoŋe norao bawareniŋ.” Mume tiŋtuŋzi erao fisime wiocnerâ muwec,
“No wemo egarepemurâ mukic?” Eme tiŋtuŋzi muwec, “Wofuŋ, no ʒâŋe fifihec epere enarekac.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ʒâŋege fitâcneoc, mamanasiŋgere biaŋgukac.”
Muha izia ʒâŋe fifihec ewec. Erâ Jesu bâjâpehuc Anutu muteŋkewec. Â ŋic wiac i homembiŋzi iŋuc jaha Anutu muteŋkembiŋ.
Jesu e Jeriko haeo fisirâ fotâcnezo ewec.
Eme hae ira ŋic moc juwec, ʒâŋene Zakaio, e takesi roro jaŋere micne, erâ moneŋ mafa sâko‐ticnehec juwec.
Eme ŋic eki Jesu hawari‐ticne honeocte ecnewec. Erâ e ŋic bembeŋnere ŋicŋondeŋko domahuc tiŋtiŋne‐bipiewec.
Iŋuc erâ gagasac jaha ŋic jowaru‐fârerâ ra nemuja hahaŋko ferâ ŋehuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Jesu ʒira ware rame honepe.”
Eme Jesu e ira fisirâ fime feme honerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Zakaio go picpac wahac, no miŋecgac ficgao iqicgupemu.”
Mume izia picpac jaha waharâ bubiaŋ manahuc ficticnao jowame fepic.
Eme ŋic sasawa jaŋe i honerâ mana sâqorerâ mumbiŋ, “E wemocte ŋic sâqocnere ficko fejec fokac.”
Zakaio eki ine Jesure maŋfuŋko rarâ muwec: “Manakic, Wofuŋ, moneŋ mafa‐nane sâckoa bâtâc barâ tucne ŋic hapetac jarepemu, â ŋic gâcne moneŋ sâc jâuruhuc jowac ropo ine ropo sâc i fohame baferâ okacne bazu‐jarepemu.”
Eme Jesuzi muwec: “Ŋic kecʒi Abrahamte ɋâric jaha, irec ere ficko miŋecgac miti fuame biaŋkekac.
Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e ŋic sâqorekicne rocjoparâ bâpiaŋ‐jopazore wahawec hâcne.”
Jesu e Jerusalem hae bâqiŋkeme ŋic dâŋticne manambiŋzi mumbiŋ, “Ʒi Anuture uucmaŋ fua taniŋkeocte dameŋne maickekac.”
Eme irec Jesuzi dâŋ suŋsuŋne moc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋicbomboŋ moczi, ŋicwofuŋ sâkorao ra mupe mâreŋ soŋaŋ âkendâŋnume risiezepac, muhuc mâreŋ wiwicko rawec.
Raocte kiŋaŋ motecfâcne 10 hefârec‐joparâ moneŋfoŋ mocjaha mocjaha muhuc jarewec: ‘Ŋoŋe moneŋ ʒi kime kiŋ qahuc basawehuc juhapie risiezepac.’
Rahame ŋicfâcne ere takic‐jopawecte ŋic kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopapie ʒâhec rarâ ŋicwofuŋ sâko ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: ‘E mâreŋ soŋaŋ‐nâŋec mi juocte muŋgopeneŋ.’
Eme ŋicwofuŋ sâko e sifu mâreŋ soŋaŋ âkendâŋneme risiewec. Risierâ kiŋaŋ motec moneŋ jarewec jaŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc hefârec‐jopawec: ‘Moneŋ ŋarepo i giene bahuc hotâckekupie wezimuc fuawec?’
Hefârec‐jopame kiŋaŋ motec moczi fisirâ muwec, ‘Bomboŋ, go moneŋfoŋ mocjaha naremeŋ izi furune 10 kime fuawec.’
Mume ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Sowine kiŋaŋ motec biaŋne, go wiac omanere gie aimuŋ bameŋte noni hae 10 jaŋere soŋaŋ râecgupe juzemec.’
Iŋuc mume kiŋaŋ motec moczi fisirâ muwec, ‘Bomboŋ, go moneŋfoŋ mocjaha naremeŋ izi furune 5 kime fuawec.’
Mume ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Sâcne, go hae 5 jaŋere soŋaŋ juzemec.’
Eme kiŋaŋ motec moczi fisirâ muwec, ‘Moneŋfoŋge ʒi, no qoruczi foŋkerâ aimuŋ râepe fowec.
Go ŋic gereŋ gereŋne, go gahac wiac mi hurehuc gâcnezi bâfuapie rozo muekic, â go gahac gie he sarac mi ehuc gâcnezi bapie fârine fuame nâzo muekic. Eme no irec araŋ bagarehuc moneŋge aimuŋ bajupo.’
Mume bomboŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Kiŋaŋ motec sâqocne go, gahac dâŋ mumec ijaha bâtikie‐garekopac; no ŋic gereŋ gereŋne, no nahac wiac mi hurehuc gâcnezi bâfuapie rozo muekopac, â no nahac gie mi he sarac ehuc gâcnezi bapie fârine fuame nâzo muekopac.
Go fuŋne‐nane iŋuc manahuc moneŋ‐nane moneŋŋic jaŋerao râetec jaŋe kime kiŋ qakupie sawehame risierâ rozapo.’
Iŋuc murâ ŋic domambiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazawec: ‘Ŋoŋe moneŋfoŋ‐ticne jâoc rorâ 10 bajukac e râceniŋ.’
Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, ‘Hâc, bomboŋ, e 10 bajukac i!’
Eme muwec, ‘No ŋazape mananiŋ, moc e wiac râcnekicne bajume kiqecnecnezo, â moc e wiac râcnekicne mi bajume jâoc rozo, eme mâc juzejec.
Râsifâc‐nane ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic mi jupere muŋgopieŋ, ine bacjopa warerâ honehape jopa mizieniŋ.’”
Jesu e dâŋ i mufârerâ Jerusalem haeo fisiocte rawec.
Raku Oliwa tikio ferâ Betefage â Betania hae bâqiŋ‐jofawec. Ehuc motecfâcne jaŋeraonec jajahec ʒiŋuc muhuc sorec‐jofawec:
“Hae rajecko ŋekac ira ranic. Rarâ doŋgi motecne niŋgiŋko domakac i bâfuanicmu. Motecne i ŋiczi fainao mi ŋekicne furune. Eme i bâfuarâ firuerâ bareniŋ.
Firuepire ŋic moczi ‘wemocte rokopirec?’ mume ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnenic: ‘Wofuŋzi irec mukac.’”
Mume motec jahe rarâ muwec sâc bâfuapic.
Eme doŋgi firuepire rune jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Ŋohe wemocte goroŋkekopirec?”
Jahe mupic, “Wofuŋzi irec mume rokoperec.”
Iŋuc murâ Jesurao bararâ fainao ŋaqi‐jeŋic râerâ Jesu sâsepie fewec.
Ferâ rame ŋaqi‐jeŋic hatao rumacke rambiŋ.
Eme Oliwa tiki heâŋnao huhuctecne kikefuŋ gurufâc‐ticne jaŋe mâsi‐ticne fuŋne fuŋne honembiŋ irec manasurâ ʒeri ehuc Anutu mucne bacnembiŋ.
Ehuc fânâŋkehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋicwofuŋ‐nâŋec Wofuŋte micte warekac e mumbiaŋkenaŋ, faic sâmbâŋko wama bumâteŋ fokâc â hae faic micne ira ʒeri mumuteŋ fokac.”
Iŋuc muhuc fânâŋkepie farisaio moc moc ŋicŋondeŋko jumbiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Qaqazu, qâjâpecfâcge qatara‐jaretec beheniŋ.”
Mupie jazawec, “No ŋazape mananiŋ, jaŋe niniŋkeniŋmuo qânâzi owackeniŋmu.”
Eme rarâ Jesu e Jerusalem hae mai jaha ŋeme hone‐fârerâ bune herickeme kiohuc muwec:
“Go akio juhâmocmurâ irec hatane dameŋ ʒiŋuczia hone taranʒaŋ me! Go ine ʒâŋege hâpokicnere wiac mi ʒâŋitaekic.
Juku dameŋ moc maicgume râsi jaŋe fisirâ somâcgurâ ŋebâzicgupie nanamaŋ bititi erâ bâŋeŋkecmu.
Erâ fic ʒoŋ hae ʒoŋ egarehuc motecfâcge qâmiziec‐jopapie raŋe siaeŋ foraniŋmu. Eme haege ŋetâ qâtâtieme sesucne fuarâ foocmu. Anutuzi maicguha râpeckemeŋ, irec wiac i fua‐gareocmu.”
Dâŋ i mutararâ ra taha ufuŋko fewec. Ferâ wiac nareŋ gareŋ ehuc domambiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc jâpec‐jopawec:
“Fic kecʒirec dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukicne: Ficnane i nunumu fic ŋezejec, ŋoŋe ine epie fiuc sindaŋ jaŋere qânâuŋ‐tinac ekac.”
Eme ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne taha ufuŋko miti jaza qazuc ehuc juwec. Ehame taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu â micne bapa sasawa jaŋe ine qapie arictac eocte dâŋne mumbiŋ.
Erâ ŋic omane mâmâc sasawa miti‐ticne manarâ erea boc ejarewecte quŋkembiŋ.
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa mocko Jesuzi taha ufuŋko ŋic miti jaza qazuc ehuc juhame taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu â soŋaŋ jaŋe erao rârâ
ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Go nâzâc, ʒira wiac eekic, i more micte eekic? Mozi iŋuc ecmurâ mugareme eekomec?”
Mupie jazawec, “No iŋuc jaha dâŋ moc wio‐ŋarepe nazaniŋ,
Johanere Miti Opâ gie i wenirec fuawec, sambâŋkonec me ŋickonec?”
Iŋuc jazame jaŋe jaŋackoaŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc nazaŋ gazaŋ embiŋ: “Nâŋâc ‘sambâŋkonec fuawec, iŋuc mupene muocmu, ‘Hâc, eme wemocte dâŋticne mi mana ʒakiembiŋ?’
Me ‘ŋickonec fuawec’, iŋuc mupene ŋic sasawa jaŋe manarâ qânâzi hehâmoc‐nâponiŋmu. Jaŋe Johanere manapie porofete fârine ekac i!”
Irec Jesu ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Hece, nâŋe Miti Opâ‐ticnere fuŋne mi manaŋgopeneŋ.”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wiac murâ sâcne, eme noni iŋuc jaha, more micte ʒira wiac eekopac, okacne wâc mi ŋazapemu.”
Jesu e ŋic dâŋ herâricne moc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋic moczi waiŋ gie sarawec. Sara‐fârerâ soŋaŋ râec‐joparâ mâreŋ wiwicko rârâ ira dameŋ ʒoricne juwec.
Juku fârine fufua dameŋ maickeme kiŋaŋ motec moc fârine tucne roocte soreme ra fisime soŋaŋ jaŋe qa imac ecnerâ jâpepie metariŋ risiewec.
Risieme runezi harierâ kiŋaŋ motec moc soreme rame iŋuc jaha wiac gâgâpâcne ecnerâ jâpepie metariŋ jaha risiewec.
Eme runezi harierâ kiŋaŋ motec moc soreme jaŋerao fisime ʒâpâ qarâ tuŋkembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie waiŋ gie runezi manarâ muwec: ‘Ʒi wenac epe? Joroc ŋokâ‐nane sorepe rame araŋ bacneniŋmu mecne.’
Eme soŋaŋ jaŋe ine ŋokâ‐ticne honerâ nazaŋ gazaŋ erâ mumbiŋ, ‘Eki hâcne juku gie ʒi rauckeocmu, murâ qapene gie ʒi nâŋâcne ezejec.’
Iŋuc murâ kâteo tuŋke tuŋke rarâ qâhâmombiŋ. Eme gie rune e soŋaŋ weniŋuc ejareocmu?
Manaŋgopieŋ, e warerâ soŋaŋ iŋucne jopa qâhâmoc ejarerâ gie‐ticnao soŋaŋ furune râec‐jopaocmu.” Eme jaŋe manarâ mumbiŋ, “Aricne, iŋuc mi ejâmbâŋkezo.”
Mupie Jesuzi hone dendeŋ‐jopahuc muwec: “Miti dâŋɋâreŋ moc kecʒiŋuc fokac i fuŋne weniŋucte? ‘Ficbapa ŋic jaŋe wâtuŋ surehuc behembiŋ, wâtuŋ izi mi jâmâ wâtuŋ ezejec i!’
Ŋic moczi jâmâ wâtuŋ ira herâ sahac‐ticne imackeocmu, â wâtuŋzi ŋic mocte faio waha qaocmu ine qâgâreckeocmu.”
Iŋuc mume miti qaqazu â taha bapa micne jaŋe ʒoaŋ ijaha kâpâcwâru baniŋte mumbiŋ. Jesu e dâŋ suŋsuŋne jaŋere muwec, i mana tararâ iŋuc ecnezo murâ ŋic jaŋere hâwic‐jopame behembiŋ.
Eme jaŋe Jesure ruc bahuc doc bapa ŋic erao sorec‐jopapie rambiŋ. Eme ŋic izi hâcne miti hawari juhuc Jesu dâŋzi bitiŋ bacnepie kime kiarao râeniŋte
mu esâic ecnehuc mumbiŋ: “Qaqazu, nâŋe gore fuŋne manaŋgopeneŋ, go dâŋ sâcne nâza qazuc eekic, erâ fekicne fosâoc‐jopahuc dâŋ mi muhasickeekic, ehuc Anuture hata jâmbomacko mutiŋne‐nâreekic.
Irec mutec mananaŋ, Roma ŋicwofuŋ takesi moneŋ râcnepene sâckeekac me mâcne?”
Mupie eeatuc‐jeŋicte fuŋne mana tararâ muwec,
“Ŋoŋe siliwa moneŋ moc bâfuarâ nowatupie honepe, ira more hawari â qâreŋ fokac?” Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Roma ŋicwofuŋte.”
Eme jazarâ muwec: “Murâ ŋicwofuŋte biŋe i ŋicwofuŋ râcnenʒepieŋ, â Anuture biŋe i Anutu râcnenʒepieŋ,”
Iŋuc mume jaŋe dâŋticne batackerâ wemocko ŋic jaŋere maio qorickenʒapiŋ. Irec mâc wareckerâ dâŋjeŋic fâsâewec.
Jaŋe rahapie sadukaio ŋic gâcne Jesurao fisimbiŋ. Ŋic i jaŋe, hâmockonec fafahare mi fokac, iŋuc muhuc jumbiŋ.
Jaŋe hâcne fisirâ Jesu dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Qaqazu, Mose e dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mutâcnewec, ‘Ŋic moczi ŋokac rorâ ɋâric‐ticne mi fuahame hâmome ɋanezi hozec‐ticne rorâ hahac‐ticnere biŋe ɋâric bâfuazejec.’
Eme hahac ɋa 7 jumbiŋ, ehuc mârâc hahac‐jeŋic ŋokac rorâ ɋâric tâmiric jurâ hâmowec.
Hâmome ɋanezi hozec‐ticne rorâ iŋuc jaha hâmowec.
Hâmome ɋaticne moczi hozec ijaha rowec. Iŋuczi iŋuc hahac ɋa 7 jaŋe ŋokac ijaha rorâ ɋâric tâmiric hâmo‐fârembiŋ.
Eme ʒâhecko hozec‐jeŋic iŋuc jaha wâc hâmowec.
Eme ŋic 7 jaŋe mâmâc sasawa ŋokac ijaha rombiŋte juku fafahare dameŋko more ŋonâŋ ezokac?”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ʒira mâreŋko ŋic ŋokac roroc eeŋgopieŋ.
Juku dameŋ sâkoo Anutuzi mana‐jareme sâckeha juju sanaŋte ɋârerâ faharenʒoŋgopieŋ, ŋic ŋokac i jaŋe ine roroc mocwâc mi enʒoŋgopieŋ.
Wemocte? Jaŋe hâmockonec faharerâ Anuture naru motecfâc ehuc aŋelo jaŋe iŋucne hâmo hetiric mi ehuc furu jaha junʒoŋgopieŋ.
Hâmokicnezi ɋârerâ faharenʒoŋgopieŋ, i Mosezi wâc ʒocbâruŋ jâc dutunao fuawec irec binaŋko mufuawec. E Wofuŋte ʒiŋuc qâreŋkewec: ‘E Abraham â Isaka â Jakobo jaŋere Anutu.’
Ine hâcne, e hâmokicne jaŋere Anutu mâcne, e ɋâricne juju jaŋere Anutu, eki maname mâmâc sasawa jujune eŋgopeneŋ ekac hâcne.”
Jesu e iŋuc muhuc jazame miti qaqazu gâcnezi mumbiŋ, “Qaqazu, go dâŋ mutecne biaŋkekac.”
Eme mocwâc mu esâic ecneniŋte manapie ŋemâckeme behembiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc muhuc esâic‐jopawec: “Kristo e Dawidire ɋâric mueŋgopieŋ i weniŋucte?
Dawidi e jahac miti mânec ɋâreŋkehuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: ‘Wofuŋ e nore Wofuŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: Go ware fâre‐naneo ŋehaŋte
no râsifâcge kikefuŋgao guruc‐jopape kikegere ââtesiŋ enʒepieŋ.’
Dawidi e Wofuŋ‐nane mucnewec izi weniŋuc erâ ɋâric‐ticne ekac?”
Eme motecfâc‐ticne ŋic maioa dâŋ decʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Ŋoŋe miti qaqazu jaŋere juju mi junʒepieŋ. Jaŋe ŋaqi ʒora rojuhuc hatao ŋic bâfuac‐jopapie mu ʒeri ejareniŋte maŋjeŋic domaekac. Ehuc mitificko â tutumaŋ ficko ŋicbomboŋ ŋeŋeoa micne ŋeniŋte mueŋgopieŋ.
Iŋucnezi hozec jaŋere fic wiac kâŋgâc jowac roeŋgopieŋ, erâ nunumu ʒorazi hehesic‐jeŋic hefackeeŋgopieŋ. Ŋic i jaŋe juku okacne hâhâwicne ronʒoŋgopieŋ.”
Jesu e qâhâŋnerâ fime rame mafaŋiczi taha katapao moneŋ‐jeŋic râepie hume honewec.
Ehame hozec moczi fisirâ toea jajahec sawa râeme huwec.
Iŋuc eme Jesuzi honerâ jazawec, “No jâmbomac ŋazape: Hozec hapetac kecizi râekac i gâcne sasawa jaŋere sâc jâurukac.
Gâcne jaŋe neŋgocne sâko fojarehame tucne sawa mac râembieŋ. Â hosec e hapetaczi ine focnejec sâc râe‐fârerâ mâc jâmbâŋ jukac.”
Tucne jaŋe taha ufuŋ qânâ erineheczi â taha geroŋzi bapie kiseŋ qâseŋ kirâ fowec i honehuc mu warec epie Jesuzi jazawec,
“Fic honeriŋ qâriŋ ecneŋgopieŋ i boc mi ŋeocmu. Dameŋ moc maickeme râsi jaŋe heropiepie ŋetâ qâtâtieme sesucne fuarâ fozokac.”
Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Qaqazu, mukic i wezimucko fuazokac â irec dameŋ bembeŋkeme sowi weniŋucne fuazokac?”
Eme Jesuzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Maŋ bâsifuc eŋarenʒipiŋte sawaŋ‐ŋeŋic qahuc junʒepieŋ. Ŋic bocjaha fuarâ nore ʒâŋe jaba bajuhuc muniŋmu: ‘No Kristo.’ Â gâcnezi muniŋmu: ‘Dameŋ biac maickekac’. Eme ŋoŋe ŋic iŋucne jaŋere bâjâpecne mi junʒepieŋ.
Erâ ʒika biŋe â râsi fânâŋ manarâ jajaŋ bibisac mi enʒepieŋ. Wiac iŋucne hâcne qanaŋ fuaocte mukicne, erâ fuame sifu dameŋ biac mi taraocmu.”
Iŋuc murâ muwec: “Mâreŋne mâreŋne ŋic guru sâko guru pitic jaŋe rârâsi efârerâ ra qa ware qa ehuc qaqac ranʒoŋgopieŋ.
Erâ homeŋ kâcɋene sâko samarierâ bazokac, erâ roroc â huc mimicne ra fua ware fua ezokac. Erâ sambâŋko sowi â wiac hâhâwicne fuazokac.
“Wiac i mi fuahame jaŋe qanaŋ rocŋopaniŋmu â ŋopa jâpec eŋareniŋmu. Erâ wâc dâŋficko â kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐ŋopaniŋmu â ŋicwofuŋ â kia jaŋerao bacŋopa raniŋmu, i ŋoŋe nore ʒâŋe bajuŋgopieŋte iŋuc eŋareniŋmu.
Eme ira fuŋne mumutaniŋ gie maic‐ŋopaocmu.
Eme jaŋere maio domahuc dâŋ weniŋuc mupene sâckeocmu muhuc mana wosâc mi enʒepieŋ.
No nahac mic â mamana baafecke‐ŋarepe dâŋ mupie kisâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe dâŋŋeŋic bawaharâ qatara‐ŋareniŋte eipieniŋmu.
Erâ omanezi sawa wiac mi eŋareniŋmu, neŋgoc mamac, hahac ɋa, seŋ sâme, âgo bago jaŋe wâc doc bacŋopaniŋmu. Eme ŋoŋeraonec gâcnezi ʒika kirâ hâmoniŋmu.
Eme ŋic mâmâc sasawa jaŋe ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanere erâ ŋoŋere manapie aaricnehec eocmu.
Wiac iŋucne eŋarehapie noni ŋezic‐ŋopape qizec susuc‐ŋeŋic moc mi sifuckeocmu.
Dodocke tâmiric juraku juju‐ŋeŋic bâfuaniŋmu.
“Momori jaŋe fisirâ Jerusalem hae somâckepie honerâ munʒepieŋ, ‘Miti hae qizec‐nâŋec tuhu eocte dameŋne maickekac.’
Eme Judaia mâreŋko juniŋmuzi tiki mâreŋko wiserâ ranʒepieŋ, â miti hae qizecko juniŋmuzi iŋuc jaha biac waha wise ranʒepieŋ.
Dameŋ ira hâcne okacne babazu fuaocmu, ehuc mitio dâŋ mukicne i fideteŋ efâreocmu.
Jei, ŋokac kiwecheczi â susuonecheczi dameŋ ira weniŋuc enʒoŋgopieŋ? Ŋicguru ʒi jaŋerao kiŋ babatara fuame bâŋeŋkerâ weaŋsicne nâniŋmu.
Eme râsi jaŋe ŋic gâcne ʒika mimicnezi jopa miziehuc gâcne mâreŋ sâc amec‐jopa rapie kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic erâ juniŋmu. Erâ qâpuc jaŋe Jerusalem haeo ima gie bahuc juhapie mâreŋ sâc ŋic qâpuc dameŋ‐jeŋic hesackeocmu.
“Eme ʒâhecko ʒoaŋ mosa bâpiŋko wiac ʒâŋe furu fuazokac, â mâreŋko hâwec sirizi â temboŋzi fânâŋ sâko eme hazec guru‐ŋeŋic fuazokac.
Erâ wâc sambâŋ qiriŋ qame tâpirine ŋeŋgoroŋkezokac. Eme ŋic jaŋe wiac fua taraocte woŋec juhuc hobu‐jeŋic taŋtaŋ âeckehame nokafe tataeŋ erâ domanʒoŋgopieŋ.
Ehame Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋnezi karorac faio domahuc ɋuŋɋasaŋ bâric bâric‐ticnehec fisime hone ʒâirenʒoŋgopieŋ.
Wiac iŋucne hâcne fuame honerâ qâhâŋnerâ fie ruruckehuc ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Roroc‐nâpo dameŋ maickekac hâcne.’”
Iŋuc murâ dâŋ suŋsuŋne moc ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckewec: “Ŋoŋe jâmiŋ â jâc gâcne gâcne honehuc fuŋne mananʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe gitec herâ fiepie honerâ mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Ʒoaŋ dameŋ maickezo ekac.’
Eme wiac mukopac i fuame honerâ munʒepieŋ: ‘Anuture uucmaŋ fua tâcnezo ekac.’
No jâmbomac ŋazape: Ŋicguru ʒi jaŋe mi sirowehapie wiac mukicne i deŋke‐fâreocmu.
Sambâŋ â mâreŋ jahe sirowezokopirec, â nore dâŋ ine mi sirowe‐jâmbâŋkezokac.
“Ŋoŋe nâ areŋ ehuc wiac omanere kirâ utuckerâ juhapie maŋŋenic bâzickeme dameŋ sâkozi bitiŋko kiki tinac ututuŋ jâmbâŋ kicŋopazacte sawaŋ‐ŋeŋic qahuc junʒepieŋ.
Dameŋ sâko e mâreŋ sâc ŋic ŋoŋe sâcŋopa‐fârerâ acmâc jaha fuaocmu.
Irec ŋoŋe maŋguŋ tâmiric erâ hati numuhuc juhapie wiac fuaocte mukicne izi riric‐ŋopame Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e fisime ere maio qiŋ herâ domanʒepieŋ.”
Jesu e ʒoaŋko ŋic taha ufuŋko miti jaza qazuc ehuc juwec. Ehame hae owâeme hae beherâ Oliwa tikio ferâ ira fojujec.
Eme hae fure pârâckeme ŋic ŋokac sasawa jaŋe miti mume mananiŋte biac taha ufuŋko tumaŋne jumbieŋ.
Goreŋ sowa juhuc aakic hombaŋ ŋeŋe irec dameŋ bembeŋkewec.
Ehame taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu jaŋe ŋic araŋ bajarembiŋte Jesu weniŋuc ecnepene arictac ezejec muhuc hata basahuc jumbiŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc juhapie Sataŋzi Jesure motec moc ʒâŋene Juda Karioto haeonec ere maŋko hume
taha bapa micne â ufuŋte polismaŋ micne jaŋerao rarâ Jesu doc bame roniŋte dâŋ mumocke‐jarewec.
Eme jaŋe manarâ bujeŋic biaŋkeme furine moneŋ râcneniŋte mujomirembiŋ.
Mupie dâŋjeŋic reŋkehuc ŋic jaŋe hone manac mi ehapie soŋsoŋko doc bame roniŋte hone qatarac ehuc juwec.
Ehame goreŋ sowa juhuc aakic lama hezuniŋte hombaŋ maickeme
Jesuzi Petoro â Johane ʒiŋuc muhuc sorec‐jofawec: “Ŋohe rarâ aakic lama hezu rikec ehapire fâpene nânʒepeŋeŋ.”
Mume jahe ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnepic: “Fic wena hezu rikec ezeperec?”
Eme ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Mananic, ŋohe haeo ferâ ŋic moc opâ râqâchec bâfuarâ bâjâperâ, ficko feme fenic.
Ferâ fic rune ʒiŋuc âzâcneniŋ: ‘Qaqazuzi gore ʒiŋuc mukac, fic maŋne wena motecfâc‐nane jaŋehec aakic lama nanaŋmu?’
Iŋuc âzâcnepire fic maŋne kâcɋene moc ŋeŋe fofo wiac rumacke emasaŋ ekicne ŋofatume ira aakic lama rike bâmoc ezepirec.”
Eme jahe rarâ wiac muwec sâc bâfuarâ aakic lama rike bâmoc epic.
Eme nâzo dameŋ maickeme motecfâcne gâcne rocjopame fisirâ nâmbiŋ.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ʒâic dameŋ‐nanezi bâmbeŋnuhame aakic lama ʒi ŋoŋehec nâpemurâ boc enarejec.
No mupe mananiŋ: No aakic lama mocwâc mi nânâ juhape Anuture uucmaŋko fâri fideteŋ eocmu.”
Iŋuc murâ waiŋ râqâc rorâ daŋge murâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe rorâ nâ nareŋ gareŋ eniŋ.
No ŋazape, waiŋ opâ mocwâc mi nânâ juhape Anuture uucmaŋ fua tâcnezokac.”
Dâŋ i murâ poroŋ rorâ daŋge murâ bazurâ ʒiŋuc muhuc jarewec: “Kecʒi fâri‐nane, [i ŋoŋere erâ qikiŋnekicne. Nore manasuhuc iŋuc nânʒepieŋ.”
Nânâ nâpie waiŋ râqâc rorâ iŋuc jaha jarehuc muwec: “Râqâc kecʒira ʒâʒâfic ɋâricnere socnane ŋekac. I ŋoŋere erâ qikiŋnekicne.]
Erâ manaŋgopieŋ, doc bacnuocmu eki nohec tebo ʒira wiac mâmâc ro nâc ehuc ŋekoperec.
Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e hata muʒâwecnekicne ijaha raocmu. Â doc baocmu e ine, jei okacne mo iŋucne roocmu.”
Iŋuc mume motec jaŋe guru‐jeŋickonec mozi i eocmu muhuc wiwioc embiŋ.
Eku wâc motec jaŋe nâŋâcnaonec mozi femicne‐nâŋec jukac muhuc hehefaric embiŋ.
Epie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Mâreŋ ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe ŋiczi kiŋaŋ qajareeŋgopieŋ â fekicne sâko jaŋe omanezi mumbiaŋ‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋerao ine iŋuc mi fuazejec. Ŋoŋerao kâcɋenezi piticnere sâc juzejec, â micnezi kiŋaŋ qaqare sâcko juzejec.
Me ŋoŋe muniŋ, wenimo izi fekicne? Nânâ mâc ŋehuc nâocmu eki fekicne, me rike bâmoc eocmu eki fekicne? Mâc ŋehuc nâocmuzi fekicne, i manaeŋgopieŋ. Noni ine ŋoŋere ŋondeŋko kiŋaŋ qaqa iŋucne erâ juekopac.
Ŋoŋe hâcne ʒârâ hâriŋ maŋko jupe jujufâc‐nane jueŋgopieŋ.
Eme Mamac‐nanezi guriŋ bapa gie munarewec iŋuc jaha noni ŋoŋe muŋarekopac,
ŋoŋe nore uucmaŋko tiwâ nâ ʒeri eniŋte â ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋeo ŋehuc Israe ŋicguru 12 jaŋere dâŋ mutaraniŋte.
“Simoŋ, Simoŋ, padi saja bapie wosâeekac iŋuc jaha Sataŋzi ŋoŋe ere meo fepie saja bacŋopaocte mujec.
Eme noni ine mamanasiŋge omaezacte gore erâ numupac. Irec go miti hatao mocwâc risierâ qomâfâcge keteŋ‐jopazemec.”
Mume Petorozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋ, go kâpâcwâruo me hâmocko fâtec fâpemu.”
Eme Jesuzi muwec, “Petoro, no gazape manac, qâqâczi miŋecgac ŋafeo mi dâŋehame goki jahec â moc micnucmu.”
Iŋuc murâ muwec, “Noni moneŋ tâmiric â he tâmiric â kikehuhu tâmiric sorec‐ŋopape ra basac qasac moc embiŋ me?” Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Iŋuc aricne jâmbâŋ.”
Mupie ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckewec: “Â dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ine moc e moneŋ focnekacko ro bajuzejec, â moc e hemotec focnekacko rupe juzejec, â moc e ʒika basahuc ŋaqi qikiŋneme moc kitâcnecnezejec.
No mupe mananiŋ, findaŋdâŋ moc ʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne: ‘E ʒika qaqa jaŋere guruo râembiŋ’, dâŋ i norao fârinehuc eocmu. Erâ nore dâŋ mukicne i mâmâc sasawa sanaŋke‐fâreocte dameŋ maickekac hâcne.”
Mume motec jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Wofuŋ honec, ʒi ʒika jajahec fokopirec.” Eme muwec: “Sâcne.”
Eme ŋeku Jesu e ŋafe sâc ejujec iŋuc erâ hae beherâ Oliwa tikio feme motec jaŋe bâjâpembiŋ.
Eme jujujecko fisirâ motecfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe eesâicko dockenʒipiŋte numuniŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ qânâ wickepene raekac irec sâc rarâ dieŋzi herâ ʒiŋuc muhuc numuwec:
“Mamac, go manatec sâckeme mutec ʒâic guru ʒizi nowaruoc. Erâ nore dâŋ mâcne, gore dâŋ sanaŋkezejec.”[
Iŋuc muhame sambâŋkonec aŋelo moczi waharâ basanaŋkewec.
Eme maŋzi ʒâic hâhâwicne ecneha fotariehuc numuwec. Ehame fofoŋac‐ticne soc ʒâmbâŋ iŋucne tâcnehuc mâreŋko wahawec.]
Numuku faharerâ motecfâcne jaŋerao rarâ honec‐jopawec: Jaŋe busâqoczi bâdoc‐jopame betaŋkerâ guŋ fombiŋ.
Fohapie jazarâ muwec: “Ŋoŋe wemocte guŋ foŋgopieŋ? Eesâicko dockenʒipiŋte faharerâ numuniŋ me!”
Iŋuc muhuc domahame mi râsi guru ututuŋ fisinʒepieŋ i! Eme motec jaŋere âgo moc ʒâŋene Juda, eki micne bajarehuc Jesurao rarâ muduckewec.
Muduckeme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Juda, go wemocte Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e muduckehuc doc bakomec?”
Eme Jesure kikefuŋfâc jaŋe wiac fuazo eme honerâ mumbiŋ, “Wofuŋ, ʒikazi jopanaŋ me?”
Iŋuc murâ jaŋeraonec moczi taha bapa sâkore kiŋaŋ motec ʒikazi qaocte hazecne fâreopec i qatarawec.
Eme Jesuzi i honerâ muwec: “Ŋoŋe beheniŋ.” Iŋuc muhuc ŋic hazec‐ticne bâuahuc bâsomiewec.
Erâ taha bapa micne â ufuŋte polisman micne â soŋaŋ e roniŋte fisimbiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe nore manapie ʒika qaqa eme ʒika qaruc‐ŋeŋichec fisirâ rocnuŋgopieŋ me?
No ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne taha ufuŋko ŋoŋehec juekopac, ehame ŋoŋe ira mi rocnumbieŋ. Ʒi ine ŋoŋere dameŋ maickekac â dapâcte tâpiri fua tâcnekac.”
Eme jaŋe Jesu rorâ bararâ taha bapa sâkore ficko bafembiŋ. Ehame Petoro e fisi fâresuc ehuc ʒâhec rawec.
Eme momori jaŋe sacmaŋko raʒirâ ʒoc ruqerâ ruahuc ŋehapie Petoro e iŋuc jaha raʒirâ ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ŋewec.
Ŋehame kiŋaŋ naru moczi fisirâ hone dedeŋnehuc muwec, “Ŋic keci ehec juekac wâc.”
Eme Petorozi mic bahuc muwec, “Ŋokac, no e mi honeekopac.”
Iŋuc murâ ŋeme mi ʒorahame ŋic moczi honerâ muwec, “Go hâcne jaŋere guruonec.” Eme Petorozi muwec, “Ŋic go, no aricne.”
Eme ʒâhec ŋic moczi fisirâ musanaŋkehuc muwec: “Â ŋic kecʒi jâmbomac ehec juekac, e Galilaia ŋic jaha.”
Mume Petorozi muwec, “Ŋic go dâŋ mutec kâuc bakopac.” Muhame izia qâqâczi dâŋewec.
Eme Wofuŋzi forisierâ Petororao ʒâŋe fime Petoro e Wofuŋzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec i manasuwec: “Qâqâczi mi dâŋehame go jahec â moc mic bacnucmu.”
Dâŋ i manasurâ bune herickeme ra kio sâqorewec.
Jesu soŋaŋkehuc domambiŋ ŋic i jaŋe mu ʒerec ecnehuc
ʒâŋe maine bâsoŋkerâ qahuc mumbiŋ, “Go porofete jukomeczi ŋic gukac ere ʒâŋe muc.”
Erâ âke sisic wiac gâcne mâmâc ecnembiŋ.
Ehapie hae fureme micne guru, taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu hâcne, jaŋe sasawa tumaŋne‐fârerâ mupie Jesu guru‐jeŋicko bafepie dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ:
“Go Kristo jukomecko mufua‐nârec.” Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No ŋazape mi mananiŋmu,
me indiŋ‐ŋopape ŋifecne sâcne wâc mi nazaniŋmu.
Ʒi ine Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e Anutu tâpiri rune fârenao ŋeocmurâ dameŋne maickekac.”
Mume manarâ mâmâc sasawa ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Eme go Anuture Ŋokâ ine hâcne?” Eme muwec, “Ine hâcne.”
Mume mumbiŋ: “Wemocte dâŋgie mocwâc banaŋmu, ʒi e jahacne mickonec wahame manaŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme jaŋe ŋeku mâmâc sasawa faharerâ Jesu Pilatorao barambiŋ.
Erao domahuc kecʒiŋuc muhuc qorickembiŋ: “Ŋic kecʒirec fuŋne ʒiŋuc fokac, e ŋic mâmâc sasawa ɋâiŋ‐jopaekac, ehuc Roma ŋicwofuŋte takesi moneŋ mi râeniŋte muac‐jopaekac, erâ wâc e jahacnere ʒiŋuc muekac: No Kristo ŋicwofuŋ.
Eme Pilatozi wiocnerâ muwec: “Go Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ me?” Eme Jesuzi muwec: “Ine hâcne mukomec.”
Mume Pilatozi taha bapa micne â ŋic guru sâko mâmâc jazarâ muwec, “No ŋic ʒirec kiŋ basakopac.”
Eme jaŋe fotarierâ mujâmbâŋkehuc mumbiŋ: “E jâmbomac ŋic qafeŋ‐jopame dâŋticnezi mâreŋ‐nâŋecko haŋ bafâreekac. E Galilaia mâreŋkonecteaŋ fuŋkerâ ewareku ʒira Judaia mâreŋko ijaha eekac.”
Iŋuc mupie Pilatozi wio‐jarerâ muwec, “Ŋic e Galilaia mâreŋkonec me?”
Eme “ine hâcne” mupie Jesu e Herodere gie gaŋkonec, iŋuc manarâ mume Heroderao barambiŋ. Herode e dameŋ ira Jerusalem haeo juwec.
Herode e Jesu honerâ bune biaŋkewec. E Jesure biŋe gâbâ manahuc honeocte boc ecne jujec. Erâ wâc mâsi moc bame honeocte aŋac focnewec.
Eme Jesu dâŋ fuŋne fuŋne wiocneme okacne moc mi bâtikiecnewec.
Ehame taha bapa micne â miti qaqazu jaŋe qoricke sanaŋkehuc domambiŋ.
Eme Herode â momorifâcne jaŋe Jesu sâckehuc ʒoraŋ ecnembiŋ. Ehuc Herodezi mume Jesu ŋicbomboŋ ŋaqi moc hecnepie hume Pilatorao mocwâc bârisiembiŋ.
Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa ira Pilato â Herode jahe ââgo epic, mârâc jaha ine kikisâ ehuc jupic.
Pilato e taha bapa micne â ŋic fekicne â ŋic omane jaŋe mâmâc hefârec‐jopame fisimbiŋ.
Eme ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc ŋic kecʒi norao barâ warembieŋ: ‘E ŋic qafeŋ‐jopaekac.’ Eme noni ŋoŋere maio fuŋne‐ticne bataniŋkepe fâri tâmiric ejec.
Herodezi iŋuc jaha erâ mume mocwâc bârisierâ bawareŋgopieŋ. Manaŋgopieŋ, kiŋticnezi hâmocte sâc mi bâfuakac,
irec mupe momori jaŋe kâcbiŋzi qapie firuepemu.” [
Kia e hombaŋ dameŋko ŋic moc firue‐jare jujec hâcne.]
Jaŋe ine micne mic sâc owackerâ mumbiŋ, “E arictac eoc, Baraba ine firue‐nârec.”
Baraba eki ine ŋic gâcne jaŋehec ʒika qahuc ŋuc moc qâhâmome kâpâcwâru ficko râembiŋ.
Eme Pilato e harierâ jazawec, “No Jesu firuepemu i!”
Mume jaŋe hahaŋne bahuc mumbiŋ, “Maripoŋko hâmooc, maripoŋko hâmooc!”
Eme Pilatozi qatara‐jarehame jahec â moc eme jazawec, “Wemo sâqocne bawecte? No manape kiŋticne hâmocte sâc mi ekacte mupe kâcbiŋ sawa kirâ juzejec.”
Eme jaŋe fota qatarierâ micne mic ʒereŋ musereckerâ owackehuc mumbiŋ, “Maripoŋko hâmooc.” Murâ qâsifu sâko qarâ fetone fehuc kiare dâŋ bawahambiŋ.
Eme Pilatozi dâŋ mumbiŋ irec fârine fuaocte mutarawec.
Ehuc dâŋjeŋic reŋkerâ qaqafeŋte â ʒikare kâpâcwâruo râekicne ŋic e firue‐jarewec â Jesu ine qikiŋne‐jarewec.
Jaŋe Jesu baraku hatao ŋic moc bâfuambiŋ, ʒâŋene Simoŋ, Kirene hae mâreŋkonec. E gieonec wareme rorâ Jesure maripoŋ ɋawenao râepie hâporâ Jesure râpefuŋko rawec.
Erâ ŋic ŋokac guru sâkozi bâjâpembiŋ. Ehuc ŋokac jaŋe kio wâwâsic â mu mamakuc ecnembiŋ.
Epie Jesuzi fotikierâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Jerusalemnec ŋokac bureŋ, ŋoŋe nore mi kioniŋ. Ŋoŋe â naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic ŋaŋacne kioniŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, juku dameŋ moc maickeme ʒiŋuc munʒoŋgopieŋ: ‘Oi, ŋokac hufiŋne â me sawane jaŋe iŋucne junʒapeŋ me!’
Eme dameŋ ira tiki jaŋere ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: ‘Ŋoŋe herickerâ waha ŋefac‐nâponiŋ’, â hârâc jaŋere muniŋmu, ‘Ŋoŋe fâuckerâ bârâraŋ‐nâponin’.
Wiac ʒiŋucne jâc ɋâricne ecneŋgopieŋko hâmocne weniŋuc ecnezo?”
Eme sâqocne bapa jajahec ehec mâmâc jopaniŋte bacjopa rambiŋ.
Eme raku mâreŋ moc ʒâŋene Utusiec ira fisirâ Jesu maripoŋko qambiŋ, â sâqocne bapa moc ŋifec â moc ŋifec mâmâc jofambiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi numuhuc muwec, “Mamac, jaŋe wiac eŋgopieŋ i fuŋne kâuc baŋgopieŋte kiŋjeŋic behec.” Momori jaŋe ine ŋaqi‐ticnere jaŋaczia ɋâsâi qapie âke fuac‐jopame sâc rauckembiŋ.
Ŋic ine wemo afecne ijaha domahuc wiac hone‐fârembiŋ. Ehuc ŋic fekicne jaŋe sâke itic ecnehuc mumbiŋ, “Gâcne bafic‐jopaweczi e jahacne sahac bafickeoc me! E Kristo Anuture joroc jukacko iŋuc eoc me!”
Momori jaŋe iŋuc jaha mu ruruc ecnembiŋ, ehuc waiŋ opâ ʒaʒacne sicnecnehuc mumbiŋ:
Go Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ jukomecko sahacge ŋezickec me!”
Eme Jesure qizec botâŋko dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc râembiŋ: “Ʒi Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ.”
Eme sâqocne bapa moczi maripoŋko domahuc bafic‐joparâ sâke kiki ecnerâ muwec, “Go iŋucnezi Kristo me? Murâ gahacne sahac batararâ nâhe mâmâc batarac‐nâfoc.”
Iŋuc mume âgonezi dâŋ mucnehuc muwec, “Go ʒikare biŋe mâmâc ekicnezi Anuture mi hâwicguha iŋuc mukomec?
Nâhâc kiŋnâhecte sâcko wiac sâcne enâctekicne, ŋic kecʒizi ine sindaŋ moc mi ewec.”
Iŋuc murâ muwec, “Jesu, go Wofuŋ tâpirigehec juku fisirâ nore manasuzemec.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No jâmbomac gazape, miŋecgac jaha nohec Paradisio jucmu.”
Eme 12 kilok ehame ʒoaŋ gâpâreme dapâc fuarâ mâreŋ sâckerâ fohame 3 kilok ewec.
Ehame taha ufuŋko qoruc ââketâc sâko ʒâʒâŋiŋ jaha hâŋ fâucke waharâ qatarawec.
Eme Jesu e wiwic jaha wirahuc muwec, “Mamac, megao maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane râekopac.” Iŋuc murâ hâmowec.
Eme momori soŋaŋzi wiac i hone manac efârerâ Anutu mumbiaŋkehuc muwec, “Ŋic kecʒi e jâmbomac bahacmâc.”
Erâ ŋic gâcne sâko wiac hone aŋac eniŋte fisimbiŋ jaŋe wiac i sasawa hone manac erâ maŋjeŋiczi tutuc qajarehame risiembiŋ.
Jesu e jahacne wiacfâc â Galilaia mâreŋkonec ŋokac bâjâperâ warembiŋ jaŋe ine taicko domahuc wiac hone manac embiŋ.
Ŋic moc juwec, ʒâŋene Josefe; hae‐ticne Judaia mâreŋko ŋewec, ʒâŋene Arimataia. Ŋic e micne sâko jumbiŋ jaŋere guruonec, erâ e ŋic wamane â tiŋne.
Âgofâcne jaŋe Jesu dâŋ qacnehuc ʒikao râepie maname mi sâckewec, erâ e Anuture uucmaŋ fua tâcneocte woŋec juwec hâcne.
Ŋic eki hâcne Pilatorao rarâ Jesu qâŋɋâŋ‐ticnere âzâcnewec.
Eme manacneme ra maripoŋkonec batararâ qoruc qaŋqaŋzi râpâckerâ bararâ qânâ hâŋko hawec ʒâŋeruŋte biŋe gufukicne ira Jesure qâŋɋâŋ râewec. Hawec i furu fowec, ira mârâc jaha qâŋɋâŋ moc mi râekicne.
I ʒaʒawie dameŋte owâ gieo fuawec, sabata hombaŋ maickezo eha.
Ŋokac tucne Jesuhec Galilaia mâreŋkoneŋ warembiŋ jaŋe Josefe bâjâpehuc honehapie Jesure qâŋɋâŋ ʒâŋeruŋko râewec.
Eme wiac hone‐fârerâ haeo risierâ wokemaŋ âsu biaŋ â kâŋâ wiac bâmockembiŋ. Erâ sabata hombaŋko sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkehuc ŋemanambiŋ.
Sonda uupicte hae fure pârâckezo ehame ŋokac jaŋe wiac âsu biaŋ bâmockembiŋ i ʒâŋeruŋko amecke rambiŋ.
Ra fisirâ honembiŋ: Qânâ sâko e rârieme hawec aaŋ fowec.
Eme ʒâŋeruŋ maŋko raʒirâ Wofuŋ Jesu qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne basambiŋ.
Basarâ weaŋkerâ domahapie ŋic jajahec ŋaqi‐jekic bâric bâricnekicne mi maŋfuŋ‐jeŋicko fuarâ domazepirec i!
Eme ŋokac jaŋe hâwic‐jopame dunduŋ domahapie ŋic jahe ʒiŋuc jazapic: “Ŋoŋe wemocte ɋârine jukac e hâmokicne jaŋerao basaŋgopieŋ?
E ʒira mi fokac, e ɋârerâ faharejec, Galilaia mâreŋko juhuc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc ŋazawec i manasuniŋ:
‘Mamac‐nanezi Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e sâqocne bapa jaŋere meo râeme qapie hâmorâ ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha ɋârerâ fahareocmu.’”
Iŋuc mupire ŋokaŋ jaŋe dâŋ i manasuhuc
ʒâŋeruŋkonec risierâ haeo fisirâ motecfâcne 11 â ŋic ŋokac gâcne dâŋ binaŋ ejarembiŋ.
Ŋokac ʒâŋe‐jeŋic Maria Madala haeonec â Johana â Maria Jakobore neŋgoc erâ âgofâc‐jeŋic gâcne mâmâc jumbiŋ. Izi hâcne aposolo biŋedâŋ jazambiŋ.
Jazapie dâŋjeŋic manapie pacgoroŋ dâŋ eme mi mana ʒakiembiŋ.
Â Petoro e ine fahare ʒâŋeruŋko gasacke rarâ okarierâ fime raʒime qoruc râpâ sawa honewec. Erâ wiac fuawec i mana warec ehuc haeo risie rawec.
Eme ʒoaŋ ijaha Jesure kikefuŋfâc jaŋeraonec ŋic jajahec Emausi haeo ranicte rapic. Hae i ʒoricko mi ŋewec, Judaŋic jaŋe qâqâtâc bembeŋkeme Jerusalem haeonec rârâ ʒoaŋ otewezo ehame fisi jumbieŋ.
Eme ŋic jahe hatao rahuc wiac fuawec irec muc manac epic.
Mu gufuc ehuc muc manac rahapire Jesu e jahac rarâ bâfuac‐jofame mâmâc rambiŋ.
Eme ʒâŋe‐jekic bâsâockekicnere mi hone tarapic.
Iŋuc ehapire wio‐jacterâ muwec: “Ŋohe wemo wiacte nazaŋ gazaŋ ehuc jukopirec?” Mume jahe ʒâŋe mai‐jekic sorondoŋ eha domapic.
Ehuc jaheraonec moc ʒâŋene Keleopa eki muwec, “Jerusalem haeo ŋic hombaŋte fisimbiŋ jaŋe dâŋ biŋe sâko hazec sâc mana‐fârehapie go mocjahazi weniŋuc erâ hazec furu jukomec.”
Eme eki wio‐jacterâ muwec, “Wemo wiac?” Mume jahe mupic, “Wiac Jesu Nazarete haeonec ere binaŋ. E porofete sâko juhuc Anuture maio â ŋicmaio wiac tâpiri jaha mu bac ehuc juwec.
Ehame taha bapa micne â fekicnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe hâmoocte mutaracnehuc kiarao râepie mume maripoŋko qambiŋ.
Nâŋe ine ere mamanac juhuc ʒiŋuc mumbeŋ: ‘Eki hâcne Israe ŋic nâŋâc niŋgiŋkonec firuec‐nâpozejec.’ Eme qapie hâmome juhapene biac ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc ekâc.
Ehame miŋecgac nâŋeraonec ŋokac gâcne bu qâqânduc dâŋ nâzâmbieŋ. Jaŋe furicte ʒâŋeruŋko rarâ
qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne basarâ risierâ ʒiŋuc mumbieŋ: ‘Aŋelo jajahec fua‐nârehuc, Jesu ɋârerâ faharejec, iŋuc nâzâkopirec.’
Eme dâŋ i manarâ nâŋeraonec ŋic âgofâc‐nâŋec tucnezi rarâ ŋokac mumbieŋ sâc bâfuambieŋ â e jahacne ine mi honembieŋ.”
Dâŋ iŋuc muhuc âzâcnepire eki muwec: “Porofete jaŋe dâŋ mu qâreŋ embiŋ i ŋoŋe wemocte mutuc â maŋ mâmâcne juhuc mi mana ʒakieeŋgopieŋ?
Kristo e wemocko hâmoc ʒâic tâmiric juku sambâŋ tatamac‐ticnao raʒizac?”
Iŋuc murâ Mose â porofete dâŋ erao iticnehuc qâreŋkembiŋ, irec fuŋne ritu‐jacte‐fârewec.
Eme raku Emausi hae bâqiŋkembiŋ. Ehuc eki hae fotâcnerâ raocte eme
jahe sakarehuc mupic, “Ʒoaŋ biac rifireha hae ŋafezo ekacte go nâhehec juc.” Eme jahehec juocte mana‐jacteme ficko mâmâc fembiŋ.
Eme nânâ nâniŋte waha ŋerâ poroŋ rorâ jambuŋkehuc bazurâ jactewec.
Ehame ʒâŋe‐jekic raruŋkeme hone tarapic. Hone tarapire izia sipuac ewec.
Eme jahe nazaŋ gazaŋ erâ kecʒiŋuc mupic: “Hatao dâŋ nâsâhuc mitire fuŋne ritu‐nâcteme bunâhec bâruŋkejec hâcne ine.”
Iŋuc murâ izia faharerâ Jerusalem haeo risie rapic. Ra fisirâ e jahacne motec 11 â âgofâc‐jeŋic gâcne tumaŋnerâ ŋehapie bâfuac‐jopapire
jaŋe biac ʒiŋuc jasambiŋ: “Wofuŋ e jâmbomac faharerâ Simoŋ fuacnejec.”
Eme jahe iŋuc jaha Wofuŋzi hatao bâfuac‐jofarâ ficko poroŋ bazume ʒâŋitapic, irec dâŋ binaŋ ejarepic.
Motec jaŋe irec dâŋ binaŋ ehuc ŋehapie Jesu e jahac ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko fuarâ domawec.
Eme jaŋe honerâ fâfârerâ hâwic‐jopame mumbiŋ, “Bawezi fuakac.”
Eme eki ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe wemocte fâfârerâ maŋjahec eŋgopieŋ?
Ʒi no nahac jâmbâŋ jukopac, ŋoŋe me kike‐nane honeniŋ, ehuc ware bâuacnurâ hone‐hâmocnuniŋ, no sahac biuc‐nanehec, bawe jaŋe ijeŋichec aricne.”
Dâŋ iŋuc jazarâ, mejahecne â kike jahecne jowatuwec.
Eme jaŋe bujeŋic biaŋkeme dâŋticne mi mamana mâc wareckehuc ŋepie wio‐jarerâ muwec:
“Nânâ‐ŋeŋic moc fokac me?” Eme jaŋe opâ qowi ʒegoc ʒakicne moc râcnerâ
honehapie ro nâc ewec.
Erâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No ŋoŋehec juhuc kecʒiŋuc ŋaza jupac: ‘Mosere sâcmutâc dâŋqâhâcko â porofete jaŋere papiao â miti mânecko nore findaŋdâŋ qâreŋkekicne, i fârinehec efâreocmu.’”
Eme miti papiao dâŋqâreŋ fokac irec fuŋne ritu‐jarekume maŋjeŋic uŋtowec.
Ehuc jazawec, “Kristore ʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne: ‘E ʒâic manaku hâmorâ ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha hâmockonec ɋârerâ fahareocmu.’
Â ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne ŋic mâreŋ sâc jaŋerao rame maŋ bâbârisie â sâqocne mumutâmire fua raocte mukicne. Gie i Jerusalem haeo fuŋkerâ barazo.
Wiac irec mumutaniŋ ŋic ŋoŋe hâcne.
Erâ manaŋgopieŋ, Mamac‐nanezi wiac biŋe qaŋarewec i sorepe waha‐ŋareocmu. Irec ŋoŋe hae ʒi mi behehuc mâc woŋec juhapie faic irec tâpiri heŋarepe huzejec.”
Eme haeonec jowac‐jopa rarâ Betania hae mendâŋko fisirâ meticne sicnehuc jambuŋ‐jopawec.
Jambuŋ‐jopahuc behec‐joparâ fewec.
Eme jaŋe bubiaŋ kâcɋene manahuc Jerusalem haeo risiembiŋ.
Risierâ taha ufuŋko hati jurâ ju ehuc Anutu muteŋkembiŋ.
Micdâŋ e fuŋnao fuŋkerâ juwarehuc juwec. Erâ Micdâŋ e juju‐ticne Anuturao foha juhuc juwec. Erâ Micdâŋ e Anutu jaha wâc juwec.
E hâcne fuŋnao Anutuhec jurâ juwarewec.
Erâ Micdâŋ e Anuture me wâc ehuc wiac sasawa bâfua‐fârewec, â wiac fuawec i e tâmiric moc mi fuawec.
Erâ juju irec rune erâ juwec. Â juju‐ticnezi ŋic tamae‐jarewec.
Eme tatamaczi dapâcko tamaeme dapâczi guriŋkeocte eipiewec.
Ŋic moc fuarâ juwec ʒâŋene Johane.
Eki tatamacte biŋedâŋ mufuame ŋic mâmâc sasawa jaŋe tatamac rune manasiŋkeniŋte Anutuzi sorewec.
Johane e jahacne tatamac rune mi juwec, e mâc tatamac runere biŋe muwec.
Tatamac rune ŋic mâreŋ sâc batamaec‐jopaekac, eki hâcne dameŋ ira mâreŋko fuarâ juwec.
E mâreŋko fufua i fuawec, erâ i sawa mâcne, mâreŋ i ekizia wâc bâfuawec, eme waharâ fuame mâreŋkonec ŋic jaŋe e sifu mi ʒâŋitambiŋ.
E jahacne me hofao fisihame gurufâc‐ticne jaŋe âgo mi ecnembiŋ.
Â âgo ecnembiŋ jaŋe ine Anuture naru motecfâc eniŋte hata bâfua‐jarewec, i ʒâŋe‐ticne mana maŋ eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne iŋuc ejareekac.
Jaŋe soc biucte hatao mi fuambiŋ, erâ ŋic mumupaŋte wâc mâcne, jaŋe Anuturaonec fuambiŋ.
Eme Micdâŋ e sahac biuchec fuarâ ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko ŋeŋe juju ewec. Eme nâŋe Wofuŋ qâreŋ‐ticne honepene Mamacte Ŋokâ jâmbâŋ mocjaha ere Wofuŋ qâreŋ ewec hâcne. E aki anonoc kadahe â dâŋ fâri qizecne bawahawec.
Fuŋne‐ticne ine Johanezi mutaniŋkerâ hahaŋne bahuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: “No ere hâcne ŋazapo, ʒâhec warekac e bâbâni juwec, eki no mi fuahape juwarehuc juwec hâcne.”
Nâŋe sasawa ere rowaŋkonec miti kadahe rorâ ro ehuc jumbeŋ.
Mose e sâcmutâc dâŋ nârewec, â Jesu Kristo eki ine aki anonoc â dâŋ fâri qizecne tahac‐nâpowec.
Anutu e ŋic moczi moc mi honewec, Ŋokâ jâmbâŋ mocjaha, Mamacte bufuŋko juekaczi ine biŋe‐ticne bawaharâ mufua‐nârewec.
Jerusalem haeonec Judaŋic jaŋe taha bapa â taha ufuŋte kiŋaŋŋic sorec‐jopapie Johanerao rarâ, go mo ŋic mo, muhuc wiocnepie fuŋne‐ticne jazawec.
E fuŋne‐ticne mi hesoŋkehuc mutaniŋkerâ kecʒiŋuc jazawec: “No Kristo aricne.”
Mume jaŋe harierâ wiocnembiŋ, “Eme go mo, go Elia me?” Eme muwec, “No e aricne.” Eme mumbiŋ, “Go porofete‐nâŋec me?” Mupie muwec, “Aricne.”
Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Wiac go mo? Sorec‐nâpopie warembeneŋ, ra weniŋuc jazanaŋmu? Go gahacnere weniŋuc muekic?”
Eme jazarâ muwec: “Porofete Jesajazi mu qâreŋ ewec, i norao sanaŋkekac. No biŋe mumu ŋic, mâreŋ tuhuo juhuc kecʒiŋuc muekopac: ‘Wofuŋte hata bâʒâweniŋ.’”
Ŋic Johanerao fisimbiŋ i jaŋe farisaio jaŋere guruonec.
Irec mocwâc indiŋkerâ mumbiŋ: “Go Kristo aricne, â Elia aricne, â porofete aricne, eme wemocte ŋic Miti Opâ rua‐jareekic?”
Mupie Johanezi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Noni ŋic opâ sawa rua‐jareekopac, â ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko moc fuawec jukac, ŋoŋe e mi hone taraeŋgopieŋ,
eki hâcne râpefuŋ‐naneo warehuc jukac, e sâko no iŋucne maczi mafahe decnepe mi sâckeocmu.”
Wiac i Betania haeo Jordaŋ ocniŋucnao fuawec. Ira hâcne Johanezi juhuc ŋic Miti Opâ rua‐jarewec.
Hae fureme Jesuzi Johanerao rame taicko honerâ ŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Honeniŋ, kecocni Anuture lama, eki mâreŋ sâc ŋic sâqocne‐jeŋic fainao feme âsickekac.
Ere hâcne kecʒiŋuc ŋazapo: ‘Ʒâhec warekac, e bâbâni juwec, eki no mi fuahape juwarewec.’
No nahac mârâc e mi hone tarapo. Israe ŋic ŋoŋe biŋe‐ticne ŋazape mananiŋte hâcne fisirâ Miti Opâ fuŋkepo.”
Johane e iŋuc murâ muwec: “No Mârozi hapâ hawario sambâŋkonec waharâ fai‐ticnao herâ ŋeme honepo.
No nahac mârâc mi hone tarahape Miti Opâre munareweczi ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Mâro waharâ fai‐ticnao herâ ŋeme honecmu eki ŋic Tiri Mâro rua‐jareocmu.’
No i hâcne honepore fuŋne‐ticne kecʒiŋuc mupo: ‘Eki hâcne Anuture Ŋokâ.’”
Hae fureme Johane erâ motecfâcne jaŋeraonec jajahec mâreŋ ijaha domambiŋ.
Domahapie Jesu e ijaha fotâcneme honerâ motec jasarâ muwec: “Honenic, Anuture lama kecocni.”
Mume jahe dâŋ i manarâ Jesure râpefuŋko rapic.
Rapire Jesuzi forisierâ honec‐jofarâ muwec: “Ŋohe wemocte warekopirec?” Eme jahe mupic: “Rabi (nâŋâcne dâŋko: Qaqazu), go fic wena jukomec?”
Eme ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ware honenic.” Mume jahe bâjâperâ fic honerâ ʒoaŋ gie bapa ira juweckoa jupic. I ʒoaŋ otewezo eha iŋuc epic.
Johanere dâŋ manarâ Jesu bâjâpepic moc ʒâŋene Anderea, Simoŋ Petoro ɋaticne.
Eme eki biac hahac‐ticne Simoŋ bâfuarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Nâhe Mesia (Kristo hâcne) bâfuakoperec.”
Iŋuc murâ Jesurao jowame rapic. Eme Jesuzi honerâ muwec: “Go Simoŋ, Johanere ŋokâ, gore ʒâŋe Kefa mukopac” (nâŋâcne dâŋko: Haroŋaŋ).
Hae fureme Jesu e Galilaia mâreŋko raocte ʒawierâ Filipo bâfuarâ âzâcnewec, “Go bâjâpecnuc.”
Filipo e Besaida haeonec, Anderea â Petoro jahe hae irecteaŋ.
Eme Filipozi Natanae bâfuarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mose e sâcmutâc dâŋqâhâcko findaŋdâŋ‐ticne qâreŋkewec, â porofete jaŋe wâc qâreŋkembiŋ, ŋic e hâcne bâfuaŋgopeneŋ, Jesu, Josefere ŋokâ, Nazarete haeonec.”
Eme Natanaezi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Nazarete haeonec wemo wiac bipinehec fuaocmu?” Mume Filipozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Murâ ware honec.”
Eme Natanaezi Jesurao ra fisime honerâ muwec, “Honeniŋ, ŋic kecizi Israe ŋic fârine, maŋticnao sioc moc mi fokac.”
Iŋuc mume Natanaezi wiocnerâ muwec: “Go wena jupe honecnumeŋ?” Eme Jesuzi muwec, “Filipozi mi hefârecguhame nemuja fuŋko ŋetec honecgupac.”
Mume Natanaezi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Qaqazu, go jâmbomac Anuture Ŋokâ, Israe ŋic nâŋere ŋicwofuŋ.”
Eme Jesuzi muwec: “Nemuja fuŋko ŋemec i mufua‐garepe manasiŋnukomec, manakic, hone manac ekomec ʒi susucne sawa, fâri ombâŋne miŋecnea hone manac erahuc jucmu.”
Iŋuc murâ muwec, “No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazape: Ŋoŋe sambâŋ aŋkeme Anuture aŋelofâc jaŋe Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne erao fec wahac epie honec‐jopaniŋmu.”
Gie bapa jajahec tarame Kana haeo Galilaia mâreŋko ŋic ŋokac jajahec muturec‐jofaniŋte irec tiwâ bâzi qapie fisiwec.
Ehuc Jesu neŋgoc‐ticne erâ e jahacne â motecfâc‐ticne mâmâc hefârec‐jopapie fisimbiŋ.
Eme tumaŋnerâ bâzihec waiŋ nâpie ʒickeme Jesu neŋgoc‐ticnezi e âzâcnerâ muwec: “Waiŋ‐jeŋic omaekac.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋokac, i nâhâcne wiac me? Dameŋ‐nane miŋecnea maickeocmu.”
Eme neŋgoc‐ticnezi kiŋaŋ qaqa ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wiac mocte ŋazame enʒepieŋ.”
Eme fic ira opâ pake 6 ŋewec. Judaŋic jaŋe me sahac‐jeŋic gâbâ ʒure jumbieŋte fic sâc opâ pake iŋuc ŋerawec. Pake i piticne mâcne, kâcɋene sâko.
Eme Jesuzi kiŋaŋ qaqa ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe opâ fiarâ pakeo qapie huoc.” Eme jaŋe iŋuc erâ opâ qapie hurâ pake micnao qafârewec.
Iŋuc epie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe tucne fiarâ nânâ soŋaŋtao baraniŋ.”
Eme jaŋe fiarâ barahapie opâzi waiŋ eme nânâ soŋaŋzi nâhonerâ kâuc bawec. Kiŋaŋ motec opâ fiarâ pakeo qapie huwec jaŋe sawazi waiŋte fuŋne mana tarambiŋ. Eme nânâ soŋaŋzi ŋic ŋokac bawec, e hefârerâ
ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Qanaŋ waiŋ aŋacne gumec‐jopapene nâkupie maŋjeŋic bibiriwazo eme ʒâhec waiŋ oomane gumec‐jopaeŋgopeneŋ, hata‐nâŋec iŋuc fokac. Go ine qac qâtikic ehuc aŋacne hefacketec ŋeku ʒâhec fuakac.”
Jesu e Kana haeo Galilaia mâreŋko ira hâcne mâsi bapa gie‐ticne fuŋkehuc Wofuŋ qâreŋ‐ticnere foŋ bararuŋkewec. Eme motecfâcne jaŋe i honerâ e manasiŋkembiŋ.
Eme Jesu e Kana haeonec Kafanaum haeo rame neŋgoc ɋafâc‐ticne â motecfâc‐ticne mâmâc bâjâperâ rafârembiŋ. Eme ira boc mi jumbiŋ.
Judaŋic aakic hombaŋ‐jeŋic bembeŋkewecte Jesuzi Jerusalem haeo rafewec.
Eme taha ufuŋ ʒuhucnao lama bulimakao â hapâ wiac badomahuc nareŋ gareŋ embiŋ, ehuc irec moneŋ teboo wose biric embiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Jesuzi honec‐joparâ repa mizeme ʒika eme ŋic mecne lama bulimakao mecne jâpec‐jopame wisepie moneŋ tie‐jarerâ irec tebo herândiŋkewec.
Erâ hapâ badomambiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe Mamac‐nanere ficko wiac kosa mi epie situâc fic ezejec.”
Jesu e iŋuc eme motecfâcne jaŋe miti papiao dâŋqâreŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac irec manasumbiŋ: “Gore ficte erâ bunane ʒoc ʒarâ ʒâfitacnukac.”
Eme Judaŋic jaŋe wiocnerâ mumbiŋ: “Go iŋuc ekomeczi wemo mâsi moc bahuc fuŋnege bataniŋke‐nârecmu?”
Eme micjeŋicko rorâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe taha ufuŋ kecʒi heropiepie noni ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha mocwâc bâzickepemu.”
Iŋuc muhuc jazame mumbiŋ, “Kâcɋenefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe taha ufuŋ ʒi jara 46 baku bâzickembiŋ, eme goki ʒoaŋ jahec â moc sawa ira bâzickezo mukomec me?”
Jesu eki ine sahac‐ticnere ufuŋko ɋetickehuc muwec.
Juku hâmockonec ɋârerâ fahareme motecfâcne jaŋe dâŋ i manasumbiŋ. Ehuc ufuŋte muwec, â miti papiao ere dâŋ gâcne mukicne, irec mâmâc manapie fârine eha mana ʒakiembiŋ.
Jesu e aakic hombaŋko Jerusalem haeo juhuc fuŋne qaqa mâsi bame ŋic bocjahazi honerâ ʒâŋe‐ticne mana sakac embiŋ.
Jesu e jahac ine ŋic hone tarac‐jopa‐fârewecte jaŋerao mi fohorewec.
E ŋic mocte fuŋne manaocte gâcne mu indiŋ mi ejarewec, e jahaczia ŋic maŋjeŋic hone ʒâŋitac ejare‐fârewec.
Farisaio ŋic jaŋere âgo moc juwec ʒâŋene Nikodemo. E Judaŋic jaŋere micne sâko wâc juwec.
Ŋic eki hâcne Jesu ŋafeo iqickerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Qaqazu, nâŋe fuŋnege manaeŋgopeneŋ, go qaqazu fârinezi Anuturaonec wahameŋ, go mâsi baekic i ŋic moczi Anutu tâmiric juhuc bapane mi ekac.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ gazape: Moc e harierâ fufua ɋâricne mi fuaocmuzi Anuture uucmaŋ sâcne mi bâfuaocmu.”
Eme Nikodemozi muwec, “Hâc, moc e kâcɋeŋkekicnezi fufua ɋâricne weniŋuc fuaocmu, wemocko neŋgoc bumaŋko mocwâc hume hâsine roocmu?”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ gazape: Moc e Opâ â Mârore kiwecko ɋâricne mi fuakicnezi Anuture uucmaŋko sâcne mi raʒiocmu.
Ŋickiwecko fuakicnezi ŋic hawari jaha, Mârore kiwecko fuakicnezi Mârore hawari jaha.
Ŋoŋe fufua ɋâricne fuaniŋte mupe go manatec mi quŋkeoc.
Mâŋâŋ e kosa qaekac, eme go fânâŋ‐ticne i manaekic, â fuŋne wenirec fuŋkerâ wareekac, â wena rataraekac, ine mi manaekic. Eme moc e Mârore kiwecko fuakicne, e fuŋne‐ticne iŋucnea fokac.”
Mume Nikodemozi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “I weniŋuc erâ iŋuc ezo?”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Israe ŋic jaŋere qaqazuzi irec kâuc bakomec me?
No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ gazape: Nâŋe wiac hone manac eeŋgopeneŋ ijaha ŋaza mutâc eeŋgopeneŋ, eme ŋoŋe ine dâŋnâŋec qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ.
Wiac mâreŋko fufuane irec mac ŋazape sifu mi mana ʒakieeŋgopieŋ, eme wiac sambâŋko fufuane irec ŋazape wemo‐ŋeŋiczi mana ʒakieniŋmu?
Ŋic moczi sambâŋko moc mi fewec, Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne, sambâŋkonec wahawec, e mocjahazi sambâŋko wâc juekac.
“Mose e mârâc jaha mâreŋ sawao homa bâfeŋnewec, iŋuc jaha Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e bâfeŋnezo mukicne.
Eme e manasiŋkeniŋmu jaŋe juju sanaŋ bâfuaniŋmu.
Anutu e ŋic ŋoŋere mo iŋucne ecnewecte Ŋokâ jâmbâŋ‐ticne mocjaha e râe qikiŋ ecnewec. Eme e manasiŋkeniŋmu jaŋe moc mi sipirickehuc juju sanaŋ bâfuaniŋmu.
Ŋokâ e ŋic jaŋere kiŋ bataraocte mâcne, ŋic bâpiaŋ‐jopaocte Anutuzi soreme wahawec.
Moc e Ŋokâ manasiŋkekaczi okacnere biŋe mi ekac. Â moc e Ŋokâ mi manasiŋkekaczi ine biac okacnere biŋe ekac. Wemocte? E Anuture Ŋokâ jâmbâŋ mocjaha ere ʒâŋe mana maŋ mi ekac irec.
Okacnere fuŋne ʒiŋuc fokac: Tatamaczi ŋic maic‐jopame jaŋe tatamac bâsuerâ dapâcte wosâembiŋ, juju bapa‐jeŋic sâqocnere iŋuc hâcne embiŋ.
Moc e sindaŋ eocmuzi tatamac râpeckeocmu, juju bapa‐ticnere fuŋne jaŋgeŋkezacte wemocko tatamacko fua taniŋ eocmu.
Moc e dâŋ fâri qizecne reŋkeocmuzi ine tatamac maickeocmu, eme eebapa‐ticne Anuture micdâŋte sâcko ekicne irec fuŋne taniŋkeocmu.”
Eme juku Jesu e motecfâcne rocjopame Jerusalem hae beherâ Judaia qaŋeŋnaopec ra jumbiŋ. Ira jaŋehec juhuc ŋic opâ rua‐jarewec.
Johane e mâreŋ moc ʒâŋene Ainoŋ, Salim haeopec juhuc iŋuc jaha Miti Opâ gie bawec, ira opâ bocjaha fowecte ŋic jaŋe fisipie rua‐jarewec.
Johane e dameŋ ira kâpâcwâru ficko mi râekicne.
Eme Judaŋic moczi Johane motecfâc‐ticne jaŋehec opâ ruruare mu qaqatarac embiŋ.
Eme motec jaŋe Johanerao rarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Qaqazu, go Jordaŋ ocniŋucnao juhaŋtecne ŋic moc bâfuacgume fuŋne‐ticne mujaŋgeŋkerâ nâzâmeŋ, eki dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ŋic opâ rua‐jareme erao rafâreŋgopieŋ.”
Mupie Johanezi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋic moc e sambâŋ runezi wiac râcne tahac mi ehame e jahac wemocko kâŋgâc roocmu.
No kecʒiŋuc muhuc ŋazapo i wemocko mickeniŋmu, ‘No Kristo aricne, no biŋe mumu‐ticne sawa.’
Ŋokac biŋe mucnekicne eki hâcne ŋokac rune. Eme ŋokac bahuc ʒeri kâcɋene ʒeri eme âgo‐ticnezi manarâ bafickehuc bubiaŋ sâko bâfuaocmu wâc. Bubiaŋ i hâcne manapemurâ dameŋne maickekac ʒi.
Eki fua fehame noni pitiwazepac.
Faicnec wahaweczi qâhuc‐nâpo‐fârekac. Moc e mâreŋkonec fuakicnezi mâreŋte biŋe ekac â mâreŋkopec dâŋ muekac. Â sambâŋkonec wahaweczi ine qâhuc‐nâpo‐fârekac.
Eki wiac hone manac ewec irec dâŋ biŋe muekac. Mume ine ŋic jaŋe dâŋticne qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ.
Â dâŋticne mana maŋ ekac e Anutu mume sasanaŋ jukac dâŋ i dopeckekac.
Anutuzi ŋic sorewec eki Anuture dâŋ jaha muekac. Ŋic iŋucne e Anutuzi Mâro sâc tâmiric qikiŋnecneekac.
Mamac e Ŋokâ hone ririŋkehuc ere meo wiac sasawa râe‐fârewec.
Moc e Ŋokâ manasiŋkeocmu e juju sanaŋ ʒiŋuczia fuacnekac, â moc e Ŋokâre dâŋ bâsuehuc juocmuzi juju sanaŋ mi bâfuaocmu. Iŋucnere faio Anuture kimbeŋ feweczi foocmu.”
Farisaio jaŋe Jesure ʒiŋuc manambiŋ: “Eki motec rocjoparâ opâ rua‐jareekac, i Johanere gurufâc jowaruŋgopieŋ.”
Dâŋ i mâc mumbiŋ, Jesu e jahac ŋic opâ mi rua‐jarewec, motec jaŋe mume rua‐jarembiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi dâŋ iŋucne manarâ Judaia mâreŋ beherâ Galilaia mâreŋko risie rawec.
Rahuc Samaria mâreŋ fotâcnewec.
Fotâcnehuc Samariare hae moc ʒâŋene Sika ira fisiwec. Hae i Jakobozi ŋokâ‐ticne Josefe mâreŋ qikiŋnecnewec irec mendâŋko ŋewec.
Eme ijaha Jakobore opâ nombâŋ fowec wâc. Eme Jesu e ira guŋpiticko fisirâ betaŋkerâ nombâŋmecko waha ŋemanawec.
Ŋehame Samaria ŋokac moczi opâ fiaocte fisiwec. Fisime Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go opâ moc gumecnuc.”
Motecfâcne jaŋe nânâ furine baniŋte haeo fehapie Jesu buc ŋehuc ŋokac opâre âzâcnewec.
Âzâcneme ŋokac e muwec, “Go Judaŋiczi weniŋuc erâ Samaria ŋokac norao opâre mukic?” Judaŋic â Samaria ŋic jaŋe bâtâcko jujumbieŋte ŋokac e iŋuc muwec.
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Anutu jauŋ‐ticnere fuŋne â opâre gazakopac nore fuŋne mâmâc kâuc bakic. Mana tararâ muzac numu‐naretec opâ fifisine garezapo.”
Mume ŋokaczi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Bomboŋ, opâ nombâŋ i ʒoricne, erâ go opâ fifiage aricnere opâ fifisine wenirec fiacmu?
Mimiŋne‐nâŋec Jakobo e opâ nombâŋ ʒi rowec. Erâ e jahacne â ŋokâfâcne â lama bulimakaofâc‐ticne jaŋe opâ ʒi jaha nâhuc jumbiŋ. Goki Jakobore sâc i jâuruhuc opâ moc bâfuacmu?”
Iŋuc mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Opâ ʒi gapecne tâmiric, irec i hati nârâ nâ ehuc juzo,
â nore opâ ine gapecnehec, moc e i nâocmu, e opâre mocwâc mi hâmohuc mâc juraʒihuc juocmu. Noni opâ i ŋic moc râcnepe maŋticnao opâ ʒâŋe bâfuacneme juju sanaŋte ʒâkâŋko rahuc domaocmu.”
Mume ŋokaczi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Bomboŋ, go opâ i naretec nârâ opâre mocwâc mi hâmozepac, ehuc ʒira gâbâ ware fiahuc domaekopac i behezepac.”
Iŋuc mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ra ŋowege jowatec warenic.”
Eme ŋokaczi muwec, “No ŋowe‐nane aricne.” Mume Jesuzi muwec, “Go ŋowege aricne, i sâcne mukomec;
go ŋic memoc ba behec ejaremeŋ, â ʒiŋuczia bakomec e gore ŋowe aricne, irec go dâŋ jâmbomac mukomec.”
Mume ŋokaczi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋicbomboŋ‐nane, no miŋecne manakopac, go porofete.
Irec mutec manape: Kâcɋenefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe tiki kecʒira Anutu mai ecne jumbieŋ, â Judaŋic ŋoŋe ine Jerusalem haeoa Anutu mai ecnezo, iŋuc mueŋgopieŋ.”
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋokac, no gazape manac: Dameŋ moc bembeŋkekac, i maickeme ŋoŋe Mamac mai ecneniŋmu i tiki kecʒira mâcne â Jerusalem haeo wâc mi eniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe kâuc bahuc mai ecneeŋgopieŋ, nâŋe ine mana tarahuc mai ecneeŋgopeneŋ. Bâbâpiaŋ i Judaŋic nâŋeraonec.
Dameŋ moc maickeocmu erâ ʒi biac maickekac hâcne, ira kikefuŋfâc‐ticne fârine jaŋe maŋzi â dâŋ fâri qizecnere sâcko Mamac mai ecneniŋmu. Mamac e ŋic iŋucne jaŋere ecneekac.
Anutu e Mâro fuŋgâtâne, irec e mai ecneeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe Mâro â dâŋ fâri qizec jahere ŋesiŋko mai ecnenʒepieŋ.”
Mume ŋokaczi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No manakopac, Mesia fuaocte mukicne, ʒâŋene moc Kristo, eki fuarâ wiac sasawa mu bataniŋ enâreocmu.”
Eme Jesuzi âzâcnewec: “Dâŋ gazakopac, no hâcne ʒi.”
Iŋuc muhame motecfâcne fisimbiŋ. Fisirâ ŋokachec muc manac ewec irec wareckembiŋ. Erâ wemo wiacte dâŋ âzâcnekomec, me weniŋucte âzâcnekomec, iŋuc muhuc wiocneniŋte manapie quŋkeme behembiŋ.
Eme ŋokac e opâ râqâc‐ticne beherâ haeo gasacke rarâ ŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Ŋoŋe warerâ ŋic moc honeniŋ, eki epo bapo irec dâŋ mutaniŋke‐nare‐fârekac. E Kristo wiac moc?”
Eme haeonec waharâ Jesurao fisi‐fârembiŋ.
Eme motec jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Qaqazu, nânâ nâc.”
Mupie jazawec, “Nânâ fuŋmoc fonarekac, i ŋoŋe mi manaŋgopieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume motec jaŋackoaŋ nazaŋ gazaŋ erâ mumbiŋ: “Moczi moc nânâ bafisirâ râcnembieŋ me?”
Mupie muwec, “Sorecnuwec ere mic reŋkehuc gie‐ticne baku babatara izi nânâ‐nane ekac.
Ŋaŋac ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: ‘Mosa 4 tarame nânâ fârine fuaocmu.’ Â noni ine ŋazape mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe qâhâŋnerâ ʒâŋe fihuc gie honeniŋ, nânâ fârine fufua dameŋ ʒine hâcne maickekac.
Ro qânusuc gie baocmuzi furine roocmu, â fârinezi juju sanaŋte biŋe eocmu. Eme he sarac ewec â fârine rome fewec jahe mâmâc babafic erâ ʒeri enicmu.
Ehame dâŋ kecʒi sanaŋkeocmu: ‘Moczi he sarac eekac, â moczi fârine rome feekac.’
Noni ŋoŋe he sarac mi embiŋko fârine ropie feocte sorec‐ŋopakopac. Gie i gâcnezi bapie fuawec eme ŋoŋe mâc rauckeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme Samaria ŋokac e haefâc‐ticne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Wiac epo bapo i mutaniŋke‐nare‐fârejec.” Eme dâŋ irec bocjahazi Jesu manasiŋkembiŋ.
Irec Jesurao fisirâ jaŋehec juocte hefârembiŋ. Eme Jesuzi mana‐jarerâ ʒoaŋ gie bapa jajahec jaŋere haeo juwec.
Eme miti jazame bocjaha jâmbâŋzi mana ʒakiembiŋ.
Ehuc ŋokac ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Qanaŋ gore dâŋ binaŋte erâ manasiŋkembeneŋ, ʒi ine nâŋe nâŋâc micticnaonec dâŋ manarâ ʒiŋuc manapaŋkeŋgopeneŋ: Eki jâmbomac mâreŋ sâc ŋic nâŋâcne Bâbâpiaŋ.”
Eme Jesu e jaŋehec gie bapa jajahec jurâ Galilaia mâreŋko rawec.
Jesu e jahac qanaŋ ʒiŋuc mufuawec: “Porofete moc e jahacne hae mâreŋko jume sâcne mi sâseniŋmu.”
Eme Galilaia mâreŋko rafisime Galilaia ŋic jaŋe âgo ecnembiŋ. Ine jaŋe juwicnao mâmâc Jerusalem haeo rarâ aakic hombaŋko gie bame honembiŋte iŋuc ecnembiŋ.
Eme Kana haeo Galilaia mâreŋko mârâc mume opâzi waiŋ ewec ira hâcne mocwâc risiewec. Eme Kafanaum haeo kia moc juwec, e ŋokâ‐ticne hucsâko bame fowec.
Eme Jesu e Judaia mâreŋkonec risierâ Galilaia mâreŋko mocwâc ware fisikac, iŋuc mupie manarâ kia e Kana haeo Jesurao rarâ ŋokâ‐ticne hâmozo ehuc fowec irec jowame ranicte numucnewec.
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋoŋe mâsi â wiac ʒâŋe furu‐ŋeŋic sawa honerâ dâŋnane mana ʒakieeŋgopieŋ.”
Eme ŋiczi muwec: “Wofuŋ, ŋokâ‐nane hâmozacte biac fâzemec.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go mâc rac, ŋokâge ɋiɋic qakac.” Eme ŋic e Jesure dâŋ mana ʒakiehuc risie rawec.
Ehame motec jaŋe kiŋaŋ warerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ŋokâge ɋiɋic qajec jukac.”
Mupie ɋiɋic qawec dameŋ irec mu indiŋ ejareme mumbiŋ: “Jacne ʒoaŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋ ŋehame ira hucticne âke niniŋkejec.”
Iŋuc mupie ŋiczi fuŋne kecʒiŋuc manawec: Dameŋ ira hâcne Wofuŋzi sorecnuhuc mujec, “Ŋokâge ɋiɋic qakac.” Eme e jahacne â garikiŋfâc‐ticne Jesu manasiŋke‐fârembiŋ.
Jesu e Judaia mâreŋkonec Galilaia mâreŋko risierâ fuŋne qaqa mâsi i bame jajahec ewec.
Juku Judaŋic jaŋere hombaŋ sâko moc maickeme Jesu e Jerusalem haeo rafewec.
