Eme Jerusalem haeo Lama Motâcko riqic moc ŋewec ʒâŋene Betesida. Ere mecnao fic memoc ŋerawec.
Fic ira ŋic huchec â tiŋtuŋ â ʒeke puriŋ â soc kekereŋhec bocjaha fombiŋ, [ehuc opâ qiriŋ qaocte woŋeckembiŋ;
Wofuŋte aŋelo moczi dameŋ ocŋondeŋ sâc riqicko waharâ opâ qâuawec; qâuahame moczi bâbâni opâo huwec e huc ecnewec i niniŋkecneme ɋiɋic qawec.]
Eme moc fowec e puriŋ ecnehuc juhame jara 38 ewec.
Eme Jesuzi ŋic e honerâ dameŋ ʒora fohuc jukac, iŋuc manarâ wiocnerâ muwec: “Go ɋiɋic qacmurâ egarekac me?”
Eme puriŋzi muwec, “Bomboŋ, mo ŋic mo junarekaczi opâ qiriŋ qaha riqicko râecnuzac? Â no nahac huzo mupe ine moczi biac âkehocnurâ huekac.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go faharerâ fofoge rorâ rac.”
Mume izia sahac‐ticne biaŋkeme faharerâ fofo‐ticne ameckerâ rawec. Ʒoaŋ ira ine sabata hombaŋ ŋembiŋ.
Irec Judaŋic jaŋe ŋic ɋiɋic qawec e ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Miŋecgac hombaŋko fofoge hâpokomec i mi eene.”
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Bâpiaŋnukaczi ʒiŋuc naza sorec ekac: ‘Fofoge rorâ rac.’”
Mume wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Fofoge rorâ rac gazajec ŋic e ʒâŋene mo?”
Mupie ŋic biaŋkeweczi kâuc bawec. Jesu e ŋicguru ira domambiŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko kamierâ rawec.
Izi ʒâhec Jesuzi ŋic e taha ufuŋko bâfuarâ uŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go sahacge biaŋkejec, eme wiac ŋemâc bâmâcne jâmbâŋ fua‐garezacte sâqocne mocwâc mi bazemec.”
Eme ŋic e Jesu hone tararâ ra Judaŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋic bâpiaŋnukac ʒâŋene Jesu.”
Jesu e sabata hombaŋko gie iŋucne bawecte Judaŋic jaŋe râsi ecnembiŋ.
Epie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Mamac‐nane e gie ʒuʒuhuc jaha baekac, eme noni iŋuc jaha wâc eekopac.”
Eme Jesu e sabata hombaŋ hesifuckewec â Anuture Mamac‐nane muhuc Anuture sâcko ʒuhuckewec, Judaŋic jaŋe wiac jajahec irec erâ mana gâpârerâ qaniŋte mumbiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazape mananiŋ, Ŋokâzi maŋticnere sâcne gie mi baekac, Mamaczi bame sâc honehuc baekac. Eki baekac ijaha Ŋokâzi baekac.
Mamac e Ŋokâ honebâckeekacte gie baekac sâc jâutu‐fâreekac, erâ gie ʒi honeŋgopieŋ sawa mâcne, fekicne sâko jâutume ŋoŋe honerâ wareckeniŋmu.
Mamac e hâmokicne wiwic‐joparâ bâɋârec‐jopaekac, iŋuc jaha Ŋokâzi e me e bâɋârezo murâ bâɋâreocmu.
Erâ Mamac e ŋic okacnere dâŋ mi mutara‐jareekac, gie i Ŋokâre meo râewec.
Eme ŋic jaŋe Mamac sâseeŋgopieŋ iŋuc jaha Ŋokâ sâsenʒepieŋ. Moc e Ŋokâ mi sâseocmuzi, Ŋokâ sorewec, Mamac hâcne, e iŋuc jaha mi sâseocmu.
No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazape mananiŋ: Moczi nore dâŋ mana maŋ ehuc, sorecnuwec e manasiŋkeocmu, ŋic e ʒiŋuczia juju sanaŋhec ekac. E okacnere biŋe mi ee hâmoc râpeckerâ jujuo raʒiwec jukac hâcne.
No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazape mananiŋ: Dameŋ moc maickeocmu, erâ ʒi biac maickekac hâcne, ira hâmokicnezi Anutu Ŋokâ‐ticne ere dâŋ manarâ ɋârerâ juniŋmu.
Mamac e jujure fuŋqizecne, eme Ŋokâ e iŋuc jaha jujure fuŋqizecne eocte qikiŋnecnewec.
Erâ e Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne jukacte ŋic okacnere dâŋ mutara‐jareocte mucnewec.
Dâŋ irec manapie mi quŋkezejec. Dameŋ moc bakicne fokac i maickeme ʒâŋeruŋko foeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ere dâŋ wiwira manarâ wefunʒoŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc juju biaŋne jumbiŋzi juju sanaŋte faharenʒoŋgopieŋ, â juju sâqocne jumbiŋzi kiŋte okacne roniŋte faharenʒoŋgopieŋ.
No nahacne maŋte gie i bapane mi fokac, Mamac‐nanere micsâcko sawa okacnere dâŋ mutara‐jareekopac. Iŋuc ehuc okacnere gie bape sâckoa eocmu. I no nahacne dâŋ mâcne, sorecnuwec ere dâŋ ʒaeckeekopac.
“No nahac fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkepe fârimâc eocmu.
Fuŋne‐nane i moczi mutaniŋkeocmu, erâ no manakopac, fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkeme fârine eocmu.
Ŋoŋe Johane mu indiŋ ecnepie dâŋ fâri qizecne mutaniŋkewec.
Erâ ŋiczi fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkeniŋte ine mi muekopac, ŋoŋe fuŋne‐nane manarâ jujure hata âteniŋte irec mâc ŋaŋacnere muekopac.
Johane e jâmbomac lambe sâko erâ tamae‐ŋarewec. Ehame ŋoŋe mâc ʒâziriŋne nacbembeŋ hone aŋac ehuc jumbiŋ sawa.
“Â nore fuŋne mutaniŋkeekac, e Johane iŋucne mâcne, e sâc moc. Mamac gie munarewec, gie irec fârine bâfuape ine Mamaczi sorecnume wahapo irec fuŋne taniŋkeekac.
Mamac sorecnuwec eki hâcne fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkewec. Ŋoŋe ine e jahacne mickonec dâŋ mi manambiŋ â hawarine wâc mi honembiŋ.
Erâ ŋoŋe dâŋticne maŋŋeŋicko sâcne mi râepie fohuc juekac. Ŋic sorewec ere dâŋ qikiŋnehuc wemocko iŋuc eniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe miti papiao kecʒiŋuc muhuc wose gufuc eeŋgopieŋ: Juju sanaŋ ira hâcne soŋkekicne. Erâ izi hâcne nore fuŋne mufuaekac.
Eme ŋoŋe norao juhuc juju sanaŋhec ee i sifu qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ.
“No ŋiczi sahac mumuteŋ wiac enareniŋte irec mi muekopac.
Ŋoŋere fuŋne ine jâmbomac manaekopac, maŋŋeŋic Anuturea mi domaekac.
No Mamac‐nanere micte ŋoŋerao wahapo, eme ŋoŋe sifu âgo mi enareeŋgopieŋ. Juku ŋic moc e e jahacne maŋte fisime ine âgo ecneniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe ŋaŋaczia mumuteŋ eec ehuc Anutu qâqâhâc sâko ere mumuteŋte mi eŋareekaczi wemocko mamanasiŋhec eniŋmu?
Ŋoŋe nore ʒiŋuc mi munʒepieŋ: Eki Mamactao dâŋnâŋec mugâpâre‐nâreocmu. Iŋuc mâcne, ŋoŋe ŋic moctao roweckeeŋgopieŋ, Mose hâcne, eki mugâpâre‐ŋareocmu.
Mose e dâŋ qâreŋkewec i nore qâreŋkewec. Eme ŋoŋe ere dâŋ mana ʒakierâ muzac nore mâmâc mana ʒakienʒapiŋ.
Mosere dâŋqâreŋ qikiŋnehuc nore dâŋ wemocko mana ʒakieniŋmu?”
Jesu e dâŋ i mufârerâ Galilaia riqic, Tiberia riqic hâcne, fotâcnerâ ocniŋucnao raʒiwec.
Raʒime ŋic ŋokac bocjahazi huc ʒâichec ɋiɋicne bacjopame honembiŋte bâjâpembiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi motecfâcne rocjopame tikio ferâ ŋembiŋ.
Dameŋ ira Judaŋic aakic hombaŋ‐jeŋic bembeŋkewec.
Eme Jesuzi ʒâŋe firâ ŋic guru sâko fisipie honec‐joparâ Filipo wiocnerâ muwec, “Poroŋ wenirec furine barâ i sâko gumec‐jopapene sâcjopaocmu?”
E wiac eocte manasume foha mâc esâickewec.
Eme Filipozi ʒiŋuc muwec: “20 kinazi poroŋ furine barâ gumec‐jopapene mâc hesâsâc‐jopaocmu.”
Mume motecfâcne jaŋeraonec moc, Anderea, Simoŋ Petorore ɋa, eki ʒiŋuc muwec:
“Ʒira motec moc jukac eki poroŋ memoc â opâ qowi jajahec bajukac, erâ ŋic guru sâko jâmbâŋte keci mac izi wemo ezo?”
Eme Jesuzi muwec, “Ŋoŋe ŋic ejarepie qâzuckerâ waha ŋeniŋ.” Eme mâreŋ ira kecɋaŋ fowec i toma âterâ ŋic 5 tauseŋ qâririŋ iŋuczi waha ŋerambiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi poroŋ rorâ daŋge murâ ŋic ŋerambiŋ jaŋe bâtâc bajarewec â qowi iŋuc jaha mupie sâc jarewec.
Nârâ gapec‐jopame Jesuzi motecfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Tiwâne forâ sipirickezacte nuseniŋ.”
Eme jaŋe poroŋ memoc irec tiwâne nusepie sasac 12 hurâ fusewec.
Eme ŋic jaŋe fuŋne qaqa mâsi i hone manac erâ mumbiŋ, “Porofete sâko mâreŋko fuaocte mukicne, ʒine hâcne jâmbâŋ.”
Eme jaŋe Jesu orâŋkerâ mezi rorâ ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic âkendâŋnezo ehapie hone tarac‐joparâ behec‐joparâ e jahackoaŋ tikio fewec.
Hae owâeme motecfâcne jaŋe riqicmecko humbiŋ.
Hurâ Kafanaum haeo risie raniŋte wokeo fembiŋ. Erâ hae dapâc eme Jesu juhame buc rambiŋ.
Ehuc mâŋâŋ sanaŋne domame siri kâcɋene qame rambiŋ.
Jaŋe kilometa 4 me 5 irec sâc rakuhapie Jesuzi riqic faio âte âte rarâ woke bâqiŋkeme honerâ fâfârembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie wira‐jarerâ muwec: “Nahac fâkopac, mi hâwic‐ŋopaoc.”
Eme wokeo ropie feocte ehapie izia woke mâreŋ razo mumbiŋko fisiwec.
Ŋic guru sâko jaŋe riqic ocniŋucnao fohapie hae furewec. Hae fureme ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Jacne ŋafeo woke mocsâkoa ŋeme honembeneŋ, ira motecfâcne Jesu beherâ buc ferâ rambieŋ.”
Iŋuc manahuc ŋehapie Tiberia haeonec woke gâcne Wofuŋzi daŋge murâ poroŋ gumec‐jopawecko ware fisimbiŋ.
Eme ŋic jaŋe Jesu e jahacne â motecfâcne basac‐joparâ wokeo ferâ Kafanaum haeo risie rarâ ira basambiŋ.
Riqic ʒiŋucnao basaku bâfuarâ mumbiŋ, “Qaqazu, go wezimucne waremec?”
Wiocnepie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ mupe mananiŋ, ŋoŋe fuŋne qaqa mâsi bape honeeŋgopieŋ irec mâcne, nânâ gumec‐ŋopape nâ gapec embieŋ, irec basacnuŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe gie banʒepieŋ, erâ nânâ sisirowenere mâcne, juju sanaŋte nânâ irec giene banʒepieŋ. Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne eki, Anutu Mamaczi kamac sarahuc âkendâŋnewecte, juju sanaŋte nânâ i sâcne ŋareocmu.”
Mume dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ: “Nâŋe weniŋuc erâ Anuture gie banaŋmu?”
Eme ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋic sorewec e manasiŋkezo, izi Anuture gie biŋe‐ŋeŋic ekac.”
Mume dâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Mo fuŋne qaqa mâsi mo batec honerâ manasiŋgunaŋmu? Mo gie mo bacmu?
Mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mâreŋ sawao mana nâjumbieŋ. Eme irec dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc fokac: ‘Sambâŋkonec nânâ jareme nâjumbieŋ.’”
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Jâmbomac jâmbâŋ mupe mananiŋ: Mose e sambâŋkonec nânâ mi bâfua‐ŋarewec, Mamac‐nanezi sambâŋkonec nânâ fârine ŋareekac hâcne.
Nânâ sambâŋkonec waharâ mâreŋŋic juju bâfua‐ŋareekac izi Anuturaonec nânâ fârine ekac.”
Mume ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Wofuŋ, go nânâ mukic i dameŋ sâc nârezemec.”
Eme ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Jujure nânâ no hâcne. Moc e norao qohotaocmu e nânâre moc mi hâmoocmu, â moc e no manasiŋnuocmu e opâre moc mi hâmoocmu.
No ine ŋazape, ŋoŋe no honecnu‐bipiehuc sifu mi manasiŋnueŋgopieŋ.
Mamaczi nareekac i jaŋe norao fisi‐fâreniŋmu, â norao fisiocmu e mi bâsuepemu.
Sambâŋkonec wahapo i no nahacne micdâŋ dopeckepemurâ mâcne, sorecnuwec ere micdâŋ dopeckepemurâ wahapo.
Mamac‐nanezi norao râec‐jopaekac ŋic i jaŋe sipirickenʒipiŋte hone qâzuc ejareku dameŋ sâkoo furu jaha wiwic‐jopape faharenʒoŋgopieŋ; sorecnuwec ere micdâŋ iŋuc hâcne fokac.
Ŋokâ hone dendeŋnehuc manasiŋkeniŋmu sâc juju sanaŋ rauckeniŋmu; Mamac‐nanere micdâŋ iŋuc hâcne fokac. Eme noni dameŋ sâkoo bâɋârec‐jopazokopac.”
Jesu e “sambâŋkeonec nânâ no hâcne” iŋuc muwecte Judaŋic jaŋe mana sâqorecnehuc dâŋembiŋ.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Wiac Jesu e Josefere ŋokâ, neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne i nâŋe honec‐jofaeŋgopeneŋ. Eme wemocte ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘No sambâŋkonec wahapo’?”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazarâ muwec: “Ŋoŋe boc mi manapie sâqorezejec.
Ŋic moc e jahacne maŋte norao fifisi i mi fokac, Mamac sorecnuwec eki fâreme fifisine ine fokac. Eme noni ŋic iŋucne e dameŋ sâkoo bâɋârezokopac.
Porofete jaŋere dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc fokac: ‘Anutu e jahac ŋic sasawa miti jaza qazuc eocmu.’ Irec moc e Mamaczi miti âzâcne qazuc eme manaocmu e norao fisiocmu.
Ŋic moczi moc Mamac honewec i mi fokac, Anuturaonec wahawec e mocjahazi Mamac honewec.
No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazape mananiŋ: Moc e no manasiŋnuocmuzi juju sanaŋhec eocmu.
Jujure nânâ no hâcne.
Mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mâreŋ sawao mana nâipiehuc hâmo‐fârembiŋ.
Â sambâŋkonec nânâ nârâ mi hâhâmo ine norao fokac ʒi.
Jujure nânâ sambâŋkonec wahakicne no nahacne hâcne. Irec moc e noraonec nânâ nârâ juraʒihuc juocmu sanaŋ. Biuc‐nanezi nânâ ekac, i ŋiczi juju bâfuaniŋte ŋarepemu.”
Eme Judaŋic jaŋaczia mu qaqatarac erâ mumbiŋ, “E weniŋuc erâ biuc‐ticne nâreme nanaŋmurâ mukac?”
Epie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazakopac, ŋoŋe Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne ere biuc â soc mi nâniŋmuo maŋŋeŋicko juju mi fuaocmu.
Moc e nore biuc â soc nâocmuzi juju sanaŋhec eocmu, eme noni dameŋ sâkoo bâɋârezokopac.
Nore biuc izi nânâ fârine, â nore soc izi opâ fârine.
Nore biuc â soc nâocmuzi no maŋnuocmu a noni e maŋkepemu.
Mamac e juju runezi sorecnume wahapore Mamacte erâ juekopac, eme no nâcnuocmuzi iŋuc jaha nore erâ juocmu.
Sambâŋkonec nânâ irec fuŋne iŋuc fokac. I mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic nâmbiŋ iŋucne mâcne. Jaŋe nâipiehuc hâmombiŋ. Â nore nânâ ʒi nâocmu e ine juraʒihuc juocmu sanaŋ.”
Jesu e Kafanaum haeo mitificko juhuc dâŋ i jaza qazuc ewec.
Kikefuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec bocjahazi dâŋ i manarâ mumbiŋ, “Dâŋ kecʒi manapene ququŋkenehec ekac, i mozi manaocmu?”
Eme mu takic embiŋ i Jesu e maŋticnezi manarâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Dâŋ i manapie sâqorekac me?
Eme Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋnezi mârâc juweckoa risie feme manapie weniŋuc eocmu?
Sahacte biuczi juju bâbâfua i mi fokac, juju bâbâfua i Mârore gie. No dâŋ ŋazaekopac i Mârohec â jujuhec.
Eme ŋoŋeraonec tucnezi ine mana maŋ mi eeŋgopieŋ.” Jesu e miti‐ticne qikiŋneniŋmu jaŋe mârâcko mana tarac‐jopawec, â doc baocmu e mâmâc mana tarawec, irec dâŋ iŋuc jazawec.
Erâ dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “No irec hâcne kecʒiŋuc ŋazapac: Moc e Mamaczi mi baafeckeha norao fisirâ jujune mi fokac.”
Eme dameŋ ira kikefuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec bocjahazi jume jujure takic‐jopame râpeckembiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi motec fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne 12 indiŋ‐joparâ muwec, “Ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha râpecnuzo muŋgopieŋ me?”
Mume Simoŋ Petorozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋ, go behecgurâ moc morao ranaŋmu? Go mocjahazi juju sanaŋte dâŋ bajuekic.
Nâŋe go manasiŋguhuc ʒiŋuc mana‐gareeŋgopeneŋ: Go Anuture Tiriŋic hâcne.”
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No motec ŋoŋe 12 rowosâec‐ŋopapo. Eme wemocte ŋoŋeraonec moczi Sataŋ ekac?”
E Juda Simoŋte ŋokâ Karioto haeonec ere manasuhuc iŋuc muwec. E motec 12 jaŋere guruoneczi hâcne juku ʒâhecko Jesu doc bawec.
Jerusalem haeonec Judaŋic jaŋe Jesu qaniŋte dâŋ qacnepie Judaia mâreŋ‐jeŋic qikiŋnerâ Galilaia mâreŋko sawa rac warec ehuc juwec.
Ehuc juhame Judaŋic rehac boze hombaŋ‐jeŋic bembeŋkewec.
Ehame qafâc‐ticne ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Go ʒawierâ Judaia mâreŋko rarâ, ʒira mâsi wiac baekic i ocna batec kikefuŋfâcge jaŋe honenʒepieŋ.
Mozi fua tâcnezo murâ soŋsoŋ juhuc gie baocmu? Go gie iŋucne bazo muekicte ra ŋicguruo fua taniŋkerâ batec honeniŋ me!”
Ɋafâc‐ticne jaŋe e mi manasiŋkehuc iŋuc mumbiŋ.
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe dameŋ kosao wiac ezo murâ sâcne eniŋmu, no ine dameŋ‐nane mi maickekac.
Ŋic jaŋe ŋoŋe wemocko qaisoc‐ŋopaniŋmu, no ine juju bapa‐jeŋic sâqocne i mutaniŋkepe qaisocnueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe hombaŋko raniŋ, no ine dameŋ‐nane mi maickekacte ʒiŋuczia mi rapemu.”
Iŋuc murâ Galilaia mâreŋkoa juwec.
Eme jaŋe bânierâ rahapie e ʒâhecko buc kamierâ rawec.
Eme hombaŋ maickeme Judaŋic micne jaŋe basarâ wiwioc erâ mumbiŋ, “E wena jukac?”
Â ŋic omane sâko jaŋe ere dâŋ bocjaha mufembiŋ. Ehuc gâcnezi mumbiŋ, “E ŋic biaŋne,” â gâcnezi qatararâ mumbiŋ, “Aricne, e ŋic maŋ bâsifuc ejareekac.”
Erâ Judaŋic micne jaŋere hâwic‐jopame dâŋ tâtâcko mi mumbiŋ.
Eme hombaŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋko Jesu e taha ufuŋko ferâ miti jaza qazuc ewec.
Miti mume Judaŋic micne jaŋe wareckerâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “E nâŋâcne mamana ficko mi juweczi weniŋuc erâ mitire fuŋne manaekac?”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No mitire fuŋne qazu‐ŋareekopac i no nahacne mâcne, i sorecnuwec ere.
Eme mitire fuŋne kecʒi i Anuturaonec me no nahacnaonec, i Anutu micne reŋkehuc mana tarazo.
Moc e jahacnaonec manasurâ muocmu, e sahac mumuteŋte hata âteocmu, â moc e gie runere mumuteŋ fuaocte gie baocmu, ere ine sahac fefe tâmiric siocmâc jukac muzo.
Mose e sâcmutâc dâŋ mufua‐ŋarewec. Â ŋoŋeraonec moczi moc mi reŋkeekac. Eme ŋoŋe wemo wiacte nuzo muŋgopieŋ?”
Mume ŋic omane sâko jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Go demoŋzi maŋge bâsifuckekac. Mozi guzo mukac?”
Eme Jesuzi jazawec, “No mâsi mocjaha bapo irec erâ mu warec boc eeŋgopieŋ.
Mupe mananiŋ: Mosezi motecfâc‐ŋeŋic sahac‐jeŋicko ma baniŋte muŋarewec. Erâ i Mosezi mi fuŋkewec, mimiŋne jaŋe fuŋkembiŋ. Eme gie i bapane maickeme sabata hombaŋko wâc baeŋgopieŋ.
Ine hâcne Mosere sâcmutâc dâŋ huckepie fârimâc ezacte hombaŋko motecfâc‐ŋeŋic sahac tofa‐jeŋicko gie i baeŋgopieŋ, â no ine ŋicpuriŋ sahac‐ticne furu jaha hombaŋko bâpiaŋkepo, irec wemocte mana gâpâre‐nareŋgopieŋ?
Ŋoŋe dâŋ onʒoŋ jaha sahacne mi muniŋ, mana wosâehuc dâŋ fârine munʒapiŋ me!”
Eme Jerusalem hae rune jaŋe ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋic qazo mueŋgopieŋ ine hâcne ʒi.
Hâc, e weniŋuc erâ dâŋ tâtâcko mume micnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mi qataracneŋgopieŋ? Me jaŋe fuŋne‐ticne mana tarahuc manacnepie Kristo ekac mecne?
Erâ iŋuc wâc mâcne mecne. E fufua‐ticnere fuŋne manaŋgopeneŋ. Kristo wareocmu ine ere fuŋne kâuc bafârenaŋmu.”
Jesu e taha ufuŋko miti qazu‐jarehuc domahame iŋuc mupie hahaŋne bahuc muwec, “Oi ŋoŋe, mana taracnurâ fufua‐nanere fuŋne manaeŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe hâcne. Wahapo i no nahacne maŋte mi wahapo, jâmbomac rune moc jukac eki sorecnume wahapo. Ŋoŋe e kâuc baŋgopieŋ.
No ine e jahacne bufuŋkonec sorecnume wahapore e mana tarakopac.”
Iŋuc mume kâpâcwâru baniŋte mumbiŋ. Erâ dameŋ‐ticne mi maickewecte mejeŋic mâckeme behembiŋ.
Ehame ŋic omane jaŋeraonec bocjahazi fuŋkerâ Jesu manasiŋkembiŋ. Ehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Kristo fisiocmu, e ŋic ʒizi mâsi baekac i sirickehuc baocmu me? Aricne, e bafâreekac.”
Ŋic jaŋe dâŋ iŋucne kamierâ mupie farisaio jaŋe manarâ taha bapa micne jaŋehec nazaŋ gazaŋ erâ momori jaŋe Jesu kâpâcwâru baniŋte sorec‐jopapie rambiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi ŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No dameŋ bembeŋne sawa ŋoŋehec jurâ sorecnuwec erao risiepemu.
Eme ŋoŋe no basacnu‐bipiehuc mi bâfuacnuniŋmu. Ra jupemu ira wemocko fâniŋmu.”
Iŋuc mume Judaŋic jaŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc nazaŋ gazaŋ embiŋ: “E wena rame basa‐bipienaŋte mukac? Judaŋic âgofâc‐nâŋec Grik mâreŋko juraŋgopieŋ jaŋerao raocte mukac, ehuc Grik miti jazaocte manasuhuc mukac?
Basacnu‐bipiehuc mi bâfuacnuniŋmu, â rapemu ira sâcne mi fâniŋmu, dâŋ iŋucne weniŋucte mukac?”
Judaŋic jaŋe hombaŋ botâŋne ŋetaraniŋte tutumaŋ sâko ehuc ŋehapie Jesuzi faharerâ domahuc dâŋ wiwic jaha ʒiŋuc muwec: “Moc e opâre hâmokacko norao warerâ nâzejec.
Â moc e manasiŋnuhuc juocmu ere bumaŋkonec opâ sâro fifisine wahahuc domaocmu. Miti papiao dâŋ iŋuc hâcne qâreŋkekicne.”
Jesu manasiŋkembiŋ jaŋe Mâro biŋe qajarehuc iŋuc muwec. Jesu e dameŋ ira sambâŋ eri tatamac‐ticnere maŋnao mi risie fewecte Mâro mi wahawec.
Ŋic jaŋe dâŋ i manarâ Jesure ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “E jâmbomac porofete sâko‐nâŋec.”
Â gâcnezi mumbiŋ, “E Kristo jâmbâŋ.” Mupie tucnezi qatararâ mumbiŋ, “Wiac Kristo e wemocko Galilaia mâreŋkonec fuaocmu.
Tiri Papiao dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukicne: Kristo e Dawidire haefuŋ Betelehem ira oso gitecfâc‐ticne jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec fuaocmu.”
Ŋic jaŋe Jesure iŋuc muhuc fâuckembiŋ.
Eme gâcnezi kâpâcwâru baniŋte murâ mejeŋic mâckeme behembiŋ.
Eme momori jaŋe taha bapa micne â farisaio jaŋerao risiepie wio‐jarerâ mumbiŋ: “Ŋoŋe wemocte mi rorâ bawareŋgopieŋ?”
Wiopie momori jaŋe mumbiŋ, “E dâŋ muekac, iŋucne ŋic gâcnezi mumune mi fokac.”
Mupie farisaio ŋic jaŋe ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Me, ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha maŋ bâsifuc eŋarejec?
Soŋaŋ kâcqene â farisaio ŋic nâŋeraonec moczi erao moc qohotac me?
I aricne i, ŋic omane guru, sâcmutâc dâŋ mi mamana jaŋe sawa, hârâcte biŋe jaŋe hâcne.”
Eme âgo‐jeŋic moc Nikodemo, mârâc Jesu iqickewec, eki ine ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Ŋoŋe muniŋ, ŋic moc fuŋne‐ticne mi manahuc â kiŋticne mi honehuc okacnere dâŋ mâc mumutarane, iŋuc ezore sâcmutâc papia‐nâŋecko moc qâreŋkekicne fokac me?”
Eme âgofâcne jaŋe ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Eme go iŋuc jaha Galilaia mâreŋkonec me? Wose gufuc eku ʒiŋuc manacmu: Galilaia mâreŋkonec porofete fufuane mi fokac.”[
Eme jaŋe râwiŋnerâ ficjeŋic sâc rafârembiŋ.
Jesu e Oliwa tikio fewec.
Hae fureme irecnec risierâ taha ufuŋko feme ŋic jaŋe erao mâretec tumaŋnembiŋ. Eme ira ŋehuc miti jaza qazuc ewec.
Ehame miti qaqazu â farisaio ŋic jaŋe ŋokac moc boe sau ehuc juhame bâfuakicne e Jesurao bararâ
mumbiŋ, “Qaqazu, ŋokac kecʒi boe sau ehuc juhame bâfuakicne.
Eme Mose e ŋokac iŋucne qânâzi hehâmoc‐jopazore sâcmutâc dâŋko munârewec. Gahac ine weniŋuc mukic?”
I mâc esâickepie dâŋ iŋuc me iŋuc mume dâŋko râeniŋte fecnehuc mumbiŋ. Mupie Jesu e daperâ mâreŋko mezi qâreŋkewec.
Qâreŋkehame wiocnerâ wiocne epie qâhâŋnerâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋeraonec moc bahac tâmiric juekaczi fuŋkerâ qânâzi heme henʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ mocwâc daperâ mâreŋko qâreŋkewec.
Ehame jaŋe dâŋticne manarâ micnezi bânieme moc moc raku rafârembiŋ. Eme ŋokac e Jesure maŋfuŋko buc domame,
Jesuzi qâhâŋnerâ wiocnerâ muwec: “Ŋokac, jaŋe wena? Moczi moc okacnere dâŋ mi mugarejec me?”
Eme ŋokazi muwec, “Wofuŋ, aricne.” Mume muwec, “Eme noni iŋuc jaha okacnere dâŋ mi mugarepemu. Go mâc ra juhuc sâqocne mocwâc mi bazemec.”]
Eme Jesuzi ŋic dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ jazawec: “No mâreŋ sâc ŋic ŋoŋere ʒoctamac. Eme moc e no bâjâpecnuocmuzi dapâcko mi rahuc juocmu. E jujure tatamac focnehame juocmu.”
Iŋuc mume farisaio ŋic jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ʒi go gahac fuŋnege mutaniŋkekomec, i manapene fârine mi ekac.”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No nahac fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkepe irec fârimâc mi eekac. No wenirec warepo â wena rapemu irec fuŋne manahuc dâŋ muekopac. Ŋoŋe ine irec â irec mâmâc kâuc baeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe fuŋne riritu gie baeŋgopieŋ i sasahac eekac. No ine fuŋne riritu gie mi baekopac.
Me fuŋne riritu gie bapemuo ine fârinehec eocmu. No fuŋne riritu gie buc bapane mi fokac. Mamac sorecnuwec eki baficnume bapane fokac.
Eme sâcmutâc dâŋŋeŋicko kecʒiŋuc fokac: ‘Ŋic jajaheczi mocte fuŋne ritupire fârine muzo.’
Eme no fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkehape Mamac sorecnuwec eki iŋuc jaha mutaniŋkeekac.”
Dâŋ iŋuc jazame wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Mamacge wena?” Eme ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe no mi mana taracnuhuc Mamac‐nane iŋuc jaha mi mana taraeŋgopieŋ, no mana taracnurâ muzac, Mamac‐nane iŋuc jaha mana taranʒapiŋ.”
Jesu e ufuŋko taha katapa ŋewec maŋne ira miti jaza qazuc ehuc dâŋ i muwec. Eme dameŋ‐ticne mi maickewecte wemocko afeckerâ kâpâcwâru banʒapiŋ.
Eme Jesu e harierâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No behec‐ŋopa rape ŋoŋe basacnurâ sâqocne‐ŋeŋichec juku hâmoniŋmu. No ra jupemu ira wemocko fâniŋmu.”
Iŋuc mume Judaŋic jaŋe mumbiŋ, “‘No ra jupemu ira wemocko fâniŋmu’, iŋuc wemocte mukac? Sahac‐ticne qarâ hâmoocte mukac me weniŋuc?”
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe juwickonec, no faickonec, ŋoŋe mâreŋkonec, no mâreŋkonec mâcne.
No irec hâcne ŋazakopac: Ŋoŋe sâqocne‐ŋeŋichec juku hâmoniŋmu. No jukopac ʒi fuŋne‐nane ŋazaekopac i mi mana ʒakieniŋmuo, sâqocne‐ŋeŋic foŋarehame hâmoniŋmu hâcne.”
Mume wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Eme go mo?” Mupie Jesuzi jazawec, “Ŋazaekopac i jâmbâŋ hâcne.
No ŋoŋere bahac â kiŋdâŋ bocjaha bajuekopac. Sorecnuwec eki dâŋ fârine muekac, eme noni micticnaonec manapo ijaha ʒira mâreŋko mufuaekopac.”
Mamac‐ticnere iŋuc jazame jaŋe mi mana tarambiŋ.
Irec Jesuzi ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne bâfeŋnerâ fuŋne‐ticne mana taraniŋmu. Erâ no nahacne maŋte wiac mi eekopac, Mamaczi qazu‐narewec dâŋ ijaha muekopac, i wâc mana taraniŋmu.
Sorecnuwec e nohec juekac. No dameŋ sâc wiac epe bape maname biaŋkeekacte no mi behecnuekac.”
Dâŋ iŋuc mume ŋic bocjahazi manasiŋkembiŋ.
Eme e manasiŋkembiŋ Judaŋic jaŋe hâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe nore dâŋko juhuc ine motec fuŋfuŋfâc‐nane eniŋmu.
Eme nore dâŋ fâri qizecne mana tarapie izi batarac‐ŋopame niŋgiŋ tâmiric sâcne erâ juniŋmu.”
Mume dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ: “Nâŋe Abrahamte ɋâricfâc, mozi mo kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne bacnâporâ niŋgiŋ‐nâpowecte go ʒiŋuc mukomec: ‘Niŋgiŋ tâmiric eniŋmu’?”
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazakopac, moc e sâqocne baocmuzi sâqocnere kiŋaŋ qaqa eocmu.
Kiŋaŋ qaqazi bomboŋ‐ticnere fic haeoa hati mi jurâ ju eocmu, ŋokâzi ine mamac‐ticnere fic haeo hati juraʒihuc juocmu.
Irec Ŋokâ eki firuec‐ŋopame ŋoŋe jâmbomac niŋgiŋ tâmiric juniŋmu.
“Ŋoŋe Abrahamte ɋâricfâc, i noni manakopac. Eme ŋoŋe ine dâŋnanezi ŋoŋerao hesowariekacte qâhâmocnuzo muŋgopieŋ.
No Mamac‐nanerao wiac honehuc jupo irec hâcne muekopac, â ŋoŋe ine ŋaŋacne mamactaonec wiac manambiŋ i eeŋgopieŋ.”
Mume ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Nâŋe mamac‐nâŋec Abraham.” Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe Abrahamte ɋâricfâc jurâ muzac e hawari enʒapiŋ.
Anuturao dâŋ fâri qizecne manapo i ŋazaekopac, ehame ŋoŋe nuzo muŋgopieŋ. Wiac iŋucne Abrahamzi mi ewec.
Ŋoŋe ine ŋaŋacne maŋte hata âteeŋgopieŋ.” Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Nâŋe fiuckonec mi fuambeŋ, Anutu e Mamac‐nâŋec mocjaha.”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Mamac‐ŋeŋic Anutu eme muzac, no âgo enarenʒapiŋ. No Anuturaonec hâcne wahapo, no nahacne maŋte mi wahapo, eki sorecnume wahapo.
Weniŋuc erâ jupie dâŋnanezi maŋŋeŋicko mi huekac? No dâŋ mupe ŋoŋe hazec afec mi manaeŋgopieŋ irec hâcne.
Ŋoŋe mamac‐ŋeŋic Sataŋ, eme ere qafeŋko wiac eeŋgopieŋ. E mârâc jaha ŋic sisipiric juweczi juwareekac. E dâŋ fâri qizecne râpeckewecte maŋticnao jâmbomac dâŋ moc mi fokac. E bureczi nânâ opâ‐ticne ewec. E burecŋic â burecte mamac.
No ine dâŋ fâri qizecne ŋazaekopacte dâŋnane qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋeraonec moczi sâcne nore bahac moc muocmu? Eme no sâc iŋucnezi dâŋ fâri qizecne ŋazape wemocte mi mana ʒakieeŋgopieŋ?
Moc e Anuture biŋe juocmuzi dâŋticne manaocmu. Ŋoŋe Anuture biŋe mi jueŋgopieŋte dâŋticne qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ.”
Mume Judaŋic jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ: “Wiac wemo mueŋgopeneŋ, go Samaria ŋic, go demoŋzi egareekac.”
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No demoŋzi mi enareekac, no Mamac‐nane sâseekopac, ŋoŋe ine no ba jawa enareeŋgopieŋ.
No ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanere manabâc erâ mi ŋazakopac. Ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane hewirickerâ irec dâŋne mumu ine mocte gie.
No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazape mananiŋ: Moc e nore dâŋ bajuocmuzi hâmoc moc mi maicke‐jâmbâŋkeocmu.”
Iŋuc mume Judaŋic jaŋe kecʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Demoŋzi egareekac, i jâmbomac. Abraham hâmowec, â porofete jaŋe iŋuc jaha hâmombiŋ, ehame go ʒiŋuc mukic: ‘Moc e nore dâŋ bajuocmuzi hâmoc moc mi maickeocmu.’
Mamac‐nâŋec Abraham e sâkozi hâmowec, eme go ere sâc jâuruzo mukomec? Â porofete jaŋe iŋuc jaha wâc hâmombiŋ. Go wemocte sahacge boc bafekomec?”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No nahac sahac‐nane bafepe mi sâckeocmu. Mamac‐nane jukac, e Anutu‐nâŋec mucneeŋgopieŋ, eki ine muafecnuekac.
Ŋoŋe e mi mana taraeŋgopieŋ, no ine mana taraekopac. Irec no weniŋuc mi mana tarakopac mupemu. I mupe burec eme ŋoŋere sâc ezapo. Aricne, no mana tarahuc dâŋticne bajuekopac.
Mamac‐ŋeŋic Abraham e nore ʒâfo maickeme honeocte aŋac sâko bajuwec. Erâ juku maickeme honerâ ʒeri ewec.”
Iŋuc mume Judaŋic jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Go jarage 50 mi bazumeŋzi Abraham honemeŋ me?”
Mupie Jesuzi jazawec: “No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazape: No Abraham mi fuarâ juhame jupozi jukopac.”
Iŋuc mume qânâ rorâ hezo epie e fosiroŋnerâ taha ufuŋkonec wahawec.
Jesu e hata rahuc ŋic moc neŋgoc bumaŋkonec tiŋtuŋ fuakicne e bâfuawec.
Eme motecfâcne jaŋe wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Qaqazu, more kiŋte tiŋtuŋ fuawec, e jahacne me neŋgoc mamac jahere?”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Irec aricne, e jahacne kiŋte me neŋgoc mamac jahere kiŋte mâcne, Anutu tâpiri‐ticnere fuŋne erao taniŋkeocte iŋuc fuawec.
Nâŋâc sorecnuwec ere gie ʒoaŋkoa bahuc junʒepeneŋ, ŋafe fuame gie bapane arictac eocmu.
No mâreŋko jupemu sâc ʒoctamac‐nanezi âke tamae‐ŋareocmu.”
Iŋuc murâ mâreŋko tâfeckerâ afe jârickerâ ŋic tiŋtuŋ ʒâŋene ruacnerâ
ʒiŋuc muhuc sorewec: “Go rarâ Siloam riqicko wânâŋge ʒurec.” (Siloam i nâŋâcne dâŋko sorekicne.) Eme ŋic e rarâ sahac‐ticne ʒurehuc ʒâŋe fitâcnewec.
Iŋuc erâ risieme âgofâc‐ticne jaŋe, â nânâre numu‐jarehuc juwec ŋic i jaŋe mâmâc honerâ wiwioc erâ mumbiŋ: “Nânâre numu‐nârehuc ŋeŋerâ juekac e hâcne me?”
Eme tucnezi mumbiŋ, “Ine hâcne.” Â tucnezi mumbiŋ, “Aricne, e tinac moc.” Iŋuc mupie e jahac muwec, “No hâcne ʒi.”
Eme wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Weniŋuc erâ ʒâŋe fitâcnekomec?”
Eme jazawec, “Ŋic moc ʒâŋene Jesu eki afe jârickerâ ʒâŋe‐nane ruacnerâ ʒiŋuc nazajec: ‘Go Siloam riqicko rarâ sahacge ʒurec.’ Eme no rarâ sahac‐nane ʒurerâ ʒâŋe fifi epac.”
Iŋuc mume wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Ŋic e wena jukac?” Eme muwec, “No mi manakopac.”
Eme ŋic tiŋtuŋ ecnewec e farisaio jaŋerao jowa rambiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi afe jârickerâ ʒâŋene bâtâcnewec i sabata hombaŋko ewec.
Eme farisaio ŋic jaŋe iŋuc jaha wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Go weniŋuc erâ ʒâŋe fifi emec?” Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “E ʒâŋe‐nane afe ruacneme no ra sahac‐nane ʒurerâ ʒâŋe fifi epac.”
Eme farisaio jaŋeraonec gâcnezi mumbiŋ, “Ŋic e Anuturaonec aricne, e hombaŋ‐nâŋec qâsuakac.” Gâcnezi ine mumbiŋ, “E hehesic juhuc muzac mâsi iŋucne wemocko bazac.” Iŋuc muhuc qaqatarac embiŋ.
Ehuc ŋic tiŋtuŋ ecnewec e indiŋkerâ mumbiŋ, “Ʒâŋege bâtâcnejec, gahac ere weniŋuc mukic?” Eme muwec, “E porofete.”
Eme Judaŋic jaŋe ŋic e jâmbomac ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ juku ʒâŋe fifi ejec, iŋuc muhuc maŋjahec erâ neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne hefârec‐jofarâ
wio‐jacterâ mumbiŋ: “Ŋokâ‐ŋekic tiŋtuŋ fuawec mukopirec ʒine hâcne? E weniŋuc erâ ʒâŋe fifi ejec?”
Eme neŋgoc mamac jahecne ʒiŋuc mupic: “E ŋokâ‐nâhec, i manakoperec, â tiŋtuŋ fuawec, i wâc manakoperec.
Erâ weniŋuc erâ ʒâŋe fifi ejec, me mozi ʒâŋene bâtâcnejec, ine mi manakoperec. Wiac e soka‐fârekicne, irec e jahacne wiocnepie fuŋne‐ticne ŋazaoc.”
I Judaŋic jaŋere hâwic‐jofame iŋuc mupic. Jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc mujomirembiŋ: “Moc e Jesure Kristo mume miti sakarecnenʒepeneŋ.”
Irec hâcne neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne hâwic‐jofame ʒiŋuc mupic: “E soka tarakicnere e jahacne wiocneniŋ.”
Eme ŋic ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ ecnewec e mocwâc hefârerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Go Anutu muteŋkehuc dâŋenʒaŋ, nâŋe ŋic ere fuŋne manaŋgopeneŋ, e hehesicne.”
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “E ŋic hehesicne me mâcne, i mi manakopac. Â tiŋtuŋ jupozi ʒâŋe fifi epac, ine mana‐jâmbâŋkekopac.”
Mume harierâ wiocnembiŋ, “Weniŋuc egarejec, weniŋuc erâ ʒâŋege bâtâcnejec?”
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No ŋazapac i, ŋoŋe ine mi manambieŋ; wemocte hâsine ŋazape mananiŋte muŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe motecfâcne ezo muŋgopieŋ me?”
Iŋuc mume haneckerâ mumbiŋ, “Go hâcne motec‐ticne, nâŋe ine Mosere motecfâc.
Mose e Anutuzi dâŋ âzâcnewec, i manaŋgopeneŋ, â ŋic e irec me irec fuarâ warewec ine mi manaŋgopeneŋ.”
Mupie ŋiczi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarewec: “Ʒâŋe‐nane bâtâcnejec ere fufuare kâuc bapie warec‐ŋopakopac.
Nâŋâc kecʒiŋuc manaeŋgopeneŋ: Anutu e ŋic hehesicne mi bafic‐jopaekac, moc e araŋ bacnehuc micne reŋkeme bafickeocmu.
Â ŋic moczi tiŋtuŋ fuakicne moc ʒâŋe fifi bawec, biŋe iŋucne mâreŋ fufuaonecteaŋ moc mi mana wefukicne.
Irec ŋic e Anuturaonec mi waharâ muzac, gie iŋucne wemocko bazac.”
Mume ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Sâqoc qaqocne fuakicne go iŋucnezi miti qazu‐nârekomec me?” Iŋuc murâ tuŋkembiŋ.
Tuŋkepie Jesuzi manawec. Erâ bâfuarâ wiocnerâ muwec, “Go Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e manasiŋkekomec?”
Eme ŋiczi muwec, “Wofuŋ go mukomec e mo? Nowatutec hone tararâ manasiŋkepe.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Â go honemec, dâŋ gazakopac no hâcne ine.”
Eme ŋiczi muwec, “Wofuŋ, no manasiŋgukopac”, iŋuc murâ kikefuŋnao fodapewec.
Eme Jesuzi muwec, “No ŋic fuŋne‐ŋeŋic bajaŋgeŋkepemurâ mâreŋko wahapo. Eme irec tiŋtuŋzi ʒâŋe fifi enʒepieŋ â ʒâŋe fifizi tiŋtuŋ enʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume farisaio ŋic mâmâc domambiŋ jaŋe manarâ mumbiŋ, “Â nâŋe tiŋtuŋ me?”
Mupie Jesuzi jazawec: “Ŋoŋe tiŋtuŋ jurâ muzac kiŋ tâmiric enʒapiŋ. Ŋaŋac mueŋgopieŋ, ‘Nâŋe ʒâŋe fifi’, irec kiŋ foŋareocmu.”
Jesuzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: “No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazape mananiŋ, moc e lama jaŋere sapao feocte motâcko mi raʒihuc mocko sac huckerâ huocmu, ere fiuc roro â soroŋ qaqa muzo.
Moc e motâcko raʒirâ feocmu, ere ine lama soŋaŋ‐jeŋic muzo.
E fisime motâc soŋaŋzi honerâ motâc rocneocmu â lama jaŋe dâŋ hawari‐ticne mananiŋmu. Eme lamafâc‐ticne jaŋere ʒâŋe wirahuc sapaonec jowac‐jopa wahaocmu.
E jahacne biŋefâc jowac‐jopa‐fâreme waharâ, dâŋ hawari‐ticne manaeŋgopieŋte bâjâpeniŋmu.
Ŋic furune moc e ine mi bâjâpeniŋmu, e dâŋ hawari‐ticne kâuc bahuc hâhâwic bacnerâ wiseniŋmu.”
Jesu e dâŋ suŋsuŋne iŋuc mume jaŋe weniŋucte iŋuc mukac muhuc kâuc bambiŋ.
Eme Jesu e harierâ jazawec, “Jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazape mananiŋ, lama jaŋerao fefe irec motâc no.
No mi fuahape fuambiŋ jaŋe ine fiuc roro â soroŋ qaqa. Irec lama jaŋe dâŋjeŋic mi manambiŋ.
Motâc no hâcne. Moc e fotâcnurâ raʒiocmu, e mi sipirickeocmu. E raʒic wefuc ehuc nânâ mâriri bâfuaocmu.
Fiuc roro e lama qa sipiric erâ fiuc bawiseocte sawa fisiekac. No ine lama jaŋe juhâc qâhâmoniŋte nânâ bâfuape ɋaŋɋaŋ ɋâriaŋ fojareocte fisipo.
“No soŋaŋ biaŋne. Soŋaŋ biaŋnezi lama jaŋere erâ juju‐ticne qikiŋneocmu.
Soŋaŋ jabane, lama rujeŋic mi juekaczi ine kâte qâto fisime honerâ lama behec‐joparâ wiseocmu. Ehame kâte qâtozi lama ki bâtâtiec ejareocmu.
E soŋaŋ jabanere lama jaŋere manabâc mi eocmu.
No ine soŋaŋ biaŋne juekopac, eme Mamac â no hohonec mamanac eekoperec,
irec sâcko no â gurufâc‐nane hohonec mamanac eeŋgopeneŋ. Irec no lama jaŋere erâ juju‐nane qikiŋnepemu.
No lamafâc‐nane guru moc juŋgopieŋ, jaŋe sapa ʒirecnec mâcne, eme no jaŋe wâc mâmâc amec‐jopa warepe dâŋnane mananiŋmu. Eme lamazi guru mocjaha â soŋaŋzi wâc mocjaha iŋuc fuaocmu.
No juju‐nane qikiŋnerâ mocwâc ropemu, irec Mamaczi nore ecneekac.
Juju‐nane moczi mi nowac roocmu, i no nahacne maŋte qikiŋnepemu. No juju‐nane qikiŋnepemurâ â ropemurâ irec tâpiri mâmâc fonarekac. Iŋuc epemurâ Mamac‐nanezi munarewec.”
Jesu e dâŋ iŋuc mume Judaŋic jaŋe manarâ mocwâc mu qaqatarac embiŋ.
Ehuc bocjahazi ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “E demoŋzi ecneme maŋne sifuckekac, dâŋ mume wemocte manahuc juŋgopieŋ.”
Gâcnezi ine ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Demoŋheczi dâŋ iŋucne mi muocmu, me demoŋ moczi ŋic tiŋtuŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe sâcne bâtâcneocmu me?”
Judaŋic taha ufuŋ jambuŋkembiŋ irec jara hombaŋ i mâmâteŋ dameŋko maickeme
Jesu e taha ufuŋ irec maŋne moc ʒâŋene Salomo ira rac warec ehuc juhame
Judaŋic jaŋe orâŋkerâ ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Go wemocte fuŋnege hesoŋketec maŋjahec boc eeŋgopeneŋ? Go Kristo jukomecko mutaniŋkerâ nâzâc me!”
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No ŋazape mi mana ʒakieeŋgopieŋ. Mamac‐nanere micte gie baekopac izi mutaniŋnuekac.
Â ŋoŋe ine lamafâc‐nane mi erâ juŋgopieŋte dâŋnane mi mana ʒakieeŋgopieŋ.
Lamafâc‐nane erâ juŋgopieŋ jaŋe dâŋnane manaengopieŋ. Eme noni mana tarac‐jopahape bâjâpecnueŋgopieŋ.
Eme juju sanaŋ bâfua‐jarepe sisipiric tâmiric juraʒihuc juniŋmu. Jaŋe nore meonec moczi babatarac‐jopane mi fokac.
Mamac‐nanezi norao râec‐jopawec e ŋic â wiac sasawa qâhuc‐jopa‐fârekac. Eme jaŋe moczi Mamac‐nanere meonec sâcne mi batarac‐jopaocmu.
No â Mamac nâhe mocjaha.”
Iŋuc mume Judaŋic jaŋe qânâ ameckerâ hezo embiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Gie biaŋne fuŋne fuŋne Mamacte ŋesiŋko bape honembieŋ, eme ŋoŋe wenimo irec qânâzi hecnuzo eŋgopieŋ?”
Eme Judaŋic jaŋe micnao rorâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Gie biaŋne baekic irec mâcne, go ŋic jaha juekiczi Anutu âkehockehuc gahacnere Anutu muekic, irec qânâzi hecguzo muŋgopeneŋ.”
Iŋuc mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Sâcmutâc dâŋŋeŋicko ʒiŋuc mukicne: ‘Noni mupo, ŋoŋe nemu’.
Eme mitire dâŋqâreŋ i âke sipuhuc moc mumune mi fokac. Erâ Anuture dâŋ fua‐jare jujec iŋucne mac jaŋe nemu mujarewec.
Ehame ʒi ine no Mamaczi mutiricnurâ sorecnume wahapozi ‘no Anuture Ŋokâ’ iŋuc mupe ŋoŋe wemocte muŋgopieŋ, ‘Go Anutu âkehockekic’?
Gie baekopac i honepie Mamac‐nanere sâc mi eekacko dâŋnane qikiŋnepie sâckeocmu.
Me honepie Mamac‐nanere sâc eekacko ine dâŋnanere mâcne, gie bapa‐nanere erâ ʒâŋitacnunʒepieŋ, ehuc Mamaczi no maŋnuekac â noni Mamac maŋkeekopac irec fuŋne mana taranʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume kâpâcwâru bazo ehuc bârucnepie rawec.
Eme Jesu e Jordaŋ opâ ocniŋucnao Johanezi mârâc fuŋkerâ ŋic opâ rua‐jare jujecko ra juwec.
Ira juhame ŋic bocjahazi erao fisirâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Johane e mâsi bapa i mi bawec, â ŋic kecʒirec dâŋ muwec ine fideteŋ efârekac.”
Eme mâreŋ ira bocjahazi Jesu manasiŋkembiŋ.
Betania haeo ŋic moc juwec ʒâŋene Lazaro, e huc bame fowec. Maria â Mata jahe hahac qozi hae irecteaŋ.
Maria eki hâcne Wofuŋ opâ âsu biaŋ ruacnerâ qizec susuc‐ticnezi kikene bâkereŋkewec. Ɋaticne Lazaro hâcne huc fowec.
Eme jahe hahac qozi Jesurao dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muhuc râepire rawec: “Wofuŋ go manac, âgoge huc fokac.”
Eme Jesuzi biŋe manarâ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Huc irec fârine hâmoc fuaocte mâcne, Anuture mumuteŋ fuaocte mukicne. Anutu Ŋokâ‐ticne ere sambâŋ qâreŋ fua taniŋkeocte hâcne.”
Mata â qoticne â Lazaro jaŋere Jesuzi ecnewec.
Eme hucte biŋe manarâ juweckoa gie bapa jajahec mocwâc juwec.
Iŋuc jurâ motecfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Warepie Judaia mâreŋko risie ranaŋ.”
Mume motecfâcne jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Qaqazu, Judaŋic jaŋe juc bânic moc ira qânâzi hecguzo mumbiŋ, eme ʒi wemocte jaŋerao mocwâc risiezo mukic?”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Gie bapa dameŋ aua 12 fokac i! Moc e ʒoaŋko hata rahame wiac moczi he âkec mi ecneocmu, e tatamacko wiac sâcne honeocmu.
Moc e ŋafeo tatamac basahuc hata rahame ine he âkec ecneocmu.”
Iŋuc murâ dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckewec: “Âgo‐nâŋec Lazaro guŋ fokac, eme no rarâ wiwickepemu.”
Eme motec jaŋe ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Wofuŋ, guŋ fohuc biaŋkeocmu.”
Jesu e hâmocte dâŋ suŋsuŋne mume jaŋe guŋ jâmbâŋte mukac muhuc mi mana‐hâmombiŋ.
Irec Jesuzi muɋaɋackerâ jazawec, “Lazaro hâmojec.
No ira mi ra juhape hâmojecte ŋoŋere erâ bunane biaŋkekac, ŋoŋe mamanasiŋ fârihec eniŋte wiac i fuajec. Ʒi ine erao ranaŋ.”
Eme Toma, ʒâŋene moc Didimo, eki motec âgofâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Nâŋâc mâmâc rarâ ehec hâmonʒepeneŋ.”
Lazaro ʒâŋeruŋko fohame ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â jahec ehame Jesu ra fisiwec.
Betania hae i Jerusalem hae irec raʒimicne bembeŋko ŋewecte
irecnec Judaŋic bocjahazi Mata â Maria ɋajekic hâmowecte soŋgâŋ fâsâc honec‐jofazo rambiŋ.
Eme Mata e Jesu fisikac mupie manarâ Maria ficko ŋehame ra hatao bâfuawec.
Bâfuarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋ, go ʒira jutec muzac ɋanane mi hâmozac.
Erâ ʒiŋuczia gore wâc manakopac, wiac irec me irec Anutu numucnetec mana‐gareocmu.”
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ɋage ɋârerâ fahareocmu.”
Mume Matazi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Juku dameŋ sâkoo ɋârerâ fahareocmu i manakopac.”
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ɋâɋâre â juju rune no, irec moc e no manasiŋnuocmuzi hâmo‐bipierâ juocmu,
â moc e ɋâricne juhuc manasiŋnuocmuzi hâhâmo tâmiric juraʒihuc juocmu sanaŋ. Go dâŋ i mana ʒakiekomec?”
Eme Matazi muwec: “Go Kristo Anuture Ŋokâzi mâreŋko wahaocte mukicne hâcne, i maŋnanezi mana ʒakiekopac.”
Dâŋ iŋuc murâ qoticne Maria wiracnerâ saŋucko ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Qaqazu warejec gore mukac.”
Eme Mariazi manarâ izia faharerâ Jesurao rawec.
Jesu e hae upeo Mata dâŋ âzâcneweckoa domawec.
Eme Maria e biac faharerâ rame Judaŋic soŋgâŋte ficticnao ŋembiŋ jaŋe ʒâŋeruŋko kioocte rakac muhuc bâjâpembiŋ.
Eme Maria e hae upeo hurâ Jesu honerâ kikefuŋnao fodaperâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋ, go ʒira jutec muzac ɋanane mi hâmozac.”
Iŋuc murâ kiome Judaŋic bâjâpembiŋ jaŋe e bafickerâ mâmâc kiombiŋ. Kiopie Jesuzi honec‐joparâ mana hâtâwehuc gâgâmârâwec.
Iŋuc erâ wio‐jarewec, “Wena duckembieŋ?” Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Wofuŋ ware honec.”
Eme Jesu ʒâŋene ruruame ʒâŋeucne wahawec.
Eme Judaŋic jaŋe honerâ mumbiŋ, “Honeniŋ, maŋne ere mo iŋucne domawec.”
Â gâcnezi mumbiŋ, “Tiŋtuŋ moc ʒâŋene bâtâcneweczi ŋic kecʒi sâcne mi bâpiaŋkeme ɋiɋic qazac me?”
Eme Jesuzi bune mocwâc hâhâtâwehame ʒâŋeruŋko ra fisiwec. Qâŋɋâŋ e qânâ hawecko fowec, motâcne qânâ kâcɋenezi âke bâzickekicne.
Irec Jesuzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Qânâ bârârieniŋ.” Mume hâmocnere hahac Mata eki muwec: “Wofuŋ, ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â jahec fowecte âsu fikac.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Dâŋ gazape mi manamec, go manasiŋnutec Anutu tâpiri‐ticnere qâreŋ fuame honecmu.”
Eme qânâ bârâriepie Jesuzi faic fime fehame ʒiŋuc numuwec: “Mamac, go nunumu‐nane manamecte daŋge gazakopac.
Go nunumu‐nane dameŋ sâc manaekic i manakopac. No mâc ŋic ʒi doma raŋgopieŋ jaŋe goki sorecnutec wahapo i maŋjeŋiczi mana ʒakieniŋte dâŋ iŋuc gazakopac.”
Iŋuc murâ hahaŋne bahuc wirawec, “Lazaro go wahac.”
Mume hâmokicnezi wahawec. Me kikene qoruczi qâfisekicne â ʒâŋe maine qoruczi foŋkekicne, irec Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Qoruc goroŋkepie raoc.”
Judaŋic Mariarao fisimbiŋ jaŋeraonec bocjahazi Jesu wiac eme honerâ e manasiŋkembiŋ.
Gâcnezi ine farisaio ŋic jaŋerao rarâ Jesuzi wiac ewec irec dâŋ binaŋ ejarembiŋ.
Eme taha bapa micne â farisaio ŋic jaŋe dâŋ i manarâ micne bapa hefârec‐joparâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋic e mâsi bocjaha bakacte wenac enaŋ?
Nâŋâc qâoma ecnehuc juhapene ŋic jaŋe erao qohota‐fârepie Romaŋic jaŋe râsi enârerâ mâreŋ â ŋic nâwoc rofâreniŋmu.”
Eme jaŋere âgo moc, ʒâŋene Kaifa, jara dameŋ ira taha bapa sâko juwec, eki ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋoŋe maŋ mamanasu tâmiric juŋgopieŋ,
erâ ʒiŋuc wâc mi manaŋgopieŋ: Ŋicguru nâŋâc sipiricke‐fârenʒipeŋte mocjahazi âkehoc‐nâpohuc hâmome izi ŋoŋe wâc bafic‐ŋopaocmu.”
Dâŋ i maŋticnere mi muwec, e jara dameŋ ira taha bapa sâko juwecte fiŋdaŋdâŋ muwec. Jesu e jâmbomac ŋic jaŋere erâ hâmoocte mucnekicne,
erâ Judaŋic jaŋere sawa mâcne, Anuture naru motecfâc mâreŋ sâc juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc bâtumaŋ‐jopame guru mocjaha erâ juniŋte iŋuc mucnekicne.
Eme micne bapa jaŋe ʒoaŋ gie bapa ira hâcne Jesu qaniŋte dâŋgie fuŋkembiŋ.
Irec Jesu e Judaŋic jaŋerao mocwâc mi fua tâcnerâ juwec, e mâreŋ burocne irec mecqaŋeŋao hae moc ŋewec, Eferaim, ira motecfâcne rocjopame ra jumbiŋ.
Eme Judaŋic aakic hombaŋ‐jeŋic bembeŋkehame hae pitickonec ŋic bocjahazi bahac wâwânâŋ gie‐jeŋic baniŋte biac bânierâ Jerusalem haeo rambiŋ.
Eme taha ufuŋko Jesu basarâ ʒiŋuc muhuc nazaŋ gazaŋ embiŋ: “Ŋoŋe weniŋuc muŋgopieŋ, e hombaŋte wareocmu me mâcne?”
Taha bapa micne â farisaio ŋic jaŋe ine mumupaŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Moc e ŋeŋe juju‐ticne honerâ ware mufua‐nâreme kâpâcwâru banʒepeneŋ.”
Aakic hombaŋ juwicnao ʒoaŋ gie bapa 6 fohame Jesuzi Betania haeo ra fisiwec. E hae ira hâcne Lazaro hâmockonec bâɋârewec.
Eme Jesu tiwâ bâzi rikecnepie Matazi râe bâmoc ejareme Lazarohec mâmâc ŋehuc nâmbiŋ.
Ŋehapie Mariazi kiruŋ moc opâ âsu biaŋ furi sâko jâmbâŋ i rorâ Jesu kikene ruacnerâ qizec susuc‐ticnezi bâkereŋkewec. Eme fic âsu biaŋ fifârewec.
Eme motec jaŋere âgo moc Juda Karioto haeonec docbapa ŋic, eki ʒiŋuc muwec:
“Opâ âsu izi 30 kina kitâcneme ŋic hapetac jarepene sâckezac me!”
E dâŋ i hapetac jaŋere manasuhuc mi muwec, e moneŋ kânoŋ wirec‐jeŋic bajuhuc moneŋ hume ro soŋsoŋ ejujec, irec muwec.
Eme Jesuzi muwec, “Ŋoŋe ŋokac dâŋ mi mucneniŋ, e opâ âsu i sahac‐nane ruacneme hâmope ducnuniŋte irec biŋe hâcne bajuwec.
Ŋic hapetac dameŋ sâc ŋoŋerao juhuc juniŋmu, no ine ŋoŋerao boc mi jupemu.”
Eme Judaŋic bocjaha jaŋe hae ira jume manarâ ijaha fisimbiŋ. Erâ Jesure sawa mâcne, Lazaro hâmockonec bâɋârewec e mâmâc honeniŋte fisimbiŋ.
Eme irec taha bapa micne jaŋe Lazaro mâmâc qaniŋte dâŋgie bambiŋ.
Judaŋic bocjahazi ere erâ rarâ Jesurao qohotambiŋte iŋuc embiŋ.
Hae fureme ŋic guru sâko hombaŋte biac Jerusalem haeo fisimbiŋ jaŋe dâŋ biŋe ʒiŋuc manambiŋ: “Jesu warehuc jukac.”
Dâŋ i manarâ ʒariŋ bazu amec erâ hatao bâfuaniŋte rambiŋ. Erâ bâfuarâ ofac hecnehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ohec, Wofuŋte micte ware‐nârekac e mumbiaŋkenaŋ, Israe ŋicwofuŋ ohec!”
Jesu e doŋgi motecne bâfuacnepie fainao ŋehuc rawec. I findaŋdâŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac irec sâcko ewec:
“Zioŋte otâ, go mi hâwicguoc; manakic, ŋicwofuŋgezi fakac, doŋgi motecnere âsio fakac.”
Dâŋ i motecfâc‐ticne jaŋe mârâc mi mana‐hâmombiŋ. Juku Jesu sambâŋ tatamac‐ticnao risie feme dâŋ irec manasurâ ʒiŋuc mana tarambiŋ: I ere qâreŋkekicnere sâc ijaha ecnembiŋ.
Jesu e Lazaro wiracneme ʒâŋeruŋkonec wahame honembiŋ ŋic guru sâko i jaŋe gâcne dâŋ binaŋ ejarembiŋ.
Eme mâsi irec biŋe manambiŋte bocjahazi hatao ra bâfuambiŋ hâcne.
Eme farisaio ŋic jaŋe jaŋackoaŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc muc manac embiŋ: “Manaŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe dâŋgie bâipiehapie ŋic mâmâc sasawa erao qohota‐fâreŋgopieŋ ine!”
Judaŋic hombaŋte Jerusalem haeo fisimbiŋ jaŋere ŋondeŋko Grikŋic qâpuc moc moc mâmâc juhuc Anutu mai ecnembiŋ.
Eme jaŋe Filipo Besaida haeonec Galilaia mâreŋkonec erao rarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ŋicbomboŋ, nâŋe Jesu honezo muŋgopeneŋ.”
Mupie Filipozi Anderea âzâcneme mâmâc Jesurao rarâ dâŋ i âzâcnepic.
Âzâcnepire ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne huriri qâreŋ‐ticne fua tâcneocte ʒâfo maickekac hâcne.
Jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazape mananiŋ, jacgoŋ hândâŋ e mâreŋko mi hurâ mâc foku foocmu, mâreŋte nânâ eme ine fârine bocjaha fuaocmu.
Moc e juju‐ticne âgo ecneme sifuckecneocmu, moc e mâreŋko juhuc juju‐ticne râsi ecneme juju sanaŋte biŋe focneocmu.
Moc e nore kiŋaŋ qaqa ezo murâ bâjâpecnuzejec, eme no jupemuoa kiŋaŋ qaqa‐nanezi juocmu. Moc e no kiŋaŋ qanareocmu, e Mamac‐nanezi erickeocmu.
Ʒi maŋnane fâfârerâ ɋarac ɋarac qakac. Ehame weniŋuc mupemu? ‘Mamac go dameŋ maicnukac i bâsuec’ iŋuc mupe? Misac, iŋuc aricne, dameŋ i hâcne maicnuocte mukicne.
Irec Mamac go mutec ʒâŋe biŋegere huriri qâreŋ fua tâcnezejec.” Mume sambâŋkonec dâŋ ʒiŋuc wahawec: “I huriri qâreŋ‐ticne fuawec erâ huriri qâreŋ jaha fua raocmu.”
Eme ŋicguru domambiŋ jaŋe manarâ mumbiŋ, “Ɋuŋ hejec.” Â gâcnezi mumbiŋ, “Aŋelo moczi dâŋ âzâcnejec.”
Mupie Jesuzi micjeŋicko rorâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Dâŋ i nahacnere mâcne, ŋoŋere erâ fuajec.
Ʒi mâreŋko ââke râwiŋ dameŋ maickekacte mâreŋ ʒirec ŋicbomboŋ e hetuŋkezo.
Mâreŋkonec bâfeŋnupie mâreŋ sâc ŋic fârec‐jopape norao fisiniŋmu.”
I hâmoc weniŋucne hâmoocmu irec dâŋ suŋsuŋne iŋuc muwec.
Mume ŋicguru domambiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Nâŋe mitio dâŋ kecʒiŋuc manaeŋgopeneŋ: Kristo e mi hâmohuc juraʒihuc juocmu. Eme goki wemocte ʒiŋuc mukic: ‘Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e bâfeŋneniŋmu’? Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e mo?”
Eme Jesuzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarewec: “Ʒoctamac e ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko dameŋ bembeŋne mac tamaeocmu. Irec dapâczi foŋŋopazacte ʒoctamac foŋarehame e maickerâ junʒepieŋ. Moc e dapâcko rahuc hata mi hone taraocmu.
Irec ʒoctamac foŋarehame maŋzi sakarehuc kikefuŋfâc‐ticne enʒepieŋ.” Jesu e dâŋ iŋuc murâ ra soŋsoŋko juwec.
Jesu e mâsi fuŋne ʒâŋe fai‐jeŋicko bame hone‐bipiehuc sifu erao mi roweckembiŋ.
I porofete Jesajare dâŋ sanaŋkeocte iŋuc embiŋ. E dâŋ ʒiŋuc qâreŋkewec: “Wofuŋ, biŋedâŋge mupene mozi mana ʒakieekac? Â Wofuŋte me i morao fua taniŋkeekac?”
Erâ Jesure dâŋ mi mana ʒakiembiŋ i Jesajare dâŋqâreŋ moc fokacte embiŋ ine kecʒiŋuc:
“E ʒâŋe‐jeŋic tiŋtuŋ barâ maŋjeŋic bâzickewec, jaŋe ʒâŋezi wiac hone taranʒipiŋte, â maŋzi wiac mana taranʒipiŋte, ehuc maŋjeŋic bârisiepie bâpiaŋ‐jopazipore.”
Jesaja dâŋ muwec, i Jesu sambâŋ tatamac‐ticne honerâ muwec.
Eme micne bapa jaŋeraonec gâcne jaŋe Jesu manasiŋkembiŋ wâc. Erâ mufuapie farisaio jaŋe miti sakare‐jarenʒipiŋte hâwic‐jopame hesoŋkembiŋ.
Jaŋe ʒâŋe biŋe‐jeŋic ŋic jaŋerao waha qaqane ezacte manapie ŋemâckewec, â Anuturao waha qaqane ezacte manapie afeckewec.
Jesu e hahaŋne bahuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Moc e no manasiŋnuocmu, e no sawa mâcne, sorecnuwec e mâmâc manasiŋkeocmu.
Â moc e no honecnuocmuzi sorecnuwec e mâmâc honeocmu.
No ʒoc tatamaczi mâreŋko wahapo, eme moc e no manasiŋnuocmuzi dapâckonec wefuocmu.
Moc e dâŋnane manarâ beheme okacne mi râcnepemu, no ŋic okacne jarepemurâ mâcne, bâpiaŋ‐jopapemurâ wahapo.
Moc e no qikiŋnuhuc dâŋnane beheocmu, e mumutara fuacneocmu, dâŋ muekopac izi juku dameŋ sâkoo mumutara ecneocmu.
No dâŋ i no nahacne maŋte mi muekopac, Mamac sorecnuwec e jahac dâŋ mufuapemurâ sâcmutâc enarewec.
Erâ no manakopac, micdâŋ‐ticnezi juju sanaŋ bâfuaekac. Dâŋ muekopac i Mamaczi mutâcne‐narewec sâc muekopac.”
Aakic hombaŋ maickehame Jesuzi e jahacnere ʒiŋuc manawec: No mâreŋ beherâ Mamactao risie fepemurâ dameŋ bembeŋkekac. Iŋuc manarâ mâreŋko wiacfâc‐ticne maŋjauŋ ejarewec, i ejare tarahuc hâmoocte muwec.
Eme ŋafere nânâ nâniŋte tumaŋnehapie wiac kecʒiŋuc fuawec: Simoŋ ŋokâ‐ticne Juda, Karioto haeonec, e Jesu doc baocte Sataŋzi maŋticnao qafeŋ râewec.
Â Jesu e ʒiŋuc manawec: Mamac e wiac sasawa furu qârârie‐narekac, eme no Anuturaonec wahapozi mocwâc Anuturao risie fepemu.
Fuŋne iŋuc manahuc nânâ nâhuc ŋembiŋkonec faharerâ ŋaqi ʒora faine i hetararâ gie qoruc jomawec.
Erâ opâ râqâcko qame hume fuŋkerâ motecfâcne kike ʒure‐jarewec. Ehuc gie qoruczi bâkereŋke‐jarewec.
Ejare raku Simoŋ Petororao fisime ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Wofuŋzi kike‐nane ʒurezo mukic me?”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wiac ekopac irec fuŋne ʒiŋuczia mi manakomec, juku ʒâhecko manacmu.”
Eme Petorozi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Aricne, go kike‐nane mi ʒure‐jâmbâŋkecmu.” Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Noni mi ʒurecgupe nohec maŋ ʒuʒuhuc mi jucmu.”
Eme Petorozi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Wofuŋ, murâ kike‐nane sawa mâcne, me qizec‐nane mâmâc ʒurec.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Moc e opâ ruarâ ʒâhec kike‐ticne sawa ʒureme sahacne ɋaɋacne fofâreocmu, eme ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha ɋaɋackembiŋ, erâ ɋaɋacnea mi jufâreŋgopieŋ.”
E doc bapa‐ticne mana tarahuc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ɋaɋacnea mi jufâreŋgopieŋ.”
Kike‐jeŋic ʒure‐fârerâ ŋaqi ʒora‐ticne mocwâc heme hume waha ŋehuc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No wiac eŋarepac irec fuŋne manaŋgopieŋ me?
Ŋoŋe Qaqazu â Wofuŋ munareeŋgopieŋ, erâ iŋeŋic jukopacte sâcne munareeŋgopieŋ.
Eme no Wofuŋ â Qaqazu‐ŋeŋiczi kike‐ŋeŋic ʒure‐ŋarepacte ŋaŋaczia iŋuc jaha kike ʒuʒurec erahuc jupie sâckezejec.
Mâsi eŋarepac izi juju bapare ma qâreŋ‐ŋeŋic eme i honehuc, eŋarepac irec sâc ehuc junʒepieŋ.
No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ mupe mananiŋ: Kiŋaŋ moteczi bomboŋ‐ticnere sâc sirickerâ jujune i mi fokac, â sorekicnezi sorewec ere sâc sirickerâ jujune i wâc mi fokac.
Eme dâŋ i manapaŋkerâ irec sâcko jupie no ŋoŋere manape ʒerine eocmu.
No dâŋ mupe mâmâc sasawa mi rocŋopakac. No wenimoi rowosâec‐ŋopapo i manakopac. Dâŋqâreŋ moc kecʒiŋuc fokac, i sanaŋkeocmu hâcne: Nânâ bâfâuc ecneekopac eki wâc bunaneo bakac.
Wiac i mi fuahame qanaŋ ŋazakopac, eme ʒâhec fuame, e Wofuŋzi qanaŋ manahuc muwec, nore iŋuc munʒepieŋ.
No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazape, moc e gie muŋarekicne ŋoŋe hezu hewâneŋ eŋareocmuzi gie rune no hezu hewâneŋ enareocmu, â moc e no enareocmuzi sorecnuwec e hezu hewâneŋ ecneocmu.”
Jesu e dâŋ iŋuc murâ bu ʒaʒamaŋne fâuckezo eme mutaniŋkerâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ mupe mananiŋ, ŋoŋeraonec moczi no doc bacnuocmu.”
Iŋuc mume motec jaŋe hohonec efârerâ, i more mukac, muhuc kâuc bambiŋ.
Eme motec moc Jesure maŋfuŋko ŋewec, e bufuŋ jâmbâŋ‐ticne,
e hâcne Simoŋ Petorozi mezi sâsâc ecnerâ muwec, “Wiocnetec gazaoc, more mukac?”
Eme motec eki hâcne qizec‐ticne Jesure amecko fohorerâ muwec, “Wofuŋ go more mukic?”
Eme Jesuzi muwec, “Poroŋ sicko âke uruckerâ râcnepe nâocmu ere hâcne mukopac.” Iŋuc murâ poroŋ sicko âke uruckerâ Simoŋ ŋokâ‐ticne Juda, Karioto haeonec, e râcneme nâwec.
Nâme Sataŋzi maŋne sakioŋkewec. Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wiac ezo mukomec, i biac jaha ezemec.”
Dâŋ iŋuc âzâcneme gâcne mâmâc ŋembiŋzi mi mana‐hâmombiŋ.
Ehuc tucnezi ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Juda e moneŋ kânoŋ wirec‐nâŋec bajukacte hombaŋte wiac moc furine baocte sorekac, me ŋic hapetac moneŋ jareocte mukac.”
Eme Juda e poroŋ nârâ izia ŋafe fuaha rawec.
Juda rame Jesuzi motec gâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ʒi Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne e huriri qâreŋ‐ticne fuakac, eme ere erâ Anuture huriri qâreŋ mâmâc fuakac.
Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋnezi Anuture huriri qâreŋ bâfuawecte Anutu e jahac Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne ere huriri qâreŋ iŋuc jaha bâfuaocmu, dameŋ mi ʒorahame biac bâfuaocmu.
Motecfâc‐nane, no dameŋ bembeŋne mac moc ŋoŋehec jupemu. Eme ʒâhec basacnuniŋmu. Eme Judaŋic jazapo ijaha ŋoŋe ŋazape: No rapemu ijaha sâcne mi fâniŋmu.
Eme ʒi sâcmutâc dâŋ ɋâricne ŋazape: Maŋjauŋ eec enʒepieŋ, noni maŋjauŋ eŋare warehuc jupo iŋuc jaha ŋaŋackoaŋ maŋjauŋ eec enʒepieŋ.
Maŋjauŋ eec epie ŋic jaŋe honec‐ŋopapie motecfâc‐nane juŋgopieŋ ezejec.”
Eme Simoŋ Petorozi wiocnerâ muwec, “Wofuŋ, go wena racmu?” Eme Jesuzi muwec, “No rapemu ijaha ʒiŋuczia sâcne mi fâcmu, juku ʒâhec ine fâzemec.”
Eme Petorozi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Wofuŋ, no wemocte ʒiŋuczia sâcne mi fâpemu? No gore erâ juju‐nane sâcne qikiŋnepemu.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go nore erâ jujuge qikiŋnezo mukomec me? No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ gazape: Qâqâczi mi dâŋehame goki jahec â moc mic bacnucmu.
“Ŋoŋe fâfârerâ maŋŋeŋic mi gâckezejec. Anutu manasiŋkehuc no mâmâc manasiŋnunʒepieŋ.
Mamac‐nanere hae qizecko fic bocjaha ŋerakac. Iŋuc mi fome muzac, ŋeŋe hewâneŋke‐ŋarezo rapemu, i moc ŋazazapo me?
Eme ra ŋeŋe hewâneŋke‐ŋarerâ mocwâc risie warerâ jowac‐ŋopape rarâ no jupemuoa junʒepieŋ.
Rapemu hata i honeeŋgopieŋ.”
Mume Tomazi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go wena racmu, i nâŋe mi manaŋgopeneŋ, irec wemocko hata honenaŋmu.”
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Hata â dâŋ fâri qizec â juju irec rune no. No nowarurâ Mamactao fifisi i mi fokac.
Ŋoŋe juwicnao no ʒâŋitacnurâ muzac Mamac‐nane iŋuc jaha ʒâŋitanʒapiŋ. Ʒi ine Mamac‐nane ʒâŋitarâ mana taraŋgopieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Filipozi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Go Mamac nâwotutec honerâ manapene taraocmu.”
Eme Jesuzi muwec: “Filipo, no dameŋ ʒora ŋoŋehec juhape go mi hone tarac‐nukomec? Moc e no honecnuekaczi Mamac honeekac. Eme go wemocte ʒiŋuc mukomec: ‘Go Mamac nâwotutec honenaŋ’?
Mamaczi no maŋnuekac â noni Mamac maŋkeekopac i mi mana ʒakiekic me? Dâŋ ŋazaekopac i nahacne maŋte mi ŋazaekopac, Mamaczi nore maŋko juhuc gie‐ticne baekac.
Mamaczi no maŋnuekac â noni Mamac maŋkeekopac, dâŋ i manapie fârine ezejec. Me miczi mupe mi sâcŋopakacko wiac bapa‐nanere erâ dâŋ i mana ʒakieniŋ.
“No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ mupe mananiŋ: No manasiŋnuocmuzi gie baekopac ijaha baocmu. Erâ i sawa mâcne, sâcnane jâuruhuc baocmu. No Mamactao fepemure iŋuc hâcne fuaocmu.
Eme ŋoŋe nore ʒâŋe bajuhuc numupie sâc mana‐ŋarehuc epemu. I Mamacte mumuteŋ Ŋokâre erâ fuaocte iŋuc epemu.
Ʒâŋe‐nane bajuhuc numu‐narepie mana‐ŋarehuc epemu.
Maŋŋeŋic nore qikiŋneeŋgopieŋko micnane reŋkeniŋmu.
Eme noni Mamac numucnepe neŋgoc ŋesiŋ‐ŋeŋic moc soreme waharâ ŋoŋehec juhuc juocmu sanaŋ.
Dâŋ fâri qizecnere Mâro hâcne. I miti tâmiriczi rorone mi fokac. Jaŋe e mi hone taraeŋgopieŋ â e mi mana taraeŋgopieŋ. E ŋoŋehec juekaczi maŋŋeŋicko hurâ juocmu, irec ŋoŋe e kâuc mi baeŋgopieŋ.
No behec‐ŋopape bekâ mâsiŋ erâ mi juniŋmu. No ŋoŋerao risie warepemu.
Dameŋ bembeŋne mac moc fokac, i tarame miti tâmiriczi mocwâc mi honecnuniŋmu. Ŋoŋe ine honecnuniŋmu. No juju sanaŋ jukopac, irec ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha ɋâricne juraniŋmu.
Dameŋ ira, Mamaczi no maŋnuekac â noni ŋoŋe maŋŋopaekopac, â ŋoŋe no maŋnueŋgopieŋ i mana taraniŋmu.
“Moc e micdâŋ‐nane bajuhuc sâseocmu, eki maŋjauŋ enareocmu. Eme moc e no maŋjauŋ enareme Mamac‐nanezi e iŋuc jaha maŋjauŋ ecneocmu, â no nahac wâc maŋjauŋ ecnehuc fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkecnepemu.”
Iŋuc mume Juda Karioto haeonec ere wasezi wiocnerâ muwec: “Wofuŋ, go weniŋuc erâ fuŋnege nâŋerao sawa bataniŋkehuc ŋic gâcne sâko jaŋe hesoŋke‐jarezo mukic?”
Mume Jesuzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Moc e maŋjauŋ enareocmuzi dâŋnane mana rereŋ eocmu. Eme Mamac‐nanezi e iŋuc jaha maŋjauŋ ecneocmu. Eme nâhe mâmâc erao fisirâ ŋeŋe juju enacmu.
Moc e maŋjauŋ mi enareocmuzi dâŋnane wemocko mana rereŋ eocmu. Erâ dâŋ ŋazaekopac i no nahacnaonec mâcne, i Mamac sorecnuwec eraonec.
“No nahac ŋoŋehec juhuc dâŋ iŋucne ŋaza qazuc eekopac.
Eme neŋgoc ŋesiŋ Tiri Mâro hâcne e Mamaczi nore micte soreme waharâ dâŋ sasawa ŋaza qazuc eŋareocmu, â noni ŋazaekopac i heɋâre‐ŋare‐fâreocmu.
No merâfâc‐nane wama ŋarekopac, ŋic wama mâcne, no nahacne wama jâmbâŋ ŋarekopac. Irec maŋŋeŋic mi fâfârerâ gâckezejec.
No kecʒiŋuc ŋazape manambieŋ: ‘No rarâ juku ŋoŋerao mocwâc risiepemu.’ Ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic nore qikiŋnerâ muzac, ine Mamactao fepemu i manarâ bubiaŋ bâfuanʒapiŋ. Mamac e nore femicne jukacte manasuhuc iŋuc enʒapiŋ.
Ʒi fârine mi fuaha qanaŋ ŋazakopac, irec fuame honerâ mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋic sanaŋkezejec.
No ʒi dâŋ bocjaha mi ʒuhuckerâ ŋazapemu. Mâreŋ ʒirec ŋicbomboŋ wareocte ʒawiekac, warerâ norao hetakireocmu.
Eme Mamac maŋjauŋ ecnehuc gie munarewec baekopac i miti tâmiriczi hone taraniŋte faharepie ranaŋ.
“No waiŋjâc fuŋqizecne jâmbâŋ, â Mamac‐nanezi waiŋ gie rune.
Tieŋne moc norao foipiehuc fârinehec mi eme qâtâcne behec eocmu, â tieŋne moc fârinehec fome gie bacneme soka biaŋ eocte soŋaŋkeocmu.
Ŋoŋe ine miti ŋazape manahuc biac ɋaɋackembiŋ juŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Eme ŋoŋe no maŋnupie noni ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha maŋŋopapemu. Waiŋ tieŋnezi jâcnehec ʒuʒuhuc mi fohuc e jahackoaŋ sawa fârinehec mi eocmu. Eme ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha no mi maŋnuhuc wemocko fârinehec eniŋmu.
Waiŋjâc fuŋqizecne no, tieŋ taeŋne ŋoŋe. Moc e no maŋnuhame noni e maŋkepemu, eme iŋucnezi fârine sâkohec eocmu. Ŋoŋe no tâmiric juhuc wiac eene i mi fokac.
Moc e no mi maŋnume e behezo, eme waiŋ tieŋne behepie ɋaŋame qâzuckerâ behepie ʒocko ʒaekac, sâc ijaha ecnezo.
Ŋoŋe no maŋnuhuc dâŋnane maŋkeniŋmu, eme wiac irec me irec numupie fua‐ŋareocmu.
Ŋoŋe fârine sâkohec ehuc motec jâmbâŋfâc‐nane erâ jupie Mamac‐nanere mumuteŋ fuaocmu.
“Mamaczi no maŋjauŋ enareekac, iŋuc jaha noni ŋoŋe maŋjauŋ eŋareekopac. Eme ŋoŋe nore maŋjauŋkoa junʒepieŋ.
Micdâŋ‐nane reŋkehuc ine nore maŋjauŋko juniŋmu, no iŋuc jaha Mamac‐nanere micdâŋ reŋkehuc ere maŋjauŋko juekopac.
Nore bubiaŋzi ŋoŋerao fotâcneme ŋoŋerezi fufusuc foocte dâŋ ʒi ŋaza‐fârekopac. Erâ ŋoŋerao fohuc fua sawec ezejec.
Micdâŋ‐nane kecʒiŋuc ŋazakopac: Noni maŋjauŋ eŋareekopac, iŋuc jaha ŋaŋaczia maŋjauŋ eec enʒepieŋ.
Moc e âgofâcne jaŋere riŋ rohuc juju‐ticne qaisockeocmu, irec maŋjauŋ fekicne sâko muzo.
Gie muŋareekopac i bapie honec‐ŋopape âgofâc‐nane eniŋmu.
No dameŋ ʒi kiŋaŋ qaqa mocwâc mi muŋarekopac, mana‐ŋarepe âgofâc‐nane eŋgopieŋ. Kiŋaŋ qaqazi bomboŋ‐ticnere maŋko dâŋ foekac i mi manaekac. Noni ine Mamac‐naneraonec dâŋ manapo sâc mufuarâ ŋaza‐fârepore honec‐ŋopape âgofâc‐nane eŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe no mi rowosâecnumbiŋ, noni ŋoŋe rowosâec‐ŋopapo, erâ ra juhuc fârine bâfuaniŋte muŋarepo. Eme fârine bâfuapie fofonehec ezejec. Iŋuc erâ nore ʒâŋe bajuhuc Mamac numucnepie sâc ŋareocmu.
Maŋjauŋ eec enʒepieŋ, micdâŋ ine hâcne ŋazakopac.
“Miti tâmiriczi qaisoc‐ŋopapie ʒiŋuc munʒepieŋ: ‘Wofuŋ e mârâcko iŋuc hâcne fuŋkerâ qaisockembiŋ.’
Miti tâmiric jaŋere guruo raʒipie muzac âgo eŋarenʒapiŋ. No ine jaŋere guruonec rowosâec‐ŋopape eebapa‐jeŋic râpeckembiŋte qaisoc‐ŋopaeŋgopieŋ.
No dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc ŋazapo irec manasunʒepieŋ: Kiŋaŋ qaqazi bomboŋ‐ticnere sâc sirickerâ jujune mi fokac. Jaŋe no râsi enarembiŋko ŋoŋe râsi jaha eŋareniŋmu, jaŋe nore dâŋ mana maŋ embiŋko ŋoŋere dâŋ iŋuc jaha mana maŋ eniŋmu.
Sorecnuwec e mi ʒâŋitaeŋgopieŋte nore erâ iŋuc hâcne eŋareniŋmu.
No jaŋerao mi waharâ fuŋne mi jazape muzac kiŋ tâmiric junʒapiŋ. Ʒi ine kiŋjeŋic wemocko murârâŋneniŋmu.
Moc e no qaisocnuekaczi Mamac‐nane iŋuc jaha qaisockeekac.
No ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko mâsi sâko, ŋiczi mi bapane, i mi bazapo muzac kiŋ tâmiric junʒapiŋ. Ʒi ine bape hone‐fâre‐bipiehuc no qaisocnuhuc Mamac‐nane iŋuc jaha qaisockeeŋgopieŋ.
Iŋuc epie mitio dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc fokac, i sanaŋkekac hâcne: ‘Jaŋe oma jâmbâŋ qaisocnumbiŋ.’
Neŋgoc ŋesiŋ, dâŋ fâri qizecnere Mâro hâcne, Mamactao jukac, e sorepe Mamactaonec waharâ fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkeocmu.
Erâ ŋoŋe gie fuŋkepoonec nohec juwarembiŋte iŋuc jaha fuŋne‐nane mutaniŋkenʒepieŋ.
“Juku wiac eŋarepie manapie ririsi ezacte dâŋ i qanaŋ ŋazakopac.
Jaŋe mitific sakare‐ŋareniŋmu. Erâ wâc dameŋ moc maickeocmu, ira Anuture gie baŋgopeneŋ muhuc qâhâmoc‐ŋopaniŋmu.
Jaŋe Mamac mecne no mecne mi ʒâŋitac‐nâfoeŋgopieŋte iŋuc eniŋmu.
No dâŋ qanaŋ ŋazakopac, i sanaŋkeme munʒepieŋ: Eki mârâc jaha nâzâwec hâcne. Dâŋ i dameŋ‐nane ʒoricne fohame mârâc biac mi ŋazapo.
“Ʒi ine sorecnuwec erao fezo ehape ŋoŋeraonec moczi moc ʒiŋuc mi wio‐narekac: ‘Go wena racmu?’
Dâŋ iŋucne ŋazakopacte mâc busâqoczi maŋŋeŋic fusucmakac.
No dâŋ jâmbomac mupe mananiŋ: Risie fepemu i ŋoŋerao fârine fuaocte fepemu. Mi fezapo muzac, neŋgoc ŋesiŋzi mi wahazac. Ferâ ine sorepe wahaocmu.
Waharâ ŋic fuŋne bataniŋke‐jareme ʒiŋuc mananiŋmu: Kiŋ fokac â tiŋke biaŋ fokac â okacne dâŋ mumutara fokac.
Kiŋte fuŋne ʒiŋucko mananiŋmu: Jaŋe no mi manasiŋnueŋgopieŋ.
Tiŋke biaŋte fuŋne ʒiŋucko mananiŋmu: No Mamactao risie fepe mocwâc mi honecnuniŋmu.
Okacne dâŋ mumutara irec fuŋne ʒiŋucko mananiŋmu: Mâreŋ ʒirec ŋicbomboŋ okacne dâŋ biac mutaracnekicne.
“Dâŋ ŋaŋazane bocjaha fokac, erâ dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ŋazape wemocko amecke‐fâreniŋmu.
Dâŋ fâri qizecnere Mâro eki ine waharâ dâŋ fâri qizecnere ʒâkâŋko bâutuc‐ŋopaocmu. E jahacne maŋte dâŋ mi ŋazaocmu, mutâcnecnekicne sâc ŋazaocmu, erâ juku wiac fuaocmu i wâc mufua‐ŋareocmu.
Dâŋ i no nahacne rowaŋkonec rorâ mujaŋgeŋke‐ŋareme nore huriri qâreŋ fuaocmu.
Mamactao wiac fokac irec rune no. Irec hâcne mupac, ‘Nore rowaŋkonec rorâ mujaŋgeŋke‐ŋareocmu.’
“Dameŋ bembeŋne fokac, i tarame rape basacnuniŋmu. Erâ irec faicnao dameŋ bembeŋne jaha wâc fokac, i tarame warepe honecnuniŋmu.”
Iŋuc mume motec jaŋe nazaŋ gazaŋ erâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Weniŋucte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukac? ‘Dameŋ bembeŋne fokac, i tarame rape basacnuniŋmu, erâ irec faicnao dameŋ bembeŋne jaha wâc fokac, i tarame warepe honecnuniŋmu.’ Â moc ʒiŋuc mukac: ‘Mamactao fepemu.’”
Iŋuc murâ harierâ mumbiŋ: “‘Dameŋ bembeŋne fokac,’ iŋuc wemocte mukac, nâŋe kâuc baŋgopeneŋ.”
Wiocnezo epie Jesuzi hone tarac‐joparâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Dâŋ kecʒiŋuc ŋazapacte muc manac eŋgopieŋ, ‘Dameŋ bembeŋne fokac, i tarame rape basacnuniŋmu, erâ irec faicnao dameŋ bembeŋne fokac, i tarame warepe honecnuniŋmu.’
No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazape: Ŋoŋe ki mamakuc ehapie miti tâmiriczi ʒeri eniŋmu. Ŋoŋe busâqocko juniŋmu, ehame busâqoc‐ŋeŋiczi ŋerisieme bubiaŋ fuaocmu.
Ŋokac moc e motec roocte dameŋne maickeme ʒâic manaocmu. Izi motec rome ʒâic omaeme, ɋâric fuajec irec bubiaŋ manaocmu.
Eme ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha dameŋ ʒiŋuczia buʒâichec juniŋmu. Juhapie mocwâc risierâ honec‐ŋopape bubiaŋ bâfuaniŋmu. Eme bubiaŋ i moczi mi qâsua‐ŋareocmu.
Eme dameŋ ira wiac mocte mi kâuc barâ wio‐nareniŋmu. No jâmbomac jâmbâŋ ŋazape: Ŋoŋe Mamac wiac mocte numucnepie ʒâŋe‐nanere erâ ŋareocmu.
Juwarembiŋ ira nore ʒâŋe bajuhuc mi numu jumbieŋ. Ʒi ine numurâ ropie bubiaŋ‐ŋeŋiczi fua sawec erâ fufuse fozejec.
“Dâŋ ŋaza warehuc jupo i suŋsuŋne qahuc ŋazapo. Juku dameŋ moc maickeocmu ira ine dâŋ suŋsuŋne mi muhuc, Mamacte fuŋne mâc mutaniŋkerâ ŋazapemu.
Dameŋ ira ʒâŋe‐nane bajuhuc numupie noni ŋoŋe bâsâoc‐ŋopahuc Mamac ââzâcne i mi epemu.
No Mamactaonec wahapo, dâŋ i mana ʒakiehuc maŋjauŋ enareeŋgopieŋte Mamac e jahac wâc iŋuc jaha maŋjauŋ eŋareekac.
No Mamac beherâ mâreŋko wahapo, eme ʒi mâreŋ beherâ Mamactao mocwâc fekopac.”
Iŋuc mume motec jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Ʒi dâŋ suŋsuŋne mi muhuc mâc mutaniŋkerâ nâzâkomec hâcne.
Irec gore ʒiŋuc manaŋgopeneŋ: Ŋic jaŋe mu wioc mi egarehapie go gahaczia wiac sasawa mana‐fâreekic, go Anuturaonec wahameŋ i mana ʒakieeŋgopeneŋ.”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe miŋecne mana ʒakieŋgopieŋ me?
Dameŋ moc fokac, i biac maickeme no behecnurâ siŋsaŋ qarâ ficŋeŋic sâc rafâreniŋmu. Erâ behecnupie buc mi jupemu, Mamaczi nohec jukacte buc jâmbâŋ mi jupemu.
Nore wamazi ŋoŋerao foocte dâŋ iŋucne ŋazakopac. Ŋoŋe mâreŋko ʒârâ hâriŋ faio jueŋgopieŋ, eme noni mâreŋte micne momori fozukopacte ŋoŋe hâbi‐ŋeŋichec junʒepieŋ.”
Jesu e dâŋ i mutararâ sambâŋko fime feha ʒiŋuc muhuc numuwec: “Mamac, dameŋ maickekac. Go Ŋokâgere huriri qâreŋ bâfuatec Ŋokâzi iŋuc jaha gore huriri qâreŋ bâfuazejec.
Go e mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋere rusâko râemeŋ, ehuc ŋic erao râec‐jopameŋ sâc jaŋe juju sanaŋ bâfua‐jareocte mucnemeŋ.
Juju sanaŋte fuŋne ine ʒiŋuc fokac: Go Anutu fârine mocjaha â soremeŋ, Jesu Kristo hâcne, ŋic jaŋe iŋuc mana tarac‐nâfopie juju sanaŋ fua‐jareocmu.
Gie munaremeŋ i baku batarape mâreŋko huriri qâreŋge fuakac.
O Mamac, mâreŋ mi fuahame gohec sambâŋ tatamac‐nanehec jupo, ijaha ʒi mocwâc bârisie‐naretec rojuzepac.
“Guru sâkoonec ŋic nore bâwosâec‐jopameŋ jaŋe biŋedâŋge mujaŋgeŋke‐jarepo. I gore biŋe juhapie nore qikiŋ‐jopameŋ, eme jaŋe gore dâŋ ropie maŋjeŋic ewec.
Wiac fonarekac i goraonec sasawa, jaŋe i mana taraŋgopieŋ.
Go dâŋ naremeŋ i jarepe ro sakarec embiŋ. Ehuc goraonec wahapo i manapaŋkembiŋ, â go gahac gie munaremeŋ i mana ʒakiembiŋ.
“No jaŋere erâ numu‐garekopac. Miti tâmiric jaŋere erâ mi numu‐garekopac, naremeŋ jaŋere sawa erâ numu‐garekopac, jaŋe gore biŋe hâcne.
Nore biŋezi gore biŋe â gore biŋezi nore biŋe. Eme maŋjeŋicko huriri qâreŋ‐nane fuawec fokac.
No mâreŋko juju‐nane tarakac, jaŋe ine mâreŋko ʒuhuckerâ juhapie no gorao fâzo ekopac. Tiri Mamac, biŋedâŋge naretec jazapo, eme go hemiriŋ‐jopatec dâŋ irec maŋnao junʒepieŋ. Eme nâhâc maŋ mocjaha juekoperec, iŋuc jaha jaŋe maŋ mocjaha junʒepieŋ.
Jaŋehec jupo sâc biŋedâŋge naremeŋ izi hemiriŋ‐jopape irec maŋnao jumbiŋ. Ehuc soŋaŋ‐jopape moc mi sifuckembiŋ. Dâŋqâreŋ sanaŋkeocte hârâcte biŋe mocjahazi sipirickewec.
Ʒi gorao fâzo ehuc ʒira mâreŋko dâŋ iŋuc gazape nore bubiaŋzi jaŋerao fotâcnerâ ɋârâŋkeme bajunʒepieŋ.
No dâŋge jarepe bajupie mâreŋte biŋe jaŋe qaisoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ. No nahac mâreŋte biŋe mi juekopac, iŋuc jaha jaŋe mâreŋte biŋe mi jueŋgopieŋte iŋuc hâcne ejareeŋgopieŋ.
Go mâreŋkonec rocjopacmurâ mâcne, sâqocnere ŋezic‐jopacmurâ gazakopac.
No gâtâ‐nane mâreŋko mi bawec, iŋuc jaha jaŋe gâtâ‐jeŋic mâreŋko mi bawec.
Gore dâŋ fâri qizecnezi maŋjeŋic furu batec fozejec. Gore mitizi dâŋ fâri qizecne hâcne.
Goki no mâreŋko gie munaremeŋ, iŋuc jaha noni jaŋe mâreŋko gie mujarepo.
Jaŋe dâŋ fâri qizecnezi maŋjeŋic furu bame juniŋte no nahac wâc jaŋere erâ maŋsahac‐nane bâtirirâ râekopac.
“Erâ no jaŋere sawa mi numu‐garekopac, miti jazapie manasiŋnuniŋmu jaŋere mâmâc numu‐garekopac.
Jaŋe maŋwirec erâ juniŋte gazakopac. Mamac, go no maŋnuekic â noni go maŋguekopac, iŋuc jaha jaŋe nâhâc maŋnâfonʒepieŋ. Iŋuc epie miti tâmiric jaŋe gahac sorecnutec wahapo i manapaŋkenʒepieŋ.
Nâhâc maŋ mocjaha juekoperec, iŋuc jaha jaŋe maŋ mocjaha erâ junʒepieŋ. Iŋuc juniŋte hâcne huriri qâreŋ naremeŋ ijaha jarepo.
No maŋjopahape go maŋnutec jaŋe maŋzi ʒâʒâfic ehuc hâcbuc erâ junʒepieŋ. Iŋuc jupie miti tâmiriczi goki sorecnutec wahapo i mana ʒakienʒepieŋ, â no maŋzi ʒâficnuhuc jaŋe mâmâc ʒâfic‐jopaekic, i wâc manapaŋkenʒepieŋ.
Mamac, naremeŋ ŋic i jaŋe no jupemuoa juniŋte mukopac. Eme mâreŋ hobeteŋne mi fuahame maŋjauŋ enarehuc sambâŋ tatamac tahacnumeŋ, i hâcne nohec juhuc hone aŋac enʒepieŋ.
Mamac, tiŋne rune, ŋic jaŋe mi mana taracgumbiŋ, noni ine mana taracguekopac, erâ kikefuŋfâc‐nane jaŋe gahac sorecnutec wahapo i manapaŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
No biŋedâŋge mutaniŋke‐jarepo erâ mutaniŋke‐jarehuc jupemu. Eme maŋjauŋ no enaremeŋ ijaha jaŋerao fome maŋjopahuc jupemu.”
Jesu e nunumu dâŋ i muku mufârerâ motecfâcne rocjopame haeonec hurâ Kidoroŋ opâ herâ, mâreŋ mocko jufu gie fowec, ira rambiŋ.
Jesu â motecfâcne ira gâbâ tumaŋne jumbieŋte Juda docbapa ŋic e jufu i honewec wâc.
Eme ira hâcne juhapie Judazi kiaraonec momori erâ taha bapa micne â farisaio ŋic jaŋeraonec motec rocjopame waha lambe â ʒika barâ rambiŋ.
Eme Jesu e wiac ecneniŋmu i mana‐fârehuc jufu tofanao ra bâfuac‐joparâ wio‐jarewec: “Ŋoŋe mo basaŋgopieŋ?”
Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Jesu Nazarete rune.” Mupie muwec, “No hâcne ʒi.” Ehame Juda docbapa ŋic e ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko domawec.
Eme “no hâcne ʒi” Jesuzi iŋuc jazame jaŋe rârâpe rahuc rândiŋke qambiŋ.
Iŋuc epie hâsine wio‐jarerâ muwec: “Ŋoŋe mo basaŋgopieŋ?” Eme mumbiŋ, “Jesu Nazarete rune.”
Mupie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No ŋazapac i, no hâcne ʒi. No basacnuŋgopieŋko keci jaŋe behec‐jopaniŋ.”
Iŋuc eme dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec i sanaŋkewec: “Naremeŋ jaŋe soŋaŋ‐jopape moc mi sifuckembiŋ.”
Eme Simoŋ Petoro e sâqe bajuwec i becsahackonec unuckerâ taha bapa sâko kiŋaŋ motec‐ticne hazecne fâreopec i qatarawec. Motec ʒâŋene Maiko.
Iŋuc eme Jesuzi Petoro ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Sâqege becsahacko râec huoc. Me ʒâic guru Mamac‐nanezi râe‐narekac, i qikiŋnepemurâ mukic?”
Eme soŋaŋ‐jeŋiczi mume momori â Judaŋic motecfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe Jesu rorâ mene qarâ
Hanasire ficko barambiŋ. Eme dameŋ ira Judaŋic taha bapa sâko‐jeŋic juwec, ʒâŋene Kaifa, eki Hanasire otâ bawec.
Kaifa eki hâcne Judaŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋicguru nâŋâc sipiricke‐fârenʒipeŋte mocjahazi âkehoc‐nâporâ hâmome tarazejec.”
Simoŋ Petoro â motec âgo‐ticne moc jahe Jesu barahapie ʒâhec rapic. Eme âgo‐ticne e ine taha bapa sâkozi hone jujecte Jesu bâjâperâ ficmaŋko mâmâc raʒimbiŋ.
Petoro eki ine sacrâpeo domawec. Eme âgo‐ticnezi taha bapa sâkore ficko jujujecte hurâ sacmotâc soŋaŋ naru e âzâcneme Petoro motâc rocneme sacmaŋko raʒiwec.
Eme motâc soŋaŋ naru eki Petoro honerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋic kecocnirec motecfâc jaŋere guruonec go moc ine hâcne.” Eme eki muwec, “No aricne.”
Eme kiŋaŋ motec â momori jaŋe mâmâteŋte ʒoc ruqerâ ruahuc domahapie Petoro e ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko rarâ iŋuc jaha ʒoc ruawec.
Eme taha bapa sâkozi Jesu motec rocjopawec â miti muwec, irec mu indiŋ ecnewec.
Ecneme Jesuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “No dâŋ hofao tâtâc muekopac, Judaŋic mitificko â taha ufuŋko tumaŋnehapie dâŋ jaza qazuc eekopac, soŋsoŋ mi muekopac.
Irec wemocte no wio‐narekic? Dâŋ jazape manaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ejaretec muekopac sâc gazapie manac.”
Iŋuc mume kiŋaŋ motec doma rambiŋ jaŋeraonec moczi Jesu maucnao qahuc muwec, “Go taha bapa sâko dâŋ iŋucne wemocte âzâcnekomec?”
Eme Jesuzi dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Dâŋ hehesic mukopacko fuŋne mutec manape, â tiŋne mukopacko wemocte nukomec?”
Eme Hanasizi mume Jesu mene qarâ taha bapa sâko Kaifa erao barambiŋ.
Eme Simoŋ Petoro e ine ʒoc ruahuc domahame wiocnerâ mumbiŋ, “Motecfâc‐ticne jaŋere guruonec go moc ine hâcne mecne?” Eme mic barâ muwec, “No aricne.”
Mume taha bapa sâkore kiŋaŋ motec moc, Petorozi hazecne qatarawec ere qomâ, eki ʒiŋuc muwec: “Â go jufuo ehec mâmâc jupie honecgupac.”
Eme Petoro e mic bame izia qâqâczi dâŋewec.
Hae fureme Jesu Kaifare fickonec bawaharâ kiarao barambiŋ. Judaŋic jaŋe ine wâwânâŋ erâ aakic hombaŋko bâtâcko junʒipiŋte kiare ficko mi fembiŋ.
Ehuc hae ʒoŋao domapie Pilatozi ʒaeo waharâ wio‐jarerâ muwec: “Ŋic keci wemo kiŋte bawareŋgopieŋ?”
Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “E sâqocne bapa mi juzac muzac gorao mi bawarenʒapeŋ.”
Mupie Pilatozi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋaŋacne sâcmutâc dâŋ sâcko dâŋticne mutaracneniŋ me.” Eme Judaŋic jaŋe mumbiŋ, “Nâŋe ŋic hâmocko rârâec‐jopare aka henârekicne.”
Judaŋic jaŋe iŋuc epie Jesu e jahac hâmoc‐ticnere dâŋ muwec, hata i âke fuawec.
Eme Pilatozi ficmaŋko ferâ Jesu hefârerâ muwec: “Go jâmbomac Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ me?”
Eme Jesuzi muwec, “Dâŋ i gahacne maŋte mukic me gâcnezi micgao râepie mukic?”
Mume Pilatozi muwec, “Wiac no Judaŋic me? Go gahacne ŋicfâc â taha bapa micne jaŋe norao râecguŋgopieŋ. Go wemo emeŋ?”
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “No mâreŋ ŋicwofuŋ aricne, mâreŋ ŋicwofuŋ juzapo muzac momorifâc‐nane jaŋe ʒikazi ŋezicnuhapie Judaŋic jaŋe wemocko rocnunʒapiŋ. No ine mâreŋ ŋicwofuŋ aricne.”
Eme Pilatozi muwec: “Eme go ŋicwofuŋ fuŋmoc?” Mume Jesuzi muwec, “Ine hâcne mukomec, no ŋicwofuŋ fuŋmoc. No dâŋ fâri qizecne mutaniŋkepemurâ mâreŋko waharâ fuapo. Eme moc e dâŋ fâri qizecne jauŋkeocmuzi dâŋnane âgo ecneocmu.”
Eme Pilatozi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Dâŋ fâri qizecne i wemo wiac moc?” Iŋuc murâ ʒaeo mocwâc hurâ Judaŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No ŋic kecʒirec kiŋ basakopac.
Hata‐ŋeŋic moc fokac. Ŋoŋe aakic hombaŋko mupie no kâpâcwâru ŋic moc akicke‐ŋareekopac. Eme ʒi manapie sâckeme Judaŋic ŋicwofuŋ‐ŋeŋic akickepe juŋarezejec.”
Eme jaŋe harierâ owackehuc mumbiŋ: “Aricne, e mâcne, Baraba akicke‐nârec.” Baraba e ine ʒikaŋic.
Eme Pilatozi mume momori jaŋe Jesu becsahac biriŋneheczi qambiŋ.
Qarâ muc ʒârâneheczi hendiŋ ba akic erâ qizecnao hecnepie huwec â ŋaqi bâbâroŋ mâmâc hecnepie huwec.
Iŋuc erâ maŋfuŋnao birickerâ domahuc fânâŋkecnehuc mumbiŋ: “Ohec, Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ.” Muhuc mainao qambiŋ.
Eme Pilatozi Judaŋic jaŋerao mocwâc hurâ muwec, “Honeniŋ, no ŋoŋerao jowa wahakopac, no kiŋticne basakopacte ŋaŋac fuŋne‐ticne honeniŋ.”
Eme Jesu e muchendiŋ â ŋaqi bâbâroŋ, wiac iŋucnehec waha domame Pilatozi jowaturâ muwec: “Ŋic mac ʒi honeniŋ.”
Eme taha bapa micne â ŋicfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe honerâ dâŋ ɋeŋɋeŋnehec ehuc mumbiŋ: “Maripoŋko feoc, feoc.” Mupie Pilatozi micjeŋicko rorâ muwec: “No kiŋticne basakopacte ŋoŋe ŋaŋac rorâ maripoŋko qaniŋ.”
Eme Judaŋic jaŋe ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “E jahacnere no Anuture Ŋokâ muekac, eme ŋic iŋucne jaŋe hâmoniŋte sâcmutâc dâŋnâŋec fokacte hâmozejec.”
Eme Pilato e dâŋ i manarâ mâretec hâwickewec.
Eme Jesu mocwâc ficmaŋko jowa ferâ indiŋkerâ muwec: “Go wenirec fuameŋ?” Mume Jesuzi micnao mi rowec.
Iŋuc eme Pilatozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go dâŋ mi nazakomec me? Noni mupe jucmu me mupe maripoŋko hâmocmu irec tâpiri râe‐narekicne, i mi manakic me?”
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Mâc muzac go nore dâŋ wemocko munʒaŋ, nore dâŋ mumure faicnec tâpiri qikiŋne‐garekicnere mukomec hâcne. Irec gorao râecnukac ŋic ere kiŋzi gore jâurukac.”
Dâŋ i manarâ Pilatozi Jesu akickezo mume Judaŋic jaŋe owa ruruckerâ mumbiŋ: “Go ŋic e akickerâ Sisare âgo mocwâc mi jucmu. Moc e jahacnere ŋicwofuŋ muhuc Sisa âkehockeocmu.”
Pilatozi dâŋ i manarâ mume Jesu jowa wahapie dâŋ mumutara ŋeŋe‐ticnao waha ŋewec. Ŋeŋe i qânâ ʒaeo râekicne, eme ʒae irec ʒâŋe Judaŋic jaŋe Gabata mujumbieŋ.
Eme Judaŋic jaŋe hae fureme aakic hombaŋ ŋeniŋte teuŋko raʒimbiŋ. Ehame qâqâtâc bembeŋkeha Pilato e ŋeŋe‐ticnao ŋehuc Judaŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Honeniŋ, ŋicwofuŋ‐ŋeŋic ʒi.”
Mume jaŋe owa ruruckerâ mumbiŋ: “E arictac eoc, e arictac eoc, maripoŋko feoc.” Eme Pilatozi muwec: “Hâc, eme ŋicwofuŋ‐ŋeŋic mupe maripoŋko hâmoocte muŋgopieŋ me?” Mume taha bapa micne jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ: “Nâŋe ŋicwofuŋ‐nâŋec moc aricne, Sisa mocjahazi junârekac.”
Eme Pilatozi mana urue‐jarerâ Jesu maripoŋko hâmoocte qikiŋne‐jarewec.
Eme momori jaŋe Jesu rorâ maripoŋ râcnepie hâpome mâreŋ moc ʒâŋene Utusiec, Judadâŋko Goligata, ira barambiŋ.
Bararâ maripoŋko qambiŋ. Erâ sâqocne bapa jajahec mâmâc jofarâ moc ŋifec, moc ŋifec, â Jesu ʒâʒâŋiŋko, iŋuc biric‐jopambiŋ.
Eme Pilatozi mume Jesure qizec botâŋko maripoŋko qâreŋ kecʒiŋuc râembiŋ: “Jesu Nazarete haeonec Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ.”
Jesu qambiŋ mâreŋ i hae bembeŋko fowecte Judaŋic bocjahazi ira rac warec ehuc qâreŋ i wosembiŋ. Eme qâreŋ i Judadâŋko â Romadâŋko â Grikdâŋko râekicne.
Eme Judaŋic jaŋere taha bapa micne jaŋe Pilato ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Go Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ iŋuc mi qâreŋkec. E jahacne muwec, no Judaŋic jaŋere ŋicwofuŋ, iŋuc qâreŋkec.”
Eme Pilatozi muwec: “Qâreŋkepac izia fooc.”
Eme momori jaŋe Jesu maripoŋko qarâ ŋaqi‐ticne faine bâtâcnepie jahec â jahec eme ru sâc embiŋ. Â ŋaqi‐ticne maŋne hâfâ iŋucne oorâŋ fukicnere
ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “I bâtâcnepene sâqoreocmu, irec ɋâsâi qapene rune âke fuaoc.” Iŋuc epie miti papiao dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne i sanaŋkewec: “Jaŋe ŋaqi‐nane faine bâtâc bambiŋ, â maŋnere ine ɋâsâi qambiŋ.”
Momori jaŋe iŋuc hâcne embiŋ. Jesure maripoŋ fuŋko ine ʒiŋuc domambiŋ: Neŋgoc‐ticne â neŋgoc‐ticnere qo, erâ Maria Kelopa ere ŋonâŋ, â Maria Madala haeonec.
Eme Jesu e neŋgoc‐ticne â motec bufuŋ‐ticne domapire honec‐jofarâ neŋgoc‐ticne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋokac, motecge keci hâcne.”
Iŋuc murâ motec‐ticne ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Neŋgocge keci hâcne.” Eme dameŋ ira Jesure neŋgoc jowame motec jahacne ficko ferâ ŋec juc ewec.
Eme Jesu e gie‐ticne tarame manarâ, miti papiao findaŋdâŋ moc fokac i deŋkeocte, ʒiŋuc muwec: “No opâre enarekac.”
Eme râqâc moc maŋnao waiŋ opâ ʒaʒacne ŋewec, ira hâwec sâmbiŋ âke uruckerâ qeŋqeŋko âke kindeŋnerâ micnao iticnepie nâwec.
Waiŋ opâ nârâ wirahuc muwec: “Batarakopac.” Iŋuc mume qizecne forârieme mâro‐ticne wefuwec.
Eme Judaŋic jaŋe teuŋko raʒimbiŋte ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Tomâcko sabata hombaŋ sâkoo ŋic jopakicne jaŋere qâŋɋâŋ maripoŋko mi domazejec.” Iŋuc murâ Pilato âzâcnepie momori jaŋe ŋic siec‐jeŋic qazurâ qâŋɋâŋ‐jeŋic bataraniŋte Judaŋic mana‐jarewec.
Eme momori jaŋe sâqocne bapa Jesuhec jofakicne mocte siec qazurâ ra mocte siec qazumbiŋ.
Iŋuc erâ Jesurao fisirâ honembiŋ: E biac hâmowec. Honerâ siecne mi qaqazu
momori moczi tambaraŋne sânduzi âke mârâŋkeme soc â opâ wahawec.
Wiac i ʒâŋe fâri‐ticnezi honewec eki mutaniŋkeme jâmbomac ekac. E manakac, dâŋ i fârine. Irec ŋoŋe mana ʒakienʒepieŋ.
Miti papiao findaŋdâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc fokac i sanaŋkeocte wiac i fuawec: “Ŋoŋe siecne mi qazunʒepieŋ.”
Erâ wâc miti papiao dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc fokac: “Jaŋe âke mârâŋkembiŋ erao ʒâŋe finʒepieŋ.”
Josefe Arimataia haeonec e Jesure motec juwec, erâ Judaŋic jaŋere hâwickeme fufua mi juwec, soŋsoŋ juwec. Eki hâcne Pilatorao rarâ Jesu qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne bataraocte mufuacnewec. Eme Pilatozi manacneme ra batarawec.
Ehame Nikodemo, ŋafeo Jesu iqickewec, eki wokemaŋ âsu biaŋ â kâŋâ bocjaha amecke rarâ Josefe bafickeme
Jesure qâŋɋâŋ ruacnerâ qoruc qaŋqaŋzi râpâckepic. Judaŋic jaŋe qâŋɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic iŋuc hâcne ejare jumbieŋ.
Eme Jesu qambiŋ mâreŋ irec ŋifecnao jufu gie moc fowec, ira hawec moc ʒâŋeruŋte biŋe gufukicne fowec. Ira ŋic moc mi ducjopakicne, furu fowec.
Eme Judaŋic hombaŋte teuŋko raʒimbiŋte bembeŋko ira hâcne Jesure qâŋɋâŋ râepic.
Eme Sonda hae mi fure taniŋkeha Maria Madala haeoneczi ʒâŋeruŋko rawec. Ra fisirâ honewec: Qânâ e ʒâŋeruŋkonec bârâriekicne.
Iŋuc honerâ gasacke rarâ Simoŋ Petoro â Jesu motec bufuŋ‐ticne jasarâ muwec: “Wofuŋ qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne bawisembieŋ, eme wena râembieŋ i nâŋe kâuc baŋgopeneŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Petoro â motec âgo‐ticne jahe ʒâŋeruŋko rapic.
Hatao gagasac jaha rahuc âgonezi Petoro âte tariŋkerâ biac ra fisiwec.
Ra fisirâ hawecmaŋko mi raʒihuc mâc okarierâ fime raʒime qoruc râpâ sawa fome honewec.
Ehame Petoro e ʒâhec fisirâ maŋnao raʒirâ qoruc râpâ honewec
â qizec‐ticnere foŋ moc buc bazukicne fome honewec.
Iŋuc eme motec âgo‐ticne bâbâni ʒâŋeruŋko fisiwec eki raʒirâ iŋuc jaha hone‐fârerâ manapaŋkewec.
Juwicnao ine jahe Jesuzi hâmockonec ɋârerâ fahareocte miti papiao findaŋdâŋ fowec i mi mana tarapic.
Eme jahe haeo mocwâc risie rapic.
Eme Maria eki ʒâŋeruŋ sahacnao domahuc kiowec; kiohuc ra motâcko okarierâ ʒâŋeruŋko fime raʒime
aŋelo jajahec ŋaqi qaŋqaŋhec Jesure qâŋɋâŋ fofotacnao ŋepire honec‐jofawec, moc e qizecne fowecko â moc e kikene fowecko ŋewec.
Eme jahe mupic: “Ŋokac, go wemocte kiokomec?” Eme eki muwec: “Wofuŋ‐nanere qâŋɋâŋ mocko bawisepie basakopac.”
Iŋuc murâ forisierâ Jesu jahacne honewec. Honerâ Jesu hawarine mi hone tarawec.
Eme Jesuzi wiocnerâ muwec: “Ŋokac, go wemocte kiokomec? Mo basakic?” Eme eki jufu runezi domakac muhuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋicbomboŋ‐nane, goki qâŋɋâŋ mocko bara râemecko mutec manarâ ra rozepac.”
Eme Jesuzi muwec, “Maria.” Mume e forisierâ Judadâŋko “Rabuni” muwec, nâŋâcne dâŋko qaqazu.
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Bâua basanaŋ mi enarec. No Mamactao miŋecnea fepemu i! Go rarâ qomâfâc‐nane ʒiŋuc jazac: Nore Mamaczi ŋoŋere Mamac, â nore Anutuzi ŋoŋere Anutu, eme erao hâcne fepemu.”
Eme Maria Madala haeoneczi risie rarâ motecfâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No Wofuŋ honepe dâŋ iŋuc nazajec.”
Eme Sonda hae ŋafeme motec jaŋe Judaŋic jaŋere hâwic‐jopame tumaŋnerâ ficmotâc ki bafârerâ ŋembiŋ. Ŋehapie Jesu e ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko fuarâ domahuc jazawec: “Wama ŋoŋerao fozejec.”
Iŋuc murâ mejahecne â tambaraŋne jowatuwec. Eme motec jaŋe Wofuŋ honerâ bujeŋic biaŋkewec.
Eme harierâ jazawec: “Wama ŋoŋerao fozejec. Mamaczi no sorecnuwec iŋuc jaha noni ŋoŋe sorec‐ŋopakopac.”
Iŋuc murâ ficnec‐joparâ muwec: “Tiri Mâro ro maŋ eniŋ,
ŋoŋe ŋic sâqocne‐jeŋic mutâmirepie tâmire‐jareocmu, mi mutâmirepie fojareocmu.”
Motec âgo‐jeŋic moc ʒâŋene Toma, ʒâŋene moc Didimo, eki mocko juhame Jesuzi fua‐jarewec.
Eme motec âgofâcne jaŋe biŋedâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Nâŋe Wofuŋ honembeneŋ.” Iŋuc mupie muwec: “No nahac ʒâŋe jâmbâŋ‐nanezi menao biriŋ râfu honerâ menanezi râfu bahonerâ tambaraŋne bâuarâ dâŋŋeŋic manape fârine eocmu.”
Sonda mocwâc fuame motec jaŋe Tomahec mâmâc ficko qâzuckerâ motâc ki bafârerâ ŋembiŋ. Ŋehapie Jesu e ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko mocwâc fuarâ domahuc jazawec: “Wama ŋoŋerao fozejec.”
Iŋuc murâ Toma âzâcnewec: “Go memotecgezi menane bahonec â mege sicnerâ tambaraŋ‐naneo râec, erâ maŋjahec mocwâc mi ehuc manasiŋnuzemec.”
Eme Tomazi muwec: “Go Wofuŋ‐nane â Anutu‐nane.”
Mume Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go honecnukomecte manasiŋnukomec, mi honecnuhuc manasiŋnueŋgopieŋ jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac.”
Mâsi gâcne bocjaha Jesuzi motecfâcne jaŋere ʒâŋe faio bawec, i papia ʒira mi qâreŋke‐fârekicne.
Qâreŋkekicne mac kecʒi ine ʒiŋucte qâreŋkekicne: Ŋoŋe wose manac erâ Jesu e Kristo, Anuture Ŋokâ, dâŋ i mana ʒakienʒepieŋ, erâ e jahacne manasiŋkehuc ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnere erâ juju sanaŋhec enʒepieŋ.
Juku motec jaŋe Tiberia riqicko juhapie fua‐jarewec. Kecʒiŋuc ehapie fua‐jarewec:
Jumbiŋ ine Simoŋ Petoro, Toma, ʒâŋene moc Didimo, Natanae e Galilaia mâreŋko Kana hae ŋewec irecnec, erâ Ʒebedaio ŋokâ jahec‐ticne â motecfâcne jaŋeraonec jajahec mocwâc, ŋic iŋuczi jumbiŋ.
Ehuc Simoŋ Petorozi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “No qowi rozo rakopac.” Mume mumbiŋ, “Nâŋe gohec mâmâc ranaŋ.” Iŋuc murâ wokeo ferâ rambiŋ. Ra juhuc ŋafe ira qowi mi rombiŋ.
Eme riqicko juhapie hae fufurecte Jesuzi moŋgeŋko domawec. Domame Jesu hawarine mi hone tarambiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi wio‐jarerâ muwec, “Motec, qowi‐ŋeŋic moc fokac me?” Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Aricne.”
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Woke fâreopec wasaŋ behepie qowi jowaocmu.” Mume wasaŋ behepie qowi mâretec jâmbâŋ jowa susuckeme fâre‐bipiembiŋ.
Eme Jesu motec bufuŋ‐ticnezi Petoro ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “I Wofuŋ ine hâcne.” Mume Wofuŋ ʒâŋe manarâ Simoŋ Petoro e kambaŋ sawa qajuwecte ŋaqi‐ticne faine heme hume riqicko rucnewec.
Jaŋe moŋgeŋ heririŋ (100 meta irec sâc) jumbiŋte motec gâcne jaŋe woke foickehuc wasaŋ qowihec fâre fâre rambiŋ.
Eme moŋgeŋko ferâ tiŋko wiac ʒiŋuc honembiŋ: Ʒoc uucko opâ qowi â nânâ ʒegoc ʒahuc fowec.
Ra fisipie Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Qowi rombieŋ i tucne bareniŋ.”
Mume Simoŋ Petorozi wokeo ferâ wasaŋ tiŋko fâreme fewec. Maŋnao qowi kâcqene 153 fowec, eme sifu mi tâcnewec.
Eme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ware furic nânâ nâniŋ.” Mume motec jaŋe wemocko ʒiŋuc wionʒapiŋ: “Go mo?” Jaŋe Wofuŋ ine hâcne i mana‐fârembiŋ.
Eme Jesuzi warerâ nânâ qowi bâtâc bahuc jarewec.
I Jesu e hâmockonec faharerâ motecfâcne fua‐jareme jahec â moc ewec.
Furic nânâ nâpie Jesuzi Simoŋ Petoro ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnewec: “Simoŋ Johanere ŋokâ, âgofâcge jaŋe no maŋzi ʒâficnueŋgopieŋ, go jowarurâ sâc moc ʒâficnuekic me?” Eme Petorozi muwec, “Wofuŋ, no gore enarekac i manakomec.” Eme Jesuzi muwec: “Go lamafâc‐mae soŋaŋ‐jopazemec.
Iŋuc murâ mocwâc wiocnewec: “Simoŋ Johanere ŋokâ, go jâmbomac ʒâficnuekic?” Eme Petorozi muwec: “Wofuŋ, no gore enarekac i manakomec.” Mume Jesuzi muwec: “Go lamafâc‐nane jaŋere soŋaŋ juzemec.”
Iŋuc murâ harierâ wiocnewec: “Simoŋ Johanere ŋokâ, go jâmbomac nore egarekac me?” Ʒâʒâficte wiocneme jahec â moc eme Petoro e bune sâqoreme muwec: “Wofuŋ, go wiac sasawa mana‐fâreekic, no gore enarekac i wâc manakomec.” Mume Jesuzi muwec: “Go lamafâc‐nane soŋaŋ‐jopazemec.
Jâmbomac jâmbâŋ gazape: Go ŋicmotec juhuc becsahacge jomarâ hata ira me ira razo egareme rajumec. Izi juku ŋicqizec erâ mege bâfeŋnetec ŋic moczi becsahac joma‐garerâ mi razo mucmu ira bacgu raocmu.”
Jesu e iŋuc muhuc Petoro hâmoc‐ticnere dâŋ suŋsuŋne âzâcnewec. Hâmoc‐ticne fuŋmoczi Anutu muteŋkeocte manasuhuc muwec hâcne. Dâŋ iŋuc murâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ware bâjâpecnuc.”
Eme Petoro e fotikierâ Jesu motec bufuŋ‐ticnezi râpefuŋnao rame honewec. Motec e aakic lama nâmbiŋko qizec‐ticne Jesure amecko fohorerâ wiocnerâ muwec: “Wofuŋ, mozi doc bacguocmu?”
Eme motec hâcne ʒâhec rame Petorozi honerâ Jesu wiocnerâ muwec: “Wofuŋ, motec kecʒizi ine weniŋuc eocmu?”
Wiocneme Jesuzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “E juhame no risiepemurâ manacnepe fokacko ere dâŋ wemocte mukomec? Go mâc bâjâpecnuc.”
Eme miti mamana gâcne jaŋe ʒâhec Johanere ʒiŋuc musifuckembiŋ: “Motec e mi hâmoocmu.” Jesu e ine ere ʒiŋuc mi muwec: “E mi hâmoocmu.” Dâŋ ʒiŋuc sawa âzâcnewec: “E juhame no risiepemurâ manacnepe fokacko ere dâŋ wemocte mukomec.”
