Motec eki hâcne wiac ʒi hone mana tarac eku mutaniŋkehuc papia ʒi qâreŋkewec. Eme nâŋe ere manaeŋgopeneŋ, dâŋticne fârine jâmbâŋ.
Eme Jesuzi wiac gâcne gâcne ewec bawec, i wemocko papiao qâreŋke‐fârezo. I papiao fofâreme muzac, no manape ŋiczi wowose tarane mi ezac.
O Teofilo, no mârâc dâŋ qâreŋke‐garepo, ine Jesuzi gie bawec â miti muwec irec dâŋ binaŋ sasawa egarepo.
E gie‐ticne fuŋkerâ baraku dameŋ‐ticne maickeme Tiri Mârozi ecneme aposolo rowosâec‐jopawec jaŋe micrâfâ‐ticne jaza tararâ sambâŋko fewec, irec binaŋ hâcne qâreŋke‐fârepo.
E ʒâic manaku hâmorâ mocwâc ɋârerâ jaŋe hâcne ʒoaŋ gie bapa 40 fua soŋ ejarehuc fuŋne‐ticne bajaŋgeŋkeme hone manac embiŋ, â Anuture uucmaŋ irec dâŋ jaza mutâc ewec.
Erâ jaŋehec ŋec domac ehuc dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe Jerusalem hae jâpec mi behenʒepieŋ, Mamacte biŋedâŋ ŋazape manambiŋ, i fârinehec eocte ira woŋec junʒepieŋ.
Johane e opâ rua‐ŋarewec, ʒi ine dameŋ mi ʒorahame Tiri Mâro rua‐ŋarezo.”
Iŋuc mume, tumaŋnerâ jumbiŋ jaŋe ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnembiŋ: “Wofuŋ, go dameŋ ira hâcne Israe ŋic qâzuc‐nâpotec mocwâc nâŋe nâŋâcne ŋicwofuŋhec erâ junaŋmu me?”
Mupie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Mamac e tâpiri‐ticnere erâ dameŋ ʒoric qândâŋ bawec fokac i ŋoŋe mamanane mi ekac.
Mocjaha Tiri Mârozi ŋoŋerao waharâ tâpiri bâfua‐ŋareme biŋe mumufâc‐nane eniŋmu. Ehuc Jerusalem haeo bâtâcnerâ miti‐nane Judaia â Samaria mâreŋko murâ murakupie mâreŋ qaŋeŋne sâcke‐fâreocmu.”
Dâŋ iŋuc murâ ʒâŋe fai‐jeŋicko afeckerâ fewec. Fehame karoraczi bâsoŋkeme basambiŋ.
Eme sambâŋko fehame firâ râqârehuc domahapie ŋic jajahec ŋaqi qaŋqaŋhec mi jaŋerao fuarâ domazepirec i!
Erâ ʒiŋuc jazapic: “Galilaia mâreŋkonec ŋicbureŋ, ŋoŋe wemocte sambâŋko fihuc jaha domaŋgopieŋ? Jesu ŋoŋe honehapie behec‐ŋoparâ sambâŋko fekac, eki hâcne juku iŋuc jaha wahazokac.”
Eme aposolo jaŋe Oliwa tikionec risie waharâ raʒimicnao Jerusalem hae ŋewec ira raʒimbiŋ. Sawane i sabata hombaŋko hata rarane irec sâc.
Raʒirâ haeo ferâ ŋeŋe juju ehuc jumbiŋ fic ira fembiŋ. Jumbiŋ ine ʒiŋuc: Petoro â Johane, Jakobo â Anderea, Filipo â Toma, Batolomaio â Mataio, Jakobo Alifaiore ŋokâ, Simoŋ Ʒelote, erâ Juda Jakobore ŋokâ.
Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne maŋ mocjaha erâ nunumu gie ʒuʒuhuc jaha bahuc jumbiŋ. Iŋuc ehapie Jesure neŋgoc Maria â ŋokac gâcne â Jesu ɋafâc‐ticne jaŋe mâmâc bafic‐jopambiŋ.
Dameŋ ira Jesure qâjâpecfâc ʒare‐jeŋic 120 qâririŋ iŋuczi tumaŋnerâ ŋehapie Petoro e ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko faharerâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Âgo bureŋ, Juda râsi jowac‐jopame Jesu rombiŋ ere dâŋ Tiri Mârozi Dawidi mic ba afec ecneme mu qâreŋ ewec i wemocko mâc fozac.
Juda e nâŋâcnaonec hâcne, â miti gie i e mâmâc mucnekicne.
Eme ŋic eki ʒika furizi mâreŋ kitâcnecnewec ira ra qizeczi qârisic hurâ bune qâfâuckeme hone waha‐fârewec.
Eme biŋe i Jerusalem haeoneczi mana‐fârerâ mâreŋ irec ʒâŋe Akedama mumbiŋ, nâŋâcne dâŋko Ʒikamâreŋ.
Miti mânecko ʒiŋuc hâcne qâreŋkekicne fokac: ‘Hae‐ticne tuhu fuazejec, â ficticnao ŋic moc mi juzejec.’ Erâ moc ʒiŋuc: ‘Mafa‐ticne i furunezi rauckezejec.’
Eme Jesu ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko jume ju ecnepene ŋic gâcnezi qâsuec‐nâpombiŋ,
ehuc Johanezi Jesu Miti Opâ ruacneme gie‐ticne fuŋkewec dameŋ ira erao ʒuhuckerâ bâjâpehuc juhapene sambâŋko fewec, ŋic iŋucne moczi fuarâ bafic‐nâpome, Jesu hâmockonec faharewec irec biŋe mupene haŋ bazejec.”
Petorozi iŋuc jazame ŋic jajahec bâfuac‐jofambiŋ. Moc ʒâŋene Josefe, Basaba mucne jumbieŋ, ʒâŋene moc Jusito, erâ âgone Matia.
Bâfuac‐jofarâ ʒiŋuc muhuc numumbiŋ: “O Wofuŋ maŋ hohone, go ŋicjahec ʒi jaheraonec wenimoi bâwosâekomec i nâwotutec mucnepene
Juda miti â aposolo gie‐ticne hetararâ e jahacne hatao rawec ere jujutacko juzejec.”
Iŋuc numurâ miti ɋâsâi qapie Matia âke fuame aposolo 11 jaŋerao ʒuhuckewec.
Pentekoso dameŋ maickeha jaŋ mâmâc sasawa fic mocjahao qâzuckerâ ŋefârembiŋ.
Ŋehapie sambâŋkonec fânâŋ moc mâŋâŋ hâhâwicne ere fânâŋ tinac ɋeŋfâfâc jaha fânâŋke wahawec. Waharâ fic ŋembiŋ ira raʒirâ fusucmawec.
Ehame jaŋerao wiac moc hawarine ʒocnameŋ tinac fuarâ domahuc ŋeratierâ ŋic ŋokac qizec‐jeŋic sâc biricke rawec.
Eme Tiri Mârozi maŋjeŋicko hurâ fusucmame dâŋmarac fuŋne fuŋne dâŋembiŋ, Mârozi ru sâc bâfua‐jareme dâŋe rambiŋ.
Eme dameŋ ira Jerusalem haeo mâreŋ sâc irecnec Judaŋic mitine jumbiŋ.
Eme jaŋe fânâŋ sâko i manarâ mâretec fisirâ tumaŋnehuc bipic tatara embiŋ. Ehuc aposolo jaŋe dâŋjeŋic sâc dâŋepie
manarâ maŋjeŋic goroŋkeme wareckerâ mumbiŋ, “Ŋic dâŋeŋgopieŋ ʒi jaŋe Galilaia ŋic sasawa,
jaŋe weniŋuc erâ dâŋnâŋec sâc dâŋepie manapene dâŋrune marac efârekac?
Nâŋâc ʒi Pataŋic â Medeŋic â Elamŋic, erâ Mesopotamia mâreŋkonec â Judaia mâreŋkonec â Kapadokia mâreŋkonec â Ponto mâreŋkonec â Asia mâreŋkonec
â Frigia mâreŋkonec â Pamfilia mâreŋkonec â Aigita mâreŋkonec â Africa mâreŋkonec Kirene hae rârec rârec irecnec, nâŋâc Romaŋic
â Judaŋic mafa â hae fâri erâ Kretaŋic â Arabia ŋic. Nâŋâc iŋuczi juhuc dâŋnâŋec sâc Anutu mâsi sâko‐ticnere biŋedâŋ mupie manaŋgopeneŋ.”
Ŋic jaŋe iŋuc murâ maŋjeŋic goroŋkeme kâuc barâ nazaŋ gazaŋ erâ mumbiŋ, “I wemo mâsi mo?”
Gâcnezi ine aposolo mufec muriŋ ejarehuc mumbiŋ, “Jaŋe waiŋ opâ gapecmâc nâmbieŋte maŋjeŋic bibiriwakac.”
Eme Petoro e âgofâcne 11 jaŋehec domahuc dâŋ hahaŋne barâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Judaŋic â Jerusalem haeo juŋgopieŋ sasawa, no dâŋ ŋazape hazec‐ŋeŋic râerâ mananiŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic kecʒi jaŋere muŋgopieŋ ‘Waiŋ opâ nâku maŋjeŋic bibiriwakac.’ Iŋuc aricne. Hae miŋecne furekacte wemocko waiŋ opâ nanʒapeŋ.
Porofete Joelezi findaŋdâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkewec i sanaŋkekac hâcne:
‘Anutuzi mukac: Juku mâreŋ dameŋne bembeŋkeha, no Mâro‐nane ŋic ʒeŋgoma sâcke‐jarepemu; eme otâ ŋokâfâc‐ŋeŋic findaŋdâŋ muniŋmu, socɋârifâc‐ŋeŋic wiac ʒâŋe furu honeniŋmu, â ŋic ŋokac qizecfâc‐ŋeŋic guŋ fârine mananiŋmu.
Erâ kiŋaŋ qaqa ŋic ŋokacfâc‐nane dameŋ ira Mâro‐nane sâcke‐jarepe findaŋdâŋ muniŋmu.
Erâ mupe faic sambâŋko ʒâŋe furu wiac fuaocmu, â juwic mâreŋko fuŋne qaqa mâsi fuaocmu, soc â ʒoc â hosâc rombâŋ.
Ʒoaŋ ʒâŋene hâpoocmu, â mosa ʒâŋene socsoc eocmu, ehame Wofuŋte dameŋ maickeocmu, dameŋ biaŋ sâko hâcne.
Eme ira Wofuŋte ʒâŋe riwaseckeniŋmu, jaŋe sisipirickonec batarac‐jopazo.’
“Israe ŋicbureŋ no ŋazape mananiŋ: Jesu Nazarete haeonec e Anutuzi neŋgoc ŋesiŋ ŋecnehame ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko tâpiri sâko‐ticnezi mâsi â wiac ʒâŋe furu bahuc, Anuturaonec wahawec, irec fuŋne‐ticne bataniŋkeme honembiŋ.
E hâcne Anutuzi mârâc jaha maname fowecte hata mutaracnewec irec sâcko ŋoŋe wiac ecnehuc doc barâ ŋic qâpuc jaŋerao râepie maripoŋko qapie hâmowec.
E hâcne hâmoczi gozi kime Anutuzi gozi bacneme ɋârerâ faharewec. Hâmoczi e wemocko sakarezac.
Dawidizi ere hâcne kecʒiŋuc muwec: ‘No Wofuŋ hone dendeŋnehuc mi beheekopac, e fâre‐naneo domahame biric boroc mi epemu.
Irec bunane biaŋkeme nameŋzi mu ʒeri ekopac, erâ sahac‐nanezi wâc sâcne ŋec foc eocmu. Go mi qaisocnutec hâmoc haeo ʒâziŋkepemu, â Tiriŋicge mi behetec gârecke ʒaŋ eocmu.
<range>
Go jujure hata nowatumeŋ, maigao ʒeri bubiaŋ guru dindiŋ bâfua‐narecmu.’
“Âgo bureŋ, no mimiŋne‐nâŋec Dawidi ere acmâc ŋazape, e hâmome duckembiŋ, eme ʒâŋeruŋ‐ticne hone manac ehuc jueŋgopeneŋ.
E porofete juweczi ʒiŋuc manawec: Anutu e ɋâricfâc‐nane jaŋeraonec moc âkendâŋneme nore ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋetacko ŋeocte mupaŋke‐narewec.
I manahuc juwicnao Kristo fafahare‐ticnere hâcne muwec, ‘E hâmoc mi qikiŋnecneocmu â sahac‐ticne gârecke ʒaŋ mi eocmu.’
Eme Jesu e hâcne Anutuzi baɋâreme fahareme nâŋe ʒâŋe fâri‐nâŋeczi hone‐fârembeŋ.
Eme Anutu mefârenao risie feme Tiri Mâro biŋe qanâre‐kicne e hâcne Mamaczi qikiŋnecneme soreme wahame fuŋne‐ticne hone manac eŋgopieŋ ʒine hâcne.
Dawidi e jahacne sambâŋko mi fewec, mâc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc ine muwec: ‘Wofuŋzi nore Wofuŋ âzâcnewec: Ware fâre‐naneo ŋehaŋtec,
râsifâcge guruc‐jopape kikegere ââtesiŋ enʒepieŋ.’
Irec Israe ŋic mâmâc sasawa ʒiŋuc mana sanaŋkenʒepieŋ: Ŋoŋe Jesu maripoŋko qambiŋ, e Anutuzi Wofuŋ â Kristo âkendâŋne‐nârewec jukac.”
Petorozi dâŋ iŋuc jazame maŋjeŋic henʒaŋneme e jahacne â aposolo gâcne ʒiŋuc mu wioc ejarembiŋ: “Ŋic âgofâc, nâŋe weniŋuc epene sâckeocmu?”
Mupie Petorozi ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic bârisierâ Jesu Kristo ʒâŋene biŋeckehuc Miti Opâ ruapie sâqocne‐ŋeŋic tâmirezejec, eme Anutuzi Tiri Mâro tahacke‐ŋareocmu wâc.
Ŋaŋacne â ɋâricfâc‐ŋeŋic â ʒoricko juraŋgopieŋ, Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋeczi hefârec‐ŋopaocmu sâc, ŋoŋe hâcne Tiri Mâro biŋe qaŋare‐fârekicne.”
Petoro e iŋuc murâ dâŋ gâcne ʒuhuckerâ uŋ sawaŋ ejarehuc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe ŋic bâbâsifucne jaŋere guruonec wiserâ wefupie rocŋopazo.”
Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa ira ŋic 3 tauseŋ jaŋe Petorore mitidâŋ mana ʒakiepie Miti Opâ rua‐jarepie Jesure kikefuŋfâc jaŋerao ʒuhuckembiŋ.
Eme aposolo jaŋe miti jaza qazuc epie mananiŋte henʒiriŋnehuc jumbiŋ, ehuc maŋzi roroc bâmbândeŋ erâ tiwâre â nunumure gâbâ tumaŋne jumbieŋ.
Eme ŋic ŋokac ʒeŋgoma hâwic sahac efârembiŋ â aposolo jaŋe mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bahuc jumbiŋ.
Opâ ruac jaŋe maŋzi ʒâʒâfic erâ wiac sasawa‐jeŋic wirec bajumbiŋ.
Â gâcne jaŋe ine jufu mafa wiac‐jeŋic qikiŋnepie moneŋ kitâcneme âgofâc‐jeŋic waha qaqane wiac basambiŋ sâc bâtâc bajarembiŋ.
Jaŋe ʒoaŋ gie bapa sâc taha ufuŋko maŋ mocjaha erâ tumaŋne jumbieŋ â tiwâ i ficjeŋic sâc nâjumbieŋ. Ehuc nânâ‐jeŋic bubiaŋko bâtâc tâmiric nâhuc jumbiŋ.
Erâ Anutu mumbiaŋkehuc jumbiŋ. Iŋuc epie ŋic gâcnezi hone ʒiziwec‐jopambiŋ. Eme Wofuŋ e ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne ŋic mitizi bâpiaŋ‐jopahame guru‐jeŋicko ro ʒuhuc ejarewec.
Ʒoaŋ mocko Petoro â Johane jahe owâ gieo nunumu dameŋ maickeme taha ufuŋko fepic.
Ehame ŋic moc neŋgoc bumaŋkonec puriŋ fuakicne e reŋke warembiŋ. Ŋic e âgofâcne jaŋe ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne taha ufuŋte Motâcbiaŋko râepie ŋehuc ŋic ufuŋko fec wahac embiŋ jaŋe bâmec wiacte numu‐jare jujec.
Eme Petoro â Johane jahe taha ufuŋko fezo ehapire honec‐jofarâ iŋuc jaha numu‐jactewec.
Numu‐jacteme jahe e hone dendeŋnepic, ehuc Petorozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go nâhe honec‐nâfoc.”
Mume ŋicpuriŋzi wiac moc narezo mukopirec muhuc nâckâbâc jaha honec‐jofawec.
Iŋuc ehame Petorozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Moneŋ boreŋ wiac no mi fonarekac, wiac mocjaha fonarekac ine garepe roc, Jesu Kristo Nazarete haeonec ere micte gazape fahare hata juc.”
Iŋuc murâ mefârenao rohuc bafaharewec. Ecneme izia kike bibiric‐ticne urueme fu herâ fahare domawec,
erâ jahehec mâmâc taha ufuŋko fembiŋ, erâ hata juju‐ticnere kiwac qawac ehuc Anutu muteŋkewec.
Eme ŋic sasawa jaŋe hata jume â Anutu muteŋkeme honembiŋ.
Ehuc ʒâŋitarâ mumbiŋ, “Taha ufuŋte Motâcbiaŋko bâmec wiacte numu‐nârehuc ŋeekac ine hâcne.” Erâ biaŋkewec irec hone fâfârerâ mâretec seckembiŋ.
Eme Petoro â Johane jaherao qohotame ŋic mâmâc sasawa taha ufuŋ maŋne moc ʒâŋene Salomo ira jaherao tumaŋne‐fârehuc me kirâ domambiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Petorozi honec‐joparâ ŋic dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Israe ŋicbureŋ, ŋoŋe wemocte ŋic ʒirec hone warec boc enâctehuc domaŋgopieŋ? Wiac nâhe nâhâcne mitire me tâpirire e hata juju‐ticne bâfuacnekoperec me?
Aricne, Abraham â Isaka â Jakobo jaŋere Anutu, mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋere Anutu, eki hâcne kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Jesu ere Wofuŋ qâreŋ ŋic kecʒirec faio bâfuame honeŋgopieŋ. Ŋoŋe ine e qaisockerâ qâpuc jaŋerao râembiŋ. Ehame Pilatozi firuezo mume ŋoŋe qikiŋnembiŋ.
Ine hâcne Maŋɋaɋac â Tiŋne rune e qikiŋnehuc ʒika qaqaŋic akicke‐ŋareocte mu bâuruec ecnembiŋ.
Ehuc jujure Micne bapa qambiŋ. Qapie Anutuzi bâɋâreme hâmockonec fahareme ʒâŋe fâri‐nâŋeczi qame honembeŋ.
Eme hone manac ecneeŋgopieŋ ŋic kecʒi e Jesu ʒâŋe‐ticne manasiŋkepene ʒâŋe‐ticnere tâpirizi bâpiaŋkeme sahac ɋiɋic eme hone‐fâreŋgopieŋ.
Erâ qomâfâc‐nane, no manakopac, ŋoŋe â micne bapafâc‐ŋeŋic ŋoŋe kâuc bahuc iŋuc embiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Anutu e Kristo ʒâic manaku hâmoocte irec dâŋ porofete sasawa jaŋere micko râeme mu qâreŋ embiŋ i hâcne sanaŋkewec.
Irec ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic bârisierâ juju raŋɋa‐ŋeŋic râpeckepie kiŋŋeŋic tâmirezejec. Eme Wofuŋte maio nanaŋ ʒurec ʒurec juju irec dameŋ maicke‐ŋarezejec.
Erâ wâc Kristo‐ŋeŋic baʒawie‐ŋarewec, Jesu hâcne, sore‐ŋarezejec.
Ʒi ine Jesu e sambâŋzi foŋkeme jukuhame wiac sasawa Anutuzi mârâc jaha jâmbâŋ porofetefâc‐ticne micjeŋicko râeme mumbiŋ i fâri fideteŋ eocte dameŋne maickeocmu.
Mose e dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: ‘Wofuŋ Anutu e qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec porofete moc no iŋucne bâfua‐ŋareme dâŋ ŋazame sâc mananʒepieŋ.
Eme moc e dâŋticne qikiŋneme e qarâ qârârâŋnenʒepieŋ.’
Erâ porofete gâcne Samue jume juwarembiŋ jaŋe iŋuc jaha dameŋ ʒirec dâŋ mu qâreŋ efârembiŋ.
Porofete jumbiŋ jaŋere ɋâricfâc ŋoŋe, erâ Anutuzi mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ewec, ʒâʒâfic irec rune ŋoŋe jaha wâc. Ʒâʒâfic i Abraham ʒiŋuc âzâcnehuc bâfuawec: No ɋâricfâcge jambuŋ‐jopape jambuŋ izi mâreŋne mâreŋne ŋic sâcjopa‐fârezejec.’
Ŋoŋere hâcne Anutuzi qanaŋ manasurâ Ŋokâ‐ticne soreme waha fuawec, i ŋoŋe sasawa sindaŋ hata‐ŋeŋickonec bârisiec‐ŋopahuc jambuŋ‐ŋopaocte iŋuc hâcne ewec.”
Petoro â Johane jahe ŋic dâŋ iŋuc jazahuc domahapire taha bapa â ufuŋte polisman micne â sadukaio ŋic jaŋe mâmâc jaherao fisimbiŋ.
Jahe ŋic miti jazahuc, Jesu e hâmockonec ɋârewec, biŋedâŋ i muiŋnepire manapie sâqoreme
rocjofarâ hae biac owâewecte kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐jofapie fohapire hae furewec.
Eme Petorozi miti mume manambiŋ jaŋeraonec bocjahazi i mana ʒakierâ Jesure kikefuŋfâc jaŋerao ʒuhuckepie ŋic sasawa ʒare‐jeŋic 5 tauseŋ ewec.
Hae fureme micne bapa â soŋaŋ â miti qaqazu jaŋe Jerusalem haeo
taha bapa sâko Hanasi â Kaifa â Johane â Alesande â kikefuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec tumaŋnembiŋ.
Erâ mupie aposolo jahe tutumaŋ‐jeŋicko bacjofa fembiŋ. Eme mai‐jeŋicko domapire esâic‐jofarâ mumbiŋ, “Mozi mamac eŋactehuc mu qafeŋ eŋacteme mâsi i bapirec?”
Eme Petoro e Tiri Mârozi maŋnao fusucmame dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Micne bapa â soŋaŋfâc‐nâŋec, mupe mananiŋ:
Nâhe ŋicpuriŋ jauŋkeperec, irec ŋoŋe, mozi neŋgoc ŋesiŋ eŋacteha ŋic bâpiaŋkepirec, muhuc miŋecgac mu gufuc enâcteŋgopieŋko
mutaniŋkepe ŋoŋe â Israe ŋic mâmâc sasawa mananiŋ: Jesu Kristo Nazarete haeonec, ŋoŋe maripoŋko qapie hâmome Anutuzi hâmockonec bâɋâreme faharewec jukac, ere tâpirire ŋic keci sahac ɋiɋic ejec mai‐ŋeŋicko domakac hâcne.
Ficbapa ŋic ŋoŋe Jesu e wâtuŋ sâqocne muhuc behepie izi hâcne jâmâ wâtuŋ sâko ewec domakac.
Bâbâpiaŋ i ŋic moctao moc mi fokac, â ŋic mocte ʒâŋe riwaseckehuc bibiaŋkene i wâc mâreŋko mi fokac.”
Eme Petoro â Johane jahe ŋic omane, mamana ficko mi jukicnezi hâhâwic tâmiric micafec jaha dâŋ mupire manarâ wareckembiŋ. Erâ jahe Jesuhec jupic i hone tarac‐jojambiŋ,
â ŋic sahac ɋiɋic eweczi jaherao domame e wâc honehuc irec dâŋ bâtikie‐jacteniŋte basambiŋ.
Basarâ ejactepie hae ʒoŋao hurâ domahapire jaŋackoaŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc nazaŋ gazaŋ embiŋ:
“Nâŋâc ŋic jahe weniŋuc ejactenaŋ? Jahe mâsi bapire fua tâcneme Jerusalem haeoneczi biŋene biac mana‐fârembieŋ, irec wemocko hemackezo?
Eme dâŋ i hae sâc haŋ bame mana‐fârenʒipiŋte mu hâhâwic ejactepene ŋic hâcne ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne mocwâc mi jaza‐jâmbâŋkezepirec.”
Iŋuc murâ hefârec‐jofarâ ʒiŋuc jasambiŋ: “Ŋohe Jesure ʒâŋe ŋic mocwâc mi jaza qazuc ejâmbâŋkezepirec.”
Mupie Petoro â Johane jahe dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarepic: “Ŋoŋe ŋaŋac mana honeniŋ, ŋoŋere dâŋ reŋkehuc Anuture dâŋ qiqikiŋ, irec Anutuzi maname sâckeocmu me?
Wiac hone manac ehuc jumbeŋ i sâcne mi hesoŋkerâ junaŋmu.”
Iŋuc mupire jaŋe mu hâhâwic dâŋ mocwâc jasahuc râec‐jofapie rapic. Haeŋic ŋokac omane jaŋe mâsi i hone manac erâ Anutu mucne bacnembiŋte jaŋerao quŋkehuc aposolo jahe wiac mi ejactembiŋ.
Ŋic sahac ɋiɋic bakicne e puriŋ fohuc juha jara 40 ewec i mana‐fârembiŋ hâcne.
Petoro â Johane jahe ŋic tutumaŋkonec waharâ âgo wiacfâc‐jekic jaŋerao rarâ taha bapa micne â soŋaŋ jaŋe dâŋ jasambiŋ irec mu binaŋ ehuc jaza‐fârepic.
Eme jaŋe i manarâ maŋjeŋic qâzuckerâ Anuturao sâsepie fehame ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Wofuŋ sâko Wofuŋ, go sambâŋ â mâreŋ â hâwec i wiac fuŋne fuŋne‐jeŋichec râemeŋzi
Tiri Mâro ecnetec eki mimiŋne‐nâŋec Dawidi, kiŋaŋŋicge hâcne, micne baafeckeme dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: ‘Qapuc jaŋe wemocte ju fâfânâŋ eeŋgopieŋ, â ŋicne ŋicne dâŋ racne birickeeŋgopieŋ?
Wofuŋ â Kristo‐ticne râsi ejacteniŋte mâreŋ sâc ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe meo roroc eeŋgopieŋ, â ŋicbomboŋ jaŋe ââte sanaŋ eeŋgopieŋ.’
“Hae kecʒira ine jâmbomac tiri Ŋokâge Jesu, Kristo âkendâŋnemeŋ, e râsi ecneniŋte Herode â Pilato jahe ŋic qâpuc jaŋehec â Israe ŋic jaŋehec dâŋ ŋiŋihec embiŋ.
Erâ gahacne mezi â miczi mu bâmoc emeŋ irec sâcmac embiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋ, ʒi ine mu hâhâwic dâŋjeŋic hone manac ehuc kiŋaŋŋicfâcge hâbi hejaretec mitige hâhâwicmâc munʒepieŋ.
Ehapie mege sicnetec sahac ɋiɋic â mâsi fuŋne fuŋne tiri kiŋaŋŋicge Jesu ere erâ fua razejec.”
Iŋuc numupie fic, tumaŋnerâ ŋembiŋ, qiriŋ qiriŋ qawec. Ehame Tiri Mârozi maŋjeŋicko fusucmame Anuture dâŋ micafec jaha ŋic jazambiŋ.
Opâ ruac guru jaŋe maŋ mocjaha ehuc ʒâʒâfic erâ jumbiŋ. Ehuc wiac fojarewec irec nore gore mi muhuc qâqâhâc mocjaha fojarewec.
Eme aposolo jaŋe Wofuŋ Jesu hâmockonec faharewec irec biŋedâŋ tâpiri jaha muhuc jumbiŋ. Eme aki anonoc sâkozi sâcjopa‐fârerâ fowec.
Erâ ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko moczi tac qararacne mi juwec. Jufu gie â mafa wiac‐jeŋichec jumbiŋ jaŋe i qikiŋnepie moneŋ kitâcne‐jareme
aposolo jaŋerao râembiŋ. Eme jaŋe ŋic wiac basapie sâc bârâwiŋnerâ jare jumbieŋ.
Eme ŋic moc juwec ʒâŋene Josefe, aposolo jaŋe ʒâŋene moc Banaba mumbiŋ, nâŋâcne dâŋko Bâmiriŋmotec, e Lewire ɋâric, Kipiro nucko fuawec.
Ŋic eki jufu‐ticne qikiŋneme moneŋ fuame aposolo jaŋerao furu jaha râe‐fârewec.
Eme ŋic moc juwec ʒâŋene Anania, e ŋonâŋ‐ticne Safira ehec muc manac ehuc hae mâreŋ‐ticne qikiŋneme moneŋ fua‐jacteme
mamanac erâ tucne hefackepire fojactewec â tucne sawa ŋiczi aposolo jaŋerao râewec.
Râeme Petorozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Anania, go wemocte Sataŋzi maŋge bâsifuckeme Tiri Mâro eatuckehuc hae mâreŋgere furi tucne hefackekomec?
Hae mâreŋge fogarezo murâ fogarezac, me qikiŋnerâ furine moneŋ rorâ izi iŋuc me iŋuc ezo murâ enʒaŋ. Go weniŋuc erâ maŋgezi surucgume iŋuc emec? Go ŋic nâŋe mâcne, go Anutu eatuckekomec.”
Iŋuc mume Anania e dâŋ mana manahuc rândiŋke qarâ hâmowec. Eme hone manac embiŋ jaŋe hâhâwic sâko fua‐jarewec.
Eme ŋicmotec domambiŋ jaŋe qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne qoruczi râpâckerâ bara duckembiŋ.
Eme aua 3 tarame ŋonâŋ‐ticne biŋe mi mamana, mâc fokac muhuc fisiwec.
Fisime Petorozi ʒiŋuc wiocnewec: “Hae mâreŋte furine ine mac hâcne warejec?” Eme eki muwec, “Ine mac sawa hâcne.”
Mume Petorozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ŋohe wemocte Wofuŋte Mâro eatuckenicte mamanac epirec? Manakic, ŋowege duckembieŋ motâc râpeo domaŋgopieŋ, jaŋe go iŋuc jaha bacgu ra ducguniŋmu.”
Iŋuc mume izia kikefuŋnao rândiŋke ɋarâ hâmowec. Eme ŋicmotec jaŋe ficmaŋko ferâ qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne honerâ bara ŋowe‐ticne duckembiŋko ijaha duckembiŋ.
Eme opâ ruac guru â ŋic gâcne biŋe‐jekic manambiŋ jaŋerao hâhâwic sâko fuawec.
Aposolo jaŋe mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bocjaha ŋic jaŋerao bambiŋ. Eme Jesure kikefuŋ jaŋe taha ufuŋ maŋne moc ʒâŋene Salomo ira maŋ mocjaha erâ tumaŋne jumbieŋ.
Tumaŋnehapie ŋic gâcnezi araŋ bajarehuc enʒaŋauc kosa mi ejare jumbieŋ. Jaŋe opâ ruac jaŋere manapie bipinehec ewec.
Erâ ŋic â ŋokac gurune gurune miti mana ʒakiehuc Wofuŋtao ʒuhucke jumbieŋ.
Erâ wâc âgofâc‐jeŋic huc ʒâichec hatao fofo â kanʒe faio kecʒiŋuc muhuc râec‐jopambiŋ: Petorozi rac warec eme nâkumuc‐ticnezi foninipec‐jopazejec.
Erâ Jerusalem hae rârec rârec ŋic jurambiŋ jaŋe orâŋ bârâŋ fisihuc jumbiŋ. Ehuc huchec â demoŋhecfâc‐jeŋic mâmâc amec‐jopa fisipie biaŋke‐fârembiŋ.
Eme wiac iŋucne fuame taha bapa sâko e â qaŋeŋfâc‐ticne, sadukaio ŋic hâcne, jaŋe maŋzi ruc bahuc
aposolo mana sâqore‐jarerâ rocjoparâ kâpâcwâru fic sâkoo râec‐jopambiŋ.
Eme ira fohapie ŋafeo Wofuŋte aŋelozi motâc rojarerâ jowac‐jopa hurâ ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Ŋoŋe taha ufuŋko ferâ ŋic sasawa juju hata kecʒirec biŋedâŋ jazahuc domanʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc jazame jaŋe manarâ furicte taha ufuŋko ferâ miti mumbiŋ. Ehame taha bapa sâko e â qaŋeŋfâcne jaŋe qâturerâ ŋic fekicne â Israe ŋic micne guru‐jeŋic hefârec‐jopapie furu fisimbiŋ. Erâ polisman jaŋe kâpâcwâru ficko ra aposolo rocjopapie fisiniŋte mumbiŋ.
Eme polisman jaŋe ra kâpâcwâru ficko basac‐joparâ risierâ mumbiŋ,
“Nâŋe ra fisirâ motâc kine sanaŋne bakicne honembeneŋ, erâ soŋaŋ jaŋe motâcko domambieŋ wâc. Erâ motâc rorâ ferâ ŋic ine basac‐jopambeneŋ.”
Dâŋ i mupie ufuŋte polisman micne â taha bapa micne jaŋe manapie quŋkewec.
Ehapie ŋic moczi fisirâ muwec, “Manaŋgopieŋ, kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐jopambieŋ jaŋe ufuŋko ŋic miti jazahuc domaŋgopieŋ.”
Mume polisman micne eki soŋaŋfâcne rocjopame ra aposolo urucko jowac‐jopa warembiŋ. Ŋic jaŋe qânâzi hecjopanʒipiŋte hâwic‐jopame wânʒâŋnehec ʒame kirac mi ejarembiŋ.
Eme micne bapa tutumaŋko râec‐jopapie domahapie taha bapa sâkozi dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Nâŋe ŋic hâcne ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne mi mupie haŋ baocte mic muac mi eŋarembeŋ me? Eme ŋoŋe sifu dâŋ i Jerusalem haeo mocwâc muiŋneŋgopieŋ, ehuc ŋic hâcne ere kiŋ nâŋere faio râezo muŋgopieŋ.”
Mume Petoro â aposolo gâcne jaŋe dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnembiŋ: “Ŋicdâŋ reŋkehuc Anuture dâŋ qiqikiŋ i mi fokac.
Ŋoŋe Jesu maripoŋko qarâ qâhâmopie mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋere Anutuzi bâɋâreme faharewec.
Fahareme Anutuzi e jahacne mefâreo râerâ micne sâko â bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec âkendâŋnewec. Eme ʒi Israe ŋic ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic bârisiepie sâqocne‐ŋeŋic ʒureocte muekac.
Eme irec biŋe hâcne Tiri Mâro â nâŋe mueŋgopeneŋ. Tiri Mâro e Anutuzi micrereŋfâc‐ticne jareekac.”
Dâŋ iŋuc jazame bujeŋic henʒaŋneme mana hâtâwerâ aposolo jopaniŋte mumbiŋ.
Eme tutumaŋ‐jeŋicko farisaio ŋic moc ŋewec, ʒâŋene Gamalie, e sâcmutâc dâŋ qaqazu‐jeŋic fekicne. Eki hâcne mume aposolo jaŋe hae ʒoŋao hurâ juhapie
micne bapa âgofâcne ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Israe ŋicbureŋ, ŋoŋe ŋic i wiac mana wosâehuc ejarenʒepieŋ.
Mârâc ŋic moc ʒâŋene Teuda eki, no ŋicbomboŋ micne‐ŋeŋic, iŋuc mume ŋic 400 erao qohotambiŋ. Eme e jahacne ʒika kime ŋicfâc‐ticne tâtiepie gie‐jeŋic omatac fuawec.
Erâ ʒâhec Galilaia mâreŋko ŋic moc ʒâŋene Juda, e wose qâreŋ enârembiŋ dameŋ ira ŋic gâcne qafeŋ‐jopame bâjâpembiŋ. Eme e jahacne qahuc ŋicfâc‐ticne jopa qâtâtiec ejarembiŋ.
Irec ʒi dâŋ ŋazape mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe ŋic ʒi behec‐jopapie juniŋ. Jaŋe dâŋ â gie i maŋjeŋicte mu bac eeŋgopieŋko sifuckerâ arictac eocmu.
Me Anutuzi neŋgoc ŋesiŋ ejarehame mu bac eeŋgopieŋko bâipiec‐jopaniŋmu. Ŋoŋe gie‐jeŋic ima bahuc Anutu e jahacne râsi ecnenʒipiŋkohec.”
Iŋuc jazame jaŋe manapie sâckeme aposolo ejarepie tutumaŋko fepie kâcbiŋzi jopambiŋ. Joparâ ŋic Jesure ʒâŋe biŋe mi jazaniŋte muac‐joparâ sorec‐jopambiŋ.
Sorec‐jopapie Wofuŋ e jaŋere maname sâckeha ʒâŋe‐ticnere erâ ʒika kimbiŋte bubiaŋ manahuc ŋic tutumaŋkonec waharâ rambiŋ.
Erâ ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne taha ufuŋko â ŋicficko Jesu Kristo ere Biŋebiaŋ jaza qazuc erâ mi behembiŋ.
Dameŋ ira opâ ruac guru sâko embiŋte nânâ bârâwiŋne‐jarehuc Grik opâ ruac jaŋere hozec bâtiric‐jopapie Juda opâ ruac jaŋere manapie mi sâckeme dâŋ bâfuambiŋ.
Iŋuc epie aposolo 12 jaŋe opâ ruac hetumaŋ‐jopa‐fârerâ ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Nâŋe sahackopec gie i dopeckehuc Anuture dâŋ mumu irec gie behepene wahame mi sâckeocmu.
Irec ŋic âgofâc, ŋoŋe ŋic 7 ŋaŋacne ŋondeŋko Mâro â mamanahec jupie honec‐jopapie sâckeme rowosâec‐jopanʒepieŋ. Eme nâŋe gie i mujarepene banʒepieŋ.
Nâŋe ine nunumu â miti mumu irec gie paŋʒâic jaha banʒepeneŋ.”
Dâŋ iŋuc mupie opâ ruac jaŋe manapie sâcke‐fârewec. Ehuc ŋic ʒiŋuc bâwosâec‐jopambiŋ: Stefano, e maŋnao mamanasiŋ â Tiri Mâro fufusuc fowec, erâ Filipo â Porokoro â Nikano â Timoŋ â Pamena â Nikolao, e Antiokia haeonec ŋic qâpuczi Judaŋic jaŋerao ʒuhuckewec.
Eme ŋic i hâcne jaŋe aposolo jaŋere maŋfuŋko birickerâ domapie mejeŋic qizec‐jeŋicko râehuc numu jambuŋ ejarembiŋ.
Eme Anuture dâŋzi haŋ bahuc fome Jesure kikefuŋ jaŋerao denaŋne denaŋne ʒuhuckeme ʒuhuc erambiŋ. Erâ taha bapa jaŋeraonec wâc bocjahazi miti mana rereŋ embiŋ.
Stefano e miti â tâpiri bocjaha focnewecte ŋic jaŋerao mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bawec.
Eme Hotâonec mujarembiŋ ŋic i jaŋere mitificko tumaŋne jumbieŋ, jaŋeraonec ŋic gâcne â Kirene ŋic â Alesandria ŋic â Kilikia ŋic â Asia ŋic, iŋuczi qâturerâ Stefano mu qatarac ecnembiŋ.
Eme e dâŋ mana utuckehuc Mârohec mume jaŋere dâŋzi firorieme eipiecnembiŋ.
Eipierâ ŋic qafeŋ‐jopapie jaŋe Stefanore ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋic e Mose â Anutu musoriŋ‐jofame manambeŋ.”
Iŋuc ehuc ŋic omane â soŋaŋ â miti qaqazu mu âke ɋâfoŋ ejarembiŋ. Erâ Stefano somâckerâ hâporâ micne guru tutumaŋko barambiŋ.
Ehuc dâŋ qanaŋ bâmockerâ âgofâc‐jeŋic jarepie bajumbiŋ jaŋe ejarepie Stefanore burec ehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋic e tiri ufuŋ â sâcmutâc dâŋnâŋec surehuc juekac.
Nâŋe kecʒiŋuc mume manambeŋ: ‘Jesu Nazarete haeonec eki hâcne ufuŋ ʒi ima qahuc sâcmutâc dâŋ Mosezi mufua‐nârewec i hetâtieocmu.’”
Eme tutumaŋko ŋembiŋ ŋic i jaŋe Stefanorao firâ râqârehuc ʒâŋe maine honepie aŋelo hawari tinac ewec.
Eme taha bapa sâkozi Stefano wiocnerâ muwec, “Dâŋ muŋgopieŋ i jâmbomac me?”
Mume Stefano ʒiŋuc muwec: “Kâcɋenefâc‐nane â âgofâc‐nane, dâŋ mupe mananiŋ: Mimiŋne‐nâŋec Abraham e Haraŋ haeo mi rahuc Mesopotamia mâreŋko juhame Tatamac Anutuzi fuacnerâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
‘Go mâreŋ qizecge â mame sâkofâcge behec‐joparâ noni mâreŋ moc gowatupe ira ra juzemec.’
Eme e dâŋ i manarâ Kaldea mâreŋ‐ticne beherâ Haraŋ haeo ra juwec. Ira juhame mamac‐ticne hâmome Anutuzi mâreŋ ŋoŋe rauckerâ juŋgopieŋko ʒira hâcne jowa warewec.
Jowa warerâ mâreŋ mi qikiŋnecneme rauckewec, aricne, moc mi râcne huŋgaŋke‐jâmbâŋkewec. E â ɋâricfâc‐ticne ʒâhec rauckeniŋte biŋe sawa qacnewec. I ɋâric tâmiric juha sifu iŋuc mucnewec.
Ehuc Anutuzi dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc muwec: ‘Ɋâricfâcge jaŋe jara 400 mâreŋ furune mocko jaba juhuc kiŋaŋ qaqa erâ sisi hâhâŋ faio junʒoŋgopieŋ.’
Erâ dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ muwec: ‘Kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic bacjopaniŋmu ŋic i okacne jarepe ɋâricfâcge râec‐jopapie mâreŋ kecʒira warerâ no kiŋaŋ qanarehuc junʒoŋgopieŋ.’
Eme Abraham e ɋâricfâc‐ticne ere biŋe qacjopahuc sahac‐jeŋicko ma baocte mucnewecte ŋokâ‐ticne Isaka fuarâ fohame ʒoaŋ gie bapa 8 eme iŋuc hâcne ecnewec. Eme Isakazi Jakobo bâfuawec, â Jakobozi mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec 12 bâfuac‐jopawec.
“Eme mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe ɋajeŋic Josefe iiŋguuŋ ecneku moneŋte qikiŋnepie Aigita mâreŋko barambiŋ. Ira ra juhame Anutuzi ehec juhuc
ʒârâ hâriŋ faionec batararâ jauŋ â miti tahackecneme Aigita ŋicwofuŋ Farao eki hone biaŋkerâ e jahacne fic hae â Aigita ŋicfâc‐ticne mâmâc soŋaŋ‐jopahuc juocte ŋicbomboŋ sâko âkendâŋnewec.
Âkendâŋneme juhame roroc fuarâ Aigita â Kanaaŋ mâreŋko qarâ suriŋkerâ fome hae mâreŋ hâŋkewec. Eme mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe nânâre hâmohuc jumbiŋ.
Eku Jakobo e, Aigita mâreŋko nânâ fokac, iŋuc mupie manarâ ŋokâfâcne sorec‐jopame ira rambiŋ.
Eme harierâ mocwâc rapie Josefezi hahacfâc‐ticne fuŋne‐ticne mutaniŋke‐jareme Faraozi fufua‐ticnere fuŋne wâc manawec.
Eme Josefezi mume mamac‐ticne Jakobo â wiacfâc‐ticne sasawa, ŋic ŋokac 75, amec‐jopa rambiŋ.
Eme Jakobo e Aigita mâreŋko rarâ juku hâmowec â ŋokâfâc‐ticne mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe iŋuc jaha hâmo‐fârembiŋ.
Hâmopie qâŋɋâŋfâc‐jeŋic Sikemko bacjopa warerâ, Abrahamzi Sikem haeo Hamorore ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec mâreŋ moc ʒâŋeruŋte biŋe moneŋzi furine bawec, ira ducjopambiŋ.
“Eme Anutuzi Abraham dâŋbiŋe qacnewec i sanaŋkeocte dameŋ bembeŋkezo ehame jaŋe Aigita mâreŋko mâretec sawe mâririackembiŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc juhapie Aigita ŋicwofuŋ furune moc fuawec eki Josefe kâuc bawec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋ eki hâcne mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec doc bacjopahuc sipiric‐jopawec. Ehuc mume ɋâricfâc‐jeŋic behec‐jopapie hâmocko rafârembiŋ.
Dameŋ ira hâcne Mose fuawec. Motec e Anutuzi honeme biaŋne jâmbâŋ ewec. Eme mamac‐ticnere ficko soŋsoŋ barâ juhapie mosa jahec â moc ewec.
Eku behepie Farao otâ‐ticnezi bâfuarâ motec bawec.
Eme Farao ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe Aigita ŋic jaŋere mamana sasawa qazucnepie mana sanaŋkerâ wiac mume bame bipinehec ewec.
“Juku jara‐ticne 40 bazurâ Israe ŋic âgofâc‐ticne hone manac ejareocte maŋne afeckeme rawec.
Rarâ Aigita ŋic moczi Israe ŋic moc qame honerâ âgo‐ticne ŋezickehuc Aigita ŋic hâmocne qawec.
Ehuc muwec, no âgofâc‐nane Faraore meonec batarac‐jopapemurâ Anutuzi gie bakac i mana taraniŋmu. Eme jaŋe ine mi mana tarambiŋ.
Eme hae fureme mocwâc rarâ Israe ŋic jajahec qaqac ehapire bâfuac‐jofarâ mu bârâwiŋ ejactehuc ʒiŋuc jasawec: ‘Ŋic jahec, ŋohe ââgozi wemocte rârâsi ekopirec?’
Mume ŋic ʒika fuŋkerâ âgone qaweczi dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: ‘Go nâhere kia me soŋaŋ mozi râecguwec?
Jacne Aigita ŋic qamec iŋuc jaha no nuzo mukic me?’
Eme Mose e dâŋ i manarâ izia wiserâ ra Midiaŋ mâreŋko ŋic furune jaŋere ŋondeŋko juwec. Erâ ŋokac bame ŋokâ jajahec fuacnepic.
“Eme jara 40 mocwâc juku ra mâreŋ burocnao Sinai tikifuŋko juhame aŋelo moczi jâc dutunao ʒocbâruŋ maŋko fuacnewec.
Eme Mose e wemo wiaczi weniŋuc ekac muhuc hone‐hâmoocte rame Wofuŋte dâŋ ʒiŋuc fuawec:
‘No mimiŋnefâcge jaŋere Anutu, Abraham â Isaka â Jakobo jaŋere Anutu hâcne. Eme Mose e ɋarac ɋarac qahuc dunduŋ dadape domawec.
Domame Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: ‘Mâreŋ âtekomec i tiri mâreŋ, irec kikehuhuge heunuckec.
Ŋicfâc‐nane Aigita mâreŋko fific guguriŋ ejarepie kio wâwâsic epie mana wefukupe tarakac. Eme ʒi batarac‐jopapemurâ wahakopac hâcne. Irec go Aigita mâreŋko sorecgupe razemec.’
“Ŋic jaŋe Mose qikiŋnehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: ‘Go mozi kia me soŋaŋ‐nâŋec râecguwec?’ Eme Anutuzi ŋic e hâcne micne bapa â babatara‐jeŋic eocte muhuc aŋelo‐ticne ecneme ʒocbâruŋ maŋko fuacnerâ gie i mucnewec.
Ehuc soreme ra jowac‐jopa warewec. Iŋuc ehuc Aigita mareŋko â Hâwec Bâbâroŋko â mâreŋ tuhuo mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bahuc juhame jara 40 ewec.
Erâ Mose ekizia wâc Israe ŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: ‘Anutu e âgofâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere ŋondeŋkonec porofete moc no iŋucne bâfua‐ŋareocmu.’
Iŋuc muwec. Erâ ekizia wâc mâreŋ burocnao mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec hombaŋ tutumaŋ‐jeŋicko juhuc Sinai tikio aŋelo mickonec fofo sanaŋ dâŋ manarâ jazawec.
Mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe ine dâŋticne beherâ e jahacne bâsuerâ Aigita mâreŋko risieniŋte maŋjeŋic domame
Aroŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: ‘Go ɋâŋ qâqâtâc moc banâretec izi bânie‐nâreme risienʒepeneŋ. Mose Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐nâpo warewec e sifucke wiac moc ewec mecne.’
Iŋuc murâ bulimakao qâqâtâc barâ bâzi rikecnehuc, mejeŋiczi bambiŋ wiac i mu ʒeri ecnembiŋ.
I epie Anutuzi behec‐jopame maŋjeŋic sifuckeme mosa bâpiŋ jaŋerao siŋkembiŋ. Eme irec hâcne porofete jaŋere papiao dâŋ ʒiŋuc fokac: ‘Israe rune ŋoŋe jara 40 mâreŋ burocnao juhuc qowi bâzi me bâzi gâcne moc rike‐narembiŋ me?
Ŋoŋe Molokore qoruc boze reŋke jumbieŋ â nemu Refaŋ ere bâpiŋ hawari bajumbiŋ. Wiac i hâcne numucneniŋte ba akic embiŋ. Irec no Babe ocniŋucnao râec‐ŋopapemu.’
“Mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mâreŋ tuhuo miti qoruc boze ŋejarewec i Anutuzi Mose hawarine jâutuhuc mutâcnecnewec sâc bakicne.
Eme boze i hâcne mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe tuczi tuc bawareku Josuazi micne bajareme ʒira qâpuc jaŋere mâreŋko bafisimbiŋ. Bafisipie Anutuzi ŋic qâpuc jopa jâpec ejareme mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mâreŋ rauckerâ miti boze‐jeŋic ijaha wâc bapie ŋejarehame Dawidi fuawec.
Erâ Dawidi e Jakobore Anutu ere jauŋzi erao fome manahuc ufuŋ bacneocte âzâcnewec.
Erâ e jahac mâcne, Salomozi Wofuŋ ufuŋ bacnewec.
Femicne sâko e ine ufuŋ ŋicmezi bakicne ira ŋeŋe juju mi eekac. Porofete micko dâŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fuakac:
‘Sambâŋzi ŋeŋe‐nane â mâreŋzi kike ââtesiŋ‐nane. Wofuŋzi mukac, fic weniŋucne moc banarepie sâckeocmu, me ŋeŋe fofo weniŋucne moc bâfua‐narepie sâc nuocmu?
No menanezi wiac sasawa i mi bâfua‐fârepo me?’
“Râŋgeŋ qaŋqaŋne ŋoŋe, maŋ hazec‐ŋeŋic mi uŋtokicne, mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic ejumbieŋ iŋuc jaha ŋoŋe ehuc Tiri Mâro jâpe hetapaic ecnehuc jueŋgopieŋ.
Mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe mo porofete mo akickembiŋ me? Aricne, tiŋne rune fuaocte findaŋdâŋ mumbiŋ ŋic i jaŋe wâc mâmâc jopambiŋ. Juku e jahacne doc bahuc qaqa, ine ŋoŋe hâcne embiŋ.
Sâcmutâc daŋŋeŋic aŋelo miczi mukicne i ŋoŋe sifu qâsuambiŋ.”
Stefanozi dâŋ iŋuc jazame bujeŋic ʒâʒâficne qame aaric sâko manambiŋ.
Stefano ine Tiri Mârozi maŋnao fusucmame sambâŋko fime feme Anuture tatamacko Jesu Anutu mefârenao domame honehuc muwec,
“Manaŋgopieŋ, no sambâŋ aŋkeme Ŋic Fâri Wâtuŋne Anutu mefârenao domame honekopac.”
Iŋuc mume dâŋ ojowa sâko hâsockecnehuc hazecjeŋic bâbâzickerâ izia mâmâc sâko ɋuruŋ herâ hâpo rârierâ tuŋke tuŋke raku
hae râpeo fisirâ qânâzi hembiŋ. Ehuc soŋaŋ jaŋe ŋaqi‐jeŋic ʒoricne hetararâ ŋicmotec moc ʒâŋene Saulo ere kikefuŋko guruckembiŋ.
Erâ Stefano qânâzi hepie nunumu dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: “O Wofuŋ Jesu, go maŋ qâqâtâc‐nane roc.”
Iŋuc murâ dieŋzi herâ mocwâc wiwic jaha muwec, “Wofuŋ go kiŋ kecʒi behe‐jarezemec.” Iŋuc murâ hâmowec. Qapie hâmome Saulozi maname sâckewec.
Eme dameŋ ijaha Jerusalem haeonec opâ ruac kikefuŋ râsi sâko fuŋke‐jarembiŋ. Ejarepie wiserâ râwiŋ qâwiŋ erâ Judaia â Samaria mâreŋko rafârembiŋ. Aposolo jaŋe sawa getâc‐jopapie jumbiŋ.
Eme ŋic mitine gâcne jaŋe Stefano duckerâ kio mamakuc ecnembiŋ.
Saulo eki ine opâ ruac ima bacjoparâ ficne ferâ ro fârec ejarehuc kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐jopahuc domawec.
Opâ ruac bâtâtiec‐jopakicne jaŋe ine hae sâc juhuc ŋic miti jaza rambiŋ.
Eku Filipozi Samaria ŋic jaŋere hae qizecko fisirâ Kristore biŋedâŋ jazawec.
Jazame ŋic guru sâko jaŋe dâŋticnere ejareme mana aŋac embiŋ. Ehuc mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bame honembiŋ.
E demoŋ bocjaha jâpe‐jareme ŋicmaŋkonec wefurâ owackehuc wisembiŋ. Erâ wâc ʒeke puriŋ â kike demba bocjaha sahac ɋiɋic bacjopawec.
Eme irec hae ira ʒeri kâcɋene fuawec.
Eme hae ijaha qaŋgec bapa moc juwec, ʒâŋene Simoŋ. E jahacnere no ŋic fekicne muhuc qaŋgec gie bame Samaria ŋicguru jaŋe honepie bipinehec ewec.
Ehuc fekicne wahakicne jaŋe ere manapie fefene eme ʒiŋuc mujumbieŋ: “Ŋic kecʒizi Anuture tâpiri, Sokawec Sâko mucnekicne, irec hozine hâcne.”
Eme qaŋgec‐ticnezi maŋ bâsifuc ejarewecte dameŋ ʒora erao qohotahuc jumbiŋ.
Juhapie Filipozi Anuture uucmaŋte Biŋebiaŋ â Jesu Kristore dâŋ binaŋ jazame mana ʒakierâ ŋic â ŋokac mâmâc Miti Opâ ruambiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Simoŋ e iŋuc jaha miti mana ʒakierâ opâ ruarâ Filipore maŋfuŋko juwec, ehuc mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bame hone warec mâretec ehuc juwec.
Eme Samaria ŋicguru jaŋe Anuture dâŋ ro maŋ epie irec biŋe Jerusalem haeo aposolo jaŋerao rame manambiŋ. Ehuc Petoro â Johane sorec‐jofapie rapic.
Ra fisirâ jaŋe Tiri Mârohec eniŋte Wofuŋ numucnepic.
Juwicnao Tiri Mârozi jaŋerao mi wahawec, jaŋe mâc Jesure ʒâŋeo ʒuhuckehuc Miti Opâ sawa ruambiŋ.
Eme aposolo jahe mejekic qizec‐jeŋicko râepire jaŋe Tiri Mârohec embiŋ.
Aposolo jahe ŋic jaŋere qizec faio mejekic râepire Tiri Mârohec epie Simoŋzi honerâ jaherao moneŋ amecke fisirâ
ʒiŋuc jasawec: “Ŋohe tâpiri i no iŋuc jaha narepire ŋic mocte qizecko menane râepe Tiri Mârohec ezejec.”
Mume Petorozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Anuture jauŋ moneŋzi furine bazo mukomecte moneŋgezi gohec mâmâc sisipiricko razac me!
Anutuzi maŋsiocge honekacte tâpiri ʒizi moc mi hehuŋgaŋguhame mâc jâmbâŋ jucmu.
Go bâbâsifucge qikiŋnehuc maŋge bârisierâ Wofuŋ numucnetec maŋgao andac sâko bâtâmire‐garezejec.
Go sâqocne hâtânezi hariŋguekac hâcne.”
Eme Simoŋzi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋohe ŋahac nore erâ Wofuŋ numucnepire akicnuha wiac mukopirec i mi fua‐narezejec.”
Eme aposolo jahe ŋic ŋokac Wofuŋte dâŋ jaza sanaŋkerâ Jerusalem haeo risiepic. Risiehuc Samaria hae bocjaha Biŋebiaŋ jaza jaza rapic.
Wofuŋte aŋelo moczi Filipo ʒiŋuc muhuc âzâcnewec: “Go ʒawierâ juwickopec, Jerusalem haeonec Gaza haeo hueŋgopieŋ hata ira razemec.” Hata i mâreŋ tuhuo fokac.
Iŋuc muhuc âzâcneme Filipozi ʒawierâ rawec. Eme Etiopia mâreŋko ŋokac wofuŋ juwec, ʒâŋene Kandake, ere ŋicbomboŋ â moneŋ mafa soŋaŋ sâko eki Jerusalem haeo Anutu mai ecneocte rafeweckonec
risieocte keretacko rahuc porofete Jesaja ere dâŋqâreŋ wosewec.
Iŋuc ehame Mârozi Filipo ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ajoc, go ra keretac kecocni bâfuac.”
Mume Filipozi ra bâfuarâ ŋic e porofete Jesaja ere dâŋqâreŋ wosehame manarâ wiocnewec, “Dâŋ wosekomec irec fuŋne manakic me?”
Eme eki muwec, “Moczi mi nazahame nahackoaŋ wemocko sâcne manapemu?” Iŋuc murâ Filipo âzâcneme keretacko ferâ qâteme ŋepic.
Dâŋqâreŋ wosewec ine kecʒiŋuc: “Lama moc qa hezuc eniŋte baraeŋgopieŋ, me kanʒaŋ bâbâtâc ŋic erao fâsâerâ foekac, iŋuc hâcne micticne moc mi aŋkewec.
Bâpitiwambiŋko kiŋ babatara i erao tarawec. Â mâreŋko juju‐ticne qâriuŋkewecte qaŋeŋfâcne mozi wose manac ejare‐fâreocmu?”
Eme ŋicbomboŋ e Filipo ʒiŋuc muhuc wiocnewec: “Go mutec manape, porofete e more iŋuc mukac, e jahacnere me ŋic mocte?
Eme Filipo e porofetere dâŋko iticnehuc Jesure Biŋebiaŋ âzâcnewec.
Iŋuc ehuc raku opâo fisipic. Eme ŋicbomboŋzi muwec, “Honec, opâ fokac ʒi; Miti Opâre mupe sâcne rua‐narecmu me?”[
Eme Filipozi muwec, “Dâŋ gazapac i maŋ hâcbuc mana ʒakiekomecko sâcne eene.” Eme dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnewec: “Jesu Kristo e Anuture Ŋokâ i mana ʒakiekopac.”]
Iŋuc murâ keretac bâniniŋkerâ Filipo â ŋicbomboŋ opâo hupic. Hurâ Filipozi ruacnewec.
Eme opâonec wefupire Wofuŋte Mârozi Filipo jowa rame ŋicbomboŋzi mocwâc mi honehuc bubiaŋko hata‐ticnao rawec.
Filipo eki ine Asidode haeo fisime honembiŋ. Erâ irecnec fuŋkerâ haene haene miti jaza raku Kaisarea hae bâfuawec.
Saulo e Wofuŋte kikefuŋ râsi ejarehuc ima bacjopaocte maŋʒoc‐ticne gâmâc gâfâŋ wefuhuc domawec. Ehuc ra taha bapa sâkorao mume
Damasko haeo Judaŋic jumbiŋ jaŋere papia qâreŋkerâ râcnewec. Râcneme rorâ ocna hata ɋârio moc jupie bâfuac‐joparâ ŋic mecne ŋokac mecne mejeŋic qarâ Jerusalem haeo bacjopa wareocte rawec.
Izi raku Damasko hae bâqiŋkezo ehame sambâŋkonec ʒoc tatamaczi uŋ herâ waha âeckewec.
Âeckeme mâreŋko rândiŋke qarâ fohuc dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc manawec: “Saulo, Saulo, go wemocte nu jâpec enarehuc juekic?”
Mume Saulozi wiohuc muwec, “Wofuŋ go mo?” Eme muwec, “Nu jâpec enarehuc juekic Jesu no hâcne.
Go faharerâ haeo ratec ira wiac ecmurâ dâŋne gazaniŋmu.”
Eme ŋic ehec jumbiŋ jaŋe dâŋwe tâmiric mâc fâsâerâ domambiŋ, jaŋe dâŋ sawa manambiŋ, â ŋic ine moc mi honembiŋ.
Eme Saulo e faharerâ ʒâŋe fiocte fi qeruruc ewec. Iŋuc eme ŋicfâcne jaŋe menao rorâ Damasko haeo barambiŋ.
Eme ira ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc tiŋtuŋ jaha fohuc nânâ opâ mi nâwec.
Damasko haeo Jesure qâjâpec moc juwec, ʒâŋene Anania, e Wofuŋzi maŋko fuac ecnehuc wiracnewec, “Anania.” Eme muwec, “Wofuŋ no ʒi.”
Mume Wofuŋzi ʒuhuckerâ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Go hata ʒâŋene Dândâŋne mueŋgopieŋ ira rarâ Judare ficko ferâ ŋic moc ʒâŋene Saulo, Taso haeonec, e bâfuazemec. Manakic, e numu‐narehuc fokac.
Erâ maŋticnezi wiac ʒiŋuc honejec: Ŋic moc ʒâŋene Anania erao fisirâ ʒâŋe fifihec eocte mene qizecnao râejec.”
Wofuŋ e dâŋ iŋuc muhuc âzâcneme Ananiazi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Wofuŋ, ŋic ere mâretec mupie manaekopac, e fuŋfuŋfâcge Jerusalem haeo ba imac wemo afecne ejareekac.
Erâ ʒira iŋuc jaha ʒâŋege riwaseckeeŋgopeneŋ nâŋe repac‐nâporâ bacnâpo raocte taha bapa micne jaŋe mucnembiŋ.”
Mume Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go sifu rac, ŋic e mefâro‐nane, eki hâcne ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane ŋic qâpuc â ŋicwofuŋ â Israe guru jaŋerao barahuc juzejec.
Iŋuc ehame no ʒâŋe biŋe‐nanere erâ ʒârâ hâriŋ faio juocte qazucnepemu.”
Eme Anania e rarâ fic mukicne ira ferâ Saulore qizecko meticne râehuc muwec, “Saulo qomâ‐nane, Wofuŋ Jesu hatao fua‐garewec, eki hâcne sorecnume warekopac, go ʒâŋe fifi ehuc Tiri Mârohec ecmurâ mukac.”
Iŋuc muhuc âzâcneme izia ʒâŋenaonec wiac gagara tinac wahame ʒâŋe fifi erâ faharerâ mume Miti Opâ ruacnewec.
Ehame nânâ nârâ sanaŋkewec. Saulo e Jesure kikefuŋ Damasko haeo jumbiŋ jaŋehec piticne jurâ
izia biac Judaŋic jaŋere mitificko ferâ Jesure biŋe muropiehuc kecʒiŋuc jazawec: “Jesu e Anuture Ŋokâ.”
Iŋuc jazame manarâ quŋkecnehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Jerusalem haeo ʒâŋe i hâcne riwaseckepie ima bacjopaku ʒira iŋuc jaha repac‐joparâ taha bapa micne jaŋerao bacjopa raocte warewec, izi weniŋuc erâ hec hetikic ekac?”
Eme Saulo e samandiŋkerâ, Jesu e Kristo jâmbâŋ, irec dâŋfuŋne muritu‐hâmohuc Damasko haeo Judaŋic jumbiŋ jazame manapie guguru ewec.
Iŋuc eku Judaŋic jaŋe Saulo qaniŋte mumockembiŋ.
Mumockepie Saulozi biŋe manarâ juhame jaŋe qaniŋte haesac motâcko ŋafe furec soŋsoŋ domambiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Jesure qâjâpecfâc jaŋe ŋafeo sasacko ŋiherâ sacrâpeo âke suepie hurâ wisewec.
Eme raku Jerusalem haeo fisirâ Jesure kikefuŋ jaŋerao ʒuhuckeocte mume araŋ bacnembiŋ. Ehuc e Jesure motec ewec i manapie jâmbomac mi ewec.
Eme Banabazi âgo ecnehuc aposolo jaŋerao jowa rarâ, Wofuŋzi Saulo hatao fuacnerâ dâŋ âzâcneme Damasko haeo Jesure biŋe mutaniŋkewec, irec dâŋ binaŋ ejarewec.
Eme jaŋehec Jerusalem haeo ŋeŋe juju ewec.
Ehuc Wofuŋte ʒâŋeo âtesiŋnehuc ŋic miti acmeruŋ tâmiric jazawec. Eme Judaŋiczi Grikdâŋ mumu jaŋehec wâc mitire muc manac ehuc dâŋ bâbârisiec embiŋ. Eme ŋic i jaŋe hâcne qazo mupie
âgofâcne jaŋe manarâ Kaisarea haeo jowa hurâ râepie raku Taso haeo fisiwec.
Eme opâ ruac kikefuŋ Judaia â Galilaia â Samaria mâreŋko jurambiŋ jaŋerao wama fuawec. Wamao juhuc heheʒakiec erâ qaboc‐jeŋic qapie hume Wofuŋte maio rumehuc jumbiŋ. Ehuc Tiri Mârozi neŋgoc ŋesiŋ ŋejarehame miti soka ŋedâmârec eme guru‐jeŋic ɋâriŋ qawec.
Petoro e hata juku Jesure fuŋfuŋfâc Lida haeo jumbiŋ jaŋerao wâc fisiwec.
Erâ ira ŋic moc honewec, ʒâŋene Ainea, e puriŋ erâ fohuc juha jara 8 ewec.
Eme Petorozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Ainea, Jesu Kristozi ɋiɋicne bacgukacte faharerâ fofoge gahac bâpiaŋkec.” Mume izia faharewec.
Iŋuc eme Lida â Saroŋ heaoneczi honerâ maŋjeŋic bârisierâ Wofuŋte kikefuŋ embiŋ.
Jope haeo opâ ruac naru ŋokac moc juwec, ʒâŋene Tabita, Kâtedâŋko Sâec. E gâcne ehâmo‐jarehuc bâmec bocjaha bajarehuc juwec.
Eme Petoro mâreŋ ira juhame Tabita e huc fuacneme hâmowec. Hâmome qâŋɋâŋ‐ticne ʒurerâ ficmaŋne mocko baferâ râembiŋ.
Lida i Jope hae bembeŋko ŋewecte opâ ruac jaŋe Petorore biŋe manarâ ŋic jajahec erao sorec‐jofapie rarâ ʒiŋuc âzâcnepic: “Go jowacgupere nâŋere haeo biac ranaŋ.”
Eme Petoro e manarâ ʒawieme jahehec rambiŋ. Ra fisime qâŋɋâŋ fowecko jowa fembiŋ. Feme ŋokac hozec sasawa jaŋe e orâŋkerâ ki busâqoc ehuc Tabita ɋâricne juhuc ŋaqi ɋâtâ‐jarewec i jâutu‐fârembiŋ.
Eme Petorozi ejareme hufârepie dieŋzi herâ numuwec. Numu tararâ qâŋɋâŋ maickeme ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Tabita go faharec.” Mume ʒâŋe fitâcnehuc Petoro honerâ fahare ŋewec.
Ŋehame Petorozi menao rohuc âzâcneme fahare domawec. Eme opâ ruac â hozec wira‐jareme fepie Tabita ɋâricne bârisie‐jarewec.
Eme irec biŋe Jope haeo haŋ bame bocjahazi Wofuŋtao qohotambiŋ.
Eme Petoro e ŋic moc ʒâŋene Simoŋ, becsahac bapa, ere ficko dameŋ ʒoʒoricne ŋeŋe juju ewec.
Kaisarea haeo ŋic moc juwec, ʒâŋene Konelio, e Italia mâreŋkonec momori jaŋere soŋaŋ juwec.
Erâ e jahacne â wiacfâc‐ticne jaŋe Anutu araŋ bacnehuc rumerâ jujumbieŋ. Ehuc ŋic ŋokac bâmec bocjaha bajarewec, erâ Anuturao gâbâ numu jujec.
Konelio e iŋuc ekume ʒoaŋ mocko owâ gieo Anuture aŋelo moczi maŋko fuac ecneme honeha ʒâŋene wiracnehuc muwec: “Konelio.”
Wiracneme hone dendeŋnehuc fâfârerâ muwec, “Wofuŋ, wemo wiacte?” Eme eki muwec, “Nunumu â bâmecge Anuturao hefâme mana biaŋkewec.
Irec go Jope haeo kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopatec ra ŋic moc ʒâŋene Simoŋ, ʒâŋe‐ticne moc Petoro, jowa warenʒepieŋ,
e wase‐ticne Simoŋ, becsahac bapa, ere ficko ŋeŋe juju ekac; fic i hâwecmecko ŋekac.”
Aŋelo e dâŋ i âzâcnerâ rame kiŋaŋ motec jajahec â momorifâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec mitine moc hefârec‐joparâ
dâŋ binaŋ jaza‐fârerâ Jope haeo sorec‐jopame rambiŋ.
Ŋic jaŋe raku hatao fombiŋ. Hae fureme mocwâc raku hae bâmbeŋkezo ehapie ʒoaŋ ʒâʒâŋiŋko Petorozi numuocte fic maŋne mocko fewec.
Numuku nânâre hâmorâ mume rike bâmoc ecnehapie Wofuŋzi maŋko fuac ecneme wiac ʒiŋuc honewec:
Sambâŋ aŋkeme wiac moc racsâko tinac tofane 4 ira basanaŋkehuc mâreŋko âkesuepie wahawec.
Maŋnao qowi â homa wiac â wipe fuŋne fuŋne fowec.
Ehame dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc fuawec: “Ajoc Petoro, hezu nâc ec.”
Eme Petorozi muwec, “Wofuŋ, misac, no wiac hecke‐nârekicne â mamakâcne moc mi nâekopac.”
Mume dâŋ harierâ ʒiŋuc fuawec: “Anutuzi muʒurekac i goki mi surec.”
Wiac i fuame jahec â moc eme izia racnehec fârepie sambâŋko risie fewec.
Eme Petoro e wiac ʒâŋe furu honewec irec maŋ kukumbuc ecnehame Konelio ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe haeo fisirâ Simoŋ ficticnere wio wio raku bâfuarâ motâcko domahuc
wiracne basac ehuc mumbiŋ, “Simoŋ, ʒâŋene moc Petoro, e fic ʒira jukac me?”
Eme Petoro e wiac ʒâŋe furu‐ticnere manatâc qâtâc ehuc jaha juhame Mârozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, ŋic jahec â moc fisirâ go basacguŋgopieŋ,
irec go hurâ jaŋehec racmurâ maŋ bahac mi ezemec, ŋic i noni mupe warembieŋ.”
Eme Petorozi jaŋerao hurâ muwec, “Basacnuŋgopieŋ no hâcne ʒi, wemo wiacte wareŋgopieŋ?”
Mume ŋic jaŋe ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Momori soŋaŋ Konelio, e Anutu araŋ bacnehuc tiŋne juekac, â Judaŋic jaŋe ere manapie sâckeekac, e hâcne tiri aŋelo moczi fuacnerâ go ficticnao hefârecgurâ micgaonec dâŋ manaocte âzâcnewec.”
Iŋuc mupie Petorozi hezu hewâneŋ ejarewec. Fohapie hae fureme e â Jope haeonec opâ ruac gâcne mâmâc ŋic jaŋehec rambiŋ.
Jaŋe hatao ŋafe moc forâ raku Kaisarea haeo fisimbiŋ. Konelio e wiacfâcne â âgo qomâfâc‐ticne hetumaŋ‐jopame woŋec juhapie fisimbiŋ.
Fisirâ Petorozi ficko fezo ehame Koneliozi ware maŋfuŋnao fodaperâ muac baafec ecnewec.
Ecneme Petorozi ro bafaharehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Faharec, no ŋic jaha wâc.”
Eme muc manac ehuc ficmaŋko ferâ ŋic tumaŋnerâ ŋepie honec‐joparâ ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“Ŋoŋe Judaŋic nâŋere fuŋne manaŋgopieŋ, nâŋe ŋic furune ŋoŋehec ââgo â iiqic mi enaŋte aka henârekicne. No ine ŋoŋe wâwânâŋhec â hone suŋgiŋne mi muŋarepemurâ Anutuzi fuŋne naza nowatuc ewec.
Irec hâcne hefârecnupie warepemurâ mi quŋkepo. Eme ʒi hefârecnumbiŋ irec mupie manape.”
Iŋuc mume Koneliozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No wiac ʒâŋe furu honerâ juwarehape miŋecgac ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â jahec ekac irec dâŋ binaŋ egarepe. No owâ gieo numuhape ŋic moc ŋaqi‐ticne tatamacnehec norao fuarâ
ʒiŋuc nazawec: Konelio, Anutuzi nunumuge manarâ bâmecgere mana biaŋkewec.
Irec go Jope haeo ŋic sorec‐jopatec Simoŋ, ʒâŋe‐ticne moc Petoro, jowa warenʒepieŋ. Eki wase‐ticne Simoŋ, becsahac bapa, ere ficko ŋeŋe juju ekac; ficticne hâwecmecko ŋekac.
Eme no irec hâcne ŋic sorec‐jopape gorao fâmbiŋ. Eme go dâŋnane manarâ warekicte bunane biaŋkekac. Eme ʒi Wofuŋzi dâŋ gazawec i mutec mananaŋte Anuture maio tumaŋnerâ ŋefâreŋgopeneŋ hâcne.”
Eme Petoro e micafec erâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Anutu e ŋic nâŋâcne sahac‐nâŋeckopec maname feriŋ wahariŋ mi eekac i mana‐jâmbâŋkekopac ʒi.
Ŋic gurune gurune jaŋeraonec gâcnezi e araŋ bacnehuc aimuŋ jupie jaŋere maname mitio rorocjopane eekac.
Anutu e Israe ŋic nâŋerao dâŋ fârine bâfuawec, irec biŋe ŋoŋe manaeŋgopieŋ; e Jesu Kristo, ŋic sasawa nâŋâcne Wofuŋ hâcne, soreme wamadâŋ biaŋ nâzâ‐fârewec.
Erâ Judaia mâreŋko wiac fuawec, irec biŋe wâc ʒiŋuc manaeŋgopieŋ: Johane e ŋic Miti Opâre dâŋ jazahame gie qanaŋ Galilaia mâreŋkonec domarâ rawec;
â Jesu Nazarete haeonec e ine Anutuzi tâpiri â Tiri Mâro tahackecneme mâreŋ rârecke rac warec ehuc ŋic jauŋ bacjopawec â Sataŋzi bâumbeŋ‐jopawec jaŋe bâpiaŋ‐jopa‐fârewec. Anutuzi dopeckehame gie i hâcne bawec.
Eme Judaŋic nâŋere mâreŋko â Jerusalem haeo wiac muwec bawec i nâŋe hone manac efârembeŋ. Ehame juku maripoŋko qapie hâmowec.
Hâmorâ fohame ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eme Anutuzi bâɋârewec. Bâɋârerâ râeme fua sipuac ewec.
Erâ ŋic kosa jaŋerao mâcne, ŋic biŋe mumufâc‐ticne, Anutuzi mârâc rowosâec‐nâpowec, nâŋerao sawa fuawec. Nâŋe hâcne hâmockonec fahareme ehec nâ gugumec â mumac qamanac embeŋ.
Erâ Anutuzi e ŋic ɋâricne â hâmokicne mumutara‐nâŋec âkendâŋnewec, irec biŋedâŋ ŋic guru sâc mutaniŋkerâ jazanaŋte munârewec.
Eme e manasiŋkeniŋmu jaŋe ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnere erâ sâqocne tâmire‐jareocmu, i porofete jaŋe mufua‐fârembiŋ.”
Petoro e dâŋ iŋuc muhuc domahame, manahuc ŋembiŋ jaŋerao Tiri Mâro wahawec.
Eme Judaŋiczi opâ ruac, Petorohec rambiŋ, jaŋe Anutuzi ŋic qâpuc Tiri Mâro tahacke‐jareme bipic tatara ejarewec.
Ŋic qâpuc jaŋe dâŋmarac furune dâŋehuc Anutu musokapie manambiŋ hâcne. Eme Petorozi ʒiŋuc muwec:
“Nâŋâc Tiri Mârohec embeŋ, ŋic kecʒi jaŋe iŋuc jaha fua‐jareme Miti Opâ wemocko sakare‐jarezo.”
Iŋuc murâ mume ŋicfâcne jaŋe Jesu Kristo ere ʒâŋeo ʒuhuc‐jopahuc opâ rua‐jarembiŋ. Eme jaŋe Miti Opâ ruarâ Petoro sakarepie ʒoaŋ gie bapa gâcne jaŋehec ŋeŋe juju ewec.
Aposolo gâcne â opâ ruac Judaia mâreŋko jumbiŋ, jaŋe qâpuczi wâc Anuture dâŋ ro maŋ embiŋ irec biŋe manambiŋ.
Irec Petorozi Jerusalem haeo risie feme Judaŋiczi opâ ruac jaŋe manacnepie mi sâckeme
ʒiŋuc âzâcnembiŋ: “Go wemocte Mosere ma tâmiric iqic‐joparâ jaŋere meonec wiac nâmeŋ?”
Eme Petorozi wiac fuawec i fuŋnaonecteaŋ qâwirickerâ ʒiŋuc jazawec:
“No Jope haeo numuhuc juhape Wofuŋzi maŋko fuac enareme wiac kecʒiŋuc honepo: Wiac moc racsâko tinac tofane 4 ira basanaŋkehuc sambâŋkonec âkesuepie wahaku maŋfuŋ‐naneo fisiwec.
Wahame findendeŋnehuc hone qârâwiŋ ejarehuc honepo: Maŋnao qowi kosa, micmâŋ â micnehec, erâ homa wiac â sawa wipe fowec.
Ehame norao dâŋ wiwira kecʒiŋuc fuawec: ‘Ajoc Petoro, go hezu nâc ec.’
Eme noni mupo, ‘Wofuŋ, misac, no wiac hecke‐nârekicne â mamakâcne moc mi nâekopac.’
Iŋuc mupe sambâŋkonec dâŋ harierâ ʒiŋuc fuawec: ‘Anutuzi wiac muʒurekac i goki mi surec.’
Wiac iŋuc fuame jahec â moc eme racticnehec fârepie sambâŋko risie fewec.
Eme manaŋgopieŋ, wiac i arictac ehame izia Kaisarea haeonec ŋic jahec â moc nore kiŋaŋ fârâ fic jumbeŋ ira fisimbiŋ.
Fisipie Mârozi ʒiŋuc nazawec: ‘Go jaŋehec racmurâ maŋbahac mi ec.’ Eme rape opâ ruac ŋic 6 kecʒi jaŋe bâjâpecnumbiŋ. Ra fisirâ momori soŋaŋte ficko fepene
dâŋ binaŋ kecʒiŋuc enârewec: ‘Nore ficko aŋelozi wefu fua‐narerâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: Go Jope haeo kiŋaŋ sorec‐jopatec Simoŋ, ʒâŋene moc Petoro, jowa warepie
dâŋ mume go â wiacfâcge ŋoŋe manarâ biaŋke‐fârenʒepieŋ.’
Eme no miti jazahape mârâc nâŋâcnao Tiri Mâro wahawec iŋuc jaha jaŋerao wahawec.
Eme no i honerâ Wofuŋzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec i manasupo: ‘Johanezi opâ rua‐ŋarewec, ŋoŋe ine Tiri Mâro rua‐ŋarezo.’
Eme nâŋâc Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo manasiŋkehapene wiac tahacke‐nârewec, ijaha jaŋe tahacke‐jareme no iŋucnezi wemocko Anutu qataracnezapo.”
Iŋuc muhuc jazame jaŋe manarâ maŋjeŋic fâre wahame Anutu muteŋkehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Opo, Anutu e ŋic qâpuc maŋjeŋic bârisierâ juju sanaŋte biŋe eniŋte wâc mujarekac hâcne.”
Stefano qarâ opâ ruac gâcne jopa bâtâtiec ejarepie haha rârâwiŋ qarâ tucnezi Foinike â Kipiro nucko â Antiokia haeo rambiŋ. Ra juhuc miti i Judaŋic sawa jazambiŋ.
Eme ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko Kipiro nuckonec â Kirene mâreŋkonec opâ ruac ŋic jumbiŋ, jaŋe Antiokia haeo fisirâ Grikŋic jaŋehec iŋuc jaha muc manac ehuc Wofuŋ Jesure Biŋebiaŋ jazambiŋ.
Eme Wofuŋzi tâpiri sicne‐jarehame jazapie ŋic guru sâko jaŋe manarâ maŋjeŋic bârisierâ Wofuŋte biŋe embiŋ.
Eme irec dâŋ Jerusalem kikefuŋ jaŋerao rame manarâ Banaba sorepie Antiokia haeo rawec.
Ra fisirâ Anutu uruc jauŋ‐ticne honerâ bubiaŋ manarâ maŋjeŋiczi Wofuŋtao herâŋke sanaŋkeniŋte faŋ qajarewec.
Banaba e ŋic biaŋne, maŋnao Tiri Mâro â mamanasiŋ fusewec. Eme hae ira ŋic wemo afecnezi Wofuŋtao ʒuhuckembiŋ.
Eme Banaba e Saulo bâfuaocte Taso haeo rawec.
Ra bâfuarâ jowame Antiokia haeo warepic. Erâ opâ ruac guruo jara moc juhuc ŋic bocjaha miti jaza qazuc epic. Antiokia hae ira hâcne ŋiczi Jesure kikefuŋ jaŋere ʒâŋe Kristoŋic mufuambiŋ.
Dameŋ ira porofete ŋic Jerusalem haeonec Antiokia haeo rambiŋ.
Ehuc jaŋeraonec moc, ʒâŋene Agabo, e Mârozi ecneme mâreŋ sâc roroc sâko fuaocte irec findaŋdâŋ muwec. Eme roroc i ŋicwofuŋ sâko Klaudio juhame fuawec.
Eme opâ ruac jaŋe dâŋ i manarâ moneŋ fojarewec sâc bâturerâ Judaia mâreŋko âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao râepie raocte mupaŋkembiŋ.
Erâ moneŋ bâfuambiŋ i Banaba â Saulo jactepie bara opâ ruac soŋaŋ micnefâc‐jeŋic jarepic.
Dameŋ ira ŋicwofuŋ Herode e kikefuŋte ŋic ŋokac gâcne jopa sipiric ejareocte kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐jopawec.
Ehuc Johane hahac‐ticne Jakobo mume ʒikazi qâhâmombiŋ.
Iŋuc eme Judaŋic jaŋe aŋac‐jopame honec‐joparâ Petoro iŋuc jaha mume goreŋ sowa hombaŋ maickeme kâpâcwâru bambiŋ.
Aakic hombaŋ tarame Judaŋic jowaturâ qaocte manasurâ mume kâpâcwâru ficko râerâ momori 16 jaŋe soŋaŋkembiŋ.
Eme Petoro e kâpâcwâru ficko fohame kikefuŋ jaŋeraonec nunumu ʒuʒuhuc jaha Anuturao fehuc domawec.
Eme Herode e hae fureme ŋic jowatuocte ʒâfo maickewec ŋafe ira momori jajahec jahe Petoro kâpâcwâru jajaheczi bândeŋnerâ bafopic, â momori gâcne motâc râpeo soŋaŋ domambiŋ wâc.
Ehame ficmaŋko mi Wofuŋte aŋelo moczi ututuŋ fuarâ domame fic tamae‐fârezejec i! Eme aŋelozi Petoro gâjoŋnao qâuahuc wiwickerâ muwec: “Picpac faharec.” Mume izia Petorore meonec kâpâcwâru ŋeŋgoroŋkerâ wahawec.
Eme aŋelozi âzâcnewec, “Umbikage jomarâ kikehuhuge hetec huoc.” Iŋuc eme aŋelozi mocwâc âzâcnewec, “Ŋaqige ʒoricne hetec hume bâjâpecnuc.”
Eme bâjâpehuc aŋelozi wiac ecnewec i maname fârine mâcne, guŋko ecnekicne tinac ewec.
Eme jahe motâc mocko momori domahapie jowaru raʒi, motâc mocko iŋuc jaha domahapie jowaru raʒi, eku hae ʒoŋaopec kimotâc sâko maickepire e jahac aŋkeme hupic. Hurâ hatao rahuc aŋelo e sipuac ewec.
Eme Petoro e maŋne uŋtome ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ʒi mana‐jâmbâŋkekopac, Wofuŋ e aŋelo‐ticne soreme Herodere niŋgiŋkonec â Judaŋic jaŋere aarickonec bataracnukac.”
Iŋuc mana tarahuc rarâ Johane Marekore neŋgoc, ʒâŋene Maria, ere ficko fisiwec. Ira bocjahazi tumaŋnerâ numuhuc ŋembiŋ.
Eme Petorozi ʒae motâcko heickeme kiŋaŋ naru moc, ʒâŋene Rode, e mozi heickekac muhuc waharâ
Petoro dâŋ hawari‐ticne manarâ motâc mi roro mâc ʒeri ehuc ficmaŋko ferâ, Petoro warejec domakac muhuc jazawec.
Jazame jaŋe manarâ mumbiŋ, “Go maŋge sifuckekac.” Eki ine qizec qahuc muwec, “E jâmbâŋ domakac.” Eme jaŋe mumbiŋ, “I aŋelo‐ticnezi mecne.”
Eme Petoro e heickehuc jaha domame motâc rorâ e jahacne honerâ maŋjeŋic omaewec.
Eme dâŋemâc juniŋte me bazuc ejarerâ Wofuŋzi kâpâcwâru fickonec firuerâ bawahawec irec dâŋ binaŋ ejare‐fârerâ muwec, “Ŋoŋe dâŋbiŋe ʒi Jakobo â âgo gâcne jazaniŋ.” Iŋuc muhuc fâre fâsâerâ mocko rawec.
Hae fureme momori jaŋe Petoro basarâ wemo wiaczi weniŋuc ecnejec muhuc mumutucne embiŋ.
Eme Herodezi bâfuaniŋte mume basa‐bipiepie mu indiŋ ejarerâ momori jaŋe soŋaŋ i qâhâmoc‐jopaniŋte mutâcne‐jarewec. Erâ Judaia mâreŋ beherâ Kaisarea haeo hurâ juwec.
Herode e dameŋ ira Tiro â Sidoŋ haeonec râsi ejarewec. Eme hae irec rune jaŋe qâturehuc fisirâ dâŋ mufâsâeniŋte ŋicwofuŋte ŋicbomboŋ, ʒâŋene Bilasto, mu bâmunaŋ ecnepie bafic‐jopawec. Jaŋe wiac nareŋ gareŋ‐jeŋic tâcnewecte i mocwâc ʒuhuckeniŋte iŋuc embiŋ.
Eme Herode e dâŋ bârisie‐jareocte ʒâfo bajarewec i maickeme eri‐ticne barâ ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋe‐ticnao waha ŋehuc mu âkeriŋ dâŋ jazawec.
Jazame ŋic mâmâc sasawa fânâŋkecnehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Dâŋ i ŋicdâŋ mâcne, i nemure dâŋ.”
Eme mi qatara‐jarehuc Anutu âkehockewecte Wofuŋte aŋelozi ɋeŋnea qawec. Eme umbeŋzi nanʒaŋneme hâmowec.
Anuture dâŋzi ine qazu qâiŋ erâ haŋ barawec.
Eme Banaba â Saulo jahe Jerusalem haeo wiac mujactekicne sâc efârerâ Antiokia haeo risienicte Johane Mareko jowapire mâmâc rambiŋ.
Antiokia kikefuŋ maŋnao porofete â qaqazu ʒiŋuc jumbiŋ: Banaba, â Simoŋ, ʒâŋe‐ticne moc Nige, â Lukio Kirene haeonec, â Manaeŋ, e ŋicwofuŋ Herode ehec mâmâc qâqârândiŋ juhuc sokapic, erâ Saulo.
Eme ʒoaŋ mocko sowa juhuc gae mitire tumaŋnehapie Tiri Mârozi dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Banaba â Saulo gie mujactepo i banicte baʒawiec‐jofaniŋ.”
Mume sowa jurâ mejeŋic qizec‐jekicko râehuc numu jambuŋ ejacterâ miti kiŋaŋ râec‐jofapie rapic.
Tiri Mârozi iŋuc ehuc sorec‐jofame jahe raku Seleukia haeo fisipic. Ira fisirâ wokeo ferâ raku Kipiro nucko fisirâ
irec hae qizec Salami ira rarâ Judaŋic jaŋere mitificko ferâ Anuture dâŋ jazapic. Erâ Johane e jahehec mâmâc juhuc bafic‐jofawec.
Eme nuc fotâcne‐fârerâ Pafo haeo fisimbiŋ. Ira fisirâ Judaŋic moc qaŋgec bapa â porofete burecne juwec, ʒâŋene Barajesu, e bâfuambiŋ.
Ŋic e kia moc Seregio Paulo ere âgo juwec. Kia e maŋfânâŋ‐ticneheczi Anuture dâŋ manaocte ecneme Banaba â Saulo hefârec‐jofawec.
Hefârec‐jofame qaŋgec bapa Elima (ʒâŋe i qaŋgec bapare mujumbieŋ hâcne) eki kia miti sakarecnehuc hecke‐jactewec.
Eme Saulo, ʒâŋene Paulo wâc mumbiŋ, e Tiri Mârozi maŋ ba afec ecneme Elima ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec:
“Sataŋte ŋic go, tiŋke biaŋte râsi sanaŋ, maŋge eeatuc â sindaŋzi fusucmakicne, go Wofuŋte hata dândâŋ imackeekic i wezimucko behecmu?
Irec ʒi Wofuŋ tâpiri‐ticnere fuŋne honezemec; go tiŋtuŋ erâ dameŋ ŋondeŋ moc tatamac hohone tâmiric juzemec.” Mume izia ʒâŋene dapâc eme tiŋtuŋ qahuc mezi bajaŋ qajaŋ erâ menao roniŋte muwec.
Wiac i fuame kiazi honerâ Wofuŋte mitire maname bipinehec eme mana ʒakiewec.
Paulo â ŋicfâcne jaŋe Pafo hae beherâ wokeo mocwâc ferâ raku Pamfilia mâreŋko Perege haeo fisimbiŋ. Ira Johanezi behec‐joparâ Jerusalem haeo risiewec.
Eme jaŋe Perege haeonec raku Pisidia mâreŋko Antiokia hae wasene ira fisimbiŋ. Ira juhapie sabata hombaŋ maickeme Judaŋic jaŋere mitificko ferâ ŋembiŋ.
Eme soŋaŋ jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋqâhâcte â porofete jaŋere dâŋqâreŋ gâcne wose tararâ ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Âgo bureŋ, dâŋmiti moc maŋkeŋgopieŋko mupie mananaŋ.”
Eme Paulozi faharerâ niniŋkeniŋte mezi bâuruŋ‐joparâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Israe ŋicbureŋ ŋoŋe, â gâcne Anutu araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ, mâmâc ŋazape mananiŋ:
Israe ŋic nâŋâcne Anutu eki mimi apafâc‐nâŋec rowosâec‐joparâ Aigita mâreŋko juhapie basawec‐jopawec. Erâ tâpiri sanaŋ‐ticnezi irecnec jowac‐jopa warerâ
mâreŋ burocnao gume qataŋ ejarehuc juhame jara 40 ewec.
Erâ Kanaaŋ mâreŋko ŋicguru 7 bâsirowec‐joparâ mume apafâc‐nâŋec jaŋe mâreŋ i bâtâc barâ ru sâc erâ jumbiŋ. Ehame jara 450 tarawec.
Eme Kanaaŋ mâreŋko juhapie mumutiŋ ŋic bâfua‐jareme jurakupie porofete Samue fuawec.
Eme ŋicwofuŋte mupie Anutuzi Benjamiŋte qâricfâc jaŋeraonec Kisi ŋokâ‐ticne Saulo âkendâŋne‐jareme jara 40 micne bajarehuc juwec.
Eme e bârârierâ Dawidi ŋicwofuŋ‐jeŋic âkendâŋnewec. Erâ ere dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: ‘No Isaire ŋokâ Dawidi ere maŋnane sâckeme hone wosâepo, eki hâcne mupe rereŋ‐nane juocmu.’
Eme Dawidi qâricfâc‐ticne jaŋeraonec Israe ŋic nâŋâcne bâbâpiaŋ moc fuaocte biŋedâŋ mukicne i fârinehec eocte Anutuzi mume Jesu hâcne fuawec.
Erâ ŋicŋondeŋko fua tâcneocte qanaŋ Johanezi Israe ŋic sasawa maŋjeŋic bârisierâ Miti Opâ ruaniŋte jazawec.
Erâ Johane e hata mucnekicne i âte tarahuc ŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: ‘E muhuc munareeŋgopieŋ ŋic e no aricne. E jahacne ʒâhec warehuc jukac; e sâko no iŋucnezi mafahe‐ticne decnepe mi sâckeocmu.’
“Qomâfâc‐nane Abrahamte qâricfâc ŋoŋe, erâ gâcne Anutu araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ, mupe mananiŋ: Bâbâpiaŋ irec dâŋ i nâŋâcnao râekicne.
Jerusalem ŋic fekicne wahakicne jaŋe Jesu mi ʒâŋitahuc ʒikao feocte mutaracnembiŋ. Jaŋe iŋuc epie porofete jaŋere findaŋdâŋ sabata hombaŋ sâc wose manac eeŋgopeneŋ i deŋkewec.
Jaŋe Jesure kiŋ basa‐bipiehuc sifu Pilato qizec qacnepie qâhâmowec.
Eme mitio mukicne sâc i etaracnerâ maripoŋkonec batararâ ʒâŋeruŋ hawecko râembiŋ.
Eme Anutuzi hâmockonec bâqâreme faharewec.
Erâ ehec Galilaia mâreŋkonec Jerusalem haeo mâmâc rambiŋ jaŋe ʒoaŋ gie bapa bocjaha fua‐jarewec. Fua‐jareme honembiŋ jaŋe ine biŋe mumufâc‐ticne embiŋ juŋgopieŋ.
Eme mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec wiac biŋe qajarekicne
i Anutuzi Jesu bâqâreme qâricfâc‐jeŋic nâŋâcnao fârinehec ewec, eme irec bubiaŋ dâŋ ŋazaeŋgopeneŋ. Irec hâcne Miti Mânec namba 2 ira dâŋ ʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne fokac: ‘Go hâcne Ŋokâ‐nane, no miŋecgac bâfuacgukopac.’
Jesu bâqâreme faharewec e ʒâhec hâhâmo i mocwâc mi bâfuaocmu, irec Anutuzi dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec: ‘No Dawidi biŋe qacnepo irec fârine fofo sanaŋ i hâcne tahacke‐ŋarepemu.’
Erâ Miti Mânec mocko dâŋ ʒiŋuc fokac: ‘Go Tiriŋicge mi behetec gârecke ʒaŋ eocmu.’
Dawidire manaeŋgopeneŋ, e Anutuzi gie mucnewec i ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋerao batararâ hâmowec. Hâmome mimi apafâc‐ticne jaŋerao râepie gârecke ʒaŋ ewec.
Â Anutuzi bâqârewec e ine gârecke ʒaŋticne tâmiric.
“Qomâfâc‐nane, ŋazape mananiŋ. Sâqocne bâbâtâmire i ŋic eki hâcne bâfuawecte irec dâŋzi maic‐ŋopakac.
Mosere sâcmutâc dâŋzi kiŋŋeŋic guriŋkeocte eipiewec, Jesurao siŋkepie ine sâcne bârârie‐ŋareocmu.
Porofete jaŋerao dâŋ ʒiŋuc fokac i ŋoŋerao sanaŋkezacte uŋ ŋazakopac:
‘Oi, miti qiqikiŋ, ŋoŋe wareckerâ omaenʒepieŋ; no ŋoŋerao gie fuŋmoc bapemu; biŋene manarâ manapie mi bapane eocmu.’”
Eme Paulo â Banaba jahe mitifickonec wahapire ŋic jaŋe sabata hombaŋ mocko dâŋ irecteaŋ jazanicte mumbiŋ.
Eme tutumaŋkonec waharâ Judaŋic bocjaha â qâpuc Judaŋic jaŋere bâjâpecne gâcne jaŋe mâmâc Paulo â Banaba bâjâpec‐jofahapie Anuture jauŋko aimuŋ juniŋte mu sawaŋ ejarepic.
Eme sabata hombâŋ‐jeŋic mocwâc maickeme hae irec ŋic Anuture dâŋ mananiŋte mâretec fisimbiŋ.
Fisipie Judaŋic jaŋe honec‐joparâ mana sâqore‐jarerâ Paulo dâŋticne mu surec ehuc bawahambiŋ.
Iŋuc epie Paulo â Banaba jahe mai qanʒaŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc muhuc jazapic: “Judaŋic ŋoŋe Anuture dâŋ qanaŋ ŋaŋazare mukicne. Ʒi ine ŋaŋac qikiŋnehuc juju sanaŋte biŋe eniŋte mi muŋgopieŋte behec‐ŋoparâ qâpuc jaŋerao ranacmu.
Wofuŋ e irec hâcne kecʒiŋuc munârewec: ‘Noni go ŋic qâpuc jaŋere ʒoctamac râecgupore bâbâpiaŋ‐jeŋic juraku mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao jutarazemec.’”
Iŋuc mupire qâpuc jaŋe manarâ bujeŋic biaŋkeme Wofuŋte dâŋ muac baafec ecnembiŋ. Eme juju sanaŋte biŋe eniŋte mana wosâc ejarekicne sâc jaŋe miti mana ʒakiembiŋ.
Eme mâreŋ ira Wofuŋte dâŋzi haŋ barawec.
Hae irec ŋic fekicne jaŋere ŋonâŋfâc gâcne Judaŋic jaŋere bâjâpecne jumbiŋ, jaŋe Judaŋiczi qafeŋ‐jopahuc hae soŋaŋ mâmâc maŋ bâiŋ ejarembiŋ. Eme babafic erâ Paulo â Banaba râsi ejactehuc hae mâreŋ‐jeŋic sakare‐jacterâ jâpec‐jofapie rapic.
Rahuc kike‐jekickonec gâc wândoc‐jeŋic âteickepire wahahame suŋgiŋ‐jopahuc Ikonioŋ haeo rapic.
Rahapire miti mamana jaŋere maŋko ʒeri bubiaŋ â Tiri Mâro fua babaraŋ fuawec.
Eme Ikonioŋ haeo fisirâ iŋuc jaha Judaŋic jaŋere mitificko ferâ miti mupire fârio qawec. Ehame Judaŋic â Grikŋic bocjahazi Jesure kikefuŋ embiŋ.
Judaŋic gâcne jaŋe ine miti qikiŋnehuc hae irec ŋic suruc‐jopapie Kristoŋic aaric mana‐jarembiŋ.
Eme jahe sifu mosa dameŋ gâcne hae ira juhuctecne Wofuŋtao roweckerâ miti‐ticne hâwicmâc muhuc jupic. Ehapire Wofuŋzi akicdâŋ‐ticnere fuŋne bataniŋkehuc neŋgoc ŋesiŋ ŋejactehame mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bapic.
Eme hae irec ŋic jaŋe fâuckehuc tucne Judaŋic jaŋerao qohotambiŋ â tucne jaŋe aposolo jaherao qohotambiŋ.
Izi ʒâhecko ŋic qâpuc â Judaŋic gâcne jaŋe aposolo qânâzi he imac ejacteniŋte roroc epie
manarâ wiserâ Likaonia mâreŋko rapic. Erâ ira Listera â Derebe â hae gâcnao
Biŋebiaŋ murahuc jupic.
Eme Listera haeo ira ŋic moc ŋewec, e kike jahec‐ticne ɋaŋakicne. E neŋgoc bumaŋko iŋucne fuarâ hata juju tâmiric mâc ŋejujec.
Eme Paulozi miti mume manahuc ŋehame erao findendeŋnerâ fuŋne‐ticne ʒiŋuc manawec: Ŋic e bibiaŋte mamanasiŋ sâcne focnekac.
Iŋuc manarâ dâŋ hahaŋne bahuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go kikegezi âterâ fahare hâŋ domac.” Mume ŋic e furutuc herâ fahare rac warec ewec.
Eme ŋic guru sâko jaŋe Paulozi mâsi bawec i honerâ micne micʒiriŋ Likaonia dâŋjeŋicko ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Nemu jaŋe ŋicsahachec erâ ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko fuambiŋ juŋgopieŋ.”
Ehuc Banaba e nemu moc ʒâŋene Dia ere wase bambiŋ, â Paulo e dâŋ bâtâcnerâ mujujecte nemu moc ʒâŋene Hermes ere wase bambiŋ.
Eme nemu Dia ere taha bapa eki mume bulimakao â reso eri wiac hae upeo nemure ufuŋ ŋewecko amecke hurâ ŋicjahec jahere bâzi rikezo embiŋ.
Eme aposolo jahec Banaba â Paulo jahe i manarâ fâfâre sâqorehuc hemâtâc‐jofame ŋic bâfâuc bâfâuc‐jopa
rarâ ʒiŋuc mupic: “Oi, ŋicbureŋ, ŋoŋe wemo eŋgopieŋ! Nâhe ŋic jaha wâc, ŋoŋere sâc. Ŋoŋe nemu burec burec râpec‐joparâ Wofuŋ jujune maickeniŋte Biŋebiaŋ‐ticne muekoperec hâcne. Eki sambâŋ â mâreŋ â hâwec wiac fuŋne fuŋne‐jeŋichec bâfua‐fârewec.
Erâ juwefukicne dameŋ ira ŋic qâpuc mana‐jarehame maŋjeŋicte juju hata fuŋne fuŋne bâfuarâ jujumbieŋ.
Erâ qâoma mi eŋarewec, fuŋne‐ticne mananiŋte âgo jauŋ eŋarehuc mume hoe ʒoaŋ sâckoa eme mâriri fuame nâ ʒeri ejumbieŋ.”
Ŋicjahec jahe dâŋ iŋuc muhuc mu bâmâteŋ ejarehuc qatara‐jarekupire bâzi ririke‐jacte i behembiŋ.
Eme ira juhapire Antiokia haeonec â Ikonioŋ haeonec Judaŋic fisirâ ŋic mu bâdoc ejarepie babafic erâ Paulo qânâzi hembiŋ. Erâ hâmokac muhuc hae râpeo fâre rambiŋ.
Eme ira fohame opâ ruac jaŋe fisirâ orâŋke âte sâoc ecnehapie ɋârerâ fahare haeo fewec.
Erâ hae fureme Banabahec Derebe haeo rapic. Rarâ ira Biŋebiaŋ mupire ŋic bocjahazi mana ʒakiepie Jesure kikefuŋ bacjopapic. Iŋuc erâ hata rapicko ijaha mocwâc risiehuc Listera â Ikonioŋ â Antiokia haeo fisi fisi warepic.
Hae sâc fisihuc Jesure kikefuŋ jaŋe mamanasiŋ heʒakierâ juniŋte mu basanaŋ ejare warehuc ʒiŋuc jazapic: “Nâŋâc ʒârâ hâriŋ faio juhuc Anuture uucmaŋko raʒinaŋte muʒâwe‐nârekicne.”
Erâ wâc kikefuŋ gurune gurune soŋaŋ bâwosâe‐jarerâ sowa juhuc numu jambuŋ ejarehuc, manasiŋkembiŋ Wofuŋ erao hâcne râec‐jopapic.
Eme Pisidia mâreŋ fotâcnerâ raku Pamfilia mâreŋko fisipic.
Ira fisirâ Perege haeo miti jazarâ Atalia haeo hupic.
Ira hurâ wokeo ferâ raku Antiokia haeo fisipic. Hae ira hâcne opâ ruac jaŋe Wofuŋte jauŋko râec‐jofahuc gie mujactepie fuŋkerâ barapic.
Izi ware fisirâ kikefuŋ hetumaŋ‐joparâ, Anutuzi neŋgoc ŋesiŋ ŋejactehame gie bapic, â qâpuc motâc rojareme mamanasiŋhec embiŋ, irec dâŋ binaŋ ejare‐fârepic.
Erâ dameŋ ʒoʒoricnea Jesure gurufâc jaŋere ŋondeŋko jupic.
Judaia mâreŋkonec opâ ruac gâcne Antiokia haeo rarâ kikefuŋte ŋic ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Ŋoŋe Mosere dâŋ sâcko sahac‐ŋeŋicko ma mi bahuc Wofuŋte biŋe sâcne mi eniŋmu.”
Iŋuc muhuc Paulo â Banaba jahehec mufec muwahac ehuc qaqatarac sâko embiŋ. Eku ʒiŋuc mumockembiŋ: “Paulo â Banaba erâ opâ ruac jaŋeraonec ŋic tucne jaŋe dâŋ i aposolo â mitire micne Jerusalem haeo juŋgopieŋ jaŋerao baranʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ kikefuŋzi sorec‐jopahuc mâzoc‐jopapie rambiŋ. Rahuc Foinike â Samaria mâreŋ fotâcnehuctecne opâ ruac ʒiŋuc jaza rambiŋ: “Qâpuc bocjahazi mitio raʒiŋgopieŋ.” Jazapie manarâ jaŋerao bubiaŋ kâcɋene fuawec.
Eme raku Jerusalem haeo fisipie opâ ruac kikefuŋ â aposolo â mitire micne jaŋe mu ʒeri ejarehapie, Anutuzi neŋgoc ŋesiŋ ŋejarehame miti gie bapie fârinehec ewec, irec dâŋ binaŋ ejarembiŋ.
Dâŋ binaŋ etara‐jarepie opâ ruac gâcne farisaio jaŋere guruoneczi ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋic qâpuc sahac‐jeŋicko ma bazo â Mosere sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkeniŋte mu hezuc ejarezo. I tâmiric mitio rocjopapie mi sâckeocmu.”
Eme aposolo â mitire micne jaŋe dâŋ i muniŋte buc tumaŋnembiŋ.
Tumaŋnerâ dâŋ hec hetikic eku Petorozi faharerâ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Qomâfâc‐nane, ŋic qâpuc Biŋebiaŋ bâtâcnerâ jajaza ine Anutuzi mârâcko âgo‐ŋeŋic no bâwosâecnume jazape manarâ Jesure kikefuŋ embiŋ i ŋoŋe manaŋgopieŋ.
Eme Anutu e maŋ hohonezi Judaŋic nâŋâc Tiri Mâro nârewec iŋuc jaha ŋic qâpuc jarehuc fuŋne nâwotuwec.
Jaŋe e manasiŋkepie maŋjeŋic ʒure bâpiaŋ ejarehuc nâŋâc enârewec sâc ijaha jaŋe ejarewec.
Irec ŋoŋe wemocte Anuture sâc jâuruhuc tagi ŋemâcne sâko, kâcɋenefâc‐nâŋec â nâŋâc deipiembeŋ ijaha qâpuckonec opâ ruac jaŋere faio râezo muŋgopieŋ?
Iŋuc misac, nâŋâc ʒiŋuc manaeŋgopeneŋ, bibiaŋke i Judaŋic â qâpuc mâmâc Wofuŋ Jesu anonoc‐ticnere erâ biaŋkeeŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme tumaŋnekicne sasawa jaŋe mâc fâsâerâ ŋefârembiŋ. Ŋehapie Paulo â Banaba jahe Anutuzi gieŋic jucnehapire qâpuc jaŋerao mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bawec irec mu binaŋ ehuc jazapic.
Jazaku jaza‐fârepire Jakobozi dâŋ ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Âgo bureŋ, dâŋ mupe mananiŋ.
Anutu e qâpuc guruonec ŋic rocjopame biŋefâc‐ticne eniŋte hata bâfuawec, irec dâŋ binaŋ Simoŋzi mume manambeneŋ.
Eme ere dâŋzi findaŋdâŋko iticnekac. Porofete jaŋere dâŋqâreŋ moc kecʒiŋuc hâcne fokac:
‘Noni juku risierânec Dawidire boze ʒaŋkekicne heɋârepemu â sesucne qâʒurerâ ʒumururuckepemu.
Eme ŋic ʒanʒaŋne Wofuŋ wira basac ecnenʒepieŋ, â ŋic qâpuc biŋefâc‐nane erâ iŋuc jaha enʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ e dâŋ iŋucne mufua wefuhuc juweczi mukac hâcne.’
Irec no mana wosâerâ ʒiŋuc mukopac: Qâpuc guruoneczi Anutu maickeŋgopieŋ jaŋe tagi sâko mi râe‐jarenʒepeneŋ.
Jaŋe nemuɋâŋte wiac mamakâcne â sasec boe sau â qowi bituakicne â qowisoc, wiac i bâec baniŋte mupaŋkerâ papia qâreŋke‐jarenʒepeneŋ.
I ʒiŋucte enʒepeneŋ: Mosere dâŋ i mimiŋzi ɋâric mârâc jaha fuŋkerâ hae sâc wose warehuc jukicne, â ʒiŋuczia wâc iŋuc jaha sabata hombaŋ sâc mitificne ficne wose manac eeŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme aposolo â micne jaŋe kikefuŋte ŋic sasawa jazapie manapie sâckeme jaŋeraonec ŋic jajahec bâwosâec‐jofambiŋ. Moc ʒâŋene Juda, ʒâŋe‐ticne moc Basaba, erâ Sila, mitire micne bapa jahe hâcne bâwosâec‐jofarâ Paulo â Banaba jahehec mâmâc Antiokia haeo raniŋte sorec‐jopambiŋ.
Ehuc papia moc ʒiŋuc muhuc qâreŋkerâ jarepie barambiŋ: “Qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic aposolo â mitire micne nâŋe qomâfâc‐nâŋec qâpuc guruonec Antiokia haeo â Siria â Kilikia mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe mu ʒeri eŋarehuc papia ʒi râe‐ŋareŋgopeneŋ.
Nâŋe mi manahapene ʒirec ŋic gâcne ŋoŋerao fârâ dâŋ ŋazahuc maŋ bâsifuc eŋarepie ŋoŋerao dâŋ fâfâuc fuawec.
Eme nâŋe i manarâ tumaŋne‐fârehuc ŋic jajahec bâwosâec‐jofarâ qomâ jahec‐naŋec Banaba â Paulo jahehec sorec‐jopapene fâŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic jahe hâcne Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere erâ juju‐jekic qikiŋnepic.
Eme ŋic bâwosâec‐jofambeneŋ Juda â Sila, jahe fârâ dâŋ i miczi wâc ŋazapire mananʒepieŋ.
Tiri Mâro â nâŋe tagi gâcne moc mi ʒuhuckehuc wiac kecʒiŋuc sawa ine râe‐ŋarenaŋte mumockembeneŋ:
Ŋoŋe nemuɋâŋte taha bâzi â qowisoc â qowi bituakicne â sasec boe sau i râpecke sanaŋkenʒepieŋ. Biaŋne junʒepieŋ.”
Eme kikefuŋ jaŋe ŋic i hâcne jaza mâzoc ejarepie rambiŋ. Raku Antiokia haeo fisirâ opâ ruac guru hetumaŋ‐joparâ papia jarembiŋ.
Jarepie wose manac erâ âgodâŋ qâreŋke‐jarembiŋ irec bujeŋic biaŋkewec.
Eme Juda â Sila jahe porofete jupiczi dâŋ bocjaha muhuc mu âkeriŋ ejarerâ mitio dopec‐jopapic.
Eme jaŋehec juju dameŋ i tarame neŋgocfâc‐jekic jaŋerao risienicte bubiaŋko râe mâzoc ejactembiŋ. [
Sila e ine jaŋerao juocte muwec.]
Paulo â Banaba jahe Antiokia haeo ʒuhuckerâ jupic. Ehuc mitiŋic gâcne jaŋehec babafic erâ Wofuŋte dâŋ ŋic jaza qazuc embiŋ.
Juku Paulozi Banaba ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Nâhâc miti kiŋaŋ rahuc Wofuŋte dâŋ mupere hae sâc âgofâc‐nâhec fuambiŋ jaŋe weniŋuc juŋgopieŋ i ra hone manac ejarezeperec.”
Iŋuc mume Banaba e Johane Mareko mâmâc raniŋte muwec.
Eme Mareko e mârâcko jahehec raku Pamfilia mâreŋko gie furunao fisirâ behec‐jofarâ risiewecte Paulozi ehec raniŋte maname mi sâckewec.
Ehuc Banabahec mu qaqatarac sanaŋne eku râwiŋnepic. Râwiŋnehuc Banabazi Mareko jowame ra wokeo ferâ Kipiro nucko rapic.
Paulo e ine Sila rowosâeme opâ ruac jaŋe Wofuŋte jauŋko râec‐jofahuc mâzoc‐jofapie rapic.
Rahuc Siria â Kilikia mâreŋ fotâcnehuc Jesure kikefuŋ mu basanaŋ ejarepic.
Paulo â Sila jahe raku Derebe â Listera haeo fisipic. Eme Listera haeo ira Jesure qâjâpec moc juwec ʒâŋene Timoteo. E neŋgoc‐ticne Juda ŋokac opâ ruac â mamac‐ticne Grikŋic.
Listera â Ikonioŋ haeonec miti mamana jaŋe Timoteore fuŋne muafeckehuc Paulo âzâcnembiŋ.
Âzâcnepie Paulo e jume ju eocte âzâcnewec. Eme mâreŋ ira Judaŋic jurambiŋ jaŋe motecte mamac e Grikŋic i mana‐fârembiŋ. Irec Paulozi jaŋere erâ sahacnao Mosere ma bawec.
Eme hae sâc rahuc, aposolo â micne Jerusalem haeo mumupaŋ mumbiŋ, i reŋkeniŋte opâ ruac jaza rapic.
Iŋuc ehuc gie bapire Jesure kikefuŋ jaŋere mamanasiŋ ɋârâŋkewec â ʒoaŋ sâc qâpuczi jaŋerao ra heacmârec ekupie bocjaha embiŋ.
Eme Asia mâreŋko miti murazo mupie Tiri Mârozi hecke‐jareme Frigia â Galatia mâreŋ fotâcnehuc rambiŋ.
Raku Misia mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao fisirâ ŋifec bâŋorierâ Bitinia mâreŋko razo mupie Jesure Mârozi iŋuc jaha mi mana‐jarewec.
Irec jaŋe Misia mâreŋ qacnerâ raku hâwecmecko Troa haeo fisimbiŋ.
Ira fisirâ ŋafeo Paulo e maŋnezi ŋerisieme wiac kecʒiŋuc honewec: Makedonia ŋic moczi erao fuarâ domahuc mu wâsic ecnehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go Makedonia mâreŋko fârâ bafic‐nâpozemec.”
Paulo e wiac i honeme ʒiŋuc mumbeŋ: “Anutu e Makedonia mâreŋko ra Biŋebiaŋ jazanaŋte munârekac hâcne.” Iŋuc murâ izia ranaŋte ʒawiembeŋ.
Ʒawierâ wokeo ferâ Troa hae beherâ fofotâc raku Samotrake nucko fisimbeŋ. Hae fureme irecnec raku Neapoli haeo fisimbeŋ.
Ira wokeonec waharâ raku Filipi haeo fisimbeŋ. I Makedonia mâreŋ irec hae sâko moc, Romaŋic jaŋe hae rune erâ jumbiŋ. Hae ira ʒoaŋ gâcnao jukupene
sabata hombaŋ maickeme hae upeo opâ moc fowec ira ʒiŋuc muhuc humbeŋ: “Judaŋic numueŋgopieŋ irec toma opâo moc fokacko hurâ honenaŋ.” Iŋuc muhuc hurâ ŋokac tumaŋnerâ juhapie bâfuac‐joparâ waha ŋehuc miti jazambeŋ.
Eme jaŋere guruo ŋokac moczi Anutu araŋ bacnehuc juwec, ʒâŋene Lidia, e qoruc situâc rune, Tiatira haeonec. Ŋokac e hâcne Wofuŋzi maŋne bâuŋtome Paulole dâŋ hazec hâric manawec.
Erâ e jahacne â wiacfâc‐ticne Miti Opâ ruarâ ʒiŋuc nâzâwec: “Ŋoŋe honecnupie Wofuŋte biŋe ekopacko nore ficko wefurâ ŋeŋe juju enʒepieŋ.” Iŋuc muhuc hota‐nâreme fembeŋ.
Dameŋ mocko nunumure tomao huhapene kiŋaŋ naru moczi bâfuac‐nâpowec. Naru e faŋfaŋ demoŋ‐ticnehec juhuc ŋic jaŋere fuŋne mufua jujec, ehuc rufâc‐ticne moneŋ mafa bocjaha hure‐jare jujec.
Eme eki hâcne bâfuac‐nâporâ Paulo â nâŋe bâjâpec‐nâpohuc dâŋ wiwira kecʒiŋuc ewec: “Ŋic kecʒizi Anutu femicne sâko ere kiŋaŋ qaqa juhuc biaŋkeniŋte hata muʒâwe‐ŋareeŋgopieŋ.”
Dâŋ wiwira i sasawa ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne enârekume Paulo e irec takickeme forisierâ demoŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No Jesu Kristo ere micte gazape ŋokacte maŋkonec wefu rac.” Iŋuc mume izia wefurâ rawec.
Eme naru rufâc‐ticne jaŋe moneŋ mafa fufua‐jeŋic arictac eme manarâ Paulo â Sila rocjofarâ
hae ʒâʒâŋiŋko kia jaŋerao fârec‐jofa rarâ qoric‐jofahuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Jahe Judaŋiczi hae‐nâŋecko warerâ maŋbâiŋ enârekopirec,
ehuc mâsi qâreŋ furune, Romaŋiczi mi eene â mi babajune, i hâcne bâfuakopirec.”
Eme ŋic guru sâko domambiŋ jaŋe aaric mana‐jactehuc râsi ʒâŋe honec‐jofapie kiazi ŋaqi‐jekic heuc qâunuckerâ mume kâcbiŋzi jofambiŋ.
Kâcbiŋzi mâretec qâtâc bâtâc‐jofarâ kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐jofarâ soŋaŋ e motâc basanaŋkerâ aimuŋ soŋaŋ‐jofaocte âzâcnembiŋ.
Âzâcnepie kâpâcwâru fic maŋne ʒâʒâŋiŋko râec‐jofarâ kike‐jekic jâc fifitacko râeme kindeŋneme fopic.
Ŋafe ʒâʒâŋiŋko Paulo â Sila jahe Anutu gae nunumu ecnehuc muteŋkepic. Epire kâpâcwâru ŋic gâcnezi micfânâŋ‐jekic manambiŋ.
Ehame homeŋ sâko ututuŋ bame kâpâcwâru fic sâpene qiriŋ qame motâc aŋke‐fârewec â ŋic sasawa kâpâcwâru‐jeŋic ŋeŋgoroŋkewec.
Eme kâpâcwâru ficsoŋaŋzi guŋkonec mana ɋâɋârerâ faharerâ motâc aaŋ doma‐fâreme honerâ, kâpâcwâru ŋic wise‐fârembieŋ muhuc sâqe‐ticne becsahackonec unuckerâ sahac‐ticne âeckezo ewec.
Iŋuc ezo eme Paulozi owackerâ muwec, “Sahacge mi sipirickec, nâŋe furu jaha ŋeŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme soŋaŋ e lambere mume wiacfâcne jaŋe râcnepie ficmaŋko ferâ ɋarac ɋarac qahuc Paulo â Sila jahere kikefuŋko fodapewec.
Erâ ficmaŋkonec jowacjofa waharâ wio‐jacterâ muwec, “Ŋicbomboŋ jahec‐nane, no weniŋuc erâ biaŋkepemu?”
Eme jahe ʒiŋuc âzâcnepic: “Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo manasiŋkehuc go â wiacfâcge biaŋkeniŋmu.”
Iŋuc murâ e â wiacfâcne Wofuŋte dâŋ jazapic.
Jazapire soŋaŋzi ŋafeoa hefârec‐jofarâ kâcbiŋ micrâfâcne ʒure‐jactewec. Erâ mume e jahacne â wiacfâcne Miti Opâ rua‐jarepic.
Eme e jahacne ficmaŋko râec‐jofarâ mume nânâ rike bâmoc ejactembiŋ. Eme e â wiacfâcne Anuture biŋe embiŋte bujeŋic biaŋkewec.
Hae fureme kia jaŋe polisman ʒiŋuc muhuc jaza sorec embiŋ: “Ŋic jahec firuec‐jofazo.”
Eme soŋaŋzi manarâ Paulo ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “No sorec‐ŋofape ranicte kia jaŋe dâŋ râepie warekac, irec ŋohe waha rarâ wamao juzepirec.”
Mume Paulozi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Jaŋe Romaŋic guruonec fuakicne nâhe dâŋficko mi râec‐nâfohuc ŋichofao qâtâc bâtâc‐nâforâ kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐nâfombieŋ. Eme ʒi wemocte kamicnea sorec‐nâfoŋgopieŋ? Iŋuc aricne, jaŋac ware jowac‐nâfopie razeperec.”
Paulo e dâŋ iŋuc mume polisman jaŋe risie rarâ kia jazapie jaŋe ŋic jahec Romaŋic guruo fuakicne biŋe i manarâ fâfârembiŋ.
Fâfârerâ ŋic jaherao warerâ mu bâmiriŋ ejacterâ kâpâcwâru fickonec jowac‐jofa waharâ hae‐jeŋic beherâ ranicte jasambiŋ.
Eme jahe kâpâcwâru fickonec waharâ Lidia ere ficko rarâ Jesure kikefuŋ honec‐joparâ mu sawaŋ ejarerâ rapic.
Eme Paulo â Sila jahe Amfipoli â Apolonia hae fotâc‐jofarâ Tesalonike haeo fisipic. Ira Judaŋic jaŋere mitific moc ŋewec.
Eme Paulo e ejujec iŋuc erâ sabata hombaŋ jahec â moc mitific‐jeŋicko ferâ jaŋehec mitire muc manac ewec. Ehuc miti dâŋqâreŋ gâcne irec fuŋne jaza mutâc ehuc ʒiŋuc muwec:
“Kristo e hâmorâ fahareocte mitio mukicne hâcne. Eme Jesure ʒâŋe biŋe ŋazaekopac e Kristo jâmbâŋ hâcne.”
Eme tucne jaŋe dâŋ i mana ʒakierâ Paulo â Sila jaherao qohotambiŋ. Erâ Grikŋic Anutu araŋ bacnehuc jumbiŋzi bocjaha jaŋerao wâc ʒuhuckembiŋ, erâ ŋokac fekicne afecne mâcne.
Eme ŋic bocjahazi miti manapie Judaŋic jaŋe mana sâqorerâ ŋic otec ɋeticne â râŋgeŋne henusuc‐joparâ mu ojowa sâko erâ Jasoŋte ficko Paulo â Sila ŋepicko tumaŋne‐fârembiŋ. Tumaŋne‐fârerâ ŋicjahec hâcne rocjofarâ ŋichofao râec‐jofazo mumbiŋ.
Erâ basac‐jofarâ Jasoŋ â miti mamana gâcne rocjoparâ hae soŋaŋ jaŋerao fârec‐jopa rambiŋ. Ehuc ʒiŋuc muhuc owac owacke rambiŋ: “Mâreŋne mâreŋne maŋbâiŋ ejareeŋgopieŋ ŋic izi hâcne nâŋerao wâc fisipie
Jasoŋzi hezu hewâneŋ ejarekac. Jaŋe Roma ŋicwofuŋte dâŋ qâsuahuc ŋicwofuŋ furune moc Jesu ere biŋe mupie haŋ baekac.”
Dâŋ iŋuc muhuc haeŋic â soŋaŋ mu qafeŋ ejarembiŋ.
Eme soŋaŋ jaŋe Jasoŋ â âgofâcne ejarepie sahac taha‐jeŋic qikiŋne‐jarepie râec‐jopapie rambiŋ.
Eme miti mamana jaŋe Paulo â Sila ŋafeoa ejactepie Berea haeo rapic. Ira fisirâ Judaŋic jaŋere mitificko ferâ miti mupic.
Eme hae irec Judaŋic jaŋe urucne, Tesalonike haeonec jaŋe iŋucne mâcne, irec miti maŋafec jaha manambiŋ. Erâ dâŋjekic jâmbomac me burec muhuc ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne gufu koparic ehuc miti papia wose manac embiŋ.
Eme jaŋeraonec bocjahazi Jesure kikefuŋ embiŋ, erâ Grikŋic â ŋokac fekicne gâcne sâkozi jaŋerao ʒuhuckembiŋ wâc.
Paulozi Anuture dâŋ Berea haeo muromackeme biŋe Tesalonike haeo rame irec Judaŋiczi manambiŋ. Manarâ Berea haeo warerâ hae rune mu heinʒaŋ ejarehuc maŋjeŋic bâiŋnembiŋ.
Iŋuc epie miti mamana jaŋe Paulo ecnepie hae i beherâ raku hâwecko fisiwec. Sila â Timoteo jahe ine ijaha jupic.
Eme ŋic jaŋe Paulo jowa raku Ateŋ haeo râepie ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe risierâ mupie Sila â Timoteo jahe biac warezepirec.” Eme ŋic jaŋe risiembiŋ.
Eme Paulo e Ateŋ haeo jahere woŋec juhuc ɋâŋ qâqâtâc mâretec ŋerame honerâ maŋne ʒoc ʒawec.
Erâ Judaŋic jaŋere mitificko ferâ Judaŋic jaŋacne â Grikŋic gâcne Judaŋic jaŋere qâjâpecne jumbiŋ jaŋehec mâmâc mitire muc manac embiŋ. Erâ wâc ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne hae ʒoŋao ŋic bâfuac‐joparâ iŋuc jaha miti jazawec.
Eme hae ira mamana ŋic jumbiŋ, ʒâŋe‐jeŋic Epikue ŋic â Stoike ŋic. Eme ŋic jaŋe hâcne Paulohec dâŋ mu bâtikic eec embiŋ. Ehuc gâcnezi Paulore ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ŋic keci mâc pacgoroŋ enârekac.” Â tucnezi ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “E nemu furunere biŋe mukac tinac i.” Paulo e Jesure biŋe â hâmockonec fafahare irec dâŋ mume jaŋe iŋuc mumbiŋ.
Iŋuc murâ mâreŋ facne moc ʒâŋene Areo ira jowa ferâ mumbiŋ: “Go dâŋ furune mukomec i weniŋucte mukic,
dâŋ i hazec furu‐nâŋec, irec fuŋnehec mutec mananaŋ.”
Ateŋ haeonec ŋic, mafa â hae fâri, jaŋe dâŋ biŋe furune manarâ dâŋ ijaha qame qoŋgiŋ ehuc mu binaŋ mâretec ejumbieŋ.
Eme Paulo e Areo dâŋtomao ra domahuc ŋic ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ateŋ haeonec ŋicbureŋ, no fuŋne‐ŋeŋic ʒiŋuc honekopac, ŋoŋe nemu bocjaha jaŋere araŋ baeŋgopieŋ.
No hae‐ŋeŋicko rac warec ehuc nemuɋâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic honec‐jopaku alata mocko qâreŋ ʒiŋuc fome wosepac: ‘Kecʒi nemu furune mocte biŋe.’ Eme nemu furune, mi manahuc kiŋaŋ qacneeŋgopieŋ, Anutu hâcne, ere fuŋne ŋazape mananiŋ.
Anutu e mâreŋ bâfuarâ fainao wiac sasawa râe‐fârewec, eki hâcne sambâŋ â mâreŋ irec rune.
E ufuŋ ŋicmezi bakicne ira ŋeŋe juju mi eekac, erâ wâc wiac moc basame ŋiczi gie bacnehuc wiac bâbâfuacne mi fokac. I aricne, ekizia ŋic nâŋâc juju â mâro â wiac sasawa nâre‐fâreekac.
Erâ ŋic ukicne mocjaha bâfuarâ mume eraonec mâreŋ sâc ŋic gurune gurune fua rambeŋ. Erâ fuarâ juranaŋte dameŋ â gaŋ rukec i ekizia munârewec.
Erâ i maŋnâŋeczi basac qasac eraku Anutu e jahacne bâfuanaŋte manasuhuc iŋuc ewec. E ʒoricko mâcne, ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko ŋic sâcnâporâ juekac.
‘Nâŋâc ere jujumaŋko juhuc wiac ebac eeŋgopeneŋ.’ Ŋoŋere mamana ŋic gâcnezi wâc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: ‘Nâŋâc Anuturaonec fuakicne.’
Eme ŋic jaŋe maŋjeŋicte erâ gol me siliwa me qânâzi ɋâŋ qâqâtâc ba eric eeŋgopieŋ, ine Anuturaonec fuakicne nâŋâc Anuture manapene irec sâc mi ezejec.
Qâpuc juwefuhapie hone akic eŋare warehuc juwec, irec dameŋ tarawec. Ʒi ine mâreŋ sâc ŋic mâmâc sasawa maŋjeŋic bârisieniŋte mujarekac.
E dameŋ bawec fokac, ira mâreŋne mâreŋne ŋic fuŋne‐nâŋec bataniŋkerâ okacne sâckoa nâreocmu. Erâ ŋic moc e gie i hâcne baocte âkendâŋnewec, erâ mâreŋŋic sasawa e manapaŋkenaŋte hâmockonec bâɋârewec jukac.”
Paulo e hâmockonec fafahare irec dâŋ mume gâcnezi mu surec embiŋ, â gâcnezi mumbiŋ, “Dâŋ i dameŋ mocte wâc mutec mananʒepeneŋ.”
Iŋuc epie Paulozi behec‐joparâ rawec.
Ŋic gâcnezi ine Paulorao qohotahuc Jesure biŋe embiŋ. Jaŋeraonec mumutara ŋic sâko moc ʒâŋene Dionisio, erâ ŋokac moc ʒâŋene Damari, erâ gâcne.
Eme Paulo e Ateŋ hae beherâ Korinti haeo rawec.
Ira Judaŋic moc bâfuawec, ʒâŋene Aqila, e Pontu mâreŋko fuawec. Erâ ŋonâŋ‐ticne Prisila ehec Italia mâreŋko juhapire ŋicwofuŋ sâko Klaudiozi Judaŋic Roma hae sakare‐jarehuc jâpec‐jopawec. Eme jahe hae i beherâ ɋâricne Korinti haeo rapic. Eme Paulozi jahe iqic‐jofawec.
Paulo e selific bapa, â Aqila e gie ijaha bawecte ficticnao ŋeŋe juju ehuc bafickeme mâmâc bapic.
Erâ Paulo e sabata hombaŋ sâc Judaŋic jaŋere mitificko ferâ Judaŋic â Grikŋic miti jazahuc mu bâŋgoroŋ ejarewec.
Eme Sila â Timoteo jahe Makedonia mâreŋkonec warepire Paulozi miti gie paŋʒâic bawec, ehuc Jesu e Kristo jâmbâŋ irec fuŋne Judaŋic ritu ɋaɋacke‐jarewec.
Iŋuc ejareme jaŋe dâŋticne bâsuehuc mu supaic ecnepie ŋaqi‐ticne itiriŋkeme gâc wândoc wahame ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Sipirickeniŋmu irec kiŋ nore mâcne, ŋaŋacne eocmu. Irec ʒi râpec‐ŋoparâ qâpuc jaŋerao sawa gie bapemu.”
Iŋuc murâ ŋic moc ʒâŋene Titio Justo, e Grikŋiczi Judaŋic jaŋere qâjâpecne juwec, ere ficko ferâ ŋeŋe juju ewec. Ficticne Judaŋic jaŋere mitific heririŋ ŋewec.
Eme mitificte soŋaŋ ʒâŋene Krispo e â wiacfâcne jaŋe miti manarâ Jesure kikefuŋ embiŋ. Eme Korinti ŋic jaŋeraonec wâc bocjahazi miti manambiŋ i mana ʒakierâ Miti Opâ ruambiŋ.
Eme ŋafe mocko Wofuŋzi Paulo maŋko fuac ecnehuc ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Go hâhâwic qamaserâ miti murâ mi behezemec, muhuc jaha juzemec.
