Jesajazi findaŋdâŋ moc ʒiŋuc hâcne muwec: “Sambâŋ momori jaŋere Wofuŋ e ŋicukic moc mi getâc‐jopa‐nâreme muzac, ine Sodom jaŋere sâc bâfuanʒapeŋ, â Gomora jaŋe iŋucne enʒapeŋ.”
Eme ʒi weniŋuc muzo? Kecʒiŋuc: Ŋic qâpuc tiŋke biaŋ eniŋte mi fotariembiŋzi tiŋke biaŋ embiŋ, mamanasiŋte tiŋke biaŋ embiŋ hâcne.
Â Israe ŋic sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkehuc tiŋke biaŋ eniŋte fotariembiŋzi sâcmutâc dâŋ bâmâmâckembiŋ.
Wemocte? Ʒiŋucte: Jaŋe mamanasiŋte mâcne, mâc juju bapa‐jeŋicte tiŋke biaŋ eniŋte mumbiŋ. Ehuc hatao qânâ fowec ira kike‐jeŋic hezumbiŋ.
Kecʒiŋuc hâcne qâreŋkekicne fokac: “Manakic, no Zioŋ haeo qânâ moc râekopac ira kike‐jeŋic hepirickeniŋmu, â buse ŋeŋene moc hekopac ira heariweniŋmu. Eme moczi e manasiŋkeocmu ine mi qurutuaocmu.”
Qomâfâc‐nane, Judaŋic âgofâc‐nane biaŋkeniŋte maŋnanezi boc enareme Anutu irec numucneekopac.
Jaŋe Anutu kiŋaŋ qacneniŋte ʒoɋac ehuc jueŋgopieŋ i honeekopaczi mukopac. Erâ i hatane kâuc bahuc eeŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe Anuturaonec kiŋfâsâc eere hata fokac i kâuc baeŋgopieŋte jaŋac tiŋke biaŋ eniŋte giene baeŋgopieŋ. Irec Anutu tiŋne rune mi dapecnembiŋ.
Ŋiczi mamanasiŋhec erâ kiŋfâsâc bâfuanaŋte Kristozi sâcmutâc dâŋte hata hebâzicke‐nârewec.
Mose e dâŋ ʒiŋuc qâreŋkewec: “Ŋic moc e sâcmutâc dâŋte tiŋke biaŋ hata âteocmuzi juju bâfuaocmu.”
Â mamanasiŋte tiŋke biaŋ eere dâŋ ine kecʒiŋuc fokac: “Go maŋgezi ʒiŋuc mi muzemec: Mozi sambâŋko ferâ Kristo bawahaocmu,
me mozi hârâcko hurâ Kristo hâmokicne jaŋeraonec jowa wefuocmu?”
Iŋuc mâcne, tiri papiao kecʒiŋuc mukicne: “Miti i ʒoricko mi fokac, i mumugao â mamanagao râekicne.” I mamanasiŋte dâŋ ŋaza qazuc eeŋgopeneŋ irec mukicne.
Jesu e Wofuŋ‐nane i mumugao foocmu â Anutuzi Jesu hâmockonec bâɋâre‐narewec i mamanagao foocmu eme biaŋkerâ jucmu.
Maŋzi Jesu manasiŋkehuc kiŋfâsâc ezo, â miczi e mutaniŋkehuc biaŋkezo.
Eme irec hâcne miti papiao kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne: “E manasiŋkeocmuzi mi qurutuaocmu.”
Judaŋic â Grikŋic bârâwiŋ mi eŋgopeneŋ, e mocjahazi Wofuŋ junâre‐fâreekac, erâ wiac fuŋne fuŋne hezu henâreekac.
Irec hâcne ʒiŋuc mukicne: “Wofuŋte ʒâŋe riwaseckeocmuzi biaŋkerâ juocmu.”
Ririwasecke i e mi manasiŋkeeŋgopieŋzi wemocko eniŋmu? Anutu mamanasiŋke i dâŋticne mi manaeŋgopieŋzi wemocko eniŋmu? Anutu dâŋticne mamana i biŋe mumu tâmiric wemocko eniŋmu?
Â biŋe mumu i moczi jaza sorec mi ejarehame wemocko fuaniŋmu? Dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “Biŋebiaŋ mumuŋic jaŋere kike fânâŋzi maŋ baafec bâfuaekac.”
Biŋebiaŋ ine ŋic gâcnezi mana rereŋ mi embiŋ. Jesajazi wâc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Wofuŋ, biŋedâŋ muhaŋnekicne i mozi mana ʒakiewec?”
Irec ʒiŋuc manazo: Mamanasiŋ i miti mu manacte fârine, â miti mu manac i Kristore micte fuaekac.
Hâc, eme ʒiŋuc muhuc wiokopac: Jaŋe miti mi manambiŋ me? Iŋuc mâcne, “Micfânâŋ‐jeŋiczi mâreŋ sâcke‐fârewec â dâŋjeŋiczi mâreŋ qaŋeŋnao fisiwec.”
Eme mocwâc wiohuc mukopac: Israe ŋic jaŋe mi mecne mana‐hâmombiŋ? Iŋuc mâcne, qanaŋ Mosezi ʒiŋuc qâreŋkewec i mupe: “No ŋic omane rocjopape siric‐ŋopapie iiŋguuŋ ejarenʒepieŋ; ŋicguru mutucne hefârec‐jopape buŋeŋic gâpârezejec.”
Eme ʒâhec Jesajazi dâŋ bâutuckehuc kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Mi basacnuhuc jumbiŋzi bâfuacnumbiŋ, nore mi muhuc jumbiŋ jaŋe maic‐jopapo.”
Erâ Israe ŋic jaŋere ine ʒiŋuc mu qâreŋ ewec: “No ŋicguru mana qâomane â mickobacne dameŋ ʒora meoric qajarehuc jupo.”
Eme wiokopac: Anutuzi ŋicfâc‐ticne behec‐jopawec me? Aricne, iŋuc mi ewec. Noni Israe ŋic jaha wâc, Abrahamte ɋâric, Benjamiŋte guruonec.
Anutuzi qanaŋ manac‐jopawec ŋic i mi behec‐jopawec. Me ŋoŋe Eliare binaŋ miti papiao i wose manac mi eeŋgopieŋ me?
E Israe ŋic jaŋere dâŋ muhuc Anutu ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Wofuŋ, jaŋe porofetefâcge jopa‐fârehuc alatage henʒaŋnembiŋ, eme ʒi buc juhape no wâc nuniŋte muŋgopieŋ.”
Iŋuc mume Anutuzi dâŋ weniŋuc bâtikiecnewec? “No ŋic 7000 sakarec‐jopape Baali nemu mi dapecnembiŋ.”
Eme dameŋ ʒi iŋuc jaha Anutuzi aki anonoc‐ticnere erâ ŋic tiwâne rowosâec‐jopawec juŋgopieŋ.
I aki anonoc‐ticnere iŋuc ejarewecko juju bapa‐jeŋicte mi ejarewec. Iŋuc mi eme muzac, ine aki anonoc fârine mi ezac.
Eme weniŋuc? Israe ŋic jaŋe wiac fârine bâfuazo mumbiŋ i mi bâfuambiŋ; rowosâec‐jopakicne jaŋe sawa bâfuambiŋ, gâcne sâko ine maŋsanaŋ embiŋ.
Irec ʒiŋuc hâcne qâreŋkekicne fokac: “Anutu e maŋjeŋic bâsifuckewec, ʒâŋe‐jeŋic bâhâpowec â hazec‐jeŋic qâzic qawec. Iŋuc ejareha jumbiŋzi jueŋgopieŋ.”
Â Dawidizi mu qâreŋ ewec: “Jaŋe nânâ nahapie râsi fisipie fâfâc‐jopazejec, Mâreŋko jopaha okacne fisi‐jarezejec.
Go ʒâŋe‐jeŋic bâhâpotec tiŋtuŋ qanʒepieŋ, â râpe‐jeŋic bahasicketec miŋgeŋ miŋgeŋ junʒepieŋ sanaŋ.”
Eme wiokopac: Israe ŋic jaŋe fâfâc‐jopawec i waha qâhâmoc‐jopaocte iŋuc fuawec me? Iŋuc aricne, jaŋe bâbâpiaŋ râpeckepie qâpuc jaŋere biŋe ewec, ine qâpuc jaŋe manapie Israe ŋic jaŋe honec‐joparâ iiŋguuŋ ejareniŋte iŋuc fuawec.
Eme miti qiqikiŋ‐jeŋiczi mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋerao miti mâriri bâfuawecko, â dodocke‐jeŋiczi ŋic qâpuc jaŋerao miti ʒâkâŋ bâfuawecko, opoŋ, juku furu jaha maŋjeŋic bârisiepie fârine mo iŋucne fuazokac!
Qâpuckonec opâ ruac ŋoŋe dâŋ ʒi ŋazape mananiŋ: No qâpuc ŋoŋere aposolo juekopaczi gie‐nane baericko baʒihuc baekopac,
i soctofafâc‐nane âkeriŋ‐jopape gâcnezi bâjâpecnuhuc biaŋkeniŋte.
Anutuzi Israe ŋic behec‐jopame mâreŋ sâc miti fuawec, izi juku rocjopame mi hâmockonec ɋâɋârezi fuazokac me?
Nânâ hata qaqasune jambuŋkepene nânâ mâmâc sâcke‐fâreekac, â jâc gâtânezi furu fome tieŋne iŋuc jaha furu foocmu.
Eme Anutuzi tieŋne gâcne hetâcne behec ehuc irec dodoma tacko oliwa kâteo fuakicne irec tieŋne go râe ʒuhuc egarewec. Eme oliwa gâtânere ŋiŋic wokemaŋzi gume hesiwiŋ egarehame,
go tieŋne raŋɋane mi mana pitiwac‐jopahuc maŋfefe mi ezemec. Iŋuc ezicte ʒiŋuc manac: Go gâtâ gume hesiwiŋ mi ecnekomec, gâtâzi go egareekac.
Mupe go ŋifecne ʒiŋuc mecne mucmu: “Anutuzi no hâcne râe ʒuhuc enareocte tieŋne raŋɋane hetâcne behec ejarewec.”
I mukic mac. Jaŋe miti qiqikiŋ‐jeŋicte hetâcne behec ejarekicne â go ine mamanasiŋgere dodomatac‐jeŋicko domakomec. Irec go sahacge mi bafehuc rumerâ juzemec.
Anutu e oliwa e jahacne tieŋne mi akickewecko go iŋuc jaha mi akicguocmu.
Irec go buuruc‐ticnere mecne â fâro‐ticnere mecne mi nikecguzejec. Fâro‐ticnere fârine i miti râpeckembiŋ jaŋerao fuawec, â buuruc‐ticnere fârine i gorao fuawec. Eme go erao qohotahuc jutec fârine i sâcne fogareocmu. Iŋuc mi etec ine go wâc hetâcne behec egareocmu.
Erâ wâc tieŋne raŋɋane jaŋe maŋsanaŋ‐jeŋic beheniŋmuo Anutuzi mocwâc râe ʒuhuc ejarezo murâ sâcne ejareocmu.
Eme kâteonec oliwa rocgurâ hae oliwa jâcnao râe ʒuhuc egareweczi hae oliwa e jahacne tieŋfâc mocwâc ʒuhuc‐jopazo murâ mi quŋkeocmu, i onʒoŋ jaha ʒuhuc‐jopaocmu.
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋe, kâuc bahuc ŋaŋacne mamanao roweckerâ mana sifuckenʒipiŋte dâŋ soŋne ʒi mufua‐ŋarepe. Israe ŋic tucne jaŋe maŋsanaŋ erâ juhapie qâpuc sâko jaŋe mitire maŋko raʒiniŋmu.
Raʒihapie ʒâhec Israe ŋicguru qâqâhâc biaŋke‐fâreniŋmu. Ʒiŋuc hâcne qâreŋkekicne fokac: “Zioŋ haeonec Bâbâpiaŋ moc fuarâ Jakoborao jawa âsu gârec ofaŋneme raocmu.
Iŋuc eme no sâqocne‐jeŋic ʒurerâ jaŋehec mocwâc ʒâʒâfic epemu.”
Israe ŋic jaŋe qâpuc ŋoŋere erâ Biŋebiaŋte râsi juŋgopieŋ â rowosâec‐jopakicnere ine mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere erâ Anuture jorocfâc juŋgopieŋ.
Anutu e âgo ʒâʒâfic dâŋsaric‐ticne â hehefâre dâŋticne mi dockeocmu.
Qâpuc ŋoŋe mârâc jaha maŋsanaŋ erâ jumbiŋ, eme ʒâhec Israe ŋic jaŋe maŋsanaŋ ehapie Anutuzi buuruc‐ticnao râec‐ŋopawec.
Iŋuc jaha jaŋe maŋsanaŋ juhapie Anutuzi buuruc‐ticnao râec‐ŋopawec, i jaŋe wâc buuruc ejareocte iŋuc ewec.
Anutu e ŋic sasawa bâturec‐jopahuc qaqatarao basanaŋ‐jopawec, i mâmâc sasawa buuruc‐ticnao râec‐jopaocte iŋuc ewec.
Opoŋ, Anutu e mitire mâriri â maŋɋârâŋ â mamana saric‐ticne irec ʒâkâŋne mo iŋucne fokac! Mumutara‐ticnere fuŋne i ŋiczi mi mamanane â gie bapa‐ticnere hata i ŋiczi mi hohonene.
“Wofuŋte maŋko dâŋ fokac i mo ŋiczi manawec, me dâŋ muhame mozi bafickerâ muwec?”
“Me mo ŋiczi e qanaŋ wiac moc qikiŋnecnewecko tofane bazucneocmu?”
Wiac sasawa eraonec wareekac â erao siŋkerâ foekac â erao rafâreekac. Mumuteŋzi mumuteŋ i erao ʒuhuckeme ʒuhuc foraʒihuc juzejec sanaŋ. Jâmbomac.
Âgofâc‐nane, no Anutu buuruc‐ticnere erâ dâŋ hazec qâuŋ ŋazape mananiŋ. Ŋoŋe sahac‐ŋeŋic Anutu qikiŋnecnepie taha bâzi ɋaɋacne â tirine eme honeme biaŋkezejec. Iŋuc ehuc Anutu kiŋaŋ fârine qacnenʒepieŋ.
Erâ juju bapa‐ŋeŋiczi miti tâmiric jaŋere sâc mi ezejec. Ŋoŋe maŋ mamanasu‐ŋeŋic bâtikiepie hawarine moc eme Anutu micdâŋ‐ticnere sâcko gie biaŋne â hohone ʒiziwene â tirine irec wosâenʒepieŋ.
Aki anonoc tahacnukicnere mâmâc sasawa ŋazape mananiŋ: Moc e jahacnere maname fefene boc mi ezejec, Anutuzi miti râcnewec sâc i sawa ezejec, sâc jâuruhuc ine mi ezejec.
Ʒiŋuc mananiŋ: Fâri ombâŋ‐nâŋec mocjaha e kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne bocjahazi gie fuŋne fuŋne baeŋgopieŋ.
Eme ŋifec Kristorao iŋuc jaha bocjahazi qâfâsâepene fâri ombâŋ mocjaha ekac, erâ me kikefâcne juhuc dodopec eeŋgopeneŋ.
Mitire tâpire fuŋne fuŋne i aki anonoc nâre tahac ekicne sâc fonâre rakac. Eme irec sâcko gie banʒepeneŋ. Irec moc e Anuture micdâŋ mumufuare tâpiri focnekacko mamanasiŋ‐ticnere sâcko muzejec.
Moc e kiŋaŋ qaqa giere tâpiri focnekaczi gie i bazejec, â moc e qaqazu gie baocmu e irec tâpiri focnekac sâc bazejec.
Uŋsawaŋ dâŋ muekac e irec tâpiri focnekacko muzejec, bâmec gie baekac e maŋticne bawahahuc bazejec, moc e micne juocte mucnekicko ʒoɋachec juzejec, â moc e jauŋ gie baocmuzi buafec jaha bazajec.
Jauŋ babac i sahaczi sawa mi enʒepieŋ. Wiac sâqocnere mamakâc‐ŋopazejec â wiac biaŋnao qohotanʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ââgo fârine junʒepieŋ, erâ sâsâsec eniŋte sisiric efârenʒepieŋ.
Rokac bârokac tâmiric ɋicwânʒâŋhec erâ junʒepieŋ. Mârore buŋeŋic bâruŋkezejec, ehuc Wofuŋ kiŋaŋ qacnenʒepieŋ.
Sambâŋ worickehuc bubiaŋ junʒepieŋ, â ʒâic busâqocko maŋuruc junʒepieŋ. Erâ nunumu gie i uruc ʒuhuc jaha banʒepieŋ.
Anuture mitiŋicfâc hume serereŋ jupie hone bafic ejarenʒepieŋ. Ŋic fisipie afeckerâ hezu hewâneŋ ejarenʒepieŋ.
Ŋopa jâpec eŋareniŋmu jaŋe jambuŋ‐jopanʒepieŋ. Micŋeŋickonec sâwecdâŋ mâcne, jambuŋdâŋ sawa wahazejec.
Bubiaŋ eniŋmu jaŋe qâtec‐joparâ bubiaŋ enʒepieŋ, kioniŋmu jaŋe qâtec‐joparâ kionʒepieŋ.
Maŋŋeŋic bâturehuc wiac mocjahare henʒiriŋnehuc junʒepieŋ. Ŋaŋacnere boc mi manapie sâckezejec.
Sâqocnere okac babazuc mi enʒepieŋ. Ŋic âgo ejareekac ijaha enʒepieŋ.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋehec wamao juju i eene eme ŋoŋe hâcne irec hatane âtenʒepieŋ.
Âgofâc, kiŋŋeŋic ŋaŋac mi batarahuc Wofuŋ kimbeŋ‐ticnere biŋe râepie fozejec. Dâŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne qâreŋkekicne fokac: “Kiŋ babatara i nore gie, â okacne babazu i no nahac epemu, Wofuŋ e iŋuc mukac.”
Ŋoŋe ine ʒiŋuc enʒepieŋ: Râsige nânâre hâmome nânâ gumezemec, opâre hâmome opâ gumezemec. Go iŋuc etecne mimiehuc ʒara marane eocmu.
Sâqocnezi go mi bawahacguzejec. Aricne, go wiac biaŋne ehuc sâqocne bawahazemec.
Ŋic mâmâc sasawa kia gawaman jaŋere dâŋ reŋkenʒepieŋ. Kia gawaman gie i Anuturaonec. Juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe Anuture micte juraŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Irec moc e kia gawaman jaŋere dâŋ qâsuahuc Anuture dâŋ qâsuaocmu. Erâ qâsuaniŋmu jaŋe okacne roniŋmu.
Ebapa‐jeŋic biaŋne jaŋe kia gawaman jaŋere mi hâwic‐jopaekac, sâqocne baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine hâwic‐jopaekac. Irec go hâhâwic tâmiric juzo murâ wiac biaŋne ezemec. Wiac biaŋne etec gore manapie sâckeocmu.
Kia gawaman jaŋe Anuture kiŋaŋ qaqa hâcne, ŋezicgupie juhâmocmurâ mujarekicne. Go sâqocne bacmuo ine hâwicguzejec, jaŋe ʒika maŋgâŋ mi bajueŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe Anuture kiŋaŋ qaqazi sâqocne bapa jaŋerao bâbâtiŋ gie bahuc okacne jareniŋmu.
Irec dâŋjeŋic reŋke‐jâmbâŋkezo, erâ i okacnere hâhâwicte sawa mâcne, gahacne maŋzi tutuc qagarezacte wâc dâŋjeŋic reŋkezemec.
Jaŋe Anutuzi soŋaŋ gie mujarewec i baeŋgopieŋte hâcne ŋoŋe takesi moneŋ râeeŋgopieŋ.
Eme ŋoŋe wiac mukicne sâc ejarenʒepieŋ: Takesi jajarere mukicne jaŋe takesi jarenʒepieŋ, kiŋaŋ qaqajarere mukicne jaŋe kiŋaŋ qajarenʒepieŋ, araŋ babajarere mukicne jaŋe araŋ bajarenʒepieŋ, sâsâsec‐jopare mukicne jaŋe sâsec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Wiac omanere tofa bazupie tarazejec, maŋjauŋte tofa mocjaha babazuc epie tatarane ine mi fokac. Maŋjauŋhec juekaczi sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkekac muzo.
Sâcmutâc dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukicne: Ŋowe ŋonâŋ ŋohe bebehec mi ezepirec, go ʒika mi qazemec, go fiuc mi rozemec, go andac mi ezemec, sâcmutâc dâŋ i erâ gâcne i mâmâc sasawa qâhâckerâ qizecne ʒiŋuc mukicne: Gahacnere egareekac sâc ijaha âgogere egarezejec.
Maŋjauŋhec juocmuzi âgo‐ticne sâqocne mi ecneocmu. Irec maŋjauŋzi sâcmutâc dâŋrereŋ fârine ekac.
Iŋuc eniŋte muŋarekicne ŋoŋe dameŋ ʒirec fuŋne manaŋgopieŋ, guŋkonec ɋârerâ faharezo irec ʒâfo maickekac hâcne. Miti fuŋkerâ manambeŋ ira bâbâpiaŋte dameŋ ʒoʒoricne fowec, ʒi ine dameŋ qândâŋkekac.
Ŋafe tarazo ekacte hae fureocte furic râekac. Irec dapâcte wiac hetararâ tatamackonec sându maro menâŋecko raʒizejec.
Ʒoaŋ ɋaɋacko jujune pectâc junʒepeneŋ, nâ areŋ â tiwâ kadahe me gae wowo â sasec mamakâc me rârâsi â iiriac i mi ezo, aricne.
Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo e ŋaqi‐ŋeŋic eme rojunʒepieŋ. Erâ sahac‐ŋeŋiczi sasec bâfuazacte mana manahuc jauŋ bacnenʒepieŋ.
Mitio gegec bititicne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe âgo miriŋ ejarenʒepieŋ, ehuc wiac omanere memeŋgaru epie mu qâsuac mi ejarenʒepieŋ.
Moc e manabâc tâmiric wiac kosa nâekac, moc e ine memeŋgaru ehuc monʒaŋ sawa nâekac.
Irec wiac kosa nâocmuzi âgo‐ticne nâ bâtâc eekac eremaname wawahane mi ezejec, â nâ bâtâc eocmuzi âgo‐ticne wiac kosa nâekac ere maname mi sâqorezejec. E Anuture ŋic jaha wâc.
Irec go wemogezi mocte kiŋaŋ qaqa miti babaju‐ticnere fuŋne mutec sâckeocmu? E sanaŋkeocmu me dockeocmu, i Wofuŋ‐ticnere wiac. Erâ e mi dockeocmu, Wofuŋ e sâcne hume keteŋ ecneme qiŋ herâ domaocmu.
Â ʒoaŋ gie bapare iŋuc jaha, moc e wose bâtâc eocmu, â moc e maname qâfâsâeocmu. Moczi me moczi iŋuc me iŋuc ezo murâ mana sanaŋkehuc ezejec.
Ʒoaŋ gie bapa wose bâtâc eekaczi Wofuŋte erâ eekac, â nânâ kosa nâekaczi Wofuŋte erâ eekac wâc, ehuc Anutu nânâre daŋge âzâcneekac. Â nâ bâtâc eekaczi iŋuc jaha Wofuŋte erâ eekac, ehuc Anutu daŋge âzâcneekac wâc.
Nâŋâcnaonec moczi moc e jahacnere mi juekac â e jahacnere mi hâmoekac.
Juju i Wofuŋte jueŋgopeneŋ, hâhâmo i Wofuŋte hâmoeŋgopeneŋ. Irec junaŋmu me hâmonaŋmu i Wofuŋtea enaŋmu.
Irec hâcne Kristozi hâmokicne â ɋâricne mâmâc Wofuŋ enâreocte hâmorâ wâc ɋârewec.
Eme go wemogezi âgogere dâŋ mutaracmu? Me go wemogezi âgogere manatec wawahane eocmu? Nâŋâc mâmâc sasawa Anuture maio fuapene dâŋnâŋec mutara‐nâreocmu.
Ʒiŋuc hâcne qâreŋkekicne fokac: “Wofuŋzi mukac, no jujâmbâŋkekopacte ŋic ʒeŋgoma dieŋzi henare‐fârenʒepieŋ â ʒeŋgoma micjeŋiczi muafecnunʒepieŋ.”
Irec nâŋâc mâmâc sasawa Anuturao fuŋne‐nâŋec munaŋte munârekicne hâcne.
Irec nâŋâc dâŋ mumutarac mi enʒepeneŋ. Kecʒiŋuc ine ezo: Ŋoŋe âgo gâcne maŋ bâsifuc ejarehuc mamana sâqoc bâfua‐jarenʒipiŋte manabâcko junʒepieŋ.
No Wofuŋ Jesuhec juekopaczi ʒiŋuc mana sanaŋkekopac: Nânâ i me i nâhuc wâwânâŋhec eene mi fokac. Â moc e, wiac kosa nârâ wâwânâŋhec ezo, iŋuc muhuc sifu nâocmu, e ine jâmbomac wâwânâŋhec eocmu.
Go ine âgoge nânâre busâqoc bâfuacnetec maŋjauŋ micke‐garezo. Âgoge biaŋkeocte Kristozi ere wâc hâmowec, go irec manasuhuc âgoge nânâre erâ ba imac mi ecnezemec.
Ŋoŋe wiac fârine bajuŋgopieŋ i ŋic gâcnezi musoriŋkenʒipiŋte soŋaŋkehuc bajunʒepieŋ.
Nânâ qowizi Anuture uucmaŋte fârine mi ekac, kiŋfâsâc fufua â wama â Tiri Mâroraonec ʒeri bubiaŋ izi wiac fârine.
Moc e hata i âtehuc Kristo kiŋaŋ qacneme e Anutuzi honeme biaŋkeocmu â ŋic jaŋe ere manapie sâckeocmu.
Irec hâcne nâŋâc wama foocte â miti maŋ sâc fua bâbâriŋ eocte hehesanaŋ enʒepeneŋ.
Go nânâre erâ Anuture gie ima mi qazemec. Nânâ qowi i biaŋne sasawa, moc e ine, nârâ maŋbâiŋ gie bapemu, iŋuc manahuc sifu nâme sâqorecneocmu.
Go âgoge maŋbâiŋ ecnezicte ere erâ qowi â waiŋ opâ qikiŋnetec sâckeocmu.
Go wiac iŋucnere maŋfâsâcge fokac, i Anuture maio bajutec gahacnao sawa fozejec. Mo e wiac mocte maname sâckeha maŋbahac fâfâsâc eme biaŋkeocmu.
Â moc e mana maŋjahec eipiehuc sifu nâme sâqorecneocmu, e mamanasiŋ faio me ekac irec. Wiac i me i mamanasiŋ faio mi epene bahacnehec eocmu.
Sanaŋheczi gegec dodocne âsi qataŋ ejarenʒepeneŋ, nâŋâc nâŋâcnere mamanac mi junʒepeneŋ.
Nâŋâc âgofâc‐nâŋec jaŋere mamanac juhuc biaŋkeniŋte â mitio sanaŋkeniŋte bafic‐jopanʒepeneŋ.
Kristo e iŋuc jaha e jahacnere mamanac mi juwec. Dâŋqâreŋ moc ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “Go musoriŋgumbiŋ jaŋere mumusoriŋzi nore faio fekac.”
Mârâc jaha dâŋ mu qâreŋ embiŋ, i nâŋâc mitire fuŋne mana‐hâmonaŋte embiŋ, dâŋqâreŋ izi hâcne basanaŋ‐nâpohuc baafec‐nâpome wiac biŋe qanârekicne irec mamanac junaŋte qâreŋkekicne.
Anutu e babasanaŋ â bâbaafec runezi eŋareme Jesu Kristore sâko maŋ mamanasu mocjaha erâ junʒepieŋ.
Ehuc maŋŋeŋic â micŋeŋic tureme Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo ere Anutu â Mamac muteŋkenʒepieŋ.
Irec hâcne Anuture eri qâreŋ fuaocte Kristozi rocŋopawec iŋuc jaha ŋoŋe maŋzi roroc efârenʒepieŋ.
No kecʒiŋucte ŋazakopac: Anutu e mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec biŋedâŋ mujâmbâŋkehuc jazawec i fârinehec eocte Kristozi mahec nâŋere kiŋaŋ qaqa ewec.
Erâ wâc ŋic qâpuc jaŋe Anutu buuruc‐ticnere erâ muteŋkeniŋte iŋuc ewec. Dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “No qâpuc jaŋerao muteŋguhuc ʒâŋege mumbiaŋkepemu.”
Erâ dâŋ moc kecʒiŋuc fokac: “Ŋic qâpuc ŋoŋe Anuture fuŋfuŋfâc jaŋehec mu ʒeri enʒepieŋ.”
Erâ moc ʒiŋuc: “Qâpuc ŋoŋe ʒeŋgoma Wofuŋ mucne bacnenʒepieŋ, â ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe e muac baafec ecnenʒepieŋ.”
Erâ Jesajazi dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc mu qâreŋ ewec: “Jâctuc Isai gitecne fuarâ eki qâpuc Wofuŋ ejareocmu; eme qâpuczi ere mamanac juniŋmu.”
Ʒeŋaŋ rune Anutu e mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋicte bubiaŋ â wama bâfua‐ŋareme Tiri Mârore tâpirio ŋesiŋnepie sambâŋ ʒeŋaŋ‐ŋeŋicte manariŋ qâriŋ ŋoŋerao fua ŋeiŋ ezejec.
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋe uruc jauŋ‐ŋeŋic fokac â mitire fuŋne i wâc sâcne mana‐hâmoŋgopieŋ, irec ŋaŋaczia faŋ qaqac ezo murâ mi bititieniŋmu, i no fuŋne‐ŋeŋic iŋuc hâcne mana sanaŋkekopac.
Erâ sifu no Anutuzi miti gie tahacnuwecte dâŋ gâcne i mai qanʒaŋ jaha qâreŋke‐ŋarehuc mitire manasu‐ŋarekopac.
Jesu Kristo e qâpuc ŋoŋere miti kiŋaŋŋic râecnuwecte no Anutu Biŋebiaŋ‐ticnere taha bapa gie bape Tiri Mârozi maŋfuru bacŋopame Wofuŋte taha biaŋ enʒepieŋ.
No Anuture gie baekopac i Jesu Kristore erâ manape fefene eekac.
Gie i nahackoaŋ wemo‐nanezi bazapo, aricne, Jesu Kristozi neŋgoc ŋenareha qâpuc jaŋe miti mana rereŋ eniŋte miczi â mezi gie bapo.
No tâpiri â mâsihec juhuc Tiri Mâroraonec hâbi rorâ Jerusalem haeonec fuŋkerâ Kristore Biŋebiaŋ mâreŋ râreckehuc muiŋne rakupe Ilirikoŋ mâreŋko mickewec.
Ehuc gâcne jaŋere hâsinao bazipore Kristore ʒâŋe biŋe mi ra fisiwecko furunao ʒocne qapemurâ herâ wâwânʒâŋneekopac.
Dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac irec sâcko eekopac: “Dâŋ binaŋ‐ticne mi ejarekicne jaŋe e honeniŋmu, â biŋe‐ticne mi manambiŋ jaŋe mamanahec eniŋmu.”
No fuŋne iŋucte hâcne ŋoŋerao fâpemurâ dameŋ sâc quŋkeekopac.
Juwarepo i ŋoŋerao fâpemurâ maŋzi sawa manahuc jupo, ʒi ine mâreŋ gâcnao gie‐nane tarakacte
Sipen mâreŋko razo ehuc ŋoŋerao fisipemurâ manasukopac. Fisipe ŋoŋehec sahac hâroŋ qaqac erâ ŋoŋeraonec moc moczi qâtecnupie mâmâc Sipen mâreŋko ranʒepeneŋ.
Dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ine mitiŋic kiŋaŋ qajarehuc Jerusalem haeo razo ekopac.
Makedonia â Akaia kikefuŋ jaŋe Jerusalem haeonec mitiŋic hapetac dopec‐jopaniŋte afeckerâ mupaŋkembiŋ.
Jaŋe buafec‐jeŋicte iŋuc epie sâckewec. Qâpuckonec miti mamana jaŋe Jerusalem haeonec mitiŋic jaŋeraonec miti boreŋ rombiŋte tofa jaŋerao fokac. Eme tofa i hâcne bazu‐jareniŋte sahackopec wiac jarepie sâckeocmu.
Eme mumupaŋ‐jeŋicte fârine fuawec i no nahac bararâ jarepe tarame ŋoŋerao fotâcnehuc Sipen mâreŋko rapemu.
Erâ no manakopac, ŋoŋerao metariŋ mi fâpemu, Kristoraonec jambuŋ kadahe bafâpemu.
Âgofâc‐nane, no Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere erâ â Mârore jauŋte erâ hazec qâuŋ ŋazakopac, ŋoŋe nore erâ Anutu numucnehuc juju gie‐nanere baficnunʒepieŋ.
Baficnupie Anutuzi Judaia mâreŋko ŋic jaŋere meonec bataracnuzejec, â Jerusalem haeonec mitiŋic bubiaŋ wiac jarepe aŋac‐jopazejec.
Izi ʒâhec Anutuzi manahame bubiaŋko fârâ ŋoŋerao jumanahuc âke mâteŋnuzejec.
Anutu wama rune eki ine ŋoŋehec jufârezejec. Jâmbomac.
Ŋokac âgo‐nâŋec Foibe, Keŋkereai kikefuŋ bafic‐jopahuc juekac, e fâ fisime
ŋoŋe mitio munârekicne irec sâcko Wofuŋte erâ hezu hewâneŋ ecnenʒepieŋ. Erâ e irec me irec ecneme bafickenʒepieŋ. Ŋokac e no nahacne â gâcne mâmâc kiŋaŋ qanârehuc juwec.
Erâ Prisika â Aqila, Kristo Jesu gie‐ticnere babafic jahec‐nane jahe jasaniŋ, mamanac‐nane jaherao fokac.
Jahe hâcne nore erâ sahac‐jekic qaisockezo epicte no sawa mâcne, hae sâc kikefuŋ nâŋe jahere bubiaŋ bajueŋgopeneŋ.
Jahere ficko mitire tumaŋneeŋgopieŋ ŋic ŋokac i jaŋe wâc mu ʒeri ejarekopac. Âgo‐nane Epaineto, Asia mâreŋ masunao micne barâ Kristoŋic ewec, e wâc mu ʒeri ecnekopac.
Maria e wâc mu ʒeri ecnekopac âzâcneniŋ, e ŋoŋere erâ gie bocjaha bawec.
Androniko â Junia, Judaŋic âgo jahec‐nane, kâpâcwâru mâmâc bacnâpokicne, jaherao mamanac‐nane fokac i jasaniŋ. Jahe ŋic ʒâŋe biŋeheczi aposolo jaŋere guruo juhuc, no mâc juhape Kristore miti bânierâ manapic.
Mitio âgo‐nane Ampiliato e wâc mu ʒeri ecnekopac.
Urbano, Kristore giere babafic embeŋ, â Sitaki âgo‐nane jahe wâc mu ʒeri ejactekopac i jasaniŋ.
Apele, Kristore ŋic fârine, â Aristobulo ere wiacfâc jaŋe mu ʒeri ejarekopac.
Judaŋic âgo‐nane Herodioŋ erâ Narikiso wiacfâcne gâcne mitio jueŋgopieŋ, jaŋerao mamanac‐nane fokac.
Ŋokac jahec Tirifaina â Tirifosa, Wofuŋte erâ gie sâko bapic, â Peasi e iŋuc jaha Wofuŋte erâ gie paŋʒâic bawec, jaŋe mu ʒeri ejarekopac wâc.
Wofuŋte bufuŋ Rufu â neŋgoc‐ticne, e no wâc neŋgoc enarewec, jaherao mamanac‐nane fokac.
Asiŋkrito, Filegoŋ, Hereme, Patoroba, Herema â âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋe mu ʒeri ejare‐fârekopac.
Filologo â ŋokac Julia erâ Nereo â seŋticne â Olumpa â miti ŋic ŋokac jaŋehec jueŋgopieŋ, jaŋe mâmâc mu ʒeri ejare‐fârekopac.
Ŋaŋac wâc mitio meo babac enʒepieŋ. Hae sâc Kristore kikefuŋ jaŋe ŋoŋere mamanac wâc juŋgopieŋ.
Âgofâc, ŋoŋerao fâfâuc bâfuahuc, miti qazu‐ŋarekicne i bâsifuckezo eeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋere ruc bahuc dic bajarenʒepieŋ.
Ŋic iŋucne jaŋe Wofuŋ Kristo mâcne, jaŋe jaŋacne hobu kiŋaŋ qacneeŋgopieŋ. Ehuc mumumbiaŋ dâŋ muhuc ŋic ŋokac omane mu bâmiriŋ ejarehuc eatuc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Miti mana rereŋ‐ŋeŋicte biŋe i hae sâc rafârewec. Eme no irec ŋoŋere bubiaŋ manahuc kecʒiŋuc eniŋte ŋazape: Wiac biaŋnere maŋafec junʒepieŋ â wiac sâqocnere ine maŋ ŋeŋemâc enʒepieŋ.
Anutu wama rune eki mi ʒoraha Sataŋ ro bawaha âte ecneocmu. Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo ere aki anonoczi ŋoŋerao fozejec.
Babafic‐nane Timoteo â Judaŋic âgofâc‐nane Lukio â Jasoŋ â Sosipate jaŋe ŋoŋere mamanac juŋgopieŋ.
Teatio no papia ʒi (Paulore mickonec) qâreŋkehuc iŋuc jaha Wofuŋte maio ŋoŋere manasukopac.
Gaio e no â kikefuŋ mâmâc sasawa hezu hewâneŋ enâreekaczi iŋuc jaha ŋoŋere manasukac. Erâ hae soŋaŋ Erasto â âgo‐nâŋec Qato jahe iŋuc jaha eŋarekopirec.[
Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere aki anonoczi ŋoŋerao fotâcnerâ fosejec. Jâmbomac.]
Anutu e Biŋebiaŋ muekopac â Jesu Kristore dâŋ muromackeekopac irec sâcko mamanasiŋko keteŋ‐ŋopaocte tâpiri focnekac. Anutu juju sanaŋ dâŋticne hâcne soŋne fowarehuc jukume
dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ere micte muropiekicne â ŋicne ŋicne mana rereŋ eniŋte miti papiao bajaŋgeŋkekicne.
Eme Anutu hâcne, buc maŋɋârâŋ juekac, erao Jesu Kristore erâ mumuteŋzi mumuteŋ hati foraʒihuc juzejec sanaŋ. Jâmbomac.
Anuture micte Jesu Kristore aposolo epo Paulo no hâcne â âgo‐nâŋec Sostene
nâhe Korinti haeonec Anuture kikefuŋ ŋoŋere papia ʒi râekoperec. Ŋoŋe Jesu Kristozi jambuŋ‐ŋoparâ tirimoc juniŋte hefârec‐ŋopawec. Iŋuc eŋareme ine hae sâc opâ ruac ʒira â gâcnao Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo ʒâŋe‐ticne riwaseckehuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋehec mocjaha embiŋ.
Mamac‐nâŋec Anutu â Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo eraonec aki anonoc â wama ŋoŋerao fotâcnerâ fozejec.
Anutu e Jesu Kristore erâ aki anonoc sesic‐ŋopawecte no ŋoŋere manasuhuc daŋge berec jaha âzâcneekopac.
E miti mumure aafec â mamana fuŋne fuŋne aameo tahac‐ŋopawec.
I Kristore mumutaniŋ dâŋzi ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko gâtâ bawecte iŋuc fuawec.
Eme mitire wiac moc mi basaeŋgopieŋ. Mâc Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo fua taniŋkeocte woŋec mocjaha jueŋgopeneŋ.
Eki hâcne Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristore fifisi dameŋko kiŋfâsâc domaniŋte hefârec‐ŋopame juhapie dameŋ‐ŋeŋic taraocmu.
Anutu e Ŋokâ‐ticne Jesu Kristo, Wofuŋ‐nâŋec hâcne, erao ʒuhuckeniŋte hefârec‐ŋopaweczi mocmu mocmu‐ticne mi fokac.
Âgofâc‐nane, no Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ʒâŋe‐ticnere erâ uŋdâŋ ʒi mupe mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe dâŋ fuŋne fuŋne â fâfâuc mi bâfuanʒepieŋ, aricne. Maŋ mamanasu‐ŋeŋic bâturepie mocjaha eha junʒepieŋ.
Âgo bureŋ, no ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko dâŋ fuawec fokac i Koloe ere wiacfâc mupie manapo.
Dâŋ kecʒiŋucte mukopac: Ŋoŋeraonec moczi muekac “no Paulore ŋic”, â moczi muekac “no Apolore ŋic”, â moczi muekac “no Kefare ŋic”, â moczi muekac “no Kristore ŋic.”
Hâc, i weniŋuc, Kristozi fâuckewec me? Me Paulo noni ŋoŋere erâ maripoŋko hâmopo? Me Paulo nore ʒâŋezi hucŋopaha Miti Opâ ruambiŋ?
Sowine no nahac Miti Opâ mi rua‐ŋarepo, Krisipo â Gaio jahe sawa rua‐jactepo.
Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc munʒipiŋte: “Ere ʒâŋezi hucnâpoha Miti Opâ ruambeŋ.”
Mâcne, ʒi moc manasukopac, Stefana ere wiacfâc jaŋe wâc rua‐jarepo, gâcne jaŋere ine mi manakopac.
Kristozi ŋic Miti Opâ rua‐jarepemurâ mâcne, Biŋebiaŋ jaza qazuc epemurâ munarewec. Erâ Kristo maripoŋ‐ticnere dâŋ tâpirimâc ezacte maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ ericke bâpiaŋ ehuc mi muekopac.
Maripoŋte dâŋ i sisipiric hata âteeŋgopieŋzi manapie racne eekac, â bâbâpiaŋ hatao jueŋgopeneŋzi ine manapene Anuturaonec tâpirihec eekac.
Dâŋqâreŋ moc ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “No maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋere dâŋ qape wahaocmu â mamana‐jeŋichec jaŋere mamana batackepemu.”
Eme maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe weni? Â mana gufu koparic ŋic jaŋe weni? Â dameŋ ʒirec fuŋne mamana jaŋe weni? Anutu e maŋ mamana‐jeŋic bahameŋkewec hâcne.
Eme Anuture maŋɋârâŋ dâŋbiri fua‐bipieha ŋic jaŋe jaŋacne mamanazi Anuture fuŋne ʒâŋitaniŋte emâmâŋkembiŋ, irec Anutuzi maname sâckeme mitidâŋ mutucne i manarâ biaŋkenaŋte muwec.
Judaŋic jaŋe fuŋne qaqa mâsire qizec qaeŋgopieŋ â Grikŋic jaŋe maŋɋârâŋhec eniŋte fotarieeŋgopieŋ,
nâŋe ine Kristo maripoŋko qakicne irec dâŋ mupene Judaŋic jaŋe manapie quŋke sâqoreekac â qâpuc jaŋe manapie dâŋ mutucne eekac,
ehame hefârec‐jopakicne, Judaŋic mecne Grikŋic mecne, jaŋe ine Kristore manapie Anutu tâpiri‐ticnere â maŋɋârâŋ‐ticnere hozine eekac.
Ŋic jaŋe Anuture mutucne muhapie mutuc‐ticnezi ŋic jaŋere mamana jâuruekac â Anuture dodocne muhapie dodocne‐ticnezi ŋic jaŋere tâpiri sirickeekac.
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋic weniŋucne hefârec‐ŋopakicne i mana honeniŋ: Sahackopec wiacte maŋɋârâŋhec bocjaha mâcne, tâpirihec bocjaha mâcne, ŋicbomboŋ guruonec bocjaha mâcne.
Ŋic maio mutucne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe Anutuzi hefârec‐jopahuc maŋɋârâŋhec mimi qaqa ejareekac, â ŋic maio gegec dodocne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe Anutuzi hefârec‐jopahuc tâpirihec mimi qaqa ejareekac,
â ŋic maio omane â hujukicne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe Anutuzi hefârec‐jopaekac, â ŋic maio bebekâne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe Anutuzi hefârec‐jopahuc ʒai ʒonʒoŋ‐jeŋichec jaŋe siŋ qatara‐jareekac.
Mâreŋŋic moczi Anuture maio sahac‐ticne bafezacte iŋuc hâcne ewec.
E mitio juju‐ŋeŋicte bâbâfua i Kristo Jesu râe‐nârewec. Kristo e hâcne Anutuzi maŋɋârâŋ dâŋte rowaŋ‐nâŋec â kiŋroro‐nâŋec â maŋɋaɋac bâbâfua‐nâŋec â kikitâc‐nâŋec râe‐nârewec.
Irec dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc fokac i sanaŋkezejec: “Moc e mumuteŋ dâŋ muzo murâ Wofuŋtao muzejec.”
Âgo bureŋ, no ŋoŋerao fisipo ine Anuture mumutaniŋ dâŋ ŋazapemurâ dâŋ ericke bâpiaŋ ehuc me maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ moc muhuc mi ŋazapo.
No ʒiŋuc mana sanaŋkehuc fâpo: Dâŋ gâcne aricne, Jesu Kristo maripoŋko qakicne ere dâŋ jâmbâŋ jaha muzepac.
Erâ ŋoŋerao dodocne enarehame hâhâwic â memezac faio boc jupo.
Ehuc miti mumu i maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ mu bâpiaŋ ekicne irec sâcko mi mupo, aricne, tâpiri â Mâro ŋoŋerao fuaocte irec sâcko mupo.
I mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋiczi ŋic maŋɋârâŋ dâŋko mâcne, Anuture tâpirio fosiŋneocte iŋuc epo.
Maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ hukicne ine maŋjeŋic ɋârâŋkekicne jaŋe jazaeŋgopeneŋ, erâ i mâreŋ kecʒirec maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ me mâreŋ ŋicbomboŋ sisirowenezi dâŋ hukicne mueŋgopieŋ irec sâc mi eekac, aricne.
Nâŋe Anuture dâŋsoŋ hukicne mufuaeŋgopeneŋ. Dâŋ i ŋic nâŋâc taniŋke ɋaɋac enaŋte Anutuzi mârâc jaha dameŋmâc juwecko mu bâmoc ewec.
Mâreŋ ŋicbomboŋ jaŋeraonec moczi moc dâŋ hukicne i hâcne mi mana tarambiŋ, mana tararâ muzac eri tatamac Wofuŋ maripoŋko mi qanʒapiŋ.
Irec dâŋqâreŋ fokac ine ʒiŋuc: “Ʒâŋezi mi honekicne â hazeczi mi manakicne, â ŋicmaŋ moczi moc mi manasukicne, Anutuzi maŋjauŋ ecneeŋgopieŋ jaŋere biŋe bâmockewec i hâcne.”
Nâŋe ine Anutuzi Mâro‐ticne ecneme dâŋ i mufua‐nârewec. Mâro e wiac sasawa irec fuŋne mana gufuc efâreekac. Anutu e jahacne fuŋne bâutuckekicne i mâmâc manaekac.
Mo ŋiczi âgo‐ticnere maŋte fuŋne manaocmu? Maŋ rune eki sawa manaocmu. Eme Anutu maŋticnere fuŋne iŋuc jaha ŋic moczi mi manaocmu, Anutu Mâro‐ticnezi buc manaocmu.
Eme nâŋe ŋickonec mâro i mi rombeŋ, nâŋe Anuturaonec miti kâdoc hone mana tarac enaŋte Anuturaonec Mâro i rombeŋ.
Nâŋe miti kâdoc irec hâcne mu binaŋ eeŋgopeneŋ. I ŋic maŋɋârâŋheczi mi qazu‐nârembiŋ, i Mârozi qazu‐nârewec. Eme Mârore dâŋ i Mârore dâŋmaracko mueŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋic Mâro tâmiric moczi ine Anutu Mâro‐ticnere dâŋ mi manaocmu. E wemo‐ticnezi manaocmu, aricne, e maname dâŋ fârimâc eocmu. I Mâroheczi mamanane sawa eekac.
Ŋic Mâroheczi wiac sasawa sâcne mana wosâeocmu, ŋic Mâro tâmiriczi ine ere fuŋne kâuc baocmu.
Wofuŋ maŋticnere dâŋ i mozi manaweczi sâcne âzâcne mutâc eocmu? Nâŋe ine Kristo maŋbucticnere dâŋ bajuŋgopeneŋ.
Âgofâc‐nane, no ŋoŋerao fisirâ ŋic Mârohec dâŋ jajazane i wemocko ŋazazapo? Aricne, ŋic Mâro tâmiric jajazane i Kristore ɋiefâc ŋoŋe ŋazapo.
No nânâ sanaŋne mi ŋarehuc susu sawa gumec‐ŋopapo, nânâ sanaŋne wemocko nanʒapiŋ. Erâ ʒiŋuczia nânâ sanaŋne nâniŋte sâc wâc mi eŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Mârohec sâcne mi embiŋ. E tâmiric juhuc hâcne iiriac â kikisâ bâfuahuc ŋic omane jaŋe iŋucne jueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe “no Paulore ŋic”, “no Apolore ŋic” mueŋgopieŋte ŋic iŋucne ŋoŋe ŋic omane hâcne muŋarezo.
Apolo e mo? Â Paulo no mo? Nâhe kiŋaŋ qaqa sawazi miti ŋazapere manambiŋ. Erâ Wofuŋzi gie munâctewec sâc bapec.
No he sarac epo, Apolo e hofâ gie bawec, â Wofuŋzi ine jambuŋkeme fârine fuawec.
Irec he sarac eekac ere mi muzo, â hofâ gie baekac ere mi muzo, jambuŋkeme fârine fuaekac, Anutu hâcne ere mocjaha muzo.
He sarac eekac â hofâ gie baekac jahe sâcjekic mocjaha, furine ine gie‐jekicte sâc bârâwiŋ ronicmu.
Nâŋe Anuture babafic, ŋoŋe ine Anuture gie â Anuture fic.
Anutuzi gie tahacnuwec sâc no ficbapa fârinezi simeŋ wâtuŋ râepe huwec. Eme irec fainao ŋic moczi fic ʒuhuckerâ baekac. Iŋucnezi mana manahuc bazejec.
Wâtuŋ huwec domakac, Jesu Kristo hâcne, e unucke behec erâ moc râepene huhune mi fokac.
Eme wâtuŋ irec fainao moczi gol siliwa me qânâ sanaŋzi, me pipisac sopâc bacrehaczi ʒuhuckerâ baocmu, ine juku fic bapa‐ticnere fuŋne taniŋkeocmu.
Juku dameŋ sâkoo hâcne fuŋne taniŋkeocmu. Ira ʒocsâko bâruŋkeocmu, eme ʒoc izi hâcne ficgiere fuŋne bataniŋkeocmu.
Ŋic moczi wâtuŋ faio fic baocmu, i ʒoczi ʒâipieme furine roocmu.
Â ŋic mocte fic ʒoczi ʒafâreme furine tâmiric juocmu, e jahacne ine akickezo, akickehuc ʒockonec batarazo.
Ŋoŋe Anuture miti ufuŋ, â Anuture Mârozi maŋŋeŋicko ŋeŋe juju eekac, i mi manaŋgopieŋ me?
Ŋic moc e Anuture ufuŋ ima baocmu e Anutuzi wâc ima baocmu. Anuture miti ufuŋ i furu mukicne, eme ufuŋ‐ticne i ŋoŋe hâcne.
Ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic mi eatuckenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋeraonec moc e ŋicdâŋ mana maŋ ehuc mamana‐ticnere maname fefene eocmu, iŋucnezi mamana i qikiŋnehuc mutucne erâ mamana fârine bâfuazejec.
Mâreŋte maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ i Anutuzi maname fârimâc eekac. Dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “E ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋe maŋsioc gie bahapie somâc‐jopame somâmaŋ‐ticnao hueŋgopieŋ.”
Erâ moc ʒiŋuc: “Wofuŋ e ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec jaŋere dâŋ maname racne eekac.”
Irec ŋoŋe mâreŋŋic nâŋere muhuc maŋfefe mi enʒepieŋ. Wiac sasawa i ŋoŋere biŋe.
Paulo â Apolo â Kefa nâŋe ŋoŋere biŋe. Erâ mâreŋko wiac sasawa, juju me hâhâmo, ʒiŋuczia fofone â juku fufuane, i ŋoŋere biŋe sasawa.
Ŋoŋe ine Kristore biŋe â Kristo eki ine Anuture biŋe.
Ŋoŋe nâŋere manapie Kristore kiŋaŋ qaqa â Anutu boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ‐ticnere soŋaŋ ezejec.
Eme soŋaŋ e ine metâne juocte mucnekicne.
Erâ no nahacnere mupe: Ŋoŋe me ŋic tutumaŋ moczi nore dâŋ muniŋmu i manape fârine mi eocmu. Erâ no nahac wâc fuŋne‐nane sâcne mi mupemu.
No bahac‐nane moc mi manakopac, erâ irec bahacmâc jukopac mi muzo. Nore fuŋne babataniŋ mocjaha jukac, Wofuŋ hâcne.
Irec ŋoŋe fuŋne babataniŋte fâro mi enʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ e jahac fisirâ wiac soŋsoŋ fokac i wâc hewirickeocmu, â ŋicmaŋko wiac fokac i mâmâc bâfua‐fâreocmu. Eme Anutuzi ŋic sasawa sâcjeŋic manahuc mumbiaŋ‐jopaocmu.
Âgofâc, dâŋ mukopac i Apolo â no nâhe nâhâcnao iticnehuc mukopac. Eme ŋoŋe nâherao fuŋne kecʒiŋuc honehuc mana taranʒepieŋ: Mitidâŋko sâc mukicne i mi jâuruhuc wiac efezo â mâreŋŋic bafec bawahac enârehuc maŋfefe mi ezo.
Me go ŋiczi wiac hezu hegareniŋte mozi mugarewec? Me go wiac fogarekac i wenimoi gare tahac mi ekicne? Aricne, i gare tahac efârekicne, eme go wemocte manatec mi garekicne tinac eme sahacge bafeekic?
Ŋoŋe ine biac gapec‐ŋopakicne, biac mâriri sâkohec embiŋ juŋgopieŋ, nâŋe tâmiric ŋicwofuŋ embiŋ juŋgopieŋ. Jâmbomac ŋicwofuŋ enʒapiŋ me, ehuc hefârec‐nâpopie ŋoŋerao ʒuhuckehuc ŋicwofuŋ jaha enʒapeŋ.
No manape Anutuzi aposolo nâŋe ŋic jawane jaŋere guruo râec‐nâpowec ekac, ʒikare biŋe ekicne tinac. Mâmâc sâko, aŋelo mecne ŋic mecne, honec‐nâpopie mamakucne eeŋgopeneŋ hâcne.
Nâŋe Kristore erâ ŋic mutucne embeŋ, ŋoŋe ine Kristorao ʒuhuckerâ mamana sâkohec embiŋ, nâŋe gegec dodocne, ŋoŋe ine sasanaŋhec, ŋoŋe fekicne, nâŋe ine waha qaqane.
Nâŋe nânâ opâre hâmo sipiric embeŋzi eeŋgopeneŋ, erâ ŋaqi tâmiric â ʒika faio â fic hae tâmiric jumbeŋzi juŋgopeneŋ.
Â wiac piticne hotâckenaŋte nâŋe nâŋâcne mezi gie baeŋgopeneŋ. Musoriŋ‐nâpohapie jambuŋ‐jopaeŋgopeneŋ, fific guguriŋ enârehapie mana urueeŋgopeneŋ.
Musâqorec‐nâpohapie mu bâmiriŋ ejareeŋgopeneŋ, nâŋe ŋic mâmâc sâko jaŋere jawa sânʒâŋ tinac jumbeŋzi juŋgopeneŋ hâcne.
No mimi qaqa eŋarepere mâcne, no naru motecfâc‐mae ŋoŋe uŋ sawaŋ eŋarehuc dâŋ ʒi qâreŋkekopac.
Kristoo wiʒecfâc‐ŋeŋic guruhec juŋareŋgopieŋ mecne, â mamac ine wemocko bocjaha juŋarenʒapiŋ, Kristo Jesure erâ Biŋebiaŋ ŋazahuc no mocjahazi mamac‐ŋeŋic epo jukopac.
Eme irec nore kike hata bâjâpehuc juniŋte hazec qâuŋ ŋazape mananʒepieŋ.
No irec erâ hâcne Timoteo, Wofuŋko motec biaŋ‐mae junarekac, e ŋoŋerao sorepe fakac, fârâ no Kristore miti hata kikefuŋ hae sâc jaza jowatuc eekopac i manasu‐ŋareme mananʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋeraonec gâcnezi e mi wareocmu, nore iŋuc muhuc mukac mupe embiŋ.
No ine Wofuŋzi maname sâckeme mi ʒoraha ŋoŋerao fâpemu, fârâ mukac mupe eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe dâŋjeŋicte mi muhuc tâpiri‐jeŋicte fuŋne bataniŋkepemu.
Anuture miti hata i dâŋko mâcne, sasanaŋko fua taniŋkeekac.
Eme ŋoŋe nore weniŋuc muŋgopieŋ? Kâcbiŋhec fâpemurâ muŋgopieŋ, me maŋjauŋ â buuruchec fâpemurâ muŋgopieŋ?
No ʒiŋuc ine jâmbomac mupie manaekopac: Ŋoŋerao mamakâc hâhâwicne, qâpuc jaŋerao mi fufuane, iŋucne fuawec fokac. Ŋic moczi mamac‐ticnere ŋonâŋhec juekac, irec mukopac.
Eme ŋoŋe wemocte wiac iŋucne fuarâ fohame pepecne eeŋgopieŋ? Ŋoŋe busâqoc manahuc ŋic wiac ewec e behenʒapiŋ me!
No sahac‐nanezi wiwicko juhuc maŋnanezi iqic‐ŋoparâ ŋic wiac ewec ere dâŋ ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko juhuc tinac kecʒiŋuc mutarapo:
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Jesu ere ʒâŋeo tumaŋnehapie no ere tâpirio ŋesiŋnehuc maŋnanezi iqic‐ŋopape
ŋic e Sataŋ qikiŋnecnepene maŋ sahac raŋɋa‐ticne sipirickezejec, eme Wofuŋ Jesure dameŋ maickeme mâro‐ticnezi aakic bâfuazejec.
Wiac iŋucne foipiehame sahac‐ŋeŋic bafeeŋgopieŋte manape sâqorekac. Bec hâhâtâne i wiac piticnezi fârine ruacneme rikepie isirickeme hâtâne efâreocmu, i mi manaeŋgopieŋ me?
Irec hâhâtâne wosâerâ behepie rahame fârine nocne enʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe hâhâtâ‐ŋeŋic ŋowac rofârekicne. Nâŋâcne aakic lama okac‐nâŋec qakicne wâc, Kristo hâcne.
Irec hombaŋ‐ticne ŋenaŋte wiac hâhâtâne behenʒepeneŋ. Mamakâc â sindaŋ irec hâhâtâne qikiŋnerâ wiac ɋaɋacne â tiŋne irec fârine nocne bajuhuc hombaŋ‐ticne ŋezo.
No mârâc papia moc ʒiŋuc qâreŋke‐ŋarepo: “Ŋoŋe sasecŋic jaŋehec wiac nâ nareŋ gareŋ â iiqic mi enʒepieŋ”,
i ŋic qâpuczi sasecŋic me bâkiri bapa â fiuc serereŋhec me bawe qaŋgec wiac babaju jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere mi mupo. Jaŋe mâreŋ behehuc behec‐jopazo i sawa fokac.
No kecʒiŋucte qâreŋke‐ŋarepo: Miti mamana âgo‐ŋeŋic moczi sasecko sâqoreocmu me bâkiri baocmu, me bawe qaŋgec wiac bajuocmu, me fiuc serereŋ eocmu, ŋic iŋucne behehuc ehec nâ nareŋ gareŋ moc mi enʒepieŋ.
No ŋic râpene jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere dâŋ mumure wemocko qâreŋkezapo. Ŋaŋacne ŋondeŋko miti mamana jaŋere bahacdâŋ mupie sâckeocmu.
Â râpene jueŋgopieŋ jaŋere bahacdâŋ i Anutuzi muocmu. Sâqocne bapa e behepie ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko mi juzejec.
Ŋoŋeraonec moczi âgo‐ticnere bahacdâŋ bajuocmu, e dâŋ i mitiŋic jaŋerao mi rârâe ŋic miti tâmiric jaŋerao râeme sâckeocmu me?
Mitiŋic nâŋâc juku miti tâmiric jaŋere dâŋ mutaranaŋmu, i mi manaŋgopieŋ me? Me juku gie iŋucne baniŋte muŋarekicnezi ŋaŋacne dâŋ jawane fuame sâcne mi mutaraniŋmu me?
Nâŋâc aŋelo jaŋere dâŋ wâc mutaranʒoŋgopeneŋzi wiac omanere dâŋ fuame wemocko bititienaŋmu.
Wiac omanere dâŋ fuame ŋoŋe wemocte kikefuŋzi mana‐jareme wawahane eekac ŋic iŋucne jaŋerao barapie mutara‐ŋareeŋgopieŋ?
Ŋoŋe dâŋ i manapie miminehec eocte ŋazakopac. Ŋoŋerao ŋic maŋɋârâŋhec moc mi jukac me? Eme dâŋŋeŋic fuame erao barapie mutiŋne‐ŋarezac.
Ŋoŋe ine iŋuc mi eeŋgopieŋ, aricne, miti mamana moczi âgo‐ticnehec dâŋbahac‐jekic fuame miti tâmiric jaŋerao barame mutara‐jacteniŋmu.
Ŋoŋerao dâŋgie fuaekac izi miti‐ŋeŋic bawahaekac. Gâcnezi wiac hehesicne me bâbâsifucne eŋarezo murâ eŋarepie ŋifecpeaŋ fozac me!
Ŋoŋe ine ŋaŋac wiac hehesicne â fiuc serereŋ eeŋgopieŋ, ehuc mitio qomâfâc‐ŋeŋic mâmâc ejareeŋgopieŋ.
Sâqocne bapazi Anuture uucmaŋko raraʒine mi fokac, i mi manaŋgopieŋ me? Ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic mi eatuckeniŋ, sau bapa, me bawe qaŋgec babaju, me ŋokac ba behecne, me sasecŋic, me ŋiczia mamakâc eec eene,
me fiuc roro, me bâkiri bapa, me maŋsifuc opâ nâ areŋ eene, me dâŋ bâbâiŋ, me kâŋgâc rohuc ʒika qaqa, iŋucnezi Anuture uucmaŋko mi raʒiniŋmu.
Eme gâcne ŋoŋe mârâc sâc iŋuc hâcne jujumbieŋ. Ʒi ine ʒurec‐ŋopakicne â maŋfuru bacŋopakicne â kiŋfâsâc bacŋopakicne. I Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristore ʒâŋe bajueŋgopieŋte â Anutu‐nâŋecte Mârohec jueŋgopieŋte iŋuc eŋarekicne.
Wiac sasawa eene fonarekac, erâ wiac sasawa epe izi sâcne mi baficnuocmu. Wiac sasawa eene fonarekac, erâ wiac moczi ŋicbomboŋ enareme irec kiŋaŋ qaqa juju ine misac.
Nânâ qowizi hobure biŋe â hobuzi nânâ qowire biŋe. Juku Anutuzi e â e mâmâc imac‐jofame arictac enicmu. Sahaczi ine sasecte biŋe mâcne, i Wofuŋte biŋe, Wofuŋ e sahacte ru.
Eme Anutuzi Wofuŋ bâɋârewec iŋuc jaha tâpiri‐ticnezi nâŋâc bâɋârec‐nâpozokac.
Sahac‐ŋeŋic Kristore kiŋaŋ qaqa, i mi manaŋgopieŋ me? Eme Kristore kiŋaŋ qaqa e weniŋuc qârisiepene sasecte kiŋaŋ qaqa eocmu? Iŋuc aricne.
Me ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc mi manaŋgopieŋ, ŋic moczi ŋokac sâqocne moctao qohotame jahe maŋ sahac mocjaha enicmu. Dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “Jahe jajaheczi mocjaha erâ junicmu.”
Â moc e Wofuŋtao qohotame ehec maŋ qâqâtâc mocjaha enicmu.
Ŋoŋe sasec boe sau dic bacnenʒepieŋ. Ŋic moczi wiac hehesicne gâcne eocmu izi sahac‐ticne mi heuaocmu, â boe sau eocmuzi ine e jahacne sahac bâbieocmu.
Me ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc mi manaŋgopieŋ, sahac‐ŋeŋic i Tiri Mârore ufuŋ, e ŋoŋere sahacmaŋko ŋeŋe juju eocte Anutuzi râe‐ŋarewec. Ŋoŋe maŋ sahac rune aricne.
Ŋoŋe furi‐ŋeŋic rokicne. Irec sahac‐ŋeŋiczi Anuture ʒâŋe biŋe dopeckezejec.
Ŋoŋe papia râe‐narehuc dâŋ wio‐narembiŋ, irec ʒiŋuc mufuape mananiŋ: Ŋic moczi ŋokac tâmiric juzo mume sâckeocmu.
Erâ sasecte eesâic fokacte ŋiczi ŋokac rorâ ehec paŋʒâic juzejec, â ŋokaczi iŋuc jaha ŋic rorâ ehec paŋʒâic juzejec.
Eme ŋiczi sahac‐ticne i ŋonâŋ‐ticne mi sakarecnezejec, â ŋonâŋzi sahac‐ticne ŋowe‐ticne mi sakarecnezejec.
Ŋonâŋ e sahac‐ticnere dâŋ mumu i jahacne mâcne, ŋowe qikiŋnecnekicne, â ŋowe e iŋuc jaha sahac‐ticnere dâŋ mumu i jahacne mâcne, ŋonâŋ qikiŋnecnekicne.
Ŋowe ŋonâŋ ŋoŋe sahac sasakarec kosa mi enʒepieŋ. Mâc nunumure afeckeniŋte qanaŋ muc manac erâ dameŋ bahuc iŋuc epie sâckeocmu. Dameŋ tâmiric mâc jufepie Sataŋzi esâic‐ŋopazacte iŋuc mukopac.
Ŋic â ŋokac roroc eniŋte mukopac i mana urue‐ŋarehuc mukopac, mupaŋke‐ŋarehuc mâcne.
Nahacne maŋzi ʒiŋuc mukac: Ŋic sasawa no jukopac iŋuc jufârenʒapiŋ me. Anutu e ine tâpiri buc buc tahac‐nâpoekac i hatane bârâwiŋ, moc iŋuc â moc iŋuc.
Ŋic ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ â hozec jaŋere ine ʒiŋuc mukopac: Jaŋe no iŋucne jufepie sâckeocmu.
Me sasec tâmiric sâcne jujune mi fojarekacko ine sasecte ʒoczi sipiric‐jopazacte ŋowe ŋonâŋ erâ junʒepieŋ.
Ŋowe ŋonâŋ ŋoŋere dâŋ mupe mananiŋ, erâ i nore dâŋ mâcne, i Wofuŋte micdâŋ: Ŋokac moczi ŋowe‐ticne mi behezejec.
Â ŋowe‐ticne biac behewecko ŋic tâmiric juzejec, me ŋowe‐ticnehec mocwâc âgo babac ezepirec. Erâ ŋic moczi iŋuc jaha ŋonâŋ‐ticne mi behezejec.
Gâcne jaŋere dâŋ ʒi mupe manapie Wofuŋte mâcne, no nahacne ezejec: Opâ ruac ŋic moc ere ŋonâŋ qâpuc juocmu, eme ŋokac izi ehec juocte ecneocmuo mi behezejec.
Me opâ ruac ŋokac moc ere ŋowe qâpuc juocmu, eme ŋic izi ehec juocte ecneocmuo mi behezejec.
Ŋic qâpuc erao ŋonâŋ‐ticnere jambuŋzi fotâcnewec, â ŋokac qâpuc erao ŋowe‐ticnere jambuŋzi fotâcnewec. Eme irec hâcne naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic jambuŋhec embiŋ juŋgopieŋ, i tâmiric muzac qâpuc junʒapiŋ.
Qâpuc ŋiczi me qâpuc ŋokaczi ine âgo‐ticne miti mamana beheocte qizec qame mi sakarezejec. Irec niŋgiŋne mi fokac. Anutu e wamao ââgo erâ juniŋte hefârec‐ŋopawec.
Ŋokac go ŋowege miti hatao fâretec wareocmu me mâcne, i moc manakic me? Me ŋic go ŋonâŋge miti hatao fâretec wareocmu me mâcne, i moc manakic me?
Moc e Wofuŋzi juju bâfuacnewec, â moc e Anutuzi gie mucnewec, sâc ijaha mitio juzejec wâc. No dâŋ iŋuc kikefuŋ hae sâc jaza mutâc eekopac.
Moc e mahec juhame Wofuŋzi hefârewecko ma i mi behezejec. Â moc e ma tâmiric juhame Wofuŋzi hefârewecko mare mi muzejec.
Mahec juju me ma tâmiric juju izi fârine mâcne, Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋ rereŋ izi fârine ekac.
Moc e dodoma ira me ira domahame Wofuŋzi hefârewecko dodoma ijaha domazejec.
Go kiŋaŋ qaqa juhaŋtec hefârecguwecko manabâc tâmiric juzemec. Mâc firuecguzo mupie mi qikiŋnezemec.
Moc e kiŋaŋ qaqa juhame Wofuŋzi hefâreme Wofuŋte ŋicfâri ewec jukac. Â moc e ŋicfâri juhame Wofuŋzi hefâreme Kristore kiŋaŋ qaqa ewec jukac.
Ŋoŋe furi‐ŋeŋic rokicnere ŋic jaŋere kiŋaŋ qaqa mi enʒepieŋ.
Âgo bureŋ, moc e mârâc domahuc miti manawec, biri ijaha dameŋ ʒiŋuczia domahuc Anuturao qohotazejec.
Naru ʒeŋoŋ jaŋere Wofuŋte micdâŋ mi bajukopac. Erâ Wofuŋzi roroŋ fâre‐nareme mitihec epore nahacne dâŋ ŋazape mananiŋ:
Dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ʒârâ hâriŋ boc fuaekacte ŋic moc ŋonâŋ tâmiric juzo mume manape biaŋkeocmu.
Â ŋokac biŋe biac mugarekicko ine mi qikiŋnezemec, me go mesawane jukicko ine ŋokacte mi muzemec.
Me ŋokac rozo murâ rotec wâc mi sâqoreocmu, â naru ʒeŋoŋ moczi ŋic rome wâc mi sâqoreocmu. Erâ iŋucnezi sahackopec wiacte hume serereŋ juniŋmu. No ine i tâmiric mac juniŋte enareha mukopac.
Âgofâc‐nane, dâŋ ʒi mupe mananiŋ: Dameŋ rifirekac. Eme dameŋ bembeŋne fokacte ŋonâŋhec jueŋgopieŋzi jupie ŋonâŋ tâmiric juju tinac ezejec,
â kioeŋgopieŋzi jupie ki tâmiric tinac ezejec, â ʒeri eeŋgopieŋzi jupie ʒeri tâmiric tinac ezejec,
â wiac nâ bac eeŋgopieŋzi jupie i tâmiric tinac ezejec. Mâreŋ hawari qâreŋne ʒi hone manac eeŋgopeneŋ i siroweocmu ekac, irec hâcne dâŋ i mukopac.
Ŋoŋe ine wiac omanere mana mezac tâmiric erâ juniŋte manasuhuc mukopac. Ŋonâŋ tâmiriczi Wofuŋte giere mana mezac eocmu, ehuc Wofuŋzi manacneme biaŋkeocte muocmu.
Ŋonâŋheczi ine sahackopec wiacte mana mezac eocmu, ehuc ŋonâŋ‐ticnezi manacneme biaŋkeocte muocmu.
Iŋuc erâ maŋguru eocmu. Eme ŋokac ʒeŋoŋ â naru ʒeŋoŋ jaŋe iŋuc jaha Wofuŋte giere mana mezac eniŋmu, ehuc maŋ sahac‐jeŋic Wofuŋte biŋe eocte manasuniŋmu. Â ŋokac ŋoweheczi ine sahackopec wiacte mana mezac eocmu, ehuc ŋowe‐ticnezi manacneme biaŋkeocte muocmu.
Ŋoŋe sâcne juhâmoniŋte dâŋ ʒi ŋazakopac, qaisoc‐ŋopahuc mâcne, ŋoŋe kosa mi juhuc maŋ mamanasu‐ŋeŋic qâzuckepie Wofuŋtea hâcbuc domaocte mukopac hâcne.
Me ŋic moc e otâ‐ticne ŋic roronere sâc bâfuaha sakareocte maname mi sâckeme ŋicko râezo murâ râezejec, i mi sâqoreocmu.
Ŋic moc e ine maŋticnezi ʒiŋuc mana sanaŋkeocmu, otâ‐nane mâc juzejec, iŋuc murâ manane mi quŋkeocmu, ehuc afeckerâ iŋuc mupaŋkeme sâckeocmu.
Irec ŋic moc e otâ‐ticne ŋicne ŋicko râeme sâsâckecne eocmu, â moc e otâ‐ticne sakareme ine sâcke‐hâmoocmu.
Ŋokac moc e ŋowe‐ticne juocmu sâc gâjoŋnao bohotarâ domazejec. Ŋowe‐ticne hâmome ine ŋic moc me moc rozo murâ rozejec, erâ kosa ehuc mâcne, Wofuŋtao roweckehuc ezejec.
Ŋowe tâmiric mâc juocmu irec ine manape sâcke‐hâmoocmu. I nahacne dâŋ, erâ i Anuture Mâro wâc fonarekacte mukopac.
Ʒi nemure tiwâ ʒepecte mupe. Nâŋâc fuŋne mamana jufâreŋgopeneŋ i manaŋgopeneŋ. Erâ fuŋne mamana saware sahac fefe fuaocmu, maŋjauŋhec juhuc ine heheʒakiec erâ sâcne juzo.
Moc e mamana‐ticne mana sokame ere muzo, mamana fârine mi focnekac.
Moc e Anutu maŋjauŋ ecneocmu, e ine Anutuzi manariŋkewec.
Nemure tiwâ ʒepecte ine ʒiŋuc manaŋgopeneŋ: Nemu e wiac fârine mâcne, Anutu e mocjaha fârine.
Nemu sambâŋko me mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ, dâŋ iŋuc mupie nemu â wofuŋ burec burec wemo afecne foraŋgopieŋ ekac.
Â nâŋâc ine Anutu Mamac‐nâŋec mocjaha junârekac, eraonec hâcne wiac sasawa fua‐fârewec â nâŋâc erea juŋgopeneŋ. Erâ Wofuŋ mocjaha, Jesu Kristo, ere meo wiac sasawa â nâŋâc jufâreŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe ine fuŋne iŋuc sâcne mi mana‐hâmoŋgopieŋ. Eme iŋucnezi nemu e wiac fârine muwarehuc juku maŋjeŋic ewecte tiwâ ʒepec e araŋ bacnehuc manabâcko nâpie maŋjeŋic hegâpâreekac.
Anutu e nânâre erâ mi mana‐nâreme biaŋkeocmu. Tiwâ ʒepec qikiŋnepene mi mana wahac‐nâpoocmu, me nâpene mi mana‐nâreme feocmu.
Mâc gâcne ŋoŋe mana jaŋgeŋkehuc nâeŋgopieŋzi âgofâc‐ŋeŋic miti afecne fojareekac jaŋe maŋ bâsifuc ejarenʒipiŋte manabâc enʒepieŋ.
Go qarâ sanaŋgere nemu ufuŋko ʒepecne nâhuc ŋehaŋtec âgoge moc manabâcheczi honecgurâ, nakacte nâpe muhuc mi ijaha nâocmu me?
Eme âgoge miti afecne focnekac e Kristore soczia wâc kitâcneweczi gore qarâ sanaŋte mi docke sâqorec eocmu me?
Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc âgofâc‐ŋeŋic wâwânâŋ ejarehuc maŋ bâsifuc ejareniŋmu, ine Kristo wâwânâŋ ecneniŋmu.
Irec no tiwâ ʒepec nâpe âgo‐nanezi irec erâ docke sâqorec ezacte ere manabâc ehuc tiwâ ʒepec qikiŋnehuc mâc juku hâmozepac.
No niŋgiŋhec juekopac me? No aposolo aricne me? No Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu mi honepo me? Gie‐nanere fârine Wofuŋte jambuŋko fuakicne i ŋoŋe mi eŋgopieŋ me?
No gâcne jaŋere aposolo mi mecne juekopac, â ŋoŋere ine jâmbomac juekopac. Aposolo gie‐nanere ma Wofuŋte jambuŋko fuakicne i ŋoŋe hâcne.
Fuŋne‐nanere mueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikie‐jarekopac.
Gâcne nâŋe ŋoŋeraonec nânâ opâ mi ronaŋte muac‐nâpokicne me?
Aposolo tucne â Wofuŋte ɋafâc â Petoro jaŋe ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋehec miti kiŋaŋ raeŋgopieŋ, ehame gâcne nâŋe sâc ijaha enaŋte mi mana‐nârekicne me?
Me no â Banaba nâhe sawa mezi gie bapa behenacte mi mana‐nâctekicne me?
Me mo momori ŋiczi ʒikare wiac e jahacne moneŋzi furine baocmu? Me mozi gie he sarac eme fârine fuame mi ro nâc eocmu? Me mozi noniŋ bulimakao gie bahuc jaŋere susu ba nâc mi eocmu?
Ʒi ŋicdâŋ sawa mukopac me? Sâcmutâc dâŋzi ijaha mi mufuakac me?
Mosere sâcmutâc dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne fokac: “Bulimakaozi gie bagarehuc sopâc kecɋaŋ nâzo mume mi sakarecnezemec.” Eme Anutuzi dâŋ i bulimakao jaŋere sawa manasuhuc muwec me?
Ŋic nâŋâcne mâmâc mi muwec me? I nâŋâcne hâcne mukicne. Gie he rikec eekaczi mâc mi eekac, fârine fuame nâocte manasuhuc eekac, â sara mamac eekac e iŋuc jaha fârine fuacneocte manasuhuc eekac.
Nâŋe ŋoŋerao maŋte wiac sara mamac embeŋko okacne ŋoŋeraonec sahacte wiac ronaŋte manapie ŋemâckekac me?
Gâcne jaŋe ŋoŋeraonec nânâ mafa rohapie nâŋe gie fuŋkembeŋzi rorone mi fokac me? Erâ ine Kristo Biŋebiaŋ‐ticne aka hecnenʒipeŋte ŋoŋeraonec nânâ mafa rorore mukicne i qikiŋnehuc mâc hume serereŋ jueŋgopeneŋ.
Taha ufuŋko gie baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe taha ufuŋkonec nânâ nâeŋgopieŋ, â alatao bâzi ririke gie baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe alatare wiac nâ bac eeŋgopieŋ, i ŋoŋe mi manaeŋgopieŋ me?
Eme Wofuŋ e Biŋebiaŋ mumu ŋic nâŋe iŋuc jaha Biŋebiaŋzi sahacte dope wiac kifua‐nâreocte muwec.
No ine hata i mi âteekopac. Erâ ŋoŋe irec sâcko enareniŋte manasuhuc mi qâreŋkekopac, aricne. Hâmoczi rocnuzac irec manape afeckezac, â ʒeridâŋ‐nane i babawaha‐nare irec ine manape ŋic moczi mi enare‐jâmbâŋkezejec ekac.
Biŋebiaŋ muromackeekopac irec mumumbiaŋ dâŋ mupe wemocko sâckeocmu, gie i hâcne nore faio râekicne i! Eme hetarepe, jei, Wofuŋzi weniŋuc enareocmu!
Gie i no nahacne maŋte fuarâ bazapo muzac juku furine rozapo. Nahacne maŋte mi ropore ʒiŋuc ekac: Micne gie fai‐naneo fewec.
Hâc, eme wemo furi roekopac? Furine ʒiŋuc: No miti kiŋaŋ rahuc ŋic Biŋebiaŋ furimâc jazaekopac, ehuc Biŋebiaŋ mumure furi sahackopec wiac rorore mukicne i qikiŋneekopac.
No ŋic sasawa jaŋere kiŋaŋ qaqa mi jukopaczi sifu kiŋaŋ qaqa‐jeŋic epo jukopac. I ŋic bocjahazi miti manarâ biaŋkeniŋte manasuhuc epo hâcne.
Judaŋic jaŋerao juhuc Judaŋic hawari epo, i Judaŋiczi biaŋkeniŋte. Sâcmutâc dâŋte kiŋaŋ qaeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao juhuc sâcmutâc dâŋte kiŋaŋne qaeŋgopieŋzi biaŋkeniŋte epo.
Qâpuc sâcmutâc dâŋ tâmiric jaŋerao juhuc sâcmutâc dâŋ tâmiric hawari epo, i Anuture maio sâcmutâc dâŋ tâmiric juhuc mâcne, no Kristore sâcmutâc dâŋ bajuekopac, erâ qâpuc jaŋe biaŋkeniŋte iŋuc epo.
Ŋic dodocne jaŋerao juhuc dodocne hawari epo, i dodocnezi biaŋkeniŋte epo. Ŋic fuŋne jaŋerao juhuc hawari fuŋne fuŋne epo, i gâcnezi sipirickehapie sifu gâcnezi biaŋkeniŋte.
Wiac sasawa i mâc mâcne, Biŋebiaŋzi fua raocte eekopac, erâ no nahac wâc irec kâdoc ropemurâ eekopac.
Ŋoŋe kecʒiŋuc mi manaŋgopieŋ me? Sâsâc eere hofao ira motec jaŋe gagasa i mâmâc gasacke‐fâreniŋmu, â eri roro ine mocsâkoazi mao bâbâni fisirâ roocmu. Eme ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha eri‐ŋeŋic roniŋte gasackenʒepieŋ.
Motec jaŋe sasanaŋte sâsâc ehuc sowa fuŋne jueŋgopieŋ, jaŋe eri sisirowenere iŋuc eeŋgopieŋ, nâŋâc ine eri fofo sanaŋte iŋuc enʒepeneŋ.
No nahac wâc gasackeekopac, i ma hone dendeŋnehuc gasackeekopac. No sându‐nane sawao kosa mi wickeekopac.
No ŋic miti muromacke‐jarehuc juku nahacne rârâricne ezipore sahac‐nane ro waha âte ecnehuc ŋicbomboŋ‐ticne juekopac.
Âgofâc‐nane, no mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec wiac embiŋ irec manasu‐ŋarepe mananiŋ. Jaŋe mâmâc sasawa karoraczi sâoc‐jopaha rahuc hâwec fotâcnembiŋ.
Ehuc Mosere ŋicfâc eniŋte karorac â hâweczi miti opâ‐jeŋic eme ruambiŋ.
Erâ Mârozi nânâ bâfua‐jarewec i jaŋe mâmâc sasawa nârambiŋ,
â Mârozi opâ bâfua‐jarewec i wâc mâmâc sasawa nârambiŋ. Mârore qânâzi bâjâpec‐jopawec, eraonec hâcne opâ wahame nâmbiŋ, qânâ ʒâŋene Kristo.
Eme sifu Anutuzi gâcne sâko mana sâqore‐jareme mâreŋ sawao hâmo sipiric efârembiŋ.
Jaŋerao wiac fuawec i uŋsawaŋ‐nâŋec ekac, jaŋe sâqocnere andac embiŋ iŋuc jaha enʒipeŋte.
Jaŋeraonec gâcnezi nemu qaŋgec wiacte kiŋaŋ qaqa embiŋ, iŋuc wâc mi enʒepeneŋ. Dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “Ŋic jaŋe waha ŋehuc tiwâ ʒepec nâku faharerâ gae wohuc domambiŋ.”
Erâ sasec boe sau wâc mi enʒepeneŋ. Jaŋeraonec gâcnezi sasec boe sau embiŋ, ehuc ʒoaŋ gie bapa ijaha ŋic 23 tauseŋ hâmombiŋ.
Erâ Wofuŋ maŋbâiŋ wâc mi ecnenʒepeneŋ. Jaŋeraonec gâcnezi maŋbâiŋ ecnepie homazi kicjopame hâmo sipiric embiŋ.
Erâ kâroŋ wâc mi qanʒepeneŋ. Jaŋeraonec gâcnezi kâroŋ qapie sisipiric runezi sipiric‐jopawec.
Jaŋerao wiac fuawec izi ma âkendâŋnekicne ekac. Eme mâreŋte dameŋ qândâŋkeha juŋgopeneŋ nâŋâcnere uŋsawaŋ muhuc dâŋbinaŋ i hâcne qâreŋkekicne.
Irec hâcne moc e jahacnere maname sasanaŋ eekaczi dockezacte rumehuc juzejec.
Ŋoŋerao eesâic fua warewec i ŋic tâpiri‐ŋeŋicte sâcko fuawec. Erâ Anutu e mume sasanaŋzi eesâic baafeckeme tâpiri‐ŋeŋicte sâc mi jâuruocmu. Erâ eesâic fuaocmu sâc âte sâoc‐ŋopame sâcne sanaŋkeniŋmu.
Irec hâcne, âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋe nemu qaŋgec wiacte geŋkerâ junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe maŋ mamanasuhec juŋgopieŋ, irec dâŋ ʒi mupe ŋaŋac mana honeniŋ.
Râqâcko waiŋ jambuŋkewecte jambuŋkerâ nâhuc Kristore sochec ʒuʒuhuc mi eeŋgopeneŋ me? Â poroŋ nâhuc Kristore sahachec ʒuʒuhuc mi eeŋgopeneŋ me?
Nânâzi mocjaha, i gugumec ehuc ŋic bocjahazi âgo guru mocjaha eeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋoŋe sahackopec Israe ŋic juŋgopieŋ jaŋere manasuniŋ. Ŋic taha bâzi nâeŋgopieŋ jaŋe alatahec ʒuʒuhuc mi eeŋgopieŋ me?
Dâŋ i weniŋucte mukopac? Nemure tiwâ ʒepec i wiac fârine me? Â nemu e jahacne wâc fârine me?
Iŋuc aricne. Qâpuc jaŋe tiwâ ʒepec rikeeŋgopieŋ i Anuture biŋe mâcne, i demoŋ jaŋere biŋe eekac. Eme no ŋoŋere ʒiŋuc mukopac: Ŋoŋe demoŋ jaŋehec ʒuʒuhuc mi enʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋte râqâckonec nâhuc demoŋ jaŋere râqâckonec mâmâc nânâ i sâcne mi eniŋmu. Â Wofuŋte teboonec nâhuc demoŋ jaŋere teboonec mâmâc nânâ i wâc sâcne mi eniŋmu.
Me nâŋâc Wofuŋ maŋbâiŋ ecnenaŋ me? Nâŋâcne tâpirizi ere sirickekac me?
Wiac sasawa eene fokac, erâ wiac sasawa epene izi sâcne mi bafic‐nâpoocmu. Wiac sasawa eene fokac, erâ wiac sasawa ehuc mitio dodopec eene ine mi fokac.
Moc e jahacnere mi manasuhuc, âgo‐ticnere manasuzejec.
Ŋoŋe buŋko bec qowi furine bazo murâ kosa banʒepieŋ, ehuc keci omane me nemure ufuŋkonec, iŋuc muhuc mu manabâc mi enʒepieŋ.
Mâreŋ â wiac sasawa mâreŋ fusucmarâ fokac i Wofuŋzi rune jukac.
Qâpuc moczi hezu hewâneŋ eŋareme ficticnao fezo murâ fenʒepieŋ, erâ nânâ qowi gumec‐ŋopame manabâc tâmiric kosa nâhuc mu wioc mi enʒepieŋ.
Â nahapie ŋic moczi ʒiŋuc moc ŋazaocmu: “Bec ʒi nemu ufuŋkonec”, eme mi nânʒepieŋ. I mufua‐ŋareocmu ŋic ere manabâc ehuc qikiŋnenʒepieŋ.
I nâpie ŋaŋacne maŋ sâqorezacte mâcne, âgo‐ŋeŋicte maŋ sâqorezacte mukopac. No nahacne maŋ manabâc tâmiric fome wemocte moczi e jahacne maŋte sâc norao âke hotaocmu?
No Anutu daŋge âzâcnehuc nunumu faio nâpe moczi wemocte mana sâqore‐nareocmu?
Irec ŋoŋe nânâ qowi nâniŋte, me i me i eniŋte Anutu mumbiaŋkehuc enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Judaŋic â Grikŋic â Anuture kikefuŋ jaŋere maio bahacmâc jupie moc mi mana sâqore‐ŋarenʒepieŋ.
No iŋuc jaha ŋic fuŋne fuŋne jaŋe honecnupie sâckeocte juhuc no nahacne wiac biaŋkeocte mâcne, ŋic bocjaha miti manarâ biaŋkeniŋte giene baekopac.
No Kristore hata âtehuc bâjâpeekopac, eme ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha nore hata âtehuc bâjâpecnunʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe wiac ebac epo irec manasu‐fârehuc mumutâc dâŋnanere sâcko jueŋgopieŋ, irec manape biaŋkekac.
Eme ʒi moc mupe mananiŋ, Kristo e ŋicte kâcɋene, ŋic e ŋokacte kâcɋene, Anutu e Kristore kâcɋene.
Ŋic moc e qârufac rojuhuc numuocmu me Anuture micdâŋ mufuaocmu, e kâcɋene‐ticne mimi qaqa ecneocmu.
Â ŋokac moczi qârufac tâmiric juhuc numuocmu me Anuture micdâŋ mufuaocmu, e iŋuc jaha kâcɋene‐ticne mimi qaqa ecneocmu, erâ ŋokac kosa jujune qizec‐jeŋic rokicne jaŋehec sâc mocjaha eocmu.
Irec ŋokac moc qârufac tâmiric jume qizec rocnezo. Me ŋokac moc e irec mimierâ qizec susuc‐ticne sakareocmuzi qârufac rojuzejec.
Ŋic e ine qizectuc juzejec. E Anuture hawari â Anuture eri tofa bakicne irec. Ŋokac e ine ŋicte eri tofa bakicne.
Ŋic e ŋokactaonec mi rokicne, ŋokaczi ŋictaonec rokicne.
Ŋic e ŋokacte erâ mi bâfuakicne, ŋokac e ine ŋicte erâ bâfuakicne.
Ŋokac e ŋicte wahamicne jukacte irec ma moc qârufac hâcne rojuzejec, mâc jume aŋelo jaŋe honepie sâqorezacte.
Erâ sifu ŋic e mocbuc‐ticne juju â ŋokac e mocbuc‐ticne juju i Wofuŋte maio mi fokac.
Ŋokac e ŋictaonec rokicne, iŋuc wâc ŋiczi ŋokackonec fua sawec eeŋgopeneŋ. Erâ wiac i sasawa Anuturaonec.
Ŋoŋe ŋaŋac mana honeniŋ, ŋokac moc qârufac tâmiric juhuc Anutu numucneme sâckeocmu me?
Â ŋic moc e qizec susuc ʒoricne rojume iŋuc jaha honepie mi sâckeocmu, irec fuŋne mârâc miti tâmiric juhuc wâc manambiŋ.
Â ŋokac moc qizec susuc ʒoricne rojume e ine honepie biaŋkeocmu. Qizec susuc ʒoricnezi qârufac‐ticne eekac.
Moc e dâŋ ʒi qâsuazo murâ ʒiŋuc manazejec: Mâsi i nâŋe â Anuture kikefuŋ gâcne mi bajueŋgopeneŋ.
Wiac moc ʒi ine mana‐ŋarepe bahacnehec eha uŋ sawaŋ eŋarehuc mupe: Ŋoŋe tumaŋnehuc maŋ biaŋ qaqac mi ehuc maŋ bâbâsâqorec eeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ mitire tumaŋnepie ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko fâfâuc fuaekac, iŋuc nazapie manape jâmbomac tinac ekac.
Erâ fâfâuc i mâc mâcne, ŋoŋeraonec wenizi mitio sanaŋkeŋgopieŋ jaŋe fua tâcneniŋte hâcne fuakac.
Eme ŋoŋe Wofuŋte Tiwâ nâniŋte tumaŋnerâ hesifuckeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋaŋacne nânâ bafisirâ boki mi bahuc fâro erâ buc buc nâpie moc e hâmoekac â moc e gapecmâc nâekac.
Hâc, ŋaŋacne fic basahuc iŋuc eeŋgopieŋ me? Ŋoŋe nânâ opâ nâzo murâ ira nanʒapiŋ! Wemocte Anuture gurufâc jaŋere manapie wawahane eme hapetac busâqoc ejareeŋgopieŋ? Wemo ŋazape? Mumbiaŋ‐ŋopape? Wiac kecirec mi mumbiaŋ‐ŋopazo.
No Wofuŋtaonec hâcne ropo i ŋarepo wâc. Ine ʒiŋuc: Wofuŋ Jesu e Judazi doc bawec ŋafe ira poroŋ rorâ
daŋge murâ bazurâ muwec: “Kecʒi fâri‐nane, ŋoŋere due bahuc qikiŋnekicne. Nore manasuhuc iŋuc nâhuc junʒepieŋ.”
Poroŋ nâpie waiŋ râqâc iŋuc jaha rorâ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Râqâc kecʒira ʒâʒâfic ɋâricnere socnane ŋekac. Nâniŋmu sâc nore manasuhuc iŋuc nâhuc junʒepieŋ.”
Ŋoŋe poroŋ â waiŋ i nâniŋmu sâc Wofuŋ hâmoc biŋe‐ticne mutaniŋkehuc juhapie risieocmu.
Irec moc e poroŋ â Wofuŋte waiŋ i enʒaŋauc ecnehuc nâocmu, e Wofuŋ fâri â socticne nâsifuckeme kiŋnehec eocmu.
Irec moc e poroŋ â waiŋ nâzo murâ qanaŋ maŋticnere fuŋne hone manac ehuc bajaŋgeŋkerâ nâzejec.
Moc e Wofuŋte fâri hone ʒâŋitac mi ehuc nâocmuzi kiŋticne nâfuaocmu.
Ŋoŋe iŋuc hâcne eeŋgopieŋte huc dodoc â huc ʒâic boc eŋareekac, â gâcnezi biac hâmocko foŋgopieŋ.
Nâŋâc nâŋâc fuŋne‐nâŋec bataniŋkenʒapeŋ muzac, Wofuŋzi mi bataniŋkezac.
Qâoma epene ine Wofuŋzi fuŋne‐nâŋec bataniŋkehuc bâtiŋ‐nâpoocmu, miti tâmiric jaŋehec juku behec‐nâpome sipirickenʒipeŋte iŋuc hâcne enâreocmu.
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋe tiwâ wirec nâniŋte tumaŋnerâ woŋec ŋehapie fisi‐fârepie fuŋkenʒepieŋ.
Moc e nânâre boc ecneme qanaŋ e jahacne ficko nâzejec, tutumaŋ bâbâsifucne epie okacne fua‐ŋarezacte. Dâŋ gâcne i no nahac fârâ mutâcne‐ŋarepemu.
Âgo bureŋ, Mâroraonec miti kadahe irec fuŋne kâuc banʒipiŋte ŋazape mananiŋ.
Ŋoŋe mârâc jaha qâpuc juhapie maŋʒoc fua‐ŋarewec sâc nemuɋâŋ kâpâne jaŋerao ra qohota jumbieŋ.
Eme irec ŋifecne mupe mananiŋ: Moc e Anuture Mârozi bufahac qacnehame wemocko muocmu “Jesu go sâwecgukopac”, â moc e Tiri Mârozi bufahac mi qacnehame wemocko muocmu “Jesu e Wofuŋ”.
Mitire kadahe fuŋne fuŋne fokac, Mâro ine mocjaha,
mitire kiŋaŋ gie fuŋne fuŋne fokac, gie rune ine Wofuŋ mocjaha,
mitire tâpiri fuŋne fuŋne fokac, tâpiri rune ine Anutu mocjaha. Eki hâcne bâfua‐nâre‐fâreekac.
Mâro e mitio juhâmonaŋte ŋic ru sâc tâpiri‐ticne kâdoc qanâreekac.
Moc e Mârozi ecneme miti maŋɋârâŋhec muocmu, moc e Mâro izia ecneme sâc mitire fuŋne hukicne muocmu,
moc e Mâro izia ecneme mamanasiŋ sâkohec juocmu, moc e Mâro izia ecneme ŋic huc ʒâichec ɋiɋicne bacjopaocmu,
erâ moc mâsi baocte tâpiri bâfuacneocmu, moc findaŋdâŋ muocte maŋne bâuŋtoocmu, moc e mâro fuŋne fuŋne ʒâŋitaocte maŋne batamaeocmu, moc e miti marac furuo muocte micne baafeckeocmu, moc e miti marac furu manarâ ŋic dâŋjeŋicko bâtikieocte bafickeocmu.
Wiac i sasawa Mâro izia bafâreekac, ehuc maŋticnere ŋic ru sâc wiac bârâwiŋne‐nâreekac.
Ŋic nâŋâc sahac‐nâŋeczi mocjaha â sahacte kiŋaŋ qaqafâc ine bocjaha, eme jaŋe bocjahazi qâturepie sahac mocjaha ekac; eme Kristorao sâc ijaha fokac.
Mâro mocjahazi nâŋâc Miti Opâo bâturec‐nâpome sahac‐nâŋecte sâc erâ mocjaha embeŋ. Judaŋic â Grikŋic, kiŋaŋ qaqa â ŋicbomboŋ, nâŋâc Mâro ijaha sasawa ro maŋ efârekicnere mocjaha embeŋ.
Eme sahacte kiŋaŋ qaqa iŋuc jaha mocjaha mâcne, bocjaha.
Eme kike e wemocko ʒiŋuc muzac: “No me aricne, irec sahacte tofa mi ekopac”, iŋuc murâ wemocko sahac beherâ buc juocmu?
Me hazeczi wemocko ʒiŋuc muzac: “No ʒâŋe aricne, irec sahacte tofa mi ekopac”, iŋuc murâ wemocko sahac beherâ buc juocmu?
Sahacko ʒâŋe sasawa fome muzac sahaczi hazec basazac. Me hazec sasawa fome muzac sâke basazac.
Anutu e ine mana tarahuc sahacte kiŋaŋ qaqa gie fuŋne fuŋne mujarewec.
Sahacte kiŋaŋ qaqa fuŋne‐jeŋic mocjaha efâreme muzac sahac e sâqorerâ arictac ezac.
Ʒi ine kiŋaŋ qaqazi bocjaha â sahaczi mocjaha.
Eme ʒâŋezi wemocko me âzâcneocmu, “No go tâmiric sâcne jupemu.” Me qizeczi wemocko kike jasaocmu, “No ŋohe tâmiric sâcne jupemu.”
Aricne, sahac‐nâŋecte tofafâc dodocne jaŋe tâmiric hâcne sâcne mi juzo.
Â sahac‐nâŋecte tofafâc wawahane jaŋe hâcne hone jauŋ ejareeŋgopeneŋ, â miminehec jaŋe foŋjopapene biaŋne hawari eeŋgopieŋ.
Hawari biaŋ jaŋe ine tâtâc foeŋgopieŋ. Anutu e sahac bâfuahuc tofafâcne gâcne wahakicne jaŋe gie fekicne mujarewec.
I sahac‐nâŋecte tofafâc fâfâuc mi ehuc kiŋaŋ qaqac sâckoa eniŋte iŋuc hâcne ewec.
Irec tofane moczi ʒâic maname gâcne jaŋe mâmâc mana‐fâreniŋmu, me moczi ʒeri eme gâcne mâmâc ʒeri efâreniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe mâmâc sâko qâturerâ Kristore sahac eŋgopieŋ â buc buc sahac‐ticnere kiŋaŋ qaqafâc eŋgopieŋ.
Anutu e kikefuŋfâc‐ticne nâŋâcnao ŋic ʒiŋuc râec‐jopawec: Qanaŋ aposolo, izi porofete, izi qaqazu, erâ ŋic mâsi bapare tâpirihec â ŋic huc ʒâic bâbâpiaŋ irec tâpirihec, erâ jauŋ bapa, erâ soŋaŋ, erâ dâŋ marac furuo mumu, iŋuc hâcne râec‐jopawec.
Nâŋâc aposolo sasawa râec‐nâpowec me? Me porofete me qaqazu sasawa râec‐nâpowec me? Me mâsi bapare tâpiri
me huc ʒâic bâbâpiaŋ irec tâpiri fonâre‐fârekac me? Me dâŋ marac furuo mumu me ŋic dâŋjeŋicko bac bâtikic eene jufâreŋgopeneŋ me?
Ŋoŋe mitire kadahe fekicne bâfuaniŋte ʒoɋac enʒepieŋ. Eme noni irec hata biaŋne jâmbâŋ ʒi ŋowatupe honeniŋ.
No ŋicmaracko me aŋelo maracko miti muzapo, ehuc maŋjauŋ tâmiric juzapo, ine qeŋ goŋgoŋ iŋucne erâ dâŋ fânâŋ sawa ezapo.
Me no porofete juhuc dâŋ soŋne mana‐fârezapo â mitire ʒuhucne mana utucke‐fârezapo â tiki mupe rârieocte irec sâc mamanasiŋ fonarezac, ehuc maŋjauŋ tâmiric juzapo, ine ŋic jawane ezapo.
Me wiac‐nane sasawa hapetac bâmec bajarezapo â sahac‐nane qikiŋnepe ʒocte nânâ ezac, ehuc maŋjauŋ tâmiricko ezapo, ine racne efârezac.
Maŋjauŋheczi wama ruaine juocmu, maŋjauŋheczi iiŋguuŋ mi eocmu, maŋjauŋheczi penaroŋ mi eocmu, e jahacnere maname fefene mi eocmu;
e ʒaubac tâmiric, iiriac tâmiric, aaric tâmiric, kiŋ babaju tâmiric juocmu;
e sâqocnezi haŋ bame busâqoc manaocmu, â mitizi haŋ bame bubiaŋ manaocmu;
maŋjauŋhec e dede ââsic‐ticne ɋârâŋne, mamanasiŋ‐ticne ɋârâŋne, maŋzi woworic‐ticne ɋârâŋne, maŋuruc‐ticne ɋârâŋne.
Maŋjauŋ i tatarane tâmiric. Findaŋdâŋ mumu i tataranehec, erâ dâŋ marac furuo mumu i wâc tataranehec, â fuŋne mamana i wâc tataranehec.
I ʒiŋucte: Fuŋne mamana‐nâŋec i faisuc â findaŋdâŋ mumu‐nâŋec i faisuc jaha wâc.
Juku ine wiac fofo dunduŋne fuame wiac faisuc eenezi omaezokac.
No ɋiene juhuc ɋiedâŋ mujupac â ɋiemaŋhec jujupac â ɋie mamana mana jupac. Izi juku ŋic erâ ɋie wiac hetarapo.
Dameŋ ʒiŋuczia wiac honeeŋgopeneŋ i turuŋzi hawari bâtikie‐nâreme sisifucne honeeŋgopeneŋ irec sâc, juku ine fârine ʒâŋeo hehec erâ hone mana tarac ezokopac, i Wofuŋzi no hone mana tarac enarewec irec sâc.
Eme fofo sanaŋ foniŋmu ine mamanasiŋ, woworic â maŋjauŋ, jaŋe jahec â moczi. Maŋjauŋzi ine micne ekac.
Ŋoŋe maŋjauŋhec juniŋte ɋicwânʒâŋ enʒepieŋ. Erâ miti kadahe gâcne roniŋte irec wâc ʒoɋac enʒepieŋ, ehuc Anuture micdâŋ mumufuare manapie fefene ezejec.
Moc e dâŋ marac furuo muekac e ŋic mi jazahuc Anutu âzâcneekac. E Mârozi ecneme dâŋ marac furuo mume ŋic jaŋe kâuc baeŋgopieŋ.
Â Anuture micdâŋ mufuaekaczi ine ŋic faŋ qajareekac â âkesiŋ‐jopaekac â buuruc qajareekac.
Marac furuo dâŋ muekaczi e jahacne maŋ âkesiŋkeekac, â Anuture micdâŋ mufuaekaczi ine kikefuŋ guru âkesiŋ‐jopaekac.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ marac furuo mufârepie manape sâckeocmu, Anuture micdâŋ mufuapie ine manape sâcke‐hâmoocmu. Anuture micdâŋ mufuaekac ŋic e marac furuo dâŋ mumuŋic ere sâc sirickekac. Mocjaha, marac furuo dâŋ muku kikefuŋ guru bâtikie‐jareme manarâ fârine bajupie ine sâcjeŋic mocjaha eocmu.
Âgofâc, no ŋoŋerao fârâ marac furuo dâŋ ŋazape wemocko âkesiŋ‐ŋopaocmu? No muraruŋ dâŋ me miti hukicne me findaŋdâŋ me mu qaqazuc dâŋ muratie‐ŋarepe ine sâcne maŋfâri‐ŋeŋic eocmu.
Wiac omane, woŋgâŋ mimi ŋokac wiac, i qapie dâŋ hawarine tâtâc mi fuame wemocko ʒâŋitazo?
Me qeŋ kosa qapie dâŋ eme manarâ wemocko “wiac mocte kuku qanâreŋgopieŋ” muhuc ra bafic‐jopaniŋmu?
Â ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha marac furuo dâŋ foŋnehec mupie gâcnezi wemocko mananiŋmu, i dâŋŋeŋiczi qahameŋkeocmu.
Mâreŋ sâc ŋic dâŋmarac fuŋne fuŋne forakac i mamanane sasawa.
Mâc noni dâŋmarac moc kâuc bapemuo dâŋ irec runezi nore maname mutucne eocmu, â noni ere iŋuc jaha manape mutucne eocmu.
Eme ŋoŋerao fuŋne ijaha fokac. Mârore tâpiri ŋoŋerao fuaocte mueŋgopieŋ i sâcne, erâ i hâcne mitizi kikefuŋ âkesiŋ‐jopaocte ʒoɋac enʒepieŋ.
Irec marac furuo dâŋ muocmu e fuŋne mana‐hâmorâ ŋic ŋokac bâtikie‐jareocte Wofuŋ numucneme bafickezejec.
No marac furuo numupemu, ine maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi sawa epemu, â mamana‐nanezi mâc foocmu.
Eme irec weniŋuc ezo? Kecʒiŋuc ezo: No maŋ qâqâtâc‐nanezi numume mamana‐nanezi mana tararâ miczi mutaniŋkezejec.
Me go maŋ qâqâtâcgezi Wofuŋ muteŋketec ŋic omane moczi dâŋge kâuc bahuc wemocko baficgurâ “Jâmbomac” muocmu?
Go mumuteŋ dâŋ fârinehec mucmu mecne, erâ âgogezi kâuc baha wemocko maŋne âkesiŋkeocmu?
Anutu daŋge âzâcnekopac, marac furuo dâŋ mumu i no ŋoŋere sâc mâcne, sâc fekicne fonarekac.
Eme irec manape fârine eme muzac, tutumaŋko marac furuo dâŋ ʒoricne ʒora muzo murâ muzapo. Erâ no irec manape wahakac, â mitidâŋ jahec mac sawa mutaniŋkehuc ŋic ŋokac jaza qazuc ee, irec ine manape fekac.
Âgofâc, dâŋ mana wosâc eere mamana‐ŋeŋiczi ɋie jaŋere sâc mi ezejec, sâqocnere i ɋiene jaŋere sâc enʒepieŋ, â mana wosâcte ine maŋ mamana‐ŋeŋiczi sokakicne jaŋere sâc ezejec.
Sâcmutâc dâŋqâhâcko dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne fokac: “Wofuŋ e mukac, ‘No ŋic furune ejarepe jaŋe ŋicguru ʒi dâŋmarac furunao micdâŋ‐nane jazapie i wâc sifu mi mananiŋmu.’”
Eme irec ŋifecne mupe: Marac furuo dâŋ mumu i fuŋne qaqa mâsi moc, erâ i opâ ruac jaŋere biŋe mi ekac, i qâpuc jaŋere biŋe, â Anuture micdâŋ mumufua ine qâpuc jaŋere biŋe mâcne, i opâ ruac jaŋere biŋe.
Irec kikefuŋ guru tumaŋne‐fârehuc mâmâc sasawa marac furuo dâŋ muhapie ŋic omane me qâpuc moczi hefârâ honec‐ŋoparâ muocmu: “Maŋsifuc ejarekac.”
Â Anuture micdâŋ mufuahuc ŋehapie ŋic qâpuc me omane moczi ŋoŋerao hefârâ miti i manaocmu, ine mâmâc sasawa maŋticnere fuŋne bataniŋkeniŋmu â mumu hehec ecneniŋmu.
Eme maŋticnao wiac hesoŋkeme foekac i fua taniŋkeme ʒâŋe maine mâreŋko hetutuckerâ Anutu muafeckehuc muocmu, Anutu e jâmbomac ŋoŋehec jukac.
Âgo bureŋ, irec weniŋuc? Ŋoŋe tumaŋneniŋte murâ maŋ metariŋ mi fisieŋgopieŋ. Moc e miti gae bafisiekac, moc e mu qaqazuc dâŋ, moc e Anuture micdâŋ furune, moc e marac furu dâŋ, â moc e marac furu dâŋ irec fuŋne. Wiac i sasawa miti fua sawec eŋareocte enʒepieŋ.
Marac furuo dâŋ muzo murâ boczi mâcne, jajahec me jahec â moc sawazi munʒepieŋ. Erâ buc buc mupie sâc moczi fuŋne bâtikierâ ŋazazejec.
Bâbâtikie ŋic basaniŋmuo tutumaŋko marac furu dâŋ mi muzo. Moc e muzo murâ bucticne â Anuturao muzejec.
Â Anuture micdâŋ mumufua ine iŋuc jaha ŋic jajahec me jahec â moc munʒepieŋ, eme gâcne mana wosâerâ ŋifecne munʒepieŋ.
Moc e ŋehame Mârozi maŋticnao miti râeme muzo mume mârâc fuŋkejeczi behezejec.
Anuture micdâŋ mumufua i ezo murâ sâcne efârenʒepieŋ, ehuc buc buc mupie gâcne sasawa jaŋe mitihec erâ maŋafec bâfuanʒepieŋ.
Anuture micdâŋ mumufua ŋic mârofâc‐jeŋic jaŋe porofete âgofâc‐jeŋic jaŋere dâŋ reŋkenʒepieŋ.
Anutu e hesi qâsifuc Anutu mâcne, e wama Anutu.
Kikefuŋ gâcnao mitire tumaŋnehuc ŋokac jaŋe dâŋemâc ŋeeŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋerao iŋuc jaha enʒepieŋ. Ŋokac jaŋe iŋuc ehuc wahamicne juniŋte i sâcmutâc dâŋqâhâcko mukicne wâc.
Wiac moc manazo ejareme ficjeŋicko ŋowefâc‐jeŋic mu wioc ejarenʒepieŋ. Ŋokac moczi kikefuŋ tutumaŋko dâŋ mume mimi qaqanehec eocmu.
Me Anuture dâŋzi ŋoŋeraonec fuawec? Me ŋoŋe buc manambiŋ?
Ŋoŋeraonec moczi e jahacnere maname porofete me ŋic Mârohec eocmu, e dâŋ qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac i Wofuŋte mumupaŋ, iŋuc mana tarazejec.
Moc e dâŋ ʒi maname fârine mi eme e mana suazo.
Irec, âgofâc, ʒiŋuc mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe Anuture micdâŋ mumufua irec ʒoɋac enʒepieŋ, â marac furuo dâŋ mumure aka wâc mi henʒepieŋ.
Wiac sasawa epie pec sererec â tiŋbenoŋ fozejec.
Âgofâc‐nane, Biŋebiaŋ ŋazape manambiŋ, erâ wâc bajueŋgopieŋ, irecteaŋ manasu‐ŋarepe.
Qazu‐ŋarepo irec sâckoa bajuŋgopieŋko sâcne bâpiaŋ‐ŋopaocmu. Me bajuhapie biac sifucke‐ŋare wiac moc ewec?
Miti qizecne no narekicne ijaha ŋoŋe ŋarehuc kecʒiŋuc muhuc fuŋke‐ŋarepo: Kristo e miti papiao mucnekicne irec sâcko erâ sâqocne‐nâŋecte okacne hâmowec.
Erâ miti papiao mucnekicne irec sâckoa ʒâŋeruŋko hurâ ʒoaŋ jahec â moc eha ɋârerâ faharewec.
Faharerâ qanaŋ Kefa fuacnewec, izi motecfâcne 12 fua‐jarewec.
Izi mitiŋic ʒare‐jeŋic 500 jâuruwec jaŋe tumaŋnehapie fua‐jareme hone‐fârembiŋ. Jaŋeraonec bocjahazi ɋâricne juŋgopieŋ, â gâcnezi hâmombiŋ.
Izi Jakobo fuacnewec, izi aposolo mâmâc sasawa fua‐jarewec.
Ʒâhecko ine ombâŋtâc no wâc fua‐narewec.
No aposolo waha qaqane jâmbâŋ, no Anuture kikefuŋ guru jopa sipiric ejarepore aposolo ʒâŋe munarepie mi sâckeekac.
No aposolo epo i Anutu aki anonoc‐ticnere erâ epo. Erâ aki anonoc‐ticnezi norao racne mi ewec. No gie bapo i gâcne jaŋere sâc jâurukac, erâ no nahac wemo‐nanezi bazapo, Anuture aki anonoc norao fowec izi bawec.
Eme no mecne jaŋe mecne miti iŋuc hâcne muromackeeŋgopeneŋ, eme ŋoŋe i hâcne manambiŋ bajuŋgopieŋ.
Kristo e hâmockonec ɋârerâ faharewec, miti iŋuc muhuc ŋazapene wemocte ŋoŋeraonec gâcnezi hâmockonec fafahare mi fokac mueŋgopieŋ?
Hâmockonec fafahare‐nâŋec i mickehuc Kristo fafahare‐ticne mâmâc mickezo.
Kristo mi faharezacko ine miti mumu‐nâŋec fârimâc ezac â mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋic iŋuc jaha fârimâc ezac.
Erâ i sawa mâcne. Nâŋe Anuture mumbeŋ, e Kristo hâmockonec bafaharewec. Eme hâmockonec fafahare mi fozacko Anutuzi wemocko Kristo bafaharezac. Irec dâŋ mumbeŋ i Anutu micko itic ecnehuc burecŋicfâc‐ticne eŋgopeneŋ ezac.
Ŋic hâmockonec mi fahareniŋmu, iŋuc murâ Kristore iŋuc jaha hâmockonec mi faharewec muzo.
Kristo e hâmockonec mi faharezacko ine mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋic racne ezac â kiŋŋeŋic foŋarezac,
â Kristo manasiŋkehuc hâmombiŋzi sipirickembiŋ ezac.
Nâŋâc mâreŋko ʒira sawa Kristore mamanac maŋgâŋ junʒapeŋko, ine mamakucne fuŋmoc ehuc gâcne siric‐jopa‐fârenʒapeŋ.
Erâ iŋuc mâcne, Kristo e jâmbomac hâmockonec ɋârerâ ŋic hâmokicne jaŋere micne barâ faharewec jukac.
Ʒiŋucte hâcne: Ŋiczi hâmoc fuŋke‐nârewec iŋuc jaha ŋiczi hâmockonec fafahare fuŋke‐nârewec.
Adamhec ʒuʒuhuc‐nâŋec fokacte hâmo‐fâreeŋgopeneŋ, iŋuc jaha Kristohec ʒuʒuhuc‐nâŋec fokacte fahare‐fârenʒoŋgopeneŋ.
Erâ birine mukicne sâc faharezo: Micne bapazi Kristo, izi fifisi‐ticnao Kristore bufuŋfâc,
izi dameŋ taraocmu; Kristo e fekicne â tâpirihec â ʒoɋac sasanaŋhec bawahac‐jopame munaŋke‐fârehapie Wofuŋ gie‐ticne i Anutu Mamac‐ticne bârisiecneme dameŋ taraocmu hâcne.
Ʒi ine Wofuŋ gie‐ticne bahuc juocmu, juku râsifâc‐ticne ro waha âte ejare‐fârerâ gie‐ticne bataraocmu.
Râsi sâko mimic qa imac ecneocmu ʒâŋene hâmoc.
Anutuzi ŋic â wiac sasawa Kristore wahamicnao râec‐nâpo‐fârewec hâcne. Erâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc fokac, “Ŋic â wiac sasawa bawahac‐joparâ ere wahamicnao guruc‐jopa‐fârewec”, dâŋ i manapene Anuture mâmâc mukicne mi ezejec. E hâcne Kristore wahamicnao guruc‐nâpoweczi rurumaŋnao mi huocmu.
Mamac e ŋic â wiac sasawa Ŋokâ rurumaŋnao guruc‐nâpo‐fâreme Ŋokâ e Mamacte wahamicnao waharâ domaocmu. Eme Anutuzi qâhuc‐nâpo‐fârerâ juju isiricke‐fâreocmu.
Ŋoŋeraonec gâcnezi hâmokicne jaŋere erâ Miti Opâ ruaeŋgopieŋ, i hâmockonec fafahare mi fokacko wemocte iŋuc eeŋgopieŋ?
Erâ wâc nâŋe ine wemocte ʒârâ hâriŋ faio gâbâmâc qâmâc jumbeŋzi jueŋgopeneŋ?
Âgofâc‐nane, Kristo Jesu Wofuŋ‐nâŋeczi eri‐nane râec‐ŋopawec ŋoŋere maio mukopac: No ʒoaŋ gie bapa sâc hâmoczi bâmbeŋnuha juekopac.
No Efeso haeo qowi mimicne jaŋehec juju gie bapo i ŋicdâŋko siŋkehuc epoo wemo fârine mo fua‐nareocmu? Hâmockonec fafahare mi fokacko ʒiŋuc mupene sâckezac: “Tomâcko moc hâmonʒipeŋte miŋecgac jaha nânâ qowi ro nâc qânâc enaŋ.”
Moczi moc ba qâsoric eŋarenʒipiŋ ine! Kosa jujune jaŋerao qohotaocmu e eebapa biaŋne sifuckecneocmu.
Ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic ɋâreme pectâc juhuc sâqocne geŋkenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋeraonec gâcnezi Anuture kâuc baŋgopieŋ, i manarâ mimieniŋte mukopac.
Gâcnezi ʒiŋuc mecne muniŋmu: Hâmokicne jaŋe weniŋuc erâ fahareniŋmu â sahac hawari‐jeŋic weniŋucnehec fuaniŋmu?
I dâŋ mutucne; ŋoŋe wiac saraeŋgopieŋ i mâc mi wefuekac, mimiŋne ʒaŋkeha bâpâŋne wefuekac.
Â wiac saraeŋgopieŋ, i borâcne mi saraeŋgopieŋ, hândâŋne sawa saraeŋgopieŋ, jacgoŋ me wiac gâcnere hândâŋ, eme borâcne â rehacne ʒâhec fuaekac.
Eme Anutu e mana tararâ hawari mucnewec ijaha wefurâ fuaekac, hândâŋne sâc hawari fuŋne fuŋne fuaekac.
Sahacte fuŋne iŋuc jaha mocjaha mi fokac, ŋic nâŋâcne sahac i moc â bec qowi jaŋere sahac i moc â wipe jaŋere moc â opâ qowi jaŋere moc.
Sambâŋko wiac fâri ŋerakac â mâreŋko wiac fâri ŋerakac. Erâ sambâŋko ŋerakac i eri‐ticne moc, â mâreŋko ŋerakac i eri‐ticne moc.
Ʒoaŋ e tatamacne moc, mosa e tatamacne moc, bâpiŋ jaŋe tatamac‐jeŋic moc, erâ bâpiŋ tatamac‐jeŋic mocjaha mâcne, fuŋne fuŋne fokac.
Hâmockonec fafahare irec fuŋne ijaha fokac. Sarakicnezi sisirowene, fahareocmuzi mi sisirowene;
sarakicnezi joŋtawekicne, fahareocmuzi erinehec; sarakicnezi weweaŋne, fahareocmuzi tâpirinehec;
sarakicnezi mâreŋ sahachec, fahareocmuzi sambâŋ sahachec. Mâreŋ sahac fokac, iŋuc jaha sambâŋ sahac fokac.
Dâŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne qâreŋkekicne fokac: “Ŋic mârâc fufua Adam e maŋ qâqâtâchec erâ ɋârewec.” Ʒâhec Adam e ine Mârohec ehuc juju bâbâfua irec rune ewec.
Sambâŋte wiaczi mi bâniewec, mâreŋte wiaczi bânieha sambâŋte wiaczi ʒâhec ewec.
Mâreŋŋic e mâreŋzi bakicnere mâreŋkonec ŋic ewec â ʒâhecŋic e ine sambâŋkonec.
Mâreŋkonec ŋic juwec sâc ijaha mâreŋkonec ŋicfâc‐ticne jueŋgopeneŋ, â sambâŋkonec juwec sâc ijaha sambâŋte biŋefâc‐ticne nâŋâc junaŋmu.
Eme mâreŋkonec ere hawari rombeŋ, iŋuc jaha sambâŋkonec ere hawari ronaŋmu.
Âgofâc, dâŋ moc ʒi mupe mananiŋ: Mâreŋ sahac‐nâŋeczi Anuture uucmaŋ sâcne mi rauckeocmu, â wiac gârecke ʒaŋ eenezi wiac fofo sanaŋ mi wâc rauckeocmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, ʒi dâŋ soŋne moc mufua‐ŋarepe: Nâŋâc mi hâmo‐fârenaŋmu, hetikierâ hawari moc ee ine ʒeŋgoma efârenaŋmu.
Qeŋ mimic dâŋeme ututuŋ, ɋeŋfâfâc jaha iŋuc hâcne enaŋmu. Qeŋ dâŋeme hâmokicnezi faharerâ gârecke ʒaŋ tâmiric juniŋmu, â ɋâricne junaŋmuzi wâc hetikierâ hawari moc enaŋmu.
Sahac ʒi gârecke ʒaŋ eenezi juju saric i ŋaqi iŋucne heme huzejec, â hâmocte biŋe ekicnezi juju sanaŋ heme huzejec.
Eme gârecke ʒaŋ eenezi juju saric heme huocmu, â hâmocte biŋe ekicnezi juju sanaŋ heme huocmu, dameŋ ira dâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne i deŋkeocmu: “Jujuzi hâmoc ɋâckewec.”
“Hâmoc go tâpirige weni? Hâmoc go ʒârâge weni?”
Sâqocnezi hâmocte ʒârâ ekac, â sâcmutâc dâŋte erâ sâqocnezi tâpirinehec ekac.
Anutu e Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ecneme jujure tâpiri bâfua‐nâreekacte muteŋkenʒepeneŋ.
Irec âgofâc‐mae, ŋoŋe sanaŋkerâ qiŋ herâ domanʒepieŋ, ehuc Wofuŋ gie‐ticnere dameŋ sâc henʒiriŋnehuc banʒepieŋ. Wofuŋte erâ gie bapie fârimâc mi eocmu, iŋuc manahuc banʒepieŋ.
Mitiŋic jaŋere moneŋ râezo murâ ine Galatia mâreŋkonec kikefuŋ guru jaza mutâc epo ijaha enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe moneŋ hotâckekicne irec sâc manahuc Sondane Sondane tucne bâtâc barâ buc buc râe guruc ehuc junʒepieŋ, mâc juhapie fâ fisipe moneŋ qânusuckeniŋte âecke guruc enʒipiŋte.
Ŋoŋerao fâpe ŋic mucjopaniŋmu jaŋe papia jarehuc sorec‐jopape bubiaŋte wiac‐ŋeŋic Jerusalem haeo baranʒepieŋ.
Me moneŋ bocjaha eme nohec mâmâc ranʒepeneŋ.
No Makedonia mâreŋ fotâcne‐fârerâ ŋoŋerao fâpemu, Makedonia mâreŋko boc mi jupemu, i mâc fotâcnepemu.
Ŋoŋerao fârâ piticne jupemu, me jufehape hoemaŋ taraocmu mecne. Eme ŋoŋe hatare baficnupie ira me ira razepac.
No dameŋ ʒiŋuczia mâc fofotâc fâhuc honec‐ŋopape mi sâckeocmu, irec Wofuŋzi manaha ŋoŋerao fârâ piticne jupemurâ mukopac.
No ʒi Efeso haeo juhape Mâro Hombaŋ maickeocmu.
Ʒira Wofuŋzi mitire hata bâʒâweme gie sâko‐nane fuakac. Erâ mitire kisâ bocjaha juŋgopieŋ wâc.
Timoteozi ŋoŋerao fâme âgo ecnepie hâwic sahac mi juzejec. E no Wofuŋte gie baekopac iŋuc jaha baekac.
Irec ere manapie wawahane mi ezejec. Erâ aimuŋ ecnerâ bârisiepie norao mocwâc warezejec; no â opâ ruac gâcne woŋec‐ticne juŋgopeneŋ.
Âgo‐nâŋec Apolo e opâ ruac gâcne jaŋehec ŋoŋerao fâocte âzâcne sorec epe sâcne mi afeckekac; e ʒiŋuczia mâcne, dameŋ mocte maname sâckeme ŋoŋerao fâocmu.
Ŋoŋe rucjaric‐ŋeŋic bahuc mamanasiŋko qiŋ henʒepieŋ, ehuc hâbi‐ŋeŋic rorâ sanaŋkenʒepieŋ.
Erâ wiac sasawa maŋjauŋhec enʒepieŋ.
Erâ âgofâc‐nane, dâŋ moc ŋazape mananiŋ: Ŋoŋe Stefana â wiacfâc‐ticne jaŋere manaeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe Akaia mâreŋko micne barâ miti manambiŋ, erâ mitiŋic ŋoŋerao kiŋaŋ qaqa gie baeŋgopieŋ.
Irec ŋoŋe jaŋe mecne â gâcne miti gie bahuc ʒâic manaeŋgopieŋ honec‐jopapie micnefâc‐ŋeŋic enʒepieŋ.
Stefana â Fotunato â Akaiko jaŋe norao fisipie bunane biaŋkewec. Jaŋe ŋoŋere âkehoc dâŋjauŋ enarembiŋ.
Ehuc no â ŋoŋe mâmâc maŋuruc qanârembiŋ. Ŋoŋe ŋic iŋucne jaŋere manapie biaŋkezejec.
Asia mâreŋ masunao kikefuŋ guru jaŋe ŋoŋere mamanac juŋgopieŋ. Aqila â Prisika â ficjekicko mitire tumaŋneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe Wofuŋte erâ mu ʒeri boc eŋareeŋgopieŋ.
Opâ ruac mâmâc sasawa mu ʒeri eŋare‐fâreŋgopieŋ. Ŋoŋe ŋaŋac mitio meo babac enʒepieŋ.
Ʒi Paulo no nahac mu ʒeri eŋarehuc ʒâŋe qâreŋ‐nane râekopac.
Moc e Wofuŋte takickeme hârâcte biŋe ezejec. Wofuŋ‐nâŋec go warezemec.
Wofuŋ Jesure aki anonoczi ŋoŋerao fozejec.
Maŋjauŋ‐nanezi Kristo Jesure erâ ŋoŋerao fofârekac.
Anuture micdâŋte Jesu Kristore aposolo epo Paulo no hâcne, erâ qomâ‐nâŋec Timoteo nâhe Korinti haeonec Anuture kikefuŋ â Akaia mâreŋko mitiŋic juraŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe papia ʒi qâreŋke‐ŋarehuc ʒiŋuc mukoperec:
Mamac‐nâŋec Anutu â Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo eraonec aki anonoc â wama ŋoŋerao fotâcnerâ fozejec.
Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere Mamac â Anutu muteŋkenʒepeneŋ. E buuruc Mamac â bâbâmiriŋ rune juekac.
Ehuc ʒârâ hâriŋ fuŋne fuŋne enâreme bâmiriŋ‐nâpoekac. Eme Anutuzi bâmiriŋ‐nâpoekac, bâbâmiriŋ izia nâŋe iŋuc jaha âgo gâcne ʒârâ hâriŋ fuŋne fuŋne maŋnao juhapie sâcne bâmiriŋ‐jopanaŋmu.
Kristo e ʒâic manawec irec tofane nâŋerao ɋârâŋne fuaekac, iŋuc jaha bâbâmiriŋ‐ticne ɋârâŋnea bâfua‐nâreekac.
Nâŋerao fific guguriŋ fuaekac, i ŋoŋerao bumâteŋ â bâbâpiaŋ fuaocte fua‐nâreekac, â bâbâmiriŋ fua‐nâreekac i wâc ŋoŋere erâ fua‐nâreekac, ine bâbâmiriŋ izi ŋoŋerao fotâcnerâ dopec‐ŋopahame fific guguriŋ nâŋerao fuaekac ijaha ŋoŋerao fuame irec ʒâic maŋuruc jaha mananiŋte.
Eme nâŋe ŋoŋere manabâc mi ehuc ʒiŋuc manapaŋkeŋgopeneŋ: Ʒârâ hâriŋte kâdoc rohuc bâbâmiriŋte kâdoc mâmâc roeŋgopieŋ.
Nâŋe Asia mâreŋko ʒârâ hâriŋ faio juwefumbeŋ irec kâuc banʒipiŋte mupe mananiŋ: Ira wiac hâhâwicne jâmbâŋ fai‐nâŋecko ferâ kimâc‐nâpome juju‐nâŋecte mâretec mana maŋbahac embeŋ.
Eme ʒi hâmocte biŋe eŋgopeneŋ muhuc maŋnâŋec ŋeŋgoroŋkewec. Erâ i mâc mi fua‐nârewec, nâŋe nâŋâcne tâpirire manapene waha qaqane eha Anutu hâmoc qâŋɋâŋ bâɋâreekac e mocjaha manasiŋkenaŋte wiac i fua‐nârewec.
Eme eki hâcne hâmockonec batarac‐nâpowec. Erâ e batarac‐nâpoweczi juku wâc batarac‐nâpozokac, dâŋ iŋuc mana ʒakiehuc erao siŋkeeŋgopeneŋ.
Eme ŋoŋe nunumuzi bafic‐nâpopie Anutu e buafec‐ticnere erâ ŋezic‐nâpome micne micne musereckerâ nâŋere erâ daŋge mumuteŋ ecnepie sâckezejec.
Nâŋe nâŋâcnere piticne mana biaŋkeeŋgopeneŋ ine kecʒiŋucte: Maŋfâsâc â mitio maŋtaniŋ jupene maŋnâŋeczi wiac mocte tutuc mi qanâreekac. Nâŋe miti tâmiric jaŋere maio iŋuc hâcne juhuc miti mamana ŋoŋere maio wâc jujâmbâŋkeeŋgopeneŋ. I mâreŋko maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ fokac ira siŋkehuc mâcne, Anuture uruc jauŋko siŋkehuc eeŋgopeneŋ.
Nâŋe dâŋ hetac herirec ehuc mâcne, dâŋ fârine sasawa qâreŋke‐ŋarepene wose manac eeŋgopieŋ. No manakopac, ŋoŋe ʒâhec mana tara‐jâmbâŋkeniŋmu.
Ine hâcne gâcne ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc biac mana tarazo eŋgopieŋ: Nâŋe ŋoŋere boreŋfâc â ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Jesu dameŋ sâko‐ticnao nâŋere boreŋfâc eniŋmu.
No dâŋ i hâcne maŋkehuc qanaŋ ŋoŋerao fârâ bubiaŋ qaŋarepemurâ mupo.
Erâ fâ honec‐ŋoparâ Makedonia mâreŋko razo mupo. Ira ra jurâ mocwâc ŋoŋerao risiepe gâcnezi bâjâpecnupie Judaia mâreŋko ranaŋte manasupo.
Eme no iŋuc muhuc âkesac eŋarepo muŋgopieŋ me? Me no ŋic miti tâmiric, irec dâŋ mupaŋkepe moc i fârine â moc i racne eekac?
Anutu e jâmbomac rune jukacte dâŋ ŋazapene wemocko racne â fârine ataŋ eocmu?
Anuture Ŋokâ Jesu Kristo ere fuŋne i no â Siliwano â Timoteo nâŋe ŋazapene gâcne fârine â gâcne racne iŋuc mi ewec. Aricne, ere fuŋne i fâri fideteŋ sasawa.
Anuture biŋedâŋ fuŋne fuŋne i erao hâcne deŋke‐fârekac. Irec hâcne esoc‐nâpome “Jâmbomac” muhuc Anutu mucne bacneeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋoŋehec Kristorao râec‐nâpo sanaŋkewec i Anutu eki hâcne.
Erâ ekizia wâc ma qâreŋ banârehuc ʒâʒâfic‐ticne Mâro maŋnâŋecko râeme huwec.
No Korinti haeo fârâ imac‐ŋopazipore mi fâpo. Dâŋ i Anutuzi manaha jâmbomac jâmbâŋ mukopac.
Erâ nâŋe mitio ŋicbomboŋ eŋarenaŋte mi muŋgopeneŋ, mâc ŋoŋerao bubiaŋ fuaocte babaficko gie baeŋgopeneŋ. Ŋoŋe mamanasiŋko qiŋ herâ domaŋgopieŋ i manakopac.
No ŋoŋerao fârâ busâqoc mocwâc bâfua‐ŋarezipore manabâc erâ jupo.
Noni busâqoc eŋarehape weni jaŋe bubiaŋ bâfua‐nareniŋmu? Busâqoc ecnekicnezi wemocko iŋuc eocmu?
Eme no dâŋ i hâcne ʒiŋucte qâreŋke‐ŋarepo: No fâpe ŋoŋe bubiaŋ bâbâfua‐narezi busâqoc bâfua‐narenʒipiŋ. No nâŋâcnere ʒiŋuc hâcne manapaŋkepo: Nore bubiaŋzi mâmâc sâko‐nâŋec ekac.
No bunane gufeme ŋoŋere ʒâic wemo afecne manahuc kifaio papia qâreŋke‐ŋarepo, i bu ririke eŋarepemurâ mâcne, maŋnane ŋoerea sanaŋne domakac, irec fuŋne ŋowatupemurâ epo.
Ŋic busâqoc bâfua‐nârewec, eki no sawa mâcne, ŋoŋe gâcne mâmâc bâfua‐ŋarewec, weniŋuc musokahuc “mâmâc sâko bâfua‐ŋarewec” mupemu.
Ŋoŋe bocjahazi bâtiŋnehuc wiac ecnembiŋ, i manape tarakac.
Ʒi ine busâqocko juku sipirickezacte kiŋticne behehuc mu bâmiriŋ ecnenʒepieŋ.
Irec hâcne harierâ âgo jauŋ ecneniŋte mukopac.
