No bâbâtiŋte mârâc qâreŋke‐ŋarepo, i dâŋnane sasawa reŋkepie fuŋne taniŋkeocte esâic‐ŋopapo.
Ŋoŋe ŋic mocte kiŋ behepie no iŋuc jaha behepemu. Kiŋ behekopac (bahac bâfuawec i norao moc qacnewecko behekopac) ine ŋoŋere manasuhuc Kristore micte ekopac.
I Sataŋzi eatuc‐nâpozacte iŋuc eŋgopeneŋ. E wiac enâreocte manasuekac, irec kâuc mi baŋgopieŋ.
No Troa haeo fisihape Kristore Biŋebiaŋ mupemurâ irec hatane Wofuŋzi bâʒâwe‐narewec.
Eme qomâ‐nane Tito (e ŋoŋeraonec biac mi risiewecte) basahuc maŋhâhâŋ enareme ŋicbureŋ mâzoc‐joparâ Makedonia mâreŋko warepo.
Opoŋ, Anutu e Kristore gieŋifâc‐ticne nâŋe saoreŋ qahuc bataniŋ‐nâpoekac, ehuc enâreme miti‐ticnere âsu aŋac biaŋ bâiŋnepene ŋezurâ mâreŋ sâc raekac, irec mumuteŋ sâko ecnezo.
Nâŋe Kristore âsu mumundoŋ eŋgopeneŋzi Anutu bâiŋnecnepene ŋic jujure biŋe â sisipiricte biŋe mâmâc jopaekac.
Sisipiricte biŋe jaŋe fârepie hurâ hâmoc âsu erâ jopame hâmoeŋgopieŋ, â jujure biŋe jaŋe fârepie hurâ juju âsu erâ âke ɋârec‐jopame jueŋgopieŋ. Gie iŋucne mozi bame sâckeocmu?
Nâŋe ŋic gâcnezi eeŋgopieŋ iŋuc mi eeŋgopeneŋ. Ŋic gâcne bocjahazi Anuture dâŋte manapie âbârâ gie‐jeŋic eekac. Nâŋe ine maŋtaniŋ juhuc Anuture micte â Anuture maio Kristorao qohotahuc miti mueŋgopeneŋ.
Nâŋe ŋoŋe bâmiriŋ‐ŋopanaŋte dâŋ iŋucne mocwâc fuŋkeŋgopeneŋ me? Me ŋic tucnezi eeŋgopieŋ iŋuc erâ ŋoŋerao fisirâ bâbâmiriŋ papia moc ŋowatueŋgopeneŋ? Me ŋoŋe moc qâreŋkerâ nâreeŋgopieeŋ?
Iŋuc aricne, papia‐nâŋec i ŋoŋe hâcne. Erâ papia i maŋŋeŋicko qâreŋkekicne, ŋic mâmâc sasawa hone wosec eene.
Nâŋe ŋoŋerao gie bapene Kristore papia embiŋ, irec fuŋne tâtâc fokac. Erâ papia i tiŋtezi mi qâreŋkekicne, i Anutu jujune ere Mârozi qâreŋkewec, tafe omanao mâcne, ŋicmaŋ tafeo qâreŋkewec.
Qacfiric dâŋ iŋucne ine Kristore erâ Anutu manasiŋkepene fonârekac.
Gie fârine moc nâŋe nâŋâcnaonec fuaekac iŋuc mu manasuc enaŋte ropaŋ mi fonârekac, wiac epene bibiaŋkene i Anuturaonec sasawa.
Anutu eki hâcne baʒawiec‐nâpome ʒâʒâfic ɋâricnere gie baeŋgopeneŋ. I dâŋqâreŋte giene mâcne, i Mârore gie. Dâŋqâreŋzi hâcne sisipiric bâfua‐nâreekac, â Mârozi ine juju bâfua‐nâreekac.
Miti gie raŋɋane, sisipiricte biŋe mumu hâcne, i qorac tapao qâreŋkekicne, erâ gie i sifu tatamac tâmiric mi fowec. Irec hâcne Mosere ʒâŋe maio tatamac hâhâwicne fome Israe ŋic jaŋe wemocko ira firâ honenʒapiŋ. Erâ tatamac i fofone mâcne.
Miti gie raŋɋanere tatamac iŋuc hâcne fowec. Ehame wemocko miti gie ɋâricne, Mârore biŋe mumu, i tatamac tâmiric foocmu?
Sisipiricte biŋe mumu irec giezi tatamac wawahanehec, â kiŋfâsâc eere biŋe mumu irec giezi tatamac fekicne sâkohec.
Gie raŋɋanere tatamac i gie ɋâricnere tatamac sâkozi sâockeme weaŋkeekac.
Wiac fotâmireweczi mârâc tatamacnehec fuawec, â wiac foraʒihuc jujune irec tatamaczi ine fekicne sâko.
Mamanac‐nâŋec iŋuc fokacte gie maŋafec jaha baeŋgopeneŋ,
ehuc Mose mi sâckeeŋgopeneŋ. E Israe ŋic jaŋe tatamac rârâriene i fotâmirehame honenʒipiŋte ʒâŋe maine foŋkewec.
Eme maŋjeŋic sanaŋkewecte miti raŋɋanezi wâc foŋnehec eweczi eekac. Irec wose manac ehuc mi mana taraeŋgopieŋ. Erâ foŋ i mâc mi raruŋkeocmu, Kristo e mocjahazi bararuŋkeocmu.
Jaŋe dameŋ ʒiŋuczia Mosere dâŋqâreŋ woseeŋgopieŋ sâc maŋjeŋic foŋnehec eekac.
Jaŋe maŋjeŋic bârisierâ Wofuŋ maickepie izia foŋ i firue‐jareocmu.
Wofuŋ e Mâro rune, eme Wofuŋte Mârozi juekacko wiac omaraŋ foekac.
Nâŋâc ine ʒâŋe mai‐nâŋec foŋ tâmiric fokacte Wofuŋte tatamaczi âke tamaec‐nâpome bâtikiepene wefuekac, ehuc Wofuŋte hawari sâc erâ tatamacheczi tatamachec eeŋgopeneŋ. I Wofuŋ Mâro ere mâsi.
Wofuŋ e buafec‐ticnere gie iŋucne munârewecte mi pârâweeŋgopeneŋ.
Ehuc bahac, mimi fuazacte soŋsoŋko eene, i râpecke‐fârembeŋ. Me sioc faio juhuc Anuture dâŋ bâbâsifucke i wâc mi eeŋgopeneŋ, aricne. Nâŋe Anuture maio miti mutaniŋkehuc ŋic jaŋere maŋ bâmiriŋkepene fuŋne‐nâŋec manaeŋgopieŋ.
Eme Biŋebiaŋ mueŋgopeneŋ izi foŋnehec moc eekacko ine sisipiricte biŋe jaŋerao sawa foŋnehec eekac.
Miti qiqikiŋ jaŋe hâcne mâreŋ ʒirec ŋicbomboŋzi maŋjeŋic bâzickeme wemocko Biŋebiaŋte tatamaczi hume Kristo e Anuture sâc jâmbâŋ jukac muhuc Wofuŋ qâreŋ‐ticne ʒâŋitaniŋmu?
Nâŋe miti muhuc nâŋe nâŋâcne dâŋ mi ŋazaeŋgopeneŋ, Jesu Kristo eki Wofuŋ â nâŋe ine Jesure erâ kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ŋeŋic sawa juŋgopeneŋ, iŋuc ŋazaeŋgopeneŋ.
Anutu e mârâc jaha fuŋnao dapâc fohame hae mâreŋ fureocte mume furewec, ekizia hâcne mume maŋnâŋecko mitire tatamaczi uŋ heme Kristore ʒâŋe maio Anuture huriri qâreŋ fua tâcneha ʒâŋitambeŋ.
Tâpiri ʒâkâŋ i nâŋerao mâcne, Anuturao fokac, irec fuŋne taniŋkeocte boreŋ ʒeŋaŋ‐ticne kuʒi mâreŋzi bakicne nâŋerao duckekicne.
Hume serereŋ faio juipiehuc sifu docke ʒaŋ mi eeŋgopeneŋ. Bebekâne juipiehuc sifu mi mana utuckeeŋgopeneŋ,
fific guguriŋ faio juipiehuc sifu mamac babasa mi eeŋgopeneŋ, qa imac enâre‐bipiehapie sifu hâmo sipiric mi eeŋgopeneŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc sahac‐nâŋecko Jesu hâmoc‐ticnere ma amecke jueŋgopeneŋ, i Jesu juju‐ticnere ma iŋuc jaha sahac‐nâŋecko fuaocte hâcne.
Ŋic jaŋe Jesure erâ dameŋ oombâŋko gâbâ sipiric‐nâpohuc hâmocko râec‐nâpoeŋgopieŋ, i Jesu juju‐ticnere tâpirizi sahac hâhâmo‐nâŋecko fua taniŋkeocte iŋuc fua‐nâreekac.
Eme ʒiŋuc fokac: Nâŋerao hâmoczi gie baekac, â ŋoŋerao jujuzi gie baekac.
Dâŋqâreŋ moc ʒiŋuc fokac: “No Wofuŋ manasiŋkeekopacte miti muekopac.” Eme nâŋe dâŋqâreŋ irec sâcko Mârozi esoc‐nâpoha Wofuŋ manasiŋkeeŋgopeneŋte miti mueŋgopeneŋ.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc manapaŋkeeŋgopeneŋ: Wofuŋ Jesu bâɋârewec eki nâŋe iŋuc jaha Jesuhec bâɋârec‐nâporâ ŋoŋehec mâmâc erao râec‐nâpoocmu.
Nâŋe wiac sasawa i ŋoŋere erâ kecʒiŋuc muhuc eeŋgopeneŋ: Mitizi haŋ barahame ŋic bocjahazi manahuc Anutu ʒeri mumuteŋ sâko ecnepie izi ʒuhuckeme ʒuhuc forahuc fozejec.
Nâŋe ʒiŋuc manahuc mi pârâweeŋgopeneŋ: Sahac‐nâŋec bâmuzuckehame maŋnâŋec ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne soka biaŋ eekac.
Mâreŋko ʒâic busâqoc‐nâŋec mâmâŋne â tatarane izi eri aŋac biaŋ ŋemâc bâmâcne â fofo sanaŋ bâfua‐nârehame guru dindiŋ fonârezokac.
Erâ wiac tâtâc fokac irapec mâcne, wiac soŋsoŋ fokac irapec firâ râqârepene i fua‐nârezokac. Wiac hohonene izi sisirowene, wiac mi hohonene izi fofo sanaŋ.
Nâŋe ʒiŋuc manaŋgopeneŋ: Mâreŋte ficboze‐nâŋec raruŋkeme Anutuzi sambâŋko ficsanaŋ moc bâfua‐nâreocmu, fic i mezi mi bakicne, mâc qiŋ sanaŋ qaŋqaŋ qakicne.
Eme nâŋe irec hâcne sambâŋkonec fic i henâreme huocte aŋac‐nâpome harac huacbuc ehuc jueŋgopeneŋ.
Maŋ qâqâtâc‐nâŋeczi biuctac ezacte i hâcne rojupene sâckeocmu.
Sahac boze‐nâŋecko junaŋmu sâc ŋeŋe rârâqâc enâreme hujâi ehuc jueŋgopeneŋ. Nâŋe ŋaqi‐nâŋec raŋɋane hetaranaŋte mi enâreekac, i fohame fainao ɋâricne henâreme huocte enâreekac. Ehuc hâmocte biŋe ekicne i jujuzi ɋâckeocte mueŋgopeneŋ.
Wiac biaŋ i fua‐nâreocte bâmoc‐nâpowec i Anutu eki hâcne, ehuc irec kifac Mâro hâcne râe‐nârewec.
Nâŋe irec hâcne mana afeckehuc jueŋgopeneŋ. Ehuc ʒiŋuc manaeŋgopeneŋ: Mâreŋ sahaczi haefuŋ‐nâŋec eha jueŋgopeneŋ, i Wofuŋ basahuc mâreŋ jabao jueŋgopeneŋ.
Dameŋ ʒiŋuczia maŋzi wiac manasiŋkehuc jujune sawa fokac, fârine hohone aricne.
Erâ sifu mana afeckeeŋgopeneŋ. Ehuc sahachec mâreŋ jabao juju i beherâ mame sâko hae‐nâŋecko Wofuŋhec juju irec aŋac‐nâpoekac.
Eme juju i mame sâko haeo me mâreŋ jabao junaŋmu ine kecʒiŋuc muhuc ropaŋ eeŋgopeneŋ: Aimuŋ jupene Wofuŋzi honec‐nâpome sâckezejec.
Ʒiŋuc hâcne manaŋgopeneŋ: Juku ʒeŋgoma Kristore dâŋ mumutara ŋeŋe fuŋnao fua tâcnepene, sahachec juhuc wiac hurekicne, biaŋne me sâqocne, irec tofa ru sâc bazu‐nâreocmu.
Wofuŋ araŋ bacnehuc junaŋte mukicne i manahuc ŋic mu hemiriŋ ejareeŋgopeneŋ. Iŋuc ehapene Anutuzi maŋnâŋec honeekac, â ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha maŋŋeŋiczi fuŋne‐nâŋec ŋazame manaeŋgopieŋ.
Nâŋe iŋuc mupene manapie nâŋe harierâ bâbâmiriŋ dâŋ muŋgopeneŋ mi ezejec. Nâŋe mâc ŋaza qâmoc eŋgopeneŋ, eme ŋoŋe ŋic gâcne, maŋtac juhuc sahackopec wiacte sawa penaroŋ eeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe dâŋ i jazahuc bâsâoc‐nâponʒepieŋ.
Nâŋe maŋnâŋec ŋeŋgoroŋkeekacko ine Anutu gie‐ticnere erâ ŋeŋgoroŋkeekac, me maŋnâŋec fâretiŋ foekacko ine ŋoŋe mitihec eniŋte iŋuc foekac.
Kristore maŋjauŋzi maŋnâŋec fenʒoŋkehame juhuc ʒiŋuc mana sanaŋkeeŋgopeneŋ: Mocjahazi okac‐nâŋec hâmowecte mâmâc sâko hâmombeŋ ekac.
Mâmâc sâko okac‐nâŋec hâmowec ine kecʒiŋucte: Juju i nâŋâc nâŋâcnere mâcne, okac‐nâŋec hâmorâ faharewec ere erâ junʒepeneŋ.
Irec ʒi miti dameŋko sahac hawari sawa hohonec erâ ʒâʒâŋitac i sâcne mi enaŋmu. Erâ wâc Kristo iŋuc jaha mârâc sahac hawarine honehuc ʒâŋitambeŋ, irec sâc ʒiŋuczia mocwâc mi enaŋmu.
Irec ŋic moc Kristorao ʒuhuckeekac e fuŋmoc eekac. Ine wiac raŋɋane omaewec, ŋicbureŋ, wiac ɋâricne fuawec.
Wiac i Anuture mâsi sasawa. Eki hâcne Kristozi jahacnehec miriŋ bacnâpowec. Erâ nâŋâc miriŋ babac biŋedâŋ mupene haŋ baocte irec gie munârewec.
Ine hâcne Anutu e Kristoo juhuc mâreŋŋic jahacnehec miriŋ bacnâpowec, ehuc kiŋnâŋec behewec. Erâ miriŋ babac dâŋ ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko âkendâŋnewec domakac.
Irec nâŋe Kristore biŋe mumuzi Anuture mu baafec dâŋ ŋazaeŋgopeneŋ. Nâŋe Kristo âkehockehuc numu‐ŋareeŋgopeneŋ: Anutuhec miriŋ babac enʒepieŋ.
Sâqocnere kâuc bawec e Anutuzi nâŋâcnere erâ sâqocne bapa mucnewec, i nâŋâc Jesuhec qâfâsâehuc Anuture tiŋne jujufâc enaŋte iŋuc hâcne ewec.
Anuture babaficfâc nâŋe mu âkesiŋ eŋarehuc ʒiŋuc ŋazaeŋgopeneŋ: “Anuture aki anonoc tahac‐ŋopakicne i fârimâc mi ezejec.”
Dâŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “No dameŋ biaŋko mana‐garepo â bâbâpiaŋ dameŋko baficgupo.” Manaŋgopieŋ, dameŋ biaŋ jâmbâŋ ʒine hâcne, â bâbâpiaŋ dameŋ iŋuc jaha ʒine hâcne.
Nâŋe ŋic jaŋe gie bapa‐nâŋec surenʒipiŋte gâŋ ŋezic mi ejareeŋgopeneŋ.
Nâŋe Anuture gieŋic jueŋgopeneŋ irec fuŋne bataniŋehuc wiac ʒiŋuc eraeŋgopeneŋ: Ʒâicmaŋko maŋuruc jueŋgopeneŋ, ʒârâ hâriŋ faio jueŋgopeneŋ, fific guguriŋ faio jueŋgopeneŋ, hâhâwic maŋko jueŋgopeneŋ,
ʒika faio jueŋgopeneŋ, kâpâcwâru ficko ŋeeŋgopeneŋ, râsi ŋondeŋko jueŋgopeneŋ, giere ʒâic manaeŋgopeneŋ, guŋɋâri jueŋgopeneŋ, nânâ tâmiricko jueŋgopeneŋ,
bahac fâsâc jueŋgopeneŋ, mamana tarahec jueŋgopeneŋ, bumâteŋ jueŋgopeneŋ, âgo jauŋ ejareeŋgopeneŋ, Tiri Mârohec jueŋgopeneŋ, maŋjauŋ fârihec jueŋgopeneŋ,
dâŋ fâri qizecne mueŋgopeneŋ, Anuture tâpirio jueŋgopeneŋ, mitire sându marohec jueŋgopeneŋ,
mumumbiaŋ â mimi qaqa ŋoŋondeŋko jueŋgopeneŋ, mu bâsâoc â mufec muriŋ ŋoŋondeŋko jueŋgopeneŋ, burecŋic munârehapie siocmâc jueŋgopeneŋ,
fuŋne‐nâŋec basahapie biŋe rarahec jueŋgopeneŋ, hâmozo eeŋgopeneŋzi sifu ɋâricne jueŋgopeneŋ, nâpo sipiric ekicnezi sifu mi omaeeŋgopeneŋ,
busâqoc enârekicnezi sifu bubiaŋko jueŋgopeneŋ, hapetaczi sifu ŋic bocjaha bâmec bajareeŋgopeneŋ, wiac babasanezi sifu mâriri sâkohec jueŋgopeneŋ.
O Korinti ŋicbureŋ, maŋnâŋec ŋoŋerea kâcɋene domame micnâŋec afeckac hâcne.
Maŋzi sanaŋnea ʒâfic‐ŋopaŋgopeneŋ, ŋoŋere maŋjauŋ ine afecne mac fokac.
Eme no naru motecfâc‐nane ŋoŋe ŋazape: Ŋoŋe okacne bazuhuc iŋuc jaha maŋŋeŋic nâŋere râepie kâcɋenea domazejec.
Ŋic qâpuc jaŋe jâcjeŋic reŋkepie ŋoŋe mi bafic‐jopanʒepieŋ. Tiŋne â hehesic jahe wemocko ââgo enicmu? Me tatamac â dapâc jahe wemocko ʒâʒâfic enicmu?
Me Kristo â râsi qizec‐ticne jahe wemocko maŋ mocjaha enicmu? Me opâ ruac â qâpuc jaŋe wemocko qâfâsâeniŋmu?
Me Anuture ufuŋ â nemuɋâŋ jahe wemocko ʒuʒuhuc enicmu? Manaŋgopieŋ, Anutu jujunere ufuŋ i nâŋâc. Anutuzi ʒiŋuc hâcne muwec: “No ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ŋeŋe juju epemu, ehuc Anutu‐jeŋic ehape jaŋe ŋicfâc‐nane junʒepieŋ.
Irec qâpuc behec‐joparâ bâtâcko junʒepieŋ, Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac. Erâ wiac mamakâcne ba bâuac mi enʒepieŋ, eme noni hezu hewâneŋ eŋarepemu.
Erâ mamac eŋarehape naru motecfâc‐nane erâ junʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ bapa‐fâre e dâŋ iŋuc mukac.”
Âgo bureŋ, wiac iŋucnere biŋe qanârekicnere wiac mamakâcnezi maŋ sahac‐nâŋec hegâpâreekac i ʒure ɋaɋackenʒepeneŋ. Erâ Anutu araŋ bacnehuc maŋɋaɋac jaha junʒepeneŋ.
Ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋic mi sakare‐nârenʒepieŋ. Nâŋe ŋoŋerao wiac hehesic mi embeŋ, me wiac‐ŋeŋic ima mi qambeŋ, me wiac‐ŋeŋic moc kâŋgâc mi rombeŋ.
No dâŋ i musâqorec‐ŋopahuc mi mukopac. No miŋecne mac ŋazapac, maŋnâŋeczi ʒâfic‐ŋopaŋgopeneŋ, i ŋoŋehec mâmâc hâmonaŋte me junaŋte.
Maŋnanezi ŋoŋerao siŋkeha wemo afecne muafec‐ŋopakopac, no bunane boc bâmiriŋkekicne, ʒâic busâqocko ʒeri kâcɋene fua‐narekac.
Makedonia mâreŋko ware fisirâ wemocko âke uruerâ junʒapeŋ. Ʒira sahacte biŋe ʒika â maŋte biŋe hâhâwic, wiac izi fuarâ sisi hâhâŋ enâreha jumbeŋ.
Bebekâne bâmiriŋ‐jopaekac Anutu eki hâcne ine nâŋere bâbâmiriŋte Tito ecneme risiewec.
Erâ risiewec irec sawa mâcne, ŋoŋe bubiaŋ dâŋ âzâcnembiŋ, i bafisime manarâ bunâŋec uruewec. Erâ no woricnuhuc jueŋgopieŋ â ki busâqochec jueŋgopieŋ â nore erâ gie‐ŋeŋic dopeckehuc ʒoɋac eeŋgopieŋ, i nâzâme bubiaŋ fekicne manapo.
No mârâc papia moc qâreŋke‐ŋarehuc maŋʒâic bâfua‐ŋarepo, irec bunane mi sâqorekac. Qâreŋkepo ira jâmbomac bunane sâqorewec. Ʒi ine manakopac, i dameŋ bembeŋne sawa maŋʒâic bâfua‐ŋarewec.
Eme ʒi bubiaŋ manakopac, ine buʒâic manambiŋ irec mâcne, buʒâiczi ŋoŋerao maŋ bâbârisie bâfuawec, irec bunane biaŋkekac. Anutu mamana‐ticnere sâcko buʒâic ɋaɋacne manambiŋte dâŋnâŋeczi mi bâsâqorec‐ŋopawec.
Buʒâic ɋaɋacne izi maŋ bâbârisie bâfuame ŋiczi biaŋkezo, eme buʒâic iŋucne bâfuaocmuzi ʒâhec irec mi maname sâqoreocmu. Â buʒâic gâpâcne, ŋic mamanare sâcko fuaekac, izi ine maŋmutuc bâfuame sipirickezo.
Honeniŋ me, buʒâic ɋaɋacnezi ŋoŋerao fârine wemo afecne bâfuawec: Fâro, fuŋne babataniŋ, sâqocne bâbâsue, hâhâwic, mu hejâpec, ʒoɋac, bâbâtiŋ, wiac iŋuc hâcne bâfuawec. Eme sâqocnere hehesoŋ â ŋeŋezic ŋoŋerao mi fokac, irec fuŋne taniŋkewec.
Mârâc papia qâreŋke‐ŋarepo, i ŋic sâqocne bawec ere erâ mâcne, me sâqocne bajarewec jaŋere erâ wâc mâcne, dâŋ ŋazapene Anuture maio micrereŋ‐ŋeŋicte fuŋne taniŋkeocte irec qâreŋke‐ŋarepo. Eme ŋoŋe iŋuc hâcne ehuc bunâŋec bâmiriŋkembiŋ.
Erâ bunâŋec bâmiriŋkembiŋ sawa mâcne, ŋoŋe Tito bubiaŋ qacnepie risieme nâŋe wemo afecne mana biaŋ embeŋ.
No mârâc jaha muafec‐ŋopahuc Tito âzâcnepo, dâŋ i burec mi ewec. Ŋoŋe dâŋ ŋazape fârinehec efârewec, iŋuc jaha Tito ŋoŋere mumumbiaŋ dâŋ âzâcnepo i wâc fârinehec jaha ewec.
Tito ŋoŋerao fâme araŋ bacnehuc micne reŋkembiŋ, e irec manasuhuc maŋne ŋoŋere boc ecneekac.
No ŋoŋere erâ maŋbahac tâmiric sâcne jupemu, irec bunane biaŋkekac.
Âgo bureŋ, Makedonia mâreŋkonec kikefuŋ jaŋerao Anuture jauŋ fuawec irec ŋazanaŋ.
Jaŋe ʒârâ hâriŋ sâkoo juhuc bahac qahameŋ erâ tac qararacne jueŋgopieŋ, ehame sifu mitire ʒeri fekicne fojareekacte bubiaŋ wiac ɋâfoŋne bâmockembiŋ.
No jaŋere mana‐jâmbâŋkekopac, jaŋe jaŋacne maŋte afeckerâ tâpiri‐jeŋicte sâc, erâ wâc sâc i jâuruhuc râembiŋ.
Nâŋe mi ejarehapene jaŋe jaŋac hota‐nârehuc mitiŋic jaŋere bubiaŋ wiac bâfuarâ bafic‐nâponiŋte mumbiŋ.
Erâ wiac afecne eniŋmu muhapene ʒiŋuc embiŋ: Qanaŋ maŋjeŋic Wofuŋ qikiŋnecnerâ nâŋe mâmâc Anuture erâ qikiŋne‐nârembiŋ.
Jaŋe iŋuc embiŋte Titozi ŋoŋerao bubiaŋ gie barâ tofane râewec i bataraocte mucneŋgopeneŋ.
Eme mamanasiŋ â miti mumu â miti fuŋne mamana tara â giere ʒoɋac â maŋjauŋ eenâre, wiac iŋucnere fârine bocjaha bâfuambiŋte bubiaŋ gie mukicne irec iŋuc jaha afeckenʒepieŋ.
No hota‐ŋarehuc mi mukopac, miti mamana gâcne jaŋerao aafec fuawec, eme ŋoŋere maŋjauŋ sâc weniŋucne fokac irec fuŋne taniŋkeocte mukopac.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo uruc jauŋ‐ticnere manaeŋgopieŋ, e mâriri sâkoheczi ŋoŋere erâ hapetac ewec, i ŋoŋe hapetac‐ticnere erâ mâririhec eniŋte iŋuc hâcne ewec.
Eme ʒi dâŋ mâc ŋazakopac i reŋkepie fârinehec ezejec. Ŋoŋe hâcne jara raŋɋanao biac moneŋ bâtureniŋte afeckerâ fuŋkembiŋ.
Eme i ʒuhuckerâ etarapie aafec‐ŋeŋicte fârine, wiac foŋarekac sâc fuazejec.
Wiac buafecte rârâe irec mamana biaŋ fuaocmu, rârâe ine moc e focnekac irec sâc râezejec, mi focnekac irec sâc mâcne.
Bubiaŋte wiac rârâere mukicne i jaŋe sahac mâteŋ juhapie ŋoŋe ʒocne ʒâicne mananiŋte mâcne,
ŋoŋere mafa mâririzi dameŋ ʒiŋuczia jaŋere roroc jâpeme wiac sâckoa fuaocte mukicne, eme juku dameŋ mocko jaŋere mâririzi ŋoŋere roroc jâpeme iŋuc jaha sâckoa fua‐ŋarezejec.
Dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “Bocjaha nusembiŋzi mâririhec mi embiŋ, â afecne nusembiŋzi roroc mi embiŋ.”
Anutu e Tito esockeme, maŋnâŋezi ŋoŋere erâ bâruŋkekac sâc ijaha erao fuakacte muteŋkenaŋ.
Nâŋe mucnepene manawec sawa mâcne, e jahac maŋticnere afecke‐jâmbâŋkerâ fâzo ekac.
Opâ ruac âgo‐nâŋec moc, kikefuŋ sasawa jaŋe Biŋebiaŋte gie bapa‐ticnere mana biaŋ eeŋgopieŋ, e mâmâc sorepene fâkopirec.
Kikefuŋ jaŋe ŋic e hâcne bubiaŋ moneŋ rorore bafic‐nâpoocte bâwosâembiŋ. Gie i Wofuŋ sâsehuc buafec‐nâŋecte baŋgopeneŋ.
Mumusifuc fuazacte moneŋ sâko i ʒâŋe ʒereŋko sosoŋaŋ ehuc ro qâzuc eeŋgopeneŋ.
Nâŋe wiac epene Wofuŋzia maname biaŋkeocte mâcne, ŋiczi mâmâc manapie sâckeocte mueŋgopeneŋ.
Nâŋe jahehec âgo‐nâŋec moc mâmâc sorec‐jopapene fâŋgopieŋ, ŋic e dameŋ gâcnao esâicke honepene ʒoɋac‐ticnere fuŋne taniŋkewec, ʒi ine ŋoŋere bubiaŋ manahuc ʒoɋac fekicne bâfuakac.
Ŋoŋe Titore manaeŋgopieŋ, e âgo babafic‐nane, mâmâc gie bapa ŋicjahec‐ŋeŋic jukoperec, â âgo jahec‐nâŋec jahere wâc manaŋgopieŋ, jahe kikefuŋ jaŋe sorec‐jofaŋgopieŋ, erâ jahe Kristore ʒuŋe gâpiŋ hâcne.
Nâŋe ŋoŋe muafec‐ŋopaeŋgopeneŋ irec dâŋ i fârinehec eocte ŋic iŋucnezi fâpie âgo jauŋ ejarepie kikefuŋ gâcne jaŋe mananʒepieŋ.
Mitiŋic ehâmo‐jarehuc moneŋ jareniŋte i sâcne manaŋgopieŋ, irec wemocte boc qâreŋke‐ŋarepemu.
Akaia opâ ruac ŋoŋe jara raŋɋanao biac afeckerâ moneŋ bâbâfua fuŋkembiŋ, irec binaŋ Makedonia ŋic bajarepe ŋic gâcne sâko jaŋe ʒoɋac‐ŋeŋicte biŋe manarâ bujeŋic âeckewec.
No muafec‐ŋopapo i racne ezacte âgofâc‐nane sorec‐jopape fâpie mupo iŋuc hâcne erâ ʒawienʒepieŋ.
No nahac ʒâhec Makedonia ŋic jaŋehec fâpe moneŋ rârâere bititiepie dâŋnane wawahane eme no â ŋoŋe mâmâc mimienʒipeŋ.
Irec hâcne ŋic ejarepe bânierâ fâŋgopieŋ. Fâ fisipie bubiaŋ moneŋ râeniŋte nazambiŋ i qanaŋ râe bâmoc epie ŋezejec. Eme micneneŋte moneŋ mâcne, mitire bubiaŋte moneŋ ezejec.
Erâ ine ʒiŋuc mukopac: Moc e wiac afecne he sarac eocmu, e wiac afecnea nâ roroc eocmu, â moc e wiac ŋemâcne he sarac eocmu e wiac ŋemâcnea nâ roroc eocmu.
Irec ʒiŋuc efârezo: Moc e buafec‐ticnere sâcko wiac‐ticne qikiŋnezejec, jâiŋko me micneneŋte misac. Wiac buafec qikiŋneocmu, ŋic iŋucnere Anutuzi maname biaŋkeocmu.
Anutu e tâpiri runezi buafec‐ticnere jambuŋ‐ŋopame mâriri fua‐ŋareme ŋaŋacne nâ bac eipiehuc bâmec gie fuŋne fuŋne baniŋte wiac mi basaniŋmu.
Dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “E kada bahuc ŋic hapetac bâmec bajareekac, â buafec‐ticne i tofamâc fohuc juocmu.”
Ŋic ukicne bâfua‐jareme he sarac eeŋgopieŋ â fârine bâfua‐jareme nâ bac eeŋgopieŋ, Anutu e hâcne ŋoŋe wâc he sarac eniŋte ukicne bâfua‐ŋarerâ jambuŋkeme buafec‐ŋeŋicte fârine fua sawec eocmu.
Eme mâriri sâkohec erâ ŋic bâmec fuŋne fuŋne bajarepie jaŋe nâŋâcnere erâ Anutu daŋge mumuteŋ ecneniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe mitiŋic bubiaŋ wiac ejarepie izi roroc‐jeŋic jâpeocmu sawa mâcne, izi daŋge mumuteŋ irec mâriri wâc bâfuame Anuturao qacneocmu.
Ŋoŋe Kristore Biŋebiaŋ mana rereŋ eeŋgopieŋ irec fuŋne bubiaŋ wiac‐ŋeŋiczi bataniŋkeme Jerusalem haeonec mitiŋic â opâ ruac gâcne sasawa jaŋehec ââgo ʒuʒuhuc‐ŋeŋic fuame Anutu mumbiaŋkeniŋmu.
Erâ ŋoŋerao Anutu miti‐ticnere fârine fua sawec ekacte maŋzi ʒâfic‐ŋopahuc ŋoŋere erâ Anutu numucneniŋmu.
Anutu buafec‐ticne i wemocko sâcne mutaniŋkezo, irec mâc wareckehuc daŋge âzâcnenaŋ.
Ʒi Paulo noni Kristo bumâteŋ‐ticnere â uruc‐ticnere erâ ŋazape mananiŋ. Gâcnezi nore mueŋgopieŋ, “Ʒira ware juhuc miriŋdâŋ enâreekac, â ocna ra juhuc momori dâŋ enâreekac.”
Âgofâc, ŋoŋerao fâ juhuc momori dâŋ ŋazapemurâ irec mi qafeŋnunʒepieŋ. Gâcnezi “sahacte wiacko utuckerâ juekac”, nore iŋuc mueŋgopieŋ, ŋic i jaŋe momori dâŋ jazapemurâ maŋnane afeckekac.
Wiac nâŋe sahachec juju i jâmbomac jueŋgopeneŋ, â momori juju ine sahacte hata fokac iŋucko mi jueŋgopeneŋ.
Sându maro bajuhuc juju gie baeŋgopeneŋ, i mâreŋkonec mâcne, i Anuture tâpiri sanaŋhec. Eme izi râsire sac bazueŋgopeneŋ, â qac momori‐ticne qapene wahaekac,
â hârâc huec Anuture dâŋ sirickeekac i qa imac eeŋgopeneŋ, erâ Kristore micrereŋ sawa fuaocte mamana fuŋne fuŋne kâpâcwâru baeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋoŋe micrereŋte afecke‐fârehapie nâŋe ŋic gâcne jaŋe qaqatara‐jeŋicte bâtiŋ‐jopazore woŋec juŋgopeneŋ.
Wiac moc ʒi tâtâc fokac i honeniŋ: Ŋoŋe wemocte sahackopec wiac omanere manapie fârine eekac? Ŋoŋeraonec ŋic moczi e jahacnere maname Kristore ŋic fârine eekacko ʒiŋuc manazejec: E buc Kristore ŋic mi juekac, nâŋe wâc Kristore ŋicfâc jaha jueŋgopeneŋ.
Erâ Wofuŋzi giere tâpiri râe‐narewec, ŋoŋe âkesiŋ‐ŋopapere, sipiric‐ŋopapere mâcne, no irec erâ ropaŋdâŋ piticne muraʒihuc mupe boc mi sâqore‐nareocmu.
Â papia qâreŋke‐ŋareekopac irec manapie mu hâhâwic dâŋ mi ezejec.
Ʒiŋuc hâcne munareeŋgopieŋ: “Papiao dâŋ bipinehec â tâpirinehec qâreŋkeekac, sahaczi maic‐nâpoekac ine weweaŋne, â dâŋ mumu‐ticne ine wawahane.”
Ŋic iŋucne jaŋe ʒiŋuc mananʒepieŋ: Nâŋe ʒoricko juhuc dâŋ qâreŋkeeŋgopeneŋ, dâŋ irec fârine ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko juhuc bâfuaeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋic sahac fefe jueŋgopieŋ jaŋerao nâŋe iŋucnezi wemocko ʒuhuckerâ sâc babac enaŋmu. Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne gâcne nâŋere eebapa irec mi manasuhuc jaŋacnere sawa muhuc sahac fefe dâŋ kosa woseeŋgopieŋ.
Nâŋe ine Anutuzi giere sâc banârewec iŋuc bafâku ŋoŋerao fisimbeŋ, irec mac manasuhuc mumuafec dâŋ mueŋgopeneŋ, â sâc tâmiricko kosa mumu ine mi eeŋgopeneŋ.
Nâŋe gie‐nâŋecte sâc i mi musokaeŋgopeneŋ, gie rukec‐nâŋec i jâmbomac ŋoŋerao fokac, nâŋe hâcne bâbâni ŋoŋerao fisirâ Kristore Biŋebiaŋ qanaŋ ŋazambeŋ.
Nâŋe ŋic gâcne jaŋere gieo kâŋgâc raʒi domahuc sahac fefe dâŋ kosa mumu i mi eeŋgopeneŋ. Mamanasiŋzi ŋoŋerao fua sawec eme gie rukec‐nâŋec bâsokanaŋte ine jâmbomac maŋnâŋec domaha jueŋgopeneŋ.
Eme ŋic râpe‐ŋeŋicko juŋgopieŋ jaŋerao Biŋebiaŋ muranaŋmu. Â ŋic mocte gie fârine rauckehuc pepec dâŋ mumu i mi eeŋgopeneŋ.
Moc e mumuteŋ dâŋ muzo murâ Wofuŋte erâ muzejec.
Moc e jahacne sahac mumbiaŋkeme e miti fârihec ekac mi mucnezo, Wofuŋzi mumbiaŋkeme miti fârihec ekac muzo.
Ŋoŋe manahapie mutucdâŋ piticne ŋazape. Sifu mac mananʒepieŋ.
No ŋoŋere erâ qizec qaekopac, erâ qizec qaqa dâŋnane i Anuturaonec. Noni ŋoŋe Kristore biŋefâc erâ pectâc juniŋte ŋic mocjaha ehec bâturec‐ŋopapo.
Ʒi ine homazi Ewa sioc ecnehuc bâdockewec iŋuc jaha ŋoŋe ŋic gâcnezi eatuc‐ŋopapie maŋŋeŋic fâuckeme Kristo râŋgeŋ rocnenʒipiŋte manabâc ekopac.
Ŋoŋerao ŋic moczi fisirâ Jesure fuŋne nâŋe ŋazaeŋgopeneŋ ijaha mâcne, hawarine moc ŋazaocmu, â Mâro nâŋeraonec rombiŋ i mâcne, furune moc ŋareocmu, â Biŋebiaŋ nâŋeraonec manambiŋ i mâcne, maracne moc ŋazaocmu, i ŋoŋe mi qatarahuc mâc manapie sâckeekac.
No nahacnere manape norao wiac i me i basahuc aposolo fekicne sâko jaŋere jujuwicnao jukopac mi eekac.
No miti muminʒiriŋkerâ mumu i mi mecne fonarekac, â mitire fuŋne mamana ine manaekopac, erâ irec fuŋne baratie‐fârehuc mâmâc‐ŋeŋic bataniŋke‐ŋarepo.
Me nahac wahamicne juhuc ŋoŋe ikisiŋ‐ŋopahuc Anuture Biŋebiaŋ katucmâc ŋazapo i sâqorewec me?
Ŋoŋerao miti gie bapemurâ kikefuŋ gâcne jaŋe jâmbomac moneŋ mafa jowac ropo.
Â ŋoŋerao ine wiac basac bahameŋ juhuc mubâre mi eŋarepo. No batac qatac juhape Makedonia mâreŋkonec âgofâc‐nane fisirâ wiac nare gumec embiŋ. Â ŋoŋerao ine mâc juhape nore ʒâic mi manambiŋ â jufehuc wâc mi mananiŋte mukopac.
Kristore dâŋfâri maŋnaneo foha mukopac: Ʒeridâŋ inane Akaia mâreŋko moc mi bawaha‐narezo.
Muŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋere mi enarehame iŋuc eekopac? Iŋuc aricne, i Anutuzi manakac.
Wiac eekopac i ehuc jupemu, erâ i mâc mâcne, ŋic gâcne jaŋe Paulore sâcko juŋgopeneŋ muhuc maŋjeŋic bafenʒipiŋte siŋ qatara‐jareekopac.
Ŋic iŋucnezi aposolo burecne â miti gie bapa siochec juhuc Kristore aposolofâc nâŋere sahac hawari sawa eeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ i wiac furune mi eeŋgopieŋ, Sataŋ e jahacne wâc aŋelo tatamachec jaŋere hawari tinac eekac,
eme irec gie bapa ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe iŋuc jaha tiŋnere kiŋaŋ qaqa jaŋere hawari rojueŋgopieŋ.
Mupac i mocwâc mupe, nore manapie ŋic mutucne mi ezejec. Erâ sifu muzo murâ muniŋ, ehuc mana‐narehapie sahac‐nane piticne muteŋkepe.
No ʒi dâŋ mupemu i Wofuŋte micsâcko mi mupemu, mâc mumuteŋ dâŋ fuŋkekicnere sifu mutuc erâ mupemu.
Ŋic gâcnezi sahackopec wiacte mumumbiaŋ dâŋ mueŋgopieŋte no iŋuc jaha epemu.
Oi, fuŋne mamana ŋoŋe, gâcnezi mutucdâŋ ŋazapie manapie sâckeekac hâcne.
Â kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐jeŋic bacŋopapie iŋuc jaha manapie sâckeekac, â ŋowac ro nâc eŋareniŋmu me eatuc‐ŋopaniŋmu me ŋicbomboŋ eŋareniŋmu me imac‐ŋopaniŋmu, i ŋoŋe manapie sâcke‐fâreocmu hâcne.
Nâŋe gegec dodocnezi iŋuc sâko wemocko eŋarenʒapeŋ, i mana sâqorehuc mukopac. Moc e wiac irec me irec penaroŋ eocmu, i no ezo murâ sâcne epemu. Dâŋ i mutucne, i mana‐bipiehuc mukopac.
Jaŋacnere Judaŋic mueŋgopieŋ, no wâc ijaha. Jaŋacnere Israe ŋic mueŋgopieŋ, no wâc ijaha. Jaŋacnere Abrahamte ɋâric mueŋgopieŋ, no wâc ijaha.
Jaŋacnere Kristore gieŋic mueŋgopieŋ, no ʒi sifu maŋmutuc dâŋ mupe, no Kristore gieŋic sâc moc. No giere ʒâic manaekopac i sâc moc, â kâpâcwâru ficko feekopac i sâc moc, â ʒika kiekopac i sâc moc, â sipirickezo eekopac i sâc moc.
Judaŋic jaŋe dameŋ memoc repazi 39 numbiŋ,
dameŋ jahec â moc kâcbiŋzi nukicne, moc i qânâzi hehâmocnumbiŋ, dameŋ jahec â moc woke hericke fâuc eme hâwecko hurâ hu epo, ŋafe ʒoaŋ moc woke sâqoreme hâwecko qac qâsoriehuc jupo.
Erâ sopâc kâte hârâc tiki fotâcne qâqâwiric bazu bâfeŋ ehuc jupo, opâ rumio ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio fehuc jupo, râsi ŋondeŋko ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio fepo, Judaŋic ŋondeŋko ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio fepo, qâpuc ŋondeŋko ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio fepo, ŋic jujuo ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio fepo, tuhuo ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio fepo, hâwecko ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio fepo, mitiŋic burecne jaŋere ŋondeŋko ʒârâ ʒâpâ faio fepo.
Iŋuczi iŋuc ehuc hume serereŋ â huacbuc qâbucne juwarepo, ehuc ŋafeo guŋɋâri juju, nânâ opâre hâhâmo, hoe mâmâteŋte ɋarac ɋarac qaqa, ŋaqi bilaŋke babasa, iŋuc ehuc juekopac.
Erâ i sawa mâcne, ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne kiŋaŋ fisihuc fâro âkefec enarepie hae sâc kikefuŋ jaŋere mana mezac ehuc juekopac.
Wemocko hae moczi qau bititicne juhapie âke uruerâ sâcne jupemu? Wemocko hae moczi qâsoriehapie sâcne ŋemâteŋkepemu?
Eme no irec wemo‐nane musokapemu? Gegec dodoc‐nane mocjaha musokape sâckeocmu.
Wofuŋ Jesu ere Anutu â Mamac, e mumuteŋ hatizi dâŋ jâmbomac mukopac i manakac.
Damasko haeo juhape ŋicwofuŋ Areta ere kiazi kâpâcwâru bacnuocte hae upeo somâ râewec.
Eme irec âgofâc‐nane jaŋe kâdocko ŋihecnurâ sacrâpeo âke suecnupie hurâ wisepo.
Mumuteŋ dâŋ mupene mi sâckeekac, erâ sifu mupe. Ehuc Wofuŋzi maŋko fuac â maŋbâwiŋ enarewec, irec dâŋ binaŋ epe.
No Kristore ŋic moc manakopac e wiac moc honerâ jukuhame jara 14 ekac. Ŋic e hâcne Wofuŋzi maŋbâwiŋ ecneme sambâŋ namba 3 ira fewec. I sahachec me sahac tâmiric ewec, i no mi manakopac, Anutuzia manakac.
Eme ŋic e Wofuŋzi maŋbâwiŋ ecneme paradisio hâcne ferâ dâŋ miczi mi mumune â mâreŋŋiczi mi mumufuane i manawec.
No ŋic e manakopac, â sahachec juhuc me sahac hetarahuc ewec, i no mi manakopac, Anutuzia manakac.
Ŋic ere erâ mumuteŋ dâŋ mupemu, nahacnere mi mupemu, ine muzo murâ gegec dodoc‐nane sawa musokapemu.
Mumuteŋ dâŋ mupe muzac, i jâmbomac dâŋ muzapore ŋic mutucne mi ezapo. Erâ nore manapie fefene boc ezacte ine mi epemu, wiac mupe bape ŋaŋac hone manac eeŋgopieŋ izia fozejec.
Wofuŋzi wiac ʒâŋe hazec furu nowatuwec, irec maŋnane fezacte sahac biuc‐naneo ʒârâ moc duckewec, i Sataŋte kiŋaŋŋic moc e maŋnanezi boc fezacte mehuhuŋzi hecnuhuc juocte mukicne.
Eme behecnuocte Wofuŋ wâsickekuhape jahec â moc ewec.
Eme dâŋ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Jauŋ‐nanezi sâcguekac â tâpiri‐nanezi dodoc rorokacko fua ɋârâŋkeekac.” Irec Kristore tâpirizi norao mâckeocte dodoc rorokac‐nanere manape feha mumbiaŋkezepac.
Eme Kristore erâ dodoc rorokac epemu me ʒika kipemu, me hume serereŋ jupemu, me fific guguriŋ â imaŋ gomaŋ faio jupemu, i sifu bubiaŋ manaekopac. No dodoc rorokacko sanaŋkeekopac hâcne.
Ʒi mutucdâŋ mupac, i ŋoŋe enarepie mupac. Ŋaŋac mumbiaŋnupie sâckezac. No jawa omane juekopac i manakopac, erâ aposolo fekicne jaŋere wahamicne juju ine mi juekopac.
No ŋoŋerao gie maŋuruc jaha bape mâsi â wiac ʒâŋe furu â wiac tâpirihec fuahuc izi aposolo fuŋne‐nane bataniŋkewec.
Eme ŋoŋe wemo basahuc kikefuŋ gâcne jaŋere sâc mi embiŋ? Mâc wiac ŋowac ro nâc ee i mocjaha mi eŋarepo. Hehesic‐nane i mi mana sâqore‐narenʒepieŋ.
No jajahec iqic‐ŋopapo, eme ʒi mocwâc fâpere ʒawiehuc jukopac. Fârâ mârâc epo ijaha ehuc sahacte dopere mi bâʒâic‐ŋopapemu. No moneŋ mafa‐ŋeŋicte mâcne, ŋaŋacnere harac eekopac. Naru moteczi neŋgoc mamac wiac hure‐jareniŋte mi mukicne, neŋgoc mamaczi naru motec hure‐jareniŋmu ine sâckeocmu.
No ine maŋ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋic biaŋkeocte moneŋ mafa sawa mâcne, juju‐nane wâc qaisockezo afeckekopac. Nore maŋzi ŋoŋere kâcɋene domaha ŋoŋerezi nore piticne domaoc me?
Ŋic gâcnezi nore ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: Wiac tâtâc nânâwoc ro i mi ewec. Â soŋsoŋko ŋic eatuc‐jopahuc wiac jojowac ro i ewec mecne.
Irec ŋoŋe muniŋ, no ŋicfâc‐nane ŋoŋerao sorec‐jopahuc ejarepe wiac moc ŋowac rombiŋ me?
Erâ Tito fâocte mucnepo ehuc opâ ruac moc sorepe jojowac erâ fâpic. Eme Titozi fârâ wiac moc ŋowac rowec me? Nâhe Mâro wirec â hata wirec mi jukoperec me?
Dâŋ mueŋgopeneŋ i esecne mana warepie sahac ŋeŋezic dâŋ eekac me? Erâ iŋuc mâcne, nâŋe Kristohec juhuc Anuture maio dâŋ mueŋgopeneŋ, erâ âgofâc, irec me irec mâcne, ŋoŋe âkesiŋ‐ŋopanaŋte dâŋ mueŋgopeneŋ.
No ŋoŋerao fârâ honec‐ŋopape mi sâckezacte, â ŋoŋe nore iŋuc jaha manapie mi sâckezacte manabâc ekopac. Ŋoŋerao kisâ, iiŋguuŋ, kimbeŋ, hehefaric, micko âkec, gupe, penaroŋ, hesi qâsifuc, wiac i fohame fâ bâfuazipore maŋbahacnukac.
Ŋoŋeraonec gâcnezi maŋwânâŋ, boe sau, nânâ qowi âmbâŋ nânâ, i ehuc maŋjeŋic mi bârisieeŋgopieŋ, eme iŋuc juhapie ŋoŋerao fâpe Anutu‐nanezi bawahacnume ŋic iŋucne jaŋere ki busâqoc ezipore mana mezac ekopac.
Ʒi ŋoŋerao mocwâc fâpe jahec â moc eocmu. Fâ fisipe ŋic jajahec me jahec â moczi mocte bahacte fuŋne mupie dâŋticne munaŋmu.
Ŋic bahachec â gâcne ŋoŋe mâmâc arecne 2 fâpo ira uŋ ŋazapo ijaha wiwicko juhuc mukopac, ʒi ʒâhec mocwâc fârâ mi akic‐ŋopapemu.
Nore maŋko dâŋ râeme muekopac Kristo hâcne, ere tâpiri fuame honezo mueŋgopieŋte honenʒepieŋ. Kristo e ŋoŋerao gie‐ticne rorokacne mâcne, tâpirihec baekac.
Mârâc jâmbomac rokaweme maripoŋko qambiŋ, ʒi ine Anuture tâpirihec faharewec jukac. Nâŋe iŋuc jaha ere erâ rokaweeŋgopeneŋ, irec ere erâ wâc Anuture tâpirio ŋesiŋnehuc jujure fuŋne ŋoŋerao bajaŋgeŋkenaŋmu.
Ŋoŋe mamanasiŋhec jueŋgopieŋ me mâcne, irec maŋŋeŋic esâicke honehuc fuŋne bataniŋkenʒepieŋ. Me Jesu Kristozi maŋŋeŋicko juekac irec fârine basaeŋgopieŋ? Iŋuc eeŋgopieŋko sahaczi mitiŋic muŋarezo.
Nâŋe ine sahaczi mitiŋic mi jueŋgopeneŋ, iŋuc hone tarac‐nâponiŋte worickekopac.
Anutuzi soŋaŋ‐ŋopame bahac mi bâfuaniŋte numucnehuc jueŋgopeneŋ. Nâŋe honec‐nâpopie mitiŋic fârine enaŋmu me mâcne, irec mi mueŋgopeneŋ, ŋoŋe mitidâŋ reŋkepie fârinehec eocte mocjaha mueŋgopeneŋ.
Nâŋe iŋucnezi wemocko dâŋfâri râsi ecnenaŋmu, âgo ecnenaŋmu sawa fokac.
Nâŋe tâpiri basahuc juhapene ŋoŋe tâpirihec juniŋmu i bunâŋec biaŋkeocmu. Erâ maŋŋeŋiczi soka sanaŋ eocte Wofuŋ numucneeŋgopeneŋ.
No ŋoŋerao fârâ ʒâire‐ŋarezipore qanaŋ ʒoricko juhuc uŋdâŋ qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac. Wofuŋzi tâpiri narewec, izi imac‐ŋopapemurâ mâcne, hume keteŋ eŋarepemurâ narewec.
Erâ dâŋ mutarahuc kecʒiŋuc mupe: Ŋoŋe bubiaŋko junʒepieŋ, erâ uŋsawaŋ dâŋ manarâ maŋŋeŋic ba emasaŋ enʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe maŋ mocjaha efârerâ wamao junʒepieŋ. Eme Anutu e maŋjauŋ â wama runezi ŋoŋehec juocmu.
Ŋoŋe mitio meo babac efârenʒepieŋ. Ʒirec mitiŋiczi manasuc‐ŋopa‐fâreŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ Jesu Kristore aki anonoc â Anuture maŋjauŋ â Tiri Mârore miriŋ i ŋoŋerao fohuc juzejec.
Paulo no aposolo, ŋiczi mi sorecnumbiŋ â ŋic moczi gie wâc mi munarewec, Jesu Kristo â Anutu Mamac e hâmockonec bâɋâreweczi gie i munarewec.
No â âgo gâcne nohec juŋgopieŋ nâŋe kikefuŋ Galatia mâreŋko juraŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe papia ʒi râe‐ŋareŋgopeneŋ.
Anutu Mamac â Wofuŋ‐ŋâŋec Jesu Kristo eraonec aki anonoc â wama ŋoŋerao fotâcnerâ fozejec.
Jesu e Mamac‐nâŋec Anutu ere micte juju sâqocne ʒi jueŋgopeneŋkonec bâhoc‐nâpoocte sindaŋ‐nâŋecte erâ sahac‐ticne qaisockewec.
Irec erao mumuteŋzi mumuteŋ fohuc juzejec. Jâmbomac.
Ŋoŋe Kristore aki anonocko râec‐ŋopahuc hefârec‐ŋopawec ehec jupie mi ʒoraha e râpeckehuc miti fuŋmoc irec hazec rârâe eŋgopieŋ, no irec wareckekopac.
Erâ Biŋebiaŋ fuŋmoc wena fokac? I aricne i. Mâc ŋic tucnezi maŋ bâsifuc eŋarehuc Kristore Biŋebiaŋ âke sipueŋgopieŋ, i sawa fokac.
Irec nâŋe wâc, me sambâŋkonec aŋelo moczi, Biŋebiaŋ ŋazakicne i âke sipuhuc moc ŋazanaŋmuo, iŋucnezi hârâcte biŋe ezejec.
Dâŋ mârâc mumbeŋ ijaha ʒi wâc mukopac: Moczi Biŋebiaŋ qazu‐ŋarekicne i âke sipuhuc moc ŋazaocmu e hârâcte biŋe ezejec.
Eme weniŋuc, dâŋ ʒi mukopac i ŋiczi honecnupie biaŋkeocte me Anutuzi honecnume biaŋkeocte mukopac? No ŋic dape‐jarehuc gie bazapo muzac, wemocko Kristore kiŋaŋ qaqa juzapo.
Âgofâc‐nane, no dâŋ ŋazape mananiŋ: Biŋebiaŋ ŋazapo i ŋickonec mâcne,
erâ wâc ŋiczi mi naza qazuc embiŋ, i Jesu Kristo e jahac mufua‐narewec.
No mârâc jaha Judaŋic jaŋere guruo juhuc wiac epo, i ŋoŋe manaeŋgopieŋ. No Anuture kikefuŋfâc jopa jâpec ejarehuc mâretec sipiric‐jopapo.
Ehuc kâcɋenefâc‐nâŋec jaŋere dâŋ mi wahazejec muhuc samac qamandiŋkerâ motec âgofâc‐nane siric‐jopapo.
Eme Anutu e qanaŋ neŋgoc bumaŋko hone wosâecnurâ uruc jauŋ‐ticnere erâ hefârec‐nuweczi maname sâckeme
Ŋokâ‐ticnere biŋedâŋ qâpuc jaŋerao musawepere ere fuŋne bataniŋke‐narewec. Iŋuc enareme sahac biuchec jaŋe mu wioc mi ejarepo,
erâ wâc Jerusalem haeo mi ferâ aposolo fuŋkerâ juwarembiŋ jaŋe mi iqic‐jopapo. Aricne, no Arabia mâreŋko ra juku Damasko haeo risiepo.
Juhape jara 3 tarame Kefa honepemurâ Jerusalem haeo ferâ ʒoaŋ gie bapa 15 ehec jupo.
Aposolo gâcne mi honec‐jopapo, Wofuŋ ɋaticne Jakobo e sawa honepo wâc.
Dâŋ qâreŋkekopac i Anuture maio jâmbomac muhuc qâreŋkekopac.
Iŋuc erâ Siria â Kilikia mâreŋko ra jupo.
Â Judaia mâreŋko Kristore kikefuŋ jaŋe ine mi honecnumbiŋ.
Jaŋe nore biŋedâŋ ʒiŋuc sawa manambiŋ: “Nâpo jâpec enârehuc miti ima qaocte muweczi ŋic miti i hâcne jazahuc juekac.”
Iŋuc muhuc nore erâ Anutu muteŋkembiŋ.
Ehame jara 14 tarame Jerusalem haeo mocwâc fepemurâ Banaba â Tito rocjofape mâmâc fembeŋ.
Erâ i mâc mi epo, Wofuŋzi dâŋ mufua‐narehuc bufahac qanareme fepo. Ferâ qâpuc jaŋerao Biŋebiaŋ musaweekopac i mutaniŋke‐jarepo. Micne ʒâŋe biŋehec jaŋe bucko wâc ejarekicne, jaŋe hâcne manapie mi sâckeme gie maŋgâŋ bawefuhuc jupo iŋuc ezacte.
Jupe juju‐nane Tito e Grikŋizi opâ ruakicne juwec, eme e wâc sahacnao mahec eocte mi mucnembiŋ.
Eme nâŋere giemaŋko mitiŋic burecnezi raʒirâ, nâŋe Kristo Jesure erâ rambaŋ juhapene rucko honetâc‐nâporâ Mosere kiŋaŋ qaqa bacnâpozo mueŋgopieŋ,
ŋic izi hâcne bawahac‐nâpozo mupie nâŋe Biŋebiaŋzi ŋoŋerao bâbâsifucnehec ezacte moc mi docke‐jarembeŋ.
Eme ŋic micne jaŋe mârâc jaha iŋuc me iŋuc jumbiŋ, no irec manape hawarine moc mi eekac, Anutuzi iŋuc jaha sahackopec honec‐nâpome bârâwiŋ mi eekac. Ŋic micne jaŋe hâcne dâŋ furune mi ʒuhucke‐narembiŋ.
Aricne, ʒiŋuc ine manambiŋ: Anutuzi Petoro ŋic mahec jaŋerao Biŋebiaŋ muiŋneocte mucnewec, iŋuc jaha no ŋic ma tâmiric jaŋerao muiŋnepere munarewec.
Ehuc Petoro aposolo gie‐ticne baha bafickeme fârinehec ewec, iŋuc jaha no baficnume bape fârinehec jaha wâc ewec.
Eme Wofuŋ e gie tahacke‐narewec, i Jakobo, Kefa â Johane jaŋe Jesure kikefuŋ guru jaŋere jâcne jumbiŋzi mana tararâ no â Banaba âgo bacnâfohuc menâhecko bambiŋ, erâ nâhe qâpuc jaŋerao gie bahapere jaŋe jaŋac ŋic mahec jaŋerao baniŋte mumbiŋ.
Erâ hapetacfâc‐jeŋic ehâmo‐jarenaŋte irec sawa nazambiŋ. Eme no irec dâŋ hâcne ʒoɋac erâ muekopac.
Eme Kefazi Antiokia haeo warerâ wiac babahacnehec eme honerâ maiqanʒaŋ jaha âzâcnepo.
E qanaŋ qâpuczi opâ ruac jaŋehec nânâ wirec nâwec. Ehame Jakobore ŋicfâc fisipie honec‐joparâ mahec jaŋere hâwickeme qâpuckonec opâ ruac bâtâc bajarerâ hone takirec‐jopawec.
Erâ âkeac ehuc ra rowec ware rowec eme Judaŋic gâcne bafickepie Banaba jaŋerao ʒuhuckerâ sâc ijaha ewec.
Eme Biŋebiaŋte hata fâretiŋ mi âtepie honec‐joparâ ŋic gâcne jaŋere maio Kefa ʒiŋuc âzâcnepo: “Go Judaŋiczi Judaŋic nâŋâcne eebapao mâcne, qâpuc jaŋere eebapao eekic, izi wemocte qâpuc jaŋe Judaŋic nâŋâcne eebapao eniŋte muekic?”
Nâŋâc qâpuc kosa jujune jaŋe iŋucne mi fuambeŋ, Judaŋic fuambeŋ.
Erâ ine ʒiŋuc manaŋgopeneŋ: Ŋiczi sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkehuc kiŋfâsâc eene mi fokac. Eme Kristo e sâcmutâc dâŋ rereŋkere mâcne, mamanasiŋ‐nâŋecte erâ kiŋfâsâc bâcnâpoocte, nâŋâc wâc Jesu Kristo manasiŋkeeŋgopeneŋ. Sâcmutâc dâŋte gie bahuc moczi moc kiŋfâsâc eene mi fokac.
Eme Kristorao qohotahuc kiŋfâsâc ezo mueŋgopeneŋzi sifu sâqocne baeŋgopeneŋko weniŋuc muzo? I Kristozi sâqocnere qafeŋ‐nâpoekac me? Aricne, iŋuc mi fokac.
Â wiac duckepo i mocwâc heɋârepemu, ine jâmbomac qaqatara ŋic epemu.
Â sâcmutâc dâŋzi nume hâmocnepo i Anutu jucnepemurâ epo.
No Kristohec maripoŋko nukicne. Eme ʒi juekopac i no nahacne mâcne, Kristozi maŋnaneo juekac. Sahachec juju i juekopac, erâ Anutu Ŋokâ‐ticne manasiŋkehuc e sawa jucneekopac. Eki hâcne maŋjauŋ enarehuc juju‐ticne nore due bawec.
No Anutu aki anonoc‐ticne mi qâsuakopac. Sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkehuc kiŋfâsâc eene fozacko Kristo e maŋgâŋko hâmowec ezac.
O Galata ŋic mutucne! Ŋoŋe mozi maŋ bâsifuc eŋarewec? Jesu Kristo maripoŋko qakicne ere hawari ŋaza ŋowatuc epe ʒâŋe fâri‐ŋeŋiczi honembiŋ i!
Wiac mocjahare wio‐ŋarepe nazaniŋ: Mâro rombiŋ i weniŋuc ehuc rombiŋ? Sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkehuc rombiŋ, me miti manarâ mamanasiŋhec ehuc rombiŋ?
Maŋmutuc wemocte eŋgopieŋ? Mârore hata fuŋkerâ âtembiŋzi juju raŋɋare hatao raʒiŋgopieŋ me?
Wiac fekicne sâko i maŋgâŋ fua‐ŋarewec me? — jâmbomac fârimâc ewecko.
Mâro ŋarehuc wiac tâpirihec ŋoŋerao eekac, eki sâcmutâc dâŋ rereŋte me mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋicte eŋareekac me?
Abraham e iŋuc hâcne ecnekicne. E Anutu manasiŋkeme kiŋfâsâc mucnewec.
Irec ʒiŋuc mananiŋ: Mamanasiŋhec jaŋe Abrahamte ɋâricfâc fârine.
Ŋic qâpuc jaŋe Anutu manasiŋkepie kiŋfâsâc bacjopaocmu, irec hâcne mârâc jaha manasuhuc Abrahamte Biŋebiaŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc mume miti papiao qâreŋkembiŋ: “Qâpuc guru jaŋe gore jambuŋko raʒi‐fâreniŋmu.”
Irec hâcne, Abrahamzi mamanasiŋ hata âtewec ijaha âteniŋmuzi ere jambuŋko raʒiniŋmu.
Â sâcmutâc dâŋte giezi fosiŋ‐jeŋic eha juniŋmu jaŋe ine sâwechec eniŋmu. Ʒiŋuc hâcne qâreŋkekicne fokac: “Sâcmutâc birio dâŋ forakac i moc mi qâsuazo. Moc e qâsuaocmuzi sâwec hotâckeocmu.”
Sâcmutâc dâŋte maŋnao juhuc Anuturao kiŋfâsâc eene mi fokac, i dâŋ ʒizi mujaŋgeŋkekac: “Mamanasiŋte erâ biaŋkekicnezi juju hotâckeocmu.”
Sâcmutâc dâŋko ine mamanasiŋte moc mi mukicne. Ine ʒiŋuc mukicne: “Giene bafâreocmuzi juju hotâckeocmu.”
Dâŋqâreŋ moc ʒiŋuc fokac: “Ŋic jâcko ɋetic‐jopakicne jaŋe sâwecte biŋe.” Eme Kristo e nâŋâcnere iŋuc hâcne erâ sâwec hotâckewec, ehuc sâcmutâc dâŋte sâwec i bâsue‐nârewec.
Eme irec Jesu Kristore erâ Abrahamte jambuŋzi ŋicne ŋicne jaŋerao sâcne raocmu. Eme Mâro biŋe qânârekicne ine mamanasiŋhec erâ ronaŋmu.
Âgofâc, no wiac omanao sâc hehuc mupe: Ŋic moczi hâmohuc merâfâc‐ticne biŋe qajareocmu, i moczi qâsuarâ fainao dâŋ moc mi ʒuhuckeocmu.
Eme miti merâfâc i Abraham â ɋâric‐ticne biŋe qajactekicne hâcne. Ɋâricfâc‐ticne bocjaha jaŋere mi mukicne, mocjahare mukicne, Kristo hâcne.
No kecʒiŋucte mukopac: Anutuzi mârâc jaha miti merâfâc irec biŋedâŋ muwec, ehame ʒâhecko jara 430 tarame sâcmutâc dâŋ mufuawec, eme sâcmutâc dâŋ ʒâhec mufuakicne izi wemocko biŋedâŋ mârâc mukicne qame wahaocmu.
Miti merâfâc i sâcmutâc dâŋte erâ rorone eme muzac ine biŋedâŋte erâ rorone i arictac ezac. Anutuzi ine miti merâfâc i katucmâc‐ticnere erâ Abraham biŋe qacnewec.
Hâc, eme sâcmutâc dâŋ wemocte mukicne? I qaqatarare mufuakicne, erâ fofo sanaŋ foocte mâcne, Abrahamte ɋâric biŋedâŋ rune fuame rârieocte mukicne. Sâcmutâc dâŋ i aŋelo miczi mukicne â ŋicwirec ere meo râekicne.
Ŋicwirec moczi ŋic mocjahare mâcne, bocjaha jaŋere qâqâhâc domaocmu. Anutu eki ine mocjaha.
Eme sâcmutâc dâŋzi Anuture biŋedâŋ âkehockeocmu me? Iŋuc aricne. Sâcmutâc dâŋzi ŋicmaŋ mi heɋâreocmu. I eene eme muzac, ine jâmbomac sâcmutâc dâŋte erâ kiŋfâsâc ee i fuazac.
Ŋic mâmâc sasawa sâqocnere niŋgiŋko jueŋgopeneŋ, fuŋne‐nâŋec iŋuc hâcne miti papiao mufuakicne. Eme irec hâcne Jesu Kristo manasiŋkehuc mitihec erâ biŋedâŋte fârine ronaŋmu, i sawa fokac.
Judaŋic nâŋâc mârâc jaha mamanasiŋ tâmiric juhapene sâcmutâc dâŋzi kâpâcwâru bacnâpome nigiŋko fokuhapene mamanasiŋte biŋedâŋzi fua tâcnewec.
Eme irec sâcmutâc dâŋzi bâbâtiŋ‐nâŋec erâ Kristorao râec‐nâpowec, i mamanasiŋhec erâ kiŋfâsâc enaŋte iŋuc ekicne.
Nâŋâc mamanasiŋte hata fuame i âtepene bâbâtiŋte niŋgiŋ tâcnewec.
Eme ŋoŋe Kristo Jesu manasiŋkeŋgopieŋte ʒeŋgoma Anuture naru motecfâc embiŋ juŋgopieŋ.
Miti Opâ rua‐ŋarehuc Kristorao ʒuhuc‐ŋopakicne ŋoŋe mâmâc sasawa Kristozi ŋaqi‐ŋeŋic ehame hepie huwec.
Eme irec Judaŋic â Grikŋic, fekicne â wahakicne, ŋic â ŋokac, bârâwiŋ juju i tarame ŋoŋe mâmâc sasawa Kristo Jesurao sâc mocjaha embiŋ.
Ŋoŋe Kristore biŋe embiŋzi Abrahamte ɋâricfâc fârine juŋgopieŋ, erâ biŋedâŋte sâcko merâfâc‐ticne bajuniŋmu.
Moc ʒiŋuc mupe mananiŋ: Motec ɋiene moc e mamac hâmocnere merâfâc raucke‐bipiehuc sifu kiŋaŋ motec hawari juocmu.
Ehame wawa rau â âgo tofazi merâfâc qâzuckerâ bacne juhapie dameŋ mamaczi bawec i maickeocmu.
Nâŋâcne sâc ijaha fokac. Mârâc jaha maŋzi ɋiene juhuc mâreŋte wiac omanere kiŋaŋ qajumbeneŋ.
Eme ʒâhecko dameŋ bakicne i qosackeme Anutuzi Ŋokâ‐ticne soreme ŋokackonec fuawec â sâcmutâc dâŋte kiŋaŋ qawec.
Ine nâŋâc sâcmutâc dâŋte niŋgiŋkonec goroŋ‐nâpome Anuture naru motecfâc enaŋte iŋuc ewec.
Eme ŋoŋe naru motecfâc‐ticne eŋgopieŋte Anutuzi Ŋokâ‐ticnere Mâro maŋnâŋecko soreme hurâ ʒiŋuc wirâ wâwâsic eekac: “O Mamac biaŋ.”
Irec go kiŋaŋ qaqa‐ticne mâcne, motec‐ticne juekic. Erâ motec‐ticne juhuc Anutu katucmâc‐ticnere erâ merâfâc rune wâc juekic.
Ŋoŋe mârâc jaha Anuture kâuc bahuc nemu, Wofuŋ fârine mi jujune, jaŋe kiŋaŋ qajare jumbieŋ.
Eme ʒâhec Anutuzi hone ʒâŋitac eŋareme ŋoŋe e wâc hone tarambiŋ. Ehame wiac tâpiri tâmiric â fârimâc i wemocte mocwâc maickehuc kiŋaŋne qaŋgopieŋ?
Ehuc hombaŋ fuŋne fuŋnere manapie fârine eme ŋeeŋgopieŋ.
Gie‐nanezi ŋoŋerao fârimâc ezacte mana mezac boc eekopac.
Âgofâc‐nane, no numu‐ŋarehuc mupe: No ŋoŋere sâc epore ŋoŋe nore sâc enʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe ʒi juwarehuc wiac hehesicne moc mi enarembiŋ.
Ŋoŋe manaŋgopieŋ, no mârâcko huc ʒâic enarehame Biŋebiaŋ ŋazapo.
Eme sahac dodoc mâretec enareme ŋoŋe nore sifu tatakicne mi eŋarewec â mi mamakâc‐ŋopawec. Aricne, ŋoŋe honecnupie Anuture aŋelo tinac epo, opoŋ, Kristo Jesu tinac epe hefârecnumbiŋ.
Joi, dameŋ ira mu ʒeri embiŋ i weniŋucte omaekac? Ŋoŋe ʒâŋe hândâŋ‐ŋeŋic unuckerâ no nanarene fome muzac enʒapiŋ, i jâmbomac manahuc mukopac.
Eme dameŋ ʒiŋuczia dâŋ fârine ŋazape honecnupie râsi‐ŋeŋic ekopac me?
Ŋic gâcnezi ŋoŋere harac baeŋgopieŋ i âke râwiŋ‐nâpopie ŋoŋe jaŋere harac eniŋte manasuhuc eeŋgopieŋ. Ine hâcne sioc ehuc ŋoŋere harac baeŋgopieŋ.
Wiac biaŋnere erâ harac ee i biaŋne. Ine ŋoŋerao fârâ juhape sawa mâcne, dameŋ sâc epie biaŋkeocmu.
Naru motecfâc‐nane, no ŋoŋere erâ gozi kicnuha ʒâic manapo, ijaha harierâ manakopac, erâ Kristore hawari ŋoŋerao fua tâcneocte ʒâic i mana rahuc jupemu.
No ŋoŋere mana guruc boc ekopacte ŋoŋerao biac fârâ dâŋ mu hetikic ehuc ŋazazore enarekac.
Wio‐ŋarepe nazaniŋ, sâcmutâc dâŋte kiŋaŋ qazo mueŋgopieŋzi irec papia wose manac mi eeŋgopieŋ me?
Ira hâcne ʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne: Abrahamte ŋokâ jajahec fuapic, moc i kiŋaŋ naruzi rowec â moc i ŋonâŋzi rowec.
Eme kiŋaŋ naruzi rowec e omanao fuawec, â ŋonâŋzi rowec e Anuture biŋedâŋte sâcko fuawec.
Eme dâŋ irec ŋifecne ʒiŋuc fokac: Ŋokac jahe mitire ʒâʒâfic jajahec irec sâsâcne epic. Ʒâʒâfic moc Sinai tikio ekicne, ere kikefuŋzi ine kiŋaŋ qaqa embiŋ, eme irec sâsâcne Hagazi ewec.
Haga i Sinai tiki, Arabia mâreŋko ŋekac, irec ʒâŋe moc. Â Jerusalem hae i Sinai tikihec sâcjekic mocjaha ekopirec, ere kikefuŋ jaŋe kiŋaŋ qaqa jaha wâc eŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Â Jerusalem hae faic ŋekac izi Sara ere sâc, hae izi hâcne neŋgoc jâmbâŋ‐nâŋec ekac.
Dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “Ŋokac hufiŋne, motec mi roro go bubiaŋ manazemec, gozi mi kicguekac go ʒeri ehuc kiwaezemec. Ŋokac ŋichec e ɋâric afecne fuacnehapie me sawanezi naru motec bocjaha rocjopaocmu.”
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋe Isakare sâc erâ biŋedâŋte fuambiŋ.
Eme mârâc jaha motec omanao fuakicnezi Mârore dâŋte fuakicne e râsi ecnewec, sâc ijaha miŋecgac fokac.
Eme miti papiao dâŋ weniŋuc fokac? “Kiŋaŋ naru e ŋokâ‐ticnehec jâpec‐jofatec ranic, kiŋaŋ narure ŋokâzi ŋonâŋte ŋokâhec merâfâc mi rauckezejec.”
Âgofâc‐nane, nâŋâc kiŋaŋ narure ɋârifâc aricne, nâŋâc ŋonâŋte ɋâricfâc.
Niŋgiŋ tâmiric junaŋte Kristozi goroŋ‐nâpowec. Irec gâcnezi niŋgiŋko râec‐ŋoparâ kiŋaŋ qaqa eniŋte muŋarepie qikiŋnenʒepieŋ.
No Paulozi ŋazape mananiŋ, ŋoŋe sahac‐ŋeŋicko ma bapie Kristozi ŋoŋerao wiac omane tinac eocmu.
Mocwâc harierâ ŋaza‐jâmbâŋkepe, moc e sahac‐ticnao ma baocmuzi sâcmutâc dâŋ gâcne sâko mâmâc hâpo‐fâreme sâckeocmu.
Sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkehuc kiŋfâsâc ezo mueŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe Kristohec ʒâʒâfic embiŋ i tâcnekac â aki anonoczi ŋoŋerao fârimâc ekac.
Nâŋe ine Mârorao ŋesiŋnehuc mamanasiŋte erâ kiŋfâsâc ee bâfuanaŋte irec mamanac jueŋgopeneŋ.
Kristo Jesurao fisirâ mahec juju â ma tâmiric juju irec mâmâc jaha fârimâc muzo, mamanasiŋte qâreŋ maŋko fuame irec mocjaha fârine muzo.
Ŋoŋe mitire hata sâcne fuŋkerâ âtembiŋ. Âtehapie mozi aka heŋareme dâŋ fâri qizecne râpeckeŋgopieŋ?
Hefârec‐ŋopawec eki irec esoc qafeŋ mi eŋarekac.
Qowi hâhâtâcne pitic siŋgaŋ gaucnezi nânâ sicko hurâ mâmâc sâcke‐fâreocmu.
Erâ ŋoŋe nore dâŋ mi qikiŋneniŋmu, i Wofuŋte erâ manabâc tâmiric mukopac. Â ŋic izi me izi maŋ bâsifuc eŋareocmu, e kiŋ irec okacne fisicneocmu.
Âgofâc, no ine mahec eniŋte ŋic jazazapo muzac, wemocko fific guguriŋ moc enarenʒapiŋ? Iŋuc jazazapoo maripoŋte mamana gâpâre i mâmâc omaezac.
Maŋqaqa eŋareeŋgopieŋ ŋic iŋucnezi sahac‐jeŋic hetâc qâtâcnenʒapiŋ me!
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋe niŋgiŋ tâmiric juniŋte hefârec‐ŋopakicne, erâ niŋgiŋ tâmiric jujuzi âki eha sahacte dâŋ reŋkeniŋte mâcne, maŋjauŋko kiŋaŋ qaqac eniŋte irec hefârec‐ŋopakicne.
Irec hâcne sâcmutâc dâŋte qâqâhâc ʒiŋuc mukicne: “Gahacnere egareekac, sâc ijaha âgogere egarezejec.”
Ŋoŋe ine miczi nânâc ehuc kikic qaqac boc erâ oomaec enʒipiŋte uŋ ŋazakopac.
Erâ ine ʒiŋuc mukopac: Ŋoŋe Mârore tâpirio siŋkerâ junʒepieŋ, iŋuc ehuc maŋraŋɋare sasec gie mi baniŋmu.
Maŋraŋɋare aŋaczi hâcne Mâro kisueekac â Mârozi maŋraŋɋa kisueekac, eme jahe hâcne rârâsi epire ŋoŋe wiac ezo mueŋgopieŋ i sâcne mi afeckerâ eeŋgopieŋ.
Mârozi jowa baafec eŋareme ine sâcmutâc dâŋzi ŋicbomboŋ mi eŋareocmu.
Maŋraŋɋare gie i soŋsoŋko mi foekac, i ʒiŋuc fuaekac: Boe sau, mamakâc, nâ areŋ,
nemu araŋ babajare, hafec qaŋgec, rârâsi, sosopec, iiŋguuŋ, kimbeŋ, hehefaric, fâfâuc, rârâwiŋ,
mu kâroŋ, opâ momori me bec qowi âmbâŋ nânâ, erâ wiac gâcne. Wiac iŋucnere mârâc jaha ŋazapo erâ ʒi mocwâc ŋazape: Sâqocne i baniŋmuzi Anuture uucmaŋko mi raʒiniŋmu.
Mârore fârine ine kecʒiŋuc fuaekac: Maŋjauŋ, bubiaŋ, wama, bumâteŋ, buafec, buuruc, ââgo sanaŋ,
ruaine, maŋzi sowa juju. Mârore fârine hâcne irec aka mi fokac.
Kristo Jesure biŋe jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe juju raŋɋa‐jeŋic sasec â sâqocnere andachec i maripoŋko qapie omaewec.
Mârore tâpirire jueŋgopeneŋko Mârore hata jaha âtenʒepeneŋ.
Sahaczi fecko fec ehuc hehesuac mi enʒepeneŋ, erâ wâc iiŋguuŋ mi eec enʒepeneŋ.
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋic moczi dockerâ bahac bâfuame ŋoŋe Mâroheczi bumâteŋ erâ iŋucne mu bâtiŋ ecnenʒepieŋ. Ehuc go gahac eesâicko pârâckezicte rucge bazemec.
Wiac kihuhuŋ‐ŋopaekac i nowac gowacroŋ ehuc babaficko banʒepieŋ. Iŋuc ehuc Kristore sâcmutâc dâŋ sâcne reŋkeniŋmu.
Ŋic moc e wiac fârine moc mi ehuc e jahacnere maname fefene eocmu, iŋucnezi maŋticne fagac ecnekac muzo.
Irec moc e jahacne juju bapa hone ʒâŋitac ezejec. Eme ʒeridâŋ i e jahacnere erâ fuaocmu erâ fuaocmu, ŋic mocte erâ mâcne.
Giere ŋemâc kâdoc qakicne i ru sâc areckezo.
Miti ŋaza qazuc eeŋgopieŋ ŋic i jaŋe wiac fuŋne fuŋne boki bahuc jare gumec enʒepieŋ.
Anutu mu qâtimbuc ecnepie mâc foocmu, iŋuc moc mupie. I aricne jâmbâŋ, ŋic moc gie baocmu e irec fârine juku ijaha roocmu.
Moc e maŋraŋɋare gie baocmu, e juku maŋraŋɋa‐ticnere fârine sisipiric bâfuaocmu, â moc e Mârore gie baocmu, e juku Mârore fârine juju sanaŋ bâfuaocmu.
Wiac biaŋne i rorokac tâmiric enʒepeneŋ, eme mi betaŋkenaŋmuo juku dameŋ‐ticnao mâriri bâfuanaŋmu.
Irec dameŋ‐nâŋec fohame ŋic sasawa ehâmo‐jarenʒepeneŋ. Ehuc mitio âgofâc‐nâŋec wiac bafehuc ejarenʒepeneŋ.
Ŋoŋe qâreŋ sâko ʒi honeniŋ, no nahacne mezi qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe sahaczi miti hawari biaŋ erâ ŋoŋe sahacko mahec eniŋte fotarie‐ŋareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe Kristo maripoŋ‐ticnere erâ fific guguriŋ faio fenʒipiŋte iŋuc hâcne eeŋgopieŋ.
Sahacko mahec embiŋ ŋic i jaŋe jaŋac wâc sâcmutâc dâŋ mi reŋkeeŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe mâc ŋoŋe mahec erâ jaŋerao ʒuhuckepie sahac‐jeŋic muteŋkeniŋte manasueŋgopieŋ.
No ine wiac irec mi irec mâcne, Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo maripoŋ‐ticnere biŋedâŋ irec mocjaha mumuteŋ bajuekopac. Ere erâ mâreŋkonec wiaczi maripoŋko hâmo‐narewec, â no iŋuc jaha maripoŋko mâreŋkonec wiac hâmocnepo.
Sahacko mahec juju me ma tâmiric juju izi fârine aricne, juju ɋâricne izi mocjaha fârine ekac.
Gaŋ rukec ira hâcne domaeŋgopieŋ sâc ŋoŋerao wama â buuruc fotâcnerâ fozejec, erâ Anuture Israe ŋic jaŋerao mâmâc.
Ʒi moczi moc neneŋ gie mocwâc mi narezejec. No Wofuŋ Jesure râfu qâreŋ sahac‐naneo fome bajuekopac.
Âgofâc‐nane, Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristore aki anonoczi maŋŋeŋicko fozejec. Jâmbomac.
Paulo no Anuture micte Jesu Kristore aposolo epozi Efeso haeonec mitiŋic, Kristo Jesu manasiŋkeeŋgopieŋ hâcne, ŋoŋere papia ʒi râekopac.
Mamac‐nâŋec Anutu â Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo eraonec aki anonoc â wama ŋoŋerao fotâcnera fozejec.
Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere Anutu â Mamac, eki sambâŋkonec miti jambuŋ‐ticne fuŋne fune Kristore erâ nâre tahac ewecte mumbiaŋkenʒepeneŋ.
Eki mârâc jaha jâmbâŋ mâreŋte hobeteŋne mi fuahame mai‐ticnao maŋfuru â bahacmâc junate Kristore erâ mana wosâc enârewec.
E qanaŋ maname fowecte hâcne Jesu Kristore erâ maŋjauŋ enârehuc naru motecfâc‐ticne erâ junaŋte buafec‐ticnere mupaŋke‐nârewec.
E joroc Ŋokâ‐ticnere erâ aki anonoc biaŋ‐ticne tahac‐nâpowecte muteŋ bâteŋ ecnenʒepeneŋ.
Jesu e socticnezi kitâc‐nâpowecte sâqocne bâbâtâmire fua‐nârewec, i aki anonoc‐ticnere ʒâkâŋ fokac irec sâc hâcne.
Eme ʒâkâŋ‐ticnao maŋɋârâŋ â mamana fâri bâmâckehuc qoŋgiŋke‐nârewec.
Ehuc maŋbuc‐ticnere dâŋ, qanaŋ maname biaŋkeme ʒiŋuc âkendâŋnewec i mujaŋgeŋke‐nârewec:
“No guriŋne bahape dameŋ maŋkepo i qosackeme Kristozi wiac sasawa, sambâŋko mecne mâreŋko mecne, qâturehuc irec fuŋqizecne ezejec.”
Ere erâ, wiac sasawa maŋticnere mupaŋkerâ baekaczi mârâc jaha hone wosâec‐nâporâ miti merâfâc rauckenaŋte munârewec.
Eme irec Kristore mamanac jumbeŋ jueŋgopeneŋzi Anufu ʒâŋe rara‐ticnere mumuteŋfâc erâ junʒepeneŋ.
Eme ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha dâŋ fâri qizecne, bâbâpiaŋ‐ŋeŋicte Biŋebiaŋ hâcne, ro maŋ ehuc Kristo manasiŋkepie Tiri Mâro qanaŋ biŋe qanârekicne i ŋareme maqâreŋhec embiŋ.
Sambâŋko huhure biŋe‐nâŋec fokac, irec ʒâʒâficne Mâro nârekicne. Eme Anutu ʒâŋe rara‐ticnere mumuteŋ sâko fuaocte biŋefâc‐ticne nâŋâcnao Mârozi bâbâpiaŋ gie fuŋkewec i batarazokac.
Eme ŋoŋe Wofuŋ Jesu manasiŋkeeŋgopieŋ â mitiŋic âgofâc‐nâŋec maŋjauŋ ejareeŋgopieŋ, irec biŋedâŋ manapore
ŋoŋere dameŋ sâc manasuhuc Wofuŋ daŋge mumuteŋ ecneekopac.
Ehuc ŋoŋere ʒiŋuc numuekopac: Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo ere Anutu, eri tatamac Mamac hâcne, eki Mâro ŋareme izi maŋɋârâŋhec bacŋoparâ Wofuŋte fuŋne mufua‐ŋareme mana taranʒepieŋ.
Erâ maŋʒâŋe‐ŋeŋic bâtâcneme ine Wofuŋzi rocŋopahuc sambâŋ ʒeŋaŋ biŋe qaŋarewec, ire manapie fârine ezejec, â fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne ŋoŋe huhure ʒâŋe rara biaŋ kadahe ŋarewec, irec wâc manapie fârine ezejec,
â mamanasiŋhec nâŋâcnao tâpiri soka makakicne i teqâ saki‐ticnezi gie baekac sâc bâfuawec, irec iŋuc jaha manapie fârine ezejec.
Tâpiri irec fuŋne Kristo hâmockonec bâɋârerâ sambâŋko mefâre‐ticnao râehuc bataniŋkewec.
Ehuc kia gawaman â ŋicwofuŋ â fekicne fuŋne fuŋne jaŋere femicne sâko râewecte mâreŋko â sambâŋko ʒâŋe biŋe fokac izi gâkowakac, dameŋ ʒiŋucziare sawa mâcne, iŋuc fohuc juocmu sanaŋ.
Erâ wiac sasawa maŋfuŋnao heteckehuc kike‐ticnere rurumaŋko guruc‐jopahuc qizec‐jeŋic eocte âkendâŋnerâ kikefuŋ gurufâcne jaŋerao râewec.
Eme jaŋe me kikefâc‐ticne ehapie ŋihe umbiŋ ejarehuc fofotâc juhuc wiac sasawa sâcke raekac.
Ŋoŋe mârâc jaha sindaŋ hârindaŋ ehuc hâmocne jujumbieŋ.
Ine mâreŋte juju hata maŋnao juhuc saware tâpiri irec ŋicbomboŋ erao qohota jumbieŋ. Ere mârozi hâcne dameŋ ʒiŋuczia wâc qaqatara ŋic jaŋerao gie baekac.
Nâŋâc mârâc jaha jaŋere sâc jaha jufârehuc maŋraŋɋa‐nâŋecte aŋac bâjâpembeŋ. Ehuc sahac‐nâŋecte â maŋ mamanasu‐nâŋecte dâŋ reŋkehuc gâcne jaŋe iŋucne kimbeŋte biŋefâc embeŋ.
Anutu eki buuruc‐ticne bocjaha fokacte maŋjauŋ kâcɋene enârehuc
qaqatara‐nâŋecte erâ hâmokicne nâŋâc Kristohec mâmâc bâɋârec‐nâpowec. Manaŋgopieŋ, katucmâc‐ticnere erâ bâpiaŋ‐ŋopawec ŋoŋe,
E Kristo Jesuhec bâɋârec‐nâporâ ehec mâmâc sambâŋte jujuo râec‐nâpowec hâcne.
I nacnere mocko ʒiŋuc fuaocte ewec: Aki anonoc‐ticnere rowaŋ sâko i Kristo Jesuo maŋuruc qanârehuc qaratie‐nâreocmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, e aki anonoc eŋarehuc mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋicte erâ bâpiaŋ‐ŋopawec, i ŋaŋacnere mâcne, Anutu buafec‐ticnere iŋuc eŋarewec.
Mo gie mo bambiŋte iŋuc eŋarezac, i aricne. Irec sahac mumuteŋ moc mi fuazejec.
Nâŋâc Anuture metofafâc, eki Kristo Jesuo bâfuac‐nâpowec hâcne, erâ hata biaŋne Anutuzi hâcne muʒâwe‐nârewec i âtehuc junaŋte munârewec.
Ŋoŋe mârâc jaha qâpuc jujumbieŋ, irec manasuhuc junʒepieŋ. Eme dameŋ ira ma tâmiric juhapie Judaŋic jaŋe sahac‐jeŋicko maheczi ʒâgu muŋare jumbieŋ.
Dameŋ ira Kristo tâmiric jumbiŋ, erâ Israe ŋic jaŋe hae fâri juhapie ŋoŋe mafa jumbiŋ, â jaŋe fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne bacjopame biŋedâŋ‐ticne bajuhapie ŋoŋe ʒoŋifecfâc‐ticne erâ metariŋ jumbiŋ, erâ maŋzi wiac fârine moc mi worickehuc Anutu tâmiric hâcne jumbiŋ.
Dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ine ŋoŋe kâteo jumbiŋzi Kristo Jesurao ʒuhuckehuc Kristo socticnere erâ haeo fisimbiŋ jueŋgopieŋ.
E jahac wama‐nâŋec juekac. E ŋic jâcne jajahec ŋondeŋ‐jekicko rârâsizi aka sanaŋ fowec i qâropiehuc, mocjaha bacjofawec.
Ine sâcmutâc dâŋqâhâcko bâtâc â mumuac bocjaha mukicne i e jahacne sahac qaisockehuc bârâriewec. Ehuc ŋic jâcne jajahec jahere dodoma tacko ŋic ɋâricne mocjaha ine e jahac fuarâ domahuc wama bâfuawec.
E maripoŋlo hâmowecko ŋic jâcne jajahec fâri ombâŋ mocjahao qâturec‐nâpohuc Anutuhec miriŋ bacnâpowec, ehuc rârâsi qame wahawec.
Erâ fisirâ kâteo jukicne ŋoŋe â haeo jukicne nâŋe mâmâc wamare biŋedâŋ nâzâme manambeŋ.
Erâ wâc hata bâʒâwe‐nârewecte nâŋâc Mâro mocjaha rauckerâ Mamactao fisieŋgopeneŋ.
Eme irec dameŋ ʒiŋuczia mafa â jaba mocwâc mi jueŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋe mitiŋic gâcne jaŋehec hae fâri â Anuture kikefuŋfâc embiŋ juŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe aposolo â porofete jaŋe wâtuŋ ŋokacne ehuc decŋopapie doma raŋgopieŋ, â Jesu Kristozi wâtuŋ ŋicne ekac.
Erao ŋicne ŋicne ʒuhucke itic epene Wofuŋte furu ufuŋ fua feekac.
Mârozi ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha erao râe ʒuhuc eŋareme Anuture fic eŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Eme Paulo no irec hâcne qâpuc ŋoŋere erâ Kristo Jesure kâpâcwâru ŋic epo jukopac.
Ŋoŋe nore manambiŋ, Anutuzi uruc jauŋ‐ticnere erâ ŋoŋerao miti gie bapemurâ munarewec.
Munarehuc dâŋ soŋne mufua‐narewec, dâŋ i hâcne biac bembeŋne qâreŋkepac,
ŋoŋe i wosehuc, no Kristore dâŋ soŋne maŋzi hone raruŋkekopac iŋuc sâcne mananiŋmu.
Dâŋ soŋne i mârâc jaha ŋic juwarembiŋ jaŋerao mi mufuakicne, tiri aposolo â porofete nâŋerao ʒâhec Mârozi mufuawec.
Dâŋ soŋne kecʒiŋuc: Biŋebiaŋte fârine qâpuc ŋoŋe Judaŋic nâŋehec sâc mocjaha â guru mocjaha erâ Kristo Jesurao biŋedâŋ deŋkewec i mâmâc rauckerâ bajuniŋte mukicne.
Eme Biŋebiaŋ irec kiŋaŋ qaqa jupemurâ Anutuzi uruc jauŋ‐ticnere erâ tâpiri sâko‐ticnere fuŋne norao bataniŋkewec.
Kristorao mâriri sâko fofone fokac irec dâŋ soŋne qâpuc mutâniŋke‐jarepemurâ irec gie biaŋ mitiŋic wawahane jâmbâŋ no hâcne munarekicne.
Dâŋ soŋne muraruŋkepere mukicne, i Anutu bapafâre e maŋbuc‐ticnere dameŋne dameŋne baju warehuc juwec.
Ʒi ine Anutuzi kikefuŋ gurufâc‐ticne nâŋâcnao maŋɋârâŋ‐ticnere fârine qaratiekume qâreŋne fuŋne fuŋne fuame sambâŋko ira fekicne â tâpirihec jaŋe wâc hone ʒâŋitac eeŋgopieŋ.
Anutu e mârâc jaha dameŋ tâmiricko maŋnezi dâŋ mupaŋkewec irec fârine hâcne Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Kristo Jesu sorehuc bâfuawec.
Eme eki hâcne hata bâʒâwe‐nâreme e manasiŋkehuc hâhâwic tâmiric Anutu maickeeŋgopeneŋ.
Irec ʒiŋuc ŋazape mananiŋ: No ŋoŋere erâ fific guguriŋ faio jupe irec maŋŋeŋic mi wahazejec, aricne, ŋoŋe irec manapie eri qoqonaŋ‐ŋeŋic ezejec.
Irec hâcne sambâŋko â mâreŋko ŋic guru sâc jueŋgopeneŋ
nâŋâcne Mamac fârine e dieŋzi hecnehuc ŋoŋere erâ numucnehuc ʒiŋuc muekopac:
Anutu e hahaŋnehec sâkozi Mâro ecneme tâpiri bâfua‐ŋareme maŋŋeŋiczi soka sanaŋ ezejec.
Eme Kristo manasiŋkepie maŋŋeŋicko ŋeŋe juju ezejec. Eme ere maŋjauŋko gâtâ barâ qiŋ herâ domanʒepieŋ.
Ehuc mitiŋic gâcne sasawa jaŋehec mâmâc mitire fuŋne botâŋne, hâŋne otecne, i afeckerâ mana taranʒepieŋ,
erâ wâc Kristore maŋjauŋ, ŋic mamana jâuru‐fâreekac, i sifu mana‐hâmonʒepieŋ. Ehame Anuturao maŋ mâriri fufusuc fokac izi bâfusec‐ŋopazejec.
Tâpiri‐ticnere fuŋne nâŋâcnao bataniŋkeekac Anutu hâcne, e wiac bapa‐ticnezi nunumu‐nâŋec â mamanasu‐nâŋec siricke‐fâreekacte
kikefuŋko â Kristo Jesurao mumuteŋ‐ticne mimiŋzi ɋâric ʒuhuckeme ʒuhuc fofehuc juzejec sanaŋ. Jâmbomac.
No Wofuŋte kâpâcwâru ŋiczi faŋ qaŋarehuc ŋazape: Wiac fekicnere hefârec‐ŋopakicne irec sâcko junʒepieŋ.
Ehuc maŋhuhuŋ â buuruc â bumâteŋ juhuc maŋjauŋko dedec ââsic enʒepieŋ.
Erâ Mâro e wamare muczi qâzuc‐ŋoparâ dâtâc‐ŋopawec, i qâtâcnenʒipiŋte ruc babac ehuc junʒepieŋ.
Fâri ombâŋzi mocjaha â Mârozi mocjaha erâ wâc sambâŋ ʒeŋaŋ mocjahare biŋe qaŋarehuc hefârec‐ŋopakicne.
Ine hâcne, Wofuŋzi mocjaha, mamanasiŋzi mocjaha, Miti Opâzi mocjaha.
Erâ Anutu e Mamac wirec‐nâŋec mocjaha, eki mâmâc sasawa qâhuc‐nâpokac erâ maŋnâŋec sâc tâpiri sicne‐nâreekac â mâŋnâŋec sâc ŋeŋe juju eekac.
Kristo e ŋicne ŋicne mitire kâdoc nârewec sâc bajueŋgopeneŋ.
Irec hâcne dâŋqâreŋ moc ʒiŋuc fokac: “E faic jâmbâŋ fehuc kâpâcwâru ŋic bacjopa rawec, e ŋic wiac tahac‐jopawec.”
“Faic fewec”, i mâc mi mukicne, mâreŋko juwic jâmbâŋ wahaweckonec risie fewec.
E wahaweczia risierâ sambâŋne sambâŋne fotâcnerâ fewec, i sambâŋ â mâreŋ fusucmârâ jufâreocte fewec hâcne.
Erâ ekizia wâc ŋic gâcne aposolo râec‐nâpowec, gâcne porofete, gâcne miti kiŋaŋ ŋic, gâcne lama guru jaŋere soŋaŋ â qaqazu,
i mitiŋic ŋokac baʒawiec‐jopapene kikefuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa gie bapie Kristore me kike fâri ombâŋ soka sanaŋ eocte ŋic iŋuc râec‐nâpowec.
Iŋuczi iŋuc gie bakupene mamanasiŋ‐nâŋec â Anutu Ŋokâ‐ticnere fuŋne mamana‐nâŋec i niniweme maŋ mocjaha enʒepeneŋ. Ehuc mitio sosoka‐nâŋecte sâc mukicne i Kristore rowaŋkonec tâpiri fârehuc fua sokac eku ŋic kâcɋene erâ bâfuanʒepeneŋ.
Nâŋâc ɋiene hati mi ee sanaŋkerâ juhapene eeatuc ŋic jaŋe sioc enârepie gibioc dâŋ â mumusifuc‐jeŋicte mâŋâŋzi ba bâsoriŋ â qac qârândiŋ moc mi enârezejec.
Aricne, nâŋâc dâŋfâri paŋʒâic bajupene maŋjauŋ‐nâŋeczi fua sawec ehame qizec‐nâŋec Kristo erao ʒuhucke sanaŋkenʒepeneŋ.
Erao ʒuhuckepene ruazi ŋeturec‐nâporâ bândeŋ‐nâpome ɋâɋâdoc erâ me sahac‐ticne eeŋgopeneŋ. Ehuc tofafâc‐ticne erâ tâpiri fonâreekac sâc gie bahuc maŋjauŋko soka ewec enaŋmu.
No Wofuŋte maio ŋaza‐jâmbâŋkepe: Ŋoŋe qâpuc, maŋ mamanasu‐jeŋic wiac jawanere foekac, jaŋere sâc mi junʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe maŋjeŋic dapâc ekicnere mutuc â maŋsanaŋ erâ Anuture juju râpeckembiŋ.
Eme maŋjeŋic ʒikeme nânâ qowire nâ areŋ ehuc sasec mamakâc fuŋne fuŋne takicmâc ebac eeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ine juju iŋucne juniŋte Kristore fuŋne mi qazu‐ŋarekicne.
Ŋoŋe fuŋne‐ticne qazu‐ŋarekicko Jesurao dâŋfâri kecʒiŋuc fokac i hâcne manambiŋ:
Qâpuc juju râpeckerâ maŋraŋɋa‐ŋeŋic burec ehuc sasecko sipirickeekac, i heunuckenʒepieŋ.
Erâ mâro manacnepie mamanasu‐ŋeŋic heɋârehame
maŋɋâri hepie huzejec. I hâcne Anuture hawari iŋucne tiŋne â furu jâmbâŋ bâfuakicne.
Irec ŋoŋe burec beherâ dâŋ jâmbomac sasawa nazaŋ gazaŋ enʒepieŋ, nâŋâc qoqomâ efâreŋgopeneŋte.
Kimbeŋko mi sâqorenʒepieŋ. Kimbeŋ aaric mi bajuhapie ʒoaŋ ŋeutuckezejec.
Erâ Sataŋ mi mana uruecnenʒepieŋ.
Fiuc rorozi fiuc qikiŋnerâ meticnezi gie ʒoɋac bahuc nânâ mafa bâfuarâ waha qaqane boki bajarezejec.
Dâŋ simbiŋne micŋeŋickonec mi wahazejec, dâŋ biaŋne sawa, ine dodopec eere hatane fuame mupie ŋic âgo bacjopazejec.
Anuture Tiri Mâro mi qaisockenʒepieŋ, e hâcne roroc‐nâpo dameŋko maqâreŋ‐ŋeŋic eocte tahac‐ŋopakicne.
Râsidâŋ, kimbeŋ aaric, mu ojowa, susurec, erâ wiac gâgâpâcne gâcne i ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko mi fuazejec.
Ŋoŋe ââgo erâ eehâmoc ehuc kiŋ bebehec enʒepieŋ, Anutu e iŋuc jaha Kristore erâ kiŋŋeŋic behewec.
Ŋoŋe joroc naru motecfâcne juŋgopieŋzi Anutu sâckehuc junʒepieŋ.
Erâ maŋjauŋhec junʒepieŋ. Kristo e iŋuc jaha maŋjauŋ enârehuc nâŋâcnere erâ sahac‐ticne qaisockerâ Anutu taha bâzi biaŋ ecnewec.
Boe sau, sasec mamakâc, buchâro, irec saŋuc wâc mitiŋic ŋoŋere ŋondeŋko mi fuazejec.
Dâŋ miminehec, mutucdâŋ, dâŋ simbiŋne, i epie sâqoreocmu. Daŋge mumuteŋ ine epie sâckeocmu.
Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc mana sanaŋkenʒepieŋ: Boe sau ŋic â sasec mamakâchec â buchâro, nemu qaŋgec ŋic hâcne, jaŋe Kristo â Anutu uucmaŋ‐ticnao ŋeŋe basaniŋmu.
Eatuc‐ŋopahuc siocdâŋ ŋazapie manapie fârine mi ezejec. Sâqocne iŋucnere hâcne Anuturaonec okacne qaqatara ŋic jaŋerao fuaocmu.
Irec ŋoŋe mi bafic‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe mârâc jaha dapâchec jujumbieŋ, ʒi ine Wofuŋtao fisirâ tatamachec embiŋ juŋgopieŋ. Irec tatamacte ɋâricfâc erâ irec hawari junʒepieŋ.
Tatamacte fârine fuaekac i maŋbiaŋhec juju â tiŋne juju â jâmbomac dâŋ mumu.
Wiac ezo murâ ine Wofuŋzi maname biaŋkeocmu me mâcne, i qanaŋ mana wosâerâ enʒepieŋ.
Gâcnezi dapâcte wiac jawane epie mi qâsuec‐jopanʒepieŋ, aricne. Ŋoŋe irec tapa qararuŋkehuc qatara‐jarenʒepieŋ.
Wiac soŋsoŋko eeŋgopieŋ i mu bâuac epene miminehec jaha eocmu.
Wiac iŋucne tapane qararuŋkepene tatamaczi âeckeme fuaocmu. Eme tâtâc fuakac wiac izi wâc tatamac bâfuaocmu.
Irec hâcne ʒiŋuc mukicne: “Guŋ foekiczi faharec, â hâmockonec ɋârec, eme Kristozi batamaecguocmu.”
Ŋoŋe juju bapa‐ŋeŋicte ruc bahuc junʒepieŋ. Erâ mutuc matacne mâcne, maŋ mamanasuhec junʒepieŋ.
Dameŋ ʒira sâqocnezi haŋ bawec fokacte dameŋ gâcne mi behehuc gie ʒoɋachec banʒepieŋ.
Maŋ tâmiric tinac mi junʒepieŋ, Wofuŋzi gie muŋareekac i hone ʒâŋitac enʒepieŋ.
Waiŋ opâ wiacte âmbâŋ mi enʒepieŋ, izi maŋ sisipiric gie. Mârore ine âmbâŋ enʒepieŋ.
Mârozi esoc‐ŋopaocmu sâc gae mânec hehuc maŋ nareŋ gareŋ enʒepieŋ. Â maŋŋeŋicko Wofuŋ gaezi â musizi mu ʒeri ecnenʒepieŋ.
Erâ Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristore erâ dameŋ sâc Anutu Mamac wiac fuŋne fuŋnere daŋge mumuteŋ ecnenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Kristo araŋ bacnehuc micrereŋ eec efârenʒepieŋ.
Ŋonâŋ ŋoŋe Wofuŋte rereŋfâc juŋgopieŋ iŋuc jaha ŋowefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere junʒepieŋ.
Ŋowezi ŋonâŋte qizec ekac hâcne, iŋuc jaha Kristozi kikefuŋte qizec ekac, ehuc me sahac‐ticnere bâbâpiaŋ wâc ekac.
Eme kikefuŋzi Kristore mic reŋkeekac, iŋuc jaha ŋonâŋ jaŋe ŋowefâc‐jeŋic jaŋere mic dameŋ sâc reŋkenʒepieŋ.
Ŋowe ŋoŋe ŋonâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic maŋjauŋ ejarenʒepieŋ. Kristo e iŋuc jaha kikefuŋ‐ticne maŋjauŋ ecnehuc ere due bawec.
Erâ kikiruhucne â sâfânehec â wâc wiac gâcnehec juzacte mitidâŋzi opâ umbiŋkeha ʒurehuc jambuŋkerâ
ericke bâpiaŋ ecnerâ e jahacne biŋe furu â bahacmâc juocte mucnewec.
Eme ŋowe jaŋe jaŋacne sahac jauŋ bacneeŋgopieŋ, sâc ijaha ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic bajarenʒepieŋ. Moc e ŋonâŋ‐ticne maŋjauŋ ecnehuc e jahacne sahac mâmâc ecneocmu.
Ŋic moczi moc sahac‐ticne râsi mi eecne, gume jauŋ ecnehuc jaha juekac, Kristozi kikefuŋ ecnehuc juekac iŋuc;
nâŋâc me sahac‐ticnere tofafâc juŋgopeneŋ hâcne.
“Irec hâcne ŋic moczi neŋgoc mamac jahec‐ticne behec‐jofarâ ŋonâŋ‐ticnerao qohotame jahe maŋ sahac mocjaha erâ junicmu.”
I dâŋ soŋne, qame hukicne. Ine Kristo â Kikefuŋ jahere muhuc mukopac.
Ŋoŋe ine ŋic sasawa sahac‐ŋeŋic jauŋ baeŋgopieŋ sâc ijaha ŋonâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic jauŋ bacjopanʒepieŋ. Â ŋokac ine ŋowefâc‐ŋeŋic araŋ bajarenʒepieŋ.
Naru motec ŋoŋe Wofuŋte erâ neŋgoc mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere dâŋ reŋkenʒepieŋ. Izi hata biaŋne.
“Go neŋgoc mamac jahecge sâsec‐jofazemec”, i sâcmutâc dâŋ fekicne, erâ biŋedâŋ‐ticne ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ mukicne:
“Iŋuc erâ mâreŋko dameŋ ʒora juhâc qâhâmocmu.”
Mamac ŋoŋe naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic aaric bâfuanʒipiŋte wiac kosa mi ejarenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe mitio jaza bâtiŋ â uŋ sawaŋ ejarehuc soŋaŋ‐jopahapie sokanʒepieŋ.
Kiŋaŋ qaqa ŋoŋe mâreŋ ŋicbomboŋfâc‐ŋeŋic araŋ bajarehuc, maŋŋeŋiczi qâzuc foha, Kristo ecneŋgopieŋ tinac, mana mezac ehuc micjeŋic reŋkenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋicbomboŋfâc‐ŋeŋic maizi qambaraŋ ejarepie honec‐ŋopapie biaŋkeocte mâcne, nâŋe Kristore kiŋaŋ qaqa, iŋuc muhuc Anutuzi hata muwec i maŋafec jaha âtenʒepieŋ.
Ŋic jaŋere manasuhuc aricne, Wofuŋte manasuhuc gie‐ŋeŋic tatakic tâmiric banʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe manaeŋgopieŋ, moc e kiŋaŋ qaqa me ŋicbomboŋ juhuc wiac biaŋne ehuc juocmu, e Wofuŋzi okacne sâc ijaha bazucneocmu.
Erâ ŋicbomboŋ ŋoŋe kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ŋeŋic iŋuc jaha ehâmo‐jarenʒepieŋ, ehuc mu imac mi ejarenʒepieŋ. Erâ ʒiŋuc mananʒepieŋ: Kiŋaŋ qaqa â ŋicbomboŋ ine sambâŋko Wofuŋ wirec‐ŋeŋic jukac, e ra rowec ware rowec mi focnekac.
Mutarahuc mupe: Wofuŋtao roweckepie tâpiri sâko‐ticnezi ŋoŋerao fotâcneme qaboc‐ŋeŋichec junʒepieŋ.
Erâ Anuturaonec sându maro ʒika wiac ro barâ juhapie Sataŋzi rucko râsi fisi‐ŋareme hâbi‐ŋeŋic rorâ jâpenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe manaŋgopieŋ, nâŋâc râsi sahac biuchec jaŋehec ʒika qaqa mi eeŋgopeneŋ, aricne, ŋicbomboŋ sâko â momori sanaŋ, dameŋ ʒi dapâc fokac irec guriŋ bapa, demoŋ sâqocne sambâŋ rurumaŋko jueŋgopieŋ, jaŋe râsi enâreeŋgopieŋ.
Irec Anuturaonec sându maro ʒika wiac ro bajuhuc ʒika dameŋko qiŋ herâ domahapie râsi jaŋe bâipiec‐ŋoparâ wisenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe kecʒiŋuc domanʒepieŋ: Dâŋ fâri qizecnezi umbika‐ŋeŋic eme jomanʒepieŋ, kiŋfâsâczi maruku‐ŋeŋic ene rufanʒepieŋ,
wamare Biŋebiaŋ baʒawiehuc badomanʒepieŋ, izi kikehuhu hepie hume âte sanaŋkeŋgopieŋ ezejec.
Erâ neŋgocne sâko ine mamanasiŋzi maro‐ŋeŋic eme dameŋ sâc he bâfeŋnerâ domahapie sâqocne runere ʒoc tepe moteczi kisowarierâ hâpozejec.
Erâ wâc aeŋdu ʒâŋene bâbâpiaŋ hepie huzejec, â Mâroraonec ʒika, Anuture dâŋ hâcne, i bajunʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ʒâfo sâc Mârore tâpirio Wofuŋ ʒuʒuhuc jaha numucnehuc wâsickenʒepieŋ, erâ qâoma mi ehuc rucjaric‐ŋeŋic banʒepieŋ, erâ hae sâc mitiŋic guru jaŋere nunumu gie banʒepieŋ wâc.
Erâ nore mâmâc numuhuc jupie Wofuŋzi micnane baafeckeme Biŋebiaŋ soŋsoŋ fowec i asa feferaŋko mutaniŋkezepac.
No irec biŋe mumu kâpâcwâruo foekopaczi hâhâwic tâmiric mutaniŋkepe sâckezejec.
Juju‐nanere fuŋne â gie baekopac i kâuc banʒipiŋte Tikikozi fârâ dâŋ binaŋ eŋare‐fâreocmu, e âgo biaŋ‐nâŋec â Wofuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa micrereŋhec.
Eki nâŋere dâŋ binaŋ eŋarehuc bubiaŋ qaŋareocte sorepe fakac hâcne.
Anutu Mamac â Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo eki âgofâc‐nane ŋoŋe wama bâfua‐ŋarehuc mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋic basanaŋkeme maŋjauŋhec junʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo erao qohota sanaŋkeeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋerao aki anonoczi fozejec.
Paulo â Timoteo, Jesu Kristore kiŋaŋ qaqa, nâhe Filipi haeonec Kristo Jesure mitiŋic ŋokac â soŋaŋ babafic ŋoŋere papia ʒi râekoperec.
Mamac‐nâŋec Anutu â Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo eraonec aki anonoc â wama ŋoŋerao fotâcnerâ fozejec.
No ŋoŋere manasuhuc sâc Anutu‐nane daŋge âzâcneekopac.
Ŋoŋe Biŋebiaŋ manahuc izia nâŋehec qâturerâ giene bawarehuc jumbiŋ,
eme irec numuekopac sâc mâmâc‐ŋeŋicte bubiaŋ manahuc Wofuŋ daŋge numumu ecneekopac.
Erâ ʒiŋuc manapaŋkekopac, gie biaŋ ŋoŋerao fuŋkeweczi baku bataraha Jesu Kristo fifisi dameŋ‐ticne maickezokac.
No ŋoŋe sasawa iŋuc mana‐ŋarekopac i fuŋne ʒiŋucte sâckekac: No ʒira kâpâcwâru ficko Biŋebiaŋte erâ dâŋgie bahuc feŋeŋ râecnepe ŋoŋe sasawa bificnuhuc ŋesiŋ ŋenareeŋgopieŋ; eme no irec hâcne maŋnanezi ʒâfic‐ŋopaekopac.
Jesu Kristozi maŋjauŋ enâreekac ira hesiŋnehuc no ŋoŋere erâ maŋhâhâŋ boc enareekac, i Anutuzi manaha jâmbomac mukopac.
Erâ maŋjauŋ‐ŋeŋiczi maŋ mamanasu â mamana wosâc‐ŋeŋic bâsoka raocte numuhuc juekopac.
Eme ŋoŋe wiac fâri wâmbuŋne hone ʒâŋitac erâ Kristo fifisi‐ticnere manasuhuc maŋtaniŋ â bahacmâc junʒepieŋ,
ehuc Jesu Kristozi hume keteŋ eŋareme mitire fârine mâririhec bâfuapie Anuture ʒeri mumuteŋ ezejec.
Âgofâc‐nane, kâuc banʒipiŋte ŋazape, no ʒira wiac fua‐narewec izi Biŋebiaŋ hatacke‐hâmoocte fuawec.
No Kristore erâ kâpâcwâru ŋic epo, dâŋ izi ʒira kia â momori â ŋic gâcne jaŋere hazecko hufârewec.
Eme kâpâcwâruo ŋehape ʒirecnec âgofâc‐nâŋec gâcne sâko jaŋe Wofuŋte manasuhuc afeckerâ Anuture dâŋ hâhâwic tâmiric mueŋgopieŋ.
Tucne Kristore miti i iiŋguuŋko â hehefaricko mueŋkopieŋ, â tucnezi ine buurucko mueŋgopieŋ.
I jaŋe mueŋgopieŋ ine no ʒira fohuc Biŋebiaŋ ŋezickeekopac irec maŋjauŋ enarehuc mueŋgopieŋ,
â gâcnezi ine sioc ehuc iiriacko Kristore ʒâŋe muromackeeŋgopieŋ, i kâpâcwâru‐nanere faio buʒâic bâfua‐nareniŋte eeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ iŋuc me iŋuc, miti qâtiŋ ehuc muniŋmu me jâmbomacko muniŋmu irec wemocte boc muzo, mâc Kristore dâŋzi haŋ baocmu izi fârine, eme i fuakacte bunane biaŋkekac.
Erâ ʒiŋuc muhuc bubiaŋ hati jupemu: Ŋoŋe nore erâ nunumu gie bapie Jesu Kristore Mârozi baficnume wiac kecʒizi bubiaŋ bâfua‐nareocmu.
Erâ mimi mi bâfuapemu, i manapaŋkepe ʒickeha maŋzi worickehuc jupemu. Ewarepo iŋuc erapemu, jujure me hâhâmore sahac‐nane maŋafec jaha Kristo qikiŋnecnepe izi mumuteŋ‐ticne ezejec.
Kristozi juju‐nane ekac â hâmoczi wiac fekicne bâfua‐nareocmu.
Me mâreŋko ʒuhuckerâ jupemu, ine giere fârine mocwâc bâfuapemu. Irec wenimoire afeckepe muhuc maŋguru ekopac.
No mocte â mocte mâmâc enarekac. Mâreŋ beherâ Kristo bâfuarâ ehec juju irec aŋacnukac, izi hâcne wiac fekicne.
Â ŋoŋe bekâ enʒipiŋte ine ŋoŋere erâ mâreŋko mocwâc ʒuhuckerâ jupe sâckeocmu.
Eme irec hâcne ʒiŋuc manapaŋkekopac: No mi hâhâmo ŋoŋehec jupemu, erâ bafic‐ŋopape mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋic ɋârâŋkeme bubiaŋhec junʒepieŋ.
Â ŋoŋerao mocwâc fârâ jupe nore erâ Jesu Kristo muteŋkeeŋgopieŋzi hati erâ muteŋkenʒepieŋ.
Mocjaha, ŋoŋe kikefuŋte maio Kristore furu Biŋebiaŋ irec sâcko junʒepieŋ. Erâ maŋ mocjaha ehuc ʒâʒâfic erâ keketeŋ domahuc Biŋebiaŋte juju gie bapie fârâ honec‐ŋopazepac, me taicko juhuc biŋe‐ŋeŋic manazepac.
Keketeŋ epie kisâfâc‐ŋeŋic hâhâwic heŋarepie hâbi‐ŋeŋic mi goroŋkezejec. Iŋuc epie Anutuzi jaŋe behec‐jopaocmu â ŋoŋe rocŋopaocmu irec fuŋne bataniŋkeocmu.
Anutuzi Kristo wiac ecneniŋte mana‐ŋarewec i manasiŋkeniŋte sawa mâcne, ere erâ ʒâic fâro faio juniŋte mâmâc mana‐ŋarewec.
Eme no mârâcko juju gie bape honecnumbiŋ â ʒiŋuczia bape biŋene manaeŋgopieŋ, juju gie ijaha ŋoŋe baeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋerao Kristore erâ sawaŋ qaqac me maŋjauŋko muketeŋ, me Mârohec ʒâʒâfic, me miriŋ â buuruc, wiac i sasawa fokacko
bubiaŋ‐nane ferâ foocte mamanasu‐ŋeŋic qâturenʒepieŋ, erâ maŋzi ʒâʒâfic ehuc mocjaha efârerâ wiac irecteaŋ henʒiriŋnehuc junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe hehefaricko â sahac mumuteŋko wiac mi enʒepieŋ, moc e jahacne maŋ bawahahuc âgofâcne jaŋere maname fezejec.
Erâ moc e jahacne wiac embiaŋkeocte sawa mâcne, âgofâcne jaŋere fua biaŋ eocte mâmâc manasuzejec.
Kristo Jesure maŋ mamanasu fowec, iŋuc jaha ŋoŋerezi fozejec.
E Anutu juju jeweczi ine, Anuture sâcko juekopac weniŋuc behepemu, iŋuc muhuc mi sakarewec.
Aricne, e juju‐ticne hetararâ kiŋaŋ qaqa hawari rohuc ŋic iŋucne fuawec, â eebapa‐ticne honepie ŋic nâŋâcne sâc ewec.
E wahakicne erâ juhuc micrereŋte hata âte raku hâmoc maickewec, maripoŋko hâmoc hâcne.
Iŋuc ewecte Anutuzi bafehuc fekicne sâko âkendâŋnewec. Âkendâŋnerâ ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne fuŋmoc izi haŋ bahuc ŋic ʒâŋe biŋe getâcke‐fâreocte mucnewec.
Eme sambâŋko â mâreŋko â mâreŋ jujuwicnao jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma Jesure ʒâŋe muhuc dieŋzi hecnenʒepieŋ.
â micne mic sâc Jesu Kristo e Wofuŋ jukac iŋuc musereckenʒepieŋ. Eme mumuteŋ izi Anutu Mamacte biŋe ezejec.
Jorocfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe dameŋ sâc micrereŋ eeŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋehec juhape sawa mâcne, taicko juhape wâc ejâmbâŋkeeŋgopieŋ, irec bâbâpiaŋ‐ŋeŋicte fârine bâfuaniŋte mezac‐ŋopaha fotac qatarienʒepieŋ.
Anutu e jahac hâcne, honec‐ŋopame biaŋkeocte aafecke mecne fârine bâbâfua mecne irec tâpiri ŋareekac.
Ŋoŋe wiac sasawa kâroŋ â maŋguru tâmiric enʒepieŋ.
Erâ bahacmâc â maŋtaniŋ junʒepieŋ, ehuc ŋicguru bac bâŋoricne â qaqaharicne jaŋere dapâc ŋondeŋko Anuture naru motecfâc maŋɋaɋac erâ juhuc bâpiŋ iŋucne tamaenʒepieŋ.
Tamaehuc jujure dâŋ paŋnea bajunʒepieŋ. Iŋuc epie juku Kristo fifisi dameŋ‐ticnao, ʒâic mi mana‐bipiepo â gie mi bâipiepo, irec fuŋne taniŋkeme ʒeri bubiaŋ manazepac.
No mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋic Anutu taha bacnehuc sahac‐nane due bapemuo sifu irec ʒeri ehuc ŋoŋehec bubiaŋ manapemu.
Â ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha ʒeri ehuc nohec bubiaŋ mananʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ Jesuzi maname sâckeme Timoteo biac ŋoŋerao sorepe fâocte mukopac. Eme ŋoŋere dâŋ biŋe moc risie wareme manarâ bunane mâteŋkezejec.
Ŋic e iŋucne moc mi junareŋgopieŋ, eki jâmbomac ŋoŋere manoniehuc maŋticnezi dopec‐ŋopaocmu.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe jaŋacnere sawa manasuhuc Jesu Kristo gie‐ticnere mi mueŋgopieŋ.
Timoteo ine juju‐ticnere fuŋne manaeŋgopieŋ, ŋokâzi mamac‐ticne bafickeekac iŋuc jaha no Biŋebiaŋte giere baficnuekac.
Eme no nahacnao wiac iŋuc me iŋuc fuaocmu i mana‐hâmorâ e hâcne biac sorepe fâocmu.
Erâ Wofuŋzi mana‐nareme no nahac wâc mi ʒoraha ŋoŋerao fâpemu, iŋuc manakopac.
No wiac basahuc juhape ŋoŋe Epafodito sorepie ware dope hutuŋ enarewec, ehuc qomâ‐nane â babafic‐nane â momori âgo‐nane juekac, e sifu bârisie‐ŋarezo mukopac.
E huc bame biŋene manambiŋ, eme ere manabâc enʒipiŋte ŋoŋere maŋhâhâŋ ecnekac.
E huc ŋemâcne bame hâmozo ewec. Anutuzi ine ehâmocnewec, erâ e sawa mâcne, norao busâqoczi busâqoc fuazacte no mâmâc ehâmo‐narewec.
Ŋoŋe honerâ buŋeŋic biaŋkeocte â no iŋuc jaha manabâc tâmiric jupemurâ e mi sakarehuc ʒiŋuczia râepe fakac.
Irec fâme bubiaŋ manacnehuc Wofuŋte erâ âgo ecnenʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe ŋic iŋucne hâcne sâsac‐jopanʒepieŋ.
E Kristore giere erâ hâmozo ewec. Ŋoŋere okacne kiŋaŋ qanareocte sahac‐ticne qaisockewec.
Âgofâc‐nane, moc mupe. Wofuŋte erâ bubiaŋhec junʒepieŋ. Dâŋ hâsine ijaha qâreŋke‐ŋarezore manape mi quŋkekac, â ŋoŋe ine hume keteŋ eŋarezejec.
Ŋoŋe qâto jaŋere rucsoŋaŋ junʒepieŋ, miti gie bapa bâbâsifucne, sahac hehetâc ŋic jaŋere rucsoŋaŋ hâcne junʒepieŋ.
Anutu maŋzi kiŋaŋ qacneeŋgopeneŋ â Kristo Jesurao qohotaeŋgopeneŋ â mamanasiŋ‐nâŋec sahacko mi râeeŋgopeneŋ, nâŋâc hâcne ma fârine bajueŋgopeneŋ.
No nahac sahacko siŋkezo murâ sâcne ezapo. Ŋic gâcne jaŋe sahacko siŋkeeŋgopieŋ no ijaha ezo murâ siric‐jopazapo.
No fuarâ fohape ʒoaŋ 8 eme sahac‐naneo ma bambiŋ, no Israe ŋicguruonec, Benjamiŋte ɋâric, no Judaŋiczi Judaŋic jaŋeraonec fuakicne hâcne, sâcmutâc dâŋte neŋgocne farisaio ŋic jupo,
ʒoɋac‐nanere erâ kikefuŋ jaŋere râsi epo, sâcmutâc dâŋ sâcko tiŋne juju â bahacmâc jupo.
Eme no mârâc wiac bajuhuc manape fârine ewec, i ʒâhec ine Kristore erâ manape racne ewec.
No Wofuŋ‐nane Kristo Jesu ere fuŋne hone ʒâŋitâc erâ manape furi sâko eme wiac mârâc epo bapo irec jâmbomac manape racne eekac. No Kristo rauckepemurâ ere erâ wiac sasawa ho jawa muhuc qikiŋne‐fârepo.
No erao qohotahuc, sâcmutâc reŋkehuc kiŋfâsâc bâbâfua i mâcne, Kristo manasiŋkehuc kiŋfâsâc juju irec enareekac. Mamanasiŋhec jupe Anutuzi kiŋnanere maname tatara, irec mukopac.
Erâ no Kristo maŋzi hemiriŋkepe fafahare‐ticnere tâpiri norao fuame ʒâic manawecko ʒuhuckerâ ehec manazepac. Eku hâmoc‐ticnere hawari wâc bâfuazepac.
Iŋuc eerâ raku hâmockonec fafahare bâfuapere enareekac.
No nahacnere ʒiŋuc mi mukopac: Biac mao fisirâ eri bâfuapo. Mâc Kristo Jesuzi no rocnuwecte eri bâfuapemurâ hata gagasa i gasackeekopac.
Âgofâc‐nane, eri biac bâfuarâ ropo, i no nahacnere manape iŋuc mi ekac. Kecʒiŋuc ine eekopac: Wiac hetarapo i râpeckeekopac, â wiac mai‐naneo râekicne irec menane sicneekopac,
ehuc Anutuzi Jezu Kristore erâ sambâŋte hefârecnuhuc mao eri râe‐narewec, i bâfuapemurâ ʒâŋezi hone dendeŋnehuc gasackeekopac.
Soka tarakicne nâŋâc mâmâc sasawa wiac irecteaŋ hâcne henʒiriŋnehuc junʒepeneŋ. Eme wiac mocte manapie hatane moc ekacko Anutuzi maŋŋeŋic batamaeme mana taraniŋmu.
Mâc hata âte warembeŋ ijaha âte ranʒepeneŋ.
Âgofâc‐nane, banie‐ŋarepe honecnuhuc ijaha bâjâpecnunʒepieŋ. Â ŋic gâcne sâc ijaha juhuc bânie‐ŋareeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao wâc ʒâŋe fihuc junʒepieŋ.
Ŋic tucne jaŋere ŋaza warehuc jupo, ʒi ine ki busâqochec mocwâc ŋazape: Jaŋe Kristo maripoŋ‐ticne râsi ecneeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne sisipiric bâfuaniŋmu. Hobu‐jeŋiczi wofuŋ ejareekac, â wiac mimineheczi bubiaŋ qajareekac, â mâreŋkonec wiac maŋ mamanasu‐jeŋic rofâreekac.
Nâŋâc ine sambâŋ hae irec fârine, eme irecnec hâcne bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec, Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo, e waharâ rocnâpoocte woŋec jueŋgopeneŋ.
E ŋic â wiac sasawa bawahac‐joparâ jahacne rurumaŋko guruc‐jopaocte tâpiri focnekac, tâpiri izi sahac‐nâŋec waha qaqane bâtikieme e jahacne sahac iŋucne tatamac huririnehec eocmu.
Âgo biaŋfâc‐nane, maŋnane ŋoŋere boc ecneekac, ŋoŋe hâcne eri bubiaŋfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe Wofuŋtao qohota sanaŋkenʒepieŋ, jorocfâc‐mae.
Euodia â Sintike ŋokac jahec jahe Wofuŋte erâ maŋ mocjaha erâ juzepirec.
Â babafic fâri‐nane go ine ŋokac jahec hâcne hone maiŋ ejactezemec. Jahe mecne â Kelemento â âgo gâcne jaŋe Biŋebiaŋte giere dopecnumbiŋ. Ʒâŋe‐jeŋic juju sanaŋte papia qizecko fofârekac.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋte erâ ʒeri bubiaŋ manahuc junʒepieŋ, no harierâ mupe, ʒeri bubiaŋ mananʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋzi bâqiŋ‐nâpokacte ŋic sasawa wamane ejarenʒepieŋ.
Wiac irec me irec mana mezac mi ee maŋŋeŋicte dâŋ fuŋne fuŋne i Anutu daŋge nunumu ecnehuc mutaniŋkecnenʒepieŋ.
Eme Anuture wama e ŋic mamana sirickeekaczi maŋ mamanasu‐ŋeŋic qâzuckeme Kristore fosanaŋkeocmu.
Erâ âgofâc, dâŋ moc mupe: Wiac fârine â wiac araŋ bapanehec, wiac tiŋne â wiac ɋaɋacne, wiac hohone ʒiziwene â wiac mamana ʒiziwene, wiac eesaricne â wiac bubiaŋ bâbâfuane, wiac i sasaware henʒiriŋnehuc junʒepieŋ.
No wiac mu qazuc â ŋaza ŋowatuc epe hone manac embiŋ, ijaha ehuc jupie Anutu wama runezi ŋoŋehec juocmu.
Ŋoŋe ŋondeŋne moc mâc juwareku ʒi nore mocwâc manasurâ buafec‐ŋeŋicte ehâmo‐narembiŋ, irec manape Wofuŋtao qacneme bubiaŋ kâcɋene manakopac. Ŋoŋe nore mamanasu i manasumbiŋ, mâc wiac enareniŋte hata basarâ quŋkembiŋ.
No kâroŋ qaŋarehuc mi mukopac, no wiac i me i basarâ mâc juhuc manape mi sâqoreekac.
No qafec qawahac juju me fofo dunduŋ fonareha juju, iŋuc me iŋuc juzo murâ sâcne jupemu. Nâ gapehec juju â natac qatac juju, mâriri faio juju â roroc faio juju, irec fuŋne mâmâc manaekopac.
Tâpiri nareme sanaŋkeekopac, ere erâ jupe bape sâcke‐fâreekac.
Ŋoŋe ine busâqocko juhape ehâmo‐narembiŋte manape biaŋkekac.
Filipi haeonec ŋic ŋokac ŋoŋe manaŋgopieŋ, no Biŋebiaŋte gie fufuŋke dameŋko Makedonia mâreŋ behepoo kikefuŋ gâcnezi mâc juhapie ŋoŋe buc nohec nareŋ gareŋ embeŋ.
Erâ Tesalonike haeo juhape sahacte wiaczi dopecnuhuc jumbiŋ wâc.
No moneŋ mafare mi mukopac, mâc miti‐ŋeŋicte fârine fuaocte mukopac, eme fârine izi ŋoŋeraopec hamârekao hâcne.
Ʒi wiac bâfuacnu‐fârewec, bocjaha fonarekac. Epafoditozi ŋoŋeraonec wiac bafisi‐nareme mâririhec epo jukopac. Ŋoŋe no wiac enarembiŋ, irec manape Wofuŋ taha bâzi biaŋ âsu mumundoŋnehec ecnembiŋ ekac.
Anutu‐nane e mâriri bâbâfuazi Kristo Jesure erâ wiac hezu heŋareme hâmoc huriaŋ tâmiric juniŋmu.
Anutu Mamac‐nâŋec erao ine mumuteŋzi mumuteŋ foraʒihuc juzejec sanaŋ. Jâmbomac.
No Kristo Jesure erâ manasuc‐ŋopakopac, i mitiŋic ŋokac jaza‐fârenʒepieŋ. Â âgofâc‐nane nohec juŋgopieŋ jaŋe wâc manasuc‐ŋopaŋgopieŋ.
Mitiŋic sasawa â Sisare ŋicfâc jaŋe wâc boc manasuc‐ŋopaŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo ere aki anonoczi maŋ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋicko fofârezejec. Jâmbomac.
Paulo no Anuture micte Jesu Kristore aposolo epo, erâ âgo‐nâŋec Timoteo,
Nâhe Kolosai haeonec mitiŋic â âgofâc‐nâhec Kristorao qohotaŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe papia ʒi râe‐ŋarekoperec. Anutu Mamac‐nâŋec eraonec aki anonoc â wama ŋoŋerao fotâcnerâ fozejec.
Nâŋe Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere Mamac Anutu hâcne ŋoŋere erâ dameŋ sâc daŋge nunumu ecneeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋoŋe Kristo Jesu manasiŋkeeŋgopieŋ â mitiŋic hae gâcnaonec maŋjauŋ ejareeŋgopieŋ irec mecne,
â sambâŋ miti ʒeŋaŋ ŋoŋere biŋe râekicne irec mâmâc Anutu muteŋkeeŋgopeneŋ. Ŋoŋe miti ʒeŋaŋte kâuc mi baeŋgopieŋ. Dâŋ fâri qizecne Biŋebiaŋ hâcne ŋoŋerao fuawec irec biŋe mârâc manambiŋ.
Biŋebiaŋ i mâreŋ sâc fua bâbâriŋ rahuc fârinehec eekac. Eme Anutu akidâŋ‐ticne ŋoŋerao fâme jâmbomacko mana maŋ embiŋ, dameŋ ira ŋoŋerao iŋuc jaha fârinehec ewec.
Joroc âgo babafic‐nâŋec Epafara, Kristore kiŋaŋ qaqa micrereŋhec, eki qazu‐ŋareme manambiŋ hâcne.
Erâ ekizia wâc, Mârozi ŋoŋerao maŋjauŋ bâfuawec, irec dâŋ binaŋ enârewec.
Eme nâŋe dâŋ binaŋ‐ŋeŋic manarâ izia fuŋkerâ Anutuzi maŋ mamana‐ŋeŋic bâsokame micdâŋ‐ticnere â Mârore maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ mana taraniŋte numucne warehuc jueŋgopeneŋ.
Wofuŋzi iŋuc hâcne eŋareme juju‐ŋeŋiczi fuŋne‐ticne mutaniŋkeme honec‐ŋopame biaŋkezejec. Â mitio gie fuŋne fuŋne fokac, i bahuc irec fârine bâfuanʒepieŋ, ehuc Anuture fuŋne mana ɋârâŋke rahuc junʒepieŋ.
Erâ Anuture tâpiri mu wawarec‐ticnehec izi âkesiŋ‐ŋopame hâbi sâko hepie hume juhapie fai‐ŋeŋicko wiac ŋemâcne feme sâc docke pârâc tâmiric bumâteŋ jaha de domahuc bubiaŋ mananʒepieŋ.
Erâ Mamac‐nâŋec e faic tatamacko merâfâc‐ticne râe‐nârewec, i mitiŋic nâŋâc ru sâc enaŋte bâmoc‐nâpoekacte buafec jaha daŋge âzâcnenʒepeneŋ.
Anutu e dâpac runere tâpirionec batarac‐nâporâ joroc Ŋokâ‐ticnere uucmaŋko râec‐nâpowec.
Ŋokâ‐ticne eki hâcne sâqocne‐nâŋec tâmireote kiwiric‐nâŋec rowec.
Anutu soŋne ere hawari tâtâc fufua Ŋokâ‐ticne hâcne. E wiac sasawa mi fuahame micne barâ juweczi juwec.
Ere jujuo wiac sasawa sambâŋko â mâreŋko fua‐fârewec, wiac hohonene â mi hohonene, ŋic me aŋelo ɋuŋɋasaŋhec me tâpirihec, fekicne sâko me araŋ bapa‐jarene, i mâmâc sasawa ere tâpirio â ere biŋe fuakicne.
E wiac sasawa irec juwicnao juwec erâ wiac sasawa irec micne sâko, erâ wiac sasawa ere dope sisiŋko fowarehuc juekac.
