Erâ e me sahac‐ticne, kikefuŋ‐ticne hâcne, nâŋâcne qizec juekac. Erâ fufuŋke ŋic, hâmockonec micne barâ faharewec, ehuc wiac sasawa irec jâcne ewec.
Anutu e juju â tâpiri‐ticnere rowaŋ Ŋokârao guru fufusuc foocte maname sâckewec.
Erâ wiac sasawa sambâŋko â mareŋko Anutu jahacnehec miriŋ bacnâpoocte mucneme eki hâcne maripoŋko socticnezi wama bâfuahuc iŋuc ewec.
Ŋoŋe mârâc jaha Anutu râpeckerâ nâme nikecne erâ sâqocne fuŋne fuŋne bahuc maŋʒârâhec jujumbieŋ.
Eme Kristo sahac biuchec fuarâ hâmoc‐ticnezi miriŋ bacŋoparâ Anuture maio furu â maŋɋaɋac â bahac fâsâc juniŋte râec‐ŋopawec.
Eme irec ŋoŋe mamanasiŋko qiŋ herâ domahuc, Biŋebiaŋzi woworic bâfua‐ŋarewec i sifucke‐ŋarezacte biric borocne mi enʒepieŋ. Biŋebiaŋ i ŋoŋe qazu‐ŋarekicne, erâ ŋoŋe sawa mâcne, ŋicne ŋicne mâreŋ sâc jaza rakicne. Paulo no hâcne irec kiŋaŋŋic juekopac.
No ŋoŋere erâ ʒâic serereŋ faio juekopac irec ʒi manape biaŋkeekac. Kristozi me sahac‐ticne, kikefuŋ‐ticne hâcne, ere erâ ʒâic serereŋ manawec, ʒâic irec tofanao ʒuhuckehuc mamanane fokacte nore sahacko fehuc micne qazejec.
No Anutu dâŋbiri‐ticnere sâcko kikefuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa erâ ŋoŋerao micdâŋ‐ticnere qaqazu gie batarapemurâ munarekicne.
Dâŋ i dameŋne dameŋne soŋne fome mimiŋzi ɋâric mi mamana mâc juwefuhuc jumbiŋ, eme dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ine mitiŋicfâc‐ticne mufua‐nârekicne.
Erâ qâpuc jaŋerao dâŋ soŋnere mâriri biaŋ sâko fuakac i mitiŋicfâc‐ticne mutaniŋke‐nârekac. Kristo maŋŋeŋicko juekac e hâcne dâŋ soŋnere fârine â sambâŋ ʒeŋaŋ irec hozine.
Ere fuŋne mutaniŋkehuc ŋicne ŋicne uŋ sawaŋ ejarerâ maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ sasawa jaza qazuc eeŋgopeneŋ, i Kristoo ŋic fârine epie erao guruc‐jopanaŋte iŋuc eeŋgopeneŋ.
Ere tâpirizi eferenʒoŋnume gie i hâcne fotariehuc baekopac.
No ŋazape mananiŋ, ŋoŋe mecne â Laodikea haeonec â ŋic gâcne ʒâŋe mai‐nane mi honembiŋ, ŋoŋere ʒâic afecne mi manaekopac.
Ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋiczi âte tâcnerâ roroc efâreme Anutu dâŋsoŋ‐ticnere fuŋne, Kristo hâcne, mana maŋ ehuc mana utuckerâ mana taranʒepieŋ.
Erao hâcne maŋɋârâŋ â mamana tara irec ʒâkâŋne soŋkekicne fokac.
Moczi moc mu hemiriŋ eŋarehuc maŋ bâsifuc eŋarenʒipiŋte dâŋ i mukopac.
No sahac‐nanezi wiwicko juekopac, maŋnanezi ine ŋoŋehec juhuc ŋoŋe Kristo manasiŋkehuc ʒiʒimic erâ sosoŋaŋko domapie honec‐ŋoparâ bunane biaŋkekac.
Ŋoŋe Kristo Jesu Wofuŋ eŋareocte rombiŋ erao qohotahuc junʒepieŋ,
ehuc eraoa gâtâ barâ fua‐hâmonʒepieŋ, â mamanasiŋte hata ŋaza ŋowatuc ekicne ijaha âte sanaŋkerâ daŋge mumuteŋ ecnehuc jupie ferâ fe ehuc fozejec.
Moczi moc ŋickonec mamana dâŋ, eeatuc dâŋ racne hâcne, qazu‐ŋarehuc maŋŋeŋic bawisenʒipiŋte rucŋeŋic banʒepieŋ. Dâŋ iŋucne i mimiŋne jaŋere maŋko fuac dâŋ â mâreŋte wiac tâpirihec ira roweckehuc mueŋgopieŋ, Kristorao siŋkehuc mâcne.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Anuture sâc i Kristo maŋ sahac‐ticnao qaja fuserâ qâniniwerâ fokac.
Irec ŋoŋe erao wiac moc mi basaniŋmu, eki hâcne micne â fekicne sasawa jaŋere qizecne.
Eraonec maŋeŋic wâc rombiŋ, mezi sahacko ma bapa i mâcne, juju‐ŋeŋic raŋɋane heunuckehuc Kristore maqâreŋhec embiŋ hâcne.
Ihec eniŋte Miti Opâ rua‐ŋarehuc ere hâmocko ʒuhuc‐ŋopakicne, erâ Anutu e tâpiri‐ticnezi Kristo hâmockonec bâɋârewec, tâpiri ijaha manasiŋkepie ŋoŋerao fotâcneme fafahare‐ticnao wâc ʒuhuc‐ŋopakicne.
Ŋoŋe mârâc jaha ma tâmiric juhuc sâqocne kosa barâ hâmocne juhapie Anutu e kiŋŋeŋic behehuc Kristohec bâɋârec‐ŋopawec.
Erâ dâŋ qaqatara‐nâŋec qâreŋkekicne i âke sifuckehuc irec kiŋ papia i bâsuckerâ maripoŋko ɋetickeme arictâc ewec.
Iŋuc ehuc fekicne â tâpirihec hâbi‐jeŋic bâŋgoroŋkerâ saoreŋ qahuc fuŋne‐jeŋic bataniŋkewec.
Ŋic moczi nânâ qowi soware me sabata hombaŋ me mosa hombaŋ i me i ŋeŋere me mi ŋeŋere mu supaic mi eŋarezejec.
Wiac iŋucnere nâkumucne muzo, fârine ʒâhec fuaocte irec nâkumucnezi qanaŋ bâniewec. Â fârine ine Kristorao fuawec fokac.
Ŋic gâcnezi maŋhuhuŋ hawari erâ juhuc aŋelo araŋ bajareeŋgopieŋ, â maŋnâŋec ŋerisieme wiac honeeŋgopeneŋ muhuc irec manapie fârine eme sahac‐jeŋic maŋgâŋ muʒoraeŋgopieŋ, ŋic iŋucne jaŋe boreŋ fâri‐ŋeŋic mi ŋowac ronʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe hâcne Kristorao sâcne mi siŋkeeŋgopieŋ. Eki qizec‐nâŋec â nâŋâc me sahac‐ticne. Eme qizeckonec ruazi fâuckerâ wahahuc me kike fâri ombâŋ‐ticne basanaŋ‐nâpohuc bândeŋ‐nâpoekac. Ehuc gume hesiwiŋ enâreme soka sanaŋte tâpiri Anuturaonec fua‐nâreekac.
Ŋoŋe Kristore hâmocko ʒuhuckehuc mâreŋte wiac tâpirihec râpeckembiŋko wemocte mâreŋte hae fâri juhuc tinac sâcmutâc dâŋticne reŋkeeŋgo‐pieŋ?
Dâŋ kecʒiŋuc: “Keci mi bâuac, keci mi nâc, keci mi roc.”
Wiac nâ bac erâ bebehene hâcne, irec kibâtâc dâŋ i ŋiczi maŋjeŋicte manasurâ mu qaqazuc eeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic iŋucnezi maŋɋârâŋ hawari erâ “bâtâcko â sowa juhuc sahac bâpitiwazo” iŋuc mupie dâŋ izi fârine tinac eekac. Erâ wiac iŋucnezi fârine aricne, izi sasec aka sâcne mi hecneocmu.
Ŋoŋe Kristo fafahare‐ticnao ʒuhuckembiŋko ine faic Anuture maŋfuŋko Kristo jukacko wiac fokac, irec henʒiriŋnehuc junʒepieŋ.
Mâreŋko wiac fokac irec mâcne, faic wiac fokac irec maŋ mamanasu‐ŋeŋic râepie fozejec.
Ŋoŋe hâmombiŋ hâcne, eme juju‐ŋeŋic Kristohec Anuturao soŋkekicne fokac.
Juku Kristo e juju runâŋeczi fua taniŋkeme ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha ehec mâmâc tatamac huririnao fua taniŋkeniŋmu.
Wiac kecʒiŋucte ine sowa juhuc sahac‐ŋeŋic bâhâmonʒepieŋ: Boe sau, maŋwânâŋ, bu gâgâpâcne, sasec sâqocne, buchâro, i eocmu e sahac‐ticnezi wofuŋ ecnekac muzo.
Wiac i sasaware Anuturaonec okacne fisiocmu.
Ŋoŋe mârâcko iŋuc jaha wiac i bajupie maŋ fâri‐ŋeŋic ejujec.
Ʒi ine wiac iŋucne sasawa hetaranʒepieŋ. Ehuc aaric, kimbeŋ, râŋgeŋ bârâŋgeŋ, dâŋ gâgâpâcne â simbiŋne i qikiŋnenʒepieŋ.
Burec eec i wâc mi enʒepieŋ. Maŋraŋɋa‐ŋeŋic mâsi qâqâreŋ‐ticnehec heunucke behec erâ
maŋɋâri‐ŋeŋic hepie hume rojuŋgopieŋ. Maŋ i hâcne bâbâfuazi bâpiaŋkeme mamanahec erâ e jahacne hawari iŋucne fuahuc jukac.
Irec bârâwiŋ juju i tarawec, Grikŋic â Judaŋic, mahec â ma tâmiric, hâwecŋic â kâte sanaŋ, kiŋaŋ qaqa â ŋicbomboŋ, mâmâc sasawa Kristozi qâhâc‐nâporâ micne junâre‐fâreekac.
Eme Anuture biŋefâc, e jahac maŋjauŋ eŋarehuc rowosâec‐ŋopawec, ŋoŋe buuruc â buafec â maŋhuhuŋ â miriŋ â bumâteŋ izi ŋaqi‐ŋeŋic eme hepie hume rojunʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe aakic enʒepieŋ, â ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko dâŋ fuame kiŋ bebehec enʒepieŋ. Wofuŋzi kiŋ behe‐ŋarewec iŋuc jaha eec enʒepieŋ.
Eme wiac sasawa irec fainao maŋjauŋ bajupie izi wiac bâture‐fârehuc ematauckezejec.
Erâ Kristore wamazi maŋŋeŋicko guriŋne bazejec. Ŋoŋe wamahec erâ me sahac mocjahao juniŋte rocŋopakicne hâcne. Erâ wâc daŋge mumuteŋ ehuc junʒepieŋ.
Kristore dâŋzi ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko sawe mâririackezejec. Eme maŋɋârâŋ dâŋ fuŋne fuŋne qaqazuc ehuc faŋ qaqac enʒepieŋ. Erâ miti gae mânec i Mârozi baafec‐ŋopaha maŋŋeŋiczi Anutu muteŋkehuc hecnenʒepieŋ.
Eme maŋzi me mezi wiac ezo murâ i Wofuŋ Jesu manasiŋkehuc enʒepieŋ, ehuc ere erâ Anutu Mamac daŋge âzâcnenʒepieŋ.
Ŋokac ŋoŋe ŋowefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere rereŋfâc junʒepieŋ, Wofuŋte biŋe ekicnezi iŋuc epie sâckeocmu.
Ŋic ŋoŋe ŋonâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic maŋjauŋ ejarenʒepieŋ, ʒâʒâicne ine mi ejarenʒepieŋ.
Naru motec ŋoŋe neŋgoc mamacfâc‐ŋeŋic dâŋ mupie sâc reŋkenʒepieŋ, iŋuc epie Wofuŋzi maname biaŋkeocmu.
Mamac ŋoŋe naru motecfâc‐ŋeŋic hâwic sahac enʒipiŋte aaricko wiac mi ejarenʒepieŋ.
Kiŋaŋ qaqa ŋoŋe mâreŋ ŋicbomboŋfâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere mic reŋke‐fârenʒepieŋ, maizi qambaraŋ ejarepie ŋiczi sawa honec‐ŋopapie sâckeocte mâcne, maŋsiocmâc Wofuŋ araŋ bacnehuc epie sâckeomu.
Gie‐ŋeŋic sasawa i ŋic jaŋere erâ mâcne, Wofuŋte erâ aafec faio banʒepieŋ.
Kecʒiŋuc manahuc: Gie furi sambâŋko merâfâc fokac i Wofuŋtaonec roniŋmu. Irec Wofuŋ Kristo ere kiŋaŋ qaqafâc juŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Moc e gie‐ticne bâsâqoreocmu, e irec okacne jaha roocmu. Wofuŋtao ra rowec ware rowec mi fokac.
Ŋicbomboŋ ŋoŋe kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ŋeŋic wiac sâkoa etiŋnehuc ejarenʒepieŋ, ehuc ŋaŋacne femicne Wofuŋ sambâŋko jukac i manasunʒepieŋ.
Paŋʒâic jaha numuhuc junʒepieŋ. Erâ rucgereŋ juhuc daŋge nunumu enʒepieŋ.
Erâ nâŋere wâc numupie Anutuzi mitire hata bâʒâwe‐nâreme Kristore dâŋ soŋne mufuanʒepeneŋ. Dâŋ irec hâcne niŋgiŋko fokopac.
Nunumuzi dopecnupie dâŋ afeckehuc mujaŋgeŋkepe sâckezejec.
Qâpuc jaŋehec bâbâfuac erâ wiac mana tara‐hâmohuc enʒepieŋ. Ehuc gie bapa dameŋ mi sipirickenʒepieŋ.
Dâŋŋeŋic hâwec ruacnepie aŋacne ezejec. Eme ŋic dâŋ iŋuc me iŋuc bâtikie‐jareniŋte mi bititienʒepieŋ.
No nahacne dâŋ binaŋ i Tikikozi eŋareocmu. E joroc âgo babafic‐nâŋec â Wofuŋte kiŋaŋ qaqa micrereŋhec.
E hâcne juju‐nâŋecte dâŋ binaŋ eŋarehuc mu âkeriŋ eŋareocte ŋoŋerao sorepe fakac.
Erâ Onesimo, miti mamana âgo biaŋ‐nâŋec, ŋoŋere haeonec, e mâmâc ecnepe fârâ ʒirec dâŋ binaŋ eŋare‐fâreocmu.
Kâpâcwâru ŋic âgo‐nane Aristako â Banaba nafe‐ticne Mareko â Jesu, ʒâŋe‐ticne moc Justo, jaŋe manasu‐ŋareŋgopieŋ. Mareko ere sâcmutâc eŋarepo, fâ fisiocmuo âgo ecnenʒepieŋ.
Ŋic i jaŋe sawa Judaŋic jaŋeraonec fuakicnezi Anutu uucmaŋ‐ticnere giere baficnueŋgopieŋ, ehuc bubiaŋ qanareeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ ŋoŋere haeonec ŋic moc Epafara, Kristore kiŋaŋ qaqa, ere mamanac ŋoŋerao fokac, erâ ŋoŋe sanaŋkerâ Anuture micsâcko juhuc wiac mana tararâ etiŋneniŋte dameŋ sâc nunumuzi dopec‐ŋopaekac.
No fuŋne‐ticne manakopac, e ŋoŋere mecne erâ Laodikea haconec â Hierapoli haeonec mitiŋic jaŋere mecne mâmâc ʒâic gie wemo afecne baekac.
Luka dokta biaŋ‐nâŋec â Dema jahe mu ʒeri eŋarekopirec.
Erâ no Laodikea haeonec mitiŋic â Nimfasi â wiacfâcne mu ʒeri ejarekopac i mufua‐jarenʒepieŋ.
Papia ʒi ŋic ŋokac wose‐jarepie mana‐fârepie Laodikea haeonec kikefuŋ jaŋerao râepie rame wosenʒepieŋ. Â jaŋere moc qâreŋkepo iŋuc jaha ŋarepie wosenʒepieŋ.
Arikipo e ʒiŋuc âzâcnenʒepieŋ: “Miti gie Wofuŋzi neŋgoc ŋeha mugarekicne i aijakic jaha bâhâmozemec.”
Paulo no nahacne ʒâŋe qâreŋ ʒi râekopac. Kâpâcwâru ŋic nore manasunʒepieŋ. Aki anonoczi ŋoŋerao fozejec.
Paulo, Siliwano â Timoteo nâŋe Tesalonike haeonec kikefuŋ, Anutu Mamac â Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo ere ŋicfâc, ŋoŋere papia ʒi râeŋgopeneŋ. Aki anonoc â wama ŋoŋerao fotâcnerâ fozejec.
Nâŋe dameŋ sâc ŋoŋere erâ Anutu daŋge âzâcneeŋgopeneŋ, erâ nunumu gie bahuc sâc ŋoŋere manasu‐fâreeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋoŋe mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋicte fârine bâfuaeŋgopieŋ â maŋjauŋte bâmec gie baeŋgopieŋ â Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo paŋʒâic jaha worickeeŋgopieŋ, irec Mamac‐nâŋec Anutu ere maio hati manasurâ mufuahuc âzâcneeŋgopeneŋ.
Âgofâc, nâŋe manaŋgopeneŋ, Anutuzi maŋjauŋ eŋarehuc rowosâec‐ŋopawec.
Iŋuc eŋarewecte Biŋebiaŋ bafârâ ŋazapene dâŋ sawa mi ewec, i tâpirihec â Tiri Mârohec â buâkecnehec ewec. Ŋoŋerao jumbeŋko ŋoŋere erâ wiac ebac embeŋ i manaŋgopieŋ.
Eme nâŋe bâjâpec‐nâpombiŋ, bâjâpec‐nâpohuc Wofuŋ e jahacne mâmâc bâjâpembiŋ. Ehuc miti i fific guguriŋ faio Tiri Mârozi bufahac qaŋarehame ro maŋ embi.
Ŋoŋe iŋuc ehuc Makedonia â Akaia mâreŋkonec miti mamana jaŋe micne bajarehuc fuŋne qazu‐jarembiŋ.
Ŋoŋeraonec hâcne Wofuŋte dâŋzi haŋ barahuc Makedonia â Akaia mâreŋko fuawec, erâ i sawa mâcne, ŋoŋe Anutu manasiŋkembiŋ irec dâŋ biŋe i hae sâc mana‐fârepie nâŋe jajazane moc mi fuawec.
Jaŋe jaŋac ŋoŋerao gie bapene fârine fuawec irec dâŋ nâzâeŋgopieŋ. Erâ ŋoŋe nemuɋâŋ râpeckerâ Anutu jujune â fârine maickerâ ŋicfâc‐ticne embiŋ,
erâ Ŋokâ‐ticne Jesu hâmockonec bâɋârekicne, e juku sambâŋkonec waharâ okac dameŋko ŋezic‐nâpozokac, ere ʒawiehuc jueŋgopieŋ, irec dâŋ binaŋ‐ŋeŋic hae sâc eeŋgopieŋ.
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋerao fisirâ gie bapene fârimâc mi ewec i ŋaŋac manaŋgopieŋ.
Qanaŋ Filipi haeo qa imac enârembiŋ i manaŋgopieŋ wâc. Enârepie sifu mi dockembeŋ. Aricne, Anuturao roweckepene bubiaŋ qanâreme afeckerâ ŋoŋerao fârâ Anuture Biŋebiaŋ i juju gie sâko bahuc mufua‐ŋarembeŋ.
Babaafec dâŋ mueŋgopeneŋ i mamana sifuc faio mâcne, me maŋsifuc faio mâcne, me kege wage eŋarehuc mâcne;
Anutuzi honec‐nâpome sâckeme Biŋebiaŋ muromackenaŋte betoŋ‐nâpowec irec sâc mueŋgopeneŋ. Ŋiczi mana‐nârepie biaŋkeocte aricne, Anutu e maŋ hohonezi mana‐nâreme biaŋkeocte mocjaha mueŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋoŋe nâŋere manaeŋgopieŋ, nâŋe bâbâmiriŋ dâŋ moc mi ŋazambeŋ â mitio ake hehuc moneŋ mafare andac i wâc mi embeŋ, i Anutuzi manaha mukopac.
Kristore aposolo nâŋe mana‐nârepie feme sâckeocmu i manahuc sifu ŋoŋe me hae gâcnaonec ŋicbomboŋ eŋarenaŋte mi mumbeŋ.
Aricne, neŋgoc moczi kogocfâcne hemiriŋ‐jopaekac, iŋuc jaha nâŋe ŋoŋerao juhuc eŋarembeŋ.
Aŋac‐nâŋec ŋoŋerao fowecte Anuture Biŋebiaŋ ŋaŋazare sawa mâcne, ŋoŋere erâ juju‐nâŋec qiqikiŋ irec mâmâc afeckembeŋ, maŋnâŋec ŋoŋerao âeckewec irec.
Âgofâc, micneneŋ eŋarepene takic‐ŋopazacte ŋafe furec sahacte gie mâmâc ʒocne fârone bahuc domambeŋ, i ehuc Anuture Biŋebiaŋ ŋazambeŋ, ŋoŋe irec manasueŋgopieŋ.
Nâŋe maŋtaniŋ â tiŋne â bahacmâc juhuc miti mamana ŋoŋe wiac eŋarembeŋ, i ŋoŋe mecne â Anutu mecne fuŋne‐nâŋec manaŋgopieŋ.
Erâ moc ʒiŋuc wâc manaŋgopieŋ: Mamac moczi naru motecfâcne ejareekac, sâc ijaha nâŋe ŋoŋe eŋarehuc buc buc mu sawaŋ dâŋ ŋazambeŋ â esoc qafeŋ eŋarembeŋ â ʒiŋuc muʒakiehuc ŋazambeŋ:
“Uucmaŋ‐ticne â eri tatamac‐ticne rauckeniŋte hefârec‐ŋopaekac Anutu hâcne, ere ŋicfâc fârine erâ irec sâcko junʒepieŋ.”
Nâŋe Anuture dâŋ ŋazapene manapie ŋicdâŋ mi ewec. Eme iŋuc sâcne manambiŋ, i Anuture dâŋ jâmbâŋ, eki miti mamana ŋoŋerao gie baekac. Eme nâŋe irec hâcne Anutu daŋge mumuteŋ kuduc jaha ecnehuc jueŋgopeneŋ.
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋe Anuture kikefuŋ Judaia mâreŋko Kristo Jesurao qohotambiŋ jaŋehec sâc mocjaha embiŋ. Jaŋe Judaŋiczi jopa qâʒâic ejarembiŋ iŋuc jaha âgofâc‐ŋeŋic gâcnezi ŋoŋe ŋopa qâʒâic eŋarembiŋ.
Judaŋic jaŋe Wofuŋ Jesu â porofete iŋuc jaha qâhâmoc‐jopambiŋ, erâ wâc nâŋe nâpo jâpec enârembiŋ. Jaŋe Anutu âgo mi ecneeŋgopieŋ â ŋicne ŋicne kisuec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc qâpuc miti jazapene manarâ biaŋkenʒipiŋte aka henâreeŋgopieŋ. Jaŋe iŋuczi iŋuc ehuc sâqocne faio fefec hefekupie kiŋjeŋicte sâc micne qame Anuture kimbeŋ fisi‐jarewec.
Âgofâc, nâŋe behec‐ŋopambeŋ, erâ maŋzi mâcne, sahaczi dameŋ ŋondeŋ ʒi ŋoŋe tâmiric juhuc huacbuc eŋgopeneŋte mocwâc honec‐ŋopanaŋte boc enâreekac.
Eme irec fârâ iqic‐ŋopanaŋte mumbeŋ, Paulo no nahac dameŋ moc â moc fâzo mupe Sataŋzi aka henarewec.
Ŋoŋere aŋac‐nâpoekac i ʒiŋucte: Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu ere fifisi dameŋko weni jaŋe gie fâri‐nâŋec â ʒeri‐nâŋec â eri‐nâŋec eniŋmu? Ŋoŋe wâc enâreniŋmu hâcne.
Ŋoŋe mumuteŋ‐nâŋec â bubiaŋ‐nâŋec.
Ŋoŋere maŋhâhâŋ boc enârekume nâŋe gâcnezi sifu Ateŋ haeo buc juhuc
Timoteo sorepene behec‐nâporâ ŋoŋerao fâwec. E âgo‐nâŋec â Anuture gieŋic juhuc Kristore Biŋebiaŋ muekaczi fârâ mitio hume keteŋ eŋarehuc faŋ qaŋareocte mucnembeŋ.
Ŋoŋe ʒârâ hâriŋ faio juhuc dockenʒipiŋte iŋuc embeŋ. Ŋoŋe manaŋgopieŋ, miti mâteŋne juhuc mananaŋte mi munârekicne.
Nâŋe ŋoŋerao juhuc qanaŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc ŋazambeŋ: “Ʒika biac fai‐nâŋecko feocmu.” Eme dâŋ i sanaŋkewec, i manaŋgopieŋ.
Eme eesâic runezi bârokawec‐ŋopame gie‐nanere fârine omaezacte maŋ kukumbuc boc enareme jupe bape sâqoreme ŋic e miti babaju‐ŋeŋicte fuŋne manaocte sorepe fâwec.
Eme ʒi Timoteo e risie warerâ mamanasiŋ â maŋjauŋ‐ŋeŋicte biŋe biaŋ nâzâwec. Erâ nâŋere boc manasueŋgopieŋ, â nâŋe ŋoŋe honec‐ŋopazo muhapene ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha nâŋe honec‐nâpozo mueŋgopieŋ, dâŋ i nâzâ‐fârewec.
Âgofâc, nâŋe ʒârâ hâriŋ â buʒâiczi maŋnâŋec hehâriŋkeme juhapene miti babaju‐ŋeŋicte dâŋzi bunâŋec bâuruewec.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ heme hariŋ ecnehuc sanaŋkeeŋgopieŋ i manahuc maŋnâŋec fie ruruckekac.
Ŋoŋere erâ Anuture maio bubiaŋ sâko manaeŋgopeneŋte Anutu daŋge mo iŋucne ecnepene sâckeocmu?
Mâc mana‐nâreha ŋoŋerao fârâ hohonec erâ miti gâcne forakac i moc ʒuhucke‐ŋarenaŋte ŋafe furec mu wâwâsic ecneeŋgopeneŋ.
Mamac‐nâŋec Anutu â Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu e jahac hata bâfua‐nâreme ŋoŋerao fânʒepeneŋ.
Ŋoŋerao ine Wofuŋzi maŋjauŋ‐ŋeŋic bâŋɋârâŋkeme ŋedâmâreme ŋaŋackoaŋ â gâcne jaŋehec eec enʒepieŋ; nâŋe iŋuc jaha ŋoŋe eŋareeŋgopeneŋ.
Erâ Anutuzi maŋŋeŋic keteŋkeme ŋoŋe Mamac‐nâŋecte maio bahacmâc â maŋfuru juhapie Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu tiŋnefâc‐ticne sasawa jaŋehec fisizejec.
Âgofâc‐nane, Wofuŋ Jesure erâ uŋ sawaŋ eŋarehuc moc ʒiŋuc ŋazapene mananiŋ: Mitio juju bapa‐ŋeŋiczi Anutu âgo ecneocte fuŋne ŋaza qazuc embeŋ, ijaha junʒepieŋ. Mitio juju i sâcne jueŋgopieŋ, mâc juŋɋârâŋkeniŋte ŋazaŋgopeneŋ.
Wofuŋ Jesure micte dâŋ ŋaza qâmoc embeŋ, irec kâuc mi baŋgopieŋ.
Anutu e ʒiŋuc hâcne muekac: Boe sau qikiŋnehuc maŋɋaɋac junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋerao moczi e jahacne ŋonâŋ maŋɋaɋacko â pectâcko rauckezejec,
sasecte ʒocbâruŋko misac, i ŋic qâpuc Anuture kâuc baeŋgopieŋzi eeŋgopieŋ.
Moczi moc aka huckehuc wiac iŋucnao âgo‐ticne mi eatuckezejec. Wofuŋ e wiac irec okacne bazu‐fâreocmu; nâŋe dâŋ i mârâc jaha mujomirerâ ŋazambeŋ.
Maŋwânâŋhec junaŋte aricne, maŋɋaɋac junaŋte Anutuzi hefârec‐nâpowec.
Irec moc e dâŋ i bâsueocmu, e ŋic moc mâcne, Anuctu e jahacne bâsueocmu, Tiri Mâro maŋŋeŋicko râeekac e hâcne bâsueocmu.
Ŋoŋe miti mamanazi maŋzi jauŋ babac eniŋte wemocte boc qâreŋke‐ŋarenaŋmu, Anutu e jahac maŋzi jauŋ babac eniŋte fuŋne ŋaza ŋowatuc ewec.
Erâ ŋoŋe Makedonia mâreŋ hae sâc opâ ruac juraŋgopieŋ jaŋe maŋjauŋ ejarehuc jueŋgopieŋ. Erâ sifu mocwâc ɋârâŋkeocte ŋazaŋgopeneŋ.
Erâ dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc ŋaza qâmoc embeŋ: Rac warec juhuc dâŋ ojowa mi ee, hae‐ŋeŋicko ŋezurâ ŋehuc mezi gie muŋarekicne aijakic jaha baniŋte ɋicwânʒâŋ enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc qâpuc jaŋere maio roroc tâmiric pectâc junʒepieŋ.
Âgofâc, ŋoŋe hâmokicne jaŋere kâuc bârâ, miti tâmiriczi maŋjeŋic ʒickeme ki mamakuc eeŋgopieŋ iŋuc enʒipiŋte ŋazapene mananiŋ:
Nâŋâc Jesu hâmorâ faharewec dâŋ i maŋkerâ ʒiŋuc mananʒepeneŋ: Anutu e Jesu ecneme hâmokicne jaŋe e jahacnehec amec‐jopa fisiocmu.
Â moc i Wofuŋ e jahacne micdâŋ ŋazanaŋ: Mâreŋko ɋâricne juhapene Wofuŋ fisiocmu nâŋâc hâmokicne mi siric‐jopanaŋmu.
Wofuŋ e sambâŋkonec wahaocte ine dâŋ wiwira â aŋelo qizecte micʒonʒoŋ â Anuture qeŋfânâŋ fuahame wahaocmu. Wahame Kristo manasiŋkehuc hâmombiŋ jaŋe bâbâni fahareniŋmu.
Faharepie ɋâricne junaŋmu, tiwâne hâcne, izi jaŋerao ʒuhuckepene karoraczi bafec‐nâpome sawao Wofuŋhec bâbâfuac enaŋmu. Erâ Wofuŋhec juhuc junaŋmu sanaŋ.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ i hâcne muc manac ehuc maŋ bâbâmâteŋ enʒepieŋ.
Âgofâc‐nane, dameŋte â ʒâfore dâŋ wemocte moc qâreŋke‐ŋarenaŋmu?
Ŋaŋac ʒiŋuc sâcne manaŋgopieŋ: Râsi jaŋe ŋafeo ututuŋ fisieŋgopieŋ, iŋuc jaha dameŋ‐ticne ɋeŋfâfâc jaha maickeocmu.
Eme ŋic jaŋe aki wama sâko fokac muhuc mana fâserâ juhapie wiac hâhâwicnezi acmâc jaha fisi‐jareocmu. Ŋokac kiwechec moc e gozi onʒoŋ jaha kime fâfâreocmu, iŋuc jaha ŋic iŋucne jaŋe wiac onʒoŋ jaha fua‐jareme wemocko moc wiseniŋmu.
Âgofâc, ŋoŋe ine dapâcko mi juŋgopieŋ, irec wemocko Wofuŋte dameŋzi râsi iŋucne erâ ututuŋ maic‐ŋopame bipic tatara eniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe tatamacte â ʒoaŋte kikefuŋ ekicne, nâŋâc ŋafere me dapâcte biŋe aricne.
Irec ŋic gâcnezi guŋ fopie qâtec‐joparâ guŋ mi fonʒepeneŋ, rucgereŋ‐nâŋec bahuc maŋte sowa junʒepeneŋ.
Guŋ fofo jaŋe ŋafeo foeŋgopieŋ â gae wowo jaŋe ŋafeo wohuc bâbâsifuc bâfuaeŋgopieŋ.
Ʒoaŋte biŋe ekicne nâŋâc ine maŋte sowa junʒepeneŋ, ehuc mamanasiŋ â maŋjauŋ izi maruku enârezejec, â bâbâpiaŋte woworiczi dunâŋec ezejec.
I ʒiŋucte: Anutu e kimbeŋ‐ticnere fârine hotâckenaŋte mâcne, Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristore erâ bâbâpiaŋ rauckenaŋte muekac.
E hâcne okac‐nâŋec hâmowec, i hâmohuc me ɋâricne juhuc ehec mâmâc junaŋte iŋuc ewec.
Ŋoŋe irec hâcne faŋ qaqac â hehe ʒakiec eeŋgopieŋ iŋuc jaha ehuc junʒepieŋ.
Âgo bureŋ, wiac mocte esoc‐ŋopaŋgopeneŋ: Ŋoŋerao ʒâic gie baeŋgopieŋ â Wofuŋte erâ micne baŋareeŋgopieŋ â mu bâtiŋ eŋareŋgopieŋ i jaŋe sâsec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Ehuc gie‐jeŋicte erâ maŋjauŋ ejarehuc mana‐jarepie fehâmbâŋkezejec. Erâ wâc wama qaqac ehuc junʒepieŋ.
Âgofâc, hazec qâuŋ dâŋ moc ŋazape mananiŋ. Ŋic kosa jujune jaŋe uŋ sawaŋ ejarenʒepieŋ, ŋic manabâcne jaŋe mu âkeriŋ ejarenʒepieŋ, bataŋkekicne jaŋe dopec‐jopanʒepieŋ, erâ mâmâc hezu hemiriŋ ejarenʒepieŋ.
Sâqocnere okac babazuc enʒipiŋte sosoŋaŋ enʒepieŋ. Ŋaŋackoaŋ â ŋic gâcne sasawa jaŋehec eehâmoc erâ erahuc junʒepieŋ.
Bubiaŋ faio jurâ jurahuc junʒepieŋ.
Nunumu moc mi hetaranʒepieŋ.
Wiac irec me irec daŋge mumuteŋ enʒepieŋ, i Kristo Jesure erâ eniŋte Anutuzi muŋarekac.
Mârore ʒoc mi hehâponʒepieŋ.
Anuture micdâŋ mufua‐ŋarepie mana qâoma mi enʒepieŋ.
Dâŋ sasawa mana wosâerâ bâtâc banʒepieŋ, â biaŋne eme bajunʒepieŋ.
Sâqocne fuŋne fuŋne ine qikiŋnenʒepieŋ.
Anutu wama rune e jahac ʒure bâpiaŋ eŋareme maŋfuru ejâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ, eme mâro â maŋ qâqâtâc â sahac‐ŋeŋic furu fohame Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere fifisi dameŋko bahacmâc domanʒepieŋ.
Hefârec‐ŋopakac e mume sasanaŋ, irec gie‐ticne baku batarocmu.
Âgofâc, ŋoŋe nâŋere erâ numunʒepieŋ.
Opâ ruac ŋoŋe mitio meo babac efârenʒepieŋ.
No Wofuŋte maio ŋaza sanaŋkepe: Ŋoŋe papia kecʒi opâ ruac mâmâc sasawa wose‐jarepie mananʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere aki anonoczi ŋoŋerao fotâcnerâ fozejec.
Paulo, Siliwano â Timoteo nâŋe Tesalonike haeonec kikefuŋ guru, Mamac‐nâŋec Anutu â Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo ere ŋicfâc, ŋoŋere papia ʒi râeŋgopeneŋ.
Anutu Mamac â Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo eraonec aki anonoc â wama ŋoŋerao fotâcnerâ fozejec.
Âgofâc, maŋnâŋeczi jâiŋ‐nâpome ŋoŋere erâ Anutu dameŋ sâc daŋge âzâcneeŋgopeneŋ. Mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋic boc fua ɋârâŋ eekac, â maŋjauŋ‐ŋeŋic fua sawec eme qame qoŋgiŋ eeŋgopieŋ. Eme irec Anutu daŋge âzâcnepene i jâmbomac sâckeekac.
Erâ ŋoŋe fific guguriŋ eŋarepie ʒâic busâqochec juhuc mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋic mi ŋeŋgoroŋkeha sifu sanaŋkerâ jueŋgopieŋ, irec dâŋ binaŋ hae sâc Anuture kikefuŋfâc ejareeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋoŋe wiac‐ŋareekac, irec ʒiŋuc muzo: Anutuzi okac dameŋko wiac sâckoa enâreocmu, irec sâsâcne ʒi qanaŋ fuakac. Anutuzi ŋoŋere maname sâckeme uucmaŋ‐ticnao raraʒire sâc bâfuaniŋte ʒârâ hâriŋ faio jueŋgopieŋ.
Eme juku Anutu mana wosâc‐ticne tiŋne fokac irec sâc enâreocmu: Ŋoŋe ʒâic fâro eŋareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒâic fâro jaha bâfua‐jareocmu,
â ʒâic fâro manaeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe ine nâŋe‐hec mâmâc bâgunuc‐nâpoocmu. I juku Wofuŋ Jesu e aŋelo guru hâhâwicne jaŋehec sambâŋkonec waha fua tâcneocmu ira iŋuc enâreocmu.
E ʒocbâruŋko waharâ ŋic Anuture kâuc baeŋgopieŋ â Wofuŋ Jesu Biŋebiaŋ‐ticne mana rereŋ mi eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe okacne jareocmu.
Ŋic i jaŋe Anutuzi furine sisipiric sanaŋ jarehuc ʒâŋe mai‐ticnaonec â tâpiri‐ticnere huriri biaŋkonec bârâriec‐jopaocmu.
Eme dameŋ ira fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋerao eri tatamac‐ticne fuaocmu, â miti‐ticne ro maŋ embiŋ jaŋe hone warec ecneniŋmu. Ŋoŋe ine mumutaniŋ dâŋnâŋec mana ʒakiembiŋ hâcne.
Irec hâcne ŋoŋere erâ dameŋ sâc numuhuc ʒiŋuc mueŋgopeneŋ: Anutu‐nâŋec e hefârec‐ŋopaweczi irec sâcko juniŋte baʒawiec‐ŋopazejec, erâ tâpiri‐ticnezi dopec‐ŋopahame wiac biaŋnere mu manasuc ehuc mamanasiŋte gie fâri bâfua‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc epie Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu ere ʒâŋe qâreŋzi ŋoŋerao fua jaŋgeŋkezejec, â ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha erao taniŋke biaŋ enʒepieŋ. I Anutu‐nâŋec â Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo eki aki anonoc‐ticnere iŋuc eŋarezejec.
Âgofâc, Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo fifisi‐ticnere â ehec bâbâfuac ee irec dâŋne moc ŋazapene mananiŋ.
Ŋic gâcne jaŋe Wofuŋte dameŋ maickekac muhuc Mârorao muhotaniŋmu, me nâŋe micko itic enâreniŋmu me papia‐nâŋecte mu ɋetic eniŋmu, eme ŋoŋe mi mutuc erâ fâfârepie maŋŋeŋic hockezejec.
Eatuc dâŋ iŋuc me iŋuc ŋazapie mi mananʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ dameŋ‐ticne maickezo eha qanaŋ miti ima qaqa sâko fuaocmu, erâ sindaŋŋic sisipiricte biŋe eki hâcne fua tâcneocmu.
Eme ʒâŋene Anutu me miti wiac mueŋgopieŋ i sasawa râsi ecnehuc qâhuckerâ ro waha âte ecne‐fâreocmu. Erâ Anuture ufuŋko ferâ ŋehuc e jahacnere muocmu, “No Anutu.”
No ŋoŋerao juhuc irec hâcne ŋazapo, i moc manasuŋgopieŋ me?
Dameŋ ʒiŋuczia aka fokac, i manaŋgopieŋ, i hâcne rârieme dameŋ‐ticnao fua tâcneocmu.
Ʒi ine sindaŋzi soŋsoŋko biac gie‐ticne baekac. Â aka hecneekac e rârieme sindaŋŋic fua tâcneocmu.
Eme Wofuŋ Jesu e micrombâŋ‐ticnezi qarâ fifisi‐ticnere ʒâziriŋnezi imackeocmu.
Ŋic e Sataŋzi neŋgoc ŋesiŋ ŋecnehame tâpiri wiac fuŋne fuŋnehec fuarâ burecko mâsi â qaŋgec wiac ʒâŋe furu baocmu.
Erâ ŋic gâcne, dâŋ fâri qizecne manarâ bibiaŋke i qaisockerâ sisipiricte biŋe eeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe sâqocnere maŋ bâsifuc ejareocmu.
Ŋic jaŋe iŋuc eeŋgopieŋte Anutuzi eeatuc neŋgoc qizecne sâko mume fuame burecko qohotaniŋmu hâcne.
I mâc mâcne, dâŋ fâri qizecne qikiŋnerâ wiac hehesicnere aŋac‐jopaekac, ŋic i jaŋe okacne fisi‐jareocte iŋuc hâcne eocmu.
Âgofâc‐nâŋec, Wofuŋte jorocfâc, ŋoŋe Mârozi baɋaɋac‐ŋopame dâŋ fâri qizecnao qohotahuc biaŋkeniŋte Anutuzi mârâc jaha rowosâec‐ŋopawec, irec daŋge hati âzâcnenaŋte maŋnâŋeczi jâiŋ‐nâpoekac.
Irec hâcne Biŋebiaŋ ŋazapene manarâ Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo eri tatamac‐ticne rauckeniŋte hefârec‐ŋopawec.
Eme irec âgofâc ŋoŋe sanaŋkerâ dâŋ miczi â papiazi ŋaza qazuc embeŋ i paŋʒâic bajunʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo â Anutu Mamac‐nâŋec eki maŋjauŋ enârehuc katucmâc‐ticnere erâ bubiaŋ fofo sanaŋ bâfua‐nârewec â ʒeŋaŋ fâri woŋec‐nâŋec râewec,
eki hâcne maŋŋeŋic bâinaŋkerâ dopec‐ŋopame dâŋfâri â gie fâri i ŋoŋerao mi wahazejec.
Âgofâc, dâŋ moc fokac mananiŋ: Nâŋere erâ numupie Wofuŋte dâŋzi fofotâc haŋ barame qâreŋ biaŋ‐ticne ŋoŋerao fuawec iŋuc jaha fua razejec.
Erâ ŋic maŋbâiŋ bâbâfuane â sindaŋne jaŋere erâ Anutuzi ŋezic‐nâpoocte nunumuzi wâc bafic‐nâponʒepieŋ. Miti i ŋiczi furu ninic ro maŋ mi eeŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋzi ine mume sasanaŋ, irec hume keteŋ eŋarehuc sâqocne runere roroŋ sasapec eŋareocmu.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ ŋâzapene reŋkerâ reŋke rahuc juniŋmu, irec Wofuŋte erâ ŋoŋere maŋjahec mi eŋgopeneŋ.
Wofuŋzi maŋŋeŋic jowame Anuture maŋjauŋko â Kristore bumâteŋko iticnezejec.
Âgofâc, Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere micte ŋazapene mananiŋ, dâŋ qazu‐ŋarembeŋ i opâ ruac gâcnezi mi reŋkehuc kosa jueŋgopieŋ, ŋic i jaŋehec mi junʒepieŋ.
Nâŋe hata fuŋkerâ âte‐ŋarembeŋ ijaha bâjâpec‐nâponiŋte kâuc mi baŋgopieŋ. Nâŋe ŋoŋerao ojoŋ mi jumbeŋ.
Erâ ŋoŋeraonec nânâ furimâc mi nâmbeŋ, aricne, nânâ mafare micneneŋ eŋarenʒipeŋte ŋafe furec mezi gie ʒocnehec bahuc ʒâic manambeŋ.
Erâ iŋuc enaŋte mi munârekicne, nâŋe qaŋeŋ‐ŋopahuc fuŋne ŋowatupene nâŋere mimiŋ qâjâpec juniŋte iŋuc eŋarembeŋ.
Ŋoŋerao juhuc ʒiŋuc hâcne boc ŋazambeŋ: Ojoŋ juocmuzi nânâ mi nâzejec.
Eme ʒi ŋoŋeraonec dâŋ ʒiŋuc wareme manambeŋ: Ŋic gâcnezi gie‐jeŋic hetârarâ qâoma erâ jueŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic iŋucne jaŋe Wofuŋ Jesu Kristore micte uŋdâŋ ʒiŋuc jazapene mana‐jâmbâŋkenʒepieŋ: Ŋezu ŋewâneŋ erâ gie‐jeŋic bapie fârine fuame jaŋacneonec nânʒepieŋ.
Âgofâc, ŋoŋe ine eehâmo gie tatakic tâmiric banʒepieŋ.
Ʒi papiao dâŋ qâreŋke‐ŋareŋgopeneŋ, i ŋic moczi qikiŋneme fuŋne‐ticne mujaŋgeŋkerâ behepie buc juhuc mimiezejec.
Râsi ecneniŋte mi mukopac, âgo‐nâŋec muhuc mu bâtiŋ ecnehuc tutuc qacnenʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ e wama runezi ine wama bâfua‐ŋareme ŋoŋerao dameŋ sâc sâcke‐fârerâ fozejec. Wofuŋ e ŋoŋehec jufârezejec.
Ʒi Paulo no nahacne mezi ʒâŋe qâreŋ‐nane râekopac. Papia qâreŋkeekopac sâc ma izi fuaekac. Iŋuc hâcne qâreŋkeekopac.
Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere aki anonoczi ŋoŋerao fotâcnerâ fozejec.
Paulo no Anutu bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋecte micte â Kristo Jesu mamanac‐nâŋecte micte Kristo Jesure aposolo juekopaczi
mitio motec jâmbâŋ‐nane Timoteo go papia ʒi qâreŋke‐garekopac. Anutu Mamac â Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Kristo Jesu eraonec aki anonoc â uruc jauŋ â wama gorao fotâcnerâ fozejec.
No Makedonia mâreŋko razo ehuc gazapo iŋuc ezemec, ehuc Efeso haeo ʒuhuckerâ juhuc, ŋic tucnezi miti musifuckeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe qatara‐jaretec behenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe nemu binaŋ bahuc ŋic gaŋne gaŋne juwefumbiŋ irec fuŋne qapie raʒic wefuc eme mu qaqataranehec fuaekac. Iŋuc epie Anutu manasiŋkehuc kiŋaŋ qaqacne i wahame sâqoreekac.
Miti mumure fârine ine ʒiŋuc fuame sâckeocmu: Maŋtaniŋ â maŋʒuruc â maŋ mamanasiŋhec juhuc maŋjauŋ bâfuazo.
Ŋic tucnezi ine miti hata i qâsorierâ dâŋ jawane fârimâc bâfuambiŋ bajuŋgopieŋ.
Erâ jaŋacnere ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: Nâŋe Mosere sâcmutâc dâŋ irec qaqazu, iŋuc murâ dâŋ kosa muhuc irec sasanaŋ bâfuaeŋgopieŋ.
Nâŋâc sâcmutâc dâŋte ʒiŋuc manaeŋgopeneŋ: I dâŋ biaŋne, erâ fuŋne‐ticne mana‐hâmohuc bajuzo.
Fuŋne‐ticne ine ʒiŋuc fokac: Sâcmutâc dâŋ i ŋic bahacmâc jaŋere biŋe mi ekac, ŋic sindaŋne, râŋgeŋne, araŋ bapa tâmiric, sâqocne bapa, maŋwânâŋhec, ʒaubacne, neŋgoc mamac sisipiric, ʒika qaqa,
boe sau ŋic, ŋiczia ŋicko sasec gie bapa, ŋic ŋokac fiuc rocjoparâ gâcne qikiŋne‐jarehuc moneŋ bâbâfua, burecŋic, Wofuŋte ʒâŋe muhuc burecko mumupaŋ ee, erâ wiac gâcne moc dâŋ fari biaŋ râsi ecneekac, wiac iŋucne eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere hâcne sâcmutâc dâŋ mukicne.
Anutu juju aŋac rune ere Biŋebiaŋ eri tatamacnehec tahacnukicne izi hâcne iŋuc mufuakac.
Tâpiri narehuc basanaŋnuwec Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Kristo Jesu e daŋge âzâcneekopac. Eki mana‐nareme sâckeme betoŋnuhuc miti gie munarewec hâcne.
Juwicnao e musoriŋkehuc ŋicfâcne râsi ejarerâ jopa qâʒâic ejarehape sifu iŋuc enarewec. No Wofuŋte fuŋne kâuc bahuc mamanasiŋ‐nane tâmiricte iŋuc epore akicnuwec.
Eme Wofuŋ‐nâŋecte aki anonoczi norao qaja fuseme Kristo Jesuraonec mamanasiŋ â maŋjauŋhec epo.
Jesu Kristo e sâqocne bapa bâpiaŋ‐nâpoocte mâreŋko wahawec, dâŋ i fârine jâmbâŋ â mâmâc sâko ro maŋ eenere sâc. Sâqocne bapa jaŋere micne no hâcne.
Eme Jesu Kristo e akicnurâ, uruc jauŋ‐ticne ŋemâcne fokac, irec fuŋne norao furu jaha bataniŋkewec i mâc mâcne, ŋic ʒâhec mâsi i hâcne norao honerâ e manasiŋkerâ juju sanaŋko fisiniŋte iŋuc enarewec.
Juju sanaŋte Wofuŋ Sâko, mi hâhâmone â mi hohonene, Anutu sâko mocjaha hâcne, ere ʒâŋe biŋe â eri tatamac foraʒihuc juzejec sanaŋ. Jâmbomac.
Motec‐nane Timoteo, qanaŋ gore findaŋdâŋ fuawec irec sâcko dâŋ mutâcne‐garekicne i hâcne râe‐garekopac. Go i bajuhuc momori gie biaŋ sanaŋkerâ bazemec.
Erâ mamanasiŋge foʒakierâ fohame maŋge soŋaŋketec ɋaɋacnea fozejec. Ŋic tucnezi maŋɋaɋac juju râpeckembiŋte mamanasiŋ‐jeŋic ŋeŋgoroŋkeme qâsoriembiŋ.
Jaŋeraonec moc Himenaio â moc Alesande, eme jahe Sataŋzi bâʒâic‐jofakume mumusoriŋ‐jekic behenicte erao râec‐jofapo.
No bâbâni dâŋ moc gaza qâmoc epe: Nunumu wâwâsic â daŋge mumuteŋ izi ŋaŋacne â ŋic gâcne sasawa dopec‐jopahuc
ŋicwofuŋ â kia gawaman mâmâc dopec‐jopanʒepieŋ. Eme soŋaŋ‐nâpohapie wamao mâteŋne â mitine juhâmopene ŋiczi mana‐nârepie fezejec.
Izi biaŋkeocmu, â bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec Anutu e irec maname sâckeocmu.
Eki ŋic mâmâc sasawa biaŋkerâ dâŋ fâri qizecne mana maŋ eniŋte muekac hâcne.
Anutu mocjaha hâcne junârekac, erâ Anutu â ŋic ŋondeŋ‐nâŋecko ŋicwirec‐nâŋec mocjaha Jesu Kristo e ŋic ekicnezi junâre‐fârekac.
Eki hâcne juju‐ticne qikiŋnehuc mâmâc sâko kiwiric‐nâŋec rowec, irec biŋezi dameŋ‐ticnao haŋ baocte.
No irec biŋe mumu â aposolo jupemurâ râecnukicne, erâ ŋic qâpuc dâŋ fâri qizecne â mamanasiŋte fuŋne jaza mutâc epemurâ qaqazu gie munarekicne. Dâŋ i burec mâcne, jâmbomac mukopac.
Ŋic jaŋere mukopac, jaŋe hae sâc aaric â maŋjahec tâmiric juhuc mejeŋic ɋaɋacne foha Anuturao sicnerâ numunʒerpieŋ.
Â ŋokac jaŋere mukopac, jaŋe ŋaqi aickerâ rojuhuc rume rume jupie izi eri‐jeŋic ezejec, â qizec susuc‐jeŋicko mâsi qâreŋ ee, me eri wiac furi sâko qoqonaŋ, me ŋaqi hohonebâcne ro juju ine mi enʒepieŋ.
Ŋokac mitio juzo muŋgopieŋzi eehâmo gie bapie sâckeocmu.
Ŋokac jaŋe wahamicne juhuc niniŋkerâ hazec râehuc mamana gie banʒepieŋ.
Ŋokaczi qaqazu gie baocte me ŋic qâhuc‐jopaocte mi manacnekopac, e mâc rumerâ juzejec.
Adam e bâbâni bâfuakicne â Ewa ine ʒâhec.
Adam e eesaic rune mi manacnewec, ŋokaczi ine manacnerâ qaqatara bâfuawec.
Ŋokaczi motec roro‐ticnere biaŋkeocmu, ine mamanasiŋhec â maŋjauŋhec erâ maŋɋaɋac juniŋmu ŋokac i jaŋe iŋuc hâcne eniŋmu.
Moc e mitire micne bapa juocte muocmu, e gie furi sâkore ecnekac muzo, dâŋ i jâmbomac.
Eme mitire micne bapazi bahacmâc juhuc ŋokac mocjahahec juzejec, erâ maŋsowa juzejec, eesifuc tâmiric metâne juzejec, jauŋhec juzejec, qaqazu gie basarickehuc bapane,
waiŋ opâ âmbâŋ mi nâzejec, ʒikafac aricne, urucne â wamane juzejec, moneŋ mafare mubâre mi ezejec,
e jahacne wiacfâc sâcne soŋaŋ‐jopazejec erâ pectâc juhuc naru motecfâcne mu bâtiŋ ejareme micrereŋhec junʒepieŋ.
Moc e wiacfâc‐ticne sâcne mi soŋaŋ‐jopaocmu, e wemocko Anuture kikefuŋ mamac ejareocmu.
Erâ opâ ruac ɋâricne moczi mitire micne bapa mi juzejec, iŋucnezi penaroŋ eme Sataŋzi doc bazacte.
Ŋic ŋokac kikefuŋko mi raʒimbiŋ jaŋe wâc manacnepie sâckeekac ŋic iŋucnezi mitire micne juzejec, jaŋe musoriŋkepie Sataŋzi maŋne bâsifuckeme ere bitiŋko kizacte.
Babafic jaŋe iŋuc jaha ŋic metâne junʒepieŋ, nameŋ sosohoc mi junʒepieŋ, waiŋ opâ nâ âmbâŋ mi enʒepieŋ, moneŋ mafare mubâre mi enʒepieŋ.
Miti boreŋ soŋsoŋ fowarehuc juwec i maŋɋaɋacko duckepie fozejec.
Jaŋe wâc qanaŋ ba esâic ejarezo; eme fuŋne‐jeŋic hone manac epie sâckeme gie jarezo.
Ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋe iŋuc jaha metâne junʒepieŋ, gupe micko âkec mi enʒepieŋ, maŋsowa juhuc wiac sasawa mu bac epie fâri fideteŋ efârezejec.
Bâbafic mo e ŋokac mocjahahec juzejec. Naru motecfâc‐ticne â wiacfâc‐ticne sâcne soŋaŋ‐jopazejec.
Eme babafic moc e gie‐ticne bame biaŋkeme maŋte juju ʒae biaŋne bâfuaocmu â Kristo Jesurao qohotahuc giere afecke‐hâmoocmu.
No gorao biac fâpemurâ manasuhuc sifu kecʒiŋucte dâŋ ʒi qâreŋke‐garekopac:
Wiac moczi niŋgiŋnume jupe ʒorame Anuture ficko ju bac ezore fuŋne kâuc bazic. Anutu jujune ere kikefuŋfâc jaŋe hâcne ficticne, erâ wâc dâŋ fâri qizecnere gumi â hobeteŋne juŋgopieŋ.
Miti‐nâŋecte fuŋne qame hukicne mutaniŋkeeŋgopeneŋ i qeŋ bipinehec: E sahacko fua tâcnekicne, Mârozi fuŋne bataniŋkekicne, aŋelozi honekicne, qâpucko biŋene mukicne, mâreŋ sâc mana maŋ ekicne, eri tatamacko bafekicne.
Mâro e qanaŋ ʒiŋuc mujaŋgeŋkerâ muekac: Juku ʒâhec ŋic tucnezi miti beherâ maŋ bâsifuc bâbâfua jaŋere eeatuc dâŋko â demoŋ jaŋere burecdâŋko qohotaniŋmu.
Ine burecŋiczi maŋjeŋic ʒukiwic bakicnere ŋic eatuc‐jopahuc ʒiŋuc jazaeŋgopieŋ:
“Ŋokac mi rohuc ŋicʒeŋoŋ juzo â nânâ gâcne mi nâhuc irec sowa juzo.” Nânâ i Anutuzi râe‐fârewec, erâ mamanasiŋhec juhuc dâŋfâri mana maŋ embeŋzi daŋge âzâcnehuc nanaŋte muwec.
Anuturaonec wiac fuakicne i biaŋne sasawa. Erâ daŋge âzâcnehuc nâ bac eeŋgopeneŋko qaqatarene mi fokac.
I Anuture dâŋzi â nunumuzi jambuŋkekicne hâcne.
Go opâ ruac dâŋ i jaza qâmoc ecmu, ine Jesu Kristore kiŋaŋŋic dâŋ rereŋhec jucmu, ehuc mamanasiŋte dâŋ â mitire dâŋfuŋne fârine mana rereŋ ewaremeŋ izi maŋgere nâqiŋ eha jucmu.
Â qeŋokac qizec dâŋ wose murarane ine qikiŋnezemec. Go Wofuŋ manasiŋkehuc jucmurâ maŋzi aafec bazemec.
Sahacte aafec gie bapa izi fâfârine, â maŋ baafeckehuc Wofuŋ manariŋ qâriŋ eecne ine fârine. Izi ʒira mâreŋko â juku sambâŋko juju bâfua‐nâreocte mukicne.
Dâŋ i fârine jâmbâŋ â mâmâc sâko ro maŋ eenere sâc.
Irec fârine hâcne ronaŋte gie amec fâfâuc baeŋgopeneŋ, ine mumusoriŋzi fai‐nâŋecko feipieha Anutu jujune ere mamanacko juhuc eeŋgopeneŋ. E hâcne mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋere bâbâpiaŋ juekaczi mamanasiŋhec nâŋâcne ejâmbâŋkeekac.
Dâŋ mukopac sasawa i jaza mutâc ezemec.
Go motec ɋâri jukic irec ŋic jaŋe gore manapie wawahane mi ezejec. Go maŋjauŋhec â mamanasiŋhec â maŋɋaɋachec jutec miti mumugezi â juju bapagezi opâ ruac guru hata jowatuzejec.
Woŋec‐nane juhuc miti wose qazuc â jaza qâmoc ehuc juzemec.
Micne bapa jaŋe Mâroraonec dâŋ mufuahuc mejeŋic qizecgao râehuc jambuŋgumbiŋ, jambuŋ irec fârine sifucke‐garezacte bâiŋ basawec ezemec.
Go irec mana mezac ehuc giege baʒihuc batec fârine fuarâ fua ehuc fome hone‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Gahacne maŋ sahac soŋaŋkehuc mitire dâŋfuŋne furu mimic foŋareocte mâmâc soŋaŋkezemec. Go i hâcne paŋʒâic bajuzemec. Iŋuc ecmuo ine dâŋge manaeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mecne â go gahacne mâmâc juju biaŋko fisiniŋmu.
Ŋicqizec moc dâŋ âzâcnemurâ fâfâcnehec mi ecnezemec, mamac‐nane muhuc urucko mu tutuc ecnezemec, ŋicmotec hahac ɋafâc‐nane muhuc sâcjeŋicko jaza bâtiŋ ejarezemec.
Ŋokac qizec neŋgocfâc‐nane muhuc iŋuc jaha uruc jauŋdâŋ jazazemec, ŋokac sahac ɋâri seŋfâc‐nane muhuc rucge bahuc dâŋ wiac jazazemec.
Hozec sâsec‐jopahuc dâŋjeŋic dopeckezemec, hozec jâmbâŋ jaŋere mukopac.
Hozec moc naru motec me ŋosafâcne juniŋmu, ine jaŋe qanaŋ jaŋacne ficko miti gie bahuc ŋic ŋokac qizefâc‐jeŋic jauŋ‐jopanʒepieŋ, ehuc juwicnao wiac ejarekicne irec tofa bazunʒepieŋ. Anutu e irec maname sâckeocmu.
Hozec fârine ine e jahackoaŋ juhuc Anuturao roweckeekac, ehuc ŋafe furec nunumu wâwâsic ecneekac.
Â hozec moc sasec gie baocmu ere ine ɋâricnezi hâmocne mucnezo.
Dâŋ i wâc jaza sanaŋketec manarâ bahacmâc junʒepieŋ.
Moc e wiacfâcne â soctofafâcne hone jauŋ â kime dopec mi ejareocmu e miti beherâ qâpuc sanaŋ ewec mucnezo.
Hozec moc jara‐ticne 60 bazuwec, erâ ŋic mocjahahec juwec, iŋucne sawa ʒâŋe‐ticne bâmec papiao râezo.
Erâ eehâmo gie bawec me mâcne, irec fuŋne taniŋkeocte kecʒiŋuc mu wioc ezo: Naru motec rocjoparâ gume jowac ejarewec me mâcne? Erao ŋic furune fisipie hezu hewâneŋ ejarewec me mâcne? Mitiŋic bâmec bajarewec me aricne? Jauŋ gie fuŋne fuŋne bawec me mâcne? Fuŋne‐jeŋic iŋuc hâcne manazo.
Hozec sahac ɋâri jaŋe ʒâŋe‐jeŋic bâmec papiao feocte mupie ine qatara‐jarezemec. Iŋucne jaŋe sasecte ejareme Kristo qâoma ecnerâ ŋicte sahac bapa eeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ mârâc dâŋ mupaŋkembiŋ i qâsuapie bahacnehec eekac.
Erâ wâc gie tâmiricte ficbiri juhuc oma qâoma erâ jueŋgopieŋ, erâ i sawa mâcne, dâŋ jawane â simbiŋne kosa wosepie feekac.
Irec no ʒiŋuc mukopac: Hozec sahac ɋâri jaŋe ŋic mocwâc rorâ naru motec rocjoparâ dete mamac â ro rikec qâ rikec enʒepieŋ. Iŋuc ehuc jupie kisâ jaŋe sâqocnere ojowa baniŋmurâ dâŋ basarâ behenʒepieŋ.
Hozec gâcne jaŋe ine biac hata qâsoriembiŋ Sataŋ bâjâpeeŋgopieŋ.
Hozec moc e miti ŋokac mocte ficko juhuc gie bafickeme ine eki bâmec bacnezejec, â qâqâhâc‐jeŋickonec mi rozejec, qâqâhâc‐jeŋic i hozec waha qaqane jaŋere ezejec.
Soŋaŋzi gie‐jeŋic bapie biaŋkeme wiac bafehuc ehâmo‐jarezo, ine miti mumu â qaqazu gie paŋʒâic baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne iŋuc ejarezo.
Miti papiao dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “Bulimakaozi gi bagarehuc sopâc kecɋaŋ nâzo mume mi sakarecnezemec.” Erâ moc ʒiŋuc: “Gie bapa ŋic e furi fuacneme sâckeocmu.”
Ŋic mocjahazi soŋaŋ moc dâŋko râezo mume mi manacnezemec, ŋic 2 me 3 jaŋe mupie ine manarâ giene bazemec.
Moczi bahac bâfuame âgo guru jaŋere maio mu bâtiŋ ecnetec gâcne jaŋe manahuc hâwic‐jopazejec wâc.
No Anutu â Jesu Kristo ere maio â aŋelo bufuŋfâc‐ticne jaŋere maio kecʒiŋuc mupaŋke‐garekopac: Dâŋ gaza qâmoc ekopac i aimuŋ soŋaŋkehaŋ moc mi wahazejec, ehuc maŋgere ŋic ŋokac wiac sâctiri moc mi ejarezemec.
Go ŋic miti giere fâro ehuc biac mi jambuŋ‐jopazemec, jaŋere kiŋzi gore faio fezacte. Gahacne maŋ sahac soŋaŋketec ɋaɋacnea fozejec.
Go bukiki â huc ʒâic gâbâ egareekacte opâ sawa mi nâzemec, waiŋ opâ afecne mac nâzemec wâc.
Ŋic tucne jaŋere sâqocne i fuŋne babataniŋ dameŋ mi maickeha qanaŋ fua taniŋkeekac, tucne jaŋere soŋsoŋ foku ʒâhec fuaocmu.
Eme eehâmo gie i iŋuc jaha fua taniŋkeekac, â iŋuc mi eekacko soŋsoŋ foku ʒâhec fua taniŋkeocmu.
Kiŋaŋ qaqa juŋgopieŋ jaŋe sasawa bomboŋfâc‐jeŋic sâsec‐jopahuc rume‐jarenʒepieŋ, Anuture ʒâŋe biŋe babawaha â miti susure fuazacte iŋuc enʒepieŋ.
Erâ bomboŋfâc‐jeŋic gâcne opâ ruac jaŋe ine ʒiŋuc mi muhuc bawahac‐jopanʒepieŋ: “Mitio sâcnâŋec mocjaha eŋgopeneŋ.” Aricne, “bomboŋfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe Wofuŋ manasiŋkepie âgo jauŋ ejareekacte ehâmo‐nâreeŋgopieŋ”, iŋuc muhuc kiŋaŋ maŋafec jaha qajarepie sâckeocmu. Go dâŋ i jaza mutâc ehuc faŋ qajarezemec.
Moc e dâŋ i âke sipurâ moc muhuc Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere dâŋbiaŋ qikiŋnehuc miti hatare sâcmutâc râpeckeekac ere ʒiŋuc muzo:
E maŋgâc erâ sahac‐ticne bafehuc dâŋ giŋkeme giŋ baʒihuc muraocmu, izi sasec‐ticne eocmu hâcne. Eme irec iiŋguuŋ, hehefaric, mumusoriŋ, qoqoric,
erâ wâc mu qaqatarac hati fuaekac. Ŋic iŋucne jaŋe maŋjeŋic sifuckerâ mamana‐jeŋic ʒikeme, moneŋ mafa fua‐nârezejec muhuc miti bajuniŋte mueŋgopieŋ.
Miti babajuzi jâmbomac sahacte dope bâbâfua‐nârene, mocjaha mukâroŋ tâmiric bajunʒepeneŋ.
Ʒiŋuc manasunʒepeneŋ: Fuanaŋte mâreŋko metariŋ warembeŋ, juku hâmonaŋte iŋuc jaha metariŋ jaha ranaŋmu.
Eme irec hâcne nânâ wiac â ŋaqi qoruc fonâreme manapene sâckeha junʒepeneŋ.
Moneŋ mafa sâko qâhâckezo muniŋmu, jaŋe eesâicte wiwiticko feniŋmu, erâ wiac omane fuŋne fuŋnere sasec bâfuarâ mana utuckehuc sipirickeniŋmu.
Moneŋ mafare andaczi sâqocne gâcnere jâcne hâcne. Ŋic tucnezi irec harac ehuc miti hata qâsorierâ buʒâic sâko bâfuambiŋ.
Anuture ŋic go wiac iŋucne geŋkezemec. Ehuc tiŋke biaŋ erâ mitihec â mamanasiŋhec â maŋjauŋhec â sasanaŋhec â buuruchec ecmurâ irec fotac qatariezemec.
Erâ mamanasiŋte juju gie biaŋ bazemec. Baku juju sanaŋte heʒakiezemec. Go irec hâcne hefârecgukicne, erâ go gahac iŋuc ecmurâ ŋic tutumaŋko mupaŋketec manambiŋ.
Anutu wiac sasawa juju bâfua‐jareekac ere maio â Jesu Kristo kia Pilatorao mumupaŋ fârine muwec ere maio musanaŋke‐garekopac:
Go sâcmutâc dâŋ mugarekicne i bâbâsifuc tâmiric â bâbâbiene tâmiric reŋkehuc juhaŋte Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo fisizejec.
Irec dameŋ maickeme juju aŋac â tâpiri buc focneekac Anutu hâcne, eki motâc rome fua taniŋkeocmu. E ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere Wofuŋ Sâko â fekicne jaŋere Fekicne.
E bucticne hâhâmo tâmiriczi, tatamac moczi moc mi raraʒine irec maŋnao juekac. E ŋic moczi moc mi honekicne erâ mi honezo. Mumumbiaŋ â tâpiri focneweczi focnehuc juocmu sanaŋ. Jâmbomac.
Ŋic mâreŋte moneŋ mafa ɋâfoŋne fojarekac jaŋe jazatec sahac‐jeŋic mi bafehuc wiac sisirowenere manapie izi hobeteŋne‐jeŋic eme ira mi âtesiŋnenʒepieŋ. Anutu e mâriri bâfua‐nâreme nâ bac ehuc jueŋgopeneŋ erao âtesiŋnenʒepieŋ.
Erâ mujaretec buafec â bokifac erâ eehâmo gie bahuc mitire fârine bocjaha bâfuanʒepieŋ.
Ehuc hobeteŋne‐jeŋic moc fofo sanaŋ i bâfuarâ juju fârine rauckenʒepieŋ.
O Timoteo, go merâfâc garekicne i soŋaŋkehuc bajuzemec. Erâ dâŋ jawane â fârimâc, ŋic gâcnezi bajuhuc ʒâŋene “dâŋ qame hukicne” mueŋgopieŋ, i qikiŋnezemec.
Ŋic tucnezi dâŋ ira hâcne qohotahuc mamanasiŋte hata qâsoriembiŋ. Aki anonoczi ŋoŋerao fosejec.
Paulo no Anuture micte, Kristo Jesuzi juju bâfuawec irec biŋedâŋ muiŋnepemurâ Kristo Jesure aposolo epozi
Timoteo motec biaŋ‐nane gore papia ʒi qâreŋkekopac. Anutu Mamac â Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Kristo Jesu eraonec aki anonoc, uruc jauŋ â wama gorao fotâcnerâ fozejec.
Mamac ŋosafâc‐nane jaŋe maŋfâsâc juhuc tuczi tuc Anuture kiŋaŋ qawarekupie ɋâric‐jeŋic noni iŋuc jaha eekopaczi daŋge âzâcnehuc nunumuo ʒuʒuhuc ŋafe furec manasucguhuc juekopac.
Nore ki busâqoc emeŋ, irec manasurâ honecguhuc bubiaŋ sâko manapemurâ enareekac.
Erâ mamanasiŋ fârine fogarekac, irec wâc manasuekopac, mamanasiŋ i hâcne mimige Loisi â neŋgocge Eunike jaherao foweczi gorao wâc fotâcnewec fokac i manakopac.
Eme no irec hâcne manasu‐gararâ mupe: No menane qizecgao râepe Anutuzi jambuŋ tahacguwec i hehâroŋketec ʒocne fuazejec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc manasuzemec: Anutu e hâbi‐nâŋec goroŋkeocte mâro mi nârewec, tâpirihec â maŋjauŋhec â maŋsowahec enaŋte nârewec.
Irec go Wofuŋ‐nâŋecte biŋe mutaniŋkecmurâ mimi gaŋgaŋ mi ezemec, erâ kâpâcwâru ŋicticne nore dâŋ mucmurâ acmeruŋ wâc mi ezemec. Go Anutuzi tâpiri gareme sâc no qâsuecnurâ Biŋebiaŋte erâ ʒârâ hâriŋ faio juzemec.
Eki hâcne bâpiaŋ‐nâporâ tiridâŋ‐ticnezi hefârec‐nâpowec. I biaŋ‐nâŋecte mâcne, e jahac maname fowecte aki anonoc‐ticnere erâ iŋuc enârewec. I mârâc jaha jâmbâŋ Kristo Jesure erâ biŋe qanârekicne.
Eme fârine fufua ine dameŋ ʒi bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec Kristo Jesu wahame fua tâcnewec. Eki hâcne hâmoc qâmizierâ juju â wiac fofo sanaŋ Biŋebiaŋko bajaŋgeŋke‐nârewec.
Eme no irec biŋe mumu â aposolo â qaqazu jupemurâ munarekicne.
No irec hâcne ʒârâ hâriŋ faio juekopac, ehuc mi mimieekopac. No manasiŋkeekopac ere maŋjahec mi eekopac, aricne, no ʒiŋuc manapaŋkeekopac, e tâpiriheczi ʒeŋaŋ‐nane sâcne soŋaŋke‐narehame dameŋ sâko maickezokac.
Dâŋ fârine irec biri‐ticne qazu‐garepo ijaha bâjâpezemec, i Kristo Jesu manasiŋkehuc â maŋzi jauŋkehuc iŋuc ezemec.
Tiri Mâro maŋnâŋecko juekac eki neŋgoc ŋegarehame miti kâdoc qârârie‐garekicne, i aimuŋ soŋaŋketec fogarezejec.
Asia mâreŋko behecnu‐fârembiŋ i manameŋ, Figelo â Hemogene jahe mâmâc.
Wofuŋ e Onesiforo ere wiacfâc maŋuruc qajarezejec. Mamac‐jeŋiczi kâpâcwâru ŋic nore mi takickeha bubiaŋ hati qanarehuc juwec.
E Roma haeo fisirâ ʒoɋac basacnuku bâfuacnuwec.
Wofuŋzi manaha dameŋ sâko Wofuŋtao uruc jauŋ bâfuazejec. E Efesoo wâc kiŋaŋ qaqa gie wemo afecne bawec i go gahac hone manac emeŋ.
Kristo Jesuzi aki anonoc tahacguwec i go motec‐nanezi bajuhuc qabocge qame huzejec.
Ŋic bocjahazi hone manac ehapie gie gaza gowatuc epo, gie i hâcne ŋic tucne Wofuŋte hatao jueŋgopieŋ â miti munusuŋkeniŋte tâpiri fojarekac iŋucne jaŋe qazu‐jaretec banʒepieŋ wâc.
Go Kristo Jesure momori ŋic sanaŋne juhuc irec ʒârâ hâriŋ kâdocge rocmurâ mi takicguzejec.
Moc e momori gie baocmuzi wemocko sahackopec gie fuŋne fuŋne ameckeocmu. E momori jaŋere birio râeweczi wiac honeme sâckeocmu i sawa eocte muocmu.
Moc e sisiric gie bahuc sâcmutâc qâsuaocmuzi furine mi roocmu.
Moc e he sarac ehuc ʒâic‐ticne manaocmuzi nânâ fârine micne barâ bâsurâ nâme sâckeocmu.
Dâŋ gazakopac i manatâc qâtâc ezemec. Wofuŋ eki maŋge bâwiŋkeme mana tara‐fârezemec.
Go Jesu Kristore mamanac juzemec; e Dawidire ɋâriczi hâmockonec ɋârerâ faharewec; Biŋebiaŋ‐ticne iŋuc hâcne muekopac.
Biŋebiaŋ irec erâ ʒâic fâro manaekopac, erâ wâc sâqocne bapa iŋucne niŋgiŋnumbiŋ ŋekopac. Anuture dâŋ ine mi niŋgiŋkekicne.
No ʒâic gie sasawa i Anutu bâwosâefâc‐ticne jaŋere erâ ŋetâcneekopac, jaŋe Kristo Jesure bâbâpiaŋzi ŋihe umbiŋ ejareha eri tatamac fofone mâmâc rauckeniŋte iŋuc eekopac hâcne.
Dâŋ ʒiŋuc fokac i jâmbomac: Ere hâmocko ʒuhuckembeŋko juju‐ticnao iŋuc jaha ʒuhuckenaŋmu,
ʒâic mana takirenaŋmuo ehec guriŋ bapa gie wâc banaŋmu. E mic banaŋmuo eki iŋuc jaha mic bacnâpoocmu.
Mumupaŋ‐nâŋeczi dockeocmuo ere mumupaŋzi sanaŋkeocmu. Moc murâ moc mu i erao mi fokac.
Go dâŋ i heqâre‐jarerâ Anuture maio mujomirehuc jaza sanaŋketec dâŋ racnere mu iigoc mi enʒepieŋ. I wiac fârimâc, iŋuc ehuc miti mamana sipiric‐jopaniŋmu.
Anutuzi mana‐gareme sâckeocte ʒoɋachec juhuc giege bazemec, ehuc dâŋ fâri qizecne fâretiŋ jaha mujaŋgeŋkehuc jutec mimizi gieŋic gore faio mi fezejec.
Â dâŋ jawanere ojowane bapie mi bafic‐jopazemec. Iŋuc eeŋgopieŋzi eraku miti beheniŋmu.
Burecdâŋ‐jeŋiczi biac wicbâroŋ iŋucne erâ ŋedâmâreocmu. Ŋic iŋucne jaŋeraonec moc Himenaio â moc Fileto.
Jahe dâŋ fâri beherâ mukopirec, fafahare i biac fuawec. Iŋuc muhuc ŋic gâcne miti ba imac ejarekopirec.
Anutuzi qânâ wâtuŋ râeme huwec ine qiŋ herâ domakac. Maqâreŋ‐ticne ʒiŋuc fokac: “Wofuŋzi biŋefâc‐ticne ʒâŋitac‐jopaekac.” Erâ moc ʒiŋuc: “Wofuŋte ʒâŋe bajuŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒeŋgoma bâbâsifuc râpeckenʒepieŋ.”
Ufuŋ sâkoo râqâc wiac gol â siliwazi bakicne i sawa mâcne, jâczi â mâreŋzi bakicne i mâmâc ŋekac. Râqâc gâcnao wiac furi sâkozi huocmu, gâcnao wiac omanezi huocmu.
Moc e bâbâsifuc wiac qikiŋneme maŋne ɋaɋackeme râqâc furi sâko eme ufuŋ runezi jambuŋkerâ bajuhuc izi gie biaŋ fuŋne fuŋne baocmu.
Socɋârizi wiac fuŋne fuŋnere andac eeŋgopieŋ i bâec bazemec. Ehuc maŋjaŋic biaŋkekicnezi Wofuŋ mu wâwâsic ecneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe bafic‐jopatec tiŋke biaŋ eere â mamanasiŋte â maŋjauŋte â wamare henʒiriŋnenʒepieŋ.
Mugufuc dâŋ mutucne â racne igockezemec, irec fârine mu qaqatarac sawa fuaekac i manakic.
Wofuŋte kiŋaŋŋiczi mu hehefaric mi ezejec, e ŋic sasawa âgo ejarehuc miti micafec qazu‐jarezejec, â pepecne ecnepie wiac aaricko mi ejarezejec;
erâ ŋic maŋrâŋgeŋ ine urucko mu bâtiŋ ejareme Anutu e jahac moc bawahac‐jopame maŋjeŋic bârisierâ dâŋfâri ʒâŋitanʒepieŋ.
Eme maŋjeŋic uŋtome, Sataŋte dâŋ reŋkeniŋte wiwitic‐ticnao kicjopawec i hetaranʒepieŋ.
Go ʒiŋuc manazemec: Dameŋ tarazo eha sâqocnezi sawe mâririackeocmu.
Ŋic kecʒiŋucne juniŋmu hâcne: Jaŋe jaŋacnere sawa manoniehuc juju, moneŋ sasec, ruruc bâbâcne, sahac mumuteŋ, musurecne, neŋgoc mamac dâŋ qaqatara, nâme nikecne, araŋ bapa tâmiric,
maŋjauŋ tâmiric, kiŋ babaju, micko âkechec, nâ areŋne, qicqucne, wiac biaŋne qaqaisoc,
docbapa, enʒaŋaucne, pepecne, sasecte aŋac kâcɋene bajuhuc Anuture aŋac mi mamana,
sahaczi miti hawari juhuc mitio sasanaŋ tâmiric juju. Iŋucne hâcne jupie honec‐joparâ râpec‐jopazemec.
Ŋic mukopac jaŋeraonec tucnezi kamierâ ficbiri juhuc ŋokac kosane, bahac fuŋne fuŋne bâfuambiŋ â saseczi ejareme ra qa ware qa eeŋgopieŋ, iŋucnezi jaŋere eniŋte mu bâdoc ejareeŋgopieŋ;
ŋokac dameŋ sâc mamana gie bahuc dâŋ fâri qizecnere fuŋne mi mana taraeŋgopieŋ iŋucne hâcne.
Mârâc jaha Jane â Jambere jaha Mosere dâŋ bawahapic, iŋuc jaha ŋic mukopac jaŋe maŋjeŋic sifuckekicnere mamanasiŋte hata kâuc bahuc mutuc eeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ wiac eejeŋic wemocko boc efeniŋmu. Mutuc‐jeŋicte fuŋne taniŋkeme ŋic sasawa hone‐fâreniŋmu, Jane Jambere jaherao fuawec iŋuc.
Go jupe juju‐nanezi ine miti mumu‐nane, juju‐nane, giebapa‐nane, mamanasiŋ‐nane, buuruc‐nane, maŋjauŋ‐nane, sasanaŋ‐nane,
fific guguriŋ‐nane â ʒârâ hâriŋ‐nane, irec hatane âtehuc bâjâpecnuekic. Antiokia haeo â Ikonioŋ haeo â Listera haeo fific guguriŋ enarepie ʒâic serereŋ mo iŋucne manapo! Eme Wofuŋzi sifu wiac iŋucnaonec bataracnuwec.
Erâ ŋic gâcne wâc Kristo Jesurao qohotahuc miti hata âteniŋmu jaŋe mâmâc fific guguriŋ fua‐jare‐fâreocmu.
Ŋic repicne â eeatucne jaŋe ine jaŋacnao â gâcne jaŋerao eeatuc gie bafeku repire sanaŋkeniŋmu.
Go ine dâŋ qazu‐garekicne â maŋge ekicne ira qohotahuc juzemec. Dâŋ moraonec romeŋ i kâuc mi bakomec.
Erâ go ɋieocnecteaŋ tiri papia wose manac ewefuhuc juekicte izi maŋge batamaeha Kristo Jesu manasiŋkehuc bâbâpiaŋ sâcne bâfuacmu.
Miti papia i Anutu Mâro‐ticnere qafeŋko fua‐fârewec, eme irec wose manac epene mitire fuŋne qazu‐nâreekac â mu tutuc enâreekac â mu bâtiŋ enâreekac â tiŋne hata nâwotuekac.
Iŋuc enârehuc baʒawiec‐nâpokume nâŋâc Anuture ŋicfâri erâ eehâmo gie fuŋne fuŋne sâcne bâfuanaŋmu.
No Anuture maio â Kristo Jesu, juku Wofuŋ tâpirihec fisirâ qâricne â hâmokicne dâŋnâŋec mutaraocmu, ere maio gazapaŋkepe manac:
Go miti muminʒiriŋkezemec, ehuc ŋic irec ejareha me mi ejareha ɋicwânʒâŋ jaha jazazemec. Erâ ŋic mu tutuc â mu bâtiŋ â mu sawaŋ ejarehuc qaqazu giege uneŋko tatakic tâmiric bazemec.
Juku dameŋ moc maickeme miti riucdâŋ manapie joŋtaweme qikiŋneniŋmu. Qikiŋnerâ miti hazecte nâpene‐jeŋic sawa eme qaqazu mana wosâc ejarepie maŋjeŋic sâckeme iŋucnea guruhec rocjopaniŋmu.
Ehuc mitidâŋ fârine râpeckerâ nemu binaŋko qohotaniŋmu.
Go ine dameŋ sâc maŋtiec juzemec, ʒârâ hâriŋzi faigao feme sanaŋkezemec, Biŋebiaŋ muromackezemec, gie mugarekicne i basarickezemec.
No ine biac due bazo ekopac, rara dameŋ‐nane bembeŋkekac.
No juju gie biaŋ batarakopac, hata‐nane âte wareku mao fisikopac, mamanasiŋ‐nane soŋaŋkehape mi ŋeŋgoroŋkewec.
Eme ʒi sambâŋte eri hendiŋ biŋe‐nane râekicne fokac, i juku dameŋ sâkoo Wofuŋ, mumutara tiŋne eki narezokac, erâ no sawa mâcne, fifisi‐ticnere aŋac‐jopaha jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc jarezokac.
Go fâro barâ norao biac warezemec.
Dema e mâreŋkopec wiac irec mana kikiwerâ behecnurâ Tesalonike haeo fâwec, Kereske e Galatiao rawec, â Tito e Dalimatia mâreŋko fâwec.
Ʒi Lukahec buc jukoperec. Mareko jowatec mâmâc warezepirec. E giere sâcne baficnuocmu.
Tikiko ine sorepe Efeso haeo fâwec.
Warezo ehuc hata ŋaqi‐nane Troa haeo Karpo ere ficko hetarapo i bawarezemec, erâ papia‐nane qizecne â rehacne mâmâc amecke warezemec.
Aeŋzi wiac bapa ŋic Alesande e sâqocne bocjaha enarewec, irec Wofuŋzi juku okacne bazucneocmu.
Dâŋnâŋec mâretec ro waha âte ewec. Go ere sawaŋge qazemec.
Dâŋgie‐nane bâbâni fuawec dameŋ ira âgo moczi dâŋte mi baficnuwec, aricne, jaŋe behecnu‐fârembiŋ; kiŋjeŋic mi fojarezejec.
Wofuŋ eki ine miti musawe tarape qâpuc jaŋe mana‐fâreniŋte dopecnurâ basanaŋnuwec, ehuc laioŋte mickonec bataracnuwec.
Wofuŋ e sâqocne irec me irec ŋezicnurâ sambâŋ uucmaŋ‐ticnao râecnuocmu. Erâo eri tatamac forahuc juzejec sanaŋ. Jâmbomac.
No Prisika â Aqila â Onesiforo wiacfâc‐ticne mâmâc manasu‐jare‐fârekopac, i jazazemec.
Erasto e Korinti haeo juwec â Trofimo e huc bame Milete haeo hetarapo.
Go hoemaŋ dameŋ mi maickeha biac warezemec. Eubulozi manasu‐garekac, erâ wâc Pudeŋ â Lino â Klaudia â âgo sasawa jaŋe iŋuc jaha manasu‐gareŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋzi maŋ qâqâtâcgehec juzehec. Aki anonoczi ŋoŋerao fozejec.
Paulo, Anuture kiŋaŋŋic â Jesu Kristore aposolo, no gie munarekicne i Anuture bâwosâecfâc jaŋe mamanasiŋhec eniŋte â dâŋ fâri qizecne mitio fokac i mana taraniŋte;
ehuc juju sanaŋte biŋedâŋ, Anutu burec tâmiriczi mârâc jaha dameŋ mi fowecko muwec, i manahuc juju sanaŋ worickehuc juniŋte.
Dâŋticne i hâcne dameŋ‐ticnao mufuahuc Anutu bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋeczi noni muromackepemurâ mupaŋke‐narewec.
Eme mamanasiŋ wirec fonârekacte motec jâmbâŋ‐nane jukomec Tito go hâcne papia ʒi râe‐garekopac. Anutu Mamac â bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec Kristo Jesu eraonec aki anonoc â wama gorao fotâcnerâ fozejec.
Gie tofane fokac i bataracmurâ Kreta nucko hetaracgupo, irec gazapo iŋuc ehuc hae sâc soŋaŋ râec‐jopa razemec.
Ŋic moc bahac fâsâc â ŋokac mocjahahec juocmu, erâ naru motecfâcne mitihec â ʒaubac tâmiric â pepecne tâmiric juniŋmu, ŋic iŋucne râec‐jopazemec.
Micne bapa moc e Anuture gie soŋaŋkeekaczi bahacmâc juzejec, ehuc pepecne tâmiric â ʒâʒâicne tâmiric â waiŋ âmbâŋ mi nânâ â ʒikare aafec tâmiric â moneŋ mafare sasec tâmiric, iŋuc juzejec.
Erâ jauŋhec â wiac biaŋne sasawa dodopecke â wama ruaine, tiŋne, araŋ bapanehec â sowa bâtâchec juzejec.
Mitidâŋ mu qaqazuc ehuc hatane basanaŋkekicne i paŋnea bajuzejec. Eme izi tâpiri râcneme dâŋ fâri biaŋ ŋic qazu‐jarehuc mu sawaŋ ejarezejec â miti âke sipueŋgopieŋ jaŋere dâŋ bawahazejec.
Ŋic bocjahazi râŋgeŋne â dâŋ racne mumu â eeatuc‐jeŋichec juŋgopieŋ, Judaŋiczi opâ ruac jaŋerao wemo afecnezi iŋuc juŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic izi hâcne moneŋ mafare erâ, mumusifuc‐jeŋic qatarakicne i musawehuc garikiŋ gâcne furu jaha ba sipiric ejareeŋgopieŋ; ŋic iŋucne jaŋere mic qâbâzickezo.
Kreta jaŋacne porofete moczi ʒiŋuc muwec: “Kreta ŋic jaŋe burec hati, qowi mimicne â wiac âmbâŋ nânâ.”
No dâŋ i manape jâmbomac ekac. Irec go mu bâtiŋ sanaŋne ejaretec mamanasiŋzi bâɋârec‐jopame ɋiɋic qanʒepieŋ.
Ehuc Judaŋic jaŋere mamana gufuc dâŋ racne â ŋic dâŋfâri râpeckembiŋ jaŋere sâcmutâc dâŋ mi mananʒepieŋ.
Maŋɋaɋachec jueŋgopieŋzi wiac sasaware manapie ɋaɋacne eekac. Â sâqocnezi maŋjeŋic bâbiekume mamanasiŋ tâmiric embiŋ jueŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ine mamana â maŋjeŋic mâmâc wâwânâŋhec efârewecte wiac mocte manapie ɋaɋacne mi eekac.
Jaŋe, Anuture fuŋne manaeŋgopeneŋ, miczi iŋuc muhapie eebapa‐jeŋiczi ine mickeekac. Jaŋe ŋic mamakâcne â dâŋ qaqatara, â gie biaŋne moc bapanere sâc mâcne.
Go ine miti riucdâŋ fokac irec sâcko jaza mutâc ezemec.
Ehuc mutec ŋic kâcɋene jaŋe sowa bâtâc â metâne â wama ruaine jupie mamanasiŋ â maŋjauŋ â maŋuruc furu fojarezejec.
Erâ ŋokac kâcɋene iŋuc jaha jazatec miti ŋokac fârine erâ gupe micko âkec tâmiric â nârâmbe tâmiric juhuc juju biaŋte qaqazu enʒepieŋ.
Ehuc ŋokac socɋâri jaza mutâc epie ŋowe ɋiefâc‐jeŋic jauŋ biaŋne ejarenʒepieŋ.
Erâ mimihec erâ sasec tâmiric juhuc nâ qofac â wiac bâpiaŋke emasaŋ ehuc ŋowefâc‐jeŋic sâsec‐jopanʒepieŋ. I Anuture dâŋ susure fuazacte iŋuc enʒepieŋ.
Ŋicmotec iŋuc jaha esoc‐jopatec sowa bâtâc‐jeŋichec junʒepieŋ.
Ehuc go gahac wiac biaŋne sasawa irec micne bajarehuc eehâmo gie batec honerâ bâjâpecgunʒepieŋ. Miti mutiŋnehuc â bâmâckehuc jazazemec.
Erâ hata sanaŋ fokac irec sâcko musaricketec kisâ jaŋere maŋ henʒaŋneme jaŋe burec enâreniŋte dâŋ basarâ behenʒepieŋ.
Kiŋaŋ qaqa jazatec bomboŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere dâŋ reŋke‐fârehuc kiŋaŋ biaŋne qajarenʒepieŋ, ehuc micjeŋicko mi ronʒepieŋ.
Erâ fiuc serereŋ tâmiric juhuc wiac‐jeŋic hone qâzuc ehâmonʒepieŋ. Iŋuc ehuc bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec Anutu dâŋticne ba eric ecneniŋmu.
Mâreŋ sâc ŋic biaŋkenaŋte Anuture aki anonoczi bâtâcne bâtimuŋ ewec.
Erâ izi bâfiriec‐nâpohuc bâtiŋ‐nâpohame qâpuc hata â wiac jawanere andac i qikiŋnerâ mâreŋ ʒira wama ruaine â tiŋne â mitine junʒepeneŋ.
Iŋuc juhuc Anutu sâko â bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec Kristo Jesu ere eri tatamac fua tâcneme juju aŋacko fisinaŋte irec mamanac junʒepeneŋ.
Eki hâcne nâŋâcnere due bahuc sindaŋkonec bâhoc‐nâpowec, erâ fuŋfuŋfâc‐ticne juhuc mitire fârine ʒoɋac erâ bâfuanaŋte ʒure bâpiaŋ enârewec.
Go paŋʒâic erâ dâŋ i hâcne jazahuc mu sawaŋ â mu bâtiŋ ejarezemec. Ŋic jaŋe go mi hucgunʒepieŋ.
Go dâŋ heɋâre‐jarehuc jazatec ŋic jaŋe kia gawaman â fekicne araŋ bajarehuc dâŋjeŋic reŋkenʒepieŋ, erâ gie biaŋne fuŋne fuŋne fokac irec afeckerâ banʒepieŋ.
Erâ mumusoriŋ â dâŋ mumuc mi enʒepieŋ. Aricne, wamane juhuc ŋic maŋuruc ejare‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Nâŋâc mârâc jaha iŋuc jaha maŋmutuc erâ râŋgeŋne juhuc qac qâsoric ejumbeneŋ. Erâ sasec fuŋne fuŋne irec kiŋaŋ qahuc sindaŋ â iiŋguuŋ bâfuarâ mamakâcne erâ kikisuec ejumbeneŋ.
Izi ʒâhec ine bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec Anutu uruc jauŋ â buafec‐ticne fua tâcneme
eki nâŋâc tiŋne juhuc gie moc bambeŋte mâcne, buuruc‐ticnere erâ juju ɋârire opâzi â Tiri Mâroraonec fufua ɋâricnezi bâpiaŋ‐nâpowec.
E bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristore erâ Tiri Mâro afecne mi qoŋgiŋke‐nârewec.
I nâŋâc Kristore aki anonocte erâ kiŋnâŋec fâsâeme juju sanaŋte mamanac juku rauckenaŋte iŋuc enârewec.
Dâŋ i jâmbomac, eme go ɋicwânʒâŋ erâ âkendâŋnetec Anutu manasiŋkeeŋgopieŋzi eehâmo gie baniŋte ʒoɋac enʒepieŋ. I wiac biaŋne, i epie ŋic jauŋ bacjopaocmu.
Â mugufuc dâŋ jawane â fuŋne qaqa dâŋbiri â sâcmutâc dâŋte mu qaqatarac â bac bârisic ine geŋkezemec. I wiac racne â fârimâc.
Ŋic hâme âkefâucne moc uŋdâŋ mocjaha me jajahec âzâcnetecne qikiŋneme behetec buc juzejec.
Go manakic, ŋic iŋucne e qaqaharicne, maŋnezi mumu hehec ecne‐bipieha sâqocne baekac.
No Atema me Tikiko sorepe gorao fâ fisime biac Nikopoli haeo ware bâfuacnuzemec, no hae ira hâcne hoemaŋko juzo mukopac.
Sâcmutâc mamana ŋic Ʒena â Apolo jahe miti kiŋaŋ ranicte nânâ mafa wiac bâmocke‐jactetec wiac mi basahuc bititiezepirec.
Ŋicfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe wâc eehâmo gie baku maŋjeŋic ezejec, eme sahacte dope babasa fuaocmu sâc jauŋ gie bapie miti‐jeŋiczi fârinehec ezejec.
Ŋic nohec jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe sasawa go manasu‐gareŋgopieŋ. Mitio âgo enâreeŋgopieŋ jaŋe manasu‐jareŋgopeneŋ irec wâc jazazemec. Aki anonoczi sâcŋopa‐fârezejec.
Paulo, Kristo Jesure kâpâcwâru ŋic no, â âgo‐nâŋec Timoteo, nâhe Filemoŋ joroc babafic‐nâhec gore papia ʒi râekoperec;
erâ wâc ŋokac âgo‐nâhec Apia â momori âgo‐nâhec Akipo, erâ Filemoŋ gore ficko mitire tumaŋneeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋere mâmâc râekoperec.
Mamac‐nâŋec Anutu â Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo eraonec aki anonoc â wama ŋoŋerao fotâcnerâ fozejec.
No nunumuo gore manasuhuc sâc Anutu‐nane daŋge âzâcneekopac.
Go Wofuŋ Jesurao â mitiŋic jaŋerao maŋge domakac â jaŋere mamanac juekic irec biŋe manakopac hâcne.
Eme go mamanasiŋko nâŋehec maŋ mocjaha emeŋte wiac biaŋne Kristoraonec fua‐nârewec fokac i sasawa mana taracmurâ numuekopac.
Âgo‐nane, go mitiŋic bubiaŋ qajareekomec, irec no maŋjauŋgere bunane urueme wemo afecne ʒeri epo.
Go wiac ecmurâ i no Kristore micte mupaŋke‐garezo murâ sâcne afeckerâ ezapo,
erâ sifu maŋjauŋte erâ mâc mu hemunaŋ egarehuc mupe; ŋicqizec Paulo no hâcne, erâ dameŋ ʒi wâc Kristo Jesure kâpâcwâru ŋic epozi,
no motec‐mae Onesimo, kâpâcwâru ficko juhape fua‐narewec, ere gazakopac.
E mârâcko jugareme mi sâckewec, ʒi ine no â go mâmâc junâcteme sâckekac.
Buhândâŋ‐nane e hâcne sifu bârisie‐garepe fakac.
No Biŋebiaŋte erâ kâpâcwâru ficko ŋehape gore âkehoc kiŋaŋ qanareocte sakarezo mupo.
Erâ go mi manahaŋtecne sakarepe urucko mâcne, jâiŋko qikiŋne‐narezicte manabâc ehuc bârisie‐garekopac.
Behecgume e tâmiric piticne jumeŋ, i fuŋne ʒiŋucte mecne, risie‐garerâ gohec jusanaŋkeocte.
Kiŋaŋ qaqage sawa mâcne, mitio âgoge erâ juocte fagarekac. No hâcne iŋucne junarewec, â go ine fehuc jugareocmu i ʒiŋucte: Sahaczi gore juweczi Wofuŋte erâ bufuŋge ekac.
Go nore manatec âgoge ekopacko ine e hefârockehuc manatec Paulo hefârockekopac ezejec.
Wiac moc sipiricke‐garewecko me tofage moc erao fokacko ine nore muzemec.
Paulo no hâcne ʒi qâreŋke‐garekopac, okacne bazu‐garepemu. No nahacne tofa wâc gorao kâcɋene fokac, noraonec hâcne fuameŋ i; erâ irec wemocte boc mupemu.
Âgo‐nane, go Wofuŋte erâ wiac buafec tahacnucmurâ enarekac. Kristore erâ bubiaŋ qanarezemec.
Go micrereŋge fokac i manahuc dâŋ ʒi qâreŋke‐garekopac. Erâ manakopac, gazakopac i sawa mi ehuc maŋgere gâcne ʒuhuckecmu.
Ŋoŋe nunumuzi bataracnupie Wofuŋzi no bâriesiecnu‐ŋareme fâpemurâ mukopac, eme go irec ŋeŋe hewâneŋke‐narezemec.
Kristo Jesure kâpâcwâru ŋic âgo‐nane Epafra e manasu‐garekac.
Erâ babaficfâc‐nane Mareko, Aristako, Dema â Luka jaŋe iŋuc jaha manasu‐gareŋgopieŋ.
Wofuŋ Jesu Kristo ere aki anonoczi maŋŋeŋicko fozejec.
Anutu e mârâc jaha porofete ejareme jaŋe mimiŋnefâc‐nâŋec dâŋ hawarine fuŋne fuŋne â hatane fuŋne fuŋne jaza warekuhapie
ine ʒâhec tataranao, dameŋ ʒira hâcne, Ŋokâ ecneme dâŋ nâzâwec. Ŋokâ e wiac sasawa irec rune juocte mucnewec, ehec hâcne wiac bâfua‐fârepic.
Anutu eri tatamac‐ticnere qâreŋ erao fuawec fokacte â juju‐ticnere sâc juekacte tâpiri dâŋticnezi wiac sasawa dope siŋsiŋ ecneha foekac. Eki sâqocne ʒure bataniŋ gie bafârerâ faic fekicne sâko ere fâreo fewec ŋekac.
Aŋelo hucjopa‐fârewec jukac, irec sâcko aŋelo ʒâŋe siricke‐fârehuc ʒâŋe fekicne hotâckewec.
Anutuzi mo aŋelo mo kecʒiŋuc moc âzâcnewec: “Go hâcne Ŋokâ‐nane, no miŋecgac bâfuacgukopac”? Me kecʒiŋuc: “Noni Mamac ecnerâ jupemu â eki Ŋokâ enarerâ juzejec”?
Moc ine juku mârâc fufua e mâreŋko râeme wahaocmu irec dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Anuture aŋelofâc jaŋe dieŋzi hecne‐fârenʒepieŋ.”
Aŋelo jaŋere kecʒiŋuc mukicne: “E aŋelofâcne hawari‐jeŋic bâtikieme mâŋâŋ eeŋgopieŋ, â kiŋaŋ qaqafâcne hawari‐jeŋic bâtikieme ʒocbâruŋ eeŋgopieŋ.”
Ŋokâre ine ʒiŋuc mukicne: “Anutu go ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋege i ŋeŋe sanaŋ ŋeraʒihuc juocmu, â ŋicwofuŋ gunuge i bâbâtiŋ gunu biaŋ.
Go tiŋnere egareekac â hehesic ine râsi ecneekic. Irec Anutu, gore Anutu, eki ʒeri wokemaŋ rua‐garewec, i âgofâcge jaŋere sâc jâuruhuc rua‐garewec.”
Moc ʒiŋuc mucnekicne: “Wofuŋ go fufuŋkenao mâreŋte hobeteŋ râemeŋ, â sambâŋne sambâŋne jaŋe megere qâreŋ.
Jaŋe siroweniŋmu, go ine jusanaŋkekic, jaŋe ŋaqi iŋucne raŋɋaŋkeniŋmu.
Ŋaqi iŋucne epie goki bataforiec‐jopacmu, eme jaŋe hawari moc eniŋmu. Goki ine juekic ijaha juekic, â jara dameŋge i moc mi taraocmu.”
Anutu e mo aŋelo mo ʒiŋuc moc âzâcnewec: “Ware fâre‐naneo ŋehaŋtec râsifâcge guruc‐jopape kikegere ââtesiŋ enʒepieŋ”?
Aŋelo sasawa jaŋe mârozi kiŋaŋ qaqa, ŋic bâbâpiaŋ rauckeniŋte mukicne jaŋe bafic‐jopaniŋte sorec‐jopakicne.
Irec nâŋâc ma bâtirinʒipeŋte dâŋ manambeŋ i mocwâc paŋʒâic mana sakac enʒepeneŋ.
Aŋelo mickonec dâŋ mukicne i mupaŋkekicne, eme huhucke â qaqatara fuame okacnehec ejujec,
izi wemocko bâbâpiaŋ dâŋ fekicne qikiŋnepene okacmâc foocmu? I Wofuŋ e jahac qanaŋ mufuawec, eme hazec fâri‐jeŋiczi manambiŋ jaŋe muwarekupie sanaŋke‐nârewec.
Ehame Anutu e jahac wâc mâsi â tâpiri wiac ʒâŋe furu bâfuahuc dâŋ i dopeckehuc Tiri Mârore taha biaŋ manawec sâc kâdoc qajarehuc feŋeŋ râecnewec.
Hae mâreŋ ʒâhec fuaocmu, dâŋne muŋgopeneŋ hâcne, i Anutuzi aŋelo jaŋe guriŋne baniŋte mi muwec.
Mitiŋic moczi irec dâŋ mutaniŋkewec ine ʒiŋuc: “Go ŋic e wemomac‐ticnere manasucneekic, â ŋicte ɋâric e wemo‐ticnere hone maiŋ ecneekic?
Go dameŋ ŋondeŋ bembeŋne mac aŋelo jaŋere wahamicnao juocte mucnemeŋ, go tatamac â ʒâŋe biŋezi erickemeŋ,
ehuc wiac sasawa kike‐ticnere rurumaŋko râemeŋ.” Anutu e wiac sasawa ŋicte rurumaŋko râewec, i bâtâc mi bahuc wiac furu jaha qikiŋnecne‐fârewec ekac. Dameŋ ʒiŋuczia ine wiac ʒeŋgoma ŋicte rurumaŋko guruckekicne i mi honeeŋgopeneŋ.
Jesu ine honeŋgopeneŋ, e dameŋ ŋondeŋ bembeŋne mac aŋelo jaŋere wahamicne juhuc hâmocte ʒâic manawecte tatamac â ʒâŋe biŋe tahackekicne hâporâ jukac. E Anutuzi aki anonoc enâreocte mume hâmoc hâtâne ŋic sasawa nâŋâcnere erâ manawec hâcne.
Wiac sasawa irec rune â bâbâfua e naru motecfâcne bocjaha eri tatamac‐ticnao jowac‐jopaocte manasuhuc bâbâpiaŋ‐jeŋicte micne bapa e ʒâic serereŋ gie baku mao fisiocte mucnewec i sâcke‐hâmowec.
Eme maŋfuru bacjopakac e mecne â furu bacjopakicne jaŋe mecne Mamac‐jeŋic mocjaha, irec ɋafâc‐nane mujareocte maname mi quŋkeekac.
Dâŋticne ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “No ʒâŋe biŋege ɋafâc‐nane muromacke‐jarepe, kikefuŋ guruo ʒeri mumuteŋ egarepe.”
Erâ moc ʒiŋuc: “No erao roweckehuc jupemu.” Erâ moc ʒiŋuc: “Ʒi no erâ Anutuzi ɋie guru narewec nâŋe mâmâc juŋgopeneŋ.”
Eme ɋie jaŋe sahac biuchec sasawa jueŋgopieŋte eki ijaha wâc rowec. I e jahacne hâmoczi hâmoc rune Sataŋ hâcne tâpiri‐ticne qame goroŋkewecte,
erâ wâc hâmocte hâhâwiczi niŋgiŋ‐jopame dameŋ‐jeŋic sâc kâpâcwâru ficko ŋejumbieŋ jaŋe batarac‐jopaocte iŋuc ewec.
Wiac i aŋelo kime dopec mi ejareekac i, e Abrahamte ɋâricfâc nâŋâc kime dopec enâreekac.
Eme irec hâcne ɋafâc‐ticne jaŋehec sâc mocjaha jâmbâŋ eocte mucnekicne, hatane gâcne moc mi fowec. I taha bapa sâko urucne â hazec hâricne erâ Anuture maio taha gie bahuc ŋic ŋokac nâŋâcne sâqocne ʒure tâmireocte iŋuc ewec jukac hâcne.
E jahac ʒâic manahuc eesâicko raʒiwecte ŋic eesâic fua‐nâreha sâcne bafic‐nâpoekac.
Mitiŋic âgofâc‐nane, sambâŋte mâmâc hefârec‐ŋopakicne, ŋoŋe miti kiŋaŋ ŋic â taha bapa sâko Jesu, ʒâŋene murâ rereŋ eeŋgopeneŋ, erao findendeŋnenʒepieŋ.
Eki gie runere mume rereŋ juwec, Mosezi Anuture ficko juwec irec sâc juwec hâcne.
Fic baekac ere ʒâŋe biŋezi ficte ʒâŋe biŋe jâuruekac, sâc ijaha Jesu ʒai ʒonʒoŋ‐ticnezi Mosere sirickekac.
Ficne ficne i bâbâfua‐ticnehec, wiac sasawa irec bâbâfua ine Anutu.
Mose e Anuture ficko jufârehuc mume rereŋ gie bawec, i dâŋ ʒâhec fufuanere biŋe muocte kiŋaŋ qaqa juwec.
Kristo e ine Ŋokâzi fic rune jukac. Ficticne nâŋâc hâcne. Erâ i mâc mâcne, wiac biŋe qanârekicne irec mamanac paŋʒâic â bubiaŋko juhapene taraocmu, ine ficticne eŋgopeneŋ muzo.
Irec Tiri Mârozi dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec i nâŋâcne biŋe ekac: “Ŋoŋe miŋecgac dâŋticne manaŋgopieŋko,
tuhuo eesâic fuame aaricko ekicne, maŋsanaŋ iŋuc mi enʒepieŋ.
Mimiŋnefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋe ira wiac bapa‐nane jara 40 honembiŋ, erâ sifu pepecne enarehuc esâicnumbiŋ.
Eme no irec manape gâpâreme jaŋere ʒiŋuc mupo: ‘Jaŋe maŋjeŋiczi raŋɋa raŋɋa qâsorieeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe nore hata moc mi hone manac embiŋ.’
Iŋucte kimbeŋ qajarehuc mumupaŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupo: ‘Jaŋe nore jujumana hae mâreŋko moc mi raʒinʒepieŋ’.”
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋeraonec moc e miti qikiŋnehuc maŋ gâgâpâc erâ Anutu jujune râpeckezacte soŋaŋ babac ehuc junʒepieŋ.
Erâ ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne miŋecgaczi miŋegac forahuc juocmu sâc faŋ qaqac enʒepieŋ, sâqocnere eeatuczi ŋoŋeraonec ŋic moc ecneme maŋbâzic ezackohec.
Nâŋâc Kristore miti kâdoc babaju, ine fuŋkehuc manasiŋkembeŋ mamanasiŋ i paŋnea bajuku mao fisinaŋmuzi eŋgopeneŋ.
Dâŋ ʒiŋuc fokac: “Ŋoŋe miŋecgac dâŋticne manaŋgopieŋko, aaricko ekicne, maŋsanaŋ iŋuc mi enʒepieŋ”,
ine weni jaŋe dâŋticne mana‐bipiehuc aaric bâfuambiŋ? I mockoneczi mâcne, Mosezi micne bajareme Aigita mâreŋkonec warembiŋ ŋicguru i sasawa jaŋe hâcne.
Me weni jaŋere Anutuzi maname gâpâreme jara 40 tarawec? I sâqocne bahuc mâreŋ tuhuo hâmo sipiric embiŋ jaŋere hâcne iŋuc ewec.
Erâ weni jaŋere mumupaŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: Nore jujumana hae mâreŋko mi raʒinʒepieŋ? I dâŋticne qahuc jumbiŋ jaŋere hâcne muwec.
Irec ʒiŋuc honeŋgopeneŋ: Jaŋe miti qiqikiŋ‐jeŋicte quŋkerâ mi raʒimbiŋ.
Jujumana hae mâreŋ‐ticnao raʒinaŋte mukicne, biŋedâŋ i mi hetâtieme omaewec, irec ŋoŋeraonec moczi hatao sifuckezacte mezac‐nâpozejec.
Biŋe biaŋ dâŋ jaŋe jazakicne sâc ijaha nâŋâc nâzâkicne. Jaŋe ine dâŋ i manarâ maŋjeŋicko mi râepie hurâ fowecte jaŋerao fârimâc ewec.
Nâŋâc miti mana ʒakieeŋgopeneŋzi jujumana hae mâreŋko raʒieŋgopeneŋ. E ʒiŋuc muwec: “No kimbeŋ qajarehuc mumupaŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc mupo: Jaŋe nore jujumana hae mâreŋko moc mi raʒinʒepieŋ”, i mâreŋ hobeteŋne râehuc wiac sasawa bafârerâ sifu iŋuc muwec.
Irec ʒoaŋ namba 7 irec dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Anutu e wiac sasawa bafârereâ ʒoaŋ 7 ira jumanawec.”
Ehame faic honembeneŋ ine ʒiŋuc muwec: “Jaŋe nore jujumana hae mâreŋko moc mi raʒinʒepieŋ.”
Eme ʒi ŋic gâcnezi jujumana hae mâreŋko raraʒinere hata fokac jaha, â mârâc raraʒire biŋe biaŋ jazakicne jaŋe qikiŋnehuc mi raʒimbiŋ;
irec “miŋecgac” ʒâfo i mocwâc bahuc ʒâhec Dawidire micko dâŋ mupac i râeme ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋoŋe miŋecgac dâŋticne manaŋgopieŋko maŋbâzic mi junʒepieŋ.”
Josuazi jujumana hae mâreŋ fârine bâfua‐jareme muzac, Anutuzi ʒâhec dameŋ mocte mi muzac.
Irec ʒiŋuc mananʒepeneŋ: Anuture ŋicfâc jaŋere jujumana hombaŋ moc fokac.
Anutuzi gie batararâ jumanawec, iŋuc jaha ŋic moc Anuture jujumanao raʒiocmuzi gie‐ticne hetararâ jumanaocmu.
Eme nâŋâcnaonec moczi docke sâqorec erâ ŋic mârâc qaqatara hata âtembiŋ ijaha âtezacte jujumana hae mâreŋko raʒinaŋte ʒoɋac enʒepeneŋ.
Anuture dâŋ i jujuhec â tâpirihec, erâ sâqe moc bune râpene micnehec irec sâc jâuruhuc mictara jâmbâŋ. Izi nâhuku qâqâtâc â maŋ, bibiric â siec wamboŋ ʒuʒuhuc‐jeŋic nâtâcneekac, ehuc maŋte mamanasu â mamana wosâc irec fuŋne bataniŋkeekac.
Eme wiac bâfuakicne moczi moc Anuture maio soŋsoŋ mi foekac, erao wiac sasawa tâtâc â foŋ tâmiric foekac. Erao hâcne dâŋgie banaŋmu.
Taha bapa sâko hahaŋnehec moc junârekac, e sambâŋ fotâcne‐fârerâ fewec jukac, Jesu Anuture Ŋokâ hâcne, eme iŋucne junârekacte ʒâŋe‐ticne murâ rereŋ enʒepeneŋ.
Erâ taha bapa sâko‐nâŋec e dodocne enâreme hone qâoma mi enâreekac, nâŋâcnao eesâic fuaekac iŋuc jaha wâc erao eesâic fuŋne fuŋne fuawec, eesâicko dodocke mocjaha ine mi ewec.
Irec nâŋâc aki anonoc ŋeŋe rowaŋnao maŋafec jaha fisihuc junʒepeneŋ, eme wiac izi me izi maic maic‐nâpoha eki buuruc enârehuc aki anonoc‐ticnere erâ bafic‐nâpozejec.
Mâreŋŋic nâŋâcnaonec taha bapa sâko rowosâec‐jopakicne sasawa jaŋe ŋic jaŋere erâ Anutu fuacnehuc kiŋ bahacte taha bâzi rikecneniŋte râec‐jopakicne.
Taha bapa iŋucne e jahac ŋic dodocne jukacte ŋic mutucne â qâsoriekicne sâcne urucne ejareekac.
Erâ fuŋne iŋucte ŋic jaŋere kiŋ bahacte mecne â e jahacne mâmâc taha bâzi rikeocte mukicne.
Gie fekicne i ŋic moczi maŋticnere mi rorâ bapane, taha bapa ŋic moc e Anutuzi rowosâerâ gie mucneme sâcne baocmu, Aroŋ iŋuc hâcne ecnewec.
Eme Kristo e iŋuc jaha e jahacne maname fefene eha taha bapa sâko mi ewec, i Anutuzi ʒiŋuc muhuc mucnewec: “Go hâcne Ŋokâ‐nane, no miŋecgac bâfuacgukopac.”
Erâ dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Goki Melikisede ere sâcko taha bapa juraʒihuc jucmu sanaŋ.”
Jesu e mâreŋko juwec dameŋ ira, hâmockonec bataraocte tâpiri focnewec, erao numuhuc kio wâwâsic kâcɋene ecnewec. Ehuc Anutu araŋ bacnewecte manacnewec.
E Ŋokâ juwec, erâ sifu ʒâic gie baku micrereŋte fuŋne mana tarawec.
Erâ wiac emataucke‐fârerâ mume rereŋfâc‐ticne sasawa jaŋere bâbâpiaŋ tatara tâmiric bâfuawec.
E hâcne taha bapa sâko erâ Melikisede ere sâcko juocte Anutuzi mucnewec.
Irec dâŋ bocjaha fokac, erâ ŋoŋe hazecfâŋ juŋgopieŋte ŋaza mutâc epemurâ manape ŋemâckekac.
Ŋoŋe dameŋ ʒora miti mana wareeŋgopieŋzi gâcne qazu‐jarepie sâckezac; eme iŋucne ŋoŋe miti maine i mocwâc qaqazu‐ŋarenere sâc eŋgopieŋ. Ŋoŋe nânâ sanaŋnere sâc aricne, susu nânâre sâc sawa juŋgopieŋ.
Susu nâeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ine ɋiene mujarezo, iŋucnezi dâŋ fârine wemocko mana taraniŋmu?
Nânâ sanaŋne i sokakicne jaŋere biŋe, maŋ mamanasu‐jeŋic fua tâcneme biaŋne â sâqocne mana wosâeeŋgopieŋ jaŋere biŋe hâcne.
Irec nâŋâc ʒi Kristore dâŋ maine, fufuŋkeo mumune, i râepene foha dâŋ hukicne, wiac efehuc mumune, i moc ʒuhuckenaŋ. Wemocte miti hobeteŋne i hâsine râehuc maŋ bâbârisie â juju raŋɋa bebehe â Anutu mamanasiŋ,
â Miti Opâ â qizecko me rârâe â hâmockonec fafahare â bâtâc sanaŋ irec dâŋ mocwâc fuŋkezo?
Anutuzi maname sâckeme dâŋ moc ʒuhuckenaŋ.
Ŋic mitizi maŋjeŋic batamaeme sambâŋkonec nânâ nâhonembiŋ â Tiri Mârohec embiŋ,
erâ Anuture dâŋbiaŋ â juju sanaŋte tâpiri mana aŋac embiŋ,
ŋic iŋucne jaŋe miti behe sanaŋkehuc Anuture Ŋokâ jaŋacne maŋte mocwâc maripoŋko qahuc mamakâc ecnepie mitio bâbârisiec‐jopane mi fokac.
Mâreŋ moc hoezi gâbâ hehuc bâgunuckekume, ŋic sara mamac eeŋgopieŋ jaŋere biŋe nânâ monʒaŋ bâfuaekac, i Anutu jambuŋ‐ticnere fârine fuacneekac.
Â mâreŋ mocko hofâ qinʒiŋ sawa fuaocmu, ine fârimâc ekacte sâwec fâreme juku ʒoczi ʒaocmu.
Âgofâc, no dâŋ mukopac i ŋoŋe sipirickeniŋmu manahuc mâcne, mitio biaŋke‐hâmoniŋmu, iŋuc manahuc mukopac.
Anutu e eesifucne mâcne; ŋoŋe ere erâ ŋicfâc‐ticne hone bafic ejarehuc jauŋ bacjopambiŋ erâ eeŋgopieŋ jaha irec wemocko nikeckeocmu.
Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc eniŋte enârekac: Ŋoŋe mâmâc sasawa sâc ijaha ɋicwânʒâŋ epie sambâŋ ʒeŋaŋ bâbâfuare buâkec mi omaezejec, fofehame dameŋ tarazejec.
Eme mi rokawehuc, mitiŋic gâcne mamanasiŋ â sasanaŋhec juhuc wiac biŋec‐nâpokicne rauckeeŋgopieŋ, jaŋere hata âteniŋmu.
Jaŋeraonec moc Abraham e Anutuzi biŋedâŋ âzâcnerâ femicne mocte maio mupaŋkeocte basarâ e jahacnao râehuc mupaŋkewec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “No jambuŋgurâ jambuŋgu epemu â basawecgurâ basawecgu epemu.”
Eme Abraham e mumupaŋ dâŋ irec woŋec tatakic tâmiriŋ juku fârine rowec.
Ŋiczi fekicne moc ere maio mumupaŋ dâŋ mupene mu qaqatarac eene mi fuaocmu.
Irec Anutu e ŋic biŋe qajareme maŋjahec enʒipiŋte, maŋticnezi sanaŋkeha muwec irec fuŋne bataniŋkehuc biŋedâŋ irec fainao mumupaŋ dâŋ ʒuhuckewec.
Anutu e burec tâmiriczi dâŋsanaŋ jajahec âkendâŋ‐jofahuc nâŋâcnao suru râewec, i ere dapeŋko raʒimbeŋzi wiac biŋe qanârekicne irec fârine fotarierâ ronaŋte manasuhuc ewec.
Biŋe qanârekicne irec fârinezi juju‐nâŋecte aŋga sanaŋne â tâtâcne tâmiric iŋucne ekac, erâ aŋga izi faic qoruc ââketâc irec râpenao râekicne fokac.
Ââketâc i micne bapa‐nâŋec Jesu eki bânie‐nârehuc fotâcnerâ maŋnao raʒiwec. E Melikisede ere sâcko taha bapa erâ jusanaŋkeekaczi iŋuc ewec hâcne.
Melikisede e hâcne Salem haere ŋicwofuŋ â Anutu femicne sâko ere taha bapa juwec. Eki hâcne Abrahamzi ŋicwofuŋ râsifâc‐ticne joparâ risiehame ra hatao bâfuarâ jambuŋkewec.
Erâ e hâcne Abrahamzi mafa mateŋ bâtâc barâ teŋkonec wâŋ irec sâc râcnewec. Melikisede ʒâŋe‐ticne nâŋâcne dâŋko “Tiŋne ŋicwofuŋ”, â Salem ŋicwofuŋ ine “Wama ŋicwofuŋ”.
Melikisede e neŋgoc mamac tâmiric, apa ŋosa fuŋne‐ticne qahuc mi mufuakicne, e juju‐ticne fufuŋke tâmiric â tatara tâmiric. E Anuture Ŋokâ ere sâsâc eocte mukicnezi taha bapa juju hati ewec.
Ʒi honeniŋ, e ŋic fekicne mo iŋucne irec mimiŋne‐nâŋec Abrahamzi mafa mateŋ biaŋne sasawa bâwosâerâ teŋkonec wâŋ irec sâc râcnewec.
Lewire ɋâricfâc gâcne taha gie baniŋte mujarekicne jaŋe ŋic ŋokac âgofâc‐jeŋic Abrahamte tofâfâc jaha sifu mafa wiac teŋkonec wâŋ irec sâc jowac roniŋte sâcmutâc dâŋqâhâcko mutâcne‐jarekicne.
Â Melikisede e jaŋere guruonec mi fuakicnezi ine Abrahamtaonec teŋkonec wâŋ rowec. Ehuc miti biŋe qacnekicne e jambuŋkewec.
Â fekicnezi wahakicne jambuŋkeekac i mozi mickeocmu?
Dameŋ ʒi ŋic sisirowenezi teŋkonec wâŋ roeŋgopieŋ; ira ine juju hati mucnekicnezi rowec.
No manape ʒiŋuc ekac, Lewi e teŋkonec wâŋ roekaczi Abrahamte bifuŋko fohuc wiac i Melikisede râcnewec;
e mamac‐ticnere bifuŋko fohame Melikisedehec bâbâfuac epicte Abrahamzi râcneme Lewizi mâmâc râcnewec ekac.
Lewire ɋâricfâc jaŋere taha bapa gie sâcke‐hâmozac muzac, wemocko ʒâhec taha bapa moc Melikisede ere sâcko fuazac â Aroŋte sâcko aricne? Taha bapa giere erâ ŋic ŋokac sâcmutâc dâŋ jarekicne.
Eme taha bapa gie raŋɋane rârieha ɋâricne moc fuame, raŋɋanere sâcmutâc dâŋ iŋuc jaha râriehame ɋâricne moc fuaocmu.
Findaŋdâŋzi ŋic rokac e taha ufuŋko gie mujarekicne jaŋere guruonec mi fuawec, e guru mockonec.
Wofuŋ‐nâŋec e Judare tofafâc jaŋeraonec fuawec, i mana‐fâreŋgopeneŋ. Eme ŋicguru i jaŋe taha gie baniŋte Mosezi moc mi muwec.
Erâ irec fuŋne moc taniŋke‐hâmokac wâc. Taha bapa moc Melikisedere sâcko fuaocte mukicne,
e sahaczi fuakicnere sâcmutâc râekicne irec sâcko mâcne, juju fofo sanaŋte tâpirio taha bapa erâ juwec jukac.
Ere hâcne dâŋ ʒiŋuc mutaniŋkekicne: “Goki Melikisede ere sâcko taha bapa juraʒihuc jucmu sanaŋ.”
Ine hâcne sâcmutâc dâŋ mârâc mukicne i tâpirimâc â fâri tâmiric ewecte bârâriekicne.
Sâcmutâc dâŋzi wiac moc mi emataucke‐fârewec; eme irec okacne woworic fârine bâfuakicne, izi fârec‐nâpome Anutu sâcne maickeeŋgopeneŋ.
Ɋâricne fuawec i mumupaŋ dâŋsanaŋ tâmiric mi fuawec, raŋɋane jaŋe mumupaŋ tâmiricko taha bapa erâ jumbiŋ.
Ɋâricne ʒi ine mumupaŋ faio taha bapa ewec jukac. Ere dâŋqâreŋ ʒiŋuc fokac: “Wofuŋzi mumupaŋ dâŋ muwec i mi beheocmu: ‘Goki taha bapa juraʒihuc jucmu sanaŋ’.”
Fuŋne iŋucte ʒâʒâfic fârinere jâcne ewec, Jesu hâcne.
Raŋɋane jaŋe hâmohuc tuczi tuc juwarembiŋte bocjaha juwarembiŋ.
Ɋâricne e ine juju sanaŋ jukacte taha bapa gie‐ticne ʒuʒuhuc focnehuc juocmu sanaŋ.
Irec ere ŋesiŋko Anutu maickeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe sâcne bâbâpiaŋko râe basanaŋ ejareekac, e juju sanaŋ jukaczi hâcne dameŋ sâc roroŋ sasape ejareekac.
Taha bapa sâko‐nâŋec hâcne e furu, bahacmâc, ɋaɋacne, sâqocne bapa jaŋere sâcko mi juhuc qâtâcnerâ pectâc jujune, erâ samâŋ hucke‐fârewec jukac. Iŋucnezi hâcne junâreme sâcke‐hâmokac.
E taha bapa raŋɋane jaŋe iŋucne mâcne, e sindaŋ tâmiriczi wemocko ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne qanaŋ e jahacne sindaŋte erâ taha bâzi rikerâ ʒâhec ŋic jaŋere rikezac, e jahacne maŋ sahac i taha bâzi‐nâŋec mocjaha hâcne râeme tarawec.
Sâcmutâc dâŋko ŋic maŋjeŋiczi dodocne jaŋe taha bapa sâko juniŋte mukicne. Eme ʒâhec ine sâcmutâc dâŋ faicnao mumupaŋ dâŋsanaŋzi Ŋokâ âkendâŋnewec. Eki hâcne maŋfuru jaha juraʒihuc juocmu sanaŋ.
Dâŋ mukicne irec hândâŋne ʒiŋuc: Taha bapa sâko junârekac e faic sambâŋko femicne sâko ere ŋeŋefuŋko mefârenao fewec ŋeekac.
E furu ufuŋ, mitific fârine hâcne, irec taha bapa jukac. Ufuŋ i ŋiczi mâcne, Wofuŋ e jahac bâfuawec.
Taha bapa sâko sasawa jaŋe nânâ qowi bâzi râe rikec eniŋte mujarekicne, irec taha bapa sâko‐nâŋec wemocko taha bâzi tâmiric juzac?
Erâ e mâreŋko juhuc muzac taha bapa mi juzac, mâreŋko sâcmutâc dâŋte sâcko bâzi ririke ŋic sâcne juŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe gie‐jeŋic mitific jabane â sâsâcne ira baeŋgopieŋ, fârine ine sambâŋko ŋekac. Mose e mitire qoruc boze bazo ehame Wofuŋzi ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Manakic, tikio hawarine gowatukicne irec sâcko wiac sasawa bazemec.”
Ʒi ine Jesuzi ʒâʒâfic fekicnere jâcne juekacte taha gie fekicne jaha baekac. Ʒâʒâfic fekicne ine biŋedâŋ fekicnezi hobeteŋ ecneha bâfuakicne.
Mârâc ʒâʒâfic fowec, izi fârinehec eme muzac ʒâhec moc fuaocte dâŋne mi fuazac.
Anutu eki ine ŋic jaŋere maname mi sâckeme ʒiŋuc muwec: “Juku dameŋ mocko Israe kikefuŋ â Juda kikefuŋ jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic ɋâricne moc bâfuapemu, Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
Mârâc mimiŋnefâc‐jeŋic Aigita mâreŋkonec jowac‐jopapere mejeŋicko rohuc jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epo, ʒâʒâfic iŋucne mâcne; jaŋe ʒâʒâfic irec maŋnao paŋʒâic mi jupie noni râpec‐jopapo, Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.
Â ʒâhec Israe kikefuŋ jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epemu ine kecʒiŋuc: No mumupaŋ dâŋnane maŋjeŋicko râepe huocmu, erâ buhândâŋ‐jeŋicko qâreŋkepe foocmu, eme no Anutu‐jeŋic jupemu â jaŋe kikefuŋfâc‐nane juniŋmu.
Eme ŋic moczi ŋicâgo‐ticne me ŋic moczi qomâ‐ticne ʒiŋuc mi muhuc miti qazucneocmu: Âjoc, go Wofuŋte fuŋne manac â!’ Mâcne, jaŋe wahakicnezi mecne fekicnezi mecne mâmâc manacnu‐fâreniŋmu.
Ʒiŋucte manacnuniŋmu: No kiŋjeŋic behe‐jarepemu â sindaŋ‐jeŋicte mocwâc mi manasupemu, Wofuŋzi iŋuc mukac.”
Eme Wofuŋ e ʒâʒâfic ɋâricnere dâŋ muhuc, mârâc fowec irec “raŋɋaŋkekicne” muwec. Eme wiac raŋɋaŋkekicne â gufekicne izi arictac ezo ekac hâcne.
Ʒâʒâfic raŋɋanao Wofuŋ mai eecnere hata fowec â irec tiri qoruc boze mâreŋko ŋewec wâc.
Mitire qoruc boze hâcne kecʒiŋuc bambiŋ: Maŋne moc maine, ʒâŋene Furufic mukicne, ira kendo kikenehec domawec erâ tebo ŋewec fainao poroŋ furu mukicne i fowec.
Eme bumec maŋne moc âke tâcnekicne fowec, ʒâŋene Furu Dindiŋ mukicne.
Ira hosâc ririke alata golzi bakicne ŋewec, erâ ʒâʒâficte qorac tapa katapa golzi ɋorockekicne i ŋewec, erâ Aroŋte gunu ɋârerâ gitec hekicne i â qorac tapa mâmâc râekicne.
Fainao ine tatamacte kerubim hawari jajahec fakec‐jekiczi katapa tapane sâockehuc domapic. Irec dâŋ ninic jaha wemocko mufârezo.
Wiac iŋuc râepie fohame fic maŋne maine ira taha bapa jaŋe dameŋ sâc fec wahac ehuc gie‐jeŋic bajumbieŋ.
Fic maŋne moc ira ine taha bapa sâko e bucticne jara moc maŋnao arec mocjaha fejujec. Erâ soc tâmiric aricne, sochec sasawa fehuc e jahacne â ŋic jaŋere bahacte tie jujec.
Wiac irec fuŋne Tiri Mârozi ʒiŋuc nâwotukac: Maŋne maine izi ŋehame furu ufuŋko raraʒire hata mi fua tâcnekac.
Maŋne maine izi dameŋ ʒiŋuczia mâreŋko juŋgopeneŋ irec sâsâcne ekac. Tiri qoruc bozeo nânâ qowi bâzi râe rikec ee izi wemocko ŋic Anutu mai ecnembiŋ jaŋere maŋ bâpiaŋkezac?
I sahackopec sâcmutâc dâŋ sawa, nânâ opâre â sahac ʒuʒurere dâŋ fowec iŋucne, i ʒâhec fârinezi âkehockeocte jaba fowec.
Kristo eki ine wiac fârine fuaocte mukicne irec taha bapa sâko fuawec, ehuc qoruc boze sâc moc, fârine jâmbâŋ, mezi mi bakicne, mâreŋko mi ŋeŋene, ira raʒiwec.
Noniŋ bulimakao sochec mâcne, e jahacne sochec Furuficko arec mocjaha raʒihuc kitâc‐nâpowec izi fofo sanaŋ foocmu.
Noniŋ bulimakao soc â bulimakao ʒafe i ŋic wâwânâŋ fua‐jarewec jaŋe epie furu bacjopame sahackopec ɋaɋackembiŋ;
Kristo e ine Mâro juweczi jukac eki neŋgoc ŋecneha maŋ sahac‐ticne Anutu taha bâzi furu biaŋ ecnewec, eme nâŋâc eebapa aputacnezi maŋnâŋec hegâpârembeŋ i Kristore soczi sâcne ʒure ɋaɋackeme Anutu jujune kiŋaŋ qacnenaŋmu.
Irec hâcne Kristo e ʒâʒâfic ɋâricnere jâcne ewec, erâ ʒâʒâfic raŋɋanao juhuc kiŋ bâfuakicne i taraocte hâmowec, eme irec biŋefâc‐ticne jaŋe juju sanaŋte merâfâc roniŋte mujarekicne i sâcne roniŋmu.
Merâfâcte hata ʒiŋuc fokac: Runezi hâmome jaha rauckezo.
Ɋâricne juhame merâfâcte dâŋ mukicne i mâc foocmu, hâmome ine dâŋ irec fârine fuaocmu.
Irec hâcne ʒâʒâfic raŋɋane i soc tâmiricko wâc mi fuawec.
Mose e sâcmutâc dâŋqâhâc jâcne jâcne, mutâcnekicnere sâcko ŋic jazaku jaza‐fârerâ bulimakao â noniŋsoc opâhec bâsifuckerâ kâcbiŋko lama kanʒaŋ bâbâroŋ qâfiserâ izi soc tieme miti papia mecne ŋic ŋokac mecne mâmâc rua‐jarewec.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Anutuzi ʒâʒâficte dâŋ mupaŋke‐ŋarejec irec soc ʒi hâcne.”
Erâ taha boze â taha giere râqâc wiac i iŋuc jaha soczi ruacne‐fârewec.
Ine hâcne, sâcmutâc dâŋko mukicnere wiac ʒeŋgoma qâririŋ soczi ʒure ɋaɋackezo, â soc tâmiricko sâqocne bâbâtâmire mi fokac.
Sambâŋko wiac fârine fokac irec sâsâc wiac i soc omanezi ʒure ɋaɋackeocte mukicne, â wiac fârine e jahacne ine taha furi sâkozi ʒure ɋaɋackeocte hatane mocjaha fokac.
Irec hâcne Kristo e furu ufuŋ mezi bakicne, fârine irec sâsâcne mac, ira mi raʒiwec, e sambâŋ maŋnao raʒiwec, eme ira Anuture maio juhuc nâŋâcnere erâ taha gie‐ticne baekac.
