Erâ e maŋ sahac‐ticne hâsi fâri taha‐nâŋec qikiŋneocte wâc mi fewec, taha bapa sâkozi jâmbomac jarane jarane feekac, ehuc e jahacne soc mâcne, soc jabane rorâ tiri ufuŋko feekac.
Kristo e iŋucnere sâc erâ muzac mâreŋ fuaweckonecteaŋ wemo afecne hâmo warehuc juzac. E ine iŋuc mi ehuc dameŋ ŋondeŋ tataranao due‐nâŋec bahuc kiŋnâŋec bârârieocte fua tâcnewec.
Ŋiczi mocjaha hâmonaŋte munârekicne, eme irec faicnao dâŋnâŋec mumutara fuaocte mukicne;
eme Kristo e iŋuc jaha, ŋic bocjaha kiŋjeŋic âsickehuc mocjaha hâcne hâmoweczi mocwâc sâqocnere gie baocte mâcne, e worickehuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe rocjopaocte sawa fua taniŋkeocmu.
Sâcmutâc dâŋko wiac mukicne i mâc ʒâhec fârine fuaocmu irec mumucne sawa fuakac, fârine jâmbâŋ mâcne. Irec taha bapa jaŋe sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkehuc jarane jarane taha barâ ba epie ŋic ira Anutu mai ecneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe sâcne maŋfuru mi bacjopaekac.
Iŋuc eme muzac, taha bâzi ririke omaezac i! Ira Anutu mai ecneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe kiŋfâsâc enʒapiŋ muzac, kiŋjeŋicte manabâc mocwâc mi enʒapiŋ.
Taha bâzi izi in jarane jarane fuame kiŋjeŋicte manasueŋgopieŋ.
Noniŋ bulimakao soczi wemocko kiŋjeŋic bâtâmirezac? I aricne.
Irec hâcne Kristo mâreŋko wahaocte dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Taha bâzi fuŋne fuŋnere mi egareekac, sahac ine bâfua‐narekomec.
Qowi hâcbuc ririke me sâqocnere taha bapa i fua‐gareocte mi muekic.
Eme mupo, ‘Manakic, no Anutu gore mic reŋkepere fisikopac’, miti papiao nore dâŋ qâreŋkekicne irec sâcko.”
Faic dâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec fokac, “Taha bâzi fuŋne fuŋne â qowi hâcbuc sâqocnere taha irec mi egareekac â irec takicguekac” wiac i sâcmutâc dâŋte sâcko râe rikec ekicne.
Erâ dâŋ ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ muwec: “Manakic, gore dâŋ reŋkepere fisikopac”, iŋuc muhuc wiac raŋɋane bârârierâ ɋâricne moc âkendâŋnewec.
Irec Anuture micdâŋte erâ Jesu Kristo e sahac‐ticnezi taha bame maŋfuru embeŋ, i arec mocjaha ekicnezi fofo sanaŋ.
Taha bapa sasawa jaŋe ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne gie‐jeŋic bahuc bâzi ijaha hati rikerâ rike ehuc jueŋgopieŋ, eme izi kiŋ bahac sâcne moc mi bâtâmireekac.
Kristozi ine sâqocne‐nâŋecte taha mocjaha bame tarame faic Anutu mefârenao fewec jukac.
Eme ira râsifâc‐ticne dockerâ waha fohuc kike‐ticnere ââtesiŋ eniŋte woŋec juekac.
Maŋfuru eere hatao juŋgopieŋ jaŋere taha mocjaha bahuc bâbâpiaŋ‐jeŋicte gie batarawec.
Eme Tiri Mârozi irec dâŋ mufua‐nârekac wâc. Qanaŋ dâŋ ʒiŋuc fokac, Wofuŋ e kecʒiŋuc mukac:
“Ʒâhec dameŋko jaŋehec ʒâʒâfic epemu ine kecʒiŋuc: No mumupaŋ dâŋnane maŋjeŋicko râepe huocmu, erâ buhândâŋ‐jeŋicko qâreŋkepe foocmu.”
Erâ ʒuhuckekac, “No kiŋjeŋic behe‐jarepemu â sindaŋ‐jeŋicte mocwâc mi manasupemu.”
Sâqocne tâmire‐fâreme ine irec taha bapa iŋuc jaha omaeocmu.
Âgofâc, Jesu e socticnezi motâc ronârewecte furu ufuŋko fenaŋte maŋnâŋe afeckekac.
Irec hatane ɋâricne â jujune ine e jahac bâʒâwe‐nârewec. Ehuc ââketâc fowec, sahac‐ticne hâcne, i fotâcnerâ fewec.
Eme taha bapa fekicne Anuture ufuŋ qizeckerâ junârekac.
Irec nâŋâc mamanasiŋzi maŋnâŋec baafeckeha siocmâc mai ecnehuc junʒepeneŋ. Ine qanaŋ maŋnâŋec kiŋzi hegâpârekicne i socticnezi ruacneme taniŋkeha â sahac‐nâŋec opâ ɋaɋaczi ʒureha iŋuc sâcne enaŋmu.
Erâ mume sasanaŋzi wiac biŋe qanârewecte biŋedâŋ i kiki papaŋ jaha bajuhuc muhaŋnenʒepeneŋ.
Erâ wâc sosoŋaŋ ehuc maŋjauŋte â eehâmo giere qaqafeŋ enʒepeneŋ.
Ehuc mitire tutumaŋko gâcnezi mi fisihuc qâoma eeŋgopieŋ iŋuc mi ezo. Dameŋ sâko bâqiŋ‐nâpokac, iŋuc hâcne manahuc ʒoɋac erâ faŋ qaqac enʒepeneŋ.
Nâŋâc dâŋ fâri qizecnezi maŋnâŋec âke tamaehame sâqocne mana jaŋgeŋkehuc bapene mozi irec taha bame tâmireocmu? Aricne, iŋuc mi fokac,
ine okacne hâhâwicne â ʒocbâruŋ sâko izi sawa woŋec‐nâŋec foocmu. Ʒocbâruŋ izi mitire râsifâc ʒâmiziec‐jopaocmu hâcne.
Ŋic moczi Mosere sâcmutâc dâŋ mana suahuc qame ŋic jajahec me jahec â moczi mujaŋgeŋkepie acmâc jaha qapie hâmoekac.
Eme ŋic moc e Anuture Ŋokâ ro waha âte ecnehuc, ʒâʒâficte soc ruarâ maŋfuru ewec i mana suahuc aki anonoc rune Mâro musoriŋkeocmu, e okacne mo iŋucne fisicneocmu muŋgopieŋ?
Nâŋâc dâŋ kecʒiŋuc muwec ere fuŋne manaeŋgopeneŋ: “Kiŋ babatara i nore gie, okacne babazu i noni epemu.” Erâ moc ʒiŋuc fokac: “Wofuŋ e ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere dâŋ mutara‐jareocmu.”
Anutu jujune ere meo fefe i wiac hâhâwicne jâmbâŋ.
Ŋoŋe mârâc wiac ejumbieŋ irec manasunʒepieŋ. Dameŋ ira maŋŋeŋiczi hae furehame fific guguriŋ maŋko juju gie sâko bahuc sanaŋkembiŋ.
Eme gâcne ŋoŋe imaŋ gomaŋ â ʒâic busâqoc fai‐ŋeŋicko feme ŋic jaŋere maio mamakâc embiŋ, â gâcne ŋoŋe ine âgofâc‐ŋeŋic wiac iŋucne ejarepie ʒâic‐jeŋic mâmâc manambiŋ.
Ŋoŋe âgofâc‐ŋeŋic kâpâcwâru ficko fepie jaŋere erâ buheric fua‐ŋarewec, â moneŋ mafa ŋowac ropie ine mafa fârine fofone fonârekac muhuc manapie bubiaŋnehec ewec.
Eme ʒi hâbi‐ŋeŋic mi goroŋkezejec, hâbihec juku furine kâcɋene rozo.
Irec ŋoŋe sasanaŋ bâfuarâ Anuture micdâŋkoa juku wiac biŋe qaŋarekicne irec fârine ronʒepieŋ.
“Irec dameŋ bembeŋne mac moc fokac i tarame wareocte mukicne e ŋeŋe râqâc mi ehuc biac fisiocmu.
Ŋicnane biaŋkekicnezi ine mamanasiŋte erâ juju hotâckeocmu, â docke pârâc eocmuo maŋnanezi manacnepe mi biaŋkeocmu.”
Nâŋâc ine docke pârâc ehuc sisipiricko rara irec biŋe mâcne, nâŋâc manasiŋkehuc maŋ qâqâtâc ŋeŋezic irec biŋe.
Wiac biŋe qanârekicne i manapaŋkerâ irec woŋec juju, â wiac mi hohonene maŋzi sakarerâ babaju, izi mamanasiŋ ekac.
Mitiŋic raŋɋane jaŋe mamanasiŋ iŋucnehec jupie Anutuzi honec‐jopame biaŋkewec hâcne.
Mâreŋ i Anuture micte fuawec, ine mamanasiŋhec juhuc mana taraeŋgopeneŋ. Wiac hohonene i mi honekickonec fuawec hâcne.
Mamanasiŋhec juhuc Abezi Anutu bâzi rikecneme honeme sâckeha Kaiŋte qikiŋnewec. Mamanasiŋ‐ticnere hâcne Anutuzi honeme kiŋfâsâc eme bâzi‐ticne rohuc fuŋne‐ticne bataniŋkewec. E mamanasiŋhec juwecte manapene hâmokicnezi sifu dâŋ nâzâkac ekac.
Enoko e mamanasiŋhec juwec, irec hâmoczi mi bâuaocte Anutuzi ɋâricne bafewec. Iŋuc ecnewecte ŋiczi basambiŋ. Erâ mi feha fuŋne‐ticne biac ʒiŋuc mutaniŋkekicne: Anutuzi e honeme biaŋkewec.
Mamanasiŋ tâmiric jupene Anutuzi honec‐nâpome bibiaŋke ine mi fokac. Anutu mâc mai mi ecnezo, jukac i mana ʒakiezo, â maŋzi hefârepene tahac‐nâpoekac dâŋ i mana ʒakiehuc mai ecnezo.
Noa e mamanasiŋhec juwecte Anutuzi wiac ʒâhec fuaocmu irec biŋe qanaŋ âzâcnewec. Âzâcneme araŋ bacnehuc wiacfâc‐ticne ɋâricne juniŋte murâ woke bawec. Iŋuc ehuc ŋic kiŋjeŋicte fuŋne bataniŋkewec. Erâ mamanasiŋte erâ kiŋfâsâc ee irec fârine rauckewec.
Abraham e mamanasiŋhec juwecte mâreŋ‐ticne beherâ moc rauckeocte irec dâŋ erao fuame reŋkewec. Erâ mâreŋ irec me irec mukicne kâuc bahuc sifu rawec.
Mamanasiŋhecte mâreŋ biŋe qacnekicne ira ra fisirâ jaba juwec. Jaba juhuc bozeo sawa ŋeŋerâ juwec. Isaka â Jakobo jahe biŋe mâmâc qajactekicnezi sâc ijaha epic.
Abraham e hae ŋeŋe sanaŋ moc Anutuzi bâfuarâ basarickewec irec mamanacko juwec.
Sara e iŋuc jaha mamanasiŋhecte tâpiri fuacneme ŋokac qizec juipiehuc kiwechec ewec. Ine ɋâricte biŋe qacnewec ere, mume fufuazi mukac, muhuc iŋuc ewec.
Eme irec hâcne ŋic mocjaha, fua sawecte tâpiri‐ticne arictac ehame, eraonec ɋâric fua sawec embiŋ jaŋe sambâŋko bâpiŋ ŋerakac irec sâc, erâ hâwecmecko moŋgeŋ forakac, ŋiczi mi wowosene, irec sâc fuambiŋ.
Ŋic izi hâcne mamanasiŋhec juhuc hâmo‐fârembiŋ. Wiac biŋe qajarekicne irec fârine ine mi roro mâc taicko fome honerâ worickehuc jumbiŋ. Iŋuc ehuc fuŋne‐jeŋic ʒiŋuc manambiŋ: Nâŋe mâreŋko hotâ â jaba juŋgopeneŋ.
Dâŋ iŋuc muhuc mâreŋ qizec moc bâfuaniŋte maŋjeŋic âeckeba ewec.
Erâ jaŋacne hae mâreŋ râpeckembiŋ irec maŋhâhâŋ mi ejarewec, irec ejareme muzac risiezo murâ sâcne risienʒapiŋ.
Jaŋe ine hae mâreŋ biaŋ mocte maŋhâhâŋ ejarewec, sambâŋko fokac irec hâcne. Irec Anutu e jaŋere Anutu, ere iŋuc mupene maname mi sâqoreekac. Wemocte? E jahac hae sâko moc bâfua‐jarewec.
Abraham e Anutuzi esâickeme mamanasiŋhec juwecte Isaka taha bâzire qikiŋnewec, e biŋedâŋ roweczi ŋokâ‐ticne mocjaha qikiŋnezo ewec hâcne.
Biŋedâŋ ʒiŋuc âzâcnekicne: “Isakaraonec ɋâricfâcge fua sawec eraniŋmu.”
I kecʒiŋuc muhuc ewec: “Anutu e ŋic hâmockonec bâɋârec‐jopaocte tâpiri focnekac.” Eme irec hâmockonec tinac bârisiecnewec.
Isaka e mamanasiŋhec juwecte Jakobo â Esau jambuŋ‐jofahuc wiac ʒâhec fuaocmu irec findaŋdâŋ wâc jasawec.
Jakobo e mamanasiŋhec juwecte hâmozo ehuc Josefe ŋokâ jahec‐ticne jambuŋ‐jofawec, ehuc gunuzi âkesiŋnerâ ŋehuc Anutu dapecnewec.
Josefe e mamanasiŋhec juwecte hâmozo dameŋ‐ticne maickeme Israe ŋic jaŋe juku Aigita mâreŋ beherâ raniŋmu irec manasurâ siec‐ticnere qanaŋ dâŋ mutâcne‐jarewec.
Mose fuame neŋgoc mamacne jahe mamanasiŋhecte motec honebâckerâ ŋicwofuŋ dâŋticnere mi hâwic‐jofaha mosa jahec â moc soŋkepic.
Mose e mamanasiŋhec juwecte ine sokarâ Farao otâ‐ticnere ŋokâ mucneniŋte mupie qikiŋnewec.
E sâqocnere aŋac bembeŋne qikiŋnerâ Anuture ŋicfâc jaŋehec ʒâic busâqoc manaocte wosâewec.
Ehuc Aigita mâreŋkonec moneŋ mafa mâriri irec maname jawane ewec, â Kristore erâ mamakucne juocte ine maname fârine ewec. I juku furine roocte manasuhuc iŋuc ewec.
E mamanasiŋhec juwecte ŋicwofuŋ aaric‐ticne qamaserâ Aigita mâreŋ behewec. Erâ Anutu mi hohonene e ʒâŋezi honehuc tinac erao siŋkewec.
Mose e mamanasiŋhec juwecte mume aakic lama hezurâ socnezi ficmotâc ruacnepie aŋelo momorizi jowaruhuc mârâc ŋokâfâc‐jeŋic akic‐jopawec.
Eme Israe ŋic jaŋe mamanasiŋhec jumbiŋte Hâwec Bâbâroŋko tiŋko rara tinac rahuc fotâcnembiŋ. Aigita ŋic jaŋe ijaha ezo mupie hâweczi ɋâcjopawec.
Israe ŋic jaŋe mamanasiŋhec jumbiŋte Jeriko haesac orâŋkekuhapie ʒoaŋ gie bapa 7 eme hericke qawec.
Sasec ŋokac Rahaba e mamanasiŋhec juwecte ŋic mâreŋ hone têcnepic jahe âgo ejactewec. Eme qaqatara ŋic jopambiŋko e akickekicne.
Erâ dâŋ gâcne wemocko mufârezo. Gideoŋ â Baraki â Simsoŋ â Jefita â Dawidi â Samue â porofete jaŋere binaŋ bafârepe muzac mâretec ʒorazac.
Jaŋe mamanasiŋhec jumbiŋte ŋic guru sâko bawahac‐jopambiŋ. Bâbâtiŋ gie bâhâmombiŋ, wiac biŋe qajarekicne irec fârine rombiŋ, laioŋ micjeŋic bâbâzickembiŋ,
ʒocbâruŋ fâro‐ticne hemâteŋkembiŋ, ʒika faio feipiehuc ɋâricne jumbiŋ, dockekicnezi mocwâc sanaŋkembiŋ, ʒikao momori wânʒâŋ embiŋ, mâreŋ gâcnaonec râsi jopa jâpec embiŋ.
Ŋokac gâcne jaŋere ŋokâ hâmockonec bâɋâre‐jarekicne. Ŋic tucne bâʒâic‐jopahuc mâsi qâsi ejarekicne, eme “miti behepie akic‐ŋopazo” jazapie, juju sanaŋte ɋâreniŋte manasuhuc qikiŋnembiŋ.
Ŋic tucne jaŋe maric maŋgâpâc â qa imac ejarekicne, â tucne jaŋe me kike‐jeŋic qarâ kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐jopakicne.
Tucne jaŋe qânâzi hehâmoc‐jopakicne, tucne jopa qâʒâic ejarekicne, tucne jaŋe segezi bâtâc‐jopambiŋ, tucne jaŋe ʒikazi upe‐jeŋic qâtâcnembiŋ. Jaŋe lama â noniŋ sahacne rufarâ rorocko juhuc bebekâne erâ ʒâŋ goma faio jujumbieŋ.
Iŋucnezi ŋic wemo‐jeŋicte mâreŋko jupie sâckewec. Jaŋe tiki tuhuo mâreŋ â qorac hawecko foforâ jujumbieŋ.
I jaŋe sasawa mamanasiŋ‐jeŋicte Anutuzi honec‐jopame biaŋkewec, erâ sifu wiac biŋe qajarekicne irec fârine mi bâfuambiŋ.
Fuŋne ʒiŋucte: Anutu e nâŋâcnao wiac fekicne râeocte maname fowec, irec jaŋe nâŋâc tâmiricko juju saric bâfuaniŋte mi manasuwec.
Wiʒec guru sâko iŋucnezi karorac tinac erâ orâŋ‐nâpoŋgopieŋte wiac bâmâc‐nâpoekac i hetera‐fârenʒepeneŋ, â sâqocnere muczi fâfâc‐nâpoekac i wâc hetâcnenʒepeneŋ, ehuc hata nâwotukicne ira tatakic tâmiric gagasac jaha ranʒepeneŋ.
Ehuc Jesu, mamanasiŋte micne bapa â mamanasiŋte fârine bâbâfua, erao findendeŋnehuc junʒepeneŋ. E ʒeri bubiaŋ fuacneocte mukicne irec manasuhuc maripoŋte ʒâic manawec â mimi faio fefe mana suawec. Iŋuc erâ Anuture ŋeŋefuŋko mefârenao fewec ŋekac.
Sâqocne bapa jaŋe mukac mupe mo iŋucne ecnepie mana‐bipierâ sanaŋkewec, ŋoŋe ere hâcne manasuhuc mi takirepie maŋŋeŋic betaŋkezejec.
Ŋoŋe sâqocnezi herokawec‐ŋopazo eme samandiŋkerâ sahac‐ŋeŋic bapie wozeme dodoma, i juwarehuc iŋuc sâcne mi embiŋ.
Erâ dâŋ moc “ŋokâ” muŋarehuc faŋ qaŋarekicne fokac irec nikec‐ŋopawec me? Dâŋ ʒiŋuc: “Ŋokâ‐nane, Wofuŋzi bâtiŋgume manatec wawahane mi ezejec, â bâʒâicgume maŋge mi rokawezejec.
Wofuŋ e ŋic moc jauŋkezo murâ ba bâtiŋ ecneekac, â ŋic fuŋfuŋfâcne bacjopahuc qa qâtiŋ ejare‐fâreekac.”
Wofuŋzi ba bâtiŋ eŋarezo mume hâbi‐ŋeŋic mi ŋeŋgoroŋkezejec. Anutuzi honec‐ŋopame naru motecfâc‐ticne epie iŋuc hâcne eŋareekac. Me mo mamaczi ŋokâ‐ticne ba bâtiŋ mi ecneocmu?
Ba bâtiŋ i ŋic gâcne sasawa ejarewec, eme ŋoŋe i tâmiric jupie ine naru motecfâcne mâcne, fiuckonec fuakicne muŋarezo.
Erâ moc mupe: Mâreŋ mamacfâc‐nâŋec jaŋe qa bâtiŋ enârepie araŋ bajare jumbeneŋ. Eme qâqâtâcte Mamac e araŋ baʒihuc bacnepene sâckeocmu. Iŋuc ehuc juhâmonaŋmu.
Jaŋe mamana‐jeŋicte sâc jara dameŋ bembeŋne sawa qa bâtiŋ enâre jumbieŋ, eki ine wiac fârine fua‐nâreocte enâreekac, e jahacne tiri jujuo ʒuhuckenaŋte hâcne.
Bâbâtiŋ fuaocmu sâc i qanaŋ manapene bubiaŋhec mi ehuc busâqochec eekac; â ʒâhecko ine bâbâtiŋko juhuc sanaŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao fârine wamane fuaekac, ʒâŋene bahac fâsâc juju.
Eme ŋoŋe meŋeŋic betaŋkekicne â hoqaŋeŋ‐ŋeŋic ŋetarakicne, irec âte tiŋnehuc sanaŋkenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc hata bâʒâwepie wiŋkeme ŋoŋeraonec puriŋ ekicnezi ira qac qâsoric tâmiric âte rahuc biaŋkenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic mâmâc sasawa jaŋehec wamao jujure giene banʒepieŋ, erâ maŋfuru erâ juniŋte henʒiriŋnenʒepieŋ, maŋwânâŋhec juku Wofuŋ hohone i mi fokac.
Ŋoŋeraonec moczi Anuture aki anonoc ririzacte soŋaŋ babac enʒepieŋ. Erâ ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ʒâŋ opac moczi gitec herâ ʒacŋopame sâqorenʒipiŋte rucŋeŋic banʒepieŋ.
Erâ ŋoŋeraonec moczi Esaure hata mi âtehuc sasecŋic â ŋic araŋ bapa tâmiric mi ezejec. E nânâ mocjaha mac irec erâ mârâc fufuare merâfâc qikiŋnewec.
Ŋoŋe ere manaeŋgopieŋ, e ʒâhec jambuŋ rozo mume sakarecnekicne. E wiac ewec i suame arictac eocte kio‐bipiehuc emâmâŋkewec.
Ŋoŋe tiki moc ba bâuac eene, ʒocbâruŋnehec ira mi ra fisimbiŋ, erâ hâweŋ, dapâc â mâŋâŋ ʒâʒâkiriŋne irec maŋnao mi raʒimbiŋ.
Erâ qeŋfânâŋ sâko â dâŋowa i wâc mi manambiŋ. Manambiŋzi dâŋ niniŋkeocte numu huacbuc embiŋ.
Dâŋ kecʒiŋuc mukicne, irec manapie hâhâwicne ewec: “Qowi tiki âteuame qânâzi hehâmozo.”
Wiac i bipic tataranehec fuakume Mosezi muwec: “No hâwicnume ɋarac ɋarac qakopac.”
Ŋoŋe tiki iŋucnao mâcne, ŋoŋe Zioŋ tiki, Anutu jujune ere hae sâkoo, sambâŋte Jerusalemko fisimbiŋ. Ehuc aŋelo mi wowosec‐jopane â ʒeri tutumaŋ sâko
â fuŋfuŋ gurufâc‐ticne ʒâŋejeŋic sambâŋko qâreŋkekicne jaŋe hâcne maic‐jopambiŋ. Ehuc Anutu, ŋic sasawa nâŋâcne mumutara maickembiŋ, â ŋic tiŋne furu bacjopakicne qâqâtâcfâc‐jeŋic jaŋerao ʒuhuckembiŋ;
â Jesu, ʒâʒâfic ɋâricnere jâcne, erao fisirâ rurua soc maickembiŋ, soc izi Abe socticnezi wira wâwâsic ewec iŋuc mâcne, sâc moc wira wâwâsic eekac.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ ŋazaekac e râpeckenʒipiŋte ruc bahuc junʒepieŋ. Mârâc jaha mâreŋko waharâ dâŋ jazame qikiŋnepie okacne fisi‐jarewec. Eme ʒi sambâŋko juhuc dâŋ nâzâekac, e râpeckerâ wemocko okac tâmiric junaŋmu.
Mârâc jaha dâŋ mume mâreŋ qiriŋ qawec. Eme ʒi ine dâŋticne ʒiŋuc fokac: No juku mâreŋ mocwâc itiriŋkehuc sambâŋ mâmâc itiriŋkepemu.
Mocwâc itiriŋkepemu, iŋuc muwec, ine wiac bâfuakicne i itiriŋkeme ŋerisieocte manasuhuc muwec. Ŋerisieme fofo sanaŋ i fuarâ qiriŋmâc fozokac.
Nâŋâc uucmaŋ moc qiriŋmâc fofo sanaŋ rauckenaŋmu, irec Anutu mucne bacnenʒepeneŋ, ehuc rumerâ araŋ bacnehuc, jahac maname biaŋkeekac irec sâcko kiŋaŋ qacnenʒepeneŋ.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc mananʒepeneŋ: Anutunâŋec e ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne.
Qoqomâzi jauŋ babac eeŋgopieŋ i ŋoŋerao mi wahazejec.
Ŋic hezu hewâneŋ ejareniŋte qâoma mi enʒepieŋ. Gâcnezi ŋic hezu hewâneŋ ejareŋgopeneŋ muhuc aŋelo ejarembiŋ.
Âgofâc‐ŋeŋic kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐jopakicne jaŋere manasuhuc manapie mâmâc râec‐ŋopakicne tinac ezejec. Erâ ŋoŋe sahachec jaha juŋgopieŋte qa imac ejarekicne jaŋere wâc manasunʒepieŋ.
Ŋowe ŋonâŋ jujure manapie wiac fârine eha fofo wirecko gâc mi hezejec. Boe sau â ʒuhuc bâtâc eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe Anutuzi okacne jareocmu.
Maŋŋeŋiczi moneŋ mafare harac mi ezejec. Wiac foŋarekac sâc mukâroŋ tâmiric bajunʒepieŋ. Wofuŋ e jahac ʒiŋuc muwec: “Noni mi behecgupemu, â hone qâoma moc mi egarepemu.”
Irec nâŋâc hâbi‐nâŋec rohuc ʒiŋuc munʒepeneŋ: “Wofuŋ e ŋeŋezic‐nane, no mi hâwicnuzejec; ŋic jaŋe wemo enareniŋmu?”
Micne bapafâc‐ŋeŋic Anuture dâŋ ŋaza qazuc embiŋ jaŋere manasuhuc junʒepieŋ, erâ miti hata âteku hâmombiŋ itirocne honehuc jaŋere bâjâpecne mamanasiŋhec junʒepieŋ.
Jesu Kristo e juweczi jukac ijaha juraʒihuc juocmu sanaŋ.
Mu qaqazuc dâŋ kosane hazec furu ŋazapie izi maŋŋeŋic mi hesifuckezejec; maŋŋeŋic aki anonoczi keteŋneme qiŋ herâ fome biaŋkeocmu, wiac nâkicnezi sâcne mi basanaŋkeocmu. Hata i âtembiŋzi fârine mi bâfuambiŋ.
Nâŋâcne alata ŋekac, irec nânâ i qoruc boze kiŋaŋ qacneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe nâniŋte mi mana‐jarekicne.
Ŋoŋe manaeŋgopieŋ, qowi hezurâ socjeŋic taha bapa sâkozi sâqocnere kiŋte furu ufuŋko bafeme fârine hae sahao bahurâ ʒoczi rikeeŋgopieŋ.
Eme Jesu e iŋuc jaha socticnezi ŋic maŋfuru bacnâpoocte hae sahao qapie hâmowec.
Irec nâŋâc iŋuc jaha hae sahao erao hurâ, eki mimi faio fewec ijaha enʒepeneŋ.
Ʒiŋuc manahuc enʒepeneŋ: Hae ŋeŋe sanaŋ moc ʒira mi ŋenârekac; moc juku fufuane irec maŋhâhâŋ enâreekac.
Irec nâŋâc Jesure erâ Anutu ʒuʒuhuc jaha mumuteŋ ecnepene izi taha bâzi‐ticne ezejec, micbipic‐nâŋecte fârine ʒâŋe‐ticne muac baafec enʒepeneŋ hâcne.
Jauŋ â bâmec baniŋte qâoma mi enʒepieŋ, Anutu e irec hâcne maname taha bâzi fârine eocmu.
Micne bapafâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere dâŋ reŋkehuc sâsec‐jopanʒepieŋ; jaŋe maŋ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋic hone soŋaŋ eeŋgopieŋzi juku gie‐jeŋicte fuŋne mutaniŋkeniŋmu. Irec gie‐jeŋic bubiaŋko bapie sâckeocmu, busâqocko bahapie ŋoŋerao wiac sâcne mi biaŋkeocmu.
Ŋoŋe nâŋere erâ numuhuc junʒepieŋ. Nâŋe pectâc sasawa junaŋte ʒoɋac eeŋgopeneŋzi maŋnâŋecko bahac basaeŋgopeneŋ.
Nunumuzi baficnupie Wofuŋzi bârisiecnume ŋoŋerao biac fâpemurâ ŋaza sanaŋkekopac.
Wama Anutu e lama soŋaŋ sâko Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu ʒâʒâfic fofo sanaŋ irec socte hâmockonec bârisiewec,
Anutu eki hâcne wiac biaŋne fuŋne fuŋne tahac‐ŋopahuc baafec‐ŋopame dâŋticne reŋkenʒepieŋ, erâ e jahac maname sâckeekac i Jesu Kristore erâ ŋoŋerao bâfuazejec. Erao mumuteŋzi mumuteŋ foraʒihuc juzejec sanaŋ. Jâmbomac.
Âgofâc, no dâŋ ʒoricne boc mi qâreŋkepac, eme ŋoŋe uŋsawaŋ dâŋ i manapie mi sâqoreocte esoc‐ŋopakopac.
Erâ ŋazape mananiŋ, âgo‐nâŋec Timoteo e firuembiŋ, biac wareme jowape fanacmu.
Micnefâc‐ŋeŋic â mitiŋic ŋokac sasawa manasu‐ŋare‐fârekopac. Italia mâreŋkonec jaŋe manasu‐ŋareŋgopieŋ.
Aki anonoczi ŋoŋerao fofârezejec.
Jakobo no Anutu â Jesu Kristo ere kiŋaŋ qaqazi Israe ŋicguru 12 siŋsaŋ qarâ juraŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe mu ʒeri eŋarehuc papia ʒi râe‐ŋarekopac.
Ŋoŋerao eesâic fuŋne fuŋne fuame manapie bubiaŋnehec sasawa ezejec.
Wiac iŋucnezi hâcne mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋic ba esâic ecnekume gâtâ bame ŋoŋerao sasanaŋ fuaocmu.
Sasanaŋte fârine ŋoŋerao fua‐hâmozejec, eme wiac moc mi basahuc bahacmâc â maŋfuru junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋeraonec moczi maŋɋârâŋ basarâ Anutu numucnezejec. Eme e ŋic sasawa, dâŋ mi munârehuc, wiac maŋhumuc nâreekaczi bâfuacneocmu.
Nunumu ine maŋjahec ehuc mâcne, Wofuŋ manasiŋkehuc numucnezejec. Maŋjahec eocmu e hâwec siri, mâŋâŋzi ficne sueme fâuckerâ tâtieekac, iŋucne eocmu.
Ŋic iŋucnezi Wofuŋtaonec wiac moc roocmu mi muzejec.
Maŋguru â tie faranezi wemocko iŋuc eocmu.
Opâ ruac wahakicnezi fekicne jukopac muhuc maname ʒerine ezejec.
Â mafaŋiczi wahakicne jukopac muhuc maname ʒerine ezejec. Jâcârizi ŋeindaŋnerâ biac mârâŋkeekac, iŋuc jaha mafaheczi biac siroweniŋmu.
Ʒoaŋ e furicte wefurâ ʒocnezi ʒariŋ rikeme ɋaŋame ârine mârâŋkeme eri‐ticne wahaekac, iŋuc jaha mafaŋic jaŋe ɋaŋapie qâŋtac‐jeŋic sawa ŋeocmu.
Ŋic moc e eesâicko qiŋ herâ juocmu ere manape ʒerine ekac. E sanaŋkeku maŋne eme Wofuŋzi eri hendiŋ juju sanaŋ hâcne râcneocmu. I maŋjeŋic ere domakac jaŋe biŋe qajarekicne.
Ŋic moc sâqocnere eesâic fuacneme ʒiŋuc mi muzejec: Anutuzi esâicnukac. Sâqocnere eesâic Anuturao fufuane mi fokac, â eki wâc ŋic moc sâqocnere mi esâickeocmu.
Eesâic ine kecʒiŋuc fuaocmu, qanaŋ ŋic moc e jahacne saseczi beŋgisic sicnecnehuc hehawickeocmu.
Eme saseczi motec kiweckerâ roocmu, ʒâŋene sâqocne; sâqocnezi ine woze qeuc eku hâmoc bâfuaocmu.
Âgo biaŋfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe dâŋ mi mana sifuckenʒepieŋ,
jauŋ biaŋne â taha fârine i faicnec sasawa, tatamac Mamac eraonec wahaekac, erao hâcne hec hetikic â sâsâoc mi fokac.
Anutu e manapaŋkewecte dâŋfârizi naru motecfâcne bâfuac‐nâpowec, i wiac sasawa bâfuawec irec hata qaqasune tinac enaŋte iŋuc enârewec.
Âgo biaŋfâc‐nane, mananiŋ. Ŋiczi dâŋ mamanare afeckenʒepeneŋ, dâŋ mumure â aaricte ine ŋemâckenʒepeneŋ.
Aaricko wiac eeŋgopeneŋ izi Anuture tiŋne hata ririekac.
Irec ŋoŋe maŋwânâŋ â râŋgeŋ bârâŋgeŋ hetararâ urucko juhuc maŋŋeŋicko mitidâŋ râekicne i âgo ecnenʒepieŋ. Izi hâcne maŋ qâqâtâc‐nâŋec bâpiaŋkeocte tâpiri focnekac.
Ŋoŋe mitidâŋte fârine bâfuanʒepieŋ, mâc hazecte nâpene sawa eme maŋŋeŋic eatuckeniŋmu.
Moc e mitidâŋ mana qâoma eocmu, e ŋiczi ʒâŋe mai‐nâŋec hawario honerâ eeŋgopeneŋ, sâc ijaha eocmu.
Ʒâŋe mai‐nâŋec hawario honerâ ra qâoma erâ izia hawari‐nâŋecte nikec‐nâpoekac.
Â moc e sâcmutâc dâŋ fârine, rambaŋko rârâec‐nâpone, dâŋ ira mana utuckerâ juocmu, ehuc mana qâoma mâcne, mana rereŋ eocmu, iŋucnezi ine dâŋte fârine bâfuarâ mana aŋac eocmu.
Moc e mitio jukopac muekaczi micbipic‐ticne mi soŋaŋkehuc maŋticne eatuckeekac, ŋic iŋucnere mitio juju i racne eocmu.
Hozec bekâ busâqocko juhapie hone maiŋ ejarezo â mâreŋko sâqocne fokac izi maŋnâŋec hegâpârezacte pectâc juzo, izi Anutu â Mamac ere maio wâwânâŋ tâmiricko mitio juju ekac.
Âgofâc, ŋoŋe tatamac Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo manasiŋkeeŋgopieŋzi ŋic fekicne wahakicne wiac sâctiri mi ejarenʒepieŋ.
No kecʒiŋucte mukopac: Tutumaŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic moc boreŋ qonaŋkerâ ŋaqi erinehec hefâocmu, eme ere râpefuŋko ŋic hapetac moc ŋaqi taocnehec hefâocmu.
Ehame ŋoŋe ŋic ŋaqi erinehec erao ʒâŋe firâ ʒiŋuc âzâcneniŋmu: “Go ʒira ware popoo ŋec.” Iŋuc murâ hapetac e ʒiŋuc âzâcneniŋmu: “Go ocna domac, me ɋâriŋko waha ŋec.”
Ŋoŋe ŋondeŋ‐ŋeŋicko ŋic teŋtiri ejareeŋgopieŋ, i maŋŋeŋicko dâŋ repicne soŋkepie fokacte wiac esifuckeeŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Âgo biaŋfâc‐nane, dâŋ mupe mananiŋ: Anutuzi ŋic weniŋucne rowosâec‐jopawec? Mâreŋko hapetac jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne mamanasiŋko maŋ mâririhec erâ uucmaŋ rauckeniŋte rowosâec‐jopawec. I irec ejareekac jaŋe hâcne biŋe qajarewec.
Eme ŋoŋe ine hapetac jaŋe ʒâŋe titikic honec‐jopaeŋgopieŋ. Â weni jaŋezia bâuruŋ‐ŋoparâ kiarao râec‐ŋopaeŋgopieŋ? Mafahec jaŋe hâcne iŋuc eŋareeŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc wâc ʒâŋe biaŋ fai‐ŋeŋicko fewec e musoriŋkeeŋgopieŋ.
“Gahacnere egareekac sâc ijaha âgogere egarezejec”, sâcmutâc dâŋ neŋgocne iŋuc qâreŋkekicne fokac, i reŋkepie jâmbomac biaŋkeocmu.
Â ŋic sâctiri ejareniŋmu, ine bahac bâfuapie sâcmutâc dâŋzi qaqatara ŋic eŋgopieŋ irec fuŋne bataniŋkeocmu.
Moc e sâcmutâc dâŋ gâcne reŋke‐fârehuc mocjaha qatarame sâcmutâc dâŋ qâqâhâc qatarawec eocmu.
“Ŋowe ŋonâŋ ŋohe bebehec mi ezepirec” muwec ekizia wâc “go ʒika mi qazemec” muwec. Eme go ŋonâŋge mi behecmu, ʒika ine qacmu, ine dâŋ qaqatara ŋic ecmu.
Sâcmutâc dâŋ rambaŋko rârâec‐nâpo izi juku fuŋne babataniŋ dameŋko rambaŋko râec‐ŋopaocte wiac mana tarahuc mu bac enʒepieŋ.
Ŋic uruc jauŋ tâmiric juocmu e wâc juku uruc jauŋ mi ecnezo. Uruc jauŋhec juocmu e fuŋne babataniŋko hâhâwic tâmiric domaocmu.
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋic moczi “mamanasiŋhec jukopac” muocmu, ehuc eehâmo gie mi baocmu, e mamanasiŋ‐ticnezi moc bafickeocmu me? Mamanasiŋzi wemocko sisipirickonec bataraocmu.
Ŋic me ŋokac âgo‐ŋeŋic moczi qoruc ŋaqi me nânâ wiac basahuc juhame
ŋoŋeraonec moczi e ʒiŋuc âzâcneocmu: “Go sâcne ra juzemec, erâ fâfârezicte sahacge foŋkezemec â nânâ nâ gapec ezemec”, moc e miczi iŋuc sawa muhuc jauŋ mi bacneocmu, izi wemocko bafickeocmu?
Irec mamanasiŋ bucticne, fârine eehâmo gie mi fuaocmuo, hâmo mâteŋ ekicne muzo.
Me moczi ʒiŋuc mecne muocmu: “Go mamanasiŋ fogarekac, â no eehâmo gie fonarekac.” Me, mamanasiŋge eehâmo gie tâmiric i nowatutec honepe. Â no eehâmo gie bahuc mamanasiŋ‐nanere fuŋne sâcne gowatupemu.
Anutu mocjaha jukac, dâŋ i mana ʒakiekic; i sâcne ekic. Dâŋ i demoŋ jaŋe wâc mana ʒakieŋgopieŋ, ehuc ɋarac ɋarac qaeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic maŋtac go mamanasiŋ eehâmo gie tâmiriczi wiac jawane ekac irec fuŋne ʒi manac.
Mimiŋne‐nâŋec Abraham e ŋokâ‐ticne Isaka taha bâzi rikeocte alatao râewec ira Anutuzi manacneme kiŋfâsâc ewec i eebapa‐ticnere hâcne.
Eme ʒiŋuc honekic: Abraham mamanasiŋ‐ticne i eebapa‐ticnezi bafickewec, ehuc mamanasiŋ‐ticne qizecne qawec.
Eme irec hâcne Abrahamte dâŋqâreŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac i sanaŋkewec: “Abraham e Anutu manasiŋkeme ere maname kiŋfâsâc ewec.” Eme irec ʒâŋe‐ticne Anuture âgo mucnekicne.
Honeŋgopieŋ, Anutu e ŋic moc mamanasiŋ‐ticnere sawa mi maname kiŋfâsâc eocmu, fârine eehâmo gie bame manacneme kiŋfâsâc eocmu.
Â sasec ŋokac Rahaba e iŋuc jaha mamanasiŋ‐ticnere fârine eehâmo gie bame Anutuzi manacneme kiŋfâsâc ewec. E ŋic mâreŋ hone tâcnepic jahe erao fisipire âgo ejacterâ hatasoŋko râec‐jofame wisepic.
Irec ʒiŋuc fokac: Sahac e mâro tâmiric erâ qâŋɋâŋ eekac, iŋuc jaha mamanasiŋzi eehâmo gie tâmiric qâŋɋâŋne jaha eekac.
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋe bocjahazi qaqazu gie baniŋte mi fotarienʒepieŋ. Manaŋgopieŋ, mumutara dameŋko Wofuŋzi qaqazu nâŋe wiac baʒihuc enâreocmu.
Nâŋâc mâmâc sasawa wiac gâbâ esifuckeeŋgopeneŋ. Ŋic moc e dâŋko moc mi sâqoreocmu, e ŋic saric sarahaŋne mucnezo. Iŋucnezi me sahac‐ticne sasawa guriŋne sâcne bafâreocmu.
Becâsic jaŋe dâŋnâŋec reŋkeniŋte micko kiki râe‐jareeŋgopeneŋ. Erâ izi becsâko bac bâtikic ejareeŋgopeneŋ.
Wokere wâc manaeŋgopeneŋ, jaŋe kâcɋene sâko, erâ mâŋâŋ sanaŋnezi ficne suec‐jopame raeŋgopieŋ, eme sifu guriŋ bapa e guriŋ piticne i bac bâtikic ehuc hata muocmu ijaha wokezi raocmu.
Eme ŋicnameŋ e iŋuc jaha wiac piticne, erâ wiac wemo afecne efeekac. Manaŋgopieŋ, ʒoc masisi i wiac huŋgaŋne mac, eme iŋucne maczi sopâc sâko rikepene ʒafâreekac.
Eme nameŋ‐nâŋec ʒoc masisi iŋucnea wâc. Eki hâcne me sahac gâcne siric‐jopahuc sâqocnere neŋgocne eekaczi sahac‐nâŋec bâbie‐fâreekac â juju‐nâŋecte ŋesiŋ rikeme ʒafâreekac; e jahacne ine hârâckonec ʒoczi qâhâsâme ʒaekac.
Qowi fuŋne fuŋne tiŋkonec â hâweckonec erâ wipe homa wiac i ŋiczi bâmâteŋkezo murâ bâmâteŋkeeŋgopeneŋ.
Nameŋ ine mo ŋic mozi bâmâteŋkeocmu? E gapec tâmiric ririsiehuc sâqocne baekac, qotâre micopâzi fusucmakicne tinac.
Nameŋ‐nâŋeczi Wofuŋ Mamac muteŋkeeŋgopeneŋ, erâ nameŋzia ŋic Anuture hawarifâc sâwec‐jopaeŋgopeneŋ.
Mic ijaha mumuteŋ â sâwec wahaekac. Âgofâc‐nane, iŋuc wemocte?
Opâ ʒâŋe ijaha nocne â hâtâne ataŋ wahaekac me?
Âgofâc, hâmeŋko woraŋ fuaocmu? Me saŋko hâmeŋ fuaocmu? Me hâweczi nocne eocmu?
Ŋoŋerao maŋɋârâŋhec â maŋ manahuc wiac ee iŋucne moc juŋgopieŋ me? Ine wama ruaine juhuc eebapa biaŋne bâfuahuc maŋɋârâŋ‐jeŋicte fuŋne bataniŋkenʒepieŋ.
Â maŋjeŋicko iiŋguuŋ hâtâne â hehefaric fohame ine sahac‐jeŋic bafehuc dâŋfâri manaŋgopeneŋ mupie burec eocmu.
Maŋɋârâŋ hata iŋucne i faicnec wahakicne mi muzo, aricne, mâŋɋârâŋ hata iŋucne i mâreŋkonec, ŋickonec, Sataŋtaonec.
Iiŋguuŋ â hehefaric foocmu ijaha wâc fâfâuc â wiac gâgâpâcne gâcne gâcne fofâreocmu.
Maŋɋârâŋ hata faicnec izi ine wiac ʒiŋuc bâfuaekac: Qanaŋ maŋɋaɋac, erâ wama, miriŋ, micrereŋ, uruc jauŋhec juju â mitire fârine gâcne, erâ wâc maŋguru tâmiric â siocmâc juju.
Wamare guriŋne baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe wamao ukicne sara mamac epie fârine tiŋne juju fua‐jareekac.
Ŋoŋerao ʒika â rârâsi foekac i fuŋne weniŋucte? Me sahac‐ŋeŋicko andac forakac izi hâcne ʒika gie baekac.
Ŋoŋe andac eipiehuc wiac mi rauckeeŋgopieŋ. Ŋoŋe qaqac â iiŋguuŋ eec ehuc sifu wiac sâcne mi hotâckeeŋgopieŋ. Ŋoŋe kikisâ â kikisuec ehuc wiac sâcne mi hure nâc eeŋgopieŋ. I nunumu tâmiric jueŋgopieŋ irec.
Moc i numu‐bipiehuc wiac mi roeŋgopieŋ, ine maŋŋeŋicko dâŋ sâqocne ʒiŋuc foha numueŋgopieŋte: “Wiac fua‐nâreme samarierâ andac‐nâŋecte fârine bâfuanʒepeneŋ.”
Oi, ʒâʒâfic hehetâc ŋic ŋoŋe! Mâreŋko wiac fokac irec biŋe juocmuzi Anutu râpeckeocmu, i mi manaŋgopieŋ me? Irec moc e mâreŋkopec wiac kosa âgo ecneocmuzi Anutu kisâ ecneocmu.
Me dâŋqâreŋ kecʒiŋuc fokac i ŋoŋe manapie racne eekac me? “Maŋnâŋecko mâro râewec i ere biŋe sawa juocte ʒoɋac sâko eekac.”
Erâ ŋifec ine aki anonoc wemo afecne sicne‐nâreekac. Irec dâŋqâreŋ hâcne kecʒiŋuc fokac: “Anutu e ŋic maŋfefe dope qatara‐jareekac, ŋic maŋhuhuŋ ine aki anonoc sicne‐jareekac.”
Irec ŋoŋe Anuture rurumaŋko raʒirâ domanʒepieŋ. Ehuc Sataŋ bâsuenʒepieŋ, eme behec‐ŋoparâ wiseocmu.
Ŋoŋe Anutu maickepie eki wâc maic‐ŋopaocmu. Sâqocne bapa, maŋŋeŋic ra qa ware qa eekac, ŋoŋe meŋeŋic ʒurerâ maŋŋeŋic baɋaɋackenʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe fuŋne‐ŋeŋic mana tararâ ki busâqoc enʒepieŋ. Gâgâwi‐ŋeŋiczi rirehame busâqoc fuazejec, â ʒeri‐ŋeŋiczi rirehame ki mamakuc fuazejec.
Wofuŋte maio maŋhuhuŋ jupie eki bafaharec‐ŋopaocmu.
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋe mumusâqoc mi enʒepieŋ. Moc e âgo‐ticne musâqorerâ okacne dâŋko râeocmu, e sâcmutâc dâŋ musâqorehuc hetâtieocmu. Go ine sâcmutâc dâŋ hetâtiecmuo rereŋŋic mi ehuc mumutara ŋic ecmu.
Sâcmutâc dâŋ irec mumufua â soŋaŋ mocjaha sawa jukac, aakic â bebehe irec gie ekizia baocmu. Go ine wemogezi âgoge okacne dâŋko râecmu?
Ajoc, moc ʒi mananiŋ. Ŋoŋe kecʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: “Miŋecgac me tomâcko hae ira ra moneŋ mafa hurehuc juhapene jara moc tarame risienʒepeneŋ.”
Oi ŋoŋe, tomâcko wiac iŋuc me iŋuc fuaocmu, i moc manaeŋgopieŋ? Me juju‐ŋeŋic i weniŋucne? I rombâŋ iŋucne, fua fuahuc izia qaʒueekac.
Irec ŋoŋe kecʒiŋuc mupie sâckeocmu: “Wofuŋzi mana‐nâreme ɋâricne juhuc iŋuc me iŋuc enʒepeneŋ.”
Ŋoŋe ine pacgoroŋ dâŋ boc muhuc sahac‐ŋeŋic bafeeŋgopieŋ. Pacgoroŋ dâŋ i wiac sâqocne.
Ŋic moc e wiac biaŋne eocte mana tarahuc sifu qikiŋneekac, e bahac bâfuakac muzo.
Ajoc, mafa mâririhec ŋoŋe ʒârâ hâriŋ fua‐ŋareocmu irec qanaŋ ki mamakuc enʒepieŋ.
Mafa mâriri‐ŋeŋic i ʒaŋke‐fârewec, ŋaqi guru dindiŋ‐ŋeŋic mâreŋte temane ewec,
â moneŋ boreŋ‐ŋeŋic gufewec, eme gufe izi ŋaŋacne fuŋne bataniŋkehuc sahac‐ŋeŋic ʒoc iŋucne nâmizieocmu. Ŋoŋe dameŋ qândâŋkeha mafa sesuc sembureŋ hefembiŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, padi qaŋarepie gie furi sakare‐jarembiŋ irec kiŋzi hohosâcne qakac, erâ qa roro ŋic jaŋere kio wâwâsiczi sambâŋ momori jaŋere Wofuŋte hazecko huwec.
Ŋoŋe mâreŋko wiac nâminʒiriŋkehuc mana aŋac embiŋ â okac dameŋ maickeha nâ areŋ embiŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic tiŋne dâŋne mutararâ ʒikao râembiŋ. E sahac‐ticne mi ŋezickekac.
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋe Wofuŋ fisiocte woŋec tatakic tâmiric junʒepieŋ. Manaŋgopieŋ, gie rune moczi iŋuc jaha nânâ he sarac erâ fârine fua biaŋ eocte woŋec juekac, ehuc hoe ʒoaŋ sâckoa bacneme fua sokac eocte mamanac juekac.
Eme Wofuŋte dameŋ bembeŋkekacte ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha tatakic tâmiric woŋec juhuc maŋŋeŋic keteŋnenʒepieŋ.
Âgo bureŋ, ŋoŋe mu takic mi eec enʒepieŋ; manaŋgopieŋ mumutara ŋic e motâc râpeo domakac, fuŋne‐ŋeŋic rituzacte dâŋ ere biŋe râepie fozejec.
Âgofâc‐nane, porofete Wofuŋte micte dâŋ mumbiŋzi ʒâic busâqoc tatakic tâmiric manahuc jumbiŋ jaŋere kike hata bâjâpehuc junʒepieŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, ʒâicmaŋko sasanaŋhec jumbiŋ jaŋere manapene ʒerine ekac. Hiobe sasanaŋ‐ticnere manaeŋgopieŋ, â Wofuŋzi ʒâhec wiac afusecnewec i wâc manaeŋgopieŋ. Wofuŋ e buuruc â jauŋ‐ticne kâcɋene fokac hâcne.
Âgofâc‐nane dâŋ fârine moc ʒi: Ŋoŋe sambâŋko ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ, me mâreŋko ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ, me wiac mocko ɋetickehuc mumupaŋ, i mi enʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe dâŋŋeŋic jâmbomacte fârine jâmbomac ezejec â aricnere fârine aricne jaha ezejec. I kiŋ bâfuanʒipiŋte iŋuc enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋeraonec moczi ʒâic busâqocko juocmu, e Anutu numucnezejec, me moczi bubiaŋko juocmu, e mumuteŋ gae hezejec.
Ŋoŋeraonec moczi huc foocmu, e kikefuŋte micne bapa hefârec‐jopame fisirâ ere faio numunʒepieŋ, erâ Wofuŋte ʒâŋe muhuc wokemaŋ opâ ruacnenʒepieŋ.
Eme mamanasiŋko nunumu mukicne izi huchec bâpiaŋkeocmu â Wofuŋzi e ɋiɋicne baocmu. Â sâqocne bawecko i bâtâmirecneocmu.
Irec ŋoŋe ɋiɋic qaniŋte sâqocne mumufuac erâ nunumuzi dodopec enʒepieŋ. Ŋic tiŋne moczi numume tâpirinehec eocmu.
Elia e ŋic jaha, nâŋâc iŋucne. Eme eki hoe mi heocte samarierâ numume mâreŋko jara jahec â moc â mosa 6 hoe mi hehe mâc fowec.
Eme ʒâhec mocwâc numume sambâŋkonec hoe wahame mâreŋko wiac ukicne âkeʒuwec.
Âgofâc‐nane, ŋoŋeraonec moc e dâŋfârire hata qâsorieme âgo moczi bâtikieocmu,
e dâŋ ʒiŋuc manazejec: Moc e âgo‐ticne hata sâqocnaonec bârisieocmuzi e jahacne maŋ qâqâtâc hâmockonec bataraocmu â sâqocne guru sâko sâockeocmu.
Petoro no Jesu Kristo ere aposolo jukopaczi Anutu bâwosâecfâc‐ticne Ponto â Galatia â Kapadokia â Asia â Bitinia mâreŋko ocŋondeŋ jaba juraŋgopieŋ ŋoŋere papia ʒi qâreŋkekopac.
Anutu Mamaczi maname fowecte rowosâec‐ŋopawec ŋoŋe hâcne Mârozi maŋfuru bacŋopaocte â mume rereŋfâcne eniŋte Jesu Kristore soc ruambiŋ: Ŋoŋerao aki anonoc â wama fua bâbâriŋ fuahuc fozejec.
Nâŋâc Anutu, Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere Mamac, e muteŋkenʒepeneŋ. Eki Jesu Kristo hâmockonec faharewecte uruc jauŋ sâko‐ticnere erâ, juju fârire mamanac junaŋte bâɋârec‐nâpowec.
Sambâŋko merâfâc‐ŋeŋic ʒaʒaŋke tâmiric â bie gufec tâmiric â hâmo qanʒaraŋ tâmiric woŋec‐ŋeŋic râekicne fokac, i juku rauckeniŋte iŋuc hâcne eŋarewec.
Ehuc Anutu tâpiri‐ticnezi bâwâzâŋ‐ŋopame mamanasiŋhec juhapie juku dameŋ tarame bâbâpiaŋ kâdoc bâmockekicne i fua tâcneocmu.
Ŋoŋe irec ʒeri ehuc juŋgopieŋ, â Anutuzi muŋareme fific guguriŋ faio ferâ ʒâic busâqocko juhuc sifu dameŋ bembeŋne macte jamaŋ kirâ jueŋgopieŋ.
Manaŋgopieŋ, gol i wiac ʒaʒaŋkene fuŋne‐ticne ʒocko taniŋkeekac, ŋoŋe ine mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋic, wiac furi sâko jâmbâŋ, irec fârine fific guguriŋko fua taniŋkeme Jesu Kristo fifisi‐ticnao ŋoŋere ʒeri bubiaŋ â mumuteŋ â eri qaraweŋ fuaocmu.
Ŋoŋe Jesu e hawari‐ticne mi honembiŋzi sifu maŋŋeŋic qikiŋnecneeŋgopieŋ, erâ dameŋ ʒiŋucne wâc ʒâŋezi mi hohone sifu manasiŋkeeŋgopieŋ. Ehuc ʒeri bubiaŋ fuŋmoc, ŋicmiczi mi mumufuane, manacneeŋgopieŋ.
Mamanasiŋ‐ŋeŋicte fârine maŋ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋicte bâbâpiaŋ hâcne, maic‐ŋopakacte ʒeri eŋgopieŋ.
Bâbâpiaŋ i weniŋuc fuazokac, porofete jaŋe mârâc jaha iŋuc wiorâ gufu koparic ehuc jumbiŋ, ehuc ŋoŋerao aki anonoc fuaocte irec findaŋdâŋ muhuc jumbiŋ.
Kristo e ʒâic fâro manaku eri tatamac‐ticne rorâ juocmu, irec dâŋ Mâro‐ticnezi maŋjeŋicko râeme jaŋe dameŋ wezimucko â weniŋucnao Kristo iŋuc fuacnezokac muhuc wawariehuc jumbiŋ.
Jaŋe gie bambiŋ irec fârine jaŋacnao mâcne, ŋoŋerao fuaocte mukicne, i jaŋe mufua‐jarekicne. Eme ʒâhec irec fârine fuame Tiri Mârozi sambâŋkonec waharâ mitiŋic neŋgoc ŋejareme Biŋebiaŋ muromackembiŋ jaŋe hâcne findaŋdâŋte fârine mujaŋgeŋke‐ŋarembiŋ. Dâŋ irec ʒuhucne aŋelo jaŋe wâc mana ʒiguaniŋte buââkec jueŋgopieŋ.
Irec ŋoŋe maŋŋeŋicte umbika jomarâ maŋsowa junʒepieŋ, ehuc Jesu Kristo fua tâcnerâ aki anonoc bâfua‐ŋareocmu, irec mamanac junʒepieŋ.
Anuture mume rereŋfâc ŋoŋe mârâc jaha qâpuc‐ŋeŋicko sasechec jujumbieŋ, juju sâc ijaha ʒiŋuczia mi junʒepieŋ.
Tiri runezi hefârec‐ŋopawec ere sâcko tiri jaha jufârenʒepieŋ.
Dâŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne qâreŋkekicne fokac: “No tiri jukopacte ŋoŋe tiri jaha junʒepieŋ.”
Ŋoŋe Mamac mucnehuc wâsickeeŋgopieŋ e ra rowec ware rowec mi ehuc juju bapa‐nâŋecte sâcko dâŋnâŋec mutaraocmu; irec ŋoŋe mâreŋko jaba juhuc sâc e araŋ bacnehuc junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ʒiŋuc sâcne manaeŋgopieŋ, kâcɋenefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere sindaŋ hata âtehuc juhapie wiac sisirowenezi, gol siliwa wiaczi mi kitâc‐ŋopawec.
Ŋoŋe Kristore soc furi sâko izi kitâc‐ŋopawec. E hâcne lama sahac fâsâc â wânâŋ tâmiric iŋucne juwec.
E mârâc jaha, mâreŋte hobeteŋne mi fuahame gie i mucnekicne, fufua ine ʒâhec dameŋ tarazo ehame ŋoŋere erâ fuawec.
Erâ ŋoŋe Anuturao ʒuhuc‐ŋopawec, Anutu hâmockonec bâɋârerâ eri tatamac hecneme huwec erao hâcne; eme irec mamanasiŋ â woworic‐ŋeŋic Anuturao fokac.
Ŋoŋe dâŋfâri murâ rereŋ ekupie maŋ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋic ɋaɋackewec i ââgo fârihec eniŋte iŋuc fuawec; eme irec maŋzi jâmbâŋ ʒâʒâfic ehuc junʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe fufua ɋâri i ukic sisirowenaonec mâcne, mi sisirowenaonec, Anuture dâŋ jujune â fofo sanaŋ, irecnec âkeʒurâ fuambiŋ.
Dâŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “Sahachec jaŋe sopâc kecɋaŋ iŋucne, â ʒâŋe rarac biaŋ‐jeŋic i ʒariŋ âri iŋucne. Sopâc kecɋaŋzi ɋaŋaekac â ârinezi mârâŋkeekac. Anuture dâŋzi ine fofo sanaŋ foocmu.”
Biŋedâŋ biaŋne ŋazakicne ʒi hâcne.
Ŋoŋe sindaŋ â burec wiac â eeatuc â iiŋguuŋ â gupe micko âkec i hetara‐fârenʒepieŋ.
Hetararâ naru motec ɋiene susure ejareekac iŋuc jaha ŋoŋe maŋ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋicte susu biaŋ irec eŋarezejec. I nâhuc mitio soka pupuŋ enʒepieŋ.
Wofuŋ jauŋ‐ticne moc mana aŋac embiŋko iŋuc enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Wofuŋ, qânâ jujune hâcne, ŋiczi hone suŋgiŋkehapie Anutuzi maname fekicne eme bâwosâewec, erao âtesiŋkeniŋ.
Ehuc qânâ jujunea efârerâ ʒuhuckeme ʒuhuc doma doma fehuc Mârore ufuŋ enʒepieŋ. Erâ wâc tiri taha bapa guru erâ maŋzi Anutu taha bâzi ecnenʒepieŋ. I Jesu Kristore erâ maname biaŋkeocmu.
Miti papiao dâŋ ʒiŋuc hâcne fokac: “Manakic, no Zioŋko qânâ moc hekopac, qânâ wâtuŋ bâwosâekicne furi sâko. Ŋic moczi erao roweckeocmu e mi qurutuaocmu.”
Irec erao roweckeeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋerao wiac furi sâko ekac. Â mamanasiŋ tâmiric jaŋere ʒiŋuc mukicne: “Ficbapa jaŋe qânâ surehuc behembiŋ, izi hâcne qânâ wâtuŋ ewec domakac.”
Erâ wâc “Qânâ ira kike‐jeŋic hepirickeniŋmu â buse ira heariweniŋmu.” Ŋic miti qikiŋnehuc ira heariweniŋte mukicnere iŋuc hâcne eeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ine bâwosâecfâc‐ticne â taha bapa ŋicbomboŋfâc‐ticne â tiri ŋicgurufâc‐ticne â fuŋfuŋ gurufâc‐ticne. Iŋucne ŋoŋe dapâckonec bawefuc‐ŋoparâ tatamac jaŋgeŋ‐ticnao râec‐ŋopawec ere mâsi sâkore biŋedâŋ muropiepie haŋ bazejec.
Ŋoŋe mârâc jaha ruc hurâ jumbiŋ, ʒi ine Anuture ŋicfâc embiŋ juŋgopieŋ; mârâc jaha qarâ suŋgiŋne jumbiŋ, ʒi ine uruc jauŋko juŋgopieŋ.
Âgo biaŋfâc‐nane, no ŋazape mananiŋ, ŋoŋe mâreŋko jaba â ŋicmanac jueŋgopieŋzi sasec, maŋ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋicte râsi hâcne, i getâckenʒepieŋ.
Ehuc qâpuc jaŋere ŋondeŋko juju tiŋne junʒepieŋ. Iŋuc jupie qâpuc jaŋe fuŋne‐ŋeŋic hone mana tarac erâ, sâqocne bapa muŋareeŋgopieŋ, i beherâ juku Anuture iiqic dameŋko eehâmo gie‐ŋeŋicte erâ Anutu muteŋkenkenʒepieŋ.
Ŋiczi sâcmutâc fuŋne râekicne i ŋoŋe Wofuŋte erâ reŋke‐fârenʒepieŋ. Ŋicwofuŋ, femicne juekac, ere mecne,
â kia gawaman râec‐jopawec jaŋere mumupaŋ mecne, mâmâc reŋkenʒepieŋ; jaŋe hâcne sâqocne bapa okacne jareniŋte, â sâcne jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe mumbiaŋ‐jopaniŋte mujarekicne.
Ŋoŋe eehâmo gie bahuc ŋic mutucne, mumusifuc bâfuaeŋgopieŋ jaŋere dâŋ bâniniŋkeniŋte Anutuzi muŋareekac hâcne.
Ŋoŋe goroŋ‐ŋopakicnere rambaŋ juŋgopieŋ, erâ juju izi sâqocnere tapa mi ezejec, rambaŋ juhuc Anuture kiŋaŋ qanʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe ŋic ʒeŋgoma sâsec‐jopanʒepieŋ, âgofâc‐ŋeŋic maŋjauŋ ejarenʒepieŋ, Anutu araŋ bacnenʒepieŋ, ŋicwofuŋ sâsenʒepieŋ.
Kiŋaŋ qaqa ŋoŋe bomboŋfâc‐ŋeŋic araŋ bajarehuc micjeŋic reŋkenʒepieŋ, i bomboŋ urucne â mâteŋne jaŋe sawa mâcne, ʒâʒâicne jaŋe mâmâc iŋuc ejarenʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe maŋgâŋ bahac tâmiricko bâʒâic‐ŋopapie Anuture manasuhuc rârâŋgeŋ tâmiric jupie maname biaŋkeocmu.
Â bahac bâfuarâ ʒika kihuc rârâŋgeŋ tâmiric jupie mozi maname biaŋkeocmu? Tiŋne juhuc ʒika kirâ rârâŋgeŋ tâmiric jupie ine Anutuzi maname biaŋkeocmu.
Ŋoŋe iŋuc eniŋte hâcne muŋarekicne. Kristo e iŋuc jaha ŋoŋere erâ ʒâic manahuc bânie‐ŋarewec, eme ŋoŋe kike hata‐ticne honehuc ijaha âte ranʒepieŋ.
E bahac mi bâfuawec, â sioc micticnaonec mi fuawec.
E musâqorepie okacne mi musâqorec‐jopawec, bâʒâickepie okacnere dâŋ mi jazawec. E dâŋ mumutara gie fârine baekac ere biŋe qawec.
Nâŋâcne sâqocnezi ere sahacko feme maripoŋko bafewec, i sâqocne hâmocnehuc tiŋkerâ junaŋte ewec. Ere wiczi ŋoŋere wic bâsomiewec hâcne.
Ŋoŋe lama iŋucne qâsoc bâsoriehuc jumbiŋ. Ʒi ine maŋ qâqâtâc‐ŋeŋicte rusoŋaŋzi hefârec‐ŋopame erao fisimbiŋ.
Ŋokac ŋoŋere iŋuc jaha mupe, ŋoŋe ŋowefâc‐ŋeŋic jaŋere wahamicne junʒepieŋ. Eme ŋowefâc‐ŋeŋic gâcne miti qiqikiŋ jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe dâŋ mi jajaza mâc rume‐jarehuc maŋɋaɋac jupie
ŋonâŋfâc‐jeŋic ŋoŋere juju bapa hone manac erâ maŋjeŋic bârisienʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe sahacte eri, qizec ba ericko bapa, kubu wiac furi sâko qoqonaŋ, ŋaqi qâreŋ biaŋ rojuju, irec manapie jawane ezejec.
Ehame buuruc fârine, maŋwâmbuŋko soŋkerâ tiŋbenoŋ bâfuaekac, izi eri fofo sanaŋ‐ŋeŋic eme Anutuzi maname furi sâko eocmu.
Miti ŋokac mârâc jujumbieŋ jaŋe eri i hâcne baju jumbieŋ, ehuc Anuturao roweckehuc ŋowefâc‐jeŋic sâsec‐jopa jumbieŋ.
Sara eki hâcne Abraham dâŋticne reŋke jujec, ehuc ŋicbomboŋ mucne jujec. Eme ŋoŋe wiac biaŋne bahuc mu hâhâwicte mana mezac mi eniŋmuo otâfâc‐ticne embiŋ juŋgopieŋ muŋarezo.
Ŋic ŋoŋere iŋuc jaha mupe; ŋokac e tâpirine wahakacte ŋonâŋfâc‐ŋeŋic wiac mana manahuc ejarenʒepieŋ. Erâ juju sanaŋte biŋe mâmâc qajarekicnere sâsec‐jopahuc junʒepieŋ. Eme nunumu‐ŋeŋiczi ququŋke tâmiric qâfâsâerâ fezejec.
Erâ qâhâckehuc mupe; ŋoŋe mâmâc sasawa maŋ mocjaha erâ miriŋhec junʒepieŋ, ehuc âgofâc‐ŋeŋic maŋjauŋ ejarehuc wama ruaine â maŋhuhuŋ junʒepieŋ.
Wiac sâqocne eŋarepie okacne sâqocne jaha mi ejarenʒepieŋ, sosopec dâŋ ŋazapie okacne sosopec dâŋ jaha mi jazanʒepieŋ, aricne, ŋoŋe jambuŋ hotâckeniŋte hefârec‐ŋopakicnere jaŋe wâc jambuŋdâŋ jazanʒepieŋ.
“Moc e jujure aŋackekac â dameŋ biaŋ bâfuazo ecnekac, e nameŋ‐ticne soŋaŋkeha sâqocne mi bazejec, â micbipic‐ticne qataracneme burecdâŋ mi ezejec.
Eme sâqocne râpeckerâ wiac biaŋne ezejec, erâ wamao juhuc irec giene fotarierâ bazejec.
Wofuŋ e ŋic tiŋne jaŋerao ʒâŋe fihuc mu wâwâsic‐jeŋicte hazec râeekac, sâqocne bapa jaŋe ine Wofuŋzi hone qikiŋ ejareekac.”
Ŋoŋe wiac biaŋnere henʒiriŋnehuc juhapie mozi wemo wiac eŋareocmu?
Me juju bapa tiŋnere erâ fific guguriŋ faio feniŋmu, ine manapie bubiaŋnehec ezejec. Ʒika hâhâwic eŋarepie ɋarac ɋarac mi qanʒepieŋ â hâbi gogoroŋ mi enʒepieŋ.
Maŋŋeŋic ba emasaŋ epie Kristo e tiri Wofuŋ juŋarezejec. Erâ maŋzi wiac worickehuc jueŋgopieŋ irec mu indiŋ eŋarepie afeckerâ fuŋne mutaniŋkenʒepieŋ.
Erâ dâŋ i urucko â acmeruŋ ehuc, maŋŋeŋiczi mumu hehec mi eŋareha munʒepieŋ. Iŋuc epie, Kristohec juhuc wiac ebac eeŋgopieŋ irec qoric‐ŋopaeŋgopieŋ, ŋic i jaŋe burec‐jeŋicte fuŋne taniŋkeme mimienʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe wiac biaŋne ehuc juhapie Anutuzi maname sâckeha ʒika kâpâcwâru eŋareniŋmu irec manape fekac, â bahac bâfuapie eŋareniŋmu ine manape wahakac.
Kristo e iŋuc jaha tiŋnezi sâqocnere erâ arec moc hâmowec, e tiŋnezi hehesicne ŋoŋere erâ iŋuc ewec, Anuturao râec‐ŋopaocte. E sahachec juwecte qapie hâmowec, â Mârohec juwecte ɋârewec.
Mârohec wâc juhuc qâqâtâc kâpâcwâruo fombiŋ jaŋerao rarâ miti jazawec.
Jaŋe mârâc jaha Noa e woke bahuc juhame Anutuzi maŋuruc‐ticnere erâ woŋec‐jeŋic juipiehame dâŋticne qâsuambiŋ. Eme ŋic ŋokac jahec mac, 8 sawa, jaŋe wokeo fepie opâzi akic‐jopame jumbiŋ.
Eme ŋifecne ʒi opâzi wâc Miti Opâo bâpiaŋ‐ŋopaekac. Miti Opâ e sahac wânâŋ mi ʒureekac, e Anutu hefâreme ware maŋŋeŋic ʒureme mumu hehec mocwâc mi eŋareekac; wiac i Jesu Kristozi hâmockonec ɋârehuc bâfuawec.
E jahacne sambâŋko Anutu fârenao fewec jukac; ira juhame aŋelo fekicne jaŋe ere wahamicnao jueŋgopieŋ.
Kristo e sahac ʒâic manawecte ŋoŋe ijaha eniŋte hâbi‐ŋeŋic hepie huzejec. Ehuc ʒiŋuc mananʒepieŋ, moc e sahac ʒâic manaekaczi sâqocnere ninikec bâfuaekac.
Eme sahacko juju dameŋ‐ticne fokac sâc sasecte gie mi bapa Anuture micdâŋ sawa reŋkehuc juzejec.
Juwicnao qâpuc wiac ʒiŋuc ehuc jumbiŋ: Wiac gapec tâmiric ee, sasec, opâ momori âmbâŋ nânâ, bec qowi âmbâŋ nânâ, tiwâ sisiricko nânâ, nemu burec kiŋaŋ qaqajare, wiac i hâcne ewarehuc jukupie micne qawec.
Eme ʒi ine qâpuc jaŋe sâqocnere ʒâkâŋko fohapie mi qâtec‐jopaeŋgopieŋte manapie moc eme mu supaic eŋareeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ jaŋe juku jukicne hâmokicne fuŋne‐nâŋec bataniŋkeocte ʒawierâ jukac erao dâŋgie baniŋmu.
Eme fuŋne ʒiŋucte hâmokicne wâc Biŋebiaŋ jazakicne: Jaŋe ŋifec ŋic hata fokac irec sâcko sahaczi okacne roniŋte, â ŋifec Anuture hata fokac irec sâcko mârozi juniŋte.
Wiac sasawa irec dameŋ bembeŋkekac. Irec ŋoŋe maŋsowa â pectâc juhuc nunumure afeckenʒepieŋ.
Erâ maŋŋeŋiczi jauŋ babac ehuc junʒepieŋ. Maŋjauŋhec juhuc kiŋ bebehec sâcne ezo.
Ŋoŋe mutakic tâmiric hezu hewâneŋ eec enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Anutuzi miti mâriri fuŋne fuŋne tahac‐ŋopawec, i ŋicne ŋicne foŋarekac sâc aimuŋ bajuhuc bâmec babac â dodopec ehuc junʒepieŋ.
Moc e miti muocmu i Anuture dâŋ jâmbâŋ ezejec, moc e gie mucnekicko baocmu ine Anutuzi tâpiri râcneme sâc bazejec. Ŋoŋe iŋuc epie Anuture huriri qâreŋ i Jesu Kristore erâ ŋoŋerao fua tâcnezejec. Eri tatamac â tâpiri i erao foweczi fohuc juocmu sanaŋ. Jâmbomac.
Jorocfâc‐nane, ŋoŋerao hâbi qaqazure wiac micne momori fuawec fokac, eme ŋoŋe wiac ʒâŋe furu fua‐nârekac muhuc bipic tatara mi enʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋe Kristore erâ ʒâic fâro manahuc sâc bubiaŋ bâfuanʒepieŋ, eme juku eri tatamac‐ticne fua tâcneme iŋuc jaha bubiaŋ sâko manahuc ʒeri bari eniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe Kristo ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnere musoc qâsoriŋ‐ŋopapie manapie ʒerine ezejec. Wiac i eŋarepie tatamacte maqâreŋ, Anuture Mâro hâcne, ŋoŋerao waha juocmu.
Ŋoŋeraonec moczi ʒikare me fiucte me sindaŋte me penaroŋte ʒika kâpâcwâru faio mi fezejec.
A moc e Kristoŋic jukacte ʒika kâpâcwâru ecnepie ine irec maname mimi busâqochec mi ezejec. E ʒâŋe i bajuhuc Anuture mumuteŋ bâfuazejec.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Anutu e fuŋne babataniŋ gie‐ticne ŋicfâc‐ticne nâŋâcnao fuŋkerâ baocte dameŋne maickekac hâcne. Nâŋâcnao qanaŋ fuŋkerâ baraku Biŋebiaŋ‐ticne qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao batarame sâc weniŋucne fuaocmu?
Â “Ŋic tiŋne e okac dameŋko bipic tatara ecnehame miti qiqikiŋ â sâqocne bapa e wenac eocmu!”
Eme irec Anutuzi maname sâckeha fific guguriŋ faio feniŋmu jaŋe maŋ qâqâtâc‐jeŋic i bâbâfua mume sasanaŋ erao râehuc eehâmo gie banʒepieŋ.
Ŋoŋerao micne bapa juŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe no micne bapa âgo‐ŋeŋiczi dâŋ ŋazape. No Kristo e ʒâic fâro maname ʒâŋe fâri‐nanezi honepo, izi juku eri tatamac‐ticne fua tâcneme i wâc rauckepemu. Irec no hâcne dâŋ mu qâmoc eŋarepe mananiŋ:
Anuture lama guru soŋaŋ‐jopaniŋte muŋarekicne, i jâiŋko mâcne, buafec jaha hone maiŋ ejarenʒepieŋ, erâ moneŋ mafa huhurere manasuhuc mâcne, giere buâkec eŋareha enʒepieŋ.
Erâ wâc ŋicbomboŋ ejarehuc mâcne, lama micne bajarehuc miti hata bânie‐jarenʒepieŋ.
Eme juku soŋaŋ sâkozi fisirâ hendiŋ huririnehec fofo sanaŋ i heŋareme hume rojuniŋmu.
Ŋic socɋâri ŋoŋe iŋuc jaha ŋazakopac, ŋoŋe ŋic kâcɋene jaŋere wahamicne junʒepieŋ. Erâ mâmâc sasawa ine gie qoruc ʒâŋene maŋhuhuŋ i jomarâ kiŋaŋ qaqac enʒepieŋ. Manaŋgopieŋ, Anutu e ŋic maŋfefe jaŋe dope qatara‐jareekac â ŋic maŋhuhuŋ ine dope sicne‐jareekac.
Anuture mesanaŋzi bâuruŋ‐ŋopame dapenʒepieŋ. Iŋuc epie juku dameŋ‐ticne maickeme ekizia bafaharec‐ŋopaocmu.
Wiac mezac‐ŋopaekac sasawa i Anutu qârâriecnenʒepieŋ, eki sâcne hone jauŋ eŋareekac.
Ŋoŋe maŋsowa juhuc rucgereŋ‐ŋeŋic banʒepieŋ. Râsi sâko‐ŋeŋic Sataŋ e oâ iŋucne erâ mic aŋkerâ e me e ɋâckepe muhuc ra fisi ware fisi ehuc juekac.
Eme ŋoŋe mamanasiŋhec qiŋ herâ domahuc e hetapaickenʒepieŋ. Erâ ʒiŋuc mananʒepieŋ, âgofâc‐ŋeŋic mâreŋ sâc jaŋerao ʒâic fâro ijaha fua‐fârewec fokac.
Erâ Anutu aki anonoc rune, e eri tatamac fofo sanaŋ focnekac, ira Kristore erâ fisiniŋte hefârec‐ŋopaweczi ʒâic fâro dameŋ bembeŋne manahapie bâtiec‐ŋopahuc âkesiŋ‐ŋopaocmu, erâ basanaŋ‐ŋopahuc keteŋ‐ŋopaocmu.
Tâpiri i erao hâcne foweczi fohuc juocmu sanaŋ. Jâmbomac.
No dâŋ i Siliwano âzâcnepe qâreŋke‐ŋarekac. No ere hâcne manape âgo fârine ekac. No bapa fuŋfuŋ jaha manapozi Anutu uruc jauŋ‐ticnere dâŋ bembeŋnea mutaniŋke‐ŋarerâ faŋ qaŋarehuc mukopac, dâŋ i fârine, maŋnao qiŋ herâ domanʒepieŋ.
Babe haeonec kikefuŋ, nâŋâcnehec mâmâc rowosâec‐jopakicne, jaŋe manasu‐ŋareŋgopieŋ, erâ motec‐nane Mareko e mâmâc.
Ŋoŋe mitio ââgo ehuc meo babac efârenʒepieŋ. Kristohec jueŋgopieŋ ŋoŋerao wama fofârezejec.
Simoŋ Petoro, Jesu Kristore kiŋaŋ qaqa â aposolo noni, Anutu â bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo tiŋne‐ticnere erâ mamanasiŋ furi sâko tahac‐nâpokicne ijaha ŋare tahac ekicne, ŋoŋe papia ʒi qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac.
Ŋoŋe Anutu â Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu mana maŋ epie ŋoŋerao aki anonoc â wama ɋaŋɋaŋ ɋâriaŋ fuahuc fozejec.
Jesu e tatamac â tâpiri‐ticnezi hefârec‐nâpome hone ʒâŋitac ecnepene sahacte â maŋte dope sasawa i Anutu tâpiri‐ticnezi bâfua‐nârewec.
Iŋuc erâ dâŋ biŋe fekicne furi sâko nâre tahac ewec, i maŋkepene irec fârine nâŋâcnao fuame mâreŋko sasecte sisipiric fokac i râpeckerâ Anuture hawari qâreŋfâc enaŋmu.
Irec ŋoŋe mamanasiŋhec juŋgopieŋte ʒoɋac epie tiŋne juju‐ŋeŋic fuazejec, tiŋne jujuzi mamana bâfuazejec,
mamanazi maŋte sowa bâfuazejec, maŋte sowazi sasanaŋ bâfuazejec, sasanaŋzi miti nunumure aafec bâfuazejec,
miti nunumure aafeczi ââgo juju bâfuazejec, ââgo jujuzi maŋjauŋ bâfuazejec.
Wiac i sasawa ŋoŋerao fohuc fua ɋârâŋkeme Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo mana maŋ eniŋte giene bapie fârimâc mi eocmu.
Moc e wiac i tâmiric juocmu, ere ʒiŋuc muzo: E ʒâŋe tiŋtuŋ â maŋmutuc, mârâc ʒure bâpiaŋ ecnekicne irec nikeckewec.
Âgofâc, ŋoŋe irec hâcne samarierâ, bâwosâec‐ŋoparâ hefârec‐ŋopakicne i fârinehec eocte sasanaŋ bâfuanʒepieŋ. Ŋoŋe iŋuc erâ docke pârâc tâmiric sâcne juniŋmu.
Iŋuc epie juku Wofuŋ â bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristozi eŋareme ere juju sanaŋte uucmaŋko ququŋke tâmiric hata aaŋko raʒiniŋmu.
Ŋoŋe wiac i sasawa qazu‐ŋarekicne â dâŋfârio keteŋ‐ŋopakicne domaŋgopieŋ, i manahuc sifu dâŋ ijaha heɋâre‐ŋarehuc jupemu.
Sahac boze‐nanehec juhuc sâc dâŋ i manasu‐ŋarehuc wiwic‐ŋopape sâckeocmu.
No boze‐nane biac hetarapemu i manakopac, dâŋ i Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristozi mufua‐narewec.
Erâ behec‐ŋopape ŋoŋe dâŋ i ɋâreme ɋâre mana rahuc juniŋte emoc bâmoc eŋarepemu.
Nâŋe Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo tâpiri‐ticnere â fifisi‐ticnere dâŋ ŋazambeŋ, i nemu binaŋ ŋic mamanao fuakicne mi ŋazambeŋ, nâŋe bapa fuŋfuŋ domahuc Wofuŋ tatamac‐ticne fuame honembeŋ.
Ine Anutu Mamaczi eri mumuteŋ râcnehame sambâŋ tatamackonec erao dâŋ ʒiŋuc wahawec: “Joroc Ŋokâ‐nane keci hâcne, no hone aŋac ecneekopac.”
Nâŋe ehec mâmâc tiri tikio juhapene dâŋ i sambâŋkonec wahame manambeŋ.
Eme nâŋe irec porofete jaŋere dâŋ manapene fârine jâmbâŋ eekac, izi ʒoclambe iŋucne erâ dapâcko tamaeekacte ŋoŋe ira ʒâŋe fihuc juhapie hae fure‐fârezejec â maŋŋeŋicko bâpiŋ sâkozi wefuzejec.
Erâ qanaŋ moc ʒiŋuc mana‐hâmonʒepieŋ: Findaŋdâŋ miti papiao qâreŋkekicne fokac irec fuŋne i ŋic moczi e jahacne maŋte mi mumune.
Findaŋdâŋ i ŋiczi manasu biric erâ moc mi mukicne, ŋic jaŋe Tiri Mârozi fenʒoŋ‐jopame Anuturaonec dâŋ mujumbieŋ.
Israe ŋic jaŋerao porofete burecne i wâc mâmâc fuarâ jumbiŋ, eme ŋoŋerao iŋuc jaha qaqazu burecne fuaniŋmu. Jaŋe mitire mumusifuc bâfuapie ŋoŋerao fâfâuc fuaocmu, erâ Wofuŋ kiwiric‐jeŋic rowec e mickeniŋmu. Iŋuc epie sisipiric ɋeŋfâfâc jaha fisi‐jareocmu.
Ŋic i jaŋe sasec gie bapie bocjahazi honerâ bâjâpec‐jopaniŋmu, eme jaŋere erâ miti hata susure fuaocmu.
Erâ wâc moneŋ mafare andac ehuc maŋko fuac dâŋzi eatuc‐ŋopahuc wiac‐ŋeŋicte kâŋgâc gie baniŋmu. Jaŋere okacne dâŋ esecne mukicne i mi pârâwewec, â sisipiric‐jeŋic i micmâŋ mi ewec.
Anuture manaeŋgopeneŋ, e aŋelo sâqorekicne jaŋe mi akic‐jopawec, aricne, e hârâcko tuŋjopame duŋdapâcko humbiŋ, ira okac dameŋte woŋec foeŋgopieŋ.
E mârâc sasac jaha ŋic â wiac sasawa mi akic‐jopawec, mâc Noa, tiŋne jujure biŋe mumu, erâ ŋic ŋokac 7 jaŋe sawa ŋezic‐jopame ɋâricne juhapie ŋic sâqocne jaŋerao rumi sâko fisiwec.
Erâ Sodom â Gomora hae iŋuc jaha sirowenicte mume ʒoczi ʒacjofawec, i ŋic sâqocne ʒâhec fuarâ juniŋmu jaŋere uŋ muhuc iŋuc ewec.
Erâ wâc mitiŋic Loti e sindaŋŋic jaŋe wiac mamakâcne mimi tâmiric ehuc jupie irec buʒâic manahuc juhame ŋezickewec.
Loti e mitiheczi jaŋere ŋondeŋko juhame jaŋe sindaŋ hârindaŋ epie ʒoaŋne ʒoaŋne hone manac ehuc maŋne sisi hâhâŋ wemo afecne ewec.
Wofuŋ eki ine ŋic mitihec eesâic docko roroŋ sasapec ejareekac â miti tâmiric jaŋe okac dameŋko ʒâic gie mujareocte kâpâcwâru bacjopaekac.
Ŋic maŋjeŋiczi sasecte bâruŋkeme sohoŋ nâ ruac ehuc Wofuŋ â ŋic fekicne ro waha âte ejareeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne kâpâcwâru sanaŋne bacjopaocmu. Ŋic iŋucnezi hâhâwic tâmiric mukac mupe ehuc tatamachec jaŋe wâc musuac‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Iŋuc ehapie aŋelo jaŋe ine sasanaŋ â tâpiri fuŋmoc fojarekaczi Wofuŋte maio mi mugâpâre‐jareeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic izi hâcne maŋ tâmiric, qowi qa nâc ejareeŋgopeneŋ jaŋe iŋucne. Jaŋe wiac fuŋne kâuc baeŋgopieŋ i kosa musuaeŋgopieŋ; irec qowi sisipiric sipirickeniŋmu,
ehuc hehesic‐jeŋicte furine roniŋmu. Jaŋe ʒoaŋ ɋaɋacko tiwâ ʒepec â gae wowozi ʒeri‐jeŋic eekac. Mamakâcne â maŋwânâŋ qâŋkerâ juju, ʒege hârocko hefârec‐ŋopahuc bâbâsifucte eeatuc‐ŋopa,
ʒâŋe‐jeŋiczi sasec ʒâŋe fifi, sâqocne gapecmâc ee, ŋic biric borocne wiac iŋucnere doc babac‐jopa, moneŋ mafare harac eku maŋjeŋic ekicne, ŋic iŋucnezi hârâcte biŋe hâcne!
Jaŋe hata dândâŋne i râpeckerâ qâsoriehuc Bileam, Beorore ŋokâ, ere kike hata bâjâpembiŋ. E sâqocnere furi roocte andac eme
Wofuŋzi qaqatara‐ticnere haneckewec. Eme doŋgi dâŋ tâmiriczi ŋicdâŋ dâŋehuc porofete bâbâsifucne e heckenewec.
Ŋic iŋucnezi opâ ʒizicne iŋucne, erâ mâŋâŋzi hâwec ficne sueme ra fe ware fe eekac iŋucne tinac. Ŋic i jaŋe ŋafe sanaŋko dapâc qisiricko fisiniŋte mukicne.
Jaŋe pacgoroŋ dâŋ erâ, ŋic qâpuc hata ɋâri qaqa jaha râpeckembiŋ, jaŋe eatuc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, ehuc tiwâ ʒepeczi gisicbeŋ eme sicne‐jarepie fisipie qâturerâ sasec gie baeŋgopieŋ.
Ehuc ŋic ʒiŋuc jazaeŋgopieŋ: “Iŋuc erâ niŋgiŋ tâmiric sâcne juhâmozo”, i jaŋacne sisipiricte niŋgiŋko fohuc iŋuc mueŋgopieŋ. Ŋic moczi wiac mocte kiŋaŋ qaocmu, e wiac irec niŋgiŋko juocmu hâcne.
Manaŋgopieŋ, miti tâmiric jaŋere sohoŋ râpeckerâ Wofuŋ â bâbâpiaŋ Jesu Kristo mana maŋ embiŋzi ijaha mocwâc maickerâ qohotaniŋmu, ine mârâc juju bapa‐jeŋic afecne sâqorehame ʒâhec juju bapa‐jeŋic sâqore sanaŋkeocmu.
Ŋic iŋucne jaŋe tiŋne hata kâuc bahuc mi âtepie muzac boc mi sâqorezac; â hata i âtekicnezi tiri sâcmutâc dâŋ qazu‐jarekicne i mocwâc igockehuc hata raŋɋanao risiepie ine sâqoreekac.
Ŋic iŋucne jaŋerao dâŋ ʒiŋuc mukicne i sanaŋkeekac: Qâto e nânâ maŋurâ ijaha mocwâc nâekac, â bec e opâ ruarâ izia sohoŋ ruaekac.
Jorocfâc‐nane, ŋoŋere papia ʒi qâreŋkehape jajahec ekac. No maŋŋeŋic wiwickepe mitidâŋ mi mana sifuckehuc sâcne mana taraniŋte qâreŋke‐ŋareekopac hâcne.
Eme ŋoŋe tiri porofete mârâc jaha dâŋ mumbiŋ irec mecne â aposolofâc‐ŋeŋic nâŋe Wofuŋ â bâbâpiaŋte sâcmutâc dâŋ ŋazambeŋ i mecne mâmâc manasuhuc junʒepieŋ.
Ehuc qanaŋ ʒiŋuc mana sanaŋkenʒepieŋ: Dameŋ bembeŋkezo eme ŋic âke sisicne fuarâ mufec muriŋ dâŋ muhuc sasec gie‐jeŋicte heʒâkiriŋkerâ juniŋmu.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc muniŋmu: “Wofuŋ risieocte mukicne fârine weni? Kâcɋenefâc‐nâŋec hâmombiŋ, ehame wiac sasawa mâreŋ fuaweckonecteaŋ fowarehuc juwec iŋucnea fohuc jukac.”
Jaŋe fuŋne ʒiŋuc mana‐bipiehuc dâŋ i mueŋgopieŋ: Sambâŋ e mârâc jaha fuawec â mâreŋ e iŋuc jaha. I Anutu dâŋticnere opâonec fuarâ opâheckoaŋ fowec.
Eme ʒâhec opâzia ŋic â wiac sasawa qâuruc‐jopahuc bâsirowec‐jopawec.
Â sambâŋ â mâreŋ ʒi fokopirec ine Anuture dâŋzi sakarec‐jofame ʒocte biŋe erâ fokopirec. Okac dameŋ maickeme ŋic sâqocne jaŋe sipirickeniŋte irec woŋec fokopirec hâcne.
Jorocfâc‐nane, wiac moc ʒi kâuc mi banʒepieŋ: Wofuŋ e ʒoaŋ gie bapa mocjahare maname jare I tauseŋ tinac eekac â jara I tauseŋ irec maname ʒoaŋ gie bapa mocjaha tinac eekac.
Wofuŋ e dâŋ muwec irec fârine bâfuaocte bititiehuc dameŋ mi bâʒoraekac, ŋic gâcnezi manapie iŋuc tinac eekac. Aricne, e ŋic gâcnezi sipirickenʒipiŋte ŋoŋere erâ woŋec juekac. E ŋic mâmâc sasawa maŋjeŋic bârisie‐fâreniŋte muekac hâcne.
Wofuŋte dameŋ e râsi fisieŋgopieŋ iŋuc jaha ututuŋ maickeocmu. Maickeme sambâŋ e fânâŋ sâko ehuc siroweocmu, â wiac hohonene sasawa i ʒoczi ʒafâreocmu, erâ wâc mâreŋ â fainao wiac bâfuakicne i ʒoczi ʒâseŋkeocmu.
Wiac sasawa sirowe‐fâreocmu, irec ŋoŋe pectâc juhuc miti sisirombe faio bajunʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc Anutu dameŋ‐ticne hejâpehuc harac huacbuc enʒepieŋ. Maickeme hâcne sambâŋ e ʒoczi ʒârârâŋneocmu, â wiac hohonene sasawa i ʒocbâruŋko ʒâtâmireocmu.
Nâŋâc ine sambâŋ ɋâricne â mâreŋ ɋâricne fuaocte biŋe qanârekicne, irec woŋec jueŋgopeneŋ, eme ira tiŋne jujuzi sâcke‐fârerâ fozokac.
Jorocfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe wiac iŋucnere woŋec juhuc ere maio maŋfuru â bahacmâc juniŋte wawariehuc wamao jupie honec‐ŋopame sâckezejec.
Erâ Wofuŋ‐nâŋeczi dameŋ‐ticne bâʒorame munʒepieŋ, bâpiaŋ‐nâpoocte ekac. Âgo biaŋ‐nâŋec Paulo e maŋɋârâŋ‐ticnere sâcko dâŋ irecteaŋ qâreŋke‐ŋarewec.
E papia qâreŋkehuc sâc dâŋ i mufua rawec. Papia‐ticnao dâŋ gâcne fokac irec fuŋne qame hukicne. Eme dâŋ iŋucne i ŋic mutucne â biric borocne jaŋe musifuckeeŋgopieŋ. Erâ i ere papiare sawa mâcne, miti papia gâcnere mâmâc ehuc sisipiric maickeeŋgopieŋ.
Âgo biaŋfâc‐nane, uŋdâŋ qanaŋ ŋazakicnere ŋic kosa jujune jaŋere mumusifuczi maŋŋeŋic bâŋgoroŋkeme dockenʒipiŋte sawaŋ‐ŋeŋic qahuc junʒepieŋ.
Ehuc Wofuŋ â bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo ere aki anonocko â fuŋne‐ticne mana utuckehuc soka sanaŋ enʒepieŋ. E eri tatamac i ʒiŋuczia focnekac erâ juju sanaŋ dameŋko iŋuc jaha focne rahuc juzokac.
Fuŋnaonecteaŋ fowarehuc juwec, eme hazeczi manambeŋ â ʒâŋe‐nâŋeczi honembeŋ, erâ hone dendeŋnehuc mezi ba bâuac ecnembeŋ, i juju sanaŋte Micdâŋ hâcne.
Juju fârine fua tâcneme honembeŋte juju sanaŋte biŋedâŋ hâcne mufuarâ ŋazaeŋgopeneŋ. Juju sanaŋ i Mamactao fowarehuc juku nâŋerao fomârâŋkewec.
Ine hâcne wiac hone manac embeŋ ijaha ŋoŋe wâc ŋazaeŋgopeneŋ. Ŋazapene manapie miriŋ‐nâŋec fuame mocjaha junaŋte hâcne mueŋgopeneŋ. Eme miriŋ babac‐nâŋec i Mamac â Ŋokâ‐ticne Jesu Kristo erao qâsiŋnerâ foekac.
Iŋuc fuame bubiaŋ‐nâŋec fua ɋârâŋke taraocte papia ʒi hâcne qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac.
Dâŋ biŋe Jesuraonec kecʒiŋuc manambeŋte ŋazaeŋgopeneŋ: Anutu e tatamac, dapâc i erao moc mi fohuŋgaŋkekac.
Nâŋâc dapâcko juhuc Anuturao qohotaŋgopeneŋ mupene burec eocmu â dâŋ fâri qizecne mi bajunaŋmu.
E jahacne tatamacko jukac iŋuc jaha wâc nâŋâc tatamacko junaŋmu, ine miriŋ babac sâcne enaŋmu, eme Ŋokâ‐ticne Jesu Kristo ere soczi sâqocne‐nâŋec ʒureme ɋaɋackenaŋmu.
Nâŋâc sâqocne‐nâŋec mi fokac, iŋuc munaŋmuo maŋnâŋec eatuckenaŋmu â dâŋ fâri qizecne maŋnâŋecko mi foocmu.
Â sâqocne‐nâŋec mufuanaŋmuo ine e mume sasanaŋ â tiŋne runezi sâqocne‐nâŋec ʒurehuc bahac‐nâŋec nâwoc rofâreocmu.
Nâŋâc sâqocne mi baeŋgopeneŋ, iŋuc mupene Anutu burecŋic mucneŋgopeneŋ eocmu â dâŋticne maŋnâŋecko mi foocmu.
Naru motecfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe sâqocne banʒipiŋte dâŋ i qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac. Â moc e sâqocne baocmu, ine Mamactao sacfozic‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo e tiŋne runezi jukac, irec manasuzejec.
Eki hâcne sâqocne‐nâŋecte kiwiric rowec, erâ nâŋâcne sawa mâcne, mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋere mâmâc rowec.
Anutu mana maŋ eeŋgopeneŋ, ine sâcmutâc dâŋticne mana rereŋ epene fuŋne jaŋgeŋkeme mananaŋmu.
Â ŋic moc e sâcmutâc dâŋticne mana rereŋ mi ehuc muocmu, “No Anutu mana maŋ eekopac”, ere burecŋic muzo, ŋic iŋucnere maŋko dâŋ fâri qizecne mi fokac.
Moc e ine Anuture dâŋ mana rereŋ eocmu, e jâmbomac Anutu maŋjauŋ fârine ecneocmu. Iŋuc ehuc ine Anuturao qohotaeŋgopeneŋ irec fuŋne taniŋkeme mananaŋmu.
Moc e Anuturao qohotahuc jukopac muocmu, e Jesu juwec irec sâcko jaha juzejec.
Jorocfâc‐nane, no sâcmutâc dâŋ ɋâricne moc mi qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac, i raŋɋane, fuŋnaonec mana wefuhuc jueŋgopieŋ i hâcne. Dâŋ qazu‐ŋarekicne irec hâcne sâcmutâc dâŋ raŋɋane mukopac.
Erâ dâŋ qâreŋkekopac i sâcmutâc dâŋ ɋâricne wâc ekac, i Jesurao â ŋoŋerao mâmâc fârine ekac. Ine fuŋne ʒiŋucte: Dapâc raruŋkehame tatamac fârinezi fua tâcnehuc fokac.
Eme ŋic moc e âgo‐ticne qaisockeekaczi “no tatamacko jukopac”muocmu, ere dapâcko juweczi jukac muzo.
Â moc e âgo‐ticne maŋzi jauŋkeocmu, e ine tatamacko sâcne juraocmu, ehuc sâqocne bâbâiŋ moc mi bâfuaocmu.
Â moc e âgo‐ticne qaisockeocmu, e ine dapâcko juocmu â dapâcte hatao raocmu, e dapâcko ʒâŋe fime qiŋquŋkeme wemocko hata‐ticne hone taraocmu.
Naru motec ŋoŋe Jesu ʒâŋe‐ticnere erâ sâqocne bâtâmire‐ŋarekicnere dâŋ qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac.
Mamac ŋoŋe juwarehuc juwec sanaŋ e mana maŋ embiŋte dâŋ qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac. Ŋicmotec ŋoŋe sâqocne rune sanaŋkecnembiŋte dâŋ qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac. Naru motec ŋoŋe Mamac mana maŋ embiŋte dâŋ qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac.
Mamac ŋoŋe juwarehuc juwec sanaŋ e mana maŋ embiŋte dâŋ qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac. Ŋicmotec ŋoŋe sasanaŋ‐ŋeŋic fokac â Anuture dâŋzi maŋŋeŋicko fokac â sâqocne rune sanaŋkecnembiŋte dâŋ qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac.
Maŋŋeŋic mâreŋko me mâreŋte wiacko mi râepie fozejec. Moc e maŋticne mâreŋko râeme foocmu, e wemocko Mamac maŋjauŋ ecneocmu.
Manaŋgopieŋ, mâreŋkopec wiac sasawa: Sahaczi sasec, ʒâŋezi sasec â maŋzi fefe wiac, i Mamactaonec mâcne, i mâreŋkonec.
Eme mâreŋ e sasec wiac‐ticnehec siroweocmu, Anuture micdâŋ mana rereŋ eocmu e ine juhuc juocmu sanaŋ.
Naru motecfâc‐nane, dameŋ bembeŋke‐jâmbâŋkekac; eme ŋoŋe Kristore râsi qizec fuaocte mukicne i manaŋgopieŋ; eme ʒi biac râsifâcne bocjaha fuambiŋ juraŋgopieŋ; irec hâcne dameŋ bembeŋke‐jâmbâŋkekac i manaŋgopeneŋ.
Jaŋe fufua i nâŋâcne ŋondeŋkonec fuambiŋ, â âgo fârifâc‐nâŋec juju ine mi jumbiŋ. Jaŋe âgo fârifâc‐nâŋec jurâ muzac mi behec‐nâponʒapiŋ. Behec‐nâpombiŋ i fuŋne ʒiŋuc taniŋkeocte embiŋ: Nâŋâcnehec jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe âgo fârifâc‐nâŋec sasawa aricne.
Ŋoŋe ine Tiri runezi Mâro rua‐ŋarewecte mamanahec sasawa juŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ fâri qizecne kâuc baeŋgopieŋ muhuc papia mi qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac. Aricne, ŋoŋe dâŋfâri manaeŋgopieŋte qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac. Erâ wâc ʒiŋucte: Burec sasawa i ere maŋnaonec mi fuaekac.
Burecŋic i more muzo? Jesu e Kristo aricne, ŋic moczi iŋuc mume ere burecŋic muzo. Mamac â Ŋokâ mic bacjofaocmu, ŋic ere muzo, e Kristore râsi qizec.
Moc e Ŋokâ mickeocmu, e Mamac mâmâc qikiŋneocmu, â moc e Ŋokâ muɋaɋackeocmu, e Mamac mâmâc sakareocmu.
Fuŋnaonecteaŋ mitidâŋ mana warehuc jumbiŋ i hâcne maŋke junʒepieŋ. Mitidâŋ i maŋke jupie Ŋokâ â Mamac jahe iŋuc jaha maŋŋopahuc junicmu.
Wiac i Jesuzi biŋe qanârewec, juju sanaŋ hâcne.
Maŋ bâsifuc eŋareeŋgopieŋ jaŋere dâŋ iŋuc qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac.
Ŋoŋere ine ʒiŋuc mukopac, Mâro rua‐ŋarewec i ŋoŋerao foocmu, irec wemocte ŋic moczi mu qazuc eŋareocmu, i aricne. Mâro ruambiŋ eki dâŋ sasawa ŋaza qazuc eekac. Eme dâŋ i burec mâcne, i jâmbomac. Eme qazu‐ŋarewec iŋuc maŋnao junʒepieŋ.
Naru motecfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe Kristo maŋnao junʒepieŋ. Eme juku fua tâcneme qacfiric domanʒepeneŋ, ehuc fifisi‐ticnao mimiʒu qâʒuʒu ehuc wise ŋeŋe uruŋ mi enʒepeneŋ.
Anutu e tiŋne juekac, ŋoŋe iŋuc manaeŋgopieŋko ine ŋic moc tiŋnea jume honerâ munʒepieŋ, Anuturaonec fuawec.
Manaŋgopieŋ, Mamac‐nâŋec e maŋjauŋ mo iŋucne enârehuc naru motecfâc‐ticne munârewec. Eme i hâcne juŋgopeneŋ. Ŋic miti tâmiric jaŋe mi ʒâŋitac‐nâpoeŋgopieŋ, i Anutu e jahacne mi ʒâŋitambiŋ irec.
Âgo biaŋfâc‐nane, nâŋâc ʒiŋuczia Anuture naru motecfâc juŋgopeneŋ, â juku sâc weniŋucne bâfuanaŋmu, ine biac mi fua taniŋkekac. Ʒiŋuc ine manaŋgopeneŋ: Wofuŋ fua tâcneme juju hawari‐ticne honehuc sâc ijaha enaŋmu.
Eme moc e irec erâ worickehuc juocmuzi Wofuŋ e ɋaɋacne jukac iŋucnea juocte maŋticne emasaŋkeocmu.
Moc e sâqocne baekac, e sâcmutâc dâŋ qâsuaekac, sâcmutâc dâŋ qâqâsua izi hâcne sâqocne fârine.
Â Jesure ine manaeŋgopieŋ, e sâqocne bârireocte fisiwec, erâ e jahacne ine bahac fâsâc juwec.
Moc e Jesuo juekaczi sâqocne mi baekac. Â moc e sâqocne baekac, e ine Jesu hone manac mi ecnewec.
Naru motecfâc‐nane, moczi moc maŋ bâsifuc eŋarezo mupie mi mananʒepieŋ. Moc e tiŋne hata âteme ere ŋic tiŋne muzo, e Jesuzi juju tiŋne juekac, iŋuc jaha juocmu.
Moc e sâqocne baocmu, e Sataŋte ŋic. Sataŋ e sâqocne fuŋnaonecteaŋ bawec bahuc juekac. Anuture Ŋokâ eki Sataŋte gie imackeocte fisiwec hâcne.
Moc e Anuturaonec fuaweczi sâqocne mi baocmu. Anuturaonec jujure tâpiri focnehame e Anuturaonec fuakicnezi wemocko sâqocne baocmu.
Anuture naru motec â Sataŋte naru motecfâc jaŋere fuŋne ʒiŋucko hâcne taniŋkeme honezo: Moc e juju tiŋne mi juocmu, e Anuturaonec mi mucnezo, â moc e âgo‐ticne maŋjauŋ mi ecneocmu, ere ijaha muzo.
Mitidâŋ mana wareeŋgopieŋ i ʒiŋuc hâcne: Maŋzi jauŋ babac enʒepeneŋ.
Kaiŋte hata mi âtenʒepeneŋ, e sâqocne runere motec erâ ɋaticne qâhâmowec. Erâ wemocte qâhâmowec? Ine kecʒiŋucte: E jahacne juju bapa sâqocne â ɋaticnere juju bapa biaŋne irec.
Âgofâc‐nane, miti tâmiriczi qaisoc‐ŋopapie manapie iŋuc me iŋuc mi ezejec.
Nâŋâcne ʒiŋuc manaeŋgopeneŋ: Hâmockonec wiserâ jujuo raʒimbeŋ. Iŋuc ekicnere hâcne âgofâc‐nâŋec maŋjauŋ ejareeŋgopeneŋ. Moc e maŋjauŋ tâmiric juocmu e ine hâmocnea juocmu.
Moc e âgo‐ticne qaisockeocmu e ʒika qaqaŋic mucnezo. Eme ŋoŋe ʒika qaqaŋic jaŋere manaeŋgopieŋ, jaŋere maŋko juju sanaŋ mi fuarâ foocmu.
Jesu e nâŋâcnere erâ juju‐ticne qikiŋnewecko maŋjauŋte fuŋne ʒâŋitambeŋ. Eme nâŋâc iŋuc jaha âgofâc‐nâŋec jaŋere erâ juju‐nâŋec qikiŋnenaŋte munârekicne.
Ŋic moc e nânâ mafa mâriri‐ticne fohame âgo‐ticne waha qaqane jume hone takirerâ bune bofackeocmu, ere muzo, maŋticnao Anuture maŋjauŋ mi fokac.
Naru motecfâc‐mae, nâŋâc jauŋ i dâŋzi â micbipiczi sawa mâcne, mezi â maŋzi banʒepeneŋ.
Iŋuc epene dâŋ fâri qizecnere kikefuŋ juŋgopeneŋ irec fuŋne taniŋkeme mananaŋmu. Eme maŋnâŋeczi mumu hehec enâreme Anuture maio sâcne bâmiriŋkenaŋmu.
Ehuc ʒiŋuc munʒepeneŋ: Anutu e maŋnâŋecte sâc mâcne, e sâc moc juhuc wiac mana‐fâreekac.
Jorocfâc‐nane, maŋnâŋeczi mumu hehec mi enârehame Anuture maio qacfiric sâcne junaŋmu.
Erâ micdâŋ‐ticne reŋkehuc ere maio wiac ebac epene biaŋkeekacte irec me irec numucnepene nâreekac.
Sâcmutâc dâŋticne kecʒiŋuc fokac: Ŋokâ‐ticne Jesu Kristo ere ʒâŋe manasiŋkehuc maŋzi jauŋ babac enʒepeneŋ. Iŋuc hâcne enaŋte munârewec.
Moc e sâcmutâc dâŋticne reŋkeocmu e Anutuhec maŋmaŋ enicmu. Anutu maŋkeeŋgopeneŋ i Mâro nârewec eki mufua‐nâreme manaeŋgopeneŋ.
Âgo biaŋfâc‐nane, mâro kosa jaŋere dâŋ mi mana ʒakienʒepieŋ. Mâro moc e Anuturaonec me mâcne, i mana taraniŋte ruc banʒepieŋ. Porofete burecne wemo afecne fuambiŋ juraŋgopieŋ.
Anuture Mâro e ʒiŋucko ʒâŋitazo: Mâro moc e Jesu Kristo ŋic fuawec i mutaniŋkeocmu, e Anuturaonec iŋuc mucnezo.
Â mâro moc e Jesu mi mutaniŋkeocmu e Anuturaonec mâcne. E Kristo râsi qizec‐ticnere mâro iŋuc muzo. Ere manaeŋgopieŋ, e mâreŋko fuaocte mukicne, eme ʒine hâcne biac fuakac.
Naru motecfâc‐mae, ŋoŋe Anuturaonec, irec porofete burecne sanaŋke‐jarembiŋ. Ŋoŋere maŋko juekac ere tâpirizi mâreŋko juekac ere tâpiri sirickekac hâcne.
Porofete burecne jaŋe mâreŋkonec, irec mâreŋkonec ŋiczi dâŋ mumu i mueŋgopieŋ, mupie mâreŋkoneczi hazec‐jeŋic râeeŋgopieŋ.
Nâŋâc ine Anuturaonec, eme moc e Anutu hone ʒâŋitac eekaczi dâŋnâŋec manaekac. Anuturaonec mi fuakicnezi ine dâŋnâŋec qikiŋneekac. Dâŋ fâri qizecnere mâro â bâbâsifuc mâro jahere fuŋne iŋucko hâcne ʒâŋitaeŋgopeneŋ.
Jorocfâc‐nane, nâŋâc maŋjauŋ eec enʒepeneŋ. Maŋjauŋ i Anuturaonec. Eme moc e maŋjauŋhec juomu, e Anuturaonec fuakicnezi Anutu mana maŋ eekac mucnezo.
Moc e maŋjauŋ tâmiric juocmuzi Anutu ʒâŋe ruruŋkeocmu. Anutu e maŋjauŋ irec fuŋqizecne hâcne.
Anutuzi Ŋokâ‐ticne mocjaha e juju bâfua‐nâreocte mâreŋko soreme wahawec ira hâcne maŋjauŋ‐ticne nâŋâcnao fua taniŋkewec.
Maŋjauŋte fuŋne ʒiŋuc fokac: Nâŋâc Anutu maŋjauŋ mi ecnembeŋ, ekizia nâŋâc maŋjauŋ enârehuc Ŋokâ‐ticne soreme waharâ sâqocne‐nâŋecte erâ kiwiric nâwoc rowec.
Jorocfâc‐nane, Anutu e maŋjauŋ iŋucne sâko enârewecte nâŋâc iŋuc jaha maŋzi jauŋ babac ehuc junʒepeneŋ.
Ŋiczi Anutu hohone i moc mi ekicne, maŋzi jauŋ babac enaŋmuo ine Anutu maŋkenaŋmu, eme maŋjauŋ‐ticne nâŋâcnao fua sarickeocmu.
Eki nâŋâc maŋnâpoekac â nâŋâc e maŋkeeŋgopeneŋ, irec fuŋne ine Mâro‐ticne nârewec ira taniŋkewec.
Mamac e Ŋokâ‐ticne mâreŋ sâc ŋic bâpiaŋ‐nâpoocte soreme wahawec, eme nâŋe ʒâŋe fâri‐nâŋeczi qame honembeŋte dâŋ i mutaniŋkeeŋgopeneŋ.
Eme ŋic moczi Jesu e Anuture Ŋokâ jâmbâŋ dâŋ i mutaniŋkeocmu, e Anutu maŋkeocmu â Anutuzi wâc e maŋkeocmu.
Anutu maŋjauŋ‐ticne nâŋâcnao fuawec i hone ʒâŋitac erâ mana ʒakiembeŋ. Anutu e maŋjauŋte fuŋqizecne, eme moc e maŋjauŋhec juocmu e Anutuzi maŋkeocmu, â eki wâc Anutu maŋkeocmu.
Iŋucko nâŋâcnao maŋjauŋ fua tarawec, i okac dameŋko qacfiric domanaŋte. Jesuzi juekac iŋuc jaha nâŋâc wâc mâreŋko ʒira jueŋgopeneŋ hâcne.
Hâhâwic â maŋjauŋ jahe ââgo aricne, maŋjauŋ fârinezi hâhâwic guriŋkeocmu. Hâhâwic e ʒâic‐ticnehec. Irec moc e hâhâwic bajuocmu, erao maŋjauŋ sâcne mi fua tarawec muzo.
Nâŋâc ine Anutuzi qanaŋ maŋjauŋ enârewecte maŋjauŋhec junʒepeneŋ.
Ŋic moc e Anutu maŋjauŋ ecneekopac muhuc âgo‐ticne qaisockeocmu, ere burecŋic muzo. Manaŋgopieŋ, moc e âgo‐ticne ʒâŋezi hohonene e qaisockehuc wemocko Anutu mi hohonene maŋjauŋ ecneocmu.
Jesure sâcmutâc dâŋ ʒiŋuc fonârekac: Anutu maŋjauŋ ecneekaczi âgo‐ticne mâmâc ecnezejec.
Ŋic moczi Jesu e Kristo muhuc mana ʒakieocmu, e Anuturaonec fuakicne muzo. Eme moc e mamac bâbâfua maŋjauŋ ecneocmuzi ɋâricfâcne mâmâc ejareocmu.
Nâŋâc Anuture naru motecfâc maŋjauŋ ejareeŋgopeneŋ me mâcne, ine Anutu maŋjauŋ ecnehuc sâcmutâc dâŋticne reŋkepene izi mufuaocmu.
Anutu maŋjauŋ mâc mi ecnezo, sâcmutâc dâŋticne reŋkehuc hâcne maŋjauŋ ecnezo. Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋ i dâŋ ŋemâcne aricne.
Anuturaonec fuakicne sasawa jaŋe mâreŋkonec wiac qamaseeŋgopieŋ, â mâreŋkonec wiac qame wahaekac tâpiri i ʒâŋene mamanasiŋ‐nâŋec.
Moczi sanaŋhec erâ mâreŋkonec wiac sasawa qamaseocmu? Ŋic moc e, Jesu e Anuture Ŋokâ, iŋuc muhuc mana ʒakieocmu eki hâcne iŋuc eocmu.
Jesu Kristo eki hâcne opâhec â sochec fisiwec, opâhec sawa mâcne, opâhec â sochec mâmâc.
Mârozi ine fuŋne mufuaekac, Mâro e dâŋ fâri qizecnere rune hâcne.
Irec jahec â moc jaŋe dodopec gie baeŋgopieŋ: Mâro â opâ â soc. Eme jaŋe jahec â moczi fuŋne‐jeŋic mocjaha.
Ŋiczi dâŋ dodopec ehuc mupie manapene jâmbomac eekac, â Anutuzi dâŋ moc dopeckeme ine fâri rarau jâmbâŋ eekac. Anuture dodopec dâŋ ine Ŋokâ‐ticnere dâŋ dopeckewec i hâcne.
Moc e Anutu Ŋokâ‐ticne manasiŋkeocmu, e Anuture dâŋ fârine maŋkeocmu. Moc e Anuture dâŋ mi mana ʒakieocmu, i Anutu burecŋic mucnekac eocmu. Ŋic iŋucnezi Anutu e Ŋokâ‐ticnere dâŋ dopeckewec i maname fâri tâmiric ekac hâcne.
Â dâŋ dopeckewec ine ʒiŋuc fuakac: Anutu e juju sanaŋ bâfua‐nârewec, â juju sanaŋ irec jâcne ine Ŋokâ‐ticne.
Moc e Ŋokâ rauckeocmu e juju rauckeocmu, moc e Ŋokâ mi rauckeocmu e juju wâc mi rauckeocmu.
No dâŋ i ŋoŋe kecʒiŋuc mananiŋte qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac: Anutu Ŋokâ‐ticne manasiŋkeeŋgopieŋ ŋoŋe juju sanaŋ foŋarekac.
Nâŋâc ʒiŋuc muhuc Anutu bubiaŋ manacneeŋgopeneŋ: Wiac mocte, e jahac maname fokac irec sâcko râehuc numucnepene mana‐nâreocmu.
Ine hâcne, wiac i me i numucnepene mana‐nâreocmu, i manahuc ʒiŋuc wâc mananaŋmu: Wiac numucnekicne i biac rauckeŋgopeneŋ.
Ŋic moc e âgo‐ticnezi sâqocne bame honeocmu, sâqocne hârâcte niŋgiŋ sanaŋ‐ticnehec i mâcne, ine honerâ ere erâ numume Anutuzi juju hatao râeocmu, ine sâqocne hârâcte niŋgiŋ sanaŋ‐ticnehec mi baniŋmu jaŋe iŋuc ejareocmu. Sâqocne hârâcte niŋgiŋ sanaŋ‐ticnehec i fokac wâc. Iŋucnere nunumu gie baocte mi mukopac.
Juju bapa hehesicne i sâqocne sasawa. Erâ sâqocne gâcne ine hârâcte niŋgiŋ sanaŋ‐ticnehec mi ekac.
Nâŋâc ʒiŋuc manaŋgopeneŋ: Anuturaonec fuakicnezi sâqocne mi baocmu. Anuture Ŋokâzi hone maiŋ ecnehame sâqocne runezi mi bâuaocmu.
Nâŋâc Anuturaonec fuakicne, â miti tâmiric sasawa jaŋe sâqocne rune ere rurumaŋko foŋgopieŋ, iŋuc manaŋgopeneŋ.
Erâ ʒiŋuc wâc manaŋgopeneŋ: Anutu Ŋokâ‐ticne e waharâ maŋ mamanasu bâfua‐nârewecte jâmbomac rune mana maŋ ecneeŋgopeneŋ. Eme jâmbomac rune, Ŋokâ‐ticne Jesu Kristo, eki maŋnâpokac. Eki hâcne Anutu fârine â juju sanaŋ rune.
Naru motecfâc‐mae, wofuŋ jawane jaŋere rucgereŋ‐ŋeŋic banʒepieŋ.
Ŋicraŋɋa no ŋokac bomboŋ bâwosâekicne go â naru motecfâcge ŋoŋere papia ʒi qâreŋke‐ŋarekopac. No maŋjauŋ eŋareekopac, erâ noni sawa mâcne, dâŋ fâri qizecne mana maŋ eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mâmâc eŋareeŋgopieŋ.
Miti maŋnâŋecko fokac erâ nâŋâcnehec fohuc juocmu sanaŋ, irec erâ ââgo jueŋgopeneŋ.
Anutu Mamac â Jesu Kristo, Mamacte Ŋokâ, eraonec aki anonoc, uruc jauŋ â wama i dâŋfâri â maŋjauŋhec juhapene nâŋâcnao fotâcnerâ fohuc juocmu.
Naru motecfâcge gâcne Mamaczi sâcmutâc dâŋticne nâzâwec i reŋkehuc dâŋ fâri qizecne sâcne bajueŋgopieŋ, fuŋne‐jeŋic iŋuc manarâ bunane boc biaŋkewec.
Eme ʒi ŋokac bomboŋ go sâcmutâc dâŋ moc gazape manac. Dâŋ furune aricne, raŋɋane fuŋnaonec mana warehuc jueŋgopeneŋ ijaha ʒiŋuc gazape: Maŋjauŋ eec ehuc junʒepeneŋ.
Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋ rereŋke izi hâcne maŋjauŋ ekac. Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋ fuŋnaonec mana warehuc jueŋgopieŋ i hâcne bajuhuc sâseniŋte muŋareekac.
Manakomec, eeatuc ŋic bocjaha fuambiŋ juraŋgopieŋ, jaŋe Jesu Kristo e mâreŋ sahachec fuawec, dâŋ i mickeeŋgopieŋ. Ŋic iŋucne hâcne eeatuc ŋic â Kristore râsi ɋizec mucnezo.
Gie bapene ŋoŋerao fârine fuawec, i sifucke‐ŋarezacte soŋaŋ babac ehuc junʒepieŋ. Eme juku fârine ŋemâcne ronʒepieŋ.
Moc e Kristore mu qaqazuc dâŋ mi bajuhuc âke sipuocmu e Anutu mi rauckeocmu. Moc e mu qaqazuc dâŋ bajuocmu e ine Mamac â Ŋokâ mâmâc rauc‐jofaocmu.
Ŋic moc e mu qaqazuc dâŋ i mi bajuekaczi iqic‐ŋopazo mume fic sakarecnehuc âgo mi ecnenʒepieŋ.
Moc e ŋic iŋucne âgo ecneocmuzi bâbâsifuc‐ticnere bafickeocmu.
Dâŋ gâcne bocjaha fokac, erâ tintezi papiao qâreŋkezo mi enarekac. No ŋoŋerao biac fâpe miczi muc manac enaŋte mukopac. Ehuc bubiaŋ kâcɋene bâfuanʒepeneŋ.
Go qoge bâwosâekicne ere naru motecfâc jaŋe manasu‐gareŋgopieŋ.
No ŋicraŋɋazi âgo‐nane Gaio gore papia ʒi qâreŋkekopac. No gore jâmbomac enarekac.
Âgo‐nane, maŋge mitio sâcne foekac, iŋuc jaha sahackopec huc ʒâic tâmiric sâcne juhâmocmurâ enarekac.
Go dâŋ fâri qizecne sâcne bajuhuc reŋkeekomec, irec âgo gâcne jaŋe ware dâŋ binaŋ epie manarâ bunane boc biaŋkekac.
Naru motecfâc‐nane jaŋe dâŋ fâri qizecnere hata âteeŋgopieŋ, dâŋ i manarâ bubiaŋ fekicne jâmbâŋ manaekopac.
Âgo‐nane, go ŋic âgo ehâmo‐jareekomec, erâ bembeŋkonec sawa mâcne, ʒorickonec mâmâc ejareekic, i sâcnea eekic.
Ŋic jaŋe ʒira kikefuŋte maio jauŋgere mu warec embiŋ. Ŋic fâpie go Anutu ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticnere erâ hone jauŋ ejarerâ râec‐jopatec rapie biaŋkeocmu.
Jaŋe ʒâŋe‐ticnere erâ miti kiŋaŋ rahuc mâreŋ‐jeŋic beherâ qâpuc jaŋeraonec moneŋ mafa mi roeŋgopieŋte ehâmo‐jarezo hâcne.
Ŋic iŋucne âgo ejarehuc bafic‐jopapene dâŋ fâri qizecne haŋ baocte munârekicne hâcne.
No kikefuŋ dâŋ wirec‐jeŋic qâreŋkepo. Eme Diotrefe e micne‐jeŋic juocte muekaczi dâŋnâŋec qikiŋneekac.
Irec no fârâ juju bapa‐ticnere fuŋne bataniŋkepemu. E nâŋere burec ehuc boc musâqorec‐nâpoekac. Erâ i sawa mâcne, ŋic fâpie e jahac hezu hewâneŋ mi ejarehame gâcnezi ejarepie qatara‐jarerâ kikefuŋ sahacnao râec‐jopaekac.
Âgo‐nane go ŋic jaŋe wiac sâqocne epie mi bâjâpec‐jopazemec, wiac biaŋne epie ine bâjâpec‐jopazemec. Moc e wiac biaŋne ehuc juocmu ere muzo, e Anuturaonec fuakicne. Moc e sâqocne ehuc juocmu, e Anutu mi ʒâŋitawec muzo.
Demetrio ere fuŋne ine ŋic sasawa mutaniŋke‐fârembiŋ. Erâ mitio fuŋne‐ticne taniŋkewec wâc. Nâŋe iŋuc jaha dâŋticne dopeckeŋgopeneŋ. Erâ dâŋ jâmbomac mueŋgopeneŋ i manaekic.
Dâŋ gâcne bocjaha fokac, erâ tinte â fedazi qâreŋkezo mi enarekac.
No gorao biac fâzore mukopac. Fâ fisipe miczi nazaŋ gazaŋ ezeperec.
Wama gorao fozejec. Âgo jaŋe manasu‐gare‐fâreŋgopieŋ. Go iŋuc jaha âgofâc‐nâŋec ʒâŋe‐jeŋic wosehuc manasu‐jarezemec.
Juda no Jesu Kristore kiŋaŋ qaqa â Jakobore ɋa. Mitio hefârec‐ŋoparâ Anutu Mamacte jauŋko râec‐ŋoparâ Jesu Kristore biŋe qacŋopakicne ŋoŋere papia ʒi qâreŋkekopac.
Ŋoŋerao uruc jauŋ, wama â maŋjauŋ fua bâbâriŋ fuahuc fozejec.
Âgo biaŋfâc‐nane, miti wirec‐nâŋecte qâreŋke‐ŋarepemurâ boc enareekac. Ehuc mitiŋic mamanasiŋte hata fosanaŋkeocte biricke‐nârekicne i sifuckezacte sasanaŋ bâfuarâ juju gie baniŋte irec faŋdâŋ qâreŋke‐ŋarepemurâ dameŋ‐nane maickekac.
Ŋic gâcne guru‐ŋeŋicko kamic kamic raʒimbiŋ, jaŋe fuŋne‐jeŋic qanaŋ ʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne: Ŋic miti tâmiric, nâ areŋ juhuc sasec gie baeŋgopieŋ, ehuc wiac‐jeŋic Anuture jauŋdâŋzi foŋkehuc fekicne sâko‐nâŋec mocjaha, Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo hâcne e mickeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋoŋe dâŋ mana‐fâreeŋgopieŋ ijaha manasu‐ŋarepe. Wofuŋ e Israe ŋicguru Aigita mâreŋkonec batarac‐joparâ ʒâhec dâŋticne qikiŋnembiŋ i jaŋe behec‐jopame sipirickembiŋ.
Erâ aŋelo soŋaŋ gie‐jeŋic hetararâ hae mâreŋ‐jeŋic behembiŋ, jaŋe okac dameŋ sâkore woŋec foniŋte kâpâcwâru fofo sanaŋzi dapâczi ɋoroc‐jopawec.
Erâ Sodom, Gomora â hae rârec rârec ŋerawec, irec ŋic jaŋe ŋic keci jaŋe iŋucne sasec kosa ehuc mamakâc fuŋmoc bâfuapie ʒocsanaŋko behec‐jopame humbiŋ juŋgopieŋ, i hâhâwic râe‐nâreocte iŋuc ewec.
Eme sifu ŋic keci jaŋe wâc iŋuc jaha, guŋko jujune tinac erâ sahaczi mamakâc eeŋgopieŋ, erâ fekicne ro waha âte ejarehuc tatamachec jaŋe wâc musuac‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Mikae e aŋelo fekicnezi Mose qâŋɋâŋ‐ticnere Sataŋhec iiriac erâ mu qaqatarac ehuc Sataŋ dâŋ sâqocne âzâcneocte maname quŋkeme ʒiŋuc sawa muwec: “Wofuŋzi okacne bazu‐garezejec.”
Ŋic keci jaŋe ine wiac kâuc baeŋgopieŋ i kosa musua‐fâreeŋgopieŋ, â qowi jaŋere sâc tinac erâ mâc maŋjeŋiczi manaeŋgopieŋ ira ine sâqorerâ sipirickeeŋgopieŋ.
Jei, jaŋe juku wenac eniŋmu? Jaŋe Kaiŋte hata âteeŋgopieŋ, â moneŋ mafare harac ehuc Bileamte bâbâsifuc bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, â Kora pepec‐ticnere sipirickewec iŋuc jaha pepec‐jeŋicte sipirickeeŋgopieŋ.
Ŋic i jaŋe hâcne nânâ qowire harac ehuc fisi tutumaŋ‐ŋeŋic hehegâpârene, mimi tâmiric nâ areŋ eene, karorac hoe mi hehuc mâc mâŋâŋzi ficneme rame arictac eekac irec sâcko jujune, jâc garaŋ garaŋne, fâri tâmiric, hâsi fâri hâmokicne, qâqâfiene, ŋic iŋucne tinac hâcne,
hâwec siri ʒocnehec bazu bâfeŋ eekac iŋucne, jaŋacne sâqocne miminehec qâqâtâtiene, bâpiŋ qâsoriekicne iŋucne, duŋdapâc fofo sanaŋ i jaŋere biŋe hâcne bâfuakicne.
Adamte oso gitecne fua warekupie 7 eha Enoko fuawec, eme eki hâcne ŋic iŋucne jaŋere findaŋdâŋ ʒiŋuc muwec: “Wofuŋ e tiri ŋicfâc‐ticne guru hâhâwicne jaŋehec fisizokac,
erâ ŋic mâmâc sasawa fuŋne‐jeŋic bataniŋkehuc ŋic sindaŋne jaŋe sindaŋ‐jeŋicte okacne bazu‐jareocmu. Ŋic sindaŋne miti tâmiric jaŋe wiac gâgâpâcne bocjaha mu bac eeŋgopieŋte katucne fisi‐jareocmu hâcne.”
Ŋic izi mu qâtimbucne, isoc qaisocne, sasec fuŋne fuŋnere heʒâkiriŋkerâ jujune, pepecdâŋ mumune, ŋic moneŋ mafare mu bâmiriŋ eejarene, iŋuc hâcne jueŋgopieŋ.
Âgo biaŋfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe ine Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo aposolofâc‐ticne jaŋe qanaŋ dâŋ mumbiŋ, irec manasuhuc junʒepieŋ.
Jaŋe kecʒiŋuc ŋazahuc jumbiŋ: “Dameŋ bembeŋkeme ŋic âke sisicne fuarâ miti imackehuc sasec gie‐jeŋicte heʒâkiriŋkerâ juniŋmu.”
Ŋic iŋucnezi hâcne fâfâuc bâfuaeŋgopieŋ, erâ Mâro tâmiric maŋ qâŋɋâŋne jueŋgopieŋ.
Jorocfâc‐nane, ŋoŋe ine tiri mamanasiŋ fârine izi ŋesiŋ ŋeŋarehame sanaŋkerâ junʒepieŋ. Ehuc Tiri Mârorao roweckerâ numuhuc junʒepieŋ.
Iŋuc ehuc Anuture maŋjauŋko aimuŋ junʒepieŋ. Erâ Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristo uruc jauŋ‐ticne fua tâcneme juju sanaŋko fisiniŋte woŋec junʒepieŋ.
Ŋic miti bape behepe bajueŋgopieŋ jaŋe dopec‐jopanʒepieŋ.
Â gâcne jaŋere busâqoc manarâ rucŋeŋic bahuc bafic‐jopanʒepieŋ, ehuc qoruc‐jeŋic sâqocnezi hegâpârekicne i wâc bâec banʒepieŋ.
Âkesiŋ‐ŋopame docke pârâc tâmiric juhapie tatamac‐ticnao bahacmâc â ʒerihec râec‐ŋopaocte tâpiri focnekac,
Anutu mocjaha hâcne, e Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Jesu Kristore erâ bâbâpiaŋ‐nâŋec juekaczi tatamac â eri qaraweŋ â sasanaŋ â tâpiri mârâc dameŋ tâmiricko focnewec iŋuc jaha ʒi focnekac, erâ focne rahuc juocmu sanaŋ. Jâmbomac.
Jesu Kristore mu bararuŋ dâŋ, dameŋ mi ʒoraha wiac fuaocte mukicne i kiŋaŋŋicfâcne jaza mutâc eocte Anutuzi Jesu mufuacnewec, eme eki aŋelo‐ticne soreme kiŋaŋŋic‐ticne Johane âzâcne jâutuc ewec.
Eme eki Anuture dâŋ â Jesu Kristore mumutaniŋ dâŋ hone manac eweczi manapaŋkehuc mufuawec.
Eme findaŋdâŋ i wose‐jareocmu e jahacne mecne, â dâŋ mu qâreŋ ekicne manarâ maŋkeniŋmu jaŋe mecne, mâmâc juhâc qâhâmoniŋmu. Dameŋ bembeŋkekac hâcne.
Johane no Asia mâreŋko kikefuŋ 7 juŋgopieŋ ŋoŋere papia ʒi qâreŋkekopac. Juweczi jukac erâ wâc wareocmu eraonec mecne, â mâro 7 eri ŋeŋefuŋ‐ticnao juŋgopieŋ jaŋeraonec mecne,
â Jesu Kristo eraonec aki anonoc â wama ŋoŋerao fotâcnerâ fozejec. Eki hâcne mume sasanaŋ erâ wâc hâmockonec fafahare irec micne, â mâreŋ sâc ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere fekicne sâko jukac. E maŋjauŋ enârehuc socticnezi sâqocnaonec bâhoc‐nâporâ
uucmaŋ‐ticnere kikefuŋfâc bacnâporâ Anutu â Mamac‐ticnere taha bapafâc junaŋte munârewec, erao hâcne eri qaraweŋ â tâpiri ɋuŋɋasaŋ fokaczi fohuc juzejec sanaŋ. Jâmbomac.
Manaŋgopieŋ, e karorac faio warekac, eme ŋic sasawa ʒâŋe‐jeŋiczi honeniŋmu, â âkeckembiŋ jaŋe mâmâc honeniŋmu. Erâ mâreŋ sâc ŋic gurune gurune jaŋe ere kio mamakuc eniŋmu. Dâŋ i jâmbomac jâmbâŋ.
“Nonizia ʒâhec â bâbâni”, Wofuŋ Anutu e iŋuc mukac, e juweczi jukac erâ wâc wareocmu, e bapafâre hâcne.
Johane no fific guguriŋte â uucmaŋte â Jesure woŋec jujure mâmâc qâtec‐ŋopahuc âgo babafic‐ŋeŋic juekopac. Eme no Anuture dâŋte â Jesu mutaniŋkepore Patimo nucko râecnupie ŋepo.
Ŋehuc Wofuŋte ʒoaŋko maŋ qâruru‐nane ropieme râpefuŋ‐naneo dâŋsâko qeŋfânâŋ iŋucne fuame
ʒiŋuc manapo: “Wiac honekomec i papiao qâreŋkerâ kikefuŋ 7 kecʒiŋuc jaŋerao râetec razejec: Efeso haeo â Simirna haeo â Peagamoŋ haeo â Tiatira haeo â Sarde haeo â Filadefia haeo â Laodikea haeo.”
Eme no ŋic dâŋ nazawec e honepemurâ fotikiepo. Fotikierâ lambe 7 golzi bakicne honepo.
Lambe ŋondeŋko moc domame honepo, e hawarine ŋic hawari tinac. Ŋaqi‐ticne ʒoricne waha domawec, â amecnao umbika golzi bakicne fowec.
Qizec‐ticne â qizec susuc‐ticne qaŋqaŋ jâmbâŋ, kota hâpokicne, faroqac iŋucne, â ʒâŋe jahecne ʒoc bâruŋkeekac iŋucne tinac.
Kike jahec‐ticne ine aeŋ ʒocko ʒahuc bâruŋkeekac iŋucne tinac â dâŋ hawari‐ticne opâ sâro fânâŋ tinac.
Mefâre‐ticnezi bâpiŋ 7 badomawec, â michawec‐ticnao sâqe momori moc bune râpene micnehec waha domawec, â ʒâŋemai‐ticne ine ʒoaŋ gereŋ gereŋne eekac iŋuc tinac tamaewec.
No hawari‐ticne iŋuc honerâ rândiŋkerâ kikefuŋnao hâmocne tinac fopo. Fohape mefâre‐ticne fai‐naneo râerâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go mi hâwicguoc, ʒâhec bâbâni â juju rune no hâcne ʒi;
manakic, no hâmorâ ɋârepozi juraʒihuc jupemu sanaŋ, erâ hâmoc â hârâc motâc‐jekicte ki noni bajuekopac.
Go wiac honemec â ʒiŋuczia fuakac â ʒâhec fuaocmu i mâmâc qâreŋke‐fârezemec.
Erâ mefâre‐naneo bâpiŋ 7 i mecne â lambe 7 golzi bakicne mâmâc honemec, irec fuŋne gazape manac: Bâpiŋ 7 i kikefuŋ 7 jaŋere aŋelo, â lambe 7 ine kikefuŋ 7.
“Efeso haeonec kikefuŋ aŋelo‐jeŋicte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkec: ‘Bapiŋ 7 mefâre‐ticnezi badomahuc lambe 7 golzi bakicne irec ŋondeŋhao rac warec eekac, eki gore ʒiŋuc mukac:
