No eebapagere â giegere â sasanaŋgere fuŋne manaekopac. Goki ŋic sâqocne mana qâoma mi ejareekic. Eme irec hâcne ŋic tucne jaŋe, nâŋe aposolo, muhuc burec epie burec‐jeŋicte fuŋne bataniŋkemeŋ.
Erâ sasanaŋhec juhuc nore erâ ʒârâ hâriŋ faio tatakic tâmiric jumeŋ.
Eme no ine wiac kecʒiŋucte gore manape bahacnehec ekac: Go mârâc jaha maŋjauŋ fogarewec sâc ijaha dameŋ ʒiŋuczia mi fogarekac.
Mârâc jaha hahaŋko rahuc jumeŋzi miŋecgac wahakomec. Eme go irec manasurâ maŋge bârisierâ mârâc hatagao mocwâc âtezemec. Iŋuc mi etec no gorao fisirâ lambege bârâriepemu. Maŋge mi bârisietec iŋuc hâcne epemu.
Moc ine etec manape sâckeekac, Nikolao ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe wiac epie takicguekac, ine no iŋuc jaha wâc takicnuekac.
Mârozi kikefuŋ dâŋ jazakac, i hazecneheczi manazejec. Moc e sasanaŋ gie baraku batarame jujujâcte fârine Anuture paradisi gieo fuaekac i râcnepe nâocmu.’
“Simirna haeonec kikefuŋ aŋelo‐jeŋicte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkec: ‘Ʒâhec bâbâni â hâmorâ ɋâreweczi gore ʒiŋuc mukac:
Go fific guguriŋ faio qafec qawahac juekic, i manakopac. Erâ go mâririgehec. Â Judaŋic gâcnezi dâŋ gâgâpâcne gazaeŋgopieŋ, i wâc manakopac. Erâ jaŋe Judaŋic jâmbâŋ mâcne, jaŋe Sataŋte ŋicfâc.
Go wiac ʒârâ hâriŋne mocwâc fua‐gareocmu, irec mi hâwicguzejec. Manakic, Sataŋ e eesâic fua‐ŋareocte ŋoŋeraonec tucne kâpâcwâru ficko râec‐jopaocmu. Eme ŋoŋerao fific guguriŋ ʒoaŋ gie bapa 10 fuaocmu. Goki ine miti paŋʒâic jaha bajuku hâmotec juju sanaŋte eriduzi geroŋgupemu.
Mârozi kikefuŋ dâŋ jazakac, i hazecneheczi manazejec. Moc e sasanaŋ gie baraku batarame hâmoc namba tuzi mi imackeocmu.’
“Peagamoŋ haeonec kikefuŋ aŋelo‐jeŋicte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkec: ‘Sâqe momori, micne ŋifec â ŋifec bajuekaczi gore ʒiŋuc mukac:
Go hae jukomec, irec fuŋne manakopac, ira Sataŋte hozi sanaŋ fokac. Go ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane paŋnea bajuekic. Mupe rereŋ biaŋ‐nane Antipa e hae‐ŋeŋic Sataŋzi ŋeŋe juju eekac ira hâcne qambiŋ, eme go dameŋ ira no manasiŋnurâ mi dockemeŋ.
Erâ no gore manape piticne babahacnehec ekac. Gore haeo ŋic gâcne juŋgopieŋ, jaŋe Bileamte hata âteeŋgopieŋ. Bileam e Balakezi Israe bitiŋ râe‐jareocte âzâcneme eki qafeŋ‐jopame ɋâŋte ʒepec nâhuc sasecko sâqorembiŋ.
Eme gore haeo ŋic gâcne jaŋe Nikolao ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere hata âtehuc sâc ijaha eeŋgopieŋ.
Irec go maŋge bârisiezemec. Iŋuc mi etecne no gorao picpac jaha fisirâ ŋic hâcne râsi ejarehuc micnanere ʒikazi jopapemu.
Mârozi kikefuŋ dâŋ jazakac, i hazecneheczi manazejec. Moc e sasanaŋ gie baraku batarame e mana soŋne gumepemu. Erâ qânâ qaŋqaŋ râcnepemu, ira ʒâŋe qâreŋ‐ticne moc fome runezia buc manaocmu.’
“Tiatira haeonec kikefuŋ aŋelo‐jeŋicte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkec: ‘Anuture Ŋokâ ʒâŋene ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne â kikene aeŋ bâroŋ iŋucne, eki gore ʒiŋuc mukac:
No eebapagere â maŋjauŋgere â mamanasiŋgere â giegere â sasanaŋgere fuŋne manakopac. Erâ mârâc ɋicwânʒâŋge afecne fowec, ʒi ine fekac, i wâc manakopac.
Erâ no kecʒiŋucte gore manape bahacnehec ekac: Goki ŋokac Isebe mana qâoma ecnetec eki, no porofete ŋokac, muhuc ŋicfâc‐nane dâŋ qazu‐jarehuc qafeŋ‐jopame sasec gie bahuc ɋâŋte ʒepec nâeŋgopieŋ.
E maŋticne bârisieocte ʒâfo bacnepo, eme eki ine maŋticne bârisierâ sasec‐ticne beheocte mi muekac.
Manakic, no irec mupe huc hâmoc fuacneme fozejec, â ehec sasec eec eeŋgopieŋ jaŋerao fific guguriŋ kâcɋene fuazejec. Ŋokacte sasec wiac mi behepie iŋuc hâcne ejarepemu.
Â naru motecfâc‐ticne jaŋere mupe huc mimicnezi bâhâmoc‐jopazejec. Iŋuc epe hae sâc opâ ruac jaŋe, noni maŋjeŋicte guruc tuturuŋ hone tara‐fâreekopac, i mana taraniŋmu. No ŋic mâmâc sasawa juju bapa‐ŋeŋicte okacne bazu‐ŋarepemu.
“‘Tiatira haeonec ŋic gâcne ŋoŋe burecdâŋ i qikiŋneeŋgopieŋ, ehuc ŋic gâcne, Sataŋte fuŋne mana utuckeeŋgopeneŋ mueŋgopieŋ, jaŋe mi bafic‐jopaeŋgopieŋ, ŋoŋere mupe mananiŋ: No tagi gâcne fai‐ŋeŋicko mi râeckopac.
Eme wiac foŋarekac i paŋnea bajuhapie fisizepac.
Moc e sanaŋkerâ nore eebapa i eraku etaraocmu, e noni tâpiri râcnepe qâpuc jaŋere micne erâ
aeŋ gunu bajuhuc soŋaŋ‐jopaocmu. Ehuc mâreŋ kuʒi wiac qapene ʒaŋkeekac iŋuc ejareocmu.
No Mamac‐nanezi tâpiri narewec iŋuc jaha e râcnepemu, erâ wâc bâpiŋ sâko ʒuhuckecnepemu.
Mârozi kikefuŋ dâŋ jazakac, i hazecneheczi manazejec.’
“Sarde haeonec kikefuŋ aŋelo‐jeŋicte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkec: ‘Anuture mâro 7 â bâpiŋ 7 bajuekaczi gore ʒiŋuc mukac: No eebapagere fuŋne manakopac, ŋic jaŋe honecgupie ɋâricne jukomec tinac ekac, maŋge ine hâmoc qâŋɋâŋne fokac.
Irec go ɋârerâ ŋic gâcne hâmozo eŋgopieŋ jaŋe maŋjeŋic âke ɋârezemec. Manakic, no Anuture maio eebapage honepe mi sâckekac.
Go wiac gare tahac ekicne â gaza qazuc ekicne, i heɋârerâ aimuŋ bajuhuc maŋge bârisiezemec. Mi ɋâretecne ine râsi fifisi tinac fisi‐garepemu, go ʒâfo‐nane moc mi manahaŋtec biac fisipemu hâcne.
Sarde haeo ira ŋicfâcge gâcne juŋgopieŋ, jaŋe ŋaqi‐jeŋic sohoŋ mi ruacnembiŋ. Eme iŋucnezi juku ŋaqi qaŋqaŋ rojuhuc nohec ŋeŋe juju eniŋmu. Jaŋe iŋuc eniŋte mana‐jarepe sâckekac.
Moc e sasanaŋ gie baraku batarame ŋaqi qaŋqaŋ râcnepe rojuocmu, â ʒâŋe‐ticne juju sanaŋ papiao mi hetâmirepemu, aricne, no ʒâŋe‐ticne Mamac‐nanere maio â aŋelofâc‐ticne jaŋere maio mutaniŋkepemu.
Mârozi kikefuŋ dâŋ jazakac, i hazecneheczi manazejec.’
“Filadefia haeonec kikefuŋ aŋelo‐jeŋicte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkec: ‘Tiri juju â mume sasanaŋ, Dawidire ki bajuhuc motâc bâŋgoroŋkeme moczi mi basanaŋkeocmu, me basanaŋkeme moczi mi bâŋgoroŋkeocmu, eki hâcne gore ʒiŋuc mukac:
No eebapagere fuŋne manakopac. Manakic, no maigao motâc moc baandaŋke‐garepo i moczi moc sâcne mi hebâzicke‐gareocmu. Go tâpiri piticne sawa fogarekac i manakopac, erâ sifu dâŋnane paŋnea bajuhuc ʒâŋe biŋe‐nane mi behemeŋ.
Manakic, Sataŋte guruonec ŋic gâcne jaŋe Judaŋic fârine aricne, racne juhuc burec eeŋgopieŋ, eme no jaŋe ejarepe gorao fisirâ dieŋzi hegarehuc, âgo bacgupo i hone taranʒepieŋ.
Go woŋec‐nane tatakic tâmiric jucmurâ mugarekicne, dâŋnane i paŋnea bajumeŋte noni eesâic dameŋ maicguzacte sabecgupemu. Eesâic i mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋerao mâmâc fua‐fâreocmu.
No biac fâpemu, irec go wiac fogarekac i paŋnea bajuhaŋtec moczi eriduge mi gowac rozejec.
Moc e sasanaŋ gie baraku batarame e Anutu‐nanere ufuŋko safatariŋ âkendâŋnepemu. Eme e ira domahuc juocmu sanaŋ. Erâ ere faio Anutu‐nanere ʒâŋe qâreŋkepemu, erâ Anutu‐nanere hae ere ʒâŋe iŋuc jaha ere faio qâreŋkepemu, i Jerusalem hae ɋâricne hâcne, sambâŋkonec Anutu‐naneraonec wahaocmu, erâ no nahacne ʒâŋe ɋâri i iŋuc jaha ere faio qâreŋkepemu.
Mârozi kikefuŋ dâŋ jazakac, i hazecneheczi manazejec.’
“Laodikea haeonec kikefuŋ aŋelo‐jeŋicte dâŋ kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkec: ‘Dâŋte mamacne â mumutaniŋ fârine â mume sasanaŋ, e Anuturaonec wiac fuawec irec fuŋqizecne juekaczi gore ʒiŋuc mukac:
No eebapagere fuŋne manakopac. Go mâteŋne mi juekic â fârone mi juekic i manakopac. Mâteŋne me fârone juzo murâ junʒaŋ me!
Mâteŋne â fârone ŋondeŋ‐jekicko dodo horaŋne juekicte micnaneonec maŋucgupe wahacmu.
Go gahacnere ʒiŋuc muekomec, no mâriri bocjaha fonarekac, no wiac wemo afecne hurepo, irec wiac moc mi basapemu. Go fuŋnege kâuc baekic, ehuc qarâ suriŋne, huacbucne, tac qararacne, tiŋtuŋne â biuctac juekic, i mi mana tarakomec.
Irec go gazape manac: Go noraonec ʒuŋe kizukicne furine barâ boreŋhec ezemec, â ŋaqi qaŋqaŋ furine barâ hetec hurâ mimige sâockezejec, erâ ʒâŋere wokemaŋ furine barâ ʒâŋege ruacnerâ fiɋaɋackezemec.
No âgo bacjopaekopac jaŋe mu bâtiŋ â qa bâtiŋ ejare‐fâreekopac. Irec go ʒoɋac erâ maŋge bârisiezemec.
Manakic, no motâc râpeo domahuc heickekopac, eme moc e dâŋnane manarâ motâc ronareme ere ficko ferâ suanʒeŋ nâ gumec ecnepemu.
Moc e sasanaŋ gie baraku batarame noni hefârepe nore eri ŋeŋeo mâmâc ŋenacmu, no iŋuc jaha sasanaŋ gie baraku batarape Mamac‐nanezi ere eri ŋeŋeo ŋepemurâ hefârecnuwec.
Mârozi kikefuŋ dâŋ jazakac, i hazecneheczi manazejec.’”
No wiac i hone manac efârerâ ʒâŋe firâ mi sambâŋko motâc moc aaŋ domame honezepac i! Ehame dâŋ qanaŋ qeŋfânâŋ tinac manapo, ijaha mocwâc fuarâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go ʒira wefutec juku wiac fuaocmu gaza gowatuc epe honec.”
Iŋuc mume izia maŋnane ŋerisieme sambâŋko eri ŋeŋe moc ŋehame fainao moczi ŋeme honepo.
Â eri ŋeŋeo ŋewec e hawarine ârâŋ ɋârizi bâbâroŋ findowakicne, â ŋeŋe botâŋnao huriri somâckerâ domawec, hawarine buge iŋucne erâ jawaririŋ kikicne.
Erâ eri ŋeŋe sâko rârec rârec eri ŋeŋe gâcne 24 ŋerawec. Ŋeŋe irec faio ŋicqizec 24 ŋerambiŋ. Jaŋe ŋaqi qaŋqaŋ sasawa roŋembiŋ â eridu golzi bakicne qizec‐jeŋicko ŋerawec.
Erâ eri ŋeŋe sâkoonec bâbâric â ɋuŋ parandaŋ fuahuc fowec, â eri ŋeŋe mainao ʒocbâruŋ 7 ʒawec, i Anuture mâro 7 jaŋere ʒoc.
Erâ wâc eri ŋeŋe maio ine hâwec kiruŋzi bakicne tinac jawaririŋ kikicne fowec. Erâ eri ŋeŋe maŋfuŋnao wiac jujune 4 ŋerambiŋ, jaŋe bu râpe‐jeŋicko ʒâŋehec sasawa.
Moc e laioŋ hawari iŋucne, moc e bulimakao ŋicne hawari iŋucne, moc e ʒâŋe maine ŋic hawari iŋucne, moc ine tucwipe fahareekac hawari iŋucne.
Wiac jujune 4 jaŋe fakec‐jeŋic 6 sasawa, erâ fakec‐jeŋic faine â juwicne ʒâŋe‐jeŋic jaha fowec. Erâ ŋafe furec wirahuc ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: “Wofuŋ Anutu bapafâre, e tiri, tiri, tiri jaha, juweczi jukac erâ wâc wareocmu.”
Eme wiac jujune 4 jaŋe eri ŋeŋeo ŋeekac, juju sanaŋ rune hâcne, e daŋge mumuteŋ â ʒeri bubiaŋ ecnepie sâc
ŋicqizec 24 jaŋe, eri ŋeŋeo ŋeekac, juju sanaŋ rune hâcne, ere maŋfuŋko fodaperâ mu ʒeri ecnehuc ŋeŋefuŋ‐ticnao eridu‐jeŋic râerâ ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ:
“Wofuŋ‐nâŋec Anutu, eri qaraweŋ â ʒâŋe biŋe â tâpiri i goki raucketec sâcke‐hâmokac, goki hâcne wiac sasawa bâfuameŋ, â gore micte wiac fua‐fârewec fokac.”
Eme eri ŋeŋeo ŋeekac e mefâre‐ticnezi papia foforiŋ moc baŋeme honepo, papia e bune râpene qâreŋhec jaha fowec, erâ sâfâ 7‐zi basanaŋkekicne.
Eme aŋelo sâko honepo, e dâŋ hahaŋnehec ʒiŋuc muwec: “Mo tiŋnezi papia sâfâ‐ticne bâhockerâ bâdâmâreme sâckeocmu?”
Iŋuc mume sambâŋko me mâreŋko me mâreŋ jujuwicnao moczi moc papia sâfâ‐ticne bâhockerâ woseocte mi afeckewec.
Eme moczi sâsâcne mi juhuc papia bâdâmârerâ wosewecte bunane sâqoreme boc kiopo.
Iŋuc epe ŋicqizec jaŋeraonec moczi ʒiŋuc naza muwec: “Mi kioc, manakomec, Judare ɋâricfâc jaŋeraonec laioŋ moc fuawec, Dawidire gitecne hâcne, eki papia sâfâ‐ticne 7 bâhockerâ bâdâmâreocte wiac sasawa qamase‐fârewec.”
Eme no ʒâŋe firâ eri ŋeŋe â wiac jujune 4 irec ŋondeŋko ŋicqizec jaŋere birio Lama moc hezukicne hawari domame honepo. Ʒuŋene 7 â ʒâŋene iŋuc jaha 7. Ʒâŋene 7 i Anuture mâro 7, jaŋe mâreŋ sâc sorec‐jopakicne juraŋgopieŋ.
Eme Lamazi rarâ eri ŋeŋeo ŋewec ere mefâreonec papia foforiŋ rowec.
Papia foforiŋ rome wiac jujune 4 â ŋicqizec 24 jaŋe Lamare maŋfuŋko fodapembiŋ. Jaŋe musi‐jeŋichec sasawa, â râqâc golzi bakicne i mâmâc barâ fombiŋ. Râqâc maŋkonec hosâc âsu biaŋ wefuwec, i Anuture tiriŋicfâc jaŋere nunumu.
Eme jaŋe gae ɋâricne moc ʒiŋuc hembiŋ: “Goki papia rorâ sâfâ‐ticne bâhocketec sâcke‐hâmoocmu. Go gupie socgezi mâreŋ sâc ŋic sahac hawari fuŋne fuŋne â dâŋmarac fuŋne fuŋne kitâc‐jopame Anuture biŋe embiŋ.
Erâ qâzuc‐jopatec Anutu uucmaŋ‐ticnere kikefuŋfâc â taha bapafâc‐ticne embiŋ. Eme jaŋe mâreŋte faio guriŋ bapa gie baniŋmu.”
Eme no ʒâŋe firâ aŋelo bocjaha jâmbâŋ honec‐jopahuc micfânâŋ‐jeŋic manapo. Jaŋe eri ŋeŋe â wiac jujune â ŋicqizec orâŋ‐jopahuc domambiŋ, teŋ tauseŋ gurune gurune â wâŋ tauseŋ gurune gurune domarahuc
dâŋ ʒiŋuc wiwirao mumbiŋ: “Lama hezukicne eki tâpiri mazuc mâriri â maŋɋârâŋ â sasanaŋ â ʒâŋe biŋe â eri qaraweŋ â muac baafec rauckeme sâcke‐hâmokac.”
Eme sambâŋko â mâreŋko â mâreŋ jujuwicnao â hâwecko jurambiŋ sasawa jaŋe kecʒiŋuc mupie manapo: “Eri ŋeŋeo ŋekac e â Lama mâmâc muac baafec â ʒâŋe biŋe â eri qaraweŋ â tâpiri focnekaczi focnerahuc juzejec sanaŋ.”
Eme wiac jujune 4 jaŋe mumbiŋ: “Jâmbomac.” Â ŋicqizec jaŋe fodapehuc numucnembiŋ.
Eme no ʒâŋe firâ honepo, Lama eki papia sâfâ 7 fowec ine moc bâhockewec. Bâhockeme wiac jujune 4 jaŋeraonec moc e ɋuŋ parandaŋ maracko wirahuc muwec: “Warec.”
Mume mi becâsic qaŋqaŋ moc wareme honezepac i! Fainao ŋic moc ŋewec e tepe‐ticnehec, eme e eri qoqonaŋ râcnepie momori erâ wiac qamase rahuc juwec.
Eme Lamazi sâfâ namba 2 bâhockeme wiac jujune namba 2‐zi wirahuc muwec, “Warec!”
Mume becâsic bâbâroŋ fuawec. Fainao ŋic ŋewec e mâreŋko wama bârârieme ŋic jaŋe qâqâmiziec eniŋte tâpiri râcnekicne. Erâ ʒika sâko mâmâc râcnekicne.
Eme Lamazi sâfâ namba 3 bâhockeme wiac jujune namba 3‐zi wirahuc muwec, “Warec!” Eme no ʒâŋe firâ honehape mi becâsic gâgâpâc warezejec i! Ŋic fainao ŋewec e sigeli baŋewec.
Eme no wiac jujune jaŋere ŋondeŋko ŋicmarac tinac fuarâ ʒiŋuc mume manapo: “Padi tase 2 furine 1 kina â jacgoŋ 12 iŋuc jaha furine 1 kina. Erâ saŋ hâmeŋ fâric ine akicketec fuazejec.”
Eme Lamazi sâfâ namba 4 bâhockeme wiac jujune namba 4‐zi wiwirao muwec, “Warec!”
Eme ʒâŋe firâ honehape mi becâsic moc sahacne gowaekicne warezejec i! Ŋic fainao ŋewec ʒâŋene hâmoc. Erâ hârâckoneczi bâjâpembiŋ. Eme mâreŋko rukec jahec â moc mâc fohame moc ira mume ʒikazi â roroczi â huc mimicnezi â kâte qowi momorizi ŋic sipiric‐jopaniŋte tâpiri râe‐jarekicne.
Eme Lamazi sâfâ namba 5 bâhockewec. Ehame ŋic Anuture dâŋ bajuhuc biŋe‐ticne mutaniŋkepie jopakicne jaŋere maŋ qâqâtâc alata maŋfuŋko fopie honec‐jopapo.
Jaŋe dâŋ wiwic jaha wirahuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Tiri â mume sasanaŋ Wofuŋ, go wemocte okac dameŋ bâʒorahuc socnâŋecte kiŋ ŋic mâreŋko juŋgopieŋ jaŋerao mi batarakic?”
Iŋuc mupie ŋaqi qaŋqaŋ ru sâc jare‐fârerâ ʒiŋuc jazambiŋ: “Kiŋaŋ qaqa âgofâc‐ŋeŋic gâcne iŋuc jaha jopa qâhâmoc ejarepie ʒare‐jeŋic qosackeocte woŋec piticne junʒepieŋ.”
Eme wiac ʒiŋuc honepo: Lama e sâfâ namba 6 bâhockeme homeŋ sâko bawec. Ehame ʒoaŋ gâpârerâ kuʒi sahacne iŋucne ewec, â mosa e soc iŋucne ewec.
Â bâpiŋ jaŋe mâŋâŋzi nemuja qâmârâŋkeme wahaekac, iŋuc sambâŋkonec mârâŋkerâ wahambiŋ.
Â sambâŋ e ine papia bataforieeŋgopeneŋ iŋuc foforierâ sirowewec. Â tiki â nuc jaŋe ŋeŋe‐jeŋic behembiŋ.
Wiac iŋucne fuame mâreŋ sâc ŋicwofuŋ â ŋicbomboŋ, erâ momori micnefâc‐jeŋic â mafa mâririhec â tâpirihec, ŋic fekicne â wahakicne mâmâc sasawa mâreŋ â qânâ hawecko soŋkerâ tiki â hârâc wâsic‐jopahuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ:
“Waharâ ŋemac‐nâporâ bârârâŋ‐nâpopie eri ŋeŋeo ŋekac ere ʒâŋeo mi henʒepeneŋ â Lamare kimbeŋ mi honenʒepeneŋ.
Kimbeŋ‐jeŋicte dameŋ sâko maickekacte ŋic mozi moc juocmu?”
Eme no ʒâŋe firâ aŋelo 4 honec‐jopapo, jaŋe mâreŋ tuturuŋne 4 ira doma rahuc mâreŋte mâŋâŋ 4 badomambiŋ. Mâreŋko me hâwecko me jâcko mâŋâŋ moc mi qaocte iŋuc embiŋ.
Ehame ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec aŋelo moc wefume honepo. E Anutu jujune eraonec maqâreŋ bajuwec. Bajuhuc aŋelo 4 mâreŋko â hâwecko ima baniŋte mujarekicne jaŋe wiwic jaha wira‐jarehuc ʒiŋuc muwec:
“Ŋoŋe mâreŋko me hâwecko me jâcko ima biac mi banʒepieŋ, nâŋe qanaŋ Anuture ŋicfâc mai‐jeŋicko maqâreŋ râenaŋmu.”
Iŋuc mume ŋic maqâreŋhec jaŋere ʒare kecʒiŋuc mupie manapo: “Israe guru sâc jaŋeraonec 144 tauseŋ maqâreŋ râe‐jarekicne.
Judare guruonec 12 tauseŋ maqâreŋ‐jeŋichec, Rubeŋte guruonec 12 tauseŋ, Gade ere guruonec 12 tauseŋ,
Ase ere guruonec 12 tauseŋ, Naftali ere guruonec 12 tauseŋ, Manase ere guruonec 12 tauseŋ,
Simeoŋ ere guruonec 12 tauseŋ, Lewi ere guruonec 12 tauseŋ, Isasa ere guruonec 12 tauseŋ,
Sebuloŋ ere guruonec 12 tauseŋ, Josefe ere guruonec 12 tauseŋ, Benjamiŋ ere guruonec 12 tauseŋ, ŋic iŋuczi maqâreŋ‐jeŋichec embiŋ.”
Wiac i hone manac efârerâ moc honepo, mâreŋ sâc irec ŋic tucne, sahac hawari‐jeŋic fuŋne fuŋne â dâŋ marac‐jeŋic fuŋne fuŋne, guru sokawec jâmbâŋ, ŋic moczi mi wowosene, jaŋe eri ŋeŋere â Lamare maŋfuŋko domapie honec‐jopapo. Jaŋe ŋaqi qaŋqaŋhec sasawa,
erâ mejeŋiczi ʒariŋ badomahuc dâŋ hahaŋne bahuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Bâbâpiaŋ i Anutu‐nâŋec eri ŋeŋeo ŋekac erao â Lamarao fokac.”
Eme aŋelo sasawa eri ŋeŋe â ŋicqizec â wiac jujune 4 orâŋ‐jopahuc domambiŋ, jaŋe eri ŋeŋe maŋfuŋnao fodaperâ Anutu nunumu mumuteŋ ecnehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ:
“Jâmbomac! Mumuteŋ â eri qaraweŋ â maŋɋârâŋ â daŋge mumu â ʒâŋe rara â tâpiri â sasanaŋ i Anutu‐nâŋec focnekaczi focne rahuc juzejec sanaŋ. Jâmbomac.”
Eme ŋicqizec jaŋeraonec moczi wio‐narerâ muwec: “Ŋaqi qaŋqaŋhec i mo jaŋe? Wenirec warembiŋ?”
Wio‐nareme dâŋ ʒiŋuc bâtikiecnepo: “Ŋicbomboŋ‐nane, i goki manakic.” Eme nazawec: “Jaŋe ʒâic busâqoc maŋnaonec warembiŋ â ŋaqi‐jeŋic Lamere soczi ʒure ɋaɋackembiŋ.
Irec ʒi Anutu eri ŋeŋe‐ticnere maŋfuŋko juhuc ŋafe furec ufuŋ‐ticnao kiŋaŋ qacneeŋgopieŋ. Ehame eri ŋeŋeo ŋeekaczi qâtec‐jopahuc sâoc‐jopaocmu.
Eme nânâ opâre mocwâc mi hâmoniŋmu; ʒoaŋzi mi rikec‐jopaocmu â ʒâic fâro mi fua‐jareocmu.
Ŋeŋe ʒâʒâŋiŋko Lama domakac eki hâcne soŋaŋ‐jopaocmu, ehuc juju opâ ʒâkâŋnao amec‐jopa rahuc juocmu; erâ Anutuzi ʒâŋeuc‐jeŋic bâkereŋke‐fâreocmu.”
Eme Lama e sâfâ namba 7 bâhockeme sambâŋko niniŋ qiririŋ fuarâ fohame haf aua qâririŋ ewec.
I tarame aŋelo 7 Anuture maŋfuŋko domambiŋ jaŋe honec‐jopahape gâcnezi qeŋ 7 jarembiŋ.
Eme aŋelo moczi râqâc golzi bakicne ihec warerâ ra alata maŋfuŋko badomame gâcnezi ira hosâc âsu biaŋ bocjaha râepie huwec. Hume eri ŋeŋe mainao alata golzi bakicne ŋewec irec fainao râehuc mitiŋic jaŋere nunumuo ʒuhuckewec.
Ehame meticnaonec hosâc âsu biaŋ izi mitiŋic jaŋere nunumu bafickehuc Anuturao fewec.
Aŋelo e iŋuc erâ alataonec ʒoc kine rorâ râqâc‐ticne bâfuserâ mâreŋko hoŋkeme huwec. Hume ɋuŋ parandaŋ â bâbâric â homeŋ fuawec.
Eme aŋelo 7 qeŋ jarekicne jaŋe qeŋ qaniŋte ʒawiembiŋ.
Ehuc aŋelo namba wâŋ eki qeŋ qame hoe sanaŋ â ʒoc sochec bâsifuckekicne izi mâreŋko hewec. Heme mâreŋ tucne ʒoczi ʒawec â jâc tucne â sopâc kecɋaŋ sasawa ʒoczi ʒafârewec.
Eme aŋelo namba 2 eki qeŋ qawec. Qeŋ qame wiac moc tiki sâko iŋucne ʒocbâruŋnehec hâwecko rucnewec.
Rucneme hâwec tucne soc efârewec. Eme hâwec qowi tucne hâmo‐fârembiŋ â woke tucne ʒaŋke‐fârewec.
Eme aŋelo namba 3 eki qeŋ qawec. Qeŋ qame bâpiŋ sâko moc sambâŋkonec tara waharâ ine waha iŋucne bâruŋkehuc opâ gâcnao huwec.
Bâpiŋ ʒâŋene Hâtâqiŋqiŋ. Eme irec opâ gâcne hâtâ qiŋqiŋne eme ŋic jaŋe nâpie hâtâc‐jopame bocjaha hâmombiŋ.
Eme aŋelo namba 4 eki qeŋ qawec. Qeŋ qame ʒoaŋ mosa â bâpiŋ gâcne ira sâwec fuame tatamac‐jeŋic pitiwawec. Tatamac‐jeŋic gâkowawecte hae burec burec sawa furewec â ŋafeo iŋuc jaha mosa bâpiŋ buburecne tamaewec.
Eme no ʒâŋe firâ tucwipe sâko moc honepo. E sawao faic jâmbâŋ juhuc wiwic jaha ʒiŋuc wirawec: “Jei, jei, jei, aŋelo jahec â moc jaŋere qeŋ fokac, i qapie mâreŋŋic jaŋe weniŋuc eniŋmu!”
Eme aŋelo namba 5 eki qeŋ qawec. Eme noni bâpiŋ moc sambâŋkonec tararâ mâreŋko wahame honepo. E hârâcte tapa roocte irec ki râcnekicne.
Eme hârâcte tapa rome hosâc sâko wefuwec, gie ʒame hosâc feekac, irec sâc hosâc wefu ferâ ʒoaŋ â sawa sâocke‐fârewec.
Hosâc maŋkonec ine ɋirikiŋ wefurâ mâreŋko wahambiŋ. Micjeŋic ine omeqaqare sâc.
Erâ jaŋe mâreŋko sopâc nânâ kise me jâcrehac wiac râsi ecneniŋte mi mukicne, ŋic Anuture maqâreŋ mai‐jeŋicko mi fowec, jaŋe sawa râsi ejareniŋte mukicne.
Erâ jopapie hâmoniŋte mâcne, mâc mosa 5 kiʒâic‐jopahuc juniŋte mukicne. Ʒâic ine omeqaqare micte sâc iŋuc manazo.
Eme dameŋ ira ŋic jaŋe hâmoniŋte biŋe muniŋmu erâ mi hâmoniŋmu, hâmoc hefâre‐bipiepie sifu mi maic‐jopaocmu.
Ɋirikiŋ jaŋe ine becâsic hawari, momori jaŋe ʒikao raniŋte becâsic wiac bâmocke‐jareeŋgopieŋ hawari iŋucne hâcne. Qizec‐jeŋicko du golzi bakicne tinac ŋewec, ʒâŋe mai‐jeŋic ŋic ʒâŋe mai tinac.
Kanʒaŋ‐jeŋic ʒoricne, ŋokac qizec gere‐jeŋicte sâc. Micjeŋic laioŋte mic iŋucne.
Amec‐jeŋicko maro wapazi bakicne tinac fowec. Fakec fânâŋ‐jeŋic ine keretac fânâŋ iŋucne, becâsic bocjaha jaŋe ʒikao raniŋte keretac gagasac jaha fâre rapie fânâŋkeekac, iŋucne tinac hâcne.
Gecjeŋic omeqaqare gec iŋucne. Micjeŋic i gecjeŋicko hâcne fokac, izi ŋic mosa 5 kiʒâic‐jopahuc juniŋmu.
Erâ hârâckonec aŋelo e ŋicwofuŋ jujarekac, ʒâŋene Judaŋic jaŋere dâŋko Abadoŋ â Grikŋic jaŋere dâŋko Apolioŋ.
Tucwipezi jei jahec â moc wirawec, moc omaekac, ʒi jajahec fokopirec.
Eme aŋelo namba 6 eki qeŋ qawec. Eme alata golzi bakicne, Anuture maio ŋekac, masune 4,
irecnec dâŋ wefurâ aŋelo namba 6 qeŋ badomawec e ʒiŋuc âzâcnewec: “Eufrata opâ sâkoo aŋelo 4 niŋgiŋ‐jopakicne jaŋe bâŋgoroŋ‐jopac.”
Eme aŋelo 4 jaŋe jara, mosa, ʒoaŋ, aua maickeme mâreŋ sâc ŋic tucne qâmiziec‐jopaniŋte woŋec jumbiŋ, jaŋe hâcne firuec‐jopawec.
Eme momorifâc‐jeŋic becâsicko ŋeŋe jaŋere ʒare 200 million, iŋuc mupie manapo.
Ŋic â becâsic jaŋere hawari ine maŋ ʒâŋe‐nanezi kecʒiŋuc honepo: Ŋic jaŋe maruku bâbâroŋ â keda â bâbâŋeŋ iŋuc rojumbiŋ, â becâsic jaŋere qizec laioŋ qizecne iŋucne, micjeŋickonec ine ʒoc â hosâc â tepe ʒocne wahawec.
Eme wiac fârone jahec â moc izi ŋic gâcne sipiric‐jopa‐fârewec, becâsic mickonec ʒoc â hosâc â tepe ʒocne wahawec izi hâcne.
Becâsic tâpiri‐jeŋic ine micjeŋicko â gecjeŋicko fowec. Gecjeŋic homa iŋucne, qizecnehec, izi hâcne ŋic sipiric‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Eme ŋic tucne hâmo sipiric ehapie tucne akic‐jopakicne jaŋe maŋjeŋic mi bârisiembiŋ â juju bapa‐jeŋicte manapie mi sâqorewec. Aricne, jaŋe sifu demoŋ wiac bajumbiŋ. Â nemuɋâŋ golzi â siliwazi â aeŋzi â qânâzi â jâczi bakicne, hone manac eene tâmiric â rarac wawarecne tâmiric, i numu‐jarehuc jumbiŋ.
Ehuc ʒika â qaŋgec â sasec â fiuc i mi behembiŋ.
Eme aŋelo sâko moc sambâŋkonec wahame honepo. E karoraczi rufacnekicne, qizec botâŋnao hiriri somâckerâ domawec, ʒâŋe maine ʒoaŋ iŋucne, kike jahecne ʒocbâruŋhec.
Meticnezi papia piticne moc bâdâmârekicne i badomawec. Erâ kike fâre‐ticnezi hâwec faio â kike qanazi mâreŋko âterâ domawec.
Domahuc dâŋ wiwira kâcɋene, laioŋte dâŋ sâcko ewec. Wirame ɋuŋ 7 jaŋe dâŋembiŋ.
Dâŋehuc mupie manarâ qâreŋkezo ehape sambâŋkonec wiwira norao ʒiŋuc wahawec: “Ɋuŋ 7 dâŋ mumbieŋ i mi qâreŋkec, mâc tapa batec fooc.”
Eme aŋelo hâwecko â mâreŋko âterâ domawec, eki mefâre‐ticne sambâŋkopec sicnehuc dâŋ mupaŋkewec.
Ehuc juraʒihuc juocmu sanaŋzi wiac bâfua‐fârewec, sambâŋ â irec wiac‐ticne, mâreŋ â irec wiac‐ticne, hâwec â irec wiac‐ticne, erao hâcne ɋetickehuc ʒiŋuc mupaŋkewec: “Dameŋ mocwâc mi fokac.
Aŋelo namba 7 qeŋticne qame fânâŋ fuaocmu, dameŋ ira Anuture dâŋsoŋ, ŋicfâc‐ticne porofete biŋene jazawec, irec fârine fua taraocmu.”
Eme sambâŋkonec dâŋ manapo ijaha mocwâc fuarâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go rarâ aŋelo hâwecko â mâreŋko âterâ domahuc papia bâdâmârekicne badomakac i roc.”
Mume no aŋelorao rarâ papia nareocte âzâcnepe ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Rorâ nâc. Nâtecne bugao hâtâcguocmu â micgao baŋac iŋucne erâ aŋacguocmu.”
Iŋuc murâ papia nareme nâpo. Nârâ micnaneo baŋac iŋucne erâ aŋacnuwec, izi nâkâcnepe ine bunaneo hâtâcnuwec.
Eme ʒiŋuc nazambiŋ: “Go ŋicguru bocjaha, sahac hawari‐jeŋic â dâŋmarac‐jeŋic fuŋne fuŋne erâ ŋicwofuŋfâc‐jeŋic jaŋere findaŋdâŋ mocwâc muzemec.”
Eme moczi gunusâc narehuc ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go fahare Anuture ufuŋ â alata sâc barâ maŋnao numuhuc jueŋgopieŋ jaŋe wosec‐jopazemec.
Ufuŋte hae ʒoŋa ine sâc mi bahuc mâc behetec fooc, i qâpuc jaŋere qikiŋnekicne. Jaŋe hâcne miti hae mosa 42 ima bahuc juniŋmu.
“Eme no mumutaniŋ ŋicjahec‐nane ejactepe mateŋ barâ ŋic findaŋdâŋ jazahuc juhapire ʒoaŋ gie bapa 1 tauseŋ â 260 tarazejec.”
Jahe oliwa jâc â lambe iŋucne, jahe mâreŋte Wofuŋ ere maio domakopirec.
Ŋic moc e râsi ejactezo mume micjekickonec ʒoc waharâ ʒaocmu. Irec ŋic moczi râsi ejacterâ sipirickeocmu.
Ŋic jahe hoere motâc henicte tâpiri jactekicne, irec mupire hoe mi hehe mâc fohame findaŋdâŋ muhuc junicmu. Erâ mupire opâzi soc eocte irec tâpiri fojacteocmu, erâ mâreŋko wiac micne momori fuaocte mupire sâc fuaocmu.
Eme miti mumutaniŋ dameŋ‐jekic tarame hârâckonec qowi mimicnezi wefurâ râsi ejacterâ jofame hâmonicmu.
Hâmopire ŋic jaŋe qâŋɋâŋ‐jekic behec‐jofapie hae sâkore hae ʒoŋao fonicmu. Hae irec ʒâŋe herâriehuc Sodom â Aigita mukicne, Wofuŋ‐jekic hae ijaha maripoŋko qapie hâmowec.
Eme mâreŋ sâc ŋic gâcne, sahac hawari‐jeŋic fuŋne fuŋne â dâŋmarac‐jeŋic fuŋne fuŋne, izi qâŋɋâŋ‐jekic ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc â moc nâfocne honec‐jofahuc juniŋmu, erâ gâcnezi ducjofazo mupie qatara‐jareniŋmu.
Eme porofete jahe ŋic boc bâʒâic‐jopapicte mâreŋne mâreŋne ŋic ʒeri bubiaŋ ehuc boreŋ nareŋ gareŋ eniŋmu.
Eme ʒoaŋ gie bapa jahec â moc â moc nâfocne tarame Anuturaonec juju bâbâfua mâro qâŋɋâŋ‐jekicko raʒime ɋârerâ faharepic. Faharepire ŋic jaŋe honerâ bipic‐jeŋic tarawec.
Ehame sambâŋkonec wiwira kâcqene jaherao ʒiŋuc wahawec: “Ŋohe ʒira wefunic.” Eme râsifâc‐jekic honec‐jofahapie karorac maŋko sambâŋko fepic.
Eme dameŋ ijaha sambâŋko fepire izia homeŋ sâko bawec. Bame hae sâkoo fic gâcne, teŋkonec wâŋ irec sâc, herickehuc ŋic 7 tauseŋ jopame hâmombiŋ. Eme ɋâricne jumbiŋ jaŋe hâwic‐jopame Anutu sambâŋ rune muteŋkembiŋ.
Tucwipezi jei jahec â moc wirawec, ine jajahecte fârine fuawec, mocjahare fokac ine biac fuaocmu.
Eme aŋelo namba 7 eki qeŋ qawec. Qeŋ qame sambâŋko micfânâŋ sâko embiŋ, ehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Ʒi mâreŋ sâko mâreŋ irec Wofuŋ jujure tâpiri i Wofuŋ‐nâŋec â Kristo‐ticne ere meo fekac, eme e guriŋ bapa gie baraʒihuc juocmu sanaŋ.”
Eme ŋicqizec 24 Anuture maio eri ŋeŋe‐jeŋicko ŋembiŋzi waha fodaperâ Anutu ʒiŋuc muhuc daŋge nunumu ecnembiŋ:
“Wofuŋ Anutu bapafâre, jumeŋzi juekic, nâŋe go daŋge mumuteŋ egareŋgopeneŋ. Go tâpiri sâkoge qaratietec fuakac, ehuc Wofuŋ giege fuŋkerâ bataniŋkekic.
Ŋicne ŋicne kimbeŋ qapie gore kimbeŋzi fuakac. Erâ hâmokicne jaŋere dâŋ mutaracmurâ dameŋ maickekac. Erâ kiŋaŋ qaqafâcge, porofete â mitiŋic, â araŋ bagareeŋgopieŋ fekicne wahakicne, jaŋe furine jarecmurâ dameŋne maickekac, â mâreŋ sipirickeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe sipiric‐jopacmurâ irec dameŋ mâmâc maickekac.”
Jaŋe iŋuc epie sambâŋko Anuture ufuŋ aŋkeme qorac tapa katapa ufuŋmaŋko tâtâc fuawec. Eme izia bâbâric â micfânâŋ â ɋuŋ parandaŋ â homeŋ â hoe sanaŋ hâhâwicne fuawec.
Eme sambâŋko mâsi qâreŋ kecʒiŋuc fuawec: Ŋokac moc domawec, e ʒoaŋzi rufacnekicne, kike jujuwicnao mosa ŋewec, qizecnao bâpiŋ 12 izi hendiŋ ecnembiŋ.
Erâ e kiwechec, eme motec roocte gozi kime kio owa ewec.
E iŋuc ehuc domahame mâsi qâreŋ moc sambâŋkoa fuawec. Ine oâ sâko moc fowec, hawarine bâbâroŋ jâmbâŋ, qizecne 7 â ʒuŋene 10, â qizec‐ticne sâc ŋicwofuŋ du jaha ŋerawec.
Eme gecnezi sambâŋko bâpiŋ gâcne qatarac‐joparâ mâreŋko sâroc‐jopame wahambiŋ. Oâ e iŋuc erâ, ŋokac motec rozo ehame ʒiŋuc manasuhuc ra maŋfuŋnao fowec: Motec rome ɋâckezepac.
Eme motec rowec, e mâreŋ sâc ŋicne ŋicne aeŋ gunuzi soŋaŋ‐jopaocte mucnekicne. Erâ motec fuame ine Anuturao baferâ eri ŋeŋe‐ticnere maŋfuŋko râekicne.
Â ŋokac e ine mâreŋ tuhuo wiserâ rawec, ira ʒoaŋ gie bapa 1 tauseŋ â 260 gume jauŋ ecneniŋte Anutuzi ŋeŋe hae moc bâfuacnewec.
Eme sambâŋko ʒika fuawec. Mikae â aŋelofâc‐ticne jaŋe oâ qa jâpec ecneniŋte râsi roroc embiŋ, â ŋifec oâ â aŋelofâcne jaŋe iŋuc jaha râsi roroc embiŋ.
Erâ mi sanaŋkembiŋ. Dockepie sambâŋ sakare‐jarembiŋ.
Ehuc oâ sâko, homa raŋɋa, demoŋ micne sâko Sataŋ hâcne, mâreŋ sâc ŋic maŋ bâsifuc ejareekac, e hâcne tuŋkepie mâreŋko wahawec. E jahacne tuŋkehuc aŋelofâcne mâmâc tuŋjopapie wahambiŋ.
Eme sambâŋko dâŋ wiwira ʒiŋuc fuame manapo: “Anutu‐nâŋecte bâbâpiaŋ â tâpiri â guriŋ bapa gie â Kristo‐ticnere Wofuŋ qâreŋ ʒi fua taniŋkekac. Âgofâc‐nâŋec jaŋere râsi, Anuturao ŋafe furec qoric‐jopaekac, e tuŋkeŋgopieŋ hâcne.
Jaŋe Lamare socko ŋesiŋnehuc miti hâwicmâc mutaniŋkembiŋte sanaŋkembiŋ, ehuc juju‐jeŋic mi sakarehuc hâmocte qikiŋnembiŋ.
Irec sambâŋ maŋne maŋne â ira juŋgopieŋzi ʒeri enʒepieŋ. Â mâreŋ â hâwec, jei, ŋohe weniŋuc enicmu! Ʒi Sataŋzi ŋoŋerao hufakac, erâ dameŋ‐ticne biac taraocmu, i manahuc aaric sâkohec jukac hâcne.”
Eme oâ e mâreŋko behepie waharâ, ŋokac motec rowec e râsi ecnewec.
Eme ŋokac e tucwipe sâkore fakec jahecne râcnepie mâreŋ tuhuo ŋeŋe hae‐ticnao wiserâ homare hâhâwic soŋkewec, ira gume jauŋ ecnehuc juhapie jara jahec â moc â moc nâfocne taraocmu.
Eme ŋokac wisehame homa e râpefuŋnao opâ maŋume micticnaonec waharâ rumi sâko ewec, i ŋokac jowaocte iŋuc ewec.
Eme mâreŋzi ŋokac ŋezickehuc micne aŋkeme oâzi opâ maŋuwec i ira hufârewec.
Eme oâ e ŋokacte mana gâpârerâ kikefuŋfâc‐ticne jopaocte rawec. Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkehuc Jesu mutaniŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋe hâcne jopaocte rawec.
Ehuc hâwec moŋgeŋko hurâ domawec.
Eme no honehape hâwecmaŋkonec qowi mimicne moczi wefuwec. E ʒuŋene 10 â qizecne 7, erâ ʒuŋene sâc ira ŋicwofuŋ du 10 ŋerawec. Erâ qizec‐ticnao ʒâŋe qâreŋ simbiŋne forawec.
Qowi mimicne honepo e hawarine qâto iŋucne, menezi pusime iŋucne, â micnezi laioŋ mic iŋucne. Eme oâ e ʒoɋac sasanaŋ‐ticne â ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋe‐ticne â tâpiri sâko qikiŋnecnewec.
Qowi qizecne moc qâhâmokicne tinac honepo. Eme izi wicticne somieme biaŋkewec. Eme irec mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋe qowi hone warec boc ecnehuc râpefuŋnao jumbiŋ.
Erâ oâ e qowi tâpiri râcnewecte muteŋ bâteŋ ecnembiŋ. Ehuc qowi iŋuc jaha fenʒoŋkehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Qowi e iŋucne mozi jukac? Erâ mozi moc wemo ecneocmu?”
Eme sahac mumuteŋ dâŋ â dâŋ gâgâpâcne muocte irec micne heteckekicne. Erâ gie‐ticne i mosa 42 bahuc juocte dameŋ bacnekicne.
Eme irec Anutu e jahacne mecne â ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne mecne â sambâŋko ŋeŋe juju eeŋgopieŋ jaŋe mecne musoc qâsoriŋ ejarehuc juwec.
Erâ Anuture tiriŋicfâc râsi ejarehuc jopa sipiric ejareocte mana fâsâecnekicne, erâ wâc mâreŋne mâreŋne ŋic sahac hawari‐jeŋic â dâŋmarac‐jeŋic fuŋne fuŋne jaŋe ŋicbomboŋ ejare‐fâreocte tâpiri râcnekicne.
Eme mâreŋŋic sasawa jaŋe mu ʒeri ecneniŋmu, ŋic ʒâŋe‐jeŋic Lama qa hezuc ekicne ere juju papiao mârâc jaha mâreŋ fufuaonecteaŋ mi qâreŋkekicne jaŋe hâcne qowi iŋuc ecne‐fâreniŋmu.
Hazecneheczi dâŋ kecʒi manazejec:
“Moc e kâpâcwârure biŋe eweczi kâpâcwâru ficko fezejec. Moc e ʒikare biŋe eweczi ʒika kizejec.” Tiriŋic jaŋe dameŋ ira hâcne sasanaŋhec â mamanasiŋhec junʒepieŋ.
Eme mâreŋmaŋkonec qowi mimicne moc wefume honepo, e lama iŋucne ʒuŋene jajahec sawa fowec. Dâŋticnezi ine oâdâŋ.
Eme qowi izi qowi mârâc wefuwec ere maio ere tâpiri gie jaha bahuc jukac. Ehuc mâreŋŋic ejareme mârâc qowi, hâmocne tinac erâ ɋârewec, e dieŋzi hecneeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ mâsi kâcɋene baekac, ehuc mume mâreŋŋic honehapie sambâŋkonec ʒoc wahaekac.
Mâsi iŋucne hâcne baocte manacnekicnere mârâc qowi ere maio bahuc mâreŋŋic maŋ bâsifuc ejareekac. Ehuc mume qowi hâmokicne tinac erâ ɋârewec ere hawari baeŋgopieŋ.
Hawari i barâ râepie domaha ʒâhec qowi e manacnekicnere bâɋâreme dâŋ dâŋ eekac. Dâŋ dâŋ ehuc mume ŋic, e dieŋzi mi hecneeŋgopieŋ jaŋe qâhâmoc‐jopaeŋgopieŋ.
Erâ wâc fekicne â wahakicne, mafahec â hapetac, ŋicbomboŋ â kiŋaŋ qaqa, ŋic i mâmâc sasawa ejareme mefâre‐jeŋicko â mai‐jeŋicko maqâreŋ bafâreeŋgopieŋ.
Eme qowire ʒâŋe qâreŋ â ʒare mi bajueŋgopieŋ, jaŋe wiac furi bapare aka hejareeŋgopieŋ.
Maŋɋârâŋ ʒira fokac: Ŋic moc e mamana focnekacko qowi ʒare‐ticnere fuŋne bâfuazejec. Ʒare i ŋic mocte ʒâŋe. Ʒare hâcne i 666.
Eme no ʒâŋe firâ mi Lama Zioŋ tikio domame honezepac i! Erâ ehec ŋic 144 tauseŋ mâmâc domambiŋ. Mai‐jeŋicko e jahacne ʒâŋe qâreŋ â Mamac‐ticnere ʒâŋe qâreŋ fowec.
Eme sambâŋkonec dâŋfânâŋ manapo, i opâ sâro fânâŋ iŋucne â ɋuŋ fânâŋ sâko iŋucne. Erâ dâŋfânâŋ i manape musi tinac ewec, ŋic bocjaha musi bapie fânâŋkeekac iŋuc tinac manapo.
Jaŋe eri ŋeŋere maŋfuŋko â wiac jujune 4 â ŋicqizec jaŋere maio gae ɋâricne moc heeŋgopieŋ. Gae i ŋic gâcnezi he manac eene mi ewec, ŋic 144 tauseŋ, mâreŋŋic gâcne jaŋeraonec furi bacjopakicne, jaŋe sawa mamanane.
Jaŋe hâcne ŋokacko mi sâqorehuc maŋɋaɋac jaha jumbiŋ; jaŋe hâcne Lama jume ju ecneeŋgopieŋ; jaŋe hâcne mâreŋŋic gâcne jaŋeraonec Anuture â Lamare qaqasune bâbâni rocjopakicne.
Erâ micjeŋickonec burecdâŋ moc mi wahawec, jaŋe bahacmâc.
Eme no aŋelo moc honepo, e faic sawao fotâcnehuc rawec. E mâreŋŋic jaŋere Biŋebiaŋ fofo sanaŋ, mâreŋ sâc ŋic sahac hawari‐jeŋic â dâŋmarac‐jeŋic fuŋne fuŋne, jaŋere bajuwec.
Eki wiwic jaha wirahuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Ŋoŋe Anutu araŋ bacnehuc sâsenʒepieŋ, okac dameŋ‐ticne maickekac hâcne. Sambâŋ â mâreŋ, hâwec â opâ ʒâŋe bâfuawec e mu wâwâsic ecnenʒepieŋ.”
Iŋuc murâ rame râpefuŋnao aŋelo moczi warerâ ʒiŋuc wirawec: “Babe hae sâko tâtiekac, tâtie‐jâmbâŋkekac, hae irec rune mâreŋ sâc ŋicne sasecte waiŋ opâ momori gumec‐jopahuc jumbiŋ hâcne.”
Eme râpefuŋnao aŋelo âgo‐ticne moczi warerâ dâŋ hahaŋne bahuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Moc e qowi mimicne e jahacne me hawari‐ticne dieŋzi hecneocmu â mai‐ticnao me meticnao maqâreŋ roocmu,
e Anutuzi kimbeŋ‐ticnere waiŋ opâ momori jâmbâŋ, opâ jâmbâŋhec mi bâsifuckekicne, i râqâc‐ticnaonec gumeme tiri aŋelo â Lama jaŋere maio ʒocbâruŋko hurâ ʒâic serereŋ mana rahuc juocmu.
Eme ʒoczi ŋic iŋucne ʒâfitac‐jopame irec hosâcne ŋezume ŋezu fehuc foocmu sanaŋ. Irec ŋic qowi mimicne â hawari‐ticne dieŋzi hecnembiŋ jaŋe mecne, â ʒâŋe qâreŋ‐ticne bajumbiŋ jaŋe mâmâc ʒâiczi mi behec‐jopame ŋeŋe mana tâmiric ŋafe furec ʒuʒuhuc jaha mana rahuc juniŋmu.”
Dameŋ ira hâcne Anuture sâcmutâc dâŋ reŋkehuc Jesure miti hâwicmâc bajueŋgopieŋ tiriŋic i jaŋe sasanaŋ bâfuanʒepieŋ.
Eme sambâŋkonec dâŋ moc ʒiŋuc wahame manapo: “Go dâŋ ʒi qâreŋkec: Dameŋ ʒi fuŋkerâ, Wofuŋtao qohotahuc hâmoniŋmu jaŋere bubiaŋ manazo. Mârozi mukac, jâmbomac, jaŋe neneŋ gie‐jeŋic hetararâ ŋemanahuc biaŋ‐jopaocmu. Erâ juju bapa‐jeŋicte fârinezi rapie raocmu.”
Eme no fipe feme karorac qaŋqaŋ ututuŋ fuame honepo. Erâ karorac faio moc ŋewec, e hawari‐ticne ŋic iŋucne. Qizec‐ticnao ŋicwofuŋ du golzi bakicne roŋewec â meticnezi sâqe mictara baŋewec.
Ehame ufuŋkonec aŋelo moczi waharâ karorac faio ŋewec, e ʒiŋuc wiracnewec: “Go sâqegezi gie fârine qa roro ec, mâreŋko giere fârine woze‐fârewecte qa roro ezore dameŋne maickekac hâcne.”
Iŋuc mume karorac faio ŋeweczi sâqe‐ticne wickeme mâreŋko fârine qafârewec.
Eme aŋelo moczi sambâŋko ufuŋkonec wahawec, e iŋuc jaha sâqe mictara bajuwec.
Warehame âgo‐ticne moczi alata ŋeweckonec warewec. E ʒocte soŋaŋzi âgo‐ticne sâqe mictara bajuwec e ʒiŋuc wiracnewec: “Go sâqege mictara mâreŋko waiŋ fârine qâtâcne‐fârec, hândâŋne qeue‐fârekac hâcne.”
Mume aŋelo âgo‐ticnezi sâqe wickeme mâreŋko waiŋ hândâŋne nâtâcneme Anutu kimbeŋ‐ticnere katapa sâko irec maŋko beheme hufârewec.
Erâ hae râpeo âte pisickepie katapa maŋkonec socsâko wahahuc fowec. Wahaku ʒâkâŋne fuarâ becâsic mecqaŋeŋ‐jeŋicko qawec. Â ʒâkâŋ rereŋ ʒoric‐ticnere sâc ine 300 kilometa iŋuc ŋerawec.
Eme sambâŋko mâsi qâreŋ sâko bipinehec moc honepo. Aŋelo 7 jaŋe wiac micne momori 7 badomambiŋ. Wiac i mimic fuahame Anuturaonec okacne fisi taraocte mukicne.
Erâ hâwec moc honepo, i kiruŋzi barâ ʒocbâruŋhec bâbâsifuc ekicne tinac fome honepo. Erâ qowi mimicne ere dâŋ â hawari â ʒare qâreŋ i sanaŋkerâ qikiŋnembiŋ ŋic i jaŋe kiruŋzi hâwec irec mecnao Anuturaonec musi badomapie honec‐jopapo.
Jaŋe Anuture kiŋaŋŋic Mose â Lamare gae kecʒiŋuc muhuc heeŋgopieŋ: “O Wofuŋ Anutu bapafâre, go gie fekicne â bipinehec baekic. Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere Wofuŋ Sâko, go hatage tiŋne â fâri fideteŋ.
Wofuŋ go mozi araŋ mi bagareocmu â mozi ʒâŋege mi mumbiaŋkeocmu? Go mocjahazi tiri hâcne. Irec ŋicne ŋicne gorao warerâ dieŋzi hegareniŋmu. Go bâbâtiŋ gie fârine batec fuŋne taniŋkekac hâcne.”
Eme no ʒâŋe firâ honehape sambâŋko ufuŋ qoruc boze‐ticnehec irec motâc aŋkewec.
Aŋkeme aŋelo 7 wiac micne momori 7 bajumbiŋ, jaŋe ufuŋkonec wahambiŋ. Jaŋe ŋaqi ɋaɋacne qaŋqaŋ rojumbiŋ, â amec‐jeŋicko umbika golzi bakicne fowec.
Eme wiac jujune 4 domambiŋ jaŋeraonec moczi aŋelo 7 râqâc 7 golzi bakicne jare‐fârewec. Râqâcmaŋko ine Anutu juju sanaŋ runere kimbeŋ fusucmarâ fowec.
Eme ufuŋmaŋko Anutu tatamac‐ticnere â tâpiri‐ticnere hosâc fuarâ fusucma‐fârewec. Eme aŋelo 7 jaŋe wiac micne momori 7 mi bâfua tarahapie ufuŋko fefere hata mi fuawec.
Eme ufuŋmaŋkonec dâŋ wiwira sâko wahame manapo. I aŋelo 7 ʒiŋuc jazawec: “Ŋoŋe rarâ râqâc 7 hoŋkepie Anuture kimbeŋzi mâreŋko huzejec.”
Eme aŋelo namba 1 eki rarâ râqâc‐ticnaonec wiac hoŋkeme mâreŋko huwec. Hume ŋic qowi mimicnere ʒâŋe qâreŋ bajumbiŋ â hawari‐ticne dieŋzi hecnembiŋ jaŋe wicʒâhâc ʒâic sisiac‐ticnehec mâretec fua‐jarewec.
Eme aŋelo namba 2 eki râqâc‐ticnaonec wiac hâwecko hoŋkeme huwec. Hume hâweczi soc tânipu tinac ewec. Eme irec hâwecko qowi hâmo‐fârembiŋ.
Eme aŋelo namba 3 eki râqâc‐ticnaonec wiac hoŋkeme opâo â riqicko hume soc efârewec.
Eme aŋelo opâ soŋaŋ râekicne eki ʒiŋuc mume manapo: “Tiŋne â tiri, jumeŋzi juekic, okac babazuge bâbâsifuc tâmiric.
Jaŋe mitiŋic â porofetefâcge jaŋere soc sipirickembiŋte soc jaha gumec‐jopatec nâŋgopieŋ. Eme i sâcke‐jarekac.”
Eme alatazi dâŋ ʒiŋuc mume manapo: “Jâmbomac, Wofuŋ Anutu bapafâre, okac babazuge tiŋne â fâri fideteŋ.”
Eme aŋelo namba 4 eki râqâc‐ticnaonec wiac hoŋkeme ʒoaŋko huwec. Ira hume ʒoaŋ ʒocne bâruŋke‐jâmbâŋkerâ ŋic mâretec ʒacjopawec.
Eme ŋic jaŋe ʒoaŋ fâroroc‐ticnezi boc rikec‐jopame Anutu, micticnere wiac micne momori iŋuc fuawec, e ʒâŋe biŋe‐ticne musâqorembiŋ. Erâ maŋjeŋic sifu mi bârisierâ Anutu mi sâsembiŋ.
Eme aŋelo namba 5 eki râqâc‐ticnaonec wiac qowi mimicnere ŋicwofuŋ ŋeŋeo hoŋkeme wahawec. Wahame hae mâreŋ‐ticne dapâc efârewec. Eme ŋic jaŋe ʒâic serereŋ manahuc nameŋ‐jeŋic kitâcnembiŋ.
Eme ʒâic‐jeŋicte â wicʒâhâc‐jeŋicte Anutu sambâŋ rune musoriŋkembiŋ. Ehuc maŋjeŋic mi bârisierâ juju bapa‐jeŋic mi qikiŋnembiŋ.
Eme aŋelo namba 6 eki râqâc‐ticnaonec wiac hoŋkeme Eufrata opâ sâkoo huwec. Hume opâ ʒickewec. I hata fuame ʒoaŋ wewefunaonec ŋicwofuŋ fisiniŋte iŋuc fuawec.
Eme no honehape oâre mickonec â qowi mimicnere mickonec â porofete burecne ere mickonec demoŋ repicne jahec â moc qaqec hawari tinac wefumbiŋ.
I jaŋe demoŋ fârine, mâsi wiac baniŋte tâpiri fojarekac. Jaŋe hâcne mâreŋ sâc irec ŋicwofuŋ qafeŋ‐jopapie Anutu bapafâre ere dameŋ sâkoo râsi roroc erâ fisirâ qaqac eniŋmu.
“Manaŋgopieŋ, no ʒika qaqa jaŋe iŋucne ututuŋ fisipemu. Irec moc e biuctac jume mimi‐ticne fuazacte maŋɋâri juhuc ŋaqi‐ticne soŋaŋkezejec. Iŋuc eocmu ere manape ʒerine ekac.”
Eme demoŋ jaŋe mâreŋ moc ʒâŋene Judadâŋko Hamagedoŋ mukicne, ira ŋicwofuŋ hetumaŋ‐jopa‐fârembiŋ.
Eme aŋelo namba 7 eki râqâc‐ticnaonec wiac sawao hoŋkeme huwec. Eme ufuŋko eri ŋeŋe ŋeweckonec dâŋ wiwira moc ʒiŋuc wahawec: “Efârekicne.”
Eme bâbâric â ɋuŋ parandaŋ â micfânâŋ fuawec â homeŋ kâcɋene sâko jâmbâŋ bawec, sâc iŋucne moc ŋic fuarâ juwarembiŋko mi bawec.
Eme hae sâko fâuckeme jahec â moc ewec. Erâ mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋere hae tâtie‐fârewec, â Babe hae sâkore rufâc jaŋere Anutuzi iŋuc jaha manasurâ kimbeŋ‐ticnere waiŋ opâ gumec‐jopawec.
Erâ wâc nuc â tiki mâmâc sirowe‐fârembiŋ.
Â sambâŋkonec hoe sanaŋ hewec, hândâŋne buse iŋucne, izi ŋic hecjopame Anutu musoriŋkembiŋ. Hoe i hâhâwicne jâmbâŋ, ima‐ticnehec.
Eme aŋelo 7 râqâc 7 bajumbiŋ jaŋeraonec moczi norao warerâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Sasec ŋokac sâko opâ kâcɋenao ŋeekac e okacne fisicneocmu, i waretec gowatupe.
Mâreŋne mâreŋne ŋic jaŋe ehec sasec eec eeŋgopieŋ â mâreŋ sâc ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe eraonec hâcne sasec‐ticnere waiŋ opâ nârâ maŋsifuc ejareekac.”
Iŋuc nazame maŋnane ŋerisieme mâreŋ tuhuo jowacnu rawec. Eme ira ŋokac moc honepo, e qowi mimicne bâbâroŋ moc ere faio ŋewec. Qowi sahac‐ticnao ʒâŋe qâreŋ simbiŋne fuŋne fuŋne sâcke‐fârerâ fowec. Erâ qowi hâcne e qizec‐ticne 7 â ʒuŋene 10.
Â ŋokac e ŋaqi bâbâroŋ â âmuc âmucne rojuwec, erâ erizi kiseŋ qâseŋ kiwec. Meticnezi râqâc moc golzi bakicne badomawec, i sasec‐ticnere sohoŋ mamakâczi fusewec.
Mai‐ticnao ʒâŋesoŋ‐ticne kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkekicne fowec: “Babe hae sâko, mâreŋ sâc sasec mamakâc wiac irec neŋgocne no hâcne.”
Eme ŋokac e tiriŋic â Jesure mumutaniŋfâc jaŋere soc nâku maŋne bibiriwame honepo. Honerâ bipic tatara enarewec.
Eme aŋelozi ʒiŋuc muhuc wio‐narewec: “Wemocte bipic tatara egarekac? No ŋokacte fuŋne â qowizi âsickekac ere fuŋne â qowi qizecne 7 â ʒuŋene 10 irec fuŋne mâmâc gazape manac.
Go qowi mimicne honemec i mârâc jaha juwec, ʒi mi jukac, ʒâhec ine hârâckonec risie wefurâ sisipiric sanaŋko huocmu. Eme qowi mârâc juwec, ʒi mi jukac, juku ine risieocmu, i mâreŋko ŋic jaŋe honerâ mu warec ecneniŋmu. Ʒâŋe‐jeŋic mâreŋ fufuaonecteaŋ juju sanaŋte papiao mi qâreŋkekicne, ŋic i jaŋe hâcne iŋuc eniŋmu.
Ʒi maŋɋârâŋheczi mamanane fokac: Qizecne 7 i tiki 7, ŋokaczi ŋefackekac hâcne.
Eme tiki 7 izi ŋicwofuŋ 7. Ŋicwofuŋ 5 arictac embiŋ, moc ʒi jukac â moc juku fuaocmu. Fuarâ dameŋ bembeŋne mac juocte mucnekicne.
Qowi mârâc juwec, ʒi ine mi jukac, izi ŋicwofuŋ 7 jaŋere birio ʒuhuckehuc namba 8 eocmu, erâ sisipiricko huocmu.
“Ʒuŋene 10 honemec i ŋicwofuŋ 10 jaha wâc, erâ jaŋe gie‐jeŋic dameŋ ʒiŋuczia mi fuŋkembiŋ. Ŋicwofuŋ gie‐jeŋic fuŋkerâ qowi mimicnehec dameŋ bembeŋne mac baniŋmu.
Jaŋe maŋ mamanasu‐jeŋic mocjaha fome qowi mimicnere kiŋaŋ ʒoɋachec qaniŋmu.
Ehuc Lamahec ʒika gie baniŋmu. Eme Lama eki ine sanaŋkerâ jopaocmu. Eki hâcne fekicne jaŋere Fekicne â ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere Wofuŋ Sâko. Â jume jujufâc‐ticne rowosâec‐joparâ rocjoparâ bufuŋfâc‐ticne bacjopakicne hâcne.”
Iŋuc murâ ʒiŋuc ʒuhuckerâ nazawec: “Sasec ŋokac e opâ sâko irec mecnao ŋeme honemec, opâ izi ŋicne ŋicne, sahac hawari â dâŋmarac fuŋne fuŋnehec.
Erâ ʒuŋene 10 honemec, jaŋe mecne â qowi e mâmâc qaisockerâ ŋaqi wiac jâoc rofârerâ biucne nârâ siec sahacne ʒocko rikeniŋmu.
Erâ i mâc mi eniŋmu, Anutuzi maŋjeŋicko mu qafeŋ râeme jaŋe dâŋticne reŋkehuc maŋ mocjaha efârerâ qowi kiŋaŋ qacneniŋmu. Qacnehuc juhapie Anuture dâŋ hâcne sanaŋke‐fâreocmu.
Erâ go ŋokac honemec i hae sâko, e hâcne mâreŋ sâc ŋicwofuŋ ejareme kiŋaŋ qacneniŋte tâpiri focnekac.”
Eme no aŋelo moc sambâŋkonec wahame honepo. E tâpiri kâcɋene focnewec â tatamac‐ticnezi mâreŋ batamae‐fârewec.
E wira owa ehuc ʒiŋuc muwec: “Babe hae sâko iŋuc jaha tutuŋke sanaŋ tuŋkezo, Ehuc demoŋ jaŋere hae gie ekac, demoŋ mamakâcne jaŋe tuhu‐ticnao soŋkeniŋmu, homa â bioc bioc mamakâcne jaŋere fic hae ekac.
Mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋe sasec‐ticnere waiŋ opâ nâhuc jumbiŋ, mâreŋ sâc ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe warerâ sasec gie bahuc jumbiŋ, hae sâc siricfâc‐ticne fisi mazuc mâriri‐ticnere erâ moneŋ mafa sâko hurembiŋ, irec hâcne tâtiekac.”
Eme sambâŋkonec dâŋ wiwira moc ʒiŋuc wahame manapo: “Ŋicfâc‐nane ŋoŋe hae i beherâ wiseniŋ, ira juhuc sâqocnere bafickenʒipiŋte â wiac micne ʒâicne ŋoŋerao fotâcnezacte.
Hae izi sâqocne fainezi faine hefekume sambâŋ heuakac. Eme ʒi Anutuzi kiŋticnere mukac.
Irec fisicnerâ eŋarewec sâc ecnenʒepieŋ, ehuc sâc bafehuc okacne bazucnenʒepieŋ, katucne oto gomba ijaha bafehuc râcnenʒepieŋ.
Sahac bapa ehuc nâ aŋac â gae woŋgâŋ bajuwec irec sâc ʒâic serereŋ â ki busâqoc bâfuacnenʒepieŋ. E maŋticnezi muekac, ‘No ʒi ŋokac bomboŋ sâko, no hozec aricne, bubiaŋ faioa jurahuc jupemu.’
Iŋuc muekacte ʒoaŋ gie bapa ijaha erao wiac micne ʒârâne fuaocmu, huc hâmoc, ki mamakuc â roroc, erâ wâc ʒocte temane eocmu. Wofuŋ Anutu e tâpiri runezi kiŋticne batarakac hâcne.”
Eme mâreŋ sâc ŋicwofuŋ ehec sasec â tiwâ ʒepec gae wowo ehuc jumbiŋ, jaŋe ʒoc hosâc‐ticne feme honerâ ki mamakuc â hobu heheric eniŋmu.
Ehuc ima‐ticne honerâ bipic tatara ejareme taicko domahuc wâsickerâ muniŋmu: “Jei, jei, hae sâko! Babe hae sanaŋ go, okacne ɋeŋfâfâc jaha fisi‐garekac ine.”
Â haene haene siricfâc‐ticne jaŋe mozi mafa‐nâŋec furine baocmu muhuc iŋuc jaha ki busâqoc eniŋmu.
Mafa ine kecʒiŋuc nareŋ gareŋ embiŋ: Gol â siliwa â kubu furi sâko â qoruc erinehec sasawa, qaŋqaŋ â bâbâroŋ, hameŋne â ɋâfoŋne, erâ mondaŋjâczi wiac bakicne â elefante ʒuŋenezi wiac bakicne, erâ bonezi â aeŋzi â wapazi â qânâzi wiac bakicne,
erâ musijâc sahacne â tokic â kâŋâ â opâ âsu â hosâc âsu biaŋ, erâ waiŋ opâ â saŋ fâric â hâmu gai, erâ lama bulimakao â becâsic keretac wiac, â kiŋaŋ qaqa motec.
“Ʒi ine mâririge honeriŋ qâriŋ ehuc juekic i arictac efârewec. Erâ ʒâmbâŋ titikucge qaʒuewec, â eri qaraweŋge somarewec, wemocko mocwâc fua‐gareocmu!”
Eme siricfâc‐ticne wiac iŋucne ehec nareŋ gareŋ ehuc moneŋ mafa sâkohec embiŋ, jaŋe ima‐ticne honerâ wiwicko domahuc ki mamakuc erâ wâsickehuc ʒiŋuc muniŋmu:
“Jei, jei, hae sâko, go ŋaqi qoruc qâreŋzia kirâ qârikuakicne roju jumec â eri fuŋne fuŋne furi sâko irec maŋko jujumec!
Ʒi mafa mâririge ɋeŋnea imacke‐fârekicne ine.” Erâ wâc woke rune â wokeo gie bapa ŋic hâwecko rac warec eeŋgopieŋ, jaŋe iŋuc jaha ʒoc hosâc‐ticne feme honerâ taicko ŋehuc
ki oowa erâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Busâqoc, hae sâko iŋucne moc wena ŋekac?”
Iŋuc murâ mâsic ruarâ ki busâqoc â mu mamakuc erâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Jei, jei, hae sâko, gore erâ woke rune moneŋ mafahec embiŋ. Eme ʒi ututuŋ jaha hae sesuc fuawec.
Sambâŋ â tiriŋic â aposolo â porofete ŋoŋe ine ʒeri bubiaŋ enʒepieŋ; hae sâkore kiŋ ŋoŋerao fowec i Anutuzi batarakac hâcne.”
Dâŋ iŋuc fuame aŋelo sanaŋne moczi buse sâko ro bafaharerâ hâwecko sârockeme huwec. Hume kecʒiŋuc muwec: “Babe hae sâko iŋuc jaha tutuŋke sanaŋtuŋkezo, eme omae‐jâmbâŋkezejec.
Eme musi bapa gita qaqa guru jaŋere marac fânâŋ i gorao mocwâc mi fuazejec, â metâ qâreŋ wiac bâbâfua i gorao arictac ezejec. Eme gie wiac fânâŋ tâmiric nac gumororo barâ fozejec.
Lambe ʒoc tatamacne gorao moc mi fuazejec, â ŋic ŋokac jaŋere dâŋ gâgâwi iŋuc jaha moc mi fuazejec. Siricfâcge jaŋe mâreŋ sâc ŋicbomboŋ sâko erâ jurambiŋ, â gore qaŋgeczi mâreŋ sâc ŋic maŋjeŋic bâsifuckewec.
Erâ porofete â tiriŋic â mâreŋ sâc ŋic jopakicne jaŋere socte kiŋ i gorao fokacte iŋuc egarezo.”
Eme no sambâŋko ŋic guru sâko jaŋere micʒonʒoŋ tinac manapo, jaŋe musereckerâ ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Haleluja, bâbâpiaŋ â eri tatamac â tâpiri ɋuŋɋasaŋ, i Anutu‐nâŋec erao fokac.
Eki hâcne okac babazu gie bame fârinehec â sâckoa eekac. Sasec ŋokac sâko e mâreŋ sâc ŋic sasec qazu‐jarehuc sipiric‐jopawec ere kiŋtofa bazuwec, ehuc ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋere socte kiŋ fowec i batarawec.”
Iŋuc murâ harierâ musereckerâ mumbiŋ: “Haleluja, hae sâko ere hosâczi ŋezurâ ŋezu fehuc foocmu sanaŋ.”
Eme ŋicqizec 24 â wiac jujune 4 jaŋe waha fodaperâ Anutu eri ŋeŋe‐ticnao ŋewec e muteŋkehuc ʒiŋuc mumbiŋ: “Jâmbomac, Haleluja.”
Eme eri ŋeŋe ŋeweckonec dâŋ ʒiŋuc fuawec: “Anuture kiŋaŋŋicfâc ŋoŋe e muteŋke‐fâreniŋ, fekicne wahakicne araŋ bacneeŋgopieŋzi iŋuc hâcne eniŋ.”
Eme no micʒonʒoŋ sâko tinac mocwâc manapo, i opâ sâro fânâŋ â ɋuŋfânâŋ tinac ewec. Ine wiwira dâŋ ʒiŋuc fuawec: “Haleluja, Wofuŋ Anutu‐nâŋec bapafâre e guriŋ bapa gie‐ticne tâtâc fuŋkekac.
Irec nâŋâc ʒeri bubiaŋ ecnehuc mumbiaŋkenaŋ. Lamare ʒeri hombaŋ maickekacte biŋefâc‐ticne ʒawieŋgopieŋ.
Jaŋe ŋaqi qaŋqaŋ kisieckekicne rojuniŋte mana‐jarekicne.” Wofuŋte tiriŋicfâc eebapa tiŋne bâfuambiŋ, izi ŋaqi‐jeŋic ekac hâcne.
Eme dâŋ moc nazawec, “Go kecʒiŋuc qâreŋkec: Lamare ʒeri hombaŋko tiwâ bâzi nâniŋte hefârec‐jopakicne, jaŋe ʒeri bubiaŋ mana‐jarezo.” Iŋuc murâ muwec: “Dâŋ gazakopac i Anuture dâŋ fâri hândâŋne jâmbâŋ.”
Iŋuc nazame no dieŋzi hecnerâ numucnezo ehape qatara‐narerâ muwec: “Misac, iŋuc mi ec, no kiŋaŋ qaqa âgoge, â qomâfâcge Jesu hâwicmâc mutaniŋkeeŋgopieŋ jaŋere âgo jaha. Go Anutu e jahacne sawa daŋge nunumu ecnec.” Jesu mumutaniŋke i findaŋdâŋ mumu Mâro ere gie.
Eme no ʒâŋe firâ mi sambâŋ aŋkeme becâsic qaŋqaŋ moc honezepac i! Eme fainao ŋewec e ʒâŋene Mume sasanaŋ â Fârine mumu. E okac babazu gie â ʒika gie bâbâsifuc tâmiric sâkoa baekac.
Ʒâŋe jahec‐ticne ʒocbâruŋ iŋucne, qizec‐ticnao ŋicwofuŋ du bocjaha ŋewec. Erâ ʒâŋe qâreŋ‐ticne fowec i e jahaczia buc wose manac eekac.
Ŋaqi ʒora‐ticne i soc ruacnekicne, erâ ʒâŋe‐ticne i “Anuture Micdâŋ” mukicne.
Rame sambâŋkonec momori gurune gurune jaŋe becâsic qaŋqaŋkoa ŋehuc bâjâpembiŋ. Ŋaqi‐jeŋic qaŋqaŋ kisieckekicne.
Micticnaonec ine sâqe ʒika mictara moc wefuwec, izi hâcne ŋicne ŋicne jopa bâtiŋ ejareocmu. Erâ aeŋ gunu bajuhuc soŋaŋ‐jopaocmu. Erâ Anutu bapafâre ere kimbeŋ bajaŋgeŋkehuc tofa babazu gie baocmu.
Ŋaqi‐ticne ombâŋnao ʒâŋe qâreŋ‐ticne ʒiŋuc fokac, ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere Wofuŋ Sâko, fekicne jaŋere Fekicne.
Eme no ʒâŋe firâ aŋelo moc ʒoaŋko domame honepo. E ira domahuc wipe sawao rac warec embiŋ jaŋe mâmâc sasawa wiwic jaha wira‐jarehuc muwec: “Anutuzi ʒepec sâko bâfuakacte ware tumaŋne‐fâreniŋ,
ehuc ŋicwofuŋ jaŋere sahac biuc â fekicne jaŋere sahac biuc â ŋic sanaŋne jaŋere sahac biuc, erâ becâsic â momorifâc‐jeŋic jaŋere sahac biuc erâ ŋic mâmâc sasawa, ŋicbomboŋ â kiŋaŋ qaqa, fekicne â wahakicne jaŋere sahac biuc nâfârenʒepieŋ.”
Eme no qowi mimicne e â mâreŋ sâc ŋicwofuŋ â momorifâc‐jeŋic tumaŋne‐fârepie honec‐jopapo. Jaŋe becâsic qaŋqaŋko ŋewec e â momorifâcne râsi ejareniŋte fisimbiŋ.
Eme qowi mimicne â porofete burecne‐ticne jahe dockepic. Porofete burecne eki hâcne qowi mimicnere maio mâsi fuŋne fuŋne bawec, ehuc qowi mimicnere ʒâŋe qâreŋ bajumbiŋ â hawari‐ticne dieŋzi hecnembiŋ ŋic i maŋ bâsifuc ejarewec. Eme jahe ɋâricne rocjofarâ lambe opâre riqiczi ʒoc ʒahuc foekac ira behec‐jofapie hupic.
Gâcne sâko jaŋe ine becâsic qaŋqaŋko ŋewec ere mickonec sâqe ʒikazi waharâ jopa‐fârewec. Eme wipe jaŋe fisirâ sahac biuc‐jeŋic nârâ gagapec embiŋ.
Eme no sambâŋkonec aŋelo moczi wahame honepo. E hârâcte ki â kâpâcwâru sâko moc bajuwec.
Erâ e oâ, homa raŋɋa, demoŋ micne Sataŋ hâcne, e rorâ kâpâcwâruzi bândeŋnerâ jara 1 tauseŋ niŋgiŋhec foocte mucnerâ
hârâcko tuŋkeme huwec. Hume motâcne kizi basanaŋkerâ sâfâzi bâbâzickewec. Eme ŋicne ŋicne maŋ bâsifuc mocwâc mi ejarehuc mâc fohame jara 1 tauseŋ taraocte mukicne. Tarame firuepie wefurâ dameŋ bembeŋne mac juocmu.
Eme no eri ŋeŋe ŋerame honepo. Honehape ŋic fisirâ fainao ŋembiŋ jaŋe mumutara gie baniŋte mujarekicne. Eme Jesu mutaniŋkehuc Anuture dâŋ hâwicmâc bajuhapie upe‐jeŋic qâtâcnekicne jaŋere maŋ qâqâtâc honec‐jopapo, erâ qowi mimicne e jahacne â hawari‐ticne dieŋzi mi hecnembiŋ â ʒâŋe qâreŋ‐ticne mai‐jeŋicko â mejeŋicko mi bajumbiŋ, jaŋere maŋ qâqâtâc mâmâc honec‐jopapo. Eme ŋic i jaŋe sahac‐jeŋic ɋâreme honec‐jopapo. Eme jaŋe Kristohec ŋicwofuŋ gie bahapie jara 1 tauseŋ tarawec.
Hâmokicne gâcne sâko jaŋe ine mi ɋârehuc jara 1 tauseŋ taraocte irec woŋec fombiŋ. Fafahare honepo i fafahare namba wâŋ.
Fafahare namba wâŋko ʒuhuckeŋgopieŋ jaŋe ʒeri bubiaŋ faio tiri juŋgopieŋ. Ŋic iŋucne hâmoc namba tuzi bâsowariec‐jopaocmu. Jaŋe Anuture â Kristore taha bapafâc erâ juniŋmu, ehuc ehec ŋicwofuŋ gie bahuc juhapie jara 1 tauseŋ taraocmu.
Eme jara 1 tauseŋ tarame Sataŋ firuepie kâpâcwâru fickonec mocwâc wefuocmu.
Wefurâ ŋicne ŋicne mâreŋ ŋifec â ŋifec, faic â juwic juŋgopieŋ maŋjeŋic bâsifuckerâ Gogo â Magogo ŋic qafeŋ‐jopame râsi roroc erâ fisiniŋmu, jaŋe ʒare‐jeŋic hâwec moŋgeŋ iŋucne, wowosene tâmiric.
Fisirâ mâreŋ wâneŋ sâko ira raferâ tiriŋic toma âterâ fohapie somâc‐jopambiŋ. Somâc‐jopahuc hae biaŋ i mâmâc orâŋkembiŋ. Iŋuc ehapie sambâŋkonec ʒoc waharâ ʒâhâmoc‐jopa‐fârewec.
Â Sataŋ, maŋ bâsifuc ejarehuc juwec, e lambe opâre riqiczi ʒoc ʒahuc foekac ira behepie huwec. Qowi mimicne â porofete‐ticne burecne jahe ijaha mâmâc jupic. Eme jahe ira ŋafe ʒoaŋ qâqâtiri ʒâic fâro mana rahuc junicmu sanaŋ.
Eme no eri ŋeŋe kâcɋene qaŋqaŋ moc honepo. Fainao ŋewec ere maionec sambâŋ â mâreŋ wise tâmirepic.
Ehame hâmokicne fekicne wahakicne jaŋe mâmâc sasawa eri ŋeŋe fuŋnao domapie honec‐jopapo. Domahapie papiane papiane qaratiembiŋ. Erâ moc qaratiembiŋ i juju sanaŋte papia. Eme hâmokicne jaŋe juju bapa‐jeŋicte dâŋ papiao qâreŋkekicne i honehuc dâŋjeŋic mutarambiŋ.
Eme dameŋ ira hâweczi maŋnao hâmokicne fombiŋ jaŋe bârisiec‐jopawec â hâmoczi ŋic hâmocne bârisiec‐jopawec â hârâczi ŋic hâmocne bârisiec‐jopawec wâc. Eme hâmokicne sasawa jaŋe juju bapa‐jeŋicte fuŋne rituhuc tofa bazu‐jarekicne.
Eme hâmoc â hârâc i ʒocriqicko behepie huwec. Izi hâmoc namba tu ekac, ʒocriqic hâcne.
Eme ŋic moc e ʒâŋene juju sanaŋte papiao basarâ ʒocriqicko behepie huwec.
Eme no sambâŋ ɋâricne â mâreŋ ɋâricne honec‐jofapo. Sambâŋ raŋɋane â mâreŋ raŋɋane jahe ine sirowepic. Erâ hâwec iŋuc jaha arictac ewec.
Eme tiri hae, Jerusalem ɋâricne hâcne, sambâŋkonec Anuturaonec wahame honepo, ŋokac biŋe moc ŋicko râeniŋte erickeeŋgopieŋ iŋuc tinac ericke emasaŋ ekicne honepo.
Eme eri ŋeŋeonec dâŋ kâcɋene ʒiŋuc wareme manapo: “Honekic, Anuture ŋeŋe hae ŋic jaŋerao fuakac hâcne. Eki ŋondeŋ‐jeŋicko ŋeŋe juju ehame jaŋe ŋicfâc‐ticne erâ juniŋmu.
Anutu e jahac jaŋerao juhuc ʒâŋeuc‐jeŋic bâkereŋke‐fâreocmu. Hâmoc me busâqoc me ki oowa me huc ʒâic ira mi fuaocmu. Wiac raŋɋanezi omae‐fârewec hâcne.”
Eme eri ŋeŋeo ŋeweczi ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Manakic, no wiac sasawa ɋâricne bâfuakopac.” Iŋuc murâ muwec: “Go qâreŋkec, dâŋ i fâri hândâŋne jâmbâŋ.”
Erâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Wiac efârekicne, no bâbâni â ʒâhec, wiac fufuŋke â babatara. Moc e opâre hâmome no juju opâ ʒâkâŋkonec fiarâ katucmâc gumepemu.
Moc e sasanaŋte gie baku batararâ wiac ʒi raucke‐fâreocmu, eme noni Anutu‐ticne erâ juhape eki motec‐nane erâ juocmu.
Hâwic bâroŋ â miti qiqikiŋ â wâwânâŋhec â ʒika qaqa â sasecŋic â hafec qaŋgec ŋic â nemuɋâŋ babaju â siocdâŋ babaju sasawa, ŋic i jaŋere ŋeŋe lambe opâre riqiczi ʒoc ʒahuc foekac ira mukicne. Izi hâmoc namba tu.”
Eme aŋelo 7 râqâc‐jeŋic sâc wiac micne momorizi fuseme badomambiŋ, jaŋeraonec moczi norao warerâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Waretec Lamare ŋokac biŋe gowatupe.”
Iŋuc murâ enareme maŋnane ŋerisieme tiki sâko ʒoricne moc ŋewec ira jowacnu ferâ tiri hae Jerusalem i sambâŋkonec Anuturaonec wahame nowatume kecʒiŋuc honepo:
Anuture eri tatamaczi geroŋke‐fârekicne. Hae irec tatamacnezi qânâ furi sâko jawa ririŋ kikicne iŋucne erâ bâric bâricneekac.
Qânâsac sâko ʒoricnezi hae râreckekac. Sac i motâc‐ticne 12, erâ motâc botâŋnao aŋelo moc moc doma rapie 12 jaha ekac, erâ wâc motâc sâc Israe ŋicguru 12 jaŋere ʒâŋe qâreŋ forakac.
Ʒoaŋ wewefunaopec motâc jahec â moc domakac, mâreŋ juwicpec motâc jahec â moc domakac, mâreŋ faicpec motâc jahec â moc domakac, â ʒoaŋ huhunaopec iŋuc jaha motâc jahec â moc domakac.
Haesac irec qânâ wâtuŋ 12 doma rakac, eme wâtuŋ 12 irec ombâŋnao Lamare aposolofâc 12 jaŋere ʒâŋe qâreŋ 12 jaha forakac.
Aŋelo dâŋ nazawec eki gunusâc moc golzi bakicne badomawec, izi hae â motâc‐ticne â sacticne sâc bawec.
Hae i tuturuŋne jahec â jahec, hâŋne otecne sâckoa. Eme aŋelozi hae rârec rârec gunusâc‐ticnezi sâc bame kilometa 2 tauseŋ ewec. Hâŋne otecne â ʒoricne sâckoa sasawa.
Eme haesac ɋâfoŋ‐ticnere sâc bame 70 meta ewec, ŋiczi sâc bajueŋgopeneŋ ijaha aŋelozi bajuhuc hae sâc bawec.
Haesac i qânâ ɋaɋacne, huririnehec izi bakicne, â hae ine gol fifimârâŋne kiruŋ ɋaɋacne iŋucne izi bakicne.
Haesac irec qânâ wâtuŋ i qânâ furi sâko fuŋne fuŋne findowakicne sasawa izi bakicne. Wâtuŋ namba 1 i qânâ ɋaɋacne kiruŋ tinac izi bakicne, wâtuŋ namba 2 i qânâ keŋkeŋne izi bakicne, wâtuŋ namba 3 i qânâ kedazi bakicne, wâtuŋ namba 4 i qânâ ârâŋ ɋâri izi bakicne,
wâtuŋ namba 5 i qânâ birâ birâ izi bakicne, wâtuŋ namba 6 i qânâ bâbâroŋzi bakicne, wâtuŋ namba 7 i qânâ âmuc âmucnezi bakicne, wâtuŋ namba 8 i qânâ buge tinac weweaŋne izi bakicne, wâtuŋ namba 9 i qânâ bâbâŋeŋzi bakicne, wâtuŋ namba 10 i qânâ râweckekicnezi bakicne, wâtuŋ namba 11 i qânâ soc tinac gogowacne izi bakicne, wâtuŋ namba 12 i qânâ qondaŋ horiki tinac izi bakicne.
Sacmotâc 12 i kubu furi sâko 12 izi bakicne, motâc moc i kubi moczi bakicne, motâc moc i kubu moczi, iŋuc sasawa. Hae hata i gol ɋaɋacnezi bakicne, kiruŋ iŋucne fifimârâŋne.
Ufuŋ ine haeo moc mi ŋeme honepo, Wofuŋ Anutu bapafâre eki ufuŋ ejareekac â Lamazi mâmâc.
Erâ hae i mosa ʒoaŋzi mi âke tamaeekac, Anuture eri tatamaczi batamaeekac â Lamazi ʒoc tatamac‐ticne eekac.
Mâreŋ sâc ŋicne ŋicne jaŋe hae irec tatamackoa jufâreniŋmu, â mâreŋ sâc ŋicwofuŋ jaŋe eri boreŋ wiac‐jeŋic hae ira bara‐fâreniŋmu.
Hae i moc mi ŋafeocmu, irec sac motâcne i ʒoaŋkore aaŋ sasawa doma‐fâreocmu.
Ŋicne ŋicne jaŋere wiac furi sâko qame hukicne, aŋac ʒizine i hae ira bara‐fâreniŋmu.
Wiac wâwânâŋhec ine moc mi raʒi‐jâmbâŋkeocmu. Â ŋic moczi wiac mamakâcne me burec bajuocmu, e hae ira wâc mi raʒiocmu. Ʒâŋe‐jeŋic Lamare juju sanaŋ papiao qâreŋkekicne jaŋe sawa raʒiniŋmu.
Eme aŋelozi juju opâ sâko moc nowatume honepo, ɋaɋacne, jawa ririŋ kikicne. I Anutu â Lama ere eri ŋeŋe fuŋkonec wahakac.
Waharâ hae hata ʒâʒâŋiŋnao rakac. Opâ mecnao ŋifec â ŋifec jujujâc doma rakac. Jâc irec fârine hawarine fuŋne fuŋne 12 izi mosa sâc fua qeuc eekac. Eme mâreŋ sâc ŋic jaŋe jâc irec rehacne nâhuc biaŋkeniŋmu.
Hae ira wiac sâwechec mi foocmu. Anutu â Lama ere ŋeŋe hae ira hâcne fuame ŋicfâc‐ticne jaŋe kiŋaŋ qacnehuc juniŋmu.
Erâ hawari‐ticne honehuc juniŋmu, â ʒâŋe qâreŋ‐ticne mai‐jeŋicko fuarâ foocmu.
Hae i mi ŋafeocmu, erâ lambe me ʒoaŋ tatamacnere mi muniŋmu, Wofuŋ Anutu e jahac ʒoaŋ ejareocmu. Eme hae rune jaŋe ŋicwofuŋ gie barahuc juniŋmu sanaŋ.
Eme aŋelozi ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Dâŋ i fâri hândâŋne jâmbâŋ. Wofuŋ Anutu porofete ejareme maŋjeŋic ŋerisieekac, eki hâcne aŋelo‐ticne soreme kiŋaŋ qaqafâc‐ticne ŋoŋe wiac, mi ʒoraha fuaocte mukicne i ŋaza ŋowatuc ewec.
Manakic, no biac fâpemu, eme moc e papia kecʒira findaŋdâŋ qâreŋkekicne i sisirombe faio bajuocmu e ʒeri bubiaŋ manacnezo.”
Eme Johane no hâcne wiac i hone manac efârepo. Hone manac efârerâ aŋelo wiac nowatuwec ere maŋfuŋko fodaperâ numucnezo ehape
qatara‐narerâ muwec: “Misac mac, no kiŋaŋ qaqa âgoge, erâ porofete qomâfâcge jaŋere âgo, â papia ʒirec dâŋ aimuŋ bajuniŋmu jaŋere âgo jaha. Go Anutu e jahacne sawa daŋge nunumu ecnec.”
Iŋuc murâ ʒiŋuc nazawec: “Go papia ʒirec findaŋdâŋ fâzâ mi bazemec. Dâŋ i fârinehec eocte dameŋne bembeŋkekac hâcne.
Irec sâqocne bapa e sâqocne bazo murâ bazejec, â maŋwânâŋheczi maŋwânâŋhec juzo murâ juzejec, â mitio juekaczi ine mitioa juzejec, â maŋfuru juekaczi maŋfuru jaha juzejec.”
“Manakic, no biac fâpemu. Okacnehec fâ fisirâ ŋic juju bapa‐ŋeŋicte tofa sâckoa bazu‐ŋarepemu.
No bâbâni â ʒâhec, fuŋne â botâŋne, wiac fufuŋke â babatara.
Ŋaqi‐jeŋic ʒure ɋaɋackeeŋgopieŋ jaŋere manape ʒerine ekac. Jaŋe hâcne mujarepe jujujâckonec fârine nânʒepieŋ â hae irec maŋnao raʒinʒepieŋ.
Hae râpenao juniŋmu ine qâto â hafec qaŋgec bapa â sasecŋic â ʒika qaqa â nemuɋâŋ babaju erâ burec bajuhuc irec aŋac‐jopaekac.
“Jesu no hâcne aŋelo‐nane sorepe eki kikefuŋ gurufâc‐nane ŋoŋe mumutaniŋ dâŋ i mufua‐ŋarewec. No hâcne Dawidire fuŋqizecne â oso gitecne, erâ bâpiŋ sâko tatamachec.”
Mâro â Jesure biŋefâc jaŋe ʒiŋuc mueŋgopieŋ: “Go warezemec.” Â moc e dâŋ ʒi manarâ iŋuc jaha muzejec: “Go warezemec.” Moc e opâre hâmorâ ʒira fisizejec. Â moc e irec ecnekacko ware juju opâ furimâc nâzejec.
Papia kecʒira findaŋdâŋ qâreŋkekicne i wose manac eniŋmu ŋoŋe uŋ ŋazape mananiŋ: Moc e maŋticnere dâŋ moc ʒuhuckeocmu, ŋic e Anutuzi wiac micne momori papia kecʒira qâreŋkekicne i ʒuhuckecneocmu wâc,
â moc e findaŋdâŋ ʒi âke sipuocmu, ŋic erao Anutuzi jujujâcte dâŋ â tiri haere dâŋ ʒi qâreŋkekicne iŋuc jaha âke sipuocmu.
Dâŋ mufuakicne ʒi dopeckekaczi ʒiŋuc mukac: “Jâmbomac, no biac fâpemu.” Jâmbomac, Wofuŋ Jesu go warezemec.
Wofuŋ Jesure aki anonoczi ŋoŋerao fofârezejec. Jâmbomac.
